review_text: Pretty much any place that has decent pizza and stays open until 2 a.m. is fine by me. EBA's is not the absolute best pizza in town; honestly C&A is better. But EBA's does have good pizza, a much cleaner store, a nicer staff, and they're open later. So they get my vote every single time. The buff chick (buffalo chicken pizza) is essential to your life. Trust me on this. So are the chicken nachos. Their other food is good, and at lunch it's ridiculously cheap compared to other stuff in the area, but those are the best by far.
This place is awesome.. And as a Chilean that is all I am going to say about it haha. But seriously it is great food.

We have Going to Downtown Hftd-Sorella since around beginning of January& My daughter & I decided to Eat in, usually order out at Sorella on Fridays, but We decided to eat in..The 2nd waitress was NOT so Pleasant but we were Excited to Finally to sit & Relax especially it was a bit hot outside..The waitress seemed Annoyed that We chose to sit in, from the looks of the place it was Slow&NO One there at 3:20pm..So WHAT was the Problem??.We were waiting for my other daughter to show up&this waitress told us to sit Anywhere &DIDN'T bring us Any plates, Guess we were supposed to eat from the Appetizer plates..As she took the seasoning from the table Not asking if We wanted it there,she Reached over my glass of $3.50 Lemonade touching my straw w/ her arms! If I WANTED hair on my straw I would have put it THERE especially Didn't care to her Cigarette Smelly hands!.When a Waitress goes out for a Smoke, GO on your Break&WASH your hands!.This Waitress Didn't bother to ask how our meal was! But Our Favorite Hostess 'Taylor' Politely Greeted Us as Usual&asked how our meal was..This waitress cleared the table AGAIN she reaches over our heads&plates?.We decided NOT to have our dessert there since we were made to feel we Needed to Clear the table for Invisible customers Waiting..My daughter waited for the Waitress to come back because she wanted to take her drink w/her, after waiting for Over 5minutes for the Waitress WHO was busy talking to the pizza maker, she had to get up&ask her can she bring a cup to the table..How RUDE to Roll your Eyes at a Young College-age Regular customer!!.We are NEVER RUDE to Anyone There!.Like WOW!.A 'child's cup'??!!.How Insulting to a 20 yr old to Receive this from a Waitress especially when you Get your Bill the Tip is Automatically TAKEN out!.15% Tip!..She WASN'T Worth Any Tips!.And to Rush Off to talk to the pizza maker&To NOTICE she's Talking Badly about Us&Rolling her eyes!..THANKS WORSE Waitress in Sorella We WON'T GO Back to Order a Full meal NOR Will we go Back on Fridays&Our sometimes 2-3xs a wk Order out!! THANKS for helping to make up Our minds because my 16yr old WHO was PAYING Today, Chose NOT to Invite her 10 Friends for a get to Together to visit from Simsbury to Hftd-Sorella!.The Only GOOD thing I can say is the Our Regular Hostess Taylor is a GEM to Sorella&ALWAYS Polite&Friendly!!.This Waitress Can Learn What it means to have Superb Customer Service especially w/a Diverse Customers that Are PAYING for the Food We are Going to Eat..Were BETTER Off eating at a Nice Restaurant in West Hartford center/Blue Back Square than come back to Downtown Sorella!!.

I had dinner here with two of my girlfriends on Sunday night. Cute ambiance, good decor, good menu variety. The service was fine, but did not go above and beyond. I found the food to be a bit flavorless- including the pizza & riceballs. While I didn't think this place was overprices for tapas, the $12 cheese place included a small glob of gorgonzola and about 4 slices of some other cheese along with about 6 blueberries and some nuts. It was not a cheese plate. It was a fruit and nut plate with some cheese. $12? This is not Nolita. This is Astoria. Let's get to my favorite part: The end... ...where the waiter told us it was cash only. AT THE END OF THE MEAL. The waiter apologized that he forgot to tell us prior to the beginning of the meal, but I asked to see a manager. I've worked in restaurants my whole life- and I've never experienced such rude behavior from a manager, let alone, the OWNER. We were confused as to why we were never told it was cash only and he proceeded to point to a sign, in the front of the restaurant, about 15 feet in the air (see the picture of the small smudged chalkboard). My friend told him we didn't see it, I'm pretty sure no one in the restaurant did because two tables next to us heard our conversation and were disappointed to find out that it was cash only. The owner told us that their computer had been broken for weeks (odd, considering this place JUST opened like 2 weeks ago) and that was that. I've experienced this before with "cash-only" places like this and they usually don't get it fixed so they can avoid paying taxes and make more money by not reporting all their sales since they're only accepting cash. After telling is it was broken, the owner facetiously apologized, told us we'd get a discount, told us there was an ATM around the corner and then DISMISSED US before abruptly walking away. I was appalled, as were my friends and the other customers around us. We never even got the discount. I will definitely NOT be back.
Liked: - Good service -- the host and waiter were great - Meat stuffed olives - Pork sausage Wish were different: - Porchetta tasted like turkey from the Walmart deli - Food service was pretty slow!

Love this place! Very casual feel but the sushi makes up for it. The place has an interesting menu that includes sushi, chinese american, japanese, and a touch of Thai. And yes BYOB - they have an ice bucket if you need it chilled! The pyramid roll is my pick here, followed by C-4 roll. These are beautifully crafted and taste as good as they look!
Very, very good food! Strongly recommended to everyone who is around! Everything was very fresh and super tasty! Plus very polite service! One of my fav place in this neighborhood!!!

Tons of banchan anywhere from 13-15 different kinds! I normally order the tofu soup and eat only half because I'm so full off the banchan! My daughter and husband always order the BBQ- although very pricey. When you order the BBQ combinations (for 3-4 people) you also get a tofu soup, steamed egg dish, Korean pancake! Even though it's pricey the combos are worth the money. My daughter has ordered the chicken Katsu before (they also serve Japanese) and she enjoyed it. The fried rice is ok, not the best I've had. Recommend you stick with the Korean menu items.

Oh my gosh their nachos. I've had basically nothing but beef fajita nachos, and that's completely okay with me. They deliver quickly, and it's DELICIOUS. My displacement from Texas is relieved by Taqueria Diana.
i order some egg roll and pho to go sometimes, good place to takeout in the area

Really disappointed by the service here.  I ordered a virgin coconut drink that is usually alcoholic.  I have never, anywhere been charged full price for a virgin drink (almost ten bucks for some coconut milk and sugar).  We thought this was a mistake so we pointed it out to our server who told us that it is what is rather shortly.  I will not be returning.  NOt to mention mediocre choices for a vegetarian.

Ever since I tried California sushi for the first time a year ago, I have never gone to a different sushi restaurant. I now attend bi-weekly with my boyfriend. Love the staff and the byob offer (there's even a package store right next door for convince AND they'll heat up your saki for you!) ... Dobt forget to get the smoked salmon Sashimi which melts in your mouth!!!  can't wait to go back already!! YUMMOOOOOOOO

Just turned vegetarian and this is my first time here. I love this place already. The older guy was nice when I placed my order he catered to my every need. I got the vegetarian roti wrap. It has potatoes collar-greens and pumpkin rolled on this wrap. I don't like the cakie things between the roti but the rest of the food is great! I'm really satisfied with the whole experience! And it was super fast!!!

Friends and loved ones always hate this place. I've never had luck bringing anyone here. It's always something different and pointless to explain. All businesses on the prospect/franklin cross-street have always been cursed. However, they have frozen margaritas on tap and serve them in a tall plastic cup. I simply support that in no uncertain terms. Too few places are meeting this need. I don't want to get out the blender, or have any local bartender go mixologist on a frozen marg for 15 bones before tip. I simply want a decent, giant, frozen margarita, flushed out of a slushy machine and into a plastic cup with a straw. That is 5 stars period. The staff is nice. You would have to be.

Last night we had a splendid dinner to celebrate our daughter and friend's move to Bklyn. I have to say starting with the warm greeting from manager Brayon to the waitstaff service they did not disappoint. The food was consistently excellent, great variety of craft beers and delicious dessert. If you order the pork chop in mustard sauce you must go in the kitchen and hug the chef!!  No doubt we will be back.

If this place were a band it would be the Beatles! Wait! I have already used that in a review. Ok, try this on for size (heavy metal music blasting): on front desk introducing Jinhee (but pronounced Jeannie), working the sides her fiance Johnny, and my man on the grill ( music creshendo) Kleaver!!!! Too much? Good. Now that I have your attention I will do the rest of the review in my normal voice. :-) Lots of restaurants are started every year. Every once in awhile you get a place where you want to see the owners and staff succeede. This is one of those places. This past saturday was my first time here and I plan a return visit. I went with one of my friends and his mom after a day of helping with chores. My entree was the beef brisket with a biscuit and gravy side. The brisket was an amazing bite size with red BBQ sauce. Nice and tangy without being overpowering. The light flaky biscuit was accompanied by melt in your mouth white sausage gravy. Our party also split some of the best fries I have ever tasted. This was the nosh fries with sausage gravy and pico de gallo. The pork bellies were crispy and juicy. The collard greens are some of the best I ever tasted. Finally it is staffed by some of the nicest people. I have found a new NYC spot after visiting this city every year for 20 years. Go to this place. You will not regret it!

Andrews is a God send for those of us on a gluten free diet. The sandwiches are so good I've had them all. The Irish is my personal favorite. The cakes are so so good I treat myself to a nice big slice from time time and it can almost bring a tear to my eye. Andrews gets pretty crowded and dining in may be uncomfortable.  Please call your order in advance as the food is so fresh and the sandwiches so big each order takes awhile. Andrew for President!

This place is different from the other places in new haven. The quality and taste stands out from the rest. Wok one is cheaper than other places and does not make me feel sick like other chinese restaurants. Order the general tsos chicken with traditional white fried rice.

My GPS directed me here after typing in "diner" as soon as we for off the GWB. Well... Thank you Garmin. We had the most enjoyable server. He told jokes to my children and bartered healthy eating habits for ice cream. My Cobb Salad was on point and the rest of the family gobbled up their food. The huge sign that said "World Famous Cheesecake" was not false advertising. We all split the chocolates covered cheesecake and there was not a crumb left. Great find after a long car ride.
Friggin fantastic macarons! Woww!  Worth the price and hype of it all ! Check this place out. Totally worth it!  The vanilla macaron is my favorite. Melts in your mouth ! Fantastic!

Give me Roly Poly ANY DAY over Subway or Quizno's! The food might be pricier, but everything is really good and it's a lot more exciting for one's tastebuds. I highly recommend whichever sandwich it is that has brie and ham, and I THINK plum sauce, as that was one of the best sandwiches I've ever had. The New Haven location is especially nice, the staff seems friendly, and it's a good place to wait for the buses near the New Haven Green.

Pizza is always doughy and way over priced. The old man who owns it is rude and has no customer service. Will not be returning when these issues should be standards. Pizza also sits out a longtime and looks old.

I've stopped in here for wine and appetizers on a few occasions. The wine list is decent, & local cheeses are nice. For atmosphere, I'd describe this place a a great destination if you are having a liaison you want to keep on the DL. It's darkish and hidden despite being smack in the middle of down town. Secret agents take note ... This is where you want to meet your unnamed contact!

Love this place so much. The food is delicious every single time we go there! You will not be disappointed. Every time I go I order something different and this place seems to amaze me every single time!!!!!
Had the worst food poisoning in my life after eating here.  (Puked my guts out and diarrhea.)  It doesn't even deserve one star.

Beautiful decor, but disappointing brunch.  They forewarned me that they didn't have pork sausages and would be replacing them with bacon, no big deal. What they didn't tell us was that they didn't have broccoli rabe for their broccoli rabe pizza. Instead, we were given burnt scallion topped pizza.  My roasted potatoes were also burnt, as was a neighboring patron's bacon.  Not just slightly burnt, but entirely black and inedible.  I was honestly surprised that they would even think to serve it. Eggs were a tad on the salty side, and toast was difficult to chew. When I had asked a random waiter if they thought scallions were broccoli rabe, it was then that they took notice and apologized for the screwup. The only redeeming quality of this restaurant was that they removed the pizza from our bill.   I'd like to think that this past Sunday was just a bad fluke.  Hopefully I'll come back one day and not leave unhappy.

We came to New York for Pizza and this was EXACTLY what we were looking for. After getting a recommendation from a fantastic tour guide, my boyfriend and I went to Juliana's for supper while roaming around Brooklyn. IT WAS AMAZING. Though he is a true pizza lover, I am rather picky when it comes to my 'za (no Domino's for this girl). I was floored. The small was more than enough for us to split (we took 2 slices home and were FULL) and the price was right on point! We ordered the first pizza from the Classics section: The Margherita and added Sausage with fennel, Pepperoni, and garlic. Literally the best pizza I have ever had. I would go back to Brooklyn just for a bite!

I took my fiancee to Korchma Taras Bulba for her birthday. She's 50% Ukrainian so I knew she would enjoy it. What I didn't know was how much I was going to enjoy it. The staff was kind and attentive and they really wanted us to soak in the Ukrainian culture...they have Ukrainian movies and music playing and they took our pictures in traditional Ukrainian hats. They also sang Happy Bday to my fiancee after overhearing that it was her birthday. They discreetly asked me what her name was when I was walking to the bathroom and they took it from there, giving her a free piece of cake and birthday drink as well. I'm no expert on Ukrainian food, but I thought the Borscht, Potato Draniki and the Olivier were really good...especially the Borscht and I am normally not a fan of beets. The chicken a la Kiev was good, but the cabbage rolls changed my life : )  And then there's the vodka. The apple cinnamon was my favorite, but the horseradish was awesome too. Good stuff all around. Can't wait to go back.

This place USED to be awesome - then they changed management & ownership, and have really gone downhill. We have ordered catering for our business numerous times, and everyone at the office complained that the sandwiches weren't that great. So then I went a few more times individually and ordered a few diff things - the chicken cheesesteak is so gross I ended up throwing it all in the garbage! The next time I ordered an Italian sub, and how can you really mess up an Italian sub? Well, they managed to and it had literally NO flavor! I think they changed their orders for meats or something because they taste like garbage! I finally stopped going there as I was wasting almost $9-10 on a SUB, which is outrageously overpriced. Such a shame as they used to be phenomenal...

To echo what some of these reviewers stated the food here was fantastic. I came here for the first time with my dad years ago and loved it. Came back here on July 20th with my gf and we both instantly fell in love with the place. The food was great but I would like to say that it was their servers that really helped pushed me to review. They were kind and professional, in fact they were kind of busy that night but we never felt forgotten. I highly suggest this place for first dates. Also go for the Passion Fruit Sangeria!

Had lunch there. Was offered a community table and declined due to the fact that those seats didn't have seatbacks. There is lots of bread here, so if you're into the Paleo thing, not a lot of options.  I ordered a salad and asked them to add turkey meat to it, which they obliged. Everything is made fresh, behind the counter in plain view. My salad had awesome dressing in it- maybe blu cheese based. Also, the most phenomenal bacon bits ever. Service was good. Nice job.

I USED to come here about once a week with my wife, until we tried to get a late brunch on a Sunday at 245. Half the dining room was empty and the host told me there was no room for a stroller,  I guess there isn't room in the register for my money.  I loved the food but FOH needs to realize this isn't Manhattan.

I've eaten at Claire's on several occasions and have enjoyed it (even as someone who prefers meat). Great variety of food! Always something new to try! My husband and I actually used Claire's to order our wedding cakes. We wanted a variety so we ordered seven different cakes for our 100 guests! Our guest LOVED the variety and trying all different sorts. Claire's also has so many gluten-free, vegan options that ALL of our guests were able to find something they enjoyed!
Excellent food. Really nice staff. I definitely will be coming back.   Rice pudding was perhaps  a little too sweet but the rest was outstanding.
Love this place, so much food!!!!

I've ordered from these guys plenty of times. The food and delivery service is great. Lots of options too in their menu. I remember ordering a lamb platter once from here and when I got to eating my lamb, I started to think about that kid's show, "Lambchop," or whatever it is and I started feeling bad? Weirdest experience ever, but I thought that I'd mention that (time for the creepy stares at me now). Anyways, the food here is great. Check them out if you like healthy food that tastes great.

Stopped in around 5pm and sat at the bar which wasn't clean and felt sticky They have new touch screen menus so I tried fooling around with it to see how it works but the bartender came over and asked what I wanted. I asked for a diet coke and a menu He walked away and I put it down and a bug the size of a nickel fell out of it It crawled under the bar and I was like ooooooooo k The bartender came back gave me my menu but not the diet coke At this point I was thinking about leaving When I looked up and saw him mixing drinks and ineptly spilling the contents of one of the bottles (now he had to stop and clean it up) I bailed This place was NOT busy where he couldn't stop serve a diet coke along with the menu and get back to his drinks Never coming back here... NEVER

I went here with my friends because we saw that they have late night happy hour. We were extremely unsatisfied with our experience. We asked for water from our waitress multiple times, and after an hour the busboy brought it out for us. The place was packed and felt more like a club than restaurant, it was so noisy. Also, the bathroom was so rundown and smelled terribly. Not to mention that the food was subpar and lacked taste and dimension. The dumplings were way too spicy and then the chicken skewers were so bland. I would not recommend this place to anyone and I was extremely unsatisfied with the experience.
Nasty waitstaff.  They are happy to repeat their policy, rather then trying to be the least bit helpful.  If you want to overpay for food, and be abused at the same time, this is the place.
the pork & chicken mixed broth is too heavy for me. the char sew and noodle are good

Stopped by on a Saturday morning about half hour after they opened (fresh batch!) had a table for 6 and was seated right away as we had our own table. Sharing tables when eating with strangers is kind of awkward for me but that's just me. The server immediately knows that their soup dumplings are popular by asking right away if we wanted pork or crabmeat and pork. 6 trays of dumplings were on the way and we went to demolish them. Next thing you know, bill arrives after we went to work and out the door we went as the line continued to build outside.

Service was very slow, not sure the waiter was ever a waiter before. Sat waiting for cream for my coffee for 10 minutes. Asked what was on my dessert, waiter did not know. He said sugar but it was a nut rolled in sugar. Food was good - not fab! Presentation of food on plate could of been nicer. For the price $$$$ could of been a step above.

Great staff, great food.  I visit Philly frequently (used to live in the Fairmount neighborhood), and this is really the best Mexican I've had in Philly.  On Saturday I ordered their version of shrimp and grits -- grilled shrimp on tequila-spiked grits.  That dish is perfection.

My first time and I am a convert! Hands down beats some others in the neighborhood. Clean, bright, sleek, inviting room for a quick meal.  Menu boards are a bit confusing but the staff are beyond helpful and friendly. The choices are numerous and the food is soooo fresh. I constructed my own salad bowl and was delighted with the subtle flavorings of the chickpeas, beets and Israeli/Moroccan salad. The falafel is yummy and crisp but not oily. I will definitely be back and pass the word about Abaleh. Next time I will try the juices.

I am giving this place one star due to the horrible service that I received there. The food was good but the customer service was horrible. I had a large order and they only allowed me to order half of the it and then made me get in the back of the line to wait agin to order the rest. I was told if I ordered it all at once I would hold up the line. I spent a lot of money there to be treated very rudely. When I waited in line again to order the rest of it the girl behind the counter was very dismissive and rude. I will not be going back to that place again. If you have a larger than normal order be warned you will have to stand in line twice.
Best of everything here.  Chicken, sandwiches and the chicken with rice/white sauce is to die for!

I feel bad giving this place 2 stars because it's cute and I was so excited to go there. I'll start by saying the sushi I got was really good. My first impression was that the prices were good too, that was until I witnessed the portion sizes. If you're going to get sushi here, I most certainly recommend just getting the $3 rolls. (From now on I'll be going to City Market, despite how overpriced I consider it to be, because they offer twice as much for the price + a tomato on the side) Second, this place ain't no Japanese market, unless of course you'd qualify one as a wall display of 3 various miso soup mixes. The cooler they had was 3/4 empty. The bentos did look pretty good.. but I wasn't about to throw down $10. There were also mad flies surrounding the sushi chef.
This spot is a gem! Food was excellent!  Talk about a lot of food. I had the chicken parm hero, tried the NY style & Sicilian style pizzas and Cesar salad. All of it was AMAZING.

My sister and I wanted to go to different NYC restaurant: before theatre. We have been to Becco, Oceana, Joe Allen,and several others ( I will not mention) We wanted something different, with good food and near theatre. We decided on Hourglass Tavern after reading many of the wonderful reviews. the restaurant has a first floor (about 6 tables) second floor with bar and Bette's Bar on top floor. Menu is varied, appt, salads, comfort food, classic Italian dishes and the "best spinach pie I ever had: $4.50 a piece..made to order. Prices are very reasonable for NYC. Try it!!!

Mamoun's falafel is a quick down to earth place that may not seem appealing from the outside but I must say that their food says otherwise. If you want to eat Shawarma and not Gyro or any of the street cart food and still be in Manhattan this is your place. I always get the shawarma platter with sides of falafel and hummus - very good and filling. P.S: don't forget the extra tahini sauce on the side

First Post, I am being pro-active against the saying that people are more likely to post a bad review than a good one and giving some of my favorite establishments a nod. Grew up in Windsor since the age of 5, my grandfather and father before me swear by this place, and so do I. I am what you would call, a human ninja turtle. My favorite food is pizza, I can polish off a large pie from anywhere I have been single-handedly. It's freakish, I only weigh about 170. I eat Pizza EVERYWHERE I go, I have been to Italy, Greece, Chicago, all the boroughs of New York. The only pizzas to rival Wilson for me were Lou Malnati's in Chicago, the ORIGINAL Frank Pepe in New Haven (The expansions are lackluster), and a spot that had no name I could see in Rome (It was close to the Vatican). I would call it an even tie between Frank Pepe's since if you aren't a fan of thin NY style pizza Pepe won't be amazing for you. Me, personally, I love ALL pizza. To anyone who complains about the health factor of a pizza, seriously? If you are such a carb counter then a place called "Wilson Pizza Palace" should be off of your radar. The pies are bursting with flavor, and they are very generous with toppings. Their grinders are enormous and best if eaten on the spot. Their other food I have not explored, the Pizza / Grinders are just too darn good. But some friends tell me everything they make is good. I know the family that owns the place, they are good people and keep everything very fresh and very clean. Do not be fooled by the janky appearance of the building, it is just a piece of Windsor history.

Brought my boyfriend to Upstate and he was absolutely impressed with the food. We also waited for an hour and it is really worth the hour wait. Not having a full bar was a thumb down for my boyfriend but I was more annoyed with how our waiter was rushing us through the drink and entrée selection. Regardless, the food was amazing and we are going back for more seafood and beer :)

This place is the best!  Georgian food is an experience and the owners are passionate about sharing it.  Everything about this restaurant is quality and the owners are cutting no corners on delivering the very best food at reasonable (for NYC) prices. If trying a cuisine you've never heard of seems a little daunting, just stick with the Khinkali (think dumpling, but better than anything you are used to) and Khachapuri (think delicious warm bread with eggs and cheese and other goodness baked right in).  It's like eating comfort food while trying an entirely new cuisine - delicious through and through. Georgia is also famous for its wines, and now that Old Tbilisi Garden has its liquor license, I can't wait to go back and check out what they have to offer!

i love love love this place.  star was friendly and they kept checking on us to make sure we were good which i love.  They have really good specials during the week and the ambiance was amazing and i would definitely come again.
Love this place. Amazing sangria and great customer service! I love coming here for mojito madness. Its the only reason i love Mondays

So Delicious! Order the 1/4 Chicken platter. It comes with a small fresh salad, rice and beans. The Sweet Plantains and Yucca get two thumbs up as well! Fresh juice is great too - try the Carrot, Apple and Ginger. I was surprised that I got so much food for such a small price :) and even happier that the food is so satisfying and healthy at the same time. They deliver!

food is pretty good. very hole in the wall place. my friend got the mussels and says it was amazing and he got double the amount of mussels he usually gets. so it was a lot of mussels. I got the chicken and it was delicious too though I was still hungry afterward. but I do eat a lot...
I haven't had popovers since I left the UWS 15 years ago!! Great service and excellent food. This is the area's best option right now, and one of the best new restaurants to open.

Great menu (chinese-style noodle soups are a must), just a strange location -- hotel lobby University City. It would be one of the nicest places in Chinatown. The food is great and cheap, and the service is usually extraordinary (unless it's swamped).
I've been here a few times. Great vibe, good drinks, and they have some of the best fish tacos around. I'll be back.
Nice place  and awesome food.

Went to the Orange Squirrel for dinner this Friday. Had a bit of a mixed experience. While the food was delicious, the service was a little lacking. It was a struggle to get the waiters attention at first. My girlfriend and I started off ordering a cocktail. I received my drink quickly, however, my girlfriend had to wait an additional 5 minutes for hers. There was no reason given and no apology for the unusual wait. In addition to this, the martini she ordered came out in a wine glass which was odd.   After having a cocktail, we attempted to order a half bottle of wine to share over dinner, however, we were told that they were out of both half bottles and full bottles of wine. The food itself was delicious, I had the duck breast entree which I would recommend.  There were a lot of unique items on the menu. Our experience could have been better though. With several good dining options in the area, I am not sure if i would try it again.

This was my first time eating here and it was amazing! I would definitely recommend this place to a friend. Prices are reasonable, staff is friendly, and it's a really nice environment. The food is OUTSTANDING. We went mainly for tapas. We ordered 6 tapas for 3 people and it was the perfect amount (maybe go for 5 if you are not too hungry). My personal favorite was the cheese gnocchi / dumplings. Mm so good!
Dont buy any muffins here .. purchased one and when I got home and unwrapped it it was green molded...
Best Pizza Jersey's got...... Dam good pie!

I'm surprised this place has received so many decent reviews. There is hardly anyone ever at the bar, even during the World Cup, which should have been my sign to stay away.  Let's start with the food, it was pretty awful. The only decent item on the menu are the fries. That's it! The apps we ordered were bland and oily. The waitress commented on how little we are. Next, the service - There were maybe 15 people in the entire place and the service was extremely slow. From reading the reviews it seems like this is an ongoing issue. It was so bad that I had to walk up to the waitress while she was texting in the corner to place my order. Um...really?!! Lastly, the drinks weren't great either and the beers seemed to be a bit pricey. I won't be coming back. If you're in the area, go somewhere else!

Walked past the window last week, tried the Cortadito and it was amazing. Best cuban coffee I have had while in NYC, i was so happy i went back yesterday and tried a sandwich. I will definitely be going back for lunch!!
I love this place. Everything is authentic and freshly made. The best mussels I have had in my life.

Looks a bit worn and faded from the outside but the food is wonderful, not expensive, the staff always attentive and very polite.  Have eaten here multiple times and have always enjoyed it.  They cater to both vegetarians and meat eaters.   Delicious.

I came here early with my Grandson on a Thursday a few weeks ago, around 11/1130. There was no line, and the service was fast. Interesting to see what all of these people have been writing about. I think the pizza was good, but nothing like what all of these critics and people rave about. It's sad, but it seems not too many folks travel these days, or every review would say the same thing - "nice try to simulate what has been perfected in Italy". But it was good.

What a disappointment. I'm angry I wasted money there. A woman at blue marble recommended it to me when I asked where I could get a sandwich. I ordered the turkey and cheese. It was almost $10 and then I asked about adding avocado since it seemed kinda plain and with not much on it for the price. She charged me an additional $1.50 for the addition, bringing my sandwich to practically $12. And then it was bland as can be. I had to add salt and mustard, and ate it because I was hungry, but I was mad. If you're gonna charge $10 and up for a sandwich, it better be pretty special and at the least could include the avocado and some chips or a pickle. Why do these places think it's ok to charge so much for mediocrity? Because we'll pay it? I am not falling for it next time and sticking to a damn deli.
Best home cooked meals around... Hands down. Great portion size, healthy ingredients and amazing variety. Amazing :)

I've been here many many times. I've enjoyed every experience but one and that was because a new slow server. Every other time has been delicious and delightful. This last time I was there I had a reservation for 6pm and arrived 4 minutes early. They said they weren't open til 6pm. I waited for them to seat me off to the side. This was bizarre cause they usually open at 5 for happy hour but whatever. It was a Wednesday so they had discount sushi! I know that sounds sketchy but I've never had a problem and neither has my boyfriend (I'm a vegetarian and he is not). We usually get veggie udon noodles to share and a mixture sushi. If you have a vegetarian friend that misses sushi, bring them here! I recommend the futomaki roll....drooll....It's so GOOD! Definitely come here when you want a relaxed and delicious sushi experience! The drinks are also good. Happy hour has $6 martinis yummm =)

I love Scott's Pizza Tour. Scott had so much energy and knew all there was to know about pizza. It was fun, entertaining, and delicious.The pizza itself was amazing. Scott was insanely knowledgeable in every aspect of pizza.I highly recommend it! Loved it!I have never seen someone who loves pizza like Scott! His passion truly comes through as he gets you to explore what makes a great slice of pizza! A great chance to eat, truly appreciate, and learn how to recreate the experience in your own kitchen.
This is too good to be true. It's like home cooked meal below 72nd st. So need this fix once in a whole!  Great find!

This was probably the best sandwiches I've ever had, and the decor was fun. We got the Iraqi Turkey, Lebanese Lamb, and Jamaican Avocado with Turkey. The flavors were tremendous in all of them. The location is off the beaten path, but it worth the short walk from the downtown area. Additionally, it is located next door the Citizen Cider Cidery where they have a tasting flight. Great way to wash down the sandwich.

This place is so overly expensive, it was a joke. I paid $34 for 2 pieces of lamb and a huge chunk of fat, the size of 2 dominoe pieces. It was a joke. $4 for a soda... IT'S SODA!!! There's no iced gold bullion in there to chill the soda, just soda. $14 for, get ready for this... A sweet potatoe. C'mon! The wait staff was good, hence why there are 2 stars. Never again.

We had a business happy hour here and it was fabulous. Cocktails, served apps and good service.  Drinks and apps were spot on and the outdoor rooftop atmosphere is perfect when the weather is 70 to 82.

A family favorite. Perfect for family dinners, business dinners or dates. Food is always spectacular. Service is great and very attentive. Gluten free options or substitutions available if needed. We have also had parties there in the back room- was great, food was enjoyed by all. One thing to be noted is that reservations are often needed unless a weekday. So many options on the menu, and there are always is a great selection of daily specials. I could not rave anymore about this place!

The guys behind the counter are really nice. And the burgers are awesome we got The Up Side and the Truffle Burger were cooked perfect. This is a you have to stop. Not quite a must stop but close. Next time your in Philly or live here just try it. In my top 5 places for a great burger.

A SUPER beautiful dining experience, not to mention yummy :) The restaurant has an awesome air to it - comfortable, artsy, and natural. We sat inside (though the outside dining garden looked very cute) and I loved all of the detail from the various walls, the cool tables, the pretty plates, and really cool restroom. Split a Spanish cheese plate- delish!, and then had the scallops and swordfish for dinner (my Mom and I). Both were bursting with new flavors and cooked to perfection. A real treat, from start to finish, with great service as well! Totally recommend this yummy restaurant!

The best pizza in NYC and maybe even the U.S. The price is a little high ($5 a slice) but all of the ingredients are imported from Italy so I don't mind paying for quality. Di Fara's pizza has so much flavor and is worth the trip to Brooklyn!
The greatest.

I have to say that I get a little angry when this pizza is left of the top 10 lists for best pizza in New York. I think people get down on Lombardi's for not being the hidden gem that it once was but I personally think they do an amazing job of handling the crowds and have never, in any way, compromised the quality of their pizza. We went on a busy Friday night and were expecting to wait a while for a table. Not the case. The waitstaff runs a very tight ship and they've done a great job of maximizing the space in the building. Now for the pizza itself. You come here for the oven. Just ask the Culinary Institute of America that regularly takes samples of the wall of this oven to try to figure out why it makes the pizza taste so good. No matter what you order, make sure you get at least one original margherita pizza. This is the pizza where you have the best chance of tasting what makes this place special. It's a crispy flavorful crust, ultra fresh red sauce and perfectly sliced circles of mozzarella. That's it. So f@@(&#^$ good!! Not that it needs it but the service is fast and attentive and somehow you never seem to be waiting long for your food (the oven is gigantic). I won't knock John's or Totono's or any of the other great pizza places in NYC but this is definitely my favorite.

Had to come back for pancakes! Ordered one to be good but was so delicious I wished I was bad and ordered full stack! Perfectly crisp on outside but moist and fluffy on inside with great flavor! Had side of scrambled eggs and bacon- also perfectly done! Brilliant! But too crazy for brunch on wknd

Had a similar experience to D.S. This place must be astroturfing votes on Yelp, I had the tofu & spinach, grape leaves, and soup, all were tasteless at best and inedible at worst. Service is mediocre and slow.

I visited this restaurant when my husband and I were on our way to Newark Airport.  This restaurant was a pleasant surprise.  We found it online and decided to try it.  The staff (she may be the owner) was very friendly.  We felt like we were friends instantly.  The sushi and sashimi we ordered were very fresh. We will definitely visit again.

We work in the area and the Bantry Bay is our 'go to" place. We visit often and eat there regularly. The food is really good and very well priced. The bartenders are outstanding. We hold our company holiday party there each year and are never disappointed.
My husband and I went here last week. I was craving Thai food! OMG the Basil chicken with veggies was so delicious! And the prices are really low too!

A staple of Chinatown for many years now.  You know what your getting when you come here.  Spotty service with good/decent Chinese food at fair prices. Expect anything else and you are reaching.  Nothing on the menu to me really stands out out more than others, it really just depends what your in the mood for or what your body is craving.

The fact that the Bao Shoppe opened up right across the street from me is a huge problem since their food is really amazing. Great space, delicious food and they seem to support local artists by hanging up art for sale on the walls. Definitely check it out!

Omnivore calzone was very large and quite good. Made correctly without tomato sauce inside. Marinara dipping sauce was mild and tasty. However, the service was slow and uncoordinated. We ordered four different items,  and they were treated and served as separate orders so we ate sequentially rather than as a party. "Full service" wasn't.
The new owners are doing wonders for the place. I enjoy it alot.

Tried their lunch buffet. Service was good. Food was limited in variety. Butter chicken should be renamed as rubber chicken. My main grouch is the amount of baking soda these guys put in their food. Killed my appetite for a whole day and the next. Wont be going there again thats for sure.

Went here for lunch to order espresso, coffee and paninis. Espresso is bland and diluted whereas coffee was flavorless and luke warm. Food quality used to be fantastic but now panini are served cold and dry. we complained to the server but he didn't respond to our lack of satisfaction. So one star to food and service quality!

This place was a bit overhyped. Yes, the flavors are good but they could use some improvements. I went about a week or 2 after this place had opened and I had the shrimp tempura sushi burrito. I was a bit disappointed in the simplicity of the prep. The seaweed came straight out of a packet but I was hoping that they would toast it real quick for a bit of the aromatic roasted seaweed smell. The rice was already prepped and loaded into a machine which was pretty cool and unique. I've heard the sumo steak sushi burrito is amazing so I'll have to go by and try that sometime but I wouldn't go out of my way to this place.
Dont waste your time
Solid small town style Deli.  Right at the end of Main Street Lincoln Park, it is nice to be able to grab a good cup of coffee that isn't sold by a chain.

We had tried many Ippudo and Hakata Ippudo NY still the best ramen in NY. But we had to wait 45 min before get a table. But worth to wait. The ramen not much in a portion. But taste very good. Its consistency in ramen amazing. But the pork meat is too dry. We liked it more moist and still had fat attach....

Not worth the price. Dishes were $16 two months ago and now are $19. As for the restaurant itself, the music is always way too loud and the servers are clueless. Have no idea whats in the dishes nor how they are prepared. Went there twice and never again. Ordered take out a few times and the portions have gotten drastically smaller. My last take out call I was told to use seamless and hung up on. Called back and asked for the manager and was told he was the manager and to use seamless and was hung up on again. Manager/owner is extremely obnoxious and arrogant to say the least. I refuse to give them my business! #drunkenmonkey #stayaway #nyc #ues

Mushy vegetables, soggy crust on the chicken and watery sauce made for a very poor dish of General Tso's chicken but I have had other meals at Lotus Garden which were decent like the sweet and sour chicken... Without the sauce and fruit. The sauce makes it much too sweet and the fruit doesn't add any flavor and just make the chicken soggy. It was enjoyable with a little bit of soy sauce. Other than that, no complaints about the wonton soup or the wontons. The service is garbage. Very rude and inconsiderate. The man who helped me spoke very poor English and kept screwing up my order. I had to say it about 7 times before he finally read it back correctly. Overall a very poor experience due to poor service and soggy food. A very slim chance I will return.
Coming to Little Italy this is a great place off traditional tourist paths. Had two special pasta's and amazing fresh mango sorbet. Spaghetti rosso social is little hot and wonderful.
best pizza in BK!

not sure what all the hype is about - came on a Friday night and immediately noticed that this place is trying WAY too hard to be brooklyn and not even succeeding. crowd is mixed. the chicken (which this place is supposed to be known for) was underwhelming to say the least. ok, granted, i DID order the general tso's chicken which is clearly not a traditional southern meal, but at least try to make it taste like what i was expecting. waffles were mediocre. the only thing i'd come back for is the delicious mac and cheese. so good. but for real - not coming back.

Had my first El Vez experience this Friday and I will definitely be back! Got to the restaurant a few minutes before our reservation so we waited a few minutes for our table to be ready. I definitely recommend making a reservation if you're coming on a weekend night. Our waitress was wonderful! She got our drinks immediately after we arrived and was around to put in our order as soon as we were ready. I love Mexican and the food at El Vez was out of this world. We ordered the grilled beef tacos, mahi mahi tacos, and shrimp tacos. We also got sides of the creamy poblano corn rice, recommended by our waitress, and the rice & beans. The tacos were some of the best I've ever had. Don't even get me started on the corn rice. It was one of the most amazing things I've ever eaten and I was so glad I took her recommendation. Yes the restaurant is noisy but honestly, do you really expect to sit in a quiet restaurant on a weekend night? I did have to speak above my normal volume but I still didn't feel like I was shouting. I will definitely be back to El Vez, and soon!

We heard good things about A's, and tried it on a late July Sunday afternoon. Got a quiet table in the back and had an interesting conversation with the neighboring table (frequent visitors). Drinks were a little pricey, but quite good sized. Had the arugala salad, calamari and one order of veal Adriana for two seniors- almost too much food. It was all delicious and the wait staff was attentive and engaging. Overall, a very nice experience and one we look forward to repeating.

I'm so disappointed in this place. They close at 11pm. I call at 10:15 from Central Jersey and say I'll be there at 10:50. Can I still order food? The woman tells me yes. Of course I get there and they say nope. Sorry we shut everything down. It was 10:49. That's a terrible job by Rutt's Hut. Really disappointed. All I get is a "sorry bro."

A friend and I went to Taste of Hartford here and I was un-enthused. I had ceviche as a first course with mahi mahi.  It wasn't bad, but I typically associate a ceviche with having more than one type of sea food.  Would have liked to have different types of seafood in the ceviche.  Although the plantain bowl was a nice idea, i would have preferred just a normal dish. The entre was really bad.  It was a vegetarian taco that had brussels sprouts, among other things.  Brussels sprouts are one of my favorite veggies, but these ones were over-cooked and BROWN!  I was expecting nice vibrant green veggies!  Beyond that the flavors just didn't work together.  My friend and I ordered the same dish and both had the same reaction. The plantains for dessert were GREAT! ... as were our drinks.  If the rest of the meal had been as good, would have easily given 5 stars.

Yea why do i call mexican taco spot and i get some Chinese guy answering and taking my order. Hung up and not ordering from that place. I want mexican food i want to hear spanish mexican guy say hello not Chinese guy!!!

I'd been hearing about this place FOREVER, so I decided to finally drop in and see what the fuss was all about. Let me tell you, I'm glad I did. This spot is the BEES KNEES, YO. I ordered the naked meatballs with the parmesan cream sauce. WHOA, NELLY. If you've ever wanted to know what a full service shiatsu massage to your taste buds feels like, you have to order the parmesan cream sauce. You know why McGruff took a bite out of crime? Because it was smothered in that life changing condiment of wonder. BUT WAIT. You won't believe this, but the best part of my day happened AFTER I exited this establishment of fine dining. I had an appointment with the peeps at TinderHeadshots.com. I wanted to get some grade A, professional photos for my Tinder profile, because the one I have now where I'm petting my orange tabby, Mr. Snugglesworth, gives off an evil genius, I plan to take over the world vibe. When I got there, I had that delicious, delicious parmesan cream sauce dripping down my face. You know what these cats at Tinder Headshots did? They wiped it off my chin. They made me look like a presentable human being. Crazy, right? Did I mention the tasteful cardigan I had on was DRENCHED in that awe inspiring parmesan cream sauce? I wanted to keep it on during the photo shoot and just suck on the collar between set ups. THEY WERE HAVING NONE OF THAT. These dudes helped me into some new threads, and had me looking like a Don Juan at senior prom. Once I score a hot date on Tinder using these photos, I'm bringing my new lady friend to the Meatball Shop!

WoW! ! Booked table after our Broadway show. Place was packed and got our table pronto. Great Italian food..All dishes are X X L ..everyone shares 1 dish for 2..We did 2 for 6 and a salad. Plenty. Just like mama used to make . Molto benne.  xx
nice ambience, decent food/service...nothing special, but would go back for happy hour
Great food! Delicious Greek dishes, as well as amazing pizza! Portions are more than enough! The salads are great, I recommend the Bangkok salad or the Bob Marley salad.
soooooooooooooooooo good! just go!

Charming spot..Great Ambience..Delicious Food..Had the Ravioli Formaggio which was good however the Tiramisu won my heart- easily the most heavenly Tiramisu i have ever had!! To top it off - Real affordably priced..A must-go spot!

Fast service for delivery.... Food is typical pizza place food .... Not amazing but mediocre and fine if your hungry and not trying to spend a lot.  One time I found a staple in my soup and almost lost it.... I guess that could happen anywhere.... Right?

This place serves the best pizza. We were almost discouraged by the long waiting line but boy was the waiting worth our while. The pizza was simply the best and sitting where I could watch the preparation process I also had a visual pleasure. This is a place I will return to whenever I get the chance.
I think about the queso mac n' cheese every day. This place is legit!

Like the others who brought their pups along, we specifically chose The Elbow Room for an outdoor summer dinner because they are pet friendly. The staff was lovely (brought a water bowl and an empty bowl for our cockapoo's food), the food was very good, the beer list is huge ... it was a great experience.
The meat tasted stale--I was worried I will be sick and couldn't say anything as I took a guest there! Thank goodness no sickness happened.

I must say, the tastiest gyro I've tasted in a long time!! A++... Found this place on a search for gyro as I was really craving some.. Made the right choice! Babaganoush was on point and food was delicious.. Wish I could try everything on the menu.. Only wish service was a tad bit quicker but well worth the wait!

Fantastic Thai food at a great price. Calamari was great and I'm still craving the sweet/spicy sauce that came with it.  Husband said Pad Thai was great. I had Panang Curry Vegetable and it was outstanding, wanted to lick the bowl. Very small with approx 12 tables for 2.

I'm so glad I listened to my friend Kathleen when she told me to try the Halal Guys. At first I was a bit hesitant because I wasn't sure what halal was, but when you're in NYC, you have to try everything. The stand we went to was very busy. They had 3 or 4 guys cooking and a line that seemed to stretch on forever. But the line surprisingly went by fairly quickly- I might have been in it for less than 10 minutes. I ordered the lamb plate, and boy are the portions huge... The lamb was tender, fragrant, and very flavorful. Paired with the white sauce, it is to die for. I'm not sure if it was tzatziki or what, but it was phenomenal. For being $6, you definitely get your money's worth. They need to open up a food cart in San Diego, because I'm craving Halal guys desperately!!

I don't understand why the woman who served us was so mad. She first gave us a bitch face when my friend ordered hot water, and then she pretty much yelled at me when I ordered something to go at the end. I ordered karage curry to go and she replied "what? What you want? So you want the platter or what?" And she gave me a stare look of why don't you just pay and get the hell out of here instead of making me work more. Also when my friend asked her which of the soups was the less salty one, she replied with a rude tone "we can always make anything less salty" but her face was like, are you stupid or what? Just ask for less salt you stupid ass. Maybe she had a rough day, but never take it on the customer. We will definitely not go back to that hell again. Ramen was ok, nothing impressive. I thought Japanese people really cared about customer service, but I guess not the owner of terakawa. I will not recommend it to any of my friends to go there.

Honestly the best place in NJ to get Sushi hands down.  My niece who didn't want to come thought price was fantastic for what you get and that the food was fresh.  Awesome service, great food, nice ambience... better than going into philly

You absolutely cannot go wrong at ilili. I've taken groups as large as ten here and have also been with just one other person, the place is perfect for any occasion. The food is unbelievable and the drinks are superb. The desert is can't miss. Even the interior of the restaurant itself is spectacular. When I was with the group of ten, I ordered for everyone with the help of an incredibly knowledgeable waiter, and the result was perfect. This restaurant is now my go to for any type of special occasion or celebration. Or also when I just want some delicious food with friends! Cannot recommend highly enough!!

Was looking for a place for lunch with friends close to our hotel in University City. Very cute place - looks like an old home that someone decided should be a restaurant. I was able to make reservations through the Yelp app on Open Table and everything went very smoothly. Our waiter was very friendly and seemed knowledgable about the drink and food menu. We had drinks and oysters on the half shell for appetizers. I had the lobster BLT tacos, my mom had the Manhattan style chowder and our friend had the Ahi Tuna tacos - all were delicious and fresh. Would recommend this place to anyone in the area - they also have a few other locations around Pennsylvania - all are just as good!

My boyfriend and I came to Jolie Cantina on a whim while spending the day in Brooklyn. As a lover of Mexican food he was understandably excited, however, as I tend to stay away from the spicy variety I was tentative to say the least. I was worried for nothing!! Though certainly the dishes we ordered were spicy, they were spicy in a flavourful and enjoyable way that enhanced the dish (rather than making me die). I ordered the Cantina Mama Nachos and he the BBQ Organic Chicken Tacos and both were DELICIOUS! We were both SO glad that we stumbled on this place. Now that we are back at home (in Canada) he continually talks about the food here and complains we are so far away. If you are looking for a great (and pretty affordable) lunch/dinner with a zesty twist and a fun atmosphere, this is a fantastic option!
Mussels and fries are a great choice if you decide to try out this place but some of them didn't seem to have the flavors as the other ones. Though, the fries are banging.

We ordered sushi for take out and I have to say the sushi was awful. The place itself is not very nice either and it smelled very bad, I think they just had some renovations done. The only reason we ordered there was because of an recommendation but that will be the first and last time. The only reason I give two stars is because the lady in there was so nice but that's it.

I hate leaving negative feedback but it's now two strikes for them. Two weeks ago I tried walking in but noticed they only accept cash. Tonight, when I called to order delivery, everything from the menu was deemed obsolete/incorrect. First, several items are only available in threes, ie, tacos. They didn't have any tamales and they likely would have required a purchase of three as well but I only really wanted one. Lastly, the minimum order for delivery on the provided menu is $10 but that's apparently incorrect. $20 is now the minimum order for delivery! Oh well, it was a bust for the second time. I'll try to walk in when I have a few dollars and hope for the best.

Yummy!!!! I was pleasantly surprised by the menu and atmosphere. I had a burger jammed packed with flavor! It came with a side of Jack Daniels, all for $15 dollars. I also tried the dry rubbed brisket. Perfectly cooked and tender. The wait staff had excellent customer service and knew the menu. I would certainly go back, SOON!!!
I have to say not passing judgment but from out of state and had to try both sandwiches from Genos and Pats .I enjoyed both places for grub .Maybe on my next return ill get scoop from locals.

I have been coming here for the past few years and every time my experience has been great but recently I was very disappointed in the service.  After my sister and I placed our order, the waitress tells us 25 minutes later that neither of our entrees were available. So I decided on another entree and ten minutes later the waitress brings only my side orders (salad & avocado). The waitress then disappeared for some which I became really annoyed, subsequently the owner saw that I was visibly upset and apologized on behalf of the waitress which comes to find out left for the night. Since the waitress didn't relate to the cook my complete order, the owner  offered to give me anything I wanted on the house but after sitting there starving for an hour, my sister and I decided to leave. In addition, the staff appeared unorganized and the establishment gets smaller and smaller. I won't be coming back here anymore.
omg! the drinks were amazing and the food was delioucous!!! yes i had the cuban sandwich with freid yucka yummy! the lunch menus is great. and they also make the best mojito's

Not sure why we were the only table here between 7-9pm on a Sunday, because the food/drinks were great and waitress was lovely. Def recommend the chiatara pesto with shoestring fries (carbs on carbs but whatever, worth it) and the burratta appetizer. Leather booths, cool wallpaper and an overall old school vibe. Hope this spot picks up because a date in a silent restaurant doesn't feel very cozy or romantic.

Outdoor seating.. beautiful view of the city and statue of liberty n good atmosphere. Crab is pretty standard. Mussels are good n crab cakes are excellent.. nice strips of crab meat so that u can actually taste some substance. Dollar oysters during mon n tues, usually east coast. Good service.

Super yummy place to get an awesome soup on a dreary day.  Service was a bit spotty and the language barrier with the server was a tad bit of an issue, but all in all great stuff.  Definitely a spot that fits the bill when looking for some real Japanese options.

Best pho in Jersey City. They use fresh noodles which makes a huge difference in the quality of the pho. They also make some mean shakes (am a fan of the avocado shake myself). Sure, it's not a fine dining experience but it's a great hole in the wall Vietnamese place if you're picky about your Vietnamese food. Miles above any other Vietnamese place in Jersey City. Totally with the trek. Spring rolls are crispy and hot. Flavors are good. Bun bo hue is decent - I can only compare to my mother-in-law's bun bo hue which is out of this world. This is also pretty decent!

If you don't decide to read my entire review. Read this. Avoid this cramped rat hole establishment like the Black Plague. Food is junk, service is selective, based on age? Sex? Race? No idea why we got the treatment we did? Never have I ever ! Wow . Left me speechless. Worst service hands down in all of New York and possibly worst service I have ever received in my entire life ! Reservations at 7. We stood awkwardly at the door without being acknowledged for 10 minutes. When I finally said excuse me to the heavy set man who was checking in on table after table as he passed us , He looked irritated that I had interrupted him . Wasn't this guy just a friendly person checking in on customers ? Dr Jekyll and Mr. Hyde ??Glaring at me, he put one chubby sausage finger in the air as to silent me. .. Say whaaaat?! Around 7:30 we were seated, no apologies, I can see they are busy no? *eye roll* but I bit my tongue. What was the reservation for anyways ? He quickly sat the family of 6 who walked in after we had been waiting 25 minutes. He stumbled over the specials, lost his place and repeated himself, mentioned something about something being on his mind. Yadiyada ... We finally got our order in. When my stomach finally growled, I realized our appetizers had only arrived . We didn't realize because we were busy enjoying our conversation at the table .   I flagged someone down who I thought could be our server, not too sure who it was since they came only to deliver the appetizer and never came back since . I asked about our main dishes and he left to "check" on it . no one came back.. 15 minutes go by and someone finally slammed our dishes down on our table, turned around and left, No apology, no explanation, nothing .. I started eating because I was so hungry, until I just had to say something the food was not good. I wasted my stomach on this when there is so much good food in ny, and not only that I had wasted 2 hours in this cramped corner with a table the size of my night stand. I called over the grumpy heavy set man again and he basically said the printer malfunctioned and that was that . Also what else do I expect in NYC ? So it was my fault for eating there, I see. I had no problems with any of my reservations at other restaurants in New York at all. This review is already such a waste of my time. I won't give this place another moment of my previous time. Save yourselves people.
where I always visit on the first day of my business trip to NYC. after having long fright, BCD soondubu help me to get some energy. prefer extra spicy. staffs are nice and welcoming.

One of the best meals I've had in a while. The space is beautiful, warm and inviting.  The service was mostly impeccable. The menu was exciting with plenty of great food and drink options. The menu is printed daily. On the evening we went we had an array of small plates. The dishes were all super fresh and delicious, all with local farm to table ingredients.  I think I could eat their grilled octopus every day. It was a busy night and the kitchen fell way behind, otherwise it was a perfect meal.
I don't get what's so special about this place. It gets absolutely over crowded, terrible selection if beers on tap, minimal good selection. The garden out back is fair, if you can find a seat.

HOLY30 is what I call it... lol I'm on the whole 30 diet and Hu Kitchen is my Holy Grail!!! It's AMAZING... Their Elk Burger was to F*#$&(@($*# die for!! and their root mash bowls are the bomb! Their Kombucha seriously should be served in bars across NY!! I'm addicted to their "Sweet Kale Crunch" which is totally WHOLE30 compliant - I eat it like granola with homemade almond milk!!! my only complaint: I can't order them through seamless because I live too far:( I love HU Kitchen so much I wanna be their cook when I grow up:)

They don't use gloves while touching all over the food at the "bar kitchen" where they make the appetizers and soups. She even picked up the phone, touched dirty receipts that were balled up in the trash bin, and touched a dirty rag then kept making the food. I don't know about you but I'm very sanitary and I don't like bare hands touching my food. Bleh!

Decided to stop in here after remembering some falafel sample sent from god a couple weeks ago, no regrets at all this place is fantastic I'm surprised they weren't more crowded. I got possibly the biggest sandwich in the world "falafel laffa". I am a human being with immense appetite and I couldn't finish it. Service was nice and helpful though it's hard to hear over the glass, and while the falafel took a bit to cook it came out beautifully. Possibly the best value of anywhere in New York, whole thing was under $8 with the toppings works. Also toppings, two kinds of rice, two kinds of EGGPLANT, roasted veggies, cous cous, what a selection! As a vegan I'm always deciding between like two relevant things but this sure was a treat. Will return.

Good food but they're never open. Not sure why their hours say open until 10 pm when I've often shown up at 6:30 pm and they're closing up shop. Not a good way to build a customer base since we can never count on this place at all.

If you judge a book by its cover keep walking, if you love earnest flavorful food, run inside and grab a plate. Your tastebuds will thank you. Nothing fancy just good food you will crave over and over.

It's been a while since a sandwich has blown me away. I've now tried several from this unique little gem in the 9th Square, and each one is as awesome as the last. Everything's delicious - there was the decadent meatloaf sandwich special (called "Robert Paulson," a handy Fight Club reference) that I hope becomes a regular, the Rick Reuben (fantastic), and the PLT (a take on the BLT using a hefty porchetta that was amazing). I don't recall all the ingredients, but they're creative and you can tell a lot of detail went into the crafting of each. The Steak and Cheese is quite meaty and uses thick slices of good steak, though at times it can be a little wonky to eat - often you bite in and drag out a big piece of steak. So I guess thin slices do have their purpose. The Haute Tuna Melt is a refreshing take on a tuna melt with italian-style tuna salad (no mayo here!) with some heat from cherry peppers. As an italian who eats tuna like this at home, I'm thrilled to see this on a menu! And I can't forget my favorite (and "secret") menu item: the Bubble and Squeak! Yes, you've probably had plenty of egg+cheese+cured bacon sandwiches, but none will ever be as tasty as this. They add gravy and tater tots to the Bubble and Squeak, and serve it on a home-made square English muffin (which at times can be very starchy but still tasty). Filling, satisfying, and more delicious than it even sounds. Not on the menu (it's a combination of two different sandwiches), so you just have to ask for it. I crave it weekly. Thing is, you can only get it at night (between 8p and 3 a.m Friday and Saturday). That brings me to the next reason this place rules: it's one of the few establishments that's open late on weekends (til 3 a.m.: a blessing for nocturnal beings like me), so you don't have to just settle for a slice of pizza somewhere or Mamoun's (tried and true, but options are always good). Yes, the prices are upwards of about $10 each, and for some the sandwiches might not be big enough (they're plenty for me). But these days I care a lot about paying for quality, and quality is what you get. And on Mondays, $10 will get you a sandwich+chips+soup/salad+drink, so definitely go for that! The space itself is small and stylish -- more long than it is wide, with counter space to sit and eat, but late-night it's only service through the sidewalk window, which is a nice touch. Staff is cool and good natured (especially humorous at night) and enjoy what they're doing. My ONLY complaint has nothing to do with the food, and that is that it gets a little smokey from the sandwich grills. We're not talkin' clouds of smoke here though (just a "smokiness"), and ultimately it doesn't bother me that much since I usually get stuff to go anyway. I hope Meat & Co. never goes away. Favorite sandwich spot in the city.
Actually we have been there with our cousins Rocky and Lynn and we absolutely loved it! All around great experience! Food Service and our guys make their own wine so BYOB is a plus for us!!!

Stopped in for lunch during the middle of the week and the restaurant fairly empty. The service was attentive but their was a co worker at that bar as well and that took up most of my servers attention. The Revolution margarita was great! Tortilla chips were great! Caso Funidito, however was awful. The beef tacos were good and flavorful, however the rice had clearly been sitting under a heat lamp for quiet some time as it was not only dry but crunchy throughout. I had to add sour cream to the rice to eat it. The flan was good but the portion size was tiny. I would return but that is mostly due to the limited options of hispanic food. As someone that grew up on hispanic and Mediterranean food Revolution Cantina was "ok".

My 2 teenage kids and I went to Atticus for breakfast before our tour at Yale.  Since my daughter loves the breakfast soufflé at Panera and there's one a few doors down, she decided to get her soufflé there then join us at Atticus.  While I accompanied her to Panera, my son sat down at Atticus and ordered an orange juice to start with.  After we've gotten the soufflé, we went back to Atticus to join my son.  As soon as the lady who takes orders saw her soufflé, she came over right away, without saying good morning or anything else, rudely said, "we do not allow outside food in the cafe".  There was NO ONE ELSE eating there at the time so it's not like my daughter was taking up their precious real estate, plus both my son and I were going to eat there (my son has already placed his order) so it's not like we were not spending money there.  That left us no choice but to buy their food to go.  My son ordered a "complete breakfast" and I a "baked strata".  Honestly, I did not think the food was good and this has nothing to do with their attitude.  My son asked for regular toast and he was given 2 pieces of over-toasted baguette, he asked for scrambled eggs but was given a flat sheet of eggs (shaped like a crepe) that I won't call "scrambled", and the breakfast potatoes weren't good either.  My strata was also disappointing; the top was totally burned and the rest did not have that chewy texture (it was kind of mushy) I expected from a strata.  Bad experience.

Went Restaurant Week on a Tuesday@6:30pm and were told they had no ribs. Sounded like only thing they were cooking was "bait and switch". Asked for Manager and got Assistant Manager who said he just got in at 5pm - basically wasn't his fault.  He said he would take something off the bill even though we paid already;  didn't see him again. Hard to believe their apathy with all the competition in the area. We're won't be back.

Authentic!!  Ironically on my bf's first night in town visiting from Nola (I grew up here) we stumbled here because they had a late kitchen on a Tuesday night.  He got the BBQ shrimp and I was worried bc he is very picky, he loved it!!  I tried some and it was really good, flavorful and the real deal.  I got a Pimms Cup (it was called something different) it was awesome.  The staff was super friendly and very good.  I will recommend to my family and friends here in Philly
Great food.  Fun place. Our server was a bit rude. We had to ask for bread and drink refills .  He paid us very little attention.
Great food and really friendly service. My wife and I are just moving to the area and I am pretty sure this place will be in heavy rotation.
The Original burger....that it is.  No frills good burger.  Have it their way or no way.  I respect that!  On my way to tasting the best burgers in the USA and beyond.

the food and service here is consistently fantastic! I got the garlic rice with sunny side up egg and pork sausage with cucumber salad on the side. It is divine and I can say its my favorite brunch spot and I've even been to Clinton Street. I also tried the chicken and waffles and that is also top notch. Chicken is tender and moist and the syrup they provide for the waffles knocks it out of the park. Would def recommend!

Literally the best pizza I have ever had. i would honestly fly to new York just for dinner here if it wasnt so cost prohibative. the owner (Patsy) is awsome and his wifes cannolis should be enjoyed with someone you love. I wish yelp had a 6th star to give this family run business.
Delicious sushi!!  I'm writing this after my first takeout order and am happy to report that the rolls were awesome.  I highly recommend the Washington Square Roll!

The food and service were both excellent. I got the cabbage rolls and am already craving them again. If you check in on Yelp, you get a free shot of any flavor of their house-made infused vodkas. Also, when my group of 7 left, they gave all the women Russian cookies, the men newspapers, and everyone another shot of vodka. Great experience.

This is a nice addition to the block. The space is beautiful, really nice open air, art on the walls for purchase. I love the green life throughout the shop. Really cool bathroom. Nice staff, even though are Australian ;) The coffee is great, nice selection of teas, sameies, snacks. Basically it's a nice spot to hang out and have a bevy. Double thumbs up, I'm a fan
I've bern going here for many years and I love the good. The people are nice too. The crust is firm and they use a coal oven. They also make good garlic bread

Cold pizza? Wrong toppings? Order from here!  After a really long wait (1 1/4 hours vs 45 minutes I was told) they delivered the wrong pizza, charging us $5 more for toppings they didn't deliver. Skip it, they don't care, at all.

The food is amazing, but if I were you I would only order from here! Was with my 4 friends for the first time there to sit down and eat(normally I order) and service was not good, 2 ladies served us, we got different drinks then we orders, they forgot one drink, we were still eating the appetizers and got already our main mean and then was cold before we could start! There is only one really cute waiter, that was super nice. Making the  sign with his hands! So nice right ! But that was all! It is cheap, and so good the food! But if you go there.. Make sure you say you want the main meal after the appetizers!!!
Pretty good and authentic Chinese food. I regularly order their spicy pot.
First time here for celebrating my mom's late birthday. The food was very good especially the steak !! Every taste is heaven :) !! Will come back again for sure   yum yum

Eh.. their burgers only come with 2 add ons that are 50 cents each.. the burger doesnt include lettuces, tomato and onion so you pretty much get a dry burger and are expected to be okay with that. Their breakfast food is awesome! But come on if you are selling burgers make a damn burger! Too expensive.

On july 19th I held a surprise wedding engagement dinner for my girlfriend. The staff at Mediterra was EXCELLENT and soo helpful in the whole process! They were able to provide us with a private room for our 35-40 guests, were extremely helpful in the decoration set-up, and even provided some staff members to help distract my girlfriend and throw her off from the surprise. We were supposed to have the room from 2-5 but they let us come in 2 hours early and helped set up, and since it started late let us have the room for almost an extra hour! I ordered the steak to eat and it was one of the best steaks I've had in a long time! The seafood pasta needed just a little bit more seasoning, but was still very good. Their wine selection was excellent, and service was awesome. I want to truly thank the staff members and Mediterra for playing a huge role in making one of the best days of my life a success!

I have worked in the restaurant/hospitality industry for over 10 years, and am a frequent customer of Woodrow's. I have had nothing but great experiences at this bar. The food is always good, paint night is so much fun and the staff has always been genuinely hospitable to me and every other patron I have encountered. The waitstaff and owners know all their regulars' names and make a sincere effort to make sure all their guests are taken care of and have a good time. This is a great spot to watch a game, hang with coworkers or throw a private party (the downstairs room is amazing!). If you are grateful for the amazing, eclectic restaurant industry NYC has, and respectful of the hard working people that keep it running, you will love Woodrows too!
We met some friends for some oysters and sliders at happy hour but were asked to leave because we had a baby with us. It was 4 in the afternoon! Horrible customer service. Never going back.

Came in for dinner and the music.  Ribs were fantastic!!  The "Other orchestra" played great music.  It is pretty loud in the main dining area when the band plays.  There is room to dance if you have a partner.
Pho: the soup is too bland, not hot enough, the beef is too soft, overcooked. The beef balls have no taste, the tendons are too hard, not edible.

I like to come to this place often with my friends and family. There is a relaxed vibe and friendly environment. Good food and strong drinks make it special.The fried chicken basket and slushy infused cucumber whiskey drink is my favorite. So awesome and a must try;) The staff are very friendly.

If Tikaway Grill and Mamoun's had a drunk crazy night together, Pitaziki Mediterranean Grill would be their delicious offspring. Like Chipotle and Tikaway, you select a meat (or falafel) and choose wrap, pita, salad, or rice bowl. There is an excellent selection of toppings: baba ganouj (sp?), lettuce, red onions, eggplant, chick peas, and sauces (the tahini sauce is yummy). This place is run by the guys that used to run Aladdin Pizza in the same spot. They used to be an average pizza place. Good but nothing notable. After shutting down and reopening as Pitaziki Mediterranean Grill, they now offer something unique yet familiar, and it's fantastic. This is the kind of place you want to tell your friends about. Places like this make me glad that I live in New Haven.
great burritos, good price and the burritos are very filling...nice place to go if you enjoy mexican cuisine.
Made my co-worker sick from tuna at lunch. Decor is average, bathrooms were messy.
