As far as pizza places go, Pizza 1 IS IT!  Delicious food, reasonable prices, fast delivery. I'm so happy they opened this additional location because it's closer to where I live. Try it once and you're hooked.

My husband and I just left the Brooklyn Beet Company after we ate an appetizer and asked the bartender/server to pack our food to go. We would have loved to stay and enjoy the relaxing BBC atmosphere had the bartender not started blasting top 40 music and rushing around the restaurant with closing duties (at 9:45) while my husband and I and another couple were the only diners. $75 later we are sitting in our fourth floor walk up attempting to enjoying (predictable soggy after the walk home) cod n' chips and the chef's special burger--which happens to be the only redeeming thing about the experience other than knowing we have a Brooklyn restaurant to completely knock off our list.
I'm not a regular here, but I do go fairly often, and the service and food are always good. My favorite is the stuffed waffle with sausage and eggs yum yummy.  I give this cafe 4 bow ties out of 7.
This place has good specialty pizzas. Buffalo chicken and cheese steak are the best.
One of those new restaurants that you want to tell everyone about because you desperately want them to succeed but don't want anyone to know about because you always want to be able to get a table.

They don't deserve the 1 star but I had to click on 1.  My husband picked up a container of matzo ball soup to go.  Paid almost $7. I removed the 2 softball sized balls and there was less than 1/2 a container of soup.  I decided to call the diner. Surely there was a mistake.  I asked for the manager and the man with a very thick accent told me he was the manager.  I told him about the soup and he asked me if I requested the balls in a separate container.  I said no.  He said, well, that's the way we do it.  I explained that I felt I should get a full container of soup since that's what I paid for.  After literally arguing with me for 5 more minutes he told me to go to Dunkin Donuts and then hung up on me.  Besides the fact that the soup was awful, the "manager" HUNG up on a customer.  I expected him to say, I'm so sorry, please come back and I'll give you another. Never saw that coming.  So I guess the bland, vapid food is not the only reason I'll never go back there again.  I should have gone with the can of Campbell's.
great vibes. great drinks. good food. cash only. can get crowded and annoying when trying to find an outdoor table. still one of my fav spots in BK.

I recently made it back here with a group of people. Not like last time, the place was so empty on Friday evening! I was like, oh what's up with this place? And looked at the menu, there have been some changes to it, anyway we ordered a few plates to share. Food was generally ok to good, but I feel like it was better before. Service was still great.

Love Love Love this place.  Staff is friendly and helpful, Food from the menu was tasty.  Parking was difficult. I sat outside all night and did not want to leave.  A place you can relax and truely enjoy.

We went late and everyone was very friendly. The octopus starter should not be missed - excellently prepared with great compliments in the composition. The pizza was great, the gnocchi was even better, and they help you find the right wine by the glass for the night.

I adore their lobster roll and fish and chips. The restaurant itself is not much of a restaurant--it's more like a dingy albeit quirky shack. The beach is at its front door, which makes it a convenient summer stop. It's surrounded by a few other popular seafood joints, but this one is by far my favorite. Its cut-and-dry menu and friendly service is always a plus.

I came here for drinks and dinner a few weeks ago.  The bar manager was amazing! She explained the cocktails in depth and made excellent recommendations.  We also got a free drink for checking in on yelp! All the food was excellent as well - I highly recommend the Lancaster chicken. Definitely will come back to try to burger and the brunch!

This was a must go place in NY - and so we followed advise. Glad it was worth the hype. The pizzas were out of the world - thin crust, fresh and so crispy. We completely loved the pizza and would love to come here anytime we visit NY in future.

Stopped by for lunch and had a seriously good and seriously inexpensive combination plate as part of their lunch menu. Pad Thai, Ginger Chicken, spring rolls plus a Thai desert for $7.95. Seriously good, large portion to the point that I took some home with me.  When I asked for a container to take the Ginger Chicken they asked me if I would like some rice with it? I said yes and asked for brown rice which they added to my doggie bag AT NO CHARGE. Definitely would recommend this for food, price, atmosphere, convenience. Enjoy.

I was eagerly anticipating the opening of AmeriThai, and I am thoroughly satisfied with my overall experience. My fiance and I prefer to dine-in at new restaurants to get a better feel on the quality, freshness, preparation, and presentation of the food and I am glad we did. Atmostphere Although the space is small, the the dining area works well for the space they are in. The decor is simple and the room is clean and comfortable. Service/Food The waitress was polite, took our order quickly, and the food was brought out in no time at all. I had the green curry with beef and brown rice and my fiance had the green curry with chicken and brown rice, both made extra spicy. Both of us were extremely satisfied with our order. Overall AmeriThai is a really great addition to the neighborhood. The service was fast, the food was delicious, and everything is very reasonably priced. I am looking forward to going back so that I can try some of the other items on the menu. Helpful tips: -Cash only -BYOB

Unfortunately, I just couldn't see what the excitement is about this place.   I wasn't bothered about having to wait 20 mins to be seated, but really didn't feel welcomed by the waitress who was more concerned that I waited outside so as not to block the very narrow passageway of the restaurant. After being seated I was lucky to have dodged a storm that had started, but noticed the waitress was still ushering guests to wait outside in the rain (and it was heavy!). My entire order -for 4- tasted overcooked and dry.  The empanadas were served in marked paper bags placed in a bowl.  We also ordered the fish entree (can't remember the name of it,  but it's at the top of the menu). It was presented as an upside down bowl of rice with salad leaves around it. It looked like a large side of rice. I'm not sure why this is listed as an entree.  It left me confused.   The spinach tasted more like callaloo, but perhaps this is how spinach is suppose to taste in this part of the world. The melon lemonade was far too sweet.  The only saving grace were the plantains that were ripe and well cooked. Sadly for me, this was an overpriced anticlimax.
The jerk was ok nothing special all they do is make it spicy. Also the staff was snotty.
Great food, nice environment and very friendly family owners who serve and bartend. I'm happy to have this lovely gem in the neighborhood. I'll become a regular.
Can't say anything about the food but good happy hour drinks nice atmosphere awesome bartender
I love this place, come here all the time since my school isn't too far away!

Considering high average rating, we had good expectations. Wine list was kind of okay for the central Manhattan location ( house Montepulciano was good, but really pricy at $48/bottle). Fried calamari were well done, not too much breading, tasty sauce, however salted unevenly. Special green salad was also okay. However, the pasta special - a dish containing 4 different pastas - lasagna, Bolognese meat sauce, cheese ravioli and penne alla vodka simply had no taste whatsoever (may be Bolognese was somewhat okay and penne vodka acceptable for kids). Dessert called Titanic was huge (yes, this is family restaurant), but at least half of the huge dessert was whipped cream - overall average taste and really not worthy $30 price tag.

Okay food, prices and portions but the service is AWFUL. The first time i went, the restaurant was full. Instead of telling us to please wait, the staff completely ignored us, leaving us at the door. When we spoke up to ask how long it'll take, a server CUT US OFF MID-SENTENCE and then...went back to ignoring us. We were being extremely polite, just asking how long we would have to wait, but he angrily snapped at us, as though we did something wrong. It was beyond rude. We were actually shocked by the service, so we just left. We went back the second time thinking the first time was a fluke but, once again, we were ignored. It wasn't until a little bit later when we were finally seated. The food took forever (30min for 2 entrees--and on this afternoon there weren't many people). When it came time for the check, I saw the European girls and family to my left and right ask for their check and have it delivered to their table. So, I requested mine as well. Three times to the same person! I never got my check and had to go to the front to pay. I don't know if they expect me to pay at the front because that's asian style, and I'm Chinese, but, if so, it was a little upsetting that I was treated differently. The man I asked for the check from could have also told me the second time I asked instead of agreeing to bring the check each time, then not bringing it. I was left waiting at my table confused as to what to do when the servers promised to bring the bill but never came. I won't come again because, although the food is good, I can find food just as good food at places nearby with much better service.

I thought I wrote a review but maybe just a tip? I am new to yelp. Just go here. If you don't feel happy, you'll feel happy after being here. If you're happy, you'll feel happier. The best of the best. The nexus of the universe... A perfect blend of good food, good people, sporadic trains, and significant historic preservation... And I could go on and on. I have to bring my Philly wife here sometime soon.

New to yelp so catching up on reviewing one of my favorite restaurants in the city.  Amazing food, beer selection, happy hour and especially late night happy hour! Best place to go for a cheat meal -- burgers, maple fried chicken, pot pie, and homemade choco-tacos! Great late night happy hour stop -- cheap amazing eats like soft pretzels, deviled eggs, pork bruschetta, and oysters!

Came here for Sunday late-night happy hour with a group of friends. Half off margarita pitchers, half off tostadas and $3 nachos. Food was pretty good if not lacking a little bit of flavor. Margaritas were weak and sort of tasted like Mike's hard lemonade and/or Jose Cuervo margarita mix, but at $15 for a large pitcher I can't complain that much. Just means they're overpriced to begin with. Our waiter was awesome and friendly.
Delicious.  Perfect Philly experience.  Great service.  BYO!  Bring a red and a white :)
all the food is great but my standout faves are the Tom Tom Soup and the Thai eggplant dish!!! Great atmosphere too!

At first I was guns ready to write a raving review of how much I enjoyed this place. Good thing I waited until the end of the meal. The host quoted the wait at a half of an hour. So we kept ourselves occupied at the bar. The bartenders were very friendly and quick. And then we ended up getting seated sooner than expected which was great. I ordered the lobster roll which was very good, I just wish they used a less absorbent bread because it got soggy very quick. With lobster roll I chose to have the arugula salad and topped with red onions, dressed perfectly! After enjoying the meal and finishing our drinks we were ready for dessert. Servers passing by would look at us and see the empty plates and just ignore it. Now I too am a server and I know the work load so I always try to be patient and understanding. But then the customer sitting alone was getting the five star service, even to be created by the chef? Or owner maybe? I'm not sure. But the server stood directly behind the chef and just listened and joined in on the conversation. At that point my friend was getting impatient and irritated. So I tried to stack the plates for them to see that we were COMPLETELY finished. Then the servers were hanging out by the POS. And in my head I'm thinking, wow.. you probably are on a wait list and people are ready to move on to make the dining time faster yet you are lounging there talking? Yet the bus boy is still quick on his feet to clear our table and even wipe it for us. Seems there might need to be a change in positioning to me. Then finally I see a gentleman in a blue shirt and he seems to be scanning the tables and instantly see me looking around and asks us if we are doing okay. He was quick to grab us the dessert menu. Then the server wants to show up to take the order. And again he leaves and we end up having to hand our card to another server to go over and hand to him. I honestly think this place is great but service is a big part of a dining experience. Our server just happened to ruin it for us. But thank you to the rest of the staff that made sure we were taken care of and the chefs who made a great meal.

This place has been famous for sloppy joes (the original, not the manwich garbage) for many years. The sandwiches are great, but you may want to order extra coleslaw. They don't skimp on the meat, but it's easily a dry sandwich without the right balance between coleslaw and meat. I got the Hannah Special (brisket, turkey, Russian dressing and cole slaw).  I would never sit down and eat here. I would just takeout. It has nothing to do with the neighborhood. The owner just isn't keen on customer service. Never smiles, never greets. Just cold. It hasn't changed since 4 years ago when I was last there. So, if I want customer service I go to the place in south orange. If I'm nearby and just want a sandwich, I go here.

If you like Thai food, go here. Great price for a delicious meal. Green and Red Curry are near perfection. Cool intimate setting with a max capacity of about 30. A lot of menu items beyond curries and noodles there are plenty of items I would like to come back and try.
For coffee there is no better spot I have ever been too.  I can't have certain sweeteners due to allergies and they still managed to get me a smooth sweet coffee that was beyond reproach.

Came to Egans tonight, had a blast with friends I hadn't seen in a while.  The staff are very attentive and friendly and the food is great. The crowd is attractive and every time we have been here, we have never left disappointed. Food: I recommend the fish tacos, the chicken burger, cheeseburger of course, Irish Toasties and their famous wings, ( if you love wings get your own order, you will not want to share them, thats how great they are!) Egans is a great place to come have drinks with my friends, or just a casual dinner with my wife and kids. We will be back again!

I've been wanting to try this place for a while. There are lots of seafood restaurants in/around Hartford, but the Chowder Pot seemed like one of the best. I had the stuffed shrimp. It was delicious, but I wouldn't say it was amazingly good. If I was in the mood for seafood I would probably try another restuarant before coming here again, but I also wouldn't be opposed to eating here again.

What can I say about The Halal Guys that hasn't already been said? The food is affordable and very delicious. My girlfriend and I ordered the lamb and the chicken. They give you so much tender chicken, it was wonderful- that creamy sauce melds everything together. The lamb was very good too, not being overwhelming in taste or odor. The rice wasn't too dry and the pita bread soaks up all the juices and the sauces. The lettuce they add is also cool and refreshing to contrast all the savory protein. I could probably eat here every other day if I were visiting New York City for an extended period of time. It's definitely the best $6 I ever spent in New York. I didn't try any of the hot sauce, but I heard that shit was insane. I'd love to eat here again, I wouldn't think twice about it.
Great except the line on Saturday nights takes forever.
Its good food but not sure what the fuss is about. I had better halal street meat in nyc

Back in 1997 I was forced to have food from this place due to the fact that I used to live across the street from there, and one December night there was a crazy ass snowstorm leaving this the only place open for business within a two mile area of downtown New Haven. Yes, I really walked in a foot of snow for a couple of miles, and found nothing. I really wanted to avoid this place like the plague due to the numerous warnings I had heard over the years from friends & locals. So to my dismay I walked there and ordered a large pie to split with my Girlfriend at the time. Let's just say that calling this Pizza does a dis-service to every Pizzeria that has ever existed in the city of New Haven, or the state of CT for that matter. I have had bad Pizza before, but this was truly unique..from the cardboard textured crust, to the sour milk tasting Mozzarella and overly sweetened high fructose tomato paste..I mean sauce. Alpha Delta is the absolute worst food experience I have ever had. Seriously..I would opt for Chuck E. Cheese over it.

One of the worst experiences at a restaurant. They were out of 2 of the 3 Chardonnay's; no Brussel sprouts or Calamari that was on the menu. So 4 of the items ordered were not available. And slow service. Not good.

Come here for the pork and brisket sandwiches! They are irresistable and it is all brought together so perfectly. (The meats, sharp provolone, brocolli rab) The only thing that sucks is the lines on the weekends. I can only go to Philly on weekends because of work and sometimes the lines are too long! Once i actually waited for an hour and by the time I got close, I was told they ran out :(

It seems as though every Mexican restaurant has very mixed reviews just like this one.  For me, it's one of the better places in the area, and MUCH better than some chain restaurants as someone else suggested. The service is a bit slow, but they make up for it in food and drink quality.  Prices could be a little bit lower, but I'd rather pay a little more to go here.  My wife and I work about 15 minutes away, and have made it a point to stop in several times, even though our home is out near Sussex County.  It's also kid-friendly, which our 2-year-old appreciates.  :-) Ignore the naysayers on this one and try it out.

BE AWARE!!!!! I don't even know where to begin with this horrible experience. I went to Empanada cafe on July 22, 2014 around 9pm. If anyone has been there, you know there is only two tables, so I order my food then sat at the bigger table with my husband.  10 min into me sitting at the table and waiting for my food I felt something similar to a  hair ball cross my foot ( I was wearing sandals) . As I look down I see it's a COCKROACH.  I am not even exaggerating this cockroach was huge to the point where I yelled and jumped on the bench.  One of the ladies working the counter comes out holding  a boom . It took her 9 hits to actually kill  it as it starting clawing up the gray brick wall . I was so disgusted and clearly not going to eat the food. Right after all this, the food comes out and she has the nerve to say no refund before I even say anythinggggg about me not wanting to eat the food. I went back and forth with her for about 7 minutes .  She told me "the cockroach wasn't in the food so no refund, but i can rap up your food to go." She must of been crazy or new to this country. She had a heavy accent and Is probably use to seeing cockroaches. I am not one to complain or to ever right a review ( this is actually my 1st review )  but this experience had to be told.

It not traditional chat ...i don't really write review but this first time coz wondering why ppl give 5 star ...sorry my friend if I want eat Chatt I will go to bomb talk at NJ......that's very bullshit what owner said to me just now ......He said take ur 6 $ back and be happy
Just like being in Paris!

I love this place! Halcyon is probably one of the most beautiful restaurants and bars in the area. They have great staff, the bartenders are pro's and the servers are very attentive and knowledgeable about their menu. They have a great raw bar selection and they even do happy hour raw bar during the week. Its a great after work spot. Try their tuna tartare and crab cake, to die for. Also great tacos. Filet mignon and Cod ( if they are not super busy they will mix up the tacos for you)  Halcyon is the closest thing to a great city restaurant but in the suburbs. its a great date spot, or just a night out with family & friends. also, if they have the coconut cream pie, you MUST order it.

Went for a date night because we wanted to try something different and everything was great. The only thing we would change about our dining experience is getting an appetizer, not because it was bad, but because we were too full! We loved our meals (which were a recommendation of the bartender) and wanted to fully enjoy them. All drinks we had were awesome; sangria, mojitos, and an after dinner drink the bartender whipped up :) Fruit empanadas were the perfect ending to this meal. Will definitely go back again. make reservations because it is a small place :)
Recommendations .. The Chicken with a side of honey to dip in.. Delicious!!!! & the French onion soup is great! Don't forget an ice tea (super refreshing!!!) excellent food!

I booked the reservation for Pio Pio for my boyfriend's birthday. Upon entering the restaurant, it really looks nice. The decor is pretty and I love the darkness of the restaurant because it makes it super sexy. However, when we were seated downstairs it got so loud it was unbelievable. The food was ok...we ordered the matador combo..it was good. but my chicken wasnt cooked wnough..but at the same time it wasnt anything to go crazy for. i didnt go for the fries and hot dogs..i could make that at home. the rice and beans were good..i love rice and beans but they couldve given more. Bar was crazy expensive though..we bought some henny and honestly the amount they gave was absurd. the highlight of the meal was the tres leches cake i ordered for him. they were nice enough to come out with a candle and sing him happy birthday... overall, it was just okay. nothing to make me wanna come back in a hurry or at all. but my fellow yelpers are pretty spot on with reviews, so you can trust this one, because I LOVE food and a great meal, but this wasnt it all the way

I've always been a huge proponent of this place but tonight the service was unacceptable. I had to close out my tab at the bar so I could get my card to pay for dinner. The tab was $14. Bartender asked if I had cash. When I said no he looked at me and said 'well you better get some then!' Never have I been treated so rudely.

ok, so my 5 starts comes not from a fancy place but from what makes me feel good...and here i felt great! I saw this restaurant progressing when it was under construction and couldn't wait to try it out. I am glad I did. Brick walls, good food and wine and all of this without spending a fortune! great place to hang out with friend, family or why not a first date.

As soon as I walked up to Vite I felt like I was going to have a cozy and comfortable experience and we did. The place has a really rustic and romantic setting. It had only been opened for about 2 weeks when we went so what can you expect? As people who try new venues often, its like all restaurants that just open..it has growing pains but the essentials are in tact. The food, wine and ambience are all solid. We ordered ravioli, rigitoni with veal ragout along with the cornish hen. The ravioli has a ricotta sundried tomato and olive filling and the pasta was def made in house. The cornish hen was so much better than I've had in other places because it was juicy inside with so much flavor and the skin was so crispy and yummy. The food was amazing. Really, really good with welll balanced flavors. Oh the pastas...they come out in little pans as if they were came right off the stove..makes it feel like you are eating at your grandmothers house in Italy. We had to try that popcorn mousse because we were so curious and although we thought it would taste weird it was such an amazing treat! The food took a little while but we were enjoying ourselves and the servers(who currently are the owners all are from Cirprianis) were fun and really happy to have us there.   They also had some great wine suggestions and asked us to try their favorites free of charge to welcome us. Overall..Vite wasn't a place where we need to grab a business card to remember we've been there. We will remember and be back because of the "at home" feeling they give you.   We will be back. These guys know what they are doing it will get better fast.

As someone who has been working in the restaurant industry for over 20 years I feel quite qualified to leave a review regarding the new and exciting restaurant Vite. I went here with three girlfriends this past weekend and we loved it! I wasnt expecting it to be so busy after only being open for two weeks, so we had to wait at the bar. Not a problem for me. I was quickly offered a glass of wine and enjoyed my friends company. We decided to order our appetizers at the bar as we were hungry and didnt want to wait for our table. Meat Stuffed Olives! Whats better than that. They were really good. Probably could have went for a second order. We had the meat plate which came with bread, which they needed to replenish, They did no problem. We also had the tomato, basil and fresh mozzarella appetizer. It was delicious.  Plus a few other appetizers, all delicious. We were having such a good time hanging out by the bar eating and drinking we almost gave up our table when it became available but the waiter insisted we sit down to enjoy our dinner. We ordered the Risotto of the day which came in an authentic Italian clay pot, we also ordered the Homemade Ravioli, grilled skirt steak and rigatoni with Veal sauce. Yes we like to eat! ! The waiters assisted serving us as each entree was delivered, I must say the service was excellent.  Besides their professionalism they somehow made us feel like we were all old friends and already repeat customers. They even gave us a round of free shots after we ordered dessert. For dessert we had the tiramasu and the Popcorn Mousse with Popcorn Brittle. This is a must if you decide to go to Vite. They werent accepting credit cards that night, but it wasnt really a big deal as their was a cc machine around the corner.  The dinner took a bit long to come out but we really didnt mind as we were having such a great evening enjoying our "girls night out".  I wish more restaurants would take their time and not make you feel rushed.  Cant wait to go back!

I started working nearby about a year ago and realized quickly that there weren't too many options for lunch until I found out that the restaurant my friend always raved about had a location right up the street!  I probably average about once a week here for lunch and sometimes even grab dinner on my way home at night.  Mexican is my favorite food and this restaurant doesn't disappoint!  I usually get the surf n' turf (steak and shrimp) burrito either in a container (if I'm trying to be good) or in the tortilla and it's always delicious.  I brought one home for my husband and as he was eating it he told me it was the best burrito he ever had and if I brought him one every day, it would change his life!  Considering he hates other chain burrito places, this is quite the compliment!  The mild salsa (I don't do spicy) is also amazing and if they were to bottle it, I'd buy it!  The woman in charge is always very pleasant when she takes my order over the phone and also when I go to pick up.  I love this place and I'll continue going back!  This is the kind of authentic, delicious, local place that needs to be frequented and cherished amongst all the crappy food (in both quality and taste) that's out there.

Let me start by saying that I completely admire the concept behind this place. Healthy food. Eating right. Affordable prices. I get it. However, for me, the flavor was a bit underwhelming. The food wasn't bad. It was good.... It just wasn't  great. It seemed like a layer of flavor was missing... maybe more seasoning is needed. I don't know. I've only eaten here once and had the Sicilian Breakfast. I'll come back and try something else. Maybe it will change my mind.

My brother and I are visiting from San Diego, CA. We wanted a quick bite before we went to the Empire State Building, so we looked at our hotel list and found this place, looked at Yelp reviews, and made our way here, and boy, are we glad we came!! Aside from the awesome music playing, (Nirvana, Guns 'n Roses, Aerosmith) the food was great!!! EAT THE TOTS, JUST DO IT! We asked for well done burgers and we got WELL DONE BURGERS!!! The whole food experience was fantastic! Pricing is just as fantastic! 1st restaurant experience in NY was a huge success!
Pretty good cheap food. Restaurant ran by a nice older couple. Location makes it an ideal place to order from when in the mood for some pizza.

ZERO STARS. Party of 2. Seated immediately, great. Then over 11 mins and nobody approached our table. The funny thing is two other 2 tops right next to us were seated after us but got drinks, nachos and placed an order. That's when we left. I made eye contact with every employee but still no love. Go to Stateside, much better service and a great menu and bourbon list.

Stopped in opening night, definitely a much anticipated spot. The crowd slowly grew and everyone seemed to be having a great time. Atmosphere is chill and the open kitchen is awesome. On to the food - we started with the pickled mussels...so surprisingly refreshing and tasty! Next were the bacon wrapped matzo balls...fortunately they taste as good as they sound. The marrow was pure heaven and absolutely melts in your mouth and the chicken schnitzel was incredibly moist and delicious. Overall, I was really pleased...in truth I could've kept ordering if our plans had allowed. For those who enjoy new and interesting flavor combinations in a laid back, fun environment, the gorbals is for you. Bring friends, order one of everything and share, share, share.

A local classic and absolute staple in the Clifton/Montclair area!  Best "square" slice around - prepared with the sauce on top and cheese underneath.  The first thing you taste is the tangy sauce - crust is great as well.  Why not 5 stars? Depending on who is making the pizza quality can sometimes be inconsistent.

I came here for lunch a few months ago, and the staff had clearly just arrived... the restaurant was freezing (this was January). Since they were just setting up everything took quite a while, and my sushi was incredibly bad-- the fish was dry, limp, discolored, and old tasting and the rice was definitely from the day before.
My favorite lunch spot. The place has great food and reasonable prices. The only bad thing about is the service. The waitress is rude.

I stumbled across this place while attending Connecticon a few weeks ago.  I was starving and wandering near the Hilton; it's just a couple of blocks from there.  I wouldn't have gathered the food they had by the name, but I was pleasantly surprised.  They had breakfast sandwiches, some Korean food, and some Japanese dishes on their menu.  My boyfriend and I ordered the shrimp tempura udon and the regular udon respectively, and we both enjoyed it a lot.  There are large fridge units with bottled and canned drinks up front.   The girl at the cash register was friendly and genuine, though her parents (presumably the owners) didn't interact with us.  The restaurant was clean, but also a little empty.  There were only two other customers when we were there, and they were also convention attendees.  We left with a taro flavored boba (bubble tea), and the bubbles were perfect, not half-frozen like at some bakeries or restaurants. It was a joy to find this place in a nook in a quieter part of Hartford.  I'm not a fan of the city at all, but if you find yourself there, I would suggest Sunberry for simple and relatively inexpensive foreign cuisine.
nicest staff and delicious food.

I really enjoy the atmosphere (the outdoor seating is pretty solid), and the margaritas are pretty great. Honestly, I go back for Hugo, who is the man. He has got to be the best waiter I've ever seen, and I've seen many. He remembers us every time, he brings us free drinks and food, and he's just generally pleasant and upbeat. Great, great guy. The food here is good - you will enjoy whatever you get. I think it is moderately overpriced, but not so much to deter me from going there quite often.

One of my favorite places in New Haven. Going there in the summer is great because it has a nice deck which is hard to find on downtown New Haven. If you like tequila this is the place for you because they have a ton of tequila to try. Margaritas are really great too!
Turkey chopped BBQ is a must-have here! I am also a fan of their banana pudding cake, everything is quite good and affordable.
Had lunch there. Food was terrible (my quiche must have been made several days ago).

One of the easiest 5 stars. This place is what Brooklyn is all about with a piece of real hispanic food. The service was great and the  food brought memories of when I used to live with mom and grandma. I had the pernil with rice and my daughter had the sancocho. The food was plated great. The pernil was just like moms and the sancocho was flavored to perfection. You have to get the coconut flan. The best part of dinner was when we were caught off guard with a salsa band performing. It was a great night.
Great pizza and awesome salad. Service was slow and parking is a pain. But I love the atmosphere and would go back to this hip pizza bar.

This is undoubtedly currently  THE BEST THAI on UES! This food is so amazing that other thai in the hood seems to taste like blend food next to it. Ambiance is nice and comfy, staff is pleasant. More such wonderful restaurants into the hood please.

I love the Boil! Delicious food, friendly service and a chill crowd. Very West Coasty and a must for people who love their shellfish as much as I do. Be prepared to get your hands dirty though and don't make any plans for after since you will be sure to want to waddle home and wash all the fish off. We had the soft shell crab to start which was just okay, then we shared bags of the Lobster, Shrimp, Crawfish and Dungeness Crab. The shrimp was my absolute favorite (suck the head!) but everything was delicious in that buttery garlicky old bay sauce. The corn and potatoes were also super flavourful in that sauce and the only thing I wished was that there was more of it. Prices were very reasonable for the amount of food you get and I will definitely be back!
Had reservation, sat immediately.  Attentive wait staff, good food, nice people around us. We had shrimp and artichoke oreganato. Veal saltimbocca. Cappuccino was excellent too. Can't wait to return.

The sandwiches are delicious, the portions are generous, and the pastries delightful; however the service is terrible. The staff is obviously overworked and underpaid, they seem stressed, unorganized, and at sometimes even fearful.

I live a couple blocks from Mountain Province. It is a wonderful addition to the neighborhood. I love their coffee, and I am addicted to the homemade pineapple scones! There is nothing better than an independent coffee shop instead of a corporate chain. I almost forgot, the owner is super friendly and sweet!

Blue Corn was AMAZING! Would definitely go there again. I highly recommend this place for some of the best authentic mexican food I've had outside of Los Angeles. The atmosphere was really cool and it felt like you were in a different country. The service was excellent , and the place was very clean. The wait staff was very friendly and informative about the menu items. I ordered the Anjellitos Negroes and it was excellent. All of the prices are very reasonable for the amount of food. They have a full bar and they are CASH ONLY for now. Will definitely be back very soon! Will definitely be back

I have been coming here for years and everytime i'm greeted by the nicest people! Pastas and soups are delicious! They make fresh soup daily! They have an amazing brunch special on the weekends too! I also love the decorative touches, very cozy!

Had a wonderful girls night out dinner here at Labebe.  Definitely 5 stars on the decor  which is really stunning! The food is terrific.  Started with a the fried calamari which was cooked and seasoned perfectly, just melted in my mouth. My mom had the gazpacho and loved it.  For entrees, I had the greek salad with chicken which was delicious and my mom had the apricot glazed chicken which was fabulous. I gave it 4 stars because I think it's slightly overpriced.   I'm not sure why the reviews aren't better from other diners, but we really enjoyed this restaurant and will definitely return!
Awesome! Food has a ton of flavor and tables inside are placed throughout a little market.
Come only for drinks food has gone down hill, manager Moses served us cold fries, a dirty wine glass with ranch dressing on the glass .. WILL NEVER COME TO THIS ESTABLISHMENT AGAIN

Fantastic gastropub, had an almost overwhelming selection of beers and some of the best appetizers I have ever had. If you are going to have one definitely try the flatbread with pork belly, my mouth is watering just thinking about it. Went during happy hour so it was getting a bit crowded but the wait staff was great and courteous. Definitely will be back

The food and service weren't bad but not as good as we've had elsewhere in NYC and not as good as I would have expected based on its reputation. It was morning so didn't try the legendary cheesecake. The place itself looks great though! I heard they are moving location as the site is to be developed, so maybe that is having an impact on things.
We really liked this place!!! Great food and service.  The strawberry cheesecake was delicious!!!!
The food is average pizzeria and not cheap.  Add that to the fact that I puked my guts out in the bathroom during the "meal" and I've decided not to go back.

I love this place!  The Chaat Puri is my favorite. This is not a place to go to eat with a group of people as it is tight and usually crowded. I have eaten at the place once but rather order for pick up and enjoy it in the comfort of my own home.

Great atmosphere at this place- low key yet hip.  Super nice and helpful waitstaff from the hostess to the waiter to all of the servers and clearers!  I went here with my tween daughters and the eldest (picky eater) said it was the best restaurant she's ever eaten at. She even tried - and loved! - the watermelon gazpacho. Her personal fav was the candied bacon. I'd also recommend the pickles, the avocado appetizer, the Burke n Bag (dessert) and the amazing donuts. Yes the skirt steak was delicious -- but I have to say the apps and the desserts stole the show!

Difficult to find, needed to go into an office building and get directions from the desk manned by security guard. Only a small external sign. First time drinking sake, waitress walked us through a recommendation based on our wine tastes, was so good had to track down 2 more bottles. Food is generally excellent, somewhat unique and well-presented.

We were at Fette Sau for a going away party with a large group. The barbecue was pretty bland but we had been before for the atmosphere. But the bartender and server kept complaining at us as soon as it hit 11 o'clock. We had been there since 7:30 and had spent a lot of money and wanted to finish our drinks, but they made a big deal about cleaning up around us and even took a drink out of our friend's hand. It was rude and very unprofessional.

After a not so great experience last summer we recently decided to try Jalisco again ......for the last time. I won't get into all the details about the poor attitudes after a legitimate complaint and the subpar food they serve. If you happen to be reading this, spend your money elsewhere!!!!
The Minetta tavern is a quintessential New York experience. I tasted a great burgher. Great atmosphere and great location, just few steps from the Comedy Cellar and the Blue note.

La Sirene was my "I owe a good meal to myself" place. I was introduced to the place by my ex-boyfriend, and I claimed the place as my own. I would recommend the Goat Cheese Tarts, and if you're really wanting to treat yourself- Filet Mignon.

We had a wonderful dinner in this lovely restaurant in Soho : the cook is very careful with the quality of the food. We loved the tenderloin and the kassoulet. For dessert, we ate some delicious profiteroles with chocolate sauce.
Great fresh vietnamese sandwiches! This is a take-away place so don't go expecting to sit and be served.

Yummy pizza with great combinations but the menu is very small. The seating is family style, which was fine for our family of 5 on a pretty empty day but many might not like this. A bit pricey but the pizza was great.
Its a must to eat the burger and fries in this place. Really cozy, nice and great to eat. At night the lights make this place really romantic.

Diamond in the rough! The parking lot was almost empty when we arrived but we had a living social deal we wanted to use. Plus it's BYOB and you can't beat that! We ordered gyoza, Japanese spring roll, and the beef yakitori. The gyoza were perfectly pan fried, the spring roll was actually 8 mini rolls, great to share, and the beef yakitori had such great flavor we were scrapping the plate to identify what was in the sauce! We then had the valentines roll and the maki B platter. All the rolls were delicious but we were surprised that there were only 6 pieces in each roll on the platter. I feel like you usually see 8 pieces. But they were all delicious! We will be back!
Mussels are really good at an inexpensive price for a lot. Awesome food at a much cheaper price than it seems like it should cost.

I had the raspberry tea here today.  it was really refreshing.  I love how it's right next to the park cause I play ball at the park across the street.  The prices are reasonable and shop is small but cozy.  I would definitely come back next time and I'll definitely recommend it to a friend.
Wow so overrated. The hamburger shouldn't even be on the menu. Nice location and vibe food meh.

Great service and great food. I've been here several times, food is always consistent. Their pork belly buns,melts in your mouth. Their green papaya salad is refreshing.  Duck ramen and seafood ramen is tasty.

The food is yummy but it was better with the previous chef. Very crowded after 6pm on weeknights with the business school crowd but after 8pm ish it settles down. The duck fries and clam pizza are classic greats.

We had heard about this place and decided to check it out. We walked in the door to a strange little waiting area. The host was very nice (but seemed a bit nervous) and told us there were no tables available but that we could wait there and get drinks until something opened up. "There" was at this long bench with a few (maybe 3) small tables alongside. There were 4 of us and this made for some awkward seating. It took about a half an hour to get a table. During this time, we were each brought a drink and all of the drinks were very nicely done. The drinks took a while to be made, but after tasting them you could see why. The staff was very nice and very prompt in refilling our water while we waited. When we were seated they brought us farther back into the room. I was surprised to see just how small the place was. The wall to the left of the room had a large projector playing scenes on it. I could tell that this place was going for a very trendy, hip vibe. But I felt it was trying too hard, basically hitting me over the head with it. Something about the projector wall made me feel that the small space was even smaller. We each ordered another drink (which were very good as well) and then decided to move on to someplace else. If I didn't know of other great cocktail bars in the city, I'd be more inclined to return here. I did not try the food, so perhaps I will give it another try. Overall though the atmosphere wasn't doing it for me.
Cafe style seating (benches and long tables) was very easy going and efficient, but was nothing like a cafeteria.  I don't like sushi, but there was great food for this vegetarian.

L&B is a must if you are anywhere in Brooklyn. This restaurant has the best food in the area. The pizza is incredible and you can get both thin slices or thick pan pizza squares. They sell individual slices or entire pies...just walk up to the window and place your order and grab a picnic table outdoors. The gelatos are also amazing I hear but I was too full to try any on my last visit. I'll be back for sure!
Fresh seafood, cooked to perfection! Average atmosphere but is always very crowded because the food you find here you don't find at many restaurants. Friendly staff!

Overall wonderful experience. Saw the restaurant/bar on yelp and decided to check it out with my mom and brother, what a spectacular decision! Don't walk in expecting the Ritz, but if you want that "I'm a regular" feel, this. is. your. place. Stopped in to have some drinks and dinner and were greeted by an exceptional owner and waitress. By following the suggestions of our waitress we ordered the Drunk fish soup (amazing), garlic shrimp, fried rice with shrimp (ooooh I'm dreaming of it), and the pork belly dish. No complains heard. The service was impeccable. Rarely in New York will you get a waitress, let a lone an owner who really connects and wants to welcome you to their "home." Go and try this place, dressed in your jeans and t-shirt ready to take some shots and have a margarita (or a beer from their hefty list) and enjoy this dive bar with amazing food! You won't regret it! Thanks again, we'll be back!!

The long lines goes really quickly. I had the cauliflower sandwich it had good flavor not enough cauliflower. The bread is good, but the sandwich is mostly bread. I wish it was a little more even. The red sauce on the side adds the right amount of spice.

We stopped by Mamoun's based on other reviewers. Remember to bring cash, as they do not accept credit cards. We both had shawarma sandwiches, which did not stand up to sandwiches I had tried in the Middle East but by American standards, they were very good. The meat was a bit fatty but the sandwiches were filling, flavorful and affordable ($6/sandwich).

I'd been hearing about this place FOREVER, so I decided to finally drop in and see what the fuss was all about. Let me tell you, I'm glad I did. This spot is the BEES KNEES,YO. I ordered the fettuccine with clams in a white wine sauce. WHOA, NELLY. If you've ever wanted to know what a full service shiatsu massage to your taste buds feels like, you have to try the white wine sauce. You know why McGruff took a bite out of crime? Because it was smothered in that life changing condiment of wonder. BUT WAIT. You won't believe this, but the best part of my day happened AFTER I exited this establishment of fine dining. I had an appointment with the peeps at TinderHeadshots.com. I wanted to get some grade A, professional photos for my Tinder profile, because the one I have now where I'm petting my orange tabby, Mr. Snugglesworth, gives off an evil genius, I plan to take over the world vibe. When I got there, I had that delicious, delicious white wine sauce dripping down my face. You know what these cats at Tinder Headshots did? They wiped it off my chin. They made me look like a presentable human being. Crazy, right? Did I mention the tasteful cardigan I had on was DRENCHED in that awe inspiring white wine sauce? I wanted to keep it on during the photo shoot and just suck on the collar between set ups. THEY WERE HAVING NONE OF THAT. These dudes helped me into some new threads, and had me looking like a Don Juan at senior prom. Once I score a hot date on Tinder using these photos, I'm bringing my new lady friend to Upstate!
Kebabs are delicious!  Highly recommend.  The weather was perfect so we sat in the garden which is cute and charming.  We will be back as soon as they secure their liquor license :)

Awesome sushi at a very good price. They have a nice lunch special. Since I work around here it's nice they have a lunch special I can order off of. They are quick and efficient. Great customer service. Definitely going back!

I would say the quality of the brisket and Turkey, were a notch below fette sau, but the attentive and friendly atmosphere and service more than made up for it. My biggest complaint would be the fact that they do not serve any bbq sauce what so ever. I feel that with some sauce it would have made the turkey which was a lil bit on the dry side much more enjoyable. If your in the area I would say it's worth a try, but this place is still no match when placed up against mighty Quinn's in the city.

Allow me to preface this with two notes. First, I don't fancy European seafood on my taste palate. I prefer American seafood. Also, just a heads up that this restaurant has been the subject of two episodes of Gordon Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares. So take those two points with a grain of salt, two grains of salt which may have made my meal better. I ordered Arroz con Pollo y Chorizo thinking that'd be the safest thing for me to order on the menu given my dislike for European food. The salad and bread that held us over till our entrees arrived were delightfully good, but that's where it ended for me. The chicken was fatty and gristly. The sausage had chunks of fat in them that noticeably took up at least 1/3 of the diameter of the meat... And it tasted like bleu cheese. The rice was so so, nothing special. I decided to eat only bread for the remainder of my meal, but $16 is too much to pay for bread. I would have been better off going to Popeyes across the street...

Great food + amazing service Came here to celebrate my friend's birthday, the waiter was really helpful and attentive. One of the best that ive been to. Food were well seasoned although the apps were a liltle too salty for us but overall the food were fantastic!! Everybody enjoyed it very much ! And the Birthday boy got his liltle surprise with the help from the waiter. Thanks so much!!

This is my favorite neighborhood restaurant in the city. The market plates are perfect for vegetarians. Whether I've dined in or gotten take-out, the food is always fresh and delicious. Between this restaurant and their West Village location, have eaten here 30+ times over the past year and have never been disappointed.

I will start by saying thanks to everyone who has written a review for this place. You all have lead me to this wonderful food. This is really the type of quality and detail that every meal should entail. I feel sorry for anyone who has not been here. I will not describe the food. You need to get down here. I will be back here in three days to experience more of the menu that I could not fit into my body.
For a first timer of Jamaican cuisine there jerk chicken was finger licking good. The reasturant was very meticulous and clean.

This place is a jewel!  First of all - how often do you find Jamaican/Caribbean food around here?  But I don't just love it because it's unique - the food is really good and you can tell the lady that owns the place puts tons of love in to everything.  The lunch special is a steal, and you get a nice size portion of jerk chicken, rice and peas, plantains and veggies...  Like a homemade meal. I will say that the spice level on the jerk is pretty tame - certainly nowhere near the stuff I had on a trip to the Caribbean years ago.  It's delicious, though, and so tender it literally falls off the bone.  The sauce from the chickens run all down in to the rice and veggies. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it... The place is always very neat and clean, the food is great and the prices are very reasonable. The owner is sweet and is always friendly.  What more can you ask for?  The location is weird, hidden away in a strip mall where you wouldn't even know it's there.  But that's not a problem for you if you're reading this review!  Go out and try it!

Finding good fried chicken in NYC is difficult. Some of the most highly rated options I've tried were no better than the Publix Supermarket deli chicken (although their chicken is great). The fried chicken here was delicious. They incorporate sweet tea & lemon with a light breading and tender juicy chicken. It makes for a deadly combo. The menu is very inventive with new takes on old southern favorites. We tried a few different items and enjoyed each of them. I also recommend taking a look at the cocktail list. The drinks are well crafted and offer great flavor without being overpowering.

We were so stoked to check out this pizza place and it was pretty darn good. The place was nice for a tavern and the service and staff were great. The pizza however was super greasy. I tend to love pizza but really can't handle too much grease - so unfortunately I can't say I would reccommend this place for their pizza. My daughter had the spaghetti with meatballs and that was pretty good - not amazing but definately decent.

My girlfriend and I have adopted Yummy Sushi as our usual place. The severs are really friendly and the food is out in a flash on most days. which is great if you're having a date night and trying to get to a movie or something. The only problems I really have with this place is that they always have the same music playing and there are only a few rolls from there I really like but otherwise it's pretty cool try it out!

Big fan of this place! Super affordable, good food, really friendly staff, and quick service. We came here for my birthday and they were really accommodating and friendly. We were a pretty big group, around 10 or so, but they brought the entrees out as they were ready, so everyone was served very quickly. We got a good sense of the whole menu, and everything was delicious - the perfect amount of spiciness and well portioned. Will definitely come back here again.
SIMPLY A GEM. (Please add more vegetarian delights, especially antipasto!)

Ok for the price - pulled pork tasted more like stewed pork - no sauces to pick from No cornbread or other bread beside store bought buns? What kind of BarBQ place use "Pomme Frites"? Slaw is compliments but a spoonful? Given the hype - where is the creativity and taste? Sadly disappointed
Best pizza in new haven! Pepe's and Sally's and bar are very good but modern is my favorite! Fresh tomato white sauce with garlic and basil is my favorite

This place is unbelievable. The food is so delicious, I drool thinking about the next time I'll go for some more. Service is casual and attentive. There is even two little tables outside, which is wonderful. Keep up the good work!

We were excited to try The Simone after reading the reviews. We were concerned that we might not get a table since we called during hours and they don't answer the phone. Tina greeted us with a very warm, "you must be my 9:15."  We shyly replied no and she said, "well you are now."   The warmth by which she greeted us carried over throughout the meal and by all of her staff. We chose the wine pairings as it was obvious that Tina is a master at creating the right pair and giving you detailed information about the wine maker as well as its flavor. She even provided us a note card detailing what we are and drank, written in her lovely script! Everything was delicious, we began with the goat cheese soufflé, have never tasted a lighter soufflé. The onion jam that accompanied the Terrine was a perfect compliment. Lamb and Flounder as entrees were robust in flavor. We look forward to returning to The Simone on our next visit to the City.
we ordered the Torchietti and the pasta was undercooked and very salty, we also ordered the paparizza pie and that was salty as well.... oh and there bathrooms are disgusting!!

My firend and I had dinner at Blue Cat, last evening.  I have eaten in si=ome of the best restaurants all over North America and Europe.  The food here is AWESOME.  Presented in a top notch fashion.  The service is relaxed casual, but very good. It is almost like the food out does the location and service.  We will absolutely be back!!!

Shout out to Derek!! Such great customer service and delicious drinks! We made a quick stop here on the way to the subway and decided to stay longer. The Happy Hour us worth it. Definitely going back to check out the brunch, lunch, or dinner next time I am in town! On a side note. My friend forgot her sunglasses and when we were 3 blocks away, we heard Derek running after us with her sunglasses! WOW!

Casa Mono is easily my favorite restaurant. We've come here multiple times for birthdays, promotions, and anniversaries and Casa Mono raises the bar every time. Thank goodness it is a tapas restaurant because you get there and want to try everything. Here you have to opportunity to try several different plates without getting too full. I definitely recommend making reservations for the bar in front of the chefs so you can observe all the care the kitchen puts in to each dish. Sitting here can also help you decide what you want to order while you enjoy some wine. Venture out of your comfort zone here, you will not regret it. We tried Babbo, one of Mario B's other restaurants, and by the end of the meal we wished we had gone to Casa Mono. There's no need to go into the details of each dish, because its more rewarding to try them without a pre-existing opinion. The setting of the restaurant is lively but romantic. The staff will help remove any uncertainties you have about the menu items with detailed suggestions. Don't expect to eat on the cheap here. If you have wine, 5-7 small plates, dessert, and coffee, with tip you can expect to spend $200-$300 for two. I would be lying if I said it wasn't worth every penny.

I've been to this branch 3-4 times (mainly for lunch) and I always found the food to be sub-par. No real flavors, the rice n beans are tasteless and dry. The mole sauce is floating in oil. The default salsa tastes like cheap grocery store jar salsa. If you ask for spicy verde sauce, its decent. The portions are decent and outdoor seating is nice but that's about it. They manage to survive due to lack of any competition in the area as they are run by the same folks who run Taste of Mexico at Princeton Shopping center!
Fresh noodle made right in front of your eyes, great food and great price.

Hey I live in jersey. When you go to a place like this, you have to understand.  Charm, Sinatra playing, tables with family style portions and side salads. Men who come over to welcome you and clear the table at the same time- are they the owners, servers, patrons , who knows? The kind of place that Disney comes out to study and then replicates in a theme park. If you are looking for fancy, get outa here! Nice people, good food,

Excellent sandwiches! Usually packed at lunch (but that is to be expected, especially since they are delicious) so the wait is a little longer than expected but it is totally worth it! Nice staff, good prices, great food!

I never ordered food from this place, but my coworkers have, usually late night.  They always are out of any lasagna or ravioli entrees etc. my coworker just ordered a meatball grinder and received a breaded chicken grinder.  He ate half of it and feels too sick to bother calling them back to have the issue fixed.

Ordered the Italian Lovers pizza minus the sausage and oh my goodness. I was so surprised. The pizza was loaded with the toppings. The crust was crunchy. And it was made fresh and in a timely manner! The fried dough was well worth the $2, seeing as they provided way more than 8 pieces as it was stated on the menu. Definitely will be making more visits to try out others things that they offer. The place could definitely earn 5 stars if they cleaned the sitting area such as sweeping the floor and wiping the tables.
The BEST BEST BEST ramen I've ever have in US. 黑木耳 wins; cha-su wins; tamago wins; soup wins; the noodles themselves win. Shio ramen is too good to pass! And the price is not at all pretentious!
This Thai restaurant was a great find - the food was delicious and very reasonably priced. The service was friendly and attentive. I'd go back.

Loved The Cellar! We came after my birthday dinner across the street for drinks and it was lovely. The space was laid out nicely and the staff were super friendly. The way the bar was laid out was perfect for a big group to sit down and have people meet us and come and ago as they please. The cocktails were delish too - I had the Pat Burnham and it was refreshing. My friend had the cheese plate and it came out quickly, and he was more than satisfied. The staff was great about my birthday and gave the table a big slice of chocolate cake that was to die for.
My fiance and I were looking for a quick bite and came across this place... the Lobster rolls were delicious and the staff was friendly... Will stop by again when in Philly.
Best pizza ever! love going here with the kids on sundays

Just an update, I contacted the manager in response to his reply but never heard back. The scallops did taste very good but it was not an entree size. Your own staff at the bar agreed with this complaint. I hope that you improve this dish or offer it as an appetizer at a lower price point.

Love this place...always our "go to" date night out in New Haven. Love the idea of being able to pick on a little of this and a little of that. Love the meat and cheese plates and the garlic bulb to put on op of bread. you have to ask though if they have the garlic bulbs still because it is not on the menu any more. Also love the lobster fideos, grilled hanger steak, chorizo and figs, ham and cheese croquets. Sangria and mojitos are always a good choice too!

Tiny little hole in the wall. Food is really yummy - dumplings are big, plump, and tasty. The sesame bread with duck is delish too but a bit greasy. For value this place is 5-stars but I'll take 2 away for eh service.

I'd been hearing about this place FOREVER, so I decided to finally drop in and see what the fuss was all about. Let me tell you, I'm glad I did. This spot is the BEES KNEES,YO. I ordered the noodles with mashed sesame sauce. WHOA, NELLY. If you've ever wanted to know what a full service shiatsu massage to your taste buds feels like, you have to try the mashed sesame sauce. You know why McGruff took a bite out of crime? Because it was smothered in that life changing condiment of wonder. BUT WAIT. You won't believe this, but the best part of my day happened AFTER I exited this establishment of fine dining. I had an appointment with the peeps at TinderHeadshots.com. I wanted to get some grade A, professional photos for my Tinder profile, because the one I have now where I'm petting my orange tabby, Mr. Snugglesworth, gives off an evil genius, I plan to take over the world vibe. When I got there, I had that delicious, delicious mashed sesame sauce dripping down my face. You know what these cats at Tinder Headshots did? They wiped it off my chin. They made me look like a presentable human being. Crazy, right? Did I mention the tasteful cardigan I had on was DRENCHED in that awe inspiring mashed sesame sauce? I wanted to keep it on during the photo shoot and just suck on the collar between set ups. THEY WERE HAVING NONE OF THAT. These dudes helped me into some new threads, and had me looking like a Don Juan at senior prom. Once I score a hot date on Tinder using these photos, I'm bringing my new lady friend to Prosperity Dumpling!

This place is great!! Everytime I come here staff treats me well.  Never had a bad pizza except for the truffle soaked pizza.   Went there on a Sat. was busy I asked if we could have a glass of wine while we wait. Wait staff happily poured us what we wanted even let us sit outside. Enjoy the pizza!!
Great experience from bar to food! Scallops were cooked to perfection, "crazy jane" cocktail was thirst quenching and the molten lava cake was to die for! Would return in a nanosecond!

WARNING: I ate here on July July 21, 2014 and I ordered the whole lobster for $26. When it arrived I noticed immediately that they had removed the lobster tail - which is where most of the lobster meat is!!!! The waiter tried to convince me that it was in fact a whole lobster - but I have been eating whole lobster my whole life and it's pretty obvious when the entire tail is missing! BE CAREFUL when you order food here! I left  hungry and upset.
Wonderful place
Great food and pleasant atmosphere. Not a typical Trenton restaurant, and nice neighborhood.

Food was really good. Absolutely the worst service I have ever experienced. This service was so bad that I almost knocked a table over and left but my diner came out (before my appetizers) so that stopped me from leaving. When the apps finally came out, they forgot one taco out of two. While we waited for 45 min until we got food... Our waitress didn't come to let us know anything. We sat in the dark util we had to open our mouths. I will order out from here... But refuse to ever sit and eat.

The whole experience was average, the service was ok, price was reasonable, but food could use some work. Basically, don't order anything outside of the Appetizers and Dim Sum category. Signature dishes were good, but the cook who did the Fresh Bacon with preserved cabbage dish should be sent back to China to relearn what it supposes to taste like. The rice cake dish was too greasy and tasted flat, couple bites and I couldn't eat anything anymore.
Met local friends at the Midtown location. What a treat! Ramen here has no resemblance to the dried, salty packs you may have sampled. Try the pork rolls and any of the broth based dishes.
OUTSTANDING!!!!  Everything was perfection!  Now, I know why I miss Philly...

I live around the corner, and was so excited when they FINALLY opened.... and it is awesome! 5 of my friends and I came in on a Friday evening around 8:30pm. BYOB which is great. We ordered the sampler appetizer platter to start. Everything was very tasty. The chicken satay was incredible. The crab Rangoon was good, not earth shattering, but tasty. It came with a bunch of other stuff, which was all very quickly eaten. ($14) I asked our waitress to culinary transport me to Thailand, and she recommended the Tom Yum Soup. - It is crack. I am addicted. I can't wait to have it again. Spicy, tangy with shrimp and mushrooms. It is incredible. Seriously, it is on my list of "when can I get my next fix"  It is on the same level with the soup dumplings from Dim Sum Garden. Like i seriously may have to go back in the middle of this review. ..... I had the crazy noodles. - Awesome, I really enjoyed it. My friends had the Pad Thai - Tasty. good size servings. They seemed pleased with their pick. I would like to go back and try the curries as they looked really good on the menu. Speaking of the menu, it actually had some printed prices crossed off, with lower prices written in.....which surprised me as, normally when that happens the price goes up. All the prices were reasonable, in fact, I was kinda worried that some of them were too low. Like we might go out of business because we are giving our food away low prices. But truly, very affordable. Total bill for 5 people (5 entrees, $14 sampler platter, 2 soups) was around $70. Atmosphere was pleasant and clean. Gorgeous table linens, cloth napkins. Open kitchen concept. Q102 playing the background. My friends and I had a great time, LOVED the food, and will certainly return!
The fries are great and the sauces are plentiful. I opt for the traditional mayo but there are many different ones to try.
The empanadas were flavorful, i ordered spicy beef and and chicken and cheese empanadas both were good..its a must try...you will be waiting for about 20 minutes to be seated but its worth the wait

I really like l&w oyster, so had been looking forward to almond, but was very disappointed.  My wife and I were celebrating some recent milestones so we ordered a bottle of wine and a number of small plates to share.  The waitress asked us which order we wanted our small plates to come out in and we said we didn't mind.  Then, within two minutes we were served five different dishes all at once!  We couldn't even fit them all on our tiny table and more importantly we still had a whole bottle of wine to drink!  We asked the waitress if she could stagger the dishes (thought this would have been obvi), so she took them away.  As the waitress brought our dishes out to us the rest of the evening each one tasted like it had been resting under the heat lamp for longer than the previous one.  I found the food bland and as per the above was not impressed with the service.

What a fantastic restaurant!  One of the owners, Thibaut, is attentive and funny; he really makes the experience wonderful.  I have followed him here from a previous bar and am so happy to support his new business. I went with two friends.  We tried the cheese platter, the salad with figs, and the paleo zuchini pasta.  We literally could not stop raving about how fresh and complex the flavors in each dish were.   We will definitely be back!
the best sandwich shop anywhere!!!!

The Toasted truck just fell into my path randomly one night after a museum event. Ever since, my boyfriend and I find ourselves hoping to spot one of these trendy little trucks in random  spots constantly. Not only was the food delicious, but the service and vibe put out by the staff was over the top. Overall experience, outstanding!

The service was great from the beginning. Great atmosphere and vibe. I ordered the spicy pork meatball with spicy space and a side of mash potatoes. After few minutes the meatballs arrive. My goodness, was like eating freaking real meatballs for the first time. The meatballs were delicious, soft, moist, perfect amount of spice and the space incredible. The potatoes went along with it.

The Becco Restaurant was within walking distance of our hotel just off Time Square. When we arrived we where seated very quickly and greeted then by our sever giving use a wine. The very cool thing here is " all bottles of wine are $ 25.00" and they had 100's to select from. Within minutes the brought out a wonderful bread box with 3 different types loved them all. They had many all your could eat specials and specials of the day I had the Veal Terry my wife had 3 unlimited pasta. They have an amusing house Caesars salad all you can eat. This was old world service and real Italian food Five stars Steve the Builder and Terry the Contractor Cocoa Beach Florida
I would come here for the atmosphere. Food is good, it's very well worth eating at. I kind of felt that my pasta (custom made, I like plain pasta with herbs) was sort of watery.
A great place to find delicious vegetarian deli sandwiches. Excellent service and soothing ambiance. It also has great organic coffee and wireless internet . The Club Sandwiches are amazing!

Burgers are equivalent to something I'd get at a snack bar. I have to commend Shake shack for delivering something I thought of never experience-an absolutely undrinkable milkshake. The restaurant has 2 separate lines which is very confusing to a first-time customer. The music mind-numbingly loud and the color scheme of the interior looks like a Seattle Seahawks jersey. All hype. Awful.
the almond croissant is super delicious.
Chicken Cutlet Lagasse with prosciutto, long hots, sharp provolone, & broccoli rade..Wow! Cheesesteak is so much better than the "others" in the neighborhood.

The crispy hipcity ranch with buffalo is single handely the best vegan imitation dish I have ever eaten. If you live here, go here. If you don't, go there. If you are vegatarian, go vegan. If you are vegan, hell yeah. The girl at the register was so beautiful. Jimmy Logan Jimmy Logan is an ugly idiot.
Great pork soup dumpling. i will definitely come back everytime I come back to Philadelphia

My review is pretty much, "Why is this place not always PACKED?" It did take me forever to venture into the restaurant, but since then, I've been back many times and have never been disappointed. Everything on the menu is delicious. The brunch menu and the dinner menu - while small - only include delicious things. Who needs a huge menu with filler when you can have a small one with yum after yum? The Tagliolini, Pappardelle w/black truffle, and the chicken dish (which I can't recall the name of) are delicious. The staff and owner are also super cool. Definitely would recommend... and bring CASH.
The service wasn't good, waitress forgot an appetizer, no warm  Irish soda bread only cold rolls, disappointed

We LOVE Tashan. We used our Living Social coupon tonight and loved everything. The server was the same as our last, a very nice and helpful woman named Virginia. She helped us pick the perfect menu and our favorite this time was the scallops. A MUST try. The calamari was wonderful, matched perfectly with cheesy naan. Tashan is beautiful, the staff is gracious,we left happy and full yet again. Thank you Tashan!
Don't go here if you are gluten intolerant! The staff was very clear with us that they can not accommodate this need.

Meh... The food came out quickly but still gave me time to make friends in the dining area, which was cool. They screwed up one of the  dishes on my order but there were three or four people that came in with big orders at a similar time so I feel for them. It happens. The food was all super greasy... when it sat for an hour after we ate, the grease all separated itself from the rest of the food and lay in a puddle around everything. The best food item was the bbq pork ribs, which were super tasty even though a puddle of oil coalesced around the OUTSIDE of the container when I took them out of the bag. They were super tasty though. The garlic chicken wasn't garlicky or spicy... the hot sesame dumplings were not spicy either. Nothing that was supposed to be spicy actually was... Also... the food went right through my wife's system and made me feel bloated.... The prices we're good for the amount of food that we got. The flavor was decent and there wasn't anything bad necessarily. Yeah, I dunno... I think I'll look around for other options.

I'm giving Marlow and Sons 5 stars because...isn't it obvious? The food and atmosphere is maybe the best around. My comment is related to the morning coffee scene though. I've lived directly across the street for the last 5 years and have witnessed many changes to not only the neighborhood but the coffee too. First of all, as much as I love this place, why is the daytime service so bad? Just because you're behind the machine doesn't mean you can't at least say hello or acknowledge the presence of the customer.  This doesn't speak for everybody, there are some really great people there too. Second with all the new options in our own amazing city, even borough, why does such a establishment with local and sustainable focus still get their coffee shipped out from the west coast? Maybe the FedEx truck gives it that extra special flavor? One of the commenters below even proclaimed it's like SF in Brooklyn. As a customer living in Brooklyn and not a SF tourist, that's not a positive win for me. Will I keep getting my morning coffee here? Given it's close proximity to my studio, mostly yes. But I should probably keep my visits for the meals and get some morning exercise and walk a little farther down the road if for nothing else, supporting my local community while getting my cup of joe. The food at Marlow & Sons is amazing. Local, creative and simple all at the same time. No guilty pleasure there!
What a wonderful crew works here. Creative restaurant week offerings, beautiful AND delicious. Kudos to the owner and the staff for putting it out there for all to enjoy.

I HAD a reservation for 6 people and wanted to increase it to 7 people.. I received a comment of they needed to "ask" if that was possible.. for 1 person?!?!? then I was instructed that I needed to change my dining time to 45 min later to accommodate 1 extra person.. just 1... I canceled the reservation.. asked to speak with the manager, that never got on the phone.. I will NEVER dine there.. and will deter all who suggest it..

The place is always packed, but the line moves pretty quick and the food is good. We had both pizza & pasta. The only problem is that there isn't really room to eat inside. Still, it was a tasty and inexpensive meal - which in midtown isn't always easy to find. We even had a bonus of seeing a celebrity who was starring in a Broadway show nearby pick up his pre-show meal!
One of the better Chinese restaurants in the area.  No drinks with little pink umbrellas.  Service is fast and efficient.  A Chinese restaurant in a diner.

Had a bad experience when we checked out Southwark. The Manhattans at Southwark were (surprisingly) very watery. I imagine it's not usually the case, but when we told the bartenders that our drinks had come out a watery, they replied thatthey make hundreds of Manhattan, had won awards for them, and that nothing could possibly be wrong with them. No offer was made to remake. No other option was offered. We felt forced to ask for the check and to leave.  While we did not drink the drinks, no drink was taken off the check. It was the bad service that really bothered us. We wrote management about our negative experience, and we did not hear anything back. We understand that sometimes drinks don't hit the mark, but what was really disappointing was the service that we received. A miss for us. Save your hard earned money for better experiences. Vernick and The Franklin have been great.

Love this restaurant. The food is so wonderful. The staff is amazing..Didn't have to ask for coffee refill, they were there before my cup was finished. I recommended this restaurant to all my friends. I can't wait to go back!

I love this halal cart, one of the best i've had so far. I ordered chicken over rice and a salad, the white-sauce is great and so is the pepper but be careful of how much is put on it because its pretty spicy.
amazing! line is always long for a reason! & it moves quick! cant really ask for better prices!

When we come to the Market, we usually eat at Hershel's, but today there wasn't a line at Dinic's. The food was okay. I had their specialty, roast Italian pork, sharp prov and broccoli rabe. The pork was not that tasty. Anyhow...the worst was the housekeeping. Not only did they NOT wipe the counter after each guest, but they did not clean the serving baskets between guests. Not even spray or a rinse. The entire service area was unkempt. Ok, I'm done.

We got the lamb ribs, the pig tails, the crispy chicken skins and the razor clams. The razor clams were ok, but OH MY GOD, everything else was amazing. The smoked lamb ribs were according to my boyfriend, the best lamb he has ever ate, and I don't doubt it.
