the spaghetti was delish. the waiter was a bit annoying though because we (three diff people over the course of our meal) asked for more bread and he would not give us any and we ordered a feast (including drinks apps dinner desserts and coffees).

Great burgers... I had the burger with cheesesteak on a glazed doughnut... One of my daughters had the chocolate bacon burger, one had the French toast burger, the other had the pyt burger, and my wife had the lobster burger... A great treat after church and it was well worth it...

We were hesitant to go in at first because it looked a little run down, but so glad we did! Absolutely awesome service by a bevy of teenage girls. Veggie curry was fabulous and prices were very reasonable. If I lived here I would go there all the time!

This restaurant is stands out. Just in the basis of the exceptional wine list, Baoburg( which stands for chef bao bao in williamsburgs) deserves a michelin stars. Each offering is so well considered for its ability to match the food or offer something special, and there a few real gems at reasonable prices. The food is, of couse, supurb, and each dish is a true work of art. But perhaps the thing that more sets Baoburg apart is the service, which perfectly strikes that balance between professionalism and sincere friendliness. Truly an experience to be missed.

This was my first time visiting Baoburg, and was very excited to try these unique and original Asian European cuisine. This cozy intimate restaurant located in the heart of north Williamsburg was worth the trip, the staff was very friendly and the waiter made some great recommendations, but I wanted to try everything on the menu. My girlfriend and I choose to go with the Truffle fries and glazed chicken made with a maple flavor and soy sauce combination and chicken empanadas that we shared. I know for the next time to order 2 of those dishes cause it was so delicious I really did not want to share with my girlfriend..lol. Then we ordered the short ribs, this was also very tasty and the meat was very juicy and full of flavor. We ended our meal with the chocolate lava cake and a chocolate cream crape with ice cream. I will definitely go back to try the other items on the menu, and might live the girlfriend home, so It more food for me to enjoy...:) I also had the pleasure of meeting Chef Bao, she's a young and very talented chef with some cutting edge ideas for all food lovers, I'm looking forward to my next meal at Baourg.

Ate here on a whim, and was impressed! The server was very knowledgable about the beers available and had excellent recommendations for both food and drink. My boyfriend ordered the New Orleans shrimp and the fried green tomatoes as an appetizer, while I ordered the chicken etouffee (no crawfish, alas). Though slightly on the pricey side, our food was excellent. The portions were not huge, but perfectly sized if you don't have an enormous appetite. Both of our dishes were spicy but flavorful, and were perfectly cooked. We will certainly dine here again!
One of best ramen in town!  Gotta tryout Shio Black.
Yuck. There were bugs crawling around in the bag of stale rolls they were using to make sandwiches. Repulsive.

I was born and raised in New York and went to school in the city, so I think I know a little about pizza. This is my favorite in Manhattan. Yes there may be better in the Bronx or Brooklyn but in the city this is pizza! I've been to Totonno's, I've been to Grimaldi's and Patsy's, all good but Lombardi's is the best of these old places. No qualifiers, no this style or that style, it is only just pizza and this is how pizza is. It was the first pizzeria in America and it is my favorite because they have been using the same oven over 100 years. That's a 100 years of flavor in that pie.
over priced and not taste enough
Simply delicious. I was in the area and I the mood for sushi. Stopped in and had a tuna roll and salmon roll... Both were very good. The service was great, too.

Not your average slice but not a plain ol' grandma slice either.. This is great pizza with a very natural, homemade taste.  The buffalo is the best but the mushroom w truffle oil and dry italian sausage are favs as well.  Also a great deal as these are more filling than they look!  Don't pass it by!
Good food, really friendly service and chill vibe. I like to pop in whenever Im in the area for a vegan scramble.

I wasn't disappointed, nor overjoyed.  I ordered Lamb Byrani - medium spiced. Rice could have been more al dente and I was expecting more spice.  They threw  in two peppers which I used to up the temperature.  They should provide 2x the amount of raita (sauce) - so ask for extra on take-out.

Just had lunch at feng. I usually love everything they have. The angry dragon roll was as good as always. However the new burger is nothing special. It didn't have the special sauce. The Banh mi pork sandwich used to be amazing but they no longer have it.   They said they are changing the lunch menu again, I'll have to hear back from others as I was not impressed after my visit.
Taco King is authenticity x1,000. Delivery and online ordering added bonus. Food is fresh but still quick and delicious!
Service was top notch and the food couldn't  be any better.

Whenever I come here it is packed and I could understand why. This place always leaves me satisfied whenever I leave. This diner is one of my favorites and I am a huge fan of the bbq ribs that they make here.

Food wise, there is not a negative thing to be said about Grimaldi's on Front Street! Sliced meatballs on a pie, ummmm of course! The flavor of all the ingredients stood out down to the crust, I was blown away. Suffice it to say, I will have a positive memory of this pie for life and when I return to New York, I will be back for more. Now down to the atmosphere... yes I understand the building is as old as New York City, but that does not mean that the interior should suffer!! Seriously, use some of that hard earned dough (haha) and remodel! Oh and add a soda machine instead of serving individual bottles, should save on over head and wasting the staffs time by throwing away so much trash.

Me and my friends stopped by here the other night to grab some beers and guess who was there?? MOTHER FUCKING ASHLEE SIMPSON!! It was awesome we all did a bunch of whippits in the parking lot. Karaoke started 10 and Ashlee killed it on that song escape. You know that one "if you like piña colada"

Had the best ramen of my life here.  Also the tuna roll is very respectable.  Will definitely be going back.  The place is small and the service is very friendly. You won't be sorry. Give this place a try.

Yes they opened on Lud and its bomb! Obviously great chicken and waffles, specials and all. Kale blt salad is a a must and the polenta is great. Always have an order of mac n cheese if you wanna leave happy. Queen of New York is my fave bev, but their cocktails are all tasty. Staff is great, everyone is fun and friendly, music is tight and whether you want to dine in or have a bar experience, its fitting.

Great food , cool vibe as soon as you taste and see the food you know right away that someone really put in the time and passion to cook it. Supper new right now maybe need to work out some issue but this could very well be a really good addition to sunnyside
Fantastic sandwich shop. For all you schmucks who think subway is a good price for a shite sandwich.,, come here and try a great price for an awesome, awesome sandwich!!!

Checked in early Tuesday.  I was in the area taking care of an assignment and since I was on someone else's nickel I figured I would pick up a sandwich to share with wifey. This was visit number 2. 1st time trying was about 2 weeks ago. I saw the place on an episode of Diners Drive-ins & Dives and knew I had to visit. 1st time had the roast beef, eggplant, and mozz. Very good ! Eggplant thin and tasty, cow was tender, and the mozz was ... in a word,  GOOD. This visit was an Italian combo with lettuce, tomato, and onion. We always get vinegar on both sides of the bread with any sandwich we order and this time was no exception. It was almost 2 and a half hours before we dug into this log of deliciousness and we were not disappointed. My only complaint was there was not enough vinegar. No big deal ... that's why we have 55 gallon drums of red wine and balsamic vinegars in the basement ( :- ). However you have to get here, ... on someone else's nickel,  your nickel,  back of a radio car, ET's bicycle, ... get here. You will be glad you did.

One of the best places to get Italian cuisine in NYC! When I went, they were offering a promotion to try three different types of pasta and the one you liked best was all you can eat. This also included a salad and bread. All three choices were fantastic! Even their plain spaghetti was great! What is also great is that though the food is amazing, they're relatively reasonable on price! I will definitely go back!!!

We have been here one time with friends and enjoyed it very much. Today we returned with family. We have three vegetarian grandchildren,a vegan daughter and a son in law who will eat almost anything. Sometimes it gets a little tricky going out for dinner with the fam trying to find a place where we can all enjoy a variety of options. We left Memphis Grill and Everyone was full and happy. The selections were great!
Tried Tick Tock for the first time a couple of weekends ago when my parents visited. Huge portions, great hashbrowns and our server was super friendly!
This is the place to go for steak. I have been to nothing better the service is excellent dress os casual the price is high but worth your money

This review is based on their delivery service. The food is great and at a great price! It seemed pricey at first glance but after my first order I realized thats because they give bigger servings than other Dominican restaurants. One helping can feed about 2-4 people, but its so good I eat it all by myself. My normal is the breaded beef steak with the yellow rice. I've also had the pepper steak, beef steak in sauce, rice with bean, rice with peas, fried cheese and the fried plaintains (tostones), they're all good!

Came here for dinner one night with family including my cousins from Italy while giving them an NYC tour. We loved all of our food. Their specialty cocktails were creative and equally as good. Service was great and when they found out what we were there for, they brought us out complimentary oysters with a delicious dipping sauce that complimented the oysters very well. When they found out we couldn't take the tour of the Empire State Building due to a long wait, they escorted us to the rooftop with an amazing view of the building.  It was so close, you felt like you could touch it! Overall, amazing experience and I will definitely be returning on my next trip to Manhattan. Thanks Parker & Quinn for an amazing night!

Having been to many of the top rated restaurants in New York City, I was looking forward to eating at Bouley, rated 2nd for food in Zagat. Unfortunately, I left quite disappointed with the experience. I had the special lunch menu of five courses...none were a culinary "wow". Although the quality of each ingredient was superb, I felt that the somewhat exotic additions to each dish resulted in less than wonderful flavors. Please note I welcome creative cusine; I simply feel Bouley's attempts at modernity did not work. Service was also less than expected for a restaurant of this reputation. We waited more than 5 minutes after being seated before anyone came to to take our orders. I ran out of water midway through the meal; no one came to refill it until I was almost finished with the dessert course. We had several waiters bring courses,and we were never served by the lady who originally took our orders. I find this odd. I actually wish I could give Bouley a 3.5 rating. Needless to say, I do not intend to return to this restaurant.
Very well prepared. Love it. I'll be there on next visit in mew york city. You must go!!'
Spicy tropical chicken with black eye pea long grain rice and pineapple mango salsa and sangria !  The chicken was seasoned with spices and the rice was a perfect complement

Overall, the pizza was delicious and filling. The crust was not too thin and not too thick, and perfectly cooked. The sauce tasted unique although I prefer a bit more spice in my sauce. Good and efficient service too

Been here a few times this summer and have really enjoyed myself! The following is ranked in order of my preferences: 1) Salted Caramel Fingers. Crunchy like the pretzle they serve it with, covered in a caramel sauce. DELICIOUS! 2) The Bada Bing Fingers. A chicken parm chicken finger! My favorite part is the cheese on the inside of the chicken (I also love chicken parm in general) 3) Buffalo Balsamic Maple Fingers. The closest thing to an actual buffalo wing. Just be aware the wings are made to order, so it may take some time (about 10-15 minutes) The staff was really nice, helpful and patient (the volume of choices when you consider classic with sauce becomes heavy, haha) I found myself happy with about 3-4 fingers for an entire meal.

TWO WORDS...PORCHETTA PANINI!!!! There are two of these unctuous munchies. My personal favorite however is the Porchetta with baby arugula, scallion aioli, farm house blue...GASTRO-GAME-CHANGER. Oh, and also PANNA COTTA...BYE

I can't believe there are poor reviews for this Jimmy Johns!! I love this Jimmy Johns! Sandwiches are always excellent, I love the bread, I have never had any complaints about my order. Ordering online is so easy and you can customize everything. My co-workers and I regularly order lunch from here. Every time we have picked up our large group order, the staff at Jimmy Johns have been SOOO nice and had everything ready. They always have the entire order ready in a large box for us, no mistakes, and are always so accommodating. I think the service is excellent and LOVE going here.
I don't always want halal but when I do it's 53rd & 6th halal guys! The line is long but worth it! Very inexpensive also and is a must try just ask for the mix!
The restaurant itself isnt anything special, but the food is delicious. Definitely worth a try!

I've been a customer of Athena's Greek Kitchen for more than a decade.  Formerly Greek Delights, in Montclair, the restaurant relocated to West Orange and has a new name.  But the food is just as great as ever: delicious, reasonable, kid-friendly, and casual -- you won't be disappointed.  Try the Horiatiki salad, the to-die-for fried zucchini, the spinach and chicken pie in filo, etc.  It's all good and the owner, Ursula, is warm and welcoming.  They also deliver!
The wait can be long, but the food is worth it. I also LOVE that they have Fakin' Bacon as an option; the Penny Egg Sandwich is my favorite.

The thing that attracted me to Pellegrino's is they don't pressure you like the other restaurants in Little Italy do. Some of these places will almost force you to come in. None of that with Pellegrino's. This place is so good that they don't have to beg you like other places. I appreciate the lack of pressure. The food is truly outstanding. I haven't had a better Italian meal anywhere else. Last time I got the Pollo Palermo, and my wife got the Ravioli di Spinachi. We both raved and raved about how great the meals were. This place also has the best Italian cheesecake I've ever had. It's a must-stop any time we visit this area.
Went on a date. Menu looked great (farm to table ish) but everything was a little disappointing. Way too expensive for what it is.
Great food and drinks. Prices are okay. I had the tilapia Veracruzana. I thought I was in Mexico. It  was delicious. I'm sad that I live so far to be able to enjoy more of Chavela's other dishes.

I challenge any normal person to finish a full order of their chicken or ribs platter.  For $17, I have enough fries and rice to feed a small city and 6 large pieces of ribs and a large side salad.  The ribs are some of the best I've tried and 2 usually fills me up and still have leftovers for lunch.  Make sure you ask for their hot sauce with onions.
Love this place ,food is great ,service is top notch ,I try coming here once a week .

The food at this restaurant might come with a wait.  My girlfriend and I first came to this restaurant because of a recommendation from a friend. We were greeted by a large group of customers waiting around the hostess.  When we asked her how long the wait would be, she said 45 mins.  Time went by slowly, partially due to all of the amazing food passing by you as you wait for your table.  We eventually got seated in the crowded dining room.  Our waiter took a little bit to get our order because he was over whelmed with the other customers he had.  But when the food finally came out, it was absolutely delicious. My fiance had the ox tail which was tender and fell off the bone and I had the roast pork which was full of flavor. In conclusion, we have come back to this restaurant because the food is that good. However, we never go during busy hour.  We normally go for lunch or an early dinner. We are seated right away and the food is just as good.

I would give 4 starts but add one more because I was paying the dinner bill first time with my own salary from my new job. My boyfriend and I ordered the fish of the day, which was a whole tail of fish. He is a big fan of fish and he loves it! Other than the fish, foods are average to me.

The best in the city. Get extra cheese on your steak. I go here at least once a month just for the cheesesteaks, but everything is awesome.  Always packed no matter what day or time because they're amazing.
Honestly didn't even want to write this but such a gem of new haven. Weekend Brunch is just as good as Lena's or Bella's without the wait!

I'm always looking for a good cup of coffee wherever we visit. Square One impressed me with their regular cup of coffee ... so I went back and tried an iced coffee when we went back a couple weeks later. The iced coffee was on par with Peet's (my favorite). I've not tried any of the espresso drinks (not my style), but my son was happy with their mocha.

Best Chinese restaurant in the area!! Especially if you are vegetarian - they have the best vegetarian options around! I eat meat, but love all the delicious options! The meals always arrive quickly and are always very hot! I have been coming here since I was little & used to go at least once a week when I lived closer. They started serving sushi too which is also nice to have as an option! My favorite thing on the menu is the vegetarian wonton soup for 2. Their prices are very reasonable too. The location is very quiet and kinda relaxing inside. Can't wait to go back again soon!
You have to get that Fisherman's bowl.

Went for lunch....had the seafood Risotto, great dish ! Wouldnt hv even noticed this place if I was not taken to this place by a colleague....very nice inside as well, will definitely will go there again !

Went here for a company dinner.  What a nice place.  The food was great.  Waiters were great.  Managers came around to check on us.  I did have 1 problem.  This place challenges my motto "I will not pay good money for a bad steak".  Well I ordered the New York Strip steak.  Normally I would not walk across the street for a New York Strip as I am a rib eye guy from Texas.  I don't know how much it  cost but it was on par with top steak houses.  Cooked as I ordered, medium rare, tender and hot on the inside.  Excellent.

I really don't know who these people are that think they can get away with whatever they want like dogs in a pocket book but if you expect a dynamite meal at a fair price served by the best waitresses around, take my word for it, here is the place to be. Their sister place ,the Brookside, up the road a piece is every bit as good. You can do no wrong at either. By all means, grab some desserts! Nick is the Bakery King, Bar none! George, John & Mike hope this helps business. Keep up the good work. I'd starve to death without you. [(;-D
Dirty with lots of flies. That was enough for me not to stay.
Very cool place.  I felt like I was in Italy!! The gelato was nice and the service was great!
12.50 grand slam...!! Good portion for 2 and when u're tired from walking all around new york!!!
Great Great restaurant. The service was wonderful and the pasta was amazing. Would recommend to everyone. ,     .
impecable pizza. that is all.
Great food. Weird staff. I suggest the general tso's or orange chicken.

Recently I finally had a chance to sit and eat here. I had a amazing time!  My boyfriend and I order the Mac attack for a appetizer. That was delish !!  For dinner I had the pull pork taco and he had the meat loft. Both were great.  Drinks were good too. Cafeteria gets four stars for me. Great atmosphere. Waitress was sweet. Just hated where they had us seated. By the kitchen smh. But besides that. Great date night.

Everytime I've been, it was really busy. But the service wasn't bad, I'm in love with the cinnamon rolls, the spread is perfect. I got robs and they fell right off the bone. Just how I like it! I'll def be back

Loved the Adobado and Carne Asada burritos! Speedy service and they make your burritos fresh. I just wish they had seats, had to have my burritos standing up. I've seen long queues to order here during the weekends. 8/10
The pinwheels are possibly the best thing you'll eat this year.  Or next.  Highly recommended.  A lot.

We just went here after finding out that they were rated #2 best restaurant in America. We went with the "leave it to us" option which I definitely recommend to get the most value and a good taste of everything. There were 8 courses - to be honest, too much food for 2 people but we got the leftovers to go. I have to say that the food was really good, but not as good as I thought it would be with that type of ranking as #2 best restaurant in the nation. I would say top 20 in Philadelphia would be more appropriate...at the same time the ranking definitely sets your expectations to be really high when going into the restaurant. Overall, great fresh food and ingredients. Lots of value with the Leave it to us option to share, and the atmosphere with an open kitchen is really nice. Fun fact is that it is run by the same chef at Fork next door, but High Street is just a more low key version of it. Worth trying out for sure
This is a MUST if anyone decides to visit the city or is searching for the best drunk food. You gotta have the the original artichoke slice. So good!

So bad that it prompted me to write this, my first review... I would go back to complain, but they're closed by now and I doubt I would get a refund or at least find somebody there who cared. Safe to say this was THE most disappointing food experience I've had in Philly. I don't go out to eat much (frugal with the $), so I decided I was going to "treat" myself to some curry. Yelp informed me that this place was open until 10, half a mile from my house, and had many favorable ratings, two high marks even from fellow vegans. I walk in to carry out around 9:30pm and scan the menu. Curries are scattered throughout, but I quickly locate the vegetarian section. I assume thus that this curry is without fish paste (1 of 3 things to watch for) but inquire still if it's coconut based or includes any dairy products (2 of 3). The man at first instantly says no, and as I rephrase the question using different examples of dairy products, he insists it's only coconut based. As I prepare to order, he points to another item on the menu, the tofu and vegs with lemongrass sauce, stating he doesn't know if the curry included milk or milk bi-products... This not only queues me in that he either doesn't understand my questions or he simply doesn't care, but it also doesn't give me time to compare this with the other possible choice I had: simple veg. spring rolls. But upon his instance that this was a popular choice, I simply agree in order to be on the safe side (after ensuring that it didn't include egg products - 3 of 3). The total came out to almost $9.00, more then I was hoping to spend, especially on something I didn't really want and hadn't really been craving. The lone star in this review is given for the wait time: approximately 5 minutes (also due to zero stars not being an option), though as I will later relay, this was certainly due to the use of old, pre-made ingredients simply being thrown in a wok with water and heated. Upon delving into this dish at home, I was completely turned off by the generic Chinese style frozen tofu wedges I see in any hole-in-the-wall Asian inspired restaurant. Many of the reviewers had touted this place's Vietnamese authenticity, but literally everything screamed "shitty Chinese". The splash of sauce--which had no doubt fallen off the peppers, onions, and tofu wedges in this dish due to its waterness--was completely tasteless... like water with red pepper flakes in it. I even went as far as to put some of the plain white rice in the small puddle of it and eat just that to test if I was missing some greater flavor; this was not the case. The vegetables literally had no flavor or crunch and had clearly been heated up from frozen 12 hours before and left sitting. Same with the generic tofu wedges, anyone who has never tried tofu before and doesn't know how to cook it knows what plain-old tofu tastes like... kind of like an airy wet sponge. This is what it tasted like, the pepper-water "sauce" only serving to make it taste spicy with no other sensations. All in all, I was so, sooooo disappointed that I spent my money on this waste of meal. I ended up with rice for dinner. I do not think I'll give this place a second chance, it's affordable but not cheap and I doubt any of their produce or add-ins are fresh and/or authentic in the slightest. Very sad...

Such great food! Siri always recommend this place for brunch but we always chose other spots. Today we decided to give this place a try and OMG! Why did we wait so long?! We had the granola encrusted French toast. It was absolutely amazing! It went great with the scrambled eggs and bacon with grits! Ask for Kera! She's an awesome personality that will keep a smile on your face during the entire visit.
Cute little diner :-) food isn't bad, I enjoy Georgie's more than elm diner, but that's just my opinion.

I went there with some co-workers. We had a prefix menu. The food was terrible. The beans were extremely salty that it was impossible to eat. The rice was dry and flavorless. The plantain breaded chicken didn't have any flavor. The flan was probably the worse I ever had. The service was awful (but this commentary could be an entire memoir on its own). I can't understand why this place is called "Bogota" and on top of that their label is "Latin Bistro." There are countless of Latin restaurants around 5th Avenue with much more flavorful cuisine than this "Latin Bistro" wannabe.  It was a complete mistake dining here. This restaurant has absolutely nothing to do with Colombian food.

By far my favorite restaurant in NYC. I started coming here with my bf when it first opened and I lived a few blocks away. It's cozy and vibrant and the food is absolutely SUPERB! I recommend the shrimp tacos, tuna tartare, paella, date pudding, and chocolate soufflé. Now that I no longer live in NYC I truly miss Heidi's and always make time for a dinner there when I am vacationing in NY. After frequenting this restaurant for almost three years now I can say that the excellent food and service have been consistent. The service is incredible, both Heidi and the manager, Freddy, know how to make your dining experience something special. Honestly, words cannot describe how much I love this place!

I have been waiting to yelp this spot. My fiancee and I have been going to Lao Thai (East West whatever you want to call it ) for about 5 years. The staff is always the same friendly and awesome, the food is always terrific, flavorful and authentic. The restaurant has won some awards and been published in the papers and magazines. The prices are so reasonable for the quality and it is in an old fashioned diner with red and chrome booths and a bar stool area. Me and my fiance LOVE it and it seems to be busy even on weekday evenings!

Beyond disappointing... went with my son, who had been there before and was hoping for the monte cristo ~ which was no longer on the menu. (should have taken that as a sign) it took forever for our food to arrive,with little to no feedback from our server. We had one drink and were never offered a second. When the food finally arrived my son's cuban was cold and wet... when we voiced our concern as to why it would be laying in grease, the waitress went 'huh'. to my knowledge she never informed the chef. when we brought it to another server's attention she asked if we wanted something else and we declined. then our original server came over and said, i took the cuban off your bill. and placed the check on the table. no apologies, no offer to speak to a manager and never asked if she could get us anything else - like another beer! it was handled so unprofessionally that i will never return and don't see how they can stay in business with a combination of horrible chef and rude wait staff...sorry

At first when you walk in the service is great super friendly then they forget about you.  The food was overrated and overpriced.  We ordered the chicken parm and it was dried out . We also ordered the hen oF the woods MushrooMs & thYMe burrata mozzarella, parmesan cream pizza and there was no burrata on it.  Horrible food especially for the price.   I don't mind paying a lot as long as the food is good, which it wasn't . The only thing good was the cannoli .
Nice Laid back vibe on prince street . Drinks are good . The enchilada was burnt due to the charcoaling .

I am rewriting my review, because somehow it was filtered out.  I went this evening, it was crowded and food took a little longer than the usual.   We didn't mind as we weren't in a rush and were enjoying our drinks.  We got the farm burger which my husband said was delicious and was one of the best he's had.  We also ordered  the arancini with such a great curry sauce, mussels which are always a treat and the scallops which I said in my last review, literally melt in my mouth.  As for dessert, I got a fruit crumble which was incredible.  My husband ordered a pot of cream, which is his favorite here.  I would give it a 5 star but wondering if that's why it was filtered out to begin with. Also, I would like to state that brunch alone gets 5 stars.  So fresh and good.

I called for delivery last week and after taking my order they informed me they only deliver in a four block radius. This is very strange since they have delivered numerous times so I asked her to check again (I live probably 6 blocks away) and after being on hold for a good five minutes she told me they definitely cannot deliver. When I asked when the policy changed she informed the reason they cannot deliver is not the distance but rather.... the rain. A delivery place that doesn't deliver in the rain?! That's the whole point of delivery isn't it? The sushi is not bad but next time I want delivery I am not waisting ten minutes for a place to tell me they can't deliver in the rain. You either deliver or you don't, it can't be circumstantial that is not rights to the clients.
I love this place. Flavorful tasty food and good prices. Cheap & cheerful!

Really kool spot - I've never experienced milkshake and burgers before  I usually do beer and burgers - the milkshakes were mouthwatering very RICH not to sweet or watered down - the burgers were ok not a big fan of the French fries - I loved the atmosphere very chill place but small  - however the waitress who waited our tabled SUCKED she was very very slow really got me annoyed - but whenever I'm in NY again and I feel for a milkshake guarantee I will be visiting here

Fresh, creative, delicious.  This is easily my favorite restaurant in a neighborhood with a lot of good options.  The best part is they have a really well balanced menu with options for everyone, even people who aren't usually drawn to health restaurants.   I can't say enough nice things. I do echo other's comments about the uncomfortable chairs, but I would sit on the floor of this place if I had do. I also had a really nice experience with the owner last year when I reached out to solicit a donation for a charity event I was working on.  Even though we didn't end up partnering on that event, she couldn't have been nicer and seemed generally interested in the event and cause.   It's so nice to see a restaurant that not only takes interest in the customers' experiences, but also wants to form a connection with the local community.
Excellent taste. Great service.  Staff wonderful and helpful. My first check in. I am a frequent visitor at the dunkin. Didn't realize I could check in and review all the time.  Thank you dunkin
one word: delicious!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Fantastic! Great wine selection. We had the cheese plate followed by a prosciutto and fig Panini for lunch.  I loved being able to pair different wines with the different foods. You can't go wrong with a glass of Chateauneuf du Pape!

Good to have an Italian sandwich joint in the neighborhood , other than a pizza place. Sandwiches were very good,  just wish they had chunk sharp provolone instead of slicing provolone. Wifey has had dinners from there sharing them with a 96 year old Italian woman who does NOT need a gps around the kitchen. This seasoned chef enjoys the meals as much as wifey. It doesn't hurt that you can see a good portion of the cooking area from the counter section (I know people that freak about what potentially happens in professional kitchens).
Nice vibe good drinks the food was ok until they came and asked us to leave during our desert because we had been here for 2 hrs wtf

Besides the restaurant being in a great location, EVERYTHING was greattt! Our waitress FELICIA was exceptional. Truly loves her job and was very attentive to all our orders that night. Great job #Blend for hiring such a stupendous worker! Keep those pitchers of sangria going! We loved them.
1st timer!! Awesome! Price right....Authentic and fresh!! I will eat there again for sure.

Well I guess it's all about competition, or the lack thereof---there is maybe only one other Vietnamese restaurant in the Hartford area that I've found online, which would explain the lackluster quality and outrageous prices---$10-12 for a lousy bowl of pho (rice noodle soup) or some meat/veggies/rice plate???  Even in downtown Boston, the same can be had for around $7-8, and of far better quality.   The only plus here is that the food arrived really fast, like maybe 5 minutes fast---which suggests that it was pre-cooked and simply heated up in a microwave.  At least that's what my wife thought of her grilled pork and rice plate.  My beef and snowpeas rice plate was better, although what they called "fried rice" (the older female server offered me a choice of white vs "fried" for some reason) turned out to be nothing more than normal rice with some kind of orange coloring which made it resemble Mexican rice more than anything---there was nothing "fried" about it, zero onions, scallions, bits of egg or pork in it, just plain ORANGE rice! The best thing about our visit was that a lovely young female server came as we were finishing and gave us each two pieces of cake on paper plates, gratis.  The cake was probably from a cake mix box, but it wasn't bad, and it was a nice thought.  Perhaps she knew we weren't thrilled with the food, even though we weren't exactly scowling or complaining at them.  So generally speaking, nice service, just mediocre food and crazy pricing.
Best chicken and rice platter I've ever had. The free hot falafel while waiting in line is definitely a plus. The cart guys are super friendly too.
It's the kind of place where you actually have to stop yourself from closing your eyes and uttering "yummmm...." Because the food is so good!
Excellent salmon, and I have eaten many salmon dishes in the City.  At Sol-Mar, they grill it so that it is crisp without losing the flavor of the fish.  Excellent price also.  I'll be back!

Awesome Galician Tapas bar situated in a very authentic and vibrant part of Newark.  My girlfriend and I came here and were delighted with the overall decor and vibe of the place.   They had a great guitar player one Thurs. night named Matty D I believe who played really cool music that enriched the atmopshere.   Highly recommend this place to anyone coming looking for a classy and elegant dining establishment in the Ironbound district.  :)

Love this place !! Small and quaint, very friendly and super delicious food !  I tried the oxtail with rice & beans. Great flavor and super tender meat. If you crave Caribbean go for it.. You have nothing to lose :)
Horrible quality sushi. The fish always looks dingy and doesn't have any signs of fresh fish. Also saw rat droppings all over the restaurant.
First time tonight!!! What a great find will be back again!  The food was fresh and tasted great! People were very friendly!

Pizza Chef  is always clean and the food consistently good. Try the gluten free pizza...you won't be disappointed, even my husband likes it. Everyone that has come to visit has loved their pizza, whether from North Carolina, Oregon or Massachusetts. They have a huge menu with pizza, hot and cold sandwiches, italian dinners and more The atmosphere is a little rustic and relaxed but that is fine for a casual night out.
good cheap colombian comfort food.
Awesome food!  Flatbread, Fried Green Tomatoes w House mozzarella, Foie Gras (seasonal special), Chicken Breast perfectly cooked and juicy, Pecan pie

MSG!!! Sorry but I have to be honest! I am Vietnamese but this place is nothing close to authentic! Had dinner here with my friends and won't be coming back! If you want a good Vietnamese noodle experience (Pho) go to Pho Bang in Chinatown! If you want a great vermicelli grill pork chop with shrimp, check out Thai Son restaurant! If you want amazing authentic Vietnamese sandwich go to Ba Xuyen in 8th Ave Brooklyn! If you want a fast food Vietnamese- go back to this place!
Best pizza I ever had, good draft beers, good music, nice decor. Deffinitely a place I'll come back to.

The place was nice and the staff was very courteous. We had the wasabi xiao long bao and the spicy xiao long bao. They were well crafted--very thin skin, right amount of soup and meat, good flavor. However, they really did not skimp on the wasabi and chili paste and after a few the added flavors became overwhelming. We also ordered the iced tomato and the chocolate xiao long bao. The iced tomato was basically a chilled sweetened tomato. It was okay but at $8 I would avoid it. The chocolate xiao long bao was really good. I was expecting the dish to be overwhelmingly sweet but they were just right. If I'm in the neighborhood I would definitely return for their regular and crabmeat xiao long bao.
Everything from the food to the servers is wonderful. It is in the higher price range, but the food is so tasty.
I love Chipotle but this place is too loud and the order takers keep getting my order wrong. Make sure to speak up or you will not get what you want.

Rude waitress. sashimi was not fresh at all. I worked at a sushi restaurant so I can differentiate fresh Toro and old toro. Fresh toro definitely melts in your mouth. Old toro doesn't and it has a weird texture/taste along with a slightly darker tint.

Honestly, if it wasn't for the crappy service, I would give this place 4 1/2 stars. The food is executed beautifully but the service is subpar. It took our waiter 10 minutes to greet us once we were seated and he had a snobby attitude, which made our dining experience mediocre. When asked his opinion on dishes he would tell us what "people rave about online"--I didn't ask for what Yelpers' reviews were--I asked for the waiter's opinion. I would give this place one more chance because the food was very good. We ordered the mushroom salad, branzino, and the pasta special--all of which were fantastic.

Placed my order at 3:55 in the afternoon (not really a busy time for most places as I am in the restaurant business). Called at 5:10 just to make sure the driver wasn't lost because were only about 10 minutes from the location. I explained I ordered a little over an hour ago and they had said 45 minutes, which doesn't really bother me most times. But what did bother me was that the man on the phone was really rude and told me I had actually ordered less than an hour ago and "to give them some more time". I had all of the exact times on my phone so this was irritating. Also annoying I waited way too long before the phone was answered and he didn't actually check to see who I was. Maybe someone ELSE ordered less than an hour ago, but not me. Anyway, it's 5:30 now and still no food so I really couldn't tell you how that is. UPDATE: my, at this point, very angry boyfriend called back because he was irritated at the way I was spoken to and that we were STILL waiting. The same man on the phone instantly began arguing with him saying that it was not that long and that the driver was stuck in traffic on 287. First, that is not even the shortest way to get to us, maybe he should get a shorter route. Second, it is perfectly fine if he is in traffic. But that is absolutely no way to treat a customer ordering about 50 dollars with of food. He requested a refund while the man on the phone continued to argue and cut him off while cursing at him and saying "his times are off". Absolutely ridiculous. Never again.

First visit on a Friday evening between 7-8, not real busy. Very nice place, great food, 3 stars on waiting staff. Could have 4-5 stars but we waited a bit for water & then again for refills. We had purchased a mid priced bottle of wine so we had something to drink but at this level water is a given. We will give it another try and review again.

There aren't many restaurants like this in jackson heights. Once you walk in, you are greeted with kindness and attentiveness. The black and white decor is unique and comfortable. Very clean environment and the food is delicious! For appetizers we had chicken curry puffs. yum!  Main course- I had the beef with spicy Thai sauce. My boyfriend had the pineapple fried rice with beef.  To drink we had thai ice teas which were perfectly made.  For dessert we had green tea fried ice cream and not to mention the presentation was resplendent :)...can't wait to go back!
Believe what you hear!! The man is good!! Above all else the talent of the chef and the quality of ingredients make this the best pizza place in the entire country let alone New York.
Turkey and Cranberry Panini! *drops microphone*
Best pizza ever!

Good ramen, but not the best. Not sure why but suspect it's the broth they use- chicken broth instead of pork? Otherwise very good noodles. Each bowl comes with seaweed, scallion and 2 slices or pork already.
What a delicious Cuban sandwich and black beans soup.  Mut chexk this place out. Little gem that's been here for decades

Small, European-style shop, friendly staff. More of a to-go atmosphere than a sit-and-sip (no other consumers in the small shop on a Monday late afternoon). High quality coffee (small latte, tailored to my taste with extra steamed milk), well worth the price tag.

(this was for valentine's day 2014) Love,love this place! The service is excellent. The food is off the hook! This is our second time and we know we will be back for Brunch again for sure. Chocolate cherry bread pudding had us going back for more. That paired with complimentary Kir Royale and the rest of the food was yummy yummy ! A Huge shot out to Manager Dukes for making this Valentines special!!

Custard cups ... 'nuff said. Oh yeah ... they have other pastries, cookies, ethnic delicacies,  rolls, bagels, sandwiches,  cakes, drinks, newspapers, ... you get the idea. A very good little deli. Oh, by the way, ... did I mention they make CUSTARD CUPS !!! (I can make them myself but why expend the energy MAKING them when it could be used EATING them).

Prior to my initial visit, I had seen GH stock at local grocery stores but had never purchased, only lusted for their corn bread from afar. I resolved to visit the actually store since I like buying directly from purveyors. Holy s--t was I right to do so!!! Interior: it is so comfortable and warm. The kitchen is open so you can see what the bakers are working on. To the right is a sandwich station (haven't used so can tell you pricing info) and to the left is a seating area. It's definitely a comfortable feeling inside, nice and simple, unlike some of the other bakeries in the area. Service: now, I'm sure everyone posts this but they offer FREE SAMPLES when you get to the counter. It ranges from a variety of breads to other baked goods depending on when you get there/what is in stock. Best of all, there is a bowl(!) of butter and a bottle of honey for you to enjoy on your warm sample of bread. It doesn't stop there--the samples are excellently portioned so that you can truly get an idea of the heartiness of the product. I also have to say the staff make the experience exponentially better. Having only been in twice, I can't say this is true all the time but the people working were genuinely friendly and want to make sure you get a great service/eating experience. The person helping me did not hesitate when I asked for a description of EVERYTHING on the shelf that day as well as to give me recommendations. The thing about GH is that, service wise, I didn't not feel like just another customer. I did not feel like they were trying to rush me out or ignore me because I told them I was only browsing (many other shops have staff like this). Moreover, the interactions amongst the staff tell me that they enjoy working there and seem like they are all friends--yet another plus because it produces a fun loving, friendly atmosphere that I want to return to. Not sure if the service staff also help bake but they sure know their stuff!!! Bread: ok, down to the final test. On my visits, I sampled a oaty blueberry muffin that was dynamite. Full of whole blue tries, super moist. I also tried the cheddar garlic bread--don't mess with this one! While the taste of garlic is not overwhelming at all, I noticed my own garlic breath long after I left the shop! If you like cheddar, this is a great choice---loads of cheddar chunks! Apple crunch loaf: I ate this in TWO days. My thighs are stilled mad at me. It's covered in brown sugar (crunch) and filled with chunks of Apple. They also mix in Apple sauce so the bread is super moist and had an amazing texture. Two. Days. Yum! Nine grain: I'm in love with this bread. They must put magic in it because I can't get enough. It's a wheat bread but much more. I'm drooling just thinking about it...this bread is uber hearty, extremely flavorful and downright worth every penny. Carrot roll: I love this idea. If you like carrot cake and love cream cheese frosting, you should try this. You are never wanting for frosting. The only downside for me was that it doesn't have nuts and/or raisins. That's just me! Final assessment: while prices are high, the quality of the product makes it worth every penny. The only downside to this is if you eat the bread to fast and have to go back every couple days to sate the demons lusting for more bread!!! On the bright side, you may want to go back that frequently as service here is the friendliest I have encountered at a bakery in this area. Also, I feel bad for everyone in town who is gf--you are all missing out!

I could eat here everyday for the rest of my life! I love michaelangelos I've been here so many times and never been disappointed. Chicken parm, eggplant, mmm getting hungry thinking about it. They don't mess up sandwiches like Provenzanos from west haven has.
Had the masaman chicken. Chicken was bland and small portions. Rice was not fresh either and service was terrible. I should have gone to the Mediterranean restaurant next door. It more people there.

I'm not sure what everyone was smoking before they reviewed this place, but the smoked meats here are inedible! My husband, daughter, and I ordered three different BBQ sandwiches and let me say this HORRIBLE! All the meat tasted like lighter fluid and burnt coal. My husband will eat almost anything except for this. I got pulled pork, my daughter got brisket, and I don't remember what my husband got, because it was in the trash can before I could taste it. I am very picky so I thought it was just me, but all three dishes wound up in the trash. They do have other food there that is yummy, like the ice cream. But, stay away unless you like light fluid tasting food.

My friend and I went to the LES location. We were seated right away without a reservation. The place is quite small so I don't see it working for big parties. However, the arepas are just amazing. This is my second time here and I will be returning. The two people I've been with have enjoyed their arepas as well. The menu is not extensive but is a powerhouse. I've had two arepas and tried two others, and every single one has been delicious. Thus far, "La de pernil" is my favorite one. If you enjoy drinking beer, the cold "Michelada" is a great combo with the arepas. The flan the coco is just right, light, not too sweet with tons of flavor. I can't wait to visit the Brooklyn location and try their rum bar!

The food here is great, and the atmosphere is wonderful with a beautiful restaurant. It is too small and the food is somewhat authentic. If you love Thai, definitely check it out. It is in the center so its unnecessarily priced.
We came here kind of randomly for brunch, got great food and friendly service for a very good price--not to mention complimentary mimosas. They don't have drinks to order they do invite you to BYOB
Delicious!

This place always surprises me with its excellent cuisine, and the specials are always delicious and different. Small improvements hand gone a long way to make this my favorite hookah spot in NJ. Servers give great recommendations on food and hookah, and don't mind going the extra mile... Just ask!
By far my favorite sea food place, the food is sooo delicious, there's usually a 10 min wait but it's worth it! Never had a complaint and I've been going here since I was little. :-)
Yes, just say yes! Perfect service, really good food!
Great happy hour menu!

My husband and I stumbled upon this gem as I was looking for places to eat on Yelp! The atmosphere is rustic Italian farm and it is very romantic. The food is delicious and better priced than the ones on the main street! I had one of the specials which has gnocchi, a cheese sauce, spinach and an italian bacon. I have never had gnocchi that fresh! I'm from St. Louis and eat in their Italian neighborhood, The Hill,a lot so I know what good Italian tastes like and this was good Italian! 5he flourless chocolate cake was to die for. We loved this place and will definitely be back during our next trip to New York!

Outstanding Thai Food!  All is made to order.... Even spring rolls areas w fresh w each order!   Tom Ka Gai soup is outstanding!  Prices are right and the decor is very original and unique!  Note:  closed on Mon &Tue.  No Tom Ka Gai soup on Wed....  A must if you like outstanding fresh Thai at a great price point!

Lucky for me I live in the neighborhood. I love to try new spots and as soon as I saw this spot I decided to try it out the next day. Went with a few friends, I had a crab roll and have been coming back again and again ever since. Great decor, very friendly staff and food tastes wonderful.

Great atmosphere and the foods are amazing its authentic as you can get without leaving Queens. NY worth the travel . Parking is definitely not a problem just right in front of a municipal parking. Dont skip the desert or you will lose out

I fell in love with this small shop tucked away in the heart of the financial district that has a soul straight from Italy. This is NOT like any of these stores in New York City that claim that they sell italian food and always disappoint you. Pisillo imports EVERYTHING from Italy. The sandwiches are huge (it can literally feed 5 people) and worth every penny. They catered to my needs and wants. I told them that I didn't eat pork, and they already had a suggestion for what would be best for me. They suggested the FIRENZE and I fell in love! The Firenze has roasted chicken, provolone cheese, arugula, sweet peppers, and thee BEST balsamic vinaigrette dressing I have ever had (I've worked in the food industry for years). It beats anything I have ever tasted. AMAZING. They make the dressings themselves and I almost asked for the recipe! Besides the great food, the service is phenomenal. It is truly a mom and pop shop that makes you feel right at home. Soft music is playing in the background while you're given a warm smile and a list of their specials. They ask you what bread you prefer and call you by your name when your order is ready. I definitely recommend this place to anyone who likes to eat well and wants to enjoy a slice of Italy while trying to shut out the noise of NYC.

Super tasty food!! Had good quality music playing so that was a plus! Food flavor and presentation was awesome!! Would've liked for the waiter to come and check up on us a little more but overall totally recommend El Vez!

My boyfriend and I went here the other night for dinner. We were both quite impressed by the beef momos. They serve them with a spicy tomato basil sauce and were by far my favorite thing we tried. I ordered the non-veg thali so we could try as much as we could, and my boyfriend got their famous chicken tikka masala. We ordered both dishes spicy, but neither had much punch to them. My plate offered tastes of the daal soup, chicken saag, lamb curry, rice pudding dessert, and homemade pickles. All the dishes were on the soupy side; I felt the restaurant was trying to stretch their reserves. The lamb curry was my favorite off my plate because the flavors had a little kick and were tasteful. My thali also came with a mango lassi with homemade yogurt. Definitely delicious! The chicken tikka masala was soupy just like the other dishes, but the flavor was smooth. Overall, the portions and flavors were there, but consistency and lack of desired spice level brought down my opinion. I'd definitely go back for the momo and to see if their dishes were still soupy.

My wife and I always go there for our dates. We love going there for their excellent foods, atmosphere, services. After lunch, we would go to the Sculpture grounds and linger there for hours, taking pictures and enjoying the good weather! Its a very romantic getaway for your loved one!

A few girlfriends and I decided to check out this new French Restaurant in the UES since two of the girls live in the neighborhood. From the moment we walked in we were greeted right away by the friendly staff. We were a bit late for our reservation, but were received with grace and waited for our table to be ready, while we each sipped on a glass of sparkling Rose at one of the bar tables in front. We were sat at a nice table in the back and were waited on hand and foot! The food was absolutely delectable! We started with a nice bottle of the sparkling Rose and then the Wild Mushroom soup with Truffle Oil as an appetizer,  which is to die for.  I ordered the Salmon wrapped in Zucchini as my entree. My girlfriends ordered the Steak Tartar, the Pan Seared Chicken and the Burrata Salad. We were all very impressed with the presentation, quality and taste of our meals. I can't wait to go back to try the Paleo Zucchini Pasta!! I would definitely recommend this restaurant for a fun girls night, brunch or date night! This is a great find for the UES!
Awesome is an understatement. It tastes like authentic home cooked South Indian food. I usually don't like going to Indian Restaurants, but this is by far the most wonderful for Indian Cuisine!

only decent chinese food in harrison.  all the others are your typical strip mall chinese junk food places.  when we don't feel like driving to chinatown or parsippany (noodle chu), this is our go to place.

Local spot. They have a small establishment and need to turn and burn you as fast as they can. Decent prices for beer. A hood spot for after work. LA all the way. Mexico all the way if you need that Los Angeles home vibe. West Coast.

So they aren't lying when they say "only the best". I got a stuffed bread for the first time from there (chicken parm stuffed bread) and it was out of this world. Their bread was absolutely delicious. I'll be back soon for more and pizza!!

The 'snacks' and small plates are enough to make a meal if you're intimidated by the price of the entrees. The servers are always attentive and polite. The dining room clean and uncrowded (actual space between tables!)  We have children 10 & 12 and they love the food, admittedly they are adventurous eaters. Highly recommend for dinner and brunch on weekends.
The employees were very friendly, the environment was great, and the bagels were excellent.  To top it all off, they gave my friends and I a free cookie and muffin when they had extras.

I love their white sauce. The rice with carrots and raisons is called "qabooli". The grilled  chicken with bones is out of this world. The yougurt drink is.well prepared. Rice pudding tops the dessert. Service can be improved. Prices are more than fair.try it.

Delivery of food took over 2 hours. For around the corner delivery.. No sides or sauces like we asked for ( and paid for) and even though we tipped highly , chips were cold, burger was dripping... Not impressed at all! The deliverer pretty much dropped food at door and ran, almost like he knew something was wrong with our order...
Amazing! The service was great and fast. The food was the best. This is the 5 star restaurant!

Consistently the best noodles in New Haven. The food is always served quick and hot. It tastes amazing. And terrific value. If you're a regular, the staff is prompt to take care of you, otherwise they may come off as standoffish. That's just the norm, they don't mean anything by it, they're just focused on getting the food out, not striking up a conversation. Their limeade is so refreshing and their mushroom buns are a yummy comfort food. Such great value. You get tons of food for really cheap. Not a lot of space and the place is a bit dingy looking, but the food makes up for it. My favorite noodle spot in new haven.

Wow!  Checking with the locals pays off - Pat's & Geno's are the famous ones here & had long lines waiting to get cheesesteaks.  I tried them, they were o.k. (not really worth the hype though).  A few blocks away is a small shop called Cosmi's Deli.  It was recommended to me & I'm so glad.  What a great sandwich!  The best cheesesteak I've had (& I've had a lot).  Also the guy behind the counter (the owner?) was a great, charming host & made us feel at home (I went with my wife & son & we are from out of town). ALWAYS GO HERE instead of the more famous ones.

As a huge fan of Dinosaur BBQ in Upper Manhattan, I was delighted to hear they opened up a more convenient location. Unfortunately, the only thing this joint shares with the original Dinosaur BBQ is a name. Even the menus are completely different. The item I usually order from the Manhattan restaurant is not on the Brooklyn menu, though in all fairness, the brisket I ordered was delicious nonetheless. But the cornbread, one of the best things about Dinosaur BBQ in Manhattan was utterly disappointing. For starters, it's half the size of the cornbread they give you in Manhattan, but even more importantly, it's not even cornbread. It's some kind of muffin that tastes reminiscently of something vaguely similar to cornbread, but not really. It's basically a bland muffin. And the mash potatoes were so salty even my kid couldn't stomach it, and he's the kind of kid that would eat salt right out of the packet. That said, one could easily wait upwards of three hours for a table at the Manhattan restaurant (it's that good), whereas I got a table in Brooklyn immediately. And the staff was very friendly and accommodating, which is why I gave this place three stars instead of one or two. Had this place been called Brooklyn BBQ or something else -- anything other than Dinosaur BBQ -- I would not have gone there with such high expectations and probably would have enjoyed it much more. Calling this place Dinosaur BBQ is misleading. The REAL Dinosaur BBQ is the best BBQ joint on this side of the Mississippi, and this place unfortunately falls short. If you've never been to the REAL Dinosaur BBQ and are in this area, try this place out, you'll probably like it. But if you have an opportunity to go to the one in Harlem (and have half a day to wait at the bar for a table), I highly recommend it!

Well, I've been eating this chicken for a couple of years, I've read the reviews, I must admit  I call it crack Chicken!!!! it's soooooooooooooo addicting, whenever I go, i never order less than 20 wings, it's like a lays potato chip, you can't eat just one.......
My wife and I went to Tashan for dinner. The food and service were fantastic. The boar chops were exceptionally delicious.
My boyfriend took me there:DD. We had the tasting menu for brunch. Ate a lot and love it

Awesome old time style bar with great moonshine style drinks! I had the lightning burger and the corn n' coke drink. Both awesome. Service could have been better, but can't complain for a Wednesday.  Will return! I had the yelp $10 discount so the owner had to see it.  He asked how the drinks were, and I said that the corn' coke could be stronger. He came back with a jar of whiskey and gave me a free shot! 105 proof!   He had the bartender make me extra strong drinks for the rest of the night. Overall awesome place !

Just had an excellent dinner at Prime 151. The specials were innovative and lived up to the recommendations of the owner. The eggplant appetizer was unique and delicious. Even my husband who claims not to like eggplant loved it. The arugula salad with blueberry goat cheese and peaches was out of this world. And the pasta dishes were terrific. The lasagna is a must - much lighter than any other we've ever had. and the canneloni stuffed with short ribs was also excellent. For dessert, the brioche/bread pudding was also outstanding. Go!

Pretty good food but takes forever and the customer service is probably the worst I have ever had to deal with in my entire life. Went today and after asking about our food once (because we were waiting about 40 minutes for fingers and fries in a very empty restaurant) was called an a$$hole to the next set of customers ordering. Would recommend delivery, because I watched a bunch of those orders go out before mine did.

Went for restaurant week. The food was very good and the service was exceptional. If you're looking for a solid Mexican meal this is a very good value at a very nice location. Cocktails were a little pricey and not very strong but I understand they have some specials a lot during the week.
Way over rated.  Ran out of meat when I went first time.  Talked into the second.  had meat. but ran out shortly thereafter.   poorly run

Six dollars for a massive amount of food that few can fully finish. During the cold days it's really nice to be able to get warm food and stand around while eating. They let you put your own sauce on in however much you want, which is a plus, so I tend to get the platter, eat a bit to satisfy my hunger, pour white sauce on half, eat that half, and then go back and repour so I don't get soggy halal.

Halal indeed! I have a lot of Muslim workmates and they are often picky where to eat. Of course I wouldn't want to eat alone so I would have to go with what the majority wants. This place is our new go-to location when it comes to almost everything. :) We can eat here anytime without them ranting if this is safe or blah blah. Thank you guys! You guys saved me from their ranting ;D

If you are in Philly, do yourself a HUGE favor by heading to the terminal, deal with a long line and get yourself one of DiNic's sandwhiches/hoagies. It's just heavenly but unless you got an unwordly appetite- share!! They are humongous!! They do have long lines, but it moves pretty quick. There is bar seating as well as many seats in the Reading Terminal. DiNic's is a MUST - I would drive to Philly just for them.

The food was an ATROCITY. I'm baffled how they can really sell this food for consumption. I got Shrimp Egg Foo Young and the patties were burnt and tastless, as well as shrimp fried rice which was yellow. I've been told many low quality places here have yellow rice, and I'm disappointed the gossip was true. AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST! #EWWW
Beautiful decor, fabulous food!
Consistently ok.  The waitstaff seems to always be "really busy" and not the most attentive with their service.  The food is ok.  Love the cask beers!

A huge disappointment.   The restaurant was barely busy and the service was terrible---a long wait for drinks, no spoons brought with the soup, part of the order never arrived and it was clear that the restaurant had just opened (which was conveyed by the manager---and felt like it was some kind of excuse).   The food was passable but not memorable.  For the price it was outrageous.   In defense of the restaurant,  I complained about the experience and the meal was on them.
Always loved this place...the decor is filled with memorabilia from past to present. The crab cake florentine is to die for. I always have a great experience when I'm here

Absolutely great atmosphere, service and wine list. Food very good but if you are looking for something relatively simple, like ravioli in a good red sauce, forget it. Excellent restaurant but expect all gourmet.

I went to this place on Thursday afternoon still waited for 1.5 hr. You can tell their business goes pretty well. The service is okay. One thing I felt uncomfortable was that the waitress asked us directly what we wanted to order for food literally 2min after we sat down. My speculation is that the waitress thought we already figured out the menu while we were waiting. It is not understandable unless they handed out their paper menu to us outside before we sat down. Let's talk about the food. I ordered eggs benedict and my friend ordered blueberry pancake. To be honest, I don't feel wow when I had the food. They are just average brunch you could have like everywhere else. In sum, it is not worth waiting 1.5hr for having the food. P.S. prepare your cash because they don't accept cards

Its okay, decent burgers and nachos and foods of that sort in the summer but nothing special, over priced average fancy food in winter, the outside area could use lots of new furniture, and the bar outside is nasty

Be prepared to wait, but all good things are worth waiting for! This is the Philly classic, the archetype of what a Philly cheesesteak is. And as always, take time afterward to rest, maybe even bring a sleeping pad, cause you will want to take a nap!

got delivery from here. Ordered cheesy garlic bread and sicilian pie. First, the garlic bread: nothing special AT ALL. More like bread with cheese on it. Second, the sicilian pizza: Looked delicious, but was undercooked. I ate it up regardless, and in the middle of the night boy did I regret it. I was awakened by the biggest stomach ache ever. I assume, though I'm no doctor, that it was caused by all the undercooked dough I devoured! If it was crunchier or cooked thru, I am sure this pizza would have been phenomenal. The sauce was good. Only mistake: undercooking.

This was a surprise last minute restaurant choice that turned into a very pleasant one.  I was in the city for the day and my excursion bus dropped us off at a different spot, nowhere near the one originally promised, making my original dinner plans not feasible.  After some frantic searching on Yelp found this place.  I've had Katsu before at other Japanese restaurants but never been to a place devoted to it.  We were the only non-Asians there, generally a good sign.  Décor was nice, although the wood seats are not particularly comfortable, nice jazz music.  Temperature in the restaurant varied widely, when the air conditioner was blowing it was pleasant, when it stopped, the place got hot quickly.  The meals come with pickle and very good miso soup.  The soup had many more vegetables than I'm accustomed to in Miso but I liked it.  They give you seeds in a mortar and pestle and the table and there are three sauces.  Our server was only okay, he never offered any explanations regarding the menu or helped identify the sauces, he also was poor at refilling water glasses.  However, a very nice young woman server came over and was very helpful with explaining the use of the seeds and sauces.  Companion had one of the pork katsus, which comes with cabbage and rice.  He really loved it.  I had the chicken donburi, which is a bowl with rice, onions, your chicken and a fried egg.  I liked but didn't love it, it seemed to be a little lacking in flavor despite the sauce cooked in it.  I had the green tea ice cream for dessert, good and not too overly frozen, companion loved the pumpkin pudding.  We're definitely planning on going back.

Signed up for a Yelp account just to post this review! We recently celebrated a good friend's birthday here (group of 5 girls). First and foremost, the food, drink selection, and atmosphere were fantastic. Only critique on the food is that everything had a good amount of spice - potentially too spicy for some palates. We split the spiced nuts and deviled eggs as an appetizer - all delicious! I ordered the daily campur, which was perfectly portioned and allowed me to taste multiple things on the menu. Other items ordered were the fish curry, crispy chicken, coconut milk braised beed, and chicken wings. Some found their dishes to be too spicy, but satisfying overall. We also all split a bottle of Pinot Noir, which was a nice touch. After we finished our meal and dinner drinks, our experience took a turn for the worse. Like I said, we were celebrating a birthday. We decided to open gifts before dessert. When we initially arrived, the restaurant was quite empty (one or two other tables), but had grown to a good crowd by gift-opening time. We were all laughing, clapping, and admittedly, the birthday girl was yelling for joy as the gifts were revealed. It was at this point where another waiter (not ours, as he was delightful) came over and interrupted our celebration to say, "Don't mean to rain on your parade, but you need to stop yelling!" He then promptly walked away. Normally, if someone were to PULL ONE OF US ASIDE and mention this in a discreet manor NOT IN FRONT OF THE BIRTHDAY GIRL, we would have been able to address the issue to the birthday girl as friends. However, his tone was so rude and B?#@%Y that it left us feeling uncomfortable and embarrassed. At this point, the birthday girl excused herself to the restroom as she was noticeably upset after the shameful shushing. Thankfully, our waiter was able to get in some surprise dessert orders when she was away. HOWEVER, as he brought everything over, the "shusher" was responsible for the cake with the candle. IT BLEW OUT AS HE WALKED OVER. Our waiter had no idea and set the other desserts on the table. Bummer. The "shusher" walked back, full of attiude, with a glass over the candle (as he should have done in the first place!). We were so put-off at that point, that we didn't even feel comfortable to proudly sing "Happy Birthday". As expected, the dessert was also delicious. We all split the ice cream trio, the coconut creme brûlée, and the chocolate tart. When leaving, I made a point to say something to our waiter, as I didn't think he was aware of the comment his co-worker made to our table. He genuinely apologized, but that was it. Would love to return, but the service (from the one individual in particular) has left a bad taste in my mouth. Also would have loved to give this place a 4-5 star review because of the food and ambiance, but I just can't justify that after the awkward situation we experienced.

This was not the greatest nor worst place I've been to, but over all the stag was courteous and attentive, the good was good, but the cocktails were not all that. I ordered a dirty martini and the only Thing that was dirty was the glass. Not sure if they even put any olive juice at all. I'm not stickler so I just asked for another and showed them the dirty glass , then they made it right and bough my drink. I would say that's it's not a place that need to be seen if you can find somewhere else to drink do so.

Great place for breakfast I've stopped twice and loved it both times!  Their staff is professional and friendly.  The place has a nice homey feel to.  Try the Red Barn Portuguese muffin with mango chutney, I loved it!  I will definitely be back.
The good was amazing , especially the lunch special. They have food for vegans which was perfect for me. The service was great even during the lunch rush

Eh.  Going to give it another try for brunch, but right now not feeling super enthusiastic.  Maybe it was an off night?   Decor is AWESOME, and I love the courtyard.  So relaxing and pretty.   So. My drink was pretty good.  Definitely strong, but a little unremarkable.   The guacamole was the big downer.  It had a super smooth (too smooth) texture that seemed off - maybe they added sour cream? - with chunks of unripe/chewy avocado throughout.  Too much lime juice, not enough salt - just my preference.  The chips were nothing special. The braised short rib tacos were tasty, but a little lukewarm-ish.  Corn tortillas were great! All in all - I felt cruddy spending $51 for a "meh" meal for the two of us.  Heard they have a good brunch, so I might try it again.  If the guacamole were better, I would go back for chips and guacamole and drinks. Service was GREAT.  Maybe a little bit too attentive.

There is only one word that can describe this place - AMAZING!!! There food is very delicious and it truly changes the way you look at the vegetarian food. Their rolls are super fresh and the vegetables used are delicious. I came to order with the friend of mine at lunch time. There was a lot of people waiting in front of us, but surprisingly we were served very fast. GREAT PLACE!!!
The Ruben spring rolls are amazing! And the beef bourbon on a stick is to die for! Who needs an entree with such delicious appetizers at a very good price!

This place was perfect for a Saturday afternoon with a toddler.  Family friendly, quick, and delicious.  Excellent burgers, perfect milk shakes, yummy seasoned fries with your choice of dipping sauces.
Perfect crust, delicious sauce, homemade mozzarella all baked in a coal fired oven, much, much better than the Grimaldi's next door!
No other place like this around. From the variety of gigantic burgers to the variety of food choices if your hungry and  want deliciousness this is the place to be.

I had dinner here last night and everything was wonderful! Although I had to wait a few minutes before being sat at my table (welcome to midtown, new York city) the food was great, cooked to perfection with the perfect amount of sauce and the service was AMAZING. the servers were very knowledgeable of the wine selection, was able to suggest a delicious wine for my family and I and also knew their menu. Our drinks were always refilled without being asked and the managers as well as the staff were friendly, constantly making sure we were satisfied with our dining experience. will definitely be coming back!! thank you!
This place is next door to my barbershop and I basically eat there everyday and I'm never disappointed with the food especially the red velvet waffle with chicken
Everything was FANTASTIC!! We tried the Savory Oatmeal and the Stuffed Popovers! Do yourself a favor and save room for a Plum Dumpling. AMAZING!

I got one slice of the artichoke pizza to go and it was HUGE. Good, rich flavor but I wish it was warmer (they give you slice from already-made pie without warming in oven). Hard for me to enjoy the pizza as much with the visual of the worker touching my slice with his bare hands to put in to go box.

Recently attended a wedding at The Manor, where 15% of the total number of guests (approximately 30 people!) got sick with food poisoning.  It was clear that something from the venue went bad (most likely the oysters at the raw bar). The Manor failed  to cooperate with the bride and groom over this matter- there is a lack of response and compassion on how devastating it is for your special guests who come to honor the wedding to leave with food poisoning. Many guests contacted the bride and groom, reporting of extremely uncomfortable symptoms. The Manor asked for stool samples one week after the wedding. That doesnt sound right, does it? Also, after 1.5 months of this ordeal, the State Health Department finally contacted some guests at the wedding (both people who got sick and who did not). It's hard enough to think about what you ate the week before, how accurately can you remember everything you ate 1.5 months ago? That was a difficult conversation to have. There were also reports of some guests getting calls at 10:00PM from the State Health Department. Food poisoning- yes it happens. Lack of professionalism, service, and hospitality   from the venue should not. A wedding is one of life's most special occasions. I would think twice about working with The Manor.

This place Is the best. I drive from allentown to eat here. When you look in the window at all the food it's like heaven looking at you. Everything is very flavorful and delicious and the people that work there take care of you. I wish there was one out here in allentown.

Went with a couple friends at 9:15 in the middle of the week. It was still lively until we left after 11 - great lively atmosphere. They have a lot of variety on their menu we chose to split among us and they also serve great drinks (alcoholic and non). Good place to go for a fun vibe and good food. Do get hummus for your table - delicious.

I've been going to Ernie's since it opened. This takes me back to 1971, when I was in junior high school. Eventually it became simply "Ernie's". Excellent pizza, always friendly and pleasant folks who enjoyed their work and enjoyed their customers. Family-owned since the beginning. If you like casual, pleasant, clean and traditional, try them. They recently went from cash-only to credit cards accepted, and started offering wheat crusts and gluten-free pizza. This is a big change for them---they've always run the business on a simple, clutter-free basis, and now they're becoming more with the times! Also, they've always only been only a pizza place (no subs or spaghetti or calzones), but what they do, they do really, really well, and they love doing it. Their pizza is on the oily side, which I love. If you don't like an oily pizza, stay away. It's not for you. I have been a vegetarian since 1992, and before that time, I used to love their bacon and pepperoni pizzas. A true fest for the lover of those flavors. And yes, the bacon was always on the underdone side, rather than crispy. They ALWAYS did it that way, ensuring that it had the most flavor.
