(Responding to an earlier reviewer who complained the bacon on their pizza wasn't crispy.)

I came with my boyfriend tonight to enjoy a little Colombian food this side of Bogota. We had heard great things about the place and were eager to try it out. With all the great reviews we were sure this was going to be a wonderful meal. Tonight we finally got the chance since work was slow for both of us. It being a Wednesday summer night and all we figured we would just do the walk-in thing. When we got there, there was no one at the stand (which was odd), but we just chilled out and waited. It seemed like a nice enough place and all. Think Lower Eastside sheek paired with tacky TGIF. It seemed a little forced & a little dusty, but no big deal we weren't here to stair at the walls. We wanted some great chicharron, aji, and empanadas. Decor shmacor. Never the less the host soon arrived. He was pleasant enough and told us it would be about 15 minutes for a table. I asked if they had a garden and he said there was a patio and he would do his best to get us out there. So we sat in there weird cocktail area to wait. I say weird because it was like right there but there wasn't a server or waitress or anything to help us out. The host gave us a drink menu to look through and me and the hubby picked out a mojito for me and a frozen margarita for him. Simple straight to the point drinks where could we go wrong. I WILL TELL YOU WHERE. Who in this day and age serves the crappiest alcohol gussied up with some fresh limes and mint. Do you think people can't taste garbage liquor? While I can. It wouldn't be a big deal if the drinks were cheaper, but really $19 plus tax and tip! My man said his was fine on the liquor side, but said it tasted waaaaay too much like the crappy sour mix you find at the local beer slinging joints. Any way we moved past this. We wanted some food and luckily a table on the "patio" had opened up.  We were lead "outside" to the "patio". Oh I see you noticed all the quotation marks. So OUTSIDE is really just another room inside and PATIO means warm concrete box with disgusting gunky roof sitting on dollar folding chairs and in front of flimsy folding tables. We (and everyone around us) were by no means outside. We were just seated at crappy patio furniture INSIDE. I don't understand why you would say their was an outdoor seating area if in fact there wasn't? Whats wrong with saying we will take you to our backroom. Whatever!?!?! So there we are and we can't even hear ourselves think let alone talk to each other. There was a big table and OOOHHHHH could these ladies yammer. They were beyond loud. You would think they had never dined out beyond a high school cafeteria. And the way they spoke to the staff was embarrassing. They treated their waiter like he was a child. He just smiled and nodded. You could see he was agitated, but he kept his mouth shut and just kept on trying to be hospitable. While we were sitting there pondering what kind of weird latin world we had stumbled into our waitress came. She was also getting berated by the table, but seemed to brush it off. She gave us some water, plantain chips, and showed us their Aji sauce for the chips. She then pointed out some items on the menu that were popular. Honestly, I could barely hear her. While she was going through her schtick, a table that had been seated after us flagged down the waiter, the poor guy taking care of the loud mouths, and obviously asked to move "inside". So here we were. What on earth had happened? Me and the man just wanted a nice night out. Instead we were seated inside on crappy patio furniture, drinking garbage liquor, at PS XXX listening to the gossip of who knows what. Gosh darnit we were going to enjoy this rare night out together!!!!! (WOO SAAA). And the woo saa paid off There was a lull. The ladies quieted for a moment and for nearly the 1st time that night I felt like I was out and just enjoying myself and some time with my man. A large bald guy in a jacket, I'm guessing the manager, was out standing in front of the table. Guess why he was there????? He asked the women to tone it down. He seemed to be soft spoken but firm. This did not sit well with them. One lady demanded that he point out who was complaining (I WAS, I wasn't, but I WAS, in fact everyone "out" there was). He just seemed to repeat a plea for them to quiet down. One woman snapped back 'eff that we are just enjoying ourselves'. Again the manager insisted they quiet down. The group was not happy and muttered off while he backed off and said they were leaving. THANK GOD!! The manager left and so did the group from hell. I feel soory for him and his staff if this is what they have to deal with, but it was finally like a night out Our waitress (who I think was hiding from the drama) came back a few minutes later to get our order. The hubby had the Bandeja Peasa and I the Arroz con Pollo. The rest of the meal was fine, but nothing special. Guess what, we will be skipping Bogota forever after this foray.....

Been to Whiskey Cafe a few times and have always been impressed. The food is absolutely delicious. I highly recommend the Jack Daniels sliced steak. The mixed drinks are always made perfectly and they have a great selection of beer. The entire staff is extremely friendly and always attentive. They truly go above and beyond for their customers. What I love most is the fact that they always have something going on, live music, paint night, car shows, ect. They also have a pool table. Whiskey is an all around great place that truly values their customers.
OMG awesome. The tofu BBQ sandwich is to die for. The tater tots w cheese and all that are delish. The fact that it's BYOB is a def plus. Love coming here.
Great place for Ramen, My son Chris took me their loved it. great service. Nice waiter
love this veggie chinese food, flavorful and over all health for me

My favorite place to get soup dumplings! This place is worth the trip. Always a little packed and it feels like I'm being rushed to finish my food but the dumplings are incredible. Their other dishes are pretty good but no different than any other Chinese restaurant. The dumplings, on the other hand, are the best I've had. I love the crab and pork ones.

Stopped here on the way back home from New Hampshire.  Both of my daughters ordered the children's hot dogs and were very happy.  My wife ordered the reuben sandwich and was extremely pleased.  I ordered the chicken bacon ranch quesadilla and was completely blown away by how good it was.  The gentleman that waited on us was very kind and attentive.  Our wait for our food was ten minutes, tops. The only thing keeping me from giving five stars was the salad bar.  What they offer is tasty, but there is not much offered.  It sort of looks like the long lost brother of a real salad bar, and you don't know where it has been all of these years.  Other than that, it was great.  Would recommend to anyone and will dine there again.

just OK food, decent price, long wait, just OK ambience. Many have commended their customer service for locals. I believe that.The cashier seemed to know some people and maybe be super friendly to them. I just moved into the area. I was there at 9AM. Everyone was acting super busy with only 3 customers in store! It took more than 20 minutes for someone to take my order (with only 2 other customers). I know summer is hot and sweaty, but scratching body parts and then handling my toast with butter is not good practice. My food looked and tasted okay. I liked the sweet Italian sausage and home fries. but the eggs had black residue from the grill. I used to run a restaurant and we always clean the grill before making eggs. one thing you dont mess with in breakfast is eggs. they tell the truth about how the cook handles food. The cook also handles the cash and the waiter does delivery runs... how hygienic is that. I'm not asking for gloves and sanitary hand washes, but keep the money and street away from food. oh and BTW... it took another 17 minutes to get my check. I hope they clean up their act... or not. I got other places to visit.

Great place with a very lovely atmosphere. Besides the food, delivered fancy and tasting great, the place offers a very nice hangout to grab a bite and enjoy some local IPA's. If you're looking for an inspiring place to lighten up you're evening, this might just be the deal.
Rude bartenders. Mediocre drinks.

You want high prices and frustration? This is your place! You want constant turnover of employees so that each new employee is totally unaware of what the other employee was doing for you? This is your place! You want excuses when you call to at least explain what's bothering you? THIS IS YOUR PLACE!!!! For 4 years I've been buying this one product from this store. No one has ever thought to keep the product on the shelf for me even though, I buy it twice a month. It's rarely there. Since I like to keep the little guy in business I have continued to shop here. We own a business so we know what that's like. That said, when a customer calls and asks to speak to a manager you do not want to hear, "Well she's moving so it's been very stressful for HER!" WHAT??? I ask who else I can speak to. The girl tells me there is no manager in today and it's only her and the person in the soup section. She can't help me because she doesn't do the ordering and it's her last day! Shocker. Guess what? I will now be ordering ON LINE, all of my vitamins.There are 2 stores on line whose prices are between 50 and 20 percent lower. I could say this was a lesson learned for our own business but we've known from day one, you don't EVER want a customer to walk away this upset. You also don't want to make excuses for things you have done wrong. In a few years we'll be shaking our heads over the loss of yet another small business. But at least we'll know why.

Wow just ordered a grandma pie from here delivered. If it's 18.95 + 1.50 delivery charge + 7% tax it should be $20.88. Driver came and said $23.00( mind you no receipt ). Gave $25.00 with a tip. The pie has 8 square pieces. Called up and question the price and they are trying to say 23.00 with tax. They are charging 11% tax! And all they can say is that's the price. Arguing with the person on the phone we just hung up. A little while later the owner calls back and leaves a nasty message cursing and telling me "if I have any ***** I will come there!" I called back and the owner was cursing me out using the "F" word! What ever happened to the customer being right and trying to come to an understanding? What bad business! So in the end I paid $25.00 for 1 small pizza which cost them $1.75 to make!  I know I do pizza catering myself! I guess they don't know that being courteous goes hand in hand with a business. Too much competition in this town. Very low of them.

I visited Philadelphia in August of 2012 and contacted a local yelper for suggestions.  Being from California not knowing what humidity is about thought I would wonder about the streets and try one of the eateries on my list.  As the day was coming to an end and spending hours walking in the hot sun with temperatures exceeding what felt like 115 degrees I staggered into Amada after noticing what street I was on.  I said to myself "Self, this street name looks familiar from my list of Must Try while in Phili" I was early; they were setting up for the nights agenda.  They welcomed me in seeing that I was parched, stumbling, dehydrated, and semi lethargic.  The staff was gracious and obliging.  Explaining that they made my top ten list they were excited to introduce the menu of drinks and food.  The chef came out from the kitchen to welcome me, chatted a bit and he suggested the Chefs' selection, I believe thats what he called it.  Several tapas style courses paired with wine. Double-D-licious. I would compare this meal to an experience like no other.  Like sitting with your feet in the sand watching the sun slowly set as it has over the past few millennia, taking its place below the heavens and its bright rays loosing themselves as they fall below the crest of the ocean with the gentle breeze that brings a taste of salt on your lips and the soft sounds of the pacific tenderly and rhythmically bringing you to a place of peaceful solitude. I wish I could remember what I ate; all I remember is cured meats, delicate cheese, various berries, olives, and nuts coming out in droves of courses.    I had a coworker visit Philadelphia recently and he asked for some places to visit and eat.  This reminded me of my visit and I decided to write a 2 year reminisce that was well over due.
Enjoy this place for breakfast and dinner. Clean bathrooms and good for a date or meeting GF's. Good food on every visit.

Wow...best value I have ever experienced. Extremely good prices for huge portions of DELICIOUS food. Every other restaurant in the area is doing the complete opposite by serving tiny portions for ridiculous amounts of money. This place is amazing! Really good drinks and delectable mediterranean menu!

Delicious baked goods, from bread to pastries. Bitter coffee not the best downtown. Sloooooow servers who could care less. Always seems to be an extra person behind the counter doing nothing but unwilling to take an order unless the line is longer than 4 people. Taking premade food out of cases isn't rocket science so they should speed it up.
Very intimate and European coffee bar. Snacks, sandwiches, salads also...all freshly made. Fantastic espresso!
The ceviche there is one of the best that I have in years!! I strongly recommend this place.

Went out for a special birthday dinner and went away disappointed. Very inexperienced waiters told us the special was stripped bass when it was actually sea bass. Started clearing the table when people were still eating ordered housemade gelato, it was all crystallized . Not what you would expect from Maxs
Hamiltons is amazing. It is the best place in the neighborhood and the staff is great. I always bring my guests there. Also I love the mushroom pesto sandwich.

The food is very delicious and straightfoward. You order something and do not get bad surprises, only a full belly. One plate is enough to feed two or three people and the prices are extremely reasonable considering how pricey the NYC metro area is. The staff are awesome and very accommodating. I have very warm memories of coming here.

This place is one of my favorites.  I usually only get tapas and the occasional salad.  The last time I came here I had the shredded brussel sprout salad which was absolutely amazing.  We also had the grilled calamari, the bay scallops, the shrimp in a yummy garlic sauce, and the cheese croquettes off the tapas menu.  Everything was absolutely perfect.  Service was great and they brought us over a yummy mango dessert.  Every time I'm here I'm impressed and will definitely be back!

THIS IS MY FIRST YELP REVIEW. I have never before experienced the profound disappointment that I felt when trying to dine at The Bao yesterday evening. I grew up working in the service industry and to say that the staff and organization at this establishment is lacking is a gross understatement. My boyfriend and I love soup dumplings and heard that these were a welcome addition to our East Village neighborhood. It then became my priority to go taste for myself. After arriving for dinner at 9pm were sat immediately. After placing an order for the Kung Fu and Crab dumplings our server told us it would take about 25 minutes for them to come out. We agreed to wait. She then pushed on us to get more food because our dumplings would take so long. we ordered a scallion pancake based on her suggestion. Not that we actually wanted one, we were just hungry. 30 minutes later- no dumplings and no scallion pancake that was suggested due to long wait times. Seriously? You pushed this scallion pancake on us and you don't bring it out? The server finally arrived back to our table and told us that she was sorry- "THERE ARE NO MORE SOUP DUMPLINGS AVAILABLE." Are you fucking kidding me lady? I just waited 30 minutes after ordering, didn't get my scallion pancake, or my juicy dumplings that I had been pining for. Sorry doesn't cut it. How does a restaurant in NYC run out of their staple dish at 9:30? Ive worked in restaurants. Count your freaking portions, don't take orders you can't fill, and train your waitstaff. It's that simple. Your food is only as good as the people who actually get to try it. Ridiculous. You have wasted my time and ironically left a bad taste in my mouth- even though I only sampled your water. I will never return. Get your shit together Bao. New Yorkers aren't going to tolerate your poor planning and poor service. ** Please note after waiting 30 minutes to be told they were out of the food we ordered they offered us no concession for their mistakes. They were however still pushing for us to buy a scallion pancake to go, the same one we should have received 30 minutes prior.
One other quick thought- when the waiter took our check he just assumed the cash was for him. At no point did we say "keep the change" or "the change is for you" ! Very presumptuous and rude

The sad part of this review is that tacos are pretty tasty. This is the second time we have had terrible service at this establishment. They need some kind of manager with half a brain to start organizing things. We placed an online order for pick-up at 6:30 and could select the pick up time - we chose 6:55. We walk in a few minutes after 7. Wait in line for at least 5 minutes only to be told it will be  a few minutes. Okay, not a big deal. THIRTY minutes later - after everyone who placed their orders in front of us in the store (35 minutes after we placed our order) had received their food, they finally got around to serving us. The whole point of placing an order for pickup is getting your food in a timely manner and not standing around. Last time they didn't give us all of our food and we got home and discovered it, they were extremely rude. I do not recommend this place and I really hope the owners read this and put someone in charge who has any kind of business and restaurant sense to stop being so rude and get their operations in order. You are setting a pretty bad example of service in the up and coming neighbor.
Delicious cheesesteaks to the face! I could barely enter my order in Seamless and my sandwich was at my door. Pro tip: add sauce and get the whiz
Great pizza, I usually come here for an afternoon bite with my work friends.
Dumplings are good. Pancakes are a bit greasy and lack filling. Duck noodle soup uses all the cheapest cuts of the duck. But it's very cheap. I think I prefer Super Taste.

So obsessed with the pizza and chicken wings!!! Great prices here.. It's definitely worth the trip coming here. This place is great for families and families with little children. The meatballs are also wonderful!

Went to celebrate our son's birthday.  There were 4 of us for dinner on Sunday Aug 17th.  The staff was very friendly.  We sat upstairs and we picked our table.  The food was wonderful.  We shared about 12 plates favorites were: Fried Goat Cheese, Crispy Brussel Sprouts, lamb meatballs and octopus.  The flavors were unique.  Pace yourselves- order a few plates, enjoy them then order a few more....Our waiter was friendly and attentive.  We had Vina Ardanza with our plates.  We all enjoyed something our waiter suggested it was like a spicey ravioli.  Oh so good.   We will return!
I like Pure Fare. It is kinda pricy but the food is decent quality and the coffee is really good. I especially like their mocha's which they put chocolate chips in.
Food is good. Busy place at lunch time. Arnold Palmer (ice tea & lemonade) $4.00! :-/
love this place! the greeting you receive as you enter the main restaurant is a cool energetic welcome, and the food is just made with love and has a great variety on the menu.
I didn't like the food and my service was poor

Not my favorite Chinese in Essex. Very large portions, but not a lot of flavor. I had the chicken lo mein, crab Rangoon's, and dumplings. The lo mein could have used more chicken and a few more vegetables, the Rangoon's were more shell than stuffing, but the dumplings were good. IF I eat there again I will be trying something else, maybe it was just me, maybe they were having a bad day. But there are better Chinese restaurants in Essex.

Ehh this place is just hype. Sorry most of food here isn't that great compared to Penang's which is a block away. But the reason why I gave this a 1 star review wasnt because of the food, it's because when I couldn't finish my meal I asked for a to go box since it wouldve been a waste if I threw it out but one douchebag waiter said no.  I asked are you joking? He said no. So I said fine no tip then and he eventually got me a box. F you banana leaf I'll happily go elsewhere. This happened in the year 2010 around November. Had written the review but never posted because I forgot.

Tonight was the first time I'd eaten at Chapter One and I completely enjoyed it. I was with a group of friends, and we shared several dishes including the trout salad, okra, beef tartar, octopus salad, lentil fritters, sirloin, duck, and ribs. RIBS! I'm putting that one in ALL CAPS, but the truth is everything tasted delicious and we all had a great time. Food and drinks were excellent, the atmosphere was warm, and the service was friendly and attentive. We definitely left smiling and satisfied.
Great guacamole, great drinks. A bit pricey. Cool bar
Ike gave me my sandwiches himself. Dutch crunch bread is a must-try though my wife got wheat and it was great as well. Fantastic root beer selection!
I got the tomato, mozzarella and spinach with pesto. I was pretty good. The bread was a little generic for the price. However, the freshness of the veggies made up for it. I will be back.

The food isn't 5 star michelin, but it is very satisfying very decently priced. Cheap and decently tasty Korean food can be had here at most hours of the day. Indeed it's convenience and price is it's best aspects

I went with my boss and a co-worker and all of our food was fabulous.  Had the shortrib, boss had the pasta trio, and co-worker had the pulled pork, all were flavorful.  Can't complain with the $25 bottles of wine too - good deal!
Apple sake is Nice!
I really enjoyed the food and atmosphere of this place. Had to wait about an hour for a table but that was expected for a Friday night and it was worth it.
Always good and toasty, 10 times better than subway. The meats and dressings are incredible for a chain sub restaurant

I've been eating the penny Egg Sandwich w soy sausage for a good 5 years, maybe longer.!? I often asked for a side of tobasco in my laziest days, so once they delivered me an entire bottle with my order because they are that nice and thoughtful and i ordered that much !!! Needless to say the breakfast is delicious!!! The brunch is hard to get into. Dinner is the best- get chicken Curry salad Or veggie burger w/ fries. I love their fries! This review is making me hungry!

Up there amongst the best in Williamsburg. They usually have some mouth watering specials that will have you coming back for more. The french sandwich au jus is the best...specially since there are few places in the area that serve it.

First time going to the Hot House and we Loved it, great food, great service, excellent ambience.   The staff was so friendly and helpful!!!! Just felt so comfortable in the place.  The food was so darn good starting from the salad (bacon, greens, fried tomatoes and a lovely dressing) to the fried chicken (mild for me) ending with a beautiful double chocolate cake, warm of course with blueberries and strawberrys and whipped cream,  We were so pleased we will go again real soon!!!!!
Great food, atmosphere and service. But my favorite part of the experience was the coffee. Highly recommended for Java lovers.
I got the original, and it was ok but nothing special. The tots were good. Nothing you can't get anywhere else for less money.

Delicious burgers, ordered the chili burger.  The fries are crispy and salty . The waitress was nice enough to give me three refills on the soda I had !  Weird that the place looks like a bar but food is great quality .

it's a real burger experience! Bistroburger is fantastic with its delicious bacon and cheese and fresh onion. the meat is savory enormous and perfectly cooked. i love it more than anywhere in the world. Samantha from Milan

Greeting - yes Vibe- World War II Price- good Parking- good luck on street Bathroom- horrible- that faucet come on! Service- friendly yet in attentive Food Sausage app $10 tastes like breakfast links on over cooked red potatoes- skip it THE BURGER- huge, stacked high and only $12.50 in restaurant and $ 7.50 in bar for a scaled down version. The meat quality could be better. But overall yes one of the best burger deals ever. Lettuce and tomato and bacon on bottom bun. French onion rings on top. Nice dill pickle wedge. French fries are not good. I think they are flour coated fake crunch Dessert- skip the chocolate cakes. Not high end stuff. Drink beer not wine here WIGB? Yes for that crazy burger!

Started at the bar. Then went to table. Service was horrific. Do NOT waste your time or well hard earned money. The bartenders are so cocky except the female blonde. But the service bartender was such a douche he ruined our night.  He was so disrespectful and unprofessional that he has no idea who he has been rude to.

The good is brilliant here.  If you're thinking low brow, your right and wrong.  Sure there are perfectly prepared seafood boils but that's just the start.  I had the line caught Cod with andouille, potatoes and cherry tomatoes is a hearty deliciously lemony wine/ butter sauce.  Don't miss this place!  It's family owned and operated, and the care and concern is ever present

The two stars is not because of the wait. In fact, we didn't wait at all because we went for dinner. This was strategic. I called 15 minutes ahead to ask if there was a wait for two, of which there was not. The ambiance at night at Clinton St. Baking is great. It's candlelit and intimate and the two-top tables that make up a majority of the floor are occupied by couples. We were sat immediately, but it was steadily busy. All but one table was occupied, however that sentiment carries less weight when there are 12 tables in a restaurant. I love the biscuits they serve in place of the expected bread basket. Our food came out quickly. I suggested since it was my dining companion's first time that she get the blueberry pancakes. She absolutely loved and devoured them. I should have taken my own advice and stuck with the breakfast for dinner agenda. I ordered the burger with bleu cheese. It was mediocre at best. I requested it be cooked Medium-Rare and it came out Medium-Well/Well. This is always completely demoralizing for me. This goes hand-in-hand with the awful service we had. Had our waitress come over ONCE after the very attentive back-waiter dropped our food this situation could have been rectified. Alecia H. was our waitress on Tuesday, August 19 and she was inattentive, disinterested, and most importantly, not present! For a restaurant as small as this one I should not have to actively look for my waitress. Both me and the person I was dining with work in the food industry and we were actually laughing at how awfully we were being treated. Because we know what it is like to work in service we tried to be understanding, constantly rationalizing our server's blasé attitude, but when we realized that she was not busy serving other tables, a fact of which we could have dealt with, we started to get angry. Completely inexcusable and intolerable. Will not return.
What a gem!  Quaint, fun and sexy all in one. Great food, service and enjoyable experience!
Love this place. So happy to have a restaurant in the neighborhood offering tasty, healthy options with actual flavor. I love the Lemon Chicken, Basque shrimp and shrimp tacos, so far.

Bierstube is a great bar in Philly. My wife and I tried it out on our anniversary and had a great time. The bar has a wonderful selection of different craft and import beers, including a few beers that I had been aching to try for a long time. The service was spectacular. I don't know how frequently Vinnie works the bar, but he was one of the friendliest bartenders I've ever met. He was extremely knowledgable about all of the beers they serve, and made a surprisingly good Ginger Old Fashioned. The other servers were all very kind as well. The atmosphere was relaxed and laid back. The food was great. Of particular note was the beer-cheese dip for the soft pretzels. If there's anything that might seem confusing about the place, it's that they have a great selection of Belgian beers. It seems odd for a German restaurant, but it works.

Strange atmosphere, good food and inconsistent service. Although San Sai doesn't come even remotely close to feeling like an authentic Japanese restaurant, they offer good tea and sushi with service that is usually quite good.

I drive over 40 min to eat here cuz the food is really authentic.  It is a rare authentic Cantonese place in new jersey.  The beef chow fun taste just like what you can order in HK or China.  Chinese ppl call it strong "wok air", meaning that you can taste that it was stirred fry in a wok with strong fire. The food here is not fancy, just everyday Cantonese food.  Dim sum selection is decent on weekends.  Prices are fair. I wish there are more places like this in new jersey.
Great new place. Fantastic ambience. Enjoyed the organic herbal teas. Sacher torte very nice. Will return again!
Fresh food. Great service. Celebrity sightings.

I found this place on an app called savored and when we first arrived the atmosphere was very welcoming, trendy, and looked like a great place. The service is really good and attentive, almost too attentive because all the waiters are your waiters and they check in with you every 5-7 min, but are very friendly and polite. The food, however, is very subpar. The fried food literally just tastes fried with no other flavor. One dish was legit fat with sauce on a stick, very unappetizing. The chicken pad thai was okay but overall not worth your time in a neighborhood overflowing with good places

They all taste the same but in a great way. I think the secret sauce is basically Mayo, but again, in a great way. Current location -- selling sandwiches out of the front half of Lime -- is hilarious. Makes me want them to never get permanent digs.

Great comfort food with a little bit more flare than how your grandma made it, excellent, fast service, comfy atmosphere, strong drinks, great location... What more could you ask for? We had the pierogies for an appetizer (growing up in my big Polish family, I can tell you these are some real deal pierogies, not your Mrs.T variety!), the chicken and waffles (waffles were slightly sweet and nice and crispy on the outside but soft on the inside, chicken was perfectly crispy and not greasy), the potato pancakes (love the applesauce!) and the buttered peas. I could have done without the chicken gravy and would have preferred to have some honey, and the buttered peas were a little too close to frozen peas out of a bag for me, but these are minor complaints in an overall fantastic, delicious meal. Oh and for dessert I highly recommend the key lime pie with caramel sauce and passion fruit salsa. You won't be disappointed! And in case you were wondering, they have a Bellini of the day (served all day!), a margarita of the day and a sangria of the day on top of a nice speciality cocktail, local brew and wine list. Do yourself a favor and come here- you won't be disappointed!

My parents have been coming here for over twenty years, and I can remember coming here ever since I was young. Thankfully, the food is still exceptional, along with reasonable prices. I crave their mussels, garlic shrimp, and scallops in wine sauce. I have never once been disappointed!!
simple fast sushi.  not the freshest but sufficient. simple decor. friendly service.  a little overpriced
Love Love Love it here!

My family and I went out last night to celebrate my husband and daughter's birthdays. We were searching for somewhere reasonably priced and fun in South Philly since most of us reside there. BLUE CORN could not have been a better choice! The establishment is inviting, pleasant and impeccibly clean. The entire staff, servers and owners are incredibly nice, patient and couldn't do enough for us. Every morsel was SO fresh, tasty and most important, authentic. They were expaining every menu item completely (as most of it is in Spanish) and are such wonderful people. It is also family owned and run which is refreshing to see how wonderfully they all interact with eachother. Don't miss the Octopus Cerviche and be sure to order a Tamarin Margarita, Kudos to every person on staff-We will be sure to be back. Also, they offer a Sunday brunch which we will be sure to try!!

3 stars for the beers and the prices ! Excellent prices for the place and the ambience . Disappointed with the service and the food . Recommend not ordering the wings which were extremely oily and the nachos- which were soggy .
Due to lack of English speaking people, I was given too much food and paid dearly for it. Food is good but overly priced and without proper people to speak to over the phone I was ripped off.

Excellent food. Salads are very unique and very tasty. Tried beet selad, purshoto salad,, stuffed meatballs and steak. Service is a bit slow, so be ready for 2 hr meal. Nextdoor to Lolitas mexican ferd, same owners. Great choice.

I've been a steady customer at the Thirsty Koala for the last year and I can say that I've NEVER had a disappointing experience. The food is always delicious, the service exceptional, and a consistently delightful atmosphere. I usually stick to my favorite dish, the steak tacos, but have enjoyed the lamb lollies as well. The chips (fries) are the best I've ever had, with the most delicious sweet chili sauce on the side. The daily happy hour is the best deal around. 2 for 1 cocktails is a deal and these drinks are amazing. I'd highly recommend the "Dingo", or one of their amazing beers. Always a good end to a day! I dare you to find a more friendly/helpful wait staff in NYC. Seriously. These people are amazing and always put a smile on my face. If you haven't yet tried the Thirsty Koala, you don't know what you're missing. I'll be a life-long customer!

I like coming here for the Knicks games from time to time. It's kind of upscale but not too crazy and it's nice to not be around a bunch of wild cats. The food is good, the service is great, drinks are on point everything is aces. The only thing stopping me from giving it 5 stars is the fact it feels more like a restaurant with big T.V.'s than a sports bar, but that could be a good thing depending on what your looking for.

Tina's is a popular spot in this part of town which can make for long lines on peak days/ times.  Still it is great quality, super tasty latin cuisine.  The pork chops is sauce is a go to entre, and the fried pork is hard to beat.  On that note, the sandwiches are great and very popular with the fried pork and plantains sandwich being my fav... it looks and weighs as much as a large red brick.  As a Cuban-American a few things aren't 100% on-point- the ropa veija is a litle dry and stringy, and the picadillo has more veggies that meat... Also would love to see boliche and arroz con leche!!  But overall this is a great spot for the hubcap sized plate or lead brick sized sandwich you are craving.

This is my favorite spot to eat breakfast at in NYC. I visited Cafeteria in the beginning of May 2013. We visited the place 3 times during our stay, and every time was a great experience. The staff was friendly and very professional towards us. The food was superb and the portions was very big. If you want to eat a steak for breakfast, I can highly recommend to do it here. I had not tried it before, so this was new to me, but also very delightful. The prices are very fair compared to quality of the food and service.
The serving sizes are huge and the prices are quite good. Asiana offers a good selection of sushi and noodles and I haven't been disappointed by them yet.

The decor gives you a real feeling of the Black Sea and I love the boats on the walls. The portions are big and I'm surprised we even finished. I got the Lamb Grill Mix and it was a taste of everything and extremely gratifying. We even got free dessert for writing this review. Would definitely come again.

We ate here mid afternoon on a wednesday so the place was very quiet. We were famished and the food did not disappoint. Having found this place via the show 'best thing i ever ate' Alton Brown recommended the crepes. We ordered a sweet and savory crepe and both were delicious beyond words. The sweet crepe; apples honey goat cheese and creme fraiche, was a high point. The goat cheese brought something to the crepe that balanced out the sweetness and elevated it to a level of food I have rarely experienced. We also had the bison burger, and while the establishment is known for crepes don't be afraid to order the burger, for it was delicious. My wife fought with me for more of the burger I'd ordered. At first I thought I'd made a mistake ordering a burger at a place renowned for its crepes, but boy was i wrong. The ambiance was intimate and the staff courteous and attendant.

Boccone = Awesomeness. Just had dinner here.  Table for 8 Italians please.  The owner came over and hung out for awhile. Chatted it up about the town his family is from and where he has lived around the world.  Super nice and generous guy.  Took us all in like "mi familia." Atmosphere is great.  Clean and not fussy.  Huge place in the back too. Service was attentive.  Customer is always right attitude.  Food was great and so nicely presented. We had many of the apps: calamari, arancini, pizza and crab cakes. For dinner the pappardelle with mushrooms, halibut, snapper, gnocchi, pasta di mare... Great portion size too. Dessert was rock star. The zabaglione and bread pudding was A-mazing.  Great place to go if you are in south orange or visiting a seton haller (my alma mater!) Btw 20% off for students.  And it's byob which is a plus for me. Nothing negative here to note.   Take a walk in the quaint downtown area and have a lovely dinner here!  Mangia!  Thank you Boccone!!! We will back.

Second time eating here. First time delivery, second time pick up. Food is very consistent and very good. Definitely a family owned restaurant. I got the spicy honey dipped chicken with greens and candied yams. The dip wasn't too spicy or too sweet, very balanced, which I like. Greens were very savory with a hint of smoked meat. Candied yams weren't too sweet which I like and you can definitely taste the cinnamon. Dianna got the smothered turkey wings again with greens and green beans. She wanted the Mac but of course they ran out and had to wait for it: that's a good sign when they run out of quintessential dishes so early in the evening. Great gravy, compliments the wing which is ginormous. Brontosaurus wing! Meat fell off the bone. Green beans were good, we should have waited for the Mac. Also got catfish nuggets for appetizer. Big portion, fried very well but not dried out. Tasty and flaked when you bit into it, that's a good thing. Got the berry peach cobbler, once again not too sweet. Cobbler got a little mushy but what do you expect when you rush it home in a plastic wear. Still very tasty, definitely taste the fruit and butter. Sweet tea with mango is good, next time have to try out the Greenville: if you don't know go check the place out. In conclusion, if you haven't already try the place out. Definitely worth your money. Often you find soul food places over sauce or make the food too sweet or too salty or too whatever. I'm impressed that the chef is mindful of keeping the flavors balanced. Please support this local business, we need more family owned places like this and they make excellent food.

Went for my birthday, been meaning to try for awhile. Really nice people and space. Good concept too of unique tapas style dishes (in an area where all restaurants serve practically the same food)...but horrible execution, everything we tried was just bad and really salty.  Things like pork sliders, calamari and corn on the cob were bad even, which I honestly didn't know was possible.
Coconut mojitos are delish! Domino empanadas-to die for Love the place!! Great date place!

Wow, their breakfast omelet is incredible. I got it with onions, mushrooms and tomatoes. This place is very cozy, has a great energy, and the staff is friendly. As a vegetarian I loved seeing all the veggie and gluten free options. Definitely looking forward to coming back next time I'm in New Haven.
Gotta try their Chicken Pot Pie! :)
Sensory Overload! You can pretty much find anything you could need here.... Just be aware that there is always going to be a crowd.
Fabulous food & excellent service. This was our 2nd time, being a picky eater that's saying something!!! Highly recommended, I tell everyone how great it is!
Okay, this McLoone's feels totally disconnected from any of the rest.  It's pretty creepy and filled with old, gambling men.  It also smells like dirty Atlantic City.  Being 28, this isn't my scene.

Do not waste your money at this restaurant. Overpriced portion, bland food, and rude staff. My friend whose been to this restaurant several times recommended this place for our lunch date. But she will not be returning again because of the staffs action during our lunch. We ordered 6 oysters, clam chowder, fish and chips and a salmon burger. Oysters were warm when we received them, clam chowder was watery, and salmons burger was dry and plain. We were next to a family ( parents and a toddler). The waitress came up to the table and yelled at the family for not leaving enough tip on the bill and that they should not eat at the restaurant again if they do not have enough money for tip. I could not believe it. I was looking around the restaurant for a staff member to intervene. There was one staff member who was watching close by but did not intervene. I later found out that was the manager. He did not do anything to stop the waitress he just let the waitress yell at the customer in front of the whole restaurant. The couple did not argue but kept calm and left the restaurant. I don't understand a business who think it's acceptable to yell at a paying customers in front of other customers! There's other ways to handle the situation. At least they left her a tip after that display. The waitress should be happy she received a tip and move on instead of causing a scene in front of the entire restaurant. This same waitress was our waitress too. She was also snappy when we ordered and rude. I looked at yelp after leaving the restaurant because I had assume the waitress and the manager were just having a bad day. But apparently it looks like they're already establishing a bad reputations by themselves with their actions towards customers and lack of action from the manager. After seeing that display my friend said she will not be returning and could not believe what she had seen. There are far better seafood restaurants in Murray Hill than this place. Will not be returning.

Ok...updated review Place is still disgusting Ordered a quesadilla - waitress dropped a piece on the ground... Table across from her informed her she 'lost a piece'. She picked it up...out it on a plate and brought the piece back to me We were dying (table across from us as well) Karl- Revamp or close Please Before it's too late Read your reviews!!!
I had the Turkey Pastrami French Dip, and must say it was absolutely amazing. Everything was fresh and we got it with 10 minutes of ordering.

We have been loyal customers at Revere for several years , with same excellent satisfaction.  We are there often for lunch and dinner in the same day.  Also at least 2 times a week.  Joes bread and escarole and beans always bring us back.  Service has never been a problem and our experience with Heather at the bar is always a pleasure.

The service is pretty bad  here and so is the food. I definitely would not come here for dinner. Only had appetizers and the pizza was pretty flavorless. If your trying to get a beer in your way home from work this bar is fine. Otherwise id go somewhere else.

I have been here several times. Their house burger is one of my favorite choices and I would have to say their pizza is the best in town. The interior is small but I tend to take out most of the time. Jalapeño poppers and fries are crispy and good. Their is a seating area outside that is nice.
Always come here with the guys and get gelato and a couple of pies. You cant beat the sauce!
This place is nice. Cool scene on  a summer night. Square slice is on point. To all the noobs that don't know..ITS ALL ABOUT THE SAUCE!
great squares, spumoni ice cream is excellent...I even get it in the winter time

Amazing place best Greek food in Astoria !  Real nice outdoor dinning , services was very fast as well. Food was great ! Prices are reasonable !!! Parking can be hard to find , wait can be long something depending on the night.. Overall an amazing experience and great food !
LOVE THIS PLACE!!! Fresh sushi, awesome rolls, great service!
This hole in wall has been here for years. They have the best falafel you can find anywhere. Place is tiny and has hardly any seating that's why the 4 stars and not 5 This place is awesome!

Love this place. Fantastic food, and great value for what it is. The chef put together a wonderful sampler main for my girlfriend who is avoiding certain foods due to health conditions. Also, the chef is a ridiculously nice guy. Would go back in an instant.
Amazing service, superb food.

Beija-Flor is a gem in LIC! The food is superb. As a Brazilian myself living in NYC I was pleased to find out about this place recently. That's gonna be the place to go every time I feel homesick for sure! I have tried a few other Brazilian restaurants in the city and in Astoria, but this one is hands down the best! They carry very authentic Brazilian food on the menu. One of the things that impressed me the most was the fact that they serve "carne de sol", it is such a soulful thing which reminds me of Northeast Brazil It is a heavily salted beef, which is exposed to the sun for one or two days to cure - I love it! We started with all sort of appetizers (coxinhas, pastéis and bolinho de bacalhau) and then had the linguiça caseira (sausage). Well done, the appetizers were crusty and the filling perfect! For entrée, we had the Picanha na Chapa and Moqueca de Peixe. Both dishes stand out, but let me tell you, the Moqueca was amazeballs! You can't go wrong if you are into seafood. Even the side dishes that come - basic rice and beans - were made just right and tasted great ;) The caipirinhas were well made: passion fruit and cajú flavours! Well muddled limes, right amount of sugar and cachaça! It is the perfect companion to a ton of delicious  food. For dessert we had the coconut delight - manjar de coco - which came with a cinnamon stick and was heaven as well. Next time, I wanna try the Brazilian flan and brigadeiro!!   The service is very attentive, including the owners - extremely kind and always making sure everything was fine. Five stars! I hear they serve feijoada - a delicious and typical Brazilian dish - on saturdays with live samba. And live music on the weekend nights. I'm going to definitely check it out! You are going to have a good time even for a romantic dinner or in a group. The ambience is cozy and tasteful.  Antiques and sisal ropes decorate the place. Comfy seats and nice lighting. Love it! It is only a couple blocks from the 39 station on the N, Q train, so it is very convenient even for those coming from Manhattan. Good thing LIC is developing fast and it is becoming very trendy, with nice shops and restaurants like this popping up! Overall great experience, I will be dreaming about the food and will be looking forward to coming back anytime soon. Highly recommend!

This is a real gem amongst the food carts by Yale Medical School.  I've been getting the salads for several months but I remembered my phone today to snap a few pics.   To give you an idea about how good the salads are: I've been craving this salad all week pretty much for the whole summer. Usually, I crave pizza and desserts but I'd put this up there in the category of must-try food around New Haven.  I've yet to try the sandwiches as the other reviewers mentioned but the Chicken Caesar Salad is really great.  Jon adds TONS of chicken to it, freshly grated parmesan cheese, croutons, and fresh tomatoes followed by a dab of extra dressing.  The salad is a great deal for 6.50$ and Jon seems like a passionate guy.  I will note that he is very trusting and says just take your change out of a can of money on good faith.  I'm looking forward to trying the sammies next.
My favorite place in town. Service is sometimes slow, but the pie is worth the wait!

Went there tonight for my boyfriends birthday.. First of all the food is amazing! The ambiance is really fun and our server, Kayla, was the best! She recommended an awesome appetizer and also a dessert. Definitely can't wait to go back again and will ask for Kayla!

Cheap beer, good food for the price but the service makes it all a waste of time! Jill is the WORST bartender/server you will ever come across. She reminds of the chick who maxed out in HS and is now stuck in the town she grew up in serving all the people she thought she was better than and acting like she got the best job EVER! She's a loser!!! And when she's there the place loses atmosphere.

Hes not called the king for nothing their is just nothing compared to this food cart at all everyone else is truly inferior it's hard to explain why it's so good here you just got to experience it for yourself huge portions of savory tasty food for outstanding prices I think the most expensive thing is $9 and it's enough food for 2 meals

Worst place to visit in newark  had one of the worst experiences over the weekend. Sat outside waited for 15 min for a waiter and no one came. Went up to the bar and ordered my own drinks  and brought them to my table. I also grabbed my own menus which is ridiculous. After we got our drinks we waited about 10 min and still no one approached us. Went up to a guy who i thought was the manager. I wish i remembered his name. Older guy witch slick back hair. By far the worst i have encountered. Asked for a waiter and he said okay. Continued to wait for another 15 min and nothing. I approached him again. And he decided to finally take our order. As he approached our friend for her order she asked if he could accommodate her by giving her a chicken shish-kabob instead of the mixed kabob ( chicken, beef, pork) the waiter refused to do it. And simply said i have to accommodate you and the chef. Which in my opinion is unacceptable. Completely angered us and decided to pay for our drinks and leave. He came back to the table with a smart attitude and made a disrespectful comment. We all work in the hospitality business. For many years.  And i think that man should not work anywhere near a restaurant. I wish i remembered his name so i could let all know. If sagres management is reading this i have been going there for 3+ years and never had an issue until sunday night. Tall older white man. With dark grey slick back hair is not a good look for you guys. On the other hand out bartender was great and made us 3 delicious cocktails.

My experience today at Pepe Giallo is a reminder for restaurant owners that it takes just one bad egg in a great team to turn away oyal customers. I love Pepe Giallo's food and prices but not enough to accept the rude and unacceptable attitude of the Russian hostess/manager handling the reservations. She literally threw us out of the restaurant  when I politely complained of the long wait for a table (after waiting for 20 minutes beyond my reservation time) I hope the owner is reading these reviews and takes corrective action by firing the hostess, who is just ruining the efforts of a sincere tram that delivers great food and good service. Ms Hostess, if you are not happy working in the service industry, pl find something else where you get away with your horrible attitude. You don't deserve to be at Pepe Giallo!

Very Very Excited and Happy about this place. Just came home from having dinner here with my very strict vegetarian husband. We loved the decor, music and the food was great, fresh and executed nicely. We had the sampler platter which was just okay a little to greasy for my liking. My husband had the curried cauliflower with kale and coconut rice and he was begging me to take an additional order home!  I had the heart of palm salad with salmon and i must say it was amazing the salad was fresh, portion was great and the salmon was perfectly seasoned and very well cooked. I seldomly give reviews but I really want this place to stick around as it offers fresh healthy things that my husband and I are always looking for, The also have very good tea, and juices. Sadly we can't afford to eat here as a daily thing but will try to make it once or twice a month. Lastly, the staff was super nice just lacked some menu knowledge. GOOD LUCK VITAL!!!

This is the first time I've had anything I didn't like from this place. (And I don't order much. They give you little food and it's overpriced) I ordered the stuffed grape leaves (which weren't homemade) they were soggy and sour and the rice was mushy. They plated it on a bed of lettuce, vinegar, and some weird grumbly cheese. The grape leaves also fell apart. I also ordered the shish kabob with everything on it and the meat was grey. They put too much onion not enough lettuce and the whole thing fell apart when I tried to eat it. Now my stomach hurts. I called to tell them about it and the girl on the phone didn't even offer a refund or a new order. The girls behind the counter obviously don't care. Which is not very helpful to customers. Never ordering again

This place is the best in Ridgewood and Bushwick.  I would recommend it to anyone.  I am convinced that any serious foodie will give the thumbs up.  All the food is prepared meticulously by the chef who obviously has a high level of culinary experience. Very detailed layering of flavors and the combination of different ingredients and the textures are superb.  Ive been here four times since the discovery but each time I was wowed by what they offer. I love how they have their specials in appetizer portions too.  The seared scallops over mushroom risotto was heavenly. Their $10 burger is hands down the best tasting and the best bargain in all of NYC. I can not wait for them to get a liquor license so I can enjoy a drink with their fantastic food  at the bar. Love the service and how clean the place is. Amazing quality and cuisine at a diner price , makes this restaurant my recent favorite.

So the food here is great.  Good beer selections and generally very nice and prompt staff.  So why 2 stars?  This is about the person who takes your oder.  This happened a few months ago and it's been clawing at me since so I decided to write a review.  The first time I went no issues.  Everything was wonderful.  The 2nd time I went I waited to place my order.. there was no line.  The person who cuts the meat was cutting some meat for something else.. to go? pick up order?  not sure.  Either way I stood in front of him for about 10 minutes.  He literally made eye contact with me and looked away and just continued cutting meat.  I'm in no rush.. but give me a heads up.  "I'll be right with you chief".. "give me a second buddy".. "just gimmie a minute"... JUST ACKNOWLEDGE THE CUSTOMER IN SOME SORT OF DECENT MANNER!  We walked out without getting anything.  It's a casual place - i'm not expecting the world.  Just say something!  Sure I could have said something but I'm here trying to exchange my money for a product.  I don't expect anybody to kiss my ass and I always try to tip well as I truly believe the food service industry is one of the toughest least rewarding industries out there.  Just don't be outwardly rude about it.
Fantastic attentive service. Authentic gravy  fresh fish. Excellent dining experience. Highly recommend!
Best xiao lung bao comparable to ones in Shanghai. I am from California and definitely have not tasted so juicy bao for a long time
We had the tasting menu which was superb and a complete surprise for the price of $68. Another nice thing was that the seating is secluded and gives one a private atmosphere.

Really solid little place; I actually just stopped in for a beer and ended up getting a flight. They have four main rotating beers on draught, and a whooole host of others via bottle, etc. Our server, Tim, was awesome and incredibly helpful describing my flight.. four quality beers, my favorite of which was their Mystic Renaud Saison, best Saison I can ever remember having.. grab it if it's still there. definitely check this place out. I will swing back through for

I have been coming to Bondurants since pretty close to their opening day. Their craft beer selection is superb, and ever changing. It's rare to go back and see the same things more then once. The whiskey selection is equally as impressive and whenever I order an Old Fashion, I watch the bartender use fresh orange and ingredients. The food is awesome - I think i've tried everything on the menu at this point and have yet to be let down and have eaten brunch, lunch, dinner and late night here. The staff is also extremely knowledgable, friendly and helpful. I also really enjoy the atmosphere, from the hidden TVs that only come out for big sports events to the music to the gorgeous wood bar.

Opa has a beautiful ambiance, both inside and outside. The food is always excellent and consistent each and every time I go. Not sure why a few who commented below said that they thought it wasn't authentic Greek food. I'm 100% Greek and you're absolutely right... At least half of the items on the list aren't technically considered "traditional", and that's completely fine with me! Opa takes traditional Greek food and almost modernizes it and puts a slight twist on it. It's contemporary, and that's what Opa reflects. I love their pastichio, spinach croquettes, Tiropitas, chicken, and pretty much all of their desserts. Plus the servers, especially Jesse,  are SO nice and welcoming . It's a nice touch and aside from the delicious food, they make me want to come back ! And the best part is that they give complementary Ouzo shots at the end of your meal! Definitely go to Opa and enjoy their amazing food, drinks and service! It's affordable for the city!

I'm obsessed with Mexican food and I love that this place is right around the corner! Their margaritas are delicious and I'm a huge fan of the chorizo and potato tacos! I like their various sauces too. Great place for a group of friends.

Got the World Travel cheese plate and 3 of the family portion vegetable dishes to split with 5 other friends, and a half portion of gnocchi for myself - all delicious and very filling, and the complimentary brioche was amazing. Staff are great - very knowledgeable about the different dishes and cheeses - and the restaurant is beautiful! Good place to eat if you're willing to spend some money on quality and you're guaranteed to be full by the end!

We stopped here driving through town. Ordered 2 pepsi's which were flat and gross.   Didn't bother sending back as the table next to us had the same issue and it was just re-poured. Fries were very good, chicken fingers were decent, buffalo chicken wrap had too much dressing. Bartender was extremely nice and friendly.   I'm guessing they don't get a lot of orders for Pepsi so it was old.

I love this restaurant. Whenever we go, we always have great food, but what makes a huge difference and sets this restaurant apart from others is the excellent service. The servers are incredibly knowledgeable about their food, wine and cocktails. They are enjoyable to talk to, and always know just the right amount of attention to give. It's a very romantic restaurant for a date.
New place and you can tell.  Clean and food was extremely fresh.  Recommended for that quick laid back meal.

Last night we arrived 90 minutes before the play we were planning to see started.  Surely a party arriving at 6 pm has plenty if time to make a 7:30 pm curtain across the street!  We immediately advised our sever that we needed to leave by 7:15 pm or shortly later. The three small dish starters we ordered arrived quickly.  So we began the evening sensing that they were too hurried in their service.  That said, the beef tartare and chicken livers starters were excellent and we recommend them.  The carrot starter has gotten a lot of praise from other reviewers, but we thought it was at best okay. We ordered the chicken entree but questioned the $31 price tag.  Excellent chicken dishes at some our favorite places like Fond, Nord, and Ulivo are normally prices in the much lower zone of $15 to $25.  The waitress explained it was a large portion that could be shared so we gave it a shot. At 10 to 7 we were waiting patiently and I reminded the server we needed to leave in about 30 minutes.  Regrettably the chicken arrived but very late, at around 7:10 pm.  The manager expressed his deep regrets and agreed to take the charge off our bill.  If he is reading this, when inevitably this occurs again, I suggest you go further than the obvious.  How about an offer to waive the bar charge for our two drinks, or a free entree if we come back? It would have been a nice gesture and may have given us cause to consider trying you place a second time. Jim Macdonald

I love everything about this place!  It's attractive, warm, the service is excellent, the menu is varied and supplemented with specials, and the food is beautifully presented, excellent in taste and generous in portions.  Even the parking is easy!  Why it's taken me so long to find it is a mystery!  Enjoy.

Sheep's Milk Ricotta/Truffle Honey/Burnt Orange Toast. Poached Organic Farm Eggs. Garlic Potatoes. Smoked Bacon. Hazelnut Crusted French Toast/Sour Cherries/Mint. Whole Grain Waffle/Roasted Apples/Walnuts/Marsala Cream. OMG!!! Absolutely Delicious! Beautiful Restaurant! Love the location as well.

Tried Super spicy msala dosa and along with nice coconut chutney.. they made it exactly as I wanted ( I love bit spicy food)...Also  loved Vada and sambar .. these guys mastered these and I always fall for these delicacies .... Fast services and great atmosphere !!!! loved it !!!  I would recommend it !!!!

My wife and I split the lobster roll and fish and chips.  Definitely the best lobster roll we have had, the fish was also perfectly done.  Great snack after a hard move in day at UVM AND at Champlain College.  Thank you!
Food is very good. Everybody is smiling and accomodating. Our server is attentive. The place is cozy.

Good food, terrible service. I order takeout from here about every other week or so. Whenever I order wraps, they come out completely wrong! I've had to drive back to the restaurant at least 4 or 5 times to correct the order. The wraps were not even comped when I returned. I keep coming back because the food is very good, but if the service stays consistently bad, they will lose a customer. Always check your order before you leave the restaurant when ordering takeout!
Love this place to brunch! ++ for the deco

This place really sucks. The hookah is expensive with really cheap coal that makes more ash than Ashy Larry. I came here with my girlfriend and ordered two seafood plates. Both plates were bland and undercooked. Our server was slow, unmotivated and not very interested in serving us. The price is outrageous for the quality of food. NEVER coming here again. You're better off crossing the street and going to Nori 2 or down the block to Cuban Petes. Two crappy plates, 1 ashy hookah, no drinks = $92. SERIOUSLY?!? NEVER AGAIN!

My son and I have been coming here for years and love it!  The food is consistently good.  Tonight we had Szechuan dumplings, chicken pad thai and curry thai with tofu-all very good.  The veggies are always fresh.  Also, it's a nice looking restaurant-copper top tables, homey wooden flooring.  Try it!  You'll like it!

I cannot say enough good things about Chapter One.  This was honestly one of the best meals I've had - it's impossible to identify favorites because everything was so good! I was with a group and so we ordered many dishes to share - for apps we got the octopus, beef tartare, smoked trout salad, and fried okra. for mains we split the ribs, sirloin steak (with incredible horseradish fingerlings), and the duck confit which blew my mind.  we tried all three of the desserts which were equally impressive.  I can't wait to come back and try out their bar specials - last night they were serving house-made duck sausage! their selection of bourbon, whiskey, rye, and scotch is pretty hard to beat. the chef came out to great us and obviously takes great care in the food they serve. it shows in the final product. bravo chapter one!

The people that own this place treat customers like friends n family. They make me want to bring my family here but I live a distance away and I might just have to ! The chicken was delicious! Italian owners and they know how to season the food! As long as I'm working out here I'll be here for lunch once a week!
I had my first true Philly cheesesteak and decided to buy one from Pat's and Geno's and I have to say that Pat's was better- sorry Geno's.

Delicious and flavorful. It took us a bit to be seated but it was alright, because the customer service was amazing. Having willing waiters being avaiable to take a picture of your table and to actually joke around with is actually amazing. I got the karakamen ramen (flavorful and amazing noodle texture) with the recommended toppings. Next time I hope to get the $4.00 more bonus of rice and salad. Yum! Shoutout to John John for the amazing customer service! Salamat!

I try to eat healthy.  I especially try to avoid fried foods.  Sometimes, however you have to do what you have to do.  If you're in the mood, after a night out this place most definitely did the trick.  I highly recommend if you're having one of those nights ;)

To start off my curiosity, I had been watching a PBS series called The Mind of a Chef.  Anthony Bourdain narrates the journey of Chef David Chang and how he is so innovative with food.  The series is on Netflix and there is one episode called "NOODLES".   I probably would not have noticed this place if I had not been watching that show, but it just kind of popped up on my radar. I didn't know that Ramen was anything more than the stiff little squares you find in the grocery store. It was fun to experience and I will definitely go back next time I am in Philly. After watching the show all about different Asian inspirations on the ramen noodle, I had to try this place.  I had the ramen with pork ($10.00) and my daughter had the Chicken Miso.($12.00)  We also shared the "Eye of the Tiger" sushi roll ($12.00).  WOW! Everything was great!  I had plenty of noodles, meat,mushrooms, and other chopped up foods to eat. My daughter could not finish her ramen bowl( and thus disgraced our family), so  our waitress was kind enough to put her leftovers in a to go box.   The atmosphere was upbeat, trendy, and you can watch the chefs preparing food at the bar/counter.
I had the shrimp and crabmeat special and it was the best Mexican food I have ever had! Hands down. It was fresh and extremely flavorful
Menu is overwhelming, confusing. Price seems high to me. $13 for salad and iced tea. Small portions but that's probably for your health. Food was excellent tasting though.

Food was amazing and the owners really love what they do and love to have fun with their guests. Had the proscuitto for the app, the rack of lamb and husband had the salmon wrapped with zucchini as the main, dessert was creme brulee and flour less chocolate cake. Just..I mean come on! Amazing!!!!!!
Awesome food.  Great portions.  Old school nice hospitality. Definitely drive as it is in a sort of sketchy area.

Back over on someone else's nickel. This visit Italian combo,  meatball parmigiano,  small coleslaw. Wifey and I shared the coleslaw as we drove. Very toasty. Sandwiches will have to wait till we get back to Jersey. Can't wait.

My boyfriend and I were looking for some late night sushi and this was the place.  We phoned in an order for pickup about 40 minutes before closing and picked it up 20 minutes later.  It wasn't until after we got home and settled, and that they were now closed, that we realized they swapped out an order of eel sashimi for a California roll and we we're still charged for the former- I was really looking forward to that eel... I know we were one of the last orders of the night, and I know restaurants run out of things and that's perfectly fine.  We might try coming here again in the future, but it's just a bummer that this was my first impression experience with this restaurant.

One of the best things about NYC are the random unexpected neighborhood finds. This is one. My family of 3 checked out the window menu, were intrigued and enjoyed a nice, light Fri night meal. Particularly liked the chilled corn soup with creme fraiche and a special, fried green tomatoes. Comfortable, casual bar. Friendly service. Worth a stop!

I love everything about this place, from the $5 sangria at happy hour, to the bacon salted tater tots and even a bacon kale salad. The service was exceptional, my water refilled several times without me noticing!

This has become a regular for me. The selection of food is great and does have a good selection of vegetarian/vegan food which is delicious for this carnivorous :P. They have a great drink selection and their fried pickles are the best I have had ever. The staff is great. They even box up our food for us (which I find is rare in this day in age). They do give you a lot of food, I'm always taking a lot home with me. And I like how they incorporate polish food into their menu, which is a nice touch since the neighborhood used to be a polish neighborhood and there are still a lot of polish delis around. Their beer garden is great. They have a nice selection of crazy hot dogs, all of which are amazing. Everyone I take there is impressed by their food.
These people need to buy a bloody wine cooler, buy a bottle of red and it's above room temperature, more like warm and gross.
Wow, this is incredibly good! I ordered classic burger and chicken taco, they were awesome.
Atmosphere and the view of their roof top is good but the food is not that good!

Hip City Veg is my FAVORITE place to eat in University City. (And that's saying a lot, because I can't imagine myself giving up my meat.) I usually order the Ziggy burger, which tastes almost exactly like In n Out, but the udon noodle salad is delicious as well. Actually, forget what I said earlier. EVERYTHING ON THE MENU IS FREAKING YUMMY!!!!! You don't have to be a vegan to enjoy this restaurant.
This place is Fantastic!!!!! The wings are amazing, solid ribs and the brisket is to die for. Great atmosphere!

Vibe- stale college bar Greeting- barely Parking- street Bathroom- fail Service- slow Wine list- some good buys. Minimum choices Food Fried burger $15 original style is very delicious. About 10oz. Good beef taste and fried dough bun is a happy enclosure Fried spatzel is very hard on your teeth. I did not enjoy Beet coulis, ketchup and hot sauce are all homemade WIGB? Yes Four stars for burger only.
Walking up to this pizzeria  a couple told my family and I "This is freaking amazing pizza!" And his statement is very true! It was freaking amazing! Nuff said
Don't do it.  They shrimp rolls are full of oil.  They don't drain the rolls.  The food has NO flavor poor poor service
Outstandingly delicious beet lakte on greens topped with poached egg partnered with a beet-infused gin martini.  Holy moly this was great.  Bar service is 100% all the time.

The empanadas are really good and they give  you a variety of flavors to chose from and the empanadas are really flavor full. They have outdoor seating but not that much. And it is pretty cramped in their
Service is horrible ... Took my order and told us 20 minutes later that the chef isn't there and was maybe coming in ten minutes ... This review is not about food, it's about service

This place is delightful. I went for the first time today and the owner Morat (sp??) was so kind and knowledgable! He even let me stay and drink my coffee past the time he was supposed to be closed and not only didn't kick me out but gave me a free croissant! I will absolutely be back often! I look forward to trying their specialty of organic ice cream with a shot of espresso ;)
Absolutely delicious! The sandwiches are to die for! Especially the pulled pork and the grilled cheese. Very friendly owners.

HJ house offer bad sushi and service. I've been there few times, but their food and service are as bad as always. I don't even want to tip them. I had a cucumber salad this time, it's only few pieces of cucumber and tomatoes with some weird sauce. Their sushi I had in this places are bad too. Rice is supposed to be the most important part of sushi, but their rice is too sticky. And the raw fish they use are not fresh, at all. I don't recommend this place!

Typical of what a LOT of Williamsburg restaurants are. Overhyped, overpriced, decor-oriented, and very sub-par food. I'm going to cut to the chase. The Scotch egg was a good starter at a good price. The artichoke appy was a tiny serving for an entree price, and not worth it. The entrees that my girlfriend and I had were the Halibut and Lamb Kebab. Halibut...expensive and dry. Lamb...DID NOT TASTE LIKE LAMB. I couldn't identify what taste it was, so I sent it back and ordered the pork belly instead. Pork belly is supposed to be somewhat fatty...yes, but it's not supposed to be 95% fat and a smidgen of meat. Tried the desserts....MEH. If you have money to burn, and just want nice ambience, then this is your place. If you want good food, to go with nice ambience, there are PLENTY of better places than RYE.

My restauranteur friend says negative yelp reviews suck, since no one tells them in person. She said leave 10% and talk to the manager. So I did, but the manager's response was worse than the service that I received, so I have to write this. To sum: Sat outside, 15 minutes to order, beer order was messed up, after I got my food she never came back , water ran dry. After a long time, I had to give my credit card to the host, since my waitress was MIA. All SHE came back with was the charge slip, no bill, so I have NO idea what I paid for. I talked to the manager. Her response:   "I'm sorry, I hope that doesn't deter you from coming back."  Awkward silence. Um, it  does deter me, that's why I'm coming to you. I'm not sure what I was expecting but something different. "Oh she messed up your beer order? Your next one is on is."  Something. A pulse. An eye twitch....
the vodka sauce on the the pasta  was very good  and i liked so much  and i also liked pesto sauce too
Excellence! Just perfection!

A small and weird Japanese restaurant. Food is good, I like their Japanese curry. It's not spicy at all, and I feel very full after eating that. You can even enjoy the beautiful scenery of Champlain lake while you are eating!
Spinach Omelets are great anytime but don't pass on the special salads with fresh hand carved turkey or the hand made cheeseburgers cooked to order, no frozen patties here!
Every time I'm in the city, I make sure I come here at least once. The food is filling and delicious. And the atmosphere pleasant. Highly recommend coming here!

Yummy food. Big portions. Vaca Frita is always good but a little chewy. Love BYOB. Service can use some work. I say outside last night with one friend (no one else was outside) and the owner, bus boy and waiter kept rushing us to pay the check. What the hell? It's not like the place was closing because people were still eating inside. We weren't even there for very long at all. Chill out.

My boyfriend's friend wanted to celebrate his birthday here and had made reservations for several people, but when we arrived, they said our party was too large and that the hostess taking the reservation was new as they didn't take reservations of our size and past a certain time. Well, no worries, I understand that people make mistakes first time on the job, and we ended up getting seated anyways. I made the mistake of ordering the veggie burger with yuca fries and got horrible food poisoning later that night that confined me to a bed for a week. No thanks. Won't be back.
Pizza was good beans with burnt ends where us the meat. Service was okay salmon cake special so so . All in all not impressed

The food was excellent. I especially loved the pesto pasta, the impossibly moist roast chicken--I normally find chicken excruciatingly boring, and the crazy bold chocolate pudding. DELICIOUS. The sweet potatoes are cooked perfectly and spiced very well. The eggs were perfectly cooked and the bun was divine. The atmosphere is lovely and the food was outstanding. The ambiance is warm and inviting and the staff is friendly and helpful.
No good.  Soggy and oily pizza.  Did not like it at all.  The middle of the pizza was like a chunk of cheese.  The cheese was not good quality.

I think it was good. The place is nice, cool music not very loud, so you can have a conversation while having dinner. The food was great. We had the green curry and it was very nice. The mussels were just ok

I'm only reviewing based on the sandwich and rotisserie counter at eataly.   Went for the first time this week at around dinner time,  big mistake,  could barely walk in there so I decided to leave and come back at a less busy time.   I came back two days later around 1130 am and walked directly in back to the rotisserie counter where I ordered the prime rib sandwich and a whole rotisserie chicken.  There was still a small line but it moves quickly.  They were def worth the wait, both were delicious,  well seasoned,  and juicy / moist.   I plan on going back for both.

The sign outside said something like "$1 for the freshest slice in Philadelphia!" My slice was undercooked and had probably been sitting out for at least two hours. When I'd rather walk a few blocks and spend my $1 at Wendy's, you're not doing pizza right.
Nice space, fairly quiet in the off hours. Snarky service turned me off to the experience.

Not worth the money, I ordered a full order of ribs which should be a full rack-15 pieces. Received my order, I have 8 half pieces of rib not a full strip of rib a half strip- what a waste!!! Called to ask for the other half of my order and was told that is what 25 bucks get me half a rack. They just lost a customer!!!!!

Went back today with my boyfriend! He got the shrimp and grits and I got the jambalaya with the biscuits with sausage gravy....my boyfriend loves the biscuits.
