My jambalaya was nice and spicy and filled with shrimp and chicken, they definitely wasn't cheap with that. We didn't even break $50. Our server was super funny and very nice!! Definitely a permanent spot for me I'M SOLD!!!

I went for the first time and was expecting a great time. How many times we waited, and waited for the waitress to get refills of the drinks (I almost became so frustrated that I was tempted to do it myself). Some of the meal was WAY overcooked. My burger was supposed to be "pink inside" but is was cooked too much. We're out of water again! We were to get a free desert due to some spilled water earlier. Great! We all picked out a desert but when the waitress came to take the order she took ONE desert order and left. As I was leaving I went to the hostess area. I mentioned that they will not be seeing me again. I stated that the experience left a lot to be desired (i used more colorful language) and that I won'r return. What did she do? Call the manager? Nope! She did NOTHING! Poor wait staff and lousy service. The worst part is that THEY DON'T CARE! I'll spend my money elsewhere. Never again at Plan B.

I have been to Michael's many times in the past 10 years. Michael and his wife Marilyn couldn't be more Pleasant and accommodating! Tonight My wife had Eggplant Parmesan ,she claims it's the best she ever had ! I had Veal Marsala and it was well prepared,tender and very tasty ! It seems that Michael does quite a catering business, So if you going there on Saturday night the parking lot may seem very crowded but there are usually tables open in the dining room ! Our company has had several company functions here and everyone  raved about the food ! My biggest problem with Michaels is that the portions are too large and I prefer not to bring home food from a restaurant because it always sits in the fridge and goes bad . However, my wife doesn't have any problem with that. Given the huge selection of Italian restaurants in North Jersey I consider Michael's to be one of the best !!

It's a small space so the wait to get in might not be pleasant for you. I'll admit, the presentation is all really great. Especially the diy ice tea! Which is 5 dollars, so I guess it's fine if you're a spender, but I'm on a student budget! Pretty mediocre tho, didn't really meet up to my expectations. The food is as basic as can be and not as flavor filled as other Thai places I've been. Still never bad to try new places though! A one time visit definitely. 3 stars for the cool presentation.

A few years ago, this place was recommend to me by a friend of a friend.  Me, my brother, and a friend went here on a day-trip to NYC.  It was a very good experience.  Food was delicious, staff friendly, service good-paced.  If you are in Manhattan and are looking at reviews to find a good place, and you just can't decide, then go here and check it out.  The atmosphere is lively and fun.  It can be a bit loud, but AHH c'mon IT IS Neyork ahight! ? :) It's a fun place to eat and socialize when you may be annoyed or feel cramped in other places nearby.  Haven't been to NYC in a few years, but was thinking about NYC tonight and had to write this... next time I visit, of course I will stop in there again.
Very prompt service,  and delicious food.I made my first order from this restaurant finding it through seamless which is another website.   Food is great cone with just enough to get one person full.

I'd like to give this place more stars for the food, because I really enjoyed it - once we finally received it. We didn't have reservations but the host condescendingly informed us we could sit at the tiny hallway bar, because they didn't have tables open. I'd have no problem with this, if not for the fact that the entire time we were there (and it was a WHILE) more than 50% of their tables remained empty. I read another review in which the person felt they were treated like 2nd class citizens; that's exactly how it felt to us, too. Despite being stuck in steerage, we remained optimistic after hearing such rave reviews. Unfortunately, once you're tagged and branded as chattel, you're SOL at this place. No less than four bartenders ran back and forth in front of us and we weren't able to even order our drinks for another 15-20 min. Then it was probably half an hour until we received them. The food ordering and receiving probably took another 45 min. Food: pancakes with lemon curd were delicious, and the cucumber cocktail was very good. But the service and treatment put such a damper on the whole experience that we probably won't be going back.

The place is very small with barely anyplace to sit. The food selection is sparse. The scone was okay, but was not bursting with flavor like I had expected. The coffee is delicious though and the baristas are nice, which makes this place get another star.The atmosphere is chill. It's great to have a place you would expect to see in Brooklyn or the village right here in midtown.

THE WORST FUCKING SERVICE  EVER.  Where do I begin. When I came in to the place and tried to seat at the bar with my date I was told to get up and some other girl is in charge of seating. After I stood next to the guy for 5min literally and he looked the other way I figured I was on my own. Then I went to the bar while I was waiting and asked for a drink. I was flat out told no. At least a waiter named Dave took pity on us and got us drinks. Thank you Dave.  Then we sat down 26min for a steak tartear that tasted like nothing. Hey boys if ur gonna do a isi canister foam u have to over salt the mix. After the waiter took the order for lamb tartare and came back and said we're out. It's called 86'ing it and then I should be offered a free drink. Then wrong dish came with it.  First we asked for flights and then it was the wrong order.  And lastly the third flight 17 min. R u fucking kidding me.   THE only reason I didnt  raise a problem was because I was on a first date.if a restaurant can get cancer I hope u do. Where were ur managers on the floor. U left it up to waiters and bartenders who don't give a fuck about ur place to make ur money.

Everything was amazing. We enjoyed delicious cocktails, great company, and outstanding food. Staff was very friendly and service was good.  The fish and chips were a bit deep fried for my liking, but tasted really good. The brunch is incredible with ample portions, especially for the price. Not a bad thing on the menu!
I don't think this place is all that great. Food was okay, not what it used to be. I don't know if it was because it was busy, but my experience was just meh. Rather go somewhere else for fusion.

I'm just overly thrilled with the entire transcendence at Tria. I had cheeses that Julius Caesar would love, and wines that Napoleon would bathe in. I had the best waitresses (yes, so many!) Sarah, Becky, Maggie, Chelsey, and Ariel were all little angels working in a wine bar. I hope one day you all have the chance to imbibe and be merry at Tria. Oh! One more thing: Truffle Egg Toast.
It used to be good The food is decent but the service went to hell  arrogant, low class thugs now serve you Very disappointed long time customer Mike T

I was sitting in heaven. Peach sangria, caramel bread pudding, live music and a sense of community. Vibrant artwork all over. Delicious, varied menu. I already reserved three seats for a live show + dinner next week.
Its a delicious food ever I test it in an indian restaurant in nutley, n it's very close to us,it's good

Sometimes it's a nice feeling to go back to a place that has never changed. I used to come here all the time growing up, I later moved away. Every once in a while I get to stop by and visit this gem. I usually order the chicken Caesar wrap or a Rueben and usually a milk shake. And they still give away the tricolor lollipops that I use to have as a kid. Although it's probably nothing special to any new comers and the staff consists of your typical Jersey waitresses, it's just nice to come back to something that has not changed, that's why I tend to give it that one extra star.

Excellent food, some middle eastern reminiscent flavors(lamb appetizers) service lagging behind, our waiter was too busy to serve us, runners are good though hostess greeting us nice but quite visibly missing front teeth! Altogether great food that's enough for me to go back, yet more attention to details is needed.
Delicious and friendly!

Terrible service.  Took 15 minutes to get water. It was almost 40 minutes to get my food. Other people who sat down after me received their  food ahead of me.  When my food came out it wasn't very warm and my side of fruit was puny,
The food was delicious. But the service was dissapointing, the hostess took 15 minutes to bring the menu to us, the waitress seemed annoyed of her job.
Food is delicious! Portions are big so you can definitely share an entree with an app or two. Will be coming back for some of that fresh seafood.

This place has a beautiful website and largely rave reviews.  The service is friendly enough.  But the rest of it was thoroughly unimpressive.  I went with a friend and we each ordered the Animal Burger.  He ordered medium rare, I ordered medium well with a tomato. The 6 oz size attracted both of us.  Unfortunately, our burgers were squished flat and stuck out in a ring around the bun.  Like an oversized veggie burger.  A burger that thin cannot possibly be cooked properly - there should be a nice caramelized scorch and wonderful juicy fat drippings inside. I don't understand the attraction of having to eat a bite of flat overcooked, under-browned meat before you can get to the cheese and bun.  Further, for $13 dollars, I expect a plate.  Not some kitchy quarter pan, with my slaw in a paper state fair "bowl." Overcharging me for some mediocre food and then trying to make me feel casual (or whatever the aim is) by providing a midwestern picnic feel is dumb.  If that burger cost me $4 or $5, fine.  But for $13, I want to be treated like an adult, eating at a restaurant. Which is what I'm doing. If I wanted a fast food experience, or a picnic, I'd go do that and spend half as much. A free cake at the end doesn't do it.  I'm happy to pay for dessert when I want it. The beer was mildly flat as well.  Probably would try one of the many other restaurants around here before giving a different menu item a go.

Came here for lunch around 2:00 p.m.  I came with my girlfriend and we were the only two sitting down in the dining area.  The food was decent, however it took around 45 minutes for the food to come out, which in my opinion is wayyyyy too long for only 2 guests.  I would give it 3 stars had the food come out in a reasonable time.
Bartender couldn't pour a proper Guinness.

The menu here is simple and had a lot of southern variety. The Fried green tomatoes were fried perfectly. The mac and cheese was super creamy and cheesy. The main highlight is definitely the chicken and waffles. The chicken was fried just right and the waffles were hearty (buckwheat waffles). The blueberry toppings on the waffles along with the cinnamon butter was just enough sweetn3ss to balance out the meal. For drinks I would get the jollyrancher a watermelon and white wine agua fresca mix that was super refreshing. I will be back to try the desserts, the food was so filling to have them the same day!

We are frequent visitors at the First and Last Bakery and have never had anything but excellent food and service over the past 7 years. Management and staff provide a friendly, almost family-like environment which makes us appreciate the food even more. The menu includes not only delicious baked goods but also panini sandwiches, omelettes, French toast and pancakes , a variety of fresh coffee and even more items..

This place started out great but has been going downhill since. The food is pretty good even if the prices are a bit high. When the owner is in the shop things run mostly well. It hasn't been the case when he's not been there. Like others have said, the waiting times can be brutal. The last time I went it was so bad that I walked out. There was one person placing a huge order that was taking forever and backing things up. She has every right to order as much as she wants but you would think that one of the other employees could have stepped up to help move things along. As for the lack of cleanliness others have mentioned, I've noticed that too. There are plenty of flies around and you can see things getting a bit dirty. If a cluster of flies is near the food containers that's not a good thing. Like I said earlier, this place started out great, but they are slipping quickly now. I hope they get their act together and get back on track soon.
Love the mozzarella boss. Always have great food and great service.  Everyone is very helpful and accommodating. Thank you for your wonderful service food and staff

This is a great place to grab lunch if you are looking for healthy options. The lunch special for $8.95 included an entrée, miso soup and a drink. I tried the Bibimbap with brown rice, your choice of assorted fresh veggies, tofu and the soy lemon sauce. All items except the sauce are added to your bowl and brought to the kitchen to be quickly cooked. Sauce is added at the end right before it's all packed up for you. The veggies were very fresh as was the rice, and the tofu was crispy on the outside and meltingly soft on the inside. The soup was good but a little plain with no bits of tofu in it (the way I like it). Just broth and miso with some flecks of green floating around. I tried the steamed vegetable dumplings that were okay. The soy lemon dipping sauce was the star for those little packages! I asked for kimchi, and that was so very good, not spicy, but packed with flavor. You must ask for it though, it's not on the menu but they give it out gladly for the asking, and it's house made. I wished I could buy a larger container of it! The staff are very friendly, knowledgeable about the food, and seem to really want to make the customers happy. I'll definitely be back!
Great food, great service and an amazing view! Would definitely return and recommend to all my friends!

Terrible....  Wanted to try this place for a while and failed to get seated twice.  On the second attempt, we put our names down at 7pm for a table for three and were told an hour wait.  We called after an hour and were told they had some people taking a while to pay.  At 9pm, we walked back to check on things and were told they were "close" and they just had a 4 top, 5 top, an 8 top and a 6 top ahead of us.  My boyfriend noted they only have 24 seats in the entire place.  They then admitted they didn't know how long it would be.  We also saw they had seated people listed after us on the reservation list.   I have lived in New York for 8 years and enjoyed or endured the restaurant scene.  I have learned to have patience for good food at a well run establishment.  No fried chicken is worth this.  I wouldn't be surprised if they respond to this with another BS explanation for what happened.  This is my first review.

Let me start off by saying this is a great edition to Center City  Philadelphia, located right on jewelers row. I stopped in here for lunch one day and was greeted by the waiter who was very warm and kind I was given the option to any open table to sit at. I ordered the lamb kabob very flavorful tender juicy with a side of salad and brown rice all a delicious package.  I was greeted by the chef herself straight from Afghanistan so you know the food is authentic, she asked how my food was and if I needed anything else. The entire layout is very nice and clean, offering pick up and delivery . And all menu items are no higher than $19. Which I find very affordable, if your in the area please give this restaurant a try, you won't be disappointed.  :)

Service was good. Some of the food was very good but some was simply not good. Steak was disgustedly fatty , slaw wasn't good... Overall way overpriced, tiny portions, and felt like these folks were trying too hard to be trendy without success.
Crunchy Tai chicken wrap is my fave! Oh and the 2 kir royale w/chambord that comes with the brunch is a PLUS!
Amazing Ramen! Awesome service! Just had their short rib special Ramen and I am beyond satisfied or content. Leaving with a happy belly! They also gave us an app on the house to try!

The atmosphere was good, the staff was good, and the food was either done technically well and sometimes clever and creative.  I had the avocado sandwich, a pizza (I can't remember the name), and beet salad to share between three people.  All great.

I would give it a half star if I could. Once again horrible service. First time they got my order wrong and gave it to someone else. Today I pre ordered a sandwich and home fries, went to get it half hour later and walk into chaos and then to wait after I gave my name with no food in sight. Last time I try these guys.

I wish I had more stars to give but this place was great !! The service was extremely in and attentive and the Decore is cool ... I would recommend the soup dumplings and the fried beef. I would def return !!!
Absolutely love this place! The food is always amazing - I always get the shrimp in white wine sauce. Rodizio is also a good choice. Passion fruit sangria is also great!!

This place is still good after all these years. Order the spaghetti beeps and savoy. Top notch. Been going for over 30 years. I like that the decor is from the 60's-70's. All about the ambiance.  I do miss the phone booth.

Well, I've been here twice. Once was during lunch hours and everything was alright. Not bad, but not like "OMG, where has BR been all my life?". The second time I apparently made the mistake of dressing too "casual", if you will. It's Springfield, I'm not dressing to the hilt for a steak dinner...in Springfield. Walking in with a friend, we were ignored for awhile while other (better dressed, I guess) guests were taken to their tables right way. When I finally got to a table, I sat for a good 15 minutes watching some folks who came in well after we did, enjoy their drinks and appetizers. By the time I got my meal, the other folks were receiving their bill. Not to mention, they were treated much better than my friend and I. While our waitress wasn't rude, she talked to me as if this was my first time in a restaurant. I didn't like that so much. Moral of the story is, just because I'm wearing a Burton sweatshirt and jeans out to dinner doesn't mean I'm poor, uneducated or not willing to leave a great tip when provided with good service. How you're treated can make or break your dinning experience! In fact, good service and hospitality can also make up for a not so great meal. But, I don't dress up for dinner, what could I possible know about fine dinning experiences?

This is one of our favorite brunch places. They don't take reservations but its definitely worth the wait. My husband loves the Bloody Mary- it comes with a slice of bacon and a hard boiled egg. The service is friendly and the the food is very good.

After years of reading amazing reviews, I finally got a chance to go to Fork with work colleagues on June 24. I was extremely disappointed due to the following issues: 1) Air conditioning was NOT working, it was extremely hot, 2) waiter staff was snobby and inattentive, 3) dinner for 6 from the $70 price fixe dinner menu took over 3.5 hours from the time it took to serve us water to the time we received the check, and 4) the food was a good quality but a lot of the food was salty, portions were very, very, very small, the free food fillers in between consisted mostly of bread products to ensure that you did not leave hungry. I have food sensitivity and experienced allergic reactions to my dinner last night which tells me that there were 1) too many sulfites in the wine which was probably domestic wine disguised as French on the menu and/or 2) preservatives used in the food. Please note that I only had 2 glasses of wine over a 3.5 hour period and all the rest of my dining party had only one glass of wine. The bill per person was $115. I don't mind spending $$$ for a great dinner but this restaurant did not live up to my expectations for one of the top rated restaurants in the Phila area. And I do consider myself a food snob!

The best place for my breakfast and Brunch is Red Eye Cafe  . I love their accurate spice in foods. My best ever salty dish is Chicken Potpie with delicious puff pastry. I mostly love to try their variety of pancakes and last time I tried sweet potato pancakes. Each and individual part of this cake was incredible. I use to eat pancake from here and try to make at the home. My mom likes my pancake but I couldn't get the exact taste of it.. Mostly my friends and me visit the same place for our breakfast or Brunch and recommend everyone to take one visit of this place and must try pancake's variety of this place. You'll love it. Thumbs Up Red Eye Cafe!!!!

Their service sucks!!! The burgers were the equivalent to a Wendys burger. The only reason im giving this place 2 stars is because their truffle fries are amazing and the buffalo fries were also good. Too bad the service sucks so bad that I won't be back. 2 burger combos were $27. Sticking to Bobby Flays in University City.
good, tasty, and classic pizza. I am a fan indeed as yelp so perfectly puts.

DELICIOUS. this is the real deal right there. fantastic pizza, great service and amazing experience overall. I will definitely go back. I had the marguerita pizza which was really really good and my girlfriend enjoyed as well. I cant wait to come back.

Went to North End Bistro in Princeton for the first time today. Probably an atypically slow Saturday night but no bother...good for those of us there.  Atmosphere, service and food was excellent.  I had the Saturday night special (Pork Osso Bucco) and my wife had one of their Mac & Cheese entrees (turkey & bacon).  Both meals were well prepared, very tasty with quite large serving sizes (2 doggie bags to go, please)! Our server (Kelly) was top shelf and the manager (Kenny) stopped by several times to check in on (very pleasant as well).  And since it's a BYO (tho they offer a small selection of local wines - we got the cab. and it was quite good but I also brought a few beers) the total price of the check was quite "reasonable".   We'll be back again!
The place is not that big, they offer the usual. I think we tried oyster, and a couple of others, food was very fresh and good service.
I guess it's a decent bagel place if you like children's sized bagels and wet cream cheese...

If you got a sushi craving and need a simple fix, Mr. Sushi is for you.  I've been eating here for a few years now. and I STILL keep coming back for more. They do offer AYCE, but their lunch special of any 2 rolls for $6.95 or any 3 rolls for $9.25 is enough for me. (From opening until 3pm) The rolls on their selection list for the is the usual generic rolls, but the GEM is their spicy salmon roll.  This roll alone is enough to keep me coming back.     You can taste the salmon because their sauce isn't too spicy. But most importantly, you can feel the velvety salmon texture because they don't chop up the fish like other restaurants. My usual order is 2 rolls of spicy salmon and 1 shrimp tempura.   Although the service may be a bit on the slow side, the workers are all really nice.  So please give this place a chance and try :)
Best Breakfast Ever--- from my 15 y/o daughter after having her first Tosilog and I second that. Will definitely be back again on our next visit to NY.

Really nice place. One of our faves in the neighborhood. The long waits at the weekend are a testament to how good it is. The cappuccinos are delicious and so are the croque monsieurs. Service is always quick and efficient.

I do not understand the haters who troll on sites like this and bring down establishments like the Ice House. The location is fantastic on the shore of  beautiful Lake Champlain.  Keeley, our server, was very professional, attentive, courteous, efficient and funny. Our food was served on time, was delicious and the view is unbeatable in Burlington. We starters with crab and shrimp spring rolls and guacamole and both were good. For our entrees, I had the Cod and Lobster chowder. My wife enjoyed her Atlantic salmon very much even with her special order to swap out one side dish for another.  No problem. My daughter ordered the sirloin steak cooked to a perfect medium rare as she asked.  We enjoyed a nice bottle of Ferrari Carrano Fume Blanc which paired well with our seafood and priced very well. Then  for desert we tried their hot cheesecake and their signature ice cream Sunday. Both were Yummy. It was a wonderful meal.   Again ask for Keely. You won't be disappointed.   We are from Chicago and know good  restaurant service and food.  You don't stay in business this long if you are not good at what you do. Haters can stay away.   We will be back!

I walked in here thinking I would see the cooks preparing the salads and sandwiches right in front of my eyes but I was sadly mistaken... I didn't think the salads were ready-made and for almost $10, the kale superfood salad was a little overpriced but it was delicious. The roasted sweet potatoes (as many of you have commented) are indeed AMAZING. The lemon tahini dressing was light yet flavourful and the chickpeas and quinoa (though bland and small) were nice additions. Since I'm pescatarian, not vegan, I had to eat my salad alongside some real eggs because it wasn't enough. Next time I'm there, I'll have to try the smoothies because they look fantastic! If you're looking for a quick lunch, definitely go grab a salad to eat along with something else.

Ok i will go directly to the point: chicken in bun...just order 2 orders and you will be happy for the night..SO GOOD. the restaurant is beautiful, service is fantastic and the food is really worth the hype. I've been to the east village location and this one is much more fancy and clean. Cant wait to go back again.

This was my first time at this establishment and I honestly enjoyed it; the casual vibe made it easy to relax. This place is definitely small but that adds an extra touch of intimacy. I recommend the croissant french toast!! The only downside would be that they only accept cash but there is an atm in the restaurant.
Excellent food, great oysters that are  shocked meticulously

The only reason I give this place a 4 instead of 5 was because the service wasn't that great. Don't get me wrong the food was delicious the atmosphere was spot on but the service could of been better.. We weren't checked on a lot, We barely got refills, and most of the time we had to flag down our waiter. But besides that everything else was great.   :)

I had dinner here as part of a high school reunion. The staff was very welcoming to a large group and service was quick. We were seated on the outside patio and the staff was accommodating in adding tables and chairs. I thought the food was great and I would definitely go back for just the fries!

My wife and I went here for our first time tonight. I have to say the service was over the top! The person that showed us to our table (the owner Jimmy which we later found out) was very welcoming and energetic. He asked us our names, how long we had been married and if we had kids. Our waiter was great as well. The cheesy garlic bread is a must have! We had the mussels appetizer and the bread was very tasty dipped in the broth! As good as the food is the customer service is what really sets this place apart! We left the place stuffed and as we walked out every employee greeted us with a smile and thanked us for coming in. In my job we like to call it the 5 foot rule and this place definitely has it! 5 stars! What really topped it off was after we had already left and were walking down the street the owner ran out and yelled "wait Ron and Nancy!" That's after god only knows how many customers this guy has served in his Resturaunt that night! The fact that he remembered our names shows what great pride he takes in the service his business delivers. He handed us two loaves of bread and said to put the bread in the fridge for when the kids come home and also have us some cookies!  My wife and I eat out frequently and I rarely leave reviews but Jimmy's service was over the top! It keep me coming back and I will recommend this place to all my friends! Keep up the great work and customer service Jimmy! If your looking for a great place in the Hartford area go to Salute!
The angry dragon roll was full of flavor. Grilled chicken with mango kiwi salsa was delicious definitely coming back!!
consistently good food, hard to reserve a table, noisy
Isabella. We were there the night before I wrote the review, so it would have been August 17 around 8:30pm

This place is amazing!! Squash dumplings are ridiculous! This is a good spot to take a date, with romantic candlelit ambiance, small couple tables and a quiet atmosphere. Delicious food and the best drinks int he Union Square area make Ichabod's a great find. The atmosphere is quaint, and the service was great. Tucked into Irving Place, this place gets packed after work so be sure to make a reservation!

I used to walk to this Chinese food restaurant in my high school days when I had two or three dollars and would get an order of chicken wings and French fries... I eventually stopped because the food was so good that I would get depressed that I couldn't order more... It was that good. Fast forward to many years later- I didn't know they were still in business one year and decided to try their food again for old times sake- and boy is it everything I remembered and more. I can emphatically state that I have never had a bad delivery experience here- their prices are phenomenal and the quality of the food you get makes you feel as though you should be paying more, but got a great hook up. Everything I have tried from the general tsos to the steamed shrimp dumplings, mozzarella sticks, pu pu platter, chicken and broccoli, even the crab rangoons are delicious. I live about a mile and a half from the restaurant and every time they deliver to me, my food is so hot that I need to let it cool down first. And it always takes about 30-35 minutes. I'm really amazed by this place and I will only order Chinese from here

The food was delicious, with good veggie options for a set menu, the ambiance was beautiful. Service was very prompt and courteous. The lamb and its sauce were superb if a little dry/tough at parts, and also came in quite a large portion size. The other components of the dish were quite forgettable taste-wise, although an honorable mention goes to the chestnut polenta for inventiveness. Overall a great experience!

I looked all over and do not see my previous review anywhere. I went to Tashan Friday with 2 friends and we again had an amazing time. I had, a new dish, the red snapper, which was very nicely prepared and not overly salty. We sat with Mia at the bar, we did not have a reservation and it was packed! My friends ordered the butter chicken, which seems to have gain some spice and flavor since my last visit. Only complaint is that I could not hear the music, but that was only due to the roar of the restaurant.

Best Thai food I have ever had so far!! I moved to different state now and still miss this place. Great for lunch and group. Don't forget to order Thai ice tea! Lunch price is fairly cheap $. Only one setback is that they are close on Sunday!
Good Food at a reasonable price.

I eat here often but recently including yesterday my family didn't like the food.  It was very oily and the broccoli was undercooked.  Unfortunately the quality and concern for people's well being is being overlooked.

Small but so worth the wait for a table. The breakfast is outstanding. The Challa French toast come with extra cinnamon. The hashbrowns are full of flavor. The eggs are perfect. Can't wait to come back and try some of their other menu items!

live review: expect delays. got here at 9pm (on time for our reservation), sat at 10pm and bread came at 10.20pm.  it's 11.30pm and entrees are not here yet.  food might be good but the delay make it subpar. it's a prix fix place, not rocket science to know what/when to serve ppl.

the braised beef was delicious, i almost licked the plate once we were finished just to get another final taste. the interior is adorable. my one issue is that the "pizza bianca" is not pizza!!!!! it's bread and some kind of dipping sauce. really good, but not pizza.
I've only had their drip coffee, very disappointing. I can't speak to their espresso drinks.

Oh hey, its a ssam bar but you can't really get the good ssam unless you preorder with a bunch of people.  Great.  It's like an IHOP that doesn't sell pancakes. And yes, I know they have a fish ssam but everyone knows fish is basically a vegetable. I've been to several of David Chang's establishments and I have to say I was sorely disappointed by this one.   What we ate: -- kimchi was good, unique -- I would never have thought to put apples into it.   -- rice cake with pork sauce was good, delicious.  but its a pretty basic and simple korean dish that's really difficult to do poorly. -- pork belly bun was good but really nothing all that special.  when you're cooking with all that pork fat, it is damn hard to screw it up.  a restaurant (with a reputation like momofuku's) really should do a little more than serve up a slab of pork fat and call it a day.  it's a little lazy to be honest. -- seafood stew was terrible, awful, very bad, gross.  i had a flavor i couldn't really put my finger on and i don't really care to try to. The only reason I think this restaurant has four stars is because most other non-Japanese/Thai Asian restaurants in Manhatten are pretty terrible.

We checked this place out for dinner while on a business trip and it did not disappoint.  I tried the 50/50 burger, which was quite simply the best burger i've ever had.  We shared the greek fries, and i'd recommend sharing since one order can easily fill 2 people.  My group also tried the breakfast burger, Billy Burger, and Turkey burger, and both parties who had the beef burgers said they were one of if not THE best burger they've ever had.  The turkey burger eater said it was good, but not "the best".  Needless to say the burgers were good enough that we walked back for lunch the next day.  HIGHLY Recommend this place.  They also have some great beers on tap, if you into that sort of thing :)
Ezra, when are we getting married? Your food is orgasmic. Love, Jenny

The food is great & authentic.  Love the gibinitzi and red peppers, the food is very good for what it is. We've been there many times and always get extra to take home and i always over tip! That being said,  last night the attitude of the staff was just unacceptable.  My lovely 83 year old father made a reservation via phone for his favorite table, a day in advance... when we arrived the place was empty. A guy asked if we had a reservation and my dad spoke to him in serbian. The guy came back and said there is NO reservation. Ok, well Dad insisted he made one and even got a call to verify! A girl sitting at the bar jumps in and asks "who did you speak to,  we are the only two people who took reservations  yesterday".   The obnoxious,  disrespectful treatment was ridiculous at this point, mostly in Serbian they argued with him, basically implying my dad's a liar.   Of course they found the reservation entered on the wrong date.  They quickly blamed the owner, who just got back from vacation. ..ok... but,  then they tried to stick us at a little crooked table in the corner, or another one adjoining the one party of four in the whole place. NO! Honor the reservation,  cover for your boss who messed up... but no. So disrespectful.  I love my parents and seeing this happen as it did was very upsetting. My dad had enough and when he announced we were leaving due to this lousy treatment,  the girl stuck her nose in the air and with attitude just said "Goodbye! " no effort to fix their mistake or apologize for the insinuations.  Never going back. It's a shame.

This place is awesome! We came to NYC for a week and found this place by accident, and what a pleasurable surprise it was. The meanie isn't huge, with about a dozen entrees and some side dishes it's shorter than most but the food was excellent, service was fast and prompt and the place is clean, cozy and intimate. We tried the chicken curry, Chicken Tika Masala, the Tandoori Chicken Tika and Aloo Gobi Matar entrees along with Pakora and the Vegetable Samosa and all of them where excellent. The dish portions were big but not to big. Definitely a place to visit if you crave some affordable Indian food

Let me explain. I LOVE their food, I do. And I've been here numerous times and had a wonderful foodventure. HOWEVER. I brought my brother-in-law with me to show off this great place...but unfortunately, although the food was just as amazing as always, the service was horrible. It's not that they were slow or anything, I understand that when it's busy, you must be patient. But a certain waitress that I'd never seen working there before, who was English I presume, was VERY rude. This saddens me. I put service on a higher pedestal than quality of food. And lady, you ruined it for me. I will not be going back.

As a Business owner, I take pride in delivering the best possible product to my customers, whatever it may be. And just because of that, I felt compelled to write this review... If I could rate my experience tonight at Chutney Mary as MINUS 5 star, I would. If you are trying to decide between places to go, and this place is an option, please take it out of your options. It's got great ambiance (will give credit when it's due) but NOTHING more than that. It was my mothers 52nd birthday and we decided (I wish we hadn't) to go here for dinner as it is fairly close to our house. It was a Saturday night and we got there about 8:45. Around 9:30 after having the appetizers - which were OKAY at best - the server came up to us and told us that we should get food soon as they are going to clear out the food by 10:15. We got up mid-conversation and went to get food. I put some idli in my plate, got some Sambar, got some rice, some dal makhani (MY FAVORITE), some paneer and brought it back to the table. My parents and sister probably got the same. Once back at the table, I asked for some Garlic Naan (my favorite as well) but they said it would be $3 extra. Don't go to Indian buffets often but when I have, they have been more than delighted to provide most different type of naans at no extra cost. But hey, if that's the policy, that's completely fine with me. FOOD REVIEW: I tried breaking my idli into pieces but it was SO rigid and so hard that I couldn't. I then mixed my daal makhani (which was mostly water, barely any of the lentils) with the rice and I could barely chew the rice as they were extremely hard. I took a bite of my paneer and I felt as if I was trying to chew cardboard with garlic on it. At this time, I tried gauging how the rest of my family was feeling about the food and I could clearly see the anger in my dads eyes. (FYI - you don't want an Indian dad mad) The rest of the night went downhill once my dad got mad at how HORRIBLE the food was.... Please do yourself a favor and travel a bit further if you have to and not to ruin your night. I wish I could take this night back and have gone to a different place for my moms birthday night but this place legit ruined the night for us. And for the fact that it ruined our beautiful night, and because I feel so strongly about how BAD the food was tonight, I felt as if I needed to write this review and let everyone know. Worst buffet dinner I have ever been to. Be your own judge.
Daaaaaammn Gina! The Burliner Weisse be bangin' The So It Gose be slammin (not quite bangin) And the peps and pepperoni is my jaaaammmmm! Peace yo, we outtie

The food here is fairly good but enormously, pretentiously overpriced--strictly for gullible tourists, trust-fund babies, and yuppie hipgeoisie types with lots of disposable income. If you're not in one of these demographic categories, you're better off finding an alternate source of grub.
No longer accepting Groupons  because they claim Groupon is not paying them. I now have to go to Groupon and attempt to get my money back it is a shame of Groupon is really doing this!

Good food but the ambiance wasn't conducive to a larger party. The music was loud and they split our reservation up into two tables across the restaurant. Food was delicious but I wouldn't make an effort to come back.

This was our 2nd time at Applewood and once again it was delicious and memorable. The menu changed to complement the season and the cocktails were fun and creative (even though they make all their alcohol infusions in-house, I think Tanteo Jalapeno-Infused Tequila would have tasted better in their Jalapeno Tequila cocktail of the day). My wife and I are new to the neighborhood and just delighted to have a restaurant of this caliber around the corner. Not only was the food amazing and inventive, their hospitality was second to none. If you haven't tried Applewood, go tonight, not tomorrow, not next week, go now.
Exactly what this neighborhood needs. The owners are very friendly and the food/coffee is awesome! Excited to try more things on the menu soon.  We will definitely make this a regular spot.

My sister recommended this new spot in my old neighborhood. She raved about their pulled pork sandwich. I love me some pulled pork, but I've had it in some of the best places in the Carolina's and Arkansas, so I was skeptical. I gotta say, pretty damn good!! Best pulled pork north of the Mason-Dixon Line!!! Oh and their iced coffee is off the hook!!!

The service was fantastic and the setting ambient, warm and inviting. The atmosphere was cozy and romantic but not too overwhelming. The space is lovely with lots of windows and since we had a nice day a few were opened to let the breeze in. That was a nice touch. The apple pie had a good crust, which is obviously the most important thing about a pie and this was no doubt due in part to the pound of butter in the dough.
This place is great. Have to eat here every time I am in NYC. Simple goodness.

In town on business, ordered delivery and for 24.00 got a pizza that was burnt black on the crust and raw in the middle.  Any place that lets that pizza go out just doesn't care about their customers.  Sad.

3 stars only because I was disappointed with half my brunch.  Deep fried french toast was a good attempt but at the point at which you can taste the oil,  it's a deep fried dish gone wrong.  I'd warn people about that either on the menu or by the server.  Bread basket was amazing though and would get that again. Want to try the place for brunch.  Have tried Battersby before and expect no less

We came here for a Saturday night out. While the other reviews are rough I feel you need to remember this place is brand new. relax enjoy your evening :). The waitstaff and management are very attentive. Looking to be of any assistance. The tater tots with crab and lobster were AMAZING!! Let me start there Cocktails were fresh and inventive! Tons of options but after finding delicious ones we stuck with the throughout the evening. So we only tried a few. The tacos were all delicious the apple slaw on the short rib tacos we were delicious we were hesitant about the apple slaw but it proved to be a great. We will def be back this restaurant has nothing but continued positives!! Thanks for a fabulous evening!

Hands down the best breakfast I've ever had! My mom and I had heard amazing things about the food here so we decided to split two dishes to maximize the experience, and boy am I glad we did! We got the famous blueberry pancakes, which absolutely 100% lived up to the hype as did the heavenly warm maple butter, the Spanish Scramble, which was delicious in every way (we switched out the toast for a biscuit which I would highly suggest as it was one of the best I've ever had!) and a side of sugar-cured bacon, which is also worthy of the buzz. We had about an hour and a half wait, but we used the time to explore the neighborhood and walk down to the river so the time flew by! We got back to Clinton St about 15 minutes before when they said we would have a table and in 14 minutes our name was called! The staff was wonderful and attentive and the atmosphere was cheery and lovely. Our food arrived not long after ordering and we made sure we took time to enjoy every last bite. Anyone looking for a fantastic breakfast experience in New York needs to make Clinton St Baking Company their first stop! It was a highlight of our two-week trip.

Overall this place is average and expensive! While everyone raves about their stuff, I found that the 'best' on their menu wasn't made by them, such as the cheese and meat plates. However, the outdoor garden is adorable.....except when it poured on my husband and i because they didn't close the overhang.

Great atmosphere in the back yard, candles, wine and great food. Their pasta is amazing, and I can't imagine one going wrong with any of their menu choices. The quality and preparation of the pasta was excellent, in my opinion. Bread and olive oil to start are good and tasty, and the ravioli was yummy as well. The tiramisu was served in a cup, which did not make for the nicest presentation and it was on the smaller side, but it was satisfying. ion. The prices are not out of line for quality NYC meals, but that just means it's an appreciable hit in the wallet.

I'm not really a seafood lover so I went to Red Lobster for the chicken and steak. It was packed a little so I have to say people must enjoy it. We ordered mozzarella sticks and wings for appetizer and it was fabulous. Also the mash potatoes were on point. For our entrees we ordered chicken and steak and it was delicious. The prices were reasonable but the staff could of been better. Overall this Red Lobster was pretty good :)

This is the one!  Service was so incredibly friendly and helpful.  My last Korean BBQ venture in Cali was really ruined half by poor service, and when you have people changing grill plates, it's amazing what a quick and nice staff does for your entire dinner. Really, I was quiet charmed by all of the staff and their responsiveness.  Not to mention actually quite private seeming private rooms, the big TVs on ESPN, but nothing so loud or obnoxious that you'd be annoyed.   It's that good balance of something different and special that's also casual and inviting that a lot of restaurants in this area tend to lack. Love that the menu has some photos and really helpful description for meat choices.  The house marinade is good!  The sides are also great.  Their KimChi is at a good balance in flavor.  Bite-y without the "every bite adds to heat" problem I've had at other places.   Sauces were excellent as well.   Beers were priced fairly. The Sushi was also above what I expected for a mixed-menu place, and the wait staff warned it may take a bit with on chef at the helm.  My Sushi was out in less than 10 minutes.  My other favorite sushi place is Tokyo Sushi III and I actually couldn't decided whose I liked better. I really have to echo the other reviews that say this on par with major city expectations. I'm actually trying to plan when I can go back sooner, and really, that's a first with a lot of West Hartford / New Britain places.  The prices are right, the food is delicious, and the service is great. I was charmed into Seoul from other reviews, and was ready to be disappointed.  Nope! Perfect.

Rude and aggorant front of the house staff, more so condescending and mocking, than accommodating and inviting. Last night I pointed out to the busser that our table was extremely sticky, like all over. It either wasn't wiped or was done so with an extremely dirty towel. Anyway, thinking he'd simply grab a clean towel and give it a quick wipe, instead he gave me some story about the humidity. No, humidity doesn't cause stickiness to your table which makes you have to peel your menu from it. When I asked him to touch it himself, he did, then callously offered to put us back in line to wait for a different table if we didn't like that one. Sooooo you felt it was dirty too, aaaand thennnn... Passed the buck? Not really a home run with service. Also quite embarrassing when bringing two guests who'd never been after I'd raved about how great it is. I guess times have changed at the cantina. Also watching their front of the house manager (blonde lady) dancing around with her staff like an idiot while tables sit needing things and the place is dirty is ridiculous. Get someone in there who can professionally run a bar and up your service game. Minus one star for shitty attitude Minus one star for filthiness Minus one star for being slow and inattentive Minus one star for poor management Remaining star is for the food, recently the only thing okay there Save your energy and frustration and go somewhere else until they turn it around.
love it

Been coming to Libretti's since the mid 1960s. I've never had a had a bad meal and, mostly had great meals. Last night was no exception to the norm. An added benefit was the fun time in the bar after dinner. Karaoke us not my thing. However, there was some amazing talent singing last night ranging from Whitney and Motown to Sinatra and Martin. Loved Miss Mia! Can't wait to go back for a "complete" evening of food AND fun!
everything is good.  please get on GrubHub asap thanks!

I'm so glad I finally got to try Max Brenner as all of my friends in the east coast rave about it! I have to admit the bald man intimidated me at first glance, but I realized he just wants us to obsess about chocolate. How not to fall in love with him?? My family and I came here for dessert only. The service was fantastic and I would like to thank our server for the wonderful experience! I was thinking about skipping the drinks, but everyone was super thirsty by the time we got to the restaurant. I'm glad we didn't, because each of them tasted fantastic! All of the smoothie drinks came in the adorable MB "Alice" cup! 1. Orange Smoothie ($6.75): Fresh fruit smoothie with the perfect amount of cinnamon! This was probably my favorite! 2. Fruit Smoothie ($6.75): It's a blend of strawberry, mango, banana, and orange juice, but instead of using passion fruit as it says on the menu, the Max Brenner at Philly uses superfruit. It looked like a chocolate shake but was super refreshing. 3. Golden Latte ($6.75): One word...HONEY. The aroma of this fruit yogurt drink was perfect. 4. Yellow Granita ($3.50): This was my drink. It's a lemonade blended with fresh mint and ice--hands down the MOST refreshing drink I've had! Some might find it too sour, but I thought it was perfect! It ties with the Orange Smoothie! MB has an amazing assortment of desserts. Their menu is divided into hot chocolates, cocktails and milkshakes, waffles, cake desserts, fondue, and ice cream. 1. Tutti Fruitti Waffles ($13.95): Belgian waffles with berries and a scoop of ice cream. Comes with the chocolatey goodness known as choco-pops, which are crunchy chocolate pearls! 2. Munchies Waffles ($13.95): The better waffle deal with TWO scoop of ice cream. 3. The Melting Chocolate Truffle Heart Cake & Shake ($14.25): To be honest, I should have gotten a waffle instead. The set comes with a chocolate lava cake (with white chocolate in the center), vanilla ice cream, and an iced milk chocolate shot. It did not come with berries as it was noted in the menu. The ice cream melted pretty quick next to the warm milk chocolate pot that's to be poured on the cake. The cake itself was pretty dry. We came when it was 8 p.m., and they were all out of the I-Scream Bar Fondue. I should have went with a fondue instead. Can't complain too much, though. Our server was attentive and everything tasted great.
So-so coffee especially for what you pay. Didn't have one, but the pastries look great.
Michelin star recommended items (sugar cane ribs is a must) even got dessert because the food was so good. We had to revisit and it didn't disappoint.Side note, we love the music too.

We discovered Stone Hearth last week after a friend's recommendation and she was right -- Stone Hearth has the best happy hour in town!  Monday through Friday from 4-7 p.m., 2-for-1 wines, draft beers and cocktails, a happy hour menu filled with delicious light fare (including full-sized pizzas!) with a price point so perfect that upon receiving your bill, your head will spin leaving you wondering why you hadn't discovered the restaurant sooner? Upon arriving we sat at the bar and were greeted with water, a cocktail menu, happy hour menus, and full dinner menus (so much to choose from!) and it proceeded to get better, as it was our bartender who made our night - she was very knowledgeable and clearly had a true passion and flair for her craft.  As we worked our way through various small plates, all of which were delicious, (fresh, hot bread arrived too and we had not even asked for it, another pleasant surprise!) we were feeling a little adventurous and so, we also went on a surprise adventure with some very creative cocktails she had tailored specifically for us, and we loved everything she created.     We will be back, with friends to experience the full dinner menu and more fantastic cocktails.  Thank you for a wonderful evening, Stone Hearth! Recommended Eats:   Beef Lettuce Wraps (Bibb lettuce leaf, Asian-glazed beef with spicy aioli and fresh lime) Bacon Wrapped Dates (Almond stuffed dates wrapped in bacon baked with a balsamic drizzle) Pan Seared Scallops (Seared scallops over a cauliflower puree and a pomegranate drizzle.  Caution: worth fighting over.  I recommend more than one order per table.)

Had a great first time experience there last night. Went with fiends and we split the large tray and a carafe of mojitos. The food was excellent along with the drinks Our server was very attentive. He refilled our water every time he came back to our table. The food can out correct and in a timely manner. The only negative thing I can say is that the chairs were a little uncomfortable.

The food is delicious. This place is the perfect place for an afternoon brunch. The decor is homey and very comforting. The ambience is great; festive and loud, perfect for our noisy Mediterranean family. The service is impeccable. The after-meal chocolates are the perfect after-meal treats. Food is inventive and the menu choices are plentiful. All in all - a brunch delight.
Food and drinks tastes horrible waste of time

You take bad raw materials, poor cooking, snobby service, and... *miracle* you get 4 stars and almost 2,000 reviews.  Balthazar is one of the best financial success stories of New York, living proof that good marketing is worth more than anything else.
so good. omg!

I was very excited about coming here after months of telling my boyfriend to bring me here we finally go and we were told there was a wait about 10 min past and we were seated, I was upset at their menu they barely had much to choose from and the drinks were OK. We ordered the different meats out waitress said it's enough for two so we gave that a shot I asked her if the rice is enough for the both of us or if we needed to order extra rice and well the rice was deff not enough smh so we had to order more rice. Overall I wouldn't come back here again I don't see what the hype was about maybe just for drinks but I doubt it.

What a little gem... I had been told rather a lot about this little modest restaurant but it completely exceeded all my expectations. We ordered the mussels to start which were sublime. I had a great bit of chicken then to follow and my boyfriend, who is a burger fanatic, said 'it was the best burger he had ever had'. Such lovely staff, the room is a little cramped but I think that just adds to the charm. So perfect.

This is a great Vietnamese place. It's BYOB and there is a liquor store next door. It can get busy and be prepared to wait. We went on a Saturday night at 7pm and only waited for about 15 minutes. As we were eating I could see the line outside get longer at times. The foot was delicious and with your meal they bring bean sprout, basil, and lime for the table. The pho and broth in general are hot (temperature) and the sriracha makes it spicier. This isn't the best dining option in the middle of a warm summer. My meal came with shrimp and crab meat. There were only three shrimp in the bowl so don't get your hopes up. Others in our party had beef pho with probably 10 beef pieces. The service is slow, but friendly. We were okay with that since we weren't in a rush to leave. I will be returning to eat here again in the future, but not more than once a month.

Don't let the appearance fool you; the food is better than you'd expect. Good soups and sandwiches, especially breakfast sandwiches (which you can still order in the afternoon). The woman behind the register may seem brusque, but she'll give you good recommendations and will check to make sure you're happy.

My daughter & I had a reservation at the Tony's by Times Square, to have dinner after a show.  We ordered the Lobster Platter, one of the more expensive dishes. We both took a huge chunk of the tail relishing the taste, and then we both looked at each other with a reaction of disgust.  My daughter called it for exactly what it was, she said" oooo! this taste like the stuff they clean the bathroom with"  They slit the tail down the middle with a knife that had disinfectant on it, yes what is used to clean their bathrooms with.  The knife was never properly cleaned yuk!!!!   Besure your food is properly prepared, well heated, and don't order food douced in that tomato sauce, it is a coverup for poorly prepared food.

Laduree is by far the best place to go for macarons. The place itself is beautiful and once you enter the store, the smell surrounds you. My favorite flavors are pistachio, salted caramel, and rose. The only problems I have are the long lines and price.
Just love everything at Laduree...

So I am Mexican And i just had a great meal  at "blue corn" and I loved it! The whole thing, sopecitos, ensalada de nopales, And a classic Margarita So I had to share it with everybody!  Even if it means I will have to make a long line next time to get In there. Finally I find a Mexican restaurant in my neighborhood that I love.  It is like eating in Mexico City in La Zona Rosa! ( That is where many great Mexican restaurants in Mexico City are) I have tried several of the Mexican restaurants in the Italian  market area. They all disappoint me. I am allergic to MGS and I often get sick after eating their food because they use Goya seasonings that contains MSG.  They often have bad service, incompetent waiters and food that is not Mexican like the Mexican food I eat in Mexico.  Blue Corn is like the food I eat in an upscale restaurant in Mexico! Anyway if Blue Corn stays being what it was today for me, they will be my favorite place to eat at least once a week. Ah! And the prices are not bad, the decor is ok. Better than the other places.  I will keep trying other things from their menu. The service is excellent ( we had Agustin) and  the food is the best I had in any Mexican Restaurant in Philly. The dessert, cheese cake was just ok. I had better. I will try another one next time. The margarita was excellent, the nopales needed for me a little bit  of olive oil and lemon but it was  still really good and the sopecitos were  oh my God,  they were  the  way they should be: humble with a superiority complex. Yummy... Love You Blue Corn.  Do you love me back!  I even left  a bigger tip that I normally do. Ah and for the person that saw homeless, they are free to walk once in a while on 9th street, it is not a private street, you know.... I live here and I have  not noticed them...

I am from Chicago and was on a business visit in New York . I was looking for an Indian Restaurant in the Jackson Heights area ... Samudra seemed to be one of new restaurants and I decided to try it . I tried some of the south indian stuff like dosas and idlis - they were fresh , great tasting with the appropriate amount of spices . The service was excellent too . Being originally from Bombay , the food here brought back fond memories of the some of best Udupi restaurants there which are known for their tasty food & service at a gerat price.  I have not seen any good 'Udupi' style restaurants in Chicago or New York . Samudra is definitely the best of the lot. ! .

We came here for Sunday brunch after reading some pretty good reviews. We waited about 20 minutes which wasn't bad. The restaurant itself is cute and the food looked good. We ordered the French toast, breakfast burrito and hot chocolate. The server then vanished.... And we never saw her again. Our food was dropped on our table cafeteria style by someone who was so disinterested he didn't hear us when we asked if we could get syrup. We tried finding someone for about ten minutes before my husband had to go to the bar area and ask for it. I also forgot to mention I have a food allergy and I specifically asked the waitress if the item contained it, to which she said no... Only to have the item on my plate. I had to eat off my husbands plate and didn't get to enjoy my French toast. I would have ordered something else! Getting the check was the next ordeal... Took forever. Our waitress ended up getting sick and no one took over her many tables. People were looking around, waiting for service, waiting to pay, etc. No manager in site to help remedy the situation. The food is nothing to write home about. Go elsewhere and have an enjoyable experience! Total shame and waste of money.

Dirty and it smelled, needs Bar Rescue! My Ceasar Salad was loaded with heavy dressing, perhaps to hide brown lettuce. Pizza soggy and burnt, crust so thin it couldn't be picked up. Staff was attentive. Outdoor patio littered with cigarette butts, gross. Note:I am now home several hours later and incredibly sick. Too bad it is a lovely location by small lake.
Léa has the best in house, hand made, delicious food in the area, and one of my favorite places in New York City.

This place serves up mediocre burritos with an indifferent vibe. Not only do the ingredients taste flat and unappetizing, the deals they advertise outdoors aren't completely true or honored. For e.g., they kept changing the 5$ summer weekend hours randomly for two hours between 4--9pm, so that you're more likely to pay the full price rather than what you thought was the deal. Although I live only one block away from this place, and have visited many New Haven eating establishments regularly, this place actually turned me off enough to register and post a Yelp review.

First time to this place and we opted to sit outside.  Our waitress was so nice.  We had the artichoke tempura and it was a unique tasting app, very light and not over greasy. Than the main dishes came out.  He order the Prime Rib special at 22 oz. OMG you don't know what 22 oz of meat looks like till its in front of your face.  But it was amazing and nothing was left of it. I ordered the Roasted Pear and Warm Goat Cheese salad with chicken.  It was nice and warm and delicious.  I eat slow so my goat cheese started to cool down and crumbled as I cut into it.  But the combination is so tasty and filling. Definitely returning to this place. Oh and I used a 15% off coupon!!!  The only thing that doesn't work is their bread and oil in the beginning.  Bread is dense and cold and their style of pouring oil doesn't do it for me.  I would rather have had no bread on the table or maybe warm bread and butter.... but that just fills you up for no reason.

Best pizza on the planet.  Seriously.  I could eat this pizza every meal of my life.  I used to go to this place when it was in Trenton, and this new location is a welcome change.  The lighting, the salads, the music, the service is all top notch.  It's byob which is also a great touch.  Never disappointed, never had even a mediocre meal.  But be prepared for a wait.

We love Mexican food of all persuasions. Visiting Burlington we read about El Cortijo and wanted to give it a try. The first night we tried to get in we were unsuccessful--too crowded. But we liked the way we were treated and we came back the next night. This trip was more successful. We got a seat quickly, and the waitresses and hostess were all thoughtful and helpful. We started off with the standard Margaritas, in the large side. WE LOVED THEM! Best Margaritas we had ever had! We ordered the nachos, and they were as good as advertised. So was the guacamole, so was everything we had. I had a Burrito Pollo--it was huge and terrific. My wife had the Carne Asada. She loved it and throughout the meal we both were extremely happy with every detail--the food, the ambiance, the attention we received. We loved this place! We wish it was near us--and we each had a second and unnecessary but wonderful Margarita. Don't miss this place!
The T2 and volcano are my favorite. So delicious I never leave Burlington without eating here. I'm big on special makis and this place blows them out of the water!!! So good.

The best pizza and wings I have had in a very long time! The crew is great...but our waiter was exceptional. I have been a waitress for over 40 years, and it takes a lot to impress me.  A new twist on a "pizza" place.  The meatballs on the pizza tasted like homemade.  DEFINITELY worth the visit.

This is my favorite pizzeria in town. Their eggplant and chicken parms are by far the best i've ever had. Sauce has really good flavor and the food is always consistent. I also love their chicken cutlet sandwiches. I've been coming here for years and never been disappointed. Great Italian food!

Indian Kerala style food at its best! Very authentic reminding of eating in kerala itself. The fish moilee with Tilapia and Kozhi varutharachatu..was just great! Great place with attentive staff that we will keep going back to..keep it up Kochi!
We planned our morning/early afternoon to have lunch in the tavern. Wonderful food and the best service possible. People that work here really do care about the customer's experience.

Our 4th time here and each time It's more enjoyable. 3 1/2 hour meal each course more delicious than the next. Our waiter Matt was excellent helped us pair the wines with the courses My husband did the regular tasting and I did the vegetarian. He loved the scallop best and I thought the squash and fried green tomato were equally delicious. For dessert I loved the fruit plate and he tasted 3 sorbets. After the check when we were full to capacity They brought complimentary small Irresistible chocolates! Can't wait to go back!

Great little BYO Thai restaurant in Fairmount. We have eaten both in the restaurant as a couple and with friends, and have equally done take-out. Easy to make a reservation, nice outdoor seating and great food, and fast delivery for take out. Our favorites are the Pad Thai and the Drunken noodles, along with the Beggar's pouches for an app.

The restaurant itself is pretty basic with little decor of any kind. The staff looked very busy so it took them a while to acknowledge us, but when they did the service was ok. The service is friendly and quick, and most of the patrons are locals and obviously regulars.  I'll definitely have to come back for breakfast one morning as it's a fast and cheap eat.

Went for dinner yesterday with three others. Meal was excellent. Had the bone marrow, veal and beans and filet mignon along with the Minetta steak and mash. DIVINE all around. The bone marrow was excellent, better than most places. Our waiter Henry was excellent. Lastly the chocolate soufflé was soooo creamy and just the right thing to top off a great meal.
Went with friends, they chose. You walk in and the setting is nothing to write home about but the food is absolutely. One of the best dining experiences I have had in a long time.

Came here on a Saturday because Maharlika and Jeepney both had waits of upwards of an hour.  Ended up waiting over half an hour anyway despite a promised ten-minute wait. The food was okay.  The seasoned fries were good and crispy, though there was no discernible seasoning on them, aside from a few curls of parmesan.  I ordered the lechon kawali, which was literally just a pile of fried pork belly with a side of rice.  Half the pieces of pork belly were just deep fried fat.  I honestly wouldn't mind this that much, if there were some vegetables or something to balance it out, but the only other thing on my plate was some very sad and mushy garlic rice. Service was very friendly and attentive after the initial trouble with the wait time, but the food isn't worth coming back for.
This is a very good place. The best part is their ambiance. The next great thing is their variety of tasty cocktails. The food is good, but not exceptional.

FOUND A STAPLE IN MY MEAL. I've been here a lot (25+) with no such issues until today. No excuses for this though and I refuse to go back again. I'm lucky I didn't bite hard into it. Will be following up with them officially but also wanted to alert the yelp community.

Definitely a good place to visit if you're touring Philly with the fun local stands.  The produce market has great student prices, and caters to locals. I like the roast duck at Sang Kee's stand.  The soft pretzels.  Any of the Amish meat.  The ice cream.  Actually, I've never had bad food here.

LOVE THIS PLACE. Definitely my favorite part of Philly (Mainly in part because they have Beiler's donuts -- the most amazing thing I have ever eaten). There was so much to do here! Basically, it's an area filled with restaurants - all with their own specialties whether it's seafood, philly cheesesteaks, grilled cheese, baked goods, ice cream, etc - as well as little shops for basically anything you could want. They have a garden store with flowers and seeds to plant, as well as olive oil shops, candy shops, and many produce, fresh meats, and cheese shops. This place is a food-lover's dream, and I would highly recommend it to anyone. I wasn't a huge fan of Philly, but RTM was the BOMB.

As locals we can vouch for the view; it's really a great place to drink a beer while watching the sun set. That said, actually getting the beer into your hands will prove to be frustrating and may actually make you feel bad about yourself as images of the bartenders set afire run through your head... Prepare to be intentionally ignored or made to believe that your business is a nuisance. Even if the fucktard brothers behind the bar were mildly attentive I'd not return simply due to their lack of hygiene and basic food-safety practices. Under no circumstances should you order food here unless you're so hungry you may actually die. Do yourself a favor and just order a bottled beer and sit on the docks.
Four pork dumplings, one huge stuffed pancake, and a bottle of water, all for less than $5. Fast, cheap, delicious!

Thoroughly enjoyed dinner at the restaurant. The food and service were great and the atmosphere was the perfect level of casual with a noise level that was acceptable given the location. The modern interior decor, elegant with high vaulted ceilings, great lighting, and comfortable seating was marvelous and made me a happy camper instantly.

Well...Its my first review ever. Last night group of 20 people went to this restaurant.We liked the reviews on yelp about this place,so we've decided to try STIX.We were seated at 7;30 pm,but by 9;45 many of us still didn't get any food.The waiter and waitress obviously didn't know what they were doing,because they didn't know who ordered what and kept walking around our table asking who's food or a drink it was ,i guess when they took orders,they didn't write it down.We kept asking for our food,but didn't get any,the owner said she was short of staff,that one of the waiters called out sick.Really?How about extra chef?By 9;50 we walked out  of the STIX hungry  and upset. On the way home we saw a very nice diner,we were seated and served right away. STIX should be renamed as SUX,no food,very bad service and no apology from the owner.I feel bad for the people who came after us,around 8-9pm,I'm wondering what time did they eat,midnight?I believe if the restaurant expects large number of guest,and we made reservation for 20 people long ago,they should try to get and extra help to accommodate everyone.

Been going there for years. Only tolerated the staff due to location and convenience but the last straw was broken this morning. They got the order wrong for the millionth time.  My sandwich had half an egg on it on one side only. My egg white veggie omelet was brown and the vegetables were burned, the ham I paid for was missing. When I went back to the store to complain, the woman at the register completely ignored me, the woman who took my order replied very snotty asking me in a tone....."well how many eggs do you think are actually on a sandwich". When I asked to speak with the owner, I was told he's not there, when asked for his number, was told I can't have it, when asked for a refund, was told that's not possible. All I had left was for them to remake the order.....when I arrived at home, it was still WRONG..  if I pay for something at the very least, make it correctly and if I inform you its wrong, FIXIT IT.....I will drive out of my way not give them business again and I will ensure to inform all my neighbors who have also complained of the nasty staff and downright terrible service.

Just like everyone else on here my main focus is how fresh the food is. I love how the flavors really pop and are so distinctive. I particularly enjoy being able to find the perfect level of spice for myself based on the options provided. Great atmosphere and easy to walk to from anywhere in downtown New Haven. I would recommend Pitazikki to anyone.
Brooklyn Classic, go here for square pizza and spumoni!

This was the very first Greek eatery we found out about thanks to our uncle nino.This place is the king of Greek food in Astoria, just by the crowds every day.The pain in the butt nunu has been here many times with his uncle nino .When we make the trip waiting is part of life. Always a line outside.We order the Greek salad to start very good . My group orders seafood like whiting,barbounia,grilled octopus which they love.For me I always order a chicken dish with a side of rice and fries,yummy.The lemon potatoes are good.You get free dessert at the end which is OK but there is no dessert menu.My only real problem here is that the place is small and you are very close to everyone noI elbow room but otherwise its fine.When porcelli comes back to town I will bring him here.Also VIncente  loves this place he eats like he is in a marathon what a clown. .So folks if you like good Greek food make the trip, you won't regret it. I decided since trying other places, this place is good but not the best. On 23 rd ave you can find some  just as good if not better places to eat at.
Perfect,Cute,Amazing Food,Fantastic Bellini's, Great Service,Cute Back Patio=We'll be back, ALL THE TIME!
Best kind of bar. Unpretentious, cheap, friendly. Come with a group and make friends with Jeff, and you will leave happy. Better than the bro-magnet bars that make up most of South Street Seaport.

This place is such a gem. I haven't been here in some time but when I lived in the east village this was mine and my husbands go to spot. The selection of oysters changes daily, and there is always a new beer to try. The owner is a great guy and always very helpful with beer/oyster recommendations. My husband and I hate ordering the same thing when we go out but we both love the fettuccine and clams so much that we order our own so we don't have to share. Love the ambiance, they have great happy hour specials and the complimentary whiskey cake is the perfect ending to what is always a great meal. One of my favorite places in NYC.

Great food, clean place, friendly service. Might be the best pizza in the Nutley and Clifton area. Their Greek salad is great. It's huge, loaded with seasoned chicken, olives and feta. I bring my 4 year old there. All the workers go out of their way to talk to him, joke with him. Just a nice family place with great food. Their delivery worked out well. Honestly, I only used it once. Usually we eat there or I pick it up. But it was on time.

Infini-T has become a weekly breakfast destination for my family.  It's the only place in town where all of our culinary needs are met:  non-dairy milk teas and coffees, gluten free toast, delicious eggs and sandwiches and my son's favorite, chocolate cupcakes!   Mary and her staff are warm, friendly, and competent- we look forward to seeing them and are always well cared for.  They are especially lovely to our young son, and it has become his favorite spot.   I recommend for family weekend breakfast, getting together with friends, or just decompressing during some blissful alone time.

When I have a business dinner or just a nice dinner I choose this restaurant. Amazing food and very nice service. The price is high but worth it and at the level of a 5 star restaurant. Best italian in nyc.

I love this place! Food is always fresh and service is just amazing. I've tried so many dishes but most recently enjoyed appetizers and shrimp with broccoli.  The appetizers were fried dumplings, spring roll (best around), spare ribs and chicken wings! I always enjoy my dining experience.  You will really appreciate how fresh the food is and how generous the portions are!! Enjoy
The perfect brunch! I can't say enough about the food, the locale, the servers...I only wish they were located in Medford. It was definitely worth the drive into "town"
Recommended by foodie friends. Dropped in for Happy Hour empanadas and 2 for 1 mojitos. Tasty intro to Uruguayan food. Can't wait to go back for more.
BEST BAR EVER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! so beyond cool!!!!!!! you MUST try the "Melanie" shot!!!!!! its seriously the best
Excellent food (the escargots appetizer and lamb entree are amazing), wonderful wine selection, great service, and lovely ambiance---highly recommended!!

If it was possible I would give 0 stars. The older Spanish women who works the host stand was nothing but rude and ignorant. She never paged our remote thing they give you which made us wait even longer. She then have us all dirty menus with food in them to the point it was unreadable and I wasn't cleaning their menus. So me being a host for a living I simply took the menus and brought them to her and asked for all new ones and told her there was food in them. She then said so. So I then I showed her and requested a new menu that she did not want to give. She then threw the menus at me and told them they don't clean. And me thinking like who actually says that.lol. The waitress was very nice however was uneducated on the menu. We ended up getting food that was the worst we all have ever tasted and asked them to take back the item they have us which was wrong. They took it off the bill but the food was so bad that I was in shock of how the prices went up. And who charges $1 for a teaspoon of sour cream ??? Anyway, I will never be back. Nor will my friend and family who came with me.
