Customer for years. I dont change this place for nothing. Food is so authentic and fresh. I tried other places that they say are authentic ha. Not really. Friendly and yummy

An intimate setting, warm atmosphere, and delicious food at reasonable prices, what else can you ask for in a resturant??  There are so many good choices for food on smith and court street  but I still find myself coming back to Chez Moi at least once a week and will continue to do so.  Thank you for showing the other French restaurants in the area how its done!

Really nice bar for a date, quiet and inviting environment. I like the theme, and the bartenders are friendly and know what they are doing Only thing I didnt like was their selection on certain liquors, like gin. I wasnt crazy about the gin martini i got, not because they made it bad, but because i got a new gin i never had and it was mediocre. Nice beer selection and owner or manager was very friendly They also have a mini grocery section which is pretty cool

After 7 months I decided to return to Tashan.  My friend and I shared the vegetarian chefs tasting and it was to my liking. The service was very efficient and kind and was constantly making sure everything was okay and that we had what we needed. I would recommend Tashan for people who like inventive Indian food.

Dinner with a group of friends. The restaurant decor is fantastic and the room had a great ambience however our table for 6 people was rather small, we struggled to fit wine glasses onto the table! The food was excellent and if I was rating the restaurant on food alone, i would give it top ranking. The service was unfortunately poor - wine not being poured; our wine with main course arrived as I ate my last mouthful of my dish; a dessert was delivered that wasn't ordered; despite informing staff of an allergy petits-fours arrived containing the offending item without any warning. The sommelier when asked for wine recommendations did indeed offer suggestions however on the more expensive side. He didn't check budget or offer a selection against different price bands which again was disappointing. Our friends whom have been to the restaurant before did say the service was normally excellent so perhaps we were unlucky.

My girlfriends and I came in to celebrate our friends engagement and the service was terrific! Phil and Shannon both had such great personalities and had us laughing! They are definitely an great asset to the bar! I love bartenders who get to know their customers we will be going back!
If I had wanted a Trader Joe's frozen veggie burger I would have just stayed home. And the staff was full of attitude.  Worth a trip to Bareburger around the corner even for the extra dollars.
I have been here twice recently and enjoyed each time  Nice outdoor dining, interesting and moderately priced menu and excellent, friendly service. Will return there frequently. .

everything is so delish here... Great service.... do get their blt,  their yellowtail tartar,  yuzu and lychee panacotta, fried chicken-so juicy and the most tender chicken in the world... everything is so darn good!!

Pretty disappointed with my experience here. The menu was extremely limited and over-priced, and even though we visited early on a Sunday evening, service was quite slow. Our water glasses sat empty for long stretches at a time, prompting my dining companions to request more water several times. Our server was polite but mumbled and was very inarticulate and unhelpful when we inquired about certain menu items. In addition, the tomato salad we had was an odd amalgamation of chopped bits of sub-par plum tomatoes, complete with pieces of core. It wasn't seasoned at all either, and didn't seem to go along with the random few soybeans and pieces of basil.

I dont trust food carts lol but there are few i would buy from. These dudes are one of them. And the one on lincoln center. Something about how clean and proper they make you the food. It makes me feel safe lol I had this multiple times while walking by 14 st on a rush from work to meeting and its late. I pass diner time. I am hungry. I just dont wanna eat anything. I want something good and contained. Hummm these guys gave me a good fix multiple times. Delicious!!! The line for the cart is ridiculous but worth every bite...Its just under $7? Woooow!! What the fudge! Crazy!  Thats what i am talking about :)
Great food, very generous portions, and reasonable price! Gyro (lamb) over rice was delicious!
Inexpensive quality indian food with fast delivery in Finsbury Park area in London.
This place is okay. I gave them two stars because they have a lot of flies and my noodles came out burnt. Wish I had a better meal

Dined here last nite.  I ordered the tilapia special with mashed potatoes and vegetables. The fish was interesting an was a healthy portion.  It had an browned avocado crust.   I ordered the Sauvignon blanc from New Zealand.  It was sweet and crisp.  My dining partner ordered the Asian chicken salad which he said was very good as well.  Overall another great dinner at the Jane.  I've liked this place for years for a step above pub food in the west village.

I definitely have experienced better Mediterranean food.   The food is extremely overpriced and not worth it in the end.  We ordered the hummus, falafels , risotto and gnocchi.  The selection of wine was not great either. What kind of "high end" restaurant offers a cheap bottle of Beringers?  They also had the audacity to charge $50 for it.  I have been to many 4-5 star restaurants and they would be embarrassed to do that.  The gnocchi were too mushy and covered in this white froth that looked like fluff.  The risotto was simple, but not satisfying.  The hummus was just OK.  A true Mediterranean restaurant would have warmed it, not just put it on a shallow dish.  The falafels were probably the best thing we had, but nothing to rush back there for. The service wasn't great either.  The waitress was VERY pushy.  I really don't like that when I dine.  Let me decide what I want and if I have questions I will ask you.   She was also rather snobby and didn't make us very comfortable. Last, I have to add that the manager embarrassed me in front of the bar area if front of other patrons.  I don't want to get into why, as it was embarrassing enough when it happened.  But, let's just say that the waitress sent him over to basically ask me why I didn't leave her a high tip. Who does that??  Just thinking about makes me angry.  I was speechless.  No, I won't go back there again.

Got there quite late in the evening - around 10 and was surprised to see the place buzzing with energy , so i was ushered to a table and you could see that people were really enjoying their food . So we ordered our part and i have to say - it was quite a nice experience , really good tasting food .

My boyfriend and I just got home from their Buck-a-Shuck Mondays and I've just gotta say we had a terrible experience. I'm in the service industry and am really not too critical of what a server is doing as long as I have all that I need but our server was just horrendous. She seemed annoyed to even have us sit in her section (the high tops in the bar area) but we summed it up to her being busy and let it go but she remained unenthused, rushed, and unreliable. I stacked a few of our dirty dishes and placed them on the edge of the table in an attempt to help her out and yet the filthy plates remained there until we payed our damn check!! And as a server, we all know dirty plates are just a HUGE no-no. We came here a few nights before this Monday and service was just okay. I guess we should've just unfortunately known better. This is a place with such potential just crappy service :(

Long walk from the street to get there, but wonderful view of the East River and excellent new American cuisine make it worth the journey. Pricey, but lovely indoors, however sit outside for the view. Sea food and pasta creatively done.

Crap!!!!! Bad pours of the beers & the German food is not even remotely close to traditional style. Cheaply made food and only geared to the 20 year olds... Such a let down... I will never spend a single dollar in this place. Yuck!
A small glass of prosecco cost like a Margherita pizza..check the pizza before you start to eat mine was burn below.

Waited about 90 minutes for a table and it was definitely worth it. Our group ordered cheese plate, Margherita pizza, Cherrystone clam pizza, Anchovy pizza and a pizza with Arugula. Everything was wonderful. I would describe the style as thin crust. The atmosphere and service were great.
We definitely love it this place. Everything there is amazing. I can't explain how good was the meatballs. OMG amazing taste.

Double chocolate cookie is perfect, and it's really nice to see the baristas teaching the very involved owner how to create latte art. The owner is in the process of getting vegan ice cream sandwiches. I don't particularly care about the vegan part, but it's really cool to see how proud the guy is for thinking of it and being the only store to carry it. Baristas and the owner are both amazingly friendly. Like, stopped in to grab coffee on the way to work and am now 20 minutes late because I got caught in conversation friendly. Love this place! Wonderful people and great everything else.

This is definitely the sort of restaurant that you go to on a special occasion. The waitress was very helpful and attentive, without constantly hovering, and she was happy to make recommendations. The food itself was fantastic; fairly high prices, but worth it, and decent portion sizes. Nice ambience, quite small and close to other tables, but it didn't feel cramped.
Went there with my friend, large portions for NY. Food tasted amazing! Prices are High nevertheless. Ambiente is also very nice! Modern and cozy. Nice place to go!

Honestly, this quaint, little spot is one of my top 3 restaurants in the city. The flavors and preparation are amazing. Excellent, courteous service and charming, beach town decor. Try the oysters, the salmon burger and the Snapper special. Also, remember it's BYOB.
Burger was alright but I was waiting for better... Food is cheap, vibe is kinda cool.

I'm so happy to be back in NY, and back to one of my favorite haunts, The Ear Inn. I felt like I was immediately at home when I was greeted with a rousing "Good Morning" as I walked in, at 9 pm! That was Angela the Bartender.  She made our night amazing from beginning to end. She had great recommendations for us. From bourbon to beer, to trying the organic heirloom tomato and mozzarella salad. Yum! (The tomatoes are from their farm) The Ear was super busy that night , but we never felt neglected, Each customer was greeted as a regular, and we felt we were part of the many jokes and banter This is the Local bar scene I've missed so much. See you next week Ear Inn.
I love this place is a family restaurant small but u don't need a big restaurant to show ur love for food and people we coming back for some more food and wine ....

I've tried this place a couple times and it's always good. I've had the breakfast and Ellis island bagels and they are really filling. Not skimpy on what goes in them. Also, they have always been really friendly!

I loved it! The staff was extremely nice. I had the "Crazy Roll" - it was great. They also gave us a roll on the house courtesy of the chef. It's a BYOB establishment which is pretty cool. We brought a bottle of wine. We noticed two $1 items on our tab (assuming that's for the use of the glasses). Great spot for a casual lunch or dinner - small and cute. :)

This is by far one of my favorite places in NYC. I've been a few times with a friend and we usually go on a weekend when it's packed. I recently took some out of town friends visiting from Florida and they raved about it as well. I haven't had anything so far that was bad. Tip- the Yuca Sunrise cocktail is super yummy. Frozen margarita and sangria. Nice combination.

Not sure how my wife knew about this place, but glad she found it! We stopped in for breakfast one day, then came back the next day, and the day after that.  Tried a bunch of different pastries, breakfast and lunch sandwiches. I had the Vermonter breakfast sandwich twice: eggs, bacon, Vermont cheddar, apples on grilled raisin bread. Red Barn breakfast sandwich with mango chutney, added sausage. Very tasty! Relaxing environment. We didn't have to wait too long for our food, but remember you're in Vermont, relax for a minute! A bonus were the board games, card games and books on the tables. It kept our kids entertained while we waited for our food. Top of the list for pastries was the raspberry scone. I'd go back for them alone, perfectly moist. Also tried a pear and ginger muffin, raspberry bar, brownie bar and maple pecan scone. Pear-ginger muffin was tasty, but the pear got lost under the ginger. A pleasant spice to the muffin, perfect crumb. Raspberry bar had a coconut sprinkle, not my thing, but the crust was perfect. Brownie bar was excellent, the chips kicked up the chocolate intensity.   Maple pecan scone was excellent but the raspberry scone was by far the best thing I ate here. We'll be back, a great place for kids.

one of my favorite thai spots in the upper east side. service is quick and friendly. the space is clean. I strongly recommend it. I had deliveries a few times. I went there with my parents and they were thrilled.

I love-a thees a lovely Eatalian eatery. As an Eatalian-American myself I'm happy to have my peoples culture so-a perfectly represented. Barilla pasta, Marky Ramone marinara sauce, and biscotti for days. This place has it all!! I personally do my own little "March on Rome" anytime I'm there, right for the pastry case!!! Haha lol. Anyways, just like I-a say to all the women I meet, you'll feel way better with a little Eatalian in you!!

I don't ever write reviews but I had to $8 for a burrito smaller than chipotle by a lot. We asked for no tomatoes because there was already pico they took that as put everything on the side outside of the burrito. This was all after they read it back to us. If you've never had a burrito this place will blow you away. If you've had Taco Bell before I would go there instead. It had almost 5 stars dats whack for anyone whose had chipotle or qdoba.

This was the first gluten-free restaurant I discovered after being diagnosed with celiac disease. It's my favorite partly for that reason, but my review isn't about sentimentality. The gluten-free food is very good. I've been here a number of times, and have tried just about everything on the menu, including bowls of risotto, regular and Sicilian pizza, and sandwiches. I love the GF breadsticks that come with each meal, and have taken dessert items to go, such as cookies. Overall, there are good flavors and textures, and the bread-y items have a nice level of moisture without falling apart. That's important with gluten-free foods. Risotteria also serves gluten-free beer.

Having read the great reviews, I expected a wait, which was fine because it was 1pm on a Sunday and you'd be hard-pressed to find a decent place for brunch without one. It was probably 20 minutes before we were seated but it was worth it. The menu was extensive, the food delicious, and the service good. I'd definitely recommend. Can't wait to get back and try more!

My wife and I went last night after reading all the reviews and seeing the review on Channel 30.  Clean and new, the server behind the counter was VERY pleasant and cheerful.  Ordered NE clam chowder, a hot lobster roll, and a platter of fried shrimp.  Sides were fries, a house salad, and slaw.  Sat down and was served promptly.  The chowder was very good.  I could tell it wasn't just out of a can.  A bit overpriced at $6 for a fairly good sized cup.  The main dishes came shortly after, and the first thing I saw was the size of the lobster roll.  It was on a regular sized hot dog bun (small) and the lobster meat was left as it was pulled from the shell.  For the $19 this plate costs, I was disappointed in the potion to say the least.  The fried shrimp (10) were good.  The breading was tasty and not greasy.  Served with your choice of what appeared to be an aioli sauce or tarter sauce and fresh lemon.  The slaw was OK, not a lot of flavor.  Fries were hot and fresh, and ample serving to say the least.  Our "server" came to the table several times, and wanted to know if we wanted or needed anything.  She was very genuine and pleasant.  Overall, for my money, the place was OK, but nothing special as yet.  I will be going back to try the fish tacos I've read so much about.  Right now, it seems that J's Crab Shack is a better value for pretty much the same thing.  I'll let you know about my second visit when we go back.
The best authentic Italian food around, a little pricey but it is def worth it. The homemade raviolis and desserts are absolutely mouth watering. Top recommendation !

One of the best pizzerias I've  been to. I always make it a point to stop at Joes  when I am in town. The chicken cutlets and pasta dishes are delicious. My favorite is the buffalo chicken pizza which is baked to perfection. Definitely recommend Joes for anyone looking  for a friendly atmosphere and great food.

Artichoke is a neighborhood staple. This location is the original and authentic version of (what is now) a pretty darn famous slice of pizza. My personal favorite is still the artichoke slice although the margarita slice is a pretty close second. The ambiance is quirky and awesome and you will have a unique experience there. It's a must when you're in the East Village!

Came in, waited about 10 mins to be acknowledged. Place was a little busy at the time so I won't blame the waitress for the wait. Only thing waitress did at the beginning once acknowledged us, she brought the menus, and didn't ask for drinks like normally others restaurant do, instead we waited about another 10 mins before she came back to ask about drinks and orders. Food wise, it was delicious and it has big selection of food to order. This place has potential to be successful like I think they are but there's always room for improvements, customer service should be at 100% and that can have a big impact on customers. I'll eat again, but not in a week day where time management is really tight. Rated 3 stars for the customer service but food if I could I'll give it a 5.
Best falafel Ive ever had.
Best shrimp lo mein in town. Highly recommend ordering from here if you want great Chinese food.

My experience at Diamondz N Da Ruff was very disappointing.  The staff was very unprofessional.  We stood at the door waiting for someone to help us to no avail.  Finally, someone asked us if we were there to eat (duh) as they continue to walk pass us and then instructed us to sit anywhere.  We sat there for about 5 mins  No, menu, no water or welcoming smile.  So we decided to leave and have dinner elsewhere.  I will not be back.

My head was full of visions of the old Rx, so I'd like to disabuse anyone of the notion that Farmacy has anything in common with the old place aside from some pharmacy kitsch, and well, good food. Because the food IS good... when they actually have it. Table service is laughably bad. Waiters were friendly, but completely absent minded and inattentive. Forgot to bring milk for coffee, ketchup for fries, and then forgot again when asked. Far worse though, by noon on Sunday brunch, the kitchen had run out of several menu items, and any juice. A quick glance at the kitchen on the way to the bathroom did not inspire much confidence that the back of house is somehow more organized than the front. Also a quick rant about their table clearing: We had a reservation for brunch, and after catching someone's attention, we were seated at a table covered with the previous group's napkins and cups. "It's clean," the waiter preempted, as he took everything away. Certainly, it wasn't sticky or food encrusted, but it was an off-putting way to start a meal. Then I noticed that the one outside dining table had also been left covered with the plates and food of a departed group. And it stayed that way, throughout the two hours of our meal. It made for a pretty disgusting sight as we left the restaurant. They are striving for, and to a degree, achieving, a casual, neighborhood experience. But they are totally failing to instill any confidence in their skill or ability to run a restaurant. Maybe just scrap the table service and switch to ordering at a counter?

Tonight I went on a date and I asked my date what kind of food she would like. Unfortunately, she said what I ever I decide would be fine. I have heard about Bogota Latin Bistro thru word of mouth. So I decided to go there even though I have never been there myself. At this time, I crossed my fingers and hoped that it's as good as I been told. Let me tell you, the food was fabulous, and my waitress Jean Marie was fantastic. She was very polite and always smiled, which it was great to see cause the place was busy.  I must really commend her cause to be honest I couldn't keep a smile on my face with such a high demand. The atmosphere was great and the music almost made me get out of my chair and dance. At the end of the night my date asked me how did you find this place? I told her thru a friend and he swears it's not only great food but the service is amazing.  Jean Marie made me feel very welcomed and for that, Excellent Job. I will be definitely will be returning and I will recommend this restaurant to all my friends and colleagues.
Great quality everything, except cake. Go to CakeLife Bake Shop for treats!

Good everything flat bagels but sometimes the wait doesn't seem worth it. If you can go during off peak hours (weekdays especially) you will find that your wait will not be as long. Taylor ham egg & cheese sandwiches are good but make sure they hear your order correctly!

I LOVE FOOD but I do not see what the hooplah is about Queens Comfort. Now granted, I haven't tried their "famous" brunch menu.. but I recently went for dinner and was so underwhelmed.  The communal seating is too close for comfort. I can't have a normal conversation while listening to my neighbors as well.  I ordered the Chicken & Waffles and the meal was super bland.  I added a heap load of Hot Sauce to give it some zing.  My friend had the Cranberry Chutney Chicken Sandwich, fancy name for a plain old chicken sandwich.  Service was fast and polite... that's the only positive I got out of this visit...

Friend recommended this place. Oysters were okay. Also ordered the salmon burger ($18) and clam chowder ($12). Bread was burnt and salmon was dry.  Clam chowder was watery and too salty. Overpriced for the food taste and size. The service was the worst. Rudest servers and manager I've ever encountered. Save your money, time and dine somewhere else. Will not be returning.
I went there for the first time today and the burrito was great. It was fresh and tasty! I also loved the great variety of vegetarian options. Definitely will go there again!

This is probably one of the worst place I have ever tried while working in cartertet NJ. I ordered a bacon cheese burger for lunch and it was suppose to come with fries and a side of salad. I heard this place was pretty bad from my co workers but I figured how can anyone botch a classic cheeseburger with bacon? They did! They freaking add ham instead of bacon. Both of the bun was on the bottom of the tray so by the time it arrived.  It has absorbed all the oil. In addition to that,  they changed me extra cuz I request egg salad instead of Mac salad and it came in a super small portion. This place is a joke.  I hope they go bankrupt and fail because their prices aren't even competitive.

The sandwiches were fresh and delicious! Be sure to grab an iced drink and a sandwich to get a FREE cupcake. The girls who work there are cute too! Cozy inside but there's Columbus park across the street if you can't sit inside.

You will usually NEVER catch me at the hotel bar; but this place is tight. The lighting is what initially drew me in. Trippy decor, dope beer selection, and small but awesome late night menu are all reasons I'm still sitting here. Just noticed they have Pisco Sour on the cocktail menu. Awesome. This place screams South America.

I ate here several times and planned to bring many friends back until an unfortunate incident happened. The food is OK far from authentic but edible and portions were on the small side and one would have to order more than one dish to get their fill. A waitress brought back a salad dish with croutons hard as a rock (so much so that it broke my tooth) that's when I decided the medicare food was not worth the  trouble. The meal in actuality ended up costing me $650 to replace the cap. While the menu stated there were croutons in the salad they never said they were extremely hard. My friend who was with me also had a hard time eating through them.  Next time I'm sticking to known territory such as Pete's Tavern and Blue Bell nearby.

What a warm environment and such a great vibe! We sat at the bar for happy hour and it seemed the place was filled with regulars making conversation, which is always a good sign. The bartenders were friendly and engaging and the cocktails were great! Fried tofu was delicious - light and crispy on the outside and gooey and soft inside.
this restaurant is so good,  fried pancake is so good and the cold dishes are delicious.  when i ever feel hungry, i just go there .

Tasty, cheap and fast. Just what we wanted after a day at the Frick Museum. The gyros are not huge but just the right size for my wife and I for a late lunch. The beef/lamb meat was good. The tzatziki was light on the garlic to my taste. They put French fries on the gyro, which it didn't need. The pita was very fresh and good. Price was good at $9.50. We also had a kale and butternut squash salad that was good and also well-priced at $5.50. All in all, a good lunch spot.
buffalo chicken pizza all day!  who the fuck else stays open til 3,really?!?

Local spot - no frills but lots of fun. French fries are legit and the buckets of beer are always cold. Jukebox is always playing something to sing along too. Jeff (owner) always makes sure you have a good time. Quickly becoming one of my favorite bars in the city.

I love this place! The food is delicious, not overly hot like one may think a jerk place would be. The prices are so reasonable, under $10. for a meal!! Very simple menu, not complicated, great for first timers or seasoned foodies. Very clean & very friendly staff. So happy this is close to me. Yay!!

Breakfast here is very good and the prices are typical for the area.  Service is fast and friendly, but it can be quite loud and feels very crowded because they have shoved as many tables into the room as possible.  Dinner is standard diner fare, and is somewhat overpriced, in my estimation, though the quality was good.  They feature a very impressive display of desserts, though we haven't sampled them ... yet.

I like Amy Ruth's food as I've been frequenting this restaurant for many years. I find that the food over all is good but has changed over the past few years and continues to change not necessarily bad but original styles or recipes tastes better. I love their salmon croquettes and cheesy grits! It's one of my favorite go to meals and I order it ALl time. I realize that the recipe has changed and it doesn't taste as good as it did about six months ago. I don't know either they have a new cook or a new recipe but they should go back to the old recipe, it tastes better! And the biscuits are too thick sometimes. Doesn't taste flaky like a biscuit, not completely bad but can be better! The mac n cheese is always amazing and the chicken and waffles are to die for. The sweet tea will give you diabetes but it's worth it. It always packed in the afternoon and for dinner so breakfast is your best bet for seating without waiting on the long line. Overall, good food but can always be better.

Like the other reviews have said, the food at Pies N Thighs is awesome. I just love the smell as soon as you walk in! Only minus would be that the staff seem a little too cool so the service isn't the most attentive. But, at the end of the day, I'll keep going back because its delicious.
Best Seafood spot around!!!!! Food and Customer Service is great....... It is worth the wait.....

I went to Beija-Flor for the first time last Saturday and it was an amazing experience! As a Brazilian, I certainly appreciate a good picanha and I was impressed by the quality of the meat and the flavorful fried yucca and collar greens. The food is great! We also had a few caipirinhas and the drinks were well mixed. Better yet than the drinks and the food, was the service. The waitress was attentive, detailed, nice and didn't rush us whatsoever. Bonus part: when we were about to leave, we learned that they were about to start live samba! We stayed for a couple of more hours and I'm glad we did. I can't wait to go back there with my friends for happy hour!

I was down in the US visiting family, and we were excited for this place. However as it turns out, "The oldest pizza restaurant in America" does not mean, "The best pizza restaurant" nor even mean "A good pizza restaurant". The pizza tasted ok, but the hair gave it a bad texture. *yuck* The artichoke appetizer tasted like it was pre-made way in advance then warmed up. The atmosphere was intended to be homey but came of as more gloomy. I did like the old newspaper hanging up above the washroom urinals. That bit was cool.

This is a small, homely restaurant. The chef is Wafa herself, and her sons are among the waiters. My favorites are the vegetarian dishes. The falafel, hummus, tabbouleh, and tahini  are very fresh and authentic (in the area, compared only with Pahal Zan). The rice with lentils, mujadara and tomato bulgar are great for a vegetarian main course, especially when mixed with the hummus and/or tahini. As far as meat dishes go, I've tried the shawarma and wasn't crazy about it. It was tender and not the kind you'd expect cut from a rotating spit. For desert I'd highly recommend the Kanafeh, which is alone worth the trip to this restaurant. It is served warm and the the sweet cheese literally melts in your mouth.

Absolutely horrid, there are no words as to how terrible service was tonight. As soon as my boyfriend and I walked in, the snobby brunette hostess snickered and sat us down. After waiting over 10 minutes, she came back to take our order (because my boyfriend said something loudly). She was busy talking to the other waitress making casual conversation and looking at her phone. Granted the food came quickly, but it was definitely not as great as I believed it to be according to Yelp reviews. The tomato sauce was watery and bland, I understand it's "neapolitan pizza" though for almost $20 I didn't find it to be worth it. I ordered the ravioli, and the sauce was also watery, and not very appetizing. I was served maybe eight to nine pieces for around $17.50 for that price you would expect the meal to be at least semi-filling. Two stars is for the atmosphere, it's beautiful at night and incredibly romantic. Also, I give them props for the Apple Zu martini, that was delightful. Other than for drinks, I don't think I would ever go back.
Great bakery! Love their breads, always nice and fresh. Stopped buying bread anywhere else as fresh and daily baked breads are available there.

An awful experience never to be repeated. Let's start by setting the stage.  I've got a couple of friends in from out of town, we know we r going to be waiting a solid hr so we get there at 7:30.  I said we could be 3 or 4, so put us down for 4. 55 minutes later I go to check and they said "your table is on their entrees, it'll be 20", I said that sounds really inaccurate I would guess another 45, the hostess agrees and we head back to mamas next door for another round. Boom, finally at 9 my phone goes off 90 mins after we got there and 30 after they said a table would be available.   I'm willing to let bygones be bygones if the food is amazing, so we head over and they put 3 of us at the bar U can't put a group of 3 at a straight bar after a 90 minute wait. Like most yelpers I only leave bad reviews, but the hostess and staff were a******es for making us wait and then pulling what they did We didn't even eat, we just left in disgust Horrible service and no matter how good the food, no one should go through what we just did. I suggest sending the chefs back to restaurant wars and seeing if they can win on service this time round (top chef reference)
Nasty take out....looked like someones left overs. My pad Thai noodles were all different shapes and sizes and they looked chewed up. I will never go here again.

Yummmmm the pho is amazing! I had the shrimp spring rolls as an appetizer and the chicken pho my boyfriend had the grilled beef and fried rice and woowwweee so fresh and super affordable. The service was great and the food came out really quickly. You have to try this place! It reminds me of banois cooking :)
My other half loves their pizza. I like it, too, but its not as fabulous as the flavors the top pizza places in NH manage to produce. Their clam pizza is not as good as PP's.

Had lunch here last week (8/21/14) and I had my credit card charged THREE times for the same meal. Lunch was split between myself and a friend and thankfully I just caught the charges on my Amex. This is my first time leaving a negative review (I use reviews all the time to hep plan meals, etc.) but this totally deserves it. I'll never go back and I'll only tell others about my experience.

The wait is ridiculous but it's worth it. You couldn't possibly go there without expecting a wait. On my visit, the service was OK as the waiter didn't seem to realize that he was serving us and we sat idly for a while, hoping for someone to notice us so we could try the famous Roberta's. I finally got his attention and from then on he was great. The food was spectacular, really great, a wonderful pizza and calzone. So much dough was consumed that I couldn't eat breakfast the next day. Can't wait to go back and take my friends.
Best brunch in UWS. Smoked Salmon scrambled eggs are some of the best I've ever had. Great place to take family and friends!

It's hilarious reading comments from people that have never been to Shanghai and have tried the real deal arguing about what is good xlb and what is not. It's like watching a bunch of retards arguing about who is the best at math. Anyways, I'll give 5 stars because I'm just commenting. I'm sure the XLBs here are delicious.

Super good! Second time coming, the xia long bao or soup dumplings are definitely the best around. Got to try the wasabi dumpling and it was awesome and unique. The rice dishes were also great, I like the shredded beef and hot pepper as well as the xo sauce fried rice. Definitely recommend this place, you have to get the xiao long bao when you come of course!!
Awesome ! Great food, service and  cleanliness. Very good location -easy access to 95N & 95S

i had the avocado salad and a side of 5 pieces of falafel. it was absolutely delicious. the falafel was perfectly crunchy/fried on the outside and soft but not soggy on the inside. the seasonings/spices were wonderful. the salad was a lot bigger than i expected and the meal could have definitely been split between 2 people. i will definitely be going back - it is light and fresh and the price is on point! looking forward to trying other options on the menu.
Slow service during lunch hours, food is tasty, at times bread of the sandwiches can be very hard and crunchy. Lunch portions are on the smaller side but salad is delicious
Simply good. In every sense. The menu and dishes are simple and delicious. Love the fact that you're watching the pita bake right there. I can't wait to come back!
Food was amazing I try malai kofta it's good and dessert I try gulab jamun it's to hard

Place it's okay..  Cash only, the big turn off it's the waiting time for the crepes to be ready.. Make sure you order the food and desert all together.. Or you will be waiting there for a long long time.. :)
Service was excellent! Good was delicious and fresh and the dessert was very good as well !
oh man,,,that was an average pizza. dry floury crust and a forgettable taste.
With fly and mosquito flying around, the burned brussels, oily potato fries and overcooked fried chicken can not match its price.
Enjoyed the wine and the bread, but nothing special. Wine was average, and the price was high. Probably won't be back.

I figured I'd make this my first Yelp review.  Just moved out of Philly, but I was here almost every week.  Great food, great portions, fast service. Pho fanatic!  They have lots of other great Vietnamese dishes, too.

I do not understand the rave reviews.  I think this place is fine for cheap eats, but the quality and flavor of the dumplings do not merit 4.5 stars.  The dumplings are too doughy.  The filling (the shrimp, chicken and pork)  is not well seasoned.  I would not go there again.  I threw half of my order away.

I've eaten here only once, at the behest of my sister, who is a "regular" and raves about the place. We went for lunch, and I ordered a turkey wrap ("The Monarch") and the waffle fries.  (Should I mention that I did not find the naming of the food items after various rappers and other entertainers to be amusing?) The quality of the ingredients in the wrap were very good, but it was rather dry ... it could have used a little mayo or a dressing of some kind.  The waffle fries were very good - truly the highlight of my meal.  The waitress was friendly and efficient.  I would like to try breakfast and dinner here.

Wife and I were pleased to see this spot having lived in NY and enjoyed the original. We shared a dozen raw oysters then the oyster pan roast. Very good! Great service. I expect to over pay in Airports so no surprises.

I was looking for a nice fancy restaurant (non commercial one) and this popup. I was impressed with the way everyone explained their experience at this place. I visited the website and got even more impressed so decided to come here for our anniversary dinner. Our night was so special as we entered to this hidden gem. First impression a lovely cozy place with a lot of charm and Italian feel to it. We were greeted and as we had reservation made we were seating in last than few minutes. Our server was extremely pleasant and knowledgably. The place is totally made for you to feel that you are not in Dirty jersey any more ;) :p. The restaurant is small so don't hope for a big place with a lot of room. It is super comfortable and cozy. We ordered our food and everything from start to end was totally unbelievable. Love the way everything was coming on proper time giving us plenty of time to relax, talk, and enjoy wine with great ambiance. Place is clean, food is great, prices are very reasonable (not for college kids) and this is a perfect spot for a romantic night out. We already went back for lunch and got the same 5 star experience all over again. Lunch you get soup or Salad so it's even better. It's a BYOB and they also carry some decent wine collection. We will be back here soon.
Very small, quaint with good food. Been twice and plan to go again. Second time, the Risotto wasn't cooked through but other tapas were right on. Outdoor seating is nice and price is fair.

Consistently excellent place especially for lunch.  The chicken sandwich w fries is an ample portion.  The beer selection is also very good offering several micro brews.   The staff is friendly and efficient.  I have been dining at 2 of the Smith locations for years and highly recommend it.
This is the best food I had ever since I moved to US. The chicken kebab was just awesome. I must visit place for foodies
really good cheap cuban food and in a relaxed atmosphere. love that it is open 24/7. They were able to accommodate a large party of 10 on a saturday night but we did have to wait for 30minutes
Great food, great coffee, fast and friendly service... A+
Really good Italian food. However, I'm not a fan of family style meals, large crowds, waiting and touristy places.

I just came here with my friends. First timer and i got the breakroom fries along with the mint lemonade. The fries were really filling and delicious! This place looked like a bar filled with sauces lol. And the girl who served and made me the lemonade, I think her name was Carol? She was really nice and the drink was really good too. I would definitely come back to try other things and probably bring my boyfriend, so he could try.

Another diner that has seen better days.  The service is, at best, disinterested, the food is overpriced, usually overcooked, and uninspired.  Simply not worth it, unless one is hoping to witness some drama.

The food was alright.  I had some eggs for brunch and it was a little undercooked. He barely checked on us and food did not come out together. We had a table of 6. The worst part was when the waiter charged our credit card twice. Very disorganized and pricy for what we got.

My fiancée and I frequent this truck often for the tostadas mostly,  the food is fresh and the service is great. Very inexpensive and perfect for a date night and walk by the ocean.  He and I find it to be some of the best food from the selection of trucks.  There is also a hot dog truck for the kids.

I came here for brunch with friends on a Sunday and really enjoyed it! You can't beat the price for a boozy and tasty meal. It is loud and has a party atmosphere, which we loved because we were continuing on the celebrations that afternoon. However if you were meeting to break up with someone or deliver sobering news, this may not be the place for you. Although Fonda could definitely assist you with some liquid courage.

I used to work a block away and was addicted. Now I only spoil myself once in a while. Extra white sauce, extra red, yes, I'm sure. I don't mind torturing myself. I like more salad than rice and a chopped pita on top.

I frequented Terakawa this past summer many, many times (about once a week) and unfortunately I think that's coming to an end. The ramen is very good which is a plus because it's hard to find good ramen places in Philly. The restaurant itself is nice and service is fairly quick as well. Sadly the service, particularly the waitresses, could be a little friendlier. There seems to only be three waitresses here and I've had rude and off putting experiences with two out of three of them. It's really just a shame but I won't be going back.

Here's a message to you, Rudy: Drop the Y and rename this joint Rude. If you're looking for an oxymoronic combination 'Ivy league- dive bar' (full of hipsters, underclassmen in their Yale sweatshirts, and old bearded men) then this truly is the spot. I hate writing a bad review. I almost always opt for not saying anything, but here goes... Maybe I wasn't cool enough for this place...but should anyone have to wave down the bartender in order to distract him from his phone? When I asked about the IPA I was drinking, he seemed utterly annoyed. I'm very sorry I can't read the tap through all the douchery in the room. Once upon a time bartenders were expected to notice when your glass was empty, perhaps even remember what you were drinking! Crazy, I know.   After an hour and a half, I left Rudy's without so much as a smile from another customer, and with ZERO small talk from the staff. This is possibly the un-friendliest place I have ever been in all of my years! Also, the food was just OK and way over priced (little to no seasoning on the chicken, canned beets in my salad, bland cheese... but some tasty dressing DID help it). You couldn't pay me to come back to this place.

First of all, I would like to say that I and my family have been going to this place for years. The food was always good with great affordable prices. They had great waiters that were always very attentive and friendly to the customers. It was like you were in a family atmosphere in Europe and I. That being said, a year and a half ago I had a horrible experience going to this place. The service sucked and the food seemed not that special. They had recently brought in new staff and they were unprofessional to me and my friends. We had a young waiter attend to getting our orders and somehow he forgot to mention that a certain plate was no longer available. While placing the order our the head waiter must of noticed that the order was no good and came to our table. He stated in a very disrespectful manner that they "ran out" of the particular plate.  They did have enough for one person but my table wanted two orders of the specific plate.   This is where everything went downhill and very bad. While the waiter was explaining this to one of my friends we all did not pay attention and noticed he was there since we all were speaking to each other.  The head waiter stated that someone had to order a new plate but somehow he seemed to be frustrated with something (Even to this day I do not know why).  He was very rude and ended up stating that we all needed to work on our ordering skills since we do not know how to understand a plate "ran out". When he said that I stated that that was very disrespectful and he needed to relax. He seemed that he really did not care and proceeded to walk away. Due to this altercation they have lost a long time customer. I never experienced this situation in any other Portuguese restaurant I attended. All that was needed was for him to use some customer service skills and help with resolving the mistake. He just made my experience very uncomfortable and made it bigger than what it was. I will not be returning to place ever again. I was already approached by three of my friends to go to eat at this place but luckily I was able to recommend them to other better restaurants in Newark.

Amazing and delicious and amazing and delicious. The Brussels sprouts side is TO DIE FOR and I don't even like Brussels sprouts. The Phoenician lemonade is wow. And don't even get me started on the hummus.
Every time I come the service is top notch. I love the layout. Food is good but nothing memorable except for the carpaccio if memory serves me correct it comes with fries and well executed.
Great drinks the beach please was very refreshing.. the surf and turf wasnt typical and the service and managment did great very pleased..

We love the atmosphere at NIXs Hartford. We tried out so many things in the menu and we really loved the Pork Belly, the crab Tater tots, the smoked Mac and cheese. The cocktails were amazing. My favorite was the Bazzle Dazzle. It was so good that so ordered another one. NIXS specializes in small plates and has food late night until 12:30.

This place gets a  lot of hype...and now they are in the gyco commercial....sandwiches don't life up to the hype and I do not care for the "speak English" sign. His ancestors probably didn't speak English when they first came here...everyone has to learn and most people learn the hard way which is by being in the environment; don't make them feel bad. Not everyone is an illegal immigrate.
The food is ok and pricey.  They use to be better on quality.  Most of all seafood if frozen.  They do have good coffee.

The food was lovely but there were very few options without dairy and unfortunately very little effort was made to make a person with allergies feel welcome. The waitress did ask the kitchen but came back with only two options and never checked if the bread served had dairy. Overall the pasta was delicious (a bit too much sauce for my taste) but if you have any gluten or dairy allergies there are very FEW options and the kitchen seemed fairly unwilling to be accommodating.

If I had written this review a month ago, you would have seen four stars, but after tonight my fiancée and I will not be returning. Italian food at its best is simple, with beautiful ingredients and prepared with love. The food at Vite shows a lack of respect for ingredients and technique - indifferently prepared and mediocre. On our first visit, the food was good if unsophisticated, with hit or miss ingredients. Tonight the food was in a word, embarrassing. Where to begin... We should have walked out when we realized it was hot and stuffy inside. We debated staying and decided to have a seat. We were then given two cocktails, the reason we can only imagine as being, "thank you for not leaving." One word, disgusting. Apple liquor with prosecco. Horrible. The drinks remained on our table for the rest of the meal... as they were given. Next... Our wine. So sad. We ordered a quartino of Neprica, which we have had before and it was good. However, it was corked, and our server was unaware that this was even possible. No one even knew what the word "corked" meant. I will say, our server was lovely and has always been friendly in the past, welcoming us with a smile every time.   Then... the "porchetta with potatoes." Laughable. Sliced deli meat with soggy potato chips on top. Say no more. The mains... My fiancée has always ordered the penne, and it has been pretty consistent, yet nothing stunning. I, being the one who likes to try new things, ordered the gnocchi with duck ragu. Sounds wonderful, duck being so tender, you'd think it would lend itself well to ragu. Nope. Dog food. It literally looked like Alpo. The gnocchi was so overlooked that I thought they'd forgotten the pasta. The pasta was mush. The duck, which had been cubed and most likely flash fried in the disgusting, greasy, flavorless, grey sauce of this dish, was rubber. Plus, who serves grape tomatoes in summer when there are beautiful tomatoes in season? I had to send it back. This was not a dish designed by someone who has ever tasted good Italian food. So I asked for the penne instead (By the way, our server confirmed that the wine tasted funny and that the gnocchi was overcooked). Well, we shared my fiancées penne while we waited. When the second batch came out, it was obvious there was no quality control in the kitchen. The pasta was visibly different from the previous plate, lacking color and drowning in a watery tomato sauce. We didn't have to try it to know it was not worth eating. We sent it back again, this time asking for the check instead. We hoped that we would be comped for the meal, having endured this mess, but we knew that wouldn't be the case. We were charged for what we managed to eat and that I can say, was too much. After a walk, we returned to our favorite Mexican restaurant around the corner from Vite, where we are never disappointed.
the cuban food here is amazing! . b.y.o.b.
Healthy, fast and tasty.  Could eat here 5 days a week!
This place is adorable.  It has great GREAT fish, amazing platanos, and the owner served us and was incredibely friendly. I highly recommend this place. Cozy, authentic, and delicious.
Real Paleo food with amazing selection at a great price. No canola oil used, grain free bread and grass fed beef. It doesn't get better than this!

I judge a self-proclaimed European place by its ingredients, and primarily, by its chocolate. A $4.75 hot chocolate here is actually nothing but the Ghirardelli "hot chocolate" pack, made in a machine. Ghirardelli. At a EUROPEAN place. You'd be better going to The Bent Spoon and paying less for a truly artisanal hot chocolate (FAR superior to anything at Cafe Vienna), or buying the Ghirardelli pack and making what is essentially a hot (or iced) cocoa at home. The prices are much higher than the cafes at Palmer Square, which is the prime location in Princeton. If you really care about coffee, go to Rojo's Roastery, or Small World, or Halo Pub (they use La Colombe), where the owners know coffee and care about it. This is a cafe where no one even knows the origin of their coffee! You'll also get better coffee than this -- at one-fourth the price -- at Wawa or McDonald's. Pastries -- they are outsourced to an American woman. Essentially, NOTHING about this place is European except the owner and some of the recipes. The black forest is good some times -- cherries soaked in kirsch, cake is moist etc -- but at other times, it's dry, barely any cherries, no kirsch. So no consistency, which is hard for them to monitor because they aren't baking the things in-house.And it's nearly $8 a slice. For pastries, I'd head to Le Petit Chef or Chez Alice instead. They are serious pastry chefs, using good ingredients, and charging you a little less.

The best of the best. Great food and a nice family atmosphere. Talking to the owners is always great - and the staff is wonderful too. Ricotta gnocchi is my favorite, but I also love the caesar salad, calamari, fish and filet mignon dishes they have. And Cynthia's desserts are amazing.
My favorite pizza joint. Cash only, huge portions, and worth every penny. My husband and I have been coming here since we were kids. The best.
Great food, Great place to watch a game. They should make the places bigger because it is always over crowded.

Seemed like a decent enough place while in town for business. I was interested in the Reuben but didn't come across any reviews, glad I tried this one. Most places make below average versions with either too much flavorless meat or not enough sauce, sauerkraut and soggy bread. Everything was good about this reuben from the crunchy rye bread to the cheese, possibly the best I've had. Although it was enough for me the serving of coleslaw was quite small.
Saw the restaurant on AsianInNY.com and tried the first time. It's so good! Everything is in big portion and the staff are very nice. Will be back!
I have wanting to try this place for awhile and I was pretty disappointed overall. I don't get what the big deal is. The food was bland and nothing special. I've had MUCH better culinary experiences.

It's standard decent japanese cuisine. The service was slow but our waitress was sweet. we did get a free appetizer of spring rolls which was a nice gesture. The sushi was typical nothing really memorable though.

I have decided to try their special frog legs with garlic sauce. Now I have had frog legs many times from various places and I have somewhat an idea of what is good and not so good. I also want to be objective and not tarnish their image just because it is not to my liking. Just to point out I have a culinary degree from French Culinary Institute and I have worked in a few Michelin starred restaurants. This by no means makes me the ultimate authority but above average would be a good start. Anyway, I got the frog legs and when I asked them how big the dish was, the lady said it was a very big dish and enough for me. FYI I am 5'9 and 155lb. Surprisingly, this price tag of $16 did not include anything else, not even white rice. She did try hard to get me to buy white rice for an addition of $3. I declined thinking, like she said, the dish was big enough. Now this order was TOGO, so I did not have a chance to see what I was getting. When I got home and open the bag I saw a saute of small frog legs of 3 frogs, which, if don't already know, is 6 small frog legs sauteed with a few button mushrooms and garlic. THAT IS IT. The taste was about 4 out of 10 but the texture is where it went completely over the edge for me. The legs were dry and extremely tough. Now look, there are plenty of restaurants that can justify charging prices as such but this is absolutely not one of them. This is a whole in a wall with a very sad dining room which resembles something 3rd world tacky. How in the world was I swindled to fork over $16 for such nonsense which left me hungry and disappointed is beyond me. This was my experience with Larb. Now I would love to say that, maybe, this was a one-off mistake but having an item on the menu as such is a bad experience that is bound to repeat itself with many costumers to come.

Awesome burgers. I honestly think they are better than Shake Shack. In the very least, the buns are definitely a lot better than Shake Shack. Only one complaint that knocked out the one star is the fries. They're not very good (I think they're made from sweet potatoes?)... they're not crisp but are somewhat sogged with oil.... so go with the burgers at Bobby's Burger Palace !

I went to this restaurant for the first time to celebrate a friends birthday and ordered fish in a francese sauce; when it came I took two bites from the fish and it literally made me nauseas plus it was bland and flavorless. The waiter came to ask how our food was and I told him politely that I was pregnant and I don't know if it's my taste buds, but that I did not like the dish and wanted it replaced. He claimed that since I already ate from the dish that he couldn't bring me another plate nor remove it from the bill. I've never EVER had that happen at a restaurant...I would understand if I had eaten most of the plate, but I literally tasted the fish twice before I tried to return it. I can't emphasize how important it is to do right by your customer and provide good service, because neither me or my 3 other friends will ever go back to this place, and I will make sure to let everyone I know not to go there either. Needless to say I returned the dish and took my pregnant self home to cook something after paying for something I didn't like nor ate. Horrible!!!
Drinks are unique and strong. My tortilla soup was heavenly and inexpensive. Definitely coming back!

HOW does this place not have a five star rating?!!  I'm a HUGE fan of breakfast places and this place is the best I've ever been to.  Do yourself a favor and bring pajamas eat yourself into a coma and when you wake up you'll pick up right where you left off.  The staff works like a well oiled machine.  Just watch those guys weave in and out of each others way carrying all that delicious food!  I've only had lunch here once and it was still great.  Just make sure you do breakfast so you haven't left Montclair without experiencing euphoria.  The only thing I'd give a negative is that I couldn't fit the restaurant in my car when I moved.
Really, really loved this place. The food is delicious and the service is good and fast. I just wish they had some low carb options or could substitute the rice for more veggies.

Amazing pizzas, Great salads, great welcome :) Everything could have been perfect but what is this sparkling water at $8? Too agressive and not tasty, that could take away the flavor of the amazing food. Thanks :)

I am so pleased to see some of the positive reviews (and so disturbed to see the few negative ones; please try again). This authentic Mexican restaurant is a real find, lost in the restaurant abyss that is Bayonne (save a few Italian ones); as one reviewer says, a diamond in the rough. An extensive menu, generous servings, extremely pleasant (if not always fast) service. To call it, as some have, with no irony apparently intended, good for the area or great Mexican for New Jersey is really damni8ng it with faint praise. It deserves serious praise; if you like Mexican food and are anywhere in the vicinity, give it a try. You will come back again.

Great flavors in a very low-key atmosphere! On a Saturday night it was not very busy, but the wait staff was attentive and the food was so tasty there didn't need to be a huge crowd to enjoy the experience. The tomatillo salsa was outstanding, fish tacos were warm and tangy and the chicken enchiladas suizas were pronounced the best we have had!

They messed up my order yet again. I specifically said "extra spicy" and that I wanted an Egg Roll and they always end up giving me what they want. I paid $14 for my order and it is not spicy at all and when I asked for my egg roll they said that I did not order it and that I had to pay extra now. Horrible place. This is my last time going there and I will encourage everyone to do the same.

I have always been told that New York City has the best thin-crust pizza in the nation, so I went to try it out. I have so far been to the famed Lombardi's, Grimaldi's, and Di Fara's pie joints. Although they are  indeed great pies, they are STILL beaten out by the great DeLorenzo's. The key to their success is that their crust is indeed very thin. This is a huge plus for big tomato pie fans, but when it  comes to those who enjoy the Chicago deep dish, this may not be for you. Still, I ask everybody to try it. Their ingredients are top-notch, and they use crushed tomatoes instead of your standard pizza sauce, which adds a unique flavor that most other pies cannot beat. The only thing that  keeps me away from five stars is that, on rare occasions, the crust may be a little too burnt for my pallet. Once again, if you are a fan of an old-fashioned, thin crust tomato pie, there is no where else outside of Italy that can do it better.
The gestalt of the hummus sandwich was so good I neglected to deconstruct the sandwich to rate the hummus itself. Great quality, friendly, good service.

This restaurant is AMAZING. I had a vegan philly cheese steak - the bread was so light so the sandwich didn't feel too heavy.. and the soy steak/ nutritional yeast cheese were perfect! For dessert I had coconut cake - moist, DERRICIOUS. If I go back to Philly, I will go out of my way to come back here.

true gem of philly.  always perfect for brunch and lunch.  not expensive.  the food quality exceeds the price you pay.  coffee is always hot and delicious (i.e.brand la colombe ... that tells you the quality they inspire to achieve.)
Been there for several times mostly for brunch. Montecristo is my best and you will find not many places carrying this food and doing it right. Don't forget to add a fried egg on it:))

There is not enough I could say about Twenty Manning. Living just steps away I have become a regular here and have never had a bad experience. The menu is creative and the food is delicious. The open, airy atmosphere is the perfect setting to enjoy a specialty cocktail and unwind. I am looking forward to dining at their sister restaurant Audrey Claire.
This was our first time to visit Revolution Kitchen. My husband and I love this place. Great food, great service. I highly recommend this place!!

I took my grandma here for lunch and we both loved it!! The food was delicious. My grandma got the chicken breast triple-decker sandwich (chicken breast, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and mayo on toast). It came with a pickle and coleslaw. She really enjoyed it. It didn't come with french fries, however, which most sandwiches usually do at diners. I got a lunch special: spinach and feta cheese omelette with toast, hash browns (you can get french fries), and a cup of soup (Greek chicken orzo) all for $7.50. The soup was fantastic, and the omelet and hash browns were great as well!! Our waiter was very friendly. Although he had quite a few tables, he was attentive and checked on us a couple of times. The dining part of the restaurant was not overly clean-looking but nothing that would make me not come back. I spoke to someone who used to work as a waitress here and she said that the owner, Gus, keeps the back (kitchen, etc) very clean and keeping the front clean is up to the wait staff. When you walk in, there is no sign indicating how the seating works so I had to awkwardly stand there (my grandma is blind and so it is not easy to guide her between tables) until I could make eye contact with the waitress (who was not the most friendly) standing at the register and ask.  A sign would definitely help. Will definitely be coming back here with my grandma!!

Wonderful pizza, not to mention the service!  Everything was as good as it could be. We sat at the bar where we could see them making the genuine wood-fired pizza. The entire staff was friendly and generous.  One of the chefs making the pizza talked to us about making wood-fired pizza.  After we had our delicious Crudo pizza, our woderful waitress brought us a bag of cookies.  Sadly, I'm allergic to nuts, a main ingredient in italian cookies, so she brought me some soft serve ice-cream (I'm ten).  It was delicious! It was like vanilla, but with more depth.  Everything was magnificently perfect

I was very disappointed. I went here to enjoy a small lunch, a French bistro sounded good. It was 3 pm and still the BRUNCH menu! They could've at least put something that had to do with lunch on the menu because it felt like I was having breakfast all over again at 3 pm, the menu was pretty much just eggs! The only thing that wasn't eggs was the French Club, so I tried it. It was ok but I've definitely had better. The service was OK, but it wasn't worth it. Maybe I will give this place another chance but I honestly don't think it's worth it. There are much better places to go to in Park Slope, so don't waste your time at the Olivier Bistro. Try going to 5th or 7th avenue, they have great places to grab a bite over there.

Reading Terminal is a very large indoor market, with lots of restaurants stands, grocery stands, and stands selling a variety of other things. There's a reason it's popular with locals and tourists alike: this place is full of delicious food. It can get busy on weekends, and it's easy to get lost, but the food is worth it. Some of my favorite places are Beck's Cajun Cafe (great if you like spicy food) and Beiler's donuts, but nearly every place has great food. It's definitely not the cheapest, most meals will run you $8-11. However, this is definitely a must-do for anyone visiting Philly.

Tavern Pizza is Amazing!!!! This crust with sauté peppers and onions, with pepperoni and Sausage. They also have Gluten Free pizza. Buffalo wings are crispy and comes with Blue cheese carrots and celery.
The owner has the worst attitude that I have ever seen. Rude would be saying nicely. The food is ok at best but not worth having to deal with this character.

Allow me to tell you that I am never coming back here again. As much as I love xiao long biao, the fact that you actually came back and demanded I pay you the fucking 11 cents that I was short from the 15% TIP was WAYYYYYYYYY too much for me to handle. Not to mention the complete lack of real chinese food. Hunan/sesame chicken?  Overly salted string beans? Overpriced and NOT worth even 5 bucks in my book. Good bye.
Love this place. Fast and good. Perfect when time is tight and it's lunch time. I highly recommend. It is my lunch destination when I'm in the area
Delicious and amazing and everyone is super nice

Mamagyro used to be my go to for Greek takeout but I will NEVER order from there again! The quality of the food has plummeted and the food is always delivered soggy and thrown together. Last night I ordered my usual Greek salad with a chicken skewer and the chicken was unrecognizable and therefore inedible. So sad considering it used to be so delicious and cheap...not so much anymore!

Loved this place as soon as I walked in! The décor is far beyond what I expect from a strip mall sushi spot. The wait staff is fast and friendly and know the menu well (which is good for me because I always ask for recommendations). Food at this establishment tops almost every other place in the greater Trenton area. The all-you-can-eat lunch menu is a phenomenal deal ($18 per guest) and the food comes out fresh to order. I have been to Masa perhaps ten times now, and I have never needed to complain about the freshness of the fish/eel in my rolls. And the thing that finally sold me in was the price! I have never been billed more than 20 dollars at this place, and it never ceases to amaze me. For the quality of food/service that I get here, I would easily be happy to throw away thirty. (Of course, if that were to happen, I would have to give them four stars)
Tried to go there but their policy has recently changed to only allow hotel guests and people meeting them there in starting at 4 pm.
This place is great, the foods very traditional and homey. The staff is friendly, I love this place!
I was glad to find such good Mexican food in this area while visiting on business. Commentary chips and salsa fresh. Everything very good. Some interesting dishes incorporating lobster. Great flavors

Do not do diningin.com from this restaurant! The portions that are delivered are TINY.  I have eaten at the restaurant before, and our delivery is far smaller than what we received on our plates at the restaurant.  My $80 meal does not even cover half of our dinner plates.   I have ordered diningin.com from several restaurants and have had far better experiences than with Amada.  We will never be getting delivery from Amada again.

Cute place and perfect for lunch! Also perf for potato and cheese lovers! I got the veggie heavy and I loved the baked potato and the vegetables! I liked my friend's dish better though. She got the comatoser i think(?) and although it was not as healthy as the veggie heavy, it had more flavors! Cute place that fills you up with less than $10

Being here in US, you may never be able to exceed the said limit as you get some tasty sea food. Furthermore, Upstate owns this prestige to have city's well honored elite here and taste the food served. I came to Upstate back in July with some of my mates from office. It was an incredible experience which made me feel highly satisfied. Both; in terms of taste and liking of place, they excelled so beautifully that they are second to none and I really got impressed to them in such an excessive way out. I would recommend all my mates and other yelpers to come to this place whenever they get a chance to come to New York. This place will always retain its memories in your mind to which forgetting won't be enough easy.

I have come here many times, and have the exact same experience everytime, extremely poor and barely respectful service, and a 30 min wait to get a sandwich, which arent bad, but I cant wait for someone to open another sandwich shop in the hood.
Worth the trip, nicely surprised by authenticity and overall taste.
Pretty good food and strong drinks. Food took a bit long to come out considering the restaurant wasn't busy. But other than that I'm feeling nice and full. Can't complain :-)

Went here for lunch with a couple of friends and we were pleasantly surprised!! We all got a lunch special entree, which came with soup and a huge portion of food for under $10!! I got the egg drop soup and the chicken with cashews with fried rice. The soup was delicious.  The entree was great as well. Although the chicken portion of the dish had too much sauce for my liking, it was still good and the rice was very yummy. I had to take half of it home they give such big portions!! We ordered a California roll to share, which was delicious. They also have a bowl of crispy noodles and duck sauce and a hot pot of tea and teacups on the table, which was a nice touch. The service was great. We were greeted and seated as soon as we walked by the people working at the front at the registers. Our waiter was very friendly and our food was brought out quickly. The restaurant is big and pretty clean. The menus, however, were sticky, and a couple of other things around the restaurant looked like they could use a wipe-down, but nothing horrible. We will definitely be coming back!!
Eh - this place is ok in my books. Not very authentic, a little over-priced, but a more gourmet take. I went for dinner, however, and heard that the brunch is better.
Five stars for the date-lime-banana smoothie, which is worth walking 80 north-south blocks for. I've done this a few times and am overjoyed each time to see Taim's storefront.

Terrible service. Sat us 1 hour past our reservation time with little apologies. Sold out of nearly everything. I will never come back here. The condescending hipster waiters should lose the attitude too.

We randomly walked in here on the last night of SIPS and it was a pleasant surprise. Amazing food which was recommended to us by the bartender Justin. He was very welcoming, knowledgable, and friendly. We chatted with him a lot during our meal. The escargot and Cobia were amazing and we had the fish of the day. Which was skate and it was also really good. Very relaxed atmosphere. We will be back!
Long wait but well worth it. Food was excellent and our waiter Rich was awesome!! He gave great recommendations and super fast service.

We just cannot say enough about this little gem! We order takeout from there once a week and it never disappoints! We get the plate for 4 and have enough for all of us to eat lunch the following day! Very affordable and very good!!!
Awesome food!!!! Great customer service... I also love the smoothie!!!! The lamb & sambusa are my favorites!!!

I travel to the area every other week and try different places to mix things up over hotel food.  Sometimes $$$ and sometimes $.  I'm not that picky I tried the buffalo chicken cheesesteak.  It was awful.  I like buffalo chicken and I like cheesesteaks.  Once I could dig through the cheese, I found chicken.  Maybe.  Not at all interesting or tasty. So here I am a month or so later and figure that maybe they had an off night the last time.  Heck all the 4 and 5 star reviews cant be wrong. Ordered the 4 piece fried chicken dinner.  Get back to the hotel, put my bib on, set my place and ... 3 piece fried fish.  Fresh from the freezer.  And it was also awful. The order taker wrote chicken on the slip and mine was the only order being cooked.  I just cannot figure out what went wrong outside of not caring or maybe being able to read or both. Good riddance.

This place is the only brunch place worth going to in the city. It's that much better than all the rest. I've never picked something on the menu i didn't love - the combination of french, lebanese and american influences is executed perfectly. the portions are the right size - not too small and not offensively large like at sabrinas. The owners talk to you and their friends talk to you, and the atmosphere is intimate. You may wait for a while to get your food once you order, but it's worth it.

Foods awesome indeed, grilled cheese mozzarella would give a pizza a run for it's $, lol, love the tasteful soups & salads, very different & delightful flavors, not you're normal tomato sauce soups & salads, these are of superb quality taste
Food is decent. Staff is AWFUL. only exception is Alberto, he is phenomenal. One server Falicya was less than unpleasant. If you go in, ask for Alberto!

Rocky Hill Inn has become a staple for us...we're not quite regulars, but I think we're getting there.  The things I like about this place is that, for the most part, it's reliable.  A pub like atmosphere where you can sit comfortably at the bar and order from a decent beer menu...and, order dinner if you're so inclined.  The wait staff and bartenders are friendly so you get that neighborhood feel.  The menu could use a little change but is fairly diverse and the chef usually is pretty good with the evening specials.  The dining room in the back is nice if you feel like moving away from the pub atmosphere.     I've never been disappointed with the Rocky Hill Inn burger (RHI); although I thought the bun was too big last time.  The cheese board is a great way to start a dinner.

Tried the jjajangmyun. It was not good. The noodles were overcooked, not much pork in the sauce, and yellow radish sides were small.  I guess you get what you pay for.  Would not recommend for jjajang.

The best part about this place is the happy hour. The nachos are only 4$ dollars, and thats about what they're worth. At night things get a little hairier... Make sure you lie to the person taking people's names for tables. They have a ridiculous policy where they'll refuse to seat you if you have an "incomplete" party. They'll let anyone come in and sit ahead of you, regardless of how busy they are. You can walk in and put your name in for a table, seeing that one is open right in front of you, but if you foolishly admit you're waiting for another, they'll sit the next two people who come in. This applies to any group size. If you are a party of three and they ask if you're waiting for someone and you say yes, they'll seat the next three people who come in after you, at the table that has been sitting there open for several minutes, because they are a "complete" party. There are plenty of other mexican restaurants with better food in the area and if you're looking for dollar tacos, Interstate 95 has them on the same night, and you can sit wherever you want without having to deal with a bitchy manager.
The best Arabic food I've tried in NJ! Everything is delicious, more important is homemade!

This is my favorite Thai restaurant in NY. I am a frequent traveler of Thailand and I haven't found authentic Thai food very easily in NY. I have tried many but nothing compare to this restaurant. Best of all, the portions are HUGE! Do yourself a favor and try this restaurant if you love Thai food

Great Thai restaurant and here are the reasons for the 5 stars. -Friendly Service -Cute as hell ambiance -Crab fried rice, um I love you -To Go service. efficient and convenient -Consistency Was a favorite in 2012 and still a favorite today. Only wish that we lived closer to the west side. When we are too lazy to head into the traffic, we go to sri pra phai in Woodside which offers a lot of the similar dishes.
Good food.

Wow! Amazing pizza! Wait was outrageous (hour and a half) but that pizza was delicious. The bread is chewy but not soggy or over cooked. Cheese and sauce  was perfection and then they give you a cup of spicy peppers and Parmesan to top off the slice. The flavors were amazing! Worth the wait? I don't know but the pizza was something everyone needs to try once.

Let me start out by saying that I NEVER write reviews.  In fact, this is the first review I've written on yelp and I am sad to say that it is not a positive one.  I stopped in Burger and Barrel with my two sisters on a Sunday afternoon at around 4pm.  I understand this is an "in-between" shift time at most restaurants but that does not excuse HORRENDOUS service.  The server we had was not attentive in the slightest and quite frankly seemed annoyed at our presence.  After having to ask to water and silverware (not a joke) I said 1/2 jokingly that I hope we weren't keeping the guy here.  He responded with "Nah-- I'll be here all night" over his shoulder.  We were his only table (in fact, one of only a few tables in the place) but he seemed completely preoccupied sitting at the bar and hanging out with the other wait staff.  After we had finished our meals and waited patiently for about 20 minutes for him to come by, I had to go find him to ask for the check.  His indignant attitude and overall pompous demeanor is what put me over the edge.  Horrible service and a poor dining experience hardly justifies the over priced mediocre menu.  There are PLENTY of other delicious and well staffed restaurants in the SOHO/Greenwich village area that are far superior to Burger and Barrel.
Cheap, fast and delicious!!! What else?? Maybe the garbage outside that smell so bad...
Love this place the salmon is so good! Its beautiful. The wait stuff is so professional and remembered everything so well..   I must say that i will reserve this lower level for my birthday.
Perfect meal.  Will dream about the lasagna.  Great wine list.  Can't wait to return.

Went today with my sister and a friend. I LOVED it! Had the Seafood Malafemina and it was AMAZING! It was light and tasty, plentiful as well. The server was attentive but not overly so.
