The ambiance was wonderful, the whole experience was great! The appz we had were superb! The pulpo (octopus) was just perfect and so was the fig and Gorgonzola appetizer. The lava cake was everything I wanted and then some but then came the Tartufo and I just fell in love! I could marry it and  have its babies, that's how good that Tartufo was! Can't wait to go back again! :)

Food was just ok. Dining room was very slow, only one table other than us around 2 pm. I thought lunch would be busier, even the bar was empty. Ordered a vegetable pannini which was awful. Icing on the cake was the bartender sitting down on her ipad. I asked my server a question which she in turn had to ask the manager and the woman looked angry to even be there. No wonder the bar was empty!
Not sure if its the bread, the filling or the person making it but this place puts out some really good subs. If Im going to splurge on a messy sub its gotta be from Nicolo's.

The salads here are fantastic as is the friendly service! Try the Modena or the Spinach and enjoy outdoor seating or inside the cafe's cozy, well appointed dining room. I love that they support local artists by featuring revolving art installations on their brick red walls. Breakfast is served all day, brunch is available both Saturday and Sunday, and they incorporate fresh local ingredients into their specials daily. No matter what you are in the mood for, Gold Standard provides perfect casual dining.

WOW!!! Amazing food, great atmosphere, and never disappointed. The staff are very friendly, helpful, and aim to please. I also love all the bands that are featured. So much fun! Its a great place that has a city vibe in the burbs. Brix always has new items on special and that makes me happy that I can try new things. For me the Best in Belleville!
great pizza! cute town. definitely worth going if you are near or around Princeton.
Best diner in Hudson County hands down. You know a place is good when the wait is long and it's a regular day and no holidays.  Nice size portions

Fantastic place in lower Manhattan.  Food is great and service is exceptional; from wait staff to owner.  Excellent dinner no matter the menu choice.  I typically order off menu and always accommodated   Now in the Double Tree and they have elevated the room service offerings.  No need to look elsewhere!

I just thought we should have been treated better. So to start at the end... I ended up having a cold pork bun (my wife snuck it out for me) at the hotel and it was yummy.  It would have been better warm.  I also ended up sitting outside of the restaurant on the concrete with my 5 year old, eating a slice of pizza and watching an episode of The Office on my phone. We had bookmarked this place (we were on vacation in the city) and were excited to come.  We were able to get a table pretty quickly (it was that odd 3 o'clock hour) and upon getting there told the lady bringing us back that one of my kids would not be eating there.  We were holding his slice of pizza in plain sight along with a bag of chips.   We sat and the waiter asked if we were ready to order and we told him we'd need a minute and once again, let him know that one my kids would not be eating (he was already eating his bag of chips). Another waiter came by and we ordered some buns before ordering anything else.  He returned to give us some plates and we told him, again, one of our kids would not be eating with us and we brought his food (by now it's on the table in very, very, very plain site). A few minutes later, the buns come out and the waiter tells us, "We have a strict policy for no outside food." I understand the policy kind of.  It is the right of the restaurant to have this policy.  My issues with that day was, WHY ARE YOU TELLING US NOW!!!  We have ordered.  We are sitting.  We've had 3 employees aware of the Pizza on the table.  Since nobody enforced the policy until we ordered... can you cut us some slack?  Can you cut my child some slack?  We asked for an exception because we were not told until the food came out (we did not keep it a secret b/c we believe that's not fair to the restaurant) about the policy.  We were told again the same. So I ended up outside on the sidewalk eating a slice of pizza with my son trying to explain to him what happened and why.  Not easy to explain to a 5 year old.  I told him I was sorry that his Dad was angry, but not at him.  I told him the restaurant is not wrong in not letting him eat pizza there.  I told him there is nothing wrong with him eating anything different.  That's about as much as I could explain to him. I respect the policy.  I don't respect the restaurant and how they handled their own policy.

LOVE this food! They deliver though and I wish I could order it for delivery. The one girl who brought it to us one time (blonde curly hair, loud annoying voice) literally WALKED IN OUR HOUSE while she was handing us food! Then started talking to my children telling us stories about her two kids! mind you, this girl looks like she MIGHT  be 21, and she was telling me our children should get together for a play date!? It took me forever to shoo her out the door and even then I was afraid she was going to come back. Unbelievable! I want to order food from here so badly, but have avoided it because the last thing I want is her in the house again (delivery wise) if we do get delivery we just get maninnoes now. Their wings are very good too!
Very nice Service. Pork loin with pancetta was very tender and tasty. Pasta was also pretty good. I would recommend this place.

Oh man, this place is great! I went here for lunch and it was 22$ for 2 people, not bad! And soooo worth it! I got the mac and cheese lunch portion and the french onion soup which I was happy to hear is vegetarian! My boyfriend got the pulled pork sandwich, which he said was delicious. My meal was hearty, filling and excellent. The soup had a ton of cheese and croutons in it with fried onion on top. This is definitely not a health food place!  But if you don't mind the calories go for it! The decor is retro and cute. I also really appreciated that they labeled my leftovers with the   date and contents, thanks! I would recommend it and I will return!

this is as close as i can get to the place that i went to when i was in amsterdam  its not quite that but its really close if you have been to amsterdam and you had them i would recommend you try this place you won't regret it
I thought I knew what a cheesesteak was. And then I went to Steve's. All other cheesesteaks should bow to the King.
Great steaks!

So far, not so good. Had a party if for we were meeting. Place was half empty so not like they were crunched for space. Even with that, the owner made us wait in they lobby for several minutes till the last member of our party arrived. Very rude for a supposedly nice restaurant. Let's hope food and service are better. Food ok, but service slow. Wrong drink orders delivered. Best quote of the evening... instead of asking if everything was great the waiter asked if there were any complaints.

I was coming home from work and decided to stop into Blu Orchid around 9pm to see what it was all about.  I was  warmly greeted by the owner.  I decided to order the Pad Thai.  Although it wasn't directly on the menu, I get it with tofu which they were more than happy to accommodate me with.  Although it was a little more expensive than you can get in Thai restaurants around Sunnyside, it was definitely worth the extra dollar.  WHile I was waiting, they were very attentive.  The ingredients were very fresh as were the noodles.  The portion size was above average and everything was evenly coated evenly with the sauce, something you don't always get at other places.  I would definitely come back again to try the other delicious sounding items on their menu.  Great food, great service, great atmosphere.

Usually New Jersey nonsense.  A small "swank" restaurant in nowhere NJ.  The place was 1/3 empty, and no line, but, since we didn't have a reservation, it was an hour wait!  And, the hostess is always shocked when you choose not to wait. Stopped at Park and Orchard on the way home.  They're always dependably good, with good service.

By far the best food downtown Hartford has to offer. We go from time to time and the service is always is top notch. Table side guacamole = HEAVEN.  Can not go wrong with guacamole that you wasn't made fresh in the am and by dinner it has been in the fridge chillin'. Anything on the menu will come out fantastic. Feel bad for other restaurants in the area. Competition is fierce here.

I decided to go there and take a try because the good comments and ratings I see here. But the food came out really normal and pricy. I ate very little, they served us some bread at first, and the bread was hard so i couldn't even eat it, and the steak was so raw and tasteless. My friend and I only had two orders, and the price went up to $65, because they charged 18% of taxes automatically. We will not come back there :( The only good thing is their kind service!
the salmon is good.

Dropped in here hungover and in need of some real sustenance. I ordered the break room burger and break room fries. Place is super small maybe 10 seats at a counter that's it. After a few minutes I for a seat and the foods came. Very moist burger. Great flavor. Fries were loaded with a fried egg, bacon, jalapeños, and some secret sauce. Killer. Very friendly staff as well.

This place is pretty darn inconsistent. The restaurant itself looks gorgeous, but once you sit down, your experience will be a bit rocky here and there. Food: Be careful about what you order. The bread that they bring in? NOT complimentary like other restaurants. They don't tell you a thing, they just bring it over, and set it on the table for you, and will bring more if you finish a loaf. But it's four bucks per loaf. The food itself is -- like I said earlier -- inconsistent. Some dishes are good(such as the calamari, and the snapper), but other dishes are way too salty or glaringly a rip-off( the duck, and the market cobbler, which tastes like canned fruit). Simply put, it ranges from delicious to disgusting. Service: Sure, the waiters are attentive, but anyone else that is a part of management will REFUSE to do anything for you other than give you refills and take away your plates. They will not help you place an additional order, they will not help you order a refill of coffee, and will even give you an incredulous look or rude glare if you attempt to request anything. I'm not quite sure why my experience was so wildly different from these other reviews, but I definitely will not come back again after that disappointing(and pricey) meal. Hopefully improvements will be made and others will have a better time.

Without a doubt the best almond croissant in philadelphia. I've lived in paris, and this is the croissant in the city that equals the ones I had there. This is a special place doing amazing things that deserves a lot more attention!
Place is home for me and my family, having a special needs child makes it hard to find a place to go on a regular basis, staff is super friendly love the boneless wings
Excellent meal, friendly staff and champagne for my birthday, who could ask for more!

The thing that first drew me to this cafe was its look on the outside.  It has such a quaint feeling to it and so I had to check it out.   The espresso I got was good!  Dark roast, not bitter, and full of flavor.  No complaints about this.  I also got some food. I got a turkey panini.  I wasn't too happy with the fact that the panini wasn't toasted nor was the cheese melted, which is what I expect a panini to be.  It was more so just a sandwich.  It was good though!  Nothing special, but it was cheap and worth getting.  I would most likely get food from them again as a snack.   Overall, this seems like a wonderful place to hang out with friends or do some homework if you're in school, etc.  The lady working here was pleasant and told my friend and me about the open mic night they have.  I would have stayed to check it out, but I had to head back home to do laundry.  Perhaps worth checking out?   I recommend this place as a better alternative to the Starbucks down the street for sure.
All food was outstanding and the service was great!!  A must for a pie and Mexican Coke if you are in the area!!

YUM YUM YUM! First time here and I didn't want to leave! Best chicken I've ever had and their menu selections are great, even their customer service! I had the Bada Bing with Cajun Fries and it was soooo good, especially after a long day of work. Despite the system malfunctions they were having, an employee there by the name of Demetri did a great job maintaining amazing customer service and holding it together (I think it was his first night too!) Because of the awesome food and great employees I am MOST DEFINITELY COMING BACK!

Came with a friend for lunch. We both got the lunch special: 2 rolls and miso soup for $6.99...a great deal!! The miso soup was delicious. I got a shrimp tempura roll and a California roll. The shrimp tempura roll was excellent. The California roll, however, was not that great. It was pretty much all cucumber, with barely any crab or avocado. The service was fantastic. The waiter was very friendly. The drinks and soup were brought out almost immediately after ordering and the sushi was made and brought out within just a few minutes. The waiter checked on us a couple of times. We also ordered a roll for take-out and the waiter did not forgot to bring out the roll with the check which I was very happy about. The restaurant is small but very clean. The only thing is when you walk in, there is no sign saying whether it is self-seating or "wait to be seated" but the waiter was very attentive, greeted us as soon as we came in, and told us we could sit wherever we could like. So although it was not a problem, it might be during busy hours for those who are eating here for the first time. I will definitely be going back for the lunch special!!!!

Well the Sushi House has new owners and they have spent quite a bit of money updating the restaurant decor, which is lovely.  However, up went the prices, down went the quality of the rolls.  Less tuna in the Tsunami Tuna and less eel in the Dragon Roll, just to name a few.  Plus the stopped giving pineapple at the end of the meal.  Now even though it was canned pineapple, it was a nice touch and a palate cleanser.  We have been coming here for years and I would choose this over many other sushi restaurants in the area.  So, you can imagine our disappointment.  Not looking forward to finding a new place outside of my town.  :(
We brought in the New England and Manhattan clam chowders for lunch. These soups were over the top delicious!  Bravo to the chef! Can't wait to try other menu items!!

I've been coming to the Pure Health Lounge for a couple weeks now. They have really fresh food and really tasty smoothies. I honestly have gotten the same thing every time, which is an Asian salad and a Caribbean breeze smoothie, because it is so good. The service is really good, and the owner is present a lot of the time taking orders and handing out samples, which is really nice to see. I really wish that they had a combo deal where you could get a smoothie for a couple bucks with the purchase of a sandwich or salad. Overall great place, and it's definitely going to become a usual stop for me in New Haven.

A little gem right off Broadway with terrific wine selection, happy hour specials and exceptional hospitality!   We were fortunate enough to stumble upon it when looking for a place to grab a bite before seeing a show at Symphony Space.  Will definitely return there next time I'm back in that area and will most definitely recommend it to others!
Mood Cafe is still delicious, even two years later!The service is fantastic. The owner is incredibly friendly and more than willing to answer any questions you may have about the chaat and lassi.
Great environment, tapas style food, and funny music what more could you want?! It's a perfect place for meeting a group of friends!

They have been open for only 7 weeks as of end of August 2014, so I can understand how the first review might have been right, but my experience on week six was on the money. On our arrival at the location, we were impressed with the nice clean exterior of the building and colorful outdoor umbrellas in the rear outdoor seating area. There is parking right behind the restaurant. We were greeted and seated right away. The interior has been cleanly decorated with a few authentic touches that let you know this is a Puerto Rican restaurant. If you miss the few family photos, the background music is another clue this Puerto Rican food you are about to eat. The family photos also make you feel right at home. Our server was very pleasant, telling us that she was new to her role and enthusiastically said "we'll work through this together" which we did. It was not any work at all and she did a great job. At one point after we ordered our appetizer, two gentlemen walked out of the kitchen and immediately greeted us. They were the owners. We spent a few minutes chatting it up and they showed us around the place and the seating on the second floor, a good place for a party. We ordered the tasting appetizer which is really big enough for 3-4. It had multiple portions of several things which, unless you're familiar with the food, you're not going to recognize by name, so I won't name them. Let me just say that there wasn't a thing on the plate that we didn't like. The kitchen sent out a coupe other tasters that were not on the standard platter and they were great too. Nothing that was fried was greasy. Our lunches were authentic and tasty, with all authentic flavors done in balance. This is high praise for this cuisine as my wife is a fantastic cook and in the many Puerto Rican restaurants we've visited, she's has never come close to having praise for any of them. Yet this time, she could not stop talking about this place. Her exact words were "they nailed it!" It's a BYO-Wine which is another one of my favorite traits of a restaurant. Don't let the bar fool you, it is just a place to pull up and eat. Good if you're eating alone. Come explore this cuisine done well. We are going back this week with a couple of chef friends. I cannot wait.
Amazing sandwiches that fill you perfectly for lunch! Vegetarian friendly too! And Marie is always friendly and great!
Updating for customer service, thanks to Carver for reaching out!!
I could have the soft shell crab bun every day of my life, maybe even twice. A definite must if you're around.

Had really high hopes for this place since my friend said it's REALLY hard to get a reservation, needs to be on their email list and be a member..etc etc.   There was really nothing special...nothing, everything was just so ordinary that I don't even have anything to comment on.  It wasn't BAD...but it wasn't that great.  One suggestion to the owners, please get rid of ur furniture,  ppl are breaking their backs trying to eat off of your 2 feet high coffee tables!

Excellent food and service. We loved doing an impromptu dinner here with a party of 6, two of whom were tots. I'm giving them 4 stars because they didn't have highchairs. that being said, its probably not kid friendly but I don't see why that should stop anyone from having a great meal :)

Went to Bruno's today (Aug.28) at 7pm.  Two or three people plus me at the counter stools. Took ten minutes before anyone looked at me & took my take-out order of three meals. The girl listened to my three orders without writing anything down. "She must be good", I thought. Came back to me a few minutes later confused about my orders. So much for that. Repeated everything to her & sat there 25 minutes more before she asked me if I had been helped yet. Seriously? Then she discovers my take-out sitting in a bag right in front of her. Ok, so far, this has just been about her. My time waiting revealed lots more. Others had phoned in orders only to get there & find out no record of their order. Still others had gotten wrong orders. I got to hear it all. Lots of damage control. I finally get home to enjoy my chicken cutlet sub.  Supposed to have lettuce, tomatoes, & Caesar dressing. What I got was two paper-thin dried out pieces of breaded chicken on a roll. That's it. Dry. The breading was thicker than the chicken.  When I called them to complain, I got put on hold longer than I had patience, so I hung up.  A couple of months ago, I would have given Bruno's 4 stars, they've really gone down the tubes.  Total chaos in there. My sister recently had the same experience.  I won't be going back. Plenty of other places.

Our family meets here on Sunday mornings for a great breakfast, yes I said breakfast we love the Mi Ga. Be sure to ask for boneless if you are new and it's great to spice it up it you like hot just ask for the homemade Sate. Don't forget the ice coffee!

Lively east village spot with nice ambiance and good food. The sangria is deadly (in a good way!) tapas were delicious- 4 and an appetizer was more than enough for 2 people. Service was a bit slow and we didn't get any table bread or chips, but it's a fun hangout spot with good unique food

Bit of a small place but the wings are great, especially because you can mix flavors and create your own concoctions. They have specials on their wings during happy hour. - everything else is pretty good as well

Not only did I love the food (avocado tacos!) and drinks (best margaritas you can get!) here, but the staff was amazingly friendly and welcoming. I don't know what happened to these other random reviewers, but not only did I get my order accurately and quickly, but it was also with wonderful customer service.  Unlike the other odd people I've read on here, I took the time to ASK the names of the people helping, so I know it was Rob and Eileen that made helped make my day great. Sorry, but I don't think Rob's efforts to help customers pay for their meals is in the least bit sketchy.  I plan to spend a lot more time here and will definitely recommend Gueros to all my friends.
I work down the block so I've been here a few times. Last time they undercooked my steak so much I had it chucked for a burger. Totally disgusting (the steak was more raw than rare).

I cannot recommend the chicken lo-mein here enough. Many people have pointed out that the Pho is great, but I always go with this dish because it's $6, accented with cilantro, peppers and spices and the small is enough to feed two people. Definitely worth it!
Excellent meal.  We had the Chicken Under a Brick and it was exquisite.

After hearing about how amazing eataly is, we decided to make the journey and give it a shot... The shopping section is amazing! Very gourmet yet reasonable in options and pricing..  We had pasta calamari and a margarita pizza... The pasta was horrible. It tasted re-cooked, the shrimp was so over done you could barely cut into it and the sauce tasted like tomato purée. In other words, not the spicy zesty sauce the server raved of. The pizza was standard - with no awesome takeaways or remarks.. Overall it was a disappointing experience.

Stopped in here one day to grab some food as I did not feel like cooking that day. Got the Storachi wings and enjoyed them quite a bit. Ended up going back there another day and tried the Yum-Yum Wings which I would recommend to people to try. Much better than the Storachi. This place would get 5 stars, but the consistency of the wings can be a bit off in the way they cook them. One chef seems to put a ton of sauce on them while the other is stingy.

Simply put the best burger, beer and bar combo in Center City.  Centrally located everywhere the weekend tourist will be or resident hipster resides make it the perfect place to drop in when the burger bug bites.  There are many good things which surprised me about this particular location.   The interior is exceptionally well laid out in that there is lots of room between tables making it a great place to go if you are feeling claustrophobic from your SEPTA adventure or recovering from a long wait coming over from one of the bridges from Jersey at peak times.  Have a large group, the size and spacing of the tables will delight you (think German Brauhaus tables).   I also expected a few taps of mass produced beer to complement my burger and fries, which were exceptionally fresh tasting and made with care as I ordered them, but was greeted by at least 8 taps of craft brews from around the US - I went with an IPA I had never ran across which was outstanding.   Below the bar is a glass cased 'fridge with an equally impressive assortment of bottled brew.  Looking to watch a game and thirsty for something with a bit more bite or class, widescreen TV's adorn the walls and a full bar is ready for just about whatever you have in mind in the spirits or wine category.   Looking to eat and drink outside, this is your place as seats and tables out front await your tired, hungry fresh-air starved behind.  In summary, I went in on a whim hoping for a good burger... I left knowing I found a spot that offered not only a superb burger but also the ambiance and liquid nourishment I seek in the very few places I call my neighborhood bar when I'm in town.
authentic Chinese food
Mmmm

I came here with my boyfriend on a Tuesday night. We had tickets to a show at 7 and we got to Juniors at around 6:15, so we were in a hurry. We only waited for a little while before being seated. The waitress was really nice and was able to help me find a item on the menu that accommodated my wheat allergy. She was also understanding about us being in a hurry and gave us our check right when our dinner came.  Overall our experience was great and the food was good.

The food is alright, there are definitely P.F. Chang restaurants that do it better. The service is so-so. The bar staff is awful. Too bad this is the only P.F. Chang's in my area. Also, there's generally a long wait, not just for a table but also for the food.
Made reservation before going which was very helpful. Got the benedict Jane which was delicious!! The portions were good amount. Definitely will return.

Went here last night for the first time. There was nothing "bad" about it, but I was disappointed with my General Tso Chicken. Everyone has different cooking methods and different spins on a particular recipe and I understand that. The sauce was excellent. But, the chunks of chicken were so large and strangely shaped that it was awkward to eat even with a fork. And with no knife to cut these extra long pieces, it was a test of wills. However, the wonton soup and the shrimp egg rolls were fantastic! Great flavor. I usually prefer spring rolls to egg rolls, but I'd come back for these eggrolls any day. The other disappointment was that white rice did not come with the entree. It was a separate purchase. Still, I would return in order to try another entree.

Kochi is hands down one of the best Indian Restaurants I have been to, esp. in the central Nj region. Kochi provides a complete Indian culinary experience by offering Northern and Southern cuisine that are so flavorful and especially well balanced. Kochi's speciality as it's name suggests is with Kerala style cuisine. They offer specialities that I can attest to are better than what you can even get in Kerala! They have a wide variety and especially great seafood. They will also make items on request that are not on the menu. I've been there many times and always have been impressed. Recently I had ordered catering from them for 75 people and the food quality was superb. Thomas and Mathew are true professionals and passionate about customer service and your experience. Highly recommended in all regards.

Service and atmosphere are amazing. The food is prepared by world class chefs but I was never impressed taste-wise with any of the dishes. I've been to Gramercy at least 3 times and yeah, I rate it A-OK.

Great lunch specials: $12 for a big burger (or fish sandwich or whatever) with your choice of side (salad or fries) and a drink (coffee, wine, or beer) Beautiful space, too. Great for a quiet meal alone or an evening with friends!

I've had brunch as well as dinner here. For brunch, I usually get grits and blackened catfish with spicy tomato salsa. Once I tasted my friend's shrimp and grits and wanted her plate in addition to mine.  For dinner I've had the pan roasted salmon which was delicious. Nice place to go on a date. Mixed crowd, nice atmosphere and on a nice day/night dining in the backyard on the patio is really nice.
Food was delicious, service was great. Excellent stop in Montclair

Eaten here 4 times now, we have enjoyed every meal. Cocktails are tasty and the wine list is good. Stick to small plates for a really delicious meal. Avocado fries, lamb meatballs, golden beets are my favorites. I have had really good large plates but they can be hit or (an expensive) miss. Service is good.
LOVE their sushi esp the spicy tuna! anywhere else its okay but not as good as J&J's!

Hershel's pastrami special is the best sandwich at reading terminal market. While it's not an incredible value, it's better than anything at dinic's across the aisle and the best pastrami sandwich in Philadelphia.
First time had a whole fish in the US. Great food but so many people.

This place has absolutely amazing food. It's a bit spendy, but you get what you pay for, especially with sushi. I love people who try to claim sushi is better in some location than in some other location-- this is usually West Coast people trying to hate. I can think of a few things wrong with this... First off, I can see the ocean from NYC. Second, pretty much any fish you eat is flown in, even if you're eating it in Tokyo. This means you just want to eat somewhere that has access to good, fresh fish (hence having to pay higher prices), and Momo is definitely one of those places. Also, I was there the night of the infamous snake incident below and the girl happened to sit next to me. I thought it was a bit odd, but it's certainly no reason to give a one star review, especially when you said how good your meal was before this. If you have a problem with something like this, then you should speak up-- the owners and workers at this place are incredibly cool and helpful and I'm positive they would bend over backwards to help somebody if they thought they were in any way uncomfortable. For the record, the girl had the snake on her, sat down, and ate her meal. It's not like the thing was crawling around sampling everybody's meals... she didn't rent it shoes, she didn't buy a beer, it's not taking your spot, Dude.
We loved it, the service was fast and friendly. the food was very good and arrived in big portion sizes. We love the tapas and especially the Beet ravioli. Will be back

Really great drinks made in-house, bathtub style were the makings of a fun walk home.  Had my first plate of Loco Moco over spam friend rice - it was glutenous in the extreme but felt like the right introduction to Hawaiian cuisine.  Heaven for a haole.

Okay, so I'll be real. I've been dying to come here. I always see a crowd and I thought it would be great. The food is not great.  The hour Walt was expected...but man the food needed so much more flavor. Do yourself a good and go to mp taverna, or watawa

Bar Tano is my favorite restaurant in Brooklyn. The prices are reasonable, the food is UNREAL, and the drinks are strong and very delicious. The wait staff is always friendly and helpful. Never have to wait too long for a seat. It's also a great spot to bring a date. Bar Tano RULES!
this place is a dream come true fantastic chicken, wonderful side dishes and crazy doughnuts. Very reasonable prices! I try to get there once a month!

Went here a few times.  The food wasn't bad but it wasn't the greatest either.  I think they are trying to have the ambiance of being at the airport help diners overlook the quality of the food.  Like I said, it isn't bad.  There didn't seem to be much of any taste to the food or the gravy. It is, however, a step up from what it was before the remodel (and new ownership, I think).
Awesome food, service from Genesis was great! I would say the view is def spectacular. If you go, I suggest you take seating outside for the beautiful view.
Never sat down for a dine-in. Always order slices for Veggie and Chicken Pizza to take home. Ingredients in the Veggie pizza seem to fresh and tastes awesome fresh out of the oven!!
Went for dinner and their food leaned too heavily on sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and butter for flavor. Definitely not worth the $20 price.

We have been there several times, and each time is as good if not better than the time before!  Delicious food, amazing vegan soup, friendly staff.  Not a fancy restaurant, but truly wonderful food.  I highly recommend it!

I went here with some clients for dinner last week and it was very good.  The food is very fresh and good.  My clients were very impressed.  They were all from out of town and were impressed with the place.  This place isn't cheap- but well worth it.  The oysters were the best I've had.  The portions could have been a little larger.
Food was delish, and options weren't too bad for their lunch specials. I also love their outdoor seating; however, there is construction currently going on so it was a bit noisy.
It's an average place. Don't expect it to be the best kathi rolls ever.

The staff are very friendly and super quick.  Its an open kitchen so we got to watch the cooks whipping up our combo plate dinners. They have a large selection of American Chinese restaurant favorites so each of our group got to order our favorites.

Great spot for a date. Food is really good. I had the lobster lasagna and it was delicious. I would also get delivery and order the Thai wrap which was also good. But the place is nicely dimmed. Food price is a decent price. A little more to expensive but the food is worth it.

Came here for dinner twice and both times were really good. The food here is pretty good but it really depends on what you order. The two times I was here, I ordered 2lbs of the shrimp, cajun style and lemon and pepper. They tasted the same to me. DELICIOUS.

Came here for a happy hour one day and went again last night for a sit down dinner with friends and family. The atmosphere was very pleasant and there was live jazz playing during the middle of our meal. They had a nice selection of things on tap along with specials for drinks and our waiter made sure we were topped off when we started getting low. The food was delicious from the appetizers we ordered to our meals. The menu has a great variety of options. We are definitely going to be coming here more often.
Best egg white omelets around !  Everything here is delicious, I love their tuna salad over the Mediterranean salad ! delicious!

Wonderful service. Beautiful atmosphere. It's a great price for brunch $15 for eggs Benny plus the free drink was pleasantly shocking for the neighborhood! I recommend this to anymore who appreciates a beautiful atmosphere accompanied with great food.

Sooooooo loud & Sooooooo tasty. They put us in a great part of the restaurant near the window and brought us some delicious bread. Waiter was attentive and careless. We had a great conversation about the meaning of life and i nearly went deaf because there was so much boisterous conversation going on all around. Black paste made my tongue black ish....it was a date dinner....made me not attractive. All the same, there's nothing like fresh pasta, and this stuff is out of control good!
good brisket, can order it lean, cornbread is good, wide beer selection. mac and cheese unremarkable though.

If you live pizza you will LOVE this tour! Just finished the tour today and had a great time learning about the NYC pizza scene and the how and whys of pizza making. Scott and Alexis were very fantastic tour hosts and our "pizza group" had a fun time. Next time I am back in NYC I will definitely take this tour again!
Absolutely delicious. Everything was incredibly fresh and easily the best hummus I've had in a long time.

Love, Love, Love this place...especially when someone else treats. I prefer less expensive places usually, but this is a great special occasion place.  We eat out a lot, so it is nice to have that kind of place on my map.   The food is amazing, and they always let their staff taste everything.  It is part of how they do business.  They want their wait staff to be able to describe the food. Because of their knowledge of the values of the restaurant and community of which it belongs to shines through.  I love their use of local grown produce.  GIve it a try.

La Viola is an Amazing BYOB the waiters are excellent and will do anything for you they will also keep your beers and wines cool and bring you one when you are getting low, lovely Italian food best I have ever had an would highly recommend it to anyone! 10/10

I had never heard of this place, but my friend had eaten there, and, frankly, it was close to the theater where we were going, so it just made sense to eat there....walked in last night and the place was packed!  We took a table upstairs which was a little less hectic.  started out with a cocktail called a Southern Belle.  Champagne, strawberry something, and mint.  So incredibly delicious!  Not a frilly girlie drink at all...lovely, lovely strawberry essence and slight flavor, with the champagne cutting through whatever extra sweetness there is...I could have had 5 or 6 more of them, but ended up (only!) having 2.  We started out with the Shishito peppers, which were swathed in oil and cruchy Maldon salt.  Served along side was a grilled lemon half, which when squeezed on the peppers gave them just the right citrus-y tang.  Only issue here was that, while most or the peppers are not spicy at all, we were told that once in a while there was a hot one hanging out in the bunch. MThye weren't kidding about hot!!  Since I am not a spice girl, that ended my Shishito pepper experience.  Dinner brought the most divine, sexy, juicy, delicious, huge, properly cooked burger, which shared the plate the the most sensational, duck fat French fried potatoes.m Holy shit!  And the truffle aioli dipping sauce for them wasn't exactly shabby, either! Other than the noise level, which was practically deafening  this place really can't be beat!

The skirt steak and the mussels were awfully awesome! I was worried that the waiter might not like me because i dropped my fork and asked for a new one, but he was super cool and made me feel like I was special as a customer and human being. The ambience was more West Village than French. And I know because I've been to Paris, albeit a long time ago before my life changed so drastically for the worse and then got better again. Anyway, the food and waiter here made me very happy so three thumbs up!
Very good thin crust pizza.  The entire family liked it.  A little pricey- but very good.  Service was very good as well.
First timer and fell in love. Every entree and app was great! Wait staff fast and friendly  great ambiance! Highly recommend!
They get one star for having bad attitudes. They should have got no stars but that's not possible with yelp. Their drinks are always inconsistent. I'm highly disappointed

All-time favorite pizza when I want a simple Pizza Margherita. Now they have a gelato and soda shop around the corner called GRAZIA BELLA.  Just opened a couple days ago (posted: 8/28/2014). Tried the cheesecake and had an herbal tea. Good stuff -- rich, moist, satisfying.
great pizza if you're in the mood for fancy pizza. restaurant is good enough to go on a date. classic italian

4 blocks from the hotel. Alone so got in after about 10 minutes. Life is good! I was mistaken when I said they take credit cards. CASH ONLY Be prepared to wait a while to get into this hole in the wall, unless you're alone. Once you get in though, it is so worth it. If you need comfort food and wanna slap your mama - this is the place. They do one thing, noodles, and they do it exquisitely. Party in my mouth!
ESTHER IS AMAZING! Service was impeccable! Food was incredible! This is a must in Queens!!
Great wine flights and really good French food. Atmosphere great and service really great. My new favorite in NY.

This place has to be the best Dumpling i have ever tasted. Price is cheap,food is good,fresh,and a very nice portion. If you're in the city, stop by try some. Just remember that the place is very small, i would suggested taking it to-go

Great lunch, Duck sandwich was wonderful.  Will be going back again for dinner with my wife.  The only reason for the last star being left out is because of the dated decor, which I understand will be renovated soon.   I hope so!

We arrived early for pre theater dinner.  I ordered a cocktail of vodka chilled with fresh lime which was well prepared. Their method of charging was bizarre as they charged $4 extra for "up" saying they had to use more alcohol.( I may have preferred less since we were going to the theater).   The waitress explained that the dishes were for sharing.  We ordered two medium dishes.  The octopus was very good but 3 small pieces for $18.00 was way overpriced .  We told our waitress that we do not eat meat or poultry.  She told us there were a lot of dishes for pescatarians. She suggested the squash minus the chorizo.  It was not very satisfying- about two bites worth  not enough to share.  For the main course we ordered the black bass.  While eating it, there was something unusual  in the dish .  It was dark and therefore unnoticeable on the plate.  I thought it tasted like meat so I took the last piece out of my mouth and asked the manager what it was.  He said it was sausage.  I was rightfully upset since the waitress knew what our dietary concerns were and I had not had a morsel of meat in 15 years.  The manager apologized but in a perfunctory  way and belittled my distress.  He took the dish off the bill but became quite rude and abusive .  His attitude was unconscionable - totally uncalled for since the error was theirs.  I would never return to this restaurant nor would  I recommend it to any of my friends.  It was perhaps the worst dining experience that I can recall.

I went there for breakfast and was not impressed. I ordered a pork roll egg and cheese, it was ok. I was excited when reading the reviews and finally thought I found a good breakfast place in Philly.  It was not terrible. They offer toppings such as spinach and broccoli rabe which is a nice addition for your sandwich. I would probably go back, but I still hope to find that perfect breakfast sandwich spot in Philly!
Gale's is 5 doors down from my house and it's very pleasing to the stomach.  Can't eat it everyday cause I'll be big as a house but I wish I could.  Do something nice for yourself and eat at Gale's.

I went with a few friends and the Hostess said that there will be a 20 minute wait.  When it got close to 20 minutes, she goes it'll be another 10 minutes.  Few minutes rolled by, then she goes, the table is ordering dessert, it'll be another 10 minutes.  It's been almost 40 minutes and we have been seated yet.  We left the restaurant hungry and went to another one down the street where they sat us right away.  Never again going there.
Ok, this place is the shit!  Amazing Sushi, friendly service, fair prices. I'll be back for sure!  So happy this place opened instead of another pizza or cheese steak place.
Very unconventional indian restaurant with great food and awesome take on drinks. I was extremely impressed.  A good date spot with an intimate environment.

Logan's offers a great selection of food and desserts, but what sets this place apart is the incredible service. It is run by truly friendly people that have always made me feel welcome. The food isn't inexpensive, but you truly get what you pay for -- it's prepared fresh and everything I've had has been deliciously worth it. Don't overlook this place the next time you want to eat near the waterfront. It's quick, easy, friendly and has a great patio to sit on. Help support these wonderful people.

i love belgian fries, but this place didnt blow me away, considering the fact that they specialize in these. they do have a large variety of sauces to choose from, so that was fun at least :D i got the rosemary garlic mayo.

In the Geno's vs Pat's debate I side with Pat's because they have less neon (they just installed a neon sign a couple weeks ago) and the owner is not outwardly an obnoxious racist (I know Joey Vento is dead.) Seriously though you have to be drunk or starving to think the price and quality of these cheesesteaks are good. It is not really that hard to make a good cheesesteak but somehow the  place that invented it just makes an okay one.

I know that this is a local favorite (and my father-in-law's) but I personally don't feel the pizza is as good as it was in the past.  The food is filling but only okay.  We've had food catered from here and I've been disappointed.  Prices are pretty good and they do try to be accommodating as best as possible.
Service was great!  The food was brought out super fast and the drinks were strong.

I wish I could give this place a negative star review. I went with two other friends for brunch not long ago. The food was good, and the atmosphere seemed cool, but the service was atrocious. Having worked in the service industry I'm normally very tolerant when a server is obviously overwhelmed, but our server was not only straight up rude, but she told us to get our own water when we asked for a refill. Also, when we told her that she had split our bill incorrectly (we had clearly written on the bill how we want to total to be divided and on what card), she got huffy and did not apologize or offer to correct the mistake. When my friend tried to negotiate with her she whipped out her cell phone, took a picture of us, and muttered something about "not being welcome back." I sent my other friend over to try and make peace with her (and delete the picture from her phone), and she told him to "sue her." I tried to call the manager the next day to smooth things over, but the number listed on their website is disconnected. Tl; Dr: Don't bother with this place. Sure, it was brunch time, but the place wasn't near full and nothing excuses the aggressive and bizarre treatment we received from our server.
One of my favorite happy hour spots. Love the sweet potato ravioli and calamari! Staff is friendly.
Was a great find.    Excellent food!!!    Almost missed it because of the signage.    Up stairs is opened while the down stairs is closed.    Don't pass it up!!!

So I came on a Thursday nite, and order the crab cakes as an entrée. The entrée came with 2 crab cakes and 1 side (I choosed french fries). The crab cakes tasted blah n it was burned underneath it. I would give them another try but for $28 for 2 crab cakes I will definitely pass. Never again. And the waitress wasnt all that good. She didnt check if we needed refills at all. Only came when taking our orders n when bring our food. 8/29/14: Was contacted by owner since he wasnt satisfied by my review, USE CAUTION IF YOUR NOT GONNA GIVE A REVIEW HIGHER THAN A 1 , he will PERSONALLY EXPRESS HOW BOTHER HE IS RATHER THAN APOLOGIZING FOR THE UNPOLITE EXPERIENCE!

We went with a group of 10 people to Bank & Bourbon, which can be daunting for a wait staff, but you would think there were only 2 of us the way they managed to take care of all of our needs.  The wait staff was very attentive and made the experience even more enjoyable.  The restaurant is beautiful.  The ambiance, décor, and style is one to be enjoyed, with an amazing bar.  To the most important part...the food.  It was delicious.  I am a huge steak eater and would put this at the top of my list for places to get steak in Philly.  It was cooked just right.  The sides were delicious, I highly recommend the potatoes.  The appetizers:  we tried everyone on the menu and we all could not stop talking about how good everything was.  Each and every thing I tried was better than the last.  The dessert was melt in your mouth delicious.  I would have like to have eaten everything on the dessert menu, but after such a good dinner that would have been impossible.  The drinks:  The wine was amazing.  There was such a big selection to chose from.  The best bourbon drink I've ever had: The Secret Knock!  Even if you aren't a big whiskey drinker, I highly suggest trying one of these.  I've have never enjoyed a drink more, and can't wait to go back and have another one.  All in all it was one of the best dining experiences I've had as a whole.  I would urge anyone to go and try their food and drinks.  Kudos to Bank & Bourbon for having such an amazing restaurant.

Have been here a few time and I have yet to be unhappy. The turkey sandwich is very good and the chicken is amazing it has so much flavor. The owners are great friendly people. When your here you feel like family.
Great food... I could survive on the labneh and tabbouleh alone, but everything is delicious!
Everything was amazing. Beans have enough brisket in them that you don't need to order more but you should anyway

This review is entirely for the service I received at Mercato on Aug 16th 2014. Apologies for not saving the receipt (that had our server's name), but this has to be the worst service I have ever experienced at any restaurant - I hope it's that server and not the restaurant! It was my girlfriend's birthday and I decided to invite all our friends for a dinner at Mercato. I was really excited about this place (after hearing really great things about it from my friends) and took the extra step to convince all my friends to carry cash for this place. Since, this is a BYO place we got 1 bottle of champagne, 1 bottle of white wine, and 1 bottle of rum. Of course, the first thing we asked our server was to open the bottle of champagne. He opened the bottle right away. Please note that at this point he never bothered to check that we did not have any champagne glasses on the table. We had regular glasses at the table (not enough for the group) so we waited for our server to get either the champagne glasses or at least provide enough regular glasses on the table - assuming that he could count the number of people vs. the number of glasses at the table. Another note - he never bothered to get us ice buckets for the bottles. Anyways, we waited for 15-20 minutes until he got back to get our orders. We asked him to get glasses and ice buckets for the table. That took another 10 minutes - and the glasses he got were so dirty that we decide to share the clean ones between couples at the table.. After about 30-35 minutes (from first sitting at the table and all the above fiasco) he took our order for appetizers and entree - never specifying that he will be bringing both the courses together at the table. When the food arrived, we each had two orders fighting for space. The food was far better than the service - I wish our experience was not spoiled because of the server and I could give Mercato a higher-rating (probably a 4).

I don't know how all these food critics blast this place. You are in NH not, TX,AZ or anywhere near the Mexican border. For a place loaded with Gringos, the food was good, the chips and salsa were quite good. The drinks were fine and our waitress was exceptional. I am not thinking that this place try's to promote itself as a five star restaurant, so cut them a break!

What can I say that everyone else hasn't already? This is my favorite (note, not best) restaurant in Philadelphia. The soup dumplings, pork noodles, pan fried napa and pork dumplings, and scallion pancakes comprise the perfect meal to cap off a rough week. I was concerned that the quality or prices would change in moving to the new digs, but to my pleasant surprise, it's still great.

I love the food! I personally don't eat meat so it usually hard for me to find a restaurant for dinner, especially one which can cater to my dietary needs. But the staff is very pleasant and go above and beyond to explain to me what items I can and can't eat and what substitutes they can do for me. I also would highly recommend the Papaya  salad, it is very tasty!

I've never left a yelp review before but must explain this experience. I order delivery from this restaurant today and they came by around 30 minutes later with the food. Noticing that the bag was small I opened it and saw that the majority of my order was missing.  I called up cranky because I realized that it may take double the time for my food and explained my concern to the person on the line. I also first tried to cancel the rest of the order but they promised me food within 20 minutes (I honestly think it took maybe 15 min at most). The OWNER had delivered the missed items by car and he comped me for the error. The food was beyond amazing. I'd normally never give 5 stars for a mistake but these people clearly care very much about the quality of both their food and their service.  So five stars to them!
I've eaten at this place a few times and the food is relatively good. The prices are a little on the higher side. $9 for string beans is a bit much.

Had a great dinner here with my wife. The place was busy, but the staff was super attentive and friendly. They had a great and inexpensive food special going which included a drink - too good to pass up. The absolute highlight was the s'mores cake dessert. Wow. Char No 1 in my book.
the lamb is great, the chicken is kinda plain. they put too much rice and pita bread and not enough meat. but it is one of the better halal foods of nyc
Just good!!

love their food! such delicious food made, only thing is delivery can take long but no wonder when they're busy. service over the phone isn't the friendliest but other than that the food is excellent.

We really love this place.  Great Italian food. Who would not love it. Fair prices. Friendly wait staff. We come here often after work. The pizza is really great. So we share a few pies and a few bottles of red wine.

I went to Nixs for a lunch meeting today.  I love tapas style restaurants, which I didn't realize Nixs was, until arriving. The three of us ordered a couple dishes each, for the table to share. Everything was out of this world! I think my favorite would have to be the lobster rolls. The way the chiefs present the plates  is really classy and upscale. The place still had a laid back atmosphere though. It's a really unique spot . Our server Michael was on top of his game, very attentive, very informative. All the ingredients they use are as local as possible. Even the beers are from local craft breweries. If I remember correctly, they had at least ten on tap, which I found impressive. I was recommended to try the Hooker Irish Stout. I'm so glad I did. I read in a previous review that this restaurant blast techno music. In our experience, they had nice, slow, jazzy, bluesy tunes playing in the background. I thought it was nice. I can't say enough good things about Nixs. When you're taking clients out to lunch often, you don't always want to spend an arm and a leg. I thought the check at the end was certainly reasonable. I think this might just be my new favorite Hartford spot.

I hadn't been there in many years. So my family and I decided to try it out. First impressions dark and dirty. It's a bar, with a almost empty dining room room in the back. 1st item, french onion soup. Bottom of the pot salty. 2nd item Nachos. Very little near meatless chili. no guacamole, and cheese sauce. My wife got the coconut shrimp, it was good. My daughter got 5 under cooked mozzarella sticks. My son had the Jersey burger. A $10.00 burger should have a generous beef patti. Where's the beef! I had the chicken marsala. The chicken was tough and over cooked. The sauce was dark brown with no hint of marsala in it. More like salsbury steak gravy. The powdered mash potatoes just finished the dish. I also thought the prices were on the high side. we had 2 half priced beers and 1 soda. The bill was $77. All things considered, I wont be going back there anytime soon.

I have never in my life seen such an unprofessional staff. Please hire people with some education because it is very sad to have to use the restroom while the person I was with was pregnant and wanted to see the menu, she then didn't see anything she liked and was yelled at by a woman of larger frame " if you just wanted to use the bathroom don't make pretend you are gonna order"  Never in my life have I ever heard or could fathom a person of hospitality saying those words... Seriously need to pull it together.
I work right nearby and this place has become my go-to lunch option. Great food, great service!
I had the carrot cake and it was the best i never had im my life!! The prices are reasonable and the owner so nice and sweet. I would definetely go back to try the rest of the goodies!!

I really want to give this 2.5 stars.  On a good day it would get 3.5 stars but one of the problems is that it's inconsistent.   On a bad day - this place seems a little dirty, the staff seems a little miserable, and the prices can be a little high for what you get.  It can be slow too.   I've had amazing cold teas here, and I've also had weak coffees. Typically the soups are good, however.  I have a ton of friends in the neighborhood who are regulars at this place but some of that might to do with the fact that there's nothing else around.   Also - I am strictly commenting on breakfast and lunch, not dinner.

Have been here twice now, both times it has taken 15 minutes and focused determination to attract any waiters' attention. After being served the cycle repeats itself all the way to asking for the check so you can find any other place to go for drinks. It's a shame because the spot is really great, wish management could find good servers.
This place is outstanding ! Goat tacos the bomb ! Awesome patio ! Mucho margaritas ! Great salsas ! Fantastic menu. Great brunch menu. I highly recommend this establishment.

This place was great. Very helpful staff. GREAT MENU. I went in for brunch on a Friday afternoon with some friends and everything on the menu looked and sounded delicious. We all had our own dish, but we decided to split an order of the Red Velvet Pancakes, which I highly recommend. I went with the Eggs Benedict because as far as I remember, I'd never had eggs prepared this way and decided to have it on a whim. DELICIOUS. No alcohol, and I'm pretty sure it was BYOB but the food was so good that you won't even notice its absence from the menu. Enjoy!
Place is nice and the food is decent.  I wish they would correct the spelling errors on the menu.
This is one of my favorite restaurants - no matter what you chose on the menu you will not be disappointed. Start off with the snack menu and work your way through to dessert. Great cocktails too!.

It honestly pains me to write this review, but I think it needs to be said. As someone who has celiac and rarely can find places that I can eat out at, the first time I went to Do or Dine was INCREDIBLE - the server knew his stuff, helped me and my friend get everything possible that I could eat. It was one of the best experiences I've had in a long time. So naturally I spread the word to everyone I know with celiac and praised this restaurant. Then I visited a second time. While not all servers know a lot about celiac, I went down my usual path of explaining what I can't eat. The first course that they brought out I took one bite and there was bread. The first time in over 10 years that I've had something breaded in my system. I'm honestly not trying to be dramatic, but when something like this happens to me I'm out of commission for at least a couple weeks. So I asked if they mentioned to the kitchen that I couldn't have gluten and the response was "oh, sorry, I forgot." Which was unfortunate, but not wanting to have my friend leave before getting her food, I stayed and just had water. A week or so later I thought that I should just let Do or Dine know about this experience because I still couldn't forget how amazing my first experience there was, and really just wanting to let them know so that it doesn't happen again to someone else and let's face it this place could seriously rule! So, I wrote an email explaining everything and how much I adored this restaurant for all that they did the first time I was there and how I was hoping this second visit was just an unfortunate incident. And I sadly never heard back! Not a word. I was so disappointed by this, and It's so sad because I want to love this restaurant so much, because it's a great place, the food, aesthetic, people, all of it could be so wonderful, but if something like celiac isn't taken seriously and then never even responded to, I just can't support it. And I had to write this so that other people know.

First and foremost, last night was my first time ever setting foot into Fat Buddha. My immediate reaction to the crowd and the atmosphere - this is home. What later went on to enhance this feeling was the way that the staff interacted with the customers, the drinks were superb, the music was on point. What more could I want to celebrate my 21st birthday? Thank you to the Fat Buddha family for making my birthday one to remember! I'll definitely be back for more!

(Delivery experience) Bleak "Mediterranean" ingredients sloppily thrown into a bowl lazily shimmer at me... First reaction, "Ewww..." Soon, calmer minds prevail with the understanding that looks can be deceiving... Ultimate truth; I am hungry, and hummus, chickpeas, pita; all the basics seem to be here. How bad could it be? Consume... Ultimately only one ingredient was lacking; any basic understanding of how to prepare quality Mediterranean food. Disappointment shifts to annoyance. Honestly this is disrespectful to all who have actually tasted an honest representation, and worse, a sad attempt at gentrifying it. This was weak, weak, weak! At least an honest "Americanized" version would have SOME infused flavor! Throwing bland hummus on top of a mutilated pile of grilled onions, a tiny bit of sad chicken and 7 chick peas does not make a Mediterranean dish! It more importantly does not make a good dish! Honestly, try harder or go away...
Just attended my Fantasy Football Draft here...the staff was AWESOME and the amenities they offered our group were fantastic!
Incredibly good. I tried the brisket platter and the bahn mi burger which were both perfect. This was the best meal I've had in Astoria in a long time.

Very disappointing. Rude person taking orders on the phone and was told there is a $30 credit card minimum. To me that sounds crazy! Terrible customer service. Don't bother since there are many other places that treat customers well.
Mexican food is my favorite! But this place is so 0 (1-10), the food is greasy, the meat is like eating gum, the guacamole is old... I have never eaten such a bad food like in this restaurant.

I've never written a review but I must say the most horrible customer service, not once, not twice but three times and today just took the cake...it was the manager that was pretty rude! I guess the apple doesn't fall far from the tree...his words...after we said we've been there three times and never knew we had to asked for a table (as we were seated at the bar this time) his response, take it or leave it...and you don't need to come back if you don't like it. Confused?? Who talks to their patrons that way. How does that saying go, be nice when you're on the upward because you just might have to kiss the same people as you go down...with his customer service...bet he'll be wishing he was nicer and taught his people to be nicer. The most horrible place for customer service! I could think of better for a much more pleasant experience.
chicken parmesan was below average, $23 tilapia was just ok, lunch sandwiches are just bad - any deli would make better sandwiches. I'm not going back there for lunch or dinner.
My food took over an hour and 15 minutes and I'm still waiting. Will never order from here again

Good place to have a cup of coffee and sweet are good.  I didn't like cake today very dry and way to much sweet egg was added.  The parking xan be an issue at times. The bakery is very clean which is always s plus for me.

Everything at this dump was a zero star experience, save for the onion rings which were good. I have eaten here twice, and tried two different burgers, the hot dog, fries, and onion rings. Tourists and out of town business travelers - don't get sucked in by the convenient location - you can walk a few blocks to several better places. The prices here are way off and the food is completely bland. I hate saying things like this, but fast food burgers are cheaper and actually taste better than the slop you get here. And, to boot, it takes 20+ minutes to get your food and the place is filthy. Pass.
Overall, great place, food, ambiance and more. And, the prices were reasonable -
Thankful this place is only a couple blocks away from work. Food is really good. Combos are inexpensive and they give you a good amount. This will definitely be my go to place for lunch.

Came here because of a yelp $15 for $30 deal. There's also check in offer of a free glass of wine if you order fish which we did. The St Petersburg grilled fish was really good as was the lamb dish that we ordered. Service was great. Decor was very cozy. Would definately come back.
It was OK - not great - not bad. Got charged for Guac I did not order. Rather unfriendly.

I agree with Dennis.  This place lacks just about everything you want in a real Italian deli or shop.  The portions are light at best and they really seem to have some sort of Jesus complex about their food.  The older man that was in the kitchen, who barely seemed to speak English, looked like he hadn't shaved or showered in days.  Not the type of person I want handling my food.  And there was some really hyper woman there gabbing about her vegan stuff, at a place called "The Flying Meatballs"... this seems like the dumbest place to launch vegan business. Food was just ok, store wasn't even fully stocked and while it looked nice, its all show.  Go to Esposito's, this place will be closed before the year is over and for good reasons.

Awesome breakfast!  In town looking at schools.  What a great find. I will definitely go back.  Sausage was amazing, and toast tastes like homemade.  Love the fact you can park...unlike downtown.  Really cute "authentic" diner.  Highly recommend!

Finally got to the lobster buffet which is well known in the north jersey area. Fifty some dollars per person on a weekday night is a relative bargain for the elaborate display of food complete with ice carvings. Your dish is promptly removed after each time you finish your selection, and the selections are extensive ranging from a split of a small lobster to prime beef together with pasta pork and many other selections. But stick to the seafood, shrimp, excellent smoked salmon with capers and onions,and oysters. The lobster salad stuffed into a small lobster tail was very flavorful as was a creamy sauce with a small lump of lobster and a shrimp served in a tiny crock. The only compliant that I have is that the steamed half lobster was over cooked.
OOHHHH MANNNN. What can I say about Burrito Bar..... simply the place is AMAZING. The atmosphere, food and drinks just SPECTACULAR!

I sat there for 20 minutes before a server even acknowledged me and there were only a couple of tables and several servers. The table of 5 next to me all ordered and got their drinks before anyone even said they would be right with me. Finally when she came around I asked her if the sirloin or ribeye was better and she said she had no idea. I opted for the sirloin which looked good when it came out but was so tough I could not even chew it. The knife struggled to cut through so that was a bad sign. The baked potato and veg were good though. No dessert menu but server named off what they had. Lemon pie was ok but I've had way better from Sara Lee. For hotel food I should have stuck with nachos I guess. But after a long day of moving my daughter in to UVM I was famished. Bar area was very loud and I could hear a lot of dirty jokes being told and there were children eating near by. You can charge the meal to your room which is nice. Prices were kind of high, especially for a steak I could not eat and the server had an "oh well" attitude rather than offer me something else.

We ordered the steak medium rare, and it was excellent.  It also came with bone marrow, making it possibly the most decadent steak I've ever eaten.  The exterior was charred VERY well (how hot does their broiler get?), and the doneness of the interior was perfect with a section of layer of pink, and reddish center.  The meat was very tender, and had a great flavor to it, especially with that char and bone marrow.  I was definitely not disappointed.

Best veggie burger I've EVER had!  the veggies were cooked to perfection and the FLAVOR was magnificent!  I will certainly go back there.  I've already started spreading the word to my other vegan/vegetarian friends!
Im about 45 min away from east Hanover but I'll definitely take the ride back to eat here. Place is clean, kid friendly, and great customer service
The food here is ALWAYS amazing!!!!! Our server Natasha was AWESOME!!!! Great service!!!!!!

Escargots with garlic butter and pastis are a must have!  Never had them that way and it was a delectable choice. They were really delicious.  Also had the goat cheese salad which i really enjoyed as well. My friend got the steak frites. The meat was tender and the fries crisp.  The food and service were excellent, the decor is romantic. The location is super practical as the F, G and R trains are right there at the 4th avenue/9th street stop.  The restaurant even has WIFI! Perfect for lunch meetings and just hanging out for coffee. Glad there's no huge TV to distract the eye like in other restaurants I've been to recently. Love it! I will definitely go back to Olivier's.
Their food is delicious and rich. Pricing isn't over the top. Ambience is good, but they turned away more guests than they seated. They really need to be on servedbystadium
If you get nothing else, you have to have a dark & slushie! The bok choy was great, too. Great place to chill with friends or in a date.
Delicious and crispy pizza!! Great service, fast delivery!! Definitely the best pizza in town!! Great job guys!
I really liked both the food and the ambience!  Must haves include the edamame dumplings, Brussel sprouts, and housemade churros!
First time i bought sandwich from here and it  is so fresh. Great little restaurant in a nice neighborhood. Stop spending money on chain restaurants!! Support small businesses!!

Fantastic service and food. They have outdoor seating so you can be immersed in the hipsters that walk by. Daily 10$ specials such as lobster roll. Salmon with maple walnut crust was amazing. Steak frites outstanding! Truffle French fries were something to write home about. We made a reservation and they had our table ready and waiting. Reasonable prices for great food and service.

I have never been so excited about fried chicken in my whole life, and Black-Eyed Sally's didn't disappoint. The chicken was so tender, juicy, crisp, and extremely flavorful. The Mac and Cheese was the best I have ever had, and the greens were cooked to perfection. I have never had fried green tomatoes before, and I will defiantly be ordering them again. The only issue I had is that because we had it delivered it was kinda cold. I can not wait to try everything on the menu.

ok the food here is amazing, boneless fried chicken was incredible and the fatty tuna belly was some of the best nigiri ive ever had, that being said the waiter totally ruined our experiance. Disclaimer - he seemed very knowladgeable about the menu and was quite attentive and the staff in general was great, water topped up fast etc however.... our waiter had a very bad body odour situation that was noticable to the point of making me nautious, then the icing on the cake we received the check and put down our $$ assuming we had tipped $25 on a $130 bill not a huge tip but $36 of our bill was saki so we felt it was a fair tip. Our waiter asked if we needed change and we said no. he returned to our table almost immediatly with change and in a very rude tone asked if the service tonight was not good. we said yeah service was great, he snatched the change back up and walked off in a huff. Realizing somthing was obviously wrong i approached him and asked if he wasnt happy with our tip, he responded that we had only left $15 and he had counted the money mutliple times i appologized and explained our mistake and tried to give him an extra tip to which i was told "put ur money away" i tried to insist but he wouldnt accept the money so i just left and extra $10 on the table. Now i understand there wasnt really anyway for him to tactfully say he had been badly tipped but he left me no option but to feel like an a$&hole when i tried to fix the situation. so in summary wont be going back
The best place to have a pizza in brooklyn especially a square slice(s). Its not even lunch and i still had to wait on line. Love the slice when they are freshly made and wsiting for me.
We moved from NYC where we had a really great Thai spot and are so pleased with this place now that we are in Clifton! Great pad thai and Tony was super nice. We will definitely be going back!
I have ordered food from there to be deliver to my apartment, they came in a good time and the food was delicious. I will be ordering from them again.

Did the staff smoke their breakfast? I like smoked breakfast personally. Smoked bacon. Honey smoked ham.... but these guys... They seemed spaced out and it was just weird. We had a similar experience to other reviewers where the employees just seemed to not know what was going on, and had to ask repeatedly what we ordered, etc. The guy didn't even know what came with the meal we were ordering....He said...umm...I have to ask you a couple questions about that breakfast....we were like, eggs over-easy, and bacon. Done. Was it really that hard? Like I said, they seemed like they smoked their breakfast. In the end we were double charged on the receipt for an item. Not a huge deal, but just illustrates that these guys just aren't paying attention. The employee (maybe owner?) at the cash register, laughed it off and apologized saying something about not trying to rip us off. The donuts weren't anything special. They were square, but not anymore delicious than your average round ones.
This place was awesome! I totally coming here. :)
One of the best places for a sandwich in Philadelphia.  I had the roast pork, sharp provelone cheese and spinach.  Order this as a pork with sharp and spinach.  Next time I will try the cheesesteak.
El Pabellon. Delicious. I wish it was less expensive though, but overall, I'm a fan.

First of all - they should be commended for their success in removing that god awful stench in the weird faux health food place that was there prior.  I really thought it was there for good.  Kudos.   This place is okay.  It really is the only restaurant like it over there so it does well.  I like the cocktails and the bartenders.  There are too many kids here during the day but that just comes with the neighborhood.   Ironically enough, while most of the food is on the blander side, the Squid was insanely salty.  I'm talking, my blood pressure went through the roof as I was eating it.  Tender though. The farro salad should be called arugula salad with farro because well, farro isn't the main ingredient.  It's good though, for lunch.   I noticed one of the guys from Chinos works there now.  He's THE BEST.  I appreciated that his boss wasn't up his butt when he came out to say hi and chat for a lil :) Oh!  I left my phone there once and they took care of it for me until I picked it up.  Friendly neighborhoody staff.

Who doesn't love this place. Food is always amazing with good size portions and the margaritas are very tasty. Always loud and crowded and sometimes the wait is annoying but you could hang by the bar and get a drink in the mean time. One of my fav spots.

This is one of those hole-in-the-wall places that usually turn out to be a nice surprise.  Ani is no exception.  We tried the Mazeman, Ani Ramen and the Shoyu.  All were a bit salty but generally very tasty.  We also ordered the pork bun which turned out to be the star of the meal.  Service was very good and the wait was reasonable for a Friday night.

My wife and I just tried this place for the first time. It was absolutely incredible. The food was made fresh to order and was amazing. They have an awesome craft beer draft list!. My wife is not able to have gluten and they were able to do almost their entire menu gluten free, including having excellent gluten free pasta. I would absolutely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great date night meal!!!
good prices on drinks !
The hamburger is the best thing on the menu and it is the best hamburger in Park Slope.
One of my favorite restaurants that I keep going back to, over and over.  Love the polenta, spaghetti, and panna cotta.  They also have a great bread basket.

AMAZING soup dumplings. No longer need to venture to ChinaTown to get amazing soup dumplings. Really awesome atmosphere. Pork fried rice, crispy beef and hot & sour soup were also all on point but  the dumplings out-shined them all.

Where to begin with this Gem of a restaurant.  First issue is scoring a reso, once you've done that sit back and enjoy.  Yes its pricey and Yes it will be crowded at bar and yes you may wait 10 mins to sit, but its all worth it as your escorted into what feels like a townhouse.  We were seated upstairs which was beautifully decorated. For apps we had a few of the crudo which were so well seasoned and fresh it litteraly melted in your mouth...flavors popped left and right. we then had three pastas - garganelli, bucatini, and the capalacei.  They were all 10 out of 10!  Spectacular!  We wanted more!(back to that in a minute) for entrée we had Octopus, Branzino, and a pork chop all fantastic but PASTA! So we did what any four Italians would do, skip desert and we ordered Another Pasta!!  This time the spaghetti and agai  PERFECTO!! Running back to L'Artusi the first chance I get Best Meal in a VERY Long time
My favorite bar

Food is good, but every time I come here they screw up something in the meal ticket. Charge me for something I didn't want or forget to add a topping I requested to the order, etc. Also, just saw one of the two line cooks joking with his buddy and grab him around the back of the neck. All in good fun cuz they're just playing around, but he went back to cooking with his buddy's neck sweat all over his gloves. GROSS! Hope my burger was done before that.
Best food ever. Good customer service. Lamb gyro platter is amazing. Portions are huge! Wide variety of options on their menu.

One of my favorite Starr Restaurants in Philly, which serves awesome American food. So far everything I've ordered there was fabulously made. Lovely neighborhood. Sweet staff. Great for family and friends gathering in its super adorable garden. Just make sure to make reservations in advance ~
it's fucking good
