My daughter & I had a rare Friday off together and decided to try Tiny Elephant for breakfast. It sounded very cute & charming.  We only decided to go late morning and wanted breakfast so I called ahead of time to ask if breakfast was served all day. There answer was YES. We arrive at 12:20 and saw the breakfast items on the board but was told breakfast stops at 12:00?? I stated, I called earlier to confirm and was told breakfast all day. Here's where it gets disturbing...they never acknowledged or apologized! I was so taken back, No I'm sorry for the inconvenience or misunderstanding or anything! I didn't want to be confrontational considering is was a outing with my daughter so we begrudgingly ordered lunch.  The place is cute, the food was fine, the atmosphere was nice but they really really need to work on their customer service. Very disappointed.
crunchy. Good.
Great pork appetizer.  The atmosphere is fun and energetic. Sitting on the bar is recommended as you can see how quickly Raman is prepared. Not sure it worth the 30 min wait at 11pm.

I am updating the review for TRAIF. We went back (for the umpteenth time) and we are SO HAPPY! We went back because of our experience at the sister restaurant and we didn't want to stay on a medium note as we love SO MUCH Traif. We love ABSOLUTELY everything about this restaurant. As I wrote in the previous review , we moved in Williamsburg to be at very close walking distance from it. Every dish is fine and prepared with an unparalleled alchemy. We love Beca as a server as her energy makes the whole experience a must place. If we could, we would rate it a 6 stars...

It's absolutely amazing. It sucks that it changed from 5 pieces for $1 to 4 pieces, but whatever! I still love it to death. The pork and chive fried dumplings are made to perfection and so are the sesame/chive pancakes.

Remembering Paisano's as a pizzeria with a juke box in the back as a kid growing up in Rutherford back in a day, I wanted to like it when they transitioned into a more upscale, bistro-type eatery and the downtown became a restaurant destination of sorts. Having not been in town for several years when I first visited the new Paisano's, they did not disappoint. Visiting them numerous times the past several years, Paisano's never disappoints, including our last visit a couple weeks ago. Consider it a reliable, go-to dining choice. Deceiving in size from the outside, the restaurant is spacious on the inside, split into two parts and a backyard patio. There is also seating out front. The exterior is well done,  a classic, upscale bistro look and a welcome change from its original storefront.The décor is tasteful, running somewhere in between casual bistro and upscale restaurant and is byob.The wait staff are always on top of taking care of diners wine service.  Pricing lies somewhere in between moderate and pricey, but is good value nonetheless. Pasta is made fresh on premises, or, at least was. They likely still make pasta in-house. Typically, my visits include four or five other people, and everyone comes away happy. There is one waitress there that is on her game and is fantastic-I wish I could remember her name-she is usually there on Saturday nights. Things we ordered multiple times include the Apple & Endive Salad, ($6.95)  stuffed eggplant ($7.95) and Caesar Salad ($6.96) for appetizer /salads. Price is about right for the portion size and quality. Entrees we have enjoyed are Zuppa de Pesce, ($29.95) Linguine with white clam sauce, ($22.95) Chicken Parmesan ($21.95) Branzino, ($27.95) Penne Vodka ($18.95) Grilled Salmon, and other seafood specials. Once again, price is about right for the quality and portion size. Paisano's is not one of those pretentious upscale restaurants that equate small portion size with quality.....and high prices. One of our diners loved the Branzano, another Pear Ravioli. ($20.95). One of our diners thought even the chicken parmesan was outstanding. Tiramisu, chocolate mousse' and creme brulee' are always very good. Like most restaurants, there are occasional glitches: One time, my father had to wait almost 30 minutes for his salad-the restaurant must have run out of greens and ran to the market for romaine lettuce. Another time, I waited 40 minutes for gluten free pasta-and an extra $6 charge- Again, likely prompted a trip to the market. Getting seating you want isn't always greeted with immediate enthusiasm. However, these are manageable bumps in what is usually a positive experience. Paisano's will never be confused with a classic, four star, Wine Spectator restaurant. That being said, Paisano's is steady and reliable and might be a better choice than fading top Italian restaurants in NJ like Scalini Fedeli.

Typical crowded hipster joint but no arguing with the quality of food here. Yes, you will likely have to wait a few minutes no matter the time or day but the food (burgers in particular) are worth it. Good coffee too, usually get a latte via the walk up window when im around.

Very impressed with this new coffee house.  Very friendly and attentive staff, a variety of different fresh sandwiches, and the coffee is also very good.  Small inside, but cozy. Hard to find a spot like this in my area.  I will definitely be back.

I don't care what anyone says this place is wack!!!!! Let me start off by saying I had a reservation!!!! I have been trying to get to this place for the past year and I think there was a reason why I wasn't "destined" to eat at such a crappy establishment. Got there at 10 pm on a Saturday night and I expected  it to be crowded. I went over to tell the hostess that I had a reservation, he told me to hold tight for a few minutes and he would seat us. I waited in the bar area so he would see me. He made eye contact with me a couple of times so I know he saw me. My friend and I waited until 10:30 and he went up to the same guy and was like hey man what about us? Mind you a group of five people came in way after us without reservations and they were seated immediately. I wonder was it because he knew the people in said party? He then tells us that he in fact did forget about us! Wow! Really?!! Anyway I was so annoyed by all of this by the time we sat down. Then our waiter took a long time to even acknowledge us because he was running his mouth to another co-worker. He finally came with the bottle of tap water that is placed at each table. I was ready to order the braised short beef ribs and then he tells me that they just ran out of the ribs!! Are you kidding me?!!! Maybe if they sat us down at our table right away, they might not have run out of ribs. I told my friend it wasn't meant for me to eat here and the waiter suggested the steak. Ummm no I came here for ribs, I don't want any dang steak!  We ran out of there so fast! I will never ever patronize this business ever in life. It's like every time I go to a black owned restaurant (not all but many) the service is crappy. We had a nice rental car and took our business up to harlem and enjoyed some real soul food at Amy Ruth's where the prices were better and service was decent as they greeted us at the front door. As for soco  this place is socorny! Child boo!

Another part of the max group. Nice place, located in summer set, literally right next door to Max Amore. The menu is pretty diverse, from surf & turf, to a burger. Always multiple happy hours and they have lobster tanks market price and local selections of oysters. The ambiance is casual white tile walls and metal fixtures with booths along the outer walls and small tables mainly 2 tops. Horse shoe bar & top shelf. They have outdoor patio. Pretty pricey, but the only place for seafood lovers in gbury.

When I saw the trendy Halo Halo all over insta, i was so excited! This halo halo tastes like milk and cereal! It was disgusting!! $10 too much for this bland, milky, nothing tasting "dessert" they litterally just get rich off throwing left overs in milk! Horrendous!n
Did a beautiful job on my sons cake! It was gorgeous and delicious! A thousand layers with 3 creams inside. So yummy! Great job staff!

One of the best Italian meals I have ever had. I ordered a pasta with ragu sauce and sliced portabellas. Unbelievably delicious. Finished it off with a homemade tiramisu and espresso. Some of the best food I've ever had. Service and atmosphere were second to none. Food was prepared in a very reasonable time and the owner, chef, and server all checked regularly with me to ensure I was happy. Excellent restaurant.

Originally, we thought of a 4 stars... Although we encounter a few bummers during the night and this morning after having unslept on it... we are giving a 3 but really because we like Traif (same owners). First, it was really cold inside. The AC was over cooling the place and it did not establish a comfortable mood for our dinner. Cocktails were good but the only disappointing part is that with the ice cubes cocktail you really drink it when you are almost at dessert... Which is not a cocktail / aperitif anymore. The toasted black sesame - almond with house tequila was good . The food comes first ready, first served , as Traif. Until there no problem... Except when they forget one of the most important ones : the sliders. The bone marrow taste was good, maybe not melting enough like butter and the beef tartare was not good. The butterfish hamachi was good, the Mexican spicy edamame was good. The Coconut tuna was not pleasant and almost frozen... and the Brussels sprouts are fried so it removes all that deliciousness about them. Life and food is about balance... Not here. The scallops were good, the foie gras was good, the ribs were ok. We are still cold with goosebumps all over our arms and waiting for the sliders which never came. Meanwhile, someone refilled tap water on our bottled sparkling water. What a waste. One of us expressed it and the manager brought some sparkling water from the gun bar (sorry, that does not replace bottled sparkling water with minerals). We thought of leaving at this point but again, because it's the same owners as Traif, we thought of not leaving on a bad note. So we gave the desserts a try. We got the tres leche carrot cake and the maple flan. And that was good !!! Pfiou.... Something at least alchemic and as fine as you can find next door. But one of us could not digest the food. He got sick during the night, and another one is still trying to calm an unhappy stomach. We will not be back, we'll keep it at Traif only.
This is not Korean. Don't try it.  Not worth the money.  Michelin has not figured out how to rate Korean cuisine. undeserving one star. Money well spent for an undeserving experience.
Nope, sorry, this doesn't qualify as Mexican food.

I have been here many, MANY times in the past, and I have never received worse service than I did tonight.  I know the bartenders decently well and at the end of the night, the bar decided to do last call around 12:45am (when close says 2am).  I was fine with this as it was not a busy night for them.  However, toward that time, I was having an in-depth conversation with a person that I had just met.  All of a sudden I hear my name in particular being shouted across the bar "**************** come pay your tab, NOW!!"   I was SHOCKED to be honest.  And this is the reason that I will never, EVER return.  It was not only embarrassing for me, to be called out by name to pay my tab (when I tip VERY generously because I come so often), but also completely threw me off with the person that I was trying to network with.  (Had a great opportunity with a job I was looking for). Along with that,  I had met the owner several times, and have had many conversations with him.  For about the seventh time, I had to introduce myself and shake his hand.  Now, if you were a good business owner, don't you think you would remember your customers.... especially if they were regulars.
Pepe's is epic. A true New England legend. Search "101 Best Pizzas in America" -- #1? Right here. Deservedly so.

We went looking for a romantic dinner in this Italian restaurant. We are from Spain and we have a lot of good italian restaurants there. We have to say tha the food was was ok and the waiters were very kind, but the place was crouded and our reservation for two people resulted in a table in the middle of the restaurant, where the waiters were not able to move around and they have to move us to allow other people to go to the resterooms. Besides,the owner was a bit rude. We would not recommend it and we won't go again...

Been craving for dim sum like crazy so we tried this place today...service is terrible, they don't understand what we ordered and the food came out not what we want..and forced us to order everything...The food not even good at all...terrible terrible terrible..never come back here again

Say Cheese has been at 30th street station on Friday's for the month of August. I finally got to try it today! I had the Grilled Chicken Caesar Pita. It was delicious!  The chicken was marinated perfectly . The Caesar dressing wasn't too overwhelming, it felt light. The people working were nice and in great moods. I hope this truck comes back in the fall!
very delicious!

I live in the neighborhood and came back from an event out of town. Just needed to eat something before I crashed, so I stopped in and sat at the bar. Had the country pate to start and the grilled salmon they were running as a special as my main. Bartender was really cool and tried me on both a red and white by the glass, both were interesting and really hit the spot. Haven't tried the dining room yet but it looks so cute back there I will definitely be back with friends for a more elaborate dinner!

Went to vivo with a Groupon (paella and a pitcher of sangria for two). The Groupon stated the sangria was for the large picther and we received the small one. Which was most upsetting as the sangria was one of the better parts of the meal. We ordered shrimp stuffed peppers appetizer which was very good, Definitely the highlight of the experience. Our paella came out and while it looked appetizing the first bite made me squeamish. Not only was the seafood all overcooked and dry, but there was an unpleasant crunch of uncleaned bivalves and a fishy taste unlike i have ever experienced. To top it off our server was completely inattentive, the bus girl deserved more of a tip than him. She was at least pleasant when removing our full plates of "paella". I Don't think I've ever had an experience quite like this one. Will not be returning to vivo ...ever

There is about 15 to 20 minutes of queue everytime I came but the food is REALLY WORTH IT!! The lamb and the rice are delicious and it's so cheap that it must be hiding something! Ahahah I wrote a complete review on our blog just there: theeyefocused.wordpress.…

This location meets the standard of Cheesecake Factory.   The inside interior and ambiance are the same as other Cheesecake Factory locations.  Foods are great and portion size is BIG.  I ordered the Fetucinni pasta with sundried tomatoes and my boyfriend ordered a rib-eye steak.  I liked the pasta more than the steak; it was creamy, warm, and sweet from the sundried tomatoes. The steak seemed very typical, nothing special and it was OK.  This place is packed.  You should expect to wait for a long time to get seated and high noise level.  It's not an upscale, high end restaurant but still you can have a good time with our friend.

I don't know what everyone's raving about. Food was ok. We had mixed olives for appetizers, my husband had the lamb shank for entree, and I had the lobster ravioli. Everything was so-so, especially for the price. Best part was dessert (tiramisu).
Cheese board was ok... Beers were great! Service was lousy unless ur a regular ... Very fun atmosphere it seems if ur a local in the area tho
Food horrible Owner nasty and unpleasant food inconsistent

We went inside and were greeted by a strange smell. It smelled like pee but I don't really know what it was. I don't know if the employees could smell it; maybe not, since they're around it all the time. Or maybe they don't care. Gross. We ended up following the hostess to a table outside (because I was quickly losing my appetite inside). The waitress seemed annoyed that we wanted to taste the beers they brew on site. She came with one recommendation but think she felt obligated to do it. They charge $1.25/sample. This is fine if you know about it up front, but I didn't see that anywhere on any of the menus. Every place has a different policy on tasting so I shouldn't be expected to have to read minds. Found out when I got the check. Not a huge dent in the wallet but communication would've been nice. The waitress wasn't rude, but we felt really rushed. Maybe she was really rushed. I think she probably didn't have the staff support that she needed. Management should know that an overworked waitstaff is going to give poor service. Maybe she's better when they're not understaffed. Food was fine. We had a BLT and fries. They were good, I mean, it's pub food so I'm not expecting Gordon Ramsay to come out and start swearing or anything. The beer itself tasted really watered down. Every single one. We each picked one we liked from the samples but we were pretty underwhelmed by all of the beers we tasted. We tried to like it but, y'know, meh. The "Forbidden Fruit" was decent, and probably one of their better brews, but even that was just meh. Probably wouldn't go back there again. There are other places around there with good food and better beer.

Really unimpressed. The food was average and the service below-average. We wanted to love this place but we were served tasteless three heart salad, truffle fries that are not nearly as good as those down the street at 116 Crown, and greasy Thai (why??? didn't taste Thai to me) crab dip... When the server brought over the Windex to spray down the table next to us, we knew it was time to ask for the check.

We love Tito's in South Orange. The Mac Daddy is amazing and the steak nachos are to die for. Their tacos are scrumptious. Their chips are always fresh and they have a great selection of salsas. Overall, Tito's is one of the best restaurants in the Oranges.
One of the best burgers I've had. Tasty well cooked meat and a great bun. The burgers are simple but delicious. The potatoes are addictive too. Definitely my go to burger spot in the village.
Authentic Greek food served by authentic Greek people. Love the food, the ambiance, and service. Two thumbs up!

We had the best time at this new hot spot! The manager hooked us up with free samples of all the apps and the waiter NICK was phenomenal - Attentive, funny and very knowledgable! We were completely impressed and we'd absolutely come back!
Don't bother with the sushi . other items below standards  where is gordon ramsey when you need him

So decided to stop in and try a cheese steak at ginos steaks, what a disappointment figured coming from NYC it would be better than anything I could find back home. NOT!! First off the meat is sliced not chopped, had no flavor, the bread was weak and really didn't stand up to the steak, not even toasted, the onions , tasted like they came outa a can , the cheese ( got provolone ) again no flavor and not even melted, Oh and where are the peppers man, cant have a cheese steak without peppers! All in all very poor , I can get a better tasting cheese steak from papaya king on the corner of 42nd and 9th for $7.50 with fries and a drink. And to be fair I went across the street to try Pats king of steaks same crap! Final word can get a better cheese stake for half the price in NYC

Been there many times and I keep going back ... Love the food there, best chicken in town. Very well marinated, appetizers, sea food everything is good. I love their green spicy sauce. They have very good cocktails as well. Service is good, very well maintained. I never had to make reservations as I mostly visited during the weekdays, place gets pretty crowded but still there is room for more. I have heard during the weekends it's very tough to get in unless you have a reservation. I would recommend this place hands down.

Would not recommend this place.  2-3 hour wait.  Took my phone number and never received a text or call as they stated. Plenty of tables were open in the restaurant.  Process for seating people seemed very inefficient.
This place is incredible it is a favorite of myself and all of my friends if you have not tried it you must.

If you like a thick sandwich this place is for you.  I go here every few weeks and get the roast beef.  Hands down the best deli sandwiches in the area. The price isn't bad either considering they definitely don't skimp.

Went here for lunch today. We  sat outside and saw one table of people sitting inside. Bread (which was tasty) was served only after we asked for it. We then had to ask for olive oil to go with it. I ordered the gnocchi ragu. The food was good but the service seemed harried. There were very few vegetarian options though the selection for non-vegetarians seems good.  I may try it again but wouldn't rush back.

I was impressed by this IHOP here in Bloomfield. The waitress Destiny was on top of her game no mix up in the orders or anything. The food was well prepared so I'm pretty happy it went well plus it was crowded but time was on key.

Although a few businesses have occupied this location, they've always been bagel places as far as I could remember.  If I ever go out for breakfast, I usually go to big chain restaurants.  However, I decided to try something else for a change. I decided to eat local and support the businesses here in Bayonne.  I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised by this place.   They really seem committed to being successful in Bayonne.  They're on GrubHub, Accept PayPal, use Square for card payments, and are a member of the Bayonne Town Center.  I really wish more businesses in Bayonne embraced technology since it would make them more appealing and convenient to the tech-savvy consumer.  Their commitment to the community has definitely won me over as a customer.   Now, the place itself isn't exactly fancy by most standards: it's very casual.  The decor is sufficient, but it's not impeccable. The staff is friendly and very quick.  People kept coming through the door.  The place seemed to be enjoying regular, good business.   The food was decent, I would say.  Don't expect much on presentation. Styrofoam and plastic and paper products are ubiquitous.  Understandably, it's perhaps to keep prices low.  Perhaps they'll upgrade it after the profits really start to roll in.   I had a sausage, egg, and cheese on a poppy seed bagel. The person I was with had the French toast platter.  I admit that I've had better in other places, but I also suspect other places to use artificial products whereas this place kept it simple which I really appreciated.   All in all, I would return and recommend this place.

I really wanted a florentine bagel, it is baked with cheese and spinach in the middle, but they didn't have it. So I settled for the sourdough. It disappointed, I wanted to taste the sourness. As for customer service, I think they were overwhelmed. It is move in day at the university, so I think today is the first day they have been open this semester. My iced chai tea was the first one that my server has ever made, it could use less of the flavoring, but is still fairly good. With a few weeks under their belt, I think they would be pretty good.
Guacamole, passion fruit margarita, chorizo fig flatbread all excellent. Also, beautiful plates. Nice outdoor tables.

I'm a fan. Nice and low cost yet quality remains pretty good. The rotisserie chicken is delightful. Been coming here on and off for lunch since they opened. I do wish they change the menu up some. Perhaps a rotisserie duck or squab, or grouse, or pigeon for a change? Meh overall though, this place makes for a great lunch joint. Beyond the wish of slight menu changes, it would be nice to see them expand a bit. Perhaps a store in North Philly near Temple,  another close to UPenn. Perhaps expand out to the suburbs eh? In Newtown, next to Honey Baked Hams, the Subway that was once their closed. Eat A Pita would do well there I think..well..that is I'd be happy to be a daily consume there if they'd open up. Overall keep up the good work. Consider adding new odd meats to the menu from squab to maybe veal kidneys or tongue. Consider opening up some new store fronts. Later hours would be nice too. Other than that..high-five on the yummies!

Great place, always order take out from here and sometimes have it delivered.  This is my favorite place in the Caldwell area, great wonton soup - the rest is pretty standard Chinese food but I like the way they do it.  The store could use some updating.

I loved Halversons Upstreet Cafe! I went there for a late lunch, and I ordered the standard burger with fries. My fries were cooked to perfection and also perfectly salted. I always love a fry that doesn't need ketchup to be good. The burger was one of the best I've ever had, excellently cooked(medium rare) and the buns were perfectly greasy. I had a great meal at Halversons, and you should too!

This is one of my favorite places. It's reliable and consistent. I always get the same thing, and it's always good. Even on busy days, it's worth the weight. Don't expect anything fancy; It's a diner, ya'll. Staff is nice. Coffee is good. Eggs are delicious. Biscuits are best when right out of the oven. Cash only. It's my go-to spot.

Finally got the chance to stop during the day and enjoy my steak.  Love this place.  I'm new to Yelp and so glad I can finally tell people how I feel about places it eat.  Sorry Pat's and Gieno's this place beats you hands down...  can't wait till next night work to stop and grab dinner on the run...
New flavors fresh veggies wonderful combos great service. I love the variety and flavorful spices accompanied with the right fruit and veg combination - love this place

Quality food with a very cool atmosphere. Put your name in for a table in the back and then explore the store. It is busy and there is a reason why. Ingredients were fresh and meal was cooked to perfection. When I make my way back to New York, I will definitely be back!
Good pizza and folks that work there are really nice.  Parking isn't great but just park in bank.

I have been in multiple times and dogs would be sitting inside, chilling, eating bagels served by the staff...i thought this was cute and wanted to bring my dog. I go today and they tell me my dog cannot eat iinside because its against the health code. Wtf. What about every other time i have come. I assume they will let their friends and other mega hipsters bring their dogs and not me?! This was obnoxious. Next time i am in, im taking pics and sending to the health department. Jerks.

Let's face it this place does an amazing Carbonara and really very little else. Somehow the uninformed continue to flock here only to be treated poorly. The chick at the front door is in way over her head, the "ambience" is non existent unless you come with a group of 20 and make your own, the wine list is exceedingly esoteric so they can charge enormous sums for average wines (a Batali-Bastianich staple), the food good maybe very good at times and the waitstaff is arrogant and condescending. We walked out with a reservation after we saw our table that they made us wait for and will leave it to the rest of you.

Went in for a snack and drink after a nice long walk with a freind through town. Service was ok. We had two drinks mixed with a top shelf vodka. To no avail, there was no fuzzy warm feeling at all from our coctails. Had two more and were not happy. The bartender didn't even give us a freebie! If you go there, just drink bottled beer.

This place is horrible, the staff isn't too professional and to have tables right by the kitchen window isn't a good idea. Ironically this is where we sat at. While waiting the cook was loud. But what followed took the prize. At the server area by the kitchen window there was a roach. Once we saw that we were gone! Good thing we didn't get that food! Gross!

This was my first time ever at melt shop and I must say customer service was amazing. I got the fried chicken sandwich with tots and a milk shake and it was awesome. I will definitely be coming here again. Maurice was very kind and made sure that my food was well prepared. 5 stars to this place.
This place is amazing!!! Their shop tots are the best tots ive ever had, and their grilled cheeses are the best sandwiches ever! Definitely recommend coming coming here for lunch!
Great sandwiches and service! They have gluten free options and the food can't be much better.

I had a horrible experience here. The guy taking my order said he didn't know how to make a Reuben which is on the menu. He then wandered away and left me standing there on my cane.  He came back and told us again he couldn't make the Reuben   Meanwhile another guy came over. I got tied up with this utter nonsense. I will Never come here again. My whole family was with me to witness this debacle. Poorest service I have ever seen. And no apologies either.

I have been going to this place since I was nineteen, I am now in my latter 50's.  Their food is always on point.  My husband and I love the dogs, fish and clams.  He has been going to them even longer than I.  This is a drive-in but during the warmer months they do have tables outside.  I see people posting up two rating but I wonder if they brought their issue(s) to their attention? I see the same staff year after year and it' more like a family there.  Granted inflation has hit all take-out places and the prices to me are within reason. If you wish it faster call ahead.  It will be ready by the time you get there. I will stay a fan until it changes hands to someone else.

Took my 17 year old son for lunch..he is a burger connoisseur. He loved the atmospher immediately very cozy and private rustic with an early American time period twist to it. Our waitress Samantha was extremely attentive and knowledgeable. The food was detailed and so good. The meat was the freshest I ever tasted for a burger. My son said it was on the top list of best burgers. He had the BBQ with chipotle and the girl recommended we put it on the side which was a good suggestion because it was strong. Great experience.

I do not like burgers. Or I should say, I DID not before eating here. The custom made burgers are truly custom. Within reason, practically anything you want you can have as far as buns, meat, sauce, toppings, and the list goes on!

I have never had a bad experience at Cafeteria.  I usually try to stop by when I'm in town.  The food is always on point and the staff is trendy, friendly and cute.   (Miguel is the bomb)  They also stay open late....so if you need some great food to soak up the liquor you just drank....look no further.   A few notes for the first-timer: Must haves:   Chicken & Waffles, Mac-n-Cheese Spring Rolls and of course....The Rude Margarita, complete with a pepper for that extra kick.
We really enjoyed the food. We loved the fried chicken and waffles and the poutine. The salad was tasty and the mushrooms were decent. We will certainly come back.
Wonderful brunch.  I had Benedict Jane.  Yummy!

My family has adopted this place as our go - to close to home favorite.  The food is very good.  I am an atmosphere girl and there just isn't any.  Too bright, tables that look like something from a family diner and no break between tables.  The chicken wings were gourmet but this last time we were in they had changed from a panko type breading to a standard breading.  May have been a fluke, but it wasn't what we were hoping for and did not live up to our past experiences.  Pizzas are very tasty.  Wait staff is generally pretty cordial.
The food is so delicious every time I go but it's the atmosphere that cinches it.   ALWAYS feels like a celebration.  Grand restaurant.  Thanks.
Bliss when sober and absolute heaven when drunk.
The private dinning is elegant and charming. The food was excellent. The chef made extra appetizers just for our anniversary ! Service was superb!

Go somewhere else. The customer service sucks!!!!!!!! Most of the games are out of service. You only get four tickets per games. There's an "all you can eat" salad bar...and when I went to make my salad, I saw that there were no eggs. I asked one of the staff and they said what you see there is what we have... How is it an "all you can eat" when they can't even refill one of the sides?! Horrible customer service!!! O and it took a hour for the pizza and fries to come to our table.

I live in the neighborhood, so I was psyched to see a new restaurant open up and try it. Jora (pronounced hora) did not disappoint. The food came in healthy portions (as in you leave feeling like you actually ate something, as opposed to still feeling hungry) and tasted great. My friends had the steak and another had the lamb shank--you'll love them! John, the head waiter, was friendly and gracious! I highly recommend making a pit stop at Jora!
The service here is very disappointing. We didn't get the usual show and the food was extremely salty. I would not recommend this restaurant.

My husband and I are regulars here.  This is by far our favorite sushi restaurant and we've been to many. Wish I could buy their salad dressing too.  Never disappoints us. Yes they are busy because they are so good. So on the weekend, just be prepared. In the past, owner sake Sam has given us a a special roll on the house if we've waiting a while.
This is a carry out styled place. Very nice clean location
By far the best fish tacos that I have had in the city! This is the go-to Mexican restaurant in the West Village, and I have tried them all.

The wait was 1.5 hours but the bar vibe was really good. Good selection of beers, but wine lacked flavor during dinner. I wanted the skirt steak but notice d that no one had ordered it while we waited. EVERYONE has a burger. The corn soup was the best I have had in  a long time. Burger was very good which I had at medium. 2 floors of space. The worst thing about this place is that the bathroom temperature is like 100 degrees and soooooooooo small.

The only good thing about this place is the view (and the only reason it gets a star!) so by all means, have a drink here and enjoy the sunset, but skip the dining. There are so many good options in Burlington, this is not one of them! ;)

If you want to have your dinner with a stranger at the same table, you can come here. Besides, there's one waiter's attitude is really poor. He seems wants to beat me when I asked him question coz the space is too loud. Furthermore, each dish here is a bit sweet except the xiao long bao.
I ordered the Southwest Chik'n Salad..simply amazing!

I was dropped off at this strip mall to kill some time while my car was being worked on nearby. It was lunchtime so I decided to pop in. My expectations were really low. I was thinking "hole in the wall"..."reheated overcooked pizza".  I can't comment on the extensive menu or the other specialty pies, but the plain pizza - - wow! I was thrilled to finally eat a good piece of pizza as it was meant to taste. As someone who grew up in  Queens, NY, I really can't stand most of the pizza I eat in New Jersey. This was simple, great sauce, just enough cheese, not overcooked, just great. I wish I lived closer because I would definitely eat from here again.

NOT ON TIME!!! WORST PIZZA EVER!!! call them to order three large pies, and ask if they can make it for 45 min, the guy on the phone said yes we'll do! When i arrived there  to pickup my order wasn't ready and i wait for it 20 min! One of the pies was almost raw not baked from the bottom at all!!! WORST PIZZA EVER!
Pizza is amazing. The end.

Breakfast on the way to the beach LDW can't beat this spot! Seated right away and service was like any typical Dash n Dine establishment. Got the Grand Slamwich - Superb!! boyfriend got the 4 ways build your own and it was Yummo!! Def get those Sippy cups shaped like a cupcake. Great for filing up with 4LOKOS.. for the beach!!!
Doesn't get better. Some of the best food period. Not just Chinese

This is a great place, just like there Brooklyn location, it's friendly professional atmosphere is at it's best. Very well organized and most of all it's great customer service. They should have at least one of these locations in every borough.
Great  atmosphere, great food best of all a wide variety   of delicious  beer overall great place to hang out.. 5 stars!!!!
Good beer. Good service. Local neighborhood bar in operation over 55 years. Better than tourist trap up the steeet.

Think Cheers. It is the oldest bar in Philadelphia and one of the most popular. It also is where hotels reccomend out of towners go for a taste of Ohiladelphia. PBR pitcher is only $6.50! The staff and management is super nice and goes out of their way to make sure you have a good time. Sunday and Wednesday is Karaoke and always a good time. Between Chesnut and Walnut on a small street, Drury, off of 13th. Street. Five stars!!!!

Let me tell you something. I had this place (Tuome) on my Fatboy radar for a couple of weeks ever since I saw a picture of their Pig Out (for 2) a couple of weeks ago on some website. I told my girlfriend that we have to go here before they get too popular and cut the portion size in half like most new restaurants do after the beginning stages. I'm not gonna drag this out. The Pig Out is a must if its 2 people. It takes around 25 mins to make so be ready to wait or get an appetizer of your hungry. Although its smaller than I expected that pork was crispy on the outside and soft and mmmmm on the inside. I couldn't stop smiling. It came with a ginger sauce, some type of spicy red pepper sauce an a salad with candied walnuts and apples. PURE MOUTH SEX!!!!! The Pig Out also comes with 2 bowls of spicy peanut noodles that I inhaled LIKE A BAWSE. The corn is also a great addition with its curry, cream fresh and lime flavor. They also start you with some sort of palate cleanser that I think had pickled papaya, tomato and some crispy shit. Oooooh my nipples are getting hard just thinking about it. It's a smallish place and Im sure glad I went with just one other person. It was getting pretty busy a couple hours after it opened so GO EARLY. Servers were great and always around. I'd definitely go again.

I grew up with food from this place. Its a weekend treat to have a great Italian hot dog from here with a potato plate and a root beer. You have to go and try anything off the menu! Place has been successful for ages! Why? Because they have all the important components; great food, great friendly service, and great prices! Why are you not there now?!

Customer service is key!!! Let me start by saying that I have been to this restaurant multiple times and the food is always great! Tonight my boyfriend and I decided to stop in for dinner. I ordered the Jamaican Jerk Chicken and he ordered the Buttermilk fried Chicken breast. When the food arrived at the table I was disappointed to see that the chef had changed my dish from two chicken breasts to a mixture of breasts and legs. Although it was not as appealing as before I continued on with my meal. Only a few bites in I discovered a piece of plastic mixed within the chicken. I was immediately turned off to my meal and lost my appetite. When the waiter arrived at the table I showed him the piece of plastic. He was very apologetic and offered me a new meal. Not even a minute after he left, the manager of the restaurant came to the table to apologize, and told us the dish will be taken off the bill. Although my meal was not as great as I had hoped, the customer service was wonderful and made up for it!

I work down the street and wanted to try something new for lunch.  I was drawn to the Vital restaurant because of the location, parking and wanting to try something healthy. My Salmon Burger with a mango salsa and a side of Okra Fries was soooooo delicious.  I was surprised by the Okra fries because I remember not liking Okra when I was a kid.  Trust me those fries are great and it was nice to have a healthy fry option.  My server, Michelle, suggested that I try one of the smoothies and I had the one mixed with Mango, Pineapple and Strawberry. What I really liked is that the chef came out to the table to ask how our meal is.  I remember reading articles about the opening of the restaurant and his vast experience in gourmet dining.   On our way out, I found out that they do deliver their food so I cannot wait to order some for my staff.  Definitely must go place!

This is my go to place for Portuguese Grilled chicken in the area. They have never let me down! Priced right. Not a long wait. Made just how I like it. And of course great portions! Staff is friendly and helpful too.

Excellent Mexican!!! I had the ultimate burrito and it was filled to the max! The establishment could use a little interior updating add some booths maybe. The pricing is a little high but I'd revisit again. The salsa bar was awesome (Mix up the Pico and Hot)

Fantastic food!! Diet soda needs improvement, but the enchiladas (chicken) were perfect, beans and rice amazing also. Great place! For those who think it has a "drug cartel" theme - uh no.... Lucha is the Mexican Wrestler (remember Jack black's Movie Lucha Libre) and there are a bunch of Mexican Wrestler Masks on display.

I'm staying near this restaurant for several days and the front desk recommended I give them a try after I inquired about a good pizza spot. Upon entering the restaurant,  no one greeted me. They have the pick up table and the order table which was a bit confusing for me since there were a bunch of people waiting and I'd never been there before. At any rate, I figured it out and proceeded to place my order at the counter. I was told my order would be ready in about 15 minutes. I waited outside and came back to ask the lady at the order pickup table if my order number was ready. She said not yet and asked my order number again. So I went back outside to wait and started noticing every other customer before and after me leaving. At this point, it was 45 minutes! My order was placed at 6:31 and I went in to check a second time at 15 after 7. The lady at the cutting table/order pickup was rude and was almost ignoring me. I asked about my order and she didn't say anything for several seconds so I asked again. Then she says they are getting ready to make it now. I told her to forget about it and just refund my money. After almost an hour of waiting and previously checking in. Some of the worst customer service I've ever experienced.  The manager refunded my money and said sorry for the inconvenience, but never offered to do anything to make it right. Wow! Never again. The cashier even tried to make excuses saying they just opened to another customer over hearing the conversation. ..never once seeming apologetic.  I was a manager at a restaurant for 4 years and this type of service would have people fired. Can't comment on the food, as I never got to try it.

Went to isabellas last night for date night! My 5th time here! We were running late but the guy on the reception changed my reservation time for me twice and was so nice about it! Service was excellent from the server to food runners to the bus boys! Atmosphere was perfect and food was delicious!! Thanks isabellas for another great night!

Very friendly and attentive staff. They got perfectly with the simplicity of the place. It's clean, nicely set up and lot of different option (single table, large communal table for group, window counter) I had a tasty Croque Monsieur. Nice melted cheese on a generous serving of ham between 2 toasted piece of bread. I will try the quinoa cake next time when I will visit the city,
Not bad. The stone pies are good. Staff is friendly but very slow at times. So far I was always lucky with my dishes.

Just finished leaving this place and it was mmm mmm GOOD! So delicious. I got there at 12:00 and the food came out in about 15 minutes. I ordered the Rittenhouse Slam with whole grain toast and my best friend ordered Grilled Prawns and it was just amazing and for dessert she ordered the Carjeta Custard, it was so good and beautifully garnished with little flowers. The staff is super polite and timely. The restaurant atmosphere is very warm and inviting. We'll be staying here until Monday and most likely come back for dinner.

Yes you will wait forever but that's the price to pay (well that and $5/slice) for some of the best pizza.  Service is random (we tried several times to call in our order but no answer) and slow...  waited an hour for slices on a Thursday evening.   Locals said they burn the pies but it looks like the square pans get burned.   Traditional triangle slices are fine. Great toppings although they run out if what's on the lust but the sun dried red peppers and cherry tomatoes were awesome on my slice!

This is the only Chinese food restaurant I order from in the area. Super friendly service and very helpful if you don't exactly know the menu. Food is made just how I order it every time and it's delicious.

I had the chicken noodle and my friends had the pork noodle. We all loved it, nothing we ever tasted before. The different seasoning and vegetable made it interesting in a good way. Many people mentioned the pork buns so we tried them too and it was also amazing. The bread texture was smooth and the pork was cooked superb. But the customer service was nasty. I will never eat there again. We had a party of 4 and waited 1 hour. I didn't mind the wait because the food was going to be great. One of the staff ask us while we are waiting if we are all going to sit together. What kind of question is that? No, we are going to sit separately because that is how group of people eat. Then once the food came, not more than 20 minutes later, the server was trying to take my plate away asking me if I was done. It was simply rude. How do you extend your hand towards my bowl of noodles while it is obvious I am still eating. He asked if we were done 3 times in a matter of 10 minutes. He also stared at us the whole time which made us feel uncomfortable. We also had an extra friend join us and asked the server politely if they can simply add an extra chair to the table. Nope. Even though there were extra chairs behind us. Because of the very poor customer service we did not leave a high tip. They had the audacity to ask why our tip was so little. Did you not see that server eyeing us the entire time we were eating and asking us if were done 3 times? Also, they did not let us wrap up out food so we can take it home. We payed for the food so we should be able to take it with us. Apparently, it is "against their culture". Even though the food was above average, I will not eat there again. It is not a place where you can enjoy eating your food.

I've lived in town for almost 3 years now, and have had the chance to sample several desserts and frozen yogurts in the area. For my money, Orange Leaf is far and away the best froyo option around, and is a great little yogurt shop. I've always found the staff to be more than friendly, offering samples and suggestions, and the store is always clean and well maintained. The yogurt itself is obviously delicious, and I love how often they rotate their 16 flavors. They have tons of toppings options, the fruit is always clean and fresh, and I recently found out they make the yogurt fresh in the store daily. This place is awesome, a great date spot, and I suggest it to all my friend a when they are in town,. I'm glad to see they are doing so well.

Few years ago i had a big project in fishtown, and stumbled on this place.  Spent a few months grabbing breakfast and lunch here, and it is one of my favorites now.   occasionally, I'll go out of the way just to grab something usually a cheesesteak w/sharp prov. Awsome place, clean, good staff,  just all around well run place!!!

The food in this place is absolutely FANTASTIC! The price for the food is very reasonable & it's open 24 Hrs! This place had authentic Mexican cuisine and would recommend their Enchiladas con salsa verde.
Haven't been there in years, went today, and wow, excellent, very fresh food. For a diner, Its more of a UPSCALE Diner. Best all Around. Will be there again very soon.

I love their food. There are so many choices so you can never go wrong. The fatty melt is so good. I can never finish if though because of the large portion sizes. Their chicken and waffles is also another great choice. It comes with four crispy pieces of chicken. All in all it's a great spot for any occasion!
Great Noodles -- the noodles itself was perfectly cooked.  The broth was also perfect -- for me, it was not too heavily flavored which I like.

This is a restaurant that confirms everything I have always thought about hotel restaurants.  Mediocre at best.   While the service and smiles were ever present the real food experience was completely missing.  Lamb chops were what I would expect at a greek dinner and the veal breast was so dry it was like cardboard. I think my 818 area code confused the staff and we were seated in a booth that was presented to us like a gift from the heavens.  In reality it was in the cow path between the bar and kitchen.  Dreary really. If you are a Danny Meyers fan stick to shake shake.

Everything was pretty good, but the food wasn't anything special.  Next time we go back we will just have an appetizer, cheese platter and drinks.  The cheese cart and monger knew his cheese!  There is a room downstairs for a group of maybe 10 or so if you are looking for a place for a group.

There is nothing negative that I can write about this restaurant. The wait is not too bad. They are more than accommodating for children and even have special cutlery. The baos are always delicious as is the ramen. I always tend to go with the spicier ramen dishes on the menu
They have the best prices and the beat food. General toas chicken is amazing!!  Would reccomment to everyone.

First sign of good BBQ is the smell of BBQ down the block.  After parking the car I could smell the smoke.  I went for lunch.  Get there before 12 noon to miss the line out the door. Meal:  Brisket sandwich, side of mac & cheese and beans.  Also two slices of turkey. Brisket was terrific.   Mac & Cheese very good.   Beans were good but a little too sweet.   Turkey was moist and tender.  Turkey can easily be over smoked and dry and it was done just right. The sweet BBQ sauce was good and I added it at the table.   Corn bread was OK.   The sweet tea was also good. I've been to Bear's in Windsor and it was good but lacked atmosphere.  The new Hartford location has great BBQ and atmosphere.   Two negatives: 1.  The parking situation-- you have to find a metered spot or park in the garage. 2.  Price.  It was a bit pricey for lunch. This is a GREAT addition to the Hartford dining scene.

Para ser un sitio lleno de turistas, la comida es excelente y las porciones MONUMENTALES, de un plato comen fácilmente 4 personas. La atención es buena, a pesar de la cantidad de gente. Lo mejor de la noche: El Titanic, que buuuen postre.
Fantastic!  Had the Classic burger. I'm normally a medium rare kinda girl, but their burger is delicious and flavorful. They have great service and prices. Well worth a try!
Specialty pizza is very good. But heros and salads are horrible. Cheap bread and little meat.chicken is very rubbery and small.very disappointed
Great kabobs. Now serving wraps and the hummus is bangin'!! Quality ingredients and lots of love put into the food. Highly recommend.

Under new ownership and new name is Hong Kong Palace. There is really no sugar coating the fact that the food is terrible. The first thing we ordered is scallion pancake and it came out as a lightly fried saltine cracker???? It's rectangular and taste like cardboard. Then it pretty much went downhill from there.

Went there for buffet. Vignesh and his colleague were taking care of customers at that time. Very disorganized and several buffet items were out. Asked about it, but was told that it buffet so its normal. Three times asked for high chair for my daughter, but they just ignored us. Their mantra was cater to incoming customers than ones sitting inside. Do not recommend it to anyone.

Its very small place and from the name of the place you would not think its a breakfast spot. The workers are very orgainized and get customers in and out. Great spot to eat breakfast at. Check them out.
My favorite Mexican restaurant by far. The food was very fresh and the guacamole and homade chips were amazing! Can't wait to return with the family.

It's only 4 stars because of the line last time I was there - beware, they are super popular! But I've heard they recently opened a restaurant, or at least somewhere for people to sit and relax. The halal is delicious, and the white sauce tops any other halal I've ever had. In a way, it's a good thing that they have a line, or I could get fat pretty fast. They also have this cut the line thing that's super cute, although I've never bought enough to achieve it. The idea is that you come back often enough and after a certain number of times, you cut the line! Anyways, super nice :)

probably my favorite restaurant in greenpoint/williamsburg!  both the food and wine are amazing. the atmosphere is really cozy.  service is friendly and chill.  I would highly recommend any of the pizzas,  the arugula is my personal fave.  watched a bunch of the World Cup games here,  and had a great time.  they also carry a local hot sauce called Ozone,  which was amazing!
The place has a really good decor and dance floor, though the service could be much better and the bartenders more attentive. All in all in a decent and trendy place, I'll go there again!

Disappointed, over rated, I had a dish of seafood was not fresh, one dish of meat linguine was kind of undercooked. I felt stomach ached after this horrible meal. I will not come back again，I am very angry to come this restaurant for dinner  in New York City base on Yelp reviews. Wasted my time and money, don't come this restaurant ever.

The food here is good, and the baked goods are always fresh. Their dinner menu is a good size and is pretty varied. The cod fritters were amazing, the artichoke salad is fresh & delicious and for the entree I'm a bigger fan of their pasta than their meat dishes. The decor is really cute and the atmosphere was laid back. The waitress was really attentive, and they didn't rush us out. One of my neighborhood favs!

I love this place. Every time I go to Brooklyn I have to stop here. I love their homemade tortillas and the simple flavors. You must try their pork tacos and avocados with tortillas on the side. I love when a place can make something so extravagant with the simplest ingredients and palo santo nails it.

Service was good, food was really good!! Beer flavor was great, but just barely below room temperature so that killed it for me!!! If you are going to brew expertly crafted beer, at least make sure it is COLD!!!!!
Outstanding... you will not find a better bagel outside NYC.

Phenomenal Italian cuisine. My family are regulars at Manninos. The other night we ordered wings as an appetizer and they came out nice and crispy. Our entrees came with side salads so we were all able to enjoy a fresh salad with a tasty Balsamic glaze. I had the chicken Marsala with a spaghetti and LOVED it. My father had the tortellini bolognese with the pink cream sauce and it was so good I wanted to steal his dish too. My mother ordered her regular dish of the stuffed rigatoni. Although we all had entrees, we order pizza regularly from Manninos. Its thin and crispy, who doesn't love a good Jersey pizza pie!!

Great brunch. Whenever friends are in town I take them here and hands down they ask to go again.  Bloody Mary's are unique and delish--have candied bacon on them!  I usually get the eggs florentine---I've tried pancakes and also appetizer and everything has been delicious.  You can spend about $15-$20 and have a fantastic meal for yourself.  I highly suggest you try!

This restaurant has it.  Went last night.  Staff so attentive. Food was delish.  Atmosphere was great.  Hartford is lucky to have this restaurant.  Make every effort and go here.  You will not be disappointed.
so good, make sure you know what you want before you get in line
Sooooo delicious! The lobster Mac &cheese is the best Mac&Cheese I have had in my life!!!! Excellent service very upscale place! Everything I had was divine!
great place to grab a good hotdog they have everything you can possibly want to put on a hot dog. I would recommend this place to anyone that likes good hotdogs and a friendly environment..

I've been going to sonny's for a few years now I guess you could call me a regular, I just can't get enough of my classics 2 times a week :)  I'm not really a review kind of guy but I'm bored so decided to go on yelp and check out reviews when I stumbled on sonny's. After reading a few reviews I actually became offended for some of these workers. When I say these are a group of Great workers that's an understatement... REALLY no joke they are the hardest working people I've ever met. For the men working in the kitchen I give them High fives for just being awesome and making awesome cheesesteaks to the woman behind the register I think her name is Kate or Krissy not sure but she's hands down awesome, a matter of fact the last time I was in there I seen her on her translator helping customers from another country order and the smile on their faces was priceless I see her constantly going out of her way to make everyone feel awesome I know I feel awesome when I leave. To the people who are negative about them shame on you. I found it very inappropriate to put them on blast when they know squat about them, awesome cashier always helping the cooks out speaking in Spanish to help them understand better and awesome cooks for being kind and serving me the best damn cheesesteak.

Where do I start.  Extremely rude staff and who I can only assume was the manager was so unhelpful and disrespectful.   It was almost like they don't want your money.  Apps were very good (that's why they got 1 star)  main course was really bad.  It tasted and looked sat under a heat lamp for hours.  My wife's lechon was completely dry and my chicken was on the verge of being a weapon it was so overcooked and dry.  Both sauces had 0 flavor and the maduros were extremly dry. All in all I do not know what all the fuss is about subpar food and an extremly rude waitstaff and manager mean I will never go back

Actually if i could rate this zero stars, I would. I have traveled and lived all over the world, and consider myself kind of a foodie. I have seen many an episode of Anthony Bourdain and Andy Ricker, and said hey it would be nice to have some cool Thai food in NYC which isn't the equivelant of street food in Thailand; lets give this a whirl. I could not have been more disappointed, the service was a cross between trendy self affected and hipster (odd mix huh!), and the food was over priced crap. I ordered a Thai Sausage dish and mixed veggies, and got one single sausage and a wedge of raw cabbage for $14. Then we ordered another pork dish which was so hot (I'm a massive fan of hot food and have traveled all of India), it had to be sent back. In its place we got a savory pork belly curry, there were 3 pieces, one was 90% fat, one was 60% fat and the 3rd was acceptable. When we asked our waiter if anyone actually was expected to eat the fat he responded, well some people do; oh and that dish was $18 for fat. I was amused when the waiter asked us if we wanted to pay another $3 for a portion of rice to dip in the drippings, I mean curry. All in all a truly annoying experience, we had 2 beers, 2 dishes (if you can call them that) and a sticky rice..... the cost for this wonderful feast $60. Never again! not even with Bill Gates money, oh and Anthony well he should be ashamed of himself for propping this place up.

We have visited the pleasant Chelsea spot several times, but due to traveling had not been for over a year. All I can say is they must be under new ownership, we were eagerly looking forward to their suckling pig, preceded by various appetizers, but arrived to find a completely different menu. No suckling pig, except in the form of appetizer mini sandwiches, and the whole menu is now a limited selection of tapas along with a few rice plates. The tapas we ordered were mediocre at best, but I was especially annoyed by a paella type vegetarian rice dish, which described succulent vegetables and arrived with some limp piecs of brocoli and canned straw mushrooms. The food was pretty bad, but what is worse is that no restaurant employee, from bus boy to waiter on up, appeared to be the slightest bit interested in hearing about our disappointment. This one's a no return for us.
Very good (and cheap) Korean food. Service is quick and efficient. Very authentic food, the bibimbap is excellent. *this place is not vegetarian-only*

I was a big fan of Figs until recently. Apparently the owner went to Morocco and left Chef John in charge of the place. This chef was very nasty and inhospitable...this is in direct contrast to the warm hospitality that we have always received there...

In short, a  lot of money for mediocre food. The fried zucchini wasn't very good.  We should have sent it back. The salmon that I had was a child's portion for $30 . It wasn't good. Tasted greasy.  Needless to say we won't be back

Best fresh tuna sandwich I've ever eaten! So fresh, so delicious! Also very good French fries! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone that likes seafood! Has a pretty large menu with lots of options! I visit this place every time I'm in Princeton!

Maybe they were having a bad day because everything I've heard is positive, but did not enjoy my dinner here.  Went with three friends and we usually order a bunch of dishes and share them all.  So, I did try about 5 different plates and can't say I liked any of them. To make it worse, the food was cold. At least the staff was nice.

My wife and I have been coming here for a while now and with each time we come, it gets better and better.  The food is excellent, the atmosphere is superb and the hospitality is top notch.  When it comes to their food, they pay attention to every little detail to ensure that your meal is absolutely delicious.  I have never had a negative dining experience here. The staff knows my wife and I by our first names and that really matters.  There aren't many places that take the time to get to know your customers and cater to their every need.  If there is something you want that isn't on the menu just ask, and they will do their best to create it specially for you. The owner Angelo is also extremely welcoming and hospitable at every level.  When you walk in you are treated as a guest in their home, and they do everything in their power to please you.  Definitely if you are in the area go, and go again and again and again!

Name: Mill on the River Address: 989 Ellington Rd, South Windsor, CT 06074 Review Categories: Ambiance / Cleanliness: 4/5, Food & Drink: 3/5, Manager Visibility: 1/5, Product knowledge: 4/5, Service: 2/5 Summary:   Ambiance / Cleanliness: This restaurant was clean, lighting was good, and tables were set at a good spacing, however tables for 2 were too close to each other.  The location of the restaurant presented a romantic ambiance and the inside decorum complimented its theme. The restaurant also has outside patio seating and a nostalgic bridge better known as the kissing bridge. Food & Drink: Maryland Crab Cake - diced scallions & radicchio * lemon remoulade * chive cream sauce. Vineyard Escargot Chablisienne - garlic, white wine, butter, & Pernod sauce. 18 oz. Cowboy-Cut Rib-eye Steak. Stuffed baked lobster with baked potato and coleslaw. Drink: - Glass of Giabbino Moscato Di Asti Food temp:  The Vineyard Escargot Chablisienne was extremely hot, and burned the palate and throat on consumption. The crab cakes were lukewarm. The 18 Oz steak's was ok from side to center, but cooler near the bone as this was shown in the color of the meat (steak was asked to be well done, but from the center of the bone was medium cooked). The stuffed lobster's temperature was spot on. Preparation: All food was prepared according to standard except the patron's request for the steak being prepared well done. Presentation & Taste: The plating food was good. The flavors were balanced and food seasoned to taste.  The lobster was cooked well, the stuffing and baked potato were dry. The steak was seasoned well, juicy and flavorful. Note, 7 Oz of steak was not consumed because the food not being prepared to specification. Manager Visibility: The manager was visible, but was not engaged with customers. Product knowledge: The server was knowledgeable about the menu but never offered alternate choices for dinner. Service:  The server was not attentive. After our entrée, the server did not check to confirm with the food was to our satisfaction. Our empty dinner plated was on the table for 11 min before being removed from the table. We were not offered another drink.  There was an assumption that we only need 1 dessert that was accompanied with the baked lobster meal. We did not receive a dessert menu. There were no issues with wait times for seating, and length of wait for food was reasonable. There were no problems with the method of payment. Rating: 2.8/5. The Mill on the River received this rating because of the food preparation request of the patron, poor manager interaction with customers and lackluster service from the server. Note: We received better service from the busboy. Recommendations: Check quality of all food before serving the customers and the manager should be engaging with customer to enhance customer service, and Mill on the River should always be concerned with quality of service being presented to their patrons. Regards, AS SIMPLY SAID CONSULTING

After hearing about how amazing eataly is, we decided to make the journey and give it a shot... The shopping section is amazing! Very gourmet yet reasonable in options and pricing..  We had pasta calamari and a margarita pizza... The pasta was horrible. It tasted re-cooked, the shrimp was so over done you could barely cut into it and the sauce tasted like tomato purée. In other words, not the spicy zesty sauce the server raved of. The pizza was standard - with no awesome takeaways or remarks.

I dig the atmosphere of this place although there is definitely some design flaws with the layout which really messes with the flow of things at this restaurant. This is my second time eating here and I was only somewhat impressed the first time but figured I'd give it a second chance. The food is good the craft beer selection is relatively good. The service is ok, just ok. This last experience our server said about a total of three words to us. Our greeting after we were seated was "Are you ready"? After asking our server what they had available from Goose Island brewery, his response was "None"... So I asked 'How bout Two Roads' his response was, "White IPA"... at this point I realized he was foreign. Now don't get me wrong, I have traveled to Europe where I actually appreciate the directness of the experiences I have had over there, but this kid working in the heart of downtown New Haven with the best pizza around had the personality of a fucking dishrag. Our food was brought to us and we didn't see this kid until we were completely done with our meal and I had and empty beer glass for about 20 minutes. I work in a service industry and I understand the importance and skill it takes to make people feel appreciated for there patronize. De Legna's has a good thing going just pay attention to the little snotty nose brats you got serving the paying customers. I wont be back anytime soon. There are a handful of pizza places that blow the doors off of this place in and out of New Haven with better service to boot. Good luck and au revoir!

Love this place, have come here quite often and it's always awesome. Food never disappoints and wine is equally excellent. Sometimes things take a while to come out of e kitchen, but nothing crazy and would never prevent me from going back.
Steak was good, but ended up being doused in some sort of a butter. Service was terrible: waitress was not attentive, and got our order wrong.
I loves this restaurant because they always have fresh pasta, the ricotta is so delicious and the service is awesome.Good food, good place. I love Lupa!

Lost my business because of The snott nose young lady at nighttime that sits on her ass and does nothing she is one rude nasty bitch to the customers and needs to be take it out of that diner.   Never ever again will I ever spend one penny in that diner. Zero star review

Amazing wings!  Great staff! Perfect location!  The chef Tiffany does great work!  Came in in Sunday of Labor Day weekend and was happy to find a few different tvs with games...an old school Mario cart game in the front and outdoor seating.  But the wings were toooooooo good!

As someone who lived in Brooklyn Hts and frequented and loved the pizzeria when it was still known as "Patsy's", I was so looking forward to pizza of a similar quality at Patsy Grimaldi's new restaurant. Sadly, the pizza here is a pale shadow of the original. The crust wasn't nearly as chewy, nor was there anywhere as much char as I recall. The tomato sauce is still very fresh, though the garlic is stronger than desirable. The new place is more crowded and louder than the original, but service was friendly. The original pizza was ethereal, now it's merely good, and does not compare with pizza I have had in other cities (e.g. Mario Batali's Pizzeria Mozza in LA, 2 Amy's in DC). My experience bears out why Juliana's is not rated among the best NYC pizzerias.  Will try somewhere else on my next visit.

Hands down, one of the best restaurants in Philly. The asparago pizza and the beet salad are both to die for. Along with the meatballs, gnocchi, budino, sheeps milk ricotta, octopus...I could go on and on. But that pizza! And the chefs making the pizza. It's heaven, really. If you haven't been you're missing out. And now I'm drooling just thinking about it all.

This is my third time here favorite place for brunch prices and reasonable staff is very friendly and helpful the backyard is nice my favorite meal is the farm burger with the fresh cut fries with there special mayo sauce . Best place to get lame brunch in the area and the dinner is good too

This has always been one of my favorite places in Williamsburg. Delicious food, great ambience and wonderful service. Today however, I came in to ask whether they had space for a group of seven dear friends and was spoken to in a way an angry school teacher addresses a naughty kid, when I curiously walked towards the garden that I hadnt seen before. Absurdely rude and certainly not appropriate towards a guest who would glady bring the rabbit hole all the business in world. What a shame..

I ordered Red's for the first time one evening at work for myself and about 10 co-workers. I randomly found their menu at our front desk and decided to give it a try. I could not be more impressed! The food and customer service was amazing. The girl on the phone was very friendly and helpful. She individually bagged and labelled names for each person and their order (I appreciate that because I'm usually stuck sorting out everything which is annoying to say the least) We ordered a wide variety of food, being skeptical because we have had some sorry experiences in the past with new places we have tried. But Red's was different. Each person that ordered RAVED about the food (That never happens.. I always have at least one or two disappointed coworkers) We tried everything from Chicago dogs to sandwiches to BBQ chicken to sweet potato fries. Every single item was A-MA-ZING. The prices are more than reasonable. Delivery was quick (We even got free freshly baked chocolate chip and thumbprint cookies!!) We will definitely be making Red's our regular dinner spot from now on. Thank you for being awesome and keep up the good work!!

We were looking for a pizza place in Little Italy and this place popped up on Yelp.  It's just a few blocks off the beaten path and totally worth it.  We sat outside and ordered the Mozzarella & Prosciutto Crostini and the Diavola Pizza.  The spicy salami was perfection.  I would definitely come here again.

Pros: Food was tasty. We had the ugly duckling burger and the steak sandwich, both of which were well cooked. Cons: Service was rough.   When I asked for a drink that was on tap, they said they didn't have that one today.  No problem, I selected another one.  When they came back with my drink, they gave me a different one from what I had ordered, with the explanation that "they tasted the same" and that the other drink I wanted wasn't available today either.  Additionally, the drink order took quite a while.  Further, we wanted to sub our fries for veggies, but the server couldn't tell us what the veggies were.  We opted for that anyways, but we were served something that was primarily squash, a vegetable I hate.  Finally, when the bill came, we were up charged for the veggies, despite not having been warned of that previously. All in all, despite solid food, the overall experience was negative enough that I will not be going back.

Especially for the price, that was one of the best chicken breast sandwiches that I've ever consumed. The roll type bun put it over the top. The flavors were delicious. Next visit, I will try the mac-and-cheese and the burger.

I walked in with some friends to order some coffee.  I was ignored by all three employees at the register for at least 3 minutes. They even walked around me without saying a word to bring other orders outside. It wasn't until I asked "how do I order something" that I finally got attention. The coffee was good, the service not so much.

The Chicken Pie is good. Not mind blowing but good Delicate wafer like crust. Menus are on chalk boards on walls which is interesting.  Cool kid type music and dark atmosphere.  Lots of good beer as expected.

So annoyed with sugarfreak!!!! I yelped my brunch date with my girlfriend's abs came across this place "sugarfreak", putting my faith in yelp, I planned a birthday brunch to come here, and the place was closed and looked like it was being renovated! I was so embarrassed and angry!! They need to indicate that they are under construction or closed, in all honesty, being put they traveling time and traffic to get to this joint was a total waste,,,,I hope they are shut down for good!!!!

So I thought the point of a reservation was so you DIDN'T have to wait 30 minutes to be seated.  Also, how the hell do you not have air conditioning in 90 degree weather? They were out the tofu scramble,  chicken and biscuits, chicken and waffles, and cured salmon. That's 1/3 of their menu.  After my friend was asked to repick his entree for a third time, we left for a restaurant run by people who knew what they were doing. I am shocked this place has not closed down yet as it seems these are all ongoing issues that have yet to be rectified.
What an amazing spot. Unique and tasty food, awesome drinks, and great service. Ask for Roshina for your waitress, she's great.

This place is a great hit for Latin cuisine, might I add it is located in Park Slope. I absolutely recommend this place for it's bandeja paisa, pollo de rellenos, and mango margaritas. Thumbs up! Great service.

Service is great, Manager Samir is a total pro. The appetizers were just ok, kinda greasy and the sauces were a touch too watery. The mains were good but nothing special. Overall clean, tasty and hardy food.

Not only does La Goulette serve incredibly fresh and authentic food, but it also has an incredible staff and impeccable level of service...exceeding almost any other restaurant I have been to in Williamsburg. The employees exemplify outstanding customer service and always remember a familiar face. After only the second time dining there, they addressed my boyfriend and I by our first names and proceeded to give us complimentary tea to end the meal. Always smiling and constantly seeking ways to improve our experience, they know how to keep a customer satisfied! Absolutely love this place. Excellent service, excellent food.

Quite delicious. I had a Southern chicken sandwich, which was crunchy and good. The sweet pickles, which they called a cole slaw, were a nice touch. I will say that the server was a little peculiar. Not very friendly and preoccupied with her own drama. Perhaps if restaurants paid a living wage, staff could be more professional.

If I could give this place no stars even that would not be satisfactory...waiter insulted friends about leaving a "shitty" tip when in actually left a nice 30% tip...this has never happened anywhere else and I am severely disappointed with this establishment's professionalism
Their vegan kale Caesar salad with chicken is super delicious!

What a refreshing new addition to this neighborhood!  Sharkey's Cafe is an adorable sandwich shop, serving sandwiches, baked goods, EXCELLENT teas by Harney & Sons and coffee by Brooklyn Roasting Coffee. Portions are large and everything is very reasonably priced. The owner, Jennifer, is lovely and bakes all of the treats herself on premises -- try the Nutella Banana muffin, it is to die for!!  I ate one and brought 2 home with me they are so good -- moist and not too sweet.   All sandwiches are made with delicious Balthazar bread, and are assembled while you wait.  I had the "Simply Cucumber" -- Brie, cucumber, salt & pepper on a baguette. I normally wouldn't go for soemthing like that but it was really divine -- it was the perfect sandwich for a summer afternoon.  My friend ordered the Pope Francis - prosciutto, fresh mozerella, arugula and balsamic on a baguette - also very tasty.  Then for dessert we shared the "Monkey Biz" - peanut butter, banana and honey on a baguette.  I was tempted by the Nutella Baguette (because Nutella!) but so few places in the city offer a peanut butter banana sandwich, we had to try it.  Just like everything else it was so good! Sharkey's Cafe also offers catering -- she can do anything from small office meetings to wedding cakes.  I saw them putting together a plate of mini ham and cheese croissants that looked beautiful.   There are a handful of seats in the shop, we got lucky and got a table, so we could chat a little bit with Jennifer.  There's a park across the street you can always eat at if you don't get a seat. If you are in Chinatown and looking for something fresh & light, or on jury duty and don't want another chinese food lunch, definitely seek out Sharkey's Cafe, you will really enjoy it.

Menu prices are completely inaccurate.  The online menu said a gyro os $4.99 but it's really $8.00.   When you say something to them, they say those are old prices.  This happened to several people i know. They are scammers.  If the prices have been wrong for 3 years, then update them! I feel they leave the old prices so that people see them and what a great deal they are, order, then get hit with a bill $20 more.  Defintely an unethical place.
