They also NEVER tell you the total when you call for takeout or delivery , which is another reason i'm led to believe its a scam. They know people would never still want the order if its $20-$30 more than you think it is.

So I was in philly and decided to try something new with my girlfriend. We first went to this place el vez for brunch in which we couldn't decide what we wanted for dinner. We were recommend by the waiter there to try parc. Upon coming in we were seated quickly. Menu was pretty much written in French. Ambiance was good, decor was decent. We ordered a craft of the white wine which was delicious to start. Then for appetizers we got the tomato salad and the crab cakes. Both were excellent, for entrees I got the beef bourguignon she got the lamb shank. I would recommend both. The lamb shank was tender and delicious while words can not describe the beef. I would recommend this place for anyone looking for a good meal in the city of brotherly love.
Overall the experience was good.  Waitress was very nice,attentive and funny. The food was alright. We actually enjoyed the nachos more than anything.

A nice Spanish restaurant. You gotta try the beef rib flatbread which is great with a strong mix flavor of cheese and beef. The bite of delight just leaves you a lingering fantasy of cows walking on prairies.
Perfect for a real french/Belgian brunch ! I recommend the croissant, baguette with nutella and western omelette The atmosphere was really nice and cosy the only negative point: NO AC !!!

I love when I use yelp to find a great place and end up loving it! Quintessential wine bar with variety of craft apps and specials. Sat in the bar area bartender was very friendly and knowledgable about the wines and food. Ordered the rosemary skewered garlic bread and it blew me away. Paired nicely with the pancetta wrapped cheese stuffed dates. We got wine but I was tempted to try some of the martinis which were unique and fresh. The restaurant is small and they get very busy so I would for sure make a reservation especially if there is an event at the surrounding theaters.
Food is great. Staff is very friendly. Would recommend. Try this place!
Superb buffet for a great price. Love it. The buffet had a good assortment of dishes and the spices were on point.

I go here once a week for breakfast and I love it! First, the staff  is excellent. The owner and waitresses are all friendly and welcoming. The food is also pretty good. You can order anything as you like and it's all yummy.

Anti pasta order was amazing. Best I've had for the price. Pesto and ricotta lasagna was rich but a bit gummy. Spinach meatballs were great. Loved the home style feel of the dining experience. Definitely go here on an empty stomach and make a reservation if you want to dine in.
All of our food was super delicious, the service was great and the decorations were all really neat. I loved the whole place!

Yum. Xlb has just enough meat to where it doesn't overpower the skin or soup. I also LOVE the dan dan noodles!! They have good chew and nice heat from the peppers. Also the serving size is perfect. I can finish everything on my plate and not feel like I'm headed for a food coma! Haha.

This place is awesome!  My waiter,  Bob was great and the food is DELICIOUS. I had the birthday cake milkshake which was a little pricy but it was worth it for the cupcake that garnished this drink! The burger I had on a glazed doughnut was moist yet well done (done perfectly how I like it). After I ate it I wanted another one.  I will definitely be going back!

I have tasted a lot of Pizza spots but finally i can say that Scott's pizza tours are amazing! This spot has employees that do the tours but, luckily we got Scott as our tour Guide. They give you and the small group little booklets to write down your pizza experience. First of all the pizza is delicious! Second your host/Scott talks all about Pizza, shows how their made, and seems super! He is a nice and hilarious person, that's knows all the history of pizza, and can tell you funny stories as well. It was awesome. Tour was great and full of information about pizza. Scott knows a lot about the great history of pizza. It was full of entertainment and I would like to say that you should have to go for it. You will enjoy it definitely. The fresh Pizza will force you to take one more...

First thing you should know about this place it's byob- bring your own wine. Me and my girlfriend came here on Friday 8/29. It was our first night in philly traveling from Nyc we wanted a nice Italian spot with good wine. We came here and long behold it was byob we were pissed and since we came here 30 min from closing we were out of luck. We got for appetizers the grilled octopus and I got to say it was very tasteful, we also got the fried calamari, It was okay nothing to brag about. For entrees I got there version on the chicken Parmesan she got the veal Milanese. My meal tasted microwaved hers was pretty much bread crumbs and fat. Service was good and the person who appeared  to be the owner was nice but food wise I wouldn't recommend this place as a first option.
So awesome!!  Argentinian steak and filet were delicious. The coconut lobster as an appetizer was amazing. I highly recommend it.

Had a yen for fresh rice pudding and couldn't find it anywhere.  Then, discovered this place which i'd passed and ignored for years.  The rice pudding was so fresh that it was hot from a pot on the stove.  Delicious!
Great tapas, great wine, and great service. Definitely a place that I recommend. I've been back a number of times and love this place.
Absolutely fantastic--gorgeous garden, stellar food and wine, absolutely incredible service and atmosphere.

Ok, so for years now whenever in New Haven, which pretty much revolves around Yale, I've been barstool resident at Delaney's.  Well, it burned to the ground last week and I've been forced to venture out in search of new watering hole that can satisfy my Jones for good brew.  A great deal of thought was clearly put into the Cask Republic's design, both an open floor plan and ambient lighting are welcoming as you walk through the doors, the selection impressive. If I were to rate them on the beer and food alone it'd be 6 stars! Where they lack is warm, personalized service. The bartentenders are dismissive, acting largely like you're a pest when you make inquiries/ask questions,  mine went as far as to roll his eyes and disapproved of my choice...Beer elitism!  The service at the table was swift and courteous, but cold and mechanical,  at the tables next to ours we hear the same "script" over and over, and our servers knowledge of beer was cursory at best. Great looking bar, fantastic food, vast selection, but just missing that x factor that makes a bar a neighborhood bar...needs to build a culture.

Came here for Sunday lunch with partner and in-laws. All had pasta which were phenomenal. Can really taste the house made difference and even see it in action in the back. HOWEVER, service was subpar. Very nice folks and all but very slow and gave a vibe of they were scrambling. Bread only came after we asked for it, 30 mins into the seating. Will return to try other food but hopefully service will have tightened up.

Can't believe how bad the pizza was. Not only that, but it took a good 40 minutes after we ordered to get the pizza. It wasn't a tough order, 1/2 just cheese and 1/2 pepperoni large pizza. It wasn't cooked bad, just didn't taste good. I've had this same problem at many pizza joints in New England. I guess that just goes to show, stick with clam chowder or lobster when in the north east because they sure can't do pizza.

Not just hype - it really is the best pizza I've ever had. The old man who exclusively makes the pizzas is getting on in years and working less and less all the time, so go and try it before it's relegated to the history books.
Very good pie.  Nice authentic atmosphere. Good local brews on tap.  A little pricey, but no complaints.

The spinach and goat cheese omelet was incredible. I tasted my friend's pancakes and they were as fluffy and memorable as the reviews stated. The bloody mary was not the best according to my taste. Everything else was top notch with affordable prices.

Ordered Wanton Noodles. Very bad , I can still taste the powder wanton which means it is not cooked. Imagine uncooked pork, what does that tell you. Ecoli..And the person whom I spoke on the phone told me to use the microwave to cook it. This is a big joke. Do not order from this restaurant.  I will report them .
Fish special is the best!!! Olives are super-fresh!  Waitstaff very helpful.  Will definitely return!

We used to like the Pilgrim Diner until last night! The waitress who took my son's phone order was very rude and obnoxious. We understand that she has a strange sense of humor and usually find her funny but last night she was totally inappropriate! When I called the diner she picked up the phone screaming at me!! Too many other nice diners in the area with good food, nice servers who actually like their jobs and nice decor to put up with that!

This diner has become one of my standby stops on frequent trips back and forth to Northern New England. It located about two hours out of central Long Island where I live, which makes it a great stop for a breakfast after an early start to skip NYC traffic. The food here is just plain old honest "chow". Don't expect anything fancy, just homemade Greek diner standbys. I like their menu of daily specials; recently had a waffle and bacon special followed on the return trip by an Athenian omelette. All made to order and tasting just how it should, no more no less. Wait staff is always efficient, place is always clean. What more do you want from a diner? I'm from an area well populated by diners and have eaten at more than a few. This is above average and always dependable for me. Located 1 minute off the parkway and near gas stations, this is exactly the type of pit stop I look for to avoid the Mc-Others.

First time I tried hot pot and it was great! This was totally a different experience than any other restaurant I have ever been to. It was like korean bbq taken to a next level. Good thing I had a few guides to help me through the experience. It costs about $30 and you get as much food you want to hot pot. They start you out with a soup base and then you can order any of their foods from the normal beef, and shrimp to  pigs blood and brain =0! I was  feeling a little fear factorish at first but it tasted good (or maybe im just nice with a hot pot) Also you get to mix your own sauce in the back -try a couple mixtures through out the meal they can make a big  difference. The decor and seating was good. There are even private rooms that are great for small group of people. I liked the experience and would be back.

We went last night and took our 2 kids (8 and 11 years old) and at first the girls weren't into this place.  They don't have a kids menu but after the great guacamole they were sold.  The decor is so NOT Mexican, but I guess that doesn't matter much.  I'm from the border of AZ and MEX so I love being around Mexican stuff as I munch, but not the case here.  It looks like a new fancy place but w/ zero Mexican flare.  The service and owner (I think) were very cool and I dug their vibe, very rock n roll looking dudes, and we are a Metal family so we like our type.  Now to the food... EXCELLENT!  I got 3 different types of Tacos (best one = carnitas!), my wife got a vege one. The kids got the Tinga chicken taco and loved it.  Our oldest got another one.  My wife and I loved the corn off the cob w/ chili and it went perfect w/ the guacamole and fresh salty chips.  This place is bring your own so we brought some ice cold Modelos and it made this meal just perfect!  We will be coming back for sure and as of right now, it's our fav Mex place in New Jersey!  Watch out!

I cannot say enough about this tiny, mom-and-pop place!! The lovely woman who helped me was so gracious - explained everything on the menu, and when I couldn't stop gushing about how delicious everything was (I got the cold appetizer platter which incorporated at least seven or eight different samplings of dishes, for a mere $8!!), she simply said thank you and it's because everything is fresh and prepared in house and with great care. It showed!! Can't wait to come back!!

Purely went on yelp faith. I really don't like giving places bad reviews because I know how hard it is to run a good joint, but the worst is when a place is floating in that stratosphere of 4.5+, you have expectations, rightly, going in. But just some bullet points, good and bad: - everything too salty (and I'm an advocate of proper to strong salt use in restaurants) - eclectic dishes overengineered (chicken liver mousse, a hard dish to muss up, was a weird cool temperature, bitter and loose) - salmon was decent, but skin definitely too salty - skate, a real thin filet, so pan seared it resembled fried (and too salty) - corn risotto was the only redeeming feature - pork belly was interesting but skin was so hard (and so so salty), even the waiter recommended we cut it upside down so we didn't squish the meat. - as a huge fan of pate and liver, I'm pretty sure the cold and bitter mousse made us both queasy later in the eve. - dessert was more along the lines of Pizzeria Uno fare than a high-star Yelp review. - cannot cannot stand when places hound you for your table water choice, and then continuously refill *$12* bottles of sparkling Saratoga like at a backyard BBQ. Upselling at its best. I just expect more when places are going for this style and level of quality...and a $350 dinner for 5 with no alcohol.  Shame for such a well reviewed place by others.

This place is wonderful! The atmosphere is really cool-very modern. If you go on a warm day there's outdoor seating, and they have  floor to ceiling windows open in the front where there are a few tables also. The BET fried rice is amazing-pineapple, egg, & cashews-and it comes in a pineapple! The presentation is awesome! Delicious drunken noodle and pad thai. They have a huge menu so I will def. try something different next time. Drunken noodle is my fav., so I always go on the judgement of that. And the staff is prompt and friendly. Definitely will be returning

They need better service and a phone number. There's plenty of good food around with amazing service, you're better off going to someplace else. I ordered takeout and when I go it home it was missing an item. Since they don't have a phone, I walked all the way back there to get my money back (didn't feel like waiting another 15 minutes for just one taco). The bartender/waitress told me it was because "they've had a really busy night," which is apparently an excuse to screw up. I guess the lesson is make sure you go when they aren't busy or else they might mess up your order as well.

TERRIBLE! The waiter couldn't even understand English!!!! Before we even ordered, we asked for 2 glasses of ice water with a slice of lemon and the waiter didn't understand us, he thought we wanted lemonade or something. Also, they don't even have vermicelli!

Like most others on here...good food, bad service. I must admit they have some of the best hummus in the city and seem to know it and not bother with being friendly. I had the salmon which was very good, friend had the chick kehab which she said was dry. Maybe it was an off night as I've had it before and it was fine. I mainly go for the hummus though and the bread they serve...ohh that bread!

I have been to Antimo's many, many times. Antimo himself is usually there greeting customers and making fresh pasta. Today, August 31, Antimo was not present and it was if the inmates were running the asylum. Service was awful; they " ran out" of bread (?).  Just getting the attention of a server was a challenge   Antimo, don't leave!
Just had a rehearsal dinner here and the Food was excellent and the staff was so friendly. Great place

Very good cheese steak. Go for the cheese whiz. Bread was a little chewy, hence only 4stars.  Would eat here again.  Line moves very fast. Be ready to order and pay when you get to window...no dillydalling.  Not a lot of seating or parking but that was expected.
If I could figure out how to give zero stars I would. Slow, mediocre food, how does this place have 4 stars. Wish we had tried the Indian place down the street.

Just as great as the the Ippudo in St. Marks. We were led upstairs, the "secret" seating area. The service was amazing and the servers were very attentive. We got the pork buns and Akamaru Modern. Both were delicious and flavorful. Would definitely go back.

Went here for brunch with my girl friend service was a little slow, we were seated outside. It was packed inside with a 30 minute wait. The waiter was very nice, we got our drinks in a decent amount of time, we both got the perfecto margarita, this was a strong drink and had both of us tipsy. We were I a rush so we didn't get appetizers. We ordered the pork tacos and I got the burger of the brunch menu. Both were good however my burger didn't come out medium as I ordered it can out well done. Service needs to be better outside, and they should deff learn there temperatures when it comes to burgers or any meats.
Great place!  Very small and can seat only 6 but well worth it.  Bagels were fresh and soft.  Owner was incredibly kind and helpful.  We plan on going back quite a bit! Don't miss out!

Listen, the food is fine. Perfectly good. But the prices are a tad audacious given the quality and the awkward location. It's not bad. You'll like almost everything you order. But you'll be mad when the bill comes because it won't be THAT good and you'll still be kind of hungry. That said, the labneh is amazing, if you can get more than a teaspoon of it.

We were drawn to this place by the high rating, but really this place is nothing special (mediocre, basic cafeteria food).  The staff was nice, but it was too busy for them to handle the flow, and they only had two beers on tap.  With all the good locations around, I'm surprised by the rating and how busy they were (I'm guessing proximity to theater)

I gave this restaurant a two star rating because of how slow and bad their service is. I ordered a grilled chicken salad from there on a sunday they told me it will take about 10-15 minutes I got there in 15 minutes I had to wait a total of 35 minutes for a salad. They also do not answer their phone it took 4 tries to get someone to answer. their food is decent but not good enough to wait 35 minutes for. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!!! Unless you have plenty of time to kill.
I asked the waiter what the places was known for and he said the ngow nam beef stew  wonton noodle soup so I had the ngow nam ho fun  .  The beef  was tough and rice noodles not special.

Overall a great place in the neighborhood. Their Mac & cheese is the best. The half chicken is absolutely delicious! Sometimes I experience inconsistency in seasoning, especially with the burger/ chicken sandwich/ fish sandwich... I mean one day the burger is absolutely on the spot and the next day it's completely unseasoned. Almost as if sometimes the kitchen looses focus. If they cook their food consistently on their highest level, this place will succeed even more. Another issue for me is the staff. Usually great, a guy named Donny is very nice and professional, however I wish the staff would be a little more attentive to regular customers. The owner is a nice guy as well, polite, smiles at you and makes you feel comfortable.

The meze (appetizers) are fantastic and creative - love the sweet watermelon with feta, not to mention the excellent baba ganoush and falafel and many others.  The shellfish and lamb dishes are wonderful.  The wine ideally complements the meal, and with specials at happy hour.  But go to Miriam for the fish dishes (bronzino, sea bass, and the like.)  They roast a filet of fish absolutely perfectly every single time: barely crispy on the outside and tender in.  In this, they are completely reliable, and the price isn't bad for what you are getting.

this jollibee must get rid of all their employees and replace them with people who want to work not just to sit around and talk to each other all day if they want to stay in business. none of the workers know how to stfu while at the cash registers and just stay focus on serving customers. will never come back to this jollibee again. also the restaurant is filty. the tables and chairs need some serious cleaning.

Avoid if you're vegetarian. I ordered an eggplant parmesan and was given a chicken parmesan. Unfortunately, I didn't realize until a third of way into it.  The waiter knew I was vegetarian because we asked about the stock in the soups (all have meat stock). I was given the correct eggplant parmesan later, but there was no real apology or even offer of any discount. On the way out, another member of our party complained to the cashier, and the cashier said so that's great that we didn't get charged for both the eggplant and chicken parmesan. Wow.

Fresh, huge servings of amazing food. I can't say enough good things about the service, the food or the menu- if you want delicious quality food for breakfast with a twist on the regular boring breakfast food...go here. It is well worth it. Wish we lived around here so we could be regulars...

A lil disappointed if you go with a high expectations. The pork fried dumplings are good but the shanghai steamed pork soup dumplings and beef potato cakes are lower than average, not to mention other dishes. I don't know how it got four stars.

While the ceviche was fantastic, the entrees weren't amazing. We've been here several times and we keep coming back for the ceviche. The paella wasn't amazing, but it wasn't bad. We had the pineapple tuna, ceviche mixto, choritos, ceviche de pulpo, mussels tapas, and jaleita tapas.  Everything was great. Try it!

So good!!! I'm back for more already!! It's a corner store brunch place. So expect lots of butter. But everything is made to perfection, and at a good price. Food comes out quick! Omg and the French toast!!!!!!!! I don't trust anyone's French toast... #BOSS I was gonna post a pic but I was too hungry.

Great, Great Place. Beautiful building, Had dinner with friends got a seat outside on a beautiful night. They start the table off with simple bread and an eggplant spread that is delicious.  We then had the baked artichoke, fried calamari and roasted hot italian peppers to start, all were excellent, especially the artichoke, very tender and perfectly seasoned. I had the Lumiconi pasta dish, served in a big bowl, with chick pease sausage and chard. it was a great dish, if the chef would replace the chard with broccoli rabe this dish would be amazing. my wife had the pesto pasta dish, very simple, but not too rich and delicious.

Salt Creek is one of the few "chain restaurants" that consistently serves quality food at a fair price.  Once again we shared the ahi tuna appetizer and as usual it was wonderful. The kale & quinoa salad was a tasty blend of textures and flavors accented perfectly with tangy bits of feta cheese.  We also shared bacon wrapped shrimp which are complimented by a zesty honey chipotle sauce which would taste good on anything.  Our server Kyle was very knowledgable and friendly which made for

after reading all the reviews I expected more I admit.. I mean the food is ok, but defiantly not Special as mentioned. u can find good Halal places in the area and a good shwarma and chicken and rice.. I guess its all about taste, so for me it wasn't THAT good.
Overhyped.

I truly wanted to like this place. My husband and I were very excited after returning from our honeymoon in Portugal to find that Newark had a plethora of places to choose from. Unfortunately, we chose wrong. Our first tip off should have been when we called looking to make a reservation, and the person in the other end was short with my husband, told him not to worry and then hung up the phone. Our second clue should have been that no one was there eating when we arrived. Third, we were greeted by an older waiter who started by rolling his eyes at us for asking to be seated. The same waiter could not be bothered to pay us any attention at all as we looked at the menu. The service only got worse as the meal went on. He barely looked our way and rolled his eyes whenever we had a question. We both got the sinking feeling that it was because we weren't from the neighborhood, ie- we do not speak Portugese. The other two tables of customers were Portugese and the wait staff were on them like glue. I've never felt so uncomfortable in an establishment in all my life. Adding to this, the food was awful. The seafood rice had chewy seafood and lots of broken shells. It was listed at $15, and we were charged $17. The grilled cod my husband got was barely edible- the fish had zero taste, the broccoli rabe was beyond bitter and the potatoes were no good. I don't know how you mess up potatoes, but they did. Suffice it to say, we barely ate our meals, asked for the check (that took way too long to receive), paid and left without a word from anyone. Terrible experience. I would not wish this place on my worst enemy.

This place is amazing! Very cute Aztec/ Mexican like charm, delicious specialty margaritas, food spiced to perfection! Being from the west coast it was a pleasant experience in BK! The bartender Chow Sa... Or Chousa? Idk how to spell it, she was incredible!! She was on point at every moment! She was so intuitive and prompt to meet the needs of all patrons at the bar and partaking in spirits through the restaurant! I am very grateful I was able to witness the amazingness of her bar tending skills and eat so amazing Mexican food!! Delish! I highly recommend!
Best place to eat in East Hartford,  CT.  The owners are super friendly and the food is the best.

Friendly place and nice decor. The chicken roulade was delicious, save for the dryness of the chicken. The vegetables and fettuccini in the Fettuccini with Chicken were on the bland size. The service left much to he desired (our glasses weren't refilled even once and had to wait for the waiter to collect the check).

Was so bummed. We had a reservation and sat for 30 minutes before we could even get a drink, then couldn't get food because the kitchen was understaffed. Shame because the menu looked good. Not sure what happened but today's brunch was a disaster - hope they get their act together.

I was so excited to try an authentic Philly cheesesteak and spent the entire ride from the airport thinking about a sandwich overflowing with meat, peppers, onions and cheese "wiz," but I was disappointed when it turned out to be more roll than anything else. Very skimpy on the filling, I barely needed a napkin. I was also put off by the "this is America, please order in English" sign in their window. I only speak English, but would expect more hospitality and less blatant hostility from a   place so dependent on visits from tourists from all over. If I had noticed the sign before I ordered, I would've taken my business across the street to Pat's.

This review is long over due!! If you decide to go to Pio Pio make sure u go to the hell kitchen location, it is the BEST!!. The food is superb and DELISH!! The staff are very nice and wonderful,  the drinks are great and STRONG!! My girls and I always have a great time and never leave disappointed! ! The restaurant is very beautiful and have that modern but sophisticated look, perfect for a date night or grabbing a bite to eat!! 5 stars feel but very affordable.  The portion are so big u can share it with another person!!!!
Normal pizza place. Nohting special except the celeb images on the wallas. A pepperonin square had eight small pepperonis on it.
Get here early- the place is lively however their waiting method needs to be looked at.  Your in a crowded area waiting for a table standing over other  people eat.
If you wanted to grab a quick bite & breakfast this is the place in Center City!!!Great ambience, cool waitresses, very home style cooking...
Pretty tasty! A bit overrated for the hip but its kinda nice. the place is small so get ready to be close to people! :D
Food, atmosphere, drinks are great.. Service is 50/50.. It's always a bit slow when they don't have enough waiters available.

I've been to the Gander four times this summer for business lunches and have been wanting to take my wife here ever since. I guess that about sums it up. I'm confident that my wife--an excellent cook in her own right, with the highest standards, and someone more often that not disappointed with nyc restaurants--will love it as much as I do. The Gander is my go-to restaurant of the moment and not because it's right across the street from my office. (Okay maybe that's a small part of the reason.) From the moment the warm fluffy rolls hit the table to the yogurt Panna Cotta, everything was made with relentless attention to detail and tasted that way. After tasting and devouring all three of the warm rolls, one ecstatic lunch companion grabbed the waiter and asked, "are these yeast rolls," and when the waiter responded affirmatively, said, "I haven't had these since I was a kid in the South." He then went on to request more. I've had the salmon once (pristinely fresh and perfectly rendered) and the spaghetti and clams the next three times. I should also not fail to mention an appetizer of heirloom tomatoes and Burrata, the most delicious tomatoes of the summer, with just the perfect amount of extra virgin olive oil. One last thing. When was the last time any restaurant substituted a dessert on a prix fix menu. One lunch my companions asked for fruit. They got it. And a generous amount at that. More expensive for the restaurant. But they aim to please. And do.
Good burgers , good service , clean environment , amazing french onion soup , good staff !
Two words - Awe some!  Great menu. Great service. Great atmosphere. Great new friends.

What an awesome discovery - this place has a great vibe, even on a Monday evening. The only complaint is that there really isn't a huge selection of beer brewed on site, and two of the three are cask conditioned ales, which aren't everyone's cup of tea. Nevertheless we will definitely be making a radiation of visiting Eataly whenever were in NYC

Have eaten here every time I visit New York and keep coming back for more. Menu changes regularly and EVERYTHING is delicious! Always creative combinations of the freshest food. I usually end up getting some combination of sandwich, soup and salad which are unlike any I have eaten before. Agree with previous reviewer to try and arrive before noon when the line explodes. Grab a table outside and watch the people go by....

My husband and I ordered the Chef's tasking menu with the wine pairings.  We started off with the artichokes, which were tough and we left most of it.  The following two pasta dishes were ok, but extremely small portions.  The Ox tail was good as well as the dessert. The wines we were served were a joke.  The pairing was $65 each and with the exception of one of the wines, the rest were terrible.  Most of the bottles were already opened and one was totally sour.  Interestingly enough when we told the waitress we were thinking of getting the pairings she tried to steer us from it and recommended we get a full bottle instead. Overall, the food was mediocre and the wines were terrible.  Definitely $300 down the drain.

I don't know how the food is, because I've been sitting here for 45 minutes waiting for it. The people who arrived 15 minutes after me are eating what looks like a nice sandwich, which wasn't even on my menu because our server forgot to bring us the full menu. I'll be walking out once this review is posted if my food isn't here. Added: Eating the food now because I'm starving. Worst chilaquiles ever. Basically a giant bowl of stale chips drenched in tasteless sauce with an egg on top. The three people I'm  with don't like their food either and the table next to us just returned their food. How the hell does this dump have 4.5 stars?

I picked up an order of general tso chicken yesterday. Although, they use white meat..which is a good thing...the dish itself was beyond dry and tasteless and way over cooked. In addition they dont give you much for $13! Normally my go to chinese place is east garden in west orange,they were closed on sundays. The same general tso chicken dish at East Garden has an abundance of flavor, but some of the chicken is fatty...huge turn off. I still rather spit those pieces out and have a flavorful dish.
Average food, would expect more from such a large/elaborate location.  Pizza is comparable to Domino's,   dishes are standard.

Came here because I was craving Filipino food and I was HUNGRY! It was a total waste of my time!  I came alone at around 2pm and was seated at the bar for lunch.Patiently waited for my food ( about 40 mins now) while the fan was blowing right to me.The front area of the restaurant was about 80% empty and asked kindly the guy with a ponytail (he was the guy at the bar most of the time) if I can be seated on one of the vacant tables and the fan was really bothering me.He said ,"There's a waiting lists for the tables". I said calmly that there's no one waiting inside or outside the restaurant  but he just walked away. Also, the restaurant was an hour away from closing for lunch.I returned to my seat hungry to angry! Was watching my watch and 15 mins passed, no one occupied those empty tables! The worst part was- one of the staffs came to tell me that their kitchen computer had malfunction and they just put in my order! Seriously????? I was planning to take my order out instead of eating there since I can't stand the fan blowing on my eyes/face but I ended up leaving the place with an empty stomach, smelling like a fried fish and  a bad experience from my fellow Filipinos.I took pictures of the almost empty restaurant hoping I can post it here.I ended up eating at a Vietnamese restaurant a block away from Maharlika..I gave one star for the free glass of NY water that wasn't refilled during the entire time I was there. Next time I'll crave for Filipino food, I'll take advantage of my zip car membership and drive to Woodside or Jersey City who  has truly authentic Filipino food.
Good wings, good flavor, lots of variety. Woukd come back again!!! Hand-cut fries were a bonus.

Well to start off redwood is disgusting. We went for brunch and started off getting a pitcher of bloody mary's. I was expecting there to be alcohol in them but the only thing I left with was a bad stomach ache and having to run to the bathroom an hour later. Worst part was I was still sober. The bar is also very dirty. There were flies all over bar and other various bugs. I ordered the fried chicken and waffle meal and the chicken was drier than a 95 year old woman's....  My girlfriend ordered the 3 cheese grease monster that was pretty much inedible. The only good thing about this bar Is the impressive beer list.

This is the place to go for hearty, grown-up versions of the grilled cheese sandwich.  My favorite is the Fried Chicken--it's exactly how it sounds with a healthy portion of red cabbage slaw and met sauce on sourdough bread.  The Maple Bacon is pretty good also, but unless you're eating for two I'd go for the Fried Chicken. The tots make a great side (with extra melt sauce), and the Oreo shake will put you over but is well worth it.  Melt closes at 9pm, but go before that; popular items like the Fried Chicken sell out quickly, or they might turn off the deep fryer early.

Omg is all I can say. The service is impeccable and the food, WOW!! I'm convinced there is nothing bad on the menu. My favorites were meatballs the risotto with ruffle oil, portobello mushrooms and fresh mozzarella!!  I always come here when I'm in town. This place is so yummy.

The food is very good!!! I especially love the sandwiches and breakfast. However, the Coffee is not so great, not tastes as good as I expected (although the name of the place is "Cafe"...). I do recommend eating there, it is great food experience and nice atmosphere, but skip the coffee itself :)

Rude, dirty, small. Seriously, the people who work there are the RUDEST Peele I've ever dealt with. The owner told us if we wanted to order to go we had to wait outside. Seriously? Do not give these people business, go across the street to thang long a clean and friendly establishment, with just as good food.
Good food Fresh sushi Order at counter grab a table quickly because it is crowded wirh Penn kids   Reasonably priced Lots of choices

I came here to try their chicken and waffles, which sounded amazing, considering I was a little hungover and starving! There were 2 of us and it was a 20min wait because they were obviously understaffed and left plenty of tables empty...but I still thought it'd be worth the wait. Our waiter, Luis, talked very fast and didn't listen very well, so the service was already somewhat disappointing. I finally got my food, and after a few bites, noticed something dark in my waffle...IT WAS A BIG BLACK SCREW!! I told Luis immediately, was extremely nice about the situation, and he brought his manager out who apologized and brought me a fresh new plate of food after my friend had already finished eating...and my appetite was already ruined... What really surprised us, was that they ended up charging us full price for our meals! I kind of regret not putting on a scene, maybe they would have been more accommodating... I won't say that the food or atmosphere was that bad, but I'll definitely never be coming back here... :(

Nice family style atmosphere with good food.  A little expensive and not as attentive as we'd like, but comfortable.   Fish was good.  Salad good.  Desert good. Don't let owner suggest drinks that you then have to pay for.

Worts delivery service ever, The food is great, I completely understand that yesterday was raining and was busy but to wait 2 hours for a pizza to arrive was ridiculous, you really need to get staff together.
Amazing food, absolutely loved the ambiance. Very timely service.

First time I have been here.... It received amazing Yelp reviews and it did live up to its amazing reviews for brunch! The eggs and bacon in a popover were delicious. The freshly squeezed juice was terrific. I tried my daughters fresh toast and it was great. The waitress was nice but half of our food was not hot and she forgot our pastry basket to kickoff our brunch! I highly recommend  and would definitely go back.

Cute little place with good service and traditional Middleastern cuisine. I was actually not hungry, so while my boyfriend enjoyed his Lamb and Beef Shawarma, I nibbled on Tabbouleh salad and pita. I would love if they provide some Hummus or other sauce for the pita or served it warm, but it was still good. The Tabbouleh was good, but not what I have expected. It was essentially a parsley salad with a tiny bit of quinoa. The seasoning was good, as well as the tomato and onion, but it was definitely an overwhelming dish and for a small dish, I could only finish half. I would definitely try it again because the service was friendly and the establishment is cute with outdoor seating. Would like to give more menu items a try so I can adequately evaluate. of note, they have a Moroccan restaurant adjoining owned by the same people and I would love to try there.
Their service was slow. Food tasted ok, but the portion size was discriminatory to say the least for the price paid. Ambience and decor are pretty much non existent.
Artichoke pizza was so delicious!! Also tried their margherita pizza was pretty good....just avoid looking at the "C" health code rating when eating it

I love this place. I have been ordering from here for the last four years and love it. The quality of the pizza and ingredients are good. I can't stop telling everyone to order from here because I love it so much. Sal is one of the sons of the owner and he is very friendly and makes sure that we are taken care of. We order from here at least once a week. Unfortunately I have only tried their pizza and have not tried any of the other entrees but would love to come and try it out. Really great pizza!

I used to like this place, but got tired of the surly, elitist, entitled attitude of the people who work there. Plus, the no paper menu, no TV schtick is old and tired. It's a big city, go to the Green Rock Tavern or Kellianne's instead.

Overall a positive dining experience. My boyfriend and I wanted a romantic dress to the 9s kinda night which was appropriate there, an eclectic, but nice dress among diners. He had the Wasabi crusted filet and I the pad thai. We had the crab and lobster dim sum to start. Although the food was delicious, it didnt have the value to back the high prices. I recommend the Zen-gria to drink, light and delish. Service was attentive and up to fine dining standards. As well, the restaurant is close to 2nd street and some great choices in bars for later into your evening.
Great food. Excellent service!  A must visit for Latin American food.  Nice atmosphere.

Our first time trying the cuisine from Uzbekistan-- we really enjoyed it. Food was an interesting blend of Mediterranean, middle eastern, Russian and Eastern European. The dumplings in soup (chuchvara) was really delicious and not overpowering in tomato flavor (as most tomato soups can be). The Bokhara manti (lamb dumplings) with tomato, yogurt and dill was really tasty as well. Well balanced flavors. Ambience of the restaurant was really lovely. Service was a little slow as there was only 1 waiter but we were not in a hurry so it was ok. Overall, would highly recommend if you're not too rushed on time and are feeling a little adventurous.
Horrible pizza, although their other dishes are always pretty good.

Great food, great service. I have eaten here several times in the past few week, and it has become one of my routine dinner spots. Wait staff is quick and friendly and they usually don't make any mistakes with my order. Its a BIT pricey to eat often, but they DO have good food :D Highly recommend the fresh pappardelle dish

Always a bit over crowded during happy hour but if that's not too much of an issue for you, and if you're looking for a delicious $5 lychee martini that sneaks up on you good enough to get the job done quickly  then this is the perfect happy hour spot to pre-game

Basic. Plain. Boring. I do not enjoy writing mediocre reviews on YELP nor on Bonjourclem.com. But Iam straight on and Peeky about my food. The seating was fast. Only 5mns after we arrived we got seated. The staff is pretty good. Nothing amazing but nothing to complain about. The ambiance is very boring with a crazy level of noise at Brunch time, at least. I couldn't hear my date on the other side of the table. We ordered Texas French Toasts, Strawberry Compote Buttermilk Pancakes and Baked Eggs with Salmon. The portions are huge but quite uninteresting. The eggs were overloaded with dry cheap salmon and drowned in tasteless tomato sauce. The pancakes were topped with industrial strawberry jam and not cooked enough. The French Toasts just passable. Experience 3/10 bonjourclem.com @Bonjourclem Xoxo Clem

Good sandwiches and great Bagels. No inside seating so you'll have to grab and go! Service could be a little friendlier but the Bagels are awesome and the variety and quality of sandwiches and food is very high! Going to be a regular visit for our family!
Best food I have eaten in a rest area. Fresh and organic meat and simple ingredients. I had a Caesar salad with fresh grilled chicken and a grass fed beef hot dog. Excellent quality.

This has been my go to thai place in the Montclair area for over two years. I specifically love their tofu, however recently their service has been worse. Today we ordered three dishes for pick up, two of which were tofu for the vegetarians. It wasn't until AFTER we paid and tipped well (as we are regulars and treat our favorite spots well) that we were told casually that they ran out of tofu and just threw in some extra veggies. While I appreciate being told, it was NOT what I would consider GOOD CUSTOMER SERVICE. I would have expected a call or at least been notified before paying for the food. We wouldn't have eaten here tonight as the tofu was the craving we wanted to satisfy. We will think twice about ordering next time.

We ate here over Labor Day weekend for the restaurant's soft opening.  The place is unbelievable.  From the decor to the service to the food (the food!) to the drinks, the team of CookNSolo has killed it once again.  Go, eat everything, you won't be disappointed - the food is delicious and inventive, unlike anything this city (or any city) has ever seen.  Book now, I predict this place will be mobbed every night from now until forever.

Ugh. Since moving to the area I have been looking for a good pizza joint. The first time ordering I had just presumed the pizza got knocked around in the delivery car and that's why it looked like a slop mess. I also ordered the garlic bread and oh my goodness, I felt as if I had just bit into an actual garlic clove, it was terrible. Second time around there was a puddle of grease just flooding the whole middle of the pizza, I don't even know how I stomached two slices. I ordered another thing of garlic bread and made a note for them to just take it easy on the garlic...they didn't. If it wasn't for the grease mess and the overuse of garlic, this might be a semi decent place.

My husband and I went for dinner here because we saw it on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives the other day. Guy Fieri spoke very highly of it and we wanted to experience it also. It's a small place, so don't look for spaciousness. The waiter/host was very friendly the entire time. The wait for the food wasn't long. The food itself was delicious. The burger was better tasting and I think the best I've had in years! We could have had seasoned fries for a couple dollars more, but we stuck to the regular fries. We plan to return another day to try out other items on the menu.

The food is good but there is definitely better out there if your willing to pay a little more. Its kind of like greek fast food; it's a little healthier than american fast food chains, but probably not much. The prices are pretty good, especially for NYC, but the service/delivery could use a little help at times. The food ranges between pretty good to ok. I would suggest the mama's gyro which is pretty good, while the greek salad is ok, but forgettable as is the burger. Its worth a try and isn't the worst quick option for those tiring of other options

Great food !! Best octopus, best grilled calamari in town, fried eggplants and zucchini are delicious ! Great Greek salad !! Swordfish is fantastic! the portions are huge without loosing the quality !! Service could be a little better though ...

Went here with a group of friends last weekend and we ordered a bunch of small plates.  Every single one was atrocious, even the salad.  The mussels were inedible and the pork belly was tough and flavorless.  The service was incredibly slow, despite the fact we were there late and there wasn't much of a crowd.   The menu is pretentious, the plating is unattractive, and the food taste terrible. Stay away!
Excellent food and great service! Will be back soon.

Amazing food but DON'T JUST ORDER OFF THE MENU! Rookie mistake!!! This place is next to a tourist area and the menu is for tourists who want a quick meal. If you want some of the BEST FOOD you have ever been served talk to the staff or Jeff the owner (he is always there and is the most attentive and involved owner I have ever seen.) They will talk with you about what you like, what is fresh, and some secret off menu items that are old family recipes. If you do this you will enjoy an amazing meal. Jeff and his mom cook there together everyday and from the moment you walk in you feel like a welcome friend at the family dinner table. Locals frequent (as in everyday there is a large local crowd) this place for a reason. If you are from out of town talk to the other patrons and by the end of the night you will have a new group of best friends. Fish Market is a MUST.
Delicious falafel and tasty hummus, extremely fast service, nice personnel and low prices, what more could we ask for? Thanks Mamoun for preparing most of my lunches!

My fiance & I went to Papa's Tomato Pies in Robbinsville NJ the other night for the first time. Supposedly one of the 101 best pizza places in America (by the Daily Meal), and the America's first pizza place founded in 1912 .The wait was very long (close to an hour). Once we were seated, I was so close to the front door, that I could greet the other customers as they came in (lousy seat). We ordered pizza with half mushroom, which took forever to come out. When it did, you could not even find the 4 or 5 pieces of mushroom, and the pizza was definitely overcooked and dry, like cardboard (maybe it was left over from 1912). The wait staff was iffy, at best. They also charge $2.75 (a bit pricey for a 10 oz size.) for a cup of red cream soda.. They obviously do not like to have negative posts on their FB page, as my posting was deleted (very professional of them). The CASH ONLY was an inconvenience, as most places will take a card of some kind. They did have an ATM inside, but you will probably pay $5.00 in ATM fees to use it. So, if you do not have a good experience with them, and post that it was not good, no one on their Facebook page will ever see it.. We were really hoping for a treat, and were very, very disappointed with our meal. The only thing I found entertaining was the poor hostess stationed outside that was scurrying around like a chicken without a head. We'll not be going back for another visit..
Amazing spot,good beer,great staff,but on the food side...the hot wings i order was dry,& blah!!! But other than that everything's good...outside sitting during summer is fantastic...
Great taste French cuision. Recommended!

Food is sooo sooo good,the restaurant & ambience is really good...but the wait staff/waiter is kinda impatience, & lack of personality. He didn't even got the water that i ask 2x,& totally ignore when i ask for a extra napkins.But the place & food awesome...

I came to The Bounty because I had a beer coupon from Brokelyn. I walked there 4 times before it was actually open to use the coupon. It opens unusually late on some says & on Mondays is just straight up closed. When I finally achieved entering the place, I got one beer for the coupon & the server had kind of a weird attitude about it. I ignored him & just played around on my iPhone. The place was dead so no one to make conversation with. It's more of a restaurant that happens to have a bar than a legit bar. I bought a second beer as is customary in these situations -- the point of Brokelyn's $30 beer coupon book is to try new bars in different neighborhoods & if you go alone you should tip well & outright buy a second drink to be polite to the place that offered you the "free" beer. I tried to make conversation with the bartender about how it was always closed and I was happy to finally get inside, and other chatter but he was barely concealing his annoyance at having to talk to someone who wasn't dropping $50 on dinner. I won't be going back here. No clue what the food is like but given the hours & unfriendly atmosphere i wonder why grey even bothered to participate in the free beer coupon booklet.
Amazing!! Everything we got was delicious! Chicken parm, penne alla vodka, and a special with lobster cream sauce!!

Started with Grilled Octopus which was some of the best I have ever had and then the Paella which was excellent and very moist and flavorful. Could have been a bit more generous with seafood. Sangria and service very good.

I'm obsessed with East Gate. I come here whenever I'm craving sushi! They have this awesome unlimited sushi deal for like $22 and it is literally all you can eat PLUS that includes all the appetizers, small plates, soup, salads, and even ice cream. The sushi is alway fresh and the staff is very nice. It's an amazing deal and the sushi tastes great which is why I keep coming back. Also they are BYOB!

Writing this hungry, as I just got back from my fist time here, and after waiting for over an hour-and a half (seriously!) our food NEVER came. The waitress was nice, the atmosphere pleasant, but something definitely seems wrong in the kitchen. We did notice at one point that none of the tables in the restaurant had food (at 7.30 pm), which lasted for about 45 minutes, then we saw some food going to delivery and going to our neighbors (who arrived a half hour later), but it never came to our table. The waitress blamed it on being a busier Monday (labor day) than usual, but with three people in the kitchen, one bar person and two waitressess, and a pleasantly full, but not crowded place, I'd say there is some logistics issue going on here. I would have gone back, as the place felt mellow and pleasant, but after reading more reviews about similar issues, I probably won't.

Worst experience I have had in a restaurant. I very rarely write negative reviews on Yelp, but was so disgusted with the actions of the workers here that I decided to write one. I wouldn't say I was a frequent diner at Ray's, was there maybe three times before this bad experience took place. A friend, her autistic brother and I went into Ray's one night for pizza.  It was fairly late, maybe an hour from closing, so my friend's brother was getting a little restless. It is clear that my friend's brother suffers from autism. While ordering pizza he was making some noises, but in general keeping to himself, when out of not where the cashiers and pizza guys started laughing at him. They were making fun of him, and mocking him! Literally mocking a 9 year old boy! My friend was so upset by this she yelled and they still continued to mock. We ended up leaving. I have never seen anything like this take place. My friend was brought to tears, as she had every right to be. I was disgusted, flabbergasted, and taken a back. I will never EVER be returning here.

This place was exceptional in the 1980's. I'm saying this was a great pizza experience. Thick pizza that required a fork and knife. Then it became the worst pizza around. Avoid this place at all costs. Anything else will do. If you choose to drive 10 minutes from there Go to Star Tavern in Orange. That is good pizza. Any place in between will be Better than Rays of Verona.

Typically when I'm hungry for tapas I head straight for Barcelona in a New Haven. Living only 5 minutes from Bistro we decided to give it a shot. This may very well be East Havens gem! The service, ambiance and food from start to finish including the complimentary port wine exceeded my expectations! This place actually lifted my spirits and it wasn't just the quality spirits they had on hand! Our server was pleasant and she was right on top of everything. Having a sub par experience at DeLagna in New Haven the previous night, this was an excellent way to finish off a holiday weekend. Bravo!!! We'll be back.

Incredible sushi.  Everything was delicious and makes my mouth water just to think about what we ate.  We came here for my sister's birthday dinner and couldn't have asked for a better meal.  We splurged a bit and got the omakase plus plenty of extra pieces.  The interior and service were impeccable and the sake was delicious too.
I would like to give this place a five star review, but I have been there twice and the bus boy working the outdoor area has been rude both times.  Silly way to lose customers.
GET THE FROZEN GIN AND JUICE! I got the Beastmaster pizza and it was amazing. The wait time was about 20 mins for a table but worth it!
Fun concept. Very good locations. Enjoy

This place is awesome. The food is consistently good and the menu always has something you will want. Sidecar will always be my go to place in the neighborhood when I want food. The brunch, sandwiches, burgers, entrees, and pork nachos are always on point

After looking at the menu and reviews, my wife and I were very excited to try this neighborhood spot. We ordered the Theresa burger and the eggs benedict. After waiting more than 30 minutes (and no check-ins from our waitress, who was avoiding our eyes), we got our food. The benedict had no hollandaise. What is a benedict without hollandaise? I brought this up to the waitress, who explained that they were out. Hollandaise is not a terribly difficult thing to make quickly, but damned if they were going to make some just because someone ordered it (or at least let us know what we were ordering). To top it off, the egg whites were underdone. On the plus side, the potato wedges are very tasty, and the burger was good. Messy and overdone (medium well when I asked for medium rare) but good. Overall, this seems like the kind of place that knows how to serve good food, but I guess we got there on an off day, and a lot of the problems could have been fixed with more attentive service.
Went here the other day for the first time and the food was okay, I wasn't that impressed but my family in Montclair swears by this pizza place.

Love the small plate concept. The dishes here are so good, especially the chicken and the roasted mushrooms. Service is brilliant. Our server gave us a dessert wine each to try after our meal, for absolutely no extra charge. The pasta dishes are excellent as well.
Ok place,if you are meeting with someone's to get something to drink this is the place,kinda small rustic place.the bar tender is great,she was friendly & entertaining... Crowd are mix...

When I'm in New York, I find it shameful to buy $1 pizza. I was on a mission to flat out find the BEST PIZZA IN NY. This place came pretty damn close. The menu is short and straight to the point - just as it should be. Service was so friendly, I thought they were related to me. I ordered a half margherita/half pepperoni. It was delicious and there's really not much else to it. JUST GO.
very good quality. I love the egg on the top of the soup. nice touch. i'll be back
one of the best chives and pork fried dumplings around!!!

We were tourists in the area and stopped into Tisserie 2 days in a row because the food and coffee and people working there were wonderful. I highly recommend this place even if you are just stopping in for coffee.
Amazing! Just like in Spain! Delicious and affordable sandwiches and beer!  Perfect for a casual lunch. I hope they open more!

Almost great (3.5 stars) The renovations at the Hanover Inn have accomplished the unthinkable: maintaining the small New England town / College town feel of the old Hanover Inn while bringing in the luxury and modern amenities of large city hotels.  A similar trend can be seen in the menu from Pine.  Unfortunately, it just falls slightly short.   We had Sunday brunch at Pine.  The service was excellent.  The ambiance was clean, fun, and trendy.  The menu offered unique spins on common New England staples.  My wife started with delicious home made granola and yogurt with free berries.  I started with the goat cheese, arugula, beets, asparagus, and carrot salad.  The salad was delicious but I only had two small pieces of golden beet on the whole salad.  My wife had the stratta (essentially an open face omelette) with artichokes and parmesan cream.  It was supposed to come with a baguette but they forgot.  The stratta was delicious nonetheless.  I had the Johnnycakes (pancakes) which were slightly different than listed on the menu.  These has ginger carmelized pear baked into them and also on top.  It was a bit too much pear to be honest.  The pear baked into the pancakes was not well cooked and still pretty firm.   Overall, the menu needs some work and there is still a bit of polish required to get this to 4 or 5.  I still miss the days of the lavish buffet brunch that made the Hanover Inn famous.

A decent new addition to the SO/Maplewood dining scene.  The cioppino was amazing and I wish it was a regular menu item instead of just a special.  Service is a little amateurish but somewhat expected in the area.  The bar would be a great place for a burger and a martini, except the window seating is so tight that if you get the last table you basically can't fit, and the acoustics are so terrible you can't hear yourself think.

While the food was very tasty, the service left much to be desired. It took forever to have out order taken, we had to ask for water multiple times, and appetizer dishes were left on the table well into the meal.

Great Dominican food. The Mofongo was delicious, best I've had so far. The Yuca Frita was fresh and yummy. The Flan was AMAZING! The owner Chris is real nice and produces a great meal. The portions are great and the prices are great. We can't wait to try the rest of the menu.

Two words... Akamaru Modern!! The broth was rich and delicious; noodles were perfectly al dente with a "bite" to it (just the way I like it).The Kae-dama (extra plate of noodles) are definitely worth the additional $2. Pork buns are awesome. The Matcha Brulee was fabulous and unique.  Cool atmosphere! Service was quick and impeccable.  Always seems to be crowded so be prepared to wait. Definitely addicted to this place!

The brunch on Labor Day weekend was great. My niece had the omelette with goat cheese and spinach which I snacked on and it was most refreshing. I had the roasted tomato soup which was presented with mozzarella cheese crusted. Tasted great!  I highly recommend The Smith for brunch.

This was my second trip to Ippudo Westside and definitely won't be my last! The ramen  is oh-so-good and the broth is always very flavorful and tasty. Yum. We always order the pork buns and they never disappoint. I just wish that they would open an Ippudo in Chicago because I haven't had ramen this good in the Windy City!
One of my favorite places to eat, but some of their staff (Stuart) need to brush up on customer service. Food is really good otherwise.
Amazing fresh guacamole , service was good but unfriendly. Prices were expensive but the  food was excellent, I won't be in a rush to return but instill will be back, just for the guacamole alone
Excellent food with a great presentation!!!!

I went here earlier in the week on a friend's recommendation.  I really like this tavern.  The atmosphere is above average and the food was really good.  Terrific burger and waffle fries were cooked well.  The server was super friendly.  I'm glad the pumpkin beers seem to be early this season.
Just as a heads up - happy hour will be coming to this Gyu-Kaku location on 9/15, which I am super excited about! Exactly what I was waiting for for this restaurant.

I love this place!  This our "Go To"; NEVER had anything I didn't like off the menu.  Owner is supper friendly, and pretty much always walking around.  We've ordered everything from steak specials to Wood Fired Pizza and have never been disappointed.
Good food good service good drinks melt in mouth meats. Good wine recommendation by server. Will be back again soon
Place is really over priced. Each rice bowl (small) is $4!!!! And the hot pot is small in meats and more veggies on top. Expect about 25$ each person...

FABULOUS does not begin to describe our breakfast dining experience at the Spicey Green Bean! One Saturday morning - late in August - my son and i just happened upon this perfect spot - with a PERFECT waitress named Kerry whose smile and good nature made the experience even better! We were both very hungry - and when the food arrived (wtih very little wait time) we were so excited to find it was as amazing as we'd imagined!  We loved the experience and the SGB will absolutely become a regular stop for us in the weeks to come - THANK YOU for helping us start our day out on a great note :)
Great food, good service.

Given the yelp reviews on this place I ordered for delivery as we had just driven 9 hours and needed some rest. I ordered a chicken biriyani, chicken tikka, and raita at 7pm. We were told it would take 30-60 minutes. At 7:40 I called to confirm the order and was told that the delivery guy was stuck in traffic and would be there in five minutes. At 8:10 I called and got the exact same answer as last time. We were a 4 minute drive from the restaurant. Starved, frustrated and becoming angry we walked across the road and had a meal. We came back, went to sleep and never got our delivery. I really hope that this was a once off but is NEVER order from here again.

Even a small diner is better than this horrible experience . Party of four order was fried calamari shatobrian for two and seafood mixed plate. Served with fruits !! What the heck. Slays of unpeeled orange green apple and cantaloupe on the same plate of grilled filemignon and bullion melted in cold water. No salt pepper or anything to taste . On seafood "just paprika " with boiled green beans. Oh god what did I do to experience such a food as a chef. I had to write this on food blogs . Sorry to share this not my style to share bad things but I had to.

I just moved to the area and can't be any happier I found this place. I've come here at least twice a week after work in the past couple months. The food is great, awesome quality and the prices are amazing! I've become a little bit of a regular here and love the cozy feel of the place. Not crazy about the high tables though. The service is great- the same waitress is working every time I'm there ..she's always very friendly and smiley and regardless of the amount of people in the restaurant she always remembers to bring me extra ketchup. The crepe complete is AMAZING, and I usually get the sweet lemon or crepe suzette for dessert!! Not a big chocolate fan so I usually stick with something light. The menu is very impressive and great for all tastes. Will definitely continue to come here. Such a gem.
Amazing lunch. I had a salad that was so gorgeous I didn't want to eat it and my boyfriend got really delicious rice. He loved the marinaded meat in a stick. Overall, a really great meal

Word of warning: NOT STUDENT FRIENDLY. Food and coffee were good, but there is a terrible seven dollar minimum on credit card use (never a good idea in an increasingly moneyless world). Owners seem somewhat amicable but at the same time hostile towards customers. I enjoy a coffee shop were I can sit and do a little work. After being there for more than 20 minutes, one of the female owners (I think) made it a point to say I had to buy something to stay. I found this very rude and discourteous as I was already planning on purchasing food. There is also a lack of outlets and a general "chill" effect if you have been there too long. This is made worse by the owners constantly wandering around, making it feel as if they are watching you all the time. With all the hipster shops in New York, I wish Montclair would open a more student-friendly coffee shop.

Took my mom here for her first time. Started with delicious paper shrimp and of course the stuffed wings. Moved on to the grilled duck breast (soooooooo good) and Seafood Delight. She loved it as did I. Such wonderful blends of flavors. She can't wait to come back.
They've got the best stir fried noodles and rice in town! My favorite place in Philly.

Food is ok. 2 people for lunch and the bill was 15 dollars...the service was bad. The waitress came to get our drink order and that was the last time she made it to my table.i had to ask the hostess for the check. I will not be back. I'd rather pay more and have better service..stay away from this place unless you like being ignored.

This place was recommended by a friend, I heard about the salted caramel pretzel chicken and was immediately intrigued. The place is a bit small, probably only big enough to seat 10-15 people, but we went at around 10:30pm (30 min before closing) so it was pretty empty and able to seat us, a party of 5. The guy at the register was super chill and recommended some popular flavors for us. We weren't too hungry but wanted to try a variety of flavors, so we ordered two salted caramels, two badabings, and three originals with two sauces and he said he would throw in two surprise flavors for us. He ended up giving us 10 different kinds of sauces for the chicken fingers!!! It was so unexpected and they were all so unique and delicious! The wasabi aioli, jalapeno sauce, and sticky sauce were my favorites. The fried chicken by itself was actually pretty good too. The badabing was amazing because of the oozing cheese in the middle and the salted caramel was everything i hoped and wished it would be - the perfect combination of sweet, salty, and crunchy. Kind of reminded me of the taste of chicken n' waffles. TLDR; this place offers great service, wide variety, and delicious fried chicken. Definitely worth going to..multiple, multiple times just to try all the different flavors!

Very disappointed. Saw the good reviews and stopped in on our way home after a long drive. It was 9:20 and the hours clearly stated on the door and on Yelp the restaurant was open until 10pm. When we walked in, the manager said they could only do takeout. Really? What kind of place does that. I'm sorry if the restaurant was slow tonight but when you post your hours you should stick to it. I understand if it we walked in at 9:50, but we were there 40 min before close??? My husband and I would have been finished with dinner before close. Very disappointed.

Not a huge fan of this place. It has promise and maybe it was just the night I went & bartender I had but it wasn't very inviting. She barely paid attention to me to order a drink or make conversation. There weren't many other patrons here except a friend of he bartender and a couple of sketchy looking guys in the corner. They were playing reggae music and the ambiance was cute, which is why I'm giving 3 stars, but otherwise I didn't enjoy it. I went with a beer coupon from Brokelyn that's supposed to get you to check out new places you've never been to. I wouldn't make a trip to go back here but might give it a second shot if I'm in the area.
Excellent Service! Beautiful Atmosphere! Warm & Attentive Service! The Perfect Place for any occasion. The Princeton location is the best.

My family and I had a lovely Italian meal after my college graduation ceremony here. It was also Mother's Day, which featured a special menu in honor of the owner's mother's recipes. Besides our party, there were only a couple of other tables taken, which surprised us that it was so slow on what should be a busy night. The waitstaff was very accommodating though. The food was amazing. Everything was delicious and everyone was pleased with their meals. The prices are very reasonable. My parents were shocked that the bill was so cheap at only a few hundred dollars for a party of 10.

Not really a review, but the hours says it's closed on Sundays....I was just there yesterday which was Sunday...so yeah...Just sayin''. Hmm..Might as well as give a review: Personally I don't get the hype. I mean..the foods not bad, but there are so many other things I'd choose to get instead depending on my mood. I mainly get Halal from  here because it's really close to where I work and I get lazy. It could be the location thought. I've heard people saying this location isn't that great and there are much better Halal locations. This is the first and only one I've been to so I have nothing else to judge it on. Though I probably won't be getting it for quite some time since that Sunday it made me feel so horrible; the thought of eating anything with meat made me feel nauseous...

Sultan Gyro has good food, good prices and a very personable owner.                      Do not let reviewers like Mitchel P  AKA (,Vinnie C  ,Michael P, Peter G , Howard R )  -  deter you from eating here. If you see any reviews under these names they are all  FAKE REVIEWS .!                                                                                                                       Seems Mitchel P has his panties in a bunch because he has nowhere to eat in the area so he thinks by defaming the business he gets his revenge.What a sorry son of a bitch.Maybe we should all go on his YELP page under Drapery and Blinds Company and give him some bad reviews  and see how he feels ---except his aren't fake                                                                                                                                 By  the way since you have such a hard on for people wearing gloves here's some info.Its not imperative to wear gloves if your shop has a handwash sink I would rather food prepared by clean hands rather than dirty gloves.You know very little about food preparation and handling judging by your reviews and remarks. They offer a gluten free option for their pizza and it was Great. Gluten free beer and casual college town atmosphere with friendly and helpful staff. Good food, good service and good prices - what more can you ask for?
ilili is the worst they broke my drink and spilled the drink all over my brothers . So this restaurant needs an upgrade !!
They are the bahn masters (I'm so sorry) of the bahn mi Well priced, great tasting and quick. Heck I travel from the Bronx to get my fix. That's how good it is

Food was edible, service was atrocious. Got up and got our own menu's, then got up and got a pitcher of water since there was none put on our table nor anyone bringing it around. The rude woman with the snotty accent gracing us with food after we finally made enough of a commotion to get someone to take our order was very abrasive especially when my son asked for ranch dressing to go on his pizza. YIKES! The pizza needed more sauce or something. Needless to say we won't be going back.

I passed by walking my dog and decided to order some take out.  While waiting for my order outside, I decided to look them up on yelp and was a little worried by the low reviews/lack of pictures.   The staff was really nice.  There was a young boy working the register.  I ordered a chicken torta, beef huaraches, and lengua tacos (comes in 3). This was a good amount of food for two.  My bf and I thought each dish was pretty good, especially the lengua tacos that were really tender and flavorful, especially with the grilled onions they gave on the side.  The beef huaraches were good too -the beef was not dry and flavorless like some mentioned.  The chicken in the torta was on the drier side but I was expecting it from pounded chicken breast.  The beans and dressing and nice big toasted torta bread made up for the dryness. I normally get take out from Bianca's Deli and thought Las Pinatas was comparable, if not better.  The Las Pinatas torta and tacos were bigger compared to Bianca's.  They give you green salsa verde which was great with everything.  There was also a red sauce that tastes like a smoked chipotle.  Didn't use that one much.  Overall, I enjoyed the food and I plan to come back here.   Didn't sit down inside but I thought it was quaintly decorated with fresh potted flowers and table cloth on each table.  Music was playing in the background. FYI: noticed signs that says they are now closed on Tuesdays.
knocked off a star for the small cramped space, but you must stop by for the amazing food. the bronte burger is so friggin good, you must stop by! !!

This burger joint isn't going to blow you away but if you want something a little bit more than just a regular burger, this would suffice. If you are really hungry tho, I suggest you order two burgers. From the pictures posted, i figured the burgers were a lot bigger. The patties are thicker than your average burger but i found myself still hungry after, and thats after eating the fries also, with a soda. Besides that, the burger wasn't half bad. I had a bacon cheese burger which I ordered from the menu posted on the wall. We didn't know and asked for a menu, then the waiter pointed to the menu on the wall. What set it a part from just a regular burger is that the patty was a lot thicker. Thats about it. Other than that, on a monday night, the service was good, we were able to sit where we wanted to and the food was served quickly. It had a cozy feel and if you wanted a drink, they have a small bar in the front as you walk in. Just don't forget to bring cash because its cash only. That too is posted on the wall next to the menu. But over all, Id go back if I wanted something more than just a fast food burger at a reasonable price.

Great lunch spot. My personal favorite is their turkey sandwich...it's pretty ballet. Matt and Marie both work at the store, so definitely worth stopping by (if you like to support small businesses). Good vegetarian options ( if you're into that sort of thing) and nice, clean space to sit and eat (with some pretty cool looking tables). New spot that definitely had some love to into its conception and construction.

I went with a group of 12 people for a birthday.  Before, all of us were at the restaurant,  the manager told some of my friends to leave. When we were seated, the waiter served us drinks for more than 30 minutes.  After feeling so hungry, we had to ask the waiter to take our order. The waiter was not friendly at all- he actually came off a bit snobby. Since it was a friend's birthday, a request for the "mini band" was made. But, they decided to preform for another group of customers instead of us. The waiter then claimed the band have "performed" for us. Last , but not least the waiter then gave a wrong amount on the check and claimed it was correct. He was very adamant about the orders. Then the manager came out and proved the waiter wrong. After all the long waiting, the amount on the check was still wrong because he misread numbers on a calculator. To sum it up, this restaurant has very poor customer service.
They have the BEST pizza around! The buffalo chicken pizza they offer is the bomb . I've never had bad service and they always seem to be open late .

"Les Chicken Wings" has the appetizing description "reconstructed panko crusted chicken wings" for $14. I handed the owner $20 for an order to go, and was given back four singles (that is the new thing in bar eateries, they keep whatever quarters and dimes you're owed. stealing. not on the level of bernie madoff, but still theft). What I got was four chicken lolipops in decent sauce. Meh. Tiny portion. At least I got some slices of nice bread included, which saves this from a one star review.

I have been coming to this restaurant for five years and I have come to enjoy sitting outside and watching the most beautiful woman in the city pass by, while enjoying a  glass of wine and a delicious meal.  The owner whom I have gotten to know is a warm and personable man.  I recommend this restaurant  to anyone that loves to sit  back in a relaxed atmosphere and watch the world go by.

We had heard about how great this restaurant was and how difficult to get reservations but we could just walk in and sit at the bar.  We did sit at the bar which was great.  Unfortunately, our bartender was not too knowledgeable about the wines or the meals and she was somewhat blasé about everything.
