Can't beat the setting. Wish I had room for dessert. You'll love it. You'll come back. And you'll bring a friend. And you're friend will love it, too.

Jake's dogs were out of this world. So many options for whatever you want in your hot dog. I had an everything bagel-bun and cream cheese on my dog, and it was heaven. We tried 8 mochi together for dessert and every one of them was decadent. Not to mention, the owner was exceptionally friendly and kind-hearted. It is clear that he cares not only about customer service but loves his job. After we watched a gaggle of girls leave the shop, he realized one of them had left their wallet, and ran down the street to return it. Great experience here--if you want some great hot dogs or mochi, this is the place.

This place has been a family favorite for years and all I can say is that it is still as good as when I was young. It is the best pizza in Ironbound and the service is always good. I am also a big fan of their wraps and appetizers.

This place is pretty solid. Considerably new to this neighborhood but good. I moved to this area from jersey city where you can grab an authentic meal pretty much anywhere but this restaurant is definitely up there with the best. The employees are very nice and helpful with recommendations. Delivery is about average, around 30 minutes... If you want something very simple and quite filling, packed with flavor I would recommend any of the Tortas.

I'll begin this review by saying that I've been visiting this place for the last couple of years, and up until 6 months ago, I would have given this place a 5 star rating without a second thought. But not any more. I remember the first Burrito that I had here: Fresh, filled with guacamole, sour cream, flavorful and filling. Then about a few months ago, they raised the prices. "Fair enough, inflation hits everyone", I thought. But I wasn't prepared for the drop in quality. The burritos now are usually dry, too salty, overstuffed with beans more than anything else. The guacamole is still in the burritos, but in token proportions, while the sour cream seems to be on a permanent vacation from this place! Just today, my girlfriend ordered a burrito from this place. She specifically asked them to go easy on the beans and for extra sour cream. She got a burrito chock full of beans and with no noticeable sour cream. She took apart the burrito and sure enough, there's no sour cream anywhere in the burrito. To sum it up, a burrito from this place is dry, salty rice, cheese, lots of beans, a token amount of guacamole, with hit or miss meat (misses more often than not). If you're looking for a place that USED to be great, then this is the place you're looking for. As for me, I'll be walking the four or so more blocks to the Qdoba when I fancy a burrito from now on. At least they don't skimp on the guacamole and sour cream even if you do have to pay extra (and hey, even with the extras, it's cheaper than this place, with their $9.75 steak burritos!)

I drove by one day,  stopped just to see what they have ... 3 fish orders and 4 sides later .... I drove away. On my way  home I was salivating .... WOW,  The food is delish.....  I couldn't  get enough . Fish was lightly breaded, very nicely done and very well cooked, not salty, not too oily and/or not over cooked and dry,  just right.   Seasoning on the fish was fine, very delicate and  again not salty.   The collard greens were perfect , potato salad, coleslaw and the mac and cheese were divine and  good  portions and again  non of the above were loaded with salt .... went back again and must say ... it's addictive... Staff very  patient and nice. Nice clean waiting /dining area, oh and let's not forget  the music, background music is unbelievable...(you have to be dead no to feel it ) ....

we live in Chicago and came to Rose Petals on the suggestions of a friend. What a great breakfast!!  Cute place, good service, good music and by far the best omelette I have ever had with fresh vegetables inside and fresh herbs mixed into the egg.  Lovely.  The grits were great too.
The atmosphere is awesome and the ramen is fantastic!

Very dissapointed .  Requested a side of onions  for my hamburger and was denied. At first server said no onions on site except they have onion soup.  Real story is "chef" doesn't like his "creation" altered so she told us.  I just wanted them to enhance my experience as I love onions.  Was told the "paste" on the burger encompasses this.  Total refusal to provide the side. I told server the experience was mine as much as it was chef's but it didn't matter. I guess Yelp reviews and social media don't phase them....yet.

Dear Peppe Rosso Social, As a couple who doesn't just love to eat, but dine, we had a memorable meal at your restaurant.  Your enthusiasm and confidence in your dishes is shown through the quality of your food and it was very much loved and appreciated. Unfortunately, we had some of the worst service to date by a single individual, who also, unfortunately was our server.  It is worth mentioning that the secondary service (bus boys) and other server were superb, attentive and keen to make us happy.  One bus boy in particular was awesome and paid attention to our every need.  I only tipped 15% because I knew he would be affected if we left anything less.  I hope he gets promoted to a serving position.  He was outstanding.  He took care of literally every table in the back.  Our server (about 22, young, very tall) was young, inexperienced, and aloof--he couldn't be bothered with any table that wouldn't flirt or flatter him.  We would literally make eye contact with him and he would smile and walk away!  It was unbelievable! With that said, we were at your restaurant to dine in the Italian way.  We ordered the three courses, followed by desert, espresso and then to end we would have ordered a limoncello but were never offered the chance (to mind you this was 11:00 so the restaurant was not busy nor closing down). This is the first email I've ever written to a restaurant, I'm quite young still so don't have many quibbles when it comes to service.  But honestly, our server was unfortuante.   The food deserves a big Bravo!  Especially the burrata which was second to none, bellissima! Thank you.  We look forward to bringing our family to your restaurant.

Great breakfast burrito!!! Not so great service. Waited twenty minutes to order. Menu can be misleading. Ordered the "cider donuts" which says it comes with six per order and got donut holes half the size of dunkin donuts at it was $6.00!?!?!? Not my favorite place.
I ordered the pull pork and while I was having my first bite I saw a roach on the wall. How is this place open! So unsanitary disgusting never coming back

Hands down the best Indian food in town! Although the service is a little slow at times, the food is most definitely worth the wait. The food is very reasonably priced and the staff are so friendly and welcoming. I've come here multiple times with my friends and we'll definitely be back soon!

Let me start by saying the food is great coffee strong but there is a lady there by the name of Georgia she was extremely rude she sat us down and left us waiting for our coffee and breakfast for at least 30 minutes while she is chatting away with other customer she turned and looked at us and continue to chat then she comes towards us at  end to ask us how was the food. She was looking for that TIP in which i did not leave! We will never give them our service again EVER!!!!

This is the best bagel place in the Burlington area. I love their Egg & Cheese Bagel Sandwiches and they have the best selection of Cream Cheeses...and their daily specials are flavors you would never think of! Their coffee is the icing on the cake :)
Great pour over coffee- really wish there was more seating area tho, it's super cute inside!

This is a neighborhood "red-sauce Italian' restaurant with a pizzeria in front and a full restaurant in the back. I had been here a few times on and off for dinners; and this week I had a buffet lunch for about 20 guests. The owners and servers were as friendly  and accommodating as could be. We had five buffet trays set up, along with fresh salad. Baked ziti - sausage and peppers - baked flounder - chix Francese - eggplant rollatini - yum! The food was all tasty and passed the test of the real Italian grandma in attendance. This restaurant does what it sets out to do exceptionally well. I recommend it!
Ill only come here if im feeling snobby. The food is ok But the atmosphere is uck What is happening to brooklyn!

This "on the main street" restaurant has a casual and friendly atmosphere and service. The quality of the food was quite good but the menu is very limited (only two chicken entrees, one fish, and no veal).  The chicken parmagiana  and classic eggplant dishes were well prepared as were the salads.  One note of negativity - the owner refused to take a credit card when a Restaurant.com certificate was used stating that "We don't make any money on these so it is cash only."  He said that there was something to that effect on his website but there is nothing on the certificate and why would he assume someone would go to his website before making a reservation.  In any event upon visiting his website upon returning home I could not find any reference to the Restaurant.com certificate.  Prices are reasonable and cash was not a problem but his refusal to accept a credit card, even after I offered to pay an additional 2%, left a bad feeling due to  a poor business decision on his part.

They don't have all the traditional stuff and they don't push around those dirty karts but I like it. There are dozens of places in Philly that you can get the traditional style but if you wanna try probably the best soup dumplings in Philly, this is the spot.

Great modern Venezuelan on the Branford shore. My husband and I went here on a whim and it was great.  Amazing empanadas.  The cheese ones were light and crispy. Nice infused vodka martinis.  The mint julep wasn't the best.  Great service and it looks like they have a nice happy hour during the week.

I went here on a date we came around 7 I clock for dinner. I was finally brought to a table after waiting for 40 minutes. The steak was over cooked and when I asked for it to be medium rare like the first time I stated they returned the same plate exactly as it was. Then after dinner my date and I were hanging out in the bar area and one of the waiters proceeded to tell me after  spending $120 diner and a 20% tip that I needed to leave because of my attire. if I could give negative stars I would. I will proceed to spread the word and tell my friends. Horrible one way service !!! The only satisfaction I got was stoping at the diner on the way home.

Love love LOVE this place!  I've only gotten stir-frys here, so I can't speak for their salads or smoothies or honey bar.  I'm a big fan of creating my own stir-fry (usually get the chicken).  I don't think I've ever been disappointed with a meal...I've had a few that were "just ok", but I'll put that on me since I was the one picking out the ingredients and sauces.  I recommend going light on the sauce since I'm sure they're all full of calories and sodium (but they're sooo yummy!).  Plus, you really don't need a lot...it's one of those, "a little dab will do you" kind of situations.  Anyway, I highly recommend coming here.  I'd try to go when it's not during the lunch rush (so between 11:45 and 2pm) cuz you'll be waiting a while.
Good food--falafel sandwich is done well. Wine is also good. Good service and comfortable place.
I always enjoying being surprised by their daily specials. I have never been disappointed and recommend American Flatbread to anybody visiting town.
Had a swiss cheese omelet with homefries, toast with sausage on the side.  Very good.  Homefries were tasty.  A meal enjoyed.

Thoroughly enjoyable meal from start to finish. A small place with a back yard area as well. The menu is limited with a few specials but varied enough to cover most tastes. Our server was very pleasant and helpful in describing the dishes and in letting my friend taste her wine choice before ordering. We shared the beets and mandarin oranges app and the roasted cauliflower app , both were delicious and ample enough to share. For our main we split the pork chop which was a nice thick cut and moist throughout. It came with a side semolina panelle a sort of quiche/polenta  type dish. They also served a small homemade bread that was amazingly good and light. While some have written of the portions being small we didnt find that to be the case. The apps while not enormous were more than enough for two and its not just about quantity its about quality and taste which was definitely there. Same for the chop that we easily shared. It was filling enough that neither of us ordered desert as we were nicely full. We were there early so no crowds not sure how it is latter in the evening but they take reservations. Now on my list of places to return to.

I hate to leave a review like this, but I was frustrated by an experience I had at Venturo Osteria this evening. This review is strictly based on the outcome of the bill, for which my wife and I were a bit surprised. The short version is that their website advertises a happy hour from 4-7 with price points of $4 for beer, $5 for vino, and $6 for specialty cocktails. This is not exactly true and their is no signage or verbiage on the website to indicate that the deal is only on select beers, wines and cocktails. Unfortunately for us, the waiter we had was not upfront about this fact. Shame on me for assuming, but shame on them for their intentional vagueness. I did not get to speak to our initial server directly about this. There must have been a switchover between the brief time when we arrived and when we left, as the server tending to us had changed. I explained I was disappointed that the happy hour deal was not clear, she understood and was apologetic but the customer service ended there. If I could offer a tip to management, the next time this happens it would a good moment to acknowledge the vagueness, apologize, and offer some sort of price break.  If we had be given even one of the drinks at the happy hour price I wouldn't have been prompted to write about this negative experience. ************ The ambiance seemed fine. The garden was pleasant and we had the space to ourselves for most of the time we were there.  We can't comment on the food as this was just a quick evening out for drinks between our newborn's naps.

Ordered takeout, got some Cumin Beef and Fish Filet w/ Scallions and Ginger Sauce. The Cumin Beef should really be renamed to "Cumin Fried Batter" because there was not a trace of meat in there. They also gave us less rice than any Chinese takeout I've ordered from.   The only reason this isn't 1 star is because the fish actually tasted okay, but was still mostly batter. We aren't ordering from them again.

One star only goes to decor and the cider.  The food leaves very MUCH to be desired for.  The restaurant needs to hire a chef or serve real food.  90% of what we ordered came from a can including, pulpo, artichokes, pimiento, and wasn't very good, but with a real food price tag! Also, the jamon iberico was dry and not tasty.  We left full but eerily unsatisfied with an $86 bill wishing we had gone to a different restaurant or just cooking at home!

good food, but overrated, ate here a bunch of times, but its really bad for you. they make it very fast because of the long lines and dont really spend time cooking the meat correctly, both pats and geno's are going down the drain
What a joke. Service is rude and deceitful. Though your choices in the area may be few, you can do far better. Seriously, go to Burger King - you'll be much happier in life - and that's really sad.

Ordered an assortment of baked goods as well as the Avocado Toast and a coffee to go. If you are gluten free you must stop by and at least try the scones! The toast was also delicious, I can't wait to come in for lunch and try the ELT everyone raves about. Really good coffee and service too! You can't go wrong. Thank you Charlie. I will be back!

I came Monday night and usually most of the restaurant or wine bars do not have the right vibe. This did not happened to me at Uva! Wonderful place, very nice decor and authentic "finally" italian food and wines!! I was welcomed by i believe the hostess and i believe her name was Patrizia. She treated my friends and i  like kings. Perfect music. It is the perfect pick for dates and big party. I will go back very soon when back from the Bay area. Good job Uva

Had dinner here tonight I've been going here for a couple of year and I was gone for a couple of months on vacation and I was sad that they changed hand aka "under new management" but I turned out everything is still the same maybe a little bit better. The new owners are renovating the restaurant I haven't tried the pizza yet but the cheese streaks are better then what the used to be but they were lacking on cheese. I hope the pizza is still good. Would recommend.

I recently visited from NYC, and I must say, Seoul BBQ beats any Korean restaurant I've had in Manhattan!  We started off with sushi for an appetizer, salmon avocado and spicy tuna, and the fish was incredibly fresh.  I'd recommend asking the chef for special ordered rolls though, as I peered over in envy at some of the other sushi orders. We also ordered gun-mandu (fried pork dumplings) and kimchi-jeon (korean pancake), both were fantastic.  For my entree I ordered the soon dubu, which I find can sometimes be too salty, but the recipe here was perfect.  Also, lots of good seafood in the soup.  My parents ordered the ja jang myun which was DELICIOUS-- not an easy feat as ja jang myun, depending on the place, can be hit or miss. Seoul BBQ's authentic, not to mention clean, Korean decor gives it a unique charm that I haven't experienced at a Korean restaurant in ages.  You can tell a lot of thought and effort went into the restaurant's interior design.  And the space is huge, which helps as so many good restaurants in the area get overcrowded.   Next time I will try the BBQ, since it looked like that's what most of the tables were ordering, and now that I know the caliber of the food, I won't be hesitant in trying it-- as some places don't serve the best meat, but I completely trust this restaurant to come out on top in all their dishes. I HIGHLY recommend this spot!
Way over priced. Bartenders are horrible.

The place could be fun but the waitress who is always there (dark hair) is very mean. She makes the beco experience very uncomfortable. My friends and I wanted to have a good time, but her attitude and the way she served us, in a rush and with an attitude, made us all say that we're never going back. There was music playing, during happy hour, so we decided to dance a bit and she asked us to go sit down. Really? A Brazilian place with music... And during happy hour? We already found a replacement, where servers are nice, food is awesome --- Tabare, highly recommend it.
Crammed into a shitty little booth on the upper level where I got to watch the waitress dump the plates from cleared tables. Ate in 25 minutes and left. Won't go back.

I love wandering around neighborhoods in the city, and especially Soho, that's how I found this place, wanting a bite and to warm up. It looked so classically New York and wonderful ambience. The suckling pig was great and the lamb meatballs are amazing. I'm always glad to have someone to pick wine for me, and in this case my bf knows exactly what I wanted. Desert was amazing sponge cake with Crème fraiche (oh I can eat crème fraiche with everything, it's like the Tabasco sauce of deserts) I had a super fun time.  The service was decent and noise level was tolerable.  Will be on my list to visit again.
Food was surprisingly good. But a little pricey I think for one piece of fish. ( grilled tilapia and shrimp $14)!!!!!!

I DEF recommend this place! I've eaten there a couple of times & the food is pretty tasty! I can say the Nosh Burger with Fries & Dirty Rice was excellent & the Smoked Brisket was awesome too & the friendly service you get is a plus too! If you live or if you ever visit the Astoria area try them out, I'm sure you'll love the place & the food!!!

I wanted to love this restaurant. They only offer two entrees a night, but they always sound very good, so I was looking forward to my dinner. Well, it wasn't a total disaster, the service was personable and efficient, and the view is wonderful. The happy hour appetizer of deviled egg on toast was nice, I think. But, it was hard to taste it after several spoonfulls of the tremendously salty short rib ragu. I was excited about the short rib ragu. I lived in Italy for a while and missed rustic Italian cooking. It looked and smelled great, full of white beans and beautiful carrots, and the meat was delicious and tender. The only problem was the incredibly salty broth. When the waitress came out to see how I was doing, I decided that the salt was enough of a problem that I should mention it. She looked a little flumoxed and asked if I wanted pepper. Huh?? Well, I guess salt does go with pepper. I probably should have asked for bread to soak up some of the salt, but didn't think of it until after she left. They didn't offer any compensation for the ruined short ribs, but maybe I should have expected that given that I ate it down to the last bite. I was hungry that night, otherwise I might have sent it back and just stuck to the happy hour snacks. Maybe I'll try it again when I'm not so hungry.

This is one of my favorite restaurants on the UES. The food is delicious and service is good. Not loud at all & I love the decor! My husband and I go out to eat at Up Thai a few times a month & we always have an overall good dining experience. I highly recommend Up Thai!
I had eggs benny here this morning, by far the best breakfast I've had in NYC! It's my favourite eggs benny ever, it's a little different to your usual! Great vibe and friendly staff!
The restaurant is really 4 stars, however I am giving it a 5th as it is truly a great Mexican restaurant in a city with few alternatives. The portions are large. The taste is real Mexican sabor.
I went to Eataly twice, and I always loved it. I had a taste of their rare Red Cow Parmesan Cheese, and believe me, it was the best Parmesan cheese I ever had. Two thumbs-up.
Bad sushi , worse service, killing flies while you eat, rude and uncleanliness is apparent throughout this establishment. Definitely not the same place when it first opened. Also overpriced IMO.

I ordered delivery, a pizza and French fries. The French fries were crinkle-cut and delicious. So many restaurants nowadays rely on the cheaper coated fries, so I was happy to see something different. The cheese on them was good as well. As for the pizza, I was a bit disappointed. It was a personal size with mushrooms and onions. It was a bit soggy so that every time I picked up a piece, I got dough and no toppings came with it. The sauce had a distinct flavor which was not my taste, but that's more personal preference. I didn't eat most of it because of these reasons. The service was very quick and both the people on the phone and delivery man were helpful and courteous. I will be back to try their sandwich selection.

I would have gave this establishment no stars, but that wasn't an option. The food and service was mediocre in comparison to the price point. On the day I dined at this establishment, it was Sunday brunch.  From the moment I was seated there were signs that this was not a great choice in dinning. There were two customers seated next to my table that had threaten to walk out because they waited over 45 minutes for their order.There was a shortage of bread that day. When asked why; the explanation was that they only order  flower from Tennessee?  I ordered the crab cake benedict, It had no flavor and was small portioned.   The overall experience there was nothing to want to come back too.

Customer Service - as they served the rice as fast as a bullet that they already wanted us to leave. Our waitress was a unaccomadating and unfriendly - with making faces. Woah! Our table cannot fit our orders. We figured it out on how to put all pur orders properly on out table. Waiters will just put meals by meals on edge of the table. Horrible experience ever! Space is small. The servers are louder than their customers! Food - they have a "modern filipino cuisine" but only a small part of their menu. But if you want a filipino classic menu - go to queens! You can have it with a reasonable price for a good homemade filipino classic. Pork adobo, karekare even sisig is the same taste quality in the queens fil resto area. Environment and ambience - small, dark, loud! Sadly, it's sad. They're making noise to filipino cuisine in the neighborhood but... Customer service sucks!

I visited Okonomi last week for the Ramen Omakase, which recently resumed after they shut down ramen operations at Whole Foods. I had gotten the Omakase several times when they were doing Yuji Ramen Test Kitchen at the WF on Bowery. The new space is really comfortable and beautiful. Small, but they've used the space really well and dining there feels very personal. Yuji, Tara, and George take great care of everyone. George checked on us frequently to make sure we had enough water and tea, and that everything was to our liking. Yuji and Tara, though busy making each course throughout the meal, conversed with us from time to time and explained each dish as they brought it out. The food itself was fantastic, as always. The meal included 9 dishes: 1 sashimi, 7 small dishes of mazemen (no broth) or ramen (broth), and a dessert. There were some familiar favorites, including soft shell crab mazemen, squid mazemen, clam & corn ramen, and some great ones I had never had before, like a carbonara-like dish with uni. The desert - a shiso tofu pudding with fresh peaches - was delicious, and a refreshing way to finish the meal. The place is very small, and they're only doing Ramen Omakase two nights a week. It's not cheap ($100 a person), but it's a great experience if you can get a seat!
Food is great, but coffee and dessert took over 30 minute wait . Desserts arrived about 10 minutes earlier than coffee. Asked manager to take coffee of the check, but got refused.

This place is okay. The burgers aren't that bad. It's a little overpriced. $10 for an okay burger doesnt really make want to come back. The service is also okay. The women with glasses at the door isnt very welcoming. She wanted to seat us near the kitchen in the back when the place was empty and then sorta gave us an attitude when we asked to sit somewhere else. This place in my opinion is just okay. I'll probably go to smashburger the next time.

Friendly service and great ambiance! The spring rolls are awesome! This place has been completely redecorated inside and looks great. It's huge as well and has a whole separate room that would be great for parties and meetings.

I dined here last week. The food , drinks and service were great ! I especially enjoyed the specialty cocktails. I had the catfish nuggets for an appetizer, fried chicken with Mac and cheese for an entree.   Prices were reasonable too. Would definitely come back here!
We had an excellent meal here with friends!  Service was great!  Food was fantastic!  Atmosphere was so cool!  I'm so happy smokin' Betty's is around the corner from work!!  I'll be back...often!!
We were in the neighborhood and stopped by for some  Caribbean food.. It was delicious! We plan to stop by soon.

The place has a well deserved reputation and maintains it well.  Our office is close so on occasion we have business lunches as well as dinners here. It is odd but in many of the times we've been here rarely have we had someone greet us as we enter.  In addition the coat check, or lack of thereof, is a disappointment especially in bad weather and winter.   Breads and appetizers have always been good.  I've particularly enjoyed their carpaccio appetizer..  The portion size for both lunches and dinners are quite ample.  The Chicken Sausage has been a favorite for years and I still recommend it.  I am not a big dessert person, but I have to say through the years I have tried several and found them to be very good. I find the Lunch service more enjoyable than dinner since the crowd is often not as full, and with the open floor plan, allows you to talk reasonably.  I have also been one of the last to finish a few times and they never make you feel rushed to leave. Dinner service, particularly at peak time, can be very difficult to talk especially if you have a larger group.  At certain times of the year, particularly the Holidays, I would lower my rating  since the the combination of noise level and parties which include children makes conversation very difficult. The bar configuration an orientation I find a bit strange but the selection and service have always been good.

I love the Pig and the Prince. I've gone their several times for dates, or just drinks with friends. The building is absolutely gorgeous, and furnished nicely. As far as the food, it has always been GREAT, I mean really really great. They are constantly updating and changing the menu, which I personally love. The only thing that can be a draw back is, the portions are a little small. If I could give them a 4 1/2 stars I would, but I think the great food outweighs the small portions. They have a great bar menu as well (food, drinks, and wines), so if you'd like to spend a little less money go in and have some bar food and a drink. The duck fat fried grilled cheese is divine.

Food was fine, maybe we ordered wrong I will give them that, but I wasn't wowed. Service was TERRIBLE and very inattentive. The waiter came over we asked one question about the menu and before we could place even a drink order he ran off somewhere. We had to ask a busboy to get him back to place an order after waiting for way too long. We were given lunch menus at dinner and then laughed at when we tried to order a sandwich...which were on the menu.....that they gave us..... We ordered a bottle of wine and after our first glasses they sat there empty. I love the concept of a meat coma but I don't think a restaurant can ever be too cool for service.

Don't go this Resturant horrible service. The owner is Vietnamese women, she is rude. When I go inside nobody is there (no one) at all. After I got table I ordered some dishes and she replied me "ok". She has attitude too. The dishes  I got rice with pork chop. The rice is last night left over hard to eat. Horrible service and horrible foods. Why is some people give three stars I don't understand. Nobody in the Resturant. The price of the foods are expensive than NY.

This is a quaint New England place whose dining room was way too noisy. This was supposed to be my birthday dinner,  and it was a flop.  The flatbread appetizer was more flat bread than topping; disappointing. When the meals arrived they were presented in such a way I felt like I was it any two-bit restaurant and although I don't know this for sure... the potatoes looked and tasted like they were from a box. I would not try this restaurant again as the flavors were dull and lackluster, the presentation of the food was substandard, the ambience was too noisy, and the prices way too much.

This is probably one of the worst restaurants in hanover.  I have ordered from here many times and they have gotten it wrong every time.  The driver is very unsafe and has almost hit my friend.  One order the burrito came with a metal piece inside it about twice the size of a staple.  The restaurant pays no attention to detail and lacks any quality control.  I would save your money and go somewhere else.

Ok. The first time I can't to bogota was a yr ago and I have been hooked ever since. I love this place. Great food, great service and most of all great environment. I've been to many places and this place definitely has amazing customer service. When it comes to the drinks they are the best. Miguel, Fred, Tyler and Nicole are the best behind the bar. They rock :-D

I love to go out and hear live music.  The food is great and I finally found a place that doesn't water down their drinks... What a big difference that makes, no longer need 4 drinks to feel a buzz (Applebees and Friday's).

Decent food but not decent enough to make up for TERRIBLE SERVICE and unreasonably high prices. My friend and I were literally hovered over and stared at while we conversed after having finished our meal and received the check. In all fairness, a group was waiting for a table, but it's not clear why we were targeted rather than the half dozen other customers who had finished their meals or were close to it. There are undoubtedly much better options in the immediate vicinity in terms of food quality, prices, and definitely service.

This review is for brunch only because I've been here for dinner and it's much better. We came here for brunch for the first time today and expected to wait awhile for a table for 4 because we knew how popular it was. We were told the wait would be between 15 and 40 minutes. The first 20-30 minutes went by quickly and they started to call people who got there when we did. After 50 minutes they started to call people who had gotten there after us. The host kept saying that we were soon and then they took 3 parties of 3 and we were still waiting. After an hour and 10 minutes we heard the host say he would hold a table for a party of 8 until the rest of them arrived, but no longer than 5 minutes. So I was pissed because usually this place doesn't do that. After another 7 minutes he seated them even though the whole party wasn't there. I asked him how much longer for a table and he said you're next. He comes back out and says party of 4 at the bar. Seriously?! After an hour and 20 minutes?! At the bar?! So we go in and are hoping that the food will be so delicious that it'll make it worth the wait...wrong again. Disco tots were mushy, cranberry captain crunch French toast wasn't fully cooked inside, chicken and waffles were poorly seasoned, just spice, not flavor. Four mediocre entrees and two sub par appetizers came to $103. Definitely not worth the wait, step up your game!

My very first review! Ok, so I came this place the other night with my girls because we were dying to try the new spot that everyone has been raving about. So lets get down to business! The Jerk Chicken is absolutely on POINT!!! It is SEASONED and cooked to perfection! The jerk wings are also great. They are not the traditionally grilled, but fried. The Bok Choy is a absolutely delsh! Now for the things I was not so crazy about. The Festival was a little hard and very dry. The Oxtail was tender, but the authentic flavors were not there. It didn't taste bad but it was definitely missing a couple of ingredients to solidify that taste you're looking for when you are eating oxtail. As for drinks. The Painkiller is absolutely delicious! I was NOT a fan of the Mai Tai, Dark & Slushy or the Tropical Itch. I would definitely come back here to have the Jerk Chicken and try something else off of the menu. I
This place might be great for brunch but our dinner was awful. Salmon was fishy and tasteless. The spinach tasted like dirt. Definitely would not return

Been going here ever since it opened. Good cheap food, great wait staff that never keeps you waiting even when they're crowded, which is often because in Flatbush, we ain't dumb. Don't bring a crowd - four is max they can sit and you may have to wait a few minutes at peak times in early evening. Baked pretzels are great, as is the lamb lasagna and their burgers are all good. They update menu a lot but I hope they never stop making that lamb lasagna. Mmmmmmm.
Delicious food! Great service! Love the wonton with chili oil and Chinese hamburger! Will definitely come back!

I have been frequenting citrus for the past year. We also get good delivered out to is pretty often. Service is great! Sanju is always pleasant and goes out of his way to keep you satisfied as a customer both while ordering online as well as when we dine in the restaurant. He is a pleasant chap. My wife orders the paneer korchan(sp?) and loves the malai kofta which she claims is the best in jersey. I order the goat biryani which is pretty delicious. I have tried the Thai here and would stick to the Indian part of the menu. It's a great place for a family and would highly recommend it. It's a little tight for space but the rest of it makes up for it.

Ever wondered what a piece of cloud from heaven would taste like? Well, let your taste buds indulge as your fingers can't handle the meat from falling off the bone and your teeth barely want to chew because of your tongue's selfish feeling of savoring the taste while slowly closing your eyes and mumble to yourself the Mmm's and aweee's that these juicy and tender ribs create. If you have been looking to satisfy your craving for ribs, to no avail, well there's good news then, this is the spot that will meet and exceed what you expect from a rack of ribs.

This restaurant is a great value; the prices are excellent and you get a good amount of food. And most dishes are excellent--fresh and tasty. The curry puffs are fantastic; so are the flat noodles. My only complaint: no brown rice. If you're looking for an alternative to pricey Montclair, this is your best bet.
This place is amazing, say at the bat with 2 colleagues, the food was amazing and the bar has great style and lovely attitude! In one word, brilliant!

Came here this week with friends and we had a great experience.  The food was delicious, large portions and reasonably priced. The owner came by to check on us which is always nice! I definitely recommend it and will be back!

Great food if you are willing to wait outside to get in! The chef takes pride in all his dishes! Everything is fresh and well executed!! The chef/owner is so involved with his customers that it is very endearing. He will bring things out for you to try if you are not sure whether you might like it or aren't sure if you should order it!

their shish kabobs are really good, rice and grilled tomato. the included salad is meh. they are a little in the pricey side for shish but it make i usually end up with 2 meals. Good hummus. Baba ganoush was not good but i think its because i am use to lebonese version. their bread is really good. stuffed cabbage is a good vegetarian option.
This place was a pleasant surprise! Delicious food and amazing sangria. The service is great, very professional. We always go back at least once a month!

Had cashew tofu and vegetables.Was awful--tasted burnt and tofu was very tough.waiter was very unpleasant and  I would not go again! My husband  experienced the same  distaste for the dinner. Egg rolls were good.

The atmosphere was great and our food matched the atmosphere but the service was terrible. We had to wait to get water, our our waiter took forever to check on us and we waited unusually long for food. To top off the evening, we had to wait almost as long to pay.
Great pizza and sandwiches.  My daughter loves the pizza and my wife likes the salads.  They give huge portions so good value for your money.

The food here is good....pizza is good...avocado bruschetta is amazing and the brunch menu is great.   The only problem is that it takes forever for food to come out of the kitchen.  The waitstaff is always apologetic about the wait times....it literally is the same nonsense every time I go, which is a shame because the food is good.
Bad news.  Order wrong. Steak cooked.  Noisy place filled loud drunks. Nice waitress though and good onion rings

I really like this place, but hate the location in Wayne.  Went there a couple of times.  Went there Thursday for happy hour.  They had 2 bartenders, 10 people sitting at the bar who had already been served, and it still took someone 5 1/2 mins. just to acknowledge my existence.  Now, I know you may be thinking 5 1/2 mins isn't a long time to wait, but as a former bartender, I know exactly what one is supposed to do when a person is sitting at the bar all that time.  If you're busy, you're to, at the very least place a cocktail napkin in front of the person and say I'll be right with you.  NOT GET RIGHT IN FRONT OF ME WITH YOUR EYES TURNED DOWN TO THE FLOOR, AND PRETEND THERE'S NO ONE SITTING IN FRONT OF YOU!!!!!!!. If you want ATTENTIVE people go to the Paramus location.  They are so on the ball.  The bar is bigger, and its just overall better.  Even the management staff are better.   So, I walked out of this place, and will never return to the Wayne location.

Very good. The service is good and you get chips and salsa once your seated while you wait for your food. I like this place for lunch because the food comes out quick and is delicious! Tried going here for diner once but there was a two hour wait.

Been hearing about this place for some time - finally made the reservation (which I recommend) on Open Table; Food NYC worthy - although, well played choosing a location in Bloomfield, NJ where there is no competition. Very trendy restaurant with amazing food. If the food was terrible, I'd still give this restaurant 5 stars for the service. Even the bus boy knew the menu enough to answer my questions. Staff was friendly and knew the menu well. We started with the mushroom tempura - highly recommend. The dipping sauce was incredible. Mushroom risotto was delicious. We went with the pot pies - they're huge but deflate once you stick a fork in them - the inside isn't heavy like a typical pot pie although by the end you feel like you ate something thick and hearty (in the best way possible). Squirrel nuts were a fun little treat. Ended with a bailey's dessert shot - amazing. I'll be here again.

We used to eat here when it was HLS and I have eaten here twice now: both for lunch. I don't eat meat but my partner does. I've had the curry lentil wrap and the spinach mango salad. I've had the chips and okra fries. My partner has had the salmon burger. Finally, I've had the milkless milkshake and the paradise smoothie. Everything has been delicious. They support local agriculture, CSAs and healthy eating. No processed food. Great place for vegans, vegetarians, and meat eaters. Wonderful hospitality as well. You won't be disappointed. Our next visit will be to try brunch on Sunday!!

I couldn't wait to try this Zagat-rated restaurant and after trying it, we were utterly disappointed with the quality of the food.  There is nothing "authentic Mexican" about this restaurant! We had the enchiladas con mole and enchiladas verdes.  The mole was NOT mole.  The mole tasted closer to a sweet Italian marinara than true mole.  The enchilada verde was bathed in oil with plenty to spare and tasteless.  Only the rice and beans were palatable.   We will never go back.   I would recommend the Chef to try even using the canned Doña Maria mole as this is closer to my grandmother's "authentic" mole.

Pass on this place. The space is very cool and fun but the food and service are not worth your time.  I recently had lunch here and tried the beef rice bowl special which comes with soup or salad.  I opted for salad, which I have trouble even calling a salad.  It was a sad, stiff, small pile of cabbage in a nasty dressing. It was awful. The rice bowl was actually pretty good but my problem was that it was literally two small bites of beef in a big bowl of rice and vegetables. When the waitress asked how it was and I said I was surprised by how little beef there was she just said ok and walked away. If you are a vegetarian it might be ok as long as you aren't looking for great service.
Fantastic Italian food!! Their menu is pretty extensive but their specials are speculative  and totally worth trying. They aim to please and always do!!!
The service was great. Good portions. Great eggs Benedict. And the best English muffin ever!!

This place was recommend by a friend!! I was So excited!!!  Because they rave about the pizza, thin crusted pizza!! We got lost! They doing some construction on the road, And finally found the place! As I go inside it looks nice an cozy! They had an outdoor and patio, and regular inside seating!!  No crowd!! The hostess and elderly lady! Looks at my husband an I, as she dissecting us with her eyes! She said "seat for two" without asking were we would like to be seated! She decided to sit us on the far back next to the BATHROOM!! Mind you is was empty!!!  The customers behind us were seated on the patio! When asked if we could have patio seating! She seem annoyed! Waitress had to ask the hostess, if we could change seating, she was as well annoyed! We felt so uncomfortable and not welcome, that we left!

Garbage. We had a reservation for 8 people and 9pm and weren't seated until 10:20 after continuous "just a few more minutes" they then tried to squeeze 8 people onto two tiny tables that would seat 4 max. Not great, so we asked to move to an adjacent table after the people had finished, which was fine but added another 15 minute wait. I get it, that happens sometimes on a Saturday in Manhattan, and to be fair they gave us a round of drinks on the house. So that only knocks one star off. However, the waitress was AWFUL - she was pissed off about something and was so rude I nearly walked out there and then. She slammed dinner plates onto the table splashing tomorrow sauce up my shirt. Not only was she slow, miserable and totally inept, it was as if the very concept of serving food offended her in some way. Worst service in a Long time. The food was also pretty crap. A few stringy clams in overcooked pasta. I didn't like the look of anything anybody else ordered. The meat platter to start was fine but you can't really screw that up can you? The reason it doesn't get 1 star, is the ambiance is nice and the bar maid and hostess were both awesome. The hostess in particular. Sadly the awful waitress and the disgusting food means I will go out of my way to tell anyone who will listen to avoid this abysmal excuse of a restaurant.

While it may be unassuming from the tarp flyers on the outside this is some of the best Authentic Jersey Italian food you will get. The garlic shrimp sauce should be scraped clean with the excellent complimentary garlic bread. Every pasta I've tried has been top notch at a perfect temperature.  Highly recommended

I can't say enough good things about this place. I really don't understand where any of the negative reviews are coming from. I went there this evening for my fiancé's birthday. this was the second time we had been there - the first time, we were so impressed by the food, service, & atmosphere that, of all the places in NYC, this is where he wanted to go for his birthday dinner. I created a yelp account when we got home just so that I could write a review for this place - they seriously deserve it. the owner is extremely friendly, as is all of the staff. we were asked several times if we needed anything and if everything was to our liking - of course it was all fabulous. the cocktails are delicious - very refreshing! the bartender is also very attentive. the food is simply outstanding. the owner is a California native and studied cooking in japan, so there are hints of both Japanese and west coast influences throughout the menu. the fried chicken appetizer is a standout and we also love the taquitos. the rotisserie chicken is also unbelievable, and we loved the ancho chile brownies for dessert (chocolate with an unexpected kick). another reviewer mentioned the owner pushing them to order food. this place is new - if the owner suggested ordering food, it's because a) he's proud of his dishes (as he should be) and b) because he wants people to give it a chance. someone also said that their dish was over cooked - perhaps that was the case, but I can guarantee if anyone spoke up about it, the issue would have been corrected immediately. the staff there is far too attentive to allow for any sort of negative experience to occur. I truly can't recommend this place enough. it's in a quiet area but it's worth the trip - you won't regret it.
We are regular patrons of this Restaurant...Once a month or so. We have never been disappointed and didn't thin it could get better ...but it did ! Superb Foof and service at the Bar !

Horrible. Placed a delivery, the tacos were terrible. Only one tortilla, it was thick and not heated at all. The chicken and al pastor meat were tasteless. They were also very rude on the phone. Not impressed

Don't judge book by its cover. If your in the area, although it's not in main drag, and want a great choice of very well made hoagies,  stop in this place. Young guy that runs the counter, it feels like a family joint, is remarkably courteous and polite. Not what you expect.... But you'll be pleasantly surprised.

We came here with high expectations and Lombardi's didn't disappoint. We were seated immediately even though it was 8:00 on a Saturday. (Side note: the hosting staff wear headsets to keep things efficient and it kind of makes you feel like you're being served by Special Ops). We started with green salads for a appetizer, which easily fed two people. The salad was super fresh and the balsamic vinaigrette dressing was primo. The margherita pizza with mushrooms and pepperoni was excellent and served piping hot. It came fast, too! Our waitress was very attentive and friendly. Highly recommended to both local as a visitors.

I just had the most amazing meal at a pizzeria my god did that take me by surprise . The chicken Murphy at pizza one .this place is amazing and they deliver. It's on the spicy side of flavor but it's a carnival for your tongue. I had it over angel hair and the pasta wasn't soggy when it Arrived what!! They don't make food at pizza one they perform miracles!!!Too compliment this amazing meal I ordered a Miami beach salad wow they got a new twist on salads.Honey roasted pecans on a bed of mixed greens dried cranberries Asian pears and this dressing that was unbelievable. I had too call back and ask them what it was and a very soft voice told me they make their dressings in house. OMG they call it honey balsamic. I am very happy with pizza one and recommend them too any one who wants some happiness in their lives!!!.

I may just have had a very unfortunate experience here.  I shared an appetizer with a friend and in the middle of eating it, they brought along her main (pasta dish) and squeezed it down beside her on the very small table.  We had only been there about 15 minutes at this stage.  She asked to send it back to be kept warm and then as soon as I had finished my portion of our shared starter, my main came out and put in front of me, despite the fact that she was still eating her portion.  I ordered pizza and instead got a small, chewy flatbread that had a thick base, and must have been sitting under a heater, hence the chewiness.  I sent it back and chose another dish, which was fine and the waitress was very nice about this. Another waitress then accidentally dropped a glass on water on my friend from behind her, going on her head and down her back and then the glass dropped and smashed.  Not her fault, but they did not offer anything off the bill or a dessert or something to apologize.  Instead, they overcharged us for our wine.   This was very average food which was accompanied by a comedy of errors in service.  I really wanted to like the place, but it may have just been the most unfortunate service I have ever had in my life!

Really really like this place. Their 12" pies are better then Grimaldi's. Service is good  our waiter Arnold was exceptionally good. I've gone 3 times so far and have not been disappointed once. A must !!

Thought I'd try this place for breakfast, that maybe it would be a little different than the few other choices. Regretted my decision. The eggs were overcooked, the bacon was cheap,  thin and overdone. On top of that, the staff is super busy preparing for lunch so they seem inattentive and rushed. It's like the owner suggested they do breakfast because they are already there doing prep so they might as well make money. But the staff isn't on board. SKIP for breakfast.

Crepes are so delicious. Best coffee I have ever had. I tried the "Wow" coffee and the "basic" crepe. The crepe was huge! I bought a bag of the "Wow" coffee because it's so scrumdittleumcious! Amazing food, courteous staff, accommodating owner. We have returned and will continue to go back.

Pathetic. Very unprofessional people. We had a deal for party hall and then they turned down the deal. I do not want to comment about food quality because I never been there to eat. But I don't like the treatment which they give to customers.

This place was recommended by several friends, especially Debbie! She and everyone were so right! I thoroughly enjoyed everything !!! It makes you feel like you are In a great restaurant in Manhattan!

Had reservations tonight with my wife and a close friend who has been raving about this place for months.  We weren't seated until 45 minutes after our reservation, which was certainly not a good start.  However, while we waited, their wine was reasonably priced and crisp, and they comped us their cheese plate app, so that allowed me to look past their tardiness. Our first course was tasty.  My wife had the burrata salad, our friend the polenta special and I had the watermelon gazpacho. It all went wrong from there. I ordered the lamb chop special.  I don't use this word lightly, but it was gross.  It literally was a one inch piece of meat attached to fat, and lots of it.  The rice it was served with tasted good, and the snap peas were a treat, but the lamb fat chop was such a horrific disappointment--quite literally the worst piece of meat I have ever seen in a restaurant.  It is scary that a chef at a place of this supposed quality would plate a piece of meat like this.  And so that I'm clear, I'm greek, so I know my lamb. Really a 2.5 for the wine and first course, and the place had a good vibe, but that lamb was truly disgusting.

I was there last Wednesday with group of friends. The food here is way over average. Outside sitting is another thing we enjoyed. annddd the service!.. Very attentive, relaxed and with endless smiles. Great place to be!..
Very pathetic. I have been there few times with my office group. I hate this place. Waiters are awful. They behave very rudely. do not understand English at all. Or may be they pretend that way..

I wish I could give this place zero stars . This establishment is an atrocity . Wow.  By far the rudest staff ever. How are you going to run a business yet treat your customers like dirt. First they got my cheesesteak order wrong. Then they coped a major attitude when I tried to order my fries at the same window as my cheesesteak. My cheese fries were on the verge of being cold. I had better frozen , make it yourself cheesesteak that you get at the frozen section in the grocery store . This place is way over priced . It's disgusting.
fresh sushi and great drinks. great atmosphere and attentive staff make these a favorite of mine
BBQ Pulled Pork.  Will not disappoint, i promise.

This place is my all time favorite for Chicken Sandwiches! It's a burger place but to date I haven't tried a burger because I just love the chicken sandwiches haha! Oh and the special sauce is so amazing for the fries! The staff is very friendly and the place is clean. So far we've been here like 5 times, I hope the food stays yummy!

Went for a Saturday lunch.  Not a good idea.  Short ribs were tough and fatty. Chicken was dry. Really did not meet my expectations. Maybe dinner there would be better.  If your going to Ferry Street in Newark for lunch, you could do better than this place. Sorry.

The food is always so fresh and served quickly. The staff, especially the manager, Fernando were very helpful in accommodating a change in one of the items we wanted (pumpkin pancakes !) The dining area is always clean. The Boonton IHOP is my favorite IHOP!

Slow and poor service - the place was not crowded at 9pm on a Friday (bad sign!) and we waited over 30 minutes for our drinks to be made. The good itself was not good - farfalle pasta with meatballs was al dente on a good day -- hardly cooked at all. The pizza/flatbread was not good either - we had the meatball and bacon pizza, which had a weird crush and a tomato sauce that was too pasty. It just didn't work well together. The restaurant looks very good, but I can't recommend it.

Stay away! They will change reservations on you and try to deny service and even kick you out. I called a day before and made a reservation at 6pm. Late in the night they call me and tell me there is actually a private event and the guests will start arriving at 7:30, but also add that we're welcome to stay and eat. However, when we arrive & order they try to kick us out before 7pm in a very rude manner even though they had literally just served our food. Will not be back! Neither the food nor the service is worth it.
Everything is good. The wait is my only complaint. Too many people know how good this place is.
Service is extremely slow. Was seated for about 10 minutes before being asked for my order. The wait was even longer to get my check

Good place if you're not hungry and have enough money. We were hungry and got tiny bites, went for pizza afterwards. The quality of the food was rather low (two in our group were Spanish), but it was very nice prepared on the plate. Overpriced. We liked the atmosphere and the staff was friendly.

There used to be lines out the door  and around the corner for their salads, homemade turkey breast, ham, roast beef and pork. No more, there is rarely more than two people in line due to continued price increases over the past few years, since the new owner took over, that have nearly doubled prices. Salads are still good but I noticed that they are adding more dressing and less potato, macaroni, cole slaw, etc to increase profit. Same with fish cakes, more potato less fish and the Mac and cheese has less cheese than before and is bland where as before it was cheesy and flavorful.
Excellent good food!!! fun times. I recommend the marinated chicken breast with black beans and coconut rice along with the plantains.  It is BYOB bring your own bottle for the sangria!!!

Our family loves their food!!! Seriously, if you want an amazing home cooked meal and don't feel like cooking at home. I highly recommend going here. Honestly there hasn't been anything I've gotten from here that I didn't like. We go at least once or twice a week. Here's a list I've tried and recommend.  Their stuffed chicken breast, stuffed eggplant, stuffed pork chop, Chicken Primavera, meat or veggie lasagna, croquettes, all of the sides, rice, green beans, roasted potatoes and last but not least their homemade tiramisu. Soo good!!!
Marginal food, bad service, rude management.   Will throw away gift certificate and eat elsewhere. Basically just horrible in every way.

Typical yuppie place in a yuppie area. Loved the interior design and the bar looks awesome. Service is super fast even though the place was really crowded. French decor - high ceilings and huge mirrors which looks really nice. Ordered the eggs Benedict which was perfectly done. 1 star down because the price is just a tad high for what you get.

Four words - SPICY PASSION FRUIT MARGARITA!  If you like spicy and margaritas this is your new jam.  Went here on Saturday night and the place was hopping.  We were seated only a few minutes after we put our name in and our server, Ashley, came over shortly after that.  Ashley was great!  We had the ever delicious guacamole, mahi mahi tacos, and brisket tacos.  Everything was super yummy and the service was wonderful!  Will definitely be back!

I was in the area for work, so I found this on yelp and thought I would give it a try.  I had never experienced a Brazilian steakhouse with a pay per pound system, but figured I would try it.  They had a small salad bar and the Gaucho was behind a carving counter by the grill, so they didn't serve you, you had to go up and have him carve what you wanted.  They had a few different meats, but only a couple steak.  The rest was chicken, etc.  The flavor of the meat was ok, they were cooked to my liking, but they were luke warm.  Not sure if I would go back, but it was a unique experience.  I had 3 plates full and it cost me $25.  So the price was definitely very good, but the food choices and the overall quality of food was average at best. Also the restaurant was in a neighborhood that was a little less than desirable late in the evening.

I won't lie I did not want to come to the craft house but my family all voted on coming here so I had no choice !!! Well am glad I came ,definitely a place I can come by hang out eat and drink , there corn dip is scrumptious there drinks are amazing the bartender was on the money my waiter Eliana was great thanks for the great experience

this bar is awesome!  we drove a half hour just to come here. the place is self is amazing with TVs everywhere. the staff is super friendly, the food is excellent, the service is great and the bathrooms are kept super clean. the owner makes the place even cooler! he runs around the entire game cheering the game and everyone on, playing the dolphin song! I'm not even a dolphins fan, and i had an amazing time. we would gladly come here every Sunday if we could! definitely a place to check out.
Some of the best pickle chutney I have ever tasted.   The dosas are perfect.  I HIGHLY recommend this place, best Indian food I have had in a long time.

I come here for their happy hour, I would have to say the shoestring potatoes cooked in duck fat and drizzled with truffle oil is one of my favorite things on the menu.  Other favorites are their margarita flatbread and sesame wings.  The servicers are witty and make you feel just like you are at home.  I would strongly recommend this place.

Their employes belong to the national association of morons. Besides giving my salad away to another unfortunate sole, I was asked if they should make another one for me. Since the salad was already paid for I suggested that it would be a good idea if I received what I paid for. While waiting for my paid salad my pizza turned to stone and I my 2 front teeth became the victim of the stone cold pizza. Larry the local dentist in the woods charged me $17 for replacement teeth.... Moral of story; HIRE NEW STAFF !!!
we loved this place!  the waitor is absolutely great.  the fallafel is very good, has a kick of spice, not oily at all.  the mixed grill of lamb is tenderandjuicy.  the sea bass is very fresh.

As a former server, bartender, hostess and manager--wow. never have i been so astonished and offended. Terrible beyond horrifying service. Was accused by the manager of doing drugs in her establishment. And trust me I wouldn't be writing this review if that was even close to the truth. She kicked out both my friend and me, who were catching up on our summers over a couple of beers. When I asked her what the reason was for this, she responded, "Honestly i think you're on drugs." I guess all skinny women who go to the bathroom after a meal and 2 drinks are on drugs. I PAID my $70 bill, and I've regret it every day since. If the owners care at all about customer service they've already fired this judgmental oaf of a manager who knows nothing about business or hospitality.

The Guilty Plate certainly fills a void in Malletts Bay. It's a standard diner, with good prices and decent food. Just an idea about prices: Omelets are about $7, and good-sized breakfast sandwiches are $4-5 with homefries. My favorite thing about breakfast was the homefries; they were crispy and well-seasoned. I would love to see more local and organic ingredients, especially with everything in season right now and fantastic farmstands right around the corner. Organic eggs, please! They do have real VT maple syrup, which is always a plus. I know it's a diner, but seeing some VT stuff on the menu is great. Local jam? My dad ordered the Americana and chose French toast, which was mediocre at best. It was thin and kind of soggy and could really benefit from a bread upgrade. I was disappointed in the $4 fruit cup which was just watermelon, cantaloupe and grapes. Berries would have been really great. I ordered the Greek breakfast sandwich with spinach, feta, tomatoes and onions, and the flavor was great and was a great portion for the price. I had ordered gluten-free bread (which they have!) and the roll upon which the sandwich came looked suspiciously gluten-y. Before I even had a chance to ask about it, my server came over, apologized, and replaced it with gluten-free bread. Thanks, Taylor! My mom's gyro omelet had some meat but was missing the tomato that it advertised and was overall kind of "meh." She didn't love it. The coffee wasn't that great and we had a little bit of slowness with refills, service and time waiting for food, but overall, the place was decent! I think that as they're open for longer, they'll get into a groove. I like the booths and all of the seating at the bar. It is kind of loud, but not extreme, and there were a lot of kids running around and a very chill atmosphere. I think that the place is clean and the food good, though not fancy. Overall, it's a good diner. :)

Flawless!!! A rare NYC gem!!! Contrada is the sort of restaurant people come back from travels to far flung places and rave about--they say it's worth going to XYZ just to eat there. Yes, Contrada is that exceptional! The food is delicious and creative and accessible and inexpensive (certainly by NYC standards.) The menu is comprised of dishes that represent seemingly different cuisines from mediterranean to Italian, yet they are each delicious and complementary and clean. The main ingredient takes center stage here, the sauces or seasoning are its supporting cast. Why is this impressive? It takes work! This approach to food doesn't allow the chef anywhere to hide. Speaking of the chef, he (whose name I do not know though I had the pleasure of speaking with him,) is one shining star in a myriad galaxy of glittering staff! Michael, an owner, the sommelier, and homme du maison, is what is missing from almost every other restaurant of this quality--he is PRESENT, PERSONABLE, AND KNOWLEDGEABLE!  For the plebeian California chard lover, the wine list is a bit inaccessible, which is to say, I had no idea what to pick. Michael was endlessly patient and attentive and informative without being didactic; and he had a sense of humor about wine, though he is obviously an oenophile.Michael managed to find three different bottles that my dinner companions and I loved, and that expanded our taste. Lastly, this restaurant takes its civic duty seriously. Contrada hosts seminars and discussions, the former taught by famous journalists, the latter between literary luminaries-9/17 is a memoir writing seminar with Daphne Merkin and on 9/22 Daphne Merkin is in conversation with Erica Jong. Contrada is not just someplace to eat, but rather it is an experience akin to be a guest at a dinner party: one where the host wants you to be happy, one that will leave you vying for the next invitation. In other words, make a reservation! P.S. My husband told  me that, while everything above is absolutely true, he fears it is too stellar and that maybe I should tone it down. NO! I am a native, almost life-long, NYer and foodie. I call it as I see it, or rather eat it!

I don't often write reviews--this is my second. Our experience at this place for our 11-year anniversary, was exceptional. The food was just as good if not better than we've had on our trips to Miami South Beach. EVERYTHING we ordered was absolutely delicious, and the service was second to non. They even brought out a complimentary desert with "Happy Anniversary" written beautifully in chocolate on the plate (all I did was mention it was for our anniversary, when I booked the reservation, because they asked). It certainly wasn't a cheap meal, but we left feeling that we got what we paid for. As someone recently diagnosed with celiac, I was pleasantly impressed by their gluten free menu, and their full disclosure on any dishes that may have trace amounts of gluten. They were so understanding and they just got it. I'd give this place 6 stars, if I could! Well done!
Ugh

Tiny Thai is our favorite restaurant in Burlington area. It is delicious, colorful, consistent, cheap food. I enjoy trying new dishes but of course have my favorites. BYOB is awesome and keeps the cost down for a nice meal on the town. Service is always great too!! Highly recommend this restaurant.

Coffee is excellent! Poached egg with Haloumi - my poached egg was overcooked and completely solid inside. It was basically a boiled egg, some cheese, and a tiny piece of bread. My friend got the Mediterranean breakfast -  very basic, just a few items anyone can pull out of their fridge. Waitress was not warm or hospitable at all, she just seemed like a robot. The seating is uncomfortable. They squeeze too many people in there so you will be dining with the patrons next to you. Happy to have checked this place out, but won't be returning.

I ordered the vaunted Black Label Burger the other night, along with a pale ale beer on tap. So, was my $40 well spent? No. The burger was bland. I don't think I'm alone in this opinion, judging by other reviews I read. We're talking about a hamburger, so how much is there to say beyond that - not much. Now, I live in the neighborhood, and am frankly biased to writing a good review. I do like the old school vibe of the place. Alas, I won't order this burger again. I've had the steak frites here - that I may order again. But I've frankly had better burgers at Westville and Joy Burger Bar.

Prior to changing the menu I would have given this place 5 stars! Use to be one of my favorite places to drink and eat. Too many changes that take away from unique quality the Half Door used to have. Specialty brunch drinks are no more, amazing Curry sauce is gone, no seasonal specials. Overall the kitchen is much more generic and less creative. Love Shay and Elyse, best servers, they care but can't change things!

Went for lunch, we were the only 2 people  and the service could of not been any worse. Sat outside and we could not hear each other talk.  We had a long wait just to get water when there was nobody else in the place. The waitress was even a bit sassy when we asked her to check on our lunch after being there an hour. Food was fine. If you have eaten and Lunello other place this is a deep disappointment to say the least.

The freshest, most delicious food EVER. If I could sit here all day and eat and eat and eat, I totally would. The only issue ever to come up is the wait sometimes. But if you're lucky enough and can make it during the middle of the day on a weekday, you probably won't have to wait as long, if at all. Biscuits and gravy? Amazing. Cheese fries? Ditto. Took home a few baked goods, but they really didn't last very long, because they were great. I love the diner feel here and wish I lived close enough to be a regular, I'd eat here every day if I could.

Fantastic food for what you pay, I once calculated my entire order as if I were to buy it at another restaurant, my total calculated was over $100 but I only spent $25 great for large parties although unless your kid is a big eater I don't recommend the younger age as they only take half off the adult price. Service was reasonably slow for a Saturday night, but there is tons of food to make up for it.

Not impressed. Mac and cheese was below average (it was also cold when we got it!), two grilled cheese sandwiches were super small and burned a little and fries with herbs were small and saggy. For all we ordered we paid almost $40.   Also the atmosphere at this place is awkward and uncomfortable. The young girl and a guy who work there both seemed like it was the last place on Earth they wanted to be. Overall not worth it. Food not good and overpriced. Expected more from a place with such a great location. It will probably close down in nearby future, every-time we drive by it's empty.
This place is one of my favorite restaurant in  Astoria . even far from Brooklyn ,but I miss there food and atmosphere  . thank you for your honest business

I am so glad I found this tiny gem! Every single time I walk through the door, I'm treated like family and the bartenders always have big beautiful smiles on their faces. Especially my favorite bartender, Jillianne. She is humble and such a sweetheart. The bar is usually packed when she is working especially during football. I can't get over the impeccable customer service that she dishes out. If you want to be treated by family just walk into Emeralds on any night or day that she works. Having a bad day? Jill always listens to her patrons issues and ends up putting a smile on the faces of her loyal following. I usually call ahead to make sure she's there. The menu is great as well and their drink specials can't get anymore reasonable. 5 stars for Emeralds ALL because of Jill!!
Ordered a breakfast bagel sandwich and a long roll breakfast sandwich. Got two long roll sandwiches, and one had eggshells in it.

16 beers on tap and always a nice variety.  As the reputation goes, the wings are crazy good.  Unique flavor from their other locations.  I really like their eggplants fries with marinara sauce.  Wish they put it on regular menu.  Draws a mixed crowd, lot of locals.  Waitresses are very good and have been around for a while.

After having gone to the original hearth in Burlington, the TriBeCa hearth is a total let down. The gluten free pizza is cardboard and the sauce tastes like it comes out of a jar instead of being fresh and delicious. It's a shame that they don't bring the amazing beers down from the zero gravity brewery at the Burlington hearth. They won't even let you split the toppings on a small pizza unlike the other locations. New York City ruins yet another great concept.

So I booked a table for 2  through phone. That was the beginning of my horrible experience with Yasuda. In the phone the waiter was talking "English" very fast with heavy Japanese accent. I could barely understand him through phone, but somehow I tried hard and finally made myself clear. They also wanted me to call them on the day before the reservation to confirm the order. I did not get it. Shouldn't this be your job to call your beloved customers? Not that convenient. 2 days later I received a phone call from them to confirm my order. Finally they did this for me. "Not bad" I thought. However the English was still terrible and fast, it felt like he did not even want you to understand him, so after the confirmation on time and number of people, I simply wanted to end the conversation, while he suddenly blurted out bunch of words with byebye in the end, so fast that I didn't follow at all. But the time and number of people was already fixed, so what could be more important? I simply hanged up. Then the show was on. On the day of reservation, we arrived at Yasuda full of expectation. However when I told the waiter my name and telephone, he instantly said "oh sorry you arrived late so we CANCELLED your reservation, so NO" to me. I was shocked not only by the fact that arrived 12 mins late could render my reservation cancelled without notification, but also by the extremely unfriendly manner of the waiter. He explained that we should call the restaurant if we know we were running late, but for god's sake, 12 mins are you kidding? And shouldn't it be the restaurant's job to call customers? He explained that they only hold your reservation for 10 more mins beyond the reserved time, and he already told me that in the confirmation phone call. Really? Since this rule is so important, why didn't you make sure you do not express it with a hasty and blurry tone as if you do not want me to follow it? After this brief explanation, he simply did nothing but staring at us, without showing a little bit of effort of trying to help. I asked him what do we do? He told me to wait for another 30 mins to see if the next customer be late over 10 mins. Then we could take the seat. He said all this without politeness, without smile, without apology, not even a scent of sympathy. It seemed to me that he just wanted me to get out of their "elegant" restaurant. WOW. I will never come to this place again.

This used to be our go-to restaurant for Asian cuisine until throughout our meal we found 3 separate hairs in 3 different meals. Instead of directly apologizing, our server started comparing it to OUR HAIR! Then they made excuses saying that their chef's hair was too short to match. If that wasn't enough, they only took the cheapest item off, which wasn't even one we found a hair in. Unless you have a taste for hair, speak a foreign language they understand and have an extreme tolerance for idiots, I recommend you try someplace else.
Great brunch, reasonably priced. The sticky bun, the eggs benedict and the quiche are all really amazing. Dinner is pricey, but the food is pretty great, especially the flatbreads and the scallops.

I cannot rave enough about Nolita's.  I was just telling our waiter tonight that they should open a location on the strip in Las Vegas because Nolita's food is truly that delicious.  Having just gotten back from an eight day trip to Vegas, I feel very comfortable saying this. Nolita's has a wonderful staff, lovely atmosphere and everything from the arrancini (you must try), the chicken parm, the thanksgiving wrap, to the chicken wings etc are incredible. The food portions are large and we always have leftovers which taste just as delectable reheated the next day. They have a wide selection of beers on tap as well as cocktails and soft drinks. My boyfriend and I stop in for dinner at least twice a month and always look forward to trying something new on the menu.  A second location in Hartford or West Hartford I think would do amazing as well, and I also look forward to a website from them.

Excellent food, environment, staff, and meal was affordable. We thought the food was innovative with their wide range of choices of BBQ meals. We ate outside and enjoyed the half chicken with slaw, BBQ wings, and their baked beans were delicious. Will be coming back!

4 stars?!? These ratings are obviously padded, based on my experience at the restaurant. I'm a New Yorker and have eaten at restaurants receiving - AND deserving of 4 stars on Yelp. This place, however, was NOT one of them. Gastropub? Hardly. Better beer selection at one of the many places down the street. Or in my fridge. Food? Nothing to write home about. I could cook up a better burger at home. And it would cost me a heck of a lot less than the amount they gouge you for here. That being said, I don't mind dropping cash for a really great burger, but that's not what I got here. Service? Maybe if my table set on fire, I would've caught the attention of the waitress. Otherwise, she was in no hurry to do her job and serve the tables. I also expect service to be without attitude.

Okay, the food is amazing. I got the Cuban sandwich something, whatever it's called, from the Brunch menu. Totally worth it.
