My girlfriend got the egg something, and it was equally wonderful (I tried it). My only gripe is that I like places that feel homey and quaint (weird I know). This place is clean and not too homey. But that's just my own weird preference. Oh, also, they're cash only. That's kind of a bummer.
This place was expensive, but so worth it. Amazing service, orgasmic food. You're paying for higher quality, not hype or pretentiousness. I will be back for special occasions.

The paper towel dispenser dispenses a more than adequate amount of paper towels. Burgers are obviously the best in Philly. I would definitely recommend this place to a friend. Friendly staff and bartenders. Always a rotating bottle/can selection. Adult milkshakes are sublime, had the bacon peanutbutter one, perfectly crafted.

The food here is delicious and the owner is extremely kind and generous. He often gives me and my boyfriend free hummus while we wait for our food. The ingredients are very fresh and there are a range of different dishes to try. I especially love that the falafel is gluten free. Last but not least, the Turkish coffee is delightful and unique. This is definitely one of my favorite restaurants in Fishtown.

We loved this place. A must eat breakfast spot while visiting Princeton. Table as well as family style seating available. An order of bacon is easily 8 pieces and delicious. The blueberry pancakes  are so good you want to get down on the floor and thank The Lord for their goodness.

Taste of Mexico is a reliably good spot.   The Breakfast are really good.  There is a wide variety of options from traditional breakfast to Mexican choices.  For lunch & dinner the choices are very good & a lot less $$$$ than Tortougas on Leigh.
Good service and great pizza make it perfect when you are in the pizza mood!
Awesome sandwiches.

So cheap and so filling!! Went at around 9 with two girlfriends and it was still packed! I spent $3 and I have leftovers to eat for lunch tomorrow. They really have the key to making super good dumplings!
Very nice inside, great service, great food.

Nice Malaysian Cuisine! It's not the most authentic Malaysian restaurant around, but they make some tasty dishes with the right flavors! AND it's reasonably priced. I was seated right away and given hot tea which was delicious. I ordered the shrimp and ladies fingers, curry beef over rice and the roti with curry dipping sauce. Shrimp and ladies finger- 3.5 stars. The dish was tasty but I felt it was lacking something that was being covered with spice. Its basically shrimp with okras. It did not come with rice. Curry beef w/ rice - 3.5 stars the beef tasted delicious. It was not chewy or fatty. I recommend it. Roti w/ curry sauce - 5 stars the curry dipping sauce is heaven in a bowl. Enough said. However tea and water were made available at all times. I'll definitely be back with friends.

$2 Sangria's really ? They don't have a liquor license , only beer and wine so the sangria is wine and soda, that's why its $2. You get what you pay for. Wake up people. I know the thought of Tapas for $2 sounds intriguing but are you really getting anything on that slice of bread ? Tried it once, enough for me.
OMG I love this place more then I can say my two favorite people are Hilary and Justin they treat me like a friend not just a customer make sure you go to them

Really tasty, down-to-earth food. A good selection, including a 3:00 to 4:00 snack menu. Spinach 'n cheese dip was awesome. Chicken fingers an option for kiddies, too. Nice atmosphere and decent music for an older crowd. Our waitress was pretty chill. Definitely recommend trying this place!

I love the music they play, specially last night, they had a live band singing rock en español music. However, we received no service at all... my husband and I walked in and didn't know whether to sit or order at the bar... and sat at a table for 20 minutes until we decided to get our own drinks at the bar. Even though the music and the decoration of the bar are very tasteful, the people there were so obnoxious. Whenever a great rock en español song came on, they would request to change it for a more pop- clubbing kind of song... and the DJ would actually change it.  Why didn't they just go to a different place that fit the kind of feel they were looking for?  In general we felt a bit uncomfortable but the music was great.

This was a great restaurant. We really enjoyed the food and wine, it was all delicious. I had the cod dinner and it was the best tasking cod i ever had. The presentation was beautiful and the service was excellent! The tables are a little small and the seating a bit tight which made us decide to go elsewhere for dessert. I would recommend making a reservation especially if you have more than 2 people in your party.

Does not do justice to the original. Everything that comes out of the kitchen is either over cooked or cold (when it's supposed to be hot). Sides of vegetables are cooked with bacon. Just a horrible place to eat, especially when you have to digest that junk while you're flying. Beer and oysters and the stews are fine. Avoid everything else or you will surely be sorry.

So good! The breads are absurdly good, great fusion of Cuban/deli. Garces has done it, again! Wish I could eat here, every day. Everything is seasoned to perfection- the steak I had was unbelievably perfect. Nice location and cute decor/good atmosphere.

If I had to describe this restaurant in one word it would be AMAZING!!!!! My husband found this restaurant while looking online for somewhere new to eat and I have to say I'm definitely NOT disappointed! It's a BYOB so you can eat here at an extremely reasonable price. Our first visit we had the stuffed mushrooms as an appetizer....which were awesome! I ordered the Farfalle Siciliana and my husband had the pollo alla Chris......both delicious!!! We also both had dessert (cannoli & tiramisu) and a coffee and with no room to spare our bill was about $60.......so reasonable!! We went to Gelone again this past weekend and we had two appetizers and both had the filet mignon special. I was completely impressed when our meal came to the table and saw that they gave us each TWO filets...this was a $30 special! Again, another delicious meal! First impression is everything to me and the staff here is beyond friendly and you will feel like family as soon as you walk through the door. I would recommend making a reservation since it is a smaller restaurant and even though they have two dining rooms, they fill up quickly. I will def. be coming here again and again.......my new favorite!

I consistently attend this place for weekend brunch and have been here a couple of times during the week and I have not had a single issue. The food is unbeatable. The pastries are amazing. And the service is spot on. I recommend this to anybody local or even out of town visitors want to support small and local. This quiet and quaint cafe is the place to be!
This place has been an amazing experience to me as a Mexican food lover !highly recommended please try it you won't be disappointed ,

I've tried almost every ramen shop in the city, and though my friends and I do not always agree, I think this place is hands down the best. Get the pork buns and the spicy ramen. Hits the spot everytime.

I am reviewing this place 3 months after visiting, as I have been in 2 minds about doing so, knowing I can't possibly give it a good review. In short , the evening was a disaster. Both food and service were disasters, and the manager couldn't care less about his staff or the customers. In short: the place was super busy, under staffed and the food was just ok; very dry and overcooked meat and inattentive service. Food was bland and everyone's meal tasted almost the same. It was also cold and the meals did not come out all at once - table service 101 fail. We had been seated for about 10 minutes before our server asked us for drinks or food. She walked past us several times and we ended up calling out to her to get her to come to our table. she took our order and once the food came, she disappeared and did not return. The food and drink came together- about 15 minutes later. Slow slow slow. The atmosphere was awful- tables close together and far too noisy- our party couldn't hear each other and simply didn't converse with each other as we were having to yell. Think frat bar at 11pm kind of noise. So, here's this main reason for the 1 star: at the end of the night we tipped according to our experience with the server and the restaurant overall- the bare minimum of about 12%. We dine out a lot and are very used to tipping, but our friends were from another country and truly tipped according to experience- low. Well the server was not happy with her tip. She looked at the check in front of my friends, turned to them and said "you did not tip double the tax- you have to tip double the tax it is NY state law". I just can't believe this happened- I have never had a server do this and I think it is the most rude thing a server could possibly do. There is no law I am aware of regarding tipping. I was disgusted. I explained to her that the service was far too slow. My friends just sat there not knowing how to respond. I think she heard their accents and decided to try it on. We got up and left, and as we were leaving I could hear her complaining to her manager about our low tip. This man was leaning against the bar not even looking at her, just relaxing. I decided I would say something to him. I told him that the service was terrible and we tipped accordingly. He simply said, "yeah we are under staffed, people didn't show up for their shift and we are busy". He just stood there looking uninterested in me or his server. He looked away and did not offer any apology. I felt sorry for her at is point, however there's no excuse for her rudeness. I will never go back; there would be no point considering how much choice the UES has. What a crappy establishment- staff/management, food and ambiance.

Being a vegetarian, I was hesitant to try Brio but my first experience here turned out to be quite a pleasant one. I tried the pasta alla vodka without the bacon and I was quite impressed. Our waitress was very helpful in letting us know which dishes were vegetarian.  It was quite heavy so I did take the leftover home. Would like to come again if I get the chance.
The food is really good. The pancakes are great! Definitely a must. I recommend doing a reservation if not you'll have to wait 20-30min

With all the buzz around having to try a Philly Cheese steak with a side by comparison of Pat's and Geno's I really had much higher expectations.   To be honest I've had better cheese steaks not in Philly so the only big difference which people who live in this area seem to really love is the wit wiz option which is basically that nacho cheese whiz filling which you can get at places like 7-Eleven on your nachos or by melting that Velveeta cheese.  Prepare to put on the calories though. The one thing I really enjoyed about this place over Geno's was their meat, it was more tender and flavorful than Geno's but they could use some better bread.  I think if they took the bread from over at Geno's then they'd put Geno's out of business over time with their quality. I wouldn't return here in the future, I've had my side by side comparison and satisfied my earning to see what the buzz was/is all about so my experience is complete. Everything here is ala carte as well, you gotta buy your cheese steak apart from your fries.  It's all cash too so at the end of the day for a combo meal you're paying more than $20 for fast food which is ridiculous. While sitting here to eat we met some elderly couple from New Jersey that have been coming there for over 50 years, they used to live in Philadelphia a while back but every trip they make to Philly always includes stopping at this place.  This makes me believe this place is like going home to having a home cooked meal, you know the one thing your mom or family member makes which beats everything else.  So in this case Pat's was like eating a home cooked meal by mom for them.

So as decent as the food is- the service is one of the VERY worst in the city. There is a girl who frequently wears her hair in a pony tail and I have never felt so insignificant to a business before I met her. She took my whole group order wrong and took forever, so even though the food isn't bad I promise I will never frequent here for personal orders or work orders- because of how seriously absurd and awful the service is. On top of that when my friend walked up the counter to ask about food that we had been waiting on, he over heard her taking about customers in a very disrespectful way. VERY disrespectful way. Be VERY warned. It's decent, it's empanadas, and what you ask for is all you get...but don't expect any sort of respect on top of it

Me and my friends heard of this newly open Asian fusion restaurant  in Sunnyside and said why not give it a try since we were in the neighborhood .   The service for me counts first . It makes the stay more fun and  food more enjoyable. For this place, I rated them more than excellent . It was around closed to 10 pm when we came . We were a large group and they  let us stayed half hour passed their closing time without making us feel rushed to leave. Very exceptional business gesture! Me and my ladies tried different appetizers.   The Fried calamari is tasteful. The shrimp is delectable . Their edamame is  heavenly. Their chicken satay is  pleasant tasting. And  these were all perfectly matched with our unique Thai iced tea. For the entree, their pad Thai  is the best pad Thai I have tasted.  Their spare ribs and steak are equivalently superb as well.  What gave us a surprise was when we tried their pana cotta dessert.  The taste is  immaculate .  Rare and to die for ! The atmosphere Is relaxing , the decoration is classically modern and presentation is exciting. Did I mentioned that they carry their trademark ( orchid) to each originally crafted food when served? Overall, love this place and will come back again.  Right now, their dinner menu has not been settled yet, so more better  experience is coming on its way on our next visit.
The tapioca in the bubble tea was not sufficiently cooked and they got the order wrong.
Mahdi Mahi Tacos are amazing
Very disappointing menu choices and quality.  Definitely did not live up to all the hype.  I would not return.  Perhaps the people who love it have never had any other french country cuisine.
Love this place food and juice taste so good, and its all very healthy! I am not a vegan or vegetarian the setian is to DIE for!

Went here after work on a Friday evening with a group of friends. The place is alot larger than expected with several floors with many seating arrangements and a Comedy Club on the lower level. The atmosphere is great and the staff is friendly, we were seated on one of the upper levels where we were greeted by a friendly waiter. They had quite a few selections of drafts and the food was actually really good. Usually when you go to a place that brews there own beer the food is ok at best. I would recommend this place for a group of people or events.

My husband and myself were in North Arlington, and we were hungry seen a BBQ place thought we have a good lunch..  Well that is NOT what we had.... 1st- The waitress was in tight yoga pants and a tight tang top shirt where yes she had the body for it, but not for the job she holds that is not appropriate attire. If I was the manger I would have sent her ass home. 2nd-We waited a while for our food, which I can see if they were busy but they WERE NOT we were the only couple in the restaurant. NO EXCUSE. 3rd - My husband ordered the Angus Beef Burger he ordered it medium rare and his burger was cooked to well done and his fries looked and taste as though they were reheated. I ordered the pull pork sandwich that also came with fries my meal was ok. 4th-While I was eating my lunch the waitress and the other girl who was working the counter were standing in front of the fry warmer eating French fries right out of the warmer putting their fingers by their mouths and back in the warmer to get another fry. That is so DISGUSTING and UNSANITARY...... 5th- The waitress only came over at the end to ask if everything was ok, I told her no that my husband burger was cooked to well done she said sorry I thought you said well done, ok so she admits that she wrote down the order wrong. She asked us if she could do something for us we said the check. She still charged us for meal though.. The right thing to have done was not to charge us for his meal, or to have discounted the bill... We will NOT be returning....The owner really needs to get a manger in there that knows how to run this place.....

Difficult to describe just how delicious and amazing the food was at Village. Juicy and flavorful, I had the burger of the month (Hooch), while also tasting the foie gras-topped Whiskey King burger that my date ordered. Both were complex, perfectly cooked and were quite frankly the best burgers I've eaten. Started the meal with the pickled beets, and supplemented the burger with a shared order of fries. All in all too much for me to eat with the drinks, but couldn't be happier that I ordered it. I think for the quality of the food, the prices are incredibly reasonable, but just like any good restaurant, it's easy to run up the bill with delicious drink choices and side dishes. If you're interested in flavorful, high-class bar food and a whiskey selection that cannot disappoint, this is absolutely the place for you.
The best Asian bistro in Hartford Area! phenomenal! EasilyThe most artful, delicious and memorable restaurant experiment! Every bite is different!

Cute little place in Park Slope. The atmosphere is cozy and the food is consistently great! I've tried many things on the menu and all were outstanding. It gets very busy on the weekends so be prepared to wait unless you make a reservation. The service is great! Even though the place is extremely busy the staff is still friendly and at the same time very efficient.
Better than dominoes when you have a big group of kids to feed and they deliver. Not for me but fine for them and cheaper than a digornio.

Mom and Pop eatery since 1969. All of the food is great, however the eggplant Parmesan is out of this world. Also, the best part is they now deliver! And when there is no parking they offer to run your order out to you on the corner. Best Pizzaria in Boonton by far!

This has got to be one of the best diners in the area! I've been coming here for years and it just gets better and better. Food they serve is as good as in some high-end restaurants. The menu has endless options for every meal. And decor inside is pretty great too! Always able to be seated right away, wait for food isn't long at all and overall the atmosphere here is simply great. Even though the parking is very small, somehow I always get lucky and find a spot. Ps. Try their home made honey mustard sauce/dip - it's out of this world!

The fried green tomatoes are to die for! Everything else I did not like at all...not impressed. I had the pulled pork, mac & cheese and Cole slaw. I've had way better BBQ food. Will only return for the fried green tomatoes and the berry drink. I do love that they txt your personal cell when your seat is ready.

I so wanted to like this place.  First mistake was serving drinks to tables who came in 10 minutes after us. We had placed our drink order immediately, yet people who came in after us were served first.  I pointed this out to our waiter, yet it was still another 5 minutes before we received ours ( 1 martini -took 15 min.) - at this point I was ready to walk out, but chalked it up to them being new & still working out the kinks, plus we were really hungry.  Unfortunately, the food was a major disappointment. Our empanada appetizer with chicken was very bland & tasteless. For entree I ordered the burger, but was not asked how I liked it cooked.  It came out well done and very dry.  The fries definitely were cooked in old oil and had almost a rancid taste.  The other entree, which was the national dish of beef, rice & beans was also very bland & dry. I love rice & beans, but this dish was tasteless.  It might have tasted better with some seasoning, but there was no salt or pepper on any of the tables, only a candle & some crayons.  I still had hope for dessert, but when I saw the couple next to us each take a bite of the cake, make a face & put their forks down, I decided against it.  I wish I could have spoken up while we were there, but the staff were all very sweet and eager, I just couldn't .  I do think the potential is there, but the chef really needs to season the dishes more, and the bartender & waiters need to stay on top of orders.

Really love this place. Great service and the food was excellent. We started with Shrimp Cocktail and some salads - wow wonderful. My hubs had steak and I had Red Snapper - was sooo delicious. Our friends had fish and paella and enjoyed it as well. The atmosphere has a comfortable feel , we were laughing , drinking and just enjoying.  Hope everyone has the same experience.

Never again... One 3" diameter Crabcake was almost $8, and it tasted like old fried fish.. Terrible! The burgers were passable quality at best.   Their employees were very nice.  That was surely the best part, but with inferior food quality, I'm not returning. Maybe other items taste better, but there are way better restaurant options in the neighborhood... no reason to take the gamble.
I like to hangout with my friends after work. I like the food here, and they service. The price is not too expensive. I love Japanese food :)

A new and wonderful French restsurant.  The  atmosphere is nice and the service was excellent!! There is plenty of seating indoor and out.There are two levels and there is outdoor seating on both levels. The area is covered and is open to the sky. The menu is not complicated and makes it easy to select your food. They also have a desert menu. I tried the salmon with kalmata mashed and it was juicy and delicious. My wife had and enjoyed the Steak and Frites. Will be back with out a doubt!!

I only hesitate giving the 5th star because of the overall condition of the restaurant. The food was delicious and the the service was excellent. We ate in the bar area and had just as nice as an experience as dinning in the dinning room. The dinning room seem crowded with too many tables and the carpet looks like it needs to be replaced.  The bar area was spacious and comfortable.
Nice place.  Tasty food.No a lot of food for your $$$. Was hungry when I was done with dinner .
I've always been told "you must try the chicken and rice when you go down to New York City". I must say, this has been a great experience, loved the food!

I would have given them 5 stars if they didn't  jip me on my to go box. The took out all the meat and gave me not nearly a fraction of what I had left on my plate in a tiny to go box. Other than that great food and friendly people.

Great soul food!   Most people get it to go but we usually eat in the little dining area.   TV is always way too loud but hey its like being at your deaf grandpa's house eating home cooking.   Some ridiculously  tasty yams and Mac and cheese here.
it is nice cafe

We celebrated my sister's birthday last night (9/6/14).  Ciccio has the most delicious homemade pasta we've ever had.  The meatballs were soft and yummy.  Superb customer service.  And the drinks that Enrico made?  Forget 'aboout it!  The atmosphere was electric.  To top it off, they baked a chocolate birthday cake especially for my sister.  No words could describe this place other than "best dinner ever!"....
Great for brunch. Share a side order of crispy applewood bacon - it's too big for one! Had the lemon ricotta pancake with fresh berries. The blackberries were as big as quail eggs.

This place is terrible.  The service is painfully slow.  Our order came out wrong, and the waitress did not handle it well.  The ambiance, decor, and menu are all lackluster.  If you're in the neighborhood, do yourself a favor and walk one more block to Mile End or across the street to Fast & Fresh Burrito.   The food and service at both are excellent, and even though Mile End often has a wait you will still get served faster than at Bijan's.

Amazing service and the best lemon ricotta pancakes I've ever had in my life (hint: order them with blueberries). The perfect weekend meal spot, Tom's boasts a classic diner menu, along with some unique and tasty brunch items like Danish pancakes with blueberries, ricotta and parmesan. Sammies are simple and delicious, and fun beverage options like milkshakes or a Cherry-Lime Ricky completes the experience. I don't personally come here for the entrée items, but hey that's not what a diner is for, right? Service is fast and friendly in general, prices are more than reasonable, and the ambiance is...interesting. There is ALWAYS a line outside on Saturdays and Sundays, but it moves quickly and they treat you to orange slices and French fries with spicy mayo while you wait. These places are good for the social fabric of neighborhoods. The vapid consumerism that turns NYC neighborhoods into retail turnstiles isn't.
I love Better! I literally have lunch from there at least twice a week. So fresh and delicious. Their hummus is amazing!

Pylos practically embodies my ideal go-to restaurant: appealing decor, good service most of the time, and pretty enjoyable dishes, albeit not terribly memorable. The lamb and spanakopita are some of my favorite dishes. The prices are normal for Greek places, though lunch is slightly cheaper and less busy. The mood of this place makes it suitable for a relaxed lunch, a slightly more formal dinner, or a date. I've only been here for brunch and lunch, I know I'm missing out on dinner. Next time.

Absolutely amazing place.   Chefs Juan food is delicious !!!!! Staff is very friendly and professional.  Makes you feel like home.... Always want to come back It's my home away from home..... Me and my bf love to come here, chef always accommodates us so perfectly !!! He's awesome

A lovely cafe serving fresh plant-based food. Located ten minutes from the airport this nice little spot will satisfy diners with a variety of dietary preferences. This place was a win all-around. We split the Vermonter "Gouda" sandwich and the Broccoli Buffalo Bites. Flavors were Balanced well and everything was seasoned appropriately. Thank you for that. The staff was knowledgeable, welcoming and hospitable. The food arrived in a reasonable amount of time and we were satisfied with the portions. We will definitely be back before we leave town.  Next time your in Burlington check this place out.

What a fun place!  This is a must if you are in the area.  This establishment is BYOB.  They have pitchers of sangria's and etc to add to the alcohol you bring.  My friend and I went on a Saturday night and were seated promptly.  We ordered several tapas to share.  I had the papas rellenas which are delicious as always  I 've had the ropa vieja in the past and was hard not to order it this time since I wanted to try something new.  I had the ceviche made with tigerfish and citrus.  It was so refreshing and perfect for the summer.  I was a little disappointed with the stuffed plantains.  I felt there was barely any stuffing and they were a little dry.  The garlic shrimp is a must. I practically licked the plate. The atmosphere is fun and the decor is colorful and vibrant.  It was very loud inside and the servers played the bongos and sang to several tables for birthday celebrations.  Being a Saturday night, this was expected of course. The service was great and the waiter was always available.  I can't wait to return!
Really good for lunch and coffee. Check it out. A pretty good guy runs the establishment. Definitely worth trying.

Hmmmm--I must have eaten in a different place than the other reviewers.  Hostess was not at her place when we arrived--and when we walked in, she was less than enthusiastic in her greeting.  The space is nice--4 of us were seated in a nice booth.  Our waiter was very energetic and informative--although maybe a little too enthusiastic in his recommendations.  He mixed up the orders at our table.  While I appreciate the concept, the burgers were ordinary.  And expensive.  The onion rings were good, but not great.  It took about 20-25 minutes to get our food,  and just as long to get dessert--vegan carrot cake and chocolate shake.  Our waiter made several excuses for the kitchen--for instance, it was the chef's first time making the carrot cake.  Seriously? Overall, this place has a long way to go in my opinion, and I don't think that I would return.   The staff are dressed casually--bordering on sloppy.  Our bill totaled over $75 plus tip--way too much for mediocre burgers and a couple of desserts.

Had dinner for the first time here last night, and it was one of the best dining experiences I've had in my life. Sat at the bar on a Sunday night, and didn't catch the bartender's name but she was so great that I definitely would go back and sit at the bar whenever she's working. The popover with honey and sea salt that they bring as an amuse bouche/appetizer is beyond description-I think that it's the most delicious thing that I've ever tasted. I had 2 appetizers so I could try a couple things-the flatbread and the mussels-both were perfect. Not too filling, great flavors and presentation. I was full after both but had to try the butterscotch panna cotta-and didn't regret the decision, it was so so good. Service from the bartender was just the right amount of neighborhood friendly/laid back and perfectly anticipating exactly what I wanted and right on top of it (i.e. another glass of wine-she always had the bottle when she asked because she knew). Absolutely will be back again and again and am so happy that they are 2 blocks from my apt.

The beer list is absolutely impressive. You can find the sorts of beer I've never seen anywhere else in the U.S. Now Belgian KWAK is among of my favorites! The atmosphere is very casual. We had a table outside and enjoyed the evening in the Old Good Philly.

Have been several times and each time is better then the last! Beautiful layout if the restaurant and bar. Everything from the plates to the items on the menu has something special about them! The service is great and every waiter/waitress we've had has been very familiar with the menu as well as friendly and welcoming. You absolutely need to try the Salted Carmel Milkshake!! It's the most delicious milkshake I've ever had! The wings and onion rings are phenomenal appetizers both with a unique and savory dipping sauce. The  fish tacos, Mac and cheese, brenners burger, and pizza are TO DIE FOR!!! Will absolutely be coming back to Max Brenners! A+ A+ A+
Great flavors and eclectic spins on traditional dishes.  Dessert was not my favorite but interesting enough.

Best sushi place in the area. My boyfriend and I go there regularly. The blonde girl that works there is absolutely ADORABLE and I'm glad they finally got her some other servers to help! The sushi is FANTASTIC!!! I get the green hulk roll every time I go, and with a little extra spicy mayo, there's no better or more delicious roll anywhere. Customers for life!!!

I went here this past weekend and after hearing all the good reviews, I was disappointed to say the least. While the good was good, I thought the brisket I got could of had a more smokey flavor and less reliant on the sauce.  Also, for $14 for the large box, I felt I should have gotten more meat. Instead, 3/4 of the box was the other items and 1/4 was the main part of the dish. Service was also not helpful nor friendly. I was very dissatisfied and let down seeing that the owners run excellent restaurants but obviously don't care enough about this place.

I give two stars because the food is outstanding but the service is terrible. Be warned if you expect the waitresses or cashier/take out staff to actually listen to what you're saying and actually get your order right, you will be WRONG!!! Again terrible service but great food.

If you're looking for the most entertaining venue to watch your football game in NJ, Miami Mike's is the place to go. You'll especially love it if you're a Dolphins fan. The only cons that they don't give free refills on sodas and they removed the Rothlis-burger (double cheeseburger with two sausages and a fried egg) from their menu.

I love Yakitori and so does Anthony Bourdain.  That makes me a food critic, right?  Eh.  Well I try.   The food: The place seems to specialize in Chicken - the logo makes that obvious. Had the chicken skewers - thigh, gizzards, liver, heart, skin (yes, really). All very different and delectable. Loved the liver and the gizzards too. Must try. Other skewers - Kobe beef, garlic. Skip the beef - too ordinary - instead, order more Chicken. The garlic is a good complement to other skewers. Yaki Don (sp) was a good way to fill up, where the flavors of the grilled chicken is soaked into the short grain rice. Solid dish. Service was typical Japanese - quick, polite, efficient. Definitely the best Tsukune I've had in the US.  Give the Tontoro (pork neck) a try.....

My husband and I stopped by Eataly during a day trip to NYC and it was such a wonderful experience! You get a great sense of the hustle and bustle of the city with excellent people watching, the most delicious smells coming from different sections of the market, and the exciting sounds of locals and tourists clamoring around you. We ate at Manzo Ristorante and and we split the Carpaccio and the Pappardelle (Braised Pork and Radicchio). I was left speechless by how tasty and fresh everything was! I was savoring every single bite not wanting the meal to end. Service was laid back and friendly; we paired our lunch with a glass of prosecco for me and a beer for him before we decided to grab another drink on the rooftop bar at Birreria. (Birreria was way packed, but still a cool beer garden to those interested. Bartenders were a little less friendly, but I take it it's because the crowd was fairly large upstairs.)

I ordered the Gobdol Bimbimbap with beef and it was really delicious! It may seem a bit pricey at first, but there are a lot of different ingredients in it and they are all very fresh. The beef was very well marinated and flavorful.   I just wish they had more Korean items on the menu like Korean jjigae (soups).

I stopped in to buy a vegetarian lunch for my mother and immediately wished I had more time to stay for a 3 course meal. It was a weekday afternoon and the restaurant was full of patrons. Every dish I passed at the tables looked and smelled absolutely delicious! As I sat and waited for my to-go order, a member of the wait staff kindly offered me a seat and moments later served me the most delicious chilled Indian rice pudding ever!  If I didn't have to hurry and catch a train to New Jersey, I would have stayed for an entire meal! Can't wait to go back!

This is a trendy looking Mexican restaurant that uses Kimchee in their food, nothing more. Their food isn't even that great. First of all, the best aspect of Korean Mexican fusion food is the use of cheese in combination with Kimchee and Korean spices. Kimchee Grill barely uses cheese in their food, even their quesadilla. Studying their menu which lists the ingredients, it is clear they don't use any Korean spices at all. I had their wings and they didn't even double fry them, a signature technique in any Korean fried chicken. I am truly confounded why their rating is so high. I can only conclude that they either paid Yelp to raise it, or most of their reviewers are ignorant of good Korean Mexican fusion. To be fair I haven't tried their tacos, which I will at some point, just to be fair. Don't go here. If you want good Korean Mexican food, check out Seoul Lee BBQ, they are spectacular.

Food was marginal and not worth waiting in that line Not impressed. You all are ALL happy now.. but soon the lines and congestion will destroy any good experience you have here. Just an Overrated, Overpriced mall food court.

They did my wedding cake and everyone was talking about it! They couldn't believe how delicious it was! :) And it was absolutely stunning also! I got married at Arias and they have a great relationship because it was smooth sailing when it came to the cake. Perfection!  Thank you guys for making it wonderful!  :)

One of the best places in Philly to eat. Love the cheesesteak egg rolls and the cocktails are just as amazing. Good place to pre-game before going out on the town for the night! Go during restaurant week!

After visiting Montclair Bread Co., Starbucks, Gencarellis, etc., you realize how much you get for your money at Simit House. The prices of coffee and treats really can't be beat in this area, and there is no other place that also offers outdoor seating and the atmosphere of Church Street. This is a great find for anyone looking for lunch or just a snack. Just left Montclair Bread where I paid $6.25 for a teeny tiny coffee and teeny tiny croissant. I'm sticking with Simit House.

I think if you go here like i did and had no idea that this place had such a famous reputation you would not be that impressed. The service is great, the old school feel is great but the food was okay. The cheese cake was great! I found out afterward about their reputation, and was very surprised. It was probably great in the roaring 20's but now its just another diner shop that will probably be bought out and it will disappear like everything else in the area. Go here with no expectations and maybe you'll like it?

I recommend this restaurant!!  The food is fresh and fantastic! Service is awesome. And they give you " na pososhok" goodbye drink.  Their vodkas presented in frosted glass and the quality is great. I also went to another Eastern European restaurant Mari Vanna. And found out low quality food and vodka. And their menus are similar. I strongly recommend Korchma Taras Bulba. I felt the ethnicity and hospitality. Like I was at Ukranian village.
I have eaten here three times now and never been disappointed!! Short wait times and amazing food!!

Had the truffle scrambled eggs, guess I should have went for the mac attack everyone's raving about! Somewhat of a scrambled-eggs-snob and it was below average really. Bread wasn't the best, small side salad and bland eggs. Defs not coming back here for eggs!

This is my favorite restaurant in NYC. Did I say.....love love love love love... Always my fave recommend! The food was so good! I had the Kimolos Greek Salad, a mix of delicious veggies on focaccia, paired with a Riesling.  This was a great combination on a warm summer day; I must also mention the melon mimosa.  This cocktail is such a simple idea, but so refreshing and good. (Watermelon Juice mixed with champagne)  All the other food choices looked delicious and next time I want to try the Moroccan Couscous! Roasted Organic Chicken :$11.50:: Chipotle Mayonnaise, Roasted Tomatoes. Simple but definitely hits the spot. I love Cafe Gitane :)

I have had a few great experiences here in the past. I am a huge fan of their vegan wings and seitan cheesesteak. The waiters/waitresses have always been pleasant and kind. However, one night I headed over with my girlfriend at about 10pm for some food and beer. We decided to sit at the bar. The service from the bartender started off fine, however by the end of the meal he started getting really inappropriate. There were about two other guys at the bar, which I can only assume were the bartender's friends. The bartender begins talking very openly about how much he loves when girls with low cut tops walk into the bar, and how he would give them extra points (I assume for some bar game or something). Cue my girlfriend zipping up her jacket a little higher. At this point all we wanted to do was leave, we finished eating, and it was good, but this dude was being really immature. and I can't help but think he wanted us to hear him, based on the level of his voice. Of course he doesn't notice us shuffling and trying to get the check. His second highly intellectual conversation topic was about his high school girlfriend giving him blow jobs. This is happening from the other end of the bar, and we couldn't avoid hearing him. This bartender was not having a quite private conversation, anyone sitting at the bar could hear him. He eventually strolls over, we ask for out check, and leave. It's a shame that people have to feel physically uncomfortable when all they want to do is have a meal and a drink, but I guess it's even more of a shame that some 40 year old dude is still reminiscing about his high school sex life.
Some of the best tacos in New York. Only downsides are the long lines and lack of seating

One of my favorite slices of pizza in NYC. The lines can be long but it's worth the wait and the slices are pretty big so bring your appetite. The artichoke slice is creamy and delicious, I tried a slice of their top sellers margarita and artichoke. I loved the margarita. It was my first pizza bite during my trip to NY and it was everything I hoped it would be. Flavorful and crispy crust mmMm. The artichoke was a bit heavy but the sauce was garlicky and so delicious. My only complaint is that there was too much sauce almost like I was eating pasta sauce. And the crust was not thin but rather bready. If the proportions of sauce to crust was better this would've been my favorite. Overall, great spot especially late at night. Sometimes the pizza is burnt so that's bad. Everyone should try it out at least once.

Hands down, THE BEST sushi I have ever had in my entire life.Way better than Fat Salmon or any of those other fancy places where the seating totally sucks. I can't stop thinking about it. Probably going back there today. The Aspen rolls were the most amazing thing I've ever put in my mouth. Girl behind the counter was super sweet, she also gets 5 stars. Bit of a hole in the wall, not ideal for a first date.But, if you want the greatest sushi Philly has to offer, check this place out.

I definitely like the atmosphere.  Our server Rachel was very friendly and told us a little bit about each item on the menu as well as happy hour specials. Very unique how they recycled old wine bottles to use as water bottles that is brought out to each table as you are seated.  The flounder fish is good!!!
I def recommend this place for sushi. It is so good and fresh. All the waitstaff is really friendly to kids to. The place is always clean as we'll

I am a fan because this place is so classic NY divey.  Surly staff and all.  Drunk as skunk occasional patrons.  That guy at the bar that just won't shut up.  But you tolerate and nod along just because that is what you are supposed to do. This is a fun place to escape back to the 60's drunken bar scene.  It used to just ooze that classic stale smoke smell as well.. but unfortunately that stench is waning. Not a place for a date.  But definitely a place to grab a few after a shite day on the street.

This place has a great atmosphere! It's a cozy little Italian spot, but it also has an amazing outdoor seating area when the weather is nice. Very quaint and it does not feel like you're in NY anymore, which is a welcome relief at times. I ordered ravioli because I really wanted to try sweet potato stuffed ravioli...I am a big fan of sweet potatoes in general.  It was served in a broth which is...the water where the ravioli is boiled in with a bit extra parmesans and cilantro.   Honestly it was average...the ravioli looked more like very thin Asian dumplings.   The meatballs were tasty...and my mom, though she is Polish, cooks really good Italian meatballs with a veal, pork and beef combination and these were equivalent to hers. Food great tasted and although it was packed, food came out quickly and we enjoyed every minute!  I will definitely go back!

This place has a great atmosphere! It's a cozy little Italian spot, but it also has an amazing outdoor seating area when the weather is nice. Very quaint and it does not feel like you're in NY anymore, which is a welcome relief at times. I had the sweet potato sage ravioli. It was delicious. I often find ravioli portions to be on the puny side but this was the perfect side. I even had enough to share! My dining companions got the pasta with breadcrumbs and veggies and the gnocchi with spicy sausage. Mine was the best, for sure. Also delightful were the crostini we split, the chickpea one was surprising and addictive, the one with ricotta and speck was creamy, salty, heavenly. The highlight for me was meeting Merlin, the French Bulldog in the Frankie's logo! Their cheeses were yummy! I had a lamb dish with pasta in it, it was the perfect portion. It's REALLY not that expensive! Try it!

Just ordered delivery from this place and I wasn't impressed.  I got the white meat chicken tenders, the chicken was satisfyingly crispy, but it was not hot on delivery.  Also, the sauces were not great (Buffalo Bleu, XXX Hot, and Parm. Pesto).  The Pesto was the best of the lot, but I have a problem paying .50 per sauce (none are included in the 8+ dollars you spend on the chicken).  Not mention, the sauces weren't even full, the Pesto was only half full.  All and all, it was decent chicken, but the value isn't there and there are a myriad of other delivery places in the area that deliver a better product.
Full review coming soon. This place is flawless.

This restaurant is a true gem of the Greenpoint area. They possibly make the best red vegetarian borscht I've ever had (being half Russian Jewish and raised on my grandmother's cooking) and the blintzes are utterly spectacular. Order the Chef's choice blintzes for blueberry and cheese swirled together in a cacophony of taste bud delight. Beware though, the sloth of the itis is sure to follow this endeavor. The service was good (and the food was inexpensive, quick, and unbelievably delicious. I will certainly be a repeat customer and look forward to tasting the other items on the menu.

The food is pretty good and the place is nice. As it is really one of the only good places around newkirk plaza I can't complain. It's a great place to go grab a burger plus for those of us in Midwood Park it's close by. I love the La Vaca and soft pretzels. Not a fan of the onion rings.
Thicker, sturdier crust than most other shops and their dough and sauce are made from scratch. Cheese straight from Wisconsin. These are people who love pizza.
Really enjoyed dining here. Try the veal tongue! Great atmosphere and shout out to our waitress Sonseray! She was very professional and charming ;)

I walk by this place every day on my way to work, so I was very excited to finally try it.  It was a hot Friday night and since they don't have AC, so the crowd was thin.  Sure, it was hot inside, but I can't fault them for that.  I can fault them for the bad service and the mediocre food that was super slow.  They practically ignored us and gave us no updates on the slow food delivery.   We tried to order a drink while we waited and I thought that would be fast since the bartender appeared to be doing nothing, but no, that was slow as well. As for the food, I can start with the positives: the brussel sprouts (as I've seen in other reviews) were great.  Really flavorful and cooked well with a good char, just the way I like it.  The tuna app was super small and salty.  The 'broken crepe' had horribly overdone and chewy calamari with tiny scallops that were lost in the dish and maybe 1 mussel in the entire plate.  We also had the pardon peppers which were good but strangle covered with unappetizing, salty tiny shrimp. I'm also confused by the menu.  They list all their dishes the same, and the waitress told us that the size depended on what we were getting.  Some were small, others good for sharing and other were full entrees.  Fine, I understand the idea of Tapas, but then when we got our bill, some were clearly listed as appetizers, others as sides, and others as entrees.  If they're defined that way in the kitchen, why not just put that in the menu?  It would have really helped us make decisions on what to buy.

Good food, interesting atmosphere, and friendly staff. Everything we got was really delicious! The fried chicken has good flavor and fantastic texture. The sushi was very good, and quite reasonably priced. Good seaweed salad, but not anything unique about it. We ordered several rolls of sushi, vegetarian gyoza, seaweed salad and miso soup. My favorite dish of all was the vegetarian gyoza. I've been trying to recreate my dining experience with Momo's gyoza ever since (unsuccessfully). The skin was oh so thin but chewy, and the filling even better. The gyoza was accompanied by this spicy sauce in addition to the traditional dipping sauce... divine. It still haunts me to this day, and this was a while ago. It's that kind of attention to detail that will keep me coming back. Thanks for a great meal, Momo. See you next time!
A great time at Parc!  Food and service were wonderful!

Meh is what I have to say. Save the trip to Burlington- go one exit further on I-89, pick up a 6 pack and have 4 star experience at Tiny Thai. We ordered the wings and sampler to start. The meat on the chicken wings was good but the sauce tasted like something you could buy at the grocery store. The spring rolls were a mystery, the tofu was a sponge (granted I don't like tofu), fried dumplings was fried bread with mystery meat, chicken curry skewers were good but paper thin. The #52 (red curry) spicy but flat and boring. The #37 (sweet and sour) was okay, again the sauce was something you buy from the grocery store and I think the pineapple was from a can. Needless to say we won't be back. Glad we tried, but no thanks... We ll be at Tiny Thai! The one up and up about this place - our server was excellent and attentive.

Ive only been here a few times because its a little far from my house but i cant wait to come back!! There pizza is amazing. They specialize in sicilian slices which i love. They have both outside and inside seating and the prices are really reasonable.

Don't forget the free garlic and basil, and honestly it may be all you need. Only place better in the world is Luzzo's, sorry. Although the charm here is better. But this is really a very close second. Go with the small calzone (it's huge-only add garlic, assuming you love it), it's great for two but better all for yourself. Pies are wonderfully light and has some tremendously high quality mozzarella, fresh (still with some stems) basil, wonderful sauce (I mean wonderful)! Well worth the trip out of NYC!
Party of 6, 1 tuna, 1 chicken, 4 steak all excellent.  Great service, friendly staff.

This place was excellent! Our server Thibaut was great, very attentive. The food was perfect, and they have by far, the best waffles I've ever had in my life! I was prepared for fussy and overpriced French food. It was anything but. Amazing comfort breakfast food that will fill you up for the day. Cocotte is superb with the potatoes to die for Service was generally good, although it was rather busy, so refills on water and waiting for the check was on the slower side. Not too pricey, but certainly could go cheaper too. I would come back in a heartbeat for breakfast of lunch if I'm in the area.
Amazing food! So glad we have you in the dartmouth region! This is a cheap place with amazing great food!

This place got so good reviews I went there with my wife, there was nobody greeting us at the front door, it had a very dreadful odor, my wife asked me please leave I told her lets just see some more! The service was really bad only 1 waiter for 15 tables, as an entrée they give you cold bread that in other restaurant is usually fresh bread. The food was good nothing special just the price of it, one small pitcher of sangria just enough for 4 cups was $25 just $5 dollars different of the food my wife order. On are way out not happy with the service, the prices and the food we see that they have a big lobster tank were half of the lobsters we're dead.... I'm never going back to this place!!!!!

pretzel fried chicken !!!! so goooddd, im talking about when you think you have no clean underwear and out of no where you find one last one in your clothes drawer because you are like me and not fold your clothes after the laundromat and just stuff everything into a closet, that's how good it is. Amazing Decor, its appetizer size plates, so if you are with your girl and you are trying to be cute and save money, just order these 2 items and you both share it. The grilled cheese sandwich with mushrooms, get  mushrooms, if there is anytime you listen to a stranger for advice, it is this moment in time. The mushrooms add a soft contrast texture to the crispness of the bread. The Pretzel fried chicken is great too, definitely dope. with that being said, you now have some spare cash to spend, save it! Just walk with her to the park near by and enjoy swinging and asking her about her favorite book and tv show growing up as a kid. If she says fresh prince of bel air, take her back for a 2nd date =) -swag

As an out of towner and of Eastern European decent I was very unimpressed by the restaurant. Soon after walking in I found that the garden in the back, although a wonderful feature, was esthetically poorly executed and cheesy. The staff didn't speak English and did not know how to recommend  off of the menu. The food was mediocre at best. I ordered the sturgeon and though I didn't expect much from the fish itself, I did hope for an exiting blend of flavors to surprise me... But nothing! The best part of my meal was the pomegranate sauce that came on the side. The meal that I was anxiously awaiting to enjoy, I ended up finishing out of mere necessity and hunger.
Wrong place

This was a very very good dining experience!  I ordered two big dishes (mixed sauteed seafood w/ vegetables; and stuffed eggplant) and both came out of the kitchen fast, hot and tasted excellent.  The service was courteous and attentive from beginning to end, and the restaurant is big, quiet and beautifully appointed. Bathroom very clean.

Holy crap... this is the best restaurant in Brooklyn.  Such a comfortable atmosphere and some of the nicest people I have ever met on staff.  I live in Queens and have been just about everywhere in the city and this is by far one of my favorites.  If you haven't had a chance to check it out put it on your to do list!  xo

I give this 5 stars given the area. Other than Single Pebble or Joyce's there is no real decent Chinese and American/Chinese food that is affordable and convenient for take-out. I find Jin to be both of these things. Every time I've gone in there the food has been delicious and served in large portions. Do not pay attention to the previous bad reviews. The food is good, always made fresh, with higher quality ingredients than other Chinese places in the area. The best part is that they change the oil they use frequently so everything that's fried has a nice golden crispiness to it. I've never tried the lo mein but I'd bet it is a little on the greasy side (this is chinese takeout...). It's still my favorite quick, chinese take-out place in the area (BY FAR) and is comparable to lots of hole-in-the-wall american/chinese takeout places I frequented living in Brooklyn. Great place, I've never gotten delivery from them just because I have a car and would rather pick it up fresh so I can't speak for the delivery side of things. Crab rangoons are awesome as are the dumplings. Hot and sour soup has some seasoning that separates it from regular hot and sour soups.

My parents live in Hartland and Windsor Pizza Chef is the only place they like to go to eat or get take-out from (Mom is 68, Dad is 75 -- they like value!).  The food is consistently good and the prices are reasonable.  Went there with the folks last night and had probably the best chef salad for the price ($6.50) that I've ever had.  It was pretty basic, but VERY FRESH and tasty.  Whenever we get their pizza, it's always good.  We eat there probably twice a month, or get take out, and I"m never disappointed.  The staff is nice and they rarely ever screw-up (the  Friday night crew is excellent). My father does not eat cheese so anything he orders has to be cheese-free and that is a difficult concept at most pizza restaurants.  The decor of the restaurant is pretty run-down, but it's clean, and you can't expect much in the way of ambiance at any Pizza Chef or House of Pizza in the Upper Valley.

Located very close to the Chef's Table, this rooftop bar has an unparalleled view of midtown buildings. The atmosphere is classy, rather than clubby, with jazz and samba music playing all night rather than teenage dance music. When the sun sets, you'll get a great view. The cocktail menu is small but the one drink I had (tequila based) was good.
Food is good. Location and styling are excellent. Front of house is hit or miss. Wait staff is rude. Overrated.
The BEST Italian sandwich place on the LES. Gaia is a sweetheart, bread is made fresh everyday and the menu is spot on delicious. If I lived closer, I'd be there every day.

I am 29 years old. When I was 8 years old, I was staying at my aunt's house when I had this pizza at the actual restaurant off of Broadway. I only had it once. I had one slice. 21 years later, I still remember how good it was. It was the best slice of pizza I've ever had in my life. I compare every other piece of pizza I've ever consumed to the single slice of pizza I had at Pompei's that fateful day so many years ago. Plus, I live in California now and, lemme tell you, pizza in California sucks. I was at a place recently where avocado was a premium topping. Avocado? Seriously? What the hell is wrong with you people? The east coast has good pizza. The west coast has good Mexican food. God works in mysterious ways.

The costumer service is superb! The food is pretty good. I had a chicken quesadilla, which was freshly made and tasty. There is a pretty standard selection to choose from in terms of breakfast/lunch. They have pastries, nice cafe drinks, and to top it all off ice cream, which is delicious. The location is perfect! There is a nice patio in the back that over looks the river and passaic (third ward) park. They also play lovely music that just sets the perfect mood for the morning/afternoon. I had a lovely afternoon there. I would definitely recommend you try this place out!
looooved the beast master pizza...good food, good service=happy me! I am coming back :-)
Terrible experience here with awful food that had clearly gone bad and service that didn't even care. Awful.

I don't really understand all the mediocre reviews of this place. I will say that I do miss the tater tots that used to be on the menu. We noticed about a year ago that they replaced it with waffle fries and it's just not the same. However, the burgers are really good. The burger of the week is always some really crazy concoction that may sound weird or gross but always tastes really good. The adult milkshakes are the best here!! We've been coming here for 3 years now and love this place very time.

Stumbled upon this place when my usual go to Vietnamese restaurant, Pho Hung, happened to be closed and I was looking for somewhere else to eat nearby. Similarly to others, I was a little hesitant at first based on the store atmosphere, but I decided to give it a try and was not disappointed! Had excellent pho soup and my friend had a delicious and unique pad Thai with a medley of fresh veggies. The mixed store/restaurant atmosphere also allowed me to do some shopping for authentic Asian groceries and teas while waiting for our food. Definitely coming all the time now that I've discovered this hidden gem!
With all the options for Indian food in Iselin, this place is the best.

Oh my~lanta...YUM! First time eating here in The City of Brotherly Love so I Yelped it. Thank you Yelpers for the guide! This quaint little sandwich place is amazing ~ great choice of salads and sandwiches too. I ordered the Jewish Hoagie...corn beef, roast beef, turkey and swiss cheese. They were out of hoagie buns so suggested focaccia bread. Great choice! Lettuce, tomato onion and Russian dressing was a great combination. The fact that my sandwich didn't have the swiss cheese (not my choice) didn't matter to me ~ it was delicious! My husband had the Turkey Hummus Wrap and totally got wrapped into it! Said it was really good. We rounded out our lunch with a Pumpkin Cinnamon Sugar muffin :)

Fantastic! One of my favorite Mexican places in NJ. I recommend the California Burrito. It is a BYOB place so make sure to bring something with you. The chips and salsa are great. The staff are friendly and the place is always packed!

I love the interior of this restaurant.  It's bustling but still manages to feel like you're in someone's chic but down-to-earth, beige-themed west village townhouse.  It's very busy during weekend brunch time. The food is awesome, the menu is well priced and the service is very friendly. My only complaint is that the bloody Mary's are amazing but they're a little small and a little overpriced (12 bones a pop) - it is the West Village after all... Try the breakfast sandwich, poached eggs, and Grapefruit Brule. Would definitely recommend to others and go back for more!

The pizza is as good as the hype says and the service is actually very nice, an old Brooklyn feel, given how few people are working and how huge the demand is! The hubs was craving pizza (no surprise there) so I asked the friend we're staying with where to go. She recommended Di Fara and we were on our way... it's almost funny how quickly we rallied. No sooner had she said "world famous" then the screaching of our rental car tires were speeding away. She warned us about the wait, but we are a patient people. I will come back again and again and again for this. Don't complain about the wait. Your food is worth it. If you're upset about it, go to dominos.

Ate here a while ago. Pizza was "ok". Nothing worth the long lines. Not clear what all the HYPE is about this pizza. Tourists LOVE it. Stand in line ALL day for it. No clue what they find so elusive about it. It is just a mediocre pizza
The noodles are good! They serve quickly. Though it's not as perfect as the noodle in my hometown. It's still satisfying.

This place is awesome, and I am extremely lucky to be living close enough to this place to have them deliver to me. We went the other night and the pizza margarita was fabulous.  I specifically asked for it hot and not soggy.  The reason was that the one time before, it was.  I am guessing the one bad time was an exception.,  Luzzo's is the best. But from now on, I'm asking for it hot and crisp. I definitely suggest checking out this pizza joint when you have a chance. Definitely not to be missed!
Excellent service and crapes to die for. They got regular customer.  Definitely will be coming back for more.
Broncos is without a living doubt the BEST taco place ever. Forget about Taco Bell, Broncos has absolutely authentic tasting tacos. My mouth still waters thinking about their steak tacos....

One of my favorite local places to grab some pizza.  I always order just cheese and it's super thin, NY style, not overly saucy and super yummy!  It's cheap, you can buy it buy the slice and the place is open til 3:00 a.m.  There is one table and maybe 3 chairs so get it to go, the staff isn't overly friendly but I mean, it's not that type of place.....you can buy by the slice (served on a cheap Paper plate) or do yourself a favor and grab a whole pie to bring home.  The slices are big and foldable but ultra thin and not overly filling......YUM!  Parking isn't great but circle the block, it's worth it!

Management lacks in customer service. Went there and had me playing musical chairs. After me complaining and saying if I have to move again my drinks better be comp. Of course they didn't move me again. Better off going to the Spanish restaurant a block away with $5 margaritas and sangrias
This is my 5th visit since they opened, food and service is fantastic.  Would definitely recommend.
Yelp is great app!

I couldn't agree more with all the positive reviews I read before dining here yesterday. I'm not familiar with the area as I'm from Monmouth County & was meeting my sister who's from Bergen.  We wanted a location in the middle.  This is such a gem & we hope to be returning often. The restaurant is lovely, cozy and comfortable and had a very acceptable noise level.  The food is fresh and cooked to perfection.  I had Tilapia Oreganta which was delicious, beautifully prepared and served.  My sister had Chicken Francesca over brightly colored, crisp greens with cherry tomatoes.  Both our entrees where served with a side of linguine which neither of us thought we'd have room for but was too good not to eat.  We also had a delicious Cabernet that our server suggested with our meal.  We  ended our meal with  expresso and a tartufo...all fantastic.  The service was excellent from both our waitress and Matthew.  I highly recommend it & can't wait to return.

Ippudo is great.At Ippudo, you will most likely spend between 15-20 dollars while at Totto you will mostly likely spend 10-15 dollars. Ippudo's noodles are, in my opinion, better than Totto's while Totto's broth is much better.  I love how the waiters greet everyone in Japanese and the atmosphere is warm and cozy. Overall, its a worthwhile and great meal, but Totto is still better.

During my experience at the Crabby Shack I felt like I was on a holiday at the beach. You will come out of there with your hands dirty, crab all over your face but with a gigantic smile. I was there with 3 friends and decided to try out most items on the menu. Everything tasted fresh and amazing but if I had to chose the best dish I would go with the shrimps and their amazing sauce. I should also mention the the BLT crab sandwich which was also out of this world. In some other comments I read people complaining about the portions but I cannot think of any other place in NYC where you can have such good quality at such a reasonable price. Yes they could make the crab rolls bigger and charge you ten dollars more for them but they seem to be too honest there to do that. After we finished our meal, one of the owner came and asked for our opinion and she seemed genuinely interested in what we had to say. What a refreshing attitude in the sometime "know-it-all" NY culinary scene. Overall, I only have good things to say about this place and I will be back again and again and tell as many friends about it as possible because this place deserves to be known and appreciated by everyone.

I loved my Crab BLT!  Such a fun and friendly place. Casual and great prices - Alaskan King Crab Leg platter for $21!  There're no waiters to tip. You order at the the counter and find a seat. When it's ready, pick it up and chow down. I loved the owners, Gwen and FeFe. A great place to hang out. Music was good too.

Sunday brunch is good;  the atmosphere is relaxed and parking is easy.  My biggest issue with Jesse's for dinner is the lack of parking.  You either have to arrive for happy hour, or have a 9:00 reservation in order to ensure you will have a place to park.  It's really sad, too, because it's a good restaurant.  Recently, we planned a family dinner at Jesse's, had 6:00 pm dinner reservations.  My sister and her husband arrived early for drinks and were able to park.  Myself and my parents (separately) drove around the parking lot several times unable to find a parking space before finally giving up and leaving.  It was extremely disappointing and frustrating.  Granted, it was a busy Friday night, but still, they should have ample parking.  They are not downtown where you have the option of parking further away and walking.  I will return for Sunday brunch, but unless they expand the parking, I won't take the chance of planning another dinner there.

If you are a vegetarian don't bother.  I order a veggie quesadilla for lunch. When I got back to my office, the quesadilla had cheese, rice and a few beans.  Interesting approach, lets sell a vegetarian quesadilla that has no vegetables and charge people the same as we would for a steak or chicken quesadilla.    Darios is a rip off and I will never return.  My only regret with this review is that I could not leave zero stars.
Cute place, but the macaroon I got the other day tasted like it had been sitting out for too long.  Sorta conjured up the taste of shredded gym shoe soles.

Humo is far tastier than nearby options (e.g. Smoke Joint) and is also cheaper. They have a spacious backyard and the staff are very attentive, even though it's technically a non-waitered venue (someone frequently came out to check on us, offer more--free--bread, etc.) Everyone who works at Humo is very friendly and generous with the portions. To top it all off, they're BYOB, making it even more affordable than it already is. Recommendations: PORK BELLY, baked beans.
Great atmosphere and best prices for seafood I've seen-and the seafood tastes fresh and was tasty! I loved my lobster roll abs my hubby loved his fish and chips.

Food was acceptable. I had the vegetable fried dumplings ($8), which had great skin and filling, so much that it tasted like a pork filling at times. But considering the portion size (4), it was pretty grossly overpriced. Not that I'm complaining. Main dish was zhajiangmian ($12). Honestly, good but nothing spectacular. Sauce was pretty heavy and a bit too watery. At the very least it was hot and fresh, which was appreciated. Ambiance was nice- they bill themselves as one of those chic 'Asian fusion' places, which seems to be an excuse to dress up food you'd find at infinitely cheaper prices in Flushing. If only it weren't so overpriced, I'd probably come again for the convenience.

I was visiting and asked a local resident a good breakfast spot and was referred here. I must say this place is awesome. The wheat apple walnut pancakes are to die for and to top it off they served turkey bacon. The restaurant is small and cozy. The pricing was also just right for breakfast. I highly recommend this spot if you're visiting the area.
Marlow & sons Great music Cute place Very nice waitress Plates were anonymous including the oysters Over priced Two Stars

Very good. During the summer you can usually get seated during weekend brunch pretty quickly as long as you're willing to sit inside. Their eggs Benedict are very good although somewhat small. I went for the beet and pear salad to start; my friend had a hummus dish. I loved the salad the dressing was unreal. We both followed with Orlin Burgers once again cooked to perfection (my perfection being very well done....don't scream at me foodies!) The service was swift and the staff attentive without being intrusive. Would definitely go back!
Not authentic indian food. The staff was polite and nice. 5 stars for them but 2 stars for the food.

This place has some of the best Greek food in New York City.  I'd have to say it's on par with Taverna Kyclades out in Astoria.  There are a few things that Taverna does better and a few things that Kefi does better. Amazing food. For the meze, I had the selection of spreads with pita (free refills on the pita, I believe). Really, really tasty. My favorite was the orange-y one, wish I could remember the name. Maybe the chickpeas spread? For an entree, I decided to try some seafood since my friend told me that Kefi definitely knows how to prepare their seafood. I went with the pan seared bass and whoa, this seriously melted in your mouth. I've never had a more perfectly pan seared bass sitting on such a pretty bed of string beans. Overall, the meal and service was outstanding considering the price point and neighborhood.  Greek comfort food at its near best.

Imagine a restaurant that uses fresh ingredients, not to heavy with the fat content, and cost about what a meal at McD would cost (minus the booze)...now imagine the food was actually good, now open your eyes...you are in Joya!
Overpriced and not as good as the place across the street from there. I won't be going back there.

We had the piggy sampler.  Burnt ends and pulled pork were very good.  The mac and cheese and baked beans were homemade delicious!  The slaw was good too, and I'm not always a fan of slaw if it's not done right, so that's saying something.  This was a great choice for good food, good portions.
Anchove pizza to die for, awesome mixed drinks and great wait staff. Perfect date spot.

I have been meaning to write a review of this really cool place since my boyfriend and I went for an early saturday evening dinner back on 5/3/14. We were fascinated as we watched it gradually fill up with a wonderfully eclectic mix of patrons of all ages: great Ambience! Service was perfect as was the food. We tried 2 different "toasts", "Duck Scrapple  Salad" and a Scallop Entree.  Fairly small but extremely interesting menu! Our wine was good and my "Witch's Sabbath" Cocktail was not inexpensive, but it was to die for!
Burrata was delicious, a little noisey but cute place with decent food.

I signed up for a Yelp account just to give Nixs 5 stars!  The pulled chicken tacos are the best that I've had in the Hartford region - absolutely delicious.  I'm from Texas, so I know good tacos!  The craft cocktails don't disappoint.  I also had the lobster roll and crab and lobster tater tots - everything was great.  The service was quick, friendly, and helpful.  Nixs - so glad you came to downtown Hartford!  See you again soon!

Food is great and reasonably priced. I usually pay $8 for pork carnitas tacos which are quite filling. The margaritas are EXCELLENT especially the Blood Orange ones. I would recommend going for lunch or during non-peak hours since this restaurant gets really busy and the wait is usually out the door on weekends. Great Mexican food favorite!

We had the specials and they were amazing. Great portions and their vodka sauce is extremely tasty! Get a "small" bottle of house wine. It's really damn good and they give you way too much. Really tight space thats loud and not good for groups but the service is excellent and will go back soon!
Wonderful! Easy user friendly and as always great food great restaurant and great service! i recommend the Yelp and the restaurant!

I ate dinner here while visiting family in NJ. The food is amazing! Everything is really fresh and delicious, from the salads to the desserts, you can't go wrong no matter what you order. Oh, and the portions are huge! By the time I left, I was stuffed but had  enough leftovers to take home for another full meal. I wish there was an Appian Way in Texas, where I live, I'd definitely be a frequent customer. The staff is also great, super nice and attentive. Peggy especially!

The place was amazing. The ambiance is so cute and the food was absolutely delicious. The waitresses are very nice and welcoming. and the food presentations were well done. I went on a Tuesday night and a good amount of people were there. I definitely recommend it for a date night or family dinner. I ordered pad Thai and I recommend the galangal soup or the papaya salad! I've been here twice and was left very satisfied! Definitely a great place.

Honestly this restaurant was one of the most unique experiences that I've had in Philadelphia not only was our waiter extremely nice and very knowledgeable of the customs of Morocco he was very respectful and allowed us to peruse to through the meal at our own speed. The food was exquisite and unique I loved the music the Decour was excellent and honestly I don't think I've ever had as authentic food as I had here at market

Food is great. I add their hot peppers to everything. Long hots never disappoint. Chop or Cobb salads are awesome. Blackened Chicken, Cowboy or Sirloin Steaks and wings are my choices. Seafood is always fresh (balsamic calamari, clams & hotsy totsy mussel appetizers). Best bartenders ever!! Managers and staff are always friendly and funny. I love it!

Best mimosas anywhere and an outstanding breakfast. We had the scrambled eggs with puff pastry and the corned beef with eggs. Excellent service. Time to get a table was 45 minutes, but we were glad we waited.

2nd time they mess up my order! I ordered a rice cup w/salmon, I got my cup of rice w/TWO, literally 2 small pieces of salmon!! Who orders that!?!? seriously!? & is that even in your menu!?!? You'd think that if there's a misunderstanding during the order process they'd ask for clarification, but no!  My 2 pieces of salmon were delicious! Thanks for an awesome dinner Silver Rice!

There is no worse place to watch football than here. They don't have the Sunday ticket. And when they do have you're game on, they play the sound from Red Zone. So you can't even listen to the only game playing in the bar. Plus management does not get back to you when you email them for an explanation. We work in fidi and stopped ordering all together.
LOVE the Coconut Curry Chicken. Try it, The staff is really friendly. Get off at China Town Station, Take Race Street to 9th and turn left, about half way down.

The service here is top-notch.  The guys who served us were awesome; super down to earth, reliable, friendly, and at our every request.  Among the best service I have ever gotten anywhere. Every dish we ordered was good - I have salad every day, and yet I found the arugula different and perfectly seasoned. The mixed seafood with lobster came in a huge portion and everything was delicious and flavorful. For dessert, we shared the family style strawberry shortcake which was more than enough to feed 6 of us, especially after a meal here. This place offers great value for large groups and I would definitely come back to try some of the other dishes! I would strongly recommend reservations. It was so nice to walk in and here, "come this way, your table is ready"

Once again Tony's made me look like a star.  I sent yet another freind and his family to "my favorite italian restuarant in all of NYC" and got rave reviews back.  Even a thank you card signed by the husband, wife and all the kids.. Ciro, Jimmy and Dreni, managers all,  were all on this night and they made a point of welcoming my friends. Their server Jordana, did a fantastic job, thanks sweetie... The report I got was the food, oh the food...they couldnt beleive how much, how good and how reasonable.  And they added the sangria (which they want the recipe for....) This is one of the absolute best places to send out of towners to when they are in need of a great place to eat.  Especially family style.  Just a wonderful restuarant, super managers and staff and oh the food, the food.....FANTASTIC.... Thanks all....Ron

I truly enjoyed my experience at BLVD Bistro... They offer a nice menu with fresh produce which produces a great combination. The owners are hands on, and will greet you at the door. More importantly, the owners have true Harlem roots, and they offer a menu which echoes the history of Harlem. Personally, the Mac & Cheese, shrimp & watermelon salad, Shrimp & grits, and the simple steak were great...
