Lastly, they never included a third of the order and said they'd drop off a refund (since I paid cash) but never did. Four days and two calls later, still no refund or apology. UPDATE: After my review was posted, the owner used yelp names Gary S. and Truth H. to give herself positive feedback.  They were also used to harass me and other yelp reviewers for our negative feedback.   Do you really want these people handling your food?
Delicious food -- their half chicken is tender with a really crispy skin and the tomato pie is savory with an awesome crust. The service is efficient and friendly.
Geno's "English-only" sign is ignorant and unwelcoming. The cheesesteak at Pat's (right across the street) tastes better anyway. Although I have to admit, neither Pat's or Geno's was amazingly good.

Sat upstairs at the rooftop bar to enjoy brunch with some friends. Such good food, the banana foster waffles were delicious. The bartender Anna was such a sweetheart and made some fantastic drinks. I would recommend the "London Iced Tea", so refreshing! Overall a fantastic experience and I will definitely be back!

I'm sorry, I just hate it when "popular" restaurants think they have the right to be rude. And stop using technology if you can't handle it. They supposedly have this system where you put your name on the list and they text you when the table is ready. We were told that the wait will be around 45 min and we went to run some errands. 25 min later I got the text that the table is ready and I should go see the hostess. So we hurry back, park our bikes and all that then was told that just kidding, they just texted everyone because the iPad died. Umm... You guys don't charge that iPad?? And also where is the sense in basically lying and not showing a bit of remorse. I wouldn't be making this much of a big deal if I was seated 15 min, 25 min, or even 30 min after that text. It has been ONE HOUR since we got that text. I'm typing this as I still wait outside.
Food is okay at most. Pretty pricey buffet too. You will wait to be Senate even though the place is empty.
Love Cuban Pete's! It's just kind of a pain to wait to be seated sometimes. Wish they had a dedicated area to wait.

You can get a rice platter, like chicken tikka masala, for $7. It comes with your choice of meat, with veggies and papadum on a bed of rice. You don't usually get that sort of value with Indian restaurants. It will not be the best Indian food you've ever tasted but it's a great quick Indian place.

Am I allowed to say what I ordered was a little too chocolaty? I ordered the blintz but there was just an overwhelming amount of chocolate that it was just like eating strait up chocolate. The other person I was with really enjoyed their meal though and the drinks were quite good as well. So I remain a bit neutral at the moment!

I really wanted this restaurant to work not only because of its location but now because of the demise of Delaney's. But unfortunately there are still major problems that have not been sorted out.  When requesting a Bloody Mary, I was told that they were all out of Bloody Mary mix; when ordering the trout dish, we were told they there was no more trout. All this was at 5:30 p.m.   If they want to serve dinners they need to have the products on the menu. Also, when ordering a salad that had avocado in it, the avocado was unripe, hard and tasteless.

Chinese takeout the way it outta be! Kung Po Chicken is well done here with generous amounts of vegetables as well as a light touch with the oil. The Lo Mein was similarly well prepared as were the requisite egg rolls, hot and sour soup, and Crispy Chicken. Please open a branch in Morristown soon!

Went to this place for brunch .... Had a mimosa and a kebab wrap. Mimosa tasted very funky and the food just tasted burnt. I didn't eat much of the wrap, no server came over to ask how the food was and even when they cleared my plate and saw that I hadn't eaten much of it they still didn't say anything. Will not be going back.

Awesome place for vegan and vedge-friendly food. Pan-fried vegetarian wontons and vegan spare ribs are killer. I'm a meat eater and can say that somehow they manage to get the texture exactly right for the fake seafood and meat.

Great place!  We went here after attending  the phillies baseball game (they won!). The CrabFries are perfectly seasoned and crispy and come with 2 cups of the awesome white cheese. The lobster sandwich was very good- a good amount of lobster and delicious bread.  Hamburgers were good too and medium rare was perfect.  Tons of screens to watch the games and a Deejay. We will definitely return.

I ordered the Salmon and Sweet Potatoes and a Milk Shake. I didn't like any of it. First the fries were soggy by the time it was delivered, the milkshake was just okay and I was expecting a lot from it, since that was what most people here talked about. The Salmon was cooked well, but it was under seasoned, not sure how it got 5 stars but it's not worthy of it.

Food was good, but service not. I usually like to come back or recommend these little shops but they were just unfriendly. Was sitting outside, order was taken, drinks came and next table also got their order. Then we were signaled to get our food. when I went in to get it and asked if this was it, pointing to one item of a few laying in the counter, I got the answer "yes, that's what ordered!" in an annoyed tone. I asked for plates. no we don't have any. I asked if she had anything else, so I can share with my friend and she pulled out a take away box. OK. works. but same time the man (shopowner?) said "you want it or not? if not we'll refund it" ahem... wait a minute I just asked for something to put it in. so I asked how much is it anyway? and got the answer "you want it or not?" from the woman. I just wanted to know the price! am I not allowed to ask? it was already made and we wanted to try it, so I took it. BUT coming back here? no way. they really made me feel uncomfortable being a customer, as if I was disturbing them. why open a shop in a service industry then if you don't want to deal with people. NOT COOL.
Nice neighbourhood restaurant, decent food!

We've been to Bleu a few times now and every time it's been an awesome experience. The staff and owner are extremely friendly and the service is excellent. The fish is the freshest and most tender I've had in the city. The BYOB option really makes the place great and they are happy to provide you with glasses and an opener for any drinks you bring. The ambiance is perfect for any occasion. It's not too dark or too light and the decor/lighting/paint scheme really complements the food and service. This place is great to bring friends. Prices aren't mind-blowing, but they aren't unnecessarily expensive. The fish is high quality and would typically be priced much higher for what you get. The owner has a clear vision of providing guests with high quality sushi at fair prices. Overall, this place is awesome all around and the staff (though some newer than other since the place is relatively new) make your stay much more welcoming.
Really good Mexican food that is also reasonable! The service is good but could be better.

Not exactly clear why gluten free costs more?! Gluten free dough is only so-so, but, more importantly I wish they made it more affordable. That said, it's a viable option for Italian food that everyone can digest!

I went all out of my way to go this location and try these burgers.  I even purchased a Groupon to purchase $20.  First and foremost the service is LESS than good.. outside of the nice young lady at the register, everyone else looks like they hate being at work and conduct themselves less than in a professional manner.  The cook seems disorderly, the assistant even worse. I ordered the Cuban Sandwich, the Chili Cheese Dog, a Oreo Cookie Shake, Sweet Potatoes Fries and a Brownie for $20.59 which means with the Groupon purchased I only had a balance of $059 BUT they charged $3.00 EXTRA and Claimed it was Taxes, when it was obvious Taxes were already charged and simply came up after I provided the Groupon.  If you are going to do a marketing campaign DO NOT RIP THE CUSTOMERS OFF. Secondly.  The FOOD was HORRIBLE.. the Pork was dry, the bread soaked and the potatoes fries were mush.  Outside of the Oreo Cookie Shake and Brownie which aren't made on site.. the food is NOT WORTH THE MONEY.  And they are EXPENSIVE as hell! I DO NOT recommend this establishment unless you intend to throw away the food.

This place is so great!  I have been living a block away from it for over a year and never went in. I decided to one night about a month ago and I've gone back three times since! The bubble teas are perfect and the food is great too! There is jenga at every table which is cool. The service is great too. I recommend that you try it!
Umm fantastic place that yelp did not even mention... If you are in Chelsea NYC GO HERE... Drinks bar great atmosphere... Enjoy :)
Great labneh, fatouse, and pita. I like having Bliss in the same building. Sometimes slow.
coffee was ok; chai latte was horrible; service was extremely slow; the place does look great though; plenty of better options in the area i'd rather go to
Loved the tuna dumplings and the Sansom roll! Will be back for more!! :D
All I've got to say is one word,  lezzetli.

This is the best restaurant in New York. The drinks, the food, the service. This place is unbelievable... Vegetarian, vegan, meat eaters, they have everything. Charles, our waiter explained everything on the menu.. And we loved him. The food is so good and so creative. Coming here every business trip.... Sending everyone we know . Smitten, Newburyport Ma

Great value for really great taste. Imagine reviewing the food from a push cart. My opinion is that you can't go wrong for the price. Grilled chicken with drunken noodles is a must try dish. You'll love it.

September 2014 update: Downgrade from 3 stars to 1 star,, This place as gone straight downhill in 4 years.   I will leave it at that.  So I stopped by on a Sunday in September as I was in the area heading back from my yearly bike trip to VT... I decided to give this place another shot, since I was craving BBQ, and I came here 4 years ago, and the BBQ was half decent. I walk in during the Pats game, order a beer, and ask for a menu.  I am told the only food they are serving are chicken wings, no BBQ.   But they just ran out of wings.. It will be about a 45 minute wait for the next batch.  Ok, I am not Gordon Ramsey, but since when does it take 45 minutes for buffalo wings to cook?  I look around, and there are a total of 8 people in the bar.  Ok, 8 people in the bar, wings special during the Pats game, 1st quarter, and no food?  This is NOT a good sign! If I didn't just order a beer, I would have walked out.  The bartender was friendly, and I would have felt bad.  I drank my beer and left.  I am not sure how she keeps smiling working at this dump.  It surely costs her money she could have made in tips. I check the website, and it makes no mention of just wings being served on Sundays.  This will be my last stop here -- ever.  Obvious sign of lack of management, or not caring about their business.
Love Reading Terminal - suggest everyone try this place!
the place we go with friends a lot and you know every time you go, you will have a great  meal and great service .Gyoza is fantastic and Noodles. tacos are super good its a must try.

In Hartford for a conference and ran a cross this place on a Sunday evening.  I eat a fair amount of Thai food, and am familiar with typical American Thai.  I wanted something simple, so I ordered the coconut fried rice, and was not disappointed.  It tasted fresh and light.  The veggies (peas, carrots, onions) were not over cooked or dry, and the rice was not heavy as sometimes Americanized fried rice is.  The shrimp was small but tasted fresh.  I ordered medium spicy but it was very mild.   Service was fast and accommodating, but there were only 5 or 6 customers.  Price was very reasonable for the amount and quality of the food
Went there during lunch break w my gf. We had the Oyster special for 99 cent each. Was a really good deal. Can recommend it to everyone.
Visited here about a month ago and the food was delicious! My favorite Chinese food place in Philadelphia easily! Very friendly service and modern atmosphere.

Place is not clean. hardly anyone speaks English. They have good steamed dumplings Shanghai style but the rest of the food is below average. Fish ordered came out with a sweet sauce that was not edible. Seafood is below average. Sauces are not very good, but have no taste. Only thing that was above average were the steamed dumplings, very hot, so take your time in eating. Not good decoration, and restrooms are unclean like the flatware.

Honestly so glad to see a new place in New Haven that finally gets Mediterranean food right. Amazing high-quality food. It's newly opened, so the owners Khaled and his son Gassar have been working extremely hard to keep the prices as low as they are. Unbelievable value (unlimited topping bar, Huge portions, great taste) for what you're paying. The pita bread is a must-have - I learnt that they spent weeks trying to hunt down the perfect pita, and these ones are imported from New York. It's got the perfect balance of softness and chewiness, its warm and delicate, and definitely won't break, even with all the unlimited toppings inside! The baba ganoush is so rich and tasty, it goes perfectly with the super flavorful grilled chicken rice bowl. Surprisingly clean and comfortable. Definitely much better experience than some of the other fast food places around. The staff are impressively friendly and helpful. Plus the bright, open, sunlit space and fresh green walls makes it so welcoming, it really puts you in a better mood - which is so important when you're enjoying food!   The late hours on weekends are great too, making this place a perfect late-night pizza stop. They have really cool mediterranean-style pizzas with exciting toppings. Overall, love the food! Will be coming here very very regularly!

Not that impressed.I thought it was overpriced for what it is and the bartenders have attitude.Beers were good and the food was ok.I've tried it twice and both time left feeling like its not a neighborhood bar, they want to be in Williamburg but their not.

What a lovely find in the financial district area. I was brought here by my roommate to find not only great food, cheap beer but also a wonderful host in Jeff. Come for the food, but definitely stay for the atmosphere and the people you meet a the wonderful fishmarket restaurant!
this place has no clue how to be ran..i came in here to get lunch and there were people standing all over the place and i had no clue where to order so i got out of that dump

I'll give this place one star because the Pupusas were DELICIOUS! Tacos were great too but the service is GARBAGE! and that's me being nice about it. Both waitresses had a bad attitude and seemed like they hated their job. I was there for my sisters birthday and apart from taking our order and giving us the food our table was not visited ONCE. Not once did we get checked on or asked if we wanted refills. After asking for the bill we waited an additional 20 minutes to receive it. Mind you she practically threw the bill at us. If you want some great food definately visit this place but don't expect any hint of good service. (Ps. I've been here about 3 times in the last 6 months and all 3 times the service was bad) 3 strikes and you're out!

The #1 spot I go for all-you-can-eat sashimi!! The sea-weed salad and teriyaki squid is SO good... definitely start it off with that. I rarely eat sushi when I'm here because I chow down on sashimi. Don't get me wrong the sushi is slamming too but not a lot of places have all-you-can-eat sashimi so I make my visit worth it. The red bean ice cream is good and I usually end my meal with it mixed with vanilla ice cream.
I continue to HATE this place. Worst service of all time!!!  Newark airport.....PLEASE do something with this!!!!!!

I now live in California and miss this place terribly! Do yourself a favor and stop by when your in the area, there's not an item on their menu I wouldn't kill for! So do me a favor and eat up! PS- To the owners.. Please start a franchise and bring it to San Francisco!

I've been coming here for years! The deli has the best sandwiches around! The bakery has made several cakes for our family's special occasions and they are always amazing! They can create just about any design you have in mind. I highly recommend Pierre's Deli and Bakery.

Not good AT ALL u might as well go to Mighty Quinn's ... I would of put  0 stars but couldn't...  We ordered the short ribs they were VERY dry and chewy (I flossed my teeth and I think I still have meat stuck between them) mac and cheese was like the potato chips "Cheetos" yup dry also, not creamy at all, reminded me of the Kraft mac n cheese in a box, also some cold brisket no flavor, ummm collard greens what a disappointment it needed FLAVOR which was lacking for all of the food... Would I ever come here again ? No... I'm just mad I read all of these reviews praising this place and the food was horrible... Is pricey for no reason and  I thought to myself maybe I went on a bad day but how could have I ? I went on a Tuesday and they're closed on Mondays which means that there food should be fresh out of the smoker... I really feel like a lot of these people got paid to write a good review... (Even when u walk in and see the people eating they're chewing with their mouths open because the meat is so hard and chewy)... Either that or some people are lacking taste buds... Then to make matters worse they microwaved the food before putting the food inside the bag... After I saw that I felt disgusted and didn't even have an appetite to even eat and it explained why everything was dry and chewy... Why did I feel disgusted??? Because then I wondered how long the food had  been sitting there uncovered... And if it was food from over the weekend ughhh...Waste your money elsewhere.

Buckle up, it's going to be a bit lengthy. I "found" Hinge in '04 or '05 (just after it opened) when I was working on a property I purchased a few blocks away.  It got to be lunch time so being from "the counties" I decided to stroll around to see where I could get some food.  I come across a corner store that has busy windows but a sign over the door saying "Hinge".  Immediately I am excited to find an "old school" hardware store where the help actually knows how to fix stuff. I wander in and there is a Bakery case with pastries and pies directly in front of me and an employee (the owner) (Simone) is standing behind the case.  Being somewhat dumbfounded at where did my hardware store go I stood for a moment and just stared.  Simone asked if she could help me and me being a jokester asked "do you know where I can get some good food in this neighborhood?" Looking exasperated she asked what was wrong with here and I replied since the only signage said Hinge I thought it was a hardware store.  She then asked "are you always a pain in the ass" and I replied that "I practiced every chance I got" (to this day she asks how the "pain in the ass" is doing whenever I'm there) From that beginning I can honestly say I've been there probably 100 times since, living 45 minutes away (without traffic) THAT says something. Service is always excellent, portions are large.  I have tried many of their menu items but being a "fat old guy" I usually revert to the basics.   My favorite breakfast is simply the best western omelet I have EVER had (yes the potatoes are AMAZING) For non-breakfast the chicken Parm and crab cakes are to die for, and don't be afraid to try the Chicken parm soup! Staff, Ambiance, Food all deserving of the 5-Star rating.
Every time I'm in Brooklyn I have to stop here for a brat on a pretzel bun, with fries and I pick out a beer from an array on tap unmatched in your average bar. Great fun and food.

Some restaurants you walk out very pleased and some you walk out cheated and disappointed.  This one definitely fit in the latter category. The portion was nothing more than that of tapas with full dinner price and the taste was sub-par at best.  After 4 dishes, we still wondered what we ate yet didn't want to order anymore since we knew exactly what we were going to get.  The restaurant seemed trying to be chic and modern, but in our opinion the quality of food and presentation fell much short of it for the price you pay.  Most of the dish we ordered was salty and the taste was mediocre or below average.  And one of the desert called white bun costing $9 is what you can find for 50 cents in Asian market.  It was a joke looking at the way it was presented - a single tiny bun like a small dot on a dish.  It was a good learning experience where NOT to go ;)
Fantastic restaurant! Friendly staff and the food was out of this world amazing! Can't wait to go again. They are also great for parties!

Sit at the sushi bar and go for the omakase. Very reasonably priced and unlike Masa, the chef will actually select pieces based on what you tell him you like/dislike. It's a quiet restaurant and not particularly trendy, but if you're looking for excellent sushi, this is one of your best options.

4.5 stars!  We stumbled in on the first official day!  Glad we did.  The food is homey with a twist.  Had fried green tomato BLT with fries for $8- a deal in my book.  Bloody Mary gets an A (a grade I don't give lightly) and with cheddar stuffed olives it had extra pizzazz.  It is definitely worth a stop!
Burgers are good, not great. Was not impressed by fries. I have not had any problems with the service. But would rather BYO and go to Sketch.

Awesome place for a family dinner! I got the Mac n cheese and the fried pickles for the 5 of us to share -- more than enough for everyone! I had the chicken Caesar salad topped with fried chicken and it was delicious. The menu has a southern style to it so almost everything on it has fried chicken (hopefully that's what you're looking for!). For desert, I strongly recommend the bread pudding to share. It's massive and it tastes like heaven.
Shortest review ever: simply the best, nothing compares, will wait 25 minutes for a slice if that's what it takes.

The food was ok. I was thinking this was more of a sports bar but it is truly focused on off track betting. They had a nice bar, a good selection of beers on tap and a pretty cool setting but overall, the off track betting atmosphere is not really my speed.

Very clean & cool interior with a surprisingly wide selection of food. Went there today with two friends and caught up while sitting on a couch in the back drinking coffee, eating muffins & sandwiches while listening to what was I believe Cuban music. Except for a surge of people at about 10:15am which swamped the place, it was not overly crowded for the 90 minutes we were there and maintained a nice, comfortable atmosphere. Counter staff was also very helpful and friendly!
The food here is great. The service is outstanding as well.

I was totally surprized about the good service and quality of this Indian Restaurant. We came for dinner at 7pm and were nicely seated. There it's usual to choose 4 different courses (i took an avocado-mango salad as an appetizer, a coconut-mango soup with fish as another appetizer, the lamb ragout with rice and naan and a rice dessert). The portions are really big and you just pay 35 dollars for 4 courses. The ambience is great and kinda romantic and the waiters are more than polite and friendly. In other words, i like this restaurant

Fun neighborhood restaurant with great food and service. Love sitting outside in the summer to people watch.  The oysters are heavenly. Salads are so fresh and tasty. Unbelievable burgers. The paprika chicken and pork chops are my favorites. Comfort food at its best.  Yum!

I must be pretty spoiled by the high-quality pizza in my life because this place was nowhere close to five stars. I mean, it was decent - but I can't see much that separated it from Pizza Hut, to be perfectly honest. The cheese had that thick, overly chewy texture, the crust was greasy and not like a nice fluffy dough, the broccoli seemed like it was frozen, and there just wasn't anything special about the place.  I mean, how about offering some decent beers?! I guess if you haven't had a lot of good pizza before then a place like this must seem like a treat. That or we've got a severe case of group think going on here...sorry George.

This place is terrible!!  I can confirm how terrible it is after 2 deliveries. I'm posting a picture of the pizza I recently had delivered that had all the cheese flipped off the pie and sitting on one end of the box.   DO NOT BUY FROM THIS PLACE.

This place was highly recommended. We went in on a Sunday afternoon and the place was nearky deserted. The food was subpar and the service bad. Our waiter talked back when we were just poibting out that a plate was missing.

We found a Tapas coupon on groupon and stumbled across this place We walk in and instantly impressed with the decor. But we could not wait to leave Following are our experiences Chairs not comfortable Food took forever to get to table. Service provided to bigger groups rather than smaller ones Food was not tasty , Yukon potatoes is not a prepared dish . They were boiled and served straight out of water Worst sangria we ever had absolutely flavorless We would not recommend this place unless they improve on above things

Felt very unwelcome. Would give a no star if i could. This place would treat you according to racial differences. If you are white, they would pay more attention to you, but if you're spanish and asian or black then they would treat you as if you're dirt or non humans. Because this place is extremely racist. Especially the manager and the fake ass ugly waitresses. kept rolling her eyes everytime she passes by our table.

Fine. Overpriced and overhyped. Not the best pork bun I've ever had and the ramen, in my opinion, was utterly disappointing. The noodles were either overworked or undercooked. Wouldn't come back. Also over priced.

The food is upscale and very good.  The night we were there the noise level, including the music that kept getting louder and louder was so thunderously loud that I felt like my hearing was damaged.  Maybe all the 20-somethings there don't care, but i like to actually talk to my companions.  Also, the wine list is not only very small, but ignorant of what pairs well with Indian food.  Not a single Reisling or Gewürztraminer on the list.  Bizarre.   The food is better than 3 stars, but the noise level was so unpleasant and somehow at odds aesthetically with "upscale Indian" that I'm down-rating it.  I will never go back there unless management decides it wants customers over 30.

It is a toss up between Grimaldi's and Juliano's a couple of shops down,personally my preference is Juliano's, especially with the entire story about Patsy Grimaldi taking a stand but both of them are pretty good. Grimaldi's seems to be the more iconic choice though hence the bigger lines outside it. Best is to get the pizza and go sit at the pier to have it.
Okay coffee, okay snackies, lay-out questionable with serious constriction right in the middle of the space between counter and the wall, and really, really SLOW wifi.
I had the shrimp + jalapenio grits; was okay but the shrimps were overcooked. Was there for a large party, average meal. For this price point there are many other great restaurants in the city.
Who doesn't love pat's !!! I"m a big fan of Steve's Steaks too. But Pat's is a classic!
I love the Dos Equis beer! Great spot for snack food too

Stopped in before going to see 'Chicago'.with my husband...bad idea. I am shocked this place has such glowibg reviews based on my experience. Everything started fine. The waitress took our drink orders, but then we didn't see her...for quite some time. The tables were full but this is a small place and she seemed completely flustered. When she did come back the vodka tonics we ordered were actually vodka sodas. We were actually willing to drink them, but they tasted so bad we could not. We wanted to send them back,  but again our waitress went MIA. I actually had to get up and take them to the bar to swap them out because she had not stopped by in so long. We just swapped them out for glasses of wine...safer. By this time our food had come..but we couldn't eat it as we had no silverware. I got up again and just as I did she brought it out...except she only brought one set. So I was stick without anything until she came back. I ordered the Giramonte and my boyfriend ordered the chicken florentina.  Both very (VERY) sub par. The potatoes that came with my husbands meal were more like breakfast potatoes.  It was odd. The chicken was just "okay". The pasta I had had shrimp and scallops and they were less than fresh. Not to mention some shrrimp were deveined and some not. Deveined or not there should be consistency.  I actually avoided the seafood on the plate as much as I could the dish also lacked seasoning. We were STARVING so we ate as much as we could and just made verbal plans to stop somewhere else and grab a slice on the way home after the play so we would be satisfied. We were trying to get to our show and again the waitress went MIA. My husband had to get up and find her and let her know we needed to leave. He just gave her our card at that time because we couldn't risk her disappearing again. I should mention that the waitress apologized for all the "infractions" and gave us 10% off our bill...but since the food here is egregiously overpriced for what you get...it mattered little. Never again.
Really bad. Even for a cheap Chinese food restaurant, I expect the food not to taste slimy. This would be a good hangout spot for high school kids with low money and lower standards.

This restaurant has disappointed me today. From the service to the quantity to price of the food,  this restaurant is pretty mediocre. The food took forty minutes to come out and did not even come out in a complete set so we had to wait and our food got cold.

Cheese fries were soggy and rubbery. Looked like they deep fried the French fries 2 hours before they melted cheap American cheese on them in the microwave. Straight nasty. Pizza was cold when it arrived and wings were not very meaty. I will not get take out from here again.
Very very good! Great food, great people, great service!! Did I mention awesome pasta!! People please get the pasta!

Love the kale salad, wait staff, and that they off organic chicken and beef. I wish the fish was wild instead of farm raised. It can get crowded for brunch, but they have outside seating, which means more food outside. Love.

This place has the best burgers. I always order the Breakroom room burger with pork belly and jalapenos with there break room fries. Deleiveries usually takr about 30 min to have it deliver just a fre blocks aeay. Guess there always pack. Must try there mint lemonade as well. My 7 yr old luvs this place.
I ordered the chicken Lo Mein and the scallion pancakes. I have no complaints or had any problems and I will be ordering again from this place.
The store advertises that they open at noon on Sundays.  I was there at 12:15 and not a soul was in the store.  The lights were off and the door was locked.

Underwhelmed by the supposedly famous chicken. Poorly seasoned and bland taste. Nevertheless, my sister and I got food poisoned. I called the restaurant about this but the hostess seemed indifferent and simply told me to feel better and then hung up on me. Regardless, the quality of the food was meh and don't recommend this place. There are much better alternatives if you want tasty fried chicken. The one star here is for the decent cauliflower salad. Stay away otherwise!

This stop over was well worth the wait. We ate so much that we needed the walk back to Independence Park to help us digest it all. The steamed pork soup dumplings were a delicious surprise. I understood then why they were wearing t shirts with a dumpling on a soup spoon. Other items were quite flavorful as well. They did not have any roast pork or duck; but that was ok since there was plenty of items to choose from. We had the shanghai crispy noodles and shanghai minced pork. If you can't tell, we were really hungry! Good traditional food that specializes in dumplings. Good variety and service too. Close to Reading market and 10 min walk from 8th at staton.

Excellent food and drinks. Friendly environment. A range of novel martinis which were very tasty. The passion fruit jalapeño was a superb blend of sweet and spice. I highly recommend the tostons and empanadas as starters.   Definitely going back soon.

Just great!  It's our second time in two weeks.  Went last Saturday night to check it out and the food was absolutely great.  Decided go go again today for brunch and it was perfect.  The arepas, scrambled eggs, eggs benedict, etc.  looked and tasted delicious.  So fresh and yummy.  It was a beautiful day to sit outside on their nice patio.  You could catch a glimpse of the water down one of the side streets.  The staff is welcoming, the chef is a hoot.  We'll be back.

Hubby took me there for our anniversary dinner a few months ago. We had an amazing meal, staff was wonderful and attentive, even the chef came out to chat with us.  As you walk in, on the first room is The Apple room, it such a nice way to be greeted into a place with aroma of apples.  We were seated promptly. We decided to get the tasting menu. Can't comment on the drinks, we did not get any other beverages. Everything was explained to us very well. The amount of food was good, not like other fancy places where you leave hungry.  Service was amazing, not overbearing. Would definitely recommend this place for special occasion/celebration.

Good food, nice bar and friendly service. We were so hungry that we found this restaurant by chance. They have a bar and provide loads of options for breakfast meals. We came for lunch and the options here are way smaller. They actually offer only three meals besides different salads. But i have to say that the food is nevertheless fantastic!

Wow. I was completely blown away by each and every dish that our table had - which was more or less the entire menu. A craftsman's take on classic Argentine favorites, there is something for everyone on this menu. Exceptional creativity. The sweetbreads, octopus and empanadas (humitas) were standouts. The Balvanera team has done an amazing job turning the old Azul Bistro into a heavyweight contender.

Due to the many positive recommendations on yelp, i had much higher expecations. But actually the food was just okay. Not great but just okay. I had the famous noodles with pork soy sauce and it looked like spaghetti bolognese. My noodle soup with beef was also okay. I dont like the fat on the beef. But in the end you only pay about 5-7dollar each portion and one portion is big enough.

One of the Worst service experiences from the chef at the counter, while we sat DIRECTLY in front of him. We ordered the grilled yam towards the end of the meal, and it was given to the table next to us...which is understandable that an order mistake happens. But when the waiter told the chef, he continued to sit there for 10 mins not making a 2nd yam for us, while we sat there waiting for this, our last food item. Then the chef makes the yam and gives it to ANOTHER table next to us, who also said they didn't order it. This all happens within 5 feet of us since we're ALL sitting at the counter together. The waiter tries to tell the chef of the mistake again and the chef shoos him away. I don't know why the chef was deliberately snubbing us. We're not amateurs to fancy Japanese restaurants, we were just a quiet couple eating dinner and didn't do anything rude or disrespectful. On top of this, the appetizers we ordered from the kitchen didn't show up until the end of the meal (1.5 hours in)...so ridiculous. Absolutely AWFUL dining experience, there are too many other nice Japanese grill places in the city to have to put up with this snobbiness!

My husband and I had a superb meal here. The plata primi of spaghetti with house  made Italian sausage and a light pecorino cream sauce with fresh black pepper was flavorful and melted in our mouths. For the main plate I had the smoked brisket with peaches and radicchio slaw that was very tender and had a wonderful sweet and smokey taste.  My husband had spit roasted pork that was tender , moist and gently seasoned with rosemary.  It was served with oven roasted potatoes and crunchy, crispy roasted pork skin. The homemade pistachio and lemon verbena  gelato was a perfect ending to a fabulous dining experience. Vincent was our waiter and provided great descriptions of the menu items to help us make our choices.  The restaurant decor is comfortably wine- country chic, impeccably clean and staff worked flawlessly as a  team providing us with first class and kind service. We highly recommend Osteria!

I have been here for 1h and 25 min and still did not get my pizza. We ordered an appetizer that took 45 min to come and came cold. There are not many tables eating dinner here and 1h and 25min later they are still not bringing it...for being a Brooklyn place it sucks. The neighborhood is known for good food experiences and this is obviously the exception. Never coming back, go to Luzzos ( right next door)

We ate here before Tom Petty show.  Service was very good and the water glass never sat waiting for a refill.  We each had a Gem Salad to start.  The salads were delicious with a perfect balance of lettuce, fresh radish, crisp bacon, and hard boiled eggs and the Russian dressing had the right zip.  A warm roll with butter after the salads while we enjoyed lemon-tinis.  Our meals arrived hot from the kitchen.  He had the strip steak with mushrooms and it was accurately cooked to a medium and tender.  I had the rigatoni bolognese and it was luscious with the tender shreds of meat in a rich tomato sauce with heavy dollop of ricotta.  Heavenly!  To finish he went with the carrot cake with pineapple sorbet and walnut strudel.  This is no exaggeration:  I had to chide him to keep him from licking the plate after he had scraped it clean with the spoon.  I had the chocolate cream pie and it was so large a serving I only made a dent in 1/4 of it.  The chocolate was velvety, and the graham cracker crust was crumbled over the top of the chocolate like sprinkles and the whipped cream was delicate and fresh.  The service remained consistent and prompt, we relaxed and enjoyed our meal fully.  We have been to DISH multiple times and have had the same consistent experience each time we've gone which is also lovely.

I've only ever gone to Formosa for the all-you-can-eat special. The sushi is the best around and they have great appetizers. It's a bit pricey so I usually make it a special occasion to go but it's more than worth what you get.

I'm sure this place doesn't need my review, but what the heck.  Here goes... I was told by several people that I needed to choose between either Pat's or Geno's when visiting Philadelphia.  By sheer chance, I ended up going to Geno's.  After all the hype, I was really expecting an amazing cheese steak sandwich.  In actuality, I thought the sandwich was just alright.  I was good, don't get me wrong; but I was expecting a mindblowingly tasty experience of orgasmic proportions based on everything that was told to me.  The meat was kind of bland and dry and the overall sandwich was kind of flat.  Again, nothing special about it at all. Truth be told, I think I've had a better cheese steak sandwich in Denver of all places.  There's a place off of Broadway that I still remember as being pretty amazing to this day after having visited years ago.  But who knows, maybe I was just exceptionally hungry when I tried that place.

Loved the scenery and the views. It was a rainy night and still looked beautiful. The fish was amaze. The waitress didn't really know much and brought us the wrong crabs but still was good. Recommended!
I reached there at 2:00 pm. Waiting for 15minutes because I just need one seat. Very very good food!

I was a visitor on 9/12 looking for some good Philly Cheese Steaks, and came to here hoping for the best. The food overall was good (4/5 stars), but I'm giving 1 star because of the cashier whose rudeness and insensitivity towards me, my girlfriend, AND her coworkers, has ruined my experience. To give you a better idea, look at Joe C's review and Jason P's first picture - you will see the picture of the cashier I am talking about. Without naming the cashier, I will proceed to tell you what happened - she was very impatient and became irritated when I said I wanted the same order my girlfriend ordered. Upon realizing that she noticed I was upset with her unacceptable attitude, she then tries to rescue herself by saying my name was unique and cool. But no, that did not work unfortunately... it only led me to feel insulted. Afterwards, she ranged me up and threw the receipt in my direction expecting me to catch it, but fell to the ground. She said something along the lines "Looks like we're not working okay today, haha". She did not apologize. While I normally brush off experiences like this, what especially disturbed me was the damaged morale of her employees. I noticed she would give them a hard time. Again, Look at Joe C's review and Jason P's first picture to see the cashier I'm talking about. Please brace yourself for the incredible rudeness if you do encounter the same person. Good luck. **Management, please do not hesitate to contact me for more information regarding this transaction and incident, I'll be happy to provide more info. I will adjust my review accordingly. Thank you.
Fantastic healthy food. A great edition to midtown and there aren't many restaurants that will deliver healthy food.

Awesome food but such a long wait ! Coffee is awesome and so is brunch !! I like the staff to they are pretty down to earth. If you really can't find a seat try and sit by the bar. U night get lucky and be able to sit quicker that way.

I only had a cappuccino here, but it was made deliciously by a sweet, cute French man. The service was amazing! He went out of his way to give us suggestions on what to do around the area. The decor was like sitting in a fabulous Pinterest ad. My only regret is that I did not get to try their food. Saving it for my next trip to New York!

This is a great family place. Their pancakes are the best I've ever eaten. They have a delicious Belgian waffle as well. If you want lunch, I recommend their French Onion soup as well as their tuna melt. I've tried plenty in their menu and have never been disappointed. The staff is very nice and welcoming. My family and I go there often and highly recommend them.
10 Stars. Absolutely amazing. A place to come back. All menu items were exceptional. Very knowledgeable personal, and warming. I strongly recommend you to visit this place.

Dined here last Friday around midnight.  Very atmospheric.  All the dishes we tried were very tasty (steak au poivre, onion soup, moule frites).  Service was particularly expert, not pushy but solicitous. Highly recommend this New York institution!

One of my go to spots in soho. The seafood tower is fresh and can easily serve your hungry friends prior to a night out. For those of you still impressed with a famous face, yup still there, hi! Bread is delish be careful or you'll eat the tables portion!! Loud, tables close who cares it is NYC enjoy!!

Never been to this place but I am at work and called today at 9 am to find out what time they are closing. The guy that answer the phone started to yell over the phone that he just opened up and I am asking what time he is closing!!! Buddy I don't give a rats ass what time you open.....I need to know if I can make it there after work!!!  You sounded very arrogant to a potential new customer. Now I prefer to give my business to another vendor.

I am 100 % dominican and i can truly say the food from here taste straight out of my mothers/grandmothers kitchen !! I've  been to many Dominican restaurants and i can honestly say this one is by far the best i had. The prices are really good too . Very reasonable . I will defitnetly come back here to eat. The service was truly awesome , the waiter a tho was new he knew the menu and made great suggestions .. The Empanadas were to die for !!! Delicious . I love the feel of the place , the old rustic look is pretty dope. Makes me feel like i was having dinner back in my mother land ..
Heavenly daily specials as long as they last--don't miss the Sunday night meatballs, which are out of this world!

Great food, nice ambiance and setting. Had the claypot rice which was delicious must recommend and the pineapple fried rice was okay, but the chicken satay really took it off with the peanut sauce that comes with it.
No good / bad Chinese food and people who work here at rude nasty. I got a coupon which they refused to take. I will never go back to this place
Overrated. Tiny portions, bland food, mediocre service.

I have no idea how this restaurant got so many stars. Small portions, bland sauces. Three pasta dishes, all on the small side. Flavorless, Way overpriced. The bill was close to $100 for three dishes and the $24 bottle of house wine. Rip off. They probably paid three dollars for the bottle. Stay away.

The burgers were tremendous and the simplicity excelled. We had the pleasure of sitting at the counter seats and enjoyed conversation with Johnny K, Paulie "Bag of Donuts" and his son Jake Brake.   these three were constantly tending to the crowd on this wonderful Saturday afternoon; however, continued to share wonderful stories and antidotes with us as well.   Sure we traveled from Boston for a burger...but it was well worth the trek. Next time we'll know to order our burgers "T&B" Dana was offered a slice of the homemade Coconut Creme Pie, which she devoured! We give strong suggestions to anyone considering a drive (short or long) to enjoy a super experience at Louis' Lunch!

This place is amazing. I only recieved takeout, but the nachos, wings, and tacos we ordered were awesome, and the sog-factor was only very minor. Delivery was less than piping hot, but flavor made up for it. I recommend the fried chicken taco and the nachos especially!

Day By Day did the most amazing job catering our rather difficult wedding. From having to move 100 people into our reception hall due to rain, to dealing with a broken oven and a missing table, Day by Day managed to deliver, to quote more than one guest, "The Best Wedding Food I've EVER Had". The catering manager Stephen and his entire staff was helpful, kind, supportive, and generous throughout the entire wedding process. We had a fabulous, smooth, successful, well-fed wedding and I maintain we never would have done it all without Day By Day. Thank you all!!!
This place is awesome. yum food, great service. Highly recommend. Get the calamari! and buffalo chicken wraps :)

So my friend and I met up for lunch, it's been months since we seen each other so we were def looking forward to having a nice lunch. We got here and all was well. The waiter was very nice and we placed our order. He ordered a a meal which came with soup salad and I ordered sushi With a seaweed salad. Well his soup and stuff comes and I'm waiting for my seaweed salad for maybe 10 mins or a little more and nothing... Then I asked about it and at that point he states that there's a problem with that since I didn't want sesame seeds and the way it's already made that they are mixed in, so I said no big deal I'll take it.. Well I'm waiting at least 5 mins and nothing, so at that point I just told them I no longer want it. I just don't see how you can wait 10 mins to tell someone their was a problem with their order?!! He was busy on the phone and talking to the lady up front instead of talking to me and telling me there was a problem! Like it just doesn't make sense! This is my 2nd visit, the first wasn't too great either but I'm a believer in 2nd chances but clearly this place hasn't changed one bit, the only change I've seen is that their prices have gone sky high! Just a lil tip, if your looking for a great sushi place, take the time and head into Hoboken! It'll be well worth the car ride or train ride!

My friends recently had brunch at Cafeteria and it was a hi-light on our recent trip to NYC! We decided to forego the wait and sit at the bar, which turned out to be part of the excellent experience we enjoyed!  The beautiful Asian bartender was so sweet and made us some amazing, tasty drinks! Best bloody mary's, blood orange sangria and wild berry mojitos!! We thoroughly enjoyed our food (we had omelets, which were delicious and so fluffy!) and because one of the meals was made incorrectly we were quickly greeted by the manager, TJ, who was so nice and and brought us a complementary dessert. Needless to say we will definitely be returning to Cafeteria on our next trip to New York City!! Honorable mentions...Mr. Cervantes and Mr. Mendoza were so sweet and extended some great service as well!

Very, very crowded.  We literally could not move our chairs without hitting other guests.  The service was ok, but servers were clearly more attentive to larger parties.  Servers didn't bring us some of the items we ordered (though we weren't charged).  Could be that service is falling due to the busy-ness.  Victims of their own success.  The food was also just OK, not the best Italian I've had.

To Ramona N. -I'm not 100% sure, but if you were the woman who was writing this review on her IPAD on the way to her table (way to be obvious); you've got some nerve posting this before sitting down and eating Giotto's food. Honestly, I was there last night with my fiancé, and we had to wait a bit as well for our reservation--not a big surprise considering that they are quite good. The restaurant is popular, and we half expected to wait a little while for our table. It's just how it is. It was our anniversary, (though we don't like fanfare) so I didn't tell anybody. The food, as per usual, was excellent. Our server was super sweet and attentive. And, not sure what you mean by "concierge" (this isn't a hotel), but if you mean the hostesses, you couldn't be more wrong. The hostess who was helping us (don't know her name, but she had a feather in her hair), every single time she came outside, she checked on us--and told us that they were doing their best to move things along and get us our table. Once we came inside, the other hostess seated us with a smile and apologized again for our wait. In short--just really professional and nice girls. I never write Yelp reviews--but in this case, I think it's necessary. Giotto's deserves a solid thumbs up. We were incredibly happy with dinner--all parts of it.

It's my favorite restaurant... ever!  Yes that's a bold statement but my goodness, the food here is amazing. If I were to compare it to say Daniel, I would say that both are just as tasty.  Daniel would be much more formal and the service is top notch.  Gramercy is much more relaxed compared to Daniel.  I feel like you can talk and laugh with each other without holding back.  The food is just out of this world.  Simple, yet extremely fresh and the taste is just so bold and satisfying like nothing else you have ever had.

I went to High Street for Restaurant Week, hoping to try a few different dishes for a bit cheaper than usual. If I had come across this restaurant in another city, it might have gained a 5 in my book. But in Philly, with its incredible growing food scene, I'm holding High Street to a higher standard - and I just can't say it's one of my new favorites (and to be clear, I would have granted it a 3.5 if I could've). I thought the ambiance was cool (not just an open kitchen "concept" - there were no walls enclosing the small corner kitchen, making it completely open to the tiny restaurant). I thought the service was perfectly fine. I had a yummy cocktail (I believe it was called the Vodka Garden). Most of the food was very good - it was simple, flavorful, and well-executed. My favorites were the Rigatoni with Pastrami Ragu and the Arctic Char. There were a few dishes that I didn't love; like many other reviewers, I found the Potted Shrimps to be a bit too salty and the Country Peach dessert to be kind of odd (large piece of somewhat dry corn bread with a VERY small bit of peaches on the side). I thought the portions were fine - maybe a tad smaller than your typical small plates restaurant. Would I go back? Sure - especially to try breakfast or lunch - but I'm not dying to get back there. It just wasn't a very memorable dining experience. I've been to so many great restaurants in Philly lately that have me leaving saying WOW. I was expecting that wow-factor from Bon Appetit's Top 2 New Restaurant in the country...and I'm sorry to say I just didn't find it there!
This is for sure the best pizza I ever try in my life, if you are not from New York you have to try it at least one time.

I wish I discovered this place a while back!  A unique rustic setting gives this place an amazing atmosphere - a casual but elegant setting with great food. I had the octopus and the short ribs, and both were amazing. My friends also all enjoyed all their food with the flatbread and the schnitzel standing out. It was a busy mid week night but the service was great, efficient and on point. They then suggested we have a drink at The Third Man which is another gem!

I had a party, and I needed to find the best Chinese food in the area, so I tried them all.... This restaurant I call "Lawyers Service Chinese" because it is right near the Lawyers Service mailbox -- I would never have known if I didn't have to drop something off.  I stopped in and got some take out, and it was really, really good!  When I told them I was having a party, they were GREAT about catering a large order, and their prices and freshness could not be beat! (I also Ordered some from another restaurant in the area, but the chicken and broccoli here had more chicken and was a better deal).  They really did a great, great job, and made it seem like it was no big deal to cook for 60!  Surprising little gem of a take out place!! I ended up ordering a HUGE tray of chicken and broccoli from here, and snow peas and mixed vegetables.  They made it exactly what I asked for, and had it there on time.  Everyone asked where I ordered from.  This is really, really good food!!  (They will even do amazing steamed shrimp and vegetables with sauce on the side for weight watchers).  Totally amazing food, so close and so much less expensive than other places where the food isn't as fresh or tasty!

I love this place.  The food is fresh and delicious. An unusual spinach salad has goat cheese, walnuts, and dried apricots with the most amazing fresh pesto dressing.  Yum.  Espresso lattes are good but the assortment of chai tea lattes is awesome.  There's a chocolate version I save for special occasions when I've been very, very good and deserve a treat.  I live around the block and have always found the service polite and very accomodating.  Breakfast outside on a Saturday morning is a great way to kick off the weekend--bring your dog and chat with neighbors.  Oh, and after 6:00 p.m., sandwiches and salads are reduced to $5.00.  Such a great deal when you're too tired to make a meal after work and want something healthy.
I love La Sirene Cluny. Its perfect for a quick bite or a special meal. The food is delicious, the service is impeccable. The ambiance is warm and inviting.

Had great drinks and a delicious steak empanada. Great service from a lovely bartender Nicole, who shares my hometown of Silver Spring, MD! She had great drink recommendations and let me try Aguardiente which was awesome! Overall great experience. Two thumbs up!
My girls loved the pretty cloth napkins, roses in the bathroom on the ceiling and the tea tree soap.
Yummy!!!!  Had a beer and a nice sausage and mushroom pie.  Loved it!  You can only get a whole pie here but is not too big!  Brick oven style.

Great thai fusion food, cozy and eclectic atmosphere,  and remarkable service. I highly recommend the Thai burger and the spicy watermelon slaw. Their ingredients taste fresh and the dishes are sufficiently complex. I loved it!

Order only the xiaolong bao, the scallion pancake, the chinese ravioli with soup and fried quail. Especially the friend quail, it is so good that I went back the other day and bought 5 as snacks. Good spot for brunch but the wait is about 30 minutes to 1 hour when they are busy. The one in flushing has better Xiaolong bao but the location of this store can't be beat.  Also, be prepared to share a table with strangers because they mostly use roundtables.

Brooklyn Landmark. Nothing like the Sicilian square with a cup of spumoni. Sauce is sweet and tangy, and the cheese is put on first to ensure that the crust doesn't get soggy. One of my favorite places.

Way overpriced for food that was good but wasn't great. Party of 6 came out to close to 200 dollars. 3 of the ones in that party were children. I mean come on, 17 dollars for chicken Alfredo and a little over 20 dollars for cheese ravioli?  It's a disgrace to charge that much for something so very simple. If you look at the money signs it states there are 2 when clearly it should be marked 4 because of their prices. Don't try and drum up your business by charging outrageous prices but by offering great food at reasonable prices and you'll get more than enough business.

If it was possible to give zero stars I would.  How is it that this place has so many good reviews???  Came here on Saturday with another couple.  First time for 3 out of 4 of us.  I figured it had to be great based on the reviews...NOT.  There is little to no ambiance and the service was practically non-existant.  Seemed like a fire hazard as the only exit was the front door by the bar and the kitchen was between the bar and the dining room in the back.  Patrons crammed in community style at long tables.  There was nothing appealing about the place the second we walked in.  The host was gruff, unfriendly and annoyed that we were still waiting for the other two people in our party.  For apps we had the sausage appetizer, friend calamari and oysters on the half shell.  Nothing to write home about on any of it.  We all shared the Frutos do Mar hot platter.  Yes, it's a lot of food so maybe all these good reviews are solely based on quantity and variety.  The shish kebob was completely over cooked, making the grilled calamari and fish practically inedible.  The red sauce for the mussels tasted like a watered down jarred pasta sauce and the stuffed clams were not good at all.  The garlic shrimp may have passed muster if it wasn't so salty.  The best part of the night was that we had two pitchers of sangria and they forgot to charge us for one of them.  I have been to Forno's of Spain many times and it is SOOO much better than this place, in fact you can't even compare the two.  Needless to say I will not be back.  I think this is the first time Yelp has steered me wrong.
Super cheap in NYC is a rate find especially for great food and a great staff! Pops in the back jr in the front!

The food was good.  I thought the rice was very flavorful.  I would have liked the option of seafood only, but I'll take the chicken and beef too.  I've been to another Peruvian restaurant in the area, and the portions were smaller here.  So, I was a little let down, since the price was higher.  On one of the items, it described the dish with potatoes, but it was more like half a small potato.  The steak was a little bland.   The service, it was just terrible.  It took a long time to get seated, which was strange because the restaurant wasn't full.  Then when we were finally seated, it took forever for a waitress to come over.  She took our drink order, and even though we stated we were ready to order our meals she just walked away.   After we were done with the meal it took a long time to get our check and even longer for them to pick it up.  I almost felt like going to the counter to pay for it and be done.   The only great thing beside the "arroz chaufa" was the fact that they had live music going on.   The staff is definitely under-trained and they are a bit disorganized.  At one point the bathrooms were barricaded by chairs and tables that they kept moving to the back. If they were a bit more organized and had better service, this could be a great restaurant, but I don't think I'll be going back.
Great pizza!

Great restaurant for the most part. Sat by the bar where they had amazing happy hour deals $6 flavored mojitos + more. We ordered a few dishes and they were delicious. Service was excellent. Jessie, our waiter, could not have been more attentive. Definitely returning.

This is one of the best falafel sandwiches I've ever had; not only are there rotating flavors of falafel, but artfully tucked into the pita was a small selection of Israeli salads. This place is a true upscale corner dining option. I always like stopping here.

The Confessional has an amazing atmosphere. One of a few romantic bars on this corner. I would recommend Confessional mostly for the atmosphere- and the location. Confessional is a great place to start the night, end the night, or as an in between. After drinks you can go here to collect yourself, or to surprise a newfound romantic interest with the brilliant atmosphere inside...

I normally love Red Robin, but tonight's food seemed less than fresh. I'm not much of a complainer, and it still tasted pretty good so I didn't say anything. My date didn't seem to have any problems with it. I had to send him home early though because I started not feeling so well.

Note: This review is for Friday's All You Can Eat Buffet and the Club only. Date of Visit: Sept. 12th, Time of Visit: 7:30, then stayed for the live band This was the first time I've stopped here since it has been Rho Ristorante Discoteca. Before I attended it when it was KatManDu.   The best way I can do this review is to compare it to my former experiences at KatManDu--just to see who (in my opinion) did it better.  When I did go to KatManDu, I would usually go on Fridays (because of the live band), with Saturdays being a close second. Overall design, I do like the look of Rho, particularly the outdoor area--more welcoming and conducive to live band play during the summer.  I do wish the seating were more comfortable, since I couldn't sit at the bar or table for long periods of time due to the lack of cushioning. Food wise, I prefer the KatManDu ambiance.  There used to be more selection with the All You Can Eat Buffet.  The price increased (from $5 when it was Kat to $10 with Rho) but the variety as well as the quality of the food didn't quite stand out.  The Riesling I had to drink was nice, and the bartender was friendly. The live band was terrific and they had a great rapport with the crowd.  Yet it wasn't particularly crowded like it was back in the KatManDu days.  By around 10:30, the crowd that was there started dwindling down. This spot has potential and I'm definitely opening to coming back to Rho.  Maybe next time I'll try it during normal hours to get the full spectrum of the food.

Found this place on Grubhub and gave it a shot because it's local. Truly glad I did, the portions are huge, and the food is great. Free delivery on top of it. I should have only eaten half the salad though as I was pretty stuffed when I finished.

This place is small but it has everything you wish for a nice, authentic and flavorful Cuban coffee. My fav is cafe con leche and their chicken sandwich. Love love love!! The baristas are so nice too! Def a place worth checking out :)

Great find! We had the pork xiao long bao with scallion pancakes and the "5 kinds dim sum.  All were delicious! The highlight was of course was the xiao long bao which came out piping hot and steamed to perfection. The broth inside was very tasty and not too greasy or salty.  Initially, the gave us the wrong order twice, but the made up for it by giving us an order of the chocolate xiao long bao on the house! What a delicious treat! I've never seen it on the menu of any other dumpling places...a must have desert! Inside the dumpling molten chocolate takes the place of broth and it's stuffed with bananas. I'll definitely come back for sure!

I haven't eaten here yet, but I plan to. My boyfriend and I came here on a Saturday afternoon and sat at the bar. We we're immediately served by the wonderful bartender Angelica. She was great! Super friendly, drinks were great and she was overall awesome at checking up on everyone sitting at the bar. By the end of our time there, I had felt like I had known the servers/bartender longer than just a few hours. I'll definitely be back to try their food, because I hear their burgers are awesome!

Very subpar food, the smaller taste of mexico off harrison is much better when it comes to everything, especially the tacos, the ones here aren't even good cuts of beed for a authentic taco. Last but not least the nachos are a joke. Try the smaller taste of mexico instead

Our experience here was extremely disappointing. We had made a reservation more than a week in advance to celebrate an older family member's birthday - we were seated upstairs (despite our requests to avoid the stairs) and still were made to wait over 30 minutes at the bar for our table. Our server was incredibly disrespectful. When we told him our reason for dining that evening, his response was to look at the guest of honor and say, "Well, happy freaking birthday." When we asked him a question about a dish, he was extraordinarily condescending, and behaved as if we were stupid to even consider asking. After that encounter, he seemed to be avoiding our table at all costs - I waited an extra 10-15 minutes just to see a gluten-free menu, and we had to ask to be served glasses of tap water. He forgot more than one drink order, and more than once had to be tracked down by the bartender or another server. When it became clear that he was not in the weeds, but rather willfully inattentive, members of our party got up scavenge extra napkins and plates for the appetizers from other empty tables nearby. We waited at least 45 minutes for our entrees, so I was expecting something really spectacular. What we got was so disappointing, and not worth the wait at all. I ordered the Crab Rossa - the pasta was disgustingly over-cooked and there was no trace of crab anywhere in that dish. Other dishes were equally lackluster - requests for accommodations (no peppers, please) were blatantly ignored. Despite knowing it was a birthday celebration, the waiter never offered any kind of special action - no candles in a dessert, no special drink, nothing. I'd heard really great things about Stella Rossa, and I was really excited to go, but this experience was so disappointing I don't think we'll ever be back.

don peppe one of those ittalian restaurant which are known for the best taste among the people. don peppe i had never seen before visiting it. once i went there to taste the food it was newer one italian restaurant for me. and also one of those restaurant which are liked by me in new york.... when i entered this restaurant i was little to having hot babies near me. now i dont think that any other restaurant have better taste than it in there restaurant as ittalian food. i have impressed a lot by it. i have never gave 5star to anyone before it. and it is given by me because of it is realy able to get 5stars. don peppe is legitimately authentic. food is served in family style there, which was one of positive thing for me. it is only sad news that they dont deliver it. in alcohal they have only vine and beer,s only. it is good place for children and groups. if u want to enjoy in group at dinner time you should visit once don peppe. it is cash paying restaurant.

my friend recomended for going there to eat something special.we went to tops dinner to enjoy our diner of saturday night .AveraThe dishes seem to be hit or misge food at reasonable prices with big portions  The quesadilla had bland cheese that dripped with oil, but the salad was fresh and had some good dressing.  However, my friendordered a swordfish steak, which was tender and subtly flavored with a mix of herbsThe ambiance of the diner along with the cordial, attentive service deserve special  and spices that complemented the flavor of the fish well.mention, and make Tops Diner a standout option if you're in the area and looking fgreat place to visit.

I'd been wanting to try Ancora as I understood it to be a long-time downtown establishment which moved to the hotel across the street after Hurricane Sandy. Unfortunately the food was just as bad as one would expect from a Doubletree hotel. Wilted salad with commercial dressing, bland pasta with "pomodorini" (but only a shred of tomato), overcooked fish with an unripe tomato slice and none of the accompanying vegetables described--and this is just the food.  The waiter treated us like we were completely ignorant (perhaps he thought we were tourists) and spent ten minutes describing "specials" that just turned out to be the menu. (We had to ask for a menu, ask to place our order, and ask where the food was--it was 45 minutes before we saw a salad, and this was lunchtime! There are so many staff but it's not clear what any of them are doing.) When the waiter asked (or rather told us) whether we liked the food we could not lie, at which point the owner came out and offered us more food, free wine, dessert and coffee. For this I add one star, but I will never return!

was told that they had GF noodles that the midtown west location. they did, staff was very knowledgeable about what was in each of the dishes. and when she was unsure, she actually brought out one of the chefs who talked it over with me. extremely accommodating and extremely delicious

this pizza is incredible.  what's the secret behind the crust? because it's yummy!

This place is INSANE! Best ramen that has ever graced these lips. I can't get enough of this place, service is amazing. Spicy paste in addition to the ramen that you order is a good choice, the spicier the better. My only critique is that they don't take reservations and the wait is an eternity.

A frequenter of this restaurant, I have never been disappointed. I recommend this to friends, neighbors, family, and coworkers. Classic Italian paired with exceptional service and a heightened sense of ambiance. A great place to celebrate or to simply treat oneself to a fine dining experience. This is the best gumbo I have ever had! I am from Louisiana, so I have eaten quite a few bowls in my life.

A great Village restaurant. Small, homey, good tight menu, nice service, crowded but you can hear your conversation quite easily. Definitely a good first, second, or third date spot. Food was good quality and well made, with enough imagination to make the meal delicious but not precious. Service was friendly, efficient, and aspirational to the style of a top notch restaurant.

A very cool space.   I was there on a sunday so there so no live music but i could imagine this place would swing on a friday or saturday.   I may go back but not make a special trip there.   The BBQ is okay,  just okay.  Nothing to rave about.  Ive had better, and worse.   The Baby Back Ribs were good, but could have used more seasoning.   I don't like to have to add sauce to everything i am eating.   The Brisket was ok, not great.  Tender but lacked taste and salt.  ZERO salt.  It was a bit dry, but that could be due to the hour of my eating, 8pm on sunday, they close at 9pm. so there was not a lot of meat left by the end of the night.     The sides were just ok.  Baked beans with burnt ends was the highlight.  Plenty of burnt ends in it.  No mac-n-cheese, they had run out.   The cole slaw seemed to be commercial and not home made,  bland and very white, no red cabbage, no carrots.   My friend had a Strawberry Moonshine that was really good,  great taste and fresh strawberry.   The hot chicken wings were good, but could have been spicier.     Overall a decent experience but also a bit pricy for the quality.  I never mind paying top dollar if the bbq is outstanding.   So far no BBQ joint in NYC has surpassed Hill Country BBQ.  But I will keep searching and eating.     I would go back again if i was in Brooklyn, but wouldn't make a special trip there again.

Great place to grab any meal! I love the option of having breakfast throughout the day. Their mozzarella grill cheese with tomato and bacon is delicious! At $4.95 you can't go wrong. I never have to wait long to be seated, and the staff is always friendly. It's a great place to eat with the family   and not empty out your wallet. It's has the feel of a mom and pop restaurant with all the bells and whistles from a chain restaurant.

Great food and confortable ambiance. It was the perfect place for a relaxing dinner with a friend. Staff was attentive and suggested great choices for dinner. It takes you back to the local bistro setting of an old Paris neighborhood like St Germain... It's not about the over the top scene and decor; it's about the well prepared food!

Service was mediocre at best. Took 15 minutes for us to even get someown to ask us for water. More a hippie vibe I wouldnt go here if you were hungry cause itd take forever to get an order in. Other than the service the food was ok ot was super good but it was good. Didnt make up for the bad service. I liked the bathroom though it was downstairs and had a chalkboard where you could write on it. I thought that was pretty cool.

Rude.  Parking requires that you pay the meter. Asked the server for change for the meter and he said no. I said that I "planned to eat here" and he did not answer.  I left based on that and the poor seating arrangements.  I was dressed in professional attire.  Unbelievable.

It's so bad...I almost fell asleep on the table waiting for the food, and to be served cold and burned pizza in the end ! It's a Monday night 8:30, we were seated right away. We ordered 2 pizza and waited over 30 min for the food. When they finally arrived, they didn't feel like they were just out of the oven, they were cold and soggy...They were probably sitting by the counter for a while waiting for the staff to pick up. Given that there are only 2 places to sit down and eat at in this wing of the airport, it seems that this is the favorable choice for breakfast since there are a significant amount of more options to choose from on the menu than it's competitor (Ruby Tuesdays). While the food itself was good (bacon, egg, and cheddar omelet) the service itself was some of the worst I have had in a while. We were not acknowledged and waited well over 10 minutes to be greeted at the table. The order was clearly stated and served wrong. We were still charged the full price for the meal even though I didn't get mine until my girlfriend was done eating her own. All in all, the food is not bad at all, but this place is not for you if you're pretty stiff and judgmental about the service staff.

Food was OK, service/delivery was terrible.  Ordered carry-out in the store (3 plain fingers, 1 general tso, 1 buffalo/maple, 1 salted caramel, truffle fries and 2 sauces).  When we arrived home, the 3 plain crunchy fingers were missing from the bag.  Called to request they be delivered (I live 2 blocks away) and they promised to send them.  Over an hour later, nothing has arrived, no phone call, no refund.   The 3 fingers we did receive were OK, but not amazing.  Way better cheap eats in the area (is it still cheap when you pay for two meals but receive 1?) with better service--highly recommended to look elsewhere. UPDATE:  Manager contacted me the next day to apologize, commiserate and offer a refund/credit for next visit.  Two more stars for great follow-up!

Incredible food and a festive atmosphere. Without a doubt one of the best meals I have had in a long time. Every dish was delicious and the menu caters to all tastes. Special mention to the cavatelli which was the standout. The standard of service was also impeccable which just added to the great experience! Looking forward to becoming a regular.

I recently went here for a birthday dinner with my girlfriend and a bunch of my friends. We were a group of 10 and were seated at 6:30pm. They brought out our dinners cold and not all at once. Some of us had to wait long periods of time before they received their meals. I ordered a cheeseburger and when everyone started to receive their dinners the waiter told me that they ran out of hamburger meat and if I wanted to change my order. I don't understand how a restaurant could finally realize they were our of hamburger meat by the time they were serving everyone else's dinner. I wouldn't have cared I'd they told me this sooner but the fact that they didn't know until everyone else began being served as disgraceful and poor management. I had to wait even longer to get my meal. Throughout our stay there there were multiple times they ran out of stuff we wanted and was only find last minute. They didn't even look to offer us anything to take care of the cold dinners and for me waiting to get my new dinner so when we complained they offered us a a round of drinks for free. After having cold food, having people wait to get their meals instead of everyone being able to eat together pls being told lay minute of by the way we're out of hamburger meat it really wasn't a good way to fix the problem. I would never recommended this place and works instead make sure I know never goes there so they don't experience what we all did. Not what someone would expect when going out especially when to celebrate a birthday.

i like the garlic bread

best hotpot spot in sunset park! esp love the wine chicken~ def need to make reservations. they also have great holiday themed decors...fav was halloween decor esp the fact that they are located next to a funeral home.

The service was quick and friendly. I went in with my boyfriend to this restaurant two times I live in the area and always saw a line to get in. I'm new in NY and Honest Chops is the first butcher that I tried, first for the grass fed because I follow the Paleo Diet, second for the halal (I'm not muslim but I find this hand-slaughter practice more respectful and correct than the rest of options), and third is near my home. Super good! A friend suggested it to me, but I have to say I'm not usually the Spanish food type. But it was definitely worth the trip! Next time I'm in the mood for burritos, I'll be there!
Took family they were excellent,accommodating,food was very good ,service excellent .We especially enjoyed the pasta and deserts.would highly recommend
