Such a fun place to go. I won't say it's the best pizza in Philly but it comes close. I reserve best for Tacconelli's, Osteria, Vetri Pizza and eh..Earth Bread has a special place in my heart.  That said, this place is probably ranking 5th or 6th on my favorite pizza places to hit up. It is a hipster magnet, oriented towards the local college crowd. Being a TU graduate myself, I don't mind this so much. Hipsters don't angry me like they some how seem to do for others. I see them as "pre-yuppies", readying their plots for gentrification of the neighborhood. Rise up my pre-yuppies hipster hatchlings and take North Philly for yourselves! Serious, ..that place needs some major gentrification. Back on topic. The crust is pretty decent, the toppings are fresh I find each time. Pizzas can be creative. I wish they would have a new creative pizza rotating each week. Perhaps a pizza with lobster bisque with cognac sauce some sort of fitting cheese, topped with some pan seared foie gras? A pizza with filet mignon flambeed then topped with boite sauce? A pizza with flambeed scampi served with Newburg sauce? A pizza with sweetbreads, tripes, pigs blood, orange zest and aged gruyere would be interesting. Or perhaps a pizza with veal kidneys in mustard sauce topped with oak ripened gorgonzola and duck eggs? Just a few ideas to consider. Beyond that, low in cost and rather decent for the most part. I sort of wish they would open a store next to the West Philly Little Baby's Ice Cream shop. The city could use more pizza joints like this, West Philly would seem to be the next logical place to open a secondary branch. A side note, the bathrooms tend to be rather dirty. Clean up under the seats, clean hourly. Beyond that, keep up the good work.

I really don't know what went wrong after reading so many high-quality reviews of this pizza parlor, but it is by far the worst pizza I've had in NYC to date.  It was so dreadful that I wished I was back home upstate where I could find better almost anywhere!   Maybe it's because we ordered a couple of pies to be delivered, but it's as if the pizza was sitting out pre-cooked for hours or re-heated from the night before. The crusts were extremely soggy, not at all crispy, and extremely tenacious to take a bite out of.  We had prosciutto on top of one of the pies, and it too was flabby and not crisp at all, literally looking like it had just been tossed on top after the pizza came out of the oven.   Overall, a pathetically disappointing experience.  My peers and I were looking for something really special, and this couldn't have been further from our hopes.  Two thumbs down.  It was so bad that I wouldn't ever warrant a second attempt in the future.

None of our party could understand the good ratings of this place. Firstly it's got the vibe of a Korean McSorely's full of screaming drunks. The worst part was that the waiter lied to us insisting that 2 dishes for three people was too little, when it turned out that 2 dishes would have been excessive for 3. And then when we called him on it to cancel the third dish before it came out he insisted that we were out of luck. Not even an apology. I'm confused why a successful business would resort to such tactics to squeeze more $$ out of people, and without shame. The food was pretty good but I've had better Korean food in plenty of other places.
Never ordering from here again. The food is terrible. YUKK
Such an amazing atmosphere! The drinks were the best I've had in NYC. The service was wonderful and I would suggest this bar to anyone who wants to enjoy a delicious cocktail and a great atmosphere.

Seemingly elegant yet lacking adequate portion size. Menu should have all items as small bites. Outrageously expensive for not that great of quality food. Menu strategically words dishes to imply a greater portion and a greater plate. For example, the pork on the tomatilla dish is really only pork rinds. Sad to have spent 42 dollars on two tiny plates (both being salads).

Excellent food at non-NYC prices.  We had the cioppino (although it had a different name) and the lasagna.  The entree's were wonderful and enormous - we ate only half.  I had the house chianti, which was delightful - not typical of house wine offerings.  We thought the tiramisu was OK, not great. A few cautions:  note that they only accept cash.  Also, it's noisy and has pretty tight seating - you almost sit in your neighbor's lap. OVERALL:  DELISH + great value.
Better pizza that Pepe's or Sally's.... they deserve to win over them for best pizza place next year!

Been here twice so far... First time for lunch buffet and it was great. My favorite so far.. Everything was fresh and delicious... My second time I went for dinner and I had my favorite lamb chop and chicken kebab. Delicious.their garlic naan is out of this world.bbq and curries good too.wide verity of food.Overall, great restaurant with great food that is worth visiting.

I came here on vacation and was very happy with my experience. The staff was extremely nice, they brought our pizza out to the table in less then fifteen minutes of ordering. It was a good pizza and I had a wonderful experience.

I'm a pilot and fly into and out of Newark fairly regularly. I live close by in Livingston.  My copilot on one of my assignments told me about this restaurant that has the most incredible karaoke as well as great food, even though it's known as a pizzeria; it's close the airport in W. Orange called Starlite.  I came for a quick dinner but wound up staying 'till midnight with the KJ. I've done karaoke in all 4 corners of the world but have never seen anything like this; speakers and tvs all over the place and a little stage also. The guy said there were 40,000 songs to choose from.  I had a great time. The dinner was a special too; I had this delicious prep of swordfish with saffron rice and perfect vegetables.  It was so pretty I took a picture even though I'm an amateur photographer; it came out great.  Anyway, go! - Dine and sing!
Chicken is amazing and the biscuit it comes on is insane. This would be my last meal on death row

Nicole and John are the dynamic duo of the outside bar. They attend to all the needs of the patrons. They put the "happy" in happy hour for me and my group. Can't wait to come back next Friday. I hope they are there.
I remember coming here on valentines day two years ago and we got a cold pie. Cold pies aren't cool.

If you like ramen, try this place. I had the extra spicy totto ramen with pork and it was delicious. They brought they extra spicy oil on the side so that you can add as little or as much as you want. It's a nice cozy spot and we didn't have to wait very long for a table. I highly recommend it. Don't get the ground pork unless you've already had it. And the pork bun is awesome too!
The best american pancakes I have ever tried! So fluffy and crispy. This is a must place to visit! I went there two days in row.

Went for take out! Keyword "take out", no forks, napkins or soy sauce in the carry out bag! Food was done in 5 mins, which explains the sticky rice and black tails still on the shrimp!  Restaurant was clean atleast.  Staff very short, not too social at all!  Save your money!
Great food. Nicely smoked brisket! The icecream was a little different. It is hard icecream put through a press to make it soft.

I heard about this place being owned by one of the guys from "It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia." I enjoyed my time here at this bar. The bartender was friendly and the people that I met at the bar near closing time was also friendly. Thank you guys for making my experience at Philly a great one!

I ordered the Kimchee Pancake and the Soon Dubu Stew with seafood for takeout yesterday. The food was ok. There was nothing special about both dishes. I didn't taste any kimchee flavor in the Kimchee Pancake. The Soon Dubu Stew tasted ok, but there was hardly any seafood in it. I think the biggest disappointment was the banchan. There were only two - seasoned cucumbers and kimchi. I'm used to places giving at least four or five banchan. The kimchi was awful. I ended up taking a bite and throwing it out. The seasoned cucumbers were delicious and the reason this restaurant got a second star. This place might get a second chance with me if I was in Chinatown and I'm desperate for Korean food.

A group of 6 of us went to Karma today for lunch.  Included in the group were several adults from India, so I am relying on their comments for part of this review. First, we arrived at 11:30 which is when the restaurant opens for lunch.  The door was open and we were seated (in the very back which turned out to be a good spot close to the buffet).  We could easily hear one another until other guests crowded the room; that happened starting at noon.   Second, they were still putting food on the buffet when we arrived, so we had to wait about 10 minutes to start filling our plates. The Indians in our group started ordering various breads.  I am not sure if other tables received these breads (I was not paying attention), but they were good. The wait staff is not that fast at removing dirty dishes.  There was plenty of staff; they just were not paying attention.  They were also a bit slow filling empty or near empty water glasses. Now to the food.  It was clearly fresh and varied, but my Indian friends said it was just so-so.  On a scale of 1-10 they gave it a 4-5 (hence my 2 out of 5 star rating here).  They said it was not authentic Indian food.  They did praise the dessert, a custard with fruit in it.  Often it is too sweet, and this one was sweetened to perfection; I must admit it was good. The team compared the lunch at Karma with a lunch they had a few weeks ago at Inde Blue.  Yelp customers give Inde Blue a 4.5 star rating, but my friends were not impressed.  They were even less impressed with Karma.

I ordered a half BBQ Chicken, half Buffalo Chicken Pizza.  I received a plain pie with BBQ/Buffalo sauce drizzled on it and pieces of low quality breaded chicken cubes sparingly scattered on the pie.   This disgrace of a pizza cost $17.50.  I will not be ordering from Prime Time Pizza again.

Amazing!  Came here tonight at 9:35 with a party of 12 for my friend's birthday dinner.  We had reservations at Samba (across the street) but after being treated terribly there,   we all came here.... THANK GOODNESS! We were instantly welcomed.  A table was set up in the cozy green room.  Servers were with us immediately,  setting the table,  opening our bottles,  and serving us bread. .. all within 5 minutes!  The servers were happy and friendly, and fast!  The food was absolutely wonderful! Huge servings. ..delicious!  We were not rushed at all even though we stayed well beyond the closing time.   Impeccable service,  amazing food,  and easy access to parking.  I will most definitely be back!

Had the lamburger which was really done as nicely as you can expect for a burger. It was juicy and flavorful. The fried olives as an appetizer was actually really good and would pair well with a nice refreshing coctail. The service was good, with waitstaff being  curtious and quick with your food. The atmosphere was nice of a little cramped. The bathroom however was super dimly lit and cramped. I wouldn't go out of my way to seek it out again but wouldn't hesitate if in the neighborhood.

Wow. Some of the best pizza I've ever had in my life. The crust is crispy on bottom and soft in the middle, balanced perfectly. Also I don't know what's in their cheese but it's not like any mozzarella I've ever tasted, it has an amazing flavor! Very fast and friendly service as well. I'll definitely be back. Also they only accept cash.

We were here on time but they didn't let us in or sit down because we didn't have one person coming. We asked them for a favor because it was our friend's good bye meal together. However, they disgraced us.

Walked to this infamous Philly cheesesteak joint with my bestie after the rock n roll expo. We both were hungry and ready to devour Philadelphia's staple sandwich. We both ordered a Philly cheese with provolone and onions. Then walked over to where the condiments were with mustard, hot sauce and peppers. I happily loaded my cheesesteak with every hot pepper. I immediately took a bite and it was DELICIOUS!!! Meat was tender, cheese melted, onions buttery with the right amount of grease. The peppers complimented well with this ingenious concoction. We both finished it while walking back to the apartment. I gave it 4 stars due to the soft bread. I'm a sesame hero fan with a crunch. People try it!!! don't listen to the bad reviews! Form your own opinion once you take a bite out of meat heaven!

I live around the corner from this place and saw all the great reviews, so decided to try it out and it was delicious! I had the chicken reshmi roll and the poultry special of the day with naan bread, which was a lot of food, and it was really good!

Perfect place to catch up with your friends over margaritas! It is a bit noisy, but the food is delicious and the service is great. I have also gone there on dates and I will say that it's a better hangout for friends since it's usually hard to hear in there because it's always packed! Shared munchie recommendation: any of the nachos - the plate is huge! Margarita recommendation: any of them. All great! If you go here, you will not be disappointed!
Went here and checked it out recently.  The sandwich I ordered was pretty good, but the service could be a bit faster.  Decent place overal, resonably priced too.

Just had Daphnes Salad & Seafood Risotto ala Vodka. Both are absolute perfection. So delicious & freshly prepared. Please, please, please go here for dinner. This is the best food in the area & service is on-spot. I will be visiting again when I'm back in town. It's a traditional for us!!

Best Pizza in West Haven!!  We call  in and pick up our pie and it is awesome EVERY time. My favorite is the eggplant pizza. It is honestly the best I ever had.  They are open late too which is another nice feature. Give Mikes a try you will not be dissapointed!

Tonight was our first time coming here and we are so glad we dropped in! The vegetables are so fresh, the meats are so well seasoned, service was great and fast. The place is clean and the owner incredibly friendly and hospitable. Also, prices are great for the amount of food you get. We will be coming back often!

It is OK, let me repeat just OK.  Like all the review have mentioned it is an apartment that was converted to a restaurant.  The food was good, the waitress was attentive but the atmosphere is not the greatest.  We wanted to try this place for so long and finally did it.  It is a one time deal, there are lots of nicer italian restaurant to try.  Definitely will not return.

As a Drexel student, I take my pizza very seriously. With the myriad of pizza places around University City, you need to choose the best one to claim your loyalty to. Sava's does not just have amazing pizza (I mean, they do, their BBQ chicken and Fiesta slices are ENORMOUS and delicious!), but their paninis, wraps, and stromboli are also amazing. And don't get me started on their fries - imagine boardwalk fries in a restaurant, fried in delicious peanut oil! It's also more than a regular pizza place because it looks like a pretty nice restaurant inside. The staff is really attentive and makes sure you get your food ASAP. They also have a really awesome selection of craft beers right at the counter for you to take home - it doesn't get much better than that!

09/12/14 Probably it was the French wine that the waitress recommended but I fell in love with Buvette! Tiny, cramped yet we were all very relaxed. Service is great. Food is satisfactory, wines are fantastic!! Their entrees are tapas size but overall filling for a girly appetite. Can't wait to try out their Brunch menu!

The pizza here is great, don't get me wrong.. but I guess I was just expecting more from a restaurant that has won "best pizza" in the U.S. for serveral years in a row.  If you want something just as good and don't want to wait be sure to check out Modern!

0 Stars. I'M ACTUALLY FEELING NAUSEOUS BECAUSE OF THIS PLACE. DO NOT COME HERE....UNLESS YOU WANT TO BE POISONED! The chicken tenders and fries are from frozen packages. The fries were burnt. I felt so sick I barely ate any of it. The place is dirty and messy. There were 3 people there and no customers but there was still garbage on the tables. A bunch of people and kids came in through the kitchen door and were just hanging out with the workers while they were on their phones. I had to wait extra long because the girl made wings instead of tenders. THE FOOD WAS DISGUSTING AND THIS PLACE SHOULD BE SHUT DOWN..... I only made this yelp account so I could warn other innocent tender-lovers like myself.

I've ordered from here twice (using Grubhub) and have had a pleasant experience each time. They actually pay attention to my comments (you'd be surprised how many restaurants on GH don't heed delivery comments) and provide prompt delivery. I had to call once to change a part of my order and the woman who answered the phone was super helpful and extremely friendly. I haven't been to the actual restaurant, yet, so I can't say anything in terms of ambiance, but I will definitely stop by soon. The food is on par with the better diners in this area and the prices are very reasonable. I love the disco fries and the make-your-own salads are wonderful. Macaroni salad is also pretty tasty and isn't swimming in 3 jars of Miracle Whip :)
wings are simply awesome and other food is super-fresh, everything here is hand made here and rates are reasonable

Last night was the third time I ate at Casserole Bistro, and as with the  first two times I was not disappointed. We were a party of 6. Our appetizers consisted of onion soup, mussels, tuna trio, garlic shrimp and stuffed mushrooms. Everything was delicious!  The dinners we had were salmon, seafood risotto, short ribs, sea bass, and scallops. Everyone was extremely happy with their dinners as well.  I have tried 3 different entrees here and they have all exceeded my expectations. The food here is different, in a wonderful way. The flavors blend perfectly together. Everything is done a little differently, and the results are fabulous. I highly recommend Casserole Bistro for your next dinner out.

Came in for the hot chicken, stayed for the lemonade. Came for a date night and discovered the wonders of hot chicken and boozy lemonade with blueberries! Left full, tipsy and loving life. Far better experience than at the Smoke Joint which I understand is connected.

I love the vibe at Rye, its one of my favorite places to get an old fashioned in Williamsburg. Great food plus they have a full bar downstairs with comfy chairs. A perfect place to meet up with friends or make a reservation with that special someone.

Excellent food, solid service in a beautiful setting. We were there during the Restaurant Week menu, so I don't know what their normal offerings are like.  But the fixed menu included an onion dip with veggie chips to die for, peach soup, fabulous Amish Chicken and Waffles and a great steak dinner.  We weren't as crazy about the desserts, but that's the only area where we saw room for improvement.
Great social and professional place! Fabulous staff and super friendly! A great night spot in Hartford!

I had dinner there last week for the first time because of the Yelp 4 stars rating.  The appetizer was unique. Even though the dressing was tasty, but it covered the natural sushi flavor.  I am a sushi lover and I was disappointed at the sushi...for the 1st time, we did not finish our sushi.  The taro was not fresh at all. I will not return.

Eh..err...arrg. I'm a bit of a food snob these days..as in..I don't have kids and I plan on using my extra money that I'm not putting towards retirement towards good food. For cheesesteaks this means Barclay Prime's $150 cheesesteak. Life is good. That said, I suppose one can not live off foie gras, high end salmon, truffles and caviar alone. When I was coming up, I was a Geno's guy. I still consider myself a Geno's guy in that..I'm going to pick Geno's over Pat's if I'm going to Geno's..because, nostalgia perhaps. I think the steaks here are a bit better than Pat's, perhaps its the rolls that are of better quality. Still, these days I find cheesesteaks lacking proper texture qualities unless prepared by a private cook or just at home with some high end local grass fed meats. It seems Geno's has given into some slight laziness by leaving the meat on the grill too long..perhaps by stacking it and reheating it. Not sure. It just seems dryer than I remember when I was younger. I still love the cheesesteak, wit and wiz. The English only sign I see as more of a character setting than anything else, it doesn't bother me nor delight me. It just seems like it was placed there for the attention and with the intent to get that Americana feel to it at the peak of the Freedom Fries phenomena. Despite the flaws, I love this place. I love that they are 24/7. My favorite time to eat here is at 3-4am on a cold rainy fall night. Something about that brings back all these nostalgic feelings that bring me an era of being a 16 year old just with his license who told his mother he was going to school early to uhh..study for the SAT while instead my friends and I would drive here from the suburbs for an early morning breakfast..or sometimes..after a concert or party a late evening snack..occurring at the same time of the day...4am. Be it stoned off my face and eating 5 of these sandwiches or dangerously drunk underage..and..well..eating 5 of these sandwiches..this was a staple for my teen years set up by years of my dad and older brothers taking us here after ball games. Going here in the cold rainy late fall nights around 4am is just ...like Christmas for me oddly. I just wish the fires that used to burn in the trash cans across the street, neighboring area back in the early-mid 1990s were still around..that smell of wood burning..rain, fall..cheesesteaks. Err...outbeats the $150 cheesesteak from Barclays any day..however..I'm more likely to be willing to spoil myself on Barclays once a month and leave Geno's for a few visits in the fall, winter, and early spring. Only recommendations, figure out what's making the meat seem dry and cut it off. Other than that, I love you guys..the hell with the haters, keep the English only sign up..it adds to the feel of the place. **will edit typos later..phone typing these reviews is not fun.
As usual the service is horrible. Took half hour to get pizzas when the restaurant isn't crowded Food ok but only get take out never sitting down in here again
Without question the best and freshest Thai for many miles around. Great staff and FRIENDLY owner.
Amazing restaurant.  Pretty much the best pork I can remember eating.  Only downside I can think of is they don't allow reservations.  Otherwise great selection of food and wine.
the chicken is amazing! Found the kenyan special dish - mogo - fried yuca!!

Overall a 1 star experience.  I'd say almost a solid 4 on the menu/food, but absolutely negative service.   Came in for lunch hour, just after 12:00pm.  The host immediately advised us "it's cash only right now" before, almost begrudgingly, showing us to a table.  A bottle of water arrived with menus.  Our Server arrived fairly promptly to take our order (party of 2).  That was the last time we saw him.  Never returned to see if we needed more water/soda as we sat there quietly for 40 minutes wondering if we were going to be getting food, or even to check in and let us know of the lengthy wait.  Many other tables seemed to be experiencing the same thing as they sat looking at their watches and phones.  over the course of 45 minutes, eight burgers came out for a table of six and another table of two.  9 other tables had no food and were either seated before we came or shortly after us.   As we were deciding whether to just get up and leave, at 12:59pm, now 45-50 minutes after placing the order with the initial server, another person (runner or kitchen staff) brought our orders, which we then needed to box to go to get back to work from lunch hour.  Even with us asking for boxes, no one cared.  Any other server would have picked up on the fact this is completely wrong! Waited another 10 minutes to get the check which we requested when the other guy brought our to go boxes. Nothing for several minutes and then asked the hostess for the check.  Again, she seemed annoyed, walked to the back for three to four minutes, and then back to the front without stopping to say a word to us whether it might be coming or not.  5 minutes later a check came, and still not from our original server who we finally now located again, hanging out at the back counter.   Other tables around, fairly full on a Friday afternoon were seen sitting and waiting just as long, no servers coming out to see if they needed anything or let them know of the delay in getting their orders.   Zero customer service.  Not one of the six to eight people working there were interacting with customers. No apologies or explanation why food wasn't coming, no checking in to see if drinks needed refreshed.   Did finally get to try the burger after getting back to work, 20 minutes late from lunch hour.  Ordered the Supreme, and it was great and still managed be a little warm.  Can't say anything bad about the food, just wish the service was as good, or even mediocre and I could've dealt with that, but here it's just non-existent.   We get a lot of out town clients and I'd love to be able recommend this to them, always looking for new and good places for lunch/dinner, however there's more that goes into a restaurant than good food.   I'm about 95% that I won't go back but hopeful they can get it together and maybe give it another shot, otherwise I'll look for the closed sign to show up soon and see what goes in there next.

Horrible experience. Friends come over on Friday night 9/19/14 and decide they are hungry. Knowing bareburger is new in the area I take this as a perfect opportunity to try it. I walk in at 10:40pm and no host at the stand. He is wiping tables and says to me "sorry sir, but takeout only now." I was okay with that. I was going to make a six person order and take it back to my apt.... Only, when I get to the counter, 3 people leaning behind the counter look at me confused. When I say I'd like to make a takeout order, the guy says the kitchen is closed. I look at my watch and at the three booths that still have people eating.... And back at him. He musters out a "sorry." I then turned to leave and when I got half way to the door he said "sir, would you like to take a menu so that you can see what we have and come back later?" Really dude? No! What I'd like is to order actual food for the 5 hungry people at my apt from the restaurant I specifically came to try at 10:40 on a weekend night in center city.   I'd like to comment on the food, but I wasn't able to try it. Then I was met with bad customer service on top of it. Needless to say I won't be coming back to try the food. I took myself and my money out of the front door of bareburger and went to one of the many other places on walnut that weren't seemingly perturbed to see a customer walk into their establishment. Bad business guys...just bad business.
It's OK.

Delicious food, cool vibe & staff, and the best Grapefruit Habarnero Margarita Ever..AWESOMELY SPICY! What more can one ask for? A seat, hard to come by most times because Barrio Chino Rocks!   Thank You BC!

Great place for lunch. This is the most authentic punjabi Indian cuisine.  I had people from India (Punjab) visit this place for lunch and they said the same. Their dal is simply awesome. I can only vouch for vegetarian dishes though.
I was in NYC over a year ago and had the steak pommes frites. Absolutely delicious. The meat was excellent, but the sauce and the fries made the dish. Great atmosphere. A little pricey

We were recently on a trip to Hartford and went to the Mill on the River for our second time.  We tried it a year ago and it was good, but it didn't make any special impression.  This time was exceptional - all the way around.  Truly exceptional!  And an overall wonderful dining experience.   To get to The Mill on the River is a bit of a drive, if you're staying in Hartford, or near the airport... but it's definitely worth it.  When we arrived, it was a beautiful September evening. The sound of the river rushing as you cross over the bridge is soothing and anticipating.  Once we entered, the hostess was smiling and inviting.  She seated us right away.  Our waiter was the best.  He introduced himself as "Arlo, as in Guthrie."  The comparison seemed off the mark, but what the hell, he was funny.  We asked for his opinion as to what was good and he said "you're at The Mill on the River; everything's good."  Was he right!  Everything we had was wonderful.  And everyone around us was in a similar state of dining ecstasy. Their specialty seems to be german-inspired basics and seafood.  We started by "splitting" a caesar salad.  Arlo brought what seemed to be full-sized salad for each of us.  We're from California so never expect much of a "fresh" salad on the east coast, but the Mill's Caesar was excellent and perfectly prepared. Next, my wife had the Pan Seared Chilean Sea Bass - on Arlo's recommendation.  She's finicky about her seafood and she's super health conscious.  She doesn't want greasy or fried.  She grilled Arlo a bit on whether the searing would seem fried at all or greasy.  He assured her that it would be perfect.  He was right.  She loved it, and she thoroughly enjoyed Arlo.  I had the Signature Fra Diavolo. OMG!  It was the best.  I thought I was in the Northend of Boston... it was that good! Be assured, you'll enjoy The Mill on the River.  Ask for Arlo (probably everybody does). He's a classic.  We usually tip 15 to 20%, but for Arlo, we made it 25%.   To the management at the Mill:  you have a good one in Arlo!  He is the best.  Thanks for a delightful experience.
OK pizza. Nice staff.

Wow. New Haven needs a new Korean food haven asap bc this place is not it. Went in with the bf and found it completely empty. Placed orders, waited 20 mins for water. 47 mins for food. 48 mins for side dishes. 49 mins for utensils. Too much oil and sides are below average. Think soggy beansprouts, store bought kimchi, burnt odeng. Owners, good people. Opening up a restaurant business, not the greatest idea. Go elsewhere...

I'm at the marriott, which is 3.3 miles away. they didn't know where it is. they wanted me to pick it up. then they said their kitchen is closing. it's 9:10 and they close at 10. guess they really don't need or want the business, nor do they know how to use google maps.  pathetic.

Stumbled across the place and gave it a try. Glad we did! I had a bunch of tapas- the beef chimichurri, the shrimp w/chorizo, and the croquettes. My wife had the cordon bleu panini- everything was excellent!! Had a tomato and mozz salad on the side, it was delicious. Fresh Jersey tomatoes, mozz balls and a nice olive oil and balsamic dressing. We got stuffed, so we took a piece of devils food cheesecake to go. It's a BYOB, and the liquor store next door has a selection of whatever you may want. Great experience, we'll definitely be back again soon.

I really liked this place. The restaurant was clean and smelled amazing, the food was ridiculous (fresh, authentic Italian) and the server that helped us was very attentive. The only thing that sucks is parking. It took us forever to find a spot....but it is Center City, so maybe I shouldn't be whining so much about this. Will be coming back the next time I am in Philly.....

My fiance and I visited Lolita last month. The food is great, the drinks are super refreshing, and the menu is vegan-friendly! What more could you ask for?! When you go, order the guac. Thank me later. Can't wait to go back!
My party of four was seated and 30 minutes later still no waiter. Other tables seated after us had drink orders delivered and food orders taken. We just left.

I got here on a Friday afternoon with my mom and my girlfriend, the place was not crowded so we got a table immediately, as we sat down we were not approached by any server until like 15 minutes later because my girlfriend stared at them. We were given menus yes but we were not given any water or asked if we wanted any drinks, since we waited for so long we quickly knew what we wanted (I had passed by during brunch and the place was packed and food looked good), therefore ordered the steak and eggs. My mom had the chicken and waffles, and my girlfriend the steak sandwich. Overall the service wasn't horrible despite the bad introduction but the food was not the best. My steak was overcooked and super small( and I'm used to eating at steakhouses and have never been served such a small portion), my girlfriends sandwich was tasteless. It came with horseradish and she opted to remove it but then the sandwich completely became tasteless. The meat didn't have any taste was was undercooked even though she asked for medium-well. My mom just hated everything about the chicken and the waffles. After being to Sweet Chick in Brooklyn, nothing lives up to the name. Overall I would never come here to give this place a second chance. My money couldn't have been better spent in a nearby eatery instead of this junk. Nice clean decor though, if you're into pictures and stuff. Ha! Don't come here!
I ll make it really simple......This place is AMAZING!!!!!!  I would have posted pictures of the actual meal, couldn't stop eating long enough to take pictures. =0)

I went here a couple of days ago with my son for lunch.  We were very impressed!  As vegetarians, they had a nice selection for us to choose from.  We shared an appetizer of Zeppole with St. Andre cheese and peppered honey.  Exquisite!  The warm zeppole with the cool cheese was great, but the peppered honey really made it gourmet.  We also each had an entree of Crispy gnocchi with a creamy truffle sauce.  The hand rolled gnocchi were light and cooked to perfection, and the sauce was to die for!  A nice selection of wine and craft beer, a beautiful setting, along with excellent service give this 5 stars.

It was suggested by a friend and I loved this place so much. i would definitely gonna try this place  out again and again. My first experience was quite good enough to decide about the place. I liked the food and the service is quite great to visit this place again. The atmosphere is awesome with the quite relaxing and calm surroundings will definitely make you fan of this place. I would definitely try this place out again. I had chicken taco which was awesome. The service is worth to experience, you should also have to go to experience this place. You will love this place.

Daisiwa is poor man's sushi restaurant. That about sums it up. My partner and I used to frequent this place until we started seeing frozen tuna and salmon boxes in their trash. I read Carolyn's review about the owners driving to NYC to ensure freshness. This is a bold face lie. The miserable owner is unfortunately there EVERYDAY. He is often rude and is always smoking outside. If you're looking for sushi, go to Umai Umai. The price point is a bit higher but you're not going to be flirting with getting a food borne illness.

This place is truly a great find. The fried fish sandwich is incredible for brunch. They also have pancakes and other more traditional brunch items. What makes this place special is the decor. Truly picturesque and one of the more beautiful restaurants in Brooklyn
Was there last night food was great as usual service was goodas I expected thanks again for the great experience
Had a wonderful dinner at La Sirene. The food was wonderful, the service fantastic and overall we had a great time. It was delicious!

This restaurant was recommended by a friend. Came all the way from Rockland county with the love of my Life and the drive was worth it. Staff is excellent, especially our server Juan. The caipirinhas are great! Happy hours are very reasonable ( especially when being frugal )

Even if you don't eat at Reading Terminal Market... it's a great atmosphere.  A great place to check things out.  They have great options and all different kinds of food and baked goods.  It's a great landmark in Philly and if you go to Philly and don't stop in Reading Terminal Market for at least a walk-through, then you've missed out.  But I've been there many times and they have some really good food spots.  I really like the Lamb spot that sells sandwiches.

Ordered 2 grinders take out. First of all, they got both orders wrong but we were starving so no biggie, picked the unwanted items off and dug in. Half way through my husband picked up his second half and there was a big black bug smooshed into the bottom of the roll. Most disgusting dining experience EVER!!
more false advertising. I need chinese delivered. it's just after 9 on a Saturday night. this is the 2nd place that won't deliver 5 minutes away from them.

Loved the smiling, courteous service. Loved the Puri-Bhaji I ordered, and the Kulfi that followed. The restaurant is very clean and pleasant. The prices are very reasonable. It's really nice to be served Indian snack food on china plates rather than on paper plates. Will be back to try out the other delicacies on the menu.

Do yourself a favor and visit Marigold Kitchen in Philly for a wonderful dining experience.  The ambiance is cozy,  wait staff very friendly and professional, and the general manager makes sure you are comfortable and happy.  Every plate (14 small courses) was beautiful to look at and more importantly delicious; and by the end of the experience, very filling satisfying.  This is unlike most restaurants that you will visit.  It's very special and you won't regret it!

Stopped in to watch the World Cup this weekend. Great space with open windows and perfect location right off the L train to the city. Excellent Beer selection and friendly service. Also, Try the Cucumber and Jalapeño margarita, perfect spicy summer drink! The bacon wrapped dates are rich and oh so tasty. This is my new favorite spot in Brooklyn.

I went with okaasan wanting to try this place. I ordered the pancake with pecking duck, & chive pork fried dumplings. She order 8 shrimp boiled dumplings. I must say I have never had a bland dumpling until today...never! No flavor what so ever, & very doughy. The sauce didnt even help either lol the duck pancake was alright though, but I doubt I will come back here lol Overall I can honestly say if you don't have much money to spend, & don't care much for food come here because it will fill you up for less than $10, or even $5

We went there tonight and my girlfriend is throwing up right now. But besides that it was poor in several other ways. We asked for a booth and were told it was a 35-45 minute wait. We walked in without a reservation so that was to be expected. We sat at the bar and had a wine and two cocktails. The wine and one cocktail were disappointing. The cocktail was especially bad. Pama Old Fashioned was the name of it iirc. Avoid that drink. Funny enough the bartender admitted the drink list needed to be updated and "there's not very much that's good on it." After 50 minutes at the bar a hostess tried to seat us at a very small table directly next to the waiter's computer kiosk and restrooms. We declined that and after talking to her boss she offered us a high seat table across from the bar. Again we declined. Keep in mind that we specifically requested a booth and agreed to wait an extra amount of time for it. So after we stood in front of the hostess desk and discussed going to a quality restaurant directly across the street we were suddenly seated at what appeared to be almost the best booth in the house. Unfortunately that would be the highlight of the evening. Although the waitress was very professional and did everything to deserve a good tip I still felt wrong giving it to her. The food took almost as long to come out as it took to get our booth. The lobster ravioli was tasteless and the meal I ordered, a pork sausage and flat pasta dish that I dont recall the name of, tasted like a discount family dinner from the frozen section. I literally commented that while still eating it. The best tasting dish was the calamari appetizer. Overall this place just sucks. I could deal with the wait if the food blew me away but the food being a massive disappointment was the nail in the coffin and reason for this review. Oh and in all the time it took me to write this my girlfriend is still throwing up. Skip this place and eat across the street instead.
Always delighted to find vegan food, Charlie ... is a truly delightful find. Funky, hip, BRILLIANT food, and adventurous cocktails make this place simply divine. My current Philly favorite!
More like Pizza hut.
Delicious hot food and excellent service.

One of the best Sicilian squares I've ever tried. Very big squares though. Only 2 is enough for me to fill me up. The place itself is a nice and cozy, the atmosphere is as well. I was passing by on my way to my friends house, I guess I will be coming here again. And of course I got some Italian Ices as well, just because it's hype, so I'm definitely a regular customer of theirs. Squares are highly recommended.

Wow!  A great server was icing on the cake! Thank you Samantha for suggesting the Sherry Vinegarette salad dressing -  that was definitely a treat!  And the Spaghetti Pomodoro with meat sauce was excellent - maybe the best i've ever had!   Need a good wine choice?  Get a bottle of 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon.  Nice!

I went in a second time, ready to pay full price, and get exactly what I wanted. I ordered "build your own mashed potatoes" I guess that sounds too much like smashed, or whatever stupid cubed nasty looking chunks they put out for me. I'm like, "mashed, I ordered mashed potatoes " Nope. Gotta say mashed PIE to get effing mashed potatoes. "Smashed" potatoes are not squished, they are cubes. Why would you name it that? They clearly didn't want to remake it, and I was tired (because I haven't eaten today) of arguing with people who don't care as long as I leave. So I left. good place good atmosphere

The doughnuts were great. Samoa? Delicious! The food was good too! You can't beat the prices either. But the service? Awful. I would hardly call it service. Our waitress took our order (had to repeat a few things) and we never saw her again. My boyfriend even had to go up to the counter to get his drink refilled. This place would be a really great spot, they just have to get people in there that know how to wait tables.

We've been meaning to use our $20 coupon since we moved to E. Rutherford. Finally made it in here earlier today. We were greeted by Billy (cheery owner) and helped instantly. I had a salad which was very fresh and good. A bit chincy with only 3-4 pieces of grilled shrimp in my salad, but overall I was satisfied. Fiancée loved the sandwich he got and the rice ball. Unanimous thumbs up on the FRESH MOZZARELLA!!! We come back for sure!

I am obsessed with this place! I eat here or get delivery from them twice a week. Try the fish taco, surf n turf, and the little meats. Man the little meats is so amazing. They do it right. Everyone who works here is so friendly and happy. I will be back again and again.
One of the most well-known Chinese restaurants in New Haven and it deserves the reputation.
A fantastic neighborhood spot.  Extra star for their own Pat Lafrieda hamburger blend.
Great service and they actually played almost all major college games on there TVs. Nachos were a little burnt but good, wings were decent also and drinks were great.. would visit again!
Bland pulled pork and okay fish n' chips leaves you wanting something better.  I think the burgers are good from the other patrons' reactions, but our experience left a lot to be desired.

Parking is an absolute nightmare, a limo is highly recommended.  Or else you'll need to leave time for stalking past patrons for a spot. The legs at this establishment believe they are a step above a Don Coqui type, so they put on their best outfit and simmer down the accents.  For some reason they fluffed me about the unavailability of outside seating, I was sent to the bar for a drink while I wait.  When I finally got my table outside there was a plethora of available tables.  The mosquitoes do not stop!  They could have at least put some citronella in the candles.  It's hard to enjoy the meal when you're being ravaged by west nile.  Food was good, menu was limited.  Waitress was brain dead with a unibrow. The view was the best part of the experience.

The food was awesome and the drinks was amazing, I definitely will come back again. The salmon is amazing if your looking for seafood. I tried the mac & cheese which is also good as a appetizer. I came from happy hour and the drinks weren't bad. The view by the water was spectacular. The service was great & music was very good

I just left from having brunch here and I must say, not only is the food delectable but the service is right up to par with the amazing view of the city I got to experience, my server Felicia was really funny and super hospitable. She check on our table several times and my boyfriend and I enjoyed our experience there thanks to the great staff.  The food was finger licking good and we left wanting to go back for more.. We will definitely be back to this beautiful place with great atmosphere!

I heard about blend on the water a while ago an I'm so upset at myself for not coming sooner ! It was just an awesome experience from beginning to end.. We had a bit of a wait because we had no reservation but we were sat eventually and our server Felicia had nothing but great laughs and awesome recommendations from drinks to apps to entres and even dessert ! I never really take the opinions of others because I'm a very picky eater but she was very accommodating to my needs, as my mother is a vegetarian; we had the arepas which were especially prepared half vegetarian for us! The pernil, chicken fried rice, red snapper and salmon burger are ALL MUST HAVES ! The mojitos were deliciously flavored in a wide assortment ! (We had guava, coconut, strawberry & mango!) we shared the dessert platter because we couldn't just pick ONE ! We devoured it completely! I must say, Felicia is a phenomenal addition to the amazing view and atmosphere and complimented the chefs dishes with a divine attitude and cheerful spirit. We will return with hopes to have her again!

Con: very little flavor in their dishes. Pro: get lots of food for the money. Went on yelp and saw 4 out of 5 stars. Ordered the pad thai because that is the basic dish that all thai restaurants should do well. It had very little flavor. Only giving two stars because it is a lot of food for the money.

Le P'tit Paris Bistro was wonderful, as always.we went there beforehand. I love the place for the service, the amazing food, the attention to detail. It's a bit more casual than Daniel Boulud's other restaurants, which is another thing I love about it. Easygoing and informal, with excellent food. What more could one possibly want?

Used to be great. Staff is unfriendly, was kicked out of the patio because the rule is you can't sit outside with out eating, great vibe to create for a failing restaurant. Way to say no to business, won't be back again. And the hostess especially bad an attitude. Such a shame for what used to be a wonderful restaurant.
Nice staff. Food tastes good and looks good too!

Obsessed with Greek taverna! Their Greek salad is to die for. It's hard not to fill up on the pita bread because it's so delicious. The fish here is super fresh as well. Never get tired of coming here

I went to school at Trinity College nearby and I loved this little restaurant then and I love it now. Every time I come back to the school I make sure to visit this place and get the spicy chicken Gorgonzola. Amazing.
Not from the city, and this place was a perfect intro into the NY food scene. Go here. Now.
The brisket sandwich was very very delicious. I'm not a big red meat guy but this was worth it. Also the beans with burnt ends were phenomenal.

Zero Stars for Bigoted Behavior. There is a serious management problem at Brickyard. On two different occasions I have been with a large group of friends of different races.   In both instances snide racial comments were made by both bar and waitstaff about the race of my friends.  Obviously not to our faces but amongst each other when they assumed no one was listening (ironic considering they are mostly undocumented workers from Ireland).  Even radicalized comments and conversations of customers are not only tolerated but encouraged. It's a shame because Brickyard is an ok bar, but I cannot abide by their bigoted behavior.  It you appear to be anything other than White, Enter At Your Own Risk.

Im Reiseführer haben wir gelesen, dass es um die South Street einige leckere Restaurants hat, darum sind wir auch dort hin. Ein paar dunkle Ecken später sahen wir diese Perle und sind gleich rein. Die Eineichtung ist grosszügig, die Räume hoch und der Geräuschpegel ganz in Ordnung. Auf der Karte gibt es vor allem Fleisch, also nichts für Vegetarier. Wir hatten zuerst Drinks bestellt. Wir fragten nach und sie machten uns das gewünschte, auch wenn es nicht auf der Karte stand. Positiv: Sie wussten auch auf Anhieb, was in diese Deinks gehört. Wir hatten Spareribs und Pulles Pork, sowie Fries und Maccaroni with Chese dazu. Das Fleisch ist von toller Qualität und super gewürzt. Auch die Beilagen waren echt der Hammer. Die Portionen sind gross und die teuerste Hauptspeisenist gerade mal um die 20 Dollar. Die eine Bestellung hatten sie verwechselt und so mussten wir knapp 3 Minuten auf einen Hauptgang warten, was in meinen Augen extrem schnell ist. Mehrere Leute haben sich entschuldigt: Der Hauptgang ging aufs Haus, zusätzlich gab es noch Bohnen und Fries, alles aufs Haus! Nicht aus diesem Grund würde ich nochmal hingehen, sondern weil es einfach absolut lecker war, wir volle Mägen hatten, super Qualität und das zu einem unschlagbaren Preis.

The bacon cheeseburger on a donut bun was delicious wish it was bigger! The beer-battered onion rings were great but they only give you five of them....The adult milkshake which was the banana foster was out of this world!!!....the downer is there was a bug on the bench as I was being  seated...we also had dirty utensils
Excellent and worth the wait. Banana pancakes, Biscuits and gravy and fried green tomatoes are my favorites by far.  The service was fantastic and drinks are perfect for brunch.

I had the worst experience here a few years ago, to which I wrote a scathing review, only to have taken down, without a teace. SHaDY Yelp! I won't get into it again.... but I will tell you this, the food is over priced, lackluster,  and a hipster with a pissy attitude threatened to kick my ass, cos I was annoyed that her and her "too cool for school" boyfriend were relentlessly making out and literally swaping strings of saliva while we tried to eat!  NAUSEATING!!!!!!!

Attempted to grab a drink before our show. The place was busy but not packed. We waited over ten minutes for a bartender before walking out. The decor was very nice, and the drinks looked good but if you never get the chance to order, what's the point?

My wife and I like Thai food a lot.  Started eating in the early '80s when it broke in California.  Sri Pra Phai is pretty fair, but does not live up to the hype.  Food is good but on par with other good Thai places around the city.  Service staff is uneven and the buzz probably puts too much load on them and causes the service issues.  We were rushed to finish, and change was not returned until we asked for it.  (We left the change, but that should be OUR choice, not an assumption.)  Food is fine but avoid busy nights and don't make a special trip.  I could name two other restaurants in Queens that are as good, and some in Manhattan and Brooklyn that are better - mostly for the service and atmosphere.

My poor rating is solely focused on the older woman/owner poor attitude and complete lack of appreciation for paying customers.  I generally do not complain but refuse to feel like its bothering someone to order a sandwich star deli.  She barely opens her frowned lips enough to say the price of your purchase let alone a thank you or have a nice day.  Don't get me wrong the food is very good but I hope this person goes out of buisness.   Also understand this wasn't merely a once or twice experience.  I've been to Angelo's Deli about ten times for lunch and always get the same nasty attitude.   I will be sticking with some more customer friendly small buisneses in the area (i.e.Espositos, Avelinos, Sorentos,Cammarata's, Tutto Fresco).  Too bad as I really do enjoy the food but refuse to give such a miserable person my hard earned money.......

Consistently amazing and while they do deliver, the real treat is going there to eat in person!  Old school decor, great service and absolutely deliciously made traditional brick oven pizza.  Mouth is watering again :)
THE best pork chive dumplings I've ever had.  And you simply can not beat the prices.  The staff is a little crusty, so they lose a star, But I will keep coming back!

Came to this restaurant after finding a good review online. The staff there were a bit on the rough side, lack of customer service was definitely present but if you are looking for something really quick, cheap and extremely delicious, this is the place. We ordered four large items and paid $9. We could not finish our entire meal and the dumplings were some of the best we ever has. Check out if you are on the Lower East Side. I've had a lot of dumplings from a number of dumpling shops throughout NYC and other areas Prosperity Dumplings gives you a lot of food for your buck. I bought a bunch of dumplings cooked in a variety of ways, plus two large soups for just over $10.00. It is your normal Chinatown take out shop. What this shop lacks in size, you get in quantity. The food has a fast turn around. The food has to be good, when the shop is always packed with locals as well as visitors. You can always tell a good place to eat, when you see the locals packing the place We go here everytime we visit New York. The place is super small. There are 4 bar stools with small counters in case you are lucky enough to grab one. We got 20 Dim Sum (1 order of vegetable and 1 order of lamb) and the total was $7.20. They steam them, don't boil or bake. It started to pour so i wads lucky and got two of the bar stools and chowed down. Dang it was good. i ate the rest in the hotel room that night. You aren't here for the ambiance, you are here for the food. There is a line out the door and folks stand outside eating their dumplings and chatting. Don't miss Prosperity Dumpli.
Simply good!
This place is a great neighborhood spot. The food is always so good and the staff are great - a phenomenal place!
This place is has good pizza love it. They clean and have good costumer service. I love there chicken cutlet.

As a Brooklyn resident, I'm very accustomed to quality food at our local restaurants and typically laugh at restaurants outside of the NYC environs.  I was in NJ for a business meeting last week and given traffic, elected to have dinner west of the Hudson.  Positive media reviews led me to Terre a Terre and I was really surprised by the experience.  Excellent, fresh food in a charming, clean setting, with friendly service.  I had the lump crab croquettes and the scallops -- both delicious (I'm a sucker for anything that includes truffle oil).  With Fall now upon us, it will be interesting to see what the chef will put together for an Autumnal menu.
I work here 6 days a week And hangout here on my day off... It's gotta be a pretty great place :)

I love everything about Ippudo aside from the huge lines. I would love to frequent this establishment more often but unfortunately I can not stand waiting in lines.  The ramen broth is the best in the city and the pork buns are oh so delicious.
awesome ramen
We love Stowe's, we usually get the clam strip boat and the shrimp boat. They are delicious and a good price.
this place is around the corner from my house go here all the time for the spinach and mushroom large pie soooo good and their caesar salad is very tasty also

We just had the worst service ever from This place. The waitress wouldn't let us put three table (small tables) together for 6 people even though no one was in the place...then she told us that we could go somewhere else . So we left
My friend and I always come here when we need a good meal knowing anything will be delicious. The waitstaff is always great and I've had most of what's on the menu and everything is amazing!

So we went for my mothers 75th birthday. My sister called far in advance and said we had a party of 14. She called again that day to confirm and was told that they would set us up in front of the fireplace where there's a lot of room.  We arrived at 7pm and we were seated up a few stairs in an area too small for our large party and at an "L" shaped table where my sister was squished at the corner.  It took our waitress more than 10 minutes to pour everyone water and she kept forgetting my brother-in-law even though he asked twice.   Onto the ordering. We all ordered salads (not a difficult order) and it took forever for some of us to get ours. Some of us were done with our salads and still 10 minutes went by without some of us even getting ours. My brother-in-law complained and we were offered a free round of drinks. Ok. Then the entrees came and not until we waited another twenty minutes. My New York Strip (which I ordered medium-well) was pink and bloody. I ate it because I like it that way too but it had a lot of fat on it and it was chewy.  Not impressed with the food at all and this is supposed to be a steak house. We had three waitresses and the waiting time was my biggest complaint.  One star and that's it.  I'll never go there again. Maybe it's better if you're a smaller party or if you sit in the bar but not worth the $31 I paid for my steak and the $10 I paid for for the salad.   This is the second time my sister and her husband went there and the first time they waited 2 hours to get their order taken and drinks (I would have left way before that). Not sure how they're still in business but this place is a waste of time. Save your money.

Food wise, it's delicious. Service wise, just awful. Time and time again, we've ordered delivery, and takes them 1.5 hours to deliver it 1 mile. But it's delicious so i'm torn, but this is just ridiculous now.

Great ambiance and really loved our waitress! The chef had chilled corn soup which was wonderful, my friend had the warm vegetable salad and that was amazing as well as my rigatoni with ragu and ricotta! Dessert definitely get apple cider donuts they were to die for! Wine menu is a little difficult to read we asked for Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc, the waitress bought us two similar wines to them and they were very good!

This is a small funky (chain) restaurant selling fairly simple but good quality food. We put our name by the door as it was a busy Friday night, and happily had a drink across the road. We duly got a text message in about 30 mins - great when a system like this works. The service was fun and knowledge and the cocktails excellent and well priced. The food is meatballs either in a roll or with sides like potatoes and salad. It's simple but done well. With the atmosphere, this is a great choice. Do not miss the ice cream sandwiches at the end!

I've driven past this place for years and finally stopped in today....amazing! I've been looking for a great Mexican food place since I moved back to CT (3 years ago) and my search is finally complete! Salsa is authentic, free chips are warm (which is a big plus for me) and everything is reasonably priced. Great menu options. I got the taco salad ( lots of meat) and my bf got the chipotle steak asado. YUM!

I was thinking to go out with the friends but the place wasn't decided we tried to decide but we were confused about the places. I love this place as this was the most wonderful place in NY, I loved this place and have visited just once. A friend of mine suggested this palce to us. We went there and experienced a first class service and the atmosphere. We had a great time in there. The food here is great and the service is quick with the staff which is friendly, the atmosphere is great and calm we had fun there.The server was awesome. I am gonna visit this place again. The first experience was great, hoping best for the next visit.

The decor looks great! And even though I'm vegan, I've eaten here a number of times and the chefs have created delicious options for me including cavatelli and the tastiest cooked veggies I've had! The others in my party really enjoyed the whole fish they ordered and are definitely looking forward to coming again.

This is my 2nd time at Mercato & even though I enjoyed most of my dinner last time (risotto)  my wife didn't like hers but another couple asked us to go so we wanted to give it another try.  Cramped and loud is an understatement, I am all for getting as many diners as you can into a restaurant but we literally were elbow to elbow with the diners next to us, maybe an inch or 2 at most separated our tables, it was uncomfortable b/c you had to yell so anyone could hear you so having a private conversation was not a possibility.   Apps - None of us liked our apps, the brushetta trio was the worst, the bread was so thick and hard that you had to cut it which made the toppings topple right off the bread and there was no seasoning on any of the toppings, at one point we were going to ask for salt but then just decided on not finishing it.  The arancini, you got 1 little ball and the smokinness of the mozzarella was overpowering. You would have thought the waitress noticing most of us didn't finish our apps would have questioned us a bit on if we really enjoyed everything, no. Entrees - Salmon was delicious, Pasta stuffed with lobster and shrimp was just as disappointing as our last visit and I even asked the woman next to me who had eaten it how it was before I ordered and she just kind of shrugged her shoulders, I took that as she wasn't wanting to talk to me but now I think she probably just didn't want to flat out say that it was horrible, the pasta was overcooked and thick & the filling had no flavor. Veal was literally pounded & dropped into a deep fryer, nothing different than I would have gotten at a diner and lastly, the chicken was dry and the polenta was lumpy. Dessert - Gelato was returned as it was sour even though the waitress came back and told us the chef said it wasn't but then mysteriously we heard the waiters & waitresses start telling patrons that they had switched the gelato from Maple to blueberry hmm, my wife is a pastry chef so I think she knows when something is sour, the rest of the desserts were good.   If the food was better I might consider putting up with the uncomfortable cramped seating but I can honestly say I will never go back to this restaurant, not with so many better options in the city.

I just ordered 2 ordees of chicken Francaise without pasta. The order was delivered in no time so kudos and good tip for him. However the service sucks!! I was charged $ 34 for two orders. At least send a small salad instead of the two orders of pasta or something PLUS I specifically requested bread and received none.. i used to love it here but never again with this place
Cheap and good. Just that simple.
Staff was very awesome and food was great! We are from Texas and the food tastes excellent!

I can't even give them 1 star because the ladies took 20 mins for 2 hot mochaccinos and 1 iced.. They didn't speak English.. Ok fine, my brother can speak Spanish, but they were rude and their register wasn't cooperating resulting in short change..

We went here for my birthday last December . There brisket is amazing. My boyfriend had the fish tacos. It's more of a bar type restaurant. It was very busy in there . (Friday night & around the holidays ) .we had a wait which was to be expected since we didn't have a reservation. I'm not even sure if they take reservations. Once we were seated out waitress was very fast to take our order. The food was delicious. More tex-mex than Mexican . We didn't order any drinks. It is definitely a must try. The down size was the parking & at the time we were not aware of any parking lots available (which later on going to the piazza for a concert we found). We drove around for like 10 minutes trying to find street parking. Which was our fault for not finding.
Great eats.
Being deemed "Best Sandwich in America" by Adam Richman is a lot to live up to. I went in with pretty high expectations and still thoroughly enjoyed myself. Great food and good people.
One of my favorite burger places. Truffle burger, truffle fries, and sea salt ice cream are the best. Service is friendly and relatively quick depending on how crowded the place is. Nice decor.

Greeting - no Vibe- AA meeting meets barfly Service - you have to work for it Bathroom- fail Price-  good Parking- street or garage Food $7.50 huge burger at least 8 oz. gross lettuce single leaf on top, mealy tomato slice and harsh onion slice on bottom. Order it plain and you have one of the best burger deals ever. The meat quality is not great but for the price you get a bargain You pay at least double for this burger anywhere else. WIGB? Probably. Overall a gross place with a huge cheap burger. Beef quality is undetermined
The flavor and lack of chopped preparation for the steak is a letdown for me.  Alas.  I'll stick with Pat's or Dalessandros.

Absolutely amazing! We had a party of 10 and we had our own private room. The food was fabulous. First off the bread was a fresh baked sourdough and we had 3 rounds of it. It was the best bread I ever ate.  The lobster bisque soup was amazing and dipping the bread in was the icing on the cake! I had the scallop dinner which was so wonderful. My friends had the filet and it was to die for!! The sides are extra but they are big enough to share 2 or 3 people. I shared lobster mashed potatoes and let me say I could eat that everyday! It was pricey however it was so worth it!

This place is so cool!! I loveeeeee the décor and the staff is so nice. I also love how spacious this place is! I've only been here twice and the service was always great and the drinks are seriously impeccable!! The twizzler martini has to be my favorite drink! Its soooo delicious. I'm not a big fan of their food though but that's OK. I will still continue to come here for a appetizer and a few drinks. Loyal customer here!

Great atmosphere - just like a favourite brasserie in Paris except the service here was polite and helpful (unlike Parisians!) with thought through recommendations tailored to their take on me. I had the trout followed by a sorbet - just what I wanted for a light supper - the fish was perfectly cooked with balanced herbs that complemented and enhanced; the mango sorbet was refreshing and cleansing. Highly recommended.

I am from the south and it is hard to find good New York style pizza anywhere. Although this place was well on poi t. Very good New York style pizza. Service is fast and prices are very decent for what you get. Great place to eat if you are in a hurry with tasty delicious pizza!!

Yes, you will be likely told that the wait for a table is two hours or more. Don't be put off. Grab a coffee at any of the places nearby and keep an eye on the incoming text to tell you that it's time for your party to be seated. Pancakes are the best i have had in over twenty countries. They are full and filling, yet also light and fluffy with a perfectly crispy edge. Go the Blueberry. The chocolate and banana are also great, but the Maine Blueberry perfectly complements the pancake. Also excellent Southern style cooking fare with grits, eggs, and greens. Will definitely bring out of town folks here and be ready to come on my own with a few hours to spare.

Sugar cured bacon. Bellini. Blueberry pancakes with warm maple butter. Pure heaven. We arrived a few minutes before they opened for dinner so we didn't have to wait. I had read great reviews about this place and begged my friends to make the trek with me. We were not disappointed.

Delicious food, incredible service, beautiful decor!!! VITE Vinestoria is a real gem! Great for friends and family, cute two-person tables for date nights, and the perfect bar to enjoy happy hour. I will be a regular here for sure. Forget Manhattan, go to VITE in Astoria! Very highly recommended!

I love bare burger because they not only have delicious food, but also excellent service. They were very understanding and were happy to make my order to my specifications even though it took longer. Happily recommend it to everyone!

Don't go anywhere else! I like my burgers in assorted verity and Bareburger HOOKED IT UP! Personally, I frequently enjoy everything rare and Bareburger understood what I mean. Highly recommend it! Must visit
Amazing food!! Really fast giving us our food!! Good service nice people... Really good music as well. definitely coming back
The restaurant had great Korean food as I expected. The restaurant was clean and big to accommodate many customers. The staffs were friendly and able to get whatever we needed during our meal.

Balthazar, and all the McNally restaurants have long been at the top of our list, and we have been to them all. We returned for lunch and had a wonderful time. We were seated at one of our favorite banquettes, and the staff couldn't have been more attentive or friendlier. The food was as always, fantastic. Great oysters, escargot, duck shepherd's pie and their incredible lamb sandwich paired with a great bottle of Chablis.

I've known the owner of this business for years and I am writing this review not to just give a 5 star review but because the food is actually delicious, Nir knows how to decorate a dish and make it look like a masterpiece, his style of cooking originates from the Middle East and as a native I can swear that his cooking is as close as you can get to an authentic main course meal. Yes I must admit the service and wait staff can use a little work, but considering how busy they get it's understandable why the service is a little slow. My suggestion is to come in during the slower times to enjoy a quiet and delicious meal.

We went on a Sunday for the brunch buffet. I had seen this place many months ago when passing it by, but then completely forgot about it. Now time to actually go! It wasn't very crowded, considering that this place is HUGE. We got a spot on the second floor, calm and nice just like the rest of the place. The buffet was ok. Lots of different options to eat. It actually looked really fresh and nice for being a buffet. The wait staff was really nice from start to finish. Kept coming up to the second floor, taking orders for drinks and eggs. Overall really nice service. The bathroom was also spotless and beautiful. The food tasted just ok. Pretty whatever, nothing I would talk about a few days from now. Overall the food was what you can expect from a buffet. The vegetable scrambled egg I had though did not look tasty and was so bland I could no finish it. The french fries tasted unfinished. The tea had a weird after taste. Loved the selection of cheese, salmon, jams, olives and bread though! The egg salad was great. Would recommend this place for friends that is looking for a great brunch deal. Going for brunch can easily be a pricey story and here we got drinks / coffee / tea / juice / unlimited buffet for a set price of $24.99. After tax and tip it wasn't bad, considering the options of food offered. Would go back to do some work during the day. Would easily find a spot on the second floor due to the size of this place.
Loved the lunch we had here which was quite good and then we found out we were eating at the ground floor of the building filmed as the home of the sitcom Friends. The food is good as is the venue.

Came here for brunch today. Have been for dinner before and am always impressed. Great vibe and decor, a real neighborhood spot. If you can score a seat outside and ts nice enough weather of course definitely try and get a table out there. Marc forgione keeps things really interesting, the dishes all have a unique spin on them. We ordered: The burger - one of the best I've had in a while with onions pepper jack and a fried egg Bacon egg and cheese - sun dried tomatoes, parmasean cheese They also give you these great everything bagel rolls with veggie cream cheese spread that was a really nice touch. They do a miniature version of these at his other places. His other restaurants are khe oh and american cut and I really like all these places. Great spot for a date, or dinner with friends.
best Japanese Curry I've had in a while!

Excellent atmosphere and delicious pizza. The building itself is very interesting, complete with a view of the huge brick oven used to bake the pizzas and the tanks used to brew the house beers. There is a lively but not overwhelming vibe. It's usually quite busy there and they only take reservations in advance for large groups (according to their voicemail.) They do takeout (theoretically) but both times that I've tried calling to place an order, the automated voice message system used to answer calls/put you through to place an order was never answered. I gave 4/5 stars because of two things: first, the service was pretty inattentive (I had to hunt down our waitress for drink refills AND for our check) and despite the quality, I think the prices are a little high for what you get. That said, I would go again.
Very delicious Italian food. Everything at this place is literally gorgeous! Cant wait to go there again next weekend:) Prices are also reasonable.

Have been to Risotto House 5-6 times & always enjoyed the food & service. Always had the lamb shank & I recommended it to others that I sent to Risotto House. We were 4 people last night. Had an 8 o'clock reservation which was honored on time. Surprisingly the restaurant was only 1/2 full on a Sat night. The 4 of us ordered appetizers & also 4 lamb shanks. The waiter took our order & shortly returned saying "there is only one left". What? At 8 o'clock on a Sat night? This dish is what we came for & travelled 1/2 hr to the restaurant as our friends did also.  Of course the waiter was apologetic but nothing could be done. We ordered subsitute dishes but of course our dissappointment overshadowed our enjoyment of the subsitute dishes. We ordered one desert for the table & 3 coffees. I personally was shocked that the waiter or hostess didn't pick up the desert & coffee charge. It was a small meaningless amount but would have gone a long way "politically" & also good will. I gave TWO STARS in rating the restaurant because of our dissappointment & also not enjoying the rest of the evening due to this.

The legendary burgers? Good. Not the best I've ever had, but good. However, it was definitely not worth the huge wait (more than 40 minutes after placing our order for 4 people, with about 4-5 other regular-sized orders of a few burgers each ahead of ours to be filled.) For a place where burgers are literally the only things on the menu that need preparation, that is outrageous. We were able to order within seconds of walking though the door but still had that long of a wait. The staff have a reputation for their sarcasm and sass, which is supposed to be part of the charm of this place, but what I witnessed was rather forced and uncomfortable. The guy taking orders tried one of his "jokes" on a very confused 10 year-old trying to order chips. When she didn't pick up on it, instead of letting it slide, he repeated himself, asked if she understood, and when she shook her head, he proceeded to explain it in painstaking detail. Since I ended up waiting around for 40 minutes to get my burgers, I heard him use the same jokes and sarcastic comments about 10 times apiece. One thing I will commend are the cool old vertical grills used to prep the burger patties, and the charming old-style interior. I don't suggest planning to stay and eat your burgers unless you are fine with tons of people standing around you waiting for their orders to be filled. If you must try the burgers, call ahead and place your order for pickup. It'll save you a lot of grief.

I went to catfish with some friends visiting from out of town and while the food was decent, it wasn't worth the wait. They took an hour to make two orders of shrimp and grits and a catfish sandwich. The crazy long wait became a conversation starter with the other tables because we all waited a minimum of an hour to get our food. The food was okay, but I've had better and they definitely will not be getting repeat business from me.
Love the food! The Churrasco is to die for and there is always salsa and Hispanic music playing. Definitely recommend. It is a small place, but it's comfortable and the ambient is very nice.

Just terrible. Walked into a relatively empty bar around 9pm on a Saturday. A couple walked in after us and went and stood at the bar while we took seats toward the end, minutes prior. With zero acknowledgement of our presence, the bartender approaches the other couple first, whom he knows, shakes hands, pours shots for all of them and proceeds to engage in conversation. At this point, we waited just to see how long they would go without even making eye contact or approaching us with the intent to service. A Barback, what looked like a manager and a server all "saw" us at one point and no one as much as gave us a nod or a "hey, we'll be with you in a minute." 8 minutes later, we got up and walked out. Idiots.

Searched on Yelp for somewhere low-key within walking distance from our hotel & MP had the fewest bad reviews. So we decided to eat there. Sunday night around 7:30 & there was only 1 other table of 4. Bartender/server was very polite & we got our drinks quickly. White sangria packed a punch & while they were out of the IPA my SO wanted the suggested substitue seemed to do the job. Appy of the bruchetta - 6 pieces, 2 of each, with good quantity of toppings. The mushroom was our favorite, the carmelized onion good but the cream cheese was somewhat overpowering. We ordered the steak sandwich & clubhouse to share. Fries were average. Sandwiches were tasty, the steak could have used something to give it some punch like a horseradish mayo. Both had good amounts of fillings & ingredients tasted fresh. SO wanted dessert so he chose the Tollhouse pie. Sort of more like a pecan pie but with walnuts. Ihad a bite, seemed ok, but not my thing. I was eyeing the brownie with the cheesecake filling - the other table had that & it looked good. Overall, MP did the job & wasn't disappointing. Looking forward to some stellar meals however as our week in NY gets fully underway tomorrow.

Poor service, poor food, great cheesecake. I had heard a lot of good things about Juniors, mainly of course about their cheesecake. I decided to eat in the restaurant for dinner, I ordered the chicken & shrimp, buffalo wings, and Mac & cheese.
