The service was slow and poor, when my food was served the wings side order was wrong and I was served shrimp, but after a complaint this was sorted. The food was warm, simple and bland. I asked to take some leftovers away, half of the food wasn't packed and the waiter charged me for the wrong side on top of the correct side dish. Overall the meal was expensive and underwhelming. The impression I received was very poor and I would recommend anyone wanting to try juniors head next door to the Juniors cheesecake takeaway, but don't eat in and definitely don't order mains.
Manager was extra helpful and friendly. Food was delicious. Place was nice and clean.

We placed our order for a large party ahead of time to be ready when we arrived for lunch break.  We got there and the food wasn't ready, that's ok.  What wasn't ok was the food started coming out, crappy sandwich after crappy sandwidch.  The last people to get their sandwiches waited 45 min.  By that time the waitress attitude was so bad she slammed the tray down and didn't even deliver the last sandwich.   Wow....
Great place! We had lunch there and the food was great, especially the lobster ravioli. They have a full bar as well, which was a pleasant surprise

This is a very, very special place. My wife and I came here the day after they opened --  incidentally -- and Jeremy and Damien were so welcoming.  I've eaten here for dinner several times since they opened and have stopped in for a few afternoon beers. Every time we are welcomed back as friends. The atmosphere is romantic at night, and fun during the day. When you go, I highly recommend the la Chèvre (Tarte Flambee). They also offer cocktails that are made with Sake that I thought were going to be weird (not a sake fan) but they were really good. My favorite part of the restaurant is the owners, but the atmosphere and the food really live up to expectations as well. It's become a go-to spot for our family and our friends too!

The meal I had here was outstanding! I came here with my family for dinner and there wasn't a thing we ate that was less than amazing. We started dinner off with the fried calamari with ginger and cinnamon dipping sauce. I must say I had reservations about the sauce but boy was I wrong - even my father who is super picky loved it! I shared the butternut squash and crab meat risotto which was very rich and creamy. It was delicious to say the least - I recommend it to everyone! I also had the veal Milanese which was tender and the salad was the perfect pairing. Other members of my party got the linguini with seafood and lemon shrimp. I tried everything since I couldn't resist. Absolutely phenomenal. Can't wait to go again and it's byob!!

The atmosphere is comfortable, warm and unpretentious, echoed by the dress code which they state as "business casual". We both had the seasonal tasting menu, which was delicious, inventive and beautifully-presented. The service was excellent - attentive without being intrusive - and the staff accommodated my boyfriend's birthday with a small coconut cake, which was tasty and a added lovely special touch to the evening. The restaurant also boasts an extensive wine list, ordered by grape variety.

The artichoke pizza is always delicious. Very rich and creamy. The slices are a great size, I could barely finish one. Tried the crab pizza as well but I have mixed feelings about it. Will definitely always come back for the artichoke pizza though.
Nice place with very good service. The food is really good, I liked the special big burger the most. Give it a try, you won't regret.

Incredibly boring. I wanted to like this place, since my companions were not excited about coming and I love proving people wrong. But in the end, I was wrong. The ambiance was lovely, it had a bright, fun interior with lighting just dim enough to set the mood. The waitstaff was efficient, not overly friendly, but timely. The wine list was extensive, we ordered a bottle of Italian Merlot for the table which was fairly good. Everything was going well until the food arrived. All courses were edible but boring and unimaginative. My entree, mushroom ravioli, was small (three large ravioli, scarcely enough for a meal) and terribly greasy. My companions ordered massive burgers, which were so salty they were hard to eat. Not a memorable experience, a solid "meh" in my book.
My 3rd time here service is good , cool place to grab food and a beer on a Sunday afternoon . Tips - Burger was great as always !!!!
Quinoa risotto and pisco sours for the win!  Great addition to the neighborhood.

Had the apple crisp pancake and it was pretty good, just a little under cooked. My girlfriend had eggs, panfries and hash. It was super greasy and the eggs were also under cooked. Our waitress stopped showing up after bringing us our food. Drinks went empty and we had to get the check from another server.
Pecking duck was the best we ever had. Crispy fish was incredible too! Great good and very good service. Will go back again!
Amazing drinksssssss.

My girlfriend had made a reservation for this past Saturday at 7:30pm a few days ago. We hadn't been out to a nice dinner in a while and were looking forward to experiencing this place for the first time. As we sat down, the waitress proceeded to tell us what they were out of. Seeing as my gal and I don't eat meat, we were disappointed that the two best options for us were gone including any seafood or fish or pasta without meat.  Dejected, we decided to leave. Perhaps some restaurants consider it a sign of success when they greet customers with core dishes missing but I find it unprofessional and we felt like we wasted our time. We ate Thai in Chelsea Market instead. Despite this, my gal convinced me to try Green Table again next week but we will call first to see if their menu is intact.
Everything about the market is great.  It's truly something you have to experience on your own to understand.

I'm not a needy customer what's so ever but if you a customers whole meal on the side that should mean something . My girlfriend and I went for a midnight snack and I ordered the hungry man special it was pretty good . The ham was a little rough but besides that it was good . On the flip side the pizza they had was absolutely nasty . The sauce and pizza was just not appetizing what's so ever . We had asked the other waiters for her opinion and she said it was great . Being a server once before I always would be honest for the fact that the service and meal would rely on the customer being content . Definitely would not go here except for breakfast .

Created a Yelp profile just so I could sing the praises of this amazing bar -- as well as our server (Samantha)! Amazing food, chill atmosphere, and a never ending supply of '90s music. We found our new neighborhood bar!

I visited Cafe Mogador for brunch one Sunday. The menu has a number of good dishes. The food is very good, with interested Mediterranean-style choices. Like most brunch spots in Williamsburg, the cafe was full of people and had a really upbeat atmosphere. Great experience overall.

Grilled Corn Mexican Style served with mayonnaise, cotija cheese (hard cow's milk cheese that originated from Mexico. It is named after the town of Cotija, Michoacán), chili (sic)powder and lime by two thanks. That is all you need to know about this place.

Skip this place for sure !I went with friends recently after going once after it opened . It's gone SOOO downhill !  It seems the food has suffered on its initial rep as a good brunch place ( I orig had short rib hash -;this time it was cardboard !). But the worse thing about this place is the atmosphere and lack of service. It seems the owners have left town with all their profits ( maybe enjoying a really good restaurant meal elsewhere in Bklyn !).they've left this place to the 20- something wait staff that seem more interested in dancing to the blazing hip hop music blaring in the restaurant to watching the football game on the TV screen. Yes..this place belongs in W' burg where patrons don't go for the good food or service. Hipsters go for  the loud ear- piercing music ( and even hipsters wouldn't be caught here either!).. Waiters were cackling at each other from.across the room.at the football game, treating diners like a bother ! And did I mention the loud blaring  hip hop music?! Terrible place. Yes folks the inmates have taken over the cafeteria. Save your $$ and your time. Go to any of dozens of other fine brunch places in our hood ! Maybe you could ask the owners of Stone Park for restaurant recommendations - they're CLEARLY NOT eating at this corpse !
Amazing.  Great fresh ingredients with the perfect rolls.  If I'm ever wanting a truly amazing hoagie this is the best place to go.

After passing by this location so many times I was excited to try it out with some friends. We had attempted to do a Taco Crawl and hit various taco joints around the area and this was our first stop. I was already displeased just by looking at the menu. The items, especially the tacos, were grossly overpriced at about $5 each one. In the spirit of things I figured the price weighs in with ingredients, service, the works you know? Nope. Not a single thing about this place was enjoyable. Minimal seating, mediocre taste for the price, and dear lord god how I contained my rage at a server... I've worked in retail and food service before so I know how draining it can be for people working with customers who don't know/can't figure out what they want. But that one server's attitude.... I fucking couldn't. Never going back.
took them too long to cook our food; waited 30-35mins for the food.

Went there last night with hubby and daughter, it was a complete mess! After our 20 minute wait turned into an hour-Starving now- we were asked to share a table, not a problem! Just get us some food we thought! They forgot us though- after 20 mins our guest requested to order realizing they forgot us! We ordered - sping rolls which were tasteless, ended up leaving one back, -the crispy Vietnamese crepe was alright until I noticed a fly in the salad that came          with it -cubed beef with rice - good -fried snapper -really salty-ok -spicy shrimp with lemongrass -beef surf n turf- they forgot the beef but after letting them know they kindly provided some after 15 mins or so I ended up taking that with the rest of my food home to trash. During our wait for food I relized I forgot to order desert our waiter insisted there was plenty of time to get to that later, through all the commotion of loud crouds and outside noise he forgot. He seems like a nice guy just alot on his plate. I always leave great tips this time I just couldn't - like 2-3 dollars maybe , The wait was disastrous- we saw people who got seated after us eat wayyyy before us-crazy!, the food was nothing spectacular especially with the fly on the greens, and the service was horendous! Def never going back there. Not worth it.

Honestly I've never had a problem with the food here. I always tend to get the Smoked Mac because it's my favorite. The flavor is always great and it has the right amount of cheesiness. Although in all honesty the best part about this place is not the food, it's their workers. I have a crush on the delivery boy and I'm not ashamed haha.
The place really approves its high reputation! Food is something extremely delicious:) Service is great ! Design of the place is also cool. Can't wait to there again!!!
I eat here once a week. I dont need to say much more
Incredibly delicious burgers and great beer. Went for a quick dinner with my friend Geoff and it was a great success.

The oysters were amazing!! Asked them to pick for me and it turned out to be that I actually asked the owner!! He recommended some yummy goodness. Ordered a dozen and then ordered 6 more, they threw in a wild oyster the size of a hand! Delish! The cherry on top --- a free slice of whiskey cake!!!!!!!!   Happy girl! This place is awesome, very laid back and relaxing. Go glad I yelped this place!

Wow, people seem to either really love or really hate this place! I thought maybe it depended on who the chef was night to night, but our group ordered a bunch of stuff and it was erratic. The walnut trio (especially the green bean pate) and the mushrooms were quite tasty; the khachapuri  and the kidney beans quite disappointing--both bordered on flavorless.  The hot yogurt soup was interesting, with a strong dill flavor but too much overcooked white rice at the bottom. I didn't pay attention to what wine we ordered but I was not at all impressed with it, especially at $35 for the bottle. But my wife, who's more into wine than I am, thought it was quite good. I had a couple of sips of my friend's tarragon soda, which was quite delightful in spite of the garish food coloring (bright bluish-green).  But the drink itself was not oversweetened and the tarragon taste shone through. Of course, for both drinks, the restaurant's role consisted only of curating and opening the bottle. Overall, it was enjoyable but not extraordinary. I'm a first-timer with Georgian food, but I've eaten a lot of Eastern European and some Turkish, Uzbeki, and Persian in my time.

Really cute place. Rustic and quaint but such a great atmosphere. The live music was so much fun and the food was surprisingly delicious for a tiny little pub. I had the raviolis and my husband had the fish and chips. Both were incredibly tasty. If you are passing through the area and this place is open, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND stopping in and grabbing a bite. You wont be disappointed.

So I bought some special online deal for this place, 2 x 50.00 gift cards for 50.00, first one I used with the family, and they were all unimpressed, plus they kept it SUPER cold. Food was ok at best. Then went back last night to use the second one. Ordered 2 appetizers that came out suspiciously fast, bacon wrapped scallops and chicken Fingers. If they were made to order, should have taken at least 10 minutes I would think, not 4 minutes, just the right amount in a microwave probably. Then our pizza, topped with shrimp scampi was very mediocre, even though the server highly recommended it. The shrimp looked like the kind you get in a shrimp salad can, and tasted NO garlic on the pie at all. Besides this, our server vanished when we were done with our meal, and no one tended to us for a good 10 minutes, when I inquired where our server was, they said he was out on a delivery!!! And lastly, the place was very warm, even though it was a gorgeous cool night outside. Probably wont go back here again, deals or no deals....

I love this place because it's very reasonably priced considering the amount of food served! If you have time to wait an hour or two for a seat, then I suggest you do so because it's worth the wait. I just don't have the time.

A new amazing ,healthy,reasonably priced restaurant. The atmosphere is calming, it's beautiful and tastefully decorated. The staff are sweet as pie. On to the food... Seasoned with love, just enough and the Caribbean influence on the food items make these healthy dishes quite tasty! The stuffed avocado paired with a paradise smoothie is an amazing combo. The hummus is to die for. All around the food is absolutely amazing! A perfect place for vegans and non vegans alike.

Great experience every time I go. I am a teacher in the neighborhood and Gaia is always welcoming and has fresh specials every day. The panini sandwiches are spectacular! I rate it the best deal in the LES area.

BBQ is my favorite, my friends also like to have some BBQ at least in a week. Last week we friends decided to hang out for no reason. We decided that place for the whole plan. We reached there for dinner. The atmosphere was awesome like always, as I have been visiting it from last couple of months. The service is great with the great staff working and making it possible. Fries and Brisket was amazing and the sandwiches are wonderful. I would love to go again.

From all the restaurants on Bleecker between W12th all the way down to 6th ave this one has the worst service by far. I've been living in the neighborhood for 6 years so trust me on this one. I came in in the afternoon on a Saturday to grab a bite. When I walked in the hostess was chatting with another employee, I assumed a waitress or other hostess for some 8 minutes straight without addressing me. I was standing right next to them. I didn't interrupt them because I wanted to know how Long it would take them to realize I was waiting there to be seated. A gentlemen came by, seemed like the manager or owner and he asked me if I was being helped. I said no. I said I wanted food and he out me in a high table by the bar which I didn't mind cause I was by myself. No dinner utensils or anything was on the table. The gentlemen said someone would be right there with me. I waited another 10 minutes and 4 waiters/waitresses came pass me not asking if I needed any service (menu, drinks, water) nothing. The two chatty hostesses were legit 2 feet away from me and nothing. After an overall 20 minute of zero service I stood up and left. Worst service in the west village.
Thai Beef Salad = oral symphony!  My tastebuds are still tingling. Great service, good times.

Best Banh Mi I've had since moving to NY from DC.The old ladies behind the counter know what they're doing and are the nicest and funniest women I've met here.If you speak any Vietnamese,PLEASE order in Vietnamese,they miss hearing their language,so do a few elderly women a solid will yah? I've had every single one of their sandwiches and have never been disappointed.Fairly-priced,and stomach- filling sandwiches.I recommend the classic Banh Mi for first-timers.

Despite it's location, this place is the best source for Vietnamese sandwiches. Reasonable prices with a great selection of other Vietnamese food and delicacies. Vietnamese owned who also speak chinese.

Was so excited when this Popeyes opened up down the street from us...me and my husband go often-not anymore. I went the other day, and an employee told me their "sandwich maker" was broken...didn't understand that because it's fried chicken in bread...well, tonight my husband went to try again as we go purely for the Po Boi chicken sandwich...apparently the worker last week lied to us. They just don't make them anymore at this location. The restaraunt was founded based on the chicken sandwich-this is crazy! Substituting with Taco Bell tonight, I doubt their "burrito maker" is broken... -unsatisfied customer

Huge (too big, if that were a thing) portions, reasonable prices, good at refilling your coffee, amazing decor/ambiance, friendly waitresses. It's all good. I recommend their biscuit sandwiches, although I had their salmon salad the last time I went which was amazing.

The previous reviewers were right on target.  This is a gem in the heart of New Haven, CT.  We had a fabulous experience and our food was amazing.  You can't go wrong with the duck nachos or lettuce wraps.  The pan seared scallops were just out of this world.  My husband was not that enthralled with the cod & mussels; it was just ok.  We were all duly impressed.

We stopped in here for dinner, and we were seated immediately at our 930 dining time. After being seated, we were given menus and then promptly ignored for approximately 15 minutes.  They had a full staff on of four servers and there are only eight tables in the place. We ordered our food, and another table came in and was seated next to us. They had by far better service than us. We noticed something was wrong when we noticed that ironically all of the items we ordered were going to the table next to us. They discovered this after two out of three plates were incorrect at the second table. They took the dishes back to the kitchen, And re-returned to our table after five minutes. We were given the second hand meals that were now cold and had been handled over and over again. I ordered the ribs and were very bitter and cold and tasted like ash. None of our group of four was impressed. At the end of the night we were ready to pay and were given the bill, and as we were ready to pay, the server goes out to smoke for 15 minutes. We had to get someone else to take care of it. Not impressed at all. They have a long way to keep this place in business. I will expect it to close sooner than later.

A gem in LIC, food was great, loved the chocolate lava cake, came with some friends ordered desert,stayed for a few hours, enjoyed the atomosphere and great service, drinks were perfect, our waitress was warm, assuring and relatable. I will be back!!!

I thought it was just me that was experiencing poor service! I put up with it because the food is good, but no longer, I will be going elsewhere unless they decide to send this lady to an attitude adjustment course. I don't presume to know what her problems are and why she acts like that, however we all deal with our problems and it's up to us to keep it out of the workplace instead of projecting that misery onto customers.

Just outstanding service and a wonderful meal.  They made my dad's birthday dinner a great experience. The food was fantastic including the eggplant, veal, manicotti and much more including the tripe.  Yes tripe ! I would not hesitate to come back.  Don't worry about the decor.  Come there to enjoy an old fashioned Italian meal.

I generally go for the noodle soup here - some of the most authentic Asian food in the University City area. That comes with a couple caveats: the shou lamian (hand-drawn noodles) don't have the texture you generally expect, and the broth is a little generic. It doesn't feel like there's a huge difference between the shave noodles and shou lamian. I'd also stick with the 'Chinese' noodles options versus the 'Japanese' noodles (i.e. udon, teriyaki noodle soup). Overall, still very good - a great option when you're craving something of substance. I'm not too familiar with the bubble tea or sushi, but I do think the bubble tea is good for its price point - also some of the best in University City. Convenient and with a large selection. The sushi selection looks good and my friends enjoy it, but that's all I've got. The restaurant interior is new and feels comfortable; the ambience works. Service is above average. They also have a (somewhat expensive) selection of Chinese/Japanese beers.

The pork and duck are Okay. The soup has a horrible funky flavor (lack thereof). The service is even bad for Chinatown. The waiters just do not pay attention to you. Our friend had the congee which was actually good. We won't be back, and they won't miss our presence either. Life goes on here..
I don't get the poor reviews. 4 superb pork and chive dumplings for one measly dollar bill. A friggin steal.

Very few restaurants have left me an impression good enough to make me feel like writing a review for it, and due to my lazy nature(I bought a total of over 10,000 dollar worth goods on Amazon.com and zero reviews was written), I have never written a single serious restaurant review before Moshulu. But this one, I have to do it. It was my first anniversary with my girlfriend, and I left a note to the Open-Table reservation I made stating my situation and requesting a better view table. I doubted if anyone would notice it at all before I left home with my girlfriend. To our complete surprise, when I got to the place and sat down at a nice table as I have requested, the waitress took out an envelope of nicely printed congratulations card, with carefully hand-written anniversary greetings. We, were shocked. And of course, food/wine/service was amazing. Too many people wrote about it, I'll just skip this part. Then comes the desert, we ordered cheesecake. To our complete surprise again, it came with with a BIG chocolate words of Happy Anniversary, and a lit candle. Didn't know what to say at the moment. And just in case you don't know, cheesecake was amazing too. After the night I made a promise to myself, that I would take my love back to this ship, every single anniversary.

This place is a very cramped hole in the whole with seating maybe for ten or less people but the atmosphere was wonderful as was the service and food. Vegetable Muffalatta and Grass (Roasted Beets and Butternut Squash) Cheeky sandwiches were just wonderful as well as their buttermilk biscuits. My significant other had immensely enjoyed the Fried Chicken on a Biscuit Cheeky sandwich. Beignets were also very good but kind of small. Unfortunately they were out of Cafe Du Monde coffee but did have a nice supply of Louisiana potato chips and soft drinks. We will definitely be back to try other menu items in the future. Note that portions may be small but pricing is definitely affordable.

This place is a gem in the neighborhood.  I'm a huge foodie and very picky about food in NYC - I've been to them all, Per Se, Jean Georges, Le Bernardin, Sushi Yasuda, The Modern, Bouley, Daniel, etc.   This cozy spot is just good, old-fashioned home cooking with a great menu, ambience and great people.  Tomas is very fun and inviting and can cook up a mean dish, and is also quite the pastry chef (delicious almond croissants on the weekends!). I always start out with the curried shrimp - it's the perfect starter, and I love the smell of the curry emanating from the kitchen.  My favorite main dish is the roasted chicken - it is incredibly flavorful, moist and just hits the spot.  I pair everything with German Riesling from Mosel. Saturday nights are a blast.  The very talented Rachel brings her Ukelele Saturday nights at 8pm to perform Island music that is soothing and relaxing with dinner.  The staff is attentive and uber-friendly, and the food always hits the spot with generous portions.   Lovely people and a real gem in a neighborhood packed with Dim Sum and Chinese restaurants.  A welcome break from the usual Chinese places.

I've heard glowing reviews about Mr. Sushi...that it was the best around and the all you can eat was an unbeatable deal. Well I guess I went on a bad day. We arrived at Mr. Sushi at 12:30pm on a Sunday. I'll agree it's not prime sushi time, but that doesn't excuse the unforgiving fish smell. Some of the sushi was good, but some of the rolls made a member of our party sick when eating it. We ended up all having stomach problems a few hours later despite us eating 2-3 rolls total. The only reason I'm giving this two stars is because other than the fish smell the inside of the restaurant looks good, and some of the rolls were decent too.
We were over and and out for one hour. The staff was so fast to get us the food and as soon we had eaten the plate was gone. And they really need to change the chairs = sore backside!

I ordered the eggplant parm. The food was good but on par with other places I've tried. I wasn't a big fan of the service or should I say lack of it. My server only came by 3x. I did not even have my drink filled once. Maybe I should come with my Italian friends and then maybe I will get better service.

I had the hirata buns, the akamaru modern ramen and the creme brûlée desert. My friend had a different type of ramen. Overall the food was very heavy since the fat content of the pork belly that they use for the buns and the base of the soup is very high. The buns were awesome!!!!!! If it were not so pricey ($9 for 2) then I would have gotten more. The ramen was only ok. I would not drop $60 for another meal for two people at this place again but it was decent for my first time as a Japanese ramen place in the city. There are many other Japanese ramen restaurants in saint marks place with cheaper menus and more buns so I wouldn't come back here just for the food.

i LOVE this place. You always see Korean girls on the street nearby with their map and you just know they're looking for Ippudo. Great ramen. Perfect consistency and spicy without overpowering the other ingredients. Excellent service, though staff seem a little rushed or overwhelmed at times with the long lines. Definitely worth the wait.

This is THE restaurant that I bring my friends from out of town to.  Even with the long wait, this restaurant always delivers. My new favorite Ramen is the Karaka Men.  I prefer it to the Akamaru Modern.  The pork buns are delicious as everyone else says, but other dishes, such as the octopus (Tako something) are incredible as well and worth trying. The only negative about this restaurant is the lack of good Vegetarian options. The Wasabi based vegetarian Ramen that is served is just not on the same plane as the rest of the Ramen dishes.
Don't think...  just eat and enjoy!  Enjoy the service.  Enjoy the portions.  Enjoy all the extra amenities.  But most of all...  Enjoy the execellence and artistry of the food.
Very, very good Mediterranean food and very reasonably priced Wish they took reservations though.

Seriously. You guys tell my friend to take off his hat. He was not even wearing a baseball cap or something like that.Mind you this a neighborhood Indian place with casual ambience and clientele. Also there was no sign of a dress code. C'mon guys you are in UES not in TriBeCa. We were about to leave but thought it was impolite, so stayed there for one round of drinks and did not eat. Average drinks with a hefty price tag ,in a pretentious place. Good to take a date but not to hang out with friends

Loved everything we ordered. Rabbit, tomato pasta, halibut, fried zucchini and eggplant. Pasta was cooked al dente and thats what made it perfect. The service was good and the place was busy. Dessert was nice too. I feel portions are a little small but other than that we had a fun. Will definitely return.

The food was very good. We had asked about the 2 course lunch special but that is only for lunch Mon-Friday. This is not on the web site. While the other wait staff around us seemed to be friendly and knowledgeable, our waitress was looking at her watch and was not very helpful when asking questions about the wine or the food. This was disappointing. The Polpetine was excellent and so was the Stracci.

Delicious.  They chop the steak up, unlike Genos, which I prefer as it presents a better flavor.  Absolutely delicious--I will return soon.  The neighborhood also has a ton to see, making this a great destination.

Noodle quality is very decent. However, a server rush you to eat and add stuffs many times...they were not happy when i ask changes on 46 with three twentys..for 20 minute serving...this place should not ask tips if they want a customer to eat a noodle with a beer  in 10 mins and tip them 30%...it is rip off
I had two breakfast empanadas for $4.50 total. They were very tasty - especially the sauce provided. Service was good - No complaints. If you're hungry and in the area, I highly recommend.

This is the worst diner in the area, in my opinion. The booths look terrible, it's a travesty to sit in one of them. Not comfortable and just has a bad vibe. Coffee is absolutely horrendous, it tastes burnt and like just water with coffee flavoring. I was really hungry so I stayed even after all this and ordered scrambled eggs, bacon and some french toast. Really?! Not the flavors I was expecting. Everything was so bland and the french toast was so soggy. Not a good experience and not recommended.
My two stars says it all.  I've experienced better.  Our visit here was very meh.  We expected more from a place with such great reviews.

I was there last night with a group of friends. The first thing I noticed was the rustic looking and "woodsy"atmosphere. It has a very cool vibe and setting. After looking at the a la carte menu (which by the way, looked excellent) we decided on trying the tasting menu. Tonight's feature was the "Pork" feast. Everything was on point and delicious. My only suggestion is NOT to add the anchovies to the kale and bacon salad. Otherwise, all plates were delicious and plentiful. I must also mention the pork belly and gnocchi plates. Thumbs up on those 2 plates. Now for the not favorable part. If this is a tasting menu for a party of 5, why are you bringing all the plates out at once?! As good as the meal was, I felt rushed. I would have much preferred each plate to be brought out. When I'm eating such a meal, I love to savor and enjoy; really take my time. Unfortunately, this dining experience felt like all the food was being forced down my throat. Too fast. Too fast. Slow down! And then onto the service. Sorry guys but the service was unacceptable. No one came to check on us. No one asked us if we needed anything. I recall, we had to flag down our waitress several times. I actually thought the servers did a much better job. They constantly kept coming over, refilling our waters, and keeping the table neat and clean. If it were up to me, the entire tip should have gone to the servers. I realize it was a Saturday night and Saturday nights are probably the busiest time. However, service should have been better. Don't know if I would go back. Wonder how brunch is?

You pick your choice of meatballs (including veggie ones), your sauce and your sides and you are ready for a delicious treat. The food is tasty, freshly made and very good value for money.The service was excellent and friendly. It stays open late if you want a good meal after bar hopping.

I went with my friends to dinner for one of my friends' birthday. I was extremely dissatisfied with the service and food especially for the price we paid for. I like to pay restaurant food when it is good quality and that is why I am extremely dissatisfied with how much I had to pay for their food. Our waiter did not even introduce himself to us and barely came to our table with a smile to make sure we were satisfied. Not only that, when we ordered the titanic with a candle for my friend's birthday, only 2 waiters came over to give us the dessert and asked us to sing. I don't even think they sang with us. Now the reason why I am complaining about this is because there were 2 other tables that were also celebrating a birthday and anniversary and a whole bunch of waiters went to their tables and sang the song for them. I was pretty offended by this. Now when it comes to the food, we ordered the shrimp diavolo linguine and marinara pasta. The shrimp diavolo linguine was extremely spicy and the marinara pasta was very salty. They were both pasta dishes (which I can make on my own) and they were so disappointing. The only upside to the food is that they're big portions. Otherwise, they can do better.

This place was suggested by a friend and I was busy in that week in which it was suggested. I happened to go there last week and I experienced this place which is a gem in the town. The food here is great, I had lobster which is worth to experience and the burger which is awesome. I liked the beer here. The place is crowded with the people which is showing its popularity. The service is great which is also playing important role in fame of the place and the staff is cooperative and helpful. I loved to experience this place and will keep on visiting this place, planning to go there this wednesday, see you soon Alfie's.

I was just at La Riviera Trattoria last night for the first time.  My family and I travel all over and have had many dining experiences.  La Riviera Trattoria is absolutely the best in New Jersey.  I have celiac disease and they cater to gluten free and dairy free diners; however, they also cater to diners without food allergies.  If you have celiac, they prepare everything in a separate kitchen and the staff are trained; in fact, they are a certified gluten free restaurant.  The food was amazing:  my daughter only eats organic and she stated it was the best chicken she ever had.  I have celiac and ate the pork chop dinner with a stuffed artichoke and they were amazing.  Everyone there is so friendly; in fact. Maria, the owner;s daughter gave us so much useful information regarding celiac; she even introduced us to her dad, the owner.  We left the restaurant with a feeling that we are part of their family.  The servers were also very accommodating and friendly.  Now I know why this restaurant is so busy; call for reservations.  If you truly wish to have a fresh, friendly, and yummy dining experience, go to La Riviera Trattoria.

So slow. Was not busy at 1pm on Sunday. Took over 20 minutes to receive our two sandwich orders, and one was wrong. Four people behind the counter. One girl was making her own PB&J bagel, one was wrapping all the cream cheese for close, one was listening to the eagles play on the radio. The one guy who was making our order would take every item out for the sandwich, make the sandwich, put every item back, then wrap the sandwich and hand it to us. Bagel was tasty, cream cheese not as much. Will never go back.

I had lunch for business purposes a few times there over the past months. The food was consistenly delicious and everything I tried so far was amazing. My favorite is their salmon salad and tuna sandwich but the roasted carrot appertizer and the ham/ Prosciutto display are great starters! Every time I went there, the staff was so attentive, pleasant and prompt. A great local "best kept secret" which I think it is likely to become very popular soon.

Print had an excellent farm-to-table program. I had the tagliatelle, my wife had the salmon and we really loved everything, and felt prices were definitely fair given the quality and location. Definitely recommend!
Frank Pepe's is some of the dopest pizza on the east coast, what more is there to say? Every pizza it's solid, I like to keep it simple with sausage and red peppers!
Service was acceptable, food abundant, and atmosphere cheerful, I live on Long Island and would take the drive to come and eat here.  Very diversified crowd.

I liked this place a lot! I had never had ethiopian before this and it was interesting and delicious. I didn't  get to see the coffee ceremony they do but I did have the coffee and it is really good and really strong. At the time I went they didn't serve any drinks or beers, not sure if they do now but I would have liked to have had wine or something. Other then that the atmosphere was lovely!

I had some great stuff at Say Cheese today! They were at a street festival in West Chester and my boyfriend and I shared 2 sandwiches. They were both great but I especially looooved the Pork Belly Sammy with Broccoli Rabe and oooy goooy cheese on a snowflake bun! It was a great take on the philly roast pork sandwich!!! I also love their truck, they have a really cool logo!
Great food and beer selection with terrible customer service. The staff is either high or just doesn't care AT ALL. If the TV is on, prepare to be outright ignored by the cashier.

Food is fair but definitely over priced...I've lived in the neighborhood for some time now and I will say they have changed there attitude towards non-hipsters in a more positive way. Charming communal seating and I would say good date place. I guess my biggest complaint is the price of food
It was a Sunday night. They were 15 mins to close but still made the best food I had that day. Great and friendly service as well.

Came in about 6 PM on a Friday night.  Expected it to be full but after a couple minute wait we got a nice booth, plenty of open tables in the middle of the room.   I had a medium pizza with mushroom and sausage.  It was a thin pizza, which is fine, and it was good.  My wife had the crab cake special, which we now think was an app.  The specials menu wasn't clear what was what.  She wasn't that impressed with it, but maybe we shouldn't be trying crab cakes in a pizza joint, but then they shouldn't have it on the menu.  My beer was good, a local on tap, served in a proper glass.  The most annoying thing was a woman in a neighboring booth who probably had had an extra beer because she was LOUD.  This isn't the restaurant's fault, but we wanted to relax in a casual dining room, not hear her stories in a bar atmosphere.   I guess we'd go back but maybe try to sit in the smaller room to the left vs. the big room to the right.  Waitress was ok, basket of breads was really good.

Was extremely excited to come here because the one near my hometown in CA was closed down, however, the experience was beyond disappointing. I order my usual which was the avocado turkey burger with the garden bar. My meal came out after 15 minutes, but I was completely different than what I ordered. They said they were making one fresh for me and it would be out very soon. After 25 more minutes it finally came out, but it had the wrong cheese. When we mentioned it, they said they don't even offer that cheese even though the waitress had said they did. I was so fed up with waiting I just kept the burger. When the bill came, we fully expected that the burger be taken care of because of the amount of mistakes and time we had to wait for the correct meal. Even our waitress said the bill would look funny to us because they 'took care' of a few things. What she failed to mention is that they just 'took care' of the mistake she made by putting in the wrong meal to begin with. I am extremely let down and had a horrible experience here.

I wish I could add 0 stars. From the moment we got here we were completed lied to about product the restaurant offered and when our food was brought to us after an extremely long wait and the orders were wrong and they claimed they never had any of the original orders. Don't go here!

I assure you that I've tried pizza in many places and spaces and have to say that this is my absolute favorite. Between the sauce and crust, it's truly a magical experience. I prefer the white pizza, but I've tried their veggie concoctions and they are also quite good. That and the garlic knots are good to boot! You can't go wrong with this place (unless you just HAVE to sit down and eat your slice/s... then this place might not be for you.)
Awesome 2am meal right across the road from the hotel. Chicken with rise $6! The hot sauce is a lil too hot for me, beware xxxx

CHICKEN & BBQ RIBS Baby!!! Also, the Lamb Chops are the best in Hudson/Bergen Counties. The food is Absolutely tasty. We come at least 3x per month. Sarah & Rosa are the friendliest and most professional waitresses I've met. The ambience is super and it's BYOB which is a Big Plus. LUV u guys. see You Soon!!

A great casual spot for delicious and inexpensive food that you can eat on the go. Everyone in my family enjoys themselves when we visit. The empanadas range from savory to sweet and their homemade dipping sauce has a great kick.

We have eaten here many times before and invited friends for their first visit. We have never been disappointed. Service and food are always exceptional. Owner truly want you to enjoy your meal. For an appetizer, try the artichoke fritters with gorgonzola dip...yummy..and a large enough portion to share!

So good we went back 2 nights in a row. Comfortable seating, friendly service and the food was excellent. Good portion at a good price. Thanksgiving turkey sandwich was delicious. Best Chicken Wings I've ever had!

First, let me start off with the service cause it's almost the only thing that's decent. The service was friendly and knew most of the food on the menu. The surroundings are great. Small, basic, and clean (as of now). My friend and I both ordered thai ice tea for our drinks but they said they didn't have any. So.. then we just ordered a salty lemonade. The drinks took forever! It took them 30 mins to actually get our drinks and the place was not busy.. Now for the food.. I mean it's cheap, but the favors were a bit lacking compared to other vietnamese restaurants. They just don't give enough into the food (taste and the amount). We had summer rolls, banh mi (sandwich), crispy squid salad (was soggy and not crispy), special pho (couldn't taste the beef favor), pork chops with rice, and beef cubes (decent but gave me like 5 cubes). It's a decent start but they really need to work on the food. Will not come back though.

My friend and I were visiting Brooklyn and decided to stop by this restaurant as it seemed to have a unique feel to it, especially on a busy saturday. The atmosphere was great and the owners were lovely. We were not disappointed, the Persian starters were delicious and authentic,  and the mains superb- moist succulent meats in ample portions. Will go again if we visit New York again. Staff remain friendly even under pressure.
The coffee is just better hear than all of the options in the area, I now actually walk out of my way to just get my iced lattes here. The food is pretty darn tasty too.
I'm sorry all of the cheese steak places more or less taste the same, I prefer Jim's mostly because it's less of an eyesore.

Delightful variety on the menu, creative dishes and specials, willing to go off-menu for special requests, very customer-centered service... I could go on. It's too bad that we have to drive an hour or so to go there, but it is worth an occasional trip. I have to deduct a star because it's a BYOB.

I waited to review because it was a sad meal and some of the worst service around.  the food isn't all that great. the service was so sad i am now laughing at how really bad it was. i almost cried that day. now i can laugh about it and never return. does anyone like to have a waiter yell at them to clear a table so he can place a HOT plate down because he is "burning his hands"????

Thank you Matt & Marie for OUTSTANDING FOOD and SERVICE. We are exciting to have your business in ourarea. The food is fresh and always delivered on time. Your staff's desire to meet the customers needs is very refreshing. We look forward to our next lunch with you. Renee

I went in there for a quick bite to eat and decided to order the gnocchi with tomato sauce. I can honestly say that this gnocchi was better then most Italian restaurants I've been to. It was cooked perfectly and I ordered the lunch portion but got a generous serving. The price was also less than $10, which made it that much better. My boyfriend got the gyro which he loved, but complained that they were a little cheap on the French fries that came with it.

I am just giving you heads up about the complain enter against you for staff mistreat, as I mentioned to you over 6 months ago when you were not allowing your employees 5 minutes break for a period of  7/8 hrs worked,  I told you that I no longer eat there even that hour food is good your attitude and mis conduct to your employees is not acceptable, pls look yourself up in hall of shame, Sent from my iPhone

Quite awesome. Almost a pan fried consistency of crust but baked. The result...amazingness if that's a word. As the homie Planet Pea said, yes I have a friend named Planet Pea, "I always order the Margherita because if they can get that right, it's certified." Thumbs up as their Margherita is a delicate balance of smokey cheese with a rich yet abundantly fresh sauce...and the crust destroys the competition. The pepperoni slice was served in squares, with a delicious savoury sauce being the star of the show, cheese actually under the sauce in an unexpected role reversal. Pepperoni was spiced just right and baked until the edges curled to form a perfect bite of crunchified exterior with a delectable centre. That ravenous description courtesy of my gf who is the pork connoisseur, I'm merely a spectator in that regard :). Remarkably we kept down the pizza despite the Joe Jonas framed pic on the wall in front of us. That's truly the sign of a righteous slice. Highly recommended. Have your order in mind before hitting the cash, the staff does not take kindly to waiting especially during the business lunch rush. It's damn good pizza. Enjoy.

I'll be quick and brief with this survey. The pizza was some of the best I've had in this particular area. They have the best crust that just hits the spot. The sauce and toppings were great as well. Absolutely love the pizza.

This was my first time coming here. Went here during lunch time on a Friday so it wasn't packed at all. Our server was very kind and helpful. I was craving the  papita de rellenas since that's a Cuban staple food and we also ordered pernil with tostones. As I was digging into the papita de rellanas. I hit the center and it was ice cold!! :( I told the server immediately and he said he would bring fresh ones. They came back and they were STILL ice cold in the center. At this point I was done with my meal and didn't even bother letting the server know. It made me doubt there freshness of food by making that same mistake twice. Also I ordered the churasco. I got it medium well and it wasn't as tender as it should be. I was definitely disappointed since I was looking forward to coming to this place for a long time. Wasn't worth a $60 lunch whatsoever.
Horrible experience,  if you are into a noisy crowed restaurant with long wait time for a table. Then this is the place for you.  The service was not good, but the food was ok, just ok. Never again.

There's something about Grass Fed Beef that just makes everything taste all the better. Bacon Jam Fries are hands down, the best thing on the menu. The Bacon Jam burger is just as good! The Portobello Mushroom Sandwich will make you want to turn vegetarian and their Montclaire Blue is to die for. Totally worth the money! Must try! I did a full review on the restaurant here: my.tokzikworld.com/post/…

I'm a regular at this place, I really love the Japanese soba its absolutely amazing. My favorite dish is the dip noodle with duck, they serve a bowl of broth on top of a small fire that keeps it warm, I don't have enough words to describe how good it is. for appetizer I love the mocha and the chicken balls are very good too. only 4 star because the service is a bit slow sometime. highly recommended to try.

Love the grilled cheese and macaroni and cheese. Amazing food.  The staff is knowledgeable about the food their serving and will find the best wines to make your dinner superb! The decor is casual but romantic so great for date night! Enjoy!

It was like 12:30am and we needed some tacos. For delivery no less. They came through - delivery until 1am is all good here. The chips and guac were delicious... guac even had some peppy spice to it. But, they didn't have tacos. "All out of tacos, we only have burritos." I'm not a burrito person. Nevertheless, a burrito was ordered. It was gigantic and enough to feed 3 people. I'm serious. It was good, I guess... but it really did not hit the spot because it was not what I wanted.

I love this place! I go to Hell's Kitchen all the time. It's my comfort place because it's always reliable and consistent. Great Bar Food & Excellent shows! The best part of this place is their shows are incredible and free! Where can you go to see live bands, sideshow and burlesque for free now of days? I think it's incredible that this venue is able to do that and the drinks are affordable. Best bar, hands down.

Reservations for two on a Saturday evening at 7:30. Upon arrival, the hostess is nowhere to be found. Waited for several minutes until she arrived from the back of the restaurant. First impression upon entering the dining room: I've entered a death-metal concert considering the noise level. Hostess initially attempted to seat us at a four-top in the middle of the wait-staff and patron foot traffic, despite the availability of a two-top in the corner of the room. I had to ask to be seated at the more appropriate table. Almost on the heels of the hostess, a runner brought water, a cold loaf of sliced white bread and an awful and completely unappetizing mix of peppers and stewed vegetables. No olive oil or butter was offered. Our server came to the table for the first time within two minutes of our arrival, and three times within the first ten minutes inquiring on whether we were ready to order. We had not even looked at the menus yet, but feeling the obvious pressure from the server, I offered to place an appetizer order. Thus began the strangest exchange of the evening: The server seemed to say both that we were not permitted to have any longer to review the menu, and that partial orders were not permitted. I say we thought that, but the noise level was so high in the place that I could not truly understand what was being said, and after the server explained the "rules", she simply walked away from the table. As a side note, there were at least three or four empty tables, and several more parties which were completing their meals, so table turnover was not an issue. I've never experienced something like this at any restaurant anywhere before, and it was such strange behavior that I considered it a misunderstanding, but a rather significant service failure to be rushed ten minutes into the evening. Given the urgency, I was unable to review the wine/cocktails list. Once our order was placed a few minutes later, we saw our server twice more, for the delivery of the dessert menu and the bill (all food was delivered by runners). No one checked on us during the meal to determine our level of satisfaction. And this is where Spasso really loses points. The calamari appetizer we shared was so over-salted that more than half of the portion was left behind. The escargot were served in a stewed tomato and spinach mixture that looked like it had been just slopped on the plate. The flavors of this dish were so overpowered by the vegetables, that if I hadn't been looking for the escargot, I might have missed them. I certainly didn't taste them. My veal was acceptable, but nothing exceptional and the crabmeat topping was completely flavorless. The lemon butter sauce the dish was swimming in was far to tart and overpowering. My date's Bolognese dish was served over gnocchi in a massive bowl of thin-looking sauce. Given the disappointing nature of the meal so far, we both opted to skip coffee and desert, which clearly annoyed the server since a) it prevented the bill from reaching excessive and b) she asked us both three times if we were sure. A final point: by the time the meal ended (at 8:45), at least half and probably more of the place was empty. I guess there was no longer a need to rush the patrons. We won't be back.

Usually excellent, but... When searching for a place to make brunch reservations on Opentable yesterday, the menu page for Odeon showed they had BLT's.  My 8 year old daughter LOVES BLT's, so we booked a table at Odeon.  Drove from Brooklyn, paid $18 to park, got seated, and then discovered the brunch menu did not have a BLT (it's on their lunch menu).  I figured it would not be a problem to get one anyway as it is just bread, lettuce bacon and tomato.  I asked, they refused.   So I ordered a side of bacon and a toasted bagel (both on the menu) and asked for a side of tomato and lettuce.  Had to assemble it ourselves at the table.  Not the end of the world, but I find it surprising that they couldn't make a simple BLT for an 8 year old.  Even more surprising is that they preferred to have the customer assembling the sandwich at the table rather than having the kitchen do it.   Thanks, Odeon.

Excellent food. Excellent service. Excellent experience. There was an Eagles game yesterday and we wanted to have a great experience watching the game. We drove from DC to Chickies to watch the game. We were not disappointed. It was so awesome to watch the game around Eagles and not Redskins fans. The crabfries were awesome! Def. Coming back A+++

If i could give zero stars I would.  Ordered a salad, arrived with no chicken and the wrong dressing.  They sent me a second salad with no dressing this time.  So over this place. today was the last time they'll get my money. ps. chicken and bacon was overdone.
Awesome quaint place. Friendly and accommodating staff!! The food is amazing and soooo worth it! Go now!

I went here with a friend on our tour of the 5 boroughs.  Congratulations, Staten Island, you have a quality craft beer spot.  They have a good selection of American beer on draft as well as a few cans and bottles.  Apparently the taps are also rotated frequently.   The barbecue was well done also with just a little kick in the sauce.  Definitely worth checking out if you're nearby or just passing through SI.
Nothing more to say but Expensive, but worth it. Everything they do is fresh and incredibly detailed oriented. Food is good, fell of the place is just so much fun.
Great authentic Polish food!
very good mexican food, kinda on the pricier side. would go back again.

Truly a five star experience of the tastebuds! Food was light and not overbearing flavour at all. The waiters were all attentive and well informed on the menu. The chef sets your taste buds on a journey.  Completely a wonderful experience and coming here again.  While waiting, our waitress, Lily, offered us a fried manicotti appetizer. That was truly indescribable. We also had the broccoli rabe, lamb ragu, and squash with swiss chard. These flavors are definitely worth coming for.

Awesome but hard to get to from Manhattan unless you take ferry-then super easy. Pizza was amazing and the brookies were yummy. Will definitely return. We walked over Brooklyn bridge, not realizing there are barricades quite a way down that prevent you from getting to Dumbo area. No big deal, will just take ferry or subway next time. Worth it.
authentic as they come. carne asada taco meat was da bomb. i forgot my name was so good. going back tomorrow for more good flavor and staff pro actively assist you if u look lost as we did
Teddy , Shana Tova , Just wanted to wish you and your family happy healthy new year a haed ! This is Shemtov son . Ramin
I had the blackened catfish & grits minus the salsa. The best damn grits I've ever had!
Amazing amazing food!!! The happy hour drinks are great. Super cute vibe. If youre into spanish music the music is definitely great. My waitress was friendly.
No wait and best chicken tika masala anywhere.

This is a great place to try many different varieties of food. They have a great selection and when in center city Philadelphia its a must stop at place. Gregory Grookett highly recommends this place.

Worst Indian food I have had in the area. We ordered the chana masala, butter paneer, raita, naan, and rice. Everything except the rice was terrible. There was something wrong about the way both dishes were spiced. The chana masala was mild even though we ordered spicy. The naan was nothing special. I guess the only decent thing was the rice. We do not recommend this place and we will not be returning.

I had a wonderful time here. It's some of the best food I've had in awhile. I am so so so happy I came across this place. It's got an adorable vibe, delicious food, and fun decor! I had a great time with my friend and I am recommending this place to everyone I know!!

Gluten Free Avenger here to say the day!  Dah-duh-DAHHH!!!!   I'm here to tell you this place rocks.  It has many glluten free things on the menu.  I mean like a LOT! Me and my friend came thereSunday for brunch.  We both ordered soemthing called __SOMETHING__ Benny.  It was way yummy, hollandaise sauce and all (GF).  And there was a cobbler/crumble thing for dessert?  It was excellent.  As was their coffee.  They have almond milk creamer as well which I appreciated cause I recently got gluten poisoning at another restaurant in San Francisco three weeks ago and now eating dairy is not so pleasant of an experience. The food here is so good thar your non-GF friends will love it too.  They have many gluteny options for them.   They also have Daura GF beer!   The Gluten-Free Avenger pronounces this joint an A+.  First because it's just an A+ and second because it's near impossible to get GF in New York City.  For reasons that aren't clear.  One lady from a different food estabishment in NYC said, when I asked for gluten free, "Oh no all our stuff has the full sugar and fat!"  This is what we're dealing with.   I'd like to go back there for lunch right now but they don't open weekdays before 4p.

I love Parc!!  I was in Philly last week, and always make this my regular stop.  We sat outside and had a wonderful early evening.  The Pate is wonderful!!  I'm not sure if it's "authentic" French, but I don't really care....I love the food here!

What a wonderful experience.  My wife and I were treated like celebrities by the staff.  The food was nothing short of amazing.  the steak was done just right.  the appetizers were amazing and I recommend you try them all. I live in philly and I would drive out here every weekend. Very impressed
Arrogant waiter and small portions

I expect more on this place!, everyday there is a line at the door waiting for a table, so we were very curious and went yesterday, not for us sorry, if you want to eat fish this is not the place too much seasoned! you can even try taste de fish because of that!, every dish that we ordered has the same taste, that season that they use was too much! fish is delicate and for that reason you have to be gentle when you cook fish!, also too much oil on everything even the bread at the table completely covered of oil ...:(
Delicious food, very nice atmosphere, great service.

Holy shhhhhh! All I have to say is tender, flaky biscuit with a massive, honking prime piece of boneless fried chicken breast slathered in honey butter sauce and complimented with Frank's red hot for an amateur kick. So damn good. All I have to say part 2 is the Pecan/Fresh Peach short stack of moist, fluffy pancakes with pats of melting butter and sumptuous syrup running down the sides. Killed, massacred, pillaged and consumpted...if that's even a word. This pic (if not here, in my profile cache) is proof that my friend Planet Pea actually exists, and my lovely gf appears as his blurry lunch companion. Apologies for my food coma camera skills. Go here. Tasty as...shut your mouth.
The experience is amazing. Great seafood a'd great beer. They have no deserts so you concentration is 100% on what the sea has to offer.

Amazing! There were only one or two places in New York I liked almost as much as this fantastic little restaurant. If you want a real New York experience, you can walk in, sit at the bar while they prepare you food in front of you. All the food was delicious and everyone was very friendly! 10/10
Stopped over for a quick breakfast and was in a rush. They quickly accommodated me and got my food out quickly. Had the French toast with some bacon, it was good:)

As good as it gets!! We ordered the pig out for two, watermelon ricotta, oxtail spring rolls, and corn. Everything was absolutely amazing. It's one of those meals where you are excited to try every dish they bring out, and nothing is as expected. I will be coming back for more!!

New ownership has been amazing. Everything is fresh and made right in front of you. It may take a few minutes, but if you walk around the block your food will be ready by the time you return. With personal and friendly service, fresh handcrafted food and prices that rival most food trucks, the Tuscany Cafe is simply fantastic!

I was so excited when The Double Windsor opened up in the neighborhood and have had a number of good experiences there over the years. However, the last few times I went, the bartenders were HORRIBLE! (the guy bartenders!!, I've never had a problem with the female bartenders). They act as though they're doing you a favor for just doing their job. I once stood with a friend at the bar for about 15 minutes waiting to be served. There were 2 bartenders working. One was taking care of other customers and the other was updating the chalkboard with not a care in the world that there were bar guests waiting to be served (we weren't the only ones waiting). Finally, as the one guy continued to take his merry old time updating the chalk board (not a priority, in my opinion, when there are guests waiting to be served), the other bartender finally came over to us, was not pleasant whatsoever, a barely mumbled "What can I get you" in a most arrogant way. We were so annoyed with the attitude, that we just left and went across the street to Farrell's where we were promptly served with a smile. They might not have the beer selection that DW has, but at least their bar staff are attentive and not arrogant. Another time I was there with a couple of friends late on a Thursday night. We stayed pretty late, but it was not past the closing time. The bartender clearly wanted to close the place and was going around and removing the candles from all the tables. We were one of a few tables left and we asked if we could keep the candle on the table because it's quite dim in there, and we even said we'll bring the candle up to the bar when we leave. But the bastard of a bartender said no and took the candle off our table! I can see if it was past closing time, but the bar WAS STILL OPEN!! This is going back a bit, but really bothered me enough to include it in this review. During World Cup, they had a sign outside inviting people to come in and watch the World Cup. It was USA v. Ghana and the bar was definitely more crowded because of people wanting to watch the game. They had the TV on and when the game was about to start, I asked when they were going to turn on the volume. The bartender told me that they were not going to turn on volume to the game per the Manager of the bar. I was outraged because I specifically went there to watch the game because they were allegedly showing the game. I feel like they totally lied to get people in the bar, which is NOT COOL. I was going to give this 2 stars because the food is pretty good and they have a nice beer selection, but its their HORRIBLE BARTENDERS that led me to give it just one star. STOP HIRING JERKS FOR BARTENDERS!

I have been wanting to try Blend on the Water for a while now. And I am so glad that I did. When you walk in, you are greeted by the hostess. She was very professional and friendly and although we had to wait at the bar for a table, she assured us that we would be seated as soon as possible. The restaurant had a gorgeous view of Manhatten that was absolutely breath-taking. The bartender was very attentive and made sure we were taken care of while we waited. After about 25 minutes, we were seated. When we sat down, our Waitress, Allie, greeted us promptly and had a great positive attitude. She pointed out a few of her favorite drinks and appetizers to get us started and was very helpful, sweet and friendly the entire night. She definitely made our first experience at blend a great one! I ordered the cripy arepas to start and the surf and turf off of her recommendation:both were delicious and my friend had the pollo a la plancha, which he definitely enjoyed. And finally for dessert we had the coconut flan. I must say it was one of the best flans I've ever had. Overall, the restaurant was top notch. Quick and accurate service. Friendly wait staff and fantastic food. I will definitely be back.

Went here on a date and my date didn't like her dish after a bite and they couldn't void that dish off the bill. The way they went about it was wrong. It just didn't make sense to me cause it's more money in your pocket at the end of the day. Plus I hardly seen the waitress

Loved the delicious salad with turkey which I enjoyed in the hidden patio. One of Philly ' s best kept little secrets. Great way to enjoy outdoor dining in the city without eating on the street!  Terrific service.

Went to Westville Chelsea today to pick up my lunch. While I was waiting the bartender, Nick, did everything he should have been doing for the other customers but managed to strike up a conversation that made the wait time go quickly and enjoyably. He offered me a bit of a vanilla milkshake while I was waiting and it was the best one I've had since I was 6 years old. He made my day.
Stumbled upon this place by chance. Glad I found it! Sat by the window with my friend. Simple, good vegetarian food, and pretty cheap. Def recommend!
Great place small but really cool. The chicken is the best I have ever had in the city so far. Have to try it.

I have tried pretty much everything that's regularly on the menu, with the exception of the daily specials that change. I bring literally EVERYBODY I know here, had a few birthday celebrations (although you should def get reservations for dinner, as they run out of food quickly, and they close quite early 7pm). My favorites are the Elegante panini (homemade bread!), Spinach and gnocchi, the arugula salad, ANYTHING with their buffalo mozarella cheese (that's imported from Italy weekly).
The only restaurant I have given 5 stars on yelp. Service, food and attention to detail is superb.
Was it the worst Chinese food I have ever eaten?  Probably!  Expensive, very fatty (yuck), and the wait staff is not helpful.  I suggest McDonalds as an alternative!

Was in Philly this past weekend for the Black Keys concert and came here for brunch. I had the Oh My Omelet with goat cheese and sauteed mushrooms. It was eh okay, not great, but i;m a sucker for anything with goat cheese and its pretty hard to mess up a omelet. I think $10 for an omelet that only gives you two choices if highly over priced. My boyfriend had the waffles and liked them but thought they were a little on the burnt side. He liked how they had a strong banana tastes. Service was a little on the slow side and our server was a little inattentive but it wasn't terrible. If i lived here I probably wouldn't make it a habit of coming.
I love this place. The staff is great. Super friendly. The food is tasty. I love the French fries are tasty. The scotch eggs are yummy a must try.

I'm back again! To be welcomed by two gracious smiles as I enter. Seated quickly and as my lovely Crab Rangoon and Pad Sei Eiw lunch comes out I forgot to snap a picture of the crab this time, because I ate it before thinking...lol. The dishes are so flavorful and fresh! The staff an absolute delight and very accommodating. The restaurant is very modern, but the food is very traditional Thai style and very authentic. I asked the waitress about this today, and she told me the chef was Thai from Bankok and has cooked in several restaurants an that his aim was to keep the cuisine as close to the taste that he remembers from back home. I thought that was very sweet.

The pizza is good but i don't know if it was actually worth a fan. I also minus one star for sanitary reasons. I like the perfect amount of basil. I consider myself a pizza connoisseur. One of the main reasons why I like Di fara is because they cut their basil and give a perfect amount. I have been to a lot of places where they don't cut the basil so in some bites it is an overwhelming basil taste.

This was maybe the first time Yelp has let me down. I don't know if it's all bridge and tunnel people going here or what but I don't understand why it has such high ratings. On the surface, it does look like one of those great farm to table deals but in reality the food was overpriced and subpar. I had the rabbit, and I really love rabbit, and it was just so bland. My friends felt the same about their meals as well. And also I normally don't care about service at all, but the waitress's attitude was so bad it contributed to the underwhelmingness of the meal. There are so many other restaurants in this area, wish we had gone to another one instead.

So I searched online for the best places to eat in chinatown. Prosperity dumpling gets tons of positive reviews. BUT- -If you're looking for clean (or even cleanish) -somewhere to sit- its a glorified store front stand not a restaurant. There was one old folding table and two dumpster dive chairs on the sidewalk. -somewhere you can even stand without feeling claustrophobic or feel as if you can breathe the air. -anyone friendly THEN SKIP THIS PLACE! We got there and were underwhelmed and skeeved out. There was another couple with their phone out in front. We just looked at each other and commiserated that we both followed reviews but no way were we trying it. The dumplings might be great. They might be cheap. But this should be known as take out only and only if the condition of the place won't deter you. Our group didn't want to risk it. Neither did the couple we ran into. We wished each other luck and cleared out. Still searching for a good, clean, sit down restaurant in Chinatown.....I'll post when we find it! -

The service was great the area was great the ambiance was great but the food was just ok. I might be spoiled with all the Vegas eats we have had but the ribeye was ok and the bread was as hard as a giant crew ton

Came in from a late flight, and wanted a decent meal in the neighborhood. Using my trusty YELP app, I found out about this place which had listed hours until 2am. Arrived at 12:30 am, kitchen was closed.  It is soooo aggravating to go to restaurants that advertise late night dining when you are really hungary, drive there and find out THE KITCHEN IS CLOSED.
Went back to Black Ant again, Absolutely amazing! Same flavors, same strong great cocktails, same warm and friendly service. And the staff is always awesome!

After reading so many great reviews on this place we ventured out of our cozy bay ridge and decided to give brunch a try. SOOO very glad we did!! There was a wait when we got there around 12:30 which we expected so we saddled up to the bar and were offered to have brunch there. Sure!! No wait! Our bartender/server was Sumaiya and she was PHENOMENAL. Her suggestions on drinks and food were on point. I had the hibiscus margarita and my bf had the strawberry moonshine. Both delicious! I ordered the crawfish eggs Benedict and he had the crowd favorite of fried chicken and waffle but it's a RED VELVET waffle! On her suggestion we got a side of the Mac n cheese. To call it a side doesn't do it justice because it's a meal on its own! My bf doesn't really like waffles but these waffles made him a believer! Now he says he just likes THESE waffles. They were fluffy and perfect! My Benedict was amazing with perfectly poached eggs and an old bay hollandaise that was beyond good! We will definitely be back and most likely for dinner next time!! Well done!!!
Delicious and great service.
Order the spicy ramen and added a soft boiled egg. Great!!! Perfect portion. Don't go during dinner hour, long wait

Left a bad taste in my mouth--literally! Not only was the service poor and very slow--with the waiter forgetting to bring one of the appetizers and then disappearing so it was hard to get the missing item--but the food was quite mediocre to poor. The fried artichoke appetizer was fairly good, but the saltibocca di pollo had an unpleasant oily, smoky flavor that overpowered all of the ingredients. Tasted like the food had been doused with liquid smoke or something similar. I was unable to eat some of the dessert biscotti because they tasted like someone had put salt instead of sugar. Given all the excellent reviews, I can't understand why my friends and I got such a poor meal--for a rather high price. And that oily, smoky flavor is still in my mouth hours later.
Meh.

Food is AMAZING but the service is terrible.  Visited this establishment for a second time yesterday for Brunch.  Place was not very busy.  There were three of us and it took 45 minutes for us to get our food.  It seemed like there was only one waiter working in the entire place.  The waiter came by our table and told us that would meals were being plated - which took 10 minutes.  I ordered the french toast burger and the burger was 100% raw.  I had asked the waiter to send it back.  It took 15 minutes for my burger to come back.  The two other people who were with me were finished their means before I received mine for the second time.  When I looked at the burger, half of it was missing and all of the cream cheese icing had been scraped off.  I told this all to the waiter and he apologized and said he would "take care of some of it."  After receiving the bill I notcied that I was still charged $12 for the burger.  I notified the waiter and he apologized and then removed the charge completely.   It is a shame that service is so slow both times that I went to this restaurant as the food is quite delicious.  Not sure if I would go back a third time.

The food here was fantastic! We had the bhel puri and paneer tikka dry for our appetizers. For dinner we had butter paneer, chana masala, raita, and naan. Easily the best paneer tikka we have ever had. The texture was perfect and it was just the right amount of spicy. The chana masala was good, not the best, but not enough to take away a star. The naan was so light and crispy. The butter paneer was also excellent. We're definitely going to visit again.

Had a lousy dining experience today worth sharing.  After officiating at a funeral service, decided to stop for lunch at a restaurant I had visited once before when I was visiting family in Missouri.  The restaurant in question is "Buffalo Wild Wings".  The experience in Missouri was positive, so when I saw one in my area, decided I'd top in for lunch.   Huge mistake!   Things started pleasantly enough, until I placed my order and it arrived.   The order was totally wrong.   The waiter said, no problem, he would get the right order out quickly, as I had limited time.   A few minutes later, the order arrived, and I consumed about half of it, and requested a doggy bag to take home.  Soon the waiter arrived, asking me if I wanted dessert.   I declined, indicating that I had received a critical call and needed my check so I could get on the road.   Some time passed, before the check arrived, so I left a cash tip (20%) even though that was overly generous for the less than stellar service.   The check came, I paid it with my debit card, and the server picked it up.  Soon he returned for me to sign it, which I did, then left.  Didn't realize something was missing:  they failed to return my debit card.   I only discovered this fact about twenty miles down the road when I stopped for gas and no debit card.   I had a meager amount of cash left, enough to put in enough gas to return to the restaurant to retrieve the debit card.  When I arrived, I had to wait a while before the manager finally came for the with my card.  He said the server chased me to the parking lot, to no avail.   To say that he "chased" me was clearly an exaggeration, as I'm 61 years old and I didn't sprint to my car, which was some distance from the entrance to the restaurant.   A decent restaurant would have at least offered an apology, if not some form of comp for the additional 40 miles of driving and lost time.   Not "Buffalo Wild Wings".   My second and last time to patronize this establishment.  The food was ok, but not outstanding.  The service was substandard.  Perhaps I share some blame in not being more aware of the fact that my card had not been returned when I paid the bill, but being that I was already delayed in departing due to their poor service had me thinking more about getting back on the road.  My verdict is that "Buffalo Wild Wings" is a fast buck, low customer satisfaction operation.   From here on out, I'll eat elsewhere.

I love the sushi here. I usually order out since the dine in service is slow. My favorite roll are the Rock and roll and the Easter roll, if you're a fan of smoked salmon you will not be disappointed.

I love this place. The food is delicious. But does anyone else feel jittery and have a pounding heart rate after eating their food? I've eaten there twice in the past week for dinner and both times could not sleep or slept really poorly after. I hate to bash this place, bc, like I said, the food is delicious.
