My husband took me here for my birthday and we used a restaurant.com certificate.   My husband had the chicken parmesan and I decided to go with the capellini and meatballs. The food was very good, and the serving sizes were more than generous, what I bought home lasted another 2 meals. We were there this past Sunday and it was a beautiful day to sit outside on the deck.   Our server was very nice,so no complaints there.  The only compliaint I had is that the outdoor dining area is not right  on the lake, but on the side of the building. I noticed that another review mentioned that the lettuce in his salad was Brown.  I did not have this problem, everything was fresh.   All in all a very nice experience.
A little bit expensive.

If I could give it a minus one I would. I stopped in with a buddy an hour before closing time for a Bud-light on tap. I use to frequent this place in the 80,s and 90's and had nothing but good things to say about it. We ordered our beers and placed a 20 dollar bill on the bar. We got 4 dollars back - the bartender explained with attitude that it was 8 bucks a beer. This is absolutely outrageous. The place next door was charging us 4 bucks a beer and it is a much nicer place. I will never go back to Mollys. Beware of getting ripped off by the old man behind the bar........

food came out cool (appetizer, soup and entree) , had to send it back each time, they were out of entrees at 7PM on a Friday, very very disappointed. this is basic stuff, how can they not get this right?

They got it all wrong. Went here the other night on what should have been a very fun, spontaneous, week night date. We would've been better off at home, in our PJ's, eating store bought pizza. We waited forever and when we did finally order, they brought out another table's order. We felt teased because by then, we were famished! So we waited for our meals and when they finally came, they were cold....so much waiting....that was the worst part. The server was very non responsive, showed little urgency, and never offered an apology or kind word...Save your money. Don't go here!

OVERPRICED and MEDIOCRE I ordered a $16 Fontina and Zucchini Risotto dish and it was mediocre tasting and small in portion size. It was also so scalding hot I couldn't touch it for what seemed like 10 minutes. I'm definitely not going back to this place.

THE CHEF SHOULD BE GIVEN A NOBEL PRIZE. genius! the best steak i've ever had in my life, the best pasta i've ever had in my life, the calamari is a unique blend of cherry tomatos and bananas... whaaaaat? i over eat every time i come here. i eat here almost every day. best food i've ever had.

Junior's is known for their cheesecake so it was a must that I stop by here before I leave NY.  My boyfriend and I got the plain NY cheesecake and red velvet cheesecake.  Both was creamy and very tasty.

Online order: This might have been my fault as I forgot to put the tip on the bill when I checked out on seamless. I was just going to pay the tip with cash but didn't make that clear on the notes or anything. But the food got to me at least 70 minutes after I ordered when the predicted time was 20-45 minutes. The cheese burger was cold and broken. Yes, a part of the burger had fallen off to the side on the plate. It was a dry burger that was wet with the steam and hence soggy. I have never quite experienced anything like it. The steak fries were more like cold potatoes - the ketchup packets helped mask the taste. I have been studying all day and this midnight meal was the first thing I had eaten all day. Couldn't finish the burger or the fries (even when doused in sriracha from the fridge). Very disappointing. Considering there are so many other diners in the area, jackson hole will not be hearing from me anytime soon.

Good Morning, Over the weekend i was in PS Richards,I got myself a Expresso machine which i am very happy with. this place was awesome!! specially an associatenamed Mike Boston. This kid was very helpful. I will be always come back to this store! Thank you .

First off can I say I loved this restaurant and always boosted it to everyone. Unfortunately after last night I will never go back to this restaurant.  So picture it September 24, 2014 at 8:30pm, my mom, grandmother and I go to grab a bite to eat at a last minute decision. We arrive and order the red sangria. They pour the drink and proceed to ask for our orders. My grandmother order the salad bar and left get her food once she place it. My mom ordered the mixed meat platter and I wanted the radizio. The waiter with blue eyes say I can not have radizio and my mom can not have the mixed meat platter together. He said one of us would have to switch with the other and order the same item or get the mixed meat platter for 2. I told him we have been her many times and this is the first we have heard of this. I told him I know it has been a while since I have been her with my mom and grandmother, but we have placed our orders like this before. The waiter insisted we change our order. I asked to speak with the manager on call. The manager came to my table and I briefly explained the situation to him. He agreed with the waiter and said we have never allowed anyone to  order these two dishes together at the same table. I told him that's not true because we have done it before. He then said last week they had an issue with a customer whom order radizio and the mixed meat platter together and they were stealing the food. (but your never sold these two dishes together) He then switched it up and said a year ago that people could order the radizio and mixed meat platter together, but they can't do it now. (which is it I'm confused the stories don't match) So we asked how we could continue with our meal so all parties can get what they want. The manager said we would both have to order the same dish. I said what if I sit at another table and order my radizio. The manager said that would be fine with him. We moved to a different location in the restaurant. I sat at a table with my grandmother and mom sat at the table next to us. I asked if we could have the check put on one bill. The manager said that he would have to keep both our orders separate. The food we order finally arrived to our table arrived at both our tables and we tried to savage the rest of our experience. The next thing you know the manager comes back to my table and comes to my right hand side and tells me that this is his second time warning me about this policy. I dropped my fork and knife and asked him who he was speaking to. He seemed so sincere and said he told me the last time I was here that radizio and the mixed meat platter could not be ordered together. I told him, he didn't know what he was talking about as it has been almost a year since I have been here with my family. He pointed at me, my mom and my grandmother and said he remembers all of us and he told us this back them. My mom interjected and said the last time we were here we ordered the mixed meat platter for two and complained about you only giving us one short rib and it wasn't even you that handled that situation. Why are you here talking to us again when we solved the situation already. The manager asked my mom if her meal was ok and completely ignored what I was saying to him. But I repeated my comments again. I said I don't appreciate being spoken to like I'm a child. I asked him if he wanted me to return back to his establishment and asked him to stop ruining my meal and bothering me. The manager walked away and shortly after a waitress comes and stands in our area watching. Shortly after her arrival a waiter joins her and they begin speaking a different language. Once our meal was completed and we asked for the to-go container for my mom's dish, I told her not to let them pack it as we don't know what they would do to her food. She packed it and closed the container. Next thing you know both the waiter and waitress move away from us. I looked around and asked for the bill. If this wasn't the best evening my desert was next. They added the 15% gratuity onto my mom bill and to my bill. I wanted to tell them to take it off, but I just couldn't argue anymore. I game my card and wrote down the correct amount that was suppose to be charge excluding the gratuity. I snapped a picture and said I will call my back an dispute this another day. All in all I loved this place, but I will never go back to the restaurant again nor will my friends. Rio Radizio on Route 22 is better and has a better selection for the buffet and a better quality of meat. So long Brsilia Gill. The Better Business Bureau has be notified of your actions.   Thank you

The food is terrific, the service is exceptional, and the place is very classy, even at the bar. I have dined here fairly often and have never gotten a poor meal or shoddy service. This is a wonderful spot for special occasions. I love to take out of towners here for their first experience of the coty. You cannot go wrong with this place but please call for reservations. a secret is thqt you can sit at the bar if you have no reservations and eat.
Great food, friendly staff, nice ambiance.   Although they tend to get packed on weekends, their brunch menu is really good and they feature live jazz music.  Definitely worth the wait.
Best $6 breakfast in NYC!  Amazing greasy spoon corned beef hash.

The food was largely excellent - for starters, the chèvre tartelette was amazing, baby octopus and mussels in dijon sauce were also very good. For mains, the filet mignon with foie gras was incredible, though the heavy sauce was a little too dominant and overwhelmed the softer flavours of meat and foie gras a little. We also enjoyed the lamb a lot; the hanger steak was the only main that we thought could have been better - it was too fatty. It's very cosy - quite a lot of people crammed into a small space. It worked out fine for us, but if your neighbours are loud this may be annoying. Service was very friendly. In all, it was a lovely evening that left us very happy and planning to retur
I love the salad bar. I had a balsamic chicken was good but the chicken wasn't moist. It was kind of dry. I usually had a very good chicken.
Good pizza but expensive. Whole foods pizza is just as good and is offered at much more reasonable price.

I don't get it, I really don't.  I see the lines outside, I see the people waiting and laughing.  For what? I have been here twice. And both times, the food was sub-par at best. I gave them the benefit of the doubt the first time cause I said to myself anyone can have a bad day.  The second time though? I was done. The famed mac and cheese?  CAPTAIN CRUNCH entrees? Stop trying to think outside the box on every single thing, instead make one thing really good. The second time we came we brought my one year old son and I will be honest, I think it bothered them. This place seems like it is too cool for you, and if you don't like the food or the atmosphere "You just don't get it" type of thing.  Trust me I do get it. I graduated from culinary school, worked at restaurants in Seattle,New York and around the country.  I cook everyday for work and I know what is good food. The Turkey dinner burger? Yeah when we ordered it, the middle was cool. They are going for the Juicy Lucy thing. Why?  Honestly the best thing I had was the Mexican bottle of Coke. And oh yeah it isn't cheap for what you are getting.  Maybe it's me people,  maybe I am just a fool and out of touch. All I know is I pass this place literally every day and I just ask myself why? If you want some really good mac and cheese,  try the Cafeteria in Manhattan.  They make it very well and you can get a multiple flavor sampler as an appetizer.  Btw, I have no affiliation with the Cafeteria,  we just like to eat  out and I wanted to be honest.
Ummm this place food is soooooooooo tasty! Been twice had the jerk pork with plantain and rice 2nd time the oxtail and a bunch of other tasty sides. I love this place

I LOVE THIS PLACE! The food is amazing and what is best about this place is the staff, they are accommodating, wonderful people that are very attentive and understand customer service. The atmosphere is warm, inviting and welcoming!!! this is always my place to go for a business lunch/dinner.  And now they've added breakfast! what a treat! Try the Branzino, the spreads, Cod fritters, grilled octopus (well done), Greek salad, OMG the home made soup...seafood...amazing!, Greek yogurt...I've had these all.  There were a couple of items that were on the menu when they first open that are no longer, and wished they wouldn't of taken them off...but other then that...Delicious!!!!
The grilled octopus appetizer was a delicious entree I paired with their steamed greens. Excellent, polite, and fast service.

I love this restaurant. The food is consistently outstanding. The prices are reasonable, the portions are large and, whether you order pizza, a sandwich or a full dinner, the taste is top notch. Their chicken parm, lasagna and eggplant are the best in the Trenton area. The owner is a very affable and upbeat man and he usually makes the rounds to see that the customers are happy. the wait staff is often family and they are friendly and helpful, always eager to please. The restaurant itself is oddly configured, and seating can be awkward. However, the food is so fine that the so called ambiance is of little importance.
5 stars for the spumoni! It's well worth the trip out there just for that!

It is not always a treat to drive your departing company 140 miles to Newark Airport for their return to Germany, so we stopped at the Spanish Tavern for lunch. I do not want to get gushy, but  it made the trip worth the ride. This place is great and I would recommend it to anyone. Thank you for a very pleasant dining experience.
Solid sliders. Nothing special, but cheap price.
Excellent service and the food is great ! Had the shrim pad thai with a long island blue lemonade..food was quick. our waiter was attentive and gave us great service ! Thanks again i will be back

Besides the oysters and the excellent local beers we we served a perfectly balanced main dish of fish and vegetables (monkfish and brussels sprouts). Friendly and knowledgeable service (oyster recommendations). On a Friday night we could be seated within 20 minutes. Affordable prices.

Bad bad bad customer service. Places looks awesome BUT the hostess/Waitress/Bar tender/Cashier/busgirl LOL was unprofessional & miserable (owner makes her miserable) she got mad at us because she forgot our order lol... She asked twice and she forgot twice...She goes, "your food is almost ready"...did you order CBA? Me, "hmmm No, I have ordered ABC." Then she gets mad at me lol. OOOOKKK. And food never arrived...!

Bartenders not paying attention to non-regular customers.  The regulars are a mix of old local drunks and some are quite obnoxious.  Menu is limited and food is mediocre.  This won't be the last restaurant at this location...

What a lovely place! I've only been there once so far, but I can't wait to be back. It's so beautiful and cozy. The coffee was good and I had a chocolate cookie which was fresh (at 5pm!) and delicious. The stuff was also very friendly and polite. I only wish they were open until 6:30pm, that's when my class at FIT starts and I like to get a coffee right before.

Great coffee & food!  (and service!)  They are so nice here and always have delicious homemade treats.  Especially love the banana bread with chocolate chips.  Good sandwiches for lunch too.  Often get fresh fruit for breakfast also...always a nice variety.

Okay so I read the reviews and was not keen on eating here but we decided to try it. Should have gone with my gut! Literally! Both ordered the bacon cheeseburger. One with garlic fries and one with Cajun fries. Chocolate milkshake and a water. Food came out incredibly fast.  My burger was okay for the first few bites then got 2 big pieces of gristle so that turned me off. My fries were crispy which I like but just had done warm crushed garlic poured over it. The Cajun ones were better but super spicy. The best part of the meal was the chocolate shake as it was thick and very good chocolate but I just had one taste of it. From the time we sat down until we got our check was 17 minutes. Too fast even for an airport. Most people who take time to sit down for a meal at an airport are usually not pressed for time. Folks check out other options for a meal as we found lots of places walking to our gate. And most of all trust the YELPER reviews unlike stupid me!!! Reviews from YELPERS are meant to be used. I have got to get better with this!
I love this place. It has great food and amazing service. I'm happen to drink a lot of liquids and the sever is nice enough to leave a pitcher of water for me on the table.
Have given this place SEVERAL chances and will never be back again...the service is ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE and even after speaking with the owner, he still has the same lazy, slow staff.  Sad.

I'm all about preparation. Got the seats at the prep counter and watched the Japanese head chef dish out individual designer sushis to a Japanese couple in front of him. The presentation and choice of fish made my mouth water. When my sashimi platter came, I could tell some of the variety (maybe all) had been previously frozen and the hamachi lost a bit of flavor. Still good for typical NY sashimi standards (no freezer burn of course). Their tempura came with green tea salt, wasabi salt and some other fancy ingredient I can't remember. The flavors and textures were good. Pleasant wait staff, good dining experience.
The good is AMAZING. Go for the ribs and pulled pork. The portions are amazing. Prepare to eat when you get there. Good food for a good price. It was so good I went twice in one day.

I've only ever eaten at the bar but it's always been good. Every time we go we see this other patron who eats there 3-4 times a week and is also a been a chef. He is always saying to try the chicken. I would but the fish specials always seem more tempting. Definitely worth a stop but keep in mind this place is not super casual so dress like you should. It's worth it.
The duck was dry and tasted like fried salty cardboard. Their eggplant and panfried noodles were okay. The overall experience needs work and has a lot of potential.
Giving this place 5 stars for service and price!  The 2 waitresses could not have been more attentive to our group of 10 including 4 children.

I've passed this place 100 times thinking it was a sit down extension of the  pizza joint next door.  It's not. It should say "curry house" on the facade. Anyway, me and my girlfriend went and started with the cauliflower appetizer which tasted like crunchy chicken and was totally awesome. Then we each had a different curry with a different meat. The lamb was tender and tasty and the chicken was cooked perfectly. The curries were delicious. I won't tell which ones we got. We'll going back.

Outstanding sushi. Loved the white tuna sushi, sunflower roll and the Mountain Roll. Attentive wait staff. They even gave us 4 pieces of a chef special roll to try - on the house. All of the fish was extremely fresh.

I would like to give this place at least 4 stars because I really enjoyed the drinks, but unfortunately I cant.  While the bartender was very nice, my  husband was served in a dirty glass with a lipstick rim. I thought that was completely unacceptable, not to mention unsanitary. No wonder they have a B grade.

I can't recall the day I went but it was a memorial resturant experience.  I was greeted by an incredibly nice cashier. After a hard decision I ordered a Devils delight and the girl giggled ( of course I was confused) She explained it was Dev's Delight and named after her because it was her idea for a burger and me calling it Devils delight was a bit funny because her friends call her Devil Dev ( hard to believe such a nice girl could aquire such a nickname but cute). After she took my thorough of a medium burger, and truffle fires i didn't have to wait very long. Even before I ate the burger the smell it self had my mouth watering.  The burger was cooked to perfection and what was on the burger was amazing!  This burger was a standard beef foundation with mozzarella cheese tomato basil and a portobello mushroom, what great idea for a burger! For a mushroom lover this with a side of the delicious truffle fries is perfect. Excellent quality and service,  a bit expensive but worth every penny. No question about it I will be a return customer!

My wife and I dined in over the weekend.  I ordered the Samson and my wife ordered the cheesesteak and whiz fries.  The Samson is a massive pile of stuff while very hardy it was nothing special.  The cheesesteak was very salty and meat was overcooked.  The whiz fries were super salty and greasy - we like our fries to be cripsy and erected not drowned w/ whiz cheese.  If you enjoy salt and grease this is your haven.  The decor and service is good however the food is very salty and inhumanly greasy.
Lobster was excellent and the bun was buttery and we'll toasted. Only negative is cash only.

Okay in case no one knows it is the first pizza in America and its still amzing. I am torn between grimaldis and here but as it turns out the patzy learned how to make pizza from the original lombardi. Both legendary pizza places so it makes it hard to  choose. But I hate the fact that there is no dessert but we are here for pizza not dessert, so keep making great pizza. Even though little Italy is not as big anymore and it changed all around you, dont change a thing or maybe just add desert. Well on second thought just go down to the legendary ferara pastry shop down the block.
Came here after a show at new world stage.  Amazing quality. Fast service. Worth any wait.
I went out with my wife for some drinks and a good time.The place was awesome I will come again.

Started off a little rocky when they did not have our reservation. But quickly changed when they not only fit us in but amazed us with great service and interesting, delicious, amazing food. There were four of us so we did the "chef selection". Everything was the so good.

I ate here at this pleasant Chinese restaurant during my first visit to NYC. The pizza and cheese steaks are out of this world!  I especially like to franks red hot they put on their wings served with a cold one. The football games on big screens are a plus as well. Lastly, the take out garlic and chicken is great. The mozzarella sticks are the BOMB.  If you like Chinese food, I recommend you pass. Chinese food,wings,and beer will make you explode.

Went here twice and haven't been let down yet. Their Roti is magnificent, the service is fast and the Spicy Fried Squid Tentacles leave me smiling for hours. In all seriousness, the Seafood Rice Noodles is a simple yet infinitely flavorful dish that is enough to fill one but serve two or three. The Salted Fish and Broccoli? FANTASTIC. I've yet to try even a quarter of the menu, but I plan on going back to remedy that.

The kind folks at Natraj know how to make a great meal and treat their customers right! I live in West Orange and they very kindly deliver to my house - the food is always hot, delicious and delivered with a smile!

Stopped in for the fist time today after a recommendation. I got the roast pork with spinach and it was great. They told me i had to come back for the hot sausage. I figured why wait. I ordered one and they did not disappoint. So after 2 sandwiches I'm off for a nap, full and happy.
Very accommodating, reasonably priced and delivered a cake as a gift exactly at the expected delivery time. Would definitely order from them again.

I'm sorry to every one who have the business of biscuit Sandwich because I found an AMAZING place where I decided to go there and buy my biscuit sandwich all life. Hold your heartbeat friends this place is Cheeky Sandwiches. Let me tell that AWESOME AWESOME AMAZING this place. They have great Sandwiches for an affordable price. Good staff service,great and relaxing atmosphere, fresh items, awesome food Quality. Thank$.

I have given this place to so many chances to be good.  They never use salt so everything tastes bland. This is an easy fix and since they are the only breakfast spot in the neighborhood I have looked past this problem.  My last visit my entire order was wrong. When I called from my home the staff was rude and really didn't care that they made a mistake.  (Spoke with the same person each time I called).  The staff member sounded as if he took one to many bong hits that morning.  I don't mind if they want to smoke weed, just be able to do your job high.   Very very disappointing.  Never going back

Great coffee, delicious sandwiches, and best of all, quick service! I stopped in on a random day as I was walking down Irving street and was really impressed by this gem. I tried the RAD sandwich and can tell they use quality ingredients, want to come back soon and try the rest! The ladies behind the counter are also very charming. Rahway definitely has a new treasure with this place.
really good gyros! i would reccomend to a friend!

Food was outstanding! The experience was really fun starting with a greeting in Japanese that meant welcome. Noodle Ramen was very flavorful. However we would've like to have the pork to be cut up in the Soup. Edamame with the special salt was outstanding. Cucumber dish was excellent. Green tea sorbet was different. We would return.

The food is good and the pork and chicken buns are great! Good ramen portion, I was full after eating two pork buns and a ramen bowl. They give you extra ramen if you have broth left over. Its not free extra ramen but at least you dont have to let your broth go to waste.
pork buns ftw.

The fresh pita was the only good thing about our $105 meal. This place RIPS YOU OFF. We went this past Tuesday night around 6:45 pm. Whoever is giving this place 4 or 5 stars, must be related to the owners or chefs. We started with a waitress who seemed like she was trying out for the real life Daria. I'm sorry we came to the restaurant and you had to serve us, we totally ruined your night. We first ordered the fried olives. They tasted like someone rolled them in a bit of sawdust, let them sit in tupperware for a few days, and then warmed them up in the microwave. Then we got the hummus and pita. The hummus tasted like...nothing!! For an entree, I ordered the sea bass, per Daria's recommendation. The dish had about 4 gnocchi and 8 mushrooms with it. It tasted like every ingredient was put into a jar together, shaked around and then arranged on the plate. The flavor was consistent to store bought gravy. My husband got the special - meatballs with a flaky crust. He said it would have been good if he was a deer in winter in desperate need of salt. Daria brought us some limoncella at the end, from the chef, but it didn't wash down our disappointment.

I have been going there since they opened as Capri Caffe and I know the owner and the owner knows me well. The other day I ordered one of my favorite dish which is veal ravioli and it was not as good as it used to be -- thought it was a fluke. Today I ordered linguini with shrimp and I asked for Al Dante and guess what the linguini came out so soft!! Really?!?!? Then I told the waiter who barely spoke English argued that it was Al Dante and I was wrong! Wtf?!?!? What kind of customer service is here? I don't think I will be going back here again. Today you lost your royal customer for the past 4 years!

I love good pizza. In Nj there is some good pizza. At Grimaldi 's in Brooklyn I got some great pizza.  The line wasn't there, we walked right in, the servers were attentive, and the table relatively clean. Hey in this part of the city, everything is relative. Crust is very important in pizza. This was crisp with a nice thin layer of sauce , bubbling cheese, and just the right touch of spices. The large size was large as in let's take the rest home and eat it for breakfast. Recommend and hope you get the same cook who did our pie- a work of yummy art!!

This place has been here for a few years always wanted to try it. After a late night shopping trip to Target my husband and I decided to give it a try . The place is breathtakingly amazing , the setting is perfect. The hostess was super nice and let us pick where we wanted to sit. The waitress was an expertise. The food looked good and was good. Can't wait to go back !!

Well the only reason I am not giving it 5 STARS is because it is always hard to get in and when you do its hard to move around. I guess that is good for business. I will say what keeps me coming back in are the fantastic blood orange margaritas. Keep them coming.
Awesome beer, great food, and good prices.  I love come here!

Finally a legit BBQ place in CT! Wahoo! Only disappointment; they were all sold out of the burnt ends ): The brisket was my favorite, along with the mac&cheese and coleslaw. Their sauces are all delicious too! One suggestion: more sides please! Def need a potato salad and corn on the cob!
I stopped in for a quick lunch after searching yelp for a Cuban sandwich. I was very pleased to find a great classic Cuban sandwich. Must return to explore the rest of the menu
love this place! amazing staff, food is fabulous and wait is worth it! my bestie

Not great. I first made sure with the hostess it wasn't too late (I didn't want to be THAT guy) to eat. She assured me I wasn't being that guy and ushered me to the bar. Great, game's on and I think I already know what I want for my late dinner. Might even get a drink, too. Well, many minutes pass, and there's no bartender. I see plenty of servers walking around and chatting with each other in a pack, and still no bartender or anyone asking me if I've been helped. Eventually a guy gets behind the bar and immediately starts conversing with a worker who is off shift and eating dinner. It had been about 7 minutes and I was super hungry, so I left. Bad service will run me right out.

My review is so negative for Pepes because of the extreme disappointment I have felt the last two trips I took there. I drove from Boston, once 5 months ago and just last weekend, for my favorite white clam pizza and was told both times I could not buy one to go, even if I tipped well over 20%. They told me this would be temporary situation as "clams were running low" but that sounds like a sorry excuse. I planned for so long to get my favorite pizza and both times my patronage was dismissed, so now I am dismissing Pepes. Multiple places in new haven were happy to sell me a $30+ clam pizza, and I gladly went to a new restaurant and was pleasantly surprised. Try Sally's, bar, or modern they were much happier to sell me a pizza, I even got a free salad at modern for having to wait 10 extra minutes! My family, who have been enjoying Pepes for over 60 years, have been greatly disappointed from this. My grandma, parents, cousins and me found out that customer loyalty means nothing. This review will be changed if any updates occur. I will try again but won't get my hopes up. Management needs to fix this problem ASAP. RIP quality derives from Pepes pizza.

Very creative name for the area. We love the outdoor  seating that about does it for the good.   The food is far below the standard anyone should expect from a neighborhood bar. The interior is dark and uninviting.  Our server seemed to have other things on her mind.   I will not be returning.
Love it! Excellent pizza. Great beer. Love the barrel-aged Manhattans. Owner is a cool, nice guy. Good service. Nice atmosphere. Will come here a lot.

oh! amazing!!!!!!!!!!! every dish was spectacular!  i would dine here daily!  it's just a joy!  every dish has something unique about it.  if you are a foodie - it's a must splurge place!   also, in between courses they serve little treats - and i must say - those are to die for!  this is a fancy restaurant that can actually fill you up! so when you leave the place you wont't be hungry! (and if you have gone to some fancy places like i did, you know what i mean!) :). space: it's like a french chateau... extremely cozy and beautiful.
Fresh food, terrific service and nicely presented Mediterranean dishes.  What more could you ask for?  As the crowds will attest, this is a new area favorite!
Was in New York for 4 days, ate here 3 out of the 4 days. And I have pretty high standards for pizza!! Enough said!! Must have!!
Just left and we loved this place. We ordered nachos with chorizo for our appetizer. Dinner was tacos with pulled pork and chimichanga with steak.  Great food and even better staff! Recommended.

Was looking for a place to share with friends coming into NYC from Spain  and this seemed like sometHing that would be " tapas like"  but yet give them a different take of food from USA. We had a great time . Had been warned that it might be a bit expensive but was well worth it for high quality food. Had several new Mediteranean dishes and some normal favorites . Ambiance was good with a nice bar in entrance but we had made a reservation  since we had 6 people and were seated on time . Waiter was helpful and attentive  and food arrived on time which was surprising for a Saturday Night . We shared a number of appetizer dishes and also main dishes which worked well . Would be happy to back again .

I'm so sorry but I have to do this. This is commercialized wanna be Mexican food at it's best. You walk in, the place is gorgeous, and cozy, and warm, with pretty plates.  You've had a long day, you're starving and at this point almost anything will taste amazing... but then you sink your teeth in.  Only to find out you've deceived by pretty well decorated flavorless food. This one really shocked me, I must say!  Walked by this place for months a few times and thought this was going to be great.  The reviews were decent enough.  I'm still thrown off by it and shocked.  Maybe it was an off night? It was 9/23 after 9pm I believe. The food was very very bland!  Every part of it.  Everything from the sauce to the chicken.  Even the black beans managed to be bland.  How can you get bland black beans at a Mexican food place.?? I didn't even know that was possible.  Even the coffee which was my last attempt to enjoy something there was horrible.  I took one sip and immediately gave up on it.  Sorry but this was just my experience. Can't say I'll ever give it another chance.  Hopefully this was just an off day or something. The staff was nice.

Horrible customer service, don't go there! I have been frequenting this place for half a year only because it's close by so I can grab some food after work when I don't have time to cook. Today I order a dish which is noted not spicy on the menu, but i believe they put in the most spicy pepper there ( the green thin one).  My tears bust out since I cannot handle spicy.  The waitress said this is the way they prepare dish.  I asked for a replacement and they said since the food is touched they will not either replace or refund it because "if the food is not touched, they can still sell the dish to other customers"!!!  This is the most disgusting I eve heard in restaurant that they even try to resell food that's returned by customer. For your own hygiene Please don't go this restaurant.  Their waitress even come over to my desk scolding me for eating the food.  She glanced at my plate and judged how I eat my food, and raised her voice at me in front of all my customers.  When I asked for manager she keeps yelling "I am the manager".  I don't know where thats true or not, but don't think I will go to a place that treat their long term customer like a piece of dirt.  UNbelievable!

This place is perf if you wanna get some cheap tasty grub that makes you feel warm and fuzzy inside. Tasty comfort food mmm!! They have their own beer list so don't embarrass yourself by trying to order a Switchback (ha, tourist!). They're also open late with a good late night menu of mostly fried food (mmm mozarella sticks..) Would recommend for birthday dinner with friends, casual night out with the boo, or tension breaking meet-and-greet meal with the boo's parents.

What a great addition to the Glastonbury restaurant scene!  I had the best panini I've ever had...Steak Horseradish!  It's a build your own panini concept with a very hip atmosphere.  They have a bunch of selections or you can make your own.  Highly recommended!

I had a stop-over in New York last weekend and a friend recommended Bijan's - I fell in love with the rustic, modern and cozy decor! The food was great and the staff very accommodating - I wish they had a place like this near me in London!

Hi, I was visiting Philadelphia for one of my friends marriage. We decided to try different places and Geno's steaks was one of them because it was nearby. It was a wonderful experience. The bread was very soft and fresh. Meat was very juicy while the Cheese was ok. Wasn't so impressed by the customer service though and the seating area. Will definitely come back.

I've been here a handful of times and I've never been disappointed. The food is great, I especially love the veggie wings (which is something I never thought I'd say, being a traditional buffalo wings lover). The catfish po boy, fried pickles and brisket pinwheel are some other items on the menu that I really enjoyed. The beer selection is incredible as well. They always have some good micro brews on tap. The wait staff is very knowledgeable and helpful when it comes to describing what's on tap and helping pick out a beer. Overall, a great place to eat and/or grab a drink. I'll keep going back.

Friends and I craved for some Peruvian food  while working in New York. We ordered the Lomo Saltado which was excellent and the chicken plate was amazing! Pair that with some savignon blanc and you're all set! Definitely will come back for more!

I came here with my boyfriend and one of his best friends for dinner tonight. all I have to say the food is banging. and by banging I mean it was delicious. we all got something different and tried everything. highly recommend the empanadas and the yellow rice pork 2 different ways and the beans were superb. at the end of the day highly recommend this fine dining establishment

I am absolutely obsessed with this place! Every single time I go, I am never disappointed. The staff is perfectly polite and accommodating, serving us water and items off the menu while we waited for the rest of our party to arrive. Words do not even begin to describe their biscuits and peach butter. There isn't an adequate description for them. They're an absolutely delicious pair. The perfect items to curb your intense hunger while waiting for either your friends to arrive so you can order, or just waiting for your food to arrive. I was  a little put off by the grainy texture of the french pressed coffee, but the few sips I had of it were delightful. The cubed brown sugar dissolves fabulously in the hot coffee. I had the eggs and toast both times I went and because of this place, I'm going to start baking my eggs. The bacon is always cooked to perfection and the country toast with butter hits the nail on the head to complete that hearty lunch dish. Plus the tomatoes are so fresh! This place is a gem.
Worst service ever......and both times we went there someone ended up getting sick.....Portuguese place ....I think not.    Needs real managers and way better quality of food....

This restaurant is BYOB the food is excellent.. I've been here several times and always try different dishes and have been satisfied with all of them.. The only downfall is that they don't make reservations on weekends and it gets really packed so the wait time is very long..

I ordered a bottle of sake at this restaurant. Love the food. But when we ask the waitress if we can take a half drank bottle of sake home, we were told that it's state law that we cannot, but must finish the bottle on premise or leave it. So now, we were forced to finish the bottle and risk the danger of drunk driving. Really???
Used to be my favorite restaurant in Montclair. However the service is miserably bad. Food takes hours to come and it's really not worth the wait.

Just came back from honeymoon in Bali a week ago... Thank you guys for bringing flavors of vacation! This place is beautiful and the food is great!! Loved the crispy chicken served with spicy squash! Great portion also: leaves room to enjoy a great dessert! Service was great and I will come back!

The food here is absolutely disgusting. I ordered the orange chicken and it was raw and fatty in the inside, mushy on the outside. The sauce tasted like aunt jemima syrup. The garlic shrimp was OK but it was 90% broccoli. The noodles and egg rolls were just plain soggy. Try asking them for chili sauce without their sighing and complaining. It was a 40 dollar meal that went straight to the garbage.

This cozy tavern is the gem of fairmount/art museum area.  I had never of heard of McCrossens until I moved to this neighborhood.   The food is outstanding and offers enough diversity that everyone do be happy. My Girlfriend is a vegetarian which can lead to problems, she is super happy eating here.  We normally spilt the whipped ricotta and beet salad. The salad and ricotta is enough to fill us both up, what a deal!!  When our parents come into town we take them there and sit in the dining room.   W have eaten almost the entire menu and would order it all again.  The falafel is out of this world as is the smoked tomato with the short rib. They make very delicate gnocchi that is served with a sweet corn broth....boom Brunch is not my favorite and I would never go out for brunch unless I have to. Th past two weekends we have had guests staying at your home and we all went to McCrossens for brunch.  The Benedict and ribs have incredible eggs on them.  I have had these sous vide eggs at high end fancy restaurants. I was shocked to see them at McCrossens. A much as I dislike the idea of brunch at least these eggs give me something to look forward to.

This is the kind of place you really like to run into. While on vacation we had decided we would have a BBQ feast on our last night and we were not disappointed. The oil tank smoker they were using put out some tasty treats. The brisket was juicy and tender. The ribs were nice and smoky with a nice rub that added a layer of crispiness. They were served dry with a selection of sauces you could apply. Go for the HELL sauce. A young brother and sister were daring me to try it while I was waiting for my order to finish crisping on the grill. It was nice and fruity with a nice habenero bite. I made sure I took plenty home. We also had pulled pork and chicken, both were sauced  nicely with a nice smoky touch. The ladies who run this wonderfully rustic stop couldn't be nicer. I was treated to some nice burnt ends, ribs and chicken while I waiting. Well worth the wait and the side dishes showed the love that went into preparing their food. Definitely stop in if you are traveling through Windsor on Rt. 5.

The food was great and the design of the resturant was so happy and welcoming that when I walked in I felt like a regular.  Everything from the pizza to chicken salad were great. I usually don't order appetizers when I go for pizza but this time I tried the motzerella sticks and even though I was a little unsure at first,  It was worth it.  They were great! I loved everything about the place EXCEPT that I was fooled into thinking that my food would be brought to my table. The waitress only brought us some of our meals (I needed to pick up my own). I have no problem getting my own food but don't advertise a service that you can't fulfill. Overall it was pretty good.  I would definitely go back.

Weirdest sushi place. They used tilapia for sashimi and put cream cheese and goat cheese in sushi. I don't think I can even call them sushi. It is more of a hipster place than a sushi place. If you are a serious sushi lover, should definitely steer away from this place.

I am upset. I live a 10 min. walk from Kimchi Grill, but they refuse to deliver to the other side of Eastern Parkway, while delivering to residences well into Bed Stuy. I can only infer why they've chosen to deliver in certain areas and not others, but I will no longer frequent this establishment.

I found the atmosphere was nice and pub-like, but the pints of beer were $8, which I feel is too much for a rustic pub with sawdust on the floor. With tip that's 9 or 10 bucks for a pint, which adds up pretty quickly. Three beers for $27-30. I believe the food is pretty good, but I didn't have any.

Fantastic hamburger meat, decent sandwiches. Tasty soups and pre-prepared salads, too. Very Mom-and-Pop feeling shop with friendly service. The Italian sub, Cordon Bleu cutlets, and local bakery goods are a must!

I love salads that taste like the ingredients were picked that day.  And that is how the salad tasted.  Perfectly dressed.  Yum. The pizza followed... we asked for a crunchy crust and that is what they delivered, along with scrumptious toppings.  Nice cocktails, great wine and super friendly service.
Good healthy food at reasonable prices. Great for lunch take out. Love their spinach salad, and smoothies. Give them a try

This has become a regular haunt for my girlfriend and myself after moving to Astoria! Wonderful staff, good variety of food, and the kangaroo burger is truly a guilty pleasure (can't help feel terrible for eating them but they're absolutely delicious).

I was so excited to have an authentic Argentinian steak.  I asked before I got here if they were authentic and when I arrived if it was an authentic rib eye... 'yes'  they said.  I was disappointed in the steak and it didn't remind me of the AUTHENTIC rib eye I had before.  After our meal,  while waiting for our car,  there was a delivery man delivering OMAHA STEAKS!!!  The worker went back inside and I asked the delivery man,  'is this what you always delivery, ' Omaha Steaks' he said yes!!!
excellent place, great food... I had the steak n eggs --superb! Long live RH!

Meh. The atmosphere was nice and everything looked beautiful, but the food and service left much to be desired. We got several small plates to share: avocado panna cotta (like fancy three-layer dip); can o' bread (kinda dry, but liked the Himalayan salt platter for the butter); lobster dumplings (very good); matzoh ball soup (nothing special and my first bite had chicken gristle); chicken and dumplings (more accurate, just chicken dumplings - very good but not quite what we expected); candied bacon (okay, when is bacon ever bad, exactly?). As for the service, it was great at first, but after our first dish we hardly saw anybody again and the dishes trickled out at a very slow pace (our soup arrived barely hot, which makes me wonder if it was the server or the kitchen). Overall, I'd say fabrick is nice to look at but not much else.

This place is my favorite restaurant above all restaurants I have tried basically everything they have and all I say is you are missing out if you don't try Jane and I am not saying this because the manger and I have the same birthday lol
The artichoke slice is banging. The pizza is so good, I know it is a heart attack waiting to happen but it's worth it

I went here with friends based on the yelp reviews and found it met the high expectations.  The staff was awesome and nice. My girlfriend got a high five on the way in.  The food was really good and has a good beer and cocktail selection.  The vibe inside was really nice. It is chill and pleasant without being stuffy.

Tonight my husband and I enjoyed an evening at Diamondz N Da Ruff. The fish sandwich was fantastic!!  The french fries were real potatoes not processed. The Sangria had the right about of kick to it and Karaoke was the icing on the cake. The patrons and waitstaff were super friendly. Parking is an issue...lack of and they ran out of food early in the evening even with that I would definitely go back. I think, I will try the breakfast next.

Beautiful environment. Top notch service. Love how the waiter poured wine. Everyone at the table enjoyed their meals with the exception of my chicken scapriella. It was flavorful. But the chicken itself was a little chewy and gamey.
Horrible place. The food is good, but our party was kicked out ten minutes after we paid. I didn't even finish my sangria.

I was in town in Philly for a conference and discovered this place completely by accident. Holy cow was it amazing!! I ordered food from Kamil's (Middle Eastern)- it was a major disappointment. The tabouli- a Middle Eastern staple if there ever was one- was completely flavorless (except for the overwhelming taste of parsley and cucumber). It tasted nothing like how a (good) tabbouli should taste. The falafel sandwich was- for its price- tiny and mediocre. In short, avoid Kamil's (unless you don't mind overpaying for bland, mediocre and overpriced food)
Disappointed, the food was dry (lomo) the fish was old will not be coming back.

For me customer service is really important in a restaurant. Waiters/Waitresses can easily ruin your appetite. To me, the food was a bit better than other shanghai restaurants you go to in chinatown. The waiter/waitresses do not respect customers.

Mundo's food is cooked with love and infused with warm hospitality and creativity!!! The venue is hip and trendy, and the owners Willie and Jon are so welcoming!!!  Their soundtracks are off the hook!  I am so glad they are back!!!  Love you guys!!! You have to go to there - it's sultry and sexy!!!  A delicious experience all around - promising you a night to remember!  I bring all my friends and dates!  Love!!!
Great food, great service.  Would definitely recommend a visit to this little gem.
Reasonable prices for good quality unique sushi as well as an interesting drink menu in an awesome comfortable space. It's definitely one of my new favorite sushi spots.

If I could give them less than 1 star I would.  I was there today.  I have never been treated so horribly, and it was from the owner himself.  I walked in to order some deli.  There were 4 people behind the counter and not one of them asked if they could help me.  There was a young girl at the counter and the worker behind the counter was having a social conversation with her.  2 more people walked in behind me, and the male worker waited on them, and never said a word to me.  The other 3 people behind the counter never said anything to me.  The 2 customers left, and the male worker went back to his social conversation with the young customer at the counter.  I finally opened my mouth and asked if someone could please help me.  Up till that point I had said nothing.  I wasn't rude, nor demanding.  I placed my order, and while I was in the process of paying another female customer behind me said "They never wait on anyone or try to help their customers.  I come in here all the time, and no one will ever help me even if there are many people behind the counter."  I replied that it was ridiculous that they were all standing around and not trying to wait on anyone.  At that point a man I hadn't noticed, replied to what I said by starting to yell at me about "if I didn't like it to not come there anymore"  " That they were doing the best they could'.  I said back to him that they were standing around, or having a social conversation rather than asking if they could help me.  His voice got even louder, he said he was the owner and that if I had a complaint I should have asked for the manager rather than making a nasty comment  He said if I didn't like the way things were run there, I shouldn't go there anymore, that his manager was out, they were short handed, and they were doing the best that they could.  I said he didn't even know what occurred and I was the customer. I said if they were so short handed, why were there 4 people standing around not doing anything.  He continued screaming at the top of his lungs at me, and then just walked away.  Meanwhile the customer who had commented about the bad service apologized for getting me in trouble, and I told her not to worry.  She was trying to pick up her salad.  One of the female workers asked if she could help her and the male worker who was cashing someone else out said "no, don't help her, I have it".  But instead of taking care of the female customer, he went out to help at least 3 other people.  I finally asked the female who originally tried to help her, to please wait on her and she snapped at me "We are doing the best we can" obviously copying the owners response to me.  I will never go into this business again.  It's kind of sad since I've gone there since I was a kid.  My folks even knew the original owners.  They obviously don't care about their customers to the point of screaming and blaming them for their shortcomings.  I would stay away from this place like the plague.  The owner is an ass who doesn't deserve any customers.

Had breakfast here this morning and the French toast and eggs with sausage was great. Very spacious and workers are friendly and courteous.  Fast service and great good a must of you are in this part of town.

Heard about this place on NPR a few weeks ago and wanted to see what it was all about. Loved the decor, atmosphere, and friendly home style. It feels like a family home and they make the pizza on a table right in front of you. I also liked the fresh ingredients and the paired down menu. The thin crust pizza with portabellos and shallots was really fresh and fairly tasty but I split a large pizza with a friend and left a little hungry.  A salad and a desert would have been nice. Service is pretty quick so it's not really a place to hang out. You get your pizza, you eat it and you go. Head over to Farmacy a few blocks away for a tasty cappuccino and really yummy Sundays.

So I can't speak for the upstairs  bar and restaurant  but a friend brought me here for a punk show in the basement... I mean it's Trenton so I had pretty low expectations but it was pretty freaking great... the bartender was attentative and cool, the draft list was shockingly good (let alone for a basement dive), the crowd was friendly and fun... and the music was pretty damn good! All in all a great little local dive!

So yes they are know for the most amazing burgers around and the beer selection is also great but have you tried the pumpkin cheesecake?  All of the desserts are great but this one is a step above the rest!!
Take out only at 1:15 am even though still advertising 3 am close and plenty of people sitting and eating.  Find another late night spot for snacks!

Not that these guys need another great reveiw, but this is a great spot.  We were regulars until we moved out of the neighborhood, but miss it a lot.  The food is delicious, and fresh.  The staff is always freindly and helpful, and the beer selection is one of the best out there.

We lucked out to get seated right away. Nice outdoor seating with cute colored lights. I was referred to Papas by a friend and was so excited to try their tomato pies. I love DeLorenzos down the road but was hoping to find another great place to get tomato pies. We waited 10 minutes before our waiter came to take our order and then 52 minutes to get our pizza. I went inside to use the restroom and while inside an older gentleman in a chefs outfit was giving me a dirty look. I didnt think anything of it. Long behold our pizza arrived and it was good; with a sweet tomato sauce and crispy crust. It was good but not better than DeLorenzos. We ate our pizza and felt satisfied. We noticed the same older gentleman in a chef outfit (my guess is Papa himself) was going around greeting customers, thanking them for coming, and  giving out tickets/ coupons of some sort. He bypassed our table and gave it to EVERY table but OURS which made me realize the dirty look earlier was intentional. Right away I felt uncomfortable. Our waiter arrived and gave us our bill. He notified us that this was a cash only establishment but nowhere on the menu or on the building indicated this. We had  cash so we paid with cash. The table next to us made sure to laugh when they heard the waiter say cash only. They proceeded to say "they dont have money so I doubt they will be back". In all, pizza is good but service is terrible. I am born and raised in central nj and never in my life have I had such a racist moment living in nj.  As a minority this establishment made me feel unwelcome with their dirty looks and snide remarks. It is a shame because if it werent for that, I would have probably returned but I refuse to support an establishment that treats customers with such prejudice.

Adrienne's Pizza Bar was a huge disappointment.  There are so many superb pizza shops in NYC, but Adrienne's isn't one of them.  One wonders where those 5 star Yelp reviews come from.  The pizza is overpriced and no big deal.  The dough wasn't chewy like real pizza dough normally is, more like white bread.  $30+ for a pizza like that is a ripoff.  I can get a superior pizza for half as much.

I was visiting Philadelphia and explored this tiny cozy spot on our way back home. We stopped by to try something for dessert after eating the cheese steaks. I must say that they serve the best crepes in the town!!! I have tried several crepes places in the past, as I love crepes but this is certainly the best.  I was impressed by the amazing choices they have in sweet and savory crepes especially the "Ice-cream crepes". I tried the Dark Belgian chocolate crepe with Fresh strawberries and "Honey Honey" Lassi (Honey, vanilla, Levender). Everything was so fresh and flavorful. Owner was very kind and sweet too. She told me that they use "All Natural" stuff. I will try Kashmiri Chai next time as I am too full today. The only con is that they don't have a parking of their own and it's just street parking which could be difficult to find at times.  I'm definitely coming back!!!  Can't wait for my next trip to Philly.

Besides the long wait even with a reservation-- I must say, everything was exquisite ! The food the ambience the service was just amazing.... Felicia even gave us a complimentary dessert for our birthday celebration ! The chocolate cake literally melts in your mouth !! I recommend the nachos and the Mac n cheeses ! (Both chorizo and lobster are delish)  and the salmon burger and red snapper are just as great and zesty! This place is beyond a 5 star I can't wait to come back for my birthday ! :)

I came here to celebrate my friends birthday and I have to say...what an amazing experience!  From the moment we arrived everyone was friendly and courteous.  Our server Alex went above and beyond. She was knowledgeable about the menu and even made suggestions. The food was delicious!! We ordered the Churrascos and the Branzino...omg! We'll definitely be back!  By the way....the birthday card is a great touch! Keep up the great work!

The food was amazing, the service was excellent and the atmosphere was just unforgettable. No matter what you order on the menu you will be happy, the apps were amazing, tried a few different ones, but the Mac and cheese and tostadas were two of my favorites. Check it out, great spot.

Made a yelp account specifically to write this review. I go to this place frequently because it is the local bagel shop and it has decent food. However, I am fed up with the poor customer service. A simple Hello from the lady at the register or you're welcome after I say thank you would suffice. But to be ignored and to help someone who came in after me is incredibly disrespectful. I was ready to walk out.

My entire order of fries was "bottom of the bag." Not like I have a high bar for a pub chain, but would it have killed them to open a new bag of frozen fries and toss just a couple of the non-mutilated ones into the order of stubbies they told me to " enjoy"?  They're not even trying. The beer was cold and in a clean glass so it wasn't all bad.  Nice job Sam Adams.
Typical overpriced Eastside restaurant. Pasta was cloying, service indifferent. Only saving grace was helpful busboys.
Solid, approachable, and priced well for the neighborhood.   We try and make it here a few times a year.  It never disappoints on any level. Service, food , and drinks are all top notch.
Great addition to the neighborhood! Good food, friendly staff, and an excellent wine list.

I knew this place deserved a second chance! I visited today and the bartender was incredibly nice and welcoming! Martini was on point, service was great! Food... Like out of a five star restaurant. I ordered the filet mignonette tartare accompanied by Parmesan encrusted bruschetta and a cracked quail egg resting on a bed of coarse sea salt. Absolutely delectable! I will definitely be returning with different company and I'm so excited that my home town of east haven has a restaurant that could be a go to! Fabulous!

Worst indian food I've had in the US. The mysore masala dosa was very average. Idlis were like stones and vada was undercooked. The chutneys are bad. Sambar is decent. Didn't try the kati rolls but will not be coming back here. I don't understand why this place is popular.
Good food decent price level 4 spicy is a little week but good portions I will go back
By far my favorite pizza in Brooklyn. I've always gotten delivery, never been to the actual restaurant by delivery is always prompt and friendly. Best Pizza in nyc if you ask me.

First time here and we were amazed at how good the soup dumplings were!! The broth was perfect not too greasy and very flavorful!! Presentation was great and the atmosphere was great. It has the quiet hole in the wall with great decor. The service wasn't too bad except when we were looking to get our check it just took a little while but other than that it was pretty decent service. Definitely would come back when I'm back in NYC but give it a shot it's better than joe Shanghai's in my opinion and the wait isn't as bad!

Good beer selection, nice service and an overall nice experience.  Flatbreads are great, wings are killer.  Even the less "barlike" food is really good. Special note about brunch.  It is the best in the area, by far.  Do yourself a favor...avoid the lame place called the "strip joint" a block away, and come here for quality food and drink

This is just a really great bahn mi place. i have not had one bad experience here, the service is always great and quick. One of the more exceptional places in Elmhurst. After trying a few of their stuff, I always go back to the bulgogi bomb me, get if if you haven't yet! The only downside to this place are their drink offerings and their weird sandwich ingredient arrangement, you never really can get the perfect bite lol. I would pass on the in-house drinks since you can get a better version of nearly everything there within a few blocks. The price is spot on for the value. All in all a great spot to eat at if you're around the area.
As amazing as the food is, this place is worth going to just to hear the guy who rattles off the always extensive list of specials.

The best pizza I ever had. It was the perfect experience. Saw on the travel chqnnel and had to go try it. Met the owner and took a pic with him. Nice friendly guy. And pizza, well it was excellent. Its a landmark in new York. Cant go and not try it.

Very busy fun place to go, great pizza. Have a drink at the bar and wait for a table. Worth waiting for. We had a large pizza between two of us. Half pepperoni and half meatball. One of the few restaurants we visited in NYC that I would go back to.

The food here was very good and very affordable. They were able to accommodate a large party -- but don't take reservations. I ordered the French toast and my friend ordered the western omelet with cheese. We both split our meals with each other and every bite was delicious. The service was great and they have $6 screwdrivers (for those of us who like our breakfast drinks). The place is a bit small and can get really crowded, but we ended up only waiting for about 15 minutes. I would definitely go back and, as someone who grew up in Manhattan, the laid back BK vibe was much appreciated.
Fantastic family owned restaurant. Food is always on point and staff is stellar. A MUST GO TO PLACE!!!!!
Excelente service, great environment,  good food and fair prices. We're definitely going back! Btw, the octopus salad was amazing!

The food was really delicious. I ordered the lobster roll and although I typically don't like it when prepared with a cream dressing it was yummy! We also had the catfish and fish and chips, both of which were quite tasty. A must go for seafood lovers!

Lunch buffet does not have many veg choices, but good food to try occasionally, food at this place is way better then the most of the India restaurants in Hartford, Manchester and Simsbury area. The atmosphere is nothing special to talk about, and the service was also good (i had been a few times here). Overall a must go place to try for once.

Came to this restaurant after finding a good review online. The staff there were a bit on the rough side, lack of customer service was definitely present but if you are looking for something really quick, cheap and extremely delicious, this is the place. We ordered four large items and paid $9 We go here everytime we visit New York. it is one of my most favrout restaurant in this area. i always love this place. this is very special for me and i can't live without going there if i am in that area. its not depend that for what sort of work i am there????????? everybody knows some things are very special for them and special things cant paid always....

sketch a restaurant the size of a small bathroom with seating or perhaps "stooling" for six or seven people and there you have Prosperity Dumpling. So my advice is not to plan on eating there (although we did). It's all about takeout and sit down on a bench. The dumpling are very traditional and tasty just like my mom used to make in my youth. The price is what will have you going crazy. You'll be hard pressed to find something over 5 bucks and mostly everything is under 2 bucks. Basically you can stuff yourself and a friend and have leftovers for under ten dollars. The key is that the fried ones you get less of but they taste better on the spot, the boiled ones aren't as tasty (but still amazing) on the spot but taste progressively better as they cool off and you get at least double the amount. Have fun and enjoy this traditional meal in Chinatown!

A friend of mine recommended Montana's to me since he lives in the area. I'm glad I got the local's insight because this place rules. I ordered the swordfish entree and my friend ordered the beef tartare. Both dishes have an impressive balance of flavor and were very satisfying. I was especially interested in the liquor selection they have. You can tell that the bartenders really know their stuff. I work in bars myself and I always appreciate a good craft selection. I definitely plan to come back in later seasons and see what else they can whip up.
Excellent food and very attentive service - lot's of attention to detail in this little neighborhood gem.

The food here rocks!!!  Love the stuffed pork chop and rib-eye steak. The pasta selections are excellent as well.  The wait staff is very knowledgeable and attentive.  I always look forward to dining at Paisanos!!
Amazing!!!! Excellent food , great service, great drinks. The best place in NYC  I highly recommended

I really enjoyed this place. But the most importantly the taste of the food is amazing, the tacos enchapulinados,  enchiladas de conejo and guacamole very delicious. very attentive service and the drinks wonderful. The best mexican food!!!

Me and my friend was looking for some nice food and inexpensive ! As we was coming to the end of our travelling. That was when we stumbled across this place on yelp. The idea of 20 home made sauces is what really persuaded us. I got spicy chicken wrap with mozzarella and fries with jalapeño chedder dip. The fries are amazing!! The best I've had whilst traveling and the wrap was delicious. Staff are very friendly.... The man in front order soup and a wrap (without fries) and the chef came out with his order with fries stating "I noticed you didn't order fries so I added some for you, I didn't want you to miss out" he then later came out to see what he thought of them. He loved them as much as us! The place was busy, a lot of orders from business men to take out. I will Deffinatly be returning here before I leave Philadelphia
Israel, the owner, could spice it up a bit to make the food more authentic, but for Bucks County, Burrito's is very good.

I went here for the first time and the food was good. Everyone of the 6 people that were with us enjoyed their meal.  The place is dingy looking but the food was good and reasonable.  I would go back.

This place needs some work. Quite generic in everything they offer, but then again, prices are low. I may have ordered the wrong things. Don't eat grilled chicken here... it will be very... very dry. You'd probably safe with hummus or other simple things. I was disappointed but it's clearly a very popular spot. I imagine nothing is truly made from scratch.

I like a good balance of chick pea to tahini, balanced with some lemon juice and a touch of oil.  Since i have such stringent criteria for hummus it is hard to be satisfied! What WAS excellent was the cucumber yogurt sauce and beyoglu salad.  They have a great outdoor patio area and even if you have to eat inside the decor is bright and fun.  The service could have been better. Overall we were pleased with our time at Beyoglu, but not so much that I think I'll add it to our regular list of restaurants.

I was very upset with their reservation policy. I called the day before to make a reservation for 4 guests and was directed to email them instead.  Boy, the manager, was able to accommodate my request. However, we ran into some problems and informed them that we could not longer come so I CANCELLED IMMEDIATELY LESS THAN HALF AN HOUR LATER after making that reservation.  I DID NOT receive any confirmation on their behalf that it was confirmed or not. The following day I noticed that I was being charged $100 (50% off full charge for 4 guests, $50/person=$200) on my credit card so I called to question it. I was informed that they knew I had cancelled then but when I asked about the charges made into my account, they claimed that the moment I confirmed which again was the day before, the kitchen was already preparing our food so they have to charge me. AND EVEN THOUGH I CANCELLED HALF AN HOUR LATER, THEY COULD NOT NO LONGER CANCEL BECAUSE AS THEY SAID, THE KITCHEN WAS ALREADY PREPARING OUR FOOD THEN?! According to the manager, regardless of the fact that I had cancelled immediately whether it be 30mins/20mins/ OR EVEN 5 MINS, he had already notified the kitchen and they started preparing from that point. This was very upsetting to me, not only it makes me question why our food is already being prepared the day before, how come I did not receive any confirmation on their part, and not get notified about these charges?  I'm not the type to give bad reviews but this was by far the worst experience I've had because it was completely unreasonable and unfair.

I've eaten all over New York city, and Rubirosa is my favorite restaurant. From the appetizers (unreal rice balls) to the pizza (best pepperoni in the world), I've never seen this place have a misstep. You'll want to save room for dessert too. One time three of my friends and I split four appetizers and everything we tried was absolutely unreal. The place has it all. Cool digs and friendly staff too. Definitely, definitely check this place out.

We were so excited about coming here for brunch after reading the many positive reviews online. What a shame it did not deliver. Food was poorly prepared and service unfriendly and uncaring. Place wasn't really that busy so I'm not sure why the kitchen and floor were off their game but this was not an experience I'd like to ever repeat again. Overcooked, tasteless and greasy food delivered with a frown. Considering the many wonderful options right around the corner, who needs this?? We won't be back.

I went there for drinks on a date, and it was AWESOME!! They had the best beer, a Scottish ale. They also had a CHEESEMONGER who described their cheese selection to us. We had the Scottish blue cheese (which was the best cheese I've had in a long time) and a French cheese. It came with raspberries, figs, and TRUFFLE HONEY. So freaking good. Not that expensive either. Will definitely be going back.

Had a great burger here, loved the photo booth in the restroom! Also the bday cake was a nice dessert The other food we ordered was terrific. I got this tuna steak salad and it was huge and full of goodness. Service was nice and we were seated quickly even though there was a mistake (ours) on our reservation. I normally avoid hotel restaurants when traveling and today Bistro 128 reminded me why.  Had dinner here tonight (because there is literally nothing else nearby) and it was a 2.5 star dinner on it's own.  The whole experience borders on a 1 star for the following reasons: 1) Service is terrible. We walked in, waited 3 minutes to be seated and then were not so much as looked at for a solid 15 minutes (no exaggeration here).  It takes getting up and and asking the bartender if there is a waitstaff tonight to finally get someone to come by. 2) Food quality.  The food takes about 15 minutes to come out (not a problem that's fairly normal in a sit down restaurant) and when it does I am presented with a dry and cold (supposed to be hot) chicken sandwich, luke-warm fries and...wait for it....CANNED mushrooms on the sandwich.  There should be a disclaimer on the menu saying we use canned (nasty) mushrooms on our food.....our $13 chicken sandwich our $25 pasta dish.   3) Price. Did I mention the food was mediocre at best yet the prices are outrageous. Any dinner item is $20 and up and the usual fare of sandwiches/burgers are $13 and up.  I asked for a side salad instead of fries, got the salad which was decent but the fries came out anyway and then the side salad ends up on the bill as a separate $6 charge!  That's ok if the food is REALLY good but...well see point #2 it's not. So I ended up paying $19 plus tax and tip for a meal that was at best an $8 meal anywhere else in the country. So in conclusion....order out and stay away from this place, it looks nice from the outside but the food and prices are bad bad bad.

Il Bambino may be my favorite restaurant in New York, where I lived for over two years.  Of all the good places to eat in New York, I visited Il Bambino more than any other.  Expect VERY good, fresh food for a VERY manageable price.  There's food for foodies and food for Joe at this Astoria establishment.  For starters, try the marinated sardines.  Even those who are not crazy about seafood will enjoy these rich, salty, oily fish on top of crispy, chewy, thin bread.  If you're looking for something light after your appetizer, try a mozzarella panini, which comes with fresh tomatoes and basil pesto in it, or a crostini or two.  For a heartier meal, try a Bacon Butty panini (if you're there for Brunch) full of bacon, avocado and blue cheese.  It satisfies your hunger and your tastebuds perfectly and, judging by the crowds you see here on the weekends, it probably cures hangovers faster than you can say "Cheese Us Christo!".  The garden in the back is nice if the weather's nice.  If you're with friends, it's easy to share because lots of the items on the menu arrive in halves.  Get there hungry and leave content, and smelling of roasted, toasted wonder.  Don't leave this off of your vacation itinerary and, for pork's sake, eat here if you live in New York!

So to conclude, if your looking for some sushi, go and find somewhere else. I'm sure that the hibachi is really good considering the reviews it has received but as far as sushi... Yeah not here
