WOW The Burger is Delicious!!! My friend introduce me to this place I came all the way from Manhattan to try this amazing spot. Great place and atmosphere, way better than shack shack burger. Top food for your $. Will defiantly come back again(many times)

COCKROACH !!!! I went with my friends to this restaurant for first time with a groupon, we had the worst experience of our lives, I found a cockroach in the paella !!!!!! We wanted to throw up, worst experience ever !!!!! I don't care if it's for free ...don't eat there.
halal gods!

I live in Seattle and have a high standard for coffee. This place is great. It's small and the atmosphere is cozy and clean. I had a simple espresso drink and it was spectacular. My partner in crime had a chai latte, and while a little sweet for my taste, it was pretty great. Barista definitely knew what he was doing.
Artichoke moussaka is wonderful.  I love getting a few appetizers to split along with a horiatiki salad to get a nice sampling and keep the price very reasonable.

Seriously great food here served by very nice and informative wait staff (owners?) who obviously take pride in everything they do - from mixing the perfect Martini to keeping the water glasses filled with infused water. Had no trouble getting in on Tuesday night and the music was fun and not too loud. Shared two outstanding starters - a squash puree with amazing grilled radicchio and a cabbage dish whose complexity rolled out from first bite to finish. The two pastas of the day were more exciting and inventive than anything we had in Rome last week. Off the beaten trail for us, but plan to make it out there again soon.

Food all good!!! Server really boring!!! Created no dinning experience whatsoever. It's always a give and take though. It's either the food is okay and service is great or the food is really good but the service sucks. Can't wait to find a place that has both. But because of the food, cause here that's all that really matters, I'll give it 4 Stars.

Visited a couple of weeks ago during a business trip. Great ambiance with the music, authentically garbed staff and beautiful courtyard seating area. My companion and I both had churrascos. Mine with classic chimichurri sauce on the skirt steak and my companions el gaucho with a chipotle flavored sauce. Both excellent. For starters we had the mini cuban sandwiches (bocaditos) and sangria ceviche with a tasty tigerfish. They serve sangria but allow you to BTOB with no corkage fee. Taste of the caribbean in downtown Montclair
mac n cheese!

YAY!!! They serve veggie hot dogs now - tried the Seattle Dog and it was DELICIOUS!!! Great beer, awesome backyard, friendly staff/patrons....and now Vegetarian Friendly Food!!! I couldn't be happier.

Last nigh for dinner. Small place, but cute.  Bathroom is clean, I think. So dark in the bathroom. Weird.  We had a tasting plate that had beans, meats, guacamole, etc. It tasted good, but it looked kinda ugly. Then we had spicy lamb casserole with habernero onions. Hot, but good.  Margaritas are really good. The boy had a jalapeno one which was too hot for me, and I had a regular one.  "Both tasty and we re-ordered.  Service was fast and friendly even with only one waitress working.  Kind of expensive here for what is sort of a dive bar.

I've been going to this place for a couple of years now and there is nothing bad I can say about Sweet Afton. I am a sucker for a great beer menu and an even better brunch. The mac and cheese here is to die for (do yourself a favor and add bacon to it, you won't regret it!) and the blueberry pancakes on the brunch menu were nothing short of perfection. That being said it's a great place. I liked it a lot. I would take friends here and dates... I'm just not going to become a regular.
Really delicious meal here.  Excellent tasty drinks.  Pizza is thin and crisp with amazing toppings.  Salads are great too.  You can't go wrong here

Great location, BYOB, some seats comfy, some awkward to sit in for dinner. Food was hit/miss.  My son and I each ordered the Churrasco.  It was ok, not great.  A bit on the small side I think for the cut of meat.  My wife ordered the fish special.  It was special alright, it was so special we had to send it back.  The fish was spoiled.  Even the people next to our table smelled the rotten fish.  But I guess the chef didn't realized it.  They took it back, and we picked something else.  We didn't pay for it, but not even offered something for our trouble.  Disappointing.

My favorite saying at this place is "Spaten, Spaetzle, and a Prezel".... I love this place and the people who run it are amazing.  They have Karaoke Night, German Holidays, and the amazing Ridgewood Market happens here too This place is always fun and really does Gott Cheer !!
Best thai I've found in belleville and really in the states so far. Mamas food is awesome, the vibe is relaxed and there's a liquor store next to it for byo.

pretty great. came here before class with one of the waitresses. Delish pumpkin spice pancakes indicate that fall is here. they refilled my coffee for free which was nice as well :) good place, coming again
Fantastic smoked mozz for their pizza. Great BBQ. Home cut fries and house made sauces. Should be on DDD.
It's a nice place to sit down and eat. The staff is friendly. The chicken pot pie is so good and there's a lot of other comfort foods on the menu that I'm looking forward to trying

Meant to write this review a while back but am just now getting around to it. Place is great. Owner is awesome. He was having trouble with his credit card system, but was very apologetic. Grilled cheeses are bomb, tomato soup is the perfect match. Will definitely go back. Super fast service. Also enjoyed the ambiance of the place with open windows and a street accessible bar.
If your craving for an Italian kind of day you can never go wrong on this place.. I can say it's one of the tourist destination here in NY.

I never write reviews despite that I use Yelp quite a bit.  But my boyfriend told me to write one just so people can know what's up.  So here goes: I picked out this place based on all the great reviews.  Once we got there, it's actually an English bar called The Cricketer's Arms.  So we went up and down the street searching for it until someone told us it had moved to 18 Murray St.  Ok, fine, so we went there but found it to be an Irish bar.  So we went in and asked the bartender who pointed us to the small kitchen in the back.  Oh ok, so I guess they're sharing a kitchen? Whatever, so we went to the kitchen window and ordered, despite that a few popular items were crossed out.  At this point, we thought we could just sit down and enjoy the lunch.  But no, the bartender told us that the tables were only for bar patrons, My Belly's Playlist was only for takeout.  So we asked if we could order drinks from the bar and sit and eat.  Nope, we had to order alcoholic beverages or we had to leave.  Jeez.... I didn't know My Belly's Playlist was not even a restaurant, it's just a takeout place sharing a kitchen with some bar, and the bartenders clearly do not like the arrangement because one of them rolled her eyes when I asked if we could sit.  So whatever, we cancelled the order and left.  So, be warned, it's NOT a restaurant, it's take out only, and several items on the menu are not available anymore, e.g. el cubano sandwich.
Great pasta.

The restaurant has definitely maintained it's historical charm. Who knew a hamburger between two slices of white toast could taste so good. The flavors are kept simple and the meat cooked to perfection. A must try if you're in the area.

Went here today for a late lunch on a friend's recommendation. The food was awesome! An excellent option for meat-eaters and veggies/vegans alike. Fresh and tasty, with friendly service. We ordered our dish at heat level 5/10 and it was a genuine medium heat, perfect. I recommend ordering a cup of hot Nepalese tea to finish your meal - perfectly spiced deliciousness. We will definitely be back!

Went here around 9:30PM on a Thursday very close to when they close the store. Asked for an order of garlic knots and they were delicious, fresh out of the oven! They don't give you pre-cooked food, this place is really good!!!

Very nice experience!!! Excellent food(timballo warm octopus salad,gnocchi and pizza served with their homemade spicy oil...A MUST) service attentive and a very pleasant atmosphere. Nice outdoor seating as well.,Missing the Italian classic apperitifs and digestifs(Campari grappa limoncello amaro etc)Maybe in the future.
Delicious authentic Mexican food! Had the carne asada quesadilla and some salsa and chips. Way above expectations. Salsa is fiery hot.

The atmosphere is loud and the seating is a bit cramped. I didn't enjoy the layout of the restaurant - If I looked ahead of me, all I saw was the door to the kitchen, to the left was a brick wall and to the right was another table and wall. Others raved about this place but when the food came out I was not impressed. I ordered a tortellini dish which was extremely rich with butter and cream so much so I was sick the rest of the day from it. Not worth the price I paid (literally and figuratively).

Very small eating area out back, but the waitress was great and food was good as well. We got the 1/2 pigs head which was delicious and my other favorite dish was the 2 hot dogs, definitely get that!! definitely would come back again

Took over 1 hour to deliver a sandwich and fries 8 blocks away. Delivery guy was extremely rude on the phone when he called to let me know he was in the lobby. Needless to say, the food was cold including the fries which were cold and soggy by the time they arrived. What kind of company in the food industry operates this way???

Last night was our friend's birthday and we were very excited to celebrate with some noodles because noodles are usually delicious. We decided to try Samurai Mama because the online menu looked promising. Because she is responsible and possesses the quality of foresight, my friend called the night before to inquire about making a reservation. She was informed the restaurant does not take reservations, which is fine. My friend told the hostess we would be a party of 10 and was reassured that there probably would not be much of a wait on a Tuesday night. So, we decided to give it a go. Noodles are worth the risk, right? I arrived at the restaurant first--about 40 minutes before my friends--and decided to check out the scene inside. It was empty, which was great because this meant we would most likely get a table. The host told me to come back when my party arrived and said it was not necessary to leave my name or phone number. "Just come back," he said, "we will seat your group when everyone is here." Half of our group arrived at 6:30pm. We poked our heads into the restaurant again and guess what? Still empty! We asked the host (not the same one that was there 40 minutes before) if we could order some drinks and appetizers while we waited for the rest of our party. After a series of mumbles, he proceeded to usher us into a prison-like room, his impractical-looking black shawl floating behind him like a kite in the summer breeze. After we were all seated in this jail cell of a "waiting room," shawl man disappeared. Then, BAM, he reappeared and told us a new rule which he had apparently invented in the 2 minutes he was gone. Because of the size of our group, we were required to spend a minimum of $30 apiece. Now, I love noodles as much as the next girl, but unless there are gold flakes floating in the broth I'd prefer to save my money for other things. Also, wouldn't a normal establishment WANT a party of 10 to spend money and celebrate there? Even if we spent a measly $25 apiece? Especially since there were 3 other patrons in the restaurant. 3. And I may have even seen a tumbleweed. Don't go here. The place seems mismanaged and the staff is pretentious and rude. But do contact the host if you would like to borrow his cape for Halloween this month.

A group of friends and I were celebrating a birthday and decided we would like this spot out. I called the day before to find out if they'd take a reservation for 10 people. The girl I spoke to said that they don't take reservations. After attempting to get an idea of what kind of wait we would be looking at, we decided to give it a try. We arrived at about 6:30 and the place was empty (which was great!). Most of our party had arrived but they wouldn't seat us until everyone was there. The host asked if we would like to sit in their sitting area to have drinks and apps so we followed to the back of the restaurant and were led to what looked like a jail cell. The host then left and returned a few minutes later to inform us that their policy for large parties is that we each had to spend a minimum of $30 each. I told him that the woman I spoke with the night before hadn't mentioned anything and their website doesn't state this policy. We had traveled 40 minutes from Staten Island to come to their restaurant and they just throw this "policy" into the mix. We wound up leaving and going to SEA thai based on the principal of it! If I call and ask about a reservation and you have this kind of policy in place, you should at least inform your potential customers before they take the time to visit your business!
Simple , greatly sourced items, Italian as close to home as I can get stateside. Really nice dinner. Great Italian wine list.
Always a favorite. No doubt about why they've been here for eons... Tourists know Pepe's name. New Haven residents know Pizza House!

Pre-theatre is not the time to dine at this establishment.  Having made a 6:00 reservation which was noted as pre-theatre and was reinforced upon arrival to the restaurant, the service was not slow.... a turtle is slow....   it wasn't.    Food that we did get was good but not notable.  That being said, we ordered 3 courses.  An appetizer, soup, and a main entrée.  Soup came out a minute after the appetizer at approximately 6:30.  Then.....  we sat for over an hour waiting for a main course that my husband had to ask our absent waiter for to no avail.  "It's coming".  It arrived moments after my husband said we were cancelling it.  The waiter's response "guess they lost your ticket"....   no response from the Manager beyond a shoulder shrug.  A shame--nice space ...   if all one wants to do is look at the space....   over a long period of time.  By the way--  there were only 5 other tables being served -- essentially empty restaurant.

phenomenal restaurant. huge huge fan of everything they serve. obviously if you're reading the reviews you know to try the edamame dumplings. the buns are good and all of the seafood dishes are great too. definitely a favorite since i moved to philly :)

The food is always great & the staff is always friendly. I saw the manager being rude to the girl on the register and then she was also a little rude towards me? Unfortunate to see and experience as a customer. Maybe she was just having a bad day? Still no excuse in hospitality.

Easily one of the best places i have ever eaten. The food is fantastic and the atmosphere is great. The mussels and fries is the best I have ever had. I highly recommend this resteraunt to anyone in the area who is trying to have a nice night out on the town!

It became comical.  Food was so-so; service was a hot mess.  It got weird when the waitress brought us our check before we even finished our meal.  I told her that we'd like to probably order some dessert, but we wanted to finish our entrees first.  She then wanted to take my plate before we were done (pet peeve #49).  And then when we were done, she never came back to take the plates.  We even stacked them cleanly to help her out.  When we did finally get to order dessert, it took over 20 minutes for it to arrive.  Seriously?  It wasn't that busy.  The table next to us had the same thing happen (check arrived before they were even done; they wanted coffee but bailed on that when it took 20 minutes before it was even close to being poured).  They had ample wait staff but it didn't look like anyone was helping each other out.  One and done for us there.

WOW!  This place has everything going for it - it's quick, friendly, a great value and delish!  Lot of nice options to build your own pita/salad/wrap.  Tried the Falafel and shwarma and both were wonderfully seasoned/flavorful.  Better than Maoz - my neighborhood favorite in NYC.

I can't even count how many times I've been here, but the square slices and Italian ices are perfection. I've also ate inside at the sit down restaurant twice, very good food and service and the dessert platter is amazing. They only charge per person and you get quite a good amount of dessert, they usually change up the look of the platter by table.
Pizza is good. Had a slice nice and garlicky. The house. Salad needs a redo. And the place needs some sprucing up. People are nice. Service is solid.

So I've heard of Pies and Thighs for a while now. I finally ventured there last week. Let me say what a great set up, and what fun options. With that being said lets start on the food.  I am in love with the fried chicken , my family is from North Carolina and I've eaten fried chicken my whole life. The chicken here was moist and quite flavorful.  My friend got the catfish, she was pleased with the color, texture and everything else.  I had the  butternut donut one word " Lifechanging"... Oh and their Arnold Palmer was really good too.   Now for the cons the MAC AND CHEESE IS HORRIBLE.... How dare you tie yourself with the word Southern and have bad MAC... The cheese is chalky... yucckk.... Bake your Mac and cheese  and use good cheeses please.... It made me upset as a customer that everything else was soooo good and your mac and cheese was SUB PAR!
Have the BLT. You know you want to, and you are thinking 'boring... I should order something Exciting'. Stop. Order the BLT. Best meal I've had in the village.
Best roast pork sandwich I've ever had. Cheesesteaks aren't the best but they are still good. This place is packed alot of times so be prepared to wait.
Love this this place! Gotta try their fish Bronzino

Love this place! Awesome breakfast, fresh, hearty, delicious. Had what were probably the best pancakes ever! Service was good too! I ordered the Bubby's Burger, which was a pretty good burger, and not too greasy.  The mac & cheese was good, but not the best ever and I really enjoyed the red cabbage slaw.  The appetizing biscuits were served warm and exceptionally tasty.  For dessert, we all ordered cupcakes, and I selected the seasonal treat: pumpkin with maple icing!  The cake itself would have made a great coffee cake, even without the icing.  After all that, I was stuffed...in a good way. Next time I'd like to go back for the midnight brunch!
Very good food, reasonable prices, the ambiance of a french bistro.
Il Panino.  Great sandwiches and service.  Hot or cold hero's. Specialty salads.  In the Calandra Mall on 46 east.

Tried the two piece plus biscuit take-out fried chicken. If you are looking for southern fried chicken, this is not your place. If you want fried chicken with a distinctive Asian flair, this might be for you. The meat is brined so it has that odd, seemingly raw meat texture that brined bird has. It is not raw, just looks that way. Tasty and crisp, but from somewhere other than the south! I miss Mama's.

I love me some pizza! I eat pizza a few times a week, and I always say. even bad pizza is good pizza. But thats not the case here, the pizza is always good. The service and the staff, not so much. I love the pizza, so I try and stop in for take  out when im eating alone. I can find much better options if I want table service.

One of my fav restaurants in NYC. I do like the vibe and ambiance of the place. Drinks are great in well packed bars and the food is delicious. The alley to the restaurant is just spooky enough to gain respect from my first-time-visiting companions. On the downside there's no way to book a table for smaller groups and the service is sometimes cold and hasty.
The food is as good as the service. Their are a lot of other diners on the highway but none have that home town feel and comfort like this place.

This restaurant is the perfect UWS Brunch spot. The outdoor seating is great. I ordered the capellini which is angel hair pasta with lobster, jumbo shrimp and sea scallops. The jumbo shrimp, lobster and sea scallops were bursting with flavor! So delicious I'm salivating as I'm typing but the pasta was weak. It's tossed in a lobster broth but I felt it needed Parmesan to add a little kick...a little something. For dessert I ordered the caramel cake, it was just too sweet for my liking. Everything here was good, and I probably will be coming back when the outdoors seating opens.  Great spot Isabella's!

Maybe I'm clouded by the fact that I haven't been to Din Tai Fung in so long, but these XLBs were fantastic. I have been craving DTF since leaving California and finally got some. Not only were the XLBs great the chili sesame chicken, crispy beef, and fried rice were on point! Seriously good eats and the staff was super helpful and very friendly! Definitely a gem.

I'm from Texas, and I'm Mexican, so when I heard "Tex-Mex" in NYC, I was like, yeah right. Wow, was I surprised. The food was delicious and the margaritas were great! Everything was reasonably priced and the atmosphere was authentic with an edge and so comfortable and accommodating. The staff was friendly. Again the food is delicious and they have daily specials, so give them a try! My favs are the green chicken enchiladas, fish tacos an of course the margaritas!

Our anniversary dinner. Let's start with the seafood. Overcooked scallops and shrimp. Along with undercooked haddock. Also enjoyed the instant potatoes who enjoys paying 23.00 for a meal and gets a pile of instant mash potatoes. Will never go back.

Awesome Indian food in a cool area.  The food was simply amazing.  My co-worker and I were the only two non-Indians in the place.  Food was perfect and they serve several brands of Indian beer by the bottle.
Easy going and quiet place, the staff is always nice and smily, free wifi, and the food is fresh, made to order and fully customizable.
Yum!

i have eaten from this establishment on several occasions. I have never had an issue with their food until today. I placed an order over the phone for two different meals and i was very specific about my order. I explained in details to the girl who answered the phone what i wanted and did not want with my orders. Unfortunately, when i got home and opened the food i noticed that the girl had messed up one of my orders. #feelingdisappointed
Really well made food.  So tasty.  BYOB is so nice.
I didn't see anything wrong with the food we ordered. The food is good not too far from the authentic Thai food and that's a . Approved!

Overpriced and unsuitable for small children. Was here with my 2+ year old grandson and found no children's menu or portions. Add to that water was served in large stemmed glasses, making it difficult, if not dangerous, for little ones. So, I ordered the queso for him and chiles rellenos poblano for me. The $8 queso was paper thin and the cheese was non existent, making this dish their highest profit margin menu item. My dish was presented on a recessed serving board that did not match my oval plate. $17 hot plate wobbled wildly every time I used knife & fork.  Peppers were unrecognizable because they were doused, if not smothered, with sauce. My plate looked like something from rookie night in the kitchen.  Princeton deserves better.

For starters, the menu is jacked in the sense that it doesn't tell you what comes on each burger. All you get to choose are the sizes, which are basically small, medium, and large. You then have to ask them what comes on it, so you can tell them what to take off. This makes for a very cumbersome conversation when ordering. My friend and I had to repeat our burger orders to the cashier three times before she felt like she had it down, and then a fourth time to the woman working the grill. And these were not complicated whatsoever. When our orders were finally complete, they got my friend's burger wrong and they forgot our drinks. We also had to go back and ask for condiments,we had already asked them to include. It would be so much simpler to start the burgers plain and allow the customers to build onto it, rather than starting with everything and working backwards, I'm just saying. Now, when it comes to the food, I'm split. The fries were actually quite good. However, the cheeseburger I had was really overcooked, dry and chewy. I had to smother it in ketchup just to keep it from getting stuck in my throat. I am shocked that a place billing itself as a destination for nothing but cheeseburgers could in fact, make such a poor tasting burger. Somebody needs to teach the cooks to go for a medium rare to solid medium rather than cooking the patties to more than well done.
Best pizza I ever had in my life. Everytime im in NYC I make a big effort to go.. light flavorful pizza..
The food was amazing. Loved the goat cheese balls, meat balls and duck and figs were out favourite!!

Our favorite bagels, with interesting special offerings and very good sandwiches. The biggest draw for my family is that Feldman's is very, very good about handling food allergies. They prepare allergy orders separately and are attentive to detail, and never make us feel like an inconvenience. It should be noted that most major allergens are present, so your comfort level may vary, but they do do a good job! Always friendly and fun. So glad they're here!
FRESH and Good! Love this place and the people that work there are very friendly. Give it a try! They also make this "Burrito Juice" that is fresh mint, pineapple and cucumber. So good and fresh.

When I went there I was the fourth occupying table. Two parties where already eating so it was just another table and myself that needed our food served. The waitress would not shut up about being the only server on staff and how hard it was keeping up with serving people and side work (placing napkins and ketchup on the tables). When ever someone new would get there she was sure to let them know she was the only server there at that time (oh pitty me drama queen).

My wife and I have eaten here at least once a month since they opened and have had nothing but great experiences here.  Starting with the valet taking the hassle out of dining in Hartford to the dessert at the end of the night everything is perfect.  The staff has always been friendly and eager to make your evening the best it can possibly be.   Twice we've had something arrive at the table not quite as we expected it and the waiter fixed it immediately and perfectly and was always followed just as quickly with a manager's apology. Their wine list is pretty much unmatched in the Hartford area and I recommend the lounge for the next time you are just looking for a few drinks with friends, great atmosphere.
The wait is worth it, not just for the lovely ramen but also the fun atmosphere. Just request a table 1 hour before your intended dinner time and go to a nearby bar to have an aperitif. Enjoy!
Excellent buffet, well spiced and cooked Indian food with good selection of north and south indian... decor is ordinary with large seating area good for large parties.

Don't understand the fuss. Apart from buffalo mozzarella, the overpriced pizza was average at best. Processed ham, barely no mushrooms or olives, both tasted shit anyway. Disgrace to Italians. Learn how to make a pizza with fresh ingredients

This is my wife and I favorite spot in bayonne to get some pizza! We have tried about 4 different pies,grandma being our favorite..we are very excited to try the shrimp pie this weekend..as far as customer service goes I wont base my review on that.Our only issue was the phone girl! she seemed very rude and made us uncomfortable to be there maybe we will stick to delivery..We asked twice for extra silverwear the first time she forgot and when we asked again she mumbled something under her breath and gave it to us without a sorry or your welcome and if its the same girl she is also very rude on the phone when being asked questions about the menu..but like i said i wont base this review on that because the pizza is the best in town but maybe they should consider a more welcoming waitress

Cheesesteak was enjoyable, albeit this is quite a touristy place and I'm sure there are plenty of better places in town, maybe without the hype but good or even better. Went for one here right after one at Geno's another.  I preferred Geno's bread, but was more a fan of Pat's steak which was filleted and just less dry, with more onions.  It dis however getting the bread a little greasy. The dried red pepper gave it that oomph!!

Never again. I'd heard the place was decent but wanted to try it myself. The food is good, but the service was enough to deter me from returning. I understand its not a busy night and they were seemingly understaffed, but that's not my problem. It shouldn't take 20-30 minutes to get a goddamn take-home box and the check, which was wrong when we got it, so we ended up leaving our free dessert from yelp behind because we didn't feel like waiting another half hour for it. If I have to chase someone down for service more than once? I'm not coming back.
Fantastic guacamole and tacos! Tuna tostadas is great too! Reserved table two weeks ago! No wonder it's so so popular!
On arriving a queue greeted us our name was taken and put on a board when your name transferred to the other board it was your time to be seated. The food was ok and the service fine, very busy!

This place is right around the corner from us, and we've eaten there 3 times since moving here a little over a month ago. I've had Pepe's pizza as well, and I have to say, John and Maria's is right up there with them. Delicious crispy crust, sloppy sauce, fresh mozz, if you're a pizza person (and I am), you'll love it here. The Margherita is excellent, as is the Mama Mia. My wife has also gotten some of the non-pizza dishes, and said they were excellent as well.

I had a great experience! Had to make sure this was my first review on yelp. I wish I could remember our servers name. She was excellent! The meatballs weren't the best I had but definitely worth coming back for.  Best side is the mashed, hands down.  I'll be returning soon!
Our go to neighborhood date night.
I loooove the convenience of Woorijip...fresh, tasty, traditional Korean food and snacks. It is awesome and the staff are cool. :-)
Love this fast food burger place...just don't look at the calories information right beside each food item on the panel LOL.

I found this place by accident - the food is fabulous, but the service is even better. I think it's the owner who is always greeting customers - I have been three times now and each time he is there. I love their olive oil dip they give with the bread and I mentioned it to the owner because I wanted to buy some to take home for my fiancé - he came back with a bag of bread and olive oil to take home for free! The bakery attached is out of this world and it's so nice to be able to pick your desserts to go.

I had been craving authentic Falafel for about a month, I have eaten these regional foods state side, the Mediterranean and the Middle East. I saw the pics read the reviews and then a close friend who lives a Kosher life gave it 4.5 stars (his mom is a 6) so I was in the neighbor hood and remembered the name. I am glad I stopped in. the place is clean, the fragrance of spices and falafel being prepared in the back was a flash back. the staff friendly and the owners suggestion was a hit, ordered as authentic as I remembered and brought it home for my fiancee and I. craving filled, We will return.......Great job folks I wish you a hundred years of prosperity.

Vegetarians are not welcome here. Unless you're ready to take a walk on wild side. This place is for the meat lover. A few bites of what this well crafted menu offers will surely satisfy the carnivorous monster within. The Dinosaur Bar-B-Que features some of the best cuts of meat. There isn't a part of the cow they don't make use of. . They find the perfect blend of American BBQ !!!! Come hungry, leave full and satisfied.

the food was really delicious but i thought the prices were steeper than expected I loved the shrimps in green sauce veal extremena rib eye with madeira sauce halibut the wine list is great - but cost is high so instead of 5 you get 4 stars
Pizza is just perfect at this spot!
I ordered a Mashed Potato Bacon pizza and Harvest salad for take out.  Great pizza and amazingggg salad! Thanks, I'll be back.

I'm more in love with other coffee sources these days, but new moon still reigns when it comes to their perfect little cupcakes. Those are amazing, and they blow their competitors out of the water if you ask me. Moist, delicious, and really interesting and creative flavors.

If you are looking for a great place to sit down and enjoy a nice ambience. Go somewhere else. Patzeria is a Pizza joint, plain and simple. This is one of the best pizza slices I have had in Midtown. The grandma slice is off the walls. Amazing sauce and crust. The tomato basil slice was also equally excellent. This is going to be our regular delivery spot from now on. Only negative is that they close at midnight. The Pizza was fantastic and we will be going back when we come back to NYC.

Stumbled on this amazing place!! Had an excellent breakfast!! Wonderful staff, great food, great atmosphere!!! The Grandma Pizza was AMAZING. Such a simple type of pizza, but everything about it was delicious. I loved the crunch of the batter/crust, and really enjoyed the yummy sauce. Not too much tomato, not too much garlic - just enough of both. There wasn't too much or too little of anything. Somehow they got it right! I was also thankful for them warming it up! Best New York pizza I've had so far. Definitely going back.

Absolutely terrible- I didn't think Chinese food could be this bad. I ordered a tofu dish- and gagged when I took the first bite of tofu because it was like a chewy chunk of grease. The grease just oozed out. And to top it off, it had NO flavor. The broccoli was so undercooked. My veggie fried rice- ZERO FLAVOR! Spring rolls- NO flavor!?! Seriously - I'm not exaggerating!?! I tried adding a ton of salt to eat the rice and it was just inedible. Never again!

Possibly my favorite brunch place in Manhattan. Typical brunch food, but done perfectly. My favorites are Eggs Norwegian, Pumpkin Pancakes, and Steak and Eggs. Great home fries and fresh squeezed O.J. as well. It gets crowded, especially on Sundays. However the service is great and they really get people in and out quickly. So the wait isn't bad if there is one. Highly recommended.

Menu is tiny, space is tiny, employee charm is tiny, Bahn Mis are BANGING. Also, they close at like 9pm (8:30 delivery cutoff!?!!) which seems wild for a restaurant of any kind in NYC, i think if they were open until 10, 11, 12 they would still get tons of business.
Tourist trap.  Outstanding cheese fries though.
great,great,great!!!! bring your favorite wine and have a great meal. lunch or dinner.

We've order from Munchys numerous times and love it the food is delicious the service is great the cost is reasonable and the food is very fresh I can't get enough of great food from Munchys and the ppl that work there are more then pleasant and polite! This place is a must for and one that's hungry and wants something other then the same old same old or crappy pizza!

I am a picky eater and I love breakfast ! I'm not a huge fan of IHOP or diners . I love to go to cugino for my fresh espresso or cappuccino and the pancakes are yummy.  They have a breakfast special for like $9 or $10 with eggs ( I get poached) pancakes or French toast and choice of meat.  You can also get a short stack for $5 and they are two big fluffy pancakes . I enjoy the blt on rye with garlic sauce and friendly staff. It's small so go early or be prepared to wait on a weekend. ( but it's worth it ) they have daily specials like tiramisu pancakes or chicken and waffles , bourbon bacon waffles ... If you are by Ewing defiantly try for breakfast or brunch.

Pig and Khao is hands-down my number one favorite brunch (drunch) place in all of New York City. I have brought so many of my friends here throughout the years, and I swear there was a time during the summer that we were there religiously every Saturday morning to enjoy delicious food, bottomless drinks, and general debauchery. I even convinced one of my best friends to have her engagement party here because she was blown away with the food, drinks, and venue! The Food: Everything on the brunch menu is just flawless. I love the Filipino/Thai influence, with some Spanish elements. My favorites are the longonissa (sausage) paired with cucumber salad and garlic rice, along with the sizzling sisig and steak and eggs. For my friend's engagement party, we also tried the brioche French toast, and while seemingly out of place, it was fabulous. But seriously, the longonissa and garlic rice (with egg!) is just like how mom made it back at home in the far-off land of Los Angeles, California. The Drinks: Endless Mimosas. $15. What else can I say? If you're feeling frisky, try the seasonal Watermelon Mimosas and Lychee Mimosas. If you're a stickler for classics, then the Mango Mimosa won't hurt. Orange is boring, anyway. The Service: I've had delightful experiences with the staff there every time I've been (easily more than 15 times this past year). Additionally, during one of my drunken brunches, I ran into the owner, Chef Leah Cohen (a contestant from Top Chef), and spoke with her for a bit. She was very polite and lovely, ignoring the fact that I was happily drunk and telling her how much I loved her on Top Chef/loved the restaurant. The Venue: Although the location is basically Brooklyn (it's minutes away from the Williamsburg Bridge - Manhattan side), I can't complain. The paintings on the wall are great, the atmosphere is relaxing and not uptight, and the music they play is on point (early 90s rap/R&B). Seriously, nothing to complain about here. Although I haven't been in a month, I will be heading back soon. I cannot lie when I say that this is my go-to place for brunch on the weekends. Cannot wait to try their dinner soon! TIP: If you're like me and bring crowds of people with you, it's best that you bring CASH. While they will split your checks here with credit card, it will save you time to just divvy everything up with cash.

Very small and always crowded, but worth the tight squeeze btw the tables.  This was my second time dinning here and it was better than I remember it being. The service is top quality and so is the food. Great Italian cuisine option on the UES.
Great Burger! Fries were flavorful :-). Waiting 25 minutes for a take out order, only to have it be wrong. :-(.

Fried Chicken and the popovers drizzled with salt and honey they give you to start are to die for. Great to sit outside or in one of the window tables Incredible brunch Good wine list, nice beers on tap... Cant say enough good things.
Too modern for my taste. I am a retro snob and it does not fill my niche. Bull riding was fun though.

Don't know who Sharon W. Is, but she wasn't at the same Piccolo Angolo as me. I've been eating here for years and the food and service are top notch. Sure, it's a little small and sometimes noisy, but that's where you find the best food in New York. I live on the Upper West Side and often go down to Hudson and Jane because that's where the best Italian food in all of New York City can be found!!! The portions are huge and should be shared  (hence the higher prices) and Maria and Peter are outstanding hosts. They take reservations (online and on the phone) and always honor them. I'll be going back next week!
The sugarcane rib is amazing and the green curry was great. We also ordered the pork belly its very yummy too. Staffs was very friendly and the decoration is very pretty. Will definitely come again!

Mediocre food , service, attitude keep looking Crispy oysters hidden in overwhelming batter House roll finished with nasty spices that block any flavor of fish not much flavor to fish come to think of it? Room temperature sushi isn't high on my list for good Japanese

This place is seriously OVERPRICED.  If the food were good that would be one thing but it is nothing to rave about.  Their fries are good but that doesn't really impress me.  I paid 15 dollars for a wrap, fries, and a drink which I think it way too much.  The sandwich didn't have any flavor and the chicken in it tasted like it was frozen and then burned.  I gave it a two because of the fries and the place is VERY clean and new.
comfort food for me

My favorite local haunt: Super tasty, inspired food Cozy, clean interior Hospitable, attentive staff (easy on the eyes, to boot) And be sure to get dessert! The panna cotta, creme brulee and ice cream are all delicious.
Love their Veggie wrap and Mushroom Sandwich!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Amazingly testy!!! My school is located two blocks away, really wished I could go there everyday during lunch.
Great atmosphere, amazing cocktail and super staff. I think they have the best bartender I have never seen. One of my favorite cocktails it's the Maserati, definitely     to try

There are not too many bars in Lawrence But this is close to Trenton state or Rider. Mcguinns is a casual fun place. The owner is very nice and I enjoy their wings ( garlic ones are my favorite ) and cheese steak wrap , chicken fingers or grilled cheese . They also have good string French fries and pretzel bites with cheese . Very reasonably priced ! Lots of beers to choose from and they have Brooklyn lager on tap !!!! There is a juke box and they sometimes have karaoke on tues ( all ages) and a DJ on weds that's gets pretty good college and 20s-30s crowd.  I think they even have dollar beer specials although I only drink kettle or premium beers.  You can also watch sports or dance here and there is beer pong , pool tables , fuse ball , deer hunter and shuffle board. If the bar closes and your tipsy there is a diner next door to sober up . There is also a deck off the side . I've lived in the area my whole life and consider myself a socialite . I give it a thumbs up

Persis has become my favorite restaurant. I went for Lunch buffet, there I found lot of diverse varieties of Veg and Non Veg. Starting with Naan and Diwani handi followed by biryani and dessert. All of these are awesome. Typical Indian taste attracted me, Hence I suggested my friends to visit Persis.
Had the best indian food in a long time..loved every dish i ordered . The staff were very frriendly. Goat pepper fry was awesome ..too good.

Went there on my birthday for a quick bite before catching a plane back to Michigan. I sat at the sandwich and soup bar. I ordered a sandwich that came with a particular soup which to my taste was not at all good.  I asked if I could get a replacement and the server was totally rude about it and said all the other soups were only to be sold on an individual basis and they did not want to run out.  I then watched two other people next to me order the same sandwich and soup combo but they asked for a different soup from the menu and were allowed to do so.  When I asked the server about it she said they had not tried to exchange the delivered soup as I did and therefore they could get just what they wanted. (No worries about running out of soup based on their orders!)  Both customers sort of rolled there eyes at the server based on her arbitrary treatment of my request but were happy they could get what they wanted for soup.  They said they felt I had a legitimate complaint.  When I spoke with the manager she said she usually stood behind her staff and even though the service varied by customer for the same menu item, she could not do anything about it.  She said I was welcome to order the soup I wanted and pay for it but they would not allow me to switch soup after the order was served.  I have never seen such blatant disregard for a customer's satisfaction over a simple cup of soup.  My gut feeling was that the staff was encouraged to feel "ownership" of the product  to the point that they treated the food as if it was coming from their privately stocked kitchen and they would dole it out as they saw fit.  Nice to empower employees, but not at the risk of being rude to a customer.  I rarely send food back and felt I was treated very unfairly.  Will never go back.
Nice people , tasty food , cozy restaurant Sashimi was perfect. Just go (dont mind haters how can you give 1 start for this resturant i dont understant you hater) just go and see it your self

I just ate there - August  17th - and my food was awful. I had a duck prosciutto appetizer that was so salty I could barely get it down. Then I had a chicken breast entree that smelled like it was deep fried and tasted awful. I'd never eat there again.
3 and a half star is underselling the great experiance we had here. A truely great service and out of this world food.......worth it!!

Went for lunch for the first time today. Had hand-stuffed dumplings, amazing sauteed kale, a chicken and puffed rice appetizer and lamb "chili". Everything was amazing: made from fresh ingredients, perfectly seasoned, and presented elegantly! This might be the best restaurant in Hanover. (...or at least tied for first with Pine.) My only regret is that I can't go back for dinner tonight to try everything else on the menu. :)

Lots of beer and great selection. It's a little dirty but that's ok. The service is friendly and the bartenders are pretty attentive. It was a good time to spend with my girls here. Lots of friendly people. I'll probably come back in a few weeks.

Peppinos surprised me quite a bit. I wasn't sure what to think of the place when I first walked in but the atmosphere was warm and inviting. I sat down and had a Margarita Pie and it was to die for! Just the correct amount of sauce to cheese ratio, it came to our table piping hot and the sauce wasn't overly sweet which is a pet peeve of mine. I can't wait to go back and try some of the steak sandwiches, I hear they're great!

Atmosphere: I absolutely loved the decor. It was really artsy and hipster. I really loved the pictures on the wall. Like even the bathroom was artsy. Food/Drink: Phenomenal. I ordered the ice coffee with a almond croissant for a total of $7 exact. The ice coffee came in a little cute mason jar and it tasted great. The almond croissant must be the best I ever had. So flaky & the taste was great. Service: The workers were sooo friendly. It was nice to have them bring me the coffee and croissant. I definitely recommend this place to coffee lovers.

Sitting here at Sea Fire Grill feeling pleasantly satisfied and absolutely delighted by the service!  Our server, Emil, made our experience very enjoyable.  His suggestions were spot on.  The prawns reminded me of the British Virgin Islands which is definitely a good thing.  Huge and delicious!  The pear and crab salad was loaded with crab!  The hubby enjoyed is seafood pasta tremendously.  Then, there was desert, the upside down apple pie...OMG...heaven!!! The fig desert was very different but just as splendid!  The atmosphere was loud and busy which I expect in a New York restaurant and I sincerely enjoyed!  I will be back!
The service is slow, but the food is good (I especially enjoyed the tsukemono). My boyfriend loves it and the ambience is great!
By far the best tacos in the city! It's fresh, tasty and cheap! Even if there is a line, it moves very quick. Definitely to try
Lulu & Po is a foodies paradise. From the moment you walk in and you're hit with the aroma of a well balanced variety of small plates, you know you're palate is in for a treat.

I REALLY wanted to like this place. I honestly did. I visit the sister restaurant, Peaches Hothouse, all the time so I was excited to try this place. So I came here on a Sunday around 12 pm so I figured it would be a lil packed. I went to the hostess and she told me the wait would be 30 mins but advised me that I could go to the location next door. So me and my bf went to the next door location and got a seat right away. Our waiter came and gave us our menu, we ordered. I ordered the FARMERS OMELETTE, which had no meat in it and a side of bacon. Then we played the waiting game. Now I didn't mind waiting because the game was on but we waited close to one hour for our food but I didn't complain because I know it can get busy. Then the food comes and I am excited because at this point I'm starving! My bf gets his food, he ordered the Jim Cade, but when the waiter hands me my plate I noticed my eggs had no spinach in it, some round meat in it, and no side of bacon. I look inside and it's the Sausage Omelette. So I flag my waiter down and tell him it's the wrong item. She takes the food back and tells me it will be out soon. So I want and 30 mins go by then another 10. Then another waiter said it would be out soon but by this time in ready to go and I tell him to take it off the bill. By this time me and my bf are mad because he finished his food and I didn't even get my food yet. Then the waiter comes back with a plate of food And asked me if I wanted it. Initially, I was going to take the food to go but something told me to look and it and LI and behold it's another sausage omelette. It's now after two o clock and I still haven't eaten. I was thoroughly upset because I was seriously hungry and waited two hours for nothing. The waiter took the food off the bill but both my boyfriend and I were upset over the experience. Our waiter got  an .83 cent tip and we left. I wasted my time here Nd will never come here again. Maybe if the waiters paid less attention to the music and more attention to the customers I would have a better review. 0 stars!!!!

Stopped in here after an afternoon tour at the Tenement Museum. The neighborhood used to be known as Little Germany in the 1840's, so this was an appropriate choice.  Got a seat by the open window near sidewalk.  Great German beer, great lunch.  The owner/manager (not sure of his status) came by and chatted - nice guy.  This puts all the wanna-be Oktoberfest food out here in Jersey to shame.
The best! The food was amazing, best sable fish ever! The staff were extremely friendly and seemed like they were having fun working. My friends and I had a great time and will be back very soon!

The best of the best Vietnamese sandwiches as they bring the most authentic in all of New York and very generous portions in ingredients. There was one incident in which they were very accommodating in that they ran out of bread and three customers including myself were in the store wanting to buy THEIR sandwich. I then suggested that I would willingly go outside to buy just the bread though only I wanted their ingredients. They agreed to my request and there we go: Three more sandwiches for us to enjoy and three more sandwiches they profited from. They also make excellent coffee fried appetizers and deserts. Way to go and they've been in the business for over 20 years. Way to go.
great food. pecking duck is excellent. Many good dishes if you like your food spicey. Great service too.

I can't say enough positive things about this place. It's mine and my boyfriends go-to restaurant of choice. Both the food and service are impeccable and the Pinot Noir they have on the menu is one of the best red wines I've ever tasted. You can't go wrong with any of their veal selections and their seafood pasta is heavenly. The portions are large so we usually end up taking a lot home and the food taste just as good warmed up the next day.
the best elote available in Philly

If you're looking for a unique and magnificent experience... go to AWOL.  Seriously people, from the art on the walls to the art on the plates, this is not to be missed.   Drinks with truffle salt, food with a tandoori flavor... cocktails with beet juice.  Rad stuff.  I loved loved loved the pizza, and all the veggies are amazingly fresh.  (sweet potatoes, I don't even know what to do). The value is amazing and the service was impeccable.  get involved people.

I love this place ! They have fresh Italian bread and olives. All kinds of assortedeats and sandwiches. But my favorite is the spot they took over in Ewing called cuginos cafe 72 open for breakfast and lunch . Fresh espresso. , pancakes are delish and bacon is tasty. ... Blt w garlic aioli is yummy too
Had the burger medium cooked and all we could taste was blue cheese. Repeated on me all night. Fries were great. Burger wasn't worth the wait
Best tacos I've tasted in a long time!!! The tortillas were so good and so much flavor all around!
There's no way it can compare to Prosperity dumpling on the other end of the street. No taste at all.. :/

I am new to new york city, my friend told me about this pizzeria a couple of times, I finally ate their wonderful pizza yesterday, and I must say, they know how to make a pizza :), next time I will bring my nefew.

Me and my friend went to eat on a Wednesday night and the service was bad. I asked for lemon and lime for my water the waitress gave it to me on a napkin. But the kicker was the waitress asked to wrap my food which was seafood fra diavolo  (ok bland in seasoning so I really didn't eat much) and handed to the bus girl which had a stack of dirty plates from God knows where but not our table and puts my food on top of it. Now I think that's nasty and not sanitary? The manager was nice enough she half apologized took the meal off my bill. Smh. Won't go back.

Can't get enough of this place seriously!!! Best fresh quality food ever with an awesome service!!!! Never disappointed with all the varieties they have on the menu. Service is fast and so staff are so kind!!!
Nice place to meet friends. Awesome environment. Really fast service and cheap price of food. Many times been here and want to return when get some time.
This place is elite ! The food is so fresh and portion sizes are great. I highly recommend the kimchi soup.

I made my own potato, it was great tasting. Only recommendations is that the menu is so big to choose from, I would've liked it if they had more options in the "signature meals" section so I could just choose something they know tastes good. I'm really indecisive and was a little overwhelmed by all the choices... Not really a bad thing. Also, I think the portion size needs to increase a bit. Made my own with bacon and 2 sauces, and the total came close to $10. I just think if I'm paying Chipotle type prices (I get the same vibe) I should be getting more, like chipotle size portions. It's not McDonald's but hey it's still fast food! And $10 is steep.
Try their prawn and roast duck!
Our server was excellent, so knowledgeable about all the different kinds of flavors in oysters from different locations. It was educational and so delicious! A perfect night.

The one and the only. 62nd and Noble. Michelle is the best cheesesteak chef in Philly. God Bless her she always asks about Mom. The finest steak in Philadelphia. And a cold beer with your steak. Yeah Buddy.

I am totally in love with restaurant. I went for the first time on a date and was seated in the corner, it was well lit and the service was amazing. The food was heavenly, the portions were just right as stated before worthy of 5 stars. The staff was helpful and attentive and the bread was.......divine. I was impressed with the scallops but my date loved the pasta. This will be my valentines day 2015 location suggestion.

***Review for delivery only*** Ordered from here for lunch via seemless, given the standard 45-60 minutes wait for delivery. Reasonable, 60 minutes pass, I'll give the benefit of the doubt, maybe they're busy. 90 minutes pass, now I'm hungry and angry (hangry) called them up, tell them I placed an order an hour and a half ago, gentleman told me it will be there "any minute" another 40 minutes pass finally food (cold) arrives. With that being said, my sandwich was delicious, probably would have been better if it wasn't cold but honestly a solid sandwich. Hopefully they were having an off day but I'll be hesitant to order from there again.

A little disappointed. Chicken wings were really dry and bland. Coleslaw was really bland as well, although it had a nice consistency. Not too dry or overly runny. Just not much taste. A friend said his ribs were bland as well, and very fatty. They have live music on Thursdays. That was the highlight of the night.

PROS: My wife and I fancy ourselves as fried chicken experts, and Root & Bone's fried chicken is among the best we've ever tasted.  The way they lace the honey and lemon into the seasoning, so that you taste the lemon as well as the honey in each bite is amazing!  The macaroni and cheese is pretty good too.  CONS: The prices are on the high side compared to other chicken and waffle places to which we've been.  The pecan pie was a little watery for our tastes, and venue is on the small side, so you might consider taking your food "To go."  OVERALL:  We will definitely be back!
The crab rangoons are very good and the portions are huge but the pork fried rice is so bland with no flavor and the chicken with cashews is not good either, also lacking flavor. Too bad

I got the basic beef pho, and I was not impressed. I just moved here from Phoenix, and I didn't expect my pho restaurant from Phoenix to be better than one in NYC, but the broth was not anything special. I will say that the restaurant is extremely efficient in their ability to serve a lot of customers, but I will still be searching for a good pho place or maybe try something different next time.
Veggie bomb all the way!! Reasonably priced, delicious, quick service, "healthy" - so happy to live in the same neighborhood as Modern!

After an extra  long day I just wanted to get a bite to eat and go home. I was walking by the restaurant and looked in the window. It looked inviting so I decided to try it out.  It has a spacious feel with gorgeous high ceilings. When dining alone some restaurants want to put you next to the kitchen or the bathroom. Not here. They gave me the best seat in the house on a comfy couch next to the front window where I could watch all the night activity. My waiter was infectiously friendly and attentive without overdoing it and even the owners checked in on me. I ordered a veggie panini that was made with very fresh vegetables and grilled perfectly. It  came with a generous side salad of mixed greens that was equally fresh. And what can I say about the margarita? It was simply the best I have had (other than my own homemade ) in a very long time. To repeat that word again, it was made fresh (no mix) and for a pleasant twist used orange bitters instead of triple sec. Absolutely felt much better when I left than when I walked in. Will return with husband and friends.
One of my favorite spots downtown. Great atmosphere, amazing food and attentive service. Definitely worth a try.

just moved to the area after being away from the area for a long time found this place through some friends pizza was top notch great menu they have a little something for everyone from kids menu to fish chicken pasta .I have had the chicken Dominick and the pasta vodka they were very flavorful this is my go to place in a word awesome
Some of the best Peruvian chicken I have had. I have never been to the restaurant but always order delivery when I visit the area.

My boyfriend and I had dinner here last night, the atmosphere is cute and cozy, with a different range of music playing in the background. The staff was super friendly, sweet and very inviting. We started with the empanadas as our appetizers. Then I had the Camarones Calipso and he had Pescao Guisado O Escabechado...the food is so good and fulling that we had to take doggy bags home. I will definitely recommend this restaurant and visit again.

If only it didn't get so loud this would be a five star place for me. Starting out with the great raw bar - I'm a sucker for oysters and they have not only a good variety of both east and west coast oysters they always seem to be fresh. The entrees are excellent as well with nice pairings of fresh vegetables. I'm particularly fond of the way they do scallops but I've never been disappointed with any of their fish or seafood dishes. I must admit that I have not had much in the way of meat here but that is not what I come here for. It is also a BYO which is a big plus for me. Now if they could just find a way to make it a bit quieter.....

Really enjoy the food here. The sushi is very fresh & all of the rolls I've tried are delicious. The only thing that keeps this from being a 5 star is that there isn't a roll special on the lunch menu. On the other hand it keeps me from being stagnant in my orders. Try this place - you won't regret it!
This place gets away with whatever it wants because of its great location. The food is far below average, the service is slow and the prices are ridiculously high. Avoid it!
My husband and I celebrated our 2nd anniversary here. the garden is extremely romantic. The staff is excellent. We highly recommend the cheese plate.

I wish I could review the pizza, but we never got any. Dom's daughter told us our pie would be about 30 minutes, maybe 40. After 90 minutes, still nothing. We checked in a few times, and were repeatedly told, "Just five more minutes" or something similar. We didn't want to wait any longer and got up to leave. She berated us and told us that if we left now, everyone else would have to wait even longer and it would be our fault. What? She continued yelling at us, basically saying that we couldn't leave. My husband told her we wanted to pay for our Cokes and go. First she wouldn't take the money, continuing to yell at us. Finally, she said it would be $4 (for two half bottles). My husband gave her a $20 -- she put it in the cash register and walked away. He actually had to ask repeatedly for our change, all the while getting yelled at by her for not wanting to stay longer. The pizza looked good, but the place itself is extremely dirty. During our time there, no one cleaned any of the tables. They were covered in parmesan cheese, dirty napkins, spilled drinks, etc. I heard one of the customers complain that his chair was broken, another pointed out that upholstery stuffing was spilling out through a large tear in his seat. The bathroom is really bad, thick mildew on the sink, filthy floor...not good. I wish we could have tried the pizza, but the service was such a turnoff. I get that Di Fara's is extremely popular, but it would be nice to feel like customers were valued. While we waited, there were a number of customers who approached the counter to ask how long the wait was. Each time, the cashier would shoot them a dirty look, say nothing, and walk away. I don't get it. Considering how long the wait is to eat here, it seems like a fair question. We have tried a lot of pizza since we moved out here. Grimaldi's and La Suprema actually made us feel like they wanted us to be there. And their restaurants were clean.

Fantastic Pizza indeed. Crust, bread, cheese and sauce was carefully prepared and not overcooked nor burned. Margherita base and my toppings were Meatball, Mushroom, Spinach (very generous portion but of course you're paying $40 including tips for an 18" pie). It surprised everyone around us and they all looked at how colorful this pie was. The party next to us commenting to the waiter how I broke all the rules. Unfortunately the size of the back dining room was unbelievably narrow so its hard to move around. It is also where you can see all the pizzas are being made. And I can say the service was reasonable-tip worthy. *They don't accept credit cards so be prepared to pay in cash.

We had gone to Lombardi's after hearing so much about it and I am happy to say they lived up to their reputation. Since we went late in the day (close to closing time), we avoided the crazy lines we have heard about/seen for this place. They also had some live music going on at the time. We got both veg and chicken pizzas and they came out fresh and yummy! They are cash-only so make sure you have cash when you go there. Overall, yummy pizzas--definitely worth a visit.

My favorite late night restaurant if I'm in the mood for Jook as we say in Cantonese (Congee) Soy Sauce Chicken     Roast Pig     Salt n' Pepper Pork Chops over Rice     Preserved Vegetables with Squid Seafood Pan Fried Noodles or even Stir Fried Ho Fun. I am going to go out on a limb, doing a non Chinese thing and say their Fried Rice, Wonton Noodle Soup is also great. If you're feeling adventurous, try their Beef Tripes with Wonton Noodles. I always have an order of Choy Sum available. Very fast service though seating can be pretty crammed especially if you have a whale or rude patron behind you who refuses to push their seat in.
The best dumpling I ever had in nyc so far!!! Must try!!! Ps. Their dumpling has juicy inside just taste delicious
I tried this pizza for the first time and thought it was awful, it was soggy and very bland. I would never order here again.

Excellent food staff is friendly...  Never a bad dish.. This is one of our favorite places to eat in town.. We have even requested different dishes and they perfectly made them as well.. I would suggest anyone to try them and see for yourself..
Delicious! Mushroom tufo pho soso good. Crispy delicious banh mi. Sick

For a Malaysian restaurant in Manhattan many cannot match the taste and variety that this one offers in but thats only Manhattan. At the same time, this is the only restaurant I've been to that I always have diarrhea after eating there every single time. I usually order: Mee Goreng Roti Canai Hainan Chicken Rice Bah Kut Teh Soup Curry Beef/Chicken Iced Coffee Service is usually pretty fast and not really bad though sometimes say the bill is $51.47, I apparently give them $51 cash, 2 dimes and 27 pennies they're not happy about it though as they'll probably give you a dirty look and talk badly about you like they did me, but I did tell them they're the ones who are charging the pennies to begin with and not accepting cards. Personally if you're in the mood for Malaysian try Brooklyn's 8th Avenue as there are much better tasting and much less expensive choices and you can possibly save yourself a diarrhea.
Comon people are they paying you to leave reviews . The worst in bloomfield .. All the food is bland and for a place that is slow it's a long wait.....

Big Tray Chicken (their signature dish), Homemade Steamed Dumplings, Pancake with Beef are always my favorites. I've been coming here since it opened and theres no surprise at all, it only got more and more business. They provide fast service though the big tray chicken will take a while. Well the bread and butter of this place is if you love beer, it is definitely welcome here for Free. It is completely BYOB and I always try to bring a 6 pack or a 24oz Tsing Tao Heineken or Budweiser with me. The only problems I see in this restaurant is that it is very small, perhaps enough for just 20 patrons and to make a long story short this is where the already seated customers take advantage. The restaurant does take reservations in case you absolutely want a seat at a designated time though its not guaranteed.

This is one of my favorite bar pies ! And the the kens salad is delish as well as the boneless buffalo wings and fresh ranch dip.  They also do wings called honey buffalo barbecue that are tangy and spicy.  Mussels app is huge and comes with garlic bread and cheese.

We've been wanting to try this cozy byob and certainly were not disappointed. Although the lobster tempura was more deep fried then tempura it was sweet and moist and the fruit salsa it sat on was fresh and a perfect balance. Scallops and tuna were wonderful and if you enjoy Oreos then you can't go wrong with one dipped in funnel cake batter and deep fried served ala mode. Our waiter Matt was very informative about preparation and ingredients of the dishes and was extremely attentive! Our water was refilled countless times! Cheers to another great byob to enjoy our cellar collections!

Been there twice (just to see if my findings the first time was accurate) and I can honestly say it is not as good a pizza as the hype surrounding it leads it to be. Overall Soggy/Doughy consistency, really burnt crust, tasteless pie (meatball/pepperoni/spinach combo). Its obvious, the one who prepared the pizza does not do it with heart and that he should not even be making pizzas. The waiters can be true snobs as they have so much pride in their pizzas. One of them saw me not eating the disgusting/burnt/indigestible crust and said he was disappointed for me not eating something so "special" while kissing his clasped fingers. Whereas he should be paid to kiss my ass instead if he wants the tip. The snob tries to cover it up by quickly getting olive oil, tabasco and vinegar. Unfortunately it's really hard  to fix food that is already dead. Perhaps the only thing that tasted right was the Snapple Iced Tea to remedy the pizza's blandness and then Ginger Ale to remedy my stomach after eating burnt crust with oil, vinegar and tabasco.

Omg this place is awesome!!! On my first time visiting NYC I walk into this bar and lock eyes with this beautiful southern belle with an amazing...well I dont need to go into detail. But aside from the beautiful women working there who made me feel more than comfortable, I recieved great service in a great social enviroment. Anyone in NYC, native or just visiting needs to stop by here...5 stars!!!

Inside separate into two space infront and behind so infront space where is bar counter , they enjoy talking each others and drinking , spend gretful time. Behind space where is  ramen shop that also wrap calm atomousphere Stuffs are kindly and welcomming When we enter the entrance,stuffs are welcoming to say that "いらっしゃいませ！" make us feel so much better So at there we can order Ramen Japanese alcohol typical japanese food. When we reserve at there,they inform to us by phone that's why we don't need to waite on inside They also provide japanese green tea after dinner.

FIrst off, this is my first Yelp review- I feel strongly enough about my experience I had to share.  When I read raving reviews about this place, and saw the 1 dollar sign- I had to try it.  Every time I passed by there was always a 45 minute wait on weekends! I went on a Tuesday evening with friends around 7 and was seated right away.  It's a cute cozy atmosphere, but the service was horrible! Our food and drinks arrived quickly but the staff was very rude.  Me and my two friends were seated at a table with this weird bench thing that was making my friend uncomfortable, so I politely asked to scoot over to the next table where no one was sitting. The hostess told me, no, people sit there all the time.   DRINKS: I got an $8 margarita, which for the money was fairly boozed up, but paid $5 for the exact same thing at a bar near St. Marks, so I wasn't crazy about it. Also, there wasn't a happy hour going on either. FOOD: I got a fish taco and steak quesadilla. The taco was AWESOME, and SMALL but definitely not worth waiting 45 minutes if you're there on a weekend.  The quesadilla was really good too but I could've made the same thing at home and microwaved it. OVERALL: I'm not anxious to go back, although if you need to save a few bucks during the week, this place is one of your better bets. But in my opinion, you can get big awesome sandwiches from Mamoun's down the street for the same price as one of Taqueria's wimpy little tacos.

My favorite Mexican place in LES area. Their guac and tacos are generally good - though I found the cactus and fish the best. Also their soup is really good, it's super creamy and flavorful. The crunchy tortilla strips and buttery avocado slices in the soup add mixed textures to the soup, which I enjoyed a lot. Food is served fast and service is ok, but the place's a little too loud and cramped.

The food is very good. Italians (like actually from Italy with the accent and the cooking skills) are here making the food. Servers are friendly. It's cash only. Organic eggs, good bread, grass-fed meat. Only drawback is the bathroom situation, but it's understandable.

I've been here a few times and I have tried both their sweet and savory crepes. Service is quick and the cashiers are very friendly! I have tried the strawberry banana Nutella, grilled chicken with honey mustard, and buffalo chicken style crepes there. The least I can say about this location is that they are VERY GENEROUS with their ingredients. The crepes are filled with flavor, and the first bite is all inclusive of the ingredients that compose the crepe.  There is plenty of everything: vegetables, proteins, sauce, fruits, you name it! (Depending on the crepe you order of course) Everything is prepared right in front of you via an open kitchen, from the technique they use to disperse the crepe batter to garnishing. It is bestowed onto awaiting customers as soon as the item is ready. The crepe is hot and crispy and the ingredients are cooked perfectly.  My personal preference is for the savory crepes, only because I don't have much of a sweet tooth. I like to eat the end first (pointed part) to accommodate the avalanche of sauce these crepes appear with.  The filling is dispersed well as each bite contains a little bit of something. Very balanced. All in all, I have not had a single bad food experience for the multiple times I have been here. Definitely recommend to university city dwellers!
A nice little restaurant! Great food! Really enjoyed my dinner here!
Food was amazing! The fact that it is BYOB is great as well. Only down fall was the noise.

These guys are incredible. I've had over a dozen different sandwiches in the last couple years and every one is solid. If I have one complaint about this place, it's that they put some tissue paper on the sandwiches that gets stuck to the cheese on some sandwiches (meatball, eggplant, chicken parms.) I have to gnaw it off the paper like a squirrel. Do yourself a favor and pay the extra money for a seeded roll. Most times one half is good enough for a meal. Save the rest for later. In addition to sandwiches, they have everything you'd expect from a corner deli. Chips, candy, ice cream, soft pretzels, tons of drinks/sodas. Cigarettes. Milk. Everything. And they deliver! Skip Pats and Genos and get a real steak at Cosmis.

Stopped in on a Saturday for lunch.  Sat at the bar got the special, Suckling pig roasted in a wood burning oven.  the meat was tender and the skin perfectly crispy.  It came with a sauce on the side and fresh cut french fries.
Delicious.  Highly recommended

LIVE UNI!!! They have delicious and fabulous live uni from California. Just look at the pic! What an awesome find. Can't wait to go back. Also, Zest has an AMAZING HAPPY HOUR deal! Defin check it out.

I am giving this one star to offset all the highly-starred reviews. Yes, the place is nice-looking. And my server was nice. Plus, I'll give it to them for their bread and the house-brand ale that my dining companion seemed to like. (He's a discerning fellow in that regard.) But my burger was terrible, certainly the worst I've eaten and probably the worst in Creation. (And, as we all know, burger-quality is the beginning if not the end of how to judge the grub at a particular bar.) To be specific: not only was it dry, it was strangely seasoned, making that so-called burger something closer to meatloaf in its texture and taste. And not good meatloaf either. My suspicion: the meat was "high," as they used to say, and in time-honored fashion, the seasoning was there to mask that slight putrefaction. I detected clues indicating that many of the reviewers who liked the food at this bar were from out of town. To those folks, l say: 1. Thank you for visiting New York. 2. When it comes to food, New York can do so much better. 3. The fact that you liked the food at the Landmark leads me to think the U.S. overall maintains very low standards for its cuisine. Positive mention was made in some reviews of the bar's supposedly cool vibe, so let me add: the music stunk. And it was loud. They did post notice, though, that, at some point, live Irish music would be performed. That might bring me back - for a drink and a drink only.
Awesome!!!

This place was AWESOME. Everyone is so friendly, the food is delicious, and the atmosphere is fun. They even gave us complimentary sake shots- enough said. It was my boyfriend's birthday and they sang to him, complete with drums and cymbals! And a complimentary slice of cake and fancy chop sticks to take home to top it all off. I highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great night out!
I dint eat lobster outside of the coast of Maine and here. No where else is it as consistently fresh, never farm raised and delicious. Whole lobster or lobster roll this place is the best.

Having tried the truffle burger, Umami Burger delivers on its umami promise.  The burger is assembled to perfection in the best possible ratio of ingredients.  The caramelized patties, the use on truffle oil, and the addition of aged cheese served on lightly toasted Portuguese buns lend well to its flavor.  The fries and the additional sauces served with it were also pretty good.

Their service sucks. The food is okay. For some reason I continued to back there because I'm a gluten for punishment. But no more. I called them to place a simple order for pick up. They put me on hold for about 5 minutes (that's an eternity on hold). Then when she got back on the phone her first words were (WHAT DO YOU WANT)  are you kidding me????. That's how you ask a potential customer to spend money with you. I told she was rude and I didn't want to order anymore. P.S. CALLED state grille down the street from them.  Their service was quick and friendly and food was excellent. Nevada diner lost another customer. Learn how to staff you business and train your employees.

Wonderful restaurant. The decor is very inviting, and the staff are warm yet professional. Some of the menu items are a bit off the map, but White Dog Cafe's choices are healthy by origination, and the plating and presenation is very attractive. I had the scrumptious Cajun Crusted Catfish, which is prepared perfectly, and has an incredible spanish chorizo finish. I recommend this restaurant for anyone who enjoys a comfortable fine dining experience.
Sometimes when I'm sad, I think about their banana pancakes to cheer me up. Works every time.

Portions: HUGE Price: Reasonable So I would frequent this place after work in Bloomfield. I strongly recommend getting the Carrot Juice. It blew my mind. Creamy, aromatic, and very good with a nice spicy meal. I've had the oxtail and curry goat, both were exceptional. Compared to other Caribbean/Jamaican restaurants in the area (Montclair, Bloomfield) this is the one I most recommend. The restaurant is clean as well and staff is very friendly.
Amazing experience! Love the place , the service and of course the food! The branzino alla plancia was to die for...
