The prices are a bit higher than an average dinner we visited but you get plenty of food and service is fast and friendly
Awesome pancakes . I loved the fruit preserves they served with the muffins. The Bellini was ok not the best I've had. Overall great place for breakfast
Excellent place, very energetic. Wait time is not bad, food wait is short. Very cool place!

I've eaten here six times.  They finally got their cooking times correct.  Now medium IS medium.  Get your damn liquor license problem resolved or make it byob in the meantime!  The place is too brightly lit!  And the servers are a bit too casual.  But I love the place!  Best Elk burger!  Great Boar!  Goat!  Bison!  It's all good.  Best fries, sweet and French, around!  Get some liquor!

This place looks the part, but once the food started coming out, things went downhill quickly.   My wife and I came here with the Groupon for an appetizer, two entrees and a dessert.  We got the warm root vegetable appetizer, which wasn't terrible, however there were sauces all over the plate and none of them were particularly good or even tasted good together. My entree was the fish and chips.  The fish came in three ~6 inch long pieces, two of which were less than half an inch thick.  It basically tasted like I was just eating the cornmeal breading, which had a very unpleasant gritty texture.  Again, there were at least 4 different sauces on the plate which didn't go well together and definitely didn't enhance the taste of the breading.  The fries were good, but there were only 6 of them (they were thick cut steak fries). My wife had the pasta entree, which was pretty good, nothing to complain about. For dessert we got the brownie.  This is easily the worst dessert I've ever had in a restaurant.  There was some kind of chocolate sauce that tasted like soap, the brownie was a weird texture and the ice cream had some unidentified substance crumbled over it.  After the first bite we set out trying to identify what aspect of it tasted the worst.  It was a difficult task. Two stars because my wife's entree was decent and the service/ambience was good, but I will never be returning.

Great service but the food wasn't as great as I thought. I was expecting some good greasy indulgent gastropub delights! But they were all dry, bland, and well....boring. We got the Brussels sprouts, loaded waffle fries, pastrami dog, and an Italian sausage.
I really love Cisco's. I can't go more than 2-3 weeks without going in for Huevos Rancheros with their homemade hot sauce. I also go in when I need a Fish Taco fix.  Super tasty. Great place!
Excellent food great service nice ambiance we really enjoyed there tapas I would love to go there again thank you
Always great food, beautiful decor,  and wonderful, friendly staff and owners :)
The food here is original and delicious.  The thin crust pizza is the best in North Jersey!  The service is always outstanding and they always have great specials to pick from.

The worst sushi all you can eat place I ever been.. Taste so bad. The fish was in very big chunk barely can swallow it. How in the world they cut that salmon so big?? Such a waste of money! The tempura also greasy, the tempura sauce and as well as the soy sauce they all dilute with water no taste and quality at all. Im about to talk to the chef about how bad the food is. But I consider again as a good manner. Even my husband got stomachache right after eat there. We will never go back!! If u guys love sushi u will know what is good sushi. Not crap like this. Sorry but I have to tell the truth.

Always have a great time here. The atmosphere during all sporting events is phenomenal. Great drink specials during sporting events, excellent food. The service is as great as it could be considering how crowded it can get there. If you want to see a game full of local fans, you will enjoy every moment here.

The food we've had has been fairly good, not the best I've ever had but not terrible either. The service has been awful, the little hostess girl are clueless and ignore you if possible. I've been put on hold and hung up on several time in a row. They're too convenient for us not to go to but only when nothing else works.

Based on the very solid reviews, a friend and I went to Bahche on Saturday night.  I am completely boggled by all of the four-star ratings.  I had a chicken pesto panini that tasted off -- there's no other way to put it. I took home a spinach phyllo pastry to go, and it, too, tasted off.  Both featured a weird bitter taste and an odor I'm going to refrain from characterizing.  But I don't believe the food had gone bad -- I think this is how their food tastes.  Mediocre and unremarkable are two words that come to mind. I've never actually written a negative review on Yelp -- I don't feel good about doing it, and figure there are others out there who will.  But after having a really disappointing dinner for two last night and knowing that $50 (including a 20% tip) could've been much better spent, say, at Cubana Cafe on 6th Ave, I really felt like I needed to.  The menu is very brief, and some reviewers had noted that.  They don't really serve "dinner," per se, although they said they are testing one or two entres every night.  Maybe this is a better brunch place?  Maybe they're better at catering? As others mentioned, the space is huge.  And looks it when empty -- there was only one other table occupied in the entire space on a Saturday night when lots of people were out.  You'd think the service would've been attentive, but I can't even say that was the case!  I will give the waitress the benefit of the doubt and presume she was new.  When a table of two orders one dessert, isn't it customary to serve it with two utensils so it can be shared? Last, the street is not inviting at night.  I've lived in Bklyn for 20 years and I get it -- this area is turning around, millennials are moving in, etc.  It's Gowanus, not Park Slope. But the street the restaurant is on is not one you'd be inclined to walk down, and indeed no one was anywhere in sight when we left around 8pm.  There's at least one body shop on the block and many of the buildings are either still warehouses or they're not currently being used; however, it was too dark to know for sure.   So all that said, I just don't get it!

I was underwhelmed and disappointed with the food at L'Amante.  The appetizer was bland. The main courses were tasty but ordinary. The broccoli rabe was bitter and inedible. The fried polenta was forgettable.   The waitress was indifferent and didn't grasp the opportunity to provide excellent service. The waitress never refilled the water glasses even though she walked by many times during the meal. I had an outstanding meal the night before at Church and Main (recommended by the same person)  I guess one out of two isn't bad. When you pay upscale prices you expect an upscale experience. L'Amante missed by a mile.

Cute place but food wasn't that good. I got to greek goddess. Coffee was watered down as well and it's pricey here. Only reason I give it two stars is because the place is nice. Not too many cafés in the area but I will not be returning because food is not worth it. Next!
Great food, lovely place.
Love this place. Had my mom's b day there and they were fantastic. Everyone there wanted to come back for another party
My number 1 go to place when having a group dinner in NYC. Salads, pastas and calamari (my fav) are the best!

I love Rosario's they have super fast delivery---most of the time they are faster than the grub hub estimated time. They have fantastic chicken or steak nachos, quesadilla's and even great salads. Not a fan of the pizza but hey its not an Italian pizzeria. I wouldn't suggest eating in---theres a line of tables but there isn't much space in the restaurant. The tables with the most room are right by the bathroom. Pick up or delivery are the best options. There is a TV but its mostly for the workers.

So my sister and I got a large Margherita pie, and the pizza was just okay. Nothing phenomenal. I particularly had an issue with the sauce - it could use a little more flavor. No doubt that the food tasted fresh and the crust was thin and crispy, but I guess I was expecting a lot more. I'd prefer the Prince St. Pizza over this.

Not as good as its sister restaurant Feng in Canton, but still very yummy! I was a little disappointed when we realized they didn't have Hibashi tables, which was probably mentionned somewhere...Went for my in-laws anniversary and they knew that so as a surprise they served them a fried ice cream dessert! I didn't even ask for it, just mentionned the occasion. The waiter was excellent! Very attentive to everything we asked for. We'll go again soon.
I placed an order for delivery and it took 2 hours for me to receive my food.  The sushi had a bad smell and I didn't eat it for fear that I would get sick.  I will not order from them in the future.

Horrible place! Don't even try ! The food taste fine but the inconsistent size of sashimi and sushi  just killed my appetite. I went to this place twice this weekend, the first night I ordered a sashimi appetizer, I payed 11 bucks for 7 pieces of coin size sashimi. And my friend ordered Sake Don, she got nine huge pieces of salmon sashimi and rice for 16 bucks. The ridiculous waitress added 18% tips on our bill and we only had four people, and she was extremely impolite! The second visit with my another group of friends, I ordered Sake Don, and it's a lot smaller size and less pieces of Sashimi than my friend had. Prior to this weekend, the old waitress would even ask us to pay the bill before the food was served. Despite so many problem with this place, I still went so many times because of convenient location, but this is it!!! I'm done with Asiana House!

We've discovered our new favorite stop for lunch and brunch!  Burgers are superb, and the gyros tasty-perfect.  We're fans of diner food, and this is the area's best, bar none.  It's a little out of the way - read "middle of nowhere" - but it's worth the drive from just about anywhere.  Prices are very affordable, and the service is neighborhood-friendly.

My husband and I really love this new addition to the neighborhood. They have a great wine selection and delightful staff who are always friendly and welcoming. One of our favorite spots to hang out in Carroll Gardens - can't wait to explore their menu (and practice my french)!

Gramercy Tavern is a contemporary American cuisine restaurant with highly recommend offers special seasonal and tasting menu in Flatiron District. The location was Gramercy Farm that produced butter and cheese originally.

We love love love this place and are so happy it's in the neighborhood! The sushi is fresh and well priced. We've tried several different starters every time we've visited and they are always a hit, and about half of the rolls, all great. The service is fast and everyone is super sweet. And of course, it's BYOB!
Friendly, clean. Offer coupons, pizza is juicy and made how you like it. We have ordered from them for years and they always please us. Sandwiches are very good. Love this place!!!

First time in last night, staff was super friendly and seemed to wait on us as a team. Pretty cool. We just had drinks but menu looked great, not your typical bar food. Beer list changes frequently with really nice options. Can't wait to go back and eat

Exceptionally nice staff. Amazing food. The brunch was delicious. BBQ ribs and cheese grits. Holy crap. The pizzas are great too, as are the desserts (get the dessert empanadas - flavor explosion). Price is very reasonable as well given the quality of the food, the excellent service and beautiful setting. They even gave us a little chicken shaped timer with our French press coffee. How can you lose? Great work AWOL, we shall be returning.

After some hesitation with reading some of the recent negative posts we decided to give this a try.  My husband traveled at least 5 years ago to the area and loved this place.  We stopped for lunch today and the service and food were both great!  Gary was our waiter and he was prompt and courteous!  We chose to have an Italian club sandwich and the grilled alfredo.  Very good.  I also chose the vegetable chowder which was new to me but very good as well.  All in all a great choice.

Just got home from a disappointing dinner - Food was fine, but many mistakes for an $80+ (each) dinner, including a bowl of sugar instead of salt with the bread, room temperature rose, and and a bus boy with meal-ruining BO.

So I've heard a lot of hype about this restaurant, but it was a pretty unimpressive experience for me. The soup dumplings were great, but the two other dishes my friend and I ordered were nothing special at all. One of the dishes we ended up barely touching, and neither of us were interested in bringing it home and eating later. I've had better Chinese food in plenty of other places. Also, the service was really mediocre. I never got the glass of water I asked for at the beginning, and I felt like the waiters were giving us attitude. I would give one star, but the soup dumplings were good, so two-stars.

Yum yum! I'm originally from NC and have been searching near and far for good Mexican food and have finally found it right here in MY neighborhood!! This place is delicious and super fresh. I ordered chips and salsa, which were both made fresh in house and super tasty. I also had the verde chicken enchiladas and they were amazing delicious!! I ate there yest and am going back again today for lunch! Def try this place out, I hope it stays around!
Food is decent, but over priced. Staff is rude & if you want delivery be prepared to wait 2 hrs.

Probably one of the most overhyped restaurants in Brooklyn. Been here three times (thinking I missed something the previous visit) but their Sicilian slices are not impressive. Have had better. This place also tends to attract a lot of loud, knuckle-dragging idiots.

Yum, yum, yummy! Delicious! The food was really good. I come from a west indian family, and my dad is an amazing cook, so my pallet is definitely spoiled. I must say the food here is great! A wonderful place to take your girlfriends, or a special somebody. The only con was my waiter (Nick) was stressed, so he was less than pleasant, but not so grumpy that it ruined my visit. I will go back very soon :) Oh yea, I did ask him for a side of the lemon potatoes when my dinner came out, because the side dish we ordered for the table was smaller than I expected, and he said "No". When he should have said, "Yes, but it will take a while to come out". Hopefully I will get someone who can actually handle stress gracefully.... or whatever his issue was... In my opinion, it doesn't matter what kind of white people they are, they still hold a chip on their shoulders about blacks. They need to get use to us, and enlighten themselves, so pathetic.

Food is awesome, drinks as well - and made with care! Staff is helpful and friendly. It's exactly what olde city has been in need of recently, and I haven't been disappointed any of the times I've been there. Looking forward to the future menu additions!

The chicken kabob platter is really great here, and reasonably priced.  But don't order delivery from here.  My roommates and I have ordered from here many times and a lot of times they forget to include part of the order.  This time I called to let them know part of the order was missing.  They said they'd send the missing part and I waited half an hour, without a delivery person showing up.  I called the restaurant again and the manager argued with me and said I was lying, when clearly, part of the order, which I had already paid for, was not included. I finally got the rest of the order after waiting 45 minutes after my first call.  The food here is great, so I wish I could give a great review, so go in person- don't bother with delivery- it's not worth the hassle.

This is my fourth time at this place and the service/food has always been the same. Spectacular! The servers are always very friendly and helpful. The ambience is so down to earth and homey! The huevos rancheros is the way to go for the Sunday breakfast menu!!! The corned beef hash is amazing too and so is the Italian omelette! This is my fav breakfast spot! Waayyyyy better than Ihop or Denny's!

Soul Good!!! Collard greens, cornbread, mac & cheese, fried chicken, just amazing!!! I understand why this place has been around for 10 plus years! Great food, good service, and causal atmosphere. Wait, and the music!  The music made the experience just a little more comforting and enjoyable!

The best sports bar in Burlington hands down. Their wings are unbeatable and the service is unmatched. The owner is a good man and the entire staff is professional and experienced as possible. Especially Liz, she's a boss. Ally too!
Great family place. We really enjoyed the country atmosphere. House made sodas, housed made sausage, , jam and juice. Food was very good and pretty sizeable portions. Our waitress was awesome.

I think these bagels have potential to be good if they are actually warm when you get them. Got a bagel "fresh out of the oven"--tastes like it came fresh out of the fridge. Cold and a little chewy. Maybe ask to have it toasted in addition if you are looking for a warm bagel.
The absolute worst service ever. Ordered online (only one roll)got to the place and the food wasn't ready for 30 min. So overall waited for one roll be made for 1 hr
The space was tight but the food was excellent.

Even though my expectations are not that high to begin with when eating food as a Fridays, you would expect they could handle appetizers in a satisfactory manner.  Not a chance at this Fridays - what a scam the $10 Endless Apps deal is.   Friday's adds Ahi Tuna Crisps to this deal's offering but when you reorder them, it takes 25 minutes to get another order of 3, yes quantity of 3 crisps.  If you feel like waiting 75 minutes to eat a decent serving of this app that can be made in 5 minutes, by all means stop by this Friday's.   Let's not forget the other new item on the Endless App Menu, the Spicy Chicken Tostadas.  Sounds good, you expect chicken and cheese on a large Tostada but think again.  These chips are small and came with a minuscule amount of cheese and a microscopic amount of chicken, of the quantity of 4, 2 were void of chicken entirely and the other two had about 1/2 teaspoon of chopped chicken each.  You are basically eating chips with guac on them.  These too, took 25 minutes for each reorder to be delivered, another app that does not even require cooking. If a 1/2 star rating was available, I would chosen it at the rating for this experience.

,,let me say that the sushi was  ok,,,,,,,,,now for the bad news,,,we have gone to this place since 1994,,,,and hadn't been there in a  while and decided to go back,,  I always would get poached salmon with ginger and scallions ......so Sat nite  10/4/14,,,I ordered it..and received some concoction in a brown gravy,,,not poached,,,totally unrecognizable,,,so,,,I stuck with it  and suffered with it,,,,,,the owner manager comes over with some story that someone ordered this and now the chef thinks everyone wants this dish cooked this way,,,so,,she says I'll get you another one free of charge,,    2nd time,,,,,tough ...in some kind of oil,,I couldn't find the ginger,,,,the original chef is gone...the ginger ice cream  was literally  like dough,,,,I've never seen stringy  ice cream,,,a  first,,,,,we get our bill...surprise!!      we were charged for both horrific salmon  dishes...Needless to say,,,we won't be going back,,,,the place was empty ,,on a Saturday nite at 6PM,,,,this place was always packed,,,think its the  new chef???

Consistently good food.  Great margaritas. It is a truly Mexican party like experience. ALWAYS crowded, and usually an hour or more wait.   We did have a rude manager once, that threatened to give up our table because we were missing one person (had 12 and we asked for 13)  and it wasn't the fact that he was going to give it up, it's how rude he was and unprofessional. Definitely shouldn't be a manager. Other than that the only reason it didn't get 5 stars is for the constant wait time any day of the week.

I think Sanford restaurant it is a 5 star place. What can i tell about them. From the moment you come in ill you leave you just have an amazing experience. I agree with Amy it should be renamed "I love this place" The food it is delicious and the people there are very friendly and nice. I have a lot of dishes which i like from this place that why  i will leave it up to you to choose your favorite. Give this place a try i guaranty you wont get disappointed. ciao

This is Vietnamese food for people who aren't Vietnamese/like authentic Viet food.  I tried Banh Mi, Pho, and Cha Gio.   The Cha Gio (fried spring roll) didn't even come with fish sauce.  It came with a tangy soy sauce.  The lettuce, which you usually wrap the roll with looked like decoration on the plate, not like usable lettuce. The bread on the sandwich was extremely hard but not in the good way.  I don't know where they get their bread, but it's not great.  The meat tasted like it was freshly made, but it was missing a ton of flavors.  There were no onions, no peppers, and the buttery mayo that usually goes on banh mi was missing. The pho was all right. Everything was quite pricey, most likely due to location.  $8 for pho. $8 for banh mi. Also, Saigon Shack is CASH ONLY.

Always had great service and the food is great. Happy hour is good considering the area. Bartenders are always so friendly and they know how to make a real drink. They also gave me comp vip tickets to the comedy show although I never got to make it to the show. I really enjoy this place even when its packed. Its especially the best when not packed though since it is rather narrow.
I went to the one In the east village. I also went to the one on the Hudson. Both days I was very satisfied !! Please do not leave this restaurant without trying the baked bean. The sweet potatoes.

Went to Sunday brunch, lovely, intimate bistro. Beautiful decor. All five meals in our party were wonderful . Excellent wine list. Would have been nice to have a bread basket. Also service started great but absent at the the end of our meal and did not offer coffee or dessert. Prices were very reasonable especially for downtown Burlington. Can't wait to go back for dinner!!!!
GOOD dumplings

This place is another Philly Gimmick. There food is fine and service is ok, but over priced in IMO for this average food. You can go to a chain like Five Guys or even McDonald's SOMETIMES and get a burger on the same level or better. I liked there onion rings, but again, just what you would expect, nothing special. When I go tot Philly, there are places like Pat's Cheese steak that are amazing, PYT is just average and not worth the trip. I don't hate this place but I am very unimpressed and will not be returning.
The food was good but I wasn't happy with the service. It didn't seem to be that busy but it took a long time to flag down waiters' attention when we wanted to order or needed more water or the bill.

I give one star because of the waiting time, I came for brunch and decided to wait for a table because they said it would be 25 minutes wait. I waited and decided to check with the staff after 35 minutes of waiting, they said it would be another 15 minutes for a table, since we already waited for so long we decided to wait..20 minutes passed and they called us in, we got inside and they said that we our table wasn't ready...at this point my frustration was at its limit so I decided to leave. The food is really good and the staff was apologetic but I just wish they had a better understanding on how to manage the time and tell the customer how long they really have to wait. They also did not offer anything for our complete waste of time. We will not be coming back.
Amazing and authentic  tasting Mexican food. The drinks here are outstanding as well!!! Definitely recommended if you are looking for a reasonably priced meal out.
I love this restaurant literally am always going here and referring ppl to this spot. I absolutely love their food just hate the fact that its just cash only.

I was excited to have Dimitri back after Table 8 closed.  The menu and service was really lovely tonight.  We shared the dates appetizer and had hanger steak entree which was perfect and Black and white sesame crusted tuna..also perferct.  The fudge brownie flight to share really topped it off!             Welcome to Upper Montclair..we will be back many times!

My boyfriend and I head here semi-frequently when we're in the mood for a few beers and some awesome snacks (shishito peppers and wings are to die for!!) but tonight's experience really set itself apart from the usual good food and good service. Our server was Bryan and he was awesome, he was extremely polite and professional from beginning to end. He had great recommendations when a few things we wanted weren't available ( totally understandable for a sunday night) and was great about checking in on us and making sure we had what we needed. He even went out of his way to catch us on our way out to let us know about a discount we could use for our next visit. I have never once been disappointed in the food or service here but tonight was definitely above and beyond.
Delicious food, great staff, intimate ambiance.

+ Service polite, most speak English well +/- Ambience: relatively clean for C-town +/- Food Steamed Tiny Buns With Pork - 3.5/5 - steaming hot, skin a bit thick but tasty Salt and Pepper Squid - 3.5/5 - nice combo of sliced hot green peppers, scallions and golden fried bits of garlic - batter crunchy - squid was chewy and hard to eat--pieces need to be cut smaller Shanghai Rice Cakes w/ mixed seafood - 1/ 5 -avoid--limp, too much soy sauce stuck to the cakes, seafood tastes old (this is opposite of the above Fried squid)
Had one of our best gobi 65. Dosa was nice & crispy. Sambar & chutney could have been better.
Outrageous wine prices!
The employees are always really friendly and the have such good bubble tea and drunken chicken

Whenever I travel to a big city, I always make it a point to visit a ramen restaurant. I've been to ramen places all over the Bay Area, southern California, and Washington D.C. During my brief travel to New York, I visited this restaurant to see if it lived up to its hype. Reading other reviews, people rant and rave about this place like the food here cures cancer. The ramen is good, I'll give it that. The waiters were fast and attentive, I'll give them that. So why does this place get 3 out of 5 stars? Because the quantity of food is not worth the price they charge. For $17.95 I received a bowl of ramen with extra pork. The pork was chewy. It didn't melt on my tongue like I've experienced at other places. And there weren't enough noodles. I spent an extra $2 for more noodles in order to feel slightly full. I can't justify paying $20 for a bowl of ramen, when I spend only $12 for twice as much food that tastes just as good at other places. If you've got a tiny appetite, then this place might fill you up if you're just planning on eating ramen. If you're like me, who inhales food like a vacuum cleaner because of all the long distance running and obstacle course racing I do, then be prepared to spend extra money for more food, or eat somewhere else.

Came here early Saturday around opening to avoid lines. Pizza here isn't bad. The 4 of us ordered a large chicken pie and a small garlic, we all agreed the chicken wasn't seasoned And tasted Bland. It's decent pizza all around but for the price and EXTREME hype this location receives, it doesn't impress. I know of a few local pizzarias that are amazing and much more preferred. This isn't a place I'm visiting again.

Pat's or Gino's?  Pat's - hands down. Pat's has more cheesesteak options on the menu, better quality meat, and way better fries. Other than that, the setup for both the places is almost identical.  Counter service, outdoor seating, and the cheesesteaks show up moments after you order them.
Really enjoyed the Bolognese! Great ambiance and a very friendly staff.  We also thought the muscles were extremely good.   The price is fair and they offer generous portion. Enjoy!!!

what an amazing restaurant! last week was my first time going to rats and when i arrived i was amazed of how beautiful everything was from outside to inside. my hopes were already set high just from the look of the place but when i tried the food my hopes went through the roof... all i can say is wow. my huusband and i both indulged in the same entree ( filet mignon with cauliflower gratin on the side) and it was the  best i have ever had. overall an amxing expierience and will definetely be going back soon!
I just made my first and last visit, (take out), to John and Maria's.  It smells great driving by, but the pizza was short on cheese and sauce as well as flavor.  Essentially it was oily thin crust.
Went here with my roommates last week and had some of the best tacos in NYC by far! Serving sizes were huge and the staff was very friendly. Glad we stumbled on this place!

What a disappointment! One step above Olive Garden and I actually like Oljve Garden. Service was AWFUL! The calamari was rubbery... Yuck! The salad was served moments after the appetizer (shame shame) and when it was brought back, it was bland and boring. The pasta was undercooked, the breading on the bread shrimp fell off..ew, the veal piccata was tough and obviously low quality meat. There was no flavor. The waiter NEVER offered a beverage and seemed annoyed. We encouraged others to stay away. Don't worry, these Philly foodies won't be back!
Great food, fresh, clean, delicious! I am a big fan of the steak sandwich and the salmon. Everything I had there is really good! Highly recommend this place.

A great spot in the neighborhood, some of the best food around at affordable prices. The Burger is delicious, the Mac & Cheese is the best I ever had, the roasted chicken is incredible and now, with the new menu out, there are some special and original appetizers that are absolutely amazing! One of my favorite places in NY.
Love this neighborhood cafe! The food, service  and drinks are always great!
It's similar to Chipotle, but cheaper.. Food is fresh and staff is quite friendly

05-October-2014. I highly recommend Fogo de Chao in Philadelpia. The meats were excellent. I love rare. My husband and son prefer medium and some cuts well-done. Every cut of meat had just the right amount of seasoning. All were done to perfection! The staff are first rate, informed, and friendly. The salad bar was irresistable (vegetables, smoked fish, cheese) . I sampled the vegetables before adding any dressing, as some are already marinaded. New are the alternate sides (scalloped potatos, rice and beans, etc.). We did not try the seafood menu (new) although everthing looked and smelled wonderful. What I sincerely appreciate is that you (as the customer) set the pace for your dinner. Your seating is for several hours. Desserts, if you can enjoy any more food, are not to be missed. It is a great place to have corporate holiday or celebration parties. They also have private rooms available for family/corporate functions. Attire is casual to super fancy. The clientele are eclectic, polite, and all seem to enjoy themselves. I would recommend the restaurant in Baltimore as well.
Really cute place.  Great music, great ambiance.  Terrible service and even after we complained (which I never ever do) they still didn't try to do the right thing.

This half basement is very cozy and the price is very reasonable. Nevertheless, if you pay visit during the dinner time, especially on weekends, it should be expected the waiting time is longer yet acceptable. Recommend this place for a gathering of less than 4
Amazing staff, amazing food, beer keg taps ultra clean for flavor. Will be coming back.
Poor service.  They close the doors at least 30 mins before for accounting reasons. There were many customers returned.

I like the brisket and the mixed sauce, Great beef ribs, Great brisquet,Slaw and Links...spicy of course. Unfortunately, my stomach doesn't deal with spice like it used to but when I feel adventurous, those damn links are the best in town...what am I saying... this is the best BBQ in town. The ribs are succulant,the chicken is moist and tender and falls OFF the bone. Service is always good, and the food is wonderful.

The bread was a huge disappointment . The tomatoes were defrosted after being frozen and mushy. The meat was minimal. The staff, where not unkind, seemed less than intelligent. How do you not have salt or pepper? Avocado spread was flavorless. The pickle and chips were fine. Given these facts, how could this place use the tag line of "World's Greatest Gourmet Subs?" The owner of Jimmy John's must think Ellio's Pizza is also "gourmet." Just proves that people from Illinois like bad food.

I've only had their halal once and it was the best I've ever had. I've had a couple around Queens, but this one tops them all. I ordered the chicken over rice with white sauce and bbq sauce around $6-$7, without a drink. I liked that they had pita bread, it was soft and chewy and went well with everything. I've got to come here again sometime, I think about it all the time.

When I go to a meal with a group, for me it's the group hang that's more important than the food. That's a good thing, as the hang was the only redeeming factor in my experience at The Lebanon Diner. Don't ask for water - you won't get it. Had the biscuits & gravy & 2 eggs. Ordered my eggs "over medium." Everywhere else in the country that means the yolk will still be liquid but not runny, and the edges most likely slightly crisp. But apparently at The Lebanon Diner that should be "over well." I know this now because when I brought it to our server's attention, I was YELLED AT across a table - "The next time you need to order them OVER WELL." They did bring replacement eggs, and the yolks were fully cooked. Not the way I wanted them but I was with a group who had already gotten their food & I didn't want to delay things any longer. None of us were ever offered a coffee refill. The coffee, btw, - overcooked & burnt. But at least I had something to drink. The bill comes and I've been overcharged by $.50. I bring this to the server's attention that the menu price was $7.50 for B&G+2 eggs. She said no, this the correct price. I asked her to look at the menu. which proved her wrong. We did get a corrected bill, but only with a lot of attitude - eyes rolling, body language, and whispers to the other workers with glances toward me. The quality of the food would be enough for me to never go back. Add in the attitude of everyone who worked there & you've now got not only a "I'll never go back" but with an added recommendation into perpetuity to everyone else to stay away. If there was a "zero" stars I would have used that rating. And I never did get the water I asked for. ps. I joined Yelp specifically to post this review.

Came here for brunch and  was pleased to find a place that had a good vibe and a menu that showed creativity beyond the usual fare found at most places. What was nice is that the dishes werent creative just for the sake of being different they really showed culinary skills and thought behind them. A small but comfortable place and friendly servers. Service is on the relaxed side so if you're in a rush you wont be happy but if you want a nice leisurely conversation and meal this is the place. Coffee is good and strong and they also serve a variety of health juices. Prices are very reasonable for the quality of food,which is primarily organic, farm to table and clearly identified as to source. I had the  truffle egg bread and it was delicious, my friend had the scrambled egg with salumi, equally tasty.  Plan to return soon to try their dinner offerings.

DiNics is Da Sh*t !!!!! I saw this place in Reading Terminal and knew I would like it before I even tasted the food. My thought was "HOW IN THE WORLD DID I GROW UP IN PHILADELPHIA AND NOT KNOW ABOUT THIS PLACE!" Shame on me! So I was in town, going on a food tour and heard about it. Went there the next day and took it all in. Cooked meats with a line of people ready to order. The prices were very reasonable and what folks eating at the counter looked great. There was a wait for things that was greatly alleviated by the server who took our orders before we got to the register. By the time I paid, my pork & broccoli rabe sandwich was ready. It was delicious ! I should have had it wilh BBQ sauce but that was OK. It was that good! I'm a fan! I'll be back for sure ! If you read this, you need to go too !
Great new UES spot. Service is great and food is delicious!  We've been there for both dinner and brunch- don't miss the empanadas and pappardelle.

From food to drinks to staff it's all top notch!! My Favorite bartender is Luis, the flavors he blends to make it the perfect cocktail.. The end result is nothing short than amazing! Food is very tasty and delicious. I can't wait  to go back!

This place will change your opinion of brussel sprouts!! In a good way!! Other highlight included the Duck Shawarma. Amazing. There's a good buzzy ambience in the main dining area downstairs but it looked like mostly larger groups and we ended up on the mezzanine - quiet, nice enough simple decor and good service but you don't get the full experience unfortunately.
Horrible bar service both times we have been here. Rarely recognized by the bartenders and staff and when we were, they were extremely rude. Food was not worth the attitudes.
Want good beer and pub fare? Go to this place. I've never had a bad brew and the food is always delicious. If you like nachos, get the "Nachos Grande" and a Burly Irish Red Ale. You can't go wrong.

We went for the first time this past Sat evening to the Rodizio side of the restaurant,  service was excellent , very detailed oriented.  The Rodizio was really good but we ate so fast that we could not taste all the meats , considering  the appetizer we order plus the great pasta dishes that came along with the meal. The owner of the restaurant was very nice he introduce himself to make sure everything was okay with us and if the food was upto stardard , he was so concern he wave the sangria off our bill.  He is truly a class act and I appreciate how he conducts business.. Will return but eat definitely slower next time ;)..

What a new gem!! The drinks are perfect, the ambience is perfect, and the staff is friendly and helpful. I had dinner once and the burger and fried chicken were really good. It's a really cute date spot, or fun place to grab drinks or dinner with a friend. Great place to hang out!

.. I wanted to love this place... I stopped by for brunch as i found it while roaming. I was excited for the omelette of the day but did not receive it. The staff was friendly, the tea was good. The omelette was just not tasty. Not sure if it was lack of technique of cooking or lack of seasoning but the spinach tasted really bad. Food: 2/5 Service: 4/5 Location; 4/5 - Super cure place. Nice and chill

I came here on Friday night with a party of six people.  The hostess was very friendly and sat us when a third person arrived.  The waitress did take a long time to get to the table.  I was starving and wanted appetizers so I was a bit annoyed.  I should not have to ask if you are our waitress in order to have you come to the table and finally acknowledge our presence.  Anyways, she ended up being okay, this girl that looked like the lead of "Dirty Dancing," but that first impression really irritated me because I was hangry and I am a little bit of a b-tch.  I ordered zucchini cakes that came with a dill sauce as well as the brussel sprouts.  The zucchini cakes were kind of flimsy and unimpressive but the dill sauce was very good.  Score with the roasted brussel sprouts however!  I could not get enough!  I probably was not a good share-r with this plate...  Later we all were sat and ordered a bunch of items off the menu- lobster mac and cheese, Chilean sea bass (me- no sharing!) ahi tuna, salad with chicken, two quesadillas and some other items.  The Chilean sea bass was okay.  It was weird because the sweet potato it came with was white and I was not sure it was sweet potato even though the food runner insisted to me it was.  I have had better lobster mac and cheese.  I think the other issue is the lobster was very pink and cooked- um over-cooked, and the pasta was orzo.  Why not just tell me it is orzo?  I tried the tuna with chips and that was excellent.  At this point I was full and did not try the other items except for a baby dessert.  I love tapas and dessert tapas is even better!  I tried the warm chocolate "liquid" cake with salted caramel pretzel ice cream based off my server's recommendation.  Can't complain for $5.  It was okay.  Overall I do think the service could have been a tad better, and had I known what items here were popular before I arrived I could have had a better meal overall rather then have ordered a few duds.

Would have never picked it on my own, not being a fan of precious food in small portions, but I have to admit that I just had a great lunch.  Lots of unexpected and sublime taste combinations in a tranquil and pretty space.  Three courses for $35.  What's not to like?
We ate dinner here on a Sunday night. The food was unusual and delicious. The atmosphere was very comfortable and attractive. The service was outstanding.

Cute little hole in the wall. Food n prices were good, service was good but we were a little lost being it was our first time there. We didn't know that u seat yourself or had to get up n ask for the bill at the counter n realized they only took cash as we pulled up to the place. But all in all I'd go there again!

Took an hour to get our food. Then, barely edible nan curry pizza. Server was coughing, sweating and conveniently wiping on his hands... yes, the hands he was serving us with. Yuck!  Will never go back again.

Ordered sesame chicken here once and my ex and I got horrible food poisoning and almost wound up in the hospital! Called to complain and they pretended they didn't speak English/ hung up ha. Never ate there again.
The DJ on Friday nights rocks the house!  The crowd is mixed and casual trendy.  The drinks are inexpensive and the vibe is chill mode.  Good times!

The rendang wasn't horrible in flavor, but I was disappointed by its quantity/cost ratio. There was so little of the rendang itself that I thought I had ordered an appetizer at first. I won't be retuning.

Why did you replace the vegan cheese with Daiya? The homemade vegan cheese sauce is what made this place special. Fine to offer soy free cheese option but dumb to get rid of the original sauce which is what made the sandwich special for all these years.

Great stop for a quick breakfast or deli style lunches.  Wonderful soups.  Sandwiches are generous and made with good quality fillings - some unusual combinations, but all very tasty! Service is the friendliest in town!

Cheese Grill (which is the new official name) is the perfect addition to the Lower East Side neighbourhood. Between the delicious food, great selection of local beers and wines, excellent prices, and (the best) staff, this new establishment deserves far more than 5 stars. I highly recommend the Crispy Goat sandwich. If you have a sweet tooth, the brioche with banana and mascarpone cheese is simply heavenly. You couldn't ask for a more attentive and friendly staff (shout out to Mike!), who are also very knowledgeable about wines. They truly make you feel very welcome and the ambiance has that community/homey feel. It also has a chill vibe (almost reminds me of some cool places in Santa Monica, CA), and on top of it they have a great music playlist! I live in the LES area and I know Cheese Grill is going to be my new watering hole. I'm craving the Crispy Goat right about now!
Hands down favorite place in Philly. Had the Ouovo Pizza, Gnocci, Beet salad and Bronzino. Food=10.. Drinks=10 Service =10. Go here. It won't disappoint.

Went here during restaurant week and was sorely disappointed, especially since I've heard such amazing things about them. I ordered their pumpkin tiramisu, and I think they made it with something spoiled because it was sour.

Friendly staff. Ok beef and chicken sandwiches. All the meat were shredded. No solid texture. Sweet potato fries were excellent. Turkey chili was just so so with lots of turkey meat and no beans but does not have that kick and it was not very tasty. Seems like they just throw in ground turkey in boiling water and serve it to you in a bowl just like that. Cole Slaw was very bad. All in all, food was ok but at an above average price. Good to have experienced it but not more than once.

I seem to be the only reviewer who didn't think this place was out of sight. I went when it first opened (and took out the fried shrimp and crab roll) and my husband went the other night and took out (fish tacos and shrimp quesadilla) - but both times I was disappointed. Plus, I had an upset stomach after both meals. Sorry - I'm not returning after these two strikes outs.

It is hard to find GREAT PIZZA outside of Brooklyn but Cafe Colore comes darn close. My friends had entrees which were good but  lacked luster.and the dining room looks run down. The pork Medallions were real good so was the salmon. I think they might have to large of a menu for a small kitchen, the food took a while to come out and didn't come out all at once.
Was going to eat here but the service was so bad I walked.  At least pretend to like your job!

Prices were OK, but the food and service was subpar. I ordered the egg and cheese sandwich on a Kaiser roll. The roll was so stale it was inedible and the cheese they used appeared to be Velveeta - - orange and gooey. The egg itself had a greenish cast to it. It was a long time before the waiter finally returned and asked if everything was OK. But that point, the rest of my party had already eaten, so I refused his offer of a new meal after I told him about the stale roll (I didn't mention the cheese or egg as I felt those were more personal preferences). Others at my table also noted the stale roll (two others also got the sandwich) on their sandwiches. He took $4 off the $60 bill as compensation. Also, they used canned mushrooms in the crepes -- gross. Not recommended.

not impressed by the new owner at all. menu is small, and the food is prepared ok. couldn't do crispy homefries? first time I've heard that. you can tell all the food comes out of the back of a Sysco truck. reminded me of the food in a hospital cafeteria.  they need to try a little harder!

This is arguably the best restaurant in NJ, counting service, food, presentation, setting, and every other aspect possible. The lobster, as well as all the shellfish tastes like they pulled it right out of the ocean and put it on the buffet table. There's a great variety of dishes that were rotated through the table and they were all not only extremely delicious, but also very creative and beautifully presented. Plus, I can't forget to mention the quality of the soups. After tasting their creme of mushroom and lobster bisque soups, it put every other soup I've ever even thought about eating to shame. It crushes all standards for soup and changes your entire perception of any dish involving a savory liquid substance. As for the dessert, I ate 7 creme brûlées and that was only the beginning. Nothing else needs to be said about this phenomenal restaurant, except for it's one fatal flaw. The Manor is so outrageously delicious that you actually will suffer from Post Manor Depression (PMD) upon leaving their beautiful Victorian mansion because it is at that moment that you realize you must re-enter the realm known as reality, where food is merely mediocre at best, especially when compared to the unmatchable standards of the Manor. Do yourself a favor and indulge in this heavenly buffet, but heave my warning and eat carefully my friends.

I've now been here multiple times, lunch time, late night time and snack time. This place definitely benefits from the lack of middle eastern options in the area. Food is passable, 2 stars. Price is cheap, bumps it up to 3 stars.  If it was located in the city or queens, much lower rating. #oldguysyelptoo

This place was great. Im from south florida where there is a lot of colombian places around but here in ct i havent been able to find a lot. La Fonda was delicious, the bandeja paisa and empanadas were very good and the service and atmosphere were wonderful. I would definitely recommend it.
Food's great! Servers are very knowledgable about food and I will definitely com back!

This place has an extensive and creative menu. However we  were disappointed that they were not helpful when we had a Groupon  coupon last night. Upon checking with Groupon today we were told that this coupon just needed to be scanned. While the food is good; it is not worth the 25 minute drive.

This place is ridiculously yummy. I went with 2 friends and all of us had their plantain crusted chicken. It could not have been any better. They have so many gluten free and vegan options for food and dessert and their waiters are always super nice and attentive.

I have been to Ray's Subs several times and never have they gotten my order right. Now, this isn't to say that they can't make a good sandwich, but I regularly have to return to the counter to request the staff to add an item they omitted from my sandwich. The quality of the sandwiches are also just ok, not terrible, but not stellar. Really, the service is the reason I would not recommend Ray's to a friend. When I order Turkey, Swiss, Tomato, Lettuce, and Mayo, I expect a sandwich with all of those items. Somehow, one or two never make it to my sandwich when I order at Ray's. There are plenty of sub shops in the area that have superior service to Ray's. I would recommend any other sub shop in the Ewing area before recommending Ray's.
I actually had no idea what a lychee was before this place, now I see them all around the city. Their lychee martini happy hour deal is amazing and the best/quickest way to get your night started!

I used to love this restaurant. My husband and I have been going for five years, almost every time we visit New York. Even though this restaurant was a bit touristy, it never really bothered us because the food and service was so good. This past time the tourists were overwhelming, the food mediocre, and it took way too long to order a drink at the bar. The food was just "meh" , and the wine list could have more variety. Way too crowded, prices too high, and the atmosphere has become boring and expected, sorry but won't visit again.

Their Ramen is amazing. I am a regular here for a very long time and I never get disappointed. Great service- nice looking waitresses, delicious food, very rich flavor soup broth. and the most important part- the price- is very reasonable. Just 1 Minos, sometimes its a long wait.
Leuke gezellige tent. Het gedeelte in de serre was niet bezet, dus vonden wij niet gezellig. Maar in het vaste gedeelte prima. Genoten van een heerlijke pizza en een Italiaans biertje. Aanradertje!!
Quinoa and raw mexican kale salads are great.  I get the raw mexi with no corn because corn is disgusting. Today there was two corn kernels in my salad which sucked real bad :(((((

I'm not gonna lie. I was a fan of the previous Mundo and was damn disappointed (like a lot of people) when it closed down over a year ago. Who couldn't help but love John & Willy, their eclecticly-tasty food, and the just as eclectic crowd they drew to their little place on 32nd Street & Broadway here in Astoria? For my wife & I, we had the distinct feeling that one gets when a dear friend moves many miles away. Sure you're happy that they're moving on to new things, but you selfishly feel like they should nonetheless stay and continue to serve you your favorite Red Sonja & Oregano seasoned french fries no matter how much they might need a break. And so, about a month ago, with some apprehension & much baited breath, my wife & I stepped through the lobby of the new Paper Factory Hotel and into the warmly familiar, but wholly new & revitalized Mundo. I was so happy and excited to see it. It is truly the next phase in what I think they've always dreamed Mundo could be. It's bigger, but still warm and inviting, and it contains all the Turkish-Argentine-World decor that I loved about their old spot. They even have a proper, well stocked bar now. But, most importantly, the food is as delicious and as fresh as ever. Not only have Willie & Jon lovingly poured their hearts into the look & feel of the space, but they've also reinvigorated the food. While Red sonja still has that savory je ne sai quoi, the empanadas, salads & the veggie wrap tasted as good as they've ever tasted. And at the bar, they had these addictive Pisco sours that I can tell are going to be the go-to cocktails for the new Mundo bar. Also, as I understand it, they're even going to have live music on the lower level of the space. Mundo could very well be a new hub for art, music & live performance in Astoria. I now live in LA and there is nothing like Mundo here. Hell, there's nothing like Mundo anywhere else in the world from what I've seen, a place that's part of the neighborhood, that's unique and inviting and otherworldly at the same time. And now that I'm in LA, I can't help but feel like I'm going to be missing out on seeing Mundo 2.0 continue to grow. I miss Mundo, Jon, Willie, & Pinar and would move them here if I could, but I'm heartened to know that they are back in Astoria, better than ever, and that even more people will get to discover their charms, their warmth, and the unique Mundo integrity they brought with them from the original Mundo space. Mundo Que Viva!

First off, I do NOT like vegetables! But, I heard this place would fool me into loving them. I LOVED the bar! BEAUTIFUL! Furthermore, I am quite a wine snob and won't drink most of the "by the glass" offerings offered at other restaurants but Charlie Was a Sinner had a lovely Barbara DiAsti. (don't get it with the artichokes, very bad combo) The food was very innovative and I didn't feel like I was eating vegetables but I also don't really find it something worth having again. I will probably return with vegan friends but never on my own.

Had dinner here with a friend and it was great! Service and food were on top! I felt the prices were fair too. Our waiter was very knowledgable about everything on the menu and about little customs or tidbits in regards to eating sushi. Wonderful experience and would happily go again. Thank you Momo Sushi Shack for a great meal.

This place is terrible. The waiter takes order very slow, is extremely rude and keep on yelling at customers. The food is also awfully bad and the plates look really greasy. It is the worst Chinese restaurant that I've tried so far.

Ordered take out Broccoli Rabe awful raw garlic these people obviously deliver to people that don't know any better Poor excuse for Italian style food Order The chicken parm if your on a diet it's so flavorless you won't waste your time Worst food
best Sicilian pizza in N.Y.

Stumbled across the place after the place we wanted to go to was closed. I had the seafood pot pie. It was not a proper pot pie (sauce was not cream and the "crust" was half a biscuit) and the seafood was tasteless and overcooked. It was edible, but barely.. I guess I really should have known better than to order seafood on a Monday. My friend had the short ribs, they were "adequate." but i did think it was odd that it was served with no sides whatsoever. I totally see why we were the only people actually eating there. The dill pickle bar snack  was, sadly, the best part of our meal. Don't bother.

Food & service excellent.  We really like the eclectic menu which includes interesting meat, fish and vegetarian entrees, not just the same old run of the mill preparations.   Friendly knowledgeable servers are happy to describe anything you are unfamiliar with and the descriptions are very accurate.  Everything was very fresh and well prepared.

We are always happy and full after a visit to Rosa's. The food is outstanding and the chef is very creative with seasonal specials. Even my picky kids love the bolognese sauce and appetizers.  Can't wait to go back!

This restaurant was well worth the drive to West Haven, CT.  It is as authentic as we could find in Turkish cuisine. The decor and ambiance are cozy with Turkish music in the background with traditional artwork, window drapes, carpets and wooden panels throughout.   We were immediately greeted by two friendly staff and directed to our table.  The service is exceptionally friendly and unhurried.  As you are walking through the dining room from the front counter, you see the various salads, baklava, desserts  and skewers of meat marinating in the display refrigerator. Right after sitting down; a piping crusty hot bread basket was brought alongside an olive oil and sundried tomato dipping plate;  the starter red lentil soup ($2.95) was amazing, the roast eggplant salad appetizer ($5) was equally heavenly.  The flavour of the fire roasted eggplant mingling with garlic, lemon, cilantro, peppers and spices had just the exact and right amount of lemon vinegar and olive oil to compliment the dish. Main course of the shish combo plate ($14.95) consisted of full breast chicken and beef steak cubes on skewers, served with tomato brown rice (yes, it was delicious and tasty brown rice!!!!!) and salad.  There were no leftovers whatsoever!!! After all this delicious food, we were very full but we couldn't resist having Turkish coffee and the rice pudding dessert.  OMG!  This was food porn at its best!!!  The rice pudding ($4) was the best I have ever had, and I mean EVER.  It is served in a clay bowl which had been placed in a fire oven with milk.  Complete 4 course Dinner for two including taxes and tip was $68. This was a very memorable meal and one of the best Mediterranean experiences in Connecticut;  Now I need a big nap! #VeryYummy

My favorite spot in Harlem. Would be a 5 if they were better with managing call ins. I have to hang up and call back all the time because I was "forgotten" on hold. Still doesnt stop me from eating chicken and waffles once a week however.
The food and the service was awesome. I will definitely come here again. The fried chicken was my favorite.

Flew in in a Skyhawk yesterday and was surprised with the place. Really festive and jam packed with people watching us taxi in. Didn't get to eat as you have to have a reservation but I definitely want to come back. Great menu and really festive place

Well I have only one word: AMAZING! so I came here on Friday night, October 3, to have my birthday dinner with my family, and we had such a wonderful experience, with the food tasting delicious and the attentive staff, our waitress was wonderful, that we came back on the following sunday for BLUNCH. Our experience during the BLUNCH was even more exceptional. Our waitress MIchelle was a sweatheart, and we were even granted a free round of Mimosas because of the wait for the food. For dinner we orderd the pernil, churrasco and pollo a la plancha, it was all delicious. For Blunch we ordered the burger with egg and guacomole, the churrasco and the mofongo with shrimp, again it was all good. The drinks were perfection. The frozen sangria is becoming my favorite drink. It's sweet enough that you dont taste the alcohol, but strong enough to get the job done, and when you check in using Yelp, you get a free one! Absolutely love this place, from the wonderful location, to the exquisite dishes, and the best service Ive received at a restaurant in a while, from the hostess to the waitress, extremely friendly and attentive to ensure that you truly enjoy your time there. I highly recommend it, whether it's a date night, a night out with friends, or for a special occasion. I'll be coming back soon for sure!

Ate here last Saturday and everything was absolutely perfect. The food was incredible as was the service. My boyfriend and I were a bit late for our reservation, about 20 minutes but the hostess, I think she said her name was Syeda (sp?), was so understanding, so sweet! And that lobster mac and cheese was the best I've ever had. Was a bit of a trek from Harlem but, honestly I'd rather go here than the bougie places in Manhattan.

Don't be put off by the conflicting decoration and walk in. The weird but, frequent, mix of sleek and simple design with touches of caribbean and latin creates an eerie atmosphere at first, but this strangeness wears off as soon as the food arrives. The menu offers better value than most hispanic-oriented restaurants in the neighborhood by offering an unusually high quality at mid-to-low range prices. We ordered two entrees that excelled in presentation, preparation and flavor; both were traditional cuban dishes with dashes of fusion cuisine that made the experience more fun. The appetizer empanadas were delicious; among the best I had in NY. I'll become a regular!

As a family, we go to Okemo 2-3 times each year.  On the way home to I91 on 103.  After our first trip there, we have never gone to VT without visiting MacLaomainn's at least once per trip.  Last year we went there on the way home when we weren't even hungry.  We went there this afternoon with ravenous appetites and ordered way too much food.  As always, everything was amazing!  The only negative was that we had to wait a few minutes for a table; however, it's president's weekend and everything up there is busy.

This place does NOT deserve 4 stars. The smoked salmon was old and tasted horrible, the English muffins on the eggs florentine were soggy and the omelette was greasy. The website made this restaurant seem upscale but it was cramped and shabby. There was one small toilet next to the kitchen. I trusted Yelp and wanted to bring my friend to a beautiful French restaurant for brunch. She was disgusted by it instead. Under no circumstances does this place rate 4 stars.

Not the same. Went to Sally's this past weekend. While waiting in the typical LONG line, my husband and I were talking about how good it was last time we were here for my birthday and how we would come back again in January for my birthday. Until........ We were seated at one of the small tables that's o.k.; just 2 of us. We always order at least 2 pizzas - b/c we love(d) them. First bite - I could tell, pizza wasn't the same. Wasn't as good as the last time we were here. FOUR...yes...FOUR NEW guys running around like maniacs, busing tables, yelling for checks, checking the line, and trying to make small talk while they were running by tables with various patrons. One of them actually brought our large pizza pan to our table and shoved it on my small pizza that I was trying to eat. He told me it was to make room! No apologies, just shoved the pan onto my pizza! Another one of these guys (who looked like an investor - long sleeve button up shirt and everything) came running in from the outside and just started clearing tables! It was absolutely crazy! No way I could enjoy my meal with these four guys running around, trying to move people out like cattle, to get more people in. It made me panicky. The 2 old owners were there and were the nicest part of the whole thing. One of them took our order, then sat down the rest of the time writing up checks. NOW...ABOUT THE LADIES ROOM! - Hasn't been updated since the 1980s!!!! The tile around the toilet had all come apart and the toilet was leaking water! I almost slipped and fell. IT WAS FILTHY!!! Hadn't been cleaned in who knows how long. I had to go into the kitchen and ask for toilet paper, which they keep in a box near the dough???? So gross. You would think with all the $$ they make, they could clean it up a bit? While the Schmoozers were making small talk with various patrons, we sat and waited for boxes....and our check.......and a quick exit. No refills on soda, had to go up to the kitchen and ask for it ourselves. Amidst shouts across the room "how many people out dere?" lol! Get 'em in - move 'em out. I had read Sally's was recently sold to new owners. Sure looks this way to me. We lived on Wooster St. for many years and my husband was a regular here since the early 1980s. It's not like we don't know what we're talking about. Nope - change is in the air here, and it's not good. We won't be going back for my birthday dinner, or probably for anything else. Pepe's has always been good. There are other choices. It's not like people who know won't catch on. Just a matter of time. BTW, when we left Sally's there was no longer a line. Down the street at Pepe's there was still a long line. Hmmmmm..........

Ordered takeout from here with a date. The kale gnocchi and hazelnut panna cotta were perfection. Didn't like the liver pate at all though - it tasted too gamey and possibly old (we threw this out). I'd like to visit the actual restaurant though to try more of their pasta dishes.

excellent place to get a slice. Lots of interesting pizza choices. Quick and pleasant service. Price is typical for the area for pizza, and is good for a fast easy lunch. Had 8 pizzas delivered for a catered event. they were hot a d good.

I am relatively new to the neighborhood in Astoria and a friend asked me if I had been to Cafe Triskell.  I have now been there  four times...in the last ten days; three times for dinner and once for brunch.  It's THAT good.  I have had the Angus Steak Frites, the escargo, French Onion Soup, a Risotto special (which was only there one of the nights), a Duck Terrine Mousse and something called a Bisteya, which I've never had anywhere else before.  It was incredible.  The food is top rate.  The restaurant itself is so unassuming and rustic feeling yet the food is like a 5 star French restaurant.  Completely authentic, but  not at all expensive or pretentious.   For brunch, I had a French Toast that was the best French toast I had ever had bar none.  My friend had a Croque Madame and we shared.  She was blown away and is now obsessed with the place.  The brunch was crowded and there was a line outside that started right after we got there but I think that's just an indication of how good the food is.  The staff seems to move quickly to get everyone seated and served.   I saw some people get a little frustrated with the wait but, like any good restaurant in NYC ( or anywhere for that matter) , if you get there during a rush, you just have to wait.  On Saturday, I took a date there and made a reservation first.  That was a good idea.  The food and service were excellent.  As I looked around, I saw a number of the same people dining in the restaurant; a lot of regular customers. The owner/chef and my waitress noticed that I was a return customer and gave my date and I a special dessert crepe that was beautifully presented and not on the menu as well as some complimentary champagne.  They know how to treat people.  We had a gourmet, three course, French meal in New York City that ran me less that $80.  I feel like I'm getting away with something when I eat there. I plan on having my birthday celebration at Triskell and bringing a lot of people there.  Just one more reason to love Astoria.

I think you are better off just ordering delivery from this place, if you are in the mood for mediocrity. The owner is also the cook/busboy/waiter/etc. and you can feel the lack of customer service this creates. If you just get delivery then you wait and get your food, no harm done. But once there, it gets irritating when he has to stop to cook or answer calls or forgets things because he's preoccupied more often than not. Also, the food here is, as mentioned, mediocre at best. They make good, but not great, chicken dishes. Anything with chicken is OK, has a high turnover so it's fine. I'd say chicken and broccoli is my "favorite". I would avoid the sushi at all costs. It doesn't seem as though the order rate on it is too high so I wouldn't risk it.
Food was great but not as amazing as we expected. We like the skirt steak a lot. The staffs are very friendly and restaurant atmosphere is great.

My wife and I went to this place right after lunch hours. We decided on eating here due to the good reviews we read on yelp. The restaurant was clean and the decor fit the style of food. First of all, we were the only people in the place. We were asked by the cashier in the front if we were eating in or taking out. We replied that we were eating in. We were then told we could sit down. We took our menu and started making our decisions. Never did anyone actually come to our table to ask if we were ready to order, wanted anything to drink or if we had any questions about the menu. After waiting for a good 10 minutes, I decided to just go up and order at the cashier. We ordered a chicken doner, gyro shawarma pita ($6.75) and a lamb shish kebab small ($11.00). The food came fairly quick, but wasn't too warm. The flavors weren't bad, but the sauces were what actually gave the food the flavor. The lamb was also pretty tough. We also checked in here for the free dessert. The choices were almond, rice or brown pudding or 2 pieces of baklava (the menu says 4 pieces, I was told we would only get 2). We chose the almond pudding, which was actually pretty good. The dessert was the best part of the meal. A big annoyance throughout our meal was the manager or owner who kept his cell phone on speaker the entire time right next to our table will being on hold so we got the great sounds of crappy elevator type music while we ate. In conclusion, the food was okay, the restaurant looked nice, but I would most likely never go here again as there are definitely better options in NYC.
Great atmosphere, service & rice balls
Philly cheese steaks to die for! What a pleasant surprise. I have traveled from Manhattan on the subway  twice now ( and its a pain in the butt ) just to get the sandwich!

My friends n me went there yesterday evening. This place is so gorgeous in black&white theme. I love the rectangle chandelier. And I really love the food decor. They were terrific!!!   We had Porpia Tod, Kanom Jeep, Geoy Hor Cheese and Shrimp Fishcake for appetizers.   Then we had Crabmeat Fried Rice, Shrimp Green Curry, Platoad Yum Mamong, Suki Talay and Padped moo pha. They were so delicious!!!   I can say I Love the fish one "Platoad Yum Mamong" which is healthy n yummy food I've ever had!!!
Pretty tasty Mexican food. I get the Enchiladas Del Mae every time and so does my wife.

We choose this restaurant because it was given 4 stars on this app. The food was disappointing. The beet salad had to be sent back because it had no beets. The shrimps were chewy. The coffee was bitter. The service was friendly but that's the only good thing I can say.
Salmon Tartare and the Beet salad. Both were delicious. We ate at many restaurants but the food here was one of the most enjoyable and the least expensive!

What a delicious find! The meat fell off the bone on the chicken and ribs that I had. The potato salad was great! Corn bread was a little dry. The peanut chocolate pie was as good as dessert as a peanut butter-holic like me could want! When I am in the Treetop area again I will definitely be back.
A effin mazing dumplings. 4 for a buck?! This place was great. A Yelp search led us there. We will surely be back.
Amazing Food, Friendly service, great price. Fuel will be a regular lunch place for me now.

This place was so cramped and the decoration was sub par. I could hardly enjoy the food because we were placed in the back where the door was slightly ajar, letting in a cold breeze. I would not come back.

Why of course I had to check out this place when I'm in NYC. After all, 6000ish review... We ordered: - Hirata Chicken Wings = crispy with glazed pepper sauce. Typical. - Hirata Buns = I'm all about pork buns. Yummio! Get it. - Akamaru Modern = well-balanced broth, too bad I'm not fond of the thin noodles. - Shiromaru Hakata Classic = simple classic bowl of ramen. Delicious broth that is not overly salty. Great ambiance, great service, and great comfort food. I hope you give this place a try. Cheers!
Very bad experience.  Ordered chicken dish. Dish was dry.  Manager said that's how it would come again if they re ordered and walked away.  Left hungry. Shane.  Staff and hors d'oeuvres were good.
Great burger. Great staff. Nice selection at the bar. Really like this place!
Exactly as perfect as you would hope it to be.
BEST brisket I have had in a long time...Hardly any fat--just enuf for flavor....It was like beef pastrami..YUMMMMY!!!!!  much better than john mull's in vegas! yummy cornbread and honey butter!
Once my all time favorite places for a fast delicious economical meal.
Good diner great food service is fast and friendly food always comes out nice and hot it's just a little bit pricey for me but overall good diner
Wings are drier than sand and very pricey place is dirty in appearance and the staff is very unfriendly

Pizza was very solid. Definitely better than what Caladra's became their last few months.  Ordered veal parm, and they gave me about 1/2 pound of pasta along with it. It was very good. Wife got a grilled chicken salad, and was a huge portion Look forward to trying other things on the menu. Oh, and the Nutella pizza is awesome!

Terrible experience here very rude bitchy servers don't recommend this place to No One !!!!!!! Got sat down no menus were given to us no silverware nothing nothing terrible service from beginning to finish was very poor ......1 star for good pizza customer service should be a priority !!!
Great food, ambience and customer service. I highly recommend.

Not always in the mood for Indian fare, but we had a great experience at Tashan some months back with a multi-course meal deal through living social, so we decided it was time to pay Tashan another visit.. We were seated and attended to quickly.  Brian and Francis were our servers and did a wonderful job helping us navigate the menu.  The Gobi Manchurian was a favorite and we also enjoyed a Spinach Salad while we enjoyed the ambiance. I don't generally order scallops unless I know they are good, but Francis convinced the other half of the party with a glowing recommendation, and we were certainly glad he did. We had intended to go home and eat some fresh baked pumpkin pie, but were too full even after the sub ride back.  Thanks Tashan!

Small little restaurant with Amazing food!! Really blew my taste buds away. I came here a few times with my boyfriend, everything I've order is delicious. The duck is the best dish of all, definitely a must try :) This is not a fancy place to go to, it's a nice weekday spot to stop in for food, even dinner on weekdays are a house full at Mie Thai!! The kitchen does close at 9, so that's the only downfall....having the waiters rush your order to get it in before. Beside that, MIE THAI is a great place if your in the mood for some great Thai food without the fancy expensice prices.

Very much enjoyed the trip, I went there after work with a colleague. The waiter Cory was excellent, very attentive and helpful! I had the Skate special which was likewise excellent, cocktail drinks were also, well, excellent. Had nice selection of whisky also. Overall a great place to grab a bite to eat in a fairly upscale setting, I'm a fan!

Came here for a friends birthday on Saturday. The drinks and beers here are phenomenal to say the least. I had then cucumber basil gin drink which was amazing, I could drink those like water! The one down side is the place is kinda small so if you have a large group it's hard to coordinate but this is a great place for small groups. Will definitely be back!

Been going to this place since I was a kid until I left the town to live elsewhere. I just came back to town to visit my mother and went today. The food is just as good as I remember. I had the penne vodka slice like I used to when I was younger and it's still amazing. I also bought myself a chicken cutlet sub to bring home and that was also as delicious as I remember. Thanks guys and keep up the phenomenal work!

Went with my family for brunch and we ordered everything off the menu and it was all great! The avocado toast is great but it is only one slice of bread so even with a side of eggs it is not so filling but it still really good! The buttermilk pancakes were amazing!!! Fluffy and light and the apples of top really sealed the deal! Everything else was great, the restaurants vibe is awesome and I will definately be back!

Although the food was tasty - Although I specifically asked about the seafood ingredients in the meal the wait staff didn't mention the oyster sauce which was included in the recipe. My wife has an allergy to oysters and the omission of the ingredient caused hives and itching for the rest of the evening.
Great food

Wonderful meal. Great, friendly service. Every course was memorable, well plated and very tasty. A little noisy but not uncomfortably so. Went to a competitor (L'Amante) the next night and it was everything that Church and Main wasn't. The food was bland and forgettable, mediocre service and marginal atmosphere. Given the choice stay clear of L'Amante and choose Church and Main
I had the beast wrap, and it was one of the best wraps I have ever had. Their French fries also are the best I have had.
I tried the beef one and also duck one, about 6 to 7 dollars a bowl, you can add sides like eggs but additional cost, noodle is very fresh and good, one of the better hand pull noodle in Chinatown
Took my bunch of 11 for brunch.  Had a great time.  Food was very good and the service was excellent.  Ralph our waiter was great.

Wow, be careful what you ordered.  I asked for a glass of Chardonnay.  The bill?  $16.  Yes, I checked with the bar tender.  That's the cost for one glass of Chardonnay.  If you think you'd enjoy that glass.......

OMG!!!! I love Ruby's! This place is tiny and have only several tables.I brought my friends to here, and I never fail to satisfy my friends. You will have to wait on lunch or dinner time, but this place is so worth to wait. Get the Bronte burger or shrimp pasta.

Mamma Flora's is my favorite Italian restaurant in the Ewing area. It is my favorite restaurant to order pizza delivery from, and also my favorite restaurant to sit down for a dinner with friends or family. The pizza is Trenton-style with a thinner, crisper crust than a typical pizza. I have tried many different varieties of their pizza, including the Tomato Pie, Margarita, Greek-style, and, of course, Classic Cheese Pizza. I also am a big fan of their appetizers and dinner entrees. Their house-dressing for their salads is excellent. I also like their fried calamari. The entree portions are generous and delicious. I am a big fan of the pasta and seafood offerings. Linguini with clams in white wine sauce is one of my favorite dishes, and Mamma Flora's makes it expertly. It is a lovely family atmosphere, BYO (which is great!), and always has attentive and friendly service. I recommend Mamma Flora's to all my friends and family who visit the Ewing area.
Excellent dirty water dogs, friendly service and great price! Live this place eat there very often
