Being Cuban born and raised I have expectations of Cuban restaurants. This place was just exceptional, we were party of four, Sat night and had to wait 1hr to be seated, but it was worth every minute. Music is great as well as ambience, its BYOB like most places in NJ, the macitas de puerco for apetizers are delicious, full of flavor, juicy. Four different entrees: Churrasco (amazing, juicy, well cooked), ropa vieja, pargo all were delicious. I must say this place is legit Cuban food. Woods totally recommend it and will def be coming back, don't care the wait.
Better than Cullen. Fresh salmon and roasted veg made a perfect $10 lunch. I will be back.

The food and the service are excellent. But what you can't get many places is the ambience of their outdoor garden. It's at a prominent Passyunk corner, but not noisy and you don't feel like passersby are leaning over your shoulder. It's shady in the evening and on a summer night it's heaven.
The Ranchero is amazing. I think is better than Five Points.

I was recently visiting NY from DC when I asked a friend of mine who is a bit of foodie which restaurant he would recommend.  My requirements included great, honest food with a twist and he recommended The Gorbals.  Needless to say, he knows his food!  My friends and I were NOT disappointed.  The food was amazing, the staff was attentive, friendly, and very helpful.  The menu is highly creative (one might even say irreverent, which I loved) but the execution is nothing more than genius! Although everything was great (and we had a lot of dishes),our table's favorites were the Falafel-crusted sweet breads and the lamb ribs with crunchy raspberries but don't stop there.  You MUST try the sticky toffee pudding.  I'm not a big fan of bread pudding but this one will delight every sense of your palate (sweet, salty and spicy).  Good luck in guessing where the spice is coming from.  Highly recommended!
The best food and experience! It's a must...visited it twice during 11 days visit to NYC! Great taste, display, service, crowd, decoration!!! Highly recommended

Kate just catered a party for us in our home over the weekend.  The service was impeccable and the food was outstanding!   We chose Kate's because of how much we love her lunch spot in Verona and we were not disappointed. Our guests were gushing over the food (still are 3 days later) and we have sent all of our local friends and family over to Kate's Kreations.

Good fish tacos but the place is filthy. It was not even a busy hour while the napkins distracted me, as they raised from the ground when someone walked in, so ok, I said fine, one of the employees at the counter will pick them up....30 mins later the same distraction. Never forget to always keep a restaurant clean, specially one that sells food, that people eat while walking around.

Best burgers in Hillside!!! Surprisingly, there are many good places to eat in this township. IMO burger is one of them. My friend and me had no big expectations when we walked in for lunch, but were delighted with the quality of the food. Delicious, healthy and very unique. Excited to try something new next time!

Had a wonderful Saturday night out at this restaurant/bar. The food was great and the service was the best I've had in philly. The waitress and busboy we had went the extra mile for me, my boyfriend and sister repeatedly - they really made our night! I'm looking forward to going back!
The Post Office is a friendly place. The staff is always professional and the food is great. This is a great local spot for a burger and a beer, and it is also appropriate for children.
I came here for restaurant week with a friend and we both loved everything. I still have dreams about the tiramisu. Will definitely come back.

I am a little late posting this BUT! I would say I am coming here again!!! I had a great experience here. They deserve more stars. And I've read the other reviews... I think the other people need to come back. I've met the new lady that owns the Joint or the manager who seems to run the joint is Alex. Very cool, funny, laid back lady that knows her stuff. She suggested a few things and sure enough I'll be back to get it. My Counter Experience timeline: ::::::: We entered the building saw some pretty faces there to greet us at the door. They were all so eager to get us a table which was cool. ::::::: Walked to the table saw my surroundings and loved the modern look of the place. ::::::: Sat down and then came the whammy! This is a FREAKINGGGG huge list of toppings and stuff to choose from. A little over whelming BUT! It's BYOB Place so it's understandable. I get it. ::::::: Waited like a 1 minute then came my server named: Monique. She was super nice and greeted me with a smile. And very warm WELCOME. OMG! She is suppppeerrr TALL. I kept telling her that. I might have annoyed her but anywhooooo... ::::::: She gave me a nice run down of the menu and explained that it's a lot to take in and suggest that I get ideas from the "Expert Builds" if it was too much to handle with the picking and choosing. I asked her what was a good choice of cheese and told me the Spicy Jack and guess what?! IT WAS!!!   ::::::: They don't have just regular plan old beers they have "Craft Beers" which was amazing! Our server told us we can sample any on tap AND we did. BUT she highly recommended the Allagash White & she was on POINT! ::::::: Then we scribbled some more and then we were all done and handed in our seemed like test. ::::::: The food came out in under 20 minutes.  Kudos to the cook(s). ::::::: THIS BURGER!!! Literally melted in my mouth with flavor!!! The seasoning was OMG! DELICIOUS!! ::::::: Overall I had a GREAT SERVICE & GREAT EXPERIENCE. I will be back.
pretty good for brunch good bloodies, good portions
Tried the huge slices with some of my friends as soon as we landed. We were all not disappointed, just wished they were all over the world!
I LOVE their soups!! However I wanted to try a chicken dish hand I have to say the chicken looks and tastes weird that it makes me wonder if it's real chicken or not!!
Stylish interior, friendly staff, excellent açai bowls and an Instagram-friendly presentation, great place!

Don't order delivery.  1 hour late. Took 2 hours to get food.  Still waiting.  Delivery driver just called.  Asked where I was at and I put in notes what hotel I was staying at and the correct address.  Food will definitely be cold.  Not acceptable.
Favorite neighborhood coffee shop... have to try the apricot/almond scones!!

Lived up to the hype and reputation. Very reasonable tasting menu price but I went for two course lunch. Had lobster pasta very tasty and lamb loin - one of the best piece of lamb I had in a while Very friendly service lovely decor

I don't know how there other pizzas are but I had a big greasy slice of the artichoke pizza, cause its famous.  And it was pretty good.  It was really crunchy.  Its pretty much artichoke dip on a thick piece of really crunchy bread with extra cheese on top.  Hurts your arteries, but is pretty good.

I admit, I've been missing the South lately (especially New Orleans), so Great Jones Cafe really hit the spot. Went here a month or so ago with a friend because we were both craving some Southern comfort food. We were not disappointed! THE FOOD: The cornbread they serve at Great Jones Cafe is worth the visit alone. Seriously. It was baked with a delicious glaze on top, and the portions were very generous (95 CENTS A PIECE). I had the gumbo and my friend had the pork (I think). Although the gumbo was definitely not EXACTLY like the gumbo I had in NOLA, it did a pretty good job. I loved that it was flavorful and had a bit of a kick. THE VENUE: Small and cozy, but well decorated and definitely not your typical Manhattan restaurant. When we went, it was raining a bit, and the atmosphere in the restaurant made it feel like you were somewhere else. THE SERVICE: The service was great! We were seated promptly, and our orders taken soon after. No complaints here. Overall, we had a pretty good experience at Great Jones Cafe. Will definitely be back again to try the Jambalaya!
We were lucky to be in town for customer appreciation day. Great drink prices and complimentary cheese ball puffs. They also make great chili for Frito pie and hot dogs. Great outside bar area!
the epitome of variety
Best Hungarian Pie ever. Delicious food. Very friendly service. It's hard to eat on the spot because they have tiny room. I would recommend

This was my usual date spot. We really loved the restaurant. But yesterday, it was really BAD!!!! We went to the restaurant at 7ish and waited for 1hr. We expected the wait so we were fine with that. We received the text message saying our table is ready so we went back in to the restaurant and checked in with the host. The host said please wait a min. We stood RIGHT NEXT to the host station. Couple of minutes later, the host got changed. Other party walked-in showing their text message to the new host, and he escorted them. After the new host came back to the station, I said I checked-in before they came in and asked why did you give our table to the other party. He said, there was some miscommunications and the previous host didn't tell him that we were waiting for the table. OKAY.. WE WERE RIGHT NEXT TO THE HOST STAION HOLDING MY CELLPHONE SHOWING THE TXT MSG. BUT OH WELL. Nothing we could do so we just waited again. BUT HERE COMES A BIG PROBLEM. We waited again for a new table, and the host, one who we checked-in to, came back and two hosts talked to each other and the new host came to us and said we should had have checked-in... WHAT??? It turned out that the previous host said he didn't not receive us. ARE YOU SERIOUS? I argued that I had shown a txt msg and waited to be seated RIGHT NEXT TO THE HOST STATION. TWO HOSTS SAID CALM DOWN THERE IS NOTHING WE CAN DO. uhmmmmm hello????????????? Sorry would have been fine for me because we love the restaurant. but not accepting their mistakes and pretending nothing happened is not acceptable. I WILL NEVER GO BACK AGAIN and I HAVE TO ADMIT, FOOD IS REALLY BAD TOO.

Great cubano sandwich and the corn is delicious! If you are in nolita you have go give this tiny place a shot! The staff is attentive and i feel like you could be sitting next to someone famous and you wouldn"t even realize it! This place has charm and character and if you want a reasonably cheap and delicious meal then come here!

I've been to all other Noches de Colombia and was super excited to learn that there was one near me in Montclair, however my visit there for Sunday breakfast couldn't have been more disappointing.  Our waitress was very good, I have to give it to Julieta, she did try her best but didn't get much support from the kitchen nor from the rest of the restaurant staff.   1.  They only had one server for the whole floor, and Julieta had to ask for the others to come out and help when the tables started filling and nobody would come out to help, when they finally came, they didn't seem to please with the fact that they needed to work. 2.  Since there was not enough staff serving the tables, sure enough, our drink sat for a good 15 minutes before they made it to our table.  We got the pandebonos before we got any of the coffees and juices that we had ordered.   3.   And the part that really did it for me, the kitchen put out the wrong order for a table in front of ours, the lady order scrambled eggs and they brought here scrambled eggs with onions and tomatoes.  Coincidentally, I had ordered scrambled eggs with onions and tomatoes, and yes, when the food for our table I was presented with the eggs that they removed from the table in front of us.  Not only did they give me the eggs that the other table refused, but they were ICED cold, when I told our waitress that the eggs were not up to part, they were super cold, she apologized and took them back to kitchen.  And yes, may be 3 minutes later they come back with the same eggs that they warmed up in the microwave.  Of course I refused them and simply gave up on the idea of eating eggs there.  As if this wasn't enough, there is more... 4.   My husband's order came out with the wrong meat, they took it back and fixed it, but it just didn't taste good. 5.   My brother asked for "Carne Molida" and it was certainly from the day before (hopefully from the day before and not older).  Again, it didn't taste good. 6.   Our idea of breakfast is fresh eggs, fresh food in general, I think it's hard to mess up breakfast as it is a pretty simple meal.  Well, leave it to Noches in Montclair where they don't use eggs, rather the eggs they put on our table tasted like scrambled-eggs mixes from a carton.  Not what I would expect from any breakfast restaurant. 7.  And to top it all, it was extremely expensive for food that we did not enjoy at all. I know one family won't make much of a difference for a restaurant to be successful or not, however, I can say that we WON'T be visiting that restaurant ever again.  It is a shame because the location is very convenient and beautiful, the owner definitely spent a good chunk of money in decorating and conditioning of the restaurant to make it up to part in looks with other nice restaurants in the area.  Unfortunately, the kitchen is not putting out food that would make people want to come back for more.   Both food and service must improve, and those are the main components for a good restaurant.

Great Food, excellent service and accuracy, also communications was very good, sometimes this can be an issue with the language barrier (on both sides) but they have always been accurate with my orders. I've used this place about 20 times for take out in recent years and turned several people on to them, I almost never eat there but the place seems nice and adequate for dining in. The people on the phone and counter are very pleasant.

Stumbled across the malt house for a drink and some food and I was not disapointed!!! Great drink selection, good food, good atmosphere. Guy serving us was really helpful when choosing drinks & food! Quality place would certainly recommend it!!!

Came here late, late night with a group after a celebration. Everything was delicious! I had the pulled pork tacos, and sampled the nachos and peanut butter pie that my friends had ordered. So. Wonderful. The service was quick, friendly, and attentive, too!

Great view and good food!  Fun place where you can enjoy the city skyline!  We loved the sangria and the surf and turf recommended by our server, Allesondra.  She was so pretty with a great smile and lots of energy.  We sat  outside and she was pretty busy but always kept that smile and gave us great service!  Definitly will be back!

As a tourist, I was just walking in for a bite to eat but definitely got more than I can chew! This place needs to open up in Miami for sure!!!! The food is just a breathe of fresh air! I've been to nyc plenty times, had many different Spanish plates but blend On the water blew me away! The sea bass, the red snapper and even what would be the basic churrasco was tasteful beyond words! And Felicia is so cute and cheerful I just wanna pack her in my luggage! PLEASE OPEN A LOCATION DOWN SOUTH! THIS PLACE IS EXACTLY WHAT US FLORIDIANS ARE SCREAMING FOR ! Thanks in advance...

This place is beautiful. The food was amazing. The manager Lance was so pleasant, welcoming, and helpful. The waitress Genesis did an amazing job. Thank you guys for amazing food and an amazing experience.

Stopped in for lunch, would have rather gone hungry. Server was polite but the 'medium rare' burgers my friend and I ordered must have come from a box. Bland, overdone, shaped like hockey pucks. They were out of most beer and neglected to mention the happy hour came with stipulations. We paid $50 for freeze dried meat product and average beer. What's more, I asked for the manager to explain why the drinks were not priced at happy hour prices. We were met with a 'bad cop' server. Total bitch. We left in a huff. This is the second time. Shame on me.

This place is very decent... The menu is very interesting... The staff was exceptionally friendly & i enjoyed my dinner here... I would however like to see just a few more choices on the menu in the future
I have been standing here for 1 hour just  to be seated. I am so hungry and i wanted to eat so fast

My Sushi experience is limited to only California and this place in New York. By far this is the best I've had in terms of quality and flavor of the fish.  I ordered the Sushi and Sashimi combination to get a range of the fish and it's flavors.  My girlfriend asked for the chef's recommendations with a budget in mind. We were not disappointed.  Presentation was excellent.  The detail and quality of all ingredients used were second to none for me.  From the soy sauce to the wasabi. All very subtle and did not overpower the taste of the fish. Our server was very accommodating. My mind was blown.   My standouts from the experience in which all selections were amazing: -Fresh Eel Sushi -Toro Sushi -Scallop Sashimi -Blue Fin Tuna Sashimi Now I can't wait to take the next step and go to Japan.  If Japan is not in your future, try this place.  Definitely make a reservation!

Food was mediocre. It's BYOC which I think is an excuse for being too cheap to buy containers. It's SOUP.  If I'm paying $12 for soup, I should be able to take it home! I haven't been to this place in a while and this ruined my experience. The typical person won't bring to go containers with them. How would new customers know that they need to be really hungry or the rest of their food is going in the trash?!

Still getting it's legs but food is delicious and atmosphere is amazing. The overhaul they did on the space is phenomenal. Been once and can't wait to go again. If I may, the BLT i outstanding (fried green tomatoes, what?!!).
Amazing the mussels are out of this world and the baked cod is perfect any one who likes fusion should try this place

This place is awesome! The biscuits are incredible as well as the best fried chicken I have ever had. The pickles are pretty interesting to try. The ambiance is very dark and hip with dark wood and to a of people. The lines to get in can be a b*** for weekend brunch so I would recommend putting your name in and then going for a 40 minute walk or to get coffee or something. I have also been for dinner on a Tuesday night and there was no wait at all so plan your visit accordingly. The service is also surprisingly quick for such a big space!

Very disappointing. The special tuna/lobster salad roll could have used some crunch, like cucumber. After a while it started getting too mushy to keep eating. I asked for the grilled salmon to be rare, and the server agrued with me that it wouldn't be good - like for my stomach. She finally said ok, she'd tell the chef. It came out hard as a rock and I threw it away. Done with this place
Food is ok, nothing special. Like Sheak  shake  but food not test like that.i m not sure be back
Got the Krabi Seafood noodle soup with a side of crackling pork. It was delicious!!! This place is authentic. Best Thai restaurant ever.

OMG! I must say that this is 2 thumbs up by far the greatest AUTHENTIC THAI RESTAURANT I have ever been to in all 5 boroughs that I have ever tried. The restaurant is very exquisite, The food is superb very well seasoned and marinated down to the bone. I have to say I brought my best friend in who does not care for Asian cuisine and she was licking the sauce on the plate from the chicken wings which btw way you must try because it is out of this world. The customer service is awesome and food prices are very reasonable you must go to kitchen 79 to fill your belly with good yum yum. :)
Great food. Great atmosphere. Great location. I highly recommend the Taste of Maine all of the rolls are delicious.
so good..

I was super nervous coming here especially hearing about all these worms in sushi. I figured oh well I cant pass up on a great place that I have heard about over and over. They were very clean and we didnt wait at all. They had great prices and amazing food. Everything you get here is fantastic

They have never fail to impress me! They are super efficient when you dine in the restaurant, but also they are super fast when it comes to food delivery! Literally only takes them 10 mins to deliver their yummy food to my place!!!I can have their food every single day!
Came up from Philly my friend suggested we go somewhere nice to watch the game and to my surprise GREAT food GOOD service I will definitely go to The Huddle whenever I'm in the neighborhood.

The vegan options never disappoint. I have been going to Mehek for years, mostly getting food to go from the sub-street level. Obviously I have consistently enjoyed the food or I wouldn't keep coming back, but what made me think to write them a review is the new Chana-naan-ninis they're making. I can't stand how good they are, let alone to say. And there is one (slightly) older gent that is often there and he said he'll make me baingan bharta-naan-nini which I am so excited for. Princeton has always been low on the vegan options so I'm glad they're mixing it up with new delicious ideas. That said, I have traveled a fair amount and eaten at many other Indian spots and I do genuinely love Mehek. There is a comfort element in their food that is so satisfying and isn't easy to find.

I was very unimpressed with the food. The empanadas were dry. The shrimp skewers were meh. The brussel sprouts were tiny but were probably the best thing I had and that's not saying much. The space is nice but loud. I would not recommend it based on the below average food.

The food is pretty mediocre here but they do get three stars for atmosphere. This is the best place to be in the summer when you can enjoy the patio but other than that I wouldn't just go here for dinner. We also went to the brunch here and it was just ok.

Thought the food was pretty good. Not as good as I expected from reading reviews. I opted not to take my leftovers. I really thought the coffee could have been better. The service was not that great, I felt like we had to flag someone down when we needed something. I went 7/31, it was nice out but dark inside. I was really hoping to like this place. I would go again to see if my experience was an exception. Hey, Im an optimist!
really good, interesting food.
Outstanding food, exceptional staff. Don't pass this establishment without stopping and eating something.

They'll say it's a 10-minute wait for your order, even if it's a simple chicken gyro. But you know what? It is fresh and so delicious! I wish I ate my gyro slower, because I just want to keep tasting it. As far as chicken gyros go, this place does it right. This place is different from Oasis (falafel place on N7th and Bedford). Kabob Shack uses more fresh ingredients, whereas Oasis has a lot of pickled veggies. Both are good, just different. I personally prefer this place and am so glad to have found it! Good vibe. Friendly, laid back. There's an available power outlet, too, if you want to bring your laptop and do a bit of work during lunch.

YUMMY.  They say less is more on their pizzas.  I've gotten a red-sauce pizza both times I've gone since they import their tomatoes from Italy, and I wanted to have a authentic pizza experience.  I got mushroom as a topping, which I wouldn't recommend it made the pizza extra soggy from the water in the mushrooms, and the mushrooms are in more of a raw state then a good browned baked state.  Environment is cool.  Get there early before the main meal times cause lines get long.  They are pretty quick if it's just two people.  Two people can easily eat a small pizza which consists of 6 Huge slices.  Don't take leftovers they'll just get soggy, but its good enough to eat it all there and be a little extra full.

Yummmyyyy.  I dropped by here for a dinner with my boyfriend on a Saturday night.  We sat down, ordered steamed dumplings for an app, and ordered two udon bowls- one with shrimp tempura and fried chicken, the other with beef and egg.  First off, we were a bit worried from the reviews that said service was slow.  However, this was DEFINITELY not the case.  The food came out in less than 10 minutes after ordering.  We probably got our udon bowls immediately after we finished eating the appetizer, which was definitely less than 5 minutes after receiving it.  Secondly, the food we got was just what we were hoping for.  The steamed dumplings took us by surprise because we imagined getting gyoza, but obviously we didn't order that.  No problem there though because these were delicious and the wasabi it came with was a great addition.  Our two udon bowls were different but delicious in their own ways.  I like that the beef was actually shredded because it added tons of flavor to the broth and became almost like a soupy stew.  The tempura/chicken udon bowl was also really good, especially because of the friend chicken taste.  I was definitely iffy about that when we ordered, but after trying it, I was a fan.  I'll be back here for sure!

We stopped over for a pre-theater drink and "nibble". The menu is humble, but not at all bad (the lamb sliders were particularly good!). Good selection of drinks (including beers). Tables tend to wobble quite a bit, and the service is a bit slow, but still, worth trying out.

5 stars! I have been here a few times for both sit down dinners and for take out and never been disappointed. The staff is very friendly and warm, and the  decor is very nice and inviting. But the best part is the food! I have tried: Appetizers: naan and hummus- above average; truffle calamari- yum! So delicious; charred edamame- deliciously salted edamame that tastes grilled Entrees: both the hanger steak and duck confit- succulent and very flavorful; short ribs- fall-apart tender and perfectly seasoned; Thai saffron rice- very good, best way to describe it is like a Thai version of jambalaya. Dessert: panna cotta- perfect! not too sweet and nice flavor and of course the Thai iced tea is a must try! Will definitely come back here!

I love El Vez! During the warmer months, it is an excellent area to sit outside and enjoy a few drinks/people watch! Or, sit inside and enjoy the wonderfully eclectic decor. They have really really good drinks, not to mention amazing food. It is reasonably priced for what you get. I really miss their surf and turf tacos, and it would be a shame if they don't bring them back to their menu. I will be returning to El Vez probably about twice a year, only because I want to try out new places. This is a really great spot and I recommend everyone who is visiting Philly to come here!

I was at this place with my family and friends for lunching August 25th. There was only two other persons at one table. We were seated and the waiter took our orders immediately. Service was faster than expected but then again we were the only ones. The rava dosas that most of us ordered were delicious. We ordered some vandas too. They were dense and too heavy. Sambar was mediocre at best,chutneys were just ok. Kaima idilli was tasty. We all liked it. I am giving two stars not because the food but because of the lack of hygeine and the lack of concern by the staff. As we were close to finishing our lunch we noticed water dripping from the ceiling. It was a continuous heavy drip that we could hear. It was just in front of us and it was dripping on cups,utensils etc that were stacked for serving. We noticed the manager or the main guy there looking at the ceiling and not bothered either to move us to a different table or move the cups,plates etc. I asked him him about the leak and he just mumbled that they have to see whst it was. We all could see the ceiling at the leak heavily stained from previous leaks so we knew this was not  the first time. None of us could believe this guy's attitude. The restrooms were so filthy that we had to go to the coffee place next door for kids to use the restroom. The lack of cleanliness is something we don't tolerate in restaurants. We will never go back there again. If this is how they are in their customer's presence I hate to think how careful they are inside where the food is prepared and stored. I am sure I don't want to know

Can't to new jersey for business trip. Good everything sucks around here....UNTIL I came to this place. It's lively, food is good...and drink img the drinks are strong...do if you are a person like me, you NEED strong drinks. Nachos...awesome

Wen there with my Uncle John last week. Was recommended from a friend about how good the food was, I was pleasantly surprised with the quality and atmosphere, but felt the service fell kind of short. Although I would come here again, they need to make some changes in the customer service department. Overall try the food that's why you're there after all.
Great local spot! Try the lunch sandwiches and salad everyone I have had so far has been great. I would stay away from the chocolate it was oddly thick.

In one word Amazing!!!!!. Starting from every small detail in the service down to the food and deserts eastwick has it all figured out. I went with a few friends last week and it was simply the best meal I had in a long time. Starting from our drinks, we has great red wine dwon to my main course the special lamb shank it was great. The meat was perfectly coocked tender & juicey not extra seasoned so the natural flavor of the lamb was very present. My desert was great warm appale pie that was not to sweet and havey like in some places. Service was great and manager came to talk to us and welcome us, seems like they know the regulars here. I will gladly come to eat at eastwick again the first chance I get great experiance

My friend and I were looking for a charming/trendy place to go out for dinner and headed to West Village to another place that had great reviews, however we did not have a reservation so when we got there the place was full so we decided to walk and we found Buvette by chance. It was exactly what we were looking for! I have eaten in a lot of french restaurants in France and other countries and I have to say that was a great experience; great dishes to share, small portions, good selection, well combined flavours, beautiful wine. If I had to say something negative would be perhaps the use of too much bread but you can always leave bread on the side so no big deal. I would recommend this place to anybody visiting NYC. Bon Appetit!

I love burgers with all my heart and yet I am a typical blonde skinny girl haha This place is a hot spot for sure. Their burgers are so big and filling. NOT only that but they serve other things as well. I try to come on sundays for wings and football =) All i know is if you dont eat make sure you come here haha
My favorite restaurant in Philadelphia.  Food is delicious, staff are super friendly, and prices affordable.  Make sure to check out this place more than once.

I've been here plenty of times and called-in orders all the time and each time it is a great place to come in for a late night meal, after club meal, after sex meal & just about any time of the day kind of meal. I am hoping I don't even get a bad waitress I would most defiantly take a star down. I think I've almost had half the menu here too. If you want a great breakfast get the Starvin' Marvin, want a Great Burger? get the Caesar Burger for just $11 BUCKS!!! And they are freakingggg HUGE PATTIES!! For dinner try the stuffed crab cakes AMAZINGGGG! Who ever revamp good Ol' Willies Diner did a great job! Kudos!!! I wanna meet the person created this menu list! GREAT JOB!!!

Tucked into the Financial district is this fun and funky little Irish pub! I popped in for a quick lunch with some colleagues, and from a bartender in a leather butcher apron to the sawdust on the floor, and a bar menu of things like pot pies and scotch eggs, this place was fun! Check out the irish coffee - delicious!

A quirky and characterful pub, restaurant and English provision store where ex pats and enthusiasts can stock up on Marmite and mushy peas amid charmingly cluttered decor and sawdust strewn floors. Boasting the biggest selection of Irish whiskeys in the US, the vodka selection is also impressive. We visited on the recommendation of a barkeeper in Midtown on a chilly Sunday and warmed ourselves up with Eggs Benedict and a chicken Pot pie, washed down with a highball and 15 year old Glenlivet, all really good. It was a pity we were too early for the Sunday roast but we plan to return.

This has been my go to spot for quite some time.  Not an upscale type of restaurant but most certainly a place to visit for some great food and drinks, very laid back atmosphere.  My food of choice are the steak nachos combined with a blood orange frozen margarita.  Nice place to visit!
This bar had a very bad smell, I decided to leave at once as it was so off putting. Shame really as I was looking forward to it based on reviews.

YES! JUST YES! Everything is right about this place. Killer happy hour, great vibe! Amazing food. Friendly service! This place rocks!! If you want lively time go to the bar, if you want to take a date out, sit in the back. Everybody wins! Hollar!
Amazing!!! Wish we had this in the DC area but kinda glad we don't because I'd weigh like 300lbs ^.^ Skip the red sauce and overdo the white sauce!

Rustic Latin Cuisine.....what?? Oh how needed was a place like this on the Upper East Side. OK so they just opened on September 15th and I can't believe its only been such a short period of time. Granted this is their second location, the first being on 46th St on Restaurant Row so they may have had some practice but come on, the Hospitality factor, that's something that has to come naturally you can't fake that, but more on that later. First the location and ambiance, they seem unfazed by the subway construction happening in front of them but we too have gotten use to that. The ambiance is super relaxed and cool with a killer bar and fun double style type of dining areas. The food, yum, cocktails silly good. A Happy Hour full of goodies with food options that am told will be revealed in days. Several visits now with girlfriends and am silly about this Salmon Brulee, yeah that's right, flavor smack with every bite. Had the Pacu Fish Ribs and I don't even know what to say about these cause you just have to try it for yourself. Second visit had the Ribeye Parilla with the seven different sides they tell me change on a regular basis and you know the Argentinian influence is in full effect with meats from Pat LaFrieda I guess they are not playing with quality and it shows. So you have the Brazilian fish ribs, the Peruvian interpretation of ceviches, meats a la Argentina but truly all of Latin and South America seem to be covered on the menu. I now understand the whole Rustic aspect of the name and not just some overly colorful Latin Bistro, a bit classier and at a different level here. After my first visit I actually came across a re-run of Diners Drive Ins and Dives with Guy Fierri and noticed that it featured the Chef Owner Chef Carlos at his other restaurant in Jersey, Quahog's Shack, something like that. Not being certain, on my next visit it was confirmed by the staff that it was the same as he was working the Raw bar and checked up on our enjoying of the drinks we were having. In my nosiness I was also informed that his partner from that location was joining him here and it happens to be Chef Lucas Manteca who happens to be a nominee for the James Beard 2014 Best Chef Mid-Atlantic and my server was super excited telling us that they have tasted some of the new things that will be on the new menu and in their words, it's ridiculous, so now more reasons to keep coming back. yes I will have to bring boyfriend. These 2 will blow away this community that's what we were told so let's see. Am excited. Finally lets talk about service but more than that the general Hospitality that service falls under. I go out to eat often w girlfriends or boyfriend and there is nothing worse than feeling like you are doing the establishment a favor for being there, some, but come on NY, get a clue, you may want to see how these guys do it. From the entering its like your walking into these peoples homes and I've read other reviews around that speak of this, and you do wonder if this is just a show but nooo, it is not. Bartenders warm, informative, engaging, I would hang out with these people. The servers, knowledgeable, excited about the product, attentive and just down right warm but not over bearing as they seem to have been trained properly to read guests accordingly. The table next to us looked like they were in a different personal experience, and the server handled that table as it deserved considering they weren't as fun as we were, just more straight laced. Still we could over hear that table speaking about how wonderful their experience was at the end of their meal and that they must come back.   The Owners, wow, and forget about getting a straight answer as to who they are because there in lies the true humbleness of these folks. The GM Eddie stops by as he was doing with all tables to check on us, we ask if he's the owner because he sure as hell took ownership of this place. We were sure of it with the way he worked the room and his team and the guest, his answer, "no you are the owners, we just keep the doors open for you to enjoy" come on really. This Dude was and is on point and no show about it, the real thing. He comped a dessert at the end of meal as he wanted our opinion on some new ones they were trying out and a finish with a shot of Mezcal, which he took the time to educate us about it and the difference between Tequila and Mezcal which my girlfriend didn't know about nor in that much detail, neither did I. Anyway, you'll know who he is when you visit if not ask for him. And then there is Victor actually one of the Partners, Chef Carlos being the other, warm, sincere, grateful for us being there and as Eddie had said while both of them at our table, "we are grateful to you because you have many choices to dine and you chose US". These two are amazing especially with their banter as to who is the owner both putting it on the other, but you can see the true partnership amongst them.   Wishing the very best.

The food was excellent. The upstairs atmosphere however was bland and without character. Everyone goes out to dinner for a dining experience, not just the food. I would insist on sitting downstairs instead of the make shift storage area upstairs masquerading as a dining room.
Such a nice lunch! Steve our waiter was so good! Wavered between staying in the garden enjoying the cold beers, or going to the Brooklyn museum! Definite yummy pizza, sausage was so good!

I work in the area and my colleagues and I never come here for lunch if we need to be in and out in an hour. They cannot even get simple salads out timely. When we are not in a rush we do come for lunch. Nice owner, good service, tasty food and fair prices.

since one of my favorite sandwich shops faded to memory in the local area I was eagerly awaiting a sandy shop to take it's place. needless to say when I saw a panini place opening up I was very interested to give them a shot. overall, not bad but not wowed either. I ordered the mushroom swiss steak panini, which has sauteed mushrooms, swiss cheese, shaved ribeye, a1 sauce, and on the largest roll they had which is about the size of a small dinner plate. their medium I would say is a salad plate and the small is a hamburger bun, roughly of course. the quality is pretty good, but not phenomenal. everything is pre-made and would even go as far to say purchased then assembled right there in front of you. the panini presses take a little while to get the right crunch and with only two machines they do have difficulty meeting demands of a busy lunch crowd. that and the crew are still learning the ropes so it takes some time to get food. Price-wise, it's kinda bad. large is 10 bucks and, although a good portion, doesn't match the quality compared to the other food spots in the area. I can find cheaper higher-quality food (five guys) or slightly more expensive awesome food (plan b) heck can even find a ton of cheaper, slightly lower quality foods too (most the fast food joints or even subway in the same plaza). So I am not sure what niche this place is suppose to fill but I don't think it's filling it. Given the area, a bunch of offices with a bunch of higher wage earners, this panini shops caters to that crowd well. however for the foodies I would have to say that there isn't enough going on here to warrant an extended trip. worth a try if you are in the area, but no sandwhich mecca here.
I love this place! I came here once for brunch and i fell in love with their waffle!!! Must try if your ever there!

Yuck Went to pregame and walked in to a sea of suits and attitudes Sat at the bar and never got greeted Must have been the hoodies Whatever I wasnt in the mid for a room full of snotty assholes and waitresses who ignore those not in expensive clothes We had a desire to drink and a pocket of money Screw them The bistro at infinty was great and no 20 dollar martinis.  Win win

Just got back to AZ from a 10 day trip to Brazil and Argentina with Gate1 Travel. They do a superior job with their escorted tours. Not only great value for the dollar spent, but a chance to experience travel in a meaningful and thoughtful manner. For those seeking a break from the beaten paths of Europe, Gate1 offers a number of Latin American tours that blend the best of urban culture with history, archeology, and exquisite natural phenomena like Iguazu Falls which we visited on this trip. The feeling one gets when peering into the abyss that is our Grand Canyon is matched by the senses that are stirred by the power and energy of these enormous thundering waters on the border of Brazil and Argentina. Gate1 always offers comfortable hotels, experienced and personable tour directors and plenty of time for independent exploration. I have also visited Peru, Ecuador and Costa Rica as well as Egypt, Morocco,Turkey and the Baltics with Gate1 and suggest that any serious devotee of travel check this company out. You will not be disappointed.

Ordered Montclair blue burger, bacon cheese burger, and a blt.  Added fries to the burgers. Compared to elevation burger, smash burger, or zin burger I would put this burger at the back of the pack in terms of taste.  When you add a price tag of $31 for this take out order I don't see us going back.  I know grass fed is supposed to a big deal but at the end of the day it's still red meat.  Nobody ever says that antibiotic fed cows will kill you although it seems to be implied, and therefore justifies $9.50 for a burger. There is likely a market for high end burgers in Montclair, I just happen to not fit that mold.  If I am going to pay that much for a burger, I personally would prefer a real sit down experience  (stuffed has very limited seating) at any of the previously mentioned establishments.
Extremely cool atmosphere and the best pad Thai I've ever eaten. The spring rolls were amazing as well. I recommend you get the pad Thai medium heat and then get hot sauce on the side.
On a bright note, the baguette was good.

The first time I came here was for a friend's birthday. The waitress was great and the food/drinks were above average. Just went tonight and the hostess was unbelievably rude. Let me first say, friends are normal, polite, decent people. One friend arrived at 8:15. Told there would be a 45 minute wait. Went next door to have a drink. Around 45 mins later we got the phone call that the table was ready, answered the call and headed over. Upon walking in, we were told that the table had been given away because the call wasn't answered. Mistakes happen, no big deal. Admittedly it was awkward and we probably rolled our eyes. However, the hostess was extremely cold and repeatedly told us we didn't answer her call. My friends grew increasingly confused and annoyed. We accepted that we'd be waiting longer but then the hostess came back and sarcastically said that because of our "great energy" and being "awesome" we could have the table. We quickly decided that we weren't going to enjoy our meal after that experience and politely told the waitress we would be leaving. Don't judge this place based on our experience - I did have a good time once. Just be prepared for attitude.
A new cute Cafe Vienna on Nassau street. A bit pricy but food is very good and service is excellent

Terrible..no comparison to real new haven pizza.  How do you even call it pizza when you can't find the cheese!! Completely OVERRATED and OVERPRICED. .they will be in trouble with there long term lease unless they start making a real pizza..leave the new York pizza in new york

Always fresh, always good. Chicken Tostada Salad is amazing and we love their tacos, soup and nachos. Always ready within 10 min, friendly service and the hard and soft shells are made fresh! Love it!
cozy atmosphere, great for a date or family dinner, duck comfit was a little overdone for my taste but the have great wine list and amazing deserts.

AWFUL AWFUL AWFUL!!! I am still reeling from  utter shock by the rude and humiliating experience we endured at this restaurant. I would recommend that NO ONE eat at an establishment that would ever belittle and humiliate any of their patrons in such a manner. Basically my husband and I arrived with our 2 twin toddlers while we awaited the rest of our party of 8. My daughter sat at a table and played w the salt shaker (about a teaspoon amount into a plate). When some of the rest of our party arrived and we asked to move to a larger table I noticed The salt, apologized for the salt and proceeded to pick it up. The waiter rolled his eyes, shook his head and told us we shouldn't eat there if we couldn't control our kids. It's a small place so the ONLY other table that was seated obviously heard this  exchange also. I could almost understand his reaction if they had destroyed the place or broken something. But some salt on a plate??? At any rate we left. I am not sure if this waiter guy  is the related to the owner or has some management type role that he thinks it's ok to speak to people like that. he's also been there a long time so maybe he is just bitter. On principle  (or in solidarity if you have ever had a child) --PLEASE do not eat here. Shame on you Istanbul cafe. Ruined our night.
Super fortunate to sample Deli On The Block's wonderful food at the Durham Fair. The tacos were amazing! Everything was fresh and flavorful. Priced right! Will definitely visit their Hamden location.

Our family LOVES Brothers Pizza! We've tried everybody in the area. Papa Johns is too sweet. Dominos has become too garlicky. Aljon's and several others are ok but Brothers is the best. Just the right blend of crust, sauce and cheese. Sometimes I do think they should leave the pie in the oven for an extra minute and I've asked them to do so. That way the pie is a little more "set". But as far as flavor goes - it's always great.

My mother in law wanted to treat me and my husband to a nice birthday dinner so we chose Mafalda's since we had heard good things about the restaurant. Unfortunately for us, it was a horrible experience. The waitress was a flake, we had to ask her for silverware and twice for our drinks. We were told that olive oil would not be served with our bread because they were out. We asked for paper napkins, we were told they didn't have any. The waitress came back a few minutes later and told us she found some leftover napkins from some previous event. My husband ordered the pork medallions with figs for an appetizer and it came out severely undercooked. It was pink (raw) inside. When we sent it back, the waitress told us the chef said that's how it's always served. Really? Ever hear of Trichinosis?? While waiting for the chef to re-fire his app, my third spoonful of my french onion soup contained a piece of a DIRTY DISH RAG. Yup, definitely wasn't FOOD. We brought everything up to the owner who acknowledged the rag and apologized profusely, offered us a free dessert, whatever it took to keep us there. We hadn't even had dinner yet, why would we want dessert?! Needless to say, we got up and walked out and I nearly threw up in the parking lot thinking about where that dirty dish rag might have been before it was in my MOUTH. Never, never again will I step foot into this place. Some things can be overlooked, but this experience I will never forget. I wish there was a zero star option.

I have been going to Catered Affair for over 20 years. Starting with breakfast, you can get anything.From pancakes, omelets, sandwiches, platters, to french toast. Absolutely the best tasting, and value anywhere in Hillsborough. Going in for lunch is a great experience. Their menu is vast, offering just about anything you want from subs to salads to hot off the grill items. Their soups are second to none as they are all HOMEMADE, and delicious. These can even be bought frozen to take home and have later. Catered Affair is a warm and comfortable establishment. Their staff is VERY friendly, knowledgeable, and quite funny. It is also one of the cleanest places to eat at in the area. As for their catering side, they are hands down the best in town. Their attention to detail, and your personal needs go above and beyond. I have used them for hot buffets and an off premise BBQ. They do everything for you so you will be able to enjoy your guests. Their service staff is very professional from beginning to end, always taking into account the needs of the customer. I highly recommend Catered Affair for your next meal or catering affair. Disclaimer: Though I have been a patron for a long time I WAS NOT asked to write this review nor do I have any stake in Catered Affair.

Great Selection of Sandwiches. I compared the overall taste to the acclaimed Tastee Sub Shop in Edison NJ and I must say its fairly comparable in taste and quality. Meat is fresh and sliced in front of you, the bread is fresh and delicious, and the service was ok you can tell they favor return customers overall which isn't necessarily a bad business quality to have.  This is an all cash establishment so if you have a card make sure stop at the ATM prior to visiting.  This place seems like a great local sub spot if your looking for a classic Italian or standard deli sandwich. Try the Big Bite you wont be disappointed.
Great South Indian food. I had Mysore Rava Masala dosa and Medu Vada. As Authentic as it gets. The coconut chutney was amazing! I will definitely go there again.

For real love this place. Food is always spot on and unique, you can tell it's fresh and made with love (duck sliders YUMMY). Bottle selection is top notch, fairly priced for the area and drafts are always well balanced and great! The bartenders is awesome and knowledgable. Only complaint...what's with the gimmicky events?? Keep it up bottle bar, I only wish there was one in Jersey where I'm from.

Had dinner there last night. Empanada flight: three different fillings and styles made with pastry imported from Argentina...out of this world. Delicious potato frittata. Excellent caesar salad. Not crazy about salmon panino, but I am not crazy about salmon patties. Should have asked. Definitely going back to try other items on very diverse menu. And I won't forget the vino. (liquor store is only two doors down)

One of my favorite brunch spots in Brooklyn! There is rarely a wait to be seated because the place in rather big. Outside patio is very pretty, rustic and farm-y. Food is yummy. I especially love the humus/dips platter and the adult grilled cheese. Unfortunately there's no bottomless booze :(. Service is good, waiters are very attentive and always come around to see if they can bring us anything. Parking is not easy to find in the area, but on a nice day the walk from a far parking spot is definitely worth it.
love to visit with my friends from out of town or when i just want to feel like i am going home. antipasti bar is fabulous and customer service is especially wonderful

That was horrible.  Fruit flies, bland over cooked hockey puck burger,  fatty undercooked bacon,  over priced,  crappy environment.... Positives was the bathroom was clean.  Would be my bet this restaurant will be closed in less than 6 months.  Much better burger places within 2 miles and I'm Including Fridays.
excellence! food here makes me wanna comeback! yeah service can be better but I don't go there for service I just leave a bad tip.

If you taste diffirent food come to Blak Sea Fish & Grill Turkish Restaurant. You can enjoy the delicious (Char grilled Octopus salad,kind of appetizers.Pan fried anchovies,mussells,calamaries. They have large fish menu: (ST. Peters Fish,Mediterranean Sea Bass,Royal Dorado,Fresh Flander,Red Mulled,Grilled Whole Brook Trout,Salmon & Shrimps. And Lamb & Chicken Shish Kebabs! After the meal do not forget the taste Baklava,Brown Top Pudding & Kunefe with Turkish Coffee or Tea.

I'm not sure why this restaurant shows up on organic restaurant websites when there isn't anything organic on the menu. I REALLY, REALLY wish it were an organic restaurant because then I'd be there all the time. I had the Chicken Piccata a few weeks ago and it was good but not special enough to go out of my way for; however, if it had officially been GMO free I would definitely make the trek. I hope they decide to go that route in the future. A second suggestion would be a good cleaning---the dust on the curtains was about 2" thick.

Sometimes I forget about Cox's Market because it's not as loud as some of the other stores on Nassau Street. It is understated, but it has some of the best breakfast and lunch sandwiches in town. My favorite items on the menu are a pork roll, egg, and cheese on an everything bagel (always fresh and tasty), or a turkey club with avocado panini. The prices are fair ($3.99 bagel sandwich or $6.50 panini), and you get a ton of food! Lastly, the staff is always friendly and smiling. Give it a try!

Rodizio Rodizio Rodizio is all I have to say best bang for your buck in all of newark their quality of meat is on point most places use not such great quality and mask it with loads of salt but not here you taste flavor and quality in every bite as for the sangria I just tell the server keep it coming now as for dessert they need to up the selection a little more had the chocolate flan and a slice of the chocolate ganache cake best two on the menu in my opinion
Quick lunch before my nap from travel

First the good. It's a cute little place and the proprieter seems nice enough. Now the not-so-good. The place is over priced and service is slow. But this is not what caused me to give it the 1 start rating. They nickel and dime you by charging you extra for everything. Order bread and you get charged $0.50 for butter anf $1.50 for jelly. Really? And you'd like a refill on your coffee? That'll be $1.00. I have been to literally hundreds of breakfast places and never -- and I do mean never -- have I been charged for a coffee refill. That's just poor form and tacky. The bread was stale and the entire experience left a very bad taste in our party's mouth. I would not recommend this place and I would never go back. Very disappointing. Here's a suggestion to the owners: charge a fair price and treat your customers with a little diginty...and never -- ever -- make a customer feel like he's being ripped off.

I went in for brunch with my sister and thought the food and drinks were pretty good.  A couple of things I didn't really like were that the service staff was a little slow at responding to our needs and the host was really bad at estimating the timing for a seat. Also, the place is quite small and felt stuffy.  I would recommend eating with only one or two friends.

This place is consistency great, I don't think I've ever been disappointed with a meal. Andrew and Arthur (the sushi chefs) are friendly and quirky and dish out massive portions of American-style sushi (very thick cuts of fish). The food is reasonably priced and really two rolls is all you need to feel very full. My favorites are spicy squid, spicy salmon, salmon skin, salmon avacado, and ikura (salmon roe), yet everything is great. Their braised yellow tail collar (hamachi kama) is a real treat and worth exploring. Be prepared to wait if you come at peak dinner or lunch time but you can always call ahead to order.

I don't know about the controversy regarding the owner (PYT same owner) but who really wants to pay $13 for a 10 oz piña colada??? ESPECIALLY when you need a kick starter campaign to open in the first place Come on now....at least be friendly and provide good prompt service that acompanies the price tag. Boo.

IN the past 35 years I have had more meals in France than Brooklyn. So what a great pleasure when daughter, Brooklyn resident of 15 years took us there last week, to satisfy our need for French food, esp after 2 weeks in Brittany this summer. Great French bistro, authentic country SW France , not over fancy. Good service relaxing atmosphere and the prices most reasonable. Value for price super high. And we are from a foodie town, Portland Maine w/ some v good French spots. A jewel as another reviewer said

In my opinion best and most consistent Italian food in NYC. Gnocchi is excellent. Cavatelli is sublime. Brussel sprout shaved salad great. Sandwiches incredible. Maybe wine list could be better Great garden Dream of throwing a big wedding party here some day for my daughter or son. No reservations for party of 4 so we always eat at odd hours but go for at least 4 birthdays a year... Don't miss out
Place was warm and packed. I was sweating but I didn't care. Pork soup dumplings. Salt and pepper soft shell crab and cold sesame noodles. All excellent.
Top 5 brunch spots in NYC. haloumi. labneh. tagines. eggs. Delicious! Sometimes there is a wait on the weekends. Service is good. Drinks are good. Consistent.
Loving the ambience at Friedman's. The food's so good and guilt-free. Wonderful stuff here.
The staff was great but sadly the food was underwhelming.  They seem to be trying to put a new spin on a food that was already perfected.

We surprised Reynolds last Friday with about 25 guests from our wedding party and he handled it like a champ.  Drinks were spot on the entire night even when it was 3 deep at the bar and he even let me bum cigarettes - kinda big since packs are like $14 there. Went back on Sunday after a night out when they were closing but he had them whip me up a drink and was able to point me in the right direction for a place that would sell me a slice when everything else was closed.  I'll definitely be back next time I'm in LES.

Hands down the best Sushi/Asian fusion restaurant I've ever been to! Service was quick and attentive despite the small staff and busy dinner time rush. Food is DELICIOUS, definitely beats the price AND quality of Kotos. Definitely will be coming back.. A lot. :D
We had dinner at the Hourglass Tavern again on Sept. 24th. A late dinner after a show , everything was perfect as usual !!!!!  Great food and great service !!!!! You will not be disappointed !!!

If you don't like this place, I don't like you. Everything is tasty. They use lots of garlic. The waiters dress formal and are consummate professionals. They use white linen. There is free parking across the street. They are generous with a pour of the Spanish Rioja. They make the flan in house. I can't imagine being in Newark, and not visiting Spanish tavern.

Outstanding,  absolutely outstanding.  I can't believe I have lived so close for years and never k we about this gem.  I had the poutine that was just incredible,  it was a huge portion for an appetizer,  definitely enough to share or have as a main course.  So yummy!!  I also got the short rib and mushroom ravioli.....  Oh.  My.  God.  It was heaven,  another huge portion of food and the demi and ravioli were to die for.  The service was perfect,  the waiter was awesome and killed it service g the whole restraint and the hostess/owner was lovely and very attentive.  Beautiful place and I am super happy I found it.  I'll never leave haha

This used to b the spot...went there on a weeknight....order...get my water, it's got a few black floaters. I notify the waitress, she brings me back another water with the same shit. Ew...to top it off there was a Huge roach crawling on the wall my back is against.
We ordered veal Principesa with penne and sauce.. Amazing! We also ordered eggplant with angel hair. Great combo! I would order the veal again!

Great ambiance and the menu selection is very good for a range of tastes!  The waiter suggested a martini made with local gin that was a bit pricey - but the drinks aren't what we came for so it wasn't anything we found ourselves to be dismayed by. Had the cheese steak egg rolls which were yummy but a bit on the heavy side but to be expected! The salads were very good!  Very good service and a great place to eat with reasonable prices as well!
Holy yummy 1-2 bacon burger , my burger again with our new favorite bartender Lauren the food is a bit pricey but so worth the money: get what you pay for
I was going there to tried the fried chicken but when I got there they were serving brunch, so I ordered eggs benedict which were really good except the potatoes were a little overcooked.

I know I am preaching to the choir when I say it, but this was a perfect dining experience.  The service was so lovely--knowledgeable and attentive, but not too high pressure. The nice char on those chewy toasts with the peas and mint made a permanent imprint on my tastebuds' memory.  Also, the samples that come from the kitchen in those tiny vessels make the moment more intimate.

Having lived near Tamarind for years and loving their food, I was so happy to find this gem in our new neighborhood!  The décor is so authentic and cozy, not what you would expect to find at a restaurant on 11th and Washington next to a 7-11!  The service is always really great, explaining different dishes nicely.  The food is so good and you get so much for your money...and its BYOB!  I always get the drunken noodles and my boyfriend always gets the thai basil, both with chicken, and we split the Thai papaya salad...and the total is just over $30!!  We have seen small parties there too, so it could be a good option for a birthday dinner or a small 10-15 person gathering.  Highly recommend!!

If you love meditarianan cuise you should find Taim, very small place, even hard to sit most of the time, but fabulous tastes. Give a chance for quick lunch or afternoon snack, you will never be upset. Best hummus and falafel you could find.
Aside from the long waiting time and crowded front door, food is excellent. OK servers (most of the time), and incredible food.

Our new FAVORITE restaraunt in the Hartford area... (our old favorite was where Chef Greg was for the last decade...)  Decor is attractive and service is friendly and attentive to your needs. We had Roast Lamb over barley risotto and Seared Scallops with a morraccan cous-cous.  Both were done to perfection with subtle flavors that had us going "Mmmmm" with each fork full.  For dessert, we split a Chocolate combo that had mousse, Chocolate-Ginger Brulee, a deep fried White Chocolate Ravioli, and a shooter of Chili infused Hot Chocolate... (excuse me a moment,  gotta get a napkin. I'm drooling on myself at the memory of that Hot Chocolate...)  While I did not check out the craft beer selection this visit, we will be back on a regular basis and I look forward to trying what I understand is an excellant selection.  Best wishes on this new enterprise !

From the outside this place looked a lot more expensive than it actually was. It was very affordable, fair portions, fantastic sourdough bread served before the meal, and our waiter was just wonderful. Between 2 people we ordered a caesar salad with chicken, a margarita pita (an appetizer) and truffle fries. We split everything and it was satisfying, yet not too heavy. Our bill came out to about $30, $15 per person. So affordable, so delicious, and really great service. This place is definitely one of the best in my book.

Food was cooked perfectly - not over seasoned, salty. Unique accompaniments on entrees, which is something special, unique to the restaurant/chef. It's what I look for in quality restaurants. It's definitely worth the money you pay.
Lots of pinball machines and great food! Huge beer selection too! Very fun and pretty inexpensive!
Great family own restaurant! The Food is fresh , delicious and  abundant.. Love  going to places that aren't franchises. Also  you will also see Jerry the owner greeting And serving people!! Bravo

one of the best restaurant I have been in the city (considering price and quality). the food is delicious, the place is beautiful and great service! I love this place and def going back. Highly recommended!!

I stopped by the shop today to try out the philly cheese steak with the cheese fries cause my boy DJ Frankie phenomenon teased me with a half of sandwich sunday Man.when I got the full meal it was great the cashier was friendly the owner and cook were excellent I found a real philly cheese steak in ny in this place everyone should try it I give this place 5 stars !!!!!!
Delicious and fresh veggies. The wheat, thin crust was wonderful. Hard to believe it was delivery! Adios Dominos!

You can always tell a good pizzeria by the margherita. Lombardi's did not measure up because of the meager amount of flavorless mozzarella. Crust and sauce were of decent quality. We also ordered a side of meatballs. They were pricey but excellent.

Great vibe. The staff is having a lot fun behind the counter and they're full of personality. Sit at the counter and watch the men at work. Broth a boilin', punk rock music blaring... Yes. Totally awesome. I waited about 25 minutes and after eating there once can say I'd wait at least an hour for it again. My noodles were perfectly cooked, I added fresh seaweed and bamboo and it was dreamy. Go.
This is an updated review. I have tried the AYCE crab it's worth the money although it is a lot of work haha. I still love to come here for the red, white and blue special plus the lobster feast!

Joined friends for late night. Waited awkwardly for 5 minutes before finally getting my own cutlery from another table...and my own chair. Ordered a red sangria; given a white one and told "they taste the same anyway." Hello? We is person. If you prick us, do we not bleedz? I would rather has cheezburgerz at Shake Shackz.
Excellent, one of the best Italians I've ever eaten at. I had the chicken fantasia. Seems like a very busy place on the weekend

One of the biggest reasons why I miss living in the Chinatown area is this place. It's no frills but you can't argue the price. And the dumplings are pretty tasty too. They sell bags of frozen dumplings if you want to take them home.
Great selection and mix of healthy and comfort food. Nicely priced. Needed to feel better so I tried the burrito and it was excellent. Very efficient and friendly staff.

Wow I have to say that the Cuban Sandwich there is top notch. The server was genuinely a friendly person and very accommodating. Made us feel like we have been going there for years. Would definitely go back. This was a good find and we were just driving around looking for something to eat. Awesome treat for us.

Place gets 4 stars in my book great local spot never to noisy even though they have tv's surrounding the place with sports on every chanel great place for a quick bite to eat with a group of friends what more can I say from there onion soup and Blue cheese burger to the gigantic Delmonico stake on the menu mugs are always cold and smitwicks on tap keeps me coming back
OK food and quick seating. Servers disappear for long times. I do enjoy their salads though.

You have to place a reservation in person and wait until they call you but it's worth it. When you walk in, you're greeted emphatically in Japanese. They have some of the best ramen I've ever had. Karaka Men is my favorite at around $15. You should try their Mascarpone & Gelato for dessert. Just read the description of it on their dessert menu and you'll order it no questions asked, trust me.

Good sandwiches but over priced and expect to stand there for 15 minutes while they make your sandwich. I understand they can be busy but even when they aren't busy they take forever to make your order.

Small, cosy and nice garden, but roof is closed compeletly. Perfect for breakfast and quick lunch, very delicious, french-europe style kitchen. We had Croque Madame and Gratin, both were excellent. Be aware cash only

I enjoyed the sausage pizza we got. It was really thin. I am not giving it a five star because I don't think it is worth the long line to get in. I have had better NYC pizza but this is very good. I'm just glad we didn't have to wait over 20 minutes to be seated.

We had a reservation at 8. One person from our party hadn't arrived yet. Meanwhile I stubbed my toe on the way over and it was bleeding enough to make anyone uncomfortable. We asked the hostess, Courtney, if we could sit. (It was 8:01) she rudely said not until the final person arrived--- my boyfriend pleaded with her and told her I was bleeding and she didn't care at all. We Sat eventually and the food was fine and waitress was kind but not enough to make up for the hostess' rudeness and heartlessness.
Love all the sauce options! Best French fries spot in NYC!

Excellent fresh food!  Polite, courteous staff...Great place for lunch! Parking is limited, but within walking distance of downtown area. Also can call in and pick up orders....OMG and the soups are amazing!

I've been here a handful of times with my friends and husband over the last couple of years and every single time we leave completely satisfied with our food, drinks, the service and the atmosphere. Our last visit was with friends and we all have different tastes. I ordered sushi, my husband ordered the filet and friends ordered the ribeye and Chilean sea bass. The food was all around fantastic and the waiter was very helpful with wine suggestions and his attention to us in general. I will continue to visit Pure!

My husband and I went there last night for a spur of the moment dinner - what a wonderful find - didn't realize it was BYOB but no problems......definitely going to make a few return trips.   Food, service, atmosphe was excellent.   Loved the live Violin player during dinner - very relaxing pleasant evening with Excellent, Excellent food.   We shared a Marguerita pizza as an appetizer and since it was late decided to just get the Frittura appetizer as our dinner - couldn't finish it since portions are huge.   Cappucino, Espresso and Chocolate Souffle finished off our delicious meal. Thank you for a wonderful dining experience.

What A find. I love this place! Fantastic Service, Outstanding food. The Osso Bucco was a special and it was a delight! Their pasta was fresh and light. Well prepared. The seafood dish that was prepared for my wife was just fantastic. It is a BYOB which I do enjoy as I can bring some nice wines to go with our meals. they do set the table with some good stemware but I do bring my own. Menu is small but there are specials and we had 7 for dinner and not one complaint!!! From Apps to desert just an outstanding night!!
I love the food here! its great. The fresh steamed blue crabs are great for when me and friends have bbq's :)

Cute Salad bar; wish it was located closer to the mall so more people knew about it! I ordered the falafel salad; it was good, I had never tried it before so I wasn't in love with it but it was prepared well and tasted good!
Great food. Great service. Warm and friendly people. The pulled pork sliders were delicious and the fries that came with them were hot and crispy. I'll be visiting again.

To think this place was awarded the 'Best Pizza on Staten Island' by the SI Advance is laughable.  Dirty, dingy and with a wait staff of un-friendly gals, I found Denino's to be much ado about nothing. But more outrageous then their claims of being the best, is the fact that they messed up the bill THREE TIMES! According to my waitress, they "installed a new system which was making mistakes"...yeah, like triple charging me.  Joe and Pats quality of food is wayyy better and anyone that disagrees is just a cheap bastard!

I wouldn't normally give bad reviews for places but honestly I just needed to for this one. We were trying to have a special brunch but the place left me quite disappointed. The atmosphere is cool and we were pretty excited about it, but the ambiance was the only positive aspect to it in our experience. From the moment we sat down the server was pretty rude. She spilled water on the table and floor and did not even clean it up... We had to do it ourselves.  Waited for our food and the disappointment just grew from there. Our potatoes were cold... As if they'd been sitting out for half an hour before they brought it to us. On top of that, the sausages were cold as well and the eggs just looked sad. Again, this place probably has potential but I had such a bad experience there that I would never even go there for drinks. I'm not from Philly but whenever I visit again I'm gonna have to find another spot to have brunch.

Apparently they launched a new menu tonight, and it was lovely. The food was very good, quick, and the staff was excellent-- polite and attentive without being overbearing. I had the deconstructed chicken pot pie. I feel like 'deconstructed' anything can get you into trouble if you're not in the right hands. Luckily, I was safe and sound. The soup was fresh, hot, seasoned well, and the pastry was light. It had the perfect slight crunch when breaking into it. I had a pint and the boozy grapefruit float, which is refreshing, not sticky sweet. Too full to try desert this time, but I look forward to it in the future.

I came here real briefly to have a quick bite & a beer with a friend, was literally only here for 40 min.  I ordered the eggplant Sammy & it was pretty amazing.  The IPA I got was decent.  The best thing about this place is it's ambience.. The outdoor patio area is super cute!  Never seen anything like it... I'm knocking off one star because of the super weird bizarre server we had.  She literally talked and looked as though she popped some Molly, some xanny, as smoked 5 blunts to the dome.  She talked at like 20 words per minute & couldn't get straight to the point with anything.  Also moved super slow too.  It made my experience weird but it was kinda funny at the same time.  Me and my friend were just looking at each other like O___O

I've been coming to Paulie Gee's since they first opened and am a Greenpoint neighbor and local. I, like most, of course love the pizza and am sometimes willing to wait on the ridiculously long line to savor the woodfired goodness that is their craft. One saving grace that has kept me going back and continuously supporting the business has been their option to TAKE OUT pizza as sometimes I just can't do the massive hour long wait for a pie. I was just severely disappointed to learn they are no longer doing take out orders (come on, I am even willing to PICK UP! As no delivery option wasn't enough?) as Paulie just 'doesn't feel like doing it' anymore. Your pizza may be delicious, you may be building a small empire as far as I can tell and I applaud and support this, but must your regulars suffer if they aren't willing or able to wait in line for upwards of 45 minutes on average just to sit down? Have some humility. All it takes is a few cardboard boxes and someone to pick up the phone! The humanity! Please bring take out back. I even made a Yelp account just to post this. Thank you.

Every neighborhood needs a "go-to" chinese restaurant and this one is ours. After trying Rai Rai Ramen and being discouraged after that awful experience, this was a great replacement. Always good and the order is always right. Love their delivery service

Hands down the best steak house ever! I know this is a chain restaurant but it not like other chain restaurants. They don't have nearly as many as other chains and they really care about their food. They are situated usually in nicer areas with a higher clientele that appreciate steak. This location in Princeton, NJ is no different. You walk in there and you can tell it is not a t shirt and jeans place, it is a nice button down and slacks place. The ambiance is very laid back back but distinguished at the same time. I am a total steak guy and have been to many steakhouses but none compare. I always get the same thing. For appetizers the sliced tomato and onion, the tomato is always firm and juicy and the onion has the perfect bite and crunch. Next up my favorite, the NY Strip cooked medium rare with a side of whipped potatoes. How can you go wrong steak and potatoes. The steak is always, always cooked perfect. In the end if someone asked me where to get a good steak, I will always say Ruth Chris

I almost missed my flight home just to have this one more time before I left. Yes, its THAT serious.  You think food card in NYC, Yuck. SIKE!! Definitely not, this is probably the best thing I've ever had in New York and so randomly I crave this so bad it makes me crazy! I always just get the chicken and rice plate and ask for 2 or 3 more white sauces and one more of the red one, and it is just, to die for! Haha, cant wait until I visit New York again, just to have this (Oh, and to visit my wonderful fam of course haha)!

While it doesn't look like much from the outside this place has excellent food. Parking is a little sketchy but the food was worth the 5 minutes circling the place. I tried the chicken rollatini which is stuffed with prosciutto and sun-dried tomatoes, served with garlic mashed potatoes. It was off the chain. There is a nice little bar in there as well, which I could not take advantage of since it was a business lunch, but will definitely consider it if I'm in the area around happy hour.

I can't stop raving about this butcher to all of my friends! Actually, I've told everyone I know about it. This is a whole animal, organic, humanely raised, locally sourced butcher and it is halal. Plus, the place is spotless. Not only that, the prices are so good. I love food and the butchers there share my passion for it. They are so helpful and nice! Go there!

Tried Masa for lunch yesterday.  I would say the lunch was very good and the fish seemed pretty fresh.  I think my only complaint would have been that the sashimi pieces were pretty small, but it is an AYCE so I just ordered more.  The seafood soup was excellent with a nice spice to it (could have used a little more seafood) and the shrimp tempura were light, crispy, and very good.  The only thing keeping it from 5 stars is the $20 price is a bit high for lunch.  The service was excellent on the first round and food came out quickly.  The second round was a bit slower probably because it started getting pretty crowded. My server was very friendly. Other than that, I would definitely go again.

Ordered unagi sushi, tuna tataki and a beef ramen. Food was no where near what I expected it to be. The tuna tataki was cut way too thick and just tasted off.. Unagi sushi was below par.
