Beef in my ramen was cold. Would not recommend. Will never go back. Go to Asiana noodle shop on church st. They offer much higher quality service and food.
great tasting food, and I love the grape leaves! the hummus is great too, and the service is friendly. A nice place to bring a date.

My rating is based on their breakfast sandwich! I Just had a Taylor ham, egg and cheese (mozzarella) roll and it was amazing! It literally had five pieces of Taylor ham, two eggs and a thick, melted slice of cheese. It cost about 6 bucks and it was worth every penny. It took about 10 minutes to prepare and they're cash only. Only thing I'm worrying about is a possible heart attack, but again it was worth it! Much better than spending your cash on the stuff at DD. Enjoy!.

I have had about 10 events here in the past 12 years and every one of them was great.  Bobby makes sure every little detail is taken care of.  The first event was my rehearsal dinner.  Next was my wedding, then a surprise birthday party.   By the 4th event, I had so much confidence in Bobby and his staff, I would just tell him what we want, what the event was and I didn't worry about the details at all.  Everything was great!  From setting the tables to making sure our food choices were perfect.  I love everything about this place.  Just perfect!  My family and I have dinner here at least 8 times a year and I have guys night out here at least 4 times a year.  The Veal Saltimboca is the best anywhere around.  The wait staff is excellent.  Peggy, especially, is great.  She knows every plate my family is going to choose, even remembering I like extra salad dressing on the side.  I can't say enough and would definitely recommend it to everyone.

This is NOT New Haven apizza.  If you want that you go to the holy trinity,  Sally's, Modern, or Pepe's, or even Old World in Hamden.  This IS however New York pizza, like you would get at Lombardi's on Spring Street. THIS IS UPDATED AFTER A SECOND VISIT: A lot of great changes going on here.  First off the salads are AMAZING!  And no longer priced through the roof.  A small salad for $6 is actually quite large and as good as any I've had in the area.   Service is still excellent. The pies are better than I remembered.  But even though I order mine "well done" they come out what I would consider normal.  So not sure what terminology I need to get some black on the crust.  But if you're used to New Haven pies, DEFINITELY order you pie at least well done.   And yes, the personal pies are what would be considered small at Sally's.  The word "small" has been replaced by medium, which is a normal medium.   Excellent beer selection.  They have Palm.  Both me and the wife were happy about that. If you're looking for a different pizza experience in the area, check it out. HERE IS MY ORIGINAL REVIEW: And when you go in knowing that, the pies are good.  The service was excellent.  It's comfortable.  The beer is wonderfully cold.  There's easy parking. It's definitely a little pricy, but their small pies are really mediums by New Haven standards.  So if you take that into consideration.   Worth checking out if you just want something different, as we did.  And certainly preferable to having to deal with NYC.   But again, don't go in expecting the holy trinity.  Those are the finest pizza places on the planet, nothing will ever compare.  Go in for a good non-trinity pie.

Great place to eat out at for a quick and heavy meal. Its open late at night so its convenient to go to after a club or bar. Always have standard menu and a lot of different options. Great place for those vegetarian people out there. Price is average, usually it takes about 2 rolls to fill up on. They have also added new additional sauces and chutneys that makes the food even more flavorful. The atmosphere is great!
Just amazing little place . Nothing fancy just a feel good , smile on your face type of place .

My husband and I went here on a Wednesday evening based on a recommendation from my brother-in-law and was extremely pleased.  We saw the outside area but as it was late at night on a weeknight we just sat inside. We tried the BBQ Pork Ribs, a slice of the Texas pizza, chicken wings, and french fries with roasted garlic rosemary dipping sauce and shared it all.  First of all, I love ribs, and these were some of the best ribs you can find (except maybe if you go to the south for real BBQ).  They were amazingly tender and falling off the bone.  They gave us BBQ sauce and their chili sauce to put on there.  Both sauces were good but I decided to just eat the ribs as they were because I enjoyed them so much.  My husband planned out the order to eat so that he would have a rib as the last item so that would be the lingering flavor. The smoked mozzarella on the pizza was the most amazing thing I have ever tasted.  I was talking to the (assuming) owner to see if he would sell me just the mozzarella (which he said he has never done but might consider).  The sausage and onions and pesto just worked so well together.  As it was late on a weeknight, they had to take a regular slice and add the extra ingredients and it was still good.  I can't wait to go back to try it again when it was made as a texas slice.   Chicken wings were solid but not amazing.  They needed to be dipped in the sauce.  Its hard to get a smoky flavor since they don't smoke too long.  The french fries were cooked perfectly and my husband wanted to just drink the dipping sauce because he loved it so much. We enjoyed dinner so much that we ordered a whole pie (Max's) to go so we would have left overs for lunch the next day.  Again, we were so happy with the flavors and enjoyed every slice.   The atmosphere was a little strange inside, it was very casual and not at all what I was expecting.  They have very little seating inside and you order everything at the counter.  The man there (assuming owner) was very nice and talking to us about his smoking techniques. We will definitely be going back to this place again.
The food here is good but not the price, I'd eat elsewhere where real Mexican cook your food.

I will start by saying that ignorance is not a bliss. The Chicken was pretty good, the BBQ ribs need some help. The rice and beans were ok. The black beans yes they are from a can but had good flavor. I am an Executive Sous Chef and I will say that almost no one cook beans from scratch it's not good for your food cost and labor cost. And people please I lived in Miami for 13 years the only good thing Cubans can cook is Ropa Vieja and what they call a Cuban Sandwich. They use to much Cumin in there black beans.

Yes, 1 star. Why? Because I've come twice and although the gentleman helping me and  the cashier were kind and the cashier was friendly, the same woman has been rude to me. For what reason? I have no idea. I did not cone in rowdy, rude, obnoxious or any thing that would deserve for anyone to be giving me that kind of treatment. I've visited the France location (as a tourist) as well as the lower Manhattan location. Both were pleasant experiences. I even gave the benefit of a doubt and said maybe the first time I visited (which was on 6/11/14- thats right, almost 4 months ago), she was having a bad day so I went ahead with my purchase and chalked it up to one of those days. However, for the same person (I was told she was the manager or the head person at the time of my visit) to be so uncourteous (she acted as if I ran over her dog, or stole her car, or did something to personally affect her, even though I have never seen her before my first venture into the shop a few months prior), was completely unacceptable!!! This time I did not carry through with my purchase and I will wait until I am either downtown or back in France rather than come into contact with such treatment again, if I return at all. The whole experience left a horrible taste in my mouth.

Slightly tiny, but wonderful food. fresh pasta. legit bread perfect for your leftover pasta sauce and oil and herbs. You'll come out full and paying FAR less than you would any other italian place in soho.
Great bar with very good food. Bands every weekend and every game every Sunday. The staff is extremely friendly and once you get there they make you feel like family.

Very good food! EXCELLENT SANGRIA! The only thing about this restaurant is that a large portion of their dishes are focused on seafood. This place is right up fish lovers' alleys! Maybe one day I'll try them myself :)
The foods are fantastic period. Traditional Taiwan and Chinese food, not one of those who will rip you off. Overall this restaurant is great for everyone.
best mexican food i have had all year. take the loved ones and they will thank you for it. the staff is friendly and the price is right.. good quacamole!
It was ok! Try the other location you will enjoy the food and atmosphere more. However this location has more options and it is more of a bar and a diner atmosphere
I love the chicken! The girl server is ignorant. We can eat a whole chicken! Parking is bad during the weekends. Go on weekdays. Cash only!

The best brunch in the area, hands down. Their specials are always imaginative and delicious. Their different French toast creations are legendary. They are so nice and the prices are so reasonable it almost seems impossible. The only downside is that you have to get there very early to be one of the first in, or be prepared to wait a long time. Not uncommon to wait an hour BUT I do it all the time because it's beyond worth it. Plus they take your number so you can walk around the surrounding area, and they'll call you when you're up. They have an amazing selection of house made sausages. My favorite is the chicken/apple. I often just order a bunch off the menu and take most of it home, just so I can try things before they leave the menu!! Seriously, this place is amazing.

I was excited about going here but that soon was over. The food is overpriced for the portions. I got oxtails, rice and cabbage. Best part of the meal was the cabbage. I am like 99% sure I was given goat and not oxtails! They were too sweet and the rice was like white from the Chinese restaurant, I will not be back.
Pretty friggin' great. Can't go 5 stars because it was unbelievably loud, but it's the kind of food that shuts you up because you're just focusing in on every bite.
Yummy Pizzas, best in town, specially tomato basil with crispy crust. Though, they need to work in their customer service skills...

I went for dinner and had the fried broccoli and mushroom appetizer, then the angry crab spaghetti. It was not all that good- the pasta was especially weak, and a very small portion.  It was about 6 bites. There were a few tiny bits of crab on it. The seasoning was bland.  The smoked chocolate and verbena ice cream dessert was also average.  I was disappointed to pay so much for unimpressive food.  Maybe the lunch is more worthwhile.

My wife and I live in the neighborhood and Era is our go to when we don't feel like cooking. We have been eating here nearly weekly for at least two years now.  The food is excellent (Doro Tibs and Kik Alicha!!!).  Two can eat an excellent meal for $20 (if you don't get drinks).

The the relaxed ambiance of the cocktail lounge is popular with guest. Upon arrival we were greeted with a warm reception and promptly. The food was delicious. The service was great. A tad bit pricey but you are paying for all that you get besides the food.

Went here for dinner this week. The food was absolutely great. Their mixes of different spices and foods that combined the different Asian cuisines was great. Then, I got the Bento box for desert and it was amazing. I highly recommend this restaurant.
Cheeseballs aren't good for you, but you don't have to eat them. But you do, because you're hungry and they're free and you've been drinking highly affordable beer at the Levee.

this place is amazing kinda dark from outside but dont be afraid they have lots of room inside i got the red curry fish bowl amazing plus they give you a hugeeee salad with it its like a meal by itself everything for 8$ come on , good meal great location legit vietnamese fooddd

Very disappointed. Ordered delivery for Bhendi and Naan. It was delivered at 9pm. The delivery person called me at 7.30pm and brought the food. Since I couldn't take the delivery at that time, I asked him to come back at scheduled time. Eve after that he came back at 8.40pm. Luckily, I was available at that time. The food was utter cold. Naas was kept in the aluminum foil-kind of a bag which was wet from inside due to condensation. Naan was cold. Vegetable was cold. Taste wise, I don't care for the oily food. The bhendi subji was too oily. The naan was so think that I really went ahead and measured with the ruler. I wasn't surprised when it measured close to 1 inch! Wish I would have read the reviews properly before ordering.
Amazing place.  Can be very overwhelming if it is your first time here but there is always someoen around to direct you to the best food spots.

I'm only giving this place a star because my friend (somehow) likes the chimichangas. Let me tell you in one word: AVOID. First off, no offense, but this is a "mexican" restaurant run by chinese people. Wrong kitchen to be in. I had ordered the chicken enchilada meal, and when i got it and i opened it, it just didn't look right. it basically looked like chicken fajita. It was loaded with peppers and onions, not wrapped, and there were 3 soft tacos underneath it. If you look at a picture of an enchilada, and if you have eaten enchiladas before, that is not the description of an enchilada. So I call them and ask them about it. The woman on the phone (WITCH) told me that they make a "different type of enchilada" with all of that stuff on it. They also said that they always make food for my location all of the time and just kept going off on that. My friend also ordered the nacho salad, which was basically black beans thrown in the corner of the box. No, no, no. You bet I won't be back.

I can only give them 3 stars. The food is phenomenal but the service isn't.  I even placed an order over the phone and still had to wait 20 min and left without my food because they took too long and I had to leave.

Excellent spicy Boiled Dumplings and Fried Sesame Pancake with Ham and Egg, Duck or a lot of other varieties Descent Hot and Sour Soup as well a Corn and Egg Soup. Average Fried Dumplings though their dumplings is more expensive than the competition but at least if taste hygenic. They also have Prunella juice-thats great considering how hard it is to find it nowadays. If you want to get a seat, good luck since a lot of the patrons, and four of them at a time take their time (an hour) eating 5 pieces of dumplings. So it is not a place to eat inside unless you are so fortunate for find a seat. *To the owners, please implement a 30 minute seating while consuming food policy and no seating for people who have not ordered or simply leave their items on the chair. For every current patron who are ordering $1 and sitting for an hour, you are losing customers who would have ordered at least $10 worth at a time while only taking at most 30 minutes.
Stopped here again recently and the food was excellent as always. We've experienced intermittent service mainly due to staffing but this place is worth being patient. An unexpected gem in the area!

Great atmosphere and all, but the portions are a bit too small and a bit over-rated. I think it's a place you should go to if you haven't gone before, but it's not really a place to go to regularly...

We had a table of 9, the had a dinner special chicken/shrimp marsala, not even a hint of marsala in the dish, there were peppers and onions which hindered any flavor there was in the sauce. When I told the cook the dish was undesirable, he said good thank you and walked away. 5 of us at the table ordered the dish, 5 of us disliked it. Chicken Saltimbocca was overcooked. so brown it looked burned. glasses were filthy. I would NOT go back again
best grandma slice period!

I have been in Philly for 2 days and was really looking forward to dining at Amada. To start off my family and I walked in 10 minutes early for our 8pm reservation and the hostess did not even find our reservation, after 2 or 3 mins of a blank look on her face displaying a great lack of interest for seating us she was able to find our reservation.  We were asked to wait at the bar where after 40 mins of waiting still had no table, after the lack of ownership from the now 2 hostess that were just standing there not able to honor their part of the reservation (which was made 3 months in advance) we simply walked out and dined at another restaurant. The name Amada will never even be coming out of my families mouth and we will not be making any plans to go back because if the service starts like this I do not want to see how it will go as the night continues.

They've done a great job turning the location into a versatile bar/restaurant and mentioned plans for live music down the line. The outdoor patio is great and completely unexpected. The service was great. I certainly plan to go back.

I went on Sunday to blend on the water with my brother. I had a great time and we both loved the food . But best of all was the service I received as a customer. Syeda the host was the best because of her I would go back anytime !!! Even though Valet took. Forever but the host made me forget about it and I had one of the beat time Sunday night. I would go back to blend on the water anytime. The atmosphere was incredible including the service and the food.
Ok

Hands down the only pizza place on the planet that can compare to the holy trinity in New Haven (Sally's, Modern, Pepe's).  First off, they have a REAL brick oven (not a metal oven lined with bricks).  Secondly, one of the owners was a longtime cook at Modern so he knows how to make perfect pies.  Thirdly, they are not afraid to cook the pies they way they're supposed to be cooked: WELL DONE.  I am a firm believer that if my hands are not black after eating a pie, then I didn't really have pizza.  Beautifully blackened around the edges, perfectly cooked, these pies are mini culinary masterworks. And one note to pizza eaters: order small pies.  ALWAYS.  There isn't a pizza joint in the world that can make a perfect large pizza.  Every connoisseur I know orders only smalls, otherwise you have no right to complain.  Just saying, you might thing you know pizza, but if I see you eating a large, I know you haven't a clue.

I know people LOVE this place, but I find it a bit meh. Everything (at least in the Mexican part of the menu) is fairly spicy. The place is really popular, so it's not unusual for there to be an hour+ wait - on weeknights. Forget it on weekends. They don't take reservations. The parking lot is shared with urgent care and I've spent 20+ minutes looking for a spot before because it gets THAT crowded. Personally, it's not the Mexican place for me. But, portions are big and the prices are reasonable.
great menu choices

Best Kale Salad Ever! I've lost over 100 lbs over the past year primarily by eating a lot of salad, so when I say that Vital serves the BEST kale salad, I know what I'm talking about! The chef cuts the kale into thin strips and adds a touch of cumin to the dressing. Delicious! And, the chicken was just right! I even enjoyed the water, which is served with a slice of cucumber and lemon.  The food was so good, I just had to tell the chef! The staff is friendly and the service was great. I'm looking forward to going there again.

Favorite sushi place of all time. Been here numerous times. A little pricy but well worth the splurge. I highly recommend their tuna "sandwich, " spicy girl roll, fantasy roll, caterpillar roll, and yummy special roll. Although everything I have  had here has been outstanding. Favorite place by far!!

We scheduled Isabella's on the night of a concert at Beacon Theatre which is only a few blocks away. Great location but not an awe inspiring dinner venue. Nice outdoor seating for al fresco dining experience with portable heaters to stay warm even on colder evenings. The artichoke salad was a good starter. The bread and bean paste is a questionable deliverable. The ravioli were served on a flat plate, were hard and I would not reorder. The lasagna was good but tasted a bit like bottled sauce. The apple cobbler was a good dessert choice but rice pudding was not. Espresso was delivered cold. Service is not as attentive for a restaurant of this level. Location, location, location solves many ills.
The best Italian food in the neighborhood, hands down.  Their bruschetta with ricotta and honey was divine, and their gnocchi was so savory.  Love their food and even their sidewalk seating.

Generally speaking I really love this place. I have been going there for years, on and off, alone and with friends and have always had a great experience. Tonight, however, was one of the worst experiences I have ever had at any restaurant. I was basically threatened with physical assault by one staff person (male) and told it was ok by the supposed manager (female) because I had problems with my order. I really like this place but cannot believe that this is what the owners/management want in their staff. Great place but unfortunately reprehensible staff tonight. I'm happy to talk to any managers who contact me. Customers certainly deserve better,

Always happy with the food. It's a short distance away and I'll find myself there when I don't feel like cooking. I always have the chicken cutlet sandwich and I've yet to be disappointed. Keep up the good work!
The people working there were so nice, so I feel bad....but the food was extremely unpalatable.  Everything I ordered..
I went there for lunch, and it was a good sandwich, price was right, steak was fresh.

Chef Mike is the man!!! Ribs are bangin'!!! Crawfish hush puppies are to die for!!! Potato salad is the best ever!!! Jambalaya, when he has it, is amazing!!! I can't leave without macaroni and cheese! It's awesome!!! Too bad I live in Florida now! Sure do miss that place!!!
Great place. Amazing food. Everybody was really nice who worked there. And def a fun place to watch football

I really like what this place has become. There's a perfect balance between neighborhood/irish pub and craft haven. Jesse, the owner/GM has been putting a great deal of thought into his draft beer selections. There's always a variety of styles, flavors and brands. Whether you're looking for sweet, sour, hop or malt bombs, you'll find something here. I regularly see the draft tech in cleaning lines which tells you just how committed Poor Henry's has become to the cause. The burgers are a staple for me, but I can also confidently recommend the sliced steak, crab cakes, and chicken pot pie. The garlic sauteed broccoli is bangarang. Stop in on a Sunday night for bottle share. All the servers are friendly, whether you're in for the first time or 100th. They try hard to make you feel welcomed and move you in and out quickly at lunch time. Worth a visit.  I hear there's tap takeover in the works.  Better check the calendar.

This has got to be the best pizza in East Haven, CT. From the first bite to the last it is simply delicious. You can't go wrong with pizza from here. I come to CT maybe twice a year and I never leave without coming here for their great pizza. The place is a little hidden gem. The customer service is a A+ all the way. Such a friendly staff and they make you feel welcome as soon as you enter the door. So, if you want really good pizza this is the place to go. Once you go here, they will be your go to pizza place whenever in the East Haven, New Haven area. Pizza is so good, I buy extra to freeze and bring back to Woodbridge VA.

I've been to Alta on multiple occasions and am always blown away by the food! I've even done the option to try one of everything on the menu, so it's safe to say I approve of the food. Drinks are strong...makes for a fun group dinner experience! Great ambiance. Always a big hit!

Great classic divey New England clam shack. There are a few sparse tables inside, and some picnic tables facing the water (and street) outside. The location is also a lot more convenient to the major highways that a lot of other shacks along the coast. The prices here (especially the lunch platters) are very reasonable compared to other similar places nearby. We ordered whole belly clam lunch platter, and a lobster roll. The lobster roll was $15 at the time, and was generously filled. It was pretty good, a dedicated lobster roll place would do better - if you are only looking for a lobster roll. The clams (after adding a few packets of salt) were great, expertly fried, and tasted fresh - a generous helping came with the lunch platter. The fries were excellent, and the best I have had in a while! There are also option for non seafood eaters, and our dining companion was pleased with their cheesesteak. Overall, it's not mind blowingly amazing food, but if you are looking for a decently priced variety of good tasting seafood, this is a great option.

We were there tonight for the first time. Nice place, pleasant ambience. The hostess checked for availability like the place was over crowded. Half of the place was empty... The waiter was professional. I had a burger with fries. The burger was perfect. The fries were too tick and salty. I could not eat them. My husband had short ribs. Nice presentation but again too salty. He could not enjoy it. We asked to speak to the chef but he never came to our table. The bill was almost $90. I do not think we will be frequent guests.Sad!!! It is good to see new business in our town.

Really fun and beautiful place to rest We were on our way to boston from New York and it's a beautiful place to rest and sightsee There is a dinosaur state park next door for the kids! Waitress Kristen was real sweet and food was excellent fresh and hot! And yes big portions! You'll see

If you have ridiculously horrible vision such as I do , you'll most likely go blind attempting to read the menu ( which is on the wall) Not crazy about ordering family style and definitely not crazy about the food. Luckily I eat like a bird , but for those who actually spend money to eat like a king .prepare for the food poisoning of a lifetime . Don't say I didn't warn you!

Do yourself a favor and don't bother trying this place. ..service is horrible and slow,  but the food is even worse! !!!! Tasteless in a way that is hard to explain! !!! Lamb chops were an embarrassment,  lamb shank horrible! ! Fish smelled so fishy I gagged and the salads tasteless! !!! So sad.

I was taking some clients and wanted to show my appreciation.  I had made reservations online for four for 7 pm.  However, our table wasn't ready till 7:35.  Service was fine and the food was ok. As we are finishing dinner the manager comes to our table at 9pm +/- and he tells me that we have to leave.  I thought he was  joking. He wasn't.  He said I was told I had to leave by 9. I  explained that he was mistaken, my reservation was made online and I never spoke to anyone.  Needless to say my wife and I were completely embarrassed as we're my guests. I then emailed a complaint to MP Taverna and I have waited months for a response.  Never received one. I find it appalling.  That was the second and last time I will set foot in that establishment.  They try to be upscale but they are lacking in class and etiquette.

Must. Get. More. Buns! Best ramen I've had in the city and hands down the best pork buns around. Just go. Get the pork buns and the Karaka  Men spicy ramen you won't be disappointed. If you don't like spicy, order the Akamaru Modern. Full of flavor and delicious. Adding the soft boiled egg is a must. Absolutely worth the 1 - 1 1/2 wait.

Starting off with the good. The food was excellent, expensive but very tasty and I didn't go home hungry. Our server was mediocre but got the job done. Where the experience really went sour for me was with their head of house. He was uppity and pretentious and held the attitude that seating us was ruining his day, newsflash its your job. He was running around frantic the entire meal which made us feel uncomfortable. He then came to our table and said that he needed the table and we had to be out in 30 minutes. Our entrees hadn't even arrived yet and we wanted dessert and at least another cocktail... Needless to say this place would have much been more enjoyable without him, too bad that one person can ruin the experience. Side note there were tons of waitstaff standing around which made maneuvering in a small space more challenging. Good chef bad management.
If you like 70's wood paneling, Budweiser and your typical old school underwhelming bar food this place is for you

Being from San Diego where there are many great mexican places to eat ...found this place on yelp...and it was great...The.Tito Santana guacamole....MUY Bueno...  Blood Orange margys ..nice kick.   Mixtas Enchiladas ...hit the spot ...Got excellent service from start to finish .Would definitely good back for more
Delicious and great atmosphere!

The place was ok. I had the roast beef , eggplant and mozzarella , my friend had the roast pork with broccoli rape. The pork was dry and my sandwich was ok. Did not like the fact that all the cold cuts were pre- sliced and not boars head. They charge enough to slice the stuff fresh and have quality stuff. 2 sandwiches and 2drinks $27

This food truck was moved conveniently to outside the Firefly Brewery where I was meeting up with others. I'm here for my Academy class reunion this weekend and we all ordered various sandwiches. I was quite impressed that they could turn out such a tasty treat from a truck. It was perfectly toasted and the pickles were crisp and flavorful. I wish they were in Oregon! You are lucky to have them here in the Hartford area.

Frequently dine in and order from here for lunch- mostly subs, Panini, salad (balsamic is great!),and pizza.  Unlike the other reviews, I didn't have a problem with the red sauce, but I also haven't ordered dinner from here.  The hot subs I've ordered have been delicious, paninis have been ok, pizza is quality. Could be nice for a date- they have outdoor seating and when inside the restaurant it doesn't feel like a pizzeria.

Delicious! Beer selection was superb, food was delicious-so tasty and fresh! Our server was friendly and helpful.  Price is right, and the food leaves nothing to be desired. Atmosphere is casual and cozy, and rumor has it this place used to be a McDonald's! This is Vermont!

Great looking bar, great food and a wonderful selection of beer. Beers can be a bit pricey, but that's expected when you're dealing with specialties. Awesome late night happy hour, but unfortunate the patio isn't open late.
I love this place!!!!

You can find my boyfriend and I here on almost every holiday- I have nothing but good things to say about this place! It was heartbreaking that they were out of alligator bites when we had gone the last time, but where one appetizer isn't, another is there to make up for it. Have a meal with a pitcher of sangria, and you're good to go!!!

If you're looking for fresh meat pies, not the place to go. Everything is made elsewhere, frozen, and brought to the Whalley Ave location. When you order, they stick it in the microwave to heat it up. If I want microwaved meat pies, I'll go to stop n shop. The middle was still cold, the beef was tough, and the gravy was rubbery. It's like a restaurant of leftovers. Not good at all.
awesome pies...... can't wait to go back.

By far one of the best lobster sandwiches I have ever had! Not too creamy and the lobster tasted as fresh as they come! They have plenty of plugs to charge your phone. All in all the best place to eat at in the Newark airport
This restaurant doesn't know a recipe. A whole Branzino was ruined by an inappropriate tomato sauce. A breakfast frittata had a full salad atop. Doesn't the chef eat his/her dishes? I'll not go back.

This place is very inconsistent! They are known to be a high quality chinese restaurant,  but they are not. The first 2 times I ordered take out, the food was delicious, fresh and definitely worth the money I spent. This time I ordered something different and had it delivered and it was not even edible. I ordered the spring rolls, which are basically a mush of breading and overcooked cabbage. I also ordered sesame chicken and fried rice. The rice was the only thing I ate because the chicken was filled with breading, and compeletely soggy and once you remove all that, the chicken was so hard I couldn't even chew it. Sesame chicken is supposed to be lightly coated and crispy. I am so disappointed.  And the worst part is, there is no manager available to talk to about this, only a kid who answers the phone! Never going back there again, I could have probably gotten the same quality food or maybe better at any crappy chinese restaurant. Truly a disappointment! I wasted $25 on basically fried rice.

I've been coming here for the 13 years living in Morrisville. Consistently delicious whether eating in or out. Service is always great, even on their most crowded evenings. I'm living in Florida now and I miss the Chamberberg pie so much. Their pasta dishes are also wonderful and each has its own unique sauce. I can't wait to come visit! I'm well over due for a la villa fix!!!

Was here yesterday for a work meeting and had the spicy tuna handroll and calamari, it was excellent!   I like dim lighting, but it was definitely a little dark. That is really my only complaint.  Food & service were great.

Wonderful food prepared by a great chef.  Very creative, tasty, creole-inflected menu, different from what you find at every other place.  Warm and friendly atmosphere, and live jazz at least once a week.  More people should try this place. I think some people don't come because they are convinced it isn't for them, but this is based on a mistaken impression.

This place is great. Love the food.  The taste is amazing. No matter what you get it's very good.  I just ordered their chicken satay, chili paneer, Bombay wok special (rice and noodles combo) amazing.   Go try it.  Service is great.  Small place but worth going over and over.

This place was excellent.  It is fixed-priced but I have to say we ate like kings.  This place is perfect for a special night out -- we were surrounded by people on dates. I started off with cocktail that was very good -- I ended up ordering 2 more of the same. The menu was complicated but our server took the time to answer all of our questions.  Everything that came to the table was extraordinary looking and well presented.  Between the four of us, we tried everything and no one complained. I can't wait for another occasion to present itself so I can return for another fantastic meal.

Not ready for prime time. French is a difficult language for most. Duck should lead the menu. My duck was flavorless and not warm. The Calamari Salad was petite and less than a fresh catch. The Cornish Hen was flavorful but the size of an appetizer. This place is ideal for young couples exploring atmosphere without a budget concern. I enjoy paying for great food or satisfying  portions, but when both are missing, who wants to order dessert?

If you plan to dine here, plan to stay a very long time. Service is slow, it took 45 minutes to get only two apps, then another half hour for our entrees. Staff is not too friendly or attentive. Food is over priced and portions are too small. I wouldn't waste your time. They will not last long.

I recently tried this restaurant with two friends in from out of town who had heard of it and suggested it themselves. I love their other restaurants Hundred Acres (for dinner) and Five Points (for brunch) so was excited to try it. Overall I thought the menu at Cookshop was somewhat limited. However everything we had was very good - deviled eggs for "snack" and sweet potato fritters - the vegetarian pasta looked delicious although I did not try it - the Amish chicken is a HUGE entrée. I had the swordfish which was good but small. The main attraction to this restaurant is the desserts - we tried 3 - the peanut butter and jelly sundae was delicious, the raspberry tort with basil ice cream was delicious as was the apple tart. The service was very remarkable. Overall I recommend.

Everything is burnt. I always try and take another try, because there was one day, one loaf, ages ago that wasn't burned and tasted good. But since then, bread, scones, you name it, black and bitter on the bottom.
Very  bad service and personel, not kind at all and very snobish. Not accomodant at all. To avoid
Charming cafe in the midst of a residential street of brownstones. Ate brunch here which was a nice fusion of typical western european brunch and Greek food. Pouched eggs were spot on!

I never write reviews but I have to for this restaurant as I am so disappointed/angry.I had Sunday brunch here with 5 other friends and we all got food poisoning from this place. It was a terrible way to end the week.

Really dig this place. Ordered from seamless a few times but now that I live closer I pop in and the people are super nice. Slightly pricey, but worth it for what you get. Quality ingredients and good tasting food, period. Haven't tried it yet but apparently they are open till 4a on the wknds which is much needed in crown heights.

One of my favorite Italian restaurants. Get a big kick out of seeing all the mob movies as I'm eating. There's a number of items on the menu that I must try and one is the meatball salad appetizer. As for main courses they make the best porkchops Sicilian.  But I believe the most outstanding quality of Goodfellas is the wait staff they are truly professional and take care of you like no other place in town

Go! Go! Curry! - A Stoners Review Atmospheric Anxiety - 1 Dude, for how cramped this place is, it rates very low on the Anxiety scale. Four tables and a soda-fridge barely leave room for you to stand while ordering, but that's ok! Besides needing headphones to drown out the overzealous NYU students, this place is so gully, its a total No Flex Zone. Feel free to fulfill Kurt Cobain's wishes and "come as you are." Menu & Ordering - 5 Don't you hate when you're medicated and can't decide on what you want? Go Go Curry keeps your anxiety in-check by making SIZE and extras your only real options. Even then, you're left with 7 or so combos that are represented by HUGE, no frills photos posted on the overhead display. Repeat After Me: "Ayyo let me get that Grand Slam" Easy-Peasy- Japanesey   Flavor/$$ - 3.5 We all know everything tastes better when you're stoned and I REALLY wanted to give this place a 4.5 on first-bite flavor. The rice is fluffy, the Katsu is large & crispy, but... they were a little cheap on the curry. And even the curry itself was quite bland when compared to their own Midtown location. Also, the flavor palate is too limited to hit up on the reg. When flowers cost $20/gram, you gotta get the best for your buck where you can and in the  sub-$15 flavor category, Udon West still reigns supreme. #struglife - 5 If you cant satisfy two starving stoners for under $15 here, then you're doing it wrong. Grab a Grand Slam w/ extra rice and call it a day. If their stomach capacity is limited by the fabric content of their skinny jeans, you'll have leftovers.  Which brings me to our next category... Reheatability (microwave) - 1 Listen. Just don't. Biggest disappointment of my night. I was banking on stretching my half of a Grand Slam into two meals. You know, so I didn't have to pay ATM fees for a sh!tty deli sandwich later-on. Nah son. forget it. The rice gets harder than Hempcrete. Give the leftovers to a homeless dude IMMEDIATELY, else it may be a crime against humanity. Overall Stoner Friendly rating : 4 Peace, viZine viZion

We had 6 of us who came here late night after we watched Wicked. It looked like a neat spot and different.  So we waited for a table.  When we finally got seated, the waitress took our order and we were excited and even more hungry. Then she came back telling us about their policy.  We did not know there was a mandatory $20 per customer order policy per person.  we had 6 of us and we wanted to share everything, but some didnt want to order 20 dollars worth of food.  I think this is BS for not telling us before we ordered or sat down, like how are we suppose to know and they didnt even want to make an exception for a large group like us.  I don't recall if there was a sign, but we were like EF this and we walked out.
Awesome spot to stop by for a beer and a bite. Cheap beer you can drink outside. Really friendly staff and the food is awesome. Great 90s jams and you can play jenga if you want.

Die vielen hervorragenden  Bewertungen sind mir dann doch ein Rätsel. Ja, New York ist insgesamt ein teures Pflaster, aber hier gab es für sehr viel Geld gerade mal Durchschnittskost. Ich habe allerdings in USA noch keinen guten Italiener gefunden. Damit meine ich schmackhafte italienische Hausmannskost. Um die gleiche Qualität wie bei meinem Kleinstadt-Italiener zu bekommen, muß ich hier wohl mindestens 100€/Person investieren. Geht mal nach Berlin, Yankees, da gibt es Dutzende sehr guter Italiener für nicht mal die Hälfte! Amerika hat einfach keine Esskultur, basta!

Best Macarons I've ever had! Seriously so good. I chose the box of 6 for $24.00. You pick your own box, which is a little work of art to hold the delicious macaroons. I selected: Fleur de Sal Caramel Coconut Lemon Verbena Pistachio Chocolate Almond Cherry The shop itself is adorable. The interior design is adorably classic Parisian pastels, black and gold. The shop girls are quick and try to keep the line moving, so be prepared to be ushered through the process rather quickly.
This is by far my favorite Indian restaurant in the city. I've been here so many times and it's always delicious. The idli and dosa combo is my personal favorite!
this place is awesome!!!!! 5 stars all the way. Phenomenal wine/beer list... Amazing pizza... Excellent service... Everything about this place is perfect
Good food. Fast service and I love the fact that you can build your own burger. Drinks are good too.

I went there for lunch with my bf after receiving a coupon in the mail. He had all you can eat sushi- he said he loves it which is saying a lot bc he is definitely a sushi fanatic. The rolls looks plump full of fish and fresh and always served artistically. I got the Chinese spicy dishes which was delicious! Nearest place to get szchewan style dishes. They were so accommodating to all changes that I wanted including changing the entire set of vegetables in dish to ones I requested. Highly recommended and be my go to spot.

Didn't even try the food, just had the cheesecake, which seems to be what Junior's is known for. It was a bit pricey but very good, much what I expected. I recommend splitting the cheesecake, though. I'm a glutton and even I couldn't finish my whole piece. If you walk up and get the cheesecake at the counter, there is some seating outside, but it is limited, so you may have a hard time finding a table in the rush after the Broadway shows get out.

Never order from these people again! The driver went to the wrong house and had me wait outside for over 20 mins and he never showed up, then when he called I told him he was at the wrong house he spoke no English and gave me a hard time and left then when I called the store they told me that the driver said he was outside for long time and he won't come back very disrespectful people.

I am impressed with this place. I love pizza, but Solid oven pizza was my frist time to try. Amazing and delicious. It 's one of my best pizza experience of NYC! I can't wait to go back for more. (after I missed NYC's Biggest Pizza Party)

Sleazy! Even though a burrito costs $8.50-9.00, the owners recently started requiring you to spend $10 minimum in order to pay with a credit card in a disingenuous attempt to force you to buy extra items like sugary sodas. That move by management is offensive to formerly loyal customers of their shop. I need to use my business credit card when I buy their burritos because it is for meals during work time. I'm not going to be forced to buy things that I don't need and have to throw away every time I want a burrito. Burrito Box has lost me as a customer as a result, and I used to buy burritos from them several times a week. If they reduce the credit card minimum to an honest and reasonable $8, i.e. in line with a burrito's price, then I'll come back. Until then - I'm boycotting and encouraging many others to boycott them to. Their kind of ridiculous credit card minimum practice cannot be tolerated.

I haven't eaten anything but the artichoke pizza in here. I don't know why anyone would. Because if i had the choice, i would never eat anything else ever, let alone while I'm anywere near this place.

Never had a meal I didn't like here. I've been for brunch, lunch, and dinner and it's all great. It can get noisy but not too bad. Back patio is really nice, especially for brunch. I also like hanging at the bar. They have a tv and play the games, which is nice. When the World Cup was playing this summer we wanted to watch the US game there but when we asked the guy if they would play sound, he gave us a totally unnecessarily snooty answer. Other than that, the ppl are really friendly.  Definitely recommend.

Cranky staff, or was it just my Groupon?  After arguing that it wasn't a "meal for 2" Groupon, they agreed to let me spend the $25 on myself (lunch - thanks!). I asked for a $25 lunch - chef's choice. It wasn't great.  I still got a bill, for $6.25 - for tax and a $4.50 tip.  Really??!!  So the waitress got $4.50 for staring at me while I ate.  No soup, no salad, no water. Never again. I wouldn't go here with any sort of coupon, and don't speak directly to the cranky chef.  Guess what you can do with my 6 bucks.
Great place!!! Excellent food!!!

5 simple reasons for this yelp review. 1. Bar staff kept touching her nose and not washing her hands. 2. Louisiana restaurant and you can't even make a proper sazerac? 3. You see I have empty pint glass for over five minutes and proceed to break down the bar with out offering me another drink yet my food still hasn't arrived. 4. Food takes over an hour and the restaurant is only half filled with guest and then you come up to ask me if everything is ok? 5. The food was sub par simply put. The sugarfreak specialty should not be on the menu...
We have been there many a times for dinner and it is never disappointing. Great service, good food , BYOB = v happy family

I've come here several times and haven't had a bad experience. Had a dinner party here once for a friend and they were very accommodating. The fish tacos are amazing! The mojitos here are very strong and delicious! Highly recommended!

Very fun place, especially for visitors.  If you like crowds, come on the weekend.  All the shops are open and there are some great options for food.  If you don't like crowds, try another day of the week.  I know some of the shops are closed on certain days, so be sure to check ahead of time.

Early on a Saturday evening when we needed a restaurant close to The Stone, we ended up here after looking at several other options. We had a pleasant meal with good options ranging from paninis and soup to lamb shanks. Attractive surroundings. I'd recommend it when you're in the neighborhood, though not as a destination.

I went to Grants for my birthday recently and was very disappointed with the service and the fact there were no specials that night.  I am not sure if the slow service was due to the waiter or the kitchen but the restaurant was not busy.  I heard the couple at another table complain that their son's burger was short french fries and he said he would tell the kitchen but didn't offer them more.  I felt the food was ok - ordered the rack of lamb and the potatoes were cold and vegetables nothing special.  My husband ordered a burger and he said it was greasy.  My daughter had the pork chop and that was the best dish at the table. It was quite good.  So, my husband let the restaurant know it was my birthday when he made the reservation and then when we arrived - and there was no acknowledgement of this at all even when dessert was served. So, overall I was not impressed with the service and the food.  I love Bricco and will go back there but not expecting to visit Grants again.

Great Soul Food and a great price! Went one night because it was near our hotel. The staff was exceptional despite it being close to closing time. I went back the next day to try their breakfast and was not let down. They had a great selection of the usual dishes and a couple of uniques items. I had the savory spinach pancakes with ricotta cheese which was really tasty. The only thing I would like to see improved are their operating hours, as they close pretty early. (7:00pm)
One of my favorite place. Tried almost everything from menu, dosa, paratha or chats, everything every time is very good.

I walked by this place several times and so glad I walked in.  Super friendly staff, you can tell they take pride in this new spot.  Bar is great with cool cocktail list.  Brunch has just begun and I highly suggest you try it (just hit the gym after).  The menu is non traditional but delicious.  I would suggest you go, try anything, and you will love it. My new go to spot in the neighborhood, see you there.

This is a great find, look out for it. Their breakfasts are excellent and I stronly recommend the oatmeal. The eggs are also great. The menu is all organic and delicious. The decor is also refreshing and the staff very friendly. If you are in the 30th West search out for this place.

The food was very good considering it was vegan. Only complaint was that we had to wait 30min for them to seat is even though we had a reservation. They did give us free croquettes to apologize and they were awesome!  Will definitely come back even just for the tasty cocktails
The square slices are okay..nothing amazing..in fact the sauce is too salty for my  liking

I was here on a Saturday night and it wasn't that exciting. Admittedly, this is *the* place to get great beers in Bayonne as their selection is phenomenal! There are nice, big HDTVs, comfortable sofas, good food and excellent beers, but it just feels like something is a little bit missing here, maybe just the vibe on that specific night was all that great. Still very nice, though!
The food is consistently very good but what stands out are the burgers! The atmosphere is basic but the service is welcoming!
The sandwiches are dynamite.  If you are looking for a real italian deli then this is the place.
Ribs are VERY fatty! I felt like I was eating grizzle the whole time.... The fries were good??

love the food, love the small details of the restaurant, and love the staff! my favorite is the cinnabon pancakes they have fro brunch and the dinner menu is also pretty good! Wednesdays they have 1/2 off bottles of wine which is great!!!

How does this place have 5 star review?  $3 price tag for a small choc chip cookie, $5 for a small iced coffee?  This place is such a rip off for mediocre tasting products.  I got a slice of vegan banana bread ($3.50 for a tiny slice) because I was starving and out of options one morning.  It was dry and hardly worth half the amount.  I work right near by and would love to give them business if the prices were somewhat reasonable, but I refuse to support them at these prices.

My first time at Tango Pizza was truly an amazing culinary experience!  The first thing I noticed was how clean and neat the Argentinian restaurant is.  They have an open view of the kitchen which I like because there is nothing to hide.  The dinning room was classy and inviting, but certainly not a black tie type of place.  I sat at a side table where I ordered the Fugazza Pizza, fried and baked empanadas, salad, and a glass of authentic Argentinian wine.  The food is prepared fresh to order, the empanadas were like no other, crispy flaky crust, with a tasty meat filling, not greasy or messy.  The pizza is made with the freshest of ingredients, the cheese is high quality, not like other pizza places that use the cheap cheese and grease pools in the center.  The pizza crust is light but tasty, I think its because its a yeast based dough.  The salad was enough for a family, again fresh tasty and they didn't skimp on the Kalamata olives. The family owned restaurant is a new favorite of mine with mouth watering authentic Argentinian dishes.  Service is quick and professional, this is a great place for a quick lunch or a dinner out with friends and family.  Overall it was an excellent experience, cant wait to go back.

Very charming and warm in it's design, appearance and service. I had the pancakes - they were OK. The bloody mary's are incredible though - certainly recommend those. Don't try going without a reservation - you will wait for at least 1 hr, and that can be tough when hungry!

New to Blunch at Blend....did not disappoint!  Had the chicken Vacafrita, was amazing...chimichurri sauce was delish! One Sangrita later, I was almost smashed! The wait staff was awesome, our waitress Felichia, was so attentive and helpful and super friendly. It was a pleasure from start to finish. I highly recommend! And the view....!!!

I ordered mozzarella sticks and garlic bread. Mozzarella sticks had sauce poured on top so it was all soggy. they were burnt and tasted bland. worst mozzarella sticks I've ever had. garlic bread was burnt and had way to much garlic. two simple orders and both were God awful. service was even worse. worst lunch I've ever had.
Delicious. Had a blast here for my cousons 30th ;)

We found this little place after a few drinks in Hell's Kitchen. The place is quite small but luckily not crowded when we got there. We were three people and we shared mushroom cigars and rosemary fries for an appetizer. For our main dishes, we had Thai lamb chops, the salmon and the Tuscany chicken. All three were awesome! Too full for dessert, we chatted with out waiter. He was hilarious and we laughed the whole time. Such a pleasant meal with the doors open and unseasonably beautiful weather in the city. I can't praise this place enough. We'll definitely go back.

Did the restaurant change owners? I've been going to this restaurant for many many years and the last 2 times the food just didn't taste the same..it was good but not at the same  level ... very disappointed !

Juan and I definitely enjoyed the shrimp buns. They are amazing with the dip. We also tried stuffed shiitake mushrooms which were also delicious. We ordered Mezame Ramen and Ani Ramen. Both were delicious! Til next time. :)

Not what you expect from an italian place as concerns the decoration and especially not like an italian cafe bistro.....but but but the food is amazing period.100% authentic handmade fresh italian food.The bread is awesome the pasta is hitting the spot.there is no particular service cause you order at the counter and the owner has the right amount of italian "craziness" everything is so cute and authentic congrats.
Waited 1hr for appetizers at the bar. They never came! Lady bartender was unbelievably rude! A shame because the menu looked good.

I came here on August 1, 2014, for my 24th birthday. It was my second time eating here, since I had came here for my previous birthday. Isabella's is not only my favorite restaurant but Isabella is also my name! My second time here was much better than my first. Although my first time here also went well, this time was just better. I had a wonderful experience! Our waitress for the night was Amanda P. and she was the best waitress. She was nice, very easy going & very patient. She served me and my party free champagne for my birthday. For dessert I orderd the chocolate bag, and Amanda placed a candle on it and sang happy birthday! I wish more waitresses were like her. A waiter named Jake was also very nice and he even gave me a free Isabella's hat for my birthday! My boyfriend and friends also enjoyed the service here. There's just a very nice vibe to this place. The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is set up so nicely. I had a wonderful birthday dinner at Isabella's and I will definitely be coming back here next year for my 25th! A big thank you again to Amanda P. & Jake for a wonderful birthday experience at Isabella's!

The wait person didn't tell us about the early bird specials nor the days specials We had to ask her for them.we were there Before 6pm ,we asked about the happy hour, she said no drinks were available for happy hour. I thought happy hour meant drinks ! The food was good but the service was not .

Finally made reservations to this place after several attempts. They are always packed and there is a good reason why. We took our 15 year old son with us who appreciates good food and we all loved it. We had a three-course tasting menu and enjoyed every dish. The place is small but cozy, seams like their target audience are couples. The service was great and very personal. You can clearly see the chef cooking in the kitchen area, reminded me of one small restaurant we dined at while in Paris. Overall, the quality you get for the price is amazing. We are already planning to go again and try other offerings from the a-la cart menu.

(Posting on my husband's profile) As a bartender I'm super picky about what places I go to, and I always sit at the bar. First of all, the decor and feeling of The Blind Pig is very warm and welcoming, and you feel that immediately. The bartender, who I believe owns the restaurant with her husband, was extremely accommodating very easy to talk to. She makes you feel like a regular even if it's your first visit. The food is all made from scratch and it's delicious. The pulled pork spaetzle (spelling?) was definitely a favorite. I wandered in one day by chance and it became a favorite place of mine instantly. We went there for our anniversary last year and it was a great experience. They have my full support!!

(Posting under my husband's profile) I get coffee every morning from Milk Crate on my way to work. For years I was a die hard Starbucks fan but I can't seem to get a consistent drink from them anymore. My iced coffee from Milk Crate is always delicious and always the same. The girls at the front counter always remember my drink and they are always super nice. Love the vibe of the place and even their food is great. One of my favorite spots!

I frequently go to Jacobs Pickles. I live out of town and I go out of my way to go for dinner or brunch. It is a unique experience and opportunity to try something different and made with love. I love this place and will keep on going back. Must try the bloody Mary's. They are the Best!!!!!!!!!!

these burgers make me feel as i am a beast! Cant stop on ordering one, they are so tasty that i need to eat at least three of them to feel satisfied.  truffle fries are gorgeous.   Staff is  friendly but i dont like when it takes long to get my burger.

With an 8pm reservation, my party was still not seated at 8:45 pm. We told the hostess we were leaving and she shrugged her shoulders. I hear the food is good, but I obviously can't comment on that part. Poor restaurant management, and a disappointing waste of a Friday evening spent waiting to eat.

I have been going to Loco Pez for the past year and a half and it's still one of my top 3 favorite bars/restaurants. The prices are super affordable, the margaritas are top notch and their staff is always very welcoming. Hands down best taco joint in Philly.

Highlight: Singapore Kari Laksa I've been to a few Malaysian restaurants, but not to this one, so I decided to give it a try and see what the restaurant had to offer. Its menu had a lot of food to choose from. Décor: The restaurant was small in size, but "average" clean and organized. I wouldn't mind the area size as long as the restaurant has delicious food to serve. Service: Great service! The waiters were attentive and courteous. When I was leaving the restaurant, they said 'thank you' and 'goodbye' to me, but not 'come again' (I just realized it lol). Even so, I still enjoyed their service. Simply saying 'thank you' to customers is a nice gesture. Common courtesy is hard to come by these days. Food: I ordered Singapore Kari Laksa, even though I was at a Malaysian restaurant. I wasn't disappointed at all. It tasted so good that I even finished the whole bowl. It was spicy and savory. I could even smell the aroma of curry. Its spiciness was moderate to my taste, and its price was reasonable based on its serving. I just wish I could have more tofu in it though. I would definitely order it again, especially on a cold winter day. Winter is coming anyway!

I got to try Di Fara's slice couple of says ago and I can say that theres nothing special about it: just another NYC pizza slice with some basil on it. I would rate it 3-stars, but for $5.00 price I have to deduct 1 star to the total of 2-star rating. Nothing special. Just the hype. Oily.
Some of the best pizza in the area, especially the Sicilian.  Could eat here every day.

Really bad bagel with cream cheese and lox. 1. The bagel (that was supposed to be everything had a ton more poppy seeds than it did everything) looked nothing like the Manhattan bagels I'm used to. 2. Very little cream cheese 3. The lox was...dry and shriveled up. I don't think it was very fresh. Smoothies are good but overpriced. I'd pass on the coffee. Salads are good.

The Lombardi's is a little, funny Pizza Restaurant in little Italy. They solve their place problem on the small tables (nice red-white checked table covers by the way) by serving the very big pizzas upon high cake-plates. The pizzas look a little harassed but they taste phantastic. It's a flavor explosion only if the unique tomato sauce mets the mozzarella chees on tong. Hmmm! And a glass of good red wine round of this nice flavor spectacle. The service - kindly like everywhere in NYC but also a little more stressed in this really nice, small and filled location. Anyway, I'll visit the Lombardi's again :-)

Small, crowded Smith Street boîte filled with locals. Simple great basics for brunch and a high tolerance for children and noisy adults. Fun to people watch along with your eggs Benedict or Florentine and good coffee. Kids love the pancakes, sandwiches and relaxed atmosphere. Here several times a year when in town and feel at home.

Good food.  A little expensive, but very tasty.  New age atmosphere and artistic presentation.  We enjoyed the Beef Skewers and Fricca for appetizers, and the skirt steak and sausages entrees were very tasty.

Amazing.  The pizza is wonderful, the salads are great, the sandwiches are delicious. The decor is lovely too.  The only downside is that it's so crowded (and doesn't take reservations) but that's only because everyone else knows how great it is, too.   Our favorites are the margarita pizza and the Campania salad, although everything we've tried has been wonderful.  Can't wait to go back!

I absolutely love this place. Can't get enough of the Ricotta Pancakes. So far, I have been here 7 times. 5 of those times the service was great. The only thing bad I could say is that the service should be more consistent with such a great place. I can understand when it gets busy the server may get a little overwhelmed, but what needs to be remembered is that we are all humans. Just explain to me that the kitchen is a little backed up, I will completely understand. But don't leave me sitting for 20 mins waiting without even a glance in my direction. I would definitely recommend and I personally will be going back. BUT if I get spotty service again, I'll have to take my money elsewhere.

Stopped in to grab breakfast during a 5 hour wait for my flight following a cruise.  Wasn't sure what to expect as I hadn't been to NJ before.  Best breakfast I'd had in a very long time.  99%of the time restaurants don't get my eggs right, over medium...soft not watery yolks.  My eggs were perfect this morning and I really enjoyed and appreciated it!!!

I am new to this area and I randomly came  across this restaurant. I asked the cashier for a recommendation and she suggested the boneless ribs and that pan fried dumplings, so I went for it. The food came out pretty fast and to my surprise everything tasted amazing! I will definitely be back!
This is best roast duck place I had ever eaten in New York. I love every items in this restaurant! Beside the service is a little suck, everything else is great!

I'm a big fan of Japanese however, Ippudo didn't make the third star. The noodle soup was unimpressive as mine was extremely salty for some particular reason. The most annoying thing I had to deal with when dining here was the constant screaming from all the staff that worked there. I'm not sure if it was a custom or even understood what they were saying. The noise pollution here is beyond me. Will not come back.
Read My Lips... Just Tasty & Palatable...
Excellent!!!

A must try if you are in NYC, awesome Filipino food with added twists to their dishes. We ordered ribs cooked in banana ketchup (finger licking for sure!) and ukoy (Filipino shrimp & sweet potatoes fritters) for appetizers, what a great start! For dinner we ordered chicken kare-kare, talanka (crab fat) fried rice & pancit malabon with smoke shredded tofu & tinapa (tiny fish) for dinner. Shared a halo-halo for dessert, let's just say I wish I ordered my own! We absolutely enjoyed the amazing tasty food and the great service. Thanks to Topher our fabulous server, he was the icing on the cake for sure!
We went for our annivesary  tonight, we had  very nice relaxing dinner, Food and Service excellent, i would go back again, nice and romantic feel..

I was in the mood for a couple hot dogs so I Yelp'd and found this place. For a hot dog spot there is everything you'd want. Good tasting dogs, ample seating inside and out, friendly and quick service and very reasonably priced. I also like that they don't try to do too much. I'll be back !

Not easy to find! Luckily we had the address. It is just a door on a wooden wall. Inside it is very cozy, like an orangerie. Nice and friendly staff. Sandwiches were really good and lot's to chose from. Everything is organic. Very good coffee as well and good prices. Recommend it warmly!

BEST PLAIN PIZZA!! I live in California, and crave Tony's pizza. Every time we go to NJ to visit family, we always make at least two trips to Tony's. If you're visiting from out of state (especially West Coast) you definitely have to go here and get a true taste of that East Coast pizza. Even the family I have in NJ vouch for this pizza. I honestly haven't tried anything other than pizza here. But my recommendation for anyone from out of town, or in town, definitely make a stop here to grab a plain, cheese, pizza!

Truly one of the best restaurants around. Jimmy Cosgrove defines excellent customer service, as well as all the people he is surrounded by in Salute! I've never been in a restaurant that really makes one feel welcomed like this one. Even at their busiest time, the wait is never long. I love the food and my favorite martini is always perfect! Alas, the only problemis the parking... But hey, my husband drops me off and parks the car! PS.. The garlic bread is to die for
I got the #17, it was AMAZING. The sesame seed bread took the sandwich to a whole new level. 5/5.

Don't waste your time or money on this dump disguised as an avant garde off the beaten path watering hole. Yeah, that's it, it might just be good enough for horses. After having to wait despite a reservation and empty tables for two were available, the hostess was kind enough to take time off what seemed like a private conversation with a seated party, to show us to our table. Hint #1, dirty laundry smell and flying bugs Now the best part, in my 40+ years of dining out, I don't remember ever paying for a more disgusting meal, just to spare you the unpleasant details, I wouldn't feed that stuff to my dog. I thing a long look in the mirror is in order for the cook ( what chef? ) and the owner. What a disgrace. Other than that, a fine establishment.
Very disappointed for the amount of food you get for the money you pay. Nice atmosphere but I don't feel the quality warrants the price. I had a Seabass dinner the cost me 28 bucks and left hungry

My wife & I have been D'Italia fans for many years, going back to when they were a pizza joint across the street. We are always treated like royalty, and even when understaffed (almost never) or the food is not what we expected, they always find a way to make things right. Very rarely do I wander away from 3 or 4 standards, yet each meal seems new every time. I am the kind of guy who compares the same dishes from different restaurants, just to compare, and I always come back.  My wife is a serious Gluten Free girl, and if you are familiar with restaurants or wait staff not up to speed on ciliac or gluten allergies, you'll understand when I say this staff knows what the chef uses as ingredients.  In addition, they have added a serious gluten free pizza. Many restaurants offer this item, but the folks at D'Italia have gone far afield to locate a really good tasting pizza crust, not the same thing that every other restaurant buys, and the toppings are to die for. What more can I say, except that we recently moved out of the area, but still find a way back to D'Italia; not weekly like we used to, but almost.... Thanks Tommy & Joe, you're the best!

"Food so great, it will make you sop your plate!" I have lived in Downtown Hartford since 1997, and I have enjoyed All the BBQ this town has to offer. Bear's is, without question... the    B  E  S  T ! This is a new restaurant that makes a big impact on Downtown Hartford, and anyone who considers themselves a 'foodie', and tries the BBQ. As I walked in, I found the atmosphere to be modern designer cafe' meets thoughtful industrial utilitarian. The ceilings are high, exposed brick, metal and wood felt honest and pleasing. There is a balcony. And the meat cutting and food prep staff are all in plain sight for anyone to see.  This place is just flat out cool and I dig it. The staff are all friendly and professional... shout out to Brandon! The men's room had good colors and design, and was spotlessly clean... which honestly, is priceless and immensely appreciated right there. The daytime lighting is cool looking and perfect, but I could go for a bit warmer or dimmer mood lighting transition at night, although I could only muse about that for a hot second while I was waiting in line with my mouth watering from the BBQ aroma therapy. As soon as I sat down, the food commanded the stage. There is something about good BBQ that one instinctively and immediately recognizes as authentic. This kind of BBQ is awesome, because it has just the right recipe and it takes TIME.  I could taste it. So I asked the owner, Jamie, how long he smoked his meats ... he puts in at 3 pm and smokes it throughout the night, and doesn't take it out til 9am the next day... that's 18 hours later! That is amazing, and the food is so good it is literally addictive! My personal favorite is the Burnt Ends... on Monday, with beans and cornbread. Tuesday is my brisket day... the Broccoli salad keeps my wife happy. Wednesday I have to go Mac Attack! Thursday is my healthy Big Mama Bear's Salad topped with turkey. Friday has to be sausage and pork and extra corn bread with honey butter. Saturday is the Paw Paw's Poutine with pork an spicy sauce. Sunday is Paw Paw's Poutine with pork and spicy sauce... yes, it's that good. NOTE: Did you know that Jamie, "The Bear", is a competitive eater? He has won a ton of eating competitions, enough to start up BEAR'S! There are even competitive eating challenges listed on the black board, and held fairly often. Think you can eat big? He's got a thousand bucks, (yes, $1000.00) waiting for you, (even with the help of a couple of buddies) to try and take him down in 10 minutes... and on top of all that, Jamie and the BEAR'S family are supporters of the community. Quite often they will hold fundraising events that support deserving organizations and causes in the community. Two weeks ago I attended a fundraiser for the Hartford Public Library! What other restaurant does that? Seriously, BEAR'S is GOOD PEOPLE and GOOD FOOD! Kudos to BEAR'S SMOKEHOUSE BBQ! Tao LaBossiere, Hartford Mural Artist  -   Come enjoy one of my original mural paintings on the outside wall of BEAR'S !

Ordered the Alfie's Burger and will die having lived a life free of regret.  Our server, Jen recommended a delightful seasonal beer to me despite my having ordered a different one. Out of line, you say? You are wrong to say then, Jen did the right thing. she did the right thing.
horrible service & the girls there are nasty when answering the phone too!! over priced for not so great food!!! i stopped going there !!!!
The cheese and wine selection here is fantastic. The camembert was so delicious, my mouth waters as I write this review. Quaint ambiance. Foie gras was not so good and slightly runny.
I have only ordered delivery from here, and I must say that everything I tried has been delicious.

How can you NOT love BBQ? I swear this place is pretty awesome. The appetizers were kinda small but then you get your entree meal and its a perfect size. If you come hungry I promise you will leave satisfied. My friends and I all got different things and pretty much just shared everything off each others plates thats how good the food all looked. SO OF COURSE we had to try all of it lol. I got the RIBS and oh man so saucy love that. I would recommend the ribs to anyone that likes saucy food =)
Lunch at Bouley to celebrate a wedding of my friend.The waitstaff must be trained in all manners of hospitality! The lunch itself was good!

Atmosphere and decor was 4 stars.. Service 3 stars.. Food (taste/ quality) 1 star.. This is my third time at this restaurant and I still don't get all the hype.. The appetizers were warm at best, good flavor- but either the server forgot and they sat on the pass too long and cooled or they could have used another 2 minutes in the microwave.. This time I had the ribs, again, served at room temperature- the saving grace was the corn bread it was served with.. My wife had the Crawfish "Ettouf"(not sure on the spelling or if that's the correct name for the dish)- it was the only dish brought hot to the table, however it lacked flavor- truly a bland sauce, however, pasta cooked perfectly.. My father in law had the Seared Tuna which is served with fried calamari- the Tuna was over cooked, flavorless and cold.. I didn't try the other two dishes on the table so I can't comment on them specifically.. I chose to write this critical seeming review because this place gets WAYYY more credit than it deserves- and if your considering it as a dining option- for the money- go elsewhere.. I would have shared my complaints about the food with the server, but once the food was brought to the table zero follow up.. There are better restaurants on Staten Island people!

Being on my own meant I skipped the queue on a Sunday and ate at the bar. Delicious feta and spinach omelette and fantastic home fries. This is an extremely popular place and I can see why. Even though busy, you are not rushed. Friendly team. Also went Friday early afternoon and sat outside which makes for great people watching.
amazing

I ordered a small pizza.  I waited for a long time while watching customers order after me and leave with their food.  When I asked the cashier about my order it seems they had forgotten about it.  The place wasn't that busy and the manager was there and didn't think to apologize to me about me wait.  The cashier offered me a medium pie but because I never had the pie before I didn't want to have extra pie.  The problem was the fact that I lost all this time waiting on pizza and needed to get back to work.  There is also more people working there than there are customers.  When I finally got the pizza it didn't taste that great.  It was actually chewy and soggy in the middle like it needed to stay in the brick oven a little longer.  May be it's because they are a new establishment but I hope they can work on remembering orders and dealing with these types of problems better.

I'm truly sad that I absolutely hated this place. I researched it on Yelp for a week before I went and ended up being so very disappointed. This place gets 1 star ONLY because their food quality is good; quality, not flavor. It's fresh, nothing tasted stale or reheated, so that's where the positives end. My biggest problem is with the service and the restaurant's atmosphere. I immediately felt uncomfortable upon sitting down, so much so I thought about leaving and going elsewhere, I regret not listening to that gut feeling. I was addressed by 2 different servers one after the other, the male one asking us if we were ready to order within seconds of sitting down. While they were nice and all, something seemed terribly off about them and this place in general, again I did not feel comfortable or welcome, we both felt out of place. Then they had this God awful music blasting, which didn't help me feel like I could relax and enjoy my meal, and I didn't. It sounded like what the employees wanted to listen to with no regard to the customers. Sometimes a different song would come on and it would be REALLY loud and it made me jump the 3 different times it happened in a 20 minute span, yet they failed to correct it. When the servers weren't helping anyone, they just ran their mouths loud and non-stop at the counter with personal conversations. I'm sorry but, I'm not trying to hear that stuff so close to my table when I'm trying to have a meal. This place is horribly cramped, they try to shove too many tables so close to each other that to move around means to push over the condiments that are on them. And those tables, they're filthy and they wobble. How annoyed would you be if you were picking at your food and every time you put the fork down or grabbed a bite, the table rocked...? Super annoying. Now onto the food. I ordered the pancakes and their homemade tater tots. I was craving potato of some kind, especially tater tots, so I was excited to try their version... huge mistake. The "tater tots" weren't tater tots at all. They didn't even taste anything like potatoes, I was shocked. They tasted like croquettes, which is what they should call them, but still no potato flavor or texture anywhere. I had to get potatoes somewhere else after leaving here...sad. The dipping sauce they came with was good though. The pancakes were good, but they were HUGE, I did not notice that from yelp photos, and you get 3 of them. I could only down about one of them and my boyfriend finished another, while the 3rd one went uneaten. The syrup provided was shockingly sweet and I had to scrape it off. I tried the mac & cheese my bf ordered and it was good enough, nothing spectacular. When we were done, we couldn't pay and leave fast enough, I couldn't stand the horrible loud music and awkward atmosphere. While we were full, we both complained of being hungry, simply because our cravings were not met at all.
