I am reviewing the upstairs lounge, not the food. I find it very disappointing the owners chose not to continue a live dj in the upstairs lounge on Friday and Saturday nights. I've been here a handful of times and it is a common 20's bar scene. Stopped by this past Saturday night only to hear 4 others complain about the same issue at the bar. If the owners are attempting to draw in an older crowd with the jazz music it seems that they will only be hurting their pockets in the long run.
Second best steak wit wiz. the difference is the staff are actually not a holes, and really quite nice. but the place across the street is tastier despite the a holes behind the dome

Went here for dinner on a Friday night, really nice set up, crowded but not overly so. Had the cold noodles & thai egg rolls for a starter. Cold noodles were excellent. I had the yellow curry with coconut milk for dinner and dinner which was excellent. Generous portions, brought some home. Waitress was prompt and attentive, answered questions easily. Overall a great dinner and lunch spot!

I was there on a Monday at 11:45, we both ordered chicken dishes one being Pad Thai. The food came out in 5 minutes tops. The chicken was clearly reheated, gross reheated like microwaved with that fishy taste. They had only been opened for 45 minutes so either it was from the night prior or they make it all first thing so they can reheat. The vegetables were fine, but I couldn't get past the chicken.
Food here is so amazing...I would love to go once again with my family. My dad loved the chicken dish... 4 stars..

At first me and my buddy were wary of heading here midweek, but we were so happy that we did. The staff is phenomenal. I felt like I was a member of the family. Pete the bartender was awesome, and Alina, the manager, makes the best salad dressing on earth. Go here. We came on a Wednesday, not too many people here, but that could change if you go. So go! Right now, go!

This place is areal deal NY Slice.  Ive visited so many places that claim to be the best but Prince St really it.  Get the white Slice with Prosciutto and thank me latter.  The regular slices are everything you could dream for and the Square slices are killer.  They are no L & B but hey they also much more acceptable. The only downside is the pizza can be a bit pricey but it is totally worth it.

This is not my first time here, but rest assured it will be my last.  Service was horrible. I arrived 9:09 on a Saturday and was advised wait time will be 40 minutes. I decided to wait it out.  9:49 I went to them and said hey it's 40 minutes do you know how much longer?  They told me they called my name.. get the heck out of here with that BS.  They advised me they have to "recycle" me and three more people to come before I get seated.  I see them seating new people and many of them.  15 minutes later I asked about how much longer.  "Sir we have 2 more people ahead of you before you get your table"  Long story short, I get seated 10:30.  That is some serious BS, but once they seat us they stick us in the back corner in a booth where our server never showed up for another 30 minutes.  Not even to open the wine.  This place is a joke.  I am sorry I even left a tip  But my tip to all of you is SKIP THIS PLACE.

I wasn't sure what to expect, but man, this is a no hold's bar, hurry up and get your dog, kind of place. I love it! You know it is all fresh and yummy, because people are always in there. If you are ever in Seattle, Dick's is the hambuger place that could be Gray's cousin.

People love this place, it is true. But for me the only good things there are the bread and the croissant. Everything else there is average. The service is as good as it can be under the circumstances, because they just don't have enough servers. OK for a drink at the bar before moving on to somewhere else.

I highly recommend the dessert called rice ball in sweet wine!! It may looked like soup or porridge, but it was more thick and sticky.  There were lots of tiny sticky rice balls that had white or light yellow color in it, and within a small portion of rice wine, it was an visual and taste enjoyment. I was falling in love with the dessert,and I could feel the sweetness remained and melted in my mouth slower and slower. It really made my day!!!
a-ok.  the food is decent but line is too long and the service lukewarm.  the fish taco is my favorite.

This place is amazing! I lived in NYC for years and am here for work a lot. We haven't found a place this accommodating to late-night in a while. Great service, cold beer and the perfect melty grilled cheese. It's a wonderful place to bring a family too! (Anytime!)

Bustling Italian marketplace with amazing food and people!  We had the calamari salad and took it to go across the street to the scenic outdoor seating area. Eataly is an amazing Italian marketplace with fresh food. I got a mozzarella ball that just melted in my mouth. For dessert, I got a nutella crepe - pure heaven. Walking around Eataly reminded me of my semester abroad in Florence. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who likes Italian food. Overall it is overpriced and overcrowded but i recommend trying the restaurants. i will be coming back soon.

Finally managed to try Serpico this past weekend and it was perfect.  Food was the best I have had in a long time in Philadelphia, our waitress was attentive and welcoming and the food beyond impressed my partner and I.  I loved everything about the experience. I cannot wait to go back!

I absolutely love Delicious & Best.  Yes, it's kind of a silly name, but I adore Chinese food, have tried many places, and D&B truly is the most delicious and the best!  I often crave their shrimp fried rice, a simple dish that's extraordinary here.  I've ordered practically everything on the menu, and nothing has ever disappointed.  Keep in mind that this is a tiny hole-in-the-wall kind of place.  There's a counter with stools, but it's really best for takeout.  They are always busy, lots of bustling around, customers going in & out, but the wait time is pretty fast.  And the food is always freshly prepared with top-notch ingredients.  And delicious!
pretty good food and service.

I've been dying to try Juliana's ever since I read an article about it being the "original" Grimaldi's. The pizza here is definitely comparable to Grimaldi's, but I think better because it has a subtlety to it that makes a big difference when you plan to eat more than a couple slices. I definitely recommend this place if you're serious about pizza, or want to go to Grimaldi's but don't want to wait in that long line.

good burger, decent beer selection. expect a 'tude in typical philly fashion. as usual, i'm surprised by the ratings as the just okay sushi place down the road gets 4 stars and this 3. This is reversed fo sho.

Really good mussels at night. I had an excellent dinner there one night. Overpriced brunch and a soggy croque madame. With tax and a three dollar filter coffee and a tip, it was $22 for some brunch for just me. I don't know about y'all but this seems a little pricey for ham and cheese sandwich with some egg and sauce? Also, the croque madame was done on challah bread, but it was not crisped up at all. It should be browned and it was not at all on the top or the bottom, just all soft and soggy. Home fries were really good, if a bit greasy, they could have done with a paper towel for a second before being plated. On the plus side the staff are super nice and really attentive. I was really hungry so I did not send back the food and I guess I should have done so and seen what they had to say, but I did not really want to deal with it. In summation, good for dinner, expensive for brekkie.

Soul Food is difficult, we all have a personal connect to the taste and presentation of our families' food. That being said, I really enjoyed the food I got for takeout at The Soul Food Factory. I had Baked Turkey which wasn't as moist as my Mom's and Grandmother's recipe but it was moist enough and very flavorful. Though the Potato Salad was closer to German Potato Salad, it still had a nice spark of the Southern Tradition. Collard Greens are always scary for me. I've tried Collard Greens around this country and I'm normally disappointed. The Soul Food Factory's Collards don't match my families recipe, (mine doesn't match my Mother's, Grandmother's, or Aunt's recipe) but these are good. They pass the test for me. I'll look forward to eating in one day, because my take-out waitress was sweet, but I can feel comfortable writing this review.

My coworkers and I ordered from reds for lunch on several occassions.  We should of learned the first time..  Our order was always mixed up,  the delivery lady did not know how to give change back and they over charge you for things.  Their foodbis really oily and they honestly dont know what they're doing. Save your money. Also took. Over 10 minutes on. The phone to place the order they are dumb.

I love their speciality rolls! Cute little place, I wish it was a little bigger, but I guess the small size is a part of it's charm. I have and will continue to recommend this place to all of my friends.
Incredible meal,  incredible service! I will for sure recommend this to everyone, it was the best meal ever!!!!!

Good food, but..... One remark: please put the temperature in the restaurant higher. It's freezing inside and it makes us want to finish our dinner and go away! For the people working there the temperature might be nice, but not for the guests. Women do their best to dress nicely, but they can't show it, as it's freezing inside and I couldn't enjoy the food as much as I wanted to as it was too cold.

The name of the restaurant caught my attention, not to mention, I love duck. So I took my boyfriend here for dinner. We had the flatbread, duck poutine, chicken and waffles, and the crispy duck special.  Everything was delicious and hit the spot.  Practically growing up on smith st, this is my new favorite. The waiters were super friendly, and we even spoke to one of the owners on our way out.  We gave our compliments and cannot wait the explore the rest of the menu. We'll  definitely be back!

Some of the worst lunch I've had in Manhattan. Got the salmnon sashimi. It was supposed to have ikura on itm, but there was barely a drop. Also got the quinoa salad with chicken. There was barely any quinoa, the chicked was rock hard and the dressing tateless. I can't imagine how other yelpers can like this place. It doesn't even deserve one star.

This place... The things I could write about this place! What an amazing experience. The food, the service, the flowers, the atmosphere. I'm in love. Loved my dining experience here. I liked it here so much more than Le Bernadine actually. The venue and very pretty with a touch of coziness. Their theme is very elegant with a hint of shabby chic. The good was spectacular. I highly recommend their tasting menu for lunch. Only $58! Their most amazing tasting was his lobster salad. It was not your traditional salad at all. The staff was so wonderful!  What a wonderful way to start off my birthday!  Thank-you Gramercy Tavern - you guys rock!
My boyfriend and I had a date night and chose Gramercy Tavern :P for dinner before seeing a show.  We made a reservation for 1030 and was pleasantly surprised by the food and atmosphere!
this is hands down the best steak i ever had

One of my favorite restaurants in Philly. Calamari Salad & Tuna Pizza are so good! I've never left unhappy. They made our night special for my boyfriend & I on our anniversary, they lit a sparkler on our dessert.

Great on all accounts.  Tria offers the best of both worlds - you can easily have small bites and a drink with friends or a full, delicious dinner.  The staff is sometimes hit or miss, but the food and drinks are worth it.

Taking off one star because of reservation silliness (table for two at 5 or 11?) Anyway, finally made it here for lunch.  I agree with lots of the reviews that say the Black Label burger was good, but definitely nowhere near what it should be based on all of the hype.  But everything we else really was delicious.  I especially enjoyed the Huîtres et Crépinettes (sausage and oysters).
Sandwiches are good, but the place could use a makeover. At first I was ready to walk out of this deli/corner store due to its dingy appearance. Portions are a good size and fresh.
no line, which was amazing. 2 orders xlb crab 4 orders xlb pork jellyfish (cold) lion's head soup crispy whole seabass bean curd and vegetable onion pancake ALL GOOD. #happyfatties

I have long resisted the urge to register on Yelp, however my dinner last night at Peony Pavilion has shocked me out of my reluctance and motivated me to provide a review of what was one of the worst dining experiences I've ever had. Looking at all the positive reviews I decided to take my parents out for their anniversary here. All I can say is: I have no idea what the rave reviews are all about. First lets start and talk about the fact that upon sitting down we were ignored, no pot of tea on the table, nothing to munch on, waiting... We finally attracted the attention of a waiter who took our order and then the marathon dinner began. It easily took 20 min to get our appetizers, the food was generally bland with no hint of any spice or flavor.Little did we know this was the best part of the meal. We then waited 1 hour for our main dish to arrive, we asked several times where our food was and received profuse apologies but no food. In fact we noticed the party at the next table dealing with the same situation, they were a bit more wise then us as they didn't wait for their entree, demanded their check and left. When our food finally did arrive, my mothers flounder was cold, she didn't send it back for fear that she might not ever see it again... The rest of our meal was bland and over priced for what was delivered. The management seems to want to represent Peony Pavilion as a New York Restaurant in the suburbs as a ex-New Yorker I am fairly confident in saying that the level of service and quality of the food would never cut it in NYC. If you have 2 or 3 hours to spend on a sub par dinner then this is your place.I realize this flies in the face of many positive reviews but the facts speak for themselves. Maybe they were just having a bad night, but I'll never know as I won't be returning.

***SMALL*** This place is petite so do NOT bring a large group here without discussions and planning with the restaurant. Our group of 6 had a fantastic meal here - mostly because we knew to bring cash, knew the place was small (and made reservations well ahead of time), brought our own wine and water, and were ready to make the trek across the street to use a deli's bathroom. The food was fantastic, and the layout of the restaurant makes it possible to watch the chef at work - but keep in mind that this place is idiosyncratic.
Tasteless, greasy.  Fortune cookies were excellent.

If you can look past the harassment of the owner, the pizza isn't that bad. I went for lunch by myself to take a break from work and the owner would not stop coming over to talk to me. I appreciate the attempt to foster business but I do not need to constantly be told about why hot girls like me are crazy
Awesome beer selection and the mussels were solid; the linguini was pretty meh. Loved that the place itself is small and cozy.

The food here was good for the price but the customer service was terrible. I ordered on thing but it was incorrect when it got here called the place up and told them it was wrong. They tried to stick me with it as if it's not a problem then offered to make my next meal on the house which is decent offer but I paid for something now i should have it. Then when I said I would wait it they said ok but we want the food already sent to you. I mean really u want it back what are you gonna do other then throw it away give it to the next customers.

I've tried different places all over the city, hands down this is one of the best! its not just that the pizza is so good, its that there is so much of it! the pies are huge so don't expect to finish one off unless there are three or four of you. The staff has always been really nice, the place is chill .but the pizza...sinfully delicious.
I love adrienne's pizza they serve huge pizzas, they are simply great! And the staff is  superb
Steak frite is amazing. And def get the crume brulee for desert!!!! It's a real French brûlée :). Bon appetite!

All I can say is that Penang is OUTSTANDING! I can't name a food here that I don't like. First of all, it is always packed: it's popular with people who live both within the city and outside. There are a ton of possible options for dinner in Philadelphia's Chinatown, but this one is in the top 2 or 3 without a doubt. To start off, the Indian pancakes with the curry sauce is a great pick. For the meal, which is normally family style, I absolutely recommend the curry chicken, peaking duck, the seafood lo mien, and for your vegetable, the watercress with garlic sauce. Also, if you're a soup fan, I recommend the wonton me (one of the best soup and noodle combos I've ever tasted). White or brown rice comes with most of the dishes, so you'll have plenty of that. I recommend going to Penang if you have a big group to go out with, because then you get to taste all of the different sauces and spices and flavors of this Cambodian-Malaysian hybrid. If you're in Philadelphia on a trip or are just spending a night in the city, I DEFINITELY recommend Penang.
Good place to come and chill.  Friendly owner and cute blond bar tender with masters in Psych. So free therapy. Reasonable beer prices and definitely will be bringing friends in future visits.
Best falafel in the city!  Authentic restaurant in the heart of West Village.  I come back here once a week, it's addicting!

The spring rolls are made with the proper spring roll wrap! (some places uses the thicker kind which is not as authentic). The shrimp grilled on sugarcane was also great! Recommend these two dishes more than the bun.
Seriously, 10 stars. I can't get over how amazing/affordable this place is. Bring your own wine, and book reservations.

When one wants a gyro sandwich go the platter is also great. You will be stuff but your inner greedy will say continue to eat. I have being going here for the pass 3 or 4 years. One Saturday the family and I were in Denville I became hungry ask the family do they have a taste for Greek food. The family replied yes sounds good we need to find a spot close which I said no problem then drove us to Greek Town.

7$  for a complete , delicious lunch! Very good service and pleasant atmosphere! I was there for lunch on a Sunday and really want to come back! The location is just a few steps from the Green and Yale, the service is quick and very polite, the food absolutely gorgeous!
Good food. Really really rude bartender. Don't come if you don't feel like being treated like an annoyance.
Goddammit!! Hands down the best pizza I ever had!! Fresh ingredients! Especially love the thin crust and the amazing cheese blend they're using.

I have come in here a few times, more recently with very important clients and then my boss. I have to admit, I didn't expect the food to be as great as it was. I had perceived this to me more of a "bar scene" type of place, but I thought the food was excellent. In fact, everyone in our party loved everything they had.  I eat out quite often and consider myself somewhat of a foodie, and definitely a picky eater. I was really delighted. I had an outstanding fish dish and the last time, the ahi tuna appetizer which was perfect. Drinks are perfectly mixed and creative. We were able to enjoy the rooftop both times, which was outstanding in beautiful weather, with great energy. However, the dining room looks really fabulous as well when I passed it on the way out to the rooftop, and I am planning to try the dining room soon with a Groupon i just purchased. In short, this place won me over and I will be back again and again!
Fork is my go-to place to have dinner with friends.  The food is always delicious and the service is always on point.  Wonderful atmosphere and gorgeous space.

lovely decor nice staff and very helpful in any questions I had the day I went to take out the price is right and the chicken and steak tacos were delicious.  I asked about the chicken mole but they can not make it with out their mother who is away for 3 months she is the one with the family recipe I can not wait!!  I will be going again to this great addition to Maspeth,NY  I live only a few blocks away which turns into Middle Village and it a hop skip and a jump lol

Charming and wonderful on every level. Would go back again in a heart beat! Took a chance on Basso56 based on good on-line reviews and WOW, so glad we did! From the start, I was charmed by the downstairs, below street level entrance... as if I found a little secret tucked away! We received a warm greeting upon walking in and were promptly seated. Our server Micaela, quickly greeted us and provided us with excellent service thru out. Now the good stuff, the food!!!  For starters we had the pear and goat cheese salad, very yummy and the calamari which had a light but somewhat crunchy coating, I likey!  We also had the eggplant which was just ok and the crab cake  which was really good.  For main meal we had the Rigatoni Bolognese, very respectable,  filet mignon with truffle sauce, OMG, is all I can say. Also had the seafood risotto special, which was like heaven!!! For dessert we tried the tartuffo, ricotta cheese cake and biscotti cookies, in spite of that calorie count, I had no regrets!  Of course there was cappuccino involved and I think I heard someone say, "the best they ever had"! The combination of homey charm, warm staff, and delicious food make this place a win - win.

I love the atmosphere of Lilie's, it's very London and very cute.  It's perfect for lunch or dinner with the girls.  Our food was great, drinks were solid and service was okay.  We had to wait a long time to be seated because we couldn't find a hostess!  But after that everyone was super apologetic.

I'm conflicted wether to waste my time on this review or waste your time reading it. Not sure how this place got any stars. It was a complete waste of my time, money, and angry stomach. We ordered homemade chicken soup and a side of sweet plantains after being informed they were out of most their menu items. No tostones, yucca, one chicken left...we were there at 5:30 on Wednesday evening. The soup should have been called microwaved can chicken broth with pasta and extra pasta. We also never received our sweet plantains. We are now headed to our go to place to have real dinner. So disappointed.

Maybe I'm picky from growing up in Los Angeles, but I hold all "taco" places to a high standard. Philadelphians should get the same level of taste as an Angelino. I went here soon after it opened with my wife and I had called in an order to pick up cause I live around the corner. Most tacos at US restaurants are made with corn, so I didn't think twice about it - corn tacos are safe for the gluten-free among us. I went to pick up and asked what kind of tortillas were used for the tacos and the cashier said "flour," at which point I told her I'm gluten-free and couldn't eat the tacos that were made. She seemed very frustrated at that idea and had the cooks make new ones for free and told me I needed to specify next time what kind of tortillas to use. She never asked me what kind of tortillas I wanted, so maybe it's a moot point. What I remember about my pork tacos and my wife's chicken tacos were the blandness and small portions. It just wasn't what I'd come to expect growing up. I can make more flavorful tacos on my own by using a better variety of spices as well as lemon/lime juice, Greek yogurt (substitute for sour cream), and sauteed veggies. I won't be going back, but I will say that Mole Poblano and Tamalex in South Philly have amazing Mexican/Honduran food for the same price.

Yes this place looks out dated. Yes the service sucks.  Yes he may take a brake out of nowhere and say he is closed. Yes it is more pricey then other pizza place. BUT IT IS THE BEST PIZZA I EVER HAD. OH MY GOD DELICOUS!!! Def worth a visit!!...
So so so so delicious! We had Noah's ark and clam chowder. The lobster roll, shrimp roll and crab roll are heavenly taste~ Environment is also nice~Strongly recommended!!

Where do I start? Service : bar tender, very good, tipped him 40%.  Guy brought us the drinks to the table, very good. Guy took our order rude and un happy.   When we asked for the bill, I gave $50 for a $40 bill and the waiter asked me if I wanted any change.  I thought I ask him 'seriously? Did you actually ask me what I think you did?'.  He didnt crack a single smile all night long and made me feel uncomfortsble and I felt like he did not enjoy waitressing at all.  Well, he needs to find a job he is happy with, his manager should take notice. After that, I only left 5 bucks (for the guy ghat brought us the water really) as I did not think he worth more given his tough attitude, when I said good night he completrly ignored me and my wife too.Wow! When we left the restaurant we were not greeted by a single person on our way out(coincidence?). Food: after reading all these reviews about the best pizza in NYC I expected to eat something similar to a pizza I had in Napoli or at least Franco Manca in London, or Santa Maria in Ealing(10/10 all the way every time).  I would not dare compare those pizzas to the one we had here, they are not on the same league at all. 5.8/10 best case scenario. Cant believe all these positive reviews on the taste. Forget about service, taste was just average. Would I go there again? Absolutely not. Rude waiter, average taste, do the math.
Nice ambiance and good wine! What else do you need? Perfect for dates, or meeting up with friends. Nice and friendly staff.
I have been here multiple times and I have not had a bad meal yet. I'm usual a sushi person but I've tried the udon a few times and I've enjoyed that too.

My boyfriend and me were visiting New York and looking for a nice Italian restaurant close to Times Square. We found this one via Yelp and were not disappointed! The service was super nice, and food just plain delicious. We got a selection of complimentary olives and among those one of the best types I ever had. When I asked the waiter how they're called he even gave me the name of a shop where you can buy them. We didn't order any starters but I had the pasta trecolori and it was awesome. My boyfriend had some kind of meat which was also very good. Afterwards, we shared a pouched pear which was incredibly good. All in all - when I visit New York again, I will make sure to stop by here.

2nd day open so I expected a few bumps. I like the atmosphere. I wanted something hot to drink but nothing was on the menu. After I ordered and sat down I noticed the fancy coffee machine but I wanted hot chocolate or hot tea. I got the cheese and chive pancakes. 3 big pancakes are a bit much, 2 with more cheese would be better. I was confused as to if I return my dish somewhere, I didn't see anywhere but I got the feeling I was supposed to. I was not about to stand in line to ask. I had food left and would have liked a to go box but, no mater how much I looked at the people behind the counter, no body asked how I was doing. Eating alone, I don't walk a way from my food nor am I walking around with a plate of 1/2 eaten food. I poked at it some more and walked out. I do plan on trying again soon to see if the kinks have been worked out.

-La mia esperienza in questo ristorante non è stata delle migliori. Dal Menu abbiamo scelto: "Fried Chicken", "Bitter Greens Salad" e "Salmon Pastrami" e, al di là dei gusti personali che restano sempre opinabili,  gli abbinamenti e le porzioni delle pietanze si sono rivelate deludenti. Servizio lento e approssimativo e scarsa la conoscenza delle regole Gluten Free. Forse abbiamo scelto la serata sbagliata, forse esagerate le nostre aspettative... - My experience at this restaurant was not the best. From the menu we chose, "Fried Chicken", "Bitter Greens Salad" and "Salmon Pastrami 'and, beyond that personal tastes are always questionable, combinations and portions of the dishes have proved disappointing. Service slow and sloppy and poor knowledge of the rules Gluten Free. Maybe we chose the wrong night, perhaps exaggerated our expectations ...

In town for work this week and I ended up going twice. Fresh fish and a good deal in the all you can eat. Be prepared and come hungry. Rolls are big and delicious. I will definitely come back if I'm in the area again.
I hate to give bad reviews, but I had a bad experience here.  As my friends and I were eating lunch, a cockroach started climbing the wall from our table.  We were so disgusted after.

This place is awesome!  The food is always on point, the staff is friendly.   When they deliver they are always on time.   It's the healthiest place to eat in the Ironbound.. They have a juicery for when I don't feel like making mine at home.   Recommended!!
Good breakfast food all day. Been here 2x but they have yet to deliver the toast w breakfast without waiting

Well, even as a vegetarian I knew I had to stop in when I saw Wings Over New Haven.  Though wings are the specialty, the menu is more extensive. Not any veggie items but the best waffle fries I've ever had! The restaurant is clean & bright; the staff are cheerful & welcoming.  I would give 5 stars if there were any vegetarian offerings! (BTW,  caesar salad is NOT vegetarian;  it has anchovies in the dressing...)

After a week in NYC with all this mediocre no identity  fusion food going on, FINALLY a proper traditional Italian restaurant. NYC taste 10/10 (back in Italy would be 8.5/10), service 10/10, and people there were polite too with a smile and happy to attend. When we paid, they brought back the change without asking us whether we wanted the change or not (like they did in Lombardi's the night before - rude). We got the meatballs to start with, a salad with pear, a carbonara and a spaghetti al vongole. Pasta cooked to perfection as I asked for al dente. Tiramisu was nice, I prefer mine at home as I cook a lot. Montelpuciano d'abruzzo served in crystal clear glases in perfect temperature and tasted like the one I usually have in Italy and London. Atmosphere was lively meditteranean and our waiter (he had a moustache) was a typical european Italian tempered guy, asset to the restaurant.

I was having hunger pangs when I decided to stop in here. After analyzing the menu for 5 minutes, (yes I was starving but you make bad decisions when hungry so I took my time to avoid hungers regret) I settled on The Southern Comfort. It was the best decision I made all day, next to wearing my seatbelt and brushing my teeth of course. I'm not even a catfish fan but it was seasoned very well and fried perfectly. Next is the waffle, pure perfection. It had a little sweetness and the perfect texture. The gravy tied it all together to make a perfect dish. I ate all of my food, something I almost never do. Looking forward to coming back already and I haven't left yet.
I have come here 3 times now and I have never gone home disappointed. My only comparison may be to instant ramen, but I have yet to find a place that makes it better than ippudo
Awesome food, great atmosphere and good service. Go to place for take out in NYC. Chicken and lamb dishes are really good and so is their Greek salad. The food seems fresh and healthy.

Great place to relax after a busy day.  They have some of the best cocktails I have tried.  I love the espresso and cucumber one.  The service is always friendly and the food is always phenomenal.  Prices are also extremely reasonable for this kinda atmosphere.
I've had several experiences with their staff being rude, particularly in the morning, and I'm going to stop going.

Great food, i mean really great food! The problem is that this place is not the best place to enjoy the food, it is relatively small, and the best decision you can make, is to pick the food, and enjoy it at home, some place else. Give them a try, you will thank me ;))

One of the best emails I have had in NYC.  We went and had the tasting menu to celebrate an anniversary.  Everything was super high-quality and you know a place is good when it's hard to name your favorite dish.  Service was great too.  I also liked that the tasting menu filled you up but wasn't too much to eat. Word to the wise - tasting menu is a much better value than ordering a la carte.

I live one block from here and I have been excitedly awaiting a trial. Walked in this morning with my parents for breakfast, 3 of us. There were 2 tables available to accommodate a party of 4 but we were informed that a larger party was going to arrive soon, so we said ok no problem. She asked us if we would sit at the communal table. Ideally we would say no but we didn't want to be a hassle. However, we walked up and the table was already pretty small and the hostess/waitress started to tell these nice women they had to move for us. I felt so bad they were clearly irritated but they obliged. As mentioned earlier we spotted 2 empty tables so I simply inquired about the availability of other one (totally legitimate question might I add). With an eye roll, thrown hands up and attitude she replied "either take or leave or wait 20 min for a table (which there were already 2!) to open up." You know sassy girl we will LEAVE it. We would've been happy to wait, considering my father is 6'2 we really needed our own table, but I was so embarrassed and appalled by her demeanor we turn around walked right out. Extremely unprofessional and will probably not bring my business here ever considering the only taste I left with was a bitter woman. That's all.

I've liked this place since it opened.  The burgers remind me of the very first time I ever had a non-fast food burger.  Unfortunately they once gave me a burger americano with the beef patty pretty much raw inside....it was gross.  I had to send my son back to the place to show them what they served gave me and of course get a replacement.  I never went back....perhaps in due time I will.   So, giving this place only 3 stars for that bad experience, otherwise their burgers are normally delicious and the fries as well. Edited to comment on photo: Someone posted a photo of their lumpia...hate to say it, but the meat looks very pink inside so I think it's not fully cooked.  I hope you didn't eat it.

I really wanted to like this place, because we recently moved 2 blocks away. We went there for the 3rd time last night and I think it's time for a review. The two of us went there on a week day at 7:30pm. They took our order at about 7:45. I ordered the chicken cutlet salad from the "specials" menu, and my boyfriend ordered fish tacos. The food didn't arrive until 8:40. I could have gone home, made a salad and ate it in that time (the server kept stopping by every 10-15 minutes, telling us "your food should be out any minute now"). The chicken cutlet in the salad was completely burnt. It was black on one side. and because it was dark, I didnt even see it until I had already had the first bite. And the Fish tacos were extremely blend and greasy. I would have been ok with the long wait if the food was good. But long wait AND bad food? no thank you!

Everything we had was delicious! Went as as group so had plenty to taste. Tried kangaroo for the first time - not bad! The scallops and foie gras were also good. My favorite dish on the menu by far is Turkish Eggs, which is two poached eggs on Greek yogurt with kirmizi biber butter. Omg, drooling right now just thinking about it. My counterparty has always ordered (of the 3 times i have been) Tea-smoked salmon, which is spinach and poached eggs on toasted sourdough with yuzu hollandaise. Also very delicious. I love coming here and we always leave full and happy.

Absolutely charming! Bouley offers a beautiful setting and world-class service for that special meal...the tasting menu was perfect for a graduation lunch with the family. The wine (was a red from Languedoc) was supremely good. The service was great - they even accommodated my request to order a dish from the Prix Fixe menu as an a la carte dish - the Rouget with Iranian Saffron Risotto. Then came the Halibut which was almost overwhelming rich, but oh-so tender and perfectly cooked. Until again, when I am in the mood... I hope to dine at Bouley again... I will try the pre-fix lunch as suggested by previous reviews.
My wife and I dropped in here in a Friday night for a bite to eat. Amazing atmosphere. Really small and very busy. Great food and really cheap.

Due to a six hour delay caused by American Airlines, I was forced to eat in the airport.  I thought Phillips Seafood would be OK because it's a chain...boy was I wrong.  I got the crab and shrimp salad wrap, and got food poisoning.  I had to go to an urgent center in Dallas where they tested me and found it was a "live" virus, meaning it just doesn't go away in 18 hours, it had to be treated with antibiotics.   The doctor at the center said this was common because "who knows how long the food hangs around in an airport".

Service was great, food amazing. Ingredients are very fresh and many are locally sourced. The menu is small but that's how they can make sure that every dish they deliver to the table is perfect. Lovely atmosphere..... we're looking forward to returning.

LEGIT. Halal Guys definitely hits the spot whether sober or intoxicated. Out of all the eateries we hit up in NYC, this was the most memorable. I can't stop dreaming about the $6 mix chicken and gyro over rice...

Was at an event at the Prudential Center on Saturday and stumbled upon this hidden gem, they had just opened the doors so I decided to try it out. Friendly service and a great atmosphere. My friend ordered a medium pizza with pepperoni and sausage and i ordered a spinach mushroom and Gorgonzola pizza all I can say is Wow Italy has been transported to Newark NJ, the brick oven is tremendous with the pizza guys using huge paddles to move the pizzas in and out of the ovens "real coal oven" this is the real deal and now I can honestly say that Newark has the best pizza in New Jersey or maybe the world try it you won't be disappointed

I couldn't believe that this place was located in Newark NJ, real authentic pizza in New Jersey. I had the clam casino pizza because I noticed that they hand shucked the clams and then placed them fresh on the pizza WOW talk about trying something new and exciting this place is hear to stay and I can say that it is the best pizza place I have ever been to. You need to try it for yourself and you will fall in love with the food Bravo Bravo
The cookie dough froho's are amazing!!! The food selection could be a little bigger but over all I love the place!!
Wanted to love it here because it's adorable and in my neighborhood but raw chicken entree made me want to puke. No thanks.

Very disappointing experience!  The food is mediocre and over salted, the wine is overpriced, even for Manhattan, the music is too loud and terrible, the kitchen door bangs every few seconds (this can be easily remedied!), the waiter tried his best, but the entire experience was unpleasant. The great mystery: the place is packed!  Perhaps the guests are tourists who can only make the mistake once.  As we live only a few blocks away, I am sorry that this cannot be counted among our neighborhood favorites.

The food was AMAZING! Great place to visit and have a nice lunch.. Everything was made fresh to order!!! Loved the flavors!!!!! We had the falafel and pork belly sandwich. Very unique restaurant!!!!!!
This was my first time eating here- got delivery. So great! It was fresh and delicious.
THIS WAS SO GOOD! The noodles were the perfect texture and tasted so fresh. The noodle soups are fantastic as well as the vegetable dumplings. A must have!!

Worst Food for the price. I went in there with my family expecting a nice restaurant with amazing food because of all the reviews and this was the first time I was truly disappointed with a restaurant after reading good reviews. If you aren't eating this kind of food on a regular basis, then you will love it because you are not use to it. I've been to Mediterranean Restaurants that cost half as much with food ten times better than this.   You will need ear plugs in this hell hole. The music is so loud I thought I was in a club. My little brother started dancing, I don't know what got into him lol. You can't hear anyone across the table from you. You will also need a flash light cuz its its really dark in there. Bottom line, DO NOT GO unless you want to pay for food that should cost less than half the price, love loud music and don't like talking to your friends and family cuz u can't hear them, and love darkness
Good food, nice staff sat at bar had a couple of items, everything wads good. Bartender was awsome really friendly and had some good suggestions, will be going back real soon. good spot for a date

Cavernous- no. High ceilings and plenty of oxygen- yes. Who wants to hangout in a stuffy restaurant anyway. During the day it's perfect for a business lunch or a get together and during the night it's perfect for dancing and getting a great cocktail. Happy hour has 1$ oysters shrimp and clams which is an awesome deal.
Geno's is like the old man river's version of cheese steak and Pat's is like the greatest heaven on earth.. I could never see in passing up Pat's cheese steak for anything.

I stopped in here and was surprised to see they had such a diverse menu, I just needed to use the bathroom and felt guilty so I ordered a hummus and it came with naan bread. This is the best hummus,  I ever tasted.  They place was packed so the food must be delicious!

This is probably one of the most interesting and best restaurants in New York!  It's a great, small venue, but it's very welcoming, intimate, and you immediately know you're in for a great meal when you step in. Anyone that can make roasted chicken taste like the finest gourmet entree ever conceived is doing something very, very right. Insanely simple food made the way God had intended. (Or possibly the other guy!) Damn this was amazing. I can't spit off the menu cuz I go into a food coma remembering the many great meals I've had here. The celebrities that hid here want to be invisible. Just so they can keep enjoying the fare. Overall, I think the place is worth every penny.  The only downside is that the seating is a bit tight.  But overall a nice romantic restaurant that serves quality food :-)

Brooklyn Commune has the luxury of being the only show in town. If you have the unfortunate experience of stopping by here in the morning you'll be able to find 1 lone individual trying to single handedly staff a coffee bar counter, cook, wait tables, bus tables, and do dishes. It is a disaster! Sometimes you will even find the ill fitted owners hiding deep in the back of the kitchen While a line forms out the door, (remember, it's the only convenient coffee shop for many citizens and the location is amazing.) While the owner cowers in the depths of the kitchen potential and irritated customers turn and walk out. The owners don't seem to care or lack the ability to face, help, and interact with patrons in their customer service based proprietorship. The coffee is good, the food if you're careful is nice. Emphasis on the careful, at times it feels as if an 8 year old was given free range with the spice rack.   My biggest gripe, the severe lack of employees, and the mentality to stand and watch and do nothing as customers walk out the door by the owners. Once a competitor opens up, I think this place will shutter.
Didn't get in. Closed early

Some of the best bar food I have had, Awesome wings, fries, bang clams!!!! It is a dive bar people, don't expect 5 star service or dining experience go to a place where that is expected and critique them , not a place like sharkeys..... Cant say I have ever had a bad meal here and I have been here over 50 times...
Great food, people and atmosphere. I was very satisfied. The portion sizes and prices are good and taste amazing

GUYS. I rarely order takeout because I'm admittedly That Girl when everyone in the office starts placing the Seamless order--Oh, they only have white bread? Hm. No, I still don't eat meat. Oh, tomato on my grilled cheese? No, it'll be soggy. Still, I tried the Belly's Grilled Cheese. This place has serious ingredients--Meunster AND Provolone? Ok!--and excellent execution--cheese melted on either side to keep the *black pepper & rosemary compound butter seared* wholegrain bread crispy? Yes, please! And tomato and/or bacon, if you want, for $1. Pretty great overall prices, too, esp for Manhattan. AND a decently sized portion of their satisfyingly hearty house tomato soup. Oh, and another thing: I was unwrapping the small bit of toast to dip in my soup when I realized it wasn't toast, but A SURPRISE COOKIE. I usually decline cookies, but I'm just feeling pretty great about this whole order. Best part: my low-maintenance friends all ordered the same thing and we're all respectively loving it.

My wife and I have eaten her countless times. We used to order several times a week, but since they opened their second location in Gowanus, the owner has disappeared and there's been a marked decline in the quality, quantity, and service. It's worth trying once, o. We strongly suggest dining in vs. taking out. Not because it's a wonderful dining experience, but because the food doesn't travel well and they tend to be really stingy or get things wrong on to-go orders. Makes sense when you consider this is food truck cuisine, meant to be consumed immediately. Favorites: falafel, chicken soup, pizza, pulled chicken tostada. Nachos look good too. Just be aware that the spicy is really spicy! Sadly, we crossed this off our go-to list for the reasons mentioned above.

OMG I had no I would be in love with Mediterranean Cuisine!!  It was FANTASTIC!  The mezza style was so fun for us with our friends...great way to eat delicious food & enjoy an awesome evening at the same time!   We especially LOVED the octopus which was something we would never even think of eating and it was OUT OF THIS WORLD!!!  The service was on point and friendly!  The atmosphere was shabby chic at its best!  Can't wait to go back we talk about it all the time!

This has been my absolute favorite Italian restaurant I  had the pleasure to dine in!  Believe me, I have dined in many !  Love the small town personal atmosphere and service is excellent!  My always favorite is clams in white wine sauce, homemade manicotti with the best tomato sauce, and for dessert, their apple pie!  It sometimes is a challenge getting there due to the traffic, but well worth the effort!  Only request I still keep asking for, is Please, Please rehang that beautiful oil painting you always had over our favorite booth! First thing you see when you walk in the door! Sunflowers, blue sky! Gorgeous and so authentic/heart warming!
Came to times square from L A. Looking for NYC's best cheesecake. Was not disappointed!

I am from California and a friend of mine took me to Jackson Hole and I would say I was impressed!!! Superb burgers and a humungous portion! Not that I eat big but I was satisfied! I missed it and I would definitely visit the place again if ever I go to New York for vacations. I love it!!!!!

DO NOT ORDER TAKEOUT THERE.  Complete disaster.  They told me 15 minutes.  The order took 55 minutes.  The service was awful.  The staff just stood there as takeout customers just waited around.  There was no checking up on the order.  It was completely disorganized.  There was no apology and explanation on how a "4 minute cook time" according to the website took so long.  You can't even blame the dine in guests as it was less than half full.  In one transaction you have turned an advocate of the location to a former customer.   Ultimately I blame the management of this location.  I hope corporate reads this especially if they have plans of taking this further (I research these types of businesses for a living).  Management has trained their staff poorly. Perhaps management should have noticed the pileup of takeout orders and people standing around the area and thus blocking both the bar access as well as the kitchen access.  Perhaps management should train employees to tell guests that it will take longer than 15 minutes when calling in the order.   Also I blame your outdated POS terminal and kitchen display (or lack thereof) despite opening 3 months ago.  It's 2014.  New restaurants have terminals that have time counters on orders that make people aware that a person has waited 55 minutes for an order that was supposed to take 15 minutes.  They have line expediters that figure out hold ups in transactions so ultimately customers don't see 10 other people get their order before they do.   Finally the pizza crust was overly charred (and this is coming from someone that likes charred pizza crusts) making the whole trip not worth it.   You are located in a town with 20 pizza places.  You either need to be ridiculously better than all of the other places (especially at $20 a pie) or you need to lower the friction of buying a pizza in order to get me to call you and drive past the other locations.  You are failing on both fronts.  I never write reviews and yet this transaction was so frustrating that you inspired me to sign up and write a review.

Delicious food. Legit farm to table restaurant with a beautiful decor and very polite and helpful staff. A bit pricey and the portions are small but we had a fabulous experience. I love that they cook with fresh organic ingredients. The service was superb and the food was just as good as it looked. The egg and mushroom pizza was super rich but super yummy. And the crunchy shrimp salad with carrot sesame dressing is a dish that will keep me coming back. The shrimp could be "crunchier" though. I can't wait to go back again especially because the menu will be totally different with the change of season because of the farm to table dining concept.

Mediocre food for unreasonable prices. The pasta sauce is homemade I believe but there was way too much olive oil which drowned out the herbs and other flavors and pooled at the bottom of the meatballs. Margherita pizza had similar sauce so there was absolutely no flavor to it. Very disappointed after reading such great reviews.

Cool place.  Loved the bar area.  Had a great selection of IPA's and wine.  Appetizers and dinners were tasty.  I wish the portions were a little larger for the price but I expected that.  Service from all staff members was excellent.

Came in about a week ago after gone without my fix for too long. I love this place. The portions are great, food is always exciting, and the staff is super friendly. On this most recent visit I got one of the waiters that had been then before the the closing and he recognized me and was great as usual. Really glad some of the old staff is there. I had a zombie, aligator, and the trinity poboy and it all was better than i remember. The food took a little time but I imagine that comes with the territory of reopening after so long. Can't wait for more!

I've been going to Tria for years and never have had a bad experience.  Best time to go is during "Sunday school," you can check out a new wines, beers, cheeses that change week to week and are a bit off the beaten path.  It's great to have a wine bar with so much adventure that is still affordable - love trying new great wines.  Servers are friendly and know their stuff well - so trust their recommendations if you aren't sure where to start.
Best place in philly!
love reading terminal market. great meat & produce selection

I've never had a bad experience here. The bread, from Terra Momo Bread Co, and olive oil are fantastic, the wines are excellent. The menu is not incredibly inventive and I'd like to see more variety and use of seasonal ingredients. The ambiance is great, particularly when you can sit outside, and the service I've received has always been good.

Since the algorithm decided that my first review would not show here, I thought I should try writing another review that will show up. My now-husband and I had a horrible experience at Frankie's on the night we got married at City Hall.  We were first told the wait was 45 minutes.  We were relaxed, drank a bottle of wine on the patio and chatted away.  But we were not seated until 1.5 hours had gone by.  When we were finally sitting at a table, the server was so incredibly rude and inattentive that even after waiting for so long already, we got up and left.  If I wait for 1.5 hours for a table, I expect a certain level of kindness and service from waitstaff.  No food in the world is worth that kind of attitude. We ended up going to Brucie, got a table right away, had an extremely delicious meal, served by extremely friendly people, and cannot wait to return.

Delicious!!! Had the Brussel sprouts and quinoa and zucchini slider with avocado fries and it was great! They forgot to add the pork belly to the sprouts I ordered and they immediately sent it over!!! So nice!!!

I live in DC, but work in NYC occasionally. I always stay in Princeton because it is cheep, and easy to get in and out of. On every trip I make a point of eatting here. I think the curries are fantastic, and I love the general atmosphere of the restaurant.   I have never been disappointed.
The happy hour is very valuable!!!
Don't judge a book by its cover.  Despite the understated outside and simple interior decor, all dishes ordered by our party of 6 were great!  Hats off to the chef!!  We would definitely come back.

Great food! Warm Italian place with a family atmosphere. I recommend getting a few meatballs on the side, maybe even a few to go. I've ate at the Villa more than once and could never complain about one thing. Food comes out hot and is delicious. Employees treat you like you are a regular even if it's your second visit. I will continue eating at the Villa whenever I'm in Philadelphia again. Highly recommend.

I'm giving this restaurant 1 star because the food was pretty good; nothing extraordinary, and overpriced (though not for the area), but reasonably tasty.  And the room itself was quite lovely. Service:  The worst waitress I've ever experienced in a restaurant of this class. Surly; angry; unbelievable attitude.  No introduction. Not one smile throughout. She obviously hated working there, and particularly hated our party because we had two elderly people with us. She never checked in with us to see if we were happy with our meals.  She never refilled our water. She obviously couldn't wait until we left her section. I did not pay the bill, but I wouldn't have given her a cent as a tip. Seating:  We'd made a reservation for a specific table for 1:15 on Monday Columbus Day. That table was very near the entrance because we had two elderly people with us. One had just gotten out of the hospital, the other was handicapped & on an electric scooter.  We arrived a little late: 1:23.  They'd given the table away!  We were asked if we'd be willing to use the ramp, to a table on the upper level; our guest with the scooter declined to do so, since negotiating the ramp was a little tight -- AND, reasonably, he wanted the table which he always got.  It took THIRTY minutes for the guests at the table we'd reserved to get their check, pay their bill, and depart. The waitress did nothing to expedite processing their check once they'd handed in their credit card.  That added 12 minutes to the wait (which would've only been 18, if she'd rushed it through). The hostess never should have given away our four-top just because we were 8 minutes late.  And the waitress absolutely could & should have expedited the departure of the guests at our reserved table. This was a very bad experience, and did damage to a long-awaited reunion experience.
This place is great the food is fantastic the chef is a master he's friendly talks to all the tables.  The fish is fresh like it just came out of the sea.

My favorite place! If you like Potatoes this is the place for you! Such a variety and you can build your own or choose from there amazing combos they have. I've never had something I didn't like from this place. 5 stars!!!

Are you kidding me. I sat at the counter for 12 minutes - no one spoke to me or offered to take my order.  I walked out. Got tired of watching the cashiers flirt with each other and the servers talking to each other and ignoring guests.  Awful service - can't rate the food

Not only is the food absolutely to die for, but so is the customer service! It was obvious that this place has it going on by the number of regulars that passed through the door to grab some yummies that they must have been craving for very good reason. I was lucky enough to sit by the counter with the array of sweet treats. I indulged in the sour cherry pie a la mode and I must admit, it is one of the best pies I ever had and the crust was impeccable. I even took some home as it was so hard to choose! This place is a must, an absolute must!!!
Perfect "real" breakfast... Like a Route 66 diner. Small, but awesome. And they're totally cool.
Awesome place!!!! Love their sandwiches and lots of vegan options. Coffee is wonderful too by the way.

The Bounty is a lovely restaurant with potential but they need to improve both their service and their food. The kitchen has a heavy hand with sauces, seasonings and oil.  While they are on the right track with their desire to provide flavorful dishes, they simply need to tone it down a bit and let the ingredients speak for themselves a bit more. The service was detached and distracted.  Bartender was chatting with his buddies and ignoring his customers.   Took a smoke break and jumped back behind the bar with out washing his hands and  then served us our food.  This is a breach of basic industry protocol. Left there with the feeling that The Bounty was not being operated by someone who really cared about the quality of the food or the customer experience.

Best brunch in manhattan. Everything is homemade and amazing. The thin sourdough pancakes are the best pancakes in the history of mankind. Definitely worth going as much as possible. Kid friendly too.

We were so pleased with this restaurant on our last visit to TriBeCa...pies were the best we've ever had. Family enjoyed everything from the mac n cheese to the organic salmon and chicken.  If visiting NY, this is worth the drive to Hudson St.  They also have a spot on the High Line that serves pies and homemade ice cream and pop.

This place is awesome. The food is amazing, delicious and affordable.   It's wonderful to have so many rose options in a place that looks like a spot for a European romantic movie. I kind of felt like I was in Europe for a minute. Every crepe I've had was fantastic.  The Out To Pasture and La Colombiana are my favs. The Kashmiri chai is out of this world. One of a kind In many ways. This was my second trip and there will be many more for sure :)) Will definitely recommend to everyone!!!

I was in Philadelphia for a show over at World Cafe Live and was in the mood for a savory crepe. Authentic french crepes, with excellent prices. The food was amazing!  It looked beautiful & tasted even better. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the owner is very friendly. The food was prepared quickly. I cannot think of a single thing that wasn't done well! I highly recommend it!

First time there and all I can say is AMAZING. Me and my bestfriend went at night and just the view itself is breath taking. Our waitress was amazing! She always made sure we were okay and that everything was fine and she took our orders quick. The food came really fast and tasted delicious! The vibe was just perfect. The music wasn't so loud nor low, it was just right. I recommend everyone to try this place. I enjoyed it for my first time and I would definitely return!

This place is fantastic. I came here the other night with a friend, we both had the tuscan chicken, it was delightful! We also shared the mushroom cigars and the tuna tartar to start. They were both outstanding. Cant wait to come back! Its BYOB!
Great food, great service, and such a cute location! Definitely a great place to go for breakfast.

O-M-G! I just love this place, the atmosphere is so clean and pet friendly, the staff are so delightful and the food is amazing, I love their hazelnut latte. this is now my fav spot-love the Sunday crowd

Good service, great food. Been here 3 times, consistently good. Broccoli rabe dish is my favorite. My fiancé thinks they should fill up the wine glasses more. Will definitely be back again. There's always a wait but what do you expect when a place is good.
Always excellent service, great wine list, really consistent food quality. Well worth a visit
I mean, it's fine and I had no complaints -- cute spot, nice servers, everything tasted good -- but food this basic should cost a lot less. Every single thing on the menu is overpriced by $5 to $10.

Huge fan of Tom's Turkey Club! Very filling (I only manage to eat half and save half for later) with a lot of meat. Bacon is cooked perfectly and I love the clean, crispness the cucumber adds to the sandwich. I would like to try some other menu options, but I can't keep away from this delicious club!

Excellent service, great ambience, awesome carribean style restaurant. My wife and I had lunch here and we must say, we were impressed with everything. From the smart menu in an otterbox type frame, simple with not so many items, but just enough to leave your mouth watering and curious of every item. Anyway, lets get to the most important part, the food. I had jerked chicken wings with okra fries. I must say, ive eaten at plenty carib. spots but this jerked chicken takes the cake.  I love spicy food and this was right down my alley and I love that they have a non spicy bbq option as well if thats not your thing (my wife). It wasnt hot sauce type spicy,  it was a natural spicy that was spicy because of the natural herbs and spices! I prefer okra fries over all fries now as well, thats how good they were(this was my first time eating okra fries). Theyre fried in a special plantain flour that make your mouth water as you eat them. My wife had the salmon burger with chips. You cant go wrong with the salmon burger, seasoned and cooked to perfection served with chips [(also can be served with okra fries (recommended)]. Even the chips were made with a seasoning they make there that was absolutely delicious. And all this was washed down with a wonderfully made sorrel which is one of my favorite carribbean drinks(served non-alcoholic, but restaurant is B.Y.O.B so bring rum if you want it loaded!). Oh and the water is served with a lemon and a cucumber slice which makes it so refreshing it might be illegal. This place is truly special because of the way they cook healthy food, it leaves wanting more plus you leave feeling better than when you came in. This is a truly special place which I will come to frequently because I feel it truly is vital, all pun intended!

All I can say is the food is great here Anthony really can cook up some great dishes you have to try the chicken savoy on the bone it's amazing and the shrimp beeps are to die for keep up the great cooking and service you do . Thanks

2.5 stars. The one word to describe this place is "inconsistent." The cocktails are the one standout - always delicious and inventive. The food ranges from excellent to bland. The service is relaxed at best, and several times it's taken 15-20 minutes to even be acknowledged by a server. I have had one or two excellent experiences here and at least half a dozen poor ones. I do not think I will be returning, except perhaps for a cocktail at the bar.

I lived in Texas for 4 years and North Carolina for 4 years...this BBQ is quite nice.  Line can take a while and you can't reserve a seat.  Great menu and probably my favorite BBQ place in NYC.  It would be here vs hill country BBQ for my favorite (both Texan I might add).  Single thing is weighty so would limit yourself to one side unless really hungry.  A bit messy wouldn't go on a date here.

What can I say, if your reading this you've already been and you just found your newest favorite pizza place and if you haven't you probably stopped reading after the third review and are on your way there, my favorite of the new haven pizza scene
meh. Food was lousy. Service was great. Came for brunch left tipsy and had a great experience, sadly I left hungry though and in retrospect portions were not appropriate fro pricing.

You pay for what you get and this place is worth every penny!!!! There are often coupons in the Mercer County Clipper.  The restaurant is clean and the food is very good!  Everyone in the family will find something to eat and leave full!
one of my favorite hidden gems of my hometown! the polenta, lemon pasta, and homemade zeppoles with fresh cannoli cream are to die for!
My family and I love their food, it's just amazing and the people are so friendly. The price is good as well and you get a lot:)

Some of the best brunch on the Upper West Side. I've been to Jacobs Pickles many times and it never disappoints. The portions are huge. You will not leave Jacobs pickles hungry. The honey chicken and biscuit is amazing. Their homemade fries and ketchup are a favorite! If you crawl out of bed late, hungover expect to be on a wait but this wait is worth it!

Wife and I dropped in for the $10.00 lunch which includes a coffee or soda. We both had the burgers with fries, red onions, lettuce, tomato, cheese and bacon. These burgers were cooked just right and must be half a pound each. These are REAL French Fries, not the extruded ones that some places serve. Extruded ones come out of a machine like toothpaste comes out of a tube. Extruded ones are basically mashed potatoes mixed with whatever chemicals are needed so they do not discolor. Waitress came back at least twice to table to make sure everything was OK. Noise level at lunch was not high. We could easily talk. Just realized that there may be no TVs. What a pleasant surprise! We don't go to a pubic place to watch TV. We can do that at home. Real paper towels in bathroom, not just a blow dryer. The places with a dryer, if you change your baby, how do you dry the baby/ Some dryers have a slit to stick your hands into. They are having a special event for Halloween and may go back for that. Very nice place.

Our bartender, Julia, started our visit by talking to her coworkers and not acknowledging us for several minutes. When she finally came over she was not overly friendly bordering rude. When I ordered an Irish coffee she served it and then told me there was no more whip cream in a flip manner and then just walked off. When I finished my drink she was again talking to a coworker and I had to ask for my check after several minutes sitting with an empty drink on the bar and then just threw the bill on the bar. She didn't even take the time to ring up our purchase and had a coworker do it. When her coworker got on the job behind the bar she sneezed in her hand and then just continued to make drinks. We were going to have dinner there, but with this kind of introduction to their business there is no way I would eat there. If these people worked for me I would fire them!!!
YES!!! As good as it gets! If you are into authentic Thai food, this place is the one you are looking for. So far this is THE BEST Thai restaurant I have been to.

Went on a Sunday afternoon to grab some brunch with a couple of friends. We walked in and since this was our first time we awkwardly stood around for some help on seating. One waitress told us to go into the backyard and then another told us to wait to be seated. After awkwardly standing around, we eventually were seated in the backyard. The ambience was pretty cool and relaxed which I thought was worth the 2 stars. I ordered the gravy biscuits and my friend ordered the special of the day, apple pancakes. I could not finish my biscuits because it almost felt like it was doused in salt. I tried a bite of my friends apple pancakes in hopes of a better meal but was sadly disappointed. The pancakes tasted very dense and doughy with a couple of apples on top. However, the waitress that was serving us was very pleasant and kind which made up for some of the experience at J'eatjet.
Its not Hype, this place is really producing some of the best tasting dumplings. its worth it to stand in line.

I stopped by for coffee on opening day and was able to sit in their adorable back patio with my dog. The staff are very friendly and the cafe is self is really cute. I appreciate that they had honey for my coffee, but would have loved almond or coconut milk to go along with it. I will definitely be back in to try the food ASAP. Glad to have them in the neighborhood.

The quality of the meat is really good in the pho.  I enjoyed the crudo I started with as well, but it was less exciting.  Location is not the easiest to get to - I suppose it's pretty "hipster" and adds to that vibe, but we had an enjoyable meal.  Love the BYOB vibe - very small and I can appreciate the we do a few things well sentiment - and they do.  The pho itself was a little on the bland side unless you add the herbs they give you and some sriracha, but the quality of ingredients was great.  They were out of bahn mi when we went, so we'd like to return to try that out next time, I'd go again, but not often - it's too far and I've been told there are other good pho places to check out.

In this lovely little Chelsea restaurant I had one of the best if not the best sandwich I have ever had.  Go and order the credo pork sandwich, marinated, braised pork butt with aiole  and chimicurri sauce, and crunchy diced potatoes!

At less less than $23 per person after tax, this is a one of a kind Hot Pot and/or Korean BBQ Buffet All You Can Eat. So you DO NOT need to go to Flushing or 34th Street. Nor do you have to pay a premium. They serve you as they have the hordes of choices for the BBQ. A deeper look and it is not exclusive to Korean Style BBQ but also quite a few Chinese dishes as well. I would recommend either Hot Pot or BBQ but not both unless you can really eat. You will be pleasantly surprised that one of the free drink choices includes Prunella, which is great for those who are familiar with it. Do make reservations because you will end up waiting a while and thankfully they do call you when the table is ready in case you're not stranded there. I would say go after 9p to be safe so the wait may not be as long. Smaller tables have more efficient service than big tables as it is usually one server per party though if they see its a really big group and it gets really busy, then 2 or more may swing by in different intervals. Overall the cheapest place to do BBQ with an unmatched variety and competitively priced Hot Pot.
Welcome to the neighborhood!  Love that they have so many veg-friendly options, and the fish taco was ridiculously good.

I've always loved their fillings.  However, I got some savory crepes, and was disappointed to see that there wasn't much filling in them.  I know that they're just starting out.  So I hope they can keep the consistency I have come to expect from them.  Otherwise, it just won't be worth it for the price or the long wait during their busy times.
Great boneless wings

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. My girlfriend did pickup, came home and the wings were bad, no sauce and very dry. She brought our order back to get remade or get her money back. She came home in tears, the manager "Chris" became very aggressive with her and yelled at her in a store full of customers. This is unbelievable and hands down the worst management ever. Needless to say between the bad wings, but more over how they treat repeat customers, we will NEVER pay this place another dime. Thankful for competition, new customers on the market.

Prices are good food is above average and selection is great. They are on grub hub. I recommend it. Pizza is good. sandwiches are good. Plus delivery is pretty fast and I've never had an issue. Cheese stakes are good. They have some good deals check the coupons. I'm a regular.
Good place to go for great beer. I have had some of the appetizers and they were good. This is a great place to go to relax in the city.

The pizza is average. It's good, but nothing special. 20 bucks for a small and two toppings. Classic wood fire pizza. The service isn't very good either. Only 1 water refill even though I asked for more. I would choose another pizza spot if you head to Brooklyn.

one of my favorite bars! sometimes a lil too crowded but the staff members are great, and they take the time to get to know you, and they make you feel comfortable right from the moment you step in. Great food, great drinks, and great atmosphere!

THE FOOD IS GREAT, BUT.... I took off 2 stars reluctantly. I was hovering between 3 or 4 stars but I finally settled on 3 stars. I ate lunch here on a rainy day (more like a drizzly day) and the restaurant was completely empty.  Only 1 other customer came to pick up a take out order. When I arrived, the hostess was having a rather animated conversation (in English) with a customer on the phone. I believe this is the same hostess who the other reviewers say yells all the time. To me, she speaks in a very quick shrill voice which is not the greatest to hear when you want to eat in peace. I had been looking forward to eating here for quite a while, since I love Thai food and the ratings from other sites seemed high. My order was a lunch special consisting of Jasmine tea, coconut rice and shrimp shumai (lunch special). The food was very flavorfull, well cooked, and delicious. The rice did not taste very "coco-nutty", but it was still good. The shrimp shumai are bite sized but very filling. The hostess did pour my tea and showed me a trick to making great tea :) To me, an empty restaurant is not a good sign, even on a slightly rainy day. I feel that customers probably prefer to take out food although the interior is nicely decorated. However, the lighting is a bit dark and not as welcoming as it could be. I didn't care for the "Budweiser" menus or the cheap paper place mats on the elegant tables, very tacky. Consider that  many items on the dinner menu are as high as $22 per serving which isn't cheap. All the lunch specials are $8.95. This price range puts it on a PF Chang's footing, but Chang's far exceeds them in terms of interior and service. The Japanese restaurant down the street, Ginza, is not as fancy but the service is great, the interior is decent (no frills) and your food comes fast (it isn't as great, but it's still pretty good). All foodies know that great food is 90% of dining out, but service and ambience count for a lot too. Tamarind Grill could EASILY get up to a consistent 5 star level or even higher if it would offer a more welcoming and customer friendly atmosphere, play some mood music, and offer service comparable to other Asian restaurants in the area. I hope they are able to see that people really love the food, but deserve to have a complete eat-in restaurant experience.

Overall the best restaurant in the burlington area. Known for their beautiful salad bar, the windjammer is a great place for large and small parties and even has a fun pub upstairs--the Upper Deck. Service staff is knowledgable and professional. Food is always good. There is something on the menu for everyone. If you want the best, ask your host to put you in Sonja's section. Best server in town.
Such a good bargain. Not the prettiest place but the food tastes amazing and the lunch menu is an amazing bargain. I would recommend this to anyone in the neighborhood.

The worse minestrone soup! Pure tomato sauce. No consistency of beans vegetables or pasta. The bartender said he was sorry. Owning a business ourselves we would of offered a drink on the house. Very disappointed !!!
Yucca Fries are a must! Best I've had

I happened to stop by here because of my friend who is a huge fan of Woorijip. I tried their Beef Teriyaki with brown rice and I have to say, it's delicious! I love the sauce that they use. Everything is cheaper compared to the Food Court across the street. And there are also a variety of different meals to get. I have to say if you do come here, ask for a Woorijip card so that after coming here like around 10 times, you can get a discount during the next time you come. I recommend this place!

This place is so adorable! I love the open windows in the warm weather, giving you the impression you're sitting outside. The decor is modern but has a kind of cabin in the woods feel, and the food is delicious. Our table tasted a lot - the seared tuna special, the burger and fries, the pork belly, etc, all superb!
Wonderful food and service. loved the cheese fries. Burgers are good too. Will definitely recommend to my friends.

Words cant describe how amazingly good this place is. I made a yelp accound just for this place. LOL. I got an italiano with mozz and it tasted like a meatball just like our waitress said it would taste like. I didnt pit the marinara on it but i dipped my fries in it and it was so good. I was the first person to get a piece of their homemade cheesecake and I kid you not, AH-EFFING-MAZING!!!! Their zeppoles are amazing too however I need a rehab for their goodness. I'm such a dessert person. LOL. A must go visit! I will definitely be back.
The clam pie was one of the best pies I ever had.  The crust and flavor of the pie was great.  It was well worth the trip to New Haven.  I will go back.

So... I'll say that I came to this place because its clearly HIGHLY recommended, and I love BBQ. Unfortunately I was met with pork belly whose dryness was rivaled only by the attitude of the guy who dished it out to me -- we'll call him Snarky Bandana Guy. I was forced to hastily choose my meat and sides as I tried to take a gander at the selections on the menu. I ordered a cple half pounds of various meats to give it all try, all of it average. The beef rib which "Snarky Bandana Guy" passionately said he "couldn't do a half lb" of, was the highlight of it all, yet still not over the moon. Perhaps it was an off day... but it was Saturday afternoon, so go figure. If you enjoy Red Hook imports that take pride in their "local dining options" and snide service then give hometown a try. I'd skip the trip to no mans land and head to Williamsburg instead. Fette Sau is waaaay better.
Woo hoo, I was here for a soft opening and really enjoyed the Hors d'oeuvres and Ever Upward beer. The ambience is nice and well worth checking out.
