We decided to exit the premises vowing never to eat there again, so then the Owner/Manager says to us you'll be back in a very condescending way...The bottom line is,we know that 2 customers won't really make a difference when it comes to their profits.....BUT MAYBE JUST MAYBE WE CAN COLLECTIVELY..... A lot of us eat at this restaurant but if they are not going to do right by us when called upon.....WHY SHOULD WE!
Best for two. Get 1-2 items and share.

I go here all the time for my favorite drink, frozen margaritas, and my favorite food, steak nachos. They do those two foods very well. I've tried other things on their menu--burritos, tacos, and plantains--and they're good as well. Complimentary salsa and chips are great and much better than you can get in a store.

This was one of the most bizarre restaurant experiences that I have ever had. Long story short, I was served two glasses of milk--one servable but close to spoiling, one clearly sour to both of us eating. I wasn't comfortable eating French toast made with milk after that experience. According to the below, the manager tasted both glasses and found them to be fresh, so he left our meal as-is. I'm not going to call him a liar--maybe his sense of taste is overwhelmed after tasting food all the time, or there's some other issue where he honestly didn't notice. Also, it's true that I was getting emotional, so I can believe that he didn't want to come near the table. At any other restaurant, though, there would have been a number of customer service courtesies that weren't followed here: 1) Offer me an opportunity to order something else and let me pay for it; 2) Provide a small courtesy, like a free iced tea or something other than milk; 3) Comp some or all of my food. None of those things were followed here. Also, the last time I checked, isn't a restaurant supposed to err on the side of finding that the customer is right? And for the record, though the French toast tasted fine and I was hungry, I was too busy thinking about spoiled milk in the kitchen and the lack of a resolution to this to be happy with my experience. If I had to speculate as to what happened here, perhaps senior management is breathing down the manager's neck so much about maximizing profits or wasted food that he's reluctant to do anything. Since I'm a local, I'll probably go somewhere else next time. I'm posting my email, truncated for here, and his response. --- Dear Green Eggs: ...When my milk arrived, it was servable but slightly sour. I complained to another server who came to my table by mistake and asked for another glass of milk. My fiancee and I both agreed that the replacement was completely sour and spoiled.... When the manager came over to my table, he told me that he had tasted the first glass of milk himself when I sent it back and that it was fine. I told him that the second glass of milk was completely spoiled and that because French toast was made with milk, after two sour glasses of milk I felt like I didn't want to eat the French toast that I had ordered anymore. ... I was served the French toast that I originally ordered, and when the bill came, I was charged the full amount minus $3 for milk I didn't drink, $32.40. ... The message that you sent to me today is that you don't take your customers seriously... Joe --- Joe, I was actually the manager that you had the discussion with about the spoiled milk. First, I'd like to thank you for how well you handled the situation. I know that you may believe that you lost your cool, but I truly (and I told you at the table) don't believe that you did. Many customers would have been in my face attempting to physically harm me over the milk, but you used your words and treated me with respect, which I greatly appreciated. When you first came to the counter, you told me about your milk, which I was already told by Joy about. She brought over a small glass and the bottle to me and asked me to try it. I tried the milk, and inspected the date on the package. The "Sell By" date on the milk was for 10/20/14 and I tried the milk myself and it was not spoiled to my taste. I had the busboy bring up fresh milk and dump that container anyway, because that is a major issue, food poisoning can come very easily from those items. I tried the milk and inspected the date again, and it was to my standards. I understand your concern with this milk and the french toast milk being the same, but it is not. We use whole milk for our french toast and the Tiramisu French Toast that you ordered. This batter was checked in the morning for freshness by myself, the Chef de Cuisine, and his Sous Chef in our daily line check. After I removed the milk from the table, I went to check on your food to make sure that it was perfect, and again, to my standards, it was. I returned with Joy at the table and your fiance clearly didn't want us to keep coming back and discussing the matter with you. She was frustrated and I didn't want you both to have a terrible experience. After you received your food, I talked with Joy to make sure that everything was okay and she assured me that it was. I poked my head in the room, privately, to make sure that everything was going well and you seemed, to my eyes, to be enjoying your Tiramisu tremendously. I understand that maybe the milk wasn't to your liking, so I took it off, even though I believe that the milk was safe and okay to drink and I received no other complaints throughout the entire shift. Also, each time I left the table, I excused myself to check on either your complaint or your food or something directly related to your experience. I apologize for your experience and please feel free to email me back if you have any questions Franco C. Assistant General Mgr
Nice one.
Ok the best thing I've ever eaten between 2 pieces of bread. Seriously if I'm within 100 miles ill make the trip. How can they redefine the philly cheese steak? I have no idea.
The interior is really pretty, and the food was good too, the price is reasonable, and the waiters are really cute lol I would totally recommend this place to anyone and everyone !!

Worst service ive ever seen. Counter girl started yelling at me when I asked why i was missing some of my food in the bag. Got no refund...rather than saying sorry, she told me shes been working there too long to deal with me.. im not sure what that means. When I asked for her name she told she doesnt have to disclose that information!

Anthony's is one of my all time favorite restaurants. I started by stopping in for a cup of coffee after yoga, and have moved up to occasionally ordering a week's worth of food for a family. No matter how big or small my order, they have always been friendly and helpful. I'm not surprised he's offered to personalize menu items to accommodate someone's dietary needs. He's offered me similar accommodations and even sent me instructions for how to prepare his delicious ravioli that he sells over the holidays so I could wow my family despite my limited skills in the kitchen. The owner & staff are truly the nicest people - which makes the experience that much more amazing. The brunches are incredible, the lunches are delicious and always changing, but by far the best time to go to Anthony's is for Thursday night dinner. The menu is always creative - putting a twist on your favorite comfort foods. AND it's BYOB - does it get much better? I honestly cannot say enough good things about Anthony's - and I stand by my words as I've brought numerous friends along at different times - all of whom have fallen in love. And so, I can't help but address a post about Anthony being argumentative - I find it hard to believe. I've gone enough that friends joke he can plan his retirement on me. Though rare, I have seen him exhausted. And I've seen him swamped, but never seen him nasty. I'm not saying people - and restaurants - can't have off days, and if someone caught such a day, it's really unfortunate, because this place is a hidden gem. However, if you're saying you've had repeated instances of food that was stale, not well seasoned, or orders that have been delayed while simultaneously calling yourself a long paying customer who generally likes the food, that seems a little contradictory. Not saying you couldn't have a bad experience, but suggesting its par for the course is not even close to an accurate description of this place. So, for anyone else thinking of checking out this restaurant, I HIGHLY recommend you head over and try it for yourself. Given the fact that he majority of the reviews are outstanding, I am confident you won't be disappointed.

Always pleased when it comes to this place. The food is great love the pad Thai & steamed dumplings. The wait staff is very attentive & the prices are even better. They have a luncheon special daily that is worth the price.
Cheap, tasty and friendly

I stopped in on a Sunday and sat at the bar to watch some football. I was immediately impressed with the cleanliness and wide open feel of this place. The bar was sleek and well decorated with color changing lights in the center with two large TVs on either side playing Sunday NFL.   I was greeted by the bartender who made me feel quite welcome and comfortable. I decided not to have one of the 2 dozen or so beer options. I even rejected the idea of having some Whistle Pig or another local spirit. If I wasn't driving, I would have had plenty of local brew or booze options. I was impressed with the menu. It was concise and had plenty of options for a variety of cravings. The bartender recommended the spicy burger. I thought that sounded good but I have a weakness for Boucher Blue in Highgate. The Green Mountain burger came to me perfectly medium rare and juicy with good seasoning and sear. It was topped with a good portion of the cheese along with maple bacon (I think - I don't quite remember it being there) arugula, tomato and slightly sweet picked onions. I asked for extra garlic aioli on the side so I could dip my fries in it. It had a mellow garlic flavor which complimented the contents of the burger. The fries were hand cut and served crispy and they complimented the aioli. The brioche bun was just ok. I would have liked to have more texture and a little less sweetness. My burger would have paired well with a hearty and savory bread but the brioche was not a deal breaker. It's exciting to have another restaurant option in Williston that focusses on the local ingredients. I wish the price would reflect the money we should be saving on shipping over long distances. My burger, fries and water was $14 so $20 with tax and tip. I think that is a little steep for a 6oz. patty of beef no matter how local it is. I'll be back for more Boucher blue. Next time I'll bring more money and a designated driver.

Great for fried-food lovers.   What I tried: Combo deal flounder, 2 shrimps, fries. Plus fried broccoli with cheese separately. Tasty/good/fresh.  Fries average. Did not usually notice the place when walking past it until I found out about it online. Easy to miss. People nice. I like the food. Would come again.
Yuck. I have never had pizza cooked from a conveyer belt oven before and never will again! Sloppy mess pizza.
Great spots for sandwiches thumbs down for pastries. The good thing is that it was open past 7pm on a Sunday.. Nice place very nice environment

Went to the Farm for brunch today. Food was good, but for the portion size, the prices were high. The shock really came ,when we got the bill, at the end of the meal. $3.50, for coffee, REALLY??? Most places include coffee with brunch, but aside from that, I have never paid that price for coffee in Brooklyn. If you want bread with a brunch entree, that doesn't include it (like an omelet, who doesn't give you bread, with eggs) it's an extra $2.00. When we spoke to the manager about the price of coffee (which by the way, is not listed on the menu), he was condescending, which was not necessary at all. When we paid the bill, after asking if we needed change, he didn't even bring back the right amount! Won't be back!!!

This place was very good! We started by getting the soup of the day and it was flavored perfectly. We then ordered the calamari and they were cooked perfectly. The tomato sauce that came with it was so good! I am not a tomato sauce person and I would put this sauce on pasta. For our entree we ordered a whole bbq chicken and ribs with rice and French fries! The fries were cooked perfectly! The ribs and chicken were also cooked perfectly. The chicken was moist and tender. Overall, great place!

I rather not eat Italian abroad since I come from Italy but this Italian restaurant pizzeria was highly recommended by a friend of mine and I had to pay a visit. I found this place outstanding ,I had timbal lo di zucchini first and than a diavolo pizza,to be honest I don't think you can find a pizza so good in Italy so easily. The crust , the tomato sauce, the mozzarella fiordilatte in NYC I couldn't believe it. So good that they deserved my first review on yelp. Bravi
simple delicious italian food at very reasonable price

Went on my daughters reco.    Great menu, great service, great food.  Lived up to my expectations.  Was disappointed with the Desserts, didn t live up to the high standards of the rest of the meal.  Will definitely go again

It's such a shame that having such great food, the service at this restaurant is that bad. My boyfriend and I had a late reservation at this place, after dinner we were enjoying our conversation so we stayed on the table talking for a little after we paid our check probably around 11, we looked around and there were still 3 other tables so we thought it would be no problem.. All of the sudden all the servers and I believe the owners were behind the counter staring at us, waiting for us to leave, one of them which I believe was either one of the owners of a manager said loud enough just for us to hear and on a very rude tone: "ok enough is enough it's time to leave." What a terrible and rude service, if you don't want people at your restaurant, do not open one.

I expected a lot from this place considering it has pretty good reviews on yelp. I went on Sunday around noon and the wait was about 40 minutes. It was a chilly day and we waited outside since it's really small inside and there's really no space inside to wait. The host was nice coming out every so often to let us know it'll be a couple more minutes. Once we sat down, everything went downhill. The waitress that served us looked like she hated her job. I ordered the special which was a mushroom and jalapeño omelette. It took an hour for us to get our food. The two tables on the left of us ate and left and our food was still not in front of us. I understand that it was busy so maybe that's what took so long. Then the table on our right, who got seated AFTER us, got their food before us! When we called for the waitress to ask for our food, she didn't even bother to stop at our table completely. She just passed us by and said "I know what your thinking but it's not my fault." Excuse me? That comment completely ruined my experience here. The host that was so nice before we got seated was so cold towards us when we asked for our food. He didn't even apologize for our wait. He just told us if we wanted to leave he won't stop us. We were debating on leaving and was about to get up and leave, but our food had just come and we were starving since we had waited for about 2 hours for our food. The food was disappointing. Considering how long it took, I expected hot food. Everything on my plate was cold. The omelette was mediocre. I could've went grocery shopping and made it myself at home in a shorter amount of time. And I would've had hot food!
A great place to eat with a variety of good food. My personal favorites are The Original Turkey for a healthy sandwich, smoothies from Kamal's, and pretzels from Miller's Twist.
Amazing food, really fresh and healthy. Great selection of vegetarian stuff like black bean & sweet potato burger-like-things. And delicious veggies! Plus, great service. This place wins.

I was disappointed with the cheesesteak.  A friend told me they were the best in the city, I thought it tasted more like shredded canned dog food meat. Too salty and the meat was dry. The front desk lady was blown away when I threw her a couple dollars, then I learned why. Probably wont be back

I was really excited to see that they had stuffed artichokes. So I ordered takeout, and also tried to order rice balls, but they said they didn't have them. So that was disappointing. When I picked up my order, the guy was nice, but the place was so tiny, I'm glad I wasn't staying. When I opened my order at home, I was not expecting this kind of stuffed artichoke. There was way too much stuffing I couldn't even find the artichoke. I ended up eating what I could of the leaves with minimal stuffing, and ended up being left with enough stuffing for 15 more orders that I had to just throw out. Overall, I definitely won't be ordering stuffed artichokes from that place ever again.

Great vibe. But most if all GREAT Food. What I love most is that most of their items are pretty much spanish-american cuisine. I'm also in love with their grilled pizza choices! They have the classics like the magaerita and hilo (Hawaiian ) but they also have inventive choices like the new duck seared pizza which is out of this world! It seems like they update the menu with items, but to me thats pretty amazing considering everything I tried there is just delicious. Will eat here at least once a week.

Great Indian Food. All vegetarian.  We waited and waited for Bombay Talk. Finally gave up and tried Talk of the Town. Wow, what a pleasant surprise! All of our hesitation due to the place being empty vs Bombay Talk turned out to be misplaced.   Although small, this is a gem of a place. I am going to tell all my friends about it.
Best vegetarian food with real india's taste and best hospitality...should definitely check this place out and surely you will be delighted and want to visit again...
Wonderful place! Love it!

The food and service is always great. I had the Chicken sandwich and it was delicious and a large portion. The coffee is delicious. I've tasted most of the desserts and I can say that they're all worth trying. I would recommend this place to everyone.

This place is a casual restaurant for snacking while drinking. If you've been to Japan you will recognize it as authentic Japanese food (e.g., karaage chicken, menchikatsu croquette or gobou salad), but this is not your "typical" Japanese restaurant (e.g., when I went they didn't have sushi or teriyaki in the menu). The place itself is small, good for eating with a friend or a small group of friends. If you're planning on a larger group you probably want to call in advance and check (e.g., we were 8, more than that would have been complicated). In terms of quality I was quite impressed, really juicy hamburger steak, moist and tender fried chicken and a perfectly fried breaded combo platter, with a delicious melt-in-your-mouth sweet bean jelly for dessert.
A vegan cafe and cocktail lounge with a wonderful ambiance and super tasty dishes. The sunchoke soup, chick pea fries and the potato croquettes are simply fabulous!

Terrific food at a great price. My girlfriend and I come here as often as we can. The fresh rolls are amazing and the spring rolls are always cooked perfectly- we can't get enough of the sauce. It's hard to try new things at this restaurant because the chicken pad Thai is the best we've ever had. We crave The Terrace weekly and it never disappoints!
The Mediterranean sandwich is just lettuce and tomatoes with a sprinkle of feta on a doughy bread. Absolutely tasteless!

HIGHLY recommend! Actually this is my first comment on yelp, because I found I definitely should write one to recommend this place for everybody! The BEST lamb skewer I had so far!!! Also had hotpot with friends there today! The best thing to do in a cold day lol!!

We cannot complain about the food, appam, uthappam and their super duper mutton Biryani. the taste ... Yummy! however they NEED to improve their service. There is always a line and once you get seated be prepared to wait for 30-40 minutes for your first order to arrive.

A staple in Brooklyn pizza. They're famous for a reason. I cant lie, they have declined over the past years, but their food is still above average. Cant go wrong with a Philly style cheese steak & a spumoni. Good stuff, i look forward to eating here for another 20+ years.

This place was much better when I was little. A lot has changed. The only thing I like from here is breakfast and the breakfast sandwiches...Once in awhile my boyfriend and I will have take out and the food is always so bland and cold, and the take out containers are not sturdy..but the employees are always so sweet and everytime I ask for utensils and ketchup or syrup, they always give me extra

Jeff is super nice but it all goes down from there. Service is very poor and food the worst I've had in years. Then we saw the kitchen and they had food on the floor. The board of health would close them down if they inspected. Nice bar but terrible restaurant.

I would give the Coconut Soup (which comes in a bowl shaped and sized like a large vase) 6 stars if that was possible here.  Something about the balance of coconut broth, spice and some addictive fried onion bits is really irresistible.

Told everyone who'd listen for months how great this was after having the same great waiter 2 days in a row, first in the back where, in keeping with other commenters, the service can be awful, and then in the front Yesterday we took my niece and husband on an important double-date and was treated horribly by no less than 4 individuals there - a) waiter who chatted with me while we waited for other couple (he: "how are you?" me: "fine, what about you?" he: "not as good as you" - listen, I worked 90 hours each of the last 3 weeks so f__ off, OK?), b) gentleman manning reservations (me: "our guest couple will walk in here 1 minute from now for our 6pm reservation which is 2 minutes from now, what about the front room?"  he: "ask Jerry, so I'll cancel your reservation now?" - I'm not going to explain further how, frankly, malicious this "idea" was . . . ), c) drink-taker waiter on being asked for water after we ordered a beer and bottle of wine: "what for?" and no less than 2 more gratuitous hostile comments, and never did bring us the water, d) non-aligned waiter who brought us 2nd of requested doggie bags on being asked about the 1st that was "inadvertently" discarded, shrugged his shoulders, then 5 minutes later said "we don't want to rush you but we need the table" Besides the drinks mentioned, my nephew-in-law ordered 2 more beers, we paid for more than we can eat - what did we do to deserve this?  How do I get my chance for a passable experience with my guests back? Many of the staff are exemplary persons (not just as service people, that is), really great people - but they are mixed in with surly, openly hostile characters - if you don't get abused here, you'll swear it's just the best - I do agree on the bar being an outstanding place (room also has the advantage of a broad window) but we were a group of 4 - Okay, NOW I get it, go as a couple and sit at the bar, great, sit in the back at your peril

This is from an experience at this restaurant a few months ago. One of the worst delivery experiences I have ever had. Ordered 3 burritos and guac for delivery at 8pm on a weekend night. We were told 40 minutes when we ordered. I called back at 1 hour and 2 hours and was told the order was on the way both times. I live in 10 blocks away. The last time I called I was told to be more patient because someone else had waited for three hours before me. I told them I didn't want the food anymore because I wanted to go to bed. I was also cursed at by the person from the restaurant on the phone. It's a shame because they have great Mexican food, but haven't quite figured out efficient delivery service yet. Also inexcusable imo to curse at a customer no matter what.

I went here for the first time the other night after walking by this place numerous times. Well have I been missing something. First of all John the owner and bartender is sooo friendly and welcoming. It's a place that you just feel comfortable in. We hit happy hour here and when we went to pay the bill we utterly surprised that the drafts were only $2.50, even at reular price $5.00 is cheap. Then I actually went back a night later with other friends and ate there. Food is great, good pub food with an eclectic feel, and the bread to die for. This will be my new favorite place, and I will continue to bring more friends here.

My dinner at Blend started off on a bad foot... We had reservations and when my party arrived we got seated by the hostess who was very sweet and wished me a happy birthday. I was also greeted with a lovely personal birthday card from Blend which was cute. Once we sat down, our waitress came to our table and barely smiled. I asked her about the free sangria for the check in and she pretended like she didn't know what I was talking about. So I pulled out my phone to show her and she just said that's one per table ok?! So she did know what I was talking about because shebwouldnt know the details of the offer if this was brand new for her. Anyhow, she came to the table a couple of times but my party still didn't even know what we wanted. So many good choices and every time we would say we need more time she would roll her eyes and walk away, didn't even bother to say "Don't worry take your time" or even make suggestions for us. Additionally, I ordered the frozen sangria cause I heard great reviews about it. Unfortunately, I didn't like it and asked to switch it out for the white sangria which was so deliciously amazing. When I asked if I could switch out the drink she let out an annoyed sigh and just made a hand motion for me to give her the drink. That's when I took initiative to ask for a manager because I refuse to be treated like this especially on my birthday. The manager that came to speak to me was Matthew and he was so apologetic for the way my guests and I were treated. I explained that is was my first time here and I was disappointed in the service. He switched out our waitress with another one named Joanna and she was such a sweetheart. Always checked up on us, asked if we needed anything else. Our food came out, I ordered the lobster mac and cheese and the tostone nachos as my meal which were to die! My guests entrées also looked and smelled delicious! Our waitress ended up giving us shots on the house as a token for their apology. Later on they also surprised me with a complimentary dessert  with 3 different cakes and ice cream.  Thank you Matthew for making the effort and turning what started as a bad night, into a great one!

This is a throw back restaurant in an old Italian American neighborhood. This owner operator trattoria is a real jem in the heart of corona. Mario our host was outstanding. His recommendations of house made soppersata and pickled eggplant were excellent choice for an antipasto. Only the red pepper stuffed with risotto bolegenese was even better. For entree the veal a la grappa served with broccoli rabe was tender savory and slightly sweet with a hint of fresh table grapes. The pasta special was also outstanding. The pasta dough was cut with guitar strings to create a spaghetti not to be missed. It was topped with a variety of fresh mushrooms and finished with roasted tomatoes and shaved black truffles. The house made red wine was a perfect pairing for this old school Italian feast. Complimentary biscotti and a lemon chello on the rocks was a perfect ending to this authentic queens restaurant. I can't wait to return. Thanks Nicolette for showing us this fine dining destination in the heart of corona.

Sandwiches are always so filling! Boars head meat is the best and that's all that they use...I always get ham and cheese with the works and add hot peppers...ingredients are always so yummy and fresh!

This is the best restaurant I have ever been too! The food is simply amazing! so much flavor and spices! Chips and salsa are always fresh and warm...I always order the chili with onions sour cream and cheese...its not the spicy so I add some hot sauce that is on the table...the chili is so yummy full of flavor! I also get the blackened chicken fajitas! They are to die for! They come with lettuce tomato onions cheese and 4 tortillas, I ask for extra sour cream and that orange marmalade sauce and I'm in heaven! ...the decor is fun too and I love the music! No matter what time of the day there will always be a wait...longest I waited was 40 mins but it's so worth it!

great service!  salad was great, baby squid delicious, 2 of the 3 grilled sardines were wonderful, the recommended wine was fantastic and the shrimp perfectly cooked!  We'll be going back and also to their new location in Westbrook!
The Oyster shooters alone are worth five stars. Best sushi in Philadelphia.

Terrible customer experience. Walk up to the counter you place your order and logically go have a seat only to be kicked out of it because that's for dining guests only if you accidentally gotten online to order something to go.

Ok dining experience but this past delivery took over an hour and when they brought my food they forgot 3 of my drinks , when I called they were very rude and said that they put it in there and that I was wrong !! Bad customer service, they said they would bring it , another hour goes by and I call again and they said they would bring it soon. So they were never even going to bring it ! Ridiculous! Never order delivery here if you want it in time or your correct order .

My boyfriend and I wanted to try something new so when we passed by this cool, trendy Korean restaurant we thought: why not? We were not disappointed to say the least. We are both pescatarian and find it difficult at times to find food that is made with just as much flavor as those with meat in it. The sushi here is to DIE for. It was simply delicious. We also ordered the sauteed mushroom appetizer and I couldn't believe how well seasoned it was. It was full of flavor! The fries were hot and crisp and were served with ketchup and a sort of spicy kimchi mayo which I really enjoyed. We sat ourselves at the bar and the bartender was extremely accommodating and we were really happy with his suggestions with the food and drinks we were served. The staff were really friendly and inviting and they really make sure to check up on you to make sure you're being attended to. Bottom line: I will definitely be recommending this restaurant to friends and family and will probably be back the next time I go to the city.

Ambience? Check. Young, fashionable clientele? Check. Service? Decent. Food? Ehh... If this was the only restaurant left in the world, I would not starve. However, I found the food to be very heavily seasoned, masking the flavors of the ingredients. At similar price points for swanky tapas bars, there are better options out there (e.g. Alta).

The only reason I am giving this place one star is because the site does not allow a grade of zero.  I have been to many Famous Dave's, but the service here is the worst.  My wife and I came for lunch.  The place was fairly empty with only a few tables occupied.  We waited a while without any server coming to our table.  Another couple came in well after us and were seated at the next booth.  The server finally came to the area, and went directly to the other table and ignored us.  He then went to the back of the restaurant to place their order.  We waited for him to come back, even though he should have waited on us first because we were seated well before the other party.  Finally, we see him come with the drinks for the other table.  He served their drinks and walked away again without coming to us.  At this point, after being ignored for so long we left. Given the experience, we will never go back to this Famous Dave's location.  There is no excuse for this lack of service.  Also, I have to wonder ... if the manager cannot even have the servers accomplish the simple task of waiting on tables in the order they are seated, or waiting on tables at all, that gives me great pause as to how the rest of the restaurant is being managed.  There are enough good restaurants in the area to visit that will happily provide excellent food and service. We will be eating at those instead.

Their stock is terrible, always out of stuff! 1day:  they had no seafood bcus it all had gotten spoiled. 2nd time:  gave us catfish when menu said white fish 3rd time:  20mins waiting on food to be ready bcus only 2pp ws workin 4th time & last time:  they didnt have the beer batter chicken or chicken tenders & limited on shrimp so had to order something else. The fries sucked! Mac&cheese look like someone eat half of the cup.
The dude at the cash register on Friday nights looks like Pharrel.

I give the sandwiches a 5 star, but give the workers no stars...everytime I call there is this one guy who is always so rude and rushes you off the phone...he makes you feel like you are a bother to him and that your annoying...I work at a restaurant and I would never be rude to a customer in person or on the phone. I don't know his name but I wish I did so when I call I could ask to talk to someone else. A few times I have asked for hot peppers and they never put any on. The macaroni salad I think is the best thing they have there. I also like the subway club...turkey ham and cheese...they are stingy with the cheese...

I brought the family the other night. Not exactly the type of place I would expect to accomodate kids, but they did a hell of a job. They even made a meal not on the menu for my picky daughter, who eats nothing but pasta. The wait staff and chef were very friendly. The food was amazing. I had the Duck Jambalaya. I would definately order it again. Good beer selection. Overall, the place had a nice feel to it. Whether you are looking for a small comfortable bar, or a place to get amazing food, this is definately the place.

Love the decor in this place! Reminds me of an old library with the old books and furniture...the food here is amazing! I always get the French onion soup and juicy cheese burger on a pretzel bun! Very friendly staff too!

Walked in and no one bothered to greet us. The hostess was not friendly at all. The dining area was subpar to say the least. The food was ok but could have been better. Will not be retuning to this place.

Wow. I couldn't be happier that this place just opened up. I just moved here and was pretty sad at the lack of coffee shops in the area but now Manny's is open! There is not one thing about this place I don't like. Coffee is great, food selection is on point and the customer service is amazing. The people behind the counter are so welcoming  and happy. I am beyond ecstatic that this place is here. It's really a great spot, 100% recommended!

Pizza is pretty good..I think it's a little pricey...The staff is sometimes nice. The one man looks like he hates his job and doesn't want to be there. I like the fact that you dont have to walk into pathmark to get inside the pizza place...they have a door outside by the parking lot
Really inexpensive, good quality, nice atmosphere, very cool garden seating area, and hardworking staff!

This past Friday night the host had no problem seating all the cute girls ahead of me and my husband despite our names being higher on the list.  When asked about it the host said he called our name 3 times.  Hard to believe that we didn't hear him being that we were standing at the very front of this restaurant the whole time.  It takes us a lot to question let alone complain about the processes if a restaurant but this experience was so over the top horrible that I feel it my obligation to report....

Went to Giovanni's last week for a late lunch/dinner. The place is on the small side with a nice casual atmosphere. The first thing I noticed after being seated was the place seemed quite loud although there were not many customers. After looking around I quickly realized it was loud because the majority of the staff likes to hang out by the bar and loudly discuss their every life detail. This was a really big turn off, I just wanted to tell them to shut up and pay attention to the diners or go clean something. The next negative was the drunk guy that we were seated next to. How do I know he was drunk you ask? after receiving drink after drink he managed to get up and stumble squeezing through the tables as he dropped his full glass of Margarita right next to our table resulting in Margarita splashing all over my leg and on my shirt and on top of the table and on my girlfriend's purse, it even managed to get all over another patron of the restaurant. The truth is things happen and I was not upset with the guy, however I was upset that the event even took place and how the restaurant dealt with the situation. First off: before you decide to start cleaning the floor get me and the other guests that were affected a damp cloth immediately so we could clean ourselves off. Second: to the owner and bar staff you should really ask yourself if you'd like the place to be a restaurant where people go to have great food and a couple of drinks, or a place where a person can go to get drunk before 5 PM because the bar staff thinks it's acceptable to serve drink after drink after drink after drink. Are you a restaurant or a want to be bar hangout? Let's talk about the Food. Overall the food was very good. The one drawback is that it took forever to get. We really weren't sure what the holdup was to get out some pretty basic dishes and the fact that the restaurant wasn't even at half full capacity. As an appetizer we had the Calamari & zucchini fritti, Calamari was cooked perfectly and had a nice flavor. The zucchini was really soggy but it did have a nice flavor I think it was just fried at the wrong temperature which made it soggy. As entries we had the eggplant Parmesan which was very good and we also had the Tagliatelle di spinaci - Spinach tagliatelle with fresh rosemary chicken & mushrooms in a parmesan cream sauce, in all seriousness this was one of the best pasta dishes that I have had, the dish was executed perfectly. As for dessert we had the tiramisu which was very very good. After reading several reviews I saw that several people complained about portion size. The fact is that the portions are sized perfectly. The problem with society is that all too often we tend to overeat, I'm guilty of this myself. You must understand restaurant portion sizes are based on a three course meal. You're not supposed to be served a dinner that you don't finish and then doggy bag and eat for lunch and dinner the next day. That's being overserved, and something you typically find a lesser quality food. Overall nice casual atmosphere staff is way too loud and needs training there's a restaurant/bar identity crisis the food that we ate was very good priced fairly I will try them again
I could eat the strawberry ribs all dayyyy!

I had a negative experience.  Since the food is just average, I don't see me coming back. After an exchange of emails with Jeff (owner) in which he told me that he would tell the staff we were coming at 7, I arrived on time with friends.  A waiter told me that he knew nothing and we needed to wait half an hour. I told him about the email exchange and asked to speak with the manager.  He said there was no manager, and from what I could see there was no leadership in the place.   He made me find the email and show it to him, which I did. Then, he did nothing but waste my time with puerile arguments about why the email exchange was irrelevant. He gave another group a table before us. I sent another email to Jeff telling him of the problem and he wrote "please accept my apologies."  That was all.   I understand that mix-ups occur, but with so many tasty and fun restaurants in Brooklyn, why go here to get average food, small portions and clueless service?
The crepes here are always fresh and delicious and the portions always very generous.   Love the coffee and the Chai too.  Carolina is a great barista!

This place is alive! Hustling n bustling but yet accommodating with good service n fresh food cooked by yourself with your chosen soup to cook your chosen item n dip into your own scrumptious sauce. Mmmmmmm
Delicious!!!

Given the fantastic reviews, my girlfriend and I were shocked at how terrible both the service and the food was.   To start, my side of the table had sticky residue and chunks on it that they chose not to wash even after learning of it.  I had to cover it with a napkin so as not to get my clothes dirty.   Second, the service was really slow and the waiters were not as polite as most places that I have been to.   Finally, I love brunch and since I live in NYC I expect brunch to meet certain basic standards.  This one did not.  The eggs in the eggs benedict were overcooked, the salmon looked and tasted like it came out of a can, and the potato pancake just did not belong there at all.  The french toast was edible, but nothing special at all.  We did not try the tarts, but they did not look very appetizing. This is one of the only times that Yelp has gotten it completely wrong.  I would absolutely recommend going to one of the many other fabulous restaurants in NYC instead of this literal hole in the wall.

I've ordered the Krab Rangoon, which is one of their appetizers. Best thing that I ever tasted in my life. Their combination platter has a lot of taste. I kinda want to order more of their selections but I got too full. The staff are friendly too. If you're in the area, I recommend to check this place out.
Stopped in for a last minute bite based on the yelped reviews. The food was delicious.  Definitely a great decision and the gnocchi was fantastic.
delish

I enjoy breakfast here. The crab cakes are awesome. Rose Petals also has dinner on Thursday and Fridays. I always order the oxtail. The meat is tender and the flavor is out of this world. The best I have ever had.

Ordered fried calamari (extra crispy) and clams in white sauce for pickup was told 30 min. went to pick it up and waited another 30 min.the place was busy but no reason to wait so long. Got the food home the calamari was chewy not crispy, and the clams in white sauce was dry (no sauce) and 8 of the clams were not open something the cook should have noticed. I have had food from Gencarellis in the past which was good but this was not quality food.

Eh, I wanted to love this place.  Major disappointment. Things started well:  It was my pick for a special date. We had a reservation, and were seated on time at a romantic, great table for 2 at the back of the restaurant.  Love the warm vibe of the open kitchen and wood tables. Great lighting.   Looked at the menu, and was drawn immediately to several things on the menu.   Food:  I ordered a fig salad.  Waitress tells us after the fact, oh, sorry we are out of figs, we are substituting something else. I ordered duck.  Waitress returns to the table after we place the order and says halfhearted oh, sorry we just sold the last duck.  When your menu has about 5 entrees on it, wouldn't you make sure not to run out of your signature at prime time on a Friday!? The apps we got were fine, small portions not particularly interesting flavors.  The steak was excellent, but kitchen didn't honor medium rare request.  Fluke was fine. Service:  Waitress wasn't very attentive (see issues above) except to rush us to order or get more drinks. Slow to bring wine.  Not welcoming, basic too cool attitude. Evening then took a terrible turn when they squeezed a table for six in next to us - carrying a 2 top over my husbands head.  Their party included several drunk mid twenties girls who proceeded to yell/raise the decibel level in the restaurant by multiples.  It was so bad the date at the table on the other side of us chose to finish their bottle of wine at the bar rather than stay at the table. Bottom line:  go elsewhere.  Other options with better food and service in the west village.

We were there on a Saturday evening. We had a reservation for 7 pm and we were seated at 6:55 in their upstairs room. The service was prompt. The waitress was a warm and attentive person. We ordered lots of cold mezes, all of which were delicious. Especially humus, cacik, and eggplant salad were heavenly. They came with warm Turkish bread which is always a big plus. Then we had tandir kebap which is very difficult to make right (I'm Turkish, I've had many bad experiences with it), but this was just perfect. We also had kofte kebap and grilled chicken and they were also pretty good. I don't think we needed a main course per person since the sizes of the appetizers were huge. But everything was so delicious that we even wanted to try their deserts and I would say we didn't regret. We payed $120 for 5 mezes, 3 main courses, lots of drinks and desert and I think it was reasonable for the location and amount of food. I will definitely go back next time I'm in NYC.

I wish I can give them 10 stars! This is the best chinese food I have ever had! I don't go anywhere else! So convenient because this place is 3 mins down the road from me. I always get amazing food and great service! If I need a delivery, they are always here within 20 mins. My favorite is the boneless spare rib combo..I tell them to make my ribs well done and it's so yummy! I might order some for lunch now! Haha

As I waiting for my food for the past 30 mins,  let see if I get my food before I finish writing this.  The place only 1/3 full when I walked in. The chef is walking around collecting dishes, what the hell is going on???? Finally our food came, decent food minus my husbands coffee.  Clearly they didn't steam the milk long enough, my cappuccino is not hot at all.  Good food is not everything, service is just as important.    Now we see how long it takes to get our bill.......
The place was very clean and had a great Greek vibe to it. The food and service was excellent. My wife and will be coming back again soon ...

I should first state that Stephen Starr is my personal god. That said, El Vez is just as good, if not better, than anything else he has done in our fair city. Been here 6 or 7 times and it is always great. What ever you eat will be fabulous, but you can super-size the experience by ordering the "blood-orange frozen margarita." Caution: you might only want to get just one...

We went to Jesse's this past week as we have always had great food and service.  One of the dishes we ordered was not the usual delicious and when we told, Audra, our waitress,  She happily ordered another entrée to replace it.  Her service was friendly, attentive, exceptional!  Thank you Audra for a fabulous dining experience!
Los Angeles type Mexican spot. Great tacos, solid margaritas, and an authentic ambiance.

Had a party of 20 for lunch today. From the first phone calls and email communications, we were feeling confident that we picked a great place.  Everyone was so responsive and helpful and accommodating. When we arrived the tables were set beautifully,  with all of the red wine we dropped off earlier on display across the tables and our white wines chilling. The service was friendly and excellent.  Wine glasses and water glasses were always being refilled and warm bread baskets never went empty. We had chosen a lunch party package and every person raved about the selection of entrees.  The package included appetizers served family style, an entree, and dessert.   Everything was delicious. This was our first time visiting La Mezzaluna, but it definitely wont be out last.

I was very excited to visit this place, but it was just one unfortunate instance after another! The food took a very long time to come out even though there were only two other people in the place (that's fine, we weren't in a rush) but we waited without water or a chance to order some coffee. When we did get our food my order was completely wrong (it happens) but we weren't able to find our waitress to tell her! My husband's crepe also came out cold : / and there wasn't enough room on the table for our coffees and our food so all three of us had to keep our coffees on another table and reach over when we were thirsty. At that point we just had to laugh at the whole situation- we gave up and went down the street to the Petite Parisian place where we know the crepes are hot the and the wait staff is attentive. Maybe we'll come back to try the gelato to-go some time...

Delicious stuffed artichoke! Both my sister and I really enjoyed them. I haven't had one like that in years and was happy to find a place that made them so well. I also had the chicken franchese which was good. It came with two pieces of chicken and I chose to get pasta with it instead of a salad. Kinda wished the pasta had the same sauce instead of the red sauce, but only because I'm picky like that. We then shared the tartufo, which was great as well. Came with 5 pieces, we ended up eating two each. I also ordered a cappuccino, the glass was a little messy so I had to wipe my hands off, but it was good. Overall, I definitely will be going back to try more.

Today was the second time that I have eaten here. The first time was great , the food was great & our waiter was very kind. I love bbq and I was so happy with our first visit , so I decided to come back today. Our service was horrible. We have ordered the course and some extra meats and other extra orders to add to our course. The appetizers came in and everything was great . Then our food came out & everything was great. But then we realized that only about 1/3 of our order came out. I usually am a very understanding person and usually will wait because yes, the place was very busy, so I do understand that maybe my food is taking so long because they are very busy. I told the waiter that my order didn't come out yet. He told me that there are still coming out. So I waited for about another 15 minutes & it still didn't come out yet. So I talked to the waiter again & told him. He finally got out our order but it was only one of the other 4 orders that we still didn't get. I thought okay maybe it is really busy that is why it is taking so long, so I waited again. For another 10-15 minutes, the food never came. So I asked the waiter again, he told us that we got all of our order already, but we didn't. So he went to go check with the kitchen to what is going on. He came back and told us that the orders came out already, it was two orders in one plate. But I was a hundred percent sure that it was only one order. One, that i went here already before & i know that two order is not that tiny. Two, it is very obvious that two order is not 5 pieces of meat. We told him, he talked to us like he did not  believes us. He left and came back again, asking us what the orders are that are missing. We told him, about 10 minutes later, then it came. He didn't apologize or anything, he felt like it's not his fault. I was very upset and told him that I am very very dissapointed in the service because who likes eating and then waiting like 30 minutes because they think that all of our food came out already? He finally said " my apologies " and then he end up blaming it on the kitchen. We finished our food and then got our desserts. I was also upset because of how poorly he took care of our table. Usually they would changed the grilling plate about 2-4 times, he didn't at all. He didn't came to see if we needed anything or see if we needed water refills. I know he could do a lot better than that. After all of that, the general manager came and asked us what happened. I explained to her and she said she was very sorry. She was really nice to us & understand us. She made our experience there a little better. I don't know if I am going to come back, but if i am , I hope my service will not be as bad as the one I had tonight because I do love the food here.
Awesome Peruvian food!!! Highly recommend it one little downfall pets should not be allowed in restaurants

My family and I have been going here for years...located close to the house and very convenient.. Great pizza...fresh ingredients and friendly staff. The inside is still very old looking. They could use a make over. I always pick up my food and it's always got and ready when I get there. And if you dress up on Halloween and decided to get pizza they will give u a free slice for wearing a costume
such a great place!
A bit expensive for the portion sizes but it was delicious! The ambiance is pretty romantic too, good date night.

I am not usually a fan of breakfast but I am going to tell you that I was absolutely THRILLED with my breakfast this morning.  I did a blue plate with corn beef hash and hashbrowns.. WHOA!  The absolute best hash I have EVER had.  I could eat this every single day! The corn beef is fresh made.. nothing out of a can, that is for sure... the hashbrowns were so good... rainbow potatoes and perfectly fried - yumm! Our server Jay was very attentive and personable!  The restaurant has a warm,  eclectic environment with an appreciation and support for local artists. I am so happy to have a restaurant like Spicy Green Bean in Glastonbury.  Love this place!  So much on the menu - and you know its all quality products.

This is a very cozy Italian restaurant. If you are Italian and like Italian food, you will feel very comfortable here.a lot of things are imported from Italy. The food is very good and has very nice presentation. I gave it only four stars because the skirt steak was not good at all it was very tough we asked the waiter where the steak was from, he said not from America.our country has the best beef. I'm not going to get into why, but my father is a butcher and I can say that the US does have the best beef   you can definitely tell it wasn't American raised cow. My dish was excellent it was a homemade pasta with pancetta and Pomodoro sauce , it was a little salty but it was enjoyable. the desserts were to die for. the best thing I need to say is our waiter his name was Adam a young nice b Young man, he reminded me a little bit of Adam Sandler. He had perfect presentation, consideration, always was looking to make sure we were satisfied. One of the best waiters I have ever had, in many years of dining. Definitely check it out, if your meat lover don't order meat. Other than that you will love the place. I also want to add that it is a BYOB but you can order your wine and the store down the street will personally deliver it to you.that's awesome!
The wings are amazing, and they have a wide beer selection. Bar staff is great. The dinner selections are good, but not awesome.

Awesome food! Great service. Had an issue tonight with my delivery, my boyfriend called to talk about what happened and things were taken care of, no questions asked. We love this neighborhood and we were super happy to find this place a few weeks ago. I recommend the Cubano, fried brussel sprouts and the tomato soup!
The sushi here is great! It's always fresh and yummy. I've never eaten in, but I get take-out frequently, and just love their sushi!
Terrible food, service at the door was okay but service at the table was horrible. Stay away.

I thought the food here was good.... I got the salmon, poached eggs on the potato pancakes with the yogurt dill sauce. I have a friend who works at the joint and told me about. She told me to come around 2pm so I would not have to wait in line a super long time. It 25mins to get a seat and that is the slow time. When we were sat our server did not come greet us for 15 minutes to take our order or say hello. She was so slammed and clearly had to big of a section to cover. The entire meal she only took our order and then came to drop off the check. 2nd problem... I had LONG GROSS HAIR in the food. I was only half way done with my meal when I found it. Since there was no service I had to get the attention of the hostess who sat us to let my server know...  She NEVER came over to apologize. A random guy who (never introduced his self), but served us our drinks came over and took my plate and asked me if I wanted a replacement meal. I lost my appetite and was over the service and the mood so I said I didn't want a replacement. When our waitress gave us the bill she again didn't acknowledge or say sorry about the hair in the food and just gave us our bill. (i don't even think someone told her about it) But when we got the bill they took off my $14 entree and $6 bloody Mary. Over all, food was good. Service could be good, but they need to give there servers smaller sections so they have a chance to do there job and be prepared to wait outside in the cold to get seated.

PLUS: Many of the tapas we tried were excellent. The deserts were outstanding as well. -Spicy Sausage/pepper tapa, braised artichokes, and capaocolla were superb, mezzelune were amazing according to my vegetarian wife -couscous chocolate pudding was a major delight, MINUS: 2 Cold entrees, presentation of pasta dish (linguine with mussels-type dish) was quite lacking. Just kind of thrown on the plate with no garnish or design. BIGGEST MINUS: While knowledgable, the waiter was incredibly pushy. There is a difference between suggesting options to your diners based on your knowledge vs sounding like a car salesman. We were asked 3+ to add additional dishes even though we were very clear that we were done with our tapas and main courses. 3 times. Before, during, and after our dessert we were offered espresso. Do we really need to say "no" 3 times to be clear? This was the low-point of the experience at Brigantessa. SUGGESTION: It would be nice to offer the Primi with size options, since there are only 3 Secondi on the current menu. OVERALL: Minus the pushy waiter and some kitchen issues they are probably already working on improving since they just opened, a solid addition to our neighborhood.  We didn't try the pizza tonight, but the adjacent table seemed to be enjoying theirs. I would likely return. but I will also remember to bring additional cash-2 couple dining came to just under $300 after gratuity with just a few drinks.

We arrived, a party of 6, for some quick burgers before a 'paintnite ' event. We ordered with the understanding that we had to be at the event in 30min or so. With five min to start time... The first hamburger arrived via the owners hands. Each meal then arrived approx every 2 min after the previous meal! One at a time! Who does that? 3 items were either cold or room temperature! My burger was hot and well cooked! This is why I gave the only two stars or it would have been a '0'! I do not recommend this venue. There is more to this story, including denial from the owner at every complaint our group had about the food and service. Denial is not becoming of customer service! Be warned!

Nothing to look at. Ordered the ceviche, the empanadas the melted cheese and the tostada from the brunch menu. Service was slow and food really mediocre, just not cutting it. The place had a lot of flies inside, they charged me a michelada twice because "they charge the sauce and the beer independently". Ended up paying 120 bucks for a really unsatisfying brunch. In the future i'll avoid this place like the plague.
Nice selection of beers and a simple menu with solid burger choices. Lots of fun, busy, and sitting at the bar is the way to go.

Came to this place on accident and it was definitely the best accident that could have happened on my trip to Burlington. The food is to die for I nearly collapsed on the table in joy after I took my first bite of the Croque Madame. I also highly recommend the tater tots.
The service was great. The food was excellent. But the dishes were a little bit small. The desserts were nice, not recommended. The prices are very high. Overall it is a nice restaurant.

I had an uninspired, overlcooked, dry pork shank smothered in ketchupy barbeque sauce. The Caesar salad was mediocre at best and my friend felt the same about the fried chicken.The place was extremely noisy and the waiter  was in a perpetual rush.

Hell yeah! Great intimate rustic ambiance. Delicious food. I don't really have any complaints. My waitress could have been a tad more attentive, but it's all good. This is a great spot if you're not necessarily looking to be seen but want a neighborhood favorite. Very comfortable setting. I enjoyed the roasted chicken and sage shrimp. I'd definitely come back.

It's going to be really hard to write this review, the rating is not because of the food or drinks, those were really good. But I do appreciate when a good manager keeps the staff in checked. When we got there we were told that the pitcher of sangria was $10 in happy hour. We order 2 pitchers before 7pm, among several plates. When it was time to pay the bill, our surprise was seeing the pitchers at full price. And when I asked about it the waiter tells me that the one at that price is the half pitcher. At this point all I wanted to do is talk to the manager, and the waiter in a very rude manner approached us, and claiming that it was a misunderstanding and miscommunication grabbed the bill (which was handwritten) and tore it right there in front of us. As I see things, if it was a mistake (totally posible) I would have fix the pitcher value as a way to say sorry and let the customer pay the bill. At this point with no bill I couldn't pay it, couldn't talk to the manager and no tip for the waiter of course after that behavior. It seems very dubious to me and my friends that this guys destroyed the bill without trying to come up with another solution and talk about it. I consider myself a very understanding costumer but I don't answer good to rudeness and when I feel some type of dishonesty is happening I can't let it go. Hopefully this was a one person thing and I had bad luck.

We recently enjoyed dinner on a Friday evening at Cedar Point's outdoor patio. Cedar Point  was crowded but the hostess handled the seating well. We didn't have to wait too long.   The waiter was also attentive and our food came quickly. As an appetizer, we shared tender chicken wings which were spicy but not too hot, and which came with grilled Brussel sprouts, a  great contrast.  My husband had fish and chips- the batter wasn't greasy and the fish was moist and really tasty; as good as any we enjoyed in Ireland and England. And  the potato  fries combined with sweet potato fries were a yummy compliment. I ordered the kale burger- it was good but it could have used more spice for my palate. So I borrowed the sauces that came with the fish and chips. Definitely recommend Cedar Point for good food, good atmosphere, good experience at great prices.

Everytime someone would mention "Park Tavern" i would jump up in joy & say lets go! ..... Not so much anymore Just a few months back i decided to bring my boyfriend to the Park Tavern, being the pizza lover that he is.. what can go wrong????? ALOT Being turkish muslims, we dont eat pork, anywhere we go before we order.. We kindly ask our waitress to correct us if we accidently order anything containing pork & to please tell the cook we dont eat pork as well. Everythings fine, she smiled agrees says thats perfectly fine and shed let the cook know. So we put our order in. A tossed salad with mozz, mussels, and a small pie. 2 minutes laaaaaater... We get our salad... Everythings fine. I put some salad on my plate, go to serve my boyfriend some salad.. And BAM!  A piece of salami or ham or whatever it was idk, but i know it was pork. So i call my waitress order and show her the piece of pork.. In our salad.. She apologizes and takes the salad back. Asking if we wanted another. We kindly said no.... We get our mussels eat our pizza.. Ask for the check. And see the salad is still on there.. *FULL PRICE* i call her over and tell her there must have been a mistake, she takes a look at it.. And says "no, i dont see any" Excuse me ?! Apparently the salad was halfway gone. Clearly she didnt give a crap to look on our plates to see all the salad we didnt eat. Anyway. I ask to speak to her manager. The response we get was "sorry our manager went home"  ok.. So i ask to speak to the person in charger. Another waitress comes over, i explain my situation and she says to call back tmrw and speak with a manager because she has no privileges to take food off of the bill. Excuse me but what if i found a roach in my food ?! Your gonna make someone PAY?! so i called back everyday for three days asking to speak to a manager and each day i got a different excuse saying the manager was "out" or "in a meeting" Ive worked in a restaurant since i was the age of 12 and never have i ever seen management this bad. Clearly they need the 9$ more than i do.. And thats a bad sign. Gave 2 stars cause the pizza is actually really good. To bad i wont be enjoying it anymore.
Love this place. Great pasta , burgers , sandwiches and cheesesteaks

My wife and I saw a review shortly after The Gorbals opened. Bacon wrapped matzoh balls?! Whole pig's head!! We made the pilgrimage to Brooklyn. It was too cold to stay on the rooftop bar, looking forward to next time. The environment in the restaurant was inviting and comfortable. Our server, Dominic, was incredible, which turned out to be important since the menu was "unique". (Which was the reason we came) The drink menu needed to be explained/explored, everything sounded so good. The four of us all tried something different (x2). Great start to the evening. We then basically wanted everything on the menu (way too much but we couldn't decide). Dom helped us pare down our choices a little then offered smaller portions of a couple items. So we ended up with "nearly" everything instead. The bacon wrapped matzoh was excellent, as were the Shiite peppers. We all agreed that the flash fried broccoli was the best broccoli that we have ever had. We passed on the pig's head and had the braised lamb neck - just the sweetest meat that melted in your mouth. I usually pass on beef tongue, but I had to try it after everyone else rolled their eyes back after one bite, it was incredible. I won't try to be the foodie, describing and commenting on all the nuance of each dish. I will sum it up as a great meal! Fortunately, there were only four desserts to choose from, we ordered one each and passed them around. I can't imagine eating here frequently (we live in Ohio), but we will be returning next visit to NYC. Looking forward to a menu of new delights.
Most comments below focus on the food (which is amazing), however I wanted to point out that the drinks are amazing as well. Keeps me coming back! Our Thursday night spot!
I got some fried chicken with a side of mac & cheese and collard greens  DELICIOUS!  Would go here all the time if I lived closer!

This place is great. It is small and cozy and perfect for a quick stop in before class, if you are a Temple Student. Although I am a student, it is nice to see non-students in here as well. There seems to be a nice mix, which I appreciate. Sometimes I get anxious when there are too many students in a small area like that. I always get the homefries with green peppers and onions.

Amazing!    I think I've tried just about everything on the menu I go so often.  Yesterday I had the steak & eggs (poached to perfection) with a kale salad and it was delicious!  The food & service keep me coming back every week.  The people there are super friendly & know a lot of their customers by first name. It's in a great location a block from Lafayette stop off the C train. The menu is diverse & has great options for people who have dietary restrictions...the gluten free pastries are the bomb!
Had the Roast Beef on baguette. The baguette was a little too hard but still delicious. Also had a cup of Yucatan Chicken soup which was out of this world.

Best Japanese restaurant in Bayonne. It's located at the very north east corner of the cross shopping center, next to the Staple and Stop & Shop. We always go there for a lunch / dinner after our weekly grocery shopping at Stop & Shop. During holidays, The waiting time can be long if you didn't make reservation ahead. We once waited 2 hour on the night of Feb 14, 2014. The food is fresh & tasty.  The Sushi meets the quality of much pricier Sushi restaurants in the city. The hibachi is impressive and amazing due to skill of the hibachi chef. Love the head bands the hibachi chef wears that printed with Kamikaze ("神風").
Took the ferry over and found this spot.  So happy we did!  Roseanne is an amazing bartender and made a few West Coast folks feel right at home!  Good drinks, good music & good folks!

Went once in the summer for the lunch buffet (around $10? Don't remember) with a group from work. Loved the food. Craving to go back again! All of the main dishes were very tasty. I wish I could've had more if there was more time before going back to the office and more space in my stomach. Great price and great tasting food. Would go for the food. Not for you if you're looking for anything else fancy. But the food is so good. At least for the one time I've been there so far.

Recently had my wedding there all our guest had a great time and so did the groom and i... Steve Goodman helped us and he was great he made everything so easy on us and the matridee Steve was aawesome too he made sure the whole night that my groom and i were ok and if we needed anything and knew all the plans and made everything go so smooth

Although the food is good when i place on order for deilvery it is downhill.  The staff that picks up the phone is sometimes rude and ALWAYS forget the green sauce.  I mention it for years- DONT FORGET THE EXTRA GREEN SAUCE and i think they do it intentionally like I am on a realty show....I have alot better things to do than to write a review but Its not acceptabel to treat your neighboors this way.  Get the order right or it will def. catch up to you at some point.  Also when I request a middle piece of salmon dont say NO....Get your customer service together..
Great food, Great Price, Good Service. They open at 630 had my food ready in 10 mins.

Great little store with a deli inside that serves up a mean burger. Get the burger of the week and it comes with any bag of chips that cost 99cents, which in this case was a big 3.5 oz bag of Utz! Really good deal, definitely worth the 2 minute walk through the parking garage from the airport to avoid the outrageous airport prices.

Amazing authentic mexican food. I've been to Taqueria once in downtown jersey city, and shortly  after visited El Aguila Dorada, because one of my friends was complaining how overpriced the food was and how the quality of food wasn't as good as El Aguila's food. Turns out, my friend was absolutely right. Taqueria gives you about 3 tacos for 9 bucks, but El Aguila gives you something like 5 for the same price.  Also the quality of the salsa is much more thicker and richer instead of something watered down like Taqueria. The service and waiters were nice and the pricing isn't bad at all. It has a nice homely environment so if you want to have a quiet dinner with a date this is your spot! If you live in or around the Bayonne area definitely check out El Aguila, you won't be disappointed!

We happened in on a Friday night after the ballet. We were happy to get the one open table. It was a true c.c. restaurant with people from every background dinning all mixed together. I tried many things I had never had & loved it all!! I am quite a wine snob but I don't know much about Spanish wines. I got a taste of 2 and loved them both!! This is very rare in Philly. We had a ball, no complaints.
Food not that great went there several time all time food takes forever and is always cold...
this place is on and off for me. some days it's great, some it's okay. but i still come here since it's open 24/7! convenient for those late hungry nights in the city

Went for lunch with a friend, shared hummus, appetizers, kebab.  Atmosphere very nice, sat in side room on cushions, good decor.  Service OK.  Food.....not so much.  Hummus had little taste, as did kebabs.  I ordered the beet salad, which was supposed to be a house specialty -- and was soooo disappointed.  I think they used canned beets and frozen potatoes.  Large portion of awful bland veggie mush.  Not going back there.
Yes! Buttery and creamy!  Artichoke pizza slice at its finest. Nothing fancy, just an excellent slice on the go for fans of artichoke, which i am!

Disrespected & Disappointed FOOD:                   Very Good ATMOSPHERE:   Loud / Noisy DECOR:                Stylish & Cool SERVICE:              Disappointing & Disrespectful I went with my family (Mother, Aunt & Uncle - who are older).  I'm in my 40's.  I think that Mayfield may be catering to a younger crowd because the treatment of me and my family was disrespectful and left a bad taste in our mouths.  The hostess sat us at a table for 6 but only after objecting to sitting at a hightop table in the back, which would have been uncomfortable for my family who are in their 80's.  The insensitivity was obvious and after objecting to the table suggestion, the hostess sat us down at the table and said she would have to move us if a larger party arrived (who does that?)  Once you're seated... you're seated!   I did not make a fuss but did step away so that I could talk to her privately, and told her that my family were older and that we would not be moving. She made a smart comment... which I heard but ignored. I was trying to enjoy myself! The food was very good.  The restaurant is stylish and cool.  It was a little loud but that's just NYC!   My poor rating is really because of the service!  My Aunt & Uncle have gone to the restaurant 5+ times.  It was a place that they highly recommended and that they were excited to introduce to me. They were disappointed in the service from not only the hostess but also the waitress... If you decide to go, I hope you have better service and if the restaurant management takes notice of this review.  I hope they will make their staff aware that going out is suppose to be enjoyable and disappointed!

Came here for dinner. Had the stuffed tomato, it was mediocre. The flavor wasn't dynamic at all. Ordered the midnight flyer cocktail, I couldn't even drink it. I never send drinks back but this one went right back where it came from. Ordered the Brooklyn cue..much better. Slow service. Actually, no service. I get that it is Monday night but how unimpressive. My water glass sat empty for my entire meal and my server was awol until presenting me with my bill. There are thousands of amazing restaurants in this city. This unfortunately isn't one of them.
Great Service ! It was super quiet on a Friday night . Food was great great great . Love Cracker Barrel !!

I had dinner here a few weeks ago at the bar. i have to say that I had an amazing time. The bartender Tom, was so cool and funny. He made the experience a lot of fun. The food was delicious too say the least. I cant wait to go back. If I had one complaint it would be the other bartender, I think her name was Kelly, or Kelsey? Very strange girl and seemed flustered the whole time. But over all, LOVED!!!

Consistently delicious. Even on delivery. Everything I've tried has been way worth every penny. Even a simple side of kale is done just right. I love when a restaurant puts just as much care on the sides as they do their mains. Thanks for a great dinner Bogota!

The food is delicious as i heard and the menu is very unique. Everything is made fresh with quality ingredients. Its perfect place for breakfast or lunch for great price.   I had to try Memo burger, Its AMAZING!!!! Its perfect amount of house ground beef patty w caramelized onion, fontina cheese on brioche roll...And the fresh cut fries are very delicious as well.. The coffee is Excellent and they make it  the way you like..It look like they fresh ground beans too.. The service is great with very friendly staffs, The  space is small but its very cozy and cute. I will definitely be back to try everything on the menu!! I Love the place and the food .

I can get past this place being overpriced because its local and the staff is super friendly. On the rare occasion that I do take-out, I cannot stand by the juice bar and endure the manager? being overly aggressive and loudly scolding the workers. Not only should she have some tact in front of the customers, more importantly, she should have a less hostile approach when speaking to her staff.  If this woman is the manager, she needs to be fired, if she's an owner, I don't want to spend another dollar here.
Okay place! Wine is okay and food is expected if a chain! Atmosphere more of a sports bar then italian. Okay for a fun night out with no expectations of great italian!

Went here in April 2014  -- great food -- a surprise given the strip-mall location!  Excellent hummus, baba ganoush.  If you order the "dinner," it's a lot of food.  We had kebabs/ gyros combo. Very good food for the price, atmosphere is family-friendly.  Ignore the fact that its a strip mall...this place makes good food in a nice clean friendly place.  total happiness.

There are many good things about this place, but equally as many turn offs. Although the place sounds like a small local breakfast place, the interior makes you feel as if you are in a small crowded food court. The lunch items looked pretty good ( I myself did not try any) however the breakfast was OK...nothing more. If you are looking for a good local breakfast place with tasty food that will keep you coming back, I suggest you keep looking, nothing outstandingly good here.
My new favorite spot in town.

Today was my second visit within a month.   The chicken takes 30 mins to make but is worth the wait as it comes out in a generous portion, warm and succulent.  The atmosphere takes me away to Greece.  Last but not least the service is on point; the entire staff makes you feel welcome and gracious for your business.

What a TOTAL RIP OFF this place is!!!  Went here for brunch and OMG what a poor excuse for a restaurant that says they serve brunch it was. Total Disaster!!  First off, it took several minutes before anyone came to our table to ask my brother and I if we wanted anything to drink.  (Mind you, the place was EMPTY!!  with the exception of a couple having coffee at a table on the other side of the restaurant). Finally the waiter comes over and asks if he could take our drink order. When we tell him what we want, he says he's sorry but he can't give us that because it's not on the brunch menu!  WTF?!!? Are you kidding me??  After giving our opinion about how ridiculous we thought that was, he says he'll go and ask the bartender if we can get what we want. Hello???  We're customers willing to spend money in your poor excuse of an establishment-give us what we want. He then comes back and says the bartender will accommodate us. (Why thank you sir mixologist!!). NOW THE NASTY FOOD... I went with the steak and eggs, my brother with some shrimp panini thing. Let me tell you- not only horrible tasting, but 3 tiny pieces of steak (tips) with two eggs over easy for $20 plus -RIDICULOUS!!!
