Love it! place has been a staple on the island for years with great pizza

We love LIC Market and are so thankful that it's in the Court Square area.  They have a cozy and charming space, outstanding service that is friendly and knowledgeable, and the meals are always delicious and inspired.   For dinner, we found the portions to be a little small for us -- so we ended up splitting a few additional dishes amongst the table.  But for brunch the portions seemed larger and more filling which was nice. Whenever we have guests in Long Island City we always send them to LIC Market because you just can't go wrong there.  I may even go as far to say it's the best restaurant in Long Island City...
I had the lam'bretta and it was amazing! Very good service too. totally recommended!

Quick delivery. That's the only positive I have for this place. Ordered udon noodles with beef. The noodles were extra rubbery feeling and just tasted over cooked. I'm by no means a Japanese cuisine expert but I can definitely advise to stay away from that part of the menu. Then again this is really a Chinese restaurant so maybe I ordered wrong? However my wife's Chinese seafood dish was equally as bad. The steamed dumplings were extremely bland. The spring rolls were good and the chicken corn soup was also bland.

So where do I start.....this place was so laid back. My boyfriend and I went after a friend recommended it....we got to sit in their backyard which was so peaceful. It was the perfect start to our date night. We had several happy hour specials which were awesome. The sever was good she was the only waitress for the back area and did a good job on checking on everyone. The food is AMAZING!! Their huge on organic local foods including their ketchup!! I have recommended this place to other couples price is great too!!!

For the amount of food you get for the amount you pay...this place is a bargain. Would definitely come here again. FYI - the place is cash only so be sure to bring cash. However, there is an ATM near the entrance that charges an arm and leg in fees.
so good i went twice in one day.  then took four more home the next day.
Great place for local take out or pick up. Probably would not dine in as it's an older  dated room. Driver is very friendly and fast! Have been happy with the quality of the pizzas.

THE BEST empanadas in NY! Even though the location is a bit random, i drive out here just for the food. Its really good quality and unbelievably affordable. They also have a variety of options. Love this place!

Had a birthday party for my sister there and had a blast. The staff is extremely accommodating, the food is super yummy and the drinks are the best. I would go back with a party of two so there's no confusion with the bill. ;-)

Great Set up with many different bars and rooms. Located in one of my favorite parts of philly, if not my favorite. I have had more than one occassion though where the service has been terrible, every other time it is average.
I love this place. Would eat there every night if I was closer. I always get a filet or tuna on a hot rock. Best deal around and high quality fish and meat. A must go!!
I thought after waiting over 30 minutes for my food, it would taste magical...yeah..not so much. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't amazing. It was average and definitely not worth the wait.
Probably the best burger I've ever had. Get the Truffle oil burger you won't regret it!
Food is not that great , service isn't too great either seems like they rush you out when they have people waiting. Had better Peruvian food
Favorite spot in NY.
My favorite Meal of the day is always breakfast and they always satisfy my needs (pause).... One of these day's I will attend pancake month!

Not many places serve poutine in the states. Caseus does! Very authentic too. I usually always order this. I also love that they make a butter of the day. I once experienced a butter with honey and cashews that was to die for on their warm fresh bread. The steak and frites was also very good.

What can i say? This place is one of the best places in bay ridge hands down and I have lived here all my life. The beer selection is amazing, the food is great. My personal favorite is the Johnny Cash hotdog. In the winter and summer this place is packed on the weekends and it should be. I live around the corner from Lockyard and I am a frequent patron. I hope this stays around for a LONG time!

This place used to be cool back in 2006, but now it has lost its classy appeal. During a snow storm, they wouldn't serve me any drink made with liquor,only wine, because they told me I had been drinking since 4, when in reality, I had one drink at 4, left for five hours and came back when I realized there would be no work the next day. Unprofessional bar tenders told me he wasn't serving me "because he can." Impressive. Everyone had tattoos now and this place usually involves 40 some year olds falling off bar stools. Not the best scene if you are looking for some class. Also, the food sucks now and the cheese plate is one step above Cracker Barrel! Go elsewhere!

What a drag.  Out of all of the wonderful Philadelphia restaurants, I chose to have my birthday dinner here and it was not a stellar showing.   We made reservations over a week in advance for 8pm and arrived right on time.  The hostess indicated that they were running about 10 min. behind and welcomed us to sit at the bar. The decor of this restaurant was sort of dated/worn and the bartenders seemed full of inside jokes. After a half hour, my husband inquired about when we would be seated.  The manager came over to us and offered to purchase "bar snacks".  My husband asked him to pick up the bar tab instead--which he did. When we finally were seated an hour after our reservations, they put us in this ancillary seating in the basement with absolutely no warmth or atmosphere!  The cushions on the bench seating were floppy and kept sliding down to the floor. The manager brought us cava on the house, which was a nice gesture, but it's really not a wine that we'd usually enjoy. Sure the food might have been presented well and had lovely complex flavors, but our initial impression was so clouded, that we barely noticed. For the reputation that this restaurant has and for the prices that you are paying, we really expected to be wowed and were not.

Best place for lunch in State House Square! As a vegetarian, this place has TONS of options to choose from.  I especially love the California Wrap (hummus, avocado, seeds, sprouts), the burrito (roasted veggies, beans, cheese, rice) Staff is fast and friendly. Note that the Natural is cash only.

The food is below average.  The previous restaurant had the best authentic thai food.  This version is very Americanized.  The hours of the restaurant are not consistent.  I tried ordering a few times and they had closed early.  Food is not consistent. The same dish is made many different ways. This place has  much work in improving itself.  I would recommend a pass.  There are many other much better authentic thai restaurants minutes away.
Great food & service. Their homemade salsa is awesome. Everything is always fresh. I am in the food business and I am tough to please, but this place always gets the job done. Keep it up!
Best irish pub in Hartford. Hands down. Quaint and comfortable pub atmosphere with drinks and a menu to bring the Emerald Isle right to Hartford

All in all a truly awful experience. Service was slow and inattentive. Food was DRENCHED in salt. There is a difference between salted and too salty but they apparently don't know what that is. Coconut juice had little real coconut and tasted watered down and over sweetened. Papaya salad was swimming in dressing. Normally I would take out my displeasure in a tip rather than a review, but they had the gall to charge us an 18% gratuity for a party of six. Avoid like the plague.
Ok this place is getting 5 stars because Mike the bartender was the best!  Fun and engaging.  Thanks Mike!

I came here for our anniversary lunch today! I decided to take my boyfriend here bc I heard so many great reviews about this place I really had to try it. The atmosphere is just perfect. The dining area is very nice. WE were greeted very warm and professionally by Goran.The Calamari was out of this world, one of the best we had out of all the restaurants we ever ate at. The pizza was delicious. I have to say its probably the best pizza on state street. Modern pizza can move way over bc Da Legna is definitely on top of my list!  Even though it got a little busy Goran took the time to chat with us and treated us like we were long time friends. I will surely be returning, I was impressed with everything :)

All the sushi was fresh and presented in an appealing way. The waitress was nothing but courteous and nice. Didn't enjoy the sushi "pizza" as the bread was a bit soggy. Other than that - great little spot! Would certainly go back. Byob doesn't hurt either

The Market has always been a favorite for breakfast, lunch or their Catering company.  Chef Rodney Mitchell has just acquired the business and he has already brought a flair of taste and satisfaction to this long term Montgomery establishment.  I've enjoyed the dishes introduced just in the first week of ownership.  The Salmon, soup selection and new salads are delicious.  I noted that they also are making the change to Small World Coffee, another local treat.  Well done Rodney and team!!!
Fantastic pizza!
Fabulous date place! Small but has a comfortable atmosphere. Service is wonderful.

We ordered food based on these reviews!  We were so happy with the food!  It was delicious and plentiful.  Very affordable.  We ordered online three hours before we needed it and called up to confirm that we wanted it delivered another time.  The food arrived exactly the time we wanted!  We will definitely order from Tina's again while visiting tia in NYC!!!

The food here is great but the recent staffing changes are taking this place down hill. The old server was amazing. The new waiter rude and has ruined our last two visits. I hope they figure this out soon. He needs to have patience and stop telling the customers dont worry!

We have been meaning to go to La Cigogne since it opened and are so glad we finally made it in!  Jeremy was wonderful, made it feel like a real neighborhood place.  We loved the food and the atmosphere and it has such a fun mix of people with friends, on dates, with families (we took our 4 month old who loved it too!).  Definitely will be our go to neighborhood spot, so glad they have come to town...

Please before you die try their gnocchis. Although the place is cramped, I wanna go back just for the gnocchis. And our server, don't remember her name, was really great and very nice. Fries are decent too. I tried the cookies and milk dessert and it was pretty good, not as good as I expected, but definitely try it and split it with someone

This meal was absolutely wonderful. Ambience was beautiful-not too crowded or stuffy. Staff was attentive and helpful. Each course got better and better. The price may seem like a lot at first but with all the "extras" they give you, it is well worth it. As soon as we mentioned we met the pastry chef previously, the kitchen brought out 2 complimentary (delicious) desserts to what we had already ordered! Excellent meal and experience overall.

We love pho and stopped at this place to try it. The decor left much to be desired. So we were not sure how the food would be. After our first taste of the pho broth we just looked at each other and smiled. One of the best bowls of pho we have ever had. The price was very reasonable. Can't wait to go back!!
Great pizza for a decent price ( for the area at least). For 4 bucks you can get a huge slice with lots of cheese and toppings.This place is great, even better drunk.
Great for brunch! Good for dinner too! Amazing service!

The oatmeal is the best I ever had, just delicious.  I often stop in for a custom made salad which is always fresh and delicious.  The soups are great, usually something for everyone.  to the commenter who didn't like it, they are always willing to give you a taste of the soup first, to make sure you like it.  The owners are very friendly nice people.  Great place.

Though I had heard great things about this place, after nearly a week of trying to score reservations for the night that I had friends in from out of town, I was kind of over it.  Man, am I ever glad that my friend kept pushing for this one!  I managed to snag their very last table as a walk-in earlyish on Friday night, despite the crowds.  While I waited for my friends, I had an expensive but absolutely delicious Tom Collins at the bar-- the perfect antidote for a long week-- and was pleasantly surprised at the kind service I received in spite of the somewhat hectic atmosphere. All of that pales in comparison, though, to the Minetta Burger.  Seriously, THE BEST burger I have ever eaten in my entire life-- and I don't mess around when it comes to red meat.  The waiter gave us a light-hearted yet stern lecture about trying a bite without condiments before deciding to add any of the ketchup, mayo, or mustard he brought to the table, and I am glad that I took his advice.  Absolutely nothing was needed to make that burger better.  Everything came out hot and perfectly cooked, and the burger was just SUPERB.  Now I know what all the fuss is about!

Came here for brunch over the past weekend, was super excited to try out the food finally. I did enjoy the food, but the service was so-so. Our waitress handed us our check before we asked for it (which would have made sense if the place was extremely busy, but we were one of three tables there) and then we noticed she kept walking by to check if we had put our cards in or not. Made us feel a little uncomfortable but I would still go back here again, because it was delicious!
Busy, interesting. A little fake.
what a great family trip....you must visit and have pulled pork or cheesesteak wit or wit out....

Been going to Reading Terminal Market since the time when there was still a working train terminal overhead. Nowhere else do you encounter the fabulous atmosphere, great smells, and busy merchants that make up this market that is a true Philly institution. Among my favorites - "Down Home Diner" "DiNic's Pork" and "Salumeria." Flowers, ice cream, spices, goods and meats, old books, cookies to die for, breads that really ARE the staff of life. It's all there. Go! Already!
Owners responded appropriately to address the issue.

One star loss for the rude service and two more for the "eh" food. The broth only tasted good with the two slices of pork that we were given. When those were gone so was all the flavor and then the broth was mostly just water. Watched as the chef grabbed pre-packaged noodles from a cardboard box and throw it in some water which turned out to be extremely chewy. The menu doesn't explain what's in the food. Waitress kept plopping water into the cups and spilling it all over. The bill came to 24 and the tip section read 2 dollars. We paid the 26. As we were leaving she comes up to us and tells us we haven't given her a tip. States the two dollars were tax and as my bf pulls out his wallet she requests a $4 tip which may be a reasonable tip for someone who wasn't spilling water everywhere and forgetting the sides we asked for. Tried to eat ramen somewhere that wasn't Totto Ramen. Went in expecting Totto Ramen quality and we were of course let down. Our bad...
Great Food, Service, and overall experience!

Loved my experience at Izakaya! The food was delicious, really high quality ingredients and preparation. It most definitely is not a typical nyc Japanese restaurant. The offerings were traditional Japanese fare but not the same old dishes offered in like every Japanese restaurant I've been to ever. The fried tofu was so delicious, just the right consistency and great flavoring. The chicken namban was really tasty as well, and I also appreciated the kitchen staff's thoughtful presentation of the food. That green tea was so frickin tasty I just couldn't stop with the refills. The atmosphere is bright, cheery and welcoming, great place to eat with friends, a significant other or business associate. It is byob until the liquor license goes through in a couple weeks but the owners are gifting their customers with a coupon for one free drink for when that glorious day comes :) Can't wait to visit again and try the addictive fried chicken!!!

I'm a native of Rahway and I've been waiting for a place I could enjoy in walking distance of home. This place is great, the prices are affordable and the drinks are awesome. The female bartender with the dark hair (can't recall her name) is friendly and very attentive. In most bars I wait about 10 minutes to be served, but every time I come here I'm served instantly and my husband and friends and I can hold conversations with each other without yelling over the music. The music selection is varied and appeals to all tastes. I would recommend this place to anyone.e
They serve a good Burger!
One of the best slices i've had. BIG SLICE !!!! Owners or very friendly !!!! A must for pizza lovers !!!!

Absolutely stellar authentic Greek food, like being in the Greek isles only noisier . We waited( you usually do) but what a great place. We had the Greek salad, the feta was beautifully creamy and dusted with oregano and bathed in olive oil. In Greece lettuce is unusual, so the salad had some romaine, cut small, but was filled with tomato,cucumbers, sweet red onion, excellent olives and pepperocini. The simple dressing was excellent. The lemon roasted potatoes were simply incredible. Tender and flavorful. The grilled octopus was butter tender with a great charred flavor. Even the bread was excellent. I only wish that I lived close so I could return again soon, but alas, I live 6000 mile away.
The short ribs are out this world , the ambience is cozy  and is very inviting.  The  chorizo burger is amazing . It's easy to get to by car and train . This neighborhood gem will see more of me .
Been eating from the stand  most of  my time working on 60 Madison.  Best  fresh food stand in the area.
Such a hidden treasure! Great beers on tap, friendly service, and delicious oysters. No freezer, so everything is super fresh! Sooooo fresh!!
Get the curious george it will change your life.

Ha a 730pm Saturday reservation to celebrate my wife's birthday.  Ordered the 4 course Prix Fix menu with the waiter picking the courses for my wife.  Plating was very nice and the food was great with portions slightly smaller than I would have liked.  A nice touch at the end with some chocolates and a birthday candle Decibel level in the room  is great for conversation.  We will definitely eat here again.

I would have liked to give our wings and barbecue 5 stars,  because they were pretty darn close, and certainly satisfying and delicious. I'm taking back that last star because of the pricing of some of the many beer choices. We dropped in during happy hour, when beers marked with an asterisk (*) are NOT discounted. We weren't made aware of this, and due to some pretty inconsistent pricing, ended up paying 12 dollars for one beer (Hitochino). It was a delicious beer- different, flavorful, and well-balanced, but I probably wouldn't have ordered it if prices had been posted ON THE BEER LIST OR THE CHALKBOARD!  I view this as an unfortunate decision of management to not inform consumers of prices more than the barkeeper's failure to mention the price anomaly.  Next time I will be asking for prices as well as choices, which is unfortunate to say the least. Go for the food, don't order the asterisks.
The Brisket was Good, but all the sides sucked! The service kind of sucked too!
Really good food.. Tasted so good Mexican after very long.. Just don't get get swordfish. Rest all is awesome

Outstanding! This is definitely one of my new favorite restaurants in CT!! The service was incredible - very friendly and not too disruptive. The food was amazing!! We asked our waiter to give us his top 3 favorite tapas on the menu and they were perfect. They even split a bowl of soup between my friend and I instead of giving us two large ones since we both wanted to try. The soup was the seafood bisque special and we HIGHLY recommend it if it's on special when you get there - definitely order it. Actual jumbo shrimp, mussels and scallops in the bisque with a delicious crispy parmesan crostini. We also tried the lava cake and tres leches specials for dessert, again absolutely outstanding. Lava cake was soft, perfect temperature and filled with gooey chocolate. Will definitely return and recommend to friends - can't wait to try the remainder of the menu!

The salads we had were all really great. Beyond that I wasn't impressed. One waitress covering 15 tables. Charge by the glass for soda refills. Pizza is thin crust but extremely extremely greasy. I'm not a health not but I had to use the napkins to try to dry it out.
Excellent, quick food! Had brunch on a Wednesday and it was yummy and inexpensive overall. I'll likely be back!
What can i say . The bbq here is amazing.  I have been down south and to have a place in nyc that serves bbq as good or better then places in the south is an example of NYC's magic . Love this place!

If Ur in the mood for great pizza, Modern Apizza is the place to be.  The Food is excellent in every sense of the word Excellent.  Just be sure u have the time to spare, and that's a good thing, because the food is so good, more than likely u'll be standing out the door waiting to get in, however, once seated and its all said and done, I get cha u'll be back !!
I had an AMAZING experience at the Mariachi Grill. The food was very fresh and and delicious. The restaurant is very clean and I was very impressed!! I highly recommend.
Definitely worth the visit!

Excellent Latin fusion is the theme at Blue Cat. Went there to celebrate life , food, & family : & both my mom & husband told me again & again what a great experience it was . We started with the homemade guacamole with textured vegetable chips. I'm a Guacamole aficionado, and this dish here is the real deal . Mom had the black bean soup and beef empanadas, but with flavorful and unique but not overly spicy . Hubby enjoyed the Carne Asada , delicately slow cooked meat that was perfectly textured and full of taste. I had the Pompano Fish special, exquisitely out of this world it's all I can say. The service was friendly and helpful . Environment is funky casual. Street parking is usually available without too much trouble. Blue Cat is BYO , Cash Only , & a great meal & experience .

We never got to eat there since the hostess would not seat a party of 5 last Sat around 2 pm. There was a table for 4 and a 2 top right next to it that would have worked perfectly, but no. There were also other empty tables. She kept saying it was company policy, we could sit in a line at the bar if we wanted. Even after we explained that we were friends from all over the country  celebrating for one day it was still a no go. So we went to Maialino just down the street and had a lovely time. Cafe Mono missed out on a $400+ check and the fact that the New Yorker in our group will not be back.

It shoulda been 5 stars.   A lovely meal.  My wife and I agreed we feel the Mushroom Gravy Smothered Chicken was a little tastier than the Sausage Gravy Fried Chicken, but that is a minor quibble.  The cheese grits were sublime, a term I don't often use, but absolutely appropriate here.   It was a pleasure to be served by John.  So unusual to find a professional who was helpful, hard-working (often stopping by the table to refill my coffee), and friendly without being overbearing.  After experiences with many mediocre to poor waiters at restaurants high and low, John was a breath of fresh air. And speaking of fresh air...the entire front of the restaurant was open.  It was cold.  We were told it was the policy to keep the front open.  On a cold and rainy day, we want respite from the elements, not huddling in our coats and ordering hot coffee to keep our hands warm.  We would have awarded this restaurant 5 stars, but the policy to freeze the patrons warrants the 4 (perhaps it should be 3) star review. It was our first visit to this highly rated place.  We will not return until the warmth of spring.
Good food. Friendly staff.

Surprised by the yelp rating.  Our table full of californians wouldnt come back. Things to note: 1/ owner is very nice 2/ took  greater than 30 min to get 3 orders of tacos around 6pm 3/ a bit pricey for what you get, tacos are similar price to highly rated manhattan tacquerias
Simple. Awesome. That's all I need to say about this place. Definitely recommended. Get the soup a bit spicy... And slurp!!! Slurping is a must... You're welcomed to quote me on that.

You can see the stress/tiredness in all servers faces, which to me, made it an uncomfortable place for me to dine at. I ordered anyway since I was super hungry and it was close to the Broadway show I had just watched. In all, this cramped up Japanese ramen place doesn't serve the best bowl of ramen - you can find better. It's also quite expensive for the medium sized bowl you get in my opinion. Perhaps it was the service? Not coming back. Next time I want ramen, I'll try Ippudo.

The last time I came here with my daughter (and we used to be regulars for all the quirky reasons listed), it turned from quirky to just poor food, poor service and poor attitudes. There were four people for lunch. The waitress lost one customer's credit card somewhere between the woman's table and the cash register. The poor woman had to leave without her card. We waited more than 40 minutes for our food - not sure why and when I complained, the waitress just shrugged her shoulders and basically indicated no one was happy there. I indicated that it was a shame and that Beachland would put them out of business if things did'nt improve. I have never been back and that was two years ago --- I regularly eat at the Pug and Beachland. The owners should sit up and take notice or they are going to become irrelevant in West Hartford. The clientele will eventually become too old to even go there. Update the restaurant! Open it up and make it not so dingy and get some adequate help.

Apart from the strangely futuristic decor, this place was an extremely pleasant surprise.  After living in the city for several years, I had yet to come across a French restaurant (in Manhattan, anyway) that offered up both excellent food and reasonable prices.  Amelie delivered on both fronts! The bacon and prosciutto-wrapped dates were delicious (hard to go wrong with that one), the French bread was crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside, the steak was cooked how I ordered it, and my friend's pork chops were fantastic.  Add to that a good wine list, a decadent chocolate dessert, and wonderful service, and you've got the makings of a great night.  Truly the perfect place to celebrate my birthday!

Worked in the restaurant business a long time and have recently come to NH. Have been to the same named place in SONO and enjoyed everything, atmosphere, food, drink and service, in NH tho... first off they act like the staff is all told on a daily basis they are better than everyone they will serve. But the real problem I had was I am almost positive that my food was partially microwaved! I heard the bartender refer to my order being done being "nuked" in 2 minutes and when my small plate of steak tips, Im pretty sure he meant microwaved when he said nuked. After that it was all cold plates for me and they did do a good job on everything else. Just not anything that needs to be nuked apparently.

Came here at 9am on a Saturday morning, boo yea beat the traffic and fell in love with these never-frozen dumplings. I got the pork and cabbage dumplings, fried and steamed. I liked the fried one a little bit more than the steamed but I'd recommend to anyone trying both. Their Soy Bean Milk is AMAZING! Never really had soy bean milk but for some reason this milk was bringing me back some warm and fuzzy feelings of happiness. Even though it was 9am, we had to wait 2 minutes to get seating so expect to eat the milk + dumplings outside...

This restaurant is delicious! We got here a little early (630) and there were several open tables. I was glad to see because we had not made a reservation. By 730 the place was packed with people. The food is amazing. I ordered the filet mignon and my boyfriend ordered the chicken which were both extremely delicious. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

This place used to be great when they served Short Rib but the last two times that I tried to get short rib, they didn't have it.  I even called the first time to ask and they told me they did and then didn't have it when I drove all the way there. I just tried to call them again and the person on the phone was rude, and once again, no short rib.  Time to try a new place!

Had to go after reading all reviews and the chicken biscuit sandwich exceeded all expectations. However I know personal taste but didn't think same about the shrimp po boy. Bottom line it is a must trip to get chicken biscuit
fantastic!! Perfect for romantic dinners or meals with family or friends. Delicious traditional Italian everything, a local fav.
Very authentic for a Chinese restaurant that isn't owned by Chinese people. I like spicy and they had a lot of good dishes with spicy taste. Dan Dan noodles is a must.
I had a Groupon for this place and was very happy.  I came here with some coworkers and everyone raved about the food.

I had the pleasure of visiting this place today for a late lunch with my parents. The ingredients are fresh, the preparation is spot on and the taste was wonderful. I love the fact that they source their ingredients from local farms. I had a gluten free crepe with harvest veggies and goat cheese and my parents had the BLT and bacon and cheese. Thumbs up from everyone! Only downside was the $40 parking ticket from Princeton police, in the 5 minutes it took me to get change to feed the meter. Grrrr....
Great food and atmosphere. Service was wonderful and accommodated our need to be out by a certain time to make a show!

I cannot say enough good things about Gelones. As soon as you walk though the door their are warm welcomes and pleasant faces.  I go here at least 3 times a month in the winter time and their food is always amazing. They make many of their own pasta's, the ingredients are always fresh and full of flavor. The staff is literally amazing they are so attentive to your needs and do not harass you or linger around your table. They make amazing specials and I can almost say whatever you order is going to wonderful, not to mention you can bring your own WINE!. This is the best Italian food in town, and the price is beyond reasonable. If you have not been here make a reservation and treat yourself, you are not getting any better than gelones.
S'gucci.

This review is just for the weeknight manager, who handles my complaints with both professionalism, manners and a smile. It's easy to handle a happy customer, so I always appreciate those who can handle me.
Delicious and great service
Perfection! All of the food is divine. I love the tie die pizza and the ravioli! I have had a few different salads, all of which were wonderful. Probably my favorite restaurant in NYC.

3 of us ate at 'chapter one' last evening..  what a great find..  staff was helpful..  service was good.. whether appetizer or entree blend of ingredients was perfect without being overpowering..  sound level was acceptable..  i will definitely be a repeat patron..  i wish them great success..restaurant was not full but by 9 p.m. the bar was hopping with hungry individuals..
Best Sandwiches on the North Shore and Vinny is always there with a smile and a handshake...

I recently went here to celebrate my sisters birthday and the atmosphere is amazing! The fact that they have an indoor space and an outdoor patio allows maximum comfort with chairs and couches. The drinks were moderately priced and the music kept everyone on their feet. The DJ was interactive and entertaining. I was able to navigate within the space easily and parking wasn't terrible.

Eaten about 30 times here in the past year or so since they've been open. Tried almost every menu item during that time. Not one bad meal, period. Always a great selection of brews, including some that are hard to find elsewhere. Friendly staff, clean establishment, prompt and attentive service. What else can you ask for, really? This place is a breath of fresh air for someone looking for something besides the usual pizza joint, fast food, or $100 a plate establishment. Definitely a much-needed niche in the area that knows how to serve up good...everything.
Meat on a stick. Bacon on a stick. WHAT'S NOT TO LOVE? Big props to Matthew!

I have been there so many times over the years. Had some good meals there. I have only had maybe one bad experience where the Tuna burger tasted old. I told them. And they were very good about it. Made me something else.

A hidden gem with great food and wonderful service. We have been eating here since it opened. Saverio is a wonderful chef/owner   who uses the freshest ingredients to produce Italian Classics. Everything is prepared to order and frankly we are always amazed that he can turn out great dishes for a full restaurant from such a modest sized kitchen. The service is very good even on busy nights. Exceptional in every way.
Come to Bergen Burger! Quality burgers and great staff! The fusion of Filipino flavors and dishes is an awesome touch. Chef Jerome is doing an amazing job. I'll always come to Bergen Burger for sure!
Best Peruvian food hands down , except when you come around 9:30 ish -10 pm they give you horrible beans around this time , but on a regular their chicken and green sauce is amazing !!

Great beer selection. Great food with limited options so all of them are done well. We are in the parlor downstairs which was nice and quaint but the wait at the bar to get drinks on a non crowded Wednesday was a little long at times. You have to order all food and drinks through the bar even if you are at a table. Also it was extremely warm in the downstairs even on a cool day.
great food!
the best.

This place deserves three stars for the exceptionally tasty and unique food but the service here is awful. The obnoxious manager who refused to split our cards as well as the hostess who had nothing but attitude really ruined what could have otherwise been a five star experience.

I went into PDs and sat down on a bench and watched and waited for a seat. Near the bar was half pitcher of some sort of liquid with liquid soaked napkins dripping on the floor. Sitting at the bar (for lack of a better word) were 3 guys in their black leather fags...dirty fingernails, greasy hair and bad beards. The place isn't well lit which is probably intentional. I took out a pie for reasons I stated above...the pizza tasted flat. It was similar to a frozen pizza. Location doesn't make a good place to eat, it's the best ingredients and know how of the people in the kitchen.

I would give this place one star but added an extra star for fast delivery. The food had no flavor and the shrimp tasted rubbery. The vegetables were fresh but the sauce they were in tasted like nothing. My frozen meal tasted better.

If you want to avoid the long line, visit this stand earlier in the day! Once the sun goes down, the line gets realllll crazy! The rice is chewy and they give you a generous amount, so in my opinion one plate is a perfect amount to share. The white sauce is really important because without it this dish is a bit dry. I wish that I had a little bit more salad in mine. The meat is tender and the pita bread is a nice addition. Pretty solid. I'm not sure if I will crave this place, but the next time I am in New York, I will be sure to grab a bowl!

Not sure about all these positive reviews...came here for a casual weekday meal and had a completely underwhelming experience. The food was bland, barely seasoned at all. The chicken wings were served in a raspberry habanero sauce that didn't work at all. Definitely trying too hard to be more upscale than they're capable of. Seemed like they're under new management and the change has been for the worse.

I am a native of Rahway and try my hardest to support the local businesses, my husband and I went there for the first time about a week ago. The atmosphere was warm and comfortable however my husband and I sat there for almost 10 minutes without being served. The prices for the shots and cocktails was very reasonable and tasty. I felt uncomfortable because it was hardly easy to talk over the other loudly singing patrons. I would not suggest here for a intimate date night but if you want a night on the town (well Rahway) then I'd say go for it!

Awesome decor, super friendly hostess, good start! On a Wednesday night the restaurant was packed, we were seated promptly even though our party was not complete. Server was very knowledgable and told us about a 40 day dry aged ribeye that sounded so good we could not resist. We started off with croquettes with truffle that were outstanding, melted mozzarella cheese in the center. Kale salad was crisp and the tahini dressing gave it a nice sweetness. With the ribeye (worth every penny, we payed $90 for it, but was big enough for the 4 of us) we also shared their Mac & cheese which was super creamy and crispy on top. We ended the meal with Nutella doughnuts and there caramel budino which were both amazing. Great work baker & co, I will be back soon.
Worth their long wait,  as much as I love shakeshack, I would recommend that you check out umami over shakeshack. Truffle everything!

Their food is pretty decent actually - I've gotten the cavatelli and the pizza and been happy with both. The reason for two stars is that given the price, the portions are laughably small, like half the amount of pasta you'd expect and an 8" pizza at best. Not worth your money for delivery.

My first visit to NIXS Hartford was wonderful... good ambiance!  The food was well prepared and the portions were just right!  The staff, including the Manager, was very warm and accommodating.  I'm very excited for my next visit now that they have a DJ!!!

Simple authentic Italian food. After a long time we finally had a great Italian pizza. Sometimes it's hard to find one even in our hometown. Price / value was also very good. We usually think of NYC as an expansive place to eat, but we would have paid the same at home.
Wonderful restaurant. Food is creative and delicious and the service excellent. Don't miss it
Food is good and the environment is very nice. It was a little loud for me but nothing I couldn't deal with. I took my dad and brother when they came to visit and they liked it as well.
Great food. Wish I had someone to explain the ordering process because I felt so lost. The lady wasn't very nice when I did order, but its whatever, I'd still go back there to eat lol.
Atmosphere was nice. Service was great. Food was Awesome!!! We had Oysters, French fries, cornbread, fried chicken and waffles. All delicious!!!

One of my favourite food places on Earth! Everything from the bacon-oyster stew to the grilled cheese and raw scallion carpaccio has been incredible. I always try to have the specials unless I have my mind set on the always-incredible Poutine with Juz de Duc, which is literally duck-gravy! Oh, be praised Poutine! Also a fine selection of the best craft beers in the area and most  helpful and friendly staff ever! A recommendation without a reservation!
Friendly owner.  Excellent food.  It's not cheap for takeout, but the quality is excellent.  Worth the extra $'s.  One taste and you'll never eat Boston Market again.

This is only good if you are devoted to the lifestyle.  Sure, roasted plain sweet potato is great for roasted plain sweet potato- but if you throw on some butter, all the sudden its a hell of a lot better than roasted plain sweet potato.

The food was completely insipid and had no flavor at all. We were surprised the place had so many good reviews since we had 3 small plates and none of them tasted good. Wine selection was okay and service wasn't  bad, but the food was awful.
Amazing food, very friendly and accomodating staff. Seafood paella is the best.
Delicious sandwiches, Great flavor. Family friendly. Very good service. Ambiance is conductive for eating and conversation
The pulled pork sandwich tastes so good that it makes me feel less guilty about grinding up a living animal into tiny pieces and putting it between two pieces of bread for pure pleasure. Wait...

The atmosphere was sort of like a cafe you might find in a foreign country. There was a TV playing a Lebanese soap opera. The food is all prepared fresh and the young lady who served us was attentive and pleasant. My daughter got the hummus which was an amazing serving with pita and olives for just $4. She told me it tasted very good. I got a Kefta kabob which came with flat bread, grilled vegetables and a tasty rice pilaf. The serving size was large enough for dinner tonight and lunch tomorrow. I am a fan of good Mediterranean food and I will definitely be coming back and bringing my wife with me.

I used to LOVE this place. I came here for lunch today and noticed the dirty fry oil right behind register that I didn't notice before. It was lunch time and the oil was nasty dark as black already. I'm pretty sure they don't change the oil often. The guy threw my donkatsu into the nasty oil to fry and that was enough for me losing my appetite... It was rainy chilli day and the door was left open. I asked the owner if I can close door cause I didn't want to eat my lunch as shivering with cold. He said no and said that I'm wearing a jacket and I should be fine. What a nice customer care?! They should learn how Jananese care their customer nicely. (Ppl work here are not Japanese). Anyhow, I don't think I will come back here again
Best sea food ever!! Get ready to work though... Definetly worth the price! Great service, nice vibes and crowd, fast and yummy!!
Great place to eat the spicy tomato soup was great and I normally don't eat tomatoes and the grilled cheese With bacon was great would eat here again

Ordered for delivery..it wasn't the best. I had high hopes for it based on the reviews, but maybe its better when its not for delivery? The grilled pork chops tasted weird and the shrimp and tofu was mediocre. =\ I wanna try eating there and hopefully it'll be a better experience, but I'm extremely reluctant.

90-105 minutes to deliver a grilled cheese sandwich? You would think an establishment with limited to zero seating would have their delivery game down pat and be more efficient.  If their delivery took less time then they would obtain my business.  I shall now order from elsewhere.   I added one star because when your food is finally delivered it is good (when it is not cold from taking so long).
It was a rainy day and it makes a difference when staff is friendly. The delicious veggie omelet for and a huge cup of coffee last me a whole day til dinner

Wanted to leave a short review about my time here. All in All excellent service and a cozy place. Food was good and had a nice brunch selection. Will be back and be bringing some more friends for a nice lazy Sunday brunch!

Wow. I gave up on looking for good tacos in nyc years ago, i wish i knew this place existed when i first moved here! By far the best tacos I've had in the city. Everything from the quality of the meat, flavor, and their home made salsas is just perfect. PS if you get the pork taco, they slab a couple pieces of grilled pineapples on it. Delicious.
Damn fine cocktails. Sampled 3 different ones from friends and they were all great. Also, the rocking sofa. Atmosphere is on point!

I really wanted to like this place but I found it to be just mediocre. The portion sizes were good and the decor was nice. The place was very crowded, especially for a weekday night and I felt that they were not adequately staffed. I'm not sure if they were just having a bad day, but all the dishes were very salty.

One word: FOOD POISONING. I usually don't leave reviews unless my experience is completely positive or complete disaster. I got to New York this morning, had Poached egg and rosewater waffle, shortly after party in the bathroom all day. UGH. Please make sure your food is alright. This place just ruined my entire New York trip.

When I first arrived at the restaurant,I noticed a sign at the front entrance to go to the back entrance.  It was a little strange how we were ushered to an area with only Asians.  It was also, strange how more Asians were brought to our section as time passed.  I just thought that it was popular amongst Asians.  Soon enough the room was dimly lit for no apparent reason.  I tried to give this place the benefit of the doubt.     So, my friend took me to this restaurant based on the good reviews on yelp and for my birthday.  The food was really tasty, we ordered two appetizers, one entree and a dessert which were quite filling.  The service was pretty good too.  However, what happened next was unforgivable.     Once my friend asked for the bill and it was paid for, we tried to leave the premises.  We tried to exit through the darkly lit back entrance that we entered through, but it was locked.  A staff member escorted us to the main entrance and to our surprise it was well lit.  What we noticed was that there were no minorities.  Once we exited the restaurant my friend and I both commented on this, how we were seated in a different room with all the Asians and felt like second-class citizens.  After my experience here I won't ever be returning!!!

One of my favorite places. I live one block away and no matter if I dine in, or order a delivery, the quality of food and service always surpasses my expectations. When you visit, you must try fried pickles, Korean BBQ pork belly sandwich and "Fish and Chips".

I was skeptical about Marigold Kitchen's re-opening under junior chefs. But, wow, what I discovered...it got better! These talented young culinary artists are in the groove! Come enjoy the beginning of an excellent new era. Five stars hands down.

If they wouldn't have gotten my order wrong TWICE in a row (after telling me that I'm the one who ordered the wrong thing) then I imagine it would be delicious but alas, I'll never know. The girl with the dreads needs to work somewhere else...far far away from customers. After telling me that I was the one who made the mistake (ummm, no...I would never have ordered what they served me), she then giggled with the cook after giving me the EXACT same incorrect order....for the second time. No apology, no assistance, just accusatory-ness and irritation at our existence.   No thank you.
Great food and very good service too!  I will definitely be back to this place.
The best asian skewer in philly. All ingredients are so fresh and very nice service unlike some Chinese restaurant around here. The price is acceptable and atmosphere is cute.

I booked the Malt House for a Happy Hour for about 200 people on a Monday night. The management and staff were wonderful to work with. The beer was delicious. We came in October, so there was a large selection of seasonal pumpkin and Oktoberfest beers. The food was tasty too. They provided a generous amount for the guests. The bar is in a great location, close to NYU and Washington Square Park. It got a bit cramped at times, but that is to be expected in the Village. Overall, I would highly recommend The Malt House.

This place is horrible!!!!  I have no idea what how this place gets better ratings. I had the BBQ ribs. There is nothing BBQ about these ribs. They are BOILED!!! Who the hell boils ribs, slathers them w cheap sauce and try's to pawn them off as a culinary treat!?? They were terrible I threw half of them out. The pork fried rice had very little pork, the rice tasted burnt and was stale as if it was prepared days ago. The egg roll was a decent size and fried week, but was sloppy inside and again no pork!!! I wouldn't try it again or recommend it.
The beer list is one of the best you will find anywhere, and there is always something interesting on tap!  Fast, friendly service.  The drunken shrimp is great, and so are the burgers.
Really nice place, really nice staff. Loved it

Really great pumpkin coffee! They have all kinds of bagels to choose from. I got a breakfast sandwich with some veggies and cheese.  Very tasty! Ps they have $2 pumpkin muffins for all you pumpkin lovers!! I read thru their lunch menu, looks all very fresh! I'll probably take a to go sandwich for my lunch later!

Terrible! The menu is a piece of paper, yes just a piece of paper, the food was nothing more than average and the walls where they placed the candles on tables are burnt! I usually don't hate on restaurants on the internet but this place sucks. Never again!

This restaurant has generic american Chinese food, but their service has always been amazing. The people working there were friendly and fast... Until tonight. I tried to order takeout (10 min for delivery) and before tax the order came to 9.55. There is nothing about pre tax delivery minimums and they have always delivered in the past, but the american girl who answered the phone tonight was rude and refused to deliver without raising the price (before tax). As I stated before there is no mention of needed to reach the minimum first and this girl was a brat and should be fired. Needless to say I will no longer support them.

We have been to Nolita several times since it opened and have always been impressed. The decor is warm and sophisticated and the wait staff is always friendly, quick, and eager to share the specials. My go-to is the chicken parm which is always huge and super crispy. My ONLY complaint is that the spaghetti it comes with is rinsed and can sometimes pool on my plate but I have absolutely no doubt I could ask for it sticky and they would accommodate (if only i could remember). I have had the pear and champagne drink a few times and it continues to impress.  My husband gets the spaghetti and meatballs and stuffs himself silly. For dessert I have only had the cheesecake but, again, it was great. We will continue to scratch our italian itch here and will definitely try our luck with delivery!

If you want to OVERPAY for BURNT pizza and a server that isn't attentive then this place is for you.  I heard the server say, "Is everythink okay?" Before we could answer he'd already turned and dashed away.  I DO NOT LIKE BURNT PIZZA and would have complained to the server if he spent a minute at our table.  Then to top it off, I told the cashier that the pizza was burnt, he said, "you should have told your server".  Oh, and before I forget, don't expect refills for your drinks.  SOUP WAS TOO SALTY, SALAD TASTED SOUR, AND THE PIZZA WAS BURNT.  THAT IS ALL THEY SERVE AND COULDN'T GET ONE ITEM RIGHT. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE THERE ARE BETTER PLACES NEARBY!  LIKE CAFE ANTONIO'S ACROSS THE STREET.
Delicious. Fresh sushi. Nice wait staff.  Some authentic bar food. I'm glad this opened up in LIC!

Came here once after going to the movie theater with the family.  We had a good experience with the food and especially loved the lamb chops- this item definitely stood out for all of us in how tasty it was! Came here a long time ago so I don't remember much else, but definitely would have came back again soon if I had the chance!!! I remember leaving quite happy!
These burgers are amazing!!! Will definitely come back. Beware bathrooms are unisex but they give enough privacy so everything is good.
Unbelievable food- especially the Mediterranean Platter. Best breakfast/lunch place in Philly by far. Really guys, its that good!!!

An incredible selection of beers and whiskeys, bourbons, ryes - everything liquid! I was not convinced by the food though!  Burgers were a bit too dry, shrimp sliders extremely dry (the shrimp was so deep fried there was hardly anything left that resembled a shrimp) and both batches of the IPA fries we got were a bit cold-greasy. Old Rasputin Imperial Stout stood out with it's predictable good quality.   I will not order food again, but will definitely grab some drinks the next time in the neighborhood. (For the sweet-tooths, there's a Hungarian pastry shop on the corner!)
Keep your stuff close. We got our stuff stolen right from the bar as soon as we stepped outside.

Great restaurant with awesome food & very polite & friendly servers. Had the monk fish for lunch & I definitely would recommend it to my friends! Their wine list was a great selection & I would definitely recommend the Pinot blanc with the monk fish.yummmmmyyy!!
always great, never disappoints. I haven't really tried any of the burgers but I'm sure they are just as yummy!!

This place has cheated me. I am a vegetarian and always ask the staff to prepare the food without fish/meat/eggs. I also make sure to communicate this when I place an order via seamless. I have ordered from here many times and eaten in as well and each time I give them the same instructions. I placed an order on seamless today and told them to prepare the food strictly vegetarian without fish/meat/egg and they rejected my order saying that they always use fish/oyster sauce. When I questioned them about why this wasn't communicated to me earlier, they just shrugged it off. I am absolutely appalled and disgusted by their callous attitude. I would never have ordered in the first place if they mentioned they put fish/oyster sauce in everything. I plan on registering an official complaint with consumer protection.
I'm still thinking about that black bean burger. I'm going back to next chance I get.
The best!

A little pricey, but great atmosphere, staff, food and drinks. The menu is somewhat limited, but has most of the basics i.e. pizza, burgers, salads etc. on a more level. We sat outside by the fires on a fall monday night, and it was a great time. Members of our party had cider, beer, and wine, and under the guidance of our server, we were all very happy with our choices. The food was great, nothing crazy, but a quality meal. The outside fire pits are the biggest hit for me, it was a great time and we will definitely go back, not only for relaxed nights, but also a Friday or Saturday.

A true diamond in the rough in Kensington. this place has stepped it up some more and it has become a great local spot. Some more cuisines would be nice. Chris and everyone there is super nice. def reccomend
As part Spaniard, everything I had (bread, chorizo, boquerones, tortilla, and patatas bravas) were absolutely excellent except for the average tortilla. Order everything else though! Great place

I have been there for many times and I am a fan there. I have tried the BBQ and hot pot, and both of them are worth trying. But I did not try them at the same time, because that would be too much for me. I think it is a good place to hang out no matter you go in a small group or in a large group. And the employees there are nice too. By the way, if you go there on your birthday, show them you ID, and you don not need to pay! Free birthday meal!!!

Love love love this place!!!   Been there three times this month and can't wait to go back. Brought three others the last time we went and they loved it too!!   Very reasonable prices and good sized portions. The skirt steak pizza is my favorite.  Wife loves their eggplant.  Service always outstanding and great atmosphere.

Modern European, young yet gourmet.  So thoughtfully appointed.  Music is albums on a turntable. The food is fresh and a taste of Paris' best bistro fare. Vegans accommodated. A quick taxi exit off the BQE just across the East River from the East Village.
Very poor management. Very rude staff. Sorry did not get chance to judge the food, coz the staff was not ready to cooperate. Think twice before going with a large group. Very rigid staff

We entered at 10.10 with a group of 15 ppl. I was greeted with "you guys have to order coz we r closing at 10.30" The owner was super rude! First of all, she gave us separate tables. I objected.offf.. M pissed!! Absolute crap on part of restaurant!! Arggghhhh.. Will never ever come again!!!!!! You are done

I'm a big fan of their iselin, nj branch.  This branch's pizza is nowhere near on par with the one in Iselin.  The marinara sauce is lacking in flavor/spices and is waaaay too salty.  They also don't use the same yellowish mozzarella (or mixed) pizza cheese as Iselin.   To top it off their door says they deliver when they don't.   The one in Iselin, NJ is a Pizza connoisseur's dream.  If you haven't tried them, give them a shot and you'll be hooked. Props to Singas in general though for bringging back decently-sized  personal pies with amazing crusts (unlike Domino's or Pizza Hut's standard crusts).
I am rating it 5 stars as the food is closest to an Indian taste. Do try the drums of heaven it's really nice.
Went for Sunday brunch.  Everything was very good and the service was great!
Best pancakes 6 years in a row is overrated. The German Apple pancakes were mediocre at best. The omelettes were over cooked and dry. Definitely left disappointed.
I like hot dogs. I was visiting New Haven and craved a hot dog. I found Jake's online and I am glad I did. I had the Baconator. Great value for the money. Thanks.

The food is fresh and delicious, but over priced. The employees are unfriendly...I go there everyday (for about the past 6 months) for a morning coffee and the employees look at me like they've never seen me before. You would think they would want to have a better connection with their regulars. The only reason I continue to go back is for the convenience and good coffee.
horrible food poisoning after having frog legs here. never again.

This place gets five stars because of the balance between quality and value.  The food is excellent with delicate layers of flavoring and great cook.  The curry puffs, egg rolls, etc.. are as good as it gets.  I don't eat fried foods, but those are so delicately done with such a perfect cook that they are not greasy at all.  Crisp and just wonderful. The curries that they do are phenomenal and very nicely balanced.  Rich, but not too rich, well seasoned but not overly seasoned, etc.... I come here a few times a month. Tonight for the first time I had a slight issue with a dish.  The head chef personally saw to it that the dish was redone.  It was taken care of quickly and the results were nothing short of awesome.  They went above and beyond to make sure we had a perfect experience.   I am a regular and plan to continue being a regular here.
One of the best Italian places in Manhattan. By all means deserves the highest rating.

Pizza was a lot bigger than expected and wasn't greasy at all but I found it to be not as tasty as some of the other slices I've  tried in the city. I really think it was the sauce, it just tasted a bit bland to me. It also took at least 30 mins, probably 45, for our small pizza to come. The place was packed but I still didn't understand why it would take so long given how fast those pizzas cook. Overall it wasn't worth the effort to me given how quickly you can get great slices in NYC.

Im from brooklyn and let me tell you, pizzalinos makes an unbelievable pizza. The grandma pizza is delicious and love the chicken roll and pizza bites. I love everything.  The people that work their are very nice and friendly. Joe keep up the good work. Wish you all the best and lots of luck. See you soon!!!!

amazing place inside and out.... its tucked away in a cute spot right off the main street in Princeton and definitely thought it was a plus that they had private parking. it had a really nice romantic ambiance to it and great service from the manager that opened the door for me and my husband to the waitress who gave us the up most care, it was an all around gem of a place to find! yea sure, the food is pricey and you might not get diner sized plates and stuff yourself to the brim food you get amazing tastes and great service for your visit and my husband and i both think that its completely worth it. a nice touch was the owner came up and asked us how our food and night was going and what can we say other that, "great!" and "you have an amazing place!" so please if you're in the near by area you should go to the peacock inn.... you'll have a great time!!

The five star reviews listed have said it all. Great food and service (thank you, Fidel and Glenn), charming and intimate atmosphere, interesting and reasonably priced menu, along with BYOB. We are always welcomed with great fervor and enjoy ourselves immensely. The UWS at its best!
Sarah at the bar was fantastic best food I have had in the area yet. I stopped in on a business trip and it was fantastic all around

"When it comes to crepes, I know what I am doing. I spent time in Brittany where the Galette De Sarrasin (Savory crepes) originated. I can tell you that what you get here is the closest thing to the original I found in the US. I was pleasantly surprised. The staff was attentive. I loved the Mexicana crepe. It s a good mix between European and Mexican flavors. I also like that they serve you salad with your crepe. The atmosphere is nice and their choice of music is very edgy too. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a delicious meal in a great place."

First time making a restaurant rec on Yelp! We went to Shehrazad's this evening with a friend. Had felafel (with a slight delicious zest), extremely moist and flavorful chicken kabobs, a plump spinach pie brimming over with filling and the best baklava I've had in a long time.  (It is a small place where you sit at a counter or at one 2-person table. or you can do take-out. Or you can take your food next door to his hookah bar, 1001 Nights Hookah Bar.) Extremely good value. The owner, George, is Lebanese and you feel like you're his guests and you've haven't felt as welcomed, as well-fed, and as comfortable for a long time. He gave us a tour of both establishments, pointing out his "kitchen" (the restaurant) his "living room" (the front room of the hookah bar) and his "salon" (the cosy back room of the hookah bar). Stop by, and say hello to George for me!
Love their morrocan chicken cous cous. But is really poor service the girl that served me did not smile once. Was a shame because I usually love going there whenever I am in New York.

This is almost as good as it gets when you crave thin crust pizza. I'm not big on pizzas in general, but when I do indulge once in a blue moon then this is the place! It would probably be 5 stars from me if I hadn't tried pizza all over the country and in Italy as well, but it's definitely up there. No doubt about it. The place has an older type vibe to it, like something out of 70s or 80s films. It's very nice overall and gives off a good vibe and lovely atmosphere. The pizza is the thinnest you will find and it is absolutely sublime! If that's your thing then you have to come here. If not, it's still worth a visit. You might love it! Their sweet peppers topping is great and it's usually my go to topping. Everyone is also very nice and welcoming.

definitely one of the best south indian places in the area. It is family owned and you get to see the owner around every now and then. Ala carte is just as good but I would suggest the lunch buffet for the variety. The spices and food taste very authentic and fresh. Rarely have I had something here that I didn't like. I prefer this place over some of the other very well to do south indian places. Food at Myilai is simple to the basics and delicious. Highly recommend. The ambiance is casual and this place seems kid/family friendly.

Just had our babies babtism party here with 15 guest and everything was amazing from the moment we got there to the moment we left. Service was amazing and food even better! Would recommend this place to anyone!

After managing two seats at the communal table, we were promptly greeted by friendly, bubbly, helpful Isabel.  She recommended wines for both myself and my friend, both which we loved.  She placed our order for food and it came out exactly as ordered - and MOST delicious!! There was never a moment that we wanted for anything, because Isabel was extremely attentive.  Our wine glasses were full, our needs were met, even before we actually needed anything. Great experience, outstanding service from Isabel, and a resounding yes to the question of whether or not we will return. Keep up the good work, SCG!!

I've visited a few times over the last month and unfortunately it wasn't the same experience as my first dinner here. The most recent meal was by far the worst and my last try with this place. I had a friend in town so I took her here for dinner. It didn't start out well when the server explained they were out of at least 4 or 5 items on the menu...and it's a small menu. So we ordered a few things to share. The calamari was horrid...chewy and poorly done. Both our pasta entrees were under seasoned, over cooked and flavorless. If you are going to charge $16 for a simple tomato pasta, it better be perfect and this wasn't even close.  A big disappointment, since I really want to love this place! The ambiance is perfect and the place is stunning, the staff is friendly but I'm sorry I will be spending my money elsewhere from now on.
I have no idea where they get there meat, had a stake and it tasted perfect. Best I had ever had, a bit pricy so I don't go often, but the meal is outstanding.
From out of town, so yelp helps out a lot. Wasn't disappoint; the food was delicious, the staff was very friendly, and the atmosphere was very cosy! Definitely would recommend!

FINALLY! A gourmet pizza shop on East Passyunk Ave. I am going to boldly put this out there- this pizza is better than that from Zavino and Pizzeria Vetri. They have the wood fire oven and fresh ingredients- but I believe their competitive advantage is the use of imported San Marzano tomatoes. I highly recommend the Margherita (if you, like me, are simplistic when it comes to pizza) and the Cannulo pizza- the pizza/cannoli hybrid with ricotta, porcini mushrooms, and sausage. The Cannulo was quite different but very delicious. In addition to the delicious fod, the wait staff was exremely well-educated and friendly. The place is decorated contemporary with a rustic twist. They serve fresh bread and a delicious good-quality olive oil. I will be back many more times!

Ate here earlier this week.  Excellent selection on the lunch special menu.  I ordered the fish and chips that were very good.  It was a large portion and very well priced.   I ordered a Palm beer draft and the selection of draft beers was excellent as well.  Many micro brews were represented.  Service was great and friendly   It is also a very comfortable restaurant.  Highly recommended.

We came all the way from Manhattan because we heard good things about Krupa Grocery, and believe us, it was well-worth the trip on a rainy Wednesday night. The food - the sausage dish and scallop dish - were both wonderful. The service was warm and friendly, and what's better than a really great glass of wine to top it off? We will definitely be back there soon. Wish it was in the East Village!
pho 2 is my favorite sandwich ever! my husband always switches his up but I'm always loyal to the pho 2.
More hype than substance. Lunch menu is rathered limited to say the least. Service was acceptable.

They offer many traditional fast food dishes; and yes, true to their claim, they offer the same pre-frozen flavorless stuff you can get on the "grease trucks" on Rutgers Campus. Their Fat-Cats: Let me preface this by saying that "Fat Sandwiches" in general are one of the cheapest ways to "get full" on Rutgers Campus.  Usually the perfect filler for often broke students who "don't care" as long as it fills the tank.   Here in Central Jersey, we've seen sampled these sandwiches from dozens of restaurants.  Given the nature of the sandwich, they, rarely run for anything over $7. Mr. G's  uses tasteless cheap Italian rolls (you know the one that stays "fresh forever" but tastes like Styrofoam). ...seriously, the bread almost completely dulls the flavor of the remaining ingredients inside the sandwich.   The burger inside was overcooked and seriously inedibly bland. You could neither taste the beef nor the fat (much like a flip-flop). Seriously guys, step it up.  I've had better burgers at Wendy's.   The fries were okay.  Again, the same frozen stuff you find in all local spots.   Wings:  waaay overpriced at $1 per wing (double what anyone else charges, including Cluck-U)!  Despite the lack of variety in sauce styles, I went ahead an purchased an order to see what the price tag was all about.  I was disappointed by a tray of tiny dry flavorless mini-wings.   If you want the "same old" blandness offered by the cheapest spots in Central J, this place is for you.  They don't even deliver.  So I can simply order the same dishes from just about any Pizza joint in the area.   The hardest/worst part about writing this review is that the cook/staff are clean and fast.  They need to use better ingredients (meat patties, bread, etc.).
An amazing Bahn Mi Thank you Nam Nam I will definitely come back.

Good bar that has great deals on Thursday nights. Had family and friends here for my birthday a year back and the food was excellent as well. Definitely a first stop if you're in South Orange looking for a good mean and a cold beer.

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE SUMS IT UP! My guest and I walk in, it is a Wednesday at 5:45 and from the kitchen is loud spanish music playing. I ask our server about the music and she says it is "for the workers". That should have been the red flag to walk out. Are there hispanics cooking my Thai food? Stupid us stayed and placed our order. Shared dumplings for an app, they were ok, nothing great nothing bad. She had Pad Thai........chicken was DRY, no peanuts, no tofu and red onions in it?!?!?!? I don't even know if it was Pad Thai. I had a Spicy Chicken off the special border. It should have been renamed Bland Chicken and the special was UNspecial. When we asked the waitress about the issues with the Pad Thai she said "all places make it different". Whatever! DO NOT GO HERE!

Some of the best Italian food I have ever had.  I had lunch there and the special was an eggplant parm sub with a caesar salad.  I hadn't really heard much about the place so I figured they probably couldn't hurt those two things. Well, my expectations were about to me blown away.  First, best caesar I've ever had.  The cheese,dressing, perfect croutons, wow.  Then I tried my sandwich.  Absolutely perfect Italian bread, layers of thinly sliced eggplant stacked with a pillow of cheese covering it.  The sauce was mild but allowed the eggplant to shine.  Every single bite was delicious.  The sandwich was also quite large, it was a big plate of food, though not overwhelming.   The staff was also incredibly warm and kind.  One of the best dining experiences I've had in New Jersey.

The food was good. ordered the Matador and was surprised how much food came with that order! That's a good thing :) would be good for about 3- 4 people. had the Ceviche for starters and was also fantastic! Will be back.

I have been to Cuban Pete's many times but I have to say it is not like it was. Unfortunately, we went last week on a Friday. We purposely went early in order to avoid the crowd. We ordered our appetizers and our dinners at the same time... BIG mistake!! We felt extremely RUSHED because our dinners came out and we weren't even done with our appetizers!! Who does that???? Is it not customary to wait until your diners are done with their first course before you bring the next one out? Two of my friends ordered the  churrasco steak and could not even eat half of it because the meat was chewy. These are not cheap entrees either. I ordered the short ribs and there was just too much grease on my plate and in my rice. Our waiter was great and attentive but I feel the quality of this restaurant has gone down. I won't be going there anymore. If you do go don't order your apps and dinners at the same time!

Been here a few times but wasn't happy the last couple of times. So decided I would give it another shot. What a mistake... Got there at 12:45 pm lunch time. The credit card machine was not working. The "ropa Vieja" was not ready to be served to guest so I got the lechon which was raw and had no flavor and to top it off my soda was flat!!! Most likely the last time I come here. Very disappointed.

seriously AMAZED by this place! the food is basically street cart food but its such a beautiful little hidden gem of a place with thee BEST view! would definitely recommend for lunch with friends , or for a very laid back afternoon spot. food was also tasty too but DEF CANNOT BEAT THAT VIEW!!! .. oh yeah and theres beer :D

We had an 8pm reservation.  We were seated around 8:15. After ordering,  we waited quite some time; our salads were served at 9:30. Two of us ordered a salad that was supposed to have goat cheese;  however there was no cheese and the waitress disappeared so we couldn't ask about it.  When she finally showed she she apologized and said she could add it to our entrees - really? We weren't offered bread until we asked for it and by this time we were starved. The dinners were good  but not worth the wait. We try to support local businesses but they really need to work on their customer service.

Being from Southern California I was told to come here because they were one of the best cheesesteak joints in Philly. Great recommendation!! There was a long line extending out the door so I knew it had to be a good place!! Steak was thinly sliced and with Whiz  that was so nice!! Definitely will be a regular customer!!
Best sliced cheese pizza in the area! The pros are that it has a great sauce and is open late. The con is that its cash only.
Shrimp & Grits better than New Orleans. Good food. Caring service. Reasonable prices. Across from Harlem Stage a hidden performing arts treasure
world famous crabby fries!!! terrible. frozen fries sprinkled with old bay. no crab meat!!! please dont advertise crabby fries and not have crab meat on the fries. terrible.

Went there because it was the only diner like food near our hotel and the food was great along with the service.  Ordered the thanksgiving dinner and loved it. I rarely eat turkey since I don't like it as much as chicken but the turkey there was amazing. Service was courteous and didn't take forever to serve us. Would definitely come. Back here again if I am in Philadelphia

One of the bestest cocktail bars in the world! Make sure to try the Ready Fire Aim. It's delicious. Can be hard to get in. I suggest reserving a table and eating although you miss the fireworks at the bar.

The young who makes my burrito is very sweet (Everytime I go!) He's wonderful. The manager is pretty intimidating and doesn't come off very friendly. As for the food, it's a solid choice (cheap and tasty). It's way better than moes (on route 33). Plus you get free chips if you check in! Can't beat that

This place is pretty disgusting. It sucks when you go out to eat absolutely famished and it really clouds your judgement. The service was so ridiculously slow, if I hadn't been in drinking mode on a Friday night with my best friends I MIGHT have been annoyed. I digress...I ordered my burger medium well and I received it an hour later so raw it looked like it had just been butchered out in the parking lot by some kid named Rico. And what on earth is a lettuce wrap? Unfortunately, I ended up eating most of it, because like I said, the hunger. The waitress was surly and weird and I was taken aback by the fact that they pretty much bring an iPad to your table and ask you to sign off on your bill and tip right there!? What if I wanted to discuss how shitty the service was with my girlfriends first and ask what they were leaving? Awkward! Oh and I forgot how the hostess insisted on calling my friend "Alison" Steve, and pretty much yelled STEEVE in her face when we didn't get up and go to our table. I mean, Steve was before us on the list so I'd have no problem pretending to be him but that's not the point. I give this place 2 stars because it looked cool inside and they had Harpoon double IPA on tap in 16oz glasses. Other than that, save your money and TIME and skip dinner and go to Christmas Tree Shops. (They close at 9pm bt dubs)

Montclair is New Jersey's "restaurant scene" but Raymond's is Montclair's signature restaurant due to longevity and consistent quality and service, unlike so many restaurants that come and go in this town. Great for breakfast, lunch and dinner. BYOB like most Montclair restaurants, with a great wine store next door. Convenient! Saturday and Sunday brunch is always very busy and although no reservations, they do a great job accommodating the crowds. Relaxed and stylish NYC vibe. Great place to come with friends, not for a romantic dinner. I have many fav dishes here but the red beet based veggie burger is about the best VB I've tasted anywhere, very "meaty" texture and moist. Great place for 8 am business breakfasts when it is quiet and you can actually get street parking on Church Street!
Food is great everbody if your in the area or not to far to order you should try it out it's really some great food

I am sorry, but I don't get all the hype.     We ordered their #3 (sausage, broccoli rabe, ...).   It was fine, but it wasn't anything great.    We also had a spinach salad, which was also just fine fine; nothing special.  I liked the IPA they had on tap, but the pizza was just A-OK and the salad was a meh. Also, of disappointment was that we said we wanted to add mushrooms to the #3.   They said NO --- you can't add any toppings to our specialty pizzas.   This is ridiculous especially when they offer it as a topping on build your own pizzas..     Even more ridiculous is the following:  the table next to us was custom building a pizza (choosing all their own toppings), and she said they wanted spinach as a topping; the customers were told that they don't have a spinach topping, at which point the customer pointed to our table and said "they have a huge spinach salad in front of them; was that the last of the spinach?"  To which the waiter responded:  "All of the spinach we have is for salads only." These people are ridiculous.  They have mushrooms, but you can only put it on a pizza built from scratch; you can't add it to one of their specialty pizzas even if you are willing to pay for it.   They have spinach, but you can't get that on any pizza even if you are willing to pay for it.      After a 20-25 minute wait for us to be seated, and just A-OK pizza, this is dropping them from what would have been 3 stars to 2 stars due to the lack of flexibility by the restaurant with respect to toppings.
fabulous food, gorgeous design of the space and views looking at the boat basin.

A wide variety of beers but the food prices are outrageous, examples: 1) District Wings - $10 Only consist of 4 small wings and a tiny portion of salad 2) Salmon Tartare - $11 4 tiny pieces of toasted bread with little bit of salmon and two salmon roes Never coming back
