Incredibly authentic and incredible atmosphere. My group each got a different pizza and they were all delicious. They cook the pizza in a brick oven, so it was ready in no time. They recommended putting their spicy olive oil on the pizza, which was also good; not too spicy, with good flavor.

I am prompted to write this review. I have just waited 2 hrs for my takeaway. 2 hrs! That has to be takeaway first! These guys are ALWAYS late, and always have the same excuse. I am yet to speak to the manager, who my husband and I have left messages for. The food is good enough (not necessarily the best Turkish I have had), but it is definitely not worth a 2 hr wait. Even a 1hr wait is too much. Save yourself the headache and aggravation, and go somewhere else. Needless to say I won't be ordering from here ever again.

Delicious experience and I don't really like mexican food. IT was great for a tasty snack and the carne asada was beautiful. I really like this place and will go here again. Muy deliciouso!! Hah, I don't know spanish. But good place.
Delicious I had the meatball slice. Slices r huge nice and crunchy loved it!!! My bf got the Margarita slice he loved it. Great spot for late night hunger lol.

I've been going to CK in wayne since as long as I can remember.. Great takeout however, a year or two ago it changed hands and although I continued to go it was ok not great.. Last week I decided to give this new place KOI a try... Walked in and recognized one of the previous CK owners.. Ordered a bunch of takeout and I was elated... It was that "great" takeout I've been missing... So happy... Definitely will give the sushi a try on the next visit

Did they invent a portal door to transport you to Greece on 1st avenue? Nope. It's just Taverna Kyclades. My favorite (and now the only) Greek restaurant in New york. Oh and yeah, complimentary dessert.
just love it.....always good....hope they have more variety of appetizers than just the 65 series

Just landed in NYC first stop- Table 57! Quaint restaurant that embodies what we love about NYC- great pasta - atmosphere just what we love as well. Highly recommend!

My husband and I were at a law school reunion weekend.  I'm a pizza lover and had a list with me from The Daily Meal of the "101 Best Pizzas in America."  We had three uncommitted meals and my plan was to go to the top three rated pizzerias in New Haven, as per this list.  Thursday night was Frank Pepe's for its white clam pizza, rated the best pizza in America.  Lunch on Friday was supposed to be Sally's tomato pie because it was rated # 5 on the list, but it was not open for lunch so we went to the third most highly rated pizzeria in New Haven (according to this list) - Modern Apizza.  The pizza that was supposed to be #12 on the list was the Italian Bomb so we ordered that and a salad.  The waiter recommended the Caesar salad.  The Caesar Salad was not a Caesar.  The dressing wasn't right and it had lots of extraneous flavors, including some black, supermarket-quality canned olives.  Croutons were good, but the mélange of rye, wheat and white croutons confused the palate, and the cucumbers and tomatoes that were included in the overly chilled concoction detracted, rather than enhanced, the improperly chopped up romaine..    Now for the pizza - an abomination.  There was so much undercooked bacon on the pizza that I could not taste the really delicious Italian sausage.  It was a total bacon grease bomb with a pasty, undercooked crust that really tasted raw.  Now, I realize that perhaps we got an undercooked one and I started to take the toppings off and pile them up on the edges of the pizza that were properly cooked to the right degree since they had no toppings on them. Pretty soon, I had a plate of dough left.  My husband didn't want me to say anything (he's so polite!) but I did tell the waiter that the crust was undercooked.  He said I should have told him earlier, and he was right.  To his credit, he offered to cook us a new one, but we are staying in a hotel so it wasn't any use to us and I declined.  Also, I wasn't quite  convinced they could really make a good pizza since they used canned mushrooms -- Can you imagine - canned mushrooms in this day and age???!!! I will say, though, the tomato sauce and the fennel sausage that they used were good.  After this, I'm sorry to say that we didn't have the desire to sample Sally's tomato pie Friday night.  It wasn't within walking distance of our hotel and we didn't want to drive to it, wait in line and then perhaps be disappointed.  I have a nagging feeling that I'll regret it, however!

=== Your wait time is: 30 minutes. === This is something I wish we had been told, prior to nonchalantly placing our order for a basic pork torta. Half an hour's time is something you'd expect from customer service, when you're calling in to cancel your cable subscription, but not a food truck, am I correct? I don't know about you, but I've always thought that a food truck equates to lightning-fast grub on wheels. With that said, you'd require more than the mere patience of the Dalai Lama, if deciding to give Taquería Auténtica Food Truck a whirl. To worsen matters further for us two customers growing increasingly impatient as each were hungry, they exchanged worrisome looks when having spotted the cook on board, failing to remove his gloves while handling the money, along with all else. Just imagine what has touched your taco shells in the process. (Sir, if you would kindly check the paper slip on which you had so hastily scribbled upon, I did not order a side of food poisoning.) What baffled us, was that the tortas were simply sitting there after they were done cooking on the grill. It was only when the cook caught us eyeing him like a hawk, that he finally decided to wrap it up. Cut to five minutes later, we were handed our food, the aluminum foil covered with smudges of guacamole, as though a child had decided to do some last minute finger-painting on it. Thank you, and have a messy day. The other Yelpers here are precisely correct, when they say that the operator is disorganized and unable to find anything within his grasp. Perhaps he could pay a much needed visit to IKEA to attain nifty ideas for tidying up? Not only is their service in need of desperate improvement, but the system by which orders are handled, needs a complete restructuring. If they wish to build a loyal base of customers, they need to forget everything they've ever learned and start again from scratch. As for the pork torta itself, the sandwich was nothing so remotely divine that I'd risk acquiring sunburn on a hot summer day. ¡Sí Señor! Taquería, as it turns out, was not "Auténtica" enough for this chica.

I was excited to try this place but left a little underwhelmed. Perhaps expectations were too high. We ordered two appetizers and one main course to share for two, which was actually quite filling. The best dish was the crab over spaghetti, which was pleasantly unusual. The other appetizer was the octopus salad, which was nothing special. The restaurant itself is a little room. Some reviews here have called it nice and quaint, but to me it really just felt like an incomplete room. I wouldn't base any decision to come here on this, in either direction. Service was great though, and the waitresses were very knowledgeable and friendly.

We dined at Cafe Matisse tonight and the entire experience was wonderful. We were greeted warmly at the door by Larry, who acknowledged my note in the reservation that it was our fifth anniversary by seating us at a cozy corner table with a view of the dining room. All of the servers were friendly, informative, and attentive throughout the meal. We each did a 4-course meal that was very well-timed. We began with the beet salad tart, which was a festival of flavors that you might not normally expect from a seemingly straightforward dish. This tart was exceptional and the perfect way to begin our meal. We moved on to the lamb "carpaccio" and the sliced Muscovy duck, both of which were also excellent with layered flavors that made each bite more interesting and delicious than the previous.  We finished with the Matisse burger, which was perfect and luxe, and frankly, better than any "gourmet" burger I've eaten in NYC.  Dessert did not disappoint either--the banana cream pie was heavenly--even though we were full we couldn't stop eating it. The one note that was slightly out of tune was the flourless chocolate cake, which itself was wonderful and would have been preferable with a simple complementary ice cream rather than the peanut butter mascarpone, banana, and melted whipped cream combination, which just missed the mark. All in all, the meal was a real treat for us and a wonderful way to spend our celebratory evening. We will definitely be returning!

Their rice is undercooked, to the point that it is almost crunchy, and their "sesame seed chicken" is just a pile of goo slop. Their chicken is the lowest quality garbage a restaurant can serve, it is like 95% breading and rubbery chicken chunks in the center. They also served me some brown chicken wings from being cooked in oil that was almost black when I walked in. Totally disgusting and you can tell they never eat the food they cook. Go to imperial wok in New Haven. They have been there for 30 years and cook excellent Chinese food. Stay away from dirty China chef!

Lovely staff. Delicious food. Amazing atmosphere. The best dish there is Jambalaya and Eggs. I am not sure why people are saying that it was not seasoned enough. I found it to be perfect. Also their coffee is good, which is important for a brunch place. Highly recommend!
I will pass.
Love this place! Even though they have VERY bad communication on taking order. I ordered the pollo frito and it's awesome.

Eventually... My burger was very good, as were the truffle fries.  The staff, not so much... Hostess was on the phone, and we had to wait to be seated.  Table next to us was seated a few minuets later, was served drinks, and bread, before we were even greeted.  Our waiter forgot one of the drinks, and my order came out wrong.
Still a good steak @ a great price service is really young but really try hard See you guys soon.

My family and I visited Talk of the Town recently and we were very pleased! The owner was very helpful and courteous. Restaurant was clean and had many small tables. By the time we left it was packed! It, of course, featured a Bollywood movie playing on a TV for everyone's entertainment. We ordered 2 samosa, aloo tikki chaat and gobi paratha. My daughter (4) had some basmati rice and dahi, with a few tastes of our spicier selections. The chaat was seriously delicious and I think next time we will order more of that. Paratha was also very good. It wasn't dry and it had a nice spice level (even being mild, lol!) and the raita and pickle were super tasty.  I would say the samosa was just alright, perhaps it's more of a south Indian type style that I am not used to. Sauces on the side were spiced nicely. We wanted to order dessert but we were very full; next time. Thank you!
Excellent food! It's been a long time I had such flavorful food. We had 6 different dishes and all of them were very delicious. A must go place for Foodies who love Indian food.

Too bad...was a great place once, but since this Summer food has gone way down...ie. pizza delivered half-cooked and cheese topping comes watery. Phone order takers incompetent and rude. Moving on and searching for new place....I hear Ruthie's in Montclair makes a yumo coal-oven pizza ..,Yum!!

Came for Thursday dinner with my female friend. They gave us the separate table in the worst imaginable place in spite of the fact there were other empty tables, around 5-6 . When we asked for a different place, we were told everything else was reserved (???). We decided to leave... Sorry but restaurant experience is not about food quality but service as well..

I love Thai food, and Brookside is very authentic. Meals are cooked to order, so it takes a while to get your meal. I appreciate that. Went there on a rainy Monday night and took advantage of the 2/$20 special. One appetizer to share (crispy noodles with shrimp), 1 chicken pad thai, 1 vegetarian wide noodles. It was really delicious, and I asked for some spicy sauce on the side. Wow! It was homemade and fiery. One quibble: I had ordered hot tea. When asked for another cup, was given tepid water to use on existing green tea bag. That's cheap and chintzy to me. Service was adequate if not friendly. I will definitely go back there. Too bad they don't deliver, at least to Montclair. Blocks away? Weird.

My son and I were at birra last night and I can't say enough about the fabulous wait staff.  They all left such a positive impression which is unusual for most restaurants. Such a friendly bunch of people! The food  was wonderful as usual too!

Dishes have to be cleaner. At beginning the food were good and now they more like slacking of making them. In order to have more customers, they have to be more consistent. Make sure you dump all of the left over like hot & sour peppers etc. They will bring it out for the next customer. Sometime there is hair in the food.

This is easily one of the best restaurants in Montclair. We always get the meat sampler and are never disappointed with the quality of the food!  The hibiscus tea is also delicious. It's the perfect place to grab food before or after heading to the movies or the Wellmont. We have also brought our 2-year-old for lunch and she enjoyed sharing with us as well!

My favorite restaurant in jersey. From the quality of the food, the relaxing atmosphere and of course best customer service. I love their calamari, seaweed salad and you have got to try their ceviche! Their sushi is soo fresh and yummy. Coming from california - i have tried many sushi places.. and honestly,  this is the best sushi place i have tried. It's also BYOB. I love this place!

After waiting 18 minutes just for someone to ask us if we had ordered yet, we finally got some drinks and placed our food orders. I ordered the biscuits and gravy. The breakfast came out 45 minutes later. The biscuits were cold and stale - I had to use a knife to saw them apart. The gravy was cold and had begun to solidify. The eggs were cold. The hash browns were somewhat warm and alright. My friend's breakfast sandwich came out completely wrong. We had to flag someone down to get a refill - mine never came. We made sure to ask for the check as soon as we got our food. There were only a couple of donuts left - they were pretty good, even though we were given the wrong one again. Horrible service, awful food. Would not recommend.

Unfortunately, I am not at all impressed with my experience here.  The exterior/interior finish work looks great and would invite a pleasant experience.  With that said, the bartender service is severely mediocre as they were very unprofessional and disparaging.  I'm hoping this was a one time occurrence, but the consistent negative attitude received would tell otherwise.
Came here for the chicken/ waffles. Chicken was great but waffles, pancakes, fruit toppings, sticky tables, dirty utensils and everything else sucked.

Upon arrival we sat ourselves at the counter and were alone for awhile until the owner or whoever it was came to take our orders and then quickly went into the back room. We got kind of grossed out and scared when the homeless man sitting to next got up to the other side of the kitchen and started grabbing the food and thought he was the chef. He used his bare hands to grab an entire cucumber and found a knife to slice it basically helping himself to everything. The owner finally comes out and tells the homeless guy he can't be back there. The food was ok nothing special and the entire place lacked cleanliness.

Hue is my favorite spot for food off campus. Their Korean tacos are delicious and the chicken teriyaki is the best around. I have tried a lot of their other food and it's all good. All of the staff are really friendly. I'd recommend any Temple student check out Hue.
Seriously one of the best apple pies I've ever had. The cinnamon in the pie is unbelievable!

I absolutely love this restaurant & it's servers, managers and all. They all played a big part of the success of my boyfriend's 24th surprise birthday dinner. The food was amazing, all of it . I do not like fish but their fish is absolutely amazing. My waiter Alexis has to be the sweetest, patient, and helpful person I've come across. The manager Lance, & assistant manager Matthew are amazing . Even the security personnel made sure we were all set and satisfied. They hospitality a whole new meaning . Definitely will return
I thought this was really good. It's a pizzeria within walking distance of the Element Harrison. The Sicilian Slice was good, but I also really liked the plain old pie.
Very slow service. Was waiting for food for over an hour. Food just ok. Not worth the money. Waste of evening.

This place deserves ABSOLUTELY NO STAR at all!! This has been the worst  experience ever. The food was absolutely disgusting and the service was horrible. I wouldn't eat this again, ever! I was with 4 of my friends and WE ALL agree it was the worst! We are Hispanic and trust me we know what good Spanish food taste like & this by farthest was the most disgusting ! We were definitely un please!

good vibe and food were nice, only the music was too loud for me.  We ordered two drinks, one bimbimbab, one spicy chicken pot with rice, and 1 dozen dollar oysters and the total was only $67! The oysters were very fresh.
I went here for brunch last week and I absolutely loved it. The food was great and the coffee was pretty good. The service was decent. It was very busy and the food was incredible.

Got us in and we sat for 40 minutes at table The water person came by 4 times to offer water. Never saw waitress although asked for her Got up and left no one even cares it approached us to ask why we are leaving Very bad never had an issue like this at a Resturant

Nice surprise at this place. Fantastic wings and pizza. And the real surprise was the price. Excellent food + excellent price + excellent service equals fantastic experience!  And on top of that they will deliver. I found my new spot.

Went here for my birthday and had an awful experience. The staff was extremely rude to us. Before ordering drinks, we asked if the five of us could have separate checks and were told they would only split it 3 ways because "it's a pain in the ass". Meaning, they were 100% capable of doing it but just didn't feel like it. While we talked over how we could pay on one bill(only 1 of us had cash) the waiter angrily told us that he'd split the check 5 ways but to note that they don't normally do that. We said thank you and waited for our meal. The food was okay but nothing great. He came back and threw the checks on the table. My bill was a little over $13 and I gave $15 and asked for change so I could give him a bigger tip. He came back with our bills and threw them down on the table and said "thanks for not tipping, we really appreciate it"  and stormed off. I looked down and notice he gave me my change in all coins. Really? We just got our change/cards back and you're already saying that? MY friends with cards didn't even have a chance to fill out the tip portion of the receipt. Then, a girl, we assume was the manager, came over to us, bent over and said "did you guys really threaten to leave if we didn't split your checks?" we all looked around confused and told her no because those words never came out of our mouths. She continued to ask us  "really? you didn't? um are you sure?" we assured her we didn't and she goes "well just know its kind of a new york city thing so yeah" in the most sassy tone and walked away. What kind of customer service is that?

First of all, it's a buffet, so don't expect a 5 star service, as all the employees are Chinese and barely speak English. However, they are efficient at doing their job. The food is 50/50... You've got to pick and choose what you eat. For the price, you actually get crab legs, crawfish, shrimp, different meats, and the choice is nice enough that you'll find something you like. On weekends, they have the chocolate fountain, and that is worth anything really. I've been going there for the past 7 years and I don't plan on stopping. I can also say that they are extremely clean, as I've been there at the closing time, and I was surprised to see how they cleaned the closed section. It was an eye opening for me. I could give 5 stars, but things could be improved, like the grill section where food items stay out at the ambient temperature, and that can't be good for the food...

10/25/2014 around 7PM The service itself didn't make me want to go back again. We didn't actually have a meal there. Just some lemon drinks. My gf really liked it. A little sweet for me. Anyway we walked up to the counter and asked for the menu. My gf asked "Can we take the menu and take a look?" She doesn't even answer. So we just sat down looking at the menu and ordered. We were both facing the street and she didn't even tell us that the drinks were ready. And when we we were done with the drinks and wanted to know where I can throw it away I asked the other girl who was in a conversation with her coworker. She was so annoyed and was like "WHAT?" With a frown as if I described to her the most disgusting thing in the world. WT*? Anyway I wasn't really going to post the review until there were 3 strikes. I was really surprised to see that there were no reviews about the service. Either it's me being used to kind Arizona service or somehow both of them are not Asian-friendly(which one's better)? Oh and they both were wearing a fedora. It must be the fedora.

So where to begin? I took my fiancé here for our date night last Thursday (10/23). I had previously eaten here with friends and I thought service and food were great. This past Thursday, however, this was not the case. The food, of course, was great. The service, not quite there yet. We arrived before 7 without a reservation. We had previously called to make one but they no longer had room, so they told us to arrive before 7. Once we get there, we are told there is a 45 minute wait, but that's okey. We give them our phone number and go for a walk. In exactly that time they call us and we come back for our dinner. The dinner was very good, we ordered a carafe of sake and two dinner sets. The service was very good all this while. We finished our food in around an hour. Granted that by this time it was 8.30. Meaning we ate all of our meal in under an hour. We still had half a carafe of sake, tea and water. My fiancé and I were pleased to this point but out of the blue one of the hostesses, the American one, not the Japanese one, approaches us and says: "um guys I'm gonna need this table there are people waiting". I found this appalling. We had already payed. Almost a hundred dollars. We tipped over 20% because we found it to be that good (our waitress). And, after all this, only being an hour at the table, I am asked to leave? Like this? This was not enough for them, one of the busboys was hovering our table for the very uncomfortable 15 minutes we remained after what the hostess said to us. It made the whole experience, and our date night, a very uncomfortable situation. They ruined it. It is a big surprise that this is the way they treated us in a Japanese restaurant, an authentic one at that, where service is usually excellent.   Needless to say, I will not be coming back. Really sad, because the food is good. It is in my neighborhood, my work, my school and my gym are in a 4 block radius.
There is nothing better than sharing good food in a comfortable atmosphere with the people you care about. So enjoy the wonderful food and the atmosphere with a friend. Had a great time.
Very delicious and fresh. Both the shredded chicken and beef in my dish we cooked perfectly. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for Mexican cuisine.

I ordered online, they delivered it really fast, food was good, delivery man is extremely friendly, than it made me sick the whole day, I ended up chained to my toilet for the remainder of the evening, But there is a second chance for everything, I just would really have to think twice before i order again
the first and the best
I love the scallops, thats what I get when I come here, I just wanted to give them a shout for the great customer service. will go again her: yelp.com/biz/chattime-ph… again.

This places food was down right gross!!!  I purchase a pizza, pasta dinner, and chicken fingers.  Pizza was okay, not really made greasy.  Penn Vodka was just pasta with a little ricotta and barley and sauce that was horrific.  Chicken was so salty I took a bite and couldn't eat anymore.  Even worse it was very high prices.  $50.00 plus dollars for just that.  I don't mean to be rude or disrespectful.  I am just trying to be honest.  On a plus side delivery service was great.

The roast pork is AMAZING; the taste, the texture, the smell....it's the best, if you like tuna fish. Save yourself the disappointment, avoid this spot and go explore the countless other places that are worth your time in Park Slope.

Best Pizza in the Upper Valley, New England, USA..the World!!! Locally owned and operated, he caters to the people here in the valley with great pride. Great staff, great experience inside, takeout or delivery....you'll love it...
Been there twice and both times had great pizza.  Friendly service too.  Will be going again soon.  Fantastic place.

Absolutely awful restaurant! We had a large party, seriously took about half of the restaurant, booked well in advance. They only had one bartender (who was seriously amazing, just really overworked) one waiter for probably 30 of us until we complained. Over an hour to just get drinks, food came out an interesting combination of burned on the outside and undercooked on the inside. Don't waste your time!

Service gets an A+, but it was not a busy night.  Food gets a C-. For a party of 8, most was well prepared, but a couple of the salmon dishes were not cooked completely.  the crab stuffing was so spicy it masked the other flavors in the dish.  And they charged a 23% tip on food & tax.

I'm not sure what happened to this place. I've been eating here since they opened, but things seemed to be sliding a bit. I love the apps. The main courses are really generously portioned. But they've cut back on the happy hour and seriously raised the beer prices. Why? But really, this is the reason for the one star review: If I'm going to go to a place that serves an almost $20 hamburger, is it too much to expect clean bathrooms? It's really gross to sit through the rest of dinner with urine on your shoes. They have rugs in the hallway outside the bathrooms--I imagine so you can wipe your feet after using the toilet. Disgusting. And, unfortunately, this has been my experience in my last three visits (I keep going back thinking they might just manage to clean the bathrooms). The last time I was there, the bathroom I used had no soap, which is troubling because I saw a member of the staff leave that bathroom and then serve people food.

Omg! I'm literally sitting here in a state of bliss after my meal. I popped in with my friend who is visiting from out of town and we were starving after running errands all day. We were seated promptly in the beautiful sun room in the back. The waiter informed us of the specials which included mushrooms stuffed with crabmeat....amazing!!! We enjoyed our appetizer and then had the zuppa di pesce which was full of scallops, Shrimp, mussels and calamari in a marinara sauce. Great food, service (Danielle and Blake are awesome!) and atmosphere. What else could a girl want? I'm really looking forward to bringing my colleagues and family here in the future. Also, the owner and manager Noemi is a GEM :)

It is a good place to have options of variety of indian food. I love the indo-chinese food here. The best part of this food court is that they make fresh food for you after you order it so it is hot and steaming while you eat it or take it home. Great place to pick up food on your way home.

Onze vrienden die in New York wonen boekten deze plek voor het diner. Reserveringen waren een paar dagen van tevoren gemaakt en het was een van de weinige plaatsen die plaatsen beschikbaar had. Algemeen was de maaltijd was heerlijk! Ik at niet een van de hapjes want ze hadden vlees in hen en ik ben vegetariër, maar de rest was erg goed. toilet zijn een beetje vuil

Een must als je houdt van authentieke Italiaanse gerechten. De sfeer is ok, maar het eten is geweldig. We hebben Italië meerdere malen bezocht en dit was zeer authentiek. We probeerden het degustatiemenu en genoten van elk gerecht geserveerd. leuke plaats !!

We stumbled upon this place in our search for breakfast after our go-to place had too many people--and we were so happy we did! As New Jerseyans we take breakfast very seriously, and Our House did not disappoint. Extensive and interesting menu, so much so that we HAVE to come back before we go home. Coffee was spectacular, breakfast was on point, and the cocktail menu is unlike anything you've ever heard. Lots of vegetarian/vegan options too :-)
I had the best kale/quinoa salad at this place. I'm trying to replicate it at home now.

I prefer Pat's over the other one, The cheese steaks are lovely, they taste great. you can smell the air and tell that it is a good spot to grab a steak. I go every time I am in the area and have a taste for cheese steak.
I loved it! It is a small place but so cozi!!!!!! The food is so good! I try to go every weekend.

It is a nice place with horrible hostesses. The waiters, bartenders are okay. Hostesses are terrible. When you call to make a reservation, they hang up on you. If you are a minute late, your table is given to someone else. Yes, 1 minute.  But again, the food is good, drinks are really nice. But they need more friendly hostesses.

You gotta have the crab BLT with avocado. It's sufreakingpurb. All the parts come together perfectly with the bread and $2 sides. I'm tempted to get one of their crab taco sauces in it next time like the lemon aoli or wasabi mayo. Nice owner Fifi and good chowder and buttery crab rolls too. Already naming the next visit.
Uncooked paneer appetizers, biryani = white rice mixed into older biryani masala, trying to cover up stale food into too much spice! I'm so glad we have other options in parsippany now!
Waiting nearly ten mins before leaving due to the servers lack of interest in making money. Place is also dated and in need of a deep clean as it smells a bit funky.
First place in the Upper Valley to make a real latte, and they even did it with almond milk. I *heart* the Tuckerbox

Currently a limited drink menu but my waitress was able to have the bartender make the drink i love!  so awesome of her and my tip reflected my appreciation!  it took a while (10+ mins) for my waitress to greet me when she delivered water and chips, but they had only been open a few days so I know there are some kinks to work out.  table was super wobbly (lack of attention to detail).  tacos were good.  I'll be going again soon for sure.  it's very close to my work so it has the potential to be a weekly $40 tradition, hope they work out the kinks and fix that table.
Wow. Amazing. My wife is Chinese American and knows her dim sum. Great dumplings baos and pancakes. Service was good and just the right amount of surly. Love this place.

Good service. Bartender doesn't take food order which was fine. Waitress was pleasant to deal with. Food is so so. Really watered down French onion soup and they messed up my order of side vegetable. Good atmosphere.

Have never had a complaint when getting a sandwich from here! Staff are always super fast and friendly! They have never messed up a sub they made for me! I also love their potato chips and their chocolate chip cookies! So delicious every time! Highly recommend! I hope more jimmy johns pop up around New Jersey!

One of the best street meat in the area! I haven't been to their sit down location but i have been to their midtown location. I'm really surprised how good and different theirs is compared to everyone elses.  My favorite however is Rafikis. I feel it s more healthy but who am I kidding? THe hot sauce is out of this world!

I have one word to say about this place AMAZING I recently went into this fantastic bee pizza place next door to the prudential center, I had the spinch mushroom gorgonzola pizza WOW and my friends had the clam casino pizza and the sausage mushroom pizza what an incredible addition the downtown and a place that we will be regulars at, my new favorite place to go, the pizza is rhe best I have ever had in the united states its that good
the beef hand drawn noodle, skewered lamb bbq, and spicy pig ears were amazing!!! i would definitely come back and try other dishes SOON!!!!;D

I sat at the counter and got very quick service. I ordered roast pork with broccoli rabe and provolone. It's a very juicy sandwich so stock up on napkins. It's overall pretty good. However if I'm comparing it to some others in the area it gets beaten out by John's Roast Pork and Tony Luke's. But if you're in Reading Terminal, it's not a bad option at all.

Being fans of Le Virtu for years my wife and I were eagerly anticipating Brigantessa's opening. We walked in on a Monday evening about a week after they opened and were greeted right away. Even though it was fairly busy we were offered seating immediately; a choice of upstairs or down across from the bar. We sat downstairs and looked over the menu. We both work in the biz so we expected that they would still have some wrinkles to iron out. It took a bit for the server to notice us but once he did the service was good, if a bit sporadic. I believe he was the bartender as well and this caused him to overlook us several times. But I don't really want to review the service one week into opening, they will get into their groove soon enough. We ordered the octopus and artichokes to start. The artichokes were very good, with a nice dusting of bread crumbs, a hint of lemon and crispy capers. They were a nice size and great to share. The octopus on the other hand was not a good value. The flavors were decent but the dish had three tiny, less than an inch long, pieces of octopus. It consisted of 90% beans and some nice pickled onion. The Margherita pizza we received for dinner had to be among the most disappointing dishes I've had in a while. I'm sure there is a reason behind the preparation; the traditional style of presentation and the minimalist ingredients, but with a fantastic new oven as a main focus of the place I expected better. The dough was chewy and very lightly browned. The four pieces of mozzarella on it slid off the top in one bite; it wasn't that warm and as such the cheese stayed in big clumps and never fully melted. With the kind pizza being made in Philly today, Zavino, Stella, you really need to be at the top of your game. This pie did not do it for us. As I said we love Le Virtu and since we live in the neighborhood we'll be back. I just hope some of the pretensions can be dropped and the menu worked out.
Uzbekistani comfort food?  YES!  The lamb pilaf is so delicious and their pumpkin samosas are enormous.  Easily the best place to eat in McGinley Sq.

Listen to me and listen to me well. This place is the absolute best Italian food in the area. I work at Pugliese Kitchen & Bath and we order from this place at least once a week and they do not disappoint. Try it out for yourself. You will not be let down

Having recently returned from my maiden voyage to India, I found myself craving something reminiscent of the wondrous weeks I spent in India. Much to my surprise, I discovered this little eatery only blocks from job! The food, while not being as flavorful as other Indian restaurants, is tolerable for its price. However, as with another reviewer I did find myself falling ill on 2 occasions after eating there several weeks apart. This was especially strange because I have no history of becoming sick from food. More disturbingly, the men working in and patronizing this spot don't seem to be especially respectful of women. Every time I visited, the employees and patrons would overtly ogle my body and make lurid comments about their admiration for my figure. I often feel that we as women are implicitly encouraged to tolerate sexual harassment. However, I choose to be one less. I'm no longer spending my hard-earned money in places where I'm not afforded the respect I'm entitled to because of my gender. And the food at Dil-e Punjab Deli is not impressive enough to challenge my conviction.
Oh yeah this place is doing it right. Steak is good, cheese has flavor, bread is toasted. All in all a steak sandwich done right. Tip: bring cash, cash only.
Certainly not the best anymore but an "institution" none the less.

Food was absolutely amazing but waiting on the waiters took for ever! Had my table waiting for about 30minutes until the waiter showed up with just drinks then another hour for the food. After that the waiter didnt show up until we were literally done with the food.

Come on this is not a Japanese restaurant or a sushi bar. It's just a normal fast food with some Japanese style name. if you come here to find some sashimi you will really disappointed. I hate California roll.

We stopped in for a quick breakfast and were very impressed not only with the selection but the food itself. Great bagels, great cream cheeses. Can't wait to go back for more. The staff was friendly and fast even though the line was out the door.

There's no good reason you haven't been here yet. Cantina is that spot no matter what season it is. Most people come here in the summer to sit in their huge outdoor area. I think they might sometimes allow small dogs but definitely not larger dogs. Be prepared to wait for drinks. (Their bar is extremely small and I don't think you could fit more than 2 people back there to make drinks.) it's like being in Mexico... In south philly. Ask for will, d, or mark if you're at the bar. They're the sh*t. They have great margaritas and do awesome pitcher specials if you go for happy hour. I go here about once a month and I've never had a bad experience. Food is decent, may be a little overpriced. Definitely almost spent $20 on a burrito recently. I wish the menu would change more frequently. Tequila flights are serious! Get them! Drink the Bloody Mary type nonsense they give you. It's spicy but incredible. I have two complaints about this place. If you sit at the bar in the winter time you have to keep your jacket on because it's so damn cold. Two, change the God damned jukebox!!!!!! Lady gaga has been on there for over a year!!! That is embarrassing!!! And most of the other stuff sucks!!! Seriously! Change it immediately! I'd rather listen to morse code!!!

2nd time I chose Sweet Afton for brunch in one week. Last Sunday my boyfriend and I had brunch there but our waitress was strange and was super condescending and dismissive---Okay-everyone has a bad day. One week later my friends are in town and all four of us met for brunch and again I chose Sweet Afton- last week they had a great Pumpkin Ale on tap and I wanted another. Anyway, same waitress (Adrian) this time she was blatantly rude to my friends, dismissive and basically ignored our requests. Zero customer service. She actually talked over my friend who was trying to get information on their breakfast burger Adrain again made another rude comment. Very strange to treat customers so poorly. After our food came one of my friends asked for hot sauce (Adrian was over by the bar shooting the shit with another employee and ignored his request). He ended up at the bar to get some from the bartender(who was rude too). Guess it's their vibe but News Flash Sweet Afton--It's never cool to treat customers so rudely. Especially when you serve such mediocre food. Don't waste your money here. Not until Adrian gets some training in customer service. Totally disappointing twice from start to finish.

This is the 1st time I have ever taken the time to write a review...I went last night for the first time, the service was actually the worst I've ever gotten. We walked in and there were some really nice booths and an empty one we expected to be seated at since all the other occupants were pairs of two, instead she sat us as a table by itself off to the side that was old and broken and looked dirty. When I asked to sit at the both she said no sorry because more people might come...????? Whatever, so this place doesn't allow you to buy individual rolls, i think it's exclusively all you can eat which is weird, but they threw down some paper checklists and didn't explain anything to us, it was 10 minutes before we could find a waitress to explain to us how the menu works. We finally order and the sushi isn't bad but it's not amazing, I would say it was good for an all you can eat establishment. We ordered mango and avocado and the mango was not ripe, it was still white and hard with no flavor whatsoever. The food did come out very quickly though. After we finished our first round we wanted to make another order, when we FINALLY got hold of another waitress she gave us more paper checklists, we waited for 30 minutes before she came back with our check? We told her we never got our second order of food, turns out they had forgotten and of course no one checks on your table so you have to wait for someone to walk by. With all that being said, I might give this place another try just because the price was decent compared with the quality of food and the options you have, the all you can eat menu includes soups, salads, teriyaki, desserts, etc. But at least next time I'll be more prepared to deal with terrible service.

If you want to be in the area of the Philly Sports Complex but you don't want to pay all the money for tickets, this is a great place to go. The signature crab fries are great and the chicken wings are great also. The environment in the restaurant on game night is like none other, so I'd recommend going here if you're a philly sports fan.

This brunch was absolutely delicious. Although the place was crowded, the waitress and host were attentive and on top of our orders. The breakfast burrito lived up to expectations, and the tater tots were an unusual but absolutely welcomed side!

I took my mom to Puerto Viejo on Saturday night, we were very impressed with the place. From start to finish we had a pleasurable experience, the food, the service and the ambiance was excellent. I will go back  again.

Absolutely Terrible Service... Stopped by for a bagel.  They were not busy and I was the only one at the counter. I waited 10 minutes to be served and then left out of frustration. Of the 3 staff members I saw working, only 1 was helping customers.  One was doing some with the coffee machines and chatting with the person making sandwiches, and the other one was talking with his friends.  They didn't care I was there.  No one even acknowledge I was standing there.  A simple 'Hello, we'll be with you in one minute" would have made all the difference...but it was like I wasn't even there. So what good does a quality product do, when the staff is rude and they don't help their customers? This is the first yelp review I've written.  I found this experience so frustrating that I had to share it.  I actually go into the Bagel Market fairly frequently and the service has consistently been problematic...but this really is a whole new level of bad.

I recently went to a wedding here and was very impressed with the food /service and atmosphere. My boyfriend and I decided we needed to come back for a date night.  Which we did.  Christine was our server and she was absolutely delightful.  Not only was she friendly,  but knowledgeable and informative about the menu and history of the restaurant. We were so happy to be out on a  date night on a Saturday (being in the service industry it was a big deal...)... So every moment was special.  She helped it to be that way.  Service was efficient,  timing on food was efficient and our experience was wonderful.  Not only were we treated wonderfully,  but also were served a faux paus of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries.  Thank you Christine and Mill on the River for making our night out so memorable and special.  We will definitely be back.

The perfect dive on south street. Love everything from the color of the walls to the vintage furniture to the bumper cars to the amazing jukebox. It's cheap for south street. Punks cook your damn food. It's fried and it's cheap. The bathrooms smell really weird but just deal with it. Pool table upstairs. Just go

So far been here for #40mins. Its Sunday brunch, I didnt know they took reservations, I didn't know we had TONS of people in front of the two of us. I'm usually better about that sort of thing but, I was reading. The hostess here...I have to say once I walked I felt that she didnt know how to seat people...could be because of the reservations, idk but her communication just is non-existent. I just found out "as soon as they pay their check" we will be seated... Question: Who da hell takes reservations for BRUNCH! WHO!!!! they are looking a lot of money. Im sitting by the door watching over 15 people walk out the space is very small and the hostess clearly doesn't know how yo maximize the use of it. The food...I guess is good people aren't leaving though outside turns over quickly because its chilly out but the inside 50+ mins now and one table (communal table two people) have left. if I get seated in 5 mins ill let you know about food and wait staff service...
Purchased the 16 course sushi + sake groupon and was SO pleased. the staff was amazing and personal and the food was delightful! I can't wait to go back!

Good ideas, but poor execution. We showed up, told the waitress our reservation and that we needed a parking pass. She proceeded to give us the pass and then forgot to show us to our table. So we seated ourselves. The wine (the list is about ten pages) I ordered had gone sour (she had just opened the bottle, she said, but hadn't tasted it). My wife's salad hadn't been washed, there were bad leaves and sand in it. The steak wasn't done as we'd ordered it. The food was otherwise tasty, and the martini was good. I could have made better at home and hired someone to to the dishes for less though. Maybe it was just the waitress. There was only one for the whole place.

Went there for dinner (made a reservation for two). Started off with the Stuffed Meatballs (even though it only comes with 2 meatballs, they're big enough) and in my opinion, it's pretty worth it! Wanted to try the pork rines everyone was raving about but was told they took it off the menu :( (oh well!) We also got the Grilled Mediterranean Octopus dish and it was delicious!! - along with the Beastia pizza (for any meat lovers out there). Was too full to try their desserts which sounded awesome but will definitely be back soon to try their Salted Caramel Budino! --The only negative thing I have to say about this place is that some of the tables are way too close to each other, I mean, yeah, it is a small restaurant but they are inches away from each other and gives you barely any privacy (you can hear everyones conversations). We were sat at a table and there was another table for two that was  just inches away from our table and it was really tight. I guess for next time I can put in a special request for a table that's a bit isolated and not 3 inches from another table.   Overall, this is a great place to try if you want Mediterranean food.

Burger was decent, but small. For a burger, fries and a shake, I paid $20. They were out of vanilla custard... The water cups are about 4 oz... Customer service is not a strength here. Unfortunately, great food is not either.

The risotto is very good. Service is excellent. Small place that does a good job making you comfortable. I've tried 5 of their risottos and enjoyed all of them. The pizza is good but I wouldn't go there for that since Johns pizza is on the same block and is one of the best.

This place was seriously the only breakfast place that seemed to be open on a Monday morning! Then again it was pretty early. However! The breakfast food definitely hit the spot. I ordered a Western omelet and hash browns. The hash browns were really perfect. I mean soft yet crunchy, not burnt or overly crispy. This place seems like a whatever, mediocre/average place to grab food but I think it's worth checking out to satisfy any breakfast needs. It definitely satisfied mine! I also ordered a coffee. It was affordable, quick, and portions were generous. Go if you're in the area!

The worst... We waited for 1.5 hours while other ppl were seated before us. They kept saying they were getting the table together and never was really. Manager was less helpful, after 2 hrs we left and got Wendy's up the road. There was no sympathetic as we had 7 kids with us who were very hungry. If they could not accommodate they should have been honest about the expectations. They were however very accommodating to all the other bigger white parties. Will never come here. Will report to head quarters.

My fiance and I visit this location quite frequently.  It is by far one of our fave places to go for date nights.  Not only because the food is amazing.  they are well known for there rolls and butter.   our reason for going back time after time is the amazing staff.  I do not think we have ever gotten the same waiter twice.  However, we have always had beyond excellent service.  I dont recall ever having to ask for my drink to be refilled they just bring a refill right away.  always friendly and upbeat. I would say we have been here about ten times or so, never getting same wait staff yet always getting the same phenomenal service as the last.   texas roadhouse at this location has done a wonderful job hireling the best of the best and training them to be the best of the best.   five stars to the staff!!
Fantastic coffee. John the barista is the best in town! Recommeded. - Valerie from Los Angeles

Amazing food, service and ambiance. This place lives up to the hype. The pumpkin soup was full of flavor and the chicken paired nicely with a lovely white burgundy from their awesome wine list. Our server knew so much about the wine and the food and was very attentive.  My mom was a little overwhelmed by the dessert list as it is long and full of delicious options that are a little more creative than she's used to. Our server so patiently and nicely broke everything down for her so she picked the perfect thing--cookies and milk (7 different types of cookies, it was like Christmas in October).

Patronized High Street twice this weekend.  Plus take-out.  Overall - such a well-run comfortable casual attractive space with a serious kitchen producing flawless dishes, flawless pastas, the best 'salads' and vegetable preparations in Philadelphia, a superior on-premises bakery, wonderful hostesses and waitstaff.  Subtly pickled vegetables and salads, hearty dishes, respectable portions.

The artichoke pizza at this place is amazing!  The flavor reminds me of Alfredo pasta sauce!    They only have a few types of pizza, but I am sure all of them are delicious!  The beer at this place is a great value for your money - 32 ounce cups for $8!!!
Always delicious and fast delivery! Never had an issue.. a bit pricey but you get what you pay for. Very happy to be a regular customer!

Terrible service... The server refused to serve appetizers on our plates - when we asked for serving he simply said we don't give that kind of service. The attitude from the server and manager ruined our birthday celebrations.

"Poor service with average food" My wife and I came to this place for brunch today and as soon as we walked in a red flag  came up. The kid at the door which lack a good appearance, told us that the wait was 45 minutes which was a little absurd because we were the only ones waiting for a table I mean it's not like there's a line and the restaurant was super busy. Within 5 minutes there was an empty table. We could've left because he told us 45 but this was truly irrelevant for was coming. The table and chair were still dirty when they sat us. We waited a few minutes and the waiter came to take our order but we told her we needed 2 more minutes to decide what to eat so she left, at least 10 minutes past and someone who seemed concerned about us came and asked us if we were okay but we felt like the wait wasn't a big deal so we didn't say anything. When the waiter came to take our order she seemed like she was in a big rush for us to finish ordering, in fact she didn't even offer or ask if we wanted any drinks. I order the waffles with a raspberry sauce and dark chicken and my wife order eggs Benedict both with orange juice, they brought us the orange juice and they taste it like if you took tropicana OJ and pored a good amount of water and ice in it.   The food came but not complete, the raspberry sauce was nowhere to be found, not even maple syrup or honey. When I asked her for the sauce she told me that they didn't have anymore, so I asked for syrup and they brought me Aunt Jemima which honestly is like the most synthetic syrup one could find but whatever at least is something. The chicken and waffles were good, the Orange juice was horrible, and the service was the worst, my wife said her food was inferior in many aspects I'm sure she's gonna write a review as well. I feel that this place has huge potential but they need to focus on the service a lot more.  Keep in mind that is a little expensive too we payed $50 dollars for 2 plates that probably cost $25 to $30.

I held my husband's 40th birthday dinner here.  The co-owner worked with me to come up with the perfect menu.  They were flexible and accommodating and the prices were more than fair.  The night of the party the staff was wonderful, the food delicious - - they did everything in their power to make it the perfect evening.  This is a popular restaurant and they don't need to go above-and-beyond to fill their seats -   the fact that they do makes them even better.  I'm sure we'll be back soon and often - I'm already craving the schnitzel.

My friends and I have laughed about this brunch for weeks now -- worst experience ever!  We went about a month or so ago (before I had a Yelp account) when it was really hot and their AC was out.  The location is great and the atmosphere was perfect for the area, but....   1) It took over a half hour before we could get somebody's attention to order drinks. 2) on a Sunday at brunch time they didn't have iced coffee.  Maybe they didn't have ice?  Our water had clearly been sitting out for a while since it was verging on warm.   3) They didn't have 2/3 of the meals we tried to order.   4)  We waited for about an hour before our food came.  I ordered an egg plate that was reallyyyyy badly overcooked.  Everybody else's food was apparently fine, though.  My friends said that if it were just about the food they would consider coming back.   5)  We waited for our check and table to be cleared for about a half hour after we finished our plates.   6)  We received the wrong check.   7)  When we finally got the right check and turned it in, I just got up to take it back from the waitress since she was too busy chatting with her friends rather than walking it back to our table. Oh, and after all this nothing was comped.  Uugh -- never again!
My absolute favorite restaurant in Hanover area. Lots of choices on the menu. I feel it is the best bar, drinks are very well made.

Dont go mexican, they slap cheddar cheese unevenly on top of everything and big globs of sour cream, presentation was unappealing, salsa was good. "Fresh" house salad was totally wilted. Tres leches dessert was dry opposite to what a tres leches is supposed to be.
This place is under new management.  They know how to run business.  Everything is fresh and delicious.

I ordered Sweet potato fries and a green Gorgonzola salad with apple and nuts. The salad and apple dressing combination was delicious. Except there was no cheese in it, that is why I gave it only 3 stars. My friends has a Ruben and chicken club and it was fresh and delicious. Their only draw back was too much salt on the fries. We all still think the place has potential for its freshness and We will go back.

We stopped Friday morning for breakfast. No wait, took menus and sat ourselves.  We weren't blown away by the menu options at all,  but we managed to pull something together and ordered. Hadn't noticed the cash only sign, but luckily I had cash that day.  I changed an order by simply asking to replace ciabatta bread with a croissant & removing tomato and avocado but was told I'd have to pay full price PLUS $2.50 for the croissant.  So that's like $13 for a croissant with egg & cheese.  Lol.... Outlandish,  but I said ok.  Our total was $23 but after paying we decided to go elsewhere.  Didn't ask for a refund or anything.  Maybe the money can be used to improve some things or to cover the next 8 croissants when someone wants to simply swap their bread.  Smh. With some tweaks, it could be a lovely place however.

the food was amazing! Very flavorful!  The service was great!  We had the shrimp appetizer and Gato salad to start... Both great!,,  then the halibut as our entree...also amazing! I highly recommend this restaurant!  And the cherry on top was that Bobby Flay himself was there cooking and talking to the patrons!
Their brunch is amazing and back garden is beautiful too. You do have to come early since there is always a wait on weekends.

It Was once Fernand Point who once said, "If the divine creator has taken pains to give us delicious and exquisite things to eat, the least we can do is prepare them well and serve with ceremony." Mundo has mastered both. Each dish a gift to the palate, celebrated by the warmth of those who present it.
Very friendly staff! Try the chicken noodle soup its delicious!!
Awesome food, open 24 hours  7 days  a week and they have very fast delivery

Honestly surprised to see bad reviews on here. Wings is the best place ever. Me and my friends just call it "wings". Been going here since they opened. I read one review saying the people didn't speak good English? Does that really matter? They're so nice, they're a family and they work well together. It's not fine dining, it's a place that makes greasy food like wings, fries, anything with cheese. I've never been disappointed with them. Today I ordered from a place in which I wanted a plain bagel and they delivered a cinnamon raisin with no phone call to ask if that was ok. Wings always tells you if they have run out of something and give you options for substitutions. Anyway. Wings is the best. Get disco fries with a side of honey mustard! Best thing ever. Also they're deliver is quick and dependable. Never missed an item and always on time even in a snow storm. Love them.
Great pizza, the sauce and cheese are great. Definitly a must try.
Had the loudest customer ever, talking about the Smurfs. Seriously. Forever. Once he left, the place was great and the food seemed to taste better. It's a bit cramped so get there early.

I remember when it used to be called Cafe Clave. It's used to be so spacious, and the wifi was awesome. Now, it's trying to be something they are not. Call it a restaurant and drop the cafe. I read that the previous owner had some troubles and had to sell quick. Otherwise, the cafe would have still been awesome. For the noobs that are saying the cafe is a hidden gem or great, it's not. It was here before you moved from whatever town you lived before. It used to be one of the best cafe spots in West Philly. It was another alternative to that ghastly cafe a block away, Green Line. Now, it looks like a cheap Sabrina's with poor service. At least Sabrina's has good variety of food. Why the hate? Fine, where do I begin... 1. Service is awful; I had to wait ten minutes just to get water. 2. Their coffee is very bland at best. 3. Wifi (when available) is inferior to the old cafe it once was. 4. Chairs are tiny. If you weigh more than 80 lbs, you will have a hard time sitting in them. 5. Cafe Clave had character. This restaurant doesn't. It's just another pretentious, hipster closet with poor coffee and service. I don't know why the old cafe closed down, but Clave will be very missed. It's a shame what they have done to the place. It looks terrible, sloppy and small. I rather stay home and study than ever set foot in that monstrosity that Clave is called now.
Love this place.

The laid back, chilled atmosphere is an oasis in this mad town, and we didn't have to compete with the loud talking that is so common in New York. Food was delicious - ordered the seafood stew and the special sausage dish. And had the coconut tapioca for dessert - again, delicious. Perfect spot in a great part of town for a Sunday evening.
Check out the pasta and good shop next door.  Amazing pea/mint/ricotta pasta to take home and complete a fab meal.  Great customer service as well. Yum

The level of seven-course tasting in today's menu is much lower than average.From the very beginning of free appetisers to last desert, almost each course let me down.The squash soup with cold fois gras was too sweet; the poached egg with mushrooms and salty meat weretoo sticky to continue the following courses.The worst course shown up in the third course. Tasteless pasta with a lot of tasteless sauce. I had to order my waiter to recooked the pasta. Of course the new pasta  tasted as bad as the previous one.Although the bass and duck turned out to be a little bit Michelin Star Restaurant, but their sides(celery)remained their ugly flavor. I totally lost confidence in their food before finishing their terrible deserts.

Ate here last night and regretted it immediately. Very unsanitary, flys all over the place. Ribs were dry and the mashed potatoes were so salty they were inedible. My boyfriend had to immediately use the bathroom after eating. We will never go again. I will give 2.5 stars to the Mac and cheese. It was good but had definitely been sitting for way too long.

Totally worth all of the hype! Adorable atmosphere and we didn't have to wait too long (20 minutes at 10:30am on a Sunday morning). I highly recommend the sourdough pancakes...such a treat! Two notes: one, you can't bring outside coffee to your table, so be sure to finish it beforehand if you grab a cup while you wait; two, it's pretty pricey, so be prepared to drop about $30/person.
Love it everything was on point ! very satisfied! I am Italian, made me feel like home! truly my best pick! Love it truly! And honestly couldnt have been better!

I had been here twice before and it was good food and good service. But don't go there if they have a party in the restaurant because kitchen and waiters only serve the party. We went there for dinner. Food came later than usual. We waited 10 minutes for steak sauce. Forget about the steak knives as they never showed up to our table. Because the bad service, our waiter just added 18% tips to our check which it wasn't like that for my first two visit. Big disappointment!!!! Will never go back there and get rip off!

We have ordered food from this place for 3 times in last 2 weeks.  I drive 14 miles to this place to have the best chicken, lamb in NJ. Amazing chicken tandoori, tikka and lamb dishes. If you are looking for only vegetarian, this may not be your best bet, but they do complete justice to meat. They make fresh desi desserts as well, and the best part is that the owner/ manager is extremely honest about freshness of food. Unlike some other desi restaurants that we have been to, this restaurant gets highest rating for its hospitality. We were not charged for a dish when they did not have what exactly we wanted.

The idea is great and I'm sure eat-in is better but I've ordered twice online and both pies looked the same - folded over from sliding while delivery guys are biking around the neighborhood. And this time it took nearly and hour to deliver 4 blocks away as the delivery guy apparently got lost???
TWO WORDS: Italian Bomb. Arguably one of the best pizzas I've ever had. Pro tip: don't show up at Modern at 8pm on a Friday, you'll wait a while.

0ur reservation was for 9pm we did not sit until well after 10pm with the explanation that it was Saturday night and this should be expected. The offered us a glass of prosseco in the house which was nice, but the attitudes of the staff were not even close to apologetic. The appetizers came out quick, but the entrees took another 50-60 minutes to come out (we ordered pasta and scallops, two things that cook fast) during this time the waitress was no where to be found. The space is extremely loud and the tables are packed in so conversation is difficult when the restaurant is completely full. Charred octopus was great, scallops were yummy and the pastas were decent. Good food for a reasonable price, it just took forever to get it.

My girlfriend and I absutely love coming here. We always have an extremely long wait but we don't care. We just post up in the back bar area and have a thousand drinks until our name is called. What a fun atmosphere. You can also order food while you wait so if your girlfriend gets cranky when she's hungry you won't have a problem. Great drink selection, great charcuterie, cool vibe, great tunes. Now the food. Absolutely best pizza on the planet. I think all the reviews must say that. Something about their bread and toppings. Gotta stand in the front and just watch the cooks making the pizza in the oven. It's mesmerizing. Now a word to the wise: THE PASTA IS AMAZING!!! Ask which pastas are homemade and order all of them. Do not sleep. Also the ribs are shadily unreal. I hear the burger is amazing at lunch but I won't really have an opportunity to come at lunch ever unfortunately. Anyway, to the folks at Roberta's, we love you!

I found  Percy Street BBQ a perfect place to bring hungry college kids!  The food & service was very good.  Would recommend the pumpkin ale on draft!  The vibe of this place was great because of the music from jukebox  and large tables with bench seating.  Next time in Philly...will go back!

My waiter was sexy that's why he got a good tip, not because he was good or anything... The food was a heart attack waiting to happen, although it was ok I did enjoy my plates pickles for the app but service was very slow

I stopped in with my sister for a quick coffee and left vowing never to return. The space is very pretty and the coffee we got was decent (albeit kind of expensive) but I would never return because the staff was incredibly rude for no reason whatsoever. The young lady at the register bitterly took our order, slammed everything including the glass sugar dispenser on the glass counter before us and made us feel so unwelcome. Also we happened to see a cell phone just laying on a side counter. When we pointed it out to the hostess she gave us a why-are-you-talking-to-me look and rudely told us it belonged to the coffee place. Maybe they treated us so poorly because we're not hipsters and deigned to enter their space? Seriously there's a lot of attitude in this place which is absurd because it's Astoria, not Williamsburg, so relax guys. I know some people somehow feel important being treated like crap by baristas with anger issues but I'm not one of them.

Food was excellent. Went for Sunday brunch. Interesting ingredients. Small yet varied menu. Service was excellent and friendly. Atmosphere relaxed. Decor funky. Would definitely go back when we return on our next visit to NYC

I guess I should say more...  I've eaten lunch/dinner at Teresa more than 100 times since it opened.   For many years the food was good to great, the service was very good and the enviro was trendy towny chic.  The service is still good but the food is poor to fair with an occasional good.  The restaurant is tired and the Momos have lost their eye for for the details.  A trip through the box and coat cluttered hallway to get to the dirty old bathroom facilities reinforces how far this once good restaurant has fallen.

Three of us went in on a Friday night for dinner, drinks, and of course to play some games. We asked a waitress walking by if we should sit anywhere and she told us to go upstairs and sit at a table behind a few pinball machines. The place isn't huge, so they may not have any other options, but the table placement was pretty awkward. There were butts in our face pretty much the whole time (of people playing the pinball machines). The beer list was great, but I am gluten-free so I asked if there were any ciders available. She said they had just ran out of the fruity cider they had on tap and that they had a cider called "Dirty Mayor" by Citizen Cider in a can. I asked if it was a regular cider and she said yeah so I ordered that. When it came, I was surprised to see that it was a ginger cider.. And I hate ginger :( I asked for a straw for my water and was a little put back when the waitress brought it to me unwrapped. It sort of grossed me out. We got up to play pinball on the other side of the floor as we waited for the food. While my boyfriend was playing, the waitress brought our food, put it on the table, and left. I wished she would have came over and let us know it was there and asked if we'd like anything else. There were no condiments on the table and I would have liked pepper and ketchup for the fries. I had ordered a burger cooked medium-well and the entire burger was still pink and had juices running out. At least to me, medium well should only have a bit of pink left in the center. While we ate, the waitress never came back to see if we needed anything or ask how the food was. Everything we ordered tasted fine, but nothing extraordinary. As a bar, they offer a lot of local beer choices and some interesting mixed drinks. The games are obviously awesome and there isn't anywhere else in the area to go for that kind of experience. I just would have been much happier with a better waitress and food that was cooked correctly. Honestly, I think the food aspect is a bit too much and I would have been better off eating somewhere else first.
Place is great so far!!!!  Wonderful salad, and I also had their Omelet for breakfast.  Can't wait for them to stay open until 9pm.

Staff is terrible.... We made a reservation days in advance... We get to the restaurant and they claim they have no reservation. Sigh. Ultimately they were able to accommodate the group in the outdoor patio area on a shared bench table with another party. Very uncomfortable. The waitstaff was mediocre at best. The food is good but not worth the money.

Great tasting food in a quaint place that does remind me of my time in London!  Went for brunch today, but was here a year ago and still remember the delicious meal I had then - the best ever succulent brick chicken! Today's meal was challah french toast topped with pumpkin whipped cream. The flavor was A-mazing! Surely the 235th wonder of the world. Oh, and my waiter Joe was superb!

Avoid. This. Place. Nothing remotely French about this place except a lame attempt to look "française" with a waitstaff wearing striped Marcel Marceau mime shirts. Food? Bland, tasteless, watery. Wildy expensive. Service? Rock bottom, from the rude, harried hostess to the incompetent wait staff. Atop all of this, this story happened to me and is true: I spent over $75 eating and drinking at the bar and settled up, tipped and left. 2 days later, I got a €600 (euro) charge from a department store in France to my card. While I got the charge reversed, something smells rotten about these facts: I haven't been to France in 5 years; I know no one in France;  I just dined at a "French" restaurant with a smarmy, smug staff. Do the math. What a joke.
Wonderful atmosphere, excellent service and delicious food make this restaurant a must visit!

Great Italian Food! No chain restaurant style food here! If you want to taste a piece of great Italian style food, then this is a great place. Service is pretty good and ambiance is nice, cozy. I had raviolis stuffed with seafood and it was out of this world!

Was brought here for dinner this past Friday and was pleasantly surprised at the wonderful decor, the friendliness and attentiveness of the staff and the great jazz music. We both enjoyed our dinner very much and will definitely be back.

The Churrasco grill is one of the best restaurants I have ever been to. My family and I look forward to our meals there. The small , cozy feel is just what I look for when spending time together with my family. The food is pure perfection. The South American taste and flavor shines in every dish. The "Shrimp Izza " appetizer is my favorite. The Churrasco skirt steak is perfectly wood fire grilled and juicy. The 40 minute ride is well worth it for us. And it's BYOB. Even better!

Very nice and flexible staff, the food is good and the choice is really enough. The hot pot is better than the bbq though. You eat for free for your birthday and you get taken care of well . I like this place .

Amazing! So glad to have another vegetarian option nearby. Food was fresh, delicious and spicy! Drunken noodles soooooo good!!! Papaya salad sooooo yummy! Owners were super nice and prices are reasonable!

Came here on a Thursday night. The restaurant was packed and there was a wait so we sat at the bar. Great ambiance--the place has an overall vibrant atmosphere and I really loved the decor.  The staff was very friendly and attentive. We tried the ceviche, the corn "off" the cob, and several tacos--al pastor de pollo, lengua, carnitas, and pescado. I wasn't a big fan of the Oaxacan rice and beans but everything else was very good. All of the tacos were tasty...small to perfectly fit in one hand but melt in your mouth delicious. We had the churros for dessert and they were a perfect end to a good meal. I would definitely return.

lovely Cuban spot in Boonton Food tastes authentic, generous portions and very tasty, met the needs of my tastes buds! Josh the owner serves the food to your table.  He is a bonus to the experience, friendly and informative.  This is a must try.  I'll be back
We heard a lot about this place, and finally got to eat here. What a treat!!! Friendly owner. Great authentic food. We WILL be back...often. Thanks Jose!
Great place will not be disappointed! Wide variety of choices. And super friendly service!

After a 3 1/2 hour drive in traffic from New Jersey, the dinner at Infinity Bistro made up for it(and the ssj show) . We had to call the restaurant as we were lost and Justin (bvg director/bar manager) guided us through the streets of Hartford via phone and stayed with us until we arrived. Once inside we cannot say enough about the pleasant demeanor of the ENTIRE staff from the hostesses to the waiters. My wife ordered the lobster bisque which had big chunks of lobster and could have been a meal. We then split a lobster roll and burger which were both awesome. It was also greatly appreciated when Michael Cammelletti, the gen'l mgr sought us out to thank us for coming. We will be back and thanks to Justin for the coffee for the ride home.
Always eat here when visiting Wall Street area.  Service is awesome.  Food wonderful with very good presentation.  Great atmosphere.

I like their food and the atmosphere. My daughter LOVES their fruit smoothies and say they rival her grand pops, which is saying a lot because in her eyes he makes THE BEST smoothies ever. Unfortunately I love pork and prefer pork bacon over any other type of bacon. The service was a tad slow. And I've only ate here twice b/c every other time I've come here it's packed beyond belief.

My mother and I had breakfast at the restaurant a couple weeks ago.  The food was good.  Coffee hot.  Food was fresh, including the fruit.  My mother had waffles and I had French toast.  Delicious.   Our meal was made better by the friendly conversation held with fellow diners.  I plan to return and see if my findings are consistent.

Ippudo in Greenwhich stands out for its famous Ramen Noodles and traditional japanese cuisine. I tried their shishitos, Chicken and Pork Buns, service is good and you're always greeted with a loud welcome and since its always busy its worth the wait for what you spend to eat. The atmosphere is enjoyable, the traditional Japanese design is great. Chef Masashi delivers the quality you would want from  a Japanese restaurant. Overall i enjoyed it, it does get full so if waiting in line isn't your choice then move along, but its worth the wait. "Irasshaimase!" everyone
Amazing ramen. The lines are long, especially on the weeks so make sure to come right when it opens. Best ramen in NYC and I've been to at least 10 different places.

My family and I went twice to this wonderful Italian restaurant this past summer. The service was impeccable,   the entrees and  the food was so delicious. It's an authentic Italian Restaurant! We love everything about it

Its not as good as you think... like at all I can make a better cheesesteak at home no lie. They rush you to order the steak was tough and chewy something like gum seemed like it was sitting on the grill for hrs before we got it it. The cheese sauce was good but there was barely any on it. Even there bread wasn't the best it was just to much of it and it was kinda old like it was sitting in the freezer for weeks and they just took it out and sold it.  The best part of this place is the fries lol I won't be coming back to be honest with you I was sorely disappointed in this place.
The ambience is great, it's low-lit but very comfortable. I'd recommend sitting at the ramen bar inside the restaurant (not the alcohol bar when you first walk in, although I'm sure that's fine too).

It was a nice and quiet place to escape the craziness outside. The service was exceptional. The wait staff was friendly, quick, and efficient. The prefix lunch ($25) was perfect. I started with a yummy spinach salad with a bacon vinegarette- sooo good! Then moved onto the hanger steak and fries! The steak was cooked to perfection  I would recommend this place to anyone who is in NYC!

I was very excited to go to dinner tonight.  Friends have said great things about this restaurant.   We get there,  2 people, and they seat is with a family with 3 kids.  Normally no issue, however they were gluten free.  So all the food had to be made with their soy sauce and nothing else.  We should have been given a choice.  The food was very bland.  No flavor. The chicken was ridiculously over cooked.  The service was ok,  didn't realize is be charged per seltzer either. We went be going back.
Always a favorite when I go to Philly. Great Guac.

My hubby and I came here today and the service was friendly and fast! The food was excellent! We each had tacos. The hubby had BBQ pork tacos which were super flavorful. I had a variety... Crispy fish, Chorizo, and spicy beef. The beef taco was good but nothing compared to the others. The crispy fish was my fave out of the 3 and the Chorizo in 2nd. Also ... hit up their taco truck on Tuesdays. Their tacos, quesadillas, and salads with cilantro lime dressing ...Always rock!!!
