Went here for my birthday .. The place is OKAY but I did leave there still hungry lol
I would definitely come back if i'm visiting soho again. Didn't get to try most of the dishes, but beef curry and stripped chicken breast noodle were great for hangover.

I wish I could review the chicken and the donuts separately, because they are two different worlds. I almost think that I must be having different donuts then everyone else here because honestly, these are disgusting. But I've tried them twice (at this location; never been to the others), and they were the same both times. When you squeeze them, grease oozes out; the bag is coated in a layer of I don't know what. I gave one to my wife and, after a single bite, she refused to continue. It's a shame because the flavors have potential; they're nothing incredibly creative but still better than your run-of-the-mill donut place. But ugh these things are bad. 1 star. At best. And like I said - the chicken was a different story. The chicken itself was moist and flavorful while the skin was crispy and comes with a variety of spices. I'm a fan! I'd give it 4/5 stars, just getting dinged on some consistency issues (the odd piece is dried out). The worst part about the chicken, though, is that it comes with a free donut. Which is bad enough that I think twice about going by to order the chicken! In sum: donuts=gross, chicken=amazing.

I've read about this place so many times and have never been yet. So after visiting my doctor I waddled my 8m pregnant self in and decided to give them a try. Best decision ever. I'm a turkey snob and if it isn't real turkey breast, then I don't want it. The people behind the counter were very friendly and made me feel at ease, as I know sometimes certain places have a well known ordering system that's isn't known to newbies like me. I got the "half" smoked turkey and Swiss. Half was huge 12"! Anyways, I'll be back next week after my doc appt!
As I type my review I have a bellyful of half a turkey sub. I'm fantasizing about demolishing the other 1/2 but I'm too lazy to get up! One of the best sandwiches I've had.

I've been to this restaurant a number of times. Each time was a great experience! I have yet to experience all the dishes but my favorite so far is the molasses braised short ribs with a side of mashed potatoes, broccoli and cornbread. This dish has tons of flavor and very fulfilling in terms of portion size. All the waiters and staff are amazing but my favorite is Lawrence. He did a fantastic job with giving me the full SoCo experience!

Found this restaurant on Yelp with a moderate 3$ rating.  The food was incredible.  We are both of Italian decent and yet we loved the food and the service was just so good.  When you arrive you get appetizers without even ordering them (grilled spicy peppers, salami and cheese as well as some fried veggies that were exquisite and crunchy.  We both ordered a main course and the portions were too large to finish.  The bottle of wine they recommended worked perfectly for our taste and the cappuccino and ricotta cake was great as well.  Top it off with a home made fig grappa that I wasn't charged for and it made for a perfect meal. Will return and will tell my friends and work acquaintances about it.

I live close to the downtown Ippudo and decided to try it one Monday evening.  There always seems to be a line so I figured it is worth a try.  We arrived at 9:30 and had to wait about 1/2 hour for a table for 3.  While waiting we tried a pork bun which was very tasty.  The atmosphere is quite busy.  The service was quick since they need to turn around tables fast.  The ramen was fine.  Would I wait more than 1/2 hour to be seated.  Probably not, the bar area was quite small.  I would go back but try to time it when it wasn't quite so crowded.

This place is awesome!!! I have never written a review but they do deserve it. I been going to this establishment for a while, and I always leave satisfied. The design is amazing, authentic Japanese style. I usually order the chicken buns as an appetizer and for the main I take the soba (da!)v great restaurant, Im not surprise that they have over than 6k reviews on yelp.
loved it

Joe installed an outdoor Tantenna on my house in Brooklyn, NY.  I found him helpful, professional, efficient, courteous and knowledgeable.  Not only that but he was on time.  And he even called me the next day to make sure that everything was working properly.  I will certainly call him again for other projects.  I can't recommend him highly enough!

Recently opened brewery that offers great food and good craft beer. I ate the Rustic pizza, my friend had the Adult Grilled Cheese, and another friend had the Cheeseburger. All of the food was phenomenal. They have these pretzel fondue bites that were delicious. I plan on going back several times, both for lunch and at happy hour.

It's never busy at this restaurant for lunch. I always get seated quickly, and the hostess will usually give you a nice window seat. Unlike most places the waiter will let you sit and talk without much disturbance. The only downfall is on a day when you have obligations to go somewhere after, and your kind of waiting thinging..ok i want to leave now.. The food is always really hot, which is how i like my food. Sizzlinggg. The deep dish pizza is my favorite so I always order it. its always crispy and made just right.

What is there no to love about this place! Every time I order I try to get a new dish and 9.5/10 times I love every single dish! The portions are little small but worth every penny. My favorites are the Pad Thai and Hawaiian Chicken. My co-worker loves the wing dings and another loves the Spicy Noodles, Sesame Chicken and Chicken w. Ginger and Scallion(on the Lunch Special).
Warm beer. Horrible service

The Eddy is fully deserving of all these good reviews. The food and service is exceptional. Ordered one plate of oysters for starters. They were so good we ordered a second. Scallops were delicious too. For mains I ordered the gnocchi and my gf ordered the ribeye - seriously good - and perfectly matched with the Brunello di Montalcino. Our waiter Bill was really knowledgeable and pleasant. Just what you want in a waiter.

I had heard good things and when I finally made it there to eat, I was not disappointed. My friend and I both chose to be surprised by the chef's tasting menu. I really liked the food selections and that they took into account our preferences. Service was great and the infused tequilas were interesting- I will be back to try again!

Marra's is a staple lunch at my house at least once a week. while I'm there I always grab an entree to make for quick dinner later on in the week. The owner might be the sweetest woman I have ever met in my life. She is always greets me with such kindness. The food is amazing. I have never had anything I didn't like. It sticks close to my grandmothers cooking and I like that it makes me feel at home.

It's...okay. Not the best in the world...  Modern tastes better and has faster service. We stopped going to Pepe's as much because they always have such a huge wait. Next time another property in the neighborhood opens up, they should definitely buy it and have an additional dining room on the weekends. If you really want to try it, just go for an early lunch when they open and you'll get a seat and delicious pizza (with less of the black char, if you don't like that).
Un endroit simple, typique, agréable, sympathique et un service convivial.... À ne pas rater !!!!   Merci
We ordered the Hakata Tonton hot pot for two, and it's delicious!!!!!!!! They don't take tips, but their service is extremely wonderful!!!

I got the worst food poisoning of my life here and so did everybody I went with. The food tasted very good going down, but don't risk the consequences of having a second, third, tenth tasting... I've heard a lot of people have had the same problem. I think the health department needs to be investigating.
Went there recently, food was not the best and there was a very odd scent. I didn't feel the same after eating there last Friday.

Amazing, amazing, amazing! Love this place. The food is incredible. I never had such wonderful shark and I really like the bread they serve it in. First time I had anything like it. Also the smelt fish is spectacular. One of my favorite dishes I had there. The staff is extremely friendly and easy going. Great atmosphere to the whole place. You cannot go wrong with Lolo's!

I've had the biggest range of experiences here. Some have been EXCELLENT, others have been TERRIBLE. I love that their drink menu is extremely diverse with many interesting creations (a floater of Malbec in a cocktail, heck yeah!). Don't get caught sitting at the bar at last call though. I had been there with three friends, buying everyone's drinks for the celebratory night, totaling...well...a lot. We had a very friendly time with the bartender who was wonderful and attentive and laughed with us. It was really fun. Then, out of nowhere, some insanely rude man in a suit walked up to me, tapped me on the shoulder, and said "time to go." My reaction was, "what?" He replied, "it's last call, time to pay and leave." We were all struck dumb, including the bartender who started apologizing profusely and telling us what wonderful customers we were and that we were welcome to stay until they closed. The suited man came back five minutes later, and told the bartender to be getting people's checks settled and he could clean up later. It was such a downer and totally inappropriate, especially the tone he was using. FIRST OF ALL, Last Call is NOT time to pay and leave. It's time to order one more drink for WHILE you are paying and getting ready to leave (this was still 30-minutes before their posted closing time). Second of all, how could you possibly be that rude? We loved the bartender, and might go back some day, but we haven't been back in over 6 months after that incident.

Best diner in Hamden!!! Way better than Acropolis or IHOP. The food is always fresh, delicious, and well-prepared (even in the middle of the night). It always comes out fast and the wait staff is very good. They always notice if your coffee is running low and will just bring the pot over (and always remember more creamer) without asking! Yes! The wait staff isn't ALWAYS friendly, but they mostly are, and I've never seen them be rude. They have a huge menu and everything on it I've had is good. They also automatically total up your order in the cheapest way possible, so you can just blindly order your breakfast however you want it without worrying about being charged too much for the extras. It's also quite clean, except that the un-carpeted section doesn't always feel the cleanest...a little gritty. So if you're in sandals and it's been raining, just ask for the carpeted section. I've also never had to wait for a table even when the other places are packed. This place is truly a hidden gem. You can even call-in takeout orders and I think they do delivery too.

I've been here twice and both times loved it. Last time was in the summer and we were seated out back on the nice little patio where it feels like a nice peaceful escape. I had a mimosa to start which was made with fresh squeezed OJ. This place gets 5 starts for the outdoor space and atmosphere and for the great food and service!

Just came here for lunch. Food and service was excellent. Manager even came around to see how everything was. The only reason why I'm giving it one less star is there was only 3 servers walking around and it slowe things down a bit, but once we ordered they were all very attentive. Would visit again.

Really good pizza with THICK CRUST OPTIONS (yay!) and a HUGE menu. Because their menu is so large, though, some things suffer. I'd like to see them eliminate some things from their menu and just do what they offer a little better across the board. Not by a lot, but I do feel everything is just slightly more expensive than it should be. I'd tip more for take-out if the prices were a little less. The big detractor is that take-out takes forever. They'll tell you 20 minutes, but it always takes at least 40, and usually more. So whatever time they tell me is when I leave the house, then I stop and get some soda and Parmesan somewhere, and then it's usually still a few minutes before it's ready when I get there, unless I order in the late evening. They do always have Food Network going in the waiting area, so that gets you in the mood. I'd suggest not eating-in here. Bad, slow service and no atmosphere. They should make the banquet room their dining room and have a dedicated waiter.
The pizza is very salty. The staff is very rude. The ingredients are not always fresh. They do not handle large groups well. The tables are not clean.

Kumo is our go-to sushi spot! All the staff is super friendly and the sushi is just delicious! I love their Kumo Roll and Sun Flower Roll! Can't forget the fried ice cream! We've been here so many times, I think I recall one Saturday night service was a bit off but it was jammed packed so we didn't hold it against them to much, other than that, all the other times we've gone its been nothing but great!

My co-workers and I love ordering here! We've had plenty of dishes that I can rave about from calzones to wraps to of course PIZZA! We've had their white, plain, toppings, Sicilian, and Grandma pies and are satisfied every single time. Their salads are large and filling! We order various times a month and at least once every week. Their minestrone is great if you're looking for soup, I can keep going with the reviews but overall I would like to say this is a must GO TO place for lunch and dinners.

I saw this place on numerous gluten free apps and it is listed as gluten free on yelp. IT IS NOT GLUTEN FREE. They had three options (all salads) and not even corn tortillas for their tacos. It's terrible for a gluten free meal. Service was also extremely slow. This was really unexpected as there were only four patrons and two severs. Not good. Maybe swing through here for a slooooow drink and then head three doors down to Reviver for a true delicious gluten free experience.

Love this place. Old school Italian feel. Pizza is unique and addicting. For $10 a cheese pie you are getting your money's worth. Entrees are humongous and taste homemade. Sometimes service can be slow. However, the food is well worth the wait!

This is one of the best restaurants I've found for those with severe food allergies or gluten intolerance. They are extremely knowledgable and don't make you feel like a pain in the ___ for asking lots of questions about the ingredients and preparation. The gluten free bread is amazing, having tried tons of brands as well as baking my own and always ending up disappointed. The gluten free spinach ricotta ravioli is so good that my gluten eating dining partners liked it more than their own meal!
I don't eat red meat but when I do its a cheese steak from ginos in south philly a must for a bucket list.

The service, cocktails and quality of food were all really great. We started with the Empanadas, the Mixto Cebiche and the Juanita's chicken. Would recommend all of the above!  The atmosphere was loud but not too much so.

I don't understand how a restaurant can get a larger order that may take some extra time to prepare and can't just call and say "Hey man, big order. Might be a little longer." I'd be fine with that. More than fine with it. PSP however, do not communicate. What I want you to know is that instead, they leave you hanging for 90 minutes and when you call them, this is the conversation that happens: "Prince Street Pizza" "Hi, I'm calling to follow up on an order I placed a little over an hour ago." "Yeah, gonna be 30 minutes." "Oh. I was quoted an hour for delivery." "Well, we gotta lot of orders." "I wish you guys would have called to tell me." "Well, what do you want from me? We gotta lot of orders. I'm sorry." (HANGS UP) I also want you to know that happens after another 30 minutes. When the delivery guy does shows up, he slams the pizzas down on your conference room table and huffily acts like you demanded he come to a remote Siberian military base in the middle of the night with pizzas you requested be cooked in his kitchen at home, even though it's actually 2:00pm and you called a pizzeria, a place known for their ability to make pizzas, and paid them to do so. I fully recognize where I messed up. Maybe my order was bigger than usual. But come on PSP. You make pizza. It's what you do. Being upset that I put an order in and NOT COMMUNICATING about it with me and then showing up late and being rude to me is as utter and complete a failure as I can possibly imagine. No, that's not true - you could have brought me hamburgers. Then it would have been a complete failure. Who cares if the pizza was good or bad. PSP, you gotta talk to people.
The best Italian food that you will find in Astoria! Authentic, scrumptious & romantic!  The owners of Vite clearly know what they are doing.

Came here for lunch on a weekday, but it was holiday, so it was super busy.  The ambiance was great, it felt like a little tropical escape... but that's where my compliments end. The servers were clearly very overwhelmed and short-staffed, so it took us forever to get a glass of water, let alone place our order.  When we finally did get our food (I had chicken with rice & beans) it was so incredibly underwhelming I had to slather it in hot sauce to make it worth eating.  My husband and I lived in Union City before and used to have amazing Latin cuisine at our disposal, but even so, this was food was super gringo-fied.  It's probably great to come and get tipsy with their drink mixers and your alcohol of choice, but don't come for the food, and don't expect to get it quickly.  We could barely flag down a server to get our check.

This restaurant is a gem in the rough. The food is authentic Mexican, better than any chain restaurant. Everything is cooked to order but the service is quick. You can't go wrong stopping here for either breakfast or lunch.

The conveniently located Americana Diner has reinvented the basic NJ diner experience and really brings quality food to East Windsor residents and people passing through our town during their travels along Route 130. This place is a not so hidden jem offering a wonderfully delicious alternative to the poison served at places like McDonald's and Burger King just a little farther up the road.

I have been going to Sahara Grill since it was opened back in 1999 (or 2000). It is my go-to place for better flavored middle-eastern food, its not as bland as the other restaurants with the same genre and cuisine. I almost always order the mixed grill platter and I have almost never been disappointed. The service is very polite, very pleasant, the space is in the pure heart of Philadelphia downtown which makes it even more convenient and there's a paid parking right across. I have to say, that since going to this place for so many years, I've noticed the quantity has decreased with the skewers but the food still tastes great. Their new white sauce is not as impressive, tastes like sour cream (maybe that's exactly what it is) but if you ask for the spicy green sauce, that really adds more flavor if you needed it. Overall, my family and I love to dine here at least once in 2 months whenever we are visiting Philadelphia. I highly recommend it.

First of all, I am a huge fan of local cafes and privately owned restaurants. And if you are too, this place is PERFECT. The setting is modern with a touch of a nature, making it a pretty casual place (no need for fancy for breakfast!). My entire meal and my friends' meals were all fantastic, but I don't think any of us finished because the portions are so big. If you go, I recommend the raspberry chocolate truffle lattes, they were so good we got them to go too!

I like going to this spot, however I was there a few nights ago with a group of friends and there was an asian waitress who was rude as hell. She had a very nasty attitude and kept telling people to stay out of her way because she needed the space to work. Its a bar not a restaurant or hall, people are going to be standing and talking. Ive been a waiter myself and as a waiter you need to politely ask people to move and kind of find your way around the crowd, don't like it? Then don't wait on tables, simple.

BLOWN AWAY!!!!!! The lamb ribs were to die for. It literally fell of the bones. and so clever of the chef to incorporate dehydrated raspberries and crispy ginger. I've been here multiple times and I am never disappointed. In fact, I fall deeper in love with the food.

There are many pizza places in Montclair but Dino's is one of the oldest and really the best.  Although the pizza isn't spiced in a special way, they use the highest quality ingredients making for the healthiest, freshest pizza in town.   After eating Dino's, I always feel good, never bloated or greasy, etc.  Anyway, I have lived in town my whole life and I highly recommend them.

I can not stop dreaming about their trout tartar. served with fried trout skin, to be used as a chip. the menu is clever and the pre-fix is an amazing deal. That's off to the chef. You're a breath of fresh air to this congested city.

Great food Awesome bouncer Cool ambience "Rude & High Bartenders" Management please do something about the bartenders, as a costumer I come to this place because of the food,drinks and service not because of these arrogant kids at the bar. I used to come every Friday by but after last night I'm not going back, I hope I don't get to see the same faces at Macao when I order a drink with my friends.
This restaurant is just great. The food is really good . I recomend for people to give it a try. You wont regret it...

i was in town from the west coast for a wedding.  while i was excited for the wedding i was concerned i would miss "el classico"(Barcelona v. Real Madrid), not to mention Chelsea v. Man U the following day.  i wasn't concerned for too long......  long story short, it became mine and my friends' hang out spot for the weekend when not involved in wedding stuff.  plenty of screens, plenty of drinks, solid food, and a non-contrived hospitality that's often hard to come by on the west coast.  if you want a cozy and friendly joint to catch an EPL match with some friends, go here.  it was the backdrop for a great reunion for me and mine.  cheers!

This place is amazing. When you walk in you literally don't know where or what to go to first. All your senses are a buzz. Should you go to the grocery section and shop or do you go to the food section and eat first! A wide variety of cheeses, breads, olives, vegetables,  you name it they have it EVERYTHING ITALIAN.  The burrata is delicious. Everything there is so good to eat. This is also a great place to take your visiting out of town friends.
Nice restaurant with a good selection for lunch. Had the pasta dish with seafood and it was pretty good. Price wasn't too bad either. Service was ok. Wish I had more time to stay here.

I have had dinner and lunch at this new eatery in Hanover.  I am going back next Tues for dinner again. I really liked the food...taste and quality of ingredients, as well as that they cook to order. That is a plus UNLESS you are attending a concert, play, or movie at the College and was hoping to have time for dessert, as well an appetizer and main course. Even getting there at 5:15 it was tight to get across the street to the 7pm concert- I had to forgo trying dessert. I did have the Chia pudding another time and really liked it, though I could have handled it a tad less sweet.  Good Chi tea, but again, just an itsy bitsy tad too sweeter than optimal for me, but I would order again. I have had 2 of the soups and loved both of them...the spicy red one and the lentil. (I can't remember the name of the spicy red one- it is the 1st listed under soups). The Moo Moo that I chose was spinach paneer. I would like to get Moo Moos again, though I would rather have fewer dumplings on the plate with each having more filling in them. That way, same amount of filling, but with less starch.  The spicing is fantastic, so flavorful. I did not want a burning tongue to overpower flavor so I started with a 6 for heat. The next visit I went for an 8.  I think that is what I would stay with. Friend asked for 10 and I tried it. Still did have flavor but, for me, if I have really burning taste buds it diminishes the pleasure. I have had better goat in Mpls--it was more tender, but I did like the flavor of the curry a lot. Such friendly owners who really have a high standard for what they serve. There are many things I will try in the coming months. How great it is to have a yummy new ethic restaurant that is also of such good quality.

Absolutely delicious. If you're looking for authentic Mexican, this is not the place for you! Neither is anywhere in VT, as far as I can tell. But if you want something a little more hipster and a little less greasy, you'll be happy. Ingredients were fresh and the black beans were especially great!

Always has a long line.  It's takeout only which can be kind of a pain.  There is a park across the street but it's kind of depressing.   Anyway the food itself is really delicious, and the amount of food you get is ridiculous compared to what you are paying.  I normally get a 3 item combo over rice for only $6.  You get a mountain of food for this price.  I really like that the meats are cut to order and not precut - so it's really tasty and fresh.  Another review wrote about the spot between the window shields where you can get sprayed with grease while the guy with the big knife is hacking away at the meat - they are totally right!  So watch out for that.   Love this place.

Friendly & accommodating counter staff; clean bathroom; good music at a pleasant volume; really tasty, tender & juicy Chicago-style Italian beef sandwiches; you are offered the au jus dipped or on the side; you are offered chipotle mayonnaise on the side; sweet potato fries, crispy on the outside & moist on the inside; I love it here! I first met the proprietress at the Taste of Essex event in 2014, where, by the way, she won the award for best entree with her turkey burger! So I came to check it out, and now I've come back, and am very satisfied, again!

I was recently on vacation to New York with some friends and was told by a New Yorker that Juniors was the place to go for cheesecake. We stopped in after our show, great that they're open late and not too crowded, even on a Friday night. We shared some buffalo chicken fingers and fries, and they did not disappoint. Huge chunks of chicken, lightly breaded with a very different, but great buffalo sauce. After dinner, we decided on the original cheesecake, which was outstanding! Such a perfect density and flavor. We also had superb service, the best we had in New York, from Mary! She was so friendly and sweet. We loved it south we came back the next day for a couple of slices to go, this time a raspberry swirl and chocolate swirl. Again, amazing! I lived it so much I plan on mail ordering one so my family can try it. Very satisfied!

Nearby Chinese place. Affordable price. Service is really great.. The lady welcomed me with a warm smile. Food is average. Hot n sour soup was quiet bland. Chicken lo me in was good. Could be an emergency takeout place for Union ave residents.
Great ambiance, great music and of course great tiramisu and wine. I strongly recommend you to visit here.

I was there last night and WOW is all I can say. They have renovated the restaurant really really nice.  The food is still amazing, were thinking it was new owners but we found out its still the same owners. Father and 2 sons still running the place. They changed their waiter but he was really nice and he knows the menu, he was on top of things whenever we needed water or bread he was there to give it to us. I would definitely recommend this place.

The Best Burger and fries in Carroll Gardens!!!! The Beef Burger was cooked perfectly and was topped with melted Camembert Cheese and crispy Bacon. The home cut fries were crispy on the outside and cooked just right on the inside and tossed in rock salt. The Outside seating makes it a great place to enjoy lunch during the week.

Once upon a time, I gave this place 3-4 stars. It was never like what you'd find in an urban Chinatown, but it was decent for small-town Chinese cuisine. Although they have the staples of Polynesian-American "Chinese" food, the menu is nicely balanced with semi-authetic items, including things like tripe, jellyfish, chicken feet, and har gow (shrimp dumplings). The problem lately is not the selection, but the quality. I had one meal a few months ago that was so bad, I would have sent it back had I been dining at the restaurant (which is something I never do). But, as it was take-out and I live 15 minutes away, I didn't think it was worth the return trip, and I chalked it up to an off night. However, each time I've been back since then (three times), the food was still awful. I don't know if they lost their head chef or what's going on, but the food is now bland, cooked wrong (either under or overcooked, at random), and often missing items. Unfortunately, they have the market cornered in Hanover, so I doubt they have any incentive to change. But, if a decent Chinese place opened in town, they could drive this place out of business in a month. Unless you're stuck in Hanover and can't live without some semblance of Chinese food, I would definitely avoid this place. The way it is right now, I'd be hard pressed to eat this food if it were free. I'm definitely not paying for it.
The Cioppino was fantastic!!! Seafood in it was delicious. And the staff were very nice and attentive even though the bar area was very busy.
Awsome pizza with a very attentive staff. Worth stopping by for a slice, salad or complete dinner. Pick anything and you'll enjoy!
Everything we had here was delicious and fresh. There were some really interesting flavors that were new for me, so I really enjoyed it. Good prices, and good service.

Does not disappoint. We were a little worried that it wouldn't live up to the expectations the original SS created, but burgers are just as good and the line isn't as painfully long (at least not yet...a little worried about once the line does get consistently long as we'll be waiting halfway down 77th Street). The space is great, and the employees are incredibly inc
One of the best places to walk around and explore way too many food options.

This place is one of the best that I've been to. The mushroom turnovers and the fried pickles are amazing, the burgers are juicy and delicious, but my favorite is the fish and chips. I go to Oxcart almost on a weekly basis, and would highly recommend this place to everyone.

I have been eating at talk of the town now for over a year. The quality of food and service is great and has only gotten better and better over time.  The place is clean all the time. The best thing is no foam plates are used here. I'm happy that this place is close to where I live and i don't have to drive a few miles. I have been and will continue to happily recommend this place to my friends. Good job 'Talk Of The Town', keep up the great job.

My friends and I went here for our friends giving last year and my I can't wait to go back this year. So this place is in the back streets of Chinatown which kinda made it hard for my friends and I to find, but we were very glad we did. The wait was about 20 minutes which wouldn't have been bad if it wasn't pouring outside and the only place to stand and wait was outside the restaurant not ok when your umbrella is flying away and you weren't weather prepared. Anyhow we weren't able to be seated until all of our guests were present which made the wait a little longer, which was our friends fault. When we were seated we were immediately greeted by a waiter and he took our drink orders. The only problem was that we could barely understand him and vice versa ( good thing our friend spoke Chinese because One of my friends was allergic to peanuts and the waiter couldn't understand that in english.) The food was amazing we literally ordered 2 orders of Pork, Chicken and Beef dumplings, 2 orders of rice (fried rice, and chicken fried rice) The shredded pork soup was phenomenal! For approximately 8 of us the food portions were average and it did leave me personally full. The drink variety is slim but the food variety is amazing. We're having our annual Friendsgiving there again this year and I can't wait to try the duck this time!

Great Find in midtown!  I'm always looking for a hip restaurant with creative food, not a stuffy, formal place of which there are many in NYC.  I wanted East side, small plates, interesting food pairings and upscale, contemporary atmosphere.  The service was terrific as was the food.  We are from the SF Bay area and have superb food choices and Vitae was equally as terrific as our local hot spots in Silicon Valley or SF.  The veal meatballs were excellent, juicy, tasty and interesting, and I'm not a meatball lover.  The sashimi was deliious but not as interesting, and the pulled pork tacos melted in our mouths and the duck was cooked perfectly with bacon and herb flavor.  Well done dish but not my favorite to have bacon with duck.  Wine list was generous with CA wines.  WE liked that.  And the server who is from Kansas, was excellent.  We will be back and are happy we found a new place to visit for dinner. Katie from SF

Their Washu Gyu Hamburg is incredibly delicious with the sauce. What I recommend so far are 1. Washu-Gyu Hamburg 2. Chicken Nanban 3. Harami Aburi (not sure the name) They are still BYOB open. I cannot wait for full open. I need to cover their whole mune. Thanks to Yudai who is the BOSS!!
My girlfriend and I came here for dinner. Delicious food and a very friendly staff.  I highly recommend.   We look forward to returning for another wonderful meal.
Always yummy food and drinks service is great just very busy but we'll worth it my family has been coming here 3 decades  and live close by they are amazing

Had a awesome meal here the other night ordered food for take out perfectly cooked burger great quality meat delicious meal very happy with the service and they havens great atmosphere and beer selection highly recommended
I'm not a pancake person, but the banana pancake is superb. Everything you'd want in a cozy diner!
I used to work here so I know it's good lol I hope to go soon I miss this place especially the food
Had dinner tonight. Awesome sushi, fresh and good portions. Chicken teriyaki was very good, chicken was tender and no fat!

Great atmosphere, true smokehouse smell, mouth watering food, and fantasic customer service. These are all things you get when you go to FunniBonz. The price is right for what you receive. I see people stating that they have to wait long...It isn't a fast food joint like McDonald's. They do have to actually cook fries and smoke the burger meat. 10 minutes to wait is not long for fresh food. The food is AMAZING! I've been there twice and had the pulled pork and smokehouse burger. The burger is one of my all time favorites! The pulled pork was tender and perfectly sesoned. Jim, one of the owners, is OUTSTANDING! He is genuine, beyond friendly, and welcoming. He truly cares about his customers and it shows! He goes out on the floor and talks to his guests and treats them as if they're his family. I have never experienced customer service so great, and I work in the hospitality industry! I recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for great bbq and awesome service! I know I can't wait to return!
It gives student 10% discount so the dinner was like 10 dollars, which is very cheap. The hibachi was my favorite, but the sushi was not that fresh, so I will give a 4 star.
Great service and delicious food! I went there for dinner on Wednesday night and everything was great. My friend and I had a good time.  No complain!
Expensive for what the quality of the food is. I am shocked that this place has received such high reviews. I tried a variety of menu options none of which stood out for me.

Came in just for a banana and fig smoothie, and o m g thats as good as it gets! Not too thick not too thin, not too sweet but not too bitter, by far the best smoothies in town! I wish they a location closer to work but ugh, will definitely make the trip back to try another smoothie!

This is a diamond in a sea of Quartz !!! I came to  Confessional last week and was blown away with the intimate atmosphere, the food, the drinks, and most importantly, the service. The place was relatively busy, but we only waited a few minutes for a table and the manager was unbelievably sweet and accommodating . The food was fantastic...a great blend of Latino and Americano that really turned on the palate !! Try the lamb chops, the shrimp chicharron, the sliders, and every mixed drink you can handle.....this place is is fantastic!!! I'll be back often, and I totally recommend it to everyone!!!

I love this restaurant!  the food is delicious, plenty and well priced. The ambience is happy, but make sure you are not in a hurry, this place gets packed.  Don't leave without trying their margaritas.. they are the best! :)
Super cute & cozy & very clean!! Great food super fresh!- & most importantly brought fast to the table! The staff is nice & friendly. I will definitely come again! Thanks!!

Dosa was very bland.chutney was bland.to surprise the name phili chutney company ,but they give frozen chutney in a small cup,and not fresh.it was Americanized dosa.samosa were too oily,idli were very bad and very bad smelling.i couldn't understand how it got these reviews.will never visit again.

Where I live in East Hartford Chef Greg worked just around the corner and that restaurant was my Favorite place to eat because of him.  Homemade sweet potato ravioli with a balsamic drizzle and fried basil...ummmm. The most amazing innovative dishes, everything was a treat from soup- Tomato Sausage Florentine, one of my favs, to desert- that summer he played with creating ice cream flavors, I have to say the ricotta tart with basil ice cream was crazy good!! Nolita's made their BEST move inviting Greg to this lovely place where he is encouraged to create his wonderful, delicious, gifts.  We had a reservation for 9 last  Friday and each and everyone LOVED the soups, entrees, and deserts that we sampled. Thank you for giving Chef Greg the best quality ingredients and a place to create his flavorful art.
A "must" restaurant!
Amazing, interesting decor. Margarita pitchers were great and not weak. Nachos we ordered were average. Service was ok, not exceptional. Would go back for more margaritas and cool decor.

Shahnawaz is the nearest Pakistani Halal restaurant to where I live. And this branch location in North Brunswick is certainly a lot better than their other older restaurant in Edison NJ. The Ambiance is good, the sitting arrangement is a lot better.The buffet is good as well, their food overall is just okay, nothing too impressive. A few items that are noteworthy, their lamb chops, Chicken Tikka masala, and chicken/ beef bihari kabab are very good. Their chicken biryani or Chicken korma and karhayee isn't praiseworthy. Although, i've found their russmalaayee to be spoiled twice (not in a row). This place is easy to find, the location is very convenient, close to pretty much every highway (rt 1, Rt 130, 4 miles from Exit 8A and Exit 9 on the NJ Turnpike). For someone not looking for something too special this should be a good fit.
Great bar. You smell the delicious food when you walk in.  And Walter makes a mean cocktail.

Worst place ever. The manager is an incompetent pompous individual who treats customers like dirt. I have never had a more infuriating experience at a restaurant in my life. I can't wait for flat top to go out of business. That manager brings Shame to the whole neighborhood. If I could I would rate it 0
Had the trio platter and it was so delicious!! So much food but well worth it.

Coming from the San Francisco Bay Area, where we have plenty of amazing food options, we can be a little picky...but this place rose to the challenge.  Definitely one of the best meals we've had since arriving on the East Coast.  We went for lunch.  The grilled cheese with pulled pork sandwich was amazing, and so was the squash soup. The only thing I wasn't crazy about was the apple cobbler...it tasted smokey like it had been cooked in the same oven as meat (which it probably was).  Our server was GREAT, and when we asked for just a sample of the fig ice cream, he brought us a whole scoop.  It was pricey, over $100 for the 4 of us for lunch (including 4 beverages and 2 desserts), but sometimes good food is worth the money.

Some really good options. The 'special' grilled cheese of the day was great - mozzarella and pesto panni. The food service area is very, very small. Some might call it cozy.They do provide table service and waitstaff, unlike some very small boutique dining establishments. Overall a very nice option in a quaint area of Montclair.

Went to have breakfast it was 10:30am.  Asked someone about getting some eggs she said to late setting up for lunch. Said ok grabbed a corn muffin was fixing some coffee ask where's the butter and the person at the cash register said where it was. Was adding sugar and cream to the coffees and some lady goes hurry up we are closing. So why didn't someone say that when we grabbed a try? Well we just left everything there and left. The only reason gave 1star is because you can't do less
This restaurant is one of my favorite now。 cuz  the noodle taste awesome。 the fish is fresh . specially sashimi deluxe. love it!

Cheap but not worth your time. There are so many other delicious restaurants here in NY, and although this place is cheap, definitely not worth it. ==== I was really excited to try this place after reading all the Yelp reviews, but I was really disappointed. The ingredients are not fresh. You can tell that they masked the taste of the meat with a lot of salt and soy sauce. And the place didn't look very clean and made me nervous about what I was putting in my stomach (And this coming from someone who grew up in Asia...). Lastly, the dumplings I received were transferred from another container to my takeout box. It was clear that it was sitting out for some time.... Also, I waited 15 minutes for my dumplings and then was told that they were out. There aren't many places to sit at this place. And it does get pretty busy... Have some cash on hand if you decide to try this place!
Really amazing Italian food! We look forward to returning. I had the chicken marsala and it was wonderful. Huge portions as well, for a decent price.
Wide variety of sandwiches, some tastier than others but overall very good. Would recommend to friends. Try the pulled pork with mancheo cheese and crispy onions
Good, simple, Indian food.  I don't understand the poor reviews.
Was always a fan of the truck and the business moving to the next level has taken the food with it. The entire menu is awesome and the people couldn't be nicer!

Overall it was a okay stop for lunch, but I was hoping for much more. Our server wasn't very attentive (did not get a refill once on water, had to ask for just about everything) and there was confusion with our orders and the check. Our food was mediocre at best (we ate off the lunch menu), especially for the price.
It seemed like the quality of food was below average.
I LOVE TACO EL BRONCOS! the best chicken tacos... my go to spot for tacos
Authentic and delicious food in a beautiful setting - you feel like you're in a little Parisian cafe!

I have never written a review before but was prompted to put cursor to laptop by the wonderful dining experience I had at Emporio. My wife and I decided to have our wedding dinner for 18 people at Emporio on Oct 24th. We had a long table in the back room and had a fixed menu family style. I can't say enough about the food, the ambience and the service at this restaurant. The charred octopus was exquisite as was the pizza, burrata and steak. The staff were wonderful and allowed us to linger with our guests without any pressure to leave. I would unreservedly recommend Emporio and particularly anyone looking for a great place for a small wedding dinner or any other larger party celebratory occasion.

This is the best bar in Belleville,  maybe even essex county!  Great food, drinks, music and the staff is A+++++++  love this place.  They even have a night every Wednesday that they have free dance lessons and latin music all night long.
The Ramen is extremely flavorful. Quick and friendly service.
awesome ramen. way too popular now.
one of the best pork buns!!!! and a better chance of getting in here than momofuko. but I also feel like their ramens are better than momofuko's as well.

I just love drinking green tea out of those little cups! Who doesn't! But this place has some great ramen and the spicy pork is my personal favorite. The fish is also great that's what my boyfriend says, but I don't try it since fish isn't my favorite! Friendly and attentive staff also this is a must go!

Place has gone down hill and they changed the bbq sauce on the ribs no longer the Nice sweet barbecue sauce now it's that cheap sauce that the Chinese restaurants use don't know what happened use to order from them for all sports events sad to say they will never see me there again

This place is definitely over hyped. I had better ramen in SF and didn't have to wait 2 hrs to get it. I was excited to try this place out because of all the reviews and they said their soup was really flavorful. Well, I came here around 7 one day with my boyfriend and we had to wait about 2 hrs for a party of 2 on a Wednesday. So we decided to walk around and come back. Once we came back, we waited again for another half an hr before getting called to be seated. The place had a nice ambience and was pretty modern for a ramen spot. Once we got seated, we were ready to order. We started with the steamed pork buns, which were pretty good. Nice texture and flavor. Then I ordered the Karaka-men with an egg and my boyfriend ordered the other the Akamaru Modern. It didn't take long for our food to come out but when they did, my boyfriends bowl had a egg in it (which he didn't order), and the server asked if we were sharing. I said no, and he left. I waited for about 15 mins wondering where my bowl of ramen was. We were seated right near the kitchen, so I saw them make it for the people who have sat down after us, but mines never came. So I asked our waitress where my order was, and she went to go check and it turns out that she only imputed one order and forgot about mines. She then quickly apologized and said that it would be coming out shortly. Finally after about 30 mins of waiting for my food, my ramen arrived, but it wasn't what I ordered. They gave me the Akamaru Modern. I didn't want to bother her again so I just ate it since I was hungry. The flavor of the ramen did not impress me at all. I don't know if it was because I waited so long that everything just tasted meh or because it really lacked a lot of flavor. After we finished, the waitress again apologized and said that the manager is giving us a complimentary dessert for their mistake. I can't say no to desserts and it did make me feel better that they were compensating us for their mistake. Overall, I don't know if I would come here again. For the price we paid, I could of went somewhere else and had a better meal and service.

You know a place is great when you cant name the best thing you ate because they were all just.so.good.   We debated ordering the tasting menu, but ended up going a la carte.  We had: bacon tater tots scallop crudo oysters burrata ribeye panna cotta I can honestly say everything was excellent.  Even the bathroom was clean and maintained nicely.  Will definitely be back soon.
My FAV!
Burgers were heavenly. My boyfriend and I will return.

We were almost carried away by the fruit flies!  We went to Min Ghung for dinner on Monday night (10/27/14) and the first thing we noticed was that there was nobody in the place! The second thing we noticed was that the new owner has completely changed the menu and boy have the prices gone up!  We asked about the Happy Hour Specials and were disappointed to hear that it ended in September.  We also noticed that they had a sign for a "Sake Tasting" which they're having on Halloween night - who in their right mind would plan that on a night when most are home with their children?  The owners obviously don't know what they're doing and based on the amount of fruit flies attacking us during our meal, we have to question the cleanliness of the kitchen!  This used to be one of my favorite sushi restaurants but sadly, it's gone way down hill :(

Put in a good size order of food  it was a vast array of different types of foods ranging from pastas,eggplant chicken Parmesan and for some reason everything tasted just mediocre sauce was very acidy and price we're not cheap sorry to say there's much better places to eat in new haven for the same money I have gone here many times for events and party's but recently food quality had sadly decreased do yourself a favor and pick another place to enjoy Italian

Pizza was edible (buffalo chicken, we just wanted food to keep from being hungry) but they delivered the wrong wings (I paid for boneless and was given bone in wings) and they forgot the blue cheese. Going to go by tomorrow and ask for my money back for the wings, will change to 3/4 star if they do that for me. Pretty upset right now though.

We've been ordering from them for years.  Years!  They're pretty much a subpar Chinese and Japanese place, moreso in the last year or so when we realized there were much better joints out there.  Still, if you want quick and edible Chinese, they're the place to order from. I've turned a blind eye to the subpar food but horrible service I will not stand for.  We ordered online and half the food was missing.  I called, kindly told the lady there and she argued that she was right, despite my reading to her what her website states.  She was rude, irrational, and not friendly.  I even took screenshots to prove her wrong.  In the end, I just hung up.  They will never get my business again.  And I will be sure to pass along my review to others.  The customer is always right, something they need to learn something fierce.

Tuckerbox has always been a staple of downtown White River.  It serves the local businesses with delicious gourmet coffees, teas and lattes.  They are now serving amazing Turkish cuisine for dinner meals.  We had a feast of a cold appetizer, hot appetizer and a kabob meal.  We thoroughly enjoyed every bite of our meal! We chose a Turkish Syra for wine, it was amazingly smooth and delicious.  The desserts were equally as enjoyable. Beyond the delicious food was the warm, comfortable atmosphere and the outstanding server (May).  She was friendly, helpful and genuinely kind.   We would highly recommend the new and improved Tuckerbox.  Visit anytime of day, you're sure to enjoy your experience and tasty treats!

What a delicious Italian restaurant!  I went there tonight with a group of nine of my friends, and we were all delighted!  The restaurant is so cozy and it looks like an authentic trattoria italiana.  The food was exceptional.... We all had the Price Fixed menu and we ate soooo much!  Everything tasted delicious all the way through dessert (the tiramisu is out of this world).  The owner/chef was incredible.  Super attentive  and kept coming to our table to check on us.  From beginning to end, i couldn't have asked for a better experience.  Tanti grazie!

Had a bad experience with this place. Took my sis along with me to this joint. Since we eat only chicken .. Asked if they have chicken param. They remade the cheese pizza they had into chicken Param. Soo the crust was like biscuits. I couldn't eat them.

Definitely one of my favorite places in the city. You get a huge cheese steak for an average price for cheese steaks and they're very tasty.  If you're willing to travel to a slightly sketchy area, it'll be worth your trip.

My husband and I went here for my birthday dinner because of a friend's recommendation. My husband is THE pickiest eater in the world and he loved his meal! He had the traditional Venezuelan dish of shredded beef over rice and beans, and I had the short ribs over polenta. We both were in heaven with our meals but what made our experience even better was the owner, who personally checked in with us and even helped us order. Another bonus was the woman from Venezuela sitting at the next table over who commented to us that when she eats at Jojoto, she feels like she is eating at home. Everything we had was amazing: the arepitas (on the house and a delicious start) beef empanadas, and toston were all mouth watering and delicious, my sangria was made perfectly, and my husband couldn't stop raving about the place. I know I found a winner when even he will eat from the menu and has expressed desire to return again and bring friends! Oh yeah did I mention the entertainment? Right in the middle of our dinner the music stopped and an incredibly talented woman started singing and dancing throughout the restaurant. I've never experienced anything like it before and had so much fun, I cannot wait to return.

Found Tashan on Yelp while searching for an Indian place that would be new and interesting. Enjoyed myself thoroughly! The food was very tasty, very well presented and Portion sizes were just right! It was interesting to watch the chefs work in the open kitchen. We were there during Restaurant Week, tried the Chef's Tasting Menu and though there werent as many vegetarian options, they did accommodate us  with extra choices where they could.   Looking forward to an opportunity to go again with friends and family!!!

Had lunch here today food was delicious I had a chicken noodle dish was very good customer service was great the meal was $16 for 2 people with drink great deal and good food i'm a very picky person the place was clean and it was well worth the trip
Affordable and high quality.
Amazing food, friendly staff & great prices. The conch fritters were to die for. I will be coming back again !
Great food (we had the aged steak and the roasted chicken), the service was very friendly. We'll go again!
3 words...on the money!!!

Don't generally base an opinion on an establishment after only being there one time, but holy cow.... Pizza was alright, but seemed very expensive for what it was. The thing that killed me was the service! Absolutely TERRIBLE! Ordered a soda that took about half an hour to arrive. After food was delivered not one person stopped by the table to check on us. Went up to get a refill on my drink because nobody was coming back, one of the workers looked at me(and clearly saw I had an empty glass) and turned around. Stood there for a few minutes hoping someone would help me but I got nothing. The other thing that I thought odd was that during the check out they ask if you want to put a tip on it right away. I understand filling that out yourself if you have a paper receipt, but felt that it was quite rude they be so upfront about it. Definitely won't be coming back here.
Might be the best sushi I've had since moving to the city over a year ago.  The waiter was helpful and we loved the atmosphere.  Already have another reservation.

Great new addition to the hood! I went about a month ago with friends and we had a lovely experience.  Both managers were very nice and friendly as well as both of the bartenders.  I love the bar and the vibe of this place. They have an awesome selection of Tequilas.  I tried the Lobster Tacos which was superb, the Beef Empanadas which I thought were delicious, and the Salmon Tartare which was excellent as well.  I really am looking forward to trying their Skirt Steak! Yum!
Top notch pizza, cute environment, great staff, I'll be back.

This is the first time I order take out and had to eat left overs. After waiting about an hour for the food to be delivered, the shrimp in garlic sauce was cold, and my picadinho with shrimp had NO shrimp. They also forgot my two liter coke. Of course I called but was placed on hold twice. Needless to say, I will not order from this place again.

I have been coming here since the last 8 years most of the time after work hours. It used to be an ok place with decent service. But today when I entered this place,  it smelt like public restroom, floors are sticky and there is a stench in the air. I am not coming again
Pizza's always great, and I love the crust. If you're anywhere nearby, gotta go.

When I travel I'm all about finding the hidden gems. Yoshi Sono is a hidden gem! I'm having the Leslie Roll consisting of shrimp tempura, cucumber and spicy tuna with wasabi mayo. Delicious! Some edamame and hot sake and all in the world is right. Kicks Ass and Balls! お尻とボールをキック

Impossible to order a bad dish for lunch or dinner but.. What makes this place more special? In the middle of the West Village i.e. Brunch places everywhere, Meme has the best Sat/Sun brunch food in Manhattan. The homemade chicken sausage with eggs and apple/sweet potato hash (recently added) is a triumph.
No amount of neon and flash will make what they pass for a cheese steak any good.  There are SO many good cheese steak options in the city and none of them are anywhere near this intersection.
Definitely lived up to the reviews, try the "tower" dessert and roasted peppers appetizer Great decor, and good service too.

We just found out about Pingala last week and have been looking forward to trying it. First, the location is incredible. It is in an old converted woolen mill and has a beautiful view overlooking the river. The cafe itself has a wonderful mural on one wall and is casual with an outdoor patio. I had the Vermonter, which was spot on. I love how generous they were with the greens on the sandwich, and the flavors were perfect. Apple, nut-based house made Gouda, eggplant bacon - WOW. I love to see some new flavors in the vegan food space. That said, the food here can easily please the palate of anyone, vegan or not.
I usually drive to Hudson county to get my Cuban on.  But Pete's is a very good place that is close, with good food and nice staff.  Go early if you don't want to wait,.
Bacon Jam Burger is amazing!  Great management.   Looking forward to a return visit soon.
Great food, classy staff, and a beautiful ceiling.

Nicolas used to be my favorite restaurant in the area. Unfortunately, since they moved from Hawthorne the food has gone down hill. We ordered chicken Marcela tonight and the sauce was like water. No flavor at all and the mushrooms appeared to be canned. My daughter would not even eat the water soaked chicken. Perhaps today was a really off day, but we will not be returning for overpriced boiled chicken.

I had to try their pizza because of the hype. i would not go back. The price was very high . $4 extra for sausage and i could hardly find any as well as the sauce. there was none.  maybe 1 tbsp. drop on the whole pie.Maybe it is because i am used to new Haven, the best, pizza but I don;t like basil on my pizza. It may look good but doesn't belong. There are too many good pizza places around for me to go back. The prices were so overpriced also.

If 3 1/2 stars where an option... Nothing wrong with Handy's Lunch it just never wows me and they could use a makeover.  Staffs friendly and helpful.  Pretty quick if you want white bread and non local beef.
If you're gay, do not come here because bartender Luis will call you a faggot in Spanish. I am disgusted and hurt. No way to run a restaurant. You deserve 0 stars.

If your in the mood for something different this is the place.  Its not cheap so be warned.  Its not a place to stop for a quick thing you need to sit down and allow the food and drink to wash over you and enjoy the ride.

Ugh...so overhyped. Not worth the wait at ALL. I've had macarons straight from Paris before and these don't even compare. Isn't this place supposed to be just as good at macarons in Paris?? I've had plenty of macarons here in California that are far more tastier than Laduree so I really don't understand the hype. I thought these macarons were going to be life changing so I ordered $70 worth. Immediately, I regretted doing so when I stepped outside of the shop to take a bite into the pistachio. What a complete let down! Do yourself a favor and skip this place, instead go get some delicious cookies at Levain Bakery!

I've been here a number of times and have always had a great experience!  It's a really great place to spend some time with friends and enjoy exceptionally good food and a nice selection of wines and beer.

Love the food..  Awesome Salads burgers and soups.and their quesadillas are awesome...  Tina the best waitress fun and great sense of humor...  Favorite Hostess is Reham!  Friendly staff.  Reasonable prices. Open 24 hours so great get away for a late night snack or cup of coffee

I attended a small birthday party here and we all had a blast.  The pizza was thin crusted the way I like it and  the drinks are prepared perfectly.  Some people think drinks are expensive when they cost 12.00 but if they are made with enough liquor that you can actually taste then they are not over priced at all.  This establishment knows how to make a real drink.  Service was good and all the food was prepared deliciously. No complaints from any us and there was 16 loud individuals at our table.  I will be back  for sure.
Great place - staff is awesome, nice selection and make sure to try the deviled eggs!

I only made a yelp account so I could give this restaurant five stars.  I have tried nearly everything on their lunch special menu and have never been disappointed.  I especially love their gyu don lunch box and sushi rolls.  The prices are great, and they have special discounts for Jefferson students and faculty.   The service is what makes this place stand out from any other restaurant I have ever been to.  The owner is so friendly to all his guests and personally thanks them for coming.  Every once in a while he'll whip up an extra ice cream or kimchee fries for his customers.  For my friend's birthday, he not only bought happy birthday balloons as table centerpieces, but also handed out four plates of kimchee fries on the house.  FOUR PLATES.  The waiters/waitresses are all very courteous as well.   This is definitely one of the best sushi/japanese places around town, especially for their lunch specials (although their specialty rolls are heavenly as well). I highly recommend it!
I am really happy that there is a French Restaurant in Brooklyn. Beautiful space with a friendly staff. Just went for a beer, I have to check out the food.   Look forward to going again. Cheers
Woohoo! As godo as it gets!
Great selection if wine and tapas.  Love their cheese menu.  I've been here multiple times and it never fails amaze me.  Definitely worth the trip if you're into vet wine or cheese.

Really large variety of sweets. Place was crowded and service at the sweets counter was slow but it was worth it I guess because the sweets we got were indeed good. Watch out for $15 min on credit cards, luckily we had cash.
Went here awhile ago with a few friends. It was very delicious and super cheap, for 5 of us it was just around $70 before tip. Service was okay, nothing special, but I will definitely be going back.

Nice ambience. The food was good and the waiter was kind. The food really tasty we tried the Salmon burger and the lasagna with eggplant and tofu (could have been a bigger portion). The end result was very pleasant

I had such high hope for this place, but I was greatly disappointed for my first visit yesterday 10/29/14, which was also my birthday. The server was pleasant; however, the food was way too salty. My husband and I had the Simon Bisque soup, Clam bake, seafood risotto, meatloaf, all of them were salty. I understand if one of the dishes were salty, but all of them...I was extremely disappointed for a restaurant with great service and nice ambience, the food could be better!!! For dessert, we had Crème Brulee, it was cold and the sugary top was even crunchy. And I ordered a cappuccino, I got a latte instead. Overall, it was extremely a letdown.
Yummy dumplings on the cheap!  Their sesame pancakes are also fresh, fluffy, and delicious.  There's 3-4 chairs in the space, but be prepared to be eating on the streets, or bring them home!

This place is slipping.  For years it was our favorite in the entire area.  The past two times, it was disappointing.  The bean soup is far less flavorful than it used to be and was served nearly room temp the last time.  The crab stuffed peppers are nowhere near as good as in the past.  Even the portion size of the white anchovies is shrinking.  Many of our all-time favorites are just not close to what we're used to tasting.  Still excellent flat breads, but who drives an hour on a weekend for great flat breads. Used to be impossible to get seating on a Friday night unless you lucked out at the bar.  The last trip we (party of 2) showed up at 5:30 and were seated right away.  Seems like we're not the only ones noticing a slide.
Words cannot describe how good the food was!

Ever since this place opened i've eaten here numerous times and if you are into latin cuisine this place is one of the best. The scenery and the view the city is breathtaking. The food is very delicious one of my favorite things there is the lobster mac and cheese. If you are planning to go dont be such a hardass on judging the service in this place, it needs a lots of work. But the managers and the bartenders are pretty chill so if youre food comes out late or theres a slight problem with your food they will be more than happy to drown you with drinks on the house.

Overpriced coffee, overpriced hot chocolate, overpriced everything. This place is strictly for rich and wealthy folk, or for the European visitors that dont know any better. I don't see the big fuss about the place, but I don't fit the adjectives listed earlier. $6 for a hot chocolate... 'nuff said. Eli's is around the corner from this place, and Marche Madison is a block away. Spend your money in either of those places.

While I miss Chef Yasuda, this place still delivers and I try to get there on an occasional visit back to NYC.  Definitely sit at the sushi bar for the best experience.  Gotta go with the omakase and ask the chef to suggest a sake.  Guaranteed awesome experience and major sushi coma!

Food is good but  pricy.  When they first opened a couple years ago, the BBQ sandwich was only $2.50, but now it's over $5.  Service was terrible.  But if you order to go, then it's fine.  Their crab noodle soup is also good.

first time on Staten Island and New York for the matter, stumbled off the ferry into this place. Was greeting very welcoming by very quickly seated. I liked the atmosphere and the cool custom painting on the walls that showed all of NYC which was cool for a visitor like me to see. I had the corned beef hash which was great! Would recommend this place to visitors or residents!

I'm normally not one to write reviews, good or bad, but, today I just had to. I've passed this place many times and have always been curious. I now finally work right around the corner, as in I could walk there in 10 minutes, so I decided to finally try it out. After putting my order in at 2:15pm, way after any lunch rush would be, I waited an hour and 15 minutes to pay $13 for a cold grilled chicken wrap (which was not terrible but not great) and cold, soggy curly fries. About 50 mins after I placed the order I called and asked how much longer it would be and I was told it was leaving the place then. Now like I said, I work right around the corner and don't see how it could take another 25 mins for it to get here. Once it finally arrive I was greeted by a teenager who was wearing sunglasses (even thought it was cloudy) and gave me the reason that they were really busy. Now, I've worked at numerous Pizza places while I was a teenager and I know how long certain things should take. Not once did the guy on the phone tell me they were busy or that it would be remotely close to this long of a wait. Finally, the price for the quality food I was served was crap. I do not mind paying money for food but, when it takes that long and tastes that shitty, it gets me angry. Overall, I wish the person answering the phone would have told me it would have been that long of a wait so I could avoided all of this and just gotten food elsewhere. Although maybe I owe him a thanks so now I know to never order again.

This is the kind of place that you honestly consider breaking into at 5am to steal a slab of their brisket. Absolutely to die for. I have tried the entire menu (Pulled pork, brisket, ribs, sausage, wings, whole chicken) and have loved each and every moment of it. There can be a line outside nearly every night, but the 5 minute wait and very reasonable pricing is worth it. I can easily spend $25-30 here, but if you are tight on cash, you could be happy with a $9-13 dinner investment. Can't recommend enough for anyone after an authentic BBQ experience. The brisket is the best thing on the menu.

Amazing seafood, such as Ceviche with Octopus, Squid and Shrimp, and entrees, such as Tacu Tacu with fish, Jalea and A lo Pobre. Wonderful Tres Leche Cake at the end of the meal. Great service in a nice, quaint, vibrant setting. We look forward to having our favorites every time.

With such a  poor food quality, Atera is arguably one of the worst michelin star restaurants I've been to in my whole life. The service was OK but not superior. But really, the food here is more than disappointing that I feel sorry for wasting so much money dining here. You'll have a much better dining experience if you go to Le Bernadin or Eleven Madison Park instead of this place. Seafood here is disgusting and meat here are overcooked and poorly flavored, while vegetable dishes are either too salty or tasteless. Desserts are OK but not enough to compensate for poor quality of other dishes.

Only issue is you cannot read the menu it is so dark in there. I had to use my phone to read it. But other than that, everything was amazing. The fried chicken and bacon pancakes are worth having. Drinks are excellent and all of the pickles are tasty! It's worth the wait!
Love this place! Can't say I've ever had a better bartender than Devin. He's an all around treat and the place wouldn't be the same without him!

Staff was quick and friendly, food was above average, portions were big.  We got a few dishes to go and I really liked how they didn't skimp on the to go containers.  They even put the Thai tea in separate containers so it would taste like it should when you got it home.  Keep up the great work!
BOMB!  Small venue but great food!! Loved it.
Have been eating here since i was 9, the food has always been good... the rice here is the best by far... plus if you go by the buffet side they serve you a lot!

Such a wonderful spot! Quick service, great quality, friendly staff. I enjoyed the grilled skirt steak with the Rosemary potatoes and spinach, affordable pricing at $16. The decor is eclectic and artistic. Ryan and Paul were awesome! Definitely worth checking out when you're in the neighborhood.
Great food, great beer.  Service was great.  Tried beer samplers, pizza was amazing. Save room for pumpkin dessert it was delicious.

Food was COLD today!!!  I had a BBQ veggie burger and fries 2 weeks ago and Love them so much!  But today my fries are cold (seemed they were sitting there for a while... and the burger wasn't hot either kinda warm-cold. I really think Food there is very very good.  But I refused to pay $10 for cold FOOD.  Soooo sad but not coming back...

You don't have a lot to spend? And you want a ton of food? Well this is the spot. Literally a hole in the wall, with practically no seating and a line out the door. Prosperity Dumpling is a legendary spot out here. The women who are taking the orders are shouting to get you in and out as quick as possible. It's rude but it's the real deal. The pricing is dirt cheap and you really get your money's worth. I got the pork dumplings boiled and fried. Both were spilling out with juices. YUM! And we got the egg sesame pancake. Greasy goodness! I spent about 7 bucks and it was enough food for 4 ppl. Impressive. These are the places I love.

please, if you are really looking for a cheesesteak, DO NOT get one from here.  Soggy, gristle-filled awefulness.  There are so many good options in the city- none of which are anywhere near this intersection.

Omg if you have a problem with this place there must be something wrong with you!!  Excellent food, service and ambiance!!!  I've been here several times and each time blows me away more then the last!!  Try it for yourself..ps..those Brussel sprouts with bacon and candied walnuts A MUST!!!!  Thank you for always an amazing meal and experience!!!  :)
They deliver which is tough to find in Parsippany.  we've had the salads, chili and wraps for lunch at the office.  Love the mayo-less potato salad.

I am disturbed and confused. My family and I have ordered from here since they have opened but tonight was the worst phone experience I have ever had. Long story short, I called to place an order for pick up and was told to call back in 5 minutes then dial tone. I called back, asked if we got disconnected and was told "no, we weren't disconnected, do you want to order?" I said " no but I will come to the store." Got to the store, a man walked to the register, I asked if he was the person who I just spoke to about the call back in 5 min., he said yes. I asked " what was that all about?" He said "we didn't get disconnected. Do you still want to order?" I asked his name and said "no, Leo," which he told me was his name. I will never spend any money there again and I hope my friends and family follow. I did like the food. Thanks Leo!!
The atmosphere food and drinks are all wonderful.  Never have had bad service here.  Such a great place to cone for some good Mexican cuisine.

Really nice tacos. The beef tongue taco is fantastic. Staff are friendly and assertive. Totally recommend for a larger group of people, and also solo! Menu is simple (apart from a few standouts), and I would avoid the tortas, they are pretty basic for $8.
Can't go wrong with a traditional Italian dinner at Carmine's . The atmosphere is very nice portions are huge and prices are appropriate. Location is wonderful as you are in the heart of the city

Terrible racist place. Came here the night before Halloween to have a good time with my friends and i was harassed because I didn't order a drink when they wanted me to. They even threatened to call the police on me when I refused to leave after being mistreated.... I will never ever go to this restaurant again.

What a great experience and pizza. Nancy has been there for something like 28 years and was fantastic. Shared a bottle of wine, a salad and a couple of medium pizza's, there was 4 in the party. Try a simple pepperoni pizza, you will not be disappointed.

Arrived with a group of friends and we all ordered something different, luckily.  I got the French toast which was crispy and fluffy.  Tried several other dishes at the table like the chocolate chip pancakes, normally I wouldn't go sweet but I could see my self ordering those new time.

Simply the greatest cocktail menu (upstairs) you will ever find.  I ate lunch at the bar downstairs, solid fare.  Overall its a great choice for lunch or any time. Upstairs is amazing.  I fancy myself a good mixologist.  I'm like a civil war surgeon sawing off peoples arm's compared to a a skilled surgeon of today.  They have different categories depending on your style of libation desired.  Ingredients not commonly (or ever) seen anywhere else.  Curry leaves, euchalyptus, pistachio, etc.  Amazing
Growing up this was far and away my favorite pizza on Staten Island.  Any time I am in the area I try and fit it in my schedule.  You won't be disappointed.

I live in the neighborhood and was a regular customer of Egg, so when I passed by this restaurant numerous times and read the news about the Michelin star it's only natural for me to make a reservation of 6 on a Wednesday night. I was very excited about it. The appetizer was good with the essence of fall harvest, we got chestnut soup, potatoes chicken pate etc, all was enjoyable, and we had the gnocchi with walnut and kale, delicious, and main course came, 3 of us including me ordered the pork loin, and I had the first bite, it was incredibly dry, and the other 2 ppl had the same problem, it was pretty small so all of us finished it or almost did. We decided to tell our waiter about it although he didn't show up during the main course, and we did, and he said oh, I'll tell the chef. After that he came deliver the dessert, filled the cups with water, and came with check and fetch the check and the issue was not mentioned anymore. We sat there with him doing his thing, and the chef came. to our surprise she stopped at every table nearby and asked about the food, but not our table. We sat through all these awkwardness, and all of us were wondering but we strongly believed that they were waiting for a better time to get back to us. But no. They lowered their heads and avoided bringing it up again. We signed the receipt and realized this was it. Forgive me for not being confrontational enough, but I really didn't feel like complaining about my food, and after the server promised he will tell the chef,following up by asking something like, so did you tell the chef? It's just weird. I thought it's their job to do so. We stepped out of the restaurant filled with questions. And half of us the incredibly dry pork loin.
I had my doubts.  But the place served some very good food.  The service was excellent even though the place was busy.  I recommend the Lamb Shish.

I lived for 8 years in Ethiopia and felt as though I were back there in one of my favorite eateries while I was at Walia. "I'm in 7th Heaven" I said to my companions...."No, you're in South Orange", they replied. The food was like home cooked, and the hostesses and server were as warm & welcoming as they would be in Ethiopia, where guests are an honored presence. The portions were just right...plenty without having too much leftover. The range of selections is excellent. There are various meat dishes, and vegetarian ones also.  If you don't know the cuisine, as my companions did not,  the hostess amply explains the ingredients, spices, and preparation methods. Their coffee  at the meal's end is authentic Ethiopian, and delicious. The restaurant's atmosphere is enhanced by an interesting framed  silk artwork scarf as well as with prints  by well known Ethiopian artists. There is as well  the restaurant's namesake Walia ( a wild bighorn sheep) by a fine young artist. Get to Walia while it is still possible to get in the door without a long waiting line ahead of you!
My friend and I often eat Indian food together and Bengal Tiger did not disappoint. They have some of the best naan I've ever tasted and the main course was excellent as well.
