The food is just cheap and fine, but the service is terrible and the waitress is very rude, super racist. They expect 18% tips while there is literally no "service" at all.  When we refused to pay the 18% tips, one waitress shouted at us with very vicious words.

If you are in Manhattan, you must try La Pulperia! The warm atmosphere and ambiance of the restaurant makes you want to stay for hours. There was a celebrity at the restaurant when I was dining and every customer was treated with the same warmth and attentiveness by the staff. The chefs creations are brilliant, pulling together flavors that augment and invigorate your palate.  Supplement your meal with one of the unique and amazing cocktails from the bar and you are in for one of the best dining experiences of your life!
This is one of the best kept secrets in all of NY. Incredible service, (Jack is the man!) and is definitely the best hot pot you can find. The pork bone broth is amazing!
The service was fantastic. I had the mushroom flatbread and a salad and they were both decent. The price was good for the lunch special.
Place is great for a quick burger on the go.  Has excellent shakes and the amount of soda choices is incredible.

BIJANS is the BEST!!! I love it here. First let me say the drinks are on POINT!! The food is divine and the environment is so welcoming. I go to bijans maybe like once a week, because the people are just so warm and welcoming. The bartenders are friendly and quick with making those delicious "give me more", "pom pom', and my favorite "the bijan" drinks! The food... OH MY GOODNESS, I LOVE THE PERSIAN CHICKEN WINGS!!! The yogurt and herbs is also an amazing dish, oh and the crack soup delicious! The desserts always have these freshly cut fruits (tirimusu)... IM IN LOVE! Lets just say the cooks know how to throw down in that kitchen.The owners Johan and Sepideh are amazingly wonderful people, that bend over backwards just make sure you feel welcome and comfortable. A typical visit to Bijans: Walk in and get greeted with a smile, from one of the many attractive people workng there. They will say hello and i will either sit at the bar or at one of the tables (usually the bar). I will get a glass of water and a menu, after at most 10 minutes I will get to place my order and within an a 15 minute time period (at most) I will recieve a nice meal, and my drinks that I've order. The waitresses never messed up my order and they were always energetic and affable. After I am done with my meal, I am able to enjoy little conversations with the bartenders. I will encourage anyone who likes good afforable drinks, delicious food, sociable people and an comfortable environment, this is the place to go.

Excellent Greek food (take it from a real Greek ;) with great service and terrific ambience! My wife and I have been coming here for years and love the place. Only time I don't like going is on Valentine's Day- they do a Prix Fix menu and I like to be able to select from their full menu. So, sadly, no more V-days here. But that still leaves 364 days. You'll often find us here on our birthdays!
The atmosphere is great. There was no wait for toe people party Service was very attentive The calamari was definitely great to have and the drinks are very well done no complaints there

Great people, great food and awesome service!  A true 'taste of Italy' in a wonderful part of Queens. Intimate dining venue with a neighborhood air.  We enjoyed our second visit as much as our first.  Carmelo, Guiseppe and the entire staff are friendly, professional and welcoming.  We'll be back!!!   Buon appetito!  Mary & Jim

Upon a vacation visit to NYC, my girlfriend and I stayed a nite with a friend in Montclair. He insisted we had to go to Cuban Pete's, stating matter of factly that it is the one place you should go to when visiting Montclair. It may in fact be the best food in Montclair, but we never got that far into the meal due to some incredibly unprofessional restaurant staff and poor management. We headed over there about 8:30p on a Sunday. When we got inside, the manager asked us if we'd like to sit inside or outside. It was crowded inside and about 60's ish outside so we decided it would be better to eat outside. He told us we could sit anywhere and someone would be right with us with menus. There were two hostesses on staff. The first hostess we encountered not only did not give us menus after 15mins of sitting there, but threw us major shade each of the five times or so she passed by us. A busser came by to ask if we had been helped and said he'd get us some one, which also never happened. We quickly surmised that the staff was pissed we were sitting outside. Even though they offered us the option, we were the only ones out there and clearly the hostess/wait staff was not into it. Eventually the second hostess did drop us some menus, after 20 mins of sitting there. Still no water or set ups and she dropped the menus at our table with major angst. At this point, the buddy I'm staying with is in absolute shock at what's happening. And, since every one at the table has worked in the restaurant business, we are becoming seriously concerned that even if we did get to order, our food was gonna be....ummm....'sabotaged' is a polite word to use. The disdain from the staff was that palpable. We start to consider leaving when the coup de gras of the encounter occurrs. The manager comes out and asks 'Are you sure you folks don't wanna eat inside?'. I immediately shoot up from my chair and say 'YES! PLEASE! FINE! LET'S GO!'. He's taken aback by my response and offers a ridiculously passive aggressive suggestion: 'No No No, it's fine, you can sit out here if you want. No problems.' WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!? We got up and walked out stunned, annoyed, and really hungry. Luckily there was an OUTSTANDING Peruvian place around the corner that I couldn't recommend more (Costanera). I don't know about Montclair, but staff gets fired toot sweet over stuff like this in SF. The idea of staff picking and choosing where and when they want to work is ridiculous by any standard. This whole thing could have been avoided if they had said from the beginning 'There is no outside seating tonight'. We would have been totally content eating inside. But the AWFUL attitude of both hostesses and poor management completely turned a routine meal into a shit fest. I visit the Tri State area regularly and will likely be back to visit my friend in Montclair. But with all the good restaurants in the area, I won't even remotely consider returning to Cuban Pete's for a second chance.

one of those 'i've never written a review before.' and i haven't. because nothing in the world is worth a review except for these damn tacos. do i bring my first dates here, absolutely. have i brought my grandmother here, no, because rest her soul she passed away 10 years ago, but would i have brought her, absolutely. am i going to have five tacos cater to my first wedding, yes. my words can't do the flavor justice so i wont even try. get the taco, put the sauces on, eat it, then get another. then go out, drink, hit on girls and fail, but when you come back later for a nightcap taco you'll forget she existed. see you there tonight.

My favorite breakfast place. I drive past about 6 other breakfast restaurants on my 10 mile drive from East Hartford, Just to get this food. Always look forward to the Steak Breakfast Burrito!!!!  So much flavor,  if they weren't so big I would get two.

It pains me to write this review. I've lived in this town my entire life and my last visit was...weird. I understand the rebranding and all of that jazz but when it comes down to it this was always a diner, with excellent food. Emphasis on the diner part. To me, this was a place to meet with friends and chat and have some good food. I've been a server; if you take up a table and order a pot of coffee tip your server accordingly! While on my last visit, my friend was ordering food. I wasn't really too hungry so I decided I'd start with a coffee and see how it went. The waitress would NOT let me order a coffee, but never straight out said that. When I ordered my coffee she responded with "No food? Do you want a breakfast menu? I'll get you a breakfast menu." and before I could respond, she'd left the table. Upon return I told her I was just going to go with the coffee - her response? "Soup? How about soup?" So to shut up her, I ordered the god damn soup. If there was some sort of new rule about having to order food I would have rather she flat out said that to me. I was so annoyed and just wanted to get out of there. I didn't touch the soup. ALSO. The buffalo chicken tenders are gone and I am beyond heart broken. True tragedy. The new menu is interesting. The burgers are really delicious (if they're even still on the menu). I really can't comment on much more except for the wildly rude waitress and the uncomfortable feeling she gave me the entire time. Bummer.
yelp is a scam ...if you don't advertise with them they hide your positive reviews

We came in and owner was sitting at the bar with a T shirt on. Friendly service but unprofessional. Orange juice was supposed to be freshly squeezed but tasted old and for $4 a small champagne flute I would expect to hear oranges being squeezed. Sausage cheese croissant came with out cheese. The feta cheese omelette came with a hair so we returned a couple minutes later owner came to ask if every thing was to our liking. Really! New feta and spinach omelette had egg shells in it. Nice place burnt he owner needs to work on performance.

This Resturant is overrated the food was average and the place was very noisy it was hard to have a conversation with the person next to you. The service wasn't great and the waiter was rude. We booked a week in advance for lunch and honestly were disappointed.
The food is good, but the place is dated! They definitely some renovating! I felt like I was stuck in the 80's!

I love this place!!  The food never disappoints, especially the crepes!  Servers are mostly great.  Just had "Trevin", I believe and he was excellent.  I recommend this place for any meal or dessert.  German crepes are my fav.

Got some take out tonight. Rolls were good and sashimi was fresh.  Even a nice presentation with the take out. Hope this place sticks around.  As a tip,  park in the back,  that is where the front entrance is!

My favorite diner in the area. Food is solid- wait staff is generally attentive and friendly. The food is always fresh and the place is always clean. A classic NJ standard but an absolute standout among the other below average diners lining Rt 10.  My personal recommendation: The GYRO platter and pumpkin coffee !
The best  sangria in NYC Also the food. Is great the staff wonderful the management drennie is the best. And also really reasonable for a group!!!!

Very disappointed about this good looking restaurant! I was wishing to try the eggs Benedict but supposedly they didn't have the sauce. Service was very poor, unfriendly, waitress forgot the straw, brought the check  without asking about dessert which I wanted, didn't offer refill and when requested, she forgot, a total disaster! THE alternate eggs I ordered weren't great either.
The food is good and the prices are right! Can't beat that! But definitely a place for take-out!
Good food, solid portions. I ordered twice from here and it's a little pricey for its location.
nice place for quick bite after Broadway show. get whole cheesecake pies at take out counter next door.
Food only good in pictures ! We had mac n cheese and burger and chicken pillared all was less than ok !
I m looking forward to my next visit! Everything was delicious! Agedashi tofu, wagyu beef, shrimp balls etc...
The food was yummy! Nice decor. It's definitely a place for special occasions, because it's expensive!!

I ordered here through "Eat24" from Yelp but when I called they didn't have the order. No problem. They took the delivery order over phone and were really nice. My order came right on time to my hotel. I ordered a shrimp parm hero with LIGHT sauce and cheese and it was perfect as was the antipasto salad. DELICIOUS. I'll eat here again!

Once again we LOVE this restaurant. The food and services are always excellent. The hostess, Jennifer, and the Maitre D' Junior pay very special attention to every patron. The food is always superior and the ambiance unbeatable. Highly recommend for any ocassion.

Arroz con pollo was dry as a bone, and much like the beer-cooked pulled beef was lacking ANY flavor. Even cardboard obtains flavor around OTHER food being cooked, over time. Luckily they included apple sauce to recover this mess some. But clearly - not the way to go. The "pork beans" had 1 tiny piece of pork in it and didn't taste bacony or buttery. Wasn't even a good bean sauce. Check foodnetwork, people! It's not hard to make good, tasty beans! Not sure why this place gets any good reviews. 1 good dish (it seems ppl are talking about Bandeja Paisa) does not a restaurant make. Maybe it's ok for Park Slope.... They also push this terrible salsa-like sauce in a bottle, which is basically 95% vinegar and salt and therefore removes from flavor rather than adds to it. Plantain chips weren't bad though (free before the meal, to help sell the sauce). I'd buy those w/o ever going in for anything else there. SUPER expensive drinks. $9/glass, $40/bottle for a sangria!? Seriously!? Thing that's half water and cheap fruit, with rind!? Get real! The reason sangrias exist is BECAUSE they are super cheap, and hide the terrible $5 wine they are usually made with!
it's a must go to get fat and buy food to get fat at home.Just go!
The food is decent, but they need a face lift!! When you eat in, you feel like you're in a 70's log cabin! Everything looks old and dusty.
Rice and green beans were over cooked. Steak was good but you could do better elsewhere.
Good bagels, but they only have a 4-slice toaster so it takes forever for a toasted bagel!! I usually have to call in my order for pick up!

This place is so cute. I love the design and the employees were very attentive and sweet. I ordered the nachos upon suggestion from a waitress and another customer. My only mistake was walking it home in the rain for a half hour! Once I got home and put it in the oven, it turned soggy and piecey. I will have to eat in the next time I go. Then I may change my 4 stars to 5! I really did like the place.

I used to live in Detroit.   downtown..  near Greektown...   so I had Greek food for weeks on end...   but none as tasty as the grape arugula salad and the grilled octopus I had here!    My friends had amazing drinks, too!

This place has a lot of other things on the menu besides pizza.  The people are friendly, and it has fast service.  I usually order the pasta dishes.  The portion sizes are big and the food is good quality.
Nice ambiance. Good food. Good wine.
First of all, this is in terminal C, not B. Second, don't eat here. Staff was nice, but I had some very questionable chicken in my sandwich. Yuck.

This place does not even deserve one star. To start off with, the waiter had no interest in being there and had a I-don't-care attitude. When he went to go pour water in my sisters glass he reached across my fathers face with half of his body, almost spilling on my sister and her phone. On to the food. The complimentary bread was cold as if it was just taken out of the fridge, and the butter was rock solid. I ordered a glass of wine that the waiter suggested and it tasted cheap and was overpriced. For dinner I ordered the yellowtail tuna that I was told was grilled sushi style, meaning the inside was supposed to be raw.  It was over cooked, giving it the taste of tuna from a can. It also said it came with grilled fresh veggies, when in reality it came with 4 thin slices of zucchini. My sisters ordered the chili pepper chicken rigatoni and the chicken Marsala, the rigatoni was hard so my sister sent it back, he brought out a whole new dish and the pasta was even more undercooked. Not only was the pasta undercooked, but they had obviously tried to add an Italian flare, which ended in a mess. It was way too spicy,  and the menu didn't even mention that it was spicy. The chicken Marsala was over cooked and dry; it was nothing impressive. My father would never complain about a meal but even he said his pasta Diablo was no good. The waiter noticed I was not touching my Tuna and took it off of our check. He said that we could get a desert with the money from the tuna. I ordered carrot cake for dessert which, to my surprise, was actually pretty good, but I wouldn't go back for it. Overall, this place was over priced and the food was just not good, by the end of the night even the waiter could see that we were unhappy with all the food. Would never bother returning unless there was a new chef.

Ordered online to have it delivered through Grubhub.   It arrived about an hour late. To their defense, they claimed that had a huge party order before us. But when you have a potential new big customer, delivering our food an hour late for a lunch interview is just a big no no. Our interviewee didn't even eat lunch! You may as well as kiss that customer good-bye because there's no way we can use this place for any future company luncheons.   The food.   We ordered an assortment of dishes. eggplant with garlic. seafood hot and sour soup. kung pao chicken. yang chow fried rice. general tso's sesame chicken. sauteed cumin beef. boneless ribs. everything was cook as well as it should be expected when you considered it was delivered. However, there were two dishes that they completely missed seasoning - yang chow fried rice and seafood hot and sour soup. Yang chow fried rice they were missing salt because it tasted like plain white rice. Hot and sour soup they missed the salt and the vinegar because it tasted like water. the chief must have been asleep on these two dishes.   2/5 stars is pretty generous considering the service i got. i'm willing to try them again if the opportunity arrives. but this place will not be on the top of my list of chinese restaurants in new haven. It's a shame because this place is one of the few that actually delivers in the new haven area.
Been coming here for 20 years, every year gets better. Amazing antipasto! Great spaghetti with meat sauce and lasagna. Perfect for date nights!!!
Service was wonderful ,Food was superb, &  view of Manhattan is breathtaking. I will definitely be dining here more often.
This place was such a great surprise! All of the other reviews are on point. It's a nice little change of pace. The mole sauce is definitely the way to go!
this place stole my heart. It reminded me of home so much..& not Miami but Israel. Everything is Kosher, the service is great and the food is to die for !

A nondescript, shabby little dumpling house in downtown Brooklyn that serves amazing food. A couple of tables are available if you want to eat-in. The dumplings are fresh and served rapidly. (Never had to wait for more than a couple of minutes).  The prices are very affordable--$3.00 for ten dumplings. Check this place out if you're in the area.
The bitch who runs this place won't let you order of you don't spend $8 per person.  AKA: you have a large group and one person isn't hungry...no ramen for you.

Your search for a great pizza place can stop here.  Had the Sicilian three times and it's always on point!  When my toddler wanted to watch he guys make the pizza, the owner (maybe GM) definitely took care of us.  He hooked her up with some pizza dough that kept her entertained until the pie arrived.  Look forward to our next visit.

Is it the first pizza in NY? Yes, Maybe even in America. Is the atmosphere great? Definitely. Is the pizza good? No. I love pizzas in every possible way, but this one was just another pizza, nothing special nor worth the wait and price...
Excellent food, great place for brunch. Fries a little soggy, but still good. Great outdoor space!
Great dinning !
Extra $3 per card if u pay with Chinese credit card, ridiculous. No reminds before, no signs out the restaurant.

This place is an absolute delight. As veterans of many buffet and all you can eat places my family and I have high expectations. The expectations were quickly met and exceeded over the course of the entire meal. The staff is friendly and courteous. The nine of us spent 3 hours dining on food that was fresh and tasty, and at no time did we feel rushed. Water glasses were quickly and frequently filled and food was served efficiently. The staff helped grilled the food which added to the positive experience, as they were efficient, warm and simply pleasant to be around. The meat and veggies, along with their amazing selection of sauces, were high quality and fresh. I would definitely go back again with friend and family. Even at 10PM on a Sunday evening people were streaming in.

Just another below average bar/restaurant with an unoriginal name. Living in West Hartford I have visited the establishment several times, each being a huge disappointment. I first went to grab food and have a beer, the food menu was nothing more than bar food disguised to be more than just that, but the beer selection plentiful. The service was not great and the place appeared to be a hangout for frat kids underage girls. My other visits have shown me the bar staff either does not know what they are doing, or just don't seem to care. This place reminds me of something that should be on one of those TV shows like "bar rescue".

Amazing food & Service As always I get five star service. Was at SOCO last week and had my favorite the fried chicken w/red velvet waffle, mac & Cheese and I had a glass of moscato. One small suggestion is to hire a seasoned expert mixologist, whomever has created the drink menu did not match up creativity with taste. I know a few people who can make outstanding drinks if you'd like a recommendation. Otherwise, great times were had!  Robert was fantastic! check out my YouTube review- youtu.be/Bl0_cVbuRU4

Some months ago I had a negative service experience at Garces Trading Company.  I spoke to the Regional Manager about the experience and that I am a frequent customer.  I brought a close friend visiter from DC.  We were both disappointed.   The Regional Manager graciously apologized and offered to make up for it next time my friend comes in.  Tonight we dined at GTC and everything was spectacular.  We had a great salad and great house-made Mozzarella.  Then we had short ribs and scallops...and duck fries for "dessert". Thank you to the Regional Manager for her generosity and to our waiter Nathaniel who wisely recommended our food. Once again I love this place, and so does my visiting friend. Thank you again. Michael Silverman

We love Max Fish for a quick bite and a great drink! The bartenders here are very talented and I mean that, they like actually win awards and stuff! I have never been a big fan of the stark, sterile hospital like environment of the bar area but the dining area and outside is quite nice. The food is consistent and very good.  I love being able to get a variety of food off of the bar menu and then maybe a soup or salad off the dinner menu. Last night we had Duck wings (awesome), Crab & Shrimp app (Okay), Pulled pork sliders (too much slaw) and a chop salad (Incredible)

Blue lights? Yes, please. Window seat?  Of course.  Sound track (the Strokes and Thievery Corp.) was perfect.  Australian wine--de Gulden Zeepaard--very tasty (apparently the Dutch explorers get around).  Je weet toch. But really it was the company that made for a memorable evening.  Funny, sweet and very, very hot. Also a bit of a talker. To the waitress we kept waiting past closing: sorry to keep you from the rest of your life! We lost track of time. We promise we'll arrive earlier next time. And the sushi was pretty good. #that'sjusthowIfeel

I came here because I had a $25 restaurant.com gift certificate. Wasn't really expecting anything crazy but HOLY CRAP THIS PLACE IS DELICIOUS. Took a little long for the food to come out BUT it is well made and so good, so I'm not complaining about that part. All of the dishes are gigantic so if the entree prices scare you just be aware you are definitely bringing some of this home. The staff was so friendly and so lovely the entire time, they made it beyond pleasant. The decor is a little crazy but it's a Greek place....and I'm eating the food not looking at the walls. This place is sort of hidden away and if you see it - get in there and eat.
A month back I been their to enjoy lovely food.I love it , its was so testy.

Pizza was undercooked, rude service, and on top of that they added tip on the check for a party of four and tried to LIE and say it was for sodas. After futher questioning they admitted it was for tip. When I asked why tip was automatically added for a party of four when their signs clearly say tip added for parties of 6 or more they became upset and asked us to leave. I usually don't like to complain about places but I just had to. Tourists beware!! Always know your bill.

Besides the underground Mom and pops (delisandros) Pats is the king. Geno's stinks bread sucks meat is smaller portioned. go to Pats tourists. don't wear Mets or Boston stuff(they will break your balls). they will break your balls and don't ask to cut in half they will tell you we don't do dat. Peppers onions wiz wit.

Surprisingly good. Had flautas chicken. And tacos beef. Some tomatillo salsa and a jarritos. I forget how much it was. I just kept throwing money at the girl (who spoke no English btw) becuz it was that good. I'll be back. Not too ghetto at all if ur scared of that type of thing. Wimp

Last minute decision to eat at Carmines times sq location and service was great from reservation to when we left.  Very efficient and friendly.  Place was packed for a Wednesday night but our server was very attentive.  Meal was good and so were  our cocktails. Fun for out of state visitors.
Try this place if you are looking for a BYOB with great Mexican food for a good price! Awesome food and a cool environment! It's a great dinner spot, but you have to go early because they close at 8!
Great food and excellent staff. A very friendly and fun atmosphere. Great place to watch a game with the family.

My 1 star rating is based on the owners and their rules.  They don't take reservations except for parties greater than four, but will put your name on a wait list, which they advise doesn't guarantee a table.   I was there last night at 6:30 and wanted a table for 2 and there was one available.  The hostess, Pat, said that the table was being held for customers who went to the liquor store to get wine.  I am a regular customer, yet she's holding a table for obviously new customers (since they  didn't know it was a BYOB).  Congratulations Pat on losing a weekly customer.  Are you catering to only new customers? Besides this experience, I've seen the chef/owner berate the kitchen staff.  Perhaps they did need discipline, but it didn't have to be in front of customers.   It's a shame this is such a poorly run business because the pizza and wait staff are excellent.  It seems Tomasao is a dictator and everyone, including his wife, seems afraid to step out of line and break his rules.  I get that he doesn't want to be just another pizzeria, but the vibe that he creates in the restaurant is why I will never go back. The pizza, itself, is very thoughtful.  The only pie I've had that didn't make sense to me is the Porcini pizza.  It is a standard menu item and the flavors aren't complimentary to my palette.  The salads are boring and seem to have been an after thought.  I've tried many appetizers and I recommend not wasting your time or appetite on them.  I will miss the pizza, but it isn't worth the hassle.

Love this place.  The owners are great and James is an excellent waiter.  By far the best linguine with red clam sauce.  There are so many nice little touches here.  For instance, after dinner they will sometimes bring a complimentary cappuccino or dessert.   Make a reservation if you are coming after 6 on weekdays or 5 on weekends.

I decided to order this pizza based on the reviews and when we got the 3'large pizza plus the chicken wings all of them were so salty. When i called them the person had only one thing to say we have been in business for 35 years and we cant go wrong. Pretty bad attitude.i dont think i would ever order here
Really great food, excellent service and not overly expensive. Highly recommended

Although thier food is amazing, thier take out system with seamless is actually the worst experience I had. After waiting for about an hour for my food to arrive, I call the restaurant to see if it had been sent out already. After giving the order information to the lady on the phone, she couldn't locate the order, I was put on hold multiple times, and even had to hang up and call back. I was fed excuse after excuse and was told I had to call seamless to cancel the order myself with them. They are completely incompetent and after giving them mutilple chances the same issue always occur. I will never order from them again.

I never give bad reviews but I'm so irritated. I called and asked if they delivered and was told yes and there was no minimum delivery. I call back TEN minutes later, give my ENTIRE order AND credit card number, say it's delivery and am THEN told they can't deliver at this time after being put on hold so she can check with the manager. It was the same person I had just spoke with ten minutes ago. Extremely frustrating!!!

I live in Boston, but was visiting NYC for a few days and had the great fortune to enjoy a lot of delicious food at Lolo's! The food was cooked to perfection and the sauces and seasonings were to die for. The shrimp and coco curry sauce was my favorite, but all of the sides that I had were strong contenders too (definitely order the platanos and the Johnny cakes). The atmosphere is incredibly easy going (great music, great lighting, great vibe). The owner is so welcoming and the rest of the staff were attentive and personable. I will definitely return to Lolo's next time I visit NYC again!
This came highly recommended so we must of hit it on an off day.  It was ok.

Had my sister's 40th birthday there this weekend. The food was really good, the service was EXCELLENT. Honestly, they were so helpful in setting up, ensuring everyone was comfortable.  I would recommend anyone having a party for up to 45-50 people to check them out.

This is one of my favorite places to eat breakfast on the weekends. I always experience friendly staff and amazing food. The pastries are some of the best I've ever had. The coffee is great, and the crepes are superb. I have no complaints and have been very impressed with the consistently great food I have there.

Bijan's is a beautiful surprise, if you're new in the neighborhood, as I was.  And Henry, the barkeep and uber server, makes you feel welcome and gives great advice on the menu.  This is an oasis in Brooklyn.  I kind of hate to advertise it, because I like it to myself.  But you must go.  I had a calamari dish that was delicious and a new rose that is both dry enough and tasty.  A pleasure.  And the decor is interesting, if you love art and atmosphere.  Good pour by Henry, behind the bar.  I'm going back.  The owner seems nice, too.
The cheesesteaks are okay. Pats are better. There are other good spots in the area. This is a tourist trap to avoid. They seem to be proudly/openly xenophobic and/or racist. what's up with that???
i wish that you could sit down and eat food was good

Cedar Point hasn't been around too long but it's already a Fishtown gem. The menu is a bit hit or miss, to be honest. The kale burger, which had great potential, was bland and crumbly. I've had fries that were crispy and flavorful and amazing, and some days they're limp. However, the vegetarian wings are the best I've ever had and I honestly dream about them some nights. Po boys are solid and huge, cauliflower fritters and peanut butter greens are one of the most delicious and unique things I've tasted in the city. I just really love the vibe of this place. Always something solid to choose on the menu, great drinks, good people. If you ordered something you didn't love the first time, definitely worth another shot. Good addition to the neighborhood!
Worst staff in the front desk! Clearly, won't last long unless they start caring for customers more.

There's truth to the belief that the East Coast knows how to make pizza. I felt like Julia Roberts in Eat, Pray, Love. And it was gluten free. Best pizza I've ever had. I'm ruined. Thank you, Ann and Tatum, for the great service!

I live in the neighborhood and have been a few times now. Always have a good experience. Food is seasonal and locally sourced. Consistent and delicious. I like reliability. No liquor license, so all cocktails are beer or wine-based. Nice wine list. Really like the interior.
We celebrate this new restaurant with eating food and everything was excellent.

I love here, the manager is really funny and generous. Each time he will teach me some Portuguese.:) The people here are friendly and willing to introduce you the most tasty food. Menus might be different everyday. Food here is wonderful. My boyfriend's favorite is chicken masala( mashroom soup with chicken and rice). Really interesting place.:)

I've really enjoyed ordering from this place in the past - they have pretty good prices. But I can't stand when they put carrots in the nachos!  I just don't get it.  It's fine when you remember to order it without!

Great atmosphere and food! I always get seafood tofu soup, it comes with rice as many other Korean restaurants. I also love their pancakes, it's a bit pricy but worthy. Everytime I want Korean food, I always go bcd heheh^^

Me and my room mates just ordered a calzone and fried dough balls and we couldn't have been more disappointed! The calzone was burnt and had little to no cheese in it. Not worth the price we paid. The fried dough was soggy cold and unbearable to even finish. Along with all of that the people who work there are so incredibly rude!

We love it here! Cozy atmosphere and really good food for a great price. We've only head the pizza here a couple of times but every thing else on the menu is awesome! The pasta is huge and delicious, same with the salads! Great place for sandwiches for lunch or to bring whole family for a tasty dinner that won't empty  your wallet!

Well, what can I say. I ordered a sazerac, and neither the bartender nor the server knew what one was. The Manhattan I got instead had a hair in it. My friends martini had seeds in it and tasted of water and pure grain alcohol. No olive. I realize it's not a bar-centric spot, but the bar area looks really nice, they really should hire a proper bartender. It's NYC ffs.

Dirty, outdated and dark. I didn't stay long enough to order food I couldn't.I walked in and was the only person in the restaurant besides the three people working no one said a word to me for five minutes and I got up and left
Stop.using. truffle.oil.

First time dining at Handys and it was a great experience. The seating was interesting but made the atmosphere great. Once seated all of the employees were very helpful and polite. I ordered the chocolate chip pancakes and they were spot on. I also checked in and got my free cookie without a problem. And to top it all off were were given candy for Halloween. Great place. great food. Coming back again soon. :)

First time dining at Sandra's. Wonderful atmosphere, friendly staff. I got the sweet and spicy chicken and my girlfriend got the blackened fish. We shared the dishes and both of them were delicious, along with all of the sides. I would recommend Sandra's to anyone looking for that home cooked taste that fills you up and keeps you raving about it for days.
me and my GF hannah we think this place is F-word good!!!! enantio wine.. black sea-bass

There are five different food court style restaurants in this place.  Each one actually should be rated differently.  After you go there a few times, you can figure out which ones are the better ones.  The people who have gone here only once probably are the ones which give the poor ratings.  The bhel puri, pau bahji, sabudana khichadi are wonderful.  I did not have a good experience with the dosas.  The Indian Chai is also very good here. This place is cheap, so I eat here first, then I also do take out.  Seating is usually a problem, so it is not good for large groups.
One of the best Place in Manhathsn for those Thays love cooking and appreciate italian dishes. Pau a visit nest time in NYC.
I wanted to order for delivery, and  they gave me such a hard time because they were too busy to deliver. If you don't want to deliver food then don't offer a delivery service.
Wow. What a meal. Great introduction to the VT food scene. The foie gras (banned here in CA) was devine. Service was attentive without being cloying. Great bread. I would go back here in a heartbeat.

I went to Sefarat Mediterranean cuisine with a group of friends and it was our first time. We loved the location very friendly and family oriented, the manager recommended us to have mixed appetizer and mixed Sefarat platter. It was a great choice because all of us got to taste a little bit of everything and see what we liked I absolutely loved the shish kebabs the meat was tender and juicy precise to my taste. The price was decent we had lots left over and we were able to bring our own wine. Planning to visit this cuisine often. Would recommend to others and order the baklaba for dessert it was out of this word.
Great Italian food. Lasagna is the best!  Very nice warm atmosphere and great service. However their cash only policy gave me some troubles that day...

Had an issue and wanted to follow up online, so I asked the manager for his first name. Refused to provide name for some time, then he said he would give me his card and went to the back and never returned. Very unprofessional... Melissa in the front, on the other hand, was great! Always warm and friendly.

Overrated. Bad spirit and there is better food in the neighborhood. Pizza is ok (wood oven is never bad) but a bit stingy on the ingredients, for the price ($15-20 a small pizza). Service was just bad. Sometimes they'll include a 20% gratuity without warning, when I politely asked why, their only answer was "sometimes it is like that" (I guess when they know you'll tip less - we weren't a group and there is no mention of such on the menu). I paid it anyway and they didn't even bring back the full change (cash only place).

The service here is completely terrible, i will never come here again and i do not recommend anyone coming here just because of the service, let alone their food is terrible. The manager working there treats customers with the utmost disrespect. Let alone he is a complete RACISTS. i patiently waited on the line to get this place (which i still don't know why). I needed a table for 4 people. There was a African American group of 4 right behind us waiting for the same seating. While waiting on the line we were talking to each other and what not. The manager comes out to seat the next party, asks me how many people I'm with, i tell him 4, then asks the people behind us and they also say 4, then literally tells us to step aside while he walked them in and told us its going to be another 45 minute wait. thats just completely ridiculous. i will never in my life come here again and i will tell everyone i know to never come to this disgusting place.

I got a meatball sub and buffalo wings while hungover in bed. The meatballs were a strange dry tacky texture and did not taste like meatballs. The buffalo wings had basically no sauce on them and had no flavor, and the chicken was dry. Super disappointing hangover cure.

I heard great things about this place. The line to get in was a mile long and the wait was over an hour just to sit at a table, the service was absolutely atrocious and it took an hour and 40 minutes just to get breakfast and at the very end there was no discount and the owner refused to even talk I will never go back there again and make sure no one I know goes there

We went here Friday late morning. It was busy! The seating is great and after ordering I found something considerably easy and comfy - the space and set up is brilliant and flows well. The banana bread was yummy and fresh and the almond croissant was good too. Their lattes are fantastic and creamy with a perfect balance. They even catered for my little lovely when I asked for a babyccino. Everyone is so so friendly, happy, considerate, warm and welcoming - especially while it was super busy with people coming and going non-stop. Highly recommend!
I'm from the Midwest and I think the fried fish here is some the best I ever had. Try the Mac and cheese balls too!!

Love this place, I love that I can have habachi delivered to my house and not have to deal with the crazy crowds at the restaurant. The ny steak habachi dinner is great, the FBI dessert is awesome too! The only downside to this place is if it's busy and you order delivery, it can at times take about an hour, hour and a half to receive your food, but definitely worth the wait I feel.

Ok, so, I admit, it took me way too long to try this place since everyone is always raving about it. It's just in a neighborhood I don't go to often, so the other day when I had to visit a friend nearby I said IT'S TIME TO TRY CAFE LIFT! We were so pleased! We went on a weekday morning and there was no wait. (I'm sure this place is packed on the weekends.) I had a mushroom frittata and iced coffee. The iced coffee was fresh, which is so important. You wouldn't believe how many places in town brew iced coffee and then let it sit for days. YUCK! The fritata was amazing and came with great hashbrowns too. Perfect amount of food and a sunny, nice spot to sit and chat. Will definitely try to find an excuse to head back soon! Also, worth mentioning: if anyone is mourning the loss of Cafe Estelle like I was, this place is pretty similar in terms of the vibe and menu.

We ate here tonight on our way back from a dartmouth football game. We both went to college here in the 80s and had a kid play football here in the 2010s. My folks have lived here since 1988...you get the picture. We have been here off and on for decades. We opted for the casual no reservations part of the restaurant. The fancier part is good but frankly we have been happier with the menu at this front of the house area. Tonights dinner blew us away. We could barely figure out which small plates to order they all were so  intriguing. It almost helped...sitting down at 8:30pm on a saturday..that two of our top choices were sold out. Always a good sign. We ended up going with five small plates for dinner. The roasted oysters, duck salad, and cauliflower salad came first. Delectable each and every one. Next came calamari, short rib bruschetta, and tater tots ( okay just that made six but my husband insisted on tater tots and i ate a few. Yummy). We each had a half bottle of red and white, as we divide that way. Both worked well with our tasty bites. So there you go. Something for everyone. Dont miss this place! Except for the once a month exceptional osteria chiara pop up restaurant, there is no better place to dine in norwich or hanover. We ate at pine at the hanover inn the night before and it was very very good. But carpenter and main is better. Trust me.

We had a birthday dinner at The Writing Room last weekend and the staff could not have been nicer - even on a busy night.  They were incredibly helpful, professional, and efficient.  It was a perfect setting and everyone had a great time.  The food was fantastic too!

I ordered here from seamless, which states a 45-60 minute wait.  After waiting 80 minutes, I finally called and was put on hold for 5 minutes so that they could "check the kitchen for my order".  During that time, two different people picked up and put me on hold again.  When the person finally came back to discuss my order, he stated it was heading out the door now (as if to imply freshness).  I received my order 15-20 minutes later and it was COLD (ok, not cold, but lukewarm, which is really pretty cold).  I tried reheating in the oven and while my quesadillas were tasty, everything else was terrible.  I will never order from here, again.  By the way, a $2.00 side of guacamole is literally 2 tablespoons in a very little dixie cup.  NEVER again!

Ok, unpopular opinion time... I don't really like RTM and I always kind of dread going there. It's not too different or unique from any other indoor market I've been to, and the crowd is awful. I can find produce of the same quality and price at Super Fresh. Some of the kiosks have interesting and tasty food, but it's totally not worth it to have to stand in line, fight the crowds, and then sit there to eat. I try to avoid the market at all costs...

Crockadeli is the best deli in town! Their sandwiches are consistently delicious with fresh bread no matter what time of day you order. Manny is great- he adds a personal touch every time you go in. We love it there!
Okay, everything is cooked from frozen, prebattered or precooked. Mostly reheating food, not really cooking. Slow service!!!

I hate any place that does not take reservations. I find it incredibly annoying and unnecessary. The hosts here are also annoying in a condescending/hispter kind of way. Also, the service is bad. The people that work here come off as if they feel like they are saving the world by working here. Other than this, the food is extremely delicious (so much so that it outweighs the bad service/experience otherwise). Obviously the food is very unhealthy, perhaps excessively so- one of those places where there is butter, salt, and fat added to anything and everything. I'm surprised there wasn't a stick of butter in my water. That said, it was one of the best tasting cheeseburgers I have had in my life. It was out of this world.

Finally, a Restaurant, with my namesake as an owner. Ambiance: check out the interesting paintings/murals on the wall. Small dining space. Food: 1st attempt at Kathi roll. VERY different. Did not expect the cheese laden roll to be that tasty. Only one thing. Burns right through the tongue. So be patient and dont try to gobble it. 2nd item : The very best chole bhature in state. Hands down! 3rd Item:  interesting Dosa: paneer masala dosa. After discovering Talk of the Town . We dont go anywhere else

I actually love Champs and I know it's a very popular restaurant, but they need to figure out their waiting situation. There's no waiting area and you have to stand out in the cold from 15 minutes to an hour. Please get some walls for your customers to wait outside in. Please. It's really mean to know you have customers waiting in the cold every weekend and do nothing about it.

This is casual basic good food. I had breakfast today and it came out piping hot. The bacon was crispy but not greasy. The eggs were cooked through and the home fries had just the right amount of crisp.  The coffee was good and they kept the refills coming. I definitely want to come back to try the soup for lunch.

I went to this place and the owner and his family were there speaking Italian so I thought for sure the food would be excellent but boy was I wrong!!!  I had a meatball calzone and a cold antipasto they were both unexceptable I left and ran to get zantac!! I can't see this  Italian family eating the food they serve to there customers which really upset me cause I am also Italian!  BOTTOM LINE THIS PLACE IS A INSULT TO ITALIANS DONT GO THERE!!!!!

My experience has been so bad I'm actually still sitting in the restaurant while writing it. My girlfriend and I heard so much about this place and were very excited to eat here but were quickly and sadly disappointed. When we initially walked in there was no hostess there to greet us, eventually she rushed over and asked if we had reservations but assuming that this is just a bbq/southern cooking style place we didn't think we needed any and when we told her no she seemed mad and said she might have a table for us. She then brought us to a high table squashed against the wall next to the kitchen entrance and the table was all wobbly and didn't even have salt, pepper or any condiments on it, I don't even think it was meant to be a real table every other table had all that and a decorative candle (although the candle would've been bad anyway cause the table wobbled so much) The waitress was rude, only brought us menus but no drink menus , or even tell us of any specials and didn't even give us full silverware sets, only forks. The complementary corn bread was dry and cold but the sweet cream butter was good. When she finally took our orders I got the beef brisket sandwich with fries and my girlfriend got the beef brisket platter... 50 minutes later we finally got our food. The platter was alright, the rice and beans were good but the beef was fatty and not very hot and the coleslaw was warm. The sandwich was alright as well but still very fatty and the fries were a cold, soggy, greasy disaster and again the coleslaw was warm. It was just outright bad, and upon walking out the hostess who greeted us when we walked in didn't even tell us to have a good night or even acknowledge us.  We were really upset because the restaurant itself was awesome, very cool decor and good music, a real nice ambiance.  But we were made to feel almost like second class citizens shoved in a corner and made a last priority. I hate to say it but I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone if they can't value every customer who comes through their door.
best burritos around union square! the steak burrito is excellent and all the ingredients are fresh, helpful staff - i do wish there was more seating so I mostly order to go
My friends and I come for sushi here all the time. This is my favorite place for sushi in philly You have to try it, fish is always so fresh and full of flavor.

This is not your typical Chinese take out restaurant. It is more like a Asian fusion restaurant serving menus such as mango chicken and stir fried udon. The beef dishes are very good. However, I think this place is WAY overpriced. A quart of noodles is more than $9. An order of chicken wings really means "wings", not the whole wings. This place does look very clean though
Nice atmosphere. Good servers. Great pies, specially loved our quattro formaggi choice.

The worst place for a big party . First of all with a reservation we didn't get to sit down till an hour and a half later. Apparently the party sitting before us had already paid their bill but didn't leave. How is that our problem ? So incompetent !!! Second the manager tried to make it up by sending appetizer and desert ? Fail didn't sent enough for the whole party of 13! He sent maybe like 3 plates of very small portion not even extra plates so people could split. I would recommend for you to go somewhere else if you have a big party. Oh yea and to top it off the food isn't all that. If you know what Spanish food is about it's average.
Great place great service and delicious food I recommend The char challenge and the beef tartare very delicious

Accommodated last minute for a table.  Loved that.  Atmosphere, great......   After sitting at the table for 31 minutes I asked the server for a cocktail and mentioned that we had been waiting for a while hoping that he was our server and he said, "ma'am, we are in Williamsburg, we don't rush here"  with an attitude worthy of the Movember man he was as if I was an impatient tourist.   Not much else to say on this one..........   Steak was rare even though ordered medium.  Offers to refill empty glasses were non-existent but they hovered after dropping the check.

This place is amazing! Beautiful building and the atmosphere is very classy but quaint! Food was amazing! Lobster and duck confit appetizers, lamb and lobster entrees both incredible and delicious! Staff incredibly attentive! Definitely coming back!
I wouldn't recommend any one to come here I did not try their food yet, I just went in to get a hot coffee for my friend There staff were so rude and give me a unwelcome feeling :|

There are so many places in Montclair to eat however this place is a must. The setup is very architectually appealint to the eye and the food matches to the tongue. When i was here, I had the mild and spicy wings and short rib ramen. Pretty self-explanatory but this is a great fusion restaurantif you're looking for some great food out of your comfort zone.  Rxcept when i fuck poon
There are a lot of options in New Haven and I have had some of the best pizza anywhere...modern is simply the Best Pizza on the planet...

Roberta's is the place to go if you're looking for a good pizza, salad, or craft beer. When you walk in you're instantly greeted by  young and hip employees. I should put emphasis on hip because the whole restaurant is hip; the music, the furniture the, even the tiki bar and garden outside.  The first time i went to Roberta's was when my friend showed me. I remember splitting a pizza called the bee sting. It's a pizza with honey and either hot peppers or hot sauce. Deffinitely ask for this if it is no longer on the menu. It's worth going there just for that.

It's a popular spot for weekend brunch, so I tried the pancakes. The pancakes were undercooked. It was disgusting, because the batter was soft. The lineups were long so maybe the kitchen was rushed, but that's no excuse for a pancake place, especially at the price for three pancakes. I could have sent it back, but given the long wait, I didn't bother. I suggest others don't bother with this locale either.
Must've just came on a bad day but the food was awful. Came out cold and didn't taste good. Had the looser salad sandwich and the eggs. Will not come back

My love for Kung Fu Hoagies is sooo strong. I always get the #1 at the stand in Clark Park. Best vegan pork in the world, with little noodles and crisp veggies. The sauce is awesome. Such a fun place to stop by.
Very interesting little place. Great wait staff. They were very attentive. The food was very authentic. The deserts are to die for.
So good and they're all very nice in there, been a costumer for over 3 years only place I get sushi in Staten Island !

I found this place through word of mouth.  The fact that they have pinball machines peaked my interests.  I went with my wife and my 5 and 7 year old.  It's kind of a bar scene with an arcade feel.  They had few tables which were all high tops but and friendly atmosphere.  We arrived at 3 when they open but the kitchen doesn't open until 4.  So we waited and used the time to play some games.  My kids were in heaven.  I walked over to the pinball machines and the only had three, which was slightly disappointing.  At least they were top end machines.  I played the ACDC machine and had a blast.  45 minutes just melted away.  I even got some triple ball bonuses and a free game, I was back in the 80's!  The service was great and the menu is made up of fresh local ingredients.  My burger was well seasoned and cooked perfectly.  Fries were good as well although they seem to be a frozen product, but cooked properly and seasoned nicely.  My kids did not eat all their food but the games trumped food on this occasion for them.  My wife ate her chicken sandwich and said it was yummy.  All in all it was a good experience.  I'll be back.
Food is good when you eat there. Just don't get delivery. Was told it would take 35 minutes. Food arrived 90 minutes later cold and soggy.

We ordered from Franks last night at 8:10pm, didn't receive the pies until 9:55pm. We called repeatedly and each time was told that the pies would be there shortly. After our pies arrived we called Franks again to better understand what the issue was regarding the major delay and why it took 1 hour and 45 minutes to deliver 3 pies 5 blocks. My wife called and after being called "hun" by the initial person she spoke to, she asked to speak to the manager. The manager, Phillis, was by far one of the most unprofessional and rude managers we have ever spoken to. Phillis called my wife dumb repeatedly and told us we should have ordered from dominos instead. Being a family oriented town and serving our community, this is unacceptable behavior from a business and a manager. From now own we will be ordering from other business and not from Franks. I don't appreciate my wife being called "Hun" in and effort to belittle her or trivialize her complaint and furthermore to have a business call a customer dumb is enough for me to write this review and suggest Franks is not a quality family oriented Caldwell business.
My first trip into NYC, and the first time I had NY pizza. It did not disappoint! Wonderful friendly service.
Third time visit this restaurant for handmade noodle. Food there never disappoint us. The noodle soup is taste better than the one in Chinatown. Also recommend their sushi appetizers.

Very disappointing. We had reservations for 6:30 pm and weren't seated until 6:50. I ordered the FRUTTO DI MARE e RISOTTO - SEAFOOD and RISOTTO, which was a mixture of shrimp, scallops, a tiny bit of chopped up asparagus, all mixed in with overcooked risotto. The seafood was also overcooked - chewy shrimp and dry scallops. The dish looked as bad as it tasted. It was essentially flavorless... and overpriced at $22. I couldn't eat much of it.  My friend ordered the PICCATA alla TRECOLORI (Veal Piccata) and said it was very bland. Service was also on the slow side. After our dinner plates were bussed, the waiter came by with dessert menus. We decided on our desserts, but waited so long for the waiter to come back to take our orders that we had to skip it and leave or we would have been too late for the show we were attending.
It was still a half hour before their closing time and they were turning people away on Halloween night...

Incredible! I mean seriously...$1.00 for 4 incredibly juicy, hot, crispy delicious dumplings??? This has to be the best deal in NYC! And by far, the best dumplings!!!  Just walk in and say "one please" and you are handed 4 pieces of heaven!

My very favorite place to go for brunch. Affordable and delicious with yummy portions. I always get the veggie homefries (sometimes with avocado added) and a side of French toast. The French toast is buttery and amazing. The waitresses have always been friendly to me. Love getting carry out from here, too!

You'd think a Thai restaurant would have good Thai food. Thai Village will refute that assumption. I had a fair lemongrass soup, and a lame rendition of Kee Mao. Any basil present in the dish must have been leftover from the summer. As for my 4* request? I could have fed this bland noodle to my infant. From a value standpoint - where to start? A modest portion of kee Mao was $11. It came with nothing. That 10-oz cup of soup was another $5. With tip (I don't blame wait staff for a bad business) I paid $19 for what should have been an $8 meal. Thai Village? More like High Pillage. Never again.

This place got worse the longer I stayed. They were missing two of the five items on the brunch menu, but didn't inform us until after we had signed up for the unlimited brunch. After planning for a two-hour meal, after two and a half our food hadn't arrived. The chicken and waffles (sans waffles) can with French fries that tasted like they were reheated from McDonalds. Worst service I've ever experienced for bad food. Don't come here under any circumstances.

Finally an authentic Cuban cantina to eat at somewhat close to me. The Cuban sandwich is simply one of the best I've had in years. The tostones and maduros are delicious. Also real Cuban coffee. On my list to eat at when in Boonton area. The owner is very friendly and was taught by his grandmother and does her proud.

A cool place to have brunch or lunch on the week ends. The staff is always really nice and the little terrace out back is a great hang out when it's sunny. We sometime wait a little bit for the food but the music is nice so it's not a problem in the end.
Great place! Good food! Great atmosphere. Heart of the city. The service is awesome, the people are great! This is just the best place in philly to grab some food and a beer.

There's a pho war in this town. Most people I know swear by Pho 75 as their go-to, but I am willing to fight at the front lines for Viet Huong. Here's why: -delicious food, but honestly I think all the food at the Vietnamese spots on Washington Ave is more or less the same. -Nicest servers. They remember me and always seem happy to see me, and even are patient while I practice my pronounciation of menu items -Booths instead of uncomfortable metal chairs -nice soft lighting. some of the other pho spots are flourescent and not very inviting -beer, wine, and cocktails! Get the summer rolls and the mixed meats pho. Honestly one of my favorite meals in Philly!

Great food! Great price! I love how they give you lots of extra vegetables that you can add to your tacos. The tacos are really good! My favorite vegetables are the roasted onions. They also deliver which is great!

Service here is dodgy and some things are overpriced. They constantly have a lot of business but never seem to have control over the situation. I keep coming back because it's so convenient, and there's good wi-fi. The hummus wrap is yummy for lunch, but Cedar Park Cafe down the street is way better for brunch. Overall: they seem almost mad that they have such a good thing going and I've often been hurried through my meals.
They're a bit on the pricier side for drinks but the food is really good. Loved the mac & cheese & wings. Would definitely go back.

I work evenings and get done around nine and this is the only place in town that you can get consistently great food at that time of night. Other places may still be open but you are either the only one at the bar or it's very busy but the food is horrible. They have a great variety of small appetizers on the bar menu, which I love. The dinner menu is great also. I had the Salmon on Wednesday and it was out of this world. The oyster selection is really amazing and always taste fresh & incredible. I have had just about everything on the menu here and have truly enjoyed it all. Kind of funny but two of my favorites are the New York and the Grilled 1/2 Chicken. Don't get me wrong the fish is always tasty and cooked perfect but I figured in a Fish house they would have sub-par steak & chicken, definitely not the case! It's almost like they assume people will think that, so they go above and beyond on those items.

Not many Greek restaurants around. But this one does it right. Fresh seafood, traditional gyro platters, Greek wine!  Some of my favorites are the octopus, gigante beans & the eleniki prassini salad. You have to try this place if you are in the monroe area. Only downfall is that it is a little pricy but I guess you get what you pay for
Truffle mayo on the side is the best!!! 5 stars for great service and great frites!!!
no
Worth the wait.  Meets the expectations presented on various forums.  The staff is very active, the menu is interesting, the ramen is wonderful.

Executive Chef James DeSisto has created a great new venue in Montclair at the recently reopened Laboratorio Kitchen. No, it is not an Italian restaurant. It is a terrific and welcomed restaurant featuring New American cuisine. Greeted by welcoming and friendly (but not overly solicitous) staff, the space is well decorated and comfortable. One of our group started with an asian pear salad which popped with a hint of mint. The iceberg lettuce salad with roquefort was well presented and a nice prelude to the entrees. Our group favored the Ribeye steak and lamb chops which were prepared perfectly. Finally, we shared the pecan pie dessert which was outstanding. This is a wonderful addition to the already rich group of restaurant choices in Montclair.  You will not be disappointed.

Just, no. Went here once and had awful service. Waiter mixed up the orders but refused to acknowledge it. Service was slow and kind of painful. There are no options for people who don't like spicy, so don't bother bringing someone here who can't handle tons of spice. Overcrowded. Confusing. Not a fan.

Have been here twice for dinner.  Never crowded when I've been here. Heard it gets better later in the evening when the DJ comes.  Plenty of room and a couple of pool tables.  The food is delicious.  I had the tacos with meat and they were out of this world.  Priced like any other place.
Terrible I have no idea why there are good reviews. Doughy pizza that was under cooked. Where's DAT good cripsy pizza at?!?

Great Place For food lovers! Leuke klein restaurant in de upper westside waar met liefde voor eten gekookt wordt. De eigenaar struint dagelijks de markten af om met lekkere, eerlijke en gezonde specials te komen. Een echte aanrader!

I'm really upset. My family came in to enjoy the fantastic wings, but the quality of service was so poor. We got seated at a very crowded corner and we were missing a chair. When we asked about getting a chair, they said there weren't any and we would have to snatch it if we saw one. The waitress got two of the orders wrong and because they were wrong, there was an issue with the billing. We weren't given utensils to eat with and my sister received her meal 10 minutes late. I got home and called to complain to the manager. We didn't want to cause a scene and ruin someone else's dinner. We honestly wanted to get out of there ASAP! This was THE WORST experience we've ever.
I am a big fan of the veggie rolls on vermicelli. Nice place with a classy atmosphere to bring friends.
Went with some friends and we had so much fun! The chief was very nice and attentive. Great place and delicious food! Loved it

Service sucks!!! We asked for creamer and guess what, they're out of stock! Gave evaporated milk instead and when asked when are they having creamer. The manager on duty said late in the afternoon. Is too much if she ask one of her staffs to buy at right aid. It's not eve a half mile walk.

Short: Food deserves better service. The first time I came here was awesome; great beer, cheese, specials, etc.  The service was good too...the first time I went.  I went again with some friends and family for my birthday recently, and I had been looking forward to eating there all week.  But I definitely left very disappointed.  Our waitress was pleasant enough, I'm not sure if she was new or just having an off night, because the service was the worst I've had.  Brought out 35 dollars worth of appetizers 10 minutes after our meals had been served.  It was also clear that the fault was not on the kitchen staff, but that our food was simply not brought over to us.  My meal was served cold.  Glasses were left empty for long spans of time.  One person at our table left with a stained shirt because a waitress dropped the contents of a plate on him.   All of those things are no big deal at the end of the night and people make mistakes, and they did comp the appetizers.  It was certainly disappointing though.  I'm sure I'll be back eventually because the food is amazing, but I'll probably be bringing my money somewhere else for the foreseeable future.

This has been my favorite pizza place forever! I have tried all of the other places in town and there have been some good ones but when it comes to just straight up pizza, Foxy's wins hands down. I am not a huge fan of the other items on their menu and haven't really tried that many. Pizza night means Foxy at our house and we can always rely on it being done perfectly! It's nice to have a place in town that we like that has survived since childhood!

WORST SERVICE EVER! HORRIBLE! I forgot to review this place but it was so horrible I had to warn others. For the type of price point they have and the fine dining atmosphere ( I will say it is beautifully decorated and the owner obviously put a lot of time,effort, and money into the decor) they have the looks of a 5 star restaurant & THAT IS IT! There is nothing extraordinary or spectacular about the restaurant, food, or service. They poorly train their servers on how to interact/behave with the customers. I am thoroughly familiar with Indian food and I know it inside and out so when I came to Tashan I was expecting to be "WOW-ed" but was very dissappointed to see that the staff completely butchered the names, but I'll let that go- what I can't let go is that they had no basic knowledge of Indian food AND ONTOP OF THAT THEY WERE ALL SO DISGUSTINGLY RUDE TO MY GUESTS AND I. Deal breaker right there! City prices with a city attitude and hostility. I came here twice. The first time was about a year ago, the hostess greeted us, sat us, watered us, and took our order with much difficulty. We had been told they were closing soon so we had to rush our order in-no problem but the attitude was horrible and the food was not worth it. Small portions and a little bland. Anyhow, I decided to give it another shot and the 5 of us re-visited. This time we came around 5 pm? Not sure but they were very busy, yet it seemed they had enough waiters to go around- if only they were well trained, organized, and cared about maintaing a standard which is imperative for such a restaurant.   Our waitress came over after making us wait extra long and watered us, then asked for drinks- which arrived very late and no refills on water- forget about refills on the drinks! We asked her about the apps and how many we should get-her response for a table of 5 was to get 8-10 appetizers. You know there is something wrong when you need to order 10 appetizers to have a somewhat substantial amount WOW not only did we order over a hundred dollars in appetizers but they arrived one by one over a period of 40 mins AND WE DID NOT EVEN RECIEVE ALL OF THEM! We got the wrong naan bread and everything came out sparingly it was such a joke and a huge disappointment, especially since we were all so hungry. She refused to acknowledge that we didn't get everything we ordered and when we asked how long dinner will take she replied with a snarky rude comment! Unbelievable at that point we cancelled the dinner order and she called the manager out who offered to discount us but we refused. We wanted him to let the owner know what kind of a service he is providing and the very fact that the concept of ordering 10 appetizers for a group of 10 is seriously flawed. He adjusted our bill and charged us for WHAT WE DID GET and took off what we never received. If you don't know real indian food, you might find this place okay. they do a good job of diluting what real indian food is supposed to be with a Western twist to it. I love western food, especially indian fusion cuisines and this place attempts to modernize it for the city people and for their non-indian customers but they fail at doing so. The menu is limited and I think the menu is a problem to an extent- it is not a traditional menu and I appreciate the attempt in trying to give people something different but it doesn't work for me. Lastly the food, from what I remember the first time we visited was the saag( spinach) which was good. The biryani was NOT a traditional flavorful spiceful biryani- mediocre at best. The daal was ALRIGHT I've had better, & the signature dish of indian cuisine the Chicken Makhani/butter Chicken was decent. The baingan Bartha was a let down- so bland it was like eating raw egg plant. The food was overall average, maybe slightly below average considering the prices. Like I said, if you don't know Indian food well you might find that this place is acceptable but for some one like me it just doesn't cut it- the food nor the service.
Went there tonight. Food was great. Very nice decor. Nice presentation. Very friendly staff. Definitely will be returning soon. Prices were very reasonable.
The ramen is fresh and delicious. Staff is very courteous and friendly. I've eaten lots of pork buns but these take the cake! If you get a chance to stop in don't pass it up.

My review is for the overall restaurant, although, I would give the bar staff a rating of 5 and the rest of the restaurant, which includes the food a rating of 3.  I'm a regular at SCG and have been since it opened.  I love the bar staff, Patrick, Stephanie, Jackie and Ashley.. They are always awesome, friendly and make a great drink.  I've had almost everything on the menu over the years and food is usually good.  Sometimes not great.., sometimes a bit skimpy on portions, but typically good.  I had the bbq for the first time a week ago and I do have to say they were some of the best I've ever had.  Sooo Yum.  If you want a great burger, you can't go wrong, especially if you're a blue cheese person, the blues burger is incredible.  Happy hours are great, with good prices.   Wish they would extend the HH's until 7:00 every night instead of 6:30.  Also, I must add that the food selections overall on the menu and the lighter dishes, such as the apps have gotten more limited and I suggest the menu be revamped to include more selections and also some more reasonably priced options.  The appetizer menu is really awful and if you just want something small to eat, you have to spend $16-19 on an app or get the SCG potato chips which are around $7, which is both ridiculous and not the healthiest choice.  Definitely need to add some variety and more reasonably priced items.  I've left this place several times early to go have dinner someplace else.

Good food and excellent service. The staff were extremely friendly. The chicken tikka masala and the paneer makhani were the best dishes we ordered. The coconut naan is a great naan to order because it is just a little sweet. I was impressed with the everything I ordered. The food was delicious and better than most Indian places in San Francisco. Great food, great service, great place.

My partner and I eagerly awaited the opening of this establishment and she and I were both extremely impressed with our experience. It is always a bold move to introduce a very niche style of establishment to this city, especially with a concept as ubiquitous as "pizza."  I hope your plans for becoming Neapolitan certified succeed - this pizza is truly exceptional and well on its way to making this restaurant one of our favorite neighborhood spots.

It has been a long long wait since George and Jennifer Sabatino left Stateside.  But it was definitely worth the wait.  Amazingly inventive cocktails, creative (and more importantly, delicious) small and large plates makes this my vote for the Best New Restaurant in Philly for 2014.  Hands down.
Awesome spot!

The food was just okay but the service was horrible.   We waited 15 minutes for someone to come over just to tell us they'll be back to take our order.  This took another 5 to 10 minutes.  If you have time to waste for food that's just okay, this is the place for you.  I'll never go there again.
This is my favorite restaurant in the city!!! I love their mussels. I've eaten mussels in many high-end restaurants and this place is best I've ever tasted. They also have awesome Belgian beer.

The atmosphere here is kind of dark and romantic, so don't bring someone here when trying to keep them in the friend zone. Just saying. Overall: love the curry, pad thai is not great. Hate that they only take cash. Not my favorite Thai in the world, but I've yet to a find a favorite Thai place in Philly.
I love this man.
Awesome place ! We were waited on as soon as we sat down by Justin.  Buffalo shrimp was great and thin crust pizza was NY good. Will definitely come back.
awesome, cozy and inexpensively great food. only ate dinner there.
Food is good. Can be a very loud place in a Friday night. Drinks tend to have a lot of liquor. Asked for a rum and coke, tasted like they forgot the coke.

This place is amazing in every way -- food, service, decor, ambience, clientele.  Chic, chic, chic! The best grilled octopus I have ever had, and the dorado was heavenly. We ended the meal sharing a divine yogurt and berry compote dessert. This will become a regular haunt of mine.
Really, ridiculously good Indian food. It's a little bit pricey and delivery takes about an hour, but I'd say it's worth it. My boyfriend and I order from here at least once a month.

Such a cozy environment where we sat  down and relaxed waiting for food with the football game playing. We ordered a breakfast burger each and was amazed how delicious and filling this burger was. The fries are yummy as well. It's was filling even for a big stomach I have so its worth every penny!!

Keep going back.  Best Turkey dinners on Sunday throughout the year (don't have to wait til Thanksgiving).  Always a baked potato after 4:00PM any day of the week. Friendly staff and manager,  Conor, is there to greet and make all welcome.  It is a relaxing place to have lunch, dinner or a light snack ..or on some days just dessert!
The waiters are very friendly! I ordered spring roll and pai thai, they are awesome and taste different than the other thai u might probably have

I have been coming here with my girlfriend since they opened last year.  Phenomenal tacos, burritos, nachos.  Stand outs are the pollo and al pastor options.  Extra salsa bar is a perfect touch to make every experience special. The staff is friendly and attentive which is few and far between off St. Mark's.  I hope this place sticks around as it has gained a full time position in my EV food rotation. Thank you Diana

I want to love this place. Great quiet downtempo townie vibe but every time I'm in here the bartender is completely checked out from serving the people sitting at the bar and it takes me 10+ minutes to get the check or another round.

As a Japanese person growing up in America, one of the few things my parents insisted on was proper fish.  We'd drive 1 hour (it seemed longer when we were kids) to go to a fish store they liked, rather than buy the dubious fish that was offered at the local super markets. Well, Nassau Street Seafood reminds me exactly of the place we went to.  They are clearly (a) more expensive, and (b) fresher and more experienced than the grocery store seafood department.  Your own tastes and budget will have to dictate whether it's worth it (both time and money) for you.  For me, it's worth it.  I will buy their tuna for sashimi, but only if we mutually agree it's "sashimi grade", which usually they do, but not always. Here's two tips: (1) you can learn to see freshness in fish.  (2) ask them: "what's really fresh that you like." All good fish mongers will answer (2) honestly.  If you just march in and order what you came in to buy, at Nassau Street Seafood it will be fine, but you might miss a special catch/buy they sourced in the AM. I only get my fish there, I don't try their restaurant/takeout business. Jack Morrison, the owner, also owns the deservedly well-liked seafood dinner-only Blue Point Grill next door. Disclaimer: over the years I've made friends with Jeremy, one of their managers.  I don't think this influences my review, but want to mention it.

We ordered delivery this weekend and it was the first time ordering from Fortissimo. Everything was awful.
