That would never happen here, and every guest I have taken to GT has loved the place and thanked me for finding out about it. The bar service is amazing. If you ask an opinion, for example, on what bourbon or tequila to drink, you get a wonderful tutuorial on the subject. All servers are very knowledgeable about the menu too. The food is just out of this world. My pals from a southern R&B band would not be saitsfied with the amount of food, that is not what GT is all about. The entrees and starters are exquisite. Every dish is the best it could be, with very surprising sauces and combinations. Just choose what ingredient you love, and be assured you will love your dish. Please consider the amazing cheese flights (three, five, or seven as I recall). Special cocktails are wonderful and the alcohol free cocktails are the best you will ever taste.

Meal: Dinner Type: Vegetarian Price: Around $50 for two Service: Good Recommended Dish: Jaipuri Kofta with plain Naan The food is good, but their dessert was a disappointment. And the restaurant was extremely packed and crowded. I would prefer to get the food delivered rather than eat there.

Reading Terminal is a great place to visit and shop. Tourists and locals enjoy the variety of shops and eateries. We buy our best fruits and vegetables there. The butcher shops offer the finest cuts of meat and will pack it on ice if you need to keep it cool. This is a must stop in the City of Brotherly Love, don't miss it. Even try the Gator Gumbo

Yummylicious! The ambiance was very good, the foods SUPERB and the price was so affordable. Were are so happy with the great experience in here.
Love this place. Very welcoming atmosphere. Hamburgers are so good. They have many different options. Would recommend to all hamburger lovers.

The food is just amazing and it's close to the Arts museum, you can eat out and then enjoy the museum.

Not only was the slice huge but it was delicious. It was tasty, the crust was perfect and slightly crispy.  The sauce was good with a good amount of oozing cheese on top. I'm eating pizza somewhere else right now and wishing I was eating at Gina's instead. I wasn't a huge fan of their Italian sub but the pizza is def worth trying.

My favorite pizza place in the greater Hartford area. Their cheese to sauce to crust ratio is perfect. The crust, oh my lord, the crust is the most warm, fluffy, delicious crust  to ever be attached to pizza. The restaurant itself is located in an old grocery store and they left the tiles up making where the produce, fish, etc. used to be located. The feeling is great in there and there is also nice outdoor seating for the summer. This place is my go to whenever I want to order pizza and is one of my favorite parts of Wethersfield. It is worth a visit to anyone who even remotely enjoys eating pizza!

I have been going here for a few years now and it is my favorite restaurant. The food is amazing and the service is fast. All of the servers are very kind and remember you when you go back. The best Ethiopian food I have ever had!

I have the say the food is top notch, this has been my go to place for burritos. The only negative I have to give this place is the customer service. When I came in to order food, the staff just stared and didn't approach me for quite some time. That'll make you feel awkward!

My friends and I first went in because it seemed like a typical dive bar that we would like but it ended up being a surprising find in the financial district. The food was delicious. I have had the fried mac and cheese, crispy fried rice, and the pork belly sandwich at different times and they were all great.   What really makes this bar unique is the atmosphere.  Fishmarket is a bar where you actually have that thought, "this is my local bar" which is very rare in the city.  Jeff and the other bartenders are so welcoming and fun.  They make it so it seems you are just hanging out having drinks with some old friends.  Another bonus, was the round of Jameson Jeff had given to the whole bar to keep the fun going.  You will always leave with a good time and some great new friends.  Highly recommend!
so good I wish they would deliver!!
Read about this place and found it randomly coming off of Bay St station.  Very cute, retains its Brooklyn-vibe.  Baked goods are delicious.  I can't wait to have them deliver!

The food is good here but it's a huge shame that the service sucks. It makes the whole experience, whether your dining in or taking out, totally not worth it. There food takes forever to come out and their waitstaff is neglectful. Be warned, I ordered by phone and when I came to pick it up, they informed me they had given my order to someone else. At 9pm, the last thing I wanted to do was wait another hour to get food. Seriously, how do you mess up giving an order for "Emma" to a guy.
It is a place we like a lot. we love the healthy options and the garden. We have been eating there a couple of times and we will be back.

For as much as I travel and eat pizza on the road this was by far the best!! Super nice delivery lady. You can order plates, napkins and forks online which is wonderful when you live in a hotel! I will for sure be ordering when I am back in town!! Thank you Uncle Tony's pizza!!

Many thanks to John's staff and management for taking pity on 2 Flyers fans from upstate NY who arrived just at closing time on Sat. Oct. 25th, 2014. The staff couldn't be friendlier and the cheese steak sandwich and roast pork sandwich were delicious- our favorite being the cheese steak definitely!  Wonderfully hearty crusty roll heaped with steak and our choice of cheese and fried onions...YUM! Love the food here & affordable.

Fast becoming one of my favorite places for casual dining. BYOB where the food is utterly delicious. Staff is great, very attentive, no rushing no matter how busy they are   The thin, square pizza is a must!!

I love Wedge + Fig. I am always happy with the service I receive as their customer, and my meals are always fresh.

Delicious I order third of chicken beans and rice chicken noodle soup steam broc and fried shrimp dinner  amazing great customer service also. this place is so so so very good. service isn't slow and is attentive as well. love the complimentary rice chips! the hanger steak and sunchokes are a must! love this place like a lot.

I was here with a friend for brunch and we were given dinner menus by the hostess. When we sat down, we told our server that we want to order from the brunch menu because WE WERE GIVEN DINNER MENUS!! She said, "this is what we are serving right now". We don't know if we're supposed to be given dinner menus at 12nn even if the next table is still enjoying the brunch items they ordered. So we decided to order from the dinner menu that was given to us. I initially ordered kale salad and a "dinner entree" for my friend. The server came back to us and asked my friend what she ordered because it's not on the menu. Guess what?!! She handed us "A BRUNCH/LUNCH MENU!!!" We told her that we were given dinner menus so we'll take a look at the brunch/lunch menus that she handed us. She said, "okay. It's okay!" then walked away. No apologies from her!! So my friend and I shared that single brunch/lunch menu she handed us trying to figure out what to eat. Im giving two stars for this restaurant due to it's location and design. That's it! Food was okay. Tip: HIDE your dinner menus when it's not dinner time yet!

The food was excellent, the atmosphere, the prices were completely reasonable, and the service was totally fine. In fact, after a few hesitant miscommunications with the chef, she warmed up remarkably and everyone was all smiles. Very highly recommend this place. It just felt warm and wonderful.
This place is pretty much the bomb.  I don't wait in line for anything but I will here.  I don't need to tell you what's good, because it all is.

Mom and I gave this place a whirl last night. See photos. I can't understand the bad reviews here. Don't believe them. This place is excellent. At first glance, the prices seem a little high for a diner. But you quickly find out why. The food is top quality and very fresh. The whole staff that we encountered were as friendly as could be - made you feel like family. Our waitress was excellent and friendly and also left us alone enough to eat while checking in now and then to see if we needed anything. Someone else here mentioned a waitress "hovering."  We did not experience that at all. I ordered the Philly Steak wrap and Mom ordered the Monte Cristo. While we waited, our waitress brought a pickle and cole slaw for each of us. I'm not a fan of cole slaw, but I always try it when I get it because everyone makes it differently. The cole slaw here is excellent! It's rare that I will say that. Very tasty and fresh, slightly sweet and not too much bite like a lot of them have. A+. My wrap would normally come with fries but I'm trying to eat a little more healthy these days, so I asked for a vegetable instead and chose the stir fry. I was expecting the usual couple of sprigs of broccoli that most places will give you, but wow! What I got was a giant plate of mixed vegetables that were absolutely delicious!  Sautéed in olive oil and a bit of garlic, and the oil was clearly fresh. Ever been to some diners where the oil is not so fresh? Yeah, you know what I'm talking about. My wrap was very tasty and juicy yet not as sloppy as such things can be. Mom's Monte Cristo was a site to behold! A huge, open faced sandwich on two giant, fat pieces of french toast! Mounds of turkey, ham and cheese - just gorgeous. I had a taste and, wow! Fresh turkey like you'd slice from home and all of it so tasty. I've had plenty of diner food in my day. I don't know how to describe when you get meats like turkey or chicken and it's just not fresh...it's more like that turkey loaf that you see that comes in an aluminum tin?  Or it's real turkey but it's obviously been camping out in the fridge way too long?  This was fresh as could be, as if just roasted and sliced that day, and probably was. We were so full we did not have room for dessert, but we are definitely going back. Their sign outside says "Bakery on Premises" so the baked yummies must be pretty tasty. Well done, A-1 Diner. A happy surprise right in my own town.
delicious-super cheap

Came here a few times since living in the area. I haven't been disappointed at all. Tonight we went with my in-laws. Waitress was awesome! Tony the manager was also awesome. Our steaks came out all wrong-mine was way overdone, another was way underdone. They were fixed right away and were way better than expected! Will definitely come back.

Rude rude service. Very very loud at long table. Felt rushed. Very arrogant. Pastas are very average. Had a microwaved chocolate soufflé that came out 2 minutes after ordered....burning hot. Won't return. Looks authentic but it's not.

Ok, I have had large family holiday gatherings there and order from them several times a month but because of this really abusive experience, I am no longer a patron. Sad. Shame on you!!!!  If this site would let me enter NO stars .. for customer service.. yeah, that's what I would do. Bethel Caram

Went with my girlfriend a few months ago, love this restaurant. The service was great, food was good and really like the decoration  of this place, very cute and cozy. The wagyu beef tarter was so delicious as well as the asparagus. The pork loin was very juicy and tender. We would love to visit this place again and try out their other dishes.
Good food for a good price!!!
It was a great experiece at Bustan and I will definitely go back there again! The portions were big and everything we well cooked. I especially loved the dessesrt.

This spot was "da bomb"! Excellent quality for a great price. If you want your Baba's perogis this is the spot that will take you back. Its pick up/take out no dining in but worth the trip. Call ahead for pick up if you are having a party.
One hour wait but it definitely lives up to the hype! The fresh basil and olive oil on the pizza is absolutely delicious!

Service was ok. I expected better pizza. Food channel showed this place was incredibly good. NO. NOT AT ALL. Charged me for refill on ice tea. What the hack is that. Never going back again. Spend $50 to take a taxi there. I felt really stupid.
The scallion pancake, a spicy brisket bao and shoppe fries were excellent! The interior leaves a lot to be desired but they are quick and it's still good once I get it home.
I love coming here. There atmosphere is friendly warm and inviting.  Their chili is fantastic. The bar is an original.
Love Malaysian food. Very good and inexpensive

Really enjoyed this place.  Shared a strawberry and banana with Nutella AND a orange mango crepe. It was so good. Very light and fluffy. I also shared the steak crepe and it was delicious. Btw, when I say "share" the portions are huge so I had to share. The owner and waitress were also very nice and attentive. I will be returning for more.
One of the first places we visited since moving to the area.  Delicious deli foods, friendly staff, and great bread.
Horrible. Don't even bother!

I travel through Newark airport twice a week and won't be making the mistake of eating at this place again. High prices for low quality food...even for an airport. The lobster roll was sadly small on stale bread and tasted only like green peppers.  Sweet potato chips weren't fresh or hot and had an unexpected and overwhelming curry spice and salt flavor. Waited over an hour, but it was still worth it. We had some pork buns at the bar, and it was the best decision ever. Warm, sweet, glazed pork belly just melted in your mouth and it was heavenly. When we finally got seated, the ramen was equally as good. The broth was amazingly thick and rich, and I could feel my arteries clogging, but it was so worth it. Best comfort food ever.

Very nice place. Excellent value for the money. Food is a bit too spicy for my taste, but hey - that's Indian restaurant!! Recommend reservations because it gets pretty crowded after 6 pm. Very nice drink menu. Portions are large. A bit small place for parties larger then 4. Will come back!
Good food good service and good prices. The half carafe of red wine at happy hour nearly poured over the top. Great specials.

My Food: The Pad Thai was mediocre and bulked out to look like a normal portion with a bed of bean sprouts hidden under the noodles. The dish had absolutely no flavor and I had to ask for chili sauce to give it some. The Staff: Everyone seemed friendly and accommodating, but extremely overwhelmed and apologetic. The Atmosphere: Do you like dungeons? Are you a plumber? Do you like filth masked by black paint? Then welcome! The whole place is literally a dingy, dark basement with exposed plumbing inches above your head and decorated with broken framed paintings of Thai dignitaries on the walls. I was half expecting to catch the eyes of the paintings to move as we walked by. I didn't realize until we left that there was a septic pipe from the bathroom of a business upstairs running directly over us. The place was packed with local college students which by no means should give you the impression of quality dining. I would recommend passing on this place and trying your luck at one of the dozens of other Thai restaurants scattered across New Haven.

Found this gem with Yelp's help. Small but vibrant. Yummy cocktails and bustling for a weeknight. Opted for the tasting menu - apps were dreamy, gnocchi course was from heaven. Main courses were average. Maybe we were too full from the earlier courses? Worth another visit. Call ahead tho to make sure there's room.
Wonderful service, wonderful food, great prices... hands down the best indian food in the village. Open late too!!

You've literally never met a more joyful bunch! The food is spectacular the vibe is super chill and the owners are divine. I'd keep coming back for their smiles alone. Crab chowder+ Cold Fall Day= Standing in the sunshine
Food was very good - loved how it was infused with south American flavors ! Space was very nice and TVs were in good spots to watch the game.

This place has the best hot dogs in the world. They are actually called Rippers for those who haven't been here! But besides the rippers, this place also has great burgers, onion rings, Reubens, and plenty of other greasy delicious food. I have been coming to Rutt's Hut since I was a little kid and the place has not changed a bit (except for the "no smoking indoors" law, thank you).  It's not fancy, it's comfortable. Staff is friendly and welcoming. This place is always packed, no matter the time or day. I would highly recommend it anyone.
What good food!! One of the best tasting menus I've had.

Loved this place! It was so laid back and a perfect atmosphere for a lunch break! I'm from Cali and heard that there was no good Mexican food in NYC- well, someone LIED! This place was great. I recommend the cactus taco- sounds weird, but go for it!
Always a great time at Carmines. The food is always great. We have never had a bad meal or bad service at Carmines.  We make it a must every time we get to NYC. Any dish you pick is great.

The Duck Fat fries and lobster mac and cheese were phenomenal and definitely an indulgence. Make sure to get the smores milkshake as well! The setup is not good for large parties, but great for parties of 4
Great place with a very friendly bar! Bartender Ariel rocks!!! Will definitely come back!
Tried kasta kachori with aloo bhaji. This has been the worst kachori I ever ate. Will not come here again or recommend someone to visit this place.
I am so addicted to Shake Shack--I highly recommend the Shack Burger (add bacon) cheese fries, and any of their milkshakes. Five stars for fast food
I love this coffee shop! Delicious coffee choices and a great place to relax and do some work

The best Chinese Buffet I have been to in NJ.  Whenever I go to my parents house in Princeton I try to convince them to go here for lunch first.  There is a wide variety of food dishes to choose from.  Some are great, some are ok, you just have to choose what appeals to you.  For me it's the Juice Dumplings.  It's the only buffet I know of that has them. It's also good if you have kids.  You can eat some of the more "Adult" dishes and they can have chicken and broccoli, scallion pancakes, etc.  If your kid doesn't like Chinese food they also have mac and cheese, fries, chicken nuggets, etc. Rated in the world of buffets I give this place 5 stars.
Great food!!! Good for brunch.

After a long wait, I was not expecting much. But Wow! the pork belly buns are to die for! Great Noodles too, cant talk about service, as the place is so crowded. Over all, very interesting experience.
Fuckin stupid restaurant I found bugs on my food so dirty, price is too expensive and nothing taste, I don't know why people go this ridiculous spot

Very friendly bar service. Tried the filet mignon sliders. Very good. Wings looked great. Will be back.

Had lunch with friends. Server was friendly and he answered all of our questions with a smile.  Maple wings were awesome. Burgers were outstanding, we had both the beef and the lamb. We will be back for dinner in the near future. Highly recommend checking this place out

My oh my how things have change. This place used to be OK and even more than that. Nowadays, this place is one to avoid. It is nearly always empty (I pass by quite often) and started noticing it after I was in one day and thought how deserted it seemed. The next thing I noticed is how this place lost its 'diner' qualities. It just looks and feels like a run down lil 'ol restaurant that's struggling to get by. Even chain diners feel more authentic than this joint. I guess things are so bad that most of their display cases are half empty. Nothing more than what they expect to sell I presume. Almost no sign of cakes, pastries, etc. The service was horrendous. The waitress couldn't care less about her occupation or the people she's supposed to be serving and helping. We had to signal her to come over every single time! She didn't introduce herself nor did she ask if we were ready to order. No recommendations, nothing. It was like ordering from a brick wall that walks and sometimes moves its head in recognition. After our food was served she sort of disappeared I guess. Never came by to ask if we needed anything else or if the food was OK. I had a nice burger. When I say nice, I mean it looked nice. Flavor wise - not the most amazing thing you'll eat. I don't remember the burgers here being this bland before. I dare say it was slightly overcooked to my liking, but that was the least of my worries. The fries were drenched in oil. Seriously, it was like being served oil with some fries as garnish. Also, they were lukewarm. Not cold, but not good enough. They must have stopped using Heinz due to pricing issues, but the ketchup we had was a no-name brand that seriously doesn't stack up. I mean, you're an American diner! Heinz ketchup should be the first thing on the tables! It just looks and tastes right. PS - Don't go to the bathroom.
Stopped by recently and had the crab steam pot, chicken wings, johnny cakes and corn. Everything was great! The food came out fast and we really liked the backyard space. A cool, casual spot.
Great drunchies, open a majority of the time your craving calls for it.
An Earthen Gem in the Heart of Burlington! Very affordable, delicious good quality pizza and amazing ambience. Read more about it on theforbiddenmeal.com/201…

Such a beautiful lil restaurant, amazing service and delicious food. Perfectly casual but special. Incredible vanilla pear jam, had to buy two jars for $10 each. We ordered the huge Jezebel wings, 3 to share between 2 was plenty. Prawns and grits and netty biscuit. Mini biscuit side was a great taster, had to finish off with the chocolate cake. Very memorable!

Yumm! if you are looking for some signature korean food around Ktown, go to BCD! I always order the seafood tofu soup, its so delicious. I am definitely a fan of BCD

I will preface this by saying this poor review is not a reflection of the entire restaurant but of the embarassing attitude of the bar tender.  We were a party of 4 stopping in for drinks and desserts and I will say we had great service from the beginning from our server Nichole.  Onne of our orders was the Mexican hot chocolate but with a shot of kahlua.  When the order arrived, I tried it and didn't think it tasted like it had the chili powder or kahlua in it.  The other people at the table tried it as well and confirmed.  When our server came over to check on us, I let her know and she went to the bartender to replace the drink. Our table was 6 feet from the bar and we could hear the bartender berate the server and then claim that it was the correct drink.  He kept going on and on about the exact 2 oz of kahlua in it.  We heard everything. It was so unprofessional and absolutely rude. When the correct drink came out, it was overloaded with chili powder. I wouldn't send it back or complain again because I didn't want to hear this guy go off once more.  If a drink wasn't made correctly there is no need  to have a tantrum that a 3 year old would throw judgment at.
try the new fashioned!

This place is the dankest. A friend and I stumbled in here on our way to the Knitting Factory, and stuffed our faces with amazing Mediterranean food/imported beers. Started with the beets/lentils, a great appetizer salad, before working into the chicken shwarma platter and the lamb pita wrap things. So delicious! We were so full after all of the amazing food. Deliciousness aside, the place gets five stars for the intangibles. The plate presentation was great (I may have been watching Chopped recently). The staff was very friendly, chatting with us as we sat at the bar, offering us house-made hot sauces, and even giving us a complimentary dessert for no apparent reason. The music was great too - the place had a very relaxed and trendy vibe. All in all, it was a great dining experience - so much so that I'm actually taking the time to leave them a 5-star review.

I've had a really hard time finding decent ramen in Brooklyn. Ganso, despite being the hipsterest ramen joint you will ever see, takes the cake so far. Chuko, on the other hand, was not worth the wait. The pork bun was fine, and the veggies on it added a very refreshing brightness to the bun, but the pork itself was very small and just kind of there. Didn't really add to the flavor. I ordered the pork bone broth with roasted pork. (Kind of a fan of pork.) The broth was bland and much thinner than I'd ever expect of pork bone broth to be. Adding some of their really pretty good garlic oil helped a bit, but I'm a firm believer that a ramen dish should come out perfect from the kitchen. If the customer has to add something to give flavor, you're doing it wrong. The noodles, also bland, lacked the toughness I love in my ramen. And the eggs! I didn't even know it was possible for soft boiled eggs to taste like absolutely nothing! Quite surprising. The staff was incredibly friendly and they were a delight to interact with, but that's no substitute for the still-mythical perfect bowl of Brooklyn ramen. Also! I neglected to check yelp before coming here, and it seems that I probably should have tried the kimchee broth instead. I'll come back and try that some time. There's got to be Some reason there's apparently always a long wait to get in here.

Modo Mio is incredible.  I've been going here for years and it gets better and better each time!  I love there turista menu for $35.  What a value for such an amazing meal.  The sweetbreads were one of the best I've ever tried!
Nino's used to have the best penne and chicken in vodka sauce. We used to look forward to it on Fridays. I guess we will have to look for another spot. Who ever the cook was, bring him back please!!

We decided to try this place despite low yelp ratings because we pass it often and it looked interesting. The end result was a very disappointing meal. I would not feed this food to my dog. The only good thing we ate decent was the sweet plantains. The salsa was a glorified marinara. The guac was essentially a mashed avocado with a few tomatoes on top. The fajita was a large bowl of peppers and onions with some pepper steak mixed in and came out cold. It was far overpriced. We also tried the mixed appetizer taste of Mexico platter. Essentially we got some frozen jalapeño poppers that must have come out of a box. The pico de gallo was some chopped up onions with a few tomatoes thrown in. The chorizo was more or less dog food. We will definitely not be back and I would never recommend this place to anyone. If you want decent Mexican food try Senorita's in Clarke or Mojave Grill in Westfield.

What a great place! Didn't eat at any of the restaurant-style places but boy was my panini good!! Delicious produce at a really reasonable price (especially coming from Australia). Also, don't leave without having a crepe from the Nutella bar. Could spend all day in that cheese section...
Love the food here. Low frills and good quality. Great sushi and great whole fish. Scallion pancake kick butt.

So I need to start this review with one premise...I've never reviewed anything on Yelp. Frankly...no one is deserving of my time unless they wow me. Well, I've been wow'ed!! By fare this place is pretty cool. We came for the grits and shrimps wasn't what I expected it to be. The brunch was ok, the hurricane drink was great love the rum they use. Ok so we came at brunch and the atmosphere was warm and Mello. Overall cat fish was ok.
Once again delighted to be there! Great service. Delicious rolls. Thanks Hendra! See you soon!

Great food and atmosphere. Service could be a bit better or I would have given them five stars.  Never disappointed. The pizza is very good but that is not what I normally get when I go here. The salads are fantastic and specials out of this world.
Great Lunch menu.....BEST Hot & Sour Soup EVER!  SPICY....opens your sinus and on some days you'll even tear up!

Great food; great value. Huge portions and delivery. What's not to like?
Close to the O2 and right off train route. Very dark inside, service was fine, and sushi was pretty fresh.

My girlfriend and I were Bullied by the owner of this restaurant: I met up with two friends that I hadn't seen in over a year, for dinner at DaMarcella this evening (because It was close to one of my friend's apartment.) The food made up for the fact that we were crowded into a bar table with two strangers...so crowded in fact that when our "neighbors" got up to leave, one of them knocked over and shattered a wine glass in his attempt to squeeze through the tight quarters. We were enjoying ourselves so we decided to order a dessert while finishing our wine. Our bill came to $167.00 and we left a $33 tip. One of our friends had to leave but the two of us who remained decided to sit and chat for a few minutes. Within 5 minutes, the staff especially a large bald man were breathing down our necks. I've worked in restaurant service for years so I understood it when they were trying to get the table turned over, but at the same time, they were being extremely intrusive and downright rude. I walked over to the large man and said to him, "We enjoyed the food and the waiter was very nice but we really don't like being rushed." He made no attempts to apologize. I said that $200 was a lot for us to spend on dinner and we weren't happy about having men standing over us and trying to clear us out before we were ready. I thought he was Italian, and i come from an Italian family so I said something in Italian and he said, "We're in America, speak English only." He then began to laugh (literally) in my face and walked into the kitchen and waved me off with his hand. It got to the point where I asked him why he was being so nasty and finally why he was being such an ass to me after I'd given him my business. He then said to me, "This is your last time in this restaurant. You'll never eat here again!" I really didn't understand. I've dealt with so many different types of clients', guests, customers' complaints throughout my 30 years in service and I've never even thought to treat a person who was spending their hard earned money at any establishment I was working at, in this manner. I generally listen to their experience and then try to make them feel better. I'd never consider walking away while a patron is talking or blowing them off or talking to them in a condescending nasty manner as this man talked to me. I would like folks who read this to consider the way that one of the owners of this restaurant chose to treat a well meaning patron who was trying to enjoy a nice dinner with good friends after a looooong week at work. I will never go there again and I hope that others will care enough about this mistreatment not to patronize this business.
Always Reliable, Food and service always good...

nice place. staffs are super nice...but they don't have enough staffs. the miso noodle is super yummy i will go back for sure

OK- let's clear something up for the non-cuban populace out here in cyberspace. When one goes to out with the intent of eating Cuban food- Alma De Cuba, Rosa Blanca, Cuba Libre, Mixto, etc. are NOT places to experience this. These are just places that cater to tourist and non-hispanics. Basically, Cuban cuisine does not contain guacamole or ceviche anywhere. Ceviche is from Peru, though some Equadorians make it and guacamole is Mexican. Therefore, what you are eating at these places is not authentic Cuban food. How do I know this-mmm, let's see, cause I was born in Cuba, third generation. NEWSFLASH: Unfortunately, Philadelphia does not have a large Cuban population. Hence, there are no authentic Cuban restaurants anywhere to be found- whether upscale or mom and pop places. If you ever care to try real Cuban cuisine, go to Union City, NJ (there are still some of us left there) or little Havana in Miami. It's usually what I have to do if I don't want to cook or drive to my mom's. But not all is lost- eventually, I'll be opening up a small 100% Cuban restaurant where you'll be able to enjoy some real Cuban food!

Unexpectedly arrived to a busy dining room.  Read on a local blog that this was an opening week, so I didn't anticipate such a crowd.  Really energetic, I guess you could say as soon as my friends, husband and I arrived.   We hit sat at bar and waited for table....cheese plate was great....Wine on draft was even better... in dining room, our server ( I think Val or Vicky), greeted us with a rundown of the beer list and suggestions for pizzas and mussels to share.  We split a honey goat cheese flatbread, which was phenomenal with my second glass of Chard.   Had trouble deciding on entrees...ended up splitting apps for the table for our main course...Foie gras mousse (A+), Beet Parfait (I want this to replace my morning granola breakfast), Prime Rib (I didn't get to try as my husband devoured it, but he our said it's the best he'd had in years), and the Monkfish ( B+, I wish I had some bread to soak up the broth...smoked mussels were amazing though).  Really enough food for 4 of us to split and walk away happy.   It was my girlfriend's birthday, and though we never mentioned it, our server must have overheard and dropped a dessert....maybe the best rice pudding Ive ever had.   great looking room for a casual dinner with friends...open kitchen was cool.

best smoked salmon and fresh fruit

Before I write this review I have to tell you I don't really care much about service.  I'm much more interested in ambiance, food and the people I'm with but The Blind Pig, has changed me.  My boyfriend and I live 1/2 a block from this restaurant and out of sheer convenience and yearning for a local place to call our own, we've tried this place 3x.  With each experience we are completely disappointed.  The first time we went in it took over 15 minutes to get a drink and after our first round they ran out of our beer.  When we ask for the check the bartender kept eating and drinking her food and after she was done (and was asked for the 2x time) she slowly walked over to get it.  PS the place was empty at the time.  The other experiences the service was even worse.  Now, The Blind Pig is on our banned list.

This place is a hidden gem!! I was visiting family in New York and my cousin and I were eager to take part in their boozy brunch. Bottomless Mimosas? Yes, Please! The decor and ambiance was wonderful. We sat at the bar and were served by Jonathan. HE WAS FANTASTIC!! The drinks were amazing and he recommended "the forager" - absolutely divine! My cousin isn't too fond of mushrooms and even she was raving about it!!  We also ordered the french toast, the scotch egg, and rosemary potatoes. Dishes are tapas style, which is a fantastic way to try a variety of delicious menu items.   I do have to say that the hostess, Raquel, was very unpleasant (thus, 4 out of 5 stars). For her to be the first impression of the restaurant is horrible. We almost left. Maybe it's the Souther Hospitality in me that has the expectation of a hostess is supposed to be courteous and inviting, because Raquel was not! All in all, I loved our brunch thanks to Jonathan the amazing bartender and I highly recommend this restaurant to New Yorkers and tourists alike. Just don't pay Raquel any mind. :)

I was looking forward an authentic Chinese place. I have a bunch of friends from China (some from Szechuan Province) and all agree that this is the best and most authentic Chinese Restaurant in University or Center City. Definitely order one of the Szechuan style dishes, but beware that this place is extremely spicy even for people who eat are used to it. Also, the portions are big so a small plate is enough for almost anyone.
This place may be a little bit pricey. But the dishes effeminately worth the money

Glasserie is definitely worth the trek to north Greenpoint. I came here with a date last weekend and sat at the bar. The tall, blonde female bartender was so friendly and recommended an excellent glass of wine. I had the griddle bread (delicious) and the lamb in a red sauce. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, friendly and attentive staff. Great spot for a date or if you just want to treat yourself to a delicious middle eastern dinner.
What ever you get, just have them throw fried eggplant on it.

The food was amazing. I had fish,lasagna, rice, beans and chicken on a stick. My plate came out to 8.79 which is reasonably priced for the amount of food on my plate. I would like to come in on a different day to see what other options they have in the buffet.
I asked for Cosmo , and it came with bad lemon , not to forget that drink was bad. Our wings came sans ranch and blue cheese which was specially requested . All in all bad experience
We ate the special bottomless pasta dish. Nothing special.

Breakroom? A place which breaks your tastes which you get habitual off! Such an incredible place of unique postures and wonder-creating in sense of foods from diversified sorts of areas to which I have become fan of! Want to get a different taste? This would be my first and foremost choice to advice all yelpers here. Foof is so up to mark, economical and above all of them quality is provided on spot. Their Mexican tastes have made people fan of them but what made me their fan is their burgers. They make it so delicately that half of your lust for eating it increases so rapidly when you see it being prepared. This all and many more makes me die after this place!

This place is quite good. It is a very small restaurant ran by simply two employees who I believe to also be the owners. The wait time was not too bad considering there was only one cook making the sushi. The sushi itself was really good and filling and I definitely give it an A for presentation. Overall, great place and decent pricing.

To make matters worse. The manager of the restaurant who replied to my review and said that they were reaching out to me privately.. lied. They never reached out to me. Not surprised. Dishonest people make dishonest food.

This place used to be one of my favorite spots in NL.  Lately the service sucks, the drinks are watered down and the food is over salted.  Late time I went for their "Happy Hour" that was promoted on their website and when we got there the said " sorry we must have forgotten to take that down."  So we got one watered down drink and left.  I'm pretty much done giving this bar another chance.

Extremely overrated. The decor is fantastic, the feel of the restaurant is very nice. That's about it. The bar has a poor selection of drinks and is very overpriced. Chardonnay by the glass $19. How about Cabernet for $22 a glass. The bartenders aren't very personable and don't smile, even when we were the only 3 people at the bar. The menu is very unique, but the food was quite poor. We had a table of seven people and I don't think anybody liked their meal. The lamb wasn't very good, the kangaroo carpaccio was blah, the homemade pasta was the only decent item on the menu. Well the brussels sprouts were good. My colleagues and I eat at a lot of high-end restaurants and very unique places and it was just nothing special about this place other than the decor. The waitstaff was pretty terrible as well, we all ordered soup and not a single person received any. They seemed confused and it was just a bad experience. It was that bad, I felt I had to leave this review.

Had a great evening at Runner and Stone with 12 friends for my birthday - great service, very good food, (especially the grappa-cured bass and pastrami appetizers and chicken main), excellent bread and an amazing Pecan cake with brown sugar pastry cream made to order.   Highly recommended.
Walked in at closing. Rocky sent us home with the last slices from the night, for free! To cool!

After a terrible experience at the Blind Pig, my boyfriend and I went here for some dinner and drinks.  It wasn't a good idea... The margarita I got was so gross I couldn't finish it and that's saying a lot because I love my booze!  It was an early Sunday evening and the music was blasting so loud I couldn't even hear what my boyfriend was saying and he was only a few inches away.  I'll just assume he was complimenting me :) .  The food was mediocre junk food.  Don't think I'll be coming back.

Sorry Yelp reviewers... I don't know what all the fuss is about.  I actually went here based on the glowing reviews and was honestly a bit grossed out.  The soup I got had no flavor and I couldn't finish it.  The next day I never felt so bloated by the amount of salt I had consumed from it.  Pass on this one.

I was not planning on writing a review, but when i awoke this morning only wishing I had more mussels and a straw for the sauce, I felt compelled. I sat at the bar with 4 friends and ordered a good sampling of starter and main course items.  Everything was good! The apple salad was light and crisp with small pieces of pecan tossed in, the beet salad was served with  yogurt and was divine. I can't say enough about how good the mussels are. The sauce had lamb and a wonderful red sauce that we fought to get our bread in. The skate po 'boy was piping hot and delicious! With a remoulade and pickles, it was perfect. The bar was fun, the bartender made us a special Christmas margarita with chili liquor that was awesome.  Overall, a great night. We will be back.

This was my go to place awhile back, but things have changed for the worst. The customer service was better before. This condescending old woman took over the place and this spot is no longer enjoyable.

Look in the pictures section for my picture of the large caprese salad they gave me at the cost of $12.  5 tomato slices, 4 mozzarella slices and a single basil leaf.  Unacceptable.   I think that picture speaks for itself.

The food was OK. I could most likely re create these dishes in my own kitchen. I was hoping for something that would be special. Food was good, but the bartender was rude and a bit full of himself. I would have stayed for a second drink but he was up on his high horse and I didn't want to bother him. He looked a bit old and probably needed a nap.
Had the Ahi-Tuna burger, it was absolutely amazing and great for my diet.
One of my favorite restaurants in the area.  Love absolutely everything on menu and the servers and very sweet and helpful.

Being new to the area, I thought I would give Fare a shot.  Wow was I impressed!  Drinks were strong but not over powering and the Salmon Entree was one of the best I have ever had.  Service was on point and even the manager stopped by to make sure that everything was okay which meant a lot.  I will absolutely stop back again!

I'd yet to find a Greek place I loved in the city. Until someone recommended Pylos. I saw they took reservations so figured why not. And oh my, was I happy I gave it a shot. The food on the menu is exceptional.  We started off with several appetizers, including a platter of Greek yogurt, eggplant and roe with pita bread; veal-stuffed grape leaves, of which I did not partake, so I have to take my dining companions' words that they were good; and fried zucchini, which I enjoyed, although the portion was so enormous I couldn't finish it.  Dinner consisted of poached salmon for yours truly, leg of lamb for Friend 1, lamb chops for Friend 2, fish with lemon and capers for Friend 3, and some sort of seared steak and potatoes concoction for Friend 2's husband.  Words do not do justice to my wonderful salmon dish, which included rice with spinach, and was garnished with a sprig of dill.  I would definitely trek back to the East Village for this dish. I've only been here for brunch and lunch; I know I'm missing out on dinner. Next time.

Had an awful food experience today.. Started out promising.. The waitress was ok, but the menu was very decent and we were excited to get our food.  Well I would have rather stayed home I guess.  Everything expect for my French onion soup was so very Mediocre.  Hummus was the worst excuse for hummus I've had.  Tuna tacos overlooked (supposed to be seared not well done) and was very skimpy. My poor husband and his veggie burger.  My two year old did eat her hot dog without any complaint. Not worth the money and don't get excited for your food to come out

This place has a nice vibe, with what appeared to be a nice mix of locals (some with families) and tourists. The hostess greeted us with a smile and our server was very helpful. Our orders arrived promptly. That said, the food did not meet our expectations as it was rather bland (we each had corvina). Servings are quite large.
Love the Ear Inn, great local tavern, lots of history, diverse crowd, all friendly, good selection of beer and surprisingly good food, Mickey is fun, love Angela and Sunday night  band is awesome
Good food , good service. I recommend the rodizio. Open salad bar is also plus.
If you are really hungry, it is a fine choice. But I would save the calories. I didn't like any of the hot sauces either.

this place is great! a friend and I were looking for somewhere fast and good to eat before rushing to a show. we stumbled upon this place and had a great meal!! we were greeted by a young woman who passionately described the specials of the day, sat us quickly and even pointed out that meal my friend originally ordered wouldn't be good if we were in a hurry. the roasted chicken special was the juiciest, most flavorful chicken I have ever had. I wish we had more time to sit and relax through the meal...next time, for sure!

As someone who ate a lot of Cuban food in Miami for 12 years, I find that this place satisfies that craving for a solid cuban sandwich, vaca frita, flan, croquetas, and many other traditional Cuban dishes. The service was also very warm and inviting. Also, they serve a mean cup of cafecito. We noticed the side coffee window as we left - looking forward to coming back and sitting there when the weather gets warmer.

I ordered one cup of hot chocolate cost $5.08 but personally I am not really satisfied. A bit overpriced for its quality. The taste of chocolate is not strong enough, just like Ovomaltine... However, I like Ovomaltine even than this drink here.

I have been here only 2 different times. Once was out to dinner with my boyfriend and another was for a party.  As soon as you walk in the aroma of all their specials ,being cooked instantly takes over.  My boyfriend and I went on a weekend night, the place was packed!   The menu is outstanding.  The variety of specials offered to us for that evening were amazing.  There was such a variety to pick from.  The waitress was pleasant, but busy.  I have many younger years experience as a waitress so I knew her pain that night - but that night as definitely a good night for her as well!  Timing of food brought out was perfect.  My pasta special was amazing.   When I went back for a party I loved how the entire left dining room can be rented out for parties.  Again, a variety of choices were presented to us for each course.  That side room is nice and private and food was once again amazing!!! Highly recommend this place!

This was our 2nd experience at Geronimo's and first time trying the food and I need to start by saying that there "guacamole" is so fresh and tasty!! My cousin raves to me about there "frito pie" and aside from it being a bit pricey at $8 it was so delicious!Our drinks were above expectations and my boyfriend was truly impressed with the knowledgable and informative staff and there passion for tequila."Geronimo's"has a great atmosphere and ambiance about it and definently a great overall choice for a drink or meal!
Great food! Great service! Our waitress Kaitlin was outstanding, if she is representative if the rest of the wait staff I would return in a heartbeat. The carrot cake was outstanding!

Staff not excited to see you or serve you. Food is very below average, especially for price point and neighborhood. We had only been for brunch, which was fine and reasonably priced. A blackboard eats promo convinced us to try dinner. We wanted to like it. We really did. We live 4 blocks away and the decor is cozy and inviting. The food is amateur and very sub-par. First of all, appetizer of mussels took 35 minutes to make it to table. Mussels. And by the time they got there, they were hammered. Beyond overcooked. And totally gritty and uncleaned. Also - the mussels came with bread with what tasted like a store bought canned queso cheese spread on it. What?? Not to mention the whole point of bread with mussels is to have plain lovely bread to soak up the broth. Mixed pickles plate was pretty much inedible. Very overpowering vinegar. ( And I love vinegar). Nothing appealing or crunchy about it. Ribs came with black eyed peas salad which was largely tomatoes. In November. So - not good tomatoes. Chopped bits of pointless, out of season, flavorless tomatoes. It all tasted overwhelmingly again of vinegar. The baby back ribs described as "carolina style" were smothered in straight up mustard. The one place some vinegar would be appropriate, there was none. Also. At one point they pushed the empty 2 top table next to us right up against our table, which we didn't need. Then after turning away a 2 top who came in for a table, awkwardly pulled the table away from us in silence (realizing their mistake...I guess??) Oy. Sad to see staff that doesn't seem to care much about diner's experience. We'll stick with Emily, Marietta, Aita, Do or Dine, Locanda, and other neighborhood faves.
Good food, the Starters were excellent but the pad thi was to sweet and sticky. Nice place & delicious

If I'm in NYC this is a must go for me even if Italy is much closer to my home. A Italian Food Market in an old Skyscraper Lobby. Huge, fresh and tasty. You will find a smalltalk market and grocery here, try the tomatoes, fresh like bought on the farm in Italy... When hungry start with the starter sampler on the marketplace, good prociutto and cheese served with figs and honey with a great white wine to start. Then move on as your taste is, Fish, Meat or Pasta. For each you'll find a outlet. But reserve your table before taking your starter, otherwise you'll have to wait an hour... Dessert is served at the bar area, espresso is great but not the best in NYC. They have a Rooftop restaurant also but never tried it. All in all a great place to go! You can even take Italians here and they will go out with a big smile!!
Great food, reasonable prices, great serving staff. A bit crowded and busy but nice relaxed environment.

I'm a big fan of the food here. I come in at least a couple of times a month and I've been coming here religiously for about a year, but today, something happened that didn't sit well with me. A friend and I came in for coffee. I ordered a mocha and my friend ordered a cappuccino. We watched as the clerks argue about how to make the mocha, clearly not knowing how to make what was on the menu. To make things easier, I volunteered to have a cappuccino too, so they made me a cappuccino. After receiving the last drink, my friend tried to pay on his credit card for the $6 coffees. They said there was a $10 minimum. I offered to pay with debit and they continued to say $10 minimum. Neither of us had cash. As someone who comes in often, I've made purchases on a credit card for less than $10 before, so this whole situation was confusing to me. There is no sign anywhere that says there's a $10 card minimum and I wish they would have told us we'd have to pay cash for our coffees before we ordered. I'm a reasonable woman and to keep the peace I went next door to the ATM to take out cash, which I had to pay a $2 fee to do. In general, I'm upset because I'm a loyal customer and I've encouraged my friends to support this local business. Not knowing how to make the items on the menu was already an awkward experience for us to watch, but the card thing was just the icing on the cake. It was embarrassing for me to take my friend who I had just told about this "great little place down the street" for a less than pleasing experience. While I like the food, I'm tired of walking in this store to be told there's no bread for my panini, or getting a phone call an hour after I've made an order to be told the same thing. I like Ray, I enjoy talking to him when I come in, but I'm over the lackadaisical haphazard weekend staff. I think I'm going to check out some of the other local restaurants and its a darn shame, because the panini's are good... when there's bread to make one.
Every time I have had food from here, either location, it has made me sick. Low quality food and not fresh, I will never eat at or order from this place again.

I've been here a few times now and have had great meals each time.  I go here before I catch a movie with my wife. I was apprehensive about trying the brisket but did. It. was. so good!  The first time I came here service was a little slow, but that was close to their opening. Each time from then, it's gotten much better.  My wife enjoyed her meal, though I forget what burger she got, and her cocktail seemed to go down nicely, twice haha.  I'll be back soon!

Just tried my first shot at Mirchi and their Buffett and I must say it is PRETTY DAMN GOOD! It saves me a trip going to Edison aka Little India and has a lot of variety. Their biryani and chicken tikka masala was on point. Must go! Thanks for the recommendation on the payasam, the girl in the pink top who seemed like the manager.

I love that the owner is transforming our neighborhood.  And I really love his other place, The Castello Plan.  But Lea is a bit pretentious.  The decor and service are great. My only hope is that the chef would accommodate patrons.  I mean, a restaurant that doesn't have ketchup is just plain ridiculous.  A pizza that consists of ramps should have more than four small slices of them.  At this point, my boyfriend refuses to go back.  I hope that they can make these small changes, because it's a beautiful place to eat.  Now I just want to enjoy the food.

When we arrived, we were told to seat ourselves.  Someone approached our table and basically "handed" us our menus. When we received our food, the oysters were warm with the ice almost melted  and the fries were cold. One waitress on a Saturday night on South Street. We won't be coming back here.
My Favorite Sushi Place in all of connecticut!

Good music, cute waiters, but that's about it... My friend asked for a veggie burger. After a long 45 minute wait, we finally got our food, to surprisingly find out that his veggie burger wasn't only excessively burnt, but also the cheese was cold. So we asked the manager to fix it, to what he suggested to make a fresh one. We agreed... To then find out, that all they did was (literally) scrape off the burnt burger parts, and stick it in the microwave to melt the cheese. Are u kidding me??? WTF!?

Food is fantastic the service even better but when it comes to the management quite lacking. They refused to respect the wishes of the customers and think the corporate should control the volume knob and the thermostat. If you are a penguin and wish to have a nice fish dinner perhaps this is a place for you but if you like to have a nice quiet intimate meal with a significant other this is not the place to spend your hard earned cash. Perhaps next time Dan the manager will have the regional managers contact information so I can express my frustration with someone who will listen. Other bloggers are commenters on Yelp seem to think the bathrooms are adequate but apparently the female restroom was overflowing with trash, out of paper for drying your hands. Prices seem to be quite fair considering the quality of the food.  Always impressed with the fresh new creations expertly prepared. It's only the management that frustrates me.  Perhaps in the future I won't have to wear a parka while eating dinner. So in summary 1 star for excellent food. 1 star for great staff. No star for terrible volume.  No star for temperature control and no star for management so that leaves us with two out of five. Good luck.

Service was poor.  We were told that the bartender didn't show-up and the server had to do double duty as the bartender too.  Food was so-so...and that's a complement.  The other times that we went there, the service was also amateurish and indifferent at best.  Each time, we said never again!!!! Do yourself a favor and go to a real fish restaurant and save you money and don't go here.
One of the best Chinese sit down places I've been to in awhile. Ate there a few times. Good fried dumplings! Hot tea is nice, and the ribs are good, too.

Italian run, real Italian! The only thing they buy locally is the meat and fish everything else is imported from Italy and it shows.   Simple pizza made in a wood burning oven, great sauce and a staff in football garb , take me to Abruzzi - Caio baby!!!
We had dinner here, service was great and food was pretty good, mostly traditional Ukrainian, only then was a bit of a long wait.

Bella's is the best breakfast in CT by far. They always have a unique selection of brunch items and great coffee. To top it all off the waitstaff and hostess are kind, helpful, and engage in delightful conversation. The great food combined with the lively staff keeps my husband and I coming back here whenever we can.

The staff here was amazingly awesome!  my food came out hot and fast, I cant wait to eat it.  they don't deliver yet but they are working on it.  until then phone in your order and they will be sure to have it ready and right.  Go Wahoo!!!!

I'm bummed because I REALLY wanted to like this place. I love the ambiance, and I love Alsatian food. I ordered the grilled salmon, which according to the menu was a pistachio encrusted salmon with a honey mustard sauce over spinach. When it arrived, it didn't seem pistachio encrusted, and the little bit of sauce there was had no flavor. On top of that, the salmon was burnt on the bottom, which overwhelmed any of the other flavors, and it was overcooked. I guess I should have said something, and maybe I would have if anyone had asked, but I just chalked it up to a bad choice on my part. On top of that, I was very sick to my stomach later, which I didn't automatically attribute to the salmon. I had leftovers the next day (I don't like to waste food), and a few hours later became very ill once again. Maybe I just ordered the wrong dish on the wrong night, but with so many great restaurants in Carroll Gardens, I don't think I'll be giving La Cigogne a second shot.

Los Tacos is one of th places in Chelsea Market that almost always has a line. It's well worth the wait...and don't worry, the line moves quickly. Inexpensive, authentic Mexican food and drinks. You can get a meal for under $10.

This place is ok. I went and had the duck and it was delicious. But for the price they had on the menu it was such a small portion I was still hungry after I ate. It was just a let down because I love duck but it just wasn't filling and didn't do enough to satisfy my experience. Ok place, def not worth the hype. I'd rather go to Deltas in New Brunswick and pay those prices and end up with a more satisfying product. I dnt think I'll b trying duck here again anytime soon.
Great bar scene! Good small plates and the drinks are unique and interesting. Bartender Angelo is a great presence behind the bar!
We stopped here for a quick dinner on a sat night before a concert at North Star.  What a gem of a place!!!!! Amazing Thai and its a BYO.  Fabulous.  Well def be back!

Bringing a parrot head I was really looking forward to checking this place out. Tiki bars are my thing. I have one in my back yard. The Mai Tai is one of my favorite drinks but I couldn't even drink the "Mai Tai" I was served here. I don't even believe the bartenders know what a Mai Tai is. Not to mention it was way over priced for the size glass it was in. My wife had the Zombie punch which was also undrinkable and over priced. Atmosphere was equally as bad as the over priced terrible drinks. Will never go back. Better atmosphere and Mai Tai's at Bahama Breeze for half the price.
We came in with a group of 8 for drinks and had a great time! The bar tender was so accommodating and friendly! Drinks were great and would definitely come back again.

Went for impromptu Saturday dinner with my wife. We are both very experienced in Latin American cuisine,  often preparing some typical dishes at home.  The atmosphere  of this restaurant is not atypical of a similar place in a Latin American country. The service was a bit slow and when the food arrived it was below mediocre.  The supposed NY style fried calamari was mushy, no crispness at all. The other items we ordered were also much lower caliber than what we had expected, and although they seemed fresh,  the preparation needed significant improvement.  I hope they improve.

If you are in Philly, even if only for an hour or two, you MUST come here.  I've been coming here for years and I haven't had a single thing that I didn't love.   Favorites: Olympia Gyro gyro, Hershel's corned beef reuben, Termini Bros cannoli, everything Amish
Over rated. The lunch special have a small soup, it' s like boil the water then throw the stuff in. Ramen noodle taste better then that.

I must say if you want true Sicilian style food this is your place to go. Francesca is not only the owner but she personally prepares the food with help of the crew and her wonderful brother!!! . The specials are always phenomenal and her crostatas are delicious! The pizza is a winner too the crust it's really good. The classic like the rice balls and garlic knots are made like no other if you are in the area you should definitely give it a try.

Rude service. The white blond guy that sits people is a bit weird and not very professional. I ve been there several times and always gives me a difficult time. Even if there are empty places he makes me/us wait without a reason. Last time he told me there was 45 minutes waiting, however the couple behind me was told that the waiting time was only 20 minutes... But the Udon is great, so I keep going :)
Excellent food, atmosphere and service. Highly recommend the minestrone soup, the tuna and tomato panini and the bolognese. If you have space after, get the gelato!
great place for a burger or salad , or just great bar food drinks are great nice crowd a must

Was disappointed, the chicken was good, but the Mac and Cheese was nasty, sorry I can't sugar coat it. The cake was just ok to me and I thought the food was extremely over priced. Customer Service was excellent, but nothing makes up for when the Mac & Cheese isn't up to par. Wouldn't eat here again, I've definitely had better.

The food was great and flavorful. The staff was very friendly as well. The only thing I probably missed was having a good wine collection to go with the great food. Overall this was definitely a good restaurant that I would like to visit again when I am in Hamilton next time.
The Kale paella was amazing, but I think I built this place up in my head too much.  A very nice experience.

Came with the kids. Basic American-style food. Bar tender was serving the bar and dining room but was attentive and quick. Kids menu was well-rounded and they were happy (all you can ask for). Burger was one of the best I've ever had. Tender, loose, and a perfect medium. Fries were outstanding too.

The only place in Williamsburg I can recommend. The service is great. The food has never disappointed. The crowd is intercontinental. Everything is overpriced in this area but this is the only restaurant that I feel is worth every penny.

Amazing! Must get: corn, Cuban sandwich and grilled shrimp tacos! Jalapeño margarita is amazing too! Very strong! Omg Mexican grilled corn is so amazing!! I don't even like mayonnaise and now I want to recreate this food at home. I got the vegetarian tacos as my main, they were good, but the thought of grilled corn haunted me throughout the meal, even to this day... Cafe Habana is a fun, lively restaurant whose heavenly food more than justifies the long wait and cramped seating options.

Theres no doubt that this was the WORST quality food Ive ever consumed in my ENTIRE life. I recently ordered a standard small pizza and a small order of curly fries. After waiting 20 minutes past their given arrival time, i walked outside to meet the delivery guy who looked like a legit Somali pirate. He handed me a box that was smaller than my iPad, i was in shock. It was at that moment i knew i made a huge mistake. When i got inside i opened the box to see the most depressing pizza ive ever seen in my life. Usually a standard small pizza is around 12-14 inches, but this thing was a puny 7.5 at the most. A slice was no bigger than the palm of my hand and the quality was miles behind any microwaveable pizza youd find in the freezer section of a gas station. Not to mention, the little container of fries they gave me was only half full. If Gordon Ramsay ever walked into Gino's hed either commit a murder/suicide or have a stroke immediately. To call this pizza is like calling a bottle of bleach delicious. My italian relatives would be rolling in their graves if they knew i ate a pizza this bad. NEVER give these people your money and say a prayer that a tornado finds its way to this place asap.
Excellent soup and spaghettini with chicken.  even the cheeseburger is served with the class of french dining
Horrible hostess staff.  Super condescending and unhelpful. Very disappointing.  Must be a heavy weight on the business.

Went here with my friends on a fun day in philly. We chose it over Olive Garden, and it was a nice restaurant. I really liked the atmosphere of the restaurant, and granted, the service could have been better, but I ordered the margherita flatbread and the rest of my friends all ordered pasta. While the food took a little longer than I hoped it would to prepare, there was free bread and the waitress wasted no time in bringing out more free bread for us when she noticed we had eaten all of it. We all enjoyed our food. I have to admit that the food was a little bit pricey, but I would probably go back if I could. If you're looking for something a little less pricey, there happens to be an Olive Garden across the street from Fratelli's.
Always  leave happy and full!  This place has been here for years.  All the locals know if you want a good Italian meal to go here!

My family and I go here every so often. They keep it rather simple, which is smart if your seafood is fresh, which it always is here. Very casual, fun, with good staff. If you have a desire for seafood without any bs this place will satisfy.

The owner seemed rude and pushy. Could not be bothered by us. The food was not even that good but we were made to feel very unwelcome. It gave the sense that they were just trying to make money and didn't really care much about the food. There are much better places to get ramen in Chinatown.

My husband and I just discovered Zorba's last month.  Since then, we have been there twice.  The portions are large, the food is excellent, the service is great.  I highly recommend trying this place out.  Oh, and it is bring your own bottle, which I also highly suggest. :)
Pancakes: Great Huevos rancheros: Pretty good (but cold every time I order them!) Service: A bit slow given how crowded things get

I just got home from Blend, I couldn't wait  to write this review! We had a reservation for 7 and from the moment we stepped in even though it was jam packed from Happy Hour the staff somehow made us feel like we were the only people there! They were so attentive from the start! Lance the maitre d is EXCELLENT at his job and went ABOVE & BEYOND to make our night perfect!!! He made sure to ask if we were celebrating anything special or just there for a girls night. He walked us threw the menu and made suggestions and helped us decided what to order! We were a big party so we got a bunch of apps to share and they were all incredible!!! The way our food and drinks were brought out was all perfect in timing and presentation!!! To finish off a perfect night, we got the dessert sampler and damn was it worth the calories!!! We valeted the car, and the bouncer at the door made sure we waited inside so we weren't cold. All and all PERFECT! I will defiantly be back and I suggest this place especially for parties and special celebrations!!! Thank you to Blend on the Water and their amazing staff!!!

Please be aware that J & K is no longer in Monclair! They are under new management. The new place is called Heritage. After circling the block a few times looking for J & K, we called and they told us it was the same steakhouse restaurant but under new management.  Don't be fooled by this! It is not the same at all... It is an entirely different menu (Applebee's type menu).  If you are looking for a steakhouse, this is not the place to go.

If you like fresh, homemade food- this is your new favorite restaurant.  Great food! BOYB.  Beautiful space. They have just finished doing a soft open and the place is cranking! Worth the wait.   Give it a try.  You won't be disappointed.
What a great meal!  The food was fabulous and the service was fantastic!  And all at affordable prices!

was walking park slope with my girlfriend we were hungry and this amazing smell hit us and we took a chance and walked in and it was the best thing we did!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! im a Burger freak and i got my gf into them and omg best dam burger we had!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! for sure we going back and bringing other people with us.only complaint is its small

Cafe Triskell is simply my favorite restaurant in all of Queens, and probably all of NYC. This place has one of the best savory crepes I've tried.  The mushroom ham swiss crepe is amazing. The place doesn't look like much from the outside, and from the inside it looks like a cozy little place. Everything i have tried here has been fresh and delicious. There is a chef and a waitress, and EVERYTHING is made to order, so depending on your perspective, this could very well be an upside. This place is way better than most crepes places, I can't wait to go back for more!
Fantastic

I only ended up here because my wife HAD to have pancakes and the staff at the hotel where we were staying directed us to PJ's. Usually I read the reviews first, but my wife was adamant that it was were she needed to go to eat. Parking on the street is tough and metered. Then there was a long line out the front. Once we were seated inside the place seemed really cramped. The food was at best mediocre. and for some reason took forever to arrive at our table. (poor server) The pancakes had about the same taste and consistency of store brought box mix pancakes. I had the PJ's special omelette with the pancakes. The veggies that were in the omelette were not fresh, and tasted if taken from a can. My pancakes were barely warm, the butter barely tried to melt on it. My wife ordered the sampler pancake special. Her pancakes were barely were warm as well. She called the manager over to complain about the luke warm pancakes and poor server (took forever for our pancakes - which I suspect were left on the service bar under warming lights while our server did who knows what which is why they were only barely warm, we then had to have him get us utensils and napkins, and to get the rest or the order and sides which he delivered at a very leisurely pace 1 at a time) The manager did offer to replace her pancakes and it took another trip of the manager to replace mine also. By the way the manager seemed like he couldn't careless either. All up the quality of the food wasn't even the level of a Denny's and the service far worse. I will never go back again, and heartily recommend that no one else try that terrible place for way over priced pancakes. Oh, on the way out I found out was keeping our waiter for serving us - he was slumped over the entryway dais/desk area trying to chat up the female wait staff while probably nursing a hangover, at least I hope he was trying to nurse a hangover because no one could be that stupid and slow naturally. Last words - AVOID this place!

Excellent food with amazing, friendly service plus BYOB! We started with the pear salad with gorgonzola etc.-incredible, my wife had the salmon - super tender, soft and seasoned to perfection. I had the osso bucco which was also very good. Managers are always making sure everything is ok, but not too intrusive. I have waited tables and managed many Itialian restaurants over my years and this is up there with some of the best at this price point.

Nothing compares to freshly made hand pulled noodle soup on a cold NYC day! When you pass by this restaurant, you might not want to go in because it's small and looks dingy. But trust me, the rave reviews are true! I had the Beef brisket noodle soup and boiled dumplings and it truly satisfied my cravings! And, it was cheap! The noodle soup was only $6.00 and the dumplings were $3.00 for 11 pcs! I even bought their frozen dumplings to take home ($10.00/50 pcs!). This is one of the best hole in the wall cheap eats places I've been to!

Beer selection is good but low on Connecticut options. Wife's burger was over cooked and roll was Uncooked English muffin. Fries were mush. Bypass the food and be selective with your beer choice.  Whoa - watch out for your bill. We got 2 beers and were charged $20! There are 2 columns for beer prices - they don't ask you when you order they just bring the larger size! I won't ever go back here!
Food is delicious.  Service is HORRIBLE.   Seriously, some of the worst wait staff ever.

We tried to come without a reservation but the Marshall barely let me in.    I was waiting for my husband, willing to sit at the small bar.   She told me that all seats were first come first served without a reservation including the bar and that I couldn't save a seat at the bar even though I willing to eat there.    The food did look good and the rest of the staff did seem nicer.    But the snootiness at the door is making it hard for us to come back.

We've been 5 times now and have had a better experience and meal each time. Awesome, unique cocktails set the stage for a great dinner. The mussels appetizer and cheese plate are perfect starters.Pasta Amatriciana, pappardelle Finnochio, pizza patate, carbonara have all been incredible. The Farmhouse Group does not mess around, they are great at what they do and Pascolo is another feather in their cap.

The spaghetti alla carbonara is ok. I advise all to avoid the Maccheroncini; it is very salty. You can probably manage to eat your way through if your waiter keeps you well supplied with water, but otherwise it is near unbearable. The service is great at least when I was there with family. Great atmosphere and great wine list for the location. The wine list offered half bottles in addition to whole bottles. It was nice to have that option so we could have wine with dinner but not be tied down to a full bottle.

This place is wonderful. They have the best friend rice I've ever had in my life. They call it pollo chaufa. The empanadas are wire good as well.   The best part however is the daily who owns this restaurant. Wonderful people who care about their customers and are happy to share the story of their food.

Dost thou understand the true meaning of beauty? I wake up hungover on a Sunday morning, stomach aching to be filled with fluffy, savory, sweet goodness. Where else besides the Skinny Pancake will fill my stomach's desires? We drive by the location to scope out the line, which is 10+ people out the door. We look at each other in the car, eyes dancing from person to person, in hopes that somebody will just scream "FUCK IT. LET'S DO THIS." Which is exactly what happened. Every time the door opened waiting in line the smell of Nutella, home-made burgers, Bloody Mary's and fresh coffee took over my nose like a Dementor takes over your soul. We're getting close. I gaze longingly at the patrons eating and drinking in the window, hoping, wishing, that in less than 30 minutes, I, too, will be as jovial as they. Once inside, one gets to experience the true meaning of choice in life. Do I want a crepe? Sweet, or savory? Shit, the biscuits and gravy look so good. OH SNAP WHAT ABOUT THAT NUTELLA? Wait, do I really want that right now, though? The pulled pork thing and honey BBQ would do me good right now. But I DID come here for the black bean and guacamole thing. It's just -- the fresh grass-fed burger with sweet potato fries? And homemade hash browns with scallions? Life is about hard decisions. But nothing worth it in life is easy. Once your decision has been made, take a seat. Listen to some live blue-grass music, and then thank yourself for making an awesome decision to wait in line at the Skinny Pancake because you will never regret it. Side note: I will not stereotype this place, as anybody in their right mind will enjoy this Vermont gem.

Great pie made with love from the founder himself! Delicious ingredients and a firm crunchy crust makes this place live up to its "best in the state" reputation. Don't let the wait time or price scare you away because this pizza does not disappoint!

My friends and I finally had time to hang out so I suggested Lombardi's because the last time I went it was amazing. This time, not so much. We decided to order a small marguerite pizza, but the waitress (the blonde one in case you see her) kept telling us to get a large. It's fine if you suggest it once, but stop hounding us about it. We brought in outside food (cheesecake) because it was our friends birthday and she told us "don't mean to be a party pooper but you're not allowed to have outside food." That's fine, I understand, but there was absolutely no need for you to have such a rude tone and expression on your face. Thats not the worse part. She gave us the check when we still had food on the table. I'm pretty sure that's the rudest thing that a waitress has ever done to my friends and I. She was basically telling us to leave. We really did not want to give tip but we didn't want to be as rude as she was being so we did. The food was amazing and the man serving the water was incredibly nice, but that waitress needs to go. She ruined the whole experience for my little group, and I'm pretty sure it was because we weren't of European background. NYC has a very diverse background and if you didn't like that you shouldn't have decided to be a waitress.

It was a very bad experience. The food was good, but the customer service was horrible. The waiter was soooooo rude. I have never expericed any disrespectful service like this. I won't try this restaurant any more. sooooooooo bad.
The food is delicious and inventive.  The service is warm and friendly.  The selection is extensive and interesting.  The restaurant is medium-sized and comfortable.  Can't wait to go back!
A hidden gem! Will def come back again soon. Sweet uni, soft hotate, giant peony shrimp, wet-aged sirloin, and flavorful torched salmon.

It was my birthday and my friends and I decided to come here for dinner. It is unfortunate that the staff is so busy fighting with each other that the service suffered and it ruined our experience here. We couldn't even talk to each other because they just kept on arguing. Very unprofessional.
