We ordered sparkling water and since the staff was so distracted  that they refilled our half full sparkling water with tap water, ruining it. Then we waited forever for the waiter to finish fighting with what seemed like the front of house manager; he neglected our table until our meal was complete. Last but not least no birthday song dessert or anything. He completely forgot because he was so distracted. It ruined our night out. With the huge selection of Italian restaurants in Manhattan, we will not be going back again.
Yummm. Dumplings. Quick inexpensive and delicious. Tips: order by number, cash only, order take out (max seating 5: 3 indoors and 2 out on the sidewalk)
Good food, friendly waiter. Pricey drinks. Would go back.
I have been going to Park Lane pizza for about 23 years and have always loved it the staff is friendly and the pizza is delicious

This is a converted brownstone and thus had a variety of seating options. Our party of four was ushered to an intimate table, away from the noise of larger rooms. But to get there, we literally had to walk THROUGH the kitchen. And it was a small kitchen! But once seated, we were sublime. The tapas were small plates of food, from their signature brussel sprouts, to meatballs, to fish roe, to other less common fare. The food was truly delicious. The server helped us what to order and how much. The recommendations were perfect.

Very good food. Inexpensive. I've always ordered take out and it seems there are always trays and trays of food being served to diners as I wait for my brown paper bag. It's clear that they cater to their sit down diners first. This is fine but does get frustrating while you're waiting, especially since there really is no place to wait

I did an experiment whereas I ordered a small pizza from Grimaldi's and one from Juliana's, the original maker of Grimaldi's pizza. Keep in mind I had no narrative bias, I really wanted to see which was the better pizza. And the difference was striking. Grimaldi's tasted like supermarket pizza and made me yearn for real NY pizza. I was laying blame on the style of the pizza. Then I went to Juliana's. Interestingly, small pizza with identical "look".But that's where the similarities ended. I was blown away by Juliana's Pizza. Every part of the pizza offered a complimenting flavor. The crust was toasty yet malleable whereas Grimaldi's was doughy and powdery. What's the point of the oven if that's how you serve it? Juliana's cheese was scrumptious and alive with flavors whereas Grimaldis tasted like mozzarella alone. The sauce at Gromaldi's was watered down, at Juliana's it had a rich flavor. Even the basil leaf on the Juliana pizza offered an interesting unique flavor while the Grimaldi's leaf might as well been an ornament. It tasted like  over cooked lettuce.I found a respect for the style of Pizza at Juliana's.

Came here just for the cocktails and loved the experience. I didn't get to try any of the food, but the drinks were just to die for! This is a great bar to just relax, chat with friends and have some delicious drinks. Will come here again for sure!
Always a good choice....except for when the lines are long.

Service was incredibly slow, disorganized and not knowledgeable. Took forty five minutes for our order - the fried tomato salad (tomatoes weren't properly tried, the arugula was doused in dressing so heavy it looked like soup) and the French toast burger, which was bland, lacking seasoning and punch. Never got water, server was all over the place. Unfortunately we won't be coming back :(

Weak food at high prices.  The atmosphere is very nice - well lit, spacious and friendly.  Cocktails are $13, tiny, and not particularly good (the mezcal "amigo" was especially bad, and tasted the way most dollar stores smell... like off-gassing plastics).  Grilled bread and Syrian cheese appetizer were both ok, but the entrees were gross, and presented as a jumbled mess.  The squid entree was rubbery and dull, tossed around a dark pile of salty mush.  The carrot kataif pastry is like a deep fried carrot log, placed in a pool of terribly salty yogurt with some herbs thrown on top.  This is not authentic middle eastern or mediterranean, nor is it ambitious fusion/new american/fancypants.  This is a dopey palace of gentrification.  I gather their brunch is ok, but I find that hard to believe, and won't be back to find out.
Not bad

In the heart of the theater district, Carmine's serves Italian in HUGE family style portions, My wife & I got chicken parmigiana ($36) and took half of it home, so go with at least three or preferably four people. Everything is a la carte, including pasta and salad (which were immense). Quality was good, not great and the place is very loud so, it's a great location for a romantic dinners or even conversation, but it is an experience and close to most Broadway theaters.
I highly recommend this place, and I don't even care for Italian food!  It was fantastic!
the food is fantastic. they didnt get 5 stars becuase the service was ok the three times i was there.

Now known as Hong Kong Palace. New owners, new chef. Major disappointment. We just ordered a few simple items: spring rolls that were tiny and tasteless, like a mass-produced frozen product. The teriyaki beef was overcooked and flavorless. The mu shu chicken lacked seasoning. The lo mein was mushy and tasteless. Overall: horrible. And overpriced for such low quality. I've never thrown out Chinese leftovers before. I just did. Avoid. Like. Plague.

My boyfriend made a reservation 30 days in advance (Take Root policy) through Amex concierge service. Somehow our information was taken down incorrectly. Apparently, not only do you have to make a reservation 30 days prior and give your complete credit card information in case of no show, you also have to confirm your seat via phone AND email the week of the event. Because they had our phone number down wrong and couldn't get a hold of us, we showed up to eat and were denied seats. The couple who run the restaurant offered no apology for the mishap and when we expressed our disappointment and told them it was my boyfriend's birthday, they could only shrug their shoulders. We were the first guests to arrive 20 minutes early for the dinner. There are a million different ways the owners could have made a bad situation into a comical, happy one. Offer an apology, give a free glass of wine, guarantee a dinner another evening - they need a lesson in customer service. I don't care how amazing the food is - the attitude and atmosphere carry more weight. They are in the business for the wrong reasons if they don't care about the happiness of customers. My boyfriend has an uncommon name. One google search could have led the owners to the correct phone number or email address - we live in a modern world! We've never tried the food, but we already hate the place and will never return. We decided to go to French Louie instead! We told the host about our bad experience with Take Root and they gave us free champaign! Exemplary customer service. Go to French Louie! Good food AND good people.
There was tons of food to be served 15 min after close. Staff wouldn't give me anything, as I heard them shouting "throw it all out." So disappointed.
BYOB sushi happy hour! What more could you ask for. Bottle of wine and a few rolls of fresh sushi. Quick, easy, inexpensive and delicious.
by far the best food off ferry street!  service is excellent .  best sangria around!
absolutely loved the braised pork belly. authentic ambiance, knowledgable staff, very enjoyable and delicious. enjoyed it. stop reading this and get yourself in there.

Food was amazing ! Presentation was fabulous and service was lovely. Ryan took his time helping us with the menu and had great drink recommendations ! I had a mimosa and my husband had one of their signature cocktails. We shared a bottle of wine that our waiter recommended . As a restaurant owner, I am happy to say that the food was executed nicely and staff is attractive , energetic, and professional. Nice job empire diner and thank you Ryan for a great experience !

Empire State Building ... check. Brooklyn Bridge ... check. Soup Spot ... check. Manhattan first-timers should add this wonderfully convenient deli to their list of must-visit landmarks. Just south of Madison Square Garden, it's a perfect place to grab a picnic lunch and head for the High Line (another must-see landmark).

Ok Soo.. I just ordered a Brocolli pizza from city view today and I must say I enjoyed it until I started to taste something other than Brocolli , I've found 2 BIG GREEN PEPPERS in the middle of my food.. One is in the garbage (the one I spit out) & the other is still in the pizza  did I mention I hate green peppers ? #badexperience  I've had better days with city view..

Nom! nom nom nom nom nom nom nom nom nom nom nom... I can go on an on.... mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm SOooo good. I got their pork belly buns and I do NOT think I've ever had better. SOOOO GOOOOOD. Wow. A little pricey but SOOOO worth it. Better than sex! sometimes!

They couldn't make any of the specialty drinks listed on their menu. We ordered 3 drinks and they only gave us 2. The waiters were hounding the pour, lone employee that was actualy making the drinks.(The Internet cafe is attached to this World Bean) More employees standing around watching orders instead of making drinks. They need to have more staff to make the drinks and fill inventory. The morning rush really affected this place.

I'm capped at 3 stars because it's an Argentinian restaurant and the steaks are simply, bad. It doesn't matter that it's cooked med rare when the quality of the beef basically less then par with the local food store, and under salted. The aged bone in strip was very tough and had no "anejo" flavor...the skirt steak was beyond chewy and cut with the grain..oops However.. On a very positive note the empanadas, pulpo, carrots, and even the tomato salad were very good among some other dishes. Although the server was a bit green, she was super friendly, helpful, and a pleasure to have hosting us. Definitely worth going, for small plates..buyer beware of the steak until they figure out a decent meat purveyor.
It was delicious! I had forgotten just how good Indian food can be. You can tell the food and sauces are fresh & it makes such a difference. Thanks for the yummy reminder.

Since reopening the food has gone up in price and. Quite frankly my fish was unedible almost. Slathered in heavy lemonny tasting garlic butter sauce that was overbearing. This was the bronzini filet, but i tasted the sea bass and it was similar. They will never see me again and there prices are no longer a bargain
love it here. food, price, environment are all fantastic!!!

really like this place much needed on PPW- great food and good wine.. BUT the bartender ( the female  one) is the most sullen bartender i have ever encountered..also- me and my friend had 4 rounds of drinks and not one buy back... seriously?

My husband and I swear by this place! We go all the time for the chicken, ribs and picadinho. The owner is a very friendly portuguese woman and the waitresses are very nice. Definitely the best place to eat in the area!
Just like 5 guys but found the burgers were not as greasy and the fries were just as good! Great atmosphere! Will visit again and try the shakes next time based on reading other reviews.
great food, great atmosphere, great service, great wine!!! a little pricey for me
Omg the cinnamon apple infused rum - you can stop drinking anything else. Nothing will compare to this magical wonderment.

this food b good. i luv eating brunch here. they share eggs and i like that. bloody marys are spicay haaaaaaay. kelly makes the good good drinks. def get: -eggs -veggie wings -celery -alcohol def dont do: -watch love guru with mike meyers after eating at cedar point -drink your roommates flat sunkiss soda with whiskey in it from yesterdaze

Greeting- yes, friendly and make you feel valued Vibe- Vegas baby Vegas Parking- garage next door $30. Check for deals before you park Service- slow Price- expensive Bathroom- Pass. Very good Wine List- Expensive. Not overwhelming in a good way. Best buy Guenoc Petite Sirah $39 Food Chop Chop salad disappointing in lack luster amounts of cheese and meat Filet Mignon on the bone was excellent Stuffed baked potato was very good but much smaller than one would expect. Excellent crisp skin Other sides are ordinary steakhouse sides Dessert Key lime tort is awful. Gooey artificial tasting filling Baled Alaska is a classic dessert WIGB? No. Too many exciting dinning options in Philly to go to this typical steak house which was formally Roy's.
Great atmosphere.  Food was good.  Wait staff attentive.  I recommend it.

The service was great and the waiter was very helpful. The atmosphere is very pleasant but very noisy. Food was very good; ambice felt very trending tables small and too close to each other. Service was fast and attentive. The experience was different from I usually dine but I will be back.
The best pasta/Italian in upper east side since I have moved here.  The gnocchi with white truffle sauce reigned supreme. Can not wait to visit one more time.

Food is o.k.  This place is LOUD and always busy.  Waiters randomly bring out drums and start singing every 15 minutes or so... again, like I said, VERY NOISY.  Not a lot of breathing room.  However, I give them a lot of credit for being able to work in that environment.  Hosteses will always tell you "15 minutes" but 15 minutes usually means 40 mins to an hour.

My husband and I love this place.  We eat in and do take-out and the experience is always fantastic.  The food, ambiance, and service are all impeccable.  The vegetable pad thai is my favorite dish, and it's the best I've had!  Highly recommended.

Being a Newark native, this is not the overall best Portuguese restaurant in Newark, but the rodizio is good. The biggest complaint about the restaurant are the servers. They're not as friendly as you'd like them to be. If you can overlook snotty looks for some decent steak then this place is good for you.
Very nice meal. Good service. Interesting items on the menu. Nice portions. Ambience is very nice with good sound system and lighting. Definitely will be back!

Very rude waiters, very unaccommodating.. they sat us next to the bathroom even when there were seats available, we (kindly) asked to move if possible, were rudely told "no." Usually people give an explanation, but he only gave one after I stood there awkwardly for a while- I stood there counting in my head to just to see how long it would take him to give one, and I got to 8 until he finally mentioned, "its closed".

tried this place for 2 weeks straight. gave them all the chances. food is slightly above mediocre, at best, I don't know what they flavor it with service sucks, delivery is ALWAYS "gone wrong" don't buy into the no MSG bullshit, that's not possible if they're serving artificial crab meat and canned corn and other crap!

Terrible service, waited 20min to be seated with 2 young children when there was clearly many tables available, never offered a childrens menu, left due to aggravation, the hostess was of absolutely no help
Eight of us went after church.   There was a line to get in., but is see why!!  Food was delicious and plentiful.   Would recommend highly!   Great value.

Omg this place rocks... I came here for my birthday for the first time it was amazing the hospitality I received.  The food is one of a kind. I had the roast pig head, sweetbreads, uni and pork blood custard a brownie with toffee onions. OMG I love this place. I met and took a pic with top chef Ian,   the food was soo good I returned on Saturday after my birthday and enjoyed monkfish cheeks, octopus, and grilled grapes with ricotta. . AMAZING!!!!

One of the best places to have octopus because it's cooked (grilled or sautéed) to perfection. The veal chop can be hit or miss but over all this BYOB usually serves up a decent experience. For guaranteed Top Notch Service, ask for Arleen, she's been with them for ages and is truly excellent.  -H.W.

I ordered the chicken liver and foie gras mousse as a meal. AMAZING and exceeded my expectations. You can ask for as much bread as you'd like. We ordered the escargot for an appetizer, which was quite flavorful and cooked to perfection in the garlic butter. I also tried the moules frites and duck confit salad. These entrees were amazing as well, something I would get for myself. Expect quality over quantity here. An A+ in my book.

Happened to have their cheesesteak at the Old City Festival, and it was seriously the best cheesesteak I'd ever had (I don't like them overly greasy or drowning in cheese). It didn't hurt that the Conshohocken Bakery roll was also the best sandwich roll I've ever tasted. So we made a point of going to National Mechanics next time we were in the neighborhood. Really hoped to re-experience that cheesesteak, but unfortunately they don't have it on their weekend brunch menu (me, I'm not from a place where there's brunch on Saturday, so I was surprised). No complaints, though. We had a veggie burger and a delicious tuna melt, all quite tasty. Nice atmosphere, busy and lively but not jammed. Also, LOVE the excessive copper plumbing in the bathrooms -- just a fun touch. It'll definitely be our go-to in that part of town.

READ THIS 4 stars, 225 reviews! Not bad! Ordered shrimp Pad Thai. - Way too over sweetened. Too much sugar. I don't know if there's any other flavor hiding. - Shrimp is really dry. Pre-boiled in advance. Then stirred with the noodles and served. Wtf? P.S. Traveled to Thailand twice. Had street, restaurant and home cooked Thai food. I write reviews only when someone truly exceeded expectations or royally and knowingly fucked up and didn't try to make up for it. What set me off was this: Me: Excuse me, why is this so sweet? Server: It's supposed to be. Me: Oh really? Which region is this from? Server: North East. Me: I never had Pad Thai that sweet. Anywhere Server: (left the floor). I put a lot of chili, squeezed lime and added some vinegary spicy stuff. Still crap. Ate some of it, almost half. Asked for the check. Told the server that I didn't like the food. Server: have you been to Thailand? Me: Yes, twice. Server: how long? Me: 2 weeks and 3 weeks. Is this food for farang farang? (means foreigner in Thai) Sever: Oh, our chef was experimenting with new recipe. ....??? WHAT A FUCKING LIE... She just told me it's supposed to taste like that. Servers discussed it and sent another girl to present the bill (cheap move). Service 0 stars Pad Thai 0 stars Price: $13 Bon Appetite
excellent burgers good service

We love Ola, it is our "go to" restaurant.  We've been here about 5-6 times and have never had a bad meal.  Very unassuming from the outside.  Once you enter you really feel like you are somewhere else. I love the atmosphere.  My husband usually gets the black paella and I love the bahia (shrimp dish) or one of the steaks.  I can't go there without having a coconut mojito (with real sugar cane!!).  The last time we went there was some type of college class which took up both sides of the bar and it got noisy since we were right next to them.  The portions seemed slightly smaller but we will be back again and again!

The best Pizza I ever had. It's now the fifth time I have been there and every time the quality of the food remains on the same high level. Meanwhile I don't need to see the menu ;-) I found out that asking for the menu seems to be very funny for everybody in the restaurant. That's how they know that you have never been there before. The mushroom and the garlic pizza is really great. I love them. Check it out :-)

Visited them yesterday for the first time for take out. Ordered the steak and shrimp, and fettucine and shrimp. Both were quite good. A very unexpected bonus was that I ordered a separate order of french fries, and I must tell you, they were virtually indistinguishable from McDonald's fries, and we all know that McDonald's has the best fries on planet Earth, regardless of what you might think of them or fast food in general. So, that really surprised me. The also have Coca-Cola in the tall neck green glass bottles. Bottled in Mexico, its much better than the Coke you find in stores because its made with cane sugar. Coke bottled in the US is made with corn syrup. You can taste the difference. They have a lot of shrimp dishes and the menu is extensive. Its a small, out-of-the-way place, but definitely worth a visit.
Brothers Pizza has the freshest ingredients of any "pizza place" I've ever been in. Their vegetable pizza us my favorite. Their menu is much more than pizza and I've never been disappointed.

Enjoyed the food.  It was very busy but We had great service.  Make sure u go with a group or you will have lots of food left over!  The only complaint was it was very loud but overall a good experience.

I'll probably give this place another try, but am so frustrated after our experience today that it will be tough. I called twice on Saturday night trying to find out about making a booking for Sunday brunch. Nobody answered either time. Fair enough... It's probably crazy busy. So I called Sunday morning and was told to call back in an hour when the woman who did the bookings was in. Ok... That's fine too. Called back about an hour later and was told, "We don't do bookings today, but you can try to walk in." Ok... Fine. I thought this was strange because I read all the reviews about getting a booking. Whatever. I just moved around the corner and I want to try it out. So we show up and ask for a table and the woman I spoke with seemed like she was trying to discourage me from putting my name down. She said the wait would be an hour or even an hour and a half and had a bit of an attitude. Fine. My friend was coming from Brooklyn and we live in the neighborhood. Again... No big deal. I understand how long this process can take. So we wait and wait and then my friend shows up and happens to walk into the restaurant looking for us. The same woman asks her if she has a booking or not. When I find out about this I'm not absolutely annoyed. Well, we tried 4 times to make a booking and since you don't do bookings on Sunday's then how can we have a booking? We get tired of waiting and happen to walk by again on our way somewhere else to see its not very busy at all and we still have not been texted for our table. After about two hours we finally got that text. I get it. You're busy. You're popular. That's what made me want to eat there. I'm a patient man who worked in the service industry for years. I am ok with a long wait. What I'm not ok with is the terrible communication and poor attitudes. Do you allow for bookings on Sunday or not? I'd recommend going for an online booking system to take this job out of the hands of the people who didn't do so great with it today. Since I'm new to the area I'll probably give this place another go and I'll review again. Hopefully I'll have a better story to tell.

This place is the best! I only have certain suggestions every once in a while. Today's: the Steak Salad- should really be served chopped and with the steak cut into bite size pieces. Otherwise- perfection!
Bleu sushi is the best sushi in Philadelphia! The incredible food combined with the welcoming atmosphere and outstanding owner makes for an awesome experience. Highly highly recommend!
Pizzas were ok, dessert very good but overall it is not worth the price you pay. However the place is really nice and service was good. So, if you like don't care of the price I would recommend

The place is infested with roaches and the owners lack proper etiquette when it comes to treating their customers. The food normally was delicious but The Waiting Room and Butch Kowals is a lot better for your money. Don't spend a penny here unless you want roach eggs with your maduros ;-)

Really big disappointment. I'm sick so I wanted to just order a soup and get it delivered. In order to get it delivered you have to order through yelp for a $5.99 service fee plus a mandatory 15-25% gratuity. Ridiculous but when you're sick and desperate for soup ($2) you'll do it. I asked the others in my household if they wanted to add to my order since it was a delivery charge 3 times the price of my soup. I felt like it would at least make it worth it. Nope. Wrong. Called over an hour later, food still wasn't picked up by "third party." Arrived an hour and a half later (4 blocks away) WITHOUT SOUP!! My roommates keep spitting cartilage out from their general chicken and the three cup chicken is full of bones and looks like pigs feet. So the food that did come wasn't even worth waiting for. As for my soup, I called the restaurant to ask them to send the soup and they said they were closing. Called the number given on the email to try to get money back and they said because it was ordered from yelp and not directly delivery.com they couldn't do anything. DO NOT ORDER FROM YELP. NO SOUP FOR YOU YELP, NO SOUP FOR YOU!!!!!!!!! Now I'm sick and hungry and trolling on yelp. Thanks to everyone who made this possible, including myself for being stupid, sick and lazy enough to not make .89 ramen soup which would have been a better idea than ordering delivery from Empress Garden through yelp. Going to go throw money out of a window.

Great tasty food ( I ordered the steak salad, so good) and friendly staff - just a little bit busy and noisy during weekends. I celebrated my bday, so they came with a piece of delicious cake with a candle in it, that's sweet and really good service.
Excellent food, reasonable prices and friendly service and atmosphere. The chef-owner knows it's job.Try the specials , the chiken torta, and the tiramisú.

I called at 6:30 p.m. on Saturday evening requesting a table for four at 7:30.  Last minute, yes, but our babysitter decided she could make it in and my wife and I needed the night out.  After thinking for a few minutes, the hostes, Cayla (sp?) informed me that they were "fully committed" and apologized.  Fair enough, atleast she tried and did not just shut us down immediately...  15 minutes later, we get a call back-- she worked something out for us... AMAZING!  Restaurant was packed - she really did her homework.  Dinner was great!  Drinks were great!  Thanks Pig And Prince and the wonderfull hostes with the mostest up front!  We will be back!

Over-rated.  Not worthy of an appearance on Philly's Best lists. Small portions, pretentious. Honestly, sliced cucumbers with artisan salt doesn't thrill me. 3 pierogies pretending to be ravioli on a plate do not an entree make. Very disappointing.

The food here is good - but not worth waiting almost an hour for. Came here with a group of 5. After about 30 minutes we started feeling a little squirmy. Then we noticed the group next to us who had over 10 in their party and came almost 20 min after us were already getting their entrees. The couple next to us, who also arrived after us, paid and left. Meanwhile, while we're looking for our waitress, she's having a drink with another table, so that's cool. We're just chilling here starving our asses off. She was apologetic about our food being so late, but it was more of a "sorry you had to wait 5 min for your food". Not a "sorry you were here almost an hour and a half before we served you" kind of apology. To try and placate us, the host offered to buy us a round of shots. But, most of the other tables around us were also getting free drinks. We asked to speak to a manager, and I'm pretty sure a waiter from another section came and pretended to be the manager. After getting some bullshit about how this place is new, tonight was busy, we were offered to have some items comped off of our bill, which didn't happen. After some more debate with the manager, we were offered 10% off our ticket, which we took because at this point we just wanted to leave the restaurant. They swiped our credit card and had it back to us in less than 5 minutes though. All in all, an extremely dissatisfying experience. You couldn't pay me to come back here.
If you're into Thai food and you're in Burlington, this restaurant has an awesome menu and food to match.
Excellent, Fresh made to order burgers and fries all of the items are made to order. Reasonable prices, plenty of parking.

Love it. A real taste of Philly. Termini Bros for Italian pastry, Basset's chocolate Ice cream, those gross Philly cheese steaks, deli, wine, New Orleans food, Miller's pretzels, Amish baked goods, fresh produce, etc. A must for any foodie who visits Philly. It's an indoor food flea market. The Marriott is right next door as a landmark
Awesome

Very bland and unhealthy food. Got a severe bacterial infection after eating buffet . Please check all the hidden reviews before making a decision to dine here . They all convey my experience with this place - " at your own risk". Not going back ever again .

Do not eat here... Shitty food and unhygienic. I got sick. Actually four of us went there for lunch buffet,  two of us got sick. If you are really tempted by the many positive reviews here, go check the place yourselves, check the gaudy ambience, sloppy management and smell the food before you eat. They only prepare food for once or twice in a week, and serve refrigerated, microwaved food. Dear greedy management, wait till health inspection knocks on your door anytime soon. Shame on you.

I have been to the University City location from time to time, so I was extremely excited when I had heard that one was going to be in center city. I came with some friends on a Saturday night to try out the place. We arrived to find the place with a good crowd. The main bar was full, but luckily we had some friends who had reserved the second bar. We looked over the beer list and it is set up the same way as the other location. I wasn't in the mood for beer, so I opted for a cocktail instead. Then we ordered some food. The menu has some of the same items as the other location, but the are several really great additions.  I highly recommend the pickled beet parfait! Next I ordered the honey goat cheese flatbread. I mean goat cheese, honey and pistachios, so good. As for the vibe of the restaurant, it definitely was a change from the Public House. They added several TVs, including what seems to be several TVs behind the main bar that are set up to look like one tv. The had multiple games showing so this will clearly be a great spot to watch football. The crowd ranged from late 20s to early 40s and even with how full it was, you were never getting pushed or shoved around. Overall I would say a great improvement!

We ordered two appetizers. I am a vegetarian so my husband ordered a lobster roll and I ordered spring rolls. After 25 minutes his lobster roll came out and that was it, When I asked about the spring roll the waitress told me spring rolls take a long time. At least 25-35 minutes. I told her I was confused since its just a spring roll and we have already been waiting 25 minutes and the lobster roll came out. I asked her if my appetizer would be here before my meal and she said No. So we got up to leave and told the owner ..it was clear that she never put the order in and tried t blame the restaurant..after all was was done she also tried to charge us for our meal when we told her we were leaving . To add insult to injury they never checked us in with open table so I received a no show email. Stay away !
They brought us zeppolis with our pizza for free! So nice of them! Yummy pizza, will def be ordering again :)

Was hoping for a better experience.  Typical bar food that can be found all over burg.  Plus the ubiquitous mac and cheese.  Please.  Stop with the mac and cheese.  My chix po' boy was less than hoped for, with a 'fried' machine processed breast.  Not even close to the hoped for so. fried chicken which is what a po' boy is about.  Br. sprouts were tasty if only because they were drenched in maple syrup.  Beer menu enticed me but I question the temperature and the two choices were flat.  The whole experience just went downhill with the two hipsters at the bar smooching/draped all over each other.  Get a room.

Hole in the wall to dumpling empire.  That's how good they are.   Was way more fun elbowing fellow patrons and waving your lunch money at the counter woman hoping she might favor you with dumplings fresh out of the wok and not the ones that had been sitting around getting rubbery.
I had an amazing experience here last night on Saturday.  I booked a VIP table here and the service was epic.  They look completely remodeled with great music!
Blown away! It feels like you are in a Parisian restaurant. The service and food absolutely outstanding. My wife ordered the salmon and I had a delicious burger. We can't wait to go back.

Are here for the first time yesterday and was sooooo PLEASED!!! delicious food, great service, and DELICIOUS food!!! We ordered the pancakes which are the best pancakes I've ever had, the eggs Benedict which were PERFECT and one of their specials for the day. Each dish was mouth watering and I'm already dreaming of having their pancakes again.

I've been back three times since my original review. The crust was much better in my subsequent visits, and the ingredients are always top notch. I recently took my French relatives there for dinner, and they couldn't stop talking about how it was some of the best pizza they have ever had.
Love this place! Great service and food. We came here two nights in a row for dinner on a 3 night vacation!
One of the best dive bars I've ever been too. Good food and good service, never a dull moment at this bar!
Amazing staff,  friendly owners, brunch is delicious,  and the mystery beer and shot are really fun.
So awesome came here and ate in had wonderful time served as soon as sat down come and see the food was not bad at all and not even burned amazing looking forward to coming again

The best fried chicken tenders I have ever had! My family also ordered the herbed potatoes, 10  jerk sauce wings, a health salad, and the cilantro rice. The jerk sauce is out of this world! Tangy, slight bit of heat, sweet and even a tad creamy! My wife noted how fresh the health salad was, I took a bite and it was well dressed. I recommend the jerk sauce, you will not regret it, best sauce I have had in a long time. The potato seasoning was awesome, savory, with a bit of black pepper, perfect! The tenders however were the best! They were crispy, moist, and big! You really get you money's worth at this place, everything tastes fresh and well thought out. Forget Five Guy's, Check this place out!
I only like the Thai fried rice, it's really good for 2 people. The other food are okay, I've had better. Some items are a bit pricey for the portion. This place is okay.
This is one of my absolute favorite places to go for lunch the people are friendly and the food is delicious. Also I love the fact that it has the old fashioned glass coke bottles.
Great place for brunch although their hours are strange.  Never leave here feeling overs-stuffed.  Everything is always fresh!  Servers are great and really know their stuff!

DO NOT TRUST THE GOOD REVIEWS - Horrible They deserve ZERO star Placed an order for 4 ppl at 7pm over the phone but I only got my food at 9pm after I called about 5 times. I ordered several dishes with chicken, veal and shrimp. All of them were flavorless. Food was cold Pasta was dry Bread was ok ( coz they probably didnt make it) My ONE special request (no sausage in one of the dishes) was just ignored Of course I called to complain and the manager's answer was "We never delivered cold food" no apology, nothing. DONT'T BE LIKE ME...DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY !

Blend on the water definitely deserves a 5 star every time I come here I am never disappointed !! As I come in to the hostess stand to the bar and dinning room the staff at blend are very welcoming and attentive . I've had the salmon that company's it with cilantro mash potatoes to die for and to the skirt steak (churrasco) to the Mac and cheese with chorizo I recommend them all . We can't get enough with blends reasonable prices happy hour from 11am to 7pm ! Must try the frozen sangrita Shout out to the bartenders for there amazing drinks !
Awesome food awesome service management is on point food is something that's need to be tried
Just so so in terms of a lot of high quality Japanese restaurant in NYC. Not worth of waiting.

Exemplary-  everything you look for in a restaurant is here. We had a reservation and were sat right away. Service was quick and our waiter was very knowledgable. The food was to die for. This looks like a regular spot for me.

Very pleasant dinner for our first time at this rustic spanish eatery. Our party of 4 had 8pm tix to a Saturday night show at NJPAC. Not looking to be rushed we made a 6pm reservation at Spanish Pavilion because it was recommended by a friend for having good food and being less than a mile from the show. And all turned out to be true. We had the pick of our table when we arrived at ten to six, but the place quickly filled up by 7pm. We started with martinis and then shared a bottle of Tempranillo for dinner. Appetizers were the queso manchego frito (excellent!), clams with herbs in butter sauce (a special, not on the reg menu was delicious & great dipping sauce with bread), pork kabobs (juicy & tasty), artichoke dish (in a lemon white wine sauce, also very good) and crab stuffed mushrooms (they were decent but too much stuffing made them not as flavorful). For dinner we ordered two entrées to share which included a house salad for all - house dressing was a sweet & spicy catalina style -- very tasty. Our entrées were the skirt steak cooked rare (very delicious!) and the paella for two (but it easily could feed four. also very delicious, and plenty to take home for lunch the next day). Our service was very attentive, clearing and resetting plates with new utensils and constant refilling of our water glasses. The food was not fast, but we do not like to be rushed so there was always something to eat and drink which was perfect. We told our waiter we were going to a show and he remembered to bring the bill with plenty of time to depart. This allowed us to use the restroom which was also very clean. We did not have time for coffee & dessert but truthfully we were all so full we wouldn't have been able to eat it anyway. Upon leaving, the manager Jerry asked us how everything was. We said great! And got to talking and he wound up letting us leave one car of our cars in his parking lot for the 90 mins we were at the show. Such a bonus to a great evening! Thanks to Jerry and all the staff at Spanish Pavilion, we will tell our friends and definitely be back again real soon!  -H.W.

One word - WOW! Definitely worth the wait. Sat bar side with friends. Our server/bartender Victoria was the best. Her suggestion on the devil egg appetIzer and her skillful hands in crafting drinks made the whole meal that much better. Cannot describe how delicious the Mac and Cheese and full bird was - try it and see. Completely over the top!

This is my new favorite place!!! Last night it was my 4th or 5th time there and it keeps getting better.  A very diverse small, sexy and cozy hideout right in the village... The drinks are amazing and A+ for creativity. The food is fresh, tasty and delicious. The ambiance is FUN with different music from 80's, 90's and nice current artist. You can write your own confession on the walls of this place or read someone else's, anyway you are bound to stomp on few funny one that make the place warm and fun. The most important part though, is the People that work there. They make sure to Welcome you and assist you as soon as possible. Erika, the owner is a delight of a person and makes this place a unique one with her vision. My friends and I were impressed by how low key they are and how they ensure you are having a great time, even if is closing time, Oops! (just once!)   This place is perfect to go for drinks, or dinner, alone, as a couple, or in a group. I can't wait to try the winter menu, they told me they have some nice surprises. Can't wait to go there again and continue trying their sexy and funny drinks. My favorite so far is the Love affair and Devil's Advocate ;)
Drinks better than food most of the time.  Strange location!

The food may be great but I can't say much about it as I didn't get a chance to try it. Their website gives a specific closing time. We arrived 15 mins prior and they wouldn't serve us even though we knew exactly what we wanted. Very misleading...

Great Food and ambiance ! The angry orchard wings are the best ! I always sit at the bar which has been totally remodeled and has a nice vibe! One of the partners/owners always comes out to ask about the meal and drinks ! Great service from management !

A horrific circus act.  My table orders an elegant bottle of wine and they only pour 4 out of 6 of us then take the bottle away.  When I ask where the others wine was they apologized and brought it back.  Next I order an autumn salad, and they bring an odd looking fried dish out.  I question them and they confirm it's my dish and that it just happens to be fried vegetables.  Two minutes later they run back telling me they gave me calamari, mind you I'm terrified of eating any fish.  My experience was ruined as I sat there in nausea.  There was also 5 different waiters serving our table and no one could keep track of anything.  Save yourself the trouble of going here, there are plenty of other amazing Italian restaurants in the area.

Xiao long bao is decent but worst service I've ever had. First we had to ask for an extra bowl three times. Then they forgot to put in something we ordered and never apologized for anything. Also everything is overpriced and quantities are small. Make the trek to Chinatown or midtown for Xlb if you want.
It's been a week in NYC and twice in Cowgirl Seahorse.. I guess this says everything! Totally my favorite place in NYC! The food is absolutely amazing and the service is fantastic!
Incredible service, ambience, and food. And it's BYOB. This place will not disappoint you.
You will not find a better storefront type sushi place anywhere. Quality, selection, service, are all outstanding. We will be ordering regularly from here. Great find.
Accueil chaleureux, cocktails parfaits, et créatifs, service rapide dîner delicieux , gourmand et original, savoureux. Hautement recommandable
Incredible Pad Thai and ribs!!! Great place with cosy look and friendly staff. No reservations allowed but usually the line moves fast. Don't forget to drink a Singha!

True class.  Patience required and rewarded. BEWARE: Yelp and others including the restaurant's website (which is not maintained by the DeMarcos) have the wrong operating hours posted.  __Doors are locked and last order is at 8PM__.

This is coming from a true NY'er who knows pizza....this pizza is NOT good at all!  I've been to Lombardi's dozens of times in the past and considered it to be the upper echelon if true NY pizza, along with Grimaldi's and Joe's on Bleeker St.  I am truly DISAPPOINTED, because they have gone downhill. The crust has no flavor, dry, very close to cardboard.  The cheese was sliced thinner than a strand of hair and had no flavor.  The pepperoni was almost non-existent.  I feel terrible to say this but bottom line, the place is now CHEAP and uses INFERIOR ingredients. Please please please go to Joe's or Grimaldi's for true NY pizza!

This is by far my favorite ramen place!  I usually get their spicy ramen.  The broth is amazing..  A bit oily, but not overwhelmingly so :). A place you must go to when you are in NY. :) There are 3 locations now.  I've only ever been to this one.

Amazing, everything thing about it is amazing. It is true NY, noisy, crowded, funky, and fun, simply wonderful. The wait staff is always great and the food to die for! My favorite is the horseradish salmon, and the lobster bisque.

I've dined here twice for sushi and have gotten takeout a few times. It is a very welcome addition to the sushi scene in this neighborhood. I highly recommend the specialty rolls - particularly the Osaka roll and the sweet heart roll. They also have a great deal if you order 3 rolls. It's slightly more expensive  than Tsuki's or Vik's 3-roll sushi specials, but the rolls at chattime have more to them and are more filling. Highly recommend!

I LOVE PROSPERITY DUMPLING. So cheap, so delicious. I can get a full meal and still have leftovers for less than $5. There's not much room inside the shop to eat -- maybe enough room for 6-8 people to sit, so be prepared to take your food to go with you. It seems that no matter what time of day I go, there's always a line going out the door of people ordering food. Recently, I've started getting the bag of frozen dumplings and pork buns to go and bring back home with me. The only complaint I have (and why I took off 1 star) is that it seems they don't mark which are the cabbage dumplings and which ones have chives, and I've come home with the wrong dumplings. They're delicious either way though! But sometimes I don't want to have my breath reeking of chives for hours after I eat.
The wait may be long but well worth it ! All you can eat hot pot and KBBQ. Bang for your buck definitely !

I felt misled that this was the number one taco spot in NJ. Flavors were none to bland on all 5 tacos we had, for the exception of the chorizo y papas. Platanos were flavorless and the "Pico" served with them was maybe a tablespoon total. Which leads me to the salsa problem here. Who in their right mind only needs about a literal tablespoon of salsa for a bucket of chips? Stop. The "hot" sauce was a joke. Don't call it mexican if it's not, guys. Be a high class south west place. (Pinapple in tacos fyi) Last but least, I have a really high tolerance for different foods and the guacamole made me gag, for the first time ever at dinner. The sea urchin as well as the fish taco I had tasted rancid. So rancid. Tldr; not good, bad seafood, bland tacos. Waitress will treat you like a special needs person (THESE ARE TACOS. PLATOS ARE ENTREES YOU GET IT?)  Go elsewhere. Churros were good, but not traditional. Nice ambiance?  As my nana would say.

Just threw my husband's surprise 30th at Pier 76 last week. To say that everything was perfect is an understatement! A week later I am still getting phone calls and texts about how good the food is. Guests even begged to take home doggy bags! Between buffalo chicken rolls, Pizzas (Mac and cheese was a fan favorite), pasta, salad, chicken franc, sausage and peppers and zeppoles, the food seemed endless and no one went home hungry!! The staff was excellent, attentive and friendly. Both the bartender and the waitresses made sure everyone was happy and enjoying themselves. The owner Joe made sure everything ran smoothly! I couldn't have been more happy with the outcome of the party. I would definitively recommend going to pier for your next celebration. Whether it be for dinner or for a party, Pier 76 is the place to go for great food and great drinks.

Not only is the food GREAT but their entire organization is a class act! This venue helped The Sons and Daughters of Erin raise over $1000 dollars to support Eden Autism Services... This is one of the best places you can go on Staten Island!!!

Good overpriced brunch selection with erratic and disappointing service. Be prepared to wait a long time for your food to arrive and keep your fingers crossed that they get it right. The staff is friendly but unprofessional in that they get the order wrong and out of sequence most times.

I'm giving them 4 stars because normally every meal I have ordered comes out very good.  They would have gotten 5 stars from me, but they lost a star due to I'm presuming them rushing my order. I ordered a deluxe cheesesteak.  Most of it was good except for the cheese.  The cheese was not melted, in thick chunks and was not mixed with the meat at all.  Basically, there was the meat and thick solidified cheese sitting on top.  I had to throw the cheesesteak into the toaster oven to melt the cheese,

Found this place on accident!  I couldn't help but walk in after passing the intimate little spot with brick walls and dim lights. The service was impeccable.  After every few sips of wine, the waiter was always sure my glass was full.  I had the special of the night which was the Carbonara. What a delightful evening.  I will be back!

This place was so quiet..  Not a lot of people in the restaurant at all.  It took away from the energy..  But the food was great.  The well fleet oysters were great,  the calamari was full of flavor..  The scallops and pasta was filling and tasty and the surf n turf was out of this world.  It was romantic and enjoyable over all.

This was the most disgusting experience I have ever experienced. The chicken was under cooked, blood was on the plate, not sure it was human or not. Please look at the photo. Massaman curry beef was thin grey and putrid. Duck was over cooked, a child could cook it better. Service was awful, and that is to say the least. Just awful. I would NOT recommend this place.

While in Philly visiting I went out in search of coffee and breakfast. Fortunately I found Cafe Twelve in a sea of Starbucks popping up on Yelp. I'm all about supporting the indie coffee shops. Cappuccino was creamy good. So so much better than some chains automatic robot machine cranking out "espresso".  For breakfast I had a bagel sandwich which did the trick.   This was Sunday so it was nice that it was quiet and I could take over a small table and chill. Must be nice in the Spring with the big glass doors swung open. If there was anything I'd knock them for... Not a gripe but more of a suggestion to the shop... Would be nice to have some other breakfast options like oatmeal, yogurt, fruit salad.  Beyond that, love this place. Oh, the barista and the cashier were super nice. You don't see that every day at an indie coffee shop.

Bad attitude of the cashier !! It was our first time in the establishment so my wife really didn't know how to order for instance what kind of cheese or toppings . And the cashier was rushing her and mocking her and told her she doesn't speak English. She got really she wanted to speak to the manager but I told her it's ok because we're not from around the area we will not go back there next stop Geno's

The ramen bar has delicious ramen! I usually get the Tonkotsu Ramen or the  Spicy Miso Ramen. Very Flavorful!! The drinks are good as well as the desert. The ambience is good and it's a very well designed restaurant They also have an ATM there if you don't want to use cash.

My husband and I had dinner at Bloomfield Steakhouse tonight.....I have been to this restaurant many times to eat and have always came out more than pleased.....I have sent friends here and family. Always raving about it......tonight the phrase.....ALL GOOD THINGS COME TO AN END....came to mind.   We started out with calamari for an appetizer. ...Although the fish itself tasted very fresh the breading was bland and tasteless.   I ordered a rib eye with brocoli. ...The meat was overcooked although I ordered it medium.  The broccoli was cooked to the point of mush.   We had checked on Yelp to see if it was open and when we did we saw a Yelp Deal was available....so we purchased it.  Our server who was terrible. ...I asked for more water and he just filled my glass leaving my husband's empty without asking if he wanted any....He ignored us for most of the meal....anyway...He looked at us like we were diseased when we presented the Yelp Discount. He called over a girl who then questioned us about it so loudly people looked at us. It was very unprofessional and embarrassing.   I gave 2 stars for decor and there was plenty of parking.....but I will not be returning to the place. ...clearly they hired cheap help and it shows in every aspect.   Don't waste your money.  Go to NYC and visit Benjamins instead. I will NOT BE RETURNING OR RECOMMENDING this place again.

Went for breakfast at around 11. Took 40 minutes for food to arrive. Staff was very friendly and coffee was refilled right away. As arriving our table smelled like bleach. A lot of cleaning is needed here. The kitchen was out in the open and visible. The cook didn't wear gloves and was using the cash register as well. money is pretty dirty and shouldn't be handled when cooking. Not a good thing. Overall the food was your typical diner breakfast. I did to enjoy the fresh bread that came with my omelette.  Home fries was good as well.
The plates are huge and the food is really good. We order pasta and it was al dente. Ir was Great!

Since its opening my family visited this restaurant 3 times. The food is great, the service is OK, but the environment is horrible. In all the times we have to yell to be heard.  Why?  Because the cracked up the volume on the TVs. We can't even hear ourselves when we talk. No wonder they messed up our order more than once because the servers can't even hear us talk. I complained to the host to lower the volume.  She said she could try but didn't believe they can do it. She called in about my complain.  Nothing changed. I hear ringing in my ears after each visit. I am very sure that i won't go back to this restaurant until the management change this. I don't want my kids to lose their hearing by eating here.

My husband and I had lunch at Derby on Sat nov 8 . He ordered Salmon croquettes and while eating said they tasted strange. He only ate one of the two. Within 15 minutes of leaving he had severe vomiting  that lastEd for 24 hours. I would like management to be aware of this
First we weren't served and when we were it was all burnt so went to ALLWOOD DINER allwood Is family friendly and gives take out

Came here during the first weekend it was open and I had a mysterious 20 dollar up charge on my bank account. I tipped the waiter 17 dollars in cash then they took an additional 20 out. I spoke to the manager and she granted me a 30 dollar credit which I never used. The food is good and I like the look of the place. The meat is tasty with the added sauces or alone, as well as the seafood. The wings are very good too. Our waiters were good the few times we came here and the tipping situation never came about again which is good. Will continue to come here!

Cozy atmosphere, great food, awesomely friendly staff. Went on a Sunday night and it was a about half full, nice and relaxing after a day surrounded by tons of people. Have the chocolate tart for desert!

Well I'm not sure where to start.  This was quite a strange dinning experience.  My daughter is a student at St Mikes and we try to eat at different places on every trip.  I have gone to El Gato on church st a couple of times and on this particular trip we were staying at the Fairfield in Williston.  Being that we had brunch on Church street we wanted to have a close dinner and my daughter was craving Mexican.  We researched Yelp and the closer Mexican place had not such favorably reviews.  We decided to drive by and there were no customers inside so we chose differently.  I called  El Gato in Essex to see what time they were open to at 730 and they said about 9 tonight.  We arrived before 8 and all of the chairs were up on the tables in the front 2 rooms and they looked somewhat closed.  We almost went to the tap house next door but ventured in anyway.  We waited about 6 or 7 minutes and no one came out of the kitchen.  There were 2 table filled, eating, and definitely open.  I walked almost into the kitchen to see if they were still serving and we were a hungry table of 5.  Mitch pleasantly welcomed us and seated us on a big high top next to a dirty rolling floor cleaning bucket! Were they in the middle of cleaning up and left it there?  not sure.  Mitch was the only waiter and very thorough.  He recommended amazing margaritas that were not crazy priced with house infused tequila and were everything he promised.  Guacamole was amazing, queso was spicy and great,  our food was really good and explained well by Mitch.  It was great that it wasn't as crowded as their original establishment and food and service was good BUT it was hard to get around the chairs up on the tables an hour before closing and the dirty bucket of water.  On our drive back to the hotel my younger daughter said the woman, maybe the manager, seemed mad when we arrived like she wanted to close and a big party of 6 came in after us.  I'm not sure if theyreally want to grow this business or close.  Food was great,  service was good, but not sure of the total experience.

I have been coming here for years and the food is always wonderful, service is excellent, and the atmosphere is good too. The food is always readily available and they will ask you if you want to try something on the menu that hasn't been brought out to you yet. Servers pull your chairs and treat you like royalty! Even when it's full there is never a long wait if you didn't have the chance to make reservations.

Went there for the first time last week for brunch everything was fine, food was good, service was good also. just went there this morning for brunch thinking we'd be fine but they turned us down because of a "party" coming in. Last week i over heard them asking people if they had reservations as if they were some fancy restaurant. Place is a decent size to separate "parties" so others can come and eat also. sorry but i wont be returning.

I've dined at State a number of times since opening, both at the bar and in the dining room. The food is fantastic, drinks are dangerously delicious, and the staff is great! I took a number of clients (visiting from around the globe) for lunch last week during Adtech, a huge hit for business meetings as well. Specifically, the international folks loved the classy presentation of nostalgic American favorites (burger, tater tots, salmon). Well done!

I came for the wonderfully intimate coffee ceremony, but could only watch from the bar rather than an open table right next to it (mind you the place was not even remotely full) because I had eaten beforehand and purchased only drinks and appetizers for my girlfriend and I. Ironic that such a friendly ceremony be spoiled by a waiter who thinks I didn't spend enough to witness it from a decent distance. I ended up taking my table, ordering a meal to get the rude waiter off my back, and enjoyed my bunna :) Coffee was amazing, service and food was lacklustre. I won't be returning.
Amazing wings. I could eat them all day long!! Cute little spot and not intimidating. Causal local spot that is great for a beer and wings.

Really enjoyed my visit here. Great service that was attentive and friendly. Had hot chocolate, which was very tasty. Loved the cozy setting as well. Places like this allow me to skip chains without worrying about missing out on quality or taste.

Went here yesterday for lunch. The food is great and the waiters are constantly ready to serve you. The atmosphere is beyond beautiful!! It has an Indian-Thai feel to it.  And the waiters are dressed in Thailand apperal :)
The pizza was very good and the price was fair so If your looking for a quick bite to eat on the run its a great place to pick up a slice!
The best everything. Breakfast, lunch and dinner will blow your mind. Everyone I recommend it to has fallen in love.

Came here because we were in the neighborhood and had a hankering for some Thai. Ambience is nice. Place has a modern look. Dimly lit but relaxed. Definitely one of those places that try to wow with decor but drop the ball with the food. Appetizer: Thai Spare wribs- small, drrryyy. Meh. Main: I ordered the Pad Thai. Boyfriend got the Gai Kratiam. The Pad Thai was average/below average. With the Gai Kratiam, I pointed out how white one of the pieces of cabbage looked. Upon further inspection, it was rolled up wax paper. Waiter was sorry not sorry. It was deducted from bill and we promised not to go back.
Delicious food! Ordered take out a few times and it's never disappointing! Love the fried chicken dinner.
the food is great with excellent sized portions..... i would definitely put my name behind it.... keep up the great work

The food here is beyond amazing! Definitely one of my favorite restaurants in CT! Everything is made fresh and served by great people! The collard greens are my favorite, along with their famous "Obama Punch." If you haven't tried it yet, you have no idea what you're missing!

Had dinner with family and asked for t bone steak well done. Got my steak medium at best. Waited for waiter who never passed by table again the whole time the rest of the family was eating. He comes over at the end asks us if we are ready. It was obvious the steak wasn't touched but he just asks if we can cook it some more. Everyone already ate so I felt that would take too long. We get the bill and not even an adjustment for the food returned. The steak must have been frozen when they threw it on the grill. It burned on the outside and was raw and chewy on the inside. I didn't mind paying the bill in full but as a business owner, to me one upset customer Makes me think more than 50 happy customers. They could have easily removed the steak and I might have considered returning again and giving a second chance. I hope their lack of customer service and disregard for customer satisfaction takes them far, but from experience it does not. I do not recommend this place unless u want disappointment.
Their beef cutlet is amazing......

I make a point to come here every time I'm in New York at least once. The quality of the noodles alone is enough to make a trip out to Doyers street to get here, but that is merely one facet of why I am so incredibly enamored with Tasty Hand Pulled Noodles. The prices are super cheap, and the quantity of food you get (whether it be dumplings or soup) is always rather large. Not only that, but the service is incredibly quick, you get unlimited amounts of hot Jasmine tea, and the atmosphere is cramped but incredibly homey. I always leave feeling full and happy with my experience, which is all I can ever ask for honestly. This restaurant is everything to me... I can't express my love for it properly.
Excellent atmosphere for casual dining or special occasions. Try the steamed vegetable appetizer after enjoying the house punch.

Had some what high expectations of this place and am disappointed. Coming from a person who likes trying various beers, the beer here actually isn't that good. I had the burley Irish ale and seemed flat. Tried a sample of the Vermont smoked potter and that wasn't really good ethier. Not to many beer selections!! As for food, had their speciality meatloaf, ehhhh its mediocre! Place has a weird smell too. Not impressed don't fall for the tourist trap!

We have been here in the past and have had dinner when we have been either going  or on our way home from NYC.  Tonight we were looking to get a loaf of Italian bread and we were told that they had them and sell their bread.  So we ordered the bread and the young girl rang it up.  When she went to the back we could hear the guy in the back say they would not sell it to us so she came back out to let us know that they did not have any bread.  We ended up leaving but there were a number of loaves that we could see on the baking pans.  Don't think we will go back again as there are other places on the street that we would prefer to give our business to the future and the restaurant was also dead at that time.
A great atmosphere!  Great food!  Spicy Feta dip and grape leavers were fantastic!  A bit of a tight squeeze, but totally worth it to go and grab dinner!
Great wings and Mac and cheese, service was good draft list didn't seem to impress me but they had bells two hearted bottled so I was happy nice cool laid back environment
The brunch is of course, perfect. But, two points, 1, long time waiting. We have waited for 55 minutes. 2. No credit card, cash only. There's ATM across street
Nice Italian restaurant with good bread. I had the ravioli which was good-pretty good but surprisingly enjoyed the anti pasti the most. Go figure
Typical diner food but a nice little find. Would go back the staff and other customers were extremely nice. Home fries were very good. Very inexpensive!
Probably the best bar pie I've ever had.  Great atmosphere.  Waitress was a little inattentive.

Went Friday night to hear a great Band, and was pleasantly surprised by Towne Tavern ! it was very busy , packed , had a great vibe, good lighting , and delicious food ! People were dancing to the band which is great !  It is casual, but the food was more upscale than i expected , the waitress was super nice and attentive and fast ! The Bar tender was nice and fast too. The Seabass special was so good, and came with salad and bread. Only draw back is it's in a strip mall - but hey , that's Jersey ! We will go back for sure ! Oh , and forgot to mention - the shrimp quesadillas were amazing , cooked perfectly and better than most Mexican places !

Waited for 60 minutes on Sunday for brunch with a friend but BOY was it worth it! Ordered the lentil and spicy sausage soup which was the best soup I have had in years and the lox and bagel platter which was served perfectly...every element was separate (I don't eat the bagel) so I could combine each bite perfectly. The capers were huge and juicy, the cream cheese fluffy, and the salmon was silky and gorgeous. Best food I've had in Philly yet!

Great, Great food. Found this place looking for ceviche. Got so much more than that. Some of the most delicious ceviche. Also, had the lamb tacos and steak tacos. The tostadas are great as well. I've both eaten in and ordered take out. Only one problem the few times I've been here and that was missing a couple of sauces once when I ordered takeout. After mentioning it once, the nice woman at the counter doubled up on them the next time and  it never happened again so no big deal. I will def continue to eat here for many years to come.
Hands down the best pizza in town. GRANDMA PIZZA IS SO GOOD. Their food is always fresh and delivery is fast.
Decent selection of beers.

This is not the first time I visit this place. They are all good experiences. The Singkapo Laksa is very good. The broth is light and creamy, and there was a lot of meat in it(pork belly and shrimp). I also ordered a cocktail. I'm not sure about the name. Maybe Obao Sunray. It is so good. the service is very good as well. The staffs are nice and friendly. I will definitely come back again.

This is not the first time I visit this place. all good experiences. This time I tried Sambal spiced calamari and Pho Bo. The Pho($11) came with stewed beef, beef brisket and round eye. it was so good!. The caramari. lightly battered caramari with a decent amount of sauce on it. soooo good! I also ordered coctail. Fig-a-tini. fig infused vodga

Great place.  The duck confit was cooked to perfection abd the lobster and black truffle risotto was sooooooo amazing.  The place was packed but the service was still spot on.  Our server was super cool and helpful!  We will be back

We used to love Hot Tomato's years ago, long before its reincarnation at Union Place. We decided to try it again with a couple of friends. Unfortunately, this is not the Hot Tomato's of old. If you park across the street in the $10 lot, Hot Tomato's will comp you the garlic bread. Or should I say the artery clogging cheese bread. The garlic bread used to be a delicate combination of Italian cheeses. Now you can barely taste the garlic there is so much cheese. We had the wedge salad and a Boston salad special. All in all, the salad portions were large (definitely sharable) and we had no complaints. However, the entrees are a different story. My wife had the Shrimp Malta. You know those little bottles of capers? I swear her dish had an entire bottle of them. The noodles were al dente, but the dish was so salty from the capers to be almost inedible. I went with the Brooklyn Ragu. While the menu description sounded interesting, the result is basically spaghetti and meatballs. There was no creamy ricotta cheese topping and the sauce was watery. Certainly nothing at all like Grandma's gravy. Yuck. Two drinks, a salad, two entrees, 2 coffees, tip and tax set me back $81. This was NOT WORTH THE PRICE. I will not be returning to Hot Tomato's.

I'm a sucker for a good Italian BYOB and Modo Mio did not disappoint. The $35 Four course tasting menu is perfect, solid food at a good price. The bread and oil served in the beginning also came with a mild ricotta cheese which was a nice touch! My choices were as follows: 1. Antipasti, Scallop over zucchini cake (really really good, but small, wish it had more then one scallop) 2. Pasta, Gnocchi ( my fav of the night, delicious light gnocchi in a tomato sauce with panchetta throughout, good portion size too) 3. Secondi, Melanzana Eggplant (my one mistake of the night, I love eggplant but this layered eggplant dish was dry and not so flavorful. It didn't seem fresh) 4. Dessert, Apple pecan cake (tasty and a nice ending to our meal). We did have to wait about 30 minutes after our reservation time, but cracking open a bottle of red in the waiting area by the front door wasn't so bad, they brought us glasses. I'll go back again minus the eggplant!

Good things really can come in small packages. I first came across this cute little bistro looking place a couple of months back.  As a long time Windsor Terrace resident, I'm always excited to try the cool new restaurants and shops that have been sprouting up in our neighborhood over the past couple of years. It was late on a Sunday evening, and I was walking towards Prospect Park West trying to decide what to eat, when I first saw Brooklyn Proper open.  With a couple of tables already full, I took a seat at the bar and inquired as to whether dinner was still being served.  Luckily for me, it was, and a little tasting menu to boot.  I don't recall everything I ate that night, but I do remember the main dish had a side of corn that was smoked and salted, giving it almost a bacon flavor -- outstanding, I still think about that corn. That corn alone was enough to bring me back to try more new dishes several time over the past few months.  However, a tart little wine based cocktail called the Proper Sour, has also definitely contributed to bringing me back to the bar.   During the week I'm usually working late in the city or traveling for work, and even when at home, frankly I can't really cook worth a damn, so constantly eating restaurant food.  Walking up the street for a well prepared meal, chock full of fresh vegetables and proteins, full of innovative flavors and served with a friendly smile comes pretty close to home cooking for me. Consistently playing good tunes definitely helps too..
The worst hamburger I have ever eaten in my life. Beer is Nine Dollars in a warm glass.
Super fun place! Love the idea of a pizza place and night club all in one. Definitely makes those late night munchies convenient. Liked the overall vibe would definitely go back

I really wanted to like this place more than I actually did. Will give it a while to iron out the kinks and then try again. The most critical component should be the burger. And it was good but not great. Patty was thicker than Five Guys but not as large as Farmhouse, prob around 6 oz. All our parties' were slightly overdone, with zero red in it despite ordering medium doneness. Meat was moist but not especially tasty. Toppings were good, brioche bun was good but my wife's was cold to the touch. Prices were between $11-17 depending on toppings. Other Cons: - Slow service: we arrived at 11:45am with the place basically empty, but still waited about 20min for our food. - Uneven service: one burger was supposed to be plain, but had cheese on it; one dish of fries was cold Pros: - Good fries. We had a variety of orders, all were a good balance of crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Be forewarned the truffle fries have spicy chili flakes. - Good draft beer list - Facility was sleek, open and clean - Staff was friendly It's right next to the movie theater, so I anticipate that Friday dinner and Saturday lunch & dinner it will be packed. I wanted to like it more, and I think we will go back and try again. But if you're going to make your burger the centerpiece of your restaurant, it better be a great burger. As of today, I'd still choose the Farmhouse burger any day.

Not worth trying.  My son and I went in February.  I had a burger though the toppings were meager and the fries cold,  My son had the sliders, served three, one was recycled and a hockey puck, the others were good, though the fries were cold.  I gave it a shot again, because anyone can have an off day.  The family sat down, wasnt too busy but couldnt get anyone to wait on us.  A waiter came over and said someone was coming but they didnt come so we left.  These a Plan B coming to Fairfield which will not likely make it if food quality and service is as poor as I experienced. Better options like Local and Joes American in town.

Came here for the name and will return for the food! The mac and cheese is on point and I loved my fried tilapia. The fried chicken looked wonderful and tried some of the delicious waffles. The wait staff were so friendly and helpful, so ask for recommendations!! Everything was served quickly and there was a comedy show coming that I had to miss. Give it a try!!!!
My wife and I had Breakfast here and we Thought the food was good but not great.  The wait staff was good and we were able To Get in and out quickly.

The food is solid, the ambiance and service brings to mind Italian family dining at its best. The owners are very hands on and go out of their way to make their guests feel at home. We had a great time and will be back. Marco...We had a selection of meats and cheeses for an appetizer...I had the Manicotti...my fiance had the spaghetti...it was all very good. The service..your dog Coca...made the evening well worth the trip while we were in town. Thanks.

My wife and I spend last two days in NYC ,few hours ago we were walking and checking up area (around soho)for a good place to have happy hour and bum,right in front of me I saw that cute and  cozy restaurant.We decided to check it out and after all we were one big wow! The stuff work there were so nice and pleasant ,the food was fresh and fresh ,portions were just right ! I have been very picky about what I eat and the way food has been handle,after dinner I felt just right ,no over consume no after taste no acids,that is what am looking for in a place restaurant! Highly Recommended,if you find your self around area this is the place you must go to! And the ownership must expend in Washington Dc area !

Just simply wonderful.  Great food, more than sufficient selection of beer and other libations, comforting atmosphere, and attractive pricing.  All that is topped off by bartenders and wait staff second to none in the city.  I've enjoyed the wings on my first visit.  My second visit introduced me to the Devil's Pocket bacon cheeseburger that I am sure to have many more times in the future.  The bacon cheeseburger is based on La Frieda meat and it is served on a toasted brioche seeded bun with shredded Romaine lettuce, pickled onions and a choice of cheeses --- I chose Blue Cheese and asked for the rarest burger possible.  I was not disappointed.  in fact, I honestly do not remember enjoying a better urge anywhere!  I will positively return often!!!
Excellent food! It surpassed all my expectations! Healthy and Delicious food! Worthy of every dollar spent! I just loved this place!
Looking for a city sushi bar... This was a surprisingly great find in a basement... Unique energy and great food and service! Casual

We got upcharged $1 for ordering a drink on the rocks.  The bartender explained that it's because you get more alcohol for a drink on the rocks.  Guess what guy, a drink is a drink.  Pour me the same amount and put it on the rocks, just like every single other place on the planet. It's not rocket science.  Also the bartender gave a crap pour because the bottle finished, and didn't go get a new bottle.

Attended a private birthday party there on Sunday.. Food was awesome.  Loved the environment. Owner and staff were very friendly. Quick service. Will be going there again and again.. If you are in the Newark area, you gotta try there food..
Extremely friendly. Food is amazing and the price is lower than expected. I've had salads, soup and oatmeal. All outstanding. Coffee is pretty  banging too. I say a must try place and im very picky

Loved this place. Sweet tiki vibe that isn't too kitschy or overwhelming but instead has a really chill, comfortable atmosphere. The drinks are really tasty and remain loyal to the original recipes- they feature the good stuff: fine rum, fresh citrus juices and house made syrups and liqueurs. They're even on their garnish game and liberally use fresh mint leaves and freshly shaved nutmeg. I wish I had a place like this in DC where I live...will certainly be back the next time I'm in Philly. Friendly staff too!
This place has everything. And it's not just variety--you're talking high quality stuff for the old school and the nouveau foodie alike.

Came here with a group of friends on a recommendation and we were told to leave because we hadn't ordered enough. We were happy to change our orders so we could stay but we were practically kicked out before we had the chance. Pretty negative treatment for a place that supposedly preaches positivity. I understand that some establishments need to enforce a minimum spend, but if that is the case, politely explaining this to customers should be the first step - not accusing them of purposely taking up a good table and wasting everyone's time, which is not at all what we had intended! In the end we changed our orders, spent about $5 more per person, but were left with a bad taste in our mouths. Worth it? The food was fine but we won't be back after that treatment.

The friend chicken and waffles were good I finished my entire plate. My friend Brett was pretty hung over so he didn't eat too much of his. The wait to be seated is about 40 minutes but the wait list guy is entertaining.
The potato soup is delicious!
The best pizza in the Princeton-Trenton area. The guys who work there: Sal, Guy, and Dino are like family. The nicest people serving the best pizza and Italian food.
Had some takeout and was really underwhelmed. The festival bread was stale, plantains tasted just as old (after a five minute walk outside?) and the jerk seitan was boring.

amazing drinks during hh! the reviews say it all. This place is awesome to have a cheap well done drink during their hh. However, the space is so tiny that it is so hard to come here with a group of friends. I am still giving it 4 stars bc of the delicious lychee martinis and how strong they serve them. It is a cool spot for after work drinks, but remember to get here early to either get a spot by the bar or by the couches!
I had brunch here this morning with a friend. It is a small place, tucked away on Norfolk. We were early for brunch, so it wasn't too busy. They won't sit you without your whole party there.
