Beautiful atmosphere outside. Lovely decor inside. Delicious food. :) service was exceptional. We couldn't have had a better dining experience for a spur of the moment dining choice.

The service was great.  Vey friendly staff.  Food over the top.  Atomsphere very nice. I went here with my 4 children, so I had the privilege of tasting many different items on the menu.  Amazing. !!  Presentation was beautiful.   Best Buffalo chicken (and I'm from the Buffalo area).  Ribs were amazing.  French fries and gravy to die for!   I could go on and on.. If I ever go back to New Jersey,  I will definitely be come here again.
Lovely dinner there Friday night. Beet salad was fresh and delicious and my friend's mushroom soup was terrific. Fun atmosphere and amazing bottle of white burgundy. I will be back!
The menu changes often, some of my favorite items have been seasonally available. I found myself enjoying it a lot more.
Nothing like Mamagyro's for Friday night take out!  Tzadziki and pita is delicious, as are the spinach and cheese pies.  One of the best Greek places on the UES.

Been to both the LES and Astoria locations, and experience-wise, Astoria's is way better (not that service is bad in the LES one, just that I liked this crowd a bit better). I highly recommend their crab meat covered shrimp. They are beyond delicious and sure to fill you up. I had them with both Horta and the potato fries, and lets say that the potato fries were the crowd's favorite. Also, their calamari appetizer is great.

Confusingly overpriced.  An ok place to eat but the prices reflect an expectation that the food should be amazing and the ambiance superb.  the food was ok and the ambiance was a little cold.  My husband got pork chops, they were ok.  his sweet potato purree was great but that was the best thing we ate and I'm willing to bet I just liked it because it was full of butter.  I got quinoa cakes which were totally boring.  My first bite had a nice creamy texture but was too hot to eat (imagine breathing with your mouth open and fanning your tongue with your hand).  The subsequent bites were of a tolerable temp but the enjoyably creamy texture disappeared, and they really had almost no flavor.  The cold salad they were served with was crying for a vinagerette or something.  A disapointingly obligitory vegetarian offering.  I really wish I'd have gotten a $16 burger instead of the $18 quinoa cakes.  We did not get the signature steaks so maybe that's where the Guild really shines, but I can't even imagine a steak being worth $48 no matter how good it is.  The room ambiance is nice except that I was really chilly, and there were 4 tables of loud children and babies.  There was even the cliche screaming infant.  The plants by the front door are weird - they dont look healthy.  Our server didn't tell us his name, which just feels unwelcoming.  We enjoyed our special meal out but would have enjoyed a less expensive restaurant just as much, for half the price.

Dope but the new owners are def less passionate about the pizza making process and you can taste the difference! But I will still keep coming here for years to come unless there will be another drastic change for the worse! Best squares in nyc

Been to both the LES and Astoria locations, and experience-wise, Astoria's is way better (not that service is bad in the LES one, just that I liked this crowd a bit better). I highly recommend their crab meat covered shrimp. They are beyond delicious and sure to fill you up. I had them with both Horta and the potato fries, and lets say that the potato fries were the crowd's favorite. Also, their calamari appetizer is great.

Ordered General Tours chicken, honey chicken and I don't believe the chicken was actually chicken. It may have been some type of fritter but definitely not whole chicken. The chicken and pineapple fried rice was not fried rice it was white rice with dole pineapple with boiled chicken pieces.

So hey, get this -- this place serves out of this world, rich, hearty broth out of the side of the restaurant. Who would have thought of this? The crazy people at Hearth, that's who. I went and got the grass-fed broth and boy is it tasty. I think people are going to have to stop using the cliché "hot cocoa" and start getting this amazing broth to warm up when this frigid weather finally rolls through. My only gripe is that they close at 7:30pm and aren't open on Sundays, but I might be able to get past that

Great little place in the middle of a busy neighborhood. Their baked goods are amazing and I can never wait to go back just so that I have an excuse to try something new. Coffee is very good, and I love the decor. Perfect place to go read a good book or meet a friend !
I ordered the buffalo tenders with their homemade slaw 2 thumbs up!  The fried chicken, flavor was on point and so tender.
the best pizza!!! love it!
Had a delicious dinner and staff were awesome and so attentive. Would definitely return.

I come here when I visit New York often, but won't be coming anymore as I have noticed a deterioration in good quality. The Matzo Ball soup is a mainstay and hence the 2 stars else it would be 1. Had a chicken enchilada that was dry and burnt. Can't imagine even wanting to bring it out and be served.

Love this place! Gorgeous view, great food & drinks. My boyfriend & I were outside struggling to get a nice picture together when the doorman, Angel, approached us. He was so kind and offered to take a picture of us which came out great. Definitely a must try!

This place is amazing. A little noisy but the view is awesome. Alexis, my waitress provided exceptional customer service. She was very courteous and knowledgable of the food that's in the menu. My fiancé was overwhelmed and enthused about the service she provided. Her customer service skills are EXCELLENT which made his birthday dinner even more exciting. Just for the record, I'm a big critique on customer service. Thanks Alexis for making our night enjoyable and pleasant. Oh, and how can I forget, the food was DELICIOUS AND AFFORDABLE. We will definitely be visiting again. Love it!

Blend On The Water is my favorite restaurant to visit. Nothing tops delicious food served on the most beautiful views NYC can have. There juicy, tasteful arepas are to die for. The service is spectacular from the moment you walk in to moment you leave. Best of all the drinks, the sangria gets 10 thumbs up. Price range is low for the awesome service and food. Very humble staff to complete your evening! Will recommend and will keep going for every special occasion or even just to have a drink with good company!
Wow is all I can say.  Fantastic     We stayed at the Mark Hotel while in NY and was directed to this small place.  Every single bit was the best.
Wonderful meal. great atmosphere and creative menu - all experienced with top notch service. Our party of eight was given excellent service and individual attention. Highly recommend!!

Its a good Italian restaurant overall. The food is above average and served in a very classy way by professionals. The baked clams are my fave along with the chicken parm. The owner is very involved so expect the best...

Beautiful room and views, excellent service. The food was very good. We all ordered fish, and it was all "rare", which was fine for the tuna, but I had Hake, which I would have liked cooked through well; never thought to ask. I have had some restaurants cook salmon rare. I will ask for "well-done" on fish from now on. But, that was my only complaint. It was a lovely experience - and - they had validated parking in the garage, which made things even nicer. Will go back.
My go-to mexican place in Old City.  Love the dishes, their specials are often unconventional, but delicious.

Great cocktails! Amazing wine list that is unpretentious and really reasonable! The staff is great and super welcoming--they make you feel like you belong there. I love the dim lighting and the decor as well. The bathroom decor is enviable! My boyfriend and I both got steak, he got the filet and I got the NY Strip. Both were cooked perfectly and flavors were spot on. I can't wait to go back.

After trying them several times, I will not be back.  Horrible, horrible service.  Extremely long times to get food.   Only time in my life I left a bad tip.  On our final visit, it took almost an hour to get our food (it was not particularly busy).  After eating, we wanted to leave.  Had to search for our server on foot, found her in a booth chatting her friends.  Never again.

This has to be the WORST place I've ever been to. The staff is rude and can't be bothered and the food is mediocre at its best. The bartender needs an attitude adjustment. Do not waste your money on this dump!

This is the 1st brunch place i have been to in Philly with my boyfriend and he didn't ask for salt, or extra seasoning. The food was just delicious, and well seasoned. The place is small, that you feel rushed out after as soon as you finish your meal, hence the 4 stars. I will be going back.

To drive by this new chinese restaurant would be a mistake.  There is an extensive menu that features Shanghai cuisine, and it is authentic, so the sauces are on the sweeter side. We began with the Minced Chicken w/garlic sauce appetizer. The chicken was plentiful and mildly spicy and it was topped with pine nuts, which added great flavor and a nice crunch. For the main course, we tried the Bone In Chicken with a slightly sweet thick soy sauce. We also had the Shrimp Duet, which was beautifully presented (this is NOT your typical Chinese-American fare). On one side of the dish, the shrimp were covered in a bright orange sauce (made from fresh sqeezed OJ) and topped with a glazed walnut. The flavors were heavenly.  The shrimp on the other side of the dish were equally good, though completely different in taste, as they were tossed in a red, mildly spicy sauce that had a sweet finish. Service was friendly and attentive. FU Resaurant is definitely worth a visit!
Go pending related to the holiday of the year, the place is very nice, we ate very well. It changes the burgers for a price quite abordableabordable. What to do !!!
If you like bad service come here.  We'll maybe it is more like no service and being ignored.

Horrible! Place just opened. Have to order from an iPad. A waiter stands there and watches you enter your order when he could have just taken it. The food is way overpriced. One waffle is $13 and that's it, just a waffle, no eggs, bacon sausage, nothing else.  Ordered coffee at the start and it came after the meal was over.  Plastic silverware at a place that charges $20+ for breakfast. Terrible.

I enjoy going to this place every couple of months. The ambiance is hispterish cool and the staff is very friendly. Is it authentic Mexican? No. I think the majority of their taco dishes are tasty, with the exception of the fish tacos which is breaded fish inside a taco- double bread really. However, the tacos are kind of tiny. I believe the best thing on their menu and value are their nacho dishes. Nachos kenzo is a huge plate with diff meats and quite satisfying. Their vaquero menu items are ok- but I wasn't crazy about their chili dog. Way too much stuff for the supermarket hot dog bun to hold. Even after I picked off some of the chili with the sauce- the hot dog went right through the bun as soon as I picked it up. Their margaritas are also good. Parking is usually ok. Staff is competent & friendly. The place in clean - even with their retro look. I have it 4 starts because they do not accept credit/ debit which is kind of a pain for those of us who do not like carrying cash around.

Came for lunch while visiting a friends in New Haven. Loved the thin crust pizza - we had the one large pies; a large garden pie and a small gluten-free Bianco.  Both were fresh and hot and we loved that they had a gluten free dough.   My other friends had the Turkey Bacon Club sandwich and one had The Yale Cobb salad. They said both were very good and the portions were big. Loved the wide selection of non alcoholic beverages and if it weren't lunch time, and having to drive, we would have had a pitcher of local tap beer. Very cozy and comfy feel to the place, tucked away on the Yale Campus! We will be back!
Yes, solid 4 stars! Maybe 5 :) A lot of things t try on the menu. Good quality, flavors, and service.
Don't live in NYC but eat here every time I visit. Great food, wine, vibe!
Love the sushi and the noodle... Taste so fresh and yummy.... Great service and food. Love their bubble tea too, yum yum yum.... If u r around the area, stop by check it out....
Nice atmosphere , friendly services. I love the hand shaved noodle soup. Yummy yummy :)  definitely have to try the bbq squid , sauce is so gooood ~ price is affordable . Will definitely come back
A+ food A+ servers highly recommended, all the food are fresh and great bubble tea too!!!

I'm a college student who loves sushi and is determined to try every sushi restaurant within walking distance of my home, but I keep coming back to Chattime "Angry dragon" roll especially lives up to its name. Every other choice I've tried has lived up to expectations, including sushi, rice rolls. The location is next to kiwi frozen yogurt.the inside is clean and what you'd expect from any decent sushi restaurant. The servers are exceptionally polite and service itself is quick. If you want good sushi from good people at a good price, go to Chattime.

I have been here several times and it is always fantastic. The food is consistently delicious. The waitstaff is professional and friendly and the atmosphere is very relaxing.  I would highly recommend.

I wandered over here while my sister was furniture shopping next door and I am patting myself on the back for stumbling upon this place. When I walked in they were offering free bread samples and it was a very generous, thick slice of bread/sample. I had the cinnamon swirl and it tastes like a cinnamon bun in bread form. Which naturally led to my selection of a cinnamon roll as a treat for later. The cinnamon roll was amazing. Seriously, the best cinnamon roll I have ever had, anywhere. I'm from out of state and just visiting but I plan on returning the next time I'm in Burlington.

Not so much .... I thought everything was just OK ,the Goulash was over nothing & in a spicy tomato based sauce , dish looked like soup .... The place is creative with their seating since there's no room , no heat either ....
New North Indian joint in town, excellent thali with veg and non veg options. The place is clean and friendly staff.

Terrible service with groups, not friendly at all. "What you want?" Was about the only thing my waitress said to me the whole meal. They lump sum the whole check so everyone has to dish out cash. Asked for ice water; "It is ice water." It wasn't ice water. :( Spring Roll was definitely not made in store and it was surely microwaved because it was boiling hot. Mango Chicken, although pretty, consisted of mostly empty breading nuggets and then some overcooked stiff chicken pieces.

I am so moved at how much they care about their customers not only do they have great food. a fun atmosphere and staff with grand personalities.  the love and care they showed my wife in her Heath issues goes beyond the extra mile. I will never ever pass up Bruschetta for any other restaurant. I love each and every visit

I happened to see a picture of their pistachio and goat cheese encrusted New Zealand rack of lamb on Instagram and just had to try it. The food was excellent! From the bread to the entrees everything was delicious. My boyfriend had the lamb and I had the filet mignon. For dessert we shared Nutella filled zepoles, sherbert with a white chocolate shell, and their french vanilla creme brûlée. The staff was very friendly and provided great service. Overall I'd recommend trying them out and we will definitely be back again!
Fantastic food. Great ambiance. The beet salad is to die for. My dessert of choice is the Affogato....mascarpone gelato with espresso poured over it.

This place is amazing. I love the service and quality of food. They have an innovative yet classic menu w exciting flavor combinations. I have never had a bad experience here. :) I hope to go again for my birthday.

I came here for the first time tonight after hearing so much about it and my expectations where exceeded! This place has food that I had never tasted before, like pork buns, which now is one of my favorite appetizers! Delicious! The place is really trendy and the staff greets  you in Japanese which adds to the Japanese feeling. My first experience here so superb! I will definitely come back here!
Idk who the new cook is but the Food wasn't so great this time They charge for delivery despite minimum And the prices & deals online are false.

My first yelp review - because I just couldn't believe the experience. The absolute worst service and attitude I have ever experienced in a dining establishment ANYWHERE (Girard Ave Location). I walked in at 10:59 (they open at 11 but the door was open and someone was already in line) and was greeted with nasty comments by the bald man behind the grill. He was mumbling curse words under his breath that we walked in early. As I proceeded to read the menu, he was giving my mother and I dirty looks and seemed to be irritated at us merely being there.  The nasty attitude didn't stop there. After giving him my order and trying to translate to my mother, who does not speak great English, he started YELLING at us that we don't know what we want, THREW HIS PEN in the air and just WALKED AWAY FROM US!  I asked him if there was an issue and he said "YEAH, I F*****G HATE THIS S**T; GO BACK WHERE YOU CAME FROM." This was appalling.  I said "I'm sorry, but my mother doesn't speak great English."  He replied that we should know what we want and not take up his time or something of that nature. It was disgusting to say the least. My poor mother was so offended that she left almost in tears after being treated this way. I told him that we will no longer be needing anything and left as he PROCEEDED TO CURSE at us all the way out the door.   I don't know if this bald man is the owner or merely a worker at the shop, but I have never experienced such unprofessional and purely mean behavior anywhere before.  If this man has a boss, I urge you to correct this attitude immediately or you will suffer in the long run. Even if the sandwich tastes good ( i don't know since we didn't even get to try them), the service makes anything you serve not worth the time or money.   As for the bald head behind the grill - I hope that your miserable little life gets the best of you and that karma works its magic.
Good place for friends reunion.

First time ever going to an UNOs restaurant. Will never go again. At first seating and drinks were fast. But the iced teas ordered tasted like water so ordered just water. Waiter said he wouldn't charge us for it.  then it took over an hour for food to come out. Waiter kept apologizing saying kitchen forgot to put the order in. And he would credit us for a meal. Finally the food came out and it was cold.  Server never came to see of we wanted another drink since out cups were empty before we even got the food. Then when we wanted to order desert he handed us the bill with out even asking if we were done. Didn't credit anything back. Usually I leave a very nice tip... I left exact change. Will never go to this place again

This is the best place I have ever had a cheese steak in my life! I make the 30 minute drive down there about once a month, and everytime it is consistent and fantastic. It is a little on the pricy side, but at the same time it is worth every penny!

Very good place. Highly recommended. The food and staff are superb! The specialty cocktails are expertly crafted and the food was exquisite. Try the puffed beef tenderloin and the bacon tater tots I'm looking forward to my next visit!

Trendy ambiance, affordable drinks, exceptional noms, really accommodating to both small and large groups. I had a really wonderful time celebrating my birthday here.  Thank you Proper West! P.S. Proper ale is super tasty.
FIVE STARS! Bread was amazing! We all had beef: My husband ordered the filet, I ordered the prime rib and my daughter ordered the sirloin. Excellent! Can't wait to return!

traditional korean food, lots of side dishes, most a little bit spicy. Then the main menu only has severl topic, hot pot, pancake, cold noodle and korean bbq. Not too bad, but also not too good, average.

Bacon!  What's not to like?  The Bacon Flight with a Bourbon Flight is the perfect way to start ANY meal!  And then take your pick from there.  Lobster Mac and Cheese with Bacon?  Lobster Roll with Bacon?  Burger with Bacon?  Bacon an Egg Sandwich - doesn't matter what you choose, it will rock.  And save room for their new dessert menu - with bacon of course! And - if you're REALLY lucky (or maybe if ask) you'll have Antonio as your server.  He's attentive, knowledgeable, friendly, and all around FANTASTIC!

Came here for my boyfriends birthday. I give 3/5 for the experience and a 4/5 for food, because it was delicious and dessert was amazing But I was dissapointed a bit at my first time visiting becco. The restaurant called the night before to confirm my reservations and when asked i specifically mentioned I didn't want them to sing when the desert came aroud which I guess they didn't note down. Luckily I managed to stop them before too much embarrassment. And the second dissapointing thing was when ordering I mentioned I wanted to add the 3 Unlimited pastas to the meal I ordered which the menu did say I could do, but apparently they forgot that too. I ended up just having the meal which was delicious. But for the great ratings this restaurant received I did expect our night to be a little more pleasurable
Good home made pasta and great price!  Very good service.  Drinks were delicious!
Delicious, courteous staff, cozy atmosphere. My go-to French spot in Brooklyn!

After moving to Staten Island, I was a little late to discovering Vida, but once I did was very impressed. Finally - excellent food! It was the best restaurant on Staten Island, imho. The only restaurant that was good enough to stand on its own merits and without the caveat "for Staten Island" I found myself having to use to describe most dining experiences. When I heard they were closing, I was brokenhearted, but then quickly learned it was only temporary. Phew! Sadly, their reincarnation with more of a Mexican focus is nothing on par with their old offerings. I've gone twice, and both times the old wonderful Vida was gone. And considering how empty the dining room has been on prime eating-out nights, I'd say I'm not alone in this opinion. A few old menu dishes (or specials that would have been more fitting for the old menu) are still being offered, but this merely makes the whole dining experience very disjointed; schizophrenic. They had such an amazing groove before - unique, excellent dishes. I can totally imagine the amazing food they used to offer must have taken a lot of time, money and energy, and the new menu has more interchangeable ingredients among dishes. But if I wanted Mexican, sadly I know of at least two or three other restaurants that offer better. I'll refrain from naming competition because I really want Vida to figure things out! Last year I would have given Vida 5 stars and wished I could have added more! But now, it has moved way down the list of restaurants I want to go to. It has lost its focus and no longer seems to prioritize amazing taste above all else. I'm back to brokenhearted...

It surprised me to learn that the chef is vegan.  This is terrific news for me since I have dietary restrictions and cannot eat anything dairy.  Lindsey our server was wonderful.  She made sure that my food arrived without any dairy.  Usually, I feel that Mexican food is a bit easier for me because it's easy to leave it out - no sour cream on the side or cheese on top,...  This was a fun restaurant and I felt completely comfortable that I was in good hands.  I also felt like I had a fair bit of selection to pick from.  I agree with the other reviewers that it's well done Mexican food.  This restaurant has great atmosphere, terrific service and quality food.  What more can you ask for.  Oh, by the way, I only gave it 4 stars because I ordered a pumpkin margarita and it was only O.K.

Sat at the bar. The chicken here was possibly the best chicken dish I've had ever. Cocktails were a bit sweet and nothing else was super memorable for me, but I have to give at least 4 stars to the place with the best chicken I've ever had.

We recently had a 60+ people engagement celebration at app's.. The food was outstanding very tasteful and enough for everyone to have seconds, and thirds if they wanted.. The servers were attentive, helpful, and pleasant, and the atmosphere was great. I was pleased for everyone who came from out of town to attend who also had nothing but compliments. I would definitely recommend for a gathering, whatever it may be!

Whenever I want a good solid cocktail with no fuss and extensive knowledge, Southwark is the place. the bar and dinner menu are surprisingly fresh thoughtful, with almost all ingredients locally sourced. Kip or any of the bartenders or waitstaff will gladly help pair a particular wine or beer with your meal, allowing you to have a true foodie experience in a cozy and relaxed atmosphere.

We were visiting a patient and Yale and decided that rather than eat in the hospital we would go out to get a decent meal.  We ended up in front of Heirloom and decided to give it another chance.  Lunch was better than my brunch experience, but still underwhelming.  We arrived at about 1:30 and a flock of preppie doormen jumped up to hold doors and usher us into the dining room where we apparently became invisible.  After being ignored for several minutes at the hostess desk we asked a waitress if someone could seat us.  She found the hostess who somewhat reluctantly tore herself away from her conversation with a waiter and  we were seated.  Since there were only two other tables that were occupied I was a little surprised that we were such an inconvenience, but clearly we were.  The waiter was pretty good, attentive and brought the drinks promptly, but despite the fact that the dining room was dead it still took an awfully long time to get the food (burgers and fries) and the fries were cold when they arrived.  The burger was good, but it was completely, totally, absolutely unseasoned.  No salt, no pepper, no seasoning at all, just a patty of high quality beef.   It was better than hospital food, but there are so many places in New Haven that are so much better.
Blood Orange Margaritas are AMAZE-BALLS.  Also, that salsa is super addicting....really smoky and delicious!  Love this bar!!

This is the joint all of the locals go to when they want a great meal to pair with an amazing craft beer and brown liquor selection. They have over 40 beers to choose from and countless bottles of scotch, Irish whiskey, and bourbon. Burgers, tacos, spuds, and pretty much everything on the menu are delicious. Staff is very friendly and keep people coming back day after day!!

I had taken the recommendation of a well-known Philly foodie and reliable source to try Aldine when I text him, "I'm on the corner of 19th & Chestnut and want to try a new Rittenhouse restaurant.  Any suggestions?"  I was excited that I was standing 2 feet from what I expected to be a delicious dinner.  I didn't think, however, that I'd leave feeling confused and resentful.   The weather was quite cold that night when we were seated, I immediately asked for a cup of tea or anything hot to warm me up.  I was surprised to hear from the server that they have no hot drinks in house.  It's Fall and we've got an arctic outbreak approaching.  Why no hot drinks?   I was also confused by the menu.  There are no descriptions of the dishes - only ingredients - and actually not all of the ingredients are listed that could potentially pose a problem for guests with food allergies.  Because there weren't any descriptions of the dishes, I settled for the one dish that actually sounded appetizing and hot - Cappelletti: sausage: butternut: lemon (that's how it's listed on the menu).   When the food runner delivered the plate he said, "Here is your ricotta filled cappellitti"  "There's cheese in this?  It wasn't listed on the menu.  I'm allergic," I said.    He took the plate back and when I asked the server why cheese (an important ingredient in the dish) wasn't listed on the menu, she played it off as if I should have asked.   Some may argue that I should already know that cappelletti is filled with cheese.  However, how am I to know that this new contemporary restaurant isn't filling the pasta with sausage and butternut?   If I'm expected to pay $120 for a dinner for 2 at a brand new restaurant, then I should be walked through the menu thor-ough-ly.  I should also be given the full dining experience...which, in my opinion, includes the choice of a hot beverage.   I didn't order another main course, but rather shared my boyfriend's hanger steak and waited for the dessert menu.  The hanger steak was good, however, it's not a dish that would bring me back.  Thankfully they have a dairy-free desert - fennel fritters over maple ice shavings.  That made up for the menu mishap.  The fritters were hot and gooey.  I tasted some tamarind in the ice shavings and really liked the contrast of sweet and spicy/hot and cold. With the overall experience, I wasn't impressed.  I was actually resentful of the bizarre presentation of the menu and the way the cappelletti incident was handled.  If you're not going to provide descriptions of the dishes, at least train your servers to thoroughly describe what is in each dish and how it's presented.   After we settled the check, we said goodbye to the hostess and our server who didn't hear us because they were scrutinizing over the POS screen.   That pretty much summed up my Aldine experience.

Went here about  a month ago.. The food is so tasty! We had a party of 8 and shared a lot of the appetizers. They had a home made pasta special that was the best dish I've ever had! Their artichokes and olives are out of this world too in the antipasti. I will definitely be back. Good drinks, good service. ;)
Nam Nam is so Nam i just walk over once a week and nam nam nam. My belly is full of bun fun fun fun. Nam Nam Nam - Nam nam nam.
The food is absolutely amazing.  Everything was delicious and the service is incredible.  It was a wonderful dining experience and I cannot wait to return!
Fantastic service, really nice staff, and excellent food. I highly recommend the pappardelle.
The menu is huge, and I've never had a bad sub here. Amazing customer service! Cheesesteaks are one of the best in jersey!

Had a horrible dining experience on a Tuesday night. My companion ordered the chicken thighs that, when cut, were ice cold inside -obviously cooked prior and partially warmed up.  We flagged the wait staff and made them aware of this.  The chicken came back out of the kitchen within minutes --micro waved with all the sauce removed and the chicken inedible.  My pork was also fairly greasy and flavorless.  Expectations were unfortunately set with great empanadas --but quickly dashed with the main courses. When we brough this to the attention of the wait staff, they did nothing up to and including reducing the bill.  Just stuck it to us.  We felt bad not leaving a tip, but need some response.  Service was also quite bad --probably because the wait staff was avoiding us once that they understood what was going on. I would suggest that Yelpers eat elsewhere near Yale or in New Haven

I came here with my nephew and my parents the night of my first marathon and it was exceptional. Probably the best Italian food I've ever had.  And they had fried brussell sprouts as an appetizer.... UNREAL!  They were exquisite. Highly recommend!   Service was good too!
Love the Mahi fish tacos. The green iced tea is refreshing. I always get the tacos or basque shrimp. Looking to venture off and have the Balkan burger soon! I could seriously eat here every day.

Wow! Easy to find- cheap parking- amazing food!!!!! Wonderful service- fancy but not too fancy- burgers are incredible! The bison meat (it was my first time trying it) was very tasty.  Julie was very attentive- manager came by and made sure everything was good- highly recommended-

I have been getting take out here since they opened. I was happy it opened so close to where we live. It's decent generic thai food like most of the places on 9th Ave (except for Pure Thai cookhouse which is amazing). But nonetheless we enjoyed ordering from here regularly though I hate the waste of takeout. Today I thought I'd try to go for lunch with my mom and toddler. The restaurant was half crowded, but the host didn't think my stroller would fit. I clearly saw an end spot near the bar where we wouldn't be in anyone's way and figured it was not that busy so why wouldn't they want the extra business of two adults eating there? Clearly they didn't need our business or they were not family friendly even during their off hours to a well behaved toddler. So thank you for all the meals but I will walk the extra blocks to yum yum Bangkok for the same food when I want generic thai food!

One of my favorite restaurants by far with Beso being the only exception. The bartender Charlene, the manager, the Wait staff is always polite and engaging. We often sit at the bar with intentions to eat in the dining room, but with the cozy yet modern ambiance of the bar area, we end up staying at the bay for a full meal. Love it here! Tuna appetizer, clams, mussels, you can't go wrong.

Best Cheese Steak Ever! Staff is always friendly, even at peak times when the place is packed, and you can get beer to-go. Bring cash and your order in ahead to reduce wait time- they don't take credit cards and won't make your sandwich until you get there.

We.loved.it! Fantastic place...fantastic staff and better yet amazing food. The owner was there, the son and Diego was awesome. We loved him! The food is so good and Uncle Jimmy's meatballs melted in you mouth! It is a MUST do place. Seriously...so much to choose from...just choose this one! You will not be disapppointed!

Great location, however coffee not good, tastes like something you get at 7 Eleven and very expensive......  I am a small world customer and wanted to give another local store a chance.  Sorry, will not be back...

I love living in New York, however living here has made me expect exemplary service. This...was anything but that. Got here for a 7:15 reservation and we're not seated until 7:35. That was understandable and plenty of room at the bar to sit and wait. Once we were seated, our server came quickly to get our order. Appetizers took quite a long time, we had to ask for them twice. Once they arrived, we finished them quickly (the salt and pepper shrimp was actually a little cold---which means it WAS sitting out waiting to be taken up). At 8:55 we were YET TO SEE AN ENTREE, and actually another server came to our table to ask us "if we wanted anything else," I almost lost my mind. We cancelled our entrees, and left. (Everything was comped, thank goodness). But we are never, ever coming back. The moral of the story, is that I understand that a restaurant can become busy...but it was the utter lack of acknowledgement that we had been waiting, that everyone just walked past while we stared at an empty table. Not okay.

Went on 11/8/14 around 5:30. The place was empty but was full by the time we left. Definitely not a 45-60 minute wait like their Brooklyn location. The pizza was ok, but not as good as Grimaldi's in Brooklyn. Its missing something and I can't put my finger on it. Got the traditional Margherita and a pesto pie. The Margherita was bland... I used ALOT of grated cheese to give it some flavor. When in NYC I can eat a whole one myself as its so thin and tasty! Not so at this location. It was a tad bit doughy. Maybe its because the young-in's cooking the pizza were just that... young! Not like the Brooklyn guys that have been there 20 plus years. Or maybe i'm just being a Brooklyn Grimaldi's snob... or maybe they just need to find their groove. Either way I'll definitely try it again though as its much closer than Brooklyn!

Love this place! We always order tapas and we've never been disappointed. The sangria is always delicious, and they have a great cocktail list. The warm almond tart is amazing for dessert, I suggest getting the dolce de leche gelato instead of the raspberry sorbet.

Ive had my baby shower, 30th Birthday and this month I had my daughter's sweet 16 here. The experience have been great. The manager Alvita who takes care of the parties was so sweet. She is very accommodating which made the experience even better. We chose to use them to cater my daughters party and the food was great. The kitchen was spotless and the food was made the morning of the event. The mashpotatoes and ribs were a hit. The staff were very polite and on top things. The bathrooms spotless, the place was clean. I was very happy with everything. We felt at home, thats how welcoming it was throughout the evening. My next visit will be to try their food by the bar. Its a different menu and from  what I saw coming out the kitchen the food look good. The staff very friendly and the atmosphere very comfortable.
Great food and great service.

A good local pizza place, that happens to be my go to for pizza. Pizza, Calzones, Cheese Steak, Salads, Beef Patties, subs, and pasta are all very tasty. I haven't tried everything, but what I have had, I liked. I've never heard any of my friends or family complain about San Remo. Staff is polite, and cater pretty well to big groups of all ages. Prices are competitive with the area. They're a staple of Woodbridge and a definite recommend!

Hey there I have to say I've heard so much about this place. My freinds swear about this place. Guys- friends of my I have to disapoint you friends.. I was enjoying my drinks and food at a table.  Normal tuesday night low key, Relaxation. Etc etc etc...... Let me just say you know the song " the freaks come out at night" for all u old school cats? Well the new song for 2014 is the roaches come out at night". As I'm finishing my food, I'm about to take a spoon of rice when I saw a baby roach look up at me. And be pissed like I woke up the mother f**ker! Up!   I was like we pay rent for this bill at the end night.. Just because u got moved out of ur old place cause the landloard exterminator moved your ass out, has nothing to do with me enjoying my food.... Ok.. To make story short now cause I'm enjoying this.... Hostsess is advise. Chef comes out and was very apologetic wth an explanation that the exterminator was there earliern like if hey its ok, u found the roach cause of A B C, now eat up and finish........... Word of advise.... If u want to eat there..... On tues, please first ask if the exterminator exterminated the same day............ OHMYGOD. ............ Not good people.. From rafael Velazquez, New MUseum...
Excellent food. Their service is always great and the price was the best. They are quick and friendly

We went here for our anniversary and had dinner outside near the pond. We started with the crab cake appetizer which was a little expensive for one crab cake. Still, it was delicious especially with the sauce included. For our entree I had the filet mignon which was a little stringy but not bad. I will likely choose something else when we return.  What really made the place great was the atmosphere and scene outside. We were lucky enough to have a table next to the waterfall, and it was a beautiful scene as the sun set. Overall it is a quite relaxed environment to share a nice meal at, although a tad expensive.

You can just ignore all the great reviews. People are so overwhelmed by the hype of this place they check their brains, wallets and taste buds at the door. You can do that if you want to. If you check my reviews on Trip Advisor, you'll find I seldom give such a poor rating. But, there are no kind words for this miserable place or the miserable treatment we were given. And there's no way this is untypical. Lots of irrationally positive reviews site the excessive wait times. But, oh, there's so much more *not* to like! First, they kept us waiting around (in this vast place with nowhere to sit) for over an hour (supposed to be a 40 minute wait) and then *lost* us for I-don't-know-how-long. When they finally figured out we were standing right under their noses, they scolded us for inconveniencing them and sat us at a counter with our faces 12" from a wall. No kidding. After all that, you'd hope at least the food would be worth the wait. We were certainly hopeful, but alas, it wasn't worth the wait or the money. There wasn't anything about the food we were served that made it any better than any lowly "pizza place" in Manhattan. It might be impressive to look at or walk around. But, it's all hype. Do yourself a favor. Look at it. Walk around it. Then leave and go someplace else to eat. Manhattan is FULL of good restaurants where they understand how to treat you well and serve exceptional food. In the face of that, there's simply no intelligent explanation for the popularity of this awful train wreck of a place.

We went to Ladurée on Madison Avenue on Monday, November 10th, 2014. First of all, the location is great- a convenient, easy walking distance from Central Park, and about fifteen blocks from the Plaza Hotel. I have friends who work in Paris who are always going on about how great Ladurée on the Champs Élysées is,  so we decided to stop into their New York location to try the famous macarons while we were in the city. The macarons are $2.80 a piece, and a box of a dozen came to about $31.00. We tried the following flavors: rose petal, orange blossom, violet & blackcurrant, caramel fleur de sel, coffee, vanilla, chocolate coconut marshmallow, and sesame praline. Additional flavors on offer included strawberry, lemon, gingerbread, pistachio, and chestnut.  Here's what we thought of the flavors we tried: Rose Petal: we bought several of these because they came so highly recommended. I now regret this. The rose petal macarons are *extremely* floral. A tiny bite was enough for me, and I was still tasting rose petal for hours afterward. Orange Blossom: unlike the rose petal, this was floral in a good way. Light, sweet, and airy, I would definitely recommend this as the best of their floral flavors. Violet & Blackcurrant: while the violet cookie part was very good, the blackcurrant jam in the middle was more like fruit leather. It was chunky and difficult to chew- the texture was a major turnoff. Sesame Praline: the sesame praline was good, but very nondescript. It was hard to identify any particular flavor and was mostly just sweet. Coffee: the coffee was really enjoyable, with the flavor of a frothy, sweetened latte. I would order this again. Vanilla: the vanilla was delicious and I wish I had ordered more of these than the rose petal. It was rich and buttery, like French Vanilla ice cream packed into a macaron. Caramel Fleur de Sel: this was awesome! I don't usually like caramel, but this was so good. It was sweet and buttery, and perfect.   Chocolate with Coconut Marshmallow: this was by far my favorite. It was rich and chocolate it without being too sweet, and the chewy but light marshmallow center was perfect. I should've gotten a whole box of these! We also tried two other treats: a pistachio financier and madeleines. The pistachio financier was perfect- sweet and nutty with a chewy exterior and soft, moist interior.  It was delicious and I would definitely get one again.  The madeleines were a disappointment. Madeleines are my favorite cookie, and I do hold them to a high standard, but these were barely passable. Dry and stale, with very little of the characteristic buttery lemon flavor I've come to expect, I don't think they were worth what we paid for them. While we didn't try and of their other goodies, they certainly offer a wide range of larger and more complex treats. From éclairs to harmonies to St. Honorés to mille-feuilles, there is quite a selection of gorgeous pastries to choose from!  These larger pastries ranged in price from $5-$10. All in all, while it is a bit expensive, I would definitely recommend stopping by if you're in the area. It's a fun treat, a beautiful little artisan shop, and the staff are very friendly and knowledgeable. Bon appétit!

Lounge atmosphere a little cold classic Japanese restaurants / Korean. Long tables to share with other guests; very nice but also very noisy so avoid lovers. We were 4 (3 American and 1 French) and we all enjoyed. We ordered different dishes to taste and we were not disappointed! Very good value for approx 100 USD for 4 with drinks (beer) report. Remember to book!

I have celiac this restaurant is not gluten free  I ate there and was so sick the next day.i also ordered a glass of wine they have the nerve to charge 18.50 a glass . I would not recommend this restaurant for anyone that has celiac .
Had such a fantastic experience here when visiting new York! Great hospitality,  delicious food and reasonably priced. Can't recommend enough!

I invited my two friends to this place after reading some good reviews and visiting emily's website. The girl at door was really friendly (she actually came to the bar next door to tell us our table is ready) But that was the only good thing. Website describes the pizza as "new style". I don't know, maybe if new style means completely burnt pizza then OK. Maybe it's because the place is so dark that the poor pizza guy can't see what's going on with his  pizza. But seriously as european who's been in italy many times (from north to south) I am completely fine with a little burnt edges that's something that comes naturally and is wanted but this pizza (actually three pizzas) were way too burnt and had color and taste of coal. If it hadn't been burnt I believe it could be good. But at the end the pizza slice from those cheap shitty places at every corner was better experience then this new style pancake.
Delivery was fast and the people that worked there were friendly. Some places are very rude but they weren't. Had cheese pizza and it wasn't that great. Jersey can do better!
Vegan Tree, you make me feel like I CAN give up meat! Love this place and I'm an omnivore!

ABC Kitchen is one of our favorite restaurants in NYC.  The dining room is made from salvaged materials--and it was done so with quite as much visual and gastronomic panache.  Just Beautiful.  The menu is a sprawling collection of small and large shareable plates--but unlike so many, it features reasonable pricing and dishes that all seem to work well together.  We ordered Bow-tie pasta with kasha and veal meatballs, raw Maine shrimp, clam pizza, arctic char with Romanesco, ice cream cake and everything was divine. It exceeded all that has been said - delicious food, great design, attentive and very knowledgeable service, great atmosphere.

just ate at burrito box last night. been sick with food poisoning for 5 hours this morning. called manager, didn't apologize. won't give refund in less i come in, but am too sick. i told them they need to clean up their act. be careful. There at least two other reviews here that have gotten food poisoning from this place.

I hadn't been to Tony's for years. Saw some bad reviews on Yelp but we were in the neighborhood so we decided to roll the dice. What an amazing meal!! We had the flambéed chorizo and clams Tony da Caneca for an appetizer as well as an order of cod fish cakes--which are not on the menu but worth asking for. All excellent! Had the paella Valencia and grilled squid with a side of vegetables of the chef's choice. Ask for the house piri-piri hot sauce to complement your meal. This was all topped off with dessert (forgot the name but literally translate to sawdust cream brûlée) and house special coffee. The waiter was knowledgeable, friendly, funny, and handsome. Anyone who wants a bland or boring meal should stay home. If you want fun and delight go to Tony's. See you there!

This was one of our best foodie experiences! Cannot recommend highly enough! The food, atmosphere and service was second to none. The tasting menu was fantastic, portion sizes perfect to ensure you weren't feeling too full afterwards. The servers were really knowledgeable and catered perfectly for my wife who is gluten free. Some of the highlights from the tasting menu were the halibut, the oyster chowder and the duck breast.

Absolute garbage - La Sirene decided to sell Groupons, so I purchased one and followed the directions to make a reservation via Groupon. After having my reservation confirmed then subsequently cancelled twice, I called Groupon customer service assuming it was an issue with their system. Then they informed me La Sirene would no longer accept Groupons, including those that were already sold to customers.  Not the way to attract customers or build a following - and without even the courtesy to notify customers instead of just repeatedly canceling reservations.  The manner in which you guys do business is an absolute joke.

Food is amazing. You must try the scones! Their selection of tea is unbelievable!! Me and my girlfriend love to go there in the afternoons and linger over their Afternoon tea. The ambience is perfect and the owner is so lovely.
Dinics roast pork! awesome!
A variety of ethnic foods, fruits, veg and gifts
So awesome to shop and eat there, words don't do it justice. Just go and experience it for yourself.

Best healthy food in NYC. Many gluten free and vegan options. Everything I've had has been delicious. Garlic artichoke pasta and vegan lasagna are my favs. Salmon special is also superb. Veggie burger wrap is the best I've had. Just go!
Greater Ramen and sushi. Service wasn't great though.
Excellent service and even better food. Not piled on toppings, baked righr.  Catering professionals
Even without their groupon, this is a great value and quality restaurant, especially in NYC.

First impression counts, the host, obviously too cool to work there. Don't know his name but African American. I asked for a spot for one, he just looked at me with dead eyes and said you an get a spot at the bar. I sat myself, which suits me fine, but the host FAILED to inform me that the kitchen will be closing in 5 minutes. What a dick.

It's the usual business at the Spotted Pig.  They are good for a filler up while going to the games nearby but I wouldn't like scout the place out and say hey lets eat there.  Staff was so so and the food was great but the price was rebonkulus.
Long wait but great atmosphere, delicious burger and fries!
Always a pleasure here. Burger is outta control!

Always had great service and the food is great. Happy hour is good considering the area. Bartenders are always so friendly and they know how to make a real drink. They also gave me comp vip tickets to the comedy show although I never got to make it to the show. I really enjoy this place even when its packed. Its especially the best when not packed though since it is rather narrow.

Brought a friend in from out of town to try this. She studied abroad in college so I thought it would be the perfect fit. The atmosphere and decor was unreal - super German-y. Food wasn't bad. She mentioned that it wasn't exactly authentic, but to me it was pretty exotic, but very tasty. Beer selection was so great. I love trying something off the cuff and we had a lot to choose from. The only reason I gave it less than 5 star was the service. It was too packed for the wait staff and so we seemed to be forgotten a time or two. But I guess, as a restaurant, it's a good problem to have if the place is actually overflowing!

Great little place. Stopped in for a quick bite with a couple of friends. Got lucky and caught the tail end of happy hour prices for oysters - no need to pay $2 and $3 per for top notch oysters. Really fresh and expertly shucked. We shared spaghetti and meatballs - the Sunday special. Nice portion and pretty darn tasty. Bottom line : nice clean place. Reasonable prices for above average table fare.
This place is a hole in wall but the noodles are mad good! CHEAP and no tips! Epic winner! I got the beef stew noodles for $6. Ample amount of space to seat and eat! I was happy after the noodles!
Wow! I have been waiting for pizza like this! Pizza is worth the prize! Everything is fresh and healthy! I will definitely be a returning customer and spreading the word to friends.
Pretty tasty.  I enjoy the falafel+baba ganouj combo sandwich.  I also have enjoyed their shwarma and their hummus.  A nice quick bite.
Avoid the clams casino and the crab stuffing  it's really not up to par for this great restaurant
online fraud charges! beware of fraudulent charges on your credit card after placing orders online!  several of us experienced $100 starbcks card charges afterward.

I can't believe I am just finding this place! My friend had her birthday dinner here and it was amazing. I had the homemade ricotta to start and it was so good, they should sell jars of it to go, I would buy it once a week.  I ordered the chicken entree...it was the best chicken I have ever had. I got to taste a little bit of everyones entrees and I seriously can't say enough about this food, it's delicious. We were all very impressed. The cocktails were also very well done. The service was ok but the food was so good it deserves 5 stars.  I'll be coming back soon!

4.5 stars Yasuda definitely has the freshest fish out of any sushi bars in NYC that I've been to. Selection is amazing, but the downside is the pricey tab. The rice however, was kind of lackluster: dry and not as flavorful as some other places. If only they had Azabu's rice with their fish..... Edit: maybe the tab had to do with me and my friend eating almost 70 pieces of sushi before they told us we were done...

As a neighbor, I was pleased with the arrival of INJERA.  I really wanted to enjoy the place.  It's a small, beautiful room, lovely atmosphere (but noisy).   The tables along the wall are too close for comfort.  (There are a couple of tables, for two, in the middle of the room that afford more space). The injera is different than others I've had in town; it's a bit sticky (which I like), and the Shiro is really good.  However, I requested spicy food--it was rather bland. They only accept Cash or Amex.  Upon arrival, I had to leave to get cash.  After dinner, I expected correct change after payment; it was short $10.  Noticed this a block away, which necessitated return. People make mistakes; that's understandable.  It would be a mistake on my behalf to give this place another try. During this last month, I've been to five different Ethiopian restaurants in NYC (with a couple of return visits).  This was a disappointment.
no wonder it's number 1! a very delicious cookie! Huge, that for sure on my next trip to NYC I will relish it

Absolutely delicious pizza, thick crust and I was able to choose my own toppings. Definitely one of the best pizzas I've had in New York so far :) took quite a while to arrive maybe like an hour but was very happy!

The "foie gras gravy" is a sham.  I asked how they prepared it and the waitress said it was VEGAN (?!?) - made with vegetable stock and corn starch. The food was good otherwise, as were the atmosphere and the happy hour cocktail specials.

As a southerner, this is one of my favorite restaurants in the city! I love this place, the food is delicious, and the service is great. Definitely try the biscuits and fixin's, the chicken biscuits, and the cocktails! My only suggestion is that they please go back to the old grits recipe!! THe cheese grits were incredible (for people that know and love grits), but they have been playing with the recipe, and the most recent version was soupy, and less hearty and cheesy. I hope they go back to the old recipe.  But regardless of the grits you should go!

Ambiance was super nice and service was really good (3 out of 3 stars are for this) I wasn't impressed with the food at all. I also wasn't impressed that even though I mentioned that the dinner is a post wedding dinner for a party of 5, they didn't really offer any extras for an extra special day. I'm not used to that. Restaurants normally even give a free dessert for a celebration but was this place too upscale for that?! No clue.

You know those mornings when you're so hungover that you need the biggest, most delicious breakfast and all of the beverages you can fit on your table? Had one of those recently, and let me tell you - Magnolia was the perfect cure. The atmosphere was great, the descent downstairs added to the magical breakfast kingdom vibe, and the music in there seemed to have been pulled straight off my junior year of high school playlist (a good thing, I promise). Plus, they offer vegan and gluten-free options, and they're the first Green Certified restaurant in Vermont - what more could you need? I went with two friends, we got the cheese and fruit plate to start (I didn't dig the horseradish cheese but, that's just me), along with really good coffee and made the classic choice of chocolate milks all around. One of us got a Benedict (perfect) and the others got Bo Knows Breakfast. Everything was so good, I never wanted to leave. As for the service, our waitress (I think her name was Abbie?) was a godsend. She made sure we were well hydrated and had everything we needed, maybe even before we knew that we needed it. I feel like I consistently have excellent restraint experiences in Burlington, but Magnolia takes the cake

Chopped salad was good, tortilla soup was bad. Worst of all was the service. I ordered online for 12.30 pm pick-up. Reached 12.30 and was asked to wait. At 12.50 when I checked again and found they had missed my order. Wasted my entire lunch time!

My new favorite go to for happy hour! Beautiful venue and amazing appetizers...best calimari i've had in my life! Ordered the chicken sandwich which was not as amazing ass the calimari but it was still great and totally worth the price tag.
We had the bison burger sliders and wished they were full size because they were so good. We will definitely be going back to try some other items on the menu.

Ramen would be delicious, however.. please people who want to be serviced never visit here. A long waiting line is fine because it would be usual for famous restaurants. BUT, you could not believe that an employee will wait you finish before about 10 minutes you finish, and nudge you to leave your table. And, can you believe that an employee will follow after you to the outside for MORE TIP? Last weekend, I leaved a tip as 15% of the price, but a guy chased me and said "you had to give more" and his reason was, unbelievably, "you should have given to me 15% of the price INCLUDING a TAX." What an incredible service and manner is this! I was there with my friends, and an employee argued me for his a little more tip with his own calculation. Please, IF YOU WANT TO BE SERVICED, NEVER GO THIS TOTTO RAMEN!

I ordered barbecue ribs and roasted ducks. They are both small plates for 12 dollars. I would say they the dishes were good. The ribs' meat fell off the bones while dish artistically presented. Nonetheless they were not exceptional. I would say unique design but not gastronomically wonderful for the price.

Just came here yesterday for the very first time. I did not even realize this place existed but I am glad I found it from yelp. I love their fried chicken sandwich. It was amazing. Ok so yeah when you bite into it the biscuit starts to crumble and break apart but who cares because it was so frigging delicious. I should have gotten like 6 of them to bring home with me lol. The staff was welcoming and sweet If you do come here try the fried chicken sandwich

Everything was delicious especially the roasted brussels sprouts with apples, creme freche and pistachios. This is a tapas bar so the plates are small but just enough for each of the 4 of us to have a taste. We ordered quite a few different items and thoroughly enjoyed them all. The best surprise was the bill which came in at about $20 each not including wine! What a lovely evening!!

McLaddens has such a great atmosphere. My husband and I tend to come in on Sundays - he loves how many beers are on tap! The service is also great - there has been the same girl waitressing each Sunday, and she couldn't be more helpful with the tap selections! Definitely making this our regular Sunday spot!
A great date night experience! Staff were friendly, delicious food, and drinks were made to perfection! Highly recommend! You will not leave disappointed :)

Great place love the oysters here. Max burger is great too. It is a little on the pricey side but you get what you pay for right?? Anyway i heard they have good tartare too so i will be revisiting this place very soon.

The sandwiches came out pretty fast, within 15 minutes, and they were very tasty. However, the pizza didn't come until much later, at which point my sister and I had already finished our sandwiches and my wife and her friend just sat and watched us eat. The Fresca pizza didn't have much flavor and was not one of the best pizza's we had so far. Not sure if I'd return or not.

I enjoy their food. I've had better, but I've also had far worse. The portions are fair, the food is tasty, and the price doesn't kill me. If you're in the neighborhood it's a good place to get some chinese. I always do take out. I can see the negative comments about the restaurant itself. It's definitely family owned, and they're not to worried about showmanship on the inside. I'll take off one star, but it doesn't really make a huge difference to me personally. Also, their Thai Iced Tea is really good.

Amazing! Delishes! Home cooked italian food in little Italy!  Cute little authentic Italian restaurant!  The owner came out to greet us and we told him to bring us whatever the specials were... best decision ever!  Everything was to die for!  Super fresh! The owner really cared about us and cared that  we had an amazing experience! Love it!  I would deff bring family and friends next time I come to nyc!
Love this place. Just excellent.
Very reasonable tasting menu price. Thank you everyone at Bergen Hill for giving me an unforgettable memory.

Let me start off by saying that I've never written a review for any business or product, however Salute far exceeded my expectations in so many ways  that I felt that I needed to share this place with everyone! We went on a Tuesday night and it was packed! The food is fantastic and served in a timely manner. We had the cheese garlic bread and something with sausage, tortellini, and a cream sauce. I also had the chocolate lava cake.I never had an empty water glass (and I tend to go through a glass of water once every 5-7 min) and all of the waiters/waitresses seemed to support each other and check on every table so every table was being served at all times. I even saw the manager(s) helping with tables. When we left, one of the managers ( I think) gave us free garlic bread and biscotti to enjoy during our show at the Bushnell. They also gave us a 10% discount because we were seeing a show. After the show the garage was locked and we started to panic. We went back into Salute to ask for help and one of the waiters unlocked the garage for us and were extremely friendly still even though it was 10:30 at night. You really can't go wrong with this place. 5-star service and food. I will definitely be going back in the near future.
love the bacon!!!! i recommend anyone who visits new york to find time to check the place out and have the bacon! =)

Had Charcoal Chicken with a cup of cappuccino for lunch.  The meat is on the lighter side, the taste is sweet.  I also like the little heart on my cappuccino.  I know it was lunch time, all of the stuffs were very serious, no smile at all.  I don't feel the "completely at home" experience.

I happened to be in Hartford for a Phish show and I saw Woody's featured on the T.V. show Man vs. Food. I stopped in for a dog and wasn't disappointed at all. Their  "Deputy Dog" (which is a hot dog covered in pulled pork, bacon and cheese) should have songs written about it! Absolutely delicious!! My only complaint is that it is a little hard to find because its in the lobby of a building. I must have driven back and forth three times before realizing where it was. They should have more signs outside so people know where it is.

Well my first experience with Tuckerbox was just Turkish Coffee, which was delightful as was the atmosphere of this Cafe.  The second experience was lunch with a friend with Chai as our drink.  We shared our orders and I have to say they were wonderful:  Doner Kebab and Pachanga Borek. The lamb in the Kebab was so soft yet so delicately marinated it was food for the gods, while the Borek took our breaths away--I probably could have had a dozen of these! The dishes are presented beautifully and the taste is exquisite, not too mention how good the Chai was!!! I highly recommend this Turkish Bistro when you want something magical and different. Compliments to the chef!!!!!!!

I don't know where to start.  My son was playing a gig at DROM in NYC and I needed a restaurant close to this spot.  While checking the internet I came across GG's.  I called and Emily answered.  She was polite, patient and I felt just perfect for my crowd of 23.  She gave me a prefix menu that we agreed upon.  It all sounded very good.  The day of the gig my party was down to 13.  I called Emily and she was as calm   (no problem) she said, just come it'll be fine.  She also helped us find a garage near by.  Once there at 5:00PM Nov. 8, 2014 the deliciousness began.  What I thought was just a prefixed menu with some very good ideas from Emily, turned out to be a medley of delicious dishes one after another.  It was family style a  salad, with white pizza and Mediterranean pizza . Then mushrooms, pasta, hamburgers which were cut up into 4's and we were all able to taste, French fries that everyone agreed never had French fries like this, potatoes with vegetables, beets, and roasted chicken to die for,,,then to top it off ice cream with a brownie.  I don't know what to say ... We weren't sure which dish we liked better.  The staff was wonderful.  The place was crowded and why not the food is the best I've tasted in a long time.  It's Tuesday Nov. 11 and I'm still getting calls telling me the restaurant was fantastic.  And each person had their own personal favorite food,  By the way we're all foodies. We ranged from 24-68 years  of age and everyone was thrilled.   There's no way to express my gratitude to Emily and her fine staff for taking care of us as if we were the only guest in the house  My thanks to the Chef, for his food choices and concepts of how they should taste was excellent. Thank you , Thank you, Thank you,  Mary Broderick and guest!!!
Always the best in Ethiopian food and comfortable environment.  Amazing experience every time we go. Kittfo is like nothing else, and i cant wait to go back to phily.

Sophie's is great for when you are in a hurry and want to get good food, I would say the only issue is they give you a little too much and also it's a little pricey for the fast food category. But in actuality "is it really fast food?"   I think they really try to take care not to make it the normal quick and ugly food we are used to here in New York. They do try to make a  better meal, but when you are cooking for the masses and serving in hot plates what do you really expect?

What a delight to enjoy such amazing food ! The Shark + Bake was a mouthful of heaven, the jerk ribs practically melted off the bone and are the best ribs i've ever tasted by far. The selection of house sauces really blew me away which go well with the Johnny cakes and anything else for that matter. Also tried the jerk wings which are amazing also. I highly recommend Lolo's for true island street food treats. Staff is very friendly & the rustic nautical decor compliments the goodness of the eats.

I went to Balvanera for dinner and it was beyond marvelous. I was not even sure that I would like Argentinian food but  each taste was a treasure to the palate.  The small plates That I had were the provoletta. ...fabulous hot cheese....  A corn empanada and heirloom tomato salad. And  the rib steak was so tender and seasoned just right.    This is a. New spot in ny and I think it is here to stay or at least I sure hope so!
Amazing Gyro & Chicken platter
great wraps,very tasty! took the Veggie one and was really great! nice place to grab a quick lunch!

OK, so I didn't exactly get a classic beef cheesesteak, but their chicken cheesesteak was delicious! It stayed warm for such a long time, that when I bit into it a half hour later, it was still juicy and with a great amount of melted whiz. Great for when you're in the area. Super fast service. No sit down, but you get a ticket so that you get your food in the correct order and timing.!!

This place is absolutely fantastic for a late night happy hour. They have $5 fishbowls, $5 apps, $3-$4 shots and buck a shuck oysters! I've gone for two late night happy hours (10-12) and it was great every time. The lobster mac and cheese is amazing, the special cheese fries are great, and the oysters are out of this world. Definitely planning on going back more often!

I've been eating at Pellegrino's for years - a trip to NY includes a trip to Little Italy and Pellegrino's for lunch. I was incredibly disappointed this trip and will not return. I don't enjoy spending $200 for lunch to be treated rudely and as if I don't belong. Particularly in a mostly empty restaurant. To Pellegrino's - if your gnocchi is gummy, maybe you should check the batch made that day instead of telling your patron it's because she's used to frozen gnocchi and fresh gnocchi has a different texture. I've never eaten frozen gnocchi in my life and in fact know what properly made gnocchi should taste like. And I certainly didn't need to hear about my frozen gnocchi palate from the server four times. Food was meh, service was rude and curt. Thank you for encouraging me to branch out and create new NY traditions.
Nice atmosphere. Beach Please was delicious..I had a blast!!!

Their cheesestake had absolutely no taste WHATSOEVER!  I think the only seasoning they use is salt.  It sat in my stomach like a ball of steel.  The hole in the wall joints in Philly that barely even look like they are in business have the best cheesestakes by far!  Geno's only sells steak subs and they don't even provide a tasty product.   The other turn off for me was the fact they have posted "Let's take this country back" signs around the establishment.  "Speak English if you order at the window" signs are posted there.  They only sell steak subs there so it's not like the menu is complicated.  You only have one selection for God's sake!  What kind of bigot runs this dump? You will be more satisfied at McDonald's.
Excellent spot for late night dining -grilled calamari is a favorite.

Went here for my 33rd birthday specifically for the interior architecture. But I must say the food did not disappoint. All of my friends had a real great time. The drinks were amazing and the food delicsh.

Always wanted to try this place, so I went for lunch today.  Good sandwich.  Too bad the size of the steak was very, very, very small.  I felt like I was eating a mini cheesesteak.  Now I am still hungry and have to go find something else to eat.  Not worth $9.  Not even close.  You might be able to  get away with charging tourists that, but not me.  NEVER AGAIN.  Rip-off.

This is a surprisingly good restaurant in a neighborhood of good Italian restaurants featuring a varied menu with good salads, excellent entrees and great pastas. The salmon entree is among the best I've ever had, perfectly cooked and accompanied by excellently cooked vegetables. The tables are too close together and the service needs to be a tad better to reach the 5 star level!

My favorite place for a fun dinner .. Great BYOB place! Bring anything from wine to rum because they have great mixers from sangria to punches. Food is always great and huge portions. With girls we usually split  some large dishes and order lots of tapas. Goat cheese fritters: so good with a little sweetness it's like the perfect wine accompaniment Pernil con tostones: delicious Chicken lollipops: crispy I add a bit of lime juice over for some more acid kick Churasco: Med rare skirt steak juicy and flavorful Paella: huge dish we take most of it home but full of tons of seafood mussels scallops clams fish and squid Tres leches and Mango Flan are both the perfect ending!

Fantastic burger joint! The flavor of the meat was excellent, and the bacon jam brought it all together. Most everything is made in house, and you can certainly taste the difference from the chains. Loved the hand-cut fries as well. They were crispy, and not over salted. If you want a real treat, try the bacon jam fries:)
Great food and wine! Waitress was super helpful on recommending wine and interpreting dishes. Lovely back area. Would come again.

So, let me start by saying that if I was rating this strictly on my meal, five stars is not enough. If you want a hearty breakfast, specifically for a drive home the morning after sampling some of Vermont's finest craft beers, you can do no better than a breakfast sandwich on a Vermont Country Bagel. I got a sausage patty and paired with the fennel and salt on the bagel, it was heavenly. The lack of a five star review is thanks to the odd encounter we had with the girl who made my bagel. She seemed pleasant enough, or at least as much as one could working in the pit of despair that is a bagel shop on a Sunday morning, but she asked to see my receipt after handing me my bagel. I told her my girlfriend paid it, which she did, and that I would send her up with the receipt right away. When she got there, she was met with a look of confusion and rudely brushed her off to get back to the queue. It was...really odd. Enough that I am dusting off my Yelp account to tell you about it. I don't take it personally, as I have been in her shoes before, but I cannot begin to tell you how odd that was. I can understand wanting to make sure I wasn't trying to walk off without paying, but to ask to see a reciept and then decide to trust me after all? I don't know. Have some coffee.
Just randomly happened upon this place during a business trip to the area.  This place was full during lunch. The service was great and the food was fresh. Definitely recommend!
just visited Empire State Building, just found this place. great value, nice place to enjoy a real Korean food!
Over priced!  Two scallops $11. Pizza burned on rim and soft undercooked in center.  Very small meal portions which are over priced. Never again

I came into the restaurant on Wednesday last week with a few of my friends for a birthday dinner.  It was a little crowded when I came in but the hostess took my name and told me a table would be available in less than 10 minutes.  It wasn't even 5 and he came back over to seat my party.  He was very engaging and made my group feel taken care of.  We enjoyed the empanadas, pomegranate salad, arepas and fish taco's to start which was all absolutely delicious.  Our meal was wrapping up and someone in our party went to order a few desserts to celebrate the birthday.  We ordered the flan, bread pudding and the tres leches cake.  One thing that absolutely stood out was the tres leches cake from Yuca Bar.  This cake tasted authentic, fresh, DELICIOUS and AMAZING!  As we were ready to go, the hostess overheard we were there for a birthday and he came over and asked if we enjoyed our time there.  When we looked at the bill at the end, we realized he had comp'ed one of the desserts for our birthday girl.  I'm totally coming back for the amazing desserts and the wonderful personalized service.  Ask for Carlos when you go next time.  This guy makes everyone feel like they're part of the family.  Thanks Carlos!

Initially food was fresh and hot and delivery was timely. However my last three orders have been subpar and the delivery time has become increasingly longer. Tonight's delivery confirmed for me that chop chop needs to be cut off. The salmon was burnt and the mash potatoes were cold and of a weird consistency. Delivery waiy time was 1.5 hours and though i reported to chop chop that this has been the norm recently the person over the phone was pretty indifferent. Definitely not worth it especially in light of the prices.
We found a hair in our food which happens. The waiter pulled the hair from the Sushi and proceded to insinuate that the hair was my friends. The food was not great and I plan to never return.

This is a kind of love it or hate it place.  Far from perfect.  In fact it's really bad in many ways. It's quirky, dirty, and a general hole in the wall.  It's cheap and it's good enough if you know what to order.  And it's home. We all grew up on this place.  Outsiders won't get it and who can blame them. The lines are long with drunk stoners waiting for food.  But it's always open when you are hungry. And, it's home.

This place is smaller than usual for a restaurant. You definitely need to have a reservation for the spot. It only have a few tables, but it doesn't feel too packed. The foods there are fantastic. For the appetizer, I had the eggplant parm. The flavor, texture and the presentation was all there. For the entrees I got the goat cheese gnocchis, it was so delicious. The cheese melted in my mouth with so much flavor. The server was on point with us. She makes sure everything was alright. I also love the ambiance in the restaurant, it feels so warm and lively.If you want to have a quiet and lovely night out you should really want to check out this place. I personally can't wait to go back there.
Picture yourself in a hotel bar while on a business trip. Low key atmosphere, middle Of the road food, and generous pours.

I really like this establishment because there is no place like it in. NYC. It is an experience to just walk through It and take in the sights. There are foods that can be found here that cannot be found elsewhere in the city. I suggest the BBQ sandwich, which is available at lunchtime. Just make sure you get there quick because they sell out quickly.

I really like this place and the pizza is great. I often have the deep dish pizza and Stromboli. I will say that I did go once and the pizza was not the same. However, the next time I went it was a good as I remembered.
I really do not like what I ordered, Spaguetti Marinara with Shrimps, the shrimps did not taste like it, anyway I want to come back again to taste something else as I saw some interesting plates.
Oh! I like this place, it's awesome! I stop here every morning before go to my work! )) Good coffee to go and pie)))) excellent mood for all day)))
Everyone here is super nice! It's a good place! You order at counter and they'll bring it over to your table. You can either pay up front or when you leave/return the cups.

My wife and I were visiting Burlington for work and were recommended to the Blue Cat.
