Better off grabbing a sandwich at the farm to table place and people watch.
Great (pricey) beer, with a great (affordable) bakery!

The pizza dough is delicious but the service is HORRIBLE. They never came to ask us how anything was. We had to ask for refills on water every time. They are so disorganized that we ordered a tartufo and never got charged for it. Rightfully so we should have gotten free dessert with the level of service. They also do not serve Ricotta on their White Pizza....whats that about?

Yikes!!! Never again! My friend and I stopped at this Bar while waiting for my plane home. You have to already realize that it's going to be a bit pricey because it is a bar in the airport, but for the quality and quantity of the food, the prices were outrageous. The customer service was very poor, basically our waitress greeted us with "what do you want" slapped our food and drinks down and didn't come back to check on us. The food was awful! I ordered the popcorn shrimp and ended up getting some kind of sandwich popcorn shrimp and the waitress looked at me and said "that's what you ordered" nowhere on the menu did it was it was a sandwich with 3 pieces of popcorn shrimp in it. The shrimp was also, burnt and tasteless and very chewy! My friend had the claim chowder and she said it was "meh". I wish I would have read the reviews before spending $40 here on water and a meal! Not worth it! Eat in the food court!

My boyfriend and I came her for dinner last week after hearing such great things about the restaurant. We can't disagree. Our food was delicious and the menu was great. Some of the appetizers were overpriced, but what do you expect in the city!

Absolutely there is no, yes no Apizza better than Pepe's of New Haven! Thin crusted with a slightly charred edges and bottom from the Coal Fired Oven. No matter what your favorite combination is , it is the best. My favorites are Sausage & Onion, Sausage and Roasted Red Peppers and White Pie. The atmosphere brings you back to days of yore and where many famous folk stooped to experience the Nations' best and original Apizza. There are other Pepe's now in NY and CT glad to see they expanded and are carrying on the tradition of making outstanding Apizza.

We had such a wonderful Saturday lunch at Giorgio on Pine. Before a show at the Kimmel Center, we walked over to Giorgio's-bringing 7 children with us. We received a warm welcome and delicious food, served thoughtfully and efficiently. The restaurant was very attentive to our concerns about food allergies. They specially prepared two items for my son, who is allergic to tree nuts. He loved the delicious food, and we all appreciated how the staff responded to our requests. Also, our server was masterful about communicating with the children. Thank you for a relaxing Saturday afternoon in the neighborhood. We're coming back for the pasta primavera, the gnocchi and the kale salad!

Madira's is the shining gem of Point Breeze!  This bottle shop + bar combo has one of the greatest beer lists I've seen on this side of Broad Street with 18 TAPS!  The prices were excellent: a PINT of Southern Tier's Pumpking for $7!  I cannot talk up the beer and liquor selection enough, not to mention the food.  Classics like cheesesteaks and wings grace the menu along with some Indian favorites. (The samosas and smoked cheddar saison fries were to die for!)   This is definitely my new go-to spot! In addition, the Wednesday night bartender has an amazing coat.

Most regrettable decision- I had read all of the previous poor reviews about the service and I still attempted to try them out- can't blame anyone else!! I had walked by this restaurant several times and found it to be a quaint looking little place. Yesterday was my one year wedding anniversary and I was looking for the perfect place to celebrate, nothing too big, nothing too bright, something with perfect ambience. So I made reservations at this restaurant and then proceeded to go to it a day or two in advance to check it out. They weren't open when I walked in but I felt that this could be a perfect spot for a romantic dinner and I knew the exact table that I wanted to sit at. Since no one was around I left and then I called them about an hour later- I told them that I had just been in the restaurant and would like to request a specific table for my one year anniversary and I would want to make sure that nothing went wrong. The gal assured me that we were "locked in" for the specific table that I asked for, considering it was for a Wednesday night and in all likelihood,  not busy. We started off we drinks at another location and proceeded to Russet for our reservations. The first thing I noticed upon entering was how bright the place was- they had their chandeliers on, as well as all of their overhead lights, it was brighter in there than mid day outside- lacked any sort of ambiance. Then I noticed, that although only 3 or 4 tables were occupied, one happened to be the one that I was assured of getting. The ignorant hostess then seats us at the least romantic table- large table set for 4 and crammed next to a group of cranky senior citizens. As she is taking us to this lousy table, I mentioned the table issue and my guarantee for the other table and she said she would go talk to her manager. She then disappeared for quite a bit of time- no waiter, no manager, no hostess- just left us sitting at this miserable table so that I could continue to get angrier. We finally got up and started to walk out when Miss Ignorance shows up to tell us that she made a mistake and didn't read the note on our reservations properly, blah, blah, blah.......mind you, there were only 3 or 4 tables occupied and even though a small restaurant, there was plenty of other tables for the other couple that got our table, and even a couple more small 2 person tables that she could have sat us at. I told her that she f'd up our dinner plans and walked out- after so many poor reviews on service, how are they in business?? We walked over to a wonderful restaurant on Walnut, where the mere mention of our anniversary gave them cause to take phenomenal care of us. One star because it won't let me give 0 stars!

Charming, bustling, cozy, neighborhood restaurant. The food is consistently delicious across the board. Wine list is great, drinks are great, desserts are great. Service is warm and inviting. The dining room had original art, but a homey feel to it. Just a very good, pleasant, warm dining experience.

Went to Sharkeys last night.The waitress was very nice so I thought 'great another good night at Sharkeys' I could not have been more wrong. First my daughter found s staple at the bottom of her drink. Then the food came and my burger was way over done and sour. The second one was overdone and the bacon was raw! Decided to try the soup and get wings to go.The soup was ok but when I got home and tried. the wings they were terrible right down to the watered down blue. cheese and the slivers of celery.They did take off one drink and the burger.Generous to a fault. NOT!! Then since everything took longer than I had expected I got a parking ticket!!! So a total of $115 for garbage.Do not spend your hard earned money here. But like I said at the beginning the waitress was nice!

I can't find a fault with this spot. Ambiance is classy and modern without being pretentious. Staff is down to earth, knowledgable and welcoming. The food is as local as possible. Meats from area farms. Delicious! The only reason we discovered this place was because they brought Chef Michael Fox on staff. His passion for food and pleasing customers shines through in his food. We'll continue to eat wherever he is cooking.

I have lived in the area for a few years and found this spot last week. A group of us sat at the bar and we had a great time with the bartenders, a girl and an Irish guy who were so funny and made us laugh all night! We had planned to just go for one drink for happy hour and ended up staying all night! We had a great time with some regulars too, who made us feel very welcomed! Happy Hour goes till 8, which is so great and rare! Get the Nocturnal cocktail! It is a gin and tea martini! Amazing! We had the fried pickles, lamb sliders, and 1.50 oysters. The decor is incredible. I am a designer myself and it is so obvious how well planned out the lighting and decor is. This place is definitely a hidden gem in Murray hill! Can't wait to go back and try their brunch menu out! I think they have live music on Wednesday and Thursday too in their speakeasy.

I called today at 2:48 and made a reservation for 6pm - name, phone number provided and confirmed. No record of it when we arrived. Odd. Still, they had a table available and the people who followed us in had an extra 20% off coupon. Grateful for both. It took too long to receive menus, no offer of a drink, no bread when we were seated. My order of two apps instead of a main course was clarified by the waitress 10 minutes after she took it. Still, one app was delivered early - "so other servers wouldn't take it" Really would rather have eaten my meal WITH my husband. Took forever to receive my husband's entree and my other app. Asked for the check when the meal  was dellivered - had to ask again. When it came I asked the waiter to stay so we could give him our card and coupon, get the billl processed and be out quickly - nope, he vanished  before I could finish speaking. We trotted to The Bushnell and BARELY made it to the show on time. Husband's rib eye was on the rare side, but the portion was huge and flavorful so he was satisfied. Truffle fries were great. Lobster app was ok - surprisingly tough texture but tasty. Asparagras salad was lovely. The service really needs to improve. Watching other diner's frustration as curtain time approached added to the nerve wracking experience. Step it up - theater goers seem to be your main customers!

Nothing I can add that people haven't already mentioned. - Line moves fast - Put the mysterious white sauce on your food - 6 dollars for a container of food? Say wha - Sometimes they will sing for you - Food is awesome - Best late night snack
Good for lunches. Nothing exceptional but everything you need from a low maintenance lunch is there. Pizzas are good. Pastas not so much. Service was ok.
Our group waited in the rain for over an hour, without being seated.  The host simply continued to tell us "15 more minutes," until we finally had to leave.

Beautifully cooked and presented dishes with attentive service. Eggs Benedict was yummy and the unusual herb based Brunch cocktail just the ticket for a lazy Sunday holiday morning. Not the cheapest, but justified by combining cost of breakfast and dinner!

Great spot. The food is delicious!  Really well done. They had amazing complimentary bread with one meal I had. The mussels were awesome - delectable Asian inspired broth. Excellent beer selection. Great vibe, fantastic space.

Gross, chewy bread and racism served up hot. How can you have a sign that says, "This is America -  we speak English!" when your staff doesn't understand an order unless it's phrased "2 whiz wit!" Go to Jim's.
My vegetarian friends drag me here every once and a while.  It's a good place we can agree on.  I love the pancakes and assorted butter.  I like the vintage style.  Like walking into a old diner.

It's like a love hate relationship.  One day I love this place next day I hate it .. I totally can't tell you yelper to come or not...Reason being is who is serving me...   Hmmmmm. If you want domincan food come but if your looking for a setting/ambience Don't.......... DJ is great though..

I started ordering delivery from this place (when they delivered). The delivery always took 20 minutes or less.  I really like the chihuahua dog. The chipotle mayo and some kind of cheese topping make the taste perfect. The fries are pretty good too and you can chose from a bunch of dressings they have. You might need atleast 2 hot dogs for a meal as they are kind of small but really good, I have also tried the michigan dog which was fine too.

I have heard so many wonderful things about this place, but my fiancée and I were thoroughly disappointed.  Putting aside the high expectations, there were many issues. First, it took a long time for anyone to come and take a beverage order even though it wasn't busy.  That's fine, but then after we put in our orders the appetizers and entrees came out so fast we didn't have room on the table.  Second, anything that they claim is chimichurri is a half-assed version.  Half the ingredients are missing.  The "crispy pork" is crispy because it's been sitting and drying out.  We won't be coming back.
I love this place the food the atmosphere awesome I especially love the Churrasco  my go to favorite. Its really a special place.

Wow, great burger and Stuffed Burgers! Love the concept ie fast food made with some care and attention and made with real food. Nice ( but a bit scary ) touch adding the calorie values against the good. The fair Stuffed Burgers which has coffee in it is amazing! Hey it's a holiday a small indulgence is OK

This place is great for quick-serve healthy dining. I have been here several times (trying to make my way through the menu) and always leave feeling energized. So far I have tried the fish tacos (favorite) , balkan burger (love the slaw!), mahi curry (curry done right), basque shrimp (tons of flavor) and midtown chicken (excellent, filling salad). The dishes are well thought out and balanced. Highly recommend.
One of the few places you can get a gourmet meal after 11pm & find parking. I come for the salads but their brunch is good too! Try the Bloody Maria's !!!

Just went to Café Matisse for the first eime on recommendation of a friend.  Boy was she right; I took my wife for our anniversary; we both really enjoyed the excellent service and super elegant, well prepared food!  Wanted to sit out in the garden, but was getting chilly this time of year; got to return late next spring.  Portions weren't as big as I might have liked; but what we ate we sure enjoyed. Baked desserts were nicely done up, but didn't taste any better than the fresh baked at my local diner.  Brought our own special bottle of Italian primativo, and they were happy to open and serve it to us; even asked us questions about what we liked about it, and if we'd recommend it to others.  Will definitely return to Café Matisse; but only if I'm not so very hungry !

I'm probably biased because I lived in NY for most of my life & know what good Italian food is like. Bruno's is not it. The food, portions & service have gotten progressively worse in the last 5 years. The owners & adorable waitresses are great; but everything else leaves so much to be desired. The chicken parm hero is served on French bread!! The chicken cutlet is pancake thin & the sauce is worse than Ragu. Adding insult to my chicken parm injury is I actually called back!! The 1st time I was left on hold for 13 minutes. I should've known. Now I know I'll pay the $13 to go through the tunnel. Sorry Bruno's- I miss good Italian food.

Food is very good.....BUT servers are another story....there isn't an host so when you enter --you stand at door at least 5 mins  before someone acknowledges your presence.....girl at counter just does her work and doesn't look up....after being seated a menu is placed on table..no explanation or suggestion....2nd cup of coffee is hard to come by.  Kafe lacks ambiance and courtesy.....
The atmosphere and the food is amazing. The restaurant is decorated with beautiful lanterns and rustic elements. The food is  authentic thai dishes.

OK the food is good, but the service kills this place. The bartender and waitress just do not care or remember anything. It took 3 tries before we got our second round of drinks and I am a very patient person. Also had to literally chase the waitress down any time we needed anything and even then it was a 50 50 chance. This place needs a good staff and a manager that's paying attention immediately.

After hearing and reading rave reviews about the Boil, I had the pleasure of dining there last night and it did NOT disappoint! They seated us promptly although the restaurant was crowded.  They provided us with bibs and plastic gloves, which was a thoughtful gesture on their part because eating the meal can be quite messy. We ordered Catfish basket, Chicken Fingers basket and Southern Fried Chicken Wings appetizers.  They were all good, but the Catfish basket was, "slap yo' mama good!"  They were lightly battered and fried to perfection!  They were light and melted in your mouth!!!  The Catfish basket appetizer was out of this world!  I definitely will order the Catfish basket as an appetizer from now on.  The Southern Fried Chicken Wings were okay.  They were soo hot, they should have come with a caution, "do not handle while hot!"  The fork used to eat the chicken wings with melted, yes you read right melted! I dined on 2 lbs. of the most succulent Snow Crab Legs with an ear of corn and new potatoes served in "the Boil Special" sauce (a combination of garlic butter, Old Bay and Lemon Pepper sauces).  The sauce is thick and quite tasty.  My son dined on the combo of 1 lb. each Crawfish and Shrimp.  He shared some of his meal with me; the Crawfish and Shrimp were excellent! If you are looking for an authentic seafood experience, the Boil is the place to go!  I highly recommend it!

This place is by far one of the best local Chinese restaurants. Their food is fresh and tastes great. None of that sub par food here. I often do pick up and the food is always great. They have been around for decades and it definitely shows by the quality of food.
Delicious!

I see that a lot of people rave about this place. Sadly my experience wasn't so great.  First the surrounding area is a dump, but that can add to the charm... if the food is fabulous. Upon entering the restaurant, the dim lights and outdated decor seemed so gloomy. No tablecloths, cold tables, dated drop ceiling and ugly colored walls. It just didn't feel like an Italian restaurant should. I was hoping for something a bit more cheerful, perhaps some decor from Italy,  classy pictures, some plants & flowers..make it feel like I am in Tuscany.   Moving on, the waiter seem confused and it took him awhile to find himself. Finally when he came to my table,  I ordered the chicken Francese and that was disappointing. It was more like chicken in a bowl of soup. Wayyyy too much liquid. That dish is only supposed to have a light bit of sauce on the dish not a bowl of liquid.  I asked the waiter why the cook made this wrong. He said, that's is how they make it. Okayyyyyy then. I had Tiramisu for dessert. That was another let down.  I then asked the waiter why this was made wrong as well. Who puts crappy icing and color birthday sprinkles on top of Tiramisu? If it is made correctly- it does not need anything, it should just stand on its own accord. I posted the photo of it from their own website. You can clearly see what I am talking about. That was my experience there. Unless they change up that decor and learn to cook and bake correctly, I won't be back.

This was my second dinner at Mominette.  At the first, I just tried their burger frites, which was quite good, but not something to review for Yelp.  I returned with husband, daughter, and daughter's roomy the other night.  On the whole, the food was good, but the vegetable sides were all treated the same.  ("Would you like some kale with your garlic?")  The duck confit was a little bland.  The shrimp special appetizer in a light cream sauce with tomatoes was quite nice as were the mussels.  ("They were smallish, but they were good.")  The branzino special was good, but not exceptional, and the accompanying risotto was excellent.  My daughter's roommate pronounced the boeuf Bourguignon terrific.  The desserts -- creme brûlée, chocolate mousse, and flourless chocolate cake -- also were excellent. Service was cheerful but disappointing.  We were sitting at two wobbly tables.  The server fixed one but not the other.   No bread was brought to the table although our appetizers had sauces.  We were not asked if we would like another round of wine.  And, most perplexing was the veggie burger and frites.  My daughter had been here several times before and had enjoyed it.  This time, the burger was extremely heavy on the sun-dried tomatoes, rendering it almost inedible.  She forced down less than half and asked the server if they had changed the recipe.  He assured her that they had not and that was that.  He did not offer to get her something else.  Just dropped the subject.  Also, having learned that she had ordered and enjoyed it before (read: "regular customer"), he should have comped her.  He did not. The restaurant had a decent number of diners, but by no means were people beating down the doors to get in.  It's not great business to treat a regular customer in such a cavalier manner.  There are a lot of terrific new restaurants springing up in Bushwick, just clamoring to please new customers.  I don't think I'll be back to this one.
I love Moe's Hot Dog House and here was even better. The lines were huge but it was worth it. I got the shack burger and it was amazing. One of my favorite places to eat.

GREAT new neighborhood bar! My boyfriend and I went in to grab a burger and a beer and ended up staying longer in one night than we've stayed at the previous bar collectively. Great food, great service, great atmosphere. Can't wait to go back!

I love this place!!! So cheap & food is good !!! But don't go by weekend! Have to wait forever!!! We been waiting like more than 30 mins to get the table! And one thing not good is they gave tables to others after us..... Cry cry cry :( If no need to wait ! This place is good ! Cheap & Good foods

The wife and I came here March of '14, just a few months after having visited Thomas Keller's French Laundry.  We were in town to visit friends in Brooklyn but ran into my wife's colleagues as well ; to dinner we went. Honestly, having visited Ink in L.A. + TFL that same year the bar had been raised for me somewhat (...although we don't eat out that much and tend to cook most days of the week, and are by no means connoisseurs of dining out or anything like that...) WOW... What more can I add to these reviews really? impeccable service, on-point cocktails, unpretentious high-end dining at it's very finest.  Been to many alike but this place takes the cake in terms of staffing / service. Guess these city folks know what they're doing. Hats off to the pastry chef. Outstanding.
Had a wonderful tasting-menu meal here! Consummate service; best use of pomegranates in a savory meal I've ever had; best hummus; and to-die-for honey cake bread pudding.

Disappointing food and service.  On a recent visit to the Farmacy, we ordered tofu scramble and received a large plate of fried potatoes with a small amount of tofu on the side.  I ordered decaf and questioned the waiter about whether it was actually decaf, which he said it was not, then changed his mind.  Smoked salmon came with only two very small pieces of toast, and when we asked for more, there was a long wait.  There was no attitude among the staff of friendly, helpful service. Living in the neighborhood, we have long wanted the Farmacy to succeed and been regular customers.  However, after the last experience, I do not plan to go back anytime soon.  Elaine Fultz
I LOVE this place and the variety of wonderful foods, friendly merchants and festive environment.

From cheese steaks and Chinese food to donuts and fresh bakeries, the Reading Terminal has it all! This is the perfect place to go if your looking for something delicious to eat, and is one of the perks of Philly! You can find just about everything, even stuff for the pickiest eaters! :)

I was blessed to have dinner with a large party of new authors in NYC for a major Holistic Book Launch and I must say Villagio on the Park did an amazing job. The food was excellent and the atmosphere delightful. I will most definitely visit again. Author of "Lord I'm Not Done Yet."

Ordered a rancher pizza (chicken/bacon no sauce) and cheese fry for pickup. The pizza was okay, base was crunchy and mushy which was good. The combination of topping was  just okay, just edible. The cheese fry was the biggest load of crap I have ever had in the name of cheese fry. Definitely, I am not coming back.
I had the lamb sliders and scallops and both were A M A Z I N G!!  We had an excellent bottle of wine that was kept chilled. The staff was attentive and friendly in an easy-going atmosphere.

This place is in a small town of Windsor CT. All egg Omelets come with Grits on the side of the Plate. Tea Coffee and Hot Coca are free with any order and the Short Stacks of Pancakes are HUGE! The Best part of this place is not only are the Staff friendly, funny, and has cute women but no matter what time of day this place is Open they serve Breakfast ALL DAY! I believe this place is a 24/7 place as well don't quote me but this place is a fantastic place to be for dining if your in the Windsor area.

Pete is one great gentleman. I don't usually do small talks with restaurant staff, but Pete was beaming and super thoughtful I just found myself started chatting with him. Turns out he's the owner of this lovely place. He has a great life story to tell. I've been here once, but am definitely going back. I just wish the sandwich could be less oily otherwise the (calorie) cost of eating at this super cute breakfast place would be too high ;)
Had lunch here and all I can really say is WOW and YUM!! Best bread that I have had since Paris. Everything including the service was fantastic!
Wings are awesome & the best part is they deliver it..
Very Very Good New York style Deli!  The good old stuff at its best!

When I first walked in I thought "Oh God, this place is insufferably pretentious." HOWEVER, my boyfriend really wanted to try it and so I went along with it. Let's just say this place changed my mind! Our server was polite and knew the menu. Everything we ordered was fantastic and came out staggered, but timely! Even our drinks which were worth the $10 each. We also did dessert and I highly recommend you try the fig (or was it date?) and olive oil sorbet, it was sooooo good. A little on the pricey side, but at least try this place once!
Super friendly owners. Great blueberry pancakes and no fuss.

The restaurant is diverse from Japanese to Thai. I highly recommend the pineapple beef fried rice and general tso chicken! The girl behind the counter made my experience even more pleasant. The last time I ate here I had it delivered. The delivery was extremely fast. I will definitely be ordering here frequently!

We went here tonight. Service was okay, but my food was terrible. I got the chicken skewers which has been okay in the past but tonight it was terribly rubbery, and now I'm rolling over sick. I would expect better from a starr restaurant.

Loved it! Great atmosphere n delicious food! Loved Margie n frank they were great go there especially for them, there so accommodating. They're there wed through sat nights. Definitely a great night out!

Probably my favorite pizzas in Chelsea! They have a very large choice of pizzas that they cook in their beautiful oven! We often share some of their delicious appetizers - I really like the rice balls and calamari. They have affordable Italian wines which could be slightly more tasteful. The set-up is warm and cozy thanks to the oven in the dining room. Service is nice and pretty local as most of the waiters are Italian!

I have eaten here quite a few times. The buffalo chicken and chicken & ranch pizza are good. What I dont like is that they do not serve just sandwiches (without fries or salad). I mean I do not want to pay extra for fries and salad. Other than that good american food. Salads are pretty fine too.

My girlfriend and I live in the area and we definitely consider Pepe Giallo as one of our canteens! In the summer, try to get a table in their lovely gardens! We especially like this place as it is casual and you really get good food for the price you pay. My favorite entrees are their salmon pasta and balsamic chicken! They also serve some wine in carafe for a very decent price. There is a European vibe in this restaurant which is really pleasant! Service has finally strongly improved! As we were speaking a foreign language, one of their waiters filled twice the tip for us 2 years ago, which obviously was unacceptable!

So maybe it's not in the greatest of areas, nor does it look all that great inside or outside.  What it does have going for it is that is it hands down the best thin-crust pizza in NJ.  The sauce has incredible flavors and the mouthfeel of the pie is simply perfect.

The happy hour here is awesome, and all day on Wednesday! The whole bar & bar menu is half off. Wine comes to $4 a glass, and the pizzas which are rather large are only $5. I also got the filet minion meatballs which were just okay, and the truffle fries. Great food, great prices, and great bartenders! Will have to try for dinner service soon.

One of those nights where we had a Steak craving we found Ruddy & Dean's. I am very happy with the service & the food. The Lamb lollipop were amazing, soft & juicy. The steak I ordered was medium well but it was kinda well done. Not a big deal but very tasty. Dessert was AMAZING it is a must have. Overall I am very happy & will be visiting again without a doubt.

I must say that I'm not the biggest fan of this place. It seems to get rave reviews based mostly on one thing in particular: Xiao Long Bao. Yes, if you haven't been here it's worth it to come and check it out! It's what I would call a sort of hidden gem. One of those places where they have a something special lying around that you just have to try before you die. It's their thing, it's their appeal and it's what people come here for when they first hear of this place. But, and this is my big but (pun intended), after you've had the Bao and you're thinking of reasons to come back here for say, I dunno, something else - then the reasons are scarce. Thing pale in comparison. They are by no means terrible or bad, it's just that by the level of Bao you would expect a much higher quality menu and restaurant. Unfortunately, this isn't the case and you are left wanting more out of most every other dish served. It's a fine establishment and one that I will go back and visit gladly. It just lacks a bit of that something extra!

This is a new, large diner right off I95. I was the after the morning rush so there were only a few other customers.  Service was very fast and attentive.  I had the Eggs Benedict.  The eggs were poached perfectly with generous slices of ham and home fries. I didn't get to try any,  but the bakery items look amazing.
have lunch everyday here after work, nice place , healthy tasty ， coffee is not very good , that is the flaw.

Came here for an event on a blustery Thursday evening. First floor was PACKED so I guess it's popular with the 20s-40s happy hour crowd. We were upstairs in the "suite". Dude, the upstairs is GINORMOUS. SO MUCH ROOM. We had pierogie-type food and salad and drink tickets and so much space. The wait staff was really nice, too. I would definitely recommend Taste Venue for large parties.

Great service, cozy interior. Maybe a tad bit small. However the food was pretty bad. Cheese with honey and bread were awesome, but you can't really spoil good cheese. It's the crusty octopus, which everyone here seems to like, was bad. Burned, over-marinated and too spicy. Not coming back.
Excellent Authentic Mexican Food!!!   Hands down. The best in the area. So good!!
The cashier made my sandwich using the same gloves she had worn to touch the money that myself and the customer before me paid with. It's not that hard to change gloves before making food!!!

They make such tasty quinoa! Particularly like the days when they serve quinoa tabbouleh. Other days they serve quinoa with cranberries etc. Always run out quickly so I have to try my luck every time hoping they don't run out ;) Pizza is such a good deal. Some people like to come late in the afternoon and order a full pizza cos that's when you get a really good, I mean GREAT deal. I come back for their all-day breakfast too. And omelet. Tastes like real eggs unlike some restaurants using egg mix. Great staff too. Love the ladies at the cashier. So friendly and welcoming. Definitely one of my favorite casual dining place around campus. I'd have enjoyed myself even more if the middle section of the dining room is cleaner and without the weird smell (sometimes).
fried whole snapper and the salad everyone raves about is worth it. shrimp fried rice was good too.
Such great design, great service, and really good authentic thai food! A must if you're in the area!
nice thai restaurant in queens. i love their design and fancy style. good place for a date and dinner. the crisp calamari and duck drum are the best. try it！
Fresh and not heavy.
Horrible chicken cutlet, horrible french fries, horrible fried dough, very disappointed
Breakfast sandwich was tasty, but it came with cheese and there was barely ANY cheese in the breakfast sandwich.  We know that you just started your business, but you don't have to skimp that much.
Stick with El Matador for authentic Mexican.

OK if you want fresh juices made to order. They scoop frozen berries from the fridge right before me and put into blender, within 10 seconds my smoothie was ready. The omelet, though, tasted like egg mix or something. Just not how a nice, fluffy real egg omelet should taste.
the food is amazing and gluten free!  woohoo!  service is great!
The tacos are good tacos. They're just what you want. Everyone was really nice and funny.  They go above and beyond.

This place rocks! Definitely one of my favorite hangs in WeHa...or anywhere in CT really. For the beer lover: Easily one of the largest tap beer selections in CT, with limited edition special runs all the time. Ask your bartender or server for recommendations and they'll turn you on to some excellent beers, eg. Otter Creek's Citra Mantra IPA and Lagunitas Sucks were amazing, plus lots of other double IPAs to choose from. For the live music lover: So nice to see a thriving live music scene in the nightlife wasteland that CT can be. If you don't enjoy loud volume and a packed bar then it's not for you, but if you like being around a lot of energy and young, beautiful people then this is a great spot to rock out, dance, meet that special someone, etc. Although the crowd is generally a good mix of all ages. Also, they never charge a cover which is my pet peeve for seeing live bands around CT. McLadden's "gets it" and this is why it's always packed up until last call. For bar food, an Irish Pub will never let you down: And McLadden's doesn't disappoint. So many good choices on the menu, food quality is excellent, service is good but could be a little more attentive during busy times, eg. make sure I have a napkin and setup when you deliver my food. I'm a huge burger aficionado and McLadden's Angus cheeseburger with fresh jalapenos is just about top on my list in CT. Overall atmosphere: Somehow McLadden's achieves that cool dive bar vibe yet is totally classy and upscale. Sure it's a publick house so you can be as casual and comfortable as you want - and you'll fit in just fine - but if you are looking for a late night hookup then definitely dress to impress.

What a great experience!  A birthday celebration brought us out last night.  JR took great care of us; professional but funny, never hovered or rushed us.   We all had appetizers, entree and desserts.  Each was fantastic!  Appetizers included the calamari, spedini and the stuffed artichoke. I took Tara O's recommendation on the rack of lamb that was pistachio encrusted.  Perfectly cooked and it was delicious!  Other entrees were the short rib pasta dish, pork chop bolognese and the branzino special.   No one had entree envy! Desserts were very good and I'm not a dessert fan!  It seems restaurants like to offer you coffee and it's only ok and they don't offer a refill.  Not the case here.  Bravo Spiga! Don't miss an opportunity to try it out. Prices are reasonable and its a BYOB!

These guys are rock solid. I had them cater lunch for a 27 person meeting, and the food was delicious. Beyond that, the staff was communicative and arrived right at the requested time. They even accommodated some inconvenient receipt needs (for corporate reimbursement). Highly recommended.

I just discovered this gem right around the corner from my apartment.  The ambiance is great but the food is even better.  The selection is plentiful and the portions are perfect.  There were plenty of specials in addition to the menu.  The wine list is nice as well.  The prices are very reasonable and the staff is extra friendly.  I went back a couple days later and brought my girlfriend.  This is going to be a go-to place for us.  So glad to have them in the neighborhood.
I love the food and the atmosphere so much! I come semi-regularly. Brunch; deserts; pork shoulder: all amazing.

We went into Chowpatty just expecting to get a quick post-lunch dessert and left with $37 worth of sweets! The cashier and the employees were very friendly and patient while we took our time ordering. They offer samples on the counter so you can taste each type of sweet before ordering it. Though my family has a long history with Indian sweets, I myself don't have as much a taste for or experience with them. I've never seen samples offered in the few sweets stores I've visited in India or NYC, and according to my sister who is much more knowledgeable in this field, this is not common practice. That's why I feel that this place is especially awesome for rookies to the Indian sweet world, like me, since customers can get a sense of what they are ordering and feel safe in trying new things! Even without this detail, the sweets were delicious and the employees are very helpful. I would recommend this sweet shop!

We went for my brothers birthday.. we had a 7.30p reservation. The decor of the restaurant is nice and trendy. The girls welcoming the patrons had smiles but once we sat this is were things went wrong. The waiter we had was just rude and seemed like he could careless that a 6top just sat.. Secondly we got a bottle of riesling and the waiter who poured couldn't manage to pour evenly in 5 glasses. Then we wait and wait for more water for the table. We got 3 appetizers the octopus which was alright but nothing I would rush back for the sliders and the Greek sausage. All which was just nothing special. Then for dinner I got a grilled red snapper with a warm calamari salad with fingerling potatoes. This was troubling because I had 3 rings of calamari and a half of a fingerling potatoes. Others had the skirt steak, half chicken, and grilled branzino. All of these dishes for the price they were listed for were just weak. Never again to mp taverna.

Great cheese steak if you are in that area.. better then that Gino's place across the street who only gives you a little cut of meat.  However over priced and really not worth the trip.. plenty of great cheese steak places in the city and surrounding area.
Amazing ramen!  Friendly and professional service.
Had an ish week and have a burning need to be comforted or even waylaid by a sublime Mac and Cheese?  Find your way to Sweet Chick on Ludlow Street. Down home menu with a hipster bar.

Excellent Chicken parmesan sandwich - great value as I purchased the 1/3rd and it was plenty for both lunch and a take home for the next day. I brought 8 other people to this place and they all commented on how great the food, service and value were.

I check out the Chatni Indian Resturant yesterday for the lunch specials and I have to say there food is excellent. Made to order with option of how spicy you like it. I like it very spicy. Good sized lunch portions, great menu selection, excellent lunch prices. Check it out.
Really wish the Barnyard was better than we were told. It is a tired locals place. The food we've had is not predictable from visit to visit.

The line around the block says it all! Their pizza is to die for! WHITE - CLAM - PIE!!! What more do I have to say!?!?! Thin, crispy crust with warm buttery clams. Oh so very very good. You also must get the white birch beer. Being from Jersey, I've only ever had red birch beer, but the white offers a cleaner taste somewhat similar to a sprite or a cream soda or a baby of the two!

The price is no reflection of the quality of the food. Excellent fried rice and noodles. Just stay away from wontons and dumplings. The skin is too thick. Nothing like the authentic dumplings you'd taste in Asia. But when I crave noodles or rice dishes, this is the place to be.

As a beer guy who spends hours a week searching out the best places to find and enjoy beer my expectations run high....Rattle 'n' Hum never disappoints. From one of the best and most complete craft beer lists to the quick service even when it is packed, this place is a must to get to and enjoy! Be back soon for sure!

The pizza is excellent (the crust especially) but I can't give a good review to a place that charges $3 per topping.  If I want pepperoni, then an additional $3 isn't a big deal.  I tried getting peppers and onions, though, and each one cost $3.  That is an additional $6 for peppers and onions.  Had I wanted mushrooms also, that would be a total of $9 for 3 veggie toppings.  So, for a pizza place, their toppings choices are not only lacking, but extremely expensive.

I tried Koch sandwich artistry 14 years ago. Hands down they are the best in West Phila I live out of state now, but when I come to Philly , I must have a sandwich from Koch. The wait in line is worth it for a truly delicious sandwich..

I don't get the hype. Maybe I didn't use enough of that white sauce but this place is just 'good', not anything superior to other middle eastern places selling the same dishes. The line does move pretty quickly because of their efficiently, so that's a plus. Price is also decent for the amount of food you're getting. I'd come back but it really is pretty average tasting.

Stumbled upon this corner tavern and what a great place! Michael the bartender makes great drinks, and everything from kitchen is fresh and made from scratch. We had the ckn pot pie which was insane. Took me right back to a pub in liverpool called flanigans. Also had a deep fried sour pickle blt with slaw. Lucky find, glad we stopped.

Came here more than 5 times over the past two months. Love the interior design, basement in particular, at first. The food isn't bad, just not always up to standard. The female owner from Taiwan is particularly unfriendly, which turns me off. There are more welcoming Chinese restaurants making better tasting dishes in town.
The food was excellent! Had the Sardines and they were awesome, and the mushroom pizza was the best I have tasted! Great service and a cozy atmosphere.

We had a Groupon so we decided to try it out. The food was nothing that would draw me back.  We got the Signature  Smoked Wings to start that had a nice flavor and the dipping sauce was tasty.  My boyfriend got the baked mac and cheese which was pretty cheesy.  I got the fried chicken but was not a fan of the coating but really enjoyed my mashed potatoes.  The fries were mediocre and a bit bland and the onion rings were beer battered and not impressive.   Sadly, our server made the experience unpleasant. I was originally annoyed when I asked if the Groupon would cover non-alcoholic drinks as I was not interested in beer or wine.  He ran through all the options of alcoholic drinks and then said and yeah soft drinks.   He brought the sauce caddy when our food had already been out for a while.  Later, he brought us a box for leftovers and disappeared for 15 minutes without bringing the check.  We asked and had to wait several more minutes.  He then disappeared for several minutes before taking our card.  I understand he serves more than one area but if we are asking for a box we are obviously ready to leave.  Even with the live band it was not that busy to require that much lag time between steps.   Overall, I would recommend going with a Groupon but I would not go back.

A horrible experience! The service was so arrogant and the waiter was not only rude but even aggresive. The waiter dropped a burger on my friends head and he got his hair filled with mayonnaise and really bad stains on his shirt and trousers. The waiter screams you should not have turned your head its your own fault and runs away. We have to look for another waiter who says what am I going to do about that. Totally unacceptable. If there is a mistake it can happen to anyone but the attitude at corner bistro is unacceptable. Another couple had a horrible experience as well and also just left. Seriously dont go here there are so many other places around.

We came here for the first time about 6 moths ago...and have been coming ever since! The place is in a location that seems to be "cursed" in that nothing seems to last there. I hope that this place makes it! The manager is a very kind & friendly gentleman who greets us with a smile every time. The food is also very good!  Some things are better than others, sure...and the bread is not gonna knock your socks off. But everything's we've ever had has been fresh and tasty. The service is what stands out to us here...we feel like our patronage is truly appreciated whenever we go there. A far cry from the apathetic service we get at so many other ristorantes...where we feel as if they couldn't care less whether we come back or not. Bonus-the decor is adorable!!

After growing up in New York City I was excited about the possibility of a NY style pizza in the area. They boast its "authentic" but so far from it. Cardboard crust, hardly any cheese...very disappointing. Bought a few pies home to have with friends and was so embarrassed by the quality and taste. What a rip off!!!
Mushroom ravioli was really great. Fair prices for the city. I'll be back!
Amazing!!!

I Love this place! Best pizza in my area hands down! Amazing buffalo wings for a good night of watching football! Salads are huge and delicious, as well as most of the food here! Oh and the burgers are amazballs! You'll never get skimped on the alcohol in your drink here, so beware if your driving these drinks are strong!!

This wonderful chocolate oriented restaurant was a delight! The food was amazing, staff was very nice and polite. I went on a Thursday and it had many seats available, so week days are a good time to visit. I'm rating this place a 4 / 5 because of the prices, they were a bit high but the food was great, absolutely delicious, it was just perfect! We got dinner, dessert and two hot chocolates and the bill came out to over $60, so if money isn't an issue and you want an amazing dinner and dessert, definitely make a visit out to Max Brenner!

Awesome drinks great food. Today I had the junkyard fry bread and harvest moon margarita.  It was my first time having fry bread it's almost like a Mexican pizza. Delicious! And the margarita is great for the season...apple and ginger yum
this place is amazing! Went for dinner & happy hour They could work on the lighting, its dark. Other then that the food was amazing. Had the chicken and the yucca burger.

Terrible service! We went there with my two small kids and they had us waiting for more than 40 minutes in the cold. All that time they had two empty tables that were meant for "4 adults or more". They could not possibly sit us there cause those were the rules... Absurd!!! We ended up leaving when after 40 minutes they gave one of the seats to people that just got in. So disappointing.

This review reflects my more recent experience here. Sometimes their pizza is the best in town by far, but lately its been doughy, the oregano is spread unevenly, and I think they might have changed their cheese to something lower quality. That said, their sauce is fantastic and when they are on their game you get a great pie and great service. I'll go back soon, but hopefully they figure out how to make their product more consistent because I'd really like to be able to order the pizza I got the first few times I went!

One of the newish ninth-circle-of-tourist-hell-holes in Flatiron. There goes the neighborhood, which is too bad because the park next door was so nice and relatively free of tourists Avoid this over-crowded, over-priced tourist trap at all costs (except if you need to make a pitstop--bathrooms by the books).

The curry is flavorful, and the katsu was nice and tender/crispy. The serving size is pretty big, and it wasn't even the Grand Slam. Definitely would come back to try out all the different curry and toppings

Loved it! This area needs more Korean food. If you've never tried Korean food, you'll be impressed with the new variety. I went for lunch and had the lunch special. Korean restaurants are the only that give free starters, and they're great. We got pickled cucumbers and seaweed, an egg dish, kimchi and another spicy pickle dish on the house. I bought ramen and my friend got a bulgogi bento box. I thought the bulgogi bento box would be a lot smaller since it was a lunch special and because it was lunch and less expensive but it was very proportionate with the box completely full with a great mix of genuine Korean foods! The ramen was also very good it was not like any other ramen I have had but I added dumplings to it so it wasn't too plain. Finally, we got Thai Tea Bubble tea and it was the best bubble tea flavor ever! Loved my time here, will definitely come back even for dinner to see what it's like.
I LOVE this place! I've ordered and ordered countless of times. The sushi is soooo good  try it you won't regret :)
All in all my favorite restaurant in Philly.  Great prices, great service and great food. I recommend the spicy fish
I've ordered take out here twice and best Mexican food in the area. Prices are reasonable.

Very nice experience! Food was great! I had the shish kebab and it was delicious.  The hummus with the Turkish bread is a must try! The restaurant has a very nice ambiance and the waitress we had was very nice and made excellent suggestions. Definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to try Mediterranean/Turkish food!

Me and my friend made a reservation for today brunch at 3:30pm for a party of 2. We were seated around 3:50, but it's not too bad. When our drinks came, the server spilled the entire glass of apple champagne on my back, my scarf, jacket, and my bag. They did apologize, but that was it. Jeana (not sure if she's manager) offered to pay for the dry clean, and she'll bring me her business card, THAT, never happened. Asheley, our server on the other hand, only checked in once soon after the incident. Note that during our entire brunch stay, NO ONE else came to check our table see how we were doing, but they did check in on the table next to us. Also, after we wiped ourselves dry with paper towels, no one came to clean those up. So pretty much me and my friend ate with a bunch of wet paper towel on our table with our food. Totally made the day "better" for making me all wet in this 39 degree weather.

Ate breakfast there, weak coffee, had to send back the runny omlet to be cooked more, cormed bef hash was right out of a can, NOT fresh as the server had specifically indicated and service was lacking won't go back.

A great Austrian flavour in Manhattan. Cozy and friendly athmosphere, you would not imagine how that little kitchen could surprise you. The staff is very attentive and ready to advise on your choices even on weekend nights when the place is really packed! They go out of their way to make sure you are happy and have everything you need. Food quality is impeccable as is the service. Wide choice of excellent European wines and beers, also great cocktails. Worth a visit whenever you are in town. If you have to wait for a table go have a nice cocktail half a block up on C at The Third Man and they will call you when your table is ready.
Walked in at 11 on a saturday. There were 10 open tables but was told they wouldnt take walk ins because their computer was down. Absurd. Will not try to come again.

In love with this place!! Everything, salad, sandwich, pastries... Tried almost the whole menu (even if they just changed it for winterish dishes) and I can't get enough of it! By far the Memo burger is the best burger I've tried EVER but other classics sandwiches like the "Chicken cashew" or "Vietnamese wonder" or the new "El Chamo" (really really good) are ALL worth the try! Really quality food! A 5 stars for the super friendly staff and the on point delivery (never had to complain about a thing)

Absolutely love this place and have been going since I was a kid.  Lunchtime is pretty hectic but they have such a variety of vendors that you don't mind the crowds. I started a tradition with my granddaughter and she and I travel down the day before Thanksgiving, pick up some baked goods, have lunch and then hop back on the train.  I love when family comes to Philly to visit because this is a place they always want to stop at.

Awesome experience...It took me 40 mins to decide to figure out what to order ... Place is a perfect outing on a Saturday afternoon where you'll eat a nice lunch and wrap up direct from the farmers groceries! Loved it ...highly recommend!

Great place to shop for food that is fresh, delicious and quick service. Desserts of all kinds from baklava to home made chocolates, wonderful, wonderful, wonderful. Parking is a problem. Wish they were open till 9 pm.
fantastic

MICE! ON 2 OCCASIONS! This used to be one of my favorite cafes for light food and coffee/dessert until I saw a mouse staring right at me from the back of the seat/bench where I was sitting last night (right by the fireplace and the area where they keep cakes and staff handles dishes). It was in no hurry to leave, obviously not afraid of people (bad sign: no cat, no exterminators here to instill fear in their bones; also the mouse was small meaning there's probably 8-10 of its siblings and parents roaming about the premises). The waitress was in the middle of taking our dessert order and went to get the manager. The manager came and apologized, said they just (supposedly) plugged the holes downstairs but the mice keep coming back. "It's NYC," that was his excuse. Since we really like the place my friend and I didn't make a big stink out of it; the manager said the meal was on the house; the waitress came back and took our dessert order. I was shocked when she came back a little later with a check for $7 charging us for the dessert! I thought it was extra cheap of them to charge us for the dessert (the tiramisu by the way, was defrosted, still slightly frozen in the middle and not as good as it can be found in most other places) and I told her so; she pretended she didn't know what the manager told us (but somehow she knew to charge us only for the dessert) and went back to speak to him. After a long discussion with him ($7 was apparently a huge amount of money to him!) she came back and said "it must've been a misunderstanding, there's no charge." As we got up to leave, the cafe was quite empty at 2am, but the manager purposefully turned his back on us and the waitress did the same so they wouldn't have to say goodbye to us. I couldn't believe the attitude! They are lucky we were in a good mood and I didn't scream at the sight of the mouse as many women would've done in my place, and they don't even say goodbye?! The attitude shouldn't have surprised me though because I'm a regular customer here and have brought various friends here but the owner/waiting staff never show any sign of recognition (except for one waitress) - a huge difference from my other favorite place, Macondo, where they treat me like royalty every time they see me. Also, this was the second time I saw a mouse in this cafe; the first time I saw a mouse in the garden (also hanging around, not in a hurry, freely roaming between the tables and customers' feet) was this spring; on that occasion the waiter said the same thing: "it's NYC, they come in through the garden, we cannot do anything" and didn't even offer anything on the house. I've been finding excuses for them because I like the atmosphere in the cafe but a mouse is a mouse and carries disease and infection and people can get sick from them. I hope they clean up their act! As for the food: the coffees /cafe mocha, etc. and most desserts. and soups are very good, the pizza has very little cheese, a thick dough edge with no cheese/sauce on it (saving every cent?), the panini con pomodoro e basilico was good but a little more pesto sauce would've made it perfect. The place can also get extremely noisy with staff making tremendous racket in the kitchen/like area in the middle of the cafe by the fireplace - they wash dishes there and such; with all the cling and clang of the noise my friend and I on one occasion had to leave because she found it too annoying to have a conversation next to that.
It's a great place!!! 10/10 food is great anybody who wants to know more contact me at mcclure4027@hotmail.com

I had a good experience getting takeout from here, but delivery was an embarrassment. I called after an hour to check on it (ETD was 45min.) and was told it was just out the door and would be here in 5-10min. Twenty minutes later, I called back, got an apology and an offer of free bubble tea. I said I don't drink bubble tea but would take $5 off my order. Ten minutes later (now 90min. of wait and twice the estimated delivery time) I called back to find out they canceled my order. Yes, this means I'm writing this review on an empty stomach, hence excessive grumpiness. I think the food is decent for the price but it's definitely not worth this headache.
Went here for first time yesterday for lunch. Food was excellent and woman working there was super nice. Definitely will go back.

Called in an order for the first time. I specifically asked for chicken and cheese only on my quesadilla and three times was reassured yes that's all that comes on it. I get to the place, go to pay for my food and the total is twice that which was listed on their menu online. When I ask how that's possible they said that they were giving me the dinner price, and the other one was only a lunch price. It was not listed as such online, however, as quesadillas are only listed as a special, neither lunch nor dinner, and only with the lower price option. When I got home, the quesadillas were soggy and falling apart and swimming in some sort of liquid in the container. Worse, they were full of peppers and onions, which specifically were not supposed to be on them. They also had no flavor. When I added the salsa I requested on the side, it too had no flavor. So I ate bland, soggy, sloppy, messy not-what-I-ordered overpriced quesadillas for dinner. Never again. Even Taco Bell would've been better.

There's a pickle bar in the back. Salami hangs from the ceiling. I'm in love. They also have a lot of cakes. Love it more. I came for dinner, it was a Saturday night. I had the chopped sirloin with matzo ball soup. Delicious. Service was casual atmosphere, but it's a casual place. Marble tables, wood chairs, they have booths. It's a great jewish deli. Coming back for sure.

OH MY GOODNESS. This place is so adorable and accommodating. My husband and I come here every weekend. We just die for the atmosphere and friendly staff. I wish it was open earlier during the week so my little one and I could get lunch there more often. Try the french toast, you will NOT be sorry. It's the best french toast in the entire world, don't tell my Belgian grandmother.

Terrible... went there for an open bar and we were told it was 50 per person for top shelf...an hour before hand they called to let us know it would be an extra 15 per person which was not discussed ahead of time... the manager was rude and unwilling to compromise... we had a lot of people coming and it caused a huge amount of confusion ... would not recomened ever

I was surprised to find my server looking for my red wine selection in  the cooler, - it was not thankfully - server at the bar  doesn't know the wines. The food was OK - dishes pleasing to the eye but tiring to the palate. The desserts  were not good at all. Place is nicely done over and their patio should be popular in the warmer months.
Great food, service was very good and helpful great experience Nice decor reasonably priced
Great little pick-up spot for breakfast. Taylor ham egg and cheeses made to order and delicious every time

This place is super overpriced. $12 for four pieces of shrimp in the ceviche... $3 for each piece of shrimp! $8 for a tiny amount of guacamole. The arepas are tiny. The menu looks cheap because of the cheap arepas but everything else is a terrible value. I got the La Guyanas arepa with plaintains, avo and cotija cheese. It would've been okay for lunch but it was not good for dinner. The sangria was tasty but was mostly juice. This place was crazy packed but I am not entirely sure why.
Love this place!  Great bun bo hue in an extremely large bowl.  Reminds me of my summer in Saigon.  Btw, Pho 87 Vietnam offers free wifi : )

My husband took me here for our one year wedding anniversary and it was an amazing night. We were seated by the windows and the views are incredible. We made an early reservation to ensure a great view because we were told we couldn't reserve a table by the windows for a later time. We ordered the Charcuterie Plate and lump crab appetizer which were very good. For dinner we ordered the homemade squid ink spaghetti and 16 ounce 28 day dry-aged sirloin. Both were phenomenal. And to finish off our meal (and ensure a satisfactory food coma), we ordered dessert. My husband got a special with creme brulee and apples with homemade honey and I ordered the chocolate fudge sundae, which was amazingly decadent. The service was lovely, the place was beautiful and the food spectacular. I'm sure we will be back for another special occasion, because while it was expensive, we felt they were fair for the venue.
The pizza was good... I got the beast-master... Only problem was it wasn't worth 18.50 for a 10 inch thin crust pizza  that amounts to about 2 slices of a normal size pizza! Overpriced!!!

Best Fried Chicken in the 5 boroughs. The burger was cooked to perfection, and the bun (best part of a burger) was fantastic. mashed potatoes were better than my ma's on thanksgiving. really...everything was perfect. And I'm Asian so you know it must have been better than perfect b/c were crazy when it comes to our yelp reviews. In all seriousness, friendly staff, cozy room, and just the right blend of normal and hipster that make you feel right at home, and not some snooty falooty soho trend diner or some bushwick loft pot luck. yes...you should go

I don't think anyone is as in love with this place as I am. The best Peruvian food in town!! I swear you can put their green sauce and everything they serve! From the chicken to the fried yuca. The Shrimps and ceviche, sheesh, I'm at a loss for words.
I really liked the food although I had high expectations because of the reviews on here.

The restaurant has limited space. Normal waiting time is 1 hour - 1.5 hour in the evening. The food has its own south Asian features but it only worths one time taste adventure. Most of the food it serves can be found on the street in Thailand.
Great pizza. A bit over prized but definitely delicious. The lines are pretty long. It would be great if they were open everyday.

My husband and I were looking for a new place to try so we discovered Luke's Lobster, thanks to a Yelp search in our area. Reading the reviews here first helped our decision making in advance and knew to order extra food because we were starving. We ordered the Noah's Ark combo, along with 2 small cups of soup (the New England clam chowder and the spicy crab bisque). Everything was fresh and flavorful. The rolls themselves are small but the amount of seafood is pretty filling. My husband found a stray piece lobster cartilage but fortunately, it was large enough to easily pick out. I would recommend going with the crab bisque if you're pairing it with something more substantial since the chowder is  hearty. Would definitely go back and have, in fact, recommended it to a friend.

If you know what you are getting in to (super long line) then you will really enjoy yourself. They have awesome burgers and "Traif". It is a little pricey but hey this is Brooklyn after all. Definitely recommended.

The place is dirty.  Look closely the meat and veggies are left outside in the alley by the kitchen, flies, bugs and dust all over it. The meat is very fatty.  Really think you are getting a deal?  5 dumplings for a $1.00?  You are getting the worst cut meat ever.  Look at your container when you are done all that grease.  So healthy wise highly doubt it.  They should be called artery clogging dumplings as opposed to prosperity dumplings.  Enough said!

Was Saxon and Parole named for thoroughbred horses? A better name would be Paddy the Pig's. You know, the sort of old-school Bowery dive where sailors went to get rolled or worse. When I got my check for five dry little forlorn scallops ($28) on a bed of al dente wild rice I felt like a rolled sailor. You'll wait and wait and wait and wait and someone may refill your water. If you're lucky in an hour you'll get your drink. My sidecar came after the first course which itself took over an hour to receive. The drink was a full inch and a half deep even in a glass filled with ice ($16). Other tables got rolls and butter. I never did, leading me to believe that was a course, not an add on. Or perhaps I was being protected from the empty carbs. Thanks for that. I think salt and pepper are also add ons, as I never received any. A green goddess salad ($13) had no dressing and no taste. The much touted ice cream included strawberry and vanilla, nothing with rum as praised in the ridiculous reviews. The owner is an alleged Culinary Institute graduate, but is really a Bunco king. I was hungry and tired and duped. Don't you be.

The problem with this place is the wait staff, who are inattentive and subpar.  They never checked on us to see how our food was (my sandwich was missing the avocado I ordered with it).  I had to get up multiple times to ask for more coffee, syrup, and for a pen to sign the credit card bill.  The dirty dishes also were not picked up from our table and we had to pile them up on the empty table next to ours.  If they fire some of the staff and replace it with happy, helpful people I would give it 4 stars because the place has cute decor and the food is pretty good.  The wait staff really takes away from the experience.
This place really is the perfect neighborhood restaurant.  When I  feel like eating but don't want to be home  I come here.  The only thing that sucks is line at brunch.

I've been there 3 times. The first 2 times they gave me the wrong order, and the last time they finally got it right but when I took the first bite half the ingredients were missing. They definitely do not pay attention to the orders.

I have been ordering take out here for many many years even before these owners.. They were always consistently good but the other night was my last time! I have been noticing the food changing along with the cooks more recently and this time I have been disappointed one too many times with the food quality but Wednesday night's awful garbage they call good Chinese food really put it over the top, my boneless spare ribs was nothing but grizzle it was like chewing plastic and rubber and tasted disgusting I wouldn't give it to my dog! To top it off the price went up but not on the menu and they didn't say shit, just charged more with no warning! Overall, the  personality sucks! You walk in and the its "yea wha you want!" The only reason I'd go back is to see the brunette babe working there on the weekends, she has the greatest ass!  I would like to go back but they really need to try something called food quality control,  check and taste the food before it goes out. Not worth it! too many disappointments.

Of all the times I've been here I've never reviewed this little gem. It's one of my favorite things about the Trenton Farmer's Market. The owners are some of the sweetest business owners I've ever dealt with and the food is out of this world. I've had BBQ down south in Tennessee and this rivals it! I'll continue to come here as long as it's open.

Huge family restaurant where the food and service were both great. Only a couple things holding this back from a 5 star: very expensive (NYC prices) and the wait despite a reservation. Enjoyed the braised short ribs and the fact that its a BYO.

The husband and I decided to eat at Chips because we heard mixed reviews about the place and figured we would try it for ourselves. I had the "two eggies" with added birthday pancakes and he got the steak and eggs with home fries and bacon pancakes..yes..bacon pancakes! The food was okay but the portions for the price it was, was pretty sad. His steak looked like something from a frozen box at Walmart and the pancakes were nothing compared to the raves we heard about them. I would call them "doughy." Things that you would see automatically added to a meal at other restaurants ( bacon, eggs, toast, homefries, etc.) were an additional outrageous charge. Needless to say, our mediocre meal came to over $40.. Next time we are craving breakfast for dinner, we will go to the cracker barrel where quality meets quantity, and surely meets the price.

It was clean to the eye.  Although the server was in the middle of the dinning room adjusting chair legs, mind you this was a Saturday night at 8pm.  Beer was flat.  I had pulled pork tacos, it was awful.  Pretty much you could have thrown the pulled pork on a bun and it would have been BBQ pork sandwich.  There was soggy rice in the taco as well.  Thinking about it is actually turning my stomach. My gf got a burger, she asked for medium and it came out practically mooing.  So it's ambiance is catchy but I would pass on the pulled pork taco and burger.

When i got there it was cold inside had to wear my jacket. I did bring my wine  with me they bring it out  plastic cups. Order baked clam they just put bread crums over and heated. Oven baked pizza wasn't cook through it was doughie  price was too much for everything . i will never go eat again.

Food is great quality and service is absolutely superb. I enjoy the modern scene of the restaurant as well as the typical family welcome. They did a great job keeping my 11 months baby occupy by coming by and talking to her. The cost does not match the food you get to enjoy from lobster, stone crab, crab legs and fresh sushi. I highly recommend you come and eat at this hidden gem
Best options for vegetarian sushi that I know of in Philadelphia. Service is always great. Love it!
Great restaurant!

For ramen, it's okay. I've definitely had better, and it's nothing to rave about, much less wait over an hour for. We came here right when they opened so we didn't have much of a wait at all. Service was fine, restaurant atmosphere is great. The reason I am giving this location a 2-star is because I've eaten Ippudo in Japan, and the quality of this location is a pale comparison to its Japanese location. I may be bias, but if they're going to carry the name, they should uphold the same quality. The broth wasn't anywhere as good and quite bland, the chashu was tough and the ramen noodles' texture left a bad taste in my mouth. The only consistency they maintain with their Japanese counterpart besides the name is the fact that they don't give refills on soda. It was a chore for me to finish the bowl I had, and I didn't even manage that. I would never return to this location, and the only reason this is not a 1-star rating is because they have a great front of house staff and atmosphere.

My friends and I usually attend Yardley inn about twice a month. We enjoy their good food and hospitality. They can't get slow at service at time when it is busy, however its understandable.. Overall we love yardley inn
Staff are friendly, pizza not that great on take out but if you eat there its delish go figure. The entrees are awsome that cook knows what he is doing.

We came to NY for the weekend and ended up coming here twice during our stay. We first came for lunch, which turned out to be very good, both food and drinks were great (and reasonably priced too). The location is perfect...near Bryant park, Times Square and fifth avenue.  The decor is much more upscale than we expected, and so when we were looking for a drink the next night we came back. The place was full, but  not so crowded we were overlooked. In fact, we were served our drinks quickly and had a great time. Next time I'm in the city, I will definitely come back.

Excellent south Indian food specially sea food was awesome. The waiter suggested Pomfret Tandoori it was the perfect suggestion as it was very fresh and tender. The staff was polite and the service was great .Will definitely go there again !
SATURDAY CLOSED. stopped by at 2pm, the doors were locked and the chairs were on the tables. Time to update the website.

We found this place via web search while looking for a place to eat before touring the Empire State Building and figured it was a tourist trap. It wasn't. The food is WONDERFUL, the service is excellent, and prices aren't unreasonable at all. The decor and music are marvelous. Definitely the dining high point of our NYC vacation. Steaks were perfectly glazed and cooked, the clam chowder was not only delicious but obviously made fresh daily, and the bacon and cheese tater tots are evil in its purest form. We'll be back.

Great food. Great buffet. I would recommend not to go for Ala Carte as the ambience did not appeal to me. The waiters who are service oriented are giving attention to the fact whether the food was served or not but not to how it was served. Myself and my wife were having a conversation and suddenly there was a dosa on the table. There was no hello,hi and no personality. Needs a lot of improvement on that front. Not a classy restaurant at all. Stick to buffet for great food.

The frog leg  experience is amazing. My first time and I extremely recommend it. I loved the frog legs!!  The fried rice was  excellent. The service was prompt and very nice. The dumpling were good, but I was unable to taist what was inside of it. The sauce helped. It's a must for "first timers."  I will defiantly return.

The best Burger  for $7 you can find.   Best space in Bushwick between the magical garden the surrounds the perfect little nook of a bar.  It's great here and defines the phrase special find.   And not mention the coolest biggest sign I have ever seen.  Just follow the light!!!!
Got the king harry classic this time. But they sautéed my basil. Last time they didn't so definitely ask for it just fresh on top!

I give this place a 3 only because the chicken is good enough to go back for. The service is sometimes good but most times less than mediocre. I've seen people leave because it's taken so long to get their orders. Sometimes it seems more like a hangout spot for the employees than a place of business.

High quality place for a good, simple pie or slice.  If you want gourmet, you have plenty of choices S Philly- this may not be it.  Style Comparable to Santuccis.  About as inexpensive as you can find as well.

Just had the worst experience ever at Peppercorns. We arrived, were seated and then completely ignored for 15 mins. The waitress finally arrived and told us "im not ignoring you, your not going to the show are you?, I'll be back when I can." We were then ignored for another 15 mins...no water, no bread or even a drink order while we waited. After 30 minutes we walled out! It was horrible and certainly will never go back. It seemed they were either understaffed, undermanaged or both.

I have never had someone raise their voice at me while at a restaurant, especially by the waitstaff, until I went to church and main. The service there is terribly slow, and when we asked to split the check the bartender yelled at us! We could not believe it. I got a yelp account for the sole reason of writing this review. Beware of the bearded bartender

Joe P. I,ve frequented all the south end giant grinder shops since the early 70's. Since this place changed hands a few years ago the "giant" in the grinder has disappearedl back to Franklin Ave too much $$$ for downsized grinder!

Logeant dans ce quartier relativement éloigné de l'animation de Mid Manhattan, ce fut pour nous une véritable surprise de découvrir ce restaurant  au cadre sympathique et à l'accueil chaleureux. La cuisine est digne de la gastronomie italienne et les prix sont  très raisonnables. Happy to give the first opinion written in French with a view to inform a larger public
Such a wonderful place!! I have been there many times and it was equally as good. they have fast deliver.
Best Burger ever! My favorite are the Tuna Burger and Truffle French Fries....perfection! Good service and great atmosphere

As a Greek in NJ I would call this my favorite Greek restaurant in the area. Service was average but the food was authentic and beyond expectations. Definitely one to add to your list if you are a fan of great Greek food. Also gotta love that it's a BYO!

We came here for girls night dinner, 18 girls!!! We were upstairs in a relaxing, gorgeous room with a fire place and candle lit tables. They accommodated  the large crowd with ease and the food was out of this world! I have been to Puerto Rico and didn't have food this good. I had one of the specials, the portion was huge and the flavor was outstanding. Although dinner was large, we kept room for dessert. The rum cake was moist and fresh. Please do not leave here without getting their coffee. I can't wait to come back with friends.

Awful! No one in here and it's a 30 minute wait to get the food once the order is placed! Messed up and made gluten free pancakes instead of the French toast... Seriously slow and the omelette wasn't even an omelette. Would much rather go across town to breakfast nook and wait in line for a more delicious meal than this!

I came without a reservation with two college girls.  They fit us in, gave us the best service, our waiter was wonderful  and the decor was outstanding.  And our food was delicious, incredible and left me wanting to come back again and again. I love this place and hope to have a reason to go back.  I recommend it to everyone!  It was amazing!

Ok quality za... Never have had delivery not be less the 60 min.. $45~ for two 14" specialty pizzas (buffalo chicken & vegetable) Only thing this place has going is the Cal-Mungo, a crazy 5 lb calzone that you need to finish in 45 min. That's the American dream, food challenges.

WOW great place!  Was in town for work and wanted a real cheese steak and this place did it in spades!!! It's a classic diner that is better for pick p orders but dose have some seating.   I sat at the counter and the service was great friendly and authentic Philly! I would say skip the cheesy touristy places and check this place out!!
