I went to sketch burger this past summer and had a great experience so I was excited to return! However, I was extremely disappointed. First, the service was very poor. Wait staff was inattentive and unhelpful. We arrived at 7:30pm (the place is open until 9pm) and were told they were all out of regular fries. We asked how the sweet potato fries were and our waiter responded "well, the regular fries are better". Not helpful considering we could not order them. It took a long time to order our food and even longer to get the bill at the end. The waiter also forgot my friend's regular milkshake. Sketch burger has also cut down it's vegan options. One of the things I was excited to order upon returning was a vegan milkshake, but they no longer have them on the menu. I decided to just order the vegan burger with green goddess dressing, but was informed they were also out of the dressing! The burger I had tasted average, but considering there are so many better places to eat in Philly with better food, better service, and more options, I will NOT be returning.
Now this is great pizza! Got the Prosciutto di Parma and it was most definitely satisfactory, isn't quite like the one under the Brooklyn Bridge but is definitely close!

Love this place, never disappointed!! The tapas are always great, they have very unique items. The bacon wrapped dates are my favorite, the goat cheese croquettes are a close second. Just don't go in a hurry because they're always packed
We very much enjoyed the Breakfast Special.  The service was great and the food delicious!

Heard nothing but great things about the food here. I was not impressed with the Alfredo which I've never disliked, anywhere and also bummed that they didn't peel the skin off the eggplant which was sliced nice and thin though, that was good to see. The cannolis were awesome, they were out of tiramisu.

If you don't want to deliver food, that's fine. But don't offer delivery in that case. Ordered at 7pm, called at 8, 9, and 10 to check in on the order and was told each time that our order would arrive about 10-15 minutes later. Our food never arrived, and we were still charged for the order. Obviously, that's mildly unacceptable.
This place is awesome! Good food, good service, cold beer, nice environment. Live bands! What a gem!!

So I get the pleasure of traveling all over the states for a living and during my time in Bayonne,  NJ, I was told to try this place for Chinese,  and I'm so very glad I did!  This places was both clean and has a friendly staff! The food which is the important piece was Excellent!  Some of the best Chinese food I've had in years!  I ordered their General Tso's with pork fried rice, and an order of Crab Rangoon. All I can say is delish!!! I ate here twice while in town and ordered the same thing both times, and both times it was excellent!  Serving sizes are more than enough and I couldn't finish it all at lunch,  which is pretty standard at most Chinese restaurants, food prep was fast.  The only meh item was their egg rolls. Tasted pretty standard and unoriginal,  though I've yet to find a place to replicate the egg rolls of my youth. Alas I continue my search.  But I highly recommend this place if your looking for some excellent Chinese food with a friendly staff,  clean environment,  and fast service! Emmm Emmm good!!! I'll be back if work ever brings me this way again!
I would give this place zero stars if I could. I had the duck confit pasta and had the worse food poisining of my life.  I went there on a Friday and here it is Sunday and I'm still sick. Beware.
Their spicy dishes are excellent.  Delivery is fast and friendly.  Good prices all around and lunch deals are excellent.

The food and service (we sat at the bar) was very good.  The place was pretty empty so we were well attended to.  We each had a burger which were both very tasty.  The cost of a drink however was outrageous. What should have been a $6.00 rail cocktail was $9.00.  The location atmosphere and food did not dictate the high price   Another thing that really turned me off was the apparent managers walked around with their hands in their pockets (literally).  They did not speak to the guests seat people or otherwise engage.  Bad vibe from that standpoint.   May go again as the food was good but will me more judicious in what I order to drink.  Good concept poor execution.

My daughter and I went here today, this is the third time in the last 6 months.  We use to be regulars many years ago.  The Dim Sum was not very good.  It has consistently been cold all three visits.  There is nothing worse than cold Dim Sum.  It seems that they don't believe in heating their carts like normal Dim Sum places.  We usually wait to be seated in the main room, unfortunately we were short on time and had to sit in the East room.  This was worse because the cart consistently get directed to the main room, then come in the East room.  They usually come in mostly empty and ice cold.  I am done with this place.   What was good- the sticky rice (wrapped in leaf), everything else was horrible.  This place changed hands many years ago and has never been the same.  Also, don't order the soda (and never never order a mixed drink) they kill you on price, stick with the tea. I think from now on. I'll just head to Chinatown for some soup buns instead.

This place is absolutely horrible!!!! While visiting New York, my girlfriend and I decided  to try this restaurant after all the amazing reviews. We ordered 6 of the pollo taco con tado, with everything except avocado, due to my severe food allergy which I expressed vehemently. After waiting over an hour for delivery, the food had arrived. Needless to say they put avocados on all 6!!!!  I immediately called them back and expressed my concern for the fact that they put avocados on all our tacos when I repeatedly asked them not to. They said they would send out more without avocado, so I agreed and waited. I waited an hr then called back again and they said they were coming. Well, after about another 3-4 hrs it was obvious they weren't going to fix/replace my order. I would never recommend this place, Especially if you have food allergies. If I could I would rate them -5 for such horrible service.
This is the perfect neighborhood brunch spot. Good food, good service. Quirky french decor. Even the waitress had a french accent :).

Awesome tapas! I went this weekend and shared 4 plates among 4 people. The vegetarian tapas platter is AWESOME. there are so many flavors and textures, all of them done beautifully. The fried artichoke was my favorite. the braised beef dish was also amazing, plenty of flavor. the waitress told us that it was Spanish "comfort food" Reservations are REQUIRED; I saw them turn away people for not having reservations. I made a reservation for 7 and was seated by 7:10.
While I enjoyed the food immensely, the service was just a-ok.  Not giving up on them just yet, the food is just too good.
Checked this spot out for HH.  Generic bar, generic food, slow service.  Two stars for being one of only a few options in the area. I like the newer midtown outpost better.
Wouldn't take coupon they put out. Shame because the food is ok especially pho and rice

Don't know if I ate on a busy Sunday afternoon or chose the wrong dishes but this was the most tasteless meal I've had in this city. The baby ribs wss still ok but the steakburger was awful and so was the thick cut chips. Really disappointing

I've been here 4 times, ordered something different each time and it is ALL DELICIOUS. Get the chicken and waffles, they are to die for and worth every penny ($20) The portions are huge and the food is very rich in flavor so do not hesitate to share plates. Mac and cheese trio sampler is a must. All of their soups are great. Barbecue chicken sandwich and blt are also delish.
Great food. Huge portions. Hummus and babaganoush were excellent. They gave our table a free bottle of wine and a free round of desserts.

The food ranges from OK to superb. Avoid the pork and beef options, and steer towards seafood options. The sashimi platter is always a great option. The dessert options here are also very nice. The decor is nice, but the service is lacking for such a nice japanese restaurant. The staff can be abrupt and lackadaisical compared to your traditional japanese restaurant. Which is unfortunate, because otherwise I would feel like I was transported to Japan every time I come to this place.
Nice place!!! Tacos we're delish, but a bit over spiced . But my girlfriend loved it. We'll come back.
excellent cocktails.  never tried the food.

Outstanding place for dinner. We have been there several times with a bunch of friends, averaging between 8-12 people each time. The owners always greet us with a smile and treat us like family. The food is always delicious no matter what we order. The cornbread is out of this world; by far the best I ever had. The servers were also the best. A great BYOB restaurant tucked into a small Hightsown corner building. Go try it out, you won't be disappointed.

Excellent top to bottom. Visited last night for the second time, my wife and I snuck in last Sunday for a quick bite but last night we had 8. Waited for a short time after our reservation but was given prosecco while we waited and a meat plate when they seated us and they apologized throughout the evening. My experience with the menu was the same both nights, on par with Port Chester and Westport. We had 4 pies, the the burratta was a stand out along with the guanciale. The garganelli and linguine with clams were both outstanding and pasta dishes. Love the local craft beer offerings too. Service and professionalism is top notch as usual. Very excited to have them nearby and love the location.

New to the area i had to go to the renowned spotted pig for the burger and shoe string fries. I arrived and was sat right away, however my waitress seemed more busy chatting up the bartender than serving me. I waited patiently with great anticipation. I was disappointed to find out that there was no other cheese substitute for blue in house. I hate blue cheese,but decided to trust the restaurant. The Fries where amazing and crispy, but the burger was borderline inedible being smothered in a pound of blue. I scraped as much off as i could however the residue remained. I definitely won't order the burger again and service could have been more attentive, but around me I saw tons of other dishes that will bring me back.

A group of six of us went to Talk of the Town last night. It was fantastic! Super friendly service, delicious flavors, a number of things I'd never tried before. We let our server order for us, so I'm not sure of the names of the dishes we ate. But we finished off with homemade mango ice cream that was phenomenal!

I've been to this restaurant many times but I must admit what keeps me coming back is the bar. Stopped in last night and as usual the bartender was personable and made awesome drinks. There were six in our party and everyone remarked on the quality of the cocktails. While there we ordered appetizers and as usual they were delicious. Keep up the good work.
Sugarburg is my corner bar -- the perfect corner bar. The drinks are reasonably priced, the weekend DJ is awesome, and the bartenders are super friendly. Ask for Christian, he's the best!

Went to Katz tonight for dinner and what a disappointment it was. We arrived and was seated by a pleasant girl who seated us. 10 minutes later our waitress decided to show up. The place was not crowded. We ordered soup which was cold, chicken Caesar wrap and a corn beef sandwich. Well the chicken wrap came and just fell apart had to eat it with a know and fork and the corn beef was cold. Finally got our check and paid the $30.00 bill. VERY OVER PRICED FOR THE SERVICE AND QUALITY OF THE FOOD. Now I have been there before for lunch and never had a bad lunch. I hope the new management will change things oh wait this is the new management. Totally disappointed

Spuntino has great customer service and the staff is very hospitable. They really cater to you and your needs. It's not just your waiter/waitress that helps you, management and other staff are making sure you have everything you need. The atmosphere is very romantic and rustic with dim lighting but not too dark. It's a great place to go on a date because it really sets the mood. The first time my boyfriend and I went our waiter informed us about how the menu works. We had never been to a tapas place so Spuntino was very new to us. Before we went we didn't realize that it was more of appetizer's. We also didn't make a reservation and got a seat right away. We ordered the calamari which was AMAZING, the home made mozzarella, which was good but so small it's not worth getting again with the price it was. We had three Bruschetta, the tomato and basil, gorgonzola and walnut and the house cured salmon. All were really delicious and tasted so fresh. The gnochi con cinghiale toscano was really good, it had a saucy sauce and the boar meat was really rich. If you're looking for a non oily pasta this is a good choice. The second time we went the service was even better than before. We had Michelle who was very nice and constantly made sure our wine and water glasses were full. Another employee named Court, who I think was management also provided great service. We couldn't decide on our wine so court made sure we got our change of wine. She even poured the wine very professionally showing the label of the wine. Once again we didn't make a reservation but only waited 5 minutes for our table. While we waited a waitress made sure we were being helped. We ordered the bruschetta again just the gorgonzola and walnut and the tomato and basil. Just as fresh and delicious as the fist time. The calamari, because it is honestly the best item on the menu. It was warm, crunchy, lemony and delicious. The funghi pizza was ok. We love mushrooms and cheese but there was a weird bitter taste maybe it was the cheese. It was better when it was warm and fresh out the oven. Once it cooled down was when the bitter taste kicked in. Definitely a one time thing. Then we got the pesce al cartoccio which consisted of clams, mussels, sea bass and calamari and meant for two people. It's honestly not that big of a portion that is "meant for two". All items in it were delicious but most of all the sea bass was amazing! I would definitely just get the sea bass next time on its own. The wine that we had was chenin blanc, simonsig which was a full bodied wine and was half bitter and half sweet and a little stronger than we normally drink but overall really good. Overall, we definitely recommend this place, there's great customer service and great food. You will definitely want to come back!

This restaurant is overrated.  It's basically a hole in the wall, with approximately 5-6 small tables and no waiting area for people who are waiting to be seated.  they do have benches outside, but when it's 20 degrees outside, no one wants to be sitting in the cold.  The walls appear to be well decorated, but their tables are all different sizes, different designs, almost as if they ran out of money doing the walls and the kitchen and decided to go to a thrift shop and pick up any piece of furniture they can for 20 bucks.   The one star is for the nice waiters, but the food was extremely salty and overpriced.  16 bucks for beef vermicelli is pretty pricey, but the portion was also very small and  the food was very salty.   There is also no parking from what I can see, so I don't know how they are suppose to accommodate people.  Their menu seems to change too much and if you like one item, you may not find it on their menu again the next time you come. Perhaps it's just me, but I like my food to be seasoned properly, and for 16 bucks, perhaps fill up my tummy just a little? For people who are craving vietnamese, I would recommend the more authentic vietnamese restaurants in flushing or chinatown, manhattan. Good luck to those who dare to be adventurous and try this place.
I was excited to visit this spot as its conveniently close to home. Service was awful, food was nothing out of the ordinary. I'll stick to Ruth's Chris/STK to satisfy my palette.

This review is addressed to Samantha Q, I'm sorry that you have that discomfort. But what is the point of you writing a bad review if at the end of it you're going to say the food was good. The last time I checked going to a restaurant was for the food not how big the space is. Every New Yorker knows that the best food comes from the smallest places. Thats why we all say we know this great hole in the wall restaurant. Also you have to understand that this is an authentic Italian restaurant. Which means loyalty comes first. Mario (the owner) is a great host and treats every loyal customer with respect and attention. That is why he doesn't have a manager running the place like every other restaurant in the city. You visited the place on a Saturday when 98% of Mario's LOYAL customers are attending. That is why you felt left out and needy. I have been going to il Triangolo since it first open, when I call to make a reservation Mario and his family always give me the highest attention because we know each other. Kind of like in the show cheers where everyone knows your name. Trust me when i tell you that if you become a loyal customer Mario will move mountains for you. thats how true Italians treat their family.

Avoid this place! Found a little cockroach crawling in a plate they gave us, after that they try to please me and my boyfriend by giving us a "discount" which wasn't even consider a discount. Lucky I didn't report this to the food safety department. Will definitely not be going back.

Was here late on friday night and we sat at a table with the beer tap. I dont know if I have ever seen this! You get to sit there and pour your own beers...priceless.  This place is so perfect if you want to go out but not be at a club.  I didnt eat because we came after dinner, but I will be back and try food for sure.  5 stars for beer table and atmosphere.

I came here for lunch and was quite disappointed for a few key reasons: 1. The sushi rice under the fish would fall apart in my hand upon lifting the sushi from the board (so I can't imagine what would happen if one were incorrectly using chopsticks instead). 2. Some of the fish didn't taste as fresh as I expected, and in fact one or two pieces had a slightly unpleasant taste. 3. The environment of the restaurant is just OK. 4. The waitress bringing tea would reach over my face as I was eating without even giving any warning. This made the price of the meal difficult to swallow. The one silver lining was the sushi chef was very friendly.
simply the best, great atmosphere and friendly staff

I really like the food here me and my boyfriend come enjoy the healthy food however the asian waitress is extremely rude and arrogant she rolls her eyes when being asked and expect a great tip without providing any sort of service not gonna happen!

The food offerings were very appetizing and quite extensive.  However, the service provided by Kimberly was atrocious.  Her poor service included not delivering utensils; not refilling our water during the meal and bringing the wrong drink to our table was just the beginning.  She was "programmed" when speaking with us and really didn't listen to our answers.  We waited a long time to place our order and a long time to receive the food.  She blamed the kitchen for being slow, but that doesn't justify why she couldn't deliver us utensils or refill our water?   After requesting our bill, we waited 20 minutes for her to deliver an incorrect bill.  She overcharged us for items and also charged us for a beverage that we did not order.  When we finally got her attention to explain the issues, she rolled her eyes and said "I don't have time for this now, I'm very busy."    She did correct the bill and delivered it to us in about 10 minutes without an apology.   We were so frustrated with her attitude and lack of quality service, we did not leave a tip, which is something that we have NEVER done.  We left the restaurant and she tracked us down in the parking lot pleading with us to leave her a tip.  She said she has to work two jobs and has a family to raise.  How unprofessional of her to track us down.  We listened to her story, explained the many reasons why we felt she did not deserve a tip, yet she continued asking for money.  We said we were leaving and walked away with her still talking to us.  After we got home we called the manager to explain the situation. He was very understanding and listened to our feedback and said he would call us back after he spoke with Kimberly. We have never heard from him.  Although we enjoyed the food, the customer service provided by Kimberly, and the manager, made it evident that they don't want our business.

Small waiting area. Very crowded. Waitress did not introduce herself, was inattentive, and not careful when bringing our drinks and food to the table. At least our booth was clean. The side salad was inedible. Two onion slices, an olive, and a grape tomato swimming in salad dressing. Absolutely dripping. No legitimate legumes. Made the mistake of not ordering pizza. My eggplant rollatini tasted literally like an egg-roll out of a Chinese restaurant. I was so confused on what I was actually eating. Ate half. Felt a little sick afterwards. The pizzas on the other tables looked alright---a little overdone in the oven. I don't know why this place was so busy. It's the kind of place where in hindsight, I should have asked for my money back. I won't be back.

Beware...if you order a sandwich, they charge you 1$ for bread and .75$ for lettuce and tomato, without telling. Sandwiches are terrible and staff attitude is worst then the dumb expression on their charm less faces.
I've going here since they opened and love their pad thai combo. Shrimp and chicken. Wife loves the sushi. Good family owned establishment and good food.

I bought scrambled eggs in a croissant, and when I  chewed on the egg, it felt like chewing on rubber. I threw it in the garbage and it didn't even break. I'm not even sure the stuff is biodegradable. Great if you're looking for a chewing toy for your dog.
Cozy, charming and great service.  Amazing food considering the kitchen is so small. The prosciutto mozzarella is a must!  Fun local hang out.

Excellent choices. I had  the veal chop. It was outstanding. We also enjoyed the lobseter ravioli, the pork and figs had a nice sweetness. The escargot was delicious, especially the gravy. The mozzarella was special. I will definitely go back.

Should have went elsewhere. The iPad bolted right in front of me at the bar staring me in the face should have been my clue, followed by being told I have to order everything from it. Want a drink?...fondle the iPad. Want dinner?....tickle the iPad. Where is the bar experience?...."Bartender, I'll take an IPA." There is none.  Totally cold like an ex girlfriend. The best part is after you figure out the menu on the iPad and do all your own ordering it makes you pay and asks you how much you want to tip???? Tip for bloody what? I should get a freakin discount for doing all the work thus far. Then they make the poor wait staff wear these ridiculous French looking black and white horizontal striped shirts while they spend half of their time... Guess what?.... Helping customers figure out the flipping iPad!!!! I gave 2 stars because the burger was quite tasty, but it should be since I paid European pricing for it at a European pace.... Sloooow. I don't think I heard a single positive comment out of anyone other than that the food was at least good. Kudos to the poor waitstaff though for putting up with a the griping and dealing with all the iPad problems, while serving the numbing agents and grub.   I won't be back, but then again I don't want to be at Newark airport either.

What a fantastic, fabulous and most importantly, DELICIOUS dining experience.  Oh, and the staff?  Just wonderful.   I'm hooked... from the near perfect martini at the bar as I waited for my pal to arrive --  to the homemade bread and butter to start the evening.  MOTHER OF GOD!   And that's before the yummy salads (one with apples, the other with brussels sprouts) and scallops graced our table!   I slight error caused me to miss out on the short ribs but now I have something to look forward to when I dine there again SOON.   Oh, wait ...  what really rocks the house is the crack addicting side of sweet potato/kale au gratin.  Done!  Do note that this is a small neighborhood restaurant so seating is tight and if looking for a quiet little corner to chat - it can be challenging.    But if its fun you are looking for with a great staff and awfully good food - go for it.  (The owner deserves a shout out, too.  Thank you Mr. Marshal)

Good diner food with very good to excellent service.   Wait people are friendly and well versed in menu items and go out of their way to please customers.  Like their soups and burgers. Their dinners are a generous size and tasty. Have enjoyed many breakfast dishes there, such as French toast, pancakes (many flavors and seasonal), bacon, scrapple, etc.  Tempting dessert display!
Best best best food in town specially there burgers and panini mind blowing too good.
HANDS DOWN my favorite place in North Newark! Good food, nice staff, and close to home.

so the crostini was really awful, something on it was just very cold and on a hot crostini it was really off putting. if the prices were a little more friendly i would definitely come back to hang out and eat oysters, the space and ambiance were very inviting to hang out sessions.

I used to love this place until one day my daughter  inlaw and I went in for lunch so excited because we had eaten there before and the food was very good and it was fresh ,after placing our orders we notice   the cashier picking in her nose over 4 minutes and then she went over to where the food was being prepared that was it for us  we were done after that  so we cancelled our meal and we left

I tried to buy my Dad a gift card to Scannicchio's to use before a Flyers game and was told that I would have to come in to purchase the gift card due to "previous bad experiences". I told both the women and gentleman I spoke with that I live out of state (over 3 hours away) and would not be able to come in person and would pay postage, etc. to have it sent to me so I could include the gift card in my Dad's Christmas present. They said "it just can't be done" and that I could call back to speak with an owner but they didn't think it was likely they would "approve" it. WHAT?! When I read reviews about this being a family owned business I thought they would be HAPPY to help me out. I've done this with numerous other restaurants and have NEVER had a problem. They also said that since they didn't know me and I wasn't a regular it wasn't going to happen. WELL, that is certainly a way to deter new customers. I called another Italian restaurant down the street and my experience was exactly opposite. They were happy to help me give them my money and help me give my Dad a thoughtful Christmas gift. Cheers to L'angolo's for their excellent customer service. Hopefully Scannicchio's will consider some changes to their policies.

Would be 5* but the prices are quite high & even if you have a reservation it can be a bit of a wait to get seated. Do not walk in without a reservation unless you are OK sitting at the bar. Top class food, you are safe trying anything with the ricotta because it is all mouth wateringly good. Great wine list.

I have been here a few time and can honestly say this place is one of the best brunch places I have ever been to! Everyone I have taken there has said the same thing! It's reasonably priced and all their dishes are perfectly made!

This is Hands Down the BEST " home cooked" Italian restaurant around . First , the atmosphere is so welcoming and comfortable  . The entire staff is awesome and Chris ( owner) is great. It is BYOB and everything is reasonable priced. The food is always consistent and they have great specials . I don't know if I can pick a favorite dish because I think I have had EVERYTHING and it's all good !  However I would recommend the Fusili Rustici , Chicken Parm( yes , chicken Parm out of this world ! ) and Risotto Primavera . If you have any room for dessert the toasted almond cake is the meaning of life ! And the tiramisu is homemade ( omggg) . My husband and I have been going there since 2006 . If you become a regular you are treated like family .

Soo I went into El Patron. I was greeted and given menus the typical stuff. I understand this is a Mexican restaurant; however, any and everyone can eat here, so you should treat everyone the same. I sat here for about an hour and not 1 time was complimentary nachos given to me and this was way before I told them this was a take out. The women at the front seem to care more about the young Mexican men here rather than their customers waiting for hours! I will also say that when I did ask them to possibly see how long to go before I get my order at this point that I don't care for I was ignored and then 5 mins later she went to go ask and then told Me she knows it's been a long wait but they didn't even start making my food yet bc of the large group they have! Whattttttt!!!!!?! If you know that you are currently catering to a  large group and I am ordering take out. Wouldn't you think to inform the costumer that it may be some time before the food come out; so it can be at their discretion whether they want it or not?! Why tell me after an hour later. Then they tell me 10mins I wait like a dingbat bc at this point I thought I might as well. Welp. Wrong idea I stayed her for another 45 mins. Even after this long wait. Nothing was offered as simple as nachos to accommodate my wait. I then realized that they were giving nachos and sauce out and  so I asked the waitress(if that's what you wanna call them) how come I was not offered nacho and sauce and she tells me bc it was take out however I didn't decide to do take out till 30mins after my order then she says "I can give you nachos" at this point I refuse and was no longer interested. Then of course my food was mediocre. This restaurant needs better management and learn how to cater to ALL costumers. -___-

Good things come to those who wait, and for those who wait in line at Grimaldi's, you can expect that your pizza will be just like the service, GREAT! Freshly prepared pies are baked right in front of you. You can even see the guys tossing the dough in the air as you walk in. Now that's how you make a pizza!

Needed to have a quick lunch close bye in South Philly. Read the reviews and thought I would give it a try. The Summer rolls are some of the best I have ever eaten. Fresh and tasty. The Tom Yum, soup was delicious along with the Best pad Thai. Price was reasonable and I will be returning in the future.

I enjoyed this place. It was nestled on the busy street in Winooski and walking in was like a blast from the past.  Everything mac & cheese.   It was a really filling meal.  I got the chicken parm mac & cheese.  I've never seen that much cheese before.  The Peanut butter and jelly deep-fried sandwich with fluff was so good.  Probably clogged artery. The mixed fries was the best way to go.  I recommend this place if you're looking for a really filling meal.  Not the spot if you're looking for light and airy.   Overall very delicious food.

Poutine is a hard-to-come-by, hot commodity in NYC. And f you are as big a fan of poutine as I am, then you won't be disappointed. Incredible value, you get a lot for the money and the sauce selection is pretty impressive- I don't think I've tried a bad one. Free samples as well

By far the worst experience I've ever had When an owner thinks his cheesesteak sandwich is the shit, and treats his customers like shit It results in an epic diarrhea That's what it was Poor customer service Poor manners And a very very shitty meal Keep up the attitude boys!
Good food but delivery takes FOREVER.  I was starving by the time it got here.

I believe in constructive criticism, so I will begin with the positives first. -Delicious food made with seasonal ingredients -Reasonable prices for the quality of food -Great ambiance; clean, minimalistic decor -Friendly server Everything about this restaurant seems to scream "awesomeness" so I really do want to like it. Thus, I booked a reservation to celebrate my birthday here, based on the amazing yelp reviews. Alas, I did not feel valued as a customer. Something went wrong with the reservation and I tried to speak to the owner to see if we could work it out. His reply was defensive and something along the lines of "Don't talk to me about this because I'm busy." I can empathize with his standpoint because he was understaffed at the moment and indeed busy, and the issue wasn't really his fault. However, his demeanor made me feel like I was an unwelcomed guest interrupting business as usual, and I wasn't even being angry or demanding. I would totally recommend this restaurant if it weren't for that, but bad first impressions are hard to change.
Stayed at the hotel and it was amazing

We held my daughters Sweet 16/Confirmation in the Carriage Room and we were very pleased with everything. Our contact person throughout the entire process was Anna (with assists from Shannon when she wasn't available). They answered all of my questions quickly which really helped ease the nerves of a stressed out party planning Mom! They allowed us into the room early to set up because we were the only party in there that day which was very appreciated. I admit that after reading the reviews (after I signed the contract) I was PETRIFIED that the food would be subpar but I am thrilled to report that everything was excellent. I even had a few guests comment that they wanted to come back to check out the restaurant.
Awful. Pizza was dry n cold when they delivered it. Not to mention it was an hour late

Great Bar. Creative drinks.  We use to eat here but the food leaves a lot to be desired.  They have change managers at least three times...but the drinks are great.  They change the drink menu every season and it really works.  Bartenders are great.  The waiters are great. Forget about the small plates...or the food in general.

We were here a few nights back for dinner and the food was absolutely AMAZING!!!!  We had hummus and falafel for appetizers and everything was made fresh. For dinner we had the combination plate....the meat was so tender and juicy.  We were all very impressed and satisfied with our meal. The owner was also a total sweetheart.  He was attentive and kind. We would definitely recommend this restaurant and we will be back again soon,
Its overpriced and not worth for vegetarians but the service and the ambience is good.

I thought it was a coffee shop from the window, but it turned out to be Turkish and Mediterranean cuisine! My boyfriend and I connected and are having a great, unique meal! The people are 10/10 friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend that you come here for a nice, unique meal!

This place looks cool and the food is delicious. The waits are usually pretty long.  I remember getting a cheeseboard which was out of this world as appetizer.  I got sugar chicken wings which was so delicious. Was talking about it for weeks. The next time I went they didn't have it anymore but I hope they bring it back.   Another visit I got a turkey burger which was also delicious. Overall awesome place five stars.  You can't go wrong by going here.

A very unique japanese place that specializes in hot pot and pig's feet, but also has a nice selection of other dishes.   This used to be a five star place, but they haven't been able to keep up the quality of the food since they have become extremely popular. Get the foie gras inari, avocado tofu, and a hot pot. The sake is also very reasonably priced here. Avoid the sushi (it's decent, but it isn't anything special). The grill pork belly is also very good. However, due to the lack of consistency, you might experience a wonderful meal or a mediocre one.
Solid spot.  Good grilled cheese, tater tots, mac n cheese, etc.  prices are a bit steep for a grilled cheese sandwich in my opinion but it's really close and totally decent.  Worth trying.
The White Truffle Chawanmushi was life changing.

I wish I could review the food but unfortunately I was never able to! I made a reservation for a party of 4 and when I got here I was told that the restaurant had tried to call me to confirm the reservation, and since they had not been able to get a hold of me, they just cancelled it (?). I was only given the option of waiting for another table that would open up 40 minutes after my original reservation time. What the heck? If you call a restaurant to make a reservation, then it is expected that they ACTUALLY reserve a table for the time you make a reservation?

Yayy, I just got a sausage slice this last weekend. it was fresh !! and very hot, I guess because there is so many people there they all makes fresh pies. The various and styles of pizzas u can get here is just amazing. I really wish I coud come here super hungry and try like 5-6 different slices you know? (but then it might be good option my boyfriend will kick my big ass away ;)
Service varies. Food is decent.
Delicious, large portions, get the mixed chicken and lamb. Great tasting especially on a drunk night after the club lol!

Friday night was my second experience at Brigantessa and even though the first one was pretty good, this one was even better.  Service was very good and the food was delicious.  Servers were attentive but not annoying.  I had a duck leg appetizer which I think was a special-awesome. I had the cappellaci, also awesome.  Thumbs up on the meat sauce and the (homemade) pasta itself.  I also had a slice of the Regina pie, which I would advise you to eat over the regular margarita.  I had that Regina pie on my mind ever since I saw a picture of it on twitter, and I was not disappointed by the real thing. I would be happy to eat any of these things again when I go back, but I have some more menu exploring to do.  The food is just really good, I was very happy when I left.  I had fairly high expectations and they were exceeded.  The atmosphere is nice but still casual.  I have a feeling I'm going to be a good customer here.

I went to Suzy Q's for the very first time last night with a couple of my friends. It initially  started of great with our server greeting us and appearing friendly until our food arrived. I ordered barbeque half chicken and it did not even have one drop of barbeque sauce on it, which was pretty disappointing.The waiter offered to bring me a bottle of barbeque sauce which is not how any barbeque food should be made! However, my mac and cheese was good and cheesy(minus the lack of seasoning)   What is sad is the fact that not only was I not pleased with my food, but my friends were not either. My friend ordered one of their sandwiches  which was not complete! My friend requested for it to be returned in order for the missing dressings to be added this consisted of (cheese, lettuce, tomatoes)  In addition, my friend's sister ordered a salmon wrap but she was not happy with the salmon not being well done. The server soon appeared to have an attitude with us and said: "You are killing me". For the rest of the night, he did not check on us to see if everything was okay until we were finishing eating. He also took a long time with bringing us our checks. We were automatically turned off by his attitude and performance. The only thing that I was not disappointed with was my ciroc rum punch drink. My friends and I were very disappointed with the food and service at Suzy Qs. We will not be eating there in the near future.

This place Brooklyn Star deserves ZERO stars but yelp requires a rating to post and this is how much I believe people need to know how disrespectful and rude this place is. I have never needed to review any business. I am very neutral and I give all businesses a fair perspective. But people definitely need to know about this place and how they do not deserve your business unless you want to be grately mistreated and disrespected. Sorry but this place definitely does not deserve a visit at all!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! This review is literally right after the disrespect that we just received about 10mins ago. How do you offensively be rude to all 6 of us who were just looking for food during a late night. The lady who is Caucasian with brunette hair, who said her name is "Lauren", rudely dismissed all of us and said that "you are all drunk" and told us to "get out" when none of us are drunk. How do you wrongly accuse people like that?! We were not drunk at all and we were conversing with her respectfully where as she was being extremely disrespectful and racist!!! For a person that opens or works for a business, that is just unacceptable. They were being racist too!!!!! I nor any of my friends would ever step foot into this restaurant ever again even if we were starving or dying. I believe there is so many better places to spend your time and money than this rude place with rude people especially Lauren!!!!!

Great Resturant for gluten free. Went with my wife who  who is gluten and daily free, the meals are mostly both so we had a ,lot of food to choose from. Nice cosy resturants  with friendly  staff . We also had dessert  with was fantastic.  Spoke to the owner who was a really nice guy who was very knowledgeable  about gluten allergies.  We would definitely  return soon. Highly  recommended.
Best tacos in New Haven.

We found this place thanks to YELP. It had 40+ reviews and a score of 5. That was attention enough to give it a try. The place is small, but you won't feel yourself in a box, you have your room to eat. We arrived one saturday at 15pm and it was complete so we waited a few minutes and had a seat on the bar. The owner was very kind and gentle and explained to us the menus (we're from Spain and we were a bit lost about what to eat). My GF and I had an excellent service and food. The owner took care of us perfectly. Sadly there was no cake avaiable at that moment but that makes a good excuse to come back again! 10/10 will repeat and taste the chicken wings!
Great portions and great flavor! Wish they had one in Southern California. Ceviche de pescado was my favorite and true to real Peruvian Ceviche!

The atmosphere was incredible. I don't think you could pick a better date night restaurant on 2nd Ave. Service was polite and we were sat down quickly thanks to a reservation on Open Table. Food was superb and their wine list impressed the girlfriend so I was happy. The entire night has this delicious rustic italian feel to it and if you're lucky enough to sit in the wine cellar, it feels like you have been teleported there for a night.
Amazing food! BYOB - but the liquor store a few doors down delivers RIGHT TO YOUR SEAT!!! My Ab favs apps are the pernil con tostones & the empanadas!!! Never disappoint.

Excellent Thai food at a reasonable price! The pad see ew is excellent, as are the basil vegetables. Their lunch special is particularly awesome - an entree and appetizer for only $7.50 (pre-tax).  It's a quality/value combo that's hard to beat on the UES.
I've been to quite a few chinese restaurants. This one is by far one of the best. The food is always fresh and delicious. The people are friendly. This is always my go-to for chinese food.

My wife have never been to Garces restaurant before and we left very satisfied and very full. We appreciates our server and his knowledge of the tapas and ingredients! We tried the deluxe chef tasting and were very impressed with every course offered.

If your mom can't make you breakfast, this is the next best thing. The ladies are friendly and the food is delightful!  Lemon ricotta pancakes? Meatball parm omelette? Yes, please!! There's not a ton of seating but there's not usually a wait.   You can always take it to go if you're in a rush.... Otherwise enjoy a spot at the counter!
Very good! The lunch specials are reasonably priced and they give you a large portion. The food is fresh and tasty. Very salty though, but overall a great spot for lunch.

Recently, my boyfriend and I went to Yuca for Happy Hour drinks with a married couple (man and woman) with whom I work. We had a quiet time and enjoyed drinks and appetizers. At the end of the evening, I closed my tab with our bartender, Luis. I had been happy with his service and left a tip just as I would for any other bartender. As I signed the credit card slip, imagine my surprise when Luis said, in Spanish, "Finally these f*ggots are leaving." Rather than automatically becoming upset and defensive with Luis, which would have been a perfectly appropriate response to such a hateful statement, my boyfriend, friends, and I left after saying good night. I have learned long ago that returning hatred to someone  in such a situation does not improve the outcome of that experience. I also would not stoop down to Luis's level by continuing such hurtful dialogue. Rather, I decided to contact the manager of the restaurant the next day to make him aware of what happened. Surely, the manager could deal accordingly with his employee. Therefore,  I and a family member of mine called the manager the next day. When we explained the situation to Sergei, he automatically responded with, "My employee would never have said something like that unless you were belligerent with him." I explained that this simply was not the case. In fact, I left the restaurant without causing a scene, knowing it would serve no purpose. Further, even if I had not been a perfectly kind customer or was "belligerent", being called a f*ggot by anyone, especially by someone serving a customer, is completely inappropriate. Sergei then stated that he would speak with Luis. However,  he stated very emphatically that he did not believe Luis acted in the wrong. Unfortunately, this has led me to believe that the management at Yuca promotes a sense of hatred and exclusion. This is especially surprising given that this restaurant is located in the East Village. It is clear that even though gay individuals may enjoy marriage equality in New York, we are not truly considered equal by certain people. Therefore, I no longer feel comfortable being a customer at this institution, and I will no longer show Yuca my patronage.
Takes a while to get seated, but for good reason. Food and service are great.

This place is a one-man operation from start to finish, but it's a great value for money and the sushi chef is so friendly and sincere. My husband and I swing by here whenever we are in town and I look forward to the clean and quiet atmosphere. We never feel rushed to leave and we often sit there to chat and sip our unlimited tea! :) The weekday lunch deal is amazing -- 3 rolls (18 pieces) + miso soup for $9.99. I only wished he delivered as well!
Oh my God. This pub is my favorite.... I hope this place stays open forever!! I don't know what I would do without my Shepard's Pie, Glenkerry potatoes and homemade Irish Cream!! I love Vaughn's!!!

Amazing food!! I loved their vegan sushi and mushroom. I passed by this place many times and finally got to try the food with my girlfriend. We came here on a Thursday night and were very hungry, usually sushi places don't really satisfy me when I'm starving and this was a first. The service was ok

One of the best yakitori in the city! Their lunch special is a sweet deal! My favorite is the chicken skin and enoki bacon. You really can't go wrong at this place everything is delicious. It does however get packed you may have to wait. I wish it was closer to where I live!

I really wish they had a better selection for sandwiches. The menu is hard to read as well However, the staff are always very nice and helpful, and the prices are reasonable. It's no Bagel Market, but the bagels are definitely yummy and they do have a good selection of cream cheeses.

We always buy food here to cook at home, and the sandwiches are amazing. Minus one star because it is always a madhouse and crazy expensive. They also recently changed the bread on their beef sandwiches, which ended up changing the whole flavor. But overall a great place.
Amazing katsus and reasonable price. Seating can be limited but never had an issue. Food comes out hot and fast. To go is great as well.

One of the best dining experiences I've had in Wburg thus far. A friend and I went recently and had a fantastic meal. We chose to sit at the bar to decrease our wait time. We knew ahead of time that waits could be long. So we checked in, gave my digits for the text alert and headed to Commodore for drinks. 25 minutes max and we were seated. The appeal of this place, is definitely the neighborhood feel. But that's secondary to the amazing food. Joe Carrol is the man, and this is the crowning jewel to his Wburg food empire. Highlights of our meal were the Veal Flank and the Lamb Blade. I usually shy away from fish, but the Whole Mackrel was killer. No room remained for dessert, but I'm sure it's good. Can't wait to go back. #oldguysyelptoo

The worst part wasn't even the food. It was the manager that was on that night, yelling at everyone to do things that she could have done while she sat at the corner of the counter on her phone. It was especially awful as we witnessed her yelling at the servers while she spoke exceptionally loud on her cell phone. And last but not least, her talking on the phone about some sort of personal problems at home while she was ringing customers up. At least have the decency to step outside, or save the oh-so-important conversation for a more convenient time if there is no one else the use the register. Maybe not at 12 am midnight would be the best time for that conversation. She should not be in a managers position if she can't even seat a table herself when her servers are busy, and God help us all if she is in a higher position than that.

After a mixed first impression we gave it some time before returning to Lea and were very happy with our 2nd experience. We stopped in for brunch on a beautiful fall weekend and there was no wait. Our food was good, the portions generous and the coffee bottomless.

Time for the cranky old bartender to hang up his bottle opener. Sorry I offended you by asking for a drink as you gazed off into space. Reality check, buddy, customers ask for drinks. The other bartenders are good and welcoming. The burger is one if the best in the city.   Decor hasn't changed in ages and that's a god thing. Nice place for a quiet drink and a quick bite. Avoid the Saturday night all star and you will want to go back to Molly's.
I personally love their food. It's different (must try the shrimp wrapped in plantains MUST) the steak is good and so is the paella. The place is nice and low key. I like it.

Have been going here for the past 2.5 years.  The food is good and prices are reasonable.  The lunch specials are a pretty good deal as well.  The menu choices tailored for American tastes are typical and nothing extraordinary, but the ones that are more traditional Chinese are pretty good.

Average breakfast but the pastries while you wait was nice but the wait time for service was borderline crazy. Not  the best place if you are in a hurry although they want you to go as soon as they give you the check.
Horrible service...as a former new yorker disappointed to see how this place has gone down hill.
Elegant, inviting with  professional staff. The food is outstanding: carefully prepared, exquisite flavors from the salads to the fish specials. In my top-10 all-time favorite places in the world.

Siggy's needs to rename itself from Siggy's Good Food to Siggy's Freaking AmaZING Food. My diet requires strict Gluten Free dining and Siggy's provided that with their incredible fare. My non-Gluten Free friends said their burgers were some of the best they've had in a long time and the salads and other options were just as wonderful. I had the Herb Beef Stew, Gluten Free, and wow... I went back twice because it was so good! Vegan options, fresh farm-to-table style food, and Gluten Free support... almost everything a sensitive foodie could want. Unfortunately Siggy's hours of operation mean I can't often eat here but I always try and make it here once per trip to New York (from San Diego). The fireplace in the back made for a great place to hide from the cold and snow during last year's Super Bowl week!

This is one of my favorite places in Queens.  The food never disappoints...Bacon and scallion Mac and Cheese, Sugar Hill Burger, Disco tots, Cap'n Crunch chicken fingers, and so much more on that menu.  Always AMAZING!  BYOB is also a major draw so bring your appetite and bottles.
Pizza is COLD and very poor service. Mgmt was poor is responding for Fresh Pizza.
food was delicious. place was kind of empty on a weeknight, i assume this is primarily  a "brunch" place. nice service. would go again.

I love this restaurant! The staff are always friendly and accommodating. The food is delicious and the menu is simple but diverse. I have been here 3 times now with a group of 7-12 people and every time we all left happy and wanting to come back for more. If you call ahead, ask for Chase who is a great guy They can comfortably seat 16 and "tightly" do 18 people if needed. Also, I recommend the Lamb Burger which is delicious!

I stopped by for lunch as it was close to work. I'm not sure what all the rave is about either as I didn't find this restaurant overly impressive. I ordered the skirt steak with yellow rice and black beans. After some time, I was served with a terrible presentation of burnt meat. The piece of meat was on the center of an old, worn out metal plate which was bent and blackened in some areas. It would not rest evenly on the table. On top of the skirt steak were two thinly cut circles of onion. The first plate had to be sent back because it literally smelled like a house on fire. Despite the terrible presentation, the skirt steak was delicious and the rice was on point. The steak was tender and had the right texture. The black beans were a sodium shock so I just left it untouched. The waiter was nice and attentive. Overall, I wouldn't be too excited to come back.

+ Service is top-notch. Wait staff is very friendly. + Bread is poor quality. Maybe it's just Italian bread I don't like, but the bread was quite pedestrian and tasted like it came off a store shelf. I'm glad they served it with olive oil and let me request balsamic. Olive oil was good. + Calamari was yummy - fairly large portion! + Chicken Amalfi was difficult to eat. I didn't expect that a "balsamic reduction sauce" meant that this thing would be DRENCHED in balsamic. I love my balsamic but each bite of this was an acerbic, gagging, mouthful with hints of ammonia. Really difficult to eat but I was a hungry person so I ate all of it. But I didn't enjoy it. + Dessert - they had an ice cream dessert crepe which looked really good but I didn't try it. So... I wouldn't say pasta is my favorite food, and I probably just made a misstep by choosing the Chicken Amalfi. But I probably wouldn't be going back to try their other things since everything was pretty expensive when it's literally just carbs.

Salt Alert Greeting- a women just stood there and smiled. I didn't know if she worked there or was hitting on me. The hipster behind the podium had nothing to say Vibe- Alice in wonderland meets the hobbit Price- expensive Bathroom- unisex - failure Service- friendly table turning bandits Parking- after six pm the street opens up Wine by the glass is a rip off. And the poor selections make this one of the worst wine by the glass choices in the city. $16 Beckman Cab Sav Food $21 burger with shoestring fries. The cheese overwhelms the burger. Poor choice of cheese. The bun is great, the beef is ordinarily tasty. It looks better than it tastes. Cross hatching on bun and an abundance of shoestring fries make this dish too pretty to eat. Dessert Banana toffee pie is too sweet. Flourless chocolate cake is a cliche WIGB? No Talk about over rated. This is it. You are packed in at cafe tables with mushroom stools to sit on.  The bar has a limited amount of stools. Why this place has global recognition I do not know. Anyone who waits to get i here is crazy. The burgers were so salty tonight that they would make a fish's lips shrivel. If you threw one of these burgers into the Hudson River it would turn into the Dead Sea. Another typical example of over salted restaurant food. We have sodium sickness. The famous reviews about this place are. Once again BS. $109 for two burgers, two glasses of wine,one beer and two slices of pie. Crazy!

I went with 3 old friends for some beers and the "best burger" in NYC.  It was a really good burger and the fries were really skinny very well done ( i like them that way).  1st the only burger they make has blue cheese. I like blue cheese, but don't love it. I would have preferred cheddar or something else. Blue cheese is a bit stron and you can't taste the quality of the meat. The service, once you get passed waiting for 45 minutes was lackluster, but it is a burger joint for yuppies. By the way did I say it was pretty expensive and the game wasn't on TV (world series)

One of the best burgers I have ever had. ever. They have a spiced warm wine that is perfect for a winter night. Downside is that they dont take reservations so you just have to wait for a table to open up, we waited about an hour, some of that time was spent at the bar but it gets super super crowded, but if the weather is bad you dont have anywhere else to wait. It would be better if you could make a reservation.
pretty good meal
Burger. Get the Burger *drops mic**exits stage left*
best burgers!

Spent an amazing weekend up in Valatie, NY  Stopped at Hour Time Bar and Grill at 2819 route 9.  Staff was great inviting,excellent service.  Food was excellent, beers served cold and refreshing.  Facility clean and comfortable to be in.  They have everything your looking for in a great bar from OTB, Keno, lotto,darts, pool table, video games and a great Juke box. Very modern, had such a good time spent most of the late day and evening there.  Customers all seemed to be having a great time and very friendly.  If you dont want to miss out on a great time this place is a must visit if your in town even worth the trip just for a fun time out.
My favorite place for gastro pub food in the city. Almost always get the burger but the other entrees are great too. I love the starters too.
Modern Italian cuisine with creative and delicious dishes. Everything was enjoyable, but the pasta was so fresh and tasty.

11/8/2014.  Diners who have food allergies beware.  Also - those that eat vegetarian may want to dine elsewhere as the dishes seemed heavily reliant on meat, poultry and fish and kitschy culinary gimmicks (dipping dot food?).  I had read that the restaurant won the #2 ranking for Best of Philly in 2013 and was excited to plan a fun night out for my family to give it a try.  I emailed the restaurant to alert them to my daughter's peanut and egg allergies and also reminded them about these upon our arrival.  On two occasions, I had to send food away from our table as they tried to serve her bread pudding and a manchego cheese beignet. My husband and I eat vegetarian and my husband was served (erroneously) and bit into a scallop that tasted rancid. I should have read the Yelp reviews prior to making the reservation since I noted that two other diners had been served their anaphylactic food allergens and someone also bit into a rancid scallop. The manger insulted us by claiming that the beignet was plated for my husband and me to try but this course was intended for all three of us to share on a single plate. It showed a lack of understanding of food allergy safety and also was incredibly dishonest. My husband insisted on speaking to the one of the Chefs and none made an effort to speak with us and offer an explanation and/or apology.  The waiter that brought out the dish told us, "Hey, I can't be accountable for bringing that out. The chefs make it and we're supposed to serve it."  Seriously?  I will retell this story countless times and we will never dine here again.  The high ranking on best of Philly is a complete joke.  I will pray that the chefs and staff at Marigold Kitchen do not kill someone with a food allergy due to their utter lack of attention to detail despite several reminders in this regard.  Rich Landau and Kate Jacoby are infinitely more talented chefs for any diner - omnivore and vegan, alike - go to Vedge instead.

It's the great FOOD! It's the stunning DÉCOR! It's the friendly ATMOSPHERE! How can I possibly choose what I like best about Mundo - because they have it all. On Saturday night I went to their new location at The Paper Factory Hotel and was impressed. The larger space was beautifully decorated with attention to detail that makes it a plush, comfy place to relax and enjoy friends while having a cocktail and delicious meal. A notable mention: the bartender made me the perfect vodka martini. The food is a glorious combination of Mediterranean, South American, Middle Eastern and I appreciate the many uniquely interesting vegetarian selections as well. The greatest compliment I can give them is that I am planning to come back this week for the Red Sonja and Ottoman Dumplings.

Horrible service. I stood around an no one even talked to me. I finally flagged down a waiter to ask "is this self seating" and all he said was "wait" ... 15 minutes later that was the ONLY word any one in the restaurant had said to me. I was completely ignored. 3 parties came in after me and walked right past me They were greeted and seated. All three of them, seated before me. Not just seated before me, but before anyone had even attempted to talk to me! 20 minute walk from my Hotel to Friedman's. It was pouring rain and I got soaked. And a sad, hungry, cold, wet, 20 minute walk back to my Hotel. After being treated like garbage. And no time left to find another good Gluten Free place to eat nearby. I spent the rest of my day hungry and miserable. I will never come back and I will never bring friends and I will be certain to talk a -LOT- about my experience. I cannot comment on the food here as I was never greeted or seated or served. I come in from San Diego, California and I was excited to find Freidman's near my Hotel because Freidman's Lunch is so incredible for Gluten Free food. Unfortunately I will not be able to say anything good about Freidman's and honestly the whole experience puts me completely off anything with the Freidman's name on it. /sarcasm Thanks for the wonderful experience. /sarcasm

Good evening my name is Eric I've visited this establishment several times and it's changing for the worst now when I started ordering for delivery very at first it was no problem and after a couple of weeks I was told I have to spend $20 dollars for a delivery and know to be told they don't deliver to my address I ask since when the person said they never did when I have proof they did I ordered from this place 5 times in 1 week are u kidding me with that being said u guys have lost a valued and loyal customer and I will not recommend any one to this place this is not good business at all
Luciano (owner) knows how to make his customers comfortable. He's a very good host and his Italian food is the best in Bayonne!

One star for this place is too much. My husband and I ordered delivery and an hour and a half later, our food finally arrived. What a disappointment it was; we had 2 burritos which came with NO guacamole that we paid $3 extra for, which were mediocre at best (I'm Mexican), the tacos we ordered had NO sauce!!!! It was all dry meat with a sprinkle of lettuce. I was so disappointed because the sauce can make or break a good taco. Will definitely never eat here again, delivery or sit in!!!!!!
YUMMIE!!!!!!!!!! I love to eat with my paws!

I been here more then I can count and every experience has been amazing. From the fresh fish selection to the sides and the complimentary dessert. I love the ambiance of the Astoria location but this location is the only one that serves Mussels in tomato sauce with crumbled feta on top. Best I had in a long time and the portion is huge, definitely worth a try.

If people expect food to be like some cheesy chain-food menu - don't go here!!! If you want to eat something different and special - the hours are listed... I have yet to hear anything negative from people that know FOOD!!! Great place...

Three of us had a terrific meal Saturday night at Jewel of India in Hanover, NH. We had the full meal of appetizers, soup, naan and main dishes. The food is quite good and had gotten so much better in the past year; I wonder if they changed chefs? The place was crowded and we had to wait despite having a reservation but it was worth it. I plan to go back again and again.

This place is the best for raw bar and all kinds of seafood!. The oysters are delicious and always fresh. The only thing that kinda sucks it's the long wait on weekends because they do get really busy.. But you can always sit at the bar and have some wine while you wait :)
Sub standard quality of food. Pricey. Ordered Indo Chinese and the fried rice had 1-2 insects (ants) Will never ever order from here. Horrible customer service too.

Pizza is very good.Come here for excellent pizza. The smaller 10 inch round pies are enough for 1-2. I could easily polish one off myself.Its a nice place to go and get some good pizza with some co workers or friends during lunch hour.Their gelato is also a good end to a delicious  meal.

Hibachi supreme buffet is a place worth visiting..all you can eat...soups, starters, main course, desserts..we were four of us and we ate quite well. What I like most was from the grill in the corner where you can pick raw veggies, shrimp, meat or what ever you want and the chef will cook it for you on the grill! That was the most tastiest lo mein I've ever tasted...

I love Bubby's. Sure, it's over-priced for what it is. I can get a great burger at Whitman's for half the price. BUT, and I'm sure you know this, it's all about the pie. I crave that pie like it's nobody's business. I think a slice is 9 bucks. A whole pie is $65, and I would 100% buy one for Thanksgiving or something. It's totally worth it. Peanut butter pie. Pumpkin. Key lime. It's all effing unbelievable. And makes the trip to Tribecca (or the High Line loc) and the price tag completely worth it.

Was visiting Philadelphia for the weekend and had the pleasure of stumbling across this place when I was in South Philly. First of all, it was the best welcome I ever had to a coffee place ever, Liza is really nice and made me feel right at home. I went for a delicious savoury crepe with Tikka Masala which was excellent and really hit the spot. I was a tad hungover and it is great comfort food. Before I got my flight home I decided to come back for round 2! - this time had a great cup of coffee and tried the banana/nutella crepes.These are amazing and this place is a little gem! Really enjoyed the music and conversation here as well. If you are in the area, don't just come for Pats cheesesteaks, get some dessert at Liza's Creperie! It's fun, it's delicious and it's a breath of fresh air to meet an owner that is so kind to her customers. Big thumbs up from me, check it out!
Our server was Alexis she was amazing make sure you request your immediately when you get there

I went to celebrate my birthday with my closest friends and the experience was amazing. They treat you and your guest so well and to top it off the food is amazingly good. The view is incredible all around the restaurant. It's a must go place.

I came here with some coworkers and some friends and really enjoyed it. I usually don't really eat Italian but I listened to my friends recommendation and was very satisfied. The wine was very good and the waiter was very patient with our decisions. I liked the pasta sampler and had to try different flavors. I will come back and recommend this place

I tried Posto after reading the great reviews and left disappointed.  The plus of all this is that the pizza was good.  That was the only plus, however.  The service was sub-par.  After being seated and handed a menu by the host, I waited 20 minutes for a waitress to show up at my table.  To make matters worse, I watched her service two other parties who came in well after me before deciding to come over to my table.  Given that I had been sitting there for 20 minutes waiting for service, I already knew what I wanted and placed my order immediately: soup and a pizza.  After another 15 minutes, the waitress finally returned to tell me that they were out of the soup.  It's soup!  Nothing complex here.  It shouldn't take 15 minutes to serve a bowl of soup let alone  check to see that you actually have said soup.  At that point, I opted just to eat my pizza, which was tiny, and leave still hungry.  Needless to say, I didn't leave much of a tip, which is very atypical for me.

Great Middle Eastern food. The Hummus and falafel are delicious. We just lost a Gyro Place in the West Village, and although they don't do Gyro's, they do a great job with their falafel platters and sauces.  Glad they are in our neighborhood.

This place has one of the best falafels I've ever tried. The rest of the food is so hearty and healthy it is perfect when you are in the mood to eat vegan. The staff is very nice as well and we had many conversations with other customers that agreed with our opinions. I recommend this place
Tiy was super helpful in deciding what to get. All the food looks so delicious and the steak with spiced sweet potatoes was amazing! Definitely recommend this place

I am hooked on to their bbq chicken pizza... I usually get the 3 $ slice to go. I was especially impressed when their credit card machine was not working and I had no cash on me they gave me a slice on the house. Their bbq chicken wings are great also. Wish they had a better selection of soft drinks to go with it.

I went back to Bistro Mediterranean on 11/1/14. The customer service was much better this time! We didn't like our waiter very much (he was the older man who greeted and left me waiting last visit), but everyone else was very friendly. The place looks fancy but is not too expensive. My boyfriend LOVED his dinner. He got the Paella a la Valenciana and he was very content. I got the rib eye steak (Filete de ojo a la parrilla) but to my disappointment it was cooked extremely well done when I ordered it medium. This may not seem like a big deal but I have braces so my whole dinner was kind of ruined. The appetizers were very good though. I loved the cheese croquettes!!!! Now for the most impressive part of the evening was when the man in a white shirt, perhaps the manager, came to apologize about the steak. He was so kind and genuine. He brought out a free tres con leches for me to make up for the dinner. The gesture was nice, but his friendliness alone was very much appreciated! :)
Best BBQ I have had since I left the south. The ribs melt in your mouth. Cool vibe. Could go dressy or casual and still feel comfortable. Sauce is AMAZING.

I've been going to this place for some time now and I have seen the restaurant go through a number of upgrades.  One thing that has remained consistent is the quality of the food.  This is THE most authentic French cafe in the 5 boroughs.  Between me and all of the friends and family I have brought to Triskell since I moved to Astoria nearly four years ago, I have tried nearly everything on the menu.  I have never left disappointed, nor have any of my guests. There is a reason Triskell was voted best French Onion soup in all of New York.  It is.  The crepes are superb and truly authentic and the brunch menu has some choices you will simply not enjoy anywhere else.   Without a doubt: the best French Toast you will ever have. The Quiche is wonderfully presented and amazing.  The wine menu is carefully chosen and they have a unique list of beers from France you will not find elsewhere. Sometimes brunch is crowded but, hey, it's New York and this is a popular restaurant.  I will continue to return.

I recommend this place! I usually never eat Italian but after having eaten at this place I changed my mind. Their bread is just amazing and it makes you forget about the carbs. The portions are not too small, just large enough for you to try different dishes and not be too full. The waiter was not the best as he would forget what we ordered. Overall was great
Good times.

Was here Friday night excellent food the owner chef came out to my table with every dish to explain about each dish all I can say Johnaton is brilliant at what he does had the chicken entree amazing.the service here was fantastic very welcoming staff and a real beautiful space excellent choice of beers and wines had the Kronenbourg 1664 on draft excellent choice will definitely be coming back to this gem

I just stopped at BTC for a quick lunch. Place was small but environment was friendly.I ordered fish taco with the touch of hot sauce and cheez crema, chunky avocado guaco and some variety of salsa. Choosing a variety of food is a good way to ensure you're taking the nutrition you need.......... Yummy tacos for a quick lunch, they deserve four stars****

Make no mistake, the pizza at Santucci's is excellent. However, on a recent visit we got a salad that was drenched with dressing and was uneatable. Upon return of the waitress to our table, we notified her of the problem and the salad was taken off the table. Upon receipt of our bill, we were disappointed the salad remained on the bill. We asked the waitress who said she did bring it to the attention of the owner but he refused to take it off the bill. The owner refused to acknowledge a request to speak about the situation and refused to come out of the back. This is not the first we observed rude behavior on part of the owner (or manager). Secondly, as we were waiting for the owner to acknowledge the problem, we noticed an abundance of cameras and perhaps microphones in the dining area. Not sure why a BYOB would need such high security. It seems like from the reviews I have read that I am not the only person who has encountered horrific service at this establishment. Personally, I will NEVER patronize the poor behavior of this establishment.

eh.  ambiance was strange-- high ceilings as expected in this neighborhood, but dark decor which seemed odd for a less-dressy indian restaurant.  food was average and too rich/oily/creamy in my opinion.

Really nice food I came here with my coworkers and enjoyed the ambiance. The staff was nice too but not very attentive. The drinks were ok. We got the mixed veggies, the meat platter, Rosemary lamb and pasta. I would definitely come back to try more food.
truffle fries!!!!!!!!!

This is definitely the best new addition to the East Village! Their happy hour is phenomenal, my favorite? The smoked jalapeño margarita! The menu is fantastic, super creative and really tasty! The staff is always very friendly and the manager, Jorge, has always been extra accommodating to my and my groups!

We had relatives visiting from Florida, and decided to bring them to Spiga on a Friday evening which is a new restaurant that opened close to my home. I've unfortunately had a lot worse, however, I've also experienced much better. We were a party of five, and the consensus was that while the service was friendly and attentive, the food was just very....eh. Unremarkable. For the price, the food is simply not worth it, and we found the portions to be small. My fiancé and his uncle still felt hungry even after we left. Desserts were good, however. I came, I saw, and I may come back but it would strictly be for coffee and dessert.
this place is one of the better pizzerias in the newark area. i usually get delivery from here. the pizza and wings are slightly better than mediocre.

Overall, unimpressed. On a quiet night at the restaurant, our service was slow. The staff left our wine glasses empty for 20 minutes at a time, which was frustrating because our bottle of white wine was placed in a wine chiller a few feet from our table, and in order to serve ourselves, we had to get up and walk where our wine was located, which we did twice. Although the food was decent, the portions were too small, the prices too high, and the lack of good service left us hungry and unhappy.
Nice lunch, nice decor and good service but nothing exceptional. Had the salmon pasta and it was pretty basic but not bad.

I love this place and I am a regular here.  There is seating but most of the time I get it to go.  I order their tofu banh mi or chicken banh mi.  I love their miso ginger salad dressinng.  Their chicken is organic and always fresh.  The service ia friendly and fast.  When they have Farro, I always order it as an additional side.  It is very good and worth trying.  I have been a loyal customer since the day Rotisseur opened and I plan on keeping that way.
Love the fries and sauces here. Been coming here for years and will continue to do so, matter of fact i might go for a quick ride now that i think about it lol.
I was in town and heard about this place.  I ordered the steak with Cheez Whiz and had no regrets.  I enjoyed my sandwich and even went back again the next day!

Love Ippudo! I went to the original in Kyoto and it's comparable in quality and taste. Ginger broth was very ginger-y fresh and the roast pork buns have a trendy/non-traditional twist.  Would come again.

We went for lunch before seeing Wicked at the Bushnell. Our meals were amazing the service was quick and friendly. We had the "almost famous" garlic bread with cheese and we split the pesto gnocchi with sun dried tomato and grilled chicken and the grilled chicken sandwich. To top off our lunch we had the "Rated X" martini! To make the lunch even better if you are going to see a show in Hartford, Salute gives you 10% off your meal!
This is a great spot. It's bustling, full and plenty is going on all around you, and the food is great too.

If your looking for a place that takes over an hour to deliver with terrible quality you found the right place! Ordered boneless wings, received bone in. Ordered a pastrami sandwhich that was overcooked into rubber. When I contacted them about the boneless wings mix up, they arranged to have the driver come back to swap the incorrect wings for the correct ones. After another hour of waiting, driver was a no show. So now we have cold bone in wings....  a disgusting rubber meat sandwhich and a headache!  This place needs to be shut down. You have a better chance of catching ebola then this place serving edible food.

Two weeks in Seoul and I came back and realized that there was NOTHING in the United States that I wanted to eat. I had terrible cravings for Korean food. Jung's Kimchi Corner scratched the itch. Fresh and fast and no fuss, which is how Korean food is in Seoul. Reasonably-priced like in Seoul as well. The only reason I'm giving four stars instead of five is he has no makgeolli.
