But that isn't Jung's fault. I don't think you can even get makgeolli in this country and you sure couldn't sell it from a lunchtime food cart... alas.

Don't even try to make a reservation. The phone rang off the hook (20 Times) and finally answered.The lady popped her gum so loud in my ear, it's still ringing. When I ask about a private room she said, we have one in our bathroom...? NO THANKS. Next!
Now that Yogev is bartending here he leaves all his money in his pockets and forgets about it and I find it when I do the laundry.

If I could give a zero I would! Last couple of times we have gotten delivery, we noticed the quality and taste of the food had been slipping. However, after this past Friday night, we will NEVER order from Imperial 46 again. We ordered 3 sushi items, fried dumplings, fire cracker chicken, and egg rolls. When the order arrived (we paid by credit card), we realized they gave us shrimp tempura and chicken tempura instead of a shrimp tempura roll and chicken tempura roll. HUGE difference in cost, as the rolls are $6.25 each, while the chicken tempura is $14.25 and the shrimp tempura is $18.25. We then taste the firecracker chicken, which tasted like pure peanuts (no spicy taste whatsoever). I then open the dumplings to find 3 of them soggy and barely cooked and 3 of them are busted open and burnt! We call the restaurant (at this point, we just want a refund for the tempura errors and the dumplings) and the woman on the phone was beyond rude. She stated she would not give us a refund, until the driver came back and picked up the wrong food (ridiculous). She did not apologize for their error and stated they would bring the correct food, which we no longer wanted at this point, in fear it would get spit in it, but it would take at least an hour for them to deliver it.  I asked her if she was going to just serve it to other people, at which time she hesitated and said no, but that wasn't very believable. Funny how she stated it would take an hour for them to deliver the correct food, because the driver showed up to pick up the wrong items within 15 minutes! I showed the driver my dumplings, which he looked mortified. I tried to give him them, which he would not take. After he left, we called the restaurant again for the refund. The woman got loud with me after asking for a refund for the dumplings because the entire order was not returned. We finally did get our refund in the end. DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS PLACE! THE OWNER IS COMPLETELY UNPROFESSIONAL and FOOD IS DIGUSTING! Will be posting a picture of the dumplings! Awful establishment!
We had the lunch pre fixe.  Simply EXCELLENT, worth every penny.  Only complaint is the wine list, which is overpriced.

I came to Saleya for an after work outing and I absolutely loved it!! Happy hour is great here and they have delicious $5 pizza. They had a large space available upstairs for our large party. This place is very chic. The only con to this place is that they only had one bartender. When it got really crowded another bartender came in- he was Asian. He obviously didn't know what he was doing when taking orders. He also messed up our bills/ tabs. I can see myself coming here again because of their happy hour and pizza and also the space available upstairs.

I recently took a trip to NYC and we needed somewhere quick to eat because we needed to catch our bus back home.  I asked Siri where the nearest pub was, and it led us to Rattle 'N' Hum. First walking in, I was a little iffy about how things would turn out.  But let me tell you, I am very glad we ended up here!  The food was fabulous.  (I had a cheeseburger slider and their mac and cheese)  And their beer list had close to 40 beers, maybe even more.  I definitely recommend this little pub!

They delivered a very decent pint of guinness. Captain Morgan and diet coke was equally refreshing. Very limited power outlets and can get crowded easy with limited seating. Worth a stop if you have time before your flight. Our bartender Francis was conversational and polite, something other airport bars are lacking.

We are so glad to find this place in our neighborhood. Absolutely our favorite! It is a very un-Queens restaurant, in a good way. Menu is small, but well designed. Good mixture of new American fare with a bit of Korean twist. What I like about them most is their constant improvement to their menu. They keep changing the way the plate is presented, and the way it is seasoned. We have been to  Salt & Fat at least once a month since we moved to Sunnyside 2 years ago, and never have been disappointed. The dished we like... Price Edward Island Mussels, Korean BBQ Wraps, Cu-Ban, Arctic Char, and like everyone says, Bacon Infused Popcorn! Highly recommended!

Nice place ) nice interior , but if you want to eat some oysters I would recommend you to go somewhere else ) but they do have nice drinks if you like bourbon or whisky you in the right spot) I will definitely come back there for a drink)))

After a drink or two this is my favorite spot to stop by. Sometimes the lines are long at night because the food is great but it moves fast. Many people eat the food near the cart and it is really fun
Five stars, easy! This second location is larger than the first although a bit sterile (maybe a good thing for the hospital crowd?). The food is amazing though - fresh, flavorful, and inexpensive.
Awesome restaurant, fresh tasty food, great ambiance and big space. Waiters are helpful, would definitely recommend for a special occasion type of dinner.

Came hear a second time on a Sunday afternoon. The waitress was great and the food was awesome. Had the combo platter again. The creamed spinach was awesome and super fresh, the mashed potatoes are totally fresh and home made. I read the bad reviews and I am so glad that every time we come it is phenomenal. I WILL BE BACK. I love the dry rub seasoning and the smoked wings and the 4 or 5 different side sauces. LOVE THIS PLACE.
I came here for the seafood. Everything was fresh. I didnt like the setup of the seating that much, seemed crowded but that is just me!

Came here to try out our local diner for dinner, and it was alright. I had a burger that was a bit more rare than I had wanted, and quite greasy leaving me a bit ill. My fiance's meal was 'alright' too, nothing special, and certainly nothing compared to the other NJ diner's I have been to which is sad. Though the wait staff was friendly and pleasant, pretty sure I won't be stopping here again, there are better places to go within a mile radius of this place on route 1.

The food is 5 Stars The wait and the crowding and getting stepped on-- minus a star, but still worth the wait. This meal tastes like my mom made it. Seasoned well, large portions, attentive waiters that magically appear from the sea of people waiting/ 1. Coconut breaded Shrimp 2. Flan!! 3. Fried Chicken with Mango Salsa 4: Tapas- Datillas, plantanos rellenos, and the chicken lollipops. 5. Spanish Harlem Sangria- don't even need alcohol, that good. Have gone there twice on a Saturday night (hence the wait) Need to make it out there on a weekday to enjoy.
Great Burgers! The Bacon Jam Burger is my favorite burger there. Also, their Bacon jam fries; don't even get me started! The owners are doing a great job and you should go and get yourself a burger!
Good soups!

Absolutely amazing. I'm extremely picky when it comes to Indian food, but Zaroka knocks it out of the park every time. The Chicken Tikka Masala is a must.  The sauce tastes even better on top of the garlic naan. My friend and I just tried the Chana Saag tonight which looks boring and bland on the menu, but was spiced to perfection! The meal was only complemented by the staff, who could not have been friendlier. As soon as my water glass reached the halfway mark, the waiter came over immediately to top it off. I would recommend Zaroka over and over again.

Couldnt have asked for better service after a nice day. My in laws and I went here for lunch with my small son and husband, and were waited on by a waitress named Cayna. She was so friendly and had a great personality. The food came out fast, and was tasty. The views outside were nice as well as the sitting area outside. The passing boats kept my son occupied. Overall couldnt have asked for a nicer experience. Its a must go

I ordered a burrito and the nachos. I ate the nachos first and barely finished them. I was full for about 2 days straight. The food was good, but its definitely more of a take out spot because there is not more then 2 tables to sit at.
Three stars because the food was great. The service left much to be desired. Slow and not very friendly.
My go - to for takeout and lunch. Only con is the minimum delivery charge is $30-$40, a bit pricey for one persons lunch.

Chocolate lover ..or not ? well..its doesn't matter. They not only have awesome desserts but their food is delicious too. I love their Quinoa and Chickpea waffle Salad, they are simply heavenly :) Love their presentation style. Just feel their desserts little expensive they are super tasty though.

The food is not very good.  I took a burger and it was exactly like the ones I buy frozen at the grocery store to cook them in the microwave for 1.5 minute. Price was fair for the quality. House wine was really good!

I love this place. Their CCSU roll is to die for. The restaurant itself is nice and clean. Their rolls always have so many flavor combinations. Their tuna avocado and dancing roll are their best rolls. Also, crab salad is very good! This place is perfect when you are looking for a good sushi, nice place and friendly service. Love it!

My boyfriend and I ate at Sandra's a couple weeks ago and we absolutely loved it! First of all the peach, mint iced tea was fabulous. My boyfriend ordered the cajun fried chicken with mac and cheese and corn and I ordered the meat loaf with mashed potatoes and candied yams. Everything we consumed was delicious!  The waitress we had was also a sweetheart and very attentive. Overall, I was impressed with everything. It is so nice to encounter a place that serves real food in a comfortable atmosphere. I'd recommend it to anyone.

Cozy, stylish and down to earth but than the food is from heaven I ate the menu in the end of several visits and it is a never ending adventure since chef contiues to add new stuff all the time. foie gras, lentil salad, sea food soup, brunch omlettes with duck fat cooked potatoes writing this makes me hungry yumnn

I have been here a few times. One always waits outside whether with a group or on a date, then enters a packed house with no available service. After waiting in line for a drink, you're welcomed with a rushed waiter and hurried drinks. I will go back but I don't stay long.

Came here on a Thursday for dinner with 2 friends. It was pretty empty but still felt cozy. We were seated quickly and our waitress was really great, giving us lots of good recommendations (mac & cheese and kale salad were amazing). The drinks we got were about half and half - I didn't love the bartender's Old Fashioned but his Manhattan was excellent. One star off for the lack of vegetarian entrees. To be clear, their appetizers and sides had lots of options and were delicious, but if you're doing a farm to table concept you need to have more than one option that's on par with your meat dishes (no, mac & cheese doesn't count). Otherwise really great!
Come here for the burger!
This place is really nice. The service is good and the food comes in really big portions, which I like. Prices are reasonable.

Another great meal the other night.The four stars could really be five stars because I think this is a really good restaurant- to eat in and order for delivery....the decor is really warm and inviting with interesting lighting and a lot of paneled wood done in a mod 2014 way. I've had their coconut soup (can't remember exact name) the spring rolls and the spicy coconut Thai massiman (yeesh- I should get a menu to get the names right!) point is - their food is great - the flavors and taste are right on.  I would love to have more chicken in the dishes. The sauce is so good and flavorful - mixes great with the rice and meat- but more is better here :-) And no, I'm not a big eater!

Outstanding. Upon moving here this is the first place I took my girlfriend to for a date. Absolutely wonderful service from everyone including the owner Tony. Ismael was an excellent and attentive waiter. Food is amazing and a good value. They even have buffet nights which include seafood. Highly reccomend you visit. I live in Jersey city but it is an easy commute and well worth the trip.

Ever had food that leaves you wanting more even when you ate plenty? Well this is one place I can say is hard to choose when you absolutely want everything! Delicious Mediterranean and Garden Melt. Great selection of wine. The staff knows the food and it's ingredients as well as very hospitable and courteous. Definitely enjoyed myself and will be returning.

I went to Laduree @Madison Ave on Nov 10th 2014 and bought a jar of Rose Preserve. Which really makes me feel bad is when I decided to look at it today, I found the "Best Before" is 01/10/2014 !!! It's almost 10 months past!!!! I was so sad since I was planned to give this Rose Preserve to my mom as a gift.

terrific spot in the east village. the hostess was super nice and our table was waiting for us even tho the restaurant was packed.there was a good selection of wine and beer at good prices.we ordered grilled octopus and an arugula for apps and both were very tasty.i had the  parpadelle with oxtail ragu which was great but my wife's spaghetti and lamb meatballs missed the mark the suace was pasty and the meatballs were pretty plain! would definately return ,tho and try another dish.
The staff was professional and very friendly, not at all stuffy.  And the foods are truly amazing.

Recently went to JANE with a group of 11 and we all had a great time. The food was great, the atmosphere was fun and the staff were friendly and accommodating! I will definitely be back again in the near future.
I like this place and the food and waiters, but my hand skin got stuck in the bathroom faucet while shutting it off and it's still bleeding.  Please change the faucets.
There is a reason they are number 1! I recommend you go and try it, and I need not to say more; it's just that good!
I liked the variety, however i'm not much of a meat ONLY eater.
Was here for a business meeting back in September and the food was fantastic.  Everything was perfect and each dish was very well prepared.  Read the reviews.  You can't go wrong here.

I went for lunch today with a friend. I have been hearing about this spot from friends for about 7 years now. Finally I tried it. It was ok. For reasons I thought. No healthy choice apart from salads. I tried the salmon chowder which taste good. But it smelled raw. Also I tried the Crab cakes and they look like falafel and or hush puppies. But they need to have more healthy choices.
Loved it

No better place in the area for bone marrow. Their fries are kind of amazing too. I recommend a weekday trip if you want to avoid all the hoopla in that area. The vibe is a little stuffy but you'll get past that when you taste the food.

This is the BEST BEST place to get middle eastern/ Mediterranean food. Every time I've gone here it's been 10/10 in terms of service, everyone is so nice and the place is always so clean. Being a vegetarian, I always order the falafel and it's always delicious!! Plus there are student discounts on your meal. Always great always delicious never get enough hummus and pita company !!

Superb service, absolutely delicious dinner!   We ordered the Buratta and Proscutto (delicious), the Veal Parmigana (outstanding!  we split it as it is a huge portion), the Seafood Risotto (done to perfection) and the Tiramisu for dessert (best I have ever had!) Greeted by very professional and personable host, a lovely  glass of Prosecco each, homeade cookies (being passed around), and excellent Limoncello....all complimentary.   Highly recommend this restaurant.  It is one of my fav's!

Went here for lunch (a veggie burger with fries) and it was fairly uninspiring. Pretty average food and not too cheap either (5.50 for a small orange juice is quite a lot...). The other food might be better value for money or a bit more exciting, but on the basis of my experience I wouldn't hurry to go back

If you looking for a very good restaurant, Grants is the one! I use to go to this place last five years and I was never disappointed. The service is above and beyond of what superlative service is. The wine list is very well selected. The food is to die for. From the fresh organic salmon to the homemade Gnocchi's. The deserts are a perfect ending to a great meal. I would highly recommed this restaurant if you looking for a delicious food and outstanding service.
Best burger in NYC
as good as it gets!
Unreal burger. So tasty! The biggest portion of fries I've ever seen in my life.

Amazing food ! it is absolutely impossible to find good soul food in Rahway and needless to say i was ecstatic when i found this place. Super sweet staff and the food was to die for. A bit pricey, but definitely worth every penny!

Pretty good, I looked at reviews ahead of time so knew what to order. I got the wild mushroom paella. I dont think there was a crumb left on my plate. I like how the place was big and airy, I felt as if I had actually stepped out of new york city for a couple hours.
Must try chinese restaurant!

This place is full off racist employee. They only care about white customer. I have a $100 bill and they tried to call the cops and block me in the store thinking it was a fake. Little they know it was the new hundred dollar. Was it because I was a young rich black man and not a drug dealer.

I have been here for lunch and dinner on several occasions (as well as for takeout) and have never been disappointed. Their fried plantains are amazing, along with the fried steak, super tender grilled chicken, and  smoothies. Best of all, their price point is fantastic for the huge portions you get. Delicious!

I heard about that spot from a co worker who is from NY. It was on my list of things to do when I touched down in NY. Food was great , service was good , food came out quickly and was HOT you can tell it was fresh off the stove. It was worth the trip from Sunny California !

Came here for dinner with 5 people for my cousins birthday dinner on the recommendation of a member of our party who had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. When the food arrived we receive 2 baby Bok Choy's (only ordered one) and 1 stuffed pepper (we ordered 2) and no steamed kale. We mentioned the mix up of ordered to the other waiter and he said he would take care of it. When our waitress came by, an inquiry was made on the missing kale. She responded stating it would be right out. 5 minutes later, another inquiry on the missing kale the waitress argues with our friend that he never ordered it. (Keep in mind she did say it was on its way out 5 minutes ago) By the time we were done eating the missing pepper arrived which my other cousin stated he did not want anymore (as he was done with his meal) we took this as another opportunity to follow up on the missing steamed kale (at this point he is the only one with a plate in front of him waiting for the kale to go with his now cold chicken) The manager did come over to apologies about the kale and we explained that we found the waitress to be inadequate. He said that he would take care of the mix ups. Kale arrives!! Obvious this was not rushed and merely put through the POS system.  Poor guy was eating it alone as all other plates on table had been cleared at this point. We ordered 4 deserts and after they came out we asked the waitress for another one of the cookies we had ordered. After we finished and sat for a while, I told the waitress that we no longer wanted the other cookie just our check. Again she claimed we never ordered the item. Our check was deliver by the manager and not only was the forgotten and not ordered items still on the check but not one of the 4 deserts we ordered comped for the constant bad service. I approached the manager and provided him my recommendations for how this check should have looked (removal of kale and additional Bok Choy and maybe a free desert for our trouble) The check came back with the item we didn't order removed and a $4.00 desert comped -- I was told that because he did eat the kale-- he could not remove it from the check. A total of 12.00 off an over 200 dollar food check for an unacceptable dining experience When I came up to the counter to explain the amounts to go on the three different cards (obviously we were not going to entrust this to our waitresses) I was told the owner was on the phone and wanted to speak with me. The conversation started with an argument. Her stating that there were 5 people in my party I saying 6. She was looking at the table on the camera (creepy) forgetting that I was no longer seated at the table. She began to tell me what had happened during my meal, funny as she was not there. She praised the manager for "taking care of things" with no recognition that I had to provide guidance as to how to handle the situation and I still don't think it was appropriate to pay for a dish that came after the meal due to bad service. What do they say?  "Fish stinks from the head"! the credit slips were brought over by some woman claiming she was the manager -- this was the first we had seen of her all night, and she quickly informed us there was a deficit to the amount of money we placed on the cards to the amount of the check-- ignoring the pile of cash on the table. TACKY!! My advice to the owner: if you don't want to make up for your incompetent wait and management staff, higher better people or close your doors. It's a shame you chefs amazing creations were ruined by and awful dining experience and your poor business management.

Tiny, unassuming hole in the wall close to the flatiron building. Quality of the food was unbelievably high! Better scrambled eggs, pancakes and sausage than I had in any other place in NY and half the price!
Food: 5 stars Attitude: 1 star

Saw this new place last week, came back tonight with friends to eat.  Unanimous thumbs up from all four of us, the food is fantastic. Simple menu, good prices and good value. I had the Lamb meatballs with an awesome mushroom sauce, perfectly cooked side of roast veggies and a nice glass of red - just the thing on a cold, cold night!. Great, friendly service, rustic Italian decor, full bar with homemade Sangria - I'll be back!
Nice atmosphere but after sitting down for 15 minutes when it was moderately busy I was not approach by a server. Had a craving for some pizza while here for business.
They are the best. I mean it. I tried most of the food car around the city but none of them better than a king ;) keep up the good work . You deserve it.

The first greetings is "you guys doesn't have a patience " even i'm not raise my hand to asking for a server. Stay away from this restaurant. Specially for asian, cause they treat asian all is same. "NO PATIENCE" lol

There are some days you want to tried different foods , foods from other countries and i just moved to Philadelphia and I wanted to try indian food . Me and my hubby went out to have dinner last night at chutney company and we ordered paneer  dosa and chicken tikka masala with rice and one kathi roll and everything was so delicious and flavory with perfect indian taste and texture . Now that I found this nice indian resturant I will go every week.

Prior to coming here, I read the reviews and liked that they were fast because our party of 4 wanted to catch a NYC Doc movie.  However, they were over the top with the speed of their service--I felt pressured to order something (waitress wanted to take our order as we sat down & came back soon after like 3 times) and the ordering process was so much pressure.  Paying was a rush too--as soon as I got my check and was gathering money to pay, they asked if it was all set.  It seemed like they were so set on seating people who were waiting, that they forgot to treat the existing customers with courtesy.  This is great if you only have 1/2 for lunch or something but for leisure dining, it is not advised to come here.  Being an southeast asian, I do not consider this place as an authentic Vietnamese restaurant.  The shrimp vermicelli (with fish sauce) was bland.  Shrimp was overly salty and did not have an authentic taste.  The appetizers were just alright.  To my surprise, it was extremely busy.  Maybe because there aren't too many competitors in the area...not sure why.  Or maybe other dishes are better, but the service was so unpleasant that I don't think I want to find out.
This place is just simply amazing. No need to look at the menu because the specials are infinite. Always a favorite of ours in every aspect, food, service and anything else you can think of.

I ate at work before I came here to meet a few friends. I had some custom pizzas and they were good. Tonight though I drank at the bar with some friends when we were supposed to be working on coding. I have a new girlfriend and I might bring her here but we might stay at home because things are going well and it's cold outside and she likes fancy things mostly.

Well, hands down this is the best sports bar in the USA for sure. You can watch any single game of soccer that is being aired. Service is great (Kieran and Krista especially). Food here is way better than any other bar I have visited. They have a lot of TV screens and are open even for the earliest game. So to cut the long story short. This is the place to be for any football (soccer fan)... Sorry Legends

I loved La Fourno! I went with my boyfriend on a Saturday night around 7pm without a reservation and luckily got seated immediately. The inside is cozy and a lot more charming than the outside. We both got whiskey sours which were absolutely delicious. For our meals, I ordered chicken parm and he got penne alla vodka. We had no complaints about the food at all! The chicken parm was amazing and cooked to absolute perfection and the vodka sauce was to die for. Our waiter was also really friendly and made an effort to talk to us and make us feel welcome. This place is such a good break from all the takeout windows and bars along South Street.
The most disappointing place I've ever experienced, Service was terrible, the food was bland and worst of all, the decor looks like an old beat up living room. I will not be back!

The great reviews on yelp led me to this place and I must say that the food was yummy however, the service was slow, the servers not very friendly and the place, chaotic and extremely loud which for me made for an U pleasurable dining experience. Had these not been factors in rating this place and the stars based solely on the food, I'd given this place another star.

Absolutely horrible. I've had better Pierogis from a bar. If you enjoy clogging your arteries with a pound of butter, and paying to cook your own pierogis then this is the place for you. Lets start with we ordered for lunch and the woman tells me it'll be a 40 minute wait (I get there and no one is there). I had the broccoli and cheese and potatoe pierogi, there was no cheese and as mentioned before - DROWNING in butter. made me sick. everyone at my job threw theres away and we ordered something else. NEVER AGAIN
Food is not so good, but service is above average. That's really all there is to say about this place.

No stars. This sushi was disgusting. I got 2 signature rolls. They came and they were soggy and mushy. They were incorrect from what I ordered. Not sure if the quality of the sushi was just so bad that they taste wrong? I immediately spit them out because  I thought I might get sick. Not only was the sushi terrible, i waited an hour and a half on a Tuesday night! The delivery guy finally came and couldn't stop coughing. Unsanitary and the worst sushi I've ever had. In addition to that, after I opened it and tried them I called for a refund- they would only give me half off. I even told them they could pick the rolls back up. Terrible

Oh man. Good stuff. Buffet lunch pick and choose what you want for $6.49 per pound. Plenty of desserts that are extra. I mixed and matched a full plate of rice, lamb and potato, salad, veggies and it came out to $8. Not a bad deal at all. All the food tasted great and fresh. Will be coming back often.
I like dumplings.To be honest,it is real Chinese dumplings.It reminds me of my mother's dumpling.I am from Chinese.
First time here and it was by pure luck the people are great the place is clean and super cute. The food was very good had a bacon egg and cheese it was just great good coffee too.
SO SO it is not good actually.

If this is your first time, and If the wait is an hour, I believe it is worth that wait (They have a system where you leave a name and phone number, and you receive a text message when your table is almost ready so you can check back in) I had the Akamaru Ramen as well as their Pork Buns.The broth is very flavorful and they have a system where if you have enough broth left, you can pay another $2 to get another serving of Noodles. The pork buns were overrated in my opinion only because they were so similar to Peking Duck buns. I recommend just sticking to the Ramen. It is a tad pricey for a bowl of Ramen, but then again you are also paying for the decor, and for the Japanese greetings that all employees give upon arrival. All in all, it is a good experience!

I am in here all the time, the best time to go in between 4-7 pm in the afternoon. Steve, tends bar on Mondays and Wednesday.  Alex tends the bar on Thursdays and Amy tends the bar on Friday and Tuesday Kate tends the bar on Tuesdays. They have a very reasonable brunch on Sundays.   They also have a wide range of beers and alcohols Wanna have a nice time with a good and fun atmosphere! GO HERE!!! :)

I frequent Agno once or twice a week for lunch. Everything I've gotten has always been pretty delicious. However, they now seem to be experimenting with the menu.  I prefer Agno over their sister store Pure Fare because Agno offers more hot food items. But with their experimenting, things have changed a bit with a lack of notice. While the rice and protein options are still warm, all of Agno's topping are now served cold. This pretty much leads to a cold lunch (since you get three toppings in a bowl), which I'm not a fan of except when I'm craving a salad. I wish I realized this before I ordered my meal. I probably won't be returning.

Food here is amazing. It is a bit pricey but is worth every cent. The place is very small and without reservation is hard to get a table on Friday and Saturday night. My personal favorite is hummus as an appetizer and I almost always order chicken as a main course. I am giving it four stars just for lack of the outdoor seating and the fact that the bar is too small, but when it comes to the quality of service and the food they deserve 6 stars.

I had the pleasure of trying Entree last week for the very first time. The entire staff and the cozy atmosphere was excellent; truly a great dining experience as well. Everything I ordered was so delicious including the duck which I normally don't like but LOVED it here. My favorites however were definitely the calamari, lobster tail app. and the purple potatoes they served on the side!

Had an exceptional meal here!  The clams casino,  fresh oysters and turtle soup for starters.   Then crab cakes and scallops for main course.  Every single item that hit our table was phenomenal.   The cocktails as well were spot on.  I had an "Oakland blackout". Which was delicious and pleasantly presented.   Our server Michael was very helpful -- quick with a good recommendation and a winning smile. The only thing that lost some stars in my book is the fact that while we were waiting for our table there wasn't a lot of room by the bar.  I ended up close to the service bar area and a manager was extremely rude about telling me I couldn't stand there.  I can understand if it's their policy but I'm sure there were nicer ways to go about telling me. All in all it did not ruin my experience too badly and I plan on returning.

I have been to Greek Restaurants time and time again, but there are very few that come close to Skara Estiatorio! We had a VIP guest with us one evening and he has stores all around the world, and eats out all the time. He lives in Manhattan and said that nothing he has had compared to the meal we had at Skara. That was a huge surprise being the world traveler that he is! Every time I go I want my rack of lamb~It is so delicious along with the greek salad and beets. You just can't go wrong! The staff is friendly and kind, and always make sure that your dining experience is perfect. I highly recommend this well kept secret!
great spot for a burger and fries in the East Vil
It was perfectly cooked - absolutely no complaints. The servers were very knowledgeable and they did it very well.
Fried shrimp and short rib fries~so gooood! Also had village burger and it is too big to eat all up...

My girlfriends and I go out to eat often, like to try new spots in different areas, and this by far was one of my favs....Its such a comfy atmosphere and the food is out of this world...will def come back soon!!
Great Burgers had the Beef but my bf had the Turkey, Nice Spot to get a drink...I LOVE THEIR SALAD and i think i just had the best MAC and CHEESE here...

My boy Felix works here and told me to come try out the food on my birthday. And God Dam the food was amazing! Great service and the food is just literally amazing. I recommend the mint lemonade, break room burger and break room fries! It does get packed but it's worth it!

High Priced and lack luster unimaginative food. Skimpy sandwiches are the cheapest items on the menu and maybe you will get a pickle and maybe you won't. You can get potato salad or coleslaw as a side as the only option. I ordered a pastrami sandwich on one occasion and my wife ordered the salmon dinner with over done bland vegetables. Since we live in walking distance to the diner, we only go there when we are late getting home from work. As of Monday 11/17/14 we vowed to never return. Hey Tick Tock, take a lesson from the Park West diner up a few miles on Route 46 West, the food there is far superior. Park west gives you a complimentary appetizer plate of nice bread, rolls and fava bean or tomato/onion salad. Dinners are supplied with handsome portions of delicious and varietal vegetables. Lastly, get rid of the lousy blue plate specials that are unappetizing and overpriced.

Excellent all around.  One of the best meals my hubs and I have had.  Mussels were amazing!  The tap room downstairs made the wait for a table so bearable!  Can't wait to return to VT so we can come back to this place!

This is one of the best resturant in the center city especially if you like dumplings , I went out for lunch with my hubby and we had dumplings , cheese wonton and fried rice oh my god... best and healthy food in the town . Everything was just perfect and had perfected texture . I would love to go back and enjoy their delicious food .
Yes. The answer is yes. (Plus extra white sauce).

Took 10 minutes to receive our drinks on a relatively quiet night.  Burger came with no avocado, was advertised as an avocado burger. Extremely overpriced for the size of the patty.  there are half a dozen other places to go in the area for a good burger before here.

Not impressed at all.  This was my first time there and probably my last.  I had the Osso Bucco which was good but my friend had the short ribs and they were so salty she could not eat it.  I have known her for years and we eat out often.  I have never seen her send a dish back but she did these short ribs.  The surprising thing was that no one seemed to care that the meal was so bad.  They blamed it "on the sauce".  And the service just went downhill from there.  We had to ask 3 times for water refills.  And they were not that busy.  Overall, it seemed like a chore to eat at this place.  With so many good place to eat in this area, they need to get on their game.

I don't understand how this place doesn't have 5 stars. Its FANTASTIC! Everyone is super nice there...big portions, great price. To the people saying its EXPENSIVE, you're clearly cheap because this is the cheapest, high-quality breakfast I could ever get. The pancakes are awesome, light...fluffy, with a unique taste. Bacon is the best bacon around, thick cut and fresh...nice and crispy...(it has its day like I'm sure some of you do) but overall its great.
The food is average and the drinks are overpriced. It's a nice place with pretty employees but nothing special.

Stopped in here during our recent trip to Philly, we had the cheesteak w/ American cheese & onions. It was okay, nothing to really brag about but everyone stops here when their in Philly so why not?? On a night of drinking I'm sure we'll be back otherwise,  probably not.

I have been there a few times and always thought the food was decent. However, the last time I was there, there was a giant spider crawling around where the bagels were. I went up to the cashier and told him right away. He brushed me off and acted like it was no big deal. He didn't bother to tell anyone and the spider crawled around in the bagel case. I am so disgusted with how they handled this and will never go back. That is a huge health violation!

I lived in East Windsor for a number of years and was a frequent guest of the Americana. 20 years ago, the place looked like a neglected underbelly of a pirate ship, but they delivered solid diner fare. Loved it. After the renovations, they made major changes, but the food was still delicious. Skip forward to a few years ago: someone decided that they wanted to bill the joint as a restaurant, as opposed to a diner. They slashed their huge menu and replaced it with a specialized seasonal menu with limited options. Understandable in the business, unless you specialize in garbage water-soaked meat, dairy and vegetables described as delectable items on the menu. I accompanied some friends there a few times when I was in town, and tolerated it. I had all but written the place off, but had a craving for a classic pork roll sandwich with egg and cheese. I made the asinine assumption that any diner in NJ would still be able to deliver. Fools tried to class up the thing by calling it the "Trentonian" and serving it on Ciabatta bread. After a drawn-out negotiation with the server, one of my fellow guests pointed out that the hamburger roll was the closest to a hard roll that I was going to get. Ordered it. Pork roll: two pathetic, Jenny Craig slices that would probably get NJ kicked out of the union. Roll: Delivered by the food runner with the Ciabatta, the offensive bread that I had no business dealing with for a hangover sandwich. The runner tried to argue with the server that we had ordered it in that manner. Call your patrons and server a liar at the table, only to be proven wrong by the notes on the ticket, that makes for a 5 star establishment. Eggs and Cheese: Would have been good if it hadn't taken the staff 10 minutes to switch rolls and return our sandwiches at room temperature. Water: No ice. Would have felt at home if I lived in Europe. Table Bread: Served well after order was placed, same temp as the service (stone cold) Coffee: Should have grabbed the Dunkin Donuts coffee that had been sitting in my cup holder for 20 minutes for a warmer cup. Server: Friendly (being generous) Atmosphere: It was the first day of New Year, so I'll accept the fact that they didn't ask the white trash train seated in our section that was babbling in outdoor voice to leave. I would give 1 star, but our server was somewhat attentive and seemed to be overextended.

I love cantinas. I love the food, I love the way its decorated inside and out. I usually always get a burrito either pork or chicken, garlic shrimp, guacamole, and whatever really good desserts they have some time. It is definitely good!
Love! Love! Love!  Healthy food that tastes fabulous. Made a special effort to come here on my trip to NYC.

I have never had actual food here, only chocolate stuff. But it is definitely worth visiting. It smells great from the front door and the inside is nice. Kinda easy to overdo it though with the chocolate.
Fusilli Lunghi is the best!

We dined there last night. we are a  sri lankan family and  i missed  my homemade  kottu roti for  long time. this place has the  best  food. everything  was  fresh , nice and spicy very authentic... service  could be  little  bit  more formal but does not  matter. owner was  great and helpful... please  go  try best authentic sri lankan....we love it
Tacos here can be pretty hit or miss. Service also very inconsistent. Mainly order here out of convenience. Not as good as Chavelas

Just left this place and I'm still hungry! Why you ask?I ordered the chicken Fiorentino when it came out my potatoes were ice cold and the chicken was so tough I could not even cut it with a knife! Not to mention it tastes like last week's chicken! My wife ordered the gnocchi it look like  mini marshmallows! It had absolutely no taste! I didn't want to come here but my wife wanted to, once before I had an issue with dessert. I went there for some espresso and pastry they were stale as could be! I should have learned my lesson then I thought maybe it might be better well I was wrong. The best thing was nobody even came to apologize! The waiter was a total and complete dick! Sammy was his name. Way to run a business guys I can't wait to tell my friends not to go back to this place. And believe me I know lots of people including police officers and school teachers they will not come here a lot of people already think this place sucks! Jerks

This place is awesome! I have only had the crab but it is sooooo good, makes me not want to try anything else. I recommend getting all of the seasonings together. Only thing that sucks is they do not take reservations so you most likely will be waiting for a while (depends on what day and time you go). They do make up for it by sending you a text when your table is ready so you don't have to wait in the restaurant. It does get crowded. Love love love the place.
Very good pizza, and very affordable. Not heavy or floppy, it's crisp and i always order well done. I never had anything else there except there plain pizza, never had a time I had bad pizza.
Delicious breakfast menu! Everything they make is fresh and delish. Try their letter R, that's a must have!

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our dinner at Le Cheri. The Art Alliance building on Rittenhouse Square has such a subdued and relaxing ambiance. We're not sure why so many restaurants have flopped in this gorgeous location. Well--we can hope that Le Cheri is here to stay! On a rainy fall evening, we tucked in to our french onion soup, salade lyonnaise, and beef bourguingnon. Each course was deluxe and delicious. The other diners nearby were clearly enjoying themselves, too. We will be back for more. This is a gem of a restaurant where you can eat yummy food and actually have a conversation at a normal volume--such a plus if you want to delight in both the dinner and your dining companion!

Ok first impression, I come to bar and I really wanna use toilete. Bartender is nice, he recommends the wine and I go. I come back. I order cheese plate. Cheese plate comes after 25 min. It's stuffed with sweet potatoes. That we're not on menu description. But ok. Even if it was not my kind of taste I did try it. They gave me complimentary popcorns a la house style. I found a hair inside. And you know the worst thing??? Not a bartender offered to replace it   He just said "oh Jesus. Fuck it".  I haven't seen manager or anyone coming to apologize for the incident. It's a restaurant. And I found a hair in popcorn. And I chewed it. Disgusting. No one asked me how I was doing or was my meal good. Bartender was the worst. I am never coming back again

I had a great dining experience here! The food was delicious and the service was great! A really cool environment best for a small group or a date. The sushi rolls were all named after schools areas, and streets of Philadelphia which made it really personal and unique. I will definitely be coming back again!

This family-owned restaurant is wonderful. We have gone in a few times and the owner always remembers us. All of the serves are so genuine and nice and very excited to talk to you about their food. The food itself is delicious, very interesting tastes all perfectly balanced. I recommend the spinach and paneer momos as an appetizer. The soup is also very good and all of the curries and main dishes are wonderful. Highly recommended for food and good, friendly service. What a great addition to the Hanover restaurant scene.

I have been visiting this Dynamic restaurant for 10 years & have never been disappointed. The staff is very friendly & accommodating & the food is D E L I C I O U S!!!        Ps: dont 4get 2 kiss cliff!

I'm tempted not to tell you about this place. It's great.  Some of the best pizza around now.   I'm more of a purist and so am not a fan of their menu - too many concoctions and ingredients - but the pizza is top notch.  Better than Lucali and Franny for sure.  Not Di Fara in its hey day, but nothing is.  This is about as good as it gets, as Yelp says.
sesame cream brulee soooooo amazing
Great brunch and dinner spot. Very good food.

Great for lunch. Their special is awesome, includes a drink, appetizer, side salad and meal for an amazing price. Serves you well for any occasion. Work meeting or dinner with your significant other! Bring your own bottle.

This place offers banh mi sandwiches that taste ok, It definitely have room for improvement. Even though the reputation is stellar, I though it was nothing to rave about. I ordered the BBQ pork banh mi sandwich, the pork itself is pretty good, the vegetables tasted more or less fresh. However, the vegetable wasn't chopped enough, a whole piece of cilantro came out with the first bite. The bread was hard and dry, it was suspected that the bread was made a while ago, and been sitting out. So there are ups and downs with the sandwich. It was just $4.50 though, you get what you pay for.

This is the best Chinese restaurant in Northern New Jersey.  Our favorite dishes are the Lobster with Chengdu sauce, Empress chicken, gold coins, hot and sour soup, Peking Duck.  We have been eating there for the last 20 years and have never been disappointed

I was at Bogota Latin Bistro with my husband this past Saturday. We've been there a few times  before so we knew not to go for dinner because 1. It's always crowded and the wait is ridiculous 2. The food is not the greatest but appetizers are good  and 3. The drinks are over priced after happy hour. We got there at 3pm and ordered some appetizers, It was good. Our drinks were okay but they forgot to put sugar in my mojito twice. Getting the attention of our waitress was so annoying that I just drank the damn thing. I thought it wasn't right that the waitress gave us our check without asking us if we were done. I forgot how this place likes to push customers out to prevent them from ordering drinks before happy hour finishes. I told the waitress we weren't done and ordered two more drinks. I wanted to spend time with my husband away from our busy schedules but felt pressured to leave so we did even though the place had several empty tables. Advice: come before happy hour to take advantage of the drinks because they are over priced and they use way too much ice. Overall, the place is overcrowded and small. The bathrooms are messy with toilet paper all over the place but fairly clean and the food is alright. They seem to not keep the bathrooms tidy. I hope another Latin place opens up in the area.

Hi to everyone who's reading this. Before I start I should mention that I'm only a customer of Little Basil restaurant and I don't know anyone personally in that restaurant. I've read Brad A.'s  unfair comment about the little basil restaurant and I didn't appreciate the way he talked about the employees /owner of this restaurant.I have been buying food from this restaurant for over 30 years and yet, I've never had or heard any complains about the food or especially of the employees. To my understanding Brad was looking to get something for free.First of all according to him,the ad (If there was one) says if you purchase $20 or more you'll get something for free. Well, he spent $19.58 and that's not $20 .Also, he says that he does not believe they're losing a customer over 47 cents. Brad ,you should be ashamed of yourself to bother these hard working people who work at lease 14 hours a day to serve people like you and I .You don't like their food /customer service then I suggest you find someone else to put up with your non sense.Have some dignity and be a man and leave them alone and don't ruin their reputations for your cheapness and selfishness. I'm surprise why didn't Little basil management didn't take legal action against this "man". Fred D

First time I went to eat was with my family it was a bunch of us .we ordered a big selection of food cheese steaks,southwest burger,, onion rings they were my favorite..slices of pizza omg the pesto pizza was amazing..fries,chili cheese dog my niece loved it she said the chili was very good ..I live in the northeast it is n was worth traveling for good food n good service n super clean restaurant well to next time don't won't my buffalo wings to get cold..
Loved the pumpkin pie! Such great flavors.  The chicken was delicious, really crunchy coating but moist on the inside. Rice pudding was yummy, too.
Great homemade pasta, and a great delivery spot.
Still my favorite place for pizza, again delivered as promised. IF you live in Kearny don't look any further stop and check it your self.

I'm a Woodbridge CT born and raised girl and I come home about every two to three months. the first place I go to eat is Consiglio's in Little Italy.  I get on Rt 34 and shoot over to Little Italy - go by Yale NHH and battaboom battabang I'm there.  Anything and everything is oh soooo good and the wine selection is awesome.  This time I was surprised to find them opening at 4:30 with a Happy Hour special of small plates for $5.00.  Man was it the best.  The prices are not too high - the quality man it's the quality that makes what it well worth the cost.  There is no other restaurant in New Haven (or anywhere else for that matter) that meets this family's tradition of excellent Italian food.

yeah I came here and spotted a pig alright lol Tons of people pigging out on burgers haha I came here bc I heard a lot of hype on the burger but honestly I dont understand why.   Not my cup of tea but hey its not for everyone
loveeeeeeeeeeeeeee it!!!
yes i think u r the best~!!
yes i got it!

Horrible! I ordered a taco salad to be delivered. It consisted of ground beef (no taco seasoning), soggy nacho chips, lettuce, tomatoes, CUCUMBERS (when is the last time you saw a taco with cucumbers) and NO CHEESE! It was so gross that I threw it away after a couple of bites. I only gave this place a star because they gave a generous amount of this horrible salad and the delivery driver was super nice!

I have been a huge fan of Guacamole Restaurant since it opened.  I thought they had the best Mexican food in the area, even better than Honest Tom's.  And I really liked the owners.  But i wonder if there is a new owner or a new cook.  I just picked up tacos and burritos today, and they were terrible.  Awful.  Horrible.  I had a few bites and threw the whole order into the trash.  Greasy fried  onions, enough fried (??) cilantro to serve all of Mexico City, American cheese slices (??), left-over tossed salad rolled into the burrito....nothing like the fresh, excellent, best-in-Philadelphia tacos and burritos that I've always enjoyed.  WHAT HAPPENED?  Other Guacamole fans, please advise?  Was this just a bad night----shall I try again?
Wasn't overly impressed. But the staff was very friendly and the food was very good with good portion sizes.

I love everything about Union Jack's.  The employees are super friendly and upbeat every time I'm in there. The "cor blimey" with fried pickles and chipotle sauce (a staff recommendation when I didn't know what I wanted) may be the best sandwich I've ever eaten. As far as I'm concerned, the best sandwich shop in burlington if you factor in the friendly service, delicious food, reasonable pricing and ease of parking.

It's true...Nonna is really  making your dinner. I enjoyed a creamy white lasagna with asparagus and fresh lasagna noodles. Melt in your mouth goodness! Husband had veal wrapped in eggplant. We love our dinner.  If your visiting NYC, I would suggest making reservations here for an evening treat after a visit to the Statue of Liberty  or 911 memorial since you'll  be near the SI  Ferry.
Simply the best around.

While the food was good, the service was very lacking.  After running the NYC Marathon 11/2, I was set to meet up with a group for a private party.  Myself and two others arrived a little before and wanted to get a bit of light fare to tide us over until our party was able to go upstairs.    The server told us we couldn't order.  We inquired why and informed that we planned to join our party when they arrived but want to get at least an appetizer or salad and again told we could.  Next we were told we could order but that we would be taken out of the private party.  Ridiculous!! What kind of establishment doesn't want to take additional  money for service when offered.  Finally the manager had to be called to straighten things out.  We were on the verge of walking out to another place to get something.   I don't' plan on returning.

I had bfast on 11/17/15 at 8:30 am.  The atmosphere is wonderful with the hanging baskets, delicious aromas and old-world Italia ambience.  Staff is  friendly and patient.  The breakfast platter was fresh and delicious,  the cappucino was to die for.  It is wonderful that First n Last has kept the timeless paesano atmosphere of Hartford's southend. A great place to go to bring back memories of the "old" days of Hartford. Every Bulkeley High School attendee will love it, as will all others who want a relaxing breakfast with huge picture windows overlooking Maple Ave:-)  NB Parking in the front lot can look crowded, but there is plenty more parking in the back of the building.

I love penang. Always very happy with the food. Large variety of different shrimp dishes. Great presentation on some as well. Sweet and sour shrimp is great, its not the typical Chinese type. And there is an appetizer with shrimp inside alittle fried pocket thing lol, I forget the name but they are really unique and delicious.

Went for breakfast, Cinnabon pancakes were great, bagel was good my GF's super spicy burrito was good but not spicy.  Cool joint and good service.  One complaint, the bacon was awful. Hard to make bad bacon but it was rubbery and absolutely no taste. Upsetting but all in all good food and will be back

Excellent!!  Always a must when in the neighborhood.. I usually go for the pita with harissa falafel with everything on it. Also must try the platters and Sabichi, sooo good!!! Look out for daily falafel specials with different variety everyday!

So here is I love this place this is second time here and can't wait to come back , usually I go next dor to federal donuts ,,,,I ordered masala dosa and chicken vindaloo which one was spicy but I love it ,,,,go there and try

I was very impressed with the food at Cielo.  Anthony certainly knows how to fill a hungry man's stomach.  The food was tasty and the portions were of GOOD SIZE.  The Veal Florentine was my favorite and possibly one of the best meals I've ever had.  The stuffed meatball and rock shrimp Arrabbiata were also excellent.  I can't wait to go back!!

I love this place. Nice after work spot to grab a bite and watch the game. The decor is beautiful. The burgers, chicken fingers, and fries are delicious! Kar the bartender kept my drinks coming as fast as I could blink. Probably the quickest bar service I've had. Excellent service!
Had the Goloso, it was great. I'd go back to try others, prices are good too.

Completely agree with E.R.  Letter I just wrote to management: I have been frequenting your restaurant for 10+ years and have always enjoyed the authentic and delicious Spanish food.   Saturday was a special occasion, as I was treating my friend for his birthday (who is also a frequent diner).  Unfortunately the experience was a complete disappointment.  Upon seating, we were greeted by the sommelier - she was great.  From here, it went downhill.   The food was mediocre, at best... was there an issue in the kitchen?  What made it worse was our waiter was nowhere to be found.  Not once were we asked "how is everything?"  When our final tapa came out (pulpo), it was inedible so I finally asked the person behind the bar if he was our waiter and he said "of course I am "in an obnoxious tone.  We sent it back and while we wanted to order more food and drinks, we were so frustrated that we just got the check.   I'd like to know the following: -were there issues in your kitchen that evening? -was there a staffing issue? I have taken clients to your restaurant and many special friends.  While I am hoping this is an isolated experience, I'm not sure since the food AND service were unacceptable.
favorite place for pizza and Italian food. If you don't believe me try it for your self and you won't be disappointed.

I ordered takeout from this place, so I walked in to pick up my grinder. Guy tells me my total: $10.60. I pull out $11, and he puts the money in the cash register and doesn't give me any change. He proceeds to immediately go to the back (Still visible from the cash register), and pulls out some bread for another order. At no point does he wash his hands, as he continues dressing the bread and getting my order wrapped up. Grabbed my grinder, and immediately threw it in the trash. I will never order from this place again. It's unsanitary, and someone should call the health inspector.

Ok, it was tasty but def not worth a 2 hour wait! The cocktails were yummy and the food was just  alright - nothing mindblowing. A little overpriced. I mean, maybe if I didn't have to wait 2 hours I would've been a little more enthused.

Wow! This place is awesome. The Morning After sandwich is unlike anything I have ever had. It's a must try. Also the wings and clam chowder are right on. Salmon tartare forget about it!  If you have room leftover Ancho Chili Brownies or Lava Cake with Oreo Crust I highly recommend. Crazy good cocktail list. Will definitely be going back for more. This place is a gem. I love the fact you can go in on a Sunday watch a football game and not feel like you in a spots bar.

Awesome food and atmosphere. Complete remodel makes a huge difference; much nicer and more inviting than the previous restaurant. On Rutgers campus; close proximity NJIT and UMDNJ. Grilled Chicken Sandwich and the Skirt Steak are my favorite.

Disaster is all I can say!  As usual these concepts look fancy from the outside but fail to deliver.  A party of six we were.  Although there were these high tech obnoxiously placed IPads, none of us could enter our order because we wanted one check.  One person in our party had to take everyone's drink and food order as if he were the server!  It was unreal!  We received our beverages 15 minutes after we sat down because it took us that long to get everyone's order entered into the IPad.  Once received, they were incorrect.  My hot tea came out 20 minutes into the meal and it was cold.  The server tried to explain how fancy the tea was and how long it needed to steep.  I finally received my hot tea when my meal was complete!  A whole lot of chiefs standing around managing nothing!  Basic steps of service completely removed from the dining experience.  Some of the meals were mediocre at best.  They can keep their iPads and cardboard chicken. I was completely aggravated.....the last thing you need when trying to relax after TSA check in.

L'Artusi is just GREAT, and it deserves a review in the mothertongue =)   Mi sono trovato a passare casualmente, ed ho trovato quest'ottima paninoteca I panini sn belli grandi e leggeri.  Semoline e sfilatini cotti a legna. Salumi italiani, e mozzarella di bufala che arriva via aereo ogni settimana. Tutti gli ingredienti sono ottimi, io uso come prova del nove i ''sundried tomatoes'': quando il posto e' scarso, questi sn un po' acidi e pieni di olio, invece quelli di Carmelo sono dolci e saporiti. Robba bona!
By far the best tasting Malay food! Reminds me of Singapore.  Beef Rendang was my fav!
Loved it.  Greta food, service and ambience. A bit pricey, but all really good.
THIS PLACE IS SO OVER RATED its good but its normal good 30 bucks? this is for ppl who have nothing beter to do than waste money on bs.
This is the worst pizza I have ever had in my entire life.
Meal was served super fast during busy hours. Staff is generally friendly but forgot a dish we ordered.

I've never had a bad experience here. It's always good and it's always fresh too. Sometimes the lines get long but they move pretty quickly so you never wait too long. Like others have said previously, don't expect to stay here and eat. There's about 6 barstools and when the place gets crammed it's almost impossible to sit there and eat anyways.
Definetlly a place for group of friends sit down and bullshitting, great food and service. I have been there 5 times and will keep on going. Best hot pot in town!

My favorite sushi place hands down! Their lobster roll and amazing rolls are fantastic! Service is alway great. I just wish they didn't close midday, seems like I always end up there when they are closed.  Have been there many times and am addicted to all of their appetizers!
The best place to eat in Brooklyn, hands down! Good coffee, good service, the food is incredible, they nail it every time without fail. Thank you Five Leaves!!
Best Iskender plate I have ever had. If you're looking for atmosphere this might not be the place. But if you come for the food, you won't be sorry. Fast and fresh. Really outstanding!

Honestly, I eat sushi all the time and have gone to many restaurants, but Yamada is my favorite. Charlie, the owner is soooo friendly. He always greets me on first name basis, so it makes me feel great that not o my does he remember my name, but also some of my favorite rolls. The sushi is fresh and before we leave, he always gives us a complimentary taste of some new rolls he is making for tomorrow's special. I HIGHLY recommend coming here and it's also BYOB!!

I was introduced to this restaurant today at lunch for a business meeting. The restaurant is handicapped accessible which was great since one of our party was in the wheelchair. The restaurant does not have a liquor license so it's BYOB. I had an Escarole and Bean Soup which was outstanding. Following that was a Chicken Marsala panini which was large enough to share or bring home- I did the latter. My colleagues had Lasagna and a Chicken Special both of which were beautifully presented and served. Can't save enough good things about the place. Enjoy!

I like their food, I LOVE their online ordering option. For over a year I ordered lunch from them once  a week to be delivered, and things went marvelously, tasty food, on-time...ish delivery I've  An hour after my food was due I called to find out what was up, only to be lied to by an employee ("it should be there any minute" when in actuality they had not noticed my order come in so it was not even in process) It took an additional twenty minutes for my food to arrive. I sent their website an email detailing my complaint and received a hasty apology. Maybe I'm just hard to please but that was inadequate.  Were I in their shoes and there was this kind of blatant error, I would have offered something - any little boon. 10% off your next order (that would probably end up being around $2), free 20-ounce beverage on your next order, etc etc. There are any number of very inexpensive options to regain good-will with your customers. On the plus side, my budget's looking a lot better now that I don't order

I have gone for many private parties, lunches and dinner and I am never disappointed!This Farm to Table experience is a must! I've had many things on the menu, stuffed artichokes, crab cakes, scallops, mussels, hailbut, filet mignon, short ribs, baked gnochi and cheese, foie gras, blue cheese mash, etc. and everything is always better than the next!!  They also offer delicious local wine from Unionville winery, the Rose is Delcious! This is my favorite restaurant! I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE, it there! The food is delicious and  fresh!  The presentation is always beautiful! The staff is courteous and always goes above and beyond to make sure you have a great experience! Try it!  I promise you will not be disappointed!

2 .5 hrs for entrées. Service is completely unacceptable. One of my friends odered meat lasagna and was given cheese lasagna.  Just another overrated Montclair restaurant that should have not opened until they look up what timely service means.
Great happy hour oyster special  and great New England clam chowder. Definitely recommend!
This place was amazing, best soup and burger I have ever had, each dish had so much flavor in it and the service was excellent

Cute little bar upstairs and downstairs. A lot of beers on tap to choose from. I ordered the pot of meat balls (more like tiny cock of 4 tiny store bought meatballs) but I guess that's not a cool app name. The garlic bread with it was stale. So that's $3 a meatball. The 8 re fried chicken wings for $12 were burnt and ehh. It's bar food not bad but not good.
The service is fast and the Quality is out of this world!
This is one of my favorite spots for brunch in the city! Great food and attentive service! Their sticky toffee date cake is delicious - must must try!
Very small, not good for more than 2 really, but that is fine. The omelette was quite large (3-4 eggs i'd guess) and also served with potatoes and salad. The food was good, the ambiance was ok.

Wow where to start with this horrible chain restaurant?  I knew walking in that there was a reason I haven't been to a Ruby Tuesday's for over a decade.   First lets start with the cardinal sin of the universe...they ran out of bacon on the salad bar.  Ok I might be able to overlook that MAYBE!!!   Next the ribs I ordered were not like the other two that were on the table, when I pointed out that mine was lacking sauce and looked undercooked or old.  The solution????  Bring me extra sauce.   Well alright please take this back and bring nothing thanks.   Drinks ran empty was another Cardinal sin plus the waiter brought the wrong drink on several times and assured us that they were correct.   I'm pretty sure we know what drinks we are drinking.   So perhaps in another decade I will try this sad excuse for an establishment.  Or than again perhaps not! On the good side, it is close to the Marriott.

This is the best place to get crab in Brooklyn. I come here all the time for pickup or just to eat there. It would be nice if they served alcohol but it's still just delicious food they serve. Highly recommended.

The outstanding Tequila and Mezcal selection alone at Xixa warrants a visit. I'm by no means an expert or even that knowledgable when it comes to Tequilas or Mezcals. I hadn't heard of most of the ones on the menu. Have no fear, the bartenders and wait staff were especially helpful at navigating the selection.  If straight up Tequila is not your thing, the cocktail list is full of great drinks, I especially enjoyed the Cubed cocktails. After a small wait and a cocktail we headed to our table. Sharing small plate Tapas is always fun. For our party of four, we were told 10-12 dishes would suffice. Our favs were the Roasted Burrata Queso, the Seasonal Guacamole, grilled Carrots and definitely the Cornish Hen (counts as 2 dishes). The Churros with the meringue sauce were a great finish to a solid meal. #oldguysyelptoo

I walked in by coincidence and had a wonderful experience. The pancakes were delicious. I loved the idea of ordering food and drinks at the bar and paying right there. The food was served quickly (not too quick :-)) and we could leave, once we had finished. Would recommend it to anybody.
Great staff, wonderful food and loved the atmosphere.
Great burgers, fish tacos, pork belly tacos, and lychee soju! I've been here multiple times and plan on going back for more!
Brilliant!! Fabulous steak selection. Had a work dinner here and loved it. Of course you have to have a few of the Brazilian sugar cane drinks!! Pricey but you get what you pay for!

Was a friend's 60th birthday so we did a chef's table reservation for a party of 9 and, without exception, all of our party said that this was the best meal that they have ever had.  Started out with bruschetta with roasted butternut squash paste with sautéed sage on top, mixed greens with a light vinagarette.  Next came shaved, raw brussel sprouts with roasted hazelnuts and a lemon, olive oil & pecorino romano dressing (out of this world!); next a plate of assorted Italian meats i.e. prosciutto, salami, etc. with fabulous bread and breadstricks; next was gnocchi and apple/lemon risotto platters, then 3 entrees, monkfish, chicken and spareribs, served with browned & salted potatoes (all outstanding!) - and finally, deserts, assorted Italian cookies and a lovely chocolate mousse like desert topped with whipped cream and drizzled with chocolate that was wonderful.  Accompanied by many bottles of a great Barolo and ended with coffees and cappuccinos - Evan was our server and he was fabulous, attentive, fun and accommodating.  I will go back here in a New York heartbeat when I am next in NYC.
The very first time I went here I wasn't happy but I went there last night and I was pleasantly surprised. Maybe they are under new management or something. Deff coming back here soon :)
Absolutely awesome. Great pies and good beer. Good place to get together with friends!

Best Mexican food in NYC. Yes, I mean it! Extremely authentic cuisine from Puebla. Not your typical boring Rosa Mexicana menu. This is the REAL DEAL. If you're not into delicious home cooked recipes that require hours of prep and slow cooking, this is not the place for you! Margaritas are all unique and tasty, and I love the Micheladas.
Just finishing an excellent lunch. Empire burger and fish tacos. However, we are fleeing in haste because the heating system is blowing freezing air!!  Definitely a buzz kill. Oops.

I work a few miles away. I LOVE the #1 sandwich and many times order the soup. while in there, I browse the nick nacks...from ear candles to soaps to incense and trinkets. Great environment with tasty food that doesn't make you sluggish after eating it. Plus, the little "Dan's chocolates" they sell at the register are the perfect size for apres lunch :)  Keep it up!
Not only was the food amazing, the staff was extremely nice! The waitress helped us pick the food and the sides that would go with it , they even gave us samples of things to try.

This place lives up to its award of best pizza in New York by Zagat. The pizza here is really really good. It is awesome that they offer vegan pizzas. My friend is a vegan so it couldn't be more perfect dining here. We got the Ricotta Da Vegan with basil. It is so good and clearly not enough between the who of us. The service was impeccable, the servers were very attentive to our table. Paulie also made his way to our table to make sure everything is up to par. This made us feel special, and of course everything was great. The price is reasonable for NYC. I would come back for sure.

I have been there with my girlfriend for a Sunday brunch. Compared to other places in NYC, it was easy to get a table. Food is nice, although options are a bit limited. Staff wasn't really nice though. The girl serving us was rude from minute one and she kept on ignoring our requests. I had to fetch coffee myself because she would not bring it to us. I understand that brunch time is busy on a Sunday, but perhaps they should think about hiring new people

Price says $6 on menu but they charge whatever they think they can get, $10, Then says he "didn't have proper change take a can of orange soda instead of change.  I should have expected as much.  Kabab was tough as the bottom of my shoe but the rice was good!    So if you want good middle eastern rice they do have that.

Great appetizers that included calamari and pork belly.  Entrees were well cooked and delicious.  I had a burger and a friend had a great steak. The atmosphere is great for catching up with friends.  There was also live music which also added to the atmosphere.

The guacamole is pretty good. Very fresh made to order. Las flautas...mmmm. Yummy. And the tostadas. Won't be able to eat like this for much longer, but it's worth the tummy ache of not being able to stomach much of any food. So good. Oh, and they didn't get five stars because they only accept cash, and I NEVER carry cash.

I totally agreed with Ronald S!!  The oil from this place has a very strange taste.  It's a new restaurant, it shouldn't be old oil.  The aftertaste will stop me to come back to this place.  There is better options for a stone's throw away.  The buffet at Priya is much better and MMumbai Spice is very good as well.  At least I never had the strange aftertaste. The two stars is for the environment but it actually left from the previous restaurant.  Oh, it made me miss Tamarind more, love their sizzling beef!!
Ocean prime made my boss's birthday the most memorable ever.  Wondering what took them so long to open for lunch.
Very cute place with a large selection of Mediterranean dishes,  I had the $12 soup and sandwich for lunch. You can't beat that. Cool place.

I work around the area and my colleagues mentioned this restaurant had good food and was very inexpensive for a decent amount of food. So I decided to stop by and check it out for myself.... Appearance wise it is very elegant and everything from tables, chairs and cups are in tact although I'm not sure why the hostess is placed in the outside area where it is freezing cold where she was literally wearing a coat (that is torture! Especially in New York winter weather) I originally placed my order for take out because I was on my lunch and I planned to take it back to my job and eat it there boy was that a mistake! I only ordered a small appetizer (salchipapa) because I never have a huge appetite and because I thought it would be easy to cook and get out quickly the hostess reassured I would get my food quickly because it was so small but that was untrue because it took me 25 mins to get my food and at that point I just asked for it to be considered a stay in because I already wasted half of my lunch by just waiting. So what did I learn here? Umm, to call in advance for pick up or take out! Overall the food was good but then again it's just French fries and small bits of hotdogs. The bar area is pretty decent with many options to drink.
Place sucks big time!  Took over an hour to get simple wings and fries.  You don't want to go here. Never again!!!!! Ever!
Delicious!
Best cheesesteaks in the City!! Greet customer service too and fast.

Want to love this place as I live in the area.  However, if you can't figure out how to make a chicken sandwich where the bread does not completely swallow up the protein then why bother with the dated idea of foie gras scallops.  Who in their right mind is craving foie scallops at a neighborhood spot?  Perhaps you feel people will take flight to philadelphia to try your take on a dated Le bec fin dish when even they could no longer prove successful with such dated material.  The burger is dry, bland, boring and rather pathetic.  The service was rude, slow and took no notice of the amount of food untouched.  However, I have had very friendly service there in the past so this last time was a one time occurrence.  The space is great and the neighborhood is primed for this spot to be great!  I've heard neighbors complain of the food and the chicken sandwich specifically.  They want a great neighborhood place and not some wannabe Thomas Keller .  A green circle chicken sandwich, Lafrieda burger or dry aged burger, a couple light but acidic salads maybe with seasonal veg, a proper steak without some bordelaise where I doubt the classical bone marrow monte is present.  If the chef wants to be creative throw in an octopus dish or toro sashimi warmed over a salt rock with Uni powder.  Just nail the basic stuff first and people will come.  Btw, petite filets are from 1980 and these days people would rather have a solid hangar steak with lettuce cups and kimchee, or fries and mayo.

I went here last Sunday afternoon with my girlfriend and her friends. The drinks were good but the bartender was rude, unabashed and borderline insulting. I've been told that the staff of some establishments will act like this to give one an "authentic" New York experience. We did not appreciate it and he did not seem to be picking that up at all. There are many other places to have a drink in Manhattan. I won't be going back to The Bar Room.
Good food, great ambiance. Pork chop is good and the calamari is delicious
Delicious burgers and shakes! Lots of seating and fun, family friendly atmosphere! Only complaint is that I wish the burgers were bigger!

Cute little place to hang out with friends. We ordered the crawlfish with very spicy sauce. It is addictive, yes! Eating directly from a huge plastic bag and throwing the shells into the bucket on the table, sounds like a lot of fun, Huh? Recommend it!  Well, there is always a long line, but it is definitely worth the waiting!
the food here is fantastic. lunch time gets a little crowded with tourists. great place to enjoy a meal and a good glass of wine.

I don't usually write reviews but could not pass on this one. this was our first time to order from this BBQ place, and one time too many... the portions were big, seems like they're trying to compensate quality with quantity, given the portion size the have a lot to compensate on. there is a lot of vegetables, big leaves of boiled cabbage with no seasoning whats so ever, salt?. I can't say that ribs were dry, it will be understatement, they were burnt and tasteless. the chicken was dry but ok. giving 2 stars instead of 1 in hope that this was just bad day for them, but won't order again.
Easier to just drive ten minutes to get my delivery food.  1 1/2 hrs later and still waiting

I was in the neighborhood looking for a cozy, inexpensive spot for dinner, when Paprika came out in our search and it was the right choice. Restaurant was about half full (it is also freezing outside). The service was good, personable but very unpretentious, what I liked. We got two glasses of red wine, you can't go wrong with Chianti and ordered our dinner. I had their special artichoke salad and my husband had beef carpaccio.
