Both of the appetizers were fresh and flavorful. I am usually not a fan of artichoke, but decided to try it and loved that it was an actual salad, rather than whole artichoke. Our entrees were heavenly good. Honestly, I eat out pretty often, but not as often I get quality, mouthful dishes. I had black ink linguini with seafood. And my husband had a steak. I honestly suggested him not to have a steak as I only prefer to get steaks in steakhouses, but this was surprisingly good, all you can ask for in a steak. Overall, we will be back when are in the neighborhood.
Do not eat here. Very plain rolls are over $10 and they are not good at all. I don't think these people know how to make good sushi.

Not what you would expect from the outside. Much bigger & more chique inside, but despite being large it was very very crowded when our group went on a Friday night. Waiters were a little 'hispter'ish' but did explain the food well, they were not so great on their knowledge of wines. I would recommend they take a crash course in pairings. Serving time was decent for how crowded it was (took out table of 6 about 20-25mins for starters to arrive). The food was delicious but in the $$$$ range. Budget for about $150 per person if you want a full dinner & drinks.
Awesome food and excellent service! Even my picky 3yo son loved the delightful vanilla bean French toast!

This is the second time coming here and I must say its pretty good, my favorite is the fried chicken and original tonkatsu ramen, the miso is ok has a strong sesame flavor and takoyaki is a bit salty for me but over all love especially for the price!! :)

One of my favorite all time places to eat.  If you love Thai food you have go to Little Thai Market and order the salmon with red curry sauce for $7.  Absolute heaven!  Get there before noon because the lines get long.
Woohoo! As good as it gets! .
The bagel box is by far the best bagel in town . Friendly staff and quick service . Plus very reasonably priced . I recommend to everyone !

I usually avoid touristy places but this place was too good to ignore, delicious, and it reminds me of my grandmother's cooking. If you're visiting New York City , this is a must go. P.S the Soup dumplings are the main focus , it should be the first thing you order there
Don't even bother to read these reviews and come here and eat their food. You will not regret it.

I've been at several locations of this chain especially when I get the craving for "fried food".  Healthy menu items are limited and salads are made with "ICEBERG LETTUCE" ?????.  I thought they stopped farming that crap. Recently had a craving and ordered from the Montclair store which was significantly overpriced. One of the worst options for Spanish food in Essex County.
Omg. I love this place. Just for the pizza and ices. Everything else is crap. Eat the squares and slices. Enjoy an ice after. Always fresh

Food is great but service us horrific.  Called an order in at 6:00 requesting pickup at 7:00.  Dinner for one so not too difficult.  Arrived a bit early and fine that food wasn't ready.  However far from happy when I didn't get my food until 7:18.  Got home and the free dessert for aggravation was there but not my soup.  I called and asked that they use their restaurant can to drive the 1.2 miles and drop it off, was told that they don't deliver.  Told the that since it was not close to the first time their take out was wrong, they could keep my soup money and lose my business.  They did.
The drinks are so fantastically strong I don't remember what the hell I ate, but thank God I Instagrammed it. Looks like it was probably tasty. I'd go back again. And drink again. For sure.

I agree with the other posts. This place is really awful. The night waitress was really rude, ruined the whole meal so can't even say anything good about the food. The waitress needs a lesson on health codes or a visit with the healh department. she took dirty glasses from one table by inserting her hand into the glasses then proceeded to the next table to fill water glasses. She was training another waitress so I hope she does not use the same unhealthy practices. Not a good experience.
By far one of my favorite places whenever I'm near St Marks. Hot or cold soba all day every day. Also try the Maguro-don - the tuna is super fresh

not to thrilled with this place however its pretty cheap. The customer service could be better especially for a new place. You need to make sure your employees are in top shape ready to go and bring in that business ! I think this was a one time deal for me though The food is ok nothing special I say give it time and this place could probably do well
The food is fresh and yumm... Get your wine and enjoy the food..

My husband and I love to try new restaurnts in New York. Based on reviews and recommendations, were expecting a great french meal at the Simone but we're very disappointed. Our scallops and flounder, which were ordinary, did not measure up to the wonderful meals we have had in Paris or Washington. Also, our lemon tart was impossible to cut. Our waiter was very attentive but the best service is reserved for regulars.

Went to Hillstone last night surprisingly busy for Thursday night...we made reservations for 6:15 and we waited for about 5 min and immediately were seated. Loved the ambiance, the colors, the jazz playing in the background. The food took about 30 minutes however the manager Sophia came to our table and acknowledged that our food would be next...we told her we were celebrating my moms b-day and so at the end the waitress Lindsay surprised us with a delicious dessert. Amazing!! Steaks were delicious and the Brussels sprouts and fries were to die for. Over all great place, not too quiet nor too loud and all the waiters and runner were constantly smiling loved that. Definitely got to check out the bar next time looked like fun..lot of hotties ha.

This is one of my favor stake restaurants.     Our family loves this restaurant.   Food is really good and all people who work there are very kind.    Very organized and clean.   I love almost all kinds of food from their menu.    Once a while, if you don't make an appointment you have to wait.   So, it will be excellent idea to make a reservation before you go.    100% sure they will hold your spot.

Hillstone Restaurant on 53rd street and 3rd Ave in NYC  has found the secret for a successful restaurant experience.  Resident New Yorkers, my wife and I eat out often.  At Hillstone we have always encountered smiling, helpful, attractive, and attentive servers.  The food is excellent.  We have had salmon, ribs, their burger and their amazing strip steak.  We cannot say enough about that strip steak; it is juicy, tender, flavorful and seared to perfection.  It is actually enough for two. And their desserts are terrific as well.   For the quality, we find their prices absolutely worth it! Mike A.
best sichuan food in hartford area
Best bar in the City. Great food, cold Miller Lites. Bartender Keith rocks tell him Bear sent you. Cloth napkins to Boot.
The food was homemade, delicious, fresh AND inexpensive. Oxtails and pepper steak, Mac n Cheese, and carimanolas... Yummy!!!
I love this place; Best sushi in the area! Although it can be a little pricy, the sushi is good and it is a byob so you can enjoy dinner with a glass of wine. My favorite roll is the Yumi Yumi roll!
Food wasn't very filling, it was a tight squeeze at our table, you pay for the ambience.
The best Malaysian restaurant in the city. I go there all the time and take all my friends there!! Love it. Highly recommend it.
House of Small Wonder is aptly named.  Cosy, intimate, perfect for breakfast or lunch with a friend or lover, or by oneself.

Service is always great! My server Lulu was very nice and very informative. The Manager came around and checked on us, she was very nice. The ambiance was very warm and romantic. I love the live music. The food was great. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone.

My pasta dish tasted too oily.  The appetizers were great.  It was noisy. The service was very nice.  Two out of the six did not like their dishes and four people really did.  I would go back despite my dish not terrific.  All the desserts tasted wonderful.

Awesome place to get huge authentic Italian sandwiches. I have been here numerous times now and have never been disappointed. I also have never finished one of there sandwiches in one sitting either. All the meats and cheeses are imported from Italy and the bread is baked fresh every day in Brooklyn. The most recent sandwich I had was the Pisillo panini. Prosciutto, porchetta, bufala mozzarella, arugula, roasted peppers and balsamic. Absolute perfection! I can't recommend this place highly enough.
Great atmosphere. Great Tacos. Great prices. Great Margaritas. Great service. What more do you need to know?

Fantastic. Came here for lunch on a Local's recommendation. 18.95 for an endless supply of three fresh pastas. Wine at $25/bottle. Lemon chicken amazing. Casual dress for lunch, not sure about dinner. Dining area seating is close, but clientele is very friendly. Wait staff is also friendly and helpful. We are definitely coming here again
Great burger great fries.  Get the break room everything.  A bit heavy but super delicious and satisfying.  Great service as well
Great pie and my boyfriend is enjoying his sandwich and friend mushrooms! Nice place to meet up with family.
Amazing service on the 3rd floor from Brooke!! Comp small bites on occasion. High ballers are a small twist on basic well drinks

Amazing service. WONDERFUL food! I havent eaten anything from here that I didnt love. My husband and I go to NY every couple of years, and we always eat here a few times during our visit. It is worth the wait to be seated, but if you dont want to wait, go when they open :)

Situated in East Village, ssam is considerably different than noodle bar and milk bar.  At ssam they have decent drinks and a menu that seems fairly top-chef like.  Don't come here if you're hungry because you pay $18 for 4 bites of quail.  Very good tasting food.  Not enough for a real meal...if you know what I mean.  Seating can be crazy on nights but not as bad as noodle bar.  Milk is next door.
I asked for a coffee drink and the bartender concocted an impromptu cocktail with a great mix of liqueurs. Fun and professional service, and a good price.

Completely overrated, the place was dirty,  the service was shitty, they didn't know which table ordered what between mine and the one next to ours, the broth and noodles were decent but nothing amazing. I think this place is all hype.
This is my fav place in the Village, amazing food! I've probably been 20 times. LOVE the hummus, meat balls and gnocchi
Just loved this place. If I lived in NY I'd be here every weekend! I can't find its match in South Florida!

This place is not worth your time. This waitress by the name of Lauren discriminates. My friends were helping me walk because of a sprained ankle. She rudely kicked us out before we even stepped foot into the restaurant and accused us of being drunk. If you want better service, go elsewhere. This Lauren waitress needs to be educated on how to treat patrons.

Maybe this place a little overhyped? Waited  two hours at a cafe nearby to get seated even though we showed up at around 9:30 on a Saturday morning. The pancakes were good but a little too much on the heavy flour-y side. Also wish they accepted cards!

Wing. Beans. Admittedly, this review comes about a month after I've been, but I still think about that dish they had. It was a special with Wing Beans. They were perfectly spiced, the texture was immaculate, and it made my belly happier than it's ever been. To be honest with you, I can't remember the other dishes because I was so enamoured with this. Are they on the regular menu now? I do hope so. The food was delicious in general. Perfect amount of spice tailored to your needs. The presentation was also beautiful without being stuffy. Sevice was impeccable. Again, without it being super upscale fine dining, the staff was friendly from the host to the server, and even the chefs and superbly attentive without being overbearing. It was a great mix of casual with that special element that reminds the patron they're gracious for you being there. On top of that, I loved the special elements on their menu that gives background into Thai culture and specific meanings of words or how to enjoy a dish. This restaurant is the whole experience. Amazing service, amazing food, and lovely cultural background. We would go back in a heartbeat. It's definitely one if those restaurants you want to bring your out of town friends and family to.
I must say this place is awesome form the fried pickles to the atmosphere. The descent selection of music; not too loud so u can still have a descent convo.

Definitely a must. I came ready to brave the cold and eat outside, but was pleasantly surprised to see that they recently renovated the inside! It's small, but just enough space to enjoy your food and also see them cooking/baking in their food fire hearth oven. The staff was friendly and helpful and man was the food good. We came twice in two days--the first we made would own sandwich, and the second day we got their daily special breakfast sandwiches. The eggs were poached perfectly, the toppings flavorful yet not overpowering the amazing bread. Stump town coffee on tap was a plus!
very nice environment! the dishes were creative but delicious! most important, it was not expensive at all, what it offered worth for the money!
Fantastic, but pricey
Beastie Boys and falafel.. my favorite combo.  Always make sure to see if there any long hots left on the side car condiments station.

Friday night dinner with my Italian/German family (4 of us).  We all LOVE Indian food.  Small place in a busy strip mall. First.  Water.  They have 16oz water bottles out on the table for $1.99 each.  I asked for tap water.  The guy looked at me funny, but smiled and said OK.  He brought out ONE glass of water.  I then asked for 3 more.  I got 3 more.  NEVER ONCE did anyone refill water.  One staff member in charge - maybe the owner(?) - passed by our table & said hello. When my 10 yr old said he needed more water, he told my son to open the bottle.  I have NEVER been to an Indian restaurant that didn't constantly fill and refill water... usually leaving pitchers at the table!!  Not these cheapskates. Second.  The decor.  Nicely decorated.  It LOOKED warm & inviting.  Truly, the place was FREEZING.  It was a cold night & there's no barrier to the door.  Build a weather barrier wall - geez!  I looked around & everyone had their coats on, including everyone at my table but me, who had it stuffed on my lap.  Besides, even if we wanted to take them off... it was a small booth & there were no coat hooks or a coat rack.  We'd have been out of luck. Third.  The service.  The wait staff were pleasant people.  That's it.  They didn't refill our water.  They weren't efficient either.  Our meal - 4 dishes in total plus naan & rice - was brought out piecey - a couple dishes at a time.  I kept asking for rice because we had everything BUT rice..  and here's my other NEVER.  I've never been to an Indian restaurant where I've had to ASK for rice!!  Serving utensils with our main dishes were NOT provided, but we asked for them (I'm all for eating with my hands, but not from the main dishes!). No one ever came back to ask us how we were doing.  I would've otherwise told them they got 1 order wrong & that we needed more water. The food.  The lamb of the Lamb Vindaloo was game-y.  It should sorta melt in your mouth but it was TOUGH.  The Aloo Gobhi tasted WEIRD.  So weird.  Don't order it.  The naan... well, my son said it was "rotten."  Dry & not soft at all.  I get better frozen stuff at Trader Joe's.  We had Dal that was yummy.  They messed up the Chicken Biryani order - we wanted boneless.  The chicken on the bone was still yummy, but not awesome. The rice it came with was AWESOME!  Also, the spice level was WONDERFUL!  I hate when they tone it down - turn it up!  And it was!! I will never go back.  I suggest ordering out so you can stay warm & well-hydrated.  The spice level was great, but the taste & preparation was not great.  I hope there's better out there.

This place is AWESOME. The Sloppy Joe was OUTSTANDING. The jalapeños are a great touch. The mulled wine served in an apple was on point and absolutely perfect for the freezing cold NYC night. Great atmosphere, amazing music. The staff was beyond welcoming and made for a great experience. Ill be back next time I'm downtown. Check it out!!!

Excellent customer service the food was amazing especially  that delicious desert with the goat cheese and strawberry jam with the speculoos omg amazing I suggest Mike be the one to take care of anyone he's brilliant and very helpful and attentive THANKS A TON MIKE FROM ANELL AND WILMER
Awesome pizza and I love it on Sunday's! Good taste for the price! The location is convenient and the staff is friendly. It's not a big place but it's great to stop for a quick bite.

Came for my daughter birthday, nice old fashion NYC restaurant, generous portions, Great Fettuccine Alfredo, good fried calamari, average Spaghetti and meatballs and dessert anyways I'll come back and highly recommend give it a try for lunch or dinner.

After years of driving past the Arlington Diner. My wife and I thought it might be time to give it a try. We got there about 9:00 pm and were seated immediately by a grey haired gentleman. From there it was all downhill. Despite the fact that the place was about a quarter full. Our waitress was not much in the mood for waitressing. We ordered our meals and waited a good half an hour for our food to arrive. By the time it did  come, our coffee was cold and the whole town of Kearny seemed to be suffering from a coffee bean shortage. The food itself was something out of an episode of Restaurant Impossible. Tasteless, flavorless, luke warm crap that tasted like something out of the frozen section of the nearby Walmart. I could swear I was hearing the sound of a microwave timer from the nearby kitchen. When the waitress finally came around to check on us, she saw my plate was more than half full. "Wan't to get that to go?" "No, definitely not." "Maybe for lunch tomorrow?" "Thanks, but I really don't want to relive this moment." As we drove off, I could feel my stomach beginning to take a turn for the worst. It was the first, the last, the worst.

Tucked away on an unassuming South Williamsburg block is the most magical coffee coffee place I've ever had the pleasure of entering. While many cafes set out to achieve the kind of cozy, inviting vibe that radiates throughout Mountain Province, few succeed because they lack the thread that ties it all together, an owner who cares not only about the quality of the coffee and food he serves, but about his customers. Ray is behind the counter every day, but he doesn't just remember names and "the usual", he knows the details. It's why ever detail of Mountain Province is carefully thought out and executed. It's why it quickly became a neighborhood staple. It's why you see only five stars and read only rave reviews. Try the breakfast muffin and wonder how he makes it that delicious with no butter. Just try not to like everything about this place.
Great location. Go see the skyline of New York at sunset and then head over for a great pizza! Great food and the staff was really nice.

Great service and food! We were in town for a conference and looked up good places to have a drink and a relaxing dinner.  The cheese plate was great but I cannot say enough abt the gnocchi! It was outstanding. Recommend for sure.

My favorite Mexican restaurant in the city! The food is delicious and affordable, and the portions are huge. The horchata is also really good, and the salsas are delicious! Can't wait to go back. Service might be a little slow but they are super accommodating. Place is small so call ahead. Points for being BYO as well.

This is not my first BAD experience here. Terrible service. Restaurant was half empty and I was by myself. The only option for seething was the bar close to someone else or the register. I refused and the waiter said "this is what we have sir. ". I left and will never go back. I was in the restaurant business for over 27 years and have seen lots of business with this kind of attitude dying.  I hope this is not another one.

This is a decent spot for takeout when they're not too busy, in which case they have no problem turning you away. Service is not so great though (short girl with tattoos and piercings comes to mind especially). No one is really that friendly and they will absolutely criticize or reject your requests. One time I asked for sausage to be added to my cavatelli entree (which is an option for their pizza for $3) and was flat out denied because the chef did not approve of the pairing (jeez). It probably goes without saying if you live in the neighborhood, but definitely go to Barboncino or Speedy Romeo's instead of you have the opportunity.
Went here during the time it was busy and i got a regular slice. When i received it, it was just warm.... i rather have my pizza hot, but maybe its just because it was busy but still...
Went for a lunch date. LOVED the food, LOVED the atmosphere and LOVED the service.
Huge menu, with a great variety! everything I've ever tried is delicious. Would recommend the ball and chain. My favorite place to get lunch at CCSU
I've eaten here a few times.  Some food is good, some is ok. Entree portions are small though.

Pizza looks like it's going to be really good! Then you take a bite and wonder why wonderful flavor didn't pop in your mouth. Close inspection reveals that they do not use pizza sauce, barely any cheese, and the dough is like 2" thick.  It's really not good pizza at all. The place is clean though! And the staff seems friendly. Just get some real pizza in there and you guys will do fine.

Probably the best indoor market in the country.  You'll find every culinary group in SE PA represented here: Amish, German, Italian, Vietnamese.  Seating can be almost impossible, especially during lunch hour, if you're hoping to eat here.
Best Pizza in Lawrenceville!
There's a waitress named Peggy who works here who gives excellent service! Great food and reasonable prices! I come here regularly
Absolutely amazing place! I just moved to the area a few months ago and just found my new spot. Jamie's is very classy with great people.
yes.  Disappointed.  Nude gnocchi way too salty as were other dishes ordered by friends.
The fries made my day
i love their burger. it's my favorite burger in nyc so far.

Sat upstairs at the Pig.  The bartender was very knowledgeable regarding all the beer selections.  The chicken liver toast was out of this world if you're looking for just a snack to munch on.  Incredible texture and quality.

Had a late night pizza craving after a long day and Fedelos was the only place on my app still open and delivering. I ended up ordering a white pizza with chicken and peppers and it was delicious! The only negatives I can think of was there was a lot of crust and it was a little pricey. I will definitely order again though when that late night craving hits.

Like the legs of a dribbling, smacked-up prostitute, the lore of this East Village Thai spot spreads far and wide, and draws people into the neighborhood by the droves. So by the time I managed to escape work for a lunchtime bite, I had already made up my mind: I was going to love this place -- if not indefinitely, then at least long time. Stepping into this average-sized eatery, you're immediately struck with the sight of an open kitchen in the entryway -- something I found so damn endearing, I literally smiled and practically giggled, but because I was wearing a $10 button-up shirt, didn't to preserve my lofty air of professionalism. It worked. Nobody spat on me. Despite the moderately busy atmosphere, we were met promptly for seating and led to a table that rocked like a hyper-agreeable schizophrenic, which we medicated ourselves with a square of napkin and no complaint. Moments later, our server arrived to take our drinks. Or rather, force us into our only options. She informed us no one could make a cocktail at this hour, but that she'd give it the good ol' college try. We couldn't bear watching her flunk that, though (much less have to stomach it) and instead ordered beers which arrived a quarter empty, at which point I realized I was a huge pessimist. Of our order of pad Thai with chicken, pad Thai with beef, and calamari, the chicken pad Thai and calamari quizzically made it out at the same time. The beef pad Thai came some ten minutes later. While the calamari was beautifully cooked, its sauce a spicy bouquet of curries, soy, and sodium, the pad Thais were oily little affairs which had all the flavor of wet white bread. But it looked nice. It didn't sate the appetite, but it also didn't ruin it. In fact, it didn't leave any sort of impression on the appetite at all. And after this experience, it's the last non-impression it'll ever make on it ever again.

Great food!!! If I could give 10 stars I would. We came here for lunch after a funeral and were about 18 people. The food was amazing. The chicken frances was delicious. The filetto pomodora sauce was out of this world and the service was on point. I would come back everytime I visit New York. If your in the area you must try it out.

I'm glad to have found this place. People were friendly and my eggs were even over medium - no other diner or restaurant ever gets that right. The bacon was perfect, crisp but not greasy, and the home fries were also not greasy. I will definitely go back. I read the reviews before I went & was not put off by the one bad review posted. If your kids don't know how to behave in a restaurant, shame on you for bringing them in and allowing them to run around and play with things. They can get burned or hurt. At the very least it is obnoxious to waitresses and other customers. I highly recommend Chicken Dog Cafe and wish them luck.

I had the pastrami sandwich as I heard they were famous for this item.  I was sorely disappointed, it came with a bunch of lean pastrami between two slices of plain rye bread.  No butter, had to put the mustard on at the table.  The pastrami was nice and lean but had absolutely no flavor whatsoever.  I don't know how so many folks have been conned into thinking this is the best there is.  I know there is better pastrami out there but this place is not where it is.

Just flew in to the city from LA Ordered mama gyro from the taxi..:) $31!!! Food was delivered by time we got to our apartment Great gyro. Chicken skewers & best oregano fries. I give them a 4 cause the yogurt sauce was kind of dry,it needed more yogurt. I will order again Thanks mama gyro

Highly recommended! They have an indoor/ outdoor area, which is great for the summer. The service is always really good and the food is brought out fast. My absolute favorite meal to get is the burnt ends. They are so good they melt in your mouth. Pulled pork, sweet potatoes, and bacon baked beans are always favorites of mine. Another plus is this place is BYOB, so if you're on a budget, bring your own drinks and get the platter choice on the menu for around $30. This will allow you to choose the dishes and sides you love and share them with your friends/family. Love this place. Enjoy!
I got general Tso's chicken. It was very good came with fried rice and miso soup. I would recommend it to anyone looking for good Chinese take out.
I had the Mac& Cheese and Steak Burger. Very juicy and delicious!

Never order delivery on a Friday night! This is now the second week in a row where I was told an hour for delivery. Last week it took an hour and a half. Today, an hour and 45. I understand that it's Friday and it's busy, but don't make promises on delivery times that you can't keep. At least be honest about it and I wouldn't be so annoyed!

Stopped by for a meal on our 45 minute lunch break. Our food took 35 minutes to come out to the point where my hubby had to go find someone to ask where our food was. When we did receice it, my quesadilla was burned and so crunchy that it was crumbling and I couldn't even open the tortilla to add my sour cream and sauces. My husband's chicken panini had burned chicken inside and the pesto was extremely bland. When he asked for extra cheese, there was a very obvious eye roll from the waitress. Not a place we would recommend at all, especially for the price we paid for our meals.
I'll give it a 2 star for the sangria, 'cause the Leche de Tigre was terrible, the Jalea was too small!

I give the food a 5 star!  The concept is very unique. I think their only chance of making it is to turn into a fast casual establishment. It would be great to go up to the counter and choose either bowl or sandwich then choose ball and sauce and lastly choose from a selection of sides. The bowl should come with the same size roll as the sandwich. People should pay the same price for the meal and then there can be add ons. I fear keeping it like this will lead to a closing soon. No need for wait staff, ours was poorly informed and not enthusiastic.

A friend of mines had a birthday dinner here and everything was great. The music the ambience and the service was A+. My waitress Alexis was a super sweet girl who was friendly and made my visit here a very enjoyable. I will definitely dine here again

Superb. Some of the best Italian fine dining in all of New York. The service is impeccable, a return to Mad Men era of fine dining establishments. Quickly becoming one of my favorite restaurants in the city. We've been numerous times and everything on the menu is excellent.

An update to my review- I tried their seafood dishes twice. I ordered choritos a la chalaca which is mussels with a seafood, onion and tomato mixture on top. The first time they didn't get the order right and I ordered a mild spice, and it tasted good but left a very fishy taste in my mouth afterwards. I decided to try it again and the waitress was friendly, attractive and attentive and the mussels were huge. I ordered it spicy so maybe that helped in it not being fishy. I'm looking forward to trying more of their exotic dishes.

Came out to a local restaurant with the wife for date night and our experience was AMAZING!!!! There food is orgasmic. I've never eaten anything so delicious and fantastic in my life. Chef Vinny is world class, I will be telling the world about Glendale's best kept secret.

I am not much of a yelp reviewer, especially ever a negative reviewer. I called Audrey Claire at about 4pm on a Friday asking if there had been any canceled reservations. The man who answered was polite, advising me that there were no reservations on Friday. I asked about how long the wait was he claimed it would be awhile and he would refer us to a bar in the meantime. Great! We grabbed a bottle of wine and made the trip down. Well, we entered the front door and stood there talking to each other waiting for someone to approach us. My boyfriend noticed it had been awhile and I gave them the benefit of the doubt and said "they are busy, someone will be over". Then we stood there for a VERY AWKWARD amount of time, if not 10 minutes maybe more. I looked at some servers walking around and then finally one server approached us, REACHED AROUND US set down menus on the stand and walked away. This place is a very tiny cramped room and it was truly humiliating. I wouldn't go back if they served gold on a plate for free. I don't give a sh*t how good the food is. Service- by the ENTIRE staff who very clearly saw us- is terrible. The only other time I was that embarrassed was when I split my pants in the 3rd grade play. Don't give this place your time, they probably won't give you theirs.

This place is great. NFL Sunday Ticket. 2 for 1 rack of ribs on Tuesdays. The food is good and the beers are plenty. We absolutely LOVE the corn bread they bring out beforehand. Wife gets soups often and sagebrush are good. I have had burgers, buffalo wrap (excellent), and ribs and they are all things in would get again, but we moved sadly to where there are no more Tiff's near.

This is a great spot for someone that has unconventional work hours who can only grab a bite to eat during the day time or late into the evening. The establishment is open until 4am which is a great spot to go to after bar hopping or whatever you like to do in the late evenings. The menu is great I tried the Chipotle burger and the Black bean dip which was really great. Another dish I tried that is phenomenal was the Death by Mushroom stuffed ravioli, pair that up with a nice Pinot Noir and you're set for the night. The brunch is a great bargain, one of the best I've been to. For $16 you get your choice off the brunch menu complete with 2 alcoholic drinks of your choice complete with coffee or tea. I tried the Steak Skillet and It hit the spot, I was then able to compliment my mean with some Chambord mixed with Champagne, and what's great about the drinks is that you can switch them out when you're done with your first. If you're in Astoria at anytime during the day give this place a shot, with it's modern theme, atmospheric music, friendly servers this is a place in Astoria that you need to try.
I had the chicken gyro and it was excellent.  Friendly staff and you can't beat the prices.

It was a disappointment is not really good Peruvian food The quality of the products they use for cooking it's very poor I don't know what happened I think they sold the place the  new owners do not know how to cook Peruvian food Wont come back it was horrible !!!

Overrated and over priced.  Not a fine dining establishment, but a good neighborhood spot.  Food is good, but absolutely does not knock your socks off.  You can get the same bread basket at cheaper restaurants in Mulberry.  The spaghetti is good but calling it the best you've ever had shows you don't know much about spaghetti.  The fish appetizers are good, but are neither original nor better than you can find at dozens of other restaurants in NY serving the same Nobu knock-offs.  Expect the vibe is where you go to take skinny blonds who think they have no arrived, and you pay up for it.  3 hostess up front type of place.  Style over some substance.  Sort of what's wrong with NY.

Last nite we celebrated a Birthday party with my Friends at this Place... The owner was very gracious enough to take cake a day ahead for a surprise party.  The service was excellent, can 't believe , he is able to juggle do many clients at the same time and be able to tend everyone.  The Food was Amazing, everything was fresh and cooked to perfection.  Everyone raved about the dishes they had and it was just right.  The portions were equally good, you wouldn't leave hungry out of that place.  Overall we had an Amazing experience and im planning to bring back more friends here.
The Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup is the BOMB!! LOVE LOVE LOVE IT! My favorite on their menu. I just can't get enough!!

Cash Only's a bust at times, dunno why in this day and age. Their $1 taco night is always packed though for the most part the tacos on other days aren't much more expensive. (I think the Al Pastor is a buck seventy on a regular day). Burritos are amazing and they offer several vegan options too. Their salsa could be more saucy, and less 'a pile of chopped tomatoes and onions with water at the bottom of the bowl'

We have been waiting for over an hour and still no table available. The problem is that people longer way after they finish eating and no one says anything meanwhile people wait for a very long time. Be prepare to wait for an hour

lets see. ive been here about four times, one time just to get bubble tea. first the food is not that great. but at least the inexpensive price makes up for it. The noodles are usually just sticking to each other and sashimi and sushi are soso. the worst part is the service. out of the visits, i figure maybe one server was NICE enough but lacked promptness and proper english. the hostess is a bimbo who again isnt that great at speaking english and completely ignores the people waiting for their names to be written down and is extremely slow in taking other guests in to seat them. its called be systematic and prompt if you KNOW youre running a busy night. and let me just tell you about the girl working at the bubble tea bar. her name begins with a K, not to be confused with the other nice girl. she is snappy when talking to the customers and cuts the customers off when speaking. this place opened not too long ago and it certainly does not deserve 3 1/2 average. sangkee across the street deserves more when they dont even serve the same type of food!
Went out dinner and had the tasting menu. Everything was great but strawberry cinnamon glazed ribs are TO DIE FOR
very nice chinese hotpot in manhattan, as a beijinger, I like the meet and the source very much, and the service is pretty good. The only thing is you should reserve ahead of days.

In the past three months I have lived in the Greater New York City Area there is no doubt this is the best restaurant I have been to in NYC. Be prepared for a long wait on a Friday night, but it will be worth it.

I just went to try this place this afternoon and all I have to say is I've had better. The service was great my waitress was very nice and she was very attentive but when it came to the food that's where it all boils down to. I had the Chip's Favorite Omelet which is Sausage, Apples, and Cheddar Cheese and I had it diner style. As I am not a frequent eater at diners I forgot what diner style actually was and maybe I should have gotten my omelet fluffy. The sausage kind of tasted like it was those Jimmy Dean frozen sausage patties cut up into an omelet. I am going to give this place one more chance to wow me in the future and I'll definitely get something different off the menu next time.

Great place to stop and grab lunch on a cold day. Lots of parking, easy to find, friendly staff. I had the chicken piccata with cream of broccoli soup. It was nicely done, soft chicken, light breading, great flavor. Not greasy. For the price, the portion size was just right.  The soup was piping hot and had a home made taste.  They even have large cookies, soft baked.  Overall, a solid meal for the price.
Awesome deli!! Great dishes and even better sandwiches. I wouldn't go anywhere else if they were open 24/7!

Oh ippudo, how you rocked my vegetarian socks off. The wasabi shoyu ramen is perfection - a slight kick of wasabi in a deeply flavorful broth - it was so good that my friend who got the pork broth (forget which one) preferred it to hers! Also love the ambience that's the perfect in between of traditional - with counter seating by the cooks- and super modern - with international waitstaff announcing dishes in great Japanese as they bring them out.

Went here because my friend was craving shepherd's pie-- turns out they don't always have that on the menu-- and stayed despite no chance of satisfying the craving.  My friend had done very little research (probably just googled "shepherd's pie nyc") and the prices were higher than he expected, but we decided to just go for it... and oh my gosh I'm so glad we did! We split the scotch egg to start, which was good but nothing to write home about.  Other than that, everything was amazing!  I had the Beef Wellington (one of my favorites and something I don't get to have often) and, while I've had better, it was really delicious.  The beef was very tender, and the potatoes on the side were nice and crisp and actually came out hot, which so many restaurants seem to struggle with.  Yummy as this was, though, I have to admit I was a little bit  jealous of my friend's pork chop... literally the BEST pork chop I have ever eaten.  I don't know how they managed to make it so juicy and flavorful... there just are not enough good things to say about it.  I mean... I just can't even.  AMAZING. Oh, and I almost forgot about this because the pork chop just stole the show, but my friend and I tried 5 different cocktails and all of them were delicious.  I am not a scotch drinker, but my favorite was the scotch highlands... perfection in a glass.  Dessert was also yummy, service was great, and the decor was so cozy on a freezing night.  Go there.
My first cavatelli dish in jersey... It was awesome. .. not even on the menu... will be back.
Very good food,  this place is the one that other pizza places could learn a lot. The taste is priceless,  and the care for costumers top level. congrats to management.

What can I say about this little slice of France here in South Philly!!?? Just one word comes to mind..AWESOME!! The owners are the sweetest people, and the quaint atmosphere is both welcoming and relaxing!! This place will open your senses, and take you away to the Champs-Élysées!!

We went to Belle gente last night and we will never go again . this is by far the filthiest dirtiest restaurant we have ever been to. We actually watched through an open kitchen door mind you, staff drop food off a plate pick it up and put it back and then serve it to a table. we have contacted the Verona health dept this place is sick !

I finally found a Italian place that's good in Bloomfield. The pizza is great. The meatball sliders are a must every time I order. The chicken  parm was good. The rigatoni and vodka was great ate twice off it. The fettuccine Alfredo was good. And the people  working there are so nice and fast delivery

We recently held our wedding reception @ Brooklyn stoops and couldn't be happier with the service, space and food provided. Leading up to our wedding, my husband & I communicated all of our requirements to the owner Ocian, he was prompt with his responses and followed through with all our requests. Although I didn't manage to eat a lot that night, our guests said that the food was excellent (I can however say is that the drinks we're great). If you're looking for a space to have a party or event, I would absolutely recommend Brooklyn Stoops - Great place, awesome night!

First time I went here we had a great time. Ordered a few small plates and they had a great selection or wine and beer. Now the second and last time i went here, we barely sat down before we left. I know this is New York City but it's still no excuse on why their are nice around the table. And what Is even worse is that when i brought it to the waitresses attention she didn't seemed bothered nor did she ask if we wanted to sit somewhere else. It's a shame. Don't think I'll be back.
Food was awesome.  It felt like I was a guest at a family's house, which was awesome.  The wait staff was attentive and food was great.

I have ordered from here several times since they opened this location. Their other location is in the Lawrence shopping center.   I have only ordered pizza and cheese steaks from here so far. I would like a little more cheese on the cheese steak, but I have been spoiled by Sandykes/kelvys/submarias over the past 30 years. Their specialty pizzas are good and better than most in the area. Try their buffalo chicken pizza you will not be disappointed.  I would not recommend ever buying a regular pizza and adding toppings as their price for added toppings is extremely high to the point of absurdity. Delivery is quick and my order has always been correct. I order through eat24 as they give me a $2 coupon an delivery is only $1.
It's a hole in the wall serving one of the best pizzas I've ever had.  Recommend you swing by this joint when visiting Times Square.

We had a groupon and we called in for a reservation.  We were put at a table by the door and it was snowing outside.  When we asked for a different table we  were told that the table next to us was reserved for 6:00 PM.  No one ever for the table next to us.  We were never moved.  The Tapas were good with a lot of variety, dinner was good and the Sangria average.  The problem came with the service.  We had to ask for water or soda. Everyone was served their dinner except one person.  When we asked about the missing dinner we were told they would check on it.  Then we were told that there was a mix up with the computer and the food would be rushed.  Well everyone else was finished with their meals and they asked how was everything and we inquired about the missing dinner.  They said it would take 5 minutes more.  It finally came a half hour after the other meals.   At the end of the meal we asked if we would be compensated for the late arriving meal.  The hostess said she would ask the manager.  The answer was that they were very sorry but since we had a groupon we couldn't be compensated for the long wait.  If we wanted to come back we would be put in the VIP section if we explained on the phone what happened to us and this would never happen again. As we were leaving and getting our coats on they asked us if we wanted desert and attempted to show us the desert tray.  I would say for food 3 stars, service 1 star.

Listen up waitstaff: when a couple comes in, orders a bottle of wine, two dinners and dessert? Spend some time being charming! Be attentive! I had an uptight waiter from hell last night that made us feel rushed and not valued as patrons. Food was eh! Needs more flavoring for sure! We won't be back. Not a value by any means. No veggies served either - lacking presentation as well. I can go on but we've all been there!

how about going to 99 cents creations at 149 W 24st NY N Y 10011 between 6th and 7th ave in Chelsea area. on the north side of the street.  Best 99 cents store ever come and check it out, every thing for every body.

The worst service ever! I was so upset. I made a reservation and visited this place with my roommate, but in the middle of the dinner the waitress asked us to move to another table because they had that table reserved for someone else. We moved without making a problem. However, we liked the food and we decided to order some more to which the waitress replied that was going to be alot for us. We ordered the food and after we were finished I asked for desert menus, the waitress said we cannot get the menus because "we were there for almost 2 hours" and they had more reservations. I did not know there is a time limit. She already moved us once, I thought we deserved to finish our dinner with deserts, but she told us we cant see it. We just paid and left. Completely disappointed. Never going back to that place again. Food great, service horrible.

If these people want to stay in business they need to seriously reevaluate the staff,prices,and customer service. First time I went we sat at a table and even though the place was empty our food took about an hour in a half.All we ordered was whole chicken,grilled shrimp and a $19 skirt steak that could have easily fit in the palm of my hand.The rice and beans were cold,probably because the waiter was to busy chit chatting while our food sat at the counter for a while. The steak was suppose to be medium and it was so over cooked it was rubbery. The portion were very small for what they charge and the food was just okay. Gave them a second chance and I ordered for pick up. We ordered a whole chicken and some grilled shrimp when we got home the "whole chicken" was missing a drumstick and a breast...the fries were under cooked and the veggies had been soak in a spiced vinegar which made them inedible and they literally gave us 5 small shrimp. Will not be returning or ordering from here again

Came here for a lovely birthday dinner for my sister about a month ago, we had Billy and he was perfectly attentive and gave recommendations where we needed them. When you get a menu as extensive as ilili's, it can be a bit overwhelming but he took the time to make good recommendations for 5 girls to share and everything was delicious. He said the brussel sprouts were quite popular so we tried that and they definitely were delicious with a lovely walnut salad to start. The Phoenician fries and steak tartar were also quite delicious once you get over the fact that you're eating steak tartar. I've had the falafels, scallops in their restaurant week menu in the past and those were pretty good but nothing mindblowing. All the dishes here have been consistently on point. The ambiance is a fun hip spot, trendy without being obnoxious. Thanks billy for another memorable night at ilili.

The waitress, Katya was very kind when we arrived. That is, if your definition for kind is rude. My boyfriend and I tried our best to be nice, but it was clear that upon arrival, nobody wanted us there. We arrive at 1030pm, and didn't realize they closed at 11pm. As people who have worked in the restaurant industry, we know how shitty that is. But lucky for them, we are kind patrons and were trying to get out at 11pm for a friend's show around the corner anyway. Plus the restaurant was still packed with people sitting and enjoying their time. But unlucky for us, Katya didn't know that and decided to treat us like people unworthy of her time. She laid down the menus with minimal use of words...save the time she laid down the special menu and said, "these are our specials." Perhaps she doesn't know English? Who knows? We tried to excuse her lack of communication and general presence. Katya then came back for drinks. My boyfriend asked for a coffee to drink very nicely bc we both thought she must've had a long day due to the way she was acting plus he's basically just a wonderfully nice guy, but I'd never seen anyone more confused. As if she'd never heard the word before. She disappeared, then came back with another waitress and the coffee she somehow managed to figure out to ask for our order. They both stood there and said, "are you ready?" Like a swat team who's been waiting to fire for the longest time....I guess Katya needed back up? We said yes and the other waitress said, "Thank goodness" when we told her we were ready to order. Like we were taking our own sweet time? Again, who knows why we were being treated as such. We ordered. The food came out.  It looked great. Exactly what we were looking for. We asked Katya for crushed red pepper. You know, it being an Italian place, we figured it'd be easy. Again, a confused look on her face. It was like we were playing some weird guessing game. It was right behind us, so I pointed at it. And finally she placed it down. At this point, she's probably said 5 or 6 words to us. We eat our dinner. It's really quite good. But we're trying to flag her down for more water throughout the dinner, and only the busser is attentive. And finally it's time to ask for a check since we are trying to get out in a timely fashion and because we realize they might be closing due to her terribly removed disposition. I try flagging her down. 3 other employees must've seen me bc I was making huge gestures.  I go up to the bar and I say, "is it possible for us to pay our check, please?" and again, no words. She prints out the check gives it to me. I pay. The pen doesn't work, she's walked away already. At this point, I'm over Katya's Tribeca attitude. And I say, "this pen doesn't work." she's disappeared. Another waitress looks at me. Gives me a pen, then looks at Katya who reappears and they both laugh. I don't know why. It's not funny. I say, "great service" sarcastically then leave. So if you want Ok food with servers that feel like ignoring you is good service, then this is the place for you. Tribeca has plenty of other places worth your time, this is not one of them. But if you're looking for someone like Katya's who's too busy to be nice to your table, then perhaps this restaurant is for you. But if anyone has any insight into whether or not Katya doesn't speak English, maybe that'll be a good indication of if she was rude or not. Perhaps that's the explanation for the bad service...if so, good luck with your ESL classes, Katya!

Just ordered. The delivery  was horrible. The cheese steak  was bad the potatoes where undercooked the meat meat was frozen  and precut horrible. The sautéed  broccoli wasn't  even cooked. The pasta fagioli soup was not even close to being right. It was only beans and pasta  with mostly beans. They where also the wrong type of beans. And the wrong type broth. The only good thing was the fried ravioli.  Order from ZI Z IA  +1 973-743-3333 call them only a couple blocks away

I went there once for my sisters surprise party last year and I had some of their vegetable samosas which were pretty good. I got a craving for some Indian food not too long ago and I was going to go there for lunch and I saw not one person in there employee or otherwise. I recently saw that they are open again. I have to make a point to stop there so I can make my full assessment.
Food and drinks were awesome. Our waiter Andrew was awesome! Recommended all the right things. Had a groupon which made it even better. Will definitely return.

Some of the servers wear a shirt that says "You never forget your first" and this is exactly that type of place. Honestly pick anything you really can't go wrong (except the truffle burger).  If you're like me and like to enjoy the burger itself you'll find that the truffle sauce is overwhelming and takes away from perfectly cooked patty.
Sub-par. A cappuccino and a pastry for seven bucks. And the espresso wasn't poured right. And the pastry was slightly stale. Wont be going back here.

That was easy. Just moved to east Windsor and we were looking for a pizza place last night. I relied on my yelp "friends" and their reviews and found a great place on the first try. The pizza was great. Bruschetta was really good too. They give you so much of it. All I know was that it was GOOD and I ate way to much.

By FAR and away the WORST course in Ct/Ma.  The people in the pro shop are rude but the old cart guy was the most miserable person I have ever met in my life.  Have played golf over a thousand times and don't ever remember having an issue with a cart guy. Take my advice - NEVER PLAY HERE!!!  Conditions are the worst I've seen....greens terrible, divots all over the fairways, hardly mowed.  This place is a joke and will be out of business soon.  Help them put themselves out golf their misery and head somewhere else!!!!!

Awesome restaurant in of all places North Haven CT! We took the All You Can Eat deal and were very impressed. The portions were plenty and the sushi was fresh and well presented. Will definitely go back and wish to try something off the very extensive regular menu.
Amazing just wait
So delicious!! I love this. I think No1Pizza of NY. Price good too.
Long wait but the food was good :) I might go again

Fraud, the restaurant forced our friend to pay pre frix even tho our friend came to say hi and not planning to eat. The owner also came to confront us for writing a one star review and trying to take a picture of us (wtf), we went up and asked him why he took a picture and he said it's his own restaurant he can do whatever. Worse dinning experience ever, and they won't allow us to bring a cake for our birthday friend. Totally BS, never going back.

Service is great I come here often so I am familiar with the servers very polite and efficient decent amount of seating the only time it's packed is Sunday mornings after church nice variety of food food quality is great fast service a little bit of a small size parking lot but no matter where you park it's a good spot not far from the entrance friendly and clean environment nice place for families to go
Some of the best sandwich's in town. Really like the meatball pam.

The food is excellent!  Pizza is great and tonight I decided I wanted fried calamari---it was perfect!  I also like the fact if you order a salad you don't get a tin filled with wet iceberg!  Very good and never disappointing
you must try their savory waffles! i go at least once a week and it's not often enough. the service, the setting, the food... everything is so welcoming and perfect. so glad this place came to town.

We had a lovely dinner. Our waiter was attentive though we called ahead to request one vegan meal and they knew nothing of the special request. Our waiter asked the chef if he could prepare something and came back to say they would roast some veggies. As we finished dessert we were abruptly approached by the RUDE manager who told us to leave to make room for the next table. We were just sipping our last drop of our tawny port. We were shocked. The experience is not just about the food. This rating is about the poor customer service.
They will kick you out after 45 mins despite being a great patron who is planning on ordering a lot. Beware!!! Keep out at your own risk.

Four months ago, we had meal there and left so disappointed.  We returned for second chance and now dine there often. The manager is James A. is taking the restaurant to whole new level.  The food and staff are wonderful every time and so inviting you want to return as often as possible.  Delicious seafood dishes are everyday, but I warn you try touching my bread when I am eating mussels in white wine garlic sauce and you will loose a finger, the best around just out of this world.  Ok I admit I love the sangria too.

I ordered take-out from this place a few times. Decent, tasty home-cooked food. Their appetizers are tasty and delicious - empanadas with green cilantro sauce and potato wedges with spicy mayo. Their roasted chicken and shrimp with garlic sauce dishes are nice and flavorful and comes with fresh salad. This place advertises itself as fresh, cooked food. However, their chicken is already pre-made and heated up in their commercial microwaves.  Still tasty nonetheless but a little misleading. Service is spotty - sometimes they're great and quick. Other times they're slow with orders and forget to say "thank you" more often than not (imagine complete silence as you pay the bill -awkward). I would recommend this place to friends as a nice option for late night dinners or snacks but it would not be on the top of my list.

Excellent restaurant, not a conventional sushi place at all. It does not serve conventional japanese style sushi and does not have most of the fish you would expect at a sushi place nor does it use sushi rice.   Instead, Miya's serves well balanced, very tasty and usually well presented rolls of unconventional vegetable and fish combinations with nutty brown rice.  Its prices range from unjustifiably for tiny portions, to very low for large portions (the 'sushi for the masses menu').  Serving staff are always excellent and the decor is amusing.  It is a good place to take foodie friends. I particularly recommend the agedashi tofu, the kimchi tilapia rolls, and the mushroom tempura rolls (both of which have very thin rice) - I would not recommend the less flavorful nigiri (such as scallop) because the taste of the brown rice overwhelms the fish and the portions are very small given the pricing.

Great place! Loved the ambiance as soon as we walked in. Dinner seating is at the lower level - the rustic feel makes you forget you're in the city. Food is fantastic - we ordered bone marrow and pork belly to start and we were blown away - we asked for more bread to literally lick the sauce off the plate - it was so yummy . The main course was slightly disappointing, the burger was lacking in taste. The short rib with mac and cheese was so bland. The duck was fine. Overall the experience was nice but like I said the food was quite disappointing. Perhaps if we do go back we'll just order several appetizers.

After months of saying we would go there, we finally went and it was everything I expected it to be.  The decor is unchanged since the 1970's and that is a good thing.  The waitstaff was attentive and friendly and the food was exceptional. My wife imbibed in a pina colada and I knocked down several Cokes, but only paid for one (not bad, free refills on soda).  We did the wonton soup, pu pu platter appetizer because, like another reviewer said..."because you have to".  I opted for the broccoli in garlic sauce and while it was sweet and spicy, the spice was just enough to light a fire in my mouth and dissipate almost immediately. I will definitely go back again and again and again....
People that work there do not care service very bad food was not cooked right do not go

There are no words to describe dining experience at The Sea Fire Grill. Starting with front door and ending with the guys who take away your "shiny licked" plates. The food gets you to the heaven and service makes you feel royal. Special thank you to Albanian waiter Besfort( hope I spelled it right), manager Aron and of course the chef;)))
best brunch

We chose the prix fixe tasting menu for brunch that day, and it was amazing! This place is definitely on the upper end in terms of pricing though, so keep that in mind when you decide to pay it a visit. However, it is very delicious and definitely deserves it's one Michelin star ranking. Do try out the tasting menu to get a good sense of what they have to offer. However, also note that it may not exactly fill you up since the portions are tiny.

This is my third time in trio and I love it. I love the food and the prices. It a great place to go with your friends or a date. Great that is byob. My only complain is the service. Is getting bad, the sever was not attentive to us. We had to keep on asking for him to show to our table because we needed water , desert, and the check.

Extremely disappointing service. After finally getting the attention of someone, we were told there would not be a table for a while but we could sit and order at the counter. We were sitting and still looking at the menus when a waitress came over and told us some people just walked in who wanted to sit at the counter and told us to get up and go back to wait at the door until a table was available! What sort of customer service is this?
The barrel aged mescal negroni is the best cocktail I've tried in NYC (apart from in my own house of course).
N
this is a favorite of mine! been a customer for years. the staff is always so friendly and accommodating. the beer selection is wide and the bartenders are friendly.

Welcome back Mundo!  I was delighted to hear they are open again & I was looking forward to see what they've created. Menu was very similar to their old one with some favorite dishes available (red sonja, carrot dip, veggie wrap, etc) but I was actually hoping for a food more options. The other reason for only 4 stars is the portion sizes vary between tapas style & entrée and it's not very clear on the menu.  I loved everything we ordered but we needed to order side dishes to supplement.   Decor, Location,  Service...5 STARS! I will be back & I'm bringing friends to ensure they stay around for a long time! I truly wish Willy & the gang continued success as they aspire to give the neighborhood what it is lacking. Keep your eyes out for new dance nights for their large downstairs space!
LOVE this restaurant. They make the best gluten free pizza we have ever had. There customer service is awesome.

This place started off fine-good drinks, music, and food. So in that aspect I have nothing negative to say. My friends and I  went on a Friday night and had a good time. My complaint is directed to how this place closes at the end of the night. The waitress came over to our table for last call at 1:40. My friends got one more round of drinks which came around 10 minutes later. Within minutes one of the bartenders came around whistling obnoxiously loud for everyone to leave. We asked the waitress if we could finish our drinks and she said it wouldn't be a problem and she would let the bouncer know that we had just ordered. However right after, the owner comes around, drink in hand, clearly drunk, telling everyone to get out. I said something to the waitress about how was obnoxious and rude it was that the owner and bartender were basically whistling and telling everyone to leave every other minute and if I knew that would be the case I would have never ordered that last round. My friend had barely made a dent in the drink that was served minutes before. Did they expect us to chug it in 5 minutes and leave? She apologized and did her best to assure us to take our time. However even the bouncer she informed to let us finish our drinks was telling us to leave. It's not like we were trying to overstay and take our sweet time but if you order a drink you want to enjoy it and not have someone harass you to get out. The nonstop loud whistles and tellin everyone to leave did not stop so I said something to the bartender who didn't have much to say. I explained they should move their last call up to 1:30 at least if they expect everyone out the door before 2 and I didn't appreciate being rushed. If that was the case the waitress shouldn't have insisted for us to get that last round. The situation was just handled so unprofessionally and left a bad taste in my mouth. The final response I got was "well I guess you've never been here before" to which I responded that I probably won't be again. Overall don't go here on a weekend if you are planning to stay until closing unless you like being herded out of an establishment like cattle.

The number of positive reviews of this place makes me question the value of Yelp. This place is a joke. There are fewer items on the menu than I've ever seen in a restaurant. It's the only time I've ordered fajitas that didn't arrived at the table sizzling hot. The service was mediocre, and being called "amigo" at every opportunity doesn't do anything for me.
HANDS DOWN! the Best Squares you will find in brooklyn! Been going to this place ever since i moved to NY back in 09'. You cannot leave this place with out having a square and a Spumoni Icee.

I'm shocked to see the four stars here. For anyone who's ever eaten in Belgium, there's a big difference in the food quality. The French onion soup was just a bowl of cream without onion or real taste. The dame Blanche ordered looked and tasted nothing like a real one. The chocolate sauce didn't have real chocolate and when we explained about what a real dame Blanche was about (as friendly as possible) the waitress replied: "Do I look like the cook? I'm not the cook!" It was a feedback, and I hope it will somehow come through. Food was really not good, esp. For that price (60 usd per person).

Sorry yelpers, I placed this review for the wrong location. My review is supposed to be for the 134 W Broadway, New York, NY 10013 (b/t Duane St & Thomas St) in TriBeCa restaurant. I've never benn to this location.
DO NOT EAT HERE! All these five stars are fake! My girlfriend found a bug in her food.

How can a restaurant charge so much for so little? One enters this well decorated group of rooms with high expectations and leaves merely with a high bill. What a disappointment. A stylish captain recites the menu as if he was describing the wonderful inheritance left to you by your long lost uncle. Then out comes a mini mess of an appetizer...chewy over-cooked tasteless octopus. Next comes a reasonably good spicy spaghetti with small bits of clam. Then a fatty undercooked veal chop arrives lacking in both size and flavor. This is all part of thei four courses prix fixed at $97 per person. The selection of cheeses for dessert was okay. But the French press coffee was excellent! The room was almost full. So what do I know?

The most horrible pizza even . I order delivery it was soggy and everything was falling apart  horrible place for pizza and and service really horrible .i called to complain and they hung up the phone when i complain the quality of the pizza . I don't recommend this place at all.
Great service... great food and awesome atmosphere...
The food is delicious and fresh, the service is exceptional, and the food and drink options seem endless. I love the atmosphere, too. It's quiet, warm, and inviting. I'll be here a lot more often!
Food is great....drinks are great....prices are great...and staff is great! I have been to the New Haven location which is great, but the Orange location is phenomenal!

Blend on the water is probably my favorite restaurant. The food is superb, the staff is excellent, and the atmosphere is awesome. You not only have a great experience indoors, but even right outside of it, you get excellent reviews of the city. Every time I have been to this restaurant, the manager, Lance, has come to ensure the highest satisfaction. You never get that at any restaurant. I have been here a number of times, and every waitress we had was great!  Michelle was our last waitress, and she was super friendly!  Awesome place!! Def will see you again soon!!!!!!
Stopped for drinks.  Spanish fare.  Looking for chips and salsa? Find another place. Decent food.

The food was excellent but the worst dining experience. Food was cold and sitting next to a vent that was ice cold on a cold day was not very comfortable. The staff was friendly and said they would have changed it if we would have said something earlier.

Pros: 1. Great homey Italian pasta 2. David the server - incredible service Cons: outside of David, hit or miss service.  There is other great Italian restaurants to go to without the wait. We were quoted a 1.5 hour wait.  We end up waiting 3 hours to finally get a seat. There are dozens of other great restaurants around the corner we would go to had we known it would be an 11pm dinner rather than 9:30pm dinner.  We have to mention to the host that we waited double the time we were quoted and she ensured us we would get two free desserts.  Server comes to take our orders - no friendly or apologetic greeting.  Get our entrees and she is no where to be found.  Have to flag down other staff to refill waters or get something on the side.  David is the only one who brings refills or service and packs up our meals and offers more wine and brings a dessert on the house. I finally mention the lack of service and attentiveness to the manager who is originally apologetic.  After the talk -- no service still.  No acknowledgment from our original waitress, no acknowledgement of the other dessert on the house.  It takes me having to mention to a bus boy that we were ready for our check + having to physically walk back to the manager to say we want our check which is offensive after the experience we had. Long story short: great authentic Italian pasta. Not worth the wait if you are treated the way we were.  If David wasn't there, it would have been a front to back awful experience.  Will probably not go back and instead go to one of the other multiple amazing Italian places in Manhattan.

This is a very quaint but scrumptious place for drinks, food, sports. I would reccommend this place to anyone who wants to escape the craziness of the city for a quick bite to eat. The people were friendly and low key and gave us exceptional service. The food was also delicious. Just don't try any of the pumpkin draft beers.

On my first real trip to new york with my girlfriend and randomly stopped in on a Saturday. Wasn't dissapointed at all. Good food, good atmosphere, and good service. Would definitely come catch a game and grab some food here in the future.

Cannot put into words how much I love Gaia Cafe The. pasta and the pizza are amazing and the ingredients taste so fresh. In terms of value for money, Gaia is unbeatable, nowhere in Manhattan comes close.

First- I would say I thought this was an awesome place for pizza (and love to support family owned restaurants) - one we would come to for many years. Pizza is great. But, DeLorenzos- your pizza is not so good that this excuses an attitude when I politely told you  I tried calling over 40 times to order with a busy signal or a pick up and phone put on a counter with no one answering. I drove 30 minutes over to place a takeout order in person thinking the phones are out. Host tells me when they are too busy they don't answer. What?!  And then the person to take my order had yet another attitude and tells me when too busy the manager turns off the phones!  Parking lot was half full on a Friday evening. Some booths were open and wait was 5 minutes. Yes, DeLorenzos, your pizza is good but not so good that you can treat your customers like that.  You have lost our family's business for good. I will gladly go to Uno's next door and support a chain restaurant who is happy for our business and also has terrific pizza.  Go ahead and stop answering your phones - fewer customers will come. A wild success can turn when your customers get treated this way.  It will give way to supporting your competition.
Sorry I posted a review intended for another spot.

turks is the worst place i had ever ate at. one day i had took my wife and sister in law and brothers in law. the food was terrible the waitress was rude. the place was very dirty. and it stinks in there. it smell so bad anyone could get sick. i would advise everybody in the world  to please stay away from this place. if u don't want to get sick and waste money

Been hearing about di fara for long time. Came on a Saturday about 11:50 and there was a line some guy came out and said there late it going to be about 20-30 min until they open , after that it was another 20 min. There is no doubt the pizza is great and probably the best but no respect for costumer. I understand you open 6am and your late but being late at 12pm there is no excuse. Frankly they don't care since they are the best and people will be coming. I had to try it and may be back sometime since I live 10 min away but defiantly won't come before opening. When I left there was about 5 people waiting outside so the lines probably gets smaller later on. But something to try for sure
Best Mac & Cheese I have ever had. Even the adults in the family love it. Other dishes are good too. Easy to park comparing to other places in Princeton.
Great food/ awesome service!

My favorite Thai in the Village! Reasonably priced with a great ambiance. They also do takeout, and they deliver on Seamless! I used to always get the Chicken Pad Thai and have recently switched to the Drunken Noodles. Both are top-notch. One time, I went in to get take out & it was cold out so they treated me to a hot green tea. I often wonder why this place isn't more crowded.

I was going to try this one today, since I didn't make a reservation and it's Saturday, I couldn't get in. That's inderstandable. So I stand outside of it waiting to meet  my friends. And there is this guy wear a baseball hat and an apron and a pair of gloves came out of it, took out his pack of cigarette and started smoking, with his gloves on. And he finished it rather quickly, then he went for the second one,  again with his cloves on. In by past experience working in Chinese restaurant, he should be working in the kitchen. So, I guess I won't be trying it at before I forget about this....

I agree with other people that these guys are not reliable. The food is overpriced and the quality has been decreasing constantly. Whatever you do, don't try to order food from them. Both persons answering the phone are unable to take an order. If you order online, they would not register the order. The worst part: they would lie to you and tell you your order is coming when you call to confirm. If you like good sushi, go to Ajihei. If you need home delivery, Papa Johns or anything else would be better than this business. Terrible service.

went as a party of 6. everyone was more than pleased with the appetizers and meals. my zuppa di pesce was fantastic! the desserts were awesome! lou, our waiter was so personable and great. we will be back soon!

Came here last year with friends from Colorado. We had a great time with a nice bottle of wine and some great pasta, fish and chicken dishes. The restaurant has a nice ambiance to it, slightly romantic, with excellent service.

I'm Cuban and I love this place. Unlike other Philly Cuban restaurants, this place isn't just Cuban "themed". Instead, the menu more closely resembles something I expect to see in a Cuban restaurant in Little Havana. The croquetas de jamon were delicious, the cortaditos were on point, and the ropa vieja breakfast dish was perfect. I came here for lunch and I'm definitely coming back for dinner. It's a lot nicer than it looks like from outside.
Best cheesesteaks. Wit whiz! Don't let the long lines bother you if it's crowded. The lines move quick but be ready when you get to the window and its cash only!

Disgusting they had cockroaches and rats droppings coming from the basement.. I went there to eat with a friend and it was disgusting when I saw the cockroaches there was rat poo and decided not to eat and left
Great selection of belgian beers with excellent food that pairs perfectly with the beer. It is like being in Europe, right the the heart of USA's first nation's capitol.

I wouldn't go back. It was my first time and I traveled all the way from Connecticut to meet some friends who live in Brooklyn. I've read so many good things about them but they were very disappointing. When you end up paying $100 for dinner and you leave the restaurant hungry you know that they forgot the reason they are in business - to feed people. Small portions - too small - expensive, cramped, noisy, your clothes smell like food after. To top this off... We've been told we have to leave at a certain time because another party was coming in. I wouldn't go back. This place wasn't worth it.  Service was so and so...

Original plan was Sonic in Elizabeth.  Gps got it wrong, so we set out for the sonic in Edison.  On the way, my daughter spotted this place, and we went here instead.  We can only speak for the tabletop barbecue.  They bring you raw ingredients, and you cook themselves.  Not the world's best raw ingredients, but for 22.95 a person, quite reasonable.  Dessert is s'mores: way fun.  We'll be back.

Was very skeptical of getting food from a 'chindian' (Indian style Chinese food) in the USA as I've had some bad experiences. But this was a pleasant surprise. We ordered momos, hot and sour soup, noodles, and sesame chicken. Everything was not bad. The soup and momos was quite good. Chicken was okay but not a disaster. Definitely worth giving it another try!

This place is cute but they have a downfall- customer service. The food is great but this place gets pretty packed. There's a long wait time to be seated. I waited over an hour to be seated and thought no big deal I'll sit at the bar and have a drink. I was told to move because the bar is for people who want to eat! I couldn't sit and have a drink while I waited for my table, I thought that was absurd. I wouldn't go back to the location.

I always have the same thing (hearts of Palm salad and one of the pasta dishes with no protein or seafood) at this restaurant cause the food is Ok, you would think that it's much better than what it is. We go back only whenever we are in the area cause there isn't anything else over there. The owner and staff are very friendly.
The steak component of the $16.00 steak-and-eggs brunch could not have been more than 3.5 ounces in size.
Amazing food. Just be patient you have to wait

I went there because a friend said they have the best pizza.
