By far the best Sushi place i been too Even though there portions have become a bit smaller i still love the pork belly definitely worth a try. Party bomb also great way to go I love the environment and how close to home it is. I could see myself here once week
An adorable owner.  We felt welcome immediately.   Grateful for a drink and good company.

Their habenero sauce is addicting and their pulled pork is meaty. But their steak and chicken is sort of dry and their meat quantity is laughable. For the same price, it's better to go down the street to Chipotle.
I have been here several times and absolutely love it!!! Spanish tapas. I recommend this place to all my friends! Love the fact that the small plates make you feel like your not eating too much!!!
Best falafel (that I've had) in NYC. Cheap and good! Also great is the lentil soup.

Food is just OK.  Actual Prices are 15 to 40 percent higher than posted in Yelp.  Felt cheated that prices must not have been updated in a very long time or worse its a bait and switch.  No sauce given with Calamari and given only 4 pieces of bread with $200 takeout order.  Better options nearby so I can't recommend.
Delicious seafood, incredible staff, and consistently amazing nights there. Get there early, tables fill fast.

Although past meals here have been special, Thanksgiving dinner was an expensive disappointment. The normally attentive wait staff handled the four-course meal like it was assembly line work. Then again the food itself had an assembly line nature - far below the standard we had come to expect. My steak had the texture of cork. My wife barely touched her turkey as it too was dry, totally unremarkable, and diluted in an herb that overwhelmed the natural turkey flavor. Vegetables and sides were passable and minimal. Possibly the most disturbing element was the "Thanksgiving" music - a never ending loop of Vietnam era songs by the Doors, Rolling Stones, the Animals, Canned Heat, Joe Cocker, et al. All great stuff if you're having a pizza and a beer, but unexpected and inappropriate for a Thanksgiving meal that cost more than $200 per person with drinks. It was the wrong aural ingredient under any circumstance and particularly annoying when other senses were also being displeased. This meal wasn't just a slight miscue. For the price, it qualified as a true embarrassment.

4 stars. The food is great. Really delicious. We ordered a big order for a big group and everyone really enjoyed their meal. HOWEVER... I completely agree with 2 reviews before me... 1. THIS PLACE IS REALLY EXPENSIVE. 2. THE LADY WHO TAKES ORDERS OVER THE PHONE IS AGGRAVATINGLY RUDE. As I'm placing a big order, she tells me to hurry up and order quicker!!! I wasn't even taking my time! I let it go until the 3rd time she said "Quick, quick"... and I yelled back that I'm a customer and I'm making a big order from her business and that she needs to relax!!! She immediately changed her tone.   Then at the end of it all, she forgot the rice and we had to make another trip back to pick it up. Anyway... yes, we would order from there again because it was so tasty, but she's obnoxious and probably sets the prices as well.
Been there three times since it opened. Everything is great, especially the pork buns.  BYOB Yeah!!!
Best coffee in the city with great service. Went to Cafe Boca Ciega almost everyday during my 6-day stay in NYC Love that place!!

Best pizza in the city, imo. People giving this place only 4, 3 ect. stars must be referring to the unimpressive dining area, or the long wait you will likely encounter...they also must be nuts because...BEST PIZZA in NYC, heck, probably the country...and that's what this place is all about! not candle lit dining or attentive waiters (no waiters here)...but, best pizza in the city is a pretty big deal...how could it be anything but five stars!

My family and I just had thanksgiving dinner at Cheryl's and it was excellent! We are from New Orleans so it's hard to beat our southern cuisine. we decided this year that we didn't want to do all the work. This place did not disappoint. If you are looking for great food in Brooklyn, check it out.  I see some reviews say a Cheryl the owner is not as warm and friendly as some would like. well maybe, she is busy making that kick ass Mac n cheese or her delicious salmon. I will be going back and recommending to friends.

It was expensive but very good. If you're going to eat with 2 people I suggest you share a small pizza. We shared a large and it was too much for 2 people. The large is cut into 8 pieces but very big slices. Bigger than the plate they give you. I suggest you do half /half pizza. I really enjoyed the Italian raspberry and vanilla soda. So good!!

won't be back...gave this place a second chance hoping they needed to get things worked out since they were only open a few weeks and wanted to like it so much as the décor is great and Montclair could use an upscale Mexican place. First, the service...they seemed so enthusiastic but when you tell me - twice - you are going to bring me a new plate and then don't, I kind of feel that you were being insincere.  The food, the traditional guac was  a bit brighter and more plentiful the first time...the second time I ate there..not so much. The tacos..I had the al pastor and the pork belly one both times. With my second visit, both were much much drier. The corn off the cob was the HIGHLIGHT...very good with a bit of a kick. From the crudo menu, we had the ceviche (PS why they label the course as crudo when it's not is a bit suprising...) which was way too citrusy...couldn't enjoy it.  We had the chicken wings...bland is the best I can say about those...and finally, the churros...they looked delectable but undercooked inside. Oh, the chips are real tasty as is the green "salsa" that is brought out.  At the end of the day, it's about the food and service...not much here to make me come back...

My favorite place to stop while in Princeton.    Great fresh and local food, awesome atmosphere and decor as we'll as a friendly staff. I highly recommend the everything's better with bacon crepe, the baked goods and their cappuccino.   Well worth the wait

A nice bar and restaurant with dozens of exotic Belgium beers on tab and an absolutely staggering list of bottled beers from Europe and several states in USA. The mussels with Dijon are also excellent; when you finish the mussels it's good to order an extra Belgian frityes (fries) to go with the sauce. The Belgian fish and chips would be better if they were more lightly flavored.

The combination of the friendly waitstaff and delicious homemade Italian fare at Adrianna's land it on my 5 star list. Chef Valentino came out upon our request so our party of 15 could praise his many dishes.  My personal favorite was the prosciutto stuffed chicken cutlet smothered in pink sauce.  The staff loved our company and made us feel right at home. They even loved that we brought homemade wine with us. If you're ever craving a true home cooked meal head over to Adrianna's on Grand St. in New Haven

Had dinner there last night.  As usual it was perfect! Bread and dipping sauce was fantastic to start the meal.  Veal parmigiana with penne and a house garden salad was perfect. Pasta primavera with chicken was also perfect.  The deserts and coffee finished off a great meal.  PS:  its a greast BYOB

Love this spot! Very Mad Men-esque. Yummy food: oysters, fancy tater tots and loved the roasted cauliflower. Cute bartender too. So far I've sat at the bar twice, but plan to make reservations for dinner soon.

i just love it. i had #9 and they make it just how i envision a perfect crepe to be. they arrange stuffing inside carefully so it doesn't spill, which usually happens with crepe. would go again anytime.
Eh
Best pizza in NYC! I make it a point to go here everytime I visit the city! Try the lasagna pizza

It has been almost a year since I first experienced the Spicy Miso at Mu Ramen and I almost forgot how truly great it is.  I was fortunate enough to be able to dine at Mu more than once this past week even though they only opened on Monday for their soft opening (I believe the official opening is Dec 1st).  Pete Wells (NY Times) was spot on in ranking Mu as his top Ramen spot in NYC last year and now they have taken another giant leap forward to distinguish themselves from all the other Ramen restaurants in NYC. Their new permanent spot is cozy and inviting; you can tell that alot of thought went into every aspect of the design at Mu.  We had a little wait before we could get seated but it's to be expected as a result of the large cult following on social media.  Once we were seated, we were warmly greeted by Heidy He (co-owner of Mu) and she quickly updated us on the menu since a few things have been added since their pop-up days.  My wife really appreciated the insight into each dish and the guidance provided.   We decided on the Okonomiyaki, the U&I, and the Gyouza for starters and then the Mu Ramen and Spicy Miso. I was going to add the Kakuni to my Spicy Miso but Heidy recommended the Pork Jowl instead and I'm glad I listened to her advice.  The Okonomiyaki was great and I loved the smoked trout on top.  My wife loved the U&I and I completely agreed with her.  I only wish the dish was bigger bc we were both fighting for the last few bites (she won).   Fortunately for me we still had the Gyouza and this was definitely my favorite dish.  Fried chicken stuffed with foie is just a genius idea and I plan on ordering this every time I come. For our main dishes, the Mu Ramen reminded me of a traditional Korean oxtail soup and I was immediately sold on this new addition to the menu after tasting the broth.  I was very surprised at how they were able to find the perfect balance of saltiness in the broth as typically for oxtail soups, you would add your own salt/pepper to get that perfect balance.  The Spicy Miso was everything I remembered and the add-on of pork jowl made this my favorite ramen of all time.   Mu Ramen is a great addition to the Long Island City neighborhood as we were definitely in need of a restaurant with not only a great environment but great food as well.

This is my late night must eat whenever I'm in the city. There is always a line, however it moves quickly. The chicken platter is my choice of calories along with the white and BBQ sauce! The sauces are located on the side of the food truck and there is also a beverage truck a few feet away.

Just ok for Chinese take out, ordered chicken with Chinese vegetables was some what bland . Maybe it was just me but I had better . I will give them another shot but I'll try something different next time. Good brown rice and friendly people there.

Since I am from China and I have tasted many Nanzhou (actually Lan Zhou in current Mandarin Chinese) noodles, I could say with confidence that the hand-drawn noodles served in this restaurant is quite authentic. The meat that comes with the noodle soup is also very good. The service however needs to be improved.

I love ordering from here and going out to eat! The only complaints that I have are 1)The music is WAYY too loud. You can't have a conversation without yelling. 2)The staff doesn't check on you, they just bring your food and take your plates. 4)You're crammed in there like sardines! But the food is great!

Had dinner here over the weekend. Pros - food was pretty tasty and fresh.   That's it! Cons - pretty expensive for hotpot - service was rushed.   Every time I put a plate down they take it away and asked if I  wanted to order anything else.   And I mean every time. -why do customers have to pay $15 for a soup broth?  I mean this is hot pot. Are we suppose to cook it in plain water? -why do I need to tip a acceptable amount.  I mean what service am I getting here?  All they do is enter your order on a tablet and bring it to your table.  I'm doing all the cooking. But in the end I still tip them 18%. Didn't want to be a as$. -your clothes will smell of hotpot once you leave.   No way to avoid this part.  I know we didn't.
Great pizza and great service. Friendly staff and owners as well. I especially like the grandma pizza and buffalo chicken pizza and I'm looking forward to trying more.

Under new ownership!! The sauce is much MUCH better now, it tastes more fresh than before, and is no longer this weird sour tomato goop. Had the Brooklyn pie and it was very very good. Would recommend again now that it's under new ownership!
oyster leaf! amazing service and wine

Just waited 38 minutes for soup...SOUP. Not to mention that my friend's grilled cheese was the consistency of soggy French toast and tasted like bathroom cleaner thanks to the mango chutney. Really disappointed.

The food was very very good. I had the Flounder (Sautéed filets topped with crab meat and served with parsley-lemon butter sauce, accompanied by ginger fried rice). The service was excellent and the atmosphere was cozy. The view is not the greatest, but I can live with that. I have recommended this Restaurant to everyone I know.

Delicious food and friendly service. Sometimes feels a bit pricey but all in all really like the casual environment if you're meeting up with friends and family. Would recommend making a reservation in advance as this place can have a bit of a wait...

Went here two times before and I have to say that the food is sooooo delicious. I love the Katsu donburi. I ordered that two times as well~~ The first time I ordered was the Katsu Donburi and the green tea ice cream. The second time I just ordered Katsu donburi. The waiter was pretty nice. There was no wifi. I would really come here again since the food is so good.
excellent paninis , excellent service and the crepes are the toping on the cake.  Never had  bad dinner or lunch here. Great place to eat and i will be going back many times.
Every bit just got better and better! Unique flavors and superb service. A must visit!!!!

Came here w my bff Gaby on a Friday night for a "late" dinner. Food was slightly above average. Many dishes were not available and thought to explore by ordering one appetizer st a time. At 945 when my friend went to order fries,  they said the litchen closed - again,  Friday night at 945!  At least i live close by so am looking forward to the new restaurant that will open in six months once this fails. What a shame.
The food is great and the decoration here is lovely!

I can go anywhere for breakfast but I choose to come here. Just Plain Dave's has an awesome breakfast menu and I always get great service when I come. If I lived closer I would definitely dine here more often.
The worst curry I have ever had. Too lame taste, too much breading and too dirty environment
This place was well worth the trip to Brooklyn Bridge! The margherita pizza and calzone were delicious!! A must-have for sure!!
10 out of 10-- I'd rather eat this pizza for thanksgiving than turkey! Sorry Mom. Also, Lizzie, the owner, is the best!

A friend and I had lunch at Rowena's today. The food was excellent, the portions were generous and the two of us ate for $13.00 and took home leftovers. The server was a really nice guy who explained the dishes to us and couldn't have been more helpful.

My friend and I were looking for a late breakfast open on thanksgiving. Cafe gitane was the perfect place with their "petit dejeuner complet". It was the first time I had breakfast there and it was delicious.

I ate lunch at The Sea Fire Grill twice and it was fantastic both times. I'm a fairly picky eater but I had no problem ordering off the menu.  The Organic Scottish Salmon and Pan Roasted Organic Chicken were delicious!!  They were cooked to perfection.  The decor of the restaurant is very elegant and there is a fireplace in the back room that adds a nice romantic touch to the space.
Awesome place to grab a sandwich. Over 50 different choices. I go at least twice a week, they have a great staff with fair prices. It's the hidden gem of CCSU.

I just went in for a drink to the bar, but I did browse around the restaurant area, the rest of the bar and to be honest... I loved the place. Great service, great set up and super located. Go for the whiskey sour. Enjoy.
Service isn't really that great and kitchen moves a little slow, I've never had an entree come out before the 15 minute threshold for brunch or dinner. But food is delicious!

I'm a big fan of Polish/Ukrainian/Russian food and this place was basically heaven for me, the stuffed cabbages were out of this world and the Borscht filled me up good, waiters were efficient and looked a bit surprised to see Chinese people eating there hahah
Love it here.  Great burgers

We were eager to check out Bobby Flay's restaurant after reading great reviews. Hospitality was great, service was good, meals were brought out quickly. The options on the small plate menu were numerous, all was good but the food was salty and over seasoned. I thought it was the cauliflower only but the pasta dish was excessively salty as well. Overall it was good but I expected more.

went there with my family this week. We live in Brooklyn so it was quite a ride, but we wanted to try it after seeing it on Diners, Driveins and Dives. We were very excited and we tried all the dishes we saw on tv . We were all very disappointed i must say. Portion s were very small for what they charged. And nothing really t asted that amazing. I'm sorry to say place is really small and is in desperate need of update. Dinner definitely did not wow us and we will not be going back. Very disappointed.

In 35 years eating in the Ironbound this was the worst dining experience  we have ever had there. We love Portuguese and Brazilian Cuisine and have tried many restaurants without being skunked. Our waiter was totally inattentive, he spent most of our time there with his back to the dining room folding napkins. He never asked if we wanted another drink, wine  or water. He served our entree before serving my wife her soup which only arrived after my wife asked one of the other servers for it. Our drinks were good as was the bread but the food was a disaster: my wife's comment on her soup was "tastes like something that might be served in a prison." The large Cataplana  contained 3 clams, 4 bay scallops, 2 mussels, about a half dozen tiny shrimp and a lobster plus a second body. The lobster meat was shriveled and tasteless as though it had died of starvation in a holding tank and then been precooked. The broth had neither garlic or herbs and was tasteless as well. To add insult to injury, the prices were substantially higher than those on the posted menus. Stay away.

Visited Philly for a few days and was looking for good brunch/late lunch great food.  Came across Cambridge as the sister restaurant recommended by another restaurant (don't remember the name).  The service, ambiance, and food were nothing short of amazing. Everything we ordered from the food, to the draft beer was well prepared and extremely delicious. For anyone looking for a comfortable, casual, delicious  lunch / dinner... you won't be disappointed.

My bf and I first anniversary, we came here for dinner. The ambience is quite amazing.  My favorite part. Appetizer: I don't remember what we got, but I didn't have a problem. My bf eats everything. Main course: I got chicken. It was a little dry. But, not too bad. I don't remember what else. Over all, my waitress was very attentive and friendly.  Even though, the food wasn't totally amazing. Everything else made up for it. Really nice for a date. The view is just stunning.

Our family of 5 ate here on Black Friday while getting a ride on the Staten Island ferry. It's very close walk and the diner is very relaxed. My son had the Belgian waffle, my wife and two girls had the chicken fingers and fries bs then I had the chili cheese burger on a muffin. All of it was good. We will try it again on our next visit.

Havana social?....My boyfriend, his best friend, and I found this place through Yelp. I was extremely tired of walking into restaurants with great decor but crap food! this place is now my new favorite restaurant in the city! Honestly, we almost left and I'm so happy that we decided to stay and eat at the bar. If only I knew about this place 3 months ago....they're food is SOOOOO GOOOOOD that I was about to cry! I did not expect for the food to be this... amazing! My mouth had a flavorful explosion that made me feel as if fairies came and dance on my tongue with magical happy dust that collided with butterfly kisses and made sweet love. I'm in love with this place! I'm recommending this place to everyone I know, people I will meet in the future, whatever! I'm actually going back next week with my friend to share this amazingly delicious orgasmic food! Oh happy day
Best place for small private parties. Good food, good service, BYOB, overall we had the best time ever.

Our favorite restaurant in Hell's kitchen.Tiny place but with very nice atmosphere. The food is delicious. Mushroom cigars (really tasty), tuna tartar are my favourite appetizers. Filet mignon (amazing especially with rosemary fries), rack of lamb is very good too for the entry. The service is very good. Every time we coming we are getting our own bottle of wine. The place is cash only.
This is my favorite Sushi place. I highly recommend the Fire Dragon Roll if you like spicy food. This is a Byob restaurant

Seeking options while in Newark, found Sol-Mar. The place is small, and it is easy to realize that you passed him, but worth it, even if you have queue. The menu is almost entirely based on lobster dishes, and is super famous for Lobster Roll, lobster sandwich and chips. Very worth it, and it really is understandable because it is in several lists of the best Lobster Rolls NJ. The ravioli is also very good, worth a try!

Have always been more of a ramen guy but the pho here may have converted me - def my favorite place for pho by a long shot. Also had the pork chop over vermicelli which is one of my favorite dishes and it met my high expectations. Definitely my new favorite viet restaurant in nyc.

We have been coming here for the last two years. Their samosa and dosas are to die for. Dosa is Indian version of crepes, the difference is that it is made of rice, which makes them gluten free. The samosas are not gluten free though :(

We came here for drinks and it took us about 15 minutes for our waiter to come by and get us menus. He was extremely rude when we only ordered 2 drinks for 6 people at the table. The drink was pretty good but the experience was ruined because of the bad service.
The burgers were creative in a gimmicky way. The servers were all too busy being pretentious hipsters to help their customers. Overrated and overpriced.

Excellent tour. Scott is very passionate about pizza and more importantly very good at interacting with his guests. Our group had a great time. He also tweaked our tour to fit the interests of the people in our group. We had a thanksgiving day to remember!

We had an amazing post Thanksgiving drink here. The staff is very friendly, the place was completely full of candles and made a very cozy environment. We had a glass of wine and decided to order the lamb chops and the burrata with prosciutto. It was delicious!!! We are definitely going back soon, loved this place!

Yo this place is so good w matador. And jalea but the seafood paella and the chaulaflan de pollo was terrible el pollo estava fritto en end LA freidors seco sin sabor de paella muy malo pot 30$ is no way you can serve this can of dishes sorry you change chef I dont know

I typically eat Cantonese food, but love spicy (Capsaicin spicy) and Szechuan food in general also.  The Szechuan food here is hands down way better than anything near metro Boston.  I would definitely go here a lot more often if only it weren't in the middle of CT.  I guess I know where I would be scheduling my pit stops in the future. Simply outstanding Chinese food, but with the heat level dialed down to better suit the general palette.  This might perhaps be a negative for heat seekers, but a definite plus for the majority of people.  The food is so good that I don't miss the heat.  I would trust the chef to prepare the food however he thinks is best.
Most of the dishes which are small sizes are interesting, two or three in the tasting menus are incredible and cooked in front of you by a staff of three. A little overpriced tough for what you eat.
The pork buns are excellent. The spicy is serious spicy, so if you like that, it's delicious. Get there early, since the wait is long and you have to put your name down in a list. Cash only also.
Awesome place! Good craft beers! Try the Evil Genius Purple Monkey! Also try the Lamb Burger!! Couldn't put the burger down!

This place is great!  I loved the Wow coffee and the red velvet muffin! Friendly owners and great service!  The crepes are also great,  we had one with oreos and chocolate and it was awesome!  Highly recommended!!!
Drool. The end.
The crunch burrito was very good! The soup special today was pumpkin miso. That was good as well. I loved that the calories were posted on the menu.

I'm usually a big fan of Empanada Mama but the other day I went in to order takeout and it took forever. The place is usually packed but it only had a couple of tables occupied at the time. I thought 3 empanadas and an order of guacamole would take a few minutes but I was in there for nearly 20! The staff just kept walking by me and not even an apology for the delay. It was only until I went to the counter and asked that they started moving fast and I got my order. I love it and will probably get food from there but never again takeout without calling first!

What a beautiful new restaurant and bar. A cozy, warm space, exceptionally well designed by StephanieGOTO, managed by a team of truly passionate professionals serving hand-crafted drinks and highly creative food. Outstanding new restaurant. Great cocktails - let the mixologist create your cocktail - it will be just perfect.
Eric was a GREAT server. He asked what we liked and made excellent recommendations. Food was very good. The restaurant was decorated in a cool edgy and modern Asian apparel

I'm just a couple a blocks from this establishment and it was a refreshing addition to the community.  I'm not a daily meat eater anymore so this is a fabulous spot to eat  in.   The food is satisfying but not heavy and the flavors are fresh and  I can  have all my veggies.  They also have smoothies to enjoy.

Wait time is decent. Ordered a beer. Didn't get it. Ordered salmon toast. They forgot it. Party of five with friends. Server didn't seem apologetic. So it was like I didn't even eat there due to service.
This some good shit. Great food, good tunes, great value. Staff is very welcoming and happy to help, my go to after work on Fridays.

This is one of my Saturday mornig breakfast stops.  Parking is a little difficult in this neighborhood but worth driving around a couple times to find a spot.  It is very clean inside.  The service is fast and friendly.  I get scrambled egg on a croisant with cheese.  It is always good even though the cheese is never fully melted.  That little extra touch would make a difference.  They also don't have ketchup, which I have been meaning to ask them to consider.  Maybe it is my personal preference but I think they should offer ketchup to their customers.  They carry Honest tea, which is one of my favorite things to drink.  Their pricing is pretty good considering that the sandwich is filling. So far, so good!
The Pizzeria part has an amazing Pizza called Grandma's Pizza. Their dinning room side has awesome Dinner and it's a Byob. The service here is so good. My favorite waitress is Shannon. Very pleased

I've had my fair share of dining at nice restaurants, but Hakata Tonton made me so happy that I am finally writing my first review! I've tried a few hotpot places around the city, but this place is definitely my favorite. The restaurant is small and can't seat many people, so I recommend making a reservation beforehand to secure a spot. We started with the monkfish's liver and the foie gras inari sushi. The monkfish's liver was good, but didn't leave any lasting impression. But I absolutely LOVED the foie gras inari sushi to the point where my friend and I considered ordering another serving. Every single bite I took seriously felt like heaven in my mouth. The rice was seasoned well, and the tofu skin was thin and soft but still flavorful. And to top it off, the foie gras was seared nicely. Grilled pork tonsoku w/ scallion and ponzu sauce: the restaurant specializes in pig's feet, so you can only imagine how good this was. It was absolutely delicious with its gelatinous texture and its crispy, chewy skin. However, if you order the hakata tonton hotpot, I don't think a separate order of the grilled pork tonsoku is necessary. Hakata tonton hotpot: I absolutely loved it. I came with one friend, and we devoured everything, literally had nothing left in our bowl. We opted to mix in rice with the leftover broth and finished that too. I don't think I've ever eaten this much and felt this full in my life, and I eat a lot. But it was all worth it--truly all worth it. The service was attentive and good. We didn't have any problems with service as other reviews have complained about the slowness. I was so satisfied and content with my experience at this restaurant that I wanted to tip generously only to find out that the servers don't accept tip! I left with only paying 40$... ONLY 40$!!!!!!!!! I've definitely paid much more for meals that did not even match half the quality and taste of this restaurant. I already made my reservation to go back.

Just got home from dinner here, The waiter was very prompt and responsive, as was the hostess. The app. and meal were out very quickly and were fantastic, the portions were great and the price was on par with the other Mediterranean establishments I've dined in in the area. We had sampler appatizer with four different cold items, and we split an entree that had 4 different types of meat (chicken, lamb, kufta, and gyro meat, i think) that tasted freshly cooked and, again, was really good. We will be returning soon.

I was so upset every time I walked by and saw that the gate was closed. This became my favorite lunch break spot last year when they first opened. I passed by the restaurant today and I was greeted by the owners, I was so surprised when they recognized me and remembered my name! Awesome staff and great vibes, you'll be seeing me everyday!

Amazing food here. Their spicy ham and Swiss is probably the best sandwich I've had in ages. The popcorn they give you is amazing too. This place is definitely worth checking out. Staff was super friendly too. All in all I think I found my new sandwich place.

After the movies last Saturday we went to First and Last for dinner.  I had been dreaming about their Cioppino all day  my mouth was watering.  I was not disappointed,  in fact the dish was even better than I remembered.    They also have the best bred ever.  We will be back again and again

The pork buns are as necessary as a stop in central park. The food is great and the service even better. I am always overwhelmed with dinner options in New York but now I have my one go to spot. I tried so many dishes but there was nothing like the pork buns. I came with a lot of friends and thought it was going to be difficult to get a large table. Even though they were packed they were very helpful and prompt in getting us in.

Hands down favorite pizza place. I take my vegan and non vegan friends here. Nice atmosphere if u like dark and cozy. Good beer menu. Personal favorite is the ricotta de vegan. A little pricey but it's worth it in my opinion.

I was in the area and stopped by with some friends. The place was definitely short-staffed at the time. It seemed like a person working there was nowhere to be seen for stretches on end. The tones in their voice gave it away that they are not pleased at all and it was just awkward that it comes out on customers. I've worked in restaurants, things get hectic, but you always try and keep your cool when talking to clientele. Anyway, salads were bland and the pizzas and ravioli was just OK. Edible and filling, but nothing to write home about. The place just seems like it needs an energy boost or something. There's people there, but it feels dead.
Great food! The food is always fresh and delicious. The cashiers are very polite and friendly. I'll order here again soon!
Delicious for really any meal, cute and romantic, super fresh and original food. Love the crostinis.
I have been going to this place for years but today for the first time they charged me $ fit extra sauce!! R u kidding me? They should check their employees honesty at work

In PHL for the weekend and yelped this place. The family w as not disappointed at all.  Young picky daughters and they were chow'in down.   Fried dumplings were awesome. We went with hand drawn noodle soups & they were awesome. I only Wish I lived next door so I could eat it once a week.

If I could give Zero stars i would. The bar tender asked me for my license and credit card to order drinks. When i went to close my tab, i got back my card and no license. She gave it to another black girl whose name is not even close mine. I guess we all look alike. When i decided to wait until close for my card they treated me as if i did something wrong when all i did was sit in my seat and wait for them to look for my license. The owner tried to give me $20 to leave (meanwhile they already charged my card) how does one drive home without their license? I'm still sitting here. They called a police officer over but after he heard what happened he told the owner she was in the wrong and left. I'm still here at 1:22 am waiting for a solution. I will never ever come back to this place. The bar tender is so busy flirting for tips that she isn't paying attention and is more than unapologetic. I'm pissed
The resturant is always busy. Small but overall a  nice spot. The hot chicken is amazing!!!!!!!! Also great for carry-out.

Their lunch menu sucks which isn't their fault, I just should have checked before going. However, I did order the lobster mac and cheese and it came out cold. I prefer the Old City location. Also weird that there are two way mirrors letting anyone who passes by look into the bathrooms. Very strange and creepy.

My grandma spilled her hot coffee and when we told the waitress, she didn't do anything. We asked for water and ice to put on the burn and it took her minutes to get it for us. The restaurant is TINY; it shouldn't have taken more than a minute. The burn blistered and she has scabs all over her arm now. This was on top of below average food and terrible service in general. It took the waitress 10 minutes to even bring us menus and all of my food was overcooked.

The place is quite nice and the food is not bad but this is not enough to justify the price and how is ranked this restaurant in tripadvisor. The dishes are very well presented but a little bit savorless. The service was average (some good waitress but we were waiting for the wine quite a while). We did the mistake to order the wines pairing (4 different wines pairing with the 4-dish menu): It was overpriced considering the quantities served and most of the wines were not in line with our taste. Finally, the restaurant was half empty, what we found strange considering the good critics appearing here. Probably there are better options in NY for this price.

Incredibly unorganized. Arrived on a Saturday night & was told the wait would be 30 mins. Asked to sit at the bar and was told there was no bar tender even though there were clearly people sitting there having drinks. Came back 30 mins later and was told we would need to wait another 45 mins. We left! I had high hopes for this place but they need to get their act together!
This place looks like a hole in the wall from the outside but its our go to take out chinese! Theyre really fast and the food is good, we always get free sodas too

This is a dark little place in Bed/Sty with a short menu of unique food. Things like appetizers of Trout Caviar, Nippon Nachos and Hummas were all excellent. The dinners were also good but the portions are a little small. All were good. The server was pleasant but in slow motion most of the time. It is unusual for today that they are not particularly Gluten Free friendly.

Went here because my brother frequents the establishment. We decided to have a family dinner here due to this. First off, finding parking was ridiculous. Had to circle the lot a couple times before I could park even relatively close. The restaurant is located within a hotel, but you would never guess this based upon their pricing. Their serving sizes were also quite small.  I was surprised by the small portion size as most Italian style restaurants that seem to give that "home"/style atmosphere give sizeable portions. I came hungry and left hungry which was disappointing. No complaints with the service as our server was nice and quite friendly however I just did not enjoy my time here and neither did most of my family. I doubt we will return.

I was excited to get some fried chicken. Got here at 430 and they said I had to wait until 5. I asked multiple times if there is anything they can do but no. I am not a happy camper especially because their lunch menu is like 4 things. I will not be returning although I will say their fried chicken is usually pretty good. Better than Lincoln or crown but worse than a good fried chicken place.
you raised your prices :(

OMG! We were not through dinner and  we're almost pushed out by a mob on a birthday party. Our table was crushed. Spent $700+ on a not so good dinner with bad service. This is a bar NOT A RESTAURANT. No apologies from any manager. Never seen anything like this happening on a reputable restaurant. The manager is a complete moron!

So after a few attempts to eat here, during peak breakfast/brunch hours, I finally made it inside....hip hip hooray!!!! Right? Nope, not much to celebrate about. I ordered challah french toast, potatoes, fried eggs & bacon. I think the French toast was over cooked bc it was dry & tasteless thank God for the cinnamon, powered sugar & syrup. If blindfolded I would have had no idea what it was that I was eating. The potatoes were ok as were the eggs, but the pork bacon was to die for!!!! The best bacon I've had in a very long time. Oh & the coffee taste like I smoked a cigarette & I'm a non smoker.... My date ordered the Foccacia Breakfast sandwich which she enjoyed & I must admit looked quite tasty. Maybe it's just me, or maybe the cook was having a bad day but overall I did not enjoy the food here BUT I'm willing to give it another try in the future. According to the other Yelp reviews the food here rocks & that was one of the many reasons I wanted to eat here

We were up in Bayonne for thanksgiving and decided to give the place a try.  Overall we were happy with the experience. For appetizers we got the chicken satay and the pork dumplings.  The satay was decent but the dumplings were quite literally something I've bought in the frozen food section of the grocery store.   I'd expect a sit-down place to make their own or to at least have some of higher quality. For I our main courses she got the hibachi (shrimp and scallops), her "strip and scallops" was misheard.  That being said,  they're was plenty of food and she enjoyed it all.   I got the filet off of the "from the kitchen" menu.  It was slightly underdone "I ordered med rare", but not too rate for my taste.   It was a very tender and flavorful cut of meat.   I'm picky when it comes to steak and I would give that 5 stars. For dessert we were hoping for the mochi green tea and red bean ice cream but had to settle for the regular style of those flavors.   The green tea was pretty good but was more like a chocolate green tea.   The red bean was pretty chunky and did not have much sweetness to it. Our server was polite and attentive and the other employees were very nice (host not impolite but not friendly sorbet). The main dishes and service earned the rating.   Just avoid the dumplings.

Went here for the first time last Friday night.  Was very excited as my cousin spoke highly of Ola.  I was the first to arrive in my party and was sat at the table.  I ordered the jalapeno pineapple marg, it was quite tasty.  When ordering we asked for suggestions from our waitress and she wasn't very helpful.   Working in the industry you should be able to sell your menu, that's just my opinion.  My sister and cousin ordered the skirt steak and when the food runner brought the food to the table she just kept saying medium.  I think the food runner should know the food she is running and also where it is going.  In the midst of her confusion she stood there waiting for help while the food was getting cold.  I ordered the shrimp dish, it was good, not too flavorful.  The guac was good and also the dip they served w the bread was tasty as well.  I would give them one more chance just out of curiosity.

I don't know how anyone can give this place less than 5 stars. The time that they put into the ribs, brisket, and pulled pork is obvious and is de;vicious. The beer selection is excellent and constantly changing so you always have a variety. The bartender, Peter, was filled with info on all the beers and steered me towards all great beers. Overall ill defiantly be back...a lot. nice change from the norm excellent service, comfortable atmosphere, great food, great beer how can you go wrong

Love, love, love! Been coming here for years and the quality has never changed. Love their salsa, so tasty with the right amount of spice. I always get the chicken mission quesadillas,  and they are always full of flavor. Went their yestrrday, Friday night, I felt adventurous and tried the tacos, def like the hard shell better. Hubby had the chicken fajitas,  he liked them, and still have more for lunch! I always recommend as my fav mexican spot for the last 10 years!

Very pleasant surprise! Doesn't look like much from the outside, but step inside and step into a different world. I had the fish tacos and my husband had the mexican street fight. both were excellent. Food and atmosphere were both awesome. We will be back. so much more on the menu to try. Big thumbs up.

I had to wait 1 hour to sit down to eat with my party at the pizza corner but it was worth it. While we waited we had coffee and browsed through the market that has everything from gelato to truffles. The price was good. We even had some great Italian wine. Highly recommend. Worth the wait. Took some pasta home. Delicious .

Just Plain Dave's should change their name to Just Plain Wrong. When they changed locations ownership  left everything  that was good about Just Plain Dave's behind. We called our order in over the phone  and the girl who took our order was just plain rude. (forgive the puns) We drove to the new location looking forward to a shrimp po boy and my big AL (burger with Taylor ham). Walking in through the back entrance I was waiting for the warm welcome  I was used to at the old location but it was replaced by blank expressions and attitude.  I felt like I was being questioned by the Spanish inquisition. "Can I help you?? Are you  here to pick up??" Not that those are the wrong things to ask but letting a customer get a word in is a big help. Fast forward to the food...to save the suspense..it was not up to par..especially when you compare to the old just plain dave's. The big AL was exactly what I was expecting..that is if I was expecting a giant Salt burger. Now I know that a burger is going to have some salt  and Taylor ham is ..well Taylor ham, but the level of salt was right up there with the dead sea . My side of fries was no exception..just soggy and loaded with salt. My wife was equally disappointed with her shrimp po boy. There was very little sauce..mayo..or remoulade..not sure what they're using. The bread was soggy ( if it can be soggy it will be..this seems to be a trend for just plain meh.. I mean dave's) The shrimp..which is a big part of the shrimp po boy was the worst part of the sandwich. At the old just plain dave's the shrimp was shrimp..real shrimp...this shrimp is frozen..or already made and just heated I'm not sure. The only thing I can say about the shrimp po boy..not good at all. (And soggy salty fries on the side...just in case there was any doubt). I don't know what the story is with the new location or the old.place closing down..not sure if it's a new owner or what the case is but this is not just plain dave's...it's just bad.
Just God awful service and the food comes out cold. I asked for something to be fixed and they gave me attitude. We took my boyfriends mother there, and she's from out of town...just embarrasing

We went there 3 times on thanks giving. Regretfully it was closed. No signs tells you its there when closed. We didn't give up. Finally we came on sunday afternoon and found it open. It was worth the effort.
Perfect place for tapaz! We sat at the chefs bar and got to see all of the amazing food being made so we knew exactly what to order. Glad we found this gem!
It's small Nd gkod food.  I don't find it to be a good value.  Back patio is very nice.

Very well done though in think I over ordered due to the American sized tapas.   All of the dishes and the four red wines offered were excellent.   I especially liked the meatballs w manchego cheese and the charcuterie plate.   Highly recommend.

I advise not to go here anymore. This place isn't what it used to be and is going downhill sadly.  Working here for more than two and a half years has been good, but after seeing certain things, I decided it was time to get out. The environment is very negative and no one at the inn is treated equally sadly. It's sad to see a good business declining and nothing is being done. If you want to dine in at a place with more class that treats people with respect I recommend going someplace else. The Cranbury Inn is definitely not one of them.

We go to the Cranbury Inn about once a year for family celebrations. No more. One thing remains constant. The owner always ostentatiously parks his yellow Corvette at the head of the driveway -- looks like a new one this year - with the license plate "Va Bene". Ironic. Why do I mention it? You'll soon see my point. So, it's Thanksgiving. This was the first Thanksgiving without my mom who died last December. We have a small family and wanted to have a pleasant meal to mark the occasion, raise a glass and so on. It wasn't to be. First, we had to wait 25 minutes to be seated. OK, that can happen on a bustling holiday. However, things only got worse. We were seated in the back banquet room, which, we learned, had been set up for a wedding reception the next day. (We thought this was strange as each table was numbered, as you'd find at a wedding reception.) It slowly became clear why the service was so slow. They were short-staffed and there weren't enough waiters to handle this room. No exaggeration, we waited for 1 hour for a waitperson to take our DRINK order. There seemed to be no one assigned to our table. Waitpeople came over to check and left. It became more and more evident that this was a disaster in the making. Then we heard the rumblings and grumblings. Couples had screamed at the owner, the owner had overbooked, busboys didn't show up. 75 minutes to get our drinks, 90 for the soup. We kept pretty composed, but the irritation was building. Then our after 110 minutes our entrees came. The salads never arrived. Thank goodness the food was good, but the mood we had hoped to create was lost. Finally, the check came with a wrong, more expensive item tabulated.  This restaurant has been around a long time. How can the owner had so seriously misjudged his guest list? Remember the new  Corvette? Makes you wonder.

Manakeesh has been what I call my second home, it has a very cozy atmosphere.  It's a great  place to meet with important people or where you want to just hang out with your friends or have a family reunion, it fits any occasion. I did get engaged there, so having special moments in your life, Manakeesh is a great place to have it. The employees are wonderful and hospitable as well and they do whatever they can to make your  visit a wonderful experience. The food is also amazing, my favorite is the tawook, but if you are a vegetarian I would recommend zaatar  "thyme" sandwich with vegetables. Their tea and coffee is very good. The way they present it to you makes you feel your in an Arabian country. They give it to you with a whole arabic tea set as well as the coffee.  Oh and don't forget their baklava and their sweets!! Don't go to any place EXCEPT Manakeesh for their baklava! They make EVERYTHING from scratch and everything is FRESH, sometimes if you get lucky they let you try some that just came straight out the oven!I I recommend  everyone to come here. It's one of the best places to be in Philadelphia. If you don't believe me, try it!!

Stopped in last Saturday night after seeing a movie at a local cinema.  No reservation but we were graciously greeted by the hostess, Alice, and made to feel very welcome.  Started with the Brussels sprouts followed by the hangar steak frites and the Caddy burger.  Both cooked to order and very good.   Service was attentive.  Definitely a place to hit.  We will back.

I ordered an appetizer plate for Thanksgiving.  They have wonderful stuffed grape leaves.  Due to the snow I couldn't get out and Nabil had it delivered to my home.  The portions were outrageous and while I ordered for 5, it served twice that and staved off a houseful from asking "when will the turkey be ready?"   It is a real gem in South Orange.

The Pig and Prince is THE (and only) gastropub in montclair. The restaurant offers both a unique dining and environment and menu. Taking the place of the former Montclair train station, the decor of the restaurant is chic, but not over the top...well, maybe with the exception of the giant rooster painted on the back wall. The menu is extensive and eclectic. We started off with a cheese platter that showcased a variety of Pig and Prince's cheese. The cheeses ranged from a creamy goat cheese to cheddar that was as sharp as a razor blade. The cheese platter was accompanied by freshly baked raisin bread. The platter was wonderful, but could have used more raisin bread. We then moved on to a Bacon apple bor-gonzola fresno  and red onion pizza. It was amazing! The fire baked pizza exemplified the perfect marriage of salty, savory and sweet. We also had the duck confit risotto, which was dressed with fig and toasted pistachios. Unfortunately, the risotto was bland and a disappointment. I was expecting a delicious symphony of sweet and savory, but was left with flavorless duck and rice. Overall, the Pig and Prince is a unique restaurant for adventurous foodies. Though pricey, the food is freshly prepared and delicious (with the exception of the risotto) Their unique menu and setting definitely makes itself stand out from other restaurants in Montclair.

Friend of the chef suggested i try this place out, from being greeted at the door to having one of the best waiters ever, Pig & Prince was top notch. The waiter made great recommendations from apps to wine selection. Really liked the decor, atmosphere and of course the food. Will absolutely go back again.
This is by far one of the best pizzas in NYC! Creamy delicious artichoke pizza yumm!! Great anytime of the day!! I can only say I love it!
Awesome! Love the vibe and the food is warm and good! I went there last night for my birthday! The chef was very welcoming and made my night ! Thank you again!

Ate Thanksgiving meal here. This place tries awfully hard to reflect a cozy, rustic hide-a-way. This attempt masks an overpriced, pretentious venue with marginal food. The pork schnitzel was overcooked and relatively flavorless. The pickled vegetables consisted of what seemed like a Vlasic dill pickle and a spoonful of canned caraway sauerkraut. The desserts were extraordinarily forgettable - if not bad. We were stuck with a $350 bill for four and walked away wishing we'd never seen "Edi and the Wolf" - on-line or in person. Skip it. NYC has too many good restaurants to waste your time and money here.

The food is good for those who doesn't have food allergies.  unfortunately with my food allergies even when I tell them no gluten butter meat chicken and garlic I still get sick every time I went there tonight and of course I am sick and bathroom bound if I go there i probably will order edamame three bowls of them and soberts my parents enjoy their foods dumplings always was their favorite lobster friend rice with soy sauce is best for them we explored with no soy for lobster fried rice it is overly dried it needed something to moisture it atmosphere is great for people watching just make sure you don't climb to kiss Buddhism hello or else you get into trouble my family friend almost got into trouble and got out of it the soberts are awesome they give you three or four different kinds
Korean tempeh tacos were good. I think I would have liked it more if I had eaten in, but I got my food to go since I was in a rush, so the presentation was underwhelming. Tasty, and slightly spicy.

This is like the best place ever. Food galore!! You will find great food here and great donuts at the Beiler's Bakery. Love, love their donuts-especially the delicious and to die for vanilla cream and salted caramel!!

I love to go there for having home-made foods and also local vegetables and great bread at the Metropolitan Bakery. The good thing is that you can park accross the street on 12th St, and you pay a reduced fee if you go to the market. I like to buy there also coffee. One of the shops there has a great selection and the prices are good. Another neat place I go whenever I am going to travel is to a place where they sell Phila souvenirs. Or if you want to have a wonderful Amish breakfast with freshly made orange juice and pancakes, go there! You will love visiting such a great place!

Decent place to eat with great drinks. Their mojitos are really really good, makes you feel like your on an island. The food was good. I had the roasted chicken which was very well seasoned with plantains. I wasnt so crazy about the appetizers, maybe because my friend gave the order. It was a good meal after shopping for hours in the neighborhood

I'm giving this place three stars but only because of the location. The food is terrible! I had a quesadilla. Simple enough, right? No. It was watery with sauce and yet flavorless at the same time. My friends and I went there after seeing a movie and it was around 10:30 when we got there. So maybe it's because it was kind of late? Not entirely sure but it was GROSS. The service was okay. One of my friends found something in his drink. My other friend got a dirty "to go" container. Ew. Don't go to this place if you can avoid it.

I have been to Katz's Deli many times, but this was the first time since they did their renovations. All i can say is that we waited forever, both for a table and for our food, and the food was horrible. First of all, we had three children with us. The kids food came out LAST. And it was a hot dog and chicken fingers. We must have waited for our food for 45 minutes to an hour, and watched it sit up on the counter for another 15 minutes before our waitress brought it to us. Three of us had salads with grilled chicken on it. The chicken was DISGUSTING. It was far from fresh...looked gray. And it was ice cold. Lettuce was wilted, and the veggies seemed canned. The matzah ball soup was good as usual, but the rest was beyond awful. To the point that I dont think we would go back. Not sure if it is a new chef, or they can't handle the larger volume but it was terrible. I dont think it is too much to ask to have a fresh piece of chicken on a salad.
I really wish I had taken some photos of the restaurant...but I didn't bring my phone so I couldn't tell how great the environment is!!
Ask the bar tender what he would eat!!! Best place I've ever been on a trip! The foods good and the bar tender will make u pee ur pants!

Absolutely the worst Cantonese food I've had in ages. The wonton soup was inedibly salty & watery-bad broth from a can.  Shrimp in lobster sauce was salty & peppery -just not tasty. Shrimp at least were nice size, albeit rubbery.  Egg roll was pure cabbage.  Was looking for old fashioned comforting Chinese food and found none here. Will never return.
Really and excellent place!!  Max and Victor are great and the food is always outstanding at a great price.  Always busy and always active,  Their patio in good weather is great!

I've watched this place slowly getting ready to open, and was so excited for that to happen. But it has fallen very, very short. I think you'd be fine if you stuck to just meatballs, but even those are just mediocre. And honestly, though they claim it is homemade, I just didn't think the pasta was good. At. All. It was covered in cream and what tasted like canned mushrooms. The service was pretty poor, considering there were only two other seated tables. I wanted to like this place! And maybe once they get into the swing of things, they'll improve. But I don't see myself ever going back to see if that happens. Also, disclaimer--- the Yelp page says they accept credit cards, but they don't. Cash only.

I heard about this place as a brief notice from a friend and ever since then wanted to check it out. Such a great spot! Absolutely no complains. The staff is very friendly and the food is so delicious that I keep coming back..been here 2 times already during this past week and has already made a reservation for my bday dinner

Friendly staff and good food.  I have heard good things about this restaurant from a few family members and friends.  The owner was very friendly and welcoming  while not overbearing.  We ordered the spinach dip and a seafood appetizer.  The dip was very good but the seafood appetizer was spectacular.  The sauce had good flavor and a nice spice and the fish were fresh.  We even asked for more bread to soak up the sauce.   All of our entrees were very well done and the perfect size portions.  I ordered the potato crusted tilapia.  My uncle ordered the steak special and my grandfather ordered the stuffed flounder.  The vegetables that came with every entree we ordered were delicious.  Even my grandfather who does not like vegetables ate all of his.  The cheesecake crepes were very well done and the portion was bigger than expected.  My only complaint is the amount of time we had to wait for our food.  I will definitely go back and suggest to friends.

Best affordable Mexican food in NYC.  Despite the small space the food is top notch especially for the price.  I've turned many of my friends on to this spot and can't say enough good things.  If you like spice try the el diablito burrito.  Top notch food I just wish they were open for lunch on weekdays!.
Food is tasty but for a hole in the wall spot it takes forever to get your food. 45 min wait after ordering.  Suggest ordering before u go. 24 hour joint!
Always got great food from here! My fave is Kra Pao Kai. Crabrangoon is the hit. Love this place. They're family owned and always give good service.

Good food good service but what a turn off that they have paper over their white table clothes. Do they hand out crayons so we can color on it.  Come on trying to save money on your linen costs by doing this is so tacky.

We stopped in here pre Tony Bennett concert at the St. George Theater. There were no seats available (they take reservations but full house) so we sat at the bar--turns out they were the best seats in the house. Our martinis were excellent, the food--simply amazing. We had a salad wedge and lobster bisque to start--so good. The filet mignon literally melted in our mouths and the sides were equally as delicious.The bartenders (Lee Ann and Kim who have been with them since opening in 2000) couldn't have been nicer or more attentive. We would definitely come back. Highly recommend! As good if not better than anything in Manhattan.
Unique food and polite staff despite some very rude and impatient patrons.

This is one of our special occasion restaurants when we want to get together with friends and are not quite sure of their food preferences. Isabella's has a pleasant and varied menu and a nice selection of wines at reasonable prices. We have always found the waiters friendly and with a detailed knowledge of the menu and the food preparation. I am a big fan of the mushroom ravioli (great light pasta) and never disappointed. Save room for dessert. The chocolate "bag", which I guess is their signature dessert, is just wonderful. You may want to split it. Yum!

This place is phenomenal. I had the D'OH NUT Cheesesteak  burger...it was amazing. Our waitress AMY was so attentive and spunky. I would drive from Maryland again for this food AGAIN....DEFINITELY  WORTH THE DRIVE!

Food was outstanding but service was HORRIBLE. Customers are equally as rude. I would recommend this place for the food, but unless you want to be rushed and given bad service than I suggest you try going elsewhere on the princeton-junction.

Very qualified and well dressed staff takes you on a culinary adventure in beautiful original setting. You can choose the wine pairing or discover new tastes and pairings with other drinks like sake,cocktails, beer,... We especially enjoyed the cheese based ice cream.
Great food, sushi was amazing, and the owner was really nice I recommend everyone to come to this restaurant every week

Excellent for families with little kids that don't eat spicy food. Even us adults enjoyed the food and variety. The host was excellent and took care of our special food need welcomingly. Even general staff was very professional and courteous. Will recommend

What a gem in my neighborhood! The food is well prepared, and oh so many healthy choices. The bread, the pastries.....yummy! All of this plus an attentive, friendly staff. And....very good coffee. I took my grandbabies here during their recent visit. The staff asked where WE would be most comfortable sitting with two little ones. Kindness matters, and this staff goes the extra mile for their customers. Great food, great service.

Sorry. Looked super cute. But after waiting 50 mins for a slice of cheese on a plate for $15, we gave up. Thanks for the comped wine, but seriously. Why does it take 25 mins for toasted sliced bread to accompany our cheese, and another 45 mins for hamachi (code for uncooked fish!)? Not our game baby. Not our game!

Second time in a row coming here and they have overcharged on beers the entire night. I think it's become their policy to try to rip customers off. If you try to ask them about it they just shrug and swipe your card for what they want to charge you. The food also sounds a lot more appetizing than it is.
Good atmosphere cold beer. I didn't give a five because we didn't eat here only drank however the plates that went by me made me hungry.

el servicio excelente. la comida mexican muy autentica y sabrosa. defenitivamente lo recomiendo , fui hace unos meses pero debo volver pronto!. lo unico triste es que era un poco falta de atencion pero por la mayor parte, el restaurante fue una buena experiencia.
Awesome place and environment. They owner is very kind and friendly. All over a great place to dine. Thanks so much Mucio! :)
The best place to eat in Jersey...been eating this food for ages...recommend platters burgers kabobs sandwiches heaven fries
Great noodles, cooked to perfection. Atmosphere is great and the only odd is cleanness, but if you don`t mind (as I don`t) you will love the noodles and the service. Typical asian.

My boyfriend and I were there last night for the first time and  were impressed with the food and excellent service . I tried the sampler (can't remember the name) and he had the chicken burrito which was served over a green somewhat sweet sauce , along with rice and refried beans.   We also had the Mexican Flan which was delicious. Will difinitely be going back !
AMAZING! The wait is long but worth it! This place is a must go for anyone visiting or locals.

Ordered takeout with the new menu. Supremely disappointed! Mac and cheese entree was a joke. Container was just Noodles and bread crumbs with no cheese. We loved this place in the neighborhood but won't rush back after this effort.

Delicious Ramen served beautifully.  I wasn`t planned to eat here but after reading the reviews I had to stop by.  It was worth for a quick lunch in a business travel.  Place is inexpensive and food delicious.  It`s worth
Food was ok, the service was slow.  We ate upstairs and it had a weird smell, almost like a 1980's peep booth. If you can get into Carmine's definitely go there,  Much better food and service.

We were set up by our concierge at NY Palace. I asked for a comfort food Italian place for my wife and kids. Upon arrival I quickly noticed there were no children, soon figured out this is not kid friendly. We were seated in the back near the double doors. Not a good spot. My daughter had a heater blowing on her and I was constantly getting bumped. We were never sure who was our actual waiter was as Enis started but acted confused. We did not make the usual connection you would with a fine restaurant waiter. Took us 25 minutes to get our wine and had to ask twice for some bread. Adnan popped in and out and should have been our waiter, He was on top of his game.The food was not great. My gnocchi was under cooked and most of the food was under seasoned. Isn't that the #1 rule to taste your food before its sent out of the kitchen? They accommodated my son with there version on chicken tenders but unfortunately charged us $25 to leave off the sauce and salad from the Chicken Milanese. I notice on the way out that the kitchen had a staff of Latino's. That's fine but who's the chef watching the hen house. I'm not knocking the kitchen staff but a fine restaurant should have a chef checking all food going out. The atmosphere was wonderful, however our table was flexing. I lifted up the tablecloth to find a metal mesh outdoor patio table that was actually broken. Really! I was hoping for a lot more on our last night in NY

After being a loyal customer for years, and turning my eyes to declining service, I'm done. I recently had an experience where I was over/upharged, after being given the bill and giving my credit card. When I caught it and pointed it out, nicely, the waitress gave me major attitude. She then proceeded, instead of canceling the charge and running it again, double then triple charging me, which I only realized when I checked my account online. I called the restaurant but never heard back on my message--FYI, they don't pick up the phone, even during business hours, as standard practice. I had to dispute through my bank. Sorry, BL. Just bad business.

First time trying this kind of food, very delicious. The place was very spacious yet homie. The staff was great and the service delightful. As a Hispanic I love spicy food so this was definitely a wonderful experience. I will be returning here with my friends!

My favorite place to eat and drink in Northern New Jersey is now Poor Henry's.  Why? - Best beer selection around!!  - Jessie takes his time and finds beers that others are unaware or unwilling to add to their taps. - Amazing food!  - This place is much more than only wings and burgers - A bar that never feels too packed even when it is crowded. - Live music all weekend long. - Amazing people.  - A very diverse, but fun, crowd. - Amazing bartenders and servers!  - Kudos to Mike and Bob... - Ownership that cares about its customers!!!!!!!!

Hello, I've been here twice---once on a busy Saturday evening; it took us 3.5 hrs to get our food.  The waiters avoid looking at patrons eyes, then I started to wave my arms--but they ignored that as well.  I had to trap one of the waiter between 2 chairs and table to get attention on food delays.  Food when it was finally served was ok but messed up on billing which they acknowledged and fixed. The next time and last time was today (11/28/2014)---Friday evening but ordered out this time.  It was NOT a busy evening for them. I ordered the same food as the first visit.... came home only to know that they served all dishes in small portions (they provided all in small lunch containers and not full dinner-size containers that you would get at any Chinese or other Indian restaurants).  I called to address this issue and to see if they made a mistake our portion.  I was very surprised to hear "well, you get what you paid for".  it was because of this attitude that we will never come here again.   Hence, my review.  Thank you.

Their menu is health concious and uses a lot of organic products. The drink menu has many special coctails that I have never heard of. They are really good i must say that.My favorite food are the kale salad . Its to simply die for. All the food we've ordered were good. They are of *****star quality. The service is friendly and courteous . Will surely love to visit again sometime soon. Keep it up. cheers.
This place just rocks. Great, fresh sushi.  Loved the atmosphere, and a really pretty walk through Washington square. One of the best sushi restaurants in the city.

After a recent discovery of and conversion to Ramen-ism, I had to make a pilgrimage to the holy grail while I was in the city. What struck me most is that ramen is only a component of the Ippudo experience. It's really a way of life. I loved the commitment to maintaining the atmosphere - there's always someone speaking in Japanese and every item on the menu seems authentic and intentionally placed. The Akamaru Modern I tried was delicious, and they had the best ramen noodles I've eaten. So what was missing? Perhaps it's that my favorite parts of the ramen experience are the intimacy of the crowded ramen bar or the surprise of an unexpected topping in the bowl... Ippudo is undeniably quality but I think I'll seek smaller, more hole-in-the-wall places in the future to fulfill my ramen journey.

Great local pub, consistent enjoyable food.  Service isn't particularly fast, but it's at least friendly.  Best to go here during the day because it's very low key.  Gets a bit busier at night.  Dartboard and pool table in the back room.  Lots of great food options that are a step above typical pub food.

Crowd of 15 people descended on 10 Park last night for dinner.  Excellent service throughout the evening, not rushed and someone always nearby to fill a glass or answer a questions.  Started with eggplant rollitini, calamari and tomato, homemade mozzarella and basil for apps.  Everything was delicious.  Each of us had a salad and different main courses.  I had appetizer shrimp in garlic as main course, jump shrimp and lots of them.  Everyone raved how good their meal was, including my cousin who just spent a month in Italy.  Super friendly staff.  Had desert & coffee.  It was a big hit, thank you 10 Park!!

Yes we knew it was famous and somewhat touristy but as pizza lovers we had to give it a try. Don't regret it for a minute! The pizza was great, but it was the whole package that was the fun part. Fun place, funny and friendly staff and overall a fun time. Two people can easily shear a small pizza. They are huge! No beer and only cash accepted(in 2014?). Come early or you will have to wait.
The Garganelli dish was featured on the gothamist's list of the best pastas in NYCearlier this year and I have to say they've made the right selection.
Love the different sauces ...and the frites!!! You can get sauces on the side (I prefer to get it layered and 2 different sauces) I always stop here when I'm in the area for a quick meal. :-) YUM!!!

My friend and I first discovered El Vez when we decided to take a road trip from Northern New Jersey to Bensalem for Krispy Kreme donuts. We were in the mood for Mexican food for dinner, so we decided to head into Philadelphia. Our waitress raved about the guacamole, but I have never been a fan, so we opted for an open-faced quesadilla and the Tacos al Carbon (beef and chicken). The tacos came with guacamole, and we both tried it.   That guacamole was the primary reason we decided to return on Wednesday night. When we arrived, we were told there would be an hour or longer wait. They took my cell phone number which gave us a chance to walk around. Our table became available much earlier when a reservation cancelled, and they held our table longer than they originally said in the text message.   This time, we started off with the Tito Santana guacamole (mango, red bell peppers, jicama, habanero, and serrano chiles). My friend and I each ordered the carnitas tacos. My friend requested his without cilantro. Our waitress came back a little while later to see if we wanted the cilantro left out of the guacamole.   Our first trip, my friend ordered a virgin Strawberry Margarita, and on our second, I ordered a pomegranate one. Both were pretty good- though I have no reference point for comparison (virgin or non-virgin). We also ordered the tres leches cake on our second visit, and it was absolutely amazing.   It's a shame it's a 2 hour drive to get there because we'd probably eat there every week at the very least if we could.
Got steak and a chicken dish and both were so good. Love the food and the vibe of this place. Great ambiance in an old house
Excellent spot for a big group in midtown.  Family style portions make ordering easy, will be back again.

My favorite Italian restaurant.  Platters of delicious food served family style. Prices are reasonable considering how much you get. Two caveats: great bread basket - restrain yourself, and try not to over-order. Caesar salad, 2 pastas, 2 meats serves 5 or 6 no skimping. Service is excellent but Carmine's fills up so you may have to wait for a table - go to the bar and split a calamari appetizer. I love this place - 5 out of 5 stars. I'm a repeat customer and I look forward to going back. Very highly recommended.

Usually when I say "wow" I am excited to explain my experience but boy this "wow" is quite the opposite. Came here with a large party and the first knock was several apps being forgotten. Next, our entrees came out disjointed with several coming after other guests had already finished. Service was subpar on top off all this and the ultimate nail in the coffin was the manager who failed to appropriately care for our party after voicing our numerous issues. Will never return here or recommend this to anyone. PS- the table across from us had the waitress spill wine on one of them and not own it and they left in a fit.

I had the Pollo Al Forno, which is Roasted Chicken & Salsa Verde. This dish was excellent and was featured in an episode of Food Network's Best I Ever Ate by Tyler Florence. I also had the Patate, which is Roasted Potatoes, Pecorino(Italian Cheese), & Rosemary. And I ordered Broccolo, which is Broccoli, Currants, & Colatura(Anchovy Sauce). The potatoes were so good. They were like gourmet french fries because they were crisp and crunchy on the outside and soft in the inside. And the broccoli had a very sophisticated saltiness to them, I'm assuming that is a result of the Anchovy Sauce. For dessert I had the biscotti to-go. The flavors and textures of the various biscotti were perfect for a late night snack after being out at a bar.
A good place to escape from all the noises in your life. They serve delicious cocktails.
Been eating here all my life.  Love the MOR pie. The pizza is the best in Staten Island and the prices are great too. Best of it all, they have a bar.  absolutely my favorite pizza hands down.

There are a lot of good restaurants in this city, but gone are the days of having an amazing dining experience. The attention to detail, and that detail being YOU is why you go here. There's really only 1 item on the menu that you need to get and it's the "Menu Tasting" The chef selects and you enjoy. The staff is amazing. It doesn't matter who took your order because whatever you ordered shows up in front of you.

Waited in like for 30 min for a table of 4. 4 guys walk up, read the list and steal someone's reservation. When I called their attention to it, not only did they seat them they expected us to continue to wait. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER Service.
Amazing food. Impeccable service. Would recommend to anyone willing to spend money for an amazing experience. Fresh ingredients and lovely staff.

Sorry, but the original Sharkey's in Clifton is far, far better in quality of the food (particularly the famous wings!) and the level of service than this one in Boonton. We would have spent much more $$ there for beers alone if we could have gotten better service. They try hard but need to step it up to meet the original.
i go to this place all the time lol everything is good. confirmed.

The portions are so minuscule, you need a magnifying glass to see them. You cannot elevate BBQ. I haven't been here in 3 years and they've raised their price and took away half the portion. You can't charge $14 for two pieces of chopped Brussels sprouts and two pieces of bacon. Half of the bacon was pure fat and inedible. You can't charge $28 for two thin slices of brisket luncheon meat. Half of the meat being inedible fat. And the bonus is you get a half a cup of cold slaw. What kind of snobbery is this? Take your money and go to a legit bbq place like Hill Country. You won't go home hungry.

I never have seen white chicken cocked in my life, I have to explain to you people! I know the real halal food. first this meat it's boiled and not cocked with right way I swear to god. they don't have time to cook because they are in street and huge lane of people Waite. you are tasting only the white sauce and haut sauce. I don't have any thing against this people but I want them to give a good and healthy food to you people. Don't think that you are making a deal with 6$ , because you are going to not only spend too much money for the hospital but loosing your life. Add few dollars and save your self and keep every thing healthy.

My girlfriend and I were visiting a friend in Trenton during a layover at the Philadelphia airport. The food was great, especially considering that we dined at 11:30pm! Before we returned to SEPTA, the management called for a taxi to take us to the station. When our cab ran late THEY DROVE US to the station! Great, great people - superb atmosphere!
Just amazing Had the roast pork with broccoli rab provolone and sweet peppers. Bread is amazing, nothing but great reviews!
Horrible customer service. Went there once. And just left because they rush you in sitting and ordering.  I left the place disappointed.

The food was really, really good! Also, and during the summer, you can eat in their very nice enclosed patio! You get to be outdoors, but you do not have to be on the sidewalk bothering passerby people!
A simple dinner gone missing. Service was terrible, food mediocre, nd the kitchen lost my dinner. Wife's dinner was so-so.

Can't really say too much good about the quality of the food and service here. We opened with a delicious artisanal cheese plate and sautéed Nantucket Bay scallops with a nicely balanced Bandidi Chianti.
