We had an excellent house salad, saw the enticing looking caesar salad, and my husband really enjoyed his salmon salad at lunch. I had riboletta- very good and perfect for a cold day. Enjoyed the wines, too. Our limoncello tart in the evening was incredible, but had I read these reviews, I might have tried the mousse or cheesecake with chocolate sauce! At dinner, the maitre d' came around with a cookie sheet of chocolate chocolate chip cookies, which really won over my husband! We'd go back. I know NY has an infinite number of restaurants to try, but it is nice to know what to expect sometimes. There was no particular children's menu but they can do plain pasta or the pizza can be tweaked.

A very nice little place in Montclair. It's a great way to get away from Jersey so to say it is very tropical. The staff is friendly and their outfits really feels like you are in Cuba. The food is amazing. We had the steak and it's so delicious. My wife had the chicken with coconut rice and it was great!!! Would definitely come back for a romantic dinner outside. Definitely reccomend this place.

Couldn't recommend this place more. Absolutely adorable and romantic atmosphere, very classy, flowers everywhere and the staff was amazing. Food is delicious and doesn't empty the wallet. Highly recommend for a date!
Absolutely delicious. The chicken tacos are a MUST. Everybody here is always nice and the service is pretty legitimate. Can't say that they don't do a great job here.

I am so sad to be writing this, because this used to be one of our favorite restaurants in the neighborhood. However, now it seems to have turned over to the children of the former owner and our last visit was an absolutely awful experience. I made a reservation for my husband's birthday via their on line system. I even received a text confirming the reservation shortly before we arrived. However once we came to the restaurant, we had to wait awkwardly by the door, with another group, hovering over tables. The restaurant workers studiously avoided looking at us, and after several minutes I took it upon myself to move towards the back of the restaurant to try to get some attention. There was one red-headed woman, who clearly seemed to be in charge. I finally got her to acknoweldge me and told her we had a reservation. She went to check, and said it would be a few minutes. After another 10 minutes or so, she seated the other group standing next to us, but didn't say anything or even look at us. (most hosts would say, "it'll be another few minutes", or "i'm sorry for the delay"), after being ignored for another 5 minutes, I had to go to the back of the restaurant, where she seemed to be not doing much other than avoiding me. Finally after asking one of the busboys to get her, I asked about our reservation, and she said - "oh your table is on dessert it should be soon." This is 20 minutes into our reservation! needless to say we left after that abominable treatment! I have rarely had such poor customer service at a restaurant in NYC. I am completely disgusted. We went next door to Bar Bolonat, where the food was impecable and the service lovely....

This place is amazing, we have been coming here for years and this place never dissapoints. Everything on their menue is delicious and the service is great, doesn't hurt that it's BYOB also :) One thing to note is they are cash only so make sure u are prepared.

It's the place to see and be seen in Downtown Hartford.  Great place for a meeting, lunch with a friend, or some time alone to read or work.  A booster seat would be a welcome addition as many young parents visit the library with their toddlers.  Don't worry, the space can accomdate toddlers and adults in a meeting without conflict.
Breakfast, brunch, coffee.

Being a vegetarian, I had never really tried Caribbean food because I didn't think there was anything I could eat. Well, I was wrong... I'm so glad I found this place! I had the vegetable Roti wrap for lunch, which was amazing... Well I should say I had half the wrap. It was huge! The vegetables inside were so good... all very soft and flavorful. I called for pick up and the food was ready immediately when I got there about five minutes later. I definitely want to go back and try some of their other vegetarian options!

I have been a big fan of Juniors in Colchester for a long time, love the authentic Italian dishes! We went to Juniors Rustico to try it out, and we're not disappointed! There are obviously differences between this restaurant and their others, but that's to be expected, right? Different name, different food! The atmosphere is nice and relaxing, the food is delicious, though it is more expensive than there other restaurants. However, the quality and attention to detail is high too! We will definitely be returning!
No matter what we order here it is delicious! Our favorite is the patate pizza! Great place to hang out too!

Stood and waited to be seated, but no joy. Then the bartender looked at me like she'd like me to leave and pointed me to taken seats. They were hours from close and clearly not interested in my business. This is why I suppose people avoid Times Square for good drinks.
Brunch favorites:  baked eggs and focaccia with hammam tea !

Be Prepared to Wait and Check your Bill very Carefully. We had a 6:45 reservation on a Wednesday night.  We arrived at 6:30 and immediately checked in with the hostess.  We never got seated until 8:30.   We were given the explanation that there were large parties that were taking longer.   This is absurd because I asked I actually asked the large parties what time was their reservation to which they replied 6:15.    There is no way they would expect the tables to clear in 30 minutes.   Once seated, the meal was good, however, review of the check revealed an error.   The sum of the items listed was $276 while the total showed $396.   I normally don't recalculate my bill, but the total was so much more than we expected.   They apologized, took the check and disappeared for 10 minutes.  I had to find the manager to ask what was happening.  No explanation was given except "we are working on it".   A "corrected" check was produced which was still wrong.   They could not provide a detailed listing of items ordered that added up to the supposed total.  We refused to pay the check.   They finally had to "edit" the bill to add of to the items listed.   I am all for a leisurely dining experience, but we left the restaurant at 11:30, 5 hours after arriving. Stay away from this place, but if you do go, dine at your own risk (and bring a calculator.)

This place is amazing for brunch. Their french toast is probably one of the best I've ever tasted and the steak and eggs are in the same category. Cozy place, great for Sunday brunch with some friends.

The restaurant is large, with plenty of big screen TV's to watch the games while eating.  BYOB and you are all set.  Had the BBQ ranch wings and they were delicious.  Buffalo chicken mac and cheese is also amazing, but eat it warm, cold doesn't taste so great.  The parm fries were also a nice upgrade from the boring fries you get all all the other wanna-be wings places.  If you want to test those taste buds and feel some burn, try the wings of prey (i could only do 3).

I went to this place late night and was one of the few places to eat.  How can someone mess up half fried chicken with French fries.  Over cooked and instead of French fries I got fried rice.  However there getting two stars because at least they were clean. I also got an egg roll and that was one of the worse egg rolls I've ever eaten.
Love the place. Excellent food and good vibe always

Love, love, love this place. Friendly, delicious, fresh, welcoming and fun. A hidden gem in the Greater Hartford area and totally worth seeking out. I had duck panang and it was among the best I've had.  Nice selection of beers, funky atmosphere, and great food -- what more do you want?

One of the best places to eat indian food in NJ!! Went there with my family and had a very good experience. The host suggested the methi paneer tikki and it was excellent! So was the achaari paneer roll and the poori bhaji. Don't miss their vada pav !   Affordable prices, excellent staff and nice ambience ..will definitely return and try the other dishes..

So I decided to give this bar a chance tonight. After I asked for a voda soda my redhead bartender forgot my fruit (lemon or lime) which is okay because I was a bartender at some point so I understand. I asked her a few times and she chose to ignore me. Then rather than bother her I grabbed one myself. She caught me, made a big scene then proceeded to talk poorly of me to the couple of girls next to me. Once again this was the red head bartender, short hair, short height and pretty sure she was the manager. Treat all your customers with respect. I regret tipping you.
Great chicken wings. I really like this place to bring a large group of people and have a good time without spending too much money. I especially like the mac and cheese!!!
One of the best pad thai restaurant in the city.

I went here with my girlfriends for dinner and we had a great time. The place is definitely on the smaller side so make sure to make a reservation, but the ceilings are high so it doesn't feel like it and the food was great everything we orders down to the guacamole was delicious.

I been coming to café Mogador for years now, although I usually go to their East Village location I decided to give a shot to their new place in Williamsburg. The design is amazing, very welcoming feeling. The food is very taste, you get a real Moroccan authentic meal, my favorite is the Grilled Hanger Steak its so juice. Its a great place for a weekend brunch.

The delights of Ethiopia can be found at Mesob. Mesob offers a large selection of flavorful starters and appetizers that cause your taste buds to jump for joy. We started off with the Ayib Bemitmita, a cheese and chili pepper concoction that hits your mouth with waves of smooth creaminess and heat. For entree, we ordered the Meat sampler. I highly recommend the sampler, especially if it is your first time eating Ethiopian food. The sampler platter offers two beef dishes, a lamb dish, a chicken dish and a choice of any three vegetarian dishes (we choose the chickpeas, the lentils and the pureed peas). By far the best plate was the lamb; the meat was soft, savory and it's marinade complimented it. Our vegetarian selections were delicious too, however the pureed peas were almost too spicy to be palatable. Overall, we were pleased with the sampler. Mesob offers a dining experience that is unique. Their servers are very kind and will answer any question about the menu. My only gripe with Mesob is that the service is slow.

Amazing food and drinks (although a little pricey)!!!  The service is some of the best I came across in the NH area.  The pretzel nuggets that come with the cheese sauce is to die for.  Drinks are also one of their stellar attributes, with the barrel drinks being my favorite.  Although the menu changes often, the duck breast was probably my favorite meal there.  Definitely a must try.
The pizza was amazing! The ravioli was ok, but the pizza and the service gave it a 5 star. The waiter found out we were from out of town and he brought us out some spumoni just to try!
Neighbourhood restaurant which is open after 4pm. You'd wait in line at least for 30min if you don't have reservation.

I purchased an amazon local deal, never been here before. I pulled up to the front circled block a few times, no parking, cold outside. I called from my car told them about the parking situation. The worker suggested I relax in my warm car order food it would be brought to my car (while illegally parked) in 10 mins. Customer service great!!!! Parking eh unless your getting off train headed home. Food. Pretty fantastic.!!! The apple cheese sand which a MUST have. Delicious!!!!! Everything was packed immaculately even after an hour 15 when I returned home all food was still hot and fresh! Kudos!

What happened in the past year that has caused this place deteriorate so quickly?!?   Petite Abeille used to be one of the more charming restaurants in the area that served reliably great food, and we couldn't get enough of their plump mussels during our last trip and were looking forward to going back when we returned to NYC ... what a disappointment! On the contrast to our previous experiences, the service was appalling, so much so that the waitress didn't even bother to greet us when she walked over to our table to take the order.  She literally stood next to us as if she was waiting for a cue card with her lines to appear.   We should have hightailed it out of there when we saw her sourpuss face but made the mistake of sticking around.  Their famous mussels and fries, which were plump and flavorful last time, were tiny and tasteless, and everything else we ordered tasted as if they were thawed out and microwaved.  Even the ice tea tasted like dirty dishwater, and I had to send it back for a club soda. It's unfortunate that a place that was one of the highlight of our last trip had become so terrible!

Lil Burgers is the best "little" burger place around. Many people think it is just another "fast food place" but they go far beyond that with their quality of items on the menu. The flavor that the 'always fresh never frozen' burger has with the ketchup, pickle, and King Hawaiian bun cannot be beat. I've been going here since they've opened their doors and will go nowhere else for burgers. P.S. The cleanliest place on Franklin Avenue in Nutley, hands down. A+++
Nice falafel for eating out.

I couldn't have surprised my boyfriends any better without the help of The Blend Family. Where do I start this place is just drop dead beautiful! From the amazing view to the delicious food to the live mini band to the surprised face on my birthday when he saw the birthday card and the desert with candle. Everything went perfect. The staff was amazing and kind. Always checking in on us to see how everything was good. We did the check in with free sangria and boy were they delish! He had the red sangria and I had the white one. Valet parking was $7 and so worth it the area is so hard to find parking and for $7 you can't go wrong. This place definitely made his birthday memorable. Thank you so much. My boyfriend and I have already started making plans to come again. I could go on about everything but this restaurant is definitely one of a kind and a memorable place. Good for groups, good for a date and good for kids.

Absolutely love this place Food and drink are amazing & food is fresh every time. And service is just exceptional!! I defiantly recommend to anyone for drinks & fine dining. This is one of our favorite places for drinks, lunch or breakfast, we haven't signed bad experience. This is where other bad restaurant should sent their staff to observe as to how a service-oriented establishment should run a business!
Great food, nice "country" atmosphere. The staff has always been great, and the bathrooms have been clean the times I've been there.

In town for business and craved Mexican. Recommended by an associate, Read the reviews, and decided to go. Food was authentically tasteful. Service (Server and floor manager) was exceptional! Ambience and setting were just right. I'd go back again and again.. And wouldn't you know, I went back two days later and confirmed the experience once again!
Wooohoo, It was fantastic!

I am not ranking it 1 star because of what was is being said. I'm giving it 1 star because I did eat here, and I was completely not impressed by this place at all. I had gone here with my fiancé and the food wasn't good at all. I did not expect great food but I did expect something better than what I would get at a TGIF. I didn't speak to the chef Ramirez at all, he spoke a little to my fiancé and was quite dismissing, and rude to the other customers.   The place looked clean for the most part, except the small dead cockroach which didn't help my appetite either, like I can understand some restaurants gets flies but cockroaches is a diff story. I only saw a small one but that still grosses me out at a restaurant. My overall experience here was horrible. So in my experience with the place and not what's happening, I would suggest going somewhere else if you want a better atmosphere and better quality food.
It's not perfect but it's an expensively done space with a good vibe. Been there three times.  Service is spotty, food is mostly very good. Princeton needs more places that are fresh and progressive.
Pho and grilled chicken over rice are preferred, cash only.

My favorite place in New Haven!!!  Love the vegetarian arepas, either the grilled, cheesy, piled high Colombian style or the baked, stuffed with fresh avocado and sweet plantains Venezuelan style.  Also. The guacamole. The wait staff is so kind and friendly :) Also I love to have large parties here. You can make a reservation and get a whole wing to yourself .. with great music to boot.  They don't serve alcohol but I find this to be a plus -- you can bring your own wine / beer and have your favorites without paying restaurant prices on the drinks.

We hosted our son's baptism dinner at Luna last month. I can't express how grateful we are to Louie and his staff. The food was phenomenal with generous portions. People are still raving about it! The planning process was stress free as Louie and staff were so professional and accommodating to our special requests. When the day arrived we were able to sit back relax and enjoy our friends and family over delicious food and drinks! Look no further than Luna for any special event you are planning!

I've recently had a rough go at life and was feeling down. I decided to avoid all the usual hangs and go somewhere where nobody knew my face. I came across Misconduct and was skeptical at first, only because I'm a creature of habit. I found a high top near the bar, ordered a pint, and glanced around. I realized all the patrons were watching the Eagles game and the ambiance was that of mirth, laughter, cheering and happy faces. The Eagles were winning. A wonderful pinkish-redheaded server by the name of Kristen walked up, greeted me with a smile  and suggested the Roast Pork Sandwich as well as the Mac & Cheese. I went with her suggestion. She made me feel like a regular who had been frequenting Misconduct for 15 years, like family even, always engaging me with a smile and humorous banter. I've never had food or drinks arrive so fast. And when it did... Oh. My. God. The fare was more than I could have hoped for. The Mac & Cheese was to die for and the roast pork was the juiciest and most tender I've had in a while. I would have been happy with a greasy sandwich. But this was several steps above that. I feel as though the exact second my glass or plate were empty, Kristen was there, inquiring as to whether I required anything and offering impeccable suggestions.  My palate and myself fell in love with this place and we'll be back in the near future for sure. Thank you, Kristen and Misconduct.

Teresa's is another old and tired restaurant. I'm sure it's a cash cow for the owners.  Princeton is ever offering more choices that are fresher and more interesting The Momo's need to stop opening new restaurants and focus on the ones that are open.

About the food: I had the orecchiette and shared sides with the table. The pasta was small but it tasted good. Plus with the sides/appetizers that we shared, we were filled enough to have room for dessert. Some of my friends had the steak, which was pretty good too and was served with a good serving of potatoes. The broccoli side was a little bitter for some reason but the potato side (pretty filling) and mushroom appetizer (small but savory) were really good. About the experience: My friends and I had dinner at L'Artusi to celebrate Thanksgiving and our friend's 21st birthday. We made reservations a couple weeks in advance and everything was fine. Once we got there, however, we noticed that we were not treated with the same respect by the hosts as other customers. I'm not saying that they were outwardly rude but we didn't feel welcomed. They probably looked down on us because we looked too young to eat at such a restaurant. There had only a few customers already inside and those who were enthusiastically greeted before us were offered to have their jackets and coats hung in the closet and were seated either upstairs or by the side booths. When it was our turn, there was no closet offer and we were shown to a table under the stairs that lead to the second floor. The table stuck out of place being the only round table among the side tables and the bar and it felt like we were being showcased as a bunch of young girls that didn't seem to fit in. Our server was nice though and gave us suggestions for meals and drinks. We also asked her if we could put our coats into the closet since we were in a tight corner (about 30 degrees and rain that night) and she offered to bring our coats for us and returned with our tags to take back our coats later. After dinner, we went back to the hosts to ask for our coats and neither of them smiled at us and looked as if they were indifferent to our presence. It's not like we were immature or loud or obnoxious. We didn't even take too long to eat dinner. Our only "mistake" was that we were young. My opinion may seem unreasonable considering we would have stuck out either way but the treatment we received as customers seemed unfair. Nevertheless, we enjoyed our night with each other. May return after a few years, once we become the doctors/pharmacists/therapists/dentists that we plan to be.
go there all the time...yummy
Pretty darn good!
Good solid food.  Love the salsa and chips. Service is polite and prompt.   Parking easier than downtown.
Good for brunch especially on weekends.

Love this place! I am not a regular yelper I don't write review much. but I am a fan of this Thai place I have been eating here for more than 3 years. They are very good restaurant. Great food with polite service. restaurant looks clean. I am very picky about my food and they always make me happy with my food because I like it spicy and less oil. If you want authentic Thai food and not too crowded I am very recommend. You will get table easily with great dinner. Try Crying Udon noodle. My favorite menu!
Decent cheesesteak. It was seriously huge though. I wasn't expected a roll that big. I ate it anyway...and fries.
Food was good, not great.   Server was nice. Extremely overpriced, would never return due to that fact. Not worth the money by any means.

It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that Jammin' Crêpes is my favorite place in Princeton. On our first visit we tried steel cut oats with banana jam and the skinny pancake (spiced jersey apples, creamy brie, smokehouse bacon, maple syrup and freshly ground pepper). With a latte and a hot tea. All of which were delicious and encouraged one more visit before making our way back to Ohio. On our second visit we wanted to try a crêpe with egg so we ordered the full monty (turkey breast, black forest ham, free range egg with melted cheese and seasonal berry jam). We thought we'd try their "nut-cho-tella" (their homemade version of nutella) but at the very last minute switched to hammin' cheese melty (ham, swiss, pickled green beans and mustard aioli) which was a great decision. It was delicious. We're big fans of pickled veggies and aioli. I thought it was perfectly juicy, contrasted with the full Monty which had a lot of meat and was much drier (we asked for a side of maple syrup to dip, which was good). But our favorite flavor happened when the owner, Kim, came to our table to check on us. She let us try their homemade Nutella which was delicious. And also let us smell the lavender infused sugar. She told us about their four years selling crêpes at the farmers market, desire to use local and organic produce as much as possible (their front walls are lined with in-house canned produce, which is not only beautiful but it's great to know they've started with fresh ingredients and creatively stored them for non-growing seasons). After smelling the lavender infused sugar and falling in love with the business as a whole, we decided since we may not make it back for quite some time (555 miles separate us) we would take a lavender lemon crêpe for the road. As much as we are savory people more than sweet, it was hands down our favorite. We walked away with such good sweet, tart and warm flavors in our bellies. I must mention that another reason we loved jammin' crêpes is that they don't have a trash can. That may sound inconvenient, but they're doing a great job at being completely waste free. Everything they use to serve aside from what's reusable is compostable- from napkins to stir sticks!

We adore this little spot.  Great atmosphere and wine selection and love the bruchetta!  Staff are helpful friendly and attentive.   Hope to be back soon!  My husband and I had our first date and anniversary there.  Hope to be back in January to celebrate our second anniversary!

Really bad and disgusting food, here there's no respect for customers, I ordered fresh noodle stuffed with chicken and shrimp and the girl took just 3 min on go to the kitchen put 3 noodles in the microwave and gave me a disgusting lunch of 3 noodles with nothing in it.

Brothers Moon was a pioneer when they opened in Hopewell many years ago. Hopewell was a culinary desert.  Cheers for that.  But now there are several in town. Brothers Moon has  been going a long time and it's getting tired.  Maybe it's time for the owner to reinvent himself.   No disrespect, it's a solid choice but restaurants have a short half life.  Time to hit the refresh button.  You will come out stronger and better.

Coming from an asian background, having a good appetite and coming here with several friends, I can honestly say this is the best ramen I found in NY for several years now. While I admit, the long lines are a turn off from the place, the trick is to come 10 minutes before they open to quickly get seated. Aside from the wait, I have been a long time customer of Ippudo and have brought several friends here. My friend, who lived in Japan and grew up in a Japanese home, says that he finds this to be the best traditional ramen he's found outside of Tokyo! Once seated, I could not be more pleased by the attentive service and recommendations the employees gave constantly throughout all of my visits. I honestly don't think you can order anything wrong from here. Their shishito peppers, ramen and famous pork buns are simply TO DIE FOR. I even had a quick craving for their tender pork buns and ran by before heading to the airport. The employees were so kind and quickly fulfilled my craving. This place is definitely worth a visit. While the line is a long wait, the service and food are simply fabulous. Do try to come around opening though, the wait is a lot shorter (if not immediate seating).

I have been talking about going to this place since my first day in NYC! It is a shame that i waited over a year to try it.  This place is AMAZING!!!  Reminds me of the glory days of studying abroad in Belgium.  Best fries I have had since. Stick with the Mayo sauce to keep it as authentic as possible.
I like them better than Gino's. Tastes better too.

Stopped in here after a brief Brooklyn Flea stop this past weekend. The space is so fresh and clean. The decor is simple and inviting. I had the clam chowder, which was possibly the best I've ever had. Then moved on to to the crab roll which was delish. Also had their homemade lemonade and Old Bay seasoned chips, allll of which make me want to go back ASAP!!
Great food. The guacamole is awesome. Really is

I confess, I really like this place. Great beer, good solid pub food, friendly servers, totally relaxed setting -- feels like hanging out with an old friend. The place can feel a bit dark and worn, but in a comforting way. The food, while not super creative, is always fresh and satisfying. In general, I stay with their classic pub fare -- sometimes it feels like they over-reach on specials, etc. Parking sucks, but no more than anywhere else in Hartford. If Hartford has a Cheers, this is it.
Ok
Steak was great and a good atmosphere. Except the price that is a bit high I highly recommend this place if you're looking for some mouth-melting steaks

While the food was good at this restaurant, the service was ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE. My friend ordered a mimosa and never got it. After I finished my water it was never refilled. After I finished my coffee it sat empty for 20 minutes until I waved down a different waitress to fill it. (I hate doing that, so tacky.) The young waiter who took our order disappeared after doing so and we had someone else "take care" of us. Which she did not. If I were to ever go back I would just sit at the bar. My "Witch" cocktail was spectacular.

I live 1 block from here.  Very convenient, confused at what type of food, and seems to have identity issues.  We went with the "steak meal" for $115 total.  Price I felt was ok... Until... FARM raised sushi grade salmon (don't eat this), cold miso soup, GREAT edamame, and then un-seasoned raw veggies and 4 types of 3oz cuts of un-seasoned raw meat?   Maybe we ordered wrong, or made the mistake of taking meat recommendations from our vegan waiter (BYW, love vegan food, but it's a Korean steakhouse...).  All in all, 2 stars for the polite owner and staff (sharp looking gentleman too),   Food was blan, we cooked it ourselves with no seasoning, girlfriend ended up taking shots of alka seltzer when we got home. Final straw, s'more for dessert...  Literally, graham cracker, marshmallow, and 2 pieces of Hershey bar. Step up Gyu-Kaku, with that showing, its different, but won't last in this part of Philadelphia.. If they change menus and allow staff to assist more (or chef/manager/owner) to show us at least in the beginnimg how to cook the food, it would be better and more comfortable. If they helped a little even in the beginning, and added seasoning, I'd give it a 50/50 chance. Restaurant Enthusiest, private dining maître D, and respectfully commenting, Brad Messenger

Straight up Italian place. Headed to the airport and found this place. It was definitely awesome. Everyone was drinking their own bottles of wine they brought in during lunch. Just like Italy. The owner was seating everyone and finding ways to set up more tables. And the food was great. The bread was so good!

BEST. PIZZA. EVER. I have been coming here my entire life and no pizza can compare. Get the sausage pie. Get the plain pie. Get the wings. Get the calamari. Get the sangria. Get the cheap pitchers of beer. BRING CASH!

We went to Fasil for the first time on Sunday after hearing several rave reviews.  We were not disappointed!  They have redone the place beautifully and the staff was very welcoming and friendly.  Everyone enjoyed their meals immensely, from the salmon and bronzini to the lamb chops and kabobs.  And all at a reasonable price.  With the lack of excellent restaurants in the Montville/Boonton area, it is no wonder Fasil is quickly becoming the toughest reservation in town!

OK,  I have been to Miles Table 4 time now.  I must now admit I'm really enjoying this place.   I have had the Burger which is the BEST in town, the Flat Bread Pizza, that is large enough to share but its so good you won't want to it's that delicious. Also am so happy  that Finally a GREAT  place to get Breakfast , the BEST eggs ever and their home made sausage is amazing.  They also have GLUTEN FREE BREAD!!!!!! I will definitely be at Miles Table often.

I so want to like this place. Cool concept, nice decor, fun place. But frankly, the sushi is just not very good. The conveyor belt gets loaded with non-sushi items like buffalo chicken rolls, the rice is a bit gummy, the fish skimpy.  Eats more like supermarket sushi than restaurant quality. Fun place if you don't care too much about the sushi, but otherwise there are much better options around.

i like the halal guys, theyre not that bad, i used to eat their chicken and rice platters alot, quick fix when youre hungry and dont want to spend alot...im on a diet so i dont frequent as much...but i do recommend!!

I wasn't going to post a review because it would be the same as all the other reviews here and would be obsolete but I feel like I had to describe my experience. It's cold,  I'm hungry, stumbling around NYC after a tiresome day,  Halal guys has always been there to save me, Always,  there are very few food carts like it, it's food is as consistent and water flowing off a waterfall and it's taste can rival a nice warm melted chocolate bar. That's it, that's all I can say........  Oh and btw get the Mix platter
Food was pretty good when I had dinner there last week. Guacamole portions are a little small but overall, tasty food

FOOD - THE BOMBDIGGITY SERVICE - SUPERFRAGALISTIC they give you so much food. the drinks are STRONGGGG lol too strong for my liking. It's a great environment. It's filled with other diners, but just right. GET THE SPRING ROLLS!!!!? I recommended you get the pineapple rice. However, that's a meal itself. I also usually add mango chicken / lemon grass chicken.

I have been a long time customer of Saigon Pho right down the road. But no more! After seeing the reviews on Yelp decided to give this new place a try and it was easily one of the best decisions I have made!     The service was great, very personable well spoken chef who also happens to wait on customers. Another bonus is that he is classically trained in many different types of food and has experience from high class restaurants. The food was all prepared reasonably fast, and waters were refilled multiple times (unlike other places). It seemed very clear that we would be remembered if we were to return and not be treated as neophytes each time we came in (also like other places).    On to the food, AH-MA-ZING!! I felt as if I had died and gone to a pho heaven. It was visibly freshly prepared and you could tell was well made, and the beef was shaved extra thin, although they do not skimp on the amount either!    Will definitely be back soon for the great food and greater atmosphere. I look foward to trying other dishes and possibly some desserts!!

Extremely slow kitchen. I went with an hour to eat before my shift and told the server that information as well. I got canned fruit and an omelette over 45 minutes later. I boxed it and left. About 2 weeks later I was waiting for quick hem and asked for the fastest thing they could make, bagel and cream cheese was the answer. That took over 15 minutes. Don't come here with any time constraints.

I went to philly a few months ago, and I made sure to check both Pat's and Geno's. Overall, there was very little difference in the two restaurants. The meat, the bread, the cheese. You could easily get a similar or better heesesteak somewhere else. The history of the restaurant doesn't make it any better than a regular cheesesteak.

Worth the wait!! Try the Mexican coffee (soooo good!!), huevos rancheros was the bomb!!!! And my hubby got the country breakfast (he said average). Place is super small, so be prepared to wait outside while ur waiting. Friday at 12:30 was a 50 min wait...Food came super fast though!! I'll def be back!!

One of the best places for Cuban food INCLUDING the city.  Yeah the music can be a little loud and it gets crowded but it only adds to the festive atmosphere.  The place is also probably the best managed restaurant you will ever see.  The owner is def on top of things.  Ate here countless times and never had an issue and the food was always amazing Recommend going off peak hours

finally decided to grap some lunch here, and give it a try. nice selection of breakfast and lunch eats with a health twist. plenty of seating, a big enough place with elbow room. a good variety of breakfast foods,  salads, sandwiches, soups, and asian delights, like sushi, ramen, and other korean foods. staff are very nice and place is kept clean, with two levels for eating. the prices are not bad and fresh tasting which is always good, i had a chicken breast cheddar panini and a bluberry muffin , both were decent.also has buffett, but i usually avoid buffetts, will try breakfast  next time, the chicken teriyaki seems like its popular, it was recommend by my coworkers for lunch.maybe next time.   a nice place to have breakfast and lunch with enough seating and good variety of food choices to make almost anyone happy.

I came here for a quick lunch on a break and spent 25+ minutes waiting....the sign did warn that brunch items could take 10-15 minutes but 25 was needlessly excessive. I did get to stand there and watch the kitchen for a long time and I got to see plenty of people who ordered brunch items after me get their food before my friend and I did (we both ordered the egg sandwich). The best part about waiting was the other 3 people in our group (two of which also spent a long time waiting, but not as long as us) were able to find a table and finish their food before we sat down so there was more room for us and our sandwiches. I couldn't even eat my food; I bit into it and there was something so hard inside that after the bite I opened it up and found a half-dollar sized black disk that I think was supposed to be sausage...I didn't even realize that it was so hard that I didn't even get a bite out of it. Maybe if it hadn't sat on the grill for 25 minutes both these problems would have been resolved. It was literally inedible. I did get to taste some of the other food; the eggs benedict was at least edible, but the staff, environment and sausage really killed the experience.

There is NOTHING about this place that I don't reccommend. I live in the neighborhood and even if you don't, I advise you to make the trip. It comes across as family owned and not exclusive, the decor isn't exactly trendy. Anyone can walk in and be treated to a friendly, sincere greeting. It can be pretty busy in there, so patience is a plus. It is so worth the wait. If you're looking to impress a date, this isn't going to be the cozy, romantic atmosphere you might want, but trust me the food and drinks will be all you need to make the evening memorable. It is a nice place to dine and it is a good experience. If I wanted an apple martini, this is the first and only place in town I would go. It's one of those out of the way places where if you don't know about it, you don't know about it, but you should. I can't imagine anyone having a bad experience here. Parking is tough. Park at the paid garage if you can.

Unbelievable.  I ordered take out on 12/4/14 and signed the bill for $21.78.  Afterwards, they processed my credit card for $26.14.  When I spoke to the manager there, he claims that my "1" looked like a "6" which is bullocks.  THEY ARE FRAUDULENT.  They processed a tip which I didn't authorize.  I did not give them a tip because I wasn't served--it was TAKEOUT.
The food at this place is amazing with great prices. So many choices I can eat here every day!

I specifically looked on yelp with a friend to find a nice sandwhich place in between classes since we always go to a bagel shop and wanted to try something different. I may have set higher standards since the place looked nice and the selection offered is what I usually go for and honestly the food was great but the service lacked professionalism. I guess the girl at the counter was new? Here's why: - had no idea how to answer my question and it was really a yes or no answer - my meal came out first, without napkins or utensils. My friend later received hers without napkins and she had to pull out some napkins from her bag that she had from chipotle. - she asked us if we wanted water... Don't customers get water automatically? And at least a fork and a napkin? - I'm pretty sure I was overcharged but that's ok maybe tip was added? - we overheard the cashier ask another customer if they were a student... Maybe for a discount? and we were not asked, we weren't even greeted... but that's also ok i can afford my costs. My friend and I actually laughed because we have been through it and I know the first time dealing with customers is a struggle until you get used to it. So I'm not going to give the place a bad rating because of my experience, but maybe just to give her some tips on food service. Starting by not having your hair loose when you're serving food to customers and walking in and out of the kitchen... That's a big no-no... And always bring water for dine-in customers... And utensils... And napkins... And actually say Hello, how may I help you?  :) 4 stars because the food was good and I'll probably want to try some other items but next time I'll get it delivered to the school instead of dining in

Coulda Shoulda Woulda Can't Rate This old Old OLD Philly Home City Favorite Anything But The Max! Gets It On Memories & Traditions Alone Wow But Sure Didn't Disappoint Me Nor My Taste Buds & Palate In Anyway I Came In Essentially Starving After Only A Small Bite To Eat Before Flying Now I'm Stuffed & I'm Going To Blame This Condition On Ms Kelly & The Great Cooks In The Back :) I Had What Is Essentially A Meatballs Bread Bowl & Thetr Wete So Many In It Was Incredible! As Always Made New Good Memories & The Place Looks Great Actually Upscale Which Is A Good Thing Just Across Broad & The Ball Parks On Packer. Awesome Awesome Experience Cheers & TGIF Go Eagles Yes I'm Baaack To Enjoy

Just discovered this place trying to find breakfast during my all nighter studying for exams. They open early, and when I entered they were happy to say good morning. Clean, Quick, Delicious, Affordable, Great Customer Service, and all around Best Breakfast Gem at Temple. -- They should get on GrubHub! Will certainly return again

This is my second time to this Resturant and location.  First was OK but not great, so my expectations were already low.  Compared with expectations for airport food to begin with... These guys fell short on both counts When I sat down they were only moderately busy.  Yet it took right at 40 minutes to get a sandwich.  Worse, when it got there it was the worst Monte Cristo I've ever had, it's suppose to have powered suger to give it a slightly sweet taste, I think I saw a flake, the rest must have fell on the floor.   Beyond that I asked for sweet potatoes fries and they brought regular, but I didn't get charged the upcharge which meant it was the waitress' fault it seems.   When checking out the lady asked how it was, so I told her "not great", and no apology, no offer to not have to pay, SHE was disgusted I had a bad experience.   AVOID this place at all costs short of absolute hunger.

Was very disappointed. Everything from service to food. This place is not for dine in. Just make it to go first of all. The owner behaved badly. Minimum $25 on credit card. First of all they will try to get cash as if machine is broken. The quantity of food was good but it was cold. We tried Chef special mixed biriyani. And the samosas were pathetic due to oil both chicken and vegetable!!!

This place is great! It's my first time going to a Counter burger place. Supposedly they are all over LA (my home town) but I never ran into one. This one is pretty new I think. The service is amazing. And the food is even better. It's a build your own burger place. I've had the gluten free bun and their burger salads. I just add everything I can onto it and it's great. Must try if you are around.
A must do in NY!!! My husband and I ate 3 pieces in 4 days. We tried others in the city, Juniors is the BEST!!!

I meet my friend here for happy hour drinks every now and then. I have never ordered an actual meal but I always get the happy hour appetizers for half price which are pretty good. They also have half off on the house wine during happy hour which is nice. Gets a pretty decent after work crowd.

Emily's inspired me to start a yelp account!  I love this place!  Food, especially pizza is so good!  The ambiance is great. I've lived down the block from here for the past 10 years and i can't tell you how happy i am that Emily's is here!  Clearly i would recommend this place!

Been here about 6 times and try to make it there every week I visit Princeton. Their Griggstown Chicken dishes are amazing and have me hooked. Steaks are good too and comparable to a above average grade of restaurants and better than the local Ruth Chris steaks.

Really amazing that they're open so late.  However, their pizza is certainly not the best tasting in the world.  It is a bit greasy and coats the stomach with cheese.  Granted, it does taste good, but I wouldn't give it amazing reviews for the taste.
Just ok sushi. It is on the cheaper side and never the freshest. Again... Just ok.

Best breakfast in Philadelphia. As a lifelong resident of the city, I've been to many a diner, breakfast spot, etc, and I've yet to encounter a breakfast as fresh, hearty, and delicious as the Dutch eating place. Orange juice is fresh squeezed and chocolate milk is the best I've ever had...ever. If you go, I suggest the massive (and fire than filling) pancake platter or the delicious, fresh from the farm bacon.
reasonable prices. decent sandwichs. I would get a sandwich from here over that nasty fat shack any day.
Wow!! This place is massive. I tried so much cool food and the produce was fresh. Wish there was something like it in the suburbs.
good quality healthy food at a very reasonable price!
I am very happy when I come here their service is amazing and I love coming here for brunch. Overall very pleased with the service
The 20's inspired decor is beautifully done, the food is excellent, and there's live music on the weekends. I think I'm going to go back on a Sunday for brunch!
packed place in Nolita with great ambiance and delicious chilaquiles. Always a fan. I prefer to come during the week days when its not as hectic!

The place is fine. The food is good. But do not eat the French toast! It is inedible. I'm not sure it was made with eggs and bread. More like spray butter and old bread. There french toast was so bad I had to write this review for that reason alone. Everything else there is fine but not amazing.

I've been coming to L and Bs for a while. I always get the square slices. It's always cooked to perfection. The pizza slices are extra saucy while the bread is nice and soft.  I'm just drooling right now thinking about it.  Don't forget to get dessert right after the slices!
The falafel here was as delicious as promised by other Yelp reviews. It's a tiny little place with nice service. And a hot sauce that will burn you straight into your soul. YUM.

Came here on vacation, johnny was super nice and we were seated right away - even though it's a small place. Ordered coffee, eggs and a bagel - all was as expected, came out quick and was good counter style diner food. Johnny is very nice and the staff is very attentive - highly recommend!
Very fresh food. The eggs were so fresh I thought they got them straight from the chicken. The pancakes were delightful a little bit pricey though for it not to be brunch.
Awesome meatballs and cream brûlée!! I was really surprised from the quality for being in an airport!!

Really great stuff! The food is to die for, and defines comfort. Get the Schnitzel, because it's awesome. And the Beet & Vodka Cured Salmon Sandwich is one of the nicest, freshest sandwiches I've had. Stumptown coffee is on tap, literally.
Been going here for a while, the best truck in the area, food is always consistent, good portions, and the specials are awesome, really has the home cooked feel.

Full disclosure - I'm a BIG fan of Dig Inn already, so when I found out that they had just opened a new location very close to my place of employment, I nearly flipped my lid. I love how easy Dig Inn makes it for me to eat relatively well, while still feeling like I'm being indulgent by eating out. The staff at this location is BEYOND FRIENDLY. I've seen them regularly go out of their way to serve customers. I also love that the refrigeration/food prep area downstairs is totally visible, so that the customer can see their fresh vegetables and other foods stored and prepared. It really drives home the fact that I'm eating real, fresh food. Love it! Will be back many more times, and am looking forward to when they finally get their wine/beer/kombucha taps going!
I went it was O.K but not worth the price...Sorry, nice people but over heard staff taking badly about clients.
Celebrated a birthday with couple of friends.  The décor was plain and on the cold side.  Staff acted polite but lukewarm.  Food was pretty good, but not worth the money.

The sushi was not fresh and the meat was not good.  The chef was very rude and made me feel unwelcome.  For the amount of money you spend, you will be disappointed. I recommend you read all the reviews on Yelp, especially the filtered ones. Also, do online research of chef Cesar Ramirez.  The Guardian has a lengthy article describing racism by Cesar. Yelp has repeatedly deleted all of the 1 star ratings on this restaurant, including mine.  I guess Cesar paid one of those "advertising fees" to create an inflated rating.

Food is fine, service lousy! Chef never even have eye contact with you let alone welcome your patronage! Now I know why.  I am Asian!  There are many good restaurants in New York; I will never go there again!  Unpleasant experience!
Had lunch here recently, very good, attentive service. I like the interior, it's cozy and "home-y". Food was very tasty. I will be back.
My fav pizzeria in SI! Full bar too so perfect to grab a beer and slice b4 the ferry ride! Try the buffalo chicken pizza so good!

Great typical Spanish dishes at a reasonable prices in the Midtown area, most dishes can feed up to two people with good size proportions. Only bad thing is delivery service takes a bit long. (On an average time for delivery is 45-60 min) nevertheless I'm still a frequent customer.

**Went here on my first date and everything about this place was a1!!!!!! i enjoyed the food and intimate setting it gave off as if everyone was on date *dim not dark -waitress were all pretty clean n pleasant {{me and my lover now both ordered the falling off the mother f.ing bone ribs #amazing #yummy #thebestonmenu - he enjoyed the cold slaw im not a fan of #coldslaw but i did enjoy the super think french fries}} definitely a 5 star restaurant in food,price, and wine signed i love to eat & i do it consistently n with class mr.von teese n lover experience **

We were extremely disappointed with our meal. The waiter recommended the Matador Combo Meal, which was apparently the most traditional Peruvian dish. We received a huge plate of French fries and cut up hot dogs (like a children's meal), a plate of fried plantains which were cold and tasteless, a boring dressing-less salad of shredded iceberg lettuce, sliced tomatoes & avocado, a plate of beans with 1 measly cup of rice, and a whole chicken. The only thing decent about all of this was the chicken which had nice flavor. There was also a nice green sauce which we used to coat all the food with to add some flavor. $38 for what was like a children's meal. Our waiter didn't ask us if we enjoyed our meal, and never even returned to our table until we called him over for the check. And when he saw that all of the plates were basically uneaten from, he still didn't even ask if there was maybe an issue. We will definitely never return here.

The Food? Amazing!! Hoagies? Terrific!! Market? Cleaned to Perfection!! Stromboli's? Best I ever had!! Service? Staff friendly and courteous!! Why only 3 stars if this place is so great?? Because none of the good attributes matter if you drive 40min out of your way, in traffic, to pick up food and then find out they are closed even if its before 7pm. Either stay open like your website says, or change your hours on the website!!!!

LOVE the fried pickles here! The other food is ok but I keep coming back for the pickles. The staff is friendly for the most part but if you have a large group this is not the place for you. The hostesses are easily frazzled and not the most accommodating.
Always fresh and super tasty.  If you want to try really yummy mexican food check this place out. I am going to come there always. Friendly personal and good prices.

Favorite brunch spot in New York city.  Cozy, comfortable, and very charming. Their grapefruit brulee is delicious, and you can't go wrong with either the Brioche French toast or the Breakfast Club sandwich. delicious!

I have been here several times since we moved to the neighborhood and overall I would call it a solid joint. There is always a wait when you arrive but they generally move after than how long they tell you the wait is. The down side to this is that your meal is also rushed because they have a high volume of customers to please. I can only speak for the ramen as I haven't ordered many other items off the menu, but it is really fantastic and always hits the spot. The spicy miso ramen is the bomb. Avoid the vegetable ramen unless you want floating chunks of avocado and wilted lettuce in your soup. As long as you stick with the originals, you can't go wrong and this place always attracts a robust crowd. It's definitely staying in the rotation of regular neighborhood go to's.

Been coming here since as early as I can remember and the place is still the same which is a good thing.. Great authentic Cuban food. Waiters were friendly and service was excellent.. Food was delicious and portions are generous and the price is definitely great. Anyone that thinks its pricey is out of their mind

I came here a couple nights ago for a birthday party and had the best time! We did the chefs selection for a group of four for my friends birthday and our server Stephanie was beyond helpful. She recommended the best cocktails and wine to go with everything we got. We loved the strawberry short ribs and bacons doughnuts, and we left beyond pleased! A great restaurant for a fun party or just a casual date! Everything was great and our service experience was so much better because Stephanie was so accommodating and helpful!
Like eating at a locals home, with great wine!
I get delivery through grub hub here. I like the people who work here and their food is pretty good too. I don't think you will be disappointed here.

This place has the best Indian cuisine, and most hospitable service in the city. The decor is very hip and colorful. The staff are very welcoming and accommodating. The head server/manager is very professional and knowledgeable about the food and drinks. He really cares about the place and the customers dining experience. The chef is a very laid back happy guy. I can guarantee there's no stress in that kitchen. And it shows through the quality and presentation of the food. The owners are very nice, and are not shy to jump in and help the staff. They also do private parties here in their upstairs room. Very nice up there. And you can have catered food delivered to your home or party at a location of your choice. They do it all here. From a delicious reasonably priced lunch buffet. To a dinner that can be customized to your liking. Nice moist fluff basmati rice. And the mango lassi is delicious. Also a great place to bring a date. Call ahead and let them know you're coming, and if its a special occasion, and they'll make it a memorable enjoyable visit.
breakfast sandwich is banging!!!
Great atmosphere and great food.  Service is fantastic.

I am not basing this review on the quality of food and drinks that you get here but rather on the experience we had dining at this establishment. I have been to Drunken Money three times in the past couple of months and barring my first visit the overall experience we had the next two times was very unpleasant. During our second visit we were celebrating a friends birthday there and were ordering multiple rounds of drinks and appetizers however the waitress kept rushing us and was quite rude when we told her we wanted to have some entrees as well. When we asked her whether she wanted us to leave she said no but they needed to turnover the tables quickly(doesn't that mean the same thing!).  I get that your restaurant is really popular but no where else in NYC have I felt so rushed even though we were continuously ordering food and drinks. Even though our second visit was suboptimal we decided to go back because we loved the food. During our third visit the waitress took my jacket and hung it on a hook at the other end of the restaurant. After we were done paying our bill when I went to get my jacket the waitress claimed that the jacket I was going for wasn't mine. She insisted that my jacket was hung somewhere else. When I told her that she was mistaken she asked other people whether the jacket I was going for belonged to them!! I have never been so insulted before. Why would I pay $$$ for your food and steal a $ jacket!! This behaviour is just preposterous and though your food is great I don't think I will be dining there again!

This place is a great find! The creamy crab and corn soup is to die for. I find myself regularly thinking about it.  It's very heavy, so you might want to share it with one other person.  You'll definitely want to save room for their other amazing dishes.   Get the burrata as an appetizer. You won't be disappointed.  I've tried a number of their entrees.   My favorite is probably the gnocchi genovese because I LOVE gnocchi.  The meat sauce on the dumplings is so flavorful and hearty.  The "slaps of pasta" and shrimp nuovi are also very good.  They have incredible specials every night, so be sure to try one.  The one dish I had that I did not like was the chicken parm.  I was surprised because everything else is so delicious.  The chicken was dry and bland.

We wish Caesar can rise again just because "Julius the server" is so amazing! Not only is he incredibly attentive, but also made an extra effort to protect his patrons from bar creepers. Aside from the great food and drinks, Julius is the best part of the establishment. Be our BFF?

Great food a bit on the pricey side but taking into consideration location, I can understand. Their service is ok along with delivery takes a bit long. Placed an order once they messed it up 3 times! Never got an apology not once, or anything for the numerousmistakes. This place is so busy they feel they don't need to be apologetic. They really lucky their food is really good!

I was very excited to try Proper West since I really love Manhattan Proper.  I called Friday morning to make reservations for Friday night.  After I said I had a gilt city special, I was told they "may have an event" that night.  We called BS and had another friend call, and not mention the gilt special and got reservations no problem.  So already I was turned off by them.  The four of us got there, sat right away, and the only saving grace of the night was how sweet our server was.  Our appetizers were all ehhh.  Our one meal came out 30 min before the rest of the table, so we had to ask for them to bring us a fresh plate so our one friend wasn't eating a cold dish.  Two of the meals were beyond spicy and not flavorful at all.  We were all severely disappointed and this was not even worth a gilt special.  Stop trying to be so "elite" before you get your own shit together.

Delicious food! Dripping with tasty sauces, just delectable. Cozy ambient, the place is on the smallish side, the chorizo tacos are just amazing. Definitely worth a visit. My friend and I had 6 of them between the two of us and they were PERFECT.
Tasted Bear's Smokehouse shredded meats last night at the Atheneum's First Friday celebration and it was delicious. I have not yet gone to either of their locations
Not impressed. We got the chicken Marsala. It was blahhhh Would not recommend. Pick another spot.

never go here unless u want some unqualified bartender that proofs a guy with an aarp card I promply asked a manager why she did that ..and he had to.re-educate her. I had my drink and went to Ruby Tuesdays where I didnt ger hassled.to get a beer.

Came in for a drink on Wednesday night. Gave the bartender a $20 for a vodka soda and IPA and got $3 back. I glanced at the register and he had rung up  $14. When I asked him what the price of the drinks were he said $8 and $9. "Then why does your register say $14?" He looked nervous because I obviously just caught him stealing. He walked over to a stack of cash on top of the register and gave me another $3 back and said "Oh sorry." Thief. If you want to decide to tip yourself maybe you shouldn't be working in a neighborhood bar. We asked for a full refund and left.

Minutes off of the NJ Turnpike, Fernando's Grille is the ideal spot for harried travelers looking for a high quality meal in a quaint and comforting setting. Indubitably a local favorite, Fernando's grilled chicken is some of the best I've ever had; 100% juicy and flavorful. The pesto was delightful as well. The owner himself was present, brought us to our table, and was very enthusiastic. Such a low-key location with such enjoyable food is definitely worth checking out.

TRUST ME. WORST PLACE EVER. Before you decide to come here, you should check the reviews that they hide under the section "reviews that are not helpful" hahahah. PLAIN AND SIMPLE: Do yourself a favor and drive the extra 5 minutes to the next closest diner. My friend is a waitress here and she told me that her manager makes them lie to the customers about the fact that the DINER USES CANNED MEAT!!!!!! Do I need to even go on?....nastiest most disgusting harmful place. The managers soul was inhabited by the devil if he makes his staff lie!!!!! P.s READ THE GOOGLE REVIEWS, you'll see.

Food is fine; customer service in general and from the owner are both terrible. Please be warned. Some background: I work at the University of Pennsylvania, where Pari Cafe Creperie is located. I represent a student group that plans a number of events per semester. We normally have one event per year where we order a large amount of crepes and I use my university credit card. The university is a tax exempt organization, which means any purchases made with my university card have to have the tax removed. I've had a number of issues with the owner about this. Today he told me that he will not take university cards anymore. When I tried to discuss this with him further he was very rude. I asked him if he was willing to lose business over this and he said 'yes, that's fine' and hung up on me. I will not be patronizing this establishment again personally or for my department.

This place is great! The food is not traditional Indian but inventive and has never disappointed. Bartenders are attentive and quick. Great place for a large group party. Totally worth the trip a few blocks out of the high traffic portion of center city and you can't go wrong with the tiffin crew.
$5 for a coffee??? seriously felt ripped off... no table service and no food. but great ambience and funny bar dude.
Great lunch spot, food was tasty! the service was quick and the portion was just enough for  lunch. its a bit of a trek from my office on a residential block off 2nd ave
My wife and I had dinner here for our anniversary on a Wednesday night. The service was very good. The food was excellent.  We'll have to return another time to have the lasagna.

Awful diner. Bad service. The greeter has zero personality and make you feel like you are not welcome. Service is sooooo slow and the food is yuk. The place used to have good food 10 years ago but went way down hill from there. We visited a few months ago and the was no AC and nobody waited on us. So we left. Skip this place until they get there act together.
best halal food in nyc!

Wonderful dinner  tucked away location  had scallop appetizer  very very good and so fresh  we ordered the mackerel dish was lovely and the pollock dish  this was devine  we sat by the fire place  i went back to childhood days with the decor  waitstaff friendly & knowledgable about menu & farm  pleasant dining evening  somewhat pricey but very high quality therefore worth the price
Went here during restaurant week and wasn't disappointed! Our food was amazing and so was the service. We finished it off with the Mandarin donuts which were amazing.

Boy, did tonight's experience leave a bad taste in my mouth...and I'm not just talking about their shitty enchiladas (zing!) But seriously, this place blows. I'd been here a handful of times over the past 2 years but can't really speak to those experiences, mostly because I don't remember them (which is telling).  So after a long break from Chavela's special brand of mediocrity, I returned for two servings of letdown in just 3 weeks.  Let's break them down. Experience approx. 2 weeks ago:  Pretty underwhelming but passable.  They added this little side area so you can grab a drink without being crammed into the main room like a sardine.  Which is nice, since you can relax, grab a drink or five, and start catching a buzz in preparation for the boring food and baffling service.  We started with chips and guacamole, which could've come from the bodega down the street.  Just because your chips come in baby-tortilla form doesn't mean they don't suck.  But before we could get started on our boring ass appetizer...our entrees arrived!  Yup, all of our food, all at once.  Normally, I'm stoked to get my food quickly but this was disconcerting.  Not even Mexican food should be made this fast.  Now, I realize this might seem trivial to some and I sorta agree; what's wrong with the dudes in the kitchen hammering out your food at breakneck speed?  I don't mind too much, but for those of you looking for a nice little dining experience, don't say I didn't warn you.  All of your bland food might come out at once, approximately 3 minutes after you order it.   Tonight's experience:  Not really sure what to make of this.  The service and treatment was confusing and bizarre from the moment we walked in until we were basically force-fed the check.  We came in from the rain and I asked the TWO hostesses (because you need two people to do one job poorly): "What's the wait for two people?"   *crickets*   All I get is silence.  They both look at me like I'm a fucking space alien.  They continue with their deer-in-headlights staredown until finally, one of them snaps out of her daze and sheepishly mutters something, grabs two menus and walks me to my table.  It was so confusing and weird I don't even know what else to say.  We ordered some food...whatever, it's not important, it was edible but not in any way noteworthy.  Our server comes by and asks if we want dessert.  We politely decline and he walks off...only to return 10 seconds later with the check.  Dude, we both have drinks we're still working on.  I was planning on getting a beer.  Not that it should matter, but there's plenty of seating available.  But fine, I'll pay when I'm damn well good and ready.  Nope.  Try again.  Because LITERALLY 5 seconds after our server sets the bill down, some random employee I've never seen tries to take it.  Jesus Christ is the kitchen secretly on fire?  Is a fucking mob hit about to go down?  What's the goddamn rush?  Before I could let all of this really sink in, our server walks by 1 minute later and tries taking the check again.  That's it, mission accomplished, Chavela's...now I can't wait to the get the hell out of here.   So, I don't think I'll be back again.  There are too many restaurants in Brooklyn (hell, even just on Franklin) that are happy to have your business, employ sentient greeters/pleasant waitstaff and aren't trying to force you out the door.  I could honestly write a dissertation on how badly this place sucks.  I didn't even have to pull that tired "As a Mexican from LA..." card.  Chavela's crappy food/service stands on its own.
I have been here the food and service are outstanding. Who knew what a little gem of flavors was nestled in Colonia, NJ....

Veramente fatto con amore. Made by real italians with a real passion for food. I stopped in looking for a good quick meal and was stunned by the quality. The shop owneds even hooked me up with an amazing canoli. Really enjoyed this place, going back tomorrow
God dammit. This place, and the pulled pork. It was just so damned good. And the Truffle Burger, dammit. The Truffle Burger! So good. Ugh.
Great place great food.
Had a local take us as he states back in the day it was the best but now just a tourist thing to say you did. It's OK. Can't say much.

Amazing food and atmosphere! First of all, I love the interior and decoration of the Pines. The beautiful paintings of the staff gives the space a personal touch. Everything is well put together and makes me feel very comfortable. The bread was the best I've ever had! They had different kinds of rustic bread with amazing homemade butter (I could eat that everyday!) The restaurant uses local and seasonal products, so everything was super fresh and tasty. I ordered some grilled lettuce with nasturtium, with an wonderful dressing. I had a great combination of soft, crispy and crunchy. The agnolotti was cooked to perfection. Divine! The pasta was the most all dente I've ever tasted and the stuffing was rich of flavor. For dessert I had a chocolate cake, one of the best! It was still a bit soft and had a rich texture. Every dish had a perfect portion and I didn't feel stuffed at all. The wine pairing is definitely a recommendation! They have beautiful biological wines that go perfect with the meals. The restaurant manager (I think his name was Anthony) was great! Super friendly and hospitable. He explained every dish to us and our waters were filled when they were empty. To be short: go to the Pines because it is an AMAZING place.
Excellent food, service and ambiance! Great wine list. I got the eggs Benedict and the brochette. Delicious. I'll come back! Thanks!

Don't order for delivery. The pizza I received was wet and cold. It was outside for at least an hour. They don't use boxes that keeps your food hot. I had to throw away both pies and order from a different place. I wasted two hours on this restaurant. Never ever again.
Stopped in for a quick dinner. Wow I was impressed. Decadent pasta, traditional pies as you would find in Rome. Cocktails were above par for hartford. Definitely coming here again
Great fried calamari crispy and seasoned. Great pizza definitely worth a visit BYOB and good service

I go to Puzos at least once a week with friends and have been going there my whole life. There food is always on point and I have never had a problem with there service. When I go there the choices I have are endless. Sandwiches,pizzas,salads and soups and so much more. When ordering I normally get pizza or a sandwich. I would defiantly recommend number 9 on there cold sandwich section of the menu which has grilled chicken,arugula,fresh Mozzarella cheese and roasted peppers. I just take the peppers off the sandwich because I don't like peppers but instead I put on cucumbers and they have no problem changing it and that's the thing I love about this place they are willing to work to make the customer happy. And that is why they deserve 5 star.
have had cheesesteaks from all over philly - dalessandro's-gets my vote for best-and lots of meat - most other places you need a search party for the meat-
My favorite form of food is a sandwich and this place is my favorite to get them from. The breakfast items and salads are also excellent. There hasn't been anything I ordered that I didn't like.
Sweet dreams are made of these.

Bartender told me they don't have cognac then made me a vodka oj. Gave him $20 & he gave me back $8. Being nice I have a $3 tip. What does it get me?! He chases me and says I owe another $9!!! Uh...no! I gave you $20!!!! Bartenders need to stay sober!

Visited this place yesterday. Was very nice and food was extremely good. I had egg rolls ,cutlets and tea. All done in real Sri Lankan taste. Didn't have a chance to try the buffet. But waiting for it I'm my next visit. I highly recommend the place. Staff and the owner is very friendly and remind you of the true Sri Lankan hospitality.

I saw a flyer for organic burgers at Kean University of all places, so one evening when the hankering for a burger got pretty strong, I drove on over. The outside of the restaurant was a bit unassuming and not very brightly lit. My GPS said that I had arrived at the address: a Baptist church. However, it was right across the street on the corner. Inside, the restaurant had several tables as well as counter seats. I decided on the IMO style burger for under 7 bucks: an organic burger Patty on a whole wheat bun, cheddar cheese, mayo, lettuce, tomato, and caramelized onions. (Fries included on the side) I made small talk with the guy making my order- he was very friendly and made my waiting experience more enjoyable (because let's be honest, here, waiting hungrily for food is not that great). On the 15 minute drive home I tried not to focus on the food sitting next to me...it smelled so good and I couldn't wait to get home and eat ASAP! When I pulled the burger and fries out, they were nicely wrapped up in paper. The size of the burger seemed a little small, so I got a tad bit nervous. But after ONE bite, the drive and wait was all worth it. Although the size did appear small, it is a very chunky burger. I was completely full by the end (score!). It was unbelievably good- the meat, the cheese and mayo- everything combined made this worth every cent and every moment driving there and back. Can't wait to go back!

waited about 30 mins to be seated. However, the wait was well worth it! i ordered the fritatta with vegetables and pancakes with fruit, absolutely delcious! simple breakfast but it hit the right spot! will definetely return back again!

Very friendly and they seem to want to be better but they're clearly struggling. After being sat, it took nearly 20 minutes to place an order. We were looking to get in and out - and had viewed the menu before arriving - we were the people who are gone in 40 minutes. Our food came out at different times, and we were a two top.  With a movie theatre so close, they need to learn to execute quickly. The food also lacked flavor, the pad Thai had onions which was a surprise, and the tuna roll we ordered as an appetizer didn't come out until after the entrees. I hope they get it together.

Classic dive bar experience. Cheap drinks and low key atmosphere. The bartender, Bryan, was a complete asshole and only paid attention to the people he knew at the bar. Got a beer and one shot and then left. Would have been better if the bartender was more friendly.
The sushi was unique and good, the service was a little slower than I'm use to but the interesting food made up for it a little bit. I will definitely be going back!

Very bland and over-priced.  Won-ton soup had less flavor than most, and when i asked if they had any hot mustard to liven up the flavor, I was told they don't have any.  Mu shi pork was flavorless with spongy pancakes.  Chicken with garlic sauce consisted of chicken and celery strips with a few carrot strips.  Where were the other vegetables?  Overall, very disapointing.  Totally over rated

The burgers and beer were fine. The atmosphere is a little suburban for my taste...too clean and bright. Fine for Williston. What annoyed me was that the server was using some sort of app to take our order. It really took a while for him to tap through each screen to complete each order.  Seemed sort of inefficient. Fine place to go before or after a movie.

Today we went to this restaurant for the first and ONLY time.... WORST ever!!! Sat down and the worlds worst waitress came to our table Kayla is her name... .. asked her what kinds of beers they had, she handed me a menu and said I don't know... look in here. Strike one.... asked about making something on the menu a little different... she said I don't know. She said did you want me to go ask? Really?? Yes I do. Received my meal... took a bite, spit it out and sent it back... called her over and said this meal is disgusting... she looked at me and said... well I asked you if you wanted it grilled or not! I said it tastes terrible I want if off my bill.. she said whatever I am not going to fight with you.... NEVER came back to the table to ask how anything else was, never asked if we wanted refills on our drinks.. came over with a check and said here this is, do you want anything else? Seriously? I said, well had you come back over 20 minutes ago, we would have had another drink...but forget it now.. she said well you didn't tell me you wanted anything else when I took your meal away.... then I paid with cash... it took her and 2 other people to try and figure out my change.. she said is it all set? I said absolutely not! I want change... I will not reward anyone for foul service..... she needs a lot of work! The food is not all that it is cracked up to be... cant you just make a nice normal salad?? Oh that is right, you have no veggies! Thanks for a lousy afternoon on a very nice or what was very nice when we started out... we left from there and went to friendlies as I was hungry at this point... sad... they gave great service and a smile... salad was great too!

I compare all other Italian restaurants in NYC to Lupa.  And I always go back to Lupa as my absolute favorite.  The Bucatini all'Amatriciana is the best outside of Rome.  Rezzies are hard to come by, so call two weeks in advance or go last minute  & have a glass or two of wine at the bar while you wait.  It's worth the wait!!   And if they have Osso Bucco or brussel sprouts sprouts on the menu that day, order them!

Been to Calandras many times in recent times due to reviews of their bakery and baked goods. Not overly impressed. Those giving it five stars clearly have not gone to te bakeries that truly offer the earth of fresh foods that leave you wanting more. Review is based on over ten or so visits. Parking is nothing short of a cluster.... Whoever designed the parking probably built that monstrosity next to MetLife stadium. No left turn out of parking lot. Setup is nice with restaurant and coffee shop but overall layout is messy. Ordered dozen rolls, two large dinner rolls, French bread and a basket of goods to go. All cold upon pick up and noted to manager that as a fresh bakery, that is not good enough. Gave them he benefit of the doubt but since this visit everything from counter front is cold to the touch. If you advertise fresh, serve fresh! Calandras has the reputation of the best in NJ. It just isn't. Not anymore. Lou has let standards drop over the last three years at this store. There is no doubt the rolls from supermarkets are good but they are loaded with preservatives....tasty (and rated the best). But, leave them in your bread bin for a couple of days and watch what happens. Sugar desserts are great! Servers are inexperienced with Italian bakery but that is to be expected....but again, if you advertise to be the best...I will rate based on that. A good place for a casual person wanting baked goods. If you want the best, avoid or at least get everything fresh or ask for it that way.
The Italian side of me comes to life when Im here! The authentic food is great and the italian decor is greater
