There were only about 10 people in the place....IDK, but, figure it out! Don't turn people away!  Extremely rude, poor service - doesn't matter how good your food is if people can't be served!

Better options for the price and service offered here. Food is good but not worth the wait, or the awful service accompanying it. I'd recommend other spots in new haven before heading here. Might be back because friends seem to love it.

I've only come here drunk but I remember the shrimp and chorizo and the burger to be real good. The kitchen's open til late which is awesome, since this area really only has bars that are open at 1am.

Coming here with a Groupon, we have no complaints. We had the 8pm seating and we could have stayed for the 10pm if we wanted. The food and drinks were ok. The music was good considering we were in NJ. I would say about 80% of the people in attendance had a Groupon offer. The service was also acceptable. When my fiance called to make the reservations we were nicely reminded that the Groupon offer did not include the tip. Apparently folks who come with a Groupon do not tip!! C'mon folks you're getting a Jazz band with food and drinks for a fraction of the cost if you traveled to NYC, so the least you can do is leave a tip!!
Fried chicken sandwich with picked tomato was the best!

Ate here a couple of says ago and I got food poisoning from this place. My friend and I believe it was their soup we had because she felt queasy after eating it as well. I think they left the soup out for too long that it was not set to the right temperature. Spent the days puking. And also they have a lot of fruit flies that when two of them went inside my drink. You better think twice before coming to this place, you might end up getting sick!
Food was not that great.  Ordered the oxtail and chicken and both were very mediocre at best.
The owner is down to earth. Made sure we have everything we want and how we wanted it. Definitely going back

I ordered a salmon dinner. It is delicious! Everything about this place, from interior design to service to food, is excellent, much better rendition compared to the old Montclair Station. (It used to be very loud due to lack of sound insulation.) however I gave it 4 stars because I was not asked how I would like my salmon cooked. I'm sure for best practice reasons, the chef cooked the salmon through. Not my personal preference, but it still tasted very good. I was also impressed with the inclusion of salmon skin. If I had the option, I would've given them 4.5 stars.
It was great pizza but I was expecting something phenomenal. Inconvenient that they didn't take credit cards. Overall great place.

Waitresses are rude and mean. and the noodles are too oily. The pork topping is sooooooo soso flavor that doesn't deserve the time we wait and the money for it. DO NOT  WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY on this restaurant because their good marketing!

Cute tapas place to meet up with friends. Nice wine list offering and menu choices seemed to have something for the most finicky eater. It could get a bit loud as it gets busy later in the evening. Service was great!

This place is disgusting. There was hair on our tea and when we asked the server to change our tea, he was so mad and annoyed at us as if we did something stupid in the restaurant. I'm never going back here again.
100% fantastic. I love the tasting menu. Meat on meat on meat.

Hate the ordering system. Wanted a beer while I was figuring out what to eat. Asked the barman if I could get the beer I ordered while I was deciding and the answer was "no". It then snuck in a tip on the bill that I wasn't aware of until my receipt was emailed. What am I tipping?  An ordering system I don't like?  I thought tipping was based on service. Beer selection is good and they have Sculpin. That's why they get any points. Steak tartare was decent but soup was cold. I tried complaining to the iPad but it doesn't seem to care.  This place could be ok if they get rid of the ordering system.

Wow this was so bad. We were in the area and decided to stop for breakfast after seeing a commercial with a dancing singing pancake for Chip's and decided to give it a shot. First off- it's ugly inside and cash only, should've been first clue to leave but for some reason we stayed. We ordered banana pancakes and I was in the mood for lunch which is served all day... It should never be served at any time though. The worst, dryest most burnt and disgusting sandwich I've ever personally had, and I'm not being dramatic this was an embarrassment. The pancakes were extremely mediocre, yikes. Kudos to their marketing team for an entertaining commercial, and probably some third party unofficial rating as "CT's Best Pancakes." Stay away at all costs.. Service pretty blah as well.

On my first real trip to Philly, I knew that I had to try a cheesesteak and my friends had recommended Pat's to me.  People had warned me that people are a bit "gruff" in Philly, so I didn't really anticipate a wonderful customer experience, but I was a little shocked that they spent so much of their time attempting to be rude and brief with people that they messed up orders since they didn't take the time to listen.  They gave us the wrong cheese on our sandwich, but it wasn't worth correcting the error, so we moved on and figured it would do.  We ended up with the cheese steak with cheese whiz (the traditional way).

Epic. Life changing. Exhilarating. Eating a Pat's Cheese Steak with Cheese Wiz is like dying and going to heaven. Why even bother going to Geno's... that would be truly un-American! Oh, but may avoid Pat's King of Steaks at night. You did watch the intro to Fresh Prince right?

Going to visit your son in Philly requires the cheesesteak thing so where better to get the immersion experience than Passyunk Ave where you find both Geno's and Pat's. We chose Pat's. The fare is about typical PCS which is as good as that specialty gets, but the other fun feature of the visit was the faux abuse we get when the order taker detects our southern accents when we say "wit" indicating the inclusion of onions and white cheese. Of course we have to counter abuse back which results in the employee coming out to join us during his break and have a big time joking around. All in all a memorable time at an iconic American fast foodery and the steak was as good as any.

A good sandwich, a better history and story, and open 24 hours. get wit.. Great for a 3 am craving and fun to take out of town guests to because of the lore. I may have to make a run now... see you there! Be prepared to eat at the tables located outside under cover.
Pat is the best Philly steak place, there rolls are fresh and the steak is cooked to order. This has got to be the best cheese Steak in the world order it WIT and provolone that's how I like it.
Delicious mexican food. The taste and quality of the food was really good. Ended up going back to the same place for that reason. Service was good but the music was a little too loud.

Two of us went to El Vez at the recommendation of our hotel front desk clerk. The restaurant was vibrant and full on a Monday night. They were very accommodating and our wait, without reservations, was quick. We shared the guacamole - which is a house specialty and should not be missed. It was creamy and a bit spicy -- just right. We shared the seabass tacos but after taking one bite, I really did not want to share them anymore. They are on the smaller side and just right for lighter appetites or people who've just ate their body weight in chips & guac. we also shared the mixed enchiladas which were 3 - one shrimp, one chicken and one black bean. All were terrific and this was way more than enough food for two. margaritas were great and service was attentive but not smothering. I would definitely go back to El Vez when I am in Philly again.

I never write reviews unless it was really good...or really bad.  There was NOTHING that I tried that I didn't like.  The kindness of everyone that works there is a rare find.  The atmosphere is nice.  It's not noisy like you may imagine it would be.  The food was EXCELLENT!  I highly recommend the blood orange margaritas (these are the only margaritas I've liked) and El Vez cake cannot be neglected from mentioning.  Excellent choice for anyone looking for good Mexican cuisine.

Are there recently with a group of 8 people and everyone loved it. The restaurant is hoping and a great scene. The food is great! The guacamole sampler was awesome and they kept bringing out refills of their chips. Excellent margaritas as you would expect! I'm traditional but they had some fun varieties. Service was really great. With a large..

Zen in Livingston is our go-to sushi restaurant. We've visited dozens locally but still come back to Zen. Rolls are quite large compared to others. Even NYC sushi spots get a run for their money in terms of quality and variety and at 3x the price usually. Let's be clear, Zen is not cheap either but you get a better bang for you buck here. We eat in and get take out often. Excellent quality either way. BYOB at the restaurant and there's a liquor store a couple of doors down in the same strip mall.
Had a drink at the bar.  Bartender was good and chatty after we got his attention.  Pretty bar, would go back and try the food.

I was surprised - I went with some friends, and expected it to be pricy. It was actually very reasonable, and the food was great! The ordering process is a little strange - it's halfway between fast food and restaurant - but it works well for a large group, while still maintaining an air of class.
Love this place !!  Everyone is always friendly and smiley and so wonderful 4 year old! !  The foods is great too! !!!
A-OK
Great food , great service that's priced right, will be back !

Great restaurant with great service, atmosphere and delicious food. I've came here several times and anything I  would order would be a hit. Whether it be halibut to polenta to pasta to salad.  My personal recommendation would be the Halibut special and the cheese ravioli in tomato sauce.
the bartender was amazing. the chicken was perfect. a great atmosphere. can't wait to come back
Great meal, great service. Lobster Risotto, Hangar Steak. Yummy!  Beer was fresh and cold! 8 of us and every plate was empty.  Thanks!

Hands down the best restaurant in Philadelphia. Sally and her team are amazing! The service is excellent, the new location is gorgeous and the food is always on point. I wish I could give them a million stars!

Italian food, Japanese, French and Mexican are my favorite foods. And whenever I find a GREAT Mexican Cantina that's lots of fine with really good inexpensive Mexican food then there is no reason to go anywhere else -- but Cantina Dos Segundos. That's the way I feel about Cantina Dos Segundos. Si, es muy bueno!   The food is always great and the margaritas, if you're nice to the waiters (slip them an extra $$$$) can give you a quick buzz and are delightful! The only thing they are missing are Mariachis. The bartender is awesome and the staff is wonderful and the waiters are so Northern Liberties COOL!
this is the indian restaurent..which i  really want..everything is asowome..

It's a shame this place doesn't get more attention on Yelp, I have never had a fresher tastier sandwich anywhere else. This place has been around for quite a while, and for a good reason. The staff is kind, capable, and always happy to serve and like I said before their food is to die for. Counting down the days until my next visit!

In reading this review know that I don't love fish. If I eat fish it needs to be super-fresh and not taste like fish. So when I say that I loved the ceviche here it's a big deal for me. And I loved it, and intend to love it again sometime soon. I just hope it's not as insanely loud and crowded next time!
Great dishes, went here for my bday and loved all the flavors.

The food isn't bad but just don't try to call in an order and expect it to be ready when you get there. They do not even start cooking your order until you get there and pay. What was suppose to be a quick stop ended up taking over a 1/2 hour. And that is after the original 20 minutes they give you to come pick it up.

Usually I don't spend this much on ramen but what the hell right? I was able to get a reservation at 8pm for 4 on a Friday night after much practice of my re-dail-foo. My party ordered all 4 appetizers and I really liked them all. The "okonomiyaki" was my favorite due to the sweet and salty flavor. It was scallions in an 'american' pancake  batter but salty due to the trout! I had the mu ramen which had a very full and rich broth. The noodles were the perfect texture for the broth and their attempt at the sous vide egg was much better than my own! I tried the spicy miso and that had a much bolder flavor than mu ramen. It wasn't spicy in the sense of 'need to wash this down with something else', but spicy in taste. I would definitely come back just for the appetizers again! I also recommend bar seating if you like watching the chefs do their thing.

Man! They serve big portions for only $6. Try the Chicken and Lamb with rice combo with the white sauce and a pinch of the HOT SAUCE. By HOT SAUCE..yes trust me it's spicy. Also, try the Chicken Sandwich..meat, rice stuffed with pita. Thumbs up.

Excellent noodle restaurant in the heart of Chinatown! To cool down during Summer, try the cold shaved pig ears. They have a great crunch to them and are well marinated. Then heat up with a bowl of noodles. I doubt you need any more food than that but the stir fried noodles and boiled dumplings are equally great fillers.
a must eat for anyone who may find themselves traveling through Philly.
Chavelas is cool. Weird service sometimes

the food here was pretty good overall. I don't ever try French food very often. But I though I would try something different for a change. I did like the crossants for the most part but they were just a tiny bit dry, sorry to admit! The service there was just okay,though some of the staff there were not as friendly as other plcaes I've been.. not rude, just not really friendly either. The 1 thing that makes this place not quite a 5 star would be the bathroom. It was kind of dirty and smelled when I went in there, and that's kind of a big issue for me. Clean enviroments, especially places serving food is an absolute MUST. It can sometimes be the difference between whether people come back or not, and based on that alone I dont know if I would.Between a 3 star and 4 stars, I guess I'll be generous and give 4 stars.. in light of the holidays season

I was excited to try this place based on the reviews but was very disappointed. I waited close to an hour for my food - I ordered the lamb saag-and then when it finally arrived, it was barely like warm. As I write this I am hoping I don't have to wait another hour for my check. It is not looking good.

Something is definitely wrong..such highly rated place...I believe some worker is messing with the owner..I called asking to speak to the owner and some guy with a Spanish accent laughed at me and my friend ..He picks up the phone saying 'what you want' and then hangs up. ...I asked to have the owner call me bakc and no one has. .spoke to a man named Bogdan he took a message but owner never called back. ..Also I called twice today and both times the cleaning guy laughed at me and hung up ...saying that if I want to speak to the owner I need to come down there....so weird I'm buffled....All I wanted is to make reservation.for 10 people....geeee

Ordered food for my work from here and it was delicious. Everyone enjoyed it and I really loved everything! ! Especially the causa and the empanadas.  Although the causa was spicy which I don't eat I didn't want to stop! Yumm!!! The empanadas are so different than those that I've tried.
I loved this place!  The calamari, shrimp and corn was great! This is a perfect place to go with a group of friends and enjoy a meal!

We've gone to Massimo's for years, both for take out and dine in. For the most part, it's been pretty reliable. Not amazing, but decent and mostly consistent. But the last time we got take out it was horrible. Buffalo wings we ordered we actually mozzarella sticks, which they realized before I left. They replaced them with "buffalo wings" which I didn't realize until I got home were not buffalo wings, just breaded wings without buffalo sauce on them. They also had a rather strong fishy taste. Even the kids wanted nothing to do with them. Pizza was poor, we got half sausage half plain, sausage was almost non-existent, pizza was overcooked and just seemed "flimsy". Again, even the kids wanted nothing to do with it. Service for take out was also poor and surly. The curly haired guy who is always there needs to not curse so much with his co-workers when customers are there. Maybe a bad night for them but I am not in a hurry to go back, especially with so many other options.
The Soho Squares is the best interpretation of sicilian style pizza -- personal favorite is the Spicy Spring, where the pepperoni is cooked to absolute perfection. This place is no joke.

I went with a group of friends for dinner to Cookshop and loved it - It was nothing ridiculously exceptional, but maybe it's just that their brunch is better. The service was honestly kind of awkward - we had two waitresses who would just come up to our table and stand there, and I was put off a bit. Anyway, the place has a cozy ambiance and dim lighting, so perfect for a small get-together with friends or a date. Their bread basket is HUGE (so obviously this place is an automatic 4-stars) with focaccia that could give any Hell's Kitchen Italian place a run for its money. The cocktails are trendy and unique - I ordered a ginger apricot margarita, which was decent but not anything to call home about. My friends got the mojitos and they looked pretty good. We started with the pumpkin gnocchi which is to DIE for if you like that kind of thing. It melts in your mouth and the sauce was perfect to dip the bread in (which is all that matters). For my main course I got the meatloaf, which I LOVED. I was a little skeptical, partly because I don't think I've ever ordered meatloaf in a restaurant before, but it came on top of cauliflower in this tomato bisque and was a little spicy but not too overwhelming. The cauliflower was actually incredible and made me feel super healthy because this tomato sauce could have easily been paired with some hearty pasta. We were so stuffed from our bread refills and dinners, but I definitely need to go back for the desserts - there's something called a Chocolate Deliciousness on the menu (no kidding). Overall hands down one of the best dinners I've had in the area, and definitely coming back for brunch.

We went and I was hoping to find that the not so great reviews were nothing but I too fall into this status.  While the staff was very nice my party of 4 did not find the food to be anything spectacular.  The polenta fries were very bland and the main courses were nothing to rave about. The dishes are made to sound and look sophisticated but fall short of being an amazingly delicious meal.

On a recommendation I went here with 2 friends on a Tuesday night.  We arrived at around 8 and although the place was basically full we were sat quite promptly. The decor was great. I loved the chandeliers and the bare wooden tables were also sharp looking. We sat in the room to the right which looks like we were sitting in someone's house... A feeling I like from restaurants. I love beer and they had 10 taps and the selection was very thought out. It was my first taste of this years Sierra Nevada Celebration and it was awesome.  The service although busy was adequate.  We never waited long for anything and sometimes a server not being so overbearing is welcomed. One of my friends is a vegetarian and Arianne made a special pasta dish for him as they were out of the ravioli special.  Food was great.. crabcake app was perfect. We had some mushroom app that was addicting.  We ordered that for the vegetarian but I think I ate most of it. I had the pork chop which is now in my top 3 pork chops of all time.  My other friend had the chicken pot pie. It wasn't as expected but the quality of the chicken was top notch. Very rarely am I blown away by grilled chicken but the juiciness and freshness of this dish was memorable.  It's hard to mess up dessert and they didn't.  All in all a great place that I am sure is still working out the kinks of being new but I will 100% be back.

Great food - horrible service! The food here is amazing. We all had something different, and it was all delicious. The coffee is also wonderful! It was flavorful and reasonably priced for all of the food we were getting! However the service was absolutely terrible. It was not busy when we went, but yet our server continually kept messing something up up. I'm not sure if she was new, but she 1. forgot to place our order and made us wait for 45 minutes for our food. When we asked, she lied to us saying some of our dishes "take longer to make." Meanwhile everyone else at the restaurant were getting their food in under 10 minutes. The table next to us got the same dishes in about 15 minutes. When we asked for refills of our coffee or water, she would come back 10 minutes later with our refills. Nothing was speedy. 2. She ended up messing up our check 3 times, after making us wait for 15 minutes just to get the check. There were only 4 of us, and there was nothing complicated about our order, she just kept confusing the other tables and giving us the incorrect bill. 3. I had a groupon and she had to take my phone to use the groupon code. She forgot to give me my phone back, and when I went to ask for it, she told me she misplaced it and that it is "somewhere back there." She had me and the other waiters looking for it for 5 minutes before it finally showed up. I wish I could give this place 5 stars, because the food is truly 5 stars. However, the service could only be rated as 1 or 2 stars.

Went there for our holiday work party. The person who set up the party couldn't make it and there had been miscommunication but the staff and owner were beyond accommodating to meet the needs of our diverse staff. Everybody was real friendly, the food was absolutely delicious, and the place was decorated beautifully for the Holidays.

Last night, 9 of us had an expensive dinner at Metro North.  They placed our table in the bar area and the noise was so loud, we literally had to shout to talk to the persons on either side of us.  Then, they would not give us separate checks.  I told the manager that, considering the discomfort of all the VERY loud noise, they should accommodate us with the checks, but he walked away from me.  The food was very good, but the venue was like a sports bar in full swing!  I would never recommend this restaurant to anyone that wanted to carry on a quiet, intelligent conversation and in normal tones.  There are plenty of restaurants with excellent food and a quiet environment.  Why they did not give us a table in the actual dining room, which is separate from the bar, is beyond me.

Fabulous decor, great location, & amazing food. The only reason this place doesn't get five stars from me is because of the slow service. Also, don't be scared of the prices their portions make it worth it!

Great food, great service, great price. No complaints. Some might complain that it is small but thats a positive for a business like this, in my opinion. Great sushi and hibachi and its BYOB. Also, they always have dels on groupon (going on 2 yrs now) and always have coupons in local magazines. Worth checking out

I use to come to this place a while back and they would really be around to serve some quality meat.  Last night, December 19, 2014, 8 of us ate rodizio. The rodizio skewers that kept coming around were mostly chicken and sausage, then sirloin, when requested. The sirloin that passed around, had the texture of liver with a liver-like taste. It was really disappointing. I had to ask 4 times for a quality piece of meat. The only good quality piece of meat that came around for the hefty price tag of 30.00 was skirt steaks, nothing else (with a mere inch piece per person). Afterwards we went out and about to another town for drinks; 3 people left due to stomach aches! Happy holidays. The service was good, but really if we pay 30.00 a person for rodizio, please do not try to fill our stomachs with chicken, sausage, rice, beans and bringing the best of meats out per my request. I have to say this was really disappointing and I will not come back considering the other options. Lost the love for this place. :(

Of all the Viet restaurants i've tried this is definitely the best place if you want a big warm bowl of pho or a rice dish!  The service isn't the best but they are very quick when it comes to serving up the food and is at a very good price.
Shrimp & Chicken Gumbo; Shrimp & Grits; Triple Chocolate Brownie - DELICIOUS!!! Service - EXCELLENT!!! Don't need to say anything else except you should eat here!!!!!

I got excited to hear that a new soul food place is in Jersey City.  Despite the rough looking exterior we went in.  The older lady was very rude...Advice learn how to speak to customers. ..bad attitude made us leave before the food came.

Food was good but for an 8pm reservation we were given our table 840pm. What's even better is that we got a 6 seater for an 8 people table. It's gets better, the hostess told us that she can't ask a 2 seater table next to us to leave so we should hover around them to pressure them to leave!! Expect a long wait, bad service from the hostess and good food. Food worth 4 stars.

I haven't written a review in a very long time because most of my dinning experiences lately have been moderate to good.  So, really nothing to write about.  Koi, on the other hand, deserves special attention because it fits most diner's criteria for a terrible restaurant; (i) bad food, (ii) bad service, and (iii) no liquor license.  At least with a liquor license a diner can order a drink to forget about the bad food and bad service.  We went on a Friday night.  Chinese restaurant on a Friday night -- probably busy, right?  It was, but there was only one waitress running around.  She got support later in the night but the wait staff was entirely ineffective.  There were four of us so, naturally, our entrees came out at three separate times, 15 minutes apart.  (Sarcasm here)  Oh, and the waitress got our order wrong.  Instead of apologizing, after the third stage of our dinner arrived, the waitress asked, "would you like anything else."  Really?  When I asked, "Really?," she looked like a deer in headlights.  Maybe she thought customers don't mind being served the wrong order over a 45 minute period.  Oh, did I mention the food was terrible.  The broccoli with the General Tao's - still frozen.  The sushi appetizer - not edible.  (The waitress didn't ask why almost all of the sushi was still on the plate when she came to take away the plate.  I don't think she cared.)  The miso soup - like chalk.  When we told the waitress that we ordered spicy beef, not chicken, she proceeded to throw the serving spoon from the chicken dish on my plate and walk away rather angry.  She came back a few minutes later to say we were "right" and we ordered beef.  Did she really need to check and then come back and tell the customers they were correct?  There is always a silver lining.  We went to Carvel, next door, and had great service and delicious ice cream!
stay away!!  worst place to eat anywhere on plante earth. No one to ask what's going on. No manager on site. 1 hour to get coffee.  Overall awfully experience.

Awesome place! I went for a date here a few weeks back and it was one of the most romantic dates ever. We both were pretty full from lunch, so we just ordered pizza and wine. The pizza had the most delicately baked crust I have ever had and really well cooked toppings. The ambience is perfect for a romantic evening together, with minimal lighting and beautiful candles on every table and an old worldly charm around you. The price is a bit on the higher side, but compared to how costly the rest of New York City is and what a great experience it was, it was totally worth it.
Nice atmosphere. Had dinner and drinks by the fireplace. Another time we sat in the garden. Food was good, drinks were good. Good vibe. It's not a five star place, but a solid four.
For American, this place is really nice, but for Vietnamese like me, the food is not authentic. If you want true Vietnamese food that might not suit the American taste, don't go here.

I just moved here from Los Angeles, have been visiting Lebanon for a few years and had heard about Gusanoz. The locals never had anything great to say about it aside from them having good salsa. I showed up, and the first thing I heard was blaring Salsa music. My first thought was, if a Mexican owns this place, they have to be from El D.F. Sure enough they are originally near Chilangolandia, A.K.A. The Federal District of Mexico. I had ordered a two taco plate with black beans and rice. First off, who ever made those beans must have had Parkinson's with the salt Shaker. The Salt mines of North Africa had less salt than these beans. The Mexican rice was ooook. The tacos were not asada, but steak, which is cool. Overall the food was ooook. With the two tacos, beans, rice and one beer, a Pacifico, which is a basic Mexican beer, like a Coors of Mexico, the total was 23 dollars. Even in L.A. would you never see a place like Gusanoz this expensive. I asked the bar tender why the prices were this high, his response was that patrons complained they were too cheap. I call bullshit on that or the patrons are blatant idiots. Their menu also gave a definition to the word Gusanoz. Their definition was a Spanish definition as one from Spain,  of Mexico. In Mexico, a gusano is a worm, be it a earth worm, a maggot or any form of worm. Not something you would associate with food. You would associate it with tequila, but the worm in the bottle was not a Mexican idea but an American idea. It would also seem that this place has gone through several renovations to keep it a float. There is only so many holes you can patch on a sinking boat before you just give up on it. Most of the people who post positive reviews seem like they are friends with the owners or friends helping a dying dream. In conclusion, if you want to spend tons of money for sub par Mexican food, come here and get reamed for your money.

Experienced by far the worst server I have ever had in a very long time!! A few friends and I decided to grab dinner before leaving Philadelphia for the holidays and we decided on Amada since we enjoyed the whole ambiance, food and drinks the last time we were here. When we arrived for our reservation at this establishment, the hostess greeted us with a warm smile and offered to take our coats and sat us at our table right away.  Then, after getting settled at our table, Karey, the server/waitress, came to offer us water.  After we ordered the sangría blanca, a few tapas and the paella valenciana, the waitress/ server did not visit our table and asked to see if there was a possibility that we needed anything else or even how the food and drinks were.  We thought this was just the type of service she provided, but during the whole time in which we were waitress-less, we noticed that she was selectively not visiting our table.  After we noticed this stark contrast in service we asked a nice gentlemen who was bring out food to another table for a manager.  After speaking with the manager and explaining our horrible experience with the waitress, the manager was very attentive to our concerns with the waitress and handled the situation in a very professional manner.   Overall, the ambiance of this establishment is great and not too loud.  The sangría blanca was very flavorful and pretty on point in terms of sangría I have had in España and the paella valenciana was by far the best paella I have had in the states. Wish we could have had better service to accompany the wonderful and scrumptious food and drinks.  So, if you do not want to experience horrible service that was selectively delegated by the waitress, then avoid Karey.

Went for my birthday,we were seated in a front room that was freezing. They had one space heater which did nothing,because as soon as the front door opened ,in rushed the cold air. After complaining,they brought in 2 small other heater units,but by this time we were eating with our coats on and our food got cold quickly. I ordered a ziti  baked dish that was  watery and flat tasting. We ordered a meatball panini and noted the meatballs to be fatty and the sauce just ok. service was fair but we had to ask to change tables due to window draft even though we told them it was cold there.Don't plan on returning.  Also parking difficult to find.

I give this place negative three stars. We paid $121.00 dollars for two tacos, guacamole, chili, and four margaritas. If you want to pay 16 dollars for one fish taco and inedible rice and beans you should come here. I literally spit the rice in a napkin as inconspicuous as possible, it was so disgusting. Deconstructed mole sauce?! Buzz words restaurants throw around ten years ago...I should of known better. Guacamole made with brown avocados at the table by your waitress with a potato masher. Stale tostada chips that were made yesterday on the side. When you start thinking, I could make better Mexican food at home, you know you made a bad decision. Be sure to order a few margaritas to help soften the sticker shock of the bill.This is the most expensive terrible Mexican food you will ever have. Mezcal is just up the street skip this place and go pay less for better Mexican food.

Cute restaurant but don't be fooled. The restaurant was warm and welcoming but that quickly changed when we walked in. This place was crowded and no one knew where the line was to order. When we finally ordered, the cashier clearly didn't act like she knew what she was doing. We ordered a black coffee and a iced black tea. The cashier looked confused and asked if we really wanted ice in the tea repeatedly. We also ordered the avocado smash but we can't tell you how it tastes because we never received it. The iced tea didn't even have any ice in it and it was lukewarm. We ended up having to refund our order. We're never going there again.

I am a patient person, but then we started to realize that other people who showed up after us were getting their waffles. I finally went to ask for the manager, and this is where things escalated. I spoke with the manager, and my biggest concern was the continuous "non answer" from her. I explained that we ordered our food at 10:19AM, and it was now 11AM with no food. There was no empathy. I asked her why was I skipped and she told me that she would check on my order. I asked her again due to the non answer, and she kept repeating that she had to check first. After checking her answer was that everything was in sequential order. Once again, she chose not to answer my question. I asked again if I was skipped and does it normally take 40 minutes to make food here. She told me I could either take the food or get a refund. I told her I wanted a refund. Amazing traditional Italian pizza restaurant. Pies are great and prices are good too. My wife and I had the antipasta and '16 plain pizza. You can't beat Jersey pizza!
Could not have been better sushi or better service . Drinks were different and delicious . Sushi was honestly best In the area . Would recommend to anyone looking for an upscale experience.

Great concept. Get seated, scan boarding pass, order beer & food, chill out while the iPad alerts you on boarding time. Problem is the service is unbearably slow. Saw a customer get up to look for someone to clean the table. I waited 20 min just for 1 beer, and a customer next to me whispered sarcastically,"Brace yourself! Try to get drunk, or you'll get frustrated."
Had an awesome breakfast. Will defiantly come back and recommend this TriBeCa gem!! Awesome service also.

To be honest this place deserves a 0. My girlfriend and I came into the restaurant at 9:30 and they told us we had about an hour wait. We waited for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Well that is first and second when we were about to pay, we put the credit card in the receipt book (where you put ur cash or card) and a minute later the waitress comes and says that no card was left. First of all I do no understand how a card can get lost within a minute. On top of that it was my birthday, so you could imagine how I was feeling. We are never coming back here again. It's enough waiting that we had to wait 2 hours and fifteen minutes but my girlfriend had to call the card company to cancel her card, which actually took less time then waited to be seated in that restaurant! I recommend no one to go to this place!!
Love this place!!! Good food, fast service!! Faster than you would expect!!  Calamari and fried green beans all day long!!!!!!!!!!!!
Very good food, excellent drinks and great service! Will definitely come back here and I recommend this place to anyone. Very affordable, you will have a great time. :-)
Decent specials at this place, I frequent wing night on Mondays. Steaks look fantastic, drink are alright. Affordable place for a good time to watch the game, whatever you're into.

they make amazing food.. ive tried pretty much everything and have never been disappointed.. the staff is nice, only thing that stinks is the parking, that is why i took away a star.. its on a very busy street so finding parking is never fun.. but the food is worth it.. trust me...

Been a couple of times good experience just opened overall they are working out a few kinks but the pizzas are decent.  Clean new place... friendly... helpful.  Mussels are awesome (get the 900 degree ones-the others are just average).  They have some Italian dinners as well but have not tried yet.  Great addition to the area.
Won't deliver outside of walking distance.  Hard to call yourself a true delivery service otherwise.

Dank ass raw sausage. It was so soft and mushy that I instantly gagged. Ruined the rest of the already semi gross food for me. Nothing felt right after that. Loud icky people at the table next to me were also awful. Just. Awful.
Slow service. Average food. Sausage was raw. Asked for things and never got it. Burnt coffee. Loud patrons at the next table were. The. Worst. Ever.

This is one of my favorite spots in Manhattan.  The food is off the hook and they have a lot of vegetarian options.  It is a small place, so don't try and go there with too many people.  The only downside is that the bathroom is down stairs, not great accessibility....
Great food , super service , and very friendly staff! Close to 95 exit 42! Place is super clean too
A neighborhood favorite - the fried chicken continues to be one of the best in Brooklyn. Knowledgeable and friendly staff - we are very grateful for Walters!

Good comfort food. The mushroom gravy smothered chicken is excellent.  The burger is also good (although it had more pickles on it than I expected), as is the mushroom mac and cheese. Large portion sizes.

Thirty (30!) minute wait to be seated past our reservation.  15 minute wait for a cup of coffee.  Arrived cold.  Food was unimpressive,  Overcooked poached eggs.  Greasy bacon.  Uncomfortable chairs!!! (can't be understated).  Friendly staff but not attuned to their customers.  Host was very kind and even apologetic, but waiter was on scripted hipster autopilot and completely tuned out.  Won't soon return.
it was a nice romantic dinner, the place is lovely and the food pretty much organic, great taste and good size of meal

Came here for my sisters birthday (my sister and her friends love this place) LOVED IT. Being from a Spanish background it's hard to find authentic Spanish food, this place is good! The staff is very friendly too! I recommend the guacamole!!
We spent two hours and a half on the train to learn they close at 8, not 9 as mentioned on Yelp and Google reviews.
La pizza es increíble!!!! La sangría es deliciosa! Las meatballs también son buenísimas!!

the perfect spot for ramen on a cold day. Excellent choices. I suggest adding an egg into whatever you're getting. Hot sauces available for anyone who needs it spicy. Vegetarian options are delicious as well. There will be a wait - it is worth it. Super casual environment.
Ambiance is fantastic, the lights were a dim red & music playing in the background. Great spot for a date, great wine selection.

Read a review of Pine restaurant in New Hampshire Magazine and decided to give it a try when in Hanover in the evening for Revels. The waitstaff were numerous and very attentive, starting from when we entered the restaurant. I found the interesting combination of  textures and materials in the decor  pleasing. The several "snacks" we ordered were innovative and very tasty. When we asked to split a salad, which was excellent, there was no hesitation. My wife's pan-seared scallops were cooked perfectly. My duck confit with the kitchen-made fresh fettuccine was superb. The dining room manager stopped by our table several times, checking on how things were and taking away used dishes. I also encountered the inn/restaurant's general manager, making his rounds through the dining area. Obviously, the entire staff is working hard at making this operation a success. Without qualification, we think Pine is with the top restaurants in New Hampshire, counted on five fingers.
Nice chicken, good taste good price. The owners are very kind people. Recommand if you wanna have a quick meal right after visiting the independence square:)

My second bad review for this place. I ordered 3 shots and my bill came out to $36.69... when I asked for an itemized receipt they told me they could not print one... they then proceeded to tell me that they over-charged me and could not void out the ~$10 that was over-charged. My options were to either order another shot or to have a $10 "credit" they would keep in the cash register for when I came in at a later date... RIDICULOUS. Friends ordered Dogfish Head and they were $10 for a 12 oz.

Have you ever gone to a restaurant and felt you were an inconvenience to the wait staff?! I think the number of hipster beards seems to be compensating for their lack of personality. wundergroundmusic.com/75… Dont sit on the bar!

Huge disappointment the food was okay the service was deplorable we were seated quickly by a totally disinterested hostess the waitress came over left our menus and we never saw her again 20 minutes later my husband had to go ask another employee if he could take her order and was told no , we had to break his chops and he finally did and he checked on us once during the entire meal too bad , we were looking forward to having a good time but will not be returning.
This is the best place in Philadelphia to get a cheesesteak I always go cheese wiz wit onions

Cheap, open 24/7, great menu (plantain chips are amazing) and while it is tiny, the turn around is quick and they're accommodating for groups. It's a lovely late night place to grab drinks and good food :)

I think negative reviews are usually unfair to restaurants because, you know, everyone has bad days. Or, maybe you ordered something that you actually don't like and took it out on the restaurant. Food poisoning is something I don't excuse, however. I ordered eggs here and while they tasted great at the time, sure enough a few hours later my stomach was in knots and I was vomiting. I will never go here again and if you do, I hope you have a stronger stomach than I do.

First experience was last night, great atmosphere and the wait staff was responsive and friendly. Would have liked to have a little more to my meal but the guacamole was amazing! Would definitely go again!

We arrived early for lunch and got seated right away.  Our server was AWESOME!!!  She made food and drink recommendations, which were excellent.  The food and service was terrific!!!  Can't wait to go back the next time we visit Philly!!!
This was a really cool spot to meet up with some coworkers to get some food and drinks while watching the game. Great atmosphere and the staff was nothing but pleasant! Will definitely be back!
Absolutely love them!! Go here for happy hour all the time. They have the best drinks and great appetizers. Never dissapointed

So went to Mikes for dinner.... It's dead.... Took waitress 20 mins to take order..... 15 mins later... Comes over to ask what we wanted..... We walked out..... She was hammered ....so sad that we were the only ones at a table and 3 people in the bar and we could not get served ...The topper was when she said..... Please don't leave just remind me again what you wanted because I am backed up.... With what??
Was there for dinner last week and the food and service was outstanding.  It is my understanding that there is a new chef.  His menu has a great variety.
Good service but bad food!

The first time I came here was great. Had a wonderful time with Garrett  (bartender) at the bar. So good I brought 7 more friends with me the next time. had a good time then. Then I tried to have a date at the "dining room" as a walk in. From then on, it turned horrible. With an empty dining room, we were sat at the bar tables, that lovingly view all the sitting patrons at the bar butts, and crowded cause the bar is usually crowded. Our server was inexperienced and brought us the wrong drinks. we asked for another table away from the bar, We were REFUSED with the excuse that "though we don't seem busy, we have reservations), my first date with this guy so far has turned bad when I suggested this place to meet, so I'm not happy We got offered to move tables when we got our entrees, after appetizers, because those "reservations" never showed and they are still empty. By that time we just gave up and sat at the horrible table while viewing numerous empty tables across the floor from us. I complained to the manager, she did take some drinks off and replied with "I hope you try us again" So I did, this past Saturday. I had work till 5 in Grand Central, after me and my friend decided to meet half way to each other, I recommended Maysville, BIG MISTAKE!!!!!!. I call ahead of time to ask if we arrive in 20 minutes, can we have a table for two. The hostess says yes. So, I get there early, get a drink at the bar after I put my name down with the hostess. That this point there are only two tables in the entire dining room. Garrett is bartending, which I didn't know if he remembered me, so I didn't say anything but just ordered a drink. My friend arrives, we ask for a table. and guess WHAT? SAME THING. we get sat at one table away from the other horrible table I perviously sat at the last time I was there, the bar tables. My friend asks if we can sit at other side, the guy goes back to the hostess to ask, she comes over again and the same EXCUSE!!! "Though it seems we are empty, we have a lot of reservations coming" I just say forget it, lets go somewhere else. The hostess gives us the saddest fake emotions of "I'm sorry, MAYBE YOU CAN TRY AGAIN" I turn around pissed and say "OR NEVER" I ask Garrett to close out my check, and he quickly starts to be like "Hey, you were here last time, you wrote that great review about me and my manager read it" I said " Yeah that was awhile ago" cause I was surprised at the fact he remembered. IT was a long time ago, Then Garrett says, don't worry illl take care of your drink.... once again Garrett goes up and beyond my expectations of service, I really think he is a great employee and to be honest, he is the only reason I keep coming back to this place because all the other experiences I have been here were just horrible. Then later my friend tells me the hostess mumbled underneath her breathe when we wanted a DECENT table "Well maybe next time you'll have a reservation" I call later to complain, speak to a manger Named Talia? (could be wrong) "Try us again, we want you to come back, we want you to have a good time, I really want to turn this around for you" The statement is nice but do I trust it, not necessarily, I've been told that before from a manger there. Overall I'm very upset over the whole experience in total. If I want to go back alone to enjoy the bar if Garrett is working, I think I will. Its embarrassing to try to bring people to a this restaurant as a first date or for a friend you rarely get to see, twice in a row, being rejected. Its just very damaging, I know its NYC and there are thousands of restaurants, but to have the same restaurant treat me so poorly when I'm referring their business to by trying to experience their service, i just can't explain how upsetting it is. But I have brought several people to this restaurant, dates, friends, colleagues, and out of three times, only 1 was great, and its because we sat at the bar. The other two were a disaster because we tried to sit at the dining room. I have worked in hospitality (food) for over 5 years in NYC and been manger, opened places, and done every job imaginable. I have never been to a restaurant so blind business sense and inexperienced in customer service. Its really insulting to be refused a table twice now. So I am relying the message to everyone else, if you have a reservation, good luck. If the bar is open, GO THERE!

I've never had a favorite restaurant in NYC, now I do! Highly recommended!!!!  Delicious food! Wide selection of wine! The best dish is a sea urchin with salmon caviar! Will definitely come back again and again! Thank you!!!!

TLDR: strong sangria, amazing short ribs, get the pulpo ceviche. Went on a Friday night around 8, had a reservation but probably didn't need one at that time. Waitresses were nice, didn't hover over us. Music was super weird but entertaining (glee soundtrack?). Not a big fan of the tvs in the restaurant. The space is really skinny, but it makes everything seem cozy -- the people next to us were chatting with us throughout the night. We got a pitcher of sangria, which was a good deal and sneaky strong. The chips+corn they give you (free!) were great, especially with that green sauce. We ordered the ceviche sampler with the mixed, octopus, and mussel ceviche. It came out kind of late, but the waitress was really nice about it. The octopus one was in the most delicious, smoky, creamy sauce - I kept dipping the other fish in it. For tapas, we had fish tacos, which were very fresh and crispy. But the ribs really were the best part - falling off the bone, covered in a savory brown sauce, and sooo tender. Get them. I was very impressed, and liked the chill vibe. Would definitely come back.

Drinks were terrible! Water downed. Sent two drinks back. Ordered a seltzer and grey goose and I had to send it back, tasted like dirty dishrag with no alcohol. I'm giving it two stars because the server and bartenders were nice and they had karaoke.

We arrived at this restaurant a little late for our reservation but an hour and a half before a play we intended to see around the corner. The staff understood our time constraints and said there would be plenty of time. After some delay on the part of the waitstaff, we ordered drinks, salads and entrees at the same time. The drinks and salads arrived but we waited and waited for the entrees. After repeated requests for our entrees, we were told, "it's not our fault, it's the kitchen". We asked the manager to intercede and were told the same thing. We said that if the entrees weren't served we were going to have to leave in order to make the show...Nothing. We finally said "We can't stay any longer and have to leave." We were never served our entrees. As we were getting up to leave, the manager rushed over with the bill for the drinks and salads, which we promptly paid. After calmly telling the manager that they really botched our order, he threatened to call the police and have us arrested and that we were barred from ever coming back to Heirloom, as if we ever would. It was the absolute worst experience we had ever had with customer service, really unbelievable.

Whether it's pouring or blizzarding or hot as heck ... you're sure to find a line. Mixed platter + extra white sauce + just the right amount of hot sauce = perfection. Only first-timers drizzle on the hot sauce thinking they can handle it. But like the thousands of reviews before me, THIS AIN'T YOUR ORDINARY HOT SAUCE. Take it easy or else you'll suffer the next morning... Whatever you're doing guys, keep it up! Will be back here every time I visit!
Amazing! Food is made fresh. Delicious and welcoming. This is the spot to go. We had the omelet and Taylor ham cheese bagel. Amazing. The coffee was perfect. New favorite!
really good.

Have been here before, food is ok.  Went there on a Saturday at 7PM to celebrate my wife's birthday.  The hostess tried to squeeze us in a corner but she wasn't able to pull out the chairs it was so jammed.  She told me that they had no tables for two only tables for four.  She just said sorry and let us walk out.  Guess an empty table for four is better than an occupied table by two.  Very dissatisfied with the way this was handled, will never go to this place again!

Inconsistent!!! This place can be great and can be terrible. Recently, their dishes are  completely unreliable- not only in terms of quality, but in terms of ingredients. For example, I used to love a certain pasta dish with chicken, but now it's filled with disgusting " flakes of slimy dark meat" as opposed to the healthy large pieces of white meat. And just the other day, we ordered the polpette, which wed had just the week before, and the meatballs were a completely different size and were no longer all beef. I used to send many friends to these restaurants, and continue used trying it myself because it can be so good, but I'm now done unless something changes. It's the most inconsistent restaurant I've ever been to..
I like eating here when I know I want something a yardi eats so it's nice to have a taste of my country here in Hartford.

Disclaimer: This review may be unfair. But I am emotionally compromised right now. This is not directly a ricky's thai montgomery review. My FAVORITE thai food spot thai kitchen III in hillsborough was bought by a ricky's thai. Now I gave it a shot because hell how much could it change? But based on my regular orders the thai curries things have gone to COMPLETE SH*T. The rice is now hard almost like it's really old. The vegetables were the texture of baby food all mushy. Even the broccoli. (How is that even possible?) Don't even get me started on the taste of the coconut curry sauce. Before it was complex had spicy, salty, savory, and a tiny bit of sweetness. Now it's just spicy and lacking flavor. If I could ask the owners of the previous thai kitchen III to come back I would. Because ricky's thai in hillsborough is just plain Turrible (Hopefully there are a few basketball fans who get the reference)

This place was once a favorite.   Regrettably, product AND service have fallen markedly.   Order a beer?  The glass was handed to me 3/4th full!   No kidding.  This happened CONSISTENTLY through the night. Order an App'y?  Wait 40 minutes and get it served cold.   We laughed incredulously as we watched the food sitting on a tray waiting for the waitstaff to deliver it. EVEN THE GLASSWARE was inconsistent.  One time, a beer was served in a beer glass.  Another time -- same beer -- was served in a ball jar.  No kidding! Our party of 8 were so disgusted, we did finally leave much earlier than planned. ..We received biker-bar service and product in an upper-scale Princeton icon.   Senior management:  It's time to review your staffing at the Yankee Doodle Tap Room.   I suggest a top-down replacement.   Your front-end (bar/waitstaff) team is going to kill your business. -KEA December 20, 2014.

I love the fact that such a place exists to get such good food late at night in NYC. Great for layovers. The sauce and tender vegetables that come with the escargot were amazing. The Shrimp Provencal was delicious. I loved the tender ravioli. The chocolate Bruno flourless chocolate cake was very good. Can't wait to return.
ok

I've had the pleasure of coming here a few times, each with a different situation.  It was where I had lunch in the form of a delicious bagel and smoked salmon sandwich, and a decadent hot chocolate after running a philly half marathon.  It was where I took the pickiest of people I've ever dated who actually returned her amazingly thick and to die for hot chocolate.  There was no reason for the return other than she thought it wouldn't be thick... Which IMO is the BEST part of the amazing drink!  I've also enjoyed a chocolate martini, as well as a bit of my friend's white chocolate drink.  It was so good, he ordered a second right away!

If I were able to give it no stars, trust me I would. It was that bad. Now I know many people say this and I'm sure  they were probably wronged, but believe me when I say that this establishment is definitely deserving of negative stars. Anyway here it goes... My fiancee and I went in to get a quick bite to eat while we were running errands. Being students and working full-time, we appreciate quality food and quicker service, and will tip accordingly based on how the staff will go the extra mile. I ordered a BBQ chicken supermelt, and she got a burger. We split them so we each get half and half, as we always do. The burger tasted downright FUNKY. To say it smelled like a foot after gym class is giving too much credit. At first I thought it was the lettuce, but then it turned out to be really bad meat. Didn't look to be undercooked though. The waitress came over, and was very nice. She sent over the manager, ( Cesar is his name I believe ). We explained, and his reply was classic.... "We receive them in the plastic wrapping. It's vacuum sealed, so I'm not sure what happened..." and then he walks away.... Hmm...thanks for the effort there. My fiancee couldn't  even finish her half of the burger, and nothing was offered. I believe we just got dessert after, and then brought the check to be paid. The assistant manager, who no longer works there, was surprised about the burgers, but admitted he had never tasted them. No discount was offered off the meal, and then when they ask how everything was, we replied... "It was ok..." Then the golden ticket of punchlines by Cesar... "Except the burger right???" The snob is wearing the biggest s**t eating grin on his face as he says this. The future wife and I turn our heels so fast to the door, and that marked our last time that we will ever step foot in this hole. I e-mailed Friendly's Corporate, and explained the situation. I even threw it out there to them that a sundae or appetizer on the house would have made everything right. No word back. This all went down in July of 2014. And coming from someone who went to Friendly's often when it was still in Fair Lawn, I have a special place in my heart for this establishment. As far as this Bloomfield location goes, my fiancee has been going to it since she was a child and has seen it go down hill. Good luck in the future, but you will not see another dime from either of us. The word was spread to friends and family, and now here it is on Yelp.

It's a nice, clean place in a convenient location, perfect for grabbing a quick bite to eat. There are surprisingly many options for a hummus/falafel place. The staff is very friendly, and they did a good job of making a lot of seating space

The vegan boneless ribs are amazing! If I hadn't known these were vegan, I'd be certain they were the real thing. Very flavorful and incredible texture - inside and out. I sucked them down hard!! My friend ordered a second entree they were so good and we sucked them down together. Mostly him though. The only not 100% positive vibe I got was the service -- the waiter was busy waiting on like seven other tables. But that means business is good and I support China Pan business!! Can't wait to suck down some more ribs =]

Good selection of fresh produce but prepared foods aren't appealing.They have a rule that someone has to walk out with you if you use a cart.  The employee at the register made me unload my groceries and carry out 3 small bags because she was the only one there and couldn't leave the register!!!!! She told me to write in online to complain so I am. It's a ridiculous rule.  Now I just bring a basket and do my big shopping elsewhere.
Love Goodfellas.  Been going here for years.  Service, atmosphere and food is always wonderful.

I had brunch at Marc Forgione for the first time a couple of weeks ago with 3 friends. I was expecting a wonderful culinary experience, but it was negative from start to finish and I certainly will not be returning. The hosts were pretentious and the food was average at best. Their "eggs benny" was one of the worst takes on an eggs Benedict that I have ever had. Imagine a bland cylinder of potatoes with a water-logged egg on top that was not adequately poached. It had zero flavor, no texture, and poor presentation.You may think that a delicious cut of Canadian bacon or prosciutto will be the saving grace, but instead, what you get is a shriveled morsel of some nondescript crunchy "meat" that is less than half a bite. As a true connoisseur of eggs Benedict and and a lover of good brunches, I can say that this was a despicable attempt at one of the great classics.

Gets 4 stars more for the atmosphere and location.  Beautiful inside and great views.  Beer selection was a bit limited but good.  Food was good but not great although I would like to explore more of the menu.  Excellent place for a night out with family and friends.

Excellent addition to the Essex County restaurant scene -  beautiful renovation bar was hopping on a Saturday night - greeted and treated well upon arrival - sat in side room which was a little quieter - thats the only negative think I can say about the entire experience was the high sound volume  hard to hear people at your own table Food was delicious and choices eclectic   - nice size portions and wait staff helpful not too in your face - definitely on the pricey side Would definitely go back

Our dinner was off the charts at A K & B.  I could not believe that this place was the old O'Neils.  I dined at Culinariane many times so I knew the food wasn't  going to disappoint.  It was fun trying a burger as we had never had that option before. Ariane did not let us down! The drinks were a tad pricey but the liquor is top shelf  and they use fresh ingredients, so we knew we were paying for quality.  I agree that they will no doubt work out their small kinks as their aim is to make their customers happy.  See you again soon!

It's fairly obvious that the two negative reviews here are by the same person with some sort of agenda. Hate to wake you up but Mexican is not Spanish and vice versa. That being said I've only been here once but will definitely be going back. Tasty food, clean and a friendly vibe. Cindrella special quesadilla  on a fresh made tortilla was great.

The BEST crust in Vermont. I absolutely love the variety and the ingredients. The decor is great and the service is always quick. The beers on tap are also a treat as they leverage the local breweries and maintain a great variety. The prices are just right and the pizza blows American Flatbread out of the water. This is one of the best things to happen to the New North End along with the new 802 BWS beverage store. You should try it out ASAP!

This place is AMAZING! Me and my friends come here at least once a week. The amazing staff and 90s music keep us coming back and not to mention the menu is perfect. I've had every kind of grilled cheese and they are all so delicious and different and they even have seasonal drinks like mulled wine and pumpkin beer. It can be super chill but can also get really crowded on weekend. Definitely a great place to unwind with friends in a cozy atmosphere away from the cold! And you have to try the sweet potato tots!!

Mistakes happen. It's how a business handles them that counts. I've been ordering birthday cakes from Calandra's for about 4 years now and every time it's time to go pick one up, I always have a panic attack.  What if they wrote down the wrong date and it's not ready?  What if the cake looks awful?   Well, although every year my fears did not materialize and they always did an outstanding job, this year was the year they came true.  My husband went to pick up the cake and it was awful. I think I could have probably made a better looking cake than what he sent me a photo of.  Perhaps it was partly my fault, because my explanation of what I wanted was less organized and specific than usual. I didn't provide an exact photo of what I wanted, but let a girl just draw up what I described.  Big mistake! With only a couple of hours until the party, I didn't know what we were going to do. However, the folks at Calandra's did. They asked me to provide them with an exact photo of what I wanted, so I went on pinterest, downloaded one and sent it over.  Not only did they create the perfect cake within 45 minutes, while my husband waited, but they also discounted the bill by half for the trouble.   Now THAT is customer service, something that is getting harder and harder to find these days. Calandra's, I am grateful for the wonderful, friendly and customer-oriented people at your store.  You have won my loyalty and trust.  I will never go to another bakery for any of my or my family's needs again.

First time ordering from these guys. Food was delivered quickly and both employees I dealt with (on the phone and delivery man) were very friendly and professional. The food was good and the prizes are reasonable. Will definitely order from them again.
Amazing food..am still in awe at how good this place was!! Only disappointment--the tight seating :( But SO DELICIOUS!!
First, and last, check in here. The place hasn't been updated in 40 years. Food was awful.
Cool! Brooklyn style!  I moved from ny to nj. Really like that kitchen! And it also close to my house.

Excellent food. We had the tasting menu and an entree. I came here on a Friday and there was a bit of a wait so I would recommend booking ahead. I took two stars off because of our waitress. Our waitress kept dissuading us from ordering one tasting menu and an entree because it is too difficult for the kitchen and herself to serve things at different times. Otherwise it was great. I asked to be seated in a quiet area so the staff accommodated us by placing us in the far inside corner of the restaurant. We had a pleasant afternoon out and I would probably come back here again.
This is a nice bar great place to come with friends. I love how the exposed brick gave it an old fashion look. The drinks were good and I enjoyed the pizza.

Went there on a slow day so the food should have really been excellent but it wasnt. Based on the chicken parm alone its a two. It was hard chewy thin cutlets that barely had meat and the only flavor came from it being submerged in this basic sauce. Horrible.
I'm really happy with the food. Not too much personality or vibe, but when getting food to go you don't need that. The food is delicious!

Amazing food, great atmosphere. The idea is to order a few plates of food for the table, for everyone to share. Everything is vegan, the majority is gluten free. On the spicy side, so have plenty of water handy if you're not used to that. We ordered 4 plates to share, and everything we got was delicious. I am so happy I got to experience this restaurant! Will definitely be back.
Bangkok 9

Massive Farmer's market - check.  Tons of cool people shopping - check.  Fair prices on a HUGE variety of pretty much every kind of food you could ever want - check.  Only downside is the popular stalls can have long lines, but that's part of the price you pay for such a big, awesome outdoor market.  Do NOT miss this place.

I just gave my grandson his 8 birthday party with Games2u and boy was he so surprised. His friends enjoyed it so much and Alan was a wonderful host. My other grandson is now interested in his party for May. Thanks for making my grandson and his friends very, very happy.

A fantastic marketplace! Anything you need, they have it. Cheesesteaks, BBQ, Fruit Smoothies, Seafood, Baked Goods, etc. they've got it. Bar none one of the best places in Philly to get a quick bite to eat.

I have never reviewed anythinng on yelp before, and I'm hungover so the fact that I created an account and posted this should be indicative enough that this place blows. You'd expect a downtown princeton burger place to taste at least a wee bit better than trash, but no, this burger (I forget what it is called, but it was the one with bacon and pepper jack cheese) tasted like mud underneath a dumpster at an AIDS clinic. I would imagine whatever they eat in North Korea would put this shit place to shame. If I go here ever again it'll be too soon. I wouldn't wish this upon my worst fucking enemy. Yuck
This place was amazing! A little small but the food, and service was great! Very attentive staff. And Jose was an amazing server! The mimosas were delicious! Definitely a go to spot for brunch!

Went in there for dinner while on vacation visiting family and was really impressed with the food after reading a few negative reviews. I'm not adventurous enough to try anything too fancy in a bar so I stuck with the Blooming Onion Burger. It was great and pretty big for $10. The hostess was really nice and our waiter was polite and attentive despite it being busy for Thursday Night Football Saturday Edition. I'll recommend this place to others.

Very nice lil cozy spot,  it reminds me of an old fashioned dine in,  it is definitely a place to go during the Christmas season,  it just felt homely, I went for brunch had me a delicious chicken fried chicken and had their pear sour, very good stuff very cozy place for me and the honey...

I've been to "The Pig" several times with friends. This time, I took my wife for a lunch/brunch on a lovely November Saturday afternoon. We arrived just around noon and had to wait about 1/2 hour. No problem, plenty of seats around the bar downstairs (usually I go upstairs), ordered a couple of cocktails and a couple of orders of the dee-lish deviled eggs. We were seated by the delightful host, and were quickly brought water. We then ordered the Dutch Baby (a mix between a pancake and a crepe) with bacon and syrup, poached eggs with suckling pig hash and an order of string fries. Everything was so good and made even better with a small slice of pecan pie and bourbon sauce. Like always, even with a pretty good crowd waiting, we were never rushed and treated so well. Really nice job to the whole staff.
Thet have the best fries I ever had. The burger is awesome. The atmosphere is British pub meets the village. Bartenders are really good and they have a nice cask beer.
I am a recent Jersey transplant and I loooove this place. The oxtails were slamming! A bit pricey but worth every penny. I have zero complaints and I will definitely be back.

If you want to try authentic chinese food, please do not come here. Everything here is Americanized, i order spicy fish filet, a big no no. Probably they do better at shanghai food, but I'm not a big fan of "one restaurant, multiple cuisine" at all.

Absolutely awful experience.  My order was messed up, the salad never arrived....I asked for gravy for my dumplings and schweinshaxe and after 15 minutes (food was now cold) it arrived.  Oh, and charged me a buck for the gravy lol!  Asked for the manager, he never graced us with his presence.  Overpriced for sure!  I have no problem paying a premium for good food and service, this place had neither.
Nice homey place   Busy and well staffed. Good friendly service .  I had eggs over easy and toast to start, then bagel & lox. All tasty and fresh.

The food here is excellent. The mac and cheese is very good. The Sheapards Pie is also delicious  The  Poutine  here is excellent. My drink that I order was very  good. the waiter was nice and friendly. I am coming back here and trying more things.

Have eaten at this restaurant four or five times already since they've been open because the food is that good. I am a huge fan of the crispy artichoke salad and the ricotta gnocchi bolognese. The gnocchi is so fluffy it literally just dissolves in your mouth. The only downside of the dish is that it is so good that I wished it was a bigger portion. Its almost like an appetizer size but for an entree price. Other than that, I am happy that there is a new restaurant downtown that I can now frequent often.
Terrible experience with service. Food is ok, but you cannot dump on your customers and expect them to return. Never coming back. Would rather go to Oda or Pepella.
Had the vegetable pizza. Ingredients were fresh and crust was really good.. the servers were very friendly.  Went in jeans and a tshirt and felt a little out of place but overall good spot.

Went for dinner last night after I've been raving to my friends since seeing Blend's Instagram acct. Great atmosphere, great food poor and inattentive waiters. Had to chase down my waitress several times for drinks silverware and missing food items at the end had to hand my bill to busboy because of missing waitress. In all fairness place was extremely busy in the beginning but towards the end of dinner place was pretty empty and we still had poor service. Not sure if I would return. I ordered the Lomo Saltado which had an excellent twist because it taste like a stew but taste great. Also lobster mac and cheese was one of the best macs I ever had.

Over a half hour for appetizers. Never received our entres was told they lost our order in the kitchen. Was just told that we will not be getting food at all and the manager will void our order. Starving highly unprofessional.  Will never visit again

Excellent service! Staff was pleasant! Breakfast is fabulous. The French Toast is simply delicious.  I am not a french toast person but I had a serving and throughly enjoyed it.  Over medium eggs were perfect,  the toast was perfectly toasted.  Everything was hot and fresh!
We had such a great time! The place has a ton of character and if you are lucky to sit by the bar, the man behind was very knowledgable and friendly. I would definitely go back.
I've been there only twice and i honestly love the food and the service. The staff members are very polite and helpful at the same time. The young lady that helped me was Kay Kay and she was a doll.
Awesome  service and food!! Great quite and the best service you can ask for I have gone to the one in EDGEWATER AND Now Here I ENJOED Both Places :)

Was in the area so decided to try something new.... I didn't know what everything exactly was so I had a question or two. Guess I got the b*tch that everyone has been talking about because she was so freaking rude and annoyed that I actually had a question. Anyway, I don't deal with people giving me attitude in their business , where I'm spending my money so I left. She just looked at me shockingly that I walked out.  Maybe this is a cultural thing, or maybe she is just an ahole but screw this place....

Had one great experience with their gluten free pizza, the last three times however have been horrible. We just ordered and were charged for a Margherita pizza which was supposed to have fresh mozzarella, basil and sliced tomato. Instead we received a cold plain cheese pizza that looks like charcoal. It really makes me sad the the service and pizza here has gone downhill. Before I found out I had Celiacs I used to eat their regular pizza all the time and had little to no issues. I most likely will not try to give them another chance, three times too many.
Rude unprofessional and amateur service. We gave too many chances thinking it was just a rough start to new opening, but the service is still horrible and the taste is inconsistent.
Worst experience  i ever had there is notthing good in food and service. I rather drive little further to go to better places in edison.

ok, being from DC an all, I thought when I saw this little hole in the wall...yeah, ok an arcade place.  Well, to my surprise, it was so much more than that!!  It has farm to table food--locally grown beef, awesome burger, cooked to perfection,  and LOCAL Vermont Beers...Fiddlehead, I LUV U!!!  I nearly died when I saw some of the old pinball machines...its not all digital stuff here, they got the old machines, like asteriods....when was the last time you played that??????  love everthing about this place,  I was there on a Wednesday night and it was jammed....and not just young x generation geeks, there were people my age...late 50's with their grandchildren....I will definitely make this a must go to place each time I go to Burlington.  The brewer from Fiddlehead was actually there!!!
The Service and the food .......fabulous.  I Had a whole fish and I don't know when I have had a better piece.  The whole experience was wonderful
Mushroom soup was great, and I love me my brothy Japanese soups. Got the inferno roll and have no regrets. This is probably the best cc sushi I've had so far.  Will return for sure.

This place does EVERYTHING well. Service, top notch. Food, amazing (have that curry soup!!!!!!). Portion size, generous. Price, modest. Ambiance, er, Irish, lol. Yes, the location is not really near anything interesting (save this enormous and very cool cemetery), but, hey, in the end, you will not care. Trust me :)

I had the cold-brew coffee, which was fantastic. The blue cheese tomato quiche was also great served with a fresh salad.  Very nice atmosphere and friendly staffers.  I'm not in this area very often, but I will make my way back next time I am.  I recommend this place!
I know this has nothing to do with NYPD police but I  just want to say to support anything that has this logo.
Good taste. We loved the Mediterranean pizza. The only gripe was that they would not accept the yelp check in offer. Even the manager was not aware of any such offer and asked us for a coupon code.

My friends and I had the best time! Our server Sarah S. was great and knew exactly what we needed and made beer recommendations for us. Definitely request her and try the curly fries! The happy hour specials were on par! Definitely coming back soon!

As for the Pizza served at the Godfather, I couldn't hardly understand what the big deal about it was. I'm sure the Seafood and other meal options are good for I haven't tried it. I came here with my sister and old man, because my sister was craving a good old, nice, fast serving of pizza. It was a place we've always seen and thought it was another Asian restaurant along the strip. I had the Sicilian, and I was rather disappointed because the crust was burnt and the bottom crust was tough and hard. My sister and dad had a Buffalo slice, something that you would expect to give a kick in your mouth but they were also disappointed. The pizza was floppy and dry. Now of course, I thought, wow, the Village Trattoria in South Orange would never serve Buffalo slices, or any slices for that matter, in this manner.
