Above all, it was overpriced($4.50 for one buffalo slice) and shameful in flavor. I did however like the people who attended us at the counter. Nice people lol

food is as good as it gets and so is the service! they go above and beyond here to serve you! first time here so didnt know what to expect but ive heard rave reviews from friends so i decided to take my buddy and a few friends here last night for his birthday..they dont take reservations which i thought was a bit odd these days but once everybody in my party was there they got us seated right away.. we asked the waiter what was good so we took his advice and got served a new dish every 15 mins not only that but he also cut the food into portions so we didnt over order. i also brought a cake with me for my friends bday and they had it prepared and walked it out with the candles on it with out me even having to ask them!!! excellent job don peps!
They have a damn good burger

I really wanted to love this place.  I really truly did.  But, while I can only rate the food as "fine," I can at least give serious props to the awesome staff.  Super friendly, amazingly accommodating and superstars at making their patrons feel special, this place knows how to hire 'em.  You gotta love that from a trendy NYC restaurant.  It's not a common occurrence, unfortunately.

Their food sucks, my pizza was soggy and cold, customer service is even worse! So I won't be spending any more of my money here and you shouldn't either. Do yourself a favor your money is best spent elsewhere.

All I can say right now is DISAPPOINTING. Let me start off by saying I was born and raised in Brooklyn and have heard the numerous stories of how Grimaldi's pizza should be the best. The atmosphere was nice but way too loud. I couldn't hear my girlfriend to the point of where we had to lean to each other's ears to hear and I'm usually very loud. It took 15 minutes to bring us a menu and the place was not busy. We never had our water refilled until we asked at the end. The pizza was good but we got it cold. When we ordered extra cheese it seemed it could've used a little more. So we had a stale cold pizza. (Still ate all of it. Not paying this much for nothing) Which brings me to my next point. We ordered a canolli and a Spumoni Trufflel for dessert. The latter was gross and when we asked a waiter (balding guy with a Albanian accent) to take it back he got rude. Our actual waiter was nicer but not very attentive to our table so service is still low. Over all, pizza eh. Service bleh. Not coming back. I'd rather go to a local pizzeria.
Great food and the service was awesome. Try the baked eggs Sicilian or the salmon eggs Benedict.

Very good cheesesteaks made fresh to order and 100% delicious. Cash only and expect to wait in a small line. We want there and to the place across the street, and Pats won. You will need extra napkins of course, and the seating is only outdoors. Some may say there are better places and maybe so, but I have not...
Horrible food, period!
Love the drinks and the sushi....wow. Nice ambiance and cool fish tanks. Appetizers are really good as well. They seriously have great food.

Tried this place one more time to give them another shot......never again. This time was given raw chicken in my panini! When I called to let them know, not one person apologized. Really poor customer service. An apology goes a long way.

Pizza isn't anything special. The pasta is okay. Out dated style on the inside. Some old guy was cursing a lot; not too child friendly... Was pretty dirty inside. Prices are high for the food quality they serve.
yummy game day wings
You can't go with having lunch or dinner at Carmine's, just make sure to come with a few people, everything is served family style.

Honestly, I've had better burgers in other places in and around Philly. But they can make a pretty decent chicken sandwich and a nice cookie-skillet dessert. Other than that, nothing else to really write home about.

So a fun story.  Had just moved into the city and my roommate made some spare keys for the apartment.  I took one in my armband and ran along chestnut and walnut at night since it's pretty well lit and even has cops on the roads by the historic spots.  Well, after about 4 miles I ran back to our place to finish.  Turns out the spare key won't let me in the front door, and my phone died during my run as I had pandora playing.  It's also near midnight on a week day, so the idea of trying to pound on the door or yell for the roommate wasn't going to work.  I ran to a few bars looking for a phone charger, but only Jose pistola's was able to help... Even though I was in running clothes that I had sweat into.  Luckily I had a credit card on me, so I waited for my phone to charge so I could call the roommate, while enjoying a dirty martini right after my run, like any good runner should!  Excellent martini, more than friendly staff, and no problem charging my phone w a come as you are attitude.  Also found out that on Wed or Thurs upstairs is live music.  Note, bathrooms are on the third floor.
Worth the wait. Small and had to wait outside in the cold. However the best Italian food I have ever ate. Needs to be a little bigger and more room. However well priced and superb quality!!

Food looks and smells great but the only problem is the wait.  We're told when we came in it would be 20 minutes but it is now an hour an fifteen. We have asked to speak to manager but haven't seen him yet.  If coming definitely make a reservation the day before.

food is good, service so so bcoz busy ,I finished all my food then the squid appetizer on last minute put on my table ,it's fine  but I don't like the waiter automatic put the 18% tips on my bill, I been there many time ,this is 1st time automatically put tips on my bill

This used to be my favorite place to order. I literally order the same two things and the price alternates all of the time. So one day I asked the cashier why was the price different from last time and his response was "I dont make up the prices in the computer, if you dont want it then dont pay for it"  I asked for a manager and explained what just occurred and he said that sometimes whoever is on the cashier may ring it up differently. Never once did he apologize about how his employee responded and me. This is unacceptable in all aspects. I stopped eating from there for awhile after that. Recently, I ordered a Chicken Caesar wrap for delivery and it came with NO CHICKEN! I dont know what has happened to city view on Cecil b. Moore but the service is at an all time low! I will no longer be supporting this location.
Slowest service imaginable. Takes 10 minutes minutes to get a beer. 40 minutes for food.

Met a few dear friends on a rainy cold Wednesday night in December for a bite. The owner Valther with a V, greeted us warmly and seated us as requested near the window.  We were a party of three in total. There was only one other rather large party of 10 or so in the entire restaurant.    For appetizers we had a delicious and delicate Eggplant dish, also a fresh mozzarella platter and the muscles in white wine sauce all scrumptious.  For the main course I had the short ribs.  They were fabulous.  My friends had the lasagna and the chicken scarpielo.  All were extremely pleased.  For desert I ordered a pannatone bread pudding which was exquisite.  We also had a unique lemon tartufo which were both home made and wonderful.       This is a BYOB as an added bonus.   I will be returning here early and often- Enjoy

What I loved about this truck is the amount of food for the price. For about 6-7 dollars you get a whole bowl of food with some bread. The white sauce is what makes the meal. That sauce is like heaven in your mouth. And the spicy sauce is SPICY!!! I can usually handle the spice but this sauce was hot. I think this place lives up to all its hype and is worth it if your in the New York area. I want to go back.
I like the Taco here.. I have been many times and always find things better..

Really great noodles in pork soy sauce. They give you a large portion and these are really fresh. A clear standout in Philly Chinatown and a good choice for a stop near Reading Terminal Market. You could even bring the noodles over to the tables in the market if you want the real Philly experience.
Food came cold Not authentic traditional Greek food. Souvlaki came with chips not fries. Salad not fresh. Disappointed.

The food here was pretty good and decently priced. I had the panang beef curry and my friend had a Thai salad. The ambiance is nice but the line to get in was incredibly long and the bar was overly crowded so we couldnt even enjoy a drink. I guess that's what I get for coming here on a Saturday night. We will definitely be back

Would have to say this is number two worst buffet....first off if u have kids and use a 10% off its not for the whole bill, only adult meals. Cuz kids are already at a discount. Really lame. Food was ok def not worth $15.99. Don't eat the yellow cookies or clear jello...nasty soap taste. Service was attentive. Overall def one star for effort. Save your money......

A great little place ... Slightly pricey though .... All food was prepared  freshly great fried calamari  and bruschetta too... Service was very attentive  and food was very good ... Can't ask for much more

Suzy's may have been a hit joint serving delicious and customer appreciative food when it just first opened, but it looks as though the quality of the restaurant as a whole had diminished. I remember coming here with my girlfriend 2 years ago and the place hot our plates and our pallets right on the spot! ...2 years later, we receive terrible service, specifically a careless waitress with a bad attitude, almost as if she was waiting for my table to leave. I was with my girlfriend, and our two little siblings, and we ordered curly fries with a rack of ribs. The ribs were chewy and the fries were not seasoned not cooked properly. And looking through other Yelp reviews , there is either a great inconsistency with the food not being bad on some days?... Or either being VERY consistent with serving awful food on most days. Only time will tell if this restaurant has what it takes to pull itself up again. Bad service. Awful food. One star. Bottom Line.

Great coffee, wifi (ask for the password), with big floor to ceiling windows, but open doors during the summer to keep you tied to the city outdoors if you want to stay out of the sun to work on your laptop.  Didn't have any food but it smelled great.

There are at least 25 pizza restaurants in Bayonne NJ. Many of them create great pies. However, one clearly stands out. Denapoli's Krispy Pizza not only makes incredibly delicious pies their prices will astound you. When you get the bill you will swear that you went back in time to the 1980's Large pies are $9 and there is a special deal for pick up only, of two pies for $15. Everyday you can buy an oversized slice of pizza  and a can of soda for only $2.25. But enough with the prices. The pies are not too thin or too thick. They will also make any thickness you may ask for. You will never see a burnt pie and though I usually do not eat the crust of most pizzas the crust at Denapoli's is always crisp and never soggy. Only the best ingredients are used. Homemade dough and sauce with actual pieces of real tomatoes can be found in all of their pizzas  You will think you ordered a pie with extra cheese as their is always plenty of fresh Grande mozzarella spread across each pie. Finally, don't forget trying their sandwiches. They are large in size,great in taste and also ridiculously low in price. Go to their restaurant located between 31st and 32nd streets on Broadway in Bayonne. You will never want to go anywhere else. 10 Stars. SM

Never go here! I forgot my credit card and they charged almost $200 days later. When I called they hung up on me twice. Horrible customer service and not worth your money. I was really nice about it since I canceled my card I wanted to only let them know that it was being used fraudulently at their restaurant and they plain out hung up on me while I was explaining. All he said was "well that is weird" and then beeeeeep. You don't want to eat somewhere where they do this to their customers... smh
One of my favorites restaurants so far. All the food is amazing, the service is amesome and the price is very nice. Totally recomended!!!

It is hard to find something decent near the Penn station so we were happy to find this place. Fast service and great lunch option, we enjoyed our meal and made it back to the station to catch the train on time. Definitely a go if you are looking for a good meal in the area. Service was very nice and fast. Place is very quiet inside so you can enjoy the conversation.

This restaurant has amazing food and service. There were only a few things that made me really regret going here. One of them was the fact that all the employees were dressed upscale casual, except one which had cheetah print yoga paints and a rainbow colored crazy shirt and as a manager of a restaurant that didn't sit well with me. Another thing that really threw me off with that place, just take a look up and you will see at least an inch of dust caked on the ceiling fans.

Great Thai for very reasonable price, especially for NYC. Cocktails were $6 and beers for $3, can't beat that! The atmosphere was great for a date or just a dinner out with friends! Would recommend! Take a couple blocks walk and get away from Times Square!

Came in here over the weekend since I saw a few good yelps. Ordered the Fettuccine Bolognese and was not impressed. For starters, the service is less than mediocre. It's okay to not be Italian if you are serving, but seriously, at least learn your menu, and accommodate your customer. We asked for a large soup, so that we could share, the very dismissive Ecuadorian server quickly told us no, it cannot be shared, and that the soups are only served in one large bowl. Little does he know that pasta faccioli soup can indeed be shared, and it's best served in a smaller bowl. While we waited for our food, after 50 minutes it arrives, only to see that fettuccine alla bolognese, was served in a medium dark brown sauce and not the traditional red. The meat was undercooked and the taste of this plate was simply gross. It was almost like seeing one of those most unrepresentable beef stroganoff that you can buy in a box at your nearest super market. I was really disappointed, server not once came by to the table to offer anything further. The customer service was not there, however, the owner was, yet not checking on his customers as he should. I give it 1 start for the location, needs lots of work, perhaps it works for those who do not know Italian.
Love this place. Awesome atmosphere great service as well as tasty Margarita.  Food was very good little pricy but for the time it's money well spent.
Get the crab fries.

Came here a while back, but wanted to share my pleasant experience. Went for an anniversary dinner. Ordered the sauteed calamari- surprisingly it was very good, would go back for this tasty appetizer. Had the New York Strip steak- cooked perfectly and very yummy. We also ordered the lobster- also very good. The wait staff were really nice and friendly. No complaints would go again.
We were looking for somewhere to go on a Monday night, followed the reviews and ended up here. It was fantastically lively, with a great conversationalist (Robert) on the door and divine cocktails.

My boyfriend and I have been loyal customers for over a year, as the dishes have always exceeded our expectations. I would recommend this place over Pho Dang and Pho Hong, as their portions are generous (especially the noodle soups and rice dishes) and affordable (between $6-9 for an entree). If you are trying this place for the first time, I recommend any of the noodle soups (the wonton noodle soup is my boyfriend and I's favorite!), dumplings, lo mein dishes or fried rice dishes. The lo mein and fried rice dishes are safe bets for those who enjoy these dishes in other Asian cuisines. Quick tip: The small portions of the noodle soups, lo mein, chow mein and fried rice dishes are incredibly generous -- you may likely have leftovers! The ingredients are fresh, as the owner of the restaurant also owns a market across the street, and the kitchen is located behind the counter, so you can watch your dish being made. The limited seating may deter some people, but it is well worth the wait. As someone who grew up in New York City with an abundance of Vietnamese restaurants around, this restaurant does an excellent job of making comparable authentic Vietnamese dishes.

Host/owner was not friendly at all. He was cocky and did not pay much attention. Did not feel welcome. HINT: if you have a "complete party seating" only policy at least offer the first ones in a drink while they wait for the others and don't let them standing in the door with their coats on. The space its accoustics was distracting. The door let too much cold in when new people came in. The food was reasonable however lacked inspiration and taste. For example, a dish with foie gras should at least taste like it. Overall the experience did not meet expectations and did not justify the high price. It is not likely that I will ever go there again.
The portions are huge and the food is friggin fantastic!

I am still gagging thinking about the brunch I had here the other day. And it wasn't "just my dish" because my sister also said her food was not good. Before I go on, I must note that our waitress was very pleasant, attentive and sweet. Here's a breakdown: I ordered the "baked eggs" which was explained to be baked eggs in a tomato and hollandaise sauce with spinach which also came with grilled bread. I was thinking "hmm, sounds like shakshuka, yum!" Wrong. The entire thing was basically like eggs Benedict soup. The grilled bread was stuffed underneath the eggs so it had become entirely soaked in the mushy, soupy mass which was hiding underneath the eggs. Once the eggs broke, the soupiness continued and I literally could not eat it, I was so disgusted. My stomach is literally churning just thinking about it. The other issue I had was basically nothing on the menu was vegetarian, although they were able to adjust accordingly. Sorry, EV, it just wasn't good!! Maybe add some texture to the baked eggs, or keep the bread on the outside? Not sure.
Love this place! Hip, hip, hip!! Try those awesome Soju cocktails with the awesome bartender:) neighborhood gem!

My only regret is that I did not write this review sooner. I, until very recently, lived in Rahway for 11 years. I have been to Beanas dozens of time over those 11 years and have never had a bad meal; my go to being the Enchiladas Don Verde. But, anything I have ever had there, anything that any of my dining guests have ever had has always been great; from the salsa to the last bite. The food is always very fresh and well prepared, even the take out (the few times I did not dine is) holds up well and they always make sure that you have plenty of chips and salsa with the take out as well. Sure, the place has a kitschy look, but that adds to the appeal! The service overall is great, always has been, welcoming and attentive! If you are looking for something similar to Jose Tejas, or QDoba, etc. you might be disappointed as this is not that for sure; it's well above the macro packaged stuff that you'd get elsewhere.

House of Kabab now has a new owner.  The new owner used to run Asia Grocery, a halal meat place in Lake Hiawatha. We have been faithful customers in Lake Hiawatha for almost 14 years. Never disappointed. We went to House of Kabab last night (new name and new menu soon). The experience was wonderful. The food is so fresh and tasteful. A genuine family restaurant where you will feel really welcome. This is a place you really want to go back to if you like a friendly experience and great food. Btw, the butterfly chicken dish was absolutely great, as was the rice and bread. You should go there.

Seriously, no one in Bayonne should ever order from Fontana's ever again. They messed up my order and I've been waiting over 45 minutes for them to come and fix it. When I called to complain the owner answers the phone and tells me she has no driver, that I need to just wait until they get around to bringing the order back, and HUNG UP ON ME. I called back to say I don't even want the food I just want a refund, and she hung up AGAIN. Never again. Ever.

If you plan on eating from here. DO NOT ORDER FOR DELIEVERY! I have be for over an hour and a half. When I called, they said I have to wait ANOTHER 20 - 35 mins! I can understand if they were busy but they didn't not mention that on the phone. I suggest you Don't Order From This Place. They service stinks! Very unprofessional! And you PATIENCE MUST BE EXTREMELY GREAT!

Great place. Its so crowded but the place reminds me of family. I love being surrounded by the authentic food and being able to browse food products that I haven't had since I was a child. This place is great for anyone but especially anyone who appreciates authentic Italian food.
deliver on time.. food is good too.i have tried chicken with cashew nuts and it was good.

I was never to the former location, but the new location is nice, welcoming. It's better than just a diner; the food overall is fresh, solid, good portions. The prices are very fair, the service overall very good; the are attentive but not pushy, fill your coffee back up as it empties. Overall, consistently solid.

I really want to like this place as we have enjoyed the burgers in the past.    Figured it was a Sunday - 1/2 price burgers- how can you go wrong.  Well- the football crowd was cursing, loud and obnoxious.  Never once did the bartender or manager remind them people were eating- as well as a child was present.    (There was a large table of elderly people in the back which I am sure were appalled.). Waited about 15 minutes for menus.   Ordered 2 appetizers and burgers.  We were there for about 45 minutes had to wave and yell for someone's attention to get  drinks.  all the food came at once- including the appetizers.  Unfortunately, after that long wait and having the appetizers served with the meal, you can imagine how surprised we were to find all the food was cold.   My son had a burger with avocado- which was so old it was black.  Asked for the fries well done- they barely hit the oil.  Sent them back and they never returned.   Service was terrible- food was sub standard and crowd was vulgar and loud - it is after all an eating establishment and not a frat house.   There was no reason for the vulgarity to be screamed across the bar.   Sadly, as much as I want to give this place in carteret a chance as I like to support local establishments - until the owners take some pride in their food, train their staff (the staff changes regularly except for one nice man named Nelson) and do a little crowd control so that families feel welcome- they are doomed.

The atmosphere and ambiance is really nice. I went on a Monday night with my coworkers and it had a decent amount people. The menu is a little confusing and servers are really helpful. The food was tasty.
The music got so loud toward the end of the night that you couldn't even hear it. Over all, fail.

Have been to this restaurant several times.  The food is always consistent and the service is always good.  But this day, the service was incredible. Our waiter Michael answered all our questions, made suggestions to us from the menu....Everything you want from a server.  Went back a few days later and asked for him to wait on us, but unfortunately for us, he wasn't on until later that night.  Its so nice when you food is great but it all comes down to the server. I don't care how good your food is, when the service is great, you keep going back.....So kuddo's to you Michael....because of your incredible service, we are permanent customer's of Cafeteria...

Good food decent service. Good beer selection.  Even though they gave me a bud light instead of a kona. An I called them out and they still try to play it off as a kona I'm a beer expert I know the difference. I watch them pour another bud light into it an say it was kona again. Other than that excellent place.

I dined here on Monday, December 22, 2014, with my husband and 10 year-old child.  We came in about 9:05 pm.  We ordered our food at about 9:20 pm and it arrived at table at 10:10 pm.  The restaurant was about 10% full.  So the service was atrocious, and made much worse by a derisive waiter.  I had the temerity to complain at about 10:00 pm that the food was taking a long time.  He not only did not apologize, he said I should write my name down for future visits to let the chef know I required unusually fast service!!!! Whoever is managing this joint (at least on this night) should be fired, as should the offending waiter.  The food, actually, was quite good (hence the second star) but the service was laughable, offensive, and maybe close to the worst I've had in my life.
I am vegan...but when I pass Artichoke on 14th St, you better believe I stop and get a slice!

We had an excellent dinner here last week. The menu offers something for everyone. The Farmers Salad is yummy. We each had burgers that were large and tasty. The portions are very generous, the service is terrific, and the atmosphere makes for an upbeat vibe without being overwhelming. We will be back on our next trip to NY.

Great place to catch up with old friends. The drinks are awesome and the ambiance is energetic. The food was ok, I liked the corn on the cob but this place is more about the ambiance. I would return for the drinks and corn on the cob. A fun vibe for friends.

Godshall's Poultry  is the best I had ever tried at Reading terminal they get five stars from me. I have a Christmas breakfast every year for my friends and family.  The only place I go is Reading terminal to Godshall's poultry. My family would have a fit if I didn't go there to get the breakfast meats. I get the turkey bacon, turkey apple sausages, turkey links, Maple sausages and the ground sage. This has been a request for over 20 years. Thank you guys for your consistency.  It makes my Christmas the best.

Perfect place to have good drinks[A+ for drinks] and eat good food [Bartenders actually listen to your problems lol]. kickass happy hour until 10pm. Although I love this place, if you don't get there before 8:30-9pm on Thurs, Fri, Saturdays, don't bother going there will be nowhere to sit or stand. BUT as soon as happy hour is over at 10pm people start to leave and more space opens up.

ABSOLUTELY one of the least satisfying meals I have ever had in Manhattan. The food was flavorless, no salt, garlic, or even onions to bring out the flavor. Two fish dishes and a chicken mole and a quesadilla all pretty tasteless, and the  shells were left on the shrimp. When the waiter asked " How was everything" I shrugged my shoulders and said OK with a negative face, and he replied "good!" That says it all. The margaritas were good however.

In restaurant now. Two chances to talk to Bobby flay and both times he turned and walked away. So as of now his facade on tv is fake. If it changes will keep you posted. Keeping u posted he sat bar talking to two chick wouldn't even look up. And chicken was raw. My last encounter with this tv chef. Thanks...........balwag2….......go elsewhere
There's always a line outside, but it moves fast! Just get the most popular dishes and you Won't get disappointed! Cash only; tips is included in your bill!

For a locals bar, it was cozy.  Not upscale but a nice place for a few drinks (don't go exotic) and appetizers, burgers, etc. We got to meet the owner (seems the whole family works there!) and they were super friendly and nice to chat with.  I'd go back.
Went with a big party. Nothing bad to say and the food was OK.
Visited for brunch yesterday- friendly staff and great service. We had the French Onion Soup, Madame Croquet, and Steak and Eggs, the dishes were delicious and prepared very well.

I Never dined in here but we order for pick up all the time because i work nearby. We usually get their BBq Chicken and split it between 1 or 2 people because it comes with fries and rice. I want to say this place is great but they aren't too consistent, it is like 50/50 sometimes because we use this place a lot for birthday parties at the office or just when we forget our lunch. their BBQ chicken is Awesome when they make it moist, but it taste shitty when it is dry. i wish they would just put extra sauce on top all the time when they cook it. The other stuff i thought was pretty good was their streak and eggs, it came with potato chips which was nice. other than that, their okay.

This food was decent but the building itself was decrepit and should be condemned. I dont know who their landlords are but i plan to find out. I didnt want my daughter eating their food after i saw the bathroom and the kitchen. Completey filthy...update..it it run by a starrs inc and a co pany named biscuitts inc that have since gone out of business out of new haven. Landlord is deana reichentahl

The stars are only for the convenience and hours. Ordered delivery of Grub Hub and they forgot my garlic knots and the pizza and wings were cold. The food was nothing to talk about and not something i would seek out.

Small, family-run spot perfect for a quiet brunch. Visited for the first time and all three of us left happy. The "Elvis" waffles were fantastic. Crunchy fresh bacon pieces atop waffles with peanut butter, maple syrup and powdered sugar. The veggie omelette was a nice surprise. Chef included collards and pickled onions which gave it a twist and made it stand out. Fresh-pressed coffee rounded brunch out nicely. It's a tiny place (10 seats) and very laid back. Service wasn't fast or as attentive as you might find elsewhere, but it didn't detract too much from the experience. We'll look forward to going again.

without rolf being there this place is a disaster. hbexpress is even worse. it all used to be so good and still is if you buy it from rolf on the street. long waits and unknowledgable staff plague this joint.

After a visit to New York City and hearing much praise about this wonderful new bakery I just had to check it out! I was presently surprised about the politeness of the staff and the amazing quality of the food. The quiche and salads were fresh and delicious and those desserts.....I even went back to take some more to go! Place was perfectly decorated and was enjoyable to spend time in. Well worth every penny this place and we will be back for sure
Very great place. Awesome food.  i recommend everything on the menu!!!!!!!

After reading some reviews and seeing the photos, we came here last week on Thursday for my birthday dinner at 8:30pm. The decor was simple and pretty, and you get a great view of the Manhattan skyline. We ordered Chorizo Mac & cheese to start which we finished the moment it touched the table. Our entrees were all very delicious and well done. I recommend you getting the Pernil, Churrasco & Pollo a la Plancha. The bad: The wait for our entrees took about an hour or so. Our waitress Alexis checked up on us a few times throughout the wait and updated us on when our food would be coming but it was hard to flag anyone down in between if we wanted refills on water or to order extra appetizers. She was very sweet and accommodating so I'm not going to hold it against her for the lack of service. The restaurant just seemed understaffed for the amount of people seated. I wanted to like it because they are in such a great location and the food + drinks were delicious. Not sure if I want to come back again.

This place was great. Good prices incredible food. Got the ancho Chile burrito and the steak tacos for take out. The owners are probably the nicest small business owners I have ever met. They even have a nice little private room in the back that seems good for draft parties etc. Also try the limemade. It is all natural and hand made and ridiculously good. Would definitely go back
Amazing food. Love the octopus & lobster.
Best beef chow fun and fried dumbling!!!!  Not a good place for Dim sum it's very limited.
If you don't get the pretzels with beer cheese and Christmas beer yur stoopid! Really really really tasty

I hope my negative experience was just an off night.  On their nightly special menu, I ordered the Anolini with Butternut Squash.  No price listed, I asked how much, $18.95 I think, and asked specifically what kind of sauce it has.  Response: butter and sage sauce.  Not a word about asparagus.  Instead, it came out with a broth sauce and pieces of asparagus.  No butter and sage sauce, and no sage anywhere in sight.  And the asparagus was perhaps the poorest choice to accompany butternut squash I could think of, and it tasted just that bad.  My husband gave me his taglierini bolognese, which unfortunately was also a let down, the pasta tasted like the water didn't even have salt in it. One of the worst parts was also the table we were given was in their covered little outdoor area - not only was it cold, every time the door opened it was freezing.  My husband was trapped against the wall, and I was sitting on the side of the table, not across from him, because that's how they set up the table and there was no room even for that arrangement.  It's really only a table for 2 little kids, not adults, it was that small and cramped.  The couple in the only other table in this very narrow row was so on top of us that the woman flipped her hair and it touched my food.  My husband was so uncomfortable.  Super awkward. We asked the hostess if there was another table, and we were told there was an hour wait for another table. I've eaten here once before years ago and remembered it being great, so hopefully this was just an off night, but one that was poor enough of an experience that I couldn't see myself giving it another try any time soon.  Supper, if you're reading this, you can do so much better!

Visited this place in the summer during my internship in the city. Was craving for Pho so I decide to visit this restaurant since my friend in NYC said it is the best around. It was the worst $10 spent in my entire life. Never again will I try Pho in the East Coast. I heard so many bad reviews from my West Coast friends but I still tried it anyway. Bad mistakes. This place serves pho soup that smelled like Chloride bleach, either it was the bowl or the soup I couldn't tell but I didn't finish the soup after 2 bites. I decided to drink the rest of my Vietnamese coffee since it  was a little edible. Still can't believe that this place still opens and manage to keep their business in the middle of Manhattan. Either we, the West Coast people, are picky about our Pho or East Coasters just don't know what good Pho is.
Great pizzas fun menu! I enjoyed the toppings and the flavors. Not a huge fan of the crust but I am picky. Would go again.
I love this place. I eat here about 2 times a week. Always delicious and friendly. Great place
Good for traditional Japanese but staff is rude.   They talk down to you if you are not familiar with the menu.

BYOB and delicious Indian food, score! Very pleasant atmosphere and decent service. Convenient location and always full which is a good sign that what you are eating is A. authentic-ish and B. Delish!!

If I could give this diner no stars, I would. I have been here multiple occasions and every time I have been disappointed. Between oily soup, burnt mozzarella sticks and just plain grease lathered tasteless "panini" sandwiches which weren't even pressed...

Hidden gem in the heart of a neighborhood whose only other options are pubs or tourist traps. Great beer and wine selection and solid food. It's a long bar so you can usually find a stool or at least a little room to call your own. Will keep coming back.

The service was non existent.  After taking our order the waiter disappeared and the food took a really, really long time.  The waiter said it wasn't his fault, and the manager could not have cared less. The food is not good enough to justify the bad attitude.
Best Thai food I've ever had. It's a small spot. You have to get the Jungle curry fried rice. Amazing
Love the atmosphere of this place. Food is great and so is the service. I always get the fried calamari and its always good. There is also seating outside in the summer.
I was served a raw steak.  Enough said.
Always great food! This is one of the few places I recommend people go to when they are in Philly and I often take friends whenever I have the chance. It's a staple for my boyfriend and I.

My go - to place whenever I have visitors from different states. Very delicious food and service isn't too bad  This place is a good spot to bring a big group of friends and/or a nice place to have lunch date with your beloved!
2 donuts , small and a large coffee  for $9 ? Beiler's Donuts at Reading terminal market have better and cheaper donuts .

Been here since its opened and  I wont stop going here anytime soon. Great for a date or even take out food. It cant get any better than this. If you go here, you have to make sure to ask for Jose, he is the best!

I've been a frequent customer for the past two years, willing to overlook some shortcomings because I liked the concept, the commitment to healthy food and the experimentation with different ingredients/flavors. But the quality is inconsistent, the food isn't always fresh and everything is overpriced. While I like knowing the frittatas are made with fresh eggs, I'm really mad when I get egg shell in almost every one I buy.

soup to nuts Lorraine, 5 stars!! great location. love the seafood. taste so good. these people here know how to feed ya... kept eating for about 2 hours 45 minutes. pasta, bread, fish, wine, desserts, coffee...stomach felt good after that meal...

I always eat too much when I come to Terri. Got to have one of those huge pastrami on rye with a lot of deli mustard. Potato knish and one of those crunchy skined hotdogs with sauerkraut. I spend a lot of money here but boy is it worth it.

Got here early on a Sunday and didn't have to wait at all. We had the pork belly buns and chicken wings as appetizers and both were amazing. Got to the Ramen and was only slightly impressed. Not sure what the whole deal is but I definitely would not wait in line for the noodles, no line would be another story. My biggest complaint was the level they played their music. It was deafening for us, I couldn't understand why none of the employees were wearing earplugs. I guess when you are that much in demand, you want to turn tables around fast and rush people out. That must be how they do it.

We've ordered from here a few times. For some reason they can never get our order right (it's always missing a main dish and no one picks up the phone for 30 min). When they send back the remaining order, they messed it up again. Wouldn't recommend ordering from here.

Pretty disappointed. Read the reviews, saw the ratings and bypassed several places along the way. Bread was stale (even out 7 year olds asked if it was old bread) Pasta was chewy, which makes sense since they told me it is all pre-prepared. We wanted to add pancetta to some spaghetti and they just couldn't handle it. No kids drinks, other than soda, no kids menu. Atmosphere was relaxed and casual, which was nice. Service was ok, right on average I'd say, nothing to criticize, nothing to write home about.  Overall, very so so, not worth their rating in our opinion.

Food is good but I want to share my experience about dealing with the manager here, a middle age man with a beard. He was quite rude. He asked us to go to the table next to him because he saw me waving my hand to him telling him table for two, and he response with the v gesture by his hand. Right at the second we got to the table he said table for two over there and point at the table where we we're stand next to when we just got in. So I told him you just asked me to come over and he goes I talked to the other gentlemen and the waitress not talking to you. But how come he saw my and response with the hand gesture of table of two? Why you like to argue with customer so much? As a manager you may just say something nice and make the customers happy again. With this kind of experience, I would not come to this place again, even the food are good here, unless they change this unfriendly manager. Watch out guys

This place is completely unprofessional and rude.  The Hostess during the early evening and afternoon is snotty, obnoxious and down right mean.  She must be putting on a different act in front of the managers.  i sent my daughter there at the request of their fellow restaurant for a server position.  Upon arrival the woman said "DON'T COME BACK UNTIL 330! THE MANAGER WILL BE IN THEN" and gave her application to fill out.  She didn't even get a chance to tell the hostess who told her to come.  So my daughter waited outside for 30 minutes until 3:30.  When 3:30 came around, the hostess grabbed the application and said "Hes in a meeting he cant see you".   Regardless of your profits, think more about being kind to others...It's disgraceful and distasteful.
Wanted an authentic Philly Cheese Steak and that's exactly what we got! So delicious and very fast. Highly recommend.
Very good food, reasonable price, great customer service!!

When we came here a few weeks ago at about 6pm, we were told the wait time was 1.5 hours.... and we walked out since we had other plans later that night. Yesterday we got here around 4pm, the wait was about 30 mins, not too bad. The service was adequate and the ramen broth is as good as it could be. We ordered chicken Hirata buns, Shiromaru Hakata Classic with egg, Karaka-men (spicy version). We were told the chicken Hirata buns are spicy and we asked for sauce on the side.

This place is good! And the staff is very nice and attentive. I've ordered take out and sat down for lunch, and it's only been open for 2 weeks.  You can't go wrong with the pad thai or the massaman curry. Well worth a visit.
Nice atmosphere and the service is good.  I love their margaritas and happy hour specials.  My fav dish is the combinations with Chili rellenos.  I look forward to going back this weekend.
Good food; obsequious waiter; intense hostess speaking loudly and desperately into the phone.

Really good pizza nice and crispy and they have foxon park soda which is a major plus. But the place is in need of a remodeling seems run down. They can probably have sell out crowd if they went to a nicer location and fixed the place up.
Grate place, delicious food, excellent service, tasty sea food, friendly staff, prime location, value for money, big food variety.

Where to start Best Breads in CT or in all of US. The pizza is really good. This place has been a staple in the New Haven County Pizza industry for years. Not many people do it better. It would be nice if they moved location  to make a sit down restaurant cause they would sell out. There service is great you feel like it's your family. Max the cook or the brains behind the operation always makes you feel like your family. That is why I will always point people in the direction of this hometown landmark! Keep up the good work guys and gals (lady's at the register)! I forgot to mention the steak and cheese it's amazing!
great great food, great prices....just good times
Moved to 32 on west 32 street!!!! Great place. Nice atmosphere. Soup was very tasty and big. Chicken pot was very special. Restrooms quite clean.

my friends and I went for a 2 hour bottomless brunch. $20 for an entree and unlimited drinks was an unexpected and awesome deal. the food was solid and Italian themed with quality ingredients and generous portions. side note: they refilled our drinks nonstop. we couldn't even keep track of how many we had. we will definitely be back!

We celebrated my dad's 70th birthday here and it was a perfect evening. We had a large group of 22 and the service was great. The staff was very attentive but not overly so. The food was excellent. We ordered fried calamari, clams oreganata, mozzarella kisses and the spedino and everything was delicious. In our group, we also had 2 people with shellfish allergies and 2 with a gluten allergy and they took care in their preparation of everything. I would definitely go back and highly recommend it.

We are avid patrons of Fogo. DC, Baltimore, Atlanta and Philadelphia. For about five years now, our service at all of these locations has been impeccable; until last night (Sunday 12/21). We were seated in a far back corner. Water and drinks took over 15 minutes to arrive, and once we received our pao, it was cold. Unacceptable! It took entirely too long to be visited by our waitress the entire night, and old food plates were left sitting in our tables. Overall disappointing experience. We've been on Saturday nights which were way busier and received better service.

Excellent Food ! We eat here often and love the food and the people, Try the Chicken Saltimbocca , garlic shrimp, Pasta w/Eggplant, Chicken Francese-get plenty of bread cause your going to want to dunk-great sauces! Make this your next stop for food!

Ordered online for pickup, two salads with pulled chicken.  Picked up food with receipt that indicated salads with chicken.  Got to home to find two salads with zero chicken.  How could their food prep overlook that particular ingredient, seeing as how BBQ meat is the whole point of the place?
Coworkers clued me on this place an I am HOOKED!!!  The food is fresh, the service is fast, and the food is yummy.  Enough said! Oh, and the prices are reasonable.

Ate here on Saturday night and the food was decent. Boom boom shrimp and fried pickles as appetizers and a turkey reuben for dinner. The waitress was kind of flaky. She didn't have any of the specials memorized and just told us to look at what the guy next to us was eating.....ummmmmm ok...the food also came out way too quickly after the apps and the dessert menu pages were all stuck together so we didn't bother to look at it. ICK. My boyfriend and I decided to come back on Sunday to grab a bloody mary and watch football. We got up to the bar and there were two empty seats and an empty table top. We were told we couldn't sit because the seats were reserved. Seriously????? I've never heard of a bar doing this. They completely lost our business. I didn't realize empty seats make money....
Delicious!  The whole veggie sandwich was wonderful but the cilantro aioli was particularly amazing.

I love love love this place. Everything about this place is great. I love the decor, atmosphere, and food. You can never go wrong with what you order. And they have awesome drink specials. Couldn't ask for a better place.

Our food was good but this place does not have an 'Irish Pub' or 'Sports' crowd plus none of the many television screens were on. The clientele is very young and the ghetto-ish hip hop music was WAY TOO LOUD which I am not into. Male bartender was a bit aloof but female bar maid was friendly. The funniest thing I saw there was several young Hasidic Jewish children running around the Christmas tree in the adjoining hotel lobby.  Anyway, I guess it's okay for the locals but I doubt we'll go back.
The panini's are big and filling. Delicious. Avoided this place for a while because its a decent walk from my apt but ill be going back
CnR is the best.  Don't get imitation Halal.  GET HALAL GUYS!!!!
Great soup dirt cheap. I had the oxtail hand drawn noodles my brother had the duck. It's like half a duck in a bowl of soup for 6 bucks. Also try their smoothies!
I don't know how this place got 4 stars. Souvlaki was served with flavorless burnt chicken. Not sure how you can mess up a simple traditional dish like that.

Kind of heartbroken over the changes here - so much less comfortable, cozy and neighborhoody. Agree with the other reviewer who said it feels more commercial. New chef not as good as the previous one, either. The turkey burger used to be unbelievably good - think it's still the same basic recipe but was overcooked, cheese practically burnt, and it came on some kind of bizarre bright yellow bun that was frankly disgusting. The new hightop tables and booths are super uncomfortable, and I saw some older regulars giving them the side-eye, not so happy that they would have to climb up there instead of just sitting at a table. Another West Village favorite ruined.

My husband took me here for lunch today. I'm a vegetarian and watch my calories but noticed the two vegetarian sandwiches didn't have calorie counts. Then I realized NONE of the calorie counts on sandwiches/wraps included the actual calories of the bread (wrap/roll/panini). So, I asked how many calories in a wrap and the answer "We don't actually know that" Ok, so it seems like it should be healthy, but if you add the calories from the bread or wrap to the calories for the stuffing, you are looking at high calorie items that don't seem too healthy anymore. I chose to have the two egg and cheddar cheese on a whole wheat wrap (297 calories without the wrap calories added in). There was no way there was 2 eggs in it, and I'm pretty sure they were not real, they looked and tasted imitation (and no salt or pepper to be found) and the cheese looked like a slice of american cheese and didn't taste like cheddar. The eggs were so hot I burned my mouth so I wonder if they were microwaved. My husbands wrap, soup and drink came out to 15 bucks, expensive. My egg wrap and water came out to 5 bucks, and my wrap was very tiny. He enjoyed his wrap and his soup did look good. My husband did say that they do have the best Frozen Yogurt he has tasted, so I guess that is one positive... I didn't try it myself.
First time visiting Vermont. Very family friendly with a great ambiance. I highly recommend the medicine wheel Flatbread. I'd say it's found a new place in my heart right next to Brooklyn Pizza!
Fantastic, innovative food. Awesome cocktails and drink list. Top notch staff. A must visit.
delicious!!! Market fish (mahi mahi) tacos, amazing!!! Great service, and excellent margaritas too! Love the decor, nice and charming!  Reasonably priced.

I got there and the hostess was very entreating while we waited to be sat. We chose the option to sit at happy hour on a Monday night. As I sat there I waited on a waiter for more than 15 mins. I gladly got up and asked for a manager to make a complaint but a server stopped me midway and asked what the issue was. I brought to his attention that I wasn't being attended to and he gladly sat me. Chris was a phenomenal waiter. Previously being in the restaurant industry I know what it is like to be a server and how guess are suppose to be treated. My dining experience got off to a rough start but Chris made my experience a little better when he served me. Thanks a lot Chris you were great :) - Jasmine
Love the gluten-free options here.  So many things to choose from (including desserts) and they even have gluten-free bread for the beginning of the meal.   Service has always been great.

The food was incredibly good and it was in a good street and we had a great peruvian breakfast ,the service was ok , have parking, I  don't  like the decorations looks little bit desorganising ...I'll come back definitely. ....

1st time here I would have given 4 stars. Nice enough decor, very good food slightly over priced. The linguini with sea scallops and chick peas was absolutely perfect. Pork shank and short ribs over mashed potato for our entrees were also very good. Loved the experience as a whole. Been back twice since, both times HORRIBLE. The pasta with scallops was mealy and starchy, tasted very strongly of fish. I ordered it a third visit and had the same awful result. I don't know if it depends on who's cooking but this pasta dish went from great to inedible. Had the pork ribs over fried polenta. Ribs were meh, very salty. The polenta tasted like it was fried in dirty oil. Was excited about this place after my first visit. Too bad they aren't consistent enough. The neighborhood needed a good small plate italian wine bar. This is definitely NOT it. Wont be going back.
I love coming to this place! So fun and the food and mojitos are great. Service is fast too.

Nice place to spend the afternoon downing Some good craft beer!  Chris is a good dude and the hotdogs are well, hotdogs!  I just got a plain one and was happy  with it,  my buddy got one with the works and liked it.  Great start to our pub crawl!
This place is absolutely amazing, the decor, the food and the ambience are all on point.

I've never been so over the moon regarding any restaurant ever whether quick-serve or sit down.  This place is most awesome!  The food is plentiful to say the least, delicious, wholesome and makes my tummy purr.  The staff is very attentive.  The manager I think his name is Steve is very professional and caring.  This nugget of gold that I found is my new go to place for the sheer pleasure of eating.  Jamie
Fun, comfort food spot.  cool décor.  The only Starr restaurant I would bring my kids to besides Parc.  Staff are very friendly and accommodating.  Mac and cheese is delicious.

Just ate lunch at nosh borough and it was awesome. Finally found a real nice place for ordering lunch. Will soon be back to try the rest of the menu. I thought I had to go to Brooklyn to get stuff as good.

We loved it.  A great neighborhood place.  Yes, the app list is a little all over the place, but that means there's something to certainly fit your mood.  I can back the ciao bella, and saltimbocca (a special at the time) pizzas.  Both were baked perfectly and loaded with toppings.  The italian burger and chicken parm sandwich were also delicious, served on fresh-baked buns.  Service was friendly.  The kids noodles w/ cheese were incredible - consider adding a variation to the main menu.
So good!!! Eat your salad the dressing is so good! Bar guy works hard, tables & bar. Plates are beautiful... Feels special since they didn't miss any details!!!

It is one star because of the service. When I asked more water because it was spicy, the waitress said "I am working" with angry face. I know you are working, but you do not refill the water? Is it part of your job? I waited another 6minutes more for water with fire mouth and it was not even busy. I will stay away from this restaurant.  There are a lot better Thai food around the neighborhood.

Overrated. Although the garlic sauce was amazing, the crawfish tasted ENTIRELY like the garlic sauce. There was not too much meat in either the crawfish or the crab, it took too much effort to get those tiny pieces of meat out. Might come back for the shrimp, but definitely not getting the crawfish/crab combo again.
Hands down the best restaurant I've ever been too! Make a reservation before hand! Service was amazing! Our waiter was Chris and he was phenomenal.
I love this place. Everything was great. The service, food, the freshly squeezed orange juice.. Just super small, but just adorable spot. And it's black-owned!! SUPPORT SUPPORT!!!!
A metropolitan restaurant, always crammed and a little bit impersonal, but with good seafood: try the lobster and steak special. Not cheap but not disappointing.
There's no place like home!xoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxox­oxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxoxo
Great pizza and great service. Reasonable price and a large pizza is enough for two people.

As a vegetarian, I'm forever in search of a desire-worthy antipasti plate and Barbuzzo delivers. They do a buzzing weekday lunch, and can get you in and out quickly if you don't have time for unlimited people-watching at the front table. Sitting at the bar is a fun experience for solo diners, as you can literally watch the fare being prepared right in front of you. The atmosphere is hip and the servers are young and friendly. The cocktails are delicious, but so are the house made juices and non-alcoholic spritzers.
Excellent food made from excellent
Quick, courteous service. Excellent, delicious food. Had the slow-braised short ribs, they were excellent.The Ricotta and Fig appetizer is incredible.awesome food. will be back for sure.
Portuguese BBQ at its best, and very reasonable prices! I love to take out from here, but recently discovered their dining room and we really enjoyed the flaming chorizo!
Wild Boar Ribs were amazing!
Ok we went here because everyone said this is the best cheesecake ever. Fail. It is the worst cheesecake ever!

I love their bello is and truffle Mac and cheese. I got the three Mac and cheese sampler and was obsessed!! Just wish they would combine the bacon and truffle Mac and cheese together. Overall amazing experience though, great vibes and attentive staff. Some unusual crowds but then again it's New York. Another plus is its open 24/7! Five stars

Great little dive bar with good food.  I ordered a cheeseburg and the doob wings which are their signature dish- and very good. Prices were a bit higher than I expected- service was fine.  Now I have to try their expansion location in Wallingford to compare to the original in North Haven.

The company email info@hardhatcafe.com was rejected People. Buy some hamburger. There are seven items on the menu for hamburger and you have been out of burgers for 4 days. Plus we have been waiting for hard hat north haven waffle fries since you opened. Two bars. Two companies. Sell them to each other.
This place is delicious.  Menu is kinda small but everything on it is awesome. It's not open a lot, closed on Mondays and they close up at 3pm. Good coffee, good ingredients, good food. Do it!

Both times I've ordered from this place it's taken over an hour to deliver...food is Ok but way too expensive for what it is. Also, I'm fairly positive the Cornish hen on the menu is really chicken. I will definitely not order from here again unless the prices are cut in half and then the quality will match the price.
I are there once and the setting was beautiful and foods was good.  I went there during restaurant week, so I ate there for cheap.

Although it did take quite sometime to get my food, it was definitely worth the wait. Also taking into consideration how packed it was, the waiters were very hard working and assuring us on the status of our meals along with the owners of the restaurant. The food selection was very affordable. We brought our own LQ that evening and the atmosphere of the karaoke DJ and those singing was absolutely entertaining. Looking forward to another evening here.

I can't believe people are saying their pizza is no good. Though I can't vouch for their stromboli, the pizza is amazing. Try the Brooklyn and you won't be disappointed. The only place I go to for pies nowadays...

Waiting time on the food took too long, waiters were very nice though... And as far as the food its self it felt too americanized im colombian so i know what im talking about lol... All in all it was ok

One of my favorite places to eat and shop in the City!  The fair trade organic produce market is a favorite of mine, in addition to the Dutch shops, tea and coffee stores.  They seriously have the best produce (greens) I have ever tasted.  They also carry grass fed organic milk in glass bottles at fair prices.

Don't do it. Stay away. Nothing but disappointment awaits. The secret is just take whatever they bring you, whether you really ordered it or not. So when they ask, "seabreeze?" but you really ordered a tequila sunrise, just take it- trust me.

We have dined at Varalli three times, most recently December 21st 2014, every time has been an excellent experience. The venue is well designed with plenty of tables next to the windows along two walls. The service is excellent with friendly and attentive staff.   The food is superb, the chef having an exquisite understanding of sauces. My favorite dish is Agnilotto Malanzane, a delicious ravioli. The mussel appetizer is also tasty. We paired the meal with a Marlborough, NZ Sauvignon Blanc, The Infamous Goose.   For dessert, try either the creme brûlée or the tiramisu, paired with an Irish coffee (made the correct way). A great place to dine with family and/or friends or to impress a date just before going to a show.

The food was good, place homey. Wasn't  impressed with the speed of serving food and getting bills. Been there more than once, and the best to be said about their service pleasantry and speed is one word: inconsistency.
My order came way after a lot of people who came after me, the food was not tasty at all, where are all the high reviews from?! Disappointed

I've eaten here quite a bit and the food and service are normally excellent. However, the service today was slow & poor at the bar. Took 1/2 to get water, no bread was offered at the beginning of the meal, no shredded cheese offered for my pasta dish and the bartender forgot about the dessert that I ordered. However other customers were well attended.  #cheesecakefactory #willowbrookmallnj
Coimbra is a great spot for Portuguese food in the Ironbound. The beef tongue is one of the best I've had anywhere. Portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable. You should go!
Great atmosphere for getting together with a group of friends or to show up at a bar. Excellent cheese plate and fantastic service too.

Delicious food - all the dishes were right. Fresh and rich ingredients, nicely seasoned salads and well cooked fish, with the swordfish being the king. Worth to mention as well is the service that was cheerful and good. Only thing to keep in mind is the likely long wait
Stopped in for a quick bite. A good amount of good quality food for a good price. The paucity of seating is an issue.

Amazing barbecue, best in Queens. Rib tips, mac n' cheese, pulled pork sandwich, cornbread... You name it, all quality food. Staff is super friendly, owners are always around chatting with the customers. Definitely a must-eat in Astoria. And now they have a new Butcher Bar venue right next door with a bar and a solid beer selection!

Sleek decor, good food (great variety) and very nice service.  I will definitely return.  We split two rolls, had edamame, and dessert; our check came to $36 with tip.  Glad that Doma is in the neighborhood.

Ignore russian sounding reviewers-- they compare to their own bad food or melancholy of horrible Soviet Union food.. This food tastes average, very high calorie and has no sophistication of service to rank so many stars.. They 'cooked the books on yelp' no other explanation.. Would give 1 star if drink rather than taste their vine- what is that?? It that a desert vine? Not really

This is a place to return to since the menu changes almost daily. Food is fantastic and not your every day fare. First came with my wife and split a striped bass. Came back a second time with friends and split some of the appetizers - pig croquettes,

I am absolutely in love! The atmosphere is laid back and relaxing, the owner is friendly and makes you feel at home ! First things first drinks are amazing! It's been a while since someone made me a good drink and let me tell you I had both the Grinch and the PomPom cocktails! Highly recommend ! Now the biggie! The turkey duck chicken meatballs are the bomb! And the hanger steak is the way to go! Everything is beautiful in appearance and taste amazing! One mistake I made unfortunately I didn't listen to the trio option of desserts ! 3 for $10 and it would of been worth it! 10 stars!
Fair price and I really enjoy the other place which is located in 21st and broadway ave.
Appetizers= normal portion sizes, on a tasty side. My issues is wine, not enough of it in the glass per serving and somewhat on  pricier than average price.
Taïm's falafel is unmatched anywhere else. Perfectly spiced and never dry, with all the toppings & sides. The red falafel is my fave, but all are yummy. Excellent smoothies, too!

Great little spot with natural, organic food (they said its all organic and it really tastes like it is), from the local farms, fresh and delicious. One of the cooks/counter people, Kay Kay made my steak avocado sandwich so tasty I felt like eating the wrapping paper it was wrapped in ;) Give this place a try. Other food that was served on the day I was there included a variety of Southern Style cuisine. The other guys had it and they were really enjoying every bite. Great to have a place like this in town!

The service alone were snobby and cold which made the whole experience unpleasant. Food was ok, nothing spectacular. Beautiful place and food presentation very nice. Other than that nothing special. I will not be back!

Don't listen to anybody talking out of their ass. Sally's is just the same as it ever was. Nothings changed the pizza is the best and the service, well the  Service is the service. Everyone that complains about the servers just doesn't get it. It's just a bunch of family friends retirees and old part timers. You're there for the best pizza in the world not the service if you want service go downtown yuppie.

Sure it's tasty, but not incredible. Definitely not worth the two hour+ delivery wait. It arrived an hour later than scheduled and both pizzas were cold. There was barely any basil on the Margarita. So disappointing. Going with Motorino's next time.

Love the vibe of this place - sit at the bar, chat and drink some excellent $4 beers. Decor is authentic seaport, food is great. Had the Mac 'n' cheese with sopressata and hotsauce - amazing! just what was needed to gear me up to go back into the slushy cold city...
Very high quality food and varied selection. The shrimp appetizer was spiced perfectly and the chicken entrée was very tender and flavorful. Everything exceeded expectations. Portions were large too.

This tour was excellent! I just created a yelp account so I could write a review. I live in Manhattan, and I had a great time. I would highly recommend it both to tourists and to locals. Fun for a date or with the whole family. Scott is knowledgeable, engaging, and fun. It's an awesome way to explore the city.
Simply the BEST coffee shop in Northern Liberties.  Customer service is top notch, unlike in One Shot.

I have to say, my first impression of Marco's was not very good.  However, my office just ordered two pizzas and they were phenomonal! Spot on! (and I am from NJ where we pride ourself on pizza) Absolutely delicious - will definitely be getting pizza from here again!!
Food was fine, and you could find some value on the menu. I was on expense account and didn't order cheap, but the whole time I felt I was treated indifferently. It's not like they were busy.

Incredibly lackadaisical wait staff. Service was insanely slow. One of our orders was incorrect. And best of all - we got to the table and the hot sauce on the table was completely empty. Were we in the middle of a joke? We had two children with us, so when we asked for the children's menu the wait staff said everything on the menu can be made for kids. Huh?
Awesome atmosphere and friendly staff. The Hamachi Tartar, Charred Octopus & Pumpkin Tiramisu are incredible.
Ekta is expensive but is still one of the best Indian spots in Philly.

Crappy Service... The woman attending must've had a bad day, but seriously don't take it out on the customer/guest.  Barely had a chance to be seated before getting bombarded by negativity and rudeness.  Probably a good place, but the immediate negative vibe from the witch was not congruent to a pleasant meal.

No gluten free options!!! Extremely rude waitresses! I understand Ny is not warm and friendly like Texas but c'mon now people. Since this is located in little Italy I figured I could grab a gluten free pizza from a new by place and would be able to have it with everyone at Lombardis. After explaining to the manager at Lombardis that I have gluten allergies and isn't the don't offer GF pizza would it be okay for me to bring my own. Their response was no!!! I was shocked and thoroughly disappointed. Will not recommend this place to anyone.
Just awesome! Tiny place, but the soup was amazing!

It is with a heavy heart that I write this review. I have lived in town for 17 years and have gotten my fish for Christmas Eve here for 17 years. Each year I know I spend more then I should on fish but I tell myself "it's a special meal and the fish should be the best" so I spend a little extra. Well, this year they outdid themselves. My order was 2lbs of cooked large shrimp, 3lbs cleaned raw jumbo shrimp and 1lb of seafood salad.......drumroll.......$215.00! Could not believe the price. This year was at least $70.00 more then last year and I ordered more last year! I left my order there on the table and told them they were ridiculous . Walked out empty handed, never to walk in again. They are taking advantage of the holiday. Shame on you Caldwell Seafood!

I don't have to go into detail, just read the other reviews.  Awesome, fast, cheap dumplings.  The sesame pancake was awesome too.  Definitely worth checking out if you're in near the area and want a cheap filling meal.
please ,do not even bother  to go this restaurant ,its food portion so small that we had go back home and eat again,do not waste your money, i do not recommend this restaurant .

Ambiance is great.  But, it may be that people are so desperate to experience a superior meal in this town, that they over rate The Pine.  The food is not exceptional, nor is the menu all that interesting.  My short ribs were dry and that was a bummer as I was looking to it, as were the vegetables on the side.  My other three companions said their meal was "good" but not "bravo" ..... Best to go for many fewer, but exceptional choices, which change every few months.
I was in the area last week and ordered the shrimp po boy for takeout. The sandwich was ready when I arrived and it was delicious. I recommend this place to anyone in the area.

One of the better Thai places around this area.  Has become a goto place for me in terms of Thai food for the Plainsboro area.  Their menu is not limited to the typical Thai dishes.  The service is quick and the food is on-point in terms of pretty much anything you order.  From Pad Thai to the variety of rice or noodle entrees to their specialty dishes, chances are you won't go wrong with whatever you decide to order.  My favorite is the Crispy Basil Chicken.  The proportion of the entree's are reasonable.   They don't have a free-refill soda policy, which is a bummer and probably the only issue I have with this place.
The lunch special is a bargain. Great portion sizes. Friendly/warm service. The lo mein, egg rolls, and fried dumplings are my favorite dishes.
I love pasta and I'm so glad we decided to eat here. My boyfriend and I love it! The ricotta and spinish ravioli was delicious! The bread was okay and I wish I had dessert.

Aside from the high prices I was a fan....until they went ahead and took just about everything that I loved off of the menu.  Fried pickles? Gone.  Breakfast Tacos? Noticeably absent.   I live a few blocks away but I definitely won't be visiting as much.  Shame.

the spaghetti was undercooked. The tomato sauce was tasteless. There were only two shrimps in the dish tho it was called 'seafood pasta'.
Fussy and unsatisfying dishes. Entrees such as the lamb roast or squid are overtaken by too many competing garnishes. Sometimes a slice of cheese and apple are all you need.

A+ = INCREDIBLE FOOD FAIL = INEXCUSABLY BAD SERVICE -- friend and I went here for (what we thought would be) a quick lunch, no wait and was quickly seated at a table in back of main dining room. Went at lunch time, around 1p, on a Tuesday (only one other table was filled and few at the bar) -- we haven't seen each other in years so we were chatting and catching up, then realised 15 minutes passed by and no wait staff has tended to us yet... so when the hostess sat a different table, we asked to place our order with her and apologised our waitress hadn't been over and happily took our food order -- food came out in very reasonable time + looked and smelled ABSOLUTELY SCRUMPTIOUS -- we ate and scarfed the food down it was so good -- as we finished our food, another party was seated next to us and the waitress tended to them, took their order, etc -- we tried to get her attention but she quickly ran off to submit their oder -- we waited another 10 or minutes, we gave up and decided to pay at the bar (no problem with that)
Really good grilled calamari salad, the polenta was excellent and the mussels as well!
Has a good window seat. Nice place for a date.

One of my absolute favorites.  Service, ambiance and décor make this a go to spot every chance I get.  Butternut squash ravioli are amazing.  Wine prices are extremely reasonable.  Definitely a place for date night.

I am just not a fan of family style restaurants. Especially when those restaurants offer such little gluten free items! Honestly, I am shocked that NYC has such little gluten free options to offer. Nice, family friendly, our waiter was super friendly and informative!!

Min Ghung is the best sushi restaurant in Glastonbury, the food is great! The sushi chef Ivan is the master, HE make me the best sushi in the entire world, Live scallop sushi that I never have, is so fresh; the Christmas Roll also good. The service just perfect. I will be back.

My wife and I enjoyed everything about this place. We're from NY and and we wished we had a place like this near us. The food was excellent and service great. The man who I believe was the owner spoke to us and was very generous. I would certainly recommend this restaurant to anyone.

This place has potential. The wait staff was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu and overall polite and helpful. My husband tried the curry night buffet and seemed to enjoy most of the items. Although, he was skeptical initially since the entire buffet area was quite small and it didn't seem like there was much to choose from. I was more keen on trying out the dosa so I ordered it from their menu. We took a samosa chaat appetizer,  which was good. For my main course, I ordered the onion rava masala dosa. When it came, it was very soft, undone, and stuck to my plate. The chutneys and sambar were very good though. But the fact that the dosa wasn't well made ruined the entire course for me. If only it were crispy! I know what a good dosa is... I am a South Indian and make them quite frequently for my family. I believe the chef is a South Indian, and therefore there is no reason why should have served it like this. I appreciated the owner making her way around the tables and asking everyone how their orders were. After some chit chat, I subtly mentioned to her that my dosa is very soft and stuck to the plate, since she asked for suggestions/ ways they could do better. However, she didn't really address the issue and rather casually thwarted off the topic. She insisted (a few times) that we hit a "like" on her restaurant page in Facebook. I know she wants to get the word out there, but first impressions are important! Overall, I think I would be willing to give this place another try, but probably not anytime soon. The next time I'm here and my dosa is actually well-made, maybe I will hit a like on their page!

My family and I go to first and last every year for my birthday. This year I was next to my table showing my parents photographs from a vacation I took and was rudely interrupted by an older waitress with red hair and a bow in her hair who told me to move out of her way and that I "needed to do that later". The 16 of us will likely not be returning to this location after being treated so poorly by a server.

Ever since it opened, this has been one of my favorite spots in Greenpoint; I just love the pizzas! They remind me of the pizza I enjoyed on my many trips to Italy...but better in a way, as the ingredients that top these pizzas are a delightful mix of the unexpected! The atmosphere is dark and romantic and you get your pizza right out of the brick oven that's on display. It's really nice that the owner is almost always there, and he stops by the tables to have little chats to make sure everyone's enjoying themselves. I highly recommend it.
This was a great slice of pizza very crunchy quintessential New York pizza greasy cheesy delicious
Nice place. I went there last night and the female bartender was very unfriendly and seemed to be frustrated with her job. Made me feel un welcomed

Had a great dinner last night. We ordered a lot of plates and everything was great. HIghlights that really sung: the pasta that looks like little witches hats with a veal ragu, the stella pizza, the really rustic gnocchi with oxtail. Also, we had a couple classics before we ate - a negroni and a gin martini- executed perfectly.

This is my favorite restaurant in town. Every single thing I've eaten there is amazing, the prices are very reasonable, and the portions are generous. The pork and clams might be my favorite, but you can't go wrong!

After reading the other reviews of this place, I think my positive experience was just luck and good timing. I have to say the front of the building is very unappealing, and I was expecting a dumpy interior. I was pleasantly surprised once I got inside. I went to Maggie's for a work lunch. We arrived right when they opened at 11:30 and were seated right away. Since they weren't busy at this time, we didn't experience the noise and parking issues others complained of. The menu was ridiculously long and heavy so we opted to order off the one page lunch menu. I got the grilled cheese and french onion soup combo for 10.99...  Both were satisfactory for the price I paid. My coworkers got a chicken Caesar salad, a Cobb salad, and a couple pasta dishes. Everyone was happy with their food overall. Our waitress Lauren, was very attentive and nice. She split our checks with no problem. I will be back, but most likely only for lunch or drinks / apps to avoid the situations many others complained of.
Love this place! Such a great space and so many unique menu items. Now that I live out of town, it is one of our first stops upon arrival!

Been this restaurant for years. Always one of the fun places to dine out with friends because of the atomosphere and the food.   I always come here at least once or twice a month. I decided to write the review today sadly because I couldnt't help noticing that the tasting has changed in a bad way, they started serving dishes that are too spicy, too salty, and too strong since my dining there in Autumn.   I won't come back for a while untill they fix this issue.  I even assumed the chef lost his palette or they are not even tasting. I had a Coconut Soup as a starter, and this was too salty and I couldn't finish it. After the soup, my entree, Panang Curry Dish came which came out too strong with peanut sauce and salt. I couldn't have the second bite.  This was really bad. After discussing with a friend, we decided to inform our waiter that we can't finish it because the sauce was too strong and salty.   It was nice of him that he took off from the bill, but all I ask is to fix this issue so that I feel safe to come back and order. I know Thai food, but what Room Service is serviing isn't Thai.  Sorry.
Not so bad...
