That damn shrimp po boy is a problem! Otto (chef) you're the best! Ate that sandwich once a week during the summer, alone or with friends... Who needs anyone when you have food this good for company!
Excellent cuisine, super friendly staff and very cozy atmosphere. Worth the trip, even from Manhattan !
This place is absolutely amazing. No matter what you order you cannot go wrong!!! Simply amazing!!!

Over a year later and still LOVE the food. It is my go to for good Puerto Rican without having to go into the city. Trouble is the staff is still AWFUL!!! They are so disrespectful and nasty. They continue to act like you are bothering them. they are always on their cell phones while you wait for them. If you have a question forget it they roll their eyes at you. I would eat here much more often if it wasn;t for the nasty nasty nasty staff.  AND PLEASE PUT YOUR TIP JAR AWAY. Even when I do tip you are still as rude as always. Tips are for good service not because you decided to show up to work!!
A visit to Alice's Arbor is worth it just to spend time with Dominique. The food is good too.

Just perfect! Kampachi and Monkfish are two dishes we strongly recommend. If you like experements you need to try this place. As for a dessert  - go for Semifredo !!! And we love our server Lizzie! Great place!
On Christmas Eve the line is insane and they only have one person working but it's part of the adventure

I went here last night with a friend. Haven't been here in almost a year. Looks like new ownership. We ordered a chicken and goat dish with some rice. Food came in very late. The waitress brought the wrong food. She said here is your halim and the goat is to go. I said that's not what we ordered and she insisted we ordered that. Immediately started speaking Urdu or Hindi with me assuming I know how to speak because I am brown. Went back and spoke to the guy who took our order and he said they will bring the right order out shortly never apologizing for the mix up and serious delay. Food was average. I am thinking for $20 bucks together it was not bad. When we went to go pay, he rings us up for $42. He is charging $12 bucks for plain rice for two. I had a lacci that was like $4.99 and my friend had a soda, God only knows what they charged for that soda. Folks, it was a caricature circumstances. No way what we ate worth $42 bucks. On a good day $18 at tops and I am being generous. Service sucked. Attitude was the worst of it. I am on a mission now to make sure no one I know ever will visit this place. I know I won't.
Great staff great food Plus BYOB great place for couples and family highly recommend this place thank you
shrimp is really delicious and the environment is nice.

Mehhh...... Went there for quick dinner with my hubby and our 1 year old a few week ago, and the restaurant was empty (like literally empty). Anyways, we ordered 2 appetizers and two entrees. The waiter had a hard time understanding a simple question regarding a dish on the menu (i suppose lack of training on the menu items). Bad start! While waiting for our food, which took almost 35 minutes to come out (how the hell the food comes out late when ya guys have no tables?????), we heard yelling and screaming noises from the kitchen. That woke our baby up. Seriously???? I asked the water what was going on, and he replied, "our boss lost his mind." Wow, shouting and yelling at your employees really is a way to run your restaurant? No wonder the place was empty. Moving on, the appetizers...our samosas were soggy and smelly, yuck. We just sent them back without asking them to take it off our bill. The rest of the food was below average as well. I was nauseous and disgusted after that. DO NOT GO THERE. THIS PLACE WAS A WASTE OF TIME, ENERGY AND MONEY. I rather spend my money where the customers and the staff is treated with respect. I am surprised the owner still has the restaurant doors open.

was in area so lets get ready to get my melt on baby. a nice selection of melt sandwiches for lunch, and a few breakfast melt treats, i stick to the lunch menu , and pick a winner like chicken buffalo melt and a side of tater tots,  also side stuff like salads, chips, pickles .no indoor seating, order at window, and a bunch of patio type seating in the citibank atrium, the staff at window are friendly and told me tuna melt or buffalo chicken was a good pick today.prices are not bad and sandwiches are meaty enough and with tots, and soda, a good lunch meal.  many other melt choices next time, but order and leave, cause its cold to sit outdoors, but i notice some folks just dont care. so enjoy. p.s i ordered a oreo milk shake , very tasty and sweet.
Great service, great food and great prices!
Cheap, great beer on tap and delicious French fries. The main courses are all very satisfying, too. Happy hour is 4-6 and has $3 beer and cheap bottles of wine. Great for a group!
Everything was great here...from the grilled octopus salad to the whole branzino, this is definitely the place to go if you have a craving for good and fresh seafood.  Highly recommended!

Delicious meals. Our group got the tuna poke, escargot, and mussels for appetizers. Yum!! The mussels were amazing in the coconut broth. Our entrees were the duck confit risotto, duck breast, and the salmon. The duck breast I think was the best. The building is beautiful! Very airy and lovely.
Very good Asian fusion; haven't gone recently but was a great dining experience from service to food. A little pricey but great evening out place.

Theres a small wait for brunch, however the meal was very very good. Every dish for brunch is recommend, I personally love the eggplant and the shakshuka. The prices are affordable and the staff is very patient and nice

This is hands down one of my favorite restaurants in The world. The food and wine is never disappointing. I LOVE the slaw salad with a salmon burger on top. This location is just as amazing as the brooklyn heights location

I've been to This restaurant a few times, and it never disappoints. It's hard to get a table, but you can also sit at the bar. I highly recommend the Novo Mondo for anyone who wants to put some liquid in their mouth.
Excellent.

Would be give this place negative stars if I could. This review is based solely on the service.  I didn't even get as far as trying the food because the service was horrible! We made reservations but made it a little late. A short moment later we were seated but when one of the hostesses signaled to the other hostess, both my husband and I witnessed her look of disgust. I'm not trying to play the racist card nor am I one to feel suppressed because I'm Asian American but the hostess made me feel like I did not belong. When we sat down the server was far from hospitable. He almost seemed annoyed we were there. I looked at my husband and he felt the same thing - lets get up and leave this rude and uninviting environment. We're on our honeymoon and this was by far the worst experience we've had. I would tell that hostess and server do your job in a service industry and show some sort of hospitality. No one will patronize your establishment no matter how good the food may be.
I'm a big fan of all the Mogadors. The prices are very reasonable and the ambiance is wonderful. The lines can be a bit long sometimes, but the food is delicious.
I didn't order from here because there was no trace of any menu online anywhere.  Need to know what's on offer before I'll give a place a try.  :(
Roll up your sleeves and dive into the wings.  Could be the best in the city.  With a pitcher of beer, you can finish a 25 wing order by yourself.
This is my routinely stop midway to or from Boston. Nice place, excellent service, amazing food with good prices. What else do you need?

Went with my family for Christmas Eve dinner. We had the pernil, ropa vieja and churrasco. All very good flavors. Each dish came with rice, beans, fried plantains, and salad. Very nice ambience and attentive staff. I would come again.

It was pouring rain when we got to the restaurant today at 10:50 am, we walked in the door and were immediately greeted by an angry staff with an unwelcoming voice "we're not open til 11am.  Okay, we stepped out and waited til 11.  At 11 am sharp, a couple walked in and got kicked out of the restaurant by the same guy. He repeated him again with an attitude when the couple didn't move outside. I Just can't believe it how rude he was... we left and ate elsewhere it doesn't matter how good the food is... Service is equally as important. I hope he isn't the host or boss because he's simply RUDE! The service deserves no star.

Best bar in Greenpoint/Williamsburg! Great atmosphere and a big selection of beers. Spristzenhaus is the most sociable bar I've ever been to. There is a great sense of community even though the majority of us moved here from other parts of the world. Love the dining hall style seating areas, no booths and small tables mean the place is one big social house. And you can play jenga! Huge islands of beer on tap featuring many German beers and other great brews! Beers are on the more expensive side average $7-8 per glass, although they are damn good beers served in their original glasses. Food options are limited to pretty much fries and bratwurst. Not a place for food, but definitely a place to drink! I used to come here every weekend with friends, and now all my friends are bringing their friends here!

I had reservations here for December 17th and was very excited based on multiple rave reviews for their vegetarian menu (my wife is vegetarian). I got there on time and was immediately seated on the table closest to the server station. The waiter was very polite and immediately got us the food and alcohol menus. We had to specifically ask for the vegetarian menu which was ok because I don't think many vegetarians go to Italian restaurants. The restaurant progressively got noisy and crowded and I joked with my wife about it being more like a bar than a restaurant as there were people standing all around with no apparent crowd control. People including the servers started bumping into me while I was seated which annoyed the crap out of me. I even said excuse me to a few of the servers which was funny because I was the one seated and they were bumping into me! Our server got us the bread and didn't pay attention to my earlier ask of the vegetarian menu.. There was bread with salami in it on the basket which shows they didn't care. We asked to change it and another server came by and referred to us as 'friends' while placing the basket in front of us (that's rather informal for an Italian restaurant, any who). I couldn't bear to sit where we were anymore so I asked for a table change. Our server said he would check for us and five minutes later got us our entrées...and didn't even heed to my request. He comes back midway through our meal and said that he checked and there is no table available (impeccable timing). We were in the midst of a subway like atmosphere mixed with a feeling of a cheap bar and the terrible service, the only saving grace was the incredible food. I finally asked for the check and I wanted to get out of there as fast as possible. While I was waiting we were sorrounded by servers gathering for some chitchat and banter about the girl sitting on the table next to me. And then came the final nail in the coffin..one of the servers dropped a wine glass and the glass flew about and pierced my wife's leg. And much to my surprise no one even asked if she was OK and went about cleaning it in a lackadaisical fashion (ok I understand you are trying to recreate a tiny Italian village, but you went too far) So yeah it was terrible..oh did I mention that the server was selling cocktails to us much like in a fish market

Being European is hard to find a good italian reataurant in NY. However this is probably the most original italian in Town. The owner is italian, the food was delicious. Fresh products, original recipes, ambience of a real Trattoria.

This was the perfect place to stop after our walk. It's small, intimate and has a great menu. There were regulars and tourists. The menu is small, but the food is grand. It was fresh, and just the perfect amount of food. We were ready for our next adventure after this stop. The service was attentive, and our waitress was helpful and on point with her suggestions. There was a nice international vibe here.

If your craving a goooooood burger , this is the best place to go. I've been craving the perfect burger and my boyfriend took me here so we could drinks too. I ordered a bacon cheeseburger without tomatoes or onions, they forgot my lettuce but they brought it over with no problem despite the fact that they could've went a little lighter on the mayo the burger was absolutely delicious! My boyfriend substituted his buns for pretzel buns, and I added cheese to my fries , && our meal came to $45.

From the outside you would not know that this place is a gem.  My family and I discovered this place a little over a year now as we were new to caldwell and did not like the caldwell diner or the pancake house or it the others on 46. The staff is always friendly food has not yet disappoint. Great menu   Very very friendly staff.

I went to Shu Restaurant the first week they opened, food was just ok, the dish was small compare to many other Szechuan restaurant. but any way it is a Szechuan restaurant, most of my chinese friends love Szechuan food, so told friends, they tried and told me it was very pricy. Today, I bought a take out Fuqifeipian, passed to my hunsband, he asked if i bought air. The container is very small, the meat is only half the container, and the worse part is i have to add salt to the meat. I went to more than 50 of Szechuan restaurant, this one is the worst, they even don't put enought souce. I will nevner come back to Shu.

One of the best places to eat in all of North Brunswick. Their Shawarma over rice  is HEAVEN!! I get extra side of tahini to pour over it because their homemade tahini is the best I've ever had. The place is clean and the staff are friendly and wonderful! I've only ever had one dish I didn't like from them. Their meat pies are yummy. A bit pricey but sooooo worth the wait. It takes them a while to make things as most of their items are made fresh while you wait. If you aren't completely stuffed be sure to try their Baklava. Not to sweet or sticky...just perfect!

I ordered sweet potato tempura and a pina colada slushie. The best thing about this meal was the free water. The slushie tasted like detergent - no lie. It was a distinctly soapy taste (I've tasted soap before) that remained on my tongue after the meal. I complained to a waiter, who brought another waiter who asked if I would like something different. I had no time, so I told them no. They did not offer to take it off my bill and ended up charging me for that. It was something I barely sampled (the cup was still full) and tasted awful. The service was mediocre at best. For the most part, after placing my order, the waiters ignored me. The waiters had enough time on their hands to loiter around the floor. When they brought the bill, they did not even bring me a pen to put down the tip amount with. I tipped them 10% of the part of the meal that was edible. To their credit, the sweet potato tempura was decent - not spectacular and not horrible. I'm rating this as a 2 instead of 1 because of the tempura and the water.
非常糟糕的服务！等了超过一个小时菜还没上。Very bad service! The dish didn't come after more than one hour.

When we arrived we had to flag down a waiter before being seated. After 20 minutes of waiting we had to flag down the waiter again to take our orders (there had been no water up until this point). I should add that the restaurant was half empty, the bar tender was casually drinking at the bar, ignoring my eye contact and the other waiters kept walking from the kitchen to the register with no real purpose. When we finally had our waiters' attention, we ordered our starters and our mains. The starter came in a reasonable amount of time. The real issue came with our main, we waited approximately 35-40 minutes after our starter plates had been taken for our main to come. At this point neither of us were hungry and what made it even worse was that my steak was cold! As you can guess, we had to flag down a waiter who was busy eating at the bar, to bring the cheque. I have no idea why service was so slow and uninterested. It was so frustrating to watch the waiters talking amongst themselves and ignoring us throughout the night. This was on a Sunday night at around 8pm. It was with a huge sigh that we left a 10% tip. I will never revisit this place. The food was average.

This store is absolutely terrible. The people in the new store are rude & unprofessional. I'm a huge fan of the original store. Last night after some shopping down town. I had relatives from out of state. We had a party of 6 & They wanted a chicken a cheese steak so I suggested this place because of the seating. We got to the place at 10:20. I saw the sign that said they closed at 11 & the dining rooms chairs were already up. After ordering the food, the white receptionist I would think he was the manager at the site because he looked lole he was in charge but he was absolutely rude he told us that we can't dine in. There was also a party of 3 in the corner eating & forced them to pack their food up & go. Me & my relatives were also forced to leave & we decided to eat right out side of the restaurant on the hood of my car in the middle on winter. Nothing on the food but I will not be going back to this location because of that one individual's rudeness & unprofessional ethics.

Ordered the chefs special pre fixed meal which consisted of 10 tapa dishes and 2 deserts for $50 pp before tip and tax . The dishes are all for sharing. Only 2-3 bites per person per dish. So the dishes were quite small. Since it was a holiday they had the special holiday menu which had a Chinese twist. And I think that's where it threw me off. Yes the food was amazing .. But it really wasn't worth that price .  Bill came out to be about $70 pp after tip and tax .. And yes it was good... But with Chinese food , you can get amazingggggg Chinese food for a fraction of the price. For example.. One of the dishes were gyozas, walnut chicken, sweet and sour soup . So... Those dishes didn't wow us. But their other dishes were really good.. Like their pork belly, short rib, sashimi over peanut soba noodle. As for their drink menu, the cocktails and beers are not your typical drinks. They are very different. We got the 'rude pig' cocktail and 'pumpkin maitai' but they tasted kinda weird. The rude pig was very smoky with salt and bacon bits on the rim. The pumpkin maitai had a gingery taste.
Came here with friend on Christmas Eve. Very nice service and good food. Really good seafood for a buffet. Will definitely come again!
I think we found our new Christmas Eve tradition! The hot pot is sooooo delicious. And it's fun. The atmosphere is elegant but casual and friendly.
It's amazing! So good taste and nice service! It is worth the waiting and price! I hope I can try BBQ next time
It is the Best hot pot in town! Severs also great. Is not easy to find a restaurant in China town like them! I will come back next time!

Great place, lots of food, nice setting, great service, nice music I like this place a lot! Its so beautiful. It gives you a lot of portions. The music is very refreshing. I also received a 10 off coupon!
good place, good foods, and good service !!!! Amy is outstanding server!!!

This place is awesome! There's so much to chooses from and they give you some very good portions. The inside of the restaurant is cery beautiful. It's a very good price fir all the fiod they give you.
Good taste, really a nice place to go and try Chinese food!  Remember to make a reservation before you go cuz it's hard to get the place immediately!

Horrendous experience ! I saw a waiter in the restroom finish his business and go out without washing his hands. I asked him his name so I could complain to the management. He refused to tell me his name and to my surprise even his manager refused to tell me his name or reprimand him. We just left without finishing our dinner. Disgusting ! Whatever little food we ate was OK and not great compared to other choices in the Parsippany  / Morristown area. Please stay away !
Excellent fusion of Indian food with cocktail.
Yeah go to say you've been bit don't expect a great steak. Better than Geno's but that's not saying a lot. Service was better too.

This place is definitely overrated. We came here for Christmas Eve Dinner. The food is mediocre at best. Most of the tasting menu used fresh ingredients but not that delicious. The service however is quite bad for a one-star restaurant. All the waiters gave you a feeling that they wanted to go home for Christmas and showed little interest in serving the guests attentively. I won't go into details about how bad the service is but if you want you should definitely come here and experience it. If other restaurants are available, I strongly suggest you choose somewhere else for dinner.

There is a reason why this place is always packed.  Sushi is very fresh and never had a bad meal.  I usually do take-out and it's just as good.  I eat in the best restaurants in New York City and I was so surprised to find this GEM in my town.  Not a place for a romantic date because it's so small, but definitely great food...food is priced well also!  Enjoy!
Had the lunch special with desert.  Friendly service and the place is very clean.

Cheng's is probably the best chinese food in Pennington... which is easy since it is also the only chinese food in Pennington. It is pretty cheap, they get orders ready quickly, and in my experience almost never mess up the orders. The food is consistently mediocre, but those low prices and solid service keep me coming back now and then.
This place provide very traditional and typical Korean food, to midnight! !! Last night several friends went there after 1 am , the restaurant still full of people
Food is good but the service has always been a bit brusque and cold. Unfortunate as I live across the street and would love to make this place a regular.
My friends like it. Ribs are good~

My go-to place for sushi, Zest has great food, exposed brick walls, and scrumptious rolls.  Their happy hour lasts till 7, even on Saturday!  Weekday or weekend, I always stuff my face with the spicy tuna and eel rolls.  Start with the gyoza first, you won't be disappointed.  The Sapporo is on draft, and it's super cheap during happy hour.

I love the food here. Comparing it to other 'mall food court places', i prefer to come to Sarku. Their signature chicken teryaki is sublime. At this particular location they have alot of sushi selections! Other locations only have california rolls. The sauce they put on the food is wonderful! Yummmmmm....
Awesome!  My favorite spot for lunch every week.  healthy, made from scratch, delicious.  They have something for everyone.  Try a beef stir fry with cherries.  Really cool vibe and really tasty.
Happy hour is awesome, 1/2 price wine & appetizers. Marc was our waiter & was excellent. It's great for a drink & snack after work.
The pizza is amazing (and cheap) and the people is nice and honest. We left a bag with over 600 usd and came back running 10 minutes later. The cashier gave it back to us.

The price and the freshness of each bite shocked me at first. Usually you have to compromise in some area but at Lolo'S I didn't have to. I left feeling content yet not lazy. I ordered a steamed seafood pot of shrimp with the ginger butter and scallion sauce to go with it. I let the shrimp sit for a few mins while my friend and I shared the yummy conch fritters and cauliflower. Both were a delight: the cauliflower had the perfect crunchy freshness. The conch fritters were a surprise because for the first time ever I ate a conch fritter from a restaurant that actually had actual conch meat in it. Go Lolo! Our waiter tied a bib on me and I cracked open my steam pot. Such a delight and great for sharing. Homemade condiments are a must and your allowed to try as many as you want. Seating in the back is nice and cozy. Love the reggae vibe!

This is one of the best Indian restaurants I have ever been to! I came to visit NY all the way from California and I am so glad I found this place! Their Chicken Tikka Masala and chicken vindaloo are amazing! I'll definitely come here every time I visit NY.
Delish!! One of my favorite china town restaurants! Shaved noodle pork soy sauce is my favorite aside from the soups!

My husband and I went to this place today. A few hours later we went home. Earlier this evening we were both very sick. We both had diarrhea and the need to vomit. We were in and out of the bathroom for about two hours. We would never recommend this place to anyone. Please save your money and go somewhere else to eat. This was the worst buffet we have ever been to.

Sushi is alright (to remember) but the prices are exorbitant( even by airport standards). You pay before order and 20 percent advance gratuity is mandatory. Good bottles beer collection (hitachino nest pint was $29). They also let you pay with united miles (a surprise) but conversion rates are pathetic (like .8 cent per mile)
Restaurant is very crowded at night and doesnt take reservations. Better bet is to go for lunch and go a little before 12 noon to beat the crowd. All food is very good, but hamburgers are the best.

I would not even call this place fast food as they cook it right for you when you come :) the food here is on point!!! And the tikka masala sauce is heavenly. My only suggestion is that they give a little more rice with the curry bowl so I can Stretch this out to two meals. But I'll be frequenting here weekly FOR Sure!
Love it.

I was not impressed at all. They took forever to serve my food and when I finally got my meal it was cold. I told the waiter it was cold and he brought it back warmer but it was black. It looked like charcoal. The rice was also disgusting. And on top of everything my meal was very pricey. I've been sitting in here for 3 hours. I give this place a thumbs down. I will never come here again and I don't recommend anyone to come here.

If you really want the best Korean food you have to go. My favorite dish is "Galbi Jim" theire side dishes are really good. The best waitress is Katie she is awesome and Sam is really nice and funny. The atmosphere is really good and it feels authentic as well!

My family and I have been going to Noodle Chu for 15-20 years, but after today ARE NEVER COMING BACK. We had a horrible experience during Dim Sum involving one of the cart ladies.  She has bangs and wore her hair in a bun.  She erroneously marked our bill for an extra dish.  We told the waiter, and he corrected it.  When she came around again, she saw the correction and yelled at us for why we changed our bill.  We told the waiter to come and explain to her, but she demanded that we were "supposed" to only find her to correct her mistake.  She was very rude to us and pretty much accused us of cheating on our bill.  NO EMPLOYEE should yell at a paying customer and embarrass them in public, especially if they are the ones at fault.   The other employees pretty much told us that she claims she is a relative of the owner, so therefore she cannot be reprimanded.  They've received numerous complaints about this lady, and they can't do anything. I can't stand for nepotism and I believe that a restaurant should have at least SOME customer service.  The fact that nothing can be done about a RUDE employee leaves a horrible taste in my mouth.  As we were leaving, I told her that we won't be coming back because she is very rude, and she then yelled "SPEAK IN CHINESE!"  I refused, and then she added, "WHY YOU NOT SPEAK IN CHINESE?  YOU DON'T KNOW CHINESE?! HA HA HA!"  This is the kind of attitude we were dealing with. Her co-worker then asked her to borrow the food scissors, which she then dropped on the floor.  She picked them up and gave them to the co-worker.  I am resisting the urge to call the Health Inspector. It's sad that this bad apple ruined this place for us.  What's even worse is that this restaurant doesn't care and bad apples are not punished.
I've had lunch and dinner here. Service is relaxed but attentive. Don't miss the salumi or dessert. They're the perfect additions to round out a perfectly fresh meal.

I've been wanting to try this place as it was always attractive from the outside. The firefly like light fixtures were like every girl's dream (golden sparkles all around). Went in for lunch today and for a drink to celebrate Christmas. Sadly disappointing. There weren't many pros that I could think of other than I didn't have to wait long for the food to be served. The tofu salad appetizer did not have enough peanut sauce and just felt dry for the most part. My pad see iew was okay but it wasn't something that made an impression. My drink was full on alcohol over alcohol over alcohol. The description of one thousand and one nights cocktail sounded splendid with blueberries, vodka and a few different juices. What I tasted was sour alcohol. So weird. The waiter service was oddly inattentive. I had a small table with many dishes. Two appetizer bowls were just left on the table until the end of the meal. Not exciting. Do not go.

I write this to you sick from bed.  Myself and two guests had the sushi and all had a stomach ache about 3 hours after.  After ruining sleep, I ended up hugging the toilet worse than I did in college, it was truly impressive.  I will not be back as this is obviously sushi that is not fresh. Unbelievable.

I visited this place last Monday... Actually it's a modern Sri Lankan restaurant with black n white interior... The owner is really friendly and helpful.. I ordered a seafood fried rice ..... OMG... I can stop eating it... It was absolutely that good... Then I ordered another one to go...waited little bit more as they prepared everything fresh and hot... I highly recommend this place to anyone to taste real Sri Lankan taste...

I come back with my whole family for the Xmas dinner,my daughter was begging me to come again since we got back from OTAIKO last time.I think this place is worth every penny. My family and I decided to go to try the hibachi this time . The service was amazing, a girl explains you everything you are eating in detail. This is a culinary experience. From the appetizer to the hibachi meal.Kids loves it,my daughter was screaming from the beginning to the end.and also,the Dessert"GUAVA MANGO FLUTE" was FANTASTIC.Make sure you drink SAMURAI Sake sampler.

Love love love this place! So glad a great sushi place opened up nearby. My husband and I have enjoyed the food, the presentation and the service. The staff is so great and accommodating. Definitely should come check them out!

I bought several cookie trays for Christmas and not only are they some of the best cookies I have ever had.. the old school Italian's I gave them too were also extremely happy to enjoy the delicious cookies. They were so good, I went back on Christmas eve and picked up 2 more!  Easy in and out and I now have a new christmas tradition!! Thanks you! Buon Natale a tutti !

I haven't dined here yet, but I do love walking around and seeing all the delicious foods and pastries. The lines are LONG at times, but I've braved them to buy a few specialty items and snacks that you'd not likely find elsewhere. Specialty items do come with a premium price at times, but nothing too crazy.
The food is not bad, I have been there twice

Paprika used to be a really good place. Thats not the case anymore. The food was decent and tasty. The service was really poor and inept. 1) we ordered appetizers and the server never brought them and stated that he had forgotten. 2) they made errors in our orders, given us things we didnt ask for withouth any explanation. 3) they did not tell you it was cash only until the end even though their door has credit cards announcements 4) asking us to hurry up because others were waiting for a table! That was the worst. Just poor service. If you can go somewhere else, please do!
Came here with my girlfriend. Had a great meal and the deserts are amazing! Salted caramel vanilla budino is amazing. Reasonably priced!
Meh. But a slightly above average Meh. At least it's better than the places around city center.
Food and service here are really BAD. Please do not go to this restaurant. They are just making some shit.

Have been ordering from them or their predecessor for over ten years.  Food is always good and usually ready when told it will be. Can not comment on delivery as I live close enough to run over and get it.  The staff is usually quite friendly, unless they are swamped like today (Christmas).  Always a crowd.

Spent Christmas Eve with the family (11 people) and everything was 100%! Marco was very fun and helpful. Great ambiance and food was great! We had a little bit of everything. My favorites were the Tiramisu (OMG!!!!) and the Cannelloni. Definitely recommend.
Food is good but not anything special. Menu is kinda boring and would like to see some creative brunch options. A bit pricy and we had to wait quite long to get the food.

If you want true Italian food this is one of the best restaurants for that in Bucks County. Recipes are authentic and the food is outstanding. Parking can sometimes be a little bit of a pain but any other negatives are shadowed by the food and ambiance of the place. Always recommend for true homemade Italian.

For the uninitiated, there are better places than this. If you have come for a far, you might as well drive another half hour for a better place! The establishment is just too rude. The bathrooms unclean and stinks. They automatically charge a "service fee" for those in a party of 4 or above which means you can't think of holding back their tip!! They are ever hovering to get you out of there as it is a busy place and don't want you waste time enjoying your meal! We put up with it because we Indians are used to rude establishments, mediocre food and borderline health violation places as it reminds us of home :P The chaats are nothing great. If you say spicy, they would just put more chilly on it. You can get better dosas at the dosa hut down the road and better chhole bature at Rasoi. Its not that the yelp review is going to make a difference. As the owner told me, "honestly we don't care!"

Hostess was friendly. She was also the bartender.  The tuna tartare was not good at all. It just didn't have that fresh fish jazz going on.  Keeping it light and fishy, I had the mixed seafood on  a bed of greens. Totally uninspired.  Edible, but expensive for what it was. One shrimp, not tasting like it was just cooked either. Balsamic dressing on the bottom of the plate was boring too. Healthy though.   Focaccia bread was a little cold, and the olive oil was not a good quality one. Service mediocre.   Ambiance nice. Bustling a few days before Christmas.  Nice design. I would give them another try next time I come down here.

Daddy Likes, Daddy Likes :)   Excellent bread, fresh meats and toppings, very friendly owner and staff.  I also love that they have a sign saying "be nice, or leave" - that's a great way of dealing with the NJ attitudes that i'm sure businesses around here are tired of. Once I had a meatball with double provolone and it was better than being with a woman. Yes, it was.

We've been coming here as a family for years on Christmas Eve. Last night was beyond terrible. It was a total sh*t show. The servers didn't know what was going on, constantly bringing food to the wrong table, then coming back picking it up and bringing it to another table. Kinda weird. The appetizers came out about 40 minutes after we got there and were good. Then we sat and waited about an hour until our dinner came. Our family is very Italian and very particular about their pastas. They ordered sides of linguini and penne came out. Not really a big deal we asked them to change it and the head waiter said sure, and never came back. One of our party ordered the most expensive thing on the menu, lamb chops. It came out breaded and fried. I've never seen a fried and breaded lamb chops. I ordered the braccioli and it was bad. It didn't look like it was supposed to and the sauce was bland. We even complained and they didn't come anything. I'm not big into writing negative reviews but when food comes out poorly you shouldn't have to foot the bill on it. This restaurant was way over their head last night. We overheard the waiter saying they didn't have the tables numbered....
This place is the best! Cool old school glamour but attainable. Fabulous service! It's as great as everyone says-

Unfortunately not a prize winner  despite the homage to one of NY's legendary restaurants, Elaine's, which was located here. The food is predictable bar fare and the service is friendly but disorganized.  We were a party of five for a Christmas lunch, with a relatively simple order.  The cocktails - bellinis - took a long time to arrive and we're lukewarm. One of the entrees was stone cold and was sent back.  It took several requests to get it back to the table, but by this time warm and totally  dried out.  Things like this happen but with having to plead for the entree to be returned to the table and  then by the time it got there  the other guests had nearly finished, so it wasn't a very professional dining experience.  The waitress was friendly and helpful and was gracious in not charging for the returned entree, but the assistant waiter was pretty surly. The setting is very attractive and the noise level cheerful, however.  Just stay away from the food and beverages.
Awesome!

I went to the market for the second time. There are lots of places to eat and purchase fresh fruit and produce. It is crowded especially during the holiday seasons. overall, I like reading terminal market and will come back when I back to philly.
Solid food options here that address all tastes.  You really can't go wrong -- definitely worth a visit for lunch if you are staying nearby.

Ordered the honey nut old fashioned cocktail . It took 20 minutes to get. Disgusting cocktail. I ordered a wine instead and I finally got it after I was done eating. The two girls bartenders were moving at a glacial pace. Natasha, the waiter didn't get that I did not like the cocktail because it was poorly mixed not because I made the wrong choice. Natasha kept apologizing and offered me to get me whatever I wanted, so I asked for a refund on the cocktail. Apparently, the manager, John,  was the only person in the entire restaurant authorized to give a refund and never came back from wherever he was hiding. Smart guy John, you are lucky I didn't get to talk to you. Natasha, poor  thing ended up giving me cash. Insane experience. John, you need to get a new job or take some online courses on how to run a restaurant at a busy airport. Bartenders need to learn how to mix cocktails and spend less time playing with your phones and chatting with customers. DO NOT GO TO THIS RESTAURANT. Natasha, get a new job, you were actually nice.

Overrated. Food was average, line was long, lack of space. Expect to share tables with strangers, they would not spare a single seat (this is not an exaggeration, I mean this word for word). Service is very rushed but food does come out fast. For service alone I would give it a 2 out of 5 stars. Place is not the cleanest, eating utensils  was not cleaned properly. There was some dry food on the side of one of my tea cups. Food is not cheap. The entire time I was there they were trying to get you out fast, making me feel very unwelcome.

My first trip to a Chiles.  Went in the late afternoon. Place was empty and we sat at the bar.  Jackie the bartender was not very friendly at all.  She spent almost all the time in the kitchen.  We had beer. They have the usual 5 on tap, Blue Moon by the Adolph Coors Brewing Company for us.  Enchiladas with green sauce. Dry. Flavorless. Not spicy.  Burger. Dry, flavorless. Unseasoned.  Atmosphere? Dull. Boring. Would I ever come here again? No F'ing way.

Service there was great! The two servers were amazing at making me feel good even with the crowd. Food was amazing! Elotes were delicious with lots of mayo! I ordered the shrimp tacos with tostones, they were not cheap on the guac and the shrimp was AMAZING! With a great pitcher of sangria, I'll be come back!
Was pretty disappointed.   The sushi was not fresh and still somewhat frozen.  Ramen was ok, but definitely had much better.
Nice neighborhood place to get brunch. Good sandwiches, coffee, juices

Staying at a friends around the corner this place was close and being a new spot in the area I wanted to try it before it either failed or became a wild success. This place will be a wild success. Sashimi was quality and the addicting fried chicken is definitely addicting and all was priced well for the portion Try this place. Delicious, new, and the kitchen and wait staff are extremely nice. You can feel that they are there to make good quality food just for you.
Just finished eating a takeout biriyani . It's soggy , no flavor and worst ever biriyani I have eaten . I doubt I'll go back here again.
The best chicken sandwich on earth. The cheese fries are a phenomenon. For the type of food it is, 5 stars.

I went to Amanda when I was travelling in Philly. It was one of the best surprises during my trip! Excellent menu and great service. I love the garlic shrimp and cheese steak! It was crowded, so I would recommand people to make reservation first. But I enjoyed my meal a lot even though I was sitting at the bar!

I've been here six times.  Here's everything I've tried: nutty chocolate chip cookie--I've had three of these on three different occasions.  They're consistently delicious.  Crispy edges, gooey middle, high quality chocolate.  I also like the different nuts, they add a variety of taste and texture.  I've tried the Levain cookies they've been compared to and those are delicious too but different.  If you like your cookies high and cakey, without nuts, then Levain is your cookie.  I like Maman's chocolate and nut combination but that's just me.   croissant--I've had this once, in the afternoon.  It was flaky and buttery but I think it would taste fresher in the morning.  I will give it another try and report back. chocolate tea cake--moist and gooey in the middle, would be even better if it was warm instead of lukewarm, still very yummy. lemon and thyme madeleines--I had these in the evening I liked them but they tasted slightly stale. lemon cake--moist, lemony, perfection pain de tuna--a cute little tuna sandwich that was a perfect blend of  flavors, I loved the pesto spread on the bread.  And I loved that there was on mayonnaise.  A surprising favorite. potato salad--I liked the mustard flavor but I tasted too much mayonnaise for my taste.  Then again, I hate mayonnaise so if you like it, you'll probably enjoy this potato salad more than I did. smashed avocado tartinette--refreshing and savory, I liked the zing of lemon. mozzarella/tomato/pesto tartinette--good but a little bland.   hot chocolate--perfect blend of cream and chocolate, I didn't try the lavender flavor.  Will have to go back for that.   Loved the decor and the service.  My new go-to spot!
I just don't understand the hype. Cheesesteak is just fine. Bread is nothing special, and the meat was tough and hard to chew. Was pretty disappointed as I have yet to find a great cheesesteak.

Staff was wonderful, food was delicious. My favorite were the Banana Walnut pancakes! We had a last minute change to our reservation (from 5 people to 11) and manager quickly accommodated all of us. Our server Katie was friendly, pleasant and very efficient. Overall great experience. Super recommend!

Recommended by a friend. The ambiance was great, although our seating a little tight. Me by the window could hardly squeeze between tables to get to bathroom. The waiter was marvelous and all the staff equally as warm and inviting. The menu was very interesting. Lots of eclectic ingredients  - very much my thing. I like when food is both art and heart-warming. My date and I opted to share everything. A good call for this place. They offer small, medium and large plates. The oysters were perfect. Each of the ingredients of all the other dishes were quality and fresh. Unfortunately- each of the dishes we ordered, in spite of the very modest portions, weighed very heavy on our tummy. I was very excited for the grits but was disappointed that they and the accompanied pimento cheese was just too much. Did they cook the grits in butter then fry them in oil?  The portion was very small but I felt full immediately.  The chick peas were definitely fried - too friend. My date said they reminded her of McDonald's. Like french fries. Generally all of the dishes were good but wanted for something more... actually, I think they wanted for something less.  I think the dishes are too heavy handed but that could be because we went only with small plates. The cocktail was amazing. I forget the name - the vodka drink with sage. Perfect marriage of flavors. Yum. Based on my experience, I recommend going for cocktails and maybe one appetizers - not the chickpeas. Then, have dinner where they try less hard to impress/confuse your taste buds, but rather warm your hear and  belly.

Very disappointing. Our experience: We made a reservation, but we had to wait more than 20 minutes for a table. Ok... It was Xmas and busy but the service was slow. Slow to get our drinks. Appetizers (egg roll, egg drop soup and hot and sour soups) were not tasty. My husband's meal was delivered long after everyone else had their main dishes. The waiter never came back to check on us. My dinner, vegetable chow fun had too few vegetables. Very salty. The waiter never came back to fill water glasses, so I flagged the hostess and asked her for water. Overall, meh!! We won't go there again!

The have limited burger options but the burgers and fries were great. Their Burger Bound are also to die for! I was surprised it wasn't as expensive as I expected. The only downfall to this location is that there is very limited seating. There are so many people that they are waiting for someone to get up to take your table,  if you are looking for delicious quick burgers this is one of the best!
Everything is so tasty. What do they put in the butter that makes it better than regular butter? Pizza is so yummy. Service is very slow.
Really bad case of dry mouth after eating the sandwich.  Would not order from this place again.
amazing brunch. The biscuits and the brioche toast are to die for. Go ready to explode. The wait was not longer than 20 minutes for a party of two on a Sunday around 11am .

I don't think I have had such a poor dining experience in years.   The food is delicious.  I only wish the service matched.  It took an eternity to get every course, including a cocktail.   Our waiter never came back once to ask us how things were, or if we needed anything.  I actually thought after taking our order he went home.    The managers of the restaurant -- I believe that is what they were -- were just as unresponsive.   It took one of them close to 20 minutes to  get us a glass of wine.   Nobody made us feel welcomed.  Nobody seemed to care if we were there or not.   It almost felt like we were imposing -- especially on our "waiter" -- by being there for dinner. I will never go back.

Merry Christmas from the Macedonian Girls!!! Amazing people start with the owner Frank, finish with all employees: Fernando, LJ. all my Beautiful girls!!!! Thank you so much for everything, we really feel like home, good wine, good cocktails, beer. Good people. WE LOVE LILIES!!!!
Amazing food Fabulous strong drinks Low prices I wish they stayed open longer and had more locations in Manhattan. The Thai restaurants in Chelsea and Hells Kitchen can not compare!

What a joy it is to sit down comfortably and enjoy a good meal without being intruded on by obnoxious adolescent music blasting from overhead speakers.  This is very rare nowadays and one of the reasons we keep coming back.  Love their big salads and deserts.  We've never been disappointed at Paul's.

On 12/23 I took my family to this retaurant before going to a show. Everything started out great. We ordered appetizers that came out in a reasonable amount of time and were very good. After that everything went down hill fast. The main courses came out next. All dishes were room temperature at best. My son ordered one of their veal dishes and they gave him Rigatoni instead. After a little arguing they finally agreed to make what he ordered. We all now waited for his food to come out. By the time it did all of our food went from room temperature to cold. I ordered a full portion of Fettuccini Alfredo which I was going to share with my son. The full portion would fill a small salad plate. My daughter's Squid Inked pasta was mush, over over cooked. The waiter kept banging hard into my seat every time he would walk by without an excuse me or apology. The staff made no attempt to apologize for the poor service and the poor quality of food. They must have recognized their screw ups however because on a party of 5 where the tip is never figured in they made a point to give themselves 20%. I did not make a big issue of our poor dining experience out of fear we would miss our show. I will definitely not go back.
It is really a nice restaurant near doubletree. I have ordered a pasta with salmon, it is yummy! The vileto with mushroom is nice, too. What an amazing Christmas surprise!

Used to be a more fun bar, drinks now are weak and the bartender covered me in ice, a few times. In August 2014 drinks were much better and larger, service has also declined. I don't mind spending 14 bucks a drink if they are good. Other people at the bar complained about their drinks.

I just got back from Eulogy. Our first time here. My boyfriend wanted to take me out on Christmas because I'm sad and we both finally have the same day off. We wanted to go to the Ice Skating Rink on Penns Landing, but it was closed because of the melting ice and weather from yesterday. So my boyfriend and I decided to go here. Since there was so many good reviews, we were close by and my customer from my old job recommended me to come here. Worse mistake never! I never written a review before, but was call for! We decided to sit at the bar downstairs. The bartender took 5 mins to acknowledge us and he keep telling us to wait for him to take our order. It took him 15 mins to take our order.  There was about maybe 8 people at the bar including us. We got there when after everyone else. So they already got their drinks and foods. I ordered St. Bernardus Christmas Ale and my boyfriend ordered the Dirty Ho. The bartender got my beer in 5 mins, but take 10 mins to tell us he don't got the cup for the Dirty Hoe. So my boyfriend order a different beer and Moules Sausage Boursin & Potato Mussels. When we was waiting for him to take our order he was flirting with the waitress. When she came to tell him that a customer is waiting for their check. He made a comment saying she is so cute that he just want to hug her. So unprofessional! When the mussels arrived the waiter guy was about to give us our mussels, but the bartender took it and say it is the couple next to us and gave it to them. The couple gave it back to us and said that my boyfriend and I order first. Not only that he didn't give us any plates, napkins and utensils. My boyfriend and I was already upset about how long the bartender took to take our order and he just made another two more mistakes! We just wanted to enjoy our Holiday so we drank our beer and ate our mussels. The beers is good, but the mussels was bland! While we was eating the waitress came back to get a drink from the bartender. After he made the drink he made another comment to her. He said he like her smile and she should keep smiling. Can I say "sexual harassment"! My boyfriend and I didn't feel welcome here and felt that the bartender was a jerk! So we finish our beer and food and decided to leave. We waited for our check so I decided to go to the restroom and came back. We still didn't get our check. We waited 15 mins for him to give us our check. Since it is Christmas we was going to give the bartender a BIG TIPS, but he just mess it up for himself! I thought bartender is mostly working off of tips, but in his case all he worried about is flirting with the waitress and bossing the waiter around! I've never been to a bar like this and seen my boyfriend so upset! He was so angry that he just wanted to go straight home and didn't even go to the restroom. Even though he really needed to go! Terrible customer service, the mussels was bland and overcooked, and the bartender was very unprofessional!  We was there maybe an hour and it was the worse experience ever! Monks is more busier, but they gave better customer service, foods is better and they was professional! I wish I got that bartender name, but we were to angry and just wanted to leave! Never going back there again! Sorry one STARS for this place! Thanks for ruining our "Christmas Night"!
Awesome service and great food. It's an incredibly friendly restaurant and the owners make you feel part of their family.
I would say give a try. The menu items are good Kai Chi is my favs from the appetizers. The ambience is good and can get loud when it's packed. Overall I will go here again...

Very small and insanely popular. No bookings are taken so it took a few visits before we got in but certainly worth the effort. Great authentic French dishes well prepared. And hooray. .....great coffee!!!!! Will  be going back again!!!
This place is the absolute best. Great pub with great food and amazing people that make you feel like family. I highly recommend. Great place to bring friends and clients!

I make pizza, but let me tell you, this place is the best pizza in Jersey. Doesn't try to imitate Napolitan style, or anything different. Solid, greatly made, filling pizza. Surprise, their wings and calamari are really good too. Been going 20 years.
Amazing bartenders! Their skate is DELICIOUS! Their beet salad is superb! The salmon platter tastes amazing and looks beautiful!

Dead Rabbit is a cocktail bar in the financial district. It's very much a speak easy atmosphere. The drinks are very good but on the pricey side. Try the Scottish Egg appetizer, it's egg with Sausage. The downstairs can be pretty cramped but still a good time. I wish they had a bit more space downstairs at the main bar.

Delivery driver was VERY rude. Delivery was fast, which was great- so fast that they got here 40 minutes before grubhub told me it would be here- so i was in the other room and missed the call by one minute- the driver didn't want to park his car and then gave me an attitude about it. I didn't tip him because he was so rude, and then he called me after he drove away and was like yeah it was supposed to be a cash tip- and i was like yeah i didn't tip you because you were RUDE, he then started yelling something but i didn't hear because i hung up. Afraid to order from here again because of this experience.
Christmas diner was excellent!
Cool place, crowed people, great service and awesome food in certain Japanese style. Hanging with friends and late night food.
it was a terrible experience. the food was over cooked, which made the sea food rubbery and tasteless. the Sangria tasted bland.

Had dinner there last Saturday and was blown away!  We had a party of five and and asked the chef to serve away. We started with the sardines; light and lemony and perfectly fishy! Empanadas were delicious, crispy, and flaky, Olives were great, and the Endive salad was crunchy and sweet, the perfect accompaniment for what was to come!. The Burrata was also superb- soft, warm sublime. Things started to build with the roasted carrots; the flavor was hard to describe- earthy, sweet, amazing. Octopus was the best I have ever had- WOW- tender and divine in a creamy puree, an inspired combination of flavors. THEN- handmade pappardelle in a braised short rib ragu- this may have been my favorite. If you like the combination of beef and pasta, from a flavor and texture standpoint, as I do, this was nirvana. The steak may have been a special- porterhouse or T-bone- cooked medium rare to perfection, served with a chimichurri- I am salivating as I think about it!  We also had the blood sausage, another delicious plate. My intense dislike of Yelp and it's corrupt business model has caused me to pick and choose very carefully which restaurants I choose to review, but Chef Fernando Navas has created something special and the world needs to know! Enjoy!

I went Bengal Tiger tonight with my family, after seeing all these great reviews..it was a total disappointment.I have gone to many Indian restaurant in Philadelphia, and New York, and clearly this was not four and  a half stars.The food all taste the same.it was overpriced and the malai kofta which is my favorite dish at Indian-restaurant, was the worst I have ever had. It was hard cheeseballs immersed in yellow curry sauce.I basically finished my meal with some curry sauce, rice with some naan.The chola's were too spicy and too few also in spicy curry, and the spinach with paneer was alsoThe same hard cheese, that made the Michael stuff mixed in some little bit of spinach. Basically all The food all tasted  the same and was overly spicy.The service was nice. The guy was pleasant. The stairs to the restaurant were awful. However the restaurant itself was kind of cozy.
Great soup dirt cheap. I had the oxtail hand drawn noodles my brother had the duck. It's like half a duck in a bowl of soup for 6 bucks. Also try their smoothies!

The worst Thai food I ever had. Lamed curry, could't tell the different if it red or green or Panang.. or else, because it was just coconut milk with a tiny hint of chili paste (even I already asked for extra spicy). Stir fried vegetable was so so.. ;(. I can make it better. Service was ok... the waitress kind of rush, nothing special. Very disappointed.... will never go back again.

awesome restaurant! intresting blend of flavors! reccomend everybody to come! casual and good for kids. i reccomend the lamb shank and the filet mignon. the  food comes out quickly and the escargot and octupus salad is divine! desserts are delicious!

I just love The Jolly Goat - everything about it makes me happy, from the silky Latte (best I've ever had) to the exquisite baked goods (if you're gluten-free, try the apple cheddar scone), to the smiling faces behind the counter (the owner is a doll).  In NYC with my daughter for our birthdays, came here the first morning and became instant fans.  Since most folks take their coffees to go, we were lucky enough to get seats in this cozy and charming spot every time.  If I was a glass-half-empty kind of girl, I'd say I'm now ruined for LA coffee shops, but I'm not, so I'll simply look forward to getting back to New York City and The Jolly Goat - I will miss you sweet friend!
One of the best pizza places around. Great choice for anyone looking for real traditional great pizza taste.

I frequent the Redstone Tavern for dinner approximately twice per month.    The staff is always extremely helpful and friendly.    They have a great selection of reasonably priced items on the menu and I have always liked whatever I have chosen. I recommend the Red Stone to my friends and coworkers.   - Delia / Wayne NJ

I visited this place today and it was a very pleasant experience.  The customer service was great. I ordered the liver cleansing juice and PB&J smoothie - they were both delicious. I highly recommend this café to fellow vegetarians and people who love high quality juices.
Ahhhhhmazing! Had it for the first time and fell in love. It's a small place and very crowded on game days though so call in your order about 45 minutes in advance.

I have been eating here at least twice a month for the last 6 months and this place never disappoints. The homemade pasta is the best in the area. Everything is fresh, the owner is always there and it shows, everything is spot on.
Had one of the best brunches ever here when my husband and I stumbled in by accident. I had a quiche with salad that was exactly what I wanted. Good Sunday place in old city.

First time at Franklin Steakhouse after hearing mixed reviews. We came early on a Friday evening with a group of 9 including 3 children aged 4, 2 and 1. Service was just about perfect, very attentive waitress, runners and bussing. The menu is pretty big with typical steakhouse/pub fare and a decent draft and bottle beer selection. Unfortunately my first 2 draft selections were unavailable but I settled on a Sierra Nevada Pale Ale. For apps for the table we ordered the Calamari Trio which was fantastic - hot and tasty, steamer clams (special) which were plump and fresh, also piping hot. The non-seafood eaters and kids enjoyed a standard mozz stick/potato skin/chicken finger sampler which was average at best. I ordered the full rack of BBQ ribs and truffle fries. The ribs were not the meatiest, but hot, fall-off-the-bone moist and in a tangy and sweet BBQ sauce. The truffle fries were rich, crispy and amazingly flavorful. My wife had the Franklin Steak Sandwich, and my brother had the Sizzling Steak platter - both were thoroughly enjoyed. We skipped dessert but enjoyed an after dinner drink. Overall, moderately priced, nice portions of hot and tasty food served by a very attentive staff in a not-too-crowded bar/pub atmosphere. Would go again and recommend to others.
Good music and good Chicken waaangs!

Love love love this place. Wine selection is awesome as well as the beer! Never had a bad cheese here either. Could sit at their bar and sip wine and eat cheese all day long. Then maybe get a nice chocolate dessert to end the day
They seated other people before us even though we were there first. The fish tacos were okay, but there was too much tomatoes. Overall, the experience wasn't worth the wait.

New, impressive fit-out with incredible views. Our server was very sweet, but overall these guys have a long way to go before summer. The salads were not impressive, drinks took 15+ mins and one main meal was entirely forgotten, despite the dish being specifically recommended by our server. As a local, I really hope the service improves!
Overpriced and extremely bad service.  Did not have any many options and only 2 small baskets of chips and blad salsa for 9 people.
Probably my most favorite restaurant on the east coast. You have to plan in advance to get a seat here!
Great experience for the whole family. Great salmon roll sushi and spicy tuna also surprisingly good kimchi french fries, Washington square roll and other goodies.

Stopped in for an early dinner, and I doubt we'll be back. The food was so thoughtlessly prepared. The pappardelle seemed like it was left out on a warming table-it had a hardened layer of, well, something on the top and was tasteless-really visually unappetizing and super-bland. The crispy rice and salmon tartare is usually a favorite, but this, too, was flavorless and seemed like it was thrown together. During past visits, the food made up for the surly, bearded bartender-he's really talented, but he could.not.be.more.unfriendly. Now, though, I think we'll skip it altogether.

Beautiful vintage interior. Perfect place for brunch in the neighborhood. One of the best lamb burgers I have ever had. I think I tried most of the dishes and was never disappointed. Simple but good drink selection. Perfect neighborhood restaurant.

Parmesan sub was huge. Good value. Also had tuna salad. Very fresh veggies. Staff could have been more friendly. Took a long time for food even though we were the only ones there. But for the money was a good

I recently was christmas shopping and saw on the sign that they made Turkish Coffee. That is what first attracted me to go in this corner cafe. I was pleasantly surprised by the welcoming staff and authenticity of the baked goods. The owner is originally from Istanbul and I had a wonderful time speaking with him about the city over some hot Turkish coffee and delight. If you are looking for a quick cafe stop or somewhere to meet a friend, this is an awesome place to go!

This place was good years ago but its gone WAY downhill in the last couple years. Last couple times there the food was terrible. Last week I ordered a tuna melt that tasted - shall we say feculent? I sent it back and was surprised when the bill came that I was charged for it. I asked the manager about it and she said ""Sorry, I tasted it and it was fine. You need to pay for it..."" I can't recall ever being treated like that in a restaurant. \r\n\r\nOrder at your own risk, but they lost my business forever.

I used to frequent this bar often until I had a bad experience when I brought some friends. We were having a great time until the bartender gave us attitude and urged us to leave. They also refused to play hootie & the blowfish.

Do not eat sushi a lot but when I do I usually go to this place, only 5 minute drive from where I live and quick service! Pretty small place but never a problem with seating, I always enjoy the food when I get it from here XD Love anything with spicy mayo haha

I went there for Christmas lunch. I knew it would be unlikely that the "A team" would be working on Christmas Day so I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt. Things started slow when the hostess was too busy on the phone to mutter anything more than "just a minute" while extending her index finger in my face and stepping away on what appeared to be a personal call. Brushing that aside, we were eventually seated at a great table a and ordered a nice bottle of wine. Approximately five minutes later, the wrong bottle was brought to the table (same winery, different varietal). I explained the mistake and five minutes later, our server came to the table, wine list in hand, to double check.  I showed him the exact wine on the list. Five minutes after that, someone else came to the table and said that they didn't have that wine anymore. Fifteen minutes and no wine. Eventually we solved this riddle and we were able to have wine delivered to the table. Unfortunately, that did set the tone for the pace of things for the rest of the meal.  What was gauling was that the restaurant appeared to be fully staffed and servers and bussers were engaged in spirited conversations around the perimeter of the restaurant with complete disregard for the many tables that seemed to be looking around in vain hopes that food was wending its way to their tables. Food was hit and miss but I was so exasperated by the service that I am not sure I could even be objective. Suffice it to say we will NEVER go back, you should NEVER eat there and David Burke should have NEVER lent his name to this embarrassment of a restaurant. Epilogue: Open Table contacted me this morning to inquire why I no showed the restaurant yesterday. Seems the hostess was too busy on her call to correctly check off my reservation.
best goddamn authentic mex in this city! viva mulitas!!!!!!!!

The food is okay here. If you're lucky you'll come in on a good day and the food will be alright. The quality of the food isn't consistent. I started going to this restaurant every once in a while about three months ago. The quality of the food has steadily gone down since then. My favorite thing to get is the chicken shawarma sandwich. I got one this week and while i was eating it noticed the bread was really dry almost stale and i bit into some soft chewy pieces of chicken. I pulled out the pieces thinking it was fat, which i've never had on my sandwiches before. I looked closer and there were a lot of these pieces and they were pink in the middle. I certainly hope I don't get sick from this. I'm really disappointed in this place, because the food can be good but its like a 50/50 chance that it will be bad. The sauce that is put on the sandwich has also been watered down a whole lot. I hope this restaurant can turn things around but I doubt I'll be back. Overall I wouldn't recommend this place because they aren't always good and I'm disturbed by the quality of food from my last visit.

I am sorry thatI have to write such a negative review on this place.  I've been going to eat  at Roma's for the last twenty years.  Ever since they have expanded their location the service and customer has gone down hill.   Today was the last straw.  We went to Roma's for a family memorial dinner which reservations had been made for two weeks.  The bar tender had come to us  that Charlie the owner had tried  called but there was no phone number.. They were overbooked with private parties.

First off, I'm a Clifton resident of 28 years. This is my 3rd time going here in the past 2 years. Now I dunno what happened, I had 2 drinks and a burger. I never have issues when I have 2 drinks. This is y I think it's the burger. 2 hours after leaving I had a stomach ache. Got home about 10:30. By then I just wanted to go to bed. I ended up going to bed and tossed and turned for a bit hoping it would pass. Finally I was just about to fall asleep, then BOOM, I'm wide awake running to the bathroom. Yes I got sick. Very sick. I threw up a few times and then got diarrhea in the process. Finally I was done cleaned myself up then went back to bed. 1:30 am rolls along and boom round 2. I'm now finally back in bed its 1:45 am. I feel like shit and my stomach hurts. I almost wanted to go to the hospital before. I think the grande saloon kitchen is unsanitary and dangerous. It was the burger that got me sick.
awesome drinks and the bar tender Josh is the best!!
Love this place although the crowd is mostly yuppies and hipsters their food is awesome! Plus this has to be one of the best places to have yourself a mojito!
Wide array of food! Can't go wrong with a dinics roast pork or an Amish breakfast. The wait in line is worth it so don't get frustrated.

Let me start by saying we were EXTREMELY EXTREMELY disappointed with the service we had at Trattoria Dell'Arte Christmas Eve.  We have been there several times before for special occasions.  Our waiter was extremely unattentive to us and when we did ask for things we would get extremely rude and obnoxious remarks like " yes sir, anything you want sir with a bad a attitude and bad tone in his voice.  Again very unhappy with the service and will not go back to this restaurant again. Unfortunately I need to rate with only 1 star otherwise I wouldn't give it any stars.

The food here is wonderful and it definitely tastes like primo ingredients were used. Scallops were humongous and cooked well. Liver toast is rich. Deviled eggs surprisingly good. Chowder makes soup seem not so boring anymore. Extremely long wait was not enjoyable though.
This is my favorite lunch place in Princeton - The buffet lunch is cheap and extremely delicious. I love their paneers and the delicious naan. Yum!

We wanted Chinese food but the wait was way too long. After popping open the Yelp app we found this spot was right across the street. The food and the service were both great, with the wait staff constantly filling up our waters and checking in on us. We were put at the communal table in the middle and I will never understand how a restaurant expects you to sit on a stool without a seatback for an extended period and have a comfortable dinner, but we had a good crowd and so still had a good time. Definitely the best pad see ew I've ever had. My girlfriend had a fun twist on a classic dish - pad thai with the noodles made out of zucchini. Everything here felt very fresh and I would definitely recommend it to anyone in the area.
Overrated.   Tried their crab and pork dumplings with scallion pancake. Too salty and very greasy. :/

I had a fantastic time at parc. This is a large brasserie type restaurant right on Rittenhouse square. The chicken and French onion soup I can recommend. Great atmosphere and usually busy so make a reservation. In the summer months the outside seating is great and provides for some entertaining people watching
Great food! especially the pulled chicken sandwiches! Excellent service too. Anytime I needed a napkin, fork or more water - a waitress was right there! Cant wait to go again

I drove from Wisconsin and I am very very satisfied with TT Skewer. The skewers are so tender and juicy that i can feel the lamb/beef melting in my mouth. Moreover, the lamb/beef is magically preprocessed so that the skewers are very tasty even deep inside the lamb/beef chops. Also, this place is ideal for meat lovers like me coz I can enjoy varieties of skewers with unbelievably low price. Another highlight in TT Skewer is hot pot bowl. I found tons of things that I can put in my hot pot. My favorite includes cabbage, fish ball, tofu and seaweed knots. In sum, I wish I could move to Philadelphia and come here whenever I want. One thing for sure, I'll be back!

A wonderful tasty surprise when I was visiting Phili Chinatown. I had lamb skewer, chicken wings, squid and pork sausage. Lamb was soooo soft and juicy. Wings were different than any grilled wings I had before. Tender, fully-flavored but not greasy at all. My favorite is the squid. Genuine northeastern China style. I also tasted the hot pot bowl, the other main dish they had there. There were around 30 types of contains to choose from. The base soup is newly brewed using veal bones every other day. The taste is just just amazing. Strongly recommend it to anyone who want to try something "new, special and tasty" in Chinatown.

There's a lot of Diner options in West Haven and the surrounding areas but they're all mediocre in comparison to Duchess. Been going there ever since I was 2 with my family and now I've converted all my friends from Elm Diner which has been down hill in the past 5 years. Breakfast is definitely the way to go at Duchess. Foods great people are great locations not so great

Mamouns how I love you and all your locations. It never fails that at the end of a night of boozing I fill my belly here. The food is cheap and amazing even when I'm sober. There shwarma is delicious and I love the fact that the pita is kept simple with lettuce tomatoes and white sauce! I love the falafels too mmmm

Unfortunately my review can't be about the food at Michael Angelo's. We made reservations the Sunday before for the coming Sat. night. When we got there we were advised there was no such reservation for us. Although there were a few open tables we were not offered one. We left promising not to go back. About 10 minutes later they tried to call us to come back b/c they did find the reservation. We missed the call & after trying a few other places we settled on the first place that would take us in. I'm posted w/1 star but not because I wanted to, can't post a review without it.

Ordered the Italian Wedding soup.  The menu pictured showed a large bowl of soup with lots of escarole, white beans and 8 meatballs.  They brought me a small covered ramekin with three meatballs and five white beans (I counted).  Total rip off.
Everything we had was absolutely delicious. We will definitely be back.

Absolutely fabulous place.  I have never had haggis before, having heard all kinds of jokes about how bad it is.  Boy am I glad that I decided to try it out.  It was delicious.  I also had a bottle of the best hard cider that I have ever tasted.  My family and I plan to always dine here whenever we are in the area. My only request is that the kitchen stay open later than 9:00 PM on weekdays.

Stopped off here to grab a quick breakfast before my connection. Ordered the eggs with bacon and toast, along with an iced tea. I found the eggs and bacon to be cooked to my personal perfection and the tables are stocked with Dickinson's jam which was absolutely delicious with my toast. The prices were reasonable for an airport and the service was quick with no notable hiccups. I honestly can't wait until the next time I stop off at the Newark airport just to get a bite here again. My only ding against the place was that the front part seems pretty crammed, especially since most travelers are lugging large bags around with them.
Were there for the second time to enjoy their grilled octopus served in a tile, delicious! Also tried the portugese clams, delicious too. We'll return soon!

Omg!, I asked one of the waiters  who was older and had a pony tail to please take a picture of us ,  we were a table a four women, he said he would after we put our order  in ,  i asked him again shortly after and  ,he said after,   and then proceeded to say   if I wanted a different waiter to just ask for one. I couldn't believe it. Was that so bad to ask ?I just wanted one picture.  I'm a nice person I would  never  ask in a rude way.  I know so many spanish people that would have enjoyed this place ,  and i would have absolutely recommended this place. But why would I ,  I feel like I loved everything else but why would I come back. Never again, that was so rude , why would someone do that , for that reason alone I'm not coming back.  so thankyou but never again he made me feel really bad for a simple pic.

While the food is spectacular and one of the best I have had in the city, the staff is quite ride. The maitre-d is the worse, when you call to make a reservation he is temperamental and eager to get off the phone. He will cut you off before you are done and hang up. Definitely one of the rudest in the city.

A question was asked of the great Yankee, Joe DiMaggio quite some time ago. They asked him why he played so hard every day. He replied in essence that someone might be seeing me for the first time or the last time and he owed it them to be at his best. How does that relate to a restaurant? Well, when my wife and I attended Bleecker Kitchen & Co a few days before Christmas, it would have been nice if the restaurant would have heeded this advice.  Ordered the hangar steak, medium rare and it came out looking like 6 charcoal briquettes . Now, granted I would even give the benefit of the doubt if the restaurant were packed to the gills. There was one other person in the restaurant. One. Earlier in the meal, I asked if there was bread. "We don't have table bread, but I can have cut some up and bring it over" Translation- You are paying for the barest of essentials and even that is a chore.  I am neither a glutton or demanding patron but these two examples soured the evening. As we move on, my wife just needing some water had to see help staff in full teenage mode, furiously tapping away on their cell phones, perhaps candy crush, perhaps wishing a  long lost relative holiday cheer. Either way, not ideal. My wife's fish, again, overcooked which when you have two diners in the entire place, you think some extra care would have been taken. So as not to spew complete negativity, Bleecker Kitchen is ideally located, extremely cozy and overflowing with potential. If I can refer to my original thought, perhaps they mailed it in the week of Christmas.  new chef? not the prime time staff, etc. Whatever it might have been, it has to be acknowledged that when you leave that sort of taste is a patron's mouth, you have to wonder if this was an isolated issue or a pattern.
