That is for you to decide My advice -It is 2015 now, in a city full of countless restaurants. Put bread on the table. People eat bread, especially with wine. Making people pay for bread is like buying a car and finding out there is an extra charge for the steering wheel. It is bad enough they have ala carte. Just put the side item in with the meal and charge the added price. I don't want to build a meal. This combined with the no bread policy just screams "We are not bending at all, but you will." Waiter/waitress bus boys should not pace in front of patron's meals like an expectant vulture. I felt the need to scarf down my dinner in fear that a water shortage was imminent and the dishes had to be done. We were headed out for a nice night and that Bleecker Kitchen got us off on the wrong foot.

Tip: if you want a very good espresso drink, and the line is ridonculous at the corner starbucks, come here: and grab a pan au raisins while you're at it. I speak from experience (I work around the corner).
The best Thai noodle in NY.

As much as I hate dealing with Brooklyn traffic, I would do it again. Had the large round with pepperoni it was a 10, I couldn't find anything wrong with it. This place is worthy of your hard earned $. Just Go.

I may never order another pie with red onions. For 4 dollars you get 2 cents of sliced onions. Mind you, we've been ordering pizza from this venerable place for years, but finally I think I've learned my lesson.
Correction

Delicious!!! I went there with my husband on two occasions and both times we had a great experience. Favorite dishes: pork belly, tuna tartar, strawberry ribs. Dishes are small but delicious. We ordered 7 dishes for two of us and it was more than enough. My favorite drink by far is Red Pearl.
Beer is cold and food is good but been here half a dozen times and never had more than average service and most cases below average!! Don't be in a hurry and bring your patience!!

So this was my second time coming and how different it was than the first time!! I was extremely satisfied and more!!! The manager personally messaged me and gave our meal on the house next time we came because we were unsatisfied. Even that itself speaks volumes because they really want to keep the customers happy! As a disclaimer-- you can bring your own alcohol but they do not serve it. So please come prepared or just go dry! We got the BBQ+hot pot. We highly recommend the original and kimchee. The other soup flavors have cloves so if you bite into it, it may ruin your taste buds for a little. The meat was marinated great with tastiness! We had the beef and duck. Highly recommended. For hot pot-- we had a lot of seafood and beef with even more veggies. Our service was impeccable this time and I was happy. I didn't even show the free coupon until the end so they were so great. I would hope last time was a fluke. The only reason it wasn't a 5 is because of the alcohol which I know people can live without! We definitely spent a couple hours eating!!
The service was fantastic and the service was incredible. Definitely recommend this place! Can't wait to go back.
This is respectably good indian fare, but with a higher than deserving prices.

After reading all the reviews, I wondered if our group had landed in the wrong restaurant...but no, it was Landmarc in TriBeCa.  This was our first visit and we tried it for lunch.  I want to start my review by saying that the service was friendly and attentive and this is where our experience took a turn for the worse. We shared a 'Fried Calamari' and ' Lamb Meatballs'  which arrived cold and lukewarm respectively, both however were nicely seasoned.  Main course breakdown as follows: Two of us had the 'linguine alle vongole' $24 - a huge mound of pasta swimming in oil surrounded by eight very small  clams (yes, no kidding only 8 clams) no seasoning whatsoever...not even a grain of salt. 'Landmarc Burger' again totally bland, not a pinch of salt, salad nicely dressed, and good french fries. "Boudin Noir" with spinach and dried up roasted potatoes, again, everything was bland and in need of copious use of the salt shaker. The salt shaker seemed to be the most popular item at the table as we all kept reaching out for it. I will again compliment a very observant staff, they removed our more than half full plates without asking if something was wrong or if we wanted to take something home...!  Total damage to our wallet was $186 (excluding tip).
They were really rude and disrespectful. Don't choose this restaurant, they use to be good but now they've changed to become a very disappointed restaurant.
Great Thai food and the staff is always friendly to me. Don't ask for "hot" unless you want it REALLY hot! they will accommodate you if you like it mild or medium heat.
Food is good but received unfriendly response from the attendant. May be she is not in Christmas mood. Do not suggest for new peole

Let's start with the atmosphere, it's the only thing this place has going for it.  Our service was horrible and the food even worse.  Three of us had lunch and split an appetizer.  The calamari came out under cooked.  Had to chase someone down to send it back.  Then came the main course the burger was very bland and the roll was a couple days old.  The crab cake sandwich had no crab flavor to it and the parm sandwich was just gross.  With so many other options in west Hartford this one is off the list of choices. Worst part of the meal is the server never checked back to see how things were.

Still Cheating patrons...Containers have gotten smaller since last review. The daughter of the owner waited on me. You could see air pockets on the side of the container. They do not believe in filling containers to its capacity. Therefore, you get cheated at your expense. Don't waste your time to go here. They are blatantly taking advantage by giving you less product than what you pay for.
Wonderful diner with delicious and vast options and generous portions, friendly service. Will be back!

Asked waitress if I could plug my phone into the socket next to my table to charge it since I was at 9% after using it as my tour guide all day.  She kept making excuses.  Pizza was thin which was good but was too crunchy & got cold quickly.  Nothing special about this place.  Wanted to go to Lombardi's but had a line going out the door & on the street.  That place smelled really good.  Wish I waited!!!!
Excellent food, great service. Waiter Angelo is the best. My favorite Italian place by miles. High prices but worth it.
Very slow service...servers don't respond or treat u well...will never ever come again...its pathetic..wait for pizza is almost 3 hrs in the restaurant...

Long wait, but worth every minute, even though we had to rush to the airport. Neat atmosphere. Pork buns very tasty. Handmade noodles with the broth were full of flavor. Good sized portions. Sitting at the counter watching them work is fun.

i just moved to the neighborhood, and order take-out probably twice a week from Xiandu ......... I LOVE THIS PLACE OMG!!!!! Everything is so fresh and SOOO delicious. the staff is very nice and very accommodating (i have food allergies so it means a lot not to get an eye roll haha...) it's about time center city had a great thai restaurant :)

A good bar and grill located right in Midtown, off of the main avenues with a tight menu that hits the spot in so many ways. I recommend the sliders and the Mac and cheese...as well as the NY strip steak. I've been here before and would come here again.
NYC meal with NJ price! Definitely go for the tasting menu, which changes seasonally and you can't go wrong. The chef/staff/sommelier gets a 5 star; wine selection 3 thus for the 4 star review.
Dessert is much better then the dinner food. I would like to try all the desserts here.

We booked for Christmas dinner this year quite a while ago, to make sure we got a table. We got our table on time, although the greeters at the desk looked like they'd rather be elsewhere.  We waited a good 10 mins at the table before we were given a menu by the drinks waitress who explained that our main server was "really busy" with the huge table behind us. We ordered a spaghetti bolognese and a veal parm. The portions are huge but for $40 I would have expected the veal to be served on a bed of spaghetti to be honest. There were just 2 admittedly large, portions of veal. The spaghetti bolognese was plentiful, but overdone with the herbs and a little watery. Both our servers obviously finished their shifts during our meal, as we never saw them again.  We ordered dessert with our "new" server and literally waited a full 30 mins for it- looks like the kitchen shift changed as well?  Not impressive service Carmine's. Overall, the food isn't bad but certainly not great, but the service was the lowlight of the visit for us. Wouldn't rush back.
The burger with duck fat fries.  Jesus lord it's to die for. Hands down best burger I've ever had
Good food, friendly service.

A small, crowded restaurant with horrific waits. Food is phenomenal: meat and cheese plate may be the best anywhere. Beef carpaccio is rich, coq au vin is hearty, seasonal veggies are fresh and deliciously prepared. Dishes are small and shareable. Wine list is varied and interesting. Service is pleasant.

Food was excellent here. Some of the best pizza I've ever had. Why I give it 2 stars you might ask.... SERVICE! It was absolutely terrible waiter never came to the table needed a refill and that never happen. Then it took us 30 mins just to get our check. There is a lot lacking. It might have been around for a while but couldn't tell throw the service.

12/26/14   So disappointed!  went there with a nice bottle of wine tonight thinking of having a nice dinner and relax,,  NOT!    we got there at 7:30, placed our order around 7:40,   ordered appi and dinner,,  asked the waitress to take her time with the order,,  she said no problem,,  how about we had our appi and dinners all done by 8:20!  Appi came by 7:50,,  as soon as we were done the dinner came out by 8:05,,  I said to her I thought I asked you to take your time and we didn't want to be rushed,,  her answer was I thought you didn't want all the food at once?  REALLY?   didn't relax! and felt rushed,, I ordered the eggplant ,  it was the worst I ever had,,  it was dry and cakeie,,     my husband had the veal parm,, said it was ok,, I've been here a few times and thought food was pretty good til tonight,, waitress was inexperienced,,  rushed us and I didn't like spending 60 bucks in 45 min on not so great food,,   guess I wont be going back,,, Donna F

I'm here on my 27th birthday and the food is out of this world!  I think ET made it lol. The customer service is very good and the different types of meat they bring out is good as well! It's worth the $52.50.

Just paid 12 dollars here and I would have rather gone to a Ruby Tuesday's,  the food was so bad. I got a tasteless turkey burger that was dry, sweet potato wedges that were burnt, and the restaurant was desolate (barely occupied) and yet the wait was terribly long. Simply put, the food is not good here, and the only reason this restaurant survives is its location and ambiance ... This is food that, had I not paid for it, I wouldn't eat.
Absolutely the best pizza in the island.  I've been a loyal customer for many many years.  Wish they delivered!
We waited for more then 3 hours and still didn't get a table the waitress are terrible too

Our office had our company lunch catered from this place and it was amazing! Everything was really good and super fresh. The best part of it all, HANDS DOWN, was the rib eye and the mac n' cheese! The rib eye was so tender and full of flavor. The baked Mac n' Cheese was perfect with the right amount of cheese and bread crumb, not too overwhelming. It was definitely worth the order and it wont be the last time!
I get the BBQ chicken every time. Friendly staff, very casual fast food look and feel but the food is excellent.
Went on the 2nd night of their pop up shop in LIC and it was fantastic. The broth has incredible depth with a slight muskiness to it. Delicious! Buns are to die for...

This is amazing. I had the mixed gyro and chicken over rice, that was amazing with the white sauce, yum! However, I do think they need to friendly remind customers that the hot sauce is really spicy. I had a bite and I was crying. It was soooooooooo spicy! But the food was really good, you can see a long queue from distance but it was quick and fast.

A visitor might not go to all the effort to find this place, but that's what I like to do when visiting a new city. Eat where the locals eat. So many choices, I am sorry I could only enjoy one meal. We were able to walk there from our hotel. They only take cash, but there is an ATM at the entrance. Keeps the prices down. So worth the hunt. Needed to walk back to hotel as I ate enough for two. I read a review where the person said the noodles seemed to multiple as she ate. I totally agree! Very clean and brightly lit.

So we have been wanting to try the classic roast pork sandwich (with broccoli rabbe and provolone) ever since it won the title of The Best Sandwich in America, and it did not disappoint!!!! It was amazing!!!! I highly recommend it!!!!

Well, let's start with the positive. Really nice location. Attractive interior and good service. It just looked like it would be great! Sadly, it wasn't. My mother, a friend and I visited on a Friday night around 7:00 pm. We were the only ones in the place. This was a BAD omen. I choose a burger called the fire expecting something flavorful and juicy and for my side, sweet potato chips. My friend had the same and my mother choose the sliders. The food came out quickly and looked appetizing enough. Again, appearances can be deceiving. The brioche roll was as hard as a rock. The burger was well overdone and the chips were soggy and coated with a sickening amount of balsamic vinegar that leaked through their basket and onto the table. Absolutely nothing had flavor. I was starving and choked it down out of necessity and limited time but didn't enjoy a single bite. My mother and friend's experiences were similar though my friend seemed to enjoy her duck fat fries. Perhaps I'm spoiled living in Western Mass with an amazing selection of hamburger joints here but this place just doesn't deliver. A $12.00 or $13.00 sandwich SHOULD be very good. This place just wasn't. It was the first and last meal we will have here which is sad as it's location is so convenient and we visit the city regularly.

Reservation doesn't work.  After making a reseravation a week prior, they made my grand parents and young kids stood outside in the cold for an hour.  Screwed up our drink order like 5 times.  (we tried to communicate in mando, canto, english, they still screwed up).   Finally food came, but they ran out of pots... so some of us had no pot to cook.  They gave us free tea to compensate for that.. wow thank you.  bill came out to $400+.. we gave $50 tip.. waited asked for more, because we were $4.55? shy of 15%... seriously?  food is not nearly as good as it used to.  some of the veget had soil/dirt on it.. make sure you look before you cook it.. table of 10, 4 of us had diarrhea.. worth the time, money, and pain.  never again.

I went to this buffet today with high hopes. Here are some things I am not satisfied with: 1. They did not have a variety of fruits. 2. The cheesecake had more cake than cheese. 3. They did not have a lot of food for the grill section. 4. Their service wasn't the best. However, I am glad to have tried this resturant----I won't be coming back. They had a nice Christmas tree though!

Ordered the chicken noodle soup when i was sick. They put the noodles in with the broth so by the time I got home there was no broth. The noodles sucked up all the liquid. This is why take out places always put the noodles on the side! It was inedible. I called back and the man told me I could order it again sometime and it would be on the house. I thought to myself ok good but that doesn't help me now. Months have gone by and I ordered the soup again. Picked it up, no cilantro, no lime, no sauce. Noodles were separate this to!e because I specifically asked. I called again to ask where was the rest of the stuff that comes with the soup? The woman was rude rude rude! I said I wouldn't be order ng again and she that's fine and hung up! Terrible customer service. No respect for their customers. The food is good but they don't know how to run a restaurant or how to take care of their customers. Not to mention its the day after Christmas. I've never been treated so poorly before. Do not go here ever!!!!? Zero stars for their attitude and unwillingness to right their wrongs!
Tried a couple of coffees here after reading all the 5 star reviews but was severely disappointed.

Awesome ! Can't believe we found an authentic Puerto Rican restaurant. El trifongo was delicious, as was the churrasco.  Prices were very reasonable. And the service was superb from the moment we walked in.

We had a reservation for my cousin's 30th birthday the day after Xmas.  We confirmed the reservation beforehand...showed up and they were closed!!!  It looked like they were closed for repairs, possibly for the holdiays.  Regardless, who does that without informing the people that have reservations?!?  It's the most unprofessional thing I have ever seen out of a restaurant.  We ended up going to Stella, who were gracious enough to accommodate 10 people on short notice.  They said they had a party come in the week before that faced the same predicament.   Zero stars - bunch of amateurs.

Like other reviews point out but poorly state, this place can provide a little bit of everything.  I have been here for a quick bite (small plate offerings, and the food is amazing) I have been here late night to dance and have a great time.  I have also been here with my company for a small gathering where they catered our event.  I also want to point out they have a patio for out door enjoyment when the weather is nice.  Everytime I have been the service has been top notch, very accomodating, and consistent.  The drinks and specials are great, and the food is unbelievable.  If you have not been definitely need to check it out.

After reading many of the reviews-- and having had scores of Geno's steaks over the years,  I think the trick is to courteously tell the order taker EXACTLY how you want your steak sandwich!   Yes,  the staff are true South Philly types, but despite their ATTITUDE [like some police], if you treat them with great respect- they will accommodate you and eventually actually be nice! I never could understand how anyone could prefer Pat's, across the street... As to their obnoxious, distasteful signs,  never could figure that out.    Always thought it might just be a way to gain attention and advertise themselves [which worked,  I understand when they first put their anti Spanish signs up,  business increased dramatically due to large TV local AND national coverage-- no other logical reason as it clearly must antagonize a lot of people... seems crazy but I guess if you are in tremendous demand you can be as obnoxious as you want. That said,  I've never had a Jim's or Tony Luke's, but the reviews seem to say they are better.   I'll try them and let you know.

While Amin A couldn't be more wrong, Geno's does not cut their steak up while Pats does. To all the bad reviews on here I say this..... Why is there a line here 24-7? They clearly do something right. BYW you're not food critics... Don't forget that.
Amazing brunch and big portion too. Waited for r0 minutes but so worth it and there is a Morrocan cafe right in front so waiting was no problem at all

Fantastic food. I had the pancakes with berries and my son had the hash & scramble wrap. Both entrees were fresh and very filling. I could not finish the pancakes due to the large portion size (my son took care of that). Real maple syrup, of course, and cinnamon "butter". There are gluten-free options and a variety of baked goods. We'll definitely be back.

As a Newark resident I am always excited to hear about new restaurants opening, we heard about Alva Tavern and decided to give it a try.  From the staff, drinks, and food, everything was fantastic.  Our bartender was attentive but not overwhelming, every drink we ordered from the cocktail menu he took a lot of time preparing and you could tell they really cared about pouring a good drink.  We ordered the burger and lobster roll for dinner.  The burger was cooked perfectly and the fries were amazing, the lobster was good quality and was great as well.  The restaurant itself was really impressive and they did a great job preserving the old building that they occupy.  It seemed that they basically built the restaurant around the old bank vault that was there and you can still see the old vault door with the marble that surrounded it, the bartender said they make the pizzas in the vault now.  Overall it was a nice experience and I really hope this place picks up and does well.  We will definitely be back, tell your friends and go there!!

Rudest check in ever. Completely unwelcoming. Refused to honor a reservation because we were delayed a few minutes. The charm of a wet blanket.  We were treated as if they were doing us a favor by seating us.

The flatbread was soggy and I got food poisoning after eating at this place. There was a mouse that ran across the floor of the restaurant  and when I told the waitress she didn't seem surprised and told me that they have been trying to get that mouse for months!? Buy a mouse trap- it's not that hard! Stay away from this establishment!

In my book, Goodbye Fatness, Hello Gorgeous, I mention that I am looking for places that serve great food with "less guilt."  And this is the place!  I lost 125 pounds and I do not wish to gain it back.  This is a place that allows me to enjoy a lower calorie/fat dining experience.  Nothing is swimming in butter or rich sauces, yet the dishes are tasty. I had a sesame salmon salad.  It was a generous piece of salmon and the salad had the perfect amount of dressing.  I tried some of my son's burger and it was moist and delicious!  Desserts are served in shot glasses and are amazing.  It is just enough of a sweet treat instead of the big, fattening slab of cake.  The server was very nice and the dining experience was very enjoyable.  Will return again!
Great neighborhood spot, intimate setting, and great food, most especially their filet is unbelievable!

Use to be my go to pizza spot! The caprese is now $7 !! Last time I ordered it there was hardly any topping and it was melted on? That's new.. Maybe to disguise the fact that there wasn't enough topping? No Bueno
Best cheese steaks ever.. Fast  service Great area. Tons of  parking I swear by them

A friend of mine recommended I check this place out. I usually go to the lower lower side of Manhattan for good Indian food so I am now thankful to have found a good Indian restaurant so close to home. The food is good and consistent. Never had a disappointing dish. Pricing is fair for what you get. They also have a great lunch buffet for $9.95. My wife and I go to dinner here at least once a month. If you are a fan of Indian food give this place a try I don't think you will be disappointed.

This is my husband and mine's favorite restaurant! We love the garlic bread fondue as an app, they have nightly specials as well as rotating specials so there is always plenty to choose from. Monday's offer a great meatloaf sandwich and Tuesday's offer an amazing Mac and cheese that you will never finish in one sitting. Regardless if you get pasta, a meat dish, sandwich, or seafood you will not be disappointed. Great atmosphere and great staff!
It is alright. Good service and food. The place is kind of noissy sometimes. But overall it is good.

Went here on the day after Christmas for a mid-afternoon snack. In terms of aesthetic this place is top notch...service is SERIOUSLY lacking though. We ordered 18 oysters since they have such a wide selection and there are taste profiles for each oyster on a card on the table. Excited to try a variety we told the waiter to make a selection for us. We also ordered cocktails and a pretzel. It took a bit to get drinks and a bit longer to get the oysters. Our waiter came back with a ticket listing the pairs of oysters we had on the platter and we dug in. Oysters were great, shucked perfectly with good sauces. Unfortunately, there were only 14 of them...we had ordered 18. We actually didn't notice until the bill came and a variety we hadn't had was listed and then we recounted the ticket that came with the platter and there were only 14 on that. So ordered 18, served 14 and charged for 16. It was tough to get a hold of our waiter so we flagged down a manager who pushed back on us that we had eaten 16 but eventually they took it off the bill. We also never received the pretzel that was ordered at the same time as the oysters. We asked about it after a half hour and was told it was coming but it never materialized after an hour so we cut our losses and had them cancel it. I'll give this place another go after they've been open a little longer but whatever system they use to fire orders is having a communication breakdown. One really important thing to note is that there are only 4 stalls in the ladies room. Even on a light afternoon there was a line, I fear what the line will be like if this place is ever at capacity.

Very disappointing. We eat frequently in Burlington from Hen of the wood to Kens pizza, they missed the mark in a big way. I usually would give a newbie (not so much in this case since they run other shows in town) a second chance but not in this case

Horrible. Ordered from Xi'an through GrubHub and was told an hour wait on their website.  After and hour and 45 minutes, I get a phone call to come downstairs to my lobby to get the food. Are you kidding me? I paid $2.00 extra for delivery because I didn't want to leave my apartment. Two hours after ordering, I finally sit down, starving, ready to devour my food. It is soggy and disgusting. General Tso's chicken isn't that hard to screw up so I don't know what they did to it but it was awful. No heat, all sweet and just a soggy mess. Again, I was starving, and I still couldn't even eat this. I immediately ask GrubHub to return it. The restaurant tells me I can bring it back. Again, what part of delivery do you not understand? Clearly they understand nothing since they refused to come pick it up so in the trash it went along with my money. The next day GrubHub calls the restaurant to get a resolution and they ask if I still have the food so they can come pick it up and give me a $20 credit toward my next meal there. Yea, I kept your nasty food that you refused to pick up last night just in case I wanted to try to return it again the next day. And by the way, my food was $32.17, not $20. At any rate, I definitely don't want the credit since I'll never be eating at Xi'an again. They are beyond rude and the food is just awful. There are plenty of  good restaurants in Chinatown, Xi'an is not one of them.

I've eaten at many Italian and Italian fusion restaurants. None of them top Eataly. I had the beef tortellini in mushroom sauce and my friend had the gnocchi. Both were so delicious and the wine complemented the meal beautifully. Our waiter Anthony was so great. Super helpful in answering all of our questions and very attentive. I will definitely be coming back.

Well, we've given Grazer's three legitimate tries and won't be back.  The first time we went, it had just opened.  It was a nice night and the place was full.  The service was slow and poor - we waited an hour for food and had to get our own drinks.  But we chalked that up to inexperience and have since been trying to find a reason to like the restaurant.  However, each time we've been back, it's been the same experience regardless of how busy the place is.  Last night it was empty (just my family and two others).  The staff is untrained (host/hostess and waitstaff alike), the service is as painfully slow and poor as any I have ever experienced, the food is marginal and they run out of menu items seemingly all the time (yet the wait-staff doesn't tell you until you order it).   Two out of the three times we've eaten there, they've given me no choice but to leave NO tip - now that's pretty bad.   It's a shame - the location is perfect and they've done a great job with the theme and interior decor.  But at this rate, Grazers likely won't be around long and is a waste of prime commercial real estate.  Bring on a worthy Maple Tree tenant!

Comparable to any of the best steak places - at an amazing price.  Beautiful meat, perfectly cooked.  Great sides.  And an awesome little bar tacked on the side for a pre dinner drink.  Get there early - lines around the block

Bar and atmosphere is good, but food is not very Thai, too saucy and bland.  I had basil chili chicken, and there was no perceptible basil, but zuchini slices (yuk). If i go there again, i would ask them to prepare in traditional Thai manner, not Bayonne manner!
Andrea's is the best place of it's kind. I go there every time I come home and am always blown away!
Great place for sushi, appetizers are delicious the hamachi radish, snapper cucumber great for no rice sushi. Good for kids atmosphere was a little romantic.

Let me tell you all of the hideous things on tonight's visit: The waft of industrial strength bleach and bathroom cleaner which hits you in the face as soon as you walk in. How someone who works there hasn't noticed it is beyond me. Smells like a bathroom stall. The beer list where you order three beers off their "huge craft beer list" and they have none of them. When they do get your fourth choice, they charge you full price and when you get another of the two beers they have left, they don't give you a fresh glass to drink it in. The Mrs Ts style microwaved perogies they charge 5.99 for. Cardboard served Luke warm with warm glue-like mush inside. Appetizing. The undercooked tater-tots which taste like the oil they cook everything in and probably dates back to 2013. The fatty undercooked Ruben they have the gaul to charge $11 for. And this is a placed said to host a great St Patrick's Day party at??? Please!!! The ambiance of a strip club with the clientele and wait staff to match. I know it's Hamilton, but c'mon. No wonder we were the only folks in the dinning room after 9pm. Says a lot about the locals and what they like. Last time for me for sure.
Food was great and for being opened for a relatively  short period of time the place looks fantastic! Great service and atmosphere.

made us wait outside even though the dinning room was not crowded. Not sure if they use this method to show the place for potential customers outside. But Ill never go back or recommend it...The food is below average and I really do not care who used to eat in this place

My red snapper was dry. The waiter was over imposing and disappeared for a long period. The prices just  did not justify the overall quality of service. In summary overpriced food for average food quality. I was expecting better. Disappointed .
The Kerala food here is amazing. We drive over an hour to eat here and always worth it.
Love having brunch here! The eggs Benedict are delicious! The Bloody Mary is way too spicy for me, so I always get the mimosa. Love the French coffee.
Had many meals here and take out as well, always great/friendly service. Great BYOB spot and very good Thai food as well.
The food was good with a reasonable price. They offer breakfast specials and other daily specials.
If you ask for spicy, you WILL get spicy. Very affordable and quick with your order. The cha siu banh mi is where it's at for me, though they have a nice variety of other fillings too.

Had the crab puppies ( good) and the fried chicken ( not so good). My husband had the buffalo wings ( ok) and the rasta pasta (good but a bit to spicy). The server was nice but service was slow. Like others have already stated,  the music so loud we had to shout at each other. We'll try it again.
Hershel's Deli has the best Pastromi sandwiches and they treat you like a king

Whether you are going for prepared food or for ingredients, this is a must stop for anyone in town. It can get crowded around the usual times, but the finds and the fresh produce, along with the immense variety of food stands to choose from will make it worth your while.

First time in Philadelphia and I'm amazed! This place was awesome. A little overwheling, but that just means you get to try something new everyday. If I lived here I would absolutely shop at the farmers market and other shops. Everything looked so fresh and delicious. Very cool place. A must see (and eat!)

This is my second visit here and I think I could cheerfully spend a whole day here, aside from the crowds! What an amazing selection of wonderful food! We started with breakfast at Pearl's which even has real maple syrup. We stocked up on sausages, cheeses and baked goods and drooled over coffees, crepes and beautiful mountains of fresh produce. I love this place!
I would have given a higher score because I like their chinese dishes. I was.disappointed with their japanese dish the ingredients wasn't as fresh as I expected.

With a culturally and dietary-requirement diverse group, we wanted something that wouldn't be diner food yet appeal to the vegetarian, the chili-addict, the low-carb watcher and everything.  We were all on the verge of being totally hangry, and  Cabana did not disappoint.  It was amazing. Everyone loved their dishes, the flan was a great way to cap off the dinner, and the drinks were fab.  The portions are ample, and the service is efficient.  It's definitely a place that is good for many types of groups--even those with kiddos.  It would be ok for a date, but I'd say it wouldn't rank as a "romantic" place, but if the way to a man's heart is through his stomach, then he'll love Cabana!  :D

So glad I found this place! The Spotted Pig is an awesome place to spend your evening. They don't take reservations (which in some ways is nice, you don't have to plan far in advance to come here). The kitchen opens for dinner around 5 or 5:30, so that's when my group got there to put our names down for a table. We were seated by around 6:15 or so. In the meantime we enjoyed some drinks at their bar. The menu changes every day, so they really think through their menu. We had their chicken liver on toast, squid soup (more squid than soup), crispy pig ear salad, seared mackerel with sweet potato mash & house cured pancetta, grilled skirt steak with delicata squash, hazelnuts, and yogurt dressing, and wild striped bass with roasted cauliflower. They err on the "rare" side of medium-rare, just FYI. Our waitress let us know this beforehand, so we ordered the steak medium and it ended up being what we considered medium-rare. Everything was amazing, well-prepared, fresh, good service, etc. The Spotted pig is laid back, cozy, and very welcoming. I look forward to coming back again!

2nd night in the Big Apple and after a disappointing 1st night dinner we wanted to try the best they can offer in Chinatown.  Check yelp and this place have an outstanding review.  When we got there the wait is an hour.  And bec there were about 50 people waiting in line to get in, we decided to wait and give this place a try.  Xiao long bao or soup dumpling was our main purpose and this is our favorite food and boy oh boy what a big disappointment.    The taste is   bland.  Most of the customer have to share table with strangers which I don't mind if the food is worth it.  Hing Kee in Chinatown Chicago has better Xiao long bao or soup dumpling.  Their other food are ok and nothing special.  What makes their food taste better is bec of the MSG.  You'll know because an hour after eating you will be very thirsty even though you had already drank a lot of water.  Beware you've been warned.
A nice place for Chirstmas lunch! The place is a little dim. Food is in good taste and looks nice!
Great food and drinks, and very nice ambiance - especially in warmer weather when you can sit outside
Not bad, I went there a couple times. They are friendly and food is good. Recommended.

Love their pizza and antipasto. Best in town. Owner/employees are very nice. There are too many pizzerias in town to count, but this place is easily top 3 in Bayonne in terms of a standard non-artisan pizza. I recommend without hesitation.
this resturant with the authentic hawaiian cuisine  and onomea was great the ahi tuna rolls is good tasty but it just too much rice,, but the dessert coconut custard are very good !

Let me start by saying we have tried Butcher Bar at the LIC Flea as well as the Astoria Flea and we were blown away by the brisket so when a Groupon became available we jumped on it. The site suggests you call for reservations and when I called at 5:45pm and asked if I needed a reservation for 6:30 the girl who answered told me no. So, off we go and when we arrive at 6:30 I was asked if I made a reservation and I told her I was the person who called and you told me I didn't need one. She then tells me it will be a 15 to 20min wait. Wait, what?? Really?? I didn't want to ruin our date night so we went to the bar to have a drink and wait. The bar tender was really nice and we enjoyed our beers. So, 20min later we were seated. Moral of that story is don't listen to whoever answers the phone, just make a reservation to avoid starting your evening pissed off. So we sat, very excited to order our brisket. Our waitress came over, introduced herself and handed us our menus. She was super nice and during our entire meal very attentive. I ordered the Philly cheese brisket sandwich which was ok. The cheese sauce that was poured over the brisket really lacks in flavor but the sautéed onions were spot on. The bun was fresh and the cole slaw was amazing! The fresh pickle was another highlight and the side order of mashed potatoes we shared were really tasty. My wife leads a gluten free life so she ordered the beef brisket sandwich without the bun. The brisket was super dry! There were no juices oozing all over her plate like when we had it at both Flea's. It was very flavorful but dry as hay. Did I say it was dry...Dry, dry, dry...Like it had been sitting under a heat lamp at a catering hall dry. So, she put some coleslaw on top with each bite to cut the dryness. Dry I say, dry. So with the meal behind us we were asked if we would like the complimentary apple cake and we said sure. Now, as part of the Groupon it says the cake is part of the Groupon at $3.99 so it made me wonder is it complimentary for everyone or did our waitress just use the wrong word. Had she said "As part of the Groupon you get dessert as well and it's ___" Anyway, you get the point. The cake was ok but very small. If I had ordered it and it came to the table I probably would have sent it back for that price point. So, sad to say we will never go back to this restaurant because it didn't even come close to what we had at the Flea's. We will definitely look forward to next Summer when the Flea's reopen so we can have that awesome fresh brisket again oozing with juicy goodness.

I went there because it was featured in one if the travel channel shows. Definitely not the best Sicilian or pizza in Brooklyn. The service was terrible and the pizza was cold. We ordered a shrimp parmigiana and that was cold too... Money was totally wasted. Travel channel should do a little more research.

Been going to Scottos since 1976 and it has always been great. Went today and picked up a pepperoni pie, plain pie, and a chicken parmigiana roll as always it was absolutely great. Thank you for all the years of great food.
Have dined in and taken out many times, great service and excellent sushi. Also the Korean tacos are amazing!
this is how I imagine heaven to be. a menu full of the most amazing dishes. and lobster galore.
Great slaw!  Awesome service.  Very friendly and good food.  Skip Molly's and come here instead.
Very friendly place with great food at a reasonable price.  Their buffalo wings are excellent as is the mac n' cheese.
Hands down the best place to get an arepa in NYC.
The meal was astonishing. The sushi just melts in my mouth. So stop reading this review and go to Sushi Yasuda for the best sushi you'll ever get. 5 stars out of 5 stars. This place is awesome.

The front of house here represents all that is snobby in the village. We knew going in that it was cash only. Got there at 7:15pm because we had a large party of 7 coming at 8. They took our name and said it would be about 30 minutes. Everyone arrived by 7:30, and our 7 party group reduced to 5. They told us then it would be another 30 mins, or 8pm. By 8:30 we were getting hangry. Went to check on status and the hostess was extremely rude. She said I told you an hour and look at all these people in front of you. I said this is my birthday dinner and you told us minutes and we're now going on 90. She shrugged. We left and will not be back.

This place is so good it made me want to join yelp. Tacos to die for and prices that are inexpensive. It is so much better than surrounding places that it should be a before and after to any natural history trip. Thanks.

The best pizza in Bayonne if you eat in restaurant. For some reason I feel it loses the taste when you have it delivered or takeout. When judging in terms of dining in, hands down the #1 pizza slice in town.

Excellent food Exception service Imaginative combinations Was there yesterday with a party of 7 We could not have been happier Only negative comment:  the French toast is fried...it should say that On the menu. Otherwise, it was perfect. I have read the negative reviews....I guess you can't make everyone happy Waitress was outstanding
Very cool atmosphere but the drinks are only soso and you can say the same about the food. Overall the place is ok but a lot more glitz than actual substance.

I went there with family and kids at Xiao Long Bao for lunch, and we all love it. We have a mix of spicy and non-spicy dishes.  We ordered a few noodle soup and from their set lunch menu. Potion size of which is just right, with just rice and the dish plate, and nothing of the nonsense stuffs that I wouldn't even touch. We also order the Kung Fu Xiao Long Bao, and pan fried dumplings, to share. I'm quite impressed by the xiao long bao which is juicy in the inside, and the bao skin is thin yet strong enough to hold the juice/soup inside. Service is friendly and attentive. Prices are very reason, with set lunch menu under $10 ($7.95 per), and noodle soup, xiao long bao, and dumplings all under $13. We were in the neighborhood and just walk. Public transport (metro) is convenient enough, though I wouldn't drive into the area just for the meal. But if I'm in the vicinity, I would surely try it again.

Small and cosy place serves fresh food. Choice is simple-salads, sandwiches (who would have thought that turkey, brie, green apple and mustard belong that well together!), as well as pita and mac&cheese. OK, we were very hungry-but it was delicious. Very friendly service.

Ordered food from here a bunch of times in the past, but they screwed up my order so many times and charged me more than the menu stated.  Decided to give them another chance after 1yr or so, and same story. Quality is good but they consistently screw up take out orders.  Also, this is the 3rd time it has happened, they charged me more than the price on the menu, told me food prices went up.  For a $20 dinner, they would charge $22 or $23 saying, it is what it is.  That's a scummy move, would never give them my business again. Oh yeah, and they packaged my food in bag without putting the container lids on top and the sauce leaked all over my car.  I called to let them know, they said it is what it is.  As long as the food wasn't ruined, they don't care.

Coming from Brooklyn,  they bring back the delicious food s of my youth. Been there dozens of times. Sandwiches rule and the pasta is amazing. The bread is the best in the area. Catering is tremendous! !!!

Our meal at Narcissa was the worst experience of our New York stay. It was not only disappointing, it was also unpleasant. My partner and I are both vegan, and so tend to stick to vegan restaurants. Narcissa was chosen however by friends of ours for their small wedding dinner. Our friends had previously contacted the restaurant by email to ask if they could cater for vegan guests, and they were assured that this would be no problem. When we arrived however, it was a different story. The waiter was overtly offensive when we asked him what our vegan options were, initially huffing loudly, flicking his hair back, shrugging and stating there was nothing we could eat there. When our friends explained that they had been previously told there would be no problem, the waiter replied huffily 'Well you were misinformed'. He then went and spoke to the chef, returning to tell us we could choose from a mushroom risotto, the beetroot entrée (without horseradish cream) or the sea bass main (without the sea bass). The sea bass main was listed as coming with lentils and vegetables, which interested me. Having worked in high-end hospitality for many years, I knew that the usual practice if guests asked for an item to be omitted from a dish, was that they are provided with more of the other items, to ensure a full meal is received. I therefore ordered the 'veganised' sea bass, anticipating a bowl of lentils with vegetables. My partner selected the beetroot entrée as a main. In the meantime, we had finished the pre-dinner drinks we had brought from the bar, but were offered no further drinks. The single exception to this was that at one point a waiter (not the rude one allocated to our table) crept up behind my partner and whispered to her whether she would like another glass of wine, to which she answered 'yes'. He then crept away without offering further drinks to the rest of the table. She received her second glass of wine, but the rest of us were left with no drinks for the remainder of the evening. After a long wait (roughly 30-35 minutes), our meals arrived. My main amounted to four pieces of partially-cooked cauliflower and about a tablespoon of lentils. Nobody at the table was offered bread at any stage. The quality of the meals my partner and I had was pleasant, but insubstantial. When our waiter returned to check on the meals I told him they were not sufficiently good to compensate for the time taken to get them, to which he spun around without comment and strode away from the table. He later returned to the table and told me that I should have gone to Angelica's Kitchen (a famous NYC vegan restaurant), making it very clear that vegans are not welcome at Narcissa, and that we should eat with our own kind. The real kicker of the evening, however, was when the bill arrived. I had been charged $29 for four pieces of cauliflower and a tablespoon of lentils - the full price for the entire sea bass main. At that point, I called over someone who appeared to be in charge. He agreed with me that the bill was unfair and said he would deal with it. Then a further manager returned with the revised bill (my meal entirely removed from it), and apologised nicely for the error. He asked how the rest of the evening had been, so I expressed to him how bad it was. He again apologised and then removed the bar tab from the bill as well. While it was too little too late to save the evening, at least management did respond appropriately. The waiter and chef, however, were clearly offended by our veganism and behaved in overtly hostile ways towards us. I reiterate that our friends were previously assured the kitchen could provide perfectly well for vegans, but this was definitely not the case. It was hands down the worst experience of my NY vacation.

Been going here for years. Only like their Hotdogs and Hamburgers. Onions rings are great too. However, was surprised that I have never noticed this but the take out area where the cashier cooks the hot dogs does so without gloves and without washing her hands after touching money, etc. I'll still go there, I may say something eventually.
The calamari and chicken franchise were excellent.  People were very friendly and service was excellent.

What. happened?? Food used to be great, and now it's horrible - the recipes changed? Even the salad is chopped badly with different dressing. Used to be a 2-3x a week go to. After the past two orders arriving messed up, Not bothering to order again.

Campania has redeemed itself! I waited a while before updating this review because I wanted to make sure all the positive changes that I have seen where going to be long lasting. A few weeks after my terrible experience my husband convinced me to give it another chance so I did. He chatted with the manager and it turns out they had actually read the review I had posted and made some major changes in the way they do their staffing and in their management staff. I am happy you say that several months later these changes are still in place and we again enjoy a wonderful dining experience every time we go. The problems with delivery orders have been rectified as well and they never forget to send any of the little extras we request (like the balsamic glaze). The food continues to be of the highest quality and very tasty. I really appreciate the fact that they do read these reviews and work to address issues that are truly a problem. Campania has regained my business and my loyalty and we continue to proudly bring friends from outside the neighborhood there for a tasty quality Italian meal that won't break the bank. The pasta specials are often quite wonderful and their secret recipe sangria is fabulous (if they bottled it and sold it from the restaurant I'd swing by after a tough day at work and buy a jug--it's that good). Well done Campania!

Did not have any issues with service and delivery time was fine. Issue is my entire family who did not all eat one item (meaning multiple items were tainted) came down with violent food poisoning. Completely knocked us out of commission with vomitting, extreme joint pain, weakness, abdominal pain, fever and pretty much every other awful thing that can happen from food poisoning for the next day and a half. Will never eat here again and strongly recommend others do not either.
Friendly owner & workers! Had the fatburger! Note to self you must be really hungry to eat the whole thing!! Very flavorful nonetheless! I'd go back again!

Great looking Mediterranean restaurant  on East village , but for the waiting to be seat take long time, the place is quite and foods all are delicious and absolutely recommend to stopping by again with my group friends ....
#delicious #cozy #had the meat lasagna and the salmon #affordable prices #delicious #goodforhotdates #or good with hanging out with a couple on their date #pannacottababy

Rarely do i comment on a restaurant. .being a San Antonio girl who recently  moved to Vermont I've had a taste of "Vermont " BBQ from another popular spot in Whiteriver Junction  (name rhymes with patties )..so naturally I had my opinions about sampling BBQ from another Vermont place..I stumbled upon this place thinking it was a full restaurant that i had a coupon for..walked in. .its a country store..I said."sorry..thought you were a  restaurant "..he said.."I sell BBQ..would you like  some.. (thinking about my last experience. .i said NO THANKS)..he said. .just try a small  sample of my brisket..again..i said no..about to leave..them turned around and said okay..A SMALL SAMPLE..he went to the back..came back with about 4 slices of brisket. .i tasted a small piece..people when I  tell you this  was one of the BEST brisket I've  EVER tasted (remember. .Texas girl here) this man..who cooks on those precious smokers outside his "country  store " has a GIFT and its BBQ..I  mean a real gift...you know the kind when people CARED about the product they put out...So..after tasting the brisket..he offered a sample of pulled pork..OMG!..melt on ya mouth Tennessee style tender..so of course . what's next..RIBS... (faints )..I FINALLY FOUND THE SPOT FOR BBQ.  Competition quality BBQ..BOY IS GIFTED...I almost don't want to expose my find..cause i know when people get turned on  to this spot..he gonna sell out..quickly. ..daily...but imma become his best friend  so I can always call him to save me a plate..

Great food, great service .. If you plan on getting there at 12pm on the dot, go a little earlier for less of a wait. The place is PACKED at lunch which to me points towards the great food and service. I go there once ever week or every other week. The prices are very affordable

I love this place! This is the second time I have been here!! I was very lucky to find it again!! They sit you wherever you fit at any table with other people! They give you hot tea and a menu! You have to flag down staff to order because they are so busy! Once you order, the food comes fast! They have roasted ducks hanging in the kitchen! Everything I order is good! Wonton soup with duck, duck with vegetables, spring rolls, soup with shrimp, chicken and vegetables ! It's all good ! They only take cash and I was short six dollars! They said, "okay" ! No argument, no bad feelings! I appreciate that. I will definitely tell my friends and family about this authentic Chinese restaurant! I couldn't even leave a tip but I know when I come back, I will make up for it!
Came here for a date, and was completely amazed by the service, food, and atmosphere. I had 5 courses and all were to perfection!
Good steak pho and I also like the grilled chicken and spring rolls and the grilled pork chops with veggies and rice.
Absolutely the worst food I have ever eaten! They served instant potatoes and rubber roastbeef for $13 !!!!'

My Greek girlfriend and Astoria resident spoke highly of MP taverna after visiting last summer so we decided to go out of our way to return tonight. We arrived at 11:45pm and the host told us that we could be served food at either the bar or a table. We wanted to grab a drink and order a few appetizers and there were only three others sitting at the bar so we opted for that as we thought it would be quicker. After being actively ignored for twenty minutes by the bar tender  (clearly wasn't serving drinks or food, chatting with coworkers, on cell phone, etc), he sauntered over and gave us menus. We attempted to order food but he told us the grill closed at midnight. Normally this wouldn't bother me but we were clearly being ignored for some time and it was particularly frustrating after we specifically told the host we were there to eat. Very much turned off by the service and probably not worth the effort given how many fantastic Greek restaurants there are in the area.

Overpriced. I bought creme brulee, which should have a crystallized top. Instead it was like soft custard.  The tiramisu was just mocha mousse.  The cannoli shells are always stale and hard. We got sandwiches once, and it barely has any meat in it. People rave about this place, probably because its the only bakery around. For great bakery items, make a trip to Gencarelli in Bloomfield,  Brothers Bakery in Kearny (the BEST bread), Calandra's in West Caldwell.
I am unimpressed every time I go.  It's good, just not great, and certainly not worth the hype and hassle.  For this much work, Babbo and Il Mulino are so much better.

I went in for an early lunch, so I missed the rush but I could definitely see a big wait here. I ordered the eggplant and enoki steamed buns not sure if I would like them, but they are one of the most heavenly things I have every tasked, the vegetables are lightly fried and covered in a sticky, spicy, sweet sauce. It has a piece of iceberg lettuce which adds a nice textural component to the softest lightest buns in the shape of a taco you've ever had. Also the ramen was amazing, I topped it with a soft boiled egg. You need to have the ipudo nigori sake, it's an absolute must. This place is fun atmosphere with everyone shouting japanese phrases whenever food is ready or a customer arrives. Will be going back as soon as possible.

Great ramen. Little bit on the hyped up side, but it's delicious. Sitting at the counter is the best. Served HOT, but in the best way. Appetizers are good also. It's a nice big bowl that'll fill you up. Beware there can be quite the wait during the dinner rush.

We were very disappointed with the service. The food was great but the services was horrific. As side from that, we were charged 18% for a party of 4. The manager is also the waiter and he's horrible. We will not visit again just because of the service and the manager being so rude. The bus boy was the next best thing. The girls that work in the cashier are useless. To bad...  I guess you can't have it all.

The YARDLEY INN     The  BAR - A   Uber cool vibe - 30 + crowd - not cheap - strong pours     The FOOD  - B+  Like most places not everything is great but a number ( more than a few) are very good ( much more than adequate for 30+ bar crowd ). The SERVICE - B Pleasant and competent but can be a bit chatty MY CONCLUSION - If you are 30+ and not  heading  to Philadelphia then forget driving along the river and wasting gas because you won't find a better place in Bucks County.
Delicious mexican food. The taste and quality of the food was really good. Ended up going back to the same place for that reason. Service was good but the music was a little too loud.

This is such a cute place!!! The decor is something that you wouldn't normally see in New York City. After walking up the stairs, right before going in, it feels like you have been transported to a small tea place in a small village in Japan. Love it! This restaurant is known for its unique Japanese desserts. There are so many to pick from. There is also a long list if tea that you can order. They also have meal sets in the menu, which is what I ordered the last time I went there. I forgot the name, but it was a dinner set that included soup and a small dessert (it's different every day, depending on what the chef prepared that day). Very authentic home cooked type of meal. Food for the soul :)

Eating at Carmines was one of the worst mistakes I've ever made. We first waited for about an hour, thinking it would taste good with with all the waiting guests and packed tables.  When we finally got our table and ordered, we waited for about another hour and repeatedly asked the waiter for our food. When at last the food came, the spaghetti was undercooked and was all noodles with little sauce. While we were waiting for our check, we had seen another group come in and get seated, we were able to see their food come out a bit less then 30 minutes.We were so dissapointed that we went out after the dinner to eat again.

Let me start by stating that I love all things Jose Garces. I think the man is a genius and we try to go to as many of his restaurants as possible, as often as possible. We were in the city for lunch and decided to check out Village Whiskey. (We've tried to go for dinner and the wait was always pretty long).  We were happily surprised when there was no wait when we arrived.  Everything goes downhill from there though... The hostess put four of us at a high-top for two people.  When we asked if there was another option, she told us no, so we squeezed ourselves in there.  Our server was extremely cold and couldn't have been any less friendly.  She literally was the opposite of almost every Graces experience that I've ever had.  We ordered our food and it was ok-- I think I hyped it up in my head and found myself disappointed with the burger. It was nothing spectacular and really the entire experience was horribly disappointing.  The duck fat fries were okay--again nothing spectacular. I think my biggest disappoint comes from the fact that I have come to love the way that Garces' restaurants have personality and warmth, and this experience was equivalent to going in for a root canal. I will never waste my money there again and am so sad that Jose Garces is associated with this place.

Awful, waited ages for drinks which probably would not arrived if we had not asked for them. I ordered granola and yogurt. The Granola must have been a teaspoon worth so I asked for more and had it returned with what appeared to be broken digestive biscuit. Yogurt was more like thick cream and I noticed someone else had also left theirs.  My husband had a bacon omelette, which he said wasn't bad. No wonder you have to pay a gratuity up front!!!!
They mixed up our order, but made up for it with comp stuff.  Food was good.  Haven't seen a Zapata (so?) on a Mexican menu, but it was good.

Burgers are actually good! The fries are also really good as well. Ordered a medium well burger, and it was flavorful and cooked about right. I find that burgers in this neighborhood are hard to find, but the one here is good.
This food was amazing. I had the pork and I got the mango nacho appetizer. The staff is very friendly, too!

We were waiting in line as walk-in guests before it opened. There were only 4 walking seats available and a couple were waiting ahead of us. As there was no check in system, two girls behind us walked in and just sat down the rest seats without checking other people before them. We questioned the waiter but she just replied: what do you want me to do? Like ask them to give the seats to you? Would you please just provide a checking system to avoid such issues again? and to girls who just sat and might be having dinner right now, I feel bad for you guys as you were quite when we were arguing with the waiter. You took advantage from others and you knew you were wrong.
Friendly staff, good food, lots of choice. The chicken wings were a particular delight!

This quaint little Thai restaurant is very authentic! The place is bright, and music plays throughout the room. Though it is small, the space is used very wisely.  Staff is very kind, and the food came out very, very quickly! It was all delicious! As I am a creature of habit I had the sweet and sour chicken. It was fantastic! The Sweet Thai tea comes in a ceramic porcelain jar. Very cute! Two thumbs up for this hidden Thai treasure! Make sure to check in here on yelp to get 10% your meal if it's your first time. I love it, and the location is not far from the Midtown Marriott and the large post office! Well done.

I would come back to Patzeria over and over again. The pizza is so delicious! Thin crust, tons of toppings, amazing flavors, reasonable prices? What more can you ask for in a pizza? I tried the tomato/basil pizza, the grandma pizza (a square cut, thicker pizza with sweet tomato sauce), and the lasagna pizza (tastes EXACTLY like lasagna, is a bit heavier to eat and very filling. Their garlic knots are also very good (very garlicy, oily on the outside). The only thing I would really say negative about this place is that there isn't a lot of seating areas. People usually sit on stools or stand, crowded inside, or there are a few seats outside. If you wanted to have a big group eat Patzeria pizza, it would be best to do a carry out I think.
Consistently good food!
Great food, nice people, It was not expensive and the place was clean. Great choice for an informal place with great indian food. It is not a pretty restaurant but it is very good

At my first thought of good noodles this is the place I think of first. Fantastic food and service overall. You can get a variety of apps and dishes and still not break the bank. Just remember, cash only at this place unless they have changed payment options.

Such good food!! Went with my boss and we got a Kale Salad. It was AMAZING. I've never had anything like it- pears apples walnuts kale and a delicious dressing- so good, a must try! Service was amazing the staff was so kind and great. Served us soda with a glass bottle and cup of ice, which I love:) And we also got a sausage pizza to split. Broccoli rabe, fresh motz, ugh so good seriously. Everything here was amazing I will be going here for lunch often!!

Breakfast was going good until waitress gave us the bill and said manager HAD to charge $7.35 for 3 hot waters (considered as hot tea order).  Go elsewhere Better brunch at Toast (Montclair) or Raymond's (Montclair) which don't charge $2.45 per cup of hot water.

If I could give zero stars I would.  I walked in the front door to put my name in, was completely ignored by 3 people who worked there.  Finally I caught the eye of the manager, he walked over and in an annoyed tone said, 'yes'?  I said, I just need to put my name in, and he said 'no, I have a line of people', I said 'I can't even put my name in?' And he hastily responds 'no'!  Apparently, you don't put your name in you just wait in line, but he simply could have explained that and I would have got in line, but he basically told me I couldn't even do that because he had an hour worth of people in line.   Needless to say I walked out...won't be trying that place, ever!

Wow, what can I say about this spot.. This is a gem of a restaurant, the food was absolutely stupendous. Our server was a little slow at first, but more than made up for it with the quality of food we ate. I ordered squid ink pasta and arancini. I was a bit nervous about the squid ink pasta since I never had it, but it was delicious.

Wow!! This is my second time eating at Ichiban. Usually with high expectation (1st time experience) it turns out okay, but today I even enjoyed more than 1st time. The waitress is wonderful, food is just great!!! I am a Korean who lives in Boston, and can't compare Ichiban to any Korean restaurant in or near Boston. It is almost 2 hours driving from my house, however I can't already wait to go back!!
Nice and cosy place in West Village. The food is tasty with various mediterranean dishes. Ambiance is calm which is quite appreciable :-)

A GEM of a find. A Saturday late lunch craving for Maman's pho led us to a four-month new Pho Thanh Huong on the convenient corner of New Road and Rt46East. This could not have been a luckier day in this gourmand's tastebud world. We pulled up almost 2p on a Saturday and walked into an empty simply elegant establishment and immediately greeted by a young casually dressed professional. It didn't take us long to put our order in for our pho and for me, the craving for the moment - banh mi (a traditional Vietnamese sandwich). Waters and hot tea were passed out and as the tea warmed me up, I took note of the warm colors that surrounded me that brought comfort to a much anticipated meal. It wasn't long before the large white bowls were passed around with broth that had such splendid depth of smell that I immediately thought - "whoa -- Maman might have some competition for the first time!"  So you see, the traditional pho dish is much about the broth -- the way it's lovingly procured from hours of patient simmering of beef bone and special spices and a few other elements. Although my own dish, the banh mi dac biet, was waiting in front of me, my instinct was to grab a spoon and dip into my husband's not-yet-garnished bowl -- to resist a taste of the broth is like, well, a child turning away from his unopened Christmas presents. It was (pardon my implied obscenity) un-pho-king believable!  Broth PERFECTION. Of course my nasal passages were WIDE open to take in every...single...detail...of the hours of that bone exuding it's illicit flavors into the hot water that slowly danced around it.  And SO well worth the wait....and travel.  Beef...check; thin sliced onions...check; chinese basil...check; bean sprouts...check; limes...check; hoisin...check; sriracha....check; HELLOOOO taste buuuuddss!! Phew!  Ok...back down to earth.  Need say no more re: the pho.  Now to the banh mi - MELT...IN...YOUR...MOUTH.  The planets and stars and all of their moons were in proper alignment LOL for me, the lucky foodie, couldn't have hit it better two-for-two. Just perfect amount of meats and garnishes that literally married the dang sammich to my tongue...bite after bite.   So we only tasted two of the PLENTIFUL menu options and saw many that will be bringing us back for more.  My son seriously said "So, we're coming back for dinner right?" ; )  This is true Vietnamese food. We have gone to Pho Ai (Florham Park) and Lemongrass which have good food as well but this place definitely made a huge first impression that we'll be coming back soon.  The flavors seem more authentic and have much more depth.   Kudos to a great start Pho Thanh Huong and looking forward to our next experience with you.
Jesse is a really awesome, friendly bartender and he makes amazing cocktails that my girlfriend and I enjoy. Killer beer list and I LOVE THE VEGGIE WINGS

If you want to try some authentic Dosas you've come to the right place. The food is cheap and tastes super fresh. The samosas are also fantastic.I waited almost 20 minutes for the food, which I don't mind at all. The food there are fulfilling. The guy that is making the dosas is so friendly. The sambar is alright, not too crazy about it. Overall, I would come there once in a while to satisfy my cravings.

After being referred here by someone at another nearby restaurant which was packed, we found this place almost empty when we got there. The atmosphere is very nice and the staff were nice. By the time we left, it was packed too and it seemed like they didn't have enough staff to really handle it properly though. We didn't see our waiter for long periods and I had to flag him down when we needed anything. I had the burger which had a "bacon-onion jam" on it but somehow they managed to make it not taste at all like bacon; overall it seemed just like an average burger to me. The dessert I ordered - chocolate cake with pistachio gelato - was no better. The one who brought the plate said it was vanilla ice cream and he may as well have been right since the gelato only had a couple of pistachio pieces and no pistachio flavor at all. The wine is served in glasses with no stem which seems surprising considering it's better to hold wine glasses by the stem so you don't affect the temperature too much (I know to some that may sound picky). The bathroom apparently is inside the hotel down near the gym I believe they said which seems a bit inconvenient for a restaurant which serves drinks.
Everything is served in a plastic container.  This is not green or clean.  WTF is up with the plastic NYC?  From a Portlander.

We happened into Sabor Unido accidentally and could not have been more lucky. Friendly service and authentic deliciously prepared cuisine. The steak picana and the garlic shrimp were amazingly good and flavorful. The side dishes all delicious and authentic. This was the best and most true Brazilian food you can find north of the Equator. We highly recommend this friendly family owned restaurant. Not only that the prices cannot be beat!! Highly recommend!!!vvv

This place never disappoints. Delicious, homemade food at a reasonable price. Much cheaper than surrounding restaurants. Better quality than many places in the Ironbound. Delivery is very quick too, but I only live a few blocks away. The service is also excellent. Highly recommended.q
If you're wanting great tapas with a unique atmosphere this place is a must!

We used to go to Edison just to get Vietnamese pho. But then they moved out. So my wife find out that there's 1 Vietnamese restaurant in linden. We tried it and didn't like it at all. So we googled & found this place. Even closer from us. The food much better than the one in linden, the waiter was very nice. This is our new favorite pho restaurant now. P.S Cash only!!!!
Good food and very friendly and attentive staff. We live so close to this restaurant, and never had a good excuse to try it till tonight. We will absolutely be returning!

Since this place had so many good reviews i decided to give it a shot, but I  was extremely disappointed. We had curry puffs as an appetizer, which were too oily; I've much better elsewhere; my husband ordered Pad Garlic with tofu. Was ok but somewhat bland and not much garlic.  The worst dish however, was mine, "Ants Climbing a Tree'. The description sounded intriguing but what I received did not resemble the description whatsoever. I ended up with a pile of dry, bland, sour tasting noodles with little or none of the ingredients listed in the menu. Bleh! If I had been dining in I would have sent it back, but i had the meal delivered. In fact when I first opened the container i thought they sent me the wrong dish so I called them up and was assured I had the correct order.

We finally went to Geronimo's recently and were quite happy with our meals. First of all, reservations are recommended, especially on weekends as this place seems to always be packed. They have both indoor and outdoor seating. Despite being a cool November evening, the outside seating was full. The outdoor area was mostly enclosed though so you are mostly protected from the elements. Our server was very attentive and provided us with good suggestions. The menu, as one would expect, has a lot of Southwestern and Mexican fare. The menu is fairly extensive, so there is much to choose from. Best of all, if you are a tequila lover, their selection of tequilas was HUGE! For entrees, I ordered the Pork Pibil and my partner ordered the Lobster & Chorizo Mac & Cheese. Both were delicious, nicely seasoned, with the just the right amount of heat. Geronimo's is a busy and bustling place, with a somewhat loud and festive atmosphere. The food is delicious and the prices are surprisingly inexpensive. It's easy to understand why it is always full.

this is the worst soul food restaurant in the newark area the workers are rude and disrespectful,i'm not even sure how they still in business,when you try to support black owned business they give you their ass to kiss but today was the last day i support this business not to mention this is supposed to be a church establishment but again church folk are the worst to

I think the bakers should wear hairnets because I found a long piece of hair in my Mexican wedding cookies, and dirty blonde who I talked to was very rude about it. It's not my fault that a long piece of of brown hair was inside of the cookie....

what the hell am i doing here, ok no college football tonight (damn) and dear friends from west coast here, ok lets go.  old fashion wood decor with an upscale feel, nice spacious place with nice staff , my server was a very pleasant gal. the bar has an old fashion look , which adds style as well as the rest of the place,  very cozy.whom ever designed this place had old charm in mind,across the large bar is a bunch of lounge seating , and the back room with its wall designs and open view room top, which is very cool. the place was crowded but we were able to get a rear booth( hooray). the food is a nice mix of typical american( burgers and fries etc. to more upscale dishes like liver tartar and kale salad. etc. the artichoke dip for app and grilled chicken with fries were excellent, and the server was very nice and always around. this place is a little pricey, but well worth it, my friends and i had a good time. i recommend this place for drinks and or for eating, with food and staff service, that deserves 5 stars.

What can i say about BD that haven't been said already.  There is a reason why this place get soo many high remarks.  I have been coming here for years.  Some people say that it is not authentic.  I say who cares as long as the food is tasty.  The only authentic food you will get is from a home cook meal from your mother.  Going here i would recommend gettting the avocado shake, Vietnamese ice coffee, calamari,  Pho Large (two people can share), and my favorite the fried rice with beef cube and a fried egg.  The only negative thing i would say is that this place has gotten pricey through out the years. I wish they would lower the price on some of their food.

I like this place for its choices and their affordable prices of a custom made burger. The seating area is cafeteria style with no privacy. It is very loud here with the students. I wish they had combo meals to choose from. Overall, I cannot recommend this place because of the long wait times for "FAST" food and limited awkward seating.
Crowded and not the best service at all. But all and all it's a nice experience with truly original Italian flavors, plus the mix with little shops and the market makes it something unique.
Home sweet cooking.  The chicken is amazing in this place.  Great spot for lunch.  Just be sure you take a nap after eating it

I have been going to il corallo for 15 years and it is far and away one of my favorite restaurants in all of new york. The pasta, especially the black tagliarini with seafood is unbelievable. You also cannot beat rhe price, especially in this part of new york!

My friends and i went here on a Friday night. We were seated immediately even though without reservations. Once inside, i was impressed by the decor. The place wasn't too packed and the server was greeted us with a huge smile. We ordered each item on the menu and the waitress also recommended us a few items. They were all very friendly, knowledgable and attentive. Definitely will be back again soon.

One night, I went on a Tinder date.  After meeting at a bar, where she drank wine, and I drank beer, we spontaneously found our way over to Barbuzzo.  At Barbuzzo, we ordered a cheese plate and a pizza.  First off, the Tinder date was a 1 star who looked much more attractive in the pictures.  Secondly, it's irresponsible to rate a place based on a cheese plate... so that I will not do.  My rating is based on he staff, all of which were sharp.  The guys behind the bar and our server were all well versed on the local sourcing and finer details of the pizza's raw ingredients.  This is usually a good sign.  The pizza was good.  It wasn't great.  I'll take a drunken Lorenzo's slice over that Barbuzzo pizza 7 days a week.  This is the type of place that serves good food, but takes itself relatively too seriously, and that will eventually drift into "just being there" status in Philadelphia's food scene.

There was a party of 6 of us that went to this restaurant. We found good reviews of this place and decided to try it out. The place had nice decor , friendly staff but we waited for 20 minutes to get beverages and even longer to get appetizers. I got a vodka tonic and it was extremely stong, so stong that I had to return it. I got a white sangria later and it was even worse! Later our food came and it was cold! We had mixed kebab platters, whole fish and seared tuna salad. We told the waiter that our food was cold and all he did was bring a bowl of hot rice.. Then we decided to get cappuccinos. And it also came cold. I mean there is something wrong with this restaurants thermometers... Then I ordered a lava cake .. Luckily is was warm but it came over hot melted ice cream?! What?! The cake was floating on top of this liquid puddle of creamed liquid! This place is unbelievable.. Never again will we come here! FYI we spent over $300 here..

This was my first time at BurgerFi. After walking around Reading Terminal Market we just decided to walk across the street to BurgerFi instead.
