Dealing with such a large group can be challenging to say the least and he was the picture of professionalism.  The wait staff made sure that our glasses were always full, their service was prompt and overall wonderful. The ambiance and décor is classy and chic. Now, let me get to the most important part - the food - absolutely amazing!! The chef prepares all meals with organic, local produce and you can taste the difference.  The PEI mussels were gorgeous, filet mignon cooked to perfection, and the lamb chops(!) everyone agreed that they were the best they've ever had.  The chef even came out to greet us during dinner and came to see us off as we left. Every single person came away from this experience fully and completely satisfied.  A HUGE thank you to Laboratorio Kitchen for making our special day perfect.
Food was very great but service was slow had to wait 40 minutes for our food but only two other tables were being served. Also they need more wait staff but at the end we got a free desert
One of the best French restaurants in the city. I come here for brunch, dinner, and drinks all the time. For a more detailed review please click the link below: halsteadproperty.tumblr.…

We stopped in for lunch, and had the lamb stew and the squash. The squash had a wonderful presentation, served and baked in the gourd. The taste was wonderful, light and fresh. The lamb stew was thick and all of the tastes were well combined. It was topped with a few red potato wedges and three slices of soda bread. The meat fell apart with a fork and all of the vegetables were fully cooked without being mushy. They have a good draft and mead menu as well as a reasonable selection of wines by the glass or bottle.
Nothing special about this place, food is bland. Not sure if any of those reviewing ever ate outside of a chain restaurant in NJ.

The dessert is good but no reservations + minimum 30-45 min wait when there are tons of open tables. I hate when restaurants do that. Im waiting at the top of steep stairs glaring at those six empty seats... Grr

When we first walked in it was a little confusing but a very friendly young man gave us the low down and showed us where we would sit which was marked with a handkerchief. I loved the concept and when it was our turn to order I was blown away by the friendliness and how genuine the staff was. Then the food, AMAZING! A must stop!

We are students at Drexel Law, and Savas has become a staple in our diet. We usually get the buffalo chicken pizza, which is exceptional. The take-out pizza is quick, cheap, and good, which is why so many Drexel students go there. The sit-down dining is very good as well, with an impressive menu catering to many different tastes. I have tried the gyro, which is pretty good (but light on the Tzatziki sauce), and the fries, which come in a very large portion and are good and crunchy. Jess had the chicken quesadilla, which was good, but nothing special. She is a big fan of the Nutella french toast, omelets, and bloody Mary's though. While we do not sit down and eat at Savas often, we will continue to be patrons of the take-out pizza and beer for the foreseeable future.

made a quick (45 min) stop on our way back from VT. I got penne a la vodka. my dad got penne salmone and my sister got the kids' ravioli without sauce. the service was good. not amazing. the water had a weird taste. the pepperoni bites that they give out instead of dinner rolls were pretty good. the italian dressing that came with my side salad was ... odd. not in a good way. my dad's soup was good. some kind of bean- soup of the day. his pasta was decent, nothing to rave about. mine was good, but I've had better. both descriptions promised a creamy sauce- the sauce we both received wasn't exactly "creamy". my sister's ravioli dish was very bland. it would have been better with the sauce, I assume. the atmosphere is pleasant, waitresses are pretty friendly. not a bad restaurant.

Poor place no body there just us and take so long no water no beer just inca kola which is out this world ,the food taste bad we order a rice chaufa mariscos and was really bad and the ceviche was really reallly bad it is the ungly ceviche that i saw ,not recomend this place we live in miami if you like peruvian food and are near visit El Chalan is the best ceviche that is why i know what is best
Great Food, Great Atmosphere, did I mention the food was Great!

We went upstairs late one night for what we though would be a quick drink. After a sample of one of the punches and a drink each, we simply had to stay for more. Unbelievably delicious and deserving of very accolade. This review is for drinks only; we'll definitely try some food when we return.

I discovered this charming cafe yesterday and fell in love with the ambiance, the people (Tom and Teri plus the rest of the staff are super friendly and helpful), the *smoothies*, the *chai latte* and the wonderful breakfast sandwiches (try the avocado, egg, red pepper flakes Toast!). Oh my God - the bread is good! If you want a charming, friendly, healthy, yummy experience at a cafe, Cedarhurst is it. I've been living in San Fran this year -- the capital of Cafe experiences and Cedarhurst in New Haven is my all-time favorite. Thank you to the owners and all the staff for creating such a wonderful experience.
I first heard about this restaurant on the food network about 8 years ago then finally tried it out three years later. I LOVE this place. Very cozy, nice staff. Food is delicious!

I've been coming here my entire life - with my parents and now my children. The pizza here has no comparison. It's in a class all of its own. My favorite spot hands down. I highly recommend.  There is a reason there are always wait times and parking is sometimes hard to find. Like me,  everyone knows this place is worth the wait and they're not going anywhere else either!

This bar is be careful!!!!! Because we eat just 2 food and 2 beers but they charged included tip 18%  also. Bar worker asked me you need change????   I don't under stand! I said yes.  Why ask me??? You already charged 18% tip!!!!  I think they need double tip????
Sushi is best I have had yet in NJ.  From a sushi standpoint it is fantastic and worth the inconvenience of limited to no seating.  Fresh, creative, delicious rolls.

Lolos has the best Gourmet Caribbean seafood I have ever tasted. The food is so flavorful. The Jerk Ribs, the Shrimp, the smelt...mmmmm, mmmmm, mmmmm mouth watering. The owners are the most polite, personable down to earth people. Laticia and Raymond may your business continue to Thrive and spread throughout the world!! Lolo's a great Caribbean family restaurant that makes you feel like you're in the Islands.

Amazing food, great service! Stop by and support this local place. The owners are always there, don't be surprised if they come over and introduce themselves and make sure you're having a great experience. This little place is their pride and joy. The eggs benedict are my personal favorite, but I think everything is worth trying. They try to make all their food organic, sustainable, and (when possible) local.

Best halal in NYC in my opinon. Something about their food that makes me want to come back every time Im craving some halal food. Great food for a great price. I recommend the combo platter and ask for extra pita bread. White and BBQ sauce !

I really wanted to like this place. Living only a block away. The food is fair at best, I can live with that. What really sucks is how they bait and switch the prices. This is what will put them out of business, higher prices means slower or no food turn over, cold and dried out. You would think after the last few places going under they would get that. When the price was low they had lots of cars in the lot. Now their are few. They went to a lot of trouble to make flyers, only to put a higher price on the door. Should have stuck with the plan to draw a following before they chased customers away. You can order out for less.

Sitting here waiting for the food to be served for the last 40 minutes! Now empty restaurant and requested three daily meals which have previously been pre cooked. What's wrong with this picture??? Am I an idiot?? NEVER AGAIN and I don't care how good it is.... No one ever came over asking if we need anything else .... They completely disappeared from dinning room.. The food was delicious!!!

Just ate at Pellegrino's, service was incredible as was the food. Had Zuni d pesce and chicken w sausage I'm a brown savory sauce, was delicious. Stuffed shrimp appetizer was very good, as was fresh mozzarella appetizer. Excellent wine selection. Pistachio cannoli was awesome. Definitely must go here. Friendly staff and maître d. Go here every Year in December.

I went here on a whim, not expecting much as I thought it was a typical fast-food style restaurant that I passed by several times on my way to nearby Shop Rite. Boy was I wrong!  The food here was absolutely delicious and so fresh! I had the chicken tikka wrap, hummus side dish, and Afghan lassi.  The prices were also very reasonable as they give you a good amount of food for your dollar. The hummus is so wonderful and authentic. They don't over-do it with garlic, like many other restaurants. The service is so pleasant as well. I'd definitely recommend checking this place out if you love Middle Eastern food.

Went to Dish before a show at the Hartford Stage.  Valet parking in A+, Waiter B (he seemed to forget about us from time to time and we told him we were going to the show and he disappeared at the end of the meal.  Had to wait 10 minutes to get the check), Food - mine A+ (Grilled Pig Chop) yummy, my wife C+ (Baked Stuffed Shrimp) good flavor but overcooked. Drinks A,  Valet parking out A+ (We told him we were going to the show and our car was on the street ready for us when the show got out.  Wow.  Overall I would a give them a B+ and definitely would try it again.

Food was excellent and the staff was very nice. I don't understand the bad reviews here at all... most are related to service which seemed fine to us. Aside from that the pizza is just as good if not better than La Piazza in Allentown or The Vault in Bordentown. We ordered three brick oven pies and an amazing stromboli.
best chicken burrito ever.  wish there was more seating.

Came here for happy hour, they advertised good deals ($5 sized small plates and 2 for 1 drinks). The food was really good and generously sized, and would've given them 5 stars based on that alone. The problem is that the "2 for 1" drinks is per person, so you can't share it across two people. My girlfriend and I each got a beer, clearly indicating that we intended to order the happy hour special, and were surprised when we were told we would have to pay full price for both drinks instead of just one. They didn't note no sharing on the menu, the waiter didn't tell us, and this blatant false advertising and ruined my experience (to the point that I'm writing this from the table while finishing up the two extra beers I didn't want to order but was forced to).

The food is good not the greatest but it is a nice spot to relax and eat if you have all day. The service is OK but not the best. If you looking for a quick slice of pizza to go forget about it they always run out and tell you they will make a pie. Overall average the place is OK if there is no other place nearby that has pizza.

Was not impressed.  We have friends that go here on a regular basis but service was poor on a Tuesday night that we went. Server brought half the salads then later brought the others out.  He asked if I wanted pepper on my salad when I had two leaves left in it.  The really strange thing was when we ordered wine.  We ordered a bottle from the menu and it came out in a carafe.  We asked why it was in a carafe and the water said it was a magnum sized bottle so they put it in a carafe for us.  We never saw him open the bottle.  When we asked to see the bottle, he brought out an unopened bottle of a different brand..so I have no idea what we drank. Food was decent.

This place is legit!  The lunch specials are great.   I got the Hawaiian Burger which was delicious. Great food and great prices.  The service was great and the owner is a super nice guy. You should definitely check this place out.

I love this place!  The nutella crepes are amazing and the staff is always nice.  My husband and I love coming here for dessert and hot chocolate.  I have also had dinner here and was impressed.  I really enjoyed the pulled pork sandwiches.

A friend and I went there this evening.  I went past it a couple of weeks ago and have been wanting to give it a try.  As has been commented on in previous posts, the decor  is pretty uninspiring but who cares?  We went for the food and it was very good.  I've eaten in quite a few Middle Eastern restaurants and our meal was as good as I've had anywhere.  In fact, better than some fancier places.  A very nice meal and reasonably priced as well, at least from a customer's perspective.  We had the hummus, fattoush, and shared a chicken kabob platter, all of it very tasty and plentiful.  More than we could eat.  The service was fine perhaps because we were the only diners for close to three hours.  That is the sad thing.  If more people do not start patronizing the place, it will have to fold and that would be a loss.  We will definitely be going back as long as we can.  It's easy to get to so make the trip from wherever and give it a visit.  We don't think your taste buds will be disappointed.

Over the years my family has spent a substantial amount of money patronizing the bakeries on Franklin Avenue. Usually it's a good shopping experience. The past few stops at Mozzicato's Bakery have been disappointing. I believe freshness is no longer a guarantee. The arrangements of Italian Cookies made for Christmas were stale just days after purchasing them. I felt bad that not only the money spent was substantial, but the reciipients ended up throwing the cookie arrangements away. I think Mozzicato's needs to concentrate on fresh products again and if they're going to make cookie arrangements for Christmas, they need to control quality and shelf life. I will not be going back anytime soon.

First of all. I asked one of the server who was standing right in front of me where can I get some moleskine dairy and he just put hands up in the air and yelled/said really loudly "ahhh don't ask me don't ask me.. Go there go over there". Ok I get it! U're not in charge of the book area of the book cafe but you didn't need to scream. After buying my diary I decided to sit down and try their famous black bean soup. I was standing there for a long time until someone came up and acknowledge me and it was not even that busy. It's 4pm during winter. I told him I would like to sit by the bar but he still led me to this table by the stairs. Ok fine. Then i ordered my soup and they brought me a lukewarm black bean soup(the server even spilt some of the soup) with tough and chewy bread that was not even warm. Neither was the butter warm. Nonetheless, the flavor is alright. A bit too much sour cream for my liking.  Overall not a satisfying bowl of hot soup I'm looking for during winter but happy with my moleskine purchase

I have been coming here since I was a kid and while recently home for the Christmas holiday I had to make a trip for dinner. The pizza did not disappoint. With 7 people in my group we ordered 3 large pies which was perfect! Plain, pepperoni, and roasted red peppers & onions. I am also a fan of the salad- be warned they only have a few dressing choices French is my fav and the house Italian isn't bad either. Definitely a must visit when in Princeton! Be prepare to wait if you come on Friday or Saturday night, just grab a beer at the bar it's worth the wait!

Stopped by for a slice when I was driving through Philly and ended up getting a whole pie since it was so tasty. Spoke with the owner while I was eating and he told me all about the pay it forward program which is very cool. I would come back frequently if I lived nearby.
Great pizza and great service. Probably the best pizza place in this area.

Everything here is simple, fresh, and perfect. If you want to eat at a place where they really care about the quality of the ingredients, this is the place to go. I could eat this every day and never get sick of it.

Ate hear for a quick snack around 3pm the day before New Years Eve 2014! I stumbled in after seeing Grimaldi's had a line around the block. I had the pizza with arugula and prosciutto, it was amazing!!!! The staff was very friendly. I must have got there right on time as I was leaving it was packed and also started forming their line around the block. Get there early or be prepared to wait. Worth it, these people know pizza!!

Came to Labebe for a birthday dinner and brought 14 people with me.  I wish I had read all the yelp reviews before going.  It is clear that the service is SLOW and management less than professional.  Not only did our drinks and apps take forever but when the dinner FINALLY came out it was cold. We all ordered hot dishes. I repeat the food was cold and half the dishes had to be sent back.   We asked to speak to the manager and after a half hour of waiting to see him I went downstairs to speak to him.  He claimed that he was never told that we wanted to speak to him (I spoke to our waiter later and he rolled his eyes and said that the manager was informed more than once).  Well in talking to the manager (the owner's son) he became extremely defensive (and offensive).  I told him our food was cold and he replied "well you can't expect everything to come out on time and be perfect."  Now you can image the look on my face.  I told him i don't expect perfection but at the very least I do expect my food to be warm and not cold.  he stated that he was going to comp us 6 dessert to which I replied that we wasted enough time at his restaurant and would like to leave (we were there for more than 3 hours).   He in a rude manner asked me what I thought he should do and I told him (having worked in the restaurant business myself) the standard is minimum 20% discount.  He went on a rant about how his dining hall is always filled and started to raise his voice.  I kindly asked him to lower his voice and told him I was not going to get into it with him.  He said he would think about it and I asked him to come to my table and speak to the rest of the group who was waiting patiently to talk to him.  He came up and told us he would give us a discount and walked away.  we were the last to leave the restaurant and he was not even at the door to wish us a goodnight.  I've eaten in a lot of Mediterranean restaurants across the state and across the county and the food was less than average.  very unfortunate.
nachos are simple to die for :)
Best delivery man!  they have this nice man with glasses that is definitely a sweetheart. He knows how to treat a customer. Plus the pizza is great pepperoni and vegetables my favs

I wanted to like it here and for the most part I did. The food was very good. Service was very good as well...almost to good / pushy. The waiter was very nice and very eager to please. To the owner.... Why are you serving Flip Flop as the house wine, why? The Benzinger, Beninger or Mondavi was just to much for you to buy. Please.....
The Kangaroo Burgers were so delicious! No complaints at all! And the service was very nice!

Was told about this place by a friend and since I will be in New York, might as well have a try of this place!!! The roast duck rice at about $4.00 (small) was not too bad but one cannot complain for this is New York anyway. The queue was fairly long when we were there to get lunch but it moved fairly quickly. Would have liked to try the other dishes but did not have time. Note that this is a 100℅ takeaway place hence you need to eat at the park opposite which can be as bit chilly in winter!!!

I usually eat at bar or get takeout. I've been happy with the bar selection for BTG wines and ciders. I like the sandwiches and finger food selections. I haven't gotten too many of the entrees. The desserts have been decent too - it's a fun bar that doesn't get too loud. It's a decent scene in the area. I have been going here since I was a little girl, and the changes were a great improvement. If they made sone seasonal updates, that wouldn't be bad. But the staff is pretty nice and attentive. I haven't eaten in the dining room, so I can't speak to that experience. (don't like the crab cakes, though). My favorite thanksgiving wrap was removed - that was sad - love that all year.

This is my new favorite restaurant! flower crowns and straw hats?! yes please.  The potato and mushroom dumplings were fantastic.  My meal was the mushroom stroganoff and it was amazing.  Hubby got the the beef stroganoff which was just as awesome! we topped off the meal with the cherry dumplings- so delicious! Will return to this place asap!!!!
Best guac around this area! Always good, never had a bad experience here. We order frequently
Great vibe at this little off the beaten path sort of place. Fun and classic cocktails (a bit on the pricey side) and great options for a big meal or small plates. Will definitely be back.

Great Happy Hour.  Two food items and two cocktails (plus all beers half price) on the HH menu, but they were all tasty and very satisfying. Honestly 2 Manhattans for 10 bucks - how great is that?  I like the Manhattan and Old Fashioned here as well as many of the cocktails I've paid three times as much for at the prohibition-type bars.  Can't wait to go back for a full dinner.  Mostly shared tables, but a few small tables if you prefer intimate seating; outside seating looks very comfortable (too cold in December).

we had escargot, mussel and lamb, and apple tartan for dessert. the place is cozy and intimate. some dish are good some are at best ok. it was an ok dining experience, but it is not difficult to find a better place in the city in the same price range.
We had a great lunch.  The food seemed authentic, they had of plenty of great gluten-free options and the service was excellent.The atmosphere was great and they had reasonable prices.
My favorite pizza place! If you are dining in, be aware it is typically packed. The staff is super friendly too.

The place is lovely. The service friendly but inept. Salads are huge - but little to no dressing on the  mixed green. The pasta cook perfectly - seasoning or flavors OK. The pizza was horribly made with little attention to detail - ingredient toppings sparse to none. Deserts awful and the soft serve is over priced - we asked for chocolate and recv'd vanilla.  Stop,saying enjoy after every encounter with the guest- it's annoying.
Due to my busy schedule, this spot has become my home cooked meal! Their food is consistently good and the baked goods are awesome. Plus the staff is super friendly and really nice!

What a rip-off!... $8 for hot tea??? ($4 per cup.) Overpriced food - not that unusual. Food was fresh (the only reason for the second star) but not tasty at all, minimum flavor. The shrimps were nicely grilled. To say this was farang-style Thai food is an understatement. Bring your own chilly sauce, lime juice and fish sauce and you might salvage it. Service was quite gracious and OK, no Thai servers. Atmosphere is very generic. This place could as well be a bar, a coffee shop, or a tapas place.

We went to Buddakan, another asian fusion restaurant (maybe competitor of theirs) and were so impressed we decided to do asian fusion again the next weekend.  Sampan was equally delicious.  The dumplings (gyoza) were so tasty, and after living in Thailand I am addicted to fried rice.  Sampan did not disappoint.  And because the dishes are heavy you can get a few appetizers for less than $15 and basically have a full meal.
So yummy! Must go here if in Williamsburg. Breakfast was amazing and the coffee to die for.

I am a fan of the food - especially the corn. So the 4 stars are for that.  However I am definitely not a fan of the bathrooms.  Seems like the priority here is the food and drink but no one is overseeing the condition of the bathrooms. The one I used was not clean, had no paper towel and the toilet paper that people used to dry their hands was piled up on top of the wastebasket.  Not cool at all
We came a bit late for breakfast. I had fredman burger which was okay, but not as I expected since we waited for the line. The sweet potato fries was so so. Will come back for breakfast next time.

Went for lunch with wife this weekend 12/28. Why "Sushi Shack" only 2 items sushi/sashimi? Lotsa rolls. Ordered chirashi, maybe 6-7 pcs. small and thinly sliced sashimi on small bowl of rice. Only seating on benches at communal tables. Will not be going back
Prices are a bit high here :( but the sandwiches are GREAT!!

This is definitely one of the best seafood places in New York .. Really loved it and reminded me the food my father used to make back home in our family restaurant .. I would definitely come back and recommend it to people looking for a good place to eat.. Cheeeeers
delicious tacos, affordable prices, great chips and salsa, overall just a great time!

Celebrated a 30th birthday with a small group at Amada and was delighted with the ambiance, the service, and of course, the food. The servers were extremely attentive and the many varieties of tapas were brought out very timely. One of our guests had certain allergies and the servers took care to suggest the best menu options. They also consistently explained the ingredients of each dish to the table upon delivery. Some of our favorite menu items included the Mixto cheese options, the Piquillos Rellenos (crab stuffed peppers), and the Filet Mignon. The Dark Habits craft cocktail was phenomenal. A small cake and candle were brought over after the tapas were polished off, which was a nice treat to end the night.
This place is really good I love it. I'm going to take my friends out to eat here one day it's truly amazing. It's in a very nice environment just great!

Our go-to take out spot. I realize it's American Chinese food, but the quality is consistently decent and the service has always been fast and polite. Don't let the frightening appearance of the building fool you.

I had been trying to get in for a few weeks now but the waiting time was 1-2 hours long. I finally had dinner there last night and it did not disappoint. The service was amazing; the waitress was charismatic, very attentive and we even got a complimentary beer at the end! The food was very good. The catch of the day dish was excellent. The best part was the bill at the end. Having two main courses, appetizers and several rounds of drinks for under $100 in NY is quite amazing. Would definitely go back.

I love Saraghina. They make great breakfasts, lunches and dinners. Their pizzas are some of the best I've had. It has a unique and eclectic atmosphere- a converted garage/repair shop turned edgy & shabby chic restaurant with a lovely back patio. It has however become super popular over the years and you will get better service if you arrive before peak hours. They also have a great (small) bar and bakery attached to the restaurant. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Giving this place one star because I'm forced to... I visited Adrienne's back in October with a group of 8-10 people, and while our experience at the restaurant was pleasant, what happened afterwards was not. We split the check evenly between all of us, which I understand can be a hassle for a restaurant. But, that was no excuse for the fact that Adrienne's double-charged 4 of us. On top of that, they double charged me AND put an additional, unwarranted charge on my card. At this point, I had 3 charges from Adrienne's, and wanted an answer. After calling the restaurant the first time, a woman explained that the double-charge was only temporary, and that duplicate charge would disappear after a few days. That was all fine and dandy for 3 out of the 4 of us, because that duplicate charge did eventually disappear from our card statements. One problem still remained: the third charge that appeared on my statement, never disappeared and I still had an unwarranted charge on my card. So, here I am, three months later. I have called Adrienne's over 8 times, left my name, phone number and card information with the woman answering the phone, and have received NO RESPONSE from the restaurant as to how they plan on refunding the unwarranted charge. Every time, I was told that the manager would call me to resolve the issue, but clearly the manager/restaurant feels no need to address the issues they cause. It'd be nice if they'd take responsibility for their mistake, but I'm not holding my breath. It's unfortunate, because the pizza IS good and the atmosphere is fun. But, there's no reason to re-visit a restaurant that doesn't care about taking care of their customers.

Went here with my wife after having lived 2 blocks away for the last 5 years. This place was wonderful, one of the best meals I've had in a while. Great selection of single malts, and some nifty cocktails. Nice quiet atmosphere without being too dark. The escargot was good, though a little rubbery. The olives were great, though, and my main meal -the calfs live - was the best I've had. The staff was also pleasant and though service was a little slow, I didn't mind.

I was also here and christmas and wow everything about this meal was just terrible from start to finish. first of all the service was beyond slow and the waitress took our drink order and 20 minutes later got our drinks...how long does it take to get 2 glasses of wine and iced tea? after that no one came to take our order we waited about another 20 minutes spoke to the manager said someone would be right over and nothing. once we actually ordered took about another 30 minutes for appitizers to come out and then our food which was not that great and definitely not worth the price we paid for it. I really thought this place was going to be nice and upscale but it is just an overpriced hotel restaurant that i wouldnt reccommend to anyone.

Kayla has made my experience beyond pleasurable. Attentive hosting, knowledgable about the cuisine, and just plain ole fun. Will certainly be back! Don't forget to ask for Kayla-she is Blend. Or so I hope.
Great food. Excellent staff. Amazing prices. As many thumbs up as possible. Hope to make it back again soon.
Good food and Service!! Lovely place too!!

I love Sandwich Burger Bound. The burger does not taste like junk food, crisp and delicious, the price is right. The only thing is that the place is very small, the queue is long and there are few places to sit.
amazingly tasty everytime.  tiny place turns out great basics.

Stopped in after work for a quick meal. Bought my food and headed to basement dinning room. Within in seconds I was wishing that I had brought my ear plugs thanks to the obnoxiously loud music. It wasn't just the music that made this a memorably unpleasant experience. Indeed, people in tables near me were screaming at each, which isn't surprising because they had to talk over the loud music. So, I guess Dig Inn is an ok place if you don't mind being in a room with people shouting at each other and loud music cranking but for me it will be relegated to being take out only.

Hands down THE BEST SUSHI of my life! This place is a very traditional sushi restaurant and I heard that the chefs have made sushi for more than twenty years and have perfected their craft, which explains their very seasoned and serious looks on their faces when they served our omakase menu. The toro melted in my mouth and the uni was bursting with flavor. If you want to experience what sushi is really about come here, but if you wanna be just trendy and have ridiculous cartoon- like sushi-go to Nobu

We dined at Freemans for Thanksgiving Lunch 2014, on the recommandations of our hotel's concierge. The restaurant is exquisite inside, very warm and beautiful. It's in a small alleyway which is cool, the ambiance inside is dark and hipster, which we love. Our server, she was absolutely charming. Hair pulled over and braided to one side. She was adorable, so nice and very attentive. And spoke other languages, when the table next to us turned, two French woman sat down, she rattled on with them in their native language. Very impressive. The food was delicious. We each tried two different brunch cocktails, each one very unique and refreshing. And then we ordered the smoked trout plate, which was nicely presented on a wooden platter. Just make sure to get there early on the weekend, because they don't take reservations for small groups and the place fills up quickly.

Don't eat here! We all got extremely sick after going for dinner. My whole group got basic items from the menu like guacamole, chicken tacos, and chicken quesadillas. We all spent the night getting sick in various ways, it was awful.
Living in DC, EVERY time i go to Philly, i come here. i LOVE THIS PLACE!! Try thier sandwiches, and salads. Excellent food!!!

This was the perfect place to stop after our walk. It's small, intimate and has a great menu. There were regulars and tourists. The menu is small, but the food is grand. It was fresh, and just the perfect amount of food. We were ready for our next adventure after this stop. The service was attentive, and our waitress was helpful and on point with her suggestions. There was a nice international vibe here.
Great place, menus a little confusing. Sandwiches are great but oby with the egg. I dont know why it just doesnt taste good without the egg. Needs more seating but otherwise I camt conplain
Some of the best hummus I have ever had.  This place is awesome!

Gave this place a shot twice... that was a mistake.  Both times, the staff either look pissed that you are bugging them to order or are so slow and not really sure what to do.  The place your slice and stromboli in the oven, yet it's still cold when you get it.  This place needs to go, bring back a real NY style pizza place!

Drove to the Garden from Unionville,Chester County for dinner Christmas week with a party of 4 after many visits to Talula`s Table in Kennett Square.I have been to many resturants in various cities but none can compare to this overall experiance. Aimee Olexy(the owner)exceeded my expectations by giving us an experiance that made for an enchanted evening in a city I love.Great food,service,ambiance and Aimee`s magical touch gave a holistic approach to dining that was a treat for the mind as well as the taste buds.It has become obvious to me that not only are Aimee`s creative and culinary skills manifested in Her establishments but maybe most importantly Her Heart.I wish Her continued and well deserved success.If it can be said that life is nothing more than a series of experiances then this was one of the best.Way to go Aimee and many thanks.Still digesting and already looking forward to a return visit.Would like to try brunch next!!!!!!!
This place is amazing. So friendly. Food is the bomb and the perfect hangover cure!
We've been eating at Casa Piquin on and off for years. Over the last few years they have gone from good to excellent. Especially recommend the Molcajetes. Yum.
My fav place to get ramen- add an avocado its an excellent addition to any bowl!
The food was a 5/5. The service was a -1/5. I have never had service this bad at a restaurant. Disappointing. I will not go back.
Delicious meal and great wine. A bit expensive though
Awesome place with amazing people. The food was delicious. Definitely the best roast beef sandwich with provolone cheese.. YUM!.

Very good and cheap.... Two pitches of beer, two extra beers, two orders of buffalo wings, one heart attack burger, one order fried chicken, mozzarella and gravy sliders, and huddle fries =$50. We wanted to try everything on the menu but out stomachs couldn't. Def going back!
real brazilian food... nothing else to say. if you want the real deal, then this is the place!

I had the most amazing meal here! The prices were great and the food was exceptional! The service was mediocre and the decor was nice! If you eat here you must try the pork belly! It was mind blowingly good! Everyone at the table was raving about it! Definitely a must try restaurant!
Fancy dinner place - tasty food

First time customer. Very nice atmosphere, well-lit, loved the decor. Service was great, food even better. Started off with the Thai iced coffee for my friend and Thai iced tea for me, coconut curry and pineapple fried rice. Oh my God.. sooo good!  It was during the weekend, so it was unfortunate I couldn't get anything from the lunch special menu, but ehh. Too bad the curry doesn't come with rice, but whatever, it was still damn good curry. Would love to come back soon.

Love the Goat Biriyani. Little on the pricey side but I still drive 5 miles to pickup food. Friday lunch is a superb buffet with a huge exotic variety (Crab soup, kadai, Lamb Curry, Biriyani, mini uthappam, idli etc.) that varies every week. Very authentic Chettinad restaurant!
My favorite restaurant in Burlington Vermont. The food is fantastic, service is amazing, and view is spectacular. Will definitely be going back next time I am in town.
Outstanding!  Our meal was interesting and delicious.  The staff was extremely pleasant. I can't wait to revisit.

This is a 4 star place, but a 5 star diner. We went for desserts but everything we saw looked amazing. Portions are generous. The fuzzy bear hard milkshake with Peach Schnapps was amazing. Can't wait to try more.

This place was great! Very cool and friendly ambiance. The food was delicious! Over 6000 yelpers can't be wrong and weren't. I would definitely go back once in New York again. Definitely order the Pork Belly buns, they were delicious. Chicken wings as well. We also loved the Ramen. 5 Stars all the way around!

I have no idea how this place got 4.5 stars but the pappardelle which appears to be widely reviewed has zero flavor and the presentation of a fly by night Indian delivery spot.  The wine selection appears to consist of four varietals of two buck chuck, and they lack any semblance of a bar or mixology options.  The service is great though. I don't often write reviews but I feel that it would be a disservice to the Yelp community if I didnt reveal how substandard this establishment is, especially considering the glowing reviews which led our 11 person party here. For comparison sake, I have diner at multiple Michelin star establishments and visit Babbo and Momofuku everytime I am in town.

First time visit - very average. Two tapas plates were fairly bland - shrimp and potatoes. Also thought that 9.75 for a tapas plate in Hamden, CT is steep. Lastly, management standing at the corner of the bar watching us eat our meal was a bit strange. Maybe this can be improved a little bit with success.
The ramen is excellent especially the broth and the seasoned egg. The line was terrible. We waited for 90 mins.
Love this place. Brunch or dinner, the food is great and the service is excellent.
Great food and celebrity-watching at this uber-cool spot.
Stopped in today just to grab a bubble tea but after chatting with Saadet, the sweet owner, and tasting some items that were in the front case, we knew we'd be going back again...soon!
OK food, OK drinks, GREAT Margaritas GREAT Guacamole!   love this as a place for apps and drinks.  Cool décor and fun vibe!

This place mediocre. I give it 3 stars for their excellent service and 2 stars for their food. There was just one server and she handled all 5 tables in a timely and professional manner. I ordered the bison stuffed burger. I asked for it to be medium rare and it came out well done. The burger was supposed to be stuffed with blue cheese, but I didn't really taste any blue cheese. Also, if it's a stuffed burger, it isn't suppose to be two patties. It should be sealed. I didn't try anything else on the menu. Therefore I say if you're in the area it's worth a try!

The restaurant is another branch for the Cross Culture in Princeton Shopping Center. The food is great! As well as the people there! We ordered shrimp sagwaala, chicken sagwaala, and lamb curry. The flavor can be adjusted according to customers.

With family from PA and CA we were looking forward to a tasty, Italian meal with some charm. We didn't expect to wait 1.5 hours for our meal...after waiting 45 minutes to order! I also had to remind the waitress about my wine order earlier (should have been a clue). We asked about our food several times...it's being plated (nothing for 15 minutes), I'll check...it's  on its way (10 minutes). After we ate, we asked to speak to the manager...not in. The waitress then said our order had "chicken as an ingredient". So what?! Very disappointing!

I can't finish this meal. The food has sat in a heater for hours and now the stir fried rice pasta is too chewy, glued together in one mass, and worst of all the fish sauce tastes old and over powers this disappointingly simple flavor combo of sweet rice pasta, fish sauce and a hint of kimche. This dish is labeled "VEG." so I wonder what the fish sauce is doing in there and there are no ingredients listed. The other dish, blackbean sauce noodle with vegs, is also old and clumsily flavored, overpowered by soy sauce and some thickener. I can see the bits of "vegs" but certainly can't taste them. It's just old soy sauce and noodles. I feel sick and I didn't finish. If you dare come here pull dishes from the back of the heaters and avoid anything that has a sauce, but just do yourself a favor and go to one of the other restaurants you pass walking here.
Pleasant surroundings and good service.  The food was not of the previous quality.  The quantity was there but not the quality. Disappointment

My husband and I were visiting the east coast and happened to drive through Clifton, NJ.  It was dinner time and we ended up stopping here to eat.  I am a gluten-free vegan and the owner bent over backwards to accommodate my dietary restrictions.  She even offered to make something special for me that wasn't on the menu.  My husband is Italian and knows good Italian food.  We both were extremely happy with our meals.  Everything was absolutely delicious.  And if you're gluten-free or vegan, try this restaurant.  You won't be disappointed!

I haven't been to Krug's Tavern in years. The space is exactly as I remembered, and is somehow still in great shape both indoors and outdoors are tastefully decorated and alluring. Kudos to them for not showing their age. Drinks, on the other hand, aren't so great. Too sweet and syrupy, they were off the mark across the board margaritas, pimms cups, and negronis were all substandard. Wine and beer selection is nothing special. Pizzas were atrocious, akin to something you'd unwrap from the back of your freezer. Service was friendly and attentive.

I have been looking for a restaurant that could take me back to my wonderful visit to Venezuela and Jojoto has me filled with good food and nostalgia! Everything is well prepared and very authentic. The wait staff do a great job and the chef is a delight. If you want a memorable experience and a great meal head down to Jojoto!
The bartender Sarah was not only super friendly she was also fast! Great happy hour place also fresh food!

I'm sure the food here is fantastic... if I get to eat it. I'm sitting here right now not getting served. Best part is that the waiter has been ignoring my table since we walked in. There is one waiter for a completely packed restaurant. The other ststaff saw us waiving politely at hi, rolled his eyes and looked away.
Sooooo tasty and great service!
Pork buns are amazing! The lamb was delicious as well.  Portions are really small and service is so so. I would go back for the pork buns.
Great burritos the size of your stomach  hit the spot after hitting the slopes all day !!

Per Grace & Christina-NY: "The Joy of the Slice: so delicious! We  this pizza"! Mom: "What a wallet friendly treat to eat after spending 3-1/2 hours in Toys R Us. Will definitely stop here again! They even have Original Stewart's Fountain Classics Sodas which are found in far and few in between establishments!"

I heard so much about this food truck and decided to give it a try. The food is simply the best. What's even more is it's so cheap. They serve a big portion for $6. We tried the lamb over rice and the chicken combo. Came with some lettuces as well. I ordered extra white and red sauce. Be careful, the red sauce is extremely hot. The line was a little bit long but worth every minute of waiting. You can't resist the smell of the truck. There is no seating and they only accept cash, but getting the food and walking around trying to find a place to sit and eat is part of the experience. These guys working behind the truck are very fast. They are very entertaining and make great food for a more than fair price. I am glad i tried this cart. First thing on the list when visiting New York.

I normally avoid any food carts, but with these guys I go back at least 18 years. Back then I worked nights on Fifth doing an arts project for a few upscale stores, so naturally, on our "lunch-break" at 3 am we would walk over to 53rd and 6th for a nice gyro. Since then Halal Guys remain an exception to my no-cart policy. Is it really "authentic" Middle-Eastern food? Not really. But it does the trick: food is tasty, ingredients are "legible" , flavors are well-balanced, and, lastly, the prices are very reasonable to say the least. Finally, the service is rather clean and friendly.
Great soup dirt cheap. I had the oxtail hand drawn noodles my brother had the duck. It's like half a duck in a bowl of soup for 6 bucks. Also try their smoothies!

Haven't actually eaten here yet, but the restaurant has pissed me off. Made a NYE reservation two weeks prior to NYE on OpenTable because Aldine did NOT list that it was doing a prefix menu. Come to find out on 12/29 through a friend that they are--for $75 a head at our time slot. Shame on me for not checking their website, but shame on them for not updating OpenTable. And their  reservation system is now offline, so I have to speak to a human being to cancel.  And I also have no other option for NYE since it's now the day before. Nice work Aldine, nice work.

Service isnt great. They don't write down your order, so be prepared to repeat it.   I ordered the polenta with mushrooms and liver. I usually like liver but there was something awkward tasting about theirs. For $11 I paused for 4 triangles topped with mushroom and back liver. I was also sharing the tortellini with my sister, but when it arrived. There was no way, you could split that. The portions were ridiculously small. We came with a group of 6, and all of us left hungry with a $20 something bill per person. The tortellini was good, but it didn't warrant the price. It honestly tasted something I've bought and made before at home... Not good. Keep moving.

I'm not going to lie but I was a bit skeptical when another kabab place opened in the nearby vicinity of another famous kabab place. But dare I say... Better ingredients? Better food? That's Sanam for you. I love the food here. Its real authentic Indian food as well as other options. Most Indian restaurants will take as much money from you as they can before knocking you with "the runs". But at Sanam, the ingredients remind me of eating at home. Its not that fake Indian food. Its real. It means something. The flavors resonate ever so gently. The best part is that they know what spicy means. Everywhere what... Spicy means white man spice. I like the heat. They turn up the heat without losing the flavor. I have eaten from here often and never had a bad experience. This is saying a lot. Their chicken tikka masala is on point.
Great music!

Amazing food for an amazing price. The sandwiches are great, the bread is so soft and like no other. Great selection for all fat sandwich fans, my personal favorites are "The fat Elven" and "The fat Tokki". Must go for great food and service.

Wanted some takeout Chinese for so I decided to take a walk over to this place. Right when I walked in I noticed this does not look like your typical Chinese restaurant; it was nicely decorated with a large fish tank in the back and a small sushi bar. Not a bad place to come for a nice, quite dinner. I had ordered the general tso chicken and an appetizer fried dumpling.  When I got home, I was amazed at how much food there was and how well presented it was. This was not in a regular, jam as much food together as you can, Chinese container. All the foods were separated nicely and the combo included the chicken, rice, egg roll, 3 small dumplings, and a soup. Way more food than I would normally expect to receive. The rice was delicious, much better than anywhere else I have ordered from. The chicken was very good, a bit dry but I also feel it was healthier than normal. The dumplings were okay, nothing great but not bad either. In the end, nice spot to come for dinner or get takeout. It is also BYOB, so that's a plus as well.

Appetizers were so good that didn't make it to the main courses. Instead of waiting for a table, we decided to sit at the bar. The food came out really fast and we had some delicious mojitos. We ordered 4 appetizers for the 3 of us and had that for dinner. We were so delighted and stuffed that weren't able to try the entrees. Prices were absolutely reasonable. I'm definitely coming back for more!

I have been here a couple times the service was never great but the last it was terrible and insulting! I'm giving them 1 star because no stars isn't an option!  I went there with my family on a Sunday afternoon for lunch and these fools had us sitting there for 20 mins with water without taking our order.  Finally the waitress came to the table with no remorse and a my sh@t don't stick attitude.  There was no way, I was staying there.  We walked out.  The reviews indicating that the service here is terrible is no exaggeration! I would rather give my $6 at a pizza shop!
I just got swindled. No indication if they were open tonight and got charged for an order. Thinking about filing a police report for fraud. Stay away.

Awful service.  Mediocre food.  Their vegetable pasta did not have any of the vegetables they have listed on the menu. I ordered the hanger steak. Food didnt all come out at the same time for the table. My entire table received their entrees and mine never came. I asked multiple times about the status of my dish and finally got my food 45 minutes after my table got their food.  Worst experience I've had ever at a restaurant hands down. Manager and server never even apologized. I was very disappointed and will not be returning to this place.
Rather tired. an institution that needs a refresh or call it quits.

My girlfriend and I visited on 30 December 2014 around 6PM.  The restaurant was empty at first and stayed mostly empty which was surprising since the food was INCREDIBLE.  Let me reiterate...INCREDIBLE!  I have loved Indian food for a while and this was by far the Best I've had at a price that doesn't break the bank.  My girlfriend and I loved the atmosphere: walls were adorned with unique and culturally appropriate decor and the ambience was calm and romantic.  Service was terrific!  Ask about their Bengali dishes and naan!
New Years party is awful. Service is so slow, there's no dancing, and no one is happy about the mixed drinks. The ball has not dropped yet and I know I wasted money.

A rare treat when the food lives up to the hype.  Made the trip from Baltimore and wanted a great cheesesteake since we were in Philly.  It beats anything I've ever had from the dozens of carry out spots I've been to over the years.   Perfectly cooked and seasoned meat.  Tender, juicy, generous amount. Perfect cheese ratio and enhances the meat, not overwhelming it.  Fresh bread and toppings.   Call ahead though because it's small and stays busy.  My only wish was that they had a larger and updated facility.  The cheesesteake is so good though it really didn't matter.
This restaurant is cozy.  They provided our film crew with an excellent breakfast -- sausages, eggs, ham, toast.  They were quick and helpful.
Great food. The best take out restaurant in Hartford. I been eating here for over 15 years. Give it a try.

The food was delicious. It was a fixed price menu of $95 on new years eve. We arrived hungry  and left hungry. One mini ravioli,  four  mini carrots, one small but delicious short rib. Also five tiny raw scallops which I don't eat. They were nice enough to substitute roasted cauliflower which was also delicious but not enough. Very disappointing for the price. I've had larger appetizers.

So f@cking good...  Spicy lobster- get a double portion so freaking good. Cast iron chicken and broccoli rabe My go to. If you can't get a table just sit at one of the several high top tables. Great vibe.

i ordered onion and pepper pizza clearly over the phone when i got home i had olive and peppers YUK...I hate olives I called and wouldnt even offer me credit or deliver me a new one Ruined my new years Thanks BAR

Due to surgery I have not been able to visit in person, but their delivery is awesome. By far the best delivery in the East Windsor area, because it doesn't taste like "take-out"...  it is clear they are using quality ingredients and everything is made fresh. So far we've had the Margarita pizza - fantastic, Salad de Jessica - insanely delish, Alexs Masterpiece and Prime Rib sandwich - both awesome. The only so-so dish we've had was the Fettuccine Alfredo, but I think that was just be it's not a dish made for travel (the chicken it's served with was very tasty). Will continue ordering and definitely visit in person on e I am healed
Pricey but superb quality in everything they do. Fresh pasta. Fine dining. Desserts. It's really hard to miss.
Great as always.  4 times and counting.  Will be back next time in nyc! Great food and staff.

Based on some on-line reviews we decided to give Barbuzzo a try. Reservations even on a Sunday night pay off. At 8pm there was a 45 minute wait with no reservation. The small plates menu has a wide variety of tasty opitons and the wine list has something for every palate. We started with beet salad, the ordered the shrimp, mussels and a pasta plate. For wine, we had a nice Austrian Zweigelt, which more recently come in 1L bottles. (No complaints there!). Portions were well execute, tasty and with flavors perfectly balanced. The balance of flavours was evident when we ordered the mussels with no olives, and realised that it was missing something with a little saltiness or tartness to it; exactly what the olives would provided. Our loss! Rounding off the meal, the house desserts were perfect. The tiramisu was just the right moistness with out being too soggy or to dry. Definitely would recommend this restaurant and next time we are in Philadelphia, we'll certainly go back.

Be careful when you order. I ordered the taco (3 per order) and asked for one order chicken one order steak (and chips and pico) it came to $11 which surprised me so I asked if there were 3steak and three chicken tacos. She said yes. But, alas, got home to one steak and one chicken taco. Not enough for two people. Had to walk back and got attitude as if it were my first visit.

This is literally my favorite pizza of all time!! It's memorable!! First tried it when I lived in Princeton. I now live in cranford (an hour north) and I still drive down for this pizza. It's the best!! Fresh ingredients and high quality!! Yum!

Mega mimosa was awesome! I had the omelet of the day: spinach, sweet peppers, leeks add goat cheese and it was delicious. Wish my side of potatoes was actually hot...but other than that the food was delightful!
Liked it better before the renovations!!
it's very close to my building but i stopped coming after a few times cause the crowd was just too much and it took them 20' to make my to go latte. it's just not worth it.

Probably the best wine bar in new York City. The plates were not huge, so sharing seemed the thing which was really fun to do. The chesse plate is lovely and comes out so nicely plated -they do a great job with presentation. We got several cheeses and then a few appetizers and then an entre to share so we could taste a little of everything. The service was a little slow but we didn??t really care because we had such great food.

After buying and paying for our food we good in the corner of the counter to eat our tacos. In rude and unfriendly maner we were told we couldn't stay and eat there and should get out in the hallway. Never ever.
Best Thai food in NYC! The beef pad gra prow is amazing, as is the chicken pad thai. Makes the trip to LIC worth it.
The food here is exceptional. I'm going to let this menu speak for itself. Kudos to the owners of this fine establishment. Thank you. Thank you so much.

The food quality is okay....same basic recipes each and every day with no variation or variety. Unlike other Indian buffet, naan bread is limited to just one per person. If you want another bread you pay $3.29 extra for one bread...so much for it being a "buffet" with eat all you can...perhaps soon they will put restrictions on the number of servings you can have or start weighing the food!!!

The line to order moved fairly quickly and     the person taking orders was attentive,helpful and friendly. We ordered the Barbacoa beef burrito and pork and chicken tortas they all had great flavor and we were very pleased. However portions are an average portion not to be compared to a like of a home wrecker burrito.
The food, atmosphere and location of this restaurant are all superb!!! Must see if in Brooklyn!!

This place was amazing! We went here twice while spending a week in Philly and it did not disappoint. I wish I had more time to visit every place and that there was more room. Due to the small space, it can become overwhelming. DiNic's pork sandwich was great and Carmen's had the best Philly cheese steak I've ever had! Make sure to stop by Famous 4th Street Cookie Co. for some delicious treats!

Aisles of culinary goodness awaits. Just be aware that the PA Dutch section is closed on Sundays (they block it off). It can be chaotic, but "it's all part of the tour." I prefer visiting it during the week, right before the lunch/convention crowds flock over. Seating is at a premium, so you need to be vigilant to gain a spot. Lines can be long for certain places, but they move quicker than you'd think. Divide and conquer, my friends.
We ordered delivery to La Quinta in Fairfield. The service was friendly and the prices were good. Good NY style pizza.
Amazing service!

Hope I don't get sick! Ordered a burger and less than halfway through I noticed how uncooked it was inside. Very disgusting and very dangerous as ground beef should never be under cooked. Even an associate sitting next to me became grossed out. Fortunately there are many other places to eat around here.

can't beat cheap lychee martinis everyday until 10pm.  i think they're $6 now, but they're strong and well worth it.  had my birthday party here a few years ago and from what i remember, i had a jolly good time.

This hip, unassuming little joint is exactly what I want in this neighborhood.  The food is delicious and extremely reasonable.  Surprisingly, the side dishes are crazy good, which makes it an easy stop for a drink and a snack to unwind on the way home.  The corn is one of my top 5 dishes in NYC.  And how can you go wrong with avocado fries?  The beers are great, and the wine cocktails are unique and delicious.  The service is great, the manager is adorable and professional.  This place has staying power.
The booths ROCK! Super comfy! Staff was nice and drinks were pretty good. I cant wait for summer here, the windows are to die for! And the horse w the balls....(youve gotta be there to understand)

Happy New Year's to us! We decided to treat ourselves to some Chinese food that was recommend by our fellow co-workers here as being great! ... We ordered from Hong Kong Kitchen off their lunch menu and had it delivered ... to our unpleasant surprise the meals were bland and under cooked. We ordered Shrimp and Broccoli w/ white rice, General Tso's Chicken w/ fried rice, and a side of Crab Ragoon. The shrimp was still pink and tough very under cooked and the chicken was tough and still pink in the middle of some pieces and over cooked in others, the only thing that was cooked correctly was the Crab Ragoon. We called to assess the situation on the food and the receptions was rude and  nasty, demanding to know why didn't we call sooner and that we were untruthful about our food being under-cooked ... very disgusting service that is no way to speak to customers ... We will not be ordering from there EVER again. Unless you're looking for bland and tasteless under-cooked food then you shouldn't order from there either ....

Tasty pizza. Comfortable atmosphere. Although the staff is friendly, the servers seemed confused about who should actually be tending to our table... which was a little awkward when it came to ordering both drinks and food. I'm sure it was just a miscommunication, but we were hungry and had a lot of trouble catching the waitress' eye despite an almost empty restaurant. And there was a hair in our bread rolls. Needless to say, the pizza saved this place. We ordered a large Hawaiian pizza on wheat crust (a nice option!) and we really enjoyed it. The size was perfect to split between three people, and the wheat crust was surprisingly tasty! (Not your typical cardboard texture.) If there's a next time, I'll go for the infamous chicken parm sandwich, which is raved about in other reviews.

Food is too pricey. You can get so much better and cheaper food at other Thai restaurants. I love Thai food, and I tried so many Thai restaurants in town. This one is my least favorite. Had this for New Year's Eve, I feel kind of disappointed. Don't know how does the 4 star overall statues come. But I definitely won't recommend it.(ps. Some nice Thai food restaurants like'bangkok garden','siam Thai' ,'Thai noodle house'...you can do much better!

Clean and updated eating environment. Skilled sushi chef's prepare aesthetically pleasing dishes that tantalize your tastebuds. Love the chai mail surround tables; very hip. Byob. Try any of the fire rolls!

The only reason I am giving two stars is because the food tasted decent. Nothing that I haven't had before and certainly not worth the price. The service was AWFUL. Drinks were not offered and nothing else was voluntarily given. The staff literally stood around as if they had no idea what they were doing. Maybe they didn't?

Great place to come when you are completely hammered and want something to help mix with the alcohol. If you are one of the brave, try the hot sauce but make sure you have a glass of milk with you because you will be taking your shirt off just to finish eating. Get the falafel pita. It's delicious!

Okay food... BUT HORRIBLE SERVICE!!! They are not welcoming and act like its a burden to serve. I understand its a small restaurant so i shouldn't expect great service but its low by small restaurant standards!!! Try: paper masala dosa if ur really hungry. As always, live deliciously!
staff is so nice and they work with you when it comes to changing orders around. food is always good. highly recommend spicy tuna avocado salad

I would give his place a 0 star if I could. Service was slow, we waited about 10 minutes for 2 soup and a appraiser. No one offered any water, we asked for it and it arrived 5 minutes later. We had a lot of time to spare but I can't imagine for another passenger who had less time for connection. Food quality was okay but plates were very small, worst of all, they look totally different form the pictures you were shown in the fancy iPad menu. I complained about my pho soup. It had 3 meet balls, 1 piece of veggie and 1 single piece of rice noodle. I questioned that it doesn't look like what's in the picture, and the waitress confronted me asking "what do you want?" then brought my pho soup back to the kitchen. It turned out to be closer to the picture but that was another 5 minutes. Another soup we ordered was Italian wedding soup in a small cup, and the rice was undercooked with some even still crunchy. The lamb meatball appetizer was okay size and was actually tasty, but this place is pretty much a joke otherwise. STAY AWAY!!!!

Recently opened cozy spot in Bloomfield NJ.Love this place,food was awesome,service was friendly,welcoming,efficient and quick.The Chef personally came out to make sure everything was good and even joined in for a quick laugh.Ive already been there 3 times and every time was great.Love the food there!!!

This place is so cute! Only seats about 20 people, very small and intimate. Cash only and BYOB. The menu has great options and food was amazing. We had tuna tar tar and Tuscan chicken w/ Brussel sprouts and mash potatoes. Can't wait to go back and try more!

Greeted right away once coming in, very friendly staff. Only problem I had with this place was how my seafood tofu soup tasted like wet pepper flakes no flavor at all, a noticeable hole in my pancake that looked as if a piece of shrimp use to be there, and finally, the chicken galbi's hot oil was flying onto my brother's arm and face. I'm familiar with Korean food and know how to cook Korean dishes. But of course you wanna enjoy and have someone cook for you once in awhile you know? Very disappointed with the taste of the food. I think I prefer the food from the restaurants in Hmart. How the oil was repeatedly flying at my brother wasn't the employees fault, but it just fueled how upset I was already after eating the seafood pancake and seafood tofu soup. Seafood pancake was OK, I thought it was very plain and overpriced at 13 bucks. Seeing how there were barely any seafood in it. Tofu soup was just overly seasoned with the pepper flakes so it just tasted like im sipping pepper flaked soup lol Overally, the employees are very nice but the food quality was not what I am used to having in other restaurants I've been around the states. Nice people though!
Amazing service and a very intimate experience with Chef Ramirez. Unlike any other dining experience ever. This is deserving of being on everyone's bucket list
I had the Saigon Shack pho. Very tasty. The sandwiches here are also very good. A definite stop for and pho enthusiasts. Have a vietnamese coffee on the way out.
Good (and fast) service, the burger and chicken kabobs were great whilst the prices stay reasonable for Manhattan

I moved to the area about a year ago, and this is the exact sort of thing I was looking for - great and locally-sourced food, a fine selection of craft beers, and some kind of awesome hook that makes it unique in the bar scene (in this case classic arcade games). If you're looking for a place that captures the spirit of the Burlington area, I'd say this is it.

Absolutely delicuous. Came here on New Year's Eve. Had a reservation for 730. Got there at 655pm and our table was ready at 733. Service was phenomenel even though the place was packed. We had crab wontons Mongolian Beef and the Chilean Sea Bass. Strongly recommend. The bass its well worth the $25.price tag. .
SO gooooood!!

Do not eat here!  To start, my party was seated right by the entrance on a freezing cold night.  When we asked to be moved because the restaurant was empty in advance of prime hours, we were told it wasn't possible.  Given that, not only was our food salty and fatty, but it was also cold within 5 minutes of receiving it.  To cap off the miserable evening, our bill came with a 25% gratuity INCLUDED, which I quickly adjusted.  As a Greek-Albanian who knows real Greek food when she tastes it, DO NOT DINE HERE!  Since this place is in NJ, my advice to you is to locate the nearest Greek diner and EAT THERE INSTEAD.  At least you'll be able to enter the tip you want to leave without being prompted.

Excellent breakfast! Crepes were imaginative, yummy and prepared with fresh, local ingredients. We had the Noah's Ark, Early Riser and Breakfast Monster.  Cappuccino and espresso were delicious and so was the smoothie. Highly recommended.
Amazing

I took day off ,long drove to Philadelphia ,may have little eat or bar make fun. stopped Bridget Foys', walking to south street ,had very friendly staffs in there, very cold outside, not like winter but cold air is fresh, seeing not busy today in it and inside outside tables for new year holiday time.  I was  hungry and took quick for my stomach, the shot rib hash delicious and hot coffer warmed all over me.  I'm not a big proponent of the whole half-star thing, but... *if I could, I would give Bridget Foy's a 3.5 star rating.* but I still give four star.

third time eating here, great wood fire pizza in NYC. highly recommend the white clam pie. the margarita is also great. you can't go wrong ordering anything from this place. my one and only small comment was our waiter wasn't around when we needed her, and she is not to blame. it is always busy their and she had more than she can handle. love this place

Went for lunch and I waited 1 hour. I had the tori paitan ramen.  Soup was good, but it was a little lukewarm.  Noodle was good. Chashu was average. I'd give 3.5 stars, solid 4 if the soup was hotter. I would not go back if I have to wait 1 hour, maybe 30 minutes max.
Five star service and amazing food! Coming from Miami to have authentic Cuban food in Queens that should say it all! Excellent!!
There really isn't a place to sit. But for a cheap bite of great dumplings. This is where you need to go. Local favorite and everyone looks for this place!

Manager directed employees to release hundreds of New Years balloons onto the street for someone else to clean up wherever they land. Regardless of the food or drink, this is a shameful way to run a business.

Our place when meeting up with friends whom have children or vegetarian (also vegan options). Nice variety and friendly staff. Good place to hang-out, particularly during the weekdays or when they just open. Affordable (e.g. Briner special). Attractive planters on building; ownership takes interest in community.

This is a great place to bring your friends and family but the only downside is that they're always super crowded! Theres either a long wait (2 hours?) or a full booked day but it is worth the wait. I like how there is a little station for all the sauces that you would like on your meat. I came here to celebrate my birthday and it was on the house! Our server was super nice and tentative, helping us with the korean barbecue. Unfortunetly, I did not get to try the hotpot but I will definitely be back to try it next time.
Nothing earth shattering, but really good for what it is. Classy, upscale bar and grill with delicious steaks. Yum!

The service was more than terrible. Had to ask for the menu a total five times from three different waiters. Waitress suggested to us its green tea "gelato", which was nothing more than overly sweetened crappy frozen ice cream (ice specks). Not gelato in the furthest sense. The restaurant was way too busy and did not have enough wait staff. Inconsistencies with waitresses too- I asked for lettuce and garlic for the bbq meat, and while one said she will be right back with some, after 10 minutes without being back with some, I asked another and she said the restaurant ran out. ????? Overall terrible experience; over priced too.
Amazing chicken cheesesteak, homemade sauces and lovely service. I've been coming here for a couple of years and Mr. Lee is the best. Hidden gem of West Philly. They also do great hoagies.

I have worked in this neighborhood for many, many yrs. and have visited several Restaurants, this is the WORST that I have ever seen, the menu is overpriced, I asked the Waiter for lemon and he brings the lemon "in his hands" puts it on the table and says to me "is this good"? talk about a Health Department Violation and disgusting. My co-workers and I ordered soup, the waiter brings us the lunch and after we are almost done eating, he brings us the soup, which we couldn't eat as it had an awful taste. The worst Service that I have ever seen in any Restaurant, and the food gave me Diahrea, DO NOT bother with this place.

Soco- I will start with the good then go onto the not so good. I went for lunch, the menu was rather limited but everyone enjoyed their entrees. I ordered the chicken sandwich on brioche. The chicken was juicy, tasted fresh, and the bun made it even tastier. I also ordered the Mac n cheese to share. $10 is pricey for a side of Mac n cheese in my opinion, but it was enough for 3 people to share. I also tasted the shrimp in grits and the sliders which both were very good! The service was poor. There was only one waiter working, with atleast 10 tables there at that time. The hostess took over and became our server. I requested a salad instead of fries with my meal. She had to check and make sure that was possible (when the menu offered this option). The salad was simply mixed greens drowned in dressing. I couldn't even get 1 slice of tomato smh. They forgot our Mac n cheese, by time this came out we were finishing up our meals, then had to wait even longer for the waitress to bring us bowls. We had to ask for our water to be refilled. I felt that was inconsiderate. I enjoyed the food at soco but I doubt that I return. I did not feel that I got my monies worth ($25 for lunch!) with the service that was provided.

I never review because I rarely get wowed enough to want to. But here goes: We had : the miso soup, Japanese spring rolls, dragon roll, spicy tuna roll, roe and white tuna sashimi and for an entree we shared the salmon satay. Finally they gave us Mochi with ice cream on the house. I can recommend them all. Everything was so so fresh, and cooked to order. On top of it all they are really nice.
The last day in NY. It's really a great new year eve here. Foods are really good! People are really nice!! ：）

NO STARS for this restaurant from my partner and I. We got food poisoning!! Our experience here was unfortunately horrible, the staff were rude and brought our meals out stone cold. We ordered the pork belly, so I was super unimpressed to have swallowed un cooked pork meat. We sent it back, the waitress was weird about it and so rude. She came back and said one of our meals was complimentary, even though both came out cold, however as we tried to eat the second round they were still cold. The table next to us also ordered the pork and their dish came out looking amazing, with greens, sauce and meat a plenty. Whereas ours looked like something they had scraped off the bottom of the bin. Super disappointed in this as the restaurant came highly recommended.

Really cannot say enough good things about Luca's in Somerset. Superb service, thematic but not 'cheesy' decor, reasonable prices and fantastic food. I went with a party of 10 (only 2 had ever been here before and recommended it highly), none of the 10 of us had even a single complaint by the time we left. I had the Gnocchi Genovese and it was super delicious. The portions are substantial and BYOB is a nice feature given that this delicate little hole-in-the-wall is tucked away in a strip-mall next to a liquor store. Do not miss a chance to try this place. I'll definitely be back.

Good pizza but nothing special anymore. Once a nice restaurant with world famous pizza, I was shocked by the direction Grimaldi's has gone. The second floor had blasting 90's music like an arcade. We couldn't hear our friends sitting across the table. The waiters were inattentive and when our pizza came, it was rudely plopped down on the table. To top that off, it was burnt. The quality of the pizza seems to have gone down but is still made with quality ingredients.
Extremely bad services! Crazy people and unreasonable bar tender!!! Will never come back again. Give us a terrible night at New York eve!! Can't believe these people are so cold blood and not human.
This place is amazing the food is GREAT it's a very clean environment friendly people that make you feel like "good friends" I love the owner very genuine man...we will be back ...Love Colorado :)

ATTEMPTED to go here for a New Years Eve dinner with family. Made a RESERVATION for 7:30 and needless to say we walked out at 9:00pm when we were told by the clueless manager that we would have to wait another half an hour or so.  We heard stories from others who had been waiting over 2-1/2 hours that also had reservations.  I get it that its New Years Eve, but this place was a clusterfuck. Absolutely overbooked the place, so if your going to do this you have to hustle people out and not let them camp out at their tables. I understand you are their for the ambiance of hibachi, but it's New Year's Eve and you cannot allow people to spend 2 hours at their table when you have 75 people standing in the bar area waiting to be seated. The bar was jam packed and getting one of the college bartenders attention for a drink was impossible. The least the manager could do was give out free appetizers to the patient customers who were lied to when placing a reservation for a certain time. Go here at your own risk. Thankfully Jose Tejas was next door and did not have a wait. We were seated right away and had a fantastic meal. Will definitely go back to Jose Tejas in the future.

My review is not about the food... But just a weird situation . I ordered 11$ Of delivery. When the delivery guy came, i handed him a twenty and asked for $5 back. He told me that he didn't have changed and would come back later. Never came back... What a scam.
Best sushi I have ever had. Where else can you go and get free mussels with your dinner? It's sometimes crowded, but always worth the wait.

This place is amazing!!! Today was my second time coming here. The waiter is awesome and everyone is extremely friendly. We had Asian dumplings for the appetizer which was the best I ever had. For entree I had shrimp pad Thai which was really delicious. And my bf had the angry beef which he thoroughly enjoyed as well. He made a comment stating that we never finish our food whenever we went out to eat before. We finished it all and had no need for a to go bag. We also had the the mango Thai tea which was perfect.

This place is everything that you want a Bar-Restaurant to be: * Great service (this one Latina waitress was so nice and prompt) * The burger was perfectly crafted and delicious * The ambience was like something out of a photographers studio with all the "in vogue" photographs of models on the wall * The drinks are practically free! I would most definitely go again.
I went there last night for an event. Had the Bison Mesquite Burger.  It was to die for! Will definitely go again and invite all of my girlfriends.

I came to visit NYC last weekend (from Boston) and this was the perfect place to catch up and party with all my girlfriends.  The atmosphere was amazing, the staff was friendly, and the drinks delicious!  I will definitely be coming back here next time I'm in town!!!
