Great food and pleasant atmosphere. Not a typical Trenton restaurant, and nice neighborhood.

The whole experience was average, the service was ok, price was reasonable, but food could use some work. Basically, don't order anything outside of the Appetizers and Dim Sum category. Signature dishes were good, but the cook who did the Fresh Bacon with preserved cabbage dish should be sent back to China to relearn what it supposes to taste like. The rice cake dish was too greasy and tasted flat, couple bites and I couldn't eat anything anymore.
Met local friends at the Midtown location. What a treat! Ramen here has no resemblance to the dried, salty packs you may have sampled. Try the pork rolls and any of the broth based dishes.
OUTSTANDING!!!!  Everything was perfection!  Now, I know why I miss Philly...

I live around the corner, and was so excited when they FINALLY opened.... and it is awesome! 5 of my friends and I came in on a Friday evening around 8:30pm. BYOB which is great. We ordered the sampler appetizer platter to start. Everything was very tasty. The chicken satay was incredible. The crab Rangoon was good, not earth shattering, but tasty. It came with a bunch of other stuff, which was all very quickly eaten. ($14) I asked our waitress to culinary transport me to Thailand, and she recommended the Tom Yum Soup. - It is crack. I am addicted. I can't wait to have it again. Spicy, tangy with shrimp and mushrooms. It is incredible. Seriously, it is on my list of "when can I get my next fix"  It is on the same level with the soup dumplings from Dim Sum Garden. Like i seriously may have to go back in the middle of this review. ..... I had the crazy noodles. - Awesome, I really enjoyed it. My friends had the Pad Thai - Tasty. good size servings. They seemed pleased with their pick. I would like to go back and try the curries as they looked really good on the menu. Speaking of the menu, it actually had some printed prices crossed off, with lower prices written in.....which surprised me as, normally when that happens the price goes up. All the prices were reasonable, in fact, I was kinda worried that some of them were too low. Like we might go out of business because we are giving our food away low prices. But truly, very affordable. Total bill for 5 people (5 entrees, $14 sampler platter, 2 soups) was around $70. Atmosphere was pleasant and clean. Gorgeous table linens, cloth napkins. Open kitchen concept. Q102 playing the background. My friends and I had a great time, LOVED the food, and will certainly return!
The fries are great and the sauces are plentiful. I opt for the traditional mayo but there are many different ones to try.
The empanadas were flavorful, i ordered spicy beef and and chicken and cheese empanadas both were good..its a must try...you will be waiting for about 20 minutes to be seated but its worth the wait

I really like l&w oyster, so had been looking forward to almond, but was very disappointed.  My wife and I were celebrating some recent milestones so we ordered a bottle of wine and a number of small plates to share.  The waitress asked us which order we wanted our small plates to come out in and we said we didn't mind.  Then, within two minutes we were served five different dishes all at once!  We couldn't even fit them all on our tiny table and more importantly we still had a whole bottle of wine to drink!  We asked the waitress if she could stagger the dishes (thought this would have been obvi), so she took them away.  As the waitress brought our dishes out to us the rest of the evening each one tasted like it had been resting under the heat lamp for longer than the previous one.  I found the food bland and as per the above was not impressed with the service.

I just love it here.  I've been a few times and I'm never, ever disappointed.  Maybe it's because I feel like I'm dining instead of just eating out in another loud, trendy, resto of the moment.   The decor is modern and minimal but doesn't feel cold...rather very cozy and intimate.   Service is always outstanding...very knowledgeable, attentive and you don't ever feel rushed.  The food has always been scrumptious.  I think I'm one of the few that doesn't feel the need to get the monkey bread, but the lardo spread is pretty yummy.  The pastas are insane (in a good way, of course)...the scallops and suckling pig are incredible. Extensive wine list and some pretty inventive cocktails, too. Save room for dessert...whatever is chocolate on the menu, just order it! When I want a special night out, Piora is one of the first places that comes to mind.  Always love coming back here.

What a fantastic restaurant!  One of the owners, Thibaut, is attentive and funny; he really makes the experience wonderful.  I have followed him here from a previous bar and am so happy to support his new business. I went with two friends.  We tried the cheese platter, the salad with figs, and the paleo zuchini pasta.  We literally could not stop raving about how fresh and complex the flavors in each dish were.   We will definitely be back!
the best sandwich shop anywhere!!!!

Where have you been all my life!! I can't believe I've lived in Jersey all my life and have not tried this place. That relish is a crack sauce topping for the for dog combined with mustard and a side of the mouthwatering chili. I don't normally like chili, but this one is the one! If you love hot dogs you must try rutts hut. It is the holy grail of hot dogs.

The Toasted truck just fell into my path randomly one night after a museum event. Ever since, my boyfriend and I find ourselves hoping to spot one of these trendy little trucks in random  spots constantly. Not only was the food delicious, but the service and vibe put out by the staff was over the top. Overall experience, outstanding!

The service was great from the beginning. Great atmosphere and vibe. I ordered the spicy pork meatball with spicy space and a side of mash potatoes. After few minutes the meatballs arrive. My goodness, was like eating freaking real meatballs for the first time. The meatballs were delicious, soft, moist, perfect amount of spice and the space incredible. The potatoes went along with it.

The Becco Restaurant was within walking distance of our hotel just off Time Square. When we arrived we where seated very quickly and greeted then by our sever giving use a wine. The very cool thing here is " all bottles of wine are $ 25.00" and they had 100's to select from. Within minutes the brought out a wonderful bread box with 3 different types loved them all. They had many all your could eat specials and specials of the day I had the Veal Terry my wife had 3 unlimited pasta. They have an amusing house Caesars salad all you can eat. This was old world service and real Italian food Five stars Steve the Builder and Terry the Contractor Cocoa Beach Florida
A great place to find delicious vegetarian deli sandwiches. Excellent service and soothing ambiance. It also has great organic coffee and wireless internet . The Club Sandwiches are amazing!

Burgers are equivalent to something I'd get at a snack bar. I have to commend Shake shack for delivering something I thought of never experience-an absolutely undrinkable milkshake. The restaurant has 2 separate lines which is very confusing to a first-time customer. The music mind-numbingly loud and the color scheme of the interior looks like a Seattle Seahawks jersey. All hype. Awful.

Very disappointed with this place the fact that they weigh the meat should indicate something, my husband had the 1/2 pound pork belly which was more fat than meat and I had the 1/2 pound brisket, taste wise it was pretty good but the portions are to small for the price. The fact that you go to the counter and order your own food and they have paper plates and you seat yourself they could do a little better on the servings. In our opinion not worth it and won't be going back.
Chicken Cutlet Lagasse with prosciutto, long hots, sharp provolone, & broccoli rade..Wow! Cheesesteak is so much better than the "others" in the neighborhood.

The crispy hipcity ranch with buffalo is single handely the best vegan imitation dish I have ever eaten. If you live here, go here. If you don't, go there. If you are vegatarian, go vegan. If you are vegan, hell yeah. The girl at the register was so beautiful. Jimmy Logan Jimmy Logan is an ugly idiot.
Great pork soup dumpling. i will definitely come back everytime I come back to Philadelphia

My review is pretty much, "Why is this place not always PACKED?" It did take me forever to venture into the restaurant, but since then, I've been back many times and have never been disappointed. Everything on the menu is delicious. The brunch menu and the dinner menu - while small - only include delicious things. Who needs a huge menu with filler when you can have a small one with yum after yum? The Tagliolini, Pappardelle w/black truffle, and the chicken dish (which I can't recall the name of) are delicious. The staff and owner are also super cool. Definitely would recommend... and bring CASH.
The service wasn't good, waitress forgot an appetizer, no warm  Irish soda bread only cold rolls, disappointed

We LOVE Tashan. We used our Living Social coupon tonight and loved everything. The server was the same as our last, a very nice and helpful woman named Virginia. She helped us pick the perfect menu and our favorite this time was the scallops. A MUST try. The calamari was wonderful, matched perfectly with cheesy naan. Tashan is beautiful, the staff is gracious,we left happy and full yet again. Thank you Tashan!
Don't go here if you are gluten intolerant! The staff was very clear with us that they can not accommodate this need.

Meh... The food came out quickly but still gave me time to make friends in the dining area, which was cool. They screwed up one of the  dishes on my order but there were three or four people that came in with big orders at a similar time so I feel for them. It happens. The food was all super greasy... when it sat for an hour after we ate, the grease all separated itself from the rest of the food and lay in a puddle around everything. The best food item was the bbq pork ribs, which were super tasty even though a puddle of oil coalesced around the OUTSIDE of the container when I took them out of the bag. They were super tasty though. The garlic chicken wasn't garlicky or spicy... the hot sesame dumplings were not spicy either. Nothing that was supposed to be spicy actually was... Also... the food went right through my wife's system and made me feel bloated.... The prices we're good for the amount of food that we got. The flavor was decent and there wasn't anything bad necessarily. Yeah, I dunno... I think I'll look around for other options.

I'm giving Marlow and Sons 5 stars because...isn't it obvious? The food and atmosphere is maybe the best around. My comment is related to the morning coffee scene though. I've lived directly across the street for the last 5 years and have witnessed many changes to not only the neighborhood but the coffee too. First of all, as much as I love this place, why is the daytime service so bad? Just because you're behind the machine doesn't mean you can't at least say hello or acknowledge the presence of the customer.  This doesn't speak for everybody, there are some really great people there too. Second with all the new options in our own amazing city, even borough, why does such a establishment with local and sustainable focus still get their coffee shipped out from the west coast? Maybe the FedEx truck gives it that extra special flavor? One of the commenters below even proclaimed it's like SF in Brooklyn. As a customer living in Brooklyn and not a SF tourist, that's not a positive win for me. Will I keep getting my morning coffee here? Given it's close proximity to my studio, mostly yes. But I should probably keep my visits for the meals and get some morning exercise and walk a little farther down the road if for nothing else, supporting my local community while getting my cup of joe. The food at Marlow & Sons is amazing. Local, creative and simple all at the same time. No guilty pleasure there!
What a wonderful crew works here. Creative restaurant week offerings, beautiful AND delicious. Kudos to the owner and the staff for putting it out there for all to enjoy.

The place is always packed, but the line moves pretty quick and the food is good. We had both pizza & pasta. The only problem is that there isn't really room to eat inside. Still, it was a tasty and inexpensive meal - which in midtown isn't always easy to find. We even had a bonus of seeing a celebrity who was starring in a Broadway show nearby pick up his pre-show meal!
One of the better Chinese restaurants in the area.  No drinks with little pink umbrellas.  Service is fast and efficient.  A Chinese restaurant in a diner.

Had a bad experience when we checked out Southwark. The Manhattans at Southwark were (surprisingly) very watery. I imagine it's not usually the case, but when we told the bartenders that our drinks had come out a watery, they replied thatthey make hundreds of Manhattan, had won awards for them, and that nothing could possibly be wrong with them. No offer was made to remake. No other option was offered. We felt forced to ask for the check and to leave.  While we did not drink the drinks, no drink was taken off the check. It was the bad service that really bothered us. We wrote management about our negative experience, and we did not hear anything back. We understand that sometimes drinks don't hit the mark, but what was really disappointing was the service that we received. A miss for us. Save your hard earned money for better experiences. Vernick and The Franklin have been great.

Love this restaurant. The food is so wonderful. The staff is amazing..Didn't have to ask for coffee refill, they were there before my cup was finished. I recommended this restaurant to all my friends. I can't wait to go back!

I love this halal cart, one of the best i've had so far. I ordered chicken over rice and a salad, the white-sauce is great and so is the pepper but be careful of how much is put on it because its pretty spicy.
amazing! line is always long for a reason! & it moves quick! cant really ask for better prices!

When we come to the Market, we usually eat at Hershel's, but today there wasn't a line at Dinic's. The food was okay. I had their specialty, roast Italian pork, sharp prov and broccoli rabe. The pork was not that tasty. Anyhow...the worst was the housekeeping. Not only did they NOT wipe the counter after each guest, but they did not clean the serving baskets between guests. Not even spray or a rinse. The entire service area was unkempt. Ok, I'm done.

We got the lamb ribs, the pig tails, the crispy chicken skins and the razor clams. The razor clams were ok, but OH MY GOD, everything else was amazing. The smoked lamb ribs were according to my boyfriend, the best lamb he has ever ate, and I don't doubt it. The pig tails were crispy, fatty and salty in the best way possible and they had a nice salty kick. The crispy chicken skins, well what more can be said? Perfectly crispy, just the right amount of salty and simply divine.

I visited this restaurant on June 6th to celebrate my birthday with a few friends. at the time, the restaurant was not packed. our waiter took approximately 10 minutes before he came to introduce himself to us. My friends and I ordered drinks, apps and dinner, all of which took an extremely  long time to come to the table. Upon finishing dinner (which was actually pretty good), we noticed a mouse scurry across the dining room floor. When we notified our server, he went to tell the manager (did not apologize). The manager attempted a half apology stating that the mouse must have come from outside because the front door of the restaurant was open. Unfortunately, he did not offer anything to compensate us for our troubles that evening. I was utterly sick to my stomach after witnessing the vermin in the restaurant. Where there is one, there is more, so unfortunately, I will not be visiting Doc's Philadelphia again. Poor service, good food, and vermin...not my idea of a good night.

I've actually been to this place twice. I had a good experience the 1st time on a Friday night. The place was busy, but the server was attentive and we were able to hear some live music. The BBQ was delicious. I decided recently to come back a second time since I had such a good experience. The food was still excellent, but service was terrible. It was a Wednesday night and the place was packed because everybody was trying to use their Groupon before it expired. There were only 2 servers in the whole place taking care of customers and the manager was handling complaints. At one point, a family of 4 walked out because they didn't tell them that they ran out of pork until everybody else was served. The manager did offer to comp the meal, but they walked out anyway. My b/f and I received our food, but had no utensils to eat it. The BBQ meat was excellent but my sides were not the greatest.  Probably won't come back here. There are other excellent BBQ places we can go to with more consistent service.

I had my wedding reception here the end of June. The staff is amazing! First, Koulla was so patient with me and all of my questions leading up to the event. Then at my reception, every single staff member I interacted with congratulated my husband and I and they were so professional and friendly. I was very impressed with the service we received. They also did an amazing job preparing the room with the centerpieces and decorations I dropped off. The price was very reasonable, but I don't feel like I sacrificed quality for price. The food was amazing. My guests couldn't stop talking about how good the hor d'oeuvres were and our main courses were delicious. I had the broiled salmon and it was amazing! The wedding cake was also included in the package we chose and the bakery they use did a wonderful job. I don't usually even eat cake, but I loved our wedding cake, it was so moist and delicious. I was just so impressed with Marco Polo. It was so nice to be able to just relax and enjoy my wedding and not have to worry if everything was going to go smoothly.

I thought I may feel very good about this place because of my gluten free diet bias, but even my other gourmet friends who have no food restriction (and they were initially skeptical) said it was good and they want to come back here even without me. (I assume gluten-free food must taste even better too.) I would rate 4, if I would compare to some of Japanese restaurants, but it's 5 compare to most of Italian restaurant in city I have to say. In addition, I feel their food and service improved past one year since I started to go... But it just maybe I went off-peak hour and could have much more attention.   PS: If you are eating gluten-free food, please be sure to eat while it is warm, otherwise, the taste and texture quality go down a bit.

First of all I just had the Absolute Best chicken patties of my life. Simple in form and stupendous in function. Light and flaky crust with a filling of flavor and mild spices meant for the gods. My Creole Girl smoothie comprised of mango, bananna, strawberries and coconut water refreshed my partchness completley. Too bad for me that I am moving out of the area and did not pay attention to this comfy cozy relaxing cafe sooner. I give it a 5 star D-Lish!

Came here for the pastries! They had classic Italian cookies, breads, pastries, etc. We had cannolis, cupcakes, cheese bread, cookies and everything good! The red velvet cupcake was probably one of the best I've ever had. The frosting was amazing and covered with little flakes of chocolate. The cheese bread was great as a morning snack with coffee. Next time I'll definitely be looking forward to the fresh bread!
Yummy! Front counter girl was so nice. Fun, local soda
Food was all around ehh.. save yourself the disappointment and find a better place to eat.

Had a great dinner experience here with friends - we were celebrating a 21st birthday, and our server was very friendly and attentive. Sit outdoors if you get the chance! The food is delicious - we ordered mostly "small" plates, except for two friends who shared a burger, and the "small" plates are definitely not small. The burrata crostini is absolutely delicious. We also had a few beers and the really excellent pear cider. The atmosphere is very relaxed and overall it's an amazing establishment in the heart of Princeton.
Worth the wait.

I will be typing about the Big Ass Biscuit with Gravy from the Khyber Pass pub. I really like the biscuit because it is really is huge so if you are really hungry go there. The biscuit is firm but not that hard. The gravy though is the best part of this dish. There are little pieces of meat inside the gravy so after I finish the main part that is a biscuit  I get my spoon and just eat the gravy off my spoon. So if you are in Old City you should go to the Khyber Pass and eat a Big Ass Biscuit with Gravy! Looking for more awesome food Agent G.

Where shall I start...my boyfriend and I have been here a couple times before and have left beyond satisfied in the past. Tonight was just ridiculous to us. We waited about 30 minutes to be seated which is completely understandable for a Friday night. It is BYOB therefore we did (a bottle of wine), our server seemed to be offended by us having a personal bottle of hard lq and after that everything went downhill. The table next to us were seated after us and he proceeded to take their order before us. He stopped by their table to ask how everything was going, never once stopping by our table. He flew past our table a few times which is also understandable considering the huge crowd that takes over this restaurant almost every night. We finally get his attention to bring the check over and he does the math & just throws the check on the table. My boyfriend always whips out his phone to calculate 20% gratuity, but this guy didn't even deserve pocket change. Never in my life have I experienced such terrible service. Yeah the food is great but there are plenty other restaurants that provide the full package..great food AND great service.
Best restaurant! Food and server were both amazing!

I came here once earlier this year late night.. our bartender was very friendly , down to earth and just overall pleasant. It was laid back and casual. I must say I had way too much to drink and at $25 a shot.. I should of known better .. lol
good place and tasty food
The soy bean tofu soup is excellent! They also refill the side dishes. They don't take reservation. Go in around 6pm would have a higher chance of a table.
Great food, great service!  Had the filet at a birthday dinner here.  Best BYOB in Fairmount

Figs is a very nice BYOB restaurant to dine in before visiting the Philadelphia Museum of Art on one of those lazy Sunday mornings.  You can't beat the proximity - a half a block from the museum.  It's a small place but the food is excellent and reasonably priced.  The staff and owner are friendly and go out of their way to make you feel comfortable.  I recommend their crab benedict.

A range of decent to good food. Service was slow, unsure if some one called out but the host apologized several times.  Seemed genuine about it.   I had the peanut butter and fluff with fresh berries which was good and my brother had the chicken and waffles which he loved. Everyone else said their meals were ok.   Atmosphere, decor is nice.  Overall compared to others this experience is a little below 3 stars.
Scott is the face of Kati Roll.  He is a tremendous guy and the food is divine. My only gripe is the lack of mango lassi this week.
The food is delicious! Panini was so savory! Crepe was scrumptious!! Nutella and strawberry is a must have!!! I just moved here and I'm going to live in this place! Tonight I'm trying a salad!

I'm a bit baffled as to how this restaurant got four stars. Brooklynites should know better. This is an example of when hipsters try to re-create a classic dish for other hipsters without keeping it authentic. I've spent about 2 months total traveling all around Japan and I can honestly say there is nothing remotely authentic about the food here. It was a big let down. I'm still on the hunt for authentic ramen in Brooklyn, but until then I guess I have to go into Manhattan.
Great new spot in Bushwick. Good happy hour, great cocktails. Fantastical back patio.

I'll be honest.....I haven't had Pho soup from many places. However after having it here, your taste buds don't feel like they're missing a thing ! Intense flavor with all the works. I've eaten in and also taken out. To go, they all of the ingredients neatly packed. The thin cut beef accompanied the soup flawlessly. The spring rolls are light and tasty with the sauce, and the summer rolls are a hearty meal paired with the soup!
Good clean place, beautifully decorated. Was greeted immediately on entrance. Waitress helped me with menu choice. Everything was delicious. Food came out super quick. Great place would recommend it.

The customer is NOT always right! Went in today with my husband for lunch, we noticed a special on the board for a lobster salad sandwich with your choice of side for $7.99. We both ordered it... First of all there was no choice of side, they gave us coleslaw without even asking (I can get past that) then we paid. As soon as we sat down my husband says "I think they over charged us" so he got up and looked at the sign again to confirm his suspicion. It said $7.99 clearly. So when he told the woman at the register she told him the sign was wrong and asked if we still wanted our sandwiches? Who does that? She should have just offered to give him the $10 back that she overcharged us! We won't be back any time soon!!! Very disappointing!

My fiance took me out for a great date in this Italian grocery store/dining market. We had a delicious salumi and cheese plate, served with my favorite alcohol, Prosecco. Totally worth a trip. Btw, that basically what other people around us had ordered. It was crowded. We only had the appetizer and we went to Korean town for a dinner. : )　We don't usually eat salumi and cheese, but we find them very good.
It is was it is. The burgers aren't going to knock your socks off, but go so you can say you went

I love this place! Good food! Great atmosphere! Awesome people! I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a good time and Nintendo! Where else can you drink and play Mario Cart? You walk in and instantly feel like your with friends. Anyone who thinks otherwise is just socially inept. Always a great time and reasonably priced.

This place was amazing. Unlike Grimaldi's they take cards. The pizza is fresh and flavorful. Easily some of the best in NYC. The vibe is welcoming, despite the unfortunate war going on between them and Grimaldi's. The theatrics of that situation makes for an interesting story and a fun eating experience. The dough is great, the sauce is great. Fresh mozzarella, flavorful pepperoni. Love this place.

I thought the food was just as good as any sushi I've had in Philly (if not better), but reasonably priced.  The owner came over and chatted with us for a long time, even brought us some plum wine.  Such a nice guy!
Fantastic! Great atmosphere and amazing food! There were 17 pieces of shrimp in my fajita!!!

We came here on a saturday night, and YES it was busy. BUT so worth it. I got the short ribs infused in a red wine sauce and gnocche noodles. There was nothing left in my plate. It was a little chilly so bring a jacket. I should of known this knowing the area. I would like to visit this place n the future.

Excellent pizza, was walking by and the recession special caught my eye, but the yelp reviews drew me in; the service and ultimately execution knocked it out of the park. The first time was just the recession special, an amazing deal at 5 and change for two slices and a fountain soda. What sealed it was ordering delivery had two large pies one plain and one pepperoni and the quoted delivery time was 30-45, however the pizza was here between 20-30 minutes. At the end of the day, the brick oven taste is the lasting memory but the attention to detail leaves you wanting more. As for the taste, I'm one for a million toppings on my pizza and i still prefer the plain.

This place is a do not miss in NYC. The decor is minimalist, stark, and absolutely stunning. The service is prompt and friendly. And the food...well, there really are no adequate words. Just fresh and phenomenal. Go right now!
Quality snack at cheap prices... Everything on the menu is tasty and under $10... The portions are small so try a few things. Great to grab and walk over to the highline.
The food was fresh and tasty and service was quick and thorough.  Very reasonable for Princeton.
i love all pizza. and although a little thin for me, still very tasty. i had the goat cheese special. it was fresh and salty, just how i like it. very upscale for a pizza place...

We walked in, the place was not crowded for a Friday night. I ordered a Mediterranean Mule and it came in a copper mug, which reminded me of the copper cup my mom gave me back in 1991. I was 10... Life was good back then, simple some may say. My mom gave me the copper cup to put pencils and crayons as homework started to come in at a frequent rate. I loved that copper cup more than I loved my sky blue crayon, which later, sadly, dissappeared after using it too much...

Sat in the back and had a great dinner. Maybe the dinner was better than I expected bc I had amazing company, or maybe I am a meat and potatoes kind of person so the menu catered to my every (carnivore) wish. Regardless, a super place for a low key and yummy bite. The waitstaff was a little slow (not for me, but someone else would have complained) because you know what - people in NY need to get over their self absorbed "IM SPECIAL KISS MY TUSH" attitude and relax, enjoy the beautiful surrounding and yummy beef jerky!

I have been here 3 times. Most times, on Friday nights. Never disappointed. The food is great. The drinks are strong and taste great. I have had the caihpiriniah (idk if I spelled that correctly lol). Its a Brazilian drink full of fruits, sugar, and alcohol. The steak is great. The music is fun and they often have a band with carnival dancers.

I decided to try this new spot since I drive by every day and work across the street.  Upon entry it is very new looking and not full and overloaded with stuff like places tend to get after a while.  It almost looks as though they are still filling out some shelves and one fridge case in the back which was still empty.   I order the "flying meatball" #12 hot sandwich which listed meatball/pesto/prosciutto/ maybe mozzarella and sauce.  This came as a sub sandwich on some type of 6 inch roll.  The sandwich seemed very light as in not enough in between the bread.  I opened it up and saw 1 average sized meatball sliced into 4 pieces with no sign of mozzarella but the pesto did present a good aroma.  It was a red sauce with pesto mixed in but barely any sauce to be seen.  As for the bread which is great in local places like Zizza's (Florham Park) or Sorrento's (East Hanover) or even Espisito's around the corner from this place, it was miserable.  The roll was definitely microwaved to warm it up but had that ruined bread feeling after it is microwaved.   So for horrendous bread and 1 stinkin' meatball in my $8 or so sandwich I was left hungry and unsatisfied.   With so much good solid competition nearby I wish this place well but they need substantial improvements in bread quality and putting something between the microwaved bread.   After giving them a shot I won't be back nor will recommend to co-workers.  I also suggest $1 off per sandwich for Novartis employees that display a badge most businesses offer that type of discount.
This is real Chinese food.  Come here.  Everything I have had has been great.  Try the pot stickers, pork chop over rice, noodle soup.  But be sure to order from the Chinese menu.
Great price and quality for a noodle place! Beef cake and spicy beef noodle soup are must have.
Love peaches! Food is amazing & service is great. Not a long wait if you know what time to come. Great neighborhood spot to enjoy some outside lunch.

Hands down one of the best meals in the city. The food is creatively crafted and truly memorable. My must-have favorites are the edamame dumplings and wasabi crusted filet. This is my favorite place for that special romantic date.

My first time. I had the chicken samosas and the saag lamb - medium spicy with a side of plain naan. The chicken samosas were good. The dough was nicely cooked. The filling was fragrant, but a little dry and a little bland. The lamb saag was wonderful, however --- high quality chunks of lamb that were tender and not cooked to death. The saag was very flavorful with just a little heat. I would have preferred more heat, so next time I will ask for my food spicy. My impression of their spiciness is: Mild = no heat. Medium = just a touch of heat. Spicy = not sure, but probably what fans of Indian cuisine want.
Awesome food!! The flavors are awesome and the food does justice to the fresh farm vegetables . Great choices for vegetarians and the vegan option is also great!

I've been coming here for years and love the food and wait staff. Their chef salad is amazing as well as their bread. However, I really am a fan of all of their food. I have just about tried everything on the menu and have yet to be disappointed.

Housesitting in Kensington, and the owners recommended I see Joe when I need a sandwich as big as my head. It's my last day here, and I'm annoyed with myself for not having gone earlier. (Although my waistline is probably grateful.) Ordered the balsamic chicken sandwich with fancypants cheese and avocado. Except they were out of avocado. I was going to make another selection when Joe suggested he put fresh pesto in place of the avocado. So be it. Sandwich indeed came out as big as my head. It's delicious. The bread is so good, the chicken is tender and yummy. The pesto tastes great. I planned to eat half and save the other half for later, but later equals 20 minutes after I finished the first half. I'm pathetic. And happily full.
We waited 3 HOURS for our food to come. Ridiculously horrible service. Would never go back or recommend.

Absolutely wonderful place. Great food, ambiance, amazing customer service. Came on a Saturday night with a large group,made a reservation and they called me ahead of time to let me know they wouldn't be able to seat us immediately as the last party was running late which was such a nice courtesy. When we arrived, the host offered us drinks on the house because of their delay. food was unique and tasty- favorites at our table were kale and shrimp salad and the squid ink pasta.  Unique decor and nice vibe. Definitely recommend!!
Best Philly Steaks I ever had.  Can't beat the bread . Get cheez whiz and hot peppers and a side of onion rings.

ATTENTION!!! I can not give zero star and I'm upset about that. I have read majority of review and here's some thing people who are currently customer or would visit this place should read. 1) This place uses a lots of MSG and I can tell because I'm allergic to it. I told the waitress of the restaurant which is probably daughter or niece of the owner not to put any in and she already agreed on telling the chef not to do it yet they did it anyway. 2) There are bugs on my rice. My first bowl of rice had bugs on it so I was thinking of it as a minor mistake until my second bowl came out. there were still bugs on it. The man behind the counter offer me a 3 dollars discount which is the price of the rice bowl and throw me a dirty look. Are you kidding me? 3) I came here 3 times and same waitress serves me. Maybe the service is a little slow but i don't mind however, she asked me if I can leave the tips in CASH AND ON THE TABLE. When I asked her why, she told me the old man discreetly take the tips from his employees when they are not around. For that reason, I will never come back. For anyone that willing to eat in there despite the fact that their health is endanger, please leave the tips in cash to reduce the struggle those students who work there have to deal with beside their not very nice boss. Thank you.

I popped in for a late-night meal and chose the chef's tasting menu for $65.  It was fantastic!  I've eaten at a lot of great tapas places.  I've eaten at a lot of top-rated restaurants.  I can say this meal was phenomenal, service was first-rate, and truly a great value for the money.  I like all of the Garces places, but this is my favorite.  I really don't think one can have a bad experience here unless you bring it with you.

Our favorite Portuguese restaurant in Newark's Ironbound neighborhood by far.  Have been going for years and am never disappointed.  It can get crowded so be sure to have a reservation or go off hours.  My top three dishes here are the cockles in garlic sauce (appetizer) enough to share with 4-6.  They are small, succulent cockles, better than any steamed clams you've every had.  Be sure to sop up the sauce with the wonderful, fresh, rolls.  As either a main dish or an appetizer you should have their mussels in tomato sauce.  I only eat mussels if they aren't fishy and these are a winner.  Even good next day cold if you have leftovers.  Plenty for two people to share as a main dish or more folks as an appetizer.  Also, big enough to share (if you're getting the idea that the portions are large, you are correct) is my hands down fav main dish, Frutos Do Mor Na Cataplana - Seafood in a light red sauce served in a copper kettle.  It's incredible and again, you will sop up the sauce or put it over the rice that comes with it.  It's a mix of lobster, clams, mussles, scallops and other fish and the sauce isn't heavy like a marinara but is light and with a hint of sweetness. I avoid the codfish because it's a dried, salted codfish (typical for Portuguese food) and I would rather have fresh fish / seafood.  Their steaks are good too if you must. For ambiance we try to sit at one of the tables in the front near the bar.  Be sure to specify that if you are a party of 4-6. The staff is friendly though busy.  We always get the "green" wine too.  Blue label on the bottle.  Perfect with the fish.  It's a young white wine that is refreshing and not at all expensive.  As a red wine drinker, if it's white it's got to be exceptional and this is. Desserts are standard fair though their flan is really good, we usually walk down the street to a bakery and get fresh natas instead.

Read all the good reviews so had to try it out. My boyfriend is very picky when it comes to his pizza and even he said the pizza was really good. The chicken empanadas were also quite yummy! To top it off the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming!

You literally get a taste of real delicious authentic Bolivian cuisine. Being Bolivian let me tell you, it's hard to find Bolivian food around the New York/New Jersey area. Finally got a taste of home :) try the Saltenas and sandwiches de chola super delish!

Arrived At This Amazing Venue Located Vy The Water With An Amazing View It Was Beautiful Inside And Out The  Waitresses The Hostesses Were All Friendly And Accommodating The Atmosphere Was Latin. The Food Was Different But Amazing. The Appetizer Was Tasty As Well As My Main Course The Salmon Was Fresh It Needed A Lemon Which I Asked For But Never Received Nonetheless Amazing Experience!!

Food was decent but the service was HORRENDOUS! My friend & I walked in for happy hour and we ordered two beers at the bar. We took a look around and noticed that there wasn't any seating at either of the bars so we took a chance and sat down at one of the tables. We figured if it was for only those who are eating dinner, then we'd be told that and we'd get up. We were approached by the waitress (I wish I knew her name) and at that moment, we decided to order an appetizer to munch on while we drank our beers. She points at our beers and says "for future reference, there is table service."  Before we could even utter an apology, she stormed away. After getting the menu, we decided to share a plate of guacamole. The waitress looked at us as if she was offended that we only ordered one small app.  After ordering, she never spoke to us, never followed up with us, pretty much ignored us for the entire time. We noticed that she would serve water to anyone who sat down, except for us. She would ask everyone else at the tables if they were ok, if they needed anything else, the usual stuff that a waiter/waitress would ask. We got nothing! She, then, proceeds to take our plate of guac away before we were even done!! I mean, c'mon!!!! We tried to get her attention so we could pay the bill and leave, but since she wasn't giving us the time of day, we went to the bar and asked the bartender. Our waitress was standing nearby so she looks at us and goes "I'll take that, it's my tab." My friend told her that we were trying to get her attention as she walked by us 10x but she wouldn't look at us. The waitress comes back to my friend and asks "what did you just say?" standing nose to nose with my friend.  I'm sorry, but I have NEVER been treated so terribly in my life. I worked in customer service, in the food industry at that, back in high school so I get that the job can be frustrating but you work for your tip and I'm not so sure what her issue was. I will never go back to this establishment!

I LOVE AREPAS CAFE!!! I can eat here everyday if I could. The AREPAS are the bomb!! You need to get the one that comes with everything ( sweet plantains, meat, avocado, etc) ohhhh and the green sauce is delicious!! and addictive. If you love Spanish food this is your spot!!! Get the passion fruit mimosa!!!!!!!! #spanishgirlyelper
this place is GREAT! bartenders are super responsive and fun to talk to. kinda was in the mood for pasta, though. wish they had that on the menu. maybe something for the management to think about?
This place has great happy hour deals!! Everyone that works here is super nice. The Mexican revolver cocktail is on point.

Came at 730 on a Friday, nervous at first with how few customers were in, but the nerves didn't last long!  Had the lettuce wrap app which was great!  Wife had the steak tips, I had the mahi mahi (and some steak tips), both were absolutely fantastic, and would get again, although based on the reaction of the customer next to us, I may be getting the samosas next time, she couldn't stop talking about it. Drinks were very well made, had a Manhattan and a beer, my wife had a couple martinis, not too strong, but definitely not weak, perfectly done! Desert was great, had the Creme Brûlée and wife had the cheesecake. Not sure why this place isn't packed on a nightly basis, it really is that good!  Definitely coming back for more.  Only knock is that the live music tonight night have been a bit on the loud side, other then that, nothing to complain about at all.  If you're in the area, stop by, you won't be sorry!

I come here anytime I return to my hometown. Most times I come through Kearny I lack the time necessary to sit and eat but the Greeks is where you should put in time with their outstanding meals any time of the day.
I always enjoy myself here. Good food, good service and the ambiance is nice. Love the pulled pork sandwich.
This place has amazing staff and is the best go to spot to have a few beers & relax. Food is good too.

Pompei is my favorite pizza in Bayonne.  I grew up on New York pizza and when I moved to New Jersey it failed to compare for the most part.  I will say that North Bergen has a few really good spots but Pompei brought me back to my youth and never fails to satisfy!  They have to be doing something right as they recently celebrated 50 years open.  That is something to brag about now days.  The crew behind the counter are awesome too.  When you are in Bayonne you have to check them out.
The food was good but not great, server was very pleasant but everything moved a bit slow.  Would try it again though.

I bought lunch here for the office and it was ok. i had cold roast beef on a bagel and i ordered it WITHOUT lettuce and guess what i got? that being said, the staff a nice and the food was fresh. i also got the brownie's for desert: best brownie i ever had!

This place is amazing!  Great food, great service, and a really wonderful atmosphere.  I recommend it highly for a romantic dinner or even a group celebration. It's a beautiful place, designed and built by the owners, and they came back post-Hurricane Sandy even better than before.  Ben and his team really know how to run a first class restaurant, and, bonus! it's in one of the coolest neighborhoods in New York.
Ordered the lamb chops and lamb shish kabob both were amazing! Staff was fast and friendly and the food was great. Its definitely my new go to spot for Turkish food! :)

This place seems to be popular, but I found it to be a total disaster.  First of all, most of the food is terribly greasy, even for foods that are fried.  The tables for 4 are way too small for a party of 4, and to add insult to injury, the service is sloppy and unprofessional. In fact, at the beginning of our meal, the busboy serving knocked over a glass of water, it spilled all over 2 of my dinner guests, and their shopping bags, and all over the floor.  Nobody came by with a mop or extra towels to clean it up, and they had to sit with a puddle of water between them during the entire meal.  One of my guests, who was visiting from Europe, said in a case like that the manager would come over to apologize, and order the mess immediately cleaned up.  Nothing like that occurred.  If you want to impress your out-of-town family or friends do not bring them here, in fact don't go yourself.

Bad news. The experience I had tonight at this restaurant is unprecedented. While most of the food was delicious, the stew was not. It was badly overcooked and when the server asked about our meal, I told him what I just said, honestly and tactfully. He seemed a bit annoyed that I didn't like the dish, but offered to bring us something else. We ordered the steak, which was good. My biggest complaint was the lack of service. We asked for an iced tea on 4 separate occasions to different staff members and couldn't get it until almost the end of our meal. We were given a bad attitude I believe because we chose to share a meal and they didn't like that. They charged us a $6 sharing fee which was never revealed to us when we were ordering. It just showed up on the bill. After the meal was over... We paid the bill in cash. It was $77. We chose not to leave a tip because of the poor service.  Something I had only done once before in my entire life. The server chased us down the street yelling and screaming at us. He said, we were $5 short on the bill. We counted the money carefully and saw the $5 we had put in the pile was missing. I believe he pocketed the $5 claiming he didn't have it.   Still shouting on the street, he threatens to call the police unless we give him the $5 we owe.  I knew we paid it and he was angry that we hadn't tipped him. I told my friend to let him call the police because we did nothing wrong. He proceed to call us the B word, F word and finally called us LESBIANS!  This behavior was the most unprofessional I had ever experienced and blown completely out of proportion. A smarter person would be interested to inquire about what was unpleasant so that they could improve their service in the future.  Instead, he was insulted and bitter that we had opted to not leave a tip for poor service. I know this restaurant has lots of great reviews. But, the snooty attitude and cursing was ridiculous. I think as patrons, we have the right to share a meal. I would not recommend this restaurant.  They turned a birthday celebration among friends into a Jersey Shore episode.

Cool place - great cocktails. Excellent steak, spicy/sweet desserts  - and very well trained wait-staff. Had a group of 8 and everyone seemed happy. The owner/manager stopped by for a chat which gives the place a good friendly vibe.
Awesome food every-time! This place is always on point

The service was impeccable, professional, and personable. The selection on the menu combined with the specials make the epicurean selection top shelf. The  olives appiteasers were a nice selection, the bread was so fresh, and the Caesar salad was lovely with a light dressing that was quite tasty. Add the fresh pepper and the fresh grated cheese and wow! The pasta was done just right, the sauce was so flavorful, it was heavenly. Nice size portion, just enough! The tiramisu dessert was massive -be sure to share it lest you will eat it all yourself!

Food is way overpriced. Go to Mcdonalds before coming here. Much better food for a lower price. Service is also incredibly slow for not being that busy. So if you want an interminable wait for the privilege of paying 12 bucks for a burger this is the place.

Tilt has a trifecta of booze food and game. Huge tap bar. Most of the menu is locally sourced and is all delicious. Games are amazing. For a place that just opened up they have an outstanding collection of classic arcade and pinball. Really want more do you want? Even if you aren't a huge nerd this shit is fun and booze and food is en pointe.

An overpriced disappointment.  Food was  good but that was more than offset by the terribly long time it took between order being placed and delivery to the table. No bread or water was on the table and we had to request it several times before it finally arrived. Staff seemed more interested in selling wine and cocktails than in getting food that we ordered out of the kitchen. One bright spot was the bar - a great selection of spirits, a large number of well conceived cocktails on the menu, fresh and high end ingredients and terrific bartenders. I would recommend this place for a pre-dinner cocktail but will not return for a meal.
Love the burgers and fries here!! The space has great energy and the music is great. Outdoor seating is really lovely, too.

I have to say, the food was amazing. Great calamari, and we also had the mussels in garlic white wine sauce. Entrees were the arugula salad with steak, and the steak and fries. Excellent flavors and well done. The complaint is with the service. Our server was rude, barely spoke to us, and it almost felt like we were inconveniencing him by even dining there. When he took our dinner order, he didn't even speak. He just stood over us and seemed annoyed to have to take our order. The food came promptly, and was delicious. The cocktails were good. Everything was fine. When we got the bill, however, we noticed that the 20% we saved from Groupon was added back on as gratuity. Normally, I would be taken aback, thinking I'm more that responsible enough to provide my own gratuity, but now with the BAD service we received I was even more peeved that they included a whopping 20% on our bill! I don't think our server deserved 20% because of his poor attitude , and it seemed like we were being punished for using the Groupon reserve feature. Won't be back to this restaurant because of this. Feel insulted.

Everyone who works there is super friendly, the coffee is amazing (specifically the honey lavender latte). Always a pleasure to go in to get a quick cup of coffee from these guys, keep up the good work!

Food was good; the atmosphere was casual; the place is really small and the wait was a little bit more than expected; there were no real curry dishes just noodles, fried rice and wok dishes; the food was spicy but without burning your mouth and you could taste the flavor; when I asked her if she had a bar she said no but there was a drink menu when we sat down at the table after all; I would not come back without trying the rest of the places and then seeing how they compared to the rest on the street
Definitely my go-to for delivery pizza in Burlington. Quality pizza, good prices. Their whole wheat crust is excellent.
The service is great, the food is tasty and the ambiance is modern and fun. Great place to eat with a small group or to grab a quick bite solo.
Not worth the line! Waste of my time. Food was okay. Ippudo is much better.. And watch out for waitresses that would stop you for 15% tips even if you don't like their service.
Great for brunch! The drinks were good and kept coming as we needed them. Food was great and there's a pretty wide range to choose from.

My first time. I had the chicken samosas and the saag lamb - medium spicy with a side of plain naan. The chicken samosas were good. The dough was nicely cooked. The filling was fragrant, but a little dry and a little bland. The lamb saag was wonderful, however --- high quality chunks of lamb that were tender and not cooked to death. The saag was very flavorful with just a little heat. I would have preferred more heat, so next time I will ask for my food spicy. My impression of their spiciness is: Mild = no heat. Medium = just a touch of heat. Spicy = not sure, but probably what fans of Indian cuisine want.

This place is AMAZING!!!!! I am so happy that there is a spot like this right in my town!!! FINALLY!!!!!! The crepes and paninis are DELICIOUS!!!!!! They have both food and dessert crepes!!!!! They have juices with no additives -- just fruits and veggies!! My FAV is the pineapple/spinach!!  The ORGANIC COFFEE is to die for!!!! I am a bit of a coffee connoisseur and the espresso is heavenly!!!!! On top of having all of this amazing food, the owner and his awesome girl are soooo friendly and down to Earth!! He really strives on perfection and goes the distance to make everyone happy and feel at home.  Come and get a taste of perfection at 3rd Wave in Lyndhurst!! They open till midnight tonight!!! That's another great thing!! I will be there after my Zumba class to refuel!!! Woo hoo!! ENJOY!!! I know you will!!!!

Came in with a group of friends on Friday night and it was PACKED. Thank god we made a reservation so we didn't have to wait too long. We were seated in a nice booth that had 6 individual pots and a BBQ grill, so it was perfect. The girls in the front were super nice, even gave us some watermelon juice while we waited. The waiters did a great job getting us what we needed as well. Definitely will be back again!
Had the tacos Al Pastor with everything... it was meh, that was my first visit, so I hope the steak and chicken are better.

I dropped by this café by chance without any expectations. For a place in Philadelphia I got impressed by the worn out, old style furniture which adds to a casual but personal atmosphere. I ordered a mushroom quiche which was heated up and to my surprise served with a fresh but sinple green salad on the side. Real olives were tasty as were the pickles too. All of this for just about 6$! Great place for having a light lunch or just a coffee. I spent my time reading a book while other customers on their tables seemed to be working on their laptops meaning it's a great place to concentrate on own thing without noise or interruptions.
I wish I had checked the reviews. Grossly overpriced and mediocre food. Just had the smallest lobster roll I have seen in a long time.

Really Disappointing. We typically Eat-in and have a great experience, but we ordered delivery last night and it was just pitiful. $40 for 2 smoothies and 2 salads and after waiting an hour, the salads were like a side salad. They were the smallest $10 salads I've ever seen and not worth the money at all. We almost took them back bc it was so ridiculous to pay $10 for something that fits into a small bowl. I don't know if it was because of delivery that they just didn't care and threw something into a plastic container but it just made us angry- what a rip off. It filled probably 1/3 of the plastic container. When you have to supplement your take out with a sandwich it's not worth it. Save your money. Plus side- the smoothies were good. My advice- eat in.
I Love sitting outside on summer nights here enjoying cocktails with my friends. Food always good, service average. Always have specials on appetizers it seems. Prices are good.

This is my go to place for meeting friends.  Always comfortable, always seems to be half price appetizers. I love sitting outside in the warmer months. General Taos & swordfish dumplings are my goto menu items.

We normally love eating here, but their takeout service is slipping. Twice I arrive and they don't have any knowledge of my order. Three times I arrive 45 minutes after placing an order and they make me wait 20 more minutes for my food. Also, the food is highly overpriced. It would be nicer to have smaller portions and lower prices.  Not everyone can afford a $20 lunch for a soup and shrimp salad.
NY is full of ramen shops.  The quality of food and experience at Ippudo NY does not justify the long wait times.  But during it's off-peak times, it is worth a try.

Been coming here once a month for years and tonight will be the last time. I have never encountered such rude and unwelcoming hostesses. Three times they lied to both my wife and I about our table being ready and then laughed when we tried to complain.  They were rude and acting like little girls. As someone who has loved their food and been going for years, I am thoroughly disappointed. Good job losing a loyal neighborhood patron (and their friends).
Super food! Best falafel in Brooklyn. Excellent value for their meal deals too, staff are consistently friendly and cheerful. Everyone should come try this place out!

Beware - this restaurant does NOT take credit cards, CASH ONLY. The restaurant itself is small but intimate, decor is dated but clean. In the summer months they provide seating outside, where you can bring your dog, which is nice. To review our dinner experience, the mozzarella and tomato salad appetizer was tasty and the beet and goats cheese was OK, the beets were a little dry and slightly passed their best but not to bad. I asked for a little more french bread to go with my tomato salad as it had a lot of dressing on it but was told they were out which was odd as the table next to us was shortly served with french bread! I ordered the fish special but would not recommend it. They presented it to me first and it looked great in the pan, I thought for an instance they were going to prepare it at the table but it was taken away and then served to me over 10 mins later. By the time it arrived it was cold at the tail-end (stone cold, like it had been chilled) and lukewarm at the head. When I told the waiter he strongly disagreed with me and told me that the fish was not cold, then walked away. He came back to our table and offered to cook it again when he noticed I wasn't eating. The fish already had the flavor that it had been reheated so I declined to reheat it again, by that point I was done with the dish anyway as the vegetables they served with it were also old, over cooked, cold and again had a flavor that they'd been reheated. I understand kitchens prep food in advance but seriously it doesn't take much to serve fresh food and have a little quality control. That said, my husband really enjoyed his shrimp pasta dish, it was hot and tasty. Pasta was cooked well and lots of shrimp. For dessert we had tiramisu it was tasty and a good size to share. When we received the bill we immediately handed over a credit card and were told they didn't accept cards. As we didn't have cash my husband left and walked to a nearby ATM. While he was gone the waiter came by, took the bill and as he walked away told me they had forgotten something. I thought at first that they might comp the dessert or something like that as the main dish had been bad but no, they actually added a few items they'd forgotten and charged us in full for everything. Not good customer service in my opinion for a badly cooked and expensive meal. The staff were pleasant and the waiter as we were leaving attempted an overdue apology but by then it really was too late! It's possible we would come back for salad and pasta if we were desperate but then again there are LOTS of other restaurants to eat those dishes. I am sincerely disappointed as I would liked to have added this restaurant to our list of local and walkable places to eat but sadly no!
So, so, so good! Came on a Wednesday at 6 and there was no line. Took over 30 min to get our pie, but it was worth it. Wish they had a few more things on the menu.

Quality has sunk. The basics of Japanese appetizer was horribly done.   The kariage was probably triple fried. Very dry and old aged meat. Not juicy at all. Katsu-don was overdone as well. Probably fried twice since the pork was dry as well. Nabeyaki was bland and tasteless. Almost nothing worthy inside. And two other reasons to give it 1 star. Owner who is in a dress shirt was super lazy. He was staring at the counter and waiting for his employees to serve. I was watching the food turn cold. Then he goes taking a broom and sweeping the floor, dust flying everywhere while people eat. Bye Westside.
I Eat here about 3 times a week lol. The food is awesome, the people are friendly, and the prices are the best.
The peach iced tea is amazing. Brunch until 4 on weekdays. Maple bacon (with the syrup on the bacon drool drool). Cozy, airy fun setting in great location. Excellent service.
Went for dinner again on 7/25... It was just as delicious as before. Great food and great service!! Still one of my favorite restaurants to go to :)
Food was great (especially the lamb) with lots of nice extra touches and charming owners. Also great live music.

$4 PBRs! We ordered a round of 3 PBRs. Near finished. Want to leave. Waitress comes "You guys want another round?" Group: "i think we're good. thanks." Waitress comes back with another round for us. Not sure if she took "we're good, thanks" as, sure we'll have another round, or if she scammed us into another round. Glad we only ordered $4 PBRs tho. Peace BarBacon.
Unexpectedly stumbled onto this. THough it is admittedly like an upscale Olive Garden, the dining room is great, and the food is really delicious. Nice wine selection. You will enjoy.
Local dive bar with bad dive bar food and cheep beer. Watch what you order or risk getting the GI bleed

I give this place five stars because of the quality of the food. A lot of people complain of the prices and I have to agree because just one burger and smoothie costs about fifteen dollars in here. On the other hand, the groothie (smoothie) is very healthy and good to my knowledge and that burger was gigantic!! I suppose if the burgers/sandwiches were smaller then the prices could be lower and I really cant eat a whole sandwich from Hip City unless Im drunk :-/ Not because of taste but size. In summary, you do get what you pay for at Hip City Veg and perhaps its worth the couple of extra dollars. It's convenient, healthier than most and taste's good. It's not going to be all the time but I'd go again (already been so many times). Oh and the employees are always pleasant.

We love Lucky Lou's! On a beautiful Friday night there is a wait for outdoor patio seating (with live music!) but the wait is worth it! The staff is very accommodating and the food is great! Very highly recommended!

We never heard of this place before passing it a week ago while driving by. What a great gem. Service: staff (everyone) were really nice good people. Food: We had the delicious pulled chicken melt sandwiches, spicy chicken wings, and fries.  Excellent sandwich, especially with the peppers and onions.  Wings were seriously perfect.  I know this sounds like I own the place, but just giving credit where credit is due.  Fries were very good as well. Ambiance: Large, fun inside with tables outside. Price: $40 all in for 1 app, 2 mains, 1 side and 1 drink. We will be back.
Love this place. It's a local business son they have their issues. But the service here for the most part is amazing, let's not even talk about the food...it's that good
I walked in here to get a sandwich and the family who runs the place was in a heated argument in the middle of the store. They didn't even pause when I walked in, so I walked right back out.

Chili Willie's -- it's a small friendly family owned establishment out in Boonton. Entering, you'll notice it's a bit cozy inside--the space is tight. I passed by once to obtain a takeout menu the first time, and it had been packed with clientele. On a later date, I returned because I was curious to try out their food. Sitting down, they brought a basket of tortilla chips and some salsa. Both were dandy. Looking over the menu, I decided on the enchilada version of the burrito -- with roasted pork inside. I also ordered a tamale as an appetizer. The tamale came first. It was decently sized -- not too small, and not gigantic either. It came in a partial corn husk, with a side of pico de gallo, which by the way, was excellent, bursting with flavor. In comparison, the tamale was not so flavorful. Next came the entree burrito. Remember now, I ordered the roast pork enchilada style burrito. They give a large portion size. It came with rice, beans, and more pico de gallo, plus the sour cream and tortilla chip decoration. This dish is where I will be resting my case. The enchilada burrito was quite good. It had a light tomato based sauce on top, and the tortilla wrapped the roasted pork. Now, let me say, the pork has a good flavor. Not great, but good. It was a smoky flavor. I attempted to detect whether or not they had added other seasonings or not. If they had, I wasn't able to taste them, because all I tasted was the smoky flavor. If you like smokey flavors, then this would be great for you. But I would have expected a more flavorful roast pork. Now onto the beans. So those beans. They were bland. They lacked flavor. Enough said. The rice was rice with some type of tomato flavor. It was more flavorful than the beans. They should probably spice up the beans more. And of course, my favorite piece of the meal was the pico de gallo. That was the most delicious part. But the beans, I think they need to work on those. So, all in all, this place needs to work on their seasoning. Their pico is quite good. Their beans are crappy bland, and the roast pork had a 1D smokey flavor. If they are able to impart more flavor other than smoke into their roast pork, that would be great. Their beans need more seasoning or some sort. I'm giving this place 2 stars for the food quality, especially when it's only a side dish that blows away the main course.

I'm lazy, so I don't really have to do this.  I am doing this for purely selfish reasons - I want Delaware and Hudson to be around for a long long time.   My wife and I had dinner here, from every morsel of the fresh root vegetables that were so carefully selected, to the fragrant home-made pretzel that crumbled on each bite while remaining moist on the inside, the cube of jelly like pork belly served on top of string beans perfectly spiced, the fresh pasta with that deliciously fresh tomato sauce, to the droplets of infused oil that provided a such balance to a beautifully prepared tuna, all the way through the beautiful deserts.  Nothing was out of place, or less than excellent.  This is perhaps one of the best meals we've had in a long time. Her choice of ingredients, her balance, and most importantly, her restraint is so rare.   Service was attentive and befitting of the level of cuisine here. If you are a food lover who has become jaded with the NY food scene of late, Delaware & Hudson will set you right. Bravo Chef Patti Jackson!
Great beer on tap, and always the best IPA out there. Very good service from everyone who works there. Don't forget to ask for chicken nachos, delicious!
Yummy!  Cute little place. Very clean. Quick and friendly service. Excellent prices and the food was fantastic!!!
Love this place! Food is great and the bartenders are very pleasant. Decor is cozy :)

Had the Mexican (vs. American) soft tacos with my fiancé and we absolutely loved them- I had the cows tongue/steak combo and he had steak. Definitely enjoyed the cows tongue more myself but everything tasted fresh and authentic. The salsa and chips they give you are great too! Definitely going back.

I was promised a long term job , instead I was hired off the books to help clean up and do the dirty work for the grand opening of stickys new location at 33rd st , and ultimately because I was never called back in for work or even when I made several attempts to contact the owner and he blatantly ignored my messages , I had to withdraw from college and  begin career searching ASAP .... Mean while the owner posts on Facebook that's there are positions available !!!!! I've never made an error I've always shown up to work on time and ready to work , there were no reasons to why I was "fired" if that's even what's that called , if your gonna  lay me off at least have the decency to let me know , I got bills just like everyone else and needs just like everyone else ....  I don't understand how cruel you have to be , to be able to promise a position to some one and have them do the hard labor then ignore them and hire new people .......  I'm sorry but you guys lost me as a customer and supporter !!!
I want to make love to this food. I do. and no one will be able to stop me. A delicious experience!
Can 5000+ people be wrong?  Go here, go easy on the hot sauce and drown it in white magic sauce.  You will wake up feeling a few pounds heavier but as my girl Donna says, "Treat yo self!"
Good portions and the chicken over rice is good, but waaay overrated and there are tastier  halal carts out there in the city.

We came out of MoMA and were looking for a good possibility to eat. Thanks to Yelp we found this restaurant to be very close and highly rated. To be honest the Bengal Tiger doesn't look that inviting from the outside. We only gave it a try because of the Yelp rating. The service was very polite and friendly and the food was absolutely delicious! The prices are ridiculously low, I wonder how they manage to offer that high quality for these prices. The only thing I can complain about is the toilett. There is only one unisex toilett that did not look very inviting. Minus one star for the location and the toilett.
Great food, superb service. This small restaurant is great value for your money and palate :-)

We stopped for dinner last night we went to the counter & was told to sit any where but the other room was cooler. It wasn't but the server was very nice I asked for a diet Pepsi I told him I saw a bottle in the fridge when we came. We sat and waited a long time for our soda & when it came I said this is diet Pepsi not Foxon Park oh he said I'm sorry he left for another long time & came back with I believe was the same soda  & I said this is diet Pepsi? Yes he said we took a bottle out of the fridge for you. I took a sip went up to the counter pointed at the bottle of Pepsi & said I would like that bottle of diet Pepsi . The man behind the counter said you can't have that it's for delivery customers!!!! WHAT! I'm a paying customer but I can't have a diet Pepsi! Give me a break if you happen to get so many delivery orders ( after 7:00 pm), why don't you just walk over to Krougers and pick some up? I got my grinder which was nothing special & washed it down with ice water. There are so many great pizza places in the area I don't need to go back there.
Decent spot for noodles soup.

Not impressed at all.  Took a biz contact here for dinner - service was harried - waiter asked for our order three times before our drinks even arrived at the table. It seemed they were trying to push as many people as possible through in the least amount of time and had no concept of enjoying one's meal.  Appetizers were okay, though every dish seemed to include grapes and cheese - very heavy.  Stuffed grape leaves were the smallest I've ever seen and were bitter - soaked in lemon juice.  Entree sizes were huge, but my steak was badly charred on the outside/ barely cooked on the inside and the accompnying potatoes were so salty I could not eat them.  A big plate of Ugh!  The waiter noticed I barely touched my entree - I told him it was pretty bad but I did not want to complain too much in front of a business prospect.  The good news is a manger soon arrived and asked if everything was okay - I politely told him no and he comped the entree.   Other friends have eaten here and liked it, but I think this place may have passed its prime.  The service was average at best, and at the price points they charge you have many other options with much better service and great food.  Ilili is off my list for now.

This is my favorite burger shack in the city, very affordable beer with a good atmosphere and obviously an excellent burger. The character of the bar/burger shack can be characterized by its menu, hanging on the wall in a picture frame with a total of 6 options. Just get the bistro burger and a mcsorley's for 3 a pint and call it an afternoon..

Went there last night with a friend for dinner and drinks and I had a fabulous time. We started in Eagans for drinks and went over to Halycon for dinner. I found the bartenders at Eagans really friendly and proffesional. And they make perfect drinks.. I think next time I will try their own brews we started with a dozen Welfleets and a bowl of the PEIs  and both were fresh as can be. The broth that the mussles can in was so good I almost wanted to pick the bowl up and drink it. The fries on them were hot and crisp and gave me something to sop up that delicious broth. For dinner I had the whole bronzino and my friend had the tuna. Both were equally as good and fresh as the starters. I was a chef in Manhattan for years and let me tell you... I would put this place up against any similar type restaurant in the city any day of the week. The crowd was young and hip and the place was packed to the gills. There is no need to make the trek and pay for tolls and parking when I can go up the road to this gem.. I cant wait to go back..
we  loved genos steaks...were going tomorrow.

So far ive been to this establishment twice and have had great quality food and will be frequenting more often.   The brown stew chicken and rice and peas are great and the chicken is juicy and falls right off the bone.  The beef patties are great as are the dumplings.  I look forward to exploring the rest of the menu. Only problem is very overpriced.  Two beef patties and a few dumplings for over 8 dollars and small container of food about 9 or 10$.

This evening, I asked for a small gelato. The woman ahead of me got one scoop in a cone. I got one scoop in a cup, and was charged fifty percent more. I pointed out that I was getting less food for more money, but they didn't seem bothered by this. The gelato itself was fine, but no better than what I've had elsewhere. None of the refrigerated bottled drinks have prices listed, though that was also true of the two other small food businesses in Connecticut I visited today. Maybe it's a local thing. Their dry goods are pretty unoriginal--simply what you would find in any grocery store, but much more expensive. I would say that this place might work for those who live nearby and want to get some food quickly, but there is another small market just few blocks away.
Delicious food with yummy ingredients. Chicken so perfectly cooked. Decent wine selection. Great desserts. Great service. Yum.

AMAZING pizza from a slice joint that is affordable for the neighborhood. I order in the margarita square pizza once a week and am always happy with service.  It is the best pizza - hands down. No fuss. Delivery times really vary ..probably because they are busy.
Can come in anytime and expect good service and most importantly, good pizza.
I could eat their breakfast sandwich every day for the rest of my life. Totally affordable, everything is delicious, a dream come true for someone with food restrictions of any kind!

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME!! Cheesesteaks are good and prices are decent but NOT worth the HOUR wait to get it. Incredibly inefficient service. You can't order until you pay and the lady at the register is also preparing food! Came between 2-3 so not even a popular time. If there is a line out the door you will definitely wait at least 45 min to order. Other places just as popular take 10 min for the same line.
Pretty damn amazing. Food was delicious and extremely authentic!! Will definitely go back!

I've been in Astoria for four years, and as spoiled as I am to be surrounded by such amazing food all the time, I was still missing quality Italian food.  I'd given a few local places a try, but none had really sung to me until I ate the pasta at Vite.  Instant joy! This place has been packed since it opened.  My friends and I wanted to know what all the fuss was about, so we got together headed over to check it out.  They did a really great job renovating the space and the decor is simple, charming, and cozy.  We were welcomed by a staff full of smiles and friendly banter.  They suggested a wine that turned out to be pretty delicious.  I should have written it down, but it was something from Sardigna.  They were playing really great jazz the whole time. We all had some of the following (were were 7, so we really got to try a lot): Melanzane all a Parmagiana: A crowd favorite, and done really well! Polentine ai Funghi: I'm not a huge polenta fan, but high five for quality.  My mushroom-loving friend was in heaven. Insalata Fresca: You had me at fennel. Cavatelli Pasta with Lamb Ragu: I have thought about this dish basically every day since eating there.  I am dangerously close to this restaurant and may need to increase my exercise regimen just to make room for more of this.   Bucatini all a Grigia:  This was also delicious, but I couldn't really pry myself away from the cavatelli. Tiramisu Vite: Classic.  Did not disappoint.  So.  Full. One of the owners brought out some limoncello for us at the end of our meal, which was really sweet.  He informed us that it was cash only, which was not awesome, but assured us that they would be taking cards very soon.  There was an ATM machine on the very same corner, so no big deal. It was a unanimous win for my friends and me.  We were all talking about coming back to bring our significant others, because it's a really cute date spot (or our grandmothers, because some of us are single and have the raddest Nonas in town). In short, Astoria now has great Italian food.  Woot woot!

Went and checked this place out last night and I definitely approve. I liked it right away just because of the ambiance but, luckily, the food's good too! We started with the calamari and then had the spaghetti with shrimp and zucchini and the olive and sun dried tomato raviolis. All three were delicious. The portions aren't huge so definitely try out at least two of the appetizers or salads in addition to your meal.

Cuban Pete's is my favorite restaurant in Montclair, a place packed with great places to eat. There are several reasons why Cuban Pete's is a cut above the rest, however: the ambiance, the food, and the service are all at 100%, every time I've been. My only gripe is that inside the volume of the music is much too loud, but other than that this place is perfect.
