We arrived on Sunday just 5 minute before they closed their kitchen for the afternoon.  Technically speaking they could have still served us, and they were extremely rude about.  I do not recommend this place.  Further, the place was empty which infuriates me even more.

We went at Nerai on Saturday for dinner.The food and the cocktails were excellent. Very nice atmosphere .They must have the best octopus we ever had. Konstantin,the waiter same  as last time,surpass our expectations.We will go back soon.

Absolutely delicious!!! The bread and the dipping sauce were so yummy. I ordered the caprese appetizer, and I love that the tomatoes and cheese were placed on top of bread! My boyfriend ordered the cheese pizza, and it was the perfect mix of sauce and cheese! I would definitely come here again!

Great food but way too noisy. Even when you ask the staff to turn down the loud music so that you can talk, they refuse in a passive-aggressive way. Will not return - I don't want to have to wear ear-plugs when eating breakfast!
The pizza is Ok...just as good as others. it's the poor attitude of the help. One and two word answers to questions and just an unfriendly vibe is given.

The food was really excellent.The produce was very fresh and the food was very clean tasting but also flavorful. My water cress salad and vegetable pasta dish both had very unique flavors that were unlike anything I'd tasted before. I would like to say that I wish there were more vegetarian options. I've heard such great things about the burgers, so I'd love to see a unique veggie burger. I also found that the wait staff could not give me a clear answer on the ingredients in the dishes I asked about, which is of great concern to me as a vegetarian and a person with food allergies. I would recommend Crescent Grill to a friend but until there are more vegetarian options on the menu that I can be sure I can eat because I know the ingredients, I don't see this as a place I would return again and again, which is a shame because I did enjoy my meal.
Best pizza in the land of pizza.  The Spumoni is great to boot.

I stopped in on my way to the train around 5:30 PM on a Monday. I ordered the traditional mac & cheese. It came out piping hot & delicious. Staff was very courteous & owner was on site and very personable. Was surprised at the number of unusual dishes like grilled mascarpone with Nutella on brioche which I will definitely return to try. The place was very clean and the decor was bright & appropriately cheesy. A mother came in with two young children who seemed very excited about the kids meal options. Some outdoor seating available in this very pleasant little neighborhood. No alcohol is served but you are welcome to BYOB. Prices very moderate. An excellent alternative to traditional fast food options.

It's hard to write a review for a place I haven't been able to try! A few friends and I tried going last night around 6:45pm (google and the door says opened until 9) and the doors were locked. The two staff members inside ignored our knocking until we eventually made eye contact with one. We were told the store was closed for the day because they ran out of food. With the 20minute drive we took to get there, it's needless to say we were completely disappointed. I'm not sure when any of us will find time to go again- such a long trip for a place that is unprepared enough to run out of food with a staff that will ignore potential customers...
Jeff the owner is a great host. Also a pleasure to meet his mom who serves up incredible Fish Soup and Curry! So happy to find this fantastic place during family vacation to the big apple.

Kind of an odd place - big space, with room for more tables. Seems a little disorganized. But a great breakfast value with decent coffee. Check the specials board outside because there is no evidence of them inside, in writing or from the server. Our waitress never smiled, but provided perfect service. Would definitely return. The doughnuts are pretty amazing.

Amazing fresh salad, mac and cheese, and hot chocolate.  This place is beautiful, clean, and the staff is very nice.  A "must go" if near Yale in New Haven. The only bad thing is that it is a little bit more expensive than most places, BUT totally worth every penny!
Wow!! In the area for a movie and tried this place based on the reviews. Awesome food, great prices and friendly staff (and owner). Would not hesitate to come back. PS - Try the calzone!!!

Tink's is a small cozy restaurant with cute decor. All of the food sounds fantastic, but it didn't quite live up to expectations. I wasn't completely disappointed, but I just didn't think anything was terrific. I especially did not like the burrata.

Came here for my bday with a few friends. The menu is quite small but the food was decent. One of our friends had to stand cause they were limited with seats. They surprised us with a plate of salmon over corn appetizer. We had clams w/pasta, scallop zucchini and tuna/salmon appetizers. Then ended it with some whiskey bread. Really nice place for a date. Waiters are friendly!

We regularly get take out from Dusal's...at least once a week. Pizza, salads, sautéed spinach, mozzarella sticks, and the Dusal's burger - yum. It's true, they are the best in the immediate area. I will say that when we got our pizza a few nights ago...and it was 75% burnt...I had to wonder who felt it was a good idea to send it out. Please Dusal's...your reputation is on the line with stuff like that.
Good coffee! Will make it a point to stop here every time I'm in Philadelphia in the future.

Super nice people here. Very welcoming. Great pizza at a very fair price. Crispy crust to the point of the slice. The only way to serve it. Two slices later and I'm ready for the afternoon. We'll be back next time we come to SI.
So good and filling! Prices are awesome. Line is worth the wait
Wow great food and price... you won't be disappointed.
It's nice place to eat Malacian food . I order rotti with curry . It was delicious . And the rotti was so soft . I also order Malician noodles they were awesome . Their servers were friendly .
I've been ordering from here and I just so happened to find a big eyed mosquito in my Lo Mein noodles. Throwing this menu out!

Excellent restaurant. I'm originally from Caracas but have live in DC for over 24 years. I was thrilled to find this spot. The food, ambiance and price were great. I had tequenos for appetizer, a Reina Pepia arepa for main dish and shared a cachapa. The drink of choice, Polar beer. This place reminds me of the many low-key restaurants in Venezuela. I will definitely come back when I'm in NYC.

I come here all the time to eat. From all three of taim locations this is the best once. inside is very small and never any place to site. But food is never disappointing.  Whole weet falafel sandwich is a must try
Chips, Margaritas, and food that comes out super fast and is pretty good for some tex-mex. I actually asked a friend yesterday to go and overnight me some but the wait was a bit too long

Definitely the best sushi I've ever had. I always get spicy salmon roll, out of control roll, spicy tuna crunchy roll, tuna avocado roll, rainbow roll, volcano roll (extra spicy), salmon roll... Just about anything you get is delicious. The Chinese food is also very good, especially the honey walnut shrimp. I just tried the love boat sushi for two and it's very good, a lot of sushi so you won't have to order more.
Hands down the best pizza available anywhere. From the classic cheese to the white clam to the garden pizza... Simply delicious!

Loved, loved, loved this restaurant.  Vital is the perfect restaurant for those committed to eating clean. The jerk portobello mushrooms were delectable and the moist tamarind bbq chicken popped with flavor. Chef Kwame is a genius in the kitchen.
Amazing food! Super fresh ingredients. Love the ambiance  and energy. I will def be coming back!

B rated. This place is so dodgy. They for a VERY short period had an A which they place in the middle of their front window. When they revert back to a B, they hide it behind the bamboo pot plant out front. Food is average diner quality etc.  I gave up on coming here a long time back due to shitty hostess. Constantly told 15 minute wait which always turns into 30-45 minutes.

Good fun old dairy queen. Everyone is very clean, tidy and friendly they have great staff there. Obviously everyone loves their ice cream its amazing it's pretty clean and gets really packed on Fridays and Saturdays.

The food is so so.  We have had better yakitori elsewhere.  The picture of the food do not look the same as the real food.  We had the grill squid, tempura rolls, yakitori samplers, seafood pancake.  The rolls is the best. The rest is forgettable.  Oh they automatically added 20% tip.  No wonder they don't really care about your customer experience. The karaoke system takes some getting used to.  The room is not sound proof though so you can definitely hear the loud music in the lounge area.
Great bahn mi (order the #8). Quick and friendly service. I eat here at least 3x per month. Love this place!

Although the food was great here, the service was absolutely terrible. When we arrived, the restaurant was not busy at all. We made awkward eye contact with the waitress a number of times hoping to get seated, but no such luck. It took us a while to get someone's attention (a nice man who may or may not have been the manager). When we ordered, we asked for the bacon jam for the burger to be served separately, as I don't eat bacon but my dining partner does. The food came maybe 40 minutes later and the burger had....bacon jam. I asked the waitress about this and she was incredibly rude about it, and asked if I wanted them to scrape the jam off or to make a new burger. When she brought the new burger a while later, she kind of tossed the plate on the table without making eye contact with us and left. It was a disappointing experience and made the food less enjoyable. I'm sure not all the wait staff here is like this, but we just happened to experience two of their worst.

tried ordering and first person said they could deliver, although he may not have understood what we were trying to say.  when we called back, they said they actually don't deliver and it was the frustrating experience of my life. get it together.
Was there over an hour and no one would take our food order, Asked for the check and when that didn't come we finally had to leave money for our drinks  and go.
Everything here is delicious, it's impossible to pick a favorite because everything is so damn good. It's worth going back to try everything & they serve wine!!
Amazing pizza!! One of the best in Brooklyn!  The craftsmanship in each single pie makes it unique!!  Love the Classic! FYI - - Be prepared for long waiting time.
i love you guys!!!!!!!!!

Others have said this, but I feel like I should say it again: COME EARLY! I came here on a Saturday night around 9:30pm and still had to wait an hour to get seated. Nevertheless, the starving wait was totally worth it for the delicious bowl of ramen I had. I got the Chicken Paitan Ramen with an extra egg and everything about it (broth, noodles, greens, and all) was perfect. Wait or no wait, I will definitely be eating here again.

Tried this place a week ago and I was hooked! I tend to place my orders via phone but soon I'll visit! (only downside is the $15 min. for delivery). Created an account for the sole purpose that none of these reviews say much about service!! Usually I place my order around noon and a young lady answers my calls. First time ordering I was going off a co-worker suggestion of a chicken club, I asked for the girl opinion and she pointed me in the direction of the oriental chicken salad or the bison (I've ordered both and love them). She was polite about it patient and thoroughly explained the menu options, I was very impressed on all the options I was given. The delivery service was fast and well packed and the delivery guy very polite and very patient! Love this place will be placing my order tomorrow!!

This is one of my favorite pizza places in Philly, both to eat-in and take out. They make a thick, sauce-on-top square pizza that is delicious. The chicken wings (per my husband), mozzarella sticks, and salads are all good too. Santucci's is cash only, but the prices are beyond reasonable and it's BYOB...so I forgive them!

Sooooo delicious and very cheap!! We got the pork and chive dumplings, peanut noodles (2) and hot and sour soup for under ten dollars. We got two orders of the pork and chive dumplings, each one dollar! The peanut sauce on the noodles was awesome. I could not even put a dent in the serving of noodles I got. The soup was a little lacking in flavor, I would not get that again.
It's really a hole in the wall, do not expect any interior at all. Best as a quick snack or a takeaway. The quality of food is amazing for this price.
The wait staff are so very sweet and the menu has a ton of variety.  It's mine and my boyfriend's go to spot for dinner and drinks.
My wife and I got some coffee and tarts.  The tarts tasted good, but were really hard and tough to chew.  A decent variety of items for sale here.

I came here with my boyfriend for dinner and had the best time! The food was very unique and delicious. I highly recommend Tlayuda Con Chapulincs (if you don't mind the sight of grasshoppers) and Black Ant Nest for dessert. Our server Jackie was amazing. Super friendly and attentive.
Great atmosphere, great staff but they fell short on the food.  A lot of my rice was burned.  Same goes for the other person I was with.

Huevos! I've got quite a few cafes near me but I always make the extra trek to Lunitas. The food cannot be beat - everything is super fresh and I always feel like I'm in someone's comfy home. The owner is muy simpatico and plays great music. EAT -The Fulton egg sandwich on the cheddar chive jalepeño biscuit - savory goodness -Fruit/Granola/Yogurt - no skimping whatsoever - freshest variety of fruit -Empanadas - all homemade, you can taste the love! I love this spot. Best cafe in the hood. The only way this place could get better is if they had homemade whipped cream for their hot chocolates. I haven't checked on this matter but will look into it come winter and report back. NOM.
My favorite Chinese place. Very quick and affordable prices, especially the lunch specials

This is the first Yelp! review I've written; feel so strongly about this place (new favorite restaurant in NJ), and want it to be successful in a tough location (Saturday night place was only half full...so please come out and support them).  Environment was casual and friendly, but appropriately sophisticated for a nice weekend evening out.  Appetizers (mussels special and stuffed artichoke hearts) were great.  Sea scallops in entree cooked perfectly.  Marshmallow bread pudding dessert was perfect for those of us with a sweet tooth.  Happily stuffed until noon the next day.  If the same quality food had been served in NYC you would pay 30%-40% more...and still been happy.  Definitely make it a point to visit soon.

This review is purely based on their beer costs.  $17.19 for a 6 pack of IPA cans is excessive.  I was only trying to spend about $10 or so.  Another qualm I have is that out of the four times I've been there, two of those times they didn't have prices on their beer.  I don't own a store myself but I'm pretty sure that after unlocking the door and turning the lights on you should make sure your merchandise has prices on it.  I just think it's a shitty way to run a business by giving your customers a surprise at the register.
The food here is great. Service is splended. Great for lunches dinner. Great selection of food.

My daughter and I are celiac.  We were so excited to find Rubirosa's.  We were seated immediately.  The place has a good vibe to it.  We split the gluten free spaghetti & meatball,s and the gluten free fresca pizza.  They were both delicious!!!!  We wish that we could get pizza like this in Orange County, CA.

Stopped in for a quick bite and drinks with friends. From the moment we came in we were treated to a lovely setting, great service and good food. We chatted-it-up and never felt rushed. Must come back for the brunch - it's apparently something you should not miss!
The fries are great and the sauces are plentiful. I opt for the traditional mayo but there are many different ones to try.
They are small with very little meat & cheese,overpriced, and VERY grissley.

This restaurant was recommended to me by a co-foodie.  It was the best meal I have had in about a year.  Pork buns were unreal, unbelievable yellow tail (hamachi carpaccio) and maguro sashimi apps.  The two of us shared the karaka-men with a poached egg on top.  It was suggested we order extra noodles if we had broth left over but we were stuffed by then.  Fantastic service, waiter was so enthusiastic about us having the right experience given that we were newbies!

The food here is good, but it's not worth the bad service and inefficient ordering system. Last time I went here, we only had 4 tables before us but we waited over an hour to be seated. While we were waiting, we saw several people with to go orders wait over half an hour for an order of 3-4 empanadas. I'm not exactly sure if they were short staffed or what but they were finishing orders so slow. when we were finally seated, we ordered chips right away because we were starving and my pregnant sister needed to eat something ASAP.  we sat and waited for 15-20 minutes wondering where our appetizer one.  then our empanadas came out. we had to ask about our chips and they brought them out 5 minutes later. what's the point of getting appetizers if they come out after the meal? finally, it was time to pay and i gave them my card. i didn't realize until after they had swiped and i was going to add tip that they had already added gratuity - who adds gratuity for a party of 3? we asked about it and he said they made a mistake and they were only supposed to add it for a party of 4.  so they gave themselves an 18% tip even though the service was that bad. if you really must have empanada mamas, i recommend getting it to go - it won't be as good, but you'll (hopefully) get your food faster and won't have to wait forever.

This is our go-to restaurant when we are in the area.  We live 25 miles away and, on occasion when the mood struck, have driven all the way just for dinner!  My husband was born in Shanghai and is not satisfied with most AmericanChinese food ... This is his favorite.  Our kids even love it!  It's busy busy with lots of Chinese dining there so you know it's good.  The staff is very friendly to us ... We've been going there once or twice a month for years, so they know my kids by name.  My favorite dishes are eggplant stuffed with shrimp, rice cake with vegetables (my four young children DEVOUR this), and spicy beef, tofu with bamboo shoots.  Nothing you order from this restaurant will taste like takeout style chinese, and beware the menu is not numbered :)

Sweet Chick did it again!! I don't like to leave Brooklyn very often, but when I heard Sweet Chick had opened a new location I decided to go to the city and check it out! I'll keep this review simple. Amazing food, amazing drinks, and amazing staff. Why is everyone so COOL who works there?!?! Seriously, can we all hang out sometime, ill bring the beer... Although the BK location will always be my first love, the new L.E.S. location is right up there, and definitely has the Sweet Chick vibes that always keeps me coming back for more. "IT WAS ALL A DREAM"

Menu is on the smaller side for the similar restaurants that we have visited, which is fine.  But they should tell you that you need to order more than one item.  We ordered the "The Original" guac and chips which was okay for the appetizer and I ordered the Carnitas Tacos as they were one of the more-expensive tacos, so I figured they would suffice for a dinner.  Not so.  There was literally one tablespoon of carnitas on each of the three tacos.  So as to not make the party wait for another order for myself I continued to munch away on the chips after we had killed the guac.  As they took away the empty guac, they took away the chips I was obviously eating.  Would not go back.  Not if you have to order multiple items for a single meal.  I would say three orders of three tacos may get you there, but not worth the $39 that would be.
Good food, good bar, great location.

Customer service was poor. When I walked in they didn't acknowledge me. The food was basic needed more flavor. But their prices were great though. And the food was made fast..... But maybe that's why the flavor wasn't there. I don't think I will be going back anytime soon
One word: DELICIOUS! The food here is so good and the staff is amazing! Lots of choices at the buffet and also tons of meat! Highly recommend :)

Quick and tasty, came here on a Sunday evening for a light dinner.  Shared the hummus and feta sandwich with a side of arugula/salmon salad and it was just the right amount of food.  Everything was flavorful, fresh, and simple, I left feeling full and healthy.  The staff behind the counter was helpful and friendly.
The hostess not only looks like a homeless woman but had a nasty attitude. The place was empty so I see no reason to not smile and act pleasant when someone walks in the door.

This is the one great cafe with amazing coffee. The aussie flat white, just the best. Food was incredible, healthy, tasty....perfection. Only draw back is, too small for popularity, but still 5 stars because it is that good

I've been anxiously awaiting this place to open up for a couple months now, as I live up the street from it in Rutherford and walk past it virtually daily. I finally got a chance to stop in for dinner this past weekend and really enjoyed my meal. I got the Mexicano Burger with Cheddar Cheese. The flavor of the beef was unlike anything I've tasted before and was absolutely delicious. The french fries were unlike any fries I've ever had before. To be honest, they might take some getting used to but I still enjoyed them for their unique quality. The way that these fries are cooked somehow allows them to not be greasy whatsoever. I also tried the chipotle sauce on the side, which was quite tasty. I'm anxious to try the other flavored burgers on offer, and plan to be back soon. This place is a welcome addition to the neighborhood. Chef/Owner Jerome also came out to personally see how I liked my meal, which was a nice touch. I wish the place much success!

I ordered a cheeseburger. It was good. But, it wasn't  worth 20$. Everything here cost way too much. This is a place for the rich tree huggers to come. The service is slow. I think I waited about 30 minutes just for my drink. I'm not planning to come back.

I came here for a drink with some co-workers before heading to another bar nearby, and ended up staying for some food. I ordered the shrimp salad, wherein the greens were soggy and overdressed, and the shrimp was overcooked and flavorless. My co-workers had a pasta special with a vodka sauce that was completely bland. By far, the best dish at the table was the shepherd's pie, which came in a pretty hefty portion. I might come back here for drinks some time, but I'll head somewhere else if I'm hungry. Essentially, the service and ambience were great, but the food left a lot to be desired. Except for the shepherd's pie. Go ahead and get that.

Overall I love this place. I've been coming since they opened and its been fun seeing their menu grow/expand-especially since they opened the outdoor patio (usually has a wait but is definitely worth it). Very satisfied with Amanda Freitag; she definitely lived up to her reputation. -Ambiance/environment: Who doesn't like a nice cozy booth in a diner? They found a great balance between modern and old school interior, keeping the familiarity of a classic diner but also have fun music and nice lighting. The hostesses are always very friendly and always seem happy to great me. I do recall the original Empire Diner having a piano in the corner (which I wish was still there) but considering they have the private room upstairs, I'd say its a fair trade off. -Food/drink: Everything for the most part has been delicious and/or a fun play on classic diner dishes. They've recently started a daily dinner special that stays the same every week which is a lot of fun (Fish Tacos on Fridays! Who wouldn't love that?!) Make sure you save room for dessert because they always have a milkshake of the day, ice cream flavors and pies. As for the bar scene, it generally is a little more chill (which I really like) because it allows you to actually have a conversation with the bartenders-all of whom are easy going (Nick and William). The cocktails are awesome and reasonably priced for Chelsea (they have a Strawberry Foams drink made with egg whites!). The beer selection is not the most familiar which I'm not a fan of but thats just me. Wine selection is pretty encompassing and reasonably priced for the neighborhood (most bottles are between $40-$60). -Service/staff: For the most part, service has been consistent and friendly. All of the servers are easy to talk to and have out going personalities-the server Andrew probably having the biggest one:) I'm not sure if he still works there, but Pepper was one of my favorite servers too. I have noticed that sometimes the waitresses might not be the most attentive (which is fine when its busy) which for the most part is no problem but as someone who works in hospitality, I expect servers to be particularly observant. In their defense, they seem to have a lot of new staff so it might just be a one time thing. Good for dates, family get togethers and birthday parties. My roommate celebrated her birthday here and all we had to do was quietly mention to the hostess that it was her birthday. Then when it came time for desert they brought out a chocolate cake with a candle, and our server Allan gathered a couple bus boys and another server to sing happy birthday for us! I jokingly asked if he would and he did!! Definitely made our night. I always see a manager on the floor which I really like. The head manager (I think Tom?) is always greeting tables and sitting/chatting with them, something that I feel like adds a very friendly element as they clearly value their regulars. Overall:This is a place I would definitely recommend to a friend. The food is always good, as is the service. Also very dog friendly!

Coffee is great, free wi-fi also excellent in terms of speed and access. Really slow on the uptake though in terms of getting food to the table. Waited about 40 minutes for a simple breakfast burrito, with the excuse there were several large food orders ahead of mine. Any good restaurant should be able to accommodate large and small orders, so that the individual waiting for a single item doesn't become roadkill to the larger order.  Ended up cancelling my order because I'm meeting someone for lunch--had just wanted a simple light snack after driving two hours to BTV. Will definitely give them a go, and they were great about the refund -- ended up refunding me for my coffee too, which they didn't need to do.

Good pizza but bad service. One member or my group asked for the pizza to stay, mine came out 2 minutes later and since all the seats were taken I asked to have it to go. I got an attitude back something along the lines of but you told me to stay and now you are talking me to go. I expect much more from a food service place.  I would not go back.
I read many good reviews about these guys and wanted to give it a try. Me and my hubby ate chicken on the rice. It was a bit dry and not a special taste to speak out. We weren't impressed so loudly.

I had a chance to dine at Kefi with two friends on Friday (7/28). The Place: The location is great (West 80's). Restaurant decor could use a little work, the place looked a little sad, not very "Grecian." We were seated below the main floor in a "basement" for lack of a better word, even though there were plenty of seats available up top. As a result we were next to the hustle and bustle of the wait staff going in and out of the kitchen, which wasn't the best dinning experience. The Food:The food at Kefi is really, really good. I had the Kefi Salad and the Sheep's Milk Ravioli which were very tasty. The portion size of the appetizers seemed a little too large. My friends had the meatballs as an appetizer and were nearly full before they got to the entree. The Service: The service at Kefi is somewhere between good and so-so. When we went in, the bartender was extremely friendly and let us know about the happy hour specials that Kefi has available.  However, when we were seated our server was very aloof and not very accommodating, almost as if he did not want to be there. Strangely enough midway through the service, a different, much friendlier server stepped in to continue the meal service, though I'm still unsure if this was due to a coincidence or because the waitstaff overheard that we were unhappy. Overall I would give Kefi about 3 1/2 stars.

Great neighborhood comfort food. The grilled cheese is a must. Try the roasted brussel sprouts and the chicken club sandwich. The red velvet cake is terrific. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is fun for locals and tourist alike.

Bunch of my friends and I, decided to grab Mexican for dinner. We spotted Jolie's.  It looked nice and the ambiance seemed fitting from the outside. We startedd the night with drinks. I ordered a strawberry mojito and to my surprise it was pretty good. Well, I can't say the same towards the food, nothing special and extremely overpriced. The gratitude was a whopping 20% and the waiter dared to ask more as if 20% isn't pushing it. Definitely a place you go once and never go again!

The waiter was outstanding! He made us laugh the moment we walked in the doors. The food was great! I had Fettuccini Alfredo and everyone else had pizza. Nobody complained and everyone talked about how good dinner was all evening. Check it out if you are in the area.

Went there last night for the first time in over 8 years (only had not been there because of convenience).  I had the beef be bim bop in the hot pot which, although a little skimpy on the beef, was delicious and filling.  I especially like the crunchy burnt part that you can keep making more of as you keep eating and mixing.  My wife and daughter shared a few sushi rolls and other pieces of sushi, which I nibbled on as well.  The sushi was fresh and my wife and I think it is the best sushi around, but we were not aware that the delivered (because they did not always deliver).  When the bill came, I thought it was on the expensive side, however, all in all, we thought it was worth it.

It was fantastic when it first opened. Loved that thin crust pizza! LOVED IT! But then they changed the crust to tough and oily. I have given it too many chances over many months. Always tough and oily. Tried a cold gazpacho soup and I'll be damned if it wasn't too oily as well. My last experience there, I went for the burger - "medium." It was a rare soft mushy patty in the middle. Please Venturo - go back to what you once were. What went wrong!?

While the food was good it wasn't outstanding. The wine list (by the glass) could be better. The service was bad. At one time I had to get up from the table, walk to the counter and ask if someone can help us. The friend I had dinner with is black and and I was wondering whether that had something to do with the bad service.

I love this place and have been there several times. everyone is so nice, the service is beautiful and the food is delicious. It is so good to go to a restaurant and the server always asks if you have any food allergies. I always feel confident that they will prepare the food properly.
Overrated...food is exceptional...people think they are better than anyone
This place is done right! Such goood foooood! Not the most options for veggie eaters but what they do have is out of this world! Give this little gem a try!

This restaurant is a very unwelcoming place and the service is terrible. We were very badly treated and we were not able to pay by more than 2 credit cards. I don't know if the owner is aware of the technological progress, however yelling at us was not the best way to address the problem. The food was not even good to offset the very bad service.
Love Uva. Delish!

The burrito's rice was so hard it almost broke my teeth.  I went on a Saturday, so maybe just avoid buying burritos that day. I also felt worried about eating the chipotle mayo and other sauces as it was not refrigerated.  I felt the burrito really was overpriced.  Everything was far from what I know and love as taquitos y burritos en México.  The guys working there were nice enough, and I they may well be Mexican, but I doubt they designed the recipes as they did not really taste Mexican at all.

So good it deserves way more stars, but there you have it.  Five of five. Sausages, beers, wine, great burgers.  Food is stellar.  Casual and fun.  Great back garden and excellent atmosphere.  You can't go wrong.  Ballgames at the bar.  Nice bartenders and staff.  Relaxing and inviting.   I really enjoyed Lock Yard.  Something special.
Best burritos this side of New York. The atmosphere is like a Mexican drug house, but the taste of the food really makes up for it! (The green sauce is awesome!)

This place is just...sigh. Just waay to cramped. I'm not from the area and wanted to try it since it had very high reviews. Unfortunately, I didn't get the same treatment as some of the locals here. I kept getting ignored and interrupted. :( I'm not sure if the larger set man was the owner or not but who ever that was, was extremely rude. Food was bleh, nothing really special. If you are trying to have a nice quiet dinner, go somewhere else. The shouting and combined chatter of the other customers are still ringing in my ears. Sigh.

We went to another Italian restaurant the day before which was superb (a block away, newly opened at the same price range)! So our expectations was quite high. It stated good with the owner (I think) welcomed us and got us a nice table and he was very polite. The waiters on the other hand was running and they were very stressed. I asked them to level our table since it was standing on uneven ground, they rush in and put a napkin under the table and rushed away without checking wether or not it was fixes, which it wasn't so I had to call him over again to fix it. We ordered an appetiser and main course. While we were waiting (not very long) the waiters kept on running around and being super stressed, I saw them poor wine over a table and knocked down a jug of water in a stroller, luckily there were no child in it. The whole atmosphere was stressed and not very pleasant. The appetiser was not very good, can olives, can artichokes along with a bland salad (I don't think any Italian would be proud if that appetiser). The main course came out just minutes before we had ended the appetiser which gave us the impression that the main course wasn't given the attention that proper cooked food need, and we were correct - this was the most bland and tasteless pasta that I think I have had since school. It didn't taste anything like the pastas we have had the other day. When I told the waiter that this wasn't a very good dish he just went away. After a while the owner came by and I had to tell him again what I though about the dish and he apologised. When the bill came they had deducted one of the main courses, which was a nice gesture, but on the other hand that dinner experience had left us with a bad taste for the rest of that evening.

Amazing- their chicken is unbelievably tasty but very soft, their rib eye is very juicy and yummy, and I love their fake candle that doesn't look so fake ;)! Overall, I feel this place is a must go, and if I drop by this area again, I will Definitely come again!!!
Came here with my bosses. We are staying Manhattan and one boss had heard of this place. It way outta the way. It's not my kind of place. Food is a little too weird for my tastes.

This restaurant is part of Keith MacNally's collection of fine restaurants in NYC, and it is an excellent recreation of the classic French bistro. The neighborhood is chic and trendy, there are obviosly "regulars" who must live nearby in incredibly cute and trendy loft apartments and think nothing of dropping $40 for an order of steak frites. Don't get me wrong - that's actually part of the appeal. The look and feel of the restaurant is exactly what you would want for a trendy bistro (even though it's been operating for almost 18 years in the same location - that's saying a LOT for any restaurant). The inside is warm and inviting, the noise at times makes it seem you are in a nightclub, not a bistro, but the combination is exciting. Fortunately, the food does NOT disappoint. A wonderful baby beet salad, and a goat cheese and onion tart reflect traditional French style executed wonderfully (both are $19 - and not really large enough to split, so make sure you get plenty of their excellent bread). Braised short ribs, Coq Au Vin, Lamb Chops - all were well prepared, accompanied by rich sauces that just had to be soaked up with more bread (forget the carbs for one night). The service was prompt and courteous, a tad rushed, but certainly acceptable. Recommended for a great date night or a family dinner, the food of Paris with the ambiance of NYC - not a bad combination.
Cheap and yummy bibimbap. Their tea is delicious as well. Super friendly staff. I'll definitely be returning soon!

Gran bel posto. Località non proprio elegante . Locale invece carino e ben frequentato. Cibo ottimo, spesa contenuta. Il sushi e' fatto bene e anche la coppa di riso e' eccellente. Da provare. Magari tornate in taxi e non a piedi come abbiamo fatto noi....

When my 30th birthday rolled around, I knew I wanted some upscale Mexican food. A couple of Best Of lists and a bunch of yelp reviews later, I decided on Toloache. We considered all three locations, but opted for the Village location to be closer to bars after dinner. I'm so happy that we did! The entire experience at Toloache was great, and it ended up being the perfect birthday dinner. The Food: There were three of us, so we opted to share and eat tapas style. We started with the guacamole trio. It is a MUST TRY! Amazing. The price is a bit steep at $24, but I didn't regret it for a second. The Frutas (guac with mango and pomegranate!) and the Rojo were both to die for. We then shared the fish tacos, the quesadilla de huitlacoche y trufas (mushroom and truffles), and the hamachi ceviche. My boyfriend loved the quesadilla, but I thought the ceviche was the winner. Each dish was great though. The Drinks: The margaritas were all excellent, but to really have your mind blown, make sure to order the mezcalita cocktail with grilled pineapple and jalapeño. I wish I had one right now. So good! So good! So good! The Service: The service was the best part. Our server was patient through all of our annoying questions, gave great advice about what to order and once he heard it was my birthday, was sure that he and his servers gave me an appropriately embarrassing and totally fun birthday song and (delicious!) flan dessert. And, before we even mentioned my birthday, the manager Luis stopped by just to make sure that we were enjoying ourselves. My boyfriend made some joke that he enjoyed, which led him to bring us a round of tequila shots on the house. So fun! I will certainly be back! Highly recommended!

Guerros did NOT stand up to the hype from friends in the neighborhood. I ordered delivery: fried avocado and jalapeño taco, al pastor taco, and chips and salsa. The flavor of the fried avocado taco was good, but it was mushy and there was only 1 piece of jalapeño in the taco (disappointing because I love some heat), the al pastor taco had chewy, tough, and dry meat and no grilled pineapple in sight!!! I'm still giving a few stars because the chips and salsa were good, and the delivery service wasn't bad either. I will be giving Guerros one more try, eating in, to see if they can do any better: plus, margaritas!
Fantastic It was so good!  I loved it. The bar was great. It was 5 stars plus. The cocktails were great. The special dish from the kitchen was fun. Everything was 10 stars.

Food is very very good and interesting. A must to try. No reservations but the wait was fun outside. Service was good but a bit rough, but no biggy. Staff friendly. Bit crowded and noisy but that's what it's all about. Will go back.

In the top five of my favorite Thai spots. Service is always great they are attentibe. Crab fried rice great springs rolls are also good as always. They gave extra sauce free of charge. They have a great lunch deal. And they have a grade A which most Thai spots have grade pending.

What a fabulous alternative to regular sushi. Loved this place. Great food and friendly staff.We had an amazing experience here. Everything we took just tasted so good. The place is a bit small and you will need to share a table if needed, but it is one of the best Sushi places I eaten. It is indeed Sushi Beyond, basically taking Sushi to the next level of evolution.
Primos is the best! Their sandwiches are the best in town, and they have $1.50 beer all day everyday! The bartender is super friendly!

The food itself is just passable, other than condescendingly telling me that "chow mein" in NJ is in fact not a noodle dish but a noodle-less dish with vegetables. It was just mildly amusing hearing this, being a Chinese American that knows what "chow mein" literally translates to. My main gripe with this place would be the rude, unapologetic staff (well, the delivery guy was nice at least). Twice now I have been charged MORE than what their site had said (the online order had already included charges for tax, delivery, and tip), and a call to inquire about this bizarre (and seemingly illegal) event was met with unapologetic communication that their site prices need to be updated; the second order had been at least 1-2 years after the first, so it appears they have no intention of updating their site and will merrily continue to scam customers out of a couple extra bucks with each order. I hope the $2 was worth losing a customer over.
I'm giving them 5 stars just for the pastries alone!!! Always fresh and ALWAYS delicious!!!! If you're not a coffee drinker, pop in for a wonderful, flaky, baked treat!

If the Shoreline had a Top Chef, Bun Lai would be a serious contender. According to him, he uses sushi as a medium to express ideas about other cultures. With that in mind, try these unconventional rolls: the Mitzvah: wild salmon, brie and avocado or the Dr. Zhivago: shrimp tempura, seaweed and avocado, fried whole. Kooky sake cocktails are part of the Miya experience: Emerald Witches Lips, a wild pinecone sake in, yes, a ghastly shade of green or fiery housemade Firecracker Sake (pictured) Down a Sake Bomb: a shot of Firecracker Sake dropped in an iced mug of Schaeffer beer. Yikes! Haven't had this much fun since college.

My friend had told me about this place so while I was in the area I decided to check it out. Nice ambiance with a great beer selection and friendly service. Try the shrimp and grits..delicious! I'll be back for more!

OMG what an awesome place.The Betty burger was divine and the bread pudding well that was right outta heaven!! We even went back to get more to take back to our room to eat later! Once again Yelp got this plce right!!

This is a diamond in the rough in the Fidi-Tribeca bar scene.  Its a classy, upscale "sports bar" with great food--not your average bar fare.  Try the Shrimp app, Buffalo Wrap or the Lobster Ravioli-trust me!!!! Manhattan Proper is a great place to watch a game and has a nice, consistent Happy Hour scene.  I've visited several times now with some clients and the TV's are so BIG and AMAZING a part of me is waiting for my mother to yell "move away from the TV, you'll hurt your eyes"!  Which of course makes me laugh, and order another drink from my superb bartender!   Cheers to that!!!
The pizza here is some of the best around. The sauce is always the perfect sweetness, they use the right amount of cheese and spices... I love this restaurant.

Excellent!! Delicious food and great service, the gianduia mousse desert was amazing, the burguer and the steak were great too i want tk clme back to this restaurant to try the other things pn the menu
A new fav Quality food, authentic interior design, great service Great quality seafood
Good food. Very cute place, sat in the Morracan room! Portions are huge. Friendly staff. Going back for their hummus.

We had an amazing experience at the Manor doing a recent summer wedding.   Need a Photo Booth for your Wedding or special event?     nextgenphotobooth.com Get a 20% "The Manor" special discount on your Photo Booth rentals!

Excellent rotisserie chicken, best I have had in the area. The dark meat in particular. It takes about 20 minutes to prep, so call ahead. I would also recommend the yucca. Street parking seems generally available. Very excited to come back and try some of the seafood dishes, which many people were eating and looked STELLAR.

Love the food and drinks - as a college student, my friends and I are loyal customers to Sake. I've noticed this past year though their service has gone down hill hence the 3 starts instead of 4 or 5. Sake Sam is no longer the bright and cheerful owner he used to be. Servers tend to rush you and at one point - DEMAND A BIGGER TIP! As a college student I understand some kids will try to gip you, but for someone like myself who actually gives the right percentage tip, it's just terrible to generalize and gain that same customer service one who does not respect tipping. I will stay a loyal customer and enjoy the amazing I-95 roll and scorpion bowls, but I do hope to see their servers care more about their customers.
Awesome Israel cuisine! I really couldn't remember the dishes' name so forgive me. Salad and breads are even better than few of their small plates! Worth to have a try!

OMG! I pass by here every day and today I decided to stop. Great decision. I got white rice and beans with fried pork chop and fried sweet plaintains. I bought a Cuban sandwich for my husband. The food was great. They will definitely see me again. They did not get 5 stars because I had to go get cash out of an ATM because they only take cash.

We arrived on Sunday afternoon as the vendors were closing. I were able to purchase some fresh fruits and veggies. My biggest regret is not bringing any cash (and most of the vendors only take cash). We will be going back to Philly in a few weeks, so I'll update this review then.

I have been wanting to come here for a while now and I am so glad that I did. The food was great. I had the salmon burger over greens and eggplant lasagna. I went with someone who is a big meat eater and doesn't feel satisfied unless meat is in the meal. Even he liked the lasagna and said that you couldn't even tell there was no meat and was vegan! Delicious and nutritious food is what I look for and this place is both. The staff was friendly and it was a very comfortable atmosphere. I will definitely try to return in the future!

The veggie pizza is very good. Order the pizza with thin crust. You can add desired toppings to your pizza. Sometimes pizza comes slightly over salted but mostly the pizza is just the perfect!. Staff behave politely and keep the takeout timings. I would definitely go there again.

The Voodoo Queen po boy was so spicy that it was nearly inedible--they really need to give you a heads up on the menu. I am still in pain nearly two hours later. The guy next to me even sent his back, so this was clearly a problem with the menu item. That being said, I ate a large bit of my friend's Sugar Hill burger which was awesome. Fantastic service as well.

The food was great and the outdoor seating was even better. There are many factors that COULD make this place great but when it comes with bad service all that doesn't matter anymore. Not only here but at Prime Meats I had multiple awful experiences with their service. No recommendations, no enthusiasm, not even a check back after our apps or food was brought out. We regrettably had to wave down whoever we could for fresh pepper, hot pepper flakes, coffee, AND the check all the while the restaurant was pretty empty. Im not asking for a red carpet rolled out and extreme attention but it's not very hard to do the simple steps of waiting a table. 2 out of the 4 of us are in the industry and STILL couldnt think of any reason to leave over 20% which is sad because it's good to treat those in the same position. Food was ok but Im going to stick to my favorite neighborhood gem known as Fragole where the experience is always perfect in every way.

I work pretty close and always were told about this place. Since it was my 7th year anniversary and I had 30 min break for lunch, I decided to try. The vibe, deco, ambience are very nice. However, lunch menu does not offer a lot of options. It was pretty hard to choose my plate. Prices are a little high for a fast lunch as well. I ordered this ricotta pasta with pesto sauce and it was surprisingly super good. My husband ordered the burger and was very good as well. French fries are a must try, specially with the sliced garlic they add. I was in a little rush and check took a while to be dropped. Service is very fine. Definitely I'll try dinner and brunch!!!

Before heading out on my annual birthday trip weekend with friends to New York I made reservations everywhere we wanted to go. It's New York after all you need those LOL. Because of when our flights got in on Thursday and because the restaraunt was so busy the earliest we could get in was 10:30. When the reservation was made there was no mention that this late of a reservation would cause a problem in terms of serving us. It was taken as though it was just another reservation and would be no problem. So we arrived actually a few minutes early I believe and were instructed to wait at the bar for a few minutes. Again no mention of there being any problem with us having such a late reservation. We are seated a few minutes later and handed menues and less then five minutes later the waiter comes up. He doesn't introduce himself, doesn't even say good evening just says "Okay the kitchen is about to close so you need to order everything your going to eat right now." We were stunned.  If the kitchen was about to close they should have never taken our reservation in the first place or at the very least let us know that they'd be closing soon and that we would be rushed. The food was good and so were the drinks and I did like the atmosphere but the service needs work. I'm sorry but that was rude and tacky they clearly took the reservation just to make more money and decided to just rush us in and out. Not cool. The food and atmosphere maybe nice but with service like that it's not enough. There are PLENTY of wonderful restaraunts in New York that not only have great food and great atmosphere but treat their customers well, so far this isn't one of them.

Best bagels in the area. There's a few other places in town, but frankly none of them are as good. Staff are all cool, always some good rock playing ( Motorhead, Ramones, NOFX ) and the service is quick. I'm not going to wait in line 20 minutes for bagels across from city hall that aren't any good and where the staff is a bunch of unfriendly people.

I always mean to try other things on the menu when I visit here, but I end up stuffing myself with pork soup dumplings before I even get to ordering other dishes. The hot soup in the dumplings is divine, and the dumpling skin is incredibly thin and tender. As with many Chinatown spots, service is brusque and space is extremely limited - don't be surprised to be sitting elbow to elbow with strangers. Also, try and come during off-peak hours to avoid waiting.
This spot is great.
Table for 6 with tip $260. Appetizers and 3 bottles of wine. We ate like kings. Great meal.
This place is adorable! They have lots of options for everything from the ice tea selections to the great sandwiches and cold brew coffee. The staff is wonderful and friendly. Great little café!!

Thank you guys for a WONDERFUL final dinner of our vacation!  We ended our vacation here and could not have had a better experience for our final dinner.  The Filet is AMAZING and well worth it.  The Lamb was also superb!  The service was just as awesome as the food!!

I'm here on a Tuesday night, in town by myself on a work trip, sitting at the bar. Craft beer selection is good, mostly stuff that's not super common, and a few others with mass appeal. And I would say I just had one of the best pork chops of my life. Cooked perfectly medium per my request, and imagine my surprise when it showed up as a beautiful bone in 2" thick chop. Not at all what I was expecting from the bar I wasn't really sure was open until I went through the front door. If I am ever back in this area I will be back!
Wonderful! Creative and delicious menu, personal service. Don't miss the corn brûlée dessert!

If you're looking for Greek food, definitely come to Taverna. Everything was amazing. We ordered the various dips, the Greek salad and got the full seafood special. Amazing and lots of food to share for a total of 5 people. Definitely returning.
Excellent!  And I just moved from Chicago!

The square slices here are my desert island food. Not just what I would pick if I had to eat only one thing for the rest of my life. I would happily give up all of my friends and family to retreat to a desert island with unlimited squares, where I could stuff my face unabashedly with delicious little bricks of heaven. Five stars.

We're fans of Vietnamese food in our house. Tonight, a Tuesday, we went over to Huong Viet because my son's favorite, Binh Duong, is closed on Tuesday nights. He wanted his Phô Tai, and we've enjoyed the food before, so off we went. Well. As other reviewers have said, this is not the place to go if you want good service or ambiance. In fact, the waitstaff (and possibly owner or manager?) did not make us feel welcome at all. We were not asked how things were, we were not asked if we wanted anything else, we were not given the proper amount of dishes, and it took eons to get our check. I'm giving Huong Viet 3 stars because of the food (the service was so bad that I felt like giving it 1 star, but that wouldn't be totally fair). The food is delicious. I am a big fan of the crispy sweet potato nests with shrimp (really, should come in an entrée-sized portion, they were so good). My son liked his Phô. We also had a fish red curry - amazing sauce! - and a shrimp with lemongrass dish. No complaints about the food. However, the service was so off-putting, and we prefer Binh Duong (which is more conveniently located anyway) that we don't really feel the need to hurry back. I mean, maybe for take-out, but probably not. The one semi-saving grace for me, and I was alone in this, was the very, VERY loud couple dining by the window. They were so belligerent, and so loud, and so indiscreet, that it actually became entertaining. The guy seemed practically apoplectic! So thanks, loud couple, for providing comic relief during our lengthy wait for the check.

My favorite seafood place ever! There's a wait most of the time, but it's worth it for some great Greek seafood dishes. I recommend the grilled octopus, calamari, swordfish, and shrimp. Don't forget the olive bread and horta :) Also, for dinner, you get complimentary galaktoboureko.
Great caesar salad and excellent margarita flatbread. All ingredients were fresh and tasty. I ordered delivery to my hotel and am pleased with this choice.

Ok. Ok. Ok. So here we were, looking for a place to jump in to for a quick bite. At first, it looked closed. But then we found the door. Well once inside, the owner Jeff was as friendly as I read about and soon enough he and I were chatting as if we were separated at birth! Now combine that friendly atmosphere with some of the best drop dead seafood that his mom makes and you have yourself a winner! Jeff introduced me to other fellow vets and soon enough the shots were flowing (sorry wifey). I ended up having the pork belly with rice and book choy. And there was NO evidence left behind! The wife reluctantly shared ONE bite of her pescatore, and once again there was nothing left for the CSI to tie us in to the area. I threatened Jeff that we would take his mom with us (selfish bast*rd said no). Make no mistake. You won't be overwhelmed by the decor, but the atmosphere and friendliness makes this a hidden gem!! I'll be back, my Korean / Japanese /Kung fun fighting friend!
Excellent food, service, and atmosphere.  I was in town on business and saw positive Yelp reviews.  Didn't dissapoint

This was a suggestion from a friend who has a standing reservation each week at Bibou. The foie gras and bone marrow was  different and delicious. The staff was very attentive and the ambience was wonderful. We went back with friends and had the escargot, filet and snapper..  Excellent One of the best meals my husband and I ever had!!

I haven't seen my stepsister in quite some time so she asked if I liked Thai food and when I let her know I did, she said she had THE spot.  We headed down to Wintonbury Mall and walked into Thai Palace.  The owner, Linda looked our way and said, "wait" while she answered the phone.  This was fine as it was busy (lunch time).  After her call, she walked over to a person working on a website and started talking.  I finally said, hello, we are looking for a table and she asked if we wanted to sit indoors or outdoors.  We said, inside and she told us to sit and wait.  This was not ideal but my sister told me the food was great and it's worth it. We were sat after about 10 minutes, waters filled and menus in front of us.  Now we are on a roll.  The lunch specials are all 8 bucks and there is a HUGE variety of meals.  After again waiting at least 15 minutes, the owner came back to wait on us and I selected Spicy Basil Shrimp while my sister ordered Drunken Noodles.  They brought out our soup, coconut chicken and it was AMAZING!!!  They also brought out small spring rolls that I did not try.   The Spicy Basil Shrimp was not spicy, and the veggies did not seem cooked at all.  The Drunken noodles were excellent!!!  I waited for a bit and flagged down the owner again and let her know that this was NOT what I thought I ordered.  Her first reaction was to tell me it ordered wrong.  I asked how I was supposed to know I had to ask to have a spicy dish made spicy.  Honestly, this pissed me off and I told her I did not want the dish.   She asked me how many shrimp I are and how many of the spring rolls I are (to charge me for them????). I told her and let her know that she could do what ever she needed but that I would be posting about the experience here on Yelp.  She ended up taking my order off the bill and that she was sorry.   It all felt like too little too late.  It's unfortunate because I really liked my sisters dish and the coconut soup (OUTSTANDING) but, I will not be back because of the poor service.  We did end the day on a positive by going to the Italian bakery next door.
such an awesome quant spot. amazing food, amazing beers!

Tried this new addition to the neighborhood this evening with my daughter and enjoyed a really delicious meal.  The soup of the day was a chilled roasted cauliflower soup that was really fresh and very flavorful, with hints of Dijon mustard and a very pleasant tartness. For dinner I really enjoyed the short ribs with garlic polenta, cranberry beans and horse radish.  The meat, although slightly on the dry side, was very flavorful and did come apart easily.  All of the flavors worked together very nicely.  The polenta was particularly delicious. My daughter enjoyed the mussels with a lemongrass, garlic and ginger broth served with crustinis.  I tried some and the broth was wonderful! They don't have a liquor license yet. Our server Viktoria (more about Viktoria later) said that they should have that squared away sometime in August. Lastly, we shared and much enjoyed the profiteroles with a house made jam that was outstanding! Ah, back to our server Viktoria.  She was awesome!  She knew the menu inside out and was able to guide us through all of the various selections with energy and enthusiasm.  She was very attentive through the night and made a delicious meal that much more enjoyable by virtue of her attentiveness, knowledgeability and positivity.   Orchard seems to focus on fresh and seasonal, locally sourced organic produce and it showed in the food.  The freshness was very apparent and refreshing. I hope to see the Orchard blossom and I'll certainly be back to peruse more of their intriguing offerings!  Great addition to the 'hood!

If you didn't know it was there you might miss it, but if you're looking for a cozy little spot in Princeton to pass a bit of time, infini-T is definitely a place to know! You go in and see all these glass jars filled with tea leaves. You pick a flavor, I've always ordered a pot of tea to share, and they brew those fresh leaves for you right then and there. Some of the baked goods are vegan friendly which my boyfriend needs, and I can personally vouch for the fact that they're really, really good! The staff is great, and super friendly. The furniture is pieced together from different sets so it does look a little odd here and there, but it's what makes infini-T the cozy little quirky place that it is!

We went there on Saturday July 26th for Dinner after not wanting to wait on line at another restaurant. My wife sat at the table and were not attended to for about 10-15 minutes much to my dissapointment. Finally, a waitress came around to attend to us. She informed us that they were out of ice and bread however we were served warm water. How does a restaurant run out of ice and bread? I ordered a salmon dish with spinach and potatoes. The salmon was lacking flavor as were the potatoes. The spinach was disappointing. The place itself needs to be maintained better. There were tissues, napkins and straw papers scattered throught the dining room floor. The bathroom was horrendous. If they aren't maintaining the floor and the bathroom in a cleanly manner which is visible to customers what about the cleanliness of the kitchen? The signs were there and I should have gone with my gut and left. Dirty floor, staff members visibly bickering with each other and a manager foldking napkins instead of attending to a restaurant. Finally, upon my arrival home I became VERY ill. Needless to say, I will never go to Leone's again!!!

I really enjoyed the location of the restaurant.. Couldn't sit outside for dinner despite having reservations. The valet held down my car while we took pics on the beautiful public pier that the restaurant is connected to.. Food could be way better.. Not many choices and wasn't very good.. The ambiance made up for it some what..

There not open every day which stinks. But it's worth the wait the three days they are. You name it they have it. I love the corn puddig. I get it by the try. Meat pickles fresh squeeze juice fruit veggies candy cheese deli meat. Prices are reasonable. I love how you can just go for breakfast. Not alot of seating but the food they prepare there is out of this world.
Delicious! We ordered one of everything!! The place is very clean with prompt and friendly service!!
I really did not like the food here. The service and decor looked nice, but the food was not great by any means.
great food - try wonton noodle soup.  Hong Kong quality.  Xiao Long Bao also delicious.  Service can be better though.  Need smile.

Mix is one of my all time favorite places for PIZZA! Let me reiterate, for Pizza. I give them 4 solid stars based on my love their pizza. If I were rating them on other foods as well I'd probably go with a 3. I'm not a huge fan of pizza and I have to be in a mood for it. That being said Mix was one of the first places that won me over instantly with their pizza. And Is THE place I compare all other pizza places to. Something about that wood fired dough. Thin (but not too thin) and crunchy. A very flavorful dough. The perfect combination of spice and grease from the pepperoni. It's heaven. The pizza at mix is garlic-y. Perhaps a bit too garlic-y for my tastes but that doesn't stop me from thoroughly enjoying their pie. When I'm in Philly I stop at Mix quite a bit. I've tried several of their dishes none of which I've ever been inspired to have again. In fact nothing I can say I really enjoyed. Once dish in particular the watermelon gazpacho I actually returned. That soup was horrible. A watery broth that tasted nothing of watermelon and diced herbs and veggies floating around in it. I thought gazpacho was supposed to be pureed? Well this wasn't. Hopefully they have taken this off the menu by now. The restaurant itself is very cute. Be prepared to swelter if you sit near the front because that oven throws off some serious heat. Design flaw, the restrooms sit smack dab in the middle of the restaurant. So be prepared to feel super awkward if you have the need to relieve yourself. Also do not by any means get those few tables situated right outside the restroom. AWKWARD. Not to mention gross.

I come here at least once a week with my husband ! Food and Service are always great !! Margaritas are on point and no matter what you order from the menu its good !! Prices are extremely reasonable as well

When you want to splurge on fresh and exceptional sushi with the sushi bar experience, this is the place to go. Reservations aren't as hard to snag as Nakazawa and omakase is just wonderful. I rank it in my top three go-to splurge-worthy sushi places in the city. It's also cheaper since my boyfriend and I each ate around 23 pieces for reasonable omakase price.

I ordered a Cuban sandwich which was totally inedible. The meat was dry. There was no mustard. I complained to the manager who pulled my sandwich apart with his bare hands and said there was nothing wrong with it. I could not eat it if I wanted to at this point. The manager also told me I still had to pay for it. My travelling companions had pasta which was adequate.   One ate what she was given but not what she ordered.There are certainly better places than this available with good food and civil staff. These people certainly give Jersey diners a bad name.

There is nothing I like better than a classic French restaurant: no gimmicks, no over-the-top design, just crisp white tablecloths, dark wood paneling, scruffy floors, a blazing fire and food that delivers every time. Here's why I love Union League: lunch always feels like a celebration. A simple dish of pan roasted salmon resting on a fricasee of brussel sprouts and pearl onions in a puddle of mustard sauce, was sublime. Or indulge with a perfect lobster omelette (organic eggs, of course) and a crisp glass of Sauvignon Blanc.
Very cute, good atmosphere. The artichoke dip was to die for and the salads were tasty as well. The Mac and cheese was so-so, but everything else made up for it.
They make some decent Gyros. Seems like a family run business. I would definitely come back.
The place looks cozy but the crepe I had was not as good as I expected. I've had crepes at other places through out NYC that have been much better. The customer service was poor.

Delicious food, owner and waitress were really friendly and accomodating of our reservation for 8.  The atmosphere is cute, and a nice option for a big reservation or just a soho dropin. A little louder than expected, but it was also nice to have all of the windows open on a gorgeous summer day.

I went with the lady during Old City Restaurant week and we both thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. It was $25 per head with a preset menu (part of the OC Restaurant week event). You could choose from 2 appetizers, 5 entrees, and dessert was included. Even with the limited options it knocked all of our socks clean off. She got a large piece of pork roast served on the bone that was so tender you could barely pick it up with a fork. Super tasty. I got the Pez Espada - swordfish on potatoes served with some kind of tasty/spicy sauce. It is one of the best meals I've had in a while. I wish I could have been locked in a room made of that dish so I would have to eat my way out. We also got a pitcher of the El Santo margarita, which was the bomb-diggidy. You should not go here in a hurry; bring a date or a group of friends to grab a few drinks, sit, and enjoy yourselves. Our server was great, but I could see things slowing down if it were to get super busy. It was definitely a treat - next time we go I'll try and sit outside, it looked rather nice.

it is very closed to my apartment so me and my fiancé really like to go there. The food are great there and good atmosphere: my fiancé told me he almost choose here to propose! LOL my favorite is duck leg and mussels and chili salad. Another thing needs to be mention is that blue cat do not supply liquor, but u can buy wines in the store next to blue cat!

One of the very best Italian restaurants in New York. It's not classic though - the atmosphere is a little "clean," not super warm and friendly, and the portions are not what you'd typically find in a standard Italian place in the US. Not that they're too small, just that we're usually used to getting so much food you either have to take half home, or be rolled out. The pasta though is fantastic, the desserts are delicious, and the entrees well prepared. Not the place to go for your moms spaghetti and meatballs, but you can have an excellent meal here, and have your eyes opened as to how Italian food can be when prepared in the right hands.

Ok, since the last time I wrote, this place has changed from a "deli" to a sit-down place--antipasti, pastas, salads, etc.  Have been there probably once a week lately, never been disappointed, and the best thing is the specials are always things you haven't had before.  Tonight we shared a potato Parmesan--kind of a cross between an Italian-American potato pie and scalloped potatoes with proscuitto cotto. Delicious.  Then my husband had orecchiette with a sauce of puréed peas, proscuitto and a mild cheese.  Again, outstanding. I'd recommend this place to anyone in the neighborhood. Don't pass it by, and by all means, don't just think of it as a sandwich place. BTW, I was there the night William S. below made a scene.  His one star rating is undeserved. From reading his other reviews, it seems he might have an overheating problem and should stay in Connecticut.

The Margarita Pizza is AMAZING! The Wings are also really good! I am so HAPPY this place opened up right around the corner from us because it's FANTASTIC! They make the pizza WHEN you order it! The ingredients are SUPER FRESH and you can absolutely notice! FIVE STARS!!
Hillstone / Huston, whatever. they have one of the best ribs i've ever eaten. The starters are great, atmosphere is very nice and the staff are doing everything with a smile.

From the first juicy sip of sangria to the happy group of hipsters at the bar, I loved Firebox on the spot. The space is minimalist with drama: thirty foot ceilings in the bar, antique beams and exposed brick. But it's really about the locally sourced food; pictured is my delirious starter of house-made charcuterie: chicken liver mousse, house-cured salmon and duck pastrami.  An entree of pan roasted cod perched on a bed of braised kale with bits of fingerling potatos and bacon floated on a mussel studded broth.Yum! Should have stopped there, but who could pass up chocolate semi-freddo, a dreamy dessert, halfway between mousse and ice cream? Heavenly. Here's more good news: Firebox is operated by the Billings Forge Community Organization whose aim is to revitalize the Frog Hollow neighborhood that it calls home, through job training and employment. The Kitchen at Billings Forge is a bakery, urban farm-to-table caterer, and center for cooking classes (check out the schedule here) and the Studio at Billings Forge provides a community space for educational workshops, enrichment programming and a low cost entertainment venue for local performances.

Pleasantly surprised with how delicious the food was here!  I got a sandwich smothered in sausage gravy and I woulda licked my plate if no one was watching.  Nice environment for dinner.  Not too much of a fan of the pickles variety we tried though.

I came on a date during happy hour. I was, well, happy with the choice of drinks. I ultimately opted for a sangria. For the size and flavor, it was well worth the $8 I paid. The flatbread I had was also cooked well - crust thin and crisp. Yum! Given the gorgeous weather, it was a great atmosphere. A bit misleading on the outside. You can't quite tell right away where it's located (although the name insinuates), and have to take an elevator up. Had I not met my date outside, I probably would have spent a few minutes trying to figure it out. Our waitress didn't come over as often as I expected. Had it not been a casual date, this probably would have annoyed me. Given the situation, it was just right.

I have been a NYer my whole life. This is so far the best pizza I have ever eaten. Watching Dom work is amazing. He shreds the cheese fresh. He takes the pizza out of the oven with his bare hands. Then, he cuts fresh basil right on top. This place is historic in the pizza world. Pizza Mecca!
Yes, I agree the lobster roll was delicious. However the prices were just crazy! I got a half-roll for $8 and it was barely a few bites. Feeling very hungry now....
one of the best pizza i ever had !

another item checked off the bucket list. I must say that my dinner was truly a memorable night.  Rao's is special in a old school warm charming way. You can not replicate the vibe and feel of the place.   The place is pretty small and seating is tight and cozy, which I don't mind at all. The staff was warm and friendly.  Got to love a waiter that pulls up a chair and sits down at your table to take your order. The restaurant did have a couple of celabs in the house.  Not A-listers, but nevertheless celabs which I hear come to the place a lot. Now the food... I don't like to call myself a foodie, but I know food.  The food that is served here is simple decent food.  Many of the items menu items can be found on  pretty much any slightly upscale suburban pizzeria. Meatballs were pretty good, a bit to mushy and with to much cheese and fat in them for my taste.  Roast peppers were good.  Fresh Mozz and sliced tomato's were exactly what you would think they taste like.  I did really enjoy the seafood salad that was light and fresh. 2 pastas were ordered, one with plain tomato sauce  and the other with pesto sauce.  the pesto was very good, the tomato sauce pasta was pizzeria quality. No fresh pasta with these prices? Shrimp scampi was over flowered, over buttered, over salted and just not enjoyable. Veal piccata was also over floured.  Sliced steak was good.  Bro rabe was pretty ok too. After seeing the app's and entrees I knew what to expect from the desserts which were out of a box and very pedestrian. don't come here expecting good Italian food.  come for a cool experience.

Authentic Filipino cuisine. Food taste exactly like how they make them in the Philippines. Not fancy and cheap. Turo-turo style. Place has grocery as well. Need not look elsewhere. Staff are also very friendly.

Here's the thing.  The food is great, the owner is a nightmare.  Yelp is all about a comprehensive review so I'm just being honest. Visited the restaurant for brunch on a Saturday with a party of 6.  They were able to seat us within 15 minutes even though they seemed to be quite busy.  We all ordered something different and everyone seemed to be satisfied with their meal.  I had a coffee and a cheddar and tomato omelet.  The eggs were absolutely delicious, not over-cooked which tends to happen with omelets, but perfectly moist and tender!  The omelet was served with an ample amount of roasted potatoes and a slice of toast.  It was truly the perfect amount of food. The only downside to the actual meal was the weird club music that was playing loudly over the already loud dining room.  That was confusing. Anyway, my friend's credit card was charged three times.  An honest mistake by our courteous server.  My friend called the restaurant to report the charge and was told by the owner that "this sort of thing just happens with debit cards".  As if it was her fault for having a debit card...never apologizing for the accident and letting her know she'll have her money back on Tuesday.  Being a student with low funds and in-between jobs, this put her in an uncomfortable moneyless situation.  She was never offered any sort of compensation. She called back a day later to talk to the owner and just make it known that she was unsatisfied with the way things were handled and was told things such as "this really isn't a big deal".  Again, she explained that maybe not for him but for her it was all of her money.  So anyway, as she kept her calm, the owner began yelling at her and eventually hung up on her.  This just seems inappropriate.  As someone who has worked in customer service for years, I know (unfortunately) that it's typically the irrational customer's job to yell at the worker, and am still baffled at the treatment my friend received from this person. So like, great food but really terrible management.  It's a toss up.

A horrible dining experience. The location is the only good thing about this restaurant. The service was horrible. We had to seat ourselves and after waiting 10 minutes had to grab our own menus. After ordering we waited 30 minutes to get our food..which was definitely not worth the wait. It was flat out nasty...as were some of the employees. To top it off, there is no restroom.. Only a port-a-potty. To end this horrid experience, as we drove out of the parking lot, an employee waved goodbye with nothing but their middle finger. DO NOT GO HERE!!!

The woman at the counter was very nice. Oxtail was amazing and the curry goat was tender. The price is very reasonable for the portion size you order.  Medium plate was about $11 and very reasonable; I know other Caribbean restaurants elsewhere that will charge you the same amount for not even the portion size I was served here. My friend had the jerk chicken and loved it.

Great addition to the Ritner St. corridor.  I usually order from Terryin, so it is good to know there is another quality Sushi place that delivers. It's nice to switch it up once in a while and have different options. The staff was very friendly and the inside looked very clean. It's also nice that they are open on Mondays unlike some other South Philly places.

We had to leave and finish our meal elsewhere.  We started off with 12 oysters, which were not served on ice, and I found a hair in one of them.  There was lipstick stain on my wife's wine glass, and the menu was filthy.
