The beets were gross, the calamari was rubber, and overall the food was not good.   Our server, however, Brandy, was sweet, patient and did a nice job.  We did not bother advising her of the errors.
Everything i've had here is amazing. Especially their vegetarian ramen!

I had the chicken meatball dish with miso soup. It looks good and very eye appealing. The miso soup was very bland.. very weak flavor of dashi and konbu, I dunno why its very griddy like lumpy. The chicken meat ball is very flavorful and moist. The down thing is the rice, yes they drizzle with a glaze.. but the whole things needs more flavor beside that. I had matcha roll.. its moist and sweet. The matcha cake otself can add a little bit more matcha powder. Aside from that my waiter was very nice and the ambience also. Would be back to try other dishes
Really?  This is the best NYC has to offer???  Sbarro is better. Poor service and long wait too.

across the street from the brooklyn museum, this place looks like a run down shack.  we came around 530 pm on sunday and was greeted by a lady sitting on the stool instructing the 2 lady cooks behind the counter.  Everyone is very nice, there is 2 tables outside and additional seating upstairs.  Its really cramped quarters and while i waited a good half hour after i ordered my food, i saw a ton of people from all walks of life come through and order takeout and sit in.   I ordered a small plate of oxtail, which is very large still.  Came with three gigantic pieces in a delicious subtle sauce, not spicy.  Came with rice and peas and veggies which looked like boiled cabbage, corn and some other indistinguishable greens.  the salad was just some leaves with a slice of tomato with olive oil drizzled on top. I also order the mac and cheese.  It was baked with breadcrumbs on top.  I prefer my mac and cheese bursting with flavor and super cheesy, this was on the milder side, might work for some people.  i also had some of my dates stew chicken.  the skin had a crispness to it that made me think the chicken may have been fried first. overall it was decent food the place is ran so poorly and disorganized.  i wont be going back.

Maybe this is an imaginative bar with great food. Or a version of the small plate restaurant with brilliant cocktails. No matter. Order the Piyor (zubrowka bison grass vodka, white lillet, cointreau and lemon juice), or any of the hand mixed and fresh-squeezed libations. Eat a grilled shrimp slider, the fantastic fries sprinkled with parmesan and truffle oil, or the roasted organic chicken happily nested on a bed of lemony spinach or all of the above, as we did. Can't wait to go back.

I'm going to have to come back to this review one day when I have a little more time but Rat's is an overall fantastic restaurant! The food is top notch and the decor is so fun and classy. The service was very, very leisurely which some people won't like, but if you aren't in a rush and truly want to enjoy a nice, relaxing meal this is the place to go.

Great restaurant in Times Square!  Reasonable prices (given the location), large portions enough for 4 people per dish, and great service. We got the stuffed mushrooms (yum!), pasta with marinara and vegetables (forgot the name), and veal parmigiana.  A doggie bag was still needed after the meal.  We were stuffed and happy.   Highly recommended!

I love bacon. I mean I really love bacon. I just need you to know that... I was under whelmed by this place. My husband and I went here on a Friday night for dinner. Didn't need a reservation which was good. The music was so loud we could barely hear each other, let alone the waitress. The specials are written on chalkboards above the open kitchen but from where I was sitting I couldn't see them, waitress didn't even list the specials to us. Husband ordered the bacon and cheese flatbread and the bacon flight for us to share. The bacon flight was amazing! Four different types of perfectly cooked bacon, two pieces of each style perfect for us to share. The flat bread was disgusting. There was way too much cheese and the bacon was undercooked. It took about 20 minutes to get our apps and then we say there with dirty plates until our entrees came another 20-30 minutes later. I had the lobster bacon Mac and cheese and my husband had the lobster roll with bacon. My lobster was rubbery and flavorless. The Mac and cheese had no seasoning and again huge chunks of under cooked bacon which is a huge pet peeve of mine. The lobster roll was good! The lobster meat was perfectly cooked and flavorful! I think there was only 1 waitress and two runners/busers for the entire dinning part of this place which maybe caused the long waits... I don't think I will come back. Other than 4 strips of perfect bacon, nothing else was memorable. Try at your own risk.
Love this place. Tiramisu is floaty, staff is sexy & flirty, even with this old lady.

I really like this place! The chicken Caesar pizza is to die for! The salads are fresh. I always get the zepoles are an amazing dessert! They have lunch specials during the week! Prices are reasonable but consider the quality of the food you will definitely go back

Nice place and friendly service. The prices are reasonable considering the area. I ordered the three appetizer special that included the falafal balls and the calamari. The  falafal balls were great and the calamari was good too but could have been a tad more crispy.
Awesome, beats the hell out of Moe's and Chipotle. Their pork is amazing, try the taco salad on the bowl. So much cheaper than other places and taste 10x better.

Worst experience ever. Burrito? I think not. They sent me a giant taco. I asked for it to be chimmied and it wasn't done. And when I called the resturant the woman yelled at me and told me she was too busy. My boyfriend ordered the curry chicken and it had nothing but onions. Not to mention our food was saturated in oil. Ugh never again.

Wonderful dining experience!!!!  The service was attentive and the food was delicious.  Everyone in my party agreed. I would definitely come back. One negative-I ordered the Mango Salad and they drenched the salad with the passion fruit vinaigrette.  It was tasty, but overkill.

This is by far the best pizza in the area! Tonight was my first time trying John's Place and it did not disappoint.  I have been getting frustrated by the lack of costumer service at other local pizza places in Fairmount, and decided to give this place a try. We ordered 1 large cheese pizza, fries, and a grilled chicken salad. The pizza was fantastic, not too salty, with crunchy thin crust. The fries were hot and delicious. As for the grilled chicken salad it was phenomenal. I ordered a large and it will definitely last me for at least 2 meals, it's impossible to finish in one sitting. It came with a roll which is always great to dip in the balsamic dressing which I ordered on the side... Is that weird? Anyways... I can't finish this review without mentioning the fabulous customer service that I received from the phone call to the pickup. With that being said, thanks Yelp for not leading me astray.

So disappointed with this place. We waited almost an hour for our food.  Then, the food came out, one meal at a time. My husband and I were finished eating when they finally brought my daughters dinner. It was supposed to be filet mignon - but it clearly was not a filet mignon.  It was a flat steak, and overcooked to boot.  What a waste of $80!  The waitress sort of tried to apologize, but barely - no compensation for the wait and the ruined steak. Didn't want to make a scene in front of the family and turn a good night into a bad night - so we didn't demand the meal be removed from our bill.  I wish I had. I don't mind spending money to go to dinner, but HATE when I feel ripped off. That's how I felt when we left Sharky's. Will not be returning anytime soon.
I just had pizza heaven! Generous use of ricotta, the way it should be!! Great place to grab a quick slice after a show.

we came here right before the banh mi sandwiches were sold out. the banh mi was flavorful and baguette was the rigjt amount of crunch. vietnamese coffee was the right amount of sweet. the tacos were fine but the banh mi sandwiches are what make this cozy spot fantastic.

I'm a huge fan of Heirloom, especially after our wildly fun e-list Girls Night Out last year. And now it's even better: a new chef and an entirely locavore menu. Carey Savona (ex of Nobu, NY) has raised the bar with his locally sourced, revamped versions of traditional American foods. Start with a pile of charred Gypsy peppers, roasted and salted and as addictive as potato chips but oh, so much healthier. Next, a chunky sugar pea puree to spread on husks of grilled fresh bread. Lunch was Carey's genius rendition of a tuna melt: smoked New England trout piled on artisanal bread, smothered with cheddar and radish slivers, served with a side of homemade pickles (newly legal in CT) and devilishly good fries. Omnivore and vegetarian friendly, the new menu is a must try. Makes you wonder why every restaurant on the Shoreline has yet to embrace this trend. Girls night out anyone??

Not sure what the hype is about. Average bar food at best. Weak atmosphere and loud. Onion rings tasted like onion rings, "secret sauce" was honey mustard out of a bottle.... And .50c for a refill of it,... Won't be returning.

We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner! We were visiting and celebrated a Big birthday for my husband! The oysters were so fantastic! The lobster Mac-n-cheese was yummy and the mussels were delicious! Todd was our waiter and he made great recommendations! When we are back in Philly we will be back.

This place is great! I can't really tell the difference between many of the chaats but they are all great. I went here my first week in West Philly and have been back many times since. The men behind the counter are very personable and polite. The store also carries Peace Tea which is my favorite brand of Iced Tea! If you want to order on the phone, you can only do it about 15 minutes or so in advance. They don't want the chaat to sit around and not be as delicious as it could be. Understandable but threw me off at first. They are really proud of their product!
Great ambience and and great food. The octopus was cooked to perfection and the spiced duck was very flavorful. Don't skip out on the dessert flour less chocolate cake is awesome!

You can not get a deal as good as this in Midtown Manhattan. One appetizer, and two entrees, $28....its amazing, and the food is amazing too! The restaurant has such a high-class look about it too! Highly recommend!
Everything was delightful. Perfect atmosphere, friendly staff, combined with delicious melds of flavors! Bravo Bijan! I had the bijan cocktail, the shiraz salad, and the pear arugula flatbread.

Good food, large menu, staff has been friendly,  but service is just too slow for whatever reason. Even at the height of lunch, 20+ minutes for a wrap is kind of silly. I come back for the variety, but make sure you have some time.

I cannot believe I got a reservation the day of to this place. High end experimental cuisine that tastes AMAZING for a reasonable price. Leaves you pining for more. Pun intended, the food is just THAT good.
Excellent food and good service. Not a loud atmosphere either, it was pleasant. Good for a date night.

Great fresh and nutritious food for a really reasonable price served by really personable people. LOVE it! Had the Carolina BBQ Chicken and Cream of Cauliflower soup. Wish they had these in Texas. Well done Reviver!!

GREAT food and great service. Loved that it was byob too! I got the cali-turkey sandwich and absolutely loved it. My boyfriend the huevos rancheros and was impressed. The portions are huge and our waitress was very nice and attentive. Definitely going back!
Had some kind of rice bowl with TONS of sashimi on it for lunch. Very fresh. Delicious sticky rice. Maybe $14 for the bowl.

Excellent burgers... We also had the BBQ pulled pork sandwich and was blown away at how good it was... The sweet potato fries lived up to all the reviews and were FANTASTIC!!! The atmosphere is completely authentic and adds to the experience. It truly is a gem of a find!
this place is awesome.  food is unbelievable, and the people are super nice.  i highly recommend eating here, but make a reservation.  oh and don't forget to try the toasted almond tiramisu.

Drinks are tasty and refreshing. I posted a few pics (9 dishes my 3 friends and I had in ONE visit LOL)... definitely good flavors and colorful display... if you're not that hungry this will hit the spot. But if you're definitely willing to explore the menu their selections are not disappointing. However, the matzoh ball plate is kindy salty for my taste. Either way.. Dessert hit my sweet tooth!!!!!! Sooo freakin delicious!  Try the Sticky toffee pudding and the Brownie !!!! ;) Chef Illan Hall did a great job with the menus! Kudos!!! ;)

Overall good ambience, poor service only because they are short handed, decent food. Ambience: Really cool open door vibe in Hells Kitchen with a bar in front and classier seating in back.  Well kept overall. Food: (I'm vegetarian) I ordered the tofu and mixed mushroom vermicelli bowl.  Pretty presentation with the sauce in a small sauce bowl sitting on top of the noodles. I warn those that order this to not immediately pour it all on. It's more salty than I like.  The noodles were well-cooked.  The tofu skin was nice but the mushrooms seemed like they came out of a can.  Granted, this happens a lot to vegetarian dishes and the way it was prepared made it not totally bad but I would have easily preferred fresh button mushrooms.  As you eat this dish, the saltier it gets since it's sitting in all the soy-based sauce. This made the last third difficult to eat.  Overall not bad - 3 star.  I also had a Vietnamese iced coffee which was strong (but what I needed).  There seems to be a mix of Vietnamese (like pho) and Thai (Thai iced coffee, noodle dishes, curries), which is curious since there are incredible Thai restaurants close by (Wondee Siam and Pure). Service: everyone was very pleasant to me but they are short 3 or maybe 4 waitstaff. Every phase of service was slow.  Getting a seat, Ordering, drinks, food, check.  Sitting at the bar, I saw more than 10 people leave simply because they weren't being seated.  I saw two parties sit down at the bar to a dirty area that wasn't cleaned in a timely manner.  The service staff works hard but probably get a bad reputation more because of a managerial decision to have so few people working. This is one of the few times that id not recommend a place for service but this might be one

AVOID!!!!! I am cool with gruff service.  This is NYC and frankly I do not require hospitable service to enjoy a dining establishment.  That said, I have never encountered the level of aggressiveness and disrespect that I received from the manager at Kati Roll. One star for the rolls-which are honestly not bad but ZERO STARS for the service.  Maybe I would try another location, but I will NEVER return to the midtown west Kati Roll.

had a mid level tequila on the rocks the other day. a very short pour for $15. 2 or 3 small sips-GONE. I hate that!! our octopus tapas was pretty good but IMO over priced as well. my advice - pour a real drink or lower your price.  I guess I'm done with this place.

Six of us here. Everyone had lukewarm soups. Spiders falling down from the ceiling.  Tempura batter mediocre.  Will not be back. Would not suggest to even try.  Not sure how this place stays open we ate lunch and they maybe had us with 2 additional guest. Service trying the best with the tools their given which isn't much.

Ordered on a  Wednesday night at 9 pm -- was told 45 mins roughly. 90 minutes later I finally cancelled the order. This despite the restaurant assuring me 3 times that the order was already on the way.
Tuesday night trivia was a lot of fun. Cheese steaks are great plus their new buffalo fries are amazing!!!!

I was very excited to try this restaurant, as it is very close to my house and I am a huge fan of wood-fired pizza.  Unfortunately, we were very disappointed.  I am writing this review knowing that the place has only been open for a short time...so am still hopeful that they will get it together.  Beer selection was great, which is why I am giving them 2 stars instead of 1.  We ordered the chicken saltimboca appetizer...at $7 I would have expected a lot more.  The appetizer consisted of 4 tiny bite-sized pieces of chicken.  It was probably one chicken tender total.  It was completely overcooked and dry.  Was not impressed and would not order again.  We ordered the supreme pizza.  We waited well over 30-35 minutes for the pizza, and there weren't too many tables.  In addition, the waitress never came to check on us during this time, to ask if we wanted a new beer, nothing.  Anyway, the pizza finally came out.  One entire side of the pizza crust was completely black/burned to a crisp/inedible.  The rest of the pizza dough was completely raw.  We sent it back to have them put it back in the oven.  The waitress mentioned something about the weather (temperature??) having something to do with the dough not being fully cooked.  When it came back out, it was still raw.  The manager (who never came over to talk to us) offered to buy our beers for us?  No offer was ever made to make us a new pizza?  We asked to have the pizza removed from our bill since that was what we were unhappy with, and they obliged.  It seemed very strange to me that they wouldn't have offered to make us a new pizza.  We literally took 2 bites out of an entire pizza.  Anyway, I am sad to say I will not be coming back here for at least a few months until they figure out what they are doing.  At $18 for a pizza...I would much rather go to American Flatbread.

It is hard to imagine a place more heavenly than Eataly.  If you haven't been and are wondering what it is, I will tell you. It is an Italian grocery store with tiny boutique restaurants throughout and a cooking school. There is the fish restaurant, meat restaurant, the charcuterie restaurant and the beer garden.   I really could have stopped at the pasta restaurant because, come on, that is all that matters and that is where I ate, FOR DINNER. I also had two desserts. Call me a pig, I don't care, but you try and pass up anything in this place. The fact that I got out of there with just dinner, gelato and sweet focaccia was truly astounding. For dinner, at the pasta place, I had fresh pasta with a short rib ragu and a caprese salad. Both were to die for and if I had to pick a last meal this very well may be it. The short rib was so tender it fell apart in my mouth and the noodles were perfectly cooked so they offered that perfect firmness.  The mozzarella cheese, prepared in-house (like everything else) was so creamy it melted when it touched my tongue and the tomatoes were so tender that they could be cut with my fork.   After dinner I headed to the bread bar where I picked up a piece of focaccia bread covered in butter, sprinkled with sugar and baked.  I had never seen this before and I wasn't aware that focaccia could get any better, but it does. I mean really anything is better with sugar. My final stop on my eating adventure through Eataly was at the gelato counter.  Now, the true test of any gelato place is the taste of their pistachio. If the pistachio is good, then everything will be good, If they can't make pistachio, they can't make gelato. Ill go one step further, if they don't have pistachio as a flavor it's not a true gelato place.  This is true of gelato places around the world - Italy, Paris, Argentina, Los Angeles, New York. Anyway, that was a long intro to tell you that the pistachio was really great. The gelato was extra creamy, smooth and tasted like pure Italy in a cup. When you get a chance to go to Eataly - GO! Yes, it is on the tourist map (Mary and Lou) and it is packed with people, but there is no other experience like it and if you are a foodie, like me, you will be in absolute heaven.

So, this restaurant says outside their window, "Esto cambiara su vida" (This will change your life), and they are right.  This is delicious Mexican-style fare.  The prices are also great.  I have gone here many times to have their unbelievable $1 appetizers during happy hour as well as their chicken quesadillas.  Everything I have tasted here has truly been divine.  Love El Rey!

Popped in on a random Sunday night and loved it! The lamb burgers and turkey burgers were great (especially the lamb!!!). Truffle fries were a great side. The soups we ordered to start were just ok. Our server was very attentive. Will definitely be back!

Food is good. Its s bit of a noisy place. Oh if you sit on bar you can see them make the food. Great food but the mash potatoe sucks balls maybe its pan fried and that taste like amish people food but overall good food bit noisy ..cool place

Too much food!!! I got the Thali lunch special and when I got it I thought it was for two. Anyways... It was amazing. And the folks running the place are just beautiful. So welcoming and friendly. I live all the way in Brooklyn and will definitely make the journey back this way. And what a bargain. Loved it!!!

This is  a cute place, with a (mini) outdoor seating area out front. I saw some disappointing brunch reviews, but I can only speak for the dinners I've had there, and I usually order the non pizza dishes. I have been three times and the food has always been good (apps and main dishes) and I am a big fan of their cocktail list. Wait time is a bit more than I'd like ( that becomes even more of an issue in a group) but the food is yummy once you get it and on a slower night  with maybe dinner for just two, it is very nice spot in the neighborhood.

I went with traditional New York w/ cherries. It didn't last long and it was amazing! Creamy with the perfect amount of sweetness. My friends both did the chocolate mousse cheesecake, and it was good as well.

Last Wednesday a friend and myself visited fabrick before a play we were greeted immediately by 2 very friendly hostesses that brought us right over to this really quaint spot overlooking the whole restaurant. We were then greeted by our server Marc and he introduced us to the sommelier who recommended a wonderful Rioja based on our tastes. Marc then went through the menu with us and actually got us to change our minds from a few appetizers and entrees to adding a mid-course of the David Burke burger that he said was made from brisket which sounded great so we were sold. Btw it was an absolutely fantastic burger and perfect for a mid-course. The lobster dumplings were sooooo delicious I wanted more but I lost that battle because of the amount of food that we had ordered. The entrees came out, the scallops with fresh horseradish was fantastic the beets added great texture and a sweetness that off set the horseradish what a great combination of flavors We also decided on the lamb and rib combo which struck me as an unusual combination but the savory lamb just melted in your mouth and then you had the sweet, spicy sauciness to the ribs WOW. This was a meal to remember and to add to all this the wine selection was a fantastic match to all aspects of the meal Marc you definitely made this a memorable night with your suggestions thank you. I don't want to leave out the general manager which jumped at the chance to get me some extra fresh horseradish for me because I told her I love horseradish Thank you all that were involved in making this a spectacular evening. I look forward to coming back soon.

I have been meaning to try this restaurant out for ages after my brother recommend it to me so I took my girlfriend there for our anniversary & couldn't be more impressed the steak was cooked to perfection. I don't know when I'll come again though it was very pricey

I live in the area and went for dinner with my partner last night & fell in love with the place! I had the mushroom pizza. It was amazing!! The ingredients were fresh and it was garnished with super flavorful herbs. The beer menu was great as well. And as did everyone else, love the ambiance! That exposed brick and the old movies! Truly creates a speakeasy feel!
Their food is ok-chicken teriyaki was just fried chicken decked with teriyaki sauce- will not come back again.

I have been very excited to dine at Jora which opened up about a week ago. As soon as you walk in you are taken away from the decor and detail this restaurant has. The service was very inviting staff was friendly and very knowledgable of the items on the menu. (Which is a great, nothing worst than staff not knowing what they are serving). My partner and I ordered a Causa de Camarones as an appetizer which was absolutely delicious, the Causa had a different twist from the ordinary Causa with the meat filling in the middle. We ordered two cocktails which were pisco based and they were perfectly done, very refreshing for a summers night. For dinner he had the Arroz con Pollo the presentation was well done, and the meal was delicious the best best best Arroz con Pollo. I had the Lomo Saltado which was served with skirt steak the meat nice and tender. We were both very satisfied with our dinner at Jora. We are looking forward to go back for another delicious Peruvian dinner. LIC is growing with a lot of eateries and finally there is a Peruvian one in town!

good stuff.. staff talks about the customers in spanish.. calling whomever they thing is gay a "marika", means fag in spanish slang.. not very good for business.. maybe the owner, great guy, should rethink his staff ..
Seafood linguini was great and the Filet was just great, never had anything like that! This is one of the best French restaurants in Manhattan I'd say.

I came on a Friday night with a friend. Both the cocktails and the food were amazing. We tried the salmon tartare and the grilled asparagus, both delicious. The service was great, and the two women bartenders were extremely friendly and made exceptional drinks. The atmosphere and the crowd is a little mature, which is a nice change from the sports bars around the area.

Absolutely amazing food and service. My hubbie and myself just left the restaurant. I got curry goat and oxtail. From the front door we could smell the food and they did not disappoint. Walking into Morgan's is like walking into the owner's home. He was warm and welcoming...great way to end a long day after work. Will be back in a few days hope to see you there :)
I've always heard about the Reading Terminal Market, and a few short weeks ago I was finally able to experience it. This place has such variety and I cannot wait to go back and discover more things.
Joe is always friendly; the food always good; the prices right.

I love this place. They're so nice and everything I've had is yummy. Their salads are always fresh. Their cheesesteak is soooo yummy. The best I've had second to Pats. Also one of the best chicken parm sandwiches I've ever had. Will keep going back!
Really good food.. Cheesesteaks were amazing.. Bread was awesome.. Definitely would recommend getting the cheese whiz and onions.. Rather small inside.. Salads were absolutely huge !

Can't say enough good things about the place. Amazing desserts and coffee very cozy, they have a fireplace which I love in the winter. Had their pizza which was also good. I try to get here every time in the city.

This place is in a cute little alleyway in Chinatown that looks like it could be a movie set (wouldn't be surprised if it has been.) The wait is extremely long, so plan ahead. Instead of belting out synonyms for "good," I'll just say this place was a 5 (Yelp) star experience.

The service in this place is horrible the maître d' or manager is useless he sits and talks with everybody at the bar the waiters just sit around and for lack of a better word jackass around with the female staff to make dates with the female staff, it's just terrible my third attempt I've given every chance I can not going back if I'm not mistaken the owner is the same as tulipano they should really look into this and put the proper people in place to bring that restaurant back to where it should be quality service and quality food it WAS a great place at one time
Not only was the menu extensive and creative, the food was really, really good. Classic, delicious diner food that happens to be made from plants. I would definitely recommend getting a milk shake!
Great food the Cajun risotto is amazing. Ordered several small dishes and enjoyed. Service is excellent. Food is amazing. Definitely recommend it for dinner.

this places food is nothing to jump for ! the only thing I enjoyed was the chicken fingers and that's only because of the sauce everything is just basic "bar food " not worth it to me I will not be returning !
5 stars for the Burnt Ends, Shrimp & Grits, Mashed Sweet potatoes and great music.  Wish this place was in my town!

If you are looking for great Italian food at a fair price then this is the place.  Whether or not they know you, you are treated like family.  Obviously this fine establishment has been influenced by their Italian culture.  Please try it for yourself!!!!

The food here is mediocre at best. I will never go back to this place because their crappy soups spilled all over my car. For a place that specializes in take out, one would think that they would know how to pack liquids.  Ugh.

Girlfriend and I got here and got seated to a half empty restaurant. It took 15 minutes for our server to greet us and we ordered 2 margaritas and our meals. It took a half an hour to get the drinks and an hour to get to our meals. They come out luke warm. Food was slightly above average and portions were appropriate for the price point. Service was just dreadful. 3.5 stars for food.  1 star for service.  Average and round down to 2 stars.

Very slow.  Waiting over an hour for dinner.  Restaurant not crowded.  Just overheard someone say the food was awesome. I will let you know once I get my dinner. Just finished my quinoa cakes. Tasty but not impressed. Very pricey.  Service was great. Nice waitress.

Great breakfast!  Perfect coffee, amazing home fries (or substitute fruit), excellent bread and eggs, pickle bar open, lean tasty turkey bacon, great nova, bagels, lox.  Clean serene atmosphere.  Amazingly low prices for Central Philly.  We always check put breakfast places on our travels and this is one of the best!

LOVE this place.  I have tried a few other items on the menu when I'm with a group of friends but my hands down favorite is the PHO.  I could bath in the broth.  The noodles, sprouts, jalapeno peppers and Vietnamese basil are perfect additions to a very simple yet complex soup.  Its a must have if your under the weather, like a warm hug on the inside.
The food is good for quick inexpensive Chinese food.  Brown rice is available. The place is dumpy but worth the visit.  I like Ginger chicken...fresh green beans.

4 stars yeah right if your ordering for take out you better call in advance. Food quality is ok the best thing is the hours and location. I'm from NYC I know good soul food and I also know good customer service. They're pretty good with that but all seem to have an attitude and rarely smile. Get the kool-aid though. The pricing is average but for the size of the plates id rather cook at home.

Fun place and delicious food.  Had a great raspberry chocolate shake and delicious burgers and fries.  Staff was friendly and efficient except for one rude Asian waitress who was unfriendly and couldn't be bothered to treat us like paying customers.  Overall a great place and I would definitely return.

I've been eying this restaurant for weeks now and tempted by the smoked mackerel advertised on the mini tripod sign outside the front door, I decided to give it a try. I'm glad I did.   Unfortunately,  no outdoor seating so I had to leave the pooch at home but I sauntered back and ordered the broccoli salad and the smoked mackerel.  Both came out in appetizer or tapas portions,  which seems a bit pricey until you take the first bite.   The broccoli salad was mixed with generous portions of almond, cherry tomatoes,  and figs and brushed lightly with farmer cheese and toasted barley.  It was fantastic.  The broccoli was roasted and lightly chilled. The smoked mackerel was amazing.  Each bite of smokey goodness was on a small piece of toasted baguette with healthy sprigs of watercress,  small leaves of basil and pretty cheese shavings and citrus.  Every bite was a taste of heaven.   I also ordered the fermented rye drink ($3)and then it hit me.  This restaurant reminds me of the community supported kitchens in Berkeley, California,  that I loved,  with its homemade sodas and farm cooked meals in human portions. While I'm used to halving meals at the same cost and saving leftovers for the next day,  I've always said I'm willing to pay a little more for smaller portions of creative cooking and Orchard Cafe nails it.   I'll be back to try the rest of the menu.

This place is great! The Mediterranean cuisine is delicious and healthy. I took my friends here for lunch who were visiting from Germany. It was so conveniently located in midtown, yet didn't have a touristy feel. Exactly what we were looking for. The roasted eggplant and zucchini soup was delicious as was the root salad with feta. Almost too much to eat. My friends loved their Fresh Mozzarella sandwich and Chimi Chicken sandwich. Prices were great and we arrived right after the lunch rush so we were able to sit for a while and they did not seem to mind.

I had a really bad experience with this place while attending a workshop in New Haven.  It took them almost 90 minutes to deliver food to my hotel two blocks away.  When it arrived, they had forgotten the two bottles of water I'd ordered, so the woman went back to the car and brought me a diet coke (caffeine at 9pm?  Nope.) and a bottle of water that she said was "her water that she was giving to me."  It was hot and the bottle was crushed and dirty, so I assume it had been sitting in her cup holder all day.  She insisted that it wasn't open, but I was completely disgusted and threw it out.  Also, the Szechuan style wontons were revolting and I ended up tossing those too.  I couldn't even get them down, which is unfortunate because their presence on the menu was the only reason I chose this place.  If I could give this restaurant zero starts, I would.

We came here for taste of Hartford and had a lovely dinner. We started with excellent martinis, for a decent price. The service was very good. The bread was okay, but they had some different options for spreads which was nice. We started with the arancini and fried brussel sprouts, both were very tasty. My boyfriend had the hanger steak which is why I took away one star. I tried it and didn't think the quality was very good, the same could go for the accompaniments. I had the scallops over polenta which were fabulous though. Perfect serving and perfect glaze. We weren't a big fan of the desert selections but we tried them all and they were good- nothing amazing. I took a look at their normal menu which looked great and I'm sure we would be back to check it out.

This is a great spot.While waiting for a colleague out front, David brought me ginger tea, was very accommodating.  Their falafel sandwich (actually more like a wrap) may be the best I've ever had. I think the secret is slivers of pickeled turnip in the fallafel wrap. The humus appetizer was fantastic and a large portion. If u like falafel, must try Amalias
The service was slow, the food was cold, and the wait staff were eating instead of helping us. The interior was too dark, and kinda cluttered.

Sadly, my review is different than many here. We have been to Hawthorne many times and enjoyed the hospitality and food immensely. So excited when our beloved, for very different reasons, Tritone was going to become an outpost in my neighborhood. The first few times were ok. Solid drinks and tap-system. Food, with a few glitches, was aok. Cue to last week. Stopped in and ordered a burger (medium-rare...as rare as the Kitchen will let out of the Kitchen) and a Cider. The Cider was ok. The burger? I swear they threw it in a deep-fryer. Ate one bite. Not taken off check. Once bitten-twice shy has never been my mantra. That has changed. Stopped in after a 12 hour day, ordered a burger (with a heads-up to the Bartender) to go. M/R, Cheddar...that's it). Got home. Got a well-done. Brie (?)...poached pears. Un-real. Sent a message the next day in the hope that my concerns would be addressed. Not a word. Last night a Friend BEGGED me to go...grrrr...for a drink. The Cider served to her was, at best, skunked. When this was mentioned to the Bartender, after A sip, we were told "Maybe it's you"...never offered to replace/refund...asked for check...Barkeep starts to loudly berate my Friend for leaving no tip...after having an explanation spelled-out for him.. Worst Service I have ever had the displeasure of paying for. I am well aware, as a 17 year Resident of this Neighborhood, how much we need a good Bar/restaurant. This is not it.

I've been to Blend numerous times at the old location on Vernon Blvd and in all honesty! Blend on the water is great! There really is no comparison. The service is absolutely incredible. Our waitress Kayla is one of the best I've had- friendly, funny, and just all together personable and really made our experience at blend fantastic. Although, I must admit, the absence of empanadas and their inauthentic "flat bread" disappoint me...The atmosphere is great and food is delicious. I suggest you order the pollo a la plancha and coconut flan!
only good Chinese I've had in West Hartford.  it is my go to place

Came here because of the good reviews, but my husband and I left most of our food. Looked like it was prepared a while ago and sitting in buckets all day growing bacteria. Something was off about the sour cream. Had to spit out all of my steak, it was too fatty to chew through. Disappointing , wouldn't go back. Meats didn't seem fresh or seasoned well.

Been a while since I went to a place that was so filling with their lunch specials (recommend the crispy honey chicken). For around $6 you get Entree, Soup, and Fried Rice! Heck yeaaa. Oh and I left my check for work on the table like a clutz but the guy ran out to give it to me. Honest AND Delicious. See you soon!
Everything here is damn good. Try the passionfruit juice.

Good food, good cocktails, excellent service, excellent atmosphere. The decor is dark and sexy. An excellent date spot. The owner, Erika, is always here and always an amazing host. However, the thing that sets this place apart from most is the incredibly sexy atmosphere. The food, drink, decor, service; they all create something unique. A very special place with a good future ahead!
This place is terrific!  Delicious, cheap, relatively fast Indian food.  I absolutely loved every meal I have had here especially their Paneer Kati Roll.  Absolutely amazing.

I think I am not a super fan of pri-fixe menus.  I want to like them, but I just think that oftentimes the food comes out really generic and unmemorable. So I went to Yasuda for restaurant week, and while I thought that the service was impeccable and the ambiance to be relaxing, trendy, and chic at the same time, the food failed to impress me. I think we went with the pri-fixe menu - which had an appetizer, a main entree, and a dessert.  I think we ordered truffle fries on top just for flair.  For appetizer, I had the tuna tar tare, which was very fresh, but it didn't knock my socks off.  Not sure if tuna tar tare ever really knocks anyone's socks off ( but if you know a place that does, please leave me a comment and I will go try it out), so I will give it a decent rating. For the entree, I had the wagyu beef, which I thought was overcooked and lacked flavor.  It comes on a hot stone plate, which looks awesome because it's on fire as it's being brought to your table, but.... the problem is that if you don't want your beef overcooked, you need to remove it from the heat source ASAP.  I did that, but it still was a bit too cooked for my taste.  I also think it's a waste of beef to have it prepared like that. And... I don't remember the rest.  This is why #1 you should write your reviews right away and #2 it wasn't that memorable to me. I did like the huge iced buddha sculpture though.  I asked about it and they told me to take a scoop of the water, pour it over the buddha and make a wish.  Kitschy, but still fun.   I really have to come back and try their regular menu sometime.
This is definitely the best sushi in Philadelphia and the staff is super friendly!

Beautiful restaurant, but if you come to Freemans'  you should know that you are coming for the ambiance not the food. I came in a group and we are all unanimously disappointed in everything we ordered. The service was fine, but nothing exceptional.
love the pho1 went on a monday afternoon- please get there before 1230, it gets so packed afterwards. the summer roll is delicious!! would def go back!

The manager/bar tender Kyle was very rude to my sister and her gay friend. On separate occasions, he ignored them for hours. When he was confronted with this information, he blatantly lied saying he was overwhelmed with an overcrowded bar. Listen, I'm a deploying soldier and my sister was the one complaining about the show service. The bar seats about 20 people. There were roughly 12 people at the bar at any given time. Give me a break. You are slow because you are slow.
not very good food.  everything i ordered was tasteless.  the delivery was on time but that was the only good thing.  won't be eating here again.

Not only is the food finger licking good but its picture perfect!! Presentation is second to taste and Walter's perfectly achieved both. My review is strictly based on my Brunch Experience.. the Staff was friendly and polite and the food couldn't have come out any quicker. I had the French Toasts which were DELICIOUS!!! My boyfriend ordered the Egg Benedict Smoked Salmon which he enjoyed... I was too full from the 2 of the 4 French toast to taste his food but it looked really good. We will be returning to Walter's to try their other goodies.. Our friendly table neighbors recommended we try the omelets on our next visit but I'm already dreaming of being reunited with those French Toast!! Oh and my leftovers tasted even better the next morning!!! I may have found my Brooklyn Brunch Fav
Get the Pork Belly Banh Mi  and the Kimchi Fries. AMAZINGGGGGGG!

I was visiting from California and decided to try this place out. Best decision EVER! The food was amazing and service was great. The Manager John greeted us and even invited us back for brunch, but our schedules were just too packed. I highly recommend this place and I'm picky.

First things first: The food was delicious! I was here yesterday for lunch and I ordered the roasted potato/green bean/yellow beans and eggs with toast and it was so good. The potatoes were nice and crispy on the outside and creamy in the middle and the vegetables were cooked but still had a good crunch! And the eggs were just right! It's an open kitchen so you can watch the cook make your food for you and it's so interesting and fun to see. Secondly: The coffee was amazing. I ordered a latte and it was perfect and foamy and delicious and creamy and the best I've had in a long long time! I won't be able to go back to Starbucks after this... Thirdly: The service and environment was really pleasant. The decor was very hipster-ish. My favorite thing about my meal (aside from the food and drinks of course!) was just the general feel of the place. It was really homey and comfortable and not at all pretentious or anything. And I really enjoyed the fact that the staff at this place (the server, the cook, and the coffee girl) were interacting so well and so funny! It was like they were just three friends who decided to open a coffee bar/restaurant together. They were all super friendly to me and I couldn't help but eavesdrop on their conversations and their singing.
Love this place! Yummy food, great atmosphere. Their seasonal french toast is to die for! EVERY SEASON :)

My husband and I dined here for the first time tonight,  everything was delicious and the service from the hostess to the server, and all other staff was super friendly.  I ordered the lasagna which looked beautiful when it arrived, perfect slice , not sloppy looking, topped with pretty mozzarella and basil.  A very large portion and I loved every bite, even though I could only eat half.  My husband who always regrets the choices he makes after deciding between two dinners, finally chose the Chicken Parmigiana which arrived on a bed of spaghetti and tomato sauce.  He enjoyed it, and I tried a bite of the chicken which was crispy, but very moist.  We also started with fried mozzarella which arrived with a tomato basil sauce, and a salsa verde, a green pesto sauce that was delicious!  Crispy on the outside, warm and gooey on the inside.  the outside seating was full, but we were able to get a table inside, and really enjoyed the atmosphere.  Seems bigger inside than when it was Three Tomatoes.  We really enjoyed our night out and would come back to this restaurant!

Went to this place many times, when I lived right by the corner, it was always great but I always order the same thing so I can just speak for the pad that with chicken or beef, it has great size portions and great value, on the down side the place has always a line, always and it's an elbow to elbow place so if you like spaceful places avoid.
nice gourmet options plus whole wheat crust. love gorgonzola gourmet. fresh ingredients.

One of the first 5s that was a no-brainer! The customer service is so wonderful here. Our waitress was super knowledgeable and offered suggestions when she saw I could use it. We ordered the calamari, basil rice w shrimp, and green curry chicken. Everything was excellent! I mean, this is the Thai food you will craze for weeks to come. Tip: they are serious about their spice so if your not, just order mild levels of spice on everything.

It was just ok, nothing special and overpriced. $14 burger and an extra $2 for cheese (!!!), $2 bacon, $2 for fried egg. The smoked chicken was smothered in pea gravy and a pound of butter...might have a heart attack tonight.  Meh.

This has by far the best sushi i've had in Philadelphia. The staff is friendly enough and the service is good. They also are not annoyingly friendly or present which is refreshing. The booths are cute and they have a great drink selection (sapporo, asahi and so on) Great place, well kept and amazing sushi.

My husband and I celebrated his birthday at Fuji Mountain with 15 of our friends. We reserved the Karaoke Room and had a fixed menu and open bar. The food was great (and there was a lot of it!) and the service/presentation was even better. John, the manager, worked very closely with me leading up to the event to make sure it was exactly what I wanted. He worked with his staff to set up all of the decorations I dropped off (they did an excellent job!) and was very attentive to our needs and any questions or issues that came up. We all had an excellent time and I would totally recommend Fuji Mountain for your next fun event with friends!
This place is magic. The service is phenomenal and their $10 happy hour wine flight is generous and a steal.
Love Fish, they have a deal you can't beat 9$ for half a dozen oysters plus drink!  Paige is a great bartender, and the staff is welcoming. If you're in the area don't miss out on this place!
The price of these dumplings helps me be prosperous. Trust me on this - get a pancake.
Very good for airport food. The soups are all excellent: soba noodles with lots of options. Better than a plate of nasty wings or a burger you usually find while traveling.
The food is really good, we had the chicken liver pate as the appetizer that was really good and a nice watermelon salad. We took the fish as the entrée with potatoes on the side... so good.

Based on reviews here we decided to give a visit to Caracas Arepa Bar. Can't say we were disappointed, but at the same time I don't really get the amazing reviews on here. The food was alright, but nothing more than that. Arepas are small, but filling, but I couldn't help to think it's a dish you can easily and cheaply make yourself at home. Hibiscus Ice Tea is disgusting. Maybe I just don't like Hibiscus. Whatever that is. The service was good, no complaints there.

We had a party of five adults and one five month old and they were so accommodating for dinner. They took time to set up the table so the baby would be comfortable in her stroller. It was a really nice surprise given that there is a younger crowd and a bit of a bar vibe. The pizza is is absolutely the best. The host and server were excellent. We recommend this place, it is a North Shore treasure!! They make it easy to stay local!

An excellent addition to the South Orange scene.  They did a lot of work to the interior and the decor is well-done. They have a lot of space with a restaurant area and two bar areas (one upstairs & one downstairs).  I've been there to eat & to drink, but will probably end up visiting this place more for the latter. The dining experience was good.  The food we had was excellent, but it was fairly pricy compared to the other establishments in South Orange (plus, since they have a bar, they are not BYOB).  The waiter was nice, but not really as attentive as he could have been.  I'll give them a pass on that, since my wife & I ate there just after they opened, so I am sure there were some kinks to get out (plus they were really busy). But what Ricalton's will really be good for is going for a drink with friends.  There are televisions both upstairs (8) & downstairs (2) showing sports.  But this doesn't mean it is a "sports bar" atmosphere where the televisions take over the area if you're not there for a game.  Upstairs seems to be more of the classy area, with people having a drink after work or waiting for a table in the eating area.  Downstairs is smaller and more laid back with a long bar for seating and darts.  Decent tap selection and attentive bartenders on both levels.  Will be back! And to respond to a recent poster who stated "from the name and outside it appears to be an Irish pub", it should be know that the place is named after James Ricalton, who was a 19th century local resident, teacher, and from what I can tell, all-around-good-guy.  If you're looking for a more traditional Irish pub, head to the also-excellent  St James's Gate in Maplewood.

really love this place.  Not only do they have one of the largest selections of beer I've seen they have such tasty sandwiches.  The tuna is fantastic and rolls are sooo good. They serve summer cocktails and have really good evening specials.  It's super casual.. wooden booths and a communal table.

LOVE this place. Perfect for girls night or a date. The service is great; the servers never rush you. Very chill time. The outside is such a nice ambience -- lights and palm trees. Hookah is great and I love the chicken kabob. I never take home left overs but I could not leave my chicken kabob behind. Highly recommended
Loved the intimate atmosphere and food was outstanding.  Nice to BYOB.  Parking was a bit of a walk away but otherwise this is a place we will return to.

The food is great, the employees at the deli and doing delivery are the best.  Come here if you want great food!  They also have a good amount of organic food.  The lines are never long I can get in and out with no problems.

-Great experience; the cheese wiz was piping hot and the cuts of steak were hot and tender; the speed of these guys cranking out cheesesteaks unreal; be prepared with cash as this establishment doesn't take card...and thankfully it doesn't.

LOVE!!  My husband and I had been sitting on a gift card we received 4 years ago.  Mad now it took us so long to use it.  The experience was perfect from the phone call I made for reservations.  The woman that answered phone was so sweet and nice. The hostesses were just as friendly. We were seated in dining room and greeted by a very nice server named Kyle.  I asked if we could move to a window seat (it was a gorgeous day on the river) but wanted to keep Kyle as our waiter.  Friendly hostess came over and said no problem.  Food was fantastic, appetizers, main dishes, everything.   Food runners were just as pleasant.  Obviously the staff is treated well by the owners....it's been a long time since I went anywhere with that many friendly, smiling faces.  Last happy face was on the way out when I complimented the manager/owner.  Everything was perfect!!  We'll be back for sure!   Good job!

I literally cannot. I lack the ability to even. this place is the most amazing combination of southern cooking and New York class ever. the chicken and rosemary waffles are great, but the drinks and desserts are out of this world. Jair's recommendations were spot on. He's kind of a bad ass.
By far the best Indian food I've had since moving to the USA from England. Love this place and am happy that I've found it so close to home.
Always a great place to start the night out.

Don't know at what restaurant Dana G ate, but I don't think it was this one.  Dante and Luigi's is very clean, pristine tablecloths and sparkling glassware.  As for the food being pseudo-Italian, sorry don't see that either.  I would like to know what she thinks is "legit Italian."

Usually it is difficult to separate Indian cuisine from the rest, but Chatni did just that. Seated in the quaint back patio we ordered a starter and two entrees. The Chicken 65 - Indo Chicken may need a different name, but as a starter, it is definitely something worth ordering again. The lamb korma also was excellent. Perfect amount of coconut and spices. The only real downfall of the food was with the mixed tandoori. The shrimp and boneless chicken was overcooked, while the lamb and bone-in chicken were excellent. Be careful sitting outside, depending on where you are sitting, you can be forgotten. We unfortunately were.

This is a great place. The food is amazing and the service is personalized and friendly. The space is very small and the decor is sparse, so if you're looking to have a private conversation, this may not be the place. But for delicious and inspired fish and entrees, an awesome experience, very reasonable prices, and BYOB, this is the place to go!

Great sushi. Awesome happy hour, but I recommend only going during happy hour. The sushi is awesome but the waiters are inexperienced. Maybe because they are new, but you'd think newly trained staff would be fresh to the standards. I don't think it's going to be my first choice, but the 4 stars is because the sushi is soo good

Such a cute little restaurant, loved the atmosphere! The naked ball, classic beef with spicy meat sauce was so good! one of the greatest meatball I've ever tried. Saw lots of reviews about their icecream sandwich so couldn't resist but give it a try The mint icecream was so goood... Confident to say the best one I've ever had! It has actual mint leaves in it and it's not too sweet! The snickerdoodle cookie was great as welll but the today's spcial's white chocolate and almond cookie was meh.
Right on the Theatre District.  Carmine's has large portions great food and family style restaurant. I enjoyed everything I had.

Completely blown away by their brunch menu! Everything is so well-portioned and flavorful and the list goes on ad infinitum.  Someone ordered the Sicilian baked eggs over at the next table and that's definitely going to be my choice the next time I come here.   My tastes were veering towards hearty that morning so I opted for the steak and eggs which they serve sunny side up with herbed potatoes.  I'm not really someone who has a natural inclination towards steak but trust me when I say they do theirs well here.  I was licking the knife clean, reminiscent of the opening credits scene to Dexter.  Not to mention the little wooden marker stating how well your steak was cooked was an adorable and classy touch. They do their ginger ales in house too, which is always a plus in my book.  The one I got had tons of fresh cucumber muddled within the ginger ale, so you get a dry yet refreshing touch. I didn't get to check out the photobooth that everyone's been talking about, but really, when the food is so good here, that should be the last thing on your mind.  Save the picture taking for those drunken, wasted nights at a bar where you're able to break out your best poses in a conveniently placed booth.  You come here solely for the food. Oh, and definitely make a reservation.  It was a madhouse on Sunday morning, but you can see why.

Roaming around in the West Village I stumbled on this place. Loved the yelp reviews it had and decided to try. I ordered the Spinach Gnocchi. As other reviewers have said - it was totally amazing!!! I will be back as much as my budget allows to me come here because I have become a big fan.

Ordered twice this week from Whitney's.   Both times the phone service is poor and you can barely understand them. They got my order wrong first time. Pepperoni pizza tasted weird and was not expect square slices. Most the pizza went to garbage. Asked for ranch and got marinara. Thought I'd give them another chance the second time but did not order pizza. Meatball grinder was good. Calamari stunk so bad like dead fish. Obviously old. Couldn't eat it.  Asked for ranch and got bleu cheese. Will never order here again.

Had our wedding cake done here. Excellent cake along with excellent service! Pasquale is an awesome cake maker with a lot of talent. Also the price was very reasonable. Everyone should come here for their pastry and cake needs!
One of my favorite restaurant in Philadelphia very delicious food very good service and they're kids friendly.
Great set up, great bartenders and a cute area. Loved sitting next to a wide open window/wall. The food menu is limited but their calamari is a great starter and I've never had a bad meal there!

We had an hour wait for our table and then waited another 10 minutes for our waitress to arrive.  Her name is Ashley and was extremely rude.  She was so annoyed to have to take our order and even made a rude comment about what we ordered for dinner!  The $17 hamburger is nothing special and way overpriced for what you get.  With so many options in Burlington, we will not return here!
Very tasty food and friendly service. Pasta was outstanding.  Deserts are a specialty here.
We love this local queens gem. It is our go to spot when we are not in the city. Love the tapas style, unique menu and great selection of beer. Highly recommend trying this restaurant!!!

(Had chicken over rice) There's no chewiness in the chicken, which not all halal places have. It's also my favorite thing about them. The staff is very friendly and efficient. Make sure to get alot of WHITE sauce and a little bit of red sauce. I add a bit more red sauce, just to get that extra tang ;] It's so good that my friends and I always get cravings for it. The price of $7 such a steal as well! :D
Best drunk food ever, hands down - it's become a weekly post drinking ritual with friends!

Amazing Food.  Cheap price.  Big portions.  Cash only?  What's going on here?!  I come here when I can and this place is always busy.  So plan on going early knowing that there will be a wait.  Small spot with nice interior, love the brick wall.  Good staff too.  Great for a date or just out with a small group of friends.

The restaurant has nice bar and very nice ambience. But taste of food is worst. I went to their buffet on Thursday and got excited by large variety of choices. But when I start eating food I found it very poor quality and least tasty. I would not recommend their food . But if anyone wants nice ambience and a place to pass time and have some drinks then it is place to go.

We stopped by for dinner without reservations.  We were seated immediately even though most tables were filled.  Despite our server being very busy, service was prompt and efficient.  We enjoyed eating here years ago and our meal this night did not disappoint us.  There was a glitch in the computerized bill, which our waiter was unable to work around, however he did manage to get it promptly corrected.  We will definitely return.

Had an amazing meal at Penelope but more importantly the service was phenomenal. Out waitress Amirh, was so energetic and upbeat and made the entire dining experience totally amazing. She was bubbly but warm and welcoming, helpful and just the right amount of attentiveness. Can't wait to go back.
The food was super delicious and environment was fun with the red paint and checker pattern floor making it seem like a old school cafe. The only problem is seating was a little tight.

The restaurant is clean and pristine. The outdoor eating area has open airways into the restaurant, and is just as professional-looking as the interior, with a slightly different style. The outdoor chairs were comfortable, although there could've been more legroom under the tables. There were fire pits, umbrellas and a great view of Glastonbury Boulevard. The lobster bisque was delicious. The meat tasted fresh and juicy, and the broth was creamy and tasteful without being too rich. The pulled pork sandwich was excellent. It was served on a soft pretzel roll, which was very flavorful. The cole slaw within the sandwich and the pulled pork were delicious. I wish the portion was larger. I was angry that there were no prices listed for the cocktails. The cup of dirt had great gummy worms that were likably a little bit sour, but the pudding itself was not sweet or tasty. The service was excellent.

Peaches did me justice one Sunday afternoon after my cousins Graduation. Sat down pretty quickly party of 5 table was clean water was served and also the waiter introduced herself smiled and made us feel welcome. I ordered the French toast and Cheese Grits Eggs And Bacon (Turkey) since I was driving I couldn't order any cock tails in which I wanted cranberry juice was fine. The food to my surprise was great didn't like the grits too much it was not thick how I like it but no need to complain. Parking was good it was cool and quiet they have so many places to sit outside and imside and also at the bar .. Peaches you're amazing I appreciate your service I just want you to know AND YOU ARE IN BED STUY SALUTE !!!
The wait staff were amazing, but the food was the real star. Excellent crepes, pastas and desserts. Great atmosphere. Highly recommended

Delicious food, but be wary of the french-looking wild haired gentleman who sits behind the bar not serving drinks and looking aloof. In between soulful gazes into the distance, he occasionally does laps of the restaurant, looking suave and important, but don't be fooled. He is not your waiter, and will bluntly remind you of that if you mistakenly think he is because your waiter has disappeared for an extended period of time. At first glance, we assumed he was the host, but rejected that hypothesis after he greeted diners with casual shrugs as the entered the restaurant.
The best Chinese restaurants in Belleville. The food isn't too greasy. General Tso's chicken is not too spicy, seasoned just right. Service is quick, especially when picking up.
Such a beautiful restaurant to dine in. I absolutely loved the salmon avocado salad. The decor is really fitting and the ambience is great.

I have been coming here for literally 5 years, always loved the food and the service! They have always been quick and fresh most importantly! Parking gets a little busy when it's lunch time but a great rule to follow is of the place is not full then don't eat there!
Bison burger is the best meat option here! Chevapi? Not even close to the real thing :/

bar old fashioned (bulleit bourbon) was solid, well made. darby (rums + strawberry etc) was good, fresh. cucumbers tasted fresh, good seasoning. garbanzo beans popped. carrots delicious, interesting combination of chewy, sticky carrots, almond cake, and brown butter. matzoh balls horseradish mayo was good. matzoh balls were fine, light. bacon was bland, not smokey. "jewish lunchbox" gefilte fish was tasteless. shaken combination of barley, kimchi, and soft boiled egg was delicious. nice presentation. hanger steak prepared well. mad onions and sauce gave a steakhouse feel. banh mi poutine thrice-cooked fries were a good base. pork shoulder set it off. very good. action bronson.

Stopped by here on a random Monday night and had an awesome time. Tapas is awesome because you can try so many different kinds of foods, almost like snacking on several things at once until your hunger is satisfied. The tapas that stood out to me the most were the Top Sirloin Cap with Vinagrette (picture below) and chorizo al diablo! Lets not forget that full pitcher of delicious Sangria they gave me.  Awesome must-go place if you're ever in Ironbound. Parking wasn't hard to find, there's a strip mall a block away with a huge parking lot, just park it there. Here's the menus by the way: olewinetapasbar.com/menu…
I love the atmosphere in this friendly coffee shop. Perfect for visiting with a friend and having a private conversation since the seats are not too close together. Plus they make a great cappucino!

Great place to hang out. The staffs are very friendly. Love their iced red velvet latte. Best place to hang out during summer time. And it close to my fave park in Philly, Washington Square. Definitely will returning soon!
Salt and pepper..or at least salt. The margaritas were alright. Guacamole was forgettable. I'll give it another try sometime but I don't get the hype around this place.

This is exactly what this neighborhood needs. A quality food and drink establishment that is refined but somehow doesn't at all come off stuffy or overpriced. Everyone that worked there was lovely as well. They were chatting with everyone like neighbors, let us try things from the bar, and gave recommendations. I had the sweet potato wedge and deviled egg snacks and they were very, very good and appropriately priced. Thoughtful cocktail concoctions were also a steal at $7. Also a big plus that they serve food even during the week until 11pm and the bar stays open later. Will be back there for more goodness soon.

The happy hour is probably the best thing about this place but the guac specials the first time I visited sold me on everything. Great sangria, even better margaritas, fantastic tacos and everything else I tried. I would recommend coming on week days  before 6:30 to take advantage of their happy hour (the happiest hour I came across in Philly). Service is hit or miss but the food is always winning.
Tony's is the best!  Food and service are wonderful. Excellent recommendations for wine and dinner from Dimitri.
Hosted a birthday brunch there and both the food and service were great The place is small though so be prepared if you have a large party...it can be a little tight

Great breakfast, super service, super fresh food. Shakshuka is excellent but if you like it spicy ask for it spicy. The salad is cut into perfectly small pieces and dresses perfectly. The labene isn't particularly authentic but it is delicious all the same. Perfect place for a breakfast with friends.

So bummed. I really wanted to try the food here. My husband, our 2 girls and I were ready to chow down. We were told there was a wait, no problem! At most places you just saddle up to the bar and grab an app and some drinks while you wait. A couple at the bar gave up their seats for us - SO NICE - while we waited for a table. As we were deciding on drinks/apps, there was some whispering behind the bar about our little "situation" (still not sure what the problem was exactly)... and before we ordered, the hostess came over and told us in a very snotty tone that someone else was sitting there... umm yeah they were super nice and gave us their seats! She continued saying that we couldn't sit there. We could order but we needed to be in the waiting area (which was full). Didn't really get it but felt weird and uncomfortable so we gathered our kids and bailed. After we left, we thought maybe they didn't want kids in the bar area and that would've been understandable but it was not explained that way. I actually felt kicked out. Such a bummer. We walked to Flatbread instead where we were served with smiles and we spent lots of money and left a huge tip. Figure it out, people... It's called the service industry.
Got some chili sauce on my hand at some point. Proceeded to rub my nose. Queue terrible burning. Typing this with tears in my eyes and a runny nose. 10/10 would get again

I looked online to see where to get the best cheesecake in New York and and Junior's popped up several times. Did not disappoint at all. It's family owned so everything seems like it still matters. The food was great and the staff was very friendly. We ended up sitting at the bar so we could be seated right away and the bartender was very attentive and personable. Never tried any other cheesecake while in New York but I can say that it's probably the best I've had. Definitely gotta use their online delivery in the future.

My friend introduced me to this place because were both coffee lovers. As soon as I stepped into the shop, I already fell in love with the atmosphere. The overall setup is just right and there's really relaxing coffee shop music as well. The brick walls give the place a really vintage feel and the coffee is just amazing. The latte art is so cute! This is definitely somewhere id keep coming back to!!

I have been a regular at the Route 17 branch in Ramsey, and I loved everything I ever got there. This place is even closer to where I live, and is just as good. My wife and I went there last week, soon after it opened, and we had a 12-inch pie, with half her favorite toppings and half mine. We got the chicken wings, which have always been awesome, and they still are. If you like thin crust pizza, with a nicely browned crust, good sauce and cheese, and nice toppings available like prosciutto, this is where you need to go. There is a decent, albeit not huge selection of beers on tap, and I will be going back there very soon.

Lina, the server, already knows our order after coming here every sundays for lunch after mass. Their crispy calamari is by far the best I have tasted in princeton. And our most favorite dish Sesame Beef is heaven! Will always go back to this place. And the owners are really nice too.

Don't sleep on this gem. Lots of options including rice bowls, pasta, sandwiches, sushi,  and now hot pots too! I always go for the dinner combo, available any time. For $13 you get a salad with  awesome ginger dressing, a really delicious soy patty sandwich with cucumbers and Asian sauces, and a healthy sugar free smoothie! Great spot for groups as the portions are petty big and definitely shareable!

Just what the neighborhood needed! Great food and atmosphere, super friendly owners... It's become our go-to restaurant. We've eaten probably here probably a dozen times now and it's always consistently great. I like to keep it healthy, so my favorite dishes are the salmon and the warm goat cheese salad. I did indulge the other day in the chocolate mousse and it was absolutely fabulous. I also tasted my friend's French onion soup, which was outstanding.

I suppose it's rare to get this many sakes in a western restaurant and if that's you're reason for going (and you have money) this is a good place to sample some very good bottles. However if you're looking for a more rounded evening involving food, service and decor I would avoid. In that order, the good was mediocre at best. Any of the many Japanese/Korean restaurants around town will equal this at half the price. The ingredients weren't fresh and taste overall was of "frozen" and mushy. The service at the bar was very slow and innattentive despite us both asking in English and Japanese. The decor of the basement location still showed the concrete block walls and the accoutrements were just plastered on top. Considering the price I felt it was pretty low rent result. Changes in layout and menu could easily be made to bring this place in line with a true Japanese experience. I hope they will visit some top Tokyo places and emulate a little closer.

Service - Great service. Every time we have gone we get a table right away. Drinks come out fast and the food follows soon after. Atmosphere - Friday nights are the best. there are local bands with no cover charge. The pub atmosphere is warm and inviting and the outside seating is nice too. Food - The bangers and mash are so good. Pair it with a Guinness and I'm in heaven. The fish and chips are comforting and fried to perfection. The french fries are a good snack, but the sweet potato fries are by far  the best. Value - Good bargain. Large portions, tasty food, and live music? Yes, please.
Went for the first time today and definitely will not be the last. The sandwich I got, the Borgia, looked odd with the ingredients it had, but it was amazing. Friendly staff and decent prices.

If you are looking for the best slice of pie you've ever tasted, look no further. RK's coconut creme pie is by far the best dessert I could indulge in. Not to say the entrees aren't delicious (we also had the salad rolls, nachos, and pad thai...all fresh and amazing) but this pie. The thick chocolate crust and delicious fleshy coconut smothered in a fresh whipped cream...perfection!
delicious sushi at a great value.  my husband and i order take out from here all the time.  i really love the christmas roll.
Brunch was amazing. I will definitely visit this spot again. Customer service was great and it didn't take long to receive my food.

Great food. I would get the pork belly ...try to get the seat in the back outside if you can. You feel like you're dining in a garden. Indoors is nice too, a great place to take your date. Just make sure you make reservations as it can be busy. All the food here is pretty great. It's a great place for intimate group outings.
Excellent salads, soups and smoothies. Clean place and really friendly service. The mango, kale and banana with milk smoothie is great. Bubble tea is good but not too sweet..

I work in the area and have been here a bunch of times for lunch. Their pizza taste amazing and they always have a great selection to choose from. I recently tried their chicken cutlets and they were awesome too! I've tried other pizza places in the area and this place is hands down the best!
Good, but nothing amazing.  Nice interior, food was okay

i really loved this market. it was across from the marriott and all we had to do was walk over to eat breakfast, buy snacks, or just browse around and take everything in. for me the amish businesses were the most interesting because it's something unique to the location which i like. but you can get almost anything you like there, from beef jerky to cheesesteak to flavored vinegar/olive oil. go check it out!!!

We went the first day. You would never know it was the grand opening. The floor was filthy. The ketchup packets were covered in something sticky like honey. There was a roach on our table!  Staff was friendly but the food was really mediocre and expensive. I'm not a big fan of Cheeburger but it is far better...and clean!  Princeton does not need this restaurant. I predict it won't make it.

Sam's is always my first stop in town when I'm visiting my family. Caldwell has at least five or six options for bagel shops and this is by far the best one. Their bagels are fresh, flavorful, faultless... they get a full five stars. Lines can get a bit long but they move quickly and I cannot stress this enough....the bagels are worth it. Plus, you are bound to run into a friendly face or two in line. Favorite combinations: Everything "flagel" with sun-dried tomato cream cheese Cinnamon raisin bagel with plain cream cheese Pro-tip: If you're feeling hedonistic, make a drink from their machine that is half cappuccino and half hot chocolate. HEAVENLY.

I Got Porked At this Joint! Well, I am a vegetarian and saw that there was jerk seitan on the menu.  I ordered and waited for the food.  The waiter served a plate of brown chunks.  I ate one and it tasted funny.  Texture reminded me of meat.  So I asked my friend to try it.  We both confirmed that it was meat.  We looked up the menu on the wall and it was PORK!!!!  I nearly vomited in the restaurant!  How can anybody make such a mistake!  I do not eat meat let alone pork. Not only was my trust violated by their lack to attention but ate PORK!  I do not eat pork period for religious and cultural reasons.  This is the second time I ate in this restaurant. Once before when it was a sandwich shop, which I enjoyed and this very last time.  The owner waived our bill.  Overall, the other dishes we ordered were not memorable.  The festivals we ordered were served dry with no thought around dipping sauce, the rice and beans tasted like cardboard. Even the hot sauce did not help! The seitan was so disgusting it looked like dry dog food!! No garnish. Just a plate of dry brown burnt turd!   I don't get  it?  Why would a hipster chef make Caribbean food in a predominantly Caribbean nabe?  And make it as horrible as this? Yuck.  I have never yelped before but had to this time - even after a week.  I was traumatized!  I will say that the chef was apologetic and tried to offer us drinks and waived the bill.
The rudest stuff in NYC! The food is ok but every time I come here, I am watching how the servers running around at the edge of a nerve break down, ready to snap at the customers.
Love the relaxed friendly vibe and great food. Try the artichoke dip - much better than you might expect. Lamb burgers top notch. Music very retro and awesome. Listening to Elvis Costello as we type.

i hit up stix daily and am never disappointed in the product.  Tina in particular greets me with a fantastic smile and described me as "smelling rich."  which i appreciated.  Love this joint..order coffee stay for the good vibes. winner.

We had an amazing evening at this modern, organic, local and fresh looking restaurant! Jacob, our fabulous waiter couldn't have been more service minded and friendly! We had the jalapeño hummus and the veggie crisps as a starter- absolutely delicious and the organic chicken was also really tender and tasteful! The chocolate cake was really yummy!!

The staff was very welcoming and nice. Me and my boyfriend went with a groupon and it was great. We got sangria's, their Stix salad, quinoi balls with hummus and the tuna platter for two. It was all great and i love that they use organic produce. The tuna we got medium rare and it was great. The place itself looks clean and inviting.

Love this place. The food is unfailing good. I wish they played softer music. I could barely hear my date say something. Get the : -salmon -grouper -burger -butterbread Also, they have a great brunch.

It took me a few weeks to try it out after moving in the neighborhood. From outside, it did not look that great. And it seemed like a very dark space.
