However, one day, craving sushi, I decided to go in. Not only was the food delicious, but the waiter was really friendly and, totally unrelated, had a great style! Loved the shrimp katafi. Since that first time... I've probably tried most of everything. It's all really good.
Delicious! And super cool staff. Greaaaaat sake too!! So good!
My favorite Oyster place in the city.  They don't take reservations so sometimes it's a bit of a wait, but just head to a bar nearby, the wait is worth it!

I been going to Wafas since its inception around 2007. A lot has changed as its business transformed from a 4 seater take out restaurant to a 30 diner restaurant with 3 servers including the owner's sons. The food is excellent packed full of flavor but I do warn you if you are looking for Lamb or Chicken please do not order the Platter. The term Platter generally indicates large portion of the good stuff. However you will be disappointed because the same serving of Lamb or Chicken in the Platter is the same serving in the Sandwich. Keep in mind the Sandwich is $7-9 dollars whereas the Platter is $15-18. What you get for the extra 10 dollars is a overload of sides it can be pounds of rice or humas your choice. The amount of sides are overkill compared to 4 small cubes of Lamb or Chicken. If you really want Lamb or Chicken I suggest the sandwich . No need to pay extra 10 dollars for rice and humas . As a result you get three stars for portion. If you don't believe me order the Platter and see for your self. Recommend action: Serve more Lamb to balance the sides.

Very descent prices and excellent service, bread basket arrived at the table as son as we sat, get there early!!! space is very small, I had the eggs benedict and they were fantastic. boyfriend had the steak and eggs and he also loved it :)

AMAZING food! I ate here last night with my friend, who raved about his previous experiences here. I'm somewhat new to Spanish food (and COMPLETLY new to tapas), so I was nervous about trying something new. I wasn't disappointed! The calamari was stellar, and the tres leches cake was to die for! My only complaint: the service. Waiters walked by our table several times without so much as glancing at us, and our dinner ended up taking almost 3 hours due to the slow service! Nonetheless, I can't wait to come back!

I am so irate I still can't believe my experience. Last night while entertaining customers,  the waiter brought the check back to me and told me the tip wasn't enough! I tipped 18% on a poorly served dinner! I will never go back and caution anyone to beware of the "tip extortion". This is NEVER acceptable, and I question any owner who would hire a server like this.

Unpleasant experience. Waitress rushed us while ordering...I don't understand why she was in such a hurry because it took us 45 minutes to get our California and spicy tuna rolls! For better service, timing and overall tastier sushi we will stick to Daikichi from now on.

The most amazingly sweet and wholesome restaurant in all of NYC. The quaint atmosphere of the place makes you feel like you're at home with family and the food is unbelievably well-priced. Another perk is the BYOB policy with a great liquor/wine store across the street! P.s. Be sure to make reservations ahead of time as it is a very small restaurant :)

If you are a spicy seeker try the top level spicy wings. I reckon I am in the 90th percentile for spicy tolerance, but  these wings are seriously spicy. I was eating them at home, so after every two wings my dog came over to make sure I was ok (I could eat two then I had to wait five minutes in between wings). After four wings, I could feel the blood pulsing through my face and my teeth were tingling. After six I had to get up and walk around the kitchen. Eventually I sat down and concentrated on my breathing. To sum, if you REALLY LIKE SPICY and it has been too long since you have really had that wig pushed back, I recommend the wings top level hot, I promise it is hot.

Uncle Momo is definitely Uncle Nonooo!! - Food was reasonably tasty but service was horrible. The only "waiter" at the restaurant got our order mixed up, was rude, told us they ran out of water glasses, french fries, and the list goes on - The "waiter" complained to us about occupying too much "space" because we were there with a toddler - We ordered spinach pie and ended up getting a spinach salad and the "waiter" said we got our order mixed up and insisted he was right (bad customer service!!!) - We ordered a shish kabab sandwich which were supposed to come with fries (per the menu) but the "waiter" delivered a different order entirely. When we finally got the sandwich it was without fries because they were supposedly "super busy" before we got there. The fair guy with thick glasses who is presumably the owner proceeded to tell us that they could not make any more fries - We ordered the spinach pie which was served with a side order of plastic wire inside the pie

Awesome food, great service, and the environment is amazing! I got to hear some great jazz and had the pleasure of meeting the owner. He is very involved, friendly, and even got out there and jammed with the musicians. What a guy! And what a restaurant!
i like thier pizza but they have a extreamly unreasonabaly long line this means they have good food but they do  not the work force to put up with with it
If you're around and haven't been yet.... you're missing out!! Great Pizza and atmosphere. Cool backyard. Hell yeah!

There are a lot of people who have an answer for everything and those answers most likely aren't true. Not Scott. Scott is an expert in all things pizza as part of this fun hobby that he's turned into a great business. We learned a ton, ate awesome pizza and had a guide who knows his craft and loves what he does. We couldn't have asked for more. Our tour today was fantastic, and the next time we're in NYC, we will absolutely book another.
Nice and warm tiny bar.food and drinks are amazing.the french bartender always has good advices on the wine choice,very professional and friendly....love this place

Great food. Everything was fresh and delicious. I had the nachos which had freshly cut tomatoes, onions and jalapeños (which they also use to make their poco de gailo) it was amazing. After that I got the guacamole burger for my entree. Outstanding. Fresh guacamole, pico de gailo and cooked to perfection. I had to give it 5 stars. There's no doubt in my mind they deserved it.

In a city of thousands of Restaurants, Jacob's Pickles is one that you'll keep coming back to.   From great pickles, to incredible root beer, the best entrees, cheese grits, and amazing desserts it doesn't get any better.   Arrive hangry, because these portion sizes are craZy!   Personal favorite is the chicken bacon egg and cheese biscuit.  Vanilla biscuit pudding for dessert.

Have eaten here several times and find both food and service inconsistent. Management does not offer a senior discount, but that is probably because they are trying to attract a younger drinking crowd.. The first two pages of the menu list alcoholic beverages, very few food specials and prices higher than their competition. I would only go back for breakfast or lunch. This restaurant has had many name and owner changes over the years; I look for another change shortly

So disappointed with the management! Maybe once the restaurant got so famous with all the reviews, it has lost its touch with customer services at the same time! Food quality is degraded -I don't know- maybe I was wrong but the food here used to be better...much better. The staffs are so un-friendly that I was afraid to ask for anything! I'm sorry but man, I went to spend my money on food and I'm supposed to pay gratuity to show my appreciation for the service, right? Well, the service was really bad (-I think it has gone to worst for a while now) but I left them a 20% anyway which I shouldn't! Too late for that now. Oh, well... - No one came to ask if everything was alright at the table! - The empty water glasses were never filled! - The done-with food-plates and drink-glasses were never taken away! - The silverwares weren't as clean as they should have been! - Waiting time for the check was over 20 minutes! - No one came to ask if we wanted any desserts! - I asked our server for the check -she looked right at me and walked away! - Expecting the check from her and clearly not receiving it -I asked another server! The reply I got was "This is not my table!" - I walked up to the person who seemed to be in charge at the time, since she was walking around and seemed like she was checking if each and every customer were doing okay! She looked at me and told me that if I needed anything, I had to talk to my server! WTH!! Clearly, she was just walking around! I'm not going back there ever again! To me, it's just a waste of time and money! If things has changed and improved, let me know -I might give it another try! But not so soon ...

Unbelievable!  Have the Josh Panda crepe!  It's great to see a place that uses so much locally sourced food and at the same time tasteS so good. I came in hungry after a long bike ride in a thunderstorm while crossing the channel!  This ace was Mecca! You won't go away hungry!

I don't understand the negative reviews. Its not the best trattoria I've been too but i sure like it. The staff might not be too friendly but they're also not all that bad. I personally don't care to be greeted when i walk in a store/restaurant. I love their penne vodka which is what i usually get and they have great calzones.
Best pizza I've ever had, but damn. I wish it didn't cost as much.
The pizza is absolutely fresh and amazing how could one not try this place
Great addition to the neighborhood!!! Real class act and excellent too! Got to try and not drive by!!!!'

Rincon Criollo deserves nothing short of the 5 stars I've given it. I'm from South Florida and have been trying to fill the Cuban food void in my life since moving to NY a year ago. My roommate brought be to this place and I can honestly say it is the only Cuban that has satisfied my inner miamian! We ordered the arroz con pollo, which is made to order and takes about 45 mins to an hour, but was SO DELICIOUS, and even better the next day (even cold). There was enough for about 6 meals in that one order, so it was definitely worth the price. The staff was extremely friendly even if they weren't waiting on our specific table. They do an AWESOMELY hilarious dance and song if it's your birthday and the whole restaurant gets involved. It's such a cute place and AMAZING food.

What a hidden gem! Best Chinese in the Woodbridge area, generously portioned food and liquor pours,  and chill bartender .  Sit at the bar/lounge area.  It's small but there are so many flat screen TV's it's ridiculous.  Awesome place to watch multiple sports ie football, baseball.

This restaurant was good but I went of a Friday and that was a mistake. It was busy even at 1AM. The food was great but the service was a little rude and unwelcoming. I don't think I will be coming here again because I don't like to wait before I eat.

went on this dumpling crawl yesterday and this was the first place we started at and i must say it was the best place out of 7 we hit.  the chives and pork dumplings were the best of all the places we went.  i will be going back to this sort of hidden gem but i see the masses has found out about this place.  the line was out the door, onto the sidewalk and passed the next door's store front.   the second thing best about this place other than the food was the price.

The good: I like the organization of this place. Big windows and lots of sunlight...nice view out onto Fairmount and the penitentiary beyond. The snack options are good too. The PB&J linzer cookie, served cold, is excellent. The options are varied and all quite good. I haven't had any real meals here so I can't speak to the quality of the prepared food. The not-so-good: The chairs are small aluminum things that aren't very comfortable and some of the tables rock...which is an awful thing at a coffee shop (spills!). For whatever reason, this is a morning hot spot for parents with babies or toddlers. That's not necessarily a bad thing but something to consider if you want to do some quiet reading. The music can be very loud too, even in the morning, which again makes for some difficult concentration. The worst: Refills cost money, even on the drip coffee. They are cheaper than the first (a dollar, I seem to remember) but that is inexcusable for a place that claims to be fostering a sense of community. Finally, and worst of all, the coffee TASTES BAD. The drip coffee, espresso, and americanos are almost inedible when drank black. Final word: If you plan to carry out, I would strongly recommend going elsewhere. The sour-tasting coffee is not the reason to come here. If you just want a place to sit in the morning, I guess it's better than your sofa, because at least you're out of the house.

Great, Great BYOB in Fishtown!! We have eaten here 4 times now and will continue to come back.   Place is small, although they maybe opening some tables to the back.  Menu is limited, but each entry is great.   To me the best part is the cleanness and freshness of the Pho broth! There maybe other Pho restaurants in Philly but known with bettter broth!

I have been for breakfast here twice and both times I felt rushed and dismissed by the staff. Maybe because we were mums and not young hipsters? The staff weren't very friendly to us but then spent a long time talking to the guy sat next to us asking about his sneakers and taking photos of them. I may add the oats and granola were better than average but it's the service letting them down. Both occasions we went when it was quiet so this was not due to them being too busy. Shame really.
Love this place. The pizza is how pizza is supposed to be. The staff and management is always friendly and helpful. I come here every now and then when I have some spending cash.

This place is so close to my new place. However I gotta agree that the pizza here is mediocre at best. But pizza is like sex: even bad pizza is kind of good. And the guy acted like he didn't want to do the delivery when my friend asked for it. Won't ever go back there again.

Sushi meets burrito!  What a great combination.  I had the salmon roll and loved it.. going to try their new tuna roll next time I'm there.  It's a bit crowed because it just opened but they do a really good job at keeping the line moving.  Not really a place you can eat at, the sitting area is too tight with little room.

I love this place...everything in here is good. I've tried almost everything on that menu and I can't complain. I always have to order the mac and cheese. I think they shut down every day for about an hour or so and you can't order anything outside of the bar until their kitchen is open...but trust me It is worth the wait! I love the indoor patio area...it's a great place to sit and eat with friends. I recommend this restaurant 100%

One of the real hidden gems of the Philadelphia restaurant scene. I guess that's partly because the facade is small and sort of gets crowded up by the overflow of businesses on Market Street in Old City. Honestly, I don't care to go out in Old City, but I have made an exception for this place specifically, time and time again. It's reasonably-priced, homemade Italian food, the likes of which I have never quite experienced anywhere else. I've never had a dish there in probably a dozen visits, that I didn't love. The staff are extremely friendly and welcoming. They'll also give a complimentary glass of wine with dinner!

Before we begin, I must say that ramen is my favorite food. I spent two weeks in Japan surveying every ramen bar I came across, so my rating might seem a little strict. Let's start with the broth; I found the miso to have an overpowering ginger flavor that stole the show from the rest of the bowl. I also found their tonkotsu to be a little weak, but I prefer a very strong hakata-style broth with lots of fat. The chicken broth was satisfying, buy nothing to write home about. I noticed they had a wasbai style broth that I have yet to try and am very curious about. Their seasoned eggs are on par. The egg makes or breaks the experience for me so if there's a slight mistake with my yolk i am disappointed. Their chashu is tender and fatty, all in all a great bowl of soup, but again, I've had better. My quam is that the hike in price. You're not paying for better flavor instead you're buying the ambiance. If you're looking for some swanky cocktails and a done up establishment you're headed in the right direction. Their service is also amazing, I went through a gluten-free fad and they were more than happy to accommodate that by providing me with a side of rice instead of noodles. Their staff is always happy and friendly. Faves: Akamaru Modern, Shishito Peppers, Pork Buns

For approximately $15 not including tip and tax for a bowl of ramen, it better be pretty damn good.  In my opinion, Ippudo's ramen is just alright, of course, it is one of the better ramen places in New York.  The texture of the noodles is spot on, but the broth could use some help.  It is not as rich as I would like, lacks body, and has under-developed flavors.
everything raw all the time

Absolutely picture perfect. These three words describe my many experiences here at Salute. Excellent service. Excellent food. Great environment with a friendly owner who really appreciates his customers. A MUST GO!
Great place!! The food and the vibe is amazing!

Fantastic crabcakes to take home - several different varieties. Importantly, they even have a gluten-free version, which my husband really appreciates. Really good taste and always fresh. And various sauces, of which the horseradish one is my personal favorite. Then, 400 degrees and 15 minutes later, dinner's on the table. Wonderful.
A charming little place. Very spartan atmosphere, but delicious food, simply prepared and fresh. Very nice people also.

Very good food...but guys, seriously... the teenage rock so loud just offended our peaceful dinner between friends. But I just received a call from Sum 41 who are very happy to have at least one restaurant in the US who still support their awesomely melodic music. Thank you for them.

I used to love Dee's. They have so many great dairy free desserts that are delicious. However, I won't go back now. I had a cupcake decorating party so I ordered cupcakes. I did not want or know that the cupcakes would be predecorated. There were orange sprinkles. I needed this for a bachelorette party that was completely pink. Who uses orange sprinkles in July? I had to pay for my order and buy all new ones that were premade in the case, which was not the preferred cupcake choice. They were not accomodating. It was more important to get money than to have customer satisfaction.

I'm a concierge at a hotel and a Hell's Kitchen resident. I've recommended this place to so many of my clients and friends and after speaking to one of my chef pals felt like a little bacon fix. I've worked for the likes of Thomas Keller, so I know a thing or two about food. I ordered the grilled cheese as I had many times before. What makes this sandwich so special is the bread and the toasted bread and bacon combo with the tartness of the cheese meeting the sweetness of the bread . I love this sandwich and was craving it after work. What I got was a stale white bread sandwich , fatty bacon , and cheese. The cheese was melted but it looked like it went through a toaster oven with the bacon on top, some of the bacon came out undercooked . Definitely not the food I raved about since this place opened. Seriously disappointed. The soup was so so I basically could have had Campbell's soup chicken corn chowder and fared better, actually miss the tomato soup. Definitely changed my review of BarBacon... And any future clients I send over .
favorite pizza place in boonton. always has been. and they even deliver now. Give them a call, it will be worth it!

Came here simply to note that ordering Pepe's "half baked" pizza (the kitchen bakes it halfway so that you can bring it home and continue cooking it, thereby exponentially increasing how well it travels) is the best thing that has ever happened to takeout dining. Always a big, big fan of the classic cheese!

Great ambience the dark lighting gave a cozy feel but horrible for crappy camera phones. We didn't have to wait much. The food was good but I was disappointed. I discover them at the big Apple barbecue and the food was awesome. I guess I build up the experience in my head. However Sunday the brisket was charred on top and even though the meat was tender underneath that charred taste ruined the experience. Four dollars for a glass of cream soda masquerading as a pint. Appetizer was three tiny pieces of chicken. At the end of the day the food was good but the experience was disappointing. Oh yeah no parking so you gotta hunt for a spot. And if you're going to give this place a try I highly recommend you make a reservation because even on a Sunday it was crowded.

I love soup dumplings anywhere, and this was no exception. I'm also told by those more knowledgeable on the subject, that these were exceptionally good soup dumplings on account of the soup itself. Good enough for me. The eggplant in garlic sauce was good too.

I highly recommend Delaware and Hudson. The food and service were excellent. Every dish was imaginative and delightful. The service was solicitous and very friendly. The prix fixe 4-course seems like a lot of food when you review the menu -- there is such a nice variety. But everything is so fresh and prepared with light touch, yet very flavorful, that it's not a "heavy" meal. We took the remainder of our seared tuna entrees home to save room for dessert, which was also wonderful. Will be going back again soon!!

We must have ordered from an odd day, because the food was terrible.  The sushi had no flavor, and our to-go didn't even come with wasabi, soy sauce, ginger or chop sticks. We won't be ordering again.

Absolutely adore this place. We try to come early so it's not too crowded, because it does get very loud. The food is amazing - every single thing I've had here has been spine-tinglingly delicious: meatballs, italian meatloaf, wild musroom tagliatelle, gnocchi (OMG the gnocch!!!!), salads, fish, pizza... it's all delicious. They don't have a kid's menu or kid portions, so be aware. That said, my kids love the simple pizzas and they are definitely kid-friendly. The staff is always nice and attentive and the atmosphere is great. Probably my favorite place in town.

The moonshine itself wasnt amazing -- especially not when you're used to getting the legit stuff from WV *wink wink*.  But the atmosphere was good and even tho it was busy, the bartenders were all friendly, and quick to respond to drink requests.  Id definitely stop in again.
Excellent! Will definitely be back. Great atmosphere, wine, and food. Awesome service. I got the Ploughman's Platter and the Scallops. Hands down best scallops I've ever had in my life.

Their food is delicious but their service is lackluster especially when it comes to take out. I should know better to check my take out before I take it out the door. They've reconciled my order a few times but at this point, I'm just tired of calling them , explaining what I didn't get, bieng asked to go back for the completion of my order.  Examples: a)  guacamole (after stating and being charged for it and not getting it) b) dressing for my salads c) didn't add meat to an order where I've added meat. (don't get any smart ideas) Be consistent El Camino and maybe you can get the ranks of adding the Real.
They are awesome! I love their white sauce! But the HOT sauce... It's really too hot... It took me 2 hours to get rid of the hotness of the hotty!
Amazing great grub that won't hurt your tummy and it tickles your foodie fancy
great late night munchies. veggie option: falafel over rice (not vegan and may use chicken stock)
Went there with my wife and thought the food was amazing.  The vegetarian and vegan options were quite good.
Great beer selection, delicious pizza, fresh local salads... but the best part is the service. Thank you for making us feel welcome. This is the Burlington we love. 5 stars!
Excellent breakfast. Had the Penny sandwich. Great country style place in middle of NYC. Service was also excellent.  Will be back to try the pancakes.

Went here for a nice Saturday night dinner a couple of weeks ago. The ambience was superb. Very relaxing, loved the interior! Food was great - had the Tofu Pad Ped. Nice big pieces of tofu filled with great flavor. Medium spicy which was just the perfect heat and met my expectations. Service was great. Will be returning.
What a surprise this was I came for an Italian meal & found it had a wine bar aswell, I had carbonara with a nice bottle of red. The staff where great I will defiantly come bak when I'm in the area.

This place was the first time I ever had Chaat.  The owner and workers are very friendly and take the time to introduce you to what they offer which is different than anything else you'll find in Philly.  Definitely one of my favorite places to eat.  Thanks for the treat mood cafe!

I tried going to this 'bakery' on Bastille Day but it was closed (because it was on a Monday). But I went back this week and was pleasantly rewarded. I decided to have the sandwich du jour, which was brie on a baguette. It was just what a French sandwich should taste like, and I lived in France for several years, so I know. If only I could have had a ballon de rouge it would have been perfect.

We have brunch at  Cafe V a few times a month and have never been disappointed.  The staff has always been courteous and the food is delicious.  I would particularly recommend the strawberry shortcake pancakes if you happen to have a craving for sweets.  Additionally, the coffee (either hot or iced) is some of the best that I've had in the city.

Was visiting from out of town and found Mannino's here on Yelp. The reviews were right! This place if great! The owner and staff were super friendly and helpful and the food was better than expected! I highly recommend the wings! We also has the stuffed rigatoni and ravioli with vodka sauce which were all great! Thanks Mannino's!

Fantastic time at Toast! The omelet of the day had spinach, goat cheese and Capri tomatoes--Yum! Spritzers were fab and the perfect quencher for a warm day. I also had a bowl of fresh fruit and unlike some cafés the fruit was FRESH! It hadn't been in the fridge dying an icy death but perfect strawberries, blueberries, blackberries and banana. My kids (3 x 13y + 1(24y) 1 gal pal (13y)) ate everything on their plates and want to return. Above all the service was wonderful!
Check out my Blog for my review on this restaurant ! craftytaramarie.wordpres…
First time and we r hooked!!! This is now our favorite Thai joint. And we KNOW Thai!!! Mama the best and most gracious host. We r starting adoption papers!!! Thank u Mama!!!
I love love love this place, the people, the atmosphere, the food. It can be very touristy...but I never mind it. I love whenever I get the chance to come here!
I love this place! Very trendy , great ambiance , great drinks ,good food and the prices are great!! One of my fave spots in the east village!
It's how imagine heaven would be!
First time to NYC from Dallas and pleased to find this cool bar not far from my hotel. I knew I was in the right place when the bartender said she had SHINER!!!

I think they lost their chef or something because last night we were served one of the worst meals.  The artichoke in the Roasted Artichoke appetizer was totally inedible, as in they used parts that you can't eat.  The Sea Bass was cooked fine but covered in what seemed like grocery store guacamole and pureed salsa from a can.  The steak au poivre was incredibly chewy and it and the fries were swimming in a red wine sauce...the table next to us complained about their dish, and was offered a complementary drink that was never delivered.  For the price of these dishes you would expect more.

This little hole in the wall Is delicious and authentic Mexican food. The prices are moderate but the dishes are huge. The breakfast is delicious. Try the chorizo con huevos. You'll be full until dinner time. On the weekends she has Mexican tripe food called menudo and other yummy soups to help cure an amazing night out. Overall this is a place I recommend to other folks who ask me for an authentic Mexican restaurant

Great environment and atmosphere to watch any type of sporting event.. its pretty pricey but that comes with the experience of being in a sports heaven.. plus mike is a GREAT guy, whether youre a dolphin fan or patriot fan he wants to make you enjoy your time there; and  he always makes things fun.. there really is nothing in the area that is comparable to here.. My only knock is that the drinks are not free refills when you are spending a decent amount of money there on a meal and to watch a game

Hands down, one of the best sandwiches I have ever had.  The Cubano sandwich is everything a sandwich should be: salty, crunchy, rich, gooey, and flavorful.  I went here with my professor from Syracuse University and her son.  Best choice I made all day.  Unbelievably delicious.  You haven't lived until you have eaten this sandwich.  Absolutely dynamite, unforgettable.  Must go again.
I'm so happy that they finally have a storefront..one of the best arepa l've ever had!! Sooo good!!! Soo fulfilling!! I would definitely go back!!

I order to go today at the Tartinery, We took the fish soup, the artichoke hearts salad, the foie gras and the fig & blue cheese with country bread, and the corazon tea from bellocq... It was just fantastic !!!... And I came back for two other corazon later !!

We stumbled onto Lena's during a biking trip last weekend. This place is a real gem. It oozes visual charm from the inside out. Tastefully decorated with a charming, friendly staff. The food was a terrific payoff for the exterior trappings. We had pannini sandwiches that were delicious and plentiful. We also had a side of a quiona salad that was tasty and unusual. Happy to go back again!! Buon mangiare!

Been eating here since 1994. Homemade pizza is great and the catering is awesome. I always get tons of compliments on the food. Staff is always friendly and welcoming. (They make their own dough and sauce.)

I was very nervous about coming here with a group because the other reviews said it was small and cramped inside. I am very claustrophobic and hate teeny places. That being said, it was small but i still felt comfortable here. The food was absolutely excellent. I had the seafood paella. It was a great portion and very good. The octopus was the most succulent ever and I've had it everywhere. I also liked the drinks! Great sangria. The only reason why I didn't give it five stars is the service was okay - not bad but not excellent; the tables were close together and there was only one unisex bathroom for the whole restaurant. The food was worth it though!
Best eggrolls and wontons on the east coast. Love the steamed dumplings also. The only Chinese restaurant I go to. Literally amazing.

Stumbled upon this cafe while looking for NEW cafes actually for a job but instantly fell in LOVE with this place.. Really love this place due to the good atmosphere and amazing staff. ( their smiles and accents really just makes my day ) I work at a cafe in Chinatown towards LES and when I'm not working there, I'm here on my free days. I think that it's a great addition to the neighborhood! I hope nothing but great things!

Today was the first time I had a taste at Brooklyn Belly. The music was pumping and everyone seemed cool and relaxed very patiently waiting for their food. Everyone who stopped by had a smile and even a few dance steps. I had read the reviews and all were favorable. I had choices of fried shrimp, jerk chicken, conch fritters , I was on cloud nine. When it was my turn to get my food I did a two step out to the back seating area to enjoy my fried shrimp and jerk chicken. The batter on the shrimp was amazing and the jerk chicken was seasoned very nicely. This place is a must do.And when you do, I can guarantee that you will be back over and over, Amen !. You don't find this kind of vibe too often, so please don't sleep on it. And when you do check it out , let me know what you think !

We absolutely adore this restaurant!  It's perfect for Carroll Gardens - the food is amazing, the service is attentive without being intrusive and they love kids!  So far, everything we've tried on the menu has been outstanding. You can't go wrong with the scallops, burger and Tartes Flambees.  Also try the Croque Monsieur for Brunch - the most authentic in the neighborhood!  Jeremy and the rest of the staff are so welcoming. Considering how many new restaurants come and go with anonymous pasted-on, service and trendy food, La Cigogne really is a welcome mix of old-school service and amazing food and atmosphere.

Ended my last week with the visiting of this place -at first got huge open space for dealing with the parking. One of the amazing place though a bit simple before this never tried at here. Seemed a bit pricy from the other when first saw it for the ordering. As the first time before coming here knew a bit from the review done by others-ordered for their tacos that good really tasty. Also the meat here yummy -had only three tacos, meat and the sope------so delicious.

Excellent genuine Morroccan cuisine... Close to Seton Hall U and NJT station. .. Nice outdoor seating and schwarma snd babsgsnoush to die for!  Friends who like adventures would LOVE this place :-)  like traveling without leaving home :-)   AND because...BELLY DANCING :-)

I went to Jora last Wednesday and had a good time.  I had been walking past it pretty often on my way home, during the long, long time it took for them to open, so when I finally noticed they had open I couldn't wait to visit.  My expectation was moderate, as I know that sometimes food that is foreign to you may be a little shocking. My friend and I ordered the ceviche as a starter, and for our main courses I ordered the lamb shank and my friend ordered the skirt steak. Everything was delicious.  Truly, truly good.  The meat was so well seasoned and done perfectly.  The sides were very good too.  The people who served us were very, very polite and nice, and they didn't give me or my friend any looks or attitude because we didn't order drinks (we are not drinkers, and often we get a lot attitude from servers who think we are cheap or something, haha). The space was comfortable, spacious, and clean.  I am not a decoration snob, I barely pay attention to that, so won't comment too much on it.  I thought the ambiance was nice and relaxed. The menu is small, but interesting, and judging by how the meals we ordered were prepared, I would say they know how to cook there.  I liked the place.  I will bring my husband there soon, and I will probably push for my closest group of friends to have dinner there sometime.

PEACHES! Oh how I miss your delicious French toast eggs and turkey bacon with grits on the side with a tall cold glass of OJ!! Peaches has some of the best southern food in Brooklyn. Their wait staff is super friendly and posh they are well mannered and detail oriented. This is a PERFECT place for large groups and family dates that's the feel I get when I enter this environment. I only been here twice but each time the food the service and the CHECK was GREAT lol ....

Ordered the baked apple dessert and thought it was just awful.  Had it warmed since that was supposed to be preferred, but the dough was almost raw and overall it was just to sweet and mushy.  Not my thing!
Soooo good! Smells just like your grandmas kitchen. Ever since I tried their food, I eat there every week. Sticky wings are really good too.
Awesome!  So much history!  Excellent food and spirits!  No better bar in the world.
Had the Thyme Sage Roasted Chicken Breast w/ beets -- supa good.

I was staying at the motel across the street for work, when I stumbled across this little joint hidden in a gas station/liqour store.  I see there are several locations, but not being from here this was my first time to a jakes.  They have a good menu and daily specials.  The cheesesteak I got was good and filling...and the grilled cheese with ham was on point.  The staff behind the counter are good people and more than willing to accommodate.  The prices are legit, but the only downfall I can see is there is a seating area to slam your grub.  I'll definitely go back when in the area.

The owner and workers are really nice guys. I really like the place and the options. Still, they give you this look when you want to order some random item from the menu because they are just used to reheating whatever is up there. BUT DON'T BE AFRAID! Order anything and it'll be good. My only concerns:  The alfredo sauce if you order alfredo shrimp pizza or chicken alfredo pizza is VERY SALTY. It's so salty that it's hard to eat the pizza. IT's way oversalted. But overall, everything else I ate there was delicious.

Pizza is deliciously thin-crusted... crispy and packed with flavor.  they are huge so come hungry or share as an appetizer.  Everyone in my party loved their meal and I was told the veal milanese was special.  All good but you MUST have the pizza!

Five stars for service! I met up with some old friends here. We laughed (probably obnoxiously loud at times) and caught up for three hours. Even after we were the only table left, they didn't pressure us to leave or make us feel uncomfortable. Our waitress was fantastic and super accommodating, even taking pictures of us. She even commented on how jealous she was of how much fun we were having. I'm sure as we were leaving sometime after 10pm, they wanted to give a kick on the way out, but everyone wished us a good night. I would return for these reasons alone. Now for the food. Three stars. I really enjoyed the fresh bread basket with the dipping oil/spices. The spinach artichoke dip was tasty, but really greasy in the bottom of the bowl. Also, it had a strange smoky flavor that just didn't belong. The caesar salad was good with a nice strong caesar flavor dressing (not watery or bland like most I've encountered). The pizza was pretty good, but the underlying crust was a tad on the soggy side. I think they overdid the toppings and skimped on the cheese. Overall, it was a great night and when in the area again, I'll definitely return.

They need to decide if they want to be a bar or a restaurant.  They are too small to be both. At first we thought it was one of those casual, intimate Italian restaurants you hear about in NYC.   The bar only seats 5, but it sounded like they had almost 20 people sitting there.  The bar tender (looked like she was 16) was carrying on a conversation with one of their drunken patrons - both were cackling and shouting to the point where everyone was looking at them.  The music was loud, we could barely talk over it.  It could be a great place if they focused more on the restaurant side.  The food was hit and miss - the spinach ravioli were undercooked and chewy.  The cheese stuffed pasta was great.  We weren't offered drink refills, and the busboy was more attentive than our waitress (the loud teenaged looking bar tender)..  If they could provide a quiet refuge from the storm that is NYC they would do a lot better.
This place has authentic great home tasting food. I really enjoyed the cocunut cake, it was soft with right amount of moist in it.

My husband and I have lived in Maplewood for almost 19 years and have never been here. Now I know why: tired decor, crappy music and sub- par food (some of it) and service. My husband loved his chicken fajita, which came sizzling hot and fresh. My tacos were bland, messy and the last one had hot sauce spilled into it. I was unable to eat it. The waiter never checked on us; we had to ask someone else to get us the check, and when I asked to speak to a manager it took almost ten minutes for him to arrive. He was unapologetic and offered us nothing for our troubles. I can wait another 19 years before I eat there again.

Love, love, love Parc! It has a great French romantic, laid back open air atmosphere that is good for groups or couples or friends. My best friend and I visit whenever we are in town to catch up and have a wonderful meal together. We used to live in NYC and it reminds me of Pastis (but bigger) or an upscale French Roast. The restaurant itself is huge but reservations are a must because it can get crowded. I like the croque Monsieur. The trout was out of this world as well. They also give you a nice basket of French breads.  You can't go wrong here - it's a whole experience!
Extremely friendly service. Delicious soup, salad, sandwiches and other dishes. Highly recommend it!!!

Great baba ganoush. (however you spell that)  It's just a little place without much seating room and the line is kind of long but I guess that's a sign that it's good lol.  The bread pocket thingies they use are really good too. The portion I got was kind of small but I think I ordered the small one.  So the small one is small, get the big one if you're hungry.

This was my second experience at Rozzi's. I can strongly recommend this restaurant to anyone who loves burgers and traditional pub fare. My burger, topped with pulled pork and coleslaw, was fantastic (and MASSIVE!). Cooked perfectly and seasoned very well. My girlfriend ordered the assorted slider platter, which was also great. We had a hard time deciding which was the best (cheeseburger, pulled pork, chicken patty, and fish fillet)! We also had the chicken zingers appetizer. This was tasty as well. A great selection of Vermont craft beers and extremely well-made cocktails rounded out the menu. All in all, Rozzi's has proved to be a great little spot to grab quality food and drink. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Came here for a date. The atmosphere and decor was really nice. Really cute spot for a date. The ingredients seem fresh and apparently they get their veggies from the local farmers market. Oh, and did I mention it is BYOB?

Best spot I've tried for cheesesteaks easily. The food is really Philly authentic. Lots of meat sliced up and cooked to perfection and the Italian roll is perfect. I love the people who work here as they are very sincere. It gets packed quickly and the spot doesn't open too late but it's worth the trip and wait. Try it out.
The Collar, as I fondly refer to it, has a good drink selection, and tasty bar food. It's the perfect place to meet up with friends.

Service is really good. For the main dish I ordered the duck with some toasted peach sauce which is awesome and hearty. But my friend's crab pasta is too salty. Overall it's worth coming back for the duck.

I had had many trips to this restaurant growing up. My family used to go here all the time on occasion, and everything was great... fresh food, cooked perfectly, good service and it's always nice sitting by the window staring out to long island sound over lunch or dinner. I hadn't been back for quite a while, but tonight my father and I decided to stop in.Sad to say that my visit wasn't what I remembered or expected of this restaurant. To start with, the decor is SO overly dated.... and I am not one to be picky about this usually. If a restaurant wants to be unique and the decor is a little out there.... I usually let that go in my experiences... but to keep the same decor, upholstery and carpeting for 30 years is kind of gross.... as Gordon Ramsay once said on the subject, "that's a lot of farts." In general, it feels like a trip to grandma's house... very old fashioned. They out to think about getting rid of the carpet. I've always liked the booths, but they are a tad cramped together.... but at the very least they should be re upholstered. Next I would like to comment on their men's room..... absolutely hideous. .  floor was sticky and it smelled of urine.  You could actually audibly hear my shoes sticking to the floor as I was exiting the restroom, so much so that the greeter turned and looked. Finally, my comments on dinner. I was disappointed to say the least. I ordered the broiled fillet of sole, with cole slaw and a baked potato. I'd have to say that the freshest and best tasting thing was the slaw... nicely seasoned, moist and fresh tasting. Sadly, the sole was bland. It was overdone on the outside, like mush on the inside and it was sitting in a pool of oil. It along with the plate was piping hot when it came to the table.... and the plate had a dirty burnt rim around the edge of it.... two tell tale signs they're using microwaves. The potato was very dry and tough... so much so that I had to saw at it hard with my table knife to get the skin to separate..... All in all, I could do better at home.... as could anyone who can operate a stove. For the price of what you're paying versus what you receive, there is no real incentive to eating here. The service on the other hand was excellent. Our waitress was both professional and friendly, so no complaints there. I don't know if the owners and kitchen staff have just gotten lazy, or if the staff has just changed hands to non-passionate people... all I know is this was no the Jimmy's I grew up with, and I don't think I'll be going back.

We came here because we had a living social voucher, but i would definitely come back.   I had the quesadilla- which was so good! It's not an American quesadilla at all with just meat cheese and veggies but filled with all sorts of deliciousness- rice, beans, etc. It also came with fries. In addition to that we shared two papusas and flan. We also had three drinks and our bill was low  Plus I still had half my quesadilla to take home since it was very large. I also give them credit- it seems like they are reading the reviews because A) when I asked for water the server asked if I wanted tap or bottled for $1 B) spoke English to us, or at least enough to communicate back and forth ( but even if they didn't, the menu is in English- you can get by) and C) was very friendly and food came out quick.   Great place

If I could give 0 star, I would definitely do it!!! First of all, services is so slow there. You would receive your appetizer about half hour later after you order it! Second of all, the services are horrible. The staff barely speak English. Come on, if you chose to open a restaurant in NYC, go back to school to learn English then!!! Finally, if you don't speak Spanish, so don't expect to get your food quicker that the customers who speak Spanish there!!! Avoid that place!!!!!

You can't give zero stars but that would be my choice.  Currently seated in rear of an empty restaurant and the manager told my party of 7 that the only table available is the table where the flies outnumbered the customers.  Customer service fail.  I will ensure to tell the 300+ employees at my facility that you should only come here if you like flies and a rude manager.

Love love love Spice End!! Kati rolls are my cravings every other week. I am a vegetarian and my usual order is mix veggie/aloo paneer roll with lots and lots of WHITE sauce.guys that's the key ingredient.order whatever you want to but it's the sauce that does all the work. Thumbs up and their new mint lemonade are my alternate drinks for this summer!! The staff is good and so is their service. The only thing I can think of pointing out is their deliveries could b faster.and they cud hire more skilled drivers may be?! Veg biryani is to die for.They have this lunchbox special kind of thing going on in which you get one roll and some biryani, it's just perfect for you lunch where you don't want to fill yourself up with a whole biryani and roll so u get a little of both. I would definitely be one of their loyal customers and keep going till I am in Philly. Mango lassi!! To die for...way to go guys..keep serving the good food!

Had brunch with a girl friend.  Excited to try given all the hype and I love Element with same owner.  Thought it was just ok.  We got 6, 7 dishes to share - overall pretty good; presentation very nice but a bit heavy on the salt.  Service was good.  For this price, would expect more.  Perhaps dinner is different but overall it's decent but don't feel like it's great.

I have never had a bad meal at Baja's. It's worth the visit even if you just want salsa. Great salsa bar. All you can eat homemade chips. I get the pollo asada...it's perfect. The service is lighting fast and the servers are very nice. Worth a visit.

We just tried out this restaurant this evening and it gets only one star because the sauce is very bland on both the pizza and the eggplant parm. My 7 and 9 year olds had to add plenty of garlic powder, oregano, basil and pepper to make the pizza flavorful. I had to do the same with the eggplant. Unfortunately we won't return because I expect more taste for the price.

Tonight was the second time, in as many weeks, that my husband and I ventured out to the new Nolita Restaurant in East Hartford.  The food was DELICIOUS and fresh.  It was plated to appeal to the eye. as well as the palate.  The homemade pasta was beyond words and the salmon was Frrresh and wonderfully seasoned.   The only problem I had was that my martini was served in, get this, a bulbous red wine glass.  It took so much away from the martini experience.  All we got from the server was "lip service" via way of apology.  I know this might seem like a simple thing, but a martini by definition is served in a special glass.  Waiting for the drink to reach my lips was torture.  My second martini came in the appropriate glass.  Also, to add insult to injury, there was neither olive nor onion as a garnish.  I love olives with my martini.  The garden salad was fresh and the homemade dressing was flavorful; it had a nice balance of vinegar to sweetness ratio.  Our dessert was fresh cheesecake medallions with chocolate mouse medallions.  I thoroughly enjoyed the lightness and the distinctive flavors of the chocolate, the mango and the ricotta cheesecake.  My husband didn't care for the ricotta texture of the cheesecake.  Being from Brooklyn, he prefers a creamy  "NY style" cheesecake.   We have plans to return to Nolita this month with friends.  Hopefully the bar will have enough glasses in stock; perhaps I'll order another stye drink or bring my own glass.

We visited Nolita on July 19th for late afternoon dinner and thoroughly enjoyed the food and service. We had chicken picata and my partner tried a burger. The waiter was very friendly and warm and checked in with us regularly to make sure we thoroughly enjoyed the experience and we did. We enjoyed it so much we decided to book dinner for our small wedding reception of 7 people for the following Friday. Well, everyone raved -- from the pasta dishes to shrimp, scallops, appetizers and OMG the desserts. Just awesome. The manager came over and introduced herself as well to give us some history on how the restaurant started. The presentation of all dishes were amazing -- as the waiter put it very nicely when he said "you taste with eyes before you taste with your mouth" and how true it was. This was a wonderful experience....you will not be disappointed. Did I say the atmosphere is very pleasing to the eyes as well, if not, it is. This is a must try. You will definitely be back again and again.

Little pricey but the pizza was good. Also, there is a TV inside last time I remember so I don't know why it would say otherwise. I love this place and it is truly amazing! It is right next to AMC24 so you can eat, then walk on over for some movies. I had a blast last time I went. I do recommend order pizza with red sauce though because when I ordered a white sauce pizza it was really salty. I don't know what it was but perhaps it was just that one time. I don't know.
Was a little worried that this would be to she-she for me - but the food was fantastic!  Best BLT i have ever had and the Service was great

Service was great! Very nice. They charged my iPhone for me. The pictures should do the talking. I had the "beef." It was a pretty hanger steak. They didn't ask how I wanted it which I thought was strange. I tasted the pork. Very tasty. I had the green bean salad. Pretty good when you ate all the bits. Had a lot of the desserts and the cheese platter.

Recently started working in the area and had lunch there.  Have to say Big Juicy tasty hamburger and fries!  Other lunches looked really good.  Will be back for more!  Service was extremely pleasant and on point.

A jewel on the upper west side! The menu offers an incredible amount of diversity for a Mediterranean restaurant. From vegetarian friendly dishes to decadent seafood pasta and a sensational filet mignon -- there is really something for everyone. Great staff as well! Our waiter, Jake, was very attentive and refreshingly familiar with every item on both the food and wine menu. He suggested the most wonderful French Syrah with my entree. Also, the bartender introduced us to a sensational white wine - I highly recommend the Gruner Veltiner. Overall - great restaurant, would highly recommend.
Great experience from start to finish. Elegant seafood pasta dish complemented by good wine and completed with inventive desert. High standards of service. Would definitely recommend.

Bill's is your basic breakfast and lunch items at a cheap price.  Contrary to what a few yelpers have said, it IS clean and the food is prepared in front of you.  The salad items are displayed and are always fresh and clean.  You won't get a gourmet lunch here and there's not a lot of sit-down space, but that's not what Bill's is about.  It can get crazy busy around lunch time with lunch take-outs, but that's because everyone in the area knows it's reliable, well prepared, no-surprise basics.

You call this dinner?!   I ordered the crispy tofu and my wife ordered the curry. Both came out and were ridiculously small portions! My wife's entree was literally a bowl of coconut milk with ONE Jumbo shrimp. I had three little pieces of tofu with some sprouts. Really?! For $16, I can't get a few more sir?! Plus, they charged $4 for a little bowl of rice! That's absurd. Sure, the place has good ambiance and the service was great, but we won't go back to a place where you spent $50 and then had to go out for pizza afterwards.

This place is always ridiculous regardless of the time of day (unless it's closing time). Even for the high throughput of chipotle, this location sags big time. They're often also out of ingredients (like tortillas), and aren't the most friendly. However, it's chipotle and is a delicious stop-by meal.

Stowes was packed and my wife and I were pressed for time so we figured why not try Turks, its been there for years so it's gotta be good no? well... NO. It was no good. First you'll notice it is dated, not only dated but it was dirty. thick layer of dust on the ledge next to our table.  I ordered a hot lobster roll and my wife ordered the fried shrimp platter with onion rings. For the price, youre better off going to stowes, its better and equal if not less expensive. Turks lobster roll was nothing but shredded lobster, the type you get in a can. There was not one decent chunk of lobster meat there. for $13.  It was certainly not fresh lobster meat.   My wife's fried shrimp had the pre-frozen texture to it. Fresh fried shrimp is tender and has a soft yet firm consistency. This was freezer burned shrimp meat that was over fried and dry. I don't understand how this place is getting any reviews more than 1 star. Maybe they have good hot dogs and fries but I wouldnt waste a penny of my money on seafood if thats what youre going for. try Stowes. you won't be disappointed.

You know when someone who is really high puts their heart and soul into preparing your taco... if you don't, go to shifty's. While it may take a while to get your food and you may be asked to repeat your order a few times it is well worth the wait. Plus they just added a "dope" new deck in the back. Occasionally they run out of ingredients, otherwise this would be a 5 star.

I used to live down the street from this place and I always wanted to compliment the owner and chef for having the best sushi rolls in central NJ.  If I remember correctly i think it was called the godzilla roll and it was basically a rainbow roll but with lobster inside and an eel sauce on top.  It was heavenly and it would be a generous portion. I would say it was by far the best roll and dish I ever had in my entire life.  Too bad I am living out of state.   I look forward to the day I will be re-united with this roll again.  It's on my bucket list.   May this roll live on and prosper so that new generations can enjoy sushi for many years to come.  God bless.
Definitely get the guacamole nachos as an appetizer! It was a very authentic Mexican restaurant and was a hidden gem.
Delicious pizza that has amazing tasting sauce and fresh cheese.  It's a bit of a tourist attraction, but in my opinion it's a much better pizza for tourists than the new Grimaldi's in Brooklyn.

City Tap House rescued my Friday Happy Hour. I had made the mistake of going to another bar around the corner, but after a round and horrible service I came running here. I was a little upset that my go to beer on tap was out but with such an extensive beer list I had no problem finding something else to drink. The service was wonderful and my flatbread pizza came out hot and fast. I will be coming back here more often.
Best  pizza in the country
Great lunch buffet, attentive service, and they're always very accommodating with splitting the check.
Best Pizza I've had in Bay Ridge!!  We had a vodka pie that was amazing!!!! As well as a great sausage and onion.  Great staff. Will be back VERY soon!!

Honestly, I don't understand all the hype about this place. We went there around 2pm, so there wasn't that much variety of donuts, which I understand. We got one of each kind of donut that was left(4 donuts), and out of all of them, only one was good(ish). The donuts are soft on the inside like mushy cake, not like how most donuts taste like. The fried chicken was nothing special, either. We got the honey soy glazed, buttermilk ranch, and z'atar flavors, and while the chicken on the inside was quite tender, and the outside was crunchy, the flavoring was just off and fake-tasting. Someone in our group even said that Popeyes chicken tastes better. My expectations for this place were pretty high, considering all of the good reviews, and this place did not at all meet my expectations.

This place is great. Food is great. Best French onion soup, and Just the best service ever!!!!!!!!!! .  Nice place for a drink and eat. The wife and I will be back any time in jersey . There open for good late nite spot.  Everyone there make it feel like there good friends

The food looks good. We never triied it. Because the service wAs so unbeliavnly shitty that we left before ordering. 1. When a customer wants to use the restroom a smart thing would be for the 4 waitstaff gossiping outside of it to get the hellout of the way and shut up so the customer can actually get in. 2. Menues are good to have sometime within the first few minutes of seating without the customer having to wait or ask for them. 3. Seating. Dont point dissmissivly a table around the corner. Show the customer where it is and be efffing polite about it. 4. Be polite, be polite, be polite and stop gossiping and trying to look all hipsterish and cool. 5. Just get a clue as to what service is. It involves being friendly, attentive, helpful and to be all of that when the customer arrives. What a joke of a place. It is often packed, the food looks great, but all of the staff we encounterd were dismissivel rude, obnoxious brats. Worst service ever.

I met some friends here on my last visit to New York and I was pleasantly surprised.  I can be a bit picky when it comes to Italian food but this place was amazing.  The decor was beautiful in a warm and elegant way without being stark or pretentious.  The server was friendly and professional and helped me pick out the perfect wine to go with my meal.  The food was delicious and it was an all around great experience.  The hotel it's in,The Greenwich, looks lovely as well.  Can't wait for my next visit.  Still thinking about my meal.
Order the cheese pizza, only the cheese and nothing else. Keep it simple and you won't be disappointed.

In the desert that is EWR airport, this place is a good option unless you want to go to diner land Pros: Oysters / Fish and Chips were good, service was excellent Cons: Overpriced / Fruit flies in your beer is not sexy
Excellent Place! Great Great FOOD! The Bartender last night he was awesome! Great drinks!!!!!! Home Bar in Center City you will forget you are in Center City. A++++++

Like so many, Ricalton's downstairs Snug tries to look like an Irish pub, but doesn't have much of anything to do with Irish food. We tried a drink off their menu, the strawberry basil margarita. It had one too many ingredients and tasted bitter. As an appetizer, we had mediocre Jalapeno Chicken Bites sitting in a strange buttermilk sauce. They tasted just like you'd expect fried bacon chicken bites to taste from a pub. For dinner we split the Guinness Short Rib. This made the meal. The braised cut, mashed potatoes, and vegetables were all cooked perfectly. Combining the sub-par drink, average appetizer and ambiance, above average dinner, high-price, friendly but novice staff and you end up humdrum. Next time we'll try the ambiance upstairs.
Mediocre food and terrible service - 40 minutes for a simple lunch order, one item didn't come, and another was wrong. Do not eat here.

Went for lunch, the food was amazing. I had the red velvet waffles with fried chicken and I was speechless it was sooo good, the waiter was truly sweet. The atmosphere was wonderful, I will be returning really soon.
Again the food was amazing!!! I truly enjoy every meal I have had and tasted :) I'm looking forward to the next time... Birthday dinner with the family!

This place is great! Yeah, there's good food for a good value, but the decor and service especially were top-notch. From start to finish, the well-dressed waitstaff was super attentive and accommodating... When they didn't have exactly what we wanted on their menu, they offered to custom make a dish for us! We sat in the enclosed garden patio in the back and it was the perfect atmosphere for our dinner (I imagine it would be great for events too)...as rustic as it gets in Montclair! The restaurant was very spacious with ample seating, but pretty empty during our visit (I guess this place is new), but I hope more people discover La Cucina because I'd love it to stick around. Highly recommend!

This place is great!  The UES is really stepping up its game in the restaurant category.  Drunken Monkey is definitely at the top of the list.  Excellent food and really nice for large parties (I went recently for a birthday party).  You have to try the crispy okra and the punch bowl.

First off, wife and I are picky... like VERY picky, we've been spoiled when it comes to food and are very critical.  We own a restaurant and can appreciate good food. First and foremost if you are looking for AMAZING LOBSTER ROLLS... THIS IS THE PLACE! I do not know the owner, this is a completely unbiased review based on our experience there. Stowes lobster roll is amazing, we went there for the first time a this summer and we both ordered lobster rolls.  The lobster roll was jam packed with fresh lobster meat. This wasn't the frozen canned stuff you get at restaurant depot.  Nice big chunks for a very fair price. We were so impressed with the lobster roll my wife and I decided to order a fried seafood platter with scallops, shrimp and onion rings. The scallops were fried to perfection, tender and juicy and very flavorful, the shrimp was again very tender and fresh. You can tell when seafood is fresh, the consistency is very different from previously frozen seafood. I cannot say enough about this place, we have since been back about 4 times this summer. This is the only place in west haven for seafood. Take it from two discerning palettes.
Omg delicious! Others do not compare. I ordered two months but couldn't remember the name. So happy I found it again finally. Quality food!!

Delicious and refreshing dining. And as a food lover struggling to adjust to living with celiac disease, I highly appreciate their diligence and range of gluten free options... Salads, entrees and even dessert.

This place is a little too trendy = overhyped for me. By New York standards, it's not expensive, but don't expect to find value here. Skip the cocktails - they tend to be watered down and it's just clear the mason jar is too large a vehicle in which to make a quality, well-balanced drink. My watermelon gimlet was a particularly offensive mix of jolly-rancher meets formaldehyde preservative. Crispy pig ears sounded more exciting than they were - the heavy handedness of the buffalo sauce (am I eating wings?) could not even be saved by the crisp pickled cabbage. The bone marrow was quite good, but the cream sauce on top was too much for such an already rich dish and hid some of the natural and more subtle joys of the underlying marrow. The goat neck was quite good as well - perfectly paired with coconut rice. But at $34, the flavors left something to be desired as it seemed on further thought it was not something I couldn't concoct with my slow cooker and a visit to a Chinatown butcher. When the whole bill showed up just shy of $100 - my wallet felt a bit too empty and my stomach a bit too heavy for what I got.

My wife and I used to frequent this place when it first opened a few years ago, it has since switched hands and the food has gone down hill. It is one of the few places to get certain traditional chinese dishes (i wouldnt come here for their chicken and broccoli or general tso's). There service was never amazing, you generally get one filling of water and have to hunt down a waiter for more, it is generally a little slow but thats fine as the food was great. the last few times my wife and i have gone have been horrendous. We were craving the clay pot fish pot and the pork with scallions. Well we got more than we bargained for when the pork with scallions came out with a pubic hair. YES A PUBIC HAIR! As soon as the waitress put the dish down on the table and turned her back, we immediately called her back and pointed out the hair. The manager was RUDE and very unapologetic. I'm sorry but i was looking forward to this dish, so NO i did NOT plant a pubic hair on the dish. The manager was rude and pretty much insinuated that we planted the hair because it was "not there when the waitress brought it out".  How would the manager know? the waitress brought it out not the manager. We weren't born yesterday figuring they would just take the pube out and present us with the same dish -- we ended up asking for something else.   Needless to say, we are done. We can get past the slow service because thats also how it is in china town in new york (flushing -- wo hop 2), the unhygenic staff is too much for us to bear.
Hands down best chicken and waffles I've ever had!!!! Amazing! Went during happy hour and got a free beer with my meal. Can't wait to go back!

I am stunned by the comment below. They have to be talking about another restaurant... I am so upset by this review that I wish I had pictures of this beautiful & meticulously clean restaurant, you can be sure that the next time I am there I will be taking pictures and posting them, P.S... And as far as the food, it doesn't get any more authentic... It's exactly like my parents and grandparents, possibly better!

Could not wait to post a review. Wonderful dinning experience. The food was delicious and the service was exceptional. The level of care taken to prepare everything from scratch and traditionally, was shown in everything we ordered. The homemade Italian Gravy, which isn't done in any other Italian Restaurant, was as good as my Grandmothers. Portions were large and plentiful and prices were extremely reasonable for the quantity and quality. We were waited on "Hand and Foot" and greeted by the owner. This family owned business really makes their guests feel like family. I was delighted to find out that I was able to purchase their Italian Gravy and Marinara, this really topped off our evening. If you want classic Italian this is the place to go!
If you like meat, this is the right place for you.
Wow, what a deal. The buffet is clean and orderly and the lines at lunch go fast. Pretty good Korean staples and a wide assortment of both takeaway and eat-in options.

Barbuto has a great atmosphere and it's perfect for a warm evening since the front of the restaurant opens up and it feels like you are dining alfresco but it is VERY noisy.  The service wasn't very good.  Our waiter was lovely but wasn't around very often. We tried to order starters while waiting for a member of our party and we were told that the chef likes to receive complete orders so we could have the Salumi but nothing else until we were ready to order dinner.  The Salumi was good but not very large. We had: the eggplant bruschetta, kale salad and squid salad to start.  The winner was hands-down the bruschetta.  It was really fantastic. Everyone also loved the kale salad but I found it a bit too salty (I'd say the saltiness was an arching theme to the meal and I LOVE salt).  The squid was very good but a little small. We had the gnocchi and the Bolognese.  The Bolognese was the standout of the evening.  It was really delicious.  The gnocchi were fine but I thought they were just too salty. We ordered the steak, lamb, chicken and swordfish.  We all liked the steak and most of the table liked the chicken.  The chicken was very good but I didn't care for the salsa verde at all.  One of my dining companions said she has eaten comparable birds at Pio Pio.  The swordfish was good but a little small.  The lamb was okay. I ordered it medium-rare and had to send it back to the kitchen because it was over-cooked (I have actually never done that before).  The peppers and onions that came with the lamb were excellent. The fried potatoes were another highlight of the meal.  We also had the fagioli which were very good. We had the chocolate pudding for dessert which was delicious and we also had the blueberry torte with honey ice cream which was phenomenal.  We ordered 2 bottles of wine and with tip it came to $100 per/person. We had a very nice evening but I probably wouldn't return.
We LOVE this restaurant! We eat here at least once a month. The staff, the atmosphere, and the food are phenomenal! We are never disappointed when we come here.

I like to go to j's because the food is fresh and I feel like I am at the beach without driving there.  It is casual and friendly.  I like the new bar and I have never been disappointed with my meal.  The fresh seafood market is great too.
They have amazing food, burgers are to die for! The Owner is a great man and has gone a great job! The wait sometimes is a little crazy but well worth it! Highly recommended!

Delicious!!!!!! Perfect night out with the husband and baby. Amazing wine, appetizers and pizza. Waitstaff rocked and accommodated us with our baby. Appetizers hit the spot and the pizza was amazing. Had the broccoli sautéed in garlic with olive oil to compliment the pizza and it was the perfect addition.

I've been a fairly regular attendee of Lucky Lou's since my girlfriend introduced me to the restaurant two summers ago while walking through Old Wethersfield.  Ever since the place has delivered nothing but the best service, the highest quality food, and a wonderful experience.  I have been there at all hours of the day, and have never been disappointed. However, I visited this August evening and found something even more enjoyable.  After being seated by one of the higher-ups on the food chain (forgive the restaurant pun) in a busy section of the beautiful patio, my girlfriend and were already pleased with our night.  However, we had a self-admittedly new employee as a waitress.   Having been in the customer service industry since 16 myself, I never would have guessed that she was an even relatively recent hire, and she did not fail to deliver the same service I have come to expect of the establishment.  Disappointingly, we were only in to get drinks tonight, but where most other waitresses would snub us, with the occasional visit and meager expectations, she was back consistently to check on us.  After pleasant intermittent conversation with her for over an hour, I realized that I would never find such attentive or knowledgeable service with anybody else.  Another server even popped in to check to make sure we weren't 'bothered' or previously aquatinted with the lovely young lady.  I took her name down and joined Yelp simply so that I could let the world know that Bella R. is my new favorite server at my lately favorite haunt.  She was sincere, caring and extremely intelligent.  I haven't felt so privileged or deserving (outside of direct bar seating anywhere else, Lucky Lou's included) in my life.  I will be returning tomorrow for lunch simply due to her candid and delightful nature.  Anybody who has the pleasure of being seated in her section(s) should consider themselves blessed to have had such luck.  Thank you for the wonderful evening, Bella and Lucky Lou's.  I look forward to returning in the near (and distant) future.

Absolutely love this restaurant! This was our first time eating at Parker & Quinn. We let our server (nice looking guy with a mustache) be the guide, and it was definitely the right decision. The food there was SO good... We had grilled octopus and steak tartar for the appetizer and hanger steak and scallops for the main course. Everything was delicious! Service was extremely friendly and accommodating, and the guy who brought us food was super nice too. Definitely recommend.

I had an outstanding dinner with a friend.  Outstanding in all respects. The flavored of my dishes were very interesting. Among the best I have tasted in a long time.  We had a 1996 white burgundy which was in outstanding condition. For a great meal with outstanding wine choices I highly recommend Bouley. Even   Better than I had remembered..

I don't know why people are giving bad reviews the food is pretty good! The mutton Sukha was really spicy and the vanjaram fish fry was a must have for spicy eaters. My favorite dish would have to be the chicken biryiani. My only complaint would have to be    that it is really crowded and loud and not really good to hear people yelling while you eat. Other than that it was good food if you love spicy but would like to consider takeout

Don't spend 80 dollars on a quinoa mess that tastes like a poisonous solidified potion called "salmon" and a meager two fish tacos in an unappetizing bowl. It was an excruciating explosion of cheap olive oil on my palate. To make things worse, the service was so bad that it made we wonder if the waiter was venting his failure as a Broadway actor on us. Andy Warhol would have turned in his grave. I wish this place didn't act as a diner and acknowledged its status as a victim of gentrification.

The worst service and disrespectful staff. We (african american's) walked in last night asked if they were closing and serving food. Bartender said no but the lady who was then locking up the windows said yes and we aren't serving food. I said well why would you say yes the lady just looked angry. When we walked out upset I calmly expressed my frustration and she said she didn't care if we came back ever. I replied, "Not an issue we won't be back." We are three business owners who understand that one person represents thousands. I hope they close down and an appreciative restaurant opens. We highly recommend Nick's across the street. We had their crushed bacon burger and curly cheese fries and then left there and went to Infusion Lounge. Nice spot and has the best hookahs we have ever had in the city.

New Moon is a good place to cozy up and get to work, and many students in the area do just that. For their free wifi and spacious seating, it is pretty good. The last time I went there, I waited at least half an hour for a sandwich midday when the lines were down. And employee even painstakingly made a (his?) sandwich directly in front of me without acknowledging me at all. When mine was finally made, they gave it to the wrong person. I'm usually not this picky about places, as I understand how tiring it can be to work in the food service industry, but the inadequate service here left a bad taste in my mouth. Not to mention the grilled vegetable sandwich really wasn't anything special.
Yummy! Cheap! Nice guys!
Food was good and the service was great, but the atmosphere is not very appealing. It's a place to grab a quick bite, not sit down and enjoy.

I thought I would stop by for a glass of wine and some appetizers before seeing Shakespeare in the Park, but I stayed for three hours eating delicious Mediterranean cuisine and sampling an excellent selection of wines! The bar has great ambiance because of its staff. The owner is sweet and the bartenders knew their products. The owner put interesting and delicious twists on traditional Mediterranean snacks. The eggplant crostini, hummus, calamari, and bowl of chickpeas were tasty, and the lamb chops with cauliflower puree was incredible.  I look forward to going back again.

Had a lovely lunch at Riverpark today.  My husband and I had the restaurant week menu which is full of options. My husband had the salmon for appetizer (absolutely delicious), the Berkshire pork chop for entree, super juicy and tender and flavor was perfect.  He ended with the basil cream puff, which was delicious as well.  I had the corn salad panna cotta for appetizer, which had a beautiful presentation and very refreshing taste.  For entree, I got the lamb chop and sausage, which I thought the flavor was a bit to strong for me.  The portion was quite small, and although I didn't mind that, it seems like there is nothing on the plate to balance out the strong taste of the lamb.  Everything else on the plate was part of the sauce, so equally salty.  If I knew the entree would be like that, I would order a side of mash potatoes or veggie to balance it out.  But overall, the flavor was good, just a bit too heavy by itself.  For dessert, I got the raspberry cobbler.  I enjoyed the ice cream that was pair with the cobbler more.  My husband did like it cuz he is more of a heavy dessert type of person.  I do think that all three of my husband's choices were better than mine.  Perhaps if I ordered what he did, I would be more satisfied.  Overall, I think Riverpark is a fine restaurant, and they always put a lot of thoughts and effort into each dish.

This place has the three qualities any girl is looking for in a lunchtime hotspot. Beautiful ambiance, great location and amazing chicken!  The service was helpful, fast, and friendly. The octopus, shrimp, and calamari were nothing special so I recommend the Saltado over the Mixto because there is more fish in that dish.
