Well, well well!  There is now an eatery in the area that is hitting the mark when it comes to taste, gluten free options and overall experience!  Our first visit was wonderful and exceeded all our expectations. We ordered the spring rolls, karma burger and sweet potato quesadilla.  The food was light and so tasty.  We ate on the deck with the sounds of the river in the background!   Highly recommend this place.  We look forward to our next Pingala meal!

Went for an early dinner on a Wednesday around 5 pm. Three of us ordered the all you can eat rodizio. They only had a few tables occupied at the time. They were quick to seat us and take our order. However once we ordered, it took awhile before we got served. For the first 10 minutes the food was nonstop to the point where my plate was almost over flowing. I couldn't keep up with their pace. However after the first 10 minutes, the servers never came back. I was not hungry, but could definitely eat more. After sitting there for another 30 minutes without being served, one of the waiters reluctantly came over to ask if we wanted more. At which point we only got 1 more serving. They definitely do not serve you until you say stop. They stop whenever they want. In addition, their food is super salty. Couldn't really tell what meat I was eating. Everything just taste like salt. Overall, I was not impressed.

Went on a Saturday and was sat immediately.  Then waited 20 minutes and nothing.  No one even took our drink order. Maybe we'll be back when they get their act together in a few months.  10 am on a Saturday,  waiting 20 minutes at a table just to even get coffee ordered is inexcusable.

What happened to Buona?? The pizza at this place is absolutely terrible! The woman behind the counter uses her bare hands to put the slices in the oven to reheat them after I'd just seen her handle money from someone else. That's a health violation! I used to work in the food industry and that's a big no no...and simple common sense to wash your hands after handling money. On top of that the slices looked like they had put extra cheese on them to make them look fresher, which they weren't! After taking a couple of bites I got up and threw the slices in the garbage. The slices must have been from the day before because there was no taste, they were soggy, and dripping with grease from the extra cheese they used to save money by not making a FRESH pie once in a while! Won't be back! Avoid!

The owners of this restaurant are horrific people who mistreat their patrons. I have had several encounters with them where they have been completely disrespectful and their behavior has been intolerable. The food is mediocre at best and the sanitation is questionable. The quaint beautiful neighborhood of Soho deserves a better restaurant where the owners don't accost the members of the neighborhood who live close by. I can only hope that they get shut down and that the space is replaced with a  restaurant that the neighborhood enjoys.

The food was so delicious, authentic, fresh, and mouth watering. I loveeee Italian food. There was a very well fed looking gentleman just devouring his pasta with an honest expression of happiness on his face. The portions were large, though I regret getting the veal franchese. I'll definitely go back here the next time I'm in Little Italy.

just moved here from California, been here twice and everything is amazing. the pepperoni pizza is possibly the best i have ever had and the whipped ricotta is a must have. service and environment was excellent both times. will definately be coming back!

Very long wait for table, but busy tonight with Billy Joel and other concerts in town. We are 8 people; when finally seated, some dinners were brought out before all the appetizers. My son's dinner (only a sandwich) was forgotten. We asked when the last entrees were served and were told it is coming right up. That was 35 minutes ago-we just got the bill, but still no sandwich for my son! At least we weren't charged for it, but how could they charge for something they forgot? TWICE?

Just received our order, after we found out that they had forgot part of order I called them back and was told by the girl on the phone that it wasn't her fault and they're not going to send the driver back. So here's one  customer who won't be ordering from this place again

Great French place in LES. Came her for brunch. Small but inviting. No frills- just great French good, good coffee, friendly staff and one of the best meals I've had in a while. I'll definitely be back.

Last Sunday, my husband and I rented out Modo Mio for three hours for what guests believed to be a wedding reception dinner. We surprised our guests with a wedding ceremony. It was one of the best days of my life, largely due to the professionalism, accommodation, and hard work of the staff at Modo Mio. From the planning stages, the manager Chris Curtis was extremely helpful and very open for me to decorate however I wanted. He answered all of my questions in a timely manner and made sure his staff was aware of the details of the day. On the day of the event, staff came in earlier than scheduled to assist in setting up. Lucy and Gared helped move tables around, hang pictures, set-up centerpieces, etc. Throughout the evening, the staff was welcoming and extremely focused on our guests. The customer service was phenomenal and nothing was too much. Additionally, both Lucy and Gared remained calm and flexible throughout the entire evening. One of the reasons we chose to have our wedding at Modo Mio is the quality of the food. It is, hands down, our favorite restaurant. We love the Sunday family style menu and wanted our guests to have the same experience. Last Sunday, the food was incredible as always and we were thrilled our guests got to experience that. Many of our guests informed us that it was the best wedding they ever attended and the best meal they ever had. Thank you so much, Modo Mio!

First and last time EVER ordering this from nasty place! It took 2 hours for the food to come. I ordered chicken tenders and fries I only got two little chicken tenders. The guy who delivered the food was very rude. I wouldn't recommend it!

Mediocre drinks and a bartender with a bad attitude ensure it will be a long time before I try Anchor again. All of the staff were short with my friends and I and the bartender acted as though we were an annoyance rather than paying customers. He stopped just short of being incredibly rude and we left after one drink.

Whoa.  Didn't know what I was walking into.  Fresh fish station?  Oh yeah, sit down eating area to eat cooked fish.  The area where they sell pasta?  Yeah, you can sit down to have cooked pasta.  I never thought I'd see a huge supermarket ... where they'll cook the same foods for you.  Very busy.  Line almost out the door for their sit down cafe at 10pm on a Friday night.  We put our names down for the upstairs outdoor bar as well as the seafood area, both had 45 minutes wait.  We strolled over to the cheese area where you just wait to snag a tall counter top and found one within minutes.  Ordered a meat & cheese platter along with wine.  The 45 minute wait was quite accurate, but we decided to go elsewhere at that point, not by any fault of this place.  Just in a different mood at the time, plus the platter was sufficient.  Will need to go back again to browse around, which I'm sure can easily take up an hour and a half.  Looking forward to it.

Very rustic, good quality food affordable pricing don't understand why you only can get 1 coffee refill and then there's an add on charge. Highly recommend this place never a disappoint Keep in mind only cash no credit/debit
Prices are high. Foe ex: for a small square of cake you pay as if you were getting thw whole piece.
Brunch was decent. Came here before the po by was good! I would stick to the pancakes or anything but the eggs.
Meh.  Pizza wasn't hot, lacking sauce.  Overrated.  It wasn't bad but not worth the hour wait.

Small space, unfriendly workers. Terrible service. I know its new york but come on! I used to bring friends to this place because they have pretty good offer after 5:30 but if they are keep having these unhappy/rude workers serving, this place will not go any far. Food doesnt taste good when take out.

Just got back from this joint.  My boy Julian making fun of my reviews because I didn't use White Smoke to correct my mistakes.  F**k it.  I'll use it when I got lots to say like when I was talking about the ugly a**  hookas at PUSH.  Julian gonna upload a photo so the world can see how they messed up his arm with the IV they don't know how to use.  Hookas. Back to MP.  This spot is nice.  Good food, vibe, everything is tight. The waitress could have been more on point. She kept asking us the SAME question.  I bet she get fired. Otherwise its a good bar.

Do NOT under any circumstances eat at this place. The staff were nice but completely incompetent and the manager was a JERK. Our friend's food took 20-30 extra minutes to come and all they offered us was one free drink. When we complained the manager was a TOTAL asshole. It took us literally 30-40 minutes to get water.

My wife and I were trying to go to a place in Ramsey, but could't get in.  I was looking online and stumbled on the Pig & Prince, and decided to give it a try.  I couldn't have been happier with our choice, it definitely exceeded our expectations.  The space, in the train station, is amazing, and the food was even better.  I highly recommend the cured meats and cheeses, they were amazing.  We both liked everything we had, and plan to make many more trips (40 min drive) to eat there!
My favorite pizza - the artichoke is so good it's like dip on a crust. I could eat it all day. Very filling and satisfying.

Totally Random Choice by my girlfriend for a night out in the city.  We started off with the house ricotta which is drizzled in honey and sea salt served with warm bread and it was delicious.  She got the beet salad to start and even though I think beets are disgusting, she loved it.   For the entree I had the steak and tomatoes minus the tomatoes because I don't like tomatoes and I also had the spicy onion sauce on the side and I'm glad I did because the steak by itself was one of the best steaks I have had in my entire life and I never even touched the sauce.  My girlfriend got the tuna tar guac and when she was done with it I could see the bottom of the bowl and the plate lol.  We also added on a Mac and cheese which I believe was made with Gouda cheese and that too was just incredible.  I am so glad we picked this place and I would recommend it to anyone in the area and I will definitely be back.

I have waited a long time for this restaurant to open and am happy to report that it does not disappoint. I have been to the restaurant twice since it opened a little over a week ago. As a Peruvian I was impressed with the menu including one of my favorite dishes - Seco de Cordero.  It did not disappoint and I can't wait to go again soon and this time try their dessert!
One of the best white slices I've found in the Montclair area, service is always on time.

Not a good place to take kids. No high chairs are offered. When we called to check to see if we could get a booth they were not very accommodating saying they were reserved for parties of 4. And we had two adults and two kids. Food was overpriced...nothing too special.

This was our 3rd or 4th time at Rare. Although it was always nice in the past, this time it was just beyond unbearable. My boyfriend and I went on my 25th birthday, as they always send me a $25 gift certificate. We ordered cocktails like we always do and I decided to try their lychee martini. I have to say, it was the most unpleasing taste that my mouth had ever tasted. The actual lychee juice was slim to none, and I was drinking straight (what it tasted like) well vodka. If this was not bad enough, when we told our waiter about it, he proceeded to get the manager who refuses to take off the mere $12 drink off our check. I have been to Michelin rated restaurants in the city, and one restaurant in particular were more than willing to take off my $102 plate of Foie Gras as soon as I made a face, and this guy almost fainted when I wanted to send back my $12 drink!! I finally got my lamb and my boyfriend got his filet mignon. I have to say, it was pretty satisfyingly delicious. So delicious that we decided to take some home. We had 2 pieces of lamb, 3/4 of filet mignon, tomatoes and broccoli and a whole side of creamed spinach, all of which the manager offered to pack it all up for us. When we got home, our jaws almost dropped for the fact that not only the manager himself left out the tomatoes and broccoli, he had neglected to pack our creamed spinach!! As someone who grew up in the restaurant business, I am always the first person who would cut restaurants some slack. But this is just unacceptable! From the bad attitude and unprofessionalism displayed by Rare's so-called "manager", to the carelessness displayed by the staff, I would give rare a quarter of a star if I could. In the past, the manager and staff were always so welcoming and professional, and they always gave us a free dessert for our birthdays. This is definitely our final and last straw.

I've lived in the neighborhood for over a year- and this cafe is the best thing (food-wise!) that has happened to this area.  The sandwich combos are great, my personal favorite being the Monkey Biz, interesting tea flavors, and a really clean/fresh dining space.  Also, the owner Jen is really nice- always a plus!

I ordered the classic Tonkotsu soup and really enjoyed it. Lots of flavors and came out steaming hot. The slow poached egg was an added bonus. Low key, chill atmosphere and quick service. Great value -I will be returning.

Took my friend here for his birthday. We had terrible service, food only ok. One person ordered a burrito with no dairy and was given one with dairy 10 minutes after the rest of the party was served, he then had to wait another 10 minutes for the new burrito, leaving him to eat after we had already finished. Two of the entrees were stayed to come with fresh tortillas which they didn't receive, when they were requested we received tortillas that had been cut into quarters for some reason making it impossible to use them. After this sub par meal we waited another 15 minutes for a check. Awful experience.

Fresh hot and crispy Sicilian slice, rice ball parmesan, roasted artichokes, eggplant parm, and of course spumoni on a picnic table outside-doesnt get much better than that!!! The inside restaurant is nice, but sitting outside is way more fun. A Brooklyn institution that lives up to the hype. Go hungry, leave stuffed.

I really want to love it. I love the atmosphere, the service was great. But the food was just bland. It's extremely under seasoned. The clams were fishy. (I got them as an appetizer) The only spectacular thing was the wine. And that's saying something. I would love to come back - just change your chef. Please.

Today, I ate here for lunch with my wife and mother. We split between the three of us Hoisin pork with string beans, Shrimp chow mein, and shrimp with garlic sauce. The food was good, and not disappointing, but the CUSTOMER SERVICE WAS TERRIBLE!!!!! I took a few forkfuls of the shrimp chow mein, and as I was chewing it, it tasted.. funny.. and the texture was wrong. I discreetly spit out my food onto my plate and unravelled a big piece of a tough napkin that was cooked into my food! I quietly called over the manager and he apologized and took the napkin (in a little teacup) back to the kitchen. He emerged a few moments later and explained it must have gotten stuck to the bottom of some of the eggs. (Huh? ok. probably makes sense). He said he would comp "something something something". Anyway, we continued to eat, asked for the bill when we were done, and we he gave it to me the bill was for $33. $11-$12 for each dish.. ???? I called him back over, and said, where's the comp? He said, "Oh, I took off the $2 sprite."   I looked at him and thought, "Really? REALLY? I ate some potentially dirty napkin from your kitchen and you comp me for a $2 soda when my meal was $33?????" What a moron.  That was the most idiotic response an owner/manager of a restaurant can have. BAD NEWS always travels faster than GOOD NEWS. My wife and her co workers eat there almost once a week... but after this experience, who knows what else is getting in their food.  I also wouldn't want to be a customer where they don't understand how to cater to a customer.  I could have made a big scene, I could have raised my voice and let it be known that there was a foreign object in my food, but I kept everything discreet. Fxck him. It bothers me I even tipped him when I signed the check.  I doubt he'll ever read this, but I hope he does. Eat at your own risk, this time it was a napkin, maybe you'll be lucky to get a body part or some plastic wrap. :) *annoyed*

Great place for brunch. Wonderful atmosphere. Waffles were perfect, not soggy like your normal diner would make. The fruit topping was very fresh and delicious. Omelets were perfectly cooked- light, fluffy, flavorful. The side of mashed potatoes with the omelette was delicious and I'm not big on potatoes for breakfast. The coffee was equally great.

I wasn't leaving, but the bar back took my three dollars off the bar. When I question the bartender she explained to me that it was going to be tip anyway, so what is the difference. If she gave me my three dollars back she would've gotten a $10 tip in return. Shame on u. Not to mention the fact that the bar back is taking money off the bar?

One of the best dim sum and chinese restaurants in the city of Philadelphia.  The food is amazing and fresh, I always look forward to coming here, my go-to chinese restaurant. The soup dumplings by far are my favorite.  Juicy, tasty, and fresh.  We have tried several different dishes (scallion pancakes, shrimp dumplings,drunken noodle, spicy hot pots,mao po tofu, flounder in fish sauce, and the list goes on..) Every time I come here with my boyfriend or friends I'm never disappointed.  Being BYOB makes it even better.  Would highly recommended with friends/fun date night out!

After reading all the reviews we considered giving this place a try. It was the worst experience we have ever had in any Thai restaurant. The service staff is extremely rude, and the food is below average. There was a bug in our food. I do not recommend this place, its not worth it.
Delicious one of the most tasteful lobsters i ve ever had ... It was our first time be back really soon.... Very nice ambience and friendly service

I live a few blocks away from this place and I must say, yay and finally!!! Its been around for about a year and tonight was the first time I tried their food. I was intrigued based on the previous Yelp reviews and the positive reviews were spot on!!  I ordered their thin crust pizza specialties, I had the prosciutto de'parma and my son had the margherita and they were both delicious!! It was a true thin crust, just the way I like it. The sauce was excellent, tasted freshly made and you can tell they use quality ingredients. Ordering was easy, service was great and delivery was made in a reasonable time. My only regret was that I couldn't dine at their place due to an injury,  because when the pizza arrived at my house it wasn't hot and being I'm so close I assume it sat at their place for a while. I did read they have awesome desserts too which is not on their delivery menu. So as soon as I can I'm definitely dining-in because some of their pasta dishes sound amazing!! I'm thrilled that Maspeth has a more authentic Italian restaurant with unique dishes that are reasonably priced close to my home.

A few complaints: Food is so fresh and delicious, that I couldn't stop eating! Ordered chakapuly, khachapuri, elarji and kartuli salad. Really wish I ALSO ordered khinkali, soko and satsivi! (Just couldn't handle any more!!!) Dessert was probably THE BEST Georgian Napoleon i've ever tasted! I ate so much that I have to do the triple time on a treadmill tomorrow! Wine???? OMG! Stop! Service.... 5 STARS! Owners.... THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR FINALLY OPENING A GEORGIAN HOTSPOT THAT IS CLASSY, DELICIOUS AND ... Did I mention the LOCATION?

The ambiance and the view from the restaurant is amazing. The food and the service was excellent. One downfall is the wait to get a table if you don't have reservations and the drinks are much better if you order them when sitting at the bar. Are drinks weren't as enjoyable when we ordered them from our table.
Best and freshest Italian in the area. Staff is wonderful and portions are large! Atmosphere is comfortable. The food is truly outstanding!

I have been hearing alot of buzz about Room 55 which opened in the old Tazzina location. We always love to stay in the neighborhood and give our locals the business. I bought an Amazon local deal figured it was an opportunity to try it. I made a reservation for this evening and told the person who took the reservation that we had a   voucher, no mention about printing it out although I did. We arrived and were greeted by Trevor who seated us. He asked for the voucher right away which I handed to him. He gave us the menu and proceeded to mention that he was a chef and he was helping his good buddy Vinny that night. We looked over the menu and to tell you the truth nothing was making me get too excited. Trevor came to take our order we had to tell him what we would like to drink he didn't ask but proceeded to make a wine suggestion didn't tell us about the Sangria that was being served to other patrons. I ordered the mushroom/asparagus salad and my husband ordered the clams casino appetizer. I must mention that the bread basket which consisted of two flat breads and two slices of white italian bread served with olive oil was pretty pathetic at best. When Trevor took away the bread basket to make room for the appetizers he could have returned with more given the clams casino had a very nice broth great for bread dipping. For the main course I ordered the grouper with a beet salad and beet puree. By far the beets beat out the fish which was covered with two slices of toasted bread. Just ruined the fish by adding bread! Come on with the bread on fish! My husband ordered the perch which was served with spaghetti squash, half of which was hot the other half cold. Trust me for him to comment that it was cold it must have been cold because it is a running joke that I always get cold food. We skipped dessert as I couldn't wait to leave. Btw I took a picture of my view from the table I was sitting at: double doors, and about 10 warning signs an emergency kit and god knows what else. Not appealing to the eye. Sorry to say I will not be recommending or returning any time in the future. Best of luck to you though.
Love the food.

I must have expected way too much from all the reviews and hype. We made a reservation for omakase but had to sit away from the sushi bar.  They give you a selection of everything at once.  The sushi is small, lacking aesthetics and taste as good as sushi from whole foods.  Perhaps it would be different at the sushi bar... but I am not going to waste my time to find out.

It is the worst Asian restaurant. They don't know what they are doing. When I ordered for spicy food they delivered bland food. This is after they calling me to confirm about the food and the variation I've requested for. This is the worst mistake I've ever done, by ordering it from here. Please do not get food from here. They suck to the core.
Service is awful. Unfriendly cashier with bad attitude (the black female cashier's name was Lakida printed on my receipt). Too slow even for a to go order!
We order pizza from here ALL the time, love the homemade taste, really the best pizza on this side of town.

Beef brisket flavor is to die for. I don't typically go for red meat but now I totally understand why brisket is such a big deal to some people. This first try left me speechless. Smokey, juicy, and just perfection for the tastebuds. Pulled pork was good but forgettable next to that brisket. Looking forward to trying the beans with burnt ends.

Food ok but boy are they rude!  Terrible service and attitude, you almost wish they don't make it.   We got the worst out of the 3 servers (owner is nice, we had a long chat when they first opened but doesn't seem to care much now), complete with rolling eyes, disappearing, forgetful and altogether rude.  In my view,the food does not make up for that, too many other choices.  It was almost insulting, like they were doing us a big favor.

I don't understand why this place is so highly rated. The food wasn't all that memorable, but their poor service was. I came here with my boyfriend last Friday because he had been wanting to try it based on his co-worker's recommendation. I arrived around 7:30pm and waited outside the restaurant. My bf said he wouldn't be there for another 20 minutes. Ten minutes had past and the restaurant started to fill up. I decided to grab a table while there's still one available. I walked in and there appeared to be only 1 waiter. He was taking someone's order at the time. Other workers were hidden in the kitchen, behind the small counter. No one came over to greet/seat me so I helped myself to the only empty table left. It was a table that can seat a party of 4. A waitress wearing glasses, with her hair up in a ponytail, came over and with an attitude asked how many people would be dining. I said 2 and that the 2nd person would arrive in about 10 minutes. She reluctantly allowed me to stay but moved me to another table. There was a table next to the one I sat down in. That table was a smaller table that seats 2. I didn't seat myself there because it was positioned next to a couple, who had placed their belongings on the chairs. The waitress shifted the small table slightly over so that the tables were no longer touching and instructed me to sit there instead. I sat down and the first waiter I saw brought over 2 glasses of water and the menus. I browsed through the menu and had mentally picked out what I planned to order. I started playing on my phone to pass the time. About 10 minutes had passed and that b*tchy waitress came up to me again and in a whiny voice said "Is your friend here yet?! How much longer?!" I turned, looked at her and said "He'll be here any minute now".  Sure enough my bf walked in seconds later. He had missed the entire exchange but saw that i was fuming mad. I informed him of what had happened: her attitude when she came up to me; her having me switch tables, and how she came up to me the 2nd time asking the same f*ckin' question. What she should have done was act  pleasantly and ask me something in line with "Would you like to order something to drink?" or "May I start you off with some appetizers while you wait for your party?" I was hungry so if someone were to offer to take my order, I would have began eating even before my bf showed. But no, she had to be a complete a-hole about it. My bf asked if I wanted to leave and I was very tempted to. But I decided to stay since I already sat there for so long and my bf had wanted to try their food.  A few minutes later, another female customer entered the restaurant. She was a party of 1 and guess where they sat her? That's right, they gave her that big table that seats 4. I'm surprised that b*tch didn't make her wait for a smaller table. Another young female waitress came over to take our order. I asked her who's the manager of the establishment, and sadly she gestured over to THAT lady. I told the waitress that her boss is very rude, and she just said "sorry about that" on her behalf. Now onto the food. We ordered the Sha Momo to share, which are fried dumplings accompanied by their hot sauce. They were okay, but no better than the dumplings that I could have ordered from my neighborhood Chinese restaurant. My bf ordered the Luksha Shamdey which was lamb with curry over rice. He's dish was good, but again not spectacular. I ordered the Gyathuk Takpa with beef, which is basically just pan fried noodles. The noodles were bland and the beef was hard, not at all tenderized. I never had to chew so much in my life and work so hard just to eat my food. When we finished the meal, the check came and it was that b*tch who came over to clear the table. While my bf paid the bill I used that opportunity to write her a note on the back of the check essentially telling her off. I will never set foot inside that poor excuse of a restaurant ever again.

Best sushi ever. EVER. We are sushi fanatics and are always looking for a good place to eat with quality ingredients. Well this place is an hour away for us and we still come as much as possible. Husband and wife run this place together and are always friendly. Prices are great and we never leave hungry. Their sushi is always tasty and the ingredients are always fresh.  The romantic roll and crunchy spicy tuna are our favorites. And the mochi ice cream at the end is the best part of our day. We went today for my husband's birthday and we were not disappointed. Our meal consisted of tea, miso soup, edamame, shrimp sashimi, 4 rolls and dessert all for under $45. Don't let the construction or location dissuade you from going! You will not be sorry you made the trip.

This restaurant continues to capture my attention. Has the best food, ambiance, and service. On top of all that this local restaurant has started a program that offers high school student hands on training for those interested in the restaurant business. Jacob's is always a good time and I always leave with a happy tummy.

We visited this place tonight, and I'm still questioning why. The dining area and back yard are cute, but the menu is written on chalkboards all over the place, which is annoying. I hardly think that after a year, they are still waiting for their menus to be printed. Anyway, the burgers are small. If you're paying $12 for a burger, you'd expect it to be a nice size loaded with toppings, right? Nope! They are barely larger than slider burgers. We ordered some drinks, and they were watered down. My friend ordered the fried chicken, which was decent (I stole a bite), but it's waaaay overpriced. $15 for fries chicken??? I could've purchased this exact same meal at another restaurant and had better quality & larger portions, and it would've cost less. And don't even get me started on the $5 fries w/ "house ketchup", which must mean "paint thinner". It was awful! The physical area was cute. The menu selection and pricing? Not so much. I won't be back.
Best pizza in all of New York, crust is perfection and topping are all fresh.  The line are very long, but you wont be sorry you waited.
Uni Ramen?? Are you kidding?  I'm going everyday.

We ordered one of the specialty pies and a standard pepperoni, from about 10 minutes down the road in Bayonne. The delivery took over an hour, and the pizza arrived cold. It tasted like it would have been great if it was hot, but the pizza did not cool well and was hard as a rock.

Man, Yelpers, I'm disappointed.  I went WAAAAY out of my way at night which cost me about $35... They were almost closed and were rushing to.. ummmn clean? The place is filthy and the order dude was picking his nose very slowly when we walked in.. sigh.....    They were out of shrimp, chicken.. only poke and veg dumplings.. got the veg dumplings.. nothing special and we didn't even finish them.. And cringed to take a bite considering the filth and nose picking and broken stools, etc... the end.. No

I love this place. Such a nice addition to the neighborhood! I've has the salads and the pizzas and have never been disappointed. The only thing I'm taking a star off for is that it would be nice if there was a bar where you could sit at while you wait for a table. Otherwise it is wonderful!!

Montana sure does have a lot of friends... its unbelievable that this place has almost no bad reviews... other than in the press I can't fathom anyone returning to this restaurant... unfortunately because i live in the neighborhood I have returned multiple times and each time has been worse than the rest... The food is obnoxiously over priced. under portioned. and not good... watery greens, greasy chicken... even greasier vegetables (which is weird vegetables shouldn't be greasy) The service literally couldn't be worse... never in my life have a heard the word "chill" used to describe menu items... and not just once it was for every single thing.... there was nothing "chill" about any of my experiences... The commodore is a perfect bar/restaurant severing similar food at half the cost, half the wait time and twice as good. I whole heartedly agree with the review written in the observer.   this is a Disney land theme restaurant trying to cash in on and aesthetic... the saddest part is what they don't know is that they're not pioneers... North east kingdom has been in the neighborhood for what? 7 maybe even 8 years? There's a cafe down the block with a waterfall in it!!! They're not trailblazer or trendsetters... the neighborhood is already dead and over... they might as well be selling "jefftown" hats and T shirts and beer cozys at a lil stand out front... if you want a drink. go to pearls. From what i can tell its an honest version of what Montana is trying to rip-off... it was nice of him to at least not open too close to them... oh wait.... it's a block away....

Disgusting exterior, dirty interior, the carpets were disgusting.  When you walk in theres so much clutter and not to mention there was no sign of anybody to bring us to a table.  I walked around the whole place waiting looked at the buffet tables which the food looked gross like its been sitting untouched for awhile.  I noticed alot of workers just sitting around or hiding in corners eating ignoring the wondering customers looking to be seated. I was not the only person who left without even eating to other parties left as well as they also complains of how dirty it was in the dining areas.

Tried it again last night after a long hiatus.  We won't be back!  From the two rejected orders of CHEWY calamari, cold bread, small portions and super spicy BBQ chicken pizza which, had I had more than one piece would have re energized my ulcer (super thick slices of HOT pepper).  My sons kids grilled chicken was burnt, husbands gnuti was odd and small.  Manager was receptive but did Nothing to encourage us to ever come back.  Not impressed and with so many blue black west hartford options we won't be back.
Simply put........this is the "best" that's the only review you need
Love! Love! Love! Authentic, fresh and amazing. Highly recommended. Just not the lasanga. Bread is out of this world !

Service: Came in to enjoy a meal with a friend. Ordered just a single pie with some toppings. Amazingly we were seated and eating within 10 minutes of entrance. Before the new restaurant, the line used to twist around the block, now its just a few feet next to the old place, which is also a pizzeria. No credit cards. ONLY CASH. $4.50 ATM FEE. No beer. Busy place, wrong orders can occur. Poor guest appreciation (old place had a brighter attitude), however, if compared to Totonno's, well then G's got best customer service. The servers are very respectful and attentive. Food: The food is good regardless of the customer service. This is why I am giving this place a 4 star rating. This place moves a lot of traffic so the circulation of fresh ingredients is accurate. Setting: Awesome romantic setting, while you sitting next to almost 50 people.   Old Rating: "One of the coolest and tastiest joints in Brooklyn. Limited seating but its worth the wait. A great place for a first date. I bake pizza and can vouch for their sauce and dough. Sometimes the pizza is slightly burnt but you can always ask to make sure that its not. Service is busy but precise. "
Very fresh and flavorful. I miss this placed immensely. If you are searching for true, authentic Thai food... This place is the spot.

I've been here a couple of times. I enjoy the food but the wait time is absolutely ridiculous. They need to hire more cooks. Each time I've dined there I wanted more than 30 minutes for food. I tried to call in a to go order and they told me they were too busy for to go orders. They have the potential to be a really great restaurant if they get the wait time under control.

Very good service and well priced. A very good beer selection. I had the Ithaca groundsomething...it was really good. The decor is awesome. Rustic friendly place. The service was friendly. The place is large and got perfectfor large groups

I'm a pretty big fry fan, and these are some of the best I've ever had. They're the perfect texture, size, and go well with all the sauces that I've tried. On my last visit with friends we ordered a double (enough for 3-4 people) and the Parmesan peppercorn,  Vietnamese pineapple, peanut satay and frite sauces. I liked the Parmesan best (probably because I love cheese fries). In addition to the great product, the prices are reasonable. For $7.50 we got a huge serving of fries and paid about $2 for the extra sauces, which weren't too small either. The service moves quickly enough, especially considering the food is made to order right in front of you. The only drawback in my mind is the lack of seating in the restaurant - not an issue on a bright sunny day given the nearby parks, but something that could cause problems on a rainy day. Next time I come I think I'll have to try the poutine. Definitely worth a trip if you're in the area!

I've been in Mother's Ruin several times during several different trips to the NY and every time I've gone I've disliked this place (I keep getting dragged in). The bartenders have a bad attitude, the drinks are mediocre, and the lighting is always bad. I don't ever want to return, although I'm sure I'll get dragged in here again at some point. I won't be happy about it though.
My enchilada was decent but overpriced. The tacos for two looked excellent.

Second time here , breakfast is wonderful, coffee was taste amazing, With free refill. Omelet are huge with home fries. Nice and friendly staff , service is better then before. They are building their way back up after a long time. The place has a very nice atmosphere. Will come back with more friends.

Great Fresh Subs I finally got to try Vito's last week and so glad I did. This is a takeout place that serves hot and cold subs with salads. I had a basic turkey and cheese with LTM and pickles. The Italian bread was nice and fresh and it was packed with good quality meat and made with care. You can easily make 2 meals out of one sandwich. The lady at the register was friendly as can be and happy to serve. Her fresh baked cookies were so tempting. I would gladly pay an extra 2 dollars for a sandwich here over that skimpy, mass produced, preservative laced junk at Subways. I wish I lived closer to New Haven. Nice to see a few great family owned places are still alive.
Great food, great service! Past is perfectly al dente! The gravy is top notch and bread is great!
The veggie meatball has walnuts in it. This is not the place to eat for a vegetarian with a deathly nut allergy.

DO NOT ORDER TAKE OUT FROM HERE. I PUT MY ORDER IN THROUGH YELP. 1 hr, later when I called the restaurant, they said they are not going to deliver and hung up on me several times. Absolute truth, this place deserves to be shut down.
Fish & Chips and Pimms Cup was awesome as was waitress.  Manager was an not nice and had waitress apologizing for him behind his back.  Not good.
one of the best seafood market and restraint in the state.. Everything you get is great

I'll be back to try the Chicken Sandwich. Did an order for pickup and it was nice to have the lettuce, tomato, onion package separately. It's a nice place to eat in as well it seems. Will give it a go at some point hopefully.
I am not commenting on their food cuz the phone girl was super rude, and that made me doesn't want to order any food from them....

0 FUCKING STARS FUCK THIS PLACE MY GOD!!!!!!!!!! ITS 3 am and I am still thinking about how fucking shit this establishment is... Jesus H Christ....First off the Service was absolute shit it took 30 minutes to get a fucking beer, which they got wrong.  Next they proceeded to serve me and my father shit food, which mine was cold and my father said his sucked too... I told the waitress my food was cold and she got the manager and he asked if i wanted a new plate (fuck off)...The manager blamed it on being busy, this PLACE IS MANAGED BY 12 YEAR OLDS.....Overall a horrible experience and I usually dont do this but this place is exceptionally SHITTY!  I dont understand how a restaurant that is this terrible could still be in business but i assume its just another shitty corporate restaurant that cuts corners for profit.....WORST DINING EXPERIENCE EVER!!!! FUCK THIS PLACE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Picked up a large eggplant and got a free mozzarella pizza for lunch. It was delicious. No complaints.

Had the food before and after the renovation.  Hibachi, Chinese, Sushi and take-out. Hibachi is a great time and the food is phenomenal.  A bit expensive though.   Chinese food has the basics and some chef specialties.  I usually go for the Happy Nest.  It's a potato basket filled with mixed veggies along with chicken,pork,beef, and shrimp.  Absolutely amazing.    Either way it's the best I can find in the area.   Take out gives the bang for the buck and is just as delicious.   This is my go to place and I will never stop going here.  Sit down, take out, dinner party this is the place to go.  You will not be disappointed.
I think this place is decent, the food is average, and I am never disappointed.

Great food find in LIC. Wait staff was friendly, quick and helpful. Resto is a block from the 7 train stop along Vernon Blvd.   The guacamole was fresh and really delicious. Sis and I both enjoyed our main course orders of chicken enchiladas and mole de piaxtla. It was our first time to try tamarind margaritas which I have to say was different but quite good too.

This place is amazing. We have been twice and both times been amazed. For one, I am vegan, so in order to go out to fine dining anywhere I am usually relegated to finding an Italian place and getting plain pasta, something that gets old very fast no matter how good the place is. I have always been a fan of Indian food, but the food at Tashan is unique. It is a perfect blend of Indian inspired dishes with French finery. I had so many options of dishes and they were all unbelievable. My partner, the carnivore went on and on about the boar that melted in his mouth. On top of that everyone in the place went above and beyond to be at our beck and call, from opening the car door outside the restaurant to catering more to my dietary needs than any place I have ever dined before. Last night our server, Bennett, was also serving a huge party of easily 20 plus people, yet we never felt neglected. He was amazing, explaining each dish thoroughly and pointing out what I could eat and what could be modified for me. Back on New Year's Eve, when we tried this place for the first time, Virginia, modified the tasting menu for us so that my partner could have meat dishes, while I had plenty to eat that was vegan. Both servers were so nice and outgoing, that it added to the atmosphere of having everything and everyone at our service. Also, we had so much food both times, that we brought much of it home, too stuffed to eat another bite and for a very reasonable price considering the classy atmosphere. It is quickly becoming my favorite restaurant.

Service was so SLOW... Creeps were cold and not that authentic. Food was ok, my Hazel nut Latte was great, but that was about it. I guess the atmosphere was nice and relaxing, so if you have work to do this might be a better place you (if you don't love Starbucks).

I ate here last year and I was thinking about jesus and he came to me and he was all like "go rate momo-fuku on yelp". So this place is really good and that really is alot coming from a doge. The pork buns made me cry in a good way and had felt like my doge life was changed forever. In the 14 years that I will live I will always remember this restaurant and give it doge praise in the doge community. ~Yelp Doge~
Outstanding!  From bar to dining, just incredible!  Food amazing, service - Marge and Matt were terrific!   Excellent all around, and very well managed.
nothing to say. good food at a good price.
Most delicious halal I've ever had didn't think I was ever gonna like the bread but once I tried it here I'm willing to eat it anywhere

Wow! I had such high hopes for this place, and of course I was extremely disappointed by the usual sub-par customer service found in most New Haven pubs. The "bouncer" and his cronies were smoking outside with the smoke coming into the restaurant. The host was not welcoming on our entrance, or our departure. The bartenders were weird, non-social, and on their Facebook the entire time. Difficult to get a drink when it wasn't busy at all. The food was nothing special. Greasy over cooked "Waffles" (fries) and the special sauce was thick and fatty mayo with some bland seasoning. Don't waste your time here. This is my 3rd time, and it'll hopefully be my last.

We went for lunch, service was very bad, one girl was doing everything and watching TV. We asked couple of times to the owner who was walking around and playing on his smart phone but was not interested in taking care of customers requests or helping, cheese was not melted in our enchiladas at all. This place used to be good but not anymore, I would not recommend this restaurant. Service and food both sucks while it's still pricy.
Eat at the bar: it's more reasonable. Great spot to sit outside and eat. Food is very average.
Decent mix of Korean food and other asian foods. My favorite is the sashimi bi bim bap.  Service is good.

We came here for brunch because of 2 hour wait at Clinton bakery and we were in mode for fried chicken waffle. A big mistake. They were not serving that dish because they did not have any chicken that day!  We order bunch of dishes but had to send most of them back. The latte had an unpleasant note and tasted like hot cocoa. The eggs Benedict and fried eggs were over cooked. The potato hash was greasy and bland.

My awesome friend who has been here brought me here when I visited my aunt in CT. Upon arriving, we were seated at the sushi bar area. I had scallop, salmon, hirame, yellow tail sashimi and sushi. My friend got chirashi (assorted fresh fish over a bed of sushi rice) and said it was one of his favorit dish. I was very impressed with the food also. The sashimi and sushi i had was absolutely delicious and fresh. I've eaten at sushi places in Boston & NYC and this place really has some impeccable sushi. The sushi chef is very knowledgealbe about the foood.(Trust Me. I DO know about SUSHI, so I can check...) Some folks think it's a great sushi if there is spicy mayo or any other sauces all over the plate. They don't even know what the fusion style sushi is. Last but not least... Eventhough we were there just before closing, Sean K was very friendly...(thank you chef, you are the best) I will definitely return here and recommend this place to friends.(and did)

The food and service transcended taste and class. I was almost moved to tears (of joy) by the tremendous generosity of the employees. While my friend and I, let's just call them "Barbara" for now, were lucky enough to get a seat quickly, others toiled in a long line. But alas, the staff kept on bringing treats! Orange slices, honey toast, fries and even water. A sight to behold, but better experienced than told! Go here or risk losing one of life's greatest joys!

Great place for happy hour!  My friends and I hang out on the rooftop deck at least once a week in the summer. You have to get the seared tuna, they do it right! The shrimp calamari is fun, it's cooked very light and crispy! The shoestring fries are pretty cool and great to share. I've also been to the Continental Midtown for breakfast. Their breakfast dishes are tasty and not overwhelming. Oh, and you gotta love their Bloody Mary's! Not too spicy but Very flavorful and fresh tasting, they hit the spot!

Genuine Italian cuisine is prepared by the chef and he has yet to disappoint. The food reminds me if being in Italy. I have been twice and both times a left totally satisfied and the price is right. I've had the filet of sole which was perfectly seasoned and cooked. Also the mussels were so good we had to get more bread to finish the sauce. The tiramisu is perfection as well as any of the other desserts they offer. The place is a cozy gem in the middle of Astoria with all of the other imitation Italian restaurants in the neighborhood this should be your Italian go to without question.

Ok, I typically don't nitpick about places but there were a few glaring details that would prevent me from ordering again. Luckily, I was high enough to enjoy my meal. CONS: 1. They called to inform me they ran out of romaine for my Caesar Salad. They did ask if it was ok to replace with another type and I relented. It was shredded iceberg (the type they use for the subs) and I couldn't help but feel like I was eating a big bowl of noodles. Caesar salad just ain't the same without romaine. No biggie and I still ate it. 2. The "large" order of potato salad (that I was going to share with one other person) was very tiny-a single serving. Maybe they thought I ordered a small? Also, it doesn't even taste good. Vinegary and plain. Miffed, but an error I could let slip. 3. They forgot the small order of coleslaw I ordered with the sub. Perhaps they got the potato salad and coleslaw order mixed up. Sigh. 4. The sub was not packed with meats/toppings like a typical Jersey sub should be! Who in their right minds would put like 1 slice of each item and be alright with it??Pretty skimpy-not superhero quality. I thought this was a SUB shop? 5. Gave me roasted red peppers on the sub instead of hot peppers and regular ham instead of capicola. Oh, and they don't have a typical Italian sub on their menu--I had to customize a Salami and Cheese sub. They also forgot my requested olives. PROS: I won't even bother numbering them but the sub was bigger than a foot long. Which is nice but would've been nicer if it was filled like a sub should be. Also, they delivered promptly to Journal Sq (approx. 40 min). Delivery guy was very polite. *Apologies for the lengthy review. But wanted to make it clear that the small details do count, especially if there are a lot of small errors in one order. This was my first time ordering delivery from them, most likely my last. I'm sorry but I need my Jersey-sized sub.

One of the best experiences you will have dining in NYC.  It is located in a vibrant neighborhood, with easy access to shopping and public transportation.  The food is great and prices are reasonable.  Perfect for a date night or family outting.
Excellent food! Friendly staff...perfect date night :)  Oh, and one of the best filet mignon you will ever taste!

While on business trip into the city last week, accompanied by my wife, we found ourselves strolling the streets of SoHo later in the evening on a Wednesday night.  Not wanting to bear the crowds and revelry inside some of the more "scenester" restaurants, we happened upon what turned out to be - for us - the gem of Soho restaurants ... Bistro Les Amis.  Tucked away on the corner of Spring and Thompson streets, this cozy little restaurant couldn't have been more perfect - in terms of what we were looking for - even if Julia Child or James Beard themselves had created it. The atmosphere inside is like that from a classic romantic movie ... dimly lit, a rich mahogany bar, a charming banquette running opposite it ... and all around, votive candles dot the interior casting a glow not unlike sitting by crackling wood fireplace (although there isn't, in fact, one on the premises.) In other words ... the atmosphere at this restaurant is perfect for a romantic dinner with that special someone ... or, just yourself, as we noticed and happened to talk to several of the local patrons who were drinking and dining at the bar.  Often times eating at a restaurant alone can be intimidating for some ... and according to those we spoke with, Bistro Les Amis is "chill" and unpretentious.  That being said, we also noticed lively conversation at another table - but not the kind that is overbearing, or that interfered with my wife's and my special evening.  There was also an celebratory birthday party in the back, as well.  I'm very eager to experience this restaurant, too, during the daytime ... as according to our server, Ben, it's a great place to relax for a lovely lunch (and brunch, too, we heard) while shopping through the crowded streets of SoHo. And what about the food?  Frankly, I'll resort to using a completely overused word to describe it, but in short:  It was awesome.  We've been to several of the other well-recognized and well-established restaurants serving similar fare in the city - and right in SoHo, too - and this restaurant's level of food was equally on par with all of them ... and on top of that, the prices are slightly less than the other establishments.   We started our dinner with drinks at the bar with a very sweet bartender, Vera.  When the owner, himself, seated us at our table, he presented us with our menus ... and it proved difficult for us to make our choices, so we more or less ordered a "smorgasbord" of menu items and enjoyed them to our hearts content.  Oysters, fried crawfish, and the best French Onion Soup on the planet.  (Seriously ... I've never had better, and I've had a LOT of French Onion Soup in my 50+ years!)  Hanger Steak and some serious French Fries were the choice of my wife, and I settled on the housemade ravioli with mushroom duxelles that despite my growing increasingly full, tempted me to order an additional portion of to take back to Long Island with us that night (which I did ... some of which I ate for breakfast the next morning!) Despite our best efforts, we simply didn't have the room to order any of the tempting desserts that were offered to us, but we were able to sample some of them with our eyes as the food runners (extremely courteous, I might add) brought them out to other diners' tables.  Again, to use a rather adolescent word to describe something ... the profiteroles that I saw being consumed by a young couple sitting next to us simply looked "killer." Once our bill was settled and we gathered our belongings and were headed out the door, we were warmly thanked by the gentlemen who seated us, as well as by both Ben, our server, and the lovely Vera.  The one last question my wife had as she popped her head back in was if the restaurant would be open for Thanksgiving as our daughter is bringing her fiancee to the city for the parade, and invited us to join them.  It turns out that they are indeed open that day, and offer a prix-fixe classic Thanksgiving menu.  While it was hard for me to even think of Thanksgiving in July, I have to say ... given the experience we just had that night for a couple of hours on the corner of Spring and Thompson ... I'm looking forward to finding out what Thanksgiving at Bistro Les Amis will be like (I just hope they're serving Martinis that day, too, because after the crowds at that crazy parade ... I'm sure as heck going to need one ... or two!) Bottom line, folks:  Bistro Les Amis ... the secret gem of Soho (that I just let out of the bag.)

Bistro Les Amis is one of the best values for money that one can find for French restaurant!   It's small and charming ... reminds me very much of the small restaurants you find in Paris. The maitre d' / owner is just a lovely lovely man. Me and my husband been coming here for about 4 years and at least 2 or 3 times a months! The service there is always  excellent - very attentive.  Staffs are  always greets us with a smile.  Staff has not changed much, that says a lot about the way they run their business. Trust me myself is in restaurant business and I know hard is restaurant business ! The menu is also a good selection of traditional French fare.  My husband  eats pretty much same thing all the time there ! My absolute favorite starter is  foie gras.  Did I mention value for money?  The foie gras /MONK FISH was rather large, and for $16, it is a bargain compared to what you get at other places in the city.
Food was terrific!!! The Mexican hot spiced hot chocolate is to die for, and I would recommend the banana and peanut butter Krape

Went here for breakfast and was very disappointed. Service was poor and the prices on the the check were significantly higher than those listed on the menu they provided. They tried to charge a dollar more than the menu price for my western omelet and the coffee prices were inflated on the bill as well. Add to that the slooooow service. The wait to place the order was way out of line and we had to ask several times for juice that was supposed to be included in our order.
Great little place, from the hospitable waiters singing Italian, family photos covering the walls to the excellent food. Linguini with garlic and eggplant, prosciutto , I could go on and on.  Yummy!

Get atmosphere and superior service. I was not rushed out after our meal which is unusual in today's restaurants. I was welcomed by the owner and seated immediately. The food was above average and the drinks were not watered down. I highly recommend this restaurant to all visitors and native New Yorkers alike. Bravo!

I returned from 10 days in Spain and was craving all of the delightful food I had experienced there. I am also a long time fan of Amada, and when we didn't make our reservation on time Saturday evening, we decided to try Tinto since there were reservations still available. Now I know why... I was disappointed with this restaurant and with the reviews I am seeing. The hostess was pleasant but when we seated our waitress had a bit of an attitude. I asked about patatas bravas and if the potatoes on the menu were similar and she said she never heard of patatas bravas. That is like working at an American bar in Spain and saying you have never heard of French fries. Not a good start. Half of the food was good and the other half, sadly, not at all. The figs wrapped in hamon were dried figs. I would expect fresh. The crab had so much mayo mixed in, you could barely taste the crab much less any other seasoning. The pulpo was cooked well and good flavor, but at little too salty. I would order it again. The patatas were good, but after looking at other review pics and comments, I think we got shorted. We didn't have any of the delicious cream sauce that others speak of. The short rib sandwich was by far the best thing we got. Overall, I was disappointed given that it's a Jose Garces restaurant and the price of the food. Spanish food is incredibly fresh and this was far from it.

This restaurant is the worst ever! I recently went there and honestly their food menu looks good , but their real  food dishes  taste terrible they have a poor service !!! I've eaten  amazing and delicious ecuadorian food In other restaurants, but this place not compare to the others mentioned before. It's a totally waste of time and money.Not recommended.

Food was delicious but wait staff was rude, nasty and rushed our meal. We were a group of 5 looking to have several tapas and drinks and the woman waiting on us didn't answer any of our questions about the menu items, couldn't describe drinks on their drink menu and seemed annoyed that we were asking. True example of someone not liking what they do ... We were just trying to eat and drink which is what they serve at Yuca right - food and drinks ?  Not attitude? Then when she felt we didn't tip her enough...ran out of the restaurant to ask for more money... Gross. Best tip we can give is to at least be courteous - you're a waitress. You'd think we were begging for free food. We'll go elsewhere for our dinners...
I'm from SF and i came all this way to get THE LOBSTER ROLL. It was amazing. People that work there are super nice. MAKE SURE TO GET A LEMONADE. I am amazed, I wish we had a place like this in sf.

Brooklyn Proper is such a welcomed addition to the neighborhood. The decor is lovely and we'll thought out - I LOVE the mechanic's rags as napkins. The cocktails hit the spot because they are mostly vermouth-based, so I didn't feel too buzzed to enjoy my food. The food is so good. So, so good. All of the dishes were perfect to share. We ordered a bunch of things in order to try a variety and I'm glad we did. The highlights were the beef carpaccio and the zucchini dessert. The service was on point, staff was knowledgeable about their food and drink. I'll definitely be back for more!
Best crepes in the area. Hipster vibe. Friendly staff. Only con is limited seating.

The bread they use for their sandwiches is SO good. You can tell it's homemade bread and they cut the slices super thick. Yes the sandwich I got, the Vermont cured and smoked turkey, was great but I could just keep raving about the bread alone. Great deli spot right in the middle of downtown.

It's been awhile since I came back to Sabrina it was usually a good experience, but whatever you do, do not believe whatever time the hostess tells you. 25-35 mins? Sound reasonable. Until you wait for over 45 mins only for you to ask them how much longer the wait it. "Only another 25 mins" wtf. Seriously just tell your customer a fair estimate base on the previous wait time. So an hour and 15 mins later....but no worries.... Only another 25 mins before the food comes out of the kitchen. I didn't know you can "call ahead". There was 5 calls that call ahead and the hostess told all of them 35 mins. On another note, why is there empty table next to is when there are a bunch of people waiting before us?

Went here for brunch on 7/4/14. Outstanding food! We got the Turkey Club and the Biscuits and Thai Curry Gravy. Both were delicious, particularly the fried bacon on the sandwich. Also really enjoyed the Magdalena--a spicy margarita drink. Also huge props to the hostess, who did an amazing job taking care of everyone waiting for a table. She was super upbeat and nice, despite the crowds.

Truly amazing Sunday Brunch in fact we did not want to leave ! Valet parking all the guys so very nice,to the wonderful servers of coffee and drinks great job there is woman who does a great job of this and never forgets what you ask for she is on point!! Food a nd desserts very good and live the presentation !! My first time here today and will be back!!
Family style restaurant. Great service and food is a bit greasy. Also a bit too noisy.
Pretty decent pizza for the city. Really fast delivery and very generous proportions.
Just have a try. Not too sweet.

My boyfriend and I really enjoyed our experience at Blue Corn. He's Mexican, and he usually has comments about most Mexican restaurants we go to. He loved this meal. He devoured his plate. I got the salmon, which I don't normally eat fish and it was really good. Something to note, the summer sangria is amazing. I order sangria pretty everywhere I go, and this was the best I've had in a long, long time. I loved it. Their cocktails are the reason I will be going back the dessert was also really good. Looking for good food and good drinks? This place has it all!!

Hey - who wants me to write a review that is going to mince words and dance around the topic?  We cool?  Let's do this then.... You're in Montclair; have you noticed watering hole options?  Hey, Montclair has a bevy of attractive, reputable *fancy* eating establishments.  Yay.  I want a drink.  Guess what?  That's why I walked into The Office.  Upon the 2nd time I sat at the bar, Eric totally remembered me.... AND my husband.  FANtastic Happy Hour drink specials.  Friendly bar service. Does it look a Fridays?  Hella yes!  So what?  I didn't walk in here to get Lobster Thermidor; I came for a beer or a Greyhound or a glass of wine.   Pick your poison.... and your place for poison.  The Office  is exactly what I want/needed it to be. Now get back to the water cooler.

Great great addition to 36th ave in Astoria! Ever since coming back from Mexico City I have been looking for an authentic Mexican restaurant close by and have been hard pressed to find one with the same quality, until now. The tacos, although on the pricier side, are all great (I recommend the adobo, carne asada and/or the pescado/fish), a lot of flavor, tortilla not too overpowering and a great mix with the spicy sauces that they provide you with (careful, its hot!). I would also recommend adding the melted cheese. I also tried the ceviche and it is quite fresh and flavorful, definitely a pleasant surprise out in Astoria. Because they run the Mexico Blvd food truck, their hours are from 5pm to 11pm, no lunch unfortunately (at least for now). However, the late closing time definitely makes up for it. Definitely check it out!

I have become a frequent patron of this restaurant based on the excellent, freshly prepared food and fantastic drinks.  The decor is beautiful but I really go there for the food and drinks.  The seafood is always fresh and delicious.  The branzino is excellent as is the grilled stuffed calamari.  With each visit, we are making our way through the menu and have yet to hit a bad choice.  I also have enjoyed sampling the cocktails - the Santorini Sunrise is a wonderful summer choice.  But traditional drinks are also made to perfection.  It has become our go to place for dinner or for happy hour.

Hello fellow burger lovers, Today was my first time @ The Counter. I passed by a while ago but never stopped to eat. Today that changed; I decided to "build my own burger". I loved the idea of penciling in your order. You are given a sheet of all possible options & from here you  can order whatever you'd like and make your ideal burger. I went with the 1/2 lb veggie burger on a multigrain bun, I added red onions, cucumbers, carrot strings, sliced avocado, spinach, kale and spicy pepper jack cheese. It was great! I chose the garlic sauce as well as the chipotle sauce, which is served on the side so you can control your portions. I also had a side of the sweet potato fries. All this for $17.63, a little pricy for a burger but honestly this is no McDonalds burger. This thing is huge! I only ate half. Everything was made fresh. They have a nice layout, similar to Zinburger but a little more casual. They do serve liquor and have a long bar. Bruno attended me as well as another gentleman (forgot his name, sorry) and they were very polite and professional. I will definitely be coming back and bringing friends! Next time I will get the 1/3 lb patty, a little smaller that's more my speed, hahaha... You should definitely give it try for lunch, dinner, bite to eat with friends or boyfriend/girlfriend. Casual atmosphere & who doesn't love a good ol' burger! ;)
LOVED THE CHICKEN SANDWICH!!! Had the cheesecake the last time I was there...fantastic!  Great atmosphere!

I hate leaving negative reviews and I have a lot of empathy for people in the service industry. That said, the service here sucked and it ruined our entire experience. I came with a group of six people and we were seated within ten minutes. Not bad for a Friday night. But that was the end of the good times. The waiter kept confusing our order and wasn't very helpful. My friend ordered alcohol but it didn't get served until 20 minutes later. We never received water. Three burgers came out within half an hour but the other--which was also just a burger--took almost an hour. We did the polite thing and waited of our friend to be served before eating which meant our food got cold. We got chocolate cakes instead of chocolate shakes. Although that's a forgivable error, they brought out the cakes before our food. (Does cafeteria have a dessert first policy?) After all that wait, the food just wasn't worth it. When we spoke to the manager to complain about our experience, he said, "Wrll, don't tip your waiter then." Wow. How incredibly rude and unhelpful! Cafeteria won't get my money again. There are better places with people who actually care about their customers.

Tried hunters for the second time First time was brunch and I was far from being good So I gave it a second chance for dinner this time. Ordered the famous kale salad. Waiter came back 10m later saying they were out Ordered then the chicken Waiter came back another 10m or do later saying they were out By then I had nothing to eat and my date was already done with his appetizer So I tried the burger.... Asked to have it medium When it arrived to the table it was rare Sent it back to kitchen Came back as medium rare but definitely not medium Was also missing their famous aioli They kept apologizing but altogether not a good experience at all Will not go back!
Awesome!!!The falafel was heavenly. The fried flounder was crispy and delicious. This place makes u feel welcome esp. by it's owner Alli. So come enjoy the food!!!!!

STAY AWAY IF YOU HAVE A LARGE PARTY! We had a reservation for 14 and the service was horrible. The GOOD: A few standout dishes but rest were average. Definitely try the beef tongue, washu beef on hot stone, and black sesame creme brûlée. Rest were just okay. Nothing to write home about. (Definitely had better tuna tartar, fried chicken and pork, onigiri, and seaweed salad.) The BAD: There was a minimum per person, $50, which was an odd policy but no big deal since we were planning to order drinks and a lot of food. HORRIBLE SERVICE. Waitress had an attitude. She told one person in our party at the middle of the table what dishes were sold out but people at the ends of the table didn't hear. When someone tried to order a sold-out dish, she responded, "Didn't you hear me before? We ran out of that." Wow, really lady?! She brought out a dish that no one ordered. Conversation went something like this: Us: No one ordered this dish. Waitress: No, someone definitely ordered it (points finger at all of us). Us: Can you show us the order you took so we can see who may have ordered it? Waitress: No, you will not understand it. Us: Okay... Waitress: If no one wants it, we can take it away but you will still be charged for it. Us: Fine, we will just take it...... When the second-to-last dish came out, she came over and told us this was our last call for orders to the kitchen. Afterwards, we couldn't order any more  food. Then 5 seconds later,  a server gave away someone's dish to another person. He couldn't re-order the dish. Waitress was not accommodating at all. He was allergic to soy and couldn't eat the sauce that went with the noodles (that weren't his to begin with) so he asked for other accompaniments. He asked for a broth to which she said no. He asked for a dish of shredded seaweed to which she said no again. Her response was simply that all those accompaniments wouldn't taste good with the dish. The soba noodles had seaweed on it in the first place and he just wanted more seaweed! Needless to say, we didn't take the dish but ended up paying for it anyway. They gave out dessert menus while we were still eating our last dish, which definitely made us feel rushed. At this point, we knew they were trying to get us out as soon as possible. After such a terrible experience, we were surprised they didn't already include the tip (the best part of the evening). We left a below average tip (close to 15%) for below average service. The manager came over and asked us if the service was okay. We said "No, not really". He didn't apologize or try to understand where things went wrong. He simply said "okay" and walked away. Apparently, bad service runs at all levels of this restaurant. Maybe this place is good for smaller parties but definitely, do not come here if you have a large party. You have been warned!

Yummy yummy! I love getting the quesadillas instead of the taco because I love cheese! The melted cheese adds so much! Great to pick up and head up to the Highline for great views of the Hudson River.

My daughter's surprise Bridal Shower on Sunday, July 27th was absolutely fabulous!  The entire staff was accommodating, responsive and courteous.  All the guests were wowed by the atmosphere and quality/abundance of the food. The food was spectacular and the cake was a complete surprise as I didn't expect it to be such a tasty confection.  Furthermore, Buddy, Craig and Ken did everything as planned to make the afternoon a complete success! The servers anticipated our needs in advance and were included in the surprise with their efforts as decoys.  I am truly impressed and grateful for the wonderful event everyone orchestrated for us. It was a perfect party and I am usually a critical complainer!! Thank you so very much for this very special afternoon!!

my friend ordered a tart and the guy got the wrong one but they were so quick to fix it and apologized profusely. they were very friendly and the macaroons were to die for especially the lavender one. would definitly come back again.
It was sooo good!

Still a few things to work out, but a great start for a wonderful addition to LIC. Having gone to Peru last year, I was eagerly anticipating this restaurant's opening. The promise of pisco sours within walking distance of home was finally realized this week! The decor was simple, but casually elegant, featuring Peruvian pottery and other native art. The inviting interior also had a nice bar at the back, with it's own atmosphere different from the dining room. I think the pisco available in the US is not as strong as down in South America; that said, my pisco sour was very tasty, and as close to the real thing as I expect to find. My meal consisted of a shrimp chowder that was so big & full of shrimp, it could have been a main course. My actual main course was a huge braised lamb shank, accompanied by rice & beans and a small salad garnish. Very flavorful and filling. My partner had the skirt steak, which was cooked beautifully and topped with onion, peppers and roasted tomato. We finished the evening sharing a dessert of fried dough rings with a fig sauce to drizzle over them. While still not perfect (eager, but inexperienced wait staff; computers were down that night, too), JORA is a welcome addition to the neighborhood, and worthy of giving a try.
Great Israeli restaurant with amazing food! Definitely worth to get the tasting option on the menu and try a bunch of different things!

After reading a great article about this place I was super excited!! But after this experience I will not be going back and if you are reading this and still decide to go; good luck. I did call ahead and made a reservation so when we showed up (just the two of us) we were sat right away- good sign. Waited 20 minutes for our order to be taken. Ok, I'll let that slide since we did get waters right away upon being sat. We ordered a simple Caprese Salad as an app. While waiting 40 minutes for something that takes 1 minute to make, I decided to read more Yelp reviews; boy were they bad and everything that I read happened to us. So about 45 minutes in, the waitress told us that they ran out of the grass fed burger. What? What the heck were they doing for the last 45 minutes? Apparently not making our food. When our food finally came out- my chicken and waffles were missing the syrup (which I didn't realize at first). I noticed it was dry so I asked for extra syrup. The waitress can back and says they ran out. What??? Seriously?? So I asked if there was any syrup on my meal and there was not. Why even serve it to me??? I mean, I could see how the meal could have been good, but a dry waffle with chicken plopped on top. I didn't even eat a quarter of it. Our waitress was lovely! She was. But the slow, SLOW, service, and running out of one of your staple menu items (the burger and waiting 45 minutes to tell us) and running out of syrup, and the louder than life awful music where I could not hear my friend and the waitress. AWFUL. Just awful. I will not be going back. I'm disappointed because the good reviews were good. But please take caution when dining here. (On a side note, I mentioned my experience  to a friend and she said that when she dined here a week ago, they ran out of ketchup!! Who runs out of ketchup????)

Ordered delivery to my hotel room while on a trip. Quick delivery, friendly staff, and very good pizza. The regular thin crust was delicious and not too greasy, with LOTS of toppings. Definitely recommend if you're ordering in the South Brunswick area.
love this place and the food is not disappointing! Drinks and all day happy hour! I'm in.
Excellent vegetable curry (i forgot the name, starts with a K). Excllent chicken masala. daahl was good but not as great as the other two. Samosas were not that interesting. The sweet naan was great.
Possibly the most eclectic collection of really good food in the region. So many vendors under one roof it is mind boggling. Walk the aisles, smell the aromas, choose what you love!

this little gem of a store is in a small side street space where the lower rent is reflected in pricing, so compared to Sunrise or even Mitsuwa - this place is a bargain.  the owner is partners in a nearby sushi restaurant so they buy together in quantity and pass some saving on to shoppers here.  some ready to eat items in the fridge/freezer may be afford-ably made from that restaurant.  most Japanese snacks were $2, various dry mixes and wet condiments $4, while the cashier and manager can be helpful to English only shoppers.  there is a little of everything here in limited variety, but that's all this space can manage.  this is the perfect place to grab that missing ingredient on the way home, or sample a small portion of various items before stocking up on them elsewhere .  they stay open till 10pm, so if you are in Sunnyside for dinner, be sure to make a pit stop here as well.

If you don't care about customer service, this review is not for you, as the food is good. But if you do care about customer service, this might apply. They have a loyalty card, where if you buy 9 sandwiches, you get the 10th for free. No where on the card does it note a limit to the price of the sandwich, not even in fine prints. I ordered the short rib sandwich and went to pick it up. When I gave them the "free sandwich" card, they said "you owe me $1". I didn't have $1 with me, but did have my credit card. I asked if I could pay an extra $1 next time since I was a loyal customer, she said no, they couldn't do it that way. "You pay for the full sandwich and keep the card." I could have argued that nowhere does it say there is a price limit to the free sandwich. But she swiped my credit card and didn't even give me an extra stamp on a new card. If there should be a limit on the price of the free sandwich, please note it on the card, even if it's in fine prints. It really is such a shame, because I would have remained a loyal customer who lives very nearby. But because of this lousy $1, you have lost me. It probably doesn't matter since it looks like you have a pretty good customer base, but I hope you won't do it to anyone else.
