It's basic Chinese , why is the line so long. Must be over 200 other restaurants in Chinatown serving the exact same menu. I had the flounder and cold sesame noodles. I would recommend don't order this but I don't eat pork. Most other dishes here have pork including the dumplings. Can't they make a vegan dumpling? No not here. And it's cash only. What really annoyed me is that joes has a grade B for cleanliness. I will try other places in Chinatown. This one is for tourists only.
This restaurant ( tucked away in an alley ) is a diamond in the rough.  Typical crowded not pretty NYC place but worth the trip for the Dumplings, they are an absolute must have!

Horrible service !! Waited about 10 minutes before anyone attended the cashier . The young male  finally came and started taking care the ppl who were behind me . I then brought it to his attention that I was standing there before all the other ppl and he rudely said I was suppose to stand at his register not beside his register . He argued with me for a few minutes on where I should have been standing and I I said ok so that means you can't take my order he then says well what do want . At this point I am completely embarrassed , might I add I was with my seven year old son who is nervous at this point . I just ordered a water cause I wanted to run out of there when I intended to go in for dinner. As he gives me my order and I start to walk out he starts yelling out sarcastically "have a great day lady" your a real nice lady" ?!?!?!?! I have never in my life been treated by a food establishment like that. A shame because I here the food is good . But the customer service is horrible!!!
Their steakhouse burger is one of the best burger in NYC. Love their fries too. The Chocolate hazelnut doughnut is great as well.

The best ethnic food off the path. Hands down better than any Newark place and prices and service are excellent. The place is nicely decorated and has a busy bar trade. Best sangria ever. Never a wait either so you can visit anytime.

Nice restaurant, aesthetically... But the food leaves lots for wanting. Their best plate was the one filled with simple pita bread. I had the snapper and once I got over the blown up eyeballs on my plate (which could have easily been wiped off), I realized the food was .... Well, just: meh.

Came here last night for the time and I CANNNOT wait to come back! Place looks really small and you don't really notice the store front as you're walking past. I came in with my boyfriend and some friends and we opted to sit in their backyard which is so cute. I love the mural and vine they have. Our waitress Seagan was awesome she recommended the perfect choices for us so that we could try a little bit of everything. We got a butchers platter with their specialty BURNT ENDS. Our waitress described the exact cooking process and what meat it was so now I'm obviously a BBQ expert. But seriously 14 hr smoked beef tips PILE THEM ON! I only wish we got more. We also got their Philipino sausage sweet and tangy, their pork belly yum and 1 sauced ribs and 1 dry ribs. Our lovely waitress recommended the Mac and sweet potato wedges. They put maple syrup and cinnamon on them which makes them heavenly! We also got corn on the cob which looked bland but tasted so sweet! Props to them for using organic products. We ordered string beans as well which were good although not my favorite. I'm so happy we went had a great time! Bring booze although they do have two beers I'm bringing some alc to spice up my Arnold Palmer next time! Thanks butcher bar xoxo

Underwhelmed.... After waiting two months for a reservation and awaiting a Top Chef meal, I was sadly disappointed. I wish I dined with many of the reviewers who have rated their experience with 5 stars. My evening didn't come close. The much-awaited  gnocchi had perfectly crispy pancetta but was the consistency of porridge and overly salted. My pork entrée was served at room temperature, not even warm. The cheek and belly were both tasty, but I could hardly chew the loin. I related this to the server, but nothing was done to correct the situation. In my opinion, Laurel is overpriced and overrated. I am much more "Fond" of the restaurant down the street.

Great place to eat and the prices are very reasonable. We dined here on our way to a movie. We started sharing a plate of Pinxto Imperio, skewers of Crimini mushroom slices, crispy fried tofu, and probably the best Chorizo sausage I have had. Heated and served with a Mirin soy sauce, delicious! Next we shared a plate of Spanish Cheese Puffs made with Manchego and Smoked Gouda and served with a creamy sweet Red Pepper purée. I and my partner enjoyed these, they had plenty of flavor, but I was surprised that they were served cold, as was the sauce. Beth ordered a glass of Sangria (only $4!) and enjoyed it very much. (I am a teetotaler.) I had cup of the Seafood Stew with Linguica ($4.95) the broth was delicious, and loaded with potatoes, the Linguica was great, but I did not find any of the Mussels that were supposed to be in the pot. I would certainly order this again. On to the sandwiches, I ordered the Uncle Pop Pop's Old Fashioned, super thin slices of Serrano Ham served on a Croissant and accompanied by a cup  of Tomato and Butternut Squash and Vermont Cheddar Cheese Puffs. The soup was amazing, I you have got to try it! The Serrano Ham was piled on a commercially made croissant without any condiment so the flavor of the Ham was allowed to stand on its own. Perhaps a condiment on the side would be nice. Beth had the Sweet & Spicy Meatloaf which is served on Challah. It was fabulous! Not too sweet, or too spicy it was well heated and delicious! Save room for dessert! We shared a serving of Doughnut Bread Pudding ($4) made with old fashioned doughnuts and topped with a rum flavored glaze. We savored every morsel. The owner/Chef Adam and his crew are very friendly, without being intrusive. I am sure that they have a bright future ahead of them.

If you need finding some filipino also American you can take a trip here with the best part of your choice.This is an especial place in this city as they have stuff from different countries.Inviting others to take trip here because they take order even through phone.Like to agree with others review obviously it location convenient amazing service friendly.
Worst service ever, almost killed my friend who as food allergy.shame on u and ur unprofessional staff
Don't even bother placing an order. Rude with hearing issues, after taking forever to get my order right I had to finally cancel after he hung up forgetting to take down my cc #.

Astoria has many good Brazilian restaurants, but Beija Flor beats them all. From the the charm and ambiance of dining inside with live musicians playing authentic samba music to the excellence of their commitment to making the best delivery experience, I strongly recommend.

Very elegant restaurant from the food presentation to the decor. Service was top notch as well, I really have nothing bad to say about this place. Just try it is all I really have to say, you won't regret it.

Very good food, but HORRIBLE SERVICE Never have been so dissaponted of a restaurant the way I was about OH! CALAMARES. Waited over 35 min for breakfast service; in the meantime, people who showed up after we did, were already eating. We asked for an extra bread, after 13 min, we asked again and her replied to us was 'sorry, but we ran out of bread'. Very dissapointed didn't want to leave a tip, but we did after all; because the food was very good. It was my first time coming to this restaurant suggested by a closed friend to the owner. NEVER AGAIN!!

I honestly really love this place. Lance - the manager is very attentive to your needs, helping you out and suggesting what you may like - excellent service, I was impressed. The perfect ambience outside on the patio for a good Sunday night or any other night. My friend and I started with appretizers, Tuna Tartare, Mussels, Arepitas, and Lobster Mac and Cheese, it was so delicious - we were full. We also ordered Coconut Mojitos and they are to die for! Just perfect with it's coconut flakes on top - and it's great presentation, they will get you buzzed (we all want that in a drink). If you are a "Tres Leches" fan, Let me say that they have a "Coconut Tres Leche" that is to die for and it's like heaven on every bite. It's not overwhelm with too much milk or too dry, it's just perfect. I highly recommend. I wish I had seconds but the way I ate here, eliminates all that. Great food, I highly recommend it!

This restaurant used to be one of my favorite places to visit in the neighborhood; great food, nice ambience,  and decent prices. However after the experience I had yesterday,  I will not be coming back here and urge you to take your business elsewhere as well. My friend is allergic to red peppers and asked the waiter if it would be possible to substitute that ingredient for something else in the egg scramble. She was rudely told that if she read the menu, she would see no substitutions are allowed;  really,  even when a person is allergic? Additionally the gentleman didn't mention that the side of potatoes had red peppers. When my friend asked for little oil to be used they brought out eggs literally swimming in oil. Another customer was almost reprimanded for ordering too much food when ordering a burger with bacon and some crabcakes. Is this how we deserve to be treated when we choose to have a meal in a restaurant?  To be told that we are fat or should suffer because of an allergy? Finally,  when I found out that the waiter was the manager of the restaurant (with much shock)  and told him how his behavior was offending the customers and not great for business (especially when there are so many restaurants around the corner) he simply laughed it off and insisted that he did nothing wrong.. very classy Mr. Owner/Manager whoever you are. Do yourself a favor and go eat at one of the places where you feel the restaurant staff actually WANTS you to have a great experience and is appreciative of your business.
Excellent establishment! Great drinks (try the sangria), and the mushroom burger was very good. Thanks!
There food is okay, not going to lie. But I stopped eating here after they were closed for 2 weeks due to health violations. That's enough to make me stop going there.
chicken souvlaki is to die for here with a lot of flavour and the tzatziki sauce was amazing! you could eat it plain. would come back soon.
Very poor selection of main entrees on the buffet.  Had to ask  for new plates to go back up to buffet,  otherwise was under the impression that you used the same plate.

Truly, the Boathouse Café is the new hidden gem of Third Ward Park.  Whether you are meeting a friend for good conversation or recovering from a long jog, the café is your home away from home.  The owners and staff will take good care of all of your needs, no matter what your dietary or religious preferences are.  The café aims for an upscale European vibe while keeping prices reasonable and in my humble opinion, both aims are achieved.  Furthermore, the café is dedicated to integrating itself into the community and welcomes partnerships that will bolster the city's growth and development. Kudos to the owners for bringing the boathouse back to life!

today we did a dinner  in shalimar restaurant  this is really  good  restaurant  u have to go and try specially lamb chops and chiken chapli kabab i also order for take out they have really good service for take out is well they make dozen kabab with in 15 mint and all were fresh and juicy i personally recommend each and one of you go and enjoy the beautiful atmosphere shalimar rocks

It was our anniversary,our friend recommended us to try this place. Our reservation was for 10.30pm because they had nothing before that..however First thing we walkin and see empty tables in the front.. We arrived early by 9.45pm and asked the hostess(amateur) if there's a table available earlier then please get us seated..she said she will try..We r still seeing the front tables empty but not bothering the hostess assuming it's reserved.. Now 30 minutes pass by,we are still waiting,we see a couple walkin and they tell the hostess we don't have a reservation but mentioned they knew somebody,and they were given a table in 5mins.. We r still waiting and mind you they have no waiting area we r just standing by the bar.. After 35mins I ask the hostess what about these tables in the front..and she goes like'Oh you don't mind seating in front' I was like ya we just wanna eat and get out of there..Wish she had asked us 40mins ago I would have said yes..but know that we waited this long wanted to see what special arrangements they had for us inside.. Now it's 10.30pm our reservation timing..Still no table..eventually they seat us inside at 10.45pn In a nice table.. Umm the food was good.that's y the 2 stars.. For main we had,spaghetti which was great..but steep price $24 ..but still worth it as it's perfectly balanced with the sauces and spices. Starters..Polenta mushroom was nice too $19 I wish it was served hot though... Also had crispy fritto misto $17 I wish they had some more calamari in it..it was 2 pieces of calamari ring,some cauliflower,green beans..Meh.. Seems like they r keeping the food cost low to make high profit margin..again wish it was served hot,it was luke warm. We wanted to try the desert as it was our anniversary  but after the horrible experience with the hostess just wanted to get out of there.. No apologies from management..Coz I'm sure they think they are too good..and don't care about the customers..and making good money with small quantity of food. I hope they can fix the hostess and train her well to do her job!!!
The pancakes and deep friend bacon are awesome. I wish you could get just one pancake. The wait though is not fun.

I ordered Chicken Gyro Shawarma for delivery while got grilled chicken instead. To make things wrong, the delivery guy refused to give me correct amount of changes because he ran out of $1 dollar bills. The wrong experience I've ever had!!!!

After an extremely pleasant experience here three weeks ago, we were sorely disappointed by the blatant lack of respect from the wait staff. We were a group of about six seventeen-year-olds going out for brunch on a Sunday morning. We were seated at a table which was still dirty from the previous group's meal and we were not given cutlery until we asked. The restaurant was ridiculously crowded and painfully understaffed. After waiting 40 minutes to receive our beverages and another hour for our food, we realized that parties which had arrived after us had already received and finished their meals. Since we were a large group, our waitress refused to give us separate checks. Rather, she gave us one check and made it our responsibility to divide it among ourselves. This was rather difficult and frustrating considering some of us wanted to pay with cash and others with a card. We tried to be very clear about how we were paying but our waitress did not understand and made a rude comment. Although the food was delicious, we had a hard time enjoying the overall experience. We feel that we were given less attention from the wait staff and taken advantage of simply due our age.
You will wait FOREVER to even give your order. Then wait another lifetime for a glass of water!  I can't even talk about the food because I'm STILL WAITING  for just my water.

I've gone here twice, both experiences a little different. The first time, the waiter was so nice and friendly. The grande nachos are dynamite! For my entree, I got enchiladas which were very good. The strawberry daiquiri could've been improved. The second time, the food orders came out so quickly, we didn't get a chance to digest or finish the appetizer. The waitress wasn't as friendly and brought the food out so fast, it was a little too much!

Food: The chocolate croissant was a bit cold and honestly a bit chewy. I love croissants, this wasn't bad but I would not recommend it as a good croissant. The Shitake sandwich was very delicious with braised greens (spinach), the potatoes had a citric hint to them. I did enjoy the sandwich. HOWEVER! I sat at the chef's counter and guess what my company was? FLIES! I counted at least 10 of them standing on the mirror/wall next to me at once. I took a picture of the mirror and managed to capture 3 flies in the photograph. They stood on the plates that were "clean" waiting to be used by the chef, the napkins waiting for new customers, it was disgusting. I asked the chef about it and he just accepted that since all their windows  on 18th st were open, they had a fly problem. So bottom line, no shitake sandwich is worth having lunch with 300000 flies.  Go during the winter when you can be rest assured you won't get worms from eating here.

Agree with many of the reviews already posted.  We had Lasagne and it was cold, not great at all. Service was not great, never passed by to see if we were ok, several of us needed drinks.  The Tiramisu is terrible, too sweet and this is our third and last time complaining to them about this dessert.
Quick, friendly service, cheap eats, and I dream about the Pho... I wish I did not live 2 hours away I would eat it daily if I could.  Will eat here everytime I am in Burlington!

The food and service were amazing!!! Took my wife there and it was great.  The appetizers were served quick and large portions.  The main course came and it was even better portions.  Definitely get your money's worth. We finished with flan which was off the chart!  We will definitely be going back there for sure and recommend to all our friends.
One of the best pizza that I've ever had in NYC. I got the margarita one with pepperoni and meatballs and it is damn good.

We went to North End Bistro twice in 48 hours. Food was excellent. We had two of the Mac and cheese entrees (lobster and cheeseburger) and two types of soft tacos (steak and carnitas). The only thing better was the service; hat tip to Carrie and Melissa. Wine selection was small, but excellent choices on hand. We really enjoyed the Sangiovese. This is now our go to place when we are in Princeton.

I treated my sister to the brunch buffet today. We were very excited about the experience because if the menu and, for the price ($30 per person (20% GRATUITY DESPITE OF THE PARTY SIZE AND ITS A BUFFET SO YOU PRETTY MUCH SELF SERVED)), we were expecting great food. When we walked in almost immediately you can smell a kind of odor like old rugs. It was very musty. The desserts were placed right at the entrance. We were seated at a small table for two with the view facing the filthy water and dirty side of the walkway because the buffet is at the lower deck. The food was extremely distasteful. Everything was poorly flavored. For that price you would think that the food would be better. Everything was poorly prepared and the quality was very cheap. We were very hungry and yet we did not eat much of anything. All in all our experience was extremely disappointing. It was a waste of our money and I really would not recommend this place to anyone. It's very run down inside and everything was very outdated and dusty. Not worth the price that they charged.

Fries with aioli sauce were really delicious. Everyone in our party was happy with food. Service was a little slow due to understaffing but when I mentioned to our waiter that we were in a hurry to get to a concert he worked very hard at getting our food out quickly and getting us out on time. Good choice of beers on tap and good happy hour prices and choices. We would definitely go back! We sat on the street which adds to good Philly vibe.

I really wanted to like this place; I love dim sum, it's a couple blocks away from my apartment, and at first glance it looks like a great restaurant to drop by on your way home from work to get quick carryout. It isn't. I've now been here 4 times and leave every single time more pissed off than the last. The first two times I went, I spent 20 minutes waiting for my food after ordering at the counter--I was one of 3 customers in the place. But those two times the food was pretty good, so I kept coming. The third time, I called in a takeout order so as to avoid the long wait. I show up 20 minutes after my call and they say "oh, sorry, we forgot to put in your order"--and then wait another 20 minutes. Luckily, I was the ONLY customer there. That third time, the food really wasn't as good--I'm pretty sure everything they make here is frozen ahead of time, and my crystal shrimp dumpling order had this really tough skin, almost like it had gotten freezer burn. The fourth time, I decided to take a chance and order online via their website--I've never had a problem with online ordering from any of the probably close to 100 places I've ordered from before. I wait 30 minutes, then show up to get my food; lo and behold, they haven't even put the order in yet. Meanwhile, there are closer to 20 people there at that time. What they did next is literally one of the most frustrating things a restaurant has ever done--they put my order, which was put in 30 MINUTES PRIOR to anyone else's online, BEHIND everyone else's order! I swear I waited 50 minutes for what was literally the most disappointing dim sum I've ever had (and I frequently make it at home with frozen dumplings, so I've had some bad stuff). They got half the order wrong (note: always check the bag before you leave--they have messed it up 2 of the 4 times I've ordered carryout) & 2 of the dishes were cold. I know New Haven has a dearth of good Asian food and we pretty much have to put up with what is available, but this is ridiculous. In the time I waited today for my online order, I could have been halfway to Manhattan to have real dim sum. Last point: their stuff is REALLY overpriced.

I needed to be in and out in thirty-five minutes so that I could make my train back to the city. The staff delivered and then some. Service was very fast; I ordered, got my food, ate, paid, and left in less than half an hour. I've rarely had such prompt and high-quality service. Additionally, the food was great. I had the pancakes with whipped cream, strawberries, and chocolate chips, and it was amazing. Some of the best pancakes I've had in a long time. The eggs were seasoned well and highly flavorful. And the bacon, though thin, was tasty and worked as a salty contrast to the sweetness of the pancakes. I also had a fruit smoothie to drink, which was delicious. This is easily the best restaurant I've tried in Germantown, and I definitely plan to return the next time I'm in the area.

Karaka Men ramen is to die for good. Pork buns and shishito are out of this world. Best ramen I've had in NYC. Knocked off a star because the wait is so ridiculous. But you won't be disappointed. N.B. I've had good luck going on my own and getting seated right away.

Wow! Very good food. Very amazing. The place is nice and clean and one of the best ramen stops in the neighborhood. Place can order to go or there to eat. When ordering to go they put the soup and noodles and other food separate so that when you go back home. Nothing is soggy and still has crunch and texture. Beautiful.

First, I'm not much or a review writer, but had to write one for this place.  Came here for my birthday last week. This place is A.M.A.Z.I.N.G!   We were 6 of us so got to try quite a few different things.  I was a little concerned about the $15 cocktails some previous reviewers had talked about, but all our cocktails were $12.50 and good solid pours.  We were all buzzed after 3 (or was it 2 ;-).  My favorites were the Army & Navy, Aviation and the Punch! For food, here's what to try. Tiger Prawns, Pani Puri, Chilli Cheese Toast,  Butter Chicken Masala, Saag Paneer, Fried Okra, Bombay hash browns, and Biryani  (we had lamb and chicken and it was too close to call which is better). Dessert: We had Benoffe cake & the Rum Ball. Ask them to do the birthday prep.....and you're in for a treat. Whole room turns dark, funky bollwyood music and dancing girls with sparklers.  Planning a friend's next birthday there!
Come here for amazing food, depending on day of the week and mood of the owner good service! Today not the day for service or friendliness!

If you come here, expect long wait time. I came here on a Sunday early afternoon and waited for over 40 minutes to get a table. Food: The pizza was pretty good. However, they didn't use a lot of toppings. The cheese was pretty good and fresh. Interior: They were playing Frank Sinatra and it was great. The place is definitely very cramped and not much room to move. I would most likely not come back because of the long wait time.
One of the worst cheesesteaks I had, service was bad too. Oil for the fries was dirty! Will not come back ever!
I went to Mirch Masala for the first time after a comedy show last night.  Absolutely fantastic Indian food.  Service was great as well.  I live around the corner and will return often.
Absolutely my new favorite spot when I visit NY.great service,great atmosphere and some of the best mussels I've ever had!

Came in and ordered a tuna salad wrap. 30 minutes later I'm still waiting. saw someone come in and also get served after me. Also ordered a smoothie. Smoothie is cold but has no ice in it. Tastes like strawberry milk; which it is. Not sure of why this place has gotten a good review. Service is slow. @Ipek some people have other things they want to do with the day. Waiting for close to 40 min for a tuna wrap is not one of them. There was no line and empty tables and everything I ordered was cold (low prep time). If the man did order before me then his wait must have been even longer if he had been waiting before me. Maybe he had the right idea and left to do what he wanted to do and came back. In either case the wait was long. Service was very friendly, and I'm sure for some people that is all they desire. But anyone thinking they could get a quick bite to eat will be very disappointed.

This place has it all--fantastic (inventive) drinks, good food options (though I haven't ordered any large plates), and really wonderful ambiance. The back patio is delightful in the summer! Honestly, any place I can get an artisan cocktail and a plate of warm cookies (yes, that's right, warm cookies) while sitting outside enjoying the great CT summer weather is great in my book.

The place is nice specially in the summer.  The music is good... But the service is terrible. The bartenders take at least 15 minutes before they even acknowledge you! Specially if you are a female you will have no luck with getting a drink. !!! Horrible service !!!
Awesome restaurant!!! Great good, quick service and excellent margaritas!! Relatively inexpensive too. Will be back!!

I WILL NEVER GO BACK TO THIS RESTAURANT AGAIN! The wait is not worth the LACK of service you receive. They will never see my money again. For starters we were basically rushed through our meal, our waiter barely came to our table to check to see if we were okay, we had to constantly flag him down. Also I went to the restroom and found money on the floor. I went to one of the men working there and GAVE IT BACK TO HIM. When leaving I left the waiter a tip that he DESERVED and the same man I returned the money to came back and said this tip isn't enough. This was completely unprofessional! How dare you tell me what I should tip you! You gave me horrible service and yet you want a $15 tip when I left you $8 and you didn't even deserve that! I will never go here again and I will tell all my friends and family the same as well. The food isn't worth it, trust me!
Was really good but a little to over hyped.  Clam pie was the better of the two i tasted.

We had dinner here last night, four of us. While the restaurant is small (tiny!), the atmosphere is great and the food is worth the wait + tight squeeze. Not to mention, it is a BYOB, my favorite! I highly recommend the market salad + pyramid pasta (summer menu).

My girlfriend and I went here once for dinner and the food was terrible. After the meal they told us the internet was down so they weren't accepting credit cards, but we could use the ATM which charged a fee to take money out. We will never go back here again.
Soup dumplings are the best ever.   Great service.

We went here for dinner last night. We were five people, including one with gluten intolerance and a nut allergy, one pescetarian and one vegetarian. Because it was a tasting menu, the server and chef came out to discuss every course with us and describe what they would make for each person with a limited diet if the course they'd planned didn't work for us. The chef didn't just take away ingredients from dishes she'd planned in order to make them safe for us, but made totally new, just as delicious items instead. They were not only accommodating but completely prepared. The menu looks small on first glance but, other than the entrees where you choose one from a list of three, you literally get to eat everything else on the menu. I think I counted about 9 different dishes. The food was so fresh and flavorful and hyper seasonal. Super recommend!

My fiance and I go to this BBQ place a few times a year and their food is nothing short than incredible and full of flavor. I ordered a BBQ chicken sandwich and a side of burnt ends the BBQ sauce is delightful! My fiance ordered the same and was equally impressed. We also came in just before closing the and employees still greeted us with smile and we stayed to eat and they did not rush out even though they were closing. We look forward to many more visits to Uncle Willies!
Came here for restaurant week and everything was really yummy. Service was speedy and really great and all in all it was a nice experience here
Small space and often very busy & crowded, but great pizza. I stopped in here a few times for a late night slice while wandering around Times Square.
This used to be one of our favorite places. The food is still delicious but prices have gone up and food portions are down. We can go to much fancier place for that kind of money.
Overall, an enjoyable place to grab some BBQ or tacos and a few beers.  I especially enjoy the tuna tacos and the pickle chips.
Get get get the pancakes. The regular buttermilk pancakes are some of the best I've had.

You can beat that, that this place serves a fantastic portions of good quality food at a most affordable price, at that time of the hour and lastly at the safest locations. I have been there plenty number of time, some time days in a row, If you are drunk or sober, you will relish their food.
1 want  with  my family  to taz  food is  good  but  service  need  to good  .price is  very good  to
mint

It was inexpensive and good quality food. The shaved noodle was as good as it gets. A true Chinese culinary master piece! My whole family including my 6 year-old boy (who is a very picky eater) enjoyed the meal very much!

Been here several times with wife and family and without a doubt one of the best Italian meals around! Not only is the food outstanding but so is the staff, they go above and beyond to ensure you have a fantastic dining experience. We had risotto with shrimp and asparagus, meatball and garlic toast with mushroom topping for apps. I had the swordfish special for dinner, all was amazing. Will definitely be going back.
Best bar in Philly!  Great food, great beer, great atmosphere!
Went out to this place with a few friends from Jersey and loved it.  The food was great, drinks were even better and the servers were very friendly and responsive.  I'd make the trip out there again.

The food is excellent and the atmosphere is pretty good where the waiters/waitresses are super friendly: the service is great and the desserts and the appetizers (my favorite are the mozzarella sticks) are out of this world fantastic!
Great contemporary and organic food. Delicious. The only thing is that the restaurant is a bit small and it feels a bit restricted at times when you're sitting. But, the food is great and fresh.

There is no way to give zero stars, so that is why this diner gets one star... and  that is way above what it deserves.  We went to the Lyndhurst Diner last night with a few friends and had a horrible time.  The two waitresses who took our order were not communicating with each other.  We did not have menus, but one waitress started taking our order as if we had one to look at... literally going around the table saying "you... and you".   They did not seem to understand who ordered what selection.  One of them delivered the wrong dinners to two people... and the food was terrible!  A roast beef dinner was a few pieces of deli roast beef lying on a bare plate.  The mashed potatoes came on another plate and plopped down on the table with a bang.  My gyro was dry and had an odd flavor.  A friend also had the gyro dinner and was sick all night because of it. My wife's Cesar salad had little lettuce in it, and the chicken that came with it was dry and over cooked.  The cole slaw that came with my dinner was served in a small paper cup... are you kidding me????  paper???..and it was bland at best. I can say that between the poor service and horrible food, we'll never go back...
i love gyro and lamb gyro was really good. i loved it.

Amazing selection, fresh seafood, quick service. It's BYOB but there's a liquor store two or three blocks away -- just to be safe bring your own. We started off with oysters -- excellent. Moved onto the lobster bisque -- very good, larrrgeee portion. Finished off with the mixed grill special for the night - salmon and swordfish and I got the scallops. Everything tastes wonderful, light and fresh. I would love to come back.
NOISE! Good food, OK coffee, moderate price but much too noisy from a terrible heating/AC system to enjoy a peaceful meal.

I love this place. I've picked up lunch while at work, had intimate dinners, and frequent take out and I am never disappointed. The owners are this cute Thai couple who are as nice as ever. The food is delicious- I love the Paneng Curry! The restaurant itself is tiny (townhouse living room sized) and the tables are a bit close to eachother. That's probably the only thing that isn't my favorite, but stopping by when it isn't busy makes for a pleasant experience.
Food is great and the staff are extremely friendly! I will definitely be a repeat customer!

Food from Pal's is good but the rest is overpriced. The staff who take your order are usually pretty nice but the majority of the ones who you are forced to interact with to pay are curmudgeons who obviously were given a job after they complained about being at home, because no one who thought they have to actually work would act like that.

the bread is old and it looked moldy. the hygiene of the cutlery and dishes is pretty low. the dishes do not even try to resemble italian. however the entre course was nice. the personnel is friendly but behaves frustrated. overall, never again.
Absolutely to die Saturday brunch! amazing cocktail selection and the food was fantastic- big ass biscuit with sausage gravy and grits!! def visiting again

Food is excellent, but sorry to say that the service was pretty horrible :( we had a reservation for 10 on a Saturday and it took about 2 hours to get our food and only about 3 other tables in there. :( our waitress was very unfriendly and barely came to check on us or let us know why food was taking long. Our out of town guests commented how food was delicious but how horrible the service was. Wouldn't go there with a larger party.
Get the chicken biscuit! It's so good. The cajun burger is meh.
Your food was incredible and I want to come back despite the photos of the rats leaking on the table. Did someone set you up? Your still one of my fav breakfast spot in the city.

After a day of shopping with friends we stopped in for a quick bite and drinks.  What a great little bistro!  The staff were very accommodating of our party of five.... very courteous and attentive.  The owner even came over to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.  Each of our meals were delicious.  Some of us ordered "bistro classics" while others really enjoyed some more modern/creative dishes. Needless to say, we ended up eating off of each other's plates.  The waitress noticed what we were doing and instead of being frowned upon she actually brought us extra plates and silverware -- so nice.  I can't wait to go back with my husband and will definitely tell my friends and colleagues about this hidden gem!   After having such a pleasurable experience at Bistro Les Amis I had to write a review and ended up reading through some of the others written before me, most all of which were positive and complimentary.  I have to say that I'm a bit confused and taken aback by the review left by H.G. of Montauk.  It seems to be such an angry, personal attack rather than a review of his or her dining experience.  A shame that the avenue given with Yelp for sharing personal experiences and recommendations is used by some in very petty and hurtful ways.

Bistro Les Amis is a wonderful downtown NYC restaurant that I've been visiting for years every time I'm in the area. The cozy interior, the always friendly and kind owners and staff, the unique and very tasty food are the reasons that I keep coming back again and again. I always feel like home, going there for a nice lunch or just for a drink. For me, amongst the rich variety of NYC restaurants, Bistro Les Amis have a very reputable and distinguishing place as a restaurant that always exceeds my high expectations. For all of the above, I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone who appreciates delicious food and great quality service.
Been going here since I can remember! Great atmosphere, quick service, and great steaks! If you tip the lady behind the counter she tells the cooks and they all say thanks in unison, it's awesome.
Great food! Sandwiches take a while but they are worth it. If they took Bitcoin, I would spend 2x as much money here.
Great food, atmosphere, frozen drinks and impeccable, friendly service!  Luis is running a good ship there!

The pizza is consistently good and there are gluten free options. I think it's the best pizza in this part of Vermont.  In the summer lots of fresh local veggies used. As for the service, we usually order take out and it's always been done when they said -- so I can't comment on that.

I'll start by saying nothing was offensively bad here or anything like that, but I was sorely disappointed by what I got for my money.  If I spend $50 on dinner for two, I'd like to leave full, not making plans to find the nearest pizza place as I head out the door.  Some specifics: - $5 leek tart was literally the size of a Chips Ahoy/oreo cookie (could be finished in one bite) - $13 lentil "entree" consisted of a small bowl of cold lentils with a few carrots (albeit cute ones) on top - $8 squash ribbons with pecorino had only 3 pieces of pecorino in it and sorely lacked seasoning - $4 sweet potato wedges with maple creme fraiche were excellent.  The creme fraiche sauce was divine and was the sole reason I didn't give this place 1 star General feedback: I definitely expected bigger portions sizes for the cost, and it would be nice if they served complementary bread and butter, or something comparable, instead of charging $4 for it.  While the vegetables were all very fresh, I left too hungry to call my experience there satisfying.  If anything, I would recommend going for tapas (since that's basically what it was) and cocktails, but certainly not for dinner.

We had dinner there twice and had a great experience both times. we ate in the backyard and two beautiful nights. service was great and the food was unexpected. Stripped Bass fish sticks to the Grilled Cheese with Tomato Jam!!!!!!!! GREAT!!!!!! The wheat beer was great , tasty and cold.......
Great service!  Friendly staff!  Great food!  Would certainly go again
Mashed potatoe pizza was out of this world...
Excellent sushi...

Wow. I was really impressed by Hudson Eats. First, the esthetics and layout of this place are amazing. It's spacious and inviting. There's no denying it's definitely a high end food court without the typical food court feel. You can tell a lot of thought went into the design, I mean even the food trays are cool. Who ever came up with this idea is genius. For me, the food options are on point, and satisfies all my typical food cravings. Mexican, sushi, ban mi, burgers.... I could spend a pay check here. The best feature for our family, is the spacious layout which allows families like ours stroller access and a great weekend place to meet up.
Great prices for decent food. I took one star off for dine in. Our table was so sticky.
The food is good but their service is bad. Sometimes they would rush through my orders and forget to give me my rice etc.. I just wish they wound't get mix up all the time
Best Italian food in the area and very friendly staff

Delicious food. Legit farm to table restaurant with a beautiful decor and very polite and helpful staff. A bit pricey and the portions are small but we had a fabulous experience. Try to make a reservation in advance, but if you do not mind an early dinner just walk in by 6pm and you should have no problem getting a table.

Good place to go for a bite to eat on church street if your not looking to spend much. Pizza by the slice and plenty of other good Italian dishes to choose from, like stuffed shells. Yummy! Service is average but this isn't an upscale establishment like others on Church St.

Fantastic addition to an already amazing food neighborhood. Loved my sake cocktail, the Caesar Salad was tangy and not too creamy. The Tarte Flambee with scallops was complex and sublime. Can't wait to go back and try everything else.

Can't really understand how a big operation could get it so wrong. Ordered food at 835pm and it about an hour for them to get it 'right'. Food (Stromboli) was first nuked, which wasn't acceptable. 4 slices of pizza took half an hour. Another part of meal close to an hour.  Sorry, who you hire will impact your business.

amazing! oysters, scallops, and roasted octopus were fantastic, $6 prosecco is hard to beat, and the service is great. came here with a friend while in town for business and I'd highly recommend this restaurant to anyone.

Went with my husband and my out-of-town family in July and everyone LOVED it!  I would have to say the brisket was the best, but I enjoyed everything I tried.  Also, the bartender that night was excellent!  Definitely going back now that we live close.

The service in this place was not impressive. After placing our orders, the food came rather quickly. It was not a busy night. The food was delicious but they never came to the table and check if everything is ok. I had to raise my hand to get something to drink. Then I wanted to order Naan, i had to raise my hand again to get the servers attention. During our meal no one came to the table, not even to refill our waters. I gave it three stars for lame duck service.
I have been dreaming about the mussels... La Sirene will be one of my first stops when I return to New York in a few months.  DIVINE!

Got yelp  deal and is close to my area so decided to check it out wth the gf. I really wanted to give higher but there's nothing I could do. Got there round 6-630 it's a decently large open inside.  Decor was alright seemed like a good type of music night out. We were just about the only people there, so I ordered a crab burger and she got hat city salmon salad. Food came out almost an hour later. My crab burger was mush, they brought the gf the wrong salad. The woman bartender was nice she fixed it in 5 minutes later, but the salmon was raw in the center. Prices were pretty high on top of it. Could be a place to get a beer if your right there on the weekend, but besides that I wouldn't go back.
Awesome burgers and milkshakes! Try their Chipotle Bison Burger and Mushroom Swiss Burger. Anything you order from their menu is great. The burger selection is huge and are cooked perfectly.

Sure... the business has been SLIGHTLY declining but the place makes great food overall. I love EVERYTHING alfredo-sauce-style they do. It's amazing. Also, I really enjoy the plain pizza.  Not to mention, the guys who work inside are just great guys. There is one in particular who is always so nice and happy and he is the reason I keep coming there, he just makes you feel like he's giving you a good deal. (Even though they are giving you a great deal most of the time). One unfortunate thing I noticed is that I went there about a year ago and got tons of bread, so much food that I had to take it home, and paid a regular price. Few days ago, I went and got the same thing. It was one "thing" of bread, the food wasn't stacked heavily like last time, and it was ehhh. The food was still good though. I love Red Moon because they make you feel like you know them and they're your friends.
This place has taken a bit of a dive the last few years.  To top it off Bob Grant died.
Brunch brunch brunch!!!! Huevos rancheros!!! Cucumber margaritas!!! Friendly service!!!! My wife love manuel!! Mmmmm jealous !!! But I understand !!! I can't wait ti come back!!

One of the best burgers I've ever had the pleasure consuming! I'm not one for shoestring fries, but they did go really well when added atop the gorgeously cooked meat. Also, the pumpkin salad (special) was absolutely incredible! Not a lot of room to enjoy your food, but well worth making the trip, just to enjoy their burger!

Unsurprisingly, it's so hard to get a table here (relatively) because it's bobby flay and the UES, flatiron, and gramercy and older Hell's Kitchen crowd is rushing to this "HIP" "DOWNTOWN" restaurant to faux show off to their easily impressed friends how in they are. The food is definitely a notch above the standard "really solid" NY eatery, but it's not outstanding by any means. Also the crowd is not so hot. This makes it a weird place to choose because the food is only pretty good but it's impossible to get in short notice (and it's too crowded to eat at the bar). In this way, hundred acres on Thompson seems like the better choice for the relaxed meal, and has a crowd that reflects it. All in all-- solid, but not worth stressing about getting a reservation. Spend that stress time trying to get into a restaurant actually deserving of its hype.

Can't believe it took me so long to write this review! Maybe 'cuz I'm still getting over my hangover. At Sugarburg, you don't go to the bathroom, you go to the "pipi room".  The bartenders are cute AND good at mixing drinks. The crowd was great, people working here seemed like they actually wanted to be here, and the drinks were fantastic! Can't wait to go back next time I visit NY. My new favorite drink: their version of the manhattan.
The food here was delicious ! I also had a margarita that was made just right . The Reese's cheesecake we took to go was AMAZING ! My new favorite place

Love this place! ! I live for their Hemingway daiquiri (if you get the right bartender to make it) I've tried a couple of items on the menu and have never been disappointed.  The presentation of their food shows the cooks take great pride. Additionally the owner is very friendly, kind, humble person. Could easily be mistaken for costumer

I was super hungry the other day and my friend and I thought Butcher Bar would be a good spot to satiate my hunger pangs.  I've heard good things about the place and was ultimately surprised at how bad the BBQ was. I ordered 3 items ala carte.   Brisket, burnt ends and the pork belly.   The brisket was gray with no smoke rings at all... seemed like they boiled the meat instead of barbequing it.   The "burnt ends", burnt brisket ends where not burnt at all... just cubed pieces of brisket.   The pork belly was okay, I mean it's really hard to get pork belly wrong. I didn't get a chance to try the other items, like the pulled pork or ribs. If you call yourself a bbq place with word SMOKE emblazoned on the side of your building you should offer a good brisket or not offer it at all. NYC is a BBQ town and there's plenty better. 1/2 star for what they call brisket. 4 stars for the service and atmosphere.

Seriously  this place is in the middle of nowhere but still sometimes there is a line to get in. It is a very small place so most likely you will have to share the space with someone. Food is delicious and the atmosphere also.

The most delicious, romantic pizzeria in town.  The ingredients are always top quality and fresh, and the pizza is a bit fancier than at your typical corner pizzeria, but without pretension or sacrificing a traditional feel.  The service is friendly and prompt, the wine is good, and the atmosphere is cozy and nostalgic.  Only thing that would make it better is more dessert options (cannolis please) and coffee!
make your own burger gives good choices. oatmeal stout on tap is great. i like this place!
Wow! Holy Harlem soul food! No frills, just great grub! Works well with a large group too
Fresh Ass Sea Food

Came here with the ladies from the office.  I liked it.  To the point menu. Service was good.  I liked the food.  Had the roast beef and it was good.  The ladies liked the food  also.  We will probably come back again. Not too far from work.

As a Pennsylvanian I've been to Philly countless times but I never really experienced the best cheesesteaks the city had to offer (and I've eaten a lot of them). My friend and I roll up into this sketchy area of Philly to find John's Roast Pork. The reason I call it sketchy was because we were both uncomfortable leaving the car. We were shocked that it was near closing time (3:30 on a Saturday!?) so they only had a limited selection of items. We wanted cheesesteaks but settled for getting 2 small roast beef sandwiches. The staff was very nice and they worked our order quickly, however there was confusion behind the counter because when my order was ready another customer snatched our food and started leaving the establishment! It was embarrassing having to tell the man that those weren't his sandwiches, but I feel like this could have been prevented by actually putting the food in my hands. We took the food outside to eat. The sandwiches were nice and warm but the entire bottom half of the roll was SOGGY due to the copious amounts of Au Jus. The cheese which ran along the bottom of the roll was wet and tasteless. The meat was stuffed sky high (which was great) but it had a weird bite to it. The whole time I could tell my friend was trying to quell my visible disappointment by saying "it's still pretty good." I wanted to save writing a review for this place once I tried a cheesesteak, but I won't be back in Philly for over a year. PROS: Quick, easy, filling, great staff CONS: Poor atmosphere, soggy sandwiches, rather overpriced, closes early, cash only (inconvenient)

Right when I walked in, I knew this place was a winner. Outstanding service, delicious food, and an authentic neighborhood feel. Gila wasn't lying when she told my girlfriend "We have the best Chicken Shawarma in the city!" Looking forward to making many more visits to our new favorite neighborhood restaurant.
The owner is a nasty women. She's extremely rude and doesn't know how to speak to customers. I regret ever giving her business.

Im a fan for this place for its location, and so many late night memories. I stumbled in for brunch one morning, and it was great. Only downside was the homefries could dramatically increase, but all in all it was quite solid. This time i didnt ride the cow out...

Came here for drinks and ended up splitting a few dinner items. We ordered the Vine Ripened Tomatoes and Red Onion Salad, Jumbo Shrimp Cocktail, and "Build your own" burger. The food was excellent, and the drinks were strong and very good. The bartender was friendly and attentive. The decor itself is aesthetic - lots of mahogany and deep reds, dim lighting.  Great experience!

I went with family to this place for dinner and the service was absolutely awesome!! the ambiance was great too!! drinks and appetizers delicious but unfortunately the main course was horrible! I ordered the skirt steak which was like cutting rubber and the white rice was like having left over chinese  rice... how can a latin restaurant mess up rice??!! my cousins dish which included roasted potatoes were hard too, her rice was also hard and dry. We told the waitress and she agreed that other customers had also complained about the food.

Tell you folks not a good combination at Limoncello.  Currently one of the few tenants left at this shopping center. My family was one of two tables having dinner on Sunday at 7PM.  Hint when you have an Italian restaurant to yourself at Sunday evening dinner?? What we have here is basic food failure. Another Italian restaurant with a forever menu and specials. The grill vegetables overcooked and an entree named the Veal Limoncello where the meat is virtually inedible. Hopefully they will survive with their pizza delivery otherwise might become a vacancy in the near future.
Delicious food and drinks. Really nice atmosphere. Must try their yuca biscuits delicious!! Loved all of their complementary breads and their flavored butter!!
Just had a great time at the skunk hollow tavern. Best burger I've had in a while(organic Vermont beef). Great vibe, can't wait to go back.

The food and atmosphere of this place are awesome. Really tasty fajitas and a fun place to hang out. What really spoiled our experience was the service. Jose Tejas is known to have long wait times. My brother had stepped out to run an errand during our 1 hour wait. He wasn't back by the time we were seated, and within 5 minutes the manager (Alex) came over and made us relinquish our table. He was completely unreasonable for the following reasons: 1) This policy had not been enforced at the time we were seated. 2) We were planning to order my brother's meal immediately, preventing a possible delay caused by his absence. 3) We started eating the chips and salsa, my father had already ordered a drink, and we were still asked to leave. It really spoiled our evening, and given that we were in a rush, the effect was only amplified. Seemed like a waste to produce such tasty food and hire such a delinquent manager. Moral of the story? If you go, be prepared to wait, and make sure no one leaves the premises to avoid a frustrating turn of events.
This is an excellent place to have lunch. The food was hot & the beer was cold.  Eamon was a great host & very friendly with the customers. Will go back there on the next trip to NYC.
Good food, good service, cozy environment hard to hate a place like this. Sample appetizer was great. Couldn't be more full going here.

I have rolled over 3 times out of my sleep and dreamed about their biscuit bread pudding in the past week!  From start to finish this place really won me over.  Their drinks are amazing and really well suited for their theme.  Rum and root beer is my favorite but rosemary lemonade comes in a close second.  Their pickles as an appetizer are just right to get you in the mood for some good southern cooking.  I never leave without at least a jar of pickled carrots or beets, they tide me over between visits.  I enjoy coming to Jacob's Pickles with a group so that when we order our meals we can all share, there is just so much to love it would be a shame to only have 1 option!  The chicken smothered in sausage gravy and the braised turkey leg are by far some of the best i have had north of the Mason Dixon line.  Then the desserts....to choose between a fruit filled rice pudding in a mason jar or a pillowy and decadent biscuit bread pudding would stress me out more than doing my taxes!  Both desserts will quiet down even the most rowdy groups with their bright flavors and soul warming deliciousness! Needless to say, their brunch, which includes dinner favorites and egg/pancake type dishes is just as great.  Highly recommended, well worth the small wait you might have to endure on a weekend!

This place is amazing. First off, the space is wild. High ceilings, two levels of games with the balcony overlooking a kick ass mural. The walls are lined with the best classic arcade games and pinball machines. My favorites, asteroids and 1942, were both there! Gaming is cheap, and you can keep going for hours. The extended gaming is fueled by some awesome pub fare. Everything on the menu is locally sourced and organic. You have to check out the gravy fries, and make sure you get a duck fat egg on it! But we ate a lot and everything was delicious! Check out the cheesy balls too. The beer selection is vast and well curated. Really, I can't say enough good stuff about this place. Especially as it had only been open a few weeks when I visited. I don't live in VT but would love to go back to Tilt some day. Hopefully sooner than later.

I think I might be obsessed with this joint. I don't necessarily consider myself an "expert" but I know a damn good cheesesteak when I eat one and this is probably one of the best around in the neighborhood and it's for 3 reasons. 1. They use ACTUAL meat! Not some pansy frozen shit from your local Key Foods. 2. Wiz. Need I say more? 3. The staff is excellent and will make you want to keep giving them your hard earned dollars. Keep up the good work, guys!

The food in this place is amazing.  The prices are reasonable, the portions very generous and most importantly, the food tastes great.  I'm very familiar with what thai dishes should taste like, and this is comparable to food you'd get in Thailand.  I would recommend any of the shrimp dish entrees as well as the pad thai, and any of the fried rice options. Regarding the service, I've seen the reviews about the bad service, but that's not at all what I've experienced.  Have been here twice and each time had very nice waitresses.  Even the hostess was not bothered when we wanted to move inside after having a table in their lovely outside garden area. This is my family's new favorite Thai restaurant.
Very good pizza

I am a ramen lover and I have tried so many kinds of ramen around the world. I can guarantee that the ramen here is one of the best ramen I have ever tried!! My favorite ramen is totto spicy ramen. The broth is so tasteful and the chashu pork is yummy. On top of that, the chef here is so friendly. A must try!! BTW, please note that the restaurant is so small and there's always a line, but it worths waiting!!

Service sucks!!!!!!!!!! Took 20 minutes for our order to even be taken. Never got the coffee I ordered - asked two times. Food came and never checked on us. Had to ask to refill coffee. Had to ask for check! Won't be back!

Wonderful! Just visited tonite because we saw it on Triple D. As soon as we walked in we were greeted warmly and the staff and our waitress were the nicest people I ever encountered! So genuine. We enjoyed the cuban atmosphere and the food was great. We had the cod frittas appetizer. Sangria was delicious. Had the half chicken and fish in white wine and butter sauce and the best rice beans I ever had!  Plaintains were awesome. For dessert, got the guava with cream cheese and rice pudding was so good. Our waitress was very sweet and helpful with helping me choose along the way. Service was excellent!!! We enjoyed the way they celebrated someones Birthday! They make it very loud and clear so you cant miss it!! Very fun. So cute. So glad we visited!!
Been here before and going again tonight.  This is a nice spot. Everything about it is good.  When in NYC give it a try.
The food was good but our waiter was exceptionally the opposite.

Coming from NYC, I'm on the quest for a decent slice here in Lebanon New Hampshire.  I went for their carnivore pizza.  It tasted like the 2 for $12 deals at the local pizzeria I had back in college when I was broke except I had to fork over $20 for a plain old mediocre pie.  They skimped on the toppings.  There was barely enough sauce on the pizza.  And the sauce:cheese ratio is way off.  The crust is ok.  I get it, this is New Hampshire, not New York we're talking about.  But no way is this even passable for a $20 pizza.  Even the rich college kids in Hanover may balk at this.  Will not be going back.
99 favor taste ， This restaurant is very good, there is a hot pot, barbecue, infinite eat, in the past, please have a taste, absolutely won't regret it!

Such a relaxed and romantic setting. Music was nostalgic and added to the cosy ambiance. I had the yellow fin tuna, spinach fritters and veg chips. It came off the "small plates" menu but two people can EASILY share this as a satisfying meal. Great quality and flavors. I ate here by myself but will be back as soon as tomorrow to share this with my boyfriend.
This is my new favorite  restaurant in the lower east side!! The food is so delicious and DIFERENT in the good way!! The drinks r so refreshing try the black ant negating is amazing!

A cute little place with AMAZING garlic parmesan wings :) The woman who was working behind the counter was extremely friendly and helpful.  The only thing that would make it better is if their dipping sauces were homemade.

I did not get as far as the food or service. I walked in, saw unswept floors and dirty tables, and immediately asked myself whether this was indicative of the condition of their kitchen. Then, I walked out.

Why can't this diner be on Long Island?! The Tops Diner is the epitome of what a diner should be; an extensive menu, quick service and tasty oversized portions. Save room for dessert as you can expect Cheesecake Factory type desserts ranging from cheesecakes to brownies.

I would expect more from a vegan spot in manhattan with so many vegans and vegetarians ! I got the quesadilla and it is flavorless with Grease dripping out of a vegan cheese quesadilla is uncalled for ! I serve this same item at my restaurant and have never seen Diaya cheese that greasy ! Come on if our gonna put raw onions and canned peppers can u add a little seasoning to the "chicken" at least ! Not impressed at all !
The ramen is pretty good but the appetizers are the stars of the show.

NOT WORTH YOUR TIME- I went here after someone suggested what an amazing pizza they had here. Service sucks. Pizza is regular. not worth the 35 minute wait for pizza. Not one single waiter checked in on us to see if we needed anything else after we placed our drink order. Everyone around me seemed to be waiting a while for their food. Honestly not worth it. The staff seems so rough around the edges, not people persons at all.
Good...but not as good as Sonny's.

Ashley and Brian were at the bar and were absolutely awesome . My husband and I enjoyed our selves . We noticed all customers were enjoying themselves . This is our second time at happy hour and it will definitely be a place where we will meet our friends. Ashley and Brian are an asset to the company.  Thank you
Meh as in mediocre. Overpriced for Yorkville, but I guess they're anticipating when the Second Avenue subway is up and running, which will drive up prices all round.

very trendy place. valet $10 little pricey when should be free or $5. food has gluten free menu which is great for celiac people like myself! drinks were weak. the atmosphere outside was nice with cabanas, dj and bars. we had the hooka and that was fun also!
This place was not very clean inside and the waitress was slow, and also their food just taste okay.
Good meatballs! Greens are nice too! Try the sliders so you can try a bunch!

Establishments like this make me want to move back to NYC. The food is BOMB! The service is great and knowledgable, I love love love this place. And the fact that it's a 24 hour spot that serves real food is amazing! Always recommend this place, and it's the best when you're drunk lol. Get the nachos please.

Just walk in and be patient. Don't expect the servers to coddle you. Its noisy if you eat inside. Bring cash, of course. Now that you know, there is no need for you to visit, then come back and leave a bad review because the 'experience wasn't satisfactory.' The servers there are totally cool, but really busy most of the time. Despite this, they've always been patient with us. I never felt like an imposition. By Philly standards, they are downright pleasant. Most importantly, the food is really great. They have some creative options that I wouldn't think to, or want to, make at home. Everything tastes exactly as it should. Even the morning deal- $4 ham and eggs (with coffee or tea) hits the spot. Of course, not everything is a winner, but this place is consistent enough that we walk past Honey's to get here every time.
Amazing food. Great atmosphere. Get the Foie Gras.
Loved the veggie fried rice I ordered! Not sure why all the negative reviews... I had a overall good experience!

The Tic Tock Diner is the "BEST DINER" I have been to in NJ. The quality of the food is excellent! Real chicken for the finger platter! The best however was the Spinach pie/Greek salad! The feta cheese was so creamy and flavorful! Be prepared to split this dish. The pies are made with perfect spices and wrapped in philo! Melts in your mouth! As they say in Ghana PAA PAA PAA!

The chicken sandwich is amazing! Chicken thigh fried in deliciousness on a brioche bun with aioli truffle sauce. The fries are one of a kind. The service is spot on and friendly. All around great place!

Food was great. I've been twice.  First time I had a burger with blue cheese. It was amazing. Very juicy.  The bun was very nice breoche bun.  Next time I went I had the chicken sandwich and it was a piece of heaven.  Next time I go ill try the filipino burger. The desert was very good to.  Caramel pudding.

Loved loved loved! Went on 8/3 for brunch! It was excellent. Service is excellent. We had crispy dough breakfast was yummy! The puréed tomatoes were excellent. I must say the service was the best I had in NYC! Highly recommend!!!

Let's not even talk about the food. Let's talk about the fact that my mother and I waited for 20 minutes before a waitress deigned to stop by our empty table, devoid of even utensils let alone water. Let's talk about how two other tables came in after us and were immediately attended to while my mother and I were forced to sit there, futilely attempting to get the attention of a waitstaff that clearly wanted nothing to do with our proffered business. Let's talk about the fact that three waitresses watched my mother's clear attempt to politely call over an employee so that we could, god-forbid, be served, and, rather than come to our table, exchanged glances with one another and mouthed our table number between them, like seagulls squawking the same ugly sound back and forth. Let's talk about the fact that two waitresses who walked by, unable to avoid us like their more fortunate counterparts, brushed off our attempts to get service, preferring instead to pointedly ignore our presence until their most unfortunate compatriot, a waitress who, let's face it, probably drew the short straw, finally supposed that she might as well stoop so low as to take our order. Let's talk about how a gentleman came in 40 minutes after us, and was promptly seated and helped, eventually being served with his order at the exact same time as me and my mother. Now, I could speculate on why it is that all the other customers were bestowed with the glory of the attention of the staff while we were hung out to dry. Sitting at that dismally barren table with my clearly Asian mother across from my clearly Asian self, surrounded by a room full of Caucasian staff and patrons (some of whom openly gawked at us), it was a little too painfully evident that one of these was not like the other. But rather than draw any unsavory conclusions, I will instead choose to just say this: This type of behavior is unacceptable. For any reason. When I go to a restaurant, I expect a certain level of courtesy, attentiveness, and professionalism, an expectation I think we all share, and I left this establishment empty-handed. There is no quality of food high enough to make this treatment forgivable, and I urge any and all potential future patrons of this place to strongly reconsider. Money spent here would be money poorly spent.

Went here today for lunch. Ordered the double cheese burger, and fries needless to say it was a small meal for the price, but they did get my meal out fast only because they make kid size meals. I remember when I worked here when I was 16 and the burgers were huge. If you are just looking to get a fast meal then this is the place to go if your looking for a place to fill you up this isn't it. Oh and forgot it still tastes good.
I tried their fish and chips, I didn't like it. The fish was not fresh and it was very oily.

Some of the best food in town! If you want to know what real local food tastes like this is the place to go. Even the condiments are made in house and they are AMAZING! A little pricey, but it's definitely worth it. This is a must for everyone visiting Burlington.

This was so delicious. My husband and I are  both very enthusiastic about the experience we just had. The service was good - friendly, prompt, and informative wait staff, the ambience was wonderful, and the food was exquisite. For appetizers, we had the kangaroo and the scallops. While both were very tasty, the scallops were just divine. Interesting sauce that accompanied the scallop, along with the  impeccable cooking made this scallop stand out. I had the duck...I never order duck because i usually find that it has a weird taste, but this was delicious! I ate the whole thing. My husband ordered the lamb. He was very pleased. His perfect bite included the lamb, a piece of mandarin orange, polenta, and carrot puree. Yum! The whole experience was really great. Great food without any snobby pretentiousness.
We went there for dinner. Fried rice and noodles was ok. The dumplings  were so cold ad if it was made in the afternoon. It was very dry also. I wouldn't  been there without  groupon.

Let me first start by saying, that I am not a heathen by any sense of the word, but Oh My God... I wanted to lick my plate when I'm done. Enough so that my server even offered to turn his head as I pretended to do so. This place is a bit pricey, but I would gladly pay for the level of service and the food all over again every single day. Now, I may need to win the lottery to go every single day, especially considering I live in Ohio and I'd have to fly there... ok, tangent. But seriously, you get the picture. I also do not eat a ton of meat because I'm a weirdo and I'm big on texture. If I get a piece of chicken with gristle in it for example, I can't another bite. So, I will admit, I was very hesitant when I decided to order the short rib for dinner with the mashed potatoes and gravy. The server assured me it was a delicious choice over whatever else I was pondering, so I said, "What the hell? I'm on a mini vacation right? I may as well splurge a little and take a chance." When they brought out this bowl of magical deliciousness, the aroma reminded me of those old cartoons, were it would turn into a finger beckoning you over to it. I wanted to put my face into the mashed potatoes and just inhale them. The short rib was not what I expected it to be, it was a million times better, and good gravy was it tender. I have never eaten a better selection of meat in my life, and I'm not even kidding. It was fantastic. The mashed potatoes and veggies I got were such a great compliment, and I really wish we had a Red Owl here. I would love to spoil myself with that tasty dish again sometime. The atmosphere seemed dressy but was really laid back, and everything looked so industrial and so well put together. We sat up in the balcony and were overlooking the place. Fantastic!!!

I had an amazing time at this restaurant. The bread and appetizers are incredible, the Hummus is to die for! I had the roasted chicken with buckwheat dumplings that was absolutely delicious. My wife had a lamb dish that she Loved! The duck pastrami app was very creative. And leave room for the deserts. They make a cheesecake so smooth it tastes like cheesecake flavored whipped-cream. The best part is that the prices for these 'culinary works of art' are very low! I was pleasantly surprised when I saw my bill. Can't wait to go back to this restaurant again....and again.

That was the worst experience I have had in a year!!  My 10 yr old Son and I waited 40 min for wings, then the pizza came out 2 min later with all the stuff that we asked be left off.  I can only be told sorry so many times - if they were sorry they would have taken care of the check! Poor.  We will never go back!!!!

This place is super cool. I have been to a lot of sushi places, but none quite like this. The little conveyor belt of food means that you don't really have to wait for a waiter, and you can have a bit of everything. There isn't a huge variety, and it isn't the best tasting that I've ever had, but it was worth the $, and definetly unique.
Pretty good but the chicken tastes like cardboard.  I'd rather go to another cart in NYC and not wait in the long line of tourists.
Delicious food & excellent service!

Came here on Saturday with my family since I was in Jersey for the night visiting. It had two things I love: seafood for less than NYC prices and no corkage fee on BYOB. The place is in the same shopping center as a bomb bagel place and nail salon so that's good. The restaurant it's is suuuuper low key, but really cute inside. The colors are all nice shades of blue and it's obvious they sunk cash Ito renovating the place cause it looks brand new. The place opened last week but was pretty packed around 6 when we went, must have been word of mouth. There were a bunch of us so we tried the crab cakes, which weren't huge but were very tasty, Alaskan King Crab Legs (yum), the Caesar salad that had the biggest scallops I've ever seen and the mussels. My boyfriend doesn't love fish so he got the burger, which was decent, but honestly who gets a burger at a seafood restaurant anyway lol. All in all, it's casual dinner spot and if you can get a table outside then you're really in luck. I'll be back next time I visit the fam for sure.

The lobster roll here is great, definitely on my top 5 from the city. The chicken pot pie during the winter time is scrumptious The food takes a long time to come, one star off for that but otherwise this is a very cute restaurant off the busy herald square that everyone should come to try.

I've been going here for years and although I've tried hundreds of entrees, my old standby is the Piri Piri chicken picante. Small salad on the side and a mug of Portuguese wine on the side and your in heaven. Not a fancy place by any stretch of the imagination, yet they do everything right.

Just a tourist trap. Lunch prices are just a dollar below dinner price. My salad with shrimp added was terrible. No flavor and shrimp we're cut in half to make it look like there were plenty on my plate.

First time trying this place and I will not be going back! This take out and eat in location is clean and medium size. Nice size parking lot and other options in the parking lot too. Also a nice size flat screen tv to watch while eating. However the cashier isn't doesn't eat the food so clearly he shouldn't be on the register selling food to customers. Why did he feel it okay to tell me he can't help on taste options because he don't eat the food! I'm happy he was honest but how helpful is that to the customer..... I ordered a turkey burger with curly fries and Pepsi! My Pepsi was flat, food cold and it wasn't tasty!! I've had better and I wasn't happy with my food!!

Found this restaurant on yelp, booked a table on this app and had a fantastic meal. What a great place, staff could not do enough for us and the food ( ribs) where the best I've ever had. Fantastic restaurant and this app is the best .

I have been here several times and I am never disappointed. I find the staff to be very friendly and the food very good. I'm a picky eater, so I wish the menu was a bit bigger, but that's my issue and no one else's. Went there last night and had the Broccollo Pizza. I love me a crispy crust and this crust is perfect. It's as if God himself reached down from the heavens, stuck his finger in some dough and said, "Let there be pizza crust." And behold, there was pizza crust. It's thin and crispy and just the way I like it. Keep up the good work. Shout out to Chad, the sever who is always so nice.

3 of my friends and I went to EB Strong's last night craving the Waygo burgers, in which we all ended up ordering after enjoying oysters, calamari and fried oyster sliders (all amazing btw).  When we finally got to the main meal... the burgers were absolutely delicious. All 4 were cooked to perfection by Chef Nic., side salads and truffle fries were the perfect serving size to accompany the quite large burger.  Of course why stop there, we had to indulge in dessert which consisted of cheese cake...again delicious.  The service was on point which I feel is hard to come by these days in Burlington.  Was a great experience overall and we will definitely be going back.
Good service. Bone marrow (bit too oily if eaten by one person) and pepper shrimp both good. Only had appetizer by myself. Will definitely go again.

I really wanted to love this place. You should when you have to wait over an hour just to sit down. I thought the food was solid, the biscuit was great, cheese grits were great, eggs were ok, hashbrowns were ok, my companions loved their meat choices - bacon and ham respectively. Coffee was terrific.The pie was disappointing! It was tasty but our slice had almost no crust so it was like a cobbler. The service though was quite good and it was certainly good enough that I would go again when its not at peak time to give another assessment.

I don't know why the other reviewer said there was only sweet food,  I had am amazingly light and tasty quinoa and arugula salad.  My girls had adorable mini grilled cheese with savory wale fries.  The hot Co late is a great experience add well,  work things like make your own and crackling, the forks couldn't finish then they were so big. We finished off with the kids menu dessert for two.

If you want to eat like a tourist go to Pats. If you want the best cheesesteak in Philly you go where the neighborhood goes...and that's Delessandro's!! When my son said he wanted a cheesesteak from Philly the friend we were visiting INSISTED we go to Delessandro's. Sure glad we did. It was just great!

Sakura establishes itself at the top of my most horrible restaurants in Glastonbury list.  Ordered a meal for three people which included three items off of the happy hour menu, several sushi items from the regular menu, and 2 drinks. Attempted to use a CouponConnecticut.Com coupon and was told that cannot be combined with other offers. Because I had ordered from the menu and not used any other offer I objected and the smug and cocky manager said "too bad." Would not recommend this restaurant to anybody for this lack of courtesy. My wife did not even eat her dinner, finding it inedible and foul tasting.  The waiter/bartender cleared it away without asking. Min Ghung has better sushi. Hibachi is only average.
