Food was good but came out very quickly and was often cold in the middle. The flavors were nice and sangria was good so I could forgive the lack of warmth. However, service was horrible. Wait staff often leaned by the corner of the bar and took a while to get our drinks. Didn't even have an opportunity to tell them how the food was because she didn't come back until we were ready for the bill once we ordered. Had a discrepancy on the bill and was made to feel incompetent when it was their mistake. Would have given it a second chance if it weren't for the service.
Great food! Unique. Retro decor was entertaining. Chicken pot pie was amazing and the risotto delish! Ambiance relaxed, retro, comfortable.
Dry, greasy, nothing special.  Arrived at 11, quick service.  You go here for the history and the experience, not for an amazing bit to eat. Still glad I went
The food was exceptional! My mom and I had ramen and the steamed buns with chicken! I wish I had four stomachs and try more dishes. Oh and the service was quick. Must go place!

Had a great time at The Eddy. Intimate restaurant with a mixologist on hand serving bright and inventive cocktails that fittingly kicked the off the evening for our group. The refreshing bourbon daisy drink arrived in a lovely antique tea cup and my wife's parlor friar beverage was likewise delicious. Executive Chef Brendan's eclectic dishes were skillfully executed with the pillowy gnocci, pickled ramps and char rillette particularly tasty. Overall, a wonderful relaxed evening and we will certainly return soon.

LOVE! LOVE! The Crabby Shack! A quaint place - I could see in the Vineyard or Hamptons. The food was so good and very fresh. We had crab legs, crab cakes, crab roll and crab tacos, steamed broccoli, new potatoes and corn - very fresh! Not too over seasoned, just lightly seasoned and tasty, not too salty, the legs were very buttery too!  They crab legs are servedin a plastic bag that they pour this butter sauce in and when you open the bag the butter sauce is in your basket and you can dip the crab meat in it. I can see them adding some shoestrings fries and dipping sauces. (in the future) When I left I was very full and happy. :-) I went with a friend from Maryland and she ordered crab legs and a crab role to go. For dessert they had BCakeShop cupckaes, yummy and the best old fashion banana pudding. I say old fashion because it was just like your mother made it not too over the top, just vanilla pudding, bananas and vanilla wafers. SO good. The decor is classic and the bathroom I want in my home. I will definitely go back! Congrats to the ladies for making this dream a reality! I am waiting on the franchise...Harlem, LI, Hamptons, Vineyard, Philly Baltimore, DC...and the list goes on!
Their pizza is out of this world! My husband I always go here when we're in the mood for a pie and they've never disappointed!  Friendly staff, quick service, delicious food! Definitely recommend!
The food was wonderful, however I wish the veggie meatballs were vegan!  The sides tasted great.
The "chicken parmesan" was delicious. We got one order and shared with three people. The place could be cleaner, however; its popular so it's a lot of just wear and tear.
Very bad place. Rude people work in there and food is just grose. It f#&&@ up your stomach and appetite. $$very dam expensive . For the price and the quality of food is just now rite
Once again Becco didn't disappoint.   Missed reservations early due to traffic but they were kind enough to serve us after our show at 10pm.  Braised short ribs were excellent.

The barista that served me was totally full of himself. I don't pretend to be a coffee expert, but I did pay my way through college working at an espresso bar so I'm definitely not the idiot he treated me like. I ended up just ordering an iced coffee. When I asked for skim milk he said "Our skim milk is 2%." WTF?!? No, your skim milk is non-existent. YOU DO NOT HAVE SKIM MILK. That is totally trivial. I would have been fine with 2% milk if he treated me with the slightest bit of dignity and said, "I'm sorry, we don't have skim but we do have 2%." Needless to say, although I live a few blocks away, I will not be returning. If you're in the area, go to Ninth Street Espresso at 56th and Park. The people there are way nicer and so is the space.

So, I ordered some wings today and asked for them to be crispy.  The woman told me that they can't make them crispy.  Um...wtf?!    You just cook them longer.  I ordered 1/2 one flavor and 1/2 another and asked if they can put them in separate containers, and she said "I'm sorry, but we can't do that because we're corporate."  Again, wtf?!  Lastly, we asked how much sauce do we get for the 40+ wings that we ordered, and she told us that it comes with only two small sauces, any extra would cost more $$.  Such a rip off.  Overall rating:  wings themselves are a 3.5, but company's policies and/or incompetent employees bring rating down to a 2.0.

This place is the best I used to come here after school for some awesome and delicious Vietnamese hoagie and bun buo hue. The place is very calm and soothing where u can enjoy your food in peace. Also the workers here are so nice. For an asian I tried out a lot of places but this place has the best food for a cheap price.

My first choice for a buffet is Dosa Grill, that's mostly because of the quality of the food they offer. You get to pick your own variety of dosa which comes free with ever buffet. Based the food taste I assume that they always use quality ingredients. Their wife variety of Vegetarian food would be preferred choice for many veggie folks. Next best thing about this place is their staffs are very friendly and helpful. They also maintain this place very clean. During week end they buffet is costs you few extra bucks but it's ok as that's when they add few extra dishes as well. Leaving the buffet aside their dishes during dinner is also superior, specially their gongura dosa is very awesome, you got to try it once

Great spot, awesome service! My boyfriend & I love going here for after work drinks. Especially when Jimmy Fransioli is behind the bar.  He knows how to make great cocktails & most importantly, he's a people person. Anytime I'm not sure what I'm in the mood to drink, Jimmy mixes together one of his cocktail specials with all fresh ingredients which always taste amazing.  Highly recommend!

This was the perfect easy delicious lunch experience with the family.  Todd was so funny and engaging...our kids would like to live here with him.  The grilled cheese is over the top and the patty melt was amazing.  Elena's eggplant side is a must try if they haven't run out already.  If the weather is nice, this is one of the best patios.  And to top it off, they have a very selective list of craft beers.
Delicious fresh food and fast delivery! I got the Thai dumplings and tom yum. Tom yum had the perfect amount of spice - and the dumplings were loaded with fresh flavors. I would recommend!

THE BEST PIZZA. You might need to wait - it's worth it. Paulie will come over to your table, if you are a girl or have a girl sitting at it - flirt, search for compliments, tell you you look like Diane Lane when she was young. Vegan? Paulie's got your back - too many choices to try them all. Get the dessert pizza. do it.

I had Maddy Classic Burrito a few times.  It is a good burrito.  I tried the enchiladas which were okay.  The mole sauce seemed skimpy usually they smother things in the mole.  The chips were very good, fresh and crispy.  My friend had the steak tacos said they were okay seemed bland.  We like Maddy's for Lunch and I will stick with the burrito.

Asked the waiter what kind of Sam Adams they had on tap.  He told me there was only one kind of Sam Adams.  Ordered the fish and chips.  I got 3 fish stick sized pieces of fish and 10 waffle fries.  What is this, a meal for ants?

I've been here twice for drinks and have really enjoyed it. Went last night for dinner and unfortunately did not have the same experience. The kale salad was good, but the oysters were just OK and the meat board was awful. We did not end up ordering meals. Disappointed to say the least.

I love their pupu platter, potato salad and soup. They are amazingly delicious. I usually go there on Monday because they sell a bottle of wine for half price ;) The outside is lovely place to eat there!!
Loved the food here. It is definitely pricey for the portion they serve but worth it.
This cart makes my heart sing happy songs (and my tummy)! DELICIOUS, fresh, warm and heavenly!
I took my girlfriend to this place for her birthday and it rocked. They have the best pad thai i have ever had in new york city. prices are cheap and the food is great.

I have been there many times. It's a nice place to sit down for a coffee or a drink. It has a laid back and nice atmosphere. Staff are nice. I wish they had a larger pastry selection and more latte drink options.

Very crowded but not more than usual for a place that has a bar. However I was pretty thrown off when I walked in and the bar was right in front of you and you had to walk past the bar to get to the hostess station. The food was pretty good and the server was also very good and attentive. It's a nice place to go on a Friday night.

Pretty tasty! A lot in the menu and if you are not familiar with this type of food be prepared to ask a lot of questions there's just not enough description on the menu itself so we sat for five minutes and asked a lot of questions before making our decision since it was the first time we were there! I highly suggest the owner has pictures Of every dish. we sampled a few of the different entrée selections and it was plenty of food. The rice is especially tasty. We did like the kebabs and they had very nice char grill flavor to them and they were a good quality piece of meat! It's not our every day type of food but a welcome addition to the Morrisville area -you must try it at least once... I'm sure you will be back - we will be too!

Literally my favorite restaurant in the entire world. I've eaten there about 4 times just this summer it's so great. I usually get the Ricky Ricardo's Ribs which are boneless short ribs in an apricot sauce. It's reallllyyyy good I love it. It has a sweetness to it and it's just all around really good. It comes with rice and black beans and Yuca which is a latin potato which is also very good. As for the tapas I've had the chicharon de pollo which is just chicken lollipops. They're really good but can be a bit salty. I've also had the chicken empanadas. Now I've had homemade empanadas from various places and I can't say these are the best ones I've ever had. The drinks and flavors are great but it is BYOB and they'll mix sangrias for you. The atmosphere is very fun and the waiters are very friendly. It can get a little crowded especially in the winter when the outside isn't open. Most times you'll be pretty close to people next to you so the restaurant does get pretty loud. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because the noise level with the people and the music can make it hard to hear one another. But overall it is a wondering restaurant and I genuinely enjoy eating there.

Came to this place after driving 32 miles for it as Yelp reviews made it pretty attractive. A great brunch place to be at, Excellent service and food, of course. Potions are huge, none of us six could eat even half of our orders. I would recommend the owners to add some pics to the menu, we had to order using the pics on Yelp. Will be back again whenever in Philly area.

now i have ordered from this place several times almost each time they have messed something up. but today was the last straw for me. i ordered large pastrami and american cheese sub( got swiss or provolone  ordered spinach got lettuce) medium tuna salad sub large oven roasted turkey sub hot dogs( barely cooked and they forgot to bring it the first time so we had to wait an additional 20 minutes ) small ham and salami sub was very disappointed with service this time and they are usually okay

Bistro Les Amis was introduce to us by our niece who was graduating from NYU.   This place was amazing.  It was a crazy busy day and I just needed a place to unwind. I had a mint lemonade with a spike of vodka which was refreshing and a tuna nicoise. The tuna was cooked to perfection with a pepper coating.  Got to sit back and watch the sites.  Great place to people watch.  The waitress was sincere and funny.  Plus I got to practice my French.  Merci!

I'm not a New York native, so when I visit Little Italy, it's a bit of a hit or miss when choosing a restaurant.  Benito One was luckily a fantastic choice! My family went there for lunch, and the lunch special consisted of a salad, pasta platter, and entree for a very reasonable price. I had the chicken parmigiana, a salad and linguine with red sauce. I loved it! My sisters got the chicken francese and rigatoni bolognese and enjoyed it as well. The wait staff was really attentive and personable.   Highly recommend Benito One!!

The food was excellent.  If you're looking for something a little different and extremely delicious,  this is the place to go.  The best dishes were the lamb ribs, lamb neck, and poutine.  I also tried the schnitzel,  rabbit, carrots, and peas.   They were all great.  One tip: if you want the pig's head, order it as soon as you get there.  It takes an hour to cook, so I didn't have a chance to try it.  Next time!
Awesome atmosphere. Eric (bartender and girlfriend) very welcoming. Guacamole unbelievable. Definitely a must see!

Food is not worth for the price. The service is terrible and unprofessional. We ordered chicken katsu, it comes chick teriyaki, and we ordered vegetable tempura,it didn't come to our table! We saw with our own eye. We strongly WON'T recommend anyone visit this restaurant!S

I hesitated to write this review immediately following my meal at Marrakesh, because it was not going to be glowing to say the least.  But the fact that the evening I spent there still botherd me, I felt that I must share my experience with Yelp readers.  In May, a group of about 20 women went to Marrakesh to celebrate a 50th birthday.  Reservations were made in advance and we were led to a cozy private room.  At first, all was well,l but when we asked to have the air conditioning turned down, we were accommodated, but just briefly,  Before too long, the air was back up.  During some birthday toasts, we asked for the music to be turned down, which it was, but before too long it was turned back up.  This happened at least three times.  During the course in which a whole chicken is served, I asked for a fork - I was dressed up for the occasion and really didn't want to eat a whole chicken with my hands.  What I was given was the smallest, cheapest plastic fork imaginable.  Later, a few of the guests left early, leaving a tiny space open in the private room.  The hosts tried repeatedly to sit other diners IN OUR ROOM and seemed surprised that we didn't want strangers joining our celebration.  I can't imagine that the strangers would have wanted to sit with us either.  At 11:00 p.m., the hosts made it clear that we had to leave, despite the fact that restaurant was still busy with many other guests.  As we were told to leave, we asked the hosts to call us a few cabs in order to return to our hotel.  This apparently was not a viable request and our group walked quite a distance to our hotel.

2.5 Stars purely for the service and atmosphere. The staff and atmosphere gave me confidence that the whole dining experience was going to be good, but sadly the food was a huge let down. Escargot were extremely bland and of questionable freshness. No flavors, not even salt, was able to be infused into the meat. French onion soup was executed really poorly. All but 1/2 ounce of liquid had been reduced down to just a salty slurry. The flavors hinted at the potential, but alas it was a failure. Cote de Boeuf was not good. It was overcooked by at least two degrees of doneness, which should have been apparent when they sliced it for us. The flavors itself weren't very inspiring either, just loaded with crushed peppercorns. For $120, it should at least be mediocre. I certainly would not trust them with guests I am entertaining, but I might give them another shot down the road. Hope it was just an off night.

Stopped in for a burger and fries for lunch today. Food was tasty, staff was very friendly, service was quick, and price was great. Can't beat that! Looking forward to trying their bagels next time I'm in the area.

Ordered take - out and got gnocchi and falafel gyro. It was very bland. From the brief time I spent at the bar, the ambiance seemed nice and the bartender was friendly. For its price, the food was disappointing.

I would not suggest using the online ordering through their website but once that issue was corrected, the food was delivered fast, the staff is very nice and the burger, fries and shake I got were AWESOME.  Great food, just call if you want delivery.
Naan and rest of the items are more far better than any rice item. They make good curries, butter chiken, tikka masala, palak paneer....
Just had dinner here.. the wait is too long. The food is awesome!  Love the crabs and shrimp. Wonderful

I only go to this place because of location, and convenience.  The food is pretty good, but it is pricey and the service is not very good.  The lady behind the counter is rude and the waiter's couldn't really care less.  I would not go out of my way to come here.  I've gotten egg rolls, pork fried rice, boneless ribs, general tso's, and they were all pretty good.

Delicious!  The dumplings are so fresh!  As with many Chinatown holeinthewalls, don't be turned off by the crumby décor and rundown interior.  This food is good and fresh made!  A classic Chinatown experience.

My colleagues and I have been ordering and coming here for over ten years. The last experience was unacceptable. We are in the service industry so we are not ones to complain. The waitress...Asian with facial discoloration. The most rude woman, if you can call her that, said, "I work here all the time and I've never seen you" after that and more, we still left a 25% tip. She then chased us down the block, saying we didn't pay our bill. This woman is a vindictive thief and should not be allowed to treat loyal customers like this. After tracking down the owner, she was unwilling to accept or take responsibility for the psychotic employee, who accused us of not paying. Once again, we always pay and tip 25% or more. This place used to be cute and friendly. It's not anymore.

Just a bit shy of good. I had a pork chop in mancha mantel sauce. It was ok, I hear they have fresh handmade tortillas, I couldn't tell you how those are, I wasn't offered any. Over all it was just ok.

Visited the restaurant in warm August weather and sat outside to enjoy the ambience. The restaurant is located near a river but has it's own private parking lot as well as fresh greenery that keeps the scene fresh! Food was tasty and it is mostly an American burger place. My California cheesesteak was quite delicious and the fries were homemade but tasty. Would definitely go back but only if weather permits for outdoor seating.
I love this place. Everything is delicious and the atmosphere is comfortable. I would go back again and again.
Food is delicious , fresh seafood with great price and awesome service, we are both satisfy and definitely come back, would recommend it.

First off, I have to say I did NOT have their barbecue. What I DID have however was uniformly meh or less than meh: the best of the lot was the Texas Weiner all the way. But hey: you can get that ALL OVER NJ done as well or better. The Philly Cheese Steak was less than mediocre. It had too many onions and not enough flavor in the meat. In fact no flavor at all. And although I asked for it rare, it was overcooked. The Onion Rings were dry and flavorless and I assume they're bought from a mass-Onion-Ring maker and if not, they sure tasted like it.  And four packets of Ketchup? Really? Pierogies were dry, raw and unflavorful. And actually uncooked as far as I could tell? Really? Pierogies are all about the juice and oil and - preferably - subtle onion. This place very completely dis-impressed me. Not worth a second chance. Maybe a case of too extensive a menu, but absolutely nothing here felt home-made or special. Try again.

I got This delivered a few days ago and it was awesome. They were fairly quick to deliver and once they got here, the bag was perfectly stapled and a decently sized. The wraps I got were so good and not greasy at all. 5 stars!

This is your business eatery. This is where you might take prospective clients for a business lunch and expense it with the company account. Not a place for people who like AUTHENTIC Asian food. The food at PF Chang's, at every PF Chang's, is Americanized to suit the American palates, meaning they stick with the fried, sweet and spicy flavors. If you visit ANY mom and pop, hole-in-the-wall, or basically any non-chain restaurant, THAT is where you will find the true flavors. Not here. Believe me, I've tried. And I can't help but groan when my 8-year old sister wants "Chinese food" from PF Chang's.
Racist, racist bartenders and servers.  Honestly don't know why any people of color patronize this bar.
Great food and the location is very nice (but hard to find). Not too noisy, you can actually have a conversation.

OVERPRICED! Everything is great but not the main - food. The food from 3 course menu (92$ per pers) was on the lowest level for such restaurant. The choice of main course is poor. You can see the beans ( taste like heinz actually) in every dish. Starters was not bad but after that a disaster became. I had a lamb loin (2 piec sized like baby's palm) with smelly cabbage like in USSR. Second party had a pork loin . It tasted like smoked turkey breast wich was cooked couple of days ago. Cocktails was 80% ice Desert? I think you can guess. The only plus its service.

My favorite slices of pizza in New York, crab and artichoke.   The artichoke slice is great if you want to be completely stuffed and the crab if you'd like to have something to eat but not need to take a siesta afterward.   There are usually lines that can take a while, but it's worth the wait.  The slices are $4.50 but that's not a lot to ask for what you'll get.

This rating is actually 1/2 a star. The menu is written on the wall so if you are seated on the inner most part of the restaurant then you won't be able to read all the options. I ordered the chili burger which was pretty good until I found 2 hairs in it. Whoever is handling the food needs to wear a hair net. I see why the sanitation rating was a B but it certainly should have been lower. I will not be returning.

This place was a huge disappointment. Food took over an hour to prepare. My girl got the quinoa which tasted and looked like quaker oats oatmeal. I got the bistec which was so chewy I left much of it on the plate. Service was downright horrendous. I get that they're new. But it was so bad we will not be going back even once they figure it out.

Nico is literally attached to NJPAC, making it THE dining choice before a show there. Or one would think. On the upside, the food was very good and the staff was pleasant. The service was awful, and if you scroll thru these reviews, you'll see this complaint often. We sat for 20 minutes before anyone came to take an order. The food arrived quickly - actually, too quickly - with the server trying to take away our half finished appetizers to make room for the entrees. Awkward. Entree was thoroughly enjoyable. Then, we sat. And sat. And sat. No one came to offer a drink, dessert, the check, anything. Had to flag down a bus boy to find our server. 20 minutes later, offered our expensive cocktails TO GO because it was showtime. Fail.

I've been twice and I love it!  The beef sliders are the best sliders I have ever had in my life.  All the food is delicious, but the sliders are the absolute best. Really nice lounge, good location, great food, friendly staff and amazing service.
Excellent food from the pizza to the Italian dishes...My family had them do Catering recently and they couldnt be Happier with their food choices. And inexpensive too!
Very good food and they have Greek beer!! A lot of topics to choose from, fresh and healthy, I will be back! Very cool spot!

I'm a huge fan of indian food. LOVE it to death and indian cuisine is not new to me. I'm also not from New York. That being said, I ordered (whatever it's called in their language), the lamb in Marsala sauce. First off it's expensive. It's $18 where as OTHER PLACES, the same meal would cost under $10. So for $18, I was hoping it would be the best lamb curry in the world and honestly it was just OKAY. Nothing fancy about it. The lamb was good (not amazing) and the Marsala was nothing fancy either, just NORMAL ASS Marsala. We also ordered a side of naan which they gave us 4 big pieces which was nice. For the price and quality of the food tho, I wouldn't come here again. AGAIN, I LOVE indian cuisine and this was just okay to me. The price, I don't know If that's a just a New York thing but I definitely recommend you to GO SOMEWHERE ELSE because you will get the same quality food (or better) for less.

Very disappointed by this new addition to Princeton. There aren't many mid-scale burger options around, and I was hoping 30 Burgers could fill the niche. The cramped interior seems like a cheap fast food place that is still under construction. I've been to nicer looking McDonalds in far worse areas. I know this has been mentioned in other reviews, but the floor is truly disgusting. Covered in food bits and sticks when you lift your shoe. The staff seemed a bit clueless and overwhelmed, but friendly and prompt. I ordered the "Pulled pork burger" for $7 and a side of cheese fries for $3. While ordering, I asked the cashier to confirm that the burger had both pulled pork and a beef patty on it (some of the burger listings didn't mention the patty) and she replied "Yes, probably". However upon reaching my destination, I discovered that my $7 sandwich was simply a roll with lukewarm pulled pork on it. It was really uninspired and not tasty. Usually, the description of "burger" signifies a patty of some sort... not sure if the cashier or the cook messed up. The fries were decent, but overall it was an expensive experience for very mediocre food. I probably wont return.
Good food, good service. Seems year guys have been successful at putting a bit of a healthy spin on traditional dishes. I like it.

Shanghai dumplings are great here, so are the other menu items. Don't order too much if you're walking around after dinner, and don't feel like carrying leftovers. Get here early for dinner to avoid the long lines. 5:00 pm on Friday and we got right in with a table of six.
awesome ambience and great fusion food!

Let me just say 3 days have passed since we went here and I am still upset about the experience we had. First, our waitress came right over and the first thing she said was "today is only my third day" which is a little tacky since it was unsolicited, but we just laughed it off. What then happened was just inexcusable, third day or not. First, we asked for a minute to think about our order, and she did not return for 20+ minutes. She clearly did not know the menu, and when we asked if she could bring us chips she said "that's not my job, someone else does that" and we didn't get the chips for at least another 20 minutes. I ordered a drink on the rocks, she gave it to the wrong table, picked it up off their table and gave it to me, and it was frozen which was wrong anyway. She then gave me my soup with my meal when I had asked for it as an appetizer before the meal, forgot my empanadas, and completely forgot my mothers dish and never apologized for it! I don't think she had any idea she completely forgot one guest's entire meal, someone else working had to take her order again while we all sat here waiting for them to make it with now cold food. Then finally when we were just so fed up and wanted to leave as soon as possible, and didn't even argue over the fact that she OVERcharged us for extras we did not order. We were in so much of a hurry that we didn't realize the waitress gave us the paid receipt without our credit card! We had to return the next day to the restaurant to retrieve it. I would not recommend anyone to come here and will be looking up new places for future dining. I really hope someone who works here reads this and understands what a terrible experience we had.

Another amazing find in New Haven.  GREAT vegetarian/vegan options. The food is spectacular.  The service spot on.  Prices are actually low for New Haven.  Great atmosphere.  Great music.  (We actually felt as if we were on vacation on an island eating dinner late on a Thursday night.) Don't know what else I can say other than this was our best "first time" in a local restaurant in a long while. Will absolutely return...often.
Not that good...much better Italian in the city.  Staff was a disgrace.. Food subpar, only plus byob.

Taverna Kyclades is truly what Greek food in Astoria / LIC is all about. As a loyal fan of Opa! Opa! for years, migrating with carloads of friends hungry for souvlaki and gyro from the Bronx, Opa was the gold standard for me. Until I discovered Kyclades. Firstly, don't be thrown off by the wait, when you're talking about the best of something, there's going to be alot of people clamoring for their Greek salads, impeccable cold dips, and perfectly grilled meat and fish, for sub-market costs. To quench the clamoring, the lovely Greek woman who greets you at the door, and is extremely good at her job, hands you some wine and tells you to have a drink while you wait. Never saw that anywhere, and hooked me from the first time. Last night was my 4th visit, and as always, there's some new thing I discover there and swear will be the only thing I order next time because I over-ordered. First, it was the char-broiled, yet somehow impeccably juicy chicken kabob, the size of my forearm, and served with their tzatziki. The time after that, the Greek style shrimp, with a light tomato sauce, crumbled feta and large broiled shrimp that combined to form a somewhat melted, feta-ey tomato cream sauce while the grilled shrimp bathed in it, really good stuff. Last night, it was the swordfish kabob. Basically everything I said about the chicken, but better if that's possible. Tender in the middle, charred on the edges, and fall apart flaky, with a dollop of tzatiki, doesn't get any better. It also comes with a nicely prepared rice pilaf, loaded with flavor and not dry at all. The dessert is a custard wrapped in filo, smothered with honey and cinnamon, that creates the perfect sweet bite after all the savoriness. And it's complimentary, but I would gladly pay for it. All in all, go with a group, have some wine, and have a great time at Astoria's best Greek spot, hands down.

Went because of Yelp. Very nice dive with excellent food and friendly service . Yes to the salmon with mashed potatoes and bok choy! Yes to the ginger soup! Yes to the owner who clearly welcomes all:)

Went with a whole group of people. I give the place an A plus for ambiance and friendly waitstaff. Everyone at our table ordered something different but unfortunately no one loved what they got. It sounded delicious on the menu, but the taste was just not quite there for any of the dishes. Very disappointing.
People are incredibly nice and the food is made fresh and it's delicious! Thr coffee was some of the besr I've ever had. I recommend the Mocha Latte!

Gila's Nosh is awesome.  Gila is awesome and runs the place with her family.  She does most, if not all, of the cooking and everything I've tried so far is delicious for a good price. Gila is very personable and if you get to talk to her, it feels very homey like you're talking to your nana or auntie. My favorite thing to get here is their Moroccan Mint Tea.  Sometimes when I come with a couple of friends, I was able to order a pot of it.

Took my boyfriend here for his birthday. The place is elegant and very modernized. The service was phenomenal! After trying the squid ink pasta, we got two more orders right away because it was the best pasta ever.Expensive and portions are small but it this place is the real deal!
Great, fresh food and interesting characters who serve you.  Only thing keeping me from going 5 stars is the cleanliness of the eating area. Olaf, wash the walls down once in a while!

Me and my friend tried this place last week and were very disappointed.  This restaurant bills itself as a steakhouse but it appears to be better suited as a Rodizio restaurant.  They have several cuts of meat displayed in a glass showcase as you enter that are labeled as Angus Beef, but if your look at them they appear to be the same cuts you can get in a supermarket, no marbling at all. Started with shrimp and garlic app and a shrimp cocktail.  Waiter brought out the shrimp cocktail and had to wait several minutes for my friends shrimp and garlic.  It didn't make sense to bring only one app out at a time.  The shrimp and garlic was very good and the portion was huge.  The shrimp for the cocktail were warm, like they had been previously frozen then put into hot water to thaw them out.  Didn't taste fresh and the sauce was bland. We ordered a NY strip and a rib eye steak, both medium rare.  When the steaks arrived we immediately noticed they had a bronzed look to them and appeared to be overcooked.  We cut into the steaks and both were cooked well done.  Both steaks had absolutely no taste to them.  They were dry and had no seasoning.  We advised our waiter and he said he would talk to the chef.  A few minutes later he came back and offered an apology and asked if we wanted to order something else.  We both declined and asked for the check and the waiter removed the charges for both steaks. If you want good steak go to Char on R202 in Somerville, dry aged beef cooked correctly.

Food and environment is good. Lots of specialty rolls. Quality of service can be good, but has usually ranged from bad to terrible. One server I had was excellent to my friend with a gluten allergy, she knew everything about the menu and was attentive and polite the whole time. She was great. Another time? We waited forever for menus, for the check, for the receipt, for everything. Another time I was charged $500 to my card instead of $50 and they took days to rectify the problem with my bank. I don't recommend this place, even though the food really is pretty good.

Great for authentic sushi lovers. The flavors are all immersed in the fish. For anyone who likes to dip their sushi in soy sauce think again. The waitress told us "NO NO not good idea"!!!! The place is very simple yet has an elegant style at the same time. We had a small sake bottle and the omakse and it was almost $200 for two. Not your typical japanese dinner but great for special occasions.

Amazing sushi, laid back atmosphere. Love the fact that it's BYO. Have been a few times & each time left very happy. Great place for a casual date night or to gather with a few friends without paying what you would at most Center City establishments. Spartan roll is out of this world!

I agree that the 3 Leches cake is AMAZING! This hidden gem is an unassuming store on with street access and no personal property. Step inside and you suspect nothing of the delectably delightful sweets awaiting your palate. We tried the Tiramisu and the peach cake and both were extremely affordable (each slice at $2.50 and coffee for $1.50). Definitely will stop back when I'm in the area!
What a wonderful place. People are friendly service is good. i like the XLB and the braised pig feet, so tasty. Lovely decorated. Good choice;)

where do i start? well i have not use my yelp account in almost 4 years. Well after my experience here i figured i should let the people know. As the common man says We The People. i feel like the people should know about turanos pizzeria. First off, upon taking the garbage out a coupon fell out for this pizzeria. I thought it was a sign because, come on how often does it happen? So me and buddy ordered what seemed to be a deal but my god i wouldve settled for anything else. after an hour of waiting the delivery boy (or lack of one) just came with 2 items which were breadsticks and coke. At first i thought ok hey maybe he just forgot the pizza and he's gonna bring it. NOPE. next thing i know speed racer is gunning it down my block, luckily my friend who is very fast caught up and explained to the delivery boy what happened and he promised to come back with a fresh pizza. let me say that again FRESH PIZZA. so that took another 30 minutes and we were left to snack on what seemed to be bread socks. Now take a moment, remember when you were in high school and you had those sweaty socks that you wore cause you were too lazy to wash? is it all coming back to you? well THOSE would be more appetizing then those Soggy lady finger cookies dipped in water and sat on. So after 2 angry customers and an episode of the office later, the pizza finally came. Now the best part. the pizza. lets just say that if you took white bread, threw some ketchup on it, covered it in american cheese and cut up hot dogs on it. It would be better then the sweaty pie we got. the pizza was bleh. Yes, if bleh had a taste turanos would be behind that taste. this place is not appetizing and i will NEVER  eat here again. please the only thing left to do is BOYCOTT. SHAME. SHAME.......SHAME.

I would like to thank Turanos Pizzeria for motivating me to open, sign up and begin writing Yelps about restaurants I eat at. My experience at Turanos was that terrible. I should've known it be terrible when I found their coupon in my friends trash can. First of all after making the phone call, I received a call back because they had forgotten half my order. Second I was going to write a Yelp right away but I realized I only received my "breadsticks" and my coke. No one gets delivery on just "breadsticks". I thought "hmm, maybe this guy can't carry a paper bag and a coke and a pizza box, he'll be back." NOPE. Sure enough- he left ;when I chased him down the street he told me he forgot the pizza. So while I wait for the pizza, let me describe the "breadsticks" to you. Imagine a ladyfinger cookie dipped in water....but instead of water it looked like it was drenched in sweat. Garlicky sweat. The coca-cola was decent. Best part of the delivery. So I finally get my pizza - 30 minutes later. Same cold pizza. No effort in giving me a fresh pie. I open it because Hey I'm starving. And I sure as hell was not going to eat the "breadsticks". So the pizza was cooked in the same sweat as the breadsticks. Disgusting. I think a lunchables pizza has more love into it. I had to order another pizza to avoid the trauma of Turanos Pizzeria! Avoid this pizzeria at All cost unless you want bad food. Boycott Turanos! Shame, Shame, Shame.

I like Quaint but they have to expand their menu!  The drinks are good and I like the waiters there.  They should bring back the calamari.  The mixed drinks menu is excellent.  However, as a single woman I don't feel very welcome when I walk in.  I feel this place is more for couples.

We have eaten here a dozen times and the menu always changes with the season. Fresh beans, perfectly cooked meats, and great drinks. I strongly recommend this place. It's a gem of Hartford if you dare to stray from downtown.

I had been interested in visiting this place since I first read about them opening.  The draw for me is the pinball, which is difficult to find these days.  I'm happy to report that they more than met my expectations.  As for the games, a good assortment, fairly priced, and arranged so that you have enough room to play. The ambiance was a good (and unique) combination of bar, arcade, and casual dining restaurant.  Initially I thought I would just check out the pinball, but decided to get a bite to eat too.  I had their white bean chile with corn bread, which was very good.  I wouldn't mind seeing some kind of veggie burger on the menu, as well as a fish option (sandwich or fish and chips) but, as it is, the menu is creative and fresh.   So, if you have a yen for pinball or other classic arcade games, or a beer and some quality food, I'd check them out.
Everything we ordered was fresh and tasted great! Lovely ambiance and great service. Will return!
Enjoyed a chicken cutlet sandwich today called the Salerno..Fresh sautéed broccoli rabe with sun dried tomatoes and provolone cheese..Chips and an Ice tea and I'm a Happy Camper...Thanks Angelo's! :)

This is what a friend of mine meant when she said something was so good it made you want to "get up and slap your grandma!"  This is great pizza!  The char on the crust, the fresh cheese, the sprinkle of olive oil after it bakes and of course the fresh basil that is cut and sprinkled over each pie gets after it comes out of the oven.   You bite into what tastes like heaven. Go there with patience.  The lines are often long, but the wait is worth it.  Each pie is looked over with care.  If you want quick and easy, I am sure there is a Little Ceasar's that will take your $5.

First time eating here, ordered take out. The bartender who was at the front and was not friendly at all when taking my order and happened to forget to give me the rest of my change (I asked her what the total was and then gave me the rest). I ordered the spicy noodle. The dish itself was not very good. The dish wasn't quite spicy and wasn't savory and to top it off, I found a piece of hair in it. So my advice is, don't get the spicy noodle unless you're looking for a dish that has an identity crisis. And don't expect smiling servers when you walk in. Keep those expectations low.

Lombardi's pizza is probably one of those places you've heard about. Its probably a place you've heard two things about. It takes hours to get in and its the best pizza in New York!!! Well yes and no...  Pizza is excellent but not the best in NY but its pretty good!  The wait hmmm...  well its NY and pizza ok.  Yes you will have to queue, but it really is "pick your moment". We turned up and by chance there was no queue at all. Five minutes after we arrived we were the head of a queue of fifteen. If you arrive any time between 5pm and 8pm you can expect a delay getting in. But the staff will try their best. Often going in smaller groups is better. As a group of two we were seated in five minutes (As we didn't mind sitting at the bar). The portions are what you'd expect from any eatery and it is well made. My criticisms would be, there is a limited number of options for toppings and to be honest, there are better pizzerias. I had a fantastic time here and for tourists this place is easy to find and easy to love. But i can't help shake the feeling that every resident in the area just shakes their head as they travel up the road to what they this is the best kept secret . Can't fault them at their craft but that nagging suspicion keeps them from obtaining the elusive fifth star.
On weekend afternoons they serve a Bahn Mi. By far the best quality of ingredients I have had in a Philly Bahn Mi. We will be back!

Finally, excellent quality Mexican food in the area.  Service was excellent, food was outstanding, ambiance was perfect...everything about the restaurant is great.  I highly recommend this place.  We are already looking forward to going back soon.  Put this at the top of your "To Try" list...trust me, you will not regret and will become a regular as we have.
I'm originally from Szechuan, this is only place I can taste a little my hometown favor in NJ&PA area.

Clean and unique place! I love their Bibimbab and fruit smoothie. they alwas give out samples to everyone, all different kind of Kimchi and the taste is really great, Not salty, Not too spicy at all ! I was affraid to eat that spicy food but now I obsess Kimchi

I went here with some friends for drinks and something to eat before we went out to hang out...I love the set up it is so cute with the food truck in the back. The food and drinks were ok. I think its the setup that makes this such a nice place.
Great

This place is truly the last of its kind. The corned beef, pastrami are pickled on the premises. Expect an oversize sandwich when you place your order. We had the number 5, pastrami always on the bottom, then corned beef topped with coleslaw on Jewish Rye. Then we had Jewish penicillin "Matzoh Ball Soup" . The chicken broth and noodle are like old time chicken soup. The knish is obviously home made and very tasty, try it with their mustard. Enjoy their complimentary pickles and make sure you wash all this down with a DR. Browns soda. My favorite is the celery soda.
One of our favorite hidden treasures on the upper east side! Try the traditional or the chicken sandwich with veggies! The food is wonderful but the space is tight so try to go on off peak hours.

I honestly don't know how this restaurant gets such rave reviews.  Me and my girls took a taxi from the Bronx to Brooklyn to try this restaurant after reading all of the glowing reviews on Yelp.  This atmosphere is fantastic and the waiters are courteous and helpful. The bathrooms are clean. But IMO the food is just all right.  Reading the reviews my mouth watered and I couldn't wait to try the pecan encrusted pork chops with sweet potatoes and collards.  Pork chops were just o.k. - thin and kind of dry.  Sweet potatoes were good but then again it's hard to mess up a sweet potato. Collards were good.  My sister had a salmon burger with fries. Fries were excellent; salmon burger was just o.k. My other sister had baked or steamed salmon.  She said it was dry.  Someone else said the macaroni was definitely on point. I had some kind of shrimp spring roll as an appetizer that DID NOT have any shrimp in it!!! The drinks were weak - too much ice, not enough liquor. The first few sips were o.k. and then it was like drinking koolaid.  Not only that, it took about 45 minutes for our food to come.  Maybe I should have had the chicken and waffles that everyone raves about instead
Can't go wrong with this place. Works for brunch, dinner, and dates. Highly recommend the bi bim bap.

Where ever I come here I feel like a fat little pig. I want to order anything and everything off the menu and snort it all down so I can have something else! Omg did I just confess that? I've yet to be disappointed. The only thing is the wait for table and food but all well worth it!!! I'm drooling as I write this ha ha ha!

I noticed this place opening up after the tapas place closed down. I pass in town leaving the y. I never thought to eat here because good Italian food is easy to come by. What finally got me and my boyfriend here was the fact that everywhere else in town was packed. What a pleasant surprise! The staff was great and so was the food. We both had pasta which was homemade with flavorful sauces. The cappuccino was nice too. Give this place a try.
Absolutely pathetic. An embarrassment to call this pizza in the proud borough of Brooklyn. Lukewarm, limp, tasteless AND the best yet- Expensive!!!
The pizza here was amazing. We were staying in Brooklyn and knew we had to check this place out, it was well worth the wait and the hype!!

The Meal at the Eddy was of the best in awhile and on the short list of all time great meals. We had an early reservation and we had the place to our selves which was great. We took our time and paced the courses and all were  tasty, fresh and flavorful. The cocktails were great too on point. Do yourself a favor and come eat here now,  decor is cool small cozy place Come ready to eat and have your taste buds blow away. Staff is awesome that's all I have to say. Stop looking and book
Great food and a very nice atmosphere. The Salad Boat was amazing and the food was great. The lite fare menu was a great option for my wife. Also, there is a 10% off coupon in most nearby hotels.

Ymm. It's a good place for a quick bite to eat. place is very tiny but we have a fun dinner. Meatballs are one of my favorite foods. They have amazing specials. Also,the staff is really nice. It can get crowded ,maybe you will get there on a slow time but it's worth to wait.
Extremely delicious food! Typical  dining environment among Hong Kong restaurants.
Magic food, we went there in a large Group and everyone was really happy with their meals.

First off, since we only ordered the sushi, my opinions might be biased. However, I cannot say it better than my friend Gerald did, when he reviewed this page in February of 2014: "What is this place? High end appearance inside a lower budget hotel. Sushi ordered by a price/quantity formula, rather than quality/taste alone. " I think Gerald was completely right in classifying it so. Our waiter took quite a while to get us anything, and the place was eerily empty. Despite having enjoyed a tasteful sushi dish myself (the Angry Birds which I would in fact recommend), it did not make up for the atrocious wait time. The food was overpriced, at least in my opinion, and the only reason my family went, or might ever go again would be if we used the Groupon deal that finally pushed us through Pure's doors in the first place.

This restaurant is fantastic.  One of the best in Vermont.  The Turkish food is beyond delicious.  The chilled yogurt, spinanc and garlic soup is a marvel made possible by the chef's home made yogurt and inventiveness.  The Turkish Salsa is amazing!!!  I have been in Vermont for three days and have eaten here twice and plan to stop by on my way back to Boston.  This place is worth the detour.  Do't go to Hanover to eat, stop by this place!!!
This is my spot for a cheese steak big good and affordable ps ..go early the spot is in THE HOOD
Maybe the best bacalhau com natas I've had even in Portugal!! The service was so friendly!! I highly highly recommend this restaurant. They have an awesome lounge in the basement as well. Open late!!

Service was so nice and accommodating.  The food was absolutely delicious.  Even though it is listed as a 2 course  prix fixe menu,the food just keeps coming with little tastes here and there.  Each thing we had was prepared quite simply but  the food tasted so fresh and well paired that it jumped out at you.  The chef came out and talked with us as the restaurant was closing and she was in no hurry at all.  She is a simple easygoing delight, just like the food she makes!

It saddens me to give them two stars, because I used to really like their duck rice bowl. We've had other dishes from here (although I refuse to eat any more of their pork buns because with family from Taiwan, we definitely have better home-made ones) and they're ok, but it's always been about the duck rice at Momofuku Ssam Bar for me (and my family). I have family from out of town who have specifically requested to come back here just for that dish. However, after several recent experiences, I can pretty confidently say that they've gone downhill. The service is indifferent at best, which I'm saying with low expectations of a casual place where the servers dress like hipsters. However, there is a glaring problem with the kitchen now and the way they send out dishes. We ordered five orders of the duck over rice and got varying degrees of done-ness on the duck, as well as greatly disparate volume of food. I had literally half as much duck as my mother's dish, and several less pieces of lettuce (which you have to pay extra for, btw). There is obviously an expediter in charge of the kitchen sending out plates, so I really wonder what he's doing. This kind of cavalier attitude about service isn't what I would expect from a highly regarded restaurant group and I do hope they'll turn things around, because honestly, the food when on point is definitely in the 4+ star range...

WOW.  We often go out to dinner in Montclaire because of the varied choices and BYO that most offer.  This time my wife heard of Prime, which is a little off the main drag.  The reviews looked good--- they do not do it justice. The place was superb.  The owner served us  and he was beyond enthusiastic about his food.  Justifiably so.  From the fresh "wild" calamari (some of the best I have ever eaten) to the short rib stuffed canelloni, nothing disappointed.  My wife ordered  the shrimp/broccoli rabe cavatelli - the best pasta she ever had. When we thought we were done being amazed, the Brioche pudding with caramel sauce complimented by pistachio gelatto put the finishing touch on the meal.. Can't wait to go back and introduce it to our friends.

Back for second time in two weeks and that rarely happens because of the endless dining options here in Philly. Pizza and salads so delicious my husband and I needed a repeat and were not in the least disappointed.  Great food and service in a relaxed atmosphere.
Great friendly service and even better pizza, a pity we only had a chance to eat one!

I have been going here for years and it's The best on the block!   Everything is fresh and homemade.. I had the best homemade fettuccine with proscuitto, mozzarella, and sweet peppers with vodka sauce. OHHH man and the best cannoli I ever had. The ricotta cream was so fresh it was warm from the whipping it just took.

5 stars for this place. I work very close by and this is my go to when I'm not feeling fast foods. My favorite is a toasted cream cheese and jelly bagel. The bagels are warm, not over toasted, they give a good amount of cream cheese and the bagels are big. They have a good drink and bakery selection also. The muffins in the front are really good. I've also had there tuna salad on a roll for lunch. It's delicious, fresh tuna with chips and a fresh pickle on the side. Good service all the time. But be aware sometimes their hours aren't as stated.
Food is great and the service is good. Very fast, clean, and friendly. The mac and cheese, cream spinach is amazing!

We had the opportunity to come to NIXS Hartford for a pre-opening tasting. The drinks we had were fabulous. The Bad Wolf was delicious, as was the Bazzle Dazzle. For the tasting menu, we enjoyed the Tater Tots (delicious but served at less than piping hot), the Mac n Cheese (good, nice flavors), and the spinach dip (nice flavor, but again--the temperature less than ideal, and a whole garlic clove found its way into our serving). The salmon was prepared as requested--the coconut jasmine rice was amazing. The dessert of Italian doughnuts was delicious--the caramel sauce better than the cream. In all, it's definitely a great addition to Hartford's food scene.
The food is amazing on point cool resturant and spot for breakfast lunch and dinner yummy

Always a stop I make after bar hopping for delicious food. James is my favorite server here regardless of how long I haven't been around he always remembers me! The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing. They sometimes even have someone playing the piano. My favorites here is the fried calamari , the jumbalaya,  the sunday prime rib, the sliders annddd gah almost everything! Oh and the knock burger is great. The food is good and the drinks are strong! This place is great.

Very cute joint! Cool seating, very hip. Great for a dinner with friends! The food was very fun and mostly arranged to be shared. The staff was helpful and attentive. Really loved this place. I went with a group of 5 and we all walked away satisfied.
Meh....crammed, dark bar. If that's what you're into, go on in!
Fabulous stuffed French toast and home fries and peppers! My server was friendly and helpful. Plus side - they accept credit cards! Yay!!!!!!!

Had dinner there this weekend.  I have to say,  I was not very impressed to say the least.  The dishes I tried were mainly acceptable with the exception of the BBQ'd Oysters.   Dessert we had the Doug pecan pie sundae and blackberry tart. Regular tasting dessert.Service was great. Waitress & hostess were kind. Would not tell friends they haveeee to try this restaurant though.

This is late in coming, but my (now-husband) and I stayed here for a night in December 2012. It was by far the BEST experience at an Inn that we've ever had. Richard and Marilee were absolutely fantastic hosts - they upgraded our room upon arrival (even before they knew we had just gotten engaged!), got us dinner reservations in the dining room, gave us directions to some nearby shops and even sent a bottle of wine over to our table at dinner. They really made us feel like old friends.   Dinner at the Inn was amazing (as was breakfast!) My husband has a gluten allergy and not only was the food fantastic at dinner and breakfast, the staff was super accommodating and knowledgable.   The rooms were charming, rustic, and very clean. No kitsch to be found. Totally recommend! Five stars!
Amazing service, amazing food, amazing experience!!!!! Yes, portions are extremely small, but the taste is incredible! Totally worth it!!!! I will definitely be back!

Their meat is perfectly seasoned. The wait time isn't long. You'd most likely have to order two rolls, as one roll isn't really that filling. However the staff has a small issue with waste management. If you owned a restaurant, how would you want your staff to handle the garbage? A. During downtime when there are less people in the restaurant. B. Through the back door in the alley (if this is possible) C. During dinner time, persistently shove two carts of garbage through the line of a dozen people waiting to order/waiting for their order, and nudge a baby carriage along the way. ...They chose C.

Dinner July 2014. Nice, open atmosphere although a little loud for conversations. Foie gras and chicken liver was surprisingly good, as was the warm goat cheese and caramelized onion tart. Good cocktails.

This was my first visit to Zizi Limona, though my roommate has been a bunch of times before and always enjoyed the food and had good service. We took her dad, who was visiting from out of town, and her cousin, who lives in New York. To spare you all the boring details, our food took forever and in the end we waited about an hour and half to get our main dishes, which never actually made an appearance at the table. My roommate's dad went to talk to the manger (who is also the owner) and he said something along the lines of, "this is my world! you gotta wait!" and more or less berated my friend's dad for asking when the food was coming out. Ok dude. We talk about it, and decide that it's probably appropriate to leave, and let the owner know and offer to settle the bill. The owner comes out starts yelling at us and insulting everyone in the party - "Leave! I don't want you here! This isn't Manhattan!" It was crazy. I've worked for many a service industry asshole, but never one that would scream at customers. It's a bummer that a cute neighborhood spot with good food has a serious asshole for an owner.

Great place to eat at. Toloache is a nice and friendly place to be at. They have great service! The only reason i gave this a 4 star is i didn't wear proper kind of clothing and i felt awkward, but nobody mind. imma come again, but just with proper clothes.:)

FAB - U - LOUS! The atmosphere is trendy and sexy. 70's square boxes chandeliers over the bar with light blue velvet swivel bar stools with backs .. the food is great - BEST i had was the SHRIMP TACOS and the MAC AND CHEESE -- served in this sinful little pie crust - tasty --- oh, and the SPICY MARGARITA is fantastic-- but only for the edgy... an uptight a-hole who is sensitive to spice may not appreciate it - be warned :)

Terrible food. I came here because I was invited. The food was trash. I had a burger, TERRIBLE. I had some tarot toots, they were OK. Lemonade, TERRIBLE. The staff was cool as hell but I came to eat and the food was terrible.

Absolutely fresh and delicious! Back in LP for a bit and I've headed to i Sushi three times in ten days. Added bonus: the owners are friendly and thoughtful. Will return...need to order the daily specials...

Overall, this is a good restaurant. The service is prompt, wait for New York is reasonable and the variety is great. We had several yakitori and other dishes. I've had yakitori before but at other restaurants. Here it's noticeably smaller so it would be nice if they could provide an additional one on the plate for sharing. I thought the marinade is tasty and the grilling was v. nicely done.

My wife & I recently passed through Newark Airport on our vacation. We decided to eat at Garden State Diner because it was close to our Gate. Man - I am so glad we did! I've recently started enjoying Reuben sandwiches and have never had a real New York deli sandwich. I also have not had an open-face version, but this one was delicious - the best Reuben I've ever had! Generous amount of thick-sliced pastrami, 'kraut and melted Swiss cheese. Yes, we ate there on our way back home too. So, if you go through Newark Airport, swing by Gate 80 for the Garden State Diner. You'll be glad you did.

Not the same anymore! We have been to Le Grainne a couple of times in the past and never had a bad experience. We ordered the mussels which turned out to be too salty! The waiters had to be asked a couple of times for bread and water. For a French place you would expect the crepes to be spot on. But here the bananas they used were underripe with no flavor to the chocolate making the crepes extremely bland. The batter was stringy. One of the worst we have had. Left most of it. Will not be back.

Pizza was burned and stale and tasteless. To top it all of, the staff was rude. Def not going back!!!! Do yourself a favor and get some good pizza next door at grimaldis. This place is SO not what it makes itself out to be.
Great atmosphere. Friendly staff. Great food

Second time back, had another wonderful dinner. Last week we had a four plate family style mezza, shared plates which we really enjoyed. Our waitress was fantastic, made great recommendations, was on top of things without being obtrusive. This week we ordered full entrees. Had lamb kebobs, roast chicken and vegetable briam. Delicious, and generous servings, brought home enough for dinner  tomorrow. We really don't eat out often but are happy to have a beautifully decorated, non-chain restaurant nearby.
Excellent food and atmosphere with exceptional service, with a BBQ takeout 2nd to none!!

I really should have checked them out on Yelp before I let my friend bully me into airport sushi... We wanted sushi and we didn't have much time till we needed to board the plane. Considering how pricy their rolls were, you would think that it would at least be decent. Not really... We ordered the veggie dumplings which were not horrible, salmon sushi which looked and tasted awful, the eel something roll and another one with spicy tuna. Costco sushi looks gourmet compared to what we were served here. I would have been more satisfied with a bag of chips. Don't make the same mistake we did. There isn't enough wasabi and soy sauce in the world to drown the taste of that fish..
the place is  very nice and clean , all food was fresh and delicious , we order grilled shrimps and falafel  and appetizer plate , shepard salad , the staff also very pleasant . we will be back .
Friendly staff. Delicious selection of meats and cheeses. Sandwiches on the heavy side, yet surprisingly satisfying.
Merely ok. Had the specialty fish entree which was overcooked and dry. Service was slow and waitress spilled a drink all over a member of our party. Wouldn't recommend for the price.

My coworker and I were on extended business travel and we were looking for a place near our job site that was going to offer us the ability to sit down for a while.  We had a moment and fast food was not going to be for dinner.  While the area on Roosevelt does not have many options,  after driving back and forth between major intersections we opted for this restaurant.   As we pulled in the overall decor out side is not striking as very nice.  We walked in the front door and were shocked as we stepped into a bar. I immediately thought uhoh this is not the place that I intended. Pretty quickly we realize that the regular dining room area is in the back.  We made our way back to a table and was seated.  Now we're cooking!  White table cloth, comfortable surroundings in a Tuscan style themed dining room. We were immediately served our drinks of ice tea and water and given fresh bread rolls. We both decided to have the special which was the Prime Rib with a house salad, yellow rice and boiled cabbage. The special price was listed as $14.00, which we both agree is a pretty good deal. As hungry meat eaters we were now content to relax and enjoy our salad as we waited for our main entrée. When our server brought our plates I actually laughed out loud as the dinner plates were bigger than I have ever seen. I think they were actually supposed to be platters? I wish I had a tape measure but I swear it had to be at least 30 inches across. My buddy immediately challenged the waiter and asked if what we ordered was Prime Rib, as it had bones in it. Our server assured us both that indeed it was Prime Rib. As our server left we both looked at each other and we really didn't understand why the plate looked like a bony fatty grisly price of meat.  I told my buddy that at least they got the cow part right,  he said it could be horse? I replied that it is likely cow but it didn't even come with Au Jus or horseradish. After attempting to saw through this very very tough piece of meat I decided I had enough asked for the waiter again. My friend continued to eat his as his was cooked less than mine even though we ordered it exactly the same way.  The waiter got very frustrated and states that we ordered the prime rib even though I had pulled a picture of what it was supposed to look like on my phone.  He left for the kitchen and came back with a raw chunk and confidently reaffirmed that we ordered the prime rib. After a few rounds and going back and forth between us we came to realize that it is "grilled prime rib" as per the main menu but the special menu hadn't specified grilled. Overall the waiter removed mine from my ticket as I couldn't eat it. I will give three stars as he did end up taking the meal off the check but overall the entire experience was poor. I ended up stopping for a sub sandwich for my "dinner".  I won't be going back.
A great late night treat. Stopped in after dinner for an icecream cone which topped off a wonderful night.
Been here 3 times.  My favorite is the beef tendon soup (1103) The pork cutlet is good, but the broth is very neutral.

With much anticipation Jora has recently opened and is a nice addition to Long Island City. My wife and I have been twice already and plan on dining again. Jora has such delicious food and a great location. With a couple visits we've been able to try a few appetizers and main courses and everything has been delicious! The pulpo and bistec are my favorites, I can't wait to try the lamb shank! With a nice and attentive staff we've enjoyed our visits and will be back soon.

Probably the worst experience I have had at a popeyes.  After a 10 minute wait for a simple combo meal (which I never got) I gave up and had to argue to get my money back. The employees were indifferent and rude. Terrible.
Worth the wait.  Go for the soup filled dumplings and the potstickers.  You won't be dissapointed.  The long line lets you know this is a good place.
Good dumplings.

Just OK. The tacos were very meaty (I had the al pastor) but a bit light in terms of flavor. Wife ordered the steak fajitas, it was a nice presentation, but again feel like I've had much more savory Mexican in other places. They charge for chips and guac, which isn't a huge deal , except that you get a tiny little cup to share it. Feel like if I'm paying should at least get double the quantity this restaurant gives. Inexpensive, our check was around $30. BYOB, so you save some $ there. Saw some people with cold beer they were keeping in the restaurants fridge, so thats cool. Nice decor, ambience, etc. Seated very quickly, also a good thing. Had to wait a little for service, but nothing absurd.

Terrible experience.  So I decided to try this Noches since it isn't far form where I live.  I was in the mood for a good Colombian breakfast.  When I get there, the girl, I'm assuming is the host, if you can call it that, was not friendly at all.  I did not get a hello, or a welcome; instead I got "Do you need help with something?"  Well let me see.  I'm in a restaurant, and I just walked in.  I did not come here to read a book or look at decor, I obviously came here to eat.  So already I'm annoyed.  My boyfriend and I sit down.  And we wait, and wait.  I have been to many Noches de Colombia, and the thing they have in common is they love to make you wait.  Happens every time, without a fail.  And finally after about 15 minutes of waiting, the waitress shows up.  Let me say that it was not busy at all.  She asks us what we would like to drink and to order.  I ask about the breakfast menu.  She says they stop serving breakfast at 12.  Now I have been to other Noches, where I have gotten breakfast food like at 3.  And if you're Colombian, you know that some of the breakfast food is make with stuff that they use all day.  So I was a bit annoyed by this.  All I wanted was arepa and calentado.  She said I could get arepa, but not the rest.  Mind you, calentado is made by mixing rice, beans, and meat all together.  And this being a Colombian restaurant, they make these items all day.  So it was not happening apparently.  So we took our juice and coffee, paid the bill, and left.  Never coming back.  And to top it off, the parking lot is terrible.
Yum. Whether for lunch, dinner or a midnight snack, Spumoni Gardens will hit the spot. The square pizza can't be beat. Love the sausage and pepper hero, too!!

Always well cooked food. Good portion sizes and friendly wait staff. The 45 minute wait is definitely worth it, and there is a good reason people wait. I'd recommend the saganaki and grilled octopus as they are both to die for.

I really enjoy the atmosphere at this restaurant. Some of the workers just sit around, but I'm not here to complain about that. The tables are clean and everyone is friendly. Very expensive, but refills for fries and soda make up for it! The meat, mozzarella sticks, are very good. The burger rolls are decent. I love franks hot sauce. Overall a good place.

I've been living in East Rutherford now for about 4 years and while I enjoy many aspects about it the thing I will miss the most when I eventually leave is Annabella's. I came across Annabella's shortly after moving here while looking for new places in the area to eat and while I can't recall what exactly it was I ordered on my initial visit, I do know it had some of their fresh mozzarella in it and I immediately realized I would be coming back many many times...and I have. While I've tried several items on their menu, none of which have been disappointing, the shining star at Annabella's is their fresh mozz. Having grown up in an Italian family in Northern New Jersey all my life I have tried countless deli/restaurant's fresh mozz and I can safely say that Annabella's makes the best in the area (yes I have had both Fiore's and Vito's in Hoboken, on more than one occasion). I don't know how they do it (my roommate who is the sous chef at a very nice restaurant in Ridgewood asked what their secret was once and was flatly denied any intel) but I do know it's fantastic and they make it throughout the day so it's always fresh. The owner Bill is always very helpful and willing to have his staff put together a platter of fresh mozz, tomatoes, etc. or whatever else you need if you're going to a party/dinner/etc. and don't want to show up empty handed. Personally I usually just get a log of fresh mozz plus a couple loaves of bread and people wherever I bring them are never disappointed. I do this every Thanksgiving and Christmas and my family always has trouble avoiding eating it all the night before. I should point out that if you are placing an order for a big holiday like those you should definitely call a day ahead just to be safe, they can get pretty busy. Some personal favorite menu items of mine are the Plata, Estivo Wrap, Pinky Carbone, and the roast pork sandwich when it's a special but it's hard to go wrong. Also worth noting that they have extended their hours in the past year where now they are usually open till 8 or 9 on weeknights. They deliver too if you're feeling lazy. I could go on and on about this place but I recommend just checking it out for yourself, I dont think you'll be disappointed.
Love Mamoun's! Their food is delicious and so affordable.

I always loved go here to eat,  the food is so good and they always give large portions. Only thing is long wait for tables on holidays and Sundays. But it's worth it for the quality of food. Service is ok, no complaints really. And it is alittle cramped in space. I highly recommend the honey fried chicken.

Great restaurant, delicious food, very good service, charming, fun and fair price. As a Brazilian this is the most authentic place I've encountered in NY so far. The Salgadinhos appetizers and the Saturday's special feijoada were perfect, identical of what you would find in Brazil. Definitely coming back. Saturdays there's also live samba music that was very fun. Highly recommend. Ótimo restaurante, comida deliciosa, atendimento muito bom, super charmoso e preço justo. Os salgadinhos de entrada e a Feijoada (especial de Sábado) estavam perfeitos, idênticos ao do Brasil. Com certeza voltarei mais vezes. Sábado também tem samba de roda ao vivo, muito legal. Recomendadíssimo!
Went here for dessert.  The flour less cake with vanilla gelato was awesome highly recommend it.   Service is great too.

Do not eat here! It took one hour to bring out out food with the wait staff offering no information about what was going on. Lots of wait staff offering no service. No one in the restaurant since it was an off peak time .

We went looking for a great localbbar with good bar food.  We found that and so much more.  The wings are nice size and very good,  the waffle chicken bites were amazing as was the apple crumb cheese cake.
Loved it. Don't listen to the naysayers the food was excellent staff was attentive and wine cheap!!!   Will come again.

Went for restaurant week lunch with my husband. Love the environment very much. The waiters timely serve you but never bother you with questions like "is everything ok?"; you even did not see them closely around. I like the bright natural light coming from the big windows. My husband and I ordered different options for each of the three courses. Except my entree, all the other five plates are great. Fresh and good quality raw materials (very tender chicken and salmon) and processes elegantly. I wrote some calculation on the table paper when I waited for food. When I left, the waiter was so nice to ask me whether I wanted to take the paper. The overall experience was so pleasant. It deserves its reputation. Will definitely try others in the menus in the future.

My coworkers and I were so excited to try this place out because the reviews looked good and we were starving. 1. We were told it would be 5 minutes to get a table after being ignored for 10 minutes. There were 3 two-tops and 1 four-top tables open. Then, we waited for 40 minutes, not 5 to be re-acknowledged. After being re-acknowledged, we were seated after 10 minutes. 2. I swear we were skipped twice as they do not take names for a waiting list. This one group of 5 said they came 1 hour prior to us but didn't give a name and as soon as they arrived back, they were sat immediately. They were friends with the host. Where was the waiting list???? 3. After sitting, we were then told cash only. Why the hell wouldn't you disclaim that when greeting is for a table first? Or at least have a sign? We were so upset and disappointed in their service and attitude. 4. It's BYOB. I wish I could speak on their food but if their food is anything like their service and host, I bet it's awful. Unfortunately, I wanted to give this place no stars but you have to at least give one even though they are unworthy of one. Advice for the host working 8/13: Firstly, greet your customers and tell them you'll be right with them. Don't ignore people no matter how busy you are. Secondly, let your customers know it's cash only. Lastly, make and take a name for the waiting list.

Great atmosphere to have dinner and drinks, great playa for guys night oht and dinner with the wife. Food is great , I ordered the blackened salmon and loved every bite , shrimp app - also amazing prices are cheap for what it is !!! Only thing we did not like was the fact that we had to wait for almost a hour to be seated both times that we went there. Other than that, all and all we would recommend and def will be going back again!

Really liked this place. Not the best sushi I've ever had but definitely good for this area. The service and atmosphere are pleasant. Sat at the bar for a meal by myself and enjoyed it. Places in Princeton are preferable, like Tomo Sushi, but if you're looking for tasty sushi at a clean local spot, definitely come here.

Had the chicken last night. Clean and crisp and the taste was amazing. The prices are great and they have a good selection. You won't be disappointed by their wraps either. I will be visiting again for sure.

Maybe it was my date but I was smitten with this place. The atmosphere and the food. I had the steak salad he had the Cuban. Yummy.  Per the date stamp on my IG picture, I ate here 48 weeks ago. Delish.
I had the Frutta Di Mare and it was excellent.  The sauce had great flavor and balance and the pasta had a homemade taste and texture.

Food was ok nothing special but we've been here for 2 hours now and just received our appetizers. Good thing I didn't have plans to go out after. Staff was everywhere but looked like they weren't doing anything. Kinda overwhelming. And yet still waiting........ (Slowest service EVER had) this is completely unreasonable I'm so hungry.... And the prices (two mozz pieces for $8?!?!)

Well deserving of their four stars. Order the Matador combo if you and whoever is with you is hungry. You won't be disappointed. Juicy chicken, fries, rice and beans and smashed fried plantains. Treat the green sauce on the table with respect. It is spicy.
Best spinach soup ever. The only grandma slice I'll eat. Most of the staff is friendly. They know my order by now.

This place was pretty hard to find, but nevertheless I had an enjoyable experience there. I wasn't sold on the vegetarian thing but even none vegetarians can have the potato cake (it's not on the menu I think) which was obviously sent down from heaven somewhere. Whoever made it must be a genius. I am not a drinker so I can't comment on the drinks but water was fantastic! Also if you are nice to the white Italian chef with the funky pants she might give u free food, that is if she's not trying to feed u weird smelling vegetables :P she's absolutely fantastic they should give her a raise.
