Slays of unpeeled orange green apple and cantaloupe on the same plate of grilled filemignon and bullion melted in cold water. No salt pepper or anything to taste . On seafood "just paprika " with boiled green beans. Oh god what did I do to experience such a food as a chef. I had to write this on food blogs . Sorry to share this not my style to share bad things but I had to.

I just moved to the area and can't be any happier I found this place. I've come here at least twice a week after work in the past couple months. The food is great, awesome quality and the prices are amazing! I've become a little bit of a regular here and love the cozy feel of the place. Not crazy about the high tables though. The service is great- the same waitress is working every time I'm there ..she's always very friendly and smiley and regardless of the amount of people in the restaurant she always remembers to bring me extra ketchup. The crepe complete is AMAZING, and I usually get the sweet lemon or crepe suzette for dessert!! Not a big chocolate fan so I usually stick with something light. The menu is very impressive and great for all tastes. Will definitely continue to come here. Such a gem.
Amazing lunch. I had a salad that was so gorgeous I didn't want to eat it and my boyfriend got really delicious rice. He loved the marinaded meat in a stick. Overall, a really great meal

Took my mom here for her first time. Started with delicious paper shrimp and of course the stuffed wings. Moved on to the grilled duck breast (soooooooo good) and Seafood Delight. She loved it as did I. Such wonderful blends of flavors. She can't wait to come back.
They've got the best stir fried noodles and rice in town! My favorite place in Philly.

Food is ok. 2 people for lunch and the bill was 15 dollars...the service was bad. The waitress came to get our drink order and that was the last time she made it to my table.i had to ask the hostess for the check. I will not be back. I'd rather pay more and have better service..stay away from this place unless you like being ignored.

Very disappointed. Saw the good reviews and stopped in on our way home after a long drive. It was 9:20 and the hours clearly stated on the door and on Yelp the restaurant was open until 10pm. When we walked in, the manager said they could only do takeout. Really? What kind of place does that. I'm sorry if the restaurant was slow tonight but when you post your hours you should stick to it. I understand if it we walked in at 9:50, but we were there 40 min before close??? My husband and I would have been finished with dinner before close. Very disappointed.
Excellent Service! Beautiful Atmosphere! Warm & Attentive Service! The Perfect Place for any occasion. The Princeton location is the best.

My family and I had a lovely Italian meal after my college graduation ceremony here. It was also Mother's Day, which featured a special menu in honor of the owner's mother's recipes. Besides our party, there were only a couple of other tables taken, which surprised us that it was so slow on what should be a busy night. The waitstaff was very accommodating though. The food was amazing. Everything was delicious and everyone was pleased with their meals. The prices are very reasonable. My parents were shocked that the bill was so cheap at only a few hundred dollars for a party of 10.

Not really a review, but the hours says it's closed on Sundays....I was just there yesterday which was Sunday...so yeah...Just sayin''. Hmm..Might as well as give a review: Personally I don't get the hype. I mean..the foods not bad, but there are so many other things I'd choose to get instead depending on my mood. I mainly get Halal from  here because it's really close to where I work and I get lazy. It could be the location thought. I've heard people saying this location isn't that great and there are much better Halal locations. This is the first and only one I've been to so I have nothing else to judge it on. Though I probably won't be getting it for quite some time since that Sunday it made me feel so horrible; the thought of eating anything with meat made me feel nauseous...

Sultan Gyro has good food, good prices and a very personable owner.                      Do not let reviewers like Mitchel P  AKA (,Vinnie C  ,Michael P, Peter G , Howard R )  -  deter you from eating here. They offer a gluten free option for their pizza and it was Great. Gluten free beer and casual college town atmosphere with friendly and helpful staff. Good food, good service and good prices - what more can you ask for?
ilili is the worst they broke my drink and spilled the drink all over my brothers . So this restaurant needs an upgrade !!
Had dinner here tonight. The wild boar sausage pizza is fantastic. Cannoli's for dessert were a winner too!
They are the bahn masters (I'm so sorry) of the bahn mi Well priced, great tasting and quick. Heck I travel from the Bronx to get my fix. That's how good it is

Food was edible, service was atrocious. Got up and got our own menu's, then got up and got a pitcher of water since there was none put on our table nor anyone bringing it around. The rude woman with the snotty accent gracing us with food after we finally made enough of a commotion to get someone to take our order was very abrasive especially when my son asked for ranch dressing to go on his pizza. YIKES! The pizza needed more sauce or something. Needless to say we won't be going back.

I passed by walking my dog and decided to order some take out.  While waiting for my order outside, I decided to look them up on yelp and was a little worried by the low reviews/lack of pictures.   The staff was really nice.  There was a young boy working the register.  I ordered a chicken torta, beef huaraches, and lengua tacos (comes in 3). This was a good amount of food for two.  My bf and I thought each dish was pretty good, especially the lengua tacos that were really tender and flavorful, especially with the grilled onions they gave on the side.  The beef huaraches were good too -the beef was not dry and flavorless like some mentioned.  The chicken in the torta was on the drier side but I was expecting it from pounded chicken breast.  The beans and dressing and nice big toasted torta bread made up for the dryness. I normally get take out from Bianca's Deli and thought Las Pinatas was comparable, if not better.  The Las Pinatas torta and tacos were bigger compared to Bianca's.  They give you green salsa verde which was great with everything.  There was also a red sauce that tastes like a smoked chipotle.  Didn't use that one much.  Overall, I enjoyed the food and I plan to come back here.   Didn't sit down inside but I thought it was quaintly decorated with fresh potted flowers and table cloth on each table.  Music was playing in the background. FYI: noticed signs that says they are now closed on Tuesdays.
knocked off a star for the small cramped space, but you must stop by for the amazing food. the bronte burger is so friggin good, you must stop by! !!

This burger joint isn't going to blow you away but if you want something a little bit more than just a regular burger, this would suffice. If you are really hungry tho, I suggest you order two burgers. From the pictures posted, i figured the burgers were a lot bigger. The patties are thicker than your average burger but i found myself still hungry after, and thats after eating the fries also, with a soda. Besides that, the burger wasn't half bad. I had a bacon cheese burger which I ordered from the menu posted on the wall. We didn't know and asked for a menu, then the waiter pointed to the menu on the wall. What set it a part from just a regular burger is that the patty was a lot thicker. Thats about it. Other than that, on a monday night, the service was good, we were able to sit where we wanted to and the food was served quickly. It had a cozy feel and if you wanted a drink, they have a small bar in the front as you walk in. Just don't forget to bring cash because its cash only. That too is posted on the wall next to the menu. But over all, Id go back if I wanted something more than just a fast food burger at a reasonable price.
Great new spot in the art museum area.   Menu has a lot of great food options, food is fresh and well prepared and the staff is friendly and accomodating.

Great lunch spot. My personal favorite is their turkey sandwich...it's pretty ballet. Matt and Marie both work at the store, so definitely worth stopping by (if you like to support small businesses). Good vegetarian options ( if you're into that sort of thing) and nice, clean space to sit and eat (with some pretty cool looking tables). New spot that definitely had some love to into its conception and construction.

I went with a group of 12 people for a birthday.  Before, all of us were at the restaurant,  the manager told some of my friends to leave. When we were seated, the waiter served us drinks for more than 30 minutes.  After feeling so hungry, we had to ask the waiter to take our order. The waiter was not friendly at all- he actually came off a bit snobby. Since it was a friend's birthday, a request for the "mini band" was made. But, they decided to preform for another group of customers instead of us. The waiter then claimed the band have "performed" for us. Last , but not least the waiter then gave a wrong amount on the check and claimed it was correct. He was very adamant about the orders. Then the manager came out and proved the waiter wrong. After all the long waiting, the amount on the check was still wrong because he misread numbers on a calculator. To sum it up, this restaurant has very poor customer service.
They have the BEST pizza around! The buffalo chicken pizza they offer is the bomb . I've never had bad service and they always seem to be open late .

"Les Chicken Wings" has the appetizing description "reconstructed panko crusted chicken wings" for $14. I handed the owner $20 for an order to go, and was given back four singles (that is the new thing in bar eateries, they keep whatever quarters and dimes you're owed. stealing. not on the level of bernie madoff, but still theft). What I got was four chicken lolipops in decent sauce. Meh. Tiny portion. At least I got some slices of nice bread included, which saves this from a one star review.

I have been coming to this restaurant for five years and I have come to enjoy sitting outside and watching the most beautiful woman in the city pass by, while enjoying a  glass of wine and a delicious meal.  The owner whom I have gotten to know is a warm and personable man.  I recommend this restaurant  to anyone that loves to sit  back in a relaxed atmosphere and watch the world go by.

We had heard about how great this restaurant was and how difficult to get reservations but we could just walk in and sit at the bar.  We did sit at the bar which was great.  Unfortunately, our bartender was not too knowledgeable about the wines or the meals and she was somewhat blasé about everything. Not too warm or accommodating.  We finally got the attention of another bartender who was quite knowledgeable and described the meals to us with a friendly, warm demeanor.  We ordered oysters which were very fresh then a cheese plate which was great along with wonderful rolls and butter.  Then we shared an eggplant dish as well as a potato dish.  The experience was great.  I would only say that it helps knowing that some of the dishes are eclectic and somewhat small.  It's a dining experience.  Yes, I would go back again.

While I've been in the process of relocating to this area this restaurant has been my go to. Every meal I've had from brunch to lunch to dinner and drinks has been wonderful. The FOH staff and severs are all professional and knowledgeable about each dish and are happy to assist in an appropriate wine pairing. Well worth the wait for a table outside for brunch. A must if you're in the area. Mike my server this evening has been particularly wonderful.
Give it a try, Guarantee the tempting taste will satisfy your appetite.
Great food and service! Cash only.

The Pizza Stone exceeded my expectations.  I had a garden salad and margherita pizza which was fresh and delicious.  The pizza was cooked to perfection.  The selection of local beer and cider was also extensive and tasty.  I'll definitely visit again.

Dined here recently with friends. Where we liked the taste of the food, we felt the prices didn't justify the amount of food we each received. We're fine with tapas style food, but we weren't really told that by anyone in person. We'll see what the future looks like. There can be potential if they listen to their clients.

One of my favorite lunch spots in the city. Love that they're kosher, but wish it didn't mean I can't get my falafel fix on Saturdays. Great deal for half or full falafel sandwich... Great soups in the winter as well. Their fries are pretty good, but there's a bit of a wait for them. The staff can be a bit short with people at times, but it's only cause some people don't understand how to order at a lunch spot that has a line out the door all the time. Owner is a great guy as well. Definitely recommend stopping by if you're a falafel fan.

Definitely too much hype. Not worth 4 stars. Underwhelming food. Standard tuna tartare, basic arugula salad, French fries could have come from Burger King (the Gorgonzola sauce was good but not mind blowing), "mushroom truffle turkey burger" was dry, and could have been made at any deli. Service was okay. Prices are standard, not expensive but too expensive for the quality of the food. If you have any sort of palate or enjoy good food, don't come here. If you're hungry and looking for standard fare that doesn't suck, it's a good option.
Several unique dishes. Appealing presentation. Gluten-free options. Swanky atmosphere. Reasonable prices for the quality. I enjoyed the masaman curry.
Best crabs I ever had! The only con about this place is that they only accept cash :(. However the service is fast, the good is fresh and you'll leave very much so satisfied!

Two words. SLOPPY JOE. The grilled cheese was everything I wanted it to be. The sign outside said "best grilled cheese in town or we'll buy you a drink " and that's what originally sparked my interest. Music was great and for a casual place, the service was amazing. Very decent beer selection and there is a significant amount of wine to choose from. Definitely  recommend it.

Love that the maharlikans are helping the wave of filipino cuisine.  They advertise heavily on their website that this is not authentic.  Hard for many Filipinos to understand that so putting it out there is great. I had the sizzling sisig to start and it was delicious. Sisig was popping off the pan and garlic rice was tasty. I recommend using the vinegar they provide. I also tried to the longanisa which I was not really a fan of.  The longanisa was a little too sweet for my tasting. The Chicken and UBE waffles was also okay.  The waffle came out cold and the chicken was just alright.  They also use a anchovy bangaoong? Was not a fan of it.   I really enjoyed the sisig and am looking forward to try the other dishes.

We desperately want to love this place - we live down the road and would love to have another lunch/brunch/dinner option nearby. Sadly, the one time we went we found two major disappointments - first, the greeting and early service were awful. It wasn't too busy, we we're told they had a table outside (which they then have to someone else), we were seated for almost ten minutes with no menus, when we were finally approached and asked about drinks we asked for water - a few minutes later the server came back and asked if we'd ordered drinks (the same server.) By the time we got to the menus we were disappointed to see there wasn't a single choice for a vegan - something that's not only easy to accommodate, but increasingly common. Anyway, maybe the food is tasty, but the lackluster service and the lack of veggie/vegan options mean we're not likely to be back.

Agh I wanted to give this place four stars but..... The WAIT ... I almost headed somewhere else, but luckily I stayed around in line. The pizza really made up for the 30 minute wait. Pizza was tasty, different toppings than I am use to seeing, perhaps I will try something new, but I enjoyed my long time favorite- Classic Pepperoni! Can't beat it.

I was just the Matron of Honor for my cousin's wedding and she chose this kosher caterer. They were AMAZING! The food was great and the owner Laurie Epstein is extremely friendly. Servers Susan and Trish were so very kind and accommodating to the Bridal tables and quickly got us whatever we wanted. THANKS AGAIN CELEBRATIONS FOR A WONDERFUL EVENT AND GREAT FOOD!!
I went with my family on Labor Day.  Not happy. Never go again.  Food mediocre for the hour wait.

I don't care what you're coming here for or if you hate mac 'n cheese, GET THE MAC 'N CHEESE. You would be insane not to. You can get a trio of flavors, I personally got the regular, truffle and bacon. Oh my this was amazing.

Wow, best tacos I've had outside of Mexico!   Tried both the carne asada & adobada tacos. They were stuffed with meat that was juicy and flavorful.  Tried a lot of different places over the past weekend but this was definitely my most memorable and tasty meal.  I'll be back!
Delicious!

Went out to dinner with my wife and this place really worked from us. The Margarita pitchers were great.  Sam's BBQ sauce is outstanding.  Sweet sauce with a little kick.  The sauce is mixture of Carolina sweet and glaze BBQ sauce.  We ate the sauce on the grilled wings and a rack of ribs.  The grilled wings had a nice char-grilled skin with the BBQ sauce.  Ribs were the best I ever ate. Each rib had a half inch of meat on all sides of the bone with the delicious sauce.  My wife had the mahi-mahi tacos with the ranch sauce.  The ranch sauce and tacos were good, but she wish they a little bit of Sam's BBQ sauce on them.  She kept dipping the tacos in the sauce on my plate. The place was kind of empty when we got there and were seated as soon as we got in.  It was Sunday night Labor Day weekend with MIA happening on the Ben parkway.
This place is sooo good! my favorite Thai place.  The service, decor, and food are always as good as it gets.

I really enjoy this restaurant.. I've been going to Peaches for the last 4 years. The food is great and I've always enjoyed the ambiance.  However, i went to Peaches this past Labor Day 9/1/14 around 3pm... This was before shifts had changed.  I sat at by the bar area of the restaurant and witnessed what seemed to be the manager talk to the workers/servers in an awful and demeaning way.  This person was a female and seemed to be handling the paperwork for the restaurant as well as the register.  She was giving employees orders and at one point I heard her say "this girl gets on my damn nerves."  I also heard  her to talk to the bar tender who was talking to another worker  who seemed to be spanish,  The "manager" told the bar tender in an aggressive way  "Learn ESL" .   Every time she spoke it was aggressive and made myself along with my company very uncomfortable.  Although we love peaches, we could not believe the way this woman was speaking to the employes at the restaurant.  Many of which, seemed uncomfortable by the looks on their faces.  I do understand having to run a business and keep a sense of order, however if customers, such as myself and my friends that I was with are subjected to hearing the verbal abuse that this woman was projecting I just don't think its okay.  I was saddened by this experience, as I really have enjoyed this restaurant  I also feel no one (and I mean the employees) should be spoken to in such a disrespectful and demeaning way. No one , no matter what their status deserves this kind of treatment.  I strongly feel that keeping a positive work environment would be not only be beneficial to the employees but also the patrons. Please reconsider the way management deals with the employees at Peaches. In my opinion its just not ok.  Thank you... This is respectfully coming from a customer who would like to return....

Cute little tea shop..i have attended a tea tasting and tea class here..I also have bought tea to go..they are friendly..Nice atmosphere..some day i would like to have lunch here....I would recommend this place highly,,They have a nice selection of teas...
Great drinks, food and service. I will definitely be back natasha is a great server and rook great care of my kids

I have visited the Reading Market perhaps hundreds of times over the past 25 years. As a vegan, I would expect more fresh vegetables but am always sadly disappointed. In fact, the quantity of butchered meat on display and the smell of blood can make for a very unpleasant experience. A great vegetarian restaurant in the Market, "Basic 4," recently closed and now houses a shop that only sells lamb! Today, I spotted entrails and baby octopus on ice -- stomach-turning. This said, Iovine Brothers is 1 of only 3 reliable produce stalls in the market. Easily, 85% of the vendors are butchers or meat-pushers ... but DO seek out the fresh food farmstand or Iovine brothers if you care about suffering on the planet and if you care about your own health and longevity. Added bonus: The Flying Monkey bakery has vegan cupcakes and cookies! This market is extremely over-rated, and be prepared to dodge/ignore beggars who stalk neighboring sidewalks for tourists.

I want to love this place, I really do... the prices are really reasonable for sushi (especially compared to the other places nearby) and they have some really great lunch combos. The food itself is perfectly good, basically. However, myself and a friend have both had food poisoning within 24 hours of eating here... there isn't any way to guarantee it was the food from here, but it doesn't seem like a total coincidence, so I can't really recommend. Too bad.

Came here on a Sunday with my mom sister and daughter...service is very slow (no one else was dining at the time) took 15mins to get our drinks...they come in slim small glasses(no free refills)...that hospitality cornbread sliver is a joke ...I wrk in the foodservice business and never heard of giving a sliver of bread with a meal ...they advertise on the website a big hunk of cornbread with the entrees..I would of preferred them giving the slivers to us while we waited almost an hr for 3 entrees.portion size does not match price...we left hungry ...tried a brownie for dessert because that was all they had ...dry! Overall the food was ok but not worth $100+ ...I'm still stuck on the cornbread lol I've been to hole in the wall spots that FEED you . Shorten the menu also .You have to spend money to make money ...take care of your guests and they will return but if you overcharge and serve crap do you really think they will return? FYI I went back 1 more time (ordered Togo)and experienced the same thing...unsatisfied customer.

This is my third experience at Rare and truthfully my worst.  Let me begin with a positive.  The bar staff is well trained and accommodating.  Now I offer some 'improvements'.  I ordered not one but two bottles of wine that didn't match the vintage on the menu.  The server apologized but never communicated the matter to the GM.  The GM stopped over after the meal and claimed 'it was the distributor's fault'.  Rather ironic since I heard the same excuse last year.  The porterhouse was cooked perfectly but not the best quality of meat with little to no age with the cut.  Certainly didn't present like Prime rather a Choice cut.

A group of us were staying in Hartford for a long weekend. We wanted some good pizza, this place is very good! Over the weekend we ordered a total of 3 Sheets. They delivered them fast and hot!! It's even really good cold for breakfast!!
Great service and superb creative food. We had the burger and the pre fixed lunch menu for 35 Dollars. Absolutely worth it and the drinks are great!
Great food and Presentation. Love the Farm to table experience. Look forward to going back soon
This is by far my favorite Greek place!  The grilled octopus, grilled calamari, Horta and lemon potatoes are exquisite!  Beyond delicious
I can only say that their product is utterly forgettable and maybe borderline outraging given all the unwarranted praise heaped upon this dump.

Having went to college in the New Haven area I have always been a fan of the restaurant scene, however when I went back to visit recently I wanted to try something new and different. After hearing about Oak Haven and taking a peek at the menu, I knew I needed to try this place. With friends in tow, we started off with some drinks, had a few laughs and ordered some delicious food. While the steak I had was amazing, I was jealous of the fish that my friends had ordered. The aroma of the meals was enough to spark my curiosity about dessert, which you should not pass up. Everything is fresh, the atmosphere is fantastic and you can certainly tell that the those who run this place put a lot of heart into it. I am a big fan and can't wait to go back!

I had a really poor experience at Le Barricou. I'm not one to complain, it takes a lot for a bad review from me, but the lack of customer service here really ruined our brunch. I'm sorry to say I won't be back and I wouldn't recommend. Firstly, we were told we had to wait for 30 mins for a table. It was a busy Sunday so that's not totally unexpected. We ended up waiting for 40 minutes before finally getting a table for a party of three. The table was actually a table for two with a third set of cutlery squashed on. This was frustrating because we had seen two couples who came after us get seated before... if we were just going to be crammed in a table for two, why couldn't we have had their tables? The decor is really lovely but it didn't help when things got worse. We had to use two of napkins to balance out the wobbly table when we first sat down and I asked for more napkins but didn't receive any until half-way through our meals when I asked again. We ordered straight away because we knew they were busy, including a couple of iced coffees. 20 minutes later still no drinks, we inquired to where they were, but they still didn't come out until after our food.The food itself wasn't too bad but the service was just so poor. Our waitress barely tended to us and we couldn't get her attention when asking to check on the coffee and napkins. It was indeed the bus boy who helped us out here on both occasions. We received much better service from the bus boy, so thank you, you should be serving!

It's the most crowded place ever!! On Wednesdays night there are people in there like sardines but singing along to whoever is singing kareoke. There is a variety of older and young people in there having a good time. It's a great place where friends can have fun and have a drink or two. They are relatively cheap! $7 pitchers. Not bad!

If you're looking for a great meal and a great beer in New Haven, look no further. We got in to town late last Friday night and were starved. We were surprised to see how busy this place was for dinner at 10. And, people kept coming in! I had the honey truffle burger and it's a top three burger I've ever had. Plus, I had a side of the Cajun tater tots. I felt silly ordering them but so glad I did. They were fantastic and I wish I had some now. My fiancé enjoyed her mushroom and pecan burger and raved about her sweet potato fries. After trying some, I agreed they were delicious. The service was prompt and friendly. Can't recommend enough.
Awesome place, great food & Staff! The seafood is soooo fresh... my niece had chicken with tomatoes & onions with the saffron rice DELISH!!! The best shrimp & garlic EVER!

I must say we loved everything, the ambiance,  the live music and the food was excellent.  We are not from Brazil  and we felt very welcomed.  The drinks are delicious and I can't praise the food enough.  Delicioso! !!! We will continue to go and bring friends as well. Great for a date night!!!! We are in love with this place!!!

I'm completely baffled by so many positive reviews. I think people forgot to rate the pizza, and instead rated how cool they felt by going to PB. Simply put, this isn't good pizza. This is coming from someone who counts pizza as a primary food group - and has tried most places in Center City, a good chunk in South, all the ones in East Kenso/Fishtown/PR, Manayunk, Roxborough, etc. This pizza...isn't good. The service is nice, albeit unhelpful. How a restaurant can be out of so many things in the middle of the day is beyond me..like cups. How are you really out of cups? How does it take 25 minutes for a pizza to go in the oven and come out of the oven? Why is the crust as thick as a slice of Ellio's? Their tomato sauce is watery (might want to try that tomato paste, fellas), their crust is as thick as a regular slice folded over, and the cheese is ok. The fresh basil on the Jane WAS top notch. This pizza makes Lorenzo's look gourmet, Lazaro's high end, and is on par with Ellio's. Pizza aside, I'm stunned by the amount of tank tops I saw on people who were making my food. I have no idea how that isn't an L+I violation, but I sure as hell don't want armpit hair in my food. If you're in Fishtown, you're better off going to Aramingo's Best, or just going south and finding something - anything - better. Guarantee it'll have less armpit hair. Oh, and vegans - just go to Blackbird. Cheaper, better, easier.
Great scenery, decent food.  The live music can be pretty lame.

Second the bad bartender review. It's become abhorrently bad. One of them is just an outright nasty man. He'd be better off at Farrel's across the street. He just hates being there and hates everyone.

I went to FunniBonz yesterday (9/1/14) for the first time.  Walking through the front door, the restaurant smelled like smoke.  I ordered the Brisket platter with Mac and cheese and collard greens.  I was with a party of 5.  Smoked chicken platter, pulled pork platter and two smoked burger platters were ordered.  The taste of the food was outstanding.  One of the owners, Jim, was behind the counter.  He explained everything, which takes some time, and it took a little while to order our food, but it was totally worth the wait.  My son had to wait for fresh fries for his burger, and Jim brought him a complimentary piece of fried corn on the cob.  He described it, and it looked and sounded totally delicious.  My son ate the corn, and he said it was delicious!  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place to anybody who likes BBQ.  The dining area is very small, so you may need to take out, but I definitely will support this business.  I also was treated to a tour of the kitchen and got to see the genuine wood smokers that give the food the awesome flavors.

I wanted to flat out say this place sucked, in all honesty it wasn't bad but it wasn't good either. First and foremost they don't have a sign outside .. I walked past it almost twice if I didn't see the sign on the inside out of the corner of my eye i would've never found it. The other thing is the place is really small you get placed to sit and your 3 inches from touching elbows with the group or couple next to you, you feel like your not only eating with who you came with but everyone in close range. The food wasn't bad .... it just wasn't what I thought it'd be considering the hype surrounding it in the reviews and prices. ( I mean seriously, $14 for Mac and cheese?). The ribs hardly any had meat, they fell right off the bone but doesn't count for much considering how dry it was. The brisket which apparently they're known for and what I was looking most forward to was soggy and in my opinion bland. The sausage was my least favorite it had a very weird taste, I tried to pass it off to my girlfriend but she wouldn't take it either. The turkey and pulled pork were the most decent meat they served that night. I got the Mac and cheese and collard greens and it honestly was another disappointment, the Mac and cheese was good I'm usually not into the whole cheese sauce thing but it was good just not good enough for 14 dollars, the collard greens had way too much steam and vinegar, hardly no leaf and very sour. Idk what it is with this place but they either over season or under season the food. On the pulse side the service was really good, the guy serving us was great which did a lot considering we weren't pleased with much else. We wanted to to get a to go box and that's literally what we got... a cardboard box. Not gonna lie I wondered if that was it or were there going to bring containers to put the food into than in the box buuuutttt I was wrong. Collard greens, Mac and cheese and pork alI mixed together by the time I made it home. All and all I concluded I get 10x better dry rub BBQ at a cook out than I'll ever get at brisket town. I feel if they focused less on being trendy and more on the food I'd be more impressed.
Quality & cheap restaurant.

We found this restaurant on whim. This is probably the best Italian food I have ever had at a restaurant. The owner Mario was fantastic and treated us very well. The veal sorrentino was unbelievable and probably the best veal dish I ever had. The wine was great and the deserts and espresso were fantastic. This is a must place to go to for New York residents but I am from out of town but would definitely go back to this place when I return to the area.
Been going here since high school days. If u want a really good Sicilian pie or slice this is the place to go.

I love the calm, relaxed atmosphere of this place. It's very low key, no hovering waitresses-- no plates whisked away right after I'm done. I can sit here for hours enjoying wine and never feel rushed. The sushi is very good and I love the shumai. The staff is polite and sweet. I highly recommend it for a nice, peaceful evening out.
A cool comfortable environment with fresh and inexpensive food.

The veggie burger was OK. However I also ordered a plain bagel and got a egg cheese and bacon sandwich. My mother who is a vegetarian was pissed!!! They really need to get a better system on taking orders or hire additional people. ... Wasn't impressed then again that's typical New York service :)

Roberta's is the gold standard to which I compare other pizza. It's that good. If you don't like Neapolitan style pies, then it's not for you. I personally like the atmosphere and setting. Kind of like a rustic laid back vibe, checking the pretension at the door.  We always attack the pizza, which never disappoints. The crust is airy and light with a hint of burnt flavor from the wood oven. I enjoy the fact that the menu is always changing and evolving.  Are the topping options simple and slightly limited, yes. But who cares. Why would you want an overthought out and complex pie? I have only recently started exploring the rest of the menu, the non pizza. To date, I've tried the Fluke, the Carrots and Wagyu Carpaccio which were all surprisingly good. Sometimes the waits are long, but it's worth it. Haters gonna hate.

Worse restaurant ever!! Service was awful! There was no greeting at the door. They sat us because we had a reservation. Once we sat, it took a very long time to get waited on. 2 out of 6 orders were just ok. Nothing to rave about. The food took a long time to come as well. No one checked on us during dinner to see if we needed anything. There were 2 waiters and only about 3 other tables for them to serve. I would never go back there again.

Don't waste your time with this place. Totally unprofessional staff. Food is below par to the point I don't know how they stay open. Pizza sauce is bland. Dough is either under or over cooked. Grinders are thin and don't seem to have fresh veggies or decent grades of meats and cheeses. It doesn't help when you see the cooks at a local convenience store buying their sandwiches to eat.

I've been here about 10 times in the past year. I'm consistently blown away by Donny and his attentive staff. If you want to feel taken care of, appreciated as a diner, and have one of the best meals of your life, give luigis a try!

I am so thrilled this restaurant is here! I have had such positive experiences here I felt the need to share. I love sipping my delicious cappuccino out of the extra large coffee cups. The past few times I have been there I am greeted by a male manager who is always dressed very professional. It's so refreshing to walk into a place & be able to recognize who the manger is by his professionalism. I normally order the ham & cheese croissant which is delicious but when I was undecided & expressed that I wanted something lighter he recommended the chia seed pudding & he was right on! This place has made my early mornings at work much easier & something to look forward to. I sit outside sipping my cappuccino and enjoy the warm smile & small conversation from the manager (I don't remember his name) and the server whose name I believe is Christine?......Looks like I will be a regular here at this place!

The Town Diner replaces several other restaurants that were in this location.  I went with little expectation but was greatly surprised.  Not only was the meal (early birds 'til 5:30 pm) quite economical, but the food was very high quality.  I especially enjoyed their pasta sauce which was as good as any I have ever tasted at restaurants that charge 5 times the price. OK, maybe my sister's pasta sauce is better, but not by much.  One of the desert options (included with early bird) was a fresh fruit cup that was delicious and bountiful.
I only reason why I gave it 2 stars is that the service was good but the food was not so good.I will not be going back!

it was just for the lunch special (and that happened quite often, the experience each time being amazing).  It was a true test last night because the place was a lot busier than it usually is during the lunch hour and the crowd was also much more sophisticated. The food was amazing, the service was attentive, with my friends who were with us have never been to Basso before and they were all in awe, I felt so happy that they all were as crazy about this place as I was.  We have tried wine, there are some very good choices,  I think this probably makes Basso my favorite Italian restaurant in the entire city.  I don't think I will ever get tired of the food and the service.  It does get a bit pricey during the evening as compared to lunch, but in terms of comparing it to other high-level Italian places.

First time there I had the chicken cutlet sandwich.  I wasn't expecting much, but I was way more than pleasantly surprised.  Not only the best tasting but also the best consistency... So now a few weeks later we tried the chicken francaise and the chicken parm...Also great!  Had the French toast bread pudding for dessert for a delectable finish.  Will certainly go back

Sitting places  are narrow so attendants may sometimes have to push you through(asile seat).Expects you to pay tips bt 18 to 20 %. Chili pepper with chicken was good and burst with spectacular flavors.
10 STARS! Great food, great people, and great history. If you're going to complain about the wait, especially after being forewarned, stay home.
Always love it here, been coming to Amelie too many times to count. The service is always a delight and the food is always fresh and delish! Plus, they have some excellent happy hour selections.
Good food and great service! I love the location of this place too, You can make Open Table Reservations here.

Yes, just yes. This place blew my mind and my boyfriend's mind. The food here is incredible. I had the tomato basil soup as an app, the bacon crusted swordfish for dinner, as well as the s'more for dessert. My boyfriend had the heirloom tomato and buffalo mozzarella salad as an app, the rib-eye steak for dinner, and the summer thyme for dessert. Every dish we had was extremely flavorful (and we each shared with one another!) and filling. We loved it and will definitely be going back next time we are in Philly! Also, I have to give a shout out to the chef's homemade salt and honey butter. Are you kidding?! That is the best butter I've ever had! One thing I wish they had, a wider selection of bubbly! The wine menu in General was extensive but unfortunately they only had one sparkling wine option. The atmosphere of the ship is amazing both inside and outside. You really feel as though you are on an extravagant ship journey! Moshulu you rock!
Customer service was horrible. Management needs to train staff on how to treat/serve people.  I would not recommend this place to anyone.
awesome

My third  time here. WHAT A GEM.. The first time was for Dinner and it was one of the best Bass I ever had.  We came with 4 guests for brunch Sunday and everything is top notch. From the Service to Food. I love their decor. They really paid attention to detail. Definitely worth all the hype that the plaques from ny times and nj monthly stated about the whole experience. They have cards on the tables that say they are Green restaurant certified. They apparently source there food  from a 300 mile radius as our waiter Matt explained. We started with The Sausage en croute it was a special and they were great. I had the crabcake which was wonderful. It was a nice smokey flavor and a nice size with two poached eggs, melon and These potatoes in these awesome little jars. They also had some peppers and onions and were a "country style" texture. My friends had a sandwich and burger which was equally as good.  All in All This place is Just a great addition to the area..... Add owner reply

My third  time here. WHAT A GEM.. The first time was for Dinner and it was one of the best Bass I ever had.  We came with 4 guests for brunch Sunday and everything is top notch. From the Service to Food. I love their decor. They really paid attention to detail. Definitely worth all the hype that the plaques from ny times and nj monthly stated about the whole experience. They have cards on the tables that say they are Green restaurant certified. They apparently source there food  from a 300 mile radius as our waiter Matt explained. We started with The Sausage en croute it was a special and they were great. I had the crabcake which was wonderful. It was a nice smokey flavor and a nice size with two poached eggs, melon and These potatoes in these awesome little jars. They also had some peppers and onions and were a "country style" texture. My friends had a sandwich and burger which was equally as good.  All in All This place is Just a great addition to the area.....

Does not know how to accommodate guests.  Asked specifically for a corner table for father's birthday, was told yes, then given a table next to other tables.  We have a baby not immunized yet so we needed to be away from other people.  There was a corner table but was for another reservation.  Apparently other patrons were more important than our specific request that was granted over the phone. Go at your own risk. You may not get what you ask for.

The pork buns live up to the hype and are THAT good.  I can still taste them in my mouth.  Definitely the best in NY.  The ramen on the other hand is just ok.   Good but not great.  I much prefer Totto Ramen over Ippudo for ramen.  3 stars for the ramen and 5 stars for the pork buns.  I wouldn't wait in line for this place just for the ramen, but I would for those pork buns any day.
Get the tie dye pizza, cannolis and cheesecake. The pasta was ok but the pizza is the main stare. The staff is very friendly and helpful with their Recommendations
Stowes seafood was a very nice place to stop for lunch. The haddock boat was great worth the price. Check it out

Drink was okay and fairly priced. Salad was "meh" and overpriced. Entrees were good but overpriced for not including a salad. Service was slow...very slow. I don't believe they had enough staff on hand. There were lots of open tables outside but there was still a 5 minute wait for a table and then it took forever for everything....to order, food, drink, check, etc. This was my first time trying this place but my family does not plan to return. We were really happy to see some new restaurants come into the Quakerbride Mall but this is a disappointment. I'd rather see this place replaced with a Bertucci's.

a must go to in Philly! don't go to genos across the street...that guy is a total douchebag.  he owns half the block and has a picture of his face everywhere.  it's kinda creepy.  the fries at pat are super under rated and just really addicting.

This place was packed at 6pm on a Thursday evening! we lucked out and walked in at the right time and got two seats at the middle bar like area right away, which was great since we had to do a quick dinner before heading to our broadway show.   We ordered the pork hirata buns as a appetizer, which was standard, was not a big fan of the mayo, probably should have asked for less or no mayo if I had known it would have been a lot. I ordered the spicer ramen of Karak-men with an egg added and my husband got the Akamaru Modern with an egg as well.   Ramen was good, definite must try. Would I come back again? Most likely but I would probably want to try other places like Momofuku noodle bar to compare
Food and service are great!!!

Tried this place out and I'm very observant.  Girl behind the counter co mingles money handling with food prep which is disgusting and a huge health violation. Also, guy on the grill completely botched my breakfast sandwich. Egg was running off the sides of the roll and the pork roll was burned. Amazing, it all went in the trash and never again - Seriously thinking about writing the board of health, I wonder how many people have gotten sick here

This has become my husband and I's go to restaurant. We have never had a bad meal here and they have even changed our minds on things we would normally not eat. Justina   Is great to us and is always excited and welcoming when she sees us. She has come to know exactly where we wanna sit, what we will order and of course what wine we want to drink. Not to miss dishes are pretty much everything!!! My husband in particular loves anytime they have the grilled lamb chop special and I'm a risotto fan. I have never been a dessert fan mainly because I'm picky and don't eat a lot of sweets but their olive oil cake has changed my life! No matter how full I am I can never leave without eating or taking home a slice. My birthday was this pass weekend and they helped my husband make it so special by surprising me with an olive oil birthday cake!   Thank you so much!! Love you guys!

I have to give Print. five stars. I came here on a first date and I'm certain that the restaurant helped make the date a wonderful time. Orlando provided amazing wine recommendations to pair with our dinner. We had enough items off the menu to be certain that all of the ingredients were of utmost quality and completely seasonal. My steak was perfectly cooked and for someone who normally complains about portioning I was quite happy. Will return.

Not much to look at, which made the massive quantities of fairly tasty chicken we ordered that much more surprising.  I got the jerk chicken strips and thought they were a bit pricey, but then I saw the seemingly endless box of chicken and fries, and I understood.  The chicken was flavorful and mouth-burningly spicey.  Would go again if stuck in New Haven.

Great atmosphere and the service was good, but the sushi is very hit or miss. Ive ordered take out and also dined in, and it seems like some days it is great and other times its bland or "fishy". They have a large selection of food and I usually get either Sushi, Maki or Teriyaki.

I wish I remembered our initial server's name so that I could give her 5 stars. She was the ONLY bright spot in this dining experience. My party changed tables so got a different server before we placed our orders; the experience immediately went downhill at that point. It was obvious that our new server didn't want to be bothered with a large party and it showed in the service. When we complained, the manager was even more indignant. To make matters worse, the food was mediocre, at best. No one really enjoyed anything that they ordered. No one had any alcohol so I can't really speak on that aspect of the establishment. Needless to say, I'll never step foot in there again.

Food was terrible.  I had the breakfast sandwich - the bread was incredibly soggy and the cheese tasted nothing like cheddar. If you have an once of respect for your body or taste buds you will avoid eating here.

Quietly situation in the Hempstead plaza off route twenty seven, I drove past this place none the wiser to it's existence. I suppose I should preface by saying I like Chinese food.  Not that sesame chicken kind of American food, but real Zhong guo chi fan . The menu is extensive for the restaurant's size; the interior no frills. Lots of vegetable options, cooked proper and quite delicious.  Recommend the dry string bean and the sauté spinach. Meat dishes have been solid as well; dry cubed pepper chicken is way beyond how it sounds and quite wonderful.  Pepper beef is good too if that tickles your fancy. Free appetizer of this spicy pickled broccoli that is quite scrum-didilly-umptious. Their tofu general tso's really does justice, even for meat eaters. Their Lao mein is good, as is the noodle in hot oil. Bear paw tofu was enjoyable as well. They have a really good special Monday to Thursday with a pre fix menu that has a bunch of options for 21 quid, and it's more than enough for three people. Overall a good pick for real Chinese food, the price point and the deliciousness of the food make me recommend this to any yelper. Also the owner seems nice, not sure what the other reviewers experienced but i suspect a language barrier thing. Tl;dr Worth trying; excellent Chinese chow

We  had our 30th anniversary dinner at Fornos.The service was just great.They attend to all our needs.Food was great-lobster tails.The waiters surprised us with "Happy Anniversary " song.Good Food and Great Service ,try them ,you will pleased.
Delicious authentic japanese restaurant! Everything we tried was absolutely amazing. I would highly recommend the A set.
Great chicken, and really nice service.  Looks a little odd at first, but really glad I tried it.  I love spicy foods, but the sweet sauces are the way to go.
The food was great, i recommend chicken korma with garlic naan. Also the staff was very courteous and friendly.

Our whole family was in Philly and one of the place that we went to was this Noodle House. The line was so long but it was worth the wait. The hot soups were very good although I'm not a fan of the noodles with peanut butter

Got told it was a 30 minute wait but was offered a seat at the bar and got seated right away.  We ordered the prix-fix, Mimosa and bloody Mary. Food was good, service was good. Good place to grab brunch if you don't mind the crowd and noise.
Very, very good Indian food. Servings were large and the waitstaff very helpful.  Enjoyable experience all around.

Went to NIXS Hartford last week before my holiday weekend and had the best time, our server was so attentive and sociable, we just moved to the area and she was so knowlegeble about the area. She did stumble a little with the menu but the items she recommended (calamari, tots, and the margarita flat bread) were amazing and u knew she liked them by the way she sold them.was a perfect begining to our weekend. We felt like we were in NY city the atmosphere was awesome. We will definitely be back. Sandra did an amazing job and will Get better.

Glad to see that others agree that this is AUTHENTIC indian and fine at that. Great naan, great chicken tikka and korma. Flavors of the curry are bold and spicy and perfection. Planning on bringing my friends in for sure.
A little pricey but otherwise great seafood, friendly staff, and an incredible outdoor area by the water with a good view of the Statue of Liberty.
Best breakfast place I've been to in PA.  The turkey bacon spinach fritatta is fantastic.

Great little place to go for lunch or a quick meal.  I have been a few times now and have tried a burrito once and chicken tacos two other times.  All of the ingredients are super fresh. Each time I have been in, it has been a good experience from the friendly people behind the counter to the quality of the food.  Glad this place opened up in Hightstown.  Try the horchata!!

If you like soft live jazzy classic music, candlelight, and ambience Sassafrass is the place.  The crowd is hip and sophisticated but not stuffy or clicky.  It's perfect!  Try the french onion, super buffalo wings, great martinis and nice beer / wine selection.
I ate vegetable stone rice with tofu soup. To be honesty, it is not better than Chinese tofu. But I love stone rice.
great place to eat late at night, open 24 hours

Very disappointing!! I had stopped in and saw that they had some vegan options so a friend and I stopped in for lunch We shared two different sandwiches We even added a few ingredients. The breads were dry. The vegetables sparse and just plain boring. The iced green tea was great!!
This is one of the best local bar Hangouts with excellent service, great food, eclectic beers on tap, fireplace, candlelight, brick walls, and chalk boards for specials.

I have ordered picked up so I can not review the waiter or waitress serve. I have tried almost all the older restaurants in the neighborhood. I finally tried here. We made our own kids burger cake and decided to order the burgers here. We ordered for picked up and the food was ready by the time we requested. This is the only spot in the neighborhood with slider choices and the only place I've had so far that had that many options.They had 5 slider choices but we picked 3 (beef, bean, fish) with the sauce on the side. My only complaint would be that the food is a bit pricy.

A Classic. Diner style excellence performed to a near perfection. Awesome for families. The only thing holding this place back from a full 5/5 review is their lack of cleanliness around the place, as well as the occasional smokers around the premises. 4.5/5 for Creemees!!!

Ate here a few weeks ago. It was busy and took forever to get our food. Had to check with them twice to get our food. When we finally got it it did not taste good at all. It had no salt and when I told the front counter lady she said they don't put much salt because some people don't like it. I thought I was eating at a restaurant not a nursing home. They were not apologetic for the time or the bad food. Never again. One star because we got the food but never again.
My fave go to spot for pizza.

This was my first time at this place, It is very close to Times Square so it is a destination for tourists and can get pretty loud, but the food was really good. Plates are designed to be shared by 2 but the portions are really huge. I would definitely go back again, a lot of good items on the menu, and the dessert is amazing.

For our weekly catch up brunch my "bestie" and I decided to check this place out...there seemed to be a pretty long wait for indoor seating, and only a few mins for the communal outdoor seating so we went with that...we were seated next to a pair of young ladies that were waiting for someone that seemed to be a no show, so we were given that seat, they didn't seem thrilled about it, but didn't make a fuss...I guess everyone understands most places won't seat incomplete parties...the server came over with water and menu's pretty quickly, but then disappeared for a few...my bestie and I contemplated leaving because the service seemed slow, however in an effort to give this place a shot we stayed...after a few the waiter returns and we both order the crab cakes, eggs benedict and some sort of sweet tea mixed drink, we were told by our server that there was no bread, because the flower they use comes from Tennessee and they ran out...trying not laugh hysterically, we both just looked at each other like "um-ok", there's a Fairway a few blocks away, and this is NYC, I mean come on, you can get anything at any hour of the day or night right?!...the food did come out pretty quickly, and while it looked pretty, the portions were way to small, especially for the price...without accompanying bread, this $20 brunch was now looking like an appetizer!!...overall it didn't taste bad, and it looked nice, just not substantial enough to qualify as a meal... As our plates were being cleaned, someone did come over ( a manager or partner I guess)  to ask us what we thought, and I won't even write about the spirited debate we got into or how he informed us that the kitchen was the size of the table, and how proud he is that fresh food is coming out of it...you know, like he hadn't seen it before signing the lease, or that he  was doing us a favor by providing us with fresh eggs and caned crab?!?!...That pretty much did it for us, we were on the fence the entire time, and even with the slow service and the portions being small, it could've been in consideration for drinks and small bites...but after that interaction we left with a bad feeling about the place...with so many new places popping up in Harlem there really is no room for bad experiences....

We've been to Koreander a number of times. It's been our go-to place when we feel like  having something light, but not dull. Our kids tend to find something they like here as well. We have enjoyed our meals. Almost every time, I get the bibimbap, which I love. Once, I tried to order it with salmon, but was shot down (I think it would be pretty good with salmon, so I was a tad  pissed). Almost every time, all of us are generally satisfied. Last night, however, we found ourselves underwhelmed. The bibimbap was meh, and just not as satisfyingly delicious as usual. The service was kinda slow and inattentive as well, even though the restaurant was sparsely populated. And the worst part, as another reviewer noted, was the Muzak. Not only is it bad (we didn't even get to hear "Good Riddance" as the other reviewer did; that would have made it slightly more tolerable!) but it was on a loop, so we heard the same bad songs over and over. I thought I'd fall face first into my bibimbap! Somehow, though, the music/Muzak was the predominant theme of the ambiance, or lack thereof, last night. Everything seemed dull and unspecial. I don't see us returning to Koreander any time soon, sad to say.

Aviation Deli has been one of my favorite lunch spots for years. My go to is the turkey bacon sandwich but they have much more to offer! Anything from hot items off the grill such as burgers, cheese steaks, to freshly made sandwiches with tons of choices as far as meats, cheeses, toppings, and spreads! They also have a pre-made items that differ everyday and are great to pick up on the go. The staff there is very friendly and kind plus they make some amazing sandwiches!!
Service was really good, fast, and attentive. Sushi was just ok, though the Temple roll was really unique. Vegetable gyoza were kinda mushy and undercooked.

This is long and probably more rant-ish than anything so I apologize in advance if you do read this and found it not worthy lol. Literally the worst customer service I've ever received restaurant like this. We ordered 2 cheeseburgers and 2 regular fries and it took us an hour to get our food. They got slammed in the late hour because most of the customers at that point were coming in from the Made In America Music Festival so it's understandable that there would be a 20-minute or so wait. But an hour for 2 cheeseburgers? No way. We assumed that the attendant who was the middleman from the kitchen and the customer probably gave away our food by accident and didn't want to admit it. If they would have just been honest, we would have been more understanding but she refused to communicate. She saying "I don't know" or she kept blaming the kitchen and saying that they lost the ticket so they're trying to make up for it. Even if they did lose the ticket, shouldn't the customer that ordered and have been waiting for x amount of time be a priority before the people that ordered way after them? Idk, maybe that's just me lol. The manager was probably doing the least work out of all his employees. Instead of jumping on the kitchen line to help or manning the register or helping the associate PROPERLY distribute the food, he stood there in the kitchen just watching everything and on occasion yell some words of "encouragement". Sure, this review might be a bit harsh but never in my life have I waited that long for a burger. It was upsetting that all these people who came in and ordered 45 mins after us were getting their food before we were. The only reason we got our food is because the attendant got tired of us complaining and went to the kitchen and made our food herself. She basically threw the bag of food at us. Ugh. I've heard so many good things about BurgerFi so it sucks that this was my first experience. I still want to try it again so hopefully my experience will be at least decent next time.
This is the 3rd time I've been to Centro. I went in Thursday night and tried the prime rib. It was better than the other local steakhouse and a bit more reasonably priced. I'm impressed.

I was extremely disappointed with the food that I ordered tonight. It was my first time trying Noodle Village. There was hair on my dumpling, yikes! And they got my order wrong! To make matters worse no one wanted to fix my order and asked me to wait till tomorrow. My dogs food smelled better then the noodles and dumpling soup. The spring rolls were soaked in oil from the inside (had to toss in garbage). My boyfriend did say His food was tasty (oxtail curry in sauce). Never ordering from them again for the simple fact they want me to wait till tomorrow for a order they screwed up!!!!

this review is for the chocolate mousse cheesecake only... I know its a little pricy but this is very, very good! The mousse is light and fluffy - works well with the cheesecake but could use a touch more of the cheesecake to the mousse ratio. Wish it was 50/50.. delish!!! a must try.

This lovely Worcester Diner Car has been cleaned up and lovingly restored inside by the new(er) owner of the Parkway. As a local I went to the Parkway when I was young and took some time "off" as the quality of the diner slipped. When Corey & Phil opened this back up under the Parkway name I was thrilled!!! The interior is clean & sparkles as it used to when I was a kid. The food.  Oh the food is AWESOME! A basic, simple menu but done well. Locally sourced food is used when possible and the quality of all ingredients is great! *Nothing* languishes in a freezer at this diner. The home fries are top notch along with the pancakes and eggs benny! Corey & Phil like to put a twist on traditional dishes and giving the patron a scrumptious meal. (Ask Phil about his Chipotle Hollandaise sauce for eggs benny) Just remember folks that this is a SMALL intimate diner. 7 booths and roughly 30+/- stools so be prepared to wait if it is a busy day. Per "diner etiquette" the unspoken rule is that you wait for a booth or, if counter space is free, you sit at the counter. (NO going from the counter to a booth) Well worth the wait!

I saw an article about this spot opening up on nj.com, and I thought I'd check it out just to say I went to Jay-Z's mom's restaurant. If you aren't familiar with Newark, it's easy to get to, it's right off Route 21. The menu is fairly simple, two sides: one for breakfast 8-12, another for lunch after 12.  It's a simple lunch menu, some sandwiches, salads, etc. I went with the beef sliders - and I was surprised how excellent these were. First they are slightly larger than your average slider. You get two, which is more than enough. They came out sizzling, and they tasted incredibly fresh. I used ketchup on my first one, but the taste of the burger and the small amount of sauce that came with it were so good that I had no need to add ketchup to my second. The staff is extremely friendly. They were attentive, and checked in on me several times to see how I was doing, and if I needed anything. Very nice interior. It's a spacious place, especially compared to other local options in Newark. Nicely decorated, with a stage that appears to be for music/entertainment at night. Prices were a little high ($10 for sliders, $15 if I wanted fries and coleslaw), but for a fairly upscale establishment in this area this was to be expected, and the food was definitely worth it. I plan to return to try other menu items.
Great place to grab a quick lunch on the go. The main sandwich "no 1" or Banh Mi Saigon is amazing and full of flavour. If you love spice like I do, get it spicy and it will blow your mind!

nicole is da bomb!!! wow my coconut mojitos and food did the trick!!! major applause all around and props to juan always... lots of love to my homies here... farid and george you will take note. lol nothing but love here and good times...i won't forget it!!! coconut flakes for all...
3.5 stars.
The food was beautiful. As simple as that...

When my college boy comes home from Boston, there are two things he wants immediately - pizza, and a toasted everything bagel with Taylor ham and cheese!! These guys make the BEST pizza he's had in more than 7 years!! Now we just have to find the best bagel place!! :)
Phenomenal! Some of the best food in the world. It'll get a little expensive (8$ for 3 perogies?!) but I guess you get what you pay for.

I come here a few times a month. I've never had a bad plate in the 25 years I've been eating here. Eat in, take out, good prices, nice crispy pizza with lots of sauce. Pasta is always good, salads are huge, sandwiches are always made well. They have bottled coke which is nice. Also nice fountain selections. Nothing bad to say, they even open on Sundays.

We had their guacamole and chips and the guac was really geat!  The drinks were very unique and strong.  The bartender that made the drinks was innovative.  Great atmosphere and great service. Definently recommend this place for anyone looking for a good place to hang out and want some great Mexican drinks and food

Having never heard of this restaurant before going for a friend's birthday dinner, I really didn't have any expectations for it. But I'm pleased to say that I quite enjoyed everything about it. Not only was the food delicious and reasonably priced, but the atmosphere was cozy, the servers friendly and attentive, and with a live, sort of jazz band playing in the next room, the dining experience was thoroughly enjoyable. Though I was there with several friends, I'd say this would be a brilliant place for a date night as well, the dim lighting and rustic setting wonderful for an intimate dinner. We did have a reservation, so I'm not entirely sure how feasible it would be to just walk in (I went on a Saturday night, so it was pretty busy), but I'd suggest calling ahead anyway. I'm already trying to figure out when I'll be able to go again! It was that good!

I wanted to try something a little different and to be honest the ambiance is what caught my attention.  It's a really hip place in center city Philly but Absolutely Nothing like China Town.  The drinks were Awesome and the Food was Off the Charts!!!  The Ahi tuna dumplings were Scrumptious. They also have a Whole fried Snapper that was IN - FRICKIN - CREDIBLE!!!! If you are ever in Center City you are short changing yourself if you don't go.  You will NOT be Disappointed.

My husband and I had an outstanding meal here last night and I was able to tell Bobby Flay how much we enjoyed his restaurant! While everything we ordered was excellent, the service was just exceptional, from the greeting at the door to the guy serving the bread to our waiter, who was as efficient as he was pleasant. All of the food-- the grilled octopus, the chicory salad, tarragon chicken and the lamb pizza were delicious. Although we were very well satiated, it was hard to resist the peach brown butter shortcake topped with blueberry ice cream. There were so many appealing dishes on the menu, I cannot wait to go back. Perhaps the biggest strength of the food was its seasoning-- I was able to simultaneously taste mint, cumin, chili and many different herbs and spices in one dish. Bobby Flay really knows what he is doing and it was fun to chat with him as he walked in and out of the kitchen. A memorable meal.

This is my favorite spot in NYC! It feels like home. The food is fantastic and authentic. The waiters Marcelo and Marian are lovely and so attentive. Order tequeños and the pabellon arepa for the best night. The music and the ambience are incredible. Hands down the greatest Venezuelan gem in NY.

Best steakhouse this side of the Hudson River and there is plenty of parking.  Seems to always be busy on the weekends so I reccomend reservations, but I have gone on a whim in the past and found that they are accomadating if you walk in.  Once I dropped in w a party of 4 without reservations and the place was packed so the manager suggested we eat at the bar, usually not my preferance, but it worked out just fine...we actually had a great night eating and socializing with other patrons.  Great decor, huge bar area so i like to get there early and have a drink at the bar prior to sitting.  Now to one of the things i like most about Rare, the menu, now i love steak period but apparantly not everyone is a die heart steak eater...go figure...but thats what so great in addition to the typical A la carte menu you expect at a steak house they also have some fish, chicken, salads, pasta available...so there is something for everyone.  My daughter is not a big steak eater but She loves either the grilled chicken over greens or the penne vodka.  But i am reviewing a steak house so more Importantly lets talk steak my two favorites are the cowboy steak and the porterhouse for two...you cant go wrong.  Usually pair my steak up with the long hots, and cream of spinach....and of course a Mac n cheese for the table.  And you have to try and leave room for desert...many places claim their deserts are made in house...one look at the desert cart and you will actually belive it...the italan cheesecake is our favorite.
Great food, nice atmosphere. Love the place
Enjoyed everything. Wine delivery available!

I am very impressed with this place. In a land of overpriced restaurants, this was a refreshing treat. Good sized portion, very reasonably priced. Large selection of items. Don't let the word Colombian dissuade you. There are many dishes that are basic if you are hesitant to try ethnic food.
Good.

I have to agree with previous reviewers about the awkward factor about Kennett.  From the moment we walked in something seemed off.  I got the impression of tired people who were trying to be friendly but also felt resentful at our presence.  But, the smell coming from the wood fired ovens was wonderful and I hoped for an amazing meal if not great service.  Maybe it was because I had just returned from NYC, but I was pretty underwhelmed by the food.  The summer salad was fresh and had some delicious tomatoes in it and I liked the cheese, but the greens were bitter and the dressing didn't quite match.  The veggie board was an array of appealing looking dips and small bites, but was served to us without any kind of bread or other agent to dip with.  Our server claimed that that was how they usually serve it, though I witnessed her serving the same board with flatbread to another table.  Even if it were so, I felt like it was sort of petty and off-putting of her to take issue with my request for flatbread.  Each item on the veggie board was tasty, but the board as a whole lacked cohesiveness.  The oysters were fresh and salty, but a few were quite small and a bit mangled and I felt that they should not have served them.  Beans on toast was warm and filling but the egg was overcooked and the sauce seemed to have been sitting for awhile and lacked complexity.   Not Kennett's fault but it didn't help much that another table was easily overheard with conversations about "razing the ghettos" and other gems of racist nonsense. I think that Kennett has the right idea about bringing artisan, organic food to Philadelphia in a cozy environment, but they need to step up their game a few levels.  They evoke hipster tropes, but fail to embrace hipster ideology - which is to do simple things really well.

Shoulda stuck with New China.... Decided to try ming moon after not having it for ten years.  Went with the steamed dumplings and beef and broc.....dumplings were good but New China is better.... Beef had a tendony chew to it...  Also had white chunks of fat still on the beef.... Brocolli was decent but its kinda hard to mess that up...Rice was blah and tasteless  it had one pea   5 bean sprouts and tasted more like oil....... Stick with New China....
Pho was pretty salty, and from the get go three main menu items were not available. They don't even make Banh Mi anymore. What gives? Pretty disappointing. Wah

Went there for the first time last night. Only 15 min wait for a table, we were sat inside it was hot, loud from other guests and the kitchen and busing station. Shortly after sitting another couple was seated at a table two inches from our table, so much for a romantic dinner. Ordered tzatziki and calamari for apps, both were just okay. For the main we got cubed grilled pork, a Greek salad, lemon potatoes and spinach pie. My boyfriends food came out significantly before mine. When the spinach pie finally arrived the dough was significantly undercooked, the waiter took it back we waited another 20 min and asked the waiter to just have it to go since my boyfriend finished his meal....I just went to go eat my leftover spinach pie and it he dough was still raw. The rest of the food was just mediocre, we never got water refills. Our waiter seemed very distracted and at one point was no where to be found. This place is very over rated, overall a regrettable dining experience, we won't be returning.
I haven't been to Acacia in a while. I have to say this new chef and the summer menu are incredible. I had the Grilled Berkshire Pork Ribeye and it was so tender and succulent...YUM!

CRAB CAKE EGG BENEDICT aka Crab Benny. It was so delicious! The crab cakes were not dry at all and full of flavor! The hollandaise sauce complimented the eggs and crab cakes very well. I almost never finish my food just because I don't eat a lot and I actually finished both crab cakes and my breakfast potatoes. Also! Whatever sauce they use on their breakfast potatoes, ask for extra! It was so good. We came for brunch on Sunday during Labor Day weekend and it wasn't as packed as we thought it was going to be. I love the location of it. It's right by Penn's Landing and it's on Market St. I wanted to come back at night to see how the atmosphere is during late night but we didn't have time. The service was fantastic. I loved how all the servers had no problem helping each other. She was very patient with us and our questions and we all were very happy with our choices! I, of course, had mimosas too! Can't do brunch without mimosas!

This place makes hands down the best mozzarella I have ever tasted. I could give it five stars just for that. Every time I come to jersey to visit relatives, we make sure to stop in here. Yes, sometimes they ask you to call back for take out. Deal with it. That's how good they are and that's how busy they are, you can't come first every time.   I've had a bunch of different sandwiches here, I would say the eggplant is one of my favorite ingredients, the roasted pepper is also super bomb, and obviously you have to get the mozzarella. Have to. The place is super vegetarian friendly. The dudes behind the counter aren't overly nice but they are good at their jobs. Plus they're just so jersey... I love it. Was there yesterday, I'll be back whenever I'm in town.
Great southern food. I ate so much. I thought I was gonna give birth.
The sliders and cheese fries were awesome!! The bill wasn't that expensive either. Just a heads up guys, the waiters are cute.

I will keep the review simple this place is a great and awesome addition to Red Hook. The chef George and his menu is great and very delicious. The server is very knowledgeable and friendly. The drinks are amazing,  I am guessing when they get their liquor license this month the bar will just as great as the food. 2 Thumbs up for this amazing place.

I was in need of a lunch spot since I am new to working in this area and sought the guidance of Yelp.  After reading all the great reviews I had to order something.  I went with the turkey and herbs panin and sweet potato bites (both had great reviews).  I wasnt that thrilled with either!  I agree with other reviews on the bread.  I hate when sandwiches are on ciabatta or focaccia.  I think it's because it's "fancy" but really it just hurts your mouth after a while and sucks out all the moisture from the sandwich.   I also didnt think there was enough turkey or pesto to compete with the bread.  The sandwich was pretty big, so it I would suggest getting rid of the top half and making a mini sandwich with the fillings. As for the sweet potatoes... I guess because I make them at home I had an idea of what to expect and it was not that at all.  These were not baked and crisped up at all and tasted like they had no seasoning.  It seemed like they were steamed or boiled.  Maybe this is how people like them... but I wasn't a fan. The place itself is really cute.  Small, but very cozy and the people working were really nice.  I went at around 1:45 and there was a very short line but I ordered online b/c I had seen the reviews of it being a bit of a wait. I would test out something else - maybe the roast beef - but for now, I have to put this out into the world so people can see both sides!

We have passed this restaurant often, but never went in until tonight after reading yelp comments. ..have to tell you they did not exaggerate. The food was delicious. I had the special homemade ravioli stuffed with salmon and robiola cheese topped with mushrooms and truffle oil..omg!! My husband had the Linguine Nere frutii de mare ...exceptional ...we ended with an expresso ,  cappuccino and a home made strawberry napoleon. ..to die for!! We will come back for the brick oven pizza that smells delicious. Service was good, and the price reasonable, especially for the quality of food. Did I mention they deliver! !  One of the other great thing is you can bring your own wine..no corkage charge.  Great new find.

I still love this place after 15 years of going to it.  My go to choice for two is the house salad (it's big enough for two), chicken skewers, did of sautéed spinich, and edimame.  Add wasabi mash is you're still hungry.  Great place!

I LOVE Blend on the Water. Every time I have gone, the food has been absolutely delicious. As a vegetarian, it can be tricky to get good for, especially in Latin restaurants, but these guys know how to make it happen! The mini arepas without the beef are incredible. LOVE the Mangu and the Avocado salad! The cilantro mashed potatoes are to die for. Don't get me started on the flan and chocolate lava cake! Sooooo yummy!! The service has always been wonderful. That said, Alexis is one of my favorite servers! Very positive, helpful, and will make sure your dishes are up to par. She's also hilarious and incredibly attentive!
