I will be asking for her next time I go to BOTW for dinner. Which will very soon! Can you tell I love this place? lol
Spicy and good, I picked up for take-out.  Definitely will go back to eat in sometime.

Delicious food, I left very satisfied and extremely FULL. Drinks were good too - had mojitos. Best waitress - Natalia - super friendly, explained everything on the menu perfectly and had wonderful recommendations!
Food is great as always. Spicy mango mojito all day.  Crab stack, Jamaican jerkey chicken and pasta.  I can't wait for it to get here.

I brought my parents here once and now they won't even go anywhere new because the loved it so much.  Every time they visit we have to go here.  The staff has always been very friendly.  It's definitely a go-to in the neighborhood.
Love this place. It's my neighborhood bar, good beer, good food, good people. Comfortable atmosphere and a locals feel.
The valet did find our keys in another car and returned them to our hotel. Thank you n
This place is the tits, but for the past few months the line has been outrageous. Worth the wait though.
One of the nicest places Hartford has to offer, but the view of the freeway could make you forget! Very expensive, so not a usual spot for locals
the best and dedicate Chinese food with decent price in town. Especially the crab meat Xiao long Bao and spicy pot, really wanna try once more
Had the pickle back burger.  Cooked perfect to the temperature that I requested.  Service was fantastic and milk shakes were awesome.

Freshly handmade beef noodles only cost me 5.50, which is impossible in manhattan but happened. Fried dumplings are literally crispy and juicy that are second to none even in China, of course 6 pieces for 2 dollars is also economical . Good place.
Great food!

No, no, no, never again, just NO! The bar service here is TERRIBLE.  Our first clue was that this place was just about empty at 9:30 on a Saturday night in Philly.  My husband asked about one of the beers on tap.  We've been to many bars, and bartenders almost always love to let you know what's good on tap.  This lovely young lady just shoved the plastic beer listing in his face and sulked off.  Oh, heck no, Suzy Bubblegum.  Got a couple beers and waited for our friends to show up, then grabbed an outdoor table. The table service is just as bad.  Our server (1) literally sulked up to our table and stared at us until we asked about ordering something (no, seriously, this actually happened!!), (2) wrapped up our tab on HER time, so she could leave her shift, then (3) magically turned my $115 bill into a $775 bill.  Oopsies!  I had a $775 hold on my account for the better part of a week.  In addition to the correct tab they charged.  Aces. Food is just OK.  There are better mussel pots to be had, and the fries could probably come out of the fryer about an hour earlier.  Too greasy, too crispy.  Beer list is extensive, but just doesn't make up for the wasted Saturday evening.  Go elsewhere.  Anywhere.
Meh. The one vegetarian option was not good. The calamari was also not very good.

This excellent little gem of a restaurant has a wide selection of locally sourced and beautifully prepared food.  I stopped by with family on a weeknight; every table was full but we received attentive and personal service.  The owner was manning the door and stopped by our table more than once to make sure everything was perfect, and it was. Standouts were scallops wrapped in bacon, an artichoke gratin side, the kale salad.  For mains I had a sockeye salmon grilled on aromatic wood.  It was ever so slightly crisp on the outside and tender, just done, within, and not over seasoned, letting the fresh salmon do the talking.  Others at my table had the leg of lamb, quite tasty, a beautiful steak, and an enormous slab of meatloaf that was entirely consumed.  The focus of the menu is ideally prepared American dishes that highlight the pure flavors of the ingredients. For the price is was a good value, considering that it's within walking distance of Times Square.  It's unusual to have such a friendly and relaxing dinning experience in that busy neighborhood.  I highly recommend this place for dinner with friends from out of town or a special night out.

So I decided to order Koreana for lunch (delivery). When I got my food, I noticed that I was missing part of my order. I called the restaurant to let them know and they told me that they changed the menu a year ago and never updated it. They said that the meal I ordered doesn't come with vegetables anymore, even though it was indicated with vegetables on the menu. I asked the chef if he would send me a new batch of mixed vegetables because I was rather disappointed and thought it unprofessional to deliver food not as described on the menu, and what I got was the tiny bowl of vegetables seen in the picture below. These are straight from a freezer bag and microwaved with no sauce, not to mention there was about 2 bites worth of food in the whole bowl! On top of that, the bubble tea I ordered didn't contain milk even though I explicitly asked for it. Terrible experience. I feel cheated. Do yourself a favor and order elsewhere!
It's actually the best. The wait is long but worth it.

This place is crazy.  I came here with someone and the line was out the door.  I went to put my name down on the list and found out the wait was an hour to an hour and a half.  Instead of leaving and coming back, we decided to wait. When my name was called, about an hour later, we were seated at a small table in the back.  The restaurant is really small.  There's a bar and a fair amount of tables, but everything is really crammed in. I ordered the miso ramen with an extra helping and an order of spicy bamboo shoots.  When you mix the spicy bamboo shoots with the miso ramen it tastes pretty good. The service was OK.  The waiters were attentive and our waters were always filled.
Nice location, nice service but food is not that great! They used to have Japanese stuff but not sure they still have it. Only Japanese food is really good there.
A cozy environment with very nice food. The dessert was also amazing!

I wish I could give this place zero stars. I had been here for a group dinner in the Carriage House before so decided to plan a birthday dinner for myself here as a result. I emailed events and was told that the date wash held for me by their events coordinater. I was never told that I needed to sign a contract or had to confirm again that the date was guaranteed. I called to speak with the coordinator to get details together and she had promised the room to someone else, made me wait a day and then said I could not have the room. She was BEYOND rude on the phone saying it was all my fault and in "her head" that was not a confirmation and that I didn't sign the contract. Jessica failed to mention a contract needed to be signed and was not apologetic. The most horrible events customer service I have ever experienced. She was to the point of yelling at me on the phone and I had to hang up on her. I am not sure how she still has her job. I will never come to this establishment again. I am embarrassed for Palma that they choose to have this woman represent their restaurant.

Here is my 2 cents on this place. Price - 2 of 5. Price was expensive for 2 person $50. Food - 2.5 of 5 Not too tasty like a true brazilian feast. Meat & Chicken was lacking taste. Salad was truly very disappointing. A true brazilian knows their salad and the salads that was serve was cut too big in cube size and no taste(very disappointing in this.) Desert was the only Plus grade here. Decor -  3 of 5. Very Good clean place. Overall - 2 of 5. Conclusion - very disappointing after reading all the review about this place. Price avg. 25 per person , I can have a lot more delicious food at any other buffet. The true disappointment is the food no salt. I always complain brazilian food is too salty but the food serve here is absolutely no taste & no salt and not hot.

I always get out late so I end up at restaurants when the staff doesn't care I'm there and they're ready to go home, but not here.  The food, drinks, and service have been top-notch each time I've come around.   Quality seems to matter and I highly recommend it to everyone!

This is the spot for those late night cravings when intoxicated. Yep something greasy and good for the stomach. For a taco truck they sure give you good quality that I can still recognize even if I am little drunk, so that says a lot. Love all the toppings and horchata too.
Parm sandwiches are the best in the area

Not sure if it was close to closing time, but the parking lot (emptyyy) said alot (on a Tuesday). Still went in. Didnt smell fishy that was good, buffet choices were spreadout to show more that really was less. Sushi was lukewarm and entrees items were cold, lights over food didnt keep food in correct temp. I tried several sushi's meh... tried several common dishes meh... tried the desserts meh... I think they changed the area inside from the last time I was there over 2 years ago. Buidlng was very large for such a small space inside. Disappointed about the liquor pending license I really needed something strong to wash all that food down, left nauseas really needed some air.

Went to Don Pepe to try and have some great Italian while on a layover at JFK.  This really is the first time I have been disappointed with such a highly ranked yelped restaurant.   We tried the Shrimp Pasta and their famous clam linguini.  The Linguini was so disappointing especially since they are known for this dish.  Extremely  greasy and very underwhelming flavor.   The shrimp pasta was ok.  Something I would expect at a buco de peppo chain.   The biggest disappointment was the pasta.  Thats what makes a great italian dish.  The pasta was certainly not fresh nor handmade.  I literally could have  made the above meal at home and kept my $100.   And to top the experience off they didn't have the cheesecake or tiramisu for desert. Wah---wah.  For the price and quality...high disappointing.   I would not recommend making the trip from JFK for this lackluster experience. Go to terminal 4 and get a shake shack burger. 10X the value and taste.

I already reviewed this place with a brutally honest rundown of what happened, but I guess I used too many expletives for yelp to publish it. The truth about this place needs to be out there and yelp keeps hiding the truthful one-star reviews in a link at the bottom of the business page called "reviews not currently recommended." Go there to read how this place has poor service and food that makes people sick. I am not going to retype my entire experience again, so here's the bottom line; most of the waitstaff is rude or inattentive and the food isn't good. The food can (and probably will) give you food poisoning. I got the calamari and had to call out of work sick the next day. I read that this happened to other people also, but yelp hides these reviews. Just beware if you're getting food. The place is ok to get drinks on the patio, but they won't let you sit out there for just drinks until after 10pm. That's all this place is good for.

Wow. Surprise surprise. Another extremely mediocre restaurant opens in Greenpoint. Want to hear someone who knows nothing about Korean food speak about Korean food? Be sure to go when the server with the salt and pepper hair is there. Also, their beef stew is very much reminiscent of an eastern european dish. There's simply nothing "Korean" about it. Nothing. Nada. Not even close. It's like an old fashioned brisket floating in a random broth. Never again. Basically, if you're in the mood for Korean cuisine, take the G to the 7 and head to Sunnyside or Jackson Heights, or even Flushing. Or, walk to the L and head on over to K-town.
SUPER and we give it 5stars!!

Called to order delivery and was on the phone for over 10 minutes repeating my address over and over again. I practically was screaming so the lady could hear me properly. My address is simple and can easily be found on google maps but this lady had an extremely difficult time hearing or understanding me. Terrible customer service!

Super good pizza! That's a must try for everyone. You can ask for two different flavors for pizza. They have pretty good cocktails too! Do expect at least 30 minute wait for dinner so it's wise to give them your name and walk around before dinner!

I should have known when I walked in the establishment at the peak of lunch hours and there was ZERO customers and 1 guy on staff. This food was awful. PERIOD! I figured I would order the rotisserie chicken since it is their star of the show. It was rubbery and white with zero flavor and I'm pretty sure it was either boiled or steamed. Asked to have some BBQ sauce on it to make it look more like chicken. The sauce tasted like watered down steak sauce with a lot of vinegar added to it. Not in a good way. Now the sides. I ordered the Potato wedges. They looked good in the tray but they were cold and dry and also had zero flaver. Next up zucchini and corn. Other than being at room temp this wasn't nearly as bad. Flavor was ok. Not impressed at all. For only a leg and a thigh and small 1/3 cup portion of sides for $12 I won't be back. This place will be a ghost in months.

Got a white large pizza with ricotta ham and fresh mozzarella and fresh garlic it was amazingggggggg with a cream soda on the side and a cannoli for dessert loved it minus one star because there was like 5 flys that kept hovering over us but food wise it was amazinggg

I am visiting NY and really excited to eat Japanese udon. When I entered to the restaurant, there were not many customer. And I wanted to go to the restroom and I asked to a server. The server who is lady was very unkind to every question I asked. Fortunately, I am a visitor here and I don't think that I come here again.

We dined here for my fiancé's birthday. I called ahead to make a reservation and also mentioned the special occasion. We arrived exactly on time after a couple of drinks at the Irish pub around the corner. We were greeted immediately and taken straight to a table, with the first 2 people we came across wishing him a happy birthday. The food came out quite quickly given how busy the restaurant was. We ordered the delicious cheesy garlic bread to start and OMG!! I absolutely love garlic bread. It's my favourite thing ever and this did not disappoint. I wish I could have some right now (but we're on the west coast..!) Try it - you will not regret it!! Our pasta came out not long after we finished our appetiser. I had the pomodoro pasta and he had the bolognese. Both were absolutely delicious!! We were so full after our drinks and appy that we could not finish it and I was so sad! It truly was delicious. We also had a bottle of very reasonably priced red wine with our dinner! Overall a great meal and perfect choice for us. Our server was lovely, very friendly and chatty. We enjoyed every part of the night and if we are ever in Connecticut again, you can be certain we'll return!! Thank you!
El Vez is a great place for a date or just a group of friends. Great selection of food and drink, and always very accommodating at the front door!
Fortunately, I don't rate foods on authenticity. Unfortunately, I still wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone in the middleteranean or elsewhere.

What an amazing dining experience! My server was the catharsis for this! Not only did he make sure I knew Stilton was a bleu cheese he made sure I was a fan of wheat beer vs a light beer. Brandon suggested that I pair a Ommegang beer with a pot pie that had a bleu cheese biscuit on the crust . And... This was a meal that changed my culinary experience for the better! This was a fantastic choice that sure me and by business associates would DEFINITELY make Cock & Bull a choice for many more nights to come!!

I am appalled at the lack of care of this PeiWei!  The place is almost empty and the cooks are looking out the front window at the girls going into the Chipotle next door instead of cooking my food.  It has been 30 minutes and my food has not arrived.
My favorite lunch place in Philly with amazing cheesesteaks for some reason took cheesesteaks off the menu. That decision deserves one star.
There are very slow. Had a 20 min before show. Stop by and order cappuchino. 12 minutes waited for my order. Was very upset.
Had a few sneaky pints and fish and chips in the bar. Fish was cooked to perfection! Could have stayed there all night!

I've eaten here twice with high hopes. The first time I was put off based on the service. The manager or owner was sitting at the bar on his laptop during service and chastising the staff. The second time, tonight, the food was cold. We ordered the feast for 3 yet we were served a meager amount of the authentic lentil or bean-based dishes (miser wot, etc) and overloaded with beets, raw kale, a cat food looking dish that we could not identify (eggplant?) and other atypical dishes. The injera on the plate was tough and unenjoyable. It was about 45 minutes before close, and I honestly think they just gave us the leftovers from the day, but damn! We paid $40 for that "feast" and as an avid lover of Ethiopian cuisine, I was truly disappointed and left hungry.

I do not typically write reviews but after my experience at Parker & Quinn I felt that it would be a great disservice to the restaurant not to. My husband and I had such a wonderful time dining here a few weeks ago while on our first trip to The Big Apple. It was recommended to us by some friends who live in NYC, near Parker & Quinn. It was a fairly busy place and the bar was loud but we enjoyed people watching and the energy level was intoxicating. Laura was our waitress and she provided perhaps the best service that I've ever experienced. She was personable and charming but also knowledgeable on the menu. My husband eats gluten-free so we had plenty of annoying questions for her however, she didn't seem bothered nor annoyed. She cheerfully suggested a few of their signature cocktails and then wine that paired well with our entrees. Despite being obviously busy and fighting through the crowded bar to tend to her tables, Laura was attentive and observant to our needs. Our food was almost as good as the service. We shared the octopus appetizer, which had so many different and unique flavors.  I had the scallops for my entrée and they literally melted in my mouth. My husband had the ribeye steak, which was flavorful and cooked to perfection. I indulged in their special caramel cheesecake for dessert and all but licked the plate! The only negative thing I have to say about the restaurant is that it is about 1500 miles from our house!
Really good Japanese food! As someone whose lived in Japan, some of their more authentic dishes were THE BEST! Loved the udon with curry sauce and the green tea crepe cake!

A group of us stopped here on our way home from Quebec. It was the only restaurant around that was open. The outside was pretty standard of a roadside place, but there was some junk next to the building in the grass that we had to step over when we parked. The inside was pretty gross. The walls weren't finished, nothing looked clean, lots of broken and outdated things, and water damage on the ceiling (and maybe mold?). I'm not sure that the place would pass a health inspection.. I was nervous about the food, but it wasn't awful. My apple salad was pretty good until I reached the bottom: the lettuce was warm and tasted weird. My friend ordered a steak and he said it was good, and my other friend had pasta which was ok except for no sauce. The kids had smaller salads, which were crisp. We also ordered an appetizer and that was the best part - fried mushrooms, mozzarella sticks, and onion rings. Pretty good! They were lightly breaded so not very greasy or fried, which is how I like it. Our waitress, Lexi, was really nice and so was the chef. It's a real shame about the state of the place because it has potential.
The staff are friendly and professiinal and the food is good..love their grilled chicken cesar salads.

I can't say enough good things about this place.  The sushi is great, and service is the best in the city.  If you're looking for a friendly sushi/bar restaurant with friendly staff and patrons look no further than Zento!

Horrible. I order the steak lovers bowl with sweet potato fries. They didn't put the sweet potato fries in the fryer until 10 mins after my steak had been cooking. So I waited and watched my steak stay on the hot pan for about 15 mins before they drown it with the steak sauce. I waited for 15 mins, people ordered way after me already got their food. The employees didn't bother to apologize that they forgot to cook my fries which is why it took so long. The fries were ok, but the steak, as I expected, was extremely over-cooked. It was so tough that I only took two bites and threw the rest away. Would rather get mcdonalds than this.

I finally made it here a couple of weeks ago, when my husband and I were going out with a friend.  It was a Friday evening, around 7:30 p.m., and when we got there, there was only one table in use.  (By the time we left, the place was pretty busy!) We got a Kennett Square pizza to share.  I ordered the falafel burger, my husband got the eggplant parmesan, and the friend ordered a Miles Burger.   Everything was amazing.  The pizza is more like a flatbread style, but wow was it yummy.  All of us enjoyed our other choices, and I can tell you that you get a lot of food here for the price.  We could have easily been stuffed with the choices we'd made, without the pizza. I would recommend it.  The woman working there was really friendly, and it didn't take long for our food to arrive at all.

I do love this place, however I do think something needs to be said about the lack of consistency in both the service and quality of food. We went last Saturday for dinner and food/service was spot on! We decided to go again tonight because of how good it was Saturday and it was as if we were in a completely different restaurant. I don't want to be a dick, but I seriously felt like  we were on a Kitchen  Nightmares episode. Our server was nice so I don't want to blame her for any of this. We ordered exactly what we had Saturday, but had to send our burrito back because the steak was too marbled and overcooked--not as lean and savory as it was Saturday. It's as if the kitchen were trying to use every inch of the steak regardless of the quality. Our server was nice to re-order a new one without meat at a discount, but the second one was definitely rushed: undercooked  rice and cheese still cold. In terms of inconsistent service: although our server was nice, there was a bit of a wait in getting our orders in. Last Saturday we were able to order and had our drinks  in less than 5 minutes (plus it was busy). I really don't want to add this either but it was particularly annoying hearing the staff directly behind us bitching about their shifts. Sorry, I get it's a tough job, I complain about work too, but I'd get fired immediately if a customer were to hear any of it. It just hurts the business more. We decided to let it go and not complain because, above all, our server was nice and sincere. Plus we think el camino can get back on track at being an amazing place and experience. However, until that happens, I hate to say they will not be getting business from us again.

Lombardi's used to be our go-to place in Cedar Grove.  Something has changed in the past 1.5 - 2 years.  The food has certainly gone down hill and it's not a place that we tend to recommend any more. I don't have any information but I'm curious to know if there was an ownership/mgmt change in the past few years...

Classic Peruvian dishes are on point. Pricing is slightly higher than other Peruvian restaurants, but the atmosphere is also a lot more formal than other restaurants. Definitely worth checking it out.

This little gem in Lennox Hill is incredible. The truffle gnocchi is the best I've had, meat ball veal (sorry for veal haters) takes it to the next level. It's our second time here, and both times it has been great. A bit pricey, but with the salt comes the sugar. Why the four and not the five? Open table time has about a one hour wait past reservation time and it's a tad balmy inside. If you're wiling to trudge through the adversity I suggest this little Italian Spot.

Bareburger has finally made it to Philly! This place looks incredible and the new menu is amazing! I had the Wiki Wiki with Wild Boar and the Sprouts and Roots Salad. Friendly staff and great service!

Solid service. Friendly waiter who told us what items on the menu would be available to us quickly and offered us a beer sampling. The empanadas are giving me deliciousness chills at this moment; the mushrooms are just perfectly al dente. I actually had to stop and make time for a review after my mouth experienced these bites and then could not comment simultaneously, lest I exclaim passionately with my mouth full. Holy smoke. We were only in the market for a late night joint to grab a bite. Had no idea we would find a gem of food glory in our state. ;) Come here late. Enjoy a drink and split three appetizers. So yummy. So satisfying.

We went back to NY and the first night we were there we headed back to Bistro since we never had a bad experience so far . With so many restaurants in NYC people usually never go back if they had one bad experience ,they move on . We sure went back because everytime we had great food  and great service The owner remembered us which made us feel good. This place is a must go !
I love this place. One of the coolest places to chill and talk. Great drinks and great bartenders. Atmosphere is great! My go to

I've been coming here for the past 8 years and the food has always been amazing. The calamari is to die for! Mario the owner always comes out and asks how everything is, I've never had a problem here. The staff is always friendly and helpful. the food comes out delicious and in a timely manner. There's no better spot for a nice Italian dinner. A++

The delivery orders always seem to be messed up.  The pasta is WAY overcooked.  The meatballs are meatless.  The sauce to pasta ratio is lacking.  I'm writing this review to remind myself not to eat the pasta here.  Maybe something else would do?  Plenty of places in the area to keep going here though.  :(

I have been here couple of times. The rolls are great If you are a vegetarian try the mixed veggie roll and paneer roll they are good. Good for a Small group. It would be great if try keep the restaurant neat and clean.
As far as I'm concerned, this is the only place you can get good pizza in this city. You can find Ray behind the bar, he makes the place feel like cheers, only more refined ,)
the seasonal margaritas are always delicious and so is the crab quesadilla! Its full of real lump crabmeat. Nice and light! I highly recommend it! and be sure to try the karmaberry margarita!

Love this place.. Food is good drinks are great.. Everything in the menu is delicious. Great customer services. We ordered the empanadas to start which I recommend to everyone who is there. They were so delicious and had a mouthwatering taste. For the platos Fuertes, we ordered the Paella Valenciana, which was AMAZING. Being Spanish myself, I am always the first to judge everyone Else's so called paella but Yuca definitely know how to make a good one! My friend had ordered the Puerquito Cubano which was just as good. The meat was so tender it was falling apart and full of flavor! Overall it was a good place to get some decent Mexican and some strong drinks!
Great food and service! I had the monkey bread French Toast and it was the best thing ever

This place is awesome if there was a six star it would have chosen it! It's got every single facet of italian good you could think of! I suggest anyone coming to nyc to check it out. Only draw back is that there was a ton of people there and they do their best to keep is all organized.
Simply amazing! Went in after reading about it in yelp. It's true, really really great fast food.

This place is always packed and a little difficult to find somewhere to sit, but well worth it.  YUM! I got the chicken fricaisse, and the chicken was fall of the bone tender. I had one plateful of chicken, and another full plate of beans and rice with fried plantains. (As I looked at others who ordered the same thing it was piled on a single plate). The taste of it actually took a few bites to hit my taste buds but once they did it was a tasty dish - and ALOT of it too. Overall, good selection (with daily specials), cheap prices and delicious food!
I need to give this place another try
Loved this place!  was looking for a new place to take my daughter who loves Sushi, and this was the spot! Ask for the spicy Edamame!!!  Home Run, and not on the menu!!!!

First off, I thought the service was great. We had a group of 7 people here and we had a very attentive waiter who made sure we were taken care of. With a restaurant of this caliber, I believe excellent service is standard. My friend and I both tried the mixed grill which is Shish Taouk, Lamb Kebab, Kafta, Grilled Vegetables, Rice Pilaf. For $23 I was not happy with what I paid. You either expect a larger portion size or for everything on the plate to be great. You get one strip or 4-5 places of each, so the portion size was decent given the number of options we had. However, when it came out each piece was extremely dry, something that really ruins any mediterranean experience. At the end, splitting up the bill took a bit long (20 minute process). If you see us struggling with the bill and you don't suggest to split up the bill it's an extreme inconvenience considering how much we each individually paid. We all had ordered drinks from the bar + food. They had a modern POS system so I know it is possible.

This place is decent.Not the best curry I have ever had, but it's not bad. Personally I ike my pastrami cut thin and the pastrami was too thick here. The dip itself didn't taste flavorful to me. It didn't really help with the bland sandwich. The food,price,and selection were to my distaste. This place is overpriced,small, and my coworkers and I donot recommend. Pricing is okay.I think it is a little bit overpriced.

Kansai is our "go to" place in our Spring Garden neighborhood and is our place of choice when we want a delivery.  My wife and I love the friendliness of the staff and the freshness of the ingredients.  The prices on their sushi and sashimi items are really affordable and I like their display on their rolls.  The salad is nothing to cheer about but the dressing is a tangy, spicy treat.  We get the salad because of the dressing

After reading all the great reviews on here bout this place I visited NY with a friend. The cheapest Chinese food place ever, anywhere. Everything is good, ask for extra sauce, be picky, and all your request will be granted. we ordered for roast pork or chicken on small rice with a vegetable or noodle  Amazing the roast pork was cut into thin strips so it made it easy to just devour in 1 bite. Delicious we really enjoyed lunch. After you get your food, walk across to the park and you'll find picnic tables and seats. Watch the kids, the old people, and the weirdos, and take a moment to feel how blessed you are. we Highly recommended this place and come back soon
The food was decent. To me it's typical chain food quality it's either going to be decent or bad nothing spectacular. The service was so poor we were in the restaurant for such a long time.

went back a second time last night for pick up again to give their eggplant marino a try and it was good. I did not have it with the romano cheese. I switched it for the fresh mozzarella and paid the extra cost. Again it is a little pricier than the other local pizza joints but they are unique due to the coal fired oven. the eggplant was breaded and then cooked in their oven. very tasty.
Everything we have eaten from here is great. Prices are very fair and the delivery has always been on time.

Amazing! Hidden below Froyoworld this place is a must for lunch. So many different sandwiches to choose from and they use only the best products. From Boars Head to great coffee take a break from school and head over here.
There really isn't much to say but, you simply gotta visit this spot!!! Uniquely creative set up with awesome food! . . . now that's a double whammy!

EHH where do I start? I remember when Peaches first opened and it was BYOB it was such a neighborhood spot and the food was awesome! However after my last visit I no longer frequent peaches anymore. so the pros and cons below. Pros -location is close to my home -nice crowd Cons -The food is now really mediocre -The prices have gone and up and the portion size down -I ordered the spinach dip and it was very watery and not cheesy at all. I sent it back and although the water had been poured off it was dry and not creamy or cheesy at all. Not to mention all the flies that were landing in my dip. - I also ordered the shrimp and grits and the shrimp were mushy. Tsk tsk peaches please stop serving old frozen shrimp also the grits were bland -The service wasn't terrible but it was below par.
My favorite restaurant in the world. Amazing service, menu that is always changing and never disappointing, and the smoothest most superb hummus in the world. Don't forget the haloumi :)
Atmosphere and food were both lovely. The blood sausage was exquisite. Our server Doris was exceptional! Friendly, informative, attentive. We will be back again soon!
Love te love music here.. Food is awesome and they make my slightly dirty martini perfect every time. I gotta try and come for Sunday special chicken and waffle
Love this place. Nothing more to it. The food, the atmosphere, everything really.
Great place, great pizza. always on point! I even like their pasta dishes, sandwiches and salads. I dont think I have ever been disapointed in red moon!
What a great experience!! Great service, great food, great happy hour cocktails and GREAT prices! Very chìc romantic ambiance as well!

I came to the spotted pig 10 or so years ago and finally made my way back.  STILL AS GOOD AS IT WAS 10 YEARS AGO.  Wow seeing that quality of food was maintained is amazing Deviled egg - so freakin delicious Sheepsmilk ricotta gnudi - yum so good, definitely recommend Burger with shoestring fries - personally I love the burger, the meat is melt in your mouth good but I could understand the blue cheese being overwhelming or too powerful for some, there is a lot blue cheese. Also get a boat load of fries. Monkfish - awesome, tender tasted great with mushrooms I did not have to wait for a table, so I'm guessing that made my experience a lot better than some of the other yelpers who had to wait 2 hours.
This place is nice!!' Beautiful dining room. Kung Pao chicken, yum!!!
Love this place! I had the pastrami sandwich and it was the best pastrami sandwich I ever had. The meat was tender and flavorful. Highly recommend this place.
Never fails to impress me each time. I recommend going right when they open.. no wait =)

If you are looking for great pizza, pasta, or sandwiches you have the right place. One of the first times I went there I ordered calamari. They let me know they wouldn't drop the calamari until I got there so they were fresh. I was shocked and happy to hear that. Let me tell you, it was very good! The pizza is the best I have had around here and the sandwiches are made with fresh bread. That makes the difference. They have great portions and the prices are very fair. GREAT JOB GUYS keep it up!

Nice, cheap dumplings.  I probably shouldn't really be reviewing this place as I've only had their pork dumplings, but what the hay. Ordered food today both here and at Shu Jiao Fu Zhou Cuisine Restaurant a few doors down. Amazing Peking duck sandwiches...Huge for $3. Tasty fried pork buns Dumplings good, but not as good as Shu Jiao Fu Zhou down the block. Chive and egg pancake pretty good and not too greasy. Fried dumplings were good, but not spectacular. Needless to say I like this place so much I went here for dinner on my last night.  I will be back every time I go to New York now!

Ordered $22 of food on Seamless. I worked a 12 hour shift beforehand so I was def starving. I waited over the 75 minutes and no food ever arrived. After 85 minutes I called and All they did was apologize and say the delivery man was "missing'. BULLSHIT, own up and admit you never put the seamless order through. I usually order a ton of food online but I won't be recommending or ordering from Champs anytime soon. Nobody was a Champion last night.
I've come here for dinner a couple times and every time it's been delicious. We got the lamb tagine and the chicken tagine. Huge portion, and soooo good. Love the atmosphere too

Snagged a reservation for opening night and loved it!  The menu sounds old-world, but when they bring the dishes out, even the gefilte fish (especially the gefilte fish?) is modern, creative, and delicious.  Don't miss the borscht tartare or the black and white cookie dessert - actually a cookie with half lemon cheesecake, half cocoa-poppy cheesecake.  Not too big, good music, nice vibe for talking with friends.  The hipster irony of the menu with non-kosher meat and "high traif" (super non-kosher food) like shrimp lo mein feels a little unnecessary, but I'll forgive them.
1ST time vegan food experience and the taste of this food beats the regular food. Staff is excellent, very warm and friendly. Loved this place

We had dinner here yesterday and we were amazed I had the Shrimp Fra Diavolo   $17.95 Served over Pasta excellent. My husband had the Eggplant Parmigiana   $15.95  he loved it. I'm so happy we went to dinner there we hadn't been in a long while. We can't wait to go back.

A great brunch spot.  Staff is friendly and courteous.  Mixed crowd.  Young, old, dudes, couples, families.  The only con is the music was pop and a tad loud, but this flaw allows you to have private conservations. We got the Marrow Tacos which everyone is raving about and loved them! I got the squid ink pasta w. shrimp ( love that you can get half or full plate ) it was awesome & my bf. got the hanger steak which was cooked perfectly as well. So good experience overall....and I love the paint choice in the back room!

I have been a regular for quite sometime now which is a rarity. Dough is an impeccable restaurant from "head to toe". The passion of the chef/owner and the staff shows through the food and atmosphere. I highly recommend the margarita, the fresh basil grown in their garden along with the house made mozzarella & tomato sauce speaks for itself, but above all the dough is spectacular. The restaurant also excels in delicious specials, I enjoyed great ceviche and hanger steaks on occasions which were just as impressive, unique and fresh as the pizza. The service is astounding as well, which is very important to me when I go out to eat. Highly recommend this place with your favorite bottle of wine or brew because it is BYO!!

There was no way in hell I was going to wait an hour for a meal at Penny Cluse.  Wife and I tried Lucky Next Door instead and were very pleasantly surprised at how great it was.  There's nothing fancy going on there.  Sandwiches and coffee.  But good lord, the sandwiches we got were excellent.  Even the fact that there was a table with two toddlers and a crying baby next to us didn't ruin it.

I'll preface this by saying I LOVE barbeque and I have been spoiled by the good stuff in Memphis for years. That being said, the food was just okay.  The bbq was just not as flavorful as I'm used to and the meat was kind of tough.  The sides were decent overall but nothing special. Service was atrocious.  We got seated out on the back patio area quickly enough but after that it was twelve minutes before our drink order was taken.  Seven minutes for those drinks to come out.  Another five before our food order was taken because we had to order from our server, not the person who brought out the drinks.  Then two of us got food while the third order  took an extra twenty minutes and we had to go inside to find someone to ask about it.  When they finally brought out the third order there was no acknowledgement of the fact that sliders had taken forty-five minutes to be made. Don't think this Memphis BBQ girl will be back.
First time having Vietnamese Food and it was delish. The place is nice and cozy and staff is very friendly. You must have their dessert coconut pudding it to die for.

Found this place on a whim and was so surprised by the food and atmosphere. I ordered the enchilada trio.  Food was piping hot and featured three different enchiladas and sauces. Margarita was expertly prepared. Will definitely be back!
It could have a better mac and cheese selection. I was a bit disappointed by my choices.

This tiny little seafood spot is a gem amongst the Indian BYOBs of 1st Avenue! They don't take reservations and the spot fills up quickly after work, so be prepared to wait awhile if you don't get there early. My friend and I came here to catch up over drinks and mussels after work one night. I got the pot of mussels and she got some sort of mixed seafood pot with prawns, mussels and scallops. Both portion sizes were huge and neither of us were able to finish the whole pot. I think next time, I'd share a pot with someone and then get a side - that would be plenty to feed two people. The wine selection was good and not overpriced and we each had a glass of red wine over dinner. They have fans on at all times during the summer, and it actually got quite chilly in there surprisingly, so I would take a cardigan with you if you tend to get cold.
Fantastic vege burger, great fries, always bring home a container of house-made pickles.  I have also enjoyed the Chicago Dog and the Chicken Coop.  Very creative menu.

Went there tonight for my mother in laws birthday. The service was top notch and the food was amazing. My father in law had the monk fish and declared it the best fish he's ever had. I had the mushroom ravioli which was delish. My mother in law had the veal chop which she finish and she never finishes her meals. She said "i'm so full but I can't stop eating, it's so delicious!" The service was impeccable, all the staff was super attentive and our food came out piping hot. So happy to have this addition to the neighborhood. We will definitely be returning soon!!
My favorite pizza in NYC!!

I love this restaurant! My friend booked a table last week for four of us. He looked up in yelp to make sure the food is good. And it didn't disappoint. It was a wonderful dinner. Ideal for small party and date. Definitly will come back.
not bad at all

First of all, the staff is very friendly and welcoming, and they make all different kinds of people feel welcome and appreciated. Then there's the wide beer selection, which seems lovingly chosen. I often come to Hamilton's after work to unwind. Then, when I'm too comfortable to take myself home to make dinner, I rely on their kale salad, mac & cheese and bacon, and burger. Their "Ella Fitzgerald" brunch sandwich is also over-the-top delicious. They've offered great live music; they projected all the WC games -- Hamilton's is a neighborhood gem.

I'm a big fan of this restaurant.  Every time I make it to the city, I have to eat here for their spaghetti limone ($13).  I've even replicated it at home with great success.   The menu is impressive and I plan on coming back and trying a lot more stuff. We started off with a mixed salad; bruschetta with tomatoes, polenta with shaved leeks and the complimentary rustic breads with garlicky bean salad -- so good. The salad was enough for three people, very simple and clean. WHERE DOES THIS PLACE GET THEIR TOMOATOES? Seriously, I wanted to lick the bruschetta plate clean. The polenta wasn't really creamy, but the large slices of cheese was enough for me to really like it. The great service, excellent food and private space made for a really wonderful evening.

The waiters are very friendly aka i was in dope company. It was nice to get seats by the window right as we did arrive. Although as soon as me and my date graced the space with our presence we found it very loud. I myself bein the traditionalist that i am ordered the ani ramen after which this establishment is named after. The noodles were type stale feeling and the taste wasnt as wavy. It was ight but ive had much wavier.

Great atmosphere...  Quaint style...  Awesome thin crust pizza !  Have had the Ceasars salad from delivery to my work place..  Very good(fresh).  Over all enjoyable experience and will bring friends back !!

Stopped in Wednesday night with some friends since I heard they had entertainment.  Anthony the bar tender was helpful  and knowledgeable.  Dave Mack Duo played great assortment of blues, r&b and rock.  Entertainment every other Wednesday.  I'll be back then, if not before.  Great addition to East Hartford!!!!

nom nom nom! The food at might quinns is awesome! We went over the weekend so there was a line. I'm not sure if there is a better time to go if you want to avoid the line but it definitely isn't Saturday or Sunday. The place is huge and despite there being lots of people waiting in line and eating in we found seating without any problem. I had the half chicken, cole slaw with vinegar (loved that they give you the option for slaw with vinegar or slaw with mayo), and shared baked beans and the corn/edamame salad with my boyfriend. I ended up only eating half and the rest served as dinner the next night, so you definitely get a ton of food! I really liked that they didn't charge by the ounce like a lot of bbq places. I do wish that they would ask people if they want the bbq sauce on the side instead of just throwing it on the chicken. Besides this minor complaint about the food, there really is nothing bad to say. We could sit and talk without feeling rushed, the ambiance of the place is really nice, if you dine in they serve you in a container that was easily converted into a togo box (you could pick up a cover and go) and you leave feeling satisfied/very happy! One minus was that there was no tissue in the bathroom and it seemed like it had been that way for quite some time. I didn't detract any stars though because the bathroom was pretty clean for the amount of people I'm sure go in and out of there so they obviously attend to it often.

This place has one of the best pizzas and is tied with Pepe's. :) I went here before and still have not forgotten the very very yummy hot pizza they serve. I 100% approve :D Have fun finding parking though...

I visited New York for the weekend, and stayed in a loft that was directly across the street from Roberta's. Holy shit. Pizza paradise? I think so. We started our meal with the meat board of La Quercia Prosciutto, sweet soppressata, and finocchiona. The finocchiona was super fennel-y, strong and bold flavors, love it. The La Quercia prosciutto is different than prosciutto de Parma. Less salty and the flavors are a bit mild. Nonetheless, it was a great prosciutto. My least favorite was the soppressata, just a regular sweet soppressata, nothing exciting. I polished off an entire margherita which was amazing. For desert i had coffee and ice cream which was perfect. Staff is friendly. Can't wait to go again.

Had breakfast there this morning. I ordered the homemade granola with Greek yogurt. It was fantastic. Although they did put a little bit too much granola in the yogurt so I would recommend asking for the granola on the side. Nevertheless it was absolutely delicious.  The coffee was freshly brewed and the service was excellent. Definitely a good breakfast stop or anytime of the day stop. Very friendly with families. I saw a lot of young families there.  I will definitely go back there and I recommend this to everyone.

I have walked by so many times and been tempted by the desserts in the window but both times I have tried it, have been very disappointed. The menu options are confusing and they make up the prices on the fly. Its expensive and the portions are different each time, but the worst part is the food has no taste whatsoever. I love Greek food but this place makes me wonder why. Even the rice pudding has no taste. I am a vegetarian and I have to say plain tofu has more flavor than anything I've tried on the menu at Anthi's. And it looked so good, oh well...

You will love this restaurant!! Union Bar & Kitchen is such a memorable experience!  Fantastic food, unbelievably friendly staff and beautiful artwork. It has an amazing vibe, no matter what the occasion.  I've been for numerous family meals -- my kids love the mac n cheese and oba's fried chicken. I've been for dinner/drinks with friends -- I love the mussels mexican, the fish tacos, the hamachi tartare. And the trouble maker may be the best cocktail I've ever had -- I'm a sucker for mescal! Definitely worth checking out!
A diner is a diner. They've gotten better over the years. Definitely cleaner. My mom enjoyed the Long Island Iced Tea.
I was looking for a good Peruvian restaurant in the area I work at. And this was really good. Definitely going back and trying their Cuban Sandwich everyone is talking about.

I don't know what the fuss is all about for this place. The food is not great the service is horrible. Horrible service, unfriendly servers that treat you like you are invisible!!! I gave them the benefit of the doubt by coming a second time all to find that nothing changed! Never ever coming to this place again!! Oh and it's cash only!?!?!!? Like wth?? It's NYC for Pete's sake

The best Mexican restaurant in North Jersey (in my humble opinion) So authentic, really a hidden gem. I'm obsessed with the chorizo tacos, chorizo quesadilla's, and chorizo everything. My boyfriend lovesss the chicken burritos too. BYOB which is always fun. On top of that, this place is fairly inexpensive, but never substitutes that for taste. We go here once a week. Great job Casa Piquin

Ahh were do I begin! Upon entrance, my wife and I were seated next to a chatty large table. Needless to say, we couldn't hear each other's voices. After waiting 20 minutes for a menu, we placed our orders for the following menu items simultaneously in hopes we would get the food quicker. However, the appetizers took 40 minutes, soup came out 25 minutes after the appetizer, and entrees 1:30 minutes after arrival: Appetizers: shrimp skewer: tasty but had a measly three tiny shrimp on this appetizer. Fried Calamari: one word: OVERCOOKED! Super rubbery, almost impossible to cut or chew for that matter! Soup: French onion: absolutely disgusting! A big bowl of OIL with a BLOB of cheese and absolutely NO seasoning! Soup of the day: tomato bean soup: with the addition of salt and pepper it was OK. Entree #1: Cowboy steak cooked as asked. And that's the only thing good about the dish! Vegetables and mash potato purée were an absolute failure. Not just bland but it seems like they used water to blend the potatoes with instead of heavy cream or milk or something hearty and creamy. Entree #2: macadamia crusted rack of lamb. The rack was a rack so I applaud them for that. And it was cooked as asked. But here is the kicker! It is NOT crusted in macadamia nuts. Instead, they put crushed macadamia nuts on top of the lamb (total amount size of a penny) and it seemed like an afterthought. Certainly not what the menu portrayed! Dessert: cheesecake: same issue as I had with the mash potatoes. This cheesecake was anything but CREAMY like you would imagine it to be. Very gritty texture! After asking for the check, I proceed to wait another half hour for it. Wait time is ridiculous! Food is bland bland bland and not what they advertise. Outdated decor!  I will certainly not be back here anytime soon.
Great food great service. The most incredible pizza i have ever eaten. Fresh and delicious. The stuff was quick friendly and accommodating. Will definitely go back! Amazing!

Wings, TV and great service. I've been here a few times since they've open and I haven't been let down yet. The food is great, atmosphere is awesome and the owner is friendly making us feel at home. This is our new spot from now on!  Extended happy hour specials, yummy taco Tuesdays and with all these TVs, it's a great spot to meet with friends. Definitely recommend!

This was our first time ordering delivery from Ivy Bistro.  I called the restaurant after an hour and the end of the Grubhub delivery window.  They said the food was on its way.  Twenty minutes later I called again and they said the same thing.  They knew who I was and where I was calling from because of caller ID.  Ten minutes later they called me and asked if my food was there but it wasn't and they said that it would only be a minute.  I called them ten times over the next 45 minutes and they would not pick up any of my calls.  This was the worst customer service I have received in all of my years ordering delivery.  They lied to me multiple times and then would not address the issue of service.  I could have handled a delay if I was given a reason.  The food arrived warm so there was no traffic in the 3 miles to our apartment as the driver tried to make his excuses.  The food was mediocre at best.  Not worth the wait or the bad service.  Do not order from this restaurant.  Grubhub refunded my money and gave me a $15 credit for my next order.  They had my back and I appreciated it.  Forget Ivy Bistro.
This place be the bomb diggity. People are very friendly, food is also straight up off the chain. They be  representin India real hard.
Their tortellini soup is the best thing I ever ate at an Italian place and it is only $4.50! It is a massive bowl of tortellini with thinner than usually sauce but no lack of flavor!

One of my favorite Italian restaurants in Staten Island ! The veal martini is a must have and those sweet potato mini zeppolies are to die for ! The staff is wonderful and very accommodating and we never have to wait for a table which is a plus !

I really enjoyed my lunch here a few days ago! The portions were generous and the food was cooked perfectly! i ordered the tilapia with rice and it came with a beautiful salad. The quality is very good and the wait staff very attentive!

I'm from Queens, then moved to Vegas. Coming back here to see friends and family, let me tell you this place would shut businesses down in Vegas. The burger is ridiculously good. I can't get over how good it was. I know that whenever I come back to my beloved NY I will be visiting this place!!!! Super friendly staff too!!! #sarap

Hands Down the BEST pizza in Bayonne or anywhere for that matter ..I promise you wont be disappointed and not only is the pizza good but the rolls and cheese steaks are out of this world..I have family coming from Pennsylvania next week just to try it!
it was so good we went there two times back to back days.
Been here only a couple of times, but it was definitely a positive experience. I prefer Starr's other Mexican restaurant though - El Rey.

WOW this is an amazing restaurant. So glad it was recommended to us while we were in the area. They bring you out bread and offer salad bar for only $6 which is a great deal with lots of options at the salad bar. I got the filet which was SO good. I mean, out of this world good and my boyfriend got the NY Strip which unfortunately wasn't anything to write home about - it really wasn't that tender. I like the $2.50 beer selection before 6:30 which is really a good deal. Overall, I will definitely be returning to this restaurant when I'm in the area again. It really was fantastic.
Nothing to write home about.  Waiter had no idea what he was doing.  The chair at the table was more of a stump, as it lacked a back, and wasn't comfortable to sit on.   Not a fan of this place.

Mmmm great cheese fries and good organic meat on their burgers - the place is spacious but beware it has a lot of fans and it can get quite crowded during lunch hours - a bit pricey for a burger but worth the occasional splurge!

Yummy. Truly one of the best pizza's ever eaten. This place is tied for me with Modern Pizza. I went on a weekday afternoon so no waiting in lines for me :) They also had a booster seat for my one year old (kid-friendly!). The pizza was amazing of course and if you're ever in New Haven and don't want to wait in a long line, go on a weekday early afternoon. :D

We just had our rehearsal dinner at Girogio on Pine! Giorgio could not have been more helpful or nicer! We love him and his amazing menu! Everything on his menu is authentic Italian and so delicious people were talking about it for days after! It is a quaint, intimate restaurant and perfect for a rehearsal of 36 people! Giorgio is so accomdating and sweet I cannot wait to go back! And one of the best parts is, it's BYOB!! Love you Giorgio and the whole staff!
My only complaint is that the waitress was kind of a bitch lol however, since I work In the service industry too I left her a good Tip.

The food is great and extremely affordable. 2 eggs & toast for $2.50.... Seriously. Great prices here. Homemade raisin bread, homemade blueberry pancakes and real Vermont maple syrup are tough to beat anywhere. Ambiance/decor leaves a little (ok, a lot) to be desired but ultimately the most important thing is the quality of the food and the prices in my opinion. 5 stars from me admittedly is to offset the poor current average rating these guys have which quite honestly should be about 3.5 stars I'd say. They definitely deserve a better rating than they currently have. Also, they have a table with an open window that overlooks the river, very nice.

Saleya has the most attentive staff, and the most relaxed happy hour atmosphere.  If you want a nice glass of wine and brick oven pizza with killer atmosphere come here.  TriBeca is filled with dives, but this is a nice getaway from the norm with an amazing staff.  Shannon the manager really knows what he is doing, and Keelin is the best bartender in town.  If you want the real deal TriBeca laid back experience Saleya is your place.

Server was nice, but I have a problem with any restaurant that won't substitute a type of cheese on a salad. They will take the cheese off but won't let you add the cheese you do want...bad policy! I won't be going here again...
They take grilled cheese to an entire new level. Oh, and their tots and milkshakes are ridiculously wicked, too My lady and I can't stop going! We're absolutely addicted.
White sauce magic--there's the secret. Being a newbie Yorker, I've always wanted to try their food and I guess it's safe to say they have lived up to my expectations!:-)

Very good fresh food and the best place to get filet mignon and chicken with rice for under 12 bucks. They cook in front of you and they are very friendly and dont charge for extra sauces which are very tasty too. Love the white sauce.havent had the seafood but with all the police and buisness people that make the trip to the spot up on north park st, no one seems to have any problems. With the food.

The food wasnt bad, but a bad taste was left in my mouth from the customer service. From the three times I've been here I've found the woman who takes your order behind the register gave me a really bad attitude. The last time I ate from here I attempted to ask a question about the menu and she barely wanted to answer. As a consumer I don't think it's much to ask to be treated nicely. I won't be returning.

The food is fantastic, but if you make a reservation as a big group they will make you do the fixed price menu. We ended up making a reservation as two separate groups but they weren't willing to even seat us next to each other. The staff was not very accommodating. However the food and ambiance was great so it's somewhat if a trade off.

The ciabatta, sweet chili sauce, and medium rare beef is what makes the Bronte Burger so perfect. Best meal I've had in a long time! Menu is simple. Burgers and chicken sandwiches and a few smoothies.  The signature burger is called the Bronte and they really do things a bit differently on the burger front.  First, you get a side of field greens so you can ease your conscience a bit after just having gotten over your hangover.  The burgers are served on a longer French roll and are topped with sweet chili sauce.  I'm telling you, the sauce just puts these burgers over the top!  The smoothies are solid as well and I'd recommend the strawberry - banana.   Oh-Ruby's-how i wish you were in Brooklyn too! My mouth is watering just at the possibility of your amazingness in my stomach - and I'm not even hungry!
This pizza is so good. I ate too fast before taking a pic. Amazing little pizza joint.

Just opened Monday.  Happened to stumble by while walking to another restaurant.  We decided to pop in and give it a try.  Apparently bare burger is a chain, originating in NYC.  It's all organic and sustainable, which is pretty rad!  I had the grind house burger made with elk.  Sooo hard to find good game meat anywhere!  Elk is my fave meat and this burger was juicy and cooked to a perfect med rare.   We also split a snack size order of fries and rings.  It came with 4 dipping sauces.  The only one that was good was the special sauce.  All in all, excellent burgers, great variety of game meats, and the friendliest staff.  Def a must try if your a burger fanatic.  I'm glad to be the first to review this joint!  Eat there and thank me later!
I really enjoy this place.  They have the best Calamari. The garlic bread is amazing a must try.

The brunch service was a little rough. Two people in our party got the Grits Eggs and Toast and asked for the side of bacon which you can add for $2. Instead we got a bacon sandwich with each order and were scolded for not being explicit enough that it was the side of bacon and not a bacon sandwich. They then brought out the bacon but charged us the normal price and not the price that's under the Grits because we messed up our order. It was an awkward experience but I think they're just kinda busy on the weekends. Food is all right.
Awesome perfect date place.   Food amazing... atmosphere is beautiful music is pleasant

Went here last night with a friend, intending to try the duck based off of reading yelp reviews and it was a great choice. It had a salty crunch to it and I LOVE salty! The only thing I was disappointed about tho was that it wasn't whole slices of kiwi like I saw in other peoples photos  (just cause it would've made for a cooler photos ;] ) but rather chunks mixed in with the rice-thingy (it's not rice, I just don't remember the name). I didn't really like my drink, the kitchen special it tasted like diet-something but that won't deter me from coming back to try the fish and chips!! And the chicken of the chicken and waffles was delish too. Outside seating was awesome.
Great crew and crooners. From server Ellie, to music master Pasquale, and singing chef Franco. And my friend Frank Bompadre knocking out the tunes last night.

Offensively overpriced.  I feel like no one is seriously tasting their dishes with a critical palate.  Their combinations of flavors at times were simply foul.  Two good dishes out of the six we ordered.  The other four were horrid.  Almond snacks consisting of less than 12 almonds.  What?  Lentil dish was bland and boring.  The cauliflower dish is an offense to anyone who has every cooked, professional or amateur.  Those flavors do not belong together in that way.  And why is it served cold and covered with oil?  No one could honestly taste that and think that should be served to people for money.  Not anyone with ethics, pride, or good taste.  I don't mind spending over $100 at a small dish place but show pride in your work.  I cook better at home. Avoid this place at all cost.  Super disappointing.

Hoagie Haven is the best thing about the city of Princeton.  Yes, even better than the all of the discoveries and humanitarian achievements of Princeton alumni.  For where else can one pick anything on the menu, find it delicious,  plentiful and at a price more consistent with an earlier era? Enjoy
Hmmm it's nothing special, I have experienced better conceptually.

The food was so good that I have to review it before we even clear the table.  We ordered delivery, and my goodness were we impressed! We lived in California and agree that this is much closer to authentic Mexican than anything else we have had out here. The burritos were huge and delicious, stuffed with fresh veggies and rice and beans--just like the big Mission burritos we came to love in San Francisco.  Was very pleased to see they weren't dripping in oil and covered in melted cheese like you see at most restaurants here. Hubby had shrimp tostadas and skirt steak. We shared guac and chips. The guac was fresh--even for delivery. Huge chunks of ripe avocado, so we knew it hadn't been sitting around. Can't wait to order from here again. Now retreating into my food coma.....

I give bottle bar two stars for the mere fact that they have a large selection of beer at reasonable prices. As for the bar area, I am more unimpressed every time. Tonight, my sister and I purchased our beers from the bar, and then were lucky to snag a table. A waitress came by and asked if we were going to order any food, which we said no. About five minutes later, a guy came over and told us that if we were not ordering food we couldn't sit at the table. This is an understandable request for a restaurant, but this is bottle BAR. We pointed out the fact to him that zero of the people sitting at the other tables had food, but I guess since we already had our drinks when we sat down, and are two girls?? he felt we weren't allowed to sit there. So we chugged the rest of our beers and left. This all happened at 9:30 at night. No one was eating food. Maybe if this bar sold french fries I would have considered ordering something. No I do not want a side a lettuce with my pork sandwich thank you.
I visited this melt shop today and the workers Maurice and Anthony gave wonderful customer service.

Muhammad made me my sandwich not only on point, but made me and my cosplaying friends laugh during our photo shoot. We meet here for all our meetings and having this food makes them not only pleasant, but takes out the  hassle of finding a place to eat.
This place is great. The service from Anthony and Maurice was great. They made my experience great. Would love to visit again.
It was my first time at melt shop. Anthony and Maurice provided impeccable customer service and prepared my meal deliciously. I will deffinitely be returning!
Best burger I've had in Brooklyn. The service is great The atmosphere is great I will be coming back again whenever I'm In the hood..

My friend and I tried Bleu Sushi for the first time because we were looking for a BYO in the area. It was delicious and the owner was very welcoming and happy to ensure we were completely satisfied with our meal. It was obvious he has a true passion for sushi and excellent customer service. This is now my go-to sushi place as they have free delivery and good, quality, fresh fish.

Absolutely loved it!!! Kids meal was even wonderful!! Service was great! Good was great!!! I had the lobster rolls from the appetizer menu for a menu. My brother had the lobster Mac and cheese. Had great drinks and the prices were great.

I understand how the menu is just absolutely delicious and food is amazing but if you get a chance to go in please open that fridge on the left and take a sip of that mouthwatering lime-ade. I love the service and everybody is so friendly there.

We shared the Sea bass and the Fried Organic Chicken. Had the Lemon Chiffon cake for dessert. Great ambiance, wonderful reception by the staff, and to top it all off, we had a nice Rosé from Provence as our dessert wine.
Amazing place The veggie burger with cashew cheese was simply divine Their green shake and cauliflower appetizer were also really good! Would definitely go again. Nice atmosphere as we'll!!

This place is five stars because.... ....the different and crazy sushi rolls (lobster, deep fried Yankee) alongside the cheap dependable ones (eel roll, spicy tuna roll) -deeelicious.) The prices. The delivery (they deliver everywhere in the area!!) the coverage of the menu--there are curry dishes, Thai dishes, Japanese appetizers and soups. I like just trying everything. ***disclaimer***Come on people this is not gourmet!! It's Chinese takeout. But it's dependable and the price is aight. Just don't get the spareribs.

We've never been terribly impressed with this restaurant, but went again tonight because we knew it would be no trouble to get a seat without a reservation on a Friday night. That alone says a lot about this place. The next clue should have been the long wait to be seated. This was not because there was a line at the door but because the host seemed to be helping out at the tables. "Helping out" turned out to be quite the understatement. After being seated and then waiting for a painful length of time to place our drink order, the host explains that all of the wait staff no-showed that night. Seriously, no waiters or waitresses! This poor guy was trying to do it all. I felt sorry for him, but I was also feeling sorry for us as we sat without drinks forever. There were two of us and we ordered the queso dip and an appetizer sampler to share as our meal. A million minutes later, the host shows up with a tiny cup of queso and apologizes because they had run out. Thankfully he didn't charge us for it. The sampler then comes out. We had ordered beef and received half chicken and half ground beef- which tastes more like the chili you get on a hot dog than anything Mexican.  The platter was also missing  the sour cream and guacamole. I would have complained, but what would have been the point? Even the lady at the table next to us sent her meal back saying don't bother making me another one, I can't be bothered to wait that long. For $39 plus tip, we got three drinks and a mediocre appetizer. One margarita (so bad I switched to wine), one glass of house wine, one children's drink, one appetizer. Is it just me, or does that seem expensive?! Hey, stuff happens, I get it. I just won't be getting Mexican from this place anymore.
It's ok...the food is overpriced... I wasn't impressed but they do have a wide selection of hot food

Food is amazing! Not much else to be said, haha. Just don't try to go during "brunch" when all the trendy losers go. Go on a weeknight. Will be no line, less crowded, and REAL food! Instead of that brunch nonsense. Joe

Stumbled in a little before 6 on a Thursday.  Got very lucky!  They have a wonderful tapas happy hour Monday - Thursday from 4:30 to 6:30.  All the tapas in the bar area are $2.  Between three of us, we ordered 7 tapas to go with our draft beers.  The tapas were wonderful, and my favorite was the meatball.  My wife loved the bacon wrapped dates, and I have to admit, the bacon helps anything taste good!  Our daughter enjoyed the hummus and olives, and barely shared.  Looking forward to going back!

The service was great. I came here for the first time with two friends and we even got 3 free appetizers compliments of the chef to taste. The hamburgers were great and the fries amazing. The special of eggplant toast was great and the usual devil eggs were awesome. Will come back for sure and recommend to everybody.
I ordered the pork & green onion dumplings and the sesame pancake with Peking duck! Delicious!! AND all for only $5!!! Great deal, great food!!

I've been here a couple times and it's been pleasing, it's a different vibe with the atmosphere, live band on weekend nights which is fun and food is pretty good I love their cornbread and chicken corn chowder is great although it would be nicer if the portion of it was a bit larger. Staff is OK, last time I was there it was horrible our waiter forgot to bring us the cornbread and when he did he only brought 2 pieces, didn't ask how we were doing, didn't refill our drinks and overall service wasn't that great. But not bad for a southern comfort food joint.
Nice place for a drink and something to eat after work. I am a big fan of their potato chips and cheese fondue! Can get a little crowded at times.

I GIVE IT "ZERO STARS"!!!. My father who is a 100% Italian would roll over in his grave at the low Level food that is coming out of Sarcone's.  My first sandwich was a chicken cutlet that was burnt, dry, and inedible. The second was hot roast pork that did have plenty of meat, but absolutely no flavor, and when I asked the girl for au jus and broccoli rabe on the side,  she cringed at the idea of having to add anything else to my order.   I decided to give them one last chance and ordered a roast beef hoagie.  It looked like left over scraps of an overcooked roast beef that was cooked 3-4 days earlier. It was made on a stale roll with hardly any meat. I believe the fact that I bought a Groupon type deal was the beginning of my horrible experience at Sarcone's.  I bought it to support what I thought was a great food place, and came to find out it has lost its passion for making great sandwiches.  I called ahead to ask about the roast beef hoagie, because it was not part of the menu, but the girl put me on hold asap, and I could hear her tell another customer that she just got rid of one phone call, and that "here is another one and I better take care of you first so, you don't have to wait," while I am hanging on just to ask a simple question. The first person you see or speak with indicates the value of your business and needless to say I was appalled by the lack of interest or customer service (which there was none) by the bored, unprofessional,and rude cashier that represents your business. You may think by the local customers that you are doing great, but you have NO IDEA how much business you are losing by allowing the miserable, inconsiderate and often unkind individual remain as the face of your business. You have now become just another deli who cares only about money and not about the customer.  I am sure you are already suffering in revenue, hence the Groupon type certificate, but the real culprit is the front counter person who has no clue as to what Sarcone's is trying to accomplish.  I feel sorry for your loss, and hope that someday you will see the truth before you are forced to close the door. In the food business, customer service is vitally important. Your food is less than desirable, and I cannot in good conscience recommend it to anyone.   It's simple math......  LOUSY FOOD + LOUSY SERVICE + HIGH PRICES =    YOU DON'T BELONG IN THIS BUSINESS.!!!!

we've been to Acacia twice and it's always terrible.  I can't understand how this place gets 5 star reviews.  The food overpriced and lacks taste, the service is average and restaurant needed cleaning.
Great Cafe - good location - friendly staff - great food - there is parking right across and its usually pretty empty.

I have not tried their food. If excellent, they'd get 2 stars. Generally I rate food at 3-4 stars, and service at 2-3 stars, depending on outliers. I went to the bar with some medical school friends tonight at McGillin's. I bought several friends and a complete stranger some beers on both the 1st and 2nd floor of the bar. I had 2 tabs running. The ones in which I bought my friends beers, I paid for. Right after we placed our separate table drink orders, my friends decided to switch bars. They left immediately and I was stuck dealing with our current drink orders. I anticipated telling the management the situation. The waitress followed me upstairs when I went to close my tab upstairs and I told her that we were leaving, but that I'd pay for my drink. She told me I was responsible for the whole table. When I refused, she continued upstairs, logged into her station and charged me for everyone's drinks once she found out I had a second tab. I gave a fus about it and told her that I would take it up with my credit card company. I went to the manager to close my other tab and she gave me hassle about how I should be responsible to them for everyone's drinks and how they would dispute it with my credit card company and make me pay for it. Remember, we're talking about 2-3 bottled beers that my friends ordered. She told me my yelp review wouldn't matter because they have 4 stars on yelp. That maybe true, but each one counts. The bouncer also told me I was full of crap and that I would be responsible for it. Fortunately I spoke with American Express and of course I was right. They said they will absolutely cover the charges or not reimburse the business. This is about principle, not $10 in beers. The Managers name was Maggy, and the waitress' name was Kathleen, or Kathryn but she called herself Kat. This was Friday, September 6th, 2014. They get one star because of Service! Ahh, you have to love the power of good credit with your credit card company, because I will NEVER pay for those beers.

The Almond Butter Cup is like a healthy milk shake! I don't know any other place that makes their own fresh organic almond milk and has almost everything organic! I've always had great service and they are super flexible. The kale salad greens could be cut up more. Really hard to eat! I like that they offer GF bread at no extra cost! But the sandwiches could be a little more simple instead of trying to be overly creative!

Fantastic meal; deliciousity abounds.   Great wine list with reasonably priced options and wonderful food options.  Despite being full went with the tiramisu to complement the house limoncello.  Again, deliciousity abounds!!   We'll be back.
Love this place. Try the appetizer sampler, the ceviche mista, the sangria and the goat cheese empanadas!
The food was decent. Some of the things I liked some were terrible. My broccoli wasnt good and friends meal was cold. It's typical chain food restaurant. Service was poor too.

My brother and I really enjoyed this place for lunch on our first trip to Philly's Chinatown. Try their Malaysian Iced Tea- it's delicious! Good service too. It gets busy since it's right in the heart of Chinatown, but we didn't have to wait to be seated and were not rushed to leave either. Definitely would recommend this place to others.
Great place. Tiny, salad, miso soup was really great!  Fresh and taste. And Kim's special roll was great!! Recommend!!
I'm far from a vegan and I fell in love with the stuffed avocado! If you are in the area this is definitely a place to stop by! Nataki and Sakai helped us choose delicious entrees.

The crowds on any time will confirm that this is a GREAT pizza joint!  My favorite here is the meat-lovers (sausage, pepperoni, bacon, etc).   Always good to phone your order in beforehand when it's this busy.

My husband and I stopped by and just wanted some drinks (non-alcoholic for him, boozy for me). Anthony (the bartender) took amazing care of us and introduced us to incredible cocktails (I am now totally hooked on elderberry liquor). He was also fantastic to talk to and good thing we did, because we ended up having the watermelon gazpacho and OMG! Phenomenal! We were meeting friends elsewhere for dinner, but we will definitely be back!
BEST falafel I've ever had. The spicy is really spicy, fair warning. But whatever you get, you absolutely can't go wrong.

Poor planning by staff.
