This place is actually pretty good.  Infinitely better than Geno's.  If you find yourself at 9th and Passyunk 10 times... go to Pat's 10 times and Geno's 0.  Geno's is terrible.  A lot of locals will bash this place as a tourist trap.. but they're just locals trying to be ahead of the curve and act like they actually have superior knowledge of something.  Pat's is a quality cheesesteak... and if you haven't tried it with whiz... try the whiz.  I know it doesn't sound appetizing... but trust.. .it's infinitely better with whiz.  I was also reluctant to get whiz the first time... once I got it, I've never had anything else again.
Update - the food here is just so good, I had to up the rating to 4 stars from 3. The hirata buns are my new favorite.
You come here to order the bucket of fried chicken and Mac and cheese. It's the best I ever had, and I'm from the south. Wth

Tinga has declined in quality, while its prices are slowly creeping up.  The food was badly lacking in taste.  The staff remains very friendly and it's child friendly as always.  But until the food improves, we will be looking for a different 'go to' Mexican restaurant.

I was very disappointed with my experience last night. My group was a party of 6 - we were sat at 745 with a reservation. Food, drinks and waitress were great but the host was so incredibly rude. He approached our table and said we had to leave because they had a walk in party of 15 that wanted to be sat and that we can take to the bar. He could have approached the situation differently if he wanted us to move tables but did not provide us with other options and demanded that our waitress give our check. Management should have done something to make the situation better if they really did need to seat this party. The server was the only employee who offered a sincere appology.

The place is different, and different can be good. I had the Americano burger with onion rings. The burger here was delicious, and they offer student discounts for high school and college students. The food tasted fresh and unique. Will come back to try something else.
Hidden gem for any big city palette passing through this beautiful stretch of the country.

Philly has some great byob Italian but Giorgio's is one my favs! Place is always packed so reservations are suggested but the pasta is fresh & delicious every time !  Always forth the wait if you want a satisfying Italian night out !

visit fogo for the experience! there are other brazilian steakhouses with similar quality, but the atmosphere and service is not in comparison! great service, quality and flavored meats.. love it evey time

If you like dive bars you'll like Dingo's. I do like dive bars, so it works out well. It's generally a rock/metal/goth/whatever place, so don't come in dressed like it's date night or you might end up complaining like some of the other reviewers. Everything's kind of old and kind of crappy, but it's not very expensive to have a few drinks. It's cool that they keep the pool table in the back room away from the bar. There's enough space so peopl aren't tripping over each other and hitting each other with sticks.

I like being able to sit outside and the Rose Water has nice patio seating. The menu with the food/wine pairings was very well done and was also a good value. Service was very good with a minute taken with each wine to explain it without a long essay. I will go there again.

This is a good spot, I have had lunch here maybe 20 times and I'll continue. I work in the neighborhood and appreciate that the Landmark has good service, is rarely crowded, has a solid, not unremarkable menu and has a great vibe. One of my faves and not too expensive.
The size is really great and $6 for mixed chicken and gyro is really a deal. Always the long line but moves pretty fast. Worth a try.
Delicious brunch!

Rip off!!!!!   Slow kitchen, very over priced and  passable  food at best.  People are very friendly but that is more Vermont then anything else. Would def find somewhere else, this place is a skipper. Avoid at all costs.
One of the top 3 venues for live music in Philly, in terms of set up and acts they bring in.  Reasonably priced beers.  Love this place.

The food was great, good tapas size to share between two people, amazing wine selection as well. I especially liked the s'mores for dessert. The chairs are a little uncomfortable, no back rest and the tables are low so you are bending over the table, my back was hurting by the end of the night. Would recommend it and I am definitely going back!
My husband turned me onto this place early on in our relationship and we are now forever addicts together! Awesome burgers.  Always a late night stop!!!!!

The staff was very friendly and anxious to answer our questions. What I really loved was the sampling of all menu items. I am somewhat fussy, however everything was truly outstanding. The Front St area is also a very exciting area for Hartford and will only get better. Congratulations to Nixs and welcome to Hartford!
The food and drinks were great.  Can't wait to go back.
Love this place and the service is awesome.
Delicious food, friendly service and an overall nice place to eat in this town! It's a great addition!

Condujimos desde NY solo para probar los famosos cheesesteak de Sonny's, y desde luego mereció la pena! Nos arrepentimos de no haber comido dos bocadillos cada uno!! Pedimos beef steak con cheez whiz y grilled onions, de las cosas mas deliciosas que he comido en mi vida!! Ademas de estar en el centro de la ciudad, el precio es baratísimo, pagamos 22$ y comimos dos personas con patatas y bebida. Lo aconsejo como lugar obligado al visitar Philadelphia.

Last night we hosted drinks and dinner in Juni's private dining room.  Attendees, who are particular and discriminating in their tastes, described the entire experience as "spectacular," "great,"  "fabulous," and "wonderful."   Working from Seattle with amazing Director of Private Dining and Events, Annette Jordan, everything was planned to perfection in less than four days. Annette is creative, accommodating, responsive, flexible, professional, AND nice! From start to finish she did everything that she could to make last night's experience top-notch and memorable! I had read wonderful things about Executive Chef Shaun Hergatt and Juni and I am so happy to share this great review!
I
Excellent service and very friendly staff. Definitely euros recommend. The Chef's table was great seating.
Food was ok, but could have been better.  Chicken was dry on my chicken salad.  I also tried the Red Stone pizza and that was a little better.  Kind of an Olive Garden level of experience.
Phenom pizza, sauces made from scratch, relish cuke salad w/hangar steak and 15 minute take out pick up....what's not to love!

From away and randomly chose this restaurant without any prior knowledge.  This place was amazing.  Had the pulled pork sandwich and it was the best one of my life.  My dining companion had their grilled chicken sandwich and she also said it was the best she's ever had.  The service was very good, the place was very clean and the prices were very reasonable.  Already planning our next trip back!
My husband picked me up a grilled chicken, mozzarella,  roasted red pepper & balsamic vinegar on a semolina roll.  Absolutely delicious.   Need to get sandwiches from there more often.
Awesome little dinner very affordable and very polite and quick service ... Only place I'll eat if at temple ... Just wish they were open past 3 in the afternoon cause I'm a bum lol!
Excellent food and service always, Chef Forigone is always personable and the food is wonderful as well as the atmosphere.   Great experience with friends and co workers after work =.

Miami Mike's is the spot to be especially for football season ! They have a ton of TVs including a bunch of huge screens... And they just started a brand new menu for the season! When I was there this past Sunday it was absolutely packed with crazy fans for every team! The food was really good for your typical bar menu, and the waitresses were really nice and very helpful even under the demand of so many customers. Can't wait to go back for another Sunday game!

Having been to Baby Blues several times before and really enjoying their food, I have to say that Friday's BBQ experience was one of the worst I've ever had.I ordered the Get Down Ms. Brown plate which consisted of pulled pork, fried okra, and mashed sweet potatoes. The cornbread honestly and without exaggeration tasted like an old sneaker. The pulled pork was cooked in some kind of thick gelatin which rendered it practically uneatable. The only edible aspects of the lunch was the mashed sweet potatoes and the fried okra. A co-worker of mine said that the Mac and Cheese he ordered tasted like it has nail polish in it. I likely won't be ordering from there again which is too bad because I considered it to be a pretty descent bbq spot.
Best Mexican food in Philly. Authentic,  delicious, great atmosphere and reasonably priced full bar.  Make a reservation.

We took our parents here and my mom had one crystal shrimp dumpling and immediately said "don't eat anything with shrimp in it, it tastes like bleach. I tried it and yes, it definitely tasted like bleach.

Light years ahead of every other fried seafood joint I have tried in the area for whole belly clams. Apparently they are brought in fresh every morning and you can taste it. Tender and succulent with a flavorful light batter. Westville Seafood is more reminiscent of the paper napkin joints I have eaten at in Cape Cod and Maine instead of the rubber I have eaten at other places in the New Haven area. The young women who work the counter are also refreshingly professional and nice. Keep up the great work Westville Seafood!
Simply the best. Great service, nice atmosphere. Pizza is so so good, along with the apps and coffee, espresso!

TLDR: Top notch service, excellent atmosphere, great food, prices a bit high but worth at least a try if you are interested. Service: The service is impeccable and the attention was great. No word is needed when you want a refill or if you need anything. In fact, I haven't even hit the bottom of my glass the entire night. 5/5 Atmosphere: Gives off a very elegant feel. Great decor, music fits and isn't too loud, abs a mixture of great cultural song choices. Felt very welcome and comfortable. Even the owner came over to ask how everything was. 5/5 Food: I'll describe what I had, but overall everything was great. Grilled Octopus: Very tender (how do they do it?) and has a lot of rich flavors. Chick peas and other elements compliment the citrus-flavored grilled octopus. It has a bit of a smell, but don't let it fool you. However, I can see this dish being a hit or miss, so be prepared. 4/5 Duck Confit: Thin slices of duck served with a cherry reduction. Very well made, and while a bit on the salty side, goes excellent with the cherries. 4.5/5 Seafood Risotto: Amazing. Filled with a wide variety of seafood in such a densely packed meal. In fact, I'm pretty sure it had more seafood than risotto. It looked small, so I was afraid it wouldn't fill me but it was just enough. 5/5 Pricing: Quite pricy. 10 for the duck and 10 for the octopus, which both doesn't give you that much. 23 for the seafood risotto, which made it at least 60 for two with dessert (was around 7 per dessert). Expect to spend when you come here, but it's worth the money even if you only eat here once. 3/5 Even though it is quite pricy, the food, service, and atmosphere made it worthwhile. Check it out if you are interested!

I just has the best service I have ever received from any restaurant. The owner and the servers were all very nice and welcoming! And to tip it off, sushi was delicious and met my high expectations. I will definitely be back and highly recommend this place to others. Prob make a reservation though just to guarantee a seating. Also this place is BYOB!! It's truly a hidden gem that you must try!
They do not accept the 10% off deal as advertised. Food is decent though.

A group of us went to eat at this place and we were not aware that you needed to make reservations to eat brunch since most all places in Williamsburg do not take reservations at brunch time.  The person managing the place that day was not the least bit accomodating to us and treated us as he could not be bothered.  It seemed like we were annoying him with wanting support his business.  I wonder if the owneres of the place know that this is happening or do they not care when hiring.  He did not offer to put our name on the list.  We had to ask him to place our name on the list and he seemed to not want to do it.  So we all left and went to Walters Food which treated us like paying customers.  I have heard from several friends that the food might be good but the service is not great or friendly. I would even go as far as saying that they rather cater to a specific race in their establishment but can't be sure.  I hope they make changes to their staff sooner rather than later because eventually it will affect their business.
I go there every week .. just because of best tacos ever.
Incredible food. It was so delicious. The ambiance was really great. The kale chips were the best I've ever had. The staff was so warm and friendly. I highly recommend.
It was ok! Hoping better meat! The buffet was good but the bread was all old and cold! Friendly service!

While the pasta is good ( rigatoni, sausage and meatball) I had sticker shock of what a pound will cost, $9.36 that leaves you still hungry? this is not good for business. This was my third trip there and  the parking lot is empty I guess for a reason. It is a shame and was hoping the best for a new business on RT10

Nothing special about this place. Had very high hopes based on reviews and the photos of the space. Very friendly (a bit smothering) service by the host or owner or manager. One of our appetizers was a lasagnette - which had crunchy corners from reheating - not appetizing. Main dishes are quite large but bland. The parm cheese was definitely a commercial variety. The waiter was friendly yet hurried and rough around the edges. As you look around the room, it conveys different characters. Like they didn't know how to quite design the space. Lighting needs adjusting. And let me not forget how immensely distracted - and concerned - we were by the many fruit flies anxious to dive into our wine. The biggest positive - the bill was low yet we left most of our food.  Might be worth a second chance.

The food is made right behind the counter from deli fresh meat and served in take out containers so you can eat in the beautifully renovated Military Park one block away. You can't beat their cheesesteaks!

Over 100 restaurants inside.  This is the place to visit while in Philly.  You will be in food heaven!  Philly cheesesteaks, donuts, truffles, all kinds of sweets, oysters, lobsters, Chinese food, Indian food, Pakistani food, you name it, it's all here!  I can stay here for days!!!
The burger is awesome. Very noisy restaurant but this burger and French fries are amazing
Hungry for pizza and I found it.  Awesome pizza, fast delivery.  Definitely order from them again.

Attempted to order take out last night, was put on hold for no less than 15 minutes (with no hold music) before I hung up and called back.  Was placed on a more reasonable hold the second time around (maybe 5 minutes) and placed my order.  I go to pick up the food at the unfortunately decorated restaurant (think 1990's Nickelodeon meets jail? so odd), there are literally 3 other patrons inside and the staff is utterly overwhelmed.  The very sweet girl at the counter was absolutely beside herself trying to manage the phone and the - now 4 - customers.  My food is ready and open on the counter but the desk girl can't let me leave with it because she is unable to work the cash register.  At this point, the one seated customer walks up and notes that he's been waiting some 40 minutes for his mac and cheese. The whole thing was just chaos - and it didn't have to be, at all.  The staff was unable to achieve even the most basic tasks: answer phones, take orders, fill orders, serve food and take payments.  The two stoned chefs were just in outer-space and were of no help to the poor overwhelmed counter girl.  After another 20 or so minutes I was finally able to get outta there with my cold, albeit decent, food and a total headache.  The atrocious service and disorder not at all worth the very mediocre food.  One decent manager and a paint job could probably do this place a lot of good.

Three words: Great food, great service, great ambiance. When you're in the mood for some good authentic greek food, there's no better place in Queens than Kyclades. I'm a regular for the last three years and every time I have the same blast. Strongly recommended.
One of the best places in New Haven for a Burguer and Good Beer.

My husband have been eating here since they opened and they're food has been consistently fresh and flavorful. One thing I HIGHLY recommend is their soups! It was one of those husband wants mexican food days, but i was really craving soup, so I gave their soup a try. I never ask what the soup of the day is, I like for it to be a surprise and they have always been  very delicious!! If the chef wrote a cookbook on soups I would totally buy it. Their tacos, burritos, dinner entrees etc are superb too, but I felt that no one ever mentions the soup, it's seriously good.
30 years have been coming here and still great - love the Falafel with baba-go-nuah.   So yummy - come here every time when in NYC!!!

We have been HUGE, DIE HARD fans for about a decade!!. We are from CT so the trek is long & tedious but well worth the travel. Everything is delicious...you will not be sad! Not one bit! The waitstaff is also top notch! Bring a huge appetite!
Craig Alan Lenhart   Arrowbear CA Good food at a price you would expect.  Upstate.
Loved my waitress, stephany! She's super sweet and helpful! Loved all the appetizers and my burger was awesome. Def coming here with my boyfriend
My coworkers and I order lunch take-out here almost weekly.  The hoagies are AMAZING.  My absolute favorite is the Old-Fashioned Italian; I haven't found a better hoagie anywhere!

I visited this past week for the first time with a friend to an empty restaurant, which is an unfortunate and frequent consequence of Downtown Hartford as it struggles to reinvent itself. Anyway, we were seated quickly (as I said only my friend and I were the only people there). The waitress was very attentive and friendly. The meal was very very good. I had a blackened salmon with couscous and spinach. All perfectly seasoned.. My friend ordered chicken parmesan which he absolutely loved. This was a special occasion visit and the price warranted it. The meal came to about $90 which probably explains why the place was so deserted.  I would definitely visit again for another occasion, but this is not a "girls nite out" type place or a place where you bring the family for a casual meal.  and I couldn't imagine spending this type of money for dinner more than once a quarter. The ambience is nice enough, but not THAT nice, lol.  We sat inside, but there is outdoor seating. Unfortunately the outdoor patio faces a very busy street with nothing blocking you from commuters passing by. What's strange is that this restaurant is situated inside Spotlight Theater ( a first run theater), but doesn't seem geared to the tastes of the average movie goer who probably doesn't want to spend $100 on a meal and then pay for a movie. Putting that aside, if you want to treat someone really special to good service and quality food and excellent presentation, then visit Front Street Bistro. My rating of 4 stars is based on the interaction with the waitress and the quality of the meal and wine.
The place is very casual but they by far have the best pizza in the area!

Really like this place! Cool ambiance, good service, and informative about the menu (Never had Korean before so I had some questions). Even won a free beer after getting to spin the wheel!. Bibimbap was awesome as well. Only complainant is that it is a little pricey for the portion size, but overall good experience!

One of the best, if not the best, Italian restaurant in Queens. I'd like to mention the excellent food and great service that they provide. The waiter literally takes his time to present you the specials of the day and I'm not exaggerating but he talks for good 5 minutes. If you have any type of questions somebody from the staff will make sure to answer in the best way possible. Love that place

Went here and was very disappointed.  Food was average and service sucked.  Did as is my right and let them no by stiffing the server.  Tipping is always optional.  If a tip isn't received, it wasn't earned.  If it wasn't optional, it would be included in the price.  A paid employee is not the equal of a paying customer.  Never was-never will be.
Sub-par food for ridiculous prices, bad service and snobby attitudes from the staff and management who apparently go by the motto "The customer is always wrong". Wouldn't recommend to anyone

With all the hoopla over the tipping thing, I decided to go. I waited 15 minutes and no one came to ask me anything or offer any assistance. It was really uncomfortable. I did not even get a chance to order their food. Having read the other reviewers on here, it looks like the many negative ones related to service hold true after my experience. It is unfortunate that you have a place who has employees who do not care at all about the quality of the work they do. two thumbs down and zero stars if I could.

Burgers ok, but overpriced for what you get.  Service is just plain awful.  And to make it worse, it all comes with a "my sh*t doesn't stink" attitude.  And both times we were there, they screwed up the order.  I'll pass on this place.

My buddy lives right on 3rd street off Girard, so PYT is where we go whenever I'm there. The service isn't spectacular, but the food says it all. I don't have any complaints about the service, but it's a burger, so if I didn't have to wait as long as I had, then I would have 5 stars, but 4 stars should suffice.
Skip it! One of the WORST services in NYC Had to wait more than an hour to be seated
One of the best japanese restaurants for casual dining or brunch

So, EXTREMELY disappointed with this place... When I saw a Peruvian restaurant opening literally BLOCKS from my house I was excited I drive all the way to Elizabeth or Orange to satisfy my Peruvian crave. Any way my husband went inside to place the order at 11:30am on a Friday ... He met me at the stop and shop right across the street... We left 20 minutes after and I still had to run some more errands I looked at the time and freaked out it was 12:50 , we placed the order 1 hr and 20 mins. ago, for a second I was like wow this place is not like the Chinese restaurants they call u every 10 minutes after your order is done.. Anywho we went to the restaurant and can u believe the order wasn't ready??? Im not a rude person so I was like ok how much longer would I have to wait... The lady said another hour and we'll deliver the food for u. Ok no problem... We got home ... An hr. and a half later had past no sign of the food... I was busy so I couldn't call right that second so 15 minutes later( now 2 hrs. And 45 minutes after we placed the order) I decided to call ... The lady who picked up the phone LIED to my face didn't let me finish the sentence and said oh I'm outside open the door... So I was at this point starving and aggravated... Can you guys believe that my husband went outside and waited 10 additional minutes because no one was outside Grrrr... I called and the lady was like oh the girl is not there I was like no why would she if u said she was outside ... Now I'm furious I don't like getting lied too. After  3 hrs. And 15 minutes to receive the food... The chicken was bland and cold the french fries it seem the delivery girl( who let me tell u all ...walked with $50 worth of food ) ate them on the way to my house because there was barely any, the seafood ceviche looked like they took the cheapest pieces of tilapia cooked it mind u it's supposed to be with raw fish. And they shredded the fish and it wasn't in cubes Ohhh the disappointment... If I was able to rate this place 0 I would... Most places to make a customer happy after making wait so long they give them a free meal or at least reduce the bill.... Never will go there again ... I will continue to drive across town... This wasi food should be named.   Walk-away food it left a bad taste in my mouth and I've been to other bad places but this place infuriated me to the point I just had to open up a YELP account.

Expect to wait in line....when the give a estimated waiting period you need to add 30 minutes to that. Well my advice DO NOT go with more than 2 people at a time then, you will find yourself waiting at least less. Thai tea is good. Food I can't say it's good. I had the PadThai and honestly it tastes like is was just made with ketchup. The little entrees are tasty though

I got a pizza there a week ago it was tastier than the other pizzerias out there, but i'm not sure what all the hype is about. If you're walking by stop in, but it's not worth a special trip. what bothers me is the long time I had to wait until I got my pizza. after finishing the first slice I was still hungry but it wasn't worth to go thru the long wait a second time.

I would prefer their ramen over Ippudo because the broth is richer and their ingredients are better. The ramen as a whole was more flavorful as well. The restaurant is so small though with not many good seats but whenever I'm craving ramen noodles, this places always comes to mind.

Just like getting great pizza in Rome. My Pie is a great midtown find- an assuming little space with a cheesy name. But boy o boy is the pizza good. These are the Roman-style pan pizza slices, and not your typical New York triangle slice. The crust is wonderfully thick and flavorful, and the sauce is awesome. Get the slice with the cherry tomatoes and fresh mozzarella and you won't be disappointed.

We first went to try out their sweet crepes but when we saw the menu we were interesed in their salty selection too. All of their ingredients are fresh. Thats the one thing that came through when we tried the greek crepe.Their menu also has other items like muffins and they also have a good selection of organic coffee and tea.The owner is very welcoming and enthusiastic. Will definitely go back!

Had lunch here yesterday with my husband. The decor is absolutely gorgeous and probably was the reason we came in. We also love Mexican food and it's hard to find the good stuff. We ordered 2 tacos each and an agua fresca. The tacos were microscopic. At $4 and $5 apiece, the price is way too much. I understand they are the same size in Mexico, but I am sure they are not the same price. We had wonderful salsa and chips. The salsa came in the tiniest bowls I have ever seen. We asked for more salsa and they gave it to us. Then, a waitress came over and told us they usually charge for a second helping of salsa. Come on. In those tiny bowls? It was a turn off. Overall, the food was very tasty, but I have to say I did not feel we had reasonably sized portions. These days, I am willing to pay for a good meal, but not one that is so tiny, that I left feeling hungry. The value was just not there. I will have to think it over before returning.

This place is great. I heard Heath Ledger used to own this place. I can tell because the restaurant is very well managed and is decorated with great taste. I will say that the wait time is always pretty outrageous but it's because this place is that good. I would say the food and atmosphere is worth the wait though. I would totally recommend this place to all of my friends.
Another superb beef brisket noodle. Portions big but yummy

I heard about European Republic from many fellow coworkers who had been praising about their quality of food and affordable prices. They highly insisted I try this place, and days later I finally decided to give it a try. The place looked clean and eloquent, music was playing in the background and the atmosphere seemed cheerful. It was quite busy with a lot of customers when I arrived but the waiting time period for orders was shockingly short. The staff were very fast in preparing customers' orders and exceptionally friendly. While waiting my turn in line, I glanced through their menu and noticed their majority of their serving items were healthy, organic and actually very inexpensive compared to other places located within center city. Soon after, then my attention was caught upon the vast variety of exotic dipping sauces, I was getting impressed by the minute. Upon my turn to order, I asked for a side of lentil soup, grilled chicken with fresh mozzarella wrap and frites with 3 dipping sauces (roasted garlic, basil and caviar). My order was ready shortly after, and to my delight, the food was in fact amazing! The soup was excellent, the wrap tasted incredibly fresh, and the frites and dipping sauces were the best I've ever had. I was so pleased at the quality of taste that I literally bought a couple more wraps (grilled chicken brie cheese honey dijon wrap and grilled salmon caesar wrap) and frites for the road. As I walked out of the place, the young man who was dexterously working behind the register ran outside and was calling for my attention. When I turned around, he gracefully smiled while approaching me and stated I had forgotten my 3 dipping sauces. I was astounded by the young man's noble hospitality. As I thanked him, I quickly realized the only regret I had was that I wished I had taken my coworkers' advice sooner. There are far from few places within the city that possess all of the charismatic qualities as this place does. European Republic is definitely going to be my daily lunch break spot from now on. I highly recommend this place!

Had an Oyster po boy. Terrible. nothing like the great sando in the south. too few oyster, no dressing, wrong bread. Very indifferent service. All for $20+. . Just pass and get the raw oysters but that will run you $30 for a plate

Worst service I have ever experienced in NY, I will never come back again. The minute I came in it was over crowded, despite my reservation. Also the pizza was mediocre. This place basically ruined my birthday. Stay away
My favorite restaurant in Hell's Kitchen - perfect portions, great prices, NYC energy, and food for the soul! The line is always long - so come about 15 mins before you're hoping to sit.
Great service and great food! Awesome neighborhood spot! Meghan a wonderful server! I recommend this for a casual dinner spot!

Everything here was exceptional. Our server was extremely attentive and efficient. The food was an experience in itself. For appetizers, we ordered the sweet corn soup and fried calamari. The soup was out of this world. It had the perfect balance of sweetness from the corn, saltiness from the bacon and tanginess from the cream. For entrees, I had the black fettuccine with bay scallops, shrimp and mussels and my boyfriend had the thai seafood with rice pilaf. The seafood was fresh, the vegetables were crunchy (I dislike mushy vegetables), and the sauce was not overly spicy or sweet which I think is difficult to achieve because a lot of Thai restaurants tend to overdue it with the sweetness. For dessert, we had the jasmine panna cotta with berry compote per the recommendation of our great server. The creaminess of the panna cotta with the acidity of the berries made it the perfect end to our phenomenal meal. Let's just say, I had to refrain myself from licking the ramekin. We left this place with big smiles on our faces. We will definitley be coming back to try the other delicious dishes!
DO NOT DO TAKE OUT. They didn't understand our simple order and the manager gave me attitude. He was so rude. And it was so disrespectful!

I never write reviews but I do come on yelp to look for good spots and find out what people are saying about different places that I would like to try but I felt compelled to give back a little and write about Bank and Bourbon.....Have had meetings in Philly a few times over the last month and someone recommended this place as it was fairly new and a good place to eat.... Been here twice-  lunch once and dinner once....Had outstanding experience both times...Servers were good...coming over to see if we needed anything consistently but never too much to interrupt us.....lunch was really good..had the burger and 2 others had the chicken sandwich and they raved about it..... Dinner I must say was phenomenal.... staff helpful  and they had a guy there to explain all about the bourbon etc..... Usually only order steaks at steak houses so I was hesitant to get it but we ordered a cowboy steak and it rocked....glad we made that call.....atmosphere was nice as well...bar was full and good mix of people....All in all I would say if you are in Philly and looking for a good spot to eat that you haven't tried this would be a good place to check out........

possibly my favorite brunch. cute spot, but a little tight. best steak tartare. delicious croque madam. washed all that down with a nice glass of rose. i wish i could eat here everyday. hmmm, maybe i will!

The service here is good, nice staff and welcoming owner. However, the food isn't that great. Ordered a chicken wrap once that was less than desirable. Their burgers are really good though. I think consistency is a lacking factor. If they can overcome that then I believe they would be a good restaurant. Overall, not bad.

New Owners! This place is truly amazing! It is now family owned. The food in most cases is made from scratch such as the dumplings and wontons.The food has great flavors and I would definitely recommend! Although they do have dining available best for take out. Enjoy! You wont regret it!

My husband and I usually pick up our orders, as this place is ALWAYS packed!  I usually get either the Sorrento panini or Penne alla Vodka, which are both equally delicious!  My husband gets the Ischia panini, which I'm going to assume is just as amazing, based off the expression on his face every time he eats it!

Had a sampling of the grilled tonton pork belly with sesame seeds and garlic sauce and all I can is say is delish. But since it is after all pork belly if your watching your figure or cholesterol would advise to eat it once in awhile.
Delicious Ethiopian! All vegan too!

So, at Public now.  Had a 10pm reservation and it's now 10:55pm and at this point they don't know if they have a table for us.  This is quite possibly the most stupid reservation system I have even seen.
Good service today.  Don't let the strange name fool you it's pretty good. Craig Alan Lenhart  Arrowbear  CA

There is not anything here that does not make me very happy to be a New Yorker, and in New York, and  alive. It's just casual-smart-perfect, and even though the Patty Melt is a very very southern California invention, the one here is better than the best Tiny Naylor's.  Also I love the people who work there, who exude joy. Going there makes me happy the way Florent used to, the way Odeon still occasionally does.  I'd go here over Per Se any day of the week. Plus the deserts are absurd, in the best way.
Great place for live music,  Philly cheese steaks for cheap on Fridays. Huge beer selection. Pretty cheap.

The atmosphere and the magic garden. That's why you come to Milk and Roses. The food and the coffee is why you return. I love it here and always feel welcome when I arrive. By the time I leave, I feel centered and full. The attention that has gone into every detail of this place is a big part of what makes the experience. I have always enjoyed the food. So much so, that I know that it's a given that it's going to be delicious. I highly recommend it for date night, brunch or wine with friends.

This food cart hit the right spot in many ways.  The hype is true in my opinion.  One rice bowl order is enough for two people.  The server work fast, so don't bother talking as they are hustling and bustling.
cant beat it

Don't go there, is a total ripoff, my bill came with tips included for only 3 people, plus some tax they add, the tips and the tax was 45% the total amount, this overcharge must be illegal, never more :(

Basically, you will eat something that are best but never served in other hot pot restaurants. For example, fresh crabs and shrimps (definitely not frozen --- these pitiful animals were alive before they are sent to your table). Also, the shrimp/fish pastes are the best so far --- better than the best hot pot restaurants in LA, SF and others in NY!! The most attractive stuff to me, is the source. A dish of mixing special peppers, soy source and special seafood-flavored source, with some ginger slices ---- the best!!!! The waiters/waitress there are very friendly -- compared to other Chinese restaurants (but sometimes they will recommend some expensive seafood to you, but I like the food so it is not a big deal to me). A few problems -- the furnishment looks crappy, the price is high and you have to wait very long without reservations.
Stopped by to have one of my favorite pizzas. This is still one of the best pizzas around this area. Great atmosphere and excellent customer service.
Very good sushi.

I went to lunch nd dinner at Ponty Bistrot and it has always been delicious. The staff is very attentive and the owner always there to welcome you. Even the sandwiches are made with a  delicious sauce.(mergues is my favorite). All desserts are made on site and they were delicious!
Sesame chicken was overly sweet... General tsous probably was too but I think the spice covered it up.  There was a lot of breading and the chicken was dry, so the food was pretty rough to chew on...
The staff was nothing to speak of but the food was outstanding, we would definitely go again.

Mixed reviews. When I went there the first time I found the place to be pleasant, I like the atmosphere, and I loved the food. FYI the grits were phenomenal. However on my second visit I decided to bring my mom. This time I went with my mom. The place was full and I had a 15 minute wait. Now just was not the problem since some kind of wait is expected. What I did not expect was the incredibly loud music for a restaurant. If this was a bar or a club that serve food I might expect it but not from here. I waited 10 minutes before the waiter came, then i had to shout my order, repeat it more than 2x, and as you probably guessed they got it wrong, twice. I gave up and just took what i got. Holding a conversation was out of the question, since repeating myself was a must. Sigh, with all that said, food was still great and i would still go back, but if music is blaring anf place is full, i' ll pass.
I'd yummy crepes and great coffee when I went. I've been wanting to go back.
The lamb I ordered was way tooooooo salty!!! I asked for medium rare and I got medium well.

The cocktails are delicious and the portions are sizable for the price (I just hope they stay that way). I tried the flat bread, the crab cakes and the salmon with rice, everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. Make sure to give yourself a little time to really enjoy the atmosphere. Industrial at its most elegant.

I thought my sandwich was delicious, so was hubby's. We each got one with a different cheese so that we could share. The fries were yummy too. What stuck with me more than the food was the attitude of the employees. They were so friendly and funny, that it truly made for a great experience.

Went for drinks and I enjoyed my peach sangria.  My companions enjoyed their cocktails as well. Great outdoor patio space, however none of the tables were cleared outside (dishes were left on them), so we had to clear our own to sit down. The bartender was fine, but not especially helpful.  As other reviewers have mentioned, go for the patio but the service is a major drawback.

I hate to disagree with so many fellow yelpers but this joint is OVER RATED. The food is subpar, the service only so-so, the atmosphere unimpressive. Except for the courtyard. The courtyard is lovely. If you bring your own food, it's a wonderful place to dine.

We stopped here on a recommendation by the desk clerk at a nearby hotel. We were told that the food is prepared fresh and from local ingredients. We found the atmosphere to be casual and comfortable, but a little dark. I had to use the table candle to read the menu. Our waitress was very pleasant and knowledgable. Our group ordered several different items, including crab cakes, scallops, and the chicken piccata. We found the scallops and the chicken to be very good. The crab cakes, on the other hand were disappointing. Maybe it's because we live close to Baltimore and are used to a real Maryland crab cake but the ratio of filler to crab meat wasn't appealing. Over all, it was a pretty good meal.

I had a fantastic experience with Mama Mary's catering. My group ordered a meal for approximately 200 people, and they came in at a price that was far lower than other local soul food options. The meal was delivered on time, and I heard nothing but rave reviews. The pulled pork bbq had a spicy kick that was the crowd favorite. In the planning process, I worked with Sabrina, who was attentive and helpful. She allowed me to order by the pan, which really helped drop the cost per head for my event. She even threw in a complimentary pan of banana pudding to the order. I would be happy to work with her and the restaurant again. At the end of the day, Mama Mary's is delicious soul food at a competitive price.

Food and enviornment were excellent. Service was awful! Early Saturday meal with a non crowded establishment and it took the waitress 20 minutes to come to the table. Food was delivered and we had to track the waitress down for the bill.
Horrible delivery service. It took 1 hr and 20 mins for them to deliver. Called the restaurant, poor customer service and very rude. Food mediocre. Very disappointed.
Good food.  Most importantly it was quick. Had party of 8 and food came right out. Can come back for sure.

I've been here a few times and it's slightly under rated. Maybe the price is a nod to the chef and the food's quality. Still, the price and the decor hurt my rating. Order anything with buffalo brisket, duh! The guacamole is actually good.
Terrible service! We paid a $5 cover for each of us (5) ordered twice and never got drinks.

Food EXCELLENT Menu options EXCELLENT Service 4 stars only because some of the hostestes can be somewhat aloof. Not sure if it's a language thing or if they are just tired of us or other people asking to be sat away from the AC. Overall, great experience. Love the mango avocado salad!

This place is awesome! The service is good and the wait time is not bad either. The only thing is its a bit cramped but if u think about it that's a good thing cause that means its popular lol. Food is def on point and I recommend seafood lovers to come at least once.
An obscure little find that turned out to be a diamond in the rough!
I loved this cute little brunch spot.very cozy and lovely inside.i was with my boyfriend and we ordered leas breakfast and margarita pizza, very tasty:)

There is nothing like a good Brooklyn smack-down. In this case, Juliana's versus Grimaldi's. The owner of Juliana's (the older, grumpy guy) used to own Grimaldi's. He sold it to another older, grumpy guy. The new owner of Grimaldi's moved a few doors down (rumor is he didn't pay his rent) and the previous owner of Grimaldi's took the vacated space and opened Juliana's. So now it's Juliana's and Grimaldi's literally next door to one another. The good news is that Juliana's takes credit cards (Grimaldi's does not) and their pizza is amazing. Their menu can be a little confusing as they seem to want you to order pre-created pizza combinations. The other good thing about Juliana's is that they have more on their menu such as good salads. That said, Grimaldi's is still awesomely delicious. We choose which one we're going to based on the line out front.
Offers lunch specials for $5 from 11-3pm.  I would suggest that if you are located near by, do pick up instead of delivery - noticed delivery takes much longer. Other than that - fast service!
Really good Chinese food/real chicken. A little more expensive than your typical Chinese food joint but satisfying. Got sweet and sour chicken and beef with broccoli.

Two stars too much! Unfortunately everything at this restaurant is horrible. I can't even get a glass of Coke right. Let me Associates is very watering... And underseasoned. The item on my was obviously severely frozen microwaved. Shumai was the doughy gelatinous  mess of an inedible creation. Definitely avoid this place at all cost
Their burgers are bland and do not taste "great" Shrimp tacos were terrible The sweet potato fries were so soggy that I couldn't even eat them
Food is okay but too refined. Flavors and spices not well balanced and not blended. Meat in meat dishes was tough. Overall the quality is good enough to pass for a quick meal.

Came here with several friends ranging from vegan to vegetarian to full carnivore and none of us left satisfied with the quality of the food. Multiple times we found ourselves saying "this isn't bad, but I could make this - and probably make it better".  Our entrees were not hot. The service was poor. When we were offered hot sauce, we were given the tiniest little dish with maybe a teaspoon of hot sauce in the bottom. Our waitress asked us if we all wanted to get our food at the same time. Um... Yes?  The one truly impressive and enjoyable part of the meal was the apple crisp a la mode. For good vegan food, go literally anywhere else. Positivitea, Le Salbuen, Veggie Heaven, Mesob, your own kitchen at home.
Extremely rude wait staff. Spending $20 on pizza does not get you a place to eat your food in this place so be prepared to sit on the sidewalk.

We recently took good friends of ours to Thai Ping for an introductory meal. We told them how good the food was. My wife and my friend's wife ordered the same dish. My wife ordered it with no spices at all and our friend ordered her dish to be mildly spiced. My wife took her first bite and her mouth was on fire!!! Our friend's dish had no spices at all!!! We told the waitress (miserable and grumpy) about the problem and she took my wife's dish back to the chef. When she brought the dish back, she basically threw the dish  onto the table and said the chef(substitute) said the dish was not made with any hot spices. If that wasn't bad enough, she said that if we didn't like the food there that we should not come back to the restaurant!!!! We were never so embarrassed in our lives. Needless to say that not only loose our business, but you can be sure our friends will never go back to Thai Ping again. Maybe the chef should make the  food the way it is ordered and the waitress should get a personality transplant!!!!!!! This is not the way to run a business and encourage customers to return or recommend anyone to go to the restaurant.
Wow! This place is amazing! Tried the lamb shank an skirt steak but I bet everything here is awesome! Gonna try it all this winter.

Best falafel in the New York. i have been to many falafel places there is nothing like OASIS. i have been going there for almost 10 years now, same taste, same quantity & same exact price. place to be even its late at night.

Great food. Gobi Manchurian was awesome. Menu has a lot of choices and they will make good to your liking as it is freshly made. Service is a little slow as food takes time to make. I was advised to order upfront if in a hurry.

Soooooo good.  I've been here a ton and have gotten everything from vegetables to wine racks to bottomless hot chocolate...that's right...bottomless...for a dollar.  The Amish are a wonderful thing.  Great for a lunch date and study session.

So it looks like I'm not the first to write about this but what is going on with their service??  I made reservations with a large group last weekend. They didn't have our table set up when we arrived but even more so was the cold, borderline rudeness of the staff when we entered. No warm welcome or exchange of pleasantries. Then dinner--food was good but service was terrible.  There was a long, long wait between appetizers and entrees. Not once did any waiter check up on us or ask how we were doing. We complained about the wait several times and there was no apologies at all. One of my friend's dishes never came despite her asking about it several times. At the end of the night we received our bill without any sort of nice "thanks for coming" or anything, just a drop of the check on the table. It was a weird and unpleasant experience. Again the food is good but there are a lot of amazing restaurants in the neighborhood. There is no reason to visit a place that treats people this way. I also sent a follow up email to the owners to explain my feelings and never received a response. I guess that pretty much sums it up.
im from dc came to visit a day yelped places to go ended up at wishbone....loved it the wings biscuits mac and cheese on a next level... #travelchannelworthy a must vist when in philly

I got the Alexis Prime Rib & it had no taste! & I eat my steak rare/medium rare which usually has the most flavor but unfortunately it had ZERO seasoning! The garlic mashed potatoes were AMAZING though!!! & the onion soup was pretty decent.  Oh & the booths were AWFUL!!! You sink down and end up on top of springs when you sit, plus there's the added bonus of every time the person in the booth behind you leans forward or back, so do you!!! However the service & atmosphere were pleasant & friendly which helped to make up for the shortcomings. Oh & did I mention the garlic mashed potatoes were amazing?!?!

Ofrenda is one of the best Mexican restaurants in the city!!! Great selection of tekila!!! The service is what make my nite!! From mg to busboys !!! Oh. Mg send a complementary shots of tequila at the end of the meal!!!! I can't wait to come back!!!

Ive been coming here for a few years now, and haven't been dissapointed yet. The Burger melts in your mouth (order it medium rare people!) They also have one of my favorite beers on tap (Old Speckle Hen) which is hard to come by. Ive also had the Branzino here, which i ordered by mistake one night. One of the best mistakes i could have made. If I ever stray away from the burger, I'll be sure to write about it.
A disappointment. The soup dumplings weren't as good as ones I've had at other places for cheaper prices. Also had the kung pao chicken which was subpar at best.

Dumplings were okay. Not bad. The dough was kind of think for dumplings. Usually the thiner ones are better. Service is terrible. Took 30 minutes for my dumplings to be ready even though there were only 2 people in front of me on line. Tables should have been cleaned. Over-hyped restaurant

If cheap is all you care about, then you should go here. If you want consistent quality and good service from an owner who cares--absolutely do not go here.  There should be an option for ZERO stars. My family and I have been coming to Gina's for a long time, but tonight was the last time I will ever come back.   We always come for the two slice special.  Why? Partly (very partly) because of the price, but mainly for the quality and experience. The last several times we've come, we've noticed the pizza is vastly different every time.  Sometimes big, sometimes half as big, sometimes right amount of cheese, a lot of times hardly any cheese.  In the same sitting with four people, you'll find the slice size and quality is all over the place--literally some slices half as big as the others, with half as much cheese. Tonight, I decided to bring it up to the owner.  When you buy a product, it's good to know you're going to get the same thing every time.  Especially when they continue to charge you the same price every time.  When I suggested they work on their consistency, the owner was incredibly rude and said if you don't like what I have to serve, "get out!"  "Where else can you find a cheaper pizza." Mr. Owner, that's not my point.  I don't really care if you have the cheapest pizza in town.  I'm asking that you be consistent with your product, quality and experience--especially since you charge me the same price every time.  If you're going to give me a $.99 experience, at least tell me you're giving me that and don't charge me more than $.99.  This isn't about affordability--it's about consistency.  Next time I want a .$30 experience, believe me, I'll go to the .$30 store.   If you don't care about consistent quality and just want some good, big, cheap pizza, that probably won't be the same way when you go back the second, third  or fourth time, even though you'll still be charged the same price--then go for it.   If you want to patronize an owner that is cocky and rude to his customers and doesn't care what his customers think because he's so hung up on the fact that he serves "the cheapest pizza in town" and has no idea what consistent quality and service mean--then, go for it! ZERO stars.

Coney Island is more than a restaurant. They have great food and it's halal/kosher meaning no pork and no alcohol served. They have a great selection of natural, organic products. They sell Honey, Shea Butter, Incense and the even do wholesale. Which is great who wants to go to the city when they have a lot of great items there. (Incense, Oils, Bukhoor, African black soap, etc) They are almost always crowded but it is worth the trip.

Holy cow - what a DELIGHTFUL find while traveling in the Burlington area!  Imagine our surprise to find that this well-rated pizza joint is situated adjacent to a gas station, ostensibly in what would've been retail or storage space in the past.  We're suckers for artisan pizza, and thought we must have misread something when we pulled into the parking lot.  Truly, the quality of the 'za does NOT match the exterior.  Don't be afraid, walk right in and order! A myriad of toppings/combos to delight in.  All ingredients were fresh, flavorful.  The crust is delicious - hand tossed, thin and tender.    Super-friendly service to boot.  And priced so reasonably we had to do a double take! We popped in for the first time during UVM orientation in June.  It was so good, we couldn't WAIT to get back when we moved the Kid into the dorms in August!

Though a bit pricier than most places around brooklyn, this is one of the most consistent places for brunch or dinner in the area. A nice space, good service.  The menu is straight forward contemporary american, and the ingredients and quality of preparation are tops. have been here several times, for lunch and dinner, and never had a bad meal.  would definitely return.
Very tasty, a must if you want to try something different and get the V.I.P. treatment! Very friendly staff and will definitely  be coming back again!!

My friend and I tried the crepe, the chicken curry, and the fish marinated with turmeric dish. We are both Vietnamese and thought that the dishes were neither authentic nor good tasting. For example, the fish dish didn't have dill, which is the defining ingredient of that dish. The fish was deep fried and crusted while it is supposed to be soft.The chicken curry sauce was too salty and the flavors weren't balanced. Even the fish dipping sauce didn't taste right - lacking in sweet and sour flavors. The only thing I was happy with was that ingredients were fresh (and the limeade with basil seeds was very good). Prices were high but not a source of complaint for me because I know fresh ingredients cost. In short, this food only tastes good to people with limited experience with Vietnamese food and can be easily blown away by our fish caramel sauce or fresh herbs. You can buy the Vietnamese home cooking cook book by Charles Phan and cook much better food at home, honestly.
short rib tacos were AMAZING! this appetizer is a must, not spicy but flavorful. taco shell is unique too- very light and airy.

Have driven past this restaurant numerous times so my hubby and I finally decided to try it. What a great dining experience. The food was delicious!  The service was even better. We both ordered steaks that came with a choice of complimentary sauce. The red wine sauce was a great accompaniment. We will definitely be back.

Just left there with my mother. Sat for 20 mins watching one waiter take the orders of 3 other parties thst came in after us. In this 20 mins no one came to our table. No drinks nothing. We eat some free chips and left. We were completely ignored. It's too bad because the food is great.

F**KING Awesome! OPA! One of the best Greek restaurant's I've ever had the pleasure of dining at in America. This is equal to sitting on of the rooftop bars in Athens that face the Acropolis. We started off with loaf of bread served prior to meal which was wonderful and exploded with taste of oregano. Then in order out meal arrived. Greek salad followed by grilled octopus ( just like in the village, I was in heaven ) then chicken souvlaki and Greek lemon potato's just like mom makes. Your not going to find a better meal outside of Mom's cooking then this place. Frank gives it a double THUMBS UP and can't wait to go back!

It was gud. The mixed dip platter was exceptional. It wasn't too garlicky and it was so flavorful! The bread was so moist and warm and it came wrapped up in a cute little cloth. The dessert though was the best part. There's this awesome pudding with almonds and nuts, and I think there was some cinnamon in it too. They make fresh mint tea when you order, and fresh Turkish coffee. They tell you the history of the coffee, and try make it right I front of your eyes! I'm defiantly go ing back there, and In bringing all my friends and family too. They have plenty of room, and They even host parties.

I arrived with my wife one summer afternoon. The place was packed. We did not have reservations and the hostess said it would be about an hour wait, so we left and had a drink at another bar. We came back to see if space was available at the bar and it was still full, but the hostess remembered us and said wait here a few minutes because she knew people were about to leave the bar. So we did and it was worth the wait.   We were then greeted by the Bartender who was very nice and knowledgable. He made some great recommendations for us for drinks and appetizers. We like the open kitchen aspect and the fact that the head chef was on top of things. We had a sampler  platter of oysters recommended by the bartender which was spot-on. My wife ordered the smoked salmon which she very much enjoyed,and she's a tough critic when it comes to seafood. I had the scallops which were also very good and the crab cake which was ok. Over all I was very satisfied with our experience here and will definitly be returning.

Never had Georigan food before. Was very good. I was drawn in by the dough boat filled with melted cheese, butter and poached egg. It was excellent but better shared with friends than on your own. Grilled eggplant was delicious and pork skewer was juicy. Would happily go back.
Sadly after hearing raving reviews from my girlfriend and her daughter I found it to be mediocre.   The service was great, but the food was basic diner food at best.

My oh my ! After dining with blend on the water, I just had to go out of my way to get a yelp and let the world know what they have been missing ! FIRST AND FOR MOST, the time and effort this place puts in to making your stay memorable is beyond me.... It was my birthday, and they made a special birthday card just for me! Not only that, the food is scrumptious ! So much so I had to tell my server Felicia (whom had awesome recommendations) to give my compliments to the chef! And before departure I got the chance to personally thank Chef Nelson for my meal as he came out to thank me for dining with this fine establishment ! We had the arepas and the corn to start, truly one of a kind appetizers to say the least! We also had the red snapper which was phenomenal! The salmon burger exceeded my expectations for a burger! Truly blew me away with the chicken fried rice ! I'm a big fan of spicy and it had a delicious and perfectly spiced jalapeño sauce to compliment the dish ! As if that wasn't enough, we had dessert despite how stuffed we were-- the dessert platter is out of this world ! Not only that, they got the whole staff to song happy birthday which made me a little teary eyed as I never really celebrated my birthday in the past. It was truly a magical evening! I can't wait to come back... THANK YOU FELICIA AND THE REST OF THE STAFF AT BLEND ON THE WATER FOR THE IMPECCABLE AND VERY ATTENTIVE SERVICE ! You filled my night with laughter and joy and my family and I really appreciate the energy !   Ps. Please get a frozen piña colada soon !! :)  I love the happy hour special, but the blender at blend is a must ! ;)
good food I tried drunken noodle and the green curry rice both are so good! It is surprise to have such a good Thai restaurant in Bloomfield ;)

After hearing decent reviews, I convinced my friends to go here for dinner on a Friday night. It took 20 minutes to get menus and water after sitting down. The fried artichokes were unfortunate and bland. The pizza was grossly overpriced and typical at best. Upon ordering a Ketel martini I received something that tasted like dirty water. But, overall, the most disappointing experience was the service. Slow and apathetic. Also, their phone number is disconnected... I suggest to avoid this place.
Four stars because its too crowded but the unlimited sangrias and great food, kind of makes up for it.

Got rodizio at lunch.  What yurned my friend and I on to this place was the wood fired grille.  Gave great flavor to the meat!  You can't beat & $20 each for all you can eat rodizio and the amazing salad bar.

I heard about the grand opening from my coworker so we went by together and they had an amazing variety of foods. My coworker and I went recently after work and there's no doubt, Room 55 has the best tasting white wine sangria. I definitely recommend this place for some great food. I will be stopping by really soon with my girlfriend.
Really delicious food, super affordable prices!! Will definitely be back and would recommend checking it out!
Fantastic food with friendly service. Loved our dinner and will return when we're in the area.

So this was our first time to table 87 and well we absolutely enjoyed ourselves our server Jason was knowledgeable and kind. The food was delicious and timely. The only strange thing was the restroom! Great food great service!

Red Robin is awesome! I don't get the reviews of these other commentators regarding the pricing!! You're getting great size burgers with amazing selections regarding burger creativity and delicious bottomless steak fries. You pay more when you go to McDonald's/Burger King!! So seriously lets not be unrealistic here. Some waiters may not be all knowing but that's typical when they are new, so give them a break! I've been here often and will continue to go and the service is great, the food is awesome and the general manager Scott is very accommodating. Our server today is Barbara and she's the sweetest thing. I give it 5 stars because I've never had a bad experience .
Best lunch I've had in a long time.  $12 huge plate of pork & clams with great bread, glass of wine, and coffee.  Worth the walk from Penn Station, hopefully I'll get back soon.

We stopped for lunch on Sep 13. We were in the Princeton area for a wedding. I don't think we've eaten at a place where the chef gave so much thought to what he was serving. My wife had the lobster roll, which she liked more than others she's had because there were meaty pieces of lobster without too much mayo spoiling the taste. She also had the chocolate cake which she loved! I had the market salad (kale, cauliflower and red onion with pieces of grilled chicken). Our waitress was a delight. If you are in Princeton, this is the place to go!

So when the word cheap is used as the first adjective in most reviews regarding food then it usually means the food is probably not that great but the cheap factor somehow adds flavor to the meal. So if you want cheap with a neat feel to a place this is the place to be. If you are actually looking for good food pay a little more and you will get it elsewhere. I would suggest a coffee and cookie during the slower hours on a rainy day but that's about it

So where do I start! I love love love this place.. Amazing food. Rocco head chef and owner is always so nice. Comes over and thanks us all the time for our visit! Food and drinks are delicious. Never a disappointment when coming to lincontro
Great place! Looks amazing inside and the food is good!

Place was packed - friday night crowd, so we ate at the outside bar- which worked out perfectly.  food good ! escarole and beans soup was very good, Broccoli rabe and porchetta also very tasty -  I'm planning on returning to try the stuffed meatball, that looked excellent.
Nice place, I especially liked the smell of wood. we came here yesterday and ordered the braised lamb pizza- delicious! Service was friendly and quick.

My girlfriend called in a to go order to pick up after an appointment today for out dinner. I asked for pork sand which add cheddar hold coleslaw. She knows the drill. Came home with food, I looked in the bag, opened my boa up and nasty looking sandwich without cheddar and full of coleslaw. The receipt even showed as I ordered, add cheddar, hold slaw. I was so hopeful for this place and wanted to try the burger people rave about eventually, but I refuse to ever go back now on principle because they couldn't get a simple order right. My girlfriend did say the hostess was very speedy and polite though, so credit to her. Good dog? Bad dog, you and your disobedient kitchen are now dead to me forever

Probably one of the worst places to order food from. I have eaten in the restaurant and had delivery (which never arrived). A few things to note: 1. The food is mediocre at best - and to top it off leaves you with an upset stomach. 2. They mixed up my order through grubhub and I did not receive my food despite being charged. 3. The staff are extremely rude - the manager hung up on me when I asked for my money back Dont eat at this place, there are far better (and healthier) places in Philly. I would give it zero if I could
Not impressed. Veggie burger was mostly breading and my fries were burnt. My husband described his huevos rancheros as weird. Would not come back for food. Yuck.

This place is not worth the wait or the money. I just went there tonight and was seated at 6pm and did not have my meal at my table until 8pm. We started out with there eggplant appetizer which to 30 mins to come out and it was soggy and warm at best. Then they proud the soup I ordered and it was full of grease and a few vegetables. Finally my pasta dish came out it had 3 pieces of chicken in it and covered in oil as you can see by the pics I have posted. After all this and sending my dish back it was still covered In oil and had no flavor. To top it off my coffee never got refilled and my water glass was empty more then half the time and I asked 3 times before they filled my water. Just bag

Came in here on Monday night after going to their competitor around the corner, Cavanaughs Rittenhouse. The server was not only friendly and out going, she provided phenomenal service.  She checked on me before my beer hit the bottom of my glass, made sure my food was okay, and I wasn't waiting for a menu or a check for more than I needed to. The food was decent. Had I decided to wait at Cavanaughs, I would have probably been still waiting on my menu by the time I was already finished at the Wrap Shack. Anyone who goes here and has a choice of server, I recommend "princess patel", as the receipt states.

I've been here a few times.  The first time was 5 years ago on New Years Day.  We were actually hoping to eat at Joe's Pizza but they were closed for New Years.  Luckily, we stumbled upon Lombardi's - then remembered we had heard of it for being the first pizzeria in the US!  We were a party of 4, and got 2 large Margherita pies.   It was so delicious, that two of us had to eat more - and we ordered another small Margherita.  Hahaha.  I think I went back again a year or so ago, and remember the food being pretty good again. Unfortunately, I came back here with a friend this summer.  We ordered a small Margherita pie - first off, wasn't enough food for the two of us - we should've gotten a large.  That was our bad though, guess we didn't realize we were so hungry.  But the pizza was a TOTAL letdown this time - it was so soggy for the whole middle part of the pie.  I want to say the whole center was soggy at least halfway to the crust.  Also, service is pretty nonexistent.
SO good! The dumplings are always fresh and ridiculously cheap. The place definitely looks like a hole in the wall (with minimal seating), but the food is delicious. Highly recommended.

I've been going here for about 10 years. This is seriously the best Italian restaurant ever. Really, it's the best restaurant. Small and cozy. Yes, you feel like you're sitting in your family dining room...that's the charm of it. I have a hard time not ordering the same thing because I love it. Mussels with linguini. I've had the chicken Milanese which is amazing and also the roasted pork. Not a bad thing on this homemade menu...homemade food and homemade menu. This adds to the charm of the place. Angelina is the owner, cook and her son is the waiter. I love the relationship between them and it does feel like you're at Sunday dinner...if your were in an Italian home (which I'm not and that makes me love it all the more!) Fresh cannoli at the end if you can even possibly stuff them in. We've drunk them out of wine twice and John Paul had to run to the store to get us more. How much better service can you even ask for? We literally bring Tupperware to take our leftovers back to Pittsburgh. I didn't even want to write this review because I want to keep this place all to myself.
Worst service ever. We were ignored for an hour. Asked a busboy for a waiter. None came. When we walked out no one noticed!

This place has so much potential. The food was great! I didn't get to eat anything since I had to cancel my order due to the incredible wait, but I tried my friends burger which was really tasty, and the fries were cooked in truffle oil and were super delicious. The music was fun, the atmosphere was nice. The beer selection was great, but their service was horrific. My friends waited over an hour for food. We ordered an unlimited brunch deal and my friends got literally 2 drinks in 2 hours. Staff moved with no sense of urgency. Come on this is New York!!!! Others around us looked like they were having similar problems if not worse. The manager came around to every table with complaints. Oh, PS, our server told us he was drunk. Which is odd since it took us an hour to get one drink.

They're one of the only restaurants open late in not the best neighborhood. I was fully expecting a meal I might regret but it was surprisingly good. The Singapore noodles were solid, they were generously sized and they were piping hot. A surprisingly good meal.

Good consistently cold beers to choose from on tap. Bacon wrapped chicken bites were delicious! The prices are way to high for the area and the amount of food you are receiving. The burger tasted like a frozen patty. Service downstairs is better than upstairs.
Awesome pizza - best quality, flavor and prices around.  Quick delivery and friendly service.  Go Prime Time!

The chicken and red velvet waffle meal was banging!! I recommend it for dates and if you just wanna taste some good down south kinda food, service was good and we got our food kinda quick, and the sangria was on point

Burgers are delicious make sure to ask questions if in doubt abut ordering your meal? dessert not bad, service great music was not the best in my opinion,the place is need and clean they are very serviceable the rest of the other people's meals at my table they looked like it was going to be a good   birthday  lunch, everybody was happy at least this time so far anyways this place has good food but is a bit pricy be ready to spend $$$ in there God lunch with family and friends after all Whoop! Whoop! Juggalos Happy meals....!!!! ;))

Went in for cocktails and snacks- was told that they are out of their small plates because their "tapas" were being saved for next week, since they were almost out? I mean- sure, things like Dolmas and anchovies last, but come on guys- I'll just go to Parrot Market and get you some if you're really that hard up on small plates! Or just simply don't offer the small plates menu on weekends? How about that? They got two stars because the bartender was nice and attentive, even though the obnoxious people next to us would scream drink orders at him every time he stopped over to check on us. Also: side note: this isn't a sports bar. Loud drunken antics at 6pm (even though it may be Saturday) are not welcome, or appreciated. This wasn't the restaurants fault at all, but it is worthwhile to point out the type of douchebaggary that comes to this place.
Very good ramen!

Jeepney is the truth. Everything we ate was delicious and the drinks were great as well. We had the tacos and bone marrow apps with the garlic rice as well as the duck egg. Tacos were my favorite and the garlic rice was amazing both with the bone marrow and on its own. We had the pork entree as well as the potato and sausage dish. Both were super tasty. The skew towards sweet due to the coconut. Didn't bother me but some might not enjoy it as much. Deffinitley coming back.
It was ok philly is kind of slacking when it come to the cheese steak i've had better my only issue that they didnt let me mix chicken and steak
Good family spot!

Good quick device. One of us had the Mini bites which were very good. Moist and crisp. You can actually get a heathy meal. Had the buffalo wrap with the grilled chicken and a bit of blue cheese on the side. I recommend it!

Go for the drinks and starters and not for the main course. The drinks were outstanding, we each had a muddled drink and shared the hot potato chips which were great. However, our main course was extremely bland. The atmosphere is full of life and extremely loud.

Fantastic bar. I actually created a Yelp account just now because I felt I needed to give Swift a positive Review. Went here after class at NYU on a Thursday night with classmates. It's the perfect bar for having conversation: music that isn't too loud, darker lighting, and no TVs showing sports games. It's the perfect place to go to have a a relaxing drink and nice conversation with a group of friends, and a great place for a first date. It's the type of bar you'd walk into and feel relaxed ordering a beer on your own.
Awesome Philly cheese steak here.  My favorite.

Delicious!!!!! harira soup - amazing start of meal the tomato and lime opens up the appetite Seafood bastilla - savory puff pastry stuffed with shrimp and squid mouth watering!!! Olive Chicken with lemon targine - tangy and savory chicken falls off the bone!! Coming back again everything was so amazing we finished everything!
Great food, spicy shrimp amazing, Crab BLT excellent. Portions could be a little bigger

a go to take out place in park slope.  great bahn mi and the summer role appetizer is very tasty. a cut above.  prefer the sandwiches here above the local competition, which we have tried.  the place also has pho, which hits the spot when you get the jones.  they deliver and are usually pretty quick

Every Yelp review mentions the Rabbit... Yet it seems they have removed it from the menu as of at least September 2015. Total letdown. Everything else was relatively overpriced and mediocre tasting. Throw in some snotty service and you get yourself a 2 star review.

I came here for a friend's birthday and had a good time. Music was decent, but starts to feel repetitive after some time. Staff was friendly and got all of our orders correct considering the size of our group. Food was pretty good and decently priced. We got there around 9pm on a Saturday and found plenty of parking and didn't have to pay to get in, but upon leaving I noticed that men paid $10 to get in! On top of that it was $10 for valet and you had no choice because if you don't park valet you're probably parking in the nearest neighborhood which means having to cross a major highway by foot. That's $20 spent before even taking your jacket off! Luckily I didn't experience that nonsense because then this rating would be at 2 stars instead of 4.
too sweet.

Our dinner order arrived quickly, and the food was still warm. Everything was delicious. As a large group, we were able to sample several dishes. The starters: the Guac is great, so are the chips. Make sure you also order the tasty ceviche-like shrimp dip, which is amazing. As main dishes we had a little bit of everything. The salmon and the sauce it comes with are outstanding. So is the shrimp taco, which I particularly enjoyed. I also loved the Tinga burrito. Really, all dishes tasted great. And all this at an absolutely moderate price. Now I have to try items from the brunch menu... Highly recommend this place.

We just stumbled on this place and I'm glad we did. I ordered the bacon wrapped jalapeño dog and a cup mint lemonade. The food was great but I could of easily stayed and drank the lemonade all night, it was AMAZING. Breakfast looked delicious, with 3 more days in the city we may go back!
Great burgers, great people. Lots of interesting sauces and toppings. Burgers were seasoned well and cooked well. Eat here.
Simply the best. The Vegetarian Special is the best anywhere. Try it and see. Their salad is perfect too.
Don't miss the Sicilian slices @ Mr. Bruno's ... Perfect! The dinning area is clean and spacious. The staff very friendly. Glad they are in the Rutherford area.
It's really delicious! If I will go back to NY, I will go there again for their hot pot!
Owners and waiters are lovely, food is delicious. Some favorites: Nachos with pork, Cowboy burrito, durango pork chops!

Worst experience--ever! Went to the Monk Room for  the first and  last time for lunch. We were seated outside, which is fine as it was 12:40 when we arrived. So we were seated in the alley at small plastic round tables that really are not conducive to eating lunch but that was fine. The waiter came out and brought us water and Took our drink orders and. came back with drinks in about five minutes-- so all seemed well. Then the waiter disappeared --after about 15 minutes  one of my colleagues got up and walked into the restaurant to get him and let him know that we were ready to order --five minutes later he came by to take  our order -- it was then that he informed us that they were out of bread and therefore we could not order sandwiches -this really limited our options. So, at one o'clock in the afternoon on Friday, the restaurant runs out of bread!
