A very cool space.   I was there on a sunday so there so no live music but i could imagine this place would swing on a friday or saturday.   I may go back but not make a special trip there.   The BBQ is okay,  just okay.  Nothing to rave about.  Ive had better, and worse.   The Baby Back Ribs were good, but could have used more seasoning.   I don't like to have to add sauce to everything i am eating.   The Brisket was ok, not great.  Tender but lacked taste and salt.  ZERO salt.  It was a bit dry, but that could be due to the hour of my eating, 8pm on sunday, they close at 9pm. so there was not a lot of meat left by the end of the night.     The sides were just ok.  Baked beans with burnt ends was the highlight.  Plenty of burnt ends in it.  No mac-n-cheese, they had run out.   The cole slaw seemed to be commercial and not home made,  bland and very white, no red cabbage, no carrots.   My friend had a Strawberry Moonshine that was really good,  great taste and fresh strawberry.   The hot chicken wings were good, but could have been spicier.     Overall a decent experience but also a bit pricy for the quality.  I never mind paying top dollar if the bbq is outstanding.   So far no BBQ joint in NYC has surpassed Hill Country BBQ.  But I will keep searching and eating.     I would go back again if i was in Brooklyn, but wouldn't make a special trip there again.

Great place to grab any meal! I love the option of having breakfast throughout the day. Their mozzarella grill cheese with tomato and bacon is delicious! At $4.95 you can't go wrong. I never have to wait long to be seated, and the staff is always friendly. It's a great place to eat with the family   and not empty out your wallet. It's has the feel of a mom and pop restaurant with all the bells and whistles from a chain restaurant.

Great food and confortable ambiance. It was the perfect place for a relaxing dinner with a friend. Staff was attentive and suggested great choices for dinner. It takes you back to the local bistro setting of an old Paris neighborhood like St Germain... It's not about the over the top scene and decor; it's about the well prepared food!

Service was mediocre at best. Took 15 minutes for us to even get someown to ask us for water. More a hippie vibe I wouldnt go here if you were hungry cause itd take forever to get an order in. Other than the service the food was ok ot was super good but it was good. Didnt make up for the bad service. I liked the bathroom though it was downstairs and had a chalkboard where you could write on it. I thought that was pretty cool.

Rude.  Parking requires that you pay the meter. Asked the server for change for the meter and he said no. I said that I "planned to eat here" and he did not answer.  I left based on that and the poor seating arrangements.  I was dressed in professional attire.  Unbelievable.

I have dined here twice before and I was happy with my meal. So I jumped at the chance for a groupon deal.  I called on a Saturday 11:30am and made a reservation for 5:30 on Sunday evening. I made sure to Say that I had a groupon and everything was set for Sunday.  My friend and I arrive at the restaurant and they cannot find our reservation but seat us anyway. I tell the hostess that I specifically made a reservation since it was a groupon. she says it's restaurant week so they are not accepting groupons.  But she will check with the manager. Now I feel that's reservation was deleted BECAUSE it was a groupon. The manager tells me they won't accept it and I explain to hime disappointment and that I feel that is bad business practices since I made the reservation like explained in groupon. Very disappointed and we decided to eat somewhere else. I drove 45 minutes away to enjoy this groupon with friends. The manager could have been more accommodating.

It's so bad...I almost fell asleep on the table waiting for the food, and to be served cold and burned pizza in the end ! It's a Monday night 8:30, we were seated right away. We ordered 2 pizza and waited over 30 min for the food. When they finally arrived, they didn't feel like they were just out of the oven, they were cold and soggy...They were probably sitting by the counter for a while waiting for the staff to pick up. They were pretty burned too, the table next to us also found that pretty burned that they basically didn't eat the rim. I remember we had better experience the first time we came to this restaurant ...Maybe next time ...

Given that there are only 2 places to sit down and eat at in this wing of the airport, it seems that this is the favorable choice for breakfast since there are a significant amount of more options to choose from on the menu than it's competitor (Ruby Tuesdays). While the food itself was good (bacon, egg, and cheddar omelet) the service itself was some of the worst I have had in a while. We were not acknowledged and waited well over 10 minutes to be greeted at the table. The order was clearly stated and served wrong. We were still charged the full price for the meal even though I didn't get mine until my girlfriend was done eating her own. All in all, the food is not bad at all, but this place is not for you if you're pretty stiff and judgmental about the service staff.

Food was OK, service/delivery was terrible.  Ordered carry-out in the store (3 plain fingers, 1 general tso, 1 buffalo/maple, 1 salted caramel, truffle fries and 2 sauces).  When we arrived home, the 3 plain crunchy fingers were missing from the bag.  Called to request they be delivered (I live 2 blocks away) and they promised to send them.  Over an hour later, nothing has arrived, no phone call, no refund.   The 3 fingers we did receive were OK, but not amazing.  Way better cheap eats in the area (is it still cheap when you pay for two meals but receive 1?) with better service--highly recommended to look elsewhere. UPDATE:  Manager contacted me the next day to apologize, commiserate and offer a refund/credit for next visit.  Two more stars for great follow-up!

Incredible food and a festive atmosphere. Without a doubt one of the best meals I have had in a long time. Every dish was delicious and the menu caters to all tastes. Special mention to the cavatelli which was the standout. The standard of service was also impeccable which just added to the great experience! Looking forward to becoming a regular.

I recently went here for a birthday dinner with my girlfriend and a bunch of my friends. We were a group of 10 and were seated at 6:30pm. They brought out our dinners cold and not all at once. Some of us had to wait long periods of time before they received their meals. I ordered a cheeseburger and when everyone started to receive their dinners the waiter told me that they ran out of hamburger meat and if I wanted to change my order. I don't understand how a restaurant could finally realize they were our of hamburger meat by the time they were serving everyone else's dinner. I wouldn't have cared I'd they told me this sooner but the fact that they didn't know until everyone else began being served as disgraceful and poor management. I had to wait even longer to get my meal. Throughout our stay there there were multiple times they ran out of stuff we wanted and was only find last minute. They didn't even look to offer us anything to take care of the cold dinners and for me waiting to get my new dinner so when we complained they offered us a a round of drinks for free. After having cold food, having people wait to get their meals instead of everyone being able to eat together pls being told lay minute of by the way we're out of hamburger meat it really wasn't a good way to fix the problem. I would never recommended this place and works instead make sure I know never goes there so they don't experience what we all did. Not what someone would expect when going out especially when to celebrate a birthday.
This place is a classic East Village brunch spot, $10 brunch cocktails, but only $6 if you order a brunch special. On the pricier side of $$, but well worth it
i like the garlic bread
Delicious, fast on the go, cheap medditeranean food
Fantastic food.   Great prices.   Excellent service.  Only issue?  Super tiny single bathroom.

best hotpot spot in sunset park! esp love the wine chicken~ def need to make reservations. they also have great holiday themed decors...fav was halloween decor esp the fact that they are located next to a funeral home.

The service was quick and friendly. I went in with my boyfriend to this restaurant two times I live in the area and always saw a line to get in. On a not so busy day my boyfriend and I decided to give it a try. The food was terrible, I could not believe people actually waited in line to eat at this place. The food was COLD, undercooked and extremely blan. Over priced for what you get, staff was very I'm the sh*t f* ck you. Asked to get warm food second batch was cold if it weren't for me rushing to the hospital for appendasitis I would of thrown a huge fit. This review is for both times I attended this restaurant. Would not recommend organic doesn't have to taste like ASS!!!' I have eaten plenty of vegan and organic food and it doesn't taste as bad or as bland as this place.

I'm new in NY and Honest Chops is the first butcher that I tried, first for the grass fed because I follow the Paleo Diet, second for the halal (I'm not muslim but I find this hand-slaughter practice more respectful and correct than the rest of options), and third is near my home. After my first visit, and tasted their meat, definitely is My butcher. Professional, respectful and polite, clean, and the meat is superb, you feel the naturalness from the cooking to the eating. Also do home delivery, then, you have not excuse for not give it a try, if you are in search of a real natural meat, do it, you will be enthusiastic.
Everything from the service to the food was absolutely fantastic. I love this gem.
Super good! A friend suggested it to me, but I have to say I'm not usually the Spanish food type. But it was definitely worth the trip! Next time I'm in the mood for burritos, I'll be there!
Took family they were excellent,accommodating,food was very good ,service excellent .We especially enjoyed the pasta and deserts.would highly recommend

I work near Subworks and often place large sub orders to feed my staff for lunch when we are working on Saturdays.  Yesterday, I placed an order at 11:45 am to be delivered at 1:00 pm.  It was an order for 8 subs, which is smaller than the orders I usually place.  At 12:55, I received a call from Stephanie saying my order wasn't going to be ready for 1:00 pm.  I said "that's ok, how long do you think it will be?".  She put Barbara, the manager, on the phone.  Barbara proceeded to complain to me that they are too busy working on an order that was placed before mine for 40 subs and repeated that my order would not be ready.  I asked her why I wasn't told when I called that they were too busy to fill my request.  I would have called another place.  She responded with, "so do you want to cancel the order?".  Of course I had to cancel it because my staff was going to break for lunch in 5 minutes and I had no food to give them.  Barbara did not once apologize for their mistake and instead made me feel like my order was a huge inconvenience for her.  Well, I won't be ordering from or visiting Subworks ever again. Barbara won't have to worry about my orders being an inconvenience to her ever again! To the owner of Subworks, I'm sorry to inform you that you have a lousy manager who has caused you to lose future business because of her incredibly rude way of speaking to good customers.

Cash only and rude as can be. Cheesesteak was amazing and worth the abuse, but I would expect that the bad service would get old after a while. Not a great part of town. The line was all the way in the street, good thing they only take cash or the line would have been all the way to Center City.
I ordered the sampler. The portion was pretty big , came with two sides and only cost $17. def try again

My husband and I. Live in Long Island, we went there last Sunday for brunch with my son and his girl friend.  Loved it!  Food was fantastic , atmosphere - Fantastic, owner Carmelo was very welcoming!  Have already recommended it to all  my friends.  Can't  wait to go back for dinner.  Born and bred in Astoria, I am so happy to finally have a great Italian place to go!

I give this spot a five star!!! This restaurant is fab! Cozy, food is delish, and the owner went out his way to accommodate me and my party. I had originally booked the reservation for 12 people and I ended up with 19. I had an amazing bday dinner.

the great thing about this place is that you can sit outside and stare at all the characters for hours. very cozy indoors as well & they serve above average espresso. the food is too simple and boring, actually, and that's the downfall of rustico. paninis with the same repeating ingredients - it gets old after your third time here because even the first time they are just OK. nutella crepes are also OK - as expected, nothing exciting. iced coffees are def way below average, small and overpriced. bruschetta - also just OK. but come on, if that's on your already teeny-tiny menu it better be tasty and craving-inducing not just OK? ya? i mean it's bruschetta, i can make better at home on a whim. all in all, i like to come here for brunch or an evening meal with a friend when we can sit outside and chat for awhile. i come here despite the food, not because of it.
They waited over an hour to call me and tell me that they had a problem with their delivery person. I am so Hangry right now.
Perfect comfortable casual setting. Great, helpful, passionate staff. Diverse, creative and interesting menu. Wonderful, delicious food with great presentation.

I swear every time I go the food just gets better and better ! They have the best customer service and Mexican food in Bayonne hands down! I have had the privilege of going multiple times in the past few months and this is no fast food place every meal is made fresh and from scratch.
Absolutely delicious. Cute restaurant too

Travelers could count their blessings if every exit off I-91 had an eatery like the Red Barn.  Just off the interstate, everything is homemade here by the charming family that runs the business.  You can't get a more sophisticated broccoli cheddar soup anywhere.  The perfect lunch spot.

Always a fantastic experience.  Came up to visit our son and meet up with our daughter and son-in-law.  It was for a my daughter's husband's birthday celebration and I wanted to take him (them)  to what I consider one of the best.  Never disappointed.  Of course,  the food is the main thing but the staff always goes out of their way to make you feel welcome and feel very important. Staff is always there but not intrusive. What a very pleasant evening.  Look forward to coming back many times.  Total experience - to bad you can only go up to a five stars.   Jeanne L
Tasty stuff- I'm enjoying the chicken pad ew right now.

WAY over priced for what they offer. Plan on paying extra for things like jelly on toast. Don't ask for a napkin, and a credit card minimum. You are much better off going to Clair's corner copia for true food, at a reasonable price.

This place is amazing. The Little Italy is amazing and the entertainment is great. Tater tots are an added bonus. Michael isn't so bad to look at either. Outside seating allows you to enjoy the weather. Greatest grilled cheese ever and I have had a lot!!!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in New York. It's everything I am... if I was a restaurant. Simple, unassuming, seasonal and local cuisine. I started with some local IPA from New York. It was okay (I was longing for my San Diego-based Stone IPA at that point). I ordered a crispy kale salad with smoked bacon and pine nuts. It was a decent starter, but I felt like I could get this at other places. I followed that up with a roasted bone marrow croque, which was actually a very very nice dish. The richness of the bone barrow was complimented nicely with the overly crunchy piece of toast. If I came again, I'd probably order the burger as everyone around me was eating one, and they all looked damn delicious. I think I am going to have to start making regular return visits to this lovely establishment. It wassimply that good.
Pizza is great I miss the fact the we don't have a Verona pizza in town anymore but borinos is still great. The employees are very nice and it's a great atmosphere
Great food and excellent service, but very disappointing and inconvenient that they only take cash.and.no credit cards. To management please pay the darn fees and make life easier for your patrons.

I love Paprika!  My friend who went to NYU introduced me to this Lower East Side restaurant a few years ago and I have returned many times.  Paprika offers great food at decent prices, and for that, it is a Manhattan treasure.   The flavors were unique and delicious.  We had a roasted baby beet with ricotta and honey salad, garlic wine mussels (which i passed on but the sauce was great) and an antipasto platter where the meats were delicious. Two of us got different kind of raviolis which were very well done and not overwhelming in portions.  Two got the fettuncine with grapes, asparagus and shrimp (very yum) and the gnocchi was spot on. It's definitely a laid-back atmosphere. I'd like to go back when I have time to linger.

We tried the beef short rib, pork and Korean fried chicken tacos. Wow! They were all really yummy. I thought they were all equally good but for different reasons so definitely get a mixture to try a variety. We came during a slow lull on a sunny Monday afternoon. Really nice guy behind the counter and no wait for tables!

I used to order meals and pizza from Joey's all the time,  even had them cater a party.  Their food was always excellent. It had been awhile since I had ordered an entree.  A couple weeks ago we ordered pizza,  penny vodka,  fettuccine alfredo,  and a pepperoni bread.  The two pasta dishes were actually inedible.  I called and they said they were very unusually busy on a Thursday.  Everyone can have an off night,  and that's totally ok.  I asked her to take the two pasta dishes back and refund the money for them and she gave me an attitude asking if we ate them.  No,  we didn't... If they were even kind of bad I wouldn't have called,  but they were inedible.  I was afraid to have new dishes because I didn't want them to send the same food.  They didn't want to refund the money,  so they sent the exact same dishes,  but they added pepper to the alfredo.  Both dishes went straight into the garbage.  Unfortunately,  after this,  I wouldn't risk wasting more time and money and I really didn't appreciate the attitude. I'm not sure what happened to them :(

placed an order at 6:53PM.  Called at 8:32PM to cancel my order.  I did explain to them that the food would be cold even if it did arrive within the next few minutes and that I am not interested in eating cold, soggy food.  The lady on the phone was very apologetic and sincere.  The driver called me two minutes later and told me he was "close" to Jersey City and asked if I still wanted the food.  I told him, "no thank you" and he too was very aplogetic.  For the love of everything modern, get a real online menu, a working website with the ability to order online, and hire a manager who checks Yelp and makes an effort to rectify some of these mistakes!!!  You're a freaking business,  Act like it!

Candela is GREAT. Yes the portions aren't huge, but that's because it's tapas! The dishes are prepared perfectly, the balance of flavors and freshness of ingredients can't be beat. My husband and I purposely ordered what would satiate us (and we love being able to taste of bunch things in lieu of just two courses)... our bill was within $5. of the two dinners we had at the Pine Restaurant at the Hanover Inn, and we felt, the food was by far much more interesting at Candela. We also liked knowing we were helping out independent entrepreneurs and contributing to the local economy. I mean let's face it, the Hanover Inn and the Pine are owned by the college... neither is ever going anywhere! We genuinely felt like the owner and staff were trying really hard to everyone a great experience. Perhaps the more casual ambiance as compared to the Pine might be throwing off some of those that are complaining of the price.

I've been to Michael's Riverside for a bridal shower and graduation party and thought it would be the perfect place for my wedding rehearsal.  I had my rehearsal dinner there on 6/19 and the foot and service was excellent!!!  Highly recommend!!! :D

I decided to do a happy hour here after work on a Thursday with about 40-50 co-workers. The place was more then spacious enough to accommodate such a group. Rob and Star made sure everyone in the group were treated well and even went as far as working with us on giving a little more time for the happy hour. Then last minute we decided to get some platters, which for a big group are usually preordered. The order was filled and brought out within minutes. Everyone had an incredible time. If I can only add one thing it is that the seating in the back can be a little awkward with the location of the kitchen doors. Overall an A+ work by the team and a beautiful spot to hang out any day of the week. Good luck guys!

I had dinner at this place and staff is very nice and friendly. The food came how we asked. We left full and happy . It's good to call and to make a reservation because we had to wait about 10 min till when they could sit us, but was a good idea that we waited.

It's a small place with two floors. The decor is really interesting. The service was impeccable. However, the food was average. I had the salmon burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was just ok.  A little too mushy for my taste.  It fell apart and off the roll as I tried to eat it. The fries were perfectly done. My husband had the smoked beef brisket sandwich. There was practically no meat on the sandwich (about 3 slices). It was extremely thin and for some reason it was pressed like a Panini. Way over priced at $13. He was still hungry when we finished our meals. We didn't hate it but with so many other restaurants to try in Philly we won't be back.
Came here for lunch, the set up is warming and waiters were attentive, bit too much. We ordered calamari and char and sea bass, which were delicious if you are fish lover. Definitely place to go.

Artichoke is the best. Their artichoke pizza is amazing and arguably the best I've had in the city. It's unlike anything I've had. I could eat it any time of the day, and it's especially great for those late night pizza cravings since they open til 4 AM. Their slices are huge which justifies the $5 price. Can't recommend it enough! Make sure to bring cash and a big appetite.

I FRIGGIN LOVE BUDDAKAN!! I've been there about 5 times, the most recent time was this past Friday for Restaurant Week. My word they ALWAYS get it right. Firstly, the atmosphere/ambiance is fabulous. It is dimly lit but decorated in a tasteful, zen style centered around a giant, golden Buddah. The food is always fresh and yummy. This was my first time coming during Restaurant Week so I decided to partake in their special menu. I had the Yellowtail Sashimi for an appetizer. Yummy and briny. You can taste the capers, but it's not overwhelming. For the entree I had the Short Rib Chow Fun. I love their normal Sizzling Short Rib dish, so I was really excited about trying this new iteration of their amazing, fork tender short rib. It was unctuous and soothing. Such a comfort food. For dessert I didn't deviate from the script. I got what I always get: Dip Sum Donuts. ERMAGERD! They are the best little pillows of joy on the planet. They come with three dipping sauces: chocolate ganache, ginger cream cheese and blackberry jam. Since I'm not a big fan of chocolate, I always opt for an extra helping of ginger cream cheese in lieu of the ganache. I would honestly come to Buddakan just for those dern donuts, but I highly enjoy my whole meal every time I go. Some of my favorite dishes, other than my obvious love for those Dip Sum Donuts, are: Lamb Chops Sizzling Short Rib Five Spice Duck Breast (the spoonbread pudding that comes with it is heavenly) Peking Duck Buns (YUMMM) It's a great place for a nice night out on a date or a group of people. I definitely recommend getting a pitcher of the Zengria for the table.

Food was ok but service was poor. The waitress completely overwhelmed yelling at clients and annoyed with all of us. The lady at the table next to me requested 12 blueberry muffins, she came back with one so the client said kindly I wanted 12. She rolled her eyes and said so you don't want this one? The client said I want 12. The waitress came back a few minutes later and said are you sure you want 12 they are aver two dollars each?? Wow she really didn't want to get these muffins!
I was walking by and decided to give Knife a try. I got the chicken sandwich, and it doesn't make the "cut" for me.

I'm reluctant to review this place since I love it so much, but I can no longer contain this warm and fuzzy feeling. Oh yeah, and looks like other people have gotten the word out anyway so what the heck. While at Verlaine, I had a Lemongrass Mule and Hanoi Martini. When I first got my Lemongrass Mule, the bartender asked me if I liked it just to make sure, since he said it's usually strong or too unique for people's tastes. I told him that I loved it, that I love Lemongrass (or any herb/pepper infused drinks for that matter), and that I've liked drinks with the term "mule" in it. The Hanoi Martini was also good - but nothing really different than a Lychee Martini at other similar bars. I would definitely recommend this place as a good starting point but not a good place for a large group unless you've reserved the front sofa area which was booked both nights I was there.

The Spotted Pig offers some amazingly fresh plates. I came here for brunch with my girlfriend the other day and was very pleased. The food was very good and the atmosphere was super trendy. Although the prices of the brunch drinks were a bit expensive, the food and the atmosphere makes up for it. Please check out my video review on my YouTube Channel! youtube.com/mealsandreels
Recommended by Hilton to us, just walked in to a great song playing, favorite beer (Guinness) and bartender who didn't look at us like we just rolled in to town.  Texas approved and will be back.
Very friendly indeed. The Pope Francis sandwich is yummy, the Simply Cucumber is mediocre. We also had the Monkey Biz briosh and it was a fun dessert.
We went to Thai Dishes for lunch recently and it was the BEST! Everything was so fresh and delicious -- I'm so excited to have a new great take out spot in Burlington. Can't wait to go back!
this place is the best in Astoria so far, I been there many times and I never been disappointed , fresh food and excellent atmosphere.

The Gaslight is one of the better Old City taverns enjoy from time to time. New and appealing city whiskey bar with a good cocktail menu and tap beers a plus for patrons. The menu of small plates make the experience fun. With the party of 6, we were served and treated nicely. My meal of fried chicken and cornbread was crispy, tangy hot and juicy. The apps of pickled veggies, meat balls and onion dip (pate') were perfect. Pasta dish was inventive and fresh. All out good time, butt we were there at the 5pm open, so not crowded or much of a wait. Manager and staff were always present. Come over and see.
this place is awesome i love it, and would give it 5 stars except! they only have sir kensingtons ketchup i hate sir kensingtons ketchup at least give me the option of hienz! you facists

Great pizza place for lunch, always packed, good well drinks. Pie is served in rectangular slices. Sausage may be a bit on the salty side. We ordered a couple pitchers of beer, a 10" quattro formaggi pizza, and a larger square pizza with a ton of veggie toppings.  We were in a larger party, and some of the group also ordered meatballs and pasta, which were unremarkable.  However, we came for pizza and were not disappointed!  The 10" pie was fairly typical form a crust and consistency perspective.  However, the cheese combination was outstanding! I wish that I could have had more than one piece, but the entire pie was consumed in about 10 seconds. The old fashioned pizza was delicious! I like that the crust was soft but had a nice crunch. We got mushroom and prosciutto toppings and it was a nice combo. I will definitely be back here!
This is my favourite place to eat. Hands down. I have come often from the beginning and I look to many meaty nights to come. Think I'm in love
The worst falafal sandwich ever. It is cold, and half empty. Falafal hard to find. I asked for hot and white sauce, and it is hard to find. Pita is cold and broken.

Went here for my wedding anniversary yesterday and had the most amazing time and dinner. The staff, atmosphere, food are wonderful. Definitely would recommend this place. We walked out and said to each other that we want to go back soon. Like now.

Great Pork Chop Great Salmon Great Mac n Cheese Great Brussels Sprouts only thing that could have made them better was bacon! Will try a few other things next time Maisie was an excellent server always attentive and super helpful on choices/options

I realized that in tons of reviews I had never given 5 stars. I sat down to think if there were any restaurants that I could rate 5 stars. Immediately Max Downtown came to mind. This restaurant may be very expensive, but you get what you pay for. Maybe even more than what you pay for. The food is outstanding, always cooked perfectly, and it's a delight to eat there every time. The service is second to none. I just can't say enough about EVERY item on the menu. Lobster tail, crab claws, filet mignon, and on and on. Just a stellar simple menu cooked to flavor perfection.
Food poisoning. Seafood special. Explosive diarrhea.

This Resturant came highly recommended, so I thought we'd give it a try.  It was worth it.  The vegetable soup was delicious served hot! (Important to me). The kale salad had just enough crunch and very tasty. The grilled chicken was moist and flavorful. The chicken burger was also delicious but my favorite dish was the okra fries ! I loved them. A must try!
We had a party of 9, and everyone loved their food. The table leaned toward the seafood, and it was wonderful. The services was a tad pushy.....
Three words drive me back to sanfords as often as I can...DUCK AND WAFFLES...and basically every thing they have but Duck and Waffles is one of the greatest.

I actually ate there about a year ago on a business trip. I was taken there by a co-worker who lives there.  Maybe it's because I'm not from Philly, but I don't get the appeal.  The food is WAY overpriced for what you get. It was decent, but nothing to rave about. To be honest, most of it looks like it was made by a 14 year old, and thrown on the floor. The waiter acted indifferent to our presence. Like he had better things to do. I really expected more. In hindsight, a trip to Wendy's would have been more satisfying.  I didn't originally post anything because I don't usually do internet reviews, but since they don't have any problem with publicly displaying their displeasure with customers, I felt compelled to share my  experience. I give the restaurant 3 stars for being meh, not bad or good, but deduct 2 stars for their public attack on customers.  I won't be going there in my next trip out there.

Eaten here many times and have to say that the service has ALWAYS been subpar. They don't realize that good service and treating customer right is an absolutely integral part of getting people to come back. The tone is set by management, and clearly Tommy Up doesn't preach respect or guest service. Food is great, but there's a lot of great food in Philly. Tommy is a smart guy - must have considered the fallout from posting the receipt and still thought it was a good idea. Donut burger is awesome  -too bad you have to go in to get one.

My husband and I have been going here for about 3 years. The food is good--burgers of the week are a little crazy sometimes (We got the Ellios burger one time, it was eh.) but the brunch menu is my favorite! The adult shakes are super yummy but I have to agree that the food quality has decreased since they have said they will be franchising. The service is OK--nothing spectacular. The server will come to your table about twice--to take your order and then take your money. Good luck trying to get their attention any other time. I'll be back soon and will hope they start taking these reviews seriously!

Finally got to eat here on September 3rd.  Ordered a BBQ Bacon Bleu and a Butterfinger Shake and it was a perfect day to sit outside.  The service was very good, my waitress checked on me multiple times refilling my water.  I probably waited about 5 minutes for my milkshake and 10 more for my meal.  The food was good, pickle was spicy and I only ate a few of the waffle fries because I was full.  Also couldn't finish the shake.  This was at lunchtime.
Delicious.  But issues with delivery.
One of my favorite Japanese food place in New York, the foods here taste really authentic! Although sometimes it takes time for waiting, OOTOYA is one of those restaurants worth your time!

This place was amazing, thanks to going on yelp I knew to bring cash so it wasn't a problem. definately wasn't an issue especially after getting the food, was so worth every penny. I saw someone on here recommend the goat cheese and turkey crepe and I have to say outstanding!!! my sister had the shrimp w/ spinanch crepe she liked it a lot but she had definitely liked mine she said I beat her this time. we always love trying different things to compare especially somewhere new. like the atmosphere friendly environment and there homemade iced tea was great too. The croissant was nice and warm and the jelly with it was really good too. good service and good prices.
Awesome!!

I went here on Sunday afternoon with my Daughter and her friend. I didn't try either of their meals but I will share what they said. Just for reference they are both twelve and know what they like. My daughters friend had fried shrimp and pasta she thought they were ok and the pasta looked ok but as with most non Italians the sauce was just dropped on top of the pasta instead of mixed in and cooked together. My daughter had shrimp scampi, she thought it was terrible a few small shrimp way to much garlic and no wine or seasoning at all. I had the chicken Marsala special. it came covered in onions which have no place in chicken Marsala, the Marsala sauce was way to greasy and had zero Marsala flavor. The chicken was poorly cooked with no flour or coating of any type and there was no seasoning at all. Was served on top of cold pasta. The dish was inedible without a doubt in my top ten list of worst meals ever. We didn't bother with desert we had enough disappointments for one meal. I like local places over the chains and wanted to like this place but I just dont have a single good thing to say.
Cheesesteak sandwich was really good, better than the few I tried in Philly... French fries were soft and suggy. Still very much recommended!!!

I ate at this place on 9/13/2014. I could not understand the hype from all of the yelpers. The pizza was not good at all to me. The sauce and the dough were waaayyyy to salty. I thought the best thing about the pizza was th smell of fresh basil. Other than that, I do not agree with the masses.

Pretty disappointed with this place. I gave a 4 star Because this tiny shop is a well oiled efficient machine. The good: -Service is fast and I got my food in less than 2 minutes -food is cheap compared to other ramen shops - waiting was easy and fast The bad - broth was very watery and no texture -didn't come with the usual pork had to order side dish - noodle was firm  a little undercooked. 25 seconds more and it's perfect I probably won't go back. So far I Ippudo is my to go spot

My mother got married at the Valley Regency 11 years ago and it was the best wedding ever!  The cocktail hour alone was spectacular!!!!  When I got engaged at Christmas, I knew the Valley Regency was one of my top choices. I met with Franco for about 3 minutes before I knew I HAD to have my wedding there.  Franco was wonderful throughout the entire planning process.  On the day of the wedding, Danny was our man. He made sure everything ran smoothly, truly a calming and knowledgeable man!! The Valley Regency is beautiful, the staff is incredibly professional, the cocktail hour is unparalleled, and the food is so delicious and abundant!  The wedding was 5 days ago and we are still getting calls about how perfect it was and that it was the best wedding ever!!!!!!! A very heartfelt  thank you Franco and team!!  HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!!!!!

i'm a pizza freak and this place is definitely a top ten pizza in NYC kind of place. There has been a bit of an explosion of real pizza here in the last decade. Prior to that it would have been top 5. I had pizza in Naples back in the 70's when I was a kid and this comes very close. It's the real thing. You pay a premium but it's worth it. Go check it out!

Why do people love this place? Ikea furniture, pier 1 imports art on the wall and light brighter than Max Fish. Zero vibe staffed by people thinking they're working at a 3 star restaurant. The wait staff gives you a sales pitch instead of answering any menu questions and is spent the rest of the service impossible to flag down for a water refill, let alone drinks. They seemed more interested in turning over the table rather than serving the ones they had. Recommending 4-5 dishes per person (what!), then having them come out very randomly, including a gap of 30 minutes between some, didn't deliver a great experience. Plus, both times they forgot to bring out a dish and still tried to charge us for it. I'm assuming all of the 5 star reviews are from a bunch of woo girls and such who have never gone out to eat before.
One of the best dumpling place that I've been to. They don't cut down on three quality of the food although they're cheap. I come here at least once every week. Small little place but great food.

Possibly the worst Diner I've eaten in and it's a pity coz it looks beautiful from outside! Twice I've been there and twice they through away full (& I mean full) meals while I brought my daughter to the toilet!!! (Twice) I wouldn't mine if the food were good but it isn't! And to finish it off they tried to charge me full price even tho I didn't get one of the meals again, and nooooooooo sorry!!! Never again. I wish it was better news coz it's my home town diner.......

The place is dungy looking and they make you walk thru a storefront selling carpets and oil lamps.  The food is stale, most likely leftovers from the night before.  The first time we were here, we LOVED the food. The second time I wish I had stayed home and ate popcorn for dinner.  Very hit or miss, take your chances.

Very tasty!! Donuts are only available until they run out. I was a little surprised by the few times they already ran out of the kinds I liked seeing as they only have donuts and chicken. But the food is good. If they ever have the wings you should try them! Best wings in the area.

Even with the service being so-so, the food more than made up for it. As an appetizer, we had the Tostada de Atun, nothing short of incredible. The combination of watermelon and tuna is amazing. Dinner or snack, the tacos are excellent. Pork belly, tongue, shrimp...all great. For dessert, a house-made churro dipped in chocolate. Yum.   We will have to go back for entrees, but nothing disappoints. Sit at the bar if you can, to watch a great presentation.
Yum! This place is delicious. If you're looking for some good food, great staff, and a casual dining experience you've come to the right place.
this is a good place. i'm a fan and always will be.

I finally had the opportunity to check this place out last weekend. The food was delicious. I had the chicken quesadilla, my boyfriend had the Diablo burrito and we both had the corn. Everything was amazing! The setting and decor of the place is visually stimulating, it automatically puts you in a good mood. Lots of bright colors, outdoor space, mood lifting music... It really adds to the dining experience and makes it a million times better. I've heard great things about the tacos and margaritas, which I hope to try within the next week or so. All of the eco upgrades were nice as well. The bathroom floor was pretty wet and gross, though. I'm not sure if it was from the morning's rain, or if it was from the sink that was in the stall (kind of strange, but nice).I would probably come back, but more for the atmosphere than for the food.

Was in Bloomfield for a night pet-sitting and on yelp recommendation gave Primetime Pizza a shot. Deliveryman, Dave was personable and a great first impression... white pie w/grilled chicken and garlic knots didnot disappoint!!! In fact I shared the leftover pizza with my 16yr. Old sister(who is a picky eater) She polished it off without complaint- so that silence speaks volumes. I would SO EAT THERE AGAIN! Maybe next time I'll bring my husband we are "food critiques" Good food & Great price!

Below average, especially for top dollar. Came in at 9, ate at the bar, and needed Internet access, which barely worked. So annoying. I ordered the Porterhouse, which is expensive, and just wasn't that good. It came out undercooked, and they were really good about bringing it back to cook it a little more, but it just didn't taste that great. Spinach side was fine, and mashed potatoes were ok, but a little creamy for my taste. Service was fine. Big band music just wasn't my style. I've  had a lot of meals for half the price somewhere else that were better.

During our visit to NYC for about 50 days, we became regulars of Spicy village. The big tray chicken tasted so authentic and portion of it is definitely enough for two people! The owner is very friendly.  You know it is a precious attitude when you are at Manhattan and tired of confronting stony faces of waitresses. We came back to Texas recently and we so miss this place.
Delicious lunch... Salad ingredients so fresh, lightly dressed! Excellent service ! Great Turkish wine!

I am sometimes skeptical of restaurant week deals, as the menu may not represent the restaurant in its best form. This was definitely not the case at Maialino. Went in there without any expectations and came out a changed person. Very happy with dinner.  Service was excellent.  Had the Salumi Assaggio, Spaghetti Alla Carbonara, the Pollo Alla Diavolo and the Tartufo.  I'd have to say i'm both a Carbonara and a chicken snob and both were excellent.  The Carbonara was well seasoned (not over salted) with a very nice crispy Guanciale (crispy but not too fatty).  Better than ones I've had at Otto and Prune.  The chicken was cooked to perfection with very moist white meat.  Tartufo was a surprise.  Had these light crunchy chocolate pieces over chocolate ice cream over a cherry, very good! Go there and make a reservation to go back at the same time!

Just thinking about this place makes my mouth drool. Anytime I have a guest visiting, a stop to empanada mama is always planned. its the most delicious and economical place. i am always surprised at how cheap my bill is at the end of every visit. the food! everything is amazing. the green salsa is to die for. i really wish they sold bottles of it because i would put it on everything. EVERYTHING. the place is clean, the customer service is only okay, but none of that matters because the empanadas will fill you with so much happiness. this place is almost always packed, so be prepared for a wait, but it will totally be worth it.
It was a little embarrassing to order the Viagara but holy moly it was worth it!  Amazing times infinity!  This place just became one of my top 5 places to eat in all of NYC!

The food their is amazing. I know ramen originally is made with pork and some do with chicken. Wish that they could make it with beef which for me is a winner. I would recommend their food to everyone and I would always tell them keep up the good work. Everything is made fresh and you can taste it. Especially their tuna.

Excellent value-for-money choice. Wide variety of dishes. We had the classic byriani chicken, lamb , kemmah nans and the mixed salad. All very tasteful. Portions were rather generous. Very kind and friendly staff.

I always drive past this place and never really gave it a shot. If you say the name out loud it sounds like "Lousy Chinese Restaurant" which is funny. I finally got around to trying it though and it is a shocker. The food is great. The service is excellent. And the fare is quite close to authentic. I'd rate the place higher, but sometimes there is a consistency issue. If they could hit the mark every time this place would be 5 stars for sure. It's really good food though, but stick to their recommended items and you'll never miss.

The name is pretty nice for a Colombian restaurant, however the food not so much. I wanted to try this place out for the first time since I live in town and I started with an empanada de carne ( beef ) I did a to go order, once I got home I sat down and when I opened the bag the empanada was so greasy the oil was literally pouring out of the empanada.. I honesty wouldn't recommend this place if the empanada has all the grease I can only imagine a chicharon!?.
Amazing.. Very clean,friendly staff , viva Brazil!
small cozy place, extremely friendly staff, great service & nice brunches...def will go back.

Very cute and friendly little shop in Montclair. Staff was very attentive but not pushy. I ordered a Nutella crepe and sampled the gelato, both of which were amazing. The overall atmosphere is laid back and the outdoor seating area is perfect on a nice day. Definitely stopping by again and trying the other gelato flavors and coffee.

Oh Malatesta--I had heard so many great things about you and you went on to disappoint me so... I went there on a Thursday at 9:30PM, we were a party of 3. It was very chilly outside but the host told us it would be only be a 15-20 minute wait. A party of two Italian men and three women were whisked quickly inside and 45 minutes later we were still waiting outside, the host had retreated to the warm bar and we hadn't heard a word from him. We left without even setting foot inside the restaurant. A little courtesy and information would have gone a long way. I will not be back.
Good fried food. No question. However, for the cost the portions of clams are ridiculously small. Need to find another place for whole belly clams.

Okay this place might be a hidden gem but hopefully not for long! Great burgers and great fries! Quality and taste and for a very good price. Definitely worth checking these guys out - and that's coming from a burger fanatic! Glad I stumbled across this place, will be back soon enough.

The food was pretty good, but I've definitely had better.  Very tender ribs, pretty good sides.  The problem is the service.   The two arrogant, angry and bored hipster dudes serving the food were horrible.  I will save the details but just say they were probably two of the rudest food service workers I've experienced in a really long time.  It was as if we were bothering them and they even had the balls to talk sh*t about another customer right in front of us.  A customer that had a legitimate concern about being served her sides 15 minutes before her made to order dish was finished.  The customer wasn't even remotely rude to them, yet they proceeded to lambast her in front of everyone.  I honestly wanted to jump over the counter and take both of their heads and knock them together.  And I'm not talking about two kids.  They were two 'grown' men.   With two or three local BBQ joints with better food, the horrible service was enough to put this on my list of where not to eat again.
Amazing restaurant. Awesome food and even better service! Would be coming back. And their dessert tres leche cake out of this world!

Cafe Cluny was recommended by a group of people, in the street, who were leaving a near by restaurant which had a long wait to be seated. It was December, snowing, and why not try something new. We waited only 5 minutes before being seated next to the front window! Perfect. The manager was constantly checking that our eating experience was perfect. The wait staff was attentive. The opening drinks were delightful. (Bloody Mary, Mimosa, Hot Cocoa). The brunch menu was mouth watering and each of our individual orders tasted fantastic. I would definitely return to this cozy dining spot the next time I'm in NYC.
Wonderful place.  Great ambience. Delicious Moules Mariniere! Love it.

They are the new owners of the old Szechuan restaurant I was very impressed with the quality of the new chef my party ordered sweet and sour shrimp fried rice and lo mein and everything came out exceptionally well I will be returning again and again

This pizza place is one of favorite places in town! The food is delicious from the pizza to their pasta. The service is good. It's very close to my house and I can literally walk to them.. They deliver within 20-30 mins which is good it's not a long wait like most places they take about 40-45 min they are quick and reliable..

Best Italian You can get for the money. There clean, fast, friendly and reasonably priced. Been going to Boves for 20+ years and never plan on stopping. Me and my family try to eat here at least once a week. Tuesdays chicken special has always been my favorite, But the lasagna is pretty amazing too.
Great menu for light fare. Great ambiance! Paninis are very good with different pairings which are delicious. Nice cozy atmosphere
Stop by for some rice over chicken with a selection of sauces.Sit nearby and watch the world go by.
Very good food at very cheap prices.

The food and service are great. You'll find the best Calamari ever at Joya. I mean THE BEST,!!!!  Food never goes wrong, great outdoor setting for summer. The food here is really good.  Though not the BEST I have ever had, it's up high on the list.  I especially love the Pad See Yu.  Their fusion dishes are definitely worth a try.  Delivery is always prompt. Because it's right near Smith Street, the place is a hipster death trap on the weekends.  Don't bother going unless you want to wait for at least 30 minutes.  Also, it gets LOUD, crowded, and unpleasant at these times, even by NYC standards. Great ambiance with really chill music and hip crowd. A great experience after all! We will be back! Its CASH ONLY!!

It is a little bit more expensive than others and can be crowded. Buuut Its a really nice place to have brunch, the staff is really friendly and the dishes are big and very tasty. I can defenetly recommend this place!
Went here during the saint generos feist amazing food great service , the food could have been a little warmer and the bread but over all great traditional italian food !!

I've eaten at FDR three times since its opening. My first experience was fantastic. The food was incredible, the owner(s)/manager(s) were present and attentive and the waitresses were kind and helpful. Fast forward about eight months, and my last two visits have been quite the opposite. The food is still very good, but not at the same level as it originally was. However, for some reason, FDR has now decided to employ a staff of zombie-like waitresses and hostesses that all look alike, have zero depth or personality, and, most importantly, are very snobby. The whole demeanor and vibe of FDR has changed from a cozy, romantic venue to a cold, almost elitist atmosphere. The waitresses and hostesses do a  wonderful job in making you feel unwelcome, annoying and burdensome to them. This was the case on my second visit about a month ago, and I passed it off as an aberration.  However, the same cold demeanor and passive aggressiveness persisted to an even greater level on my third (and now final) visit last week. Normally, this would be the appropriate place to go into further detail, but instead I encourage those curious to simply see for themselves if they wish to do so. As noted, the food is still very good, so there won't be much lost if you do. As other reviews note, the prices are on the higher end in comparison to its competitors; or perhaps the better analogy would be that FDR falls short in comparison to other restaurants throughout the city in its price point--e.g., Bibou. In sum, the food at FDR is very good (3.5 star worthy for most dishes) but its staff is not, which, in conjunction with its price point, leaves me with a 2 star rating. If you're on the fence, I suggest passing on FDR and trying any of the numerous similar restaurants in an around town--bibou, ELA, Vernick, Meritage, il pittore, to name only a few.

I tried this place yesterday thought it was different staff was friendly, helpful wish English was a little better so that I could better understand answers to my questions.  Food was fresh and menu is pretty good.  Service is quick.

Every single last time I've been to Tom's Restaurant, I've been satisfied. I live in the area, and I always make sure to drop in when I get the chance. It is amazing how much food you get for the price! I enjoy the service as well; they have been sweet as cherry pie to me and they never fail to seat me with lightning quickness. They get your food to you in no time flat! I really love how consistently friendly they are. They reassure you that it's okay to take your time, even when the line stretches out the door! I've been on that line, by the way, and they give you coffee, cookies and fresh fruit to snack on. The food is amazing! They make a killer burger, but what I really come for is the pancakes! Apple cinnamon, pumpkin walnut, blueberry and ricotta with lemon zest - the possibilities are endless, and all very yummy! All in all, a lovely experience every last time.

I love this place! How sweet it is to be able to order anything on the menu that looks good...and it all looks good. The ELT with eggplant "bacon" is my fave! But the bahn mai, buffalo wrap, and everything I've had there was very good. Plus Trevor is an awesome and generous person.
absolutely phenomenal food and fast service.  great burgers and just tried their sushi today, perfect lunch spot during work

Stopped in here while walking near Central Park and fell in love. This is seriously the most adorable little shop. Small and atmospheric they really know how to make some coffee. Everything here is given great attention to detail and they made the best hot chocolate I have ever had. I had one there and ordered one to go. Everything is made fresh and it all tastes delicious. I also had the tomato, mozarella & basil sandwich and had them toast it for me as well, so good.
I do love this place but the menu never changes and there's very little selection!!! It's a burger & beer kinda joint!

Dear Jones, there are other seasonings besides SALT to season food. I ordered a turkey burger for take out and it was over salted. There was too much tomato aioli (making the bun soggy) and the fries were also too salty. I think your reputation is All HYPE. The one star is for the bartender.. He was accommodating and professional. Your food sucks.
Very good! My bf from AZ swears this is closest thing to true Mexican he can find. Delivery takes a while, but worth it.

Another awesome find! This place is superb! Food is excellent as well as the service! Place is pretty busy so go with reservations. My husband and I walked in as another restaurant we intended to goto was closed. We ended up eating at the bar but was still awesome! We had the steak tartar, raw bar, tomato bisque soup, brisket and the oh so yummy oxtail bone marrow fried rice! I would like my fingers twice on how good the food was!  They had excellent drink selections! But the bill was definitely very pricey but oh so worth it!  Highly recommend!

Place is terrible.  The service is horrible and the food mediocre.  I am waiting to be seated and the hostess takes someone in front of me like if I was invisible.  On top of that, they made me switch tables after I had already started my drink.  Overall bad, slow service.
Excellent food, excellent service. Everything about our meal was perfect. We will certainly be eating here again.

We are the first time to eat in Labebe. They have nice environment, good service and great food. We ordered ROASTED QUAIL and it tastes very special and excellent. The GRILLED LAMB RIB CHOPS also is my favorite. If you like lamb you should definitely to order this one.
Love the staff, decor, atmosphere - food is really good, not mind blowing hence the 4 stars but highly recommend all the same.

Yelp did not disappoint me tonight.  I don't think we would have ever noticed this place without the Yelp reviews. The meal was wonderful. I started with the Butternut Squash Bisque which was divine.  My husband chose the New York Strip which was great, no fat at all. I had the Shoyu Glazed Salmon.  I tend to order salmon at a lot of restaurants, but this was probably the best I ever had.  It was a quiet restaurant in rural Vermont, but definitely worth driving out of your way to try!!!

I have been here 3 times and I can say for sure- I don't like Cafeteria. The ambiance is definitely good. The food is over pricy- the burger which I ordered wasn't that big or good but was $20! The cocktails are good, but again- expansive. And the costumer service is SO bad!! I forgot my hat there, I called 10 mins after I left it and they told me they are saving it for me, and they took my name which is pretty unique. One dat later I came to pick it up and it was gone! They said that someone claimed it, which is so weird, I am 100000% sure no one here has my name. they just gave it to someone. I felt so bad because it was a gift from my parents, and the manager didn't even suggest some kind of a make up. Anyway, there are soooo many other restaurants in the city with great ambiance and great prices and service, so don't bother going to this place.

My daughter and I sat at one of the two outdoor tables out front early on Sunday morning because we had a puppy on a leash with us. I went inside to let the hostess know we were sitting there, and she informed us that we had to order takeout at the cashier and eat out of styrofoam containers. Then the cashier told me that the food would take 35 minutes before it was ready. The restaurant was less than half full. The food is good but overpriced. There's no good reason why I should have to eat out of takeout containers and get no waitress service when there are only 2 tables outside.
Ambiance was great....food was delicious. Wait staff was wonderful!

Every time I've come here the chicken was tough and over cooked while the gyro was pretty good save the consistent stale pita.  I wish it were fresh id go way more often.  No deserts here either which is a shame because that's a great part of Greek food.  Staff always helpful and consistent.

These guys SAVED me this Sunday. I had a meeting with 10-20 people happening on 43rd when the original location cancelled on me 4 hours before the start time. Bea was on the same block as that spot. When I gave them my sob story they gave me the atrium, closed and reserved for us for the night, no minimum or deposit or anything. They assured me that it wasn't a big deal as it was a slow Sunday night, they don't mind, etc. but really, they did me a huge favor and were really accommodating of all our little requests and arrangements. The servers and the managers I interacted with were all really  lovely, even though we weren't the biggest ticket party they've ever had, I'm sure. On top of that, the food was really, really good! I got the mushroom pizza - it was a delicious vegetarian option (in addition to being one of the cheaper items on the menu). Everyone else was really enjoying their food and drinks as well. They told me that normally there's a 25 person minimum on that atrium, so if you have a party of that size, I'd definitely recommend it - they close the doors and windows so you have a very private space with lovely decor, and apparently you can also arrange to have access to their projector. So yes, sending a big THANK YOU and five stars to Bea!

I would recommend the Thit Nuong, or any do it yourself vermicelli wraps because these have fresh ingredients and authentic Vietnamese herbs.  However, the curry chicken was mediocre due to a lack of chicken and dull tasting curry sauce, which did not feature the several complex flavors found in real curry, such as cumin and tumeric. The kitchen brings out the food in a reasonable amount of time, but the waiters are inattentive and will rarely utter a word towards you.  Cleanliness is acceptable, but could be better. Overall, the whole experience was mediocre.  While some dishes are exceptionable, others are forgettable or worse.  Everything about this restaurant is a 3/5.

Went here a while ago, so don't remember much and don't know if service or food is the same. From what i remember, parking lot is in rear of building. Neighborhood could be worse. Food was good, not great. Wait time was forever for take out. I will have to visit again and update my rating accordingly.

Tria is a nice option for a quick lunch or dinner in the city. Both the salads and the sandwiches are done well and the location is close enough to center city to walk around after dinner but far enough so that you can sit outside and not hear car horns the whole time. Their beer and wine menus are also usually pretty good.

My daughter suggested we go to Kanella's for my birthday and I'm so glad she did. We were a party of 4 and everyone of us enjoyed the meal. We started with the dips of the day--3 really tasty dips served with pita and we also ordered the flatbread with zucchini, eggplant, goat cheese and arugula. That was also delicious.I ordered the fish of the day--Brazzino- and it was excellent. We shared 2 desserts that our waiter suggested. One was the lemon tart and the other I don't remember it's name but it was out of this world! It was a custardy pie that was made with thin layers of phyllo dough. I will definitely go back for that and also to try some of the other entrees that looked interesting.

Outstanding surprise!  Didn't know what to expect on our first visit.  The restaurant is spacious, meticulously clean with soft coral colors accented by walnut blinds.  The food is amazing, easily the best Indian fare we've had in northern Jersey.  Meats, veggies, Tandoori - incredibly fresh and just spicy enough.  Even the nan was a cut above the others we've had, and their Kheer set a new standard.  The service was gracious and welcoming.  Five stars!
food was amazing, service was great. all in all a great experience. will definately be returning.

Alexus is what it is.  They do certain things very well and others not so well.  The drinks are great.  They actually know how to make a proper cocktail.  The beer is also great and well kept (always fresh, never flat), although the selection is limited and not to inventive (the most interesting beer that they have is Stella/Blue Moon the rest are the usual suspects, bud, bud light, Yuengling...).  The Delmonico steak is good (8 out of 10).  It is not Keen's or even Ruth Chris, but a very good 24 oz. steak for $24.   Tip: if you order a mixed drink don't let any of the pretty women bartenders mix it, they cant mix a drink to save their lives. Honorable mention- French Onion soup.

This place is wonderful. The food is tasty. My favorite were the Fish Tacos and the shrimp tacos are to die for. It's a must. Best margaritas I've had in a long time. Try the Tamarin one it will blow you away. And the cherry on top to my and my friend's experience were the two super friendly bartenders- Kike and Orlando.  You definitely want to go.Take it from a Chicana that grew up in LA and visits Mexico every year and knows Mexican food! Two thumbs up!!!!!
Excellent red curry with zucchini.  Opted for the added chicken and washed it down with a complimentary Tsing Tao thanks to the check in offer.  Wonderful quick lunch.

I recently started a new job in CLifton and am not familiar with the area at all.  I am so happy to have found this place this morning.  A REAL DELI!  Not over priced, not fancy.  Great food, friendly staff - it's all I need.

Second time here...this time we opted for the Mexicali and schnitzel instead Of the same thing I had last time (big WAC?). I'm any event, Food was fabulous, and despite apparently being the only one working, the waitress ( Audrey) made me an incredible smoothie. Will definitely be back and maybe try another burger, and a smoothie for sure!

We went to a birthday brunch for a friend and had a great experience. The food, like at all Bistro Petit establishments, is consistently excellent. I had the Boudin Blanc with Truffled Mashed Potatoes. It was very good, though a bit rich. To drink I had coffee and a mimosa. The coffee was high quality and the mimosa was well apportioned. For dessert the table shared a fruit tart, which was delicious. Everyone else in our group of 10 was eqully pleased. I found the service at this restaurant to be outsatnding. The waiters were knowledgeable, polite and helpful. The only issue was that the food delivery was rather slow, but this is typical of a large group. The decor is appeasing, modern and comfortable. One final plus is that we had a couple of toddlers at our table and the staff wass patient and accomodating (though this is not intended to be a child friendly place).

Love it! We had to wait 40 mins for a table but for dinner on a Friday night, with food this good, it was worth it. Service was great and the food amazing. I love, love, love that they have haloumi on the menu. I meant to take a pic but was too excited to eat. Definitely recommend and can't wait to go back!
Really good food if you love southern food I would definitely give this place a try .super tasty give this place two thumbs up!

We were told about this place from my husband's friend. This was such an amazing place to eat at. Siting outside was so nice as well. The food was AMAZING! My husband and I had the Pepperoni for an appetizer. Then we split our meal. I had the Rigatoni with the smoked salmon and he had the Lobster filled Ravioli. Both plates were great. Defiantly going back for lunch one day.

I recently went back to aniellos for dinner with my bf bc he knew a waiter who worked there. It was just awful from start to finish. The 1st thing I noticed was a family eating dinner with their 3 y/o daughter SCREAMING THE ENTIRE TIME. Like it was her job.., screaming. So effing loud that I wanted to shove the stale bread in my ears... Wait, we weren't served bread! No one disciplined this kid or even attempted to tell her SCEAMING IS UNACCEPTABLE! I was give a cruddy wine glass... The waiter just stared at me while I scraped the crud off with my finger nail. I knew the food was going to suck and was way over priced so instead if watching my poor boyfriend pay a dollar more then 3 for a a side dish  of meatballs wasn't going to happen. Of course he ordered me my own shrimp cocktail which was not chilled. Just skip it. I'm sure these ppl are very nice but it's a waste if time and money.
Excellent waffles (we got seconds ) , good omelets and a nice atmosphere. Pretty fast too and not too expensive. "Perfecto"
$5.50 for a Teenie Weenie slice of Bourbon Pecan Pie that's the size of a little bird's beak! C'mon Pies & Thighs. At least give us a slice that's worth the price. Tastes good though.

Cafe style (self-service, BAD service, plastic utensils etc) for higher-than-restaurant prices. Save yourself the heartache. Harini around the corner serves the same stuff for half the price and is a full-service restaurant. But Mylai Masala, just down the road, and Tandoori Bite in Princeton, both have fantastic buffets and a la carte menus. And great service.

Had late lunch here twice from the brunch menu. Absolutely loved the turkey club sandwich and salads in general, the S'more dessert is fabulous! Hearty portions, casual dining in a relaxed atmosphere, highly reasonable pricing. We received more efficient service downstairs than up on the rooftop (although it is lovely up there).
Everything was good. My wife particularly enjoyed her chicken special. My wife's pork loin special was also excellent. Will try to come back next time we are in the area.
It's okay but it's no jimmy buff's that's the place to go for a great Italian hotdog especially on Tuesdays when the doubles are the price of a single.

So, for my first visit to blend on the water i must say I'm not easily impressed... but its kind of hard not to be in this atmosphere! I arrived during brunch which i wasn't expecting but it was cool nonetheless. The hostess sat my family and i down upon arrival, we got a nice window seat, with an amazing view! Our server (felicia) was there to greet us with a bubbly greeting, she informed us of the soup of the day which was a delicious sweet potato creamy soup my mother enjoyed.... for apps we tried the arepas which were a hit; even wanted to order some to-go but ended up too full to even try... the steak and eggs were delicious, i was a little upset they removed the red velvet waffles and switched them for mediocre buttermilk... i didn't even bother to try them. however the steak an eggs were a great substitute. Our server kept the laughs going, which my parents loved... its been a while since we went out and still felt at home.. i would have liked to see a better dessert menu though... & when the bill arrived decently priced, that was just the cherry on top! Million dollar service at blend on the water, id recommend it to everybody! kudos guys! Ill be back!

Went to Blend this past Sunday. Three words: Arepas, Pernil, and Tatiana. The food is awesome, the drinks are good, the view is probably the best in queens, and my waitress Tatiana was excellent (and very nice on the eyes). I'll be back for sure.

We had a lovely light afternoon lunch in an area where the choices are limited at 3 p.m. Since it was a quiet time at the restaurant, the waitress gave us lots of attention. It was expensive but worth it. The food was lovely.

What a pleasant surprise.  I was coming from giving a tennis lesson and stumbled upon this jewel in the heart of  Montclair.  It takes over from where the previous  HLS left off.  The restaurant offers a good selection of healthy options including vegetarian and vegan selections.  They also have a great selections of teas both hot and cold, smoothies, freshly made juices and drinks.  I had one of their starters, the black eyed pea hummus with hemp and plantain chips.  I also had the Vitality smoothie which is pineapple, ginger, ginseng and coconut water.  The choices on the menu have a Jamaican twist but with enough variety to satisfy anyone.  The staff was friendly accommodating and fun.  I sat at the bar and we chatted like old friends.  If I could give it another half star I would.
I have eaten Sanford's many times, and their huge menu is always satisfying. They are very nice and have a great honey mustard dresssing!
Good food but all the prices on the menu are wrongg && old!! Its like 3-4$ more than everything listed

I came to PYT with my family once.  The staff was extremely slow and inattentive and just overall unhelpful.  The adult shakes were nothing special.  I wouldn't go back to this place ever.  I have no patience for terrible customer service and attention grabbing entities that lack substance.

I came to New York expecting a "wow" experience when it came to food and this place definitely hit the "wow" factor. All I have to say is the morning after sandwich had the greatest sweet and tangy crossover taste that would compliment any breakfast sandwich. The UNK sirloin burger is amazing. The dessert.......omg.... Get the chocolate lava cake with Oreo cookie crust and the ancho chili brownie! This place is on have to eat list!
Great yakitori menu! Clean fresh but too little portion.. Except that everything was good. Love the atmosphere!

Had dinner here months ago, but writing a review now because it's simply not cool to bash a small BYO because some bigots happen to eat there one night!! We were there with a party of 4, service was great, attentive but not lean down on one knee, I'm your BFF and going to annoy you. We had a little wait for our entree's, nothing major, especially on a busy busy weekend night, maybe 40 min? And it was well worth the wait! Everyone enjoyed their meal, and we always pass the plates to sample each others, and I can honestly say there was not a single thing that wasn't mouth watering. Even the side dishes were perfectly seasoned and soooooooo many places neglect the sides! All in all, money well spent, we will be back!
Thank you Penn 6...for what you did regarding the Hate Crime assault (the reward offer).  I haven't eaten there yet but I most certainly will when I am in Philly next!   -Richard   Los Angeles
This place was magical - beautiful atmosphere, fantastic food and service. Ugh, can I just live here??

I usually don't give less rating unless until i really pissed-off with food and service. I'm a traveler here. Since they don't have options for Indian Restaurant, I'd to go here and I'm NEVER going back again. There were very less customers but still this guy wasn't able to manage with few customers. I ordered (House special Biryani - Chicken+Shrimp+Lamb) for pick up. I went there. My food was ready and I didn't wait much time but the guy who works there getting mad at us since they have few orders to pick up and all came at a time and I DIDN"T GET HOUSE SPECIAL BIRYANI though he charged for it. It's all chicken in it.  I would've order chicken which is $5 less and when i asked for forks he gave me spoons. Who eats meat with spoon?? The food is not that great (I wasn't expecting that though since I go to restaurants back in New York City and i can't expect the same taste but at least they should maintain some standards). Funny part is when i came back at eating at my desk in my office, my co-worker walked-in and she was like "Did you go to Thai" i was like "Honey, that's not Curry Chicken with Rice. FFS, It's "HOUSE SPECIAL BIRYANI"

Love it! Been coming here for years. This is a very popular place, and with good reason. Cheap and delicious! Get the Spicy Noodles or some of their Coconut Curry! Only issue we ever have is with the service. Service can be really spotty sometimes even when it's not very busy. Some days it's good, some day's it's hilariously bad. Be prepared to have to hunt down your waiter sometimes. All in all, for the price, the food and the atmosphere - I will keep coming back year after year! Oh, and don't forget: CASH ONLY!

Visited Amelie on an early Friday night, the bar is crowded already. Since it's a busy night, the services seems slow, not good for quick bite. I ordered food like escargots, foie gras, mussels, salmon, and pork tenderloin. My disappointment will be the mussels were not fresh, and salmon was under cook. I guess I shouldn't order seafood. The place is small and tables are very very packed. Music is loud, but the happy hour wine flight of 3 wines for $12 and rotating $6 appetizers are great value. I recommend to get a happy hour drink here and eat somewhere else.

A hidden gem amongst the over-priced tourist traps that dominate Times Square.  Wonderful pastas and a tasty albeit limited menu of seafood and meat options.  Service is attentive and professional.  Prices are fair for the quality served.

This place was fantastic! We just went for dinner for our anniversary. The hostess and waitresses were attentive and very nice, and took the time to explain the menu. I had the fried chicken, which was amazing. My husband had the chicken liver pate and the mussels and said both were delicious as well. We also tried the switchel cocktails on recommendation of our waitress. It was fun to try something new, and it was right up my alley. Overall a great experience and a great meal.

This restaurant was highly unprofessional.. STAY CLEAR OF THE WOMEN BEHIND THE COUNTER.  They are extremely rude and they have poor service. I work in the customer service industry and that is NOT how you treat a paying customer regardless of color.  They we're highly disrespectful towards my mother and I. I was also with my grandmother as well and they were highly rude to her as well because she couldn't decide what she wanted to eat , there was no one behind her, and she apparently asked too many questions. The service is so unbelievable, words cannot describe. Please DONT EAT HERE! SAVE YOURSELF THE DRAMA AND GO EAT SOMEWHERE ELSE. THIS RESTAURANT DOES NOT EVEN DESERVE ONE STAR !
Fun happy hour
This place is everything. The food is authentic and delicious. The staff is knowledgeable and charming. I love that everything is family style, it makes for a better experience in my book.

I went to Soco for brunch with my fiance on his birthday, everything we ordered was absolutely delectable. There was a bit of a wait we were initially told 45 mins and we ended up waiting about an hour and fifteen minutes. I was pretty annoyed about that but the food was AWESOME!
So delicious! I love it! If you like noodles, this is the place for you. Most of the staff are native Japanese and it truly contributes to the overall experience :)

The food here is good. My fiance and I have been here quite a few times. The service, however, has never been great--but we've generally overlooked that b/c of the food quality and affordability. After last night, we won't be returning. The service hit an all-time low. We waited probably 10-15 minutes for ANYONE to come over to us after we sat down at an outside table, and a server only appeared after we flagged down a hostess and asked if there was anyone assigned to our section. After she took our order, we never saw her again. We had to ask two different people (a runner and a bus boy) for a side of tzatziki sauce, and neither of them brought it over. I then flagged down a waiter (not ours) and asked again. He eventually brought over a giant bowl of a sauce that was NOT tzatziki, but my fiance ate it since we were almost finished with our food by that point and we didn't want to wait any longer. Then when we got the bill, they had charged us $5.50 for the sauce! We looked for someone to talk to about the charge, and no staff passed by our table for another 5-10 minutes. I finally got so frustrated that I brought the bill inside to pay at the front desk. When we explained that we didn't order the sauce we were charged for, but rather a side of tzatziki, the hostess said she would take care of it. I then witnessed her speaking with the manager and BOTH of them rolling their eyes in our direction. Once the bill was paid, I explained to the manager that the service was really poor and that literally no staff member we spoke with EVER returned to our table (except for the waiter who brought the wrong/expensive sauce). His response? "Ok, that's your opinion." Really?
