I guess they're busy enough that they don't care about losing customers, but my fiance is in the hospitality industry and would NEVER speak that way to a patron, and certainly wouldn't say that blatantly bad service is "your opinion!" Needless to say, we'll be finding a new mediterranean place.

I really LOVE pizza. When I first time came to NYC, most of my friends recommend Grimaldi's  to me. After I tried their pizza I need to say it was really delicious. This place has too much followers, so I really recommend you come here in the weekday.

I really don't like to give low reviews since I know how hard restaurants try with their ideas and food. We came here on a busy night. The fries were pretty good in texture and size but there was a really bad bittery aftertaste - this usually means dirty oil. Maybe they fried a lot of fries by the time we came so the oil was bitter by that point. I ordered the poutine. The gravy tasted like nothing. The cheese curds were pretty decent though. Maybe my expectations were too high? I don't know, I usually love fries from anywhere almost. I will give them another shot though, hopefully their won't have that same bittery aftertaste and I will definitely not order the poutine. I will probably try the Parmesan peppercorn dip, sounds good.
Pretty decent food, but SUCH BAD SERVICE. Not just from one waitress, but across the board.

My wife and I celebrated our 14th wedding anniversary with simply the most pleasant restaurant staff we have ever encountered!  Salute was highly recommended by a variety of friends and from the moment we walked through the door we were treated as if we were regulars.  The garlic bread was every bit as delicious as we were told and the calamari was excellent.  Our entrees were perfect (I had the Rose Pasta and she had the Divers Scallops).  The Lava Cake and Espresso Martinis capped a perfect experience.  Despite the fact that the restaurant was full, we were never made to feel rushed.  Raphael made us comfortable with his pleasant attitude and it was obvious to us that he loved the restaurant.  I strongly recommend Salute for a wonderful dining experience!  Joe, Newington CT

OMG!!! Joeys pizza should be classified as an illegal controlled substance, because I swear someone is sprinkling crack in the sauce!!! Best pizza hands down in the area, in NJ for that matter... I live near fort Dix and I would happily drive the 45 minutes or so to grab a pie. It stacks right up there with the two Delorenzos, it has a perfect crisp and chewy crust, oh so lightly sweet n savory sauce and the perfect melt in your mouth chesse!!! I couldn't even make it home without devouring two slices while driving, so sorry if I cut you off! You have to give them a try, it's one of those holes in the wall that will blow your socks off! A diamond in the rough... I usually only review if food and service is horrible, but I had to make an exception for Joeys, service was friendly and fast, and pizza was amazing!!!

I LOVE this place! I go there often. Sometimes with friends for brunch or dinner and sometimes just with the company of my Ipad or a good book. This place reminds me of the cafe in the TV series Friends. It is SO cozy and beautifully decorated. Makes me feel I am somewhere in Europe. The staff is super friendly, the crepes delicious and the coffee superb. I have tried pretty much all the crepes here and can't figure out which one is my favorite. I like them all! I am addicted to the coconut gelato. Sometimes they get incredibly busy and the service can be a little slow, but that is to be expected in any restaurant, Dr.s appointment, etc, so I am not going to judge them on that. The prices are incredibly reasonable too!
When my sister in law got married here, Shannon Desiderioscioli was managing the event and did an excellent job.  Everything was smooth, looked great.  Cheers!

Great Restaurant, Great Food, Great Customer Service. Once you walk in you feel very welcome in the restaurant. There Pasta are delicious and before i forget to mention there portion is for two people. Believe me when i say i love to eat and this people really know how to serve their customers.

Decided to check this place out because of the great reviews it got on yelp. I ordered the smart duck sandwich since that seems like the most popular option and I honestly didn't really like it. I found the bread too hard and difficult to eat, and the ingredients themselves pretty bland. It might just be my personal taste, but I won't be ordering from here again.

Great fresh sushi. If they were faster on taking my order they'd be a 5 star rating. I had ell roll spicy tuna sameri and crab salad and they were all perfect. Great presentation and very nice people.

Beautiful. That's what I said and felt when I walked in. I saw suited men. It is a proper whisky (or whiskey in this case) ;) cocktail bar. Now, I'm not a dedicated whiskey drinker but the Hound Dog and the Noreaster were absolute elixirs. I understand the Manhattan and the Old Fashioned are also excellent. The food was delicious although I did not like the cornbread little bites at the start - soooooo salty! Too salty. Still, service was excellent and we were not rushed at all. Thoroughly enjoyed, although for me it is the draw to a proper cocktail bar and the vibe inside that keeps me coming back for more.

I have not taken my girlfriend out in a couple of months and wanted the first time back out to be special. Bouley did not disappoint, we only ordered 3 appetizer's (one upon recommendation) and an entree each but the meal had so many additional courses. The meal started off with an "amuse bouche" of two appetizers one that tasted like a strawberry shortcake flavored snow cone and the other a cracker smothered in an amazing sauce (still don't know what it was). They gave us two (one for each of us) of the Porcini Flan (this was the recommended appetizer dish), we also highly recommend it. We also had the North Carolina Pink Shrimp & Cape Cod Sea Scallops. The main courses were amazing too, we had the veal and lobster both were amazing. The dessert was even better, they also gave us an additional dish with dessert. And two additional "amuse bouche" within the dessert course (angel cloud, it was frozen goats milk on top of strawberries where the goats milk, the milk evaporated once it entered your mouth and the other being a tower of chocolates and macaroons). The meal, service and ambiance was AMAZING!!!
Grown-up  grill cheese is great!! Love how the server says "Grown-up on board" when the sandwich is ordered. Made me laugh

Cannot imagine the horrendous level of service I experienced with my family at this place! Waitress must have either had a horrible day or had some serious issues. She actually started yelling at me because I asked the status of my daughter's food, which the chef came over to us 15 minutes prior to say the first order was burned and he was making another. Manager came over but was absolutely useless. A total of 40 minutes passed and NEVER received her order. Worst dining experience of my life

Service What surprised me the most was even with the long lines and being outside. This street vendor actually seems surprisingly jolly. They are very animated and even makes jokes as they collect you cash. Food The white sauce is delicious and the gyro is favorite part then the chicken. I definitely recommend getting the combo because you can get chicken and lamb. Value Excellent $6 dollar get you a pretty big plate of food. Thought personally if the line is to long at the original I would go to the neighboring cart which I think is actually owned by the same company.
Is a comfortable and very nice place. The food pretty Good, great tasted.  i went with friends and the service was so good, our waitress was kind and gave us an excellent service.will comeback soon.

Wait was 45 minutes on a Thursday in sept but it was well worth it. It was well worth the wait, we got a nice private booth, the place used to be a train station and has fresh Reno with nice original floors and a lot of the old charm of a 1700 century train station. This is a local gem that if you ask around what is the best restaurant in town they all will tell you check this place out! A+ Nice service and good prices.
Went with my Aunt and 2 cousins. We had a great time, great food and good atmosphere. It was so cool to sit right by the brick oven and watch the pizzas being made.
Taste like it's made in house. It's a dive but the food taste good. A real Chinatown experience.
Great Brunch place! Will return to try out dinner
Awesome place .great food nice people just open a month and I'll definitely be back agian soon.

I came here for brunch. The food was nice and well priced but the service wasn't the best. We had to ask for things twice and they forgot part of the order. I would still go back though - it wasn't a deal breaker.
Over rated.

The food is really great the pulled pork is to die for and so is the pecan pie. The only thing I can say is get there early because this place it so popular food does run out . Lastly the macaroni and cheese is not consistent and it's only good when a specific chef makes it

As a Greek person, I found the good here to be incredibly disappointing and inauthentic, and what made it worse were the absurd prices for dishes that seemed tasteless. I was so excited to get the food of my country but left with my tail between my legs. My non-Greek date even thought the food was less than average. That's saying something.

Best pizza in town! Getting real tired of eating Papa Johns every weekend, so I decided to try a smaller, more localized business. It was definitely some of the best pizza I've had in years! I'll be making a few more visits in the near future!

It is hard to get seated here as the restaurant is small and extremely popular. However it is worth the wait. The menu is home cooked style. The artichoke, Greek salad and vegetarian entree was excellent. They also bring you warm fresh bread as starter. The seafood here apparently is excellent too.

I would take an airplane back to NY to eat at Pio Pio restaurant chains!! Sigh if I'm not wrong I remember being at their 1st restaurant in qns .. Too bad the west coast ( LA too ) doesn't have the variety and richness of food like NY does !!

If I could give zero stars I would. Refused to seat me until my friend arrived, which I could understand if it were moderately busy. However, this place is literally EMPTY- save for one table of three in a corner. Really? Get over yourselves. Ridiculous.

Threatened by employee. Wow their employees are crazy women, I was just threatened. I ordered food for delivery including a cold milkshake, after 45mins called to see if it was on its way, & it still wasn't so I cancelled the order. A girl calls me back after 1hour of waiting to tell me if I want the order I asked for a fresh unmelted fruit milkshake cus she made it an hour ago and she said no that she was doing me a favor by calling me and then threatened me if I didn't take the delivery that they won't deliver to me ever again! Wtf! I said excuse me did you really just threaten me wow. I was really ptfo and as hungry as I was it wasn't worth getting cold food and a melted shake I ordered an hr ago, that still wasn't on its way. I told her she could keep her food calling me with a nasty attitude. unbelievable Never again, I always like this places food and ate there in person and ordered often but they just killed it for me. This is why I dont support small business in this town so disrespectful and rude, who the hell do these women think they are? You wont need to deliver to me ever again, cus I wont give u my hard earn money. Like what a threat your taking away money from your business not mines what a moron. Sad that they make Spanish woman look nuts.

I visited twice recently on weekend mornings to grab a coffee.  I wouldn't recommend eating there.  First visit:  as I'm standing at the cash register counter to order my coffee, I look to my right and notice a woman in the kitchen holding an infant while placing bagels into a toaster.  What restaurant with an open kitchen thinks its a good idea that the staff have their hands all over a baby's dirty diaper ass and snotty face while simultaneously handling the food?  Second visit:  I'm standing at the cash register counter to order my coffee, one server walks by me carrying plates of food and is chomping on a mouth full of food so is unable to respond to my smile and "good morning" greeting.  Meanwhile, another staff member is standing in the kitchen eating.  If the staff is so hungry at 10AM, why don't they take a break, sit down at one of the many empty tables with their food and eat, then wash their hands before going back to work - almost every seat/table in the place was empty.  Food handlers and servers should not eat while working - not to mention handle a baby while cooking - because these habits can potentially contaminate your food with hazardous germs, bacteria and/or viruses.  I won't be going back.

Hmmm...I seriously don't know what the hype was about. I went with my family for an early Friday dinner. My wife ordered the sturgeon, I ordered the cobia, and my mother the bass.  I also ordered 2 oysters and the octopus for appetizers. The oysters were tasty, and the octopus ($16) was burnt. Quality of the fish is indeed high, but the execution was subpar. The seabass and the sturgeon was raw, the sauce with the cobia was unpleasantly bitter (and the under cooked veggies didn't help). The pesto with bread was the tastiest part of the $150 meal. The service was good, the atmosphere was pleasing. Maybe the cook had an off day when we went, but the prohibitive cost makes me hesitant to give them another shot.
Food from home. Always a plus. If you want real Latin food. That is one of maybe 5 places in NYC you will get real Latin food. I eat there at least 5 times a month: respectfully. It's always good.
Hands down amazing. Staff is great and the food is to die for. Thank you for the hospitality

I was skeptical about eating in an urban outfitters and the fact that the sign is barely visible almost had me miss this place all together. Im glad i didn't. After we were promptly seated and poured our water, we were told the chef recommended sharing. We complied. Our server was extremely knowledgable about the menu and was able to answer all the questions we fired at him. The first item we had was the fermented celery broth. sounds strange, but the flavors totally work. Although i thought the dish was missing something (couldn't put my finger on it), i would recommend it. Next was the bacon wrapped matzoh balls. A must order. They were better than my grandmothers, but then again, she wouldn't wrap hers in bacon. After that we had the beef tongue. This blew my mind. The tongue was melt in your mouth tender, the tomato romesco sauce tangy, and the croutons crunchy and citrus-y. I debated to my self if i would come back alone the next day to have it again. For our final course, we had the lamb neck with risotto oats. Although the portion size was huge, we could not finish it, and it was quite a heavy dish, it was impeccably cooked. The oats were super creamy, and the finish of mint added the slight lightness it need to not be too heavy. We liked everything so much, we decided to truck through one dessert. We opted for the chocolate brownie with onions. Although strange (my two companions enjoyed it more then i did), it was good. The stand out being the charred scallion ice cream. In short: Great service, great cocktails, great food. Highly recommended. Im glad this was my first Yelp review

I have been here a few times now but only twice for dinner and once for a snack on the roof. The spot itself is fun albeit kind of quirky (I get a kick out of walking through the Urban Outfitters just to make my way up to the top for a drink or some food). When I first heard of this place I couldn't get my head around how they would separate it from the store; the space itself solves the noise problem I can't stand in most restaurants. The dinning hall is perched up above the store where one simply becomes secluded from the retail space so much so that you forget where you are (there are separations and lighting -I can't remember exactly how it's done but its effective and pretty). What is great about this is that in a structural space so big, yet shared, the temptation to fill the space with more seats is confined (because of the urban outfitters that we are floating above) allowing all tables to have conversations without it ever feeling boisterous. I kind of love that. It feels so civil and completely missing from other popular places in this town. Then there is the food; again quirky but always really good. e.g. bacon wrapped Matzah balls and onions in a chocolate desert. - oh yeah the first time I went we were so pleased by everything so much so that I couldn't be bothered to decide on a single desert so we just ordered "all of the deserts." This was a smart thing to do.

I created this Yelp account so I could write this. I came here on a first date and started out at the roofbar. It was perfect. We were enjoying the view and cocktails (they actually make more than margaritas and a rum & coke up there) that we had a few appetizers there. My date is a vegetarian and was happily able to order enough for a meal, not just side items. We had the cucumber and crispy chickpeas, bacon wrapped matzo balls (well I had them, and they were one of the best things I've eaten this summer), and the broccoli--it made a broccoli believer out of me for sure. The rest of dinner downstairs continued to impress--there is a more extensive cocktail menu in the main dining room and bar. We decided to eat at one of the bar tables.  I had their Negroni. The bartender explained that is was a "summer variation" and was a welcomed change to my usual Negroni, light and very refreshing. My date drank the cider on tap, which was described as crisp and light. She had the corn, shishito peppers with roasted eggplant, and carrot with almond cake. I ordered the poutine and then the sweetbreads with Cool Ranch hummus. Wow, definitely best sweetbreads I've ever had and describe anything as "Cool Ranch" and I'm in! I would go back just for a few cocktails and the sweetbreads. All in all a great night. Definitely worth the venture into Brooklyn!
I have been to both restaurants in Brooklyn and in LA. Great food. Fun staff. The roof top bar at The Gorbals Brooklyn is the best! Highly recommend.

awesome spot! i thought it might be a lil gimmicky, being attached to the clothing store, but it's a fantastic stand alone restaurant. the space and decor was very open and interesting, particularly the fantastic roof view, but more importantly the menu is very tasty and VERY creative (important to me!). the lamb and bacon wrapped matzo balls are particularly awesome. really i'd prefer to give it 4.5 stars, as the staff was a little inattentive, but it was nothing extreme and they were still very nice. in any case, i feel the menu is such that i'd lean towards 5* over 4 based on that. i def recommend it.

Really amazing zucchini blossoms crisp and filled with ethereal ricotta. Amazing sweet corn raviolis balanced with truffle slices and parmesan cheese. Out of this world. Also delicious the bread pudding which could have had a few more orange slices.

Crab bisque was good but I'm from MD so a bit snobby in regards to crab soup. Ginger salad dressing was good and they make all their own dressings weekly. Citrus sautéed lobster, scallops, shrimp and scrod -- amazing!! Very tasty A++. So much food and this was the half plate. Kaelin was excellent and I highly recommend this place. I'll be back next time I'm in the area !!

I've been supporting this bar and grill for quite sometime, but what I'm beginning to notice is a pattern of receipts with items never received or ordered and never brought to the table. I've shared my table with complete strangers to wind up having my bill attached to there's so it would be above $50  so gratuity can be added. Mind you I'm a good tipper regardless. I've even had one particular bar tender ask me To pay for a bill that customers ditched even though she knew they were not with me only sharing the table. I brought to one of thee employees attention a mistake on my bill to have her reply what do you want it's not the four seasons. Exactly and Maybe that's where I should start going. I would like to visit the Booton location to see if this is Sharky's mentality or just an isolated Clifton issue. But who knows it sure ain't 4 seasons. I bought a coworker there because the food is good most of the time and it's close and practical, but after 2 visits we were totally disgusted with the service and have vowed to find somewhere else to spend our hard earned cash.

The asparagus breakfast is an INSPIRED dish. Also the duck torta, the lobster roll, and the Cuban are all really killer. Great to see Restaurants in Brooklyn serving this kind of food, innovative twists on classics.
Great food great staff great prices.....perfect for an impromptu dinner I love this restaurant
Firstly this is the hottest place in the west village (thanks to Hey Bartender). Super busy, great drinks, fun atmosphere... what more could you want.

I absolutely adore Owls!!! I come here quite frequently.  The only downside is how early they close, I wish they stayed open a lot later for my midnight cravings! It is cash only which is a little inconvenient but oh well! Waitresses are usually pretty friendly, usually just rushing around. I'll always love it here!
Overall we had a great experience. The staff is nice and the decor is beautiful inside!! All of the food was excellent. I recommend the veggie burger.  Worth the stop if you're in the area!!!
never had a bad meal at Forgione. Fabulous menu, great wait staff and beautiful location.  Not to be missed

What are all of you smoking?  I stopped in for the lunch buffet and all I found were mostly empty steamers. There were only three parties in the restaurant and it took over 20 minutes for rice and naan. The chef came out looked at the buffet my back to the kitchen and conveniently disappeared. Please feel free to forward me any information on good Indian restaurants in the area I would not send my worst enemy to this dump. Nice stomach ache later same evening. Dreck!

Can't say enough good things about this place.  The food is amazing and such a variety of grilled cheeses! the crispy goat is amazing- double thumbs up! Also really reasonable beer and wine selection- major plus is that staff awesome!
First time, last time. Ordered an original thin crust with prosciutto and mushroom. Cardboard would have offered a more sophisticated flavor profile. Never. Again.
Holy moly! I want one of everything! Beet, goat cheese, and taro ravioli! Craft beers! Gelato! Yum!

Absolutely love everything about Moonshine.  Everything I've had to eat is delicious, and I've almost worked my way through the entire menu.  My favorite is the gnocchi w/ blackened chicken and pesto.  They always have a great selection of beers and the service is friendly and on point every single time.  Love that they have different food specials so I can change it up, and they've also just started brunch which I can't wait to try.

Great service,  always greeted by the owner. Great pizza, the sauce and cheese all come together to give you a very filling for that craving of pizza you have.  Great prices, for only a $1, $1 flat you get the best slice. Go give them a try now!
Great service & atmosphere.  The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu.  Food met our expectations.

This place is seriously great, and more authentic than the tourist places in Mexico!  They have corn smut, cactus, mole, and much more on the menu. The filet mignon was great, as well as the shrimp al ajillo.
Great place with pasta favorites always the same for years great price

You know those people who pay $40 for a pair of socks? They are the people who eat at Raymond's and pretend it's the tastiest place around. No. Want a spinach omelette? You'll have to settle for undercooked scrambled eggs served in green water with a spinach topping. I weep for the souls who *wait* in line to eat here. The decor *is* adorable, but the food is forgettable.

When you think Pizza you automatically think of two places, New York or Italy. Well prepare for that to change. One trip to Juliana's and when you think of Pizza, that's all you will think of. Brooklyn's Finest! The food was savory, the atmosphere cozy and the service fast and friendly. After you satisfy your hunger with their pizza you have to make sure to top it off with one of their homemade Brookie deserts! YUM!

In 3 weeks the price of a salad went from $8.00 to $15.00. Ridiculously priced for the amount of food and the selection that you receive. The service was good but for the location being in Newark, NJ ; the prices are City (NYC) prices when they don't have much of a selection.

The definition of Italian deli food...in town visiting the Italian side of the family and told them I wanted the real NJ experience...and I now have in my mouth the ultimate Italian taste...clean building and enthusiastic wait staff.

I had a lovely time here with the BF. We sat outside, which featured nice tables and comfortable chairs. It was also a lot quieter than the inside seating area. I had the Pizzo Doro (sausage, pepperoni, and fresh mozzarella). The ingredients tasted very fresh --the pie was delicious! The BF had the Ruchetta E Proscutto (a white pizza with prosciutto, arugula, parmigiano, and balsamic dressing). He offered me a taste, and I have to say, I was a little skeptical as I've never had a white pizza that I thoroughly enjoyed. But oh man.. -Osteria Procaccini just took white pizza to a whole 'notha level! It was absolutely incredible! The flavors were so different and complex. And as a whole, the ingredients worked so well together. The pie was really a piece of art! The service was good too.  All that and at a good price, we will be back again! Of note, try to get a hold of solid directions to this place beforehand (don't just memorize/write down the address) if you are unfamiliar with the area. The house/business address numbers change abruptly at various points along Rt 27 consistent with the township boundaries. And as such, if you pass this restaurant accidentally (like we did!) and head down the road, the even numbers will be on the other side of the street as well as ascending in value. Somewhat confusing! (Btw, the restaurant is one building past a streetlight (if you are traveling northbound).) But it won't happen again, as we will be back soon!

Was a little hard to make decision with so many choices but im just indecisive and the burgers are little pricey.  Food came fast and great presentation. And ow man are those burgers good. Juicy fresh everything you want in a half pounder. House chili was tasty   definitely a must go if your a burger fan.
The food was fantastic, service was great. Only drawback is the noise from the nearby hospital, but noise in the city is kinda expected. Would definitely recommend!!

The food was great as well as the music. I was dancing and eating at the same time. The service was good as well. You were supposed to have a reservation but they allowed us to sit anyways without a reservation.
Went to Arlington pizza with my fiance who was craving pizza,the pizza was an oily mess.My neighborhood pizza in Bedstuy, Brooklyn is 10 times better.

Very nice place to have dinner, with great atmosphere and food. We tried the most interesting smoke salmon ever in this restaurant, all dishes made with care, sophisticated and not pretentious, everything to have a good time. Staff polite and efficient.

I did not have a good experience eating at this restaurant even though the food is tasty. The service was so slow that it ruined the dinner for me. Our three course dinner from a fixed menu (limited options!) was dragged out for 2.5 hours. Sometimes this can be a wonderful thing when you and a romantic partner are lingering over wine and moonlight, but that was hardly the case on the particular Wednesday night when I ate at Zahav. My party of five consumed our food quickly once it arrived and then wondered, "Where IS that next course?" Note to Zahav: Not everyone with a 5:45 reservation expects to get their entrée at 7:30pm. If that's your MO, a little more bread and hummus would have been nice.
Green Eggs and Ham! On of my favorite places to go for a Sunday brunch. Place can get packed tho. Best if you can get a spot outside on the patio.
Not a wine bar. Very limited wine selection. flights not available. Loud music. Pass.

I absolutely love Bogota! I have dined here a few times over the past few years and it gets better every time! Every dish I have ordered is great. The last 2 dishes I ordered was the Paella and one of the specials, the Fried chicken. Both were delicious! The fried chicken was so crispy and juicy. You have to dip the chicken in the honey, it makes it so much better. I love the mojitos, I have to get one every time I go. Maragritas are also very good. Who can beat all day happy hour Monday - Wednesdays? We had Catleen as our server and she was awesome!! She was nice, attentive and friendly. We had a very late dinner so we had a chance to talk to Catleen since she didn't have a lot of other tables. She had us laughing the entire time! Over all I love this restaurant. I never have to wait long for a table or for my food. Food and drinks are always delicious. We definitely hope to be catching Catleen on another one of her shifts. She was a fantastic server and made dinner so much more enjoyable.

I was traveling to New Haven for business, one overnight, and was excited to try Claire's after reading the information they provided on their website.   To say the least, I was truly disappointed.  The dining area was very unkept and dirty, the area for ordering food was being repainted and a mess.  When I asked the person at the counter what was in the stir fry, she didn't know and asked a cook behind her.  The cook said what was in the stir fry and it sounded good.  I also asked about the curry, what was in it and if it was red or green curry.  She didn't know and asked the cook again.  The cook looked in a display case to see what was there and the counter person said, "Well it actually looks yellow."   It didn't look very pleasing and who knows how long it had been in the display case. I said, I'll have the stir fry.  The cook over heard me and said, "We don't have that tonight." I walked around the street and found Jerra Tai - it was fantastic.

Extremely Rude servers who try to process patrons like an assembly line. I get that this is New York but this kind of treatment is obnoxious. I pay for the food and the service, stop harassing me when I am eating or talking!! Don't recommend this place. There are tons of other restaurants (in fact in the same area) with better food/more civil staff/better ambience

We @ Let's Get Greedy! Loved this eatery. Fun décor with old school toys on shelves and walls.  Fun food to bring out the inner kid out of you.  We loved the cheesy gravy tots, chicken & waffles and many more dishes! Check us out singing and dancing before the doors open for brunch! Click video below & see: youtu.be/xhpREGzqbVY

I got cut off after my first beer. I was kind of embarrassed, because our server brought out a second round to our entire party, and then singled me out saying she didn't feel comfortable serving me anymore alcohol. I do have a slight speech impediment so I'll give her the benefit of the doubt. The group I was with found it way more absurd that a 40 year old was being deprived of a second bud-light, then I was actually embarrassed. For what it was worth, she didn't charge me for the 5+ cokes I drank, and she quick with the refills.  I had the scallops with pasta. It was sooo good. Portions were plentiful, price was around 20 dollars. I felt that was fair. Server was otherwise attentive, we got everything we needed quickly.

First time here and I have to tell all of you the place really serves some really nice healthy food with some thought put into each dish ! I had the chicken soup and it was very good for dinner I had the fried chicken Mac and cheese and Brussels spouts and they were the star of the show excellent. The service was great and I really enjoyed this unique restaurant ...
Good food and consistent quality. The staff are always friendly and helpful. Not the best Italian food in the neighborhood, but it's convenient.
GREAT FOOD!! Loved the service - friendly - nice - clean - first time trying Thai ice tea -in love -
busy place. simple broiled seafood. crowds love it.

I'm sorry to say - the food here has gone downhill.  We used to order from this place and the food was terrific but they've changed chefs and now they're so inconsistent now you never know when things will be good but you can bet something will be bad. I told the girl at least twice and to no avail - the food never improved even when they sent something to make up for what we complained about - it still was barely edible. House special fried rice is ok, asked for a gen tso extra spicy and it tasted like sugar, egg rolls tasted old, egg drop soup with no flavor, etc. etc.  Waste of $35 if you ask me.  Never again.

This place is a well oiled machine.  Line out the door but moves fast.  Falafel plate consists of six falafel balls on a Mediterranean salad for six bucks.  The hot sauce is hot but a nice addition.  Washington park is a block away and a nice place to eat as this is take out only.

after marriage of my younger brother. yesterday  i held a party in upstate. it is quite two and half kilo meter away from my sweet home. i invite all friends for this party . i select this upstate due to this location, front display and all food items also super excellent in taste. chicken and fish is the famous item of this upstate. therefore, i select both items for guest .party start at right time. everybody likes the service of upstate. chicken and fish was hot, fresh, and delicious. natural artificial flavors also contributes to make more taste. their standard and quality so well.quick service  also good for customers attraction.the price also cheap for all customers. i really enjoy  this party in the presence of friends and  nice food.
Not really tomato pie, more like regular pizza. The pizza is good, better than most, but it's not tomato pie.

A plate of bruschetta with tomatoes, Mozzarella and basil, drizzle of balsamic. Generous amounts of tomato and mozzarella . One leaf of basil. That is absurd, sorry but it is! The basil brings the whole thing together. Further more it would have masked the fact that the tomatoes where unripe. I asked the waiter for some more basil and she said, "I think we have that" . This is an Italian restaurant. Food is fine, but the experience is ridiculous enough to deny a return visit.

We've never been disappointed with the food at Leone's. Their chicken parm sandwiches are delicious and filling, but not so heavy that you feel like you're going to die afterwards. Their pizza is good, too. We always take a walk there & grab our food to go, so I can't vouch for the table service, but we've always been greeted with a very friendly "Hey guys!"
best thai icetea ever!
A-M-A-Z-I-N-G !!! Can't get enough ! Brought my boys here and they loved it ! Genesis is always on point !
Not sure about the food. Called to make a reservation and they were rude and hung up on me. They should consider accepting online reservations with that attitude.
Happened to walk by and thought I would give them a shot.  I tried a couple tacos and  chips everything was good.  I have a menu and will definitely call for take out

Some long-time Greenwich Village denizens introduced me to this charming little bistro on a recent business trip. It's set on a great people-watching corner (in the best French tradition) and boasts an excellent menu. The beet salad with strawberries was divine, and the baked Alaskan skate was melt-in-your-mouth good (both are house specialties). Service was attentive and the floral decor makes for a lovely atmosphere. I'd recommend a weekday visit. On Fridays and Saturdays the whole East Village seems to be flooded with young suburbanites looking for a night on the town. A longer-than-average wait can be expected, but the maitre d's do their utmost to keep the tables moving.

Pretty design.  Lots of exposed brick and comfy bar stools. The Irish bartender had it going on with good cocktails.  Over cooking the calamari costs them a star, and the pickled cauliflower was a real small serving for the high prices.

No need for Anthony to respond to this review.  It was ALL good.  My second time here and my second positive review.  It was a  birthday celebration for my wife and both of our sons accompanied us.  We ate well, and the bill reached just shy of $300 (including the tip).  But I took advantage of a Groupon offer and only had to pay a total of $205, including the $ sent through Groupon.   Anyway, the money is not the point.  So many times we have gone out and dropped good money only to say, "We could have made a better dinner at home".  Not the case here.  Thoroughly enjoyed:           Apps: Imported Burrata  and eggplant;  Mini meatballs with hot peppers potatoes, Pasta Bolognese                                                                                                        Main courses: Black Cod crusted in panko, Seafood Cioppino; Whole wheat pasta with Shrimp, Broccoli Rabe and tomato...and a Korobuta pork chop with hot cherry peppers and potatoes.  Overall an outstanding meal.  Service was friendly, relaxed, but not too slow, the place was fairly quiet.  Keep up the good work!
Brunch!
The menu is odd to read. The waiter recites a very long list of "specials" that is ridiculously long and unnecessary. The FOOD IS DELICIOUS!!!!

Ordered 2 yakitori don and miso soup via phone. It normally takes about 45mins to make. Went there an hour later to find out they have our food to someone else. This is HORRIBLE SERVICE!! They said we would have to wait another 45mins and didn't even comp our food. So that's an hour and forty five min wait. I can go eat in NY OR other places that other so much BETTER FOOD! On a previous outing, went there with two other friends to eat and drink.. Service was actually decent but got charged 18% gratuity. I guess this is the only place that's doing it. Since service was decent, I actually paid for everything and didn't think much of it. After this incident, I'm taking my money to elsewhere.

Every time we go we see this other patron who eats there 3-4 times a week and is also a been a chef. He is always saying to try the chicken. I would but the fish specials always seem more tempting. Definitely worth a stop but keep in mind this place is not super casual so dress like you should. It's worth it.

The dumplings were as good or better than I have had anywhere in the world including old town in Shanghai. The othe dishes were also great and the service was friendly and very responsive. No bar yet, so went across the street and got a wonderful bottle which The bao folks opened and served at no cost. The owner is a great guy and I can't wait to visit again from Florida.
Authentic it is not. Respectable Tex-Mex, no. How does this place stay in business? Superior to Chipotle or even Moe's? No chance.
This place is awesome. Great drink selection and great menu. Atmosphere was great, not too busy on the weeknight we ate there. Waitress had good recommendations.

Excellent meal. The sorbet trio for dessert was fabulous. Only complaint is that the portions were on the small side, I had the shrimp as an appetizer and the cod as an entree. The cod was presented beautifully, but again on the small side even for fancy NYC standards. I would definitely return because the quality of the food and service was higher than most, especially for the east village Another bonus is that I was able to make a reservation for a Friday night the same day. Definitely give this place a try before it gets too hyped.

Bad dumpling house ever try. Sour & Spicy Soup tasted just like soy with spicy, also too salted. Dumpling over cooked. Services bad, they just want you to make purchase. Unhappy experience to this place.
Great ambiance, amazing food, and stellar service!!!

500 Degrees used to be my favorite spot to grab a deliciously juicy burger with all of the accoutrements. Unfortunately, my last two visits have been lackluster enough to cause me to take to Yelp. My most recent visit I came in at a fair hour (9:00) since they close around 2:00 a.m. I asked for my favorite burger (egg, bacon, potato hash, arugula.) The counter girl informed me that they were out of potato hash. I requested the same burger without the hash, she rang me up at which point the cook turned around and began YELLING at her. They engaged in a several minute argument in front of me where she looked like she may cry as he continued to insult and degrade her. My favorite part was where he turned to me and was equally argumentative. Since all I wanted was a burger, the open hostility made me extremely uncomfortable. The place was filthy, they apparently were out of half of the menu, and after this altercation with the cook I walked out of the joint sans burger. No burger is worth that kind of guest interaction.
I love SriPraPhai ! They're food is amazing and their customer service is superb. I love their massaman curry and green mango salad!
curry is the best with chicken flavor rice! OMG the best! cheap too.

OMG, "OMG please" hold me back from saying it once again OMG this pizza by far is the best I have ever tasted and to add to the review their Customer Service is also great. In combination of the experience I have had with this restaurant Yes I will be back for their great service and they're great pizza paid $80 dollars for one Lg pepperoni and a LG extra cheese, in addition to that I ordered two side of extra tomato sauce and believe me when I say for me to add it to the pizza gave it more or less of a kick to it I would definitely recommend it to other friend and future wonderers on yelpers...  bone a petite.

Excellent service, food and atmosphere. The service is easy and uncomplicated; the food delicious and interesting; great selection of French and other wines; a vibe that welcomes and invites; and all at a very reasonable price.

My brother and I stayed a few blocks away and were told to go here.  We sat down at the far side do the bar right next to the chef station.  We were able to chat with the chef and learn about the menu. They only get food from within 300 miles and each week / week and half the menu changes depending on the animal they bring  in.  We got the artichoke dip which was amazing and split a few sandwiches.   Highly recommend this place!!

Service is quick. Food is decent. This place gets an extra star for it's convenience. It's open very late, ( I think around 4 A.M. ) so when i'm around the area, I know this is the place to go to fill you up. You'll find the most random people late night though so don't be alarmed.

We are lucky to have many good options for Pizza in Wayne, but Pizza 1 has made it's mark as my favorite!  Excellent selection and very high quality ingredients.  Delivery is fast and friendly and the staff at the restaurant is top notch!   The specialty pies are very diverse.  My favorite is the Nonna's pie which is thin crust  with chunky tomato and fresh mutz. Give them a shot and you will not be disappointed. JP
Positives: Outdoors, corn almost as good as in Queens. Negatives: the margarita tasted really cheap, like it was cheap tequila and cheap mixer. That's supposed to be their specialty.

I like it here. I sat in the bar area at a table and had some pizza and some appetizers and some beers.  The menu has a good variety but it is a little on the pricier side for a bar especially when the options sound so good that you want to try it all! They will let you try different beers if you are unsure of what to pick so keep that in mind.  The staff was good and friendly.  They have live entertainment and karaoke and stuff so if that isn't your thing you might want to check what is going on first! Overall I will definitely be back.
Yum! Food was great. I was suspicious of the gluten free bread, but it was great!
Excellent fresh food, not your chain type restaurant.  The scones are absolutely to die for delicious!

First time I went, I would have given it four stars. Went during the summer for the free bbq deal. Service was slow, but it really was very busy out on the patio and our waiter was great so no problem there. Plus it was such a good deal for good food and a lovely atmosphere. The last two times I went, we ate at the bar inside and service was still slow, even though it wasn't busy. There is one bartender in particular that I officially dislike as we've had him twice. Inattentive, snarky, rude. My friend asked him to explain the drink specials and he was very vague and almost tricked us into paying full price. She brought it up to him jokingly and he did not apologize and was condescending and again, rude. Another time we had a server at a high top in the bar area and he completely ignored us for almost a half hour. Same friend hunted him down all the way at the other end of the restaurant and his excuse was that we looked busy talking and he didn't want to disrupt. .....Our water glasses had been empty and our drinks cleared ages ago. The people who work here seem so spaced out! Most foods are meh, but some are pretty good, like the pulled pork sandwich and the raviolis. So... OK food, less than stellar service. Overpriced. There doesn't seem to be another place like it in the area, though. And it seems like it can be fun with the live music some nights. Nothing beats the summer patio bbq deal though! Too bad it doesn't go on year round inside.

Cool diner in the presence of Great service! I am giving five stars to top diner due to its high quality diner.this place always good for diner. Top diner have a seperate portion for  family.the taste of all items also great and fantastic . Each and Everything fresh, hot and delicious.The menu of the food also extreme. Soft and cold drinks also available. but now a days i am facing that they stop a service of wine after a long time.I humble request that play the service of wine again. if we talk about the beauty of the top diner restaurant is super excellent. the walls and tables , chair, and furniture also nice.the atmosphere always cool. no disturbance in any work. The staff also nice, cooperative and friendly. the price of all items are balance and perfect.
The best Greek in Astoria!

I was looking for something healthy to eat. I checked out this place's website. Its menu said "Big Salads," so I decided to give it a shot. The salad was a healthy portion for $10. Although the chicken was cut up small, there was enough of it even at the end of eating. (I hate it when places skim on the meat, and you are left with all lettuce at the end.) It wasn't too bad. Sadly, they don't have a good selection of low-fat or fat-free dressings to put on the salad, so I had to use my own.
The rotisserie chicken and fried rice is worth the slight trek to woodside just for some take out.

We got lost in CT and came across this seafood spot. And let us tell you! Loved the Treasure chest filled with fried everything like fried clams, fish, crab cakes and plenty more! but our #1 draft picks are the buttery lobster roll, seafood chili & CT's different flavored bottled soda pops!  Check us out on a 4 part episodes of great food & our blooper show @ Stowes.  Enjoy our greedy antics! youtu.be/xk52Cp4ZcQA?lis… youtu.be/YKTktO0wi8E?lis… youtu.be/lJumyAG_uDk?lis… youtu.be/koi8h0ZaHoc?lis…

Sometimes when you're roadtripping and hungry you come across the best food and service. This was exactly the case when my partner and I were travelling through Our House! Immediately we loved the atmosphere in the restaurant: quirky, fun with lots of personal touches. We sat inside because the patio was full, a good sign for a comfort food joint. Our servers were attentive despite it being a full house, and helped us choose local pints. Our Lost Nation Sour Ale and Switchback Ale came quickly and were fantastic (nice one Vermont!) The two of us shared the grilled cheese V and upsized our fries to the lemon, garlic and rosemary fries. Here's a good sign people... I am not a huge fan of grilled cheese, tomato soup, or fries... and I was blown away by this meal. Simple, fresh, tasty, and hearty. For french fry lovers I definitely suggest the lemon, garlic, and rosemary option. The tomato basil soup was rich and a perfect accompaniment to the grilled cheese. Bonus: a clean bathroom! Thank you staff. Although their space feels slightly cramped during peak hours and their service was a bit slow (but sweet), if we're ever back in Vermont we are definitely going to stop by again!
Decent drinks. But: Too loud, Too crowded and Too hands-off. For my taste at least ...

Food and service was good, but be advised this is an "eat it and beat it" establishment. A few minutes after our party of 3 paid our $115 bill (including a 20% tip) we were politely but firmly asked to vacate our table for the next customers.
oxtail is off the hook and jerk chicken is soooo good.  Service is always great.  It always impresses people (after they get the food).  Get.  Here.

I come here a lot. I've never had a bad experience. I like the atmosphere. Food  comes out quickly. Everything is always fresh. Staff is always friendly. Prices aren't bad either. Great Hartford spot!
In one word, Fresh. The food and bar drinks were very clean and fresh tasting. Love the atmosphere. Fun place to go for date night! Only upset was the small portions. Otherwise, definitely returning.
My go to is the mac and cheese and I have them add buffalo chicken to it. It's great! The best part tho, they got growlers! No where else in Hartford.
Best thai food in town. They'd deserve a bigger seating area (especially when you see the size of the crappy Thai restaurants on Chapel...).
Some of the best tacos I've had. Living in Denver we get our fair share of great Mexican food.  The tacos were only 3 dollars and the margarita's were wonderful.  Go here and enjoy 3 dollar tacos.
Must try, especially delectable treat for the senses at 3am! Highly recommend! Most of the locations close at 2am, but this one's open later.

I actually made a yelp account so that I could write Bears a review. This place is great, smoked wings are unbelievable! I don't know what they put in the sauce, might be crack, I don't care. Still thinking about that pulled pork sandwich I had.  I just wish they served beer too.
This place was amazing! family style with Andre the giant size portions quick and friendly service with a high end feel.  Food was excellent.
The pork belly taco is a must try.

When was the last time a lowly sandwich blew your mind?  For me, that would be never...until yesterday, when I tried Allen Street Deli's turkey club sandwich with chipotle aioli.  A turkey club:  boring, right?  We all know the components:  turkey, bacon, mayo, lettuce.  But this combination, due to the high quality of the bacon and the INCREDIBLE flavor of the chipotle mayo, was a true taste explosion.  I am not usually a sandwich eater...but I am now an instant addict of this sandwich.  The first bite was an infusion of intense bacony deliciousness contrasted with smoky, chipotle sauce with just the right amount of heat and a snazzy backbeat of garlic and tartness -- lime maybe?  I've been trying to deconstruct the sauce ever since.  It may take many, many enjoyable returns to the trough to be truly sure.  And did I mention the bacon?  I expected the usual overly salty, cheap lunch counter bacon that crumbles on your tongue like sawdust.  But no:  this had to be artisan bacon.  It was thick, glossy and chewy with a gorgeous silken flavor of bacon, maple, and a touch of woodsmoke.  Need I say more?  The sandwich was fully priced, but came with a generous serving of kettle style potato chips and a garlicky deli pickle.  For pure deli bliss with a twist (that chipotle sauce!) it was worth every penny. Note:  this is the latest attempt to make use of a difficult location, the basement level space beneath the clothing, Indian tapestry and jewelry shop Folk.  There is currently no real signage with the name "Allen Street Deli" visible anywhere -- just a blackboard with menu offerings at street level.  And the atmosphere is perfunctory, which is a waste.  The place needs some comfy seating, games on the tables, artwork on the walls, and good music to make it a place you want to linger.  Judging by my ecstatic sandwich experience, the place deserves a fighting chance.
Food is very good and the service is OUTSTANDING!! Watch out for Greg's magic tricks and the little pictures he draws on your take out containers. Try the boneless chicken tenders, real yummy!

4 Aces is a typical country diner: cheap (sometimes greasy) food, modest atmosphere, ect. It's possibly the best food you can get in the upper valley. I always get the corned beef eggs benedict and would recommend any of the benedicts. On the weekends you have to get there by 8am otherwise there will be a wait (10-25 mins). The only criticisms I have are their hash browns (giant potato wedges) are awful, would prefer any of the other kinds. Also some pancakes don't come with syrup and they charge you a few bucks for the real maple syrup instead of giving the option of the fake/cheap stuff.

I came in last night for resturant week and had an amazing meal -  largely impart because of my server Brian!  He was super attentive, helpful and charming too.  I would defiantely recomment this place - great indian inspired food!

Absolutely lovely. Consistently amazing service. GREAT vegan options! A wide selection of cocktails and beers. Weekly drink specials. A wide selection of pizzas for every taste. My favorite pizza place in New York. If you like cocktails -- the Blood & Sand is to die for!

A very special restaurant in every respect. The food is gourmet quality. The service and staff so well trained and welcoming. The ambiance is world class. Not an easy hike from midtown but well worth the effort. A must for food lovers.

The Halal Guys were an accidental food opportunity for me. I was up in mid-town to meet a client for lunch, lunch got cancelled so I met up with a colleague from work. He asked if I've had lunch - I hadn't. And he suggested the Halal guys. I've never even heard of them and my friend has been eating there since before they became popular. Good food, a good example in operational efficiency. Great value for money.
Excellent indian food! The garlic naan bread might be the best I have ever had and the chicken masala was equally good!

The food might be OK, it's hard to say since we ordered some but never received it. Here's what GrubHub had to say about them: "The restaurant doesn't have a driver tonight and failed to tell us that." That came about 30 minutes after I placed the order. Be warned.
Pork with provolone and rabe. Best ever, no but a good sandwich.  Have it cut in half and it is enough for two. Meat fairly juicy and the bread soaks up the juice nicely.

Amazing food and an even better experience. Staff is super friendly and welcoming, they make you feel like a special guest in their home. Where to begin with the food... I had a nice selection of oysters to start then The fish ribs, yes fish ribs are like nothing I have had before. The Moqueca (fishermans stew) with coconut rice explodes with flavor each and every bite. The cocktails are out of this world- can you say bacon infused bourbon!  Overall an exceptional experience, can't wait to go back.
Amazing service, innovative and delicious food/cocktails. Excited to have it in the neighborhood and excited to return for their happy hour!

I came here to get a sandwich and their "famous" bubble tea.  One of the biggest mistakes of my life. I received a bubble tea that had 15 baby tapioca balls at most and the flavor wasn't anything amazing. I went on to order a pastrami sandwich, however all I got was a sarcastic response and a laugh right in my face. So I conformed to getting the only sandwich they had, the only option I had was to pick the bread. There is no viarity when it comes to sandwiches. I sat down to wait for my food and ended up waiting 15 minutes for a sandwich that had melted cheese and cold chicken. It wasn't remotely fulling and on top of that there is some Asian women with one of the most annoying voices I've heard yelling out people's orders.  I will never come back here. Ever. Never in my life. Or my next life.

I've been to Marisilio's a dozen times, and also gotten takeout a dozen more.  Here's what I think overall: Pros: Amazing specials, and the regular menu is good too.  The Sunday dinner thing (pasta and various meat--meatballs, bracciole, sausage)is outrageously good.  Don't miss the stuffed hot peppers for an appetizer in season, or the broccoli rabe on the side. Cons: The restaurant is frequently really cold.  The tables for two are stuck out in the middle of the dining room, and very close together--not a great arrangement for when I'm looking for a quiet date with my spouse.  The people at the next table are well within your personal space, and the table itself is too small for much food--if you want to keep picking at the app during dinner, you're out of luck. Just weird: The service is completely inconsistent.  There was an older woman working there who was one of the best servers I ever had, we saw her several times.  The last time we were there was a Sunday--early evening, not at all busy-- and we were marooned in the middle of the dining room for hours before ordering, then again before getting served, then again before being able to wrestle the check out of them.   We haven't been back since.  I would give them another try but my husband won't.  Also, takeout (even if you order from the regular menu not the carry out) is much smaller portions but at the same price as eating in.

We were out and about and thought we would stop in dinner. After we were seated, my wife went to the bathroom to wash her hands. 30 seconds later, she came out. She demanded that we leave. It as a mess! One seat was torn off and during in the bowl and paper was everywhere. Too bad the food on the other tables around the place looked good.

I based my visit on the great yelp reviews but when we arrived we were met with disdain and disrespect. We were not acknowledged at the bar and given one menu for dinner. For two people. One menu to share. If you're going to charge me $20 for a sandwich, I'm not sharing a menu. And the blonde bartender pretended we didn't exist. Don't waste your time.
Best burger in NYC. The best burger there costs 9.75 before taxes and the meat is the best ever.

had the pleasure of finding Blue Point Grill in Princeton, NJ on my anniversary.  Our waiter, Tommy, was incredibly helpful and courteous.  Never pushy, but seemingly always present when we needed something.  Grilled octopus with lemon-olive oil was to die for.  Tasted like lobster.  Scallops were beautifully prepared and were grilled to perfection.  If you like seafood-Blue Point Grill is the place to go.  Richard T.

I ran inside Morgan's in the rain, a few minutes before they closed the kitchen. The bar was still bustling. The bartender noticed me immediately. "Do you still have food?" I asked, dripping rain and out of breath. "3 more minutes! You just made it!" I was so relieved, I LOVE the chopped brisket sandwich. I picked up a sandwich and a pound of brisket for my bf. Great BBQ, amazing authentic smokey flavor!

BEST TOMATO SAWCE!!! I had the Eggplant Parmesan and it was BOMB. They slice it pretty thin, cover it in red sauce, mozz cheese and more of the delicious red sauce over it, side of pasta, soup or salad. $15 not bad at all. My husband had the meatball sandwich, I tried a bite, it's not my fave. The server seemed like it was his first day on the job, but we all had to start somewhere ;-) First time in NJ for me and it wasnt a bad place to start for good eats in the east. Compliments to the mom/pop who decided to make their kitchen a reality for Jersey noobs like myself.

The service may be lousy, but at least the food is only average and the drinks are overpriced. The Yankee Doodle Tap Room -- or "The Nass" as it's known among the student body and alumni -- reeks with tradition and nostalgia, and that may merit a visit.  That said, the quality of service and food hearkens back to a time when The Nass was the only game in town, and there are myriad better places to eat and drink that have cropped up in the past 30 years that are vastly superior and more friendly. Favorite two stories -- one night a group of us placed an order.  We were continually assured by our server that "the food will be right out."  An hour later, same server confesses that the kitchen printer broke, and our order never made it to the cooks.  One might expect a visit by the manager with an apology and an offer for a drink or a dessert on the house, right? Not here. More recently, my friend and I ordered two of the same brand of single malt scotch, one neat, the other "with a little bit of ice" (his words).   Neat scotch:  $12  Scotch with two ice cubes:  $14.  I asked the server, who shrugged her shoulders and said "that just the way it is here." Worth a visit.  Once.

The best Creamees in Burlington, hands down!  Very thick and excellent flavor.  Friendly service too. Vermont Maple Creamee is highly recommended! So delicious!!!! Next time I am getting sprinkles on my creemee.

Get the omakase chef selection!!!  Freshest sushi/sashimi I've had imported from all over the world.  The grean tea creme brulee is a must have too.  They don't take reservations so get there early around 6-7pm to avoid long wait times.

Elizabeth institution, for as long as I can remember.  Been here a gabillion times, as I grew up, on Adams Ave,  Their take out is still, mostly good.  Restaurant has steadily declined.  Last visit on Tuesday, 9/16, was the final straw.... Let's start with the service. There is none.  Barmaid, who barely spoke/understood English took our order.  ****ed it up, royally.  Saw her once.  No drink refills, no, 'How are you doing, do you need anything'? Ok, garlic shrimp and stuffed mushrooms....shrimp were tiny pieces of rubber.  Smelled off...Two, mind you, TWO mushrooms I cut into had long pieces of HAIR!!!! Ugh...Not going well.... Ordered the Seafood Parrillaldo, sp?) and Seafood Fiesta...everything dry, overcooked, even with the sauce they drown it in....Mussels left grit in my mouth.  So, so, soooooo sad.....Got McDonalds, when we left.  Seriously. Becqause this has been my 'go to' place, without going into Newark, for as long as I can remember, I have never tried Valenca's.  Friends have always raved, I was, no thanks, like Algarves.  Not anymore. Also, screaming little kids running around bar, area!!!????!!!! Love kids!!!! Just not the place. Do yourself a favor.  Pass.  Go to Newark, or try Valenca's...or Spiritos....or a diner.   P.S.  Wasn't busy.  Saw 5 other tables...4 waitstaff....wtf?
I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the selections here. I had the salmon special and was blown away!!  I would highly recommend a visit if you're in the Burlington area.
good pho, not the best i've ever had but in hillside you can't beat this. i go there every few weeks. good place to takeout

I waited for about 20-25 mins for my take out order and when i finally got the bag a roach/beetle/insect crawled up to top. I thought i imagined it so I took all the food to put on the counter and sure enough there was one crawling around and one dead.  With all the 5 star reviews I figured it must be good, but that I wasn't expecting.  First and last time coming to this place

Why ruin good food with so much salt? Well prepared good produce but 6/8 dishes were too salty. The gazpacho was almost inedible. We mentioned the problem to the waiter who commented "Are you unfamiliar with this chef? This is his signature style. Salty".  One of our party ate little as the level of salt was so obvious he felt his blood pressure condition might cause problems. At 2am in the night, two of us met at the fridge gasping for water. Also the noise level meant we could not chat. They turned the music down a bit but soon cranked it back up. On my iphone it measured 84 decibels.

Came across this place during Balthazar day, where they give out one free Balthazar, and ended up buying a small box to bring up. Yeah, that's how good it was. I had the apricot, green tea (matcha), raspberry and a few others whose name currently escapes me. All I really remember, is gobbling it all down. Hard to savor something that tastes that good.
The wings are okay I prefer Applebee's wings! The clams are my favorite from there during happy hour! From 4 to 7

I recently came to Philly to visit family and I had heardthrough the grape vine that there were so many good places in philly to get notjust a good, but an incredible breakfast so my plan was to hit one place amorning and see what all the hub-bub was about. I went to Green Eggs, Sabrina'sCafé, Honey's Sit and Eat and then finally Morning Glory. My only regret is Ididn't find this place sooner. All the places I mentioned were good and theyall had their own little twist on how they do things but Morning Glory blew meaway and I worked in the food industry for 12 years of my life. I went there ona Wednesday right as they opened (7am by the way), the server was pleasant, andhe said something like "the diner is my oyster," sit anywhere I'd like. I got alittle chuckle out of that and grabbed a booth. He brought me a coffee and Ididn't even read the menu, I told him I was in the mood for something with eggsbut not just an omelet. He recommended I get the Burrito with meat in it, Ichose sausage. I guess it's because it was so early but it seemed like rightafter he walked away from my table, we talked for a few minutes and thenmagically my food was there. It was quite possibly the best breakfast item I'dever eaten, it was scrambled eggs with all kinds of vegetables wrapped in atortilla and topped with a delicious chile sauce that's definitely a Chilesauce but it wasn't anywhere near spicy enough that anyone who has a lowtolerance for all things spicy would have a problem with. I should also mention there coffee is unbelievableand the waiter explained to me they get their beans from a local provider whomade them their own blend. It was nice because it was so early that it was justme, the waiter and the cook. The waiter explained to me it picks up later, I'mjust an early riser and I could see what he meant, as I was finishing up moreand more tables were coming in. I paid for my meal, left a more than generoustip because the server (black shirt,black polo hat) did an excellent job serving me and he made me genuinely laughtwo or three times. So now it's Thursday morning and I was supposed to tryFitzwater Café but I loved my experience the day before so it was back toMorning Glory for me. I really wanted the burrito again but I opted forsomething sweet instead. It was nice to see I had the same waiter as the daybefore and he even remembered my name. He explained the Monkey French Toast wasfeatured on a TV show and if I like sweet, I'd love this. So Monkey FrenchToast it was. Man, was that awesome AND they bring you REAL maple syrup, noneof that fake sh*t (pardon my French). The 2nd day was the same greatservice, the waiter made me laugh again but it was a bit later and I could seehe was busier. I still always had a full coffee and in our talking the daybefore he explained to me that if they could make it there, they do... What hemeant by that was they don't have Heinz, they make their own and they also maketheir own jam which he said would make a nice appetizer on top of one of theirhomemade biscuits while I waited for my Monkey French Toast. Man, was he right.It was some sort of mixed berry jam but it was phenomenal. And then there wasthe steaming hot biscuit (I ended up getting one to go they were so good).I'mreading some of these other reviews and laughing because if I could give thisplace 10 stars I would. I already can't wait for my next trip to Philly. Wewere going to come for my mother's bday in mid February but now I'm thinkingabout spending xmas with ma this year. Wink wink...

As someone who frequents the Asian Grill, I can truly say what a great place it is to go and a great place to eat.  As I read some of these reviews I see that I am not alone.  It is a rare find to have a nice sit down chinesefood dinner in this area.  The staff is attentive, the food is excellent and the quality is good.  In the years that I have been going, I have never had a problem with either the staff or the food.  It is nice to go into a place where most of the staff knows you from previous visits.  I am a bid fan of shrimp and the variety of shrimp dishes offered gives me a sometimes tough choice.  Grand Marnier Shrimp is a must to try!     I also read the negative remarks written on 9/14/14.  I want to say that this guy must have had a bad day or maybe an off day at the restaurant.  But I do not think that is the case.  Formerly a service worker, I know that a long day is tiring and people want to go home.  I also walked in to this restaurant late and had a meal.  I had no problems with the staff or management but I was also respectful of the fact that the staff has most likely worked long hours and want to go home to finally relax.  Most people who go into any place late, do not realize or even care about what the employees went through that day or how long they have been there.  Even though I walked in late with my friend, we were welcome.      So trust me, as a man who likes to eat and a man who likes a relaxing sit down meal, this is the place to try.  Hopefully you won't run into a miserable person who wants his butt kissed instead of enjoying the little things in life!!

Service was fast and friendly. Ordered the calamari special which was pretty tasty and the linguine in clan sauce (white), which was ok. All portions serve 2-4 people so it's a great place to bring a group of people.
Food is real good on several lunches I had there.  Lamb burgers are very tasty.  Service is good but could improve.  I would go back but wish prices were lower.

My wife and I have been coming to La Taverna regularly for a few years now.  If it weren't for some of the staff who we've become good friends with, a generally nice ambiance (a great outside bar) and solid happy hour pricing I'm not sure I'd come back as often as I do, if ever.  Get ready to pay Manhattan prices right in the heart of Caldwell.  The prices make me ask myself "who are they kidding?" While the quality isn't bad, it is totally average and for the money there are plenty of better options in town.  The half priced drinks and bar menu make for a nice happy hour I will admit.  A major problem I have is despite having seen the bartenders scrub down everything, the bar has a problem with flies and not the kind you buy drinks and take home. I always see people swatting and putting napkins over their drinks. I'm honestly surprised the health inspector hasn't been by to say hello.  While I generally have a negative feeling towards this place and feel disgusted putting money in the owners pockets, it is a select few staff that keep me coming back.  They are the biggest asset to CIV.  Oh...and don't get me started on that eye sore of an entry way they just constructed.
Terrible service, solid food. Waiters are clueless and drinks are watered down. Will not return.
If you're wondering if you should ditch the line at Grimaldi and walk in to Juliana's... DO IT! Authentic and awesome. Fast. High value. Courteous service. Enjoy.

They have horrible customer service and they're delivery service is a complete joke. I placed my order at 11:30am and my order did not arrive till 2:30 pm. When you call inquiring about your order and it being late they give you attitude and tell you it's on it's way when clearly isn't!
Good food but service is crappy

45 W 8th St New York NY 10011 DO NOT GO THERE!!!! Were a group of four and 3 of us were feeling motion sickness after eating here!!!! The fourth person felt it but not as much!! He drank 1 drink and a coke!! The other of us drank three drinks each and felt as if we had been drugged!! Crazy ya think?!! Yeah I would think the same!   but unfortunately not.....

Take a trip back in time for massive and delicious sirloin burgers.   As someone who appreciates a quality cut of beef, the burgers here are fresh and delicious.  There is no pre-made patty and every burger is made to order, so they're all unique.  I recommend asking the server to have them cook the burger over flame for the last minute or two to really seal in the flavor.   For what you get, you can't beat the prices or portions.
Employees really nice food was good. . But loud music while eating and not being able to hear the people sitting at our table makes me not want to go back.. Will not recommend to friends ..
Unforgettable experience, one of the best food I've ever eat. Strongly advice to go, it's worth trying.
Oh my lord YUM?! The Artichoke pizza. It was insanely good. Ugh.

Great place to eat.  Have enjoyed breakfast, lunch, and dinner here in the past.  The breakfast is one of my favorites.  Love the atmosphere and have always had very good service.  From the girl that seats you to the manager that comes from table to table seeing if everything is ok.  Great southern food at a decent price.  One of my go to places for great food.
You can not beat the $5 PBR and house whiskey special.

I love cajun/creole food and was hoping for a good meal.  Was here a long time ago when it was Ricci's.  Ordered the the shrimp and grit cakes and sausage/ shrimp gumbo.  Shrimp and grit cakes had no flavor, tomatoes tasted like they just came out of the can with no seasoning whatsoever.  Shrimp we're definitely frozen and not fresh.  The roux/ gravy on the gumbo was holding more promise visually but had the same issue. Frozen shrimp and no depth of flavor.  Thank goodness the bartender set me up with some creole seasoning and hot sauce.  Service left something to be desired as well and it was not that busy around 7:30 or so....was also not inexpensive....Really wanted this to be good as I live close.....music sounded good though...
A good variety of food and books to choose from
Best margaritas and authentic Mexican in NYC! Orlando is the best bartender I have ever come across and treats you like family.  The margaritas are to die for people.
Ordered pad Thai to go and it was very poor.  Dry, barely spicey, with rubbery mushrooms.
Culinary nirvana.  Go.

Excellent food at non-NYC prices.  We had the cioppino (although it had a different name) and the lasagna.  The entree's were wonderful and enormous - we ate only half.  I had the house chianti, which was delightful - not typical of house wine offerings.  We thought the tiramisu was OK, not great. A few cautions:  note that they only accept cash.  Also, it's noisy and has pretty tight seating - you almost sit in your neighbor's lap. OVERALL:  DELISH + great value.
Excellent service and food. Great place to take my daughter when I visit her at Montclair state.

This place is a disaster.. They don't even acknowledge your existence. They don't greet you when you get in, you have to go around asking people when you can get seated and they just say "ask that guy over there, he can seat you!" That guy then says "yeah it will be a while" so we just stand there awkwardly for a while.... We waited a half hour to get a table, and then waited almost TWO hours for our food to get there. Keep in mind, this place wasn't even busy! There were open tables and the waitresses were just standing around looking miserable. When we finally got our food, it was very disappointing.. The manicotti was so sour and bitter, truly the nastiest I've ever had. I can't believe this place has good reviews.. They seem so unorganized and the staff they have is very unfriendly.. Our waitress looked like she hated her life and everyone she served. Never going here again, seriously sad place..

Charlie may have been a sinner, but his drinks and food are spot on. I live down the street from this lively place and went in for the first time a few days ago. I asked the bartender, Joe, which drink he would recommend and he provided me with a delicious drink that was not on the menu called the Martinez. If you like bourbon, I highly suggest asking for this. My friend and I also ordered the chickpea fries, charred caesar salad and the ricotta dip with bread and everything was delicious. Service was also great. I'll definitely be going back.
Best customer service and delicious Arabic food prepared the way you like it.

This place is yummy!!! Super great brunch! All the food was amazing. Good service. They were very kind to bring me vinegar, lemon, honey and hot water for my sore throat. Our party ordered the apple gruyere omelette, spinach mushroom omelette, Benedict, and spinach goat cheese croissant. All were excellent. The fruit bowl side was also very nice. Crispy potatoes were perfect and the side salad fresh (ps. I really like East coast bunch serves a small salad with the entree; makes the meal so balanced and I feel healthier for it). Oh yeah, coffee so excellent I could drink it black. I'm curious to try Le Barricou for dinner, and I would probably return for brunch- more for the space and trip to Williamsburg, than for the food.

As good as everybody says it is.  Very seldom do these types of places live up to the hype.  This one does.  In the summertime, this place is almost magical, with families enjoying pizzas and memories at the tables outside.  In winter, you won't wait as long. The pizza is heavy on the bread and sauce (um, yum!) with a light dusting of cheese. Slices are always fresh out of the oven, and two of these bad boys are plenty for dinner (and will leave you enough room for spumoni for dessert). Get a mix of all three flavors (pistachio, vanilla and chocolate). It's a really good thing I don't live near here, because if I did I'd be eating this pizza all the time...and probably be obese. Next time you're in Brooklyn you have to have this pizza...it's incredible.

It's been almost 2 years since I've been here but I was happy I stayed local for a quick Friday night bite. Easy parking, good service & great food.  Clams in white sauce were devoured in mere seconds.  The stuffed long hots were good, but beware the heat definitely caught me a little off-guard. The strip steak was cooked perfectly and the veal saltimbocca was very good as well. Overall this is a solid BYOB spot where you can get 2 apps, 2 entrees & 2 desserts for about a $100.

A great selection of both craft beers (which rotate daily - if not more often during the day) and small batch bourbons/whiskeys, very knowledgeable bartenders, a mature (non-aggressive) crowd and an AMAZING menu keeps me coming back again and again!
