Arrived at 12:30 am, kitchen was closed.  It is soooo aggravating to go to restaurants that advertise late night dining when you are really hungary, drive there and find out THE KITCHEN IS CLOSED.
Went back to Black Ant again, Absolutely amazing! Same flavors, same strong great cocktails, same warm and friendly service. And the staff is always awesome!

After reading so many great reviews on this place we ventured out of our cozy bay ridge and decided to give brunch a try. SOOO very glad we did!! There was a wait when we got there around 12:30 which we expected so we saddled up to the bar and were offered to have brunch there. Sure!! No wait! Our bartender/server was Sumaiya and she was PHENOMENAL. Her suggestions on drinks and food were on point. I had the hibiscus margarita and my bf had the strawberry moonshine. Both delicious! I ordered the crawfish eggs Benedict and he had the crowd favorite of fried chicken and waffle but it's a RED VELVET waffle! On her suggestion we got a side of the Mac n cheese. To call it a side doesn't do it justice because it's a meal on its own! My bf doesn't really like waffles but these waffles made him a believer! Now he says he just likes THESE waffles. They were fluffy and perfect! My Benedict was amazing with perfectly poached eggs and an old bay hollandaise that was beyond good! We will definitely be back and most likely for dinner next time!! Well done!!!
Delicious and great service.
Order the spicy ramen and added a soft boiled egg. Great!!! Perfect portion. Don't go during dinner hour, long wait

Left a bad taste in my mouth--literally! Not only was the service poor and very slow--with the waiter forgetting to bring one of the appetizers and then disappearing so it was hard to get the missing item--but the food was quite mediocre to poor. The fried artichoke appetizer was fairly good, but the saltibocca di pollo had an unpleasant oily, smoky flavor that overpowered all of the ingredients. Tasted like the food had been doused with liquid smoke or something similar. I was unable to eat some of the dessert biscotti because they tasted like someone had put salt instead of sugar. Given all the excellent reviews, I can't understand why my friends and I got such a poor meal--for a rather high price. And that oily, smoky flavor is still in my mouth hours later.
Delicious noodle and cottage cheese plate. Simple but filling. The stuffed cabbage is just like mother made. Hosts are very hospitable
Meh.

Food is AMAZING but the service is terrible.  Visited this establishment for a second time yesterday for Brunch.  Place was not very busy.  There were three of us and it took 45 minutes for us to get our food.  It seemed like there was only one waiter working in the entire place.  The waiter came by our table and told us that would meals were being plated - which took 10 minutes.  I ordered the french toast burger and the burger was 100% raw.  I had asked the waiter to send it back.  It took 15 minutes for my burger to come back.  The two other people who were with me were finished their means before I received mine for the second time.  When I looked at the burger, half of it was missing and all of the cream cheese icing had been scraped off.  I told this all to the waiter and he apologized and said he would "take care of some of it."  After receiving the bill I notcied that I was still charged $12 for the burger.  I notified the waiter and he apologized and then removed the charge completely.   It is a shame that service is so slow both times that I went to this restaurant as the food is quite delicious.  Not sure if I would go back a third time.

The food here was fantastic! We had the bhel puri and paneer tikka dry for our appetizers. For dinner we had butter paneer, chana masala, raita, and naan. Easily the best paneer tikka we have ever had. The texture was perfect and it was just the right amount of spicy. The chana masala was good, not the best, but not enough to take away a star. The naan was so light and crispy. The butter paneer was also excellent. We're definitely going to visit again.
Until coming here, I had never tried Japanese desserts. Now I'm kind of obsessed. Damn you cha an.

Had a lousy dining experience today worth sharing.  After officiating at a funeral service, decided to stop for lunch at a restaurant I had visited once before when I was visiting family in Missouri.  The restaurant in question is "Buffalo Wild Wings".  The experience in Missouri was positive, so when I saw one in my area, decided I'd top in for lunch.   Huge mistake!   Things started pleasantly enough, until I placed my order and it arrived.   The order was totally wrong.   The waiter said, no problem, he would get the right order out quickly, as I had limited time.   A few minutes later, the order arrived, and I consumed about half of it, and requested a doggy bag to take home.  Soon the waiter arrived, asking me if I wanted dessert.   I declined, indicating that I had received a critical call and needed my check so I could get on the road.   Some time passed, before the check arrived, so I left a cash tip (20%) even though that was overly generous for the less than stellar service.   The check came, I paid it with my debit card, and the server picked it up.  Soon he returned for me to sign it, which I did, then left.  Didn't realize something was missing:  they failed to return my debit card.   I only discovered this fact about twenty miles down the road when I stopped for gas and no debit card.   I had a meager amount of cash left, enough to put in enough gas to return to the restaurant to retrieve the debit card.  When I arrived, I had to wait a while before the manager finally came for the with my card.  He said the server chased me to the parking lot, to no avail.   To say that he "chased" me was clearly an exaggeration, as I'm 61 years old and I didn't sprint to my car, which was some distance from the entrance to the restaurant.   A decent restaurant would have at least offered an apology, if not some form of comp for the additional 40 miles of driving and lost time.   Not "Buffalo Wild Wings".   My second and last time to patronize this establishment.  The food was ok, but not outstanding.  The service was substandard.  Perhaps I share some blame in not being more aware of the fact that my card had not been returned when I paid the bill, but being that I was already delayed in departing due to their poor service had me thinking more about getting back on the road.  My verdict is that "Buffalo Wild Wings" is a fast buck, low customer satisfaction operation.   From here on out, I'll eat elsewhere.

I love the sushi here. I usually order out since the dine in service is slow. My favorite roll are the Rock and roll and the Easter roll, if you're a fan of smoked salmon you will not be disappointed.

We had an absolutlely amazing special event christening dinner yesterday afternoon. Every single detail was perfect! The food was outstanding! Such a great menu! The staff  was wonderful and could not do enough! We will be back and recommend to all!

Myself, husband, and kids visited Rincon last Friday evening after a long time (approx. 15 yrs) anyways, the place looked the same.  First off, the soup was really, really  good, the bread was ok.  we order baked clams and a snail appe, out of this world, I ordered the paella for me and son, as we both loved it, and it always is a lot, and we end up taking it home, sorry, but not good, non of the seafood was fresh, the rice was soggy, it had a horrible smell, that throw off the whole meal. my husband ordered the broil whole red snapper, he was pretty satisfied, he enjoyed it, then my daughter ordered the garlic chicken, it was not what she expected, she said it tasted like fish.  the red sangria was  excellent, not watered down, plenty of wine, did not order desert. would not visit again, as we always enjoyed Iberia in Newark.

I love this place. The food is delicious. But does anyone else feel jittery and have a pounding heart rate after eating their food? I've eaten there twice in the past week for dinner and both times could not sleep or slept really poorly after. I hate to bash this place, bc, like I said, the food is delicious. But the past two times i've eaten here, I simply felt WEIRD -- hyper, keyed up, jittery. Literally almost makes me wonder if I'm reacting to some spice in their food. Anyone else experience this?

I came here with a friend of mines who recommended their food, because they come often, about twice a month.  I tried There-Egg Omelette with Irish Ham, Cheddar, Tomato, Caramelized Onions, Hash Browns, Sour Dough.  Sorry no pic, but it was delicious.  I loved the feel of the atmosphere, and the music was grr8.  I can't wait to try a different entree.

Want to dinosaur bbq last nigth with my family , i an use to dinosaur bbq in rochester wich is always great .well very disappointed with this one . I ordered the beef ribs and asked the waitress if she had the corn on side dish , she said no . So iorder the cold slaw and my wife the pork ribs with mac and cheese . When asked the waitress if was any special ,she said no they are not ready yet it was 6 pm . When the food got to our table ,the next table to us was ordering diner with a different waitress , when she started to tell the specials , she mentionned the corn on special .  Now the meal , the beef ribs where cut korean style , they where very very tuff and very dry like a left over bbq from the day before . Not good . The mac and cheese from my wife where also very bad . Nothing like we are use to from dinosaur bbq in other locations . I would never go back there snd not recommend to any one. I am not talking about harlem location ,i have been there and it was great ,but the brooklyn location .

Passion fruit - jalapeño martini to die for. Stopped in for happy hour tonight with my girl friend   . Great time .... Great apps... WOW and only  5 bucks. Very friendly staff. Will be back soon for dinner. 5 star plus.
What a great find. Cool place really good wait staff and the food. There was not one drop left in my Boulibasse - and the bread could not get enough. Highly recommend going here

Really good! Heuvos Del Sol is the best. Terrific service. A little slow but understandable because they are mobbed for Sunday brunch. My son had the meat lovers omelet and loved it. My wife was equally pleased with her breakfast burrito. Nice environment, very lively crowd interesting space. I've never had a bad experience at Magnolias.

Stumbled upon this place for brunch this weekend. The staff was kind and helpful and the food was delicious! It is also quite large and nice vibe. I really liked the interior. I absolutely recommend this place!

Went here for Sunday brunch with a friend. We were immediately greeted by the host and Eddie, GM. Such a genuine, sweet man! He really knows how to welcome guests and show them a good time. I was entertained by the chic atmosphere and bright sunlit decor. Our server Maggie...awesomesauce and very attentive. Our glasses of mimosas were never empty. She was cool and very personal, I love that! I had the eggs Benedict, which was exactly what I was looking for. Delicious! I wish this place lots of luck and will be telling all my friends about it. I will definitely be coming back!

I recently reserved a table on a Friday night at the Above restaurant so my wife and I can enjoy dinner together. The atmosphere was comfortable with the room about half full. My first order was the Caesar salad and a glass of the Sycamore Lane White Zinfandel. My wife chose the spinach salad with the Zinfandel wine. We both enjoyed the salad and wine which was excellent. The waiter was efficient in taking the order and the time waiting for our meal was minimal. For the main course, I ordered the Mediterranean Salmon which was excellent and my wife had the French Herb Chicken which was delicious. The food portions were so generous that we took home leftovers. Overall, the service was sufficient, the food satisfactory and the overall appearance was very good.
I think this place is just OK. I've been many times and have tried several dishes.. but it seems just mediocre. A safe option for a work lunch.

We used to love this place, and order take out about once a week.  But, lately the food hasn't been great.  The guacamole tasted very strange, the rice wasn't good and too much of it was used in the burrito and the chicken has been very salty for the last three orders.  It's too bad, because our order is always ready quickly and the food was always great before.

We came in on a busy Sunday night for the first time. The food was authentic, we ordered the tofu summer roll to start, medium pho special p1, and chicken with lemongrass and chili rice plate which were all delicious. We also order the cassava cake which was very tasty as well with the chocolate syrup.. We will be back.

I am blown away by every item I have had the delectable pleasure to experience at this quiet gem. Each item from the appetizers, soups, entrees, desert, beverages and deserts are scrumsciously amazing. The owners and staff make you feel very welcome and want to make certain that you are well pleased with your choice. We will return again and again. Highly recommended.

Awesome food.  Awesome service.  Had the avocado spring rolls with peanut sauce with a thai iced tea, which were terrific.  Then had grilled pork with spring rolls over rice noodles!  Atmosphere is also very nice, neat, and clean.
Started with the Fried Crispy Squid Delicious! So Fresh. Then the Spring Rolls and Grilled Pork over Vermicelli The flavors all blended together and were amazing! Service was great.
Great neighbourhood bar where you immediately feel like a local. Definitely worth a visit if you are in the area although be careful - you may not want to leave!

When in Philly, one must try an authentic PHILLY CHEESESTEAK SANDWICH!!!!!! I didn't though because I don't eat beef. I came here with two other friends whom are both huge carnivores and foodies. They got the philly cheesesteak (And also learned how to order it with melted cheese. It's called with wist? Or something like that haha) and I got a pork sandwich (with wist again.) The pork was okay! Wasn't spectacular, wasn't extremely flavored. But the vibes made up for it. Everyone was so enthusiastic about these sandwiches! The line also wasn't incredulously long too, so no one was grouchy. Overall, worth the try!! Especially if you aren't from Philly like me.

I had been to their express location in the Upper East Side, so I thought I would give this place a try for a pre theater dinner. I had Lomo Saltado - it was fantastic. Tender steak, delicious seasoning, crisp tomatoes. My friend had the paella - she said it was delicious. The restaurant was beautiful and lively. Service was very prompt and courteous. And all in all, a very good value.

Absolutely delicious. I think this was actually the best meal I've ever had. I went with one other person and we had pumpkin soup with hazelnut bread, some sort of sausage and lentil appetizer, suckling pig ravioli, the Corzetti (pasta coins, braised goat, mint, and chili oil), and the Roasted Rack of Rabbit, along with two cocktails. The meal was a little pricey ($130+tip for two people, but given everything we got that doesn't seem so bad), but that's literally my only negative. Every single aspect of the meal was superlative. Every dish we had was so different, but all equally amazing. The cocktails were also very, very good. Wow. The person I was with said it was better than Vetri, where he'd been a couple weeks prior. Amazing, amazing meal. Can't wait to go back.
Love this place and the cute Italian guys who run it. Their sandwiches are delicious and they even have wine now!
Yum. yum. yum. This is my favorite spot for brunch in the Slope. They even have seating outside for those nice summer days! They tacos are excellent and by far my favorite.

Great prices, huge menu. These folks are doing a great job brining more options to Hartford diners. From Kimchi Ramen and Bimbambap to Burritos and Burgers to Breakfast Sandwiches, no matter which of their multitude options you pick you will be happy. Plus, they have bubble tea and tons of other delicious smoothies and healthy options.
Delicious restaurant, great service! Try out the Bali Urap salad and the Market Fish curry. They also have expresso and Affogato - a typical Italian ice cream and coffe!!!
THIS PLACE IS SO GOOD! I want to eat here everyday. A million stars.

This might be only the third time I truly think a full establishment deserves a 5 star review. Everything was on point from the drinks to the food to the service. We had the fruit guacamole that was great. I was worried the sweetness of the fruit would get in the way but it was delicious. We also tried the quesadilla with manchego and truffle with roasted corn which was amazing. We almost ordered 10 more. The last thing we tried was the short rib tacos. I stole the rest or my girlfriends when she wasn't looking. We might break up because of it. We had a few different cocktails. I had the smoky mescalita de piña and my girlfriend had the melocita. Both were great and I'll definitely come back because the have a lot of great happy hour drinks too. Finally our service was amazing. Incredibly accommodating by answering all of our questions. We sat at the bar and they really took care of us. Best dining experience I've had in the neighborhood yet.

Your typical meat packing B & T crowd.  Not worth the aggravation of trying to justify that you are hear by choice and not that it is or was the place to go. Food is ok. Way overpriced for what you end up with.  Same with the cocktails. Not my cup of tea. Leave it to the B & T'ers.  These two deserve each other.

My friend who gets delivery to his place at 172 culver ave regularly, turned me on to Lins gourmet few months back when he ordered the ribs. The spare ribs are outstanding and tonight I said to try the chicken wings. Well they are golden crispy and fresh also. Not your regular old Chinese chicken wings. I highly recommend this place to anyone in the area.
5 Stars , Chili Lobster , ANY pasta , chicken under a brick , one of the best meals you could have , Forgione is a god damn gangster , The End , youre welcome

I suppose I just had the short end of the stick, but I had really bad stomach pains after my one and only lunch there. I give two stars because the service was impeccable and the rest of the party did not have my problems. Still I'll leave it to them to give it more stars.
Amazing flavor, perfect blend of spices. When I went I didn't have to wait at all and the staff was nice. I recommend the chicken.
I always order online and pick up - normally have to wait a few minutes, but the food is good and the portions are great.  Normally get two meals out of the dinner bento box

If you're like me, you don't have an abundance of GF options for dining in your hometown.  I found this place while searching GF options prior to my trip and was thrilled to hear about it's GF accommodations.  Unlimited GF breadsticks brought to the table as soon as we were seated!  My friend is not GF and was not super impressed with them, but I thought they were delicious and so happy with the gesture.  The GF menu offered several options for paninis, another meal I usually don't get to have.  I ordered the Italian sausage panini and it was fantastic.  There are also options for GF deserts and they sell GF baking mixes and snacks to go.  It was a wonderful experience to go to a restaurant and not be limited to a tiny selection AND to be able to enjoy the breadsticks instead of grudgingly watching others eat them while I can't.  My friend ordered a pizzette (not GF) and was quite pleased.

"Finito." This is what our waiter (also apparently the manager of the place, from what I could tell) told us when we asked for an additional basket of bread stick. Hopefully, it will also be what everyone says to considering supporting their business further. I called a day prior to make a reservation, because we had 11 people in total. When we arrived they attempted to squeeze in a customer before us because we arrived roughly 20 minutes early at the table they cleared for us. So we awkwardly stood beside the table and watched them hustle these two ladies through a full meal in sub-20 minutes (ordering and everything). Anyways, back to the bread sticks. Aside from the portions being pathetic, at best, we received two baskets of break for each side of the table (remember, 11 people). The food didn't come out for forever so another round was brought out. When the food finally did come out, we asked if we could have a third, particularly because some people had to split bread and everyone was starving (compounded by paltry serving size). It was then the manager infamously said "Finito." We were effectively told we were not allowed anymore. Well, "finito" to you, ______ (fill in as you see appropriate from review, or go and find out yourself - your loss).

My partner and I attended Miss Rachel's Saturday night family-style dinner.  It. Was. Amazing. The food was outstanding; we were totally blown away by the complexity of flavours and the beautiful plating.  I want to talk about all the food, but I'll spare you.  Highlights included the lentil-tempeh slider (with eggplant bacon, amazing pickles and other delicious stuff) and the delicata and butternut squash bisque (so good I dropped my spoon). Sitting at the same table with a bunch of random folks was a ton of fun!  We ended up staying for, like, an hour or two after dinner chatting with one couple, our wonderful waitress Sally and Miss Rachel herself. The atmosphere was fantastic.  Cute jawns on the walls, candles hither and thither.  I'm not good at describing these elements, but they were lovely. Eat here.  You will not regret it.  Srsly.

First stop with friends for a birthday dinner in my honor. We arrived 40 minutes after our reservation and were seated immediately. The wait staff provided incredible service and was very knowledgeable. The sea bass was sold out given how late we arrived but the red snapper was among the best fish meals I've had. Great ambiance and impeccable food quality and freshness. ABC Kitchen exceeded expectations.
Had dinner here Sat 9/20.  Great meal!  Fabulous service.  Waking distance from Hilton Manhattan East. Delicious offerings eclectic combinations of flavors.  Highly recommend!!

There are literally 6 pizzerias within walking distance in Boonton, but this one takes the cake!  I've had salads, chicken parm, regular pies, specialty and Sicilian - all totally on point.  It's BYOB which I like (there's a liquor store next door!) and it's conveniently located.  Best pizzeria in Boonton!

BEA and it's very kind owner + staff care for their guests like family. It is so refreshing to find a place here in nyc that has the perfect balance of service, menu and atmosphere.  The cocktail and wine selection is well curated. The menu offers a scrumptious selection of both comfort and sophistication foods. The Atrium area is perfect for small parties as well.  I have been here a few times now and the most important thing I can share is that everyone that works there cares about you and if you're having a pleasant experience. BEA is a true gem! Please check this place out for yourself. Cheers!

The food was largely excellent - for starters, the chèvre tartelette was amazing, baby octopus and mussels in dijon sauce were also very good. For mains, the filet mignon with foie gras was incredible, though the heavy sauce was a little too dominant and overwhelmed the softer flavours of meat and foie gras a little. We also enjoyed the lamb a lot; the hanger steak was the only main that we thought could have been better - it was too fatty. It's very cosy - quite a lot of people crammed into a small space. It worked out fine for us, but if your neighbours are loud this may be annoying. Service was very friendly. In all, it was a lovely evening that left us very happy and planning to return.

They make my absolute favorite Vietnamese sandwiches.  I always get the original BBQ pork sandwich. The flavor is so delicious- sweet mixed with salty, and the pickled vegetables add another dimension of flavor.  They are generous with the meat and fixings but the price is so reasonable.  Many other places are mostly bread with very little filling but they cost more too.  I've been eating Banh Mi Saigon sandwiches since I was a kid, so around 30 years, give or take.  I have always found their sandwiches consistently delicious.  This is the place I always recommend to friends and people who want a great Vietnamese sandwich.  Try it!  You will not regret it!

Although the meat was tender and the flavor was good, the service was awful! So few patrons and yet we had a long wait to be served. Three of us the table ordered different meals, yet they all looked and tasted the same.

I'm adding my humble two cents to a plethora of praise, but I have to say RTM may be the best place in Philadelphia given the number of awesome vendors here! You can find anything you crave and it's usually delicious.   Such a unique and fun place.  I would love to go here everyday!

I visit the North Jersey area two or three times yearly and always stop at The Whisky Cafe Saturday evenings on account of its music and festive atmosphere of quality live music, dancing and amiability. The groups are top notch entertainment geared toward the 50+ crowd, drinks and food are moderately priced, and freeway access/parking is excellent. I am very well-traveled and don't know of any places as this if one enjoys 50s and 60s music. There's not much to criticize; a good time is all you are looking for in this clean and hospitable venue. I cannot speak to the other nights' entertainment or atmosphere as I have only attended on Saturday. However, it's a uniquely fun place; it should not be missed if you appreciate excellent, live music and vocals.
LOVE this place.  The food is always good and consistent. The owners are very welcoming.  The lunch menu is a steal!

We liked eating here. The noise level is not too high, the staff is well  trained and the menu is varied. You can eat cheaply or more extravagantly with lots of options. We had the soup specials and they were delicious. The Cobb Salad was huge with lots of shrimp. This is close to the theaters and the staff were eager to tell us all about what there was to do in the neighborhood. We would eat there again.

Was able to finally came to this place to eat. Few times before was only for drinks and this place gets busy. prepare to wait. The cocktails here are very delicious, which made the wait seems shorter.  Most of my friends tried their burgers and they were all very satisfied, I ordered the seafood, don't know why, it came out good as well. I know this supposed to be the west village gem, and I can finally check off my list !
Stopped in not expecting to stay long. Stayed longer than we thought!! What a great time! Thanks Erin and Richie!
OG place for pork soup dumplings!

Pizza was good, but not the best I ever tried, the garlic knots were very good, Service was polite but just the usual thanks and smile, nothing special. We may stop by again if in the area, but will not make the special trip.
Unbelievable place for food, great portion size, great price and best of all great guys that work there. I recommend it to anyone for a quick easy healthy meal from some great people.

Gorgeous restaurant/bar. The food is very good (try the french toast) and they have really good fries! Can't complain about the service; friendly and helpful staff. Our new favorite breakfast/brunch place. Highly recommended :)

Getting into a debate about pizza with someone can be just as dangerous as opening up a discussion about religion or politics...it is something that can lead to a huge argument. But when we decide we want pizza...there is usually no debate about where we're headed. And we'll defy anyone to show us if there is any better pizza than the square pizzas at L&B Spumoni Gardens in Brooklyn , N.Y. This place is simply iconic. It has been around for generations and continues to be as popular as it ever was. During the warmer weather, the lines for pizza and their famous spumoni can be winding around the large area of picnic-style tables which are always packed. And during the colder months, there are always people vying for a table inside the pizzeria which is separate from the more formal restaurant. We can never get enough of the pizza...which explains why we recently went for dinner and drove back over the two bridges the very next day to get more for lunch. And, of course, you can't leave without finishing it all off with the best spumoni you will ever find. This place is frequented by the locals...and it is also revisited often by those who have moved away. During our last visit someone said that they traveled a great distance to bring their family for dinner because, "You just can't find this kind of pizza and dessert any place else. It makes you feel like you are home." Hmmm...he is so right. Visit the Karmin Kuisine Tour at our website or on Facebook.

The food was delicious, but the service was not up to par. Our waiter was not knowledgable about the menu and seemed confused when I asked for both sparkling water and ice water. The servers were friendly, but the man refilling our water seemed offended but I stopped him before he poured ice water into my glass of sparkling water. I appreciated that there were great options for vegetarians.

This is my FAVORITE restaurant. I can eat here everyday and not get tired of how amazing the food is. The food is so fresh and extremely delicious. I live for this restaurant. The Greek salad, lemon potatoes, and fried calamari are beyond this world. For the price you can't beat the quality or the portions.
Fried chicken is great. Nice waitstaff.

Besides the oysters and the excellent local beers we we served a perfectly balanced main dish of fish and vegetables (monkfish and brussels sprouts). Friendly and knowledgeable service (oyster recommendations). On a Friday night we could be seated within 20 minutes. Affordable prices.

I ordered from New Jin Lin for the first time and the food was ok. I had the Chicken and Broccoli and it was doused in sauce. The delivery on the other hand was AWFUL. The driver called and said he was "outside". I thought it was strange that he didn't come up to the door so I had to put on my shoes and jacket go outside and meet him. As I'm putting on my shoes, he starts to honk frantically in my apartment parking lot, alarming all of my neighbors. When I asked him why he didn't come to the door, I could not understand his response. Needless to say, not the best delivery experience.

I have been looking forward to going to Blend on the water since my family gave it rave reviews. I was there on Monday and absolutely loved it. The hostess was very nice and inviting, our waitress Alexis was awesome. She made our night very enjoyable. The drinks were great and the food was phenomenal. The ambiance was great. Definitely returning sooner than later.

What a great experience! Our waitress Kayla was helpful, upbeat and polite. The service was top notch and so was the food. The arepas were absolutely delicious as well as everything else. The view is stunning and overall Blend on the Water has a great ambience. I would like to thank Kayla for making my birthday dinner very pleasant. She was attentive and it was nice to see that she really loved her job. I will come back just to see her! Thank you again Kayla.

First, the service was exceptional. Second, I can't complain about the complimentary appetizers (yup, more than one!). Third, the pasta dishes were very well cooked and sauced. I highly recommend the sea food black linguine special. Fourth, the veal with spinach and cheese was awesome. Last, but not least, tiramisu was so great! It was the best I have ever had. I give five stars.

This place was highly recommended to us. We ordered the beef satay on a stick, boneless spare ribs, chicken with white rice and the beef lo mein (small). The total was $21 and they do not include free drinks with any amount of order apparently. The chicken was so/so but my husband said his ribs were too dry and the beef was overcooked. The lo mein was nothing to write letters to home about . At least we can say we tried it there.

This place is great! Everyone must try the chicken fajitas they are so good. The drinks are even better and cheap. While your waiting for your table to get ready you can help yourself to a drink at the bar and some chips and salsa! This is a good place to bring your family, birthday dinners, date nights or if you just want some good Mexican food!!
The food was great. Bring your whole family whenever you decide to take a chance on some new, and delicious food in the montclair area. I guarantee that you won't be disappointed.

I'm a big fan of Boonton Sushi House but this place came highly recommended and the menu looked yum, so I figured I'd try them out.  Got two rolls, Rainbow Roll and Mexican Roll - they were....ok.  Nothing out of this world.  Fish was ok, but a bit flavorless.  I really wanted to like this place - but - back to Boonton Sushi House.

Solid on the service and atmosphere (old tap room feel).  I had the fish tacos and my buddy had the grilled cheese.  Both were tasty. Tossed back few coronas and tequila shots. Watched some football and headed out for a show.
This place has great banana bread!
Incredible.  Never had such a good noodle experience.  Vegi friendly! We will never find a place like this again.

What a great evening; the food is excellent! We ordered 5 dishes and we enjoyed all of them. Everyone that goes here has to order the figs wrapped in bacon with blue cheese... One of the nicest dishes we have eaten!
The service is very awesome!!! We eat the lunch buffet, $12/per person.(include tax) The food is very delicious and it is a  vegetarian friendly restaurant!!
The best ceviche I've had, period. Good service, friendly servers. Good choice for a date.
Pretty good restaurant. Food was tasty. Service was a little slow. I'll try it again.

We had really good Tuesday night dinners. The roasted bluefish was fresh and really delicious. Also had excellent flank steak. Dessert included the the lemon coconut cake ~ yum. The decor has been updated and looks unique yet contemporary . Will go again! Oh, and it's BYOB so bring your own.

Great selection of traditional Greek dishes and others that are uniquely MP inspired. Most Greek restaurants have that "old" feel and are pretty formulaic with regard to the menu and decor.  MP is the cure for the common Greek restaurant as both the ambiance and the menu are refreshingly new and fresh.  The restaurant has two floors, each with its own vibe; the upstairs is the more traditional dining area, while the downstairs has the modern feel with the vibrant bar scene.  The outdoor dining area is supple and will continue to become more impressive as Ditmars progresses with its renaissance.  Suffice to say the neighbors have plenty to look at when they face MP. The food ranges from things you would consider classic Greek entrees and appetizers, to those that seemingly have a classical base with a twist, to those created by the genius of Chef Michael Psilakis.  Portions are usually generous and taste wise, the food always hits the spot.  Another benefit are the prices, especially when you compare apples to apples with the 'old' Greek restaurants in and around NYC.  When you do compare prices it becomes clear that the competitors are severely marking up the costs of their fish.  The whole pig/lamb and other whole animal options look delicious and I MUST try them in the future.

I brought all my friends here and they all loved it. We do not mind waiting for 45 mins (sometimes an hour) since it is all worth it! Noodles were so tasty - kai dama! Broth was always heavenly! And the pork bun? To die for!

I know I'm giving this place high marks, but let me put it this way. The prices are very reasonable, the empanada's are filling, but the menu is way better than other places that charge 3x the price and are not even decent. I have brought family and friends here, and they also love it. Most Spanish restaurants up town are so arrogant and comfortable with their food that they don't even care or bother, but New Yorkers can tell, we just don't come back and bad mouth you to everyone we know. How can you not even try?
had a great meal at this little restaurant in carrol gardens. the food and service was exemplary. also spoke to the chef nice guy, kinda looks like a low level pirate.

It's not easy finding a restaurant accommodating to gluten free diet but this certainly is and delicious at that. With a wide assortment of risotto and tasty sides and salads I rate my experience here well. The service wasn't up to par just givin the time I was there I would expect more attention my appetizer nearly sat on my table over 5 minutes when finished before being removed. But overall a great meal. Not the best risotto but certainly close.

Great food... Friendly service (Kristina) and from a wine snob.... The wine is not bad!   I had the chicken/sausage marsala special and it was great!  I will definitely come back on my next trip to New York!

CASH ONLY AND NO MORE SCONES. We went there to try the Earl Grey scones we've heard so much about, but they've been taken off the menu. :-( Also, the place only takes cash, so we went elsewhere; if they'd still had the scones we would've run to an ATM, but they didn't.
Amazing, every single time. Go with a group and try everything. Cool place and better food.

I usually drive to Teaneck to get my sushi fix.  Momoya is a nice place with a good atmosphere that takes pride in their presentation and customer service.  Some of the plates laid in front of us where like little pieces of artwork you almost didn't want to disturb, I said almost.  I enjoyed the view and then devoured the rolls one bite at a time.

We had heard great things about this restaurant, but were disappointed in the service. We had a party of six, and were only served five pieces of veal for our table. Instead of adding one more piece, we were told we would have to order a whole additional plate. While the quality of the food was good, the poor service made this an unhappy experience.

Chana Bhatura is expensive, not because it's 8.50 but because we wait 2 months to create the one occasion to indulge after hours in a the gym. Those who know the difference between maida puri and bhatura should skip to the next paragraph. Others please understand what your bread will taste like if not fermented; bland, flat and unexpected. If you are the yelp ninja seeking surprising new food that is unique and deserves a new cuisine classification, please enjoy yourself. I am likely to avoid this temptation. Good news about the Chana is that it saves you the trouble of going to Cinnabon later. There was enough cinnamon there to make you wonder if you just smoked gudung garam; the Indonesian cinnamon cigarette. Credit to the establishment that the Chana was well cooked; regardless of taste. I am contemplating if I should go back to the Edison location; or perhaps save the family from the 8 times a month exposure ..

Place is worthless! After calling this place "4" times and finally getting someone to answer they tell me they are closing at 10pm instead of 4am. Nice customer service people! I'll be back....yeah right.
Large portions do not make up for sloppy food. A new place may still be going through adjustments; but we think it's more likely that the kitchen is not being run by experts.

We originally came here because the head chef, Harold, won season one of Top Chef, It is a small restaurant with very cool decor. I loved the meal I got as well as everyone else's food. The bar drinks were very sophisticated and dessert was unforgettable. We ordered just about everything on the menu so we could taste it all and no one was disappointed. I highly recommend eating here, but book in advance, it's pretty tiny.

I love this place. My wife and I come here a few times a year. I've held functions in their private room, and enjoyed family meals with larger parties. It's casual enough to bring the kids; but has a nice enough ambiance to put on a blazer and take the wife out for a meal too.  They have a bar where you can go take shots and catch up on the game too. I'm a sucker for consistency; and the sweet cracker chicken always makes me give my wife the side eye. My wife enjoys the prime rib and they have yet to disappoint her. She's a picky eater. This is a place comfortable in its skin. Its not trying to be something else. Not a chain, not a diner. I don't recall their being any antique license plates, oxidized iron planes, or 12" inch vinyl records on the walls either.  I think they have their bric a brac under control. For us, its just off the beaten path enough to feel like we went somewhere nice but not stuffy.

Overall: just okay food with terrible service. We walked into a fairly crowded and rowdy restaurant. My first impression was that I had walked into someone's living room. After we were shown a table the waitress promptly removed the dishes and left us with napkins, forks, and one glass. I found this odd as plates and glasses enough for the two of us would have seemed to make sense. It made me question the cleanliness of the things they left behind. We were given ample time to peruse the menu. And also ample time to twiddle our thumbs waiting for the food.  It seemed like only one table was getting food...And that table didn't even seem to be getting all their dishes at one time. I was mildly amused watching everyone in the restaurant gaze longingly/hungrily at each dish that came out. We eventually got our dishes (came at the same time yay). We got the quail and The shrimp and fish curry. I found the quail to be dry and the curry to be heavy on the ginger.  The spicy curry had about 4 shrimp and I didn't see any fish so maybe the fish was just used to flavor the curry? Sadly, I enjoyed the seasoned rice that came with the quail the most. One of the worst parts of the meal was that my glass of water was empty several times. There seemed to be 4 to 5 ppl working but they kept disappearing into the kitchen (and coming back out empty handed) and it was difficult to flag down anyone for a refill. Thai food is known to be spicy and this is the first Thai place I've been to that wasn't attentive. We were lucky we were near the aisle...other quests were not as successful getting service. I also noticed what another reviewer said about the owner (?) Giving the check and then standing at the table until it was paid. This was a very disappointing experience. Perhaps we choose the wrong dishes (they did seem to have a lot of dishes not traditionally served in other Thai restaurants) but I will not be going back to try anything else since the service was so atrocious.

I do love these guys' Burgers. Very tasty burgers! You should try their fries!!!! something amazin i would say:) In the evenings you could have nice cold beer with good assortment of snacks for it. usually it is busy there that is the reason for giving four stars.

Came here for brunch on a Sunday and of course  it was packed out.  However, I was lucky enough to get seated at the bar.  No wait.  Woohoo. I had the veggie burger and my friend had the special of the day which was a pastrami hash.  The veggie burger was great.  The flavor of pesto on the burger was amazing and perfect.  The burger also came with French fries that were delicious.  Not oily at all.  The pastrami hash was good.  Probably wouldn't order it again but it was nice to try.   Service was very friendly.

Best Lebanese restaurant in NYC! Chef Massoud offers classic dishes and some new experiments that are delicious.  Huge space, often fully booked.  Call to reserve a table. Upstairs is a little quieter and more intimate, downstairs is bustling.
Just an awesome pizza at this place! Waiters are super-cool and funny;) And of course fast in service! Definitely a five stars place.

I hate being lied to. So when the manager lied repeatedly to me I was very upset. How am I to trust this place ever again? I've eaten here more than a few times the last couple of weeks and generally the food is decent. So when the curry chicken I ordered this evening showed up in a warm, banged up Pyrex pie dish instead of the usual white, pristine dinnerware my suspicions weren't aroused. Then I discovered that the colorless, tasteless, limp chicken and vegetables were sitting on top of of cold,  gelatinous mess of corn starch based curry sauce. When I complained to the manager and informed her of exactly what I am writing here, she denied everything, multiple times. I guess since I'm Caucasian she wouldn't assume to consider that I'm a master of Asian culinary arts, have been reheating up my wok creations in a Pyrex dish in my microvewave for over 25 years, and that I know the difference between food fresh out of the wok and under reheated out of the microwave. Shame on you, manager!

We have been here a half dozen times, at least- service is ALWAYS great and the food is outstanding.  The line/wait can sometimes be bananas. Weekdays in the afternoon there is never a line though. Get here. NOW.

Absolutely fantastic clean Thai food. I wasn't a huge fan of their version of Pad Thai but it was still delicious. The yellow curry and the mee siam were both out of this world. The decor is beautiful. One waiter dropped a bowl of rice while serving a big table and it was cleaned up before you could blink. Overall wonderful place

I had to create a YELP account (after living and eating Williamsburg for 5 years) just to love on Beehive Oven in the public sphere.  My boyfriend and I had the most wonderful meal here at Happy Hour today (a Wednesday). We ordered: A. Jezebel Wings with Buttermilk Dressing appetizer They are three very big (jumbo) wings that are fried to perfection and covered with the yummiest sweet and hot Jezebel sauce (almost like a chutney)...unbelievably tasty! B. Fried Green Tomatoes with Remoulade appetizer: I wanted to have these and watermelon lemonade on a porch every afternoon for the rest of my life while watching a little bird come down the walk and writing songs on a banjo. C. 2 Deviled Eggs (appetizer) We said cheers, bumped them together and were off!  Like eating nice chocolates from a box, each a mini celebration. Rich and decadent! We had to ignore the fact that we did little to earn them that morning.. D. An Abita Pecan beer and a Capt. Kolsch beer (they're a Texan run establishment, and they gotchu covered on that Shiner Bock!) E. The Nettie Biscuit for me (Named after the owner's true-Texan grandmother.  She smiles from a farm somewhere in TX surrounded by chickens in black and white photo posted near the kitchen) and the motto is-- "Nettie would be proud".  The fried chicken and the biscuit are both heavenly. F. Shrimp and Grits with Fried Okra for him (a generous portion of shrimp and an almost gumbo-like sauce on top of the grits (bell pepper, onion) that was so flavorful and delish. I managed to take a bite before it vanished.. G. YOU MUST ORDER One Slice of Hummingbird Cake (homemade, total food science as far as being perfectly moist/balanced/creamy etc. and such a treat.) H. 2 Coffees :) 1. This cost us 45 dollars. In Williamsburg! 2. We obviously had a trigger-happy moment and ordered everything on the menu, but we ate every single bite of it all, except for a few okra which we took home with us.  It was just so good. The best thing about Beehive Oven though is not the food. It's the owners..if you have a chance to talk to the owners John and Trevva..they are so hospitable and warm you feel like you're in someone's country home.  If at this point you're thinking that I am not accustomed to thinking critically, you read my review correctly.  There was nothing to break down about the experience.  Just a great one! If they ever open up a bed and breakfast I am so there! That said, I promise not to Yelp so basically again unless it's really dire. Best, Noni

Rude, rude, rude.  That what describes the opener/operator of this location.  Not very hospitable.  Let's remember the basics people.  You can catch more bees with honey.  Will never spend my hard earned cash at this establishment again.  Bad test in my mouth.  I will go to D&D as the owner so rudely said to me!

Every since I was a little kid my family would take me to pip pio. I am peruvian and it is always awesome to go eat out at a peruvian restaurant. I have seen and watch this family business restaurant expand and grow. I used to live by the pio pio on northern boulevard. I always enjoyed their food. When i took my mom to go dine at the pio pio on 10th ave, I was blown away by how much high standards they have for the presentation of food as aposed to the one in northern boulevard. It was an awesome experience. I tried out their ceviche mixto and some of their pisco cocktails. It was top notch. The bartender is cool and takes care of his guest. I continue to go every time I get a chance. Keep up the good work guys. Que viva Peru CARAJO!!

Went on a not so busy night and had to wait 50 minutes for a pub burger and fries. Something inside told me that this was a plan to get me to buy a second beer. Anyway, food was good when it finally arrived. Just be prepared to sit and sip your beer for a while.

This is most definitely my go to spot with clients.  The food is amazing (Red Velvet Pancakes with cream cheese frosting center, creme brûlée French toast, egg white omelets just to name a few) and the service is professional, friendly and efficient.  Ask for Brittny! She is my favorite!!
I have been going to The Stack for over 30 years. Never had one complaint about anything. Always a great experience and the staff is excellent.
You can order half servings of pasta dishes. This allows you to have two different pastas for dinner or to add one as a side dish to another dinner choice.
Pho doesn't take 30 minutes. The food was very ok: spring rolls and pho. But the service was slow and indifferent, with the overwhelmed manager as the exception.

The place was completely empty, so my bf and I were skeptical. When the salad came out, my hopes rose! Usually you get a dry crusty boring salad with your entree, this salad was perfect with just enough delicious homemade dressing, sprouts, cranberries, and leafy greens (not iceberg :) ! The food was good, not GREAT. (mushroom ravioli, chicken dish, shrimp appetizer) The shrimp was the best dish.  I definitely want to go back for breakfast! The staff was excellent! Since we were the only ones there, the chef/owner even dimmed the lights and turned up the music after noting how "romantic" we looked in the corner. It was a nice touch haha.

Yikes. I really wanted to like this place & was so excited to try their brunch, but DAMN Balthazar was disappointing. On top of the ambiance being a little claustrophobic, the food was down right horrible. My friend & I split the french toast (decent, but nothing special) and the omelet. The omelet tasted like it was made with fake liquid eggs  & a slice of kraft singles cheese. No veggies, no nothing! I don't mind spending a pretty penny on tasty food, but the price was outrageous for the quality of the meal. This place is overrated & a huge tourist trap!

Went last night, and ordered al pastor, brisket, and fried chicken tacos. The tacos that arrived at our table were fish, chorizo, and grilled chicken. They were ordered by the neighboring table, I think. We began eating before we realized the mishap (it was dark outside), and then at least one staff member realized what had happened and did exactly nothing except question us about which number we had been assigned (he'd already taken the stand w/ the number on it away) and then walk away shrugging. So yeah, pretty unsatisfying as we ended up eating tacos we had no particular craving for, and no one at Gueros cared  to remedy the mistake. The chorizo was good, everything else we got was not seasoned enough. The frozen margaritas were excellent, much better than Chavelas (which always have too much triple-sec.) I don't swear by Chavelas (competing Mexican restaurant down the road), but they've never gotten my order wrong, and they generally have enough room to sit down, unlike Gueros.

Visited here the other night, really really love the layout of the bar, I think it is one of the nicest looking bars Iv been in in New York. Great beer selection, we tried some of their locally brewed stuff. We ordered some food that was all really good and great sized portions, the Brussel sprouts were amazing, a must try! When ordering I had to make a couple of runs to the kitchen as the guy taking my order told me he was out of the first item. Upon returning with a new selection he informed me they were also out of it, it was all good though, he told me they were in the process of changing their menus, he was very nice and seemed like one of the owners. All in all this place was really great and food, drink and the atmosphere there was top notch. Where I deduct the stars though, is for the service. Upon arriving we were just presented with a menu and no greeting, we felt as if we were a hindrance in being there. She was not very attentive and we had to wait some time to be asked if we wanted another round. We spent about 5 minutes trying to get her attention to get our cheque. The waitress who brought our food and who dealt with the payment again made me feel like I was annoying her and like it was a huge chore for her to serve me. I think we will be back again as we loved the atmosphere and the food and drink, I just hope next time we are made feel a little bit more welcome.

I stopped here on my way home yesterday. I found out this is formerly Gennaro's Pizza (after I ate a slice of bland pizza from here)....it is the exact same menu and food, except they added a mexican food category and changed the name. Gennaro's has quite a few Yelp reviews.....none of them positive. Here is the link yelp.com/biz/gennaros-pi…. Here's wear I started to panick........Later last night I told  a friend of mine I went there and he told me the place was shut down by the health department days before the name change. Since I thought he was just bad mouthing the place to make it seem worse than it was....this morning I called the town of Newington....who then transferred me to the Health department or something like that. Sure enough they were closed for 3 days in August for Health violations. This is public record and available to all. My confusion is.....how is it possible to have a new Yelp page for the SAME restaurant that only changed it's name to "Nicolas Pizza and Mexican Eatery" and added a new style of food to its menu? Are we wanting people to run the risk of getting sick?

My family had a dinner here last week and overall, we enjoyed our foods and the staffs were really generous and smiled all the time! Our server discribed each dishes and an appetizer she recommended was very good! I also like the mango salad with soft shell crab on top and the pad thai. Hope they could've give us the bigger table for four adults plus 2-year old baby...the square table was way too small so had to squeeze each other.

Our group at work from up the street goes at least twice a week to Pho Dang.  We love the soup and no. 22 and the similar ones and he pad Thai too.  wonderful comfort food.  I always feel better after the pho!

This is my first Yelp review, and for good reason. If you like sushi there is no better deal than Sushi Palace. Great selection of delicious rolls, appetizers, and other dishes all you can eat for one price. The service has been nice and quick ever since their expansion too. Despite leaving New Jersey for the city I still crave Sushi Palace when I come back home.

I went to this restaurant with my friend last week and would like to go back for sure.  The restaurant is big in sizes and serves 100-200 people at the same time.  We enjoyed the hostess service which made us feel very friendly.  The portion of the dishes are super big and real family style.  The fresh mozzarella cheese is the best that I have ever tried.  The seafood linguine is exactly the light taste style that I like, wish the clam sauce could be thicker and better a little more salty which will enhance the flavor a little bit.  Dessert is good to share too.  Overall, both me and my friend love this first time experience at this Italian restaurant.

Ordered on Seamless. Food was never delivered. Called them repeatedly and kept saying order was out for delivery without actually checking. Told me 2 hours later that it was sitting at the restaurant and they wouldn't be able to deliver it. Terrible service. Food might be awesome, can't review it if it never arrives.

Went there last night for happy hour after work have been going there for years since I work right down the block and it's covenant for us to go straight from work for some apps and a beer.  I have to agree with the other reviews this place has gone down hill the food was ice cold that we had to send it back to be reheated they had no domestic beer on tap for happy hour except one and it wasn't usually the one I get.  This place used to be great and  packed every time we went there so packed that we couldn't find a seat at the bar the food and drinks were great but not any more they need to improve things especially since  Last night the bar was almost empty and soon it will be completely empty soon.
ordered signature fried chicken melt. went upstairs and realizes they skipped on the coleslaw. super dry and greasy meal for $13, will look elsewhere.

This place is great! I went in for a late lunch when I was in the area and was pleasantly surprised. Though there were only 2-3 vegetarian options, I was happy with the food. I got the veg rice platter which came with coconut rice which was very tasty and some vegetable side dish (I don't know what it was), egg with spicy sauce on top which was spicy and awesome and some onion flavored chips and cucumber to cool it all down. Very tasty and real cheap! Service was good and quick. I only wish there were more veggie options on the menu. .

I have been going to Michael's for the past 10 years, I have even had 6 parties that I hosted. Without a doubt, the BEST food and service I could have asked for. The owner, Michael, welcomes everyone as if they were coming to his home. As for the food you can't beat it. Fried Calamari melts in your mouth, baked clams, eggplant rollatini etc. excellent. My mother's surprise 85th, my sisters surprise 60th, my other halfs surprise 50th, my Reunion Christmas party and many other functions in the past years were all a success due to Michael, his staff and his chefs. I recommend this restaurant HIGHLY.     TEN STARS!!!
love the food.

Being an Italian abroad I am quite picky about food and especially about ingredients. I found their pizza amazingly prepared with fresh ingredients and I loved the fact that they don't offer American versions of Italian dishes unless most places . The only complaint I have is about the size of the pizza, I've been there with 3 girls and we don't eat that much but we found the pizza a little small for the price (15$) That's the only reason I'm not putting 5 stars

Wow!  Keep it down the kids are scared. Very hip place, but forgets where it is. Drinks took 20 min Food took 45 min and was kinda worth the wait, but don't ask me to keep it down 4 times when the bar is 10x louder than the dining room. Good fare, slow service and nervous nelly ownership. Loosen up please!
Terrible place. Just used for candy, ice cream and coffee. Weird setup. Way too overpriced. I don't know how they're still open.

I was starving and we were out and about.  Grabbed my yelp app and spotted this place.  Ordered a chicken and a steak taco.  Pretty small portions but they are like street tacos.  The chicken was the best.  Real fast service.

Amazing Food and Drinks. I would highly recommend the ceviche sampler for an appetizer The faca Frita for dinner and of course the Chocolate Cigar for dessert (My favorite Dessert). You cannot really go wrong with any of the drinks but I really enjoy the Dark and Stormy
The best Peruvian cuisine you can ask for. This place is fantastic, plus the people are friendly and welcoming. They have great specials and perfect for a family setting. VERDICT: 5/5 Stars

Came here for dinner about half a year ago, tried the pork buns, they were pretty decent. Had the roasted pork belly really loved that dish, the cabbage that comes with it matches really well with the pork. Service was attentive despite it getting busy as the drinking crowds starting building up, will def come back.
Fantastic. Exceeded all expectations. Delicious, special, divine.

Really cool and fun place - the open kitchen is different for a thai restaurant and it was nice to see all of the dishes getting prepared. I tried the Chiang Mai Fries, Zucchini Pad Thai and Kale Fried Rice. We loved it all!

When you initially pull into the lot there is valet and the place was packed. Walking in, the vibe this place gives off radiates high quality. We were unable to get seating because of all the reservations but ended up sitting at the bar. We both had the filet which could have been juicier and more tender for the A La Carte price. Upon receiving our steaks we were reluctant to use the steak sauce provided because of the wonderful presentation, however, soon found out that we needed it. Overall the food was decent. We didn't have any alcohol but good thing we didn't because the bar was slammed and they definitely should have had another bartender on.

I had made reservations via Open Table a few days prior to our dinner and had no issues whatsoever. Rare accommodated our party of 10 on an early, September evening. The staff was courteous and our server was very knowledgeable and informative (going over the different cuts; recommendations for preparations as well as the good sides to choose). According to others in our party, the bread was delicious and the bruschetta was "out of this world". I have no opinion on the bread/bruschetta as I was not about to fill my stomach with a 48oz Porterhouse (for 2...) on its way. The 48er was cooked perfectly (medium-rare for the uninitiated) and was more than enough for 2 people. I know...leftovers. I'm ashamed. My father would be turning-over in his grave were he not alive and well. And in the end, the bill for a hungry and thirsty (for booze...) party of 10 was very reasonable.

Absolutely horrendous. We had the oyster pancake (awful), the mushrooms (a ok), the foie gras (tiny and mediocre), and the mozzarella di Buffala (meh) for appetizers and the bouillabaisse (worst I've had ever in my life, plus seafood was definitely not fresh although we were said opposite) and the beef bourguignon (mediocre and meat was dry and tasteless) $25-30 per entree and $15 per appetizer is a JOKE for this 8-stool 1 table smelly joint. Service is also bad. A failed attempt of French-Korean fusion food. Never go its a joke.

When I think of Mundo, I think of the Emerald City. The event space, music, food, hospitality - it is a magical place. We live in Astoria and it meant so much to have Willie and Jon as hosts for a party on the eve of our wedding. I can't think of a better place in NYC to have a rehearsal dinner. The food is like the event space itself - original, beautiful and crowd pleasing!  Plenty of room for guests to sit and relax, mingle - or both. Plenty of menu options for vegans, carnivores - and everyone in between. Music goes really well with the space. We had both live music - and a recorded selection from my cousin's ipod. Mundo was both an exciting and a comfortable place to have our event, and we're so grateful for a magical evening that we'll remember always.

I always stop at Gina's for lunch when in town. I get the roast beef hero because they roast the beef on premises. The roast beef doesn't have the taste of preservatives like the store bought meat has. I agree with the other review that the bread is great too. You can't beat the price too. I do worry that this place will close because all but one store is vacant and people will not stop in. December 2, 2014 update Had my Gina's roast beef hero fix. Always great. Brought 5 co-workers in and they all loved it too. Main complaint from them was the hero was too big!

Review just for drinks. Espresso martini was delicious as was other drinks. Atmosphere could have been brighter and bartenders were not as knowledgeable on drinks not on menu. Excited to try other drinks and food off of vegan menu. A bit pricey for Philadelphia but worth it for comfort.
Best brunch spot in Williamsburg! There is always a 30-40 min wait, but it's 100% worth it. Enjoy!

This place is as good as it gets for pizza. Went here with a couple of friends and the environment outside is comforting. The square slices have definitley held their name for being the best slice in Brooklyn. After having the pizza we shared a nice pint of spumoni which topped it off. Everything was so enjoyable that i cannot wait to go back again.

Went there for my birthday dinner on a tue evening with my husband and kids. Luckily I brought my stroller Bc they didn't have any high chairs:( other than that the food was great and so was the service. We ordered the calamari which was ok, the tuna tartar which was TO DIE FOR. We also ordered the swordfish(liked but didn't love), the braised short ribs which was awesome and my husband had the tomahawk steak (also very delicious) which was large enough to share with my 8 year old.   I would definitely go back... minus the kids.
Love this place! Make a reservation prior to going otherwise you may have to wait.  The squid ink paella here may have been the best paella I've ever had
The new owner really cares and is a character.  The portions are ample the service is attentive and the quality is great. Not just a pizza place!
i love this place. The food was great!!!!
Classic pizza joint that makes the best pies in the area. Also large menu at very reasonable prices

Best Brazilian food I've ever had. I've lived in Astoria for 6 years, and all the amazing food and restaurants are one of my favorite things about the neighborhood. I've eaten at pretty much all the Brazilian restaurants in the neighborhood (Point Brazil, Favela, Carioca Grille) all of which I greatly enjoy, and this place, Beija Flor is by far the best! Tastes like anybody's Grandma's best cooking. Fresh! And it's SOOO affordable. Inexpensive compared to the other places. Its unfortunate that the location is a bit far off the main areas of Astoria, however it's absolutely worth the ride to 39th Ave, or a nice 15-20 minute walk from the 30th Ave-Broadway districts of the neighborhood. 5 stars and 2 thumbs up!

They have the most fantastic sloppy joe sandwiches! I ordered some for my father's birthday party and they were packaged perfectly and delicious. They were such a hit at the party, and so easy for me as well. Thank you Lakeside!

This place ain't cheap but its price reflects not only the real estate realities of TriBeCa NYC but also a conscious menu of fresh,  local and humane foods and food processing. It's a comfort food style menu; I could taste the non GMO oil on the veggie burger and there are many full fat options to tempt! There's also a diversity of art throughout and a hidden treat downstairs by the bathrooms- an old fashioned black and white photo booth for only $3. Photos worth the wait.
Whatever you do have your drinks made by Rob! He's friendly, professional and knows how to balance great taste with presentation!
Absolutely love this quaint local go-to for pasta, fish and a nice wine selection.  Really a gem.

Don't get into Michael's with an empty stomach or you'll buy out the place. The establishment is spotless and the quality of food is excellent. I usually have to go to the bank and get a 60 minute loan before I go shopping in Michael's. It is pricey BUT you get what you pay for. I would have given it 5 stars but the service leaves something to be desired. Does anyone smile?. My issue was I saw the roast beef that was in the case and perfectly cooked. I asked for a hero. I turned my head and saw that she was slicing what I thought was the roast beef I had seen in the case. WRONG !! There she was slicing this old dried out end of the roast beef. When I asked for the one in the case she said she had to finish the that one first. Needless to say I didn't buy it. Now that's not good customer service. If you're not selling what's in the case and what I ASKED for then don't put it in the case to begin with. Other than that the place is great.

thought this place would be another tourist trap. after seeing it on the Gothamist I decided to visit with a friend. mostly community style seating, but not too uncomfortable for a hectic Saturday night. ale selections were vast and unique. I tried the refreshing Crispin ale & the server even made an effort to provide it with an adorable mason jar for convenience. the speckenwolf & famous original were both so delicious. dont forget to ask your server for their daily special. what a great place to enjoy quality ny pizza fresh from the oven to your table. can't wait to come back!

This bakery is a hidden gem. The pastries, which are absolutely wonderful, lack the overwhelming sweetness so typical in American baked products. The staff is friendly and the prices are surprisingly low. I strongly suggest you give them a try.

One of the worst pizzas I've ever had in my life, including microwave pizza.  The prices were high, so ai was expecting quality or at least a large pizza. Neither was the case. The four cheese pizza smelled so bad of parmesan it made me nautious. The crust was thin, so I had hopes for a nice crisp flavorful pizza despite the smell, but again I was disappointed. $16 gets you a thin, long, "pizza" that was crammed into the box diagnally. I would be angry at how little pizza I got for my money if it wasn't for the fact that I didn't want to eat it. Also, the brownies were stale and tasted like old chocolate with heavy cocoa powder.
Great place. Friendly staff. The lemonade smoothie was delicious as was the sweet potato/pea soup, corn hummus and the salad.
Being that I'm a Mexican from CA. This food made me feel like I was home again! I had the tacos and the meat was fresh and tasty. Try the pork!
Simply the Best!!!!

A friend and I met here for lunch, and OMG...I'm offically hooked.  We sat outside on the patio and it was adorable.  I think during the warmer months, sitting on the patio with a bottle of wine (BYOB...can't beat that!) would be a perfect date night.  My friend had the pear ravioli and I had the gnocchi bolognese and both were delicious.  I live locally so I am just looking for an excuse to go back asap.

The first time we went here I ordered a dish with a spice level of 8 and I couldn't finish it- toooo hot!! But we went back recently and ordered spice level 5 and it was much better. The mung bean noodles with black bean sauce was nice with white rice. We also tried the tofu in garlic sauce style and enjoyed it. I love the high ceilings and ambience here.

My boyfriend and I came here over an hour before a Union Transfer show on a random Wednesday night. Outdoor seating looked great, about 5 or 6 open tables outside and more inside. A hostess greeted us at the entrance, but then disappeared for over five minutes inside. Another host came out to tell us that there would be a 25 minute wait and the bar was not open. When we politely asked, "Really? There seem to be a lot of open tables..." we received no explanation. Instead the host flippantly replied, "I don't come to your office and say look at all this stuff and tell you what to do." All with a shit-eating grin on his face.  Never again.

tho its my first restaurant review ever  but this place rocks the most wonderful Mexican cuisine on NYC we tried almost  half of the menu  with my family an friends killer guacamole and well crafted tacos an drinks don't miss the chance to taste some chapolinos, well done chef
Food was amazing and well presented. You would think you were eating at a 5 star restaurant. I will definitely be going back.
I had lunch for the 1st time here & the food was delicious! Customer service is great . . very attentive & friendly. I will definitely be ordering from here more often.
This place is open late for drinks and dessert which makes it ideal for a night cap. Clean and nice staff with TVs and great environment for lively drinks or to chill

All I can say is "wow".  This is an incredible restaurant.  I had the spinach salad and the chilean sea bass.  Both were so good.  The salad  was full of flavor, but the sea bass was incredible.   Most restaurants will overcook sea bass, in my opinion.  But the sea bass at this restaurant  was cooked perfectly.  It fell apart with a fork and melted in my mouth.  I was really impressed.\ In addition to that, the wait staff literally dotes on you, at all levels.  I was very impressed with the service.  I give this restaurant the highest rating possible.  Worth the experience if you're staying at the Double Tree, or anywhere in the immediate vicinity.
Seafood salad is superior.
Great food. The oxtail pappardelle was wonderful! The homemade pasta was incredible. We also had the black linguine with shellfish. Equally as good. Excellent restaurant, comfortable atmosphere!
Great Thai food, although parking was limited and the place was small, other then that it's a great restaurant.

Pizza is really great quality and above average for Bayonne... that's hard to do.   Parking is hard over there so you can order for delivery.  Otherwise walk over and enjoy the Italian garden patio feel out on the patio. I would recommend that Joe plays his pizza tossing in a loop on the tv in the pizzeria!

I think this place is more about the experience and history than it is about the food. Don't get me wrong. The cheesesteak with Cheese Wiz and onions was pretty good. It doesn't have flavor that pops out at you. The meat I had was much more chewy than other cheese steaks that I had. Service is really fast. You need to know what you want and have your money ready. From the time you order and pay not one minute goes by to when you have your food. After you order your sandwich then you get into another line for fries and a coke.  Which cost another $7.00 The fries are also average in taste. But we're not soggy. In fact they were a little on the crisp side.

I am vegetarian(fyi) so choices offered were pretty limited. But my feedback is on price & quality. Food itself was ordinary - some veg items did not have any veggies example noodles. Onion was the most prominent veggie. Tofu was bland. . And price is close $7 a pound and not 5.99$ a pound. This place definitely is not 1star in terms of price.
Good value for what you are paying for. The lamb vindaloo is tender and I would recommend it. They do not serve chana saag unfortunately.
Amazing service. Great food. Not too pricey! One of the best in downtown Hartford The Pasta ala vodka is amazing. And I love getting free biscotti after!
Visited this place right after it opened so there was a few kinks in the service. The food was awesome though.  The guacamole and margaritas were superb

Definitely make a reservation - they are a bit quirky about reservations even when they appear to have open tables. The ambience is wonderful yet different depending on the room you're seated in or if you are fortunate enough to sit on the outside patio looking over the pond and sculptures. My mom and I started lunch with a review of the drink menu listing a variety of unique elixirs and cocktails settling on a pear honeysuckle martini and a tigers blood cocktail with blood orange infused vodka. For lunch I chose the pastrami sandwich on Russian black bread. I could taste the essence of the pastrami, celery slaw and whole grain mustard before I even took my first bite. It was served with with a mustard potato salad and a crispy green garlic pickle. Mom chose a traditional Cobb salad that was beautiful and fresh with terrific apple wood bacon as garnish. For dessert we shared the sugar doughnuts served with a berry dip, Nutella and vanilla custard. All aspects of the food were great-appearance, texture and above all the flavor. The staff was attentive and knowledgeable and prices were higher than an everyday lunch but a very special treat we will be sharing again very soon.

I had my wedding at the Carriage House on September 6th and it was amazing!! After I got engaged, my husband and I looked at a ton of different venues. We walked into the Carriage House and immediately loved the look of the room. We met with Shannon and after our conversation with her we decided to book our wedding there. The wedding was everything that we could have asked for and more. Shannon  and her whole staff made sure everything was perfect the day of the wedding. The food was unbelievable and my guests are still talking about it. I couldn't imagine having my wedding anywhere but there. Anyone who wants an amazing wedding with great food and a wonderful staff this is the place.

I can't count how many times I thought about this place while I was living in Japan.  The ambiance is very cozy and feels like a piece of history.  Just looking at the well kept hardwood floor, you can see that this place has been here for a very longtime.  The menu and specials are written on chalkboards hung on the walls. The food is great here, my party and I ordered the Penne Alla Vodka and we all agreed that this was by far the best version of this pasta dish we have ever had. The pasta sauce was super creamy with a nice taste of basil and packed with sausage and melting mountains of cheese.  The penne were nice and firm and not over cooked.  There were three of us and this dish was so big, we could not finish it all.  We couldn't even order dessert, which was one of the reasons we came here, because we were told that this place has a real good tiramisu.  We ended up having to come here another time just so that we could get it.  Be advised, the portions here are HUGE. If you are ever in New York City and you are in the mood for Italian, I highly recommend coming here.

Mama Mia it's a whole lot of food & more food! Carmine's is a wonderful dining experience for Italian food while dining in the NYC... For those visiting the Times Square area I advise stop in for some chow. *** CAUTION *** Carmine's is serves family style portions. Meaning you get large amounts of food. A salad realistically could feed 4 to 6 people so either make sure your hungry or bring friends. Now the food is delicious. I've enjoy everything from chicken parmesan, garlic shrimp in angel hair pasta, Spaghetti & meatballs and several salads. "Damn I'm drooling writing this cause I now want some now." It's a huge menu and it's all quality food as you would expect. Don't fear the size, just bring appetite.

BACON BACON BAAAAACON!!! Yes its all bacon.. the tater tots are out of this freagin world! The pulled or sandwich wasn't my favorite, but everyone is different, te sandwich has coleslaw and pineapple and for me the taste wasn't good. The drinks are awesome.
