Sooo.. if you love bacon this is the place for YOU!
Good food and beer, manager and staff very helpful, food always great and atmosphere is cool, they really explain their beers in detail, I would highly recommend!

Stumbled in here on the way to an open mic with a few friends. Everyone loved the food! (Even the pickiest of my friends who hates everything we choose, was happy and smiling!! That was quite an accomplishment in my eyes!!) Please try the octopus appetizer and any of the cocktails!! Cannot wait to go back! Staff was very friendly and attentive!

This place is great. The live music was very enjoyable. I also enjoyed the macaroni and cheese. I love the environment. The staff was very professional and the prices was reasonable. Will definitely visit again.

This place is pretty good in my opinion and an excellent value for what you're paying.   Like most buffets, the food varies in quality.  I enjoyed the General Tso's chicken, the rice was great and the crab rangoons took care of business, although they weren't maybe the highest quality.  The chicken in general was decent and I liked that they included French Fries and plantains; gotta love the comfort food.  The dessert was also great, as it was the typical classic ice cream and brownie type stuff.  I'd also like to add I was not charged for a soda, or the dessert.  I only paid 12.70 to eat here: 10.70 for the buffet and I left a $ 2.00 tip.  That is a very good deal. Overall, the food was presentable, filling and left me coming back for more until I was totally full.  Though it isn't as diverse of a menu as places like The Sizzler, Old Country Buffet, or my personal favorite, Tin Tin Buffet (in the Brighton neighborhood of Boston), it does its job.   As a former New York resident and current Newark resident, I'm honestly happy that we have all-you-can-eat buffets in town at all.  When I lived in New York, buffets were hard to come by.  There was a Sizzler in Queens, that took forever to get to if you didn't live in Queens (it took me an hour and a half to get there from Brooklyn on weekends), and there were maybe a couple buffets in Brooklyn but they were also relatively off the beat-and-track.  I am happy to have Regal Buffet, and look forward to enjoying other buffets in town or elsewhere in New Jersey.

Been here a couple times. Good if you're in a rush to grab coffee and a bagel breakfast sandwich. Got to the shop around 7:15. Yelp says they are open at 7am. (THIS IS NOT TRUE). One of the guys opened the front door told me they open at 8 am. Time to fix the yelp hours.

I am half Indian and have traveled to india a dozen times.  Taj E India is the best Indian food I have had outside of india.  I asked them to make it "Indian style" and not watered down and it was amazing.  What a find in the upper valley.  Take-out only.

Delicious pizza!!! I always go home with extras because they are huge. The family salad is delicious too. My only complaint is that they don't serve mixed drinks...they have hard alcohol and they have mixers, yet they don't serve them together...I found this strange
I love this bar!  Very friendly atmosphere, great food, lots of beer on tap, it's like Cheers in this place, everyone knows your name
I've tried only 2 of the chaats- Bhel puri and Delhi chaat I think- they tasted similar but were both great. A burst of flavors and crunch -sweet, spicy, tangy. Will definitely be back.

The ambiance was really cool. There is a gorgeous oversized chandelier in the middle of the restaurant. I am vegetarian, so I opted for the tofu spicy basil dish and it was great. I also had their drink that has sake with strawberry purée - great!

We arrived here just after midnight and had no difficulty finding a place to park or a place to sit down and eat.  The tables line the sidewalk. I ordered the cheesesteak; what else is a tourist to do?  Maybe I was expecting something different I am from Jersey... it was disappointing.  The cheesesteak has chucks of steak that were exceptionally chewy and the cheese that failed to improve the overall experience. It didn't have a particular flavor that stood out and it was honestly forgettable except for the prices. It is expensive.  In a city full of flavor and variety.... I will try somewhere else next time.
Hands down my favorite place to eat crab,  grab a pticher of beer and sit outside...can't get any better than that.
Pretty expensive and small portions. But beautiful location.
Great selection for a quick pick up. Fast delivery.   Not the best pizza I have had but consistent and reasonably priced.

I used to come to this place and love it but the past few times I've been here the experience has been less than desirable...the last time I was there their credit card machine wasn't working and he didn't tell me until after I put my order in, also the past few times I've been there the food has been subpar...disappointing, but now I'll just go to Otto's Tacos a block away
Best tofu soup place ever. Like the appetizers especially the fired fish. Tofu soup is a must order each time.

Just celebrated our Thirtieth Anniversary here.  As a gay couple, even in VT we have experienced some "uncomfortable" anniversary celebrations in high end restaurants.  Not the case here, yes we were privy to  other tables conversations but unlike the Church Street Restaurant with the tables jammed together we did not have to pretend to ignore them.  Instead we were engaged with our surrounding four tops and gave reviews that may have helped with their choices as well.  Overall best service in Burlington ( sorry American Flatbread, close second)  Yes Dark, Noisy, Expensive ( Did you read the other reviews?)  Well worth the money!!!   Best dinner to date.

This was our first time to Little Italy... And our first time to this quaint little Italian gem! The owner was making meatballs when we walked in.  It truly doesn't get any more fresh! We ate so much, they had to roll us out the front door. We really enjoyed speaking with the owner about his family history. The menu is HUGE! We tried several different dishes and each was DELISH! Very authentic! Sizes were perfect, presentation very nice as well. This is a VERY SMALL place.  I'm guessing during dinner hours there must be a long wait! If you are visiting NYC, I'd put this place on your must try list!
the best thai/ viet food out of asia! dont ever miss it if u r a foodie like me. im malaysian n been to lots of restaurants and i an say this is my top 10 best in the world!

I read previous posts and decided to give it a try.  Pleasantly surprised I was.  Staff was attentive and prompt.  Great beer selection and food was as expected.  5 stars would have been given if I was blown away.

I love the decor and ambience of Jones. Went on a Friday night close to closing, but still the food was great. I have of course the doubled eggs and chicken pot pie and my date had something else but all i could remember is his mac and cheese tasting so good that i wanted to steal it. We skipped dessert this time, but we will be back again to try the other favorites.

This is by far the best spot in the neighborhood.  We always take out of town guests here for at least one meal during their stay.   The wings are like mini pieces of fries chicken, the Beet salad is fantastic as is the whipped ricotta.  They have a huge burger, that in my opinion is to big. The falafel is the best in the city... Seriously.  Brunch has gotten so much better over the past few months.  Short ribs and top chef style eggs.   The Hangover helper is one of the most unique sandwiches in the city.  Whomever is in the kitchen obviously knows what they are doing.   The service is OK at best. When I see the female Asian bartender I get food to go. She is rude to me, Not sure what I did.   I highly recommend this spot to everyone
Love the crust, sauce is just right and not too much cheese.. Interesting choices, friendly staff. Try the chipotle honey with chicken. Simply delicious.

When my wife and I went here, we both ordered tea. I should have inspected my cup more carefully, because after a couple minutes of drinking the tea, I noticed that there were smudges of red lipstick on the outside of the rim. Gross. Really? The waiter didn't even seem to care. The sushi itself was nothing special.

As good as it gets. Best Mexican food in Philly. We have been here 3 times and it does not disappoint. Delicious, inventive and easy on the budget. If you have been to Mexico City think "Valentina". Top notch Mexican cuisine in the heart of Italian  Market. Great drinks too. Try the tamarind margarita. Best  Chilaquiles in the city. Excellent menu full of new and interesting dishes. Excellent service also reminiscent of Mexico City. A real find.

Don't really want to even review this place because then it will get so popular. But OMG the food here is amazing. Service is joy -- don't expect anything special. But really really good food. And authentic. Delicious.

I've never been here for dinner but it's my favorite spot for Brunch. It's fix price and I LOVE the eggs benedict. Instead of the regular English muffin they use a more rustic bread which is awesome. The staff has also been always very nice. They don't take reservations and it's a small place so be ready to wait if you're a big party.

My husband took me here for my birthday and we used a restaurant.com certificate.   My husband had the chicken parmesan and I decided to go with the capellini and meatballs. The food was very good, and the serving sizes were more than generous, what I bought home lasted another 2 meals. We were there this past Sunday and it was a beautiful day to sit outside on the deck.   Our server was very nice,so no complaints there.  The only compliaint I had is that the outdoor dining area is not right  on the lake, but on the side of the building. I noticed that another review mentioned that the lettuce in his salad was Brown.  I did not have this problem, everything was fresh.   All in all a very nice experience.

If I could give it a minus one I would. I stopped in with a buddy an hour before closing time for a Bud-light on tap. I use to frequent this place in the 80,s and 90's and had nothing but good things to say about it. We ordered our beers and placed a 20 dollar bill on the bar. We got 4 dollars back - the bartender explained with attitude that it was 8 bucks a beer. This is absolutely outrageous. The place next door was charging us 4 bucks a beer and it is a much nicer place. I will never go back to Mollys. Beware of getting ripped off by the old man behind the bar........

food came out cool (appetizer, soup and entree) , had to send it back each time, they were out of entrees at 7PM on a Friday, very very disappointed. this is basic stuff, how can they not get this right?

They got it all wrong. Went here the other night on what should have been a very fun, spontaneous, week night date. We would've been better off at home, in our PJ's, eating store bought pizza. We waited forever and when we did finally order, they brought out another table's order. We felt teased because by then, we were famished! So we waited for our meals and when they finally came, they were cold....so much waiting....that was the worst part. The server was very non responsive, showed little urgency, and never offered an apology or kind word...Save your money. Don't go here!

OVERPRICED and MEDIOCRE I ordered a $16 Fontina and Zucchini Risotto dish and it was mediocre tasting and small in portion size. It was also so scalding hot I couldn't touch it for what seemed like 10 minutes. I'm definitely not going back to this place.

Junior's is known for their cheesecake so it was a must that I stop by here before I leave NY.  My boyfriend and I got the plain NY cheesecake and red velvet cheesecake.  Both was creamy and very tasty.

Online order: This might have been my fault as I forgot to put the tip on the bill when I checked out on seamless. I was just going to pay the tip with cash but didn't make that clear on the notes or anything. But the food got to me at least 70 minutes after I ordered when the predicted time was 20-45 minutes. The cheese burger was cold and broken. Yes, a part of the burger had fallen off to the side on the plate. It was a dry burger that was wet with the steam and hence soggy. I have never quite experienced anything like it. The steak fries were more like cold potatoes - the ketchup packets helped mask the taste. I have been studying all day and this midnight meal was the first thing I had eaten all day. Couldn't finish the burger or the fries (even when doused in sriracha from the fridge). Very disappointing. Considering there are so many other diners in the area, jackson hole will not be hearing from me anytime soon.

Good Morning, Over the weekend i was in PS Richards,I got myself a Expresso machine which i am very happy with. this place was awesome!! specially an associatenamed Mike Boston. This kid was very helpful. I will be always come back to this store! Thank you .

We arrive and order the red sangria. They pour the drink and proceed to ask for our orders. My grandmother order the salad bar and left get her food once she place it. My mom ordered the mixed meat platter and I wanted the radizio. The waiter with blue eyes say I can not have radizio and my mom can not have the mixed meat platter together.
