We watched every other family party's get seated before us and when we told this to the manager "Dominick" he didn't say anything .he is a horrible manager and his workers aren't any better,very rude snobby workers and they ignore you,there is no seating area either they have u standing and waiting for hours on "STAIRS" ,so un organized and unprofessional, I REGRET GOING HERE...they were HORRIBLE.got better customer service at MCDONALDS. SUCH A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE, my first and my last time going I WILL NEVER GO BACK TO CUBAN PETES,THANK GOD I LEFT AND DIDNT SPEND MY MONEY ON THAT REPULSIVE PLACE.SAVE YOUR MONEY DONT COME HERE.

Poor customer service.  I called on a Thursday to find out if I could make reservations for the following day, Friday, for 17 people.  I was told they don't take reservations it's a first come first serve basis.  I asked if it would be a problem with 17 people and was told depending on the time it may be a bit of a wait.  Something I was expecting.  I got there at 6:30 on Friday and went to sign in, expecting to wait.  When I approached the hostess I was told they don't seat parties greater then 12.....really?!?! I had called the day before and explicitly asked....Happy Birthday to me....had to make make other plans last minute and call all my guests with the venue change....
The food here is ALWAYS DEELISH!!! I love the Paella! The fish is heavenly! Cuban Pete's does it for me! I'm in love!!!!!
Best Spanish food in bayonne..  Great staff.. And they do deliver...
I placed an order at 1pm for two sandwiches. It arrived at 3pm. The subs were okay.

Delicious food. The brautwursts were fantastic. They are grilled, not boiled so they have a crispy skin. The flavor is wonderful and the large side of mustard is a great compliment. There is bacon in the sauerkraut and even though I love kraut as is, it did not take away from an enjoyable side dish. My friend was taken back by the red cabbage side. How do they make it?! My other two friends had more American food (wings and a burger). Both were pleased. They joined so two of us could eat some damn good German food. Our server was perplexingly slow. We thought he was the only one working, but that was not the case. Nothing that would stop me from going next time. All tables have access to an unsightly outlet and USB charging ports right behind the bench seating. But with the food tasting that good and the variety of fabulous beers, no one seems to care what it looks like. And what a bonus to the bartender who won't be bothered by the 'running low on battery' crew. Or forgetting your phone that's charging at the bar. Modern conveniences...

Cantina where the staff is too cool for customer service... Listen I used to go to this place A LOT, but lately the service has completely gone down the drain. Yes the food is really good, but that will never account for how bad the service SUCKS here! This has been the 3rd time Ive have to walk out of this place because its been so bad. One Wednesday night I call to see if theres a wait, guy tells me that he cant tell me that over the phone, but if there is a wait to just have a drink at the bar (what if I was a recovering alcoholic?) I go in anyway. They say its a 15min wait for a party of 2 wait 30 min then ask again when we would be sat, hostess says 30-45min so we leave. Another time Saturday night we get seated right away, but wait 20 min and nobody came over to greet us take our order or even a drink order so we walk out again. I overheard the staff saying that they were swamped and the kitchen was backed up (not the 1st time Ive heard this BS excuse) and the inside wasn't even crowed. Other times Ive been here the service has been hit or miss most of the time has been waiting forever to put an order in or to receive my food. I don't wanna call everybody out here Im sure theres some good staff that work there but most of them are straight up rude and weird. Too busy being cool and messing around than to worry about what their table needs. Its sad that I can count more bad experiences Ive had here than good ones. They need to just clean house and get a whole new staff. Go to the one in NoLibs Ive never had a problem there yet. As for me I will NEVER be back to this god awful location!!
Home away from home! Needed a taco badly since I had been away from Mexico for a while and this did the job!

The vibe of this place is the shiznit. The food is AWESOME and the music is unexpected. Early 2000s top 40 hits playing in the background with and the swanky look and feel of the restaurant just made this place so damn cool. It sits on top of an Urban Outfitters which is a bit weird but once you're inside you don't even notice. I have to say the best thing on the menu is the Banh Mi. I could eat that allll day. Not gonna lie, the portions are a bit small but the prices are reasonable so I didn't mind. The group of friends that I went with ordered 5 different things and we ate it all family style (I recommend this so you can try everything). The food was so good that we annihilated everything in like 5 min. It came out fast and the waitress was so awesome. Gotta tell ya, the food was so good that my friend felt so compelled to run over to the chef and tell him. He was so nice and appreciative. I definitely recommend this place if you want to eat out in Brooklyn!
Went for brunch, and I think it's a bit overrated. Prepare to wait awhile since it is quite a popular place.  I'm not sure what all the hype is about... The decor is nice and staff was friendly.
Romantic French Bistro. Outstanding Food, menu and wine list. Ridiculously crowded. Service is Above average. Lots of fun for a loud, fun couples night out.

I've been here twice for special occasions and have been disappointed both times...Most recently I ordered the fried chicken and fries...and my date ordered the beef brisket. It was a Wednesday night and the restaurant was fairly empty. Food: The food took well over 30 minutes to come out and the waitress profusely apologized for the delay which made me weary.  I realized why once I took a bite into my chicken and fries. Both were cold...not  warm at all. I immediately told the waitress and she apologized and said they would bring more out. I made sure to ask that it was not just going to be placed under the heat lamp, but actually prepared over again and she assured me it would be.  While we were waiting, my date continued to eat his cold beef brisket  (because he was too shy/timid to say anything...that's guys for ya).  While we were sipping on our cocktails and waiting for my newly prepared meal, the manager came over and apologized as well.   My fried chicken came out again and this time the chicken was super hot, crispy and delicious, but my fries were off...They were super deep fried and hard....almost as if they had just placed the same fries back into the frying machine again rather than making a fresh batch.  They were drenched in oil and made me feel sick Service: the waitress was friendly and apologetic...so was the manager. Atmosphere: super cool retro atmosphere. If they had just a bar, I would come here for drinks and maybe apps, but not an entire meal.

Okay, So I have been to this place twice and very disappointed both times. Especially since I've heard great things. First, if you are expecting the servers to be friendly then this is not the place for you. When you walk in there is no host/hostess, there is a sign in sheet.. The first time I came here we did not know this. We walked in and were ignored for about ten minutes until another couple who was eating there told us of this. four servers walked by us and completely ignored us. they could of said hi please sign in or just a welcome sign in sheet is behind you.. but no. The seating outside was empty both times I've went. We waited for 30 mins until someone called our name. We asked to sit outside but they said it was only for parties bigger then four. If they sat smaller parties outside the wait would of been shorter for many people waiting. Once we finally sat the server was not friendly. We thought maybe it is just a busy day so we decided to try this place a again. But same thing happened.. rude service. The food was just average. I honestly wish hawthornes did not burn down so i could of saved myself from coming to this place.
Falafel heaven! Delicious pita bread with hummus right in the center city philadelphia:) If you want to try an authentic Jewish food this place is number 1 on the list!
yummy: mashed potato pizza: enough said!!

Nothing special. Pricey. I had the beef brisket which was kind of a dark grey color and salty with fat chunks. Collards were average. Chicken smoked rice was really salty. Basically inedible. My son had the $10 burger that was good but really small and didn't come with any sides. Saving grace was really good corn bread. 5 kinds of sauce on the table but not one of them mustard based. Sad. Service was friendly but rushed us through our meal and only checked on us once. I won't be back.

Let me start off by saying that my family has held a few events at the Bethwood.  My cousins wedding in 2003, my college graduation party in 2005, my aunts wedding in 2010 and most recently my grandmother's birthday this Sept. 2014.  This is probably the last time our family does business with the Bethwood.   This review is strictly on the unprofessional, rude, and disrespectful behavior of one of the managers Steve Ranieri.   Our family had fully prepaid the event in advance (because that is a requirement at this venue).  After the party had ended, at the end of the night, the manager delivered a bill for a few extra charges approx.$300.  My mother told Steve she didn't agree with some of the charges and he told her "I'm not got to discuss this".  "You're coming with me now and we are going to pay this bill".  She also tried to explain she didn't have the cash to pay the balance and can pay later.   He immediately responded "This bill is getting paid now"  and repeatedly said "YOU come with me Now, YOU are going to pay this bill".  His tone was very loud, rude and disrespectful.   He did NOT ONCE say "PLEASE" or "Let's talk about this".  He spoke to her in such a degrading way my uncle and I rushed to her side in her defense.   Steve then got in an ugly shouting match with my uncle. I suggest you search for a venue with better customer service and treats their clients with respect.
ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE. Basil gnocchi is horrid, clam pizza is horrific, waiters were very rude. Out of a group of 8, not one single person enjoyed their meal! Definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!!

What a terrible experience with our server. After waiting a while for our order to be taken it was. Five minutes later the server comes back to ask if we are ready to order. We explained we ordered and were waiting on our drinks. Chocolate Egg Cream gets slopped across table and delivered to wrong person in our party. No apology and server is gone before we can ask for sweetener. When called over becomes argumentative and blames us on mess.  When food comes out, it's nearly dropped on the floor and again wrong food matched to us. We were only a party of three.

Old reliable! They deliver VERY quickly, they are inexpensive and they are so sweet on the phone. I like the chicken curry stew. And the steak. My family likes the Salmon too. The midtown location serves beer too! Great spot for eat in or delivery.
A solid Indian restaurant. I would have preferred to have more onions in my onion rava dosa though. The palak paneer (spinach paneer) is good. I like that the paneer is not soggy/too soft.

I am currently here and l'm typing this!!!! Let's get this straight from the very beginning....This place is super amazingly outrageously dope!!!!! Where else can you get great food thats made with beer but you have a personal choice of over 700 different beers. YES 700 DIFFERENT BEERS. Today my friend & I had the Angus & Andouille Sausage Sliders...Lamb Loin Chops but the star of them all was the Cajun Gumbo. MANNNNN LISTEN THIS SH*T RIGHT HERE IS AMAZING. We would have taken pics of it all but the food was so great we didn't have time. If you ever want a nice chill kickback Saturday turn down day then visit THE BOTTLE BAR EAST to fulfill all of your alcholic & foodie senses.  BTW ask for HEATHER SHE'S AMAZING, PERSONABLE & KNOWLEDGEABLE....4 thumbs up ( that's from the both of us)

From the moment you walk in you know this place is special. Beautiful decor, fantastic mix of middle eastern and Mediterranean.  Try the alcoholic special drinks- they are amazing. Ask for Tony, the owner, to recommend his favorites. You will love the grilled octopus paired with seafood risotto. I had the Kafta. save room for dessert!!  The creme brûlée was to die for. Fig and espresso Ice cream too. Beautiful place and very hospitable service.

Good food but what bothers me consistently is having to remind the staff to include my rice and gravy then have them proceed to get upset that I reminded them of what's on their own menu. Fix this and the people constantly standing in front of the restaurant id gladly bring more people to enjoy this restaurant.

This was my wife and my second time coming to this restaurant. The first time, we stumbled across it by accident.  This time, we made sure that it was our first stop after we checked into our hotel. We love it.  Everything is so fresh and tasty.  We brought our son this time, and he agrees that it is a must do for Mexican food, when in Burlington. The Margaritas are among the most flavorful that I have ever had.  The menu today was soft tacos and they were terrific.  I had one sweet potato and one beef.  They were both very tasty.
Worth the trip! Had a slice of Chocolate Swirl Cheesecake. The cake was extremely rich yet deliciously light and very flavorful. Loved every bite!!!! Will be a fan for life!

Not accommodating...drove from Gladwyne to try because saw in Philly mag. Wouldn't serve me a drink and tonight is my 40th bday!! I didn't bring id because had a new purse?!  And haven't been carded in years. With my hubby who is 50? And we were ready to drink and eat up!! Their loss!

I live in NY and was in the area and needed to bring a couple of pies to a friend.  It was hard to know where to go and I have found lots if not great pizza in CT.  I ordered their regular cheese pizza and one with a grilled chicken topping.  They were really good, comparable to pizza at home but less money here.  The chicken was not overwhelming and gave it more substance.  The kids liked it and they got their protein included.  Overall very good but the different sizes were confusing to me.  We only have 2 choices at home.

The food here was pretty good, but it was slightly lacking compared to other places in the area. Service was fast, but our waitress was a little impatient and unfriendly. Overall, the food was good for the price, but you can find better sushi in nearby restaurants for a slightly higher price.

Visited for the first time with a guy friend last night (apparently his gender is relevant, wait for it!) to split a burger and have a couple of beers at the bar. The bartender made a point to not acknowledge that I was also a patron and directed all conversation towards my friend while engaging with the other men at the bar. This went on for the entirety of out time there. As we stood up together to leave after paying for our meals, the bartender yelled after my friend "Thank you, have a great night, Buddy!", again forgetting that he was serving TWO people, one of which he didn't think deserved to be thanked for their business. He again made a point to not look in my direction. Thinking there was no way for someone in service to be so blatantly rude without reason, I walked back to the bar and waved saying, "Thank you, good night!". No response. He again, ignored me as though I wasn't standing in front of him. The guys still sitting at the bar with whom he was talking looked at me, clearly confused as to why I wasn't being acknowledged when I was clearly heard. Word of advice, keep in mind that males and females deserve to receive the same dining experience. Women are also who you are attempting to earn a living off of by being welcoming. The tip was adjusted accordingly. Ignoring the only minority female at the bar is not a good look for you as an individual, much less the establishment you are representing. I will not be coming back and definitely won't be recommending.

The food here is very ordinary... but they are generous with their portions.  The first time I went, the falafal was mushy and clearly had been sitting there for too long, they should give you fresh crunchy falafel.  Also the hummous is very bland.  This being said the food is really OK and the portions are generous.
The food is fantastic! The atmosphere is great and clean! The Chana Masala and non bread were amazing!

Tried this place for the first time tonight.  A group of us ordered several things.  The grilled chicken salad was so good!  Their oil and vinegar dressing was the best I ever had.  I also tried a bite of their pan pizza - so good.  Everyone only had great things to say.  I highly recommend this place :)

This is a great spot for a bite to eat. They always get the order right, the prices are very reasonable, and the company is great! When I don't feel like cooking breakfast, my honey surprises me with a beautiful breakfast sandwich from here. It adds a healthy balance to our love life!
Excellent food, strong beer list, and inventive cocktails, definitely worth checking out

It's pretty awesome ramen. Up to par with Ippudo ramen, pretty close. If Ippudo is an A, i would give Minca an A minus. We ordered the shoyu- 10.50 pork broths with the thick noodle and the Toroniku Ramen- slow cooked pork with the cabbage and thick noodle 15.50 Broth was very tasty, pork was tender and soft. One of the better ramen places that I've eaten. Who would have expect that between ave a and b there will be a ramen eatery. Overall, it was a nice dinner with great company. There are so many ramen places in this part of town to choose from, but give Minca a shot as you might enjoy it, especially on a cold winter day.

Where should I begin...being foreign in the United States it's hard find food that reminds you of home and its even more difficult to find the perfect ambiance to accompany the food. I went to Vonda Kitchen because of all the fabulous reviews and also after searching on Google for soul food in Newark. I don't care about any bad reviews by any mindless and confused customers. From the minute I stepped into the restaurant I felt home...for starters I had the ginger lemonade,goodness me it tasted just like my mother's homemade ginger ale I nearly wept. I met a wonderful woman named Gail she's from Trinidad we spoke for hours like we've known each other for years...she was friendly and so warm hearted. The customers around me were so welcoming and inviting talking to me...please note I have an accent and it's difficult for a lot of people to understand me. This restaurant is something really special...from the way they prepare their food to the way they treat their customers it's absolutely worth while. I never wanted to leave...I had the shrimp and grits and blueberry pancakes. Where I come from we don't have grits and pancakes...so when I had that I was instantly drawn to southern food...I wish I could never get full I would have tried everything thing on the menu. Whoever the owner is I must tell you that you're  doing a fanstastical job...from your restaurant's decor,to how your employees dress,to your amazingly delicious food and to all the wonderful lovely customers you attract. I'm honored to be a customer in your restaurant. May the Lord give you the strength to keep on keeping on.

5 Star service, ambiance and of course food! The decor of this place is quite beautiful and the wine is top-notch. Every waiter was very attentive and the presentation of every dish was beautiful. This place is truly a gem and I will definitely be returning in the near future. Try the grilled octopus, it is amazing.

This place is not the place to host a meal for a large party. This place advertises they have a party room but its simply understaffed and kitchen is not equipped for such large parties. I was invited to a christening celebration and food was served like 2 hours everyone arrived... By the time I got the good my appetite was good and food was all bland and tasteless. My plates were piling and had to request to get taken away. The manager at the time kept saying the delay was because of the hanger steak was being ordered well done v.s medium rate SERIOUSLY???!! It's hanger steak that doesn't take too long. The place had like close to 100 people there and like 3 people working. Totally understaffed, horrible service, not even an apology to the guests at the table nothing place is horrible totally don't recommend going there, food not even decent.
Frites n Sweets are to die for.  Aioli and banana ketchup are incredible.  Pineapple salsa on their tacos is terrific.   A little overpriced though.
Super delicious food. Congenial and attentive service. Oh and absolutely divine and true to form cocktails. The Earl Grey creme brûlée sublime!

Pizza is okay sometimes, the other dishes are not good, was much better before new owner ship which is odd because the owners previous pizza place was the bomb, either  way i want to say the chicken piccata was terrifying and watery and just gross looking
All was great We sat down in the porch I have salmon raw appetizer and gnocchi and my hubby  bisteca Service was great

Amy Ruth's is amazing. The location, the vibe, the food all play into this delightful food experience. Subway stops right next to the restaurant. The food is reasonably priced, especially for the City. The food was excellent here. I ordered chicken and waffles smothered.  Everything was hot, fresh and tasty. No complaints at all. Nice big portions. I also ordered a side of Mac and cheese. It was great. Complimentary cornbread was also nice. Decor was nice, place was clean, and the music was good.   Overall, I would recommend this place, and have. Numerous times.

Dropped by today because I was absolutely starving and this place is adorable!!  I had a little tomato and cheese sandwich and it was all fresh and toasty and reasonably priced (I think it was $4?).  Looks like they have a cool interactive wall?  I didn't have a chance to check it out.

They've only been open for a week, and their food is delicious!  Staff is friendly, management came out to thank everyone for coming, and the chef came out to talk, too. French onion soup made from scratch impressed even my mom who says it was as good as the best she had in Paris.  My stuffed flounder with spinach and boursin was fantastic, as were the whipped saffron potatoes.  Cappuccinos were good as was the tiramisu dessert.  It's a small restaurant, so get your reservation on OpenTable & go!

The fried chicken was simply put...the BEST I've EVER had!!! The local catch was HORRIBLE!!!! It tasted disgusting and repulsive. As if it should have been taken out with the trash 3 days prior to my arrival. I arrived with my daughter and her boyfriend as they were preparing to open. The staff was very friendly and inviting. Since this was our second time dining there, we were very excited. We were going to try something new. I needed to use the bathroom while we waited for our meals to arrive. I did get something new. The bathroom reeked of old urine. I almost gagged! I looked around the perimeter of the toilet, and it looked as if it hadn't been cleaned for at least 2 weeks. The smell was atrocious!!! It was not like this the first time I visited Root & Bone. They need to re-group!!!!!!

This place is a triumph, plain and simple. The food is phenomenal, the prices are phenomenal and the servers are phenomenal. If you haven't been here, do yourself a favour and go. Get the pastelitos as an appetizer.... or as a meal. I've had them as an app nearly every time I've been there. And the times when I'm not as hungry, I've had them as a meal with a side of Jose's Rice. The pastelitos are delicious... So delicious that as I write this review I'm sending a text to a friend to have them meet me at Jose's later today.

Absolutely delicious tapas, they deserve their high rating! Had beautiful weather on the patio, they were dog friendly, had attentive staff and food came out quickly. Will definitely come back next time we're in the area.

very good food. great atmosphere perfect for brunch. if you are hungover the blinding light of day won't hurt your eyes. my only complaint is they forgot yo write down bacon when i asked for it on the side

We liked it. The atmosphere is solid and the backyard is fantastic. Whiskey selection is strong, and having Stoudt's beer on tap is a big bonus. The bar staff could use an extra portion of personality, but no one's perfect. Generally a nice, chill atmosphere.
Great Pizza. The services was great. Me and my family will be comming back Thanks Modern Apizza for a wonderful experience

I AM IN LOVE WITH THE FOOD HERE! My fav is the lunch special of white rice pink beans and pernil OMG! With avocado absolutely amazing! If it was up to me I would order that everyday but my fiancé won't let me lol highly recommend!

I've been in NYC for about two weeks now and this is the first disappointment I've had. I am not a stranger to middle eastern food and love myself a good shwarma plate and the reviews made me think this place would be my go to. Not the case Cons: -messed up order (1 lamb and 1 chicken instead of two chicken) -chicken was 90% fat and connective tissue. Very low quality. My fiancee couldn't eat it and we fed it to the dog -our surprise lamb was pretty tough, not enough seasoning Pros: -Sauce was delicious -Delivery guy was nice -The dog enjoyed the chicken I feel weird going against the crowd here so it's possible they were having an off night. We also didn't eat any of the pita or go the sandwich route so maybe it's the bread people like. At any rate it's not for me, and if you care about meat quality it's probably not for you either.

You're better off going to Taco Bell. Ever since this place opened up I wanted to go. I finally got the chance but I was very disappointed. From the outside the place looks gorgeous. It looks like a high-end restaurant from the outside. From the inside it's terrible. Nothing about the inside of the restaurant is high-end besides Prices. The food is terrible. Straight up nasty. I got a burrito and Tamale. Tamale was disgusting. I literally almost puked. The only good food was the fried ice cream that i had for desert. I do not recommend this restaurant to anyone!!!! Think of this restaurant as a high-end Taco Bell with super expensive nastier food!

Chef Ramsey would be upset. Food quality was poor.  The pasta wasn't cooked enough.  The veggie burger tasted like a cheap burger you'd buy in the frozen food aisle.  Service: waitress seemed bothered that we were there.  There is no reason for me to ever return to this place.

I got a cheese omelet with bacon and homefries. The eggs were not scrambled well at all and the cheese was not melted in the omelet. The homefries tasted like grease. It was terrible, but the waitress was nice.

Love this place! We went here on Thursday because there was Trivia night. Me and my boyfriend got pork quesadillas which were okay (chipotle ranch that came drizzled on top made the dish), we also got the Dublin Pot Pie i think it was called. It was pretty good but small portioned and we also got the ice cream trifecta which was perfect! Sangria is also amazing! I definitely recommend this place!

Visiting fr out of town.  Looked like a nice spot, long wait so figured it must be good.  Killed some time and saw yelped and saw the low reviews and got worried - but we had a good experience.  Sure portions are not jumbo sized but it's enough to fill you up.  Had the fungi and the sauce was yummy, could have used a tad bit more salt and more sauce on the noodles.  Daughter had the cologne as she said the sauce was great but noodles were a little hard for her taste.   The bread was a bit greasy but the olive oil was good.  The calamari was just alright.   If I lived around here I would come back and try it again.

I grew up in the Philly suburbs and during the several years I lived in Center City I lived on a steady diet of cheesesteaks and pizza... so I am normally highly judgmental about so-called "philly cheesesteak" places that I've encountered outside of the Delaware Valley. So even though this place is only 6 blocks from my apt I've avoided it for fear of disappointment. But today I tried it and was impressed. Even walking over to the place I realized that its in the EXACT shitty location that someone from Philly would put a cheesesteak place - just like Tony Luke's it's on a busy industrial blvd next to a freeway overpass. You walk in and it seriously looks like they ripped all the fixtures out of a place anywhere in Philly down to the trash cans. Instead of posting stupid photos of the philly phanatic and the liberty bell all over the place, which is what most non-philly steak places do, they replicated the south street magic gardens mosaic on a wall, a touch I appreciated. The menu was mostly authentic. Steak sandwiches, 2 standard types of cheese (pro tip - cheese whiz is not the preferred cheese of most philly natives), onions and other add-ons. The rest of the menu has some other standards and a few creative options for brooklyn foodies that seems to have taken some cues from the paesano's sandwich lineup. Anyhow the sandwich itself mostly lived up to my expectations, and that was a win. Not the greatest cheesesteak I've ever had, but pretty much equivalent to what you'd get at a pizza place or a deli in Philly. The roll was cut on both ends and got soggy quickly, which hints that this is not a true Amaroso roll (critical component). Pretty close approximation however. Of course at $10 this is 2x what you'd pay for an equivalent cheesesteak in Philly but hey it's Brooklyn and they gotta pay the rent. Places around here tend to turn over very quickly these days and it's in a crap location and has some serious sandwich competition nearby so I'm really hoping this place stays in business for a while

I love this place. Even though I do not live close by, I'd find myself here every single year. I love the pad Thai It is a huge portion - and by that, I mean, I finish it and feel like I'm going to have a mini food baby. The food is really cheap and the portions are huge. But that goes for pretty much every Thai restaurant. I liked the ambience of the place though and I would definitely go back again...just not on a weekend when it's extra loud and extra crowded.

I'm a ramen fan feel this place is over hyped.  The ramen tastes gritty and after visiting two Toto Ramen locations I noticed their noodles in both places were a tiny bit undercooked. It wasn't bad just over hyped.

Ashbox is the best lunch restaurant in the entire world. Yoko is charming, the food is healthy and delicious, the music is relaxing, the avocados are always perfect, and everything is right in the world.

Not only cheap, but the best jiao ze (potstickers) I've had since I lived in China.   Go for it, don't be intimidated if you don't speak Chinese!   Stand in line; do what you have to do to get here and get an order of fried dumplings!   It's old school at its best!!!

Here's my story: I'd been on the road for 2 days, trying to get by with boring strip-mall caesar salads in places that had nothing but all-american fare, caught a cold, and needed a place to get a bowl of hot broth made from scratch to cure my viral/road food blues.  And it was date night, so I needed a place for my hungry sweetheart.  We started with the cobia - kaffir lime/pomelo/jackfruit sashimi and then a green papaya salad.  Both were well executed, but I would have gone lighter on the fish sauce.  Crispy shallots topped the salad off nicely.   When I walked in I could tell  the broth would be interesting, curiously (maybe because of my cold) the overwhelming impression was of cassia cinnamon.  I was a little nervous, not sure what it would be like, but was delighted when I tasted it. We both got the beef pho - I got a small, which for my 120lb midsize appetite (I'd skipped lunch) was perfect.  My date ate/drank every last drop of his regular size portion and was stuffed. The broth may not have cured my cold, but it made me feel a whole lot better: rich in flavor but not fatty; bright with herbs, and balanced. Do I think it's as authentic as south Philly vietnamese pho?  Hard to tell, I've never been to Vietnam.  My hunch is probably not.  Did I miss the beef tendons, when what I got was delicious meatball and and abundance of tender beef cuts?  Not a bit.   When I mentioned I found the green papaya a bit too salty, the chef kindly offered us the pineapple dessert on the house. I'm won over - we'll definitely be back.

this place look dirty to me, the food are so bad and on top the owner, I believe the sister give me a attitude, will never ever go back there, they do not know what they do, anyway Starbucks is coming soon.
Excellent wine selections. Limited but interesting menu.  Try the onion soup.
Awesome chicken empanadas!!!

As a renowned "omelet snob" I let server Ashley know that if the egg white omelette with mushroom, spinach, onion and cheese I ordered was terrible, I'd end up on Yelp. Her response "I'm up for challenge." Not only was the omelette superb, Ashley's service was as well.  And it's BYO?! Meet your new brunch spot
As good as it gets! without a doubt a gem in the area.

This place is a neighborhood gem. Good food, good service, very reasonably priced, casual... the kind of place you could eat at every other week. Probably not a place to travel across town for, though. We ordered the Mezze platter, Greek salad, and Iskender Kebab.  This was plenty of food for two people since the plates were all huge!  Loved the hummus and Patlican Salatasi (mashed eggplant). The bread came out nice and warm.  Prices are very reasonable and you definitely won't leave hungry. They have a nice wine selection I just wish they had more options by the glass. Come here any night of the week for some amazing Mediterranean food, although maybe make a reservation.

We stopped by last night for a drink & snack. Not a traditional sushi place, but they're not trying to be. Sushi: perfect ratio of filling to rice (a thin layer of rice, lots of inside.) Veggie Tempura: awesome. Kale!! Brussels sprouts!! Peppers! Drinks were normal drinks. Service is a little confused but earnest! This building has changed over so many times I'm willing to give the staff a break.

Delicious! Had a marvelous and generous sized appetizer of mussels and clams. The roasted butternut squash and asparagus sides were wonderful, as well. The waitress was terrific at handling our large party efficiently and graciously. And the kitchen staff was very accommodating of my dietary restrictions. I'll be back!

A group of 11 of us ate here last night and it was pretty bad overall. The waitress never introduced herself or said the specials, instead she walked over and asked "are you just gonna drink"? Ummm, no we made a god damn reservation obviously we're not just drinking. She checked in once for drink refills over the entire 2 hour dinner. The restaurant ran out of Sierra nevadas after my first one, so I ordered some draft beer that was clearly from a stale keg because it tasted super chalky. Then the waitress completely botched my buddy's order and brought him fish instead of chicken, and didn't offer to correct it or anything. He's a nice guy and didn't complain but that was ridiculous, because she acknowledged it was the wrong order as she placed it down in front of him. My scallops were good, but I just expected much better service for a restaurant at this price point in the west village. Especially when we doubled their business on an otherwise quiet night.

Highly dissappointed with the food. We ordered three cheesesteaks - two chicken and one beef and all were horrible. The bread quality was very bad as well. I would strongly advise people not to go here.

Pizza is delicious. Their jalepeno peppers are really spicy but good! The wait to get in was a long line but moved very quickly. One thing I have to say is the service can work on their attitude. They are always in a rush to get people out. I understand that they have people waiting and are very busy. But the service here is the type that relies on their "great pizzas" for their tips. I'd recommend them to pay a little more attention to their tables. My server didn't ask us once how our pizza is or if we need anything. He dropped the check before asking if we want dessert or anything else.

This bar had a jamming playlist. Music was on-point. We went around 9pm and it was busy but we were still able to get a table. The bar is larger than it looks when you walk in as there is a second story. We tried their beers. I had a Clearwater IPA which was very good. We had the pot stickers and veggie quesadilla - both were exceptionally good, especially since it was bar food. Our waitress was Missy. She was very nice and checked-in on us multiple times.  Would highly recommend to stop in for a drink.

Had one of the best salads I've ever had in my life at this place. The combination of brie with sweet roasted walnuts and tender chicken was just delicious. Also their fries taste great (and I'm Belgian so I'm picky if it comes to this). Good steaks and also the mussels are better than in most places. Definitely a restaurant I'd come back to again in the future.

Wow. I went to yelp and "your next review awaits" was Pat's. I hadn't been here in quite some time, but just happened  have an early lunch there last week.  Pat's has thousands  of reviews. So will mine make a profound difference? Doubt it! But I feel it must be pointed  out  that that these are NOT direct reviews of Pat's that state a  standard restaurant criteria. Example: food, drinks, service, price, atmosphere, etc, The unique, and likely unfair, characteristics of these reviews is that they have a division/competition between out-of-towners/tourists and Philadelphia residents. Additionally, another large portion pits Pat's directly against Geno's! Neither of these situations seems fair or appropriate when giving an honest and concise opinion of a single establishment. So on to a proper review. I had a cheesesteak wit, applied my personal preference of ample condiments, and a soda. Total cost: approx:$12. Not unreasonable for a totally filling and delicious lunch!
Excellent food.  Good prices. Acceptable service. This sets the standard for easy food in New York!
Really tasty  hamburger. Myself and my wife where presently surprised by the food and service, very friendly atmosphere!  This for the Princeton NJ location.
ummmmmm yummy! its a great place for a date or to hang with friends. The food is sooo good and the drinks are great too!

This is my go to place!!! The nicest staff, the best Margarita's (Blood orange YUM) Their guac is to die for and I mean all of them! They will accommodate your meal in anyway that they can to fit your special diet needs!! This is a must go to if you haven't been or are passing through town!

The Windjammer has been a good solid restaurant for years, and their salad bar is fantastic.  However, like many other restaurants have been doing recently, they are showing how much a 20%, 15%, etc. tip should be on your check.  But the amounts they calculate for you are conveniently DOUBLE the correct amount.  For people who are in a hurry or hate math, I'm sure these people are tipping these exorbitant amounts.  The last time I was there I pointed this out on a comment card, and received an email from the manager saying that they've been having trouble with the computer function or program that calculates the gratuity.  Ok fine, that's understandable.  So now it's 2 months later and I just dined there tonight.  And guess what....the gratuity calculations are still very incorrect on the bill.  This is very dishonest; they are knowingly providing  false information and are really profiting from it.  I'm very fond of their food, but this equates to really shady service.

One star is to much for this place the food has zero flavor and it will upset your stomach every time and if there's any more then 8 people eating at the restaurant the staff can barely handle everyone also if your thinking about ordering for pick up check your food 100% of the time the order is either wrong or your missing something

How this place got 4 stars, I'll never understand.  If you want beer, it's a fine place, I suppose.  The "signature" cocktail menu was lame.  One drink, we were told by the waiter sucked.  We had a cucumber vodka drink that was very average.  The food?  To give you an idea of how bad it was, I am writing this review from my toilet after making it back to the hotel.  The crab dip was runny and lacking any deep flavor.  The pita bread that came with it was greasy.  BUT, not near as greasy as the fried pickles.  My wife picked one up and the grease literally dripped off of it.  When asked by the waiter how everything was, my normally reserved wife stated, "The pickles sucked."  Never an apology.  In any event, if you're going for a simple drink, although loud, I suppose it's a fine place.  If you are even remotely hungry, run.  Run fast.

Not sure what the big deal is. Prepared food that is less than mediocre yet they charge pretty much the same price as some of the higher end places. The lines are long and it's not the most convenient place.

Woorijip brims with a myriad of freshy, inexpensive, tasty Korean dishes; available hot and fast. I figured this place would be really good and authentic since almost every person in the restaurant was Korean. Huge selection of finger food to eat with a good amount of different kinds of soju, sake, and beer as well as yummy korean drinks. Food I tried and loved: Spicy noodles Bulgogi Mook/Acorn Jelly (MY FAV BANCHAN OF ALL TIME!) Kimchee fried rice. The atmosphere isn't anything to brag about, but this place is for the cheap good food, not the decor. Definitely come here if you need a quick bite of good food to grab.
The food is so disappointing, service is not bad though and the drinks are pretty good. I don't think I will go again.

We had avocado salad, kalbi, harami, beef tongue, premium sirloin, sukiyaki bibimbap, and green tea mille crepes. The menu was a bit limited compared to the ones in Tokyo, but everything was delicious. My best favorite is harami for sure. I see some people gave low ratings because the service was slow. We also needed to wait a little bit as we didn't make a reservation, but otherwise, the service seemed perfectly fine to me. Our server was very very friendly and made us feel welcomed. I would definitely come back :)
Prepare for extreme slow service, specially when dining outside. otherwise food at a good price.

Ah, I want to love Russet but I just can't. I went there tonight and while the food was delicious, the service was horrible! There ere two of us and we shared a 1st course and each ordered a 2nd course. All there dishes were excellent! Here's the bad news, our 'server' (although I'm not exactly sure who that was) didn't greet us, didn't clear our plates and when he presented the desert menu, didn't return for over 30 minutes. The inside in cute and the atmosphere is sweet, but he passed by our table SEVERAL times without a peep. Hello, we actually wanted to order desert. By the time the hostess of all people came by to ask if we wanted desert, we decided to leave and walk to capaggiro. Huge disappointment. I was just talking to a colleague about how even when you get bad service, you tip 20% and it doesn't give any signal that they need to improve. So, I decided to leave a 6% tip which was reflective of the service received. So sad because the food is so good!

Finally tried the brunch.  The cornflake crusted French toast is quite delicious!! Perfect amount of cornflakes, bread and batter. It's basically a modern/italian bistro- nothing too fancy, nothing too complicated.  Simple menu, heavy on seafood. For the price, the food here is pretty solid and delicious. For dessert, we had the red velvet cake and apple crisp... The entrees were above average.  As another review stated, the hanger steak had burnt edges. I highly recommend Perilla...as I plan on returning with a few friends for some really good food.

I went there on Saturday night with friends. The front looked like we were in Hoboken, except for the lack of customers it was quite deserted. We made reservations just in case, but it is not necessary. Our soda's were watered down and the diet tasted like Tab. We ordered the fried calamari and muscles.  They were out of muscles so we settled for fried calamari.  I think they got the calamari from the Shop Rite frozen bags, dried out and lifeless. I ordered the rib eye and my friends ordered the filet mignon.  Well Longhorn's steaks put this place to shame and Longhorn is quite mediocur. My ribeye came out dry and lifeless about a quater of an inch thick, I felt I was at Tad's Steak house in Times Square, except it cost a lot more for this disaster. The ketchup was discolored which means it was old. I feel we wasted our appetites on substandard food, that cost alot.  If you want to go here you had better do it quickly because with the amount of customers they have and the poor quality food,  it will not be here to much longer. If you want a decent steak go elsewhere, even the Broadway dinner is better.....

I came here with my family for brunch this morning and was concerned about what I would eat because I am gluten intolerant. I called before I came and spoke with the manager. I asked if it was possible for me to bring my own gluten free bread and have them make a panini for me and he said yes! Let me tell you, it was so delicious and now I know why everyone raves about them! Thank you so much for accommodating me!

The food just tasted great!!! I go to Indian restaurants every now and then in NYC, the food here tasted best so far. The folks were courteous and the place is clean. Their lunch plate also has Nan, they have brown rice / basmati rice options. I also had the MANGO LASSI -- yummy!!!

Not only my favorite Thai place in the city, but it's such a bargain! The appetizers are probably my favorite part and with their prices, you can literally try all of them. Don't miss the curry puffs. They're out of this world, amazing. Also, I love spicy and this is one of the few places that I've been that can do it to taste. Definitely a go to place for me and a few of my friends.

Terrific ambiance, friendly and welcoming service, and all the drinks and appetizers we had at our table of 6 were excellent. We especially liked the empanadas and lobster taquitos, but everything was very enjoyable. We'll be back!

Another of our must-do stops. Particularly in the fall/winter when they have the punkin' waffles. Waits can be long, especially on the weekends, and worth it. I was excited for the brunch menu. For $17 you get a bunch dish and a drink of your choice. However, all the dishes they are known for are super sweet - Nutella maple syrup powdered sugar French toast or pumpkin waffles. Was feeling more savory so I got the Penny Egg sandwich instead on the a la carte menu. Definitely planning on coming back for some breakfast meals and probably some more pies.

Despite being the only costumers they forget to make our food. Stopped in here for a quick bite. We ordered a crepe to share and a pastry - we paid got the pastry were given a number and sat down. We sat for what seemed like a long time. We were the only ones in there. We listened as the staff chatted away. We then decided to ask for our crepe to go. OOPS they forgot to make our food. How could you forget when we were the only ones in there?  They offered us a coffee while we waited but we had waited enough.   We asked for a refund and they asked if they could refund cash instead of the credit we had originally paid. We agreed simply to get out of there sooner. With all the choice around town no need to stop in here ever again.

This place is miserable on so many levels.  The food is nothing more than half-ass tapas less than comparable to frozen food, and the service is mediocre to rubbish.  The worst part is the so called "chef" who does nothing more than sit at the bar like a beer guzzling swine and insults my close friend... Now, i must say this review is long overdo but after visiting this establishment once again, not much has changed.   The first time i went to this shit hole, my friend and I were visiting from Canada and we met (who is now my best friend and client) a girl who was just about the friendlies person we had met in NY.  After talking to her for awhile, we found out that she is used to be a trained pro. fighter in martial arts and also accomplished a few other impressive feats. We were talking when the chef... i think her name is amorette(?), decided to intrude in on the conversation and accused my friend of lying about her achievements.  The strange thing about all of this is that not only was she not invited to the conversation, but my friend didn't really know her.  To make a long story short, the lack of professionalism and utter rudeness on this "chefs" part was pretty disgusting.. and it didn't help that she just sat there like a pig guzzling beer.  After vowing to not go back to Ardesia, I was forced to attend a business gathering there, and unfortunately encountered the same horrible service and food we received the first time.  It turns out that not one person in my company enjoyed being at Ardesia, and it is safe to say that my PR company will not be visiting this place again.

Gennaro's serves not only the best...but the most authentic Italian food in Princeton. He has catered numerous parties for us and never fails to impress the guests with his superb cuisine. We look forward to our next event. Thank you, Gennaro!

Nasty burger wrapped in a nice bun. So they use a great bun on the burger, unfortunately the burger patty itself (the most important thing about a burger) was an undercooked sub-par piece of meat. Whenever a restaurant adds spices to a burger, they are trying to cover up that they use cheap beef. To make matters worse, we waited for almost 20 minutes just to get a check. The staff was friendly but too focused on talking with their friends outside then dealing with their customers. The decor inside is not very nice either, very messy behind the counter, makes you think what state the kitchen is in. I wouldn't recommend Juniper to anyone, stay away.

Two stars because the food is good. But the people who work there are morons. Especially the guy who answers the phone. First time i called in an order i ask him whats good because i've never eaten there before. He recommends something I go there to pick it up he said I ordered a mixed platter when he recommended a kabob. Then the next time i order i ordered the mixed platter cause it was good the first time I get there he TELLS ME i ordered the chicken platter. I said no i didn't he said yes i did and I double checked with you.... His attitude sucked and he hasn't gotten my order right once. You know what i'm taking a star back. Cause i just tried a wing that he said was good and it tastes like water.

Amazing! I took a ride down to Pennsylvania with my girlfriend & my cousin we all where starving & my cousin told me about this place, so we went there I eneded up getting 2 cheese steaks because they where just so good, line was long but it moved fast & quick! dont forget to the fries lol

The food was average, the meat did not taste very fresh. The service is terrible. We walked in early on a weekend to beat the rush and the lady who greeted us was so rude. We felt like we were imposing and they were doing us a favor by serving us. Will not be returning!
The workers are so rude. They even charged me for plastic plates. They take forever to bring out the food that only tastes mediocre for its price.

We got there early and by the time we left the place was packed! It was a Thursday night and I didn't expect this large restaurant to fill up, but it did. It was very different food and very good. I had the filet with a side of avocado, which was so simply prepared, yet so enjoyable. The filet was good and tasty, and not your father's filet. Served with lots of other goodies on the plate, it was a very filling meal. Loved the culture and the neighborhood.

Let me make one thing clear; my friend and I would have NOT known about this place if it were not for our host from Couchsurfing who knew everything about Philly! Kyhber Pass Pub, is an authentic Cajun Gastropub founded in 1970. It's one of Philadelphia's oldest bars and the menu features a satisfying selection of craft beers, hickory-smoked barbecue, authentic New Orleans specialties and more. My best friend and I ordered the small size of the "Nachos" which consisted of fresh corn tortilla chips, jack cheese, green tomato salsa, scallions and sour cream. My mouth is literally watering right now as I remember the burst of flavor this appetizer packed. All of the ingredients were fresh which enhanced the flavor. They were simple nachos and I think that's what allowed the flavors to really stand out. Most nachos are usually piled with heaps of cheese, sour cream, meats, etc. With so much food everything gets lost and some ingredients mask each other, but every ingredient in this dish was tasted and savored. Entrees My friend ordered from the Hickory Smoked Barbecue section of the menu. All entrees there are served with 3 bbq sauces: Kansas City (ketchup based), No. Carolina (vinegar based) and So. Carolina (mustard based). He ordered the "Sampler" which allows you to choose two or three meats and two sides for only $17. He picked pork ribs and pulled pork as his meats and chose collard greens and mac and cheese as his sides. I opted for the "North Carolina-style BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich" topped with spicy vinegar barbecue sauce and coleslaw which was $10. It came with one side so I also chose mac n cheese and added a side of collard greens for $4. I can honestly say that I never felt such a rush of emotions from biting into a sandwich. My friend and I pretty much ate in silence. We were so amazed by the food that when there was a second or two that food was not in our mouths we were too breath-taken to talk anyway. We just looked at each other with big bright eyes and exchanged nods of approval. I was impressed with the culinary skill and the passion that went into making this food. Not only that, but the service was above and beyond. My friend and I never had an empty water glass or empty dishes on the table; our waitress was there taking care of our every need. I have to admit that I will be taking another trip down to Philly solely for Khyber Pass Pub. I have never had nachos and collard greens so good anywhere else so I am sure those two will be repeat dishes.
I regularly go to UVA, really nice atmosphere an excellent wine and pasta. I recently went there for brunch too and really enjoyed the meal. really recommend it! Their gnocchi are out of this world!
UVA is a great spot for any night. Cozy atmosphere, great food, great wine. I have been with friends to drink and munch on apps and with dates for dinners. Good for either type of night.

Probably one of the best french restaurant that ive ever eaten at so far and its in an unexpected city like bloomfield! I was even fortunate enough to meet the chef and he was such a genuine and passionate individual. the ambiance was comfortable and the staff were very friendly. Its safe to say that ill be coming back soon

Bohemian is one of my favourite restaurants in New York. The concept, the atmosphere, the food- everything my taste.The fact that not too many people know about it (yet, and hopefully remains that way). We didn't order the tasting menu as we wanted to pick our own dishes. Everything there was so yummy- especially the Japanese steak, and it comes with sweet potatoes (my favourite!). Another favourite was the uni croquettes. Apart from the food, they also have amazing cocktails, really enjoyable dinner as always.
Great location. Friendly owners and GREAT TASTING PIZZA ! Can't wait to go back soon !!

I was there with my wife and my kids. We had great pasta for the kids, and 2 "not bad" testy chicken burgers for me and for my wife. My wife asked the waitress clearly that she don't want pork in her burger, and after we got the food we found that they add pork in it. We ask them nicely if they can remove it, and they did, but without an apology! I worked in many places, I believe mistakes are part of human nature, but the thing I found it non-professional in this place was making an error and not apologizing.

I wish I could give this place less than one star. This was the worst experience I have ever had at a bar. I came here with friends on a Saturday night. There was no one checking IDs at the door, but the bartender asked to see them when my friends ordered. We're 23, yet the bartender accused them of having fake IDs. His exact quote was, "There's no way this is you" (even though it was). I wasn't drinking, and yet he asked to see my ID and also accused me of using a fake. Again, to be clear, these are legitimate IDs. I try to assure him that they are real, and he sarcastically notes, "Oh, I guess if you promise." He finally serves my friends with a roll of his eyes. We go to sit on stools towards the end of the bar, and quickly get reprimanded by another employee for trying to go to the garden, which was closed, even though that's not where we were headed. Overall, the employees, particularly the bartender, were condescending and rude. I will never return here. I recommend heading to a bar with employees who have actually learned the meaning of customer service.

The bagel shop has been making their bagels smaller and smaller . They are very expensive for the size and quality of the bagel . They are very clean but I remember coming here as a kid and getting that bagel you were craving .

This brunch was excellent! Eggs with Polenta. Service was great and friendly not the typical american friendly - just friendly, I had the feeling she really cared. Not a cheap restaurant. A nice atmosphere, growded. Reservation is needed for the typical eating hours.

THE RUDE UNPROFESSIONAL MANAGER We were so excited to try this restaurant and unfortunately had such an AWFUL EXPERIENCE at the end of the evening that we will NEVER RETURN.   We booked a 7:15 PM reservation for 5 adults.  Three of us arrived on time.  My son and I went into the restaurant while my husband looked for parking (not easy to find) and ordered a cocktail.  The bartender was delightful!   The manager came over to us so I explained that my husband was searching for parking and our daughter and son in law were delayed by the traffic and rain from Tribeca but would be there within 10 minutes.  The manager said, "Fine, but we'll need your table before 9:30 PM because we have another reservation coming in".  Of course we understood and promised we would not "linger" and delay dinner for the next party.   We were all there and seated by 7:30 PM (15 minutes past our reservation time).  This was a special family dinner for us since we had not all been together in about 3 months.   We enjoyed trying all the different dishes .  Although not authentic (I'm Indonesian and I come from a long line of Indonesian chefs)  we certainly had fun and thought that the dishes were well presented and tasty.  The cuisine is more a "fusion" of Vietnamese/Indonesian but even so, the dishes were executed well.  Our server was just as delightful as the bartender.   The only person that would glare at us from time to time was the manager.   Well before 9:30 PM, we settled the check.  It was $350 before the gratuity.  We paid in cash.  Within a minute, the RUDE LITTLE MALE MANAGER came over and said, "the restaurant does not accept HUNDRED DOLLAR BILLS."  We were confused as there were NO SIGNS anywhere (not even printed on the menu) that hundred dollar bills/cash was not accepted within the restaurant.  We were all stunned...REALLY? Whoever heard of a restaurant in Brooklyn or NYC that doesn't accept cash?  We yanked out the AMEX card and paid our bill.   Our son who is in the hospitality industry decided to speak quietly to the manager at the back of the restaurant about the "no cash" policy.  It was quite obvious from the manager's  nasty attitude, that he had decided (in his feeble little brain) that we must have printed the bills up in the car before walking into "HIS" restaurant.  He got quite belligerent and dismissive with our son.   I have to admit, at that point I became quite irritated with his hideous attitude. I told him we did not appreciate his rudeness and he should not be treating customers in that way.  His response, "GET OUT OF MY RESTAURANT"!  As he was closing  the door behind me I proceeded to call him every name that fit! Sadly,  I'm sure this is not the first time this ridiculously, unprofessional, service person has behaved badly toward this restaurant's clientele.   The question is, WHY DOES THE CHEF HAVE THIS NASTY GUY AS HIS FRONT PERSON?   Is business so robust and brisk that he does not care about customers?   PLUS, if you have a policy of "NO CASH", POST IT!!!!!!   So, is Selamat Pagi worth the trip?  NO. We will certainly NEVER RECOMMEND it!
Awesome place to stop by for any thing, big breakfast plate it's great, There bagels are out standing! Egg, bacon, and lox All Day! Service is really friendly. Outstanding
Love this place!! everything is fresh and delicious. highly recommend if youre looking for a cute brunch spot!

It was my aunt's birthday and we ate here for brunch, there's a large selection of options to choose from and I was easily satisfied! My favorite was the omelet station where they created an omelet based upon my needs and the staff was courteous and friendly. I loved the vegetables and ranch dip that they had as another option of snack foods and I was unable to try the salads that they had. They also had an array of cheeses that looked exotic and delicious. I did not like the French Toast because it was a little hard to eat, but that's just me. I like my french toast soft and chewey. I also loved the tortellini, it was so delicious and made to perfection. They had a vast selection of desserts! From cheesecakes to cannolis, macarons and many more! They had ice cream and cookies and fruits you could dip in chocolate. I was definitely a fan of the strawberry cheesecake!! I enjoyed that very much.
expensive and not worth the $$$. went there last weekend-the sushi wasn't fresh and we didn't enjoy it at all. if i could give it 0 stars, i would
Just ate my first slice...best pizza I've had in Rahway so far...

The coffee is great, the front door staff move those waiting people in and bus tables quickly. You can sit inside, front area or back tables, fountain bar area, outside tables, the food is satisfying . If you are looking for high class fancy, hey it's a jersey diner in jersey. That is good enough!! Love it here, been here many times and never disappointed. When you are done, stroll around church street, so much fun!! Recommend.
Best local pizza for decades. Been going there over 35 years. The best and tony and the guys are always spot on friendly and amazing pizza etc always
Great food. Great atmosphere.
Amazing foood.. the menu is limited to a few signature dishes but each is as good as it gets !
Awful. Terrible service. The host lied to us while he was seating other people. Pretentious. Never going again.

Sophisticated, creative food without the fuss and stiffness from a high-end restaurant. The menu is simple and focused, transforming simple ingredients into innovative dishes.So nice presentations! They take the snob out of fine dining with a cozy and comfortable setting. Heavenly fresh foccacia with ricotta to start. Kieran takes you thru the beverage list. Restaurant that manages to feel intimate, bustling, special and everyday, all at once.I just love this place.
This is a small place with an incredible vibe. The food is fantastic. I had the chefs tasting menu and every dish was on point. A must try!
Offers breakfast sandwiches quickly when you're on the go. My favorite place to get breakfast before work. It's a mix of corner store and sandwich shop. Iced coffee is pretty good too!

Hands down probably my favorite restaurant ever. One of my friends recommended Cafeteria for brunch, but the place's menu for all meals looks amazing.  Perfect sized portions, diverse menu, excellent food.  Interior is super trendy and fun, and the staff is awesome; all very eclectic and cool!!  Our server gave us our beverages for free because she felt that we waited a while for them (it was a while, but this did not deter from our experience).  I'm a big breakfast sandwich lover, and theirs did not disappoint.  Overall, I will definitely be back!!

So disappointed.  I don't know if this place is under new ownership or what. Hamburgers were tasteless, fries were undercooked and tasteless.  We had to ask for pickles and coleslaw - don't t those automatically come with a burger? Ketchup bottle was empty.  Don't get me started on staff. They were unprofessional and unkempt.  They could care less that we left our food untouched after the first bite.  I wonder how they got that big "A" posted on the register.  Frankly if the health department came today I think they would close this place down. The cook had gloves on that he used to both count tips and cook. The apron he had on was full of bloody stains - probably from raw meat! Why is he counting money and handling food???  I think I am going to call Management on Monday because I was shocked at the comportment of the staff - even for a diner. Never again!

We come here for thought groupon deal they accept. We try the octopus salad . It was not like normal octopus that hard. It's juicy and soft. And the other two different dishes of fish. It was really good tasting and fresh . Especially the special app from boss. The mussel was with the steamed rice. That's what I had best ever meal . Anyway. I had good time with blacksea fish&grill . .
I loved the antibiotic- and hormone-free chicken breast with creamy guacamole and locally-sourced bread. Nice beer and cider selection on tap. Great spot overall.

Very good place! The atmosphere is classy and the food amazing! The vegetarian options are creative and delicious. I also loved how they gave you a muffin for your breakfast the next day. To top it off the cocktails are very tasty.
Very friendly and efficient service. Not my favorite Vietnamese restaurant but I would return if I was in Philadelphia as the food was pretty good!

WORST RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE I've ever had. Please don't ever bring someone you care about here. For your benefit don't bring someone you hate here either, you'll be stuck waiting through the slowest service on earth. When you ask to speak to a manager, they will be busy in the back. I can't believe I spent a dollar here. This place should be closed. It only exist to rob the patrons of the NJPAC. Major Baraka this is bad for your city.

Awesome! I'm a fan. Decided to try Tria out after passing by many times. It is a very well designed space and has a really nice curb appeal. My only reluctance to come to this place. was a man who sits on his stoop drinking coffee and smoking cigarettes. We decided to avoid him and come down 12th instead of spruce. He REALLY gave me the creeps. Anyway, back to my Tria experience: the wine selection was absolutely wonderful and the beer selection as well. They even had my favorite sour by the bottle I was uber excited. There was a young gentlemen tending the bar when we arrived ordered some draft beers from him but he seemed very unhappy at his job so we decided to sit at a table in their outdoor section. GREAT decision our server's name was becky I believe and she made us feel so special we didn't want to leave. The service was incredible and the goat cheese outstanding. The only complains I have are the management they don't seem to treat their employees with the respect the should. I would definitely come back to tria for a late night drink or even after leaving the office. You should too.
We went to the tavern for the first time and what a great energetic place it is. The service was impeccable, the food great and the place exudes fun. Not to miss.

Food was warm the booths were extremely small and close together. The food was overpriced and the eggs were burnt. I will DEFINITELY not go back the hype about gluten free and organic breakfast is not worth the price tag or atmosphere.
Super tasty Vietnamese food. We had the pork with rice and a tasty fresh sauce with a bunch of vegetables. Good portions, good value for money!

I went there on a Friday night for drinks and stayed for dinner afterwards as we got hungry and didn't want to be roaming in the City without reservation on a Friday night. It was a waste of a Friday night with seriously bad food although I was very hungry after sitting at the bar and talking a bit too long with my quite dashing and engaging date. I think I never had such bad crab cakes in my life with salad that I can only say was bland at best. They kind of redeemed themselves with the chocolate cake we had to share which was not great but good. Overall, somebody has to put a gun in my head for me to go there again other than meeting and having a quick drink. Two stars are only for the bar and OK desert.

Bogota is great! Had an awesome afternoon pitstop while walking through the slope. The Domino empanada is outstanding! The michelada came highly recommended from the bartender Erin, and did not disappoint! Excellent service from the bar for drinks and food. Can't wait to go back.
haven't had their food, but lithuanian coffee cake is amazing!!

This place is amazing for foodies.  There are types of foods for every palate during every time of day.  I have taken family members every time they have come to visit to experience what is Reading Terminal Market.  Some times there are long lines but usually well worth it.  My wife loves the pickles and honey that we pick up while at the market to take home.

I work nearby, so I'm glad I finally visited. The ambiance is what you'd expect--lots of old wood, historic fixtures, maps and paintings on the walls. It's a nice change from the rustic-modern look that you find everywhere. I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food. The slow-roasted pork sandwich is deliciously messy, with tender meat topped with a red cabbage and apple slaw. Service is friendly and prices are quite reasonable. I plan to return and check out the museum!

Well gee whiz you already knew I was gonna hit up Cici for a fat slice. Was babysitting the boys and their 13 friends.  We hopped in the '97 Dodge Caravan and gunned it to the closest Cicis! Stopped at the bank and took out a ton of money to pay for all these chipdren. Pulled into the parking lot which was just outstanding! Open spots everywhere! Turned into the closest spot and cut it too short blowing one tire and denting the other rim.  Didn't mind though.  Was time to eat some Buffett pizza. Walked in and paid for the food up front.  Gave the cash man a huge wad of bills in a zip lock and walked away.  Such friendly employee.  Will write a personal good review on Stan to corporape. So here I was. Standing in the middle of Cicis crying so hard at how amazing this place was.  A lot of people were looking at me and just turned and winked about 3 times with tears all over my red cheeks. Turned around and grabbed a plate flipped it in the air spun around and caught it. Everyone stood up and cheered and clapped. They turned on some Rich Ross and I started to pop and lock it while flippin Mac n cheese slices onto my plate. Out of nowhere my phatfarm sneaks slipped on a noodle and I clocked my chin on the counter.  My pizza flew up in the air and caught the ceiling fan sending sauce and cheese everywhere.  The incredible staff helped me up and walked me to a big booth for me and boys.  Had literally about 46 slices of pizza and cheese brad combined. Told the boys to go play air hockey while I take a quick snooze.  The manager came over and we talked for a good 12 mins about Slipknot cause he saw the people=sh*t jersey I was rockin.  All of a sudden I woke up and not only was I not in Cicis anymore but I was def in the back of an ambulance with all my boys and their friends being rushed to the ER because I actually knocked out most of my teeth and busted my chin open.  Regardless of this lethal accident...Cicis is literally life changing and don't be suprised if you don't start crying the minute you walk in.

Came here for the soft opening tonight and fully enjoyed myself. I'm quite excited to have this new joint in the neighborhood based on the food and lovely atmosphere. The almond crusted tilapia was my favorite dish served, along with the ratatouille. Dessert is a MUST.
Their attention to detail and freshness I am so impressed with! So delicious and worth a visit!

Excellent bar. Decor, service, energy and locally sourced items were all wonderful. Mike the bartender's excellent service made us come back each night we were in Vermont. The staff take their craft seriously and continually recommended winners. We took Mike's recommendation on dinner each night and weren't disappointed once. We will absolutely be back to Hotel Vermont and absolutely make many appearances at Juniper.

We just stopped at the Milford, CT rest stop thinking that subway was the only option for something "healthy". We were pleasantly surprised to find this little gem of a restaurant that offers organic, healthy meal options of veggies, uncured meats, feta-goat and other cheese options as well as gluten free choices including delicious wraps, rolls and hot dog buns!  The gentleman behind the counter was hand selected for this job as he knew what I was looking for and offered great options.  We loved our sandwiches and will tell many friends to stop there if hungry!  Way to go Mr. McDonnell. You've got the right idea and I hope to see you in airports too!
amazing!! their soup dumplings are amazing. we came here for brunch and absolutely loved it.

First, let me say the food was good.  We've had better in Plano, TX at the Bavarian Grill, but this was the best German food we've had in Philly.  My husband and I shared the Wurst Brett, where we got 6 sausages and our choice of 2 large sides.  We opted for the sauerkraut and the asparagus.  Both sides were excellent choices.  Neither of us liked the weisswurst (the only white sausage on the board and the only one that was not made in-house), but we enjoyed the other sausages. Six sausages are a lot for 2 people, and we could not finish; we also left some sauerkraut on the board, so we asked for a to-go box.  We waited about 10 minutes for the box, then we asked another waiter to get us the box.  A few minutes later our waiter came back with our box and said, "I don't know if you saw me drop your food.  I brought you new sausages." In fact he brought our food (we knew because of how they were cut).  He had tossed the sauerkraut.  A waitress came by, and we asked for the check and inquired about the sauerkraut.  She said she would ask the kitchen about the kraut.  A few minutes later our waiter came back with the check and a carton of kraut.   We shared the cheese plate as an appetizer.  OMG.  It was awesome!  You get 4 cheeses (small pieces) plus 3 spreads, a pile of cornishon pickles, and some pickled white radishes.  There are 2 kinds of bread that accompany the plate.  We highly recommend this appetizer. We also had an issue with the beer.  The waiter asked what kind we liked.  I said a porter, and he recommended a nice dark beer.  My husband asked about wheat beer.  The waiter said they had Paulaner, and my husband said he knew that beer and was trying to branch out.  He asked about a wheat beer in the featured beer section, and the waiter's reply was, "A lot of people drink it."  Come on.  For a beer and brat place all of the waiters need to know a lot about the beers on tap.  He knew next to nothing. If he could not answer our questions he should have asked the bartender for help. Our overall rating: food is good, service is poor.

Nice ambience and locale. Reservations needed. Food was above average, quick service. Sometimes way too quick, the waitress hardly gave us time to dig in to our dishes and she was already asking us how it was! Starters of meatball and fried cauliflower were great. Seconds pasta with jalapeño and almond pesto had an awesome al dente texture but the sauce was a little meh (couldn't tell what the flavor was). Scallops were good and the chocolate dessert was delicious. I would repeat!

The rumor is that the back kitchen is fabulous but the customer service is the worst I've ever seen.  After waiting months for a reservation, and arriving 10 min early, was left outside to wait for 45 mins while 3 other parties were seated. Finally we requested our wine be returned and ate 2 doors away and had a great experience. Major disappointment!!!!

Amazing thai cuisine!! Great sevice and great food!! They have really reasonable prices and have unbelievable thai food!! I have been to over 20 thai  restaurants and this is by far on my top 3!!! I would recommend the pad thai, drunken noodles, peanut curry, and mostly gang panang!! :) I really love this thai place

Long Wait and No Reservations so make sure you're there by 5:45-6pm as they are only open 6-11p and closed on Tuesdays. Love the pizzas but the calzone is my favorite! Get the large calzone if you are more than two...also, BYOB or BYOW. Enjoy!

Gaslight is Fantastic and Delicious!! I've lived in old city for the past 8 years, the brunch and food at Gaslight is the best around. The chef is one of the best in Philly. Highly recommend dining at The Gaslight. I got the crab Benedict  and the pancakes. Ridiculously good! Bloody Mary's are also awesome. Price is reasonable for the quality of the food.
Great pizza but not worth the price they charge you for. The owner is always trying to sell me stuff.
Amazing, every time. Great service, excellent beer selection and the burgers and unique and savory. 10/10.
Oysters were great, I think we had 5 different types of oysters. The scallop special was very salty, crab cakes were pretty fishy.

Comfort food at a counter only place hole in the wall that is constantly busy with the locals. Friendly down to earth owner checking on us. I think it is a son and father run business that is not fancy or special in any way other than it serves fast, good, home style food.

Perfection, as long as you go early.  My friends and I try to have lunch as soon as they open, because this place is so good it is almost always crowded after that!  This place made me truly appreciate bean curd, which is wonderful in their bibimbap.  Most of the staff is great, especially the older lady we had most recently who was more of a mom than a waitress.
