Also, there wasn't a happy hour going on either. FOOD: I got a fish taco and steak quesadilla. The taco was AWESOME, and SMALL but definitely not worth waiting 45 minutes if you're there on a weekend.  The quesadilla was really good too but I could've made the same thing at home and microwaved it. OVERALL: I'm not anxious to go back, although if you need to save a few bucks during the week, this place is one of your better bets. But in my opinion, you can get big awesome sandwiches from Mamoun's down the street for the same price as one of Taqueria's wimpy little tacos.

My favorite Mexican place in LES area. Their guac and tacos are generally good - though I found the cactus and fish the best. Also their soup is really good, it's super creamy and flavorful. The crunchy tortilla strips and buttery avocado slices in the soup add mixed textures to the soup, which I enjoyed a lot. Food is served fast and service is ok, but the place's a little too loud and cramped.
A nice little restaurant! Great food! Really enjoyed my dinner here!
Food was amazing! The fact that it is BYOB is great as well. Only down fall was the noise.

These guys are incredible. I've had over a dozen different sandwiches in the last couple years and every one is solid. If I have one complaint about this place, it's that they put some tissue paper on the sandwiches that gets stuck to the cheese on some sandwiches (meatball, eggplant, chicken parms.) I have to gnaw it off the paper like a squirrel. Do yourself a favor and pay the extra money for a seeded roll. Most times one half is good enough for a meal. Save the rest for later. In addition to sandwiches, they have everything you'd expect from a corner deli. Chips, candy, ice cream, soft pretzels, tons of drinks/sodas. Cigarettes. Milk. Everything. And they deliver! Skip Pats and Genos and get a real steak at Cosmis.

Stopped in on a Saturday for lunch.  Sat at the bar got the special, Suckling pig roasted in a wood burning oven.  the meat was tender and the skin perfectly crispy.  It came with a sauce on the side and fresh cut french fries.
Delicious.  Highly recommended

LIVE UNI!!! They have delicious and fabulous live uni from California. Just look at the pic! What an awesome find. Can't wait to go back. Also, Zest has an AMAZING HAPPY HOUR deal! Defin check it out.

I am giving this one star to offset all the highly-starred reviews. Yes, the place is nice-looking. And my server was nice. Plus, I'll give it to them for their bread and the house-brand ale that my dining companion seemed to like. (He's a discerning fellow in that regard.) But my burger was terrible, certainly the worst I've eaten and probably the worst in Creation. (And, as we all know, burger-quality is the beginning if not the end of how to judge the grub at a particular bar.) To be specific: not only was it dry, it was strangely seasoned, making that so-called burger something closer to meatloaf in its texture and taste. And not good meatloaf either. My suspicion: the meat was "high," as they used to say, and in time-honored fashion, the seasoning was there to mask that slight putrefaction. I detected clues indicating that many of the reviewers who liked the food at this bar were from out of town. To those folks, l say: 1. Thank you for visiting New York. 2. When it comes to food, New York can do so much better. 3. The fact that you liked the food at the Landmark leads me to think the U.S. overall maintains very low standards for its cuisine. Positive mention was made in some reviews of the bar's supposedly cool vibe, so let me add: the music stunk. And it was loud. They did post notice, though, that, at some point, live Irish music would be performed. That might bring me back - for a drink and a drink only.

This was a great dinner.  I am not from around here, but Scott was my server and he had great beer recommendations and knew the entire menu for great suggestions.  I highly recommend anyone check it out as I had an amazing swordfish dinner over mashed potatoes and a great crafted specialty draft beer:)
Awesome!!!

This place was AWESOME. Everyone is so friendly, the food is delicious, and the atmosphere is fun. They even gave us complimentary sake shots- enough said. It was my boyfriend's birthday and they sang to him, complete with drums and cymbals! And a complimentary slice of cake and fancy chop sticks to take home to top it all off. I highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great night out!
I dint eat lobster outside of the coast of Maine and here. No where else is it as consistently fresh, never farm raised and delicious. Whole lobster or lobster roll this place is the best.

Having tried the truffle burger, Umami Burger delivers on its umami promise.  The burger is assembled to perfection in the best possible ratio of ingredients.  The caramelized patties, the use on truffle oil, and the addition of aged cheese served on lightly toasted Portuguese buns lend well to its flavor.  The fries and the additional sauces served with it were also pretty good.

Their service sucks. The food is okay. For some reason I continued to back there because I'm a gluten for punishment. But no more. I called them to place a simple order for pick up. They put me on hold for about 5 minutes (that's an eternity on hold). Then when she got back on the phone her first words were (WHAT DO YOU WANT)  are you kidding me????. That's how you ask a potential customer to spend money with you. I told she was rude and I didn't want to order anymore. P.S. CALLED state grille down the street from them.  Their service was quick and friendly and food was excellent. Nevada diner lost another customer. Learn how to staff you business and train your employees.

Wonderful restaurant. The decor is very inviting, and the staff are warm yet professional. Some of the menu items are a bit off the map, but White Dog Cafe's choices are healthy by origination, and the plating and presenation is very attractive. I had the scrumptious Cajun Crusted Catfish, which is prepared perfectly, and has an incredible spanish chorizo finish. I recommend this restaurant for anyone who enjoys a comfortable fine dining experience.
Sometimes when I'm sad, I think about their banana pancakes to cheer me up. Works every time.

Portions: HUGE Price: Reasonable So I would frequent this place after work in Bloomfield. I strongly recommend getting the Carrot Juice. It blew my mind. Creamy, aromatic, and very good with a nice spicy meal. I've had the oxtail and curry goat, both were exceptional. Compared to other Caribbean/Jamaican restaurants in the area (Montclair, Bloomfield) this is the one I most recommend. The restaurant is clean as well and staff is very friendly.
Amazing experience! Love the place , the service and of course the food! The branzino alla plancia was to die for...
Horrible service!! Waiter never asked us what we wanted to drink and never once came back to check on how we were doing. That get you no tip sir!! Deff won't ever be coming back here

I'm not much of a sandwich guy, because most of the time you end up eating more bread than fillings, but that's certainly not the case at Provence. Their sandwiches are not fast-food or even line-style-made (like Chipotle or Potbelly), and they make sure there's plenty of filling to compensate for the delicious bread. It's midtown, so you're looking at $10/sandwich, which is ok I guess. Will definitely come back.

Wow! All the other positive reviews are exactly right. A group of six of us came here to celebrate after work, and the food was wonderful. The service was gracious and not at all intrusive. They saw we were celebrating and allowed us to sit and chat without pushing us out the door. Highly recommend!

A fanatic of Spanish foods and also a tea connoisseur, Mambo Tea House provided the best of both worlds for me. The interior is beautiful and the statue of Buddha gives a very calming vibe. I tried the plantain chips with the mojo sauce, the Cuban pumpkin soup, and the Cuban expresso tiramisu. Lastly, I tried the Jasmine tea. Everything was phenomenal. The staff was friendly, fast, and very professional. I went on a Saturday and was pleased to not find it uncomfortably packed with people.
So good!! Everything! Fried pineapple was great! They gave me 2 free sodas. Price was fair I will definitely be back!
I was very disappointed in the quality of the food. I ordered crab sticks one night and received dry, overcook, disgusting breading and when I removed the breading the meat inside was horrible.

Had a good time out with friends. The food was good, typically bar fare offerings. We tried the nachos, eggplant sticks, and poutine for apps. Poutine and nachos were really good! Eggplant sticks were avg. For dinner three of us had burgers, one had steak. Everything was great! Burgers come with two patties. Alone complaint is that draft beer could've been a little colder. Tried the Box 63 ale and it was good. What surprised me was someone had ordered a beer at the bar and changed their, so one of the managers walked around looking to see who was due for a drink. Well that person was me and he gave me a free beer. Most places would just pour it down the drain. Def will be going back!

This is by far one of the best Jose Garces resturants. Although I am a little spoiled because my boyfriend works for the company, I have to say that it does not get better than this. This past week my boyfriend and I went back to Tinto for the second time(mostly for the scallops) and had an 8:30 reservation, and we're seated until 9:30pm because the people who we're seating where we were supposed to be we're taking too long. But this was not a problem and we sat at the bar, and we're brought a couple of snacks after multiple apologies. We started with the tuna tartare sandwich as well as the oyster, which were both very tasty with bold and fresh favors. We also munched on the spiced meatballs, which was served in a skillet with sauce and an egg over the top with the perfect amount of spicyness. The lamb brochetta was very playful, cooked perfectly and paired with the sweet but creamy sauce. The duck was also very olayful served with two cherries that gave the perfect amount of sweetness. The main reason we chose to go back to Tinto was the scallops. They are the best food that I have ever eaten. They are cooked perfectly with a nice sear, and have the perfect blend of sweetness with the bed of goods that they lay on. It is so fantastic i could eat it as dessert!! The octopus was also another thing that I have added to my list of reasons to go back. It was seared perfectly so that the outside had a nice chared look and the inside was not too chewy or slimy. They were served with a chili sauce that added a nice spice. For dessert, we ordered the chocolate tart, and was surprised that the the almond cake had been sent our way as well! They were both fabulous and presented beautifully. Not only was the food good,  but the service was truly impeccable. Our server was Dave and he was very knowledgable and energetic, even toward the end of the night. When each dish was brought to the table it was explained throughly. Water and drinks were brought before you even realizes that you needed more. Everyone was nice, had a smile on their face and it was nice to see the guys in the kitchen working. We had a fabulous night and we can't wait to go back!

Love the location and the atmosphere, but both times I've been here the service has been awful. The first time a bartender was rude with me for ordering leaving a $2 tip on a $8 drink. Thinking maybe it was just an off day I came back for dinner and drinks a second time. My waiter was rude, didn't help with any questions, and was at my table a total of 2, maybe 3, times throughout the night (730pm). Will not be coming back here. Cool location but not worth the hype.

This review is not of the food but of the service. Blue Ribbon is supposed to open at 4:30. Normally we don't eat early dinners but we wanted to have a pre-fast dinner for Yom Kippur which started around 6:15pm. We stood outside when their bartender waved to us that we should wait 5 more minutes, at 4:45, he disappeared inside the restaurant. Needless to say, at 4:55 we got annoyed and went elsewhere. I've been coming to this restaurant for years and probably won't be returning because that is not how you treat customers who are waiting outside. If they weren't ready to open, he should of came outside at 4:30 when he saw us waiting and said they were not going to open for a while, we would of gone elsewhere and not waited outside for almost half hour while he stood there and put lemons in their containers. Very unprofessional.

Totally disappointed.  Restaurant wasn't even busy and I found myself waiting 25 minutes for a bowl of chili. People sitting behind us also had the same problem. I ditched after waiting way longer than is acceptable. What a joke. Terrible thing is that I have eaten here before, had a good experience and loved the food. After reading other reviews I see that lengthy waits are commonplace. What a bummer. Anyway, find somewhere else to eat on Church Street. Don't waste your time.

I only give this restaurant a three because just like every other place in NYC, it is always over crowded. Good luck finding a place to sit and drink your coffee. It was also very expensive. Six dollars for a 3 oz cup of coco is too much for even nyc. Now that I know what the deal is with this place, I tend to stick to the smaller coffee shops that give you way more bang for your buck.
Great service and innovative meals.  Fairly small portions and a bit pricey.
Gorgeous! And yummy French Macarons :) I Liove the Vanilla flavor-- wish they open a branch here in San Francisco

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!!!!!!!!!!'!!!!!!!!!!!! My roommate and I will NEVER go to this restaurant again.  Based on the reviews I read, I suggested to my roommate that we should try this place.  She is a vegan and ordered the classic pizza without the cheese.  Based on the menu, it reads that is has "tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil." She also ordered the mixed salad.  We picked up the food and then went home. When she opened the pizza box, she was appalled.  There were only FOUR basil leaves on an 18inch pizza.  The salad was tiny and not worth the amount they charged.  She went back to return the food.  Her experience was something out of Kitchen Nightmares.  She explained she was not satisfied with the quality of the food and wanted her money back.  The staff was extremely rude and REFUSED to refund her money.  They spoke to her disrespectfully and even YELLED at her!!!!!!!!!!  They finally gave her the money back.  I had also ordered the classic pizza and I was not impressed at all.  After hearing her experience, I wish I never made the suggestion.  Customer service is number one in any business and the staff when confronted with an unsatisfied customer responded unprofessionally. If I could give them negative stars, I would.

This place is right around the corner from where I live. I've taken several out of town guest here and they all have loved their experience. Suzy and the rest of the staff make you feel like family when you dine here. The prices are very reasonable and the portion sizes will fill you up. I admit I have not eaten around in Bayonne for breakfast, but this place was very fresh and very good as compared to similar diners in Jersey City. The staff is very friendly and accomodating.

We had heared a lot about Cafe Talya. and we wanted to go there but we were told wrong about adress. The correct address is "Avenida Padre Antonio Jose dos Anjos, 297 - Brooklin - Sao Paulo - RS - Brazil - 04563-000", just two blocks from Avenida Santo Amaro. There used to be a bakery and patisserie on the same address. We went there last 29th of april and it was a monday, so it was very quiet, some 3 tables inside and another outside, just beside us. Price is fair, everything (temakis) I choose were all but tasty and extremely fresh. Like when one goes to a sushi & sashimi restaurant, one can see them preparing / assembling the pieces at the counter. I drank made in Brazil sake, and then a soft drink. Not expensive, there are some 4 or 5 parking positions just in front of the restaurant. Quiet environment, cozy atmosphere. Staff is not wonderful, but proficient and polite. Definitely enjoyed and intend to go there again on my next work / business trip.
Excellent pizza and the ricotta cheesecake was amazing. Soft, romantic setting and friendly servers.

Walked past this places for weeks before venturing in with another couple... Was a little unsure at first because we were the first people for brunch but it soon filled up. the food was so good and was blown away by the vaca frita and the brunch special. Planning my next trip soon...

Avoid if you can (and yes you can, there are other options down the road). I've been to this place twice. Both times it was empty (first sign of a bad restaurant). Both time there was no one in the restaurant either, it took the lady about 3 minutes to come out from the kitchen. Food was disappointing, seems like it was just thrown in a microwave as when I got home some portions were piping hot and other portions of the meat were cold. The second time I went there I went to get a drink. She didn't know the price of the drink and stared at the wall. First it was $2.25 then she just said "Three dollars will do it". I myself have managed businesses and this is concerning. I don't know if the lady is the owner or just an employee, but no care at all. Restaurant itself is lackluster, doesn't give a clean vibe at all. Its not cheap so just AVOID.

After reading some of the bad reviews I was hesitant on dining at this restaurant.  I did,  and I found it to be great!  The service was great, the food wonderful and the portions large.  I would highly recommend this restaurant.  I don't know where all the bad reviews came from.  The pork chop was the best entree, huge, juicy and tasty.  The crab cakes were loaded with crab and hardly any filler.  I will be going back. Everyone seemed to complain about the slow service.  We had no problems.  The staff was very attentive and our food arrived in a timely manner.
Order the polenta pizza. SO GOOD!

The chef stuffs your box like theres no tomorrow that he will rubber band it. Extremely generous with portion and very tasty. Though certainly not the highest quality ingredients you will find, this place is the least expensive and most filling for thousands of miles. Just a lunch box is enough for 2-3 meals. He chops fast and is the only person chopping food so it might be a bit of a wait but definitely worth it. I recommend the BBQ Pork, Chicken Wings, Soy Sauce Chicken and Ginger over the other sauces, though he'll pour those in as well. Go there if you're hungry. It is quite an experience.

I had the most amazing experience here. my best friend took my here for lunch one day and my mouth literally watered from the taste of that salmon, with pistachio scattered on top and spinach on the bottom. Talk about food porn, the kindest service I've ever received with beautiful outdoor seating. Cant wait for the winter, to have dinner by there lovely fireplace :)

i had listened a lot about La Sireneand i wanted to visit it at least one time. I visited this nice quaint restaurant, near the Holland tunnel entrance, it is great to take a date for a nice quiet dinner, perfect for any celebrities that don't want to be bothered by the paparazzo or fans . The Food was absolute amazing. The homemade French Onion soup was so good, I ordered a second bowl. The beet salad was so fresh and crisp. everything was first class. Great Wine Selection, even Wines from Israel were offered. A MUST VISIT one of the best French Restaurants, i have visited. Everything is perfection and home made. The staff was so accommodating and friendly!
Deliciousness, every time. The crowds and wait are worthwhile. This is a terrific restaurant for visiting friends that enjoy good food.

I heard wonderful things about this place but it was only ok to me when I went there... #1 My Cup had black mold on it... I don't think they wash their dishes very well... I tried the 3 dishes and nothing was worth really being amazed about... and the mold... ayia... The service was poor. The Asian? male was only looking at the computer and calling people on the phone. The girl was only on her phone texting. Trying to get her to take my money took forever... I wanted to leave so badly... but she took so long.

I went here not knowing what to expect other than comfort food. Wow, this place was amazing. The portions are generous. The food is delicious! I tried the fried apples, among other things - I'm in love. It's a shame it's only open on the weekends, however, this keeps you wanting more. The wait staff was incredibly friendly and made me feel very welcomed. I absolutely plan on returning - probably more often than I should. Wait time for your food is a little slow, but, everything seemed made to order. It was absolutely worth the wait. Don't go if you're in a rush. Go if you're looking for a fantastic meal.

Four of us were visiting from out of state and this place was near where we were staying. Great find! The service was top notch and the special of fried chicken, baked beans, and fresh corn on the cob was a real treat. Definitely recommend it!
Was there in 2013, probably the best sandwich I ever ate. Going back to NYC this month and will immediately head there for lunch.

I'm being generous and giving 2 stars. My family was excited to try a new pizza place, and this one had great reviews.  We were encouraged when we arrived to a line out the door and a parking lot attendant who told us this pizza was comparable to Frank Pepe's. Considering how full the restaurant was, our party of 5 got a seat within 10 minutes and a server arrived promptly and quickly got us our drinks. We ordered a pizza with peppers and onions, and another with hamburger, pepperoni and bacon. The hot bite-sized dinner rolls that were brought to the table after we ordered were good. The wait for the pizza wasn't very long, and when it came, steaming hot and gooey looking, we were excited to dig in! Unfortunately,  the veggie pizza was incredibly bland. I wanted it to be good, I tried convincing myself that it was good, but it just wasn't. The meat pizza was more flavorful,  probably due to the exorbitant amount of grease soaking it. The kids were enjoying it enough, and we had eaten about half, until my daughter almost took a bite out of a slice with what looked like a mosquito cooked onto it.  We all stopped eating. When the server finally came over, and I pointed it out (the insect was obviously dead and legs cooked into the cheese), he asked if it had flown down and landed on it. I showed him how that couldn't be quite possible. He asked if we wanted a new pizza which, at that point we didn't.  We asked for the check. He quickly brought the check over, and I was surprised that not a thing had been done to make up for the fact that we had had a bug cooked onto our meal. I didn't expect to have the meal comped, but, I was surprised that there had not been any type of discount, or perhaps the kids sodas taken off the check. As a former server, I would have made some sort of adjustment. It was disappointing that the service wasn't better at what was obviously a very popular family restaurant.
Love a great cocktail, ambiance and curated library!
Quite simply the best pizza I've ever had. Great atmosphere, great food, and though you'll have to wait for a long time, there are plenty of fun bars around, and the wait is well worth it.

Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable. Menu is always changing with the seasons & beer selection is always great! Plenty of seating & the mood/ambiance is great! Close to the waterfront = plenty of parking! One of my favorite bars in old city!
Quite possibly the best Happy Hour special in downtown New Haven. Their burgers are always spot on and it doesn't hurt that they have a great beer selection. Will be back whenever I'm in the area.

We tried the fixed menu for dinner and LOVED it.  This is an expensive restaurant, but the food and drink specials were great!  I think it came with 5 courses?  It was a lot of strong drinks that night.  But everything was delicious.  At first, we thought the portions were on the small side, but at the end of dinner we left very full.  This is definitely a place to try or visit again.
This place is so good we drive 50 minutes from NJ about 4 times a year just to eat here. Everything is fantastic.

I am a big fan of gyros! I tried once when I went for vacation in Greece and I love that taste. I expected to get the same taste at Cavos but my expectations were not reached; the meat was not cooked well and the tzatziki had a weird taste. Even though it seemed not to be too busy, the food took a long time to get ready and the service was a little bit slow. However, I ll try it one more time because I ve heard good things about the chicken avgolemono.

Very good place to hangout, they play nice music too. However,  when I got there with my gf, I had to wait 19 minutes  approximately for the bartender to come ask us what we need, but she would ask other people she knew, hug them, a customer waiting is more important than all those things, we almost left, but we really liked the place. She would not smile,  not friendly at all, very rude. But the vibe is excellent there. Sorry 3 stars only for the poor service.

Yum! Yum! Yum! I had never explored the world of kati rolls until my boyfriend took me here to try an "Indian burrito." I love the achari paneer roll, it's my favorite. It has this amazing spicy tang and is a must try! Spice end is a great option for something quick and delicious or/take-out. Oh and definitely try Limca, it's a  citrus Indian soft drink. I'm not much of a soda drinker but it's definitely a nice refreshing treat.
Been here couple times and wasn't all that impressed and not to mention the PLACE HAS B for rating. Overpriced for the quality of the food and it takes a lifetime for the food to come.....

We went on a busy Saturday night and got seated in 5 minutes as the hostess took our order while we waited. We sat at the bar and received our summer rolls in 2 min and our Pho w/ Lemongrass Chicken and Lemongrass Banh Mi sandwich right after. Food was amazing and prices are great. This is not the type of place to have a leisurely dining experience but if you want fast awesome food then go here.

Spectacular atmosphere- cozy, ambient, and playful. Besides the look of the interior, the food is quite unbelievable. I had the seasonal doughnut burger and fell in love with it immediately. The salty:sweet ratio was on point and I highly recommend the Doughnut Sammy- fried chicken, bacon, chipotle mayo, between a warm glazed doighnut. I hope the doughnut becomes a main stay on the menu!

Great neighborhood spot. Grab a seat at the bar if you can, the bartender Chris is great, attentive, personable, and makes a great drink. The food isn't over thought but well done standards and great comfort food.  They have a decent wine list, good whiskey selection, and fun cocktails. I love the lack or pretension, Walter's is what it is, and excels at being, a go-to neighborhood spot.

Been there twice, and love it. AMAZING beer selection, and the burgers and fries are fantastic. The sauce that comes with the fries is awesome as well. Great place to spend an evening with a couple friends.

I would definitely add this restaurant to my list of "must return"!!  Everything from the food to the drinks was excellent.  There was a lot of personal attention and the restaurant was filled to a comfortable capacity proving that even though this place is new, there is definitely quality in every aspect of it.  I was meeting family members after a long time and we spent a delightful autumn evening in a pleasantly cheerful ambiance.  As the name states, this will be a place of "union" with my family and friends the next time I return to Manhattan.

L'Artusi is a nice place and they have pretty decent food. I usually like Italian food, so I figured that this would be a place that I should try. My friends and I had a little difficulty in finding the location, but when we did it was worth it. The service was pretty good, the restaurant was crowded when we came; which is understandable since the food is so great. I would probably come here again, the prices aren't too bad and the food is pretty good.

An okay neighborhood restaurant. I went a couple times, and I'm less and less of a fan. Okay service, okay food, but the pork was way too fatty (some fat would retain flavor, but too much fat is just a sign of poor quality control on their ingredient). I would rather go do Ippudo or other Ramen shops. And honestly, quality/price ratio is slightly lower than average.

Just ordered the green mango and catfish salad it was great The sauce they use is so good I could put it on anything. They only thing is I expected actual pieces of catfish there was none despite this I am still happy!

I was there for a party on the third floor and for some reason my table was served the slowest. 4 out of 5 tables got their food right away and my table took the longest, and I have no idea why there was such a delay for one table. I normally don't write terrible reviews, but, when I'm sitting there still waiting for my course and the other 4 tables are finished that particular course, there's obviously something wrong. to top it all off, at the end, they gave every single person a dessert except for me, and I was sitting right there waiting for it so they basically forgot. I was even super nice when dealing with the waitresses so I have no clue what I could have done to deserve this kind of service. in summary: food ok; service terrible. never ever coming back here again.
best!

This place is excellent for the price,  and the buffet style lunch is pretty awesome.  Food was great,  price was great (though they changed it to 6.95 a pound), would definitely come again (and again...).

My husband and I went here on a Friday night and were able to get a table very quickly since we were only a party of two, but it seemed like some larger groups were waiting longer. To start we had coconut shrimp, which was awesome, tasted fresh and was not greasy or oily. I had the chicken massaman, my favorite. My husband got the fried rice with pineapple chicken. We both got medium spicy, but mine wasn't too hot, which was good for me. His was definitely hotter, but still delicious. I would go back to try some of the other things as other people's plates looked very good as well.

The perfect definition of "hole in the wall". Cant beat freshness or prices. Dont expect a receipt and pay in cash. There isnt a lot of space to eat there (6 stools...3 inside, 3 outside...weather permitting). Most people come by for take out. I prefer the fresh dumplings over the frozen ones....but that is up to you. When possible...I head... I've had a lot of dumplings from a number of dumpling shops throughout NYC and other areas Prosperity Dumplings gives you a lot of food for your buck. I bought a bunch of dumplings cooked in a variety of ways, plus two large soups for just over $10.00. It is your normal Chinatown take out shop.What this shop lacks in. OVER ALL IT WAS GOOD EXPERIMENT.
dumplings are on point, had better but still prices are reasonable and love everything on the men would suggest any one to give a shot

Grandma Feldman's Chicken Soup is a miracle!  None of the pharmaceuticals have worked to beat back this cold like Lorraine's blessed broth. Thanks Feldman's for sharing this wonder and making sure we all have access to what makes us well and happy.
Seriously love the food and the brunch! Service is great most of the time. Only "bad" parts is that its always crowded and so loud that we can barely hear each other talk!
In the former 'Ino spot. A great addition to the neighborhood. Fantastic cocktails, great wine and DELISH Italian food. Love love love it!

It was a nice view, but that was it.  You will have a partially obstructed (by buildings) view of the water.   The food was sub-par yet expensive and nothing special.  I had the pleasure of dining at Farmhouse Tap and Grill the night before and was looking forward to another wonderful dining experience.  Our waiter was less than professional and when we took some time to figure out why we wanted to order, it seemed to irritate him.  I asked about locally sourced specialties but was pretty much laughed at and told that Ice House doesn't do that because the growing season in VT is so short.  It seems like other local establishments are doing it though.   We ordered the tomato and mozzarella salad and a bowl of New England clam chowder to start.  The mozzarella and balsamic was good, but the tomatoes were pale.  The chowder was very milky (runny) and not especially flavorful.   For dinner we had the eggplant dish and a the Asian grilled chicken sandwich with cilantro and mint.  The eggplant was fried and bland.  The chicken sandwich came with previously frozen French fries.  I has been spoiled by the fries the night before.  The sandwich was pretty good, but after taking half home and letting it sit overnight in my fridge, the flavors marinated and it was even better.   I would not have been so sour with my review if the food and service had impressed me.  For a bill almost $70 before tip for a party of two with no alcohol, I expected great food.
Eat here often. Excellent everything! Highly recommend.

The original Cheew Juw style restaurant (specific region of Canton). Like any other Bo Ky, I go for the   Seasoned Pork Hand Pork Chop Rice Beef Tripes Half Duck Fried Spring Rolls Choy Sum   Seating in this place is slightly better than most crammed places though it appears their tables are too big. It can get fairly busy at night time. If you want to enjoy the same food but sit comfortably, I would recommend going to the Bo Ky at 216 Grand St. though different management but same family taste.
Very Nice place!!!
Absolutely love it here, and it is our only pizzeria place !!  Love the food, atmosphere and service!

EXCELLENT FOOD, GREAT SERVICE, BEAUTIFUL ATMOSPHERE! If you've ready any of my other reviews then you know I am an Indian food junkie. I love it and can't get enough of it. Well, this place has become my favorite of all other restaurants.

Amazing food, can't say enough about it! Very  attentive wait staff and the chef came out to ask about my boyfriends duck since he said he didn't like mushrooms. The chef offered the sweet potato hash! LOVED it! The figs were phenomenal, the scallops with the raspberry balsamic reduction was cooked perfectly! My love for byos in the area are growing! Will be returning as soon as possible!
Great ambiance, really good food, and a good drink list. Plus it's right next door to the Bowery Ballroom. Get the Mommie Dearest.
This is simply the best. If you don't like it, disrespect yourself.

Pat's is a fixture in Philly and their sandwich is always good... Is it one of the premier cheesesteaks in Philly? Not by a longshot in my eyes but nevertheless its a fun piece of nostalgia to go there and have one..
Great
only got take, so limited on experience but the food here is on point, you can tell fresh quality food by that first bite, hands down can't wait to dine here

The food from here is delicious! I would order from this restaurant very often since i worked near by. My only complaint would be their prices, they are slightly higher than other locations, which made me cut down from ordering there.

Angry coffee bean is one of my  favorite COFFEE places in the world the owner is so nice and really generous the staff is so nice !! the Nutella Hot Choclate is the best and the French Fries are spicy and delicious and the chicken fingers are to die for !! the red velvet cupcake is appetizing!!!! I would recommend the  chicken soup its amazing!!! And you will spend a good time with your family OF COURSE 5 STARS!!!
Mr .Shu is one of my favorite places to eat Chinese food  it has delicious chicken and broccoli very good chicken lo mein and awesome wonton soup!!!!! Five star its really good the staff is nice !!!!

This place was awesome!  Great beer selection, great service and I enjoyed the best burger I've ever eaten!   I don't typically spend $18.95 on a cheeseburger, but I will gladly do it again.   The house special burger and hand cut fries were decadent.
Overpriced beer, lazy incompetent rude service, whole place smells like rotten egg salad.
Worst place ever!! Wow.... Food was terrible, service even worst. Please think twice before spending your money in this place. I had to sign for yelp just for this, ahhhhh !!

After having tried many espressos in Midtown, Jolly Goat is hands down the best     Even bought a pound of their French roast to take home. Service is friendly and professional. Truly a great neighborhood spot.

Sorry to say we never got to taste the food. We were treated so poorly by the maitre'd we didn't stay. Very disappointed as we were looking forward to it.  However, with all the wonderful restaurants within blocks...why would you give your time and money to someone who did not make us feel welcome....so we didn't

So far best Thai place in NYC! Located right by all the Broadway plays...their food is so delicious! I got the pad see eww which is the the wide noodles with a sweet sauce! Then I also got the coconut calamari tempura which is to die for!!! Then we tried some drinks! I got the mango mojito and the "do not disturb" both sweeter drinks but delicious! The prices are super reasonable! For the entree it was around 10 dollars and drinks were bout 9.00 each but they were good sized drinks! Definitely a place you should check out!!! Not to mention the atmosphere and vibe is totally amaze! Chandeliers, low lighting, young crowd and just overall a super chill place. The staff is super nice and friendly!!! Everyone go check it out!
First time in this place and the food was amazing. The special they had was so fresh and good. I tried the carapulcra and my friend had chaufinita which was really good. The drive was worth it.
Parma pizza is delicious! Fennel and sausage pappardelle amazing! Salmon perfectly cooked! Overall experience was great, fast friendly service!
This place - food wise - is extremely mediocre. It's not worth the money they charge.

I ordered the cheese steak with cheez whiz. The sandwich was ok. I was kind of let down, guess I expected it to be more of what good reviews left. My food was cold. Asked the gentleman if he could warm it up for me, and just wrapped it up. Wishing I would have hit a food truck instead.

Fresh sushi that was made to order. The sashimi came in generous slices. The bento box was really filling and was definitely worth $20! The service was somewhat slow but I really can't complain because they were busy and everything was being prepared fresh. Worth the wait!
Fantastic place. The taste is great and price is very reasonable. It's definitely one of the best Korean restaurants in town.

The ambiance of this restaurant is modern and chic which was fun. It is a dim and relatively small restaurant however. I've dined here a few times and absolutely loved it. The service was great and the food is authentic. I love their chicken skewers and pineapple fried rice! My friends and I always have a good time here. I took off two stars because I ordered a take out once and they gave me the wrong order. When I called in to inform them of the mistake, they insisted I take the food back to them to exchange for my order even though I've already opened the dish of the wrong order. I felt that if they were to make a mistake and then made me walk back to the restaurant, they should've at least let me keep the order/ given me a discount or offered me something as an apology. It was just too much work and frustration at 9:30PM.
The dim sum here is right up there with NYC Chinatown.

This is a real family operated restaurant. The two owners are local guys who grew up in Verona and have quite a bit of experience in the restaurant industry. The food here is varied and excellent. The wait staff is so friendly and accommodating. Whether you go for lunch, dinner, have an affair here, or have an affair catered off premises, you will not be disappointed......and, the prices are very, very reasonable! Go, you will be back again and again!

I absolutely adore this cafe. I called on a Friday to find out more info about brunch the next day. The young man who answered was extremely helpful letting me know (after speaking with the owner) that they could accommodate a group of 6 for brunch if we called ahead that day. He also confirmed that the cafe would permit us to bring some champagne and Bloody Mary mix :D when we arrived they greeted us and guided us to our table near the window beautifully set. You order at the front of the cafe and they bring everything to you. It was a lovely display of fresh breads, cheeses, cold meats, and delicious sausage. It was delectable. Our group dined, chatted and then dined some more. The staff was absolutely lovely; giving tips on how to pair the meats and cheeses, and kept our table tidy. It was a wonderful dining experience. I can't wait to make this a weekend regular. Thank you!
Food was horrible when I went. The pancakes weren't even good.
The AYCE is wonderful.  Fish is fresh and appetizers freshly made.  The ambiance is wonderful compared to all the other AYCE sushi places I have been too.  We will definitely be back!
This is a great family pizzeria!  The menu is outstanding - the atmosphere is fun and upbeat - the bar is something you would find in NYC.
Worst Brazilian place in Queens. Don't waste your time coming here. Horrible service, arrogant servers.

Great old-time place passed down through generations. Real genuine family feel in that the owner, grandson of the original owner, came out to each customer and asked about their satisfaction. We were the only non-locals and everyone got a "Hi Norm" type greeting, incl. questions about how their families were doing. We were treated equally as well giving us the desire to be one of the locals! Food was great too. Comfort style with a slight twist and truly cooked the way you ask. Can't say enough about what a wonderful feel this place has. Fun U-shaped counter where the owners circulate and check on everyone
Pretty much bland stuff, nothing to say more. Ordered food last night n most of the items didn't have a sense of complimenting each other even after we asked the receptionist.

Our server was very pleasant, Marc was there and was kind enough to pose in a photo with us.  Nice selection of appetizers, the chili lobster was top notch as was the foie gras, I highly recommend both.    I have to ding Marc on two things.    One, the drink menu is very limited, I believe there were only 5 or 6 mixed drinks listed and they were all very uninspired.   Two, there were only seven entrees (aside from the chicken-under-a-brick for two) and out of the seven FOUR were whole fish.    I'm sure they are wonderful, we didn't order any of them, but no veal?  No shrimp?  No chicken for one?    Only one steak and one pork dish...... This area of the menu needs some expansion.    Pricing was fair for this caliber of restaurant, much more reasonable than Bouley which is two blocks away.
We just had take out pizza but it was absolutely delish! I would most definitely go back!

This place is so cool. They have different food stations ranging from cheese stations to pizza an d pasta restaurants. You can literally spend all day in here. I ate at the pasta place and had the tagliatelle al ragu de manzo. HOLY PASTA it was AMAZING!!!! That is by far one of the best dishes I had in New York. The pasta was fresh and the meat was perfectly cooked and flovored. I then wanted to try some pizza so I ordered the Napoletana. it was really good as well but after a slice the anchovies were a bit too salty for my taste but my bf loved it. But I would definitely recommend this place because there is something for everyone at Eataly. It's fun to just walk around as well :) Good luck and good eats!! Yum yum

Me and my husband just went to this diner for dinner I ordered the chicken and he ordered the shrimp scampi. Our meals came with salad and the lettuce was brown the croutons were hard as hell and they served the lettuce core as well. When our meal came out he noticed that there was a DEAD ROACH soaking in the scampi sauce!!! Absolutely disgusting. STAY AWAY!!!!!! this place is a nightmare.! When we told the manager he didn't even seem surprised. Beware! If you eat here you might be the next one eating a roach.

Wow, This Place Is Hopping! What a great place; fantastic food, great atmosphere and décor, full of energy, and amazing drinks. Knowing that they just opened, I expected some rough spots, but found none. I had the buttermilk fried chicken sandwich and it was out of this world. Flavors were spot on and the roll was the best I have ever had. The fried artichokes were ridiculous, and I could have eaten 3 plates of the bacon wrapped jalapenos. Saw the two reviews below and couldn't have been more surprised because that is not the experience I had at all. Everyone in my party loved their food and had a great time. Seemed like everyone else in the place was as well; line out the door and the bar area packed!

The Blue Cat is consistently good. The steak is the best in Burlington and the wine is moderately priced. The atmosphere is very quaint, great for a romantic night out or a nice family dinner (not with young kids). I would highly recommend.

I've been meaning to write this review for awhile. Love the food here. I'm a regular. Come here at least once a week. Akeema always greets me by name and knows my order. Smart girl always sharp and on point. Anything with fish, pork or beef you can't go wrong.

We have been there for breakfast on saturday morning, had 3 eggs omlette which was very delicious. Poached egg with spinach was not satisfiyng well. Closed with crep, fantasting. Service was very friendly and quick.
Never disappointed at Noodle Pudding. The food is fantastic!

I had very high expectations for this place as I'm Cuban and was looking to host my wedding reception here. Unfortunately, the drinks and food were unpleasant: the mojitos were mostly lime juice, the croquettes tasted exactly like the frozen Goya ones, the Yucca was undercooked, and the paella was watery and had a funny smell. We had enough with the paella and refused to pay for it, we won't be going back!

In my favorite part of town to eat and drink I have always wondered why there was no where to have an ice cold beer, order simple kick-ass food and enjoy a good meal with my friends....10 Devoe's owners must have wondered the same thing.  Beautiful specials, salumi to snack on over a drink while you peruse the menu...which I will have to revisit as there is only so much food one man can eat and there were too many things I wanted to try.  Its new, its stunning and I suggest you get in the door before too many people  discover it and you can't get a table!
Best sandwicks ever stop by gals seem very nice

Maybe my expectations are just too high but they have a "lovely young lady" working there with an attitude problem, I have dealt with shitty customer service before but this gem blew all the others out of the water. I truly wish her luck in the future, because she'll need it!

Food was good. Nice presentation and great options and customizable burgers. The only thing I felt lacked was the staff. Smiling makes a big difference even if you hate working a job that involves customer service. Several staff members don't even look like they want to be employed there.
How about those pancakes

This is the best Chinese food I ever had. I love the boneless ribs. They basically sautée them in the oven. Its soooooo good. I also love the shrimp and broccoli and the general tso chicken. All the food is really fresh and really good.

Our vist was good today.  The custom dinner of parpadelle pasta with 3 meat spicy sauce was delicious.  I only ate half so I will have a great lunch tomorrow.   The berry sangria was good.  No buzz after drinking it.  My wife had angel hair and meat sauce.  Dinner was good and portions large.  We only ate half.  The waitress Kelly was attentive and was prompt when she saw we needed something.  Also the limited time only wings were delicious.   Not overly hot but had a good flavor.  Remember,  this Olive Garden and a fine dining establishment in NYC.  Food is goid.  Decor is dated.

EMILY HYLAND, the restaurant OWNER basically asked my family to leave tonight because my one-year old was too loud. We had been there all of 7 minutes. My son screamed ONCE.. she came over to our table and said "please try and keep your children quiet so as not to disturb the adult patrons"....and then went on to say that "they expect children to be seated and quiet when dining at EMILY" Oh OK. I guess she thinks that we're raising wild banshees who purposely disrupt "adult-friendly eating establishments." I should probably sit my 1-year old down (or maybe strap him his highchair so that he REALLY listens) and have a stern talk with him. Thanks, Emily! You've enlightened me. Seriously, what owner speaks to customers this way? I am a life-long resident of Clinton Hill and I've never felt so unwelcome in my own neighborhood. Unfortunately, we didn't get to try the pizza, because naturally after being spoken to that way, we got up to leave. Pretty sure, that's what she wanted. We will never go back. We ended up going to Graziella on Vanderbilt - pizza is great and they are nice, gracious and adult AND family-friendly.

I'll say two things about all the bad reviews... First... my experience was great! See more below. And... Second, maybe all the negativity is what got me a great seat and great service :) Saturday evening 5pm. Sat at the bar overlooking gate 120 and the Tarmac. Prompt service. Power supply to recharge phone and tablet readily available. Edamame was good, beer was cold, sushi was... Average. Generous pieces of fish, but very little rice in the nigiri. Pricey, but what do you expect in the international terminal of the Newark airport?!

The best kebabs I've ever had my friend Kobi brought me here on a cold dark night he was nervous about all the baklava but I told him don't be nervous about all the baklava you don't have to eat any if you don't want but he said but I love baklava. We ended up getting the kebabs they were delicious I would recommend the lamb the fish was good as well. My friend Kobi ultimately ended up getting the baklava. he loves sweets.

I have been a regular of Benjamin's Steakhouse, Sea Fire's sister, since 2009. In July of this year I stopped in with friends for drinks and desserts one night and then for a birthday sinner in September. The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated, classy, quiet but NOT STUFFY. From the front door to your wait staff you are put at ease and made to fell very welcome. I will admit, I am not a seafood person at all. However, Sea Fire has a Rib Eye Steak that was amazing. It came out very hot & very juicy with a little char on it. The Chef was able to and kind enough to make a side of potatoes for me like they have at Benjamin's but not on the menu at Sea Fire. I highly recommend you ask if they would do the same for you as that is a great side for the Rib Eye and they are cooked to perfection. The desserts are all made in house and if you don't get the cheesecake with the graham cracker crust you are missing out for sure. As fantastic as the food is at Sea Fire, the only thing that can top it is their staff. If you look up the word Prenominal you will see words like, remarkable, exceptional, incredible, unbelievable and extraordinary. With that I can safely say their staff is Phenomenal! From the greeting at the front door, to the bussers, it appears that each employee is a part owner. They take great care of each guest. Too often I see at restaurants where staff members will pass your table without even looking at you. I was at another place in NY during the same weekend and my server appeared to have gotten lost or something so I had to ask two other people for refills and each said they would try to find my server to take care of that. At Sea Fire, without being intrusive, it doesn't matter what their position is, they are there to help you. I must single out Besar, the bar back who was very helpful and professional. You can tell, even as a bar back, the management has trained him very well and instilled in him "treat the customer well." The Sea Fire Grill is a MUST while you are in New York and you have a taste for an amazing Rib Eye or Sea Food. To me, their made in house cheesecake is worth the trip alone. Thanks to Victor, Besar, Lena and the entire staff at Sea Fire for a great experience and we will see you again very soon.
Great food and nice staff.  Very attentive.  All fresh ingredients and nice sized portions.  Would definitely go again

There was some pretty extreme hangriness at play when we descended on this slick taco operation. This may or may not have influenced the comment "this is the best taco of my life" from my companion but either way, pretty damn good tacos.

Absolutely the best thai food I have ever had. The Pad Kee Mao is absolutely amazing. My mouth waters whenever I think of it. Also, the tempura vegetable appetizer is very good. They even have a part of the menu with offerings for people who are used to eating traditional thai food you would actually find in thailand. I highly recommend this restaurant to any thai food lover in the BTV area.

This is one of the best places to get authentic vietnamese food - bar none.  I got the grilled chicken banh mi with a fried egg - and trust me, putting the fried egg is the way to go!  Absolutely fantastic!  Some reviewers are commenting on the decor of the cafe and sure, it's not the best but I like the hole-in-the-wall feel of the cafe and the food is  as authentic tasting as you're going to find in the city. Word of caution though - when they say spicy, they mean it.  I got it medium spicy with the Sriracha sauce and jalapeno slices and it was definitely up there in the spice level.  I enjoyed it because I like things spicy but I guess that some people might have to watch for that.
The food was okay but a little too pricey.  The music was good but the drinks were weak.  My first few visits here were good but I think this will be my last visit, no longer impressed.

I have been coming here regularly now for a month and have tried 22 of their 30 burgers.  No doubt best burger place in Princeton. And the staff is super friendly and always ready to make suggestions!
The scallion pancakes were delicious, the crab&pork soup dumplings were okay I wish they were more hot, and the Shanghai noodles was alright. I would come just for the pancakes.

This was my all time favorite place to eat in NYC up until today.  My party of four had to wait an extra long time to get seated.  About 40 minutes in, these two guys walk right in past us and take up a four seat table--the one we were about to get. I said to the guy "we've been waiting for a long time" and he said "oh, sorry about that, you should get this table."  Oh wait...that's not what he said.  What he actually said was "I'm an investor in this restaurant, so I get to cut in line". Ouch, say it's not so Champs!  You are so cool, your food is wonderful...why are you allowing this douche bag to brazenly snub customers because he's got money?  I still love your restaurant, but I ended up waiting another 40 minutes, 80 in total, and this guy was out the door and back on his motorcycle before we even got to order, so I can't help but feel like my favorite place royally snubbed me.

Skvela bezlepkova snídaně! V nabidce je vse take v bezlepkove variantě. O vikendech je pekne plno, takze je mozne, ze si pockate na stul, ale stoji to za to. Obsluha se nas rovnou zeptala jake mame alergie nebo omezeni v jidle.
Love this place great food chips salsa guacamole yes their margaritas are very good cute in the mason jars

The food was average, and the service is awful. Do not come to this place for their "unlimited" brunch drink special. The time limited is not advertised anywhere whatsoever on the menu, so it is basically either a) arbitrarily defined by your very slow server or b) 90 minutes (I guess) assuming that it is the customer's responsibility to look it up on Yelp. There are way better truly unlimited brunch places in NYC with at least 2 hours of bottomless drinks. This place is a rip off.
Fantastic food and amazing drinks! The service was impeccable, I will definitely be going back!

I went into my night with great positivity. I've heard great things about this bar. Fun times, respectable drink prices. What I found was the opposite. I walked upstairs to use the restroom after entering into the premises. After leaving the restroom, I received suspicious looks by two bouncers who asked me why I was waiting near the door. I explained that I was waiting for a friend who then left the bathroom as I was explaining my situation. The bouncers then proceeded to kick me out because I was "talking back." They pushed me down the stairs and out of the building. I still do not know why I was kicked out. I was trying to enter the bar to see my good friends who live in Philadelphia and who had been at the bar for hours prior to my arrival. Instead, I was greeted by ridiculous accusations and an inaccurate portrayal of my true character as an individual. I'm disappointed by the character of hired members at this bar and hope they would be more considerate and reasonable in the future. If not, good luck staying open as the most racist bar in Philadelphia.
Wonderful breakfast and lunch menu. Food is delicious, and service is excellent. Our waiter, Demetrius, was just the best! We will be back, no doubt.
I have enjoyed many burgers here.   wonderful place./
Very unfriendly staff, you need to wait an hour to be served and an other 15 minutes to pay. Food was very average and uou smell oil after your breakfest

Usually I write reviews  to complain but I just had to write a review for such a wonderful night. Every year , my boyfriend and I like to take the other out to dinner for our birthdays. Just the two of us, always a different place. Last night we went to Blend in the Water as my bday choice.     First off, the $7 valet was super helpful since parking is so hard to find in the area. We got to our reservation about 5 mins late and we were seated in no time. At first glance I thought the seats were too close together but after being seated we didn't feel like we were on top of each other.     Our waitress was AMAZING!!! So up beat and honest in answering our questions. I believe her name was Alexis/Alexa. She gave us great recommendations and helped us make delicious choices. My boyfriend had the snapper and I had the pernil. The meat literally fell off the bone.  It was so good, he ate all of his plus half of mine.  The red "Sangrita" was so yummy that we will definitely be back just for drinks.   I would definitely recommend this place for a date night or night out. The scenery inside and the outside backdrop is truly beautiful.  Thanks to the entire staff for an amazing birthday!!!

This evening we called around 1030pm and asked the time they closed and they said 11pm so we said we would be right there. We arrived at 1045pm and the server said they were closed. The chef in the kitchen also said they were closed and they shut everything off and even took out the trash. Your posted closure time is 11pm you should be open for service until that time. Closing earlier than your posted time is far from proper business etiquette and very wrong. Very disappointed in this attempt for dinner. Find another service oriented place.

I've been coming here for years and the food was always great. Solid ingredients and well prepared. Not sure what happened but the ingredients and quality have changed for the worse. I hope they go back to the way it was. What happened??
Great food great atmosphere love the authentic Uruguayan food and ORDER the gnocchi!!!

My friends live in town and I was up visiting for foliage.  Since we didn't feel like cooking we decided to eat out. After googling a bunch of places, we saw the on line menu featuring some great sounding Russian food, including several vegetarian options which work out great as one of us is a vegetarian.  We also thought the two pages of vodka martinis on the menu would keep us happy during the meal. A phone call got us a reservation no problem, and a long hour later we were there, greeted by Maxx the black lab and seated.  The server gave us menus, told us about the new ravioli which is also vegetarian, and then said she'd give us a minute.  We asked about the martini list and were informed that they don't serve alcohol any longer but we could have brought our own. This is where disappointment came in.  We were actually looking forward to those martinis.  Had we known we wouldn't have wasted our time, or would have brought our own adult beverages.  I guess that is one of the reasons that the place was empty on a foliage weekend.  We opted to go to Black Rock down the road which was  crowded but still no wait, and had a great meal with a glass of wine. If you don't serve alcohol, take the two pages of drinks off your website, remove the bar menu off your website and let people know prior to arrival that it is byob.   I wonder how fresh the food would have been...no customers so everything is frozen is my guess, but for $24 do I want frozen chicken kiev? Nahh I can buy a box of it from the freezer section and microwave my own for much much less.

Honestly? I'm being extremely nice by givingthis place a"2" rdculous,rude, and unprofessional. But location is amazing! Decor is cozy and nice but feels a bit dirty in here which I'm not a big fa of.... Anywy my suggestion to this place is to either upgrade their game plan or close down! However,if the cafe is mostly empty, and you walk up to me and ask me if I'm ordering anything else and if not then ask me to leave, you have a problem with customer service. Not to mention that you were terse and rude to begin with. Just plain cold and unfriendly.

EVERYTHING IS SO GOOD HERE. I COULD DRINK THEIR BARBEQUE SAUCE B/C IT IS THE PERFECT BALANCE BETWEEN SMOKINESS/VINEGAR/SWEET.   Portions aren't gigantic, just perfect. If you are a meat lover you may want to order 2 orders. Their brisket is so tender and yummy. Just stop. Their ribs are almost fall off the bone, just perfect enough to eat the meat on the bone instead of all the meat falling off the bone if you get what I mean. The baked beans with the burnt ends of meat is so good you can eat that as a meal itself with a bread bun. And it is meaty, they are not skimpy in the order of baked beans. Their barbequed chicken is also good, but I still prefer the ribs and brisket if I'm going to make a trip out to Mighty Quinn's. Everything has a very smokey element and that's what I love b/c I feel authentic barbeque should have that charred wood flavor to it.

I had such a great time here.  The service was top-notch!  We were treated like celebrities.   There were at least 6 people waiting on us, all with character and charisma.   The bartender made personalized drinks.  The wine selection was great- mmm... Sancerre!  The chef kept surprising us with little treats, starting with the most delicious soup in an espresso cup.  The presentation was creative and artistic.  The night time view of Hartford- exciting! From starters to finish- perfection!
Good place for Mexican food. Everything was really fresh, the guacamole is a must it was really good. Accommodating for vegetarians. Place is really clean.
Very good pizza   very long line We sit down and we have to wait about 2 45 min for the pizza to come

I'm not sure why many of the reviews for Hibino in LIC describe this place and/or it's food as "authentically" Japanese since when i went to the restaurant, I did not hear Japanese spoken. In fact, it sounded Korean to me. Secondly, just because the menu has Japanese (that makes sense) on it doesn't mean the food is Japanese. Tried the $26 sashimi plate. The fish was OK, at least not stale (like BANY somewhat near by). Also had the taiyaki (Japanese fish shaped pastry with red bean inside). That was really just so-so and left me wondering if they bought the frozen ones from Mitsuwa Market in New Jersey and just heated them up. Most people I saw inside were not Asian, nor Japanese, which explains all the raving reviews from ethnic cuisine experts who live in and/or hang out in LIC, 'cause, like, you know, it's the place to be.

I want to start off by saying I have been here many times before and I have never ever had a problem. However, last night I went with one of my girlfriends, I'm Hispanic and she's black. She encountered some racist sh*t. She got to pio pio before I did and was trying to get seated. Asked the hostess if she can get seated, policy is your party must be complete. Two other parties that can after her were also incomplete and they were seated right away. She went up to hostess to ask why they got seated if they were incomplete, the hostess had nothing to say. My friend told her you can't do a favor for one party in front of another. The hostess took my friend to the back and then said sorry no seats you have to wait outside. Finally I got there and we went back in to speak to a manager. When my friend asked for a manager the hostess looked at me and was like I'll get you the manager. She did not want to make any eye contact with my friend. Smh. Manager was not there which was weird and she brought the "supervisor" which was a cook from the kitchen. He was apologizing, finally I got very upset and told hostess my friend deserves an apology. The hostess looked at me and said sorry to me.. I got even more mad and told her not to say sorry to me.. To say sorry to my friend and to stop looking at me. With so much hate and anger..She looked at my friend and finally said sorry. Other than that the food was good as always. I just felt this should be told. This is not cool people you don't treat people like that..treat them with respect.

Hanging out with some friends having some amazing food and drinks at Jacob's! Such friendly service and great atmosphere. Much more sophisticated than a restaurant with "pickles" in the name might imply! Also great music and rustic yet refined style!
cappaccino made right, grilled gouda black bean sandwiches, best secret vegetarian shop unknown to anyone until they do. i love going here.

My boyfriend and I designate Fridays as date night every other week I chose where we go for dinner. I chose Ah' Pizz because I heard fabulous things about it from dear friends of mine. I've been meaning to get around to checking the place out and finally did. I agree with a review below that Ah'Pizz should be renamed to "Eh' Pizz". The service was fine but the food was just mediocre. The first thing that really was a disappointment was that there was no bread served to our table which was surprising because I have never been to an Italian restaurant where bread was not served. We ordered the caprese salad and there was absolutely no flavor to the mozzarella cheese and the proscuitto was way too salty for my liking. I also ordered one of their specials for the evening which was the butternut squash ravioli which was nothing to write home about. For dessert I ordered Tartufo and it was definitely warm. Perhaps I should have tried their pizza since that's what everyone raves about. The other thing that confused me was that it's a BYOB place, however on the back of the dessert menu, there was a bottle menu (?) Nice ambiance and service, but definitely not somewhere I would go back to any time soon or again.

This is it folks - real Chinese food recently opened in West Hartford near A Dong. The food here cannot be compared with any of the other Chinese restaurants in the Greater Hartford region which typically offer sugary, deep-fried "Americanized" dishes with utterly boring spice regimens.   For those unfamiliar with Szechuan peppers it's important to note that they will numb your mouth and cause a buzzing/tingling sensation.  All three dishes that we ordered were covered it them which made for a fun and different culinary experience.  But at times we felt like we were running a marathon due to the sensation we were feeling in our mouths. Strongly recommend Wanxiang Fried Fish, Napa Fish, Twice-Cooked pork. Photos were from their website.

My husband and I have eaten here twice. The first time we ate at Misconduct the food was okay - enough to make us want to come back again. The next (and last) time we went there, it was atrocious. I ordered a Diet Coke, but when I took a drink out of the glass it tasted like vodka had been mixed in with the diet coke. I asked the waitress if my drink was only diet coke, and she said yes. My husband even tried it, and thought the same as I did. I don't know. Weird. On to our meal (we were the only couple in the restaurant). I ordered the carnita tacos and my husband had the hot dog. Both of our meals had a funky aftertaste, almost a musky flavor. We didn't eat half of our meals, so we asked for the check and left. Well later that night we both got very sick, and vomited all night (we shared each other's food at lunch). So on top of the horrible food, we suffered from food poisoning also. To state the obvious, we won't be back. Fado, which is right across the street, is much better in my opinion.

This place is phenomenal, and you're doing yourself a disservice if you don't try the London burger with boursin and bacon. The thick cut fries are great, and the beer selection is always changing with knowledgeable bartenders. Prices are lower than the other surrounding spots, but the decor is still higher-end pub.
Highly Over rated...

I'm from H-town where there's many Chinese dumpling shop that's highly competitive. After reading couple reviews had to check this place out. Interesting menu and the good is EXTREMELY cheap! The dumpling noodle soup has a bland broth. The Boilled shrimp dumpling has too much dough & shrimp was bland. The sesame pancake is def oily and very heavy. The ONLY this worth buying is their chive and pork fried dumpling, 4 for $1. That was good but only that. It gets a crazy busy crowd!

AWESOME, AWESOME, AWESOME!! the absolute best!!! I'm here several days a week and for a reason. Everything is fresh  and delicious. The owner, Tony, is wonderful. Very nice and very welcoming. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

Solid all around. Friendly vibe and staff. Great food - mix of comfort, savory, and healthy. "Market Sides" are awesome (quinoa/avocado/tomatoes my fav). The Vegan Rancheros are awesome. As are the newly added vegan meatballs! Def my new go-to dish. Love the late delivery (until 11pm). 983 is a staple if you live in the neighborhood. Without a doubt.

My friend and I tried the hotpot only, but we will come back for hotpot and korean bbq soon. The price was reasonable , the hotpot was great. I am usually picky on the cleanliness, it was comfortable enough for me to stay. The service was great! The waitstaff made sure the A/C was on the right temp for us. I hope this restaurant will continue the level of food quality and service, i highly recommend this restaurant to all!
So good, massive portions. Musts: scallion pancakes, Dan Dan noodles, spicy cucumbers.

Walked in at 11pm on a Saturday night. Packed restaurant, full bar, but we were very rudely told 'we're closed.' As if it were obvious. All we wanted was a margarita, we certainly had no intentions of keeping the kitchen open. I've been to the East Village location- food AND service were great. Didn't exactly feel welcome on Grand street so I don't think we'll be coming back, which is a shame since we live in the neighborhood. Keep it classy Caracas- just because you're in a trendy neighborhood, doesn't mean your customers are expendable.
Everything I have eaten here has been delicious.  I especially like the meat combo.  It is plenty of food for two people to share.  I really like the Ethiopians beers they have available.

We live in the neighborhood and were looking for breakfast on a rainy Saturday, too hungry to deal with the crush of tourists at Reading Terminal. I knew this was a hotel restaurant but got sucked into all the rave reviews and became convinced it must be  something more than the usual midrange business class hotel breakfast. It isn't. If you have stayed in a chain hotel on the side of a busy highway anywhere in the country that includes a free breakfast in the lobby, you know exactly what this is. The addition of a live chef to cook omelettes and scrambled eggs is nice, but it is still a melamine bar with stainless steel buckets set in ice and filled with individual pots of yogurt and half pints of milk, some pastries in a clear acrylic case, and a steam bar with troughs of bacon and sausage. The view is lovely, your fellow diners are exactly what you would expect at a $100 a night hotel across from a convention center, and you will pay $15.95 unless this came as part of a room package.

Today we saw this place at the magic hat octoberfest and decided to try it tonight as lines were long everywhere else. Food was amazing. Big props to KATELYNN at the register. She was so nice and helpful as I think I was a pain in the butt. Will hopefully go back again.

Went there for lunch during the week. Ordered  the burger on a whim. I usually would never order a $15.00 burger. It was really good! It had a fried egg on top. My friend had the chicken teriyaki and said it was very good. I don't know if I would order a $15.00 burger every day but I am interested in coming back to try the other things on the menu.
I had eggs at this location. My meal was very good. The wait service was not the best which is why I didn't give it 4 stars. The food is good though.

Pat's is only good when you're drunk at 2am and the bars closing. The steaks are average at best and the only really good item on the menu is the fries wit cheese. The staff are usually miserable with less than stellar attitudes. This place is only for tourists and not where real Philadelphians prefer to grab a cheesesteak. Good luck tourists!!

Ate here with my husband on a Saturday night.  Upon entering the restaurant there were only a few open tables.  We first ordered wine, the selection was mediocre.  The waitress had to ask us a second time after placing the order what we requested and then thought they were out, only to realize she wrote our order wrong.  Started with the beef wellington appetizer and mushroom soup.  The soup was great but would have been better with just a few dashes of salt.  The beef wellington had potential, but was laid over an overpowering sweet potato puree that permeated the entire dish.  Ordered the shrimp flatbread for an entree which was a huge portion.  Tasty but a lemon taste was overpowering.  My husband ordered the pork chop which was cooked perfectly and very delicious.  However, there were chunks of bleu cheese on top which ruined the flavor of the meat.  And the sweet potato puree made a second appearance which again overpowered the dish. What truly ruined our experience was the wait staff.  There was no hostess and we waited over 5 minutes at the door waiting to be escorted to our table.  As mentioned before, our wine order was placed incorrectly. When our glasses emptied, our waitress never asked if we would like a second serving.  However, the wine was not good so we were not looking for a second pouring.  The most disappointing is that upon first being served our entrees, the waitress asked us if we enjoyed our dishes before we even had a chance to take a bite.  She then came back two more times within the first three minutes asking the same questions.  However, after eating for 20 minutes no one on the wait staff was to be found.  We then sat for an additional 25 minutes in the dining room alone before someone approached us, saying that our waitress was now bartending for a private party.  It is amazing how much poor service can truly impact a dining experience, very disappointing.
Super fast to-go, great food, good prices. Hard to beat that! Open 24 hrs is awesome, too!
I love going to El Vez!  Great atmosphere and I'm always impressed with the service.
Great sushi and very interested but delicious rolls! Hibachi is always so much fun and delicious
Best calamari pasta hands down. We sat at the bar and bartender Jacob was so friendly & recommend other places in the city to visit. Great experience, I'll be back soon!

Love, love, love this place.  We've been going to this place for sushi for over 6 years now. There have been a lot of changes over the years but, the best one has been the new owner. Ivan is such a great guy. He is a creative and talented sushi chef who really enjoys interacting with his customers. Despite the renovations, the iffy wait staff at times (yes, I agree the "dreaded" waitress is the worst) and a really tough location he has remained loyal to the neighborhood and survived where I think most would fail. That should tell you just how good the sushi is here. Every person who has tried this restaurant on my recommendation has been very impressed. It's been really nice to see the place full of customers on a regular basis. I hope they get their patio back once the reno is complete. Min Ghung is one of the best things about living in Glastonbury.

I have had Luigi's food a couple times now, once delivery and once pickup and after giving it two chances I have to say I see no reason to eat here. Last night my husband and I got a cheesesteak and penne a la vodka to go. The cheesesteak was so bland and flavorless and the bread was chewy and bland as well. I would almost have wished it were greasier because at least then there may have been some flavor. the fries it came with were soggy and flavorless as well. The penne vodka was not a vodka sauce at all and tasted and looked more like a melted velveeta sauce. It tasted nothing like what I expected, the sauce was really thick and cheesy/creamy in a suspect way, the pasta was overdone. The one time I got delivery I ordered their special Blue pizza because I love pan pizzas. It was really kind of soggy and greasy when it arrived (after not very long, I will give them that). The crust was not what I would expect from a good pan pizza. The pizza looks good for picking up a slice in store, but overall I think there are better places in the neighborhood with similar menus. Pete's cheesesteak was much better and Fairmount pizza was far more flavorful.

Never...Ever!!! Again! I arrived with my husband and my 2 daughters, ages 22 and 23. The service sucked.  The waiter appeared to not even pay attention to the drink order and it was evident when he arrived back 20...yes 20 minutes later. It was a Saturday evening, but the place was only half full. 45 minutes after the food order was placed, the waiter showed up with all of it...including the appetizers that were cold.
