I ordered a small pizza.  I waited for a long time while watching customers order after me and leave with their food.  When I asked the cashier about my order it seems they had forgotten about it.  The place wasn't that busy and the manager was there and didn't think to apologize to me about me wait.  The cashier offered me a medium pie but because I never had the pie before I didn't want to have extra pie.  The problem was the fact that I lost all this time waiting on pizza and needed to get back to work.  There is also more people working there than there are customers.  When I finally got the pizza it didn't taste that great.  It was actually chewy and soggy in the middle like it needed to stay in the brick oven a little longer.  May be it's because they are a new establishment but I hope they can work on remembering orders and dealing with these types of problems better.

I'm truly sad that I absolutely hated this place. I researched it on Yelp for a week before I went and ended up being so very disappointed. This place gets 1 star ONLY because their food quality is good; quality, not flavor. It's fresh, nothing tasted stale or reheated, so that's where the positives end. My biggest problem is with the service and the restaurant's atmosphere. I immediately felt uncomfortable upon sitting down, so much so I thought about leaving and going elsewhere, I regret not listening to that gut feeling. I was addressed by 2 different servers one after the other, the male one asking us if we were ready to order within seconds of sitting down. While they were nice and all, something seemed terribly off about them and this place in general, again I did not feel comfortable or welcome, we both felt out of place. Then they had this God awful music blasting, which didn't help me feel like I could relax and enjoy my meal, and I didn't. It sounded like what the employees wanted to listen to with no regard to the customers. Sometimes a different song would come on and it would be REALLY loud and it made me jump the 3 different times it happened in a 20 minute span, yet they failed to correct it. When the servers weren't helping anyone, they just ran their mouths loud and non-stop at the counter with personal conversations. I'm sorry but, I'm not trying to hear that stuff so close to my table when I'm trying to have a meal. This place is horribly cramped, they try to shove too many tables so close to each other that to move around means to push over the condiments that are on them. And those tables, they're filthy and they wobble. How annoyed would you be if you were picking at your food and every time you put the fork down or grabbed a bite, the table rocked...? Super annoying. Now onto the food. I ordered the pancakes and their homemade tater tots. I was craving potato of some kind, especially tater tots, so I was excited to try their version... huge mistake. The "tater tots" weren't tater tots at all. They didn't even taste anything like potatoes, I was shocked. They tasted like croquettes, which is what they should call them, but still no potato flavor or texture anywhere. I had to get potatoes somewhere else after leaving here...sad. The dipping sauce they came with was good though. The pancakes were good, but they were HUGE, I did not notice that from yelp photos, and you get 3 of them. I could only down about one of them and my boyfriend finished another, while the 3rd one went uneaten. The syrup provided was shockingly sweet and I had to scrape it off. I tried the mac & cheese my bf ordered and it was good enough, nothing spectacular. When we were done, we couldn't pay and leave fast enough, I couldn't stand the horrible loud music and awkward atmosphere. While we were full, we both complained of being hungry, simply because our cravings were not met at all. Some advice to the owners; focus on the customer, it seems like this place is run to suit the servers and other employees while inconveniencing the people who come in, pay you money, and keep you in business. The environment alone is enough to stop me from coming here ever again and I don't recommend that anyone else does either. Maybe if you're drunk or hungover, you won't mind, maybe.

i thought the beef brisket and broccoli rabe were awesome together- the sharp provolone didnt fit in my opinion, actually took it off because it was ruining the brisket flavor for me - overall pretty good - but not AMAZING

2.5 rounding down. One word - overpriced.  The ambiance is very nice, and the staff is good. However.  Though the food was pretty good, relative to what you are getting, it is very overpriced.  I understand this is the Upper East Side.  Yet even so, $20 for what is essentially a small appetizer without gourmet ingredients is a bit much.  The appetizers are not samples of foie gras or caviar.  They are three small lamb meatballs and a little bit of polenta. Our group purchased two tapas, two glasses of basic pinot grigio, and a skirt steak, that ran a total bill of nearly $100.  My friend paid $29 for a pretty small skirt steak, which he described as 'the least filling steak I have ever had'.  There are plenty of high-end Manhattan restaurants where a large high-quality Filet and sides would be maybe $5 or $10 more. I do not mean to speak ill of the establishment or the employees, and I cannot speak for the happy hour or brunch.  However for a dinner, you can definitely get comparable quality for a much better price at many other restaurants in the area.

I work right down the street from La Villa and it's usually the lunch spot of choice for me and my co-workers, when we go out (or order in).  The Tradizionale pizza--a square pie with fresh garlic, oil, and sausage -- has to be the best pizza I have ever tasted, and I know I'm not the only one that thinks this way.  Even their plain slices are far above nearly every other pizzeria I've tried.   Their crusts are crispy and not too doughy, and that Tradizionale pie sausage (which is not the sausage you get if you order sausage on a regular round pizza) tastes like it was sauteed in the garlic and olive oil and is generally heavenly.   If you are eating in around lunch time, it is worth noting that this place can get packed (for good reason) and service may run a little slow.  Usually that's fine for me and my group, as we're not trying to rush back to work, but it's a better experience if you have the time to sit and enjoy yourself.  This place is owned and run by some really nice people, also.
Have to say this is my favorite place to sit down with friends and family. Always stopping in especially when it gets cold outside. Coffee always spot on and nice selection of desserts.

We discover Penelope. And glad we did, this is a busy little gem of a place, would not look out of place in Brighton, England with its duck egg blue planked walls and wooden floor. Service is quick and efficient and the breakfast delicious. Only gripe is that the menu seems to change at the weekend so if there's something you really like on a Friday ( Pancakes ) may not be available on a Sunday. Otherwise I highly recommend. Enjoy.

I cannot understand how this restaurant got so many stars!!!! My husband tried the "homemade" gnocchi which I'm sure wasn't homemade and the sauce was the worst... I tried some pasta with shrimp and cream sauce (sorry, forgot the name) and OMG what was that??? I can honestly say this was our worst restaurant experience...

I been here a few times now and like everyone has been saying it has a New York or I would say private London club/smoking lounge feel without the smoke!. Whats better here is the service and food quality along with the huge selection of brown spirits/Wines. They recently added a Cocktail cart so your girl friend/wife does not have to watch you sipping your brown spirits alone! Not that your woman should not drink brown spirits but I find most women prefer Vodka mixes;). Give it a try and look out for special events and promotion's on FB and other social media sites as they promote often.
love it.  Wish I was near by!

Place was empty so I didn't have high hopes for a good sub. Boy was I wrong!!  My son got 1/2 club sub and I got 1/2 meatball parm. The bread was fresh and the meatballs were like home cooking with delicious marinara sauce. The 1/2 subs were too big for either of us to finish. This place is highly recommended.

The hostess quoted us 30-45 minute wait and we ended up waiting over and hour for our table for two! The server barely spoke to us, except to say that he couldn't put our appetizer order in until we ordered our entrees too! The food came out before we could enjoy a glass of the $24 pitcher of sangria ($12.95 for the cuban Pete mix, $12 for the BYOB wine)! The food was hot and good, but mediocre at best and grossly over priced. They herd the customers like cattle there and it's apparent across the restaurant. I will never go back, but glad I went tonight to find out that it's not worth it!
Great food and atmosphere! I typically have the pollo cubano and sangria. There's usually a long wait so try to arrive early.

Went back with my family; my wife had not been there before.  I usually go here with my son when we go to Red Bulls games. Tonight, we all went and had an early dinner before the game.  Two had shrimp with garlic sauce and 2 has steak.  All if us thought it was great.  The food is delicious and fresh and prepared in a healthy way,  portions are good (you will not leave hungry), the sides are excellent and there are so many to choose from and the price is right.  The service is very good; the people who run the place and work here are nice people and do their best to accommodate.   I rarely go to Newark and now that the Red Bulls season is coming to an end, I'm going to have to find some time to get here.  I normally take the train and it's a quick walk from the station but I Wish it was easier to park in which case I would come here more.often.
Awesome. Love this places pork chops. Everyone should ask for Vinny boombatz. Give him a kiss for me.

After looking for a nice pizza place in bloomfield for months, finally found a place in clifton..plain cheese slice is really nice.. Garlic bread was different and gooood!!! Will surely come again here soon!!

Had all of our orders mixed up.. No set waitress.. And they all act like they don't know what you're saying and are SUPER RUDE. Took almost 45 mins to get all of our food.. Also when I ordered my food they had shrimp stool in the dough of my sumai!!!! Disgusting!! Never will go back and don't recommend to anyone! Felt so disgusted and sick after leaving that disgusting place!

Absolutely horrendous service. We sat for 20 minutes before being acknowledged by anyone. The bartender was clearly drunk or hungover or something. I ordered a "bottomless" Bloody Mary. The bartender served me ONE and then disappeared for about 30 mins. I ended up having to ask a server to give me my bill... 45 mins later. While I'll admit the food was pretty good, it was certainly not worth the awful service that came with it.

This could have been a good experience... IF -had they not totally forgotten about us and made us get up THREE times to get service. -It was literally, here sit, here are some drinks, then waiter disappeared the whole meal. -After looking for the waiter a few times he finally sent a girl back to take our order. Food was served, and again, nobody to be seen. Got up again to get service. -The check came and we tipped based on the horrible service, a very standard tip, not even deserved at all. The waitress came back and DEMANDED a higher tip. I politely said "tipping is based on service and since you pretty much left us alone the entire time, that is what we are leaving." Never ever going back.   APALLED!

Previously, the owner hung up on another coworker who I recommemded to this establishment because she called complaining about hair found in her food. I called back because I witnessed the hair and I was embarassed. I immediately thought about that Friday. Both of us did not hear him ask me if I wanted to order but that's ok. As for taking to yelp,  I generally don't but I was very offended by his attitude. I generally only take to social media with positive feedback. However he was not sincere at all. Since he maintains that he asked why didn't he ask again so both orders could be done around the same time. Instead he was doing other things instead of helping a paying, long time customer. In the past if a pastry was stale,  an order wasn't ready for pick up on time or a dish was not seasoned well I never complained or wrote a review. It was the inference that my friend and I were lying that persuaded me. Then on top of that her sandwich was soggy. Bummed!  You lost my whole office especially after this unnecessary rebuttal. Humility is always a better practice especially when dealing with the public.
The most watered-down Thai food I have ever had in my life.  'Nuff said and never again.

Dear friends, If you are looking for authentic Dominican/Puerto Rican food... THIS IS  NOT THE PLACE TO GO. Let me start by saying that, as soon as you arrive, you are greeted by an "Argentinian" hostess, and then by an "Argentinian" waiter with no clue of what a typical mofongo  is made of or taste like, just to give you an example. Sadly, they don't know much about what they are selling and serving. I mean... c'mon! Take a minute to study your restaurant's menu! Ask about what each item means or how it is made! Second, no one in the kitchen, as I learned later, was of Caribbean origin. The cook was Mexican and the rest of Central American and South American background. Now, you may think.. so what? As long as they cook well... thats what matters right? But when you order "bacalaitos" and you get two tiny smashed- dry bunuelos de bacalo from last Christmas, and a mofongo with chicken that tastes like an over cooked and over heated venezuelan arepa with, actually, no chicken couple with rice and beans that taste like those you get at an American dinner... you realize you are definitely in the WRONG PLACE. Trust me, I am Puerto Rican. I know how to cook a simple mofongo. It is NOT that difficult. But this place really really sucks! Oh... and dont order a "Tres Leches" for dessert. You are gonna get an hybrid between an Hindu and Amercian solid rice pudding instead. WORST PLACE TO EAT authentic Dominican/Puerto Rican food in Brooklyn. Please take my advice and go somewhere else.

My friend and I just ordered from this burger joint and insulted and disappointed is what I'm left with. Ordered delivery. Was told 40 mins. And hour and 10 minutes later I call and he says they got hit by a rush hour and pushed my order back and that the driver was just about to head out the door. I asked if the food was prepared hot and not old and he said yes. Food came cold to the touch, fried were old and ice cold, my shake flavor was wrong, my cookie that he was giving as an apology wasn't even put in the bag. Oh and je gave me a free soda...thanks. called back to ask if I could get my shake thar I actually paid for and how cold the burgers were and then he said he'd credit me the shake LOL really? I told him not to even bother coming back for the shake. They should be very disappointed in themselves. Oh and my lettuce on my burger was nasty. Safe the trouble and go somewhere else. Will never be ordering from this place.

Wow, I had such high hopes. The place was well reviewed and the food smelled great. However, when we figured out what we wanted none of it was available. I had to ask three times about one item as was being ignored and then got snapped at for asking. I then got a hot sandwich and they toasted it so long that the bread was rock hard (and I am not exaggerating I literally knocked on it and it sounded like wood). Maybe they just didn't like something about me but the experience was so bad that I actually left angry and I'm a pretty easy going guy.

If you're from Staten Island and have had the privilege of watching this place transform from the little restaurant that could (Against Da Grill), into a now more refined "Craft House", you know that this place truly encompasses the "Mom & Pop" inspirational energy. The menu has gone from amazing (ADG), to wow (Craft House). The beer menu is off the charts. By far, the best selection of ales, IPA (tap and bottles), lager, import and domestic beers I've ever experienced. The ambiance is that of a lower east side style bar, but with the right twist of swagger. If you happen to eat here, don't be afraid to try anything. The short and simple menu, I believe, affords a more crafted and refined approach to each dish. The fish and chips taste better than Louisiana could ever hope to out do, the battered jumbo shrimp is to die for. Recently I tried their corn dip appetizer and was really shocked at their level creativity. I won't spoil it anymore...you'll simply just have to stop by and see for yourself. Oh...and if you can't decide on a side, do yourself a favor and order the baked Macaroni, topped with fresh bacon. It's served in an aluminum deep dish...you'll thank me later.

Ordered an arugula salad which comes with walnuts, goats cheese and olives...got an arugula salad with mozz, onion, tomatoes and jalapeño...called the restaurant and talked to the owner Bobby Bornito...ask why was I given this salad..."well we didn't have some of the ingredients so we put extra in to please our customers." This place is terrible...they don't even have their own website. Gave one star because zero is not an option...this place will be out of business in a few months...

What a gem!  I was in Burlington, working at the airport for a couple days and everyone recommended this deli for a place to eat. The outside is a little rough and I was not expecting to get what I did on the inside.  I was thinking tasteless pre-wrapped sandwiches, hot dogs, hamburgers that have been sitting under a warming lamp, but that is NOT at all what I got. I was so surprised to see an extensive menu with freshly made sandwiches, paninis, burgers, soup and other delicious options!  I had a six inch Italian on multigrain bread.  This sandwich was jammed with meat and cheese and was all around completely delicious.  It was so big that I couldn't finish it.  I picked up a side of corn chowder soup (soup is my second favorite food), the perfect accompaniment to the previously mentioned glorious sandwich. If you're near the Burlington airport, grab some lunch, climb up to the observation tower and enjoy a great view and a great lunch!

The waffles at Jacks Cafe are one of the best I have ever had, made fresh to order. Jack and Marianne are always there to make sure your experience is a great one. We use their catering is one that is raved about when we have summer parties and small get togethers.

Stopped in because I knew something new had opened here and wasn't at all disappointed.  I loved the pizza, the wine and the dessert.  Service was attentive but not annoying or over the top.  Great atmosphere and will definitely come back.

My husband and I have been to The Counter several times.  We love the burgers, as well as the many options available for building our own meal.  Last night we decided to enjoy our Friday night with some burgers and had yet another great experience - this time with the service.  There was a minor hiccup with our order, which wasn't really a big deal at all, but our server Kevin, along with his manager, went out of their way to make sure we were happy and well taken care of.  My husband and I were both super impressed with Kevin's attentiveness as our waiter and will definitely ask to sit in his section if he's working next time we're there.  It's always refreshing to meet someone who is really dedicated to going above and beyond.  Thanks Kevin! We'll certainly be enjoying a burger at The Counter again soon.
If you live in Yardley, this place is Cheers

The Cafeteria is my go to place when my boyfriend and I are out. Today 10/11/14 at around 11 pm we decided to have dinner there since there our options were limited. Service was okay. I must admit, the quality of food and service has gone down hill over the years, but we still eat there because of the throwback music and chill environment. Today was the icing on the cake and I will vow to never step foot in there again. It took us about 20 minutes to be serviced. Now like I said before, we have visited the Cafeteria numerous times over the years..there was no excuse to this happening. I ordered the wild berry mojito and OMFG..the worst I have ever had...literally tasted like cranberry juice. He ordered the fish tacos and I ordered the chicken and waffles. Honestly the food was so bland. My chicken was dry and his taco tasted like butter. Our bill was fairly cheap..that is one thing that I do enjoy about the Cafeteria...alot for a little. 2 drinks an appetizer and a main dish for about $40 if I am not mistaken. We paid and proceeded to leave. As I am putting on my jacket, I notice a manager talking to my boyfriend. Because of the loud music I couldn't understand their conversation, then I notice him hand the manager extra money. I asked my boyfriend what the conversation was about, and apparently the waiter was not satisfied with our tip. The manager thought it was his duty to come and question us about the tip. Maybe I'm a little emotional about this because I am PMS-ing but this is the most ridiculous thing I have ever heard of. It was so embarrassing and unprofessional, especially as a manager! I am sorry to say this, but you have lost a very good and frequent customer. We've had several birthday's, anniversary dinners etc. When our family visits from overseas we always take them to the Cafeteria. As of today that will be the LAST time I ever step foot in that establishment.

Extremely slow service and least choices.   If you don't have 35 minutes extra wait time you better not get the coffee from here.  The business is not capable handling high volume customers,  it could be the size of the coffee maker machine they are using.

Good carne asada, a little disappointed in the adobada. A little more seasoning would have made it way better. The homemade flour tortillas were okay but got soggy really quickly and fell apart. Salsa was yummy and the guys behind the counter were really nice about putting a little more on when asked. I recently moved back from the west coast and have been looking for a good taco shop, so this place is solid for New York but can't really compare to west coast tacos.

Lived up to our expectations. Excellent ambience and food. We went for the $120 and were very happy with it. Service was very good and friendly. For 2 $120 menus, 3 glasses of wine and some more alcoholic beverages at the end we paid $410 incl tip and tax. A decent deal for the experience we've had!

Unprofessional staff. There is no host. Servers don't know the menu. The server forgot our order which we reminded him 10 minutes after we ordered. I paid the check but did not receive a receipt ! The food was good though. I would have liked at least 8-10 wings for the order price. We only got 7 shrimp with the appetizer also.

My girlfriend and I stopped by this location on our way up to VT.  We wanted a vegetarian friendly sandwich place.   This place was ideal.  Very cordial staff and delicious soup, veggie hummus wraps.   "I'll be back." [Stated in Ahnold Schwarzenegger tone of voice].

I'm dying to try the Sunday night 14 course "meze" for $35 sometime soon! The food is fantastic and it's BYOB so you can bring a fantastic bottle of wine you can actually afford. Specials are always inventive and delicious! The atmosphere is bustling yet cozy. You can't go wrong with the Cyprus breakfast--eggs, halloumi, and ham! I had amazing duck egg with a spicy yogurt and merguez sausage for my birthday brunch a few years ago which I still crave. The grilled octopus is awesome, but my favorite may be the "manti" which are spicy lamb dumplings! If the dips of the day include the pumpkin-feta dip definitely order it! It's amazing. Their baklava and cardamom ice cream are heavenly. Whenever I walk by and see people on the street enjoying their meals and wine, the corner is so inviting! I also love to inspect the quirky decor and handwritten signs. These are just the things that make Kanella uniquely special.
Went here with my mom when she was in town. It was soooo good.
Simply the best indoor market in Philadelphia. Whatever you're looking for you can find it at the Reading Terminal Market.
Love the food here! So inexpensive and delicious

I had high expectations for this restaurant based other's experiences.  In particular,  my companion had wonderful past experiences here so I was excited. However, my experience was a disappointing.  The quality of the was food okay as it did not taste any different than dishes at other Chinese restaurants at which I have dined. Thus, other than family style seating that works well for the restaurant, nothing set it apart as great. The quality of the service can improve; while taking our order the waiter began a conversation with a co-worker, which I thought was rude.  In general the wait-staff seemed disinterested in the customers. Whether it is a cultural dynamic that I do not comprehend or not, the adage of when in Rome has value for any business. Later in the evening I went to the bathroom preceded by an employee.  The person was in the bathroom for quite a while and I did not hear water running for hand-washing prior to exit. This is just my experience and I certainly do not wish to dissuade anyone from trying as it may be a wonderful for you.
Really bland food and the portions seemed smaller than average. Very disappointed. Would not do again.

Came here because the reviews were good, but I'm not sure what the appeal was . The place was a mix of Mexican and burgers.  We each had a little of each with onion rings as an appetizer.  Everything was just so bland!  The side of refried beans was so dry, seemed like they were sitting for hours.  The fish tacos were basically ground up fish pieces.  Burgers also weren't anything special.  Everything was basically food in a pinch, but if you're in the area, you'd be better off somewhere else... Suggestion, skip Mexican from the menu and stick to a stronger pub menu.
vegan small plates and drink a few blocks from my work... woo hoo! this is my go to date spot in the area. not that i get dates, but if i did, i imagine this is where i would take them.

I can't believe it, I looked up the Yelp reviews and again, you all steered me in the right direction!! I've fallen in love with their sushi, may be a little overpriced but you get what you pay for, definitely worth every penny!
Great atmosphere. I thought I was in Paris
I ordered chicken wings, lamb and chicken kebab, so yummy, highly recommended if you enjoy barbecue.

Really surprised to see all the great reviews written for this place. People must have low expectations of the standard of food they should get at Amy Ruth's prices. I had the Pres Obama which was a boiled piece of chicken smothered in an unoriginal bbq sauce. I knew I was in for it when the plate came out in less than 5 minutes. That may sound fast to an impatient diner but if you step back and think how could anything good be made that fast you'll know what I mean. The sides of corn and string beans were very obviously straight from the green giant can. You charge an average of $25 per person for dinner in a low rent area - how about you send one of the staff standing around doing nothing to the grocery store? Finally the sweet potato pie was clearly not made on sight - not homemade as advertised. Too expensive of a night for food of this quality.

The food itself would merit a 4 star review, although their definition of spicy is nearly as mild as the ketchup on a hamburger... but the service drags the place down. Every time I have come here during lunch (for the $8 lunch special, a decent portion including a 3/4 filled cup of soup)I have been met with the most disinterested, surly servers on earth.  Imagine you took your teenage daughter on vacation without her cell phone or iPod... she would be happier and friendlier than the waitstaff here.  They barely speak, and when they do, they use gruff tones and 3 word statements.  Each time I have come, they came to my table about 10 seconds after I picked up the menu, asking, "Your order?"  But if you're willing to deal with poor manners, the price makes the lunch specials worth it, at least.  I don't know if I would be willing to spend dinner prices for that treatment, though.

Ok. This is my 2nd time here and it's 2 for 2 on crappy service. I live on the block and really want to like this place for its local feel and all that but I can't. It's cute and "authentic" but when the guy forgot my order without an apology and then threw the coffee at me with a passive aggressive attitude it kind of threw me. Sorry Johnny, you lose.

Tried this place yesterday, so happy we went early and ordered of the 1/2 price list!   Sushi was bland, pork gyozo had zero taste and the spring rolls were manageable because of the sauce that came with them.   The Hoboken roll was awful.  We tried 5 rolls altogether and not impressed by any.  On a positive note, place was very clean and our waiter was nice, service was ok.  However, we will not return. Much better sushi restaurants, so don't waste your money or time.

I had planned a girls night out dinner at Sushi Lounge a few months ago. In total, it was about 13 ladies. Our reservations were for 7pm. We arrived in 3 different groups. The first group was already there before my group arrived at 7:02. The final group arrived a few minutes after us. First off, even though more than half the total group was there, they wouldn't seat us. Secondly, when they did seat us, they sat us at a table people were sitting at already. They asked the 2 couples, who were only having drinks to move down to the end of the table. They expected a group of 13 people who were having dinner to share a table with 4 other people who were only using it to have a place to set their drinks. When I tried speaking to the manager to explain to him that we were a large group who were intending on eating dinner and I didn't think there would be enough room for us to share the table, he told me to be patient and they would be leaving shortly. By the time our food came, the 2 couples were still there. I had to find the manager AGAIN just to have a comfortable dinner. One would think serving a group of 13 people would be good business. I expected better customer service from this place. I had heard such good reviews and was extremely disappointed with my first visit that I would never go back. Sushi Lounge in Hoboken, on the other hand, was a different story :-) I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at that location.

Irish Pub? Sports Bar? Burger Joint? Who knows?!? This place is suffering an identity crisis, and what's worse, none of its many identities are all that appealing. The menu is big, with everything from "philly cheesesteaks" to burgers to sandwiches to fish and chips to corned beef....pretty much the kitchen sink. Unfortunately none of it was done right; paid $13 for a burger that was overcooked and tasteless. Atmosphere is wall-to-wall TVs....I was expecting a pub, not a sports bar. Truth is, they don't know what they are.

Amazing made from scratch, so it does take them a while to serve, but the wait is well worth it!  Wonderful.  Everything very very fresh. We had dinner , not buffet. It was great and we will go there again.

While some of the food is good, it is not worth the overpriced price tags. Customer service is horrid. I came there 3 times and then decided to order for delivery. The 8$ French onion soup, which I've ordered before when I was there, came in a small sized soup cup that was half filled!! It was literally three spoonfuls! I called them and asked for a normal soup size, knowing how much it really is because I've been there, and the person on the phone was rude, insisting that this is the serving size! So it's less than small?  I mean seriously, 8$ for less than small sized cup! So wrong. Then I said, no the chef made a mistake, so he screamed to the chef, did you make a mistake? Of course the chef said no. They wouldn't redeliver a normal soup. I vowed to never go there again. It is a waste of your money.
You've got to be kidding me.  Pretentious, inedible menu.  Ridiculous sauce-covered dogshit at $200/plate prices.  Stay away.

Traveled to New England with a friend who grew up near the Hartness House.  We were welcomed with warmth by the innkeeper and taken to a lovely double room on the 3rd floor.  The place is old and well-loved. I admired the detail and thoughtful care given to every room in the place. We explored the grounds in the morning and met Max, the wonder dog. Breakfast was cooked to order and delicious.  The innkeeper was gracious and kind. We topped off our visit when we encountered two deer in the roadway as we were leaving the property. Definitely a visit for the memory books.

We are fans!  This was our third time at the restaurant and we were extremely pleased with the food and service.  Seamus was our attentive waiter, and his recommendations for wine and entrees were spot on.  The pizzas, Bianca Neva and Margherita, were the best we had since our trip to Italy this past May.   The Pollo  Valdostano was delicious as was the soup de jour.  Our friends had the lobster ravioli and the ravioli with veal and sage and they were very pleased with their dinner choices too.    Wish the restaurant was closer to where we live.  I know we would frequent it more often.

My husband and I went to the Shu restaurant. The food and service are exceptional. The inside of the restaurant is so beautifully decorated. And music was so classic. We'd love to go there again! One of best Chinese restaurant around locally. We would definitely recommend this one to all of our friends. -Brett and Rebecca
Soooo homophobic!!!!! They would not serve my boyfriend an I. We were there over an hour and we just got waters. I would never recommend this place especially for people that are gay friendly

Only experienced service and first impression. Walked in, told 5 minutes wait bwahaha really? No one was in there go to the bar to wait. I wanted a diet coke,  one friend did not want anything at the moment my brother ordered a pint of ale. Bartender was offended that we only ordered one drink and never gave me the soda. Then as we sat at the bar at least 3 parties of 3 and 4 were seated. Wow.  At that point we were out and went to Sweetwaters across the street sn awesome place been there before just wanted to try something new.  The bar staff as we waited and the food was awesome.

It's always great when there's a strong aroma in this little Korean joint. The place sells fairly cheap korean food! And the cuisine itself is already so lovely with great portions. I'm so obsessed with getting takeouts or grabbing a lunch/dinner here. The kimbap, kimchi stew, smoothies, and rice cakes are wonderful picks! The owner is very nice too. He's awesome, same goes for all of the nice workers.

We had a bad experience, after having it recommended we spent a lot of money on over priced wine, horrible wine at that. Then I had the cod which tasted of water and the scallops which needed a microscope to be found! All in all very disappointing, we complained and they did nothing about it, took nothing off the bill. Will never go back
Good breakfast especially pancakes with bacon I'll get there soon what's cooking good looking .!

We have been going here for years and just love the food. The portions are great and we always wind up taking a lot home. We order a huge pile of appys and then a meal, and eat for days to come. Wonderful.

Ordered to go tonight. Servers messed up the order. I calmly explained yet received a nasty attitude from the employee. He tried to fix the order but screwed up AGAIN. I explained the error. You would have thought he was doing me a favor by rectifying the order! I got home and burger was burnt to a crisp - think hockey puck- and the fries were essentially raw- still cold in the middle. Never again will my family of 7 order from this dive!

Hands down, my favorite pizza in New Jersey. The toasted meatballs or "toasties" as they're called taste great with a side of mustard. The place is almost always packed, but the pizza is worth the wait.
Spaghetti and meatballs = $10 fresh spaghetti pasta good sauce moist meatballs yummy
The people here have good food but the environment wasn't the best. It could look a lot better inside.
Average food. Average prices. I have tried the chinese place twice and would not go there again. The punjabi place in the back is the best among the different counters at that location.

I've dreamt about coming to this place ever since it was featured on pizza paradise.  Well it's not worth the hype.  Too light on the sauce and definatly light on the meat.  I was really wanting to be wowed but wasn't.  The service was ok not great.  Came from a long way, and as they the journey is more fun then the destination.

absolutely amazing. spending the weekend in Philly and had to check out pats and Genos! I'm a pats fan at the moment! so much history and a huge line out the door! not to mention it was delicious! provolone cheese steak wit  that's what you gotta get!!! sooo good!

We came here and we were not sure what to expect. The reviews were excellent, but we were skeptical. We were pulled in by the reasonable prices and the BYOB. So I went around the finer to get a nice red wine and we ordered, the calamari was awesome! Truly great. The derive was amazing. The corn soup was deadly. Too creamy for me, but excellent. The udon noodle dish was unique and very tasty. And the braised short rib meal was simply wonderful with a side of white rice. I got the props from my wife! She said, "You chose well honey." That just topped the night.
Great hyderabadi indian food. I like their gobhi manchurian and chilly chicken. The prices are a bit high for the decor of the place. The owner is very friendly and caring.

Food is expensive when you compare it to the quality. I have been there 3 times. The service has been average. In the last time, all dishes lacked salt. The buffet for 2 persons was around 35 dollars or so. I do not want to take chances and be surprised with bad food if I am spending that kind of money. The appetizer and dessert selection is poor for the price.

Can't speak for the service within the restaurant, as I've only ordered delivery.  but yes, consider me a fan. crust is crispy yet substantially doughy and tasty. i have a tough time ordering something else other than the "46 Special" - great flavors all around

Ok, it's been well established in prior reviews that the food is good. Eaten here twice now so I know that. The scale really bothers me. Food here is not cheap, but this nickel-dime mentality with the scale is going too far. Allow me to illustrate the process: 1.zero the scale 2. Put tray on scale 3. Zero scale 4. Put bread on scale 5. Zero the scale. 6. Put the meat on the bread 7. Give to you. I don't have a huge problem with the prices, but don't stick it in my face. The guy measuring the meat looked like Walter White measuring out meth after a cook. If you need to measure out portions, use something else other than a scale right in front of you.

I have been here a lot and it's always a good time and decent food. I also have ordered take out twice. And twice they screwed up my order. Tonight I wanted the corned beef sandwich. When I called to order all I heard was a bunch of immature girls laughing, including the hostess who answers the phone. I repeated twice what I wanted because she was too busy not doing her job. When I went to pick it up and told her my name, she asked if I ordered the Reuben. I said no, corned beef sandwich. She said it's the same thing. So I'm thinking why have a Reuben AND a corned beef sandwich on the menu if they are the same. I absolutely love Reuben's but not with pastrami. This was a pastrami Reuben. I never once said pastrami or Reuben and that's what I got. How can an establishment like this hire a hostess who probably has never seen the menu. This one girl who couldn't focus on one simple task is the reason I will never order from there again. Incompetent high school and college girls are ruining the caldwell area food experience.
Wonderful little place, a great breakfast, wonderfully cooked and great portions, I would recommend to anyone visiting the city

Average food. Food takes forever to come out. The guy taking orders probably was a car dealer (salesman) before (no offense to car dealers). Spends a lot of time trying to sell you things on the menu and you feel embarassed when you are there to order 1 appetizer. Food is made to cater to non-indian custormers too. i.e. it is not authentic indian taste. But, it is something your kids will love.
Worst place ever food all changed with new owner someone should teach chef how to cook bad Saturday tell chef to cook garlic it was white and raw in my shrimp

Amazing food, amazing service. The staff make you feel special. They pay close attention to your table to make sure you always have a clean plate, water, and full dishes of their delicious sides that accompany the rodizio. The staff are friendly and very considerate; they suggest wines to pair with the main course and always cover my coat to prevent it from getting dirty. Me and my fiancé have been visiting Fogo De Chao in center Philly for three years and we absolutely love it. It is by far our favorite tradition!
Ordered their special vegetarian pizza and buffalo wings. Pizza was very bland and ha brocoli on it.  Wings are very bad. Will never go back to this place.

Food is average. The service at times is horrible. In my last visit got an old fat waitress. I ordered "rye toast" and she heard "dry toast". When I asked her to correct the mistake, she said "honey, you are going to make me go home early". We still gave that nasty waitress a tip to pay it forward. Never going there again.

Wait time to get a table was about 10 minutes for breakfast.  The coffee was good, but they never came around to refill our coffee or anyone else's. the wait staff was slow and once we got our food they didn't come back to check on us for refills. I would say the food is average at best. I got the Belgium waffles with strawberries and bananas. The waffle was good- but some of the strawberries still had the tops on them.  My hubby had the corn beef and hash with egg whites which describes as horrible. Probably would not go back.

Although I am a recent convert to Peruvian cuisine, ever since I have discovered pollo a la brasa I have been eating it non stop. This is now my go to place for it. The chicken is always juicy, good fries too. seasoning is always perfect. once in a while i'll get the maduros (fried bananas), never a disappointment.
tried weekday buffet. good vegetarian food. Staff is also good. They have buffet to go also. The price is very reasonable.

When my partner and I decided to invite 50 people to our house to celebrate our recent marriage we selected TASHAN as the caterer.  We had enjoyed many dinners in the restaurant so we were familiar with their menu and food preparation.    And we had such a great experience when they had catered a party for us once before, the week TASHAN opened.   Brion Pizzi,the catering manager, helped us make selectons from the catering menu and to our delight he was on site, assuring that everything went right  the night of the party.  On time arrival.  Attractive table set up.  Deliciuos food that wowed everyone.  Congenial service.  And a clean up so thorough that we could just relax and enjoy the after party glow.

Ate breakfast at Frazer's. We all ordered the omelet with toast and potatoes with choice of cheese. Perfectly done, generous amount of food, very friendly and attentive server. She apologized because we had to wait, but she didn't say what took so long.

I love this place.  I've been for lunch many times. For lunch, has great specials - for a decent price.  For dinner, not quite as good a deal.  Always great service and great food. Nothing fancy, but attentive service. I love the green curry with chicken.  Spicy and yummy. I'm no expert, but I think the criticisms have to do with the misconception that this is a traditional Thai place - it's Malaysian...

What a disappointment! Food was just OK, somewhat  overpriced. Primary reason for the low rating is the length of time for food to be served. Took about 35 minutes after our order was placed. Server was attentive but seemed accustomed to the slow food service. After telling our server we were concerned about time and were unsure about dessert, he recommend a couple of desserts that he said would be quick. Fifteen minutes passed and still no dessert.  We finally told him to cancel the dessert and to bring the check. Then had to wait for the check. Won't be going back.
Tasty at first. Nice orange puffy rice.   Not sure if the orange color was saffron spice or something else, but the rest of the large portion was just ok.

Well....let me just say, the food is always great at ihop...but the service? Less than marginal. First we wait "10" minutes for a seat because it was crowded (more like 25 minutes). Then we get our table. We wait around for another 15minutes and no one comes at all. The table behind us then gets seated and right away the manager comes over, serves them coffee and apologizes for their wait! Seriously?!!!! We still hadn't seen a waiter. After the waiter for the table behind us proceeds to take their order, he finally acknowledges us- "oh I'll be right with you"- yea, well that didn't happen. The best thing?? Tita the waitress came over, from another section because she knew what was going on. She was fantastic! Props to her for saving the day - she's getting a large tip from us!

This place has spectacular food, great wine, an expert staff and the new remodel is a total WOW factor! This is a restaurant worth dining at. Make sure to talk to Pasquale. He is fun, passionate and makes for a great experience. They do dinner, lunch & special events....I had a family special event here in addition to dinner and they did an perfect job with timing, food quality and the pricing was reasonable. Things to try for dinner....Seafood Salad app, 18oz Veal Chop, Filet of Beef w/ Gorgonzola and Pancetta & the Tagliatelle w/ Broccoli Rabe and Shrimp.

We had the best night. Live music, the owners brought over a basket of toys for the kids, the food was great. Perfect atmosphere. They also won the mac&cheese competition. We have 7 kids. It can be hard to find a table sometimes but they cleared a place for us right away.
This place used to be so good on everything service and price and food now only thing good is the service.. Food sucks price is out of this world expensive. I don't even go there now

Quite possibly the most underwhelming Mexican Restaurant in the Crown Heights/Park Slope/Downtown BK region.  The service is poor . . . takes about 10-15 minute to receive additional beverages . . . the food lacks authentic flavor (perhaps the persons in the kitchen are new to Mexican cuisine?), and somehow asking for your steak to be "bloody/medium rare" results in a well-done slab O_o.  Steer clear, your best bets for Mexican continue to reside on 5th Avenue (see Bogata, Los Pollitos Mexicanos, Los Pollitos II, etc.).  I guess I should have known this restaurant was a pretender when I realized the diversity of the clientele was lacking . . . .

Have gone there with groups of friends and we always have a great time. Food is good, service nice and portions great. Eventually got a Groupon and this was an excellent value. Have gone back many times.

Honestly, there isn't much to Geno's but there cheesesteaks. You wait for a long time and buy an overpriced cheese steak and eat it and it's not really worth it. There policy is a little racist also. There really isn't much to Philly but cheesesteaks. It's not even that good, anyone could make a better quality one at home. It's alright but I rather never go there.

Ok. Here's the truth. You line up for 25 minutes, pay $10 for a piece of Philly culture, then chomp down on a greasy mess that is nothing more than a guilty pleasure. It's fun, do it once, then try making it at home. See? You made it at home!!! AND It's cheaper and better than with Geno's or Pat's. And it was easy to make!!!
tourist trap. chunky meat disgusting wiz
Marvelous food produced in this tiny restaurant. Reservations strongly suggested.
We will go back again and I guess that is the best review I can give. The waiter was very nice and friendly. Food was finger licking good. The place was clean and the views are cool. I'll
Wonderful atmosphere, large and delicious portions, and great prices. Must try the sangria! We will most definitely be back soon! Mangia!
Lower than my expectation :(

I live on the block so I've been here a few times already, which have been mostly mediocre experiences; nothing that stood out one way or the other. On Monday, I met a friend, who was in town for the evening, there for a drink. The woman who was tending bar that night was heinous, she should not be allowed to work with customers. There were only two couples in the whole place aside from us and it still took her ten minutes to turn her attention to us, after a couple of "excuse mes." For our second round, she ignored us for long minutes because she was staring at two guys who had just come in but had no intention of staying. She then poured me a second glass of prosecco, which was completely flat. I sent it back and she started loudly arguing with me claiming that she poured it from the same bottle. This was clearly untrue, because the second glass was the end of the bottle, where the first one came from a bottle over half-way full (nobody else was drinking prosecco). She was  just trying to get rid of the last bit of an old bottle at the end of the night, with no trace of bubbles, hoping I wouldn't notice. She claimed she had tasted it and it was fine. I don't enjoy being lied to and argued with when I send back the tiniest $10 glass of prosecco because it's undrinkable, IN A WINE BAR. Until this woman is relegated to the back to wash dishes, I will not be back. I'd rather walk a couple of blocks to Wine & Roses, Barcibo, or Bin 72 than put up with service like that again. This place won't last long in a neighborhood that has plenty of options with better service.

I've been there a number of times now, and this is by far my favorite restaurant in Brooklyn.  Dining there is always such a pleasant and positive experience. The food is downright mouth-watering.  I'll spare you the list of what we had, because every other review has covered the many dishes that give the place its gastronomic reputation.  But I'll say this: the food is marked by a higher level of creativity, with flavors that truly titillate the palate.  No matter how I try, I cannot put to words the OMG feeling from dishes made more uniquely than anywhere else. The service is unparalleled.  My wife and I were there again with friends last night, and Jacqueline and her brother John tended our table.  Their professionalism is so noteworthy.  Fresh plate changeovers, water refills, superb recommendations, truly attentive service overall, with smiles and a friendly demeanor.   This place is not to be missed.  The food and service are above all expectations, and the people are just really nice.

Possibly the worst experience in memory.  There was hardly anyone there and we were completely ignored by everyone for twenty minutes.  We had a reservation, yet someone without one got served their drinks and ordered before us. Start the hourglass.  This overpriced unfriendly place is doomed.  The tin man and crew wouldn't even consider a rescue even if Dorothy was stuck waiting for a table.
Second order there! Easy online menu, very fast preparation and quality in line with the price! Good spot for chinese food to go!
Best Italian byo spot we have found in philly!

Went on a Sunday night with friends to celebrate a birthday. The food was excellent, as it always is. My problem with this place is that the servers were circling our table and pulling our plates as soon as we put the fork down. It got to the point where we were holding on to our plates so that they weren't yanked off of the table. We were well within the hours of operation so I don't know what the problem was, but we all felt very rushed through our meal. So much so that we were planning to bring a very large party there for a reunion dinner but we are having second thoughts.. I don't think I'll be back because no matter how good the food is, indigestion from having to rush through the meal just isn't worth it.

As you walk down 29th street you notice a big change starting to happen. It still has an edge to it with street guys and wholesalers. There is a bar and a new Japanese? Cafe and it looks like the block is in the middle of a change. As I walked towards 6th ave out of my left peripheral I see a small cute cafe you're place and look at the chalkboard with a quote about coffee so I walk in to see what the fuss is about. As soon as you walk in there is good music and than a couple of nice baristas greeting you as if your their neighbor. I order a regular latte and the barista quickly gets to work. As I take my first sip I notice how the temperature was perfect and the micro foam was done well. The next immediate thing I realize is that the coffee is very flavorful and traditional it seems. The there were a couple of customers behind me and the barista put the drinks out with no words spoken by the customers and I thought are they preordering? Turns out the barista just knows their orders. Amazing to say the least. I like that it doesn't have a corporate feel to it or a bunch of hipsters behind the counter but just a couple guys who enjoy what they do and don't mind being there. Oh yes and serving up a mean coffee. While I sat I did notice an older gentleman popping in and out and directing orders to the guys behind the counter. He should probably lay low and let the shop run during peak hours instead of looking like the "angry owner syndrome". 5 stars for the coffee 5 stars for customer service 5 stars for being an oasis
Pizza OK, but at $22 for a small w/ 2 toppings, overpriced for the product. I'll stick w/ the usual on Wooster St
Excited to have another alternative to all the new haven style pizza places in this area. Excellent crisp but airy crust and fresh mozz.

The food is great! The prices are outrageous! The pizza was very very good as was the salad both house and Caesar.service was fine as is the decor I paid with tip $84 for a medium pizza $16 with 2 toppings($4 each) so $24 for a medium pizza.... Not even in Manhattan!!! A small personal size pizza with 2 toppings 2 salads and 2 beers 1 soda and we split a desert.i guess you pay for quality but family pizza night $84 seems about $20 too high want to come here weekly will probably monthly and without toppings beers and desert to bring the bill down to tolerable Good Luck the neighborhood needed a quality pizza place but ...jeez...

Oyster bloody mary...need I say more??  All of the seafood is good.  French onion soup.  Burger.  Bar steak.  I dream of you duck confit.  This place has been around for a while, but I still think the scene is really good.  Maybe even better now as it's more mellow than scene-y, if you know what I mean. Minor complaint - you will probably wait a bit for your table, even with a reservation.  normally I am happy to wait with a drink at the bar, but last time I was there the bar was packed and only one bartender!  I don't think that's typical though.   If you can ever make it here for breakfast, do it.  Excellent french toast and breadbasket.

Wish I could give this zero stars! One of THEE worst places I have ever been to. 2 fights broke out and that's when we were still on line waiting to get in another fight broke out inside the place. My girlfriend and I where there to meet my brother and his girl so I felt obligated to at least show my face. Any other time I would've left on the spot. I like grown and sexy vibe mature places where people are the to have a civilized good time. This place is the TOTAL opposite super duper ridiculously overcrowded very small space bad music coming out of bad equipment.Bartenders serve you one drink if you order three bcuz they suck and they're trying to serve in some weird everyone gets one drink at a time style and the food is mediocre at best. I will NEVER EVER come anywhere near this place again in my life if you want loud bad music, bad service, crappie bar food, and wanna feel like a sardine in a can this is the place.
A terrible place and super RUDE boss and waiters!!! And Yelp keeps deleting my negative comments on this restaurant. I found many people's bad comments on this were also deleted.

The service at the Pizza Stone is inconsistent.  I would not recommend going if you are in a hurry or starving, their oven does not keep up with demand on a busy night. That said, the pizza is excellent  and they have a great local beer selection.

I went here and had the worst and most ride service I have ever experienced. Most of the people were okay but the kid trying to take my order and the cashier were horrible. Food was average, nothing special and too greasy.

Trovato cercando su tripadvisor alcuni locali consigliati vicini all'albergo in cui mi trovavo, ho scoperto questo locale. Davvero una bella esperienza. Ottimo servizio e hamburger squisito. Prezzo leggermente più alto della media, ma ne vale decisamente la pena. L'hamburger e le patatine sono di una qualità decisamente superiore rispetto ad altre. Consigliato!

Best tapas place in NYC. The choices are great and the service is amazingly efficient so even if you don't have reservation you can still usually get a table after a short wait...The wine selections i also excellent which is not always the case for most tapas restaurants.

Oh my gosh! This place is amazing. I've always been a fan of Boiling Crab in California but this place has them beat. The staff is super friendly, the ambiance is warm with a bar of select beers & spirits that are hard to find elsewhere and the food... AH-FRICKIN-MAZING. Thanks to Jenny & Asa for making our experience so pleasurable & see u soon. As a foodie, this will be a near weekly indulgence. (From Quia & Kira)

hands down the best and freshest seafood in the city. i always come down here located in the Les a little small but i definitely un whine when i come here . i always get shrimp or king crab legs you name it the craw fish is ok also. the special boil sauce is the best sauce invented ever. the thing is its cash only and the atm cost almost 4 dollars to withdraw but the prices are cheap and bayou drink is delicious aw well.

The food is amazing. Service was great, even though there is wait time between different servings. The reason why I am giving 2 stars is the hostess/manager. She was very rude to me and my two friends last night when we asked for a table for 3. There were plenty of free tables, but, nonetheless, she sat us at the bar. We noticed that two tables of 4 were free for the next hour, while we were eating at the bar. We spent $250 and didn't like this treatment and this type of attitude from the lady - hostess/manager. Other than that everything else was great. I hope they find a person that can match the name and quality of the restaurant and not ruin its image. Best.
Delivery took over an hour. Pasta was OK, not much flavor. Garlic Knots are also not memorable. The marinara sauce that comes with it is AWFUL. So watery!!

Love this place and have been there multiple times..  It's a bit crowded, but it's NYC.  Usually have crepes - very good.  Coconut curry shrimp is fantastic.  Great wine selections.  Good service.  Will definitely go back again.

9 years ago when I moved to Vermont this was my favorite sushi haunt. Sadly I have been watching the place go down. The tables are constantly sticky to the touch, the plates are predominantly all chipped and the portions very inconsistent. The sushi is fine, but the establishment is filthy. Forget about eating outside in the summer months, once you order they will forget you are out there. I am thinking that for the younger gen this place might be convenient and fine. For me, I am on the lookout for a "new wonderful sushi place". Its a shame, really that no one there cares enough to say, "hey you know serving your customers on chipped and broken tableware shows a lack of respect for the customers  money".
Moroccan chicken was good but was very put off by waitress and lack of atmosphere she created..

Oh I love the Chicken Cous Cous here. It is definitely my favourite although all the food great. The coffee is not the best but the setting is really cute. Unfortunately the staff are not friendly or helpful. I have had 2 waitresses who seemed far to busy or bored to help my partner and I, even with getting us menus! Such a shame when the food is pretty good.
people keep asking me where to find the most authentic mexican street tacos. this is it! ¡son de poca madre, guey!

The morning of Day 3 brings us back to the Reading Terminal Market. in Philadelphia. I checked on Yelp the night before and was guided to the Dutch Eating Place because of the great reviews. We walked up to look at their menu and a couple was leaving their barstools which would allow the four of us to sit down. They said, "It's fantastic food, but be careful what you order. Everything is huge portions!" That was no understatement. We ordered blueberry pancakes, a side of bacon, a side of sausage, a side of breakfast potatoes, milks for the kids and orange juice for the adults. Our total was $17!!! Let me say the pancakes come three to an order and are the size of hubcaps, literally. They rank up there with some of the best I have ever had. The breakfast potatoes were lightly seasoned with Lawry's season salt. They were perfectly cooked. One of the reviewers on yelp said, "I have a crush: the Amish". I could not agree more!
Stopped for lunch while out and about with wife.  Had an amazing meal and the help was very entertaining.
Food was good and reasonably priced. Entire staff was on their cell phones the entire time I was there. Not very professional, but nice spot overall.

Sam and Charlie make you feel like family. Best pizza in the area. Especially their Sicilian pie. All their other dishes are excellent. Nothing fancy, trendy, or tacky - just good old reliable Italian food. Their Chicken Savoy is almost as good as the Belmont Tavern's. Ask for their specials on weekends. I've been eating here frequently for over 25 years and highly recommend it!
Rotten Child of the Vetri Family
The owner is one of the most rude and obnoxious people you will ever meet!!!  The food is rather bland and this place is tired...
Excellent red sauce joint...1st time you visit get the meatballs!
they charge for the containers. don't do delivery!!

Coffee=5 Service=5 Decor=5 Great little Japanese cafe. Counter service. Nice and relaxing atmosphere with a steady flow of patrons. Very friendly staff and good selection of Omusubi (aka Onigiri). Also, very reasonably priced lunch combos leave you feeling satisfied and and "light" - not uncomfortably full. The desserts are a nice change of pace as well. Japanese Green Tea Chiffon Cake, Green Tea or Black Sesame cookies, etc. The only thing that could make this cafe better would be to have organic options.
Delicious food, great environment. Really authentic Greek seafood. Lamb chops and ribeye steak are delicious as well!
Great Mexican food! Love the chips and salsa, can't stop eating! Fajita was good too!

Great northern china style skewers; ordered the squid, chicken heart, lamb, beef, steamed bun, and fish tofu. This little shop just opened up five days ago. The service is very attentive and quick. The lamb is definitely their best; it's perfectly seasoned and deliciously tender. Also the couple that owns the shop has a lovely back story for opening the place. Well worth the visit!
I came here with my girlfriend and waited longer than 1 hour for them to bring out a couple of omelettes. Very dissatisfied with the service here and would never come back again.
please bring back the sandwiches!!!!

Coffee=5 Service=5 Decor=5 Great little hidden gem in a busy commercial area. Excellent Cappuccinos very smooth... And yes I may be a sucker for the artwork in the froth but it's also an indicator of attention to detail. Once you've had a Cappuccino like this it gives you a greater appreciation and point of reference when compared to the mass-produced, production line, factory - coffee places. French press nicely done. The staff is very friendly and even if you've only been there your second time they make you feel as if you're a long time regular. They make it a point to remember you and your drink preference. Although seating is limited, the rustic decor is inviting and well done. The only thing that could make the coffee better would be an organic option.

Elegant, corporate feeling restaurant due to mid-town location and expense account diners (yes, it's expensive).  We take clients relatively often and I am always happy to eat here for free.  Cocktails are divine, also pretty pricey.

I went a couple times over a girl's weekend trip.  We went for pies, late night food, and a dinner.  All times, all parties were pleased and that is saying a lot, between picky eaters, serious foodies, and diet restrictions everybody ate well!   Some plates were exceptional (beet salad, BBQ dish), some not as good (the calamari was very bland & over fried), but all plates were empty. Service was also exceptional & friendly.  A Also please note photo booth in the basement!

Amazing service, dog friendly and they indeed treated my dog with such respect and love.i really loved it. the waiter,mark, was awesome, so were the hostess, food runner and manager, who came outside (it was cold) to greet us and my dog and brought him treats. great food, excellent fast, good wine selection and price. definitely i will return. awesome food and wine and made my night.glad  i live just a block from them. a sure 5 stars.

Went to a Bahama Breeze in Viriginia and had a great experience. The location in Wayne, NJ however has horrible service. Seated outside, waited 15 minutes and left . No one acknowledged our existence.

Went for brunch with my husband. We were in Philly for a weekend get away. Based on the reviews, I practically ran here. There was a street fair happening and the restaurant was setting up their booth. When we came up to the door, there was no one to meet you. A frazzled manager(possibly) came a few mins later. He showed us to an indoor table and before he sat us down, told us that it would be very slow service due to them being busy and setting up for the street fair. Is that my problem?  No.  We reluctantly sat anyway. Our table was wobbly and the manager? acknowledged this, said it needed to be fixed but never fixed it. We waited a good half hour for the food. I had the stuffed French toast which was ok, nothing to write home about. My husband had the Eggs Nola which he said were very good. Our waitress hustled the whole time and was very good. Overall, the place was just ok in my opinion. And, for out of towers, completely uninviting.
i know my pho. this is the best pho in manhattan. nancy (the owner) knows whats up.

Very clean facility and the gentleman who makes the sandwhichs is very outgoing and professional, and the owner who also puts in the hard work is very nice and makes u feel like family whenever I go in for a delicious sub,  unfortunately there are not enough seats to accually sit down and enjoy this tasty sub but hey eating one of stashs subs on the run is ok with me....

The worst customer service. The male that takes the reservations is the rudest I've ever encountered for a restaurant. I made the reservation several weeks ago. I was flying in from Los Angeles to NY and my son was craving sushi so I found this restaurant on yelp and made a 6pm reservation for last night. The restaurant had apparently called to confirm the reservation but since I was on a flight to NY, they left a message. As I has arrived at 1am, I started calling them at 9am. Called them all day, 6x's. There was no answer and they did not even have an answering machine so couldn't even leave a message to confirm. My 7th time, they finally answered. At this point, it was 4:00pm. The guy on the phone said he had cancelled my reservation since I didn't call back. Told him I was on a flight and that I had tried to call all day. Then he started arguing with me that they are closed during the day and that I should've called yesterday. Tried explaining again the situation and that it wasn't my fault that they don't have an answering machine. I was so upset at this point that I didn't even want to eat at his restaurant. Living in LA, good sushi is easy to come by. But this type of rude and unprofessional  behavior by this sushi place was truly shocking. There is no possible way the sushi is so good for them to have this take it or leave it attitude.

Went to Union League last night and discovered it was a limited, Prix Fixe Menu for Yale Parents Weekend, which was a bit disappointing. Service was attentive, I had 1/2 lobster app which was sweet and tender, a forgettable endive salad and the lamb loin which was so tough I still feel like I'm chewing it. I sent the lamb back and ordered a delicious and tender wild bass. Overall just an okay experience, especially for the price, desserts were very satisfying as well.

Best pizza in Burlington in my opinion. Really nice not too crispy thin crust big slices. Reasonably priced for how much pizza you get. Toppings are all really good quality ingredients, not just plain old whatever. Highly recommend Panacea next time you're craving pizza.

I am not a fan of Ramen by any means, so I was dreading the thought of having to spend money on food I don't even like. Last night's meal though was quite unexpected -- in a good way. It was packed..(duh! It's a Saturday). Waited less than 20 minutes (Shocking, I know!), then seated. The service was attentive, and the ambiance was chill in a so-not-trying way, which I appreciated. Pork buns, tasty. I mean, it's really hard to get pork buns wrong, so I'm glad they didn't. I ordered the Spicy Ramen at my friend's behest. And I found it to be super flavorful. Past experiences have shaped my biased views against Ramen compliments of super oily broths (Michi Ramen @ Austin), too-tough-to-chew chashu (Ramen Tatuya @ Austin), ridiculously salty everything (Daikokuya  @ LA). Goldilocks of Ramen, sure why not...but Ani Ramen was just right for me.  We only ordered one bowl since the servings are massive. Good call since they don't do take out boxes or bowls, which is kinda silly but oh well. I would definitely come back and try their other dishes and maybe comment on those at a later time. Honestly, if you are remotely curious about this place, give it a shot, before it  gets featured on those traveling Foodie shows. After that, who know what the line and wait times will be.

The food was amazing. We came for brunch and shared the Banana Blueberry Pancakes and the Brickyard Benedict with Lump Meat Crab. I was initially disappointed because the crab was mixed in with the spinach, but it was plentiful and so delicious! Every bite was better than the previous. Really was one of the best meals we've had in a long time. And the drink selection is great too.

Love coming here for a meal when I'm craving done delicious Filipino food..  The food is very much like home cooking.. The kare kare was hit or miss for me but that has been the only dish where that was the case. Love that they make their lumpia without meat.  Not sure how but I always walk out with the lumpia and turon!

Greeting- immediate Vibe- I can't believe this place is here Price- good Bathroom- fail Parking- street Service- very good, friendly but server has no clue about the food Wine- byob Food- all portions are huge Fried calamari is awful. Giant frozen cuttlefish rings Gnocchi is not homemade as server said. If I am wrong please let me know. It looks and tastes like the Typical store bought type $21. One portion enough for four people Stuffed hot peppers were not good. What are they stuffed with? Loin veal chop $29 is big and tasty. Served with a huge side of broccoli rabe and a baked potato Cannoli $4 is not good. Stale shell and paste like filling Huge slice of pumpkin pie with vanilla ice cream is good WIGB? Only if I was in the neighborhood. Overall- For this location near the Prudential Center, this might be the only Italian food restaurant selection. If this is so and you go here I would get the entrees and pastas not the apps. They make you feel welcome here. That is why I give it two stars and not one.

Amazing place! Went there with a group of seven without a reservation and were able to be seated right away on a Sunday. Everything from the service to the food was outstanding. This place comes highly recommended from me;)

Came here for dinner with my sister. It was super busy and we had to wait for a table; the waiter was excellent and showed us the menu and took our order so when we finally got a table we only had to wait 5-10 min for our dinner. We go chicken tikka and bhuna lamb - both were great! Best indian food I've found in this area. They are also BYOB! Can't wait to come back
Really good Sichuan cuisine!! So glad that there is finally a typical Chinese restaurant in west hartford. Will definitely come back again and again!
obsessed!
Amazing authentic Italian restaurant in Soho NY. Great spaghetti carbonara and awesome deserts

The best ramen I've ever had (not an expert, but experienced).  The staff there are enough reason to return on their own.  Warm and accommodating.   Try the curry rice as a side dish if you like Japanese curry at all.  It's totally worth it. And I'm Rumpelstiltskin if you don't slurp down the last wash of soup in your bowl!

The Food: If you want to find a spicy and authentic Korea food, you can choose Koreana. When I arrive at Philadelphia, I have heard this restaurant from my friends for a long time. I went to that restaurant with my roommate on Wednesday. We ordered two bowls of Beef Bokeum Bap, six chicken wings and scamper dumplings. The soup has stir fried rice with beef, mix vegetables and spicy broth. I like bean vermicelli in the soup. It is extremely soft. I think people of any age can try this soup. Your stomach can completely full with big portion. However, we ordered other things because we had two people. The fried chicken wings are a bit greasy. Six chicken wings was too much for us. When I ate the third one, I felt a little sick. However, the sauce with chicken wings are very delicious. The sauce is sweet. When I was taste it at the first time, it gave me a special gustation. You will never regret to taste that sauce. Scamper dumplings can be said golden color, distinct levels, but not brittle broken, but not greasy oil, the Krusty palatability. Actually, I didn't like dumplings. However, after eating scamper dumplings, I found there is another delicacy in this world. I have to say Koreana is the best Korea restaurant to visit. The Service: I arrived at the restaurant about seven o'clock. I didn't know why there so was many people waiting outside the restaurant. You should order the dishes in the front of  reception desk. Maybe it leads to a lot people need to think for a long time or discussing with their friends. To tell the truth, the efficiency of a la carte is really slow. There was many empty table available when I entered the restaurant. However, most people in the queue order at the front desk. It will give other people a feeling that a lot of people are waiting. They can't have dinner in a short time. There are few waiters in Koreana. The waiter at the front desk always listen to you patiently. Other waitress will appear when they serving dishes. No one serve you. You should pour away the water and prepare the sauce by yourself. Remember throwing your dishes after eating! The Atmosphere: The restaurant is a little small. If someone want to pour the water, they must stand carefully because they may hit other people table. However, it looks like soft fragrant. Some dishes picture hanging on the wall. When you look at that pictures to eat, you will feel more appetite. There are some tables not only in the restaurant but also outside the restaurant. Although the space is not big, it can accommodate many people. The restroom is small but clean. By the way, the location of Koreana is not easy to find. You should go to the 38th street, go straight for a short distance and then turn right. A little house can be seen on your right hand.
Poor service. And I found a price tag on my curry puffs :( very dissatisfied, I don't understand what's the hype about :(
Tourist trap
Toto Can never compare to ippudo or Jin ramen. Even worse is the attendants' attitude. So disappointed by the food and the staff.

We just took a vacation to Pennsylvania and New Jersey 3 years ago. Several months before we went, my dad was watching The Food Network and saw a show called Meat and Potatoes. On that episode there were three restaurants that were featured. One was a location in Beverly Hills which my parents went to for their chili. My dad was always a sucker for chili. On that same episode was a place in Philadelphia called "Old Original" Nick's Roast Beef. My dad said it looked so good he was ready to hop on a plane himself. This was huge for him to say because he would get airsick. He gave me a print out of Nick's info and said I had to try it. When my dad became very sick, I wanted to cancel our trip. Unfortunately, my dad lost his battle with cancer just two weeks before we left. With my mom's OK, we kept our vacation and my list of must try restaurants. Of course our first stop had to be Nicks! My hubby's cousin picked us up at the airport and we headed straight for Nick's in south Philly. It wasn't in the best of neighborhoods and if it wasn't 9:30pm at night, we may have driven past it. It is a hole in the wall place. We walked past the bar area to the back seating. I don't think there were more than 12 tables total. Then I hear my cousin call out, "It's Joe Frazier!" What??? THE Smokin' Joe Frazier? I explained to my kids this was the man who fought Muhammad Ali in the Thrilla in Manilla. We just read a biography about Ali, so they understood. After meeting Joe and getting photos, we got to business. I always have to get what a restaurant is known for. So in this case it was their Roast Beef Sandwich with Provolone Cheese. I asked for it "overboard" which means they dunk the bottom half of the kaiser roll into the au jus. The sandwich wasn't quite as juicy as I was expecting, although still quite wonderful. One of the kids got their jus on the side, so I dunked my sandwich into their jus...perfect! It was salty and indulgent. The roast beef is slow roasted, sliced thin and piled high. It was tender and delicious. Thanks dad for turning me on to Nick's. It was the perfect way to start our trip!
