thank you to yelp for this find! it was packed- and no wonder - it was delicious. i don't remember what i got but the menu said it was one of the signature dishes - some kind of fish based soup. very unique - but yum!
The paneer makhani was abysmal. The gravy was poorly done and tasted like canned tomato puree. The paneer was like rubber very disappointing

24 - ish taps of absolutely delicious craft beer. I mean the selection is absolutely fucking awesome. If you can find another bar in the area with this kind of selection, please let me know. Because you can't. Awesome seasonals. Awesome hard to find craft beers. Awesome imported sours. The bourbon bacon cheeseburger is excellent. Have had it twice and both times I got full halfway between my meal, but finished it anyway. It was just that good.

Loved it!! Awesome guac, amazing tacos - had the verduras, pescado & camarones- great salsa. This is not a burrito restaurant (ie. tex mex), it's legit. I'm jealous that it's not in my neighborhood, but it's worth the trip. Will be back.

Absolutely horrible this server was amazing however all food items that were purchased from all four people in our party or cold and on tasteful however the pancakes we ordered just to try them due to them having stated having the best pancakes around was true pancakes were amazing everything else horrible beware if you want anything else except for pancakes if you want pancakes!
Yeah! Finally a local fam. restaurant that serves breakfast all day! The fluffy omelets are their specialty and pancakes are outstanding.
The best pancakes in the state is the truth! They move the wait line quickly and you're in and out quickly.

worst Chinese food I had in a long time, they use too much flour in their dishes and the food completely lack taste. the lobster ginger/scallions was dry and again too much flour and chunks of sugar non melted. The flat noodles were socked in some flour sauce and no taste what so ever.

I always order from here when I'm not working and we even order a lot from the police department. This place is the best. Hands down number one. I don't know why they have any negative reviews. They truly are great.

Had planned on going to Mitchell's On The River to find out it is now Shad Row. Great view of the CT River and the car ferry going back and forth to Glastonbury. Food not great. My husband's clam chowder was cold and my clam strips seemed to be fried batter without the clams. Great idea but think they have taken on more than they can chew!!
We had such a great time there last night, loved the food and service.   Will be back soon!!!

For me, the best ramen in the city.  My favorite is the classic.  Akamaru modern (spicy version in red bowl) is great as well.  The other nice thing is that a lot of the other menu items are delish too. if you want something besides noodles or, if like me, your boyfriend says, Ippudo noodles again???  And then he gets chicken wings and ribs while you have your second (fourth?) bowl of noodles in 10 days...
Me and the spouse went here for our 29th wedding anniversary and we both ordered the filet. It was outstanding as was the bread pudding for desert. We will be going back!!!

Definitely hands down one of my favorite places to go either it's a romantic dinner , celebrating a birthday party or just stopping in for a bite at the bar. Jimmy and the rest of the staff are very welcoming. The food is great along with the decor. Once again thank you Jimmy for always making our visit a good one
They don't deliver & online ordering doesn't work. Good food but I must admit not good enough to pick-up on while Eagles vs. giants is on

Locale in centro a Philadelphia, non propriamente messicano, ma comunque molto gradevole. Forse un po' cacofonico. Una birra, un margherita e un appetizer in due (porzione enorme), davvero buono. Ottima opzione. Consigliato!

We had a business dinner at Carmine's back in August and I must say that the wait staff was 100% perfect. They catered to our every needs and didn't miss a step. Kudos to Carmines and there staff. The food was so exceptionally prepared and if you are looking for an authentic Italian restaurant while in New York, Carmine's is definitely a place you don't want to miss.
OMG!  WOW, what a great place!  Get the meat balls!
Awful customer service. So rude!! They made it seem like it was my fault that they gave me a shrimp roll instead of a spring roll. I'm allergic to shrimp!!!

We have had takeout from here a few times.  They do a great job of coming the pizza lightly so that you can reheat it when you get home (for us that's 2 hours).  While nothing compares to eating it fresh out of their oven, it's great that they are accommodating.
Top notch Mexican food in Essex Junction. Very helpful staff. Great atmosphere. Highly recommended.

Went for a late lunch with a party of 13 and the buffet was amazing!! It was our first time here and the service was wonderful and so accommodating for coming in at the end of the lunch hour. Some of us in the party had never experienced Indian food and they left full and happy :) I would definitely come back again and recommend it to friends!

For a loud and lively sports bar - it's really good food guys!!   Everyone said the flank steak was awesome ( I saw it and wish I'd ordered it), the Ribeye - same thing!   I ordered the burger which is definitely better than most places!   I recommend you stop here, whether you are a sports fan or just need a bite when you are staying at a nearby hotel.    Service was good and things were clean and orderly.  No regrets at all and actually glad I came. Enjoy.
Obsessed with this place. Food was amazing ! Service was amazing ! Everyone in the Philadelphia area has to go check this place out ASAP!
Great place to go and grab a burger and beer. Real casual and laid back atmosphere. I have never had a bad meal here, but I usually just go with a burger.

Got a pizza from Juniors for dinner and it was burnt on top and bottom.  How could someone running a business sell someone a pizza in this condition???  When I called and told them about the pizza they simply said I'm sorry.  Never offered to deliver another pizza.  You can be sure I will never buy a pizza again from Junior's and certainly will not recommend them to anyone.

Frozen (salty) seafood atop super wet paella, mandatory tax on tax and gratuity--the groupon "deal" is 100% not worth it. The cost of it ends up being about the same as if you were to buy everything at regular price. The blue sangria was pretty strong. However, the glasses were dirty when we were seated. They warn you that the paella takes 45 minutes to come out and constantly bug you to order appetizers. I wasn't keen. The bread was really dense & yummy/the highlight of the whole experience and the reason for the bump up to 2 stars.
Not worth the long wait...sent back food because it was wrong...Waiter never came back after food drop...hostess took it back...food was OK.
Good food, cheap food.

You see how this is going, right? I see a food joint on TV, drool as I watch and have to eat there. Day 4 of our vacation we are still in Philly and I have to go to Tommy DiNic's which is also at the Reading Terminal Market. As we ate our Miller's Twist breakfast on our first morning, we sat at a table next to DiNic's. Everyone working there was very friendly and said we should come back. Now, let me mention that we did walk by on Day 3 for lunch...but we were beyond hungry and could not handle waiting in the line. So on this day, I was prepared to wait as long as possible for my Roast Pork sandwich with Broccoli Rabe and Provolone cheese. I got in line and waited 30 minutes for my scrumptious sandwich. For me, what makes a perfect sandwich is the roll. DiNic's has their Italian rolls delivered fresh daily from a local bakery. It is crusty on the outside and soft on the inside. The pork is dunked in jus then placed in the roll. The broccoli rabe is slightly bitter and cooked in olive oil and garlic. The nuttiness of the sharp provolone was amazing. I love sharp cheese, the sharper the better, so this was perfect for me but too strong for the hubby.
Creative menu.  Good service.  Long wait.
Ok
It was the perfect meal for a great day. I loved everything about it. The spaghetti was perfect

Just went here to celebrate my parents anniversary. My dad had the ham soup, it was full of flavor and delicious. My mother had the pigeon pea soup, it was good but not as delicious as the ham soup. My husband and I had the tostones with pernil. The portions were very generous. They are BYO-wine which is great. We knew this ahead of time and brought two bottles of sangria with us. For our entrees we had the mofongo with shrimp, mofongo with pernil and the churasco with arroz con gandules. It was all delicious! Now if you are Puerto Rican the arroz con gandules will not compare to your mothers, I recommend the rice and beans. The hospitality was out of this world! The location is nice. They have parking and outdoor seating. The food is reasonably very priced. While we were eating one of the owners came out and greeted us. We told them we were celebrating my parents anniversary and they kindly gave us dessert on the house. I will definitely return to this restaurant with guests and I highly recommend it.

I stopped in here with my hubby for a drink before dinner. I'd been with friends many months ago and remembered a fun cocktail menu. I ordered a martini and he ordered an old fashioned. They were both terrible. The old fashioned was way too sweet and totally watered down. My gin martini had ice in it and way too much citrus. The bartenders were distracted and the service was poor. We won't be back.

My family and I found this hidden gem while we were looking for a place to park and get some breakfast after traveling all day. We loved everything! The space is cute. The food was amazing! The juice and coffee were nice and fresh! We were impressed with Alex, the guy who took our order at the counter, delivered our food to our table, he also cleared other tables and seem to keep the line at the counter moving pretty fast!!! He manage all of these different jobs very efficiently and with a smile and a great personality! When we are in the area again, we will be sure to visit again!!!

The cheesesteaks here are okay, very fat and greasy but bland flavor. I've had better cheesesteaks in South Korea. This place's decorations is too flashy and tries way too hard to be like Las Vegas but is more like a thrift shop light bulb fail. The cheese steaks aren't that good. Also, the policy is also kind of racist. This place should fix up there place and there cheesesteaks. I shouldn't and went and I won't come back. The cheesesteak is also over priced. I live in a condo in Philly and I hate passing by Geno's. It makes me sick and I won't come back.
Great atmosphere, cheap drinks, a jukebox and a good staff. Bartender with hipster frames is great. Great place to get loaded and stumble home

I finally had the chance to try this place out. I've heard nothing but great things and couldn't wait to finally go. I had the steak with coconut rice and it was absolutely delicious. My girlfriend got the shrimp appetizer and empenadas as well and those were both delicious. The atmosphere was great and the music wasn't as loud as I expected it to be. Service was super friendly as well. I definitely cannot wait to go back again.
Great food great service every single time. I have never been disappointed. Worth the wait!! You won't regret waiting!! Stuffed French toast is amazing!!

The new kale salad is fabulous.  I hope they keep it on the menu.  I am not exactly a big salad consumer, but I lapped this one up.  I am, however, researching the calorie and fat content.  I hope the findings are good.  I will have found a winner.

It was recommended by a friend and we came here for lunch, it was good price for the portion.  i ordered the lunch box, had a piece of salmon, fried rice, salad and soup.  The salmon was fresh and it was well cooked.

My boyfriend and I came her for our 5 year anniversary.  This place was recommended by our hotel we were staying at. This place is great the waiters were so friendly the food was incredible and the owner was so friendly and wished us a happy anniversary.  The place is so romantic and cute and comfy. Can't wait to come back here.
Food was completely ordinary, unexceptional, and the noise level was DEAFENING.

Ever since I enjoyed the amazing gourmet cheesecake at Anthony's, I couldn't wait for the day I could return for their Thursday night dinner.  I was NOT disappointed.  The variety of menu choices suited our tastes like a dream.  It wasn't difficult to see that every dish was freshly prepared, and the flavors were remarkably imaginative and well-balanced.  The service was superb; a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere, surrounded by stylish décor.  We were particularly pleased by the glasses made from Mason jars.  The friendly and sociable staff answered all our questions professionally and got our orders to the table without error.  As stuffed as we were, we couldn't pass up the sumptuous dessert menu.  Along with his signature cheesecakes, there was an assortment of cakes and pies.  We were told that his menu is different each week, so we're looking forward to our next visit.

Luv luv luv this place. Food, desserts, and service are 5-star. Butternut squash soup on the Fall menu is out of this world. Cant wait to try the rest of the seasonal menu. Have been abt half a dozen times, and always warm n friendly staff. And i appreciate that!!!

These sandwiches were huge!  I had a spinach sandwich with spinach, mushroom, red onion and melted cheddar cheese and the honey wheat bread was incredible.  It was a bit pricey for a sandwich ($9.25) but the quality of the bread and the size of the sandwich was worth it!
Great Food and presentation

MASSIVE portions but felt incredibly sick afterwards. The restaurant had the feeling that it just couldn't make up it's mind. It's a pretty place with a lot of potential but definitely needs more work. The pasta side dish that came with the meals could be a meal of it's own but you could tell it was from a huge reheated batch
One of my favorite spots. You'll never ever have a bad meal.

THE SPACE IS BEAUTIFUL , the staff IMPECCABLE especially the waitress we had THE HOSTESS IS GREAT Makes the majority of the food from scratch... An of course THE FOOD WAS DELISH ...We ORDERED many items from the menu , my eyes were bigger than my stomach , but brought my care package home to finish the rest .....OH SO YUMMY A MUST
Nothing short of spectacular- effervescent hostesses, the BEST food, and a grocery store.

My friends and I were looking somewhere to relax and have a beer when we stopped by this place. We walked in and no one greeted us which was interesting but we made our way to a table. We waited about 15 mins and not one server came by to take our orders. We were in plain sight of the servers and bartender yet we were continued to be ignored. A couple groups were even served before us and it became apparent that we were not going to be tended in any way so we finally had enough and left. The total lack of customer service was utterly appalling. It will be the first and last time I will visit this establishment.

This place is so bad I made a Yelp account just to share my experience. We came in, ungreeted by employees, so eventually we sat ourselves. One server walked past us multiple times. Despite waving him down, he gave us no attention.  A few other groups walked in after us and received the same lack of service. Meanwhile, management and another server were talking loudly behind the bar about their last night's rated R adventures. Eventually we got tired of waiting (over 20 mins) and left. My only regret is that they didn't have a toilet so that I could defecate in it and leave it unflushed as an equal exchange for their amazing service. In conclusion, I am convinced that it is no coincidence that City Point rhymes with Sh*tty Point.

I sat down with my friends for almost 15 min without any service. Employees watched us sit down, and said nothing to us. As we sat, the employees socialized with each other. New customers walked and they talked to them but still no service.  After the 4th set of customers that sat down after us got served, we just left. I am not sure if the food and drinks are good or not but if this business wants to succeed,  they really need to reevaluate their customer service policy.
The Caliente margarita was excellent! The most unusual nachos ever- the house pickled jalapeños were sweet! But so good and I am so full.
Cheesecake is good!
HUGE, JUICY HAMBURGERS! Good amount of fries with the platter. Root beer floats? Dope as well. Awesome restaurant

Third time to this restaurant, which equates to 15 Stars!!! I have yet to have a bad dish, a bad meal or a bad experience here and I seriously doubt I ever will! Simply the best Italian Restaurant in the area, if not the entire State of NJ. UPDATED REVIEW: Sorry Ristorante Venezia but you lost a star from me for your last performance last weekend. We went with my Mother and Father In Law to celebrate their 55th Wedding Anniversary. I ordered something not on the menu for an appetizer, a plate of Zuppa di Clams. It came and it was salty and just tasted like marinara over some clams. Where was the garlic? This is really what lost you that star... When I asked if the marinara that was served on the clams would be the same marinara that I would be getting served on the plate of Spaghetti and Meatballs that you had as a special last weekend, you need to be honest with me! I told you that I thought it was way too salty and if it was going to be used on my food again, i wanted to make another choice. You lied and said, "NO" the correct answer was YES! You might be able to pull the wool over other people eyes when it comes to Italian Cuisine, but not mine... ever!  I look forward to you redeeming yourself the next time I come! I certainly hope this was a one time deal and just a bad night!

Skip the salads.  Splurge and order the calamari or saganaki. Being a vegetarian, I ordered the papoutsakia, but a friend had the lamb shank which was apparently devine.   Service was fine, nothing spectacular.

We love this place!  They have the world's 2nd best caprihianas.  I say 2nd,  because the one's I make at home are 1st because I use agave instead of sugar.  With that said, the staff is friendly, there is always parking and the salad bar and meats are good in you're in the mood.  If you happen to be there on a night when the dancers are there, you'll really enjoy.  Go and have fun.

Had a first date here. intimate setting and interesting food. We didn't use it as a big dinner, just a first meeting, so the portions were perfect. It was a little small though and I felt rushed by the hostess to leave, even though I was enjoying my date.
loved it

There isn't anything that isn't phenomenal at this place!   The laffa is fabulous and I could eat my weight in that alone. However, being a vegetarian, I thought that the marinated zucchini with hazelnuts was a delightful change and amazing!   I would splurge and get more savory dishes than using the valuable stomach real estate for dessert :)

Wonderfully delicious banh mi! This Vietnamese sandwich is so tasty that we devoured the sandwiches in less than 5 minutes! The store closes at 7, we walked in at 6:56 and the owner still took our order. The pork was marinated so well that it paired perfectly with the crunchy vegetables. They even toast the buns for you! Oh and all of this for less than $5!!! Must try!
This is a great place to eat and enjoy a different Taste, The Gm is awesome !!!!!!

I read the positive reviews and wanted to give it a try. I was very disappointed by the service - extremely slow - and the food quality overall. Some may like it but I didn't have the best experience.
This place is heaven! I come to Philly every year in October and visit this market thru out my entire weekend stay. The cookies, cakes, sandwiches and everything else is jus amazing!!!!!

A fantastic building steeped in American history ... I really wanted this place to be good, or even somewhat close to the mark that the yelp rating would suggest. Sadly it was extremely far from the mark, and to top it off discovering their "C" sanitary rating as we left (it was conveniently hidden behind an umbrella at the bar entrance) punctuated an all round poor experience. Went for a Sunday lunch, I initially ordered the soup and grilled cheese on sourdough, what I got was a cold tomato bisque and cheese melted onto an old hamburger bun. They were kind enough to replace the dish for me as after checking with the kitchen the waiter discovered they had run out of any bread besides the stale buns. Second time around, I ordered the vegetable flatbread. This was equally disappointing. The dough itself was good, but the soggy vegetables and the old, wilted arugula mountain on top of it was neither appealing or tasty and all but a few bites were left on the plate. The two waitstaff that were working, were scurrying around the various seating areas of the historic building and could have definitely done with some more help. The understaffing meant that we were left waiting some time to get our check to leave ... both hungry and disappointed. Hopefully they can get their kitchen, vermin issues, and staffing levels sorted as it has the building itself is worth a visit, but sadly in its current state I would venture to nearby Stone Street to fill the belly.

AWOL (All Walks of Life) cater's too all diets and needs. Perfect for dinner or a late night snack (open till 12 on weekends). Without a doubt, the service is impeccable and the food is spectacular. John, the head chef, has created a unique menu with interesting flavor combinations and a circus of mouth-watering specials. Additionally,every cocktail has  their own wow factor, and better yet, they have a considerable selection of wines and beers. The interior creates a calming and intimate environment of pastels and suppressed illumination. I will definitely come back here again!

Very disappointed in both the meal and the service tonight.  Waited for an hour to get our salad which had wilted lettuce and very little else.  Our main meal included steak tips that were so tough that we had to cut individual small pieces so we could eat them.  Walked away with one of the worst experiences we've had in a long time.

Wow, worth the drive. Friendly service, good breakfast favs, and gigantic portions. Biggest pancakes I've seen since The Royal Canadian Pancake House. We had the 2x2x2. Enough food for two! The short stack is probably enough for 3 or 4.
Chinese here was great. Better than most other places in the area. Everything is super fresh and the restaurant is clean. Will be ordering from here for now on.

Was searching for Dim Sum in area and found Peony Pavillion. Gave it a try and loved it.  Everything tasted as though it was made from scratch.  Have experienced in other restaurants (locally, Hawaii, California) some heated up prepackaged dim sum items. The dim sum items, and we have sampled most of them at Peony, are fresh and delicious.  The wait staff is happy to accommodate and answer any of your questions.  It is a pleasant experience in a very elegant style restaurant.  So happy they opened up in our area.

Ate lunch here today and it was really good.  I had the chicken bacon ranch quesadilla and it was very yummy!  My husband had the chicken caesar salad and said it was good. Portions were a good size for the price.  French fries with garlic aioli were REALLY good. Service was good too.  We'll be back!

In the heart of Williamsburg, this French Bistro is one of the best the city has to offer.  The greatest bouillabaisse I've had in New York.  Lots of garlic in the mussels, which I love.  Wonderful atmosphere and our server was friendly and worked hard to please us.

Service was great, and the food was good. Only drawback is that there are pretty limited options for vegetarians and the kitchen is not very amenable to making substitutions. I recommend the special mojito.

I love their food.  However, the last 4 times I've ordered from here, it has taken over 1 hour and 45 minutes to receive my food.  When it says 30-40 minute delivery time on seamless, I expect it to take 30-40 minutes.  When I call after an hour, I expect the staff to be apologetic, not upset that I'm inquiring about my food.  And most of all when I ask why it still hasn't left the store after an hour and half, I expect a different response than "we're super busy". You're a gyro shop, it takes 10 minutes to prepare at most.  c'mon man.  Hate to say it, but will have to stop ordering from here, even though I love the food.

We had our first visit this past Saturday night and the four of us thoroughly enjoyed our experience. The food, the server; Dan who was terrific, and Albert, who took the time to come over to explain the Bourbon Project, made it a perfect evening. We had the flatbred, the Sushito Peppers were AWESOME!!, the steak, scallops, risotto and veggies...nothing else to say except we're going to go back to experience their Brunch. We left hoping they continue to do well and wish them all great success. P.S, My family lives in Boston and go out frequently...they can be tough to impress....not that they are food critics, but honestly, it was nice to take them somewhere new that they really appreciated.

If it weren't for our jarring experience with service last night, this place would have been without a doubt 5 stars. We've been here before, where food was impeccable, and service blew us away. It was the most chill group of guys and considerate to boot. Realized the mountain of food we ordered and helped us move to a larger table. ----Last night was a complete 180 to shit---- My boyfriend and I wanted to celebrate our last day of vacation with one of our favorite meals. It's hard enough for us to get the same time off with him working chef hours, so this experience was overwhelmingly awful. Along with 2 friends, we were really looking forward to a Bunker blowout 8:45pm, we were told it would 15-20mins for a table. No problem. Guy was nice enough to even point out potential tables that were wrapping up. 45mins later, tables still sitting on their checks, texting, and no one came out to check on us or even offer menus. We continued to wait patiently though, salivating over the idea of food. Around an hour, I finally walk in to ask how much longer since it's nearing 10pm, when they close. Same host guy from earlier meets me, walks out with me, and tells us he's going to take our order now since the kitchen is closing. We're staring dumbstruck at this guy. How does he expect us to order when we haven't even seen menus? Haven't even been offered drinks. So he brings a few menus out, then says nonchalantly and quite impatiently, "you have 4 mins". I've never been more furious and insulted from any dining experience. To have waited patiently and even initiated checking in to be considerate of the kitchen, this was the rudeness we received in return. We were so uncomfortable, that even after waiting for over an hour, we left. It's never been truer in that moment how a place can leave a bad taste in your mouth.

Friends took me here last week for my birthday. It definitely is one of the best pizzas I have ever had. The service is slow, but somehow that's part of your experience. It's a good thing because it's worth the trip out to this area of Brooklyn and waiting for the pizza. The freshest and most delicious pizza. A great experience all-around. The dessert platter was a lot of fun and tasty.

Usually I am not a big fan of Sicilian pizza but now Im a believer.. The service is super fast and friendly and had 3 slices and a drink for under 10 bucks cant beat that!! Don't waste your time or money on the regular slices stick to the square pie!

Never had a bad time at McGillins! Love it's old-timey charm and the variety of beers on tap. Food isn't bad either. Took away one star as it can get crowded and hot on weekends. And most importantly, the bathrooms aren't gross!
Great for what it is--a diner-like breakfast and lunch place. I got the check in deal and it was phenomenal!
This is the best.  Lobster 4lb was on point, cooked just right. Seafood Paella was the best I ever had on the east coast.  You just have to try.

Food was amazing but the portions are slightly smaller than what I was expecting but filling nevertheless. I usually order bluepoints but the waiter quickly referred me to a list of different kinds of oysters that she considered to be better and I was not disappointed. Love the intimate atmosphere of this restaurant.
stopped by for breakfast the other day, got myself french toast with scrambeled eggs and it had an amazing taste to it. can i just say the service was fast and great for a busy morning.
Great breakfast spot. Very convenient and the best pancakes I have ever had. They have 2 tables in the back.   It's usually crowded, but the wait goes by pretty fast.

Last night, I showed up to the pick up window, hoping to order a pie to take home. I truly wanted something quick like one of your unique mustard pies (very unique flavor). However, it was 7:45 on a Sunday and I guess that this is considered "too late" for you guys because I was told that I would not be able to order anything to go. Very disappointing. I had to settle for Pizza-Grille which was actually very pleasing, especially since they were still opened. I know that you guys offer more than pies, but come on. You truly should be opened for people that may not want a sit down meal or an early bird specials take out. And really, I was there prior to the closing time stated by the young girl who greeted me. As the son of a businessman who would have us open up the register for late comers, I was surprised that a simple order would not be granted to a customer minutes before closing time. Will not visit again.

charming location and decor but the food was average. I was not impressed by the meat, i did not even finish my dishes. It's not worth the price at all. They only had one server for the entire restaurant who was very friendly but not quick. I could see a supervisor (or owner) roaming but he would not get in to help when I was clearly tying to get someone to pay for the bill. i would not recommend and most likely not return.

Ok, so first of all, I am a restaurant lover, me and my girlfriend went to this place on a Saturday night, we had 6:30pm reservations. The area around the restaurant is hard to find parking but there is a parking lot for about $10. I got there first and my friend was stuck intraffic, they kindly accomodated us and held our reservation until she arrived, I requested a window seat and we still got it. I have to say this will be the place I use for my birthday celebration. Alex was our waitress and when I tell you she was outstanding, there was never a time when I wanted or needed something that she was not right there either asking us if we were ok or recommeding what she thought was good. I had arepas, which I never had before for appetizers, and they were excellent. Then we had the frozen sangrias and the frozen sangritas and they were also excellent. Then for our main course we had the pernil and my friend had a chicken dish, both were so good we didnt even need a doggie bag. I have to give a special shout out to Lance, whom I spoke to on the phone and he was just as fine and pleasant in person, these employees make any restaurant experience outstanding, more places need to hire help like them. I cant say enough good things about this place. We never felt rushed to leave even as the place got more packed as the night went on. My friend loves dessert and so she had molten cake with icecream and I usually dont do dessert, it was outstanding. We both cleaned that plate! The view was also a highlight of this restaurant, after dinner we went outside and took pictures of the view of nyc. Great night and I will be there again.
Muy buena la comida, pedimos 3 platos y todos súper ricos, recomiendo la quinoa veggie burger.
Great food and good service. Best veggie burger ive tried in my life and im not even a vegetarian. Steak sandwich was also delicious and the smashed platane with shrimp was aldo good

Was told the wait would be about a half hour and waited over an hour. I finally went to ask when it would be ready and the girl couldn't find my ticket. We ended up having to get it to go because it was time to put our baby to bed. The waiting area was jammed packed with annoyed customers. The food was also over priced for the quality in my opinion. I feel bad, they were kind and I guess lost a cook but they should have been upfront with the wait time because honestly waiting over am hour for take out is crazy.

We chose this place because of their Yelp reviews because we are out of towners. We were lucky to come on a Monday morning as seating is very limited. I had the protein sandwich- egg whites, turkey bacon and greens (broccoli rabe!!) with Swiss on toast. So delicious- I'll be disappointed when my next breakfast sandwiches don't have broccoli rabe. We had a side order of the homemade tots and they were wonderful. As we were waiting for our food we kept checking out the menu and decided to get a hoagie to go for lunch later in the day. This is only our second time visiting Philly- but we will be back here when we visit again!

Great price fast delivery we had the diced chicken with peppers , plantain, crab ragoon. ...we spend 4 months a year in Mainland China this is as close as it gets to ordering it in China great job...Terry
Amazing soups and baked goods. You can't tell it's a gluten free menu. They really know their stuff!

Always packed, so plan to spend about an hour waiting. The price and quality of the food is superb, the staff is very friendly. Downsides: always packed, so few laps around to find a parking spot, very loud inside, a lot of people around you, no tap beer, only bottled imports. Upsides: no dishes above 15$ (maybe one or two), large portions, delicious.
so good Sashimi ，I like fishjaw and big uni

Love, Love, Love Luna!!! The wood fired pizza was fresh, crisp and wonderful! The "Shrimp Balls" were surreal! Must try! The lemon vinaigrette on the Arugula Salad, with Prosciutto and fresh Mozzarella was addicting...the bar is gorgeous and had the best Bay Breeze ever! The front doors, slide open, so on a beautiful fall day or evening you feel like you are dining al fresco....can't wait to go back!
This is the first time I was charged a $2 'To Go' fee and to add to that the food and the service isn't even good.
The best Banh Mi in Burlington! We stopped there after having our sins absolved by walking through the holy door at the Notre Dame Basilica in Quebec City. The sandwiches filled the void nicely.

Wow, so so disappointed. Went here because there was a lot of good reviews... Ordered a club salad for carry out and it was the size of maybe a side salad and was the quality of a side salad as well. Oh yeah and no plasticware, so for an out of towner... Keep away.
Love this place!  Never disappoints!  Great food and great service!

It took us 3 weeks to make a reservation but it was well worth the wait. If you decide to come please do not eat 4 to 5 hours before otherwise you will be miserable that you were not able to enjoy all of the 15 courses. It is also BYOB which was awesome but again don't over do it and get hammered or you will not remember what an amazing time you had. The food just kept coming out and every plate was just as great as the last. If this place was in New York City it would make a fortune.

I wanted to like this place so much. In the end I liked pretty much nothing about it. The ambiance was confusing. It was not intimate, too brightly lit, and playing a music and a movie that seemed confused with their food. The food. I liked nothing about the food. Autumn Wraps--a nice concept, but nothing stuck out in their flavor. We had to add a lot of hot sauce. The Chicken Wings--they felt almost rubbery to me. They needed to be crispier, or saucier. The sauce was thin and the skin left a lot to be desired. The Cabbage/Mustard Greens. These felt overly oiled. I could tell they had been cooked haphazardly in a wok and tasted just of vinegar. The tofu on top was so fried that it became almost empty inside. The Pork Belly. The meat on this dish was so overcooked I was shocked my companion could stand it. I had one piece, with fat an inch thick and that was enough for me. I was also stunned that there was not actually pho on the menu. The sake was fine. Best part of the meal. It also felt so expensive for where it is--this dodgy corner in Bushwick. I will not be going back.

somewhat disappointing dinner. nice ambience and design of the restaurant, but: Sushi dishes are overpriced (28$ for an 8-piece futomaki role? Surely you jest), which drove us towards the "bowls" with set menu. fried pork or chicken over a lot of rice... Really nothing more than just OK. Misu soup on the side was good, egg custard dish  was interesting as a curious. Nice presentation of dishes but left us unimpressed in terms of taste, texture, etc. disappointed to see that nothing of the subtleness and minimalist approach of Japanese cuisine came through these dishes... Service tried but could not make up for the rest.
Great food and service! One of my favorite spots in Glastonbury.

Service & ambiance was awesome. I had wished that I asked for our servers name so I could personally mention her here. She was so helpful, timely, polite and pleasant. Actually, every staff member that we came in contact with was genuine and helpful.  Food was fresh and awesome. Best burger! Drink was fabulous. Prices were perfect.  Keep it up!

This place was great! I would highly recommend to anyone visiting the Hell's Kitchen area of New York City visit this restaurant. The food was amazing the atmosphere was great and the staff was very friendly treat yourself and check it out!

Simply the best pepperoni pizza around. Great crust and generous toppings. I have been loving their pies for years and will continue to do so. Do yourself a favor and just go. Also the side salad is big enough for 2 people to share.
Love this place!  Wonderful food and drinks!

Great pizza, and even better service.  My husband and I ordered delivery to our hotel while on vacation.  The pizza came quickly, the delivery guy was EXTREMELY nice and the pizza was delicious - they even brought plates and extra napkins.
Best ramen I had in NYC! Wait is kind of ridiculously long most of the time..but completely worth it!

Came in for lunch today, Easy on the wallet(cash only) pleasant on the belly. been here three times in four weeks, each time food came out quick.  Their team is fast and efficient, slightly difficult to deal with when you're coming after a hangover.   Food is good, I prefer their breakfast items, seems like this place was built to turn and burn.   Friendly staff in this french inspired bistro.  Bottom line, nothing stands out of the menu but worth the locals coming back.   Clean.

If you are in the downtown Montclair area and looking for good eats this is definitely worth the stop. Before eating at Spice I wasn't the biggest fan of Thai food. I must say that this has changed. The talapia w/ a mango salad dish is one of the best on the menu. It was filled with robust flavors and the fish was cooked to perfection. Nothing much to complain about, highly recommend it.

Went here today for the first time to get some frozen dumplings home. The shop is actually super tiny and even though it was pretty cold outside one so I walked inside it was super hot because of all the cooking and the tiny crowded space. They don't really have a whole lot upsetting actually so is more like a grab and go type of deal. It is super cheap. I got 100 chive dumplings to take home with for 18 bucks. Cook them when I got back home with some pumpkin soup and it was absolutely delicious. Totally will come back whenever I'm around the area.

probably the worst dinner experience. the restaurant was empty when we walked in yet they still made us wait 20 minutes for a table because they said they were under staffed and wanted us to have the best service. that back fired. it took another 20 minutes just to get our drinks, after all that they forgot one persons steak. we were all finished eating and the last meal finally came out.

My wife was craving some Japanese ramen after a long weekend of partying in the city. My friends and I decided to stop by for lunch.  I must say that I have never been to a "Japanese" restaurant that offered store bought Korean Shin Ramen that passed it off as Japanese ramen. 10.95 for some  ? Seriously??! The owners of this restaurant ought to be ashamed of themselves. AT LEAST advertise it for what it actually is: cup noodles. That can be made by a five year-old. On a lighter note, I do admit their sushi was decent. So two stars it is. Arigato, but Sayonara.
Friendly casual and very authentic thai. Young peppercorn is really good. Quick lunch service.

Although I generally like the food at the Capital Grille, I have two complaints. (1) my boyfriend and I have been to the restaurant multiple times and the waiter always asks, "have you dined with us before?"  They really should be tracking this.  (2) The waiter always addressed my boyfriend and I as "Mr. and Mrs.....)   Very clumsy and silly to assume that any two people dining together are married.  Wake up, it's 2014.
This is good. The vegetagles are pretty fresh.

Super good. That's literally what I thought while eating their specialty ramen (the one with squid ink noodles) Best ramen I've ever had in my life. I was lucky so the wait was 5 minutes, I'm not sure if it's worth the usual 2 hour wait though, but anything under an hour would be good enough for me. I highly reccomend this place!

I have eaten at Beyoglu more times than i can count, and it is consistently a 5 star restaurant. I think the best way to dine here is to share a bunch of mezzes but never skip out on the hummus or barbounia pilaki. Also, be sure to ask the waiter for the mezze special of the evening, if it's the zucchini pancake make sure you get two orders,  you'll thank me later.

Went in on Sunday not knowing that their brunch menu only had 6 items.  It was very difficult to accommodate our one guests who is gluten-free AND vegan, although they tried. She ended up getting some vegetable concoction made up by the kitchen--there wasn't even a salad option in the 6 menu items.  Among the rest of us, we had mussels frittes (small mussels, small portion), the brunch burger (meat and bread smothered in maple syrup), chicken confit hash (no chicken, small crock of potatoes), and a side of sliced strawberries for the baby.  Food was not impressive, and for $80 for brunch with no cocktails, I'm not willing to find out what C&P has is store for dinner.

What a perfect Sunday brunch!  Myself and 3 girlfriends arrived a bit early, so we  had the place to ourselves for a little while.  The service was great and we even got to meet Chef Warren Baird, who could not have been more gracious.  I had the Duck Hash, which apparently changes with the season and had just been updated with celery root and squash for fall - fantastic!  Buttermilk biscuits shared by the table were a huge hit with a honey flavored spread.  All of my dining companions enjoyed their meals.  Topping it off were well-made Bloody Marys.  I will definitely be coming back for dinner the next time I'm in the City.

Meant to be a NYC classic, I unfortunately did not think this was the finest example of NYC's best pizza to an out-of-towner.  The pizza was good, solid really, but not outstanding.  It did the trick, and will impress anyone who is from Asia (where good pizza is extremely rare, if non-existent), but the ingredients don't exactly sing and the crust is a bit too thick for my personal tastes.  Also had a calzone - that was very very filling

I went here a few nights ago on a date, and it was probably one of the best dining experiences I've ever had. Here's why: As soon as we entered, the restaurant had a really great vibe to it. We greeted and quickly seated, which soon after we were greeted by our sever Kat G. Who placed a bottle of both spring water & sparkling water, and gave us a head start by telling us whatever menu specials there were for the day, and the highlights of the menu. We had asked her which steak she liked best, and stated that she was vegetarian, but was still able to provide us with the best options possible--which was great. Whenever she attended to us, she worked in a timely manner, and never showed frustration in any way. I had only one mishap while we were on our date and that was that I ordered my NY strip medium, it came out a little too bloody for me. Kat immediately apologized (even though I think it was my fault for not ordering it medium well as I usually do) and said she would have them cook it for me a little longer. When it was brought back out, the steak look like it had been cooked extremely well done, and when I told her she apologized. I had realized as I had cut deeper into the steak, the kitchen had in fact cooked it to medium well, it was just the outside of the steak that was charred. About two seconds after that, a gentleman passed by our table asking how everything was and had heard that my steak had been ruined (obviously, this was one of the many managers that I had seen during my visit running around and making sure everything was being ran in a smooth manner). The fact that I had both my server and a manager assure that I was receiving the best possible service made my dining experience amazing. They didn't waste a minute on making sure I was being tended to. In addition to all of this, as my date and I were leaving Kat said she had some cookies being bagged up for to-go for us as an apology for everything (unfortunately, we forgot them). She's a great server. I would definitely come back to visit again!
Great empanadas! The prices were good and the taste was unbelievable!  Just wish the location was bigger.
Everything is 100% w o n d e r f u l !! I will  be coming back

We have just dined at Frere de Lys, what a wonderful experience in NY and a great find for UES. We are visiting from Australia. The meals were excellent my husband had the salmon and I the chicken, beautiful flavours, what a delightful restaurant, the decor is simple but beautiful so enhances the AMBIENCE, the personalities of these two young men running this restaurant make it a memorable dining experience.

I ordered delivery and they said it would take 30-45 minutes. An hour and 25 minutes later our pizza came with all the cheese shifted to the left of the pizza and it was cold. The French fries were even colder than the pizza. I can't even tell you how it tasted because it was like rubber when we reheated. We will not be ordering from here again.

This restaurant is really great. Fantastic tacos. Once I has the fish tacos (very fresh and light with lots of flavor) and once I had the pork tacos (also flavorful and more filling then the fish tacos). We shared a steak quesadilla as an app, which was OK. Drinks were really good with lots of alcohol. Our server was very attentive and very friendly.
Great wings for a good price. I like the variety of flavors. The place is also looked really clean which I appreciate.
Best burger I've ever had! Cooked perfectly and HUMONGOUS!!! Definitely big enough to share, but too good to let anyone have any =)

LIAM! LIAM!  LIAM!  Best waiter around!  Becco! Becco! Becco!  Best pasta deal in the city!  And did I mention the meatballs are to die for!  Gotta go back soon! We had a spectacular Caesar salad, wonderful wine, and the home made cannolis are a must if you are lucky to be there on a night that they are made!  We went on a a Sunday!  Ask to sit at Liam's station and you will NEVER be disappointed!  He will definitely go far!  I can see him becoming a maître d someday.
Tried the lobster roll and fried clam strips and fries. I actually really liked the fries, and I'm not usually a fan of fried things.
I travel a lot for business, and when I am in the Hartford area, I try to stop by the King and I.  Excellent home-cooked food; really enjoy the family atmosphere.
Great food.  Go hungry
Great atmosphere, wonderful food!

Like every person on here, want to love it but can not due to the rudest staff and Owner ever. I try never to be negative but can be nothing but after a 3rd time of being treated like Crap by not only the staff but the owner herself. Tonight 10/13/14, Five of  of us drove 40 minutes to eat here because the food is not half bad. We arrived at 8:35 when they close at 9:00 and a young man with black hair could not have been ruder because he wanted to close up early. Not only did he basically throw our plates and food down but continued to stare akwardly at us all trying to rush us out of there. Not how you want to spend $100. I would write this off if a very similar experience did not occur with the owner a few months back. I hope people stop going here just because of the fact that their are plenty of businesses out there that would die for your money and provide great service. I do not think that this overpriced restaurant  should be so rude to the ones that support them.

Great spot for a date or small groups ... for 3 or less, I recommend sitting at the bar as the chef's sometimes have amuse bouche on offer. Make sure you grab a bottle of wine before you get there - it is BYOB and corkage for your first bottle is nada. Best value sushi restaurant for the quality, especially if you hit up happy hour. Note that they do not take reservations on Friday or Saturday nights.

I see a few reviews about the terrible service and that is why I am giving it a 1 star.  Let me start by saying I have ordered from here countless times, always takeout.  The food is decent (we always get lunch specials) which is why we come back.  The service is atrocious though.   There were a few times where the server/host was rude to me early on but I was not sure if she meant to be.  It almost seemed as though she did not have manners like people do in the United States and that she didnt realize what she was doing was rude.  They don't treat you like people and come off as not caring about their customers. Also, the food always takes a long time to prepare.  Even though it says online when you order that it will take 10-30 minutes, it almost always takes at least 45 minutes.  When I usually get there 30 minutes after, they order me to sit down in a corner.  They are never apologetic if the food takes too long.   The last time that I went there will be the last.  I arrived 45 minutes after the order placed because they are never on time with takeout.  I get there and she realizes after 10 minutes that she gave my order to someone else.  The guy that took it called them on the phone to tell them that he had a wrong order and the server wanted to then have him bring it back and have me take it.  I wouldnt do that and asked her to make new food for us.  20 minutes later I got the new food.  She still charged me the full amount and even though she apologized, it still came off as inconsiderate.  Obviously they do not put much effort in and dont check the take out orders closely.   I could find countless other thai restaurants to eat at and I am going to call it quits with this place as should you.

SO DISAPPOINTED. NEVER HAVE A BIRTHDAY HERE. REALLY wanted to love this place! :( I had dinner at forrest point 2 weeks ago, and the week later was my friend and I's birthday, and we thought it would be a cute spot to have our bday gathering. The manager that night was coming over to all of the tables, and when she got to ours I asked her if she thought it would be a good idea to have our bday there-I explained that it would be a big group, about 20-25 people for drinks- not dinner, and maybe some snacks. She replied with great enthusiasm and acted excited for us to be coming back the following week. She then took my contact info down to call me to confirm. She called me the following friday, the day before the party, and I actually stopped by because I was in the area. I asked her again if it would be good for around 25 people, and she replied again in a cheerful, enthusiastic way- and even HUGGED me! I told her it would be around 10 PM. (the manager's name was Danielle Btw) She said they would reserve the back lounge area, and the back table- so between those 2 areas and the bar, it would be a great, laid back vibe for the birthday party. Everything seemed great! The night of the Bday, some of the guests showed up early, around 9:45, and took the back table that was reserved for us. When the rest of us got there, around 10/10:15, the manager/host had all the rest of my guests stand near the doorway, telling us there was some kind of "mix up". I didn't understand, and saw that the back area was still empty, some of my guests were at the table, and the bar was fairly empty. The manager, now a dude, not the original manager I spoke to, told us that another party "lied to " him( ?). I got really upset because I had people standing near the doorway awkwardly and were treated like we weren't supposed to be there. After they kept telling us to wait, I just told the rest of my party to go to a nearby bar instead. After many people left, he then told me he was sorry and that it was a misunderstanding- he didn't know that the people there already were part of my party. He claimed that they had said a different name for the reservation- but I don't know who or why they would say another name, when they were my friends and i was the one who made the reservation. He also said they had the reservation down as a different name. He also told me that we showed up late. Just basically a bunch of excuses. After waiting a while for the people who were there to finish up and settle their existing tab, the manager then offered to buy us a round and told us to stay, that he would accommodate our group, but by that point half the people had already left. I got really stressed out and this totally ruined the night for me. They missed out on 30 people's business that night, and almost entirely ruined my birthday if it wasn't for cheap neighborhood bar being a few blocks away. And for the previous week, the food- despite being tasty- was really expensive for such small portions anyway, I don't think I'll ever return.

Will never go back!!!  The Hostess at the front was horrible.  She was unorganized, unfriendly, rude and downright nasty.  She had our table of five walk around the restauarant with her to be seated only to decide she wasn't sure where to "put" us and  had us go back to the front.  Then she proceeded to seat other people as they came in. We waited again to be seated.  We were made to feel very unwelcomed. My main reason to give such a poor review, is that my sister, who is battling ovarian cancer and chose this restaurant for her birthday dinner that night, got up to use the ladies room.  The hostess followed her into the stall area and told her this is the ladies room, not the men's room.  Her hair is very short because of chemo treatments, but she is clearly a lady and when she said something to this Hostess, she said I only saw you out of the corrner of my eye. Not only did she see her prior to our seating fiasco, she was laughing about it afterwards with another employee.   This Hostess needs to go for sensitivity training and learn how to treat people.  She never apologized and when we said something to the manager that night, she said she would speak to her, but we were told that was her daughter.  I believe this is a direct reflection on the way the restaurant is choosing to run their business and we will never go back.   On a side note, our waitress was very nice and was so sorry for the way the Hostess treated us.   ALSO THIS IS NOT AN ORIGINAL CHOWDER POT and NOT ASSOCIATED WITH THE CHOWDER POT OF BRANFORD, CT  THEY SOLD THE BUSINESS TWO YEARS AGO AND THEY ARE STILL USING THE NAME!!
the chicken over rice is my addiction. not everyone makes it the same but this spot adds a great taste to the chicken, deff would go back.
Can't beat this place for a hand drawn noodle soup!  2 of us eat for under $20 every time. A Must try.
We went for drinks and appetizers...Daniel, the bartender, introduced us to cocktails/drinks that were delicious..we definitely will be back for dinner!

Okay, so the vegan vanilla soft serve brought me here and the rude überhip barista will prevent me from ever returning. The entire place was throbbing with a you-don't-belong-here vibe as soon as my girlfriend and I walked in. Like everyone looked up from reading their Ginsberg and writing their screenplays to give us the stink-eye. Our Ray-Bans and plaid shirts weren't on properly, apparently. Like, I don't think anyone should be rude ever, let alone if you're working. The soft serve was good, though. But, I think I'd rather drive to Bethlehem, PA to go to Vegan Treats than to return here. Other than some decent vegan options it's a pretty generic coffee shop.

Wow just wow! From the signature cocktails to the hummus... Must try the thyme salad, lamb & Brussel sprouts! Wine selection is beautiful! Our server is the absolute best I have had in a long time! Ask for April she will recommend everything that you need! Feeling blessed to have discovered such an incredible restaurant~*~
Good coffee! We took a little break from walking around. 100times better than Starbucks!

Th food is great here, I love the burger and grilled cheese. The owner, Chris, is very nice and always smiling. The place looks great, I feel so comfortable sitting and eating there. The restaurant stands out, finally a trendy place to eat in my neighborhood.

Came here for a quick bite after work, I ordered a burger and fries. My burger was okay, the fries were no so great half of them were burn. Service was not so great! The waiter was no where to be found even if the seating was nearly empty.

Have only been here for dinner, and enjoyed it every time. It is always fresh, the staff are friendly, and it has a great ambience. It's a small spot so expect a little bit of a wait if you don't have a reservation - but it will be worth it. Would recommend the BBQ squid app, the sashimi is always great, and the 2000's house special rolls are worth trying.

Absolutely delicious authentic Greek food and drink, warm, attentive service and a very nice ambiance. The meatballs are a must. The octopus was amazing. The retsina is delicious. Go, and take a friend!

This place is pretty legit. I would be here all the time if I lived in NYC! The food:  I had the Camarones Cuzco which was good but pretty rich.  My boyfriend had the Lomo Saltado which looked good but I did not get a taste because he ate it too fast! I would definitely recommend the tres leches cake if you are in the mood for dessert.
Love Brooklyn Crab. Bring some good friends, have a few drinks, and enjoy the food. Satisfaction always guaranteed.
Best burger we've ever had, pickle plate was okay, fries amaze and eggplant salad ridiculous....can't wait to go back!!!

Learned about Sonny's asking the locals for best Cheese Steak Sandwiches in downtown Philly. It surpassed our expectations - had to get one more sandwich for the road! Very friendly attention, staff appeared genuinely happy to have us as customers and tend to our needs. Highly recommended.

Can I just say delicious! Do not think twice of going to this place. Top notch service to compliment their awesome playlist of music to the suburb food they serve. I ordered the Re di Permo pizza which was delicious and my cousin ordered the tortellini. Let me tell you that once small bite of the tortellini, it took be back to Italy. The last time I went to Italy was over five years ago and the tortellini dish literally took me back, something that no other Italian dish has done thus far. The decor of the place is super cute, a rustic yet modern look. My only let down was the types of glass given for the wines. Not your typical wine glass rather a glass meant for what could been a beer sample flight. Other than that great place !!!!!!

Came in here while waiting for the taping of the Daily Show. The staff are very friendly, the place is clean, the prices cheap and the food is good. We had the Retro Burger and the grilled chicken. Both came quickly and were good for the price. Happy hour specials are on before the show $1 off draft beer, wine and well drinks. Great place to kill a couple hours.

I love Americana, their food is amazing. The food has definitely gone up in price the past few years because they made the diner more "classy". Their fresh squeezed orange juice is INCREDIBLE, I definitely recommend it. The hosts are always very kind and get you seated very promptly but the waiters are sometimes very rude and don't seem to care- but of course that's only some. They get very busy on Sunday mornings. Although it is pricey for a diner it definitely is the best in the area.

We always came here on the weekend for Dim Sum, they had a good variety and food was fresh.  However, i came in this time for dinner on a weekday.  The fish did not smell fresh at all and the service was terrible!  Not recommended on a weekday!!!

I have to give this place one star based on a major glitch by our server.  On a better night, I can see this place attaining as many as 3 stars!  So, I'll start with the worst:  the server completely screwed up our bill.  She split it 3 ways, instead of following the very neat directions written on our bill. She just split the check 3 ways because there were three cards.  Upon realizing her mistake, she cancelled it out, and swiped our cards again--without telling us.  So, we had transactions for nearly $100 instead of the $50 of our individual meal + drinks.  And it took nearly a WEEK for that charge to be reimbursed.   The food/service otherwise:  I came here for a dinner with four friends.  We came straight after work--6:30--so we had no problem getting a table.  The place is quite small, and it is crammed with tables.  We were so close to the couple on a date next to us, that the couple just jumped in our conversation.   The drinks were OK, but some of the prices seemed a little off for the "casualness" of the place.  For example, $10 for a smallish container of guacamole.  Plus, they don't give you enough chips... and then they charge you EXTRA for chips (not to mention a server spilled water all over us--and our chips.  Making some of the chips soggy...) The food was ok--nothing special, but totally edible (hence why it would get 3 stars on a better night).

The food wasn't bad, but it also wasn't the best food I have ever had. I'm giving it two stars because it was insanely over priced. Although food in Brooklyn is expensive a lot of the time, I felt like this meal was especially outrageous. It cost me 17.00 for a muffin, a small sandwich, and a small orange juice.

Terrible service, terrible food.  Had the two petite bacon wrapped filets.  One of the two petite filets was really bad.  Tasted spoiled.  I had already eaten the first, which was okay. Had I started on the bad one first, I would have immediately left.  The waiter/bartender was a bit defensive.  Had he tasted the filet, I am sure that he would have apologized. Yuck!!!!

I really like supporting black owned businesses, especially here in Harlem. I'd go back if they worked on the adjusting the prices or the serving sizes. $20 for brunch is okay if the plates are shareable or pretty large in size. They're not -- beware! You won't leave hungry but you won't leave happy either. Also, the service, while extremely friendly and warm, was a bit slow, if you're in a rush, better try another spot.
The waitress was really stupid. She kept telling that we gave the wrong tip. But the truth is she forgot we had the bill spilt and she didn't double the tip. The beef tongue was pretty good though.
Fabulous place for brunch.

The bald head cashier is rude and inappropriate!! i had never been to this establishment before but it was recommended to me by a good friend. I walked up and ordered my food then took a seat nearby. About 30 seconds later (as im textin) the cashier yells "thats your total!" My eyes which were focused on my phone screen went immediately to him and I sat there surprised for a minute until i scanned the area for the register that read $15.79 so i replied "excuse me" and he goes "what? thats too much".... ill never buy anything else from here EVER
well priced and good food.   and good service...had a perfect outdoor dinner.
I love this place!!! The crawfish and drinks are great. I also love the atmosphere here. The staffs are super friendly and helpful. There are alway a long waiting line but it move pretty fast.

After hearing my friends recount the breakfasts they ate while visiting Japan recently, I decided I needed a Japanese breakfast today.  Okonomi did not disappoint.   The basics of the meal are brown rice topped with seasoning, soup, and broiled fish accompanied with a few sides.  Today's fish were ocean perch and bluefish.  It's prime bluefish season in New York and I'd had the perch before, so I chose the former.  It was mildly marinated and perfectly grilled - delicious.  It is a strong-flavored fish, but I love these kinds of fish.  For my rice, I added uni, which was lightly dressed, in addition to regular topping and it was a great foil to the bluefish.   All-in-all, Yuji and team knocked it out of the park again.

Came in the try a Kangaroo burger because who wouldn't!? Service is good. Quick and friendly. Even the owner came out to greet us and check up on us. The drinks during happy hour are cheap, delicious, and STRONG. The koala burger was only average. Kangaroo meat is dry (I'm assuming) and the burger was a mess. The beet was too juicy and it fell apart in my hands. The don't cook it past medium rare because it's super lean and would definitely crumble but I'm not a fan of anything above medium rare. It is a bit pricey but you're paying more for the experience and opportunity to try kangaroo meat. Would definitely come back for the experience but wouldn't order a kangaroo burger or anything kangaroo.

It takes a lot for me to write a terrible review for a restaurant but I feel obligated to in this situation given the awful experience that we had here with the owner, Robin. My wife and I came here for Sunday brunch with our 3 year old daughter. We arrived at 10am right when the doors opened but she would not seat us because we were waiting for our 4th person.  Keep in mind that I am carrying a 3 yr old and that a table for 3 is the same as a table for 4.  She said it's because she wouldn't be able to turn the table as quickly and the waiter would have to come over more times.  I would have left right there and then but our friend wanted to meet us there.  She came 2 minutes afterwards. Now, Robin's argument about turning a table quicker may have had some merit (although bad customer service) if a waiter even bothered to come by and bring us menus.  I had to flag someone down and then they had to assign a waiter to us.  I ordered pancakes for my daughter and asked the waiter to bring them as soon as they were ready.  More than 15 minutes go by and nothing. Robin then comes over with a pancake and offers it to my kid.  I thought how nice...she's trying to make up for before when she had told me to stop being "flip" about the table.  Not the case....after a mediocre meal with bad service she had the balls to charge us $1 for the pancake!  The woman at the register asked me if our meal was alright at the end and she didn't bother to ask why when I said no. It does not end there!  I called Robin to speak with her about our experience and she apologized that it wasn't a fit, not taking any responsibility and preceded to defend everything that they did and then said that we left the table a mess.  We have a three year old....if you are not a family friendly restaurant then you should say so.  I told Robin to send me that $1.  She said she would and I promised that I would write that in here.  It never came. Bottom line:  awful service, mediocre food, and an unstable owner.
Great wings and good service Edwin our waiter was quick and attentive to our table which made dining in the theatre district painless
Ordered (delivery) dinner at 7:11 pm.  Food delivered at 9:08.  Medium rare burger was well done and dry.  Fries were soggy and cold.  Bummer.
Dont believe the other hyped up spots - this is the best soul food in brooklyn ! (especially the smothered chicken). and they`re good peeps!

I have been to Fricassee several times.  Each time the food has been excellent and the service attentive.  Now I will be looking for another French restaurant to enjoy, since the problem I had with my last experience begins and ends with the owner. My husband and I took friends who were visiting from abroad to dinner Saturday night.  We had a reservation for 6 o'clock.  I called asking to move it to 6:30, and was told that I could, but that the table was booked for 8 o'clock, so our experience might be rushed.  I decided to keep the 6 o'clock reservation. We arrived on time, and were seated.  There was only one other table of 2 seated when we arrived.  We were seated along the back wall, with two of us on the banquette, and two of us on chairs.  The banquette was bumpy and uncomfortable.  I stand 5'8", but the seat was so low that I felt I needed a booster seat.  We asked the waiter if we could be reseated at one of the empty tables for 4.  He consulted the owner, who said no.   My husband changed seats with me so I could sit on one of the chairs.  My guest remained on the banquette, but sat on her coat and pocketbook to reach the table comfortably.  We had plans after dinner, or I would have gotten up and left before ordering.  We enjoyed the food and the service from the waiter, spent $280, and left the restaurant, noting that the table for 4 that we had asked to be moved to had 3 diners at it.   I hope they frequent the place often, and tip large, since I will not be back.   The owner refused a rational request when the restaurant had a total of 6 patrons in it.  He does not deserve my repeat business.

I went in on my lunch break and was very pleased with the cleanliness, service, and most importantly, the GREAT TASTING FOOD!  You can tell that people at The Flying Meatballs are on their game when it comes to food.  They are very knowledgable and passionate about what they put in people's bellies.  I tried the turkey meatballs, which were terrific, and decided to buy more for dinner tonight.  It is difficult to find food anywhere that resembles anything close to mom's home cooking, and they nailed it here.  I highly recommend coming here.

I have eaten at a lot of great restaurants in Philly this year and I can say without a doubt that the meal I had at High Street was the best yet. We went with the chef's menu and everything was so carefully thought out and executed that I just couldn't wait to see what came next. The service was thoughtful and unassuming and the ambiance relaxed. The food did all if the talking. Usually I look to more exotic cuisines for exciting meals but there was nothing boring about what was served. The flavors and ingredient combinations were the work of a truly gifted chef. I can't wait to go again!

A unique city bar that I got a chance to experience a few weeks ago.  We got the chance to sit up on the roof which was very nice especially in the good weather.  As a beer guy I enjoyed their good and unique selections of beer and had their burger which is one of the better burgers I have had in Philadelphia.

Food- This was some of the best BBQ I have had in the city! I give it an A. Vibe- I felt like I was out in the country, real relaxed and laid back. A+! Service- It was basically like being at a cafeteria. You walk up and order the food. That is kind of cool but I'd much rather like a waiter. B. Price- A little pricey but it was worth the price! B
Came in on a Tuesday night -- completely empty. Got the beef cooked medium -- it was terrible. Not a lot of flavor.
Don't order delivery here. Called an hour after placing my order through seamless -- they hadn't even started making the food yet. Don't recommend.
Kinda disappointed this time.. the flavor is still there but the portion has downsized so much. When I went home, I realized I got charge extra. I think it's because the owner wasn't there
:P
Love this place.

Got a beef burger and veggie burger. Veggie burger was dry. Beef burger came out well done instead of medium rare and it took more than ten minutes in a fairly slow dining room to get a server's attention. Refire came out medium, but by then, we were over it. Servers were apologetic and kind, but perhaps a little inexperienced.

Best bagles. Not only in town but ever. Been going for probably the past 15 years +/-. A Saturday staple in my house. Always get bacon and egg on a toasted sesame- perfect. The lines can be long but it's worth it. I so found out if you purchase a sandwich you get a free small coffee. Great deal. Love them.

This was the perfect choice for a romantic dinner out! Made a reso for two at 8 and were promptly seated. The room was still full of diners and the ambiance was very warm. The service was impeccable my dinner partner and I both joked it was too good. We felt as if we were being treated as royalty. We were promptly brought menus and waters as well as a complimentary flat bread and bread rolls. The dinner prices were beyond reasonable, considering we were right on the park and in NYC. My entree was 26 and it was a seafood medley. It was supposed to be served over pasta but being gluten free I asked for it over spinach. They do have gluten free pasta but it was more than enough without. My date got the seared tuna. The wine was a bit pricey but the bottle was delicious. I loved every part of it--especially the complimentary after dinner orange liqueur. Thank you again!!

This is definitely the best Mediterranean food you'll find in the area and the portions are large - it tastes SO fresh too! I'd rate this place a 4.5, EXCEPT, the service is terribly slow and the ambiance isn't good. I recommend calling ahead, picking up, and bringing it home.
We love this place, Everyone is friendly, attentive and courteous. We were in town for 4 nights and ate there two of them. that says it all.

I have enjoy Ofrenda numerous times in the past, but this last Sunday Sep 21, I did a Birthday party for my wife and 45 People. All different backgrounds, Manhasset LI represented the USA, Germans, Colombians, Mexicans, Italians, and one Japanese The food was excellent authentic Mexican food. Fabiola was our waitresses delivering an outstanding level of service. Let's not forget the drinks from Orlando and Enrique where the hit of the night. William the GM allowed me to bring a Mariachi Band and we play music in till 2 AM. The venue turned to be more like El Tenampa in Plaza Garibaldi Mexico. And that is not easy to accomplish. Thank you berry much to the Ofrenda Team
Trout is the best here!

I don't like this place... I had a piece of plastic in my lobster Mac and cheese. It was gross.. I'm guessing it was the plastic cover from the cheese they cut to melt. The New England clam chowder was pretty cold. It tasted alright, but it was cold! The oysters didn't seem like they were really fresh. Came to this place for some good seafood, but I was disappointed.

Worst restaurant experience I have ever had. The manager did not handle it at all the way he should have. Waited 2 hours to be seated after I was told between one and one and a half hour. Then waited another hour for food to arrive. Our server called the manager to our request. The manager came by and apologized for the delay offering NO solution. The food was really good and that's why they got one star but overall experience was not worth it. Will not come back and will not recommend it.

Imagine the soul-crushing disappointment when you bite into a delectable xiao long bao, only to discover that all the soup has leaked out. This happened to at least HALF of our soup dumplings, even before we touched them. The first one I picked up had a hole in the bottom and I quickly ate it to salvage what soup was left. We were not so fortunate with the others, which were also broken and had leaked all of the soup by the time we got to them. I guess we should just count ourselves lucky that we had three that were actually intact. If we hadn't been so unfortunate, I would have rated Joe's Shanghai higher. However, the xiao long bao is the main draw here! You should at least get that right.

Second Day of Vegan eating and this place is amazing. It's completely vegan which based on their menu will have you questioning it's validity. I had their Philly Cheese Steak. Could not tell the difference from a normal chicken cheese steak that I would get at work. Their vanilla shake is to die for.

This is my first time here, and I must say I really loved the corn. But after dinner, I went to use the restroom and that really disgusted me. There was water all over the floor (from the toilet?!?!) and toilet paper scattered all over. And this is still early enough in the evening so u can't say they were too busy to clean it. It makes u wonder how clean the food is. So, as much as I loved the corn, I'm sorry but I wouldn't go back there again.

Warning, do not be deceived by the pictures on yelp.  Chicken and waffles are only served on weekends here. I went there on a Monday and even though it was a Federal holiday they were not serving the weekend menu and wouldn't accommodate my request for it.  I would definitely recommend that they change that.  I hate it when a place has different menus on different days. Overall the food was good but I wasn't blown away. Had the pancakes and chicken sausage which were tasty but the sausage had an overwhelming taste of sage and lavender.  A pretty expensive meal for breakfast, about $45 for me and my husband.  The atmosphere was nice, clean but cramped (definitely felt like I was all up on the next table).  Service ok but we waited a while for the food. Would not recommend if you have a large party because chances are you will be waiting for seats.  But for two it's fine.  I may try it again if I'm in NYC on a weekend just for the chicken and waffles.  But otherwise I could take it or leave it.

Wow! Hands down, Abe Fisher has the best service I've experienced in Philadelphia. My husband and I stopped in last weekend, without a reservations, and the staff was super accommodating to get us seated. Our waitress was incredibly attentive and extremely helpful when it came to menu selections. We tried the veal schnitzel tacos and we will definitely come back to order them again! The small plates are great for sharing and allow you to sample several of the unique menu offerings. My husband and I are relatively new to the city, and enjoy spending our time trying out new restaurants. The manager visited with us and shared a list, compiled by the staff, of other recommended restaurants in the city to try out. The service, food, and atmosphere exceeded our expectations.
