DO NOT ORDER TAKEOUT THERE.  Complete disaster.  They told me 15 minutes.  The order took 55 minutes.  The service was awful.  The staff just stood there as takeout customers just waited around.  There was no checking up on the order.  It was completely disorganized.  There was no apology and explanation on how a "4 minute cook time" according to the website took so long.  You can't even blame the dine in guests as it was less than half full.  In one transaction you have turned an advocate of the location to a former customer.   Ultimately I blame the management of this location.  I hope corporate reads this especially if they have plans of taking this further (I research these types of businesses for a living).  Management has trained their staff poorly. Perhaps management should have noticed the pileup of takeout orders and people standing around the area and thus blocking both the bar access as well as the kitchen access.  Perhaps management should train employees to tell guests that it will take longer than 15 minutes when calling in the order.   Also I blame your outdated POS terminal and kitchen display (or lack thereof) despite opening 3 months ago.  It's 2014.  New restaurants have terminals that have time counters on orders that make people aware that a person has waited 55 minutes for an order that was supposed to take 15 minutes.  They have line expediters that figure out hold ups in transactions so ultimately customers don't see 10 other people get their order before they do.   Finally the pizza crust was overly charred (and this is coming from someone that likes charred pizza crusts) making the whole trip not worth it.   You are located in a town with 20 pizza places.  You either need to be ridiculously better than all of the other places (especially at $20 a pie) or you need to lower the friction of buying a pizza in order to get me to call you and drive past the other locations.  You are failing on both fronts.  I never write reviews and yet this transaction was so frustrating that you inspired me to sign up and write a review.

Delicious food. Legit farm to table restaurant with a beautiful decor and very polite and helpful staff. A bit pricey and the portions are small but we had a fabulous experience. I love that they cook with fresh organic ingredients. The service was superb and the food was just as good as it looked. The egg and mushroom pizza was super rich but super yummy. And the crunchy shrimp salad with carrot sesame dressing is a dish that will keep me coming back. The shrimp could be "crunchier" though. I can't wait to go back again especially because the menu will be totally different with the change of season because of the farm to table dining concept.

Mediocre food for unreasonable prices. The pasta sauce is homemade I believe but there was way too much olive oil which drowned out the herbs and other flavors and pooled at the bottom of the meatballs. Margherita pizza had similar sauce so there was absolutely no flavor to it. Very disappointed after reading such great reviews.
Joe's is always a pleasure!  I feel as though the portions have gone down in size however this is the best place to get good seafood in the area.  The staff is amazing and they make joe's a fun time!

Cool place.  Loved the bar area.  Had a great selection of IPA's and wine.  Appetizers and dinners were tasty.  I wish the portions were a little larger for the price but I expected that.  Service from all staff members was excellent.

Came in about a week ago after gone without my fix for too long. I love this place. The portions are great, food is always exciting, and the staff is super friendly. On this most recent visit I got one of the waiters that had been then before the the closing and he recognized me and was great as usual. Really glad some of the old staff is there. I had a zombie, aligator, and the trinity poboy and it all was better than i remember. The food took a little time but I imagine that comes with the territory of reopening after so long. Can't wait for more!

I've been going to Tria for years and never have had a bad experience.  Best time to go is during "Sunday school," you can check out a new wines, beers, cheeses that change week to week and are a bit off the beaten path.  It's great to have a wine bar with so much adventure that is still affordable - love trying new great wines.  Servers are friendly and know their stuff well - so trust their recommendations if you aren't sure where to start.
Best place in philly!
love reading terminal market. great meat & produce selection

I've never had a bad experience here. The bread, from Terra Momo Bread Co, and olive oil are fantastic, the wines are excellent. The menu is not incredibly inventive and I'd like to see more variety and use of seasonal ingredients. The ambiance is great, particularly when you can sit outside, and the service I've received has always been good.

Since the algorithm decided that my first review would not show here, I thought I should try writing another review that will show up. My now-husband and I had a horrible experience at Frankie's on the night we got married at City Hall.  We were first told the wait was 45 minutes.  We were relaxed, drank a bottle of wine on the patio and chatted away.  But we were not seated until 1.5 hours had gone by.  When we were finally sitting at a table, the server was so incredibly rude and inattentive that even after waiting for so long already, we got up and left.  If I wait for 1.5 hours for a table, I expect a certain level of kindness and service from waitstaff.  No food in the world is worth that kind of attitude. We ended up going to Brucie, got a table right away, had an extremely delicious meal, served by extremely friendly people, and cannot wait to return.

Delicious!!! Had the Brussel sprouts and quinoa and zucchini slider with avocado fries and it was great! They forgot to add the pork belly to the sprouts I ordered and they immediately sent it over!!! So nice!!!

I live in DC, but work in NYC occasionally. I always stay in Princeton because it is cheep, and easy to get in and out of. On every trip I make a point of eatting here. I think the curries are fantastic, and I love the general atmosphere of the restaurant.   I have never been disappointed.
The happy hour is very valuable!!!
Don't judge a book by its cover.  Despite the understated outside and simple interior decor, all dishes ordered by our party of 6 were great!  Hats off to the chef!!  We would definitely come back.

Great food! Warm Italian place with a family atmosphere. I recommend getting a few meatballs on the side, maybe even a few to go. I've ate at the Villa more than once and could never complain about one thing. Food comes out hot and is delicious. Employees treat you like you are a regular even if it's your second visit. I will continue eating at the Villa whenever I'm in Philadelphia again. Highly recommend.

I'm giving this restaurant 1 star because the food was pretty good; nothing extraordinary, and overpriced (though not for the area), but reasonably tasty.  And the room itself was quite lovely. Service:  The worst waitress I've ever experienced in a restaurant of this class. Surly; angry; unbelievable attitude.  No introduction. Not one smile throughout. She obviously hated working there, and particularly hated our party because we had two elderly people with us. She never checked in with us to see if we were happy with our meals.  She never refilled our water. She obviously couldn't wait until we left her section. I did not pay the bill, but I wouldn't have given her a cent as a tip. Seating:  We'd made a reservation for a specific table for 1:15 on Monday Columbus Day. That table was very near the entrance because we had two elderly people with us. One had just gotten out of the hospital, the other was handicapped & on an electric scooter.  We arrived a little late: 1:23.  They'd given the table away!  We were asked if we'd be willing to use the ramp, to a table on the upper level; our guest with the scooter declined to do so, since negotiating the ramp was a little tight -- AND, reasonably, he wanted the table which he always got.  It took THIRTY minutes for the guests at the table we'd reserved to get their check, pay their bill, and depart. The waitress did nothing to expedite processing their check once they'd handed in their credit card.  That added 12 minutes to the wait (which would've only been 18, if she'd rushed it through). The hostess never should have given away our four-top just because we were 8 minutes late.  And the waitress absolutely could & should have expedited the departure of the guests at our reserved table. This was a very bad experience, and did damage to a long-awaited reunion experience.
This place is great the food is fantastic the chef is a master he's friendly talks to all the tables.  The fish is fresh like it just came out of the sea.

We drove to this place for dinner from North of White Mountains for some 80 miles. For the fall season the restaurant was quite busy. Dal makhani was average, chilli paneer was a little sweet and not what chilli paneer you would think of. Naan's were good.

My favorite place! If you like Potatoes this is the place for you! Such a variety and you can build your own or choose from there amazing combos they have. I've never had something I didn't like from this place. 5 stars!!!

Are you kidding me. I sat at the counter for 12 minutes - no one spoke to me or offered to take my order.  I walked out. Got tired of watching the cashiers flirt with each other and the servers talking to each other and ignoring guests.  Awful service - can't rate the food

Not only is the food absolutely to die for, but so is the customer service! It was obvious that this place has it going on by the number of regulars that passed through the door to grab some yummies that they must have been craving for very good reason. I was lucky enough to sit by the counter with the array of sweet treats. I indulged in the sour cherry pie a la mode and I must admit, it is one of the best pies I ever had and the crust was impeccable. I even took some home as it was so hard to choose! This place is a must, an absolute must!!!
Perfect "real" breakfast... Like a Route 66 diner. Small, but awesome. And they're totally cool.
Awesome place!!!! Love their sandwiches and lots of vegan options. Coffee is wonderful too by the way.

The Bounty is a lovely restaurant with potential but they need to improve both their service and their food. The kitchen has a heavy hand with sauces, seasonings and oil.  While they are on the right track with their desire to provide flavorful dishes, they simply need to tone it down a bit and let the ingredients speak for themselves a bit more. The service was detached and distracted.  Bartender was chatting with his buddies and ignoring his customers.   Took a smoke break and jumped back behind the bar with out washing his hands and  then served us our food.  This is a breach of basic industry protocol. Left there with the feeling that The Bounty was not being operated by someone who really cared about the quality of the food or the customer experience.

Best brunch in manhattan. Everything is homemade and amazing. The thin sourdough pancakes are the best pancakes in the history of mankind. Definitely worth going as much as possible. Kid friendly too.

We were so pleased with this restaurant on our last visit to TriBeCa...pies were the best we've ever had. Family enjoyed everything from the mac n cheese to the organic salmon and chicken.  If visiting NY, this is worth the drive to Hudson St.  They also have a spot on the High Line that serves pies and homemade ice cream and pop.

This place is awesome. The food is amazing, delicious and affordable.   It's wonderful to have so many rose options in a place that looks like a spot for a European romantic movie. I kind of felt like I was in Europe for a minute. Every crepe I've had was fantastic.  The Out To Pasture and La Colombiana are my favs. The Kashmiri chai is out of this world. One of a kind In many ways. This was my second trip and there will be many more for sure :)) Will definitely recommend to everyone!!!

I was in Philadelphia for a show over at World Cafe Live and was in the mood for a savory crepe. Authentic french crepes, with excellent prices. The food was amazing!  It looked beautiful & tasted even better. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the owner is very friendly. The food was prepared quickly. I cannot think of a single thing that wasn't done well! I highly recommend it!

First time there and all I can say is AMAZING. Me and my bestfriend went at night and just the view itself is breath taking. Our waitress was amazing! She always made sure we were okay and that everything was fine and she took our orders quick. The food came really fast and tasted delicious! The vibe was just perfect. The music wasn't so loud nor low, it was just right. I recommend everyone to try this place. I enjoyed it for my first time and I would definitely return!

O-M-G! I just love this place, the atmosphere is so clean and pet friendly, the staff are so delightful and the food is amazing, I love their hazelnut latte. this is now my fav spot-love the Sunday crowd

Good service, great food. Been here 3 times, consistently good. Broccoli rabe dish is my favorite. My fiancé thinks they should fill up the wine glasses more. Will definitely be back again. There's always a wait but what do you expect when a place is good.

I usually hated eating falafel but coming here it just changed my perspective. I bought the platter and the smoothie. Let's start with the platter, it comes with hummus, salad,pita bread, several different flavors of falafel and something's else. The hummus and falafel are darn GOOD and this are the stuff that makes there falafel sandwhich the best. The smoothie was alright not that good. Spent over $20 at this place but well worth. This my top place to get falafel from now on.
Always excellent service, great wine list, really consistent food quality. Well worth a visit
I mean, it's fine and I had no complaints -- cute spot, nice servers, everything tasted good -- but food this basic should cost a lot less. Every single thing on the menu is overpriced by $5 to $10.

Huge fan of Tom's Turkey Club! Very filling (I only manage to eat half and save half for later) with a lot of meat. Bacon is cooked perfectly and I love the clean, crispness the cucumber adds to the sandwich. I would like to try some other menu options, but I can't keep away from this delicious club!

Excellent service, great ambience, awesome carribean style restaurant. My wife and I had lunch here and we must say, we were impressed with everything. From the smart menu in an otterbox type frame, simple with not so many items, but just enough to leave your mouth watering and curious of every item. Anyway, lets get to the most important part, the food. I had jerked chicken wings with okra fries. I must say, ive eaten at plenty carib. spots but this jerked chicken takes the cake.  I love spicy food and this was right down my alley and I love that they have a non spicy bbq option as well if thats not your thing (my wife). It wasnt hot sauce type spicy,  it was a natural spicy that was spicy because of the natural herbs and spices! I prefer okra fries over all fries now as well, thats how good they were(this was my first time eating okra fries). Theyre fried in a special plantain flour that make your mouth water as you eat them. My wife had the salmon burger with chips. You cant go wrong with the salmon burger, seasoned and cooked to perfection served with chips [(also can be served with okra fries (recommended)]. Even the chips were made with a seasoning they make there that was absolutely delicious. And all this was washed down with a wonderfully made sorrel which is one of my favorite carribbean drinks(served non-alcoholic, but restaurant is B.Y.O.B so bring rum if you want it loaded!). Oh and the water is served with a lemon and a cucumber slice which makes it so refreshing it might be illegal. This place is truly special because of the way they cook healthy food, it leaves wanting more plus you leave feeling better than when you came in. This is a truly special place which I will come to frequently because I feel it truly is vital, all pun intended!

All I can say is the food is great here Anthony really can cook up some great dishes you have to try the chicken savoy on the bone it's amazing and the shrimp beeps are to die for keep up the great cooking and service you do . Thanks

2.5 stars. The one word to describe this place is "inconsistent." The cocktails are the one standout - always delicious and inventive. The food ranges from excellent to bland. The service is relaxed at best, and several times it's taken 15-20 minutes to even be acknowledged by a server. I have had one or two excellent experiences here and at least half a dozen poor ones. I do not think I will be returning, except perhaps for a cocktail at the bar.

I lived in Texas for 4 years and North Carolina for 4 years...this BBQ is quite nice.  Line can take a while and you can't reserve a seat.  Great menu and probably my favorite BBQ place in NYC.  It would be here vs hill country BBQ for my favorite (both Texan I might add).  Single thing is weighty so would limit yourself to one side unless really hungry.  A bit messy wouldn't go on a date here.

What can I say, if your reading this you've already been and you just found your newest favorite pizza place and if you haven't you probably stopped reading after the third review and are on your way there, my favorite of the new haven pizza scene
meh. Food was lousy. Service was great. Came for brunch left tipsy and had a great experience, sadly I left hungry though and in retrospect portions were not appropriate fro pricing.

You pay for what you get and this place is worth every penny!!!! There are often coupons in the Mercer County Clipper.  The restaurant is clean and the food is very good!  Everyone in the family will find something to eat and leave full!
one of my favorite hidden gems of my hometown! the polenta, lemon pasta, and homemade zeppoles with fresh cannoli cream are to die for!
My family and I love their food, it's just amazing and the people are so friendly. The price is good as well and you get a lot:)

Some of the best brunch on the Upper West Side. I've been to Jacobs Pickles many times and it never disappoints. The portions are huge. You will not leave Jacobs pickles hungry. The honey chicken and biscuit is amazing. Their homemade fries and ketchup are a favorite! If you crawl out of bed late, hungover expect to be on a wait but this wait is worth it!

Wife and I dropped in for the $10.00 lunch which includes a coffee or soda. We both had the burgers with fries, red onions, lettuce, tomato, cheese and bacon. These burgers were cooked just right and must be half a pound each. These are REAL French Fries, not the extruded ones that some places serve. Extruded ones come out of a machine like toothpaste comes out of a tube. Extruded ones are basically mashed potatoes mixed with whatever chemicals are needed so they do not discolor. Waitress came back at least twice to table to make sure everything was OK. Noise level at lunch was not high. We could easily talk. Just realized that there may be no TVs. What a pleasant surprise! We don't go to a pubic place to watch TV. We can do that at home. Real paper towels in bathroom, not just a blow dryer. The places with a dryer, if you change your baby, how do you dry the baby/ Some dryers have a slit to stick your hands into. They are having a special event for Halloween and may go back for that. Very nice place.

Our bartender, Julia, started our visit by talking to her coworkers and not acknowledging us for several minutes. When she finally came over she was not overly friendly bordering rude. When I ordered an Irish coffee she served it and then told me there was no more whip cream in a flip manner and then just walked off. When I finished my drink she was again talking to a coworker and I had to ask for my check after several minutes sitting with an empty drink on the bar and then just threw the bill on the bar. She didn't even take the time to ring up our purchase and had a coworker do it. When her coworker got on the job behind the bar she sneezed in her hand and then just continued to make drinks. We were going to have dinner there, but with this kind of introduction to their business there is no way I would eat there. If these people worked for me I would fire them!!!
YES!!! As good as it gets! If you are into authentic Thai food, this place is the one you are looking for. So far this is THE BEST Thai restaurant I have been to.

Went on a Sunday afternoon to grab some brunch with a couple of friends. We walked in and since this was our first time we awkwardly stood around for some help on seating. One waitress told us to go into the backyard and then another told us to wait to be seated. After awkwardly standing around, we eventually were seated in the backyard. The ambience was pretty cool and relaxed which I thought was worth the 2 stars. I ordered the gravy biscuits and my friend ordered the special of the day, apple pancakes. I could not finish my biscuits because it almost felt like it was doused in salt. I tried a bite of my friends apple pancakes in hopes of a better meal but was sadly disappointed. The pancakes tasted very dense and doughy with a couple of apples on top. However, the waitress that was serving us was very pleasant and kind which made up for some of the experience at J'eatjet.
Its not Hype, this place is really producing some of the best tasting dumplings. its worth it to stand in line.

I stopped by for coffee on opening day and was able to sit in their adorable back patio with my dog. The staff are very friendly and the cafe is self is really cute. I appreciate that they had honey for my coffee, but would have loved almond or coconut milk to go along with it. I will definitely be back in to try the food ASAP. Glad to have them in the neighborhood.

The quality of the meat is really good in the pho.  I enjoyed the crudo I started with as well, but it was less exciting.  Location is not the easiest to get to - I suppose it's pretty "hipster" and adds to that vibe, but we had an enjoyable meal.  Love the BYOB vibe - very small and I can appreciate the we do a few things well sentiment - and they do.  The pho itself was a little on the bland side unless you add the herbs they give you and some sriracha, but the quality of ingredients was great.  They were out of bahn mi when we went, so we'd like to return to try that out next time, I'd go again, but not often - it's too far and I've been told there are other good pho places to check out.

At less less than $23 per person after tax, this is a one of a kind Hot Pot and/or Korean BBQ Buffet All You Can Eat. So you DO NOT need to go to Flushing or 34th Street. Nor do you have to pay a premium. They serve you as they have the hordes of choices for the BBQ. A deeper look and it is not exclusive to Korean Style BBQ but also quite a few Chinese dishes as well. I would recommend either Hot Pot or BBQ but not both unless you can really eat. You will be pleasantly surprised that one of the free drink choices includes Prunella, which is great for those who are familiar with it. Do make reservations because you will end up waiting a while and thankfully they do call you when the table is ready in case you're not stranded there. I would say go after 9p to be safe so the wait may not be as long. Smaller tables have more efficient service than big tables as it is usually one server per party though if they see its a really big group and it gets really busy, then 2 or more may swing by in different intervals. Overall the cheapest place to do BBQ with an unmatched variety and competitively priced Hot Pot.
Welcome to the neighborhood!  Love that they have so many veg-friendly options, and the fish taco was ridiculously good.

I've always loved their fillings.  However, I got some savory crepes, and was disappointed to see that there wasn't much filling in them.  I know that they're just starting out.  So I hope they can keep the consistency I have come to expect from them.  Otherwise, it just won't be worth it for the price or the long wait during their busy times.
Great boneless wings

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. My girlfriend did pickup, came home and the wings were bad, no sauce and very dry. She brought our order back to get remade or get her money back. She came home in tears, the manager "Chris" became very aggressive with her and yelled at her in a store full of customers. This is unbelievable and hands down the worst management ever. Needless to say between the bad wings, but more over how they treat repeat customers, we will NEVER pay this place another dime. Thankful for competition, new customers on the market.

Prices are good food is above average and selection is great. They are on grub hub. I recommend it. Pizza is good. sandwiches are good. Plus delivery is pretty fast and I've never had an issue. Cheese stakes are good. They have some good deals check the coupons. I'm a regular.

Family style ONLY. Very bright. Awkwardly bright. They don't give you menus. There is one big menu on the wall (like at Burger King) and you order from that. Baked clams tasted like any other so nothing amazing here. Wait staff is attentive. They do not stray from the family style rule at all though. They are very precise about what the menu says and they will not change anything for you.

The pizza is average. It's good, but nothing special. 20 bucks for a small and two toppings. Classic wood fire pizza. The service isn't very good either. Only 1 water refill even though I asked for more. I would choose another pizza spot if you head to Brooklyn.

THE FOOD IS GREAT, BUT.... I took off 2 stars reluctantly. I was hovering between 3 or 4 stars but I finally settled on 3 stars. I ate lunch here on a rainy day (more like a drizzly day) and the restaurant was completely empty.  Only 1 other customer came to pick up a take out order. When I arrived, the hostess was having a rather animated conversation (in English) with a customer on the phone. I believe this is the same hostess who the other reviewers say yells all the time. To me, she speaks in a very quick shrill voice which is not the greatest to hear when you want to eat in peace. I had been looking forward to eating here for quite a while, since I love Thai food and the ratings from other sites seemed high. My order was a lunch special consisting of Jasmine tea, coconut rice and shrimp shumai (lunch special). The food was very flavorfull, well cooked, and delicious. The rice did not taste very "coco-nutty", but it was still good. The shrimp shumai are bite sized but very filling. The hostess did pour my tea and showed me a trick to making great tea :) To me, an empty restaurant is not a good sign, even on a slightly rainy day. I feel that customers probably prefer to take out food although the interior is nicely decorated. However, the lighting is a bit dark and not as welcoming as it could be. I didn't care for the "Budweiser" menus or the cheap paper place mats on the elegant tables, very tacky. Consider that  many items on the dinner menu are as high as $22 per serving which isn't cheap. All the lunch specials are $8.95. This price range puts it on a PF Chang's footing, but Chang's far exceeds them in terms of interior and service. The Japanese restaurant down the street, Ginza, is not as fancy but the service is great, the interior is decent (no frills) and your food comes fast (it isn't as great, but it's still pretty good). All foodies know that great food is 90% of dining out, but service and ambience count for a lot too. Tamarind Grill could EASILY get up to a consistent 5 star level or even higher if it would offer a more welcoming and customer friendly atmosphere, play some mood music, and offer service comparable to other Asian restaurants in the area. I hope they are able to see that people really love the food, but deserve to have a complete eat-in restaurant experience.

Overall the best restaurant in the burlington area. Known for their beautiful salad bar, the windjammer is a great place for large and small parties and even has a fun pub upstairs--the Upper Deck. Service staff is knowledgable and professional. Food is always good. There is something on the menu for everyone. If you want the best, ask your host to put you in Sonja's section. Best server in town.
Such a good bargain. Not the prettiest place but the food tastes amazing and the lunch menu is an amazing bargain. I would recommend this to anyone in the neighborhood.

The worse minestrone soup! Pure tomato sauce. No consistency of beans vegetables or pasta. The bartender said he was sorry. Owning a business ourselves we would of offered a drink on the house. Very disappointed !!!
Yucca Fries are a must! Best I've had

I happened to stop by here because of my friend who is a huge fan of Woorijip. I tried their Beef Teriyaki with brown rice and I have to say, it's delicious! I love the sauce that they use. Everything is cheaper compared to the Food Court across the street. And there are also a variety of different meals to get. I have to say if you do come here, ask for a Woorijip card so that after coming here like around 10 times, you can get a discount during the next time you come. I recommend this place!

This place is so adorable! I love the open windows in the warm weather, giving you the impression you're sitting outside. The decor is modern but has a kind of cabin in the woods feel, and the food is delicious. Our table tasted a lot - the seared tuna special, the burger and fries, the pork belly, etc, all superb!
Wonderful food and service. loved the cheese fries. Burgers are good too. Will definitely recommend to my friends.

Words cant describe how amazingly good this place is. I made a yelp accound just for this place. LOL. I got an italiano with mozz and it tasted like a meatball just like our waitress said it would taste like. I didnt pit the marinara on it but i dipped my fries in it and it was so good. I was the first person to get a piece of their homemade cheesecake and I kid you not, AH-EFFING-MAZING!!!! Their zeppoles are amazing too however I need a rehab for their goodness. I'm such a dessert person. LOL. A must go visit! I will definitely be back.
The clam pie was one of the best pies I ever had.  The crust and flavor of the pie was great.  It was well worth the trip to New Haven.  I will go back.

So... I'll say that I came to this place because its clearly HIGHLY recommended, and I love BBQ. Unfortunately I was met with pork belly whose dryness was rivaled only by the attitude of the guy who dished it out to me -- we'll call him Snarky Bandana Guy. I was forced to hastily choose my meat and sides as I tried to take a gander at the selections on the menu. I ordered a cple half pounds of various meats to give it all try, all of it average. The beef rib which "Snarky Bandana Guy" passionately said he "couldn't do a half lb" of, was the highlight of it all, yet still not over the moon. Perhaps it was an off day... but it was Saturday afternoon, so go figure. If you enjoy Red Hook imports that take pride in their "local dining options" and snide service then give hometown a try. I'd skip the trip to no mans land and head to Williamsburg instead. Fette Sau is waaaay better.
Woo hoo, I was here for a soft opening and really enjoyed the Hors d'oeuvres and Ever Upward beer. The ambience is nice and well worth checking out.

We were visiting New York.  We stayed on Stanten Island.  We chose Denino's based on yelp reviews.  I am so glad that we did.  It was the best in my life.  They were packed when we first got there but they got us in a booth in 15 minutes.   It's a very casual family atmosphere.   We started out with cheese sticks.  They were home made and amazing.  We got a trash can pizza and a half cheese and pepperoni/bell pepper.   All of it was awesome.  We were practically drooling.   I definitely recommend this place.  I'm going to be sad when I leave New York cause they don't have them in Ga.  Though I hear they might be getting one in Austin tx.

I stopped in for dinner a few nights ago and boy was I happy I did!  First off, the place was really cool looking...definitely spot on with the whole Jersey Boardwalk feel.   I ordered the cheesesteak and my husband ordered the smoked chicken sandwich, along with a slice of plain pizza.  We did a split on the sandwiches and I took a bite of his slice.  The cheesesteak sandwich was awesome and the smoked chicken sandwich was ridiculous!!!!  It was a bit on the sweeter side, which was a perfect compliment to the smokiness!  The pizza?  All I can say was, "WOW!"  I wish they were closer to me because they don't have anything like in Wayne.  It's worth the drive, though!  The service was exceptional, too, which is always a plus!  We also brought our 2 kids, who thoroughly enjoyed the arcade and the "boardwalk" treats for dessert...after they devoured their pizza!

Superb food! I strongly recommend the bacalhau com natas, by far some of the best I've ever had! The sangria is like no other and the atmosphere is relaxed and inviting! My mother had the octopus which is another house specialty and it too was delicious! Five stars all the way around...
Honestly one of the most amazing restaurants I've ever been too. absolutely NO complaints. amazing staff..amazing food. if you are thinking about coming here..DEFINITELY do. you won't regret it.
Great service, food was well executed good quality and great flavors as well as good portion size.  Every course was very good!

We dined at The Grocery for our anniversary. Our dinners were spectacular, definitely one of the best meals we have eaten this year. The owners Charlie and Sharon and the other staff made our anniversary a night to remember. The beet salad was amazing, the calamari was crunchy and wonderful, and the duck was superb. The chocolate fig cake and the warm apple cobbler were rich and delicious (especially with a scoop of the homemade ice cream). We really appreciated the care that all of the staff put into making our anniversary a special event.

Enjoy this restaurant every few weeks.  Dinner at the Diner is great !!!  Love the outdoor dining and casual setting but upscale food.  The wait staff is great and personable.  I loved the jersey corn cakes.  If you are looking for great outdoor dining place on the Westside, this is the place.
Came here yesterday and had to leave a review. Amazing! Food taste good and service was good as well.
The food is good, but its a little pricey and strays away from presentation of comfort food. Not the greatest but definitely not the worst.
If we will eat here you never pity about it! It cost only 6$... You can take 1 portion for 2 people!

I have eaten at several coal fired pizza restaurants across NY and CT. I was excited to see a new pizzeria in Newark. I had the clams casino pie that was excellent. Bacon makes everything better and that charred crust was spectacular. I also shared with friends the margherita pie. The tomato sauce was tasty and we added the Devils hot oil. It's was really hot and really good. Oh we also got penne with pesto.  It was like we got 20 lbs of pasta!  We definitely did not go home hungry. Overall it was a great experience, great atmosphere near the Rock!  That coal oven pie is awesome.  I'll definitely be back.

Let me start this off by saying I've literally never written a review before this. No matter how good or bad a place is, the thought to write a review about it, doesn't typically cross my mind. With that said, the Lyndhurst Diner finally crossed a line that compelled me to immediately come back and warn the general public about what a rip off this place has become, so here it goes.. I used to live across the street from the Diner, so needless to say it quickly became my go-to for ordering out. To be fair, back then I probably would've given this place 3-4 stars. I've moved since then, but I still work in the area, so today I decided to pick up some lunch after not having been there for 2 years. I ordered a Greek Salad which usually comes with anchovies, but I asked to replace them with grilled chicken. They told me the salad came with a soup, so I ordered chicken noodle. Seems like a pretty good deal right? WRONG! I go to pick up my food and they charge me $17.95 for my meal. Yes, you read that right $17.95!!! Naturally I question the price, so the man at the register checks the menu for me. Greek salad is $12.95, but adding chicken is an additional $5. You'd think that's something they'd tell me over the phone, cause who in their right mind spends nearly $20 on a salad??! As for the food itself, I leave there thinking "this better be the best effing salad I've ever had in my life." I mean, unless you're getting your veggies from the Garden of Eden, you have no right to charge nearly $20 for a salad. Anyway, as you may have guessed from my one star, the salad sucked! They didn't even put dressing on it or give me any on the side. How the eff do you forget dressing, the most integral part of a salad??!??!  The chicken was chewy and tasted like garbage. Not to mention, they only gave me 5 slivers, meaning they charge $1 per puny slice. The salad was pretty big, but since it didn't taste good who would even want all that extra lettuce. The soup was pretty good, seems homemade, not worth another star though, nor a trip back cause my mom's is better anyway. Now, maybe it's just me, but anytime I order food from a diner, I expect quick, reasonably priced food, that tastes decent. Shouldn't be too hard to live up to those expectations seeing as how they're not too high to begin with. Pretty much the only expectation they lived up to was the quick pick-up time, but if that was the only thing I cared about I would've just gone to Wendy's who actually whips up a pretty mean salad (better than here at least). So, there you have it, my god awful experience with the Lyndhurst Diner. If your question to me is would I ever go back? My question to you is, are you effing high??! If so, then maybe, just MAYBE, you'll enjoy the food there. If not, steer clear, there are plenty of other places in the area that serve better quality food and are more affordable.

Bill's has been consistently amazing for over 10 years since my days at Rutgers Newark. Today was no different. I had my usual, Chicken Slouvaki, and it was absolutely delicious. The chicken is prepared fresh with nice vegetables on a warm pita with homemade Tzatki sauce. Amazing and a steal! This healthy lunch for $5? Unheard of! Give it a try. You will be happy.

Whenever I'm in Burlington this is my first stop. My last two visits have been absolutely spectacular with food that should have a Michelin star. The chef has experience at Danielle and Per Se and he's been able to combine that with Burlington's farm to table atmosphere to produce dishes that are simple in ingredients but sublimely complex in flavor. The menu reflects what's usually in season and you can get a sample of several small dishes or enjoy a large entree that's a perfect portion. The bartender also works at a local wine shop, so feel free to ask about the wine list and what would go well with you table's dinner choices. The prices are incredibly reasonable with dinner entrees starting around $20. This should absolutely be a stop if you're in Burlington!

Love this place!! The food is awesome and the ladies always smile and ask if we like the food or nay. So sweet! Every time I go to Korean town, I always go to bcd... I had miss Korea once, wasn't as good as bcd hahaha
The potatoes were so good that I abstained from throwing my girlfriend on a table and having sex with her in the middle of the restaurant for fear of being asked never to return.

My parents brought us here as kids (in the 80's).  Love the Handy Family, so glad Earl has taken the reigns and not sold.  If I lived closer I'd definitely be there regularly.  Love my diner food with a side of friendly faces!
Prices are NOT as advertised. Charge you 60% more than what prices are listed and then pretend they don't know English when you ask them about it.
The food is delicious and the staff is very friendly. I would recommend the Spicy Thai Roll and the Edo Ichi House Roll.

Love this place! Food is mouth-watering! Their lunch specials are awesome- drink is included, soup, lunch and dessert all for about $10! Staff is always friendly no matter who serves you! I see new faces everytime I visit but even their new servers are thorough- I had the girl with the glasses last time and she was outstanding!!! The staff overall is just always in a good mood, it's a great diner atmosphere! I didn't give 5 stars only because their parking lot is kind of awkward  and the back entrance is only a one-way???? I don't understand that but it doesn't stop me from coming back
The best cocktails I've ever had very yummy Thai food great service,  beautiful restaurant,  one of those hidden gems that has just stated but hopefully will be around for a long time.

I had the 3 cheese grille cheese with bacon, the crispy goat, spicy tomato soup, french fries, sweet potato tater tots, and to top it off the sweet grilled cheese with mascarpone, bananas, and nutella with ice cream. Service was awesome, owner is cool as hell. This is by far the best grilled cheese I have ever eaten. Sorry grandma. If your around check it best bang for your buck around here you won't be sorry!
This is THE best new restaurant in Harlem! Everything we ate & drank was divine!  Try the Lenox Shandy!! I will be back for brunch!

Best margarita pizza in this area. Although their pizza is on the small side (I'm a petite girl and am able to eat their whole pie alone) it is delicious. Not crazy about their other dishes but pizza is yum
The food is fresh and it tastes great.  The owner and staff are very nice and welcoming. The prices are fair, and it's BYOB. My go to sushi place near Society Hill.
It's all good. Busy but well worth the wait. I was not as crazy about the breadsticks as everyone else but food is good and a nice wine selection.

Perfect mix of formal and casual. We had the truffle popcorn appetizer and the hummus plate appetizer. Both were amazing. For our entre- the Philly Cheese Steak cannot be beat!! The food, service, presentation, and overall experience could not be beat. Yes, the bar is loud, but it's fun and lively. Highly Recommend!

We found this purely by accident, because they had such cute blue tables outside. It was too cold to eat outside so we went in and had a fabulous Sunday brunch. We arrived about 10a and just beat the crowd. But the service was fantastic at squeezing everyone in and very upbeat. The food was fantastic - small menu, very French influence. I had the simple granola/yougurt/fruit bowl but it was fantastic. My friend had the baked eggs and loved it. Great coffee too (and I'm a Seattle snob about that).

Food and service is incredible, a new favorite! I will recommend this to everyone who wants an incredible experience with a great wine list, delicious food and top notch service. The cheese list is impeccable and they even served a birthday cake although they weren't asked to do so. I'll definitely come back and bring my loved ones!

Food was decent but the service was horrible. The wait for food was pretty long considering that we were the only table on the place. The waiter barely spoke to us, never came to check on how we were doing. He sat at a table behind us and played on his phone the entire time, we had to have another waiter help us with our check since our waiters text messages were more important than his customers. I will not be back.
Best Chinese food on South Street.Food is fresh and delicious.nice people.clean place.you have to go see it.

Stop reading Yelp reviews and check out Dasiwa for yourself. Right now. The food is amazing. Try the Loaded Gyoza or Not-cho as an appetizer. There is not a bad roll on the menu, but my personal favorites are the Dasiwaki, the Emerald City, the Aspen, the Orchid, the Shaggy Dog...and I could keep going. If you have room at the end of your meal (and good luck with that), the mochi is a refreshing dessert. The service is incredible. In all likelihood, you will meet Tom, the owner, or one of his kids over the course of your meal. The restaurant is small, and often crowded, but never once I have seen any member of the staff let that affect their service. Sam is particularly wonderful and sweet. Everyone is very accommodating - whether you need ice buckets for the five bottles of wine you brought with you (it has happened) or you want to customize an order of a roll on the menu, they've got you covered. On a personal note, a group of friends and I have been regulars at Dasiwa for almost 3 years now. This restaurant is so special to us that last year, when he needed to pick a location to propose, my fiance went to talk to Tom at Dasiwa. Tom closed the restaurant for us on a Monday night, Sam made a playlist of romantic music and set up her phone to record the event, and the sushi chefs made us an amazing dinner while keeping the post-dessert surprise a secret. It was incredible. I'm actually amazed that Dasiwa hasn't expanded yet - if this restaurant was located in a more central location, people would be flocking to it. If you decide to venture to Fairmount to give it a go, bring your beverage of choice, prepare to search for parking, and make a reservation. Any hassle you have to go through will be well worth it once you're there.
Great atmosphere but thats just about it, in order to see the menu you have to stand over people and look at it on the wall. Also not very impressed with choices on the menu
Amazing food & staff!   One of my neighborhood favorites.  Love the live music and cocktails while we waited on our food.
I had a birthday dinner about four years ago at this place and it was really good we had a great time restaurant is really nice! Food is great. I have no complaints!

NEVER ORDER FOR DELIVERY. We waited 3 and a half hours with no calls or communication, and eventually called Delivery.com, where we ordered it from, to demand a refund. No communication, called the restaurant several times and they assured us it's "10 minutes away" over 3 times. Whatever their food tastes like, it wasn't worth it. Maybe it's great for dine in, never for delivery. Never. Again. Unprofessional.

Quiet restaurant the escargot was delicious. The tables are very close so you feel on top of your neighbors. Overall, excellent experience. The two appetizers we got, the goat cheese tart and the mussels in a curry broth, were fantastic.  We messed up on the entree.  We got the duck, which was fine, but I regret not getting one of the signature dishes, either the filet with foie gras or the cassoulet.  The profiteroles were a nice enough way to end dinner. A nice note on the place is that it is BYOB, so you won't have to overpay for a nice bottle of vino!

Georgie's seems to change their menu every so often and usually they add one or two things to the vegan menu. I went back there not too long ago and they took off quite a few things, including their delicious banana chocolate cake and replaced it with this nasty raspberry chocolate cake. I know that Shoreline Diner makes the cakes, as the two diners are related, and it's out of Georgie's control, but still... We were unaware of the change, as our server did not inform us (knowing that we had not been there in awhile) and gave my cousin and i a slice of it. I couldn't even finish a bite- I was gagging. Luckily we requested the cake to be taken off of our bills and we still left her a decent tip, but I don't think I will be returning unless they change up their vegan menu again to something better.
Yummy food, huge portions, pleasant staff. My favorite is the corn with cheese, yummmmmmyyyyy
Delicious!! Such a cute cafe and the service is fast which is such a plus. I had the roasted vegetables, side of roasted potatoes and curry. The curry was indescribably good!

We went on Friday night at about 7:30pm. The greeting was good, the water came to the table quickly, the service started out well. Bread and butter showed up and that was definitely day-old, dry bread. I ordered the Spaghetti and meatballs, wife ordered Portobello Parmesan. it took about 20-25 minutes to arrive, but that's actually ok. We sat next to the open 'door' and the atmosphere was nice. The music was all-bass-all-the-time. Couldn't really hear 'music', but heard boom, boom, boom from speaker above. Not my favorite. Then...the pasta and meatballs showed up and the waitress never brought a spoon. Pasta? Bring spoon. It's that simple. Now the worst for me was the meatballs were soft and broke apart easily, not really meat at all. Did I order meatless meatballs? They were just like the filler and seasoning without the meat. Bad news man. If I like your pasta and meatballs, I'll be a fan for life. This place was ok...but that's it. I'll go back and try the chicken parm. next time, but won't be trying the meatballs anytime soon.

We were here on 16th oct 2014.pleasant atmosphere,courteous service,hygienic ,homely,very tasteful ,reasonably priced food.whenever one is in Iselin he/she should visit this restaurant

Place is beautiful, coffee excellent, and Greek yogurt was awesome. I could have gone without the smug cashier/order taker.  Clearly saw we were the only people in line (made eye contact) and Didn't acknowledge us until he was done conversing with his coworker.  10/17 morning around 10am. Would have given 5 stars if not for poor service.

They sat us at a two-top table where water was leaking on the booth seat so getting the bottom of my pants wet to start off the evening was not awesome.  The couple next to us said that 10 minutes earlier they were sat at the table and the same thing happened to the woman (pants got wet, not pleasant).  THEN a few minutes after we moved to another table the hostess sat another 2 people at the table!  We could not understand why they kept seating people at a table where the large pipe above it was leaking onto the seat.   Onto the food.  We ordered the half chicken (the side of sauce was really spicy) and the pad thai.  The half chicken my partner said was good but nothing to write home about. My pad thai was okay, but I thought there was too much chicken and the flavor was a bit underwhelming. I did appreciate all the bean sprouts though. Again nothing special.  The Chiang Mai fries were delicious and the best thing we ordered; We couldn't finish them though (perfect for 3-4 people to share, or two very-hungry-for fries people); the mayo sauce for dipping was delicious and I would gladly rub it all over a sandwich.       We don't typically eat Thai in the city but we decided to try this place due to the yelp check-in for a free drink (which was great) and because we just returned from a 2 week trip to Thailand (where we ate amazing thai food). That said, it's very difficult to find good/decent thai food in NYC and this place was decent but honestly I probably won't come back.

Omg Mexican grilled corn is so amazing!! I don't even like mayonnaise and now I want to recreate this food at home. I got the vegetarian tacos as my main, they were good, but the thought of grilled corn haunted me throughout the meal, even to this day... Their corn is always on point and the new fish tacos are actually pretty good.

If you know me personally you'd know that Oriental CUSINE IS MY 2DIE4. ..a family based small quaint  spot that sits right in the middle  of 9th St. The owners Edward & Sunny are a ball of fire and sunshine ..making it not just great for the food ...which was excellent (i had a bowl filled with awesomeness)  some very  good skewers)but for the service with a smile and customer  relationships  that you would want from a dining  experience. ..  Now I wont be to exact or precise on what I ate and purchased, but I will tell you that it was amazing ... A definite recommend from one such as myself who has been in the food service industry as a Chef/LineCook and Operations Manager for over 10yrs......and at a very reasonable price I ate like a King ...

I have come here to eat ever since I was a baby. I am proud to say that I have introduced both my sons and 3 of my friends (2 from out of tow, and 1 from another part of Brooklyn) to L&B, and they all loved it! First of all, the square pies are just as good as they were 20-30 years ago. Those slices are messy to eat, but that's part of the fun. The sauce on top / cheese on bottom combo is delicious, and so is the spumoni (I always get rainbow -- combo of vanilla, chocolate, and pistachio -- if I get spumoni that day). Veal parm, chicken parm, and pasta are great too, and so are their dessert options if you have a large number of people dining. If God Himself wanted pizza, He would go to L&B for their squares.
Everything here is delish!!!  You will not be disappointed!!
Authentic, delicious, and well worth the trip to Astoria. The seafood was amazing.
It is very delicious, you should go there... Very nice people.

Went there with high expectations. Started off well until my wife discovered sharp tiny bones in her burger. Manager refused to allow us to pay. Thankfully no injury done but really don't know how they manage their quality.
Chicken kabob was acceptable.

This place was truly amazing! Great selection of beers! So many options of oysters! Also, tried the cheese and meat plate which was amazing. I ordered the linguine and clams, and wow....this is probably the best place I have ever had this dish. The clams were very moist and garlicky, and the pasta was perfectly seasoned with what tasted to be breadcrumbs, olive oil, and some oregano. I highly recommend this, especially for $15. I also tried the crab-cake, which was equally delicious with panko breadcrumbs. Overall, I had an awesome experience and will def. go back!

Came here for lunch last Tuesday. It was fairly crowded, but good thing no wait! For my entree i chose to get a western omelet..thats how i determine for places like these if they are good.. haha I must say, it was pretty good!

I love love love the Vietnamese BBQ Pork Banh Mi (sandwich).  It was fantastic.  I also enjoyed the massaman curry, although it did not have the "right" vegetables.  It was advertised with potatoes and carrots, which I believe is traditional, but had some random green peppers, sweet potatoes, etc. which I do not eat.  At least the sauce and peanuts were right.  I'd probably get something different for dinner next time, but for lunch, I'd absolutely go for the banh mi again.  Decent atmosphere and service.

I stopped in for dinner a few nights ago and WHAT HAPPENED SUSHI LOUNGE?!?!?  The sushi I remember from last year - was NOT the sushi I had this time around.  The risotto was cold by the time it got to the table which was a HUGE reason why I wanted to come back here. The Hoboken roll - tasted very fishy and that's it.  The Hoboken roll I remember was flavorful and was so good I ordered another serving of it.  This time around, I could barely finish it.   I'm not sure if they have a different sushi chef or if management has changed but, it was very disappointing to say the least.  For the price you pay here, sushi needs to be on point not bleh.

I was told by a friend to give it a try, he said I wouldn't be disappointed the least bit have to say he was right....this is the best place to grab a shake and a crepe.  When I walked in I was greeted by a lovely woman Liza with a few customers eating on retro style table and chairs. I thought wow this is kinda cool. The prices are very reasonable. I purchased a La Colombiana it was amazing..I wish I took a pic so I can show everyone. The decor on the dish was absolutely astonishing. There are others to choose from but The La Colombiana caught my eye and i am glad it did. I'm stopping back in a couple hours to get smoothies she makes with Indian yogurt and a vegan shake as soon as my friend gets here.  See ya soon on my next review....smoothies here we come

We came here based on other Yelp! reviews and were not disappointed.  Spice Grill is an unassuming storefront in a strip mall but through its windows we could see a tastefully decorated dining room.  We arrived around 6:30 on a Friday and it was fairly quiet.  However, it quickly became busy both with others dining in as well as for take out.  The papadum and samosas we ordered were fresh and not at all greasy.  For dinner we had lamb seekh kabob, hariyali chicken and lamb palak, all very good and likewise not greasy.  The hariyali chicken in particular was tender and delicious.  Service was extremely attentive with multiple water refills, while not in any way rushing us.  All in all, a very nice dining experience.   We would definitely come here again.
I just love this place, went this morning got my latte which is just delicious and breakfast of course, the staff are just so friendly.

As a former regular at Timothy's restaurant, I was happy to see that the space was occupied by a new restaurant, and after hearing a couple good things from other food lovers, my wife and I made the trip to what is admittedly NOT Hartford's nicest neighborhood with high hopes for a great dinner. Sorry, Trinity restaurant- I had every intention of loving you but I just couldn't do it.  First of all, our server must have NEVER worked in a restaurant before. She served our appetizers and entrees simultaneously, and brought our check without even asking if we wanted dessert or coffee.  Parts of each entree that were advertised on the menu were conspicuously missing, and brought over on separate plates as an afterthought when we pointed out their absence. My bolognese was ok, my wife's swordfish a little better, but still thin and slightly too well done.  We did like the Tuscan bean soup. Our 9 year old had a cheese pizza which I thought was on the quality level of a frozen box pizza.   The space is nice, and maybe this was just a bad night, but I left missing Timothy's even more than I did before. It takes something better than average to lure us into this part of the city, and "better than average" wasn't happening at Trinity that night.

I'm not sure why I continue to go in there when I'm in the city for doctor appointments. The food is good but the guy making coffee is so obnoxiously Rude. I'll give it to you if your having a bad day but every time I go in there. Bad mojo!

One of our regular take out spots!  Love the beef/lamb Gyros and falafel.  What you get with the falafel varies based on who is making them, so make sure they included your pita and hummus!   Haven't tried much else there, but they are a monthly stop for us as we live around the corner and I can't make them better at home!
Good food. Good for takeout but they close early. Dining area is very plain. The menu is limited to a few Greek dishes which they do very well. The hummus is very good.
Consistently great Italian food. Their pastas are the best I've had.

Yelp told us this place was hot and new, since we were in the area and looking for Asian, decided to give it a shot. First thing, there isn't alcohol or beers. I know lame. My gf is vegan, when we informed this to the server he didn't even try to point to us what dishes she could have. We ordered vegetable noodle soup and spring rolls. Food came fast and was good. But because of the service and treatment we got, we'll seek elsewhere for something hot and new.

This place is horrendous! Please stay away. I went with my best friend on a Friday at 7pm and it was packed. The waiter says we can have the only available table which is by the bar but we have no service and would have to order all our food and drinks from the bar. While waiting I notice all the children which I normally love but doesn't make for a nice adult dinner. We finally get a table and the place is so small that both tables we are in between of seem like they are shouting. Our table was next to the bar and it was awkward to have that many children so close to so much alcohol. Our waiter (not the first one, now another) does not tell me the portions are very large and yet he knows I don't want a lot of food. He suggest an appetizer which I tell him I do not want after seeing the options and he does not make any there helpful suggestions. I finally decide on a Louisiana po' boy with shrimp and ask him if the shrimp is cleaned. He brings me barely fried shrimp which is not deveined. When I mention it he responds that the shrimp was washed. Um  excuse me but its a food  establishment and by sanitation standards I would assume that all food is washed. Why would he think that was genuinely my question? On top of that the breading on the shrimp came off right away and the shrimp had no taste. I basically paid $24 including tax and tip for French fries. At least the jalapeño tartar was great with the fries. The noise level never decreased. There are so many options in this area I'm really unsure why people would close to spend their $ or time here.

For years, this was my favorite restaurant in town. Then after many visits where the service was terrible, the food took over an hour to arrive, and was inconsistent in terms of temperature and quality when it finally did, I stopped going. They have a great location and used to be a great restaurant. Maybe they'll get their act together some day, but until then there are many other, better options nearby.

Im convinced that the folks who dine here do not cook at home. Any home cook can create this food. And spare me, the idiot who walks around with the truffles in the jar letting people smell them to push their $80 truffle dish is pathetic. This food was below average, especially given the price. I could easily out cook this chef. It was nothing special at all. First off you are greeted by this foul odor as you walk in, which is the old carpet in the dining room. Lets go, get rid of the 90's carpet and put hard wood floors in. The fact they hire someone just to read the specials is ridiculous. And they have them printed on a menu! But you have to ask. He spent 3.5 min reading everything. Appetizers were good, fried calamari, muscles(which were a special?)  Entrees, risotto with what appeared to be boiled sausage and boiled filet. Nasty! Halibut was over cooked and the handmade pasta was mediocre. And everything was over salted! I am really puzzled by all the good reviews. Like I said, I think the patrons that dine here often do not cook at home( 1 because they have enough play money to waste at below average "italian" restaurants and 2 because they are too old too cook for themselves)  sorry I will not be back. Come to my house for better food at a 1/4 of the price.
I've been coming here for 20+years, quality and taste went down  drastically and price went up drastically.

Visited NYC to hit a bunch of ramen shops up. Totto NAILED it. Super hip, super authentic cats working. Great funky techno playing in a shady looking basement storefront. PERFECT! Ramen was INSANE! Set the standard for our whole trip. Don't be fooled by corporate places like Ivan, or Momofuku. This place owns it. The broth has layers and depth like no other ramen I have tasted. You can tell that this food is there life and not just some chef move to dabble in. Go here!
this place is the fucking shit!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Oh the meatballs!  Jimmy , the nicest, most helpful waiter in the world says they are the signature dish.  I always rate an Italian restaurant by its sauce and this sauce is great. The  meatballs were just the best, lots of sauce and  cheese.   The level of excellence can be found in every dish.  I had the best prosciutto of my life at Campagna..  The staff is so helpful and attentive.  The ambience is friendly.  I visit often.
The Chicken Tikka Masala was hands down the best I've ever had.  I have travelled the world and eaten indian food, this was the best!

Regular slices not too great, small & thin crust, and a bit soggy not really my cup of tea but the wings are EXCELLENT! Crispy hot & fresh- sauces are good and 10 wings for $7.95 or 15 for $10.95 Good place to grab some hot chicken parms or pasta bowls plus BYOB! Wish they stayed open a bit later friday & sat nights...they close @ 10pm. A-1 pizzeria spoiled me with their 3am late night ordering ;)

Spiga is my new favorite Italian restaurant, with reasonable prices and over the top amazing food, it doesn't get much better than this. The service is great and they have a diverse menu with something for everyone. They have lunch and dinner specials if your looking for something new to have. Some of my favorite dishes are the rack of lamb, the Malfatti and the seafood salad. They are open every day of the week which is so convenient since most restaurants are closed mondays.

My overall experience was excellent, the wild mushroom white pie with the truffel sauce from the brick oven  was absolutly delicious, the staff was very friendly,it was  great weather today so we sat outside on the patio, relaxing music playing so i have to say this place is a winner. I will definatly go back.
Great place for something different. Sandwiches taste Great.!

My four star review is specifically for the eggplant bun. So so good. Do not leave this place without trying it. Also, the app they use when you're waiting to be seated is great. However, wasn't super impressed by only one veggie or fish-only option; they need to add more choices to their menu.
The food here is interesting, tasty, and reasonable.  Great India pilsner by the bottle, one of the best beers I have tasted.
I took my kids to this restaurant a few weeks ago.  The food is delicious!!  Definitely try the dumplings and the pad thai.  Super good :)

I'm a vegan (no meat, dairy, eggs) and so the crust and sauce must be superb in order to compensate for the substitute Daiya Cheese I bring to any pizza shop from the Bayonne Stop and Shop.  I happily say that Pizzalino's crust, sauce, and veggie toppings are excellent with any vegan pizza they make for me.   I love and request their marinara sauce, as the owner Joe explains the only ingredient is fresh and sweet San Marzano tomatoes - with no additional spices needed.  Add this to a well done crust and you have exactly what pizza is expected to be.   Great pizza and a wholesome honest shop.

We were super disappointed. The service was less than friendly, and we felt like we were being rushed at times, it was really loud, we were sat with the sun in our face via a giant window with no shade, the food was horrible, and for the prices. Overall can't say I was too impressed. They weren't packed or crazy busy so I'm not sure why the service was so poor.
I love the savoury crepes and coffee in this place.  May be the best Latte

Love this place! Great Italian food. Everything (but the drinks) is family sized, best for large groups or ...a couple with big appetites :) just go, if u hasn't gone already. Highly recommended. We've had many of their plates, including the Fried Calamari, salad, Chicken Cutlet, many of their pasta dishes and their sandwiches - far too many to name (or remember by name). And we have never been disappointed. This is coming from a very critical, sauce-in-the-veins, pure Italian family. So take heart. They serve "family style" portions, very large. My family of 5 (sometimes 6 or 7, if there's a significant other or two) is more than satisfied with ordering 2 family style dishes. I will continue to return as long as taste, quality & service is not compromised.

My Jamaican friend loves coming here for dinner, so our group of 3 came on a Thursday night. The food is amazing! We had the peppered shrimp appetizer, chicken patties, stew chicken and oxtail- you can't go wrong with the food! Sophie the owner is a pleasure and made a great recommendation with the peppered shrimp. The vibe is irie and we had a good time. Totally recommend!

Had never been here before and our friend who we went with raved about the place.  I couldn't agree with the other reviews more.  Its like eating in someones two bedroom apartment, tables are tight but its a great atmosphere. Cozy and warm nice place to go with friends. We started with the special Mussels in a red sauce, very tasty and we all enjoyed.  Steak Giambotta, Salmon, Pappardelle and Bronzino.  All specials and very well prepared. We all enjoyed our entrees and enjoyed them very much.  Then why only 3 out of 5 stars?  We were a group of six and when the entrees were brought to the table one person in our party did not receive theirs.  No explanation was given other than it would be out in 10 to 15 minutes.  Completely unacceptable and the way it was handled as well. The waiter/manager was not apologetic and blamed it on us with some nonsensical explanation.  Its a shame because we will not return.  Customer service is king!
Great spot for some fatty tacos and burgers !! Can't go wrong with some pork belly and eggs!

Second time here and they've expanded their menu.  Just popped in for a quick burger on my way home and I think it was better than the last time I was here.  I just had their americano burger this time around and tried their onion rings for the first time.  Whoa...  They have desserts now too and I really cannot say enough about the salted caramel zeppoles that have not already been said.   Nice to see the place busy.  Small establishments in Rutherford that serve excellent food are hard to come by.   Thanks again Bergen Burger - till next time........

Mama Rosa is a real neighborhood restaurant where you can eat comfort food in a relaxed, family atmosphere. You will actually find neighbors talking here like in a neighborhood bar.  Their pasta dishes are very good--like your mother would have made if she was Italian. I recommend the Chicken Soprano. Like most of their pasta dishes it is big enough to share with a friend and have leftovers. We have ordered a lot of takeout from them and have never been disappointed. My only complaint is that the pizza is good, but not great. Anyone going here for a gourmet experience may be disappointed but if you are looking for huge portions of comfort food, this is the place to go

Lots of people I know love this place - way overpriced for my Vermonter budget.  Won't go back unless someone else is paying.  $14 for 5 pieces of cheese and no bread or crackers?  No Way!  Went elsewhere for our entrees!

Amazing pizza. Huge, NJ boardwalk style slices that my kids loved! My kids stuck to plain slices but my husband and I tried the cheesesteak pizza, the roman pizza and the ginger pizza..they were all delicious.  Super clean place and there's even an arcade room inside with games and an air hockey table. We really enjoyed everything and will be back for pizza and funnel cake!
We ordered 3 different ceviches. Quality of ingredients was really good, seasoning not that much. Salmon entree was the highlight of the night. Great service. No pisco sour, :(
Nailed it: still talking about every course, days later.  We will be back.

Ok Starkies in Boonton NJ of all places is a great bar with outstanding food.  Yea it cost $$ but damn it is worth it.  I have lived and worked in bars for longer then I d like to admit but if you are looking for a nice bar place with good service snd consistantly good food stop by.  Do urself s favor and indulge and enjoy

I was craving for crepes really bad and i'm glad i found this place !!   The place is really small and has few seats (max 6 ppl ), so it's more like take out.   This is a snack/grab/munch establishment, not for a heavy lunch I ordered take out: Harajuku Fruit Cocktail (lots of fresh fruits), Mixed Berries Parfait (both crepes have whipped yogurt and custard cream at excellent portion  and not too heavy) and Chicken Thai , super delicious, highly recommended and love the wasabi tofu sauce. The crepes are thin and crispy and the way they were artistically prepped were so pretty I didnt want to eat it. Good thing i did coz they were amazing. Staffs are nice and friendly, you can see the staffs make the crepes at their table, the place is clean but a little bit small and i felt crowded but no biggie. Crepes are excellent, a bit pricey but worth it and i will definitely come back to try the others.

I ordered a large meatball pizza and a side of french fries with cheese and bacon for delivery. It took about 45 minutes to get here like they said and I found the fries to be exceptional and the pizza honestly was one of the better local pizzas I have tried. It's pie cut and doesn't taste like all those other square-cut pizzas you seem to be able to get around here. Would buy again.
My favorite Thai place in NYC! Great Ambience (loud, trendy, dark). MUST HAVE: chicken pad Thai and curry puffs.

Terrible. Stopped for a quick bite with the family during a road trip. Restaurant was not particularly busy. Cashier seemed to be annoyed at having to take our order. Took forever for food to be ready, then my husband's order was wrong. I eat at other D'Angelos often, and this was the worst experience I've had.

Take out is really good.  Way better than our dine-in experience.  There are 2 separate menus.  The Chubster Sandwiches are awesome and the pizza is thin crust.  The only thing keeping this from a 5 star review is the fact that our delivery guy was half an hour late.
Like I said about this place the service is horrible the location is great the restaurant is beautiful food is very good.., they just need better service but I don't think I'll be going back again

Great atmosphere! Tapas style food but everything was delicious. Fish tacos, raised short rib tacos, Mac n cheese and tater tots all amazing. Espresso martini is fresh and all other drinks were great. Service was great behind the bar. Food does come out at different times because of the tapas style. Definitely coming back!

Poor imitation of Pat's. Staff is equally as rude and abrasive. I tried their food only hoping that it would be better than Pat's, but that was a mistake. The bread is cold and stale. The sandwich was smaller than Pat's and had no taste. I found out later that the better steak sandwiches were elsewhere in Philly.

Court & I tried this place for the 1st time a few months back. And I gotta say it was worth the stop. Had to make a 2nd trip just to bring it home. Bad thing it's Saturday and they don't open until noon. But I was able to place an order so that it could be ready by 12. That's very convenient & a huge plus for me.
Food delivered quick and everything is prepared from scratch. They have a Sunday brunch and a prime rib special Sunday  nights. Happy hour is from 5 to 7 daily.

Went for Dinner after the theater. We had problems getting a cab so I called and told them we would be late. We arrived at 1130 pm and they close at 1 on Saturday. They were extremely friendly and escorted us to the back of the restaurant. The decor was amazing and cozy!!! I asked our server what she recommended and I was also with my mother and aunt. We ordered the Greek salad. No lettuce but it was outstanding!! We also had the saganaki again amazing!!! The 3 meals we had were the moussaka, braised short ribs, and lamb chops..all were FANTASTIC!!!! The manager came by to check on us. It was a fabulous experience and I would highly recommend it and will be back!!! Service, Food and over all experience were phenomenal!!!!!! A+++++

Great food, but the dishes we ordered were hit or miss: fantastic chicken and empanadas de pollo, decent salchichon, but terribly dry/bland tostones. We called-in, and the delivery was super efficient.

I've been here for both brunch and dinner and really enjoy it. The brunch wait is as described, so be prepared to get there early/wait around for a bit of time/find something to do nearby to kill off a bit of time. Their french toast and waffles are good. And the burger and fried chicken from dinner were both tasty. The prices are reasonable here, too.

I absolutely love the food; the crustinis are amazing and the entrees are great.  Every time I go there the service is good, the wine and food are great and I always can't wait to go back.  I think everyone should try UVA. Best, Chris

Cuban food fit for a king...coconut rice is a praise worthy side to entrees...the mambo king is a tasty favorite...but the chicken, pork chops, and shrimp are all delicious...definitely get appetizers...the maduros, pernil, black beans, & tostadas are all very tasty. The lollipop chicken with the garlic sauce are the wow factor here...absolutely delicious...i've tried every flavor mojito and they are phenomenal in flavor...bring your favorite wine to spike it and have a girl's night.

I was very disappointed in the food quality we order shrimp nachos that look like can cheese wiz on some stale chips with some mediocre shrimp in between. We had the endless shrimp that was nothing to write home about its a good thing that our gift card is good at several restaurant. ...

Stuffed is a perfect fit for Montclair. 100% grass fed burgers with fresh hand cut fries are welcome here. The menu is simple but there are many great choices. Get the Bacon Jam burger-you will come back to have it again. Same with bacon jam fries. Or just build your own. I have tried many variations-all are great. The atmosphere is comfortable and has a fun vibe with large screen tv and music. Staff and service were great.

The most confounding, irritating waitlist system where we were originally told 15-20 minutes, only to be told at the one hour mark that people who called ahead go to the front of the line.  As to why we weren't told up front it could be 15 mins or an hour and a half (at one hour four tables of two still ahead of us), "I'm sorry." So Sabrina, that sucks

Stopped in for breakfast to see what this new spot is all about. I have to say I was very impressed for a business just getting on their feet. Service was friendly and prompt. I ordered eggs Benedict which were delicious! not too much Hollandaise, crispy English muffin, and perfectly poached eggs. The manager Tom also came over to make sure everything was up to par which I found was a nice personal touch. He informed me that they will be making some updates to the decor which I am very excited to see. Will definitely be back to see how this place progresses!

Great dinner. We were here for Parents Weekend... so the city was packed. We had appetizers that were great... Crab and the Burrata... both were excellent For our main courses we had three.... Steak and fries - top marks from my daughter Pasta - amazing... homemade... perfect Fish (can not remember the kind)... but it was just right The waitress brought us free desert because there was some confusion over our appetizer order... they corrected that right away... so the free desert was not necessary... but really appreciated.
Awesome food.... Great staff... My Fav in NYC.... I now live and Tokyo and always find my way back for the Lobster Cannelloni... Best in the world.

I recently started following the "paleo lifestyle" after seeing (and more importantly, feeling) rather astonishing results from a 30-day paleo challenge.  Hu Kitchen, I believe, is one of the few places in New York that truly accommodates this diet -- and does so by offering a wide variety of tasty dishes.
