I generally go for the special of the day in order to mix things up but you can't go wrong with the everyday meals.  The 1/4 chicken is always good, as is the grandmaster veg smothered with the Hu Joe (I've recently learned this is called "The Diesel Parker").  And no trip to Hu Kitchen would be complete without a cup of Crack Coffee and a Crack Bar to go.   My hope is that we see more locations sprouting up around the city!

I came here last night with my boyfriend. Such a great experience!! The food was absolutely amazing! We had empanadas as an appetizer. AMAZING! I ordered the Caribbean shrimp fried rice and he had the shrimp with coconut lime sauce. We loved both dishes! Service is fantastic as well. We sat outside since it was a beautiful night, and they kept coming out to check on us. The place is BYOB so we brought our own bottle of wine, but they brought us out a wine bucket to chill our wine. Unexpected and very appreciated. They include the tip in the bill (18%) so that is also convenient. Will definitely be coming back soon!!

Found this place on yelp during a romantic getaway weekend. It's a quaint, friendly spot that wasn't too packed when we got there. I ordered the pancakes and sausage and, being the indecisive freak I am, shortly thereafter changed my order to the pumpkin pancakes. Earl had already started my pancakes, but he was happy to throw in a pumpkin mix and it was delicious. My girlfriend went all in, ordering the eggs, toast, bacon and home fries special. She finished it before I was half done my pancakes so they must have been good. Earl came out from the kitchen to greet us and ask me how my pancakes were, which was a nice touch. If I ever come back to burlington, I'll be sure to return.

So I now have two daughters at UVM  and they asked if we could go to Sweetwaters.  I agreed because maybe the last visit was an aberration.  I was wrong.  We called and asked to be put on the waiting list.  We told them we were a party of five.  They said there was no wait to come right in.  We walked in less than 5 minutes later and were told the wait would be over an hour.  From no wait to an hour in 5 minutes or less?  And an hour wait for food that is suspect at best? Stay away from the mismanaged 2nd rate hole.  Try Luenigs or the Church Street Tavern or even VPB. RUN AWAY from this place
This place deserves better ratings!  Their seafood salad, pastas, and the cheesesteak rolls are excellent!  I've never eaten in but the lady who answers the call is very nice.

This is the worst service I have ever witnessed. I waited for 5-10 minutes at a completely empty bar while the bartenders talked amongst themselves and worked on cocktails. No one acknowledged my presence, nor promised to serve me once they were finished with their orders. I left while maintaining eye contact with another server, who also refused to speak to me. Insane.

The good is decent as long as you go in with the understanding that you are getting bar food. I do love the outdoor patio as there just aren't enough places to have a drink outside on a beautiful day. It's a great place to go for a happy hour as the outdoor seating is conducive to groups and the bar is well stocked with a variety of options.

The pizza here is superb and I agree that it is the best in the neighborhood.  I like the ingredients at Motorino, but they have the "soft center" problem in their pies.  10 Devoe avoids that problem completely and has excellent (generous) toppings to go with their top-notch crust.  The crust at the outer edges might be a bit thick for some folks, but I like it.  We came in because we were Dieci fans and I have to say that I like 10 Devoe even better.  I am looking forward to the expanded menu too.  Just don't change the outstanding pizza!

I gave this place a try because I saw that they had a quinoa veggie burger + the ability to customize your burger. Although the reviews looked pretty bad, I actually liked BurgerFi.  Some of the staff members were a bit standoffish, but others were reasonably friendly. Personally, I'd prefer it if they did the ordering like The Counter (another custom burger chain) where you fill out a short card to list what you want. It's just easier than trying to tell someone what you want over the noise of a busy restaurant, and it seems to result in fewer errors. The veggie burger was delicious. Even if I didn't have a preference for vegetarian dishes where available, I would still be inclined to order the veggie burger over a traditional meat burger. It was just very, very good. Some veggie burgers are really soft and they smush out of the sides of the bun when you bite down, but that wasn't the case with this one. It had a slight crunch at the edges, and the middle was soft. I WOULD recommend getting at least one condiment or topping that adds some moisture, though. I could see how it might be a little dry without mayo, tomatoes, etc. I also liked that the burger wasn't enormous. There was an option to do a double or triple burger, but the single was the perfect size for a normal person who eats healthy portions. The fries with parmesan and herbs were also fantastic - highly recommended.   One more thing - if you want to get their food delivered, I noticed there's at least one local service that will deliver their food for a $20 minimum. Just Google "BurgerFi Philadelphia delivery" if you're curious (not going to promote a specific delivery service here).

They have a great beer selection, brews for two, special events to meet and greet with different breweries. The food is great, amazing selection of burgers, but the appetizers are big enough to be a meal.

I'll be honest, the quesadilla was amazing. However, it was amazing if all I could stomach was something that fit in the palm of my hand. The guacamole was served with a great selection of flavorful chips, but the guac itself had little to no flavor. Chipotle has a more tasty guacamole than this. We had to ask for hot sauce to add flavor.
Went here for lunch on a Saturday. Great food and service!
The lady that answers the phone has a bad attitude she's very rood and unprofessional she needs serious help mentaly im very disappointed.

This is fun place with a very welcoming atmosphere. We had the flavored vodkas and they were really tasty, you hardly noticed their potency. The borscht, of course is what most people went for near us and we were no different, both of us ordering it. We stuck to the old reliables. Vodka and borscht. It's like we were in Fiddler on the Roof or something. I recommend KTB for an authentic experience, although I can't be 100% certain it is true to Ukrainian culture but it certainly feels like it is. I will be going back for more fun and more vodka too.
Dinner here was ok, but tastes were bland and uninteresting. All in all a little too expensive for what you get.

Don't recommend the place. Food was okay but menu was very limited and for the price you pay its small portions. Also the seating made the place very school cafeteria style rather than a romantic/Cozy setting I was looking for. Honestly will not return for Business. Veggie Heaven is still at the top for me personally.
Pizza is well priced and great tasting but the customer service isn't that good. It took a long time to deliver my pizza.

The hype brought me here. The pizza made me linger. Upside - The pizza was good. I mean I'm not a fan of artichokes so that made a little bias going in but to my surprise it didn't taste too bad at all. Of course it will take a bit more to convert me to full artichoke eater but this was a start. The service was quick (once you got past the line) but that's baseline expectation for a pizza shop. Downside - seating isn't that great, lines are long and cash is king (ok this was my fault mom always told me to carry more than 5$ in my wallet). I'll have to try another flavor next time.

I cannot vouch for the food.    However.  I walked in after watching several people walk out, and I waited at the hostess station for a solid three minutes before being acknowledged.  I was the only person there.   I used to work in the restaurant business, and quick acknowledgement goes a long way.  I was about to walk out when one of them finally paid attention to me.  I saw plenty of empty tables by the bar area and in the dining room.  The bar was not packed, but moderately busy.  I asked how long for a table for two and the hostess had a blank look on her face and kept shaking her head no.   When she finally spoke she said it's reservations only.  IMO, that policy sucks.  Yes we were there for a show but clearly they were not busy at NICO.   Honestly no matter what people say, I would never attempt to go there again.   We walked over to Don Pepe where we were greeted quickly and warmly, seated right away and had a delightful preshow meal.
Very tasty diner, I got an egg white omelette with sweet potatoes and roasted broccoli and I was very pleased!! So nice to have gluten free, vegan options at such a quaint location!
The food there is amazing. The Philly sandwich is a "must have"! I was trully impressed by the colors and diversity of food and people.

I had read about Marigold many, many times before, and finally decided to try it for our fifth anniversary. I wanted something unique to surprise my husband, and Marigold did not disappoint. From the second we walked in, you could tell that service was a key focus for this establishment. They recalled the specifics of my peanut allergy , as well as the fact that it was our anniversary, details I had provided when making our reservation. I can not even put into words how amazing the food was. This is a meal I will never forget. Each course was impeccable, and so incredibly creative. Standards like pork and beans and eggs benedict took on a new, reimagined, and delicious light. To top it off, the staff did everything they could to facilitate an amazing experience. There is absolutely no doubt that I will be recommending Marigold in the future. Thank you for making our fifth wedding anniversary so memorable!
Great hole in the wall spot! Lots of options and service is quick and friendly. This is a good option for folks that want a delicious bowl of ramen but can't stand the wait at ippudo.

I was invited to a Birthday party by some friends at a new hotel in LIC it was a Thursday night if I remember correctly so I went, and to my surprise it was a Mundo a rest that was in my Street and that I loved! Was very happy to see that they were reopening in a different location but to my great surprise not only they were reopening but the scale of there new location is amazing, it was a Party to remember the music the performers I mean I have not been to a party on this level in A really long time it's something that you expect of a new year party but yeah there on a Thursday :-)  the food amazing as always (red lentil in lettuce) the cake!!!! and everything else as good as always but in a space that can really match there food and warmth yes Mundo always feels like your at home!!!!! Very happy it's back!!!!
Excellent excellent place!!!! Beautiful place, amazing service, great food and drink!!!! Excellent excellent! I truly recommend and I want to return as soon as possible!
If you are not hungry and ready to spend money, go there! These are the smallest portions i have ever seen. I wouldnt fred my baby with such small portions. And im a 158 lbs guy...
Our waiter, the bartender, the owner, the chef = absolutely amazing. Best experience. Best food. Best night. Crazy laughs.

I had my family mini party here! Everyone in my family loves the Chinese BBQ, including my Italian boyfriend and his family ^0^ I am grateful for the sweet memory. If you like BBQ, I highly recommend this place.

Great place to go for lunch, I absolutly love the hamburgers with fried egg, bacon and avacodo, out of this world. Some of the events they host are a big hit from fundraisers to the Soccer tournments live, on the big screen!!! Summer of 2014 was the most exciting to the neighborhood, they always draw a large crowd and everyones happy and cheerful, never have I seen an upset customer,(maybe its the irish in them) :) but all and all I give this palce a score of a 100% Cant beat that!!! If your looking for a friendly envirnment, good food , good people and good entertainment well this is it!!!

Udupi cafe is a quaint little place, simple in its layout and very ordinary seats & ambiance. However the food is wonderful and what one may call comfort food. The set dosa and potato sagu is my favorite and we would do the 30 min drive to have a meal there without a second thought.

Was very surprised to see Prime 16 in orange yelp rating at three stars. I've been to prime 16 in New Haven many times and it's easily a five star burger joint Just made my first trip to the Prime 16 and Orange and was equally impressed as I was in New Haven. It's a much bigger space so you don't get that intimate feeling of the New Haven style pub...but the food was terrific.   My wife the patty melt on multigrain bread with a side salad and she was in heaven. I have the Latino burger that was quick to perfection.   I highly recommend

Made reservations on Friday nite for my boyfriends birthday...wanted the night to be special Although we were ten minutes late we were told we would have to wait alittle. No problem..we were late.we only waited 15 minutes.!! The staff was very friendly. And very accommodating. The drinks were great. The appetizers ..arepas and mac and cheese amazing. The salmon was not to die for..needed seasoning. However ..the humor and personality of our waitress Felicia made everything taste better. The shots and then desert with a sparkling candle topped it off perfectly. The view is amazing..would love to go back at sunset. The floor manager Flex ..aka Matt was also amazing...thanks coach! The music was perfect for the occasion. I love Spanish music. After coffee and a walk along the water..the nite was a hit!! Thanks for a memorable evening. .

Everything this place makes is amazing.  Burritos, salads, bowls, smoothies, desserts, ect... I go here at least twice a week and they never dissapoint.  The service is always great and the staff is awesome. Always greeted when you enter. The food is always made fresh along with the homemade guacamole and pico de gallo.  My favorite item here has to be the Fresh Squeezed lemonade that is made right when you order it.  Way better than Chipotle in every aspect.  This place is also very clean and everything looks brand new.  Try this place ASAP...BYOB

Just having finished a shawarma and chicken sandwich, I find myself drooling over this review. This vendy is nothing short of "Supercalifragilisticespialidocious;" every good memory in my life flashes in my mind as I take a bite. Paired up with free solid falafel, line or not, professional, courteous, and friendly service, and sheer convenience, the only thing I wonder is why they are only King, and not Ruler of the Free World. Having lived in multiple cities in the world, I can not think of a better business that I would buy stock in if they went public. To top it off, one of my first visits a few weeks back was with some friends from Florida who are soon to be married. As a wedding gift, they jokingly asked me for some of King's food, to which the owner not only loved and welcomed, but offered me assistance in making it happen for my good friends. If I could use two, unvulgar words (while vulgar, still a great and raving review), to describe King, I would have to say "stand up", as in the kind of man I try to be, someone you can always depend on.
Flavors are so mild. Both breakfast burrito and steak tasted like nothing Mexican ever came out of that kitchen. Cheese on breakfast burrito is gas station-esq Nacho cheese/cheese wiz.
The food was a bit Greasy but it wasn't bad! Chicken was undercooked but  they cooked it again! Overall, this place is alright but not  a big fan of it!
Waited 20 minutes for menu then another 20 minutes for a drink. Lots of excuses for poor service. Good bye,  so disappointed.

Went here last night.  We had the baked brie en croute as an appetiser ($8.99).  I didn't know how to eat it so the server enlightened me.  I didn't really care of it, but it's the first time I'd ever tried something like that so it might be just my own personal preferences.  For the main meal, I ordered the grilled NY strip steak with smoked gouda roasted potatoes and green beans ($23.99).  The steak was cooked the way I ordered it (rare) but it was tough and had no flavor.  The potatoes were ok but didn't have much flavor either.  I thought maybe it was just me, but my friend ordered the same thing and also thought the steak and potatoes were lacking in flavor. The green beans were good, but you only get like eight, which I thought was a little skimpy.  We didn't have a wait a long time for the food, and the service and atmosphere was great.  If I were to go back, I'd probably order something "safe" and less expensive, like a burger or something.

This was my first time visiting Jose Tejas.... But definitely not the last.  I ordered the chicken Quesadias and I think that these were THE BEST chicken quesadias I have ever tasted in my life. I give this restaurant 5 stars...
Great place! You should try!
Good food and friendly:) not very big its a cute cozy place. I had the chicken wrap with the sauce that comes with it and fries and was very satisfied, I couldn't even finish it.
Excellent food, staff was very attentive.  I really enjoyed my experience here and will be back again.
Really great food. Great service from Sebastian. The wings were spot on and the Reuben Panini was outstanding.

I am always happy to have a new option for brunch in the neighborhood, and these reviews sounded great so I dragged my partner here this morning expecting the great food described by everyone else, but I think I passed through a wormhole under the BQE into a parallel universe where this restaurant's kitchen is staffed by a 12 year old who read a cookbook once. Except for the peach juice (delicious, everyone should serve this!) which the bartender suggested I drink when I found out they don't have any iced tea, *everything* we ordered was genuinely *terrible*-- this was honestly the worst meal I've ever had in a restaurant in NYC, perhaps ever, except for a restaurant on the side of the road in western NC once. The place itself, which was cute, was mostly empty, but our food was taking forever, and we were starving, so we flagged down the waitress and asked for the bread basket, which sounded nummy. It had some extreeemely dense biscuits; some cornbread that has the texture of a loofah sponge, as if the cook had dumped twice as much baking powder in it as required, and just as much salt; and some other cornbread-like thing that had a dollop of raspberry stuff baked inside which had no flavor at all. They served us three little dollops of toppings for this; some jelly, something which was either nut puree or bacon something (we couldn't figure it out and didn't touch it except for the initial curious taste); and a very cinnamony butter thing? Not good. My partner got scrambled eggs with sausage, toast, and home fries. The eggs were those dry, shredded strings of overcooked and under-scrambled egg, full of yellow and white streaks, that you make the first time you try and have to scrape out of the pan onto the plate. The sausage was almost inedibly salty. The hash browns were weird slices of potato soaked in oil. Even the toast was dry and bad. I got the fried chicken and waffles. The chicken was chewy and overcooked, and the batter was like what you'd put on onion rings, except the salt was missing (maybe they ran out after making the cornbread and sausage). The waffle seemed to be made of bread dough; if you ordered two, you could play ping pong using them as paddles. It was served with more cinnamon stuff and the most insanely vinegary buffalo wing sauce I ever had. (My partner did point out it cut the grease of the potatoes nicely.) I kept hoping the waitress would not perkily ask us how everything was, because I couldn't be my normal non-confrontational bright-side self after this meal. Luckily, there was minimal service also; everyone who came to our table was friendly but they never really ever came back to check on anything. We got the check, overpaid obscenely for this deep disappointment, and skedaddled as soon as we could. I can find something to like about most places I go, but, wow. Awful.
Have been here three times so far and I like every dish we got. The food comes fast and it's authentic Chinese food. They don't take card if the bill is under 20.

nice south philly place if your looking for quiet this is not the place, they have a jukebox you can play songs off. beers are hopping beers, some with big ACH count. the Brisket is ridiculous, it is amazing and you dont even need to cut it it it just pulls apart the pork is also great, it melts in your mouth, potato salad , corn bread is awesome, dessert pecan pit, i had root beer float. for the 4 of us it was 150.00, a bit pricey but worth every penny if you are in the mood for some really good Barbeque. i would come back again in a heart beat

We have visited Wild Wood Fired Pizza twice now and it just keeps getting better! The owner is very friendly and provides good service. On our first visit we enjoyed two small pies and an order of buffalo wings. We were so pleasantly surprised by how good everything was, that we brought a friend for dinner the other night. We have tried the Mushrooms and Red Onions pie, Braised Lamb, Roasted Lemon and Oregano pie and the Classic Margherita pie. All of them are delicious! The ingredients are clearly high quality, healthy and fresh. The buffalo wings are in the top 3 of best in Bayonne, in our opinion. As Arnold would say, "I'll be back!" They offer a unique style of pizza that the community should embrace.
Nice place with all sorts of spices and cheap. Make sure that you take cash. If it is less than $10.00, they will charge you a .30 cents service charge. RIDICULOUS!

Lovely atmosphere.  Perfect service.  Food was great, too. Very nice early dinner option. Only shortcoming was a loud woman laughing like a hyena two tables over, and the tile surfaces made her screeching even louder.....ouch!   Delicate desserts....really special.

Once you've crossed the street, the entrance catch up your attention. There's a unique place in the midst of Broadway. Once inside Lillie's, you immediately noticed you're in a place where quality & attention walk together. You can go with friends before or/& after a musical -it is extremely closed from the main Broadway theatres-. The service is really nice and professional. The manager is always available and look after the clients, making them feel like home. The variety of drinks is wide and amazing. You have excellent beers, whiskeys and cocktails -you have to taste the Donna Bella-. Unfortunately, we don't have enough time to taste the food, so, Lillie's , make a reservation for this tourist (:

I hardly ever write reviews but I had to say something about this awesome place. We tried to come here for dinner before our show but they were booked. The hostess Bella was very apologetic and invited us to come back after the show and she would make sure we were taken care of. We returned at 11 and the place was still packed but true to her word, Bella found a place for us at the bar and then proceeded to bring chairs over for all 6 of us. Who knew you could find such personal service near Times Square? She kept checking up on us to be sure we were happy. The drinks were well made and quickly delivered. The scotch selection was pretty decent. The bar munchies were also good. If you add in the really unique Victorian decor this place is worth a visit. I'll be back for sure.

I was excited to try moto but was sadly disappointed. I came with a party of ten, we had reservations. This place only seats 20. One hour wait for our order to be taken. Another hour and a half and finally the food arrived. Only until we told then we were here for 2.5 hours did they offer two free bottles of wine. The food was decent for boxed pasta and small servings. But due to the serving or lack of it and their long waits, they lost ten potential new customers tonight. We all agreed we would never be back.

WORST ATTITUDE I HAVE EVER RECEIVED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! After 10 minutes I walked to the store, nobody comes by to say hello or sit me or ask me to wait. I asked the waitress walking by "Can I order now". She pointed me to another waitress, who is serving another customer who came LATER into the restaurant than me......I FOUND A TABLE MYSELF and WAVED to a coming waitress I'm ready to order, who saw me but chose to IGNORE me. I talked to the this waitress and asked for reason of her behavior and expressed my willing to talk to her manager. She said "Go ahead!". Btw, I'm the only Asian in the restaurant. Is there any other reason besides RACIAL DISCRIMINATION to explain their awful attitude?!!!!! Ironically, it is an ASIAN restaurant but only friendly to NON-ASIAN.
Great romantic spot. The people really put effort to treat you very well. Great dishes. Salmon tartar, duck and grilled salmon is really good.
Loved the place!! Seafood paella is awesome!! Staff is friendly and helpful. Cant wait to come back there.. Just don't order any fancy Manhattan drinks, like "Sidecar"

OMG!!!!This pizza place is great,tasty original Italian pizza..i come here often on my lunch break,even took some home to my parents and family,they loved it...kept asking me for more....lol..oh yes Pizza boss" John" besides being very handsome guy,his friendly,respectful and polite,he knows how to treat his customers..and his staff,very sweet,hard working..decent too..smily,happy place..i recommend all..
Decent food. Cash only.

We were surprised to stumble into this gem just by chance. Great food at decent prices, and the service was superb. The waitress helped us convert a steak special to be more like the steak dish on the menu, since the special was somehow larger but also cheaper? Weird circumstance but we appreciated the assistance and ended up with leftovers to take home. Though there was ample seating when we strolled in around 7:30 on a Friday night, the place was getting busy by the time we left about an hour later, so you may have a wait if you are seeking to sit in primetime. Two big flavorful entrees, two tasty sides and two drinks came to just under $60. Worth it.
We went because we are big Sunny fans. So for that, it's worth it. The food was okay, the music was good, the beer list was okay, and the waiter was pretty good.

We ended up here when the other places had too long a wait (and can be noisy and dark) and had a nice meal! The menu said that it was new and my friends recalled it as more of a teen hangout. My grilled chicken salad with grilled onions was good; my friend had a tasty thai chicken pizza and another in our group had a very yummy, garlicky pizza.  Waitress Lauren was super friendly and the service was prompt.  It was quiet (around 8 pm) so pleasant to chat with friends.

This was an extremely disappointing meal.  Hors d'oeuvres were fine (hamachi, potato croquettes, arepas) although  we had to pay $7 extra for a third arepas (we were 3 people and an order of arepas only has 2).  The main courses were AWFUL.  The suckling pig had no skin and was only very thin pieces of pig with not much flavor. The Paella was completely insipid, with no saffron, very few small shrimp, some mussels, one scallop and tiny pieces of sausage. The rice was red but NO flavor. When we told the server how disappointed we were with the Paella, they sent over desserts and champagne (actually Prosecco) which we didn't want.  The desserts were fine.  Service is friendly, the prices are way too high.
best itialian food in the whole entire world. I would keep writing here for days if my hands didn't get tired

Food was okay. Not that great. Not that bad. I posted a pic if you look through them of the mouse that came out during dinner. Listen, I know it's NYC but when a mouse has guts to come out in a packed restaurant....it shows what's going behind those kitchen doors. If you feel like eating Turkish food, buy a cookbook and cook at home.
Pretty boring food and bad service: appetizers and entrees came at almost the same time. Would not recommend.
Overrated! Good but doesn't deserve 4.5 stars. Food is too simple, atmosphere is nice yet too crowded.
Food was great. Wine was good. Best of all the bathroom was clean and smelled amazing.... this says a lot to me.
Huge line.  Service was lacking, but the price and the quality of the food made it worth it.

I have never written a yelp review before, but had to after my experience tonight. Let me start by saying our waitress went above and beyond for us in help and politeness. The manager was a different story. She screamed at me for asking how we could best split checks, called me profane names, and told me it wasn't her job to figure it out. She then left the waitress to help me, making it impossible for the waitress to manage her other tables. When I asked the waitress about her behavior, she said it was an ongoing issue. All I can say is it's clear the manager deserves a demotion, fast.

All hype. Rude and abrasive staff... this is coming from a New Yorker! The bread was boring, steak cut too thick to chew through, cheese was optional and was just cheese whiz. I drove down from NYC just to try this hyped up joint since so many people recommended it, only to be disappointed. The local Kennedy's Fried Chicken in the ghetto neighborhoods can put together a better sandwich. Don't waste your time.
Killer!!!  Get the Goats neck and the smoked mussles!!! Had a great meal and it's a really cool atmosphere.
It's embarrassing how bad the service is at this place I'll never be back. Slow rude not knowledgeable about the menu.  Checked every box
Really good food but the meals are small, the staff was attentive and the mood was very relaxed and the price was moderate
The food is good.  The service not so much.  I've been a bartender and a server before and I know exactly what a good service is.  Makes me not want to leave a tip.

All I can say is, go and enjoy the wonderful attentiveness of the owners and brothers, Thibault and Alex.  The food is good and they go out of their way to please.  Reading some of the reviews (which are good and well deserved), there are some that aren't worth paying attention to (sorry earlier reviewers).  You will be pleased, we were, and have been back several times.  The food keeps getting better and the wines are great.  Keep up the good work guys!

Food was good. .. environment comfortable to bring friends to so why should I give it 1 star?  Our waitress gave us no attention.  She thought it was more important to converse with her friends while she's working . Her name Nastassja . I'm not one to complain but that service was horrible!  My advice don't take her as a waitress if your a minority

First time visit, will definitely return! As previous reviews have stated, the restaurant can get very packed very fast. My boyfriend and I arrived at the restaurant for an early dinner around 3-4pm and were able to be seated immediately. However, when we exited the restaurant, the line for seating was CRAZY! So get there early!! The decor and vibe of the restaurant was very comfy but could get a little noisy. The price of the food was equivalent to the decor on the tables and things like that. (Fancy glasses & seats..etc..) The menu was great BUT did not include descriptions of the food so I did find myself using my phone to google ingredients in chicken Marsala and other unknown food dishes. Each dish serves 2-4 people! My boyfriend and I ordered chicken Marsala over angel hair pasta and we ate as much as possible while still being able to take two doggy bags full of food back home! Service was quick and extremely friendly! No complaints whatsoever! Only concern is that with a big group of people we may not be able to fully agree on one dish to share haha but with a compromise everyone can be happy. Our plate was $30 (give or take a little) & we requested the chicken be cooked over pasta  (which was an extra $10) so we ended up with a bill of $43 for two people. Pricey.... But good food and lots of leftovers so I'm not completely dissatisfied. Overall, nothing but positive vibes and a positive review. My only negative is the lack of descriptions on the menu. But nothing too serious. I would also not suggest coming here if you desire a nice quiet romantic date... The place is noisy, packed and always moving...

It's solid Italian food, but probably over priced. Place is a bit touristy, but for this neighborhood it's some of the best Italian. I say come for lunch it's quieter and cheaper and the food is the same.

Girls night out! Everything was fantastic! All food, wait staff was great!  Just don't park in the parking lot next store! It is unmarked and we came out with an envelope from pro park stating we owed 25.00

The food was great. The atmosphere was awesome.  Sadly, the service was horrible. The servers had an awful attitude after the kitchen messed up the order and actively tried to persuade our table to accept a burger we didn't order. There was no apology, no offer to fix the mishap. After placing the request for the original order the server had an awful demeanor, as well as the audacity to drop off the check at a table of 6 with the words "don't worry guys, I already added the tip into the bill." NEVER GOING BACK TO THIS HOLE IN THE WALL.
This place was amazing. I have a special "gluten free" friend and they completely accommodated her with a cider beer. I'm simply thrilled with the service. #glutenfreesupporters

Showed up for dinner (on a Friday night) without a reservation and was told the wait was 45 minutes. The host was courteous and within 30 minutes we had a table. We had the best server ever. Isabel you rock. Her recommendations were on point and she did everything she could to make it a pleasant evening. Excellent service. Great place to hang out on a Friday evening. Oh yeah, the salmon and ribs were on point.

Fantastic service for out a Friday night dinner for two! The owner Captain was very personable and welcomed us at our table! The waiter's assistant/bus boy was our favorite! He was very charming and wore a classy bow tie. The appetizer Spiedini alla Romana was delicious, a must try! Shrimp Fettuccine Alfredo and Rigatoni Vodka were our main courses. Great dishes but portions were relatively small in comparison to other fine dining Italian restaurants. Definitely recommend!
The best. The line is always down the block but moves very fast. Always a great option. Their white sauce is the best I've ever had.
The hot sauce is really good and the rice is nice but honestly the meat is not that good and it is too dry overall.
Good food, decent prices, but don't go when it's busy. The servers are stressed out and rude especially the girl with the long blond curly hair.
Broth is amazinggggg And vegetables are very fresh Beef brisket cooked to tenderness Chicken chop is perfect too :) Platter is of big portion but mediocre taste

I had never had empanadas ever! Such a find because its very small. Great food, great taste, and most of all, price! My favorite is jalepeno and cheese, so spicy but so good! Don't forget their ice cream. I've had them all!

$40 for 2 medium pizza's....really...? Ordered pizza from Pi without reading reviews...and for sure get punished for that...was expecting reasonable average price for university town...Pizza quality far below average...grease ball with sour canned mushrooms. This place is a shame...and...really: $40 for 2 medium pizza of - at best - mediocre quality... Conclusion: avoid

Best burgers ever, staff is always so nice and i never have a bad time. I always get the manly burger and truffle fries- you HAVE to get the truffle fries! Got the apple pie for desert. Would have been better if it was warm but it was still so good! Best!

Tonight was my first time visiting Pho Thanh Huong, after many times going to Saigon pho and thinking that was the best pho place around. I am very pleased to say that I will never be going back to Saigon pho again. Whereas Saigon just cares about rushing you in and out (once we were even turned away for arriving a little more than half an hour prior to closing time!) in Thanh Huong you can really sense how proud they are of their food. The staff is exceptional and takes the time to recommend favorite dishes as well as offer a very knowledgeable explanation of any of the dishes you may have a question about. I definitely look forward to going back again. Better food, better atmosphere, and friendlier, welcoming people.

One of the best dining experiences I've had in Philly! My date and I did not have reservations (it was a kind of last minute decision), but the staff was very accommodating and even on a Saturday night we were seated within an hour. We spent our time waiting at the bar where the drinks were great (I had the Pear Grapefruit Fizz which came with a delicious slice of Asian pear in it). We had our appetizer (Ahi Tuna Tartare--highly recommend!) at the bar since it was full menu. We also ended up getting the Bubbles and Berries and the Black Orchid at dinner. The Black Orchid was definitely best tasting but Bubbles and Berries get extra points for presentation! The ambience was perfect for a fancier date and the waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu. We ended up getting the Lobster Bisque and French Onion soups to start and for the entree we had the Salmon Teriyaki and the Chilean Sea Bass both of which were delicious. Highly recommend the sea bass! The truffle sauce on the mashed potatoes was perfect!

Missing on the basics!   Dined during Ct Restaurant week  - their menu published on line promoted CT wines as part of this week long event  Unfortunately neither were actually available- rather some inexpensive generic Chilean cab/malbec blend was what was being offered - definite bait and switch   The chicken parm meatballs were just ok - nothing really special  In contrast the pumpkin / crab bisk was very good   Our waitress was absent during service - bread came 20 mins after the apps - and then rationed to 1 thin slice per person   The entrees- Fettucine Carbonara,Pork Osso Buco, and Steak Diane were also very good  - freshly graded parmesan cheese was not offered until several mins after being served   Expressos are served in a funky styled cup but lacked the traditional lemon rind   Parking can be challenging - you have Pratt street or a handful of spots on Main St - surprising Sorella does not offer valet parking   To sum up - food is good overall  - service needs work - promoted wines should be offered

A great new spot in Astoria for real Italian + a friendly atmosphere.  My husband + I try new places often and if we return, it's a great sign.  We've been back 4 times since they opened and each time the food, wine + service were great!  They even accommodated a 7 person party with ease and only a small wait at the bar - where a friendly bartender offered me a few tastes of red so I could decide on a favorite. The risotto (the flavors rotate) has been amazing on two occasions.  It's by far the largest portion of an entree available.  A friend did find the ravioli entree portion to be on the smaller side but that doesn't bother me at good restaurants since it's a good match when ordering both appetizers + dessert as well.   Speaking of which, Vite has made me a believer in Tiramisu - which I have never enjoyed before tasting their version!  Order it. My favorite from the start were the small glass tumblers used for wine.  It's a sweet touch and realistic one since the venue + tables are cozy.   The striped cloth napkins got me too, which all ties into an authentic Italian restaurant + a class act addition to Astoria.  Thank goodness for Vite!

A very disappointing experience at a place I once frequent: On 10 17 2014 me & my brother Bobby met up at Algarve's Restaurant in Elizabeth after work.We ordered sangria & our meal.After receiving our food & eating, Bobby noticed something in his spinach which happened to be a bug.He then asked me to validate what he pretty much already knew & I confirmed that indeed it was a bug.We then brought it to the owner's & manager's attention. They down played it saying"it's only a bug".Upon adding insult to injury they absolutely refused to comp our bill as a result of.When we responded that we were very unhappy with their actions the manager inform us that he couldn't absolve us from the bill totally only 25% which sounded ludicrous.So after expressing to him how insulted & disappointed we were at a establishment where we spend a lot of $$$ weekly. We decided to exit the premises vowing never to eat there again, so then the Owner/Manager says to us you'll be back in a very condescending way...The bottom line is,we know that 2 customers won't really make a difference when it comes to their profits.....BUT MAYBE JUST MAYBE WE CAN COLLECTIVELY..... A lot of us eat at this restaurant but if they are not going to do right by us when called upon.....WHY SHOULD WE!
Best for two. Get 1-2 items and share.

I go here all the time for my favorite drink, frozen margaritas, and my favorite food, steak nachos. They do those two foods very well. I've tried other things on their menu--burritos, tacos, and plantains--and they're good as well. Complimentary salsa and chips are great and much better than you can get in a store.

This was one of the most bizarre restaurant experiences that I have ever had. Long story short, I was served two glasses of milk--one servable but close to spoiling, one clearly sour to both of us eating. I wasn't comfortable eating French toast made with milk after that experience. According to the below, the manager tasted both glasses and found them to be fresh, so he left our meal as-is. I'm not going to call him a liar--maybe his sense of taste is overwhelmed after tasting food all the time, or there's some other issue where he honestly didn't notice. Also, it's true that I was getting emotional, so I can believe that he didn't want to come near the table. At any other restaurant, though, there would have been a number of customer service courtesies that weren't followed here: 1) Offer me an opportunity to order something else and let me pay for it; 2) Provide a small courtesy, like a free iced tea or something other than milk; 3) Comp some or all of my food. None of those things were followed here. Also, the last time I checked, isn't a restaurant supposed to err on the side of finding that the customer is right? And for the record, though the French toast tasted fine and I was hungry, I was too busy thinking about spoiled milk in the kitchen and the lack of a resolution to this to be happy with my experience. If I had to speculate as to what happened here, perhaps senior management is breathing down the manager's neck so much about maximizing profits or wasted food that he's reluctant to do anything. Since I'm a local, I'll probably go somewhere else next time. I'm posting my email, truncated for here, and his response. --- Dear Green Eggs: ...When my milk arrived, it was servable but slightly sour. I complained to another server who came to my table by mistake and asked for another glass of milk. My fiancee and I both agreed that the replacement was completely sour and spoiled.... When the manager came over to my table, he told me that he had tasted the first glass of milk himself when I sent it back and that it was fine. I told him that the second glass of milk was completely spoiled and that because French toast was made with milk, after two sour glasses of milk I felt like I didn't want to eat the French toast that I had ordered anymore. ... I was served the French toast that I originally ordered, and when the bill came, I was charged the full amount minus $3 for milk I didn't drink, $32.40. ... The message that you sent to me today is that you don't take your customers seriously... Joe --- Joe, I was actually the manager that you had the discussion with about the spoiled milk. First, I'd like to thank you for how well you handled the situation. I know that you may believe that you lost your cool, but I truly (and I told you at the table) don't believe that you did. Many customers would have been in my face attempting to physically harm me over the milk, but you used your words and treated me with respect, which I greatly appreciated. When you first came to the counter, you told me about your milk, which I was already told by Joy about. She brought over a small glass and the bottle to me and asked me to try it. I tried the milk, and inspected the date on the package. The "Sell By" date on the milk was for 10/20/14 and I tried the milk myself and it was not spoiled to my taste. I had the busboy bring up fresh milk and dump that container anyway, because that is a major issue, food poisoning can come very easily from those items. I tried the milk and inspected the date again, and it was to my standards. I understand your concern with this milk and the french toast milk being the same, but it is not. We use whole milk for our french toast and the Tiramisu French Toast that you ordered. This batter was checked in the morning for freshness by myself, the Chef de Cuisine, and his Sous Chef in our daily line check. After I removed the milk from the table, I went to check on your food to make sure that it was perfect, and again, to my standards, it was. I returned with Joy at the table and your fiance clearly didn't want us to keep coming back and discussing the matter with you. She was frustrated and I didn't want you both to have a terrible experience. After you received your food, I talked with Joy to make sure that everything was okay and she assured me that it was. I poked my head in the room, privately, to make sure that everything was going well and you seemed, to my eyes, to be enjoying your Tiramisu tremendously. I understand that maybe the milk wasn't to your liking, so I took it off, even though I believe that the milk was safe and okay to drink and I received no other complaints throughout the entire shift. Also, each time I left the table, I excused myself to check on either your complaint or your food or something directly related to your experience. I apologize for your experience and please feel free to email me back if you have any questions Franco C. Assistant General Mgr
Nice one.
Ok the best thing I've ever eaten between 2 pieces of bread. Seriously if I'm within 100 miles ill make the trip. How can they redefine the philly cheese steak? I have no idea.
The interior is really pretty, and the food was good too, the price is reasonable, and the waiters are really cute lol I would totally recommend this place to anyone and everyone !!

Worst service ive ever seen. Counter girl started yelling at me when I asked why i was missing some of my food in the bag. Got no refund...rather than saying sorry, she told me shes been working there too long to deal with me.. im not sure what that means. When I asked for her name she told she doesnt have to disclose that information!

Anthony's is one of my all time favorite restaurants. I started by stopping in for a cup of coffee after yoga, and have moved up to occasionally ordering a week's worth of food for a family. No matter how big or small my order, they have always been friendly and helpful. I'm not surprised he's offered to personalize menu items to accommodate someone's dietary needs. He's offered me similar accommodations and even sent me instructions for how to prepare his delicious ravioli that he sells over the holidays so I could wow my family despite my limited skills in the kitchen. The owner & staff are truly the nicest people - which makes the experience that much more amazing. The brunches are incredible, the lunches are delicious and always changing, but by far the best time to go to Anthony's is for Thursday night dinner. The menu is always creative - putting a twist on your favorite comfort foods. AND it's BYOB - does it get much better? I honestly cannot say enough good things about Anthony's - and I stand by my words as I've brought numerous friends along at different times - all of whom have fallen in love. And so, I can't help but address a post about Anthony being argumentative - I find it hard to believe. I've gone enough that friends joke he can plan his retirement on me. Though rare, I have seen him exhausted. And I've seen him swamped, but never seen him nasty. I'm not saying people - and restaurants - can't have off days, and if someone caught such a day, it's really unfortunate, because this place is a hidden gem. However, if you're saying you've had repeated instances of food that was stale, not well seasoned, or orders that have been delayed while simultaneously calling yourself a long paying customer who generally likes the food, that seems a little contradictory. Not saying you couldn't have a bad experience, but suggesting its par for the course is not even close to an accurate description of this place. So, for anyone else thinking of checking out this restaurant, I HIGHLY recommend you head over and try it for yourself. Given the fact that he majority of the reviews are outstanding, I am confident you won't be disappointed.

New place since late summer early fall 2014. I've ordered cheesesteak, burrito paisano, burrito mariachi, taco salad, chicken cutlet wrap, 2 XL pepperoni, 1 large bacon sausage &broccoli pizza. Everything was great. Grinders are as good or better tasting than Joey garlics. The Place is clean. I live around the corner and have been to all the restaurants that existed here. Aside from Ella's which was here in 2011, this is the best. The pizza passes my kids test & I love the grinders and Mexican food. Please give this place a try. It's pretty good.
Cheap, tasty and friendly

I stopped in on a Sunday and sat at the bar to watch some football. I was immediately impressed with the cleanliness and wide open feel of this place. The bar was sleek and well decorated with color changing lights in the center with two large TVs on either side playing Sunday NFL.   I was greeted by the bartender who made me feel quite welcome and comfortable. I decided not to have one of the 2 dozen or so beer options. I even rejected the idea of having some Whistle Pig or another local spirit. If I wasn't driving, I would have had plenty of local brew or booze options. I was impressed with the menu. It was concise and had plenty of options for a variety of cravings. The bartender recommended the spicy burger. I thought that sounded good but I have a weakness for Boucher Blue in Highgate. The Green Mountain burger came to me perfectly medium rare and juicy with good seasoning and sear. It was topped with a good portion of the cheese along with maple bacon (I think - I don't quite remember it being there) arugula, tomato and slightly sweet picked onions. I asked for extra garlic aioli on the side so I could dip my fries in it. It had a mellow garlic flavor which complimented the contents of the burger. The fries were hand cut and served crispy and they complimented the aioli. The brioche bun was just ok. I would have liked to have more texture and a little less sweetness. My burger would have paired well with a hearty and savory bread but the brioche was not a deal breaker. It's exciting to have another restaurant option in Williston that focusses on the local ingredients. I wish the price would reflect the money we should be saving on shipping over long distances. My burger, fries and water was $14 so $20 with tax and tip. I think that is a little steep for a 6oz. patty of beef no matter how local it is. I'll be back for more Boucher blue. Next time I'll bring more money and a designated driver.
Yuck. I have never had pizza cooked from a conveyer belt oven before and never will again! Sloppy mess pizza.
Great spots for sandwiches thumbs down for pastries. The good thing is that it was open past 7pm on a Sunday.. Nice place very nice environment

Went to the Farm for brunch today. Food was good, but for the portion size, the prices were high. The shock really came ,when we got the bill, at the end of the meal. $3.50, for coffee, REALLY??? Most places include coffee with brunch, but aside from that, I have never paid that price for coffee in Brooklyn. If you want bread with a brunch entree, that doesn't include it (like an omelet, who doesn't give you bread, with eggs) it's an extra $2.00. When we spoke to the manager about the price of coffee (which by the way, is not listed on the menu), he was condescending, which was not necessary at all. When we paid the bill, after asking if we needed change, he didn't even bring back the right amount! Won't be back!!!

I went on a Sunday afternoon and it was pretty empty, couldn't understand why once I had the food. The decor is beautiful and modern and they even have spaces set aside for small parties. We ordered from the reasonably priced lunch menu and I had the Kafta platter and it was a perfect portion. The food tasted fresh and delicious. The dinner menu is much more pricey and higher end foods, will have to come back to try that.

This place was very good! We started by getting the soup of the day and it was flavored perfectly. We then ordered the calamari and they were cooked perfectly. The tomato sauce that came with it was so good! I am not a tomato sauce person and I would put this sauce on pasta. For our entree we ordered a whole bbq chicken and ribs with rice and French fries! The fries were cooked perfectly! The ribs and chicken were also cooked perfectly. The chicken was moist and tender. Overall, great place!

I rather not eat Italian abroad since I come from Italy but this Italian restaurant pizzeria was highly recommended by a friend of mine and I had to pay a visit. I found this place outstanding ,I had timbal lo di zucchini first and than a diavolo pizza,to be honest I don't think you can find a pizza so good in Italy so easily. The crust , the tomato sauce, the mozzarella fiordilatte in NYC I couldn't believe it. So good that they deserved my first review on yelp. Bravi
simple delicious italian food at very reasonable price

One the best tacos I've ever had.  The carne asado taco were really tasty and was actually a good size.  The same went for the pollo asado.  Having coca cola from Mexico in a glass bottle was a huge plus.

Went on my daughters reco.    Great menu, great service, great food.  Lived up to my expectations.  Was disappointed with the Desserts, didn t live up to the high standards of the rest of the meal.  Will definitely go again

It's such a shame that having such great food, the service at this restaurant is that bad. My boyfriend and I had a late reservation at this place, after dinner we were enjoying our conversation so we stayed on the table talking for a little after we paid our check probably around 11, we looked around and there were still 3 other tables so we thought it would be no problem.. All of the sudden all the servers and I believe the owners were behind the counter staring at us, waiting for us to leave, one of them which I believe was either one of the owners of a manager said loud enough just for us to hear and on a very rude tone: "ok enough is enough it's time to leave." What a terrible and rude service, if you don't want people at your restaurant, do not open one.

I expected a lot from this place considering it has pretty good reviews on yelp. I went on Sunday around noon and the wait was about 40 minutes. It was a chilly day and we waited outside since it's really small inside and there's really no space inside to wait. The host was nice coming out every so often to let us know it'll be a couple more minutes. Once we sat down, everything went downhill. The waitress that served us looked like she hated her job. I ordered the special which was a mushroom and jalapeño omelette. It took an hour for us to get our food. The two tables on the left of us ate and left and our food was still not in front of us. I understand that it was busy so maybe that's what took so long. Then the table on our right, who got seated AFTER us, got their food before us! When we called for the waitress to ask for our food, she didn't even bother to stop at our table completely. She just passed us by and said "I know what your thinking but it's not my fault." Excuse me? That comment completely ruined my experience here. The host that was so nice before we got seated was so cold towards us when we asked for our food. He didn't even apologize for our wait. He just told us if we wanted to leave he won't stop us. We were debating on leaving and was about to get up and leave, but our food had just come and we were starving since we had waited for about 2 hours for our food. The food was disappointing. Considering how long it took, I expected hot food. Everything on my plate was cold. The omelette was mediocre. I could've went grocery shopping and made it myself at home in a shorter amount of time. And I would've had hot food!
The food was good, but not amazing. The service was excellent, though, and the Byob policy makes it an easy, chill dinner. Try it if you like ethnic!
A great place to eat with a variety of good food. My personal favorites are The Original Turkey for a healthy sandwich, smoothies from Kamal's, and pretzels from Miller's Twist.

I was disappointed with the cheesesteak.  A friend told me they were the best in the city, I thought it tasted more like shredded canned dog food meat. Too salty and the meat was dry. The front desk lady was blown away when I threw her a couple dollars, then I learned why. Probably wont be back

I was really excited to see that they had stuffed artichokes. So I ordered takeout, and also tried to order rice balls, but they said they didn't have them. So that was disappointing. When I picked up my order, the guy was nice, but the place was so tiny, I'm glad I wasn't staying. When I opened my order at home, I was not expecting this kind of stuffed artichoke. There was way too much stuffing I couldn't even find the artichoke. I ended up eating what I could of the leaves with minimal stuffing, and ended up being left with enough stuffing for 15 more orders that I had to just throw out. Overall, I definitely won't be ordering stuffed artichokes from that place ever again.

Great vibe. But most if all GREAT Food. What I love most is that most of their items are pretty much spanish-american cuisine. I'm also in love with their grilled pizza choices! They have the classics like the magaerita and hilo (Hawaiian ) but they also have inventive choices like the new duck seared pizza which is out of this world! It seems like they update the menu with items, but to me thats pretty amazing considering everything I tried there is just delicious. Will eat here at least once a week.

Great Indian Food. All vegetarian.  We waited and waited for Bombay Talk. Finally gave up and tried Talk of the Town. Wow, what a pleasant surprise! All of our hesitation due to the place being empty vs Bombay Talk turned out to be misplaced.   Although small, this is a gem of a place. I am going to tell all my friends about it.
Best vegetarian food with real india's taste and best hospitality...should definitely check this place out and surely you will be delighted and want to visit again...
Wonderful place! Love it!

The food and service is always great. I had the Chicken sandwich and it was delicious and a large portion. The coffee is delicious. I've tasted most of the desserts and I can say that they're all worth trying. I would recommend this place to everyone.
Very nice place.

This place is a casual restaurant for snacking while drinking. If you've been to Japan you will recognize it as authentic Japanese food (e.g., karaage chicken, menchikatsu croquette or gobou salad), but this is not your "typical" Japanese restaurant (e.g., when I went they didn't have sushi or teriyaki in the menu). The place itself is small, good for eating with a friend or a small group of friends. If you're planning on a larger group you probably want to call in advance and check (e.g., we were 8, more than that would have been complicated). In terms of quality I was quite impressed, really juicy hamburger steak, moist and tender fried chicken and a perfectly fried breaded combo platter, with a delicious melt-in-your-mouth sweet bean jelly for dessert.

Terrific food at a great price. My girlfriend and I come here as often as we can. The fresh rolls are amazing and the spring rolls are always cooked perfectly- we can't get enough of the sauce. It's hard to try new things at this restaurant because the chicken pad Thai is the best we've ever had. We crave The Terrace weekly and it never disappoints!
The Mediterranean sandwich is just lettuce and tomatoes with a sprinkle of feta on a doughy bread. Absolutely tasteless!

HIGHLY recommend! Actually this is my first comment on yelp, because I found I definitely should write one to recommend this place for everybody! The BEST lamb skewer I had so far!!! Also had hotpot with friends there today! The best thing to do in a cold day lol!!

We cannot complain about the food, appam, uthappam and their super duper mutton Biryani. the taste ... Yummy! however they NEED to improve their service. There is always a line and once you get seated be prepared to wait for 30-40 minutes for your first order to arrive.

A staple in Brooklyn pizza. They're famous for a reason. I cant lie, they have declined over the past years, but their food is still above average. Cant go wrong with a Philly style cheese steak & a spumoni. Good stuff, i look forward to eating here for another 20+ years.

This place was much better when I was little. A lot has changed. The only thing I like from here is breakfast and the breakfast sandwiches...Once in awhile my boyfriend and I will have take out and the food is always so bland and cold, and the take out containers are not sturdy..but the employees are always so sweet and everytime I ask for utensils and ketchup or syrup, they always give me extra

Jeff is super nice but it all goes down from there. Service is very poor and food the worst I've had in years. Then we saw the kitchen and they had food on the floor. The board of health would close them down if they inspected. Nice bar but terrible restaurant.
Amazing, cheap Indian. Love it, and order from here all the time.

I would give the Coconut Soup (which comes in a bowl shaped and sized like a large vase) 6 stars if that was possible here.  Something about the balance of coconut broth, spice and some addictive fried onion bits is really irresistible.

Told everyone who'd listen for months how great this was after having the same great waiter 2 days in a row, first in the back where, in keeping with other commenters, the service can be awful, and then in the front Yesterday we took my niece and husband on an important double-date and was treated horribly by no less than 4 individuals there - a) waiter who chatted with me while we waited for other couple (he: "how are you?" me: "fine, what about you?" he: "not as good as you" - listen, I worked 90 hours each of the last 3 weeks so f__ off, OK?), b) gentleman manning reservations (me: "our guest couple will walk in here 1 minute from now for our 6pm reservation which is 2 minutes from now, what about the front room?"  he: "ask Jerry, so I'll cancel your reservation now?" - I'm not going to explain further how, frankly, malicious this "idea" was . . . ), c) drink-taker waiter on being asked for water after we ordered a beer and bottle of wine: "what for?" and no less than 2 more gratuitous hostile comments, and never did bring us the water, d) non-aligned waiter who brought us 2nd of requested doggie bags on being asked about the 1st that was "inadvertently" discarded, shrugged his shoulders, then 5 minutes later said "we don't want to rush you but we need the table" Besides the drinks mentioned, my nephew-in-law ordered 2 more beers, we paid for more than we can eat - what did we do to deserve this?  How do I get my chance for a passable experience with my guests back? Many of the staff are exemplary persons (not just as service people, that is), really great people - but they are mixed in with surly, openly hostile characters - if you don't get abused here, you'll swear it's just the best - I do agree on the bar being an outstanding place (room also has the advantage of a broad window) but we were a group of 4 - Okay, NOW I get it, go as a couple and sit at the bar, great, sit in the back at your peril

This is from an experience at this restaurant a few months ago. One of the worst delivery experiences I have ever had. Ordered 3 burritos and guac for delivery at 8pm on a weekend night. We were told 40 minutes when we ordered. I called back at 1 hour and 2 hours and was told the order was on the way both times. I live in 10 blocks away. The last time I called I was told to be more patient because someone else had waited for three hours before me. I told them I didn't want the food anymore because I wanted to go to bed. I was also cursed at by the person from the restaurant on the phone. It's a shame because they have great Mexican food, but haven't quite figured out efficient delivery service yet. Also inexcusable imo to curse at a customer no matter what.

I went here for the first time the other night after walking by this place numerous times. Well have I been missing something. First of all John the owner and bartender is sooo friendly and welcoming. It's a place that you just feel comfortable in. We hit happy hour here and when we went to pay the bill we utterly surprised that the drafts were only $2.50, even at reular price $5.00 is cheap. Then I actually went back a night later with other friends and ate there. Food is great, good pub food with an eclectic feel, and the bread to die for. This will be my new favorite place, and I will continue to bring more friends here.

My dinner at Blend started off on a bad foot... We had reservations and when my party arrived we got seated by the hostess who was very sweet and wished me a happy birthday. I was also greeted with a lovely personal birthday card from Blend which was cute. Once we sat down, our waitress came to our table and barely smiled. I asked her about the free sangria for the check in and she pretended like she didn't know what I was talking about. So I pulled out my phone to show her and she just said that's one per table ok?! So she did know what I was talking about because shebwouldnt know the details of the offer if this was brand new for her. Anyhow, she came to the table a couple of times but my party still didn't even know what we wanted. So many good choices and every time we would say we need more time she would roll her eyes and walk away, didn't even bother to say "Don't worry take your time" or even make suggestions for us. Additionally, I ordered the frozen sangria cause I heard great reviews about it. Unfortunately, I didn't like it and asked to switch it out for the white sangria which was so deliciously amazing. When I asked if I could switch out the drink she let out an annoyed sigh and just made a hand motion for me to give her the drink. That's when I took initiative to ask for a manager because I refuse to be treated like this especially on my birthday. The manager that came to speak to me was Matthew and he was so apologetic for the way my guests and I were treated. I explained that is was my first time here and I was disappointed in the service. He switched out our waitress with another one named Joanna and she was such a sweetheart. Always checked up on us, asked if we needed anything else. Our food came out, I ordered the lobster mac and cheese and the tostone nachos as my meal which were to die! My guests entrées also looked and smelled delicious! Our waitress ended up giving us shots on the house as a token for their apology. Later on they also surprised me with a complimentary dessert  with 3 different cakes and ice cream.  Thank you Matthew for making the effort and turning what started as a bad night, into a great one!

Sandwiches are always so filling! Boars head meat is the best and that's all that they use...I always get ham and cheese with the works and add hot peppers...ingredients are always so yummy and fresh!

This is the best restaurant I have ever been too! The food is simply amazing! so much flavor and spices! Chips and salsa are always fresh and warm...I always order the chili with onions sour cream and cheese...its not the spicy so I add some hot sauce that is on the table...the chili is so yummy full of flavor! I also get the blackened chicken fajitas! They are to die for! They come with lettuce tomato onions cheese and 4 tortillas, I ask for extra sour cream and that orange marmalade sauce and I'm in heaven! ...the decor is fun too and I love the music! No matter what time of the day there will always be a wait...longest I waited was 40 mins but it's so worth it!

Terrible customer experience. Walk up to the counter you place your order and logically go have a seat only to be kicked out of it because that's for dining guests only if you accidentally gotten online to order something to go.

Ok dining experience but this past delivery took over an hour and when they brought my food they forgot 3 of my drinks , when I called they were very rude and said that they put it in there and that I was wrong !! Bad customer service, they said they would bring it , another hour goes by and I call again and they said they would bring it soon. So they were never even going to bring it ! Ridiculous! Never order delivery here if you want it in time or your correct order .

My boyfriend and I wanted to try something new so when we passed by this cool, trendy Korean restaurant we thought: why not? We were not disappointed to say the least. We are both pescatarian and find it difficult at times to find food that is made with just as much flavor as those with meat in it. The sushi here is to DIE for. It was simply delicious. We also ordered the sauteed mushroom appetizer and I couldn't believe how well seasoned it was. It was full of flavor! The fries were hot and crisp and were served with ketchup and a sort of spicy kimchi mayo which I really enjoyed. We sat ourselves at the bar and the bartender was extremely accommodating and we were really happy with his suggestions with the food and drinks we were served. The staff were really friendly and inviting and they really make sure to check up on you to make sure you're being attended to. Bottom line: I will definitely be recommending this restaurant to friends and family and will probably be back the next time I go to the city.

The only reason I am giving this place one star is because the site does not allow a grade of zero.  I have been to many Famous Dave's, but the service here is the worst.  My wife and I came for lunch.  The place was fairly empty with only a few tables occupied.  We waited a while without any server coming to our table.  Another couple came in well after us and were seated at the next booth.  The server finally came to the area, and went directly to the other table and ignored us.  He then went to the back of the restaurant to place their order.  We waited for him to come back, even though he should have waited on us first because we were seated well before the other party.  Finally, we see him come with the drinks for the other table.  He served their drinks and walked away again without coming to us.  At this point, after being ignored for so long we left. Given the experience, we will never go back to this Famous Dave's location.  There is no excuse for this lack of service.  Also, I have to wonder ... if the manager cannot even have the servers accomplish the simple task of waiting on tables in the order they are seated, or waiting on tables at all, that gives me great pause as to how the rest of the restaurant is being managed.  There are enough good restaurants in the area to visit that will happily provide excellent food and service. We will be eating at those instead.

Their stock is terrible, always out of stuff! 1day:  they had no seafood bcus it all had gotten spoiled. 2nd time:  gave us catfish when menu said white fish 3rd time:  20mins waiting on food to be ready bcus only 2pp ws workin 4th time & last time:  they didnt have the beer batter chicken or chicken tenders & limited on shrimp so had to order something else. The fries sucked! Mac&cheese look like someone eat half of the cup.
The dude at the cash register on Friday nights looks like Pharrel.

I give the sandwiches a 5 star, but give the workers no stars...everytime I call there is this one guy who is always so rude and rushes you off the phone...he makes you feel like you are a bother to him and that your annoying...I work at a restaurant and I would never be rude to a customer in person or on the phone. I don't know his name but I wish I did so when I call I could ask to talk to someone else. A few times I have asked for hot peppers and they never put any on. The macaroni salad I think is the best thing they have there. I also like the subway club...turkey ham and cheese...they are stingy with the cheese...

I brought the family the other night. Not exactly the type of place I would expect to accomodate kids, but they did a hell of a job. They even made a meal not on the menu for my picky daughter, who eats nothing but pasta. The wait staff and chef were very friendly. The food was amazing. I had the Duck Jambalaya. I would definately order it again. Good beer selection. Overall, the place had a nice feel to it. Whether you are looking for a small comfortable bar, or a place to get amazing food, this is definately the place.

Love the decor in this place! Reminds me of an old library with the old books and furniture...the food here is amazing! I always get the French onion soup and juicy cheese burger on a pretzel bun! Very friendly staff too!

The straight dope...The food was good , The desert was great.   We came in at 9pm and was told it would be 10 -15 minutes to eat, finally was able to start eating at 10 pm. Its not the servers... they were fine, just very understaffed. We asked for bread just to help us through the wait and they decided to charge us for it. They should have let us have it for free just for waiting an hour.   Other than that the ambiance and and atmosphere is incredible. Very Williamsburg , Very Brooklyn.
The ramen is tasty and the wait staff is courteous.  Sadly, the portion-size is for babies.

Walked in and no one bothered to greet us. The hostess was not friendly at all. The dining area was subpar to say the least. The food was ok but could have been better. Will not be retuning to this place.

Wow. I couldn't be happier that this place just opened up. I just moved here and was pretty sad at the lack of coffee shops in the area but now Manny's is open! There is not one thing about this place I don't like. Coffee is great, food selection is on point and the customer service is amazing. The people behind the counter are so welcoming  and happy. I am beyond ecstatic that this place is here. It's really a great spot, 100% recommended!
The food is decent - service is quick - some acquired tastes.

Pizza is pretty good..I think it's a little pricey...The staff is sometimes nice. The one man looks like he hates his job and doesn't want to be there. I like the fact that you dont have to walk into pathmark to get inside the pizza place...they have a door outside by the parking lot
Really inexpensive, good quality, nice atmosphere, very cool garden seating area, and hardworking staff!

This past Friday night the host had no problem seating all the cute girls ahead of me and my husband despite our names being higher on the list.  When asked about it the host said he called our name 3 times.  Hard to believe that we didn't hear him being that we were standing at the very front of this restaurant the whole time.  It takes us a lot to question let alone complain about the processes if a restaurant but this experience was so over the top horrible that I feel it my obligation to report....

Went to Giovanni's last week for a late lunch/dinner. The place is on the small side with a nice casual atmosphere. The first thing I noticed after being seated was the place seemed quite loud although there were not many customers. After looking around I quickly realized it was loud because the majority of the staff likes to hang out by the bar and loudly discuss their every life detail. This was a really big turn off, I just wanted to tell them to shut up and pay attention to the diners or go clean something. The next negative was the drunk guy that we were seated next to. How do I know he was drunk you ask? after receiving drink after drink he managed to get up and stumble squeezing through the tables as he dropped his full glass of Margarita right next to our table resulting in Margarita splashing all over my leg and on my shirt and on top of the table and on my girlfriend's purse, it even managed to get all over another patron of the restaurant. The truth is things happen and I was not upset with the guy, however I was upset that the event even took place and how the restaurant dealt with the situation. First off: before you decide to start cleaning the floor get me and the other guests that were affected a damp cloth immediately so we could clean ourselves off. Second: to the owner and bar staff you should really ask yourself if you'd like the place to be a restaurant where people go to have great food and a couple of drinks, or a place where a person can go to get drunk before 5 PM because the bar staff thinks it's acceptable to serve drink after drink after drink after drink. Are you a restaurant or a want to be bar hangout? Let's talk about the Food. Overall the food was very good. The one drawback is that it took forever to get. We really weren't sure what the holdup was to get out some pretty basic dishes and the fact that the restaurant wasn't even at half full capacity. As an appetizer we had the Calamari & zucchini fritti, Calamari was cooked perfectly and had a nice flavor. The zucchini was really soggy but it did have a nice flavor I think it was just fried at the wrong temperature which made it soggy. As entries we had the eggplant Parmesan which was very good and we also had the Tagliatelle di spinaci - Spinach tagliatelle with fresh rosemary chicken & mushrooms in a parmesan cream sauce, in all seriousness this was one of the best pasta dishes that I have had, the dish was executed perfectly. As for dessert we had the tiramisu which was very very good. After reading several reviews I saw that several people complained about portion size. The fact is that the portions are sized perfectly. The problem with society is that all too often we tend to overeat, I'm guilty of this myself. You must understand restaurant portion sizes are based on a three course meal. You're not supposed to be served a dinner that you don't finish and then doggy bag and eat for lunch and dinner the next day. That's being overserved, and something you typically find a lesser quality food.
