Overall nice casual atmosphere staff is way too loud and needs training there's a restaurant/bar identity crisis the food that we ate was very good priced fairly I will try them again
I could eat the strawberry ribs all dayyyy!

I had a negative experience.  Since the food is just average, I don't see me coming back. After an exchange of emails with Jeff (owner) in which he told me that he would tell the staff we were coming at 7, I arrived on time with friends.  A waiter told me that he knew nothing and we needed to wait half an hour. I told him about the email exchange and asked to speak with the manager.  He said there was no manager, and from what I could see there was no leadership in the place.   He made me find the email and show it to him, which I did. Then, he did nothing but waste my time with puerile arguments about why the email exchange was irrelevant. He gave another group a table before us. I sent another email to Jeff telling him of the problem and he wrote "please accept my apologies."  That was all.   I understand that mix-ups occur, but with so many tasty and fun restaurants in Brooklyn, why go here to get average food, small portions and clueless service?
The crepes here are always fresh and delicious and the portions always very generous.   Love the coffee and the Chai too.  Carolina is a great barista!

This place is alive! Hustling n bustling but yet accommodating with good service n fresh food cooked by yourself with your chosen soup to cook your chosen item n dip into your own scrumptious sauce. Mmmmmmm
Had gone here for dinner. Had fish tikka tandoori, which was ok. Also had biryani which wad pretty good, recommend the biryani.
Delicious!!!

Given the fantastic reviews, my girlfriend and I were shocked at how terrible both the service and the food was.   To start, my side of the table had sticky residue and chunks on it that they chose not to wash even after learning of it.  I had to cover it with a napkin so as not to get my clothes dirty.   Second, the service was really slow and the waiters were not as polite as most places that I have been to.   Finally, I love brunch and since I live in NYC I expect brunch to meet certain basic standards.  This one did not.  The eggs in the eggs benedict were overcooked, the salmon looked and tasted like it came out of a can, and the potato pancake just did not belong there at all.  The french toast was edible, but nothing special at all.  We did not try the tarts, but they did not look very appetizing. This is one of the only times that Yelp has gotten it completely wrong.  I would absolutely recommend going to one of the many other fabulous restaurants in NYC instead of this literal hole in the wall.

I've ordered the Krab Rangoon, which is one of their appetizers. Best thing that I ever tasted in my life. Their combination platter has a lot of taste. I kinda want to order more of their selections but I got too full. The staff are friendly too. If you're in the area, I recommend to check this place out.
Stopped in for a last minute bite based on the yelped reviews. The food was delicious.  Definitely a great decision and the gnocchi was fantastic.
delish

I enjoy breakfast here. The crab cakes are awesome. Rose Petals also has dinner on Thursday and Fridays. I always order the oxtail. The meat is tender and the flavor is out of this world. The best I have ever had.

Ordered fried calamari (extra crispy) and clams in white sauce for pickup was told 30 min. went to pick it up and waited another 30 min.the place was busy but no reason to wait so long. Got the food home the calamari was chewy not crispy, and the clams in white sauce was dry (no sauce) and 8 of the clams were not open something the cook should have noticed. I have had food from Gencarellis in the past which was good but this was not quality food.

We were there on a Saturday evening. We had a reservation for 7 pm and we were seated at 6:55 in their upstairs room. The service was prompt. The waitress was a warm and attentive person. We ordered lots of cold mezes, all of which were delicious. Especially humus, cacik, and eggplant salad were heavenly. They came with warm Turkish bread which is always a big plus. Then we had tandir kebap which is very difficult to make right (I'm Turkish, I've had many bad experiences with it), but this was just perfect. We also had kofte kebap and grilled chicken and they were also pretty good. I don't think we needed a main course per person since the sizes of the appetizers were huge. But everything was so delicious that we even wanted to try their deserts and I would say we didn't regret. We payed $120 for 5 mezes, 3 main courses, lots of drinks and desert and I think it was reasonable for the location and amount of food. I will definitely go back next time I'm in NYC.

I wish I can give them 10 stars! This is the best chinese food I have ever had! I don't go anywhere else! So convenient because this place is 3 mins down the road from me. I always get amazing food and great service! If I need a delivery, they are always here within 20 mins. My favorite is the boneless spare rib combo..I tell them to make my ribs well done and it's so yummy! I might order some for lunch now! Haha

As I waiting for my food for the past 30 mins,  let see if I get my food before I finish writing this.  The place only 1/3 full when I walked in. The chef is walking around collecting dishes, what the hell is going on???? Finally our food came, decent food minus my husbands coffee.  Clearly they didn't steam the milk long enough, my cappuccino is not hot at all.  Good food is not everything, service is just as important.    Now we see how long it takes to get our bill.......
The place was very clean and had a great Greek vibe to it. The food and service was excellent. My wife and will be coming back again soon ...

I should first state that Stephen Starr is my personal god. That said, El Vez is just as good, if not better, than anything else he has done in our fair city. Been here 6 or 7 times and it is always great. What ever you eat will be fabulous, but you can super-size the experience by ordering the "blood-orange frozen margarita." Caution: you might only want to get just one...

We went to Jesse's this past week as we have always had great food and service.  One of the dishes we ordered was not the usual delicious and when we told, Audra, our waitress,  She happily ordered another entrée to replace it.  Her service was friendly, attentive, exceptional!  Thank you Audra for a fabulous dining experience!

Had a party of 20 for lunch today. From the first phone calls and email communications, we were feeling confident that we picked a great place.  Everyone was so responsive and helpful and accommodating. When we arrived the tables were set beautifully,  with all of the red wine we dropped off earlier on display across the tables and our white wines chilling. The service was friendly and excellent.  Wine glasses and water glasses were always being refilled and warm bread baskets never went empty. We had chosen a lunch party package and every person raved about the selection of entrees.  The package included appetizers served family style, an entree, and dessert.   Everything was delicious. This was our first time visiting La Mezzaluna, but it definitely wont be out last.

I was very excited to visit this place, but it was just one unfortunate instance after another! The food took a very long time to come out even though there were only two other people in the place (that's fine, we weren't in a rush) but we waited without water or a chance to order some coffee. When we did get our food my order was completely wrong (it happens) but we weren't able to find our waitress to tell her! My husband's crepe also came out cold : / and there wasn't enough room on the table for our coffees and our food so all three of us had to keep our coffees on another table and reach over when we were thirsty. At that point we just had to laugh at the whole situation- we gave up and went down the street to the Petite Parisian place where we know the crepes are hot the and the wait staff is attentive. Maybe we'll come back to try the gelato to-go some time...

Delicious stuffed artichoke! Both my sister and I really enjoyed them. I haven't had one like that in years and was happy to find a place that made them so well. I also had the chicken franchese which was good. It came with two pieces of chicken and I chose to get pasta with it instead of a salad. Kinda wished the pasta had the same sauce instead of the red sauce, but only because I'm picky like that. We then shared the tartufo, which was great as well. Came with 5 pieces, we ended up eating two each. I also ordered a cappuccino, the glass was a little messy so I had to wipe my hands off, but it was good. Overall, I definitely will be going back to try more.

Today was the second time that I have eaten here. The first time was great , the food was great & our waiter was very kind. I love bbq and I was so happy with our first visit , so I decided to come back today. Our service was horrible. We have ordered the course and some extra meats and other extra orders to add to our course. The appetizers came in and everything was great . Then our food came out & everything was great. But then we realized that only about 1/3 of our order came out. I usually am a very understanding person and usually will wait because yes, the place was very busy, so I do understand that maybe my food is taking so long because they are very busy. I told the waiter that my order didn't come out yet. He told me that there are still coming out. So I waited for about another 15 minutes & it still didn't come out yet. So I talked to the waiter again & told him. He finally got out our order but it was only one of the other 4 orders that we still didn't get. I thought okay maybe it is really busy that is why it is taking so long, so I waited again. For another 10-15 minutes, the food never came. So I asked the waiter again, he told us that we got all of our order already, but we didn't. So he went to go check with the kitchen to what is going on. He came back and told us that the orders came out already, it was two orders in one plate. But I was a hundred percent sure that it was only one order. One, that i went here already before & i know that two order is not that tiny. Two, it is very obvious that two order is not 5 pieces of meat. We told him, he talked to us like he did not  believes us. He left and came back again, asking us what the orders are that are missing. We told him, about 10 minutes later, then it came. He didn't apologize or anything, he felt like it's not his fault. I was very upset and told him that I am very very dissapointed in the service because who likes eating and then waiting like 30 minutes because they think that all of our food came out already? He finally said " my apologies " and then he end up blaming it on the kitchen. We finished our food and then got our desserts. I was also upset because of how poorly he took care of our table. Usually they would changed the grilling plate about 2-4 times, he didn't at all. He didn't came to see if we needed anything or see if we needed water refills. I know he could do a lot better than that. After all of that, the general manager came and asked us what happened. I explained to her and she said she was very sorry. She was really nice to us & understand us. She made our experience there a little better. I don't know if I am going to come back, but if i am , I hope my service will not be as bad as the one I had tonight because I do love the food here.
Awesome Peruvian food!!! Highly recommend it one little downfall pets should not be allowed in restaurants

My family and I have been going here for years...located close to the house and very convenient.. Great pizza...fresh ingredients and friendly staff. The inside is still very old looking. They could use a make over. I always pick up my food and it's always got and ready when I get there. And if you dress up on Halloween and decided to get pizza they will give u a free slice for wearing a costume
such a great place!
A bit expensive for the portion sizes but it was delicious! The ambiance is pretty romantic too, good date night.

I am not usually a fan of breakfast but I am going to tell you that I was absolutely THRILLED with my breakfast this morning.  I did a blue plate with corn beef hash and hashbrowns.. WHOA!  The absolute best hash I have EVER had.  I could eat this every single day! The corn beef is fresh made.. nothing out of a can, that is for sure... the hashbrowns were so good... rainbow potatoes and perfectly fried - yumm! Our server Jay was very attentive and personable!  The restaurant has a warm,  eclectic environment with an appreciation and support for local artists. I am so happy to have a restaurant like Spicy Green Bean in Glastonbury.  Love this place!  So much on the menu - and you know its all quality products.

This is a very cozy Italian restaurant. If you are Italian and like Italian food, you will feel very comfortable here.a lot of things are imported from Italy. The food is very good and has very nice presentation. I gave it only four stars because the skirt steak was not good at all it was very tough we asked the waiter where the steak was from, he said not from America.our country has the best beef. I'm not going to get into why, but my father is a butcher and I can say that the US does have the best beef   you can definitely tell it wasn't American raised cow. My dish was excellent it was a homemade pasta with pancetta and Pomodoro sauce , it was a little salty but it was enjoyable. the desserts were to die for. the best thing I need to say is our waiter his name was Adam a young nice b Young man, he reminded me a little bit of Adam Sandler. He had perfect presentation, consideration, always was looking to make sure we were satisfied. One of the best waiters I have ever had, in many years of dining. Definitely check it out, if your meat lover don't order meat. Other than that you will love the place. I also want to add that it is a BYOB but you can order your wine and the store down the street will personally deliver it to you.that's awesome!
The wings are amazing, and they have a wide beer selection. Bar staff is great. The dinner selections are good, but not awesome.
One of my favorite spots in bushwick. The flatbread and crispy cauliflower are amazing.

Awesome food! Great service. Had an issue tonight with my delivery, my boyfriend called to talk about what happened and things were taken care of, no questions asked. We love this neighborhood and we were super happy to find this place a few weeks ago. I recommend the Cubano, fried brussel sprouts and the tomato soup!
The sushi here is great! It's always fresh and yummy. I've never eaten in, but I get take-out frequently, and just love their sushi!
Terrible food, service at the door was okay but service at the table was horrible. Stay away.

I thought the food here was good.... I got the salmon, poached eggs on the potato pancakes with the yogurt dill sauce. I have a friend who works at the joint and told me about. She told me to come around 2pm so I would not have to wait in line a super long time. It 25mins to get a seat and that is the slow time. When we were sat our server did not come greet us for 15 minutes to take our order or say hello. She was so slammed and clearly had to big of a section to cover. The entire meal she only took our order and then came to drop off the check. 2nd problem... I had LONG GROSS HAIR in the food. I was only half way done with my meal when I found it. Since there was no service I had to get the attention of the hostess who sat us to let my server know...  She NEVER came over to apologize. A random guy who (never introduced his self), but served us our drinks came over and took my plate and asked me if I wanted a replacement meal. I lost my appetite and was over the service and the mood so I said I didn't want a replacement. When our waitress gave us the bill she again didn't acknowledge or say sorry about the hair in the food and just gave us our bill. (i don't even think someone told her about it) But when we got the bill they took off my $14 entree and $6 bloody Mary. Over all, food was good. Service could be good, but they need to give there servers smaller sections so they have a chance to do there job and be prepared to wait outside in the cold to get seated.

PLUS: Many of the tapas we tried were excellent. The deserts were outstanding as well. -Spicy Sausage/pepper tapa, braised artichokes, and capaocolla were superb, mezzelune were amazing according to my vegetarian wife -couscous chocolate pudding was a major delight, MINUS: 2 Cold entrees, presentation of pasta dish (linguine with mussels-type dish) was quite lacking. Just kind of thrown on the plate with no garnish or design. BIGGEST MINUS: While knowledgable, the waiter was incredibly pushy. There is a difference between suggesting options to your diners based on your knowledge vs sounding like a car salesman. We were asked 3+ to add additional dishes even though we were very clear that we were done with our tapas and main courses. 3 times. Before, during, and after our dessert we were offered espresso. Do we really need to say "no" 3 times to be clear? This was the low-point of the experience at Brigantessa. SUGGESTION: It would be nice to offer the Primi with size options, since there are only 3 Secondi on the current menu. OVERALL: Minus the pushy waiter and some kitchen issues they are probably already working on improving since they just opened, a solid addition to our neighborhood.  We didn't try the pizza tonight, but the adjacent table seemed to be enjoying theirs. I would likely return. but I will also remember to bring additional cash-2 couple dining came to just under $300 after gratuity with just a few drinks.

We arrived, a party of 6, for some quick burgers before a 'paintnite ' event. We ordered with the understanding that we had to be at the event in 30min or so. With five min to start time... The first hamburger arrived via the owners hands. Each meal then arrived approx every 2 min after the previous meal! One at a time! Who does that? 3 items were either cold or room temperature! My burger was hot and well cooked! This is why I gave the only two stars or it would have been a '0'! I do not recommend this venue. There is more to this story, including denial from the owner at every complaint our group had about the food and service. Denial is not becoming of customer service! Be warned!

Nothing to look at. Ordered the ceviche, the empanadas the melted cheese and the tostada from the brunch menu. Service was slow and food really mediocre, just not cutting it. The place had a lot of flies inside, they charged me a michelada twice because "they charge the sauce and the beer independently". Ended up paying 120 bucks for a really unsatisfying brunch. In the future i'll avoid this place like the plague.
Nice selection of beers and a simple menu with solid burger choices. Lots of fun, busy, and sitting at the bar is the way to go.

Came to this place on accident and it was definitely the best accident that could have happened on my trip to Burlington. The food is to die for I nearly collapsed on the table in joy after I took my first bite of the Croque Madame. I also highly recommend the tater tots.
The service was great. The food was excellent. But the dishes were a little bit small. The desserts were nice, not recommended. The prices are very high. Overall it is a nice restaurant.

I had an uninspired, overlcooked, dry pork shank smothered in ketchupy barbeque sauce. The Caesar salad was mediocre at best and my friend felt the same about the fried chicken.The place was extremely noisy and the waiter  was in a perpetual rush.

Hell yeah! Great intimate rustic ambiance. Delicious food. I don't really have any complaints. My waitress could have been a tad more attentive, but it's all good. This is a great spot if you're not necessarily looking to be seen but want a neighborhood favorite. Very comfortable setting. I enjoyed the roasted chicken and sage shrimp. I'd definitely come back.

It's going to be really hard to write this review, the rating is not because of the food or drinks, those were really good. But I do appreciate when a good manager keeps the staff in checked. When we got there we were told that the pitcher of sangria was $10 in happy hour. We order 2 pitchers before 7pm, among several plates. When it was time to pay the bill, our surprise was seeing the pitchers at full price. And when I asked about it the waiter tells me that the one at that price is the half pitcher. At this point all I wanted to do is talk to the manager, and the waiter in a very rude manner approached us, and claiming that it was a misunderstanding and miscommunication grabbed the bill (which was handwritten) and tore it right there in front of us. As I see things, if it was a mistake (totally posible) I would have fix the pitcher value as a way to say sorry and let the customer pay the bill. At this point with no bill I couldn't pay it, couldn't talk to the manager and no tip for the waiter of course after that behavior. It seems very dubious to me and my friends that this guys destroyed the bill without trying to come up with another solution and talk about it. I consider myself a very understanding costumer but I don't answer good to rudeness and when I feel some type of dishonesty is happening I can't let it go. Hopefully this was a one person thing and I had bad luck.

We recently enjoyed dinner on a Friday evening at Cedar Point's outdoor patio. Cedar Point  was crowded but the hostess handled the seating well. We didn't have to wait too long.   The waiter was also attentive and our food came quickly. As an appetizer, we shared tender chicken wings which were spicy but not too hot, and which came with grilled Brussel sprouts, a  great contrast.  My husband had fish and chips- the batter wasn't greasy and the fish was moist and really tasty; as good as any we enjoyed in Ireland and England. And  the potato  fries combined with sweet potato fries were a yummy compliment. I ordered the kale burger- it was good but it could have used more spice for my palate. So I borrowed the sauces that came with the fish and chips. Definitely recommend Cedar Point for good food, good atmosphere, good experience at great prices.

Everytime someone would mention "Park Tavern" i would jump up in joy & say lets go! ..... Not so much anymore Just a few months back i decided to bring my boyfriend to the Park Tavern, being the pizza lover that he is.. what can go wrong????? ALOT Being turkish muslims, we dont eat pork, anywhere we go before we order.. We kindly ask our waitress to correct us if we accidently order anything containing pork & to please tell the cook we dont eat pork as well. Everythings fine, she smiled agrees says thats perfectly fine and shed let the cook know. So we put our order in. A tossed salad with mozz, mussels, and a small pie. 2 minutes laaaaaater... We get our salad... Everythings fine. I put some salad on my plate, go to serve my boyfriend some salad.. And BAM!  A piece of salami or ham or whatever it was idk, but i know it was pork. So i call my waitress order and show her the piece of pork.. In our salad.. She apologizes and takes the salad back. Asking if we wanted another. We kindly said no.... We get our mussels eat our pizza.. Ask for the check. And see the salad is still on there.. *FULL PRICE* i call her over and tell her there must have been a mistake, she takes a look at it.. And says "no, i dont see any" Excuse me ?! Apparently the salad was halfway gone. Clearly she didnt give a crap to look on our plates to see all the salad we didnt eat. Anyway. I ask to speak to her manager. The response we get was "sorry our manager went home"  ok.. So i ask to speak to the person in charger. Another waitress comes over, i explain my situation and she says to call back tmrw and speak with a manager because she has no privileges to take food off of the bill. Excuse me but what if i found a roach in my food ?! Your gonna make someone PAY?! so i called back everyday for three days asking to speak to a manager and each day i got a different excuse saying the manager was "out" or "in a meeting" Ive worked in a restaurant since i was the age of 12 and never have i ever seen management this bad. Clearly they need the 9$ more than i do.. And thats a bad sign. Gave 2 stars cause the pizza is actually really good. To bad i wont be enjoying it anymore.

My wife and I saw a review shortly after The Gorbals opened. Bacon wrapped matzoh balls?! Whole pig's head!! We made the pilgrimage to Brooklyn. It was too cold to stay on the rooftop bar, looking forward to next time. The environment in the restaurant was inviting and comfortable. Our server, Dominic, was incredible, which turned out to be important since the menu was "unique". (Which was the reason we came) The drink menu needed to be explained/explored, everything sounded so good. The four of us all tried something different (x2). Great start to the evening. We then basically wanted everything on the menu (way too much but we couldn't decide). Dom helped us pare down our choices a little then offered smaller portions of a couple items. So we ended up with "nearly" everything instead. The bacon wrapped matzoh was excellent, as were the Shiite peppers. We all agreed that the flash fried broccoli was the best broccoli that we have ever had. We passed on the pig's head and had the braised lamb neck - just the sweetest meat that melted in your mouth. I usually pass on beef tongue, but I had to try it after everyone else rolled their eyes back after one bite, it was incredible. I won't try to be the foodie, describing and commenting on all the nuance of each dish. I will sum it up as a great meal! Fortunately, there were only four desserts to choose from, we ordered one each and passed them around. I can't imagine eating here frequently (we live in Ohio), but we will be returning next visit to NYC. Looking forward to a menu of new delights.
Most comments below focus on the food (which is amazing), however I wanted to point out that the drinks are amazing as well. Keeps me coming back! Our Thursday night spot!
I got some fried chicken with a side of mac & cheese and collard greens  DELICIOUS!  Would go here all the time if I lived closer!

This place is great. It is small and cozy and perfect for a quick stop in before class, if you are a Temple Student. Although I am a student, it is nice to see non-students in here as well. There seems to be a nice mix, which I appreciate. Sometimes I get anxious when there are too many students in a small area like that. I always get the homefries with green peppers and onions.

Amazing!    I think I've tried just about everything on the menu I go so often.  Yesterday I had the steak & eggs (poached to perfection) with a kale salad and it was delicious!  The food & service keep me coming back every week.  The people there are super friendly & know a lot of their customers by first name. It's in a great location a block from Lafayette stop off the C train. The menu is diverse & has great options for people who have dietary restrictions...the gluten free pastries are the bomb!

Best Japanese restaurant in Bayonne. It's located at the very north east corner of the cross shopping center, next to the Staple and Stop & Shop. We always go there for a lunch / dinner after our weekly grocery shopping at Stop & Shop. During holidays, The waiting time can be long if you didn't make reservation ahead. We once waited 2 hour on the night of Feb 14, 2014. The food is fresh & tasty.  The Sushi meets the quality of much pricier Sushi restaurants in the city. The hibachi is impressive and amazing due to skill of the hibachi chef. Love the head bands the hibachi chef wears that printed with Kamikaze ("神風").

This is a great date spot. The food is delicious and the portions are large. We usually split an appetizer, order two different entrees, and never have room for dessert although I wish we had. We always go for the special appetizers. We had the lobster cocktail app once and the zucchini flowers another time.  The squash flowers were oozing with cheese and flavor. My girlfriend always orders the chicken parm. The sauce is delicious and The cheese is melted perfectly. I've had a variety of dishes, usually fish or pasta. All were outstanding. The complimentary champagne at the end, hits the spot.
Took the ferry over and found this spot.  So happy we did!  Roseanne is an amazing bartender and made a few West Coast folks feel right at home!  Good drinks, good music & good folks!

Went once in the summer for the lunch buffet (around $10? Don't remember) with a group from work. Loved the food. Craving to go back again! All of the main dishes were very tasty. I wish I could've had more if there was more time before going back to the office and more space in my stomach. Great price and great tasting food. Would go for the food. Not for you if you're looking for anything else fancy. But the food is so good. At least for the one time I've been there so far.

Recently had my wedding there all our guest had a great time and so did the groom and i... Steve Goodman helped us and he was great he made everything so easy on us and the matridee Steve was aawesome too he made sure the whole night that my groom and i were ok and if we needed anything and knew all the plans and made everything go so smooth

Although the food is good when i place on order for deilvery it is downhill.  The staff that picks up the phone is sometimes rude and ALWAYS forget the green sauce.  I mention it for years- DONT FORGET THE EXTRA GREEN SAUCE and i think they do it intentionally like I am on a realty show....I have alot better things to do than to write a review but Its not acceptabel to treat your neighboors this way.  Get the order right or it will def. catch up to you at some point.  Also when I request a middle piece of salmon dont say NO....Get your customer service together..
Great food, Great Price, Good Service. They open at 630 had my food ready in 10 mins.

Great little store with a deli inside that serves up a mean burger. Get the burger of the week and it comes with any bag of chips that cost 99cents, which in this case was a big 3.5 oz bag of Utz! Really good deal, definitely worth the 2 minute walk through the parking garage from the airport to avoid the outrageous airport prices.

Amazing authentic mexican food. I've been to Taqueria once in downtown jersey city, and shortly  after visited El Aguila Dorada, because one of my friends was complaining how overpriced the food was and how the quality of food wasn't as good as El Aguila's food. Turns out, my friend was absolutely right. Taqueria gives you about 3 tacos for 9 bucks, but El Aguila gives you something like 5 for the same price.  Also the quality of the salsa is much more thicker and richer instead of something watered down like Taqueria. The service and waiters were nice and the pricing isn't bad at all. It has a nice homely environment so if you want to have a quiet dinner with a date this is your spot! If you live in or around the Bayonne area definitely check out El Aguila, you won't be disappointed!

We had our rehearsal dinner here October 17 2014. Half the wedding party lives in NY and the other half from central jersey so I pucked a place in the middle. I found this restaurant through yelp and so happy I did. The food was fantastic and so was the staff. Thank you so much, everyone had such a great time. I will definitely be coning back to eat. Great food!!!!

We happened in on a Friday night after the ballet. We were happy to get the one open table. It was a true c.c. restaurant with people from every background dinning all mixed together. I tried many things I had never had & loved it all!! I am quite a wine snob but I don't know much about Spanish wines. I got a taste of 2 and loved them both!! This is very rare in Philly. We had a ball, no complaints.
Food not that great went there several time all time food takes forever and is always cold...
this place is on and off for me. some days it's great, some it's okay. but i still come here since it's open 24/7! convenient for those late hungry nights in the city

Went for lunch with a friend, shared hummus, appetizers, kebab.  Atmosphere very nice, sat in side room on cushions, good decor.  Service OK.  Food.....not so much.  Hummus had little taste, as did kebabs.  I ordered the beet salad, which was supposed to be a house specialty -- and was soooo disappointed.  I think they used canned beets and frozen potatoes.  Large portion of awful bland veggie mush.  Not going back there.
Yes! Buttery and creamy!  Artichoke pizza slice at its finest. Nothing fancy, just an excellent slice on the go for fans of artichoke, which i am!

Disrespected & Disappointed FOOD:                   Very Good ATMOSPHERE:   Loud / Noisy DECOR:                Stylish & Cool SERVICE:              Disappointing & Disrespectful I went with my family (Mother, Aunt & Uncle - who are older).  I'm in my 40's.  I think that Mayfield may be catering to a younger crowd because the treatment of me and my family was disrespectful and left a bad taste in our mouths.  The hostess sat us at a table for 6 but only after objecting to sitting at a hightop table in the back, which would have been uncomfortable for my family who are in their 80's.  The insensitivity was obvious and after objecting to the table suggestion, the hostess sat us down at the table and said she would have to move us if a larger party arrived (who does that?)  Once you're seated... you're seated!   I did not make a fuss but did step away so that I could talk to her privately, and told her that my family were older and that we would not be moving. She made a smart comment... which I heard but ignored. I was trying to enjoy myself! The food was very good.  The restaurant is stylish and cool.  It was a little loud but that's just NYC!   My poor rating is really because of the service!  My Aunt & Uncle have gone to the restaurant 5+ times.  It was a place that they highly recommended and that they were excited to introduce to me. They were disappointed in the service from not only the hostess but also the waitress... If you decide to go, I hope you have better service and if the restaurant management takes notice of this review.  I hope they will make their staff aware that going out is suppose to be enjoyable and disappointed!

Came here for dinner. Had the stuffed tomato, it was mediocre. The flavor wasn't dynamic at all. Ordered the midnight flyer cocktail, I couldn't even drink it. I never send drinks back but this one went right back where it came from. Ordered the Brooklyn cue..much better. Slow service. Actually, no service. I get that it is Monday night but how unimpressive. My water glass sat empty for my entire meal and my server was awol until presenting me with my bill. There are thousands of amazing restaurants in this city. This unfortunately isn't one of them.

I had dinner here a few weeks ago at the bar. i have to say that I had an amazing time. The bartender Tom, was so cool and funny. He made the experience a lot of fun. The food was delicious too say the least. I cant wait to go back. If I had one complaint it would be the other bartender, I think her name was Kelly, or Kelsey? Very strange girl and seemed flustered the whole time. But over all, LOVED!!!

Consistently delicious. Even on delivery. Everything I've tried has been way worth every penny. Even a simple side of kale is done just right. I love when a restaurant puts just as much care on the sides as they do their mains. Thanks for a great dinner Bogota!

I can get past this place being overpriced because its local and the staff is super friendly. On the rare occasion that I do take-out, I cannot stand by the juice bar and endure the manager? being overly aggressive and loudly scolding the workers. Not only should she have some tact in front of the customers, more importantly, she should have a less hostile approach when speaking to her staff.  If this woman is the manager, she needs to be fired, if she's an owner, I don't want to spend another dollar here.
Okay place! Wine is okay and food is expected if a chain! Atmosphere more of a sports bar then italian. Okay for a fun night out with no expectations of great italian!

Went here in April 2014  -- great food -- a surprise given the strip-mall location!  Excellent hummus, baba ganoush.  If you order the "dinner," it's a lot of food.  We had kebabs/ gyros combo. Very good food for the price, atmosphere is family-friendly.  Ignore the fact that its a strip mall...this place makes good food in a nice clean friendly place.  total happiness.
My new favorite spot in town.
Great selection on menu, clean and very helpful wait staff. Grace is excellent and very knowledgeable. Salmon is Devine but the shredded Brussels sprouts are out of this world. Highly Recommended

Today was my second visit within a month.   The chicken takes 30 mins to make but is worth the wait as it comes out in a generous portion, warm and succulent.  The atmosphere takes me away to Greece.  Last but not least the service is on point; the entire staff makes you feel welcome and gracious for your business.

What a TOTAL RIP OFF this place is!!!  Went here for brunch and OMG what a poor excuse for a restaurant that says they serve brunch it was. Total Disaster!!  First off, it took several minutes before anyone came to our table to ask my brother and I if we wanted anything to drink.  (Mind you, the place was EMPTY!!  with the exception of a couple having coffee at a table on the other side of the restaurant). Finally the waiter comes over and asks if he could take our drink order. When we tell him what we want, he says he's sorry but he can't give us that because it's not on the brunch menu!  WTF?!!? Are you kidding me??  After giving our opinion about how ridiculous we thought that was, he says he'll go and ask the bartender if we can get what we want. Hello???  We're customers willing to spend money in your poor excuse of an establishment-give us what we want. He then comes back and says the bartender will accommodate us. (Why thank you sir mixologist!!). NOW THE NASTY FOOD... I went with the steak and eggs, my brother with some shrimp panini thing. Let me tell you- not only horrible tasting, but 3 tiny pieces of steak (tips) with two eggs over easy for $20 plus -RIDICULOUS!!! (That my friend is not steak and eggs!!!)  My brothers shrimp were frozen baby shrimp you find in the fried rice of a cheap Chinese restaurant. (Another $20+ dish). What an insult to a foodies intelligence. Didn't want to complain as we just wanted to leave. (Waiter nowhere to be found anyway!!). Now, finally the waiter blesses us with his presence with bill in hand. (Wtf hello can we please have more water?!!?). We ask for one more drink before we leave to hopefully drown our horrific experience of a brunch. He informs us that he cannot because they are now closed. CLOSED???? (Had you come around earlier and asked if we needed anything else, we wouldn't be having this conversation!!!)   And besides...It's only 4pm!!!  He tells us they close at 4 and reopen at 6. Newsflash... If you have customers in your restaurant who are willing to spend money, TAKE THE MONEY AND MAKE THE CUSTOMER HAPPY!!  Needless to say, this was the worst experience and restaurant I've ever been to. Considering this is L.I.C. and has tons of great places for brunch, this is one place to avoid at all cost!!!  Don't say I didn't warn you...
Amazing!  Sometimes the pizza is the best, sometimes the calzone is the best and sometimes they both are.  Awesome, quiet spot.  Just put your name down early and go get a drink nearby.

Groupon was a great deal. Servers are great. Food is above average. The place is never packed for some reason, even being right in center city. I would recommend, but do expect a more casual than formal setting
Food is great. Service not quite there yet...
i love the pizza here i think its just as good if not better that robertas! the outside seating is really nice you forget your in brooklyn and its right in my hood love it im a regular
Probably the tastiest barbecue I've ever had, plus the prices are great. All of the food was fantastic and the owner is a great guy. I went on my birthday and he gave my whole group desserts.
Nice place great service better food !  Couldn't get enough of the sweet bread they provided .

My friend and I came to eat here in sort of round-about fashion: I thought there was a Friendly's off the same exit, but we couldn't find it, and we didn't want to eat McDonald's etc. American Steak House (ASH) shares a parking lot with another diner, so we flipped a coin. Chance chose the other diner, but when we got close enough to see in the window, we decided that chance was wrong, and headed into ASH. We were greeted by and ordered from a very friendly counter attendant. We were walked to a table in the dinning room, after which we went back past the counter to the salad bar which occupied an entire room, with a surprisingly large amount of options, including chicken legs, 5 kinds of pasta salad, 4 kinds of pudding, and more. I ordered the steak and shrimp, which wasn't great but wasn't terrible, and my friend had the chicken parmesan. The meal filled me up, but in that way where you're still a bit hungry. At no point were we presented with anything of desirable quality, and both meals did quite a number on our insides for the remainder of the ride, with my bubbleguts lasting well into the night. I wish I could remember our server's name, she had long, dark hair and was absolutely lovely. She brought us to our table, brought our food, made us comfortable, checked on us periodically, and answered our many questions about the inner workings of the establishment. We had to ask about tipping, because we had already paid before being seated, but hadn't left a tip yet because our dining experience had only just begun. Our server informed us that most people either leave cash on the table after their meal, or return to the front counter to leave a tip with a card. If you want to leave a $5 tip via credit card, you are actually purchasing your server a $5 gift card to the restaurant they work at, which seems like a terrible, shameful, and questionably legal business practice. Can you imagine having a family, and instead of being able to provide for them, forcing them to come to your place of work to eat food that makes them feel like they'll have diarrhea? I'd recommend tipping in cash. Overall I can't say I'd return to ASH unless I really wanted to punish my insides again, or it happened that every other restaurant on 95 disappeared. But 3 stars for the service and the story to tell the kids..

This review is for a private event! We just celebrated our son's bar mitzvah and we could not be more pleased with the outcome.  We loved working with Melissa from start to finish.  The food and atmosphere were also great!  Thank you!

The tacos are good.. but as a vegetarian, I found the potato mixture to be bland.  It tasted like boiled potatoes with no flavor.  I wouldn't go out of my way to come here, but if you are in the neighborhood, you can check it out.

Located in the historic Vermont House, The Gryphon surpasses expectations.  We've eaten here several times already in the short time they've been open.  Haven't had a bad meal yet.  The Vineyard Chowder is the best soup in Town, hands down.  The Bison Hangar is very high quality, though the side cabbage could be a bit bolder in flavor.  The burgers are great and cooked exactly as ordered.  The salmon dish was worth going back for.  The beer selection is good, and the drink specials are imaginative and prepared with great care.  The desserts are special, save room!  The owners are on premises and take great care to see to a satisfying experience.  The lunch menu is very attractive in content as well as pricing.  Just a short one block walk on Main from the foot of Church Street, this is a restaurant and bar that is worthy of regular visits.
The Pizza is great but this place it's a litte bit overrated, specially the prices are a little high for the quality of the food, and waiting for a table can last hours.

Went here with my family a few years ago for lunch on one of our trips to NYC and loved the food here! The Grilled Chicken Skewers were amazing and the Dark Chocolate "Bag" is an immediate staple to have for dessert on the menu.

My boyfriend and I got a small feast to share. It was yummy but some of the meat was dry. They have a nice selection of BBQ sauce to use at the table. A little pricey but overall not bad food and the host and waitress were very polite. The decor is fun to look at and they have funny and old vintage signs
Second time this year!! We love it here! This time got the mushroom smothered chicken biscuit! We live in Florida and make sure to stop by while in NYC. Great prices, food, and coffee!

I would say this is the one place I've been to that had a good chicken pad thai with an extra kick of freshness to it. I also had the Chinese watercress salad that was extremely delicious. I loved the thai iced tea, it was super sweet. And the curry with chicken was also great. I was a bit upset with the customer service though. After waiting 20 minutes for my change, the waitress asks if I was waiting for changed.

i came, i saw, i conquered(with cheese) lol...place is small but the flavor is big!!! only way they do wat they do is if the second u walk into that door ur magically transported to philly. thats the only way ur gettn this in brooklyn. the man is a genius, a scientest, and a chef. thats the only explanation. pass by.. you wont b disappointed.
I'm in love with Thai food and I would say this is my go to spot when I'm in park slope! I always get the chicken pad thai and a thai iced tea and my night is set! Love this place!!!

Not like the original. I mean not only did you get my order wrong. You told me I had to tell you to chop the meat! To think I drove from DC here for the dole purpose of showing my wife a great cheesesteak and left with a poor facsimile of an original great. I'll go to Jim's next time or back to the original.

If you were walking by 46 eldridge st. You would do just that walk by. This hole in the wall walk up joint has a limited menu and a hectic pace. I was showing two friends around New York and I had found this place and marked it on google. For $7 we were all three full and we agreed it may have been one of the best tasting meals we had. We had the fried Pork and Green onion dumplings and we shared a slice of the fryed sesame bread. If I lived in New York I would take the subway here at least once a week.
Very good place especially on Sunday's with the NFL ticket! Food is good and service is surprisingly good! Would come back and recommend this place for family and friends!

The farm stand salad was filling and amazing. The vegan scrapple was delicious. The coffee was great too. The staff are super friendly. And I love the decor and atmosphere. I like this place. I am looking forward to returning and trying out more items on the menu. The food did take while to arrive. But they just opened. I'll let it slide. The staff was hustling. It was just pretty crowded when I was there.
Homemade Roti Canai is amazing!!  Thin, light, crispy pancake with curry with chicken and potato.  Prawn Mee Soup was a little too rich and shrimpy for me, but it was great none the less.

This place cannot even get one star from me. There's false advertisement. The man behind the counter? His attitude was horrendous! Customer service skills were at an ALL TIME LOW! He was so darn RUDE. I REFUSE to come here EVER AGAIN. YOU GUYS GET 2 THUMBS DOWN FROM ME!  NEVER AGAIN!!!!

Excellent excellent excellent. The short ribs are not to be missed. We had the deviled eggs-- pretty good; the arugula salad-- stellar; the short ribs (mind blowing) and pumpkin cheesecake. So good. Highly recommend
Great experience.. Dan Dan Noodles and Dry Lamb Pot were the best at a 5 for spicy. Food was good, a little too spicy (peppers extra hot), plenty to eat and price was awesome for five people
Used to be great food and service has been going down hill past 3_4 months food not as tasteful and food takes forever to get

After taking my order, they realized I was out of their delivery area.  Instead of calling me back, they delivered my dinner (the owner nonetheless) and then called to let me know next time I'll have to pick up.  Now THAT'S customer service.  And the food is amazing.   Love these guys!!
Waffle bowl the is perfect hangover remedy. Go early and sit at the counter, people watch and wake up slowly before the crowds come.
All i can say is THIS IS THE BEST DINER EVER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I highly recommend this place to everybody!!!!!!!!!!
Excellent Restaurant. Food was great! wait staff were fantastic. Definitely recommend this to friends and family.

The Ramen is delicious!! I went there few night ago with my girlfriend, she ate there few times already and said its a must to try. Although we waited at the bar for about an hour - it was worth it! Real authentic Japanese cuisine, the soup is amazing!! p.s for the appetizer don't forget to try the chicken buns - so yummy!!!!

Ordered three plates last night, a chicken wrap, penne ala vodka, and chicken francese. My two roommates and I all got food poisoning. This will be the last time we offer from here. This restaurant needs to be more responsible when handling food.

A local gem Lovely atmosphere - excellent hosts and waitstaff - interesting cocktails and outstanding food. Interesting and well executed cuisine as explained by the host as a more British colonial influenced indian style - plates are presented as complete entrees rather than the more traditional pass around family style. Each entree included rice, naan and sauce - complete and satisfying - each interesting and delicious. I can't wait to go back. Highly recommended.

Amazing, amazing, amazing! My 1st time in NY, googled best restaurants in the area and Rubirosa was on every list! Loved how quaint it was...i wanted to try something authentic and simple so that I can taste their sauce, because it's all in the sauce! Well, their sauce was orgasmic! I told them they should bottle it! Had the rice balls and they were cooked to perfection. Their banana split was a perfect ending to a great meal!! Can't rave enough about this place. Got back to Miami craving that meal all over again! Great service as well btw!!!

Right when you walk into this "hole in the wall" restaurant you'll realize the atmosphere is immediately unique. It's in a weird spot but DO NOT JUDGE A BOOK BY ITS COVER. Spontaneously, my boyfriend and I were both craving Italian and it was our date night. Yelp reviewers ranted about its delicious entrees. Boy were they right. The moment you open the door countless awards cover the wall between the entrance and hostess area. I had never even heard of this restaurant and honestly, it's quite pricey. From the moment we got there- right up to leaving, the whole experience was romantic, delicious, and the servers knew what they were talking about. Even the bread with olive oil and seasonings was flavorful. Everything was excellent. I ordered the Gnocchi Genovese I believe it was and my boyfriend ordered the Free Range Organic Chicken, both were fabulous.  My dish was cooked to perfection! I didn't even need a knife to cut the meat, it was tender, like butter! With the fresh/ organic ingredients they use, it's worth EVERY penny. We will definitely be returning. If you have any doubts, just go, you won't regret it!

Its hard to miss this place at the corner with lots of people gathered around. I went here on a Wednesday night around 7pm by myself and there was barely any wait. Even for 2 people you would get seated quickly. The menu is very simple: there are four types of pizzas you can order (no slices just pies) of two different sizes. Then you choose additional toppings. I chose a small mozzarella pizza with basil, pepperoni, and sun dried tomatoes. I should've chosen a basil pizza instead. The price here is not worth it and the pizza was moderately okay. I think I would prefer dollar slices over this. Its only known for being a brick oven pizza place. The staff here do not seem friendly but the location is conveniently close to the Brooklyn Heights Promenade park.

I was in the neighborhood on a somewhat busy Friday night with some peeps.  They wisely got Taqueria Diana, but I had that for lunch and wanted something else, so I gave these guys a shot.   After waiting on line for 10 minutes to get to the counter, I paid for my regular fries with especial sauce, after which time they told me there would be another 10 minute wait.  I'm not a big fan of standing on lines, so if they told me there would be a 10 minute wait I'd have just went elsewhere before I even paid.  But the reason for the delay? Someone ordered two trays of fries, and they were going to make the entire two whole batches first.  Again, I'd normally have left already, but my friends were waiting down the block for their food, and I wanted something (different), too. Now I don't know: a) what kind of person thinks two trays of rapidly cooling fries is good for a party, as opposed to some sensible hors d'oeuvre, like cheese and crackers? Or some damn pizzas. b) what kind of establishment will satisfy this one pissant at the expense of 20-30 customers? What's the appeal of this place? That it has a line and must be good? The fries are OK, sure, I've snagged a few from a co-worker before, but over 20 minutes wait for a $5 bag of fries? I gave them their extra 10 minutes, and they were still filling that jerk-off's party order.  I asked for my money back, and they made a pretty weak insult about not taking me seriously on account of my height.  I know they're busy and I'm not sensitive about my height, but his comeback to my very profane words about their awful service was lame. So yeah; these assholes have OK, overpriced fries and shitty/rude service . And they're in a neighborhood lousy with drunk hipsters with too much money, so it doesn't matter what Yelp says, anyway.  You'll find me at Mamoun's, Two Bros., Taqueria Diana, Halal Guys, or *anywhere* else in this neighborhood.

Went here last night with my family due to the positive reviews. I have to agree with everything said before. The staff was attentive and got everything right. The menu is relatively small, but this seems to allow for better dishes all around. We had half the menu items, including the ribs in chocolate sauce (sounds odd, but was delicious), the truffle calamari (didn't taste too much truffle, but I was ok with that and the calamari was cooked well), the charred edamame, and the chicken lollipops for appetizers; the rolling chicken, duck confit, udon with shrimp, chicken fried rice, and pad thai for entrees. Everything was cooked well, and what surprised us most was the flavor combinations, especially in the sauces and sides. We kept going back for more, just to see what the hell the flavor was (whatever it was, it worked really well with the dish). My favorite was the jasmine panna cotta for dessert. Everyone from my parents to my 5-year-old niece enjoyed the food. We will definitely be back.
really good classic brunch

Delicious in every way. The free wings are spicy and saucy Szechuan. The burger with their aioli is delicious. The fried chicken and cornbread waffle is a must- goes perfectly. The PB&J panna cotta was delicious and I hate PB&J- service was great and price is right.

Been there many times.  But never again, out of anger. My advice: never, never take a group of more than four to Becco before the theater. My wife invited a large family group of our children and grandkids to dinner and the theater in honor of my 70th birthday.  She called Becco a month ahead of time.  Reserved a table for 10.  Specified 6:00.  Specifically asked for the upstairs or the back room.  Specifically asked Becco to note that we had to make a theater curtain: 10 tickets to Matilda to make.  (For us, at least, not a small expense.) Becco called my wife several times during the month to reconfirm.  Each time, she was asked to confirm that we had theater tickets. Finally, the evening arrived.  Our whole party was at reception desk by 5:50.  Told it would be just a few minutes.  Got told it would be just a few minutes 6 more times.  Finally got seated at 6:35.  That is got seated at a crowded table.  In the bar.  With one of our party's back up against a narrow crowded corridor of people standing between the bar stools and his back. No waiter, no menus until one of us went up to one of the managers to complain.  Nearly 7:00. The end result: no time for appetizers, no time for desserts, no time for a comfortable family dinner to start the evening. What should Becco have done?  It's pretty simple.  You have a sell-out restaurant.  You have no problems with the number of "turns" you have to make per night.  Don't overbook.  If you can't handle a party, tell your customers instead of taking a reservation. Don't protect your profitability at your customers'  expense.
hate the fact that this place is extremely tiny. the tacos are good, but the breakroom fries are better.

Good wine and a nice atmosphere but the food is very overpriced: tiny portions and more than half of each dish consists of bland, unsalted bread. I feel like this is one of those places people fall over themselves praising and convincing themselves they love because it's a nice space in a cute location and you might find yourself seated next to Julianne Moore or someone like that but if you break the food down, you're really getting almost nothing and it's either not that tasty (the steak tartare had no seasoning at all) or something you could make at home in less than a minute for about 35 cents (the $10 anchovy tartine). Our dessert (the chocolate mousse) was the only tasty thing we had, out of eight dishes (and, funnily enough, the only one with any salt). In any case, I'm not trying to scare anyone away. It's a cute spot and nothing was terrible. But I'd recommend it for drinks and one plate at the most and not for dinner.

What can I say about the best place ever? We shared the double bacon burger, the bacon hot dog, the grilled cheese, and burger with fried shallots. We also feasted on cheesy french fries with hot red peppers. Frogs Leap wine and Yard beer was perfect seeing that we were visiting from the Napa area. The crowning glory was the pumpkin custard. Cheers to Patricia and Derrick the manager for making our first experience at Shake Shack a delicious and fun evening.

Craving some real good beef brisket for the last few days, i yelped this place out since i was in nearby Dumbo. Having had spectacular brisket from a food truck a few weeks before, my bar was set high.Out of several in-a-row mediocre eating experiences, i was really hoping this Red Hook hipster eatery would get my thumbs up, unfortunately i was again disappointed. The few quick reviews i read (very positive) didn't prepare me for the huge Saturday evening line out the door to the order window (about a 45 minute wait) , or the lack of table service. It took us about 5 minutes to get oriented, and figure out how this weird place worked (just get on line like cattle to slaughter). While waiting on line, one nervously looks around the establishment trying to eyeball a seat, there were four of us, and the long beer festival hall tables didn't make the task easy. Once at the order "window" the "butcher" asks you what you want, and cuts off pieces of it, and weighs it right on the spot. The meat prices average $25-$30 a pound. Some things were cheaper, like the sausage, which they ran out of . The beef ribs are $25 a pound, bone and all (are you f*cking kidding me?!?) were too rich for my blood to even try. Though I suspect if its like everything else I tried, good thing I didn't waste my money. So we ordered we ordered the beef brisket, dark Chipotle chicken, lamb & pork belly, and a side of Mac n Cheese ($8 for large). Out of all those things, the cheesy mac was the best tasting, garnering a 7/10 on my subjective taste scale. The Brisket was just ok, at a 6/10. Not even close to the cheaper and much better brisket I had from the food truck. I hate myself for not remembering what it was called. The lamb belly was very dry, and had no taste (though it had a spicy rub) 3/10 The pork belly was dry and tasteless too 2/10 The chipotle chicken was spicy and decent tasting, but super dry 3/10 My friends pulled pork had no taste, and a weird mushy consistency 2/10 Their potato salad (is that what it was??) had a weird tangy-mixed with coleslaw type formula. I kinda liked it, but it was weird nonetheless 4/10 Other notes... The cashier didnt say thank you when I was done ordering and gave this kidults their due tip. The banjo playing band from Flyoverlandia, sucked. Parking took a little time to find (Saturday night, and lots of other establishments in the area). On the plus side, the beer was good. All in all I spent close to a C note and was very disappointed. Though I've never had Dallas BBQ's brisket, their Beef ribs are AWESOME, and you get a huge rack (like 3-4 pounds) for 15 bucks, with a bunch of sides. How these hometown a-holes can charge $25 a pound (thats like 1-2 ribs) for beef, is beyond me. Tommy says skip it.

I went here tonight with my family because I've heard it was so great from multiple people, and I'm sad to to say I was very disappointed! The food portions were actually surprisingly small, and the food itself was OK at best.  The food took forever, and my waitress didn't seem to care one way or another.  Overall I will not be coming back. 1-10 I give it a 3.

Cozy little placed with a  (hopefully on purpose) distressed look throughout. It actually kind of gives the place a dirty vibe. The floor is unfinished and even had a few cracks, the table had chips of paint missing. You can't really tell if it's on purpose or they just didn't have the budget to make the place look nice. We shared the Chips & Guacamole, pork tacos, and salsa verde chicken enchiladas. The Chip and guac was good and there was plenty of guac. Chicken enchiladas were very good and more flavorful than typical. The pork tacos weren't very good, and in fact lacked flavor. There just wasn't much too them at all. Service was decent, not great but not terrible. They seemed as if they're not used to being as busy as they were as the place was full and there were even people waiting outside. Plenty of waiters but not really fully attentive. Guess that's what receiving a Michelin star does for business. The star was part of the reason we decided to go, and to be honest we prefer the Mexican food at Skinny's just a few blocks away. The spicy margarita was good and very different.

Being from Maryland, I don't just get to go to White Castle when I want. Friends and I were in Edison one night and just knew we would have to make a pit stop here for late night eats. The roads confused us, but the adventure was worth the while. Yum! Sliders! Yum! Fried starches! Happy bellies for all of us. :)
What a selection of whiskey! Very cool place! Very knowledgable staff, let them pick!

I've been coming here for years now and sad to say my  most recent experience was horrific. My mother and I made 7:45 reservations for a Sunday night. We started with the octopus special, unfortunately it was extremely salty. My mom had a pasta seafood dish and I had the scallops, both dishes were extremely salty. I don't know if it was a different chef that night or what but i was very disappointed in the food and the service. During our dessert the bus boys started cleaning up all the tables, includings ours! We were in the middle of eating when he took away our water. When he asked him to leave the water, he gave us a nasty attitude and threw some other water glasses on the table. We ignored him and continued to eat dessert and have a funny conversation. I guess he thought we were laughing at him because he approached us aggressively and yelled "What is so funny, i like to laugh to". I was in such a state of shock and said "it was a private conversation". He then proceeded to ask us what our nationality was, if we were Hispanic. I asked him what did it matter to him and tried to ignore him. He asked us several more times what was so funny. The manager was not in that night or else I would have asked to speak to him. Needless to say we finished our dessert and left immediately. I will def not be returning and no longer recommend it to anyone. Terrible dining experience, waste of money, the food was horrible and the service was terrible.
this place is cute good drinks and great fries also the avocado toast is my fav great place to stop if your walking along the highline

This was the worst dinner experience I have ever had.  Our waiter would constantly ignore my friends and I as he was busy with other tables.   The food took a very long time to come out and it was only so-so.   They failed to split our check correctly and charged me more than they should have.  I will not be returning.

I've eaten here recently.   It was really good.  Had the crab sandwich and shrimp steam pot.  Was really full and satiated.   Friendly staff.  And a laid back atmosphere.   A breath of fresh air from the pretentious restaurants that are popping up all over my native Harlem

If you want to eat at Halal Guys - you better like spicy.  A little bit of hot sauce goes a LONG way here.  And they really don't know what "just a little" means.  The lines are super long - and the quality of food has really gone down in recent years.  There are better ways to spend $6.
love this place, love Halal food... I recommend this place very much!!!!!!
Lots of food for a great price!  I wish they have this in the Bay Area...
Food tastes great, line can be long but moves really quickly, had the mix over rice and lots of the white sauce, only paid $6.

The food here was superb!   The fresh bread is warm and fresh, so delicious.  We started with the mussels.   The portion was enough to share with two people.  It was made with tomatoes and crumbled sausage, I wanted to keep dunking my bread.  I had the veal with mushrooms and artichokes , it was to die for served with mashed potatoes and finely shredded vegetables.  My date had chicken dish with peppers and it was perfectly spiced for him.  We arrived late, however they treated us with the best service ever.  Even the gentleman who worked as car valet was so very nice.  We skipped dessert because we felt bad we arrived so late.  We are definately  going back.  I feel the atmosphere was romantic and very peaceful.  Cannot wait to try the other dishes.  Bravo to the owners, the wait staff and the kitchen!  You must try this place!
Best kept secret, really good Thai food in a beautiful neighborhood I recommend the fried calamari and pad see yu =]

My husband and I both love le Virtu, so we were eagerly anticipating the opening of Brigantessa. The first floor smells delicious because of the pizza oven. We sat upstairs and I was surprised about how big it was. The space was beautiful with natural light, wood floors, and Italian photos on the wall. Our waiter seemed nervous and kept apolozing for everything, which was completely unnecessary since he was really attentive and nice. We ordered the artichokes and octopus appetizers, both of which were really good. I could have used another artichoke in the portion, but I'm greedy. When we first ordered, I was a little disappointed that the Clam Pizza wasn't on the menu, since I read good things online and had a similar pizza when I lived in Italy, but was told that they were having a problem with the clams in the oven. So, I ordered the Pizza Zucca, which had squash and cipollini onions on it. I don't eat dairy and was worried getting it without cheese would be a problem, but our waiter checked with the chef and it was fine.  Despite my earlier disappointment over the lack of clam pizza, I was really happy I got it and loved it. I would order it again. My husband got the Pizza cannolo- with smoked mozzarella, pork sausage, and porcini mushrooms. It was so pretty and had such a fun shape. Since we were in a carb coma, we didn't get dessert, but a lot of the things sounded amazing. One of the the best, if not the best, pizza I've had since italy. We definitely will be back.

My boyfriend and I came in for the first time last Friday. It was very busy and the service was great. We sat at the bar with Caroline who was extremely helpful and knowledgable when we asked about cocktails. I had the coquito passion and my boyfriend had the smoky room. They both were out of this world! Caroline is a true mixologist, and very friendly. My bf and I shared the salmon brûlée and the brazilian seafood stew. Best Latin food I've had since Brazil. We were impressed with the food, drinks, service and atmosphere and will definitely be back.
i love this place! first time i had brunch there this past weekend. just as good as dinner fish tacos are so good!!! sangria also thumbs up

The food here is not NYC quality but, it is very good for our area. My complaint is the manager.  Over the past year this woman has been nothing but rude, rude and incredibly rude. I usually get my food to go so that I don't have to deal with her. If I want a pleasant dining experience, I go with a Chinese speaking friend. They need to find someone, ANYONE, who can greet customers with a smile and be pleasant and welcoming. Food quality and service has improved over the past year and overall the food is a delight. The manager totally leaves a bad taste at the end of the meal when I walk out the door though.
yum always great to eat a philly cheesesteak here!  a famous place & even if there is a line they are on the ball & wait on everyone quickly.
Awesome atmosphere! So chic and fun and the drinks are AMAZING. Try the Twizzle.

Talk about incredibly large portions.. The food was definitely filling, but I honestly was hoping for quite a lot more in terms of taste. The "famous" chicken was notably dry, and there really wasn't much substance to their fries. The only thing they had on point was their pasta. The food definitely isn't bad, but at the same time doesn't live up to the hype.
Very good but too much overprice. There many other sushi around that are just as good or bettr but they don't cost so much.

I've eaten at bareburger before in NYC and I like them a lot. The food was as good as usual but we had subpar service at the Philadelphia location. It wasn't crowded but it took them a long time to get to us even though there were a lot of employees passing us and we put our menus aside. One guy also tried to clear our fries when we still had half of them left and were actively eating them.
I just had the BEST French onion I've ever experienced in a restaurant!!! The Buffalo chicken sandwich was great too and the service was very charming!!! I will be back at Pauline's Cafe!!!!

This place is absolutely wonderful. Great food, great prices, and, most importantly, fantastic coffee. Service is fast and polite. And the food is great. If you want a good, fast meal at a good price, this is the place to get it.
The pizza was delicious and so tasty. For a thin crust pizza, it's honestly great. It's a must try if you haven't been here.

Went here on Saturday night with a few friends that live in the area.  Food was GREAT!! 1.  Chicken wings, healthy and crispy, baked in the oven with rosemary, you could eat a lot of them and not feel like your cheating on your diet!! 2.  Prosciutto  and Mozz.....enough said, I'm a sucker for prosciutto! 3. PIZZA PIZZA PIZZA!  We got a sampling with extras to spare to take home, ---white   pizza with truffle and mushroom THIS is a must, AMAZING!  ----margarita (I like the sauce) -----pesto with fresh tomatoes.  Pizza was crispy and a good ratio of sauce/cheese.  You can ask for well done for extra crispy too!! Lots of drink choices, I had a cucumber martini, very good.  And good wine list! Everyone was very nice and welcoming when I first arrived.  Being from New York and loving Grimaldis pizza I was excited to try the new restaurant.  I was surprised at how big the restaurant was, and liked that there was a separate bar area, will be good if you needed to bring kids and didn't want to be near others drinking!   In the main dining room I loved the mural of New York, it really made me reminisce about the area and where the original Grimaldis is! I will certainly be back!!!

I have wanted to try Grimaldis for a while and we will be coming back. We dined for lunch today. The pizza was crispy, the toppings were fresh, the service was good, I really liked it! The cocktail menu looks great. I will be back. Is there a happy hour or late night menu?

Dis is where I want to go if I feel like hitting up a house party where I know no one. Its small, crowded, and packed with an eclectic group of downtown intelligentsia. Every time I go, I feel like I've been transported to Paris in the 20's. It feels old school, but in an exciting way. I always seem to get caught up in conversation with someone I've never met before. Besides the excellent mingling environment, the cocktails are DELICIOUS. Pass on your usual G+T and get weird with whatever they put on the menu that week. The great spot for after dinner cocktails or post-movie snacks (Reuben Croquettes? Yes please!). If you're going to eat, call ahead and get a table. I like to get to this place around 9:30 or 10. Any time after, you'll likely be turned away at the door because its reached capacity. Also, you'll be required to respect the dress code. No flip flops. Go beyond casual. Show them you care, because they certainly do. Hands UP!

Delicious! I'd recommend the Barbecue De Maiale. We ordered the Vongole and Funghi as well. I'm told the Fughi was the best, but I'm not a mushroom person so I did not try. Service was excellent. Our waitress was assertive and the restaurant was accommodating to our party of 4 considering we decided to dine late.

Miya's is a dream, I grew up in Florida on the Gulf of Mexico where fresh local fish was a daily part of life. I went to college in New England where seafood could more easily be categorized a religion than a protein. Miya's-though admittedly boldly experimental- features a menu featuring all sustainable local fish, fresh farmed cheeses and vegetables that come together in a way that's unique and delightful. Go in with an open mind and let the staff take you through a meal that doubles as a history lesson on sushi and sustainable food practices. Yes the menu is long, no you won't be out fast. If you're looking for a spicy tuna roll and miso soup go somewhere else...though their miso is infused with pumpkin and incredible. This is a place where any seasoned foodie will be happy guaranteed.
AMAZING FOOD!!! and you can't beat the unlimited mixed drinks for 1 1/2 options a must go and eat staff was very nice and above all the drinks were NOT watered down!
sheep's milk ricotta & Uovo pizza & garlic pork loin & salted caramel budino for two!!! Can't be more satisfied and full!!!

I couldn't figure out if the salmon was supposed to be chewy. I had to google it to see it was overlooked. I ate it anyway, chew, chew , chew. I got salmon teriyaki. The salad and soup were good though.

This place is the closest thing you can possibly get to a speakeasy. Such an awesome ambiance and atmosphere. The waiters/waitresses are fully dressed and in character as if in the 1930's. They have a fantastic bar which is pretty expensive but worth it. I haven't tried the food but i heard good things. Live instrumental bands that play jazz.

WORST service I have ever encountered.... I'm new here from Miami looking for a yummy Chinese spot I order out 3-4x a week...I have ordered a few times. First time they delivered and refused to bring it up to my door. Mind you I have a 90 y/o grandmother I take care of... When I told then to please bring it up the guy rudely huffed and complained. Next time I ordered for pick up. Fast service... Now today I call for delivery again and the guy says "I have to come down to get the food". I tell him my situation again then he hangs up on me. I called back several times and finally got him on the phone and told him I would come downstairs and he rudely said "NO, NO delivery for you now" when I asked if he was the owner or manager he said he was neither of those but he didn't care no delivery and hung up on me again. I called back again and told him I would pick it up and he said if I'm only ordering one thing then don't bother to order..... I was in shock at how rude they could be. I will never give this business my money again they are rude and nasty ill mannered people... They should change workers might get more business. Disgusting person answering the phone he should be FIRED!!!!!!!!!!

I did my birthday dinner here. They had so many great options for private parties and our waiter was awesome. I come here all the time and just snag a seat at the bar. My ultimate favorite thing in the world is the Truffle oil Mac and cheese. You won't regret it!!!

I was really excited to try this new place as it is right around the corner from where I live. I have also spent a great deal of time living in Sydney and was hoping for a great cappuccino or flat white. No matter how good the coffee may be, or how pretty the granola and yogurt is arranged, or how beautifully smashed that avocado is on the 7-grain-whole-wheat-rye-raw toast, right off I rolled my eyes to see that they don't serve skim milk. But they DO serve almond and soy. Why? It's certainly not "Australian" to do that...every cafe in Sydney serves skim milk. Its snobby. It is also ignorant because no one drinks full fat MILK anymore...its 2014 guys....fat, skinny, healthy, or not, NO adult in modern day America drinks whole milk. CHILDREN drink whole milk. So if you open up a cafe (in Nolita of all places), just make your clients happy and offer skim milk. All the skinny pretty girls you're serving? They want skim too! (Oh and guess what...its even cheaper than the soy and almond you're either buying or hand-making)

Couple things: 1.) this place is legitimately overhyped on yelp. 2.) the service is slow 3.) the Benedict Jane which was recommended was not that great. Best part of the dish were the potatoes. 4.) blood Mary was actually pretty good. 5.) this place got two stars because there was an eggshell in my dish, in my first bite, and that just ultimately ruined the remainder of my experience, my friend had a crab shell or crawfish she'll in her first bite so that destroyed hers as well, my cousin like her baked egg dish  no weird errors there.  I mean it's fine, the food was fine, but when you get excited and take that first bite and get an egg shell and try to look for a paper napkin to spit it out in in front of everyone and get awkward suck it up, try to swallow the egg shell, then you can't because the texture is like sand and it's too finely ground at that point, you're just stuck with crap in your mouth etc. meh I don't want to go back. Enjoy.
