After telling me that I was the one who made the mistake (ummm, no...I would never have ordered what they served me), she then giggled with the cook after giving me the EXACT same incorrect order....for the second time. No apology, no assistance, just accusatory-ness and irritation at our existence.   No thank you.

This place is very classy with a coat check from the moment you enter and friendly wait staff. The bartender made the most wonderful Espresso Martini (my signature drink). I enjoyed the entire experience with a very tasty charred Beef with perfectly melted cheese atop.  The ambiance is old school with brick walls
Great food and very good service too!  I will definitely be back to this place.
The best asian skewer in philly. All ingredients are so fresh and very nice service unlike some Chinese restaurant around here. The price is acceptable and atmosphere is cute.

I booked the Malt House for a Happy Hour for about 200 people on a Monday night. The management and staff were wonderful to work with. The beer was delicious. We came in October, so there was a large selection of seasonal pumpkin and Oktoberfest beers. The food was tasty too. They provided a generous amount for the guests. The bar is in a great location, close to NYU and Washington Square Park. It got a bit cramped at times, but that is to be expected in the Village. Overall, I would highly recommend The Malt House.

This place is horrible!!!!  I have no idea what how this place gets better ratings. I had the BBQ ribs. There is nothing BBQ about these ribs. They are BOILED!!! Who the hell boils ribs, slathers them w cheap sauce and try's to pawn them off as a culinary treat!?? They were terrible I threw half of them out. The pork fried rice had very little pork, the rice tasted burnt and was stale as if it was prepared days ago. The egg roll was a decent size and fried week, but was sloppy inside and again no pork!!! I wouldn't try it again or recommend it.
The beer list is one of the best you will find anywhere, and there is always something interesting on tap!  Fast, friendly service.  The drunken shrimp is great, and so are the burgers.
Really nice place, really nice staff. Loved it

Really great pumpkin coffee! They have all kinds of bagels to choose from. I got a breakfast sandwich with some veggies and cheese.  Very tasty! Ps they have $2 pumpkin muffins for all you pumpkin lovers!! I read thru their lunch menu, looks all very fresh! I'll probably take a to go sandwich for my lunch later!

Terrible! The menu is a piece of paper, yes just a piece of paper, the food was nothing more than average and the walls where they placed the candles on tables are burnt! I usually don't hate on restaurants on the internet but this place sucks. Never again!

This restaurant has generic american Chinese food, but their service has always been amazing. The people working there were friendly and fast... Until tonight. I tried to order takeout (10 min for delivery) and before tax the order came to 9.55. There is nothing about pre tax delivery minimums and they have always delivered in the past, but the american girl who answered the phone tonight was rude and refused to deliver without raising the price (before tax). As I stated before there is no mention of needed to reach the minimum first and this girl was a brat and should be fired. Needless to say I will no longer support them.

We have been to Nolita several times since it opened and have always been impressed. The decor is warm and sophisticated and the wait staff is always friendly, quick, and eager to share the specials. My go-to is the chicken parm which is always huge and super crispy. My ONLY complaint is that the spaghetti it comes with is rinsed and can sometimes pool on my plate but I have absolutely no doubt I could ask for it sticky and they would accommodate (if only i could remember). I have had the pear and champagne drink a few times and it continues to impress.  My husband gets the spaghetti and meatballs and stuffs himself silly. For dessert I have only had the cheesecake but, again, it was great. We will continue to scratch our italian itch here and will definitely try our luck with delivery!

If you want to OVERPAY for BURNT pizza and a server that isn't attentive then this place is for you.  I heard the server say, "Is everythink okay?" Before we could answer he'd already turned and dashed away.  I DO NOT LIKE BURNT PIZZA and would have complained to the server if he spent a minute at our table.  Then to top it off, I told the cashier that the pizza was burnt, he said, "you should have told your server".  Oh, and before I forget, don't expect refills for your drinks.  SOUP WAS TOO SALTY, SALAD TASTED SOUR, AND THE PIZZA WAS BURNT.  THAT IS ALL THEY SERVE AND COULDN'T GET ONE ITEM RIGHT. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE THERE ARE BETTER PLACES NEARBY!  LIKE CAFE ANTONIO'S ACROSS THE STREET.
Delicious. Fresh sushi. Nice wait staff.  Some authentic bar food. I'm glad this opened up in LIC!

Came here once after going to the movie theater with the family.  We had a good experience with the food and especially loved the lamb chops- this item definitely stood out for all of us in how tasty it was! Came here a long time ago so I don't remember much else, but definitely would have came back again soon if I had the chance!!! I remember leaving quite happy!
These burgers are amazing!!! Will definitely come back. Beware bathrooms are unisex but they give enough privacy so everything is good.

An incredible selection of beers and whiskeys, bourbons, ryes - everything liquid! I was not convinced by the food though!  Burgers were a bit too dry, shrimp sliders extremely dry (the shrimp was so deep fried there was hardly anything left that resembled a shrimp) and both batches of the IPA fries we got were a bit cold-greasy. Old Rasputin Imperial Stout stood out with it's predictable good quality.   I will not order food again, but will definitely grab some drinks the next time in the neighborhood. (For the sweet-tooths, there's a Hungarian pastry shop on the corner!)
Keep your stuff close. We got our stuff stolen right from the bar as soon as we stepped outside.
always great, never disappoints. I haven't really tried any of the burgers but I'm sure they are just as yummy!!

This place has cheated me. I am a vegetarian and always ask the staff to prepare the food without fish/meat/eggs. I also make sure to communicate this when I place an order via seamless. I have ordered from here many times and eaten in as well and each time I give them the same instructions. I placed an order on seamless today and told them to prepare the food strictly vegetarian without fish/meat/egg and they rejected my order saying that they always use fish/oyster sauce. When I questioned them about why this wasn't communicated to me earlier, they just shrugged it off. I am absolutely appalled and disgusted by their callous attitude. I would never have ordered in the first place if they mentioned they put fish/oyster sauce in everything. I plan on registering an official complaint with consumer protection.
I'm still thinking about that black bean burger. I'm going back to next chance I get.
Very Pleasant staff!    I love to the spicy tuna roll! I had the sushi and sashimi combo special Fresh , and prepared well     Stop in and check them out!

A little pricey, but great atmosphere, staff, food and drinks. The menu is somewhat limited, but has most of the basics i.e. pizza, burgers, salads etc. on a more level. We sat outside by the fires on a fall monday night, and it was a great time. Members of our party had cider, beer, and wine, and under the guidance of our server, we were all very happy with our choices. The food was great, nothing crazy, but a quality meal. The outside fire pits are the biggest hit for me, it was a great time and we will definitely go back, not only for relaxed nights, but also a Friday or Saturday.

A true diamond in the rough in Kensington. this place has stepped it up some more and it has become a great local spot. Some more cuisines would be nice. Chris and everyone there is super nice. def reccomend
As part Spaniard, everything I had (bread, chorizo, boquerones, tortilla, and patatas bravas) were absolutely excellent except for the average tortilla. Order everything else though! Great place

I have been there for many times and I am a fan there. I have tried the BBQ and hot pot, and both of them are worth trying. But I did not try them at the same time, because that would be too much for me. I think it is a good place to hang out no matter you go in a small group or in a large group. And the employees there are nice too. By the way, if you go there on your birthday, show them you ID, and you don not need to pay! Free birthday meal!!!

Love love love this place!!!   Been there three times this month and can't wait to go back. Brought three others the last time we went and they loved it too!!   Very reasonable prices and good sized portions. The skirt steak pizza is my favorite.  Wife loves their eggplant.  Service always outstanding and great atmosphere.

Modern European, young yet gourmet.  So thoughtfully appointed.  Music is albums on a turntable. The food is fresh and a taste of Paris' best bistro fare. Vegans accommodated. A quick taxi exit off the BQE just across the East River from the East Village.
Very poor management. Very rude staff. Sorry did not get chance to judge the food, coz the staff was not ready to cooperate. Think twice before going with a large group. Very rigid staff

We entered at 10.10 with a group of 15 ppl. I was greeted with "you guys have to order coz we r closing at 10.30" The owner was super rude! First of all, she gave us separate tables. I objected.offf.. M pissed!! Absolute crap on part of restaurant!! Arggghhhh.. Will never ever come again!!!!!! You are done

I'm a big fan of their iselin, nj branch.  This branch's pizza is nowhere near on par with the one in Iselin.  The marinara sauce is lacking in flavor/spices and is waaaay too salty.  They also don't use the same yellowish mozzarella (or mixed) pizza cheese as Iselin.   To top it off their door says they deliver when they don't.   The one in Iselin, NJ is a Pizza connoisseur's dream.  If you haven't tried them, give them a shot and you'll be hooked. Props to Singas in general though for bringging back decently-sized  personal pies with amazing crusts (unlike Domino's or Pizza Hut's standard crusts).
I am rating it 5 stars as the food is closest to an Indian taste. Do try the drums of heaven it's really nice.
Went for Sunday brunch.  Everything was very good and the service was great!
Best pancakes 6 years in a row is overrated. The German Apple pancakes were mediocre at best. The omelettes were over cooked and dry. Definitely left disappointed.
I like hot dogs. I was visiting New Haven and craved a hot dog. I found Jake's online and I am glad I did. I had the Baconator. Great value for the money. Thanks.

The food is fresh and delicious, but over priced. The employees are unfriendly...I go there everyday (for about the past 6 months) for a morning coffee and the employees look at me like they've never seen me before. You would think they would want to have a better connection with their regulars. The only reason I continue to go back is for the convenience and good coffee.
Great service and friendly staff. Breakfast was quick, hot and really good. Nice selection of food on the menu. Nice warm and cozy place to enjoy a pastry, food, coffee or a tea.
horrible food poisoning after having frog legs here. never again.

This place gets five stars because of the balance between quality and value.  The food is excellent with delicate layers of flavoring and great cook.  The curry puffs, egg rolls, etc.. are as good as it gets.  I don't eat fried foods, but those are so delicately done with such a perfect cook that they are not greasy at all.  Crisp and just wonderful. The curries that they do are phenomenal and very nicely balanced.  Rich, but not too rich, well seasoned but not overly seasoned, etc.... I come here a few times a month. Tonight for the first time I had a slight issue with a dish.  The head chef personally saw to it that the dish was redone.  It was taken care of quickly and the results were nothing short of awesome.  They went above and beyond to make sure we had a perfect experience.   I am a regular and plan to continue being a regular here.
One of the best Italian places in Manhattan. By all means deserves the highest rating.

Pizza was a lot bigger than expected and wasn't greasy at all but I found it to be not as tasty as some of the other slices I've  tried in the city. I really think it was the sauce, it just tasted a bit bland to me. It also took at least 30 mins, probably 45, for our small pizza to come. The place was packed but I still didn't understand why it would take so long given how fast those pizzas cook. Overall it wasn't worth the effort to me given how quickly you can get great slices in NYC.

Im from brooklyn and let me tell you, pizzalinos makes an unbelievable pizza. The grandma pizza is delicious and love the chicken roll and pizza bites. I love everything.  The people that work their are very nice and friendly. Joe keep up the good work. Wish you all the best and lots of luck. See you soon!!!!

amazing place inside and out.... its tucked away in a cute spot right off the main street in Princeton and definitely thought it was a plus that they had private parking. it had a really nice romantic ambiance to it and great service from the manager that opened the door for me and my husband to the waitress who gave us the up most care, it was an all around gem of a place to find! yea sure, the food is pricey and you might not get diner sized plates and stuff yourself to the brim food you get amazing tastes and great service for your visit and my husband and i both think that its completely worth it. a nice touch was the owner came up and asked us how our food and night was going and what can we say other that, "great!" and "you have an amazing place!" so please if you're in the near by area you should go to the peacock inn.... you'll have a great time!!

The five star reviews listed have said it all. Great food and service (thank you, Fidel and Glenn), charming and intimate atmosphere, interesting and reasonably priced menu, along with BYOB. We are always welcomed with great fervor and enjoy ourselves immensely. The UWS at its best!
Sarah at the bar was fantastic best food I have had in the area yet. I stopped in on a business trip and it was fantastic all around

"When it comes to crepes, I know what I am doing. I spent time in Brittany where the Galette De Sarrasin (Savory crepes) originated. I can tell you that what you get here is the closest thing to the original I found in the US. I was pleasantly surprised. The staff was attentive. I loved the Mexicana crepe. It s a good mix between European and Mexican flavors. I also like that they serve you salad with your crepe. The atmosphere is nice and their choice of music is very edgy too. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a delicious meal in a great place."

I love the place. First time I took a bite of that burger I was in love. Seriously amazing hands down. The burger just over flows with flavor. I ordered the break room burger i put  their homemade hot sauce on it, and I ordered the breakroom fries. My review would be higher if I loved the fries but the potato tots was not necessary and it needed more cheese, would be better with a creamy sauce added maybe ranch or blue cheese, anyways. I love the staff they seem happy to be there it's as if they understand what's great about the business and genuinely enjoy what they do. Only been here twice was good each time. My boy friend is a huge fan of the drinks. I recommend anyone to go here!

First time making a restaurant rec on Yelp! We went to Shehrazad's this evening with a friend. Had felafel (with a slight delicious zest), extremely moist and flavorful chicken kabobs, a plump spinach pie brimming over with filling and the best baklava I've had in a long time.  (It is a small place where you sit at a counter or at one 2-person table. or you can do take-out. Or you can take your food next door to his hookah bar, 1001 Nights Hookah Bar.) Extremely good value. The owner, George, is Lebanese and you feel like you're his guests and you've haven't felt as welcomed, as well-fed, and as comfortable for a long time. He gave us a tour of both establishments, pointing out his "kitchen" (the restaurant) his "living room" (the front room of the hookah bar) and his "salon" (the cosy back room of the hookah bar). Stop by, and say hello to George for me!
Love their morrocan chicken cous cous. But is really poor service the girl that served me did not smile once. Was a shame because I usually love going there whenever I am in New York.

This was by far the best meal that both my husband and I have ever had!!!  As soon as you walked in you were greeted with the fresh smell of apples from their floor to ceiling wall of apples. The service was exceptional and they provided us with excellent recommendations for both our meals and for the wine pairing.  We were served an amuse-bouche with every single course of our meal.  The Procini Flan was the best appetizer I have ever had. My husband ordered the chocolate souffle for dessert (which he confirmed tasted amazing) and with that they brought us a pineapple/coconut amuse-bouche, a complimentary grilled peach & sorbet dessert, PLUS a tray of a dozen housemade chocolates.  And finally on our way out the door, after we had eaten the best food ever to our hearts content, they sent us home with a take-away lemon tea cake. The overall experience was absolutely exceptional.  It is a must try in NYC.

This is almost as good as it gets when you crave thin crust pizza. I'm not big on pizzas in general, but when I do indulge once in a blue moon then this is the place! It would probably be 5 stars from me if I hadn't tried pizza all over the country and in Italy as well, but it's definitely up there. No doubt about it. The place has an older type vibe to it, like something out of 70s or 80s films. It's very nice overall and gives off a good vibe and lovely atmosphere. The pizza is the thinnest you will find and it is absolutely sublime! If that's your thing then you have to come here. If not, it's still worth a visit. You might love it! Their sweet peppers topping is great and it's usually my go to topping. Everyone is also very nice and welcoming.

definitely one of the best south indian places in the area. It is family owned and you get to see the owner around every now and then. Ala carte is just as good but I would suggest the lunch buffet for the variety. The spices and food taste very authentic and fresh. Rarely have I had something here that I didn't like. I prefer this place over some of the other very well to do south indian places. Food at Myilai is simple to the basics and delicious. Highly recommend. The ambiance is casual and this place seems kid/family friendly.

Just had our babies babtism party here with 15 guest and everything was amazing from the moment we got there to the moment we left. Service was amazing and food even better! Would recommend this place to anyone!

After managing two seats at the communal table, we were promptly greeted by friendly, bubbly, helpful Isabel.  She recommended wines for both myself and my friend, both which we loved.  She placed our order for food and it came out exactly as ordered - and MOST delicious!! There was never a moment that we wanted for anything, because Isabel was extremely attentive.  Our wine glasses were full, our needs were met, even before we actually needed anything. Great experience, outstanding service from Isabel, and a resounding yes to the question of whether or not we will return. Keep up the good work, SCG!!

I've visited a few times over the last month and unfortunately it wasn't the same experience as my first dinner here. The most recent meal was by far the worst and my last try with this place. I had a friend in town so I took her here for dinner. It didn't start out well when the server explained they were out of at least 4 or 5 items on the menu...and it's a small menu. So we ordered a few things to share. The calamari was horrid...chewy and poorly done. Both our pasta entrees were under seasoned, over cooked and flavorless. If you are going to charge $16 for a simple tomato pasta, it better be perfect and this wasn't even close.  A big disappointment, since I really want to love this place! The ambiance is perfect and the place is stunning, the staff is friendly but I'm sorry I will be spending my money elsewhere from now on.

i freakin' love this place! food is always delicious, staff is courteous, and on point. pork slap ale is always on hand as well, a perfect accompaniment to the light, filling, superb cuisine at this fine establishment! !!
From out of town, so yelp helps out a lot. Wasn't disappoint; the food was delicious, the staff was very friendly, and the atmosphere was very cosy! Definitely would recommend!

FINALLY! A gourmet pizza shop on East Passyunk Ave. I am going to boldly put this out there- this pizza is better than that from Zavino and Pizzeria Vetri. They have the wood fire oven and fresh ingredients- but I believe their competitive advantage is the use of imported San Marzano tomatoes. I highly recommend the Margherita (if you, like me, are simplistic when it comes to pizza) and the Cannulo pizza- the pizza/cannoli hybrid with ricotta, porcini mushrooms, and sausage. The Cannulo was quite different but very delicious. In addition to the delicious fod, the wait staff was exremely well-educated and friendly. The place is decorated contemporary with a rustic twist. They serve fresh bread and a delicious good-quality olive oil. I will be back many more times!

Ate here earlier this week.  Excellent selection on the lunch special menu.  I ordered the fish and chips that were very good.  It was a large portion and very well priced.   I ordered a Palm beer draft and the selection of draft beers was excellent as well.  Many micro brews were represented.  Service was great and friendly   It is also a very comfortable restaurant.  Highly recommended.

We came all the way from Manhattan because we heard good things about Krupa Grocery, and believe us, it was well-worth the trip on a rainy Wednesday night. The food - the sausage dish and scallop dish - were both wonderful. The service was warm and friendly, and what's better than a really great glass of wine to top it off? We will definitely be back there soon. Wish it was in the East Village!
pho 2 is my favorite sandwich ever! my husband always switches his up but I'm always loyal to the pho 2.
More hype than substance. Lunch menu is rathered limited to say the least. Service was acceptable.

They offer many traditional fast food dishes; and yes, true to their claim, they offer the same pre-frozen flavorless stuff you can get on the "grease trucks" on Rutgers Campus. Their Fat-Cats: Let me preface this by saying that "Fat Sandwiches" in general are one of the cheapest ways to "get full" on Rutgers Campus.  Usually the perfect filler for often broke students who "don't care" as long as it fills the tank.   Here in Central Jersey, we've seen sampled these sandwiches from dozens of restaurants.  Given the nature of the sandwich, they, rarely run for anything over $7. Mr. G's  uses tasteless cheap Italian rolls (you know the one that stays "fresh forever" but tastes like Styrofoam). ...seriously, the bread almost completely dulls the flavor of the remaining ingredients inside the sandwich.   The burger inside was overcooked and seriously inedibly bland. You could neither taste the beef nor the fat (much like a flip-flop). Seriously guys, step it up.  I've had better burgers at Wendy's.   The fries were okay.  Again, the same frozen stuff you find in all local spots.   Wings:  waaay overpriced at $1 per wing (double what anyone else charges, including Cluck-U)!  Despite the lack of variety in sauce styles, I went ahead an purchased an order to see what the price tag was all about.  I was disappointed by a tray of tiny dry flavorless mini-wings.   If you want the "same old" blandness offered by the cheapest spots in Central J, this place is for you.  They don't even deliver.  So I can simply order the same dishes from just about any Pizza joint in the area.   The hardest/worst part about writing this review is that the cook/staff are clean and fast.  They need to use better ingredients (meat patties, bread, etc.).
An amazing Bahn Mi Thank you Nam Nam I will definitely come back.

Good bar that has great deals on Thursday nights. Had family and friends here for my birthday a year back and the food was excellent as well. Definitely a first stop if you're in South Orange looking for a good mean and a cold beer.

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE SUMS IT UP! My guest and I walk in, it is a Wednesday at 5:45 and from the kitchen is loud spanish music playing. I ask our server about the music and she says it is "for the workers". That should have been the red flag to walk out. Are there hispanics cooking my Thai food? Stupid us stayed and placed our order. Shared dumplings for an app, they were ok, nothing great nothing bad. She had Pad Thai........chicken was DRY, no peanuts, no tofu and red onions in it?!?!?!? I don't even know if it was Pad Thai. I had a Spicy Chicken off the special border. It should have been renamed Bland Chicken and the special was UNspecial. When we asked the waitress about the issues with the Pad Thai she said "all places make it different". Whatever! DO NOT GO HERE!

One of the best burgers i had.  The truffle burger was amazing. The only downfall is that the place is tiny and it gets packed so the service is so so. But this is a burger joint not a 5 star resturant. If you do not like the burgers here something is wrong with you.

Some of the best Italian food I have ever had.  I had lunch there and the special was an eggplant parm sub with a caesar salad.  I hadn't really heard much about the place so I figured they probably couldn't hurt those two things. Well, my expectations were about to me blown away.  First, best caesar I've ever had.  The cheese,dressing, perfect croutons, wow.  Then I tried my sandwich.  Absolutely perfect Italian bread, layers of thinly sliced eggplant stacked with a pillow of cheese covering it.  The sauce was mild but allowed the eggplant to shine.  Every single bite was delicious.  The sandwich was also quite large, it was a big plate of food, though not overwhelming.   The staff was also incredibly warm and kind.  One of the best dining experiences I've had in New Jersey.

The food was good. ordered the Matador and was surprised how much food came with that order! That's a good thing :) would be good for about 3- 4 people. had the Ceviche for starters and was also fantastic! Will be back.

I have been to Cuban Pete's many times but I have to say it is not like it was. Unfortunately, we went last week on a Friday. We purposely went early in order to avoid the crowd. We ordered our appetizers and our dinners at the same time... BIG mistake!! We felt extremely RUSHED because our dinners came out and we weren't even done with our appetizers!! Who does that???? Is it not customary to wait until your diners are done with their first course before you bring the next one out? Two of my friends ordered the  churrasco steak and could not even eat half of it because the meat was chewy. These are not cheap entrees either. I ordered the short ribs and there was just too much grease on my plate and in my rice. Our waiter was great and attentive but I feel the quality of this restaurant has gone down. I won't be going there anymore. If you do go don't order your apps and dinners at the same time!

Been here a few times but wasn't happy the last couple of times. So decided I would give it another shot. What a mistake... Got there at 12:45 pm lunch time. The credit card machine was not working. The "ropa Vieja" was not ready to be served to guest so I got the lechon which was raw and had no flavor and to top it off my soda was flat!!! Most likely the last time I come here. Very disappointed.

seriously AMAZED by this place! the food is basically street cart food but its such a beautiful little hidden gem of a place with thee BEST view! would definitely recommend for lunch with friends , or for a very laid back afternoon spot. food was also tasty too but DEF CANNOT BEAT THAT VIEW!!! .. oh yeah and theres beer :D

We had an 8pm reservation.  We were seated around 8:15. After ordering,  we waited quite some time; our salads were served at 9:30. Two of us ordered a salad that was supposed to have goat cheese;  however there was no cheese and the waitress disappeared so we couldn't ask about it.  When she finally showed she she apologized and said she could add it to our entrees - really? We weren't offered bread until we asked for it and by this time we were starved. The dinners were good  but not worth the wait. We try to support local businesses but they really need to work on their customer service.

Being from Southern California I was told to come here because they were one of the best cheesesteak joints in Philly. Great recommendation!! There was a long line extending out the door so I knew it had to be a good place!! Steak was thinly sliced and with Whiz  that was so nice!! Definitely will be a regular customer!!
Best sliced cheese pizza in the area! The pros are that it has a great sauce and is open late. The con is that its cash only.
Shrimp & Grits better than New Orleans. Good food. Caring service. Reasonable prices. Across from Harlem Stage a hidden performing arts treasure

We have been here twice and tried most of the items on the menu. The culinary adventure began with the friendly and cozy ambiance. Our dishes came out at the same time so we could share our plates. Beef Rendang was cooked to the perfect velvety texture, meat was coated with perfect amount of sauce, subtle yet complex flavors continued to develop with each bite. Definitely recommend this dish. Our other favorites were the fish curry, egg plant (from the small plates), chicken wings, papaya salad (has a hint of coconut flavor to it), chicken wings (not what you would expect so make sure you try these). The nasi goreng (fried rice) was very tasty and came with satifying portion. Each bite consisted intense but not overpowering shrimp flavor. This dish came with crunchy shrimp crackers and fresh cucumber to balance all the flavors. We wish we had room for dessert, next time. We liked the food here a lot. Perfect little place to catch up in the middle of the week with friends (what we did), or just sit at the bar area with the book you always wanted to read but never got to (what I will do next time). p.s. Great coffee!
world famous crabby fries!!! terrible. frozen fries sprinkled with old bay. no crab meat!!! please dont advertise crabby fries and not have crab meat on the fries. terrible.

Went there because it was the only diner like food near our hotel and the food was great along with the service.  Ordered the thanksgiving dinner and loved it. I rarely eat turkey since I don't like it as much as chicken but the turkey there was amazing. Service was courteous and didn't take forever to serve us. Would definitely come. Back here again if I am in Philadelphia

The young who makes my burrito is very sweet (Everytime I go!) He's wonderful. The manager is pretty intimidating and doesn't come off very friendly. As for the food, it's a solid choice (cheap and tasty). It's way better than moes (on route 33). Plus you get free chips if you check in! Can't beat that

This place is pretty disgusting. It sucks when you go out to eat absolutely famished and it really clouds your judgement. The service was so ridiculously slow, if I hadn't been in drinking mode on a Friday night with my best friends I MIGHT have been annoyed. I digress...I ordered my burger medium well and I received it an hour later so raw it looked like it had just been butchered out in the parking lot by some kid named Rico. And what on earth is a lettuce wrap? Unfortunately, I ended up eating most of it, because like I said, the hunger. The waitress was surly and weird and I was taken aback by the fact that they pretty much bring an iPad to your table and ask you to sign off on your bill and tip right there!? What if I wanted to discuss how shitty the service was with my girlfriends first and ask what they were leaving? Awkward! Oh and I forgot how the hostess insisted on calling my friend "Alison" Steve, and pretty much yelled STEEVE in her face when we didn't get up and go to our table. I mean, Steve was before us on the list so I'd have no problem pretending to be him but that's not the point. I give this place 2 stars because it looked cool inside and they had Harpoon double IPA on tap in 16oz glasses. Other than that, save your money and TIME and skip dinner and go to Christmas Tree Shops. (They close at 9pm bt dubs)

Montclair is New Jersey's "restaurant scene" but Raymond's is Montclair's signature restaurant due to longevity and consistent quality and service, unlike so many restaurants that come and go in this town. Great for breakfast, lunch and dinner. BYOB like most Montclair restaurants, with a great wine store next door. Convenient! Saturday and Sunday brunch is always very busy and although no reservations, they do a great job accommodating the crowds. Relaxed and stylish NYC vibe. Great place to come with friends, not for a romantic dinner. I have many fav dishes here but the red beet based veggie burger is about the best VB I've tasted anywhere, very "meaty" texture and moist. Great place for 8 am business breakfasts when it is quiet and you can actually get street parking on Church Street!
Food is great everbody if your in the area or not to far to order you should try it out it's really some great food

I am sorry, but I don't get all the hype.     We ordered their #3 (sausage, broccoli rabe, ...).   It was fine, but it wasn't anything great.    We also had a spinach salad, which was also just fine fine; nothing special.  I liked the IPA they had on tap, but the pizza was just A-OK and the salad was a meh. Also, of disappointment was that we said we wanted to add mushrooms to the #3.   They said NO --- you can't add any toppings to our specialty pizzas.   This is ridiculous especially when they offer it as a topping on build your own pizzas..     Even more ridiculous is the following:  the table next to us was custom building a pizza (choosing all their own toppings), and she said they wanted spinach as a topping; the customers were told that they don't have a spinach topping, at which point the customer pointed to our table and said "they have a huge spinach salad in front of them; was that the last of the spinach?"  To which the waiter responded:  "All of the spinach we have is for salads only." These people are ridiculous.  They have mushrooms, but you can only put it on a pizza built from scratch; you can't add it to one of their specialty pizzas even if you are willing to pay for it.   They have spinach, but you can't get that on any pizza even if you are willing to pay for it.      After a 20-25 minute wait for us to be seated, and just A-OK pizza, this is dropping them from what would have been 3 stars to 2 stars due to the lack of flexibility by the restaurant with respect to toppings.

A wide variety of beers but the food prices are outrageous, examples: 1) District Wings - $10 Only consist of 4 small wings and a tiny portion of salad 2) Salmon Tartare - $11 4 tiny pieces of toasted bread with little bit of salmon and two salmon roes Never coming back

Incredibly authentic and incredible atmosphere. My group each got a different pizza and they were all delicious. They cook the pizza in a brick oven, so it was ready in no time. They recommended putting their spicy olive oil on the pizza, which was also good; not too spicy, with good flavor.

I am prompted to write this review. I have just waited 2 hrs for my takeaway. 2 hrs! That has to be takeaway first! These guys are ALWAYS late, and always have the same excuse. I am yet to speak to the manager, who my husband and I have left messages for. The food is good enough (not necessarily the best Turkish I have had), but it is definitely not worth a 2 hr wait. Even a 1hr wait is too much. Save yourself the headache and aggravation, and go somewhere else. Needless to say I won't be ordering from here ever again.

Delicious experience and I don't really like mexican food. IT was great for a tasty snack and the carne asada was beautiful. I really like this place and will go here again. Muy deliciouso!! Hah, I don't know spanish. But good place.

Very good Indian food.  Went on a week night and had a couple of the Kerala dishes.   Good spice and flavor.   Ambiance was nice.   We've been to numerous Indian restaurants and this place is good even out.   Food is not the best we've ever had, but we left full and satisfied.
Delicious I had the meatball slice. Slices r huge nice and crunchy loved it!!! My bf got the Margarita slice he loved it. Great spot for late night hunger lol.

I've been going to CK in wayne since as long as I can remember.. Great takeout however, a year or two ago it changed hands and although I continued to go it was ok not great.. Last week I decided to give this new place KOI a try... Walked in and recognized one of the previous CK owners.. Ordered a bunch of takeout and I was elated... It was that "great" takeout I've been missing... So happy... Definitely will give the sushi a try on the next visit
just love it.....always good....hope they have more variety of appetizers than just the 65 series

Classy, flat-out good place, great drinks, atmosphere!  1 star shy of 5 because the bathroom was a tad dirty but as a dude I don't really care about this sorta stuff (perhaps girls would feel differently!).
The food is fabulous and the place has a great ambiance.

I really hope this place succeeds, I stopped there tonight and got the Korean beef short rib tacos and the parmesan truffle fries.  Food is amazing!  Only concern is that there's no sign so i'm sure they are missing out on business.  They just opened so hoping they become more visible.

What can I say I think the place is gone downhill just a bit the meals are still overall very good and very good prices and the beer specially their house ale is a good deal but I remember the last time I was there for Tuesday night wings I got very sick with diarrhea afterwards hopefully it was just a one time thing good luck.
Great food, not the best service
Great spot! Love the brunch on Sundays! Excellent food, great atmosphere day and night! Great spot for dinner with friends or just drinks. Great addition to the neighborhood!

Going in I thought hey! They fixed up this place let's give it a try. It was seriously the worst money I ever spend. Firstly, everything was over priced. I was like ok at first maybe it's like a little more money for better food. When I get my food the portions were so tiny. I mean everything I ordered was miniature. I was still like ok that's fine. Maybe it's a little taste of heaven. Nope onez bit in I almost spit it out. Disgusting! Horrible. The chicken was very rubbery. The soups were just unexplainably uneattable. And everything else we order was just gross. I literally did not touch anything. I wouldn't even serve food like this to my enemies. I walked out very unsatisfied and hungry because I couldn't eat this trash. Avoid like the plague. This is not a good addition to the neighborhood. I'm disappointed.
It was my girlfriends Bday and our waitress, Alexis, was great!!! We had an awesome time here no complaints. This place is really good for groups.
Amazing...Been here a few times.This place is great，There food is Soooo good.I ordered some sashimi.It's fresh.Special rolls also good.sushi cake .pink lady.spider are my favourites.

Rude waitress. Our table was sticky (like glue was on it) she said "i already wiped it once!" ... We sat there with napkins underneath where our arms sat. Food - terrible - salad was just lettuce with so much lemon i could not eat it. Two pieces of cheese on top not even shredded. Extremely overpriced. Dont waste your time. We will not be back!
One of the best falafel sandwich I ever had! Great lemonade too. I can only recommend this place.

Ok so it looks good and roti was nice and soft and moist.. I selected the boneless chicken seasoning was ok a bit salty thou. But I don't cook with salt so I maybe a bit sensitive to salt. There was a good amount of chicken potato curry balance. Cost was about right for the size $8.49 you could split one and not feel bad about it. Over all I would give it a three out of five stars. I'm not shouting from the roof tops but it was good enough to go back and try something else.
Just landed in NYC first stop- Table 57! Quaint restaurant that embodies what we love about NYC- great pasta - atmosphere just what we love as well. Highly recommend!
The struggle is real trying to find good pho in NY. Still trying to find my go to place. Take me back to California.
The best falafel around. I love the pickles.

My husband and I were at a law school reunion weekend.  I'm a pizza lover and had a list with me from The Daily Meal of the "101 Best Pizzas in America."  We had three uncommitted meals and my plan was to go to the top three rated pizzerias in New Haven, as per this list.  Thursday night was Frank Pepe's for its white clam pizza, rated the best pizza in America.  Lunch on Friday was supposed to be Sally's tomato pie because it was rated # 5 on the list, but it was not open for lunch so we went to the third most highly rated pizzeria in New Haven (according to this list) - Modern Apizza.  The pizza that was supposed to be #12 on the list was the Italian Bomb so we ordered that and a salad.  The waiter recommended the Caesar salad.  The Caesar Salad was not a Caesar.  The dressing wasn't right and it had lots of extraneous flavors, including some black, supermarket-quality canned olives.  Croutons were good, but the mélange of rye, wheat and white croutons confused the palate, and the cucumbers and tomatoes that were included in the overly chilled concoction detracted, rather than enhanced, the improperly chopped up romaine..    Now for the pizza - an abomination.  There was so much undercooked bacon on the pizza that I could not taste the really delicious Italian sausage.  It was a total bacon grease bomb with a pasty, undercooked crust that really tasted raw.  Now, I realize that perhaps we got an undercooked one and I started to take the toppings off and pile them up on the edges of the pizza that were properly cooked to the right degree since they had no toppings on them. Pretty soon, I had a plate of dough left.  My husband didn't want me to say anything (he's so polite!) but I did tell the waiter that the crust was undercooked.  He said I should have told him earlier, and he was right.  To his credit, he offered to cook us a new one, but we are staying in a hotel so it wasn't any use to us and I declined.  Also, I wasn't quite  convinced they could really make a good pizza since they used canned mushrooms -- Can you imagine - canned mushrooms in this day and age???!!! I will say, though, the tomato sauce and the fennel sausage that they used were good.  After this, I'm sorry to say that we didn't have the desire to sample Sally's tomato pie Friday night.  It wasn't within walking distance of our hotel and we didn't want to drive to it, wait in line and then perhaps be disappointed.  I have a nagging feeling that I'll regret it, however!
They are really good the crepes are awesome just got banana nuttela and one of the best, thanks

Man I used to come here every week until I moved out of state! Love all their salads! The one with chicken pecans and goat cheese always hit the spot for me. Their focaccia was always just baked and delicious. Can't complain about the food here I absolutely love it!

=== Your wait time is: 30 minutes. === This is something I wish we had been told, prior to nonchalantly placing our order for a basic pork torta. Half an hour's time is something you'd expect from customer service, when you're calling in to cancel your cable subscription, but not a food truck, am I correct? I don't know about you, but I've always thought that a food truck equates to lightning-fast grub on wheels. With that said, you'd require more than the mere patience of the Dalai Lama, if deciding to give Taquería Auténtica Food Truck a whirl. To worsen matters further for us two customers growing increasingly impatient as each were hungry, they exchanged worrisome looks when having spotted the cook on board, failing to remove his gloves while handling the money, along with all else. Just imagine what has touched your taco shells in the process. (Sir, if you would kindly check the paper slip on which you had so hastily scribbled upon, I did not order a side of food poisoning.) What baffled us, was that the tortas were simply sitting there after they were done cooking on the grill. It was only when the cook caught us eyeing him like a hawk, that he finally decided to wrap it up. Cut to five minutes later, we were handed our food, the aluminum foil covered with smudges of guacamole, as though a child had decided to do some last minute finger-painting on it. Thank you, and have a messy day. The other Yelpers here are precisely correct, when they say that the operator is disorganized and unable to find anything within his grasp. Perhaps he could pay a much needed visit to IKEA to attain nifty ideas for tidying up? Not only is their service in need of desperate improvement, but the system by which orders are handled, needs a complete restructuring. If they wish to build a loyal base of customers, they need to forget everything they've ever learned and start again from scratch. As for the pork torta itself, the sandwich was nothing so remotely divine that I'd risk acquiring sunburn on a hot summer day. ¡Sí Señor! Taquería, as it turns out, was not "Auténtica" enough for this chica.

I've been a fan of Lincoln Station for a long time.  Excellent rotisserie chicken, meatball sandwich, and lamb chili.  The service, however, lately has tended to be a little inconsistent.  There should really be more than one person on the waitstaff, especially in the morning.  I've seen really slow lines there of 6 or 7 people and that can be difficult for one cashier to handle.  It makes me feel like my time isn't being respected.  These are the kinds of things customers notice and remember.

Great Banh mi fix.. Love the beef bulgogi and don't forget the Joju Banh mi fries and remember to load it up... it's a clash of the american fries with a vietnamese twist... so must better then the old ketchup and pepper topping... Also for a wake up call the Vietnamese Coffee is a great kick to jump start the day no matter what time of day or night it is!!

I've eaten here many, many times since they opened. They food is awesome and the service is good. I don't think there is a bad choice on the menu. Good pizza, salads, pasta and entrees. They even have healthier options like grilled chicken parm which is not breaded or fried.  The only drawback is that the tables are close together and it can get crowded and loud. I guess a crowded restaurant is a good sign. Since this is one of my sisters favorite places I eat here whenever I visit and I'm never disappointed.

If you want Soul Food but don't want the "Itis" right after then Jacobs Pickles is the spot. Great Service and Great Food. Mushroom gravy smothered chicken, buttermilk fried of course w/cheese grits was SLAMMIN!
Great food and drinks. Very friendly staff and owner. I had the sole florentine and the best risotto ever. Very busy on Friday. Great food

Was so excited for this from reading some reviews. Got food delivered, took a while but wasn't worried as I thought they're a popular place so wud be busy. Ordered chips n guacamole, pollo burrito, mexi sausage tacos, steak tacos and pollo tacos. Some of the blandest food I've ever had, dry and no spice or flavour. The only saving grace was the mexi sausage taco, which was good I must say. The guacamole was overly bulked out with onion and tomato. The burrito was just plain bad. Good chips though.
Excellent staff and excellent pizza! They will even customize it for you! Love this place and so does our office!

The best Thai food I've had since moving down to NYC about 6 months ago. There curries are rich and perfectly spiced, the atmosphere is fantastic with an option for outdoor seating, and the prices are very affordable, I'd take this place of any Thai spot in manhattan.

I had the sea bass.  I don't think that I have ever eaten sea bass before. But, I was in NY and wanted to eat things that I normally don't eat.  I was glad I did because the sea bass was good.  It was like eating a juicy steak but better better.  We had a nice table outside but all the tables were too close together and it would have helped if our waiter spoke better English or at least smiled once in awhile.

I had the pleasure of photographing a wedding here.  The venue is really beautiful with a spacious outdoor space as well as a grand ballroom.  The weather called for possible rain, and the staff were very prepared to move the ceremony indoors if there was a last minute rain shower.  Fortunately, there were just some minor drizzle, and the couple was able to have the ceremony in the gorgeous outdoor garden area.  There were around 300 guests, but it didn't feel cramped at all during reception.  During the bride and groom's first dance, they programmed the chandeliers to have different colors which added a nice touch to the photos =].
Awesome food, best pizza I've found in the area, aside from mr. Dino's which has super expensive food.

Mmm hmm! This is one of my go-to places for sushi! It's not Manhattan-expensive and also not cheap, but overall I feel it is worth it if you want to treat yourself a little. Besides, you never really want to eat mediocre or even bad sushi. Go somewhere that has a high turnover rate and those raw food materials are in and out fresh all the time. I don't even know where to begin with their rolls since there are so many great choices. One of my favorites is the Salmon Tempura Roll. Another one I would have to recommend is the Snow Mountain Roll. The house salad with their ginger dressing also rocks. I always come back here and it's the first place I think of when I get a crave for sushi.

Beautiful and cozy place. This small restaurant is not comoletely packed, unlike other NY places. The staff is very friendly; the manager/owner (I think he was) greeted us and gave us special treatment... The food is GREAT! You should definetly try the octopus and their feta cheesecake!

I have been a WH local for a long time and this place is one of my go-to's. Happy Hour is great, and the newer hh menus are delicous. Some of the items need to be added to the regular menu. Love the variety of cocktails and craft beers here, always something to choose from. Bar staff is excellent, always willing to suggest a new concoction they have going. I'm a pretty picky person when it comes to drinks, and this place really has it down. Service is great and bar manager Jen is always at the top of her game. Many happy hours under my belt around West Hartford, but the bar staff and selections make this place my go-to. If you haven't tried this place out yet, you are missing out. Have recommended it many times to personal friends, but felt that this would be a great way to recommend this place to those I don't know.

I am not please with this place. Came there to eat for the first time and they do not have brown rice, the special come w/ choice of wonton or egg drop soup. i wasn't prep. There yellow rice is not yellow. Service suck. They look like they were lazy to cook. I told them i will never return.

We ordered chicken tenders and spinach artichoke dip but they gave us only a few chips for our dip and no dipping sauce for the tenders. The bar tender must have been new because he was having a very hard time keeping up with the not too large crowd. Yummy food and cool vibe otherwise.

I rather leave no stars. NEVER BEEN TREATED WORSE IN OUR LIVES. I myself am a server here in Philadelphia and hardly ever leave reviews, but I am truly speechless over today. My husband works for a moving company and I usually pack him lunch, today he forgot his and went to this restaurant with his co-workers. When he asked about vegetarian options (which they do have and I have had them before) HE WAS MOCKED AND MADE FUN OF AND THEY REFUSED TO SERVE HIM.  We are not pretentious vegans here, we are not rude or demanding, and the way they treated my husband today...I have never seen or heard before..terrible customer service and terrible business motto. What if we were vegetarian due to religious reasons or a food allergy? (and maybe we are!)  HOW DARE YOU. SHAME ON YOU. You picked the wrongs vegans to mess with. I will tell everyone I know to not go to your establishment ever again.
All I have to say is this place is awesome. Everything from the decor to the food was great. Service was excellent and the staff was friendly. Great addition to the neighborhood

Just had Sinatra Special Steak pizzaiola, fresh mozzarella oh my god it was the best i ever had. Also got to taste everyone in family that order a sandwich and oh my it was good. Valentino Special Fried eggplant, provolone cheese, roasted peppers, Hot Roast Beef Roast beef, fresh mozzarella, fried eggplant, natural jus and Nicky Special Ham, capocollo, salami, fried eggplant, provolone, hot salad, marinated mushrooms, lettuce, tomato, oil and vinegar I can't wait to go back!!!

I got sick after eating their prepackaged food. Its really cheap and great for quick meal, and I also know that their selection is various but I really think that they should care more about the food.
Love this deli...great owners, great food.. it is true you pay for good things in life..great quality food.. even better owners

I first stumbled across this restaurant from show that was on the travel Chanel about the absolute best places to get anything bacon across the United States . From the moment I walked in we were seated right away we started off with the bacon and beer sampler it was absolutely amazing apple wood smoked bacon.pepper  bacon,lamb bacon , jalapeño bacon each one tasted amazing and were also paired up with beers that went perfectly with each piece of bacon, for my main meal I got the hot sausage on garlic bread sandwich which was great but the sausage was indeed very spicy. Last but not least we had to try the chocolate covered bacon with strawberries it just looked too good to say no it ended up being absolutely amazing this place was well worth the trip from New Jersey and I would recommend it to any of my friends to try for them selves .

going to beccos tonight with my husband and have been there before. i love this place so much and love the authentic italian food ! recommended to anyone who is an italian food lover and looking to get stuffed!!

Horrible experience. Went there for lunch (take out) I ordered their calamari app and the person who took my order over the phone put in for the calamari dinner. Well when I arrived to pick up my food - I noticed that they were charging me $5 more than what I asked for on the menu. So of course I informed this that my order was incorrect and instead of trying to remedy their error, they went to the back and began taking my food out; which I actually didn't mind much being that they just opened recently and probably needed to save themselves money. Well when I finally returned to work to enjoy my food. I was highly disappointed, I don't know if they were upset with me for having them correct my order but the calamari was just awful - rubbery and plain...the sauce they provided had absolutely no taste and it came with a salad that included one piece of lettuce and a whole onion sliced and placed on top of the lettuce. The dressing that they provided was plain as well. I've had MUCH better Peruvian food before - save yourself a wasted trip, trust me! The place looks nice but unfortunately we can't eat the decor!
Charge for deliveries  chicken look fishee no good food charge to much for what is this place. To much bread in General Tsos chicken no good at all
Terrific spot for fresh Mediterranean/Israeli cuisine.

My family and I went to Fasil on 10/23/14, their opening night, and we were not disappointed! The food was the best that we've had in a long time, and my wife would know: she was raised in Turkey! The decor is beautiful, very Mediterranean in theme but not trying too hard. The staff is wonderful, very friendly and professional. The owner and his wife are great people too: they came to our table to see how everything was and even sent us some dessert! It's byob which is great, and the dinner prices are so reasonable you can't go wrong! I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves Turkish food or wants to try something new!
Love this place, the cavatelli is awesome. The service is just as good as the food.....i keep coming back and it keeps getting better.
Best grilled cheese ever! Ordered a few times on seamless and was never disappointed. You guys are my new favorite! Keep up the good work:)
extremely poor service. rude cashiers and waitresses. will definitely never return to this specific location.

The food is always great and never deviates in quality, speed, or presentation. Try - Tacos (any) - Chronic Burger - Ribs It will get crowded on the weekends, so plan ahead if you'd like to avoid a wait.  However I've never had to wait longer than 20 minutes.

Close to Time Square, next to the Charles Schwab building. There are a few imitation trucks nearby with the same concept, using the same colors and menus so don't get fooled.  The real Hamal trucks have signs and there's always, always a long line.  But don't let the lines scare you because it goes by super fast. There's about 4 items or so to choose from with chicken, lamb or mix that ranges from $4 to $6. Cash only. Definite must try.

Food is very good. Service sucks big time. We visit NYC twice a year and look forward to the meatballs and cucumber martinis. Fortunately those outweigh the poor service, barely. This time we sat at the bar and the service was the worst yet! It was the first place we stopped off the plane. We visited this time to celebrate our first anniversary. Very disappointing! Perhaps time to find a new favorite place.

My friend and I went here for an early dinner and decided to start with a pitcher of sangria. Sangria was in a massive pitcher and definitely a good deal. The flavor was a bit more "berry" focused than I expected from a red sangria but I loved it. The fish and chips appetizer was a perfect portion size for an appetizer. The fish was freshly prepared and not just random fish parts mashed together in a frozen fish stick as fried. Definitely appreciated the freshness. I had the sliders which were on a potato roll. Another good portion size of 2 sliders and some fries. My friend had the grilled cheese which was nothing to write home about. Only downside was the food took a long time to come out. I'm sure because it was freshly prepped but would be tough if it was busier.
Simply the best.

This is the last time at tigers tale for me! Service was slow and inadequate. Food was not what I ordered Burger medium came out rare, mushroom and onions I ordered had to be asked for never came with my burger. Menu says chips never got them, it took me 10 minutes to get the attention of another bartender to return my burger, because our original server never came back to check on us,  yet took care of clients on either side of us at the bar when the burger was returned they forgot to put  the cole slaw on the plate...... my burger which I ordered  very rare  and was cooked more  than the one we ordered  medium ...could not get anyone but the busser to answer our requests... to see if we wanted another drink I had to flag down another bartender to get another beer which I commented about the service.... no improvement!!!!,our bartender "Debbie K" just blew us off. Horrible experience  "in fact we had to get two different bartenders to help us because ours was too busy to check on us" ......... I have been coming to The Tigers Tale  for many years past (foolish fox) A waist of money and time.....and a Friday Nite to drive from Bucks county PA     Rec # 138/0233

The best creative drinks anyone can find in NYC. The food is delicious and fun,  keeping the interest of how possible did the chef create such a dish.  I love the food,  drinks and for the price, it is a must go.

Now here is a place That I have to vote on as the best in Philly for sure. If you have been here you know they are they bomb don't hate and you cant say there competition is better no sir. I go here all the time and will continue to do so. go genos!

This is one of the best slice spots in the city.  The fresh mozzarella and the prince street square are both addictive.  Also one of the best spots to grab a bite late night after leaving one of the many bars in the area.
Go for Meatball Monday: you get an appetizer, entree & dessert all in meatball style, with a glass of wine for $31.   Absolutely incredible.

I have been a loyal patron for over 10 years. The food is delicious and the server assistants are attentive and kind. However, the last few years have been awful.  The hostesses are disrespectful, inconsiderate, and clueless.  It's as if neither of them were trained properly (there are typically two girls nestled behind the booth).  The manager, who I assume is the man with peppery hair and mustache is the demise of Cuban Pete's.  He stands there barking orders at the server assistants and when he's done barking at them, he proceeds to explain why an hour wait had turned into two hours by saying, "Well, I changed my mind! Okay?"  Who says that? I'm sorry. Is this your home? If things do not go as expected, you kindly explain the situation. That's your job. I felt horrible for the waitstaff because they received the brunt of criticism and did not think it was fair they had to work under such conditions.  I will not be returning to Cuban Pete's. Worst service ever. Shout-out to their employee Risa (sp?). The only employee that seems to take her role seriously and PROFESSIONALLY.

At first glance this place looked great. We walked in and were greeted by a blonde young man who was very friendly and seated us in a booth. We ordered two leffe beers and the potato pancakes, mussels and the knackworst sandwich. The food came in less than 20 minutes. We opened our silverware napkins and quickly realized the napkins were greasy and filthy( I guess they don't wash them between reusing them). My first bite of the potato pancake was unremarkable but on the second I realized they were still frozen. This is an item that should made fresh each time not frozen and fried.Our server apologized and took them back. We moved onto the beer mussels. About a third of them were not open and after trying one and almost breaking my tooth on the sand and gravel we decided to cut our losses and move onto the knackworst sandwich. This was served on a pretzel bun with kraut and was thoroughly delicious. Unfortunately that was the only delicious thing about this place. Our server brought out the refried potato pancakes after we were finished our beers and ready to go. We asked for the check and he hadn't bothered to comp anything. Biggest waste of money we've spent in a while.
Always happy here. What can I say further. I will always bring friends and family here. Everything is fresh and the service is fantastic.

I was excited to try this place but left a little underwhelmed. Perhaps expectations were too high. We ordered two appetizers and one main course to share for two, which was actually quite filling. The best dish was the crab over spaghetti, which was pleasantly unusual. The other appetizer was the octopus salad, which was nothing special. Our main course was the tom yum monkfish - the broth was spicy and good, but the fish didn't taste as fresh as it could have been (the place is called Little Fish, after all!). The restaurant itself is a little room. Some reviews here have called it nice and quaint, but to me it really just felt like an incomplete room. I wouldn't base any decision to come here on this, in either direction. Service was great though, and the waitresses were very knowledgeable and friendly.

We dined at Cafe Matisse tonight and the entire experience was wonderful. We were greeted warmly at the door by Larry, who acknowledged my note in the reservation that it was our fifth anniversary by seating us at a cozy corner table with a view of the dining room. All of the servers were friendly, informative, and attentive throughout the meal. We each did a 4-course meal that was very well-timed. We began with the beet salad tart, which was a festival of flavors that you might not normally expect from a seemingly straightforward dish. This tart was exceptional and the perfect way to begin our meal. We moved on to the lamb "carpaccio" and the sliced Muscovy duck, both of which were also excellent with layered flavors that made each bite more interesting and delicious than the previous.  We finished with the Matisse burger, which was perfect and luxe, and frankly, better than any "gourmet" burger I've eaten in NYC.  Dessert did not disappoint either--the banana cream pie was heavenly--even though we were full we couldn't stop eating it. The one note that was slightly out of tune was the flourless chocolate cake, which itself was wonderful and would have been preferable with a simple complementary ice cream rather than the peanut butter mascarpone, banana, and melted whipped cream combination, which just missed the mark. All in all, the meal was a real treat for us and a wonderful way to spend our celebratory evening. We will definitely be returning!

love these guys too. back on my cheese steak kick. well if you did not know.. I am a cheese steak kinda guy. my mother used to grind steaks into my baby bottles when I was 2 months old. Thats how long I have been eating steaks. so when I tell you these guys are good, It comes from birth! 4 stars.
The locals told me this place has the best cheesesteaks in Philly and they are right!  Some folks told me Tony Luke's is the best but  Dalessanddo's is a tad better.
Bar service was 5 star - attentive and friendly bartenders - food was good too - good date night stop in the center !

Yummmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm The rosemary chicken wings could cure polio The pizza is definitely worth the trip and the tomato sauce had the perfect amount of sweetness For stamford folks, this is an absolute gem and I highly highly highly recommend

Drove up with my work colleagues from Stamford and it was worth it. Fresh mozzarella and great tomatoes make this pizza different from traditional New Haven spots. Bar area is cool to have a beer, pizza and wings.

I went for the first time on Friday after work to get some takeout.  I called in my order and went to pick it up about 20 minutes later.  The young man behind the counter was so welcoming and helpful and like many others I got to meet Sandra too who was just as friendly as other reviews have described!  They're moving to a cash only because of the high fees associated with cards but they still let me use my card yesterday because I didn't know.   Onto the food...I had the church plate with the BBQ pulled pork.  It was delicious!  It wasn't covered in BBQ sauce like I had expected, but it had great flavor with a little spice to it (maybe a dry rub?) and it was very moist and tasty!  My sides were all fantastic: fried okra, mac and cheese, collard greens, and yams.  So so good!  There was a square of cornbread included too.  The best part was the care they took in packaging the food so that everything stayed fresh and delicious, not soggy or on top of anything else!   This place is as good as everyone says and I can't wait to go back again!  You should definitely try it out for yourself!  Super friendly, great food!

Let me just start with saying this place is Amazing, wish it was a bit bigger and had more space in between seating but other than that the food!!! Oh my oh my I wish I could eat everything in the menu at once .. My favorite part is that you can bring your own wine for dinner!! How awesome is that!! this place is a must.. Their over the top Crepes stole my heart..  The vibe is very intimate, the staff is very friendly
Awesome place to eat. Love there pizza and dinners and salads. Love there stuffed breads. I always get my catering for work from them.
Friendly and informative staff. Good portions are large and chicken parm was excellent!
Delicious curry food. Staff was friendly and super nice. Service was quick. It wasn't too expensive either. I really enjoyed it and thought the food was great. I'll be back soon.
Felt better going out than it did going in. The beer was decently cold, as was the rest of my food though. Gotta bring your own rolaids or microwave

My wife ordered poached eggs and when the plate came it had 1 hard boiled egg. The waitress said the menu had a typo and it's only 1 poached egg. We asked for them to make it softer and more runny - they obliged. When the 2nd attempt arrived it was exactly the same and the meal was swimming in dressing. The couple next to us was complaining that they had been there for an hour and only one of them had their food. More flys than a poop factory too. Overall not a very good experience.

I recently had a 20 person birthday party at Lea and it was wonderful! Dana helped me put together a very reasonably priced menu and was so helpful in both the planning and at the actual event. The food was amazing, as always! I highly recommend Lea as a place to host your event. My boyfriend and I eat there about twice a month and we love the service, aesthetic experience and the food. I highly recommend the eggplant pizza, cannoli, and house red. YUM.

Just got back from dinner here, had the lamb chops and they were perfect.  The combination of crusty sear and pistachio sauce was amazing.  The mezze platter was a tasty combination of all the favorites and each was delicious.  Great service staff, decent prices, and delightful ambiance.  If this is not a destination place now, it is going to be!

The food was ok. My vegetables were nice and fresh! The staff was friendly and the food was seasoned very well. Very nice sized portions of food. The people were very hospitable. Comfortable setting & atmosphere!

Tried to order by phone to pick it up...Two things I tried to order they didn't have because apparently their online menu was NOT updated. How come a restaurant like that doesn't update their online menu?? Terrible experience trying to "guess" what they really have in the restaurant.
yum!

This restaurant is immaculate, I think it served the best food in the city. It is absolutely amazing. The service was on point. The server can explain what you ordered to make it sound so delicious. They even recommend courses that we may not have known. I love the atmosphere in there, such a cozy, and comfortable place. ABC Kitchen is a must visit for tourists, so they can talk about it all the way back to their native. The price is high since it is a specialty restaurant. But it is still worth it. The food, the service, and the atmosphere confirmed my admiration for this restaurant.

I am typically a huge supporter of Osteria Giotto, however when I called this evening for todays specials I got hung up on. When i called back the woman who answered the phone was rude and unapologetic. Later on in the evening i called to place a take out order. The same woman answered the phone and then told me that THEY ARE NOT ACCEPTING ORDERS, THE KITCHEN IS TOO BUSY!! They turned down business and made us very unhappy customers. I hate to leave a bad review because the food is exceptional, but  I just felt that it needed to be said.  It truly is unfortunate that this has happened, we are loyal customers who have eaten in and ordered out many many times. We live a minimum of 30 minutes away and make it a priority to eat here. We are very disappointed.
Great place the atmosphere is great the food amazing the service was a bit to slow for me.. Was hard finding parking.

Probably the best pizza in the neighborhood and delivery rocks. We like them better than Speedy Romeos, which gets all the press. I love the salad with chicken. I eat the salad and then don't feel bad about eating the delicious pizza.

I've been here twice in the past year and enjoyed the food and service both times. They have a turkey burger which says for limited time only (but it's been on the menu for awhile) that is delicious. It comes with mayo and sliced onions. I tell them to hold the mayo and grill the onions and the end result is close to perfection. Whatever you order, please at least try the sweet potato fries. I dip them in ketchup (because they're fries, right) and magic happens. I don't believe I'm exaggerating at all. Also, servers are attentive and friendly. Stop in the next time you happen to be in the area.

Horrible service we waited an 1 hr and 30 Mins noone ask if we would like a drink of water. The service is the worst I'm actually standing in the small waiting area and the waiter does not know what is going on. Horrible horrible horrible service!!!!!!!!!!

I honestly can't believe how people can eat from this place and not be flat out disgusted. Their food tastes like absolute crap. Their rice is undercooked, to the point that it is almost crunchy, and their "sesame seed chicken" is just a pile of goo slop. Their chicken is the lowest quality garbage a restaurant can serve, it is like 95% breading and rubbery chicken chunks in the center. They also served me some brown chicken wings from being cooked in oil that was almost black when I walked in. Totally disgusting and you can tell they never eat the food they cook. Go to imperial wok in New Haven. They have been there for 30 years and cook excellent Chinese food. Stay away from dirty China chef!

I am new to NJ and have visited this restaurant twice. It is one of the most decent Indian restaurants with good ambience and great food. Yes it is a little pricey BUT it is one of the upscale restaurants. I loved their food and service. I will definitely go back with friends.

Lovely staff. Delicious food. Amazing atmosphere. The best dish there is Jambalaya and Eggs. I am not sure why people are saying that it was not seasoned enough. I found it to be perfect. Also their coffee is good, which is important for a brunch place. Highly recommend!
I will pass.
Love this place! Even though they have VERY bad communication on taking order. I ordered the pollo frito and it's awesome.

Eventually... My burger was very good, as were the truffle fries.  The staff, not so much... Hostess was on the phone, and we had to wait to be seated.  Table next to us was seated a few minuets later, was served drinks, and bread, before we were even greeted.  Our waiter forgot one of the drinks, and my order came out wrong.

My family and I visited Talk of the Town recently and we were very pleased! The owner was very helpful and courteous. Restaurant was clean and had many small tables. By the time we left it was packed! It, of course, featured a Bollywood movie playing on a TV for everyone's entertainment. We ordered 2 samosa, aloo tikki chaat and gobi paratha. My daughter (4) had some basmati rice and dahi, with a few tastes of our spicier selections. The chaat was seriously delicious and I think next time we will order more of that. Paratha was also very good. It wasn't dry and it had a nice spice level (even being mild, lol!) and the raita and pickle were super tasty.  I would say the samosa was just alright, perhaps it's more of a south Indian type style that I am not used to. Sauces on the side were spiced nicely. We wanted to order dessert but we were very full; next time. Thank you!
Excellent food! It's been a long time I had such flavorful food. We had 6 different dishes and all of them were very delicious. A must go place for Foodies who love Indian food.

Too bad...was a great place once, but since this Summer food has gone way down...ie. pizza delivered half-cooked and cheese topping comes watery. Phone order takers incompetent and rude. Moving on and searching for new place....I hear Ruthie's in Montclair makes a yumo coal-oven pizza ..,Yum!!

Came for Thursday dinner with my female friend. They gave us the separate table in the worst imaginable place in spite of the fact there were other empty tables, around 5-6 . When we asked for a different place, we were told everything else was reserved (???). We decided to leave... Sorry but restaurant experience is not about food quality but service as well..

I love Thai food, and Brookside is very authentic. Meals are cooked to order, so it takes a while to get your meal. I appreciate that. Went there on a rainy Monday night and took advantage of the 2/$20 special. One appetizer to share (crispy noodles with shrimp), 1 chicken pad thai, 1 vegetarian wide noodles. It was really delicious, and I asked for some spicy sauce on the side. Wow! It was homemade and fiery. One quibble: I had ordered hot tea. When asked for another cup, was given tepid water to use on existing green tea bag. That's cheap and chintzy to me. Service was adequate if not friendly. I will definitely go back there. Too bad they don't deliver, at least to Montclair. Blocks away? Weird.

My son and I were at birra last night and I can't say enough about the fabulous wait staff.  They all left such a positive impression which is unusual for most restaurants. Such a friendly bunch of people! The food  was wonderful as usual too!

Dishes have to be cleaner. At beginning the food were good and now they more like slacking of making them. In order to have more customers, they have to be more consistent. Make sure you dump all of the left over like hot & sour peppers etc. They will bring it out for the next customer. Sometime there is hair in the food.

This is easily one of the best restaurants in Montclair. We always get the meat sampler and are never disappointed with the quality of the food!  The hibiscus tea is also delicious. It's the perfect place to grab food before or after heading to the movies or the Wellmont. We have also brought our 2-year-old for lunch and she enjoyed sharing with us as well!

My favorite restaurant in jersey. From the quality of the food, the relaxing atmosphere and of course best customer service. I love their calamari, seaweed salad and you have got to try their ceviche! Their sushi is soo fresh and yummy. Coming from california - i have tried many sushi places.. and honestly,  this is the best sushi place i have tried. It's also BYOB. I love this place!

After waiting 18 minutes just for someone to ask us if we had ordered yet, we finally got some drinks and placed our food orders. I ordered the biscuits and gravy.
