We ordered so many different platters and nothing failed to disappoint. My favorites include the rice and beans and the cheese crisps . Only complaints are the wait time and the awful "strawberry daiquiri" I returned for a tequila sunrise which is orange juice and tequila , it packed a bit of a punch and I only needed 1 drink. The daiquiri tasted more like a slushie but the server probably was not a bartender . There was about 7 tables and only 1 server which stirred up frustration but can easily be remedied . I can't even give less than 5 stars because the food is just that good.

Came on a Sunday for a quick lunch......left totally satisfied and with leftovers!!!! Also we had to buy extra food to bring home for during the week. The portions are generous, the place is clean and the staff is like family!!! Can't wait to come back!! Stop in and you won't be disappointed!
better than pats and always a fun time waiting in line with others who are getting ready to enjoy one of the best cheesesteaks in philly

Balzem was a new gem that I found! Food was very clean and loaded with flavor. The service was on point as the waiter was very attentive. The entire vibe of the restaurant was great- love a smaller restaurant with a warm inviting setting. This will definitely be added to my list of go to affordable yet delicious eats.

I went to Mexican Mariachi last week with my friend after our class got out and we hadn't eaten all day so needless to say we were both very hungry. The lady at the cash register was one of the friendliest people I've ever met and I had the Mariachi Plate and loved every bite of it.  The chips and salsa you get with the meal are very homemade and unique tasting and if you're not careful will fill you up before you have your actual meal!  The chips were thick and the salsa was just spicy enough where it didn't ruin the meal for me.  The tostada I had was great also. I will definitely be going back.  I'd eat here over Chipotle and conveniently for me Mexican Mariachi is located way closer!

My son took me there today for a family lunch and it was my first time there. It was a surprising experience as I really did not know what to expect. We had the 5-course tasting menu and the food was exquisite and expertly made. I can't say I recognize everything that was on the plate, but the blend of taste was unexpected. I didn't even realize it was a vegetarian course until the end of the meal. I would definitely come back again.

First, they have a different menu for brunch. My husband and I went around three and were given the brunch menu. So we didn't get to try the Buttermilk Fried Chicken. So, instead my husband ended up ordering some fried pork dish with waffles. i don't know if it was the time and day, but they were lacking a lot of the items from the menu. We were told about the shortage as my husband's food came out. We were told they ran out of their waffle batter, so we got some pancakes instead. Again, this was told as they brought out our food. In addition, the substitution was made without our consent. I was surprised due to the fact they are known for their chicken and WAFFLES. How can they run out of the batter for what they are known? The pork dish was also lightly pink which isn't good when it comes to pork. We hoped for the best and still consumed it due to the long wait we had to endure to get our food in the first place. It was ironic how the table next to us, who had more people and ordered after we did, got their food first. We also tried ordering one of the doughnuts as dessert, but we were also told they only had one, exactly one, doughnut left. So, I got to have that one last doughnut. The service was mediocre. Our waitress seemed very miserable to be working there. She wasn't thrilled when we asked about some items on the menu nor when we tried to order dessert. Once we ordered our food our waitress was nonexistent. Also, we were told about the changes by someone else who brought our food out. The quickest service we got from her was when we asked her for the check. I really wanted to enjoy my meal at Buttermilk Channel, but it just wasn't meant to be I guess...

I met my 4 girlfriends there one Sunday afternoon. No one came over and even offered a beverage for at least 20 minutes. When I looked at any of the waitresses they all turned their heads as if they didn't already catch me eye! Finally, we ordered. Upon delivery of our meals, everyone's, your read that right, EVERYONE'S order was wrong, except mine. I was the only salad. They took all the plates back but when they came back again, still wrooonggg! Finally on the third try they got it right. In fairness the food was good but the service was crap!! They could not even get the change right when we paid the bill. I asked for singles but got large bills. When I said something, the women, apparently the owner was so snippy, I wanted the tip back. When everyone left and I was last out the door, all Miss Snippy could say was I'm sorry, so glad you told me. But she knew something had been going wrong all along. As courtesy, they should have at least made some kind of offer...but no...too bad. This was my first time and if it's managed this poorly, I doubt I would go again nor would I recommend.
This is the best Indian restaurant in New Haven. I've tried them all now, and it's better than the one in the old diner or that other one. Tandoori chicken might be the best I've ever had.

Chef Sarah Gresko has brought a taste of the south to Hopewell, NJ. Staff is friendly, the ambience is pleasant, and the food is incredible. Can't wait until I make it back to try more of her incredible menu!!

Ok.  this is SO not a diner.  It may be a fine dining establishment.  The food may be great.  I wouldn't know, I went there at 11PM sunday night looking for a greasy cheese covered chicken salad sandwich with fries and got a snobby waitress with a farm to table menu.    As I said, this may be a great place to eat.  But it is not a freakin diner!
Albeit a bit pricey, Blue delivers quality Mediterranean Asian cuisine with flare and an intimate ambience.

$11 for 3, count 'em 3!  Ravioli's?  REALLY!?  small plate portions should not cost that much.  It amazes me how people will rave about a place, and not notice (or care) that they're being price gouged.  pizza wasnt that great either, and we had a couple rotten tomatoes on the salad.  there are many better options for Italian food than here.  But, as long as people are willing to pay, overpriced eateries will continue to get away with small portions and big prices.
Creative menu and affable staff made our private party a great success. The appetizers were inspired and everything else was terrific too ! Will be back soon.

My husband and I were here only once and we'll not come back, for sure, food is okay- nothing else cannot say about it, but service was extremely terrible- our waitress was sitting near the entrance all the time, watching tv show. She came to our table 5 min later we came - was very rude- even didn't say "hello!" to us, than was yelling at me, asking "don't you know what is that ?"- you even can't imagine how her face looked like, her body language showed her disrespect . We're unattended - she really neglected us, when we're done- had to wait 15 min for her come to table- of course, much more important for her wad to watch that tv program...we left disappointed .

food was tasty, drinks were excellent. Price not so much. I understand for drinks I am not going to fight a delicious margarita with fresh fruits for  $12 but if I am paying $14 for quesadilla or guacamole I should get enough for the price. The portions are small but the food is delish. Mexican food should not cost this much and if the price was lower I would be an avid fan. The waitstaff was nice the decor was also good.
This place is really good if you like Greek and Mediterranean style dishes. I recommend their Greek salads if you are looking for something quick and lite.

We came down for a wine dinner that was $100 a person. For a Monday night event the placed was packed! I think they actually closed the whole restaurant for the event. The wines were delicious but the food was hit or miss and a bit inconsistent with the portions as I noticed some dishes around me seem to have bigger/less portions than the ones next to them. We were seated in the second floor of the restaurant and felt a bit as an afterthought since the speaker will talk about the wine downstairs and then come upstairs to repeat it to our section but it didn't seem as thorough as he could have been. Decent wine dinner but was expecting a bit more given the price.
BYOB. We love this place. Food is always good. I usually get the chicken enchiladas and my husband gets the steak fajitas. Never disappointed and the servers are always friendly and attentive.
a fun, family atmosphere, the nicest staff and the BEST pizza. absolutely love this place every single time!!

I work upstairs and have been coming here for breakfast and lunch very regularly--probably 4 or 5 times a week, if not more, because it is so convenient.   In fact, I just came here for breakfast this morning.  A few hours later I needed a plastic fork for my lunch (which I didn't purchase there).  I went downstairs to ask for a plastic fork and was rudely turned away.   Now I am sad and I have to eat my lunch with the plastic knife I got this morning for my cream cheese. Please don't come here.  I can't believe I got turned away for a fork :(
Authentic and tasty but expensive. You can get macarons three times as large for the same price elsewhere...although not as good.

Grabbed a bite of food as I was staying at the Raddison Blue down the street. Bruschetta appetizer was amazing. I ordered an pasta dish with creamy rose sauce and shrimp and chicken. I live that they have whole wheat pasta available, but a couple of my shrimps were raw and that really put a bad taste in my mouth. For desert we ordered the gelato and it was great! Would give it another try but the food needs to be properly cooked.

I never expected to find a true Australian place is Queens, NY but this place was a great surprise! The waiter was so personable with me while I waited for my party to arrive and helped me order something that I would truly enjoy. Their kangaroo burger with feta cheese was delicious!! I would recommend this to everyone for anytime of the day but their Sunday brunch specials are unbeatable in price and flavor! I will definitely have to revisit this place in the future:)
Love the food here! Usually come for lunch and the service is great. A lot of food choices! Food quality is great, I really enjoyed it!

This is a very nice place to eat in Little Iitaly, I was looking for some authentic italian pizza for lunch you know, and I was pretty satisfied! The pizzas were delicious, the dough is really great. I especially enjoyed the desert which was a tiramisu, so delightful. The service was satisfying too.

food is super delicious they do everything fresh st. peter fish branzino and octopus salad awesome also nice dessert menu stuff is so polite and helpful especially weekend they are packed must call for reservations for sure BEST GRILLED FISH IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD
I had African coffee with a touch of chocolate and warm half and half; raisin cranberry bread and crab eggs benedict.  An absolutely wonderful experience.

If you're craving a pizza that tastes like pasta, this is the place to go. Their bread to cheese/sauce ratio is incredible and the flavor is so delicious... I come here every time I visit NYC just because it's worth every dollar. Ooey gooey cheese forever...
Amazing vegan experience. Ordered a delicious vegan Reuben with sweet potato fries. Could barely stop eating them!!!

ONLY HAD TAKEOUT. Recently rated among the best pizza in the nation by the Huff post, so i had to give it a go. Definitely a great pie, but pricey and small (I'm a college student). Service was great as far as the little interaction with the waitresses i had.
Best pie in Hamilton area. I think it bests both DeLorenzo's locations.
Great quick food even close to closing time. Personal pizza is huge. Went in late at night and they opened up a can of tomatoes. Workers were really nice and at a good price.

Really enjoyed the brunch here! Drinks were delicious and strong - the mimosa was a little too sweet for me, but the Bloody Mary was perfectly spicy. Love that you can switch between the two drinks if you're doing the unlimited special - a lot of places won't let you do that! The menu was also perfect. I love a slightly unconventional brunch. Our table mostly ordered pad thai or the Thai french toast. I had the pad thai, and it was delicious!!! Huge portions too. Our waiter was a little slow, but the food and drinks came fast, so no big deal. He was still pretty helpful with our questions. We made some modifications to our food, and everything came out correctly! Would definitely come back again!
Great food, atmosphere, and service! Will go back again!

The food is mediocre. SERVICE IS HORRIBLE. When I arrived, there were about 30 people waiting outside so I thought I'd be in for a treat if that many people were willing to wait. After being finally seated an hour later, I was eager to taste their famous soup dumplings, given all the great reviews. The soup dumplings were good, but I've had better and I was expecting amazing. As for their wonton soup... My homemade version beats theirs by miles. Decent prices and ok food but definitely not worth the hype. I guess they have a big ego because they treat customers like numbers rather than people. People arriving after me, were seated before me. Even those people apologized to me. I will definitely not be returning. Despite poor service I might have returned if the food lived up to the hype of the plethora of newspaper clippings on their front windows. Obviously, it didn't.

Just went here last night with my husband. We had no reservation and we were seated as soon as we walked in! The waiter came quickly, offered us water and told us about the different cuts of steaks. We ordered a special for an app - lobster macaroni and cheese. The portion was very big - could easily feed five people. The pieces of lobster in it were huge! I ordered a filet mignon and a side of the whipped potatoes. The steak was cooked just right and the potatoes were good, a little soupy, but ok. My husband ordered a 16 oz steak and the kale with bacon on the side, he enjoyed both very much. For dessert we shared a cherry cheesecake. Great taste and it was presented nicely. Nice place!

So I feel almost bad about writing this review...but then I get mad thinking about the 15 bucks I wasted on nachos that made me gag :/  I live in the neighborhood and after my roommate sung La Calacas high praises we went to dinner and grabbed margs and their famous nachos...which are awesome...or were The past two times we ordered nachos we noticed ehhh stuff was burnt, things werent fresh etc etc..but this time I actually had to write a review.  We decided to go with the brisket on the nachos and whatever meat they put on it was horrendous.  By meat I mean just gobs of white fat they must have shaved off from the carnitas that was going to something else because our whole order was just literally....fat.   Ugh terrible had to throw the whole thing out and we have decided third times the charm on the no bueno list :(

We ate here twice, so we really enjoyed our breakfasts: gruyere cheese omelets, salmon with great salad, breakfast wrap and great burgers & fries.  Sorry I missed the opportunity to have the great looking french toast when we returned on Sunday - not offered then.  Very cozy seating but efficient service and food served HOT.  Portions are just right and satisfying. Nice touch to offer complimentary sparkling water.

I came to parc for the first time with my sister for brunch. The weather was beautiful so we decided to sit outside which was very nice. I enjoyed my view of Rittenhouse park and watching all of the people and pets walking by. The service was ok, our server was a little rude and seemed frustrated when we'd ask questions about the menu. At times he would look around at his other tables when we were talking to him as if he was busy and that we needed to hurry and order. For brunch I had ordered the carpaccio tuna, I wasn't all that impressed. It was very salty and just not enjoyable so i decided to take it back and then i ordered the Bbeet salad which I thought was very tasty. My sister had the cheeseburger she loved it but thought it was a bit pricey for a burger, I believe the burger was $16. I would like to come back and try some other dishes; overall the place was pretty good but what i enjoyed most was the view. I would only go back when the weather is nice to sit outside again.

Here we are waiting for a sandwich and salad. 25 minutes and counting. Place is virtually empty.  Service indifferent. Food is not as good as it looks and they run out early. Place is beautiful. Customers are friendly. Were all in this together.
Inexpensive and delicious and right by the park.  I could probably eat their falafels every day.

After visiting the Republic of Georgia three years ago I fell in love with the hospitality of the people and soulful savory cuisine of this nation nestled in between the Caucus Mountains.  There are few Georgian restaurants in the USA so whenever we are in NYC we make sure one of our evening meals is Georgian.  This week we were able to introduce Georgian cuisine to a friend. Thank Old Tbilisi Garden for opening in Manhattan.  We arrived too late on Saturdsy night -the kitchen had closed, but we stayed and enjoyed a few glasses of wine because Georgian wine is some of the finest in the world.  But we returned Sunday with a friend who never had Georgian food. Now she is a convert. We started with the tomato cucumber walnut salad, followed by the baked cheese filled pastry-Khachapuri was excellent, as were the dumplings, the trout (the whole fish with tail and head). The lamb kabob was prepared to perfection.  We will be back.

This is my absolute favorite place to get lunch around YNHH. Not only does Jon make absolutely delicious salads and subs, but his portions are generous, prices are fair, and he is wonderful with customers. He loads up the salads with an incredibly generous helping of meat and fresh veggies, and the subs are huge! I am only in the area visiting family every 6-8 months or so, and I make it a point to stop by and get lunch here during my visit. I crave his salads when I come to town!! Not only is the food great, but he remembers me every single time! He is so personable and I am very impressed that he not only remembers who I am, but what I like to order each time I come back. I have nothing but good things to say about this place and Jon. I'm currently in food heaven eating his famous chicken caesar salad right now!!
Possibly the best espresso I've had NYC. Better than all the known favorites. Tiny place w lovely decor. Espresso made with time and love. Also nice that it's by all the flower shops. Keep it up!

Went in on Saturday night, Melinda was our server and was outstanding!  Fried pickles, fried mozz, vermont chicken wrap, truffle fries and of course the soft pretzels.  The food was piping hot when served and delicious.  Twice managers came over to see how our meal was, one actually apologized if our dinner was taking too long but truly it wasn't long at all, only waited about 8 minutes between apps and dinner.  We will definitely be back

I am updating my review from the last one I wrote in February 2014. As you can see I never went back as I had a very bad experience the time I was there. However, I was there just this past Saturday.  I have to say the place has done a 360 from my perspective. The check-in process is seamless not like last time were there were a bunch of people waiting by the door and no one knew what was going on. This is the first thing I noticed.  Secondly, I think the reason why the restaurant has change is because of Lance - the manager who I had the pleasure of meeting. He is extremely pleasant, knows the restaurant business and understand what is need it. He was VERY attentive and you can see that he truly cares about everyone that was in there. I noticed he went table to table and ask them how everything was going. This is what a true manager does. Now, to the food it hasn't change much. I honestly didn't have a problem with that at all. It is still delicious and plenty.  There is no question that whoever is the chef now knows what he or she is doing.  The  menus have also change. They have this menu with lighting which is an excellent idea, the place is somewhat dark therefore this helps a lot when choosing your options to eat. I love it. Now for my biggest problem I had with the place, the service. This time around we got a good one. Emily was EXCELLENT. She was nice and very attentive, knew exactly what she was doing. She was very personable which is exactly what a waitress should be.  I have to definitely give the establishment  a two thumbs up. The changes implement were great and I am definitely coming back very soon.  I had a wonderful time there.

Ordered take out today for lunch and the food was "okay". I ordered a salad, penne vodka and a pizza for a few people to share. The vodka sauce was mostly cream it was so light, and the pasta was very al dente. Im not sure I would be back,

How do I not even give a star!  We went there to celebrate with my family. Long story short the waiter was DRUNK stole money from us then when I went to the manager to ask the waiter was so rude and abusive.  Let me add that the manager apologized and said he knew he was drunk!  He asked for my # and said someone will call me regarding this.  No one ever called me nor apologized!

This restaurant was an experience, but not sure I would say a good one. The food was good, not great. The atmosphere  "an upscale, small cafeteria like" setting......not what I was expecting.  It was extremely loud and cramped. But most important, IT WAS SO EXPENSIVE WITH SUCH SMALL PORTIONS AND AN EXTREMELY LIMITED MENU! I couldn't believe that it was almost $200 per couple and the men were still hungry since the portions were so small! on a smaller note- no bread, no ice, and martinis served in wine glasses because they don't have any..........really??? Let's just say, we won't be back!

Love!  I take my sushi seriously.  Great sushi selection, very fresh.  We did omakase, but also had a few extras since we are greedy pigs. We tried all of the different cooked eel varieties, which were excellent. The atmosphere leaves a little bit to be desired, but it is mid-town after all.  The hostess is also kind of snooty.  But the food more than makes up for it.
Good pizza. The Grandpa Style pie was very good.

Love this place.  We tried a a lot of different things - sausages, ribs, brisket, pulled pork and a bunch of sides too.  Everything was really good, and the ribs were my favorite.   The only problem is that everyone else loves this place too, and the line literally goes out the door and down the block if you go at prime-time, and even pretty late (it is the East Village after all).  I try to go offpeak.
I ordered the pasta and meatballs.  The meatballs were very over herbed. Sauce was okay. I also ordered the cheesecake. The crust was hard and difficult to break with a fork.  All in all it was okay

This place has some of the best margaritas in the city. Tasty tasty tasty! Try the nachos they are nice and crispy,smothered with toppings. Steak fajitas are my fave so if you see me there, thats what I will be eating. They have a good brunch too. Bloody mary is a must at brunch.

Fantastic pizza.  Hole in the wall look from outside.  Put our name in about an hour in advance on a Friday night and were seated by around 7.  Fun, fun vibe and just perfect pizza.  Always need to try a margerita just to set a mental standard for myself.  This was excellent

I had such high hopes for this place.  We came here on 10/26 for brunch, we arrived around 1:30 and were told that there was a 15 minute wait.  No problem, we sat outside and waited.  We were seated within that time frame and given our menus.  The restaurant is pretty tight, they can stand to either reposition the tables or remove a few because depending on where you are sitting you will have to keep pushing your chair in so others can get by, this gets to be annoying. On to the ordering, our waitress Delores came over about 5-10 minutes after we were seated to take our order.  She is the only reason that this review got 2 stars, I would have left 0 stars if possible but we will get to that.  Let me preface by saying there were two servers and a bartender and about 30 tables.  They were beyond understaffed.  We were dining with two children, we ordered two orders of chix & waffles, the banana fosters french toast and the chicken wings.  A couple sat down next to us and ordered after us and wouldn't you know they got their two orders of chix and waffles before us?  No problem, the football game was on so we watched that while we waited.  Our chix wings came about 25 minutes later from the time we ordered them only to be told by a different waiter that the rest of our order shouldn't be far behind.  Well I should hope not seeing as though this should have been our appetizer. The wings were huge, thing c-town supermarket chix wings.  The flavor was nice, mild to slightly spicy.  The problem is that they weren't cooked.  We bit into one (they give you 4) and noticed some blood, then when we bit into the other two we noticed they were under cooked as well.  We signaled the waiter (not Delores) and told him what happened.  He said okay and said one second.  I food arrived about a minute later and we ended up telling Delores who took the chicken and apologized.  If you have ever been to sweet chick before you should not order the chix & waffles from here as you will be greatly disappointed.  However if you have never had the sweet chicken experience, this dish isn't bad.  One of the pieces of chicken was slightly burnt but well seasoned while the other was cooked perfectly but bland as a piece of paper.    Now on to the french toast, I love banana fosters so I was super excited about this.  The french toast was dry, I used the maple butter from the chix & waffles just to add some moisture to the plate.  The bread was super soft but dry.  Well after a few bites I find a piece of scouring pad in my food.  At this point I wanted to cry because I was starving and both of my orders were screwed up. Delores was very apologetic on behalf of the chefs.  I find the food quality here to be unsafe.  It turned out that the brillo was from the chefs cleaning the stove and they must have missed it.  Obviously there is no excuse for under cooked chicken.   Between the wait for my food and the issues with my food and the fact that I didn't eat anything I can't come back here.  If nothing else my children should have received their order first and it was clear that the food was ready because the table next to us arrived after us, ordered after us and got the exact meal before us which leads me to believe that they had our food.

wow. what a great restaurant! Their food is really really good. I went with my husband for dinner and we had the tuna, yellowtail and polenta for appetizer and the spaghetti and gnocchi with mushroom as our main course. The gnocchi was unbelievable. They also have a very good service. I highly recommend this place for any occasion, we will definitely come back.
Happy with everything! Delicious and great service :)

I have been coming to Long Horns since day 1 opening. I have met so many amazing employees who in turn also became customers of mine as well.  Understanding that this is a chain store whenever I go with my family and or friends I am served like a regular should be served with out any complaints. The Manager Tony does an amazing job, and honestly speaking having been to other locations around the NJ area this by far is the best. If anyone has any problems do not hesitate to speak your mind at the place itself and I am 100% that they will attend to any of your needs.

Whenever we are in the area we enjoy eating at this restaurant. I always seem to order the same thing - strip steak in the rock. You get a thick slab of meat that you cook yourself on a very hot lava rock. It additional you get a potato or vegetable and a very nice salad bar, soup, and bread. The prices are very reasonable and it always gets filled up fast especially as the weekend approaches. Dress is casual. It isn't fancy but very clean and the staff is very friendly. A great place to eat.
I got the Falafel Trio Platter and it was so worth it!!! Nish Nush definitely rivals Taim! Venue is very inviting as well.

We came here based on a recommendation from a friend and so happy we did. We shared some fried pickles and the honey chicken and pickles biscuit sandwich and it was all fantastic! The menu had a great variety and I would love to come back to try a few other items. Oh yeah - great beer selection. And cheese grits! And outdoor seating.
Wonderful restaurant.  Great food, nice decor. Romantic but a bit on the loud side.

This is my favorite restaurant of all time.  The prices are great, but you always have to remember, it's BYOB and cash only.  This is just my opinion, but I think the Bistro East location is better than the Ovest West location.  The menus and the chefs are different. The restaurant is small, you will be sitting very close to the table next to you, but hey, maybe you can strike up a nice conversation.  When weather permits, there is outside seating.   I strongly recommend the Grigliata Di Calamari (grilled calamri) appetizer, and the homemade Gnocchi al Filetto di Pomodoro.  My personal favorites.
Good, authentic peruvian food. Good price for huge portions, recommend Arroz Chaufa Mixto!

MANNY's you were sorely missed, that sad summer evening when the light no longer went on, and as i continued that slow walk each day, my excitement of maybe, just maybe today would be the day that you were open.   None the less, it's al go now, and i'm super happy!!!! Perfect spot, hidden, but not too hidden. Thanks for making my mornings a worth while walk on Patchen Ave.

The food is very tasteful and at a very reasonable price . The portions are also very generous . I've had Peruvian food in Miami and NYC so this is not my first time . It was pretty crowded when we went for dinner but our waiter forgot to put one of our orders in and he did not notice until we flagged him down about 20 mins after getting everyone else's food . Other than that , I had a good experience here .
The best Napolitan style pizza I've found outside of Italy. I love their pies!! Highly recommended.

I tried chicken boiled dumplings for $3. It's super cheap, tasty and filling. The only problem is you can see how they cook food in the back without gloves, it is pretty unhealthy but whatever, it is good though.

The food is amazing but the service is horrible. Our order gets messed up frequently-check it before you leave with takeout! Delivery is a joke...hours later you will find out the "couldn't find you". Only go there to eat if you have the time and patience to wait and send back whatever came out wrong. Takeout is best if you check it first! If they upgraded their customer service they would be the best in town! Hope the horrible customer service doesn't bring down the whole company!

This place is a straight rip off. A salad at panera that is 4.50 is 17 dollars here. saganaki is cheese. There shrimp had no cheese. The mixed grill was for 2...... It was a rediculous amount of money was really good for 1 and McDonald's after this meal was necessary. If you are made of money and don't care about being ripped off go here. If you care about the money you make and theb please stick to michelin restaurant they are still cheaper.

Great addition to the neighborhood.  The menu was perfect for everyone in my party as there were items from scallops and mussels to pasta and pork chops to choose from.  The wine menu had a variety of half bottles which is a perfect option for those that don't want to invest in full bottles. The ambiance was trendy but the space in between tables was very tight.

The chicken and waffles are to die for!!!!! I loved the service as well. My waiter, Lawrence was very attentive, polite and such a cool guy. He was also a cutie. This is now my favorite spot!! I give this place 2 thumbs up!
very very good!  i had the lamb kabob, morrocan cigars, and fried cauliflower.  all of it was delish.  good portions, and good prices.

I never review on Yelp but felt it necessary to take a moment and start with singing praises to Rose Petals Cafe & Lounge for their outstanding food, quality customer service and owners who really care. This quaint gem of Germantown is the start to some positive change for the area and should be an example of what small businesses in Philadelphia could be all about. Ownership has a story, but more importantly they translate there passion to caring abou there customers, going above and beyond, being a part of the community in many ways, while still serving Amazing fresh, quality food. * I felt the need to mention that some of the other reviews I have read are disheartening, especially knowing that this is a restaurant that has owners and employees that are so humble, pleasant and attentive to their customer base. I suppose some people feel the need to use yelp as a venting space, especially relating to one review stating "they have criminals working for them" simply due to what seems to be a simple credit card pos error. FYI these things happen in chain restaurants all the time, and I don't believe for 1 second they would be stealing from their customers, but again not really the type of dialouge for yelp. I have noticed that Rose Petals continues to become busier and busier, which means the word is spreading so great job guys. Keep up the good work, and remember your not going to please everyone (as yelp has already shown you) but keep true to your mission and vision of this amazing destination as those who really know appreciate your generous efforts. For those who don't I will continue to pray for you as some of the critical comments are unnecessary, but keep patronizing IHOP as that leaves more space on Sunday afternoon for me and my family to enjoy the real stuff!

One of my favorite places whenever I visit Philadelphia. Waffles are the star of the show and you can tell the batter is made in house filled with deliciousness. They just started a dinner menu on Thursday & Friday and both the Oxtails and Coconut Shrimp are simply to die for. Yummy!!! All the items I have tried have been amazing and the service is equally as warm, proficient and pleasant. My favorite part of the experience is the decor and kids room. While I sip my coffee in the largest, coolest mugs I have seen in a while, my 4 year daughter gets to play in the kids room with the train set and chaulk board. My kid has never requested a restaurant by name, but Rose Petals is clearly on top for her. Cudos Rose Petals!!!

I have been to Rose Petals several times both during the week and on the weekend and I must say that they never disappoint!!! The southern comfort waffle is by far my favorite as I've never tasted anything like it. A cornbread waffle with fried catfish and a turkey sausage cream gravy is mouthwatering just to talk about. The intimate space lends itself to meet new people, enjoy good food and relax while the wait staff provides one of the best customer service experiences I have had from chain restaurants in so long. * As a note during the week I am able to relax and even using the free wifi to get some work done, but on the weekend the place is busy and jumping. I love that other's love this place as much as I do, and hope them much success cause it's definitely my spot!
Foods not that great. Service is ok. Charge 20% automatic gratuity.

The best Chinese restaurant in Plainsboro. Main supporters are from the neighborhood Asian crowd especially Chinese. I prefer to come here during non peak hours so that the quality of the food is more guarantee. The portion of the food is on good size. The signature dishes that I like are sautéed lotus root, Peking duck, chicken and eggplant with salted fish casserole, sizzling Chilean sea bass with black bean sauce. Staffs are friendly but they can be not so attentive during the non peak hours (busy reading newspaper/using their phones) or talking too loud in the dining room (it's a culture thing, I totally understand). I suppose they have to work on it. Those patrons who don't used to using loud tone in their daily communication might feel annoying. Overall, it's a clean and good family restaurant.

Fantastic food, fantastic vibes, and the chef stefano was the epitome of a hospitable, albeit eccentric owner who cares about making his guests feel at home. The mushroom and truffle oil linguine was simple and delicious, in keeping with the italian culinary tradition. Highly recommended
Best margaritas I have found in the city.

Great food and service! I have been here twice, tried their shabu shabu dinner which was delicious, next time I'll have to try the sukiyaki dinner! I took off one star since it's not as good as the places I have been in Japan, but must say, it is the best in NYC!
stopped hear for a couple of dogs they were OK the buns were stale the onion rings needed seasoning. would stopp again only if I was in the area.
Great service and food.

I love the Farmhouse because everything is consistently very solid. They do everything on their menu well and I particularly appreciate their commitment to buying local ingredients. They have a great selection of beer, I think it must be one of the best selections of Vermont beer in Burlington. I love trying the various Hill Farmstead beers they have on tap. I find myself regularly going to Farmhouse because of it's welcoming atmosphere. I go for work happy hours, take my family there when they visit, it's a great date location, and just nice to grab a beer and a burger. Overall, if you're unsure at all of what you want to do for dinner in Burlington, it's a bit of a safe pick but you really can't go wrong with Farmhouse.

Terrible night workers. I ordered online and went to pick it up. The food wasn't ready and the workers could not even ring up the order. After 15 minutes of confusion I was told too pay twice what the website said. Plus they didn't even start my order. I walked out of there and don't plan on coming back ever
Aside from being and excellent restaurant, the Red Cat also cares about local people. Please spend money here.

Wow, what a disappointment.  An evening of decidedly mediocre food and unresponsive, unfriendly service.  The wine list is good - and not overpriced, but the overall experience was well below what we all expected. They did all the little stuff poorly.  When two of us were discussing wine, the waitress said, "I'll come back after you've decided."  Not a single opinion voiced, a recommendation made.   I always thought picking out wine was supposed to be fun, not the drive through at McDonalds.  We sat for more than 20 minutes before bread was served, and that happened only after a request.  Water glasses were empty throughout most of the meal. Oh, and they did the big stuff poorly as well.  With only two non-gluten entrees, I went with a filet of beef.  Despite a request for "medium rare toward rare" it was well done and dry.  The appetizer portion of scallops were cold and hard - apparently cooked to serve with the appetizers and held until the entrees were served.  Oh, and a $37 filet of beef should have some vegetables - more than a single ping-pong ball sized potato. Salads were good - kale caesar was dressed well and served with toasted pumpkin seeds - and the ice cream (ordered with sour cherries) was excellent.  But the waitress grabbed the creme brulee when it was half eaten and was clearly in a hurry to get us out the door. After all the hype - well, even without high expectations - this was not very good.  I'll stick to Elixir or Carpenter & Main - MUCH better food, vastly better service and much lower cost.
What can you say?! It's the famous Halal guys...best Halal food in NYC if you're into street meat. I kinda grew out of it but if you're into street meat THIS IS IT FOLKS!
Amazing food! This place was so fantastic. My husband and I were visiting for the weekend and we're super impressed with this place!

I went down to the MLC Bakeshop after a job fair so I could get some work done. A few things... I ordered a coffee Americana and it honestly tasted like water. There was some staff training going on in the other half of the store, and that's perfectly fine, but it was bar training. And the only guy technically on shift kept sneaking over for shots of wine and liquor in between making customers' drinks, which I thought was a little unprofessional. What is bringing this down to a one star review, however, was the service. People come to coffee shops all the time in order to get some coffee and do some work. Their wireless router was acting up and not letting me connect to it. The person behind the counter did some fiddling with the router when I let him know of the issue, stood up, and gave me a "you're out of luck" look while shrugging then went back for more wine at the training program. It wasn't a pleasant experience. I actually packed up and left an almost full cup of coffee on my table. I didn't get a "sorry" or "thanks for coming" on my way out. If that's the way they like to run their business, so be it. But I won't be returning and I'll be making sure all of my friends who live in the apartment complex directly above the bakeshop are aware of what they think of their customers.

I hate to leave such a negative review, but I really had a terrible experience at Penelope's this past Sunday.  After waiting for about an hour, we were seated (and this has no bearing on the wait time - I knew it would be an hour and was prepared for that), I ordered the Pumpkin Waffles special.  I had actually very much been looking forward to the waffles - it was a big reason why we came as they sounded very seasonal and just delicious.  After waiting another 30 minutes for our food to come, the waffles came out cold.  I usually never like to send food back, but I didn't feel they were worth eating cold - especially having waited now close to 90 minutes to eat.  I told our server and she quickly took them back to the kitchen - insisting that they would fix it. Now, most of the time I would assume the kitchen would remake the waffles and send out a new fresh dish.  However, what came back was simply the same waffles (I could tell obviously because I had taken the one bite to determine they were cold) - but this time they were microwaved/or heated to death that they were rock hard.  Burned and hard - not crispy on the outside, soft on the inside.  Just rock hard.   At this point - I just wanted to leave.  I was happy to pay for my dish and just leave and never come back.  My poor boyfriend basically shoved down his burger (which we paid for) and then we left.  To her credit, the server took off the dish, and then we were sent on our way. WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT.  I simply cannot believe they would just reheat/microwave a dish and send out without even checking if it was even edible anymore.  After waiting so long to eat, I had to start all over for brunch elsewhere - now around 2 hours after I initially got to Penelope. I don't regret waiting/trying Penelope's - because you have to try things to know they aren't worth coming back for. No thanks - would definitely NOT recommend, and frankly cannot understand why people wait so long (they all must be first time visitors/tourists).

HORRIBLE DO NOT ORDER. Management couldn't be more rude. Waited 90 minutes food never came. Refused to reimburse me. The man "Ali Bran" used racial derogatory profanities and I will never go to or order from this restaurant ever again. I advise you to go somewhere else.

Outstanding new place for breakfast and lunch in the Northern & Steinway area of LIC. I have eaten in twice and ordered delivery for working lunch several other times. Office managers take note, order from this place. The sandwiches are high quality and very tasty. The brisket and chicken are my favorites. Salads are fresh and of equally high quality. The owner Chris is a really nice guy.

Cafe V is a great brunch spot, but be ready to eat.  I ordered the lemon ricotta pancakes and they were amazing. Even though you would consider them "light and fluffy" it was enough for two though. Very clean interior and the wait staff is friendly.

For the life of me I cannot understand what the hype of this restaurant is. I came in with my family, it was an interesting restaurant scene where you walk into a large room and then down the stairs, everything from thereon was downhill (Literally and figuratively). They charge 25+ dollars for chicken on the bone, which taste no different than rotisserie I get at Costco for six bucks. My father mistakenly ordered the Salchichas and french fries, which were chopped up hotdogs sloppily displayed over a plate of french fries. I can't blame him for ordering this though, because there is nothing else on the menu beside the Boston market special. If you're going to drop over 200 bucks on dinner for six, make it worth it.

The best customer service I have ever experienced. The food is amazing and affordable. Bartenders are awesome and the drinks are of all/any variety. Very continental and a true representation of NYC. You'' meet a lot of interesting people. Definitely go and try everything!
Fast, easy, delicious, and knowledgable. I'm celiac and felt completely at ease enjoying the healthiest "fast food" lunch I've ever had. Yummy!
The best huevos rancheros that I've had in Philly.  Only bad part is waiting for a table when they get really busy.

This place is hit or miss. Decor is nice, cozy feel to it. The first time I came was with the family - food and service were phenomenal, was so happy to find aa place like this so close to home. Second time was so so, food not as great (runny eggs, cornmeal pancakes that were pretty bad, sausage undercooked) but STILL wanted to love this place. Got charged twice for pancakes on that visit, good thing I checked the bill after husband :)  I came back again with friends and unfortunately, service was still not good.  The waitresses are all really sweet but really don't seem to have a clue. I hope they work all the kinks out because I WOULD like to go back (goat cheese omelette is yum!) but service is just really bad.

I really wanted to love this place, given the reviews I've heard of it, but I didn't. The space is quaint and I do like being able to watch the chefs plate the food, and the food is good but it's not worth the $38-40 a dish price tag. Perhaps it's better for a couple, but our party of 5 waited for 1.5 hours to get our meal. If you're going to seat 5 people you should be able to serve 5 people in a timely manner. The 2 tops all around us were being served and finishing even before we got our meal- despite them arriving after us. We waited a long time for apps and there was very little communication from the wait staff except when she brought the appetizer out- they did comp that but then we waited another 30-45 minutes for our main course. I absolutely regret the decision to spend that amount of money here. We could have created a much better meal at home with that amount and it would've been warm. I was so disappointed. On top of it all 2 of the 5 people had some major gastrointestinal distress throughout the night from it.  Everyone has a bad night, but it hurts more when the price tag is Sooo high. I wouldn't mind so much if the dishes were $20 each- but I expect a lot more for $40 a plate.

I come here for lunch every so often.  Then I had one bad visit - not sure what was going on that day, but it was much worse than previous visits. I let some time go by and then went back - and it seemed back at its usual standard.  Pan chan (small free dishes that they give you at the beginning of the mean) was back to good quality and generous amounts.

Had a short 15min wait after our reservation time. A little crowded, but expected on a Sat night. While we hung around the shop in the front, the hostess came around with chocolate samples and even a chocolate martini sample. Service was on point, waitress was attentive and food delivery was timely. We only got dessert, but it was amazing. Can't wait to come back and try the dinner menu.
Best cheesesteak sandwich I had in a while! Must-go if in the area , would go there everyday if there was one in north jersey .

Terrible server. He double charged for guacamole, ignored us most of the meal, extremely slow service, then changed his tip! When our credit card bill came he added $10 to his tip! Absolute fraud! Food was ok, drinks good but the worst service I have ever experienced.

My experience at the Fat Buddha left an oozing, pus-filled blemish on my birthday night. I had gone to No Malice Palace (5/5 stars...go THERE) last year for my birthday and wanted a similar experience this year, hence why I chose Fat Buddha. I met with a (manager?), Carlos, a few days before the event. Carlos seemed very trustworthy, promised me a table and said my birthday experience at the bar would be 'exceptional'. Fast forward to Saturday night, I walk into the bar and I was exceptionally surprised that there was no reserved table for my party! Carlos had lied right to me face...it was very busy in the bar and another table would have taken up a lot of extra space. It seems like they couldn't accommodate a table, even if they wanted to. I was baffled that Carlos lied directly to my face. Seemed like a shady move and was done to trick my party into giving the bar business. Further, the bartender wouldn't serve me or my boyfriend drinks because the bouncer  had told her we were too 'intoxicated'. If that were true, I don't think I would be able to recall this horrific experience in such excruciating detail. Last complaint, the bar was way too crowded, couldn't even dance. I know they get a lot of traffic on weekends, but it was uncomfortable even to stand. In conclusion, the Fat Buddha lied to me for whatever reason, which is unfortunate for them because not only did my 50 person party leave the bar after 15 minutes, but I'm  pleased to blemish their Yelp page with this review.
It is hit or miss on freshness. It is also slightly overpriced for this sort of thing, but I love the pay-by-weight concept. It's good for a quick meal, but I wouldn't call it gourmet.

A New Haven tradition. Good dive bar to just go have cheap drinks that keep coming quickly with friends. It feels like a diner, but with alcohol. Pre-game here, then go have a classy drink and cigar at Owl Shop.

Great place to chill and grab a bite after work or lectures with friends. Younger crowd and atmosphere though, so you probably won't fit in if you're not in your twenties. Some older friends have said they feel like that don't get as good of service, too.

Excellent pizza and beer and they do beautifully with large groups. Go back to the pool table area if you can. Only complaint is that they start carding too early sometimes, so if you're just going to grab pizza with students, it's not always an option.
The food and drinks here are good and Well priced.  Great atmosphere.  Had a blast when came for some late night drinks with ny friends.
I always get the Italian sandwiches in the panini station. The bread is right out the wood fired oven and the meats are always fresh and of the best quality.  Pricey but worth it.
Great service nice location.  Great spot before a show at the TLA or just going to when hanging out on south street.
Really love the chicken wings!! The best I ever had!

This was our 2nd time at Da Legna and once again everything was "beyond expectations".Our waiter was hard to understand and clearly more interested in a larger party and left my cousin without her wine and boyfriend without the IPA he ordered but the host/server who kindly introduced himself as "Joseph" recovered for him nicely and was a pleasant addition to the wonderful atmosphere.He had so many interesting anecdotes about the restaurant and helped us steer through the interesting selections on the menu.My sister was quick to ask the pronunciation and translation and he told her how the g was silent like in the word "gnocchi" and how the name meant "from wood".He totally wowed us with a suggestion for a "pistachio pizza" that we would have never tried and we all agreed was one of the best topping combinations we had ever tasted.He took the ball and ran with it and made our experience a "tasty one"!! We'll definently be back and hopefully will have Joseph to help us in our food endeavors!!!

Very tasty and well-priced Margaritas. Food is also very good. Not authentic Mexican, but a culinarily more sophisticated Mexican at a good price. The quesadillas are especially wonderful. They just need to be a little faster with service and do separate checks.
Great neighborhood spot. Friendly service and consistently yummy food.
ignore. this review was meant for china gourmet in hk.

Incredibly slow service, but the food is very good. The coffee is very bad, even when they say it's fresh. I usually go through here to get a bagel-sandwich and then go elsewhere for my coffee. When you pull up, just make sure you're the only one in the drive-thru or you'll be there for an eternity.
Local bar. Older crowd. Bands at night are wayyyy too loud to hear anything inside. Impossible to hear each other. Food and drinks are good

It is such a relief to finally have somewhere to go that doesn't mass produce food. You can tell they take more time thinking about their menu and ingredient choices. We finally tried it this week as a test run and we've gone back a few times in the same week. The fresh squeezed juice drinks are great to try. As a person who really enjoys good food I encourage everyone to try this place, you will not be sorry! Everything we've had on the menu has been great so I could go on and on about each dish but if I had to recommend one item so far it would the le cordon bleu or maybe the veal meatballs?! Hard decision, but I can say that I will be back and will be trying out the breakfast menu soon. Also the staff is very friendly, homey feel and very pretty lighting at night.
We love this pizza! Always delicious!!
The burger is awesome. A lot of fries. Very good taste. A little bit pricey but... Worth it

Ok went there yesterday.  Ordered wings well done.  Not even close to that.  I ordered the garlic parm and if the wings were well done, the were soggy by being over-sauced by the garlic sauce.  We also got the jerk wings which were also over sauced.  They need to learn how to get the wings done well, with no sauce, and then LIGHTLY coat them in the sauce.  I thought that this place would have given Roma's a run for their money but quite frankly I don't think this place is going to make it and what is really sad, the landlord made Tony's pizza move for this place.  I can honestly say, I will never go back for seconds.  Sorry.

This was the best brunch I've had in Burlington hands down! The Wafflini is the way to go. I also shared the two poached eggs over a white bean stew which was delicous and innovative for this area, and the hashbrown with cheddar and bacon. My only regret was not ordering the salamon and sourcream hash brown instead! Next time for sure!

Tooooo pretentiously hipster. Plus, the coffee really isn't very good. I once witnessed a customer accidentally get YELLED AT for ordering a "tall" coffee (what Starbucks calls it). I get that is a coffee no-no, but c'mon, it's coffee...don't take it that seriously, and don't alienate your customers!

Reviews by Dan T and Rick B (and others like them) are spot on. The decor is lovely and warm, and the service is very attentive and technically strong (although lacking in true hospitality). The food, however, is lackluster at best. We had the Seasonal Tasting Menu, and there wasn't a single item that blew us away. Each item was just good, not great, and that's just not good enough for a restaurant with this type of reputation. Additionally, while one would expect small portions in a tasting menu, the portions were so ridiculously small that it really borders on the absurd. It appears that the Gramercy Tavern is taking advantage of its reputation, and perhaps there are enough folks out there non-discerning enough to challenge it, that they are now simply taking advantage of their customers. Such a shame.

Great place to find Eastern European groceries. If you are looking for old world authentic meats, this is the place. No frills, no sparkle, just good real food. They specialize in sausages. Numerous kinds of kielbasa, kishka, several wursts, head cheeses, and other stuff I didn't know existed. They do whole roasts for parties (pigs, lambs, goats). He also does custom game meat processing for hunters. A real treasure right here in Hartford.

I love this place! A unique rustic yet elegant setting gives this place an amazing atmosphere, you just never want to leave it. It gets very busy, but you feel comfortable and want to just soak it in as long as you can. The food is to die for... everything we had was on point, well executed and nicely presented. The search for interesting flavors is their strength - try the mussels, the broth is soooo good! The schnitzel is superb, just like a proper one you can get in Vienna; the ravioli and the short ribs were also outstanding.  The staff is extremely attentive and helpful, even when the place really fills up on week-ends. At the end of the dinner they reccommended we have a drink at their cocktail bar up the block - The Third Man - that is just another gem! What a great night on Avenue C - will have to come back soon!!!
excellent! If you like French food you are at the right place.

My wife and I went on the opening weekend and they have already nailed it!  The food was consistent hot and fresh.  The drinks were unique.  The owner was accessible and monitoring the scene.  The open kitchen will invite Vegan oohs and ahs.  I have not had a potato skins in 5 years and was pleased to find not only potato skins but great potato skins.  Ordered a second round  when our friend arrived.  Good location.
LOVE this place. You never know who or what you will meet!

AMAZING soup and cupcakes! This place is a gem! I only wish they had hot soup on the weekends (you can buy it cold and heat it up at home) and baked goods (maybe they could keep the previous day's and sell at a discount?). I totally get wanting to maintain their very high standard of excellence, but I bet if they sold these on the weekends at a discount, they would get even more customers. Highly recommended!

We bought a great groupon deal from Liverpool, England before we arrived in NY. As we were staying uptown, we were keen to try a meal somewhere different one evening. We couldn't fault the service; iced water for all on arrival, constantly refilled throughout, warm crusty bread and salad before some great entrees. The macaroni cheese with salmon and asparagus was outstanding - it was just a shame I was too full to finish it.  In fact, we were all so full, we had to take our 2 desserts to go (again, no problem at all). We thought it was friendly with great customer service and of course good food at a reasonable price. Next time we visit, we'll be sure we can finish it all!

Fact... Most "holes in a wall" type restaurants have just the most amazing and savory dishes; this is no exception. Oysters were fresh with extraordinary texture and flavor. I followed with a plate of steamed Mussels.... Amazing!!! I wrapped it up with the linguini & clams... To bad my stomach didn't have room for more food... Highly recommend this little seafood market & bar!!

so, so good! the restaurant, the charm, the quirks, the whole thing was just awesome. not fancy, not divey, just a quirky little joint in an intimate/eclectic setting with outstanding food. we had the burrate which was worth the trip alone, the burger which was fantastic and the flowerless chocolate cake, also delicious. they have a great IPA too and the service was good (not great, but very good).
short wait and the staff was friendly. After a very hectic day, we ordered dumplings and two entrees. The chicken was really good and generous portions.

A perfect bar. Not swamped, delicious snacks. Really dug the fried Jambalaya balls and the bahn mi po boy. The bartenders were gentlemen of an ilk not seen since the feudal days of chivalrous knights.
Incredible!  You have to try this place!

In less than 48 hours, I've tried the turkey and swiss, the pizza sandwich, and the roast beef-- all delicious!  I don't think I can pick a favorite, but adding the hot peppers gave my sandwiches today a nice kick.

Thank God Twin Dragon's replaced the old 'May May' restaurant which was filthy.  This NEW establishment is run by a very hard working family.  They are very friendly, sincere and polite. The food variety on the menu is excellent.  I have visited several times already and NEVER had a issue with their food.  Delivery is VERY fast also.  For those in doubt, give it a try and you will be pleasantly surprised.

Wow, shocked to find all the 5 star reviews. Are these fake? So this is what Blend on the Water is actually like .... Pros: * Venue comes across upscale * View is good but obstructed as you are on the ground level * Price Cons: * I had to go search for my server on several occasions * Food is heavy comfort food. It is not gourmet upscale dining * As others have mentioned, venue feels like it was designed like a nightclub. The roof is high and covered with mirror balls for instance. - Sitting there in the center, you feel like you are sitting on a temporary table in the center of a dance floor. Its uncomfortable. Overall this restaurant is a 2 star. it is definitely not a 5 star. If they had more servers, and had a decent Chef it would be a 4 star
Nice trendy spot to grab a drink!
Food is very good and the owners are incredibly nice. The best part for us is that it is kid friendly.  They have kids meals (I love that), highchairs and even TOYS!

A friend gave my me and my husband a gift certificate for this restaurant. A bit of a walk from our apt, but was worth going. Friendly, attentive service. Good wine selection (though I'm no connoisseur). Delicious lamb entree & brussel sprout side! Had a young vibrant clientele. Simple, cute decor giving the appropriate ambiance to let the food really shine!
I visit this place very often with my daughter and I must say their arepas are delicious and the service is pretty good too. I definitely recommend it

Best bartenders in New Haven. The food in the restaurant is just okay, and therefore overpriced, but it's worth it to take visitors there for the view. Brunch is good. However, the main reason to go is that it is a quiet, chill bar, where you can have a good drink prepared by excellent bartenders, enjoy a late-evening snack (the bar food is cheaper and better than the restaurant), and actually have a great conversation in comfortable chairs.
pretty loud on a sat night hard to have conversation but food was delicious!!!!! and fast would definitely recommend to arepa lovers

Last week I was spending some days in NYC when I came across Colicchio randomly, and I´m so happy I did! I was there with my boyfriend and I dont know which one of us was more enthusiastic about every single dish that we got on our tables. I particularly recommend the Loup the mer and the Milk-fed Porchetta. Every ingredient is super fresh and tasty, cant stress it enough!

Meh... went there after hearing all good things about it but i had my own feeling about it. first off the wait and the line just to get inside this place was crazy and i could barely find anyone to seat us. it took about 45 minutes to be sat which i do understand since it was Saturday night but there was a lack of order. After waiting we got sat and then had to wait another 15 minutes just to get our drink orders.... not to mention how long it took to get our drinks and food. if you're planning on going to Jose Tejas i strongly suggest either going on a week day or just simply going to the bar to get food and drinks. not a horrible place and the food was good but just a little un-organized and backed up to say the least
Always excellent...food is awesome. Loud, but fun :)

Fake-French, so it feels rather pretend for anyone who has actually spent time in Paris. However, if you're going out for a special occasion and are going to spend the money anyway, this is the place to go (or if you're going on Yale's dollar) because the food is quite good (although not everything is authentic). And when you do have a hankering for French food, this is your only option in New Haven, unless you do the right thing and cook at home.

Tasty pizza made with quality ingredients. It's a little pricey for specialty pies- but all organic, focused on local ingredients (because this is, of course, Vermont!) makes it worth it.  The crust is great and they have interesting topping combinations you'd never come up with - as well as the standards (margherita or pick-your-own).  Staff are really friendly - and, they sell by the slice!
We were avoided for what felt like an hour,when we finally were seated we were served promptly.We ordered a bacon and onion pizza and it was delicious.Would not wait in line again though

Great pizza that makes great left-overs. Only complaint is that it is all thin crust and the toppings slide off, which also means the pizza gets cold quickly, but it still tastes delicious. And if you take people who like a thicker crust, there's not really a good option for them. Take-out is a snap. They handle large orders well and quickly with no advanced notice (often a last-minute resort for large student-group gatherings).

Pretty decent bar with lots of people. It's nice and close to penn station so you can just have a drink before going home. Plus they always have the latest games on so it get pretty loud and rowdy here. I come here about once a week or so.

Love this place! It's a go-to brunch place for lots of us. But please, for the love of God, accept credit cards and/or do separate checks. It's the 21st century, folks. I can't tell you how many times we've REALLY wanted to go here, but ended up having to go somewhere else because most of the people in the group didn't have cash. So when we still want breakfast food but to pay with a credit card, we go to Four Brothers Diner on Dixwell. It's excellent.

Shout out to Derek!!!! Don't be in a rush, don't be uptight, let your attitude at the door and you'll have a great time. Food for brunch is very nice, not outstanding but solid. No food was left. They arrange for the picky-Frenchy-with-allergies that  I am (aka cobb Salad no chicken, no cheese, no dressing, no egg,... so they kindly added grilled shrimps!)! They should have a fish item on their menu, if they could though. But hey, their choice!   Derek our waiter was great. Seriously very friendly, helpful, and extremely funny!  I can thank him enough for my salad! He accidentally spilled 2 glasses - it happens people! - so we got 2 rounds on the house, he even offered dry cleaning (no need!), etc... We will be back for a low key group brunch! GREAT GREAT ATTITUDE-FREE SPOT!

I used to go here a lot with friends after work, but no longer. On two occasions it took over 2 hours for us to have dinner in a noisy environment. Never got our drinks refilled on one occasion (yes, they were alcoholic and we wanted to drink...they could've made a small fortune on us!). The other time, we were watching our waiter texting the entire time where he thought nobody could see. It usually took over 15 minutes just to get a beer... Beyond frustrating, so we don't go there anymore.

I enjoyed the food while reminiscing of being in the islands with every bite. The food was fresh and well seasoned. I've been a couple times and every so often the chef will get heavy handed on the hot spices. My food was so spicy one time, my tummy started hurting and throat swelled. HOWEVER, do not let that one experience stop you from visiting, just ask if it is spicy during the ordering process and they will let you know.

i love this place. have been in several times for a quick bite before the theater and everything from salads to soup to adventurous comfort food is fantastic... including burgers, of course. nothing seems to be an afterthought here and if everything isn't made from scratch the do one hell of a job covering it up. highly recommended!

Even though the portions are small, the food is really excellent, if a bit overpriced. The ZINC Kitchen behind it is really a great casual place for pizza and cocktails. Fast, friendly bartenders and a place to just chill with friends, although older patrons probably won't feel as welcomed. Has a 30-and-under vibe to it.

So basically I think the place just opened up. They have great salad and I ordered the shrimp. It was really good. They take their time and cook it. I drank sorrel. I love sorrel lol. It was actually good. Cool mellow place. They played Spanish music.

If you love bbq.  U will love this Place . Real fire and charcoal here. You have a choice in sauces mild  or hot  (I mix) . the chopped Bbq is also good. there sides need a little fix up but they work

Service sucks, actually it's non-existent. The guy wasn't very helpful at the counter when asking questions, but food is pretty decent. Then when I took out my debit card to pay for my $12 and change mixed gyro platter, the guy rudely said that there's a $20 minimum! I think he made that up because I did not see that posted anywhere. Usually the minimum is $5 or $10 for credit card. Then when the food came out it was packed up when I stated that my order was "for here" , another guy came out and tried to give me a paper plate and silverware. The napkin that had the silverware had orange oily stains on it... Posted a picture of it
It was weak.
This place when it does happy hour makes me grin from ear to ear i love the place  the food is delicious and the staff are friendly. 5 stars baby.
Service can be slow and it's a tight squeeze BUT food is great!! Can't beat their amazing $9 deal for 6 oysters and a drink!

WAY too loud. If you can get there when it's not packed, the food is good and so is the wine selection. But the best time to go (Sunday's with half-priced bottles) is too noisy for any conversation. Also, I don't know why, but I always get uncomfortably hit on here, which makes it feel really awkward. I think there are a lot of out-of-towners looking for a sleek bar to meet people while they stay at Omni...and it does serve that purpose. If they turned down the music and added some acoustic deadening, I'd be a regular. But I think they're wanting to sell the vibe that this place is happening. Great architecture.

I love when great new restaurants come to Brick City. The Atmosphere is welcoming & classy. I had the whole red snapper with yams & garlic green beans. It was excellent. I finished the whole fish. It was flavorful. I had a homemade sangria, that was good too. The service was great. The manager was very friendly and helpful. I love this new addition to the city. I will be coming back to try a new dish and introduce more family to Duke's.
Went here for my birthday .. The place is OKAY but I did leave there still hungry lol
I would definitely come back if i'm visiting soho again. Didn't get to try most of the dishes, but beef curry and stripped chicken breast noodle were great for hangover.

I wish I could review the chicken and the donuts separately, because they are two different worlds. I almost think that I must be having different donuts then everyone else here because honestly, these are disgusting. But I've tried them twice (at this location; never been to the others), and they were the same both times. When you squeeze them, grease oozes out; the bag is coated in a layer of I don't know what. I gave one to my wife and, after a single bite, she refused to continue. It's a shame because the flavors have potential; they're nothing incredibly creative but still better than your run-of-the-mill donut place. But ugh these things are bad. 1 star. At best. And like I said - the chicken was a different story. The chicken itself was moist and flavorful while the skin was crispy and comes with a variety of spices. I'm a fan! I'd give it 4/5 stars, just getting dinged on some consistency issues (the odd piece is dried out). The worst part about the chicken, though, is that it comes with a free donut. Which is bad enough that I think twice about going by to order the chicken! In sum: donuts=gross, chicken=amazing.

I've read about this place so many times and have never been yet. So after visiting my doctor I waddled my 8m pregnant self in and decided to give them a try. Best decision ever. I'm a turkey snob and if it isn't real turkey breast, then I don't want it. The people behind the counter were very friendly and made me feel at ease, as I know sometimes certain places have a well known ordering system that's isn't known to newbies like me. I got the "half" smoked turkey and Swiss. Half was huge 12"! Anyways, I'll be back next week after my doc appt!

I've been to this restaurant a number of times. Each time was a great experience! I have yet to experience all the dishes but my favorite so far is the molasses braised short ribs with a side of mashed potatoes, broccoli and cornbread. This dish has tons of flavor and very fulfilling in terms of portion size. All the waiters and staff are amazing but my favorite is Lawrence. He did a fantastic job with giving me the full SoCo experience!

Found this restaurant on Yelp with a moderate 3$ rating.  The food was incredible.  We are both of Italian decent and yet we loved the food and the service was just so good.  When you arrive you get appetizers without even ordering them (grilled spicy peppers, salami and cheese as well as some fried veggies that were exquisite and crunchy.  We both ordered a main course and the portions were too large to finish.  The bottle of wine they recommended worked perfectly for our taste and the cappuccino and ricotta cake was great as well.  Top it off with a home made fig grappa that I wasn't charged for and it made for a perfect meal. Will return and will tell my friends and work acquaintances about it.

I live close to the downtown Ippudo and decided to try it one Monday evening.  There always seems to be a line so I figured it is worth a try.  We arrived at 9:30 and had to wait about 1/2 hour for a table for 3.  While waiting we tried a pork bun which was very tasty.  The atmosphere is quite busy.  The service was quick since they need to turn around tables fast.  The ramen was fine.  Would I wait more than 1/2 hour to be seated.  Probably not, the bar area was quite small.  I would go back but try to time it when it wasn't quite so crowded.

This place is awesome!!! I have never written a review but they do deserve it. I been going to this establishment for a while, and I always leave satisfied. The design is amazing, authentic Japanese style. I usually order the chicken buns as an appetizer and for the main I take the soba (da!)v great restaurant, Im not surprise that they have over than 6k reviews on yelp.
loved it

Joe installed an outdoor Tantenna on my house in Brooklyn, NY.  I found him helpful, professional, efficient, courteous and knowledgeable.  Not only that but he was on time.  And he even called me the next day to make sure that everything was working properly.  I will certainly call him again for other projects.  I can't recommend him highly enough!

Recently opened brewery that offers great food and good craft beer. I ate the Rustic pizza, my friend had the Adult Grilled Cheese, and another friend had the Cheeseburger. All of the food was phenomenal. They have these pretzel fondue bites that were delicious. I plan on going back several times, both for lunch and at happy hour.

It's never busy at this restaurant for lunch. I always get seated quickly, and the hostess will usually give you a nice window seat. Unlike most places the waiter will let you sit and talk without much disturbance. The only downfall is on a day when you have obligations to go somewhere after, and your kind of waiting thinging..ok i want to leave now.. The food is always really hot, which is how i like my food. Sizzlinggg. The deep dish pizza is my favorite so I always order it. its always crispy and made just right.
Warm beer. Horrible service

The Eddy is fully deserving of all these good reviews. The food and service is exceptional. Ordered one plate of oysters for starters. They were so good we ordered a second. Scallops were delicious too. For mains I ordered the gnocchi and my gf ordered the ribeye - seriously good - and perfectly matched with the Brunello di Montalcino. Our waiter Bill was really knowledgeable and pleasant. Just what you want in a waiter.

I absolutely looooooved this place! The food was excellent and the drinks were fabulous. I had the salmon. It was flaky, buttery, and fresh! The portions were nice. I had this drink special with 3 different kinds of saki...Delicious. In my Arnold Schwarzenegger voice, "I'LL BE BAHCK!"
Love this place! Excellent tikka masala. Love the food, ambiance, service, and prices are good.

I had heard good things and when I finally made it there to eat, I was not disappointed. My friend and I both chose to be surprised by the chef's tasting menu. I really liked the food selections and that they took into account our preferences. Service was great and the infused tequilas were interesting- I will be back to try again!

Marra's is a staple lunch at my house at least once a week. while I'm there I always grab an entree to make for quick dinner later on in the week. The owner might be the sweetest woman I have ever met in my life. She is always greets me with such kindness. The food is amazing. I have never had anything I didn't like. It sticks close to my grandmothers cooking and I like that it makes me feel at home.

It's...okay. Not the best in the world...  Modern tastes better and has faster service. We stopped going to Pepe's as much because they always have such a huge wait. Next time another property in the neighborhood opens up, they should definitely buy it and have an additional dining room on the weekends. If you really want to try it, just go for an early lunch when they open and you'll get a seat and delicious pizza (with less of the black char, if you don't like that).

This is my favorite Italian place in all of  northern NJ!!  I have been there several times and I was never disappointed.  The food is always consistent, real good fresh Italian.  The owner Pasquale is so friendly. You feel like your in Italy with the ambience and music of this place. Its BYOB and make a reservation as this place is always packed.
Un endroit simple, typique, agréable, sympathique et un service convivial.... À ne pas rater !!!!   Merci
