So at this point my mom's guest are getting annoyed and now my moms friend approaches the desk to ask if we can just split the party because at this point people just want to eat and don't even care anymore and the "store owner " pops up putting his shitty ass two sense so I intervene and kindly explain to him that he shouldn't speak to his costumers in such tone and that I am speaking very calm and nicely so he should to and he then tells me "well that is how I talk, if you don't like it you can leave, how about that." He then says I was accusing him of being rude, which he was. & then tells me to leave his restaurant and to have my name crossed off the list. . I was sooooooo shocked I have never been so insulted. It took everything in me not to cause a scene in front of my mom. MOST DISRESPECTFUL DIRTY MONEY MAKING PLACE I HAVE EVER DEALT WITH. No matter how much money you make how many customers you get if your customer service sucks and you could careless you will GET NOWHERE. Respect is everything & for us to wait for 2 1/2 hours just to be kicked out on my mothers birthday was beyond disrespectful. They didn't even want to give a pregnant woman a damn chair smh. As a grow ass man, that was so distasteful.  I believe in karma and God and that guy should really count his blessing. Smh, never in my life would I ever eat there again. So unfortunate cause they really make great food. But no, I will not help pay the Devils bills. No cuban Pete's for me or my company !

Keep going back.  Best Turkey dinners on Sunday throughout the year (don't have to wait til Thanksgiving).  Always a baked potato after 4:00PM any day of the week. Friendly staff and manager,  Conor, is there to greet and make all welcome.  It is a relaxing place to have lunch, dinner or a light snack ..or on some days just dessert!

We came here for a birthday brunch on a blustery NY Sunday. We had a reservation, yet the obnoxious hipster host made us wait outside. When we asked if our 3 freezing kids could wait inside, we were told no. We finally did get our table, after about 10 minutes. Not a bad wait, except we were standing in the cold. Our table was too small for our party, yet they didn't correct it for us. We sat squished. It's better to have them tell you what they do have here, because they are missing a lot of basics. No Diet Coke. The smug waitress informed me they only carry regular. For the kids- no apple juice, no chocolate milk, no lemonade. And despite this being a brunch place, no hot cocoa or Bloody Mary. Food was ok. Not spectacular. My husband's order was wrong and they didn't bring him his correct meal for another 20 minutes. The kid's mac & cheese was very good. We split the order between 2 kids. Overall, the food wasn't good enough to make the obnoxious and horrible service worth it. I will not return.
The waiters are very friendly! I ordered spring roll and pai thai, they are awesome and taste different than the other thai u might probably have

I have been coming here with my girlfriend since they opened last year.  Phenomenal tacos, burritos, nachos.  Stand outs are the pollo and al pastor options.  Extra salsa bar is a perfect touch to make every experience special. The staff is friendly and attentive which is few and far between off St. Mark's.  I hope this place sticks around as it has gained a full time position in my EV food rotation. Thank you Diana
One of my favorite restaurants of all time. Great food, great people, great atmosphere.

I want to love this place. Great quiet downtempo townie vibe but every time I'm in here the bartender is completely checked out from serving the people sitting at the bar and it takes me 10+ minutes to get the check or another round.

We ordered delivery this weekend and it was the first time ordering from Fortissimo. Everything was awful. Their "famous" penne vodka had no flavor and the calamari smelled so bad that we were afraid to eat it. The pizza was ok, but I could have microwaved a frozen pizza with more flavor. With so many italian restaurants in the area, I suggest that you choose another one. Don't choose Fortissimo.

The Place is very homey; Food is outstanding, verity of selections I had most of them Soups, Fresh Juices, Fresh Make Sandwiches, and Cakes and Dinner specials. Gluten free. Non GMO, Organic, Dairy Free Vegan even wild caught Fish or Meat. I highly recommending this place to anyone who wants to dine healthy foods.  I am Dr. Luman, this place will be our home away from my home.

Amazing food. Really fresh and well cooked. Had jumbo prawns and mac n cheese with sweet potato fries. All on the recommendation of the hostess. Place is mega loud but that's the deal. Worth the ferry ride and walk to find it. Friendly staff and good atmosphere.

We visited Pasticceria Bruno last evening for dinner. It was, indeed, a fantastic dining experience. Our server, Adam, could not have been more pleasant! He was very familiar with the wine list, as well as the menu. We each chose a pasta special with two types of clams and crab meat. It was delicious and, of course, we had some to take home.

Have to agree with John P. review 100%. Majority of the platter was all rice and fries. Not enough servings of meat. I don't get the amazment on flavor. It's not something you can't make at home guys. Probably you'll do better lol.  Can't really feed a family without having to buy extra platters in order to get the right amount of meat for everybody. Get's expensive...ending up with rice and beans for a week. Staff is charming though. Had fun chatting with them.

YOU MUST GO!! when in Manhattan. Plane ,train or bus you must stop here for lunch or just for espresso, cappuccino and taking all in all the different pastas , all the seafood ,meats ,OMG and the cheeses and bread the bread is the best it is a foodies paradise. Ciao and Enjoy.

Well I had a bad experience here.  We had to work there one night for a party and the room manager of that night ( he was very tall, old man) was very rude and disrespectful. He came up to us to turn of the music 10 minutes before the party ended in a nasty way he spoke to us. I told him in a respectful manner we have 10 min left and the customer that paid for this room requested this record, please let the client know you want the music off. He started yelling and we had a exchange of words , he even tried to pull the cables out of the socket while the music was playing,, he was crazy !!!! I told the client and then he had an exchange of words with the manager. THIS WAS UNPROFESSIONAL !!!....from that manager, how do you take money form a client and cheat them out of their time and be rude to the clients.
Great service, Delicious food, and I can't wait to eat there again.

Yes. Now that I have tried nearly everything on the menu I feel it's time to lay it all out there. I love this place. Great casual neighborhood pizza place with great staff who clearly love and rep the food. Pizza: excellent texture and balance of sauce, cheese, toppings, spice, fat, crunch, love. Some masterfully executed classics like the margherita, as well as some delicious twists on classics like the huitlacoche pie. But don't stop there. The menu offers cured meats, cheeses, small plates, amazing salads (BLT salad!) and more. Brunch is wonderful (brunch hater here). The smoked trout and eggs is a go-to for me but on the rougher mornings, the sausage sandwich or a breakfast pie hits the spot. I plan on making this place a twice-thrice weekly stop.
A brilliant concept! Everything tastes very fresh, the burger was perfectly done. The pesto sauce is to die for!!

Love this place, one of my all time favorites. Always fresh and delicious food that tastes like it was made by your neighbor and not a restaurant. A few recommendations are the eggplant salad, shepherd salad, and fried liver is amazing. For main courses I've had the chicken and shish combination, Adana, and their steak and they were all superb!

Went for brunch.  Food was so-so.  Service was absolutely terrible.  When our food was delivered, pancakes,  omlets, etc. we asked for two things for the food, jelly for the pancakes and salt and pepper for the omlets. The waiter said they had very few salt and pepper shakers, and No jelly. He said that he couldn't take the time to look for them.  I guess they really don't need the business.
great service, great food and a charming atmosphere

My friend and I came here for a quick pre-theater dinner. And at 6pm, the place was packed. The music together with the quaint old films projecting (Grease!) on the brick wall kept us well entertained during our short evening here. We tried their green pasta with shrimp. This pasta tasted really fresh. Although there were only 4 pieces of shrimp, that too was perfectly cooked and so juicy. Together with the cream sauce, this whole dish was just fantastic. Our only gripe was the service - While waiting for our table to be set up, we were at the bar and had ordered drinks that had not been made. During this time, one of the staff started showing us to our table. I alerted her that our drinks had not arrived. So she offered this peculiar piece of advice: One of us should wait for the drinks at the bar and bring them over ourselves later, while another should follow her to the table. Isn't this strange??? I've been to several restaurants, and they've invariably offered to bring our drinks to the table whenever this happens. Also, throughout our meal, we were offered food that we did not order, THREE times. Perhaps this is some elaborate marketing strategy to get us to order more food. I hope this restaurant straightens out their service issues soon, before I come back again for their green pasta!

The hype is all worth it. We came here around 11am Sunday for brunch with an hour wait for 2 ppl, however with plenty of tables ready to go outside under heaters, it was a no brainier (not sure why others waited outside next to tables instead of sitting and eating there?) Coffee was amazing and food was indescribable. We had poached eggs with tomato and haloumi (amazing!) and the Shakshuka (also amazing!). We also had a side of duck bacon which was so flavorsome. Waiter was fast, reliable, polite and awesome. Def a great start to the day and highly recommended!

Excellent food, excellent service. Kim, the bartender, made the best margarita I've had in I don't know how long. Erin, our waitress, was easily the best server I've had in Philly. The food was complex, rich, and delicious. I think V Street might be the best vegan restaurant in Philly.

Had a great dinner here on Friday night. I had the chicken parm and my wife had one of the fish specials. Portions were perfect, flavors were top notch, and service was great. The atmosphere was very welcoming, as well. Great meal from beginning to end. We will be back!

Went to the Montville Inn last night.  Its a nice enough atmosphere but that's where it ends.  Service is mediocre at best.  Ordered an appetizer that was full of salt.  Service people there are friendly but incompetent.  Never received our dinner because the server forgot to place the order.  After an hour of waiting we paid our check and left.  It seems like there are far too many people working there but nothing is getting done.  Unfortunate because it is a nice venue. Just needs a good manager.  The wait staff stands around talking to each other and not attending to their customers.  I've been there before and had the same experience.  Won't be going back.
Overpriced, not really authentic, and they milk you everywhere they can. On The flip side, service was great!

My partner and I paid a visit to Claire's Corner Copia yesterday evening while we were in New Haven for the day.  I had heard a lot about this place for some time, and we stumbled upon it while walking 'round in the rain post-concert and decided to give the place a spontaneous last-minute go instead of the more pricier options in the 'hood. The one thing I immediately noticed was, there were so many options to choose from; it was quite overwhelming admittedly! [but in a good way]  It should be noted that Claire's is a vegetarian place, but they can and will accommodate vegan substitutions, if you ask them. I wound up ordering the Enchiladas de la Casa [gluten-free] sans the organic fried egg as my main dish for dinner.  I found it quite appetizing and the serving was generous and ample. They supply you with complimentary bread with your meal, and it should be noted that the rolls are HUGE!  They gave us two, which was plenty for my partner's lentil soup and for my enchilada.  I also ordered a Kale-a-bunga smoothie and it was to my palate and liking; not too tart, not too sweet. Before leaving, we brown-bagged a slice of their Lithuanian coffee cake, which is one of their dessert specialities which was good, also. Last aside:  if you need to use the restroom, you will have to flag a waiter/waitress down so they can open it up for you because they keep the facilities under strict lock and key. The folks who worked behind the counter seemed to be warm, patient and helpful also. If and when I return to New Haven, I'll most certainly give Claire's another go!  Enjoy folks and happy eating! :]

I love Reading Terminal Market!  It literally has anything and everything you are looking for.  I sometimes go just to look around, and I probably go there every weekend.  I love the falafel place and Bee Natural , which has honey chapstick, candles, soap, and regular honey.  So many surprises like really cheap produce and a used bookstore.

I tried this place for the first time hoping for a good burger option in-town. The service was slightly slow but friendly. However, the food was so underwhelming I didn't even finish my burger. I order a classic Cheeseburger, nothing fancy... the patty was pretty bland with not much of a texture. I would rate at slightly better than McDo but worse than Wendy's(wouldn't even make it to the tier of In-N-Out, Five Guys ...) The cheese was not melted on the patties like I am used in almost all of the cheeseburgers I used to it (around 2-3 a week this summer). The bun was meh but compared to the patties, it wasn't that bad. Even the sauteed onions were pretty raw. I just couldn't finish half my burger. The MilkShake was another fail. It is marketed as made from "Real Ice-Cream" but it must be among the worst milkshakes I had in a while and I thought I had pretty bad/cheap ones. All in all, I was hoping for a decent burger joint but this is nowhere near to fill that gap. For now, I will have to settle for Cheeburger Cheeburger.

Bad service and bad food! They gave cold soup. I order a milk shake, they gave chocolate milk. We had about 20 in our group meals came all over the place! All i order was a BLT! I gave up waiting for it! Drive right by this place!!

I'm now leaving the actual restaurant and I just ate and paid the bill and was literally asked to leave. By a young man who is in the pictures I just posted. Food was great, drinks were OKAY, service was horrible, we got here at 3:30 and waited to to eat actual dinner that wasn't serve red until 5 we ate ordered a few more drinks, and were told that a reservation was coming and that we basically had to leave. I've never in my life experienced service that way, the man told us "no rush but we have a reservation with tables we have to fill soon". Of course after we paid our bill were asked to leave. HORRIBLE SERVICE with this man in the photo.

My boyfriend and I had brunch here the other day. My cucumber jalapeño margarita was very nicely made and the service was good. I ordered the kale and mango salad (with honey almonds and lime dressing - sounded delicious). The server came back and said it had been replaced with a kale and quinoa salad instead, is that ok? Ever the fan of both kale and quinoa, i said sure. What I got was old, dry kale with a little bland, boiled quinoa mixed in with sliced red cabbage. I began to pick the yellowed, spotted kale from my salad. Now I didn't say anything when the server came to ask how it was which was wrong, in retrospect, I should have however, she could visibly see the pile of yellow kale leaves I was gathering on a dish and the mostly uneaten salad that remained on my plate. I think maybe just going for drinks is ok but I would not eat there again. When a place that serves food is ok serving food that's gone bad, better not to eat there.

I got a yelp account just to write this review. I was really disappointed with everything, we ordered two servings of chicken and waffles and a Tomato soup. The tomato  soup was terrible, it was really watery and tasteless. As for the chicken and waffles the chicken had no flavor you had to drench it in the syrup to make it taste like something although that something is not that great either. And to top it all off one of the chicken and waffle servings was all bones NOT worth the $18. Out of all the places I've gone to have chicken and waffles in the city this has been the worst and most expensive.

Food was very good. Service was a bit slow. But my  one star rating was because of what I saw today. The owner/manager was annoyed at one of his employees for whatever reason and was ridiculing him asking if he's hard of hearing and if something was wrong with his hearing. It made me uncomfortable - and i don't get uncomfortable easily - and got me mad someone was talking so down to someone - especially in front of the customers. I told them my complaint and left. Needless to say, even though the food was good, I won't be coming back and giving business to such a guy.  He needs to watch an episode of restaurant impossible and learn better.
used to eat here all the time.  the place has gone down hill.  however, the icing on the cake is the 90+ minute wait to get my food delivered.

Great late night pizza delivery we ordered at 1 am while we were staying at La quinta in on Route 3. It took about 30 min and they came right up to our door. about $16 for a small plain pie and 2 drinks. Pizza was good very fresh crust was toasty  and fluffy lol.  Totally worth it.

I love tapas. I love that my taste bud can go through so many experiences in one sitting. Amada is a great place to go for tapas because they are so accommodating. My bf and I got a free dish on the house. We also got out plate of olives for free because it came out late. Lots of complimentary dishes. Go and have an adventure with your palate.

Visited this restaurant the other day with some friends.  Took forever for the three of us to get our food which was rather pricey.  Beef brisket was decent nothing to write home about.  Mac and cheese was bland and the cinnamon apples were surprising since they were a step down from the ones at Boston market.  Corn bread was extremely dry I couldn't even eat it.  I tried the 4 sauces that were available and was not impressed.  Will not eat here again.

The food would've been alright had it not come an hour late/soggy/cold. The tacos were all mixed up in the box, and the tortillas were hard and cold. I had ordered chips with guacamole as well -- received the guac and NOT the chips. Definitely would not order from here again and do not recommend. Hopefully it is better to dine in.

Yasuda is supposed to to be one of the best in NYC. I amazed to get a rezzy here last minute at the bar but was completely underwhelmed with the quality for price point. I literally had my own personal sushi chef waiting hand and foot for me but the cuts of the fish were small and the variety didn't blow me away. I always gauge edomae style sushi on the cut sizes and how many new fish I get to try. Sadly I've had more "first times" in places a quarter of the price. I ate $180 worth with disappointment. All hype.

This is a destination stop.  There's no other way to say it.  Diners Drive In and Dives are you out there?   The pizza is just amazing - the owner is awesome and actually cares about the food he serves.   If you like pizza and live on earth then try this place.

Good food and nice atmosphere.  I found it to be very reasonably priced, which can be hard to find in NYC. Not a very romantic spot but a good place to grab some good food.  A bit too dark for my taste tho. Hard to see the menu.

My wife and I follow Chip and Tina anywhere they go Chip is the best chef of the new generation of American chefs A very  talented chef. Tina is a great wine  sommelier She is amazing  We always let her pair the wine The Simone is now our Fav in NYC       The decor is simple but elegant The lighting is defused and pleasant The staff is very attentive and friendly Love  it
I ordered take out because the wait was too long. But, the salmon benedict was great!

Five stars for the crap meat soup dumpling! It's perfect on a cold day in NY. I personally prefer the crab meat over the regular, or they call it the kungfu dumpling. Everything else on the menu was mediocre- like the spicy wonton and fried tofu vermicelli. Don't bother ordering the spring rolls. I was so disappointed I paid $3.95 for 3 mini spring rolls the size of my tiny fingers with no fillings. Unlike other restaurants in the east village, I was seated even though the rest of my party was not there yet!

Rude service, saw cook push down garbage with same gloves used to handle food, left after a single glass of wine.  Food tastes good but after seeing how unclean the kitchen was, quickly lost appetite.

I'm torn between giving a 2 or 3 stars. The idea of Tilt is awesome but I left feeling a disappointed in general. The food and beer choices had a "farm to table" feel but in all reality it was an overpriced hipster hangout with subpar food. The beer list behind the bar was hard to read from the tables and apparently outdated. The waitress had to pull up a "more accurate list" on her personal phone for all of us to read from. The menu promised something local and possibly unique but came out lack luster. The venison burger that my fiancé ordered was rare and tasteless, his side of German potato salad  had almost crunchy potatoes because they were under cooked. My pulled chicken sandwhich had no smoked or "pulled" flavor I doubt it was truly made in a traditional manner. I found 2 pieces of grizzle and 2 bones in it. One bone was so pointed it could of pierced the roof of my mouth or gums if I had bit wrong. I was pulling the last bone out of my mouth as the waitress came by, she put out her hand to offer to take it which felt a little awkward. She then dismissed it like it was something I should expect. If we go back it will be only for a brew and some classic fun. My suggestion is eat elsewhere.?

I so wanted to love this place after hearing great things but sadly not so on my visit. Went for brunch with a friend and reservations at 1 - no wait. And the place is cute-small but nice. They were out of duck bacon hash so I got the corned beef hash. Sadly, it was more potatoes and onions than hash. The hash was minuscule. I have gotten bigger portions at a local diner brunch.   We ordered orange juice and had to ask for it twice before they brought it over to the table.  No one asked us if we wanted bread. My friend had the lobster frittata. We both enjoyed the food but the service was really poor. Won't be coming back anytime soon
Great food at amazing prices. The Panang Curry is the best I have ever had. The drunken noodles were really good but the curry is the reason to go back.
Awesome ramen! Its a small little place and always have to wait, but it's totally worth it.
Wonderful food and service!! Great filet mignon and duck confit!! The escargots were also amazing! Best wine bar! Wonderful staff as well :)

Please don't go here if you are looking for fast service or "fancy" decor. The wait is long and the place is cozy. The food is AMAZING. I find myself daydreaming about it randomly. I usually get the tomato/mozz salad, chicken parm and shrimp oreganata and you can't beat it. Seriously. My mouth is watering just from writing this.

I placed my order and was told my food would arrive in 30 minutes.  After an hour and 20 minutes I called and was told the food would be there in 5 minutes.  The man I spoke to hung up on me before I could ask to cancel the order.  The food finally did arrive 15 minutes later and was cold. I called to ask for a refund.  I spoke to one man who told me he would credit me the entire amount.  Then suddenly i was speaking to another person who told me they were crediting me 15%.  In the end I paid $28 for soggy samosas and cold chicken.   Errors happen, but they won't earn any more of my business if this is the way they view customer service.

I've been to this place once before and it was good so decided to go back. We ended up going at a really busy time which is good for the business but instead of putting our name down on the list and telling us how long the wait would be, they refused to take our name down saying they are full now and we have to come back in 2 hrs to put our name down. I've never heard of such practice... They were being so rigid and weren't making much sense... Need some work in the service department.
We've been coming to Grid Iron since it's been open. It's one of favorite breakfast/brunch spots in the area. The staff usually spoils us :)

Got robbed ! Ordered seafood salad. They said it was nice size. I paid $25 for 2 shrimp 1 small lobster tail the size of my thumb and minimal crabmeat. I only wished I checked it before I sent delivery boy away. I haven't ordered from Godfathers in a while..I guess I won't again. So disappointed

My husband and I went there for dinner and were very disappointed in the service. The restaurant was not packed, but had a nice amount of guests, yet it took over an hour to get our dinner and when it came out finally one the dishes wasn't cooked thoroughly. In addition, it took at least 10 min to get water and bread when we arrived! The server took the uncooked meal off our bill, but didn't think to go above and beyond with more of a discount or anything. It's unfortunate when a place like that has good food, but doesn't have the customer service necessary for us to feel we'd go back.
food is to die for. Cash only and no reservations but when it's this good they can do that
I've had some great meals and drinks at Garces Trading Co! I'm still drooling over their homemade mozzarella. Their price point however leaves a less than desired taste in my mouth.

This place is seriously to die for. The flavor of the broth is amazing, I think the best I've ever had. I also tried the steamed fish appetizer and ribs which were so tasty. My husband and I chose to sit at the counter which also made it a great experience as we watched the time and effort that went into every meal, it was just amazing to watch how all the chefs worked together so quickly; seeing how your food is made really makes you appreciate it even more. Yes, it's loud, but that doesn't bother me. Also, you'll wait about 45 min for a table but it's worth the wait, just grab a drink with a friend at the bar and the time will pass quickly. Hope you enjoy it as much as I did!

Best sandwich shop in the area!  Advice:  Call you order in ahead of time.  There will probably be a wait.  Fresh sandwich (yes, a little over priced), but its not like you are eating there everyday.  Parking is a little tight, the building isn't much to look at but don't let that deter you from grabbing a bite to eat.  It can get a little crowded and there aren't many tables, so you may want to plan on taking you sandwich to go.  If you like turkey/bacon and honey mustard with fresh veggies - order the DOCTOR.

My roommate and I got food poisoning here. We left to go to a show at the Troc and could barely stand and threw up every ten minutes. When her boyfriend called to give the place a heads up (in case others were effected), it seemed like they didn't care and rushed off the phone. Will not be returning.
Absolute worst sub shop I have ever been to.  Plenty of other places in the area to go to.  Prices are high and the good quality is poor.

Real ingredients, fun staff, and the best pizza on Earth! Our waiter was funny, he told us to put away our phones, but then took a photo of us with the pizza and surprised us with free dessert, not just any dessert, CANNOLI!!! Stop reading reviews, just go you won't regret it. It is worth the wait, the line is long but the pizza is worth it. I am back in California and my friends thought it would be a good idea to get pizza from a local place, after Grimaldi's no other pizza will ever compare!
Not at all what I expected. Came here for a surprise party and was disappointed in the quality of the food.

As a huge fan of these guys first spot Manhattan proper in TriBeCa  I decided I had to come check out proper west their new location and I was not disappointed! Their downtown spot will always be my home as a fidi resident. But I will be sure to make it back whenever I find myself in midtown!

Used to enjoy their pizza. But the other night I ordered delivery from them. 90 minutes later I called to check on my order. I could tell they were scrambling on the other end of the phone because they had forgotten my order. It finally came 2 hrs and 8 minutes after I made the initial call. Note that I live 8 blocks away from Little Italy Pizza. I called and asked if they had a policy to refund part of my order. They said no! (His literal words were, "What do you want me to do guy?") I unfortunately won't be ordering from them again.

Order a grilled cheese and you will receive two pieces of cold cheese between cold toast slices. Yours for only $9. Order hot chocolate and you will receive Swiss Miss Instant ($4), the waiter will spill it on your date's white pants and not even offer her a napkin. Order an omelet and you will not receive silverware. Order tea and you will receive neither sugar nor milk. Order home fries and they won't have it despite being on half the items on the menu. Ditto bacon. French fries will be at minimum 75% inedible. Hand them a credit card and you will receive a description of the nearest ATM. A great place if you're on a diet, as you will not want to eat your food, if it arrives at all. Oh, and they LOVE southern rock, as in full Creedence Clearwater Revival concerts (with applause) played on loop, at ear-bleed levels, even when you ask them to turn it down. So if you don't like who you're dining with and don't want to hear them talk, and you don't like food and never want to eat it again (though you still want to pay high prices for it), this is definitely your new favorite place. Congratulations.
Greasy pizza and very very slow delivery
Simply the best. We don't live in New Haven, but make a point to step here whenever we are passing through.

Although food is pretty good, I was very disappointed by the rudeness of their waitress Emma. When you forget your customers' order (which is ok, it happens) I don't think you should call them off in front of the whole restaurant, blame them for your mistake and say things like "oh so you think you're perfect, really?". I understand her job can be difficult and frustrating, but she should keep in mind that it is not appropriate to treat customers that way, and her attitude was insulting and totally uncalled for. However, I would like to add that I didn't have to pay for what I ordered, which I appreciated. Nevertheless, I hope the restaurant management will do something to prevent their customers to be treated that way in the future.

The one was for our server who was good. No stars for the food. My pancakes were cold I asked for egg and cheese. The cheese was plopped on top of my eggs not cooked in.. When I informed them  they offered me cake. Why would I want cake? It was my first time there and will be my last. Very very disappointed.

Everything about this restaurant is amazing!!! First off, the place is beautiful with a classy and sophisticated decor, a wonderful bar (try some of the drinks created by one of the bartenders... forgot her name), and a unique and interesting open kitchen... you'll even find the bathroom to be an interesting experience. It's obvious that they spared no expense when they designed and built this place. As for the staff and service, they are among the best I've experienced at any restaurant I've ever been to. They are courteous, friendly, attentive, extremely knowledgable and very accommodating. On my most recent visit I was served by Jason Ferrer who did an outstanding job, and when there was a minor issue, it was quickly addressed and rectified by the very helpful manager Brian. Finally, the food... delicious, delicious, delicious! I've been there at least a dozen times and every meal has been excellent! I'm particularly a big fan of the "chef's tasting". I initially tried the restaurant, and the chef's tasting, utilizing a voucher that I purchased on Groupon. Since then, I have taken advantage of these exceptional offers for the chef's tasting from both Groupon and Living Social a number of times, even giving several as gifts. They have even extended the same deal when I've been there with additional diners. But I must say that the chef's tasting is well worth it, and a must try, even at the regular price. It's comprised of five courses, with each of the first four courses made up of different dishes to be shared based on the number of diners... by the way, they will accommodate special requests, allergies, etc. and will even let you try the peshwari naan if you ask. As a result, I've had the opportunity to try numerous different dishes and a symphony of flavors. Every dish I've tried has been consistent, absolutely delicious and never disappointing. If you haven't been there, I highly recommend you try it. If you have been there, I strongly encourage you to experience the chef's tasting. Unforgettable!!!
Porcini Flan is awesome, nice gin cocktails as well. The bread cart is amazing and almost ruined my appetite! The wine paring was a tad lacking, but still worth it.
Roti Canai + fish porridge is really good. Some of the beef curry is also good.
Fantastic food! will be back again.

My friend and I wanted to check this place out since it's nearby and opens till 4 am (which is awesome) however, we were extremely disappointed with the food and service.  The ambience and whole set up has a great feel to it. I love a place with candles and mason jars, it definitely adds a certain charm. I also loved that they had a exclusive menus based on the season (8-10 items)  Saying all that, we got there at 9, the bar was semi busy but the rest of the restuarant wasn't, seeing that there was barely any other customers, you would think the service would be reasonable quick. First of, the waiter took forever to take our order. (We both order the Home made beef burger) Then after waiting for 45 mins, he then decides to mention that they had to re make our burgers fresh again! I don't get what happened to it the first time but after waiting for soo long, he then mentions that they're just starting to make it! Since we were starving we decided to wait. Finally, after a total of 1 hr and 15 mins, burgers show up. Esthetically, they look delicious, a little cheap with the salad and would have loved if they had some chips or fries on the side. Anyway, after all that, it was the most peppery tasting burger I've ever had. The pepper flavor was very overwhelming however the patty was cooked nice and juicy. Pretty disappointing dinner experience altogether.
We went during restaurant week and it was amazing ! Authentic food and great service!
They serve good and cheap food! Will stop by for a $6 chicken & lamb over rice anytime I'm looking for something priced reasonably in NYC! :)

What a disaster. Waited 29 minutes for chips and dip  (which are a joke). The smallest cold dip and a tiny amount of crisps. How can you charge $6 for that? The waiter was rude and forgot to put the rest of our order through. This place is nothing like it used to be.

There's a reason that this place has been in business for so long ! We had crab meltaways, New England Clam Chowder and sliders. Food was AWESOME !   Very reasonably priced - two of had a great lunch with two beers each for around $60.00. Way too much to choose from on the menu, I plan to get back here more often.

First time at this place.  The food is awesome.  We had to drop a friend off at the Newark airport, and always are looking for some pho.  The broth was by far the best I have had. The spring rolls were very meaty and pleasant to the palate.  I will definitely visit again in the near future.
Xenophobia and racism aside, Geno's is still sub-par at best.
love this place great to bring visitors from out of town. really get a feel for Philadelphia this way. Something is always happen here. always buzzing.

Came here early July for breakfast with a family of five based on the reviews. Don't know what all the hype is about. The food was average at best , the waiter messed up the orders , the line for the one toilet is unacceptable for a restaurant with this many covers. Don't bother !

Went here for dinner with friends and we all had a bad experience.  The food was not good.. I ordered an eggplant pasta dish and it was horrible.. had barely any eggplant, all skin!  The service was very slow and our party agreed the food was not worth the price.  To boot, I told them the meal was not good and said it was all skin and no eggplant, and they said "sorry" but did not offer a new dish or anything.  would not got back!!

We had the chef's tasting menu and were pleased overall. For me each dish was just a notch over salted but my husband felt it was fine. The sunchoke purée was fantastic and the scallop was cooked perfectly. Service was impeccable- not just attentive but warm as well.
Best Brunch in NYC. Try their pancakes.. And their bacon cant be beat. Its usually an hour plus wait but well worth it!!

Wow!! Really love the New Kings Pizza!! Since the new owners took over the pizza quality has improved 200%!! I also recently started getting delivery, the veal parm was off the chain! I stop in for a slice at least two times a week now, I can't wait till the new dinning room is complete so the family can go there! Looks like we can even have a small party right there in the back.

Absolutely delicious!   I didn't find one thing that I didn't like. We had Brussel Sprouts and the lobster in the small plates section along with their house made pasta with pork and duck breast with farro.  Everything was cooked to perfection.  Staff was also attentive and courteous.  Be sure not to pass on the bread also made in house.  It was a very enjoyable meal.  Also good value for what you're served. My husband and I look forward to returning upon our next visit to VT.

The restaurant is pretty - lots of roses everywhere. But as it was supposed to be a girls night out it may note have the right tone for what we were looking for. A great place if anyone is planning to propose to their love one!! The good is lovely - quite a nice selection of tapas and the portions are in acceptable sizes too. The place is a bit too dark for my liking - then again if you're hoping to make that marriage proposal, this would make an ideal place for it!
Inconsistent.Some days food is great other days mass produced.Coq au vin sauce once sublime ,second and third times out of a package.Very,very,very loud.Still a welcome newcomer to Lincoln center.

I have been here twice in 5 days, both times excellent service and even better food. ALL the chicken is white breast meat. The soups are to die for. The $6.55 lunch specials are large enough to share if you buy an appetizer $5 with use your yelp check in coupon for  homemade ice tea enough for 2 as well, and you're out the door for under $6/person. How they make any enough $ to pay employees is beyomd me, especially ones that can cook so well. Only 2 negatives are 1) its 40 miles from home and 2) I can't stomache going to my local americanized chinese fast food shops near me now, when I know how good it can be...As a customer I'm a picky bastard so getting 5 stars out of me is almost unheard of... getting it twice in 5 days NEAR HAPPENED BEFORE..it was so good I got 4 lunch specials to go just to tide me over till my next biweekly trip to woodbridge area..next rime I may jist order a party tray amd bring it home and freeze it...

I went here the other night with a big group of friends.  We waited for a group table and and got a few drinks.  Great beer on tap.  When we got our table our server was on point. Kept our drinks filled and took the order in a timely fashion. Food was spectacular.  Salads, pizzas, you name it we got it. Nice work!!

I am always completely satisfied with my experience at pizzeria veritas. So delicious and fresh. I don't bother with any other pizza if I can help it! Exciting cocktails, and a very welcoming atmosphere. Every time I go, both owners always check in with my table, and seem to truly be thankful and appreciative for my business, even though they do not personally know me. If I had one complaint, it would be that the restaurant is very loud. Not good for quiet conversations. Definitely more of a high energy atmosphere. Just depends on your mood. Still worth 5 stars!

Quaint French restaurant of which everything breathes French except that it was built not that long ago. Even the stairs going down to the restroom was 'typical'. The oysters were excellent and the mould frites too. The crenelated brûlée was ok, too sweet for my taste and too custardie. The place was hopping that was for sure
It doesn't get much better than JJ's. The Belly buster is deliciously hot, and there is no doubt that this is the best hot dog truck around. Since 1971 and going

Great Sports Bar in heart of south Philly...Lots of screens One of best place to watch an Eagles game... Family friendly too...so bring your kids to celebrate the Eagles win...Every time I'm in philly ...I hit this spot ... Crab fries to die for... Friendly servers and good eats and great screens
Ask for Caitlyn for waitress Great old fashioned home style food that you will enjoy Mac and cheese Deviled eggs Fried chicken Meatloaf Matzah ball soup Thanksgiving meal ALL GREAT
Not great. Ordered chicken flautas and mole enchilada.... Both filled with chunks of fatty gross chicken. I almost threw up. Aguila is so much better.
Our group of six each had wonderful meals and the service was great. Most of us had fish--the halibut was the best we've ever had. Forgione watches over every plate that goes out of the kitchen!

Love bar and I really enjoy the food and the back room which opens at 10. However, the last time I was at Bar was far from OK. We had made a reservation at 7pm for a party of 14 people (fyi We all love Bar as a place to celebrate birthdays or just to eat, we come here whenever we have the chance which made this experience particularly bad). To start off, when entering the establishment, we over heard the bouncer talking about all the people they wanted to beat up tonight...oh??? Then, when the waitress came to the table we were told we had to leave the table at 8:30. This would have been fine if a) we were told this might happen ahead of time and b) we weren't a party of FOURTEEN. To make matters worse, when we asked about why is was ok to kick us out we were told by three separate people, 2 hostesses and a waitress, "its not our problem". Our dinner was then filled with a waitress yelling ANYMORE DRINKS LAST CHANCE about three times and not having enough time for our party to finish eating...we wanted another pizza! Many of us drove an hour or more to celebrate the birthdays of two friends that night and one person drove from Massachusetts. After being kicked off the table, we had to stand around the restaurant awkwardly in the way waiting for the back club to open. If we knew we would of had to give up the table, we would of gladly made plans in between dinner and their club opening up but it was too late at that point. I was really just disappointed in the lack of customer service and appreciation of regular patrons...I really hope this was a one time.

I am an Irishman therefore I am a dog lover but I don't like dogs in my domain or on my  restaurant went to go eat and a dog was inside the restaurant just not clean just not legal I will be not back The owner just posted back, saying it was legal dog, still gross, still won't be back
Ok not a Vegan at all!! But my goodness unbelievable!!! Delicious!! Hole in the wall place.. Mighty Mushroom is the one to try... Will definitely try it again
Another great meal at Dominic's restaurant. Veal paillard was excellent. Pasta was al dente and the pomodoro sauce was yummy!!

Such an awesome place in NYC - the New Yorkers are spoiled to have this gem in their midst! We got in and the place was mobbed - people everywhere - shopping, scouting for a seat at one of the mini restaurants or bars, drinking...just people everywhere. The market areas - they have a large cheese and charcuterie section, produce, fresh pasta, bread, dessert...everything and it is just like Mario Batali - legit! We managed to get a seat at one of the bars and ordered the cheese and charcuterie plate (and wine if course) and it was amazing. The fresh made ricotta was outstanding - so outstanding that I looked up the recipe and plan to make it and pair it with honey and almonds - just how it was there. Stop in and check this place out - it makes you want to move to Italy...or Eataly. :-)

For  a quick casual meal out here and there I guess it's okay. The menu isbasic, only a handful of options. My only criticism is that the food could be spicier. I ordered the extra spicy curry pan and while very good, it was probably closer to mild. Similarly, I ordered the hot curry and it tasted prety mild as well. It was delicious though. I would honestly give this place closer to 2.5 stars, if I could do half does!
just as i remember them in paris the macarons were outstanding.  the only suggestion would be to have a sitting area with coffee as they do in France

From start to finish, an extraordinary experience.The decor, cooky modern yet comfortable.The staff, thoroughly professional, friendly and helpful. The food was of the highest quality (my duck was the finest I have ever been served), imaginatively prepared and presented, and the wine list extensive and inviting. I cannot think of a better spot for a per or post-event meal at Lincoln Center, located right across the street.

As a self-titled "burger-connoisseur ", I knew this was one place I absolutely had to visit one day after seeing them on TV years ago. I saw them on there again last week and knew it was a sign. During our trip to NY this weekend, my girlfriend and I decided to take a trip to Louis' Lunch since we were staying in CT; IT WAS PURE AWESOMENESS! This small gem in the middle of the block was everything I expected. When we arrived Saturday for lunch, it was packed but they're fast and efficient so it was only about 5 mins (if that) before we were able to order our chance at burger history. The menu is While the toaster steadily cranked out slices of lightly toasted white bread, the 116 year old grills churned out the charred little pieces of perfection like madmen.  Initially, we ordered 2 cheeseburgers (well-done) w/ onions, chips, and drinks. The gf and I also ordered a plain, medium-rare cheeseburger to share while we waited for the well-done burgers to finish. After about 20 minutes (which seemed to fly due to the hilarious antics and anecdotes of the guys behind the counter), our burgers were served and it was well worth the wait. The burgers are simple. I'll say it again, SIMPLE. Pure ground beef patties on 2 slices of toasted white bread. The cheese, which is actually a spread, is the stuff of folklore. It's smooth and creamy when spread but when it all comes together, it melts like a slice of american cheese, incredible! Halfway through the burger, and after hearing at least a dozen other people order them. I decided to order the potato salad and a birch beer. How could I not have done it sooner? There used to be only 2 potato salads I would eat, safe to say it's now become 3. After great food and a bunch of laughs, we decided to go, but not before I grabbed 2 more with everything for the road (which I'm goingto devour as soon as I'm done). Great Service? Check. Great Food? Check. Yup, I definitely plan on making it a point to come here whenever I'm up that way again. BTW, there's plenty of parking surrounding the place but there is a structure (1 block east) of it that offers free parking on Saturdays from 9am-4pm!

Outstanding food! Believe me, I am a good sized guy with a HUGE appetite.  I highly recommend this deli for every meal of the day.  If you are flying in or out of the airport, give yourself extra time and grab a meal here.
Lea's is pretty amazing, especially that it's on Cortelyou road. The food is great and so is the customer service. Top notch all the way.

We walked in there at 6pm on a rainy Saturday night. We were rudely told that "the restaurant was fully committed." Omg!! We SAW many empty tables. We will never return and we will not recommend them. So rude and disrespectful. We ended up at Headquarters, a Lebanese hole in the wall. Delicious food and nicer people. I am guessing LaBebe does not need customers!
I go for the lunch buffet. Its right by work. The food is very good and the guys are nice.

This place is so amazing. The wait is horrible, we arrived at 4:15pm on a Sunday and had to wait about 30 mins to be seated. I must say that the wait was definitely worth it. We started with the seasonal fig, prosciutto and burrata salad, which was just incredible, a mix of flavors. We had two pies that were cooked to perfection and very tasty.   Have been here several times, just love the pies here. We will definitely be back for this delicious pizza.

I have no idea how this restaurant has 4 s.  Food was cold, drinks were weak (if any alcohol at all) and it was all overpriced, even for NYC.  They put complimentary appetizers on the table that were gross (except the pickles were decent).  I am betting they get re-issued to tables throughout the day.

This place is great! I had an avocado toast with an egg and an iced tea and it was delicious. A lot of the negative reviews say the vibe is too hipster-y and it's crowded, and both of those things are true. The decor is right off of somebody's pinterest board and it's hard to get a table, but I like the atmosphere and I don't mind that it's busy. Personally, I don't think you should give a place 1 star for the fact that it attracts "hipsters" and you want your coffee hot and black and to go because you're from New York and you don't have time for this!!! It's a really cute place and the guys behind the counter are really friendly and accommodating (they saw my dslr and assumed I was there to take pictures for my blog and instructed the cooks to make my food extra pretty and told me how to arrange it) (to clarify I actually just had my camera because I was walking around soho but it was very nice of them) and the food was amazing, which, let's be honest here, is the main factor that goes into a food place for me.

Had a great time here today with my wife and her family. Lovely atmosphere , friendly server with attentive service.   Great food with reasonable price , very affordable. We are absolutely coming back for the seafood.

My friend has Celiacs disease and so we asked if the wings were completely gluten free. She said they were. WRONG, the next day my friend ( he ran long distance for a D1 program) has a 200 bpm heart rate and can't stop going to the bathroom. Great scene but I question the handling of food there.
So good!! The pumpkin filled donuts were so amazing, I can't even. The dinner was very good too, but I would come here just for the donuts.

Philly steak wasnt that good but the garlic parmesan fries yummy .and the chicken was fried perfect with tasty sauce .. restaurant was clean owner polite to customers wait was long but i will be back nothing is perfect
Beautiful casual elegant spot, breezy in the spring and summer, cozy in the fall and winter.  Love the staff, cocktails, wine, oysters, pasta, meat, veggies and brunch.

We were seated in the back and had a leisurely lovely 2.5 hour meal. Goose martini was well chilled. The celery root soup appetizer and flounder entree were delicious. Chocolate dessert was heavenly. Wait staff were attentive without being intrusive. Clean restaurant.
The best Italian  food I have had to date, real authentic. Very small and crowded, but well worth it. Must have the hot roast beef with free mozz.

First time at this restaurant. My husband lived in Northern India for 3 1/2 years and craves this cuisine. Mausam did not disappoint. We had raita, lamb dal and lamb vindaloo, and started with chicken mulligatawny. Each was prepared to perfection. The server was delightful, and our food arrived piping hot.

I heard about this restaurant through a friend and went there last night.  Best middle eastern food I have ever had. The hummus they serve there is like no other hummus I have ever tasted "Two Thumbs up." I also loved there shawarma.  Just thinking about it I'm getting hungry. Additionally, the environment was so relaxing along with excellent service..... If your ever in New Haven and you need to grab something to eat you have got to try this place.  I will definitely go and eat at this place again...
Excellent selection of stuff that's hard to find.
Great place to purchase fresh groceries at a cheap price!!!

I am not big on reviewing chains, because service and quality vary greatly from location to location--- but I must say that this  Chili's was pleasant with polite,  good service.the food was tasty,fresh,hot and came out quickly with no reheats-the chain itself has come a long way- the menu has a larger variety and is slightly lower priced in general than TGIF and Applebee's and the fajitas at Chili's are far superior with much more chicken and cooked perfectly!! .Went on a Sunday with the family, bar area has NFL ticket,free refills( offered by server) on appetizer chips( nice touch) -the kiosk iPads with games for the kids are great for restless kids ( but you should be told there is a small entertainment fee attached with use)-I will be back!!

The Sunday morning dim sum are really quite good and a fun if somewhat chaotic experience.  Go a bit early to avoid the big rush.  This isn't Chinatown but it's realy better than pretty good... and yes I am a fan and it is always fun and satisfying.  I would be happy eating there every Sunday.

Some of the best chicken I've ever had. They charge by the pound, so I can't recommend the wings, but their tenders are great. Also highly recommend their various desserts and the chipotle lime mayo sauce

When I'm satisfied with a restaurant, I feel obligated to leave a good review. My family and I came here yesterday, a Sunday. I made a reservation. The owner Alex told me that they do not normally make reservations for Sunday, but he would for me. We came a half-hour earlier than the reservation. I can see why they don't normally make reservations for Sunday. The place was packed! They hurried to find tables near each other for us. They were great wait staff. The orders were executed perfectly. We were very comfortable.  I highly recommend this diner to everyone. The place, food, and service were superb.

The garden room at this café is fantastic. So beautiful. Their specialty is pizza, and it very delicious. They also have a large drink and dessert menu, and everything I tried was excellent. They play jazz music downstairs, and the atmosphere throughout it incredibly close, relaxing, and comfortable.

The service here was just not good. One male bartender was nice to some of patrons, but the rest of the staff was just plain rude and inattentive. The food took forever, and I imagine it would have actually been delicious (reason for two stars instead of one) if it was brought out hot instead of room temperature. The place would actually be a great neighborhood gem if they just had staff that card anything about customer service. Side note... They do not take credit cards.

My husband and I love this restaurant. We consistently receive great, fresh food and excellent service. The management is very hospitable and welcoming. We eat here every time we're in Iselin. You won't be disappointed!
Service was eh for "fine dining" i expected the server to at least smile or pretend a little bit that they wanted to be there. Food was delicious but extremely small portions.

So at first glance it's nothing special but THE FOOD IS AMAZING!!!!!! Last week I ordered 2 chicken sandwiches and they where huge. We ate one for lunch and the other for dinner. It had fresh avocado and a pink sauce that was killer. It was so good I ordered it again the very next day. My granny got the fish sandwich and we split 1/2s... The fish was so crispy and tender with amazing flavor and a splash of lime to just put it all together. A-ma-zing!!!! Today I went for something new and it blew me away. Ordered the huevos rancheros the plate was so big it would have been enough for two it was delish came with steak, rice, beans, queso fresco, French fries, & 2 fried eggs. SO F***ing GOOD!!! Granny had ox-tail soup. With this weather it heated her right up.

Awful.  Absolutely a HUGE disappointment.  I used to LOVE this place with the old owners, but ever since Abe left it's turned into an awful mess.  The food is NOT the same at all, it's over-priced, and just sloppy.  You get nothing for what you pay, and the recipes can't possibly be the originals.  I had been bragging about this place to my fiance for so long, and we just can't even go there anymore.  We tried twice with the same outcome... we'll never go back.  I make such better food at home that this isn't even worth the "convenience".  I feel sorry for anyone who didn't get to try Abe's food.  This is just a sorry excuse for it :(   You want to try some REAL vegan food?!  Track down the Cinnamon Snail or The Green Radish food trucks.  They put this horror show to shame!

Not a fan. Yelp is usually very useful but in this case I was disappointed. The atmosphere was nice but the menu was short and misleading. I had the sunny egg with greens which was fine. My friend had the biscuit which was huge and they brought two mini mini jams on the side. The portions are strange as well as the prices (the biscuit only 5 dollars and a small glass of orange juice 5 dollars???!). Would need a longer menu with attractive options to go back.

West Haven's best kept secret. You may not think much about this bar while just doing a drive by, but I strongly suggest popping in. Whether you're a local or not, you will sit down feeling right at home. Excellent service and by far the cheapest drinks in town. They have a large backyard area where they host numerous charity events, as well as outdoor grilling and delicious homemade food. They also offer video bowling games and have a jukebox. Do yourself a favor and take a chance on this place. You will not be disappointed.

We wanted a place for our daughter's baby shower, and not being from the area, did a lot of research to find the right place.  Fortunately, we found the Paper Factory, and ultimately Mundo. Working with Jon and Willy turned out to be the best thing that could happen.  They worked with me by phone, and everything was as expected when we arrived the day of the event.  The place is beautiful, and the food was spectacular.  Everyone went out of their way to make sure this event was special. I can't wait for my next trip to Queens, and for Mundo to open for dinner.  I would recommend this place to everyone. Loved the place, Sangria, food and the people!!

really enjoy this place. the staff is really nice and accommodating.  i always request shrimp with eggplant and crunchy basil in brown sauce... SO good. it was part of the specials one day and when i asked about it again they told me anything i ever see on their special menu they can make it for me at any time .... i just have to ask. i think thats totally awesome.  i usually order a few times a month since the foods so good and reasonably priced

Horrible. This was my first time ordering. Food was over an hour late. I called and the woman said it should be there any second. One hour and 15 min later. Food was cold and inedible. They also left out part of my order. At that point I didn't bother calling back because I would most likely wait another hour and a half. Will not order from this place again. It's a shame because I love Greek food.. There aren't too many places that deliver around here. Thanks, but no thanks. Completely unimpressed with this restaurant.
Amazing burnt ends, best slab  bacon I ever had in my life, great service and great good. I'm glad they expanded this is an awesome restaurant!!  They provide catering also.
overrated... good people watching though

This is perhaps an epitaph or nearly one. This restaurant was a regular monthly feature for my wife and I. The food reminded us of our Turkish holiday and the deserts were amazing too. Something has happened , either management had changed philosophy or they have opened another restaurant somewhere or the chef has left. We recently took our guests from London to this place after much praise only to be  completely let down. The Iskander Kebab was flat, the Kuzu Tandir was not as soft and cooked over slow charcoal fire and tasty as we have had before before and worst of all the lower portion of the Baclava were burnt to blackness and tasted of the burn. We perhaps will give this once-really-good restaurant , one more shot and then if the experience persists, will remove this place permanently from our list.

I've been here numerous time as I live in the area. My favorite is the ceviche, but ask them to add other seafood to it, costs a little more but so worth it with the hot sauce they have! The home made tortillas with duck comfit, slow cooked in the basement prep room, is fantastic.

Pretty expensive for a lot of vegetables and a lot of sauce. I got the kebab mixed with vegetables, lamb and chicken and it turned out to be mostly vegetables and not a lot of meat. The platter came out to $11 and I was expecting more food. Plus it was soaked in sauce that just tasted fatty.
Delicious comfort food, my go to soul food restaurant of choice when in new york.
The banana cream pie made me think sinful thoughts.

Burgers of greatly impressive outlets and shops can be bought from here. Mark is a brand which always helps me to bring my friend to a level of helping out my friends. I always prefer coming to this place are heavenly well blessed and Mark has the power to grab me to this. Burgers though apply to implement a gathering's own laws which signify the developed growth. Looking to hire this as a party outlet? Then forget about anything and come to Mark. I'm calling it as all time preferring because of my own choice and virtual greetings. Their burger quality is this much well ordered which is second to none and in fluctuates all said claims.

Came here based on all of the reviews. It was 2:30 in the afternoon on a Saturday, and we were getting some work done to the car at a pep boys near by, and had some time to kill. THE BAD 1. No lunch menu 2. Other reviewers said it was so inexpensive? Not true. 3. As others have mentioned, service isn't very good. Took forever to get the bill. It took so long I went up and paid it at the counter like we ordered takeout. 4. Our server didn't speak English very well. 5. They don't have lemons? Who doesn't have lemons for water? Odd THE GOOD 1. Nice place 2. Steak was good We won't be back

Better gives us a fresh, healthy and tasty alternative to take out.  Quick service (I've only made pick up orders), friendly staff and more importantly, tasty wraps.  I love the Texas bbq chicken wrap and the San Diego wrap with honey mustard.  It's nice to be able to get healthy take out and for it to taste good!

The food was lovely but it was a bit pricey compared to the quality of food and prices we discovered during our stay. We also experienced a couple beside us not receiving the correct food and the staff seemed to be rushed off their feet. We stuck to the one main course due to the price and didn't feel the need to return. Plenty of lovely places to eat. It was just convenient for our stay.
Great view! Great food! Service is great.. Tried the seafood rice at lunch.. Simply delicious.. The price is also very reasonable. Overall enjoyed my lunch here.
I like this place. I used to go here when I was younger for late night. Went back for a sandwich today, it was great. Service was good. Food was great. Can't beat it for a nice sandwich.

Not bad decor, a little dark, seemed deserted. Service fine, no problems. We were not impressed by the food. The Cavatelli Bolognese was unremarkable; watery, not too much flavor, overcooked. Wholly uninteresting; something a mildly experience home cook could whip up in an hour. Antipasti misti, you can't really go wrong with that. But half of this antipasto was pickled vegetables, seemingly right out of a can. It wasn't cheap either. I would not recommend coming to this restaurant. The food is really quite mediocre. It's also in a rather janky part of town at night. Wouldn't recommend as a date place.

We stopped by after dropping off my niece a few towns over. Not knowing the area ,we took a chance. I'm so glad we did. The bangers and mash were off the chain good, and I had the steak pie. Everything was super fresh, and I was delighted to wash it down with a Belhaven Ale - my absolute favorite beer, and they have a full line of bellhaven on tap. Rustic charm, friendly staff, and a game of futbol on the Tele. Do not miss out on this stop that is sure to be a new favorite.

If the Halal Guys (53rd and 6th) had a brother this would be the place. This halal cart is by far one of the best New York has to offer. When I first was introduced to this place the guys here were kind of enough to give us samples of their falafels and it is delicious! I'm also a fan of getting a combo. Why not the best from both worlds. What I love this place besides their delicious and tasty food is they accept credit card! If you are ever in Astoria give this place a visit and try it. The cost is cheap and the taste is superb. Your stomach will happy. Enjoy your visit.

This has got to be some of the best, most authentic cuisine I've eaten in Philly. I find that a lot of restaurants are skimpy on their portions and lack flavor and love (the most important ingredient). The service here at Ratchada was amazing, friendly, attentive and professional. The food was flavorful, fresh, authentic and clearly crafted by someone who knows and loves what they do in the kitchen. I will be here again soon. And you should go, too!

Had beef brisket sandwich, steak tartar, zeppole and baked Alaska for desserts. All were so good. Beer flight was wonderful choices as well and Octoberfest beer was great. Right behind exit of Chelsea market. $100 for 2 with tip.

The sushi is excellent but the service is even better. The waiter was very helpful with recommendations from the extensive sushi and sashimi lists while patiently explaining the etiquette of eating Japanese cuisine. The restaurant is small and busy, so plan ahead. Reservations are a must and hard to come by on the same day.

I ordered an array of sushi, pretty much most of what was available at the time. We had a good experience and the food was excellent. The salmon, toro and uni were some of the best I've had. The only exception would be the service, it wasn't bad but the ordering process was confusing and the wait staff had a bit of an attitude when asked questions.

Parking is almost impossible and thought they would have had valet parking but there was nobody outside nor a sign that indicated it was available. Found out after we were leaving the restaurant that they had valet parking available. We went based on the hype but would not make the journey again. Very crowded, food was just okay and prices were way too high for the quality of the food.
One of my favorite restaurants in the city. Great food, wine, decor and service. What's not to love?

Oh man!  After eating at Ramen Misoya this past Friday night, I was itching to eat ramen, again, today, so my boyfriend and I headed out to this place. This place is the bomb diggity, yo'!  It's a very small, hole-in-the-wall place.  Nice and cozy decor and a sense of "Japanese-Americanism" in the air.  I was already judging the place according to the ambiance, thinking it may not be good, but oh hell!  Was I wrong!  The appetizers and ramen, here, is bomb.com! I ordered Spicy Shio Ramen (comes with black garlic oil, chashu, green onion, and thin noodles).  I also ordered extra corn and extra bamboo shoots (Menma).  It was so deliciously good!  The broth was great, not too thick, yet not too thin, and very flavorful.  The chashu was excellent, fatty and juicy, just the way I like it, marinated to perfection.  Green onion was crisp and fresh.  The corn and bamboo shoots were alright, but added in together with everything else, it tasted good! I also ordered Spicy Gyoza.  This was your typical Japanese "gyoza," pan-fried, just the way that I like it (not that fried shit at inauthentic Japanese places that are Americanized...they have a lot of that stuff back home in Cali), and it was drizzled with Japanese spice.  On the side, there was gyoza dipping sauce.  Each Spicy Gyoza plate only came with about 7 pieces, but those 7 pieces were so delicious and went perfectly with my ramen! Lastly, I also ordered the "Curry Rice Set," so my ramen came with a side of curry over rice, in a bowl (with pickled ginger on the side).  This, my friends, was delicioso as well!  I ate it heartily and happily (lol, can't you tell that I simply LOVE food?!). The portions of these dishes were the perfect size, too; there wasn't so much that made you feel sickly, yet there wasn't too little that you were left craving for more.  The service here is also good, they have more manners and class here than at Ramen Misoya (where at Ramen Misoya, they kept asking us if we were done, 'cause I know they wanted to go home - the jerks!). A bit on the pricey side, but it's worth it, if you really want great ramen in NYC. They also opened another branch on 11/1 on 3rd Street.  I'll probably try that place later on, as well. Overall, I would highly recommend this place to family and friends who want some good ramen in NYC!  All hail, RAMEN-YA!  YATA!!!!!!!  Hai, oishii desu!!!!!!!!! Keep doin' yo' thang, you guys rock!

Wonderful dining experience...Took advice of Yelp reviewers & ordered the Curry Puffs - Yummy.  Also Pla Muk Tord - fancy for the best Calamari I've eaten in a very long time.  Wonderfully crispy without being chewy.  Main entrees were Gaeng Kiew Warn w/ chicken. ( Semi spicy green curry) Delicious.  Nuea Yaan, grilled beef w/ Thai sauce - very tender & flavorful.  and Fried rice w/ crab meat.  Nice to see fried rice made the way it should - with egg. The crab made it special.  Portions were large. Presentation was excellent. Place BYOB, so i brought 2 Heinekens from corner store for $3.50. Restaurant put 2nd in fridge until ready to drink. Prices very reasonable.  Workers very helpful & attentive.  I will be going back.
Some of the best margarita in NYC!

I came with a friend and Waited 45 mins for a table. Ordered the Totto ramen miso paste with pork. Soup was really creamy with mild pork taste. Delicious when mixed with miso paste. My friend had Chicken broth which has stronger chicken taste in comparison. Ramen was cooked al Dante - so yummy, to die for ! Egg was quite salty with strong soy sauce taste, slightly overcooked. Was a bit disappointed as I was expecting sweeter and soft centred egg. Overall I really enjoyed the meal ! Definitely worth a visit . Be prepare to wait for table.
come alone for maximum lonely

We visited Barcelona Saturday night for a group dinner. Unfortunately, as usual, Barcelona over booked. With a party of 7, we waited an hour past our reservation to be seated. Although the GM had apps passed and sangria, it did not take away the fact that we had been standing for 90 min waiting in an overcrowded place. Waiters pushed their way between us, other customers continued to wait and the aggravation filled the bar area. We finally were seated after 9, and the GM brought a few apps and champagne to the table. Unfortunately, this doesn't compensate for the wait nor the starving customers. Barcelona is the only game in town, and unfortunately people tolerate this crap because there aren't enough "good" options in New Haven. Food was ok- service good, but absolutely not worth the wait. Barcelona needs to STOP OVERBOOKING and honor reservations on time. Apps and champagne only go so far.

The food was very good, the service was not so good. I think our waitress may need more experience. She was slow and very little personality. I generally like to feel welcome in places where I eat. I had a better customer experience at a fast food place. Even though I only did 3 stars, I would eat here again, because I enjoyed the food so much.
Excellent dinner experience. Food was delicious. Attentive wait staff. Food was hot and not rushed. Highly recommended
Absolutely delicious Indian food, with a flare. Loved the chick peas the best, dahl was also excellent.

I had a spectacular meal with a good friend on Nov. 1.  Our waiter "G" was extremely attentive and knowledgeable, as well as the entire staff.  On top of sharing a delectable bottle of Primitivo/Montepulciano/Nero d'avola, I casually mentioned that I wanted a glass of Pinot Grigio with my salmon entree. I happened to look over at the bartender (a few feet away) and he was already pouring my glass of wine! (Bionic ears - I guess.) I am from Washington, D.C., and didn't release how narrow the streets are in some parts of Philly and how limited the parking.  Luckily there is valet parking in the front (serving other restaurants, too, but nonetheless) making the entire experience very pleasurable.   By the way, I had Rock Shrimp Ceviche with cucumber, long hots, avocado puree, and gazpacho as an appetizer and organic salmon with roasted Japanese eggplant, bok choy, coconut, and green curry broth. All to die for. The pastry chef, Jessie Prawlucki, is amazing.  My friend and I split the  Pumpkin Layer Cake with butterscotch pudding, dulce de leche, and gingersnap crumbs AND Dark Chocolate Mousse with coconut white chocolate cremeux, flourless brownie, and cinnamon crème anglaise. Now it's back to the treadmill!
Good food, very fresh, and well prepared at reasonable prices by people who really try to please. Not a fancy place, just good.

The best pizza on Lancaster! They have a great Fri-Sun special- $10 for a large cheese pizza and a 2 liter. The owner is the friendliest, and they always offer us cups for soda and plates for pizza when we eat there. Skip the other pizza places on Lancaster and go here instead!

If I could give -5 star I would. This is the worst Chinese food I have lived in NJ I had shrimp and broc it had no taste. The shrimp was not fresh and I'm being nice by saying that   The rice was beyond greasy   My daughter had a shrimp lo mein she had to chuck it. They should be ashamed to put the word health on their stationary. NASTY!!!

I gave both Geno's and Pat's a two star rating, because honestly I wasn't impressed by either. The roll was cold, meat chewy and cheese tasteless. Service was much better at Pat's. At least they were friendly.
Overpriced, outside, cheap ingredients...add to that one of the trashiest collections of patrons in the city, and you've got a real loser.

What a disappointment!!!! We waited over an hour to get a table on a Monday. This place doesn't take reservations, so we were starving by the time we were seated. To start,  the wine selection was beyond disappointing: they only feature two white wines, which are the cheapest selections from a grocery store (2 buck chuck quality) and charge $10 per glass. It would be understandable if the food was any good, but thats not the story. The vegan noodles came out luke warm, without any flavor and completely under seasoned." The pork noodles were barely edible. If you want great ramen and don't mind a wait go to Totto Ramen. It's waaaay better.

I might be from the hills side of town, but whenever I'm back in Wayne, I find myself driving down Valley Rd to go to Tony's. This is hands down the best slice in town, and they make delicious sandwiches as well. It's slightly more expensive than some of it's competitors, but believe me, the portions you get are worth it. The owner might have gotten last place on that one episode of Chopped, but he certainly knows how to cook Italian food! I honestly can't remember the last time I dined in; the ambiance of the restaurant section makes it enticing, however. This is my go-to spot for pizza in the area, and I'd recommend it to anyone.

Came here on a Thursday night and the place was bumping. The vibe perfectly walks the line between a trendy place to meet up for drinks, a spot to watch a game or somewhere to take clients out for work. Solid crowd and sound system, too. Had the house burger and truffle fries. Will def come back.

I just moved out of the neighborhood to the burbs, and I miss Little Italy already.  First, let's get the staff discussion out of the way.  You will never meet a friendlier staff and delivery guys (younger and older).  They are all super nice and friendly, and a breath of fresh air in a city that can too often be plagued by rudeness. Now for the food.  Their pizza is delicious, and so far, I haven't been able to find anything as good in the burbs.  Their fries are awesome, and always perfectly well-done the way I asked, every single time. Their wings though... ughh I miss those wings.  Do yourself a favor and try them.  They are by far the best wings I've had in the city.  Simple, crunchy, flavorful, and tender on the inside.  There is nothing better during football season than chomping down on a dozen of those crunchy wings. I miss you guys!  Please open up a place in Havertown!
The food at Jungsik truly is art. Every plate is both visually beautiful and stunningly good to eat. Coming here is an experience not to be missed. Most highly recommended.

I love this place!! food comes out fast, and its really delicious. Best of all. its so cheap!!! Here's my recommendation: Each time im coming in I order as follow: starter - Guacamole + Main- barbacoa taco and cactus taco. = yummy !!!!!

Maxican taste is rarely a found one digit here which is so bad to have at the same time.  It matters me the eventual fact that realistically speaking, things are well attributed and mixed up quite simply. Bars are too simple to be found and taken up well stuff from them. Taqueria Lower East Sid itself is a highly acknowledged product which can always be honored. When I went to this site for the first time, I had no clue what so ever because of the power which they offer. Thus, making this my choice was so simple and I made it so! Loving it! Making it a dream to visit!

Korean taste is such a choice that I would never dare to avoid. They are so up to the mark for which I am really happy and keep them as my choice of visit every now and then when I come to New York.
