Passed by on a beautiful Sunday afternoon, took a chance and grabbed an available table in the back . Warm and cozy, great service all around and an awesome, cooked to perfection medium rare burger. Meh on the fries. But what will forever stand out in my memory will be the pickle....oh man, what a great pickle.

This is a kick ass donuts place!!! Finally there is a place in Hamilton. Unlike the franchisees around the corner, you can taste the freshness and it doesn't feel doughy or heavy.  Also, they have awesome coffee and very good panini's.  This is what you expect from an owner who graduated from NY Culinary Inst. Of America .   will rate this place ***** mike
It's a wonderful experience to explore the nooks and crannies of this place. the goods, the food, and best of all the people make it a memory collector of the first order. CFC

OHHH..... Yay... I'm a Fan! My friend invited me for an outing to fresh up our memories and brush off the dust that is setting on my head which is getting older with everyday that passes. I left the job for him to choose a nice and good place in his area. I don't care that much about the food, the most important thing for me was the warm atmosphere, and the friendly staff. After sitting there for 2 hours i can definitely say I LIKE THIS PLACE!
Great food in a cool environment!

When a restaurant is "proud" of having a 1  1/2 hr waiting time, the eating experience should be really differentiated. Bianca is just good comfort food hyped by the small size and the wait. Service was not good and the host kept charming us during our wait so we didn't leave.

We live in Lawrenceville and are always exploring for new breakfast and lunch locales. Well we found a gem in downtown Pennington.  Really upbeat and friendly staff and fresh delicious homemade foods. Food is so good they run out early of many items.. I think they are learning to adjust so as not to disappoint.
My wife and i go there once a week and we  absolutly love the food. Tony the owner and his wife treat there patrona well and the food is the best thai around
I went on a Friday night, it was a wait of 25-30 mins, but it was definitely worth the wait! I had fried chicken, mac & Cheese & mash potatoes it was delicious.

Worst food of all. This is our second horrible experience. We ordered Chicken 65 which tasted so sweet and full of "Red food color". Then we ordered choley bhature, which was no way near to bhature...guess chef really needs to understand and learn between big puri and bhature. Their Andhra style fish is our least favourite of all this horrible experience.  Fish was really stinky and big chunk of green bell pepper and onions are all you can get. I wouldn't advice this place. We are definitely not coming back here period

Great bacon egg and cheese burger...!! The seasoning on the burger was so refreshing!! Way better than 5 guys and Boo ya ...The fries were very tasty as well...Nice cozy little spot for a Sunday...Hardly any wait !!!! The fountain soda was excellent also....
I get the ribs and Mac'n'cheese every time and it's DELICIOUS!!! People are ultra friendly and has a great atmosphere
It's a great spot for a guaranteed delicious beer and amazing food.
Best crepe I've had so far. The ice cream is a nice touch on the crepe . Kashmiri Chai and Chicken Tikka Masala Crepe are the "must try ones". Their lasis are great too.

Had dinner here with my mom and boyfriend last night. The food was delicious and the service amazing they really know their stuff. A bit dark with lots a great music, perfect for date night to my fellow couples. Will definitely be back. In addition to a great night I actually left my purse there and didn't realize until I was all the way home. Called Blend in a panic and was happy to hear someone wonderful turned it in! Thank you kind stranger and thanks to blend for a great night.
Absolutely loved blend!!! Great ambiance, great service & the food was excellent ! Amazing view of Manhattan skyline.

Awesome new coffee spot with a lovely welcoming feel. The coffee is excellent and the pastries are delicious. I've also done a takeaway sandwich (the schnitzel) and it was also great. Small space with a few tables but good for parties of 2 or if you're solo.
Food is always great at Jose Tejas.. Especially the sizzling platters. My only issue is the wait time.  Other than that, it serves good quality Mexican food and is a fun family spot to eat from.

Made a reservation for 45 mins and when I went to inquire about my table, the girl at the desk said I have to wait an additional 45 mins because she seated other customers. Asked for the manager. She said no managers on duty. She was very rude and not apologetic about her mistake. Couldn't talk to a manager. The waitress messed up the order and was very defensive and rude about the order. She made faces and never apologized. The food is excellent but the customer service is a 0 out of 10.

The portion is very very very small. Its like ridiculous for the price. Seriously. Taste is...not bad ...but not good enough for its price. Never choose this place when you are starving. I am not coming back to this place. Never. Ever.
Smaller portions, higher prices, colder ribs...this place used to be great, but it's on the highway to crap.

Went for lunch today with a girlfriend.  Had a very friendly and attentive waitress. We both had the escarole and bean soup which was excellent and then our waitress recommended the spinach salad and we both had that too!  She kept the refills coming on our drinks which was nice that we did not ever have to ask.  What a pleasurable experience we had today because the food and service was excellent!

So based on food alone, I'd give this place 3.5 stars, just because one of our four dishes (penne delizia) was actually quite tasty. The other 3 (chicken sorrentina, pizza rustica, ravioli bolognese) were decent but nothing special. The real reason I'm giving this place only 1 star is because of the service. It is a small place and there seemed to be only 2 waiters, so I understand they are busy and are under pressure to turn over tables, but the wait staff was straight up rude. They seemed visibly annoyed that we needed more time to decide on our choices and when we asked questions. My friend asked what exactly "twin pasta" was, and our waiter's response was an irritated "... it's twin pasta". I write this review in the hopes that the owner will see this and make some changes to the culture there so people can actually enjoy the food without feeling like an absolute chore to the wait staff.

Excellent brunch menu. My girlfriend and I split the steak sandwich and avocado toast, which are staples of the restaurant (although they went light on the avocado...) Well located in a cozy little spot in the East Village. Nice casual ambiance, very good service. Bloody Mary's were O.K.

Finally an awesome Israeli restaurant with affordable prices. An an Israeli residing here in Manhattan I was looking for a place like this for quite some time and now the search is finally over. Even their simplest dish is served with great care and nice presentation. Everything is made to order so it's always fresh. Friendly staff
我平时都不写评语的，但是真的很好吃。我男朋友带我过来吃的，点了水煮鱼和最近推出的新菜：羊肉和猪蹄儿。 当然这里不全是辣的菜，许多清淡的菜味道一样的棒！比如豆苗还有莲藕排骨汤！一定会再来！老板娘和外卖小哥­都很好！
Wow, finally no need to take the long ride to the west side for a nice bowl of ramen. The place is just as good as the original shop but without the long wait!

Hello everyone, Just finish eating brunch at this place and I am extremely disappointed because of the following: Service is very bad, the waiter was rushing us every minute to order and my friends and I haven't been sitting not even for 2 min. The waiter came with the food very quick but was so rude that he just put the plates in our face expecting us to carry the plates and deal with it ourself. He asked if we wanted pepper and one of my friend said no thanks so he was leaving and I had to say 4 times that I wanted pepper and he gave me a nasty look. Now the food review is the following: Order 2 plates with egg Benedict and the poach egg was over done and too much vinegar on it, not runny at all. Not to mention the hollandaise sauce was extremely thick. The fries were too greasy. The gravlax salmon was of bad bad quality which had a weird taste to it. The French toast was burned but still tasty. The bacon and cheese omelet was ok except that the bacon was over cooked.
awesome service, awesome staff, awesome atmosphere! I will definitely return based on the incredible attitude of employees alone. thanks for a great experience!!

The best Irish Pub in the world. The staff is great!!! ( Erica & Mike) Very welcoming and professional. The atmosphere is comforting, but fun. The food is freshly made, and served in generous portions. It's hard to pick which dish is the best, so I'll say all. I had the Irish Stew and tasted nothing like it before, it was so good and their prices are very reasonable for the quality of food. We were here for my husbands 30th b day and I must say we were all pleasantly surprised. Good job guys!!  You have long term customers out of us.

Very good food, and low romantic lighting. It says $$ on here, but expect to spend 40-50 per person, if you have drinks. Menu consists of very good small plates, each for about $10-15. The BBQ braised rib sliders were very very good, definitely a must have.
Love ordering from here, but they take forever to deliver something simple.  On average i wait close to hour and 15 min to hour and a half.

Best place ever! Service is excellent, food is yummy and unique and the place is super cute and inviting! As a tea drinker in a coffee country I am always disappointed with tea selections in cafes and brunch spots. This place, however has better standard tea blends than any other place. I couldn't be more pleased.

This is a special gem on Grand Street. Malaysian style with a touch of Chinese influence. 1.) Food: AMAZING!!! We (a group of 3) ordered: Homemade Roti Canai (One of the most popular dishes here), Baby Oyster Omelette (5 starts for sure!), Kang Kung Belacan (Must try!!), Nyonya House Special (or Steamed Striped Bass in Teow Chow Style??), Nyonya Young Tofu (Great egg noodles). Drinks: Sour Plum (This drink will save your tongue from the hotness of the food) + Green Apple & Kiwi 2.) Service: GREAT! The lady who served us was very friendly and funny. She didn't rush us at all, which is hard to find in many Asian restaurants. Other staff was nice too. My friend put his phone near the edge of the table. A man working here gently moved my friend's phone and he said, "This way, the phone won't drop." 3.) Price: $$.You get what you pay for in terms of the quality of the food and the service. 4) Waiting: NOT SO MUCH. We were lucky to have a table when we walked in. Others came later and they were in line waiting. However, they didn't wait very long. 5.) Other: The bathroom was clean. The room was very cozy for such a cold winter night outside. I really liked the way they designed the restaurant. People weren't talking too loud. Recommended to everyone whether you are single, couple, "in-the-friend-zone" friends, long-time-no-see buddies, get-together crews, etc. Also, if you are sick with General Tso Chicken and craving for new Asian food, this place is definitely for you to enjoy and discover!
Had the fish and chips this time, wasn't bad, wasn't memorable at all. Service... Not memorable either, and that's a good thing in this case

The seafood was really fresh and the food is good here but the service was lacking.   First they took our reservation with a party of 12 but when we arrived they could only sit 8 at one table and 4 at the other so we were separated.  They should have either told us or not taken our reservation.  I felt duped.  When we sat they took our drink order and gave us drinks quickly but the our waiter didnt come back to take our appetizer for 20 minutes.  The time we ordered and received drinks, appetizers and entrees was over 1.5 hours. The time we finshed dinner was 2.5 hours with rare checkup from the waiter.  This is not the first bad service I received at this place.  I just finally got fed up to write about it.  It's a shame because its hard to find good seafood in NJ.

Stay far away this place sucks. Rude and ex cons deliver the food.  We got sick for a week eating from Neptune Cafe and I will never order from them again. Theres much better places nearby to order from

First time at MP Astoria What a great secret Warm & friendly Taverna , down to Earth With food that your gramma cooks back home with a twist! The server & manager were so gracious and friendly. Food was so fresh & tasty. Look at the photos..dessert was fresh & mouthwatering. What's amazing is that  prices are so reasonable & the quality is excellent! We will be back soon Congrats to the Chef

Definitely an A+ Ramen place. The squid was also good ;of course the buns were amazing. I also tried their wings ,not bad.  sitting at the counter made the wait all worthwhile.  The chefs were a delight to watch ,busy like there's no tomorrow.
Love the Mezza plater, special baby eggplant appetizer and the octopus. Great food, service was a bit slow yet attentive - hey they were so busy!

Amazing an experience!!  Wow the simple salad of olives, tomatoes and red onion onions was Amazing!!  I know this is hard to believe but it was best salad ever and we made the mistake of getting only one to split and my non-salad eating husband demolished it!  It was the homemade vinaigrette dressing and the freshness of the lettuce and tomatoes that made this simple salad the Bomb!!  The appetizer and home-made pasta definitely was up there with the salad. Amazing dinner experience. Only Warning:make reservations!!

This used to be my go-to thai place until they raised their prices for the lunch specials without warning. I am very disappointed and won't be coming back. What used to be a great deal for the food portions is now overpriced - unless they bring back the original prices for the lunch specials, I'll be enjoying my drunken noodles at Bangkok Gardens for a cheaper price.
Came here for our first date and birthday. Pretty delicious. Highly recommend the camarones y vieras con ravioli de langosta and the grilled oysters. paella was still pretty good.
I haven't been there yet,but hear it's a good bet.

Good place to wait half the night to not receive your order until you finally get tired of waiting and just walk out. Edit: For some reason, I randomly came back months later. Dude taking the order stole a $20, asked where the rest was, and management actually backed the piece of $#!+ up. Presumably they're in on it. So besides waiting all night, it's a good place to actually be robbed by the restaurant. If you're into extreme adventures when you're hungry. Never again. Thieves.
Great food , great vibe ! Make sure to SHAREEEEE plates are huge. Waiter was  overall experience great

nice place to have korean foods for a reasonable price. salad bar section is kinda expensive but all the other packed foods are cheap and the portion is enough. it is not a restaurant where you have your own table and read through the menu, it's more like a fancy deli store with korean foods. perfect for lunch time or if you want to have simple/fast (yet tasty) korean food
This is a place of a dining experience. Great staff. Delicious food. The best calamari I ever had, I had it there.

A fledgling Mexican haven in Essex. Salsas are fantastic and flavors mingle together pleasantly. What isn't so pleasant is the often ever-growing waitlist to get a seat. Time estimates are often inconsistent, so be prepared to wait. A twenty to twenty-five minute wait may slip to upwards of 30 or more. If time is an issue, Mexicali in Williston provides fulfilling Mexican fare with much speedier seating.

I was very excited to try this place, I heard great things. We were a party of four, for brunch. The waiter seemed pretty frazzled and it took him a good 15 minutes before he even came over for our drink order. We ordered donuts to start, a beer, two bellinis and an orange juice. The beer came out after about 10 minutes, the bellinis took another 5. Three of the four dishes we ordered came out and it took another 5 for the last plate (of eggs and bacon to come out). My sister ordered the eggs and bacon, when she ordered the waiter said "and homefries and toast?" she said yes. The homefries were missing from the order and when my sister asked about them he ran in the back, quickly came back and said it doesn't come with homefries, but if she still wanted them he could order her a side, which made no sense at all. The donuts still hadn't arrived, which the waiter seemed surprised by. My crab cake benedict was extremely salty, but I was starving so I ate everything. The donuts were the best thing we had. I would go elsewhere in Williamsburg. Maybe dinner is better?

Ok, so this place looks really cute from the outside, and it is. The vibe is cool, and understated. The clients and staff seem friendly. That's about it though. In all honesty, the food sucked. My latte was as bitter as my cold, dead, heart. The avocado toast was disappointing (how do you mess that up?) - over-priced, flavorless, with fussy, out-dated, "sex in the city" presentation.  I sent my entree back: some waitress egg thing recommended by our sweet, apologetic server. My brunch companion seemed to like her lack-luster omelet, but she has low standards. ;) Now I'll admit, I'm a fussy, high-maintenance queen, but I wants what I wants - that's why I live in Chelsea.

We've been going to Penang for several years. Their food has been always good. Our fav are Rangdan beef, Thai basil curry chicken and any of their noodle soups. For those who are interested in south east asian cuisine, this place is worth a try.
We have been to this restaurant for lunch multiple times, the food always taste good, and the price is reasonable. The servers may not be the outgoing of kind, but they are friendly and quick.

I went once. It was clean. I wasn't sure what to do but, my friend guided me. The outcome fresh food served fast. They stir fry fresh custom order food. It was good but, I will have to try something else to see how much i like the place.

World Bean literally takes over where Dunkin Donuts was...what were they thinking? 3 unmotivated employees man the desolate shop. There are magazine stands on the floor  making you believe that is what they really want you to buy.. I bought a $2.88 7 oz small black coffee and an exorbitantly priced danish left from yesterday. They destroyed the whole food court area with these new venues all lined with magazone stands. Pack a lunch.

It has been a few months since I have eaten at here, but I have never had a disappointing meal. The food is excellent and the specials are not just a featured item from the menu or something they need to get rid of. the squash ravioli was wonderful. The wine selection is good and Kyla is happy to make a recommendation based on your likes and food selection. I make sure I eat here every time I am in Burlington.

Awesome, the 5000+ reviews and 4 and a half stars speak for themselves. Great SUPER CHEAP food. We ate there twice. The guys were very nice and the food was delicious. Use the red sauce with caution. It's HOT, like real real hot.

Phenomenal food and great service! Everything we ordered on our visit was some of the best Indian food I have ever had. They are BYO so we were able to bring our own bottle of wine and it was uncorked and poured for us without charge.  The staff was great, so friendly and helpful and very attentive to us despite them having a full restaurant. I would definitely return and have recommended this restaurant to all of my friends!

Ordered the stir fried chicken hand drawn noodle. The chicken came out extremely cold and i had to have them reheat it. The dish back out but the noodles were overcooked and the meat still wasn't fully heated! However, the lady was kind in taking the dish back into the kitchen.

A fantastic waste of time and resources. The service staff was very nice and knowledgable, however the food was underwhelming and bland. Lobster bisque was watery, my date described it as excrement. Everything came out within 15 minutes, maybe they're using Turbo Chef ovens? Not cool. It's a self described African restaurant, and I was excited to explore the cuisine. Unfortunately I had flashbacks to prom, a feeling of emptiness and self pity. Cut the menu in half and create a dozen exciting dishes. Get a new chef that isn't only focused on getting plates out of the kitchen fast.

Went late last night with two kids...ordered drums of heaven, hakka noodles and chili chicken..very tasty and came out promptly. hostess was very friendly, overall two thumbs up..would highly recommend.

Very good burgers, with fresh ingredients and a lot of taste. I got the Truffled especiale and I liked it. I wouldn't compare it with Shake shack burger because they don't play on the same price range. I like both in fact, and umami are more restaurant burgers. I went there on saturday night and there were plenty of space. Recommend!

Fantastic decor and atmosphere. The service was as good as it gets, and the food was delicious. My girlfriend had lost a piece of jewelry in the bathroom, and the staff was quick to find the missing jewelry and return it to its rightful owner. They were so friendly and helpful when we came back in search of it. I would definitely recommend Nix's as a Sunday brunch spot, or a Friday night cocktail venue. It's nice to see a trendy, upbeat restaurant in the Hartford community!
Love eating breakfast there! I just wish the cream of turkey soup was made everyday, it's amazing!!

Fabulous! Great atmosphere. Great decor. Good staff. Amaze balls food! Delicious apps, we had the botay (?) and the signature  French onion dumplings. The lobster Mac an cheese was melt in your mouth good.  The short ribs were more than passable. But the star for me of the evening, and I'm a fat guy, was the salad!!! I'm going back just for the "Tabolleh" (spelled wrong and not real Tabolleh). The texture, dressing, and flavor were enough to write home about. So good!

I ordered a cocktail which was mixed well and tasted great, although very expensive. The food was good quality and cooked to perfection. However, it was insanely overpriced and as a seafood fan, not really worth it from a portion size standpoint. If you are looking for some great seafood, go elsewhere. I will not be back.

This place.  Is cool.  Like, seriously cool.  It's in an abandoned train station, which makes it visually stunning.  High ceilings, exposed brick...and they have a seating area outside on the platform!  The food was ok, the staff was friendly and the atmosphere was really chill.  I'm not a big dance club girl, but they have a game night (I think they said Mondays) and trivia on Thursday, which is what I was there for.  Had a great time, and I can't wait to go back when it's warm enough to sit on the patio!

This venue kind of reminds me of a Brazilian Singha's Famous Pizza. They know what their demographic likes and delivers it in pizza encasing- think heart of palm, cucumbers, corn, eggs, Brazilian cheese (similar to cream cheese). Is it the highest form of pizza artistry imaginable? No, but you shouldn't come here for that. What you should come here for is the Pizza, the Corinithians football game in the background, the guarana soft drinks and the really down to earth wait staff. And the Pizza, lest I forget that.
waited 2.5hours. did not feel like this was worth the wait at all. the waffle was pretty good, but does not taste too much different than waffles sold at other brunch serving restaurants.

Great food! Great atmosphere! First off the place looks so small from the outside, but step through the walkway and you'll find a not so hidden treasure. Very reasonable prices and not too late portions of flavorful food make this a must dine in or outside. The only downside is that the instruments are nearly deafening inside when they sing for someone's birthday.

We has lunch at Benito One and every aspect of our meal was perfect.  Our table was ready for us when we arrived ( and we were a little early).  Our waiter Freddie was very attentive and friendly.  The owner came to our table several times during the meal to make sure we had everything we needed. We all chose the lunch special for $12.95.  It included salad or a choice of 2 soups, crusty bread, a pasta dish and an entrée dish.  The food was served hot and delicious. The restaurant is very small so I recommend reservations.

I go there with my husband once in a while, very nice place-good food, good service and relaxed. not pretentious. I would recommend for those who want to have some peaceful time and conversation. I did not try meat theorem but FISH was cooked good.

This is my second time dining at Balthazar and both times have been an absolute pleasure. The food, while slightly expensive for lunch, is well worth the money. It is a real gem in the heart of SoHo and I would recommend it to all.

Amazing food! I love going here for the weekend brunch deal but honestly, any time us a good time to go! Their food is so unique and flavorful and the drinks are delicious, I've never had such sweet fresh-squeezed orange juice. Go here! You won't regret it!

this place is very disappointing . I used to like the soup there but they either mess up the order or took a very long time to get the order ready ( lunch time and barely had any customers there). half of the time the soup tasted weird with some weird meat in it ( they said it's beef but nothing taste like that). Onetime i ordered the wonton soup and the meat in the wonton was sour and I threw up right away.
Cool place . compare to food, late night drinks are good.

Best Vietnamese food in the Burlington area. Portions are generous and affordable. I've yet to try something that wasn't absolutely delicious. The banh mi sandwiches are a fantastic deal.  Other favorites include the Pho Bo beef noodle soup, the Nepali style house special chow mein and the hand made dumplings. Good options for vegetarian and gluten free folks.

I placed an order for delivery.  The food came promptly, but I was so un-impressed by what I got. I ordered chicken fingers, fries and a chocolate milk shake.  The portions are tiny, the prices are expensive, and I didn't think the food was good at all.  I ordered a chocolate milk shake, but got a vanilla one instead, and it was watery!  I couldn't finish it.  The chicken fingers were over-cooked and rubbery, and the fries were cold and soggy.   Maybe when you dine in the quality of the food is better, but I definitely won't order takeout from this place again.  I do give some points to the fact that they have organic meat here.  That the only plus I could find.

I adore Rucola! It's my favorite neighborhood spot. I have eaten there many times. Occasionally there's a flaky waiter but overall the staff is really nice - especially the maitre d' who I think may be one of the owners? Not sure. The drinks are delicious and there's always a new and wonderful seasonal cocktail to try. The charcuterie is  great - especially the speck, I also like the grilled octopus, roast chicken, pork loin, homemade pastas. YUM. Great Italian-y dishes. Oh and brunch is good too. The place is small, so the tables are close together and there's a big communal table in the middle of the room. If you want lots of elbow room, this is probably not the place for you.

Since this spot has opened, they have been building a reputation as the "go to" spot in Hudson County for fresh, organic dishes.   My omelette was moist when I was there for late lunch and had fresh vegetables  in the omelette which came directly from the famers market.   It  was out of this world. President Bill Clinton caught on to Andrew (owner and chef) awhile ago, and after his heart attack, the President made it a point to eat healthy.  I'm with Clinton.  Andrew isa culinary master, if it's good enough for President Clinton, Andrew's Project has my vote. I'm not vegan, but the cookies, brownies and vegan desserts are out of this world.  How anyone can have a delicious dinner with desert and not "break the bank" is amazing, when you consider these expensive organic/vegan spots in the city are gourging people.  What a bargain Andrew's Project is.     There was a Rabbi there the other day.   Chef Andrew is not Jewish, but he told me he has quite a number of Jewish customers eating there regularly.   There's no gefilte fish on the menu, but the chicken soup has the same delicious flavor you find in an "old school" Jewish deli, but without all the unhealthy stuff in it.  Again, the focus on healthy foods, fresh, organic, and minimal salt. This week I will return for a fresh sandwich wrap.  The tuna looks delicious.   That looks perfect for lunch..

This is probably the best decorated restaurant I've been to in NYC. If you enjoy atmosphere, it is a reason to go out of your way. The food was delicious, authentic and with fresh ingredients. I ordered without looking at the menu because it was my first time and I like to gauge my Thai restaurants with spring rolls and Pad Kee Mao. Delicious. It was authentically spicy and portioned nicely. The spring rolls were also amazing. My favorite part was the service. They were all attentive and genuinely nice, which is a refreshing alternative to other places. We had their homemade ice cream for dessert, and I was full and happy by the end of the experience. It was pretty busy on a Friday night, but not once did we have to seek out a server for anything. I would highly recommend this place to anyone!
What a great restaurant! love the food and the service. I would highly recommend this place to any visitors in NYC. - Marilyn K.

This is honestly one of my favorite places to go get sushi. It's also the best all you can eat sushi place I've been to. I usually come with large groups so we always end up getting so much sushi. Sometimes they forgot to give you everything but the best part of all you can eat sushi is you can always order more. Most times I've been here it's been crowded so the servers are a little slow but they're so nice so that makes up for it. If you're really into sushi and think you're up for the challenge of all you can eat this is the place to go. I feel I usually order way too much but thankfully going in a big group helps that.

So, we just got back from having dinner here and the food was really good. We had the pata confit, the sinigang sa miso, and the longcilog. I'm giving this place a bad review because of the gay guy in the white shirt who told me that I couldn't drink the Coke Zero I had brought in from outside and that they're gonna have to charge me for it. He looked at me like I was some fob who doesn't know what corkage is. Dear, I'm not visiting from the old country; I'm from Los Angeles. I feel bad for your coworkers because they were great but only you ruined the experience for me and my whole family. I still left a 25% tip ($20) because unlike you, I know what classy customer service is. It's ok, karma will get you back.

This place is really good.  I wasn't sold at first because I like sour cream and cheese and their burritos didn't have either, but then they were really good anyway.  Also, good nachos, good wings, and good quesadillas.
I always like a place with huge windows, the pizza was good but not the best I've had (99 cent slices are more my thing), but the cannoli I had for desert was A+

First, I made my reservation online for the next evening, and received a phone call confirmation within a few hours of making it. The staff were extremely professional when we arrived for dinner the next evening. Our waiter was able to provide us with excellent drink and food recommendations that were spot on. The food was great and the mojitos were superb. The room was  a little dark and so it was hard to see our food. There was the expected level of background noise for a Friday night, and we were able to have a good amount of dinner conversation. I would definitely go back!

The food does take awhile to come to you but that's not really a complaint. It's made fresh to order and is fresh and steaming hot when it comes. Enormous portions, inexpensive prices. The fried shrimp were the best I ever ate. Great Mac and cheese. Had chefs complimentary creamed veggie soup, delicious. They didn't have ribs the day I went and were already out of bean pie. I will just have to return Owner/ chef came out to greet us. Very lovely and charming gentleman Highly recommend. Can't wait to return. But I did take two dinners to go. Fried chicken and fried Porgies. With sides of collard greens, Mac and cheese and black eyed peas. Yummy. Don't miss this one!!!  It a real winner!!!

BAD!  Very rude servers, even though we were there at a slower time.  We asked what was in the oxtail stew.  Our server said she didn't know, & left it at that.  The "steak" & onion dish was similar to dog meat, the broccoli was totally raw, and the pork plate had some turkey in with it!  The floor was greasy, and the air stuffy.  This place must have all friends, relatives, & employees give them good reviews - there was just way too much wrong.  As I write this I hear 2 men complaining about their food as well.

Excellent food and vegan friendly options.  They do not advertise vegan because an employee told me "people think it's weird and won't buy the food if we say it's vegan."  They should be proud of being one of the few places to offer truly vegan food.  I'd like to see them expand their vegan offerings because the quality of texture, taste, and presentation was top notch!  I would have given five stars because the food really is worth that, but the employees comments were just a bit of a turn off for me.  I'm just being picky I guess.

my favorite restaurant in NYC.  I have NEVER had a bad meal here, no matter what time i go! yes, 24 hour restaurant that holds down its class the ENTIRE time its open.  The wait staff is awesome, the food is delicious, and the atmosphere is so so great.  Feels like you're out to a fancy dinner, but the prices are perfect and the portions are large!  Drinks are even tasty here.   Recommendations?  the Fried Calamari is some of the best I've ever had, and I have had calamari EVERYWHERE.  The horseradish sauce on the side of the calamari is delicious and goes perfectly.  The "mac attack" mac and cheese trio is also delicious.  I've had the "wedge" salad and its tasty, as well as the homemade biscuits they serve at the real dinner hours (with a sweet butter... DELICIOUS) Burgers here are excellent, cooked to perfectiion and the sauces and toppings are delicious too, atop a perfectly toasted bun.  I have also had the skirt steak (AMAZING) and the shrimp risotto (delicious).   I recommend this place all the time.  It's the perfect spot for ANY time.  A great price for a more than satisfying meal.

Everything is amazing. I literally want to post a review every time I eat here.  Where do I start. Fried mac n cheese is an amazing treat. Want some real fries?  These guys will grab a potatoe, chop it up and throw it in the frier.  Jerk chicken is seasoned perfectly, get it on the thick dough bread with some home made Cole slaw which perfectly balances the spice. If you've never tried something. This is the place. I was never big on fish but the fried cod basket or the fish and chips have totally changed that for me!! The homemade Batter is amazing and the code simply melts in your mouth. Shrimp is off the chain... Fried grilled or steamed!! Like chicken wings??? Jerk or BBQ will both hit the spot! If you can't handle the jerk but still want them on the spicey side , try them HYBRID!!! you won't find it on the menu but you can order all the chicken hybrid to give you a sweet and spicey delight. Everything is made on premises, I'm talking about the spice mayo, tarter sauce, beer bated, Cole slaw, mac n cheese. Chicken and fish are bought DAILY. the only thing I've seen them not make is the ketchup!!! The owner who's the cook is there every single day, customer service is top notch. Their open late. Till 2am on Friday and Saturday. Dance hall music builds the atmosphere on top of the amazing smell you can smell from down the block.  This place literally feeds the neighborhood. Once you eat here once you will eat here whenever you don't feel like cooking. Everything is made to order so your food is specifically cooked just for you. There is only one drink available here. And it's their own home made limeaid! ! This stuff sells out every two days. So stock up!

Today was my first time in this casual restaurant. I ordered a bacon and cheese hot dog and a Pepsi. The dog was one of the best I have ever had. I will definitely be back. I read some of the negative comments listed about this restaurant. Not sure I see some of the negatives offered by others.
The food is not as good as the reviews described it to be. i felt like i was overcharged for the quality of the food. the french toasts were pretty good though.
love the hot sauce, love the cheese

Excellent dining experience.   Waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu.  The best arugula salad I ever had.  The spread appetizer and the prawn special were both delish!   Will be returning soon!

This place is absolutely delicious and can please even meat eaters!  I'm gluten-free and it was great having so many gluten-free options to choose from.  Our waiter was extremely helpful and nice, giving us information on some of the vegetarian ingredients.  He recommended the lasagna which was amazing.  I also tried the "cheese plate" which was my first time having nut cheese and it didn't disappoint, and this is from someone with a weakness for cheese.  Despite being very full, we tried two desserts because they just looked so good.  Again, I'm not used to having gluten-free options to choose from and they were both delicious!  I'd highly recommend this restaurant for a delicious, healthy meal that you can feel good about (even the dessert!).  I'm so happy that a place like this has opened in Montclair!

Absolutely delightful visit. We were seated quickly. Our server Paul made a great recommendation on a local IPA - they had an awesome selection of local beers which I always appreciate. The kids had cheese pizzas while I ordered the pork tenderloin which was fantastic alongside jalapeño cornbread and greens that were cooked perfectly. Very different but complimentary flavors. For desert I had the vanilla bean cheesecake which was also full of different but complimentary flavors. The building was very cool and the interior decor set a very relaxing and unique ambience. Overall this was a great meal and I would highly recommend it - well worth the prices for the combination of fantastic food, service, and ambience.
The rodizio here is very good, and I love the salad bar. The caipirinha is not good though, It's too sour and not sweet at all.

i understand that i was here the day before mothers day, but i was celebrating my boyfriends birthday and made reservation 2 weeke prior to the date. We were seated close to the kitchen right at the corner with little space to move. We were very uncomfortable and there was another couple seated right next to us. the music in there was so loud i could not hear my self think. The food was alil more than average but the portions were very small for it's price. It also seem as if they mixed expensive beef with cheap beef in our entree. overall experience ... i would never go again nor will i reccomend. my girlfriend told me not to go but the boyfriend always wanted to try this restuarant. I had better asian food from way cheaper places.
I love this place, I go at least 3 times a month. Definitely try their buffalo chicken pizza

I tried vegetable ramen recently i void to eat meat so i was excited they have ramen for vegan. It looked good many corns and vegetables on the top but very salty. I should have try pork or chicken soup to give better rating.
Good Thai

we were recently here on a Sunday celebrating a birthday with 8 of our very high profile extremely picky friends, we had a fantastic time and all of our dishes were amazing I had the salmon my husband had the brodetto wish a fish stew the mussels were amazing and I tasted the lasagna  we also enjoyed the wine selection and the desserts my favorite was the panna cota yum ONLY CASH

LaScala's features all the basics one needs from an Italian ristorante in Center City Philly: pasta, chicken, and meatballs. Oh, and a good sauce for all three.  Not the best you've ever had, but definitely good - and worthwhile for return visits. A contemporary setting with a perfect location just a block away from the historical attractions on Chestnut. Be sure to request a window seat close to the corner giving you a great view of Philly life and people watching at the busy corner of 6th and Chestnut. Service was attentive but not demanding, even for a Friday night on the town.  The bartender mixed good drinks. Went away full and happy. Another plus is complementary parking validation, which can be history in the making when it comes to Philly parking. Way to go, LaScala's.

We just found this restaurant. Cause we always around washington ave for get spanish food. On sunday this place already busy.we still have to wait.after we get our food.the food so delicious. We love this place.
Amazing food!! There is often a line of people waiting or a table. Great place!

Went to order Prahok kateeh. Very disappointed. Where's was the Prahok. It was so sweet. Nothing Cambodian about that. Tasted like sugar with mince pork. I was excited with the yelp review and that it was close to home. But next time I get a craving I'm calling my mother up. Zero stars if I didn't have to put a star up for the reviews.

Prime 16 happy hour and beer selection cannot be beat in Nee Haven!  The burgers are great and can be made to please almost anyone's discriminating palate. A few nit-picky observations:   Stop changing the glassware! The 12oz stemware is so bad and now the traditional cocktail glasses are being replaced with the non-standard ( less volume) glasses. And, of course, don't get me started on the horrible music. Just don't play anything, if that is the best you can do.
Best seafood in Manhattan
Amazing evening at Gila's! The food was amazing, I especially loved the Sabich which was so authentic. The atmosphere was fun and the service amazing, definitely come again!
The best super-thin crust pizza in Jersey. Just remember with thin crust, if you don't want it soggy - get extra well done and skip the toppings. PS: Stick with the pizza and skip the appetizers.
hands down the best authentic mexican food in this area.... and the service is great. the owner is always there wearing a suit.. adorable

Stopped here with a friend for a brunch. we ordered granola, and omelette. the food was not as I expected, after seeing here 5 stars. Asked for a fresh orange juice, they served me with bottled juice. The granola was very disappointing. I definitely would not come again.
Always excellent food at this great eatery in the Ironbound!

Love this place! Tiy is the best - always so welcoming and makes waiting in line fun. Highly recommend the salmon and the kale apple salad - I could eat a whole plate of only the kale salad and be happy.
had the waffle chicken sandwich. not as good as it looks. plus the food was just heated up and not freshly cooked.

Food is phenomenal. I recommend ordering their fajitas. This place is always packed. The only reason I gave them 4 stars rather than 5 is because of their odd management system. They do not accept reservations, nor do they let you take food to go... Strange if you ask me. On Friday and Saturday nights expect to wait an hour to two hours before being seated. Food is delicious, fresh and reasonably priced. Service is on point as it should be to turn over the tables in a timely manner. This is my one and only go to tex mex restaurant.

This is a hidden little gem !! It's great for a home cooked meal and a nice family owned business , they are so welcoming and friendly .. I had the home fries   , Turkey sausage and sunny side up eggs , the home fries by far the best I've had !! Stop by sometime if your interested in having a good home cooked meal !!

This is my favorite sushi restaurant to date. I was lucky enough to have had the omakase at the sushi bar when Chef Yasuda was still there. The sushi there is still quite good, but it is hard to replicate Chef Yasuda's charming personality.

Dinner last Saturday with my sister. Not sure what the hell happened but food was completey off. Asked hostess if their was someone different in the kitchen - she said no. I liked Ruddy and Dean's because their food was consistently excellent - very Manhattan-esque and thankfully very un-Staten Island. But when I ate there Saturday it was as if I was in an completely different restaurant. Prices were the same but food was substandard. Sister's meal: Clam chowder was thin and ordinary Normally it is a thicker consistensy with corn in it. Surf and turf both tasted old. My meal: Special mesculin salad with gouda - lettuce was washed but not dried so I had a wet soggy salad. Mussels were good - it's almost impossible to screw up mussels. Wedge salad - normally an amazing wedge of iceberg, large and firm, instead was Pathmark quality soft lettuce. Gorgonzola dressing is always out of this world - it was chunks of cheese with cream. I'm not sure if I will go back. It's too expensive to take a chance.

Penny Cluse is the best breakfast place I have ever been to in my life. I didn't even like tofu until I tried their tofu scramble. Now I'm a tofu convert. I highly recommend the bucket of spuds, too. This place is without a doubt worth the inevitable long wait.
Great service - yummy brunch :)

Chili is a bit spicy and delish. The chili dog is just perfect. Service is fast and price is right. Never dissapointed. I forget about this place because not on a main road I normally use, however, the fact that he is in a parking lot makes parking a cinch. Will be back again.

Food 5 stars. Service brought the average down to 1 star. I won't reiterate what you should order because other reviews have pretty much said it all. Born in Taiwan and came to NYC 7 years ago, to me, it is always exciting finding out there are good Xiao Long Bao restaurants in the city because finding a good authentic Chinese Xiao Long Bao restaurant is really not that easy here in the city. The full satisfaction from my first visit to the Bao lasted so I decided to visit again. I broadcasted how good the food is after my first visit (1 week ago) and hope all my friends and I can go together so more people will appreciate Xiao Long Bao. However, the service I had tonight completely changed my mind. My friend and I ordered: 1. Hot & Sour Soup; 2. Two orders Spicy Xiao Long Bao; 3. Fish Fillet with vegetable & fresh pepper in hot sauce; and 4. Cabbage with chilli. Got Hot & Sour Soup and 2 orders of Spicy Xiao Long Bao at about the normal time after placing our orders. We finished the food 40 mins after we sat down. Staff asked 2-3 times how's everything and we answered GREAT! DELICIOUS!!! We then started wondering if other dishes (Fish & Cabbage) are coming. I asked a female staff (Chinese speaking) to check if the kitchen has started cooking. If not, we might cancel them (Think about it, who sits in a non-high end Chinese restaurant and plans on eating for more than 1~1.5 hours?) She came back and said: "Do you still want the other dishes? If you want them, the kitchen will cook them." To me, that raised one question: Is that how this restaurant works? They take your orders but they won't necessary cook them unless you give your confirmation again. I asked her again to confirm whether the kitchen has started preparing or not, she refused to give a yes or no to my question.   What I am trying to point out is that, as a customer who simple wants to know the status of the orders, all I needed to know is if the kitchen has started cooking the food and I can help decide what to do in response to that status. We made it clear that we are happy to have the food if the food is being prepared, or we are happy to cancel them and pay the bill if the kitchen simply didn't prepare the food. However, the typical Chinese lying/manipulating way to respond to our simple question was so obvious to a certain degree, so I reiterated my simple question in Chinese respectfully. They then brought up some ridiculous excuses. The male staff said: "You ordered the dish with a whole fish, and we are not sure if you and your American friend would eat it so we didn't cook it." , "It takes 15 minutes to prepare the fish, so we waited till you are done with your Hot & Sour Soup and your Xiao Long Bao." (It's got me thinking what kind of logic this is??? Lol.) Long story short, I recommend all you Xiao Long Bao lovers come to this place knowing the service is not going to be great, but it will be average. Occasionally, the waiters tumble and make mistakes. Don't bother wasting your time with them when they pull the typical "we can't say yes or no" tricks on you. If you have been around the block, you know what I am talking about! You can't win against these type of waiters. We came here on Monday night, 11/25, at around 9:30. There is no manager here managing the business. We love the food so we still tipped them. The service could always be improved with proper training. I have never been there during the day time so maybe the staff are being supervised in the day time and hence they are more attentive and logical.

First Time at this location and it will NOT be the last!! The pizza is excellent, thin crust, no grease and all fresh! I loved the smell of the fresh burning wood from the oven, it really set an atmosphere you cannot get at any other pizza spot in Bayonne. Definetly recommend to others to give it a try. We had the large pepperoni, broccoli rabe and tomatoes pie. It was a nice sized oval pie cut into perfect sized slices. Worth a try if you want some good pizza!
We stumbled upon this place while looking for a casual place to eat with good food. Nish Nush was a perfect match! Good food, good prices. Lunch = Done. Success!

My wife and I took my parents here recently and we all enjoyed our meals immensely. The the prosciutto wrapped asparagus salad was probably the best salad I've event had. The staff was professional and friendly and the atmosphere was great. We'll definitely be going back.

Soooooo that roasted turkey wrap was bomb thank god I'm off today because I'm going back for that pumpkins thyme soup....they have very healthy and tasty food and not greasy of fried so glad to have them back now only if they could lower the prices LOLOL

The atmosphere: I visited with my friend on a chilly fall evening in early November. The weather was perfect to eat...in the garden! Through the gates, flanked by towering walls and illuminated by fairy lights, my friend and I were seated at a tiny two-top near a tree; leaves occasionally falling into my drink! Although not on a date, we were surrounded by happy couples quietly chattering. The service: Impeccable. Polite, in no hurry to rush courses, knowledgeable about the food; able to make recommendations for wine pairings. The food: Oh, the food. We shared the tasting menu. Full of flavor and delicious combinations. The small portions and endless options left us feeling satisfied. Due to dietary restrictions, we did request a single change to the menu and were happily accommodated. We had scallops, smoked trout pastry, duck, a cheese plate, foie gras, a lovely salad and more! Everything was exquisitely prepared, well presented and so full of flavor. The valet: slow, slow, slow. I walked; my friend drove and used the valet. It was recommended that we provide our ticket to the waiter about 10 minutes prior to leaving; which we did...30 MINUTES LATER...no car. We waited for 40 minutes (it was 10 pm) until the car arrived. Had I known it was going to take so long; I would have sat at the bar!

Very good pizza , but absolutely no respect for customers . was there on Saturday , came 11:30am this place should open 12pm they was late 45 minutes, no more again . Save your self time go somewhere else

Had a weird dining experience at this restaurant. First of all, our waitress was oddly strange. She could not multi-task to save her life. My dad found a long hair on the rim of his glass after he had poured his root beer into it. We brought it to her attention when she came to take our order. She took the glass and 10 minutes later she came with a clean glass filled with ice. But no soda. And we hadn't even ordered yet.  Before she returned we were already fed up with her inexperience as a server that we were so close to leaving. But right when we were about to leave, she returned. We decided to stay and my dad and I both ordered the pork burger and my mom and aunt ordered the classic burger. We literally said that hopefully their burgers were so good as to redeem our poor experience and the weird vibe of a restaurant. But not to our surprised she came back to say they were out of the pork burgers. Who runs out of a pork burger or any food item  by 5pm? So after a long period my dad finally got his bottled soda replacement. Apparently the servers have to wait for the bartenders to get bottled sodas. When we got our burgers (settled for the classic burger), it came already sliced in half and with two onion rings on it. I never cut my burgers in half since I prefer to eat them whole. So why would the cook slice my burger for me without asking me first? And please tell me how I'm supposed to insert two whole onion rings into an already sliced burger? Let's just say I had to get creative. I asked the waitress why they sliced my burger. She seemed surprised at first and then proceeded to tell me that now I know to ask for the next time. I told told her that I shouldn't have to ask because in the 36 years I've been alive, no restaurant  has ever sliced my burger half. Especially without asking me first. So after that conversation, the waitress never returned to our table to check up on us. No refills. No dessert. It was like we were the forgotten table. We couldn't wait to get the heck out of there. Oh and she charged us for the soda with the hair on it. Most places would apologize, which she didn't, and comp it. We never even heard from the manager. So overall, we will never be returning to this restaurant. It's a wannabe fine dining restaurant with mediocre and poorly trained staff. In the positive, the aesthetics of the restaurant is very nice and the burgers, though slightly over salted, weren't half bad. We still won't ever return here though.

If you are in the area than this is a "must stop" to experience traditional NY style pizza.  The fresh motz and think crust make it absolutely delicious!   Items to note: - It's been there forever so it's kind of a maze to go through - take a peek around it is very interesting - The bathrooms are one at a time but, there are multiple, if there is a line at one give another a try. I've eaten here numerous times and brought many friends when they are out visiting there have never been any disappointed.

We don't mind to wait for one hour if the food is worth it.... We went today ( 3 of us) before they open the store .... Sign our name and wait for our turn, and we realize they only call up party for two , doesn't matter how early u come, and after they sit us down , we feel rush and uncomfortable ....The noodle is plain and we feel totally not worth it , even we adding a lot of topping still tastes plain , there is many noodle place out there 100 times better here !! Try flushing

This place was a cute find! I happened to be in the area and yelped dinner spots and this came up. The food was delicious! I had the prosciutto wrapped chicken with kale salad and cauliflower. I hate kale and somehow I loved the kale salad here. I give them 4 starts only because it took a while for the food to arrive. I will definitely try this place again.

first let's say you need to get a reservation to get in here and it might take quite a while. this is classic old school Italiano food, and you get what you pay for. any dish that you pic is outstanding.

The food was great but the service was bad. I had the worst experience ever. Im never going here again. I had my food and it was great. After i came from the restroom, i found out that one of the busboy dropped mussle on my dry cleaning jacket. It was my second time wearing it. I got so upset. I told the waiter what happened and the owner came. He tried to wipe it off but got worse. He offered desserts but i had lost my appetite. I asked him for dry cleaning service fee but he said to bring the receipt then he will reimburse. It's not about the dry cleaning. I was afraid if the stain ruin the jacket. And the jacket was not cheap. I argued with him for a few minutes and then he took out one of the dish from the check. Even though he did, the cost of the jacket and the dish are uncomparable.
Amazing brunch, dinner and drinks. It can get crowded and there's often a wait - but it's well worth it. I always leave happy.

Great place with great food! The staff is marvelous and the food is fantastic. Far better than subway, the quality is amazing. They have a lot of hot sauces that are incredible. Profoundly clean and organized.
They just re-opened. Thank the heavens!

Went to Entree this weekend with a party of 8.  Everyone had a fantastic meal.  The staff was wonderful.  I have food allergies and had no problems with the menu.  We had the wedge salad, prosciutto wrapped dates, mussels, salmon, steak, scallops, tuna and the fried Oreos.  I personally had the steak and it was cooked to perfection.  The place is small, so I would call for a reservation.
The rigatoni with prosciutto is the most delicious, comforting, heavenly, rich mmmm sorry, got distracted. This place and Fiat are my current fave SoHo Italian joints.

While in Time Square I checked Yelp for a place to eat, and this place had a high review rating so why not. The food was average, not worth of a 4.5 star rating. Every dish came out at a different time leaving other people at the table waiting, and to top it off I was charged for fries that were supposed to replace vegetables that came with my dish. Would've been nice to know they charged for substitutions before hand. The waitress was very nice. No kids menu. Wouldn't recommend it.

Fast service and quality sandwiches at a great price! Don't be discouraged if you walk in at lunch hour and there's 25 people by the deli counter (and there will be).  The staff is a well oiled machine and no matter how crowded it is, chances are you'll have your order in 10 minutes or less.  When you get in line to pay, have your cash or card out, because the two Asian ladies at the register are casino quick. The menu has over 50 items on it and most are in between $4.50 and $6.50.  Thats pretty good considering the location and quality of food you're getting. Definitely one of the best take out lunch places around.
The food is excellent . The decor  is beautiful  its a place I would take love ones .

I adore this restaurant. I love everything i have ever tried from here. Particularly their singapore mei fun and the bubble tea which i buy almost every time because it is so good. In addition to the food, the workers are super friendly. One worker in particular stands out as she is usually there when i visit. Her name is May. She deserves as much recognition as the food because she is very outgoing, hardworking and welcoming (and she's pretty too!) This is where i go whenever i am in the mood for chinese food because this location has the perfect combination of friendly, dedicated workers and delicious food.

once you get here you're really know what true pizza it's all about. in my opinion this is the best pizza anywhere. if you see a line out the door its because its that good. there's really not much more to say other than go there

We had a party of 8 on Saturday night. First of all, the waiter was super friendly and efficient. Everyone in our party was pleased with their meals. I have the tilapia livornese and the fish was fresh and prepared well. Salads were fresh and tasty. Almost all of us had dessert and or coffee. It is BYOB but they were very accommodating with wine glasses. Would definitely eat here again when we are in the area.

I've dined in previously before and loved the experience. The fried tomatoes were made just right, not too greasy and were crunchy yet tender on the inside.  The wings flavored in Chipotle BBQ sauce were also done well and over all the appetizers as a whole were very good.  I would recommend getting the sampler for two for the indecisive folks out there. However on a darker note, I would recommend never buying the Living Social deal for this place.  While the food is good, they force you to make the order two days in advance.  You can not redeem on the spot even though you had already paid in full for the voucher.  This is extremely inconvenient and this policy is strictly enforced even on less busy days such as a Monday.   I'd recommend either dining in or choosing someplace else for your takeout desires.

This place was phenomenal. We ordered the: Palak chaat - it was very good but I've had better in DC. The chutney used was great but sometimes you got pieces of spinach that seemed a little greasy) Ghobhi manchurian - by far my favorite dish of the night. Spicy and delicious. The cauliflower literally melted in your mouth. Vegetable korma - I did not have high expectations for this dish but it too was great. You could taste a little bit of coconut and a little lime and it was just so great. We also ordered the goat cheese naan and the garlic/onion/cilantro naan, both which were good. The servers were also really nice and attentive. Just overall a great atmosphere.
First time here and food is great.i ordered skert stake cuz one of my friend sugeated to give it a try so it was some great sous and included some chips Im gonna be back for more
This place is perfect for a date out just to catch up with your friends. Great happy hour  on Sundays.
Great Service, Good Food, Prices were descent.  I would definitely revisit.

Definitely popular when we called in without a reservation on Sunday evening around 6 ! Restaurant fully booked but they managed to find s place for us at the bar and we enjoyed a few small tasters from the menu. Falafel was perfect , pita just right and the coffee very authentic Turkish .  It's definitely worth a visit and for a popular New York spot we were blown away by the reasonable bill !
we love empanadas from here we have tried all the flavors

I made a reservation for brunch a week in advance for a Sunday at 11am. The hostess called the day before to make sure we were still coming, and I said yes. She then went on about how they're always so crowded for brunch and so many people want to eat there so she had to double check we were still coming, and I again said YES WE WILL BE THERE.  We arrived a little before 11am to an empty restaurant. The hostess boasted of the fresh food, and it seemed pretentious. But besides all the seemingly negative vibes we were getting, we really loved the set up of the restaurant and the food lived up to the hype. It was nice to sit at a restaurant where your elbows aren't grazing your neighbor sitting at the table behind you. Granted the restaurant was empty the entire time we were there so there was no potential elbow bumping, if it were packed as the hostess previously said it would be, we would still have been seated spaciously and comfortably. The food was great, so we'll be back.

Excellent!! Been away from NJ pizza for way too long. This was a great welcome home pie! Yes...a pie! Ready in 10 minutes and $12. Everything you expect in good pizza: crispy crust, stringy mozz, and delicious sauce.

Their brunch is the best.  Their new menu is the only reason I'm giving them four stars versus five starts.  They used to have literally the best eggs benedict ever.  It had proscutto, hollaindaise sauce and all on a biscuit.  AMAZING!  About a month ago they totally switched their entire menu and no longer serve that dish.  They replaced it with something similar except ham instead of the proscutto and added kale.  Weird but tasted good.  But it wasn't the same.  Still like the place though!
Great family celebration at Palermos III.  Every said the food was great.  Staff made everyone comfortable.  We will return.

We absolutely loved the pizza here. My family and I thought it was the best we ever had. We ordered a large pepperoni and an Italian sub. Both were great. I live in Colorado and haven't been able to find pizza half this good. Next time we visit, we will be eating here.

It's a Saturday night and I am driving down route 46 west from Caldwell for dinner and drinks.  All of the "standard" restaurants are packed so we drive further to Red Stone Tavern. I've been to this place many times so far and I love the food.  Plus it is extremely inexpensive in relation to its competition. When I arrive at 7:00 PM I am surprised by the number of available parking spots.  When I walk into the bar, it's practically empty.  Now I do not care since I am at Red Stone to eat dinner, but I was a little depressed by the lack of energy this place has on a saturday night. By the end my meal I felt the same as I did the first time I ate dinner at this establishment.  Because I love the food and think the bar is extremely nice I wanted to provide this feedback. 1) If this place does not do something quick to differentiate itself from Houlihans or other standard fare places, it will fail.   2) The bar is boring and has no energy or pizzazz. 3) The beer choices have barely changed in a year.  Even though I have suggested some new beers to this place, my requests have been ignored. (See below) 4) The staff, while very nice, is slow and dull.  No one smiles and most staff seem depressed to be working on a Saturday night because they are not making money. Here is my first thought: A dedicated, creative, Craft beer bar is what's drawing the crowds these days.  Red Stone is well positioned in-between two, known, Craft Beer Bars (Poor Henry's and Nicole's 10).   Red Stone has more of an upscale feel to it than a "local pub."  Between craft beer and the beautiful bar, this place should attract a decent clientele on a Saturday night. IMHO Red Stone cannot compete on food alone.  Nor is it a food factory like Houlihans, Buffalo Wild Wings or Tiffany's.  Maybe Red Stone can create a niche by adding more beer taps and more craft beers or by running more drink specials or even adding live music on the weekends. Whatever Red Stone does, it can only be an improvement over the drab, boring product it is currently offering.  Of course this is just one man's opinion.  However, this is one man who actually took the time to write this review.
The food and service was excellent!  I have nothing negative to say!  Delicious!
One of my favorite spots. I like the decor and the wings are the best! The daily campur is a mixed offering and although not a large portion it's great to share and try a few different things.
The customer service is impeccable. Food is great quality. The food is also served pretty quickly! This is my new favorite place.
Awesome pirogies!! I dream about them! Very cool decor and a large space. Also the bartender Jared was great. I'm definitely looking forward to returning next time I'm in the area.

What a great new spot on the Island! Very modern decor giving you the Williamsburg feel.  The waiter we had named Jamal was great! He explained the beer menu to a T with no pressure to buy. We had the sampler which gives you 4 beers in a cute 8 oz mason jar for only 12 bucks!   All the beers were great I forgot the names lol. The corn dip was delicious!!! I had chicken and waffles. Hubby had a burger and fries. My chicken wasn't that great honestly but the waffles were delicious. Nice and light but airy. Nice flavor. I really enjoyed it. Highly recommend this place to go out for drinks and eats if you want to stay local.
MOST AMAZING captain crunch chicken tenders!!! You can tell that they are hand breaded and cooked to order! DE-lish!!!
Probably the best burger place in philadelphia. Very delicious. I highly recommend it. The onion rings are so good!!

It's not just about the quality of the coffee, or the pastries, but rather the attitude of the people who serve you that makes the difference. There have been several instances when I came in with a negative attitude due to the cold weather, waking up too early, or just not being in a good mood; and left with a happy vibe because of the positive attitude that the workers have which naturally rubs off on you. I would definitely urge people to check this place out! Not to mention the coffee is great.

Came across this establishment while visiting friends in NJ. Exceptional sushi with personable chefs who truly provide a great overall dining experience. Ask them to recommend you a flavorful tea to complement your sushi selection! I would definitely recommend the Sushi&Sashimi set, Tempura box, and teriyaki options. Family friendly menu as well. Can't wait to visit again to try the Donburi and Yaki noodle menu!
The food is fabulous.  The restaurant is a dive.  Grab your food to go!
their food is delicious

The room is fit for many people whilst the ambiance is casual. The food deffinetely compensates for any negatives you may encounter. My family and I ordered summer roles which are almost always a must have at vietnamese restaraunts. Also, we bermechelli salad... Very tasty (eaten at room temp), bahn mi sandwhich... To die for, and shrimp pho... The broth had just the right tang, saltiness, and sweetness. I'd have to say, if you know what you're ordering, this place is not to be underestimated whether it's the other reviews or anything else.

Finally made it to Devil's Pocket for a quick Tuesday evening bite.  Our server Mikey was pretty good and we thought our burritos  and side salads were very good.  Salad is better than the salty ones served by RA.  We really want this place to succeed so it can continue to be our Go-To neighborhood place.   Wine choices too limited and not a very good quality.  What bar/restaurant does not stock a house Pinot Noir?  Would rather pay a few dollars more for better quality wine.  My mixed drink was good. Place was pretty quiet when we arrived and gal behind the bar didn't say hi or even acknowledge we entered the place.  Maybe an introvert - used to RA friendly bartenders.   TVs nice addition with the sound off.  We were able to have a nice conversation over dinner and drinks.   Menu needs more vegetarian appetizers and entrees.  Menu is typical bar menu but is far better then Ten Stone menu but still needs work.

1. It took about an hour and a half to get three things and I live ten minutes away. 2. They all arrived cold. 3. One item was made completely wrong and they refused to redeliver so grubhub had to refund me. Everything that was correct was mediocre.  I won't be ordering from them again.
I truly agree with all the other reviews. The view is amazing but entry is only for hotel guests so be aware of this.

Man oh man, is this place a mess!  We were seeing a show at the performing arts center and wanted some food and drinks beforehand.  We sat at the bar right before everything got crazy.  There was a new bartender that knew nothing.  There's a difference between: I'm a new bartender, but I've tended elsewhere and I know what I'm doing, and I've never bar tended ever, and I don't drink and I don't go to bars.   The dinner rush came, and it seemed like EVERY waiter was ignorant about the menu when they came  to the bar to pick up drinks.  Asking tons of questions about everything. THE FOOD WAS AWFUL!  I ordered some chicken dish and it was very bland.  The presentation was awful and it looked like a piece of boiled chicken thrown on top of some carrots.   My husband got the short rib, which was also very bland and COLD.  We would have complained and sent it back, but service was few and far between.   AND when there's a show there's NO happy hour, even though they advertise happy hour with no disclaimer.   Do yourself a favor and go anywhere else before a show.   There's some sort of buffet/bar upstairs that is the same restaurant, so I have no idea how their food will be.
Great food and loved the kid's menu. They have a changing table in the bathroom. Having a reservation was key, since the spot seemed popular on a Saturday night. Good, fast service.

While visiting Philly on business, I went to the Reading Terminal Market several times for lunch. Great selection and reasonable prices in a historic venue. If you visit the fresh fruit/veggie stands before they close you can get great deals as most of the normal bags of produce that go for $3-4 are marked down to a $1!

Make sure you park in the lot which gives one a much lower rate. Di Nic's has the best roast pork. Bassett's has the best ice cream. Metropolitan has the best chocolate chips.Then walk to Chinatown and buy a peking duck to take home.

Simple perfection, made with love, great service.... Had brunch, came back later to eat again. Always a nice crowd, people laughing, having a great time. Sit at the bar if Chris is bartending, Teresa is also a great server... Just good people with great hearts, an eye for detail, and amazing charisma. All around an excellent experience. Try the Dutch baby pancakes.... The burger... And work through the drink menu... All of it.
Exceptional services  Our service adviser ken Walter is phenomenal.
Without a doubt I am coming back again, They make delicious dishes and they are all worth trying. I really Enjoyed the meals.
Yumm, Yumm, YUMM!! Enough said!!
Really good thin crust pizza - and great service - a  great experience after cold trip to liberty
Loved the place.  Wonderful beer list and the big windows which draw on the environment.  Central enough to be a regular spot.  I look forward to going back.

100% hands down the best Cheese Steak I've had in my entire life. I was traveling around the country in Philly for a few days and befriended the owners and they were the nicest people I've ever met. Why waste your time at Geno's or Pat's when you can have this?

I made a stop here on my way to a concert and it didn't disappoint.  I had the Brasilian Mixto Wrap and it filled me up, I had to take half of it home with me.  The sitting is a little tight, but the employees were pleasant.  The Brigadeiro were so good, my daughter said they were better than mines.  Next time I'm in the area will definitely stop by.

Went on a Saturday so there was a bit of a wait but I thought it was worth it. I got the eggs Normandy, the yolk was orange, and the eggs tasted so fresh. Great coffee. Good price. Stayed so long that I even got dessert and a big pot of tea. Waiters were super nice as well.
We had a great pre-marathon dinner!  Rigatoni with Vodka sauce (for the runner) was fantastic and Chicken alla Romana (for the non-runner) was delicious.  Nice menu and nice service.

LOVED everything about this place! Food was amazing - get the duck, order an extra side of frites and p.s...the French onion soup is heaven on a cold night. The bread basket is also dangerously awesome and all baked in-house. Atmosphere was buzzing for a Tuesday night right before thanksgiving and while it's a big space it feels cozy. Our server Patrick deserves at least 6stars alone...the right balance of attentive without being pushy, knowledgable and helpful. Really loved this place and we will definitely be back!

I just been there today because someone recommended  this place. The food was great fresh and tasty I'm from Mexico and this is the first time I taste 100% mexican food  in Philadelphia...I'm just  disappointed with the service..  the waitress is a nice person but she gave me different service just to being Spanish, I saw that every single table got a full service because they are white people except us
刚从纽约旅行来到费城，一路上肚子饿得两眼冒星。查yelp就看到这个东北大烤串，就想起了大连的烧烤。­yelp上面的地址是错误的，其实就是反方向，还好电话没变,打电话就问到了具体地址。老板和老板娘人超赞­的，老板娘跟我一样是东北人，看着就呆人亲啊，烤串也不错，果然不辜负我期望啊。下次来费城我一定会再来吃­！

This place is great!!! Food is fresh and decent....and always great portions. Marathon is a chain of restaurants in Philly and the menu is always reasonably innovative. I've been coming to this place near Rittenhouse Square for years and the whole staff is always fantastic, accommodating and super friendly!! PLUS the happy hour prices are outstanding with great quality wines and beers for good prices! Good go to place for a decent and not so decadent expensive meal....and casual!  #WinWIN
The crepes are perfect and so delicious! Definitely get a bacon infused crepe. Service was excellent, cozy cute atmosphere. Only a few beers on tap but all very good.
Def the best Mediterranean out there. Must get the spread platter, the taverna special, the Greek salad and them lemon potatoes! Oh, and how could I forget.... the octopus that MELTS in your mouth!!

I wanted to love this place but I was sorely disappointed. First, the service seriously lacked- other than taking our order and delivering the food we never saw or spoke to anyone. The coffee was burnt and served w spoiled creamers to which the waitress neither apologized nor looked to take off the bill, though at least she brought me a fresh, burnt cup. The challah french toast was half way decent though considering they charge you for Brown and serve sausage I could get at the store I was definitely not impressed. To top things off when I paid the bill, I was asked out loud in front of other customers what I was going to leave for a tip bc I used a card- tacky. We won't visit again.

We waited for over a half-hour for our simple food after ordering (fried fish, chili dogs, and a quesadilla). It appeared that two servers served nine or ten tables, so this didn't appear to be the bottleneck. If the server had come by to apologize for the wait and let us know when our food would be up, that may have mitigated our impatience. We were actually afraid that our order had been lost. The food was good comfort food, but in the future we'll eat where we know the service is prompt.

A few of my friends and I wanted to try out a new place to eat and we had come across Update. From the moment we were seated, they were really very friendly. The food was very delicious. The only downside was they don't take reservations and you have to wait to be seated but other than that, i would definitely come back.

The Buffalina pizza is awesome! Also, some of my favorite Caesar salad( I'm very picky about caesars) I took away a star because although most of the time my experience is excellent I've been disappointed once or twice. On the whole- great place for a bite or dinner

After writing my review I received 2 nasty messages from the owner and someone else who works there. Clearly they don't understand that the point of yelp is to express your opinion. This is the type of people who are running this place, attacking customers because they didn't love everything about your restaurant is extremely unprofessional and uncalled for.
