Maybe they should realize they have some areas that need improvement and spend their time doing that rather than attacking me for expressing my opinion.  Btw if you scroll down to the not recommend reviews you will see other people who received this treatment after posting a bad review. I had to block the owner from sending me comments.

Yelp recommended this little Deli/Restaurant, I'm over on holiday for Thanksgiving from London England, and it couldn't of been better! We shared a cheese plate with fig and honey drizzled walnuts to start, it was divine... This place is great for carnivores and vegetarians. The Bacon Lattice Cheese Mac Pie was out of this world, couldn't finish it all so took the rest home. The mushroom, sprout gnocchi was delightful also.. The service was great, we brought a selection of cheeses to take home, aswell as chocolate cake and pumpkin cheese bar. This is a little gem of a place and will be returning again this week!....

My boyfriend and I wandered in here by chance the other night. We just wanted to enjoy a quick aperitif before dinner. What a pleasant find this adorable little restaurant was! The first floor was beautiful and had a bit of a modern touch to it. It was very homey and comfortable. What REALLY set this place apart, however, was the basement. The gent taking our order informed us it used to be a speakeasy during the prohibition era. The room downstairs was fairly small, but not in a claustrophobic kind of way (unless you can't stand low ceilings) and the lighting was impeccable- very romantic. The entire room was bathed in warm candle light with 1920's jazz music playing lazily in the background. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to impress a date. The mood is incredibly sexy and low-key. The drinks were very good too! I'm hoping to go back as soon as this next weekend rolls around and maybe try the food as well.

For authentic caribbean food (and/or dairy free food), Vital is the best! I was delighted with the level of service. The waitstaff were kind and very willing to answer any questions about the menu. The food was delicious and farm-to-table-fresh. I started off with AUTHENTIC jerk chicken wings, and plantains with black bean hummus. For my main dish I had the  the tamarind BBQ chicken, which was out of this world. Also, Vital has a great selection of drinks and shakes! I highly recommend their "milkless milk shake" with raw almonds and dates. Overall, Vital is a great bet if you are in the mood for caribbean fare, or if you have dietary restrictions that prevent you from having dairy.

We made our reservation a week ahead and can only get the table but not at the bar. It's our first time there, so omakase is a must. We choose to have a combination of sashimi and sushi. I also mentioned to the server that I love uni to make sure that it's included. EVERYTHING was sooooo good! And I must say that after trying their uni sushi, I cannot stop thinking about it! Toro melted in my mouth and I just wish that I can live in the restaurant forever.   Each of us had 5-6 different sashimi and 10 sushi and it was the perfect amount of food for us. (I stuffed my face when I went to Neta the last time....) The bill was about $125 each and I would love to go back again when I save up enough money. =P

Nice place, food tasted great! A little too noisy but you get used to it. The atmosphere that is created in the restaurant is really cosy. Spent a great time with quality food! Nice place for a diner with friends or for a date. Had a great advice for the wine pairing
mamma miaaaa! great spot for Italian cuisine lovers!  Sooo fresh and delicious! Thank you Gaia! :)

Beautiful space with beautiful dishes - that taste as wonderful as they look. If it's your first trip (and surely it will not be your last) get the dishes that make Scarpetta famous. Spaghetti, Duck & Foie Gras Ravioli, the Polenta, and indulge in the bread basket. This is no ordinary bread basket. If you're a Scarpetta vet, try the Halibut or any of the seasonal truffle dishes. The service is amazing and will remind you why people make reservations here up to a month in advance. That said, make a reservation. If you can't get one, order at the bar and check out the nergoni menu.

Great spot for breakfast and lunch in Newark. 5 star quality food, recipe, and affordable prices! Staff are welcoming and passionate about their level of service. Philly Cheesesteak so good it should be renamed Uptown Cheesesteak!

I just stopped in for a quick lunch and it was a wonderful experience! They have great menu with FRESH vegan options. Reasonably priced, chill place. The backyard looks awesome for warmer days!!! I'll be back!

So we ordered a few dishes that were ok,  not great. But one dish stood out. crunchy noodle or something like that with shrimp. it has undertones that reminded me of a urinal. when we asked if there was any way we could substitute it, with great hesitation, the answer the server answered that the owner insists we would get charged for it. now every now and then a dish might come out wrong, but the owner telling the servers they can't remediate the issue smells like this dish tasted.

Oh Cheryl... I heard about this restaurant from many of my friends so today I decided to do order delivery. I live literally 3 blocks from the restaurant.  I ordered (from the menu on their website)- Grilled Pork Chop au jus with Mango Chutney, French Beans and Roasted Potatoes, Grilled Burger with Grilled Onions, Tomatoes and Hand-cut French Fries and Fried Calamari with Chili Plum Sauce. You can't go wrong with that, right? I was told to wait 25 minutes... Delivery guy came after 1 hour!!!  You can imagine temperature of the food - it was cold! Food.. Oh Cheryl...Don't even get me started... Pork chop was overcooked and almost uneatable, overcooked burger came with very thick slice of raw onion, 1 thin slice of tomato and some crapy, generic french fries ... and that "chilli plum sauce" that came with calamari - I think I have the same bottle of sauce in my fridge. Please do yourself a favor and order from somewhere else.

I felt that it was over hyped.  Tried the flag ship Paitan ramen with the char siu pork and honestly, was a bit of a let down.  Not saying it wasn't good.  I've found Zutto on hudson street to have far better more tasty ramen soup options.  Their Tonkotsu ramen with pork check meat and ginger to be far better. Plus who wants to eat a meal with blasting club music in a hole in the ground (below street level), tight space, dirty, and the cooking area is questionable. Skip the hype about having to put your name on the clip board and then order at the door before you sit down.  The ramen version of the soup nazi on Seinfeld.

Kinoko Soup. Seriously - possibly the best soup I ever had, bar none. Everything is fresh and tasty. Did I tell you about their Kinoko Soup? Only complaint: vodka came out a bit watered down and drinks are pricey.

We order from here almost every week as my 3 yr old asks for sushi for brkfst, lunch & dinner. He gets an avocado roll. The sushi is always fresh... very consistent. Their fried rice is way better than any Chinese rest rice I've ever had. It's very light full of veggies and I feel good about giving it to my kids. Chinese rest food always leave us feeling dehydrated all night probably from high sodium. The value at this place is incredible! Any other sushi place usually costs double. For this reason we can order sushi sometimes twice a week for dinner. Yes, they're not very personable but it's a take out place. They're quietly polite and that's all I need. I'm not there to socialize. Just pick up my food and take it home.

The Roast Beef Sub is Excellent. The Bread is Fresh, the Roast Beef is Rare to Medium.   The way they cut the Lettuce and Onions is the right way...    I've had my friends from the Bronx come up and they can't belie a place outside of the Bronx can make such a good wedge.
Good affordable take out food for chinese
Dumplings were great.  Very juicy and flavorful.  Ordered the steamed buns, but they were not as great.  A bit chewy and too doughy.  Will be back for the dumplings again.

I can deal with having to wait for a table, but having to put up with waiters and waitresses that care more about whether you are SHARING food, rather than giving you good service, is something that I cannot put up with.  I have eaten here on several occasions, and though the prices have crept up steadily, the service has headed in the opposite direction.  Its not necessary to tell the customer over and over again that sharing is not allowed.  Telling them once is enough.  Staff at this restaurant (ours was a lady named Chen) should spend less time harassing their customers, and worry more about other things - like getting a customers food order correct, and cooking a customers food properly.
so slow!!!!! Wait for the cuisine for looooooong time ! Oh my god. And waiter is indifferent and cold!

Its been a long time since I've ventured into McLadden's, once a regular to the West Hartford scene, I tend to stay away especially after eleven for obvious reasons.  I usta love this place!  A couple days ago a group of us stopped in for a late afternoon beer.  I was surprised by the overwhelming selection of beers.  Our bartender Steve was great!  He was very knowledge of the beers and helped us narrow our choices.  The bar defiantly draws a young crowd, but I'll be back that is for Happy hour....

Really enjoyed this place...visited for a delicious lunch mid-week, comfortable sitting and good service; then returned couple nights later for busy, lively, music-filled night-life. Excellent bar menu and bartenders; good looking women in the crowd. Great location, middle of the block on LaSalle Road in the heart of West Hartford Center.
I have been to this bar many times and what keeps me coming back is the staff, especially Steve. He is always attentive and serves great drinks.

Most amazing burger and truffle fries!!! The ribs fall off the bone, finger licking good, I was bummed that I was sharing them with my friends, next time I'll order a whole plate just for myself! Great atmosphere in each of the separate bars and dining areas! The Irish pub is downstairs, very casual and traditional Irish fare with darts and tv's.  The bar upstairs serves everything and the dining room is a cross between a casual sports bar and a really nice restaurant, depending on where you sit.   From the main dining room You can't even hear the Live music playing in the front bar, Jazz on Thursday's (I think).   Overall, Ricalton's Village Tavern is Fabulous!!! I've been there 3 times in the past 2 weeks and I'm looking forward to going back!
This was a great place. Much better than Momofuko . Fun upbeat atmosphere and great food. Good price point as well.

The only reason I'm giving this 1 star is because the food is edible.  2 of us walked in shortly after 9 pm on a Tuesday.  There was no hostess so we sat ourselves at a high top next to the bar.  The bar area was crowded, but the server who was handling our 7 table section never looked up to acknowledge us.  After 25 minutes, literally 25 minutes he looked up and asked us if we were being helped.  I said nope, and he said someone else would be right with us. 7 minutes later the server came over.  He was a nice guy.  We thought the evening was about to turn itself around, but after taking another 10 minutes to deliver us menus and our drinks I knew the lack luster service was going to continue. I was looking around to see who was in charge.  Maybe that was the problem.  There was nobody in the room managing the place.  I've never seen a bar and wait staff look down so much.  No acknowledgement of the patrons, just a cold feel. My girlfriend and I got sick of waiting for our second round of drinks that were sitting in the wait station for a good 5 minutes, so we got up and served them to ourselves. The stuffed mushrooms were a decent app.  I got the chef special seafood pasta.  It was good, but was missing the sautéed spinach that was supposed to come with it according to the menu.  Kim's raviolis weren't cooked through. It's a shame, this place has potential to be so good, but they are lacking leadership.
The best thing about this is they can make great smores. The marshmallows are delicious. I also like how you can order online and pick it up. Including on the phone which is much reliable.

Not Impressed at all.  Went because of the high rating on Zagat.. dont know where they got it.  Went to celebrate a daughters birthday.  The calamari appetizer was fishy and the tomato sauce accompanying was uneventful.   I ordered the filet mignon and expected a nice piece of meat for the cost - rec'd a tail piece which was gamey and a complete turn off.  My daughter had the Veal marsala - the veal was thick and I suspect it was chicken.  My significant other rec'd paella and the lobster tail was over cooked and tough.  Spanish rice was not flavorful same w/ veggies.  The only thing that I enjoyed was the Spanish Potatoes!  Proceed w/ caution.. !  We drove up from the shore.. total disapointment!

+++ This place serve great food. I like to go for lunch during the week, because it can be overcrowded during the week-end. Plus I prefer the lunch menu, with Bacon Egg & Cheese sandwich (with crispy string fries), the blueberry pancakes, and waffle/ricotta/fresh fruits. A-ma-zing. You can also try the Kale Salad if you're not afraid of (very) thick slices of (very) greasy bacon. The lemon and cream sauce worth it. -- I must admit that I prefer the Williamsburg spot, though. Service is faster, waiters are much more professionals. It can take ages to get a table at LES location... EVEN when there's a lot empty table !! Last week my husband and I waited for 15 minutes at the front door when  waiters were laughing together at the bar, just because they hadn't clean tables yet.... And then, they propose a table in the back of the restaurant while there was lot of space on the front (and no one came later)... I don't know what there were trying to do... Also, get use to wait for 10/15 minutes to be served between each course, BUT they like to bring the check before we have any chance to ask for a dessert !!! Bad habits. The music is greeeat for lunch (good time old rock n'roll...!) but they like to turn on the volume with crapy Rn'B (2 hours of Boys II Men... WTF ???) during the evening. Pick a side !

"Amazing food and customer service beyond expectations!!! It was a delightful dinner and special occasion that I am glad to have shared with some of the Rat's Restaurant staff.  I could give you more minor details if you wish to email me.  (john_calderone2003@yahoo…) You see, let me explain by giving you a quick overview.  I pulled a fast surprise on my girlfriend, now fiancée, for my birthday dinner, on a busy Saturday evening at Rat's.  I had them bring a desert that was marked "will you marry me?"  A lot of preparations had to be communicated to the management (some might say I was kind of annoying, even picking the exact table to sit at) The General Manager, Richard, was away on travels but quickly forwarded my email to the Assistant Manager, Alan.  Within a day, Alan emailed me ensuring everything was setup and they can handle the requests for such a special occasion.   I even asked the management to be able to take a quick picture or video of the occasion during the proposal.  Much to my dismay, after the proposal, I had 5 video's sitting in my email inbox.  There was even a video of making of the desert plate and its meticulous detailed heart. As for the food, absolutely amazing flavors.  I have been to famous food network chef's restaurant, as well as some dives.  This food is absolutely a memorable meal that compares to some of the best celeb chef's.  I started with the grilled Spanish octopus, while my fiancée had the Provençal Mezze for the Table.  The octopus was so tender and palatable.  The Provencal mezze had an array of humus, olives, quinoa, and eggplant tapenade.  For our entrée's, I tried the tasting of the lamb while my fiancée had the filet.  The lamb was perfectly cooked to my liking, while my fiancée's filet was a bit tough, but the manager quickly addressed this immediately. Thank you, Rat's staff, for making this engagement proposal a very memorable."
Love love love the food. Very warm environment and the service was spectacular. Penne Vodka was just so delish. Im becoming a regular!!!

Dissapoitning across the board. We went for hand pulled ale. It was not what we expected having been to England many times. They were out of 3 other drafts. Is this a British pub that doesn't have any British beer? Try Oconnelys down the street

dined here because it was so highly recommended on yelp... probably some of the worst italian food i've had in the city, or honestly, anywhere. im not one to write reviews, and maybe it was an off night, but fair warning to those, like me, who read yelp reviews, go to restaurants and are disappointed/ confused THIS PLACE SUCKED.  not one decent dish- brussels sprout salad overdressed, risotto was undercooked (not al dente just undercooked) and sitting in a bath of oil and balsamic, also had chunks of apples, like wtf? how do you eff up risotto that bad? thought something simpler would be better.. bucatini with pepper and pecorino.. it was gross, actually swimming in olive oil... like how? three ingredients.. i wanna know how. then chicken, which was the best in comparison but by no means good. anyways, ate here  a month ago, still thinking about it, i am not a psycho yelp person, written 2 reviews,its just that bad.

Went to grab some dinner with some friends and this place was great. The food was you're typical southern food but it was good. The mac and cheese was my favorite. They had a special on drinks and buckets of beer. The waiter wasn't really doing her job. Instead of her coming to check on us we had to look for her.

This was an amazing find while on a business trip. The staff let me know what I should order and I actually sat next to the owner. The food was great and each piece was like a little work of art. If you are in the area I would highly recommend stopping in for a bite!!!
Their food is inconsistent, sometimes it's decent sometimes it's terrible. Don't order a burger here if your idea of a burger isn't meatloaf on a bun.

I've been ordering from Chicken Galore for years.  Every time I order their wings, I get compliments on them and get asked where I got them from.  I also highly recommend the chicken and ribs there as well.
The sandwiches here were good since they were freshly made. The pork belly sandwich was the best on the menu,
Hands down best cocktails I've had in the city. The bearded alchemist has special powers, I tell you.
I had always heard about Eight Turn Crepe. I am in love with this place. Their crepes are to die for. The fruits are fresh, everything just worked well together.
Best pizza ever! Wrap your mouth around the hell boy.. Most authentic pizza in Brooklyn!
I think Heirloom serves up the best food in New Haven, however the service is inconsistent at best.  They should focus on hospitality and the details of service. The food deserves it.
Koch's used to be a great deli before the original owners passed away. Now the sandwiches are tiny compared to how the used to be and the service sucks. Definitely a let down and I won't be back.
Great food, long line, yet I was mostly impressed by its good service.

I never write on YELP but felt the need to write tonight about my experience at La Pulperia, UES.  I came with a friend and we sat at the bar which was a nice set up. We started off with a happy hour tequila cocktail- it was delicious and then empanadas- also awesome!  The fall salad was delicious and full of fresh ingredients.The employees were the perfect amount of friendly and hospitable without being over bearing.   I go out to eat a lot in NYC and I was impressed by the taste of the food, the service, and the atmosphere here.    This place seems like it would work well for large groups, dates, and families (there is a large space in the back).

This place was almost my favorite until I wanted  pizza on Monday, I didn't get it because it was closed. Then I tried on Tuesday NOPE! They had a private party for some guy with his face on sticks. Lucky for him he got pizza I on the other hand did not.

My wife and I go for the  Dinner Special's.   Soup or Salad and choice of Entree's. The Soup choices are usually two. I have not had a bad tasting soup.   I usually order the Chicken Parmigiana dinner with Pasta.   The Portion is HUGE.   More than one person can eat!   I do go back and ask for more sauce for the Spaghetti.       I'm not sure where they get there French Bread from, but it's incredible!
great fresh noodles and really nice people who work there.  get the cucumber salad and the standard noodle soup.  maybe toss some dumplings in the soup.  cheap and great.  does the body good.

I got delivery from this place and was excited b/c the menu looked good. However, upon arrival the delivery guy buzzed and stated that he was "out front." when I said, "ok," he repeated that and asked if I wanted him to bring the food to my door. I'm,yeah,that's why I ordered DELIVERY. Then, I  found out that I was missing an item(the guy gave me my food and ran off before I could check). I called e restaurant and told them I was missing an item,and they claimed they would send someone back over with it. An hour later, no sign of e food, and I called back, at which point the person on the phone said, "So, what, you want a refund or something." I actually wanted the food,but clearly that wasn't going to happen so I said yes. Then I was told that I would need to get the refund via grub hub, and he hung up. Lovely service- well,at least grub hub came through with the refund.
This pizza is gross. See the picture. That's what they gave me when I ordered three pieces. The pizza was not fit for human consumption.

This review is based on 2 visits. If the first visit was as good as the second, the rating would be 5 stars, not 4. The first visit was Saturday night, November 1st. The food was great, but the service awful. They were very, very busy. The waitress made several mistakes. One main didn't show up, she made excuses. A round of drinks was forgotten. The manager came over and spoke to us, she was very nice. We got some free shrimp cocktail. Dinner took a little less than two hours! When we were ready to leave, the manager brought the check over. She took off two of the four mains that we ordered, not just the late one. She also gave us two $50 gift certificates and invited us to give them another try. This past Friday, we did so. Totally different experience. This waitress, Loren, was great. The manager remembered us and sent us each a complementry plate. The food was great, the service was great, the drinks were large. I will go back another time.

I really wanted to love toast. It's quaint and cozy, and it was a perfect place to hop on a call while on my layover in Philadelphia. I figured I'd get a latte and some food while there. The latte was upwards of $4 for a small. I also ordered a turkey sausage grilled cheese, which I believe was around $10. We sat down and availed ourselves to the free wifi (great perk) while waiting for our food, which came within 15 mins. I took a bite of my crunchy grilled cheese, which was basically the size of a wonder bread slice, and was immediately horrified. This is not a grilled cheese with turkey sausage; this is a fucking abomination. I spread the sandwich and there was ONE slice of cheese on it--it was so dry that it wasn't even gooey or sticky. Also, there was ONE turkey sausage link that was sliced in half and spread diagonally across the sandwich. I would say that approximately 70% of the sandwich was turkey-less. The server happened to be nearby so my boyfriend said something about how the grilled cheese had no cheese...and he happily took it back and made a new one, with more cheese and the same amount of turkey sausage. It was a nice gesture but honestly, it's highway robbery to serve that sandwich and charge $10 for it. At the very most that sandwich costs $2 to make...and I'm including the side of salad greens. Overall, toast needs to step up their game. A little less stingy with the cheese, Some small tweaks to the menu, and slightly more reasonable prices, and the place would be great.

I ordered the pappardelle ($19) with high expectations, but what came out was mushy -- both the pasta and the ragu, and overly salty. It might have been slightly better if I didn't tell them I was in a hurry, but still it was really disappointing that this can ever happen to a restaurant. I'd be willing to give them another chance but I don't live in NYC.
Still my favorite.
Great restaurant, great bar, great kitchen, great Boss !!! One of my favorite restaurant in NYC !
Just an all around great meal. Expected a corporate experience but was surprised by level of service and creativity in the menu. All four at dinner were quite impressed.
very delicious! nothing to complain, maybe there are too much tofu in the tofu soup...

Met a friend here for a pastry and coffee.  Place was packed midday on a Saturday but the servers accommodated us outside (with heaters on) until an inside table opened up.  Lovely apple strudel...and some other tempting choices. Excellent service...I'll be back to try some of the other temptations.

Obao is one of my favorite place in Hell's kitchen area. The atmosphere is very romantic. it is perfect for a date or just a casual meal with friends. my favorite item is Spareribs on sugarcane, Pho Bo , and Beef Luclak things to note- 1 The Portion of Pho Bo is very big. 2 spareribs on sugarcane is actually a thin slice of spareribs wrapped around sugarcane.3 you will need to make a reservation during the dinner time. It is always packed!
Absolutely amazing guacamole!!
Delicious and fast lunch specials! One of the better choices in the area.

The food was really good. A step up from regular Chinese places. However, the service wasn't great. Kind of rude to be frank. My party of 4 (all middle aged adults) ordered a large amount of food and as soon as we started eating they gave us the check.  One minute later, the waitress came back to collect it and we were shocked that we had to stop eating to figure out the bill in front of her. Also, while still eating, they started closing the lights at 10pm saying they were closing. The main waiter seemed very bothered and short with everyone as well. Probably just his personality but not very welcoming. Service does not match the food.

Catered is a 'Boro tradition and icon. Continued our pre-thanksgiving tradition of lunch at catered.  Fresh sandwiches and bread are always available, but the real treat is the way each customer is treated like a friend and a much welcomed customer.  Karen, Pete, Ruben and staff are top shelf people making a difference with great food and hospitality in Hillsborough
A great place to get some of the best foods of NYC.  The careful preparation and great taste, and for a very reasonable price . it a really good choice , lots of veggie options.

This place customer service is one of the worst !!!! My girlfriend & I grab a drink and a bite there. We were there for 1 1/2 hour ... The waiter gave us a check when we were still eating then he kept on walking by to peak if we were going to pay ... Then another waiter came by few times and did the same thing.... We told them we were not ready. 10 mins later he came back he told us sorry we have two people as waited for a table ... We were furious what is there to do with us ????? Go tell another table that !!!! One thing I can't stand the most is every custom coming to your restaurant should be treated equally & customer service is the key to maintain a good busy besides good food! So I really just want to lay it out there about our experience as a first time customer !!!! One thing for sure is we will never go back again !!!!!!!!!
Loved the lamb shoulder entree - one of the best I've had.  Salmon was fantastic as well.
Incredible. Order from here ALL the TIME.

We came here with friends for brunch on a cold Sunday afternoon. Surprisingly, it wasnt packed, which was a great thing for us. We had amazing service, all our requests were delivered very fast and with smile. Food was really good. We have been to a lot of brunches in the area and I though that selection was great and food was delicious for just $13.50. I think it will become our new favourite brunch spot, very cozy atmosphere!

This place is just wonderful. I've never had such refreshing food. The service is great. They are slow sometimes so if you're going to eat in make sure you have at least an hour to hang out. The festive feel is really nice too. The portions are very large, and inexpensive. My favorites: Horchata drink (milky, cinnamon) Enchiladas Steak w/mushrooms Flautas
Everything was delicious. I had the skate and kale salad some time ago and I still think about it but each plate in our party was extremely pleased with their order.

One of the best and most unique restaurants in New York without a doubt!! The food was amazing and the servers were really friendly and attentive. I had the Burger with the lot and my friend had the lamp lollies-both phenomenal!! I loved how the owner came to our table to talk to us about the food, explain what is what and how the food is prepared. Definetely going back!! P.S. When you go don't forget to order the Triple T tiramisu for dessert...trust me on this!!
I was reimbursed within days. GREAT customer service! I will give this spot another try!

I ordered three things. Cup of Lobster Bisque was ok. They topped it with two big chunks of Lobster meat which was a nice touch but the overall soup was eh. I only ate half of it. The Lobster roll wasn't great for the price. I got it CT style with butter. The roll wasn't toasted and the lobster didn't have much flavor. Could have been picked meet from a couple days old. I also ordered the kids portion of fish and chips so I'd be able to try it and the fish was good. Had a great beer batter and was flaky and tasty. Overall, this place doesn't have a very warm atmosphere or great food for the prices. I'd say, go to J's crab shack or spend a little more and go to Max's Oyster Bar. I'd eat eat here lunch if my office was next door but that's about it.

I came here with a friend. The food was ok, not the best but in my opinion worth the price paid. I really liked the buffet style selection of side dishes (rice,plantains, salad, etc) 3 stars because it took 30 minutes to get our bill and the service was ok
We had a great time here for my parent's anniversary. The atmosphere was great, the food was good and the cocktails were fun and fancy. We'd definitely go back!

We made a reservation for 3 people online through the yelp app. We were seated and about 5-10 minutes later were asked to get up because they needed that table (table for 4) for a larger party that was coming. We ended up waiting another 15 minutes before being seated again. The food was OK. Most of the staff was not that friendly. But I will say the drinks were good. If when they asked us to get up after seating us they offered us a free drink at the bar while we waited as an apology for the inconvenience, I would have had much more respect for the establishment and how they treat their patrons. The kicker--the large group we had to give up our table for arrived almost an hour later (as we were finishing eating), so there was no need to make us move after all.
Great selection of food, from Italian dishes to various cheese selections. Conveniently located in Center City, right by City Hall, this is a great lunch (and tourist) destination.

The Reading Terminal Market has a great mix: dinners, delis, bakeries, bars, candy shops, cheese shops, coffee shops. Dinic's has America's best sandwich. Money Malloy's served an awesome fresh mushroom omelet. It's the perfect breakfast or lunch stop.

Do not eat at this restaurant!!! My entire family had food poisoning.  The food is spoiled, the workers in the back are extremely dirty.  The restaurant is dirty.  It's amazing the restaurant is still open despite several health code violations. The owner is horrible.

The beer selection at this place is fantastic, as is the service.  We went here for a company happy hour last night and there truly was something for everyone - including me, a loyal cider drinker.  They even have cider on tap!  NOBODY has cider on tap! The bartenders were super responsive and friendly. The only reason I take a star away is because they didn't do anything to change the absolutely awful layout that existed when it was Public House, and that was a big mistake in my opinion.  It results in a near-empty dining area and total congestion near the bar.  I REALLY wish they would have done something about it, but I guess its too late now.

This place is incredible. Go no further than the Burger for your first experience. It simply is the best burger you will ever eat! All the starters are delicious - especially the deviled eggs. Chowder is nice and for anyone adventurous, try any special of the day. Benoffee pie is the fantastic. Coffee and teas are nice.
Don't expect good service but the food is unbelievable. Order the soup dumplings...don't hesitate.

I been to this place several times, I do like their veggie sandwiches. But today I ordered their chicken shawarma, and it looked like dog food. I would not be surprise it was really dog food because the owner also owns a pet hotel in Soho.

Me of my favorite restaurants in the whole city!! There aren't many places left like this downtown. The owner greets you at the door every time you arrive and will ask you to go an grab a drink next door at Von until your table is ready. He then comes and grabs you and offers you to bring your drinks back next door to sit for your perfect Italian home style meal! It feels like being in someone's Italian grandmas house. Highly recommend! Great place for a bottle of wine with friends or loved ones.
Great food, great service, very reasonable price!

I love the food here, plus it has a great atmosphere. The food is always up to the standards of my picky taste buds. (Especially their chicken gyro) My only complaint is that sometimes the staff aren't the friendliest, but other than that I would definitely recommend it.
The pizza was burned!
I've been going to this place since I was 9 years old. Im 25 now and I still cant get enough of it. Whether its the square slices or the spamoni Ices I will never get tired of L&B's.

Hands down best pizza and calzone in NYC.  Yes the wait is long - call ahead and don't go on a Tuesday as theyre closed that day.  Well worth the wait.  The cheese calzone is incredible.  The crust is out of this world.  The cheese pie is simply the best thing on earth.
Pros: Potatoes!!!!!! Lots of variety and tons of options to choose from. Will come back to try other combinations. Cons: Portions could be slightly bigger.
Best pizza around these parts! I haven't lived in CT in 10 years and every time I come home I make sure to stop in and grab a pie at Wilsons. Highly recommend you so the same.

I had a great chance to visit this area. A friend of mine invited me to Orchard for dinner, he told me that this restaurant offers organic food. It was hard to believe without trying. A waitress, who took care of us, gave an advise to try whole trout and short rib. And it was wonderful. The fish was without bones and so crispy outside and juicy inside. Instead of main dish we ordered a couple appetizers, artichoke dip and shrimp to start. Everything was delicious. I tried Old Apple Tree cocktail and to be honest I wasn't  expected it could be so good. I'm really exiting with this place. The special atmosphere, good music and nice stuff made my night. Thank you guys for your great job. I'll definitely be back and take my friends with me.

Great place to get a quick lunch in midtown. Their pastrami sandwich with pickled jalapeños is fantastic. Their coffee is really good as well. Everything is always fresh, I love their creative panini selection.

They lose a star for being too expensive and only having 3 bar stools. I am definitely spoiled and used to open spaces - welcome to New York! However, they only have THREE stools, in total. So keep it moving! My coffee was $3.50 and I also had a little snack, mini baguette for $8ish. It was tasty, but again, i am still hungry - welcome to New York! The coffee itself was delicious and pure, smooth. Fig and goat cheese mini baguette was tasty. The staff was super nice, charming, funny. I definitely enjoyed my brief time here!  I will come again.

Everything i had in this place is greAt i live in garfield near passaic and paterson if u wNt a nice place to take your special someone this is the place kitchen closes at 12 Prices are a little more but is worth it nice clean place they close at 2-3 am pisco sour is great Lomo saltado te lo traen sizziling   Ceviche very good  yes porcions are measure but if u are a body builder or watch your figure u will be ok with it

Been waiting for the delivery for past an hour.. Called 3 times third time they told me that the guy was infront and no one was answering so he went back.. They didnt even let us know that they were outside no one called.. And they kept us waiting for nothing... Very poor service. They didnt even knocked on my door or call... Wont ever gonna buy pizza from here anymore

With menu in hand I called Jose's around 7:00pm on a Wednesday night, and asked politely, 'May I place and order for delivery?'. "Hold on", is what the woman told me. I waited patiently. It's rush hour, right? I waited some more, all the while hearing bustling and discussions going on in the establishment. I hung up thinking they forgot about me. I called back, and chuckled when a man now told me the same thing, "Hold on". I thought, 'How long can this go on?'. They MUST want my business, right? Is this a joke? Am I being punked? I literally held the line while watching Jeopardy for 23min and 55sec. (It became a principal thing after 10min) During this time, my BF used his cell phone to call them, and we got an answering machine. What I'm getting at is this is NOT a customer focused restaurant. Don't call here expecting service while hungry. If I hadn't eaten from here before, and know the food is half decent, I'd say stay away completely. Only call for delivery if you're not the thirty-minute-or-less type of person... or hungry... or impatient.

Very excited for grand opening of legit Soon Du Bu spot in the area. We had delicious tofu soup, kalbi and stone pot bibimbap. Just as good as Pal Park but a much shorter drive. Score!! Everyone who likes Korean food should go & keep them around

Overpriced pretentious.  Spent $100 for four tiny dishes. The food was interesting but nothing spectacular.  Eat before going if you must. Oh and BYOB even though the website shows a bar menu and doesn't say it.
The food is amazing here!!!!!  Very clean!  The whole staff is great.  Loved everything I ever ate here.

It must be so stressful to work at an airport restaurant - it's Thanksgiving morning and a storm is rolling in and this place is packed with grumpy travellers but the staff is so so nice! Especially Brian M-he's been extra accommodating to us and even though the food is just okay (hence the 4 stars) the service more than makes up for this! A little kindness and patience goes a long way. I recommend the egg and cheese sandwich with lettuce, and a touch of mayo. You can even stay for a cocktail after!! :)
One of the best meals in the city.  The oysters and mussels are epic.  Chef guy is a gem. Don't miss the desserts either.

I searched Yelp by star ratings and proximity to our hotel for a restaurant - wow!  Yelpers did not fail us!!!  This was a most excellent meal.  We ordered a hummus/falafel plate, Greek salad, and eggplant dish.  All were delicious!  The atmosphere is more of a take out, casual type of place - no table service - it was very clean and well appointed with middle eastern decor, and very friendly employees.  The only complaint I have is that they charge $1 for a small, albeit delicious, pita, but it was so good I'm not even going to dock a star!  Yum!!!!

The best thing that's happened to this area is this market.   The food is always amazing...if you want to bring home dinner or get a sub..by far the best quality.  They make everything there..the bread is to die for!  Joe Clemente is an awesome chef and I really can't say enough good things other than you get excellent quality for the money.  The sub's are probably the best I have ever eaten in my life and I am an expert on sub's..lol They are like going to NYC or South Philly..just super close to home and oh so good... Try this place out once and you will be a customer for life!
Underbar frukost. med alla tillval kommer du lätt upp i 50 dollar för två personer dock... Men det liknar något man skulle hitta på Söder i Stockholm och det är unikt i den här stan.

If you like oversalted and burnt pizza this is the place to go. The wait is ridiculous and the pizza is even worse.  Will never go back - there are too many other pizza places around NYC to try before I go here again and the pizza shop itself is a dump.  So gross.

This place was awful. Lousy waitress. Inexpensive and you get what you pay for. We just went for appetizers. Had the beef satay, tough meat, and the peanut sauce was ok, but cold! Had the tiger shrimp rolls, which was a mediocre shrimp, wrapped in a wonton and fried. That's it. Tom Yum soup was lukewarm, and WAY salty. Total disappointment. There's better places in Park Slope for sure!

Totto Ramen has sure changed! The restaurant has gotten too popular for its own good because they now SKIMP ON INGREDIENTS. Additionally, the quality of the meat is inferior to what it once was. The ramen is barely on par with few instant ramen I've had. It's time to reconsider Totto Ramen and go to the WEST VILLAGE!

My girlfriend loves taking me here! At first I was quizzical as it wasn't one of the amazing places that I take her to eat. When I sat down I was explained the menu and everything on it changes WITH what is in season so everything is fresh...alwAys! Major point! The only reason why I cannot give a five star is because the paint is bigger than the canvas. They serve you everything on a small wood plank and for messy eaters like my girlfriend makes for a bit so awesome white dress sorry guys ;)
Though the store is very small, but I saw so many people were in line. So I tired. The pork fried dumpling was amazing gooooooood！！！！

People who eat here have reported having spiritual revelations regarding their purpose on Earth, the true nature of the universe as well as deep insight into how to be the best person they possibly can. This is viewed by many as a spiritual awakening and what is often described as a rebirth. In addition, it is often reported that individuals feel they gain access to higher spiritual dimensions and make contact with various spiritual or extra-dimensional beings who can act as guides or healers,  take your order,  or just crack open the coldest Budweiser this side of Wyckoff..  I'd take a star off because of some mega babe model waitress that refused to swaddle me into a papoose and have me sleep off the rest of my meal strapped to her back, but I ALSO refuse to be defeated, and will be back.

Delicious scones and breads. The baguette is better than in most places in Paris. The soups sandwiches and panini are also very yummy. One of the best cappuccinos. The atmosphere is great, friendly service. The Hungarian rolls are a must to try. If you are in Burlington make sure you try this friendly cafe.

Visiting for the holidays.  I had the Hoagie omelet. Was with a party of 8. The omelets, home fries and pancakes were delicious!  Our server was Amy, and she was great. Quick, helpful, with a dose of humor!  Wish we lived closer!
Change your yelp time on when you actually close and I'll change my review. I walk in a bit before 11 and boom the shutdown!? Says you close much later

We were a party of 5. When we got there the hostess asked if we called & made a reservation.  We didn't.  They made a table work for us.  Service was slow since they only had 1 waitress. Prices we on the higher side, I had salmon which was $24. Very small dining area.  I won't go rushing back.

Great spot, great service and great sandwhiches.  I'm an Italian kid from n.newark and not many places outside of iron bound have the custard pies.   They are the ultimate favorite for dessert always.  The owner made a special order for me with trader Joe's cookie butter and cream. It was outstanding!  So happy theirs a place close to my home to go to now.

This place is worth the hype. I've had my fair share of ramen and I know good ramen when I have one. AND THIS IS GREAT RAMEN. I had the pork buns: must try! Karaka Ramen: very delicious! We got there right when they opened and there was already a line out the door. Expect to wait if you don't come when they open their doors. Otherwise it can be up to a two hour wait. A must on your list if you are a ramen lover when in NY!

Came here last night to meet a few old friends for dinner and beers.  We were all blown away!  The space is clean, crisp, open and inviting, with beautiful exposed brick, plenty of seating and standing room.  The atmosphere was warm and friendly, great background music, not too loud for conversation.  The waitstaff was cheerful, enthusiastic, and knowledgable.  Overall a really cool, friendly, and inviting vibe. The beer was fantastic!  Flavorful, fresh, and delicious.  Especially the 117 Pale Ale, Evolve IPA II, and Fritzie's Lager.  10 beers on tap all made in house!!!  Our group tried every single one, and they were all amazing!  So refreshing to see a local brewpub make really good beer!  Close your eyes and point at the beer list, you will not be disappointed.   The food was incredible!   I started with the Bryan's pretzels & Fritzie's fondue appetizer.  Generous portions, enough for sharing, perfectly baked and salted pretzels, delicious beercheese and spicy mustard dipping sauces.   For the main course, I had the Flat Iron Steak.  It came out superbly cooked, (medium, as requested) cut and served on top of a bed of diced sweet potato and brussel sprouts with at the perfect sauce to compliment.  I cannot say enough about how delicious this entree was.  The best plate I have had in months, hands down!   After a few more beers, a friend and I split the Smashed Fingerlings from the 'Bar Bites' menu.  These too were so tasty and perfectly paired with Fritzie's fondue.  Amazing alternative to greasy fries!  Better tasting and healthier! A 5 star experience all around!  Absolutely recommend 2nd Story to anyone and everyone!  Perfect to meet a group of friends for dinner or drinks, I saw a handful of couples who seemed to be enjoying themselves - so great date spot, and perfect atmosphere for an afterwork happy hour.  I will definitely be returning soon and often! I picked up a growler to go of the Evolve IPA II.  Can't wait to share this great beer and experience with more friends and family!

My wife and I love stopping by the Swann Lounge (adjacent to the Fountain Restaurant in the hotel) for a drink when we are in Philly.   It is a very relaxing atmosphere with many couches and comfortable chairs.  There are also large windows which let you look out onto the Parkway.  The service is always top notch and very accommodating.  For example, we once stopped in late and were in the mood for a little snack and asked if they could make us french fries.  Even though they were not on the menu our server brought out a basket of fries that tasted delicious.  The cocktails are great too and the wine pours are generous.  We are also huge fans of the trail mix that they provide for free.  On the weekends they have live music which is always enjoyable. We have also dined at the Fountain Restaurant and the food/service is phenomenal.  If you are looking for a restaurant for a special occasion, or simply want great food and service, then this is the place to go.

The Place: Took my girlfriend to Skara Estiatorio for Dinner Saturday night at 6:15. The place was about ¼ full when we arrived. We were greeted with a smile and asked if we would like to check our coats. We were seated at a table near the front. The place isn't large, but we certainly didn't feel like we were on top of the next table. In a shocking development, they actually had Salt and Pepper shakers on the table!! Lately it seems that every restaurant we go to we have to ask for them. Oh, and the salt was "Himalayan Sea Salt"... in case you're into that. The place was well lit (we could read the menus without the help of a flashlight app), clean and while I wouldn't consider it an overly romantic spot, it wasn't very noisy either.   The Staff: Our server was Andrea. She was extremely helpful, friendly, knowledgeable and apparently tried every item on the menu. It's important that we don't feel rushed, as reviewing the menu items can take us about an hour..... at any rate, we never felt rushed and by the time we got around to ordering our main course (it's a BYOB, by the way), the place had pretty much filled up. The owner came over to our table on more than one occasion during dinner and seemed genuinely interested in our experience. Great guy, super nice. The Food: We ordered two appetizers - the Skara Eggplant and the Wrapped Feta. The eggplant was a bit bland, but still tasted good. The Wrapped Feta was outstanding. For our main course, we both ordered one of the specials. We ordered the Moshari Stifado - (braised beef) and the Lamb Shank Lemonato which is severed over potatoes. Both were delicious and tender. The portion size was more than adequate. The Moshari Stifado was large enough to allow half to be taken home. For dessert our server recommended the Eck-Mek... it's like a firm custard with whipped cream (homemade of course), over a unique crust that I really can't explain. It was covered with Caramel. Fantastic!! Highly recommend it. In summary, I highly recommend Skara Estiatorio and will definitely go again.
Food was delicious but service so so. Our Server was not very attentive.

Excellent atmosphere. The server was really sweet and friendly and seriously insanely delicious shrimp and grits with well poached egg. And their signature fried chicken and waffles was spot on amazing. Crispy batter and moist chicken. The waffles were well prepared and the choice of three flavored butters (blueberry, Rosemary and lemon honey were all incredible) and also nice to get real maple syrup with it. Overall could not rave enough and can't wait to go back!

Great service and great food! Our group was accommodated after not having made reservations on a very busy Sunday afternoon. Wait staff were all very attentive and friendly, and we were served our food quickly. It was all delicious. Garlic cheesy bread is a must. All four of us finished every last bite of our meals! We were also given complimentary garlic bread and biscotti to take home which was a nice touch

BEST RESTAURANT IN HARTFORD! Hands down! The best service, food, atmosphere, and bang for your buck. I love the staff! There's never a sad face in that place.They should have a red carpet it's always VIP for locals.

The food is innovative and delicious! We ordered the chef's tasting menu and it was a lot of food for such a good price, they cater it based on food you tell them you like and dislike, during the meal they noticed we didn't really eat the duck dish (just personally don't like duck but looked good) and came out with an extra dish, on top of a great meal, the great drinks, very friendly staff and service made it a great experience, have been back 3 times since! MAKE SURE TO GET THE CARROTS!

Just enjoyed a family style meal with a party of 15 at Adrianna's. The food was delicious. From the burrata and tomato appetizer to the chicken cordon bleu, everything was done to perfection. It was impressive how well the staff was able to accommodate such a large party. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone in the New Haven area.

Every time we head up north to visit family, we stop at Rutt's Hut. I remember being intimidated by the look of a Ripper as a kid because I had never seen a hotdog that looked like that. These are absolutely some of the greatest hotdogs you will ever come by. The flavor combined with the crunch of a Ripper is an experience I can't describe, you've gotta try it for yourself.

First thing I always look at when I walk into a restaurant is how clean it is... This place is spotless .... And the food is delicious!!! My husband and I rarely ever go out to eat but we are buying a house in lyndhurst and after our home inspection we figured we would stop in for some dinner... We were both so pleasantly surprised how really great the food was! The arroz con pollo was delicious as well as the empanadas we ordered for an appetizer, probably the best I've had...my husband had steak with onions and he said it was really good also... Definitely recommend this place!!!

As someone that eats out almost 5 nights a week it is difficult to find a restaurant that excites me...I searched for a new haunt last minute on Saturday night and stumbled across Near and Far.  I grazed over the reviews and was uncertain as some very misguided individuals who posted some unflattering statements. I am not sure if they accidentally stumbled into the wrong restaurant but I cannot disagree more vehemently.  This place is fantastic!! Let's start with the food.  It is hands down the best fried chicken I have ever had the pleasure of eating...absolutely superb!!!!  The brussel sprouts were perfect...just enough salty and just enough sweet.  The burgers are done with such care you would think the chef had been preparing them for  hours..  Everyone in our party of 6 was thrilled with their orders...try everything! The service is friendly and the chef's sense of humor and sociability synched the deal for me.. This restaurant is small, creatively decorated and is thankfully not loud. Do  not go to Near and Far if you are looking for an in and out meal.  The food takes a bit of time to prepare with their small kitchen.  Go to Near and Far with good friends, conversation and the expectation to be beyond satisfied. I highly recommend everyone try this restaurant.
Good place to go with friends, food was good and like the tea.

The barnyard is a no-frills eatery in Totowa. It's in desperate need of modernization, coming straight to you from the 1970s in all of its glorious decor. The food is okay, large portion size makes up for the average taste. I had a bacon cheeseburger, medium well, and though it was cooked just right it was dripping in An excessive amount of grease (then again it was a bacon cheeseburger). It was not bad, but not great either. The waitstaff is kind and attentive; and their beer selection is relatively extensive. The saving grace of this restaurant is the volleyball court and outdoor patio in the back, which is great on a cool summer evening. Overall, the barnyard is an okay place if you're not a picky eater and do not care about ambience. However, I definitely would not bring a date there.
This is our all time favorite sushi in the area.  Service is fast, friendly and the sushi is absolutely delicious.  We've come back time and time.... and time again.

It's pricey but a unique dining experience. EVERYTHING I tasted was delicious and fresh. The regulars are very friendly. The atmosphere is like visiting your favorite family member's home for an elegant but not pretentious dinner with the neighbors invited. Loved it!

This place has a lot going for it. The lines are sometimes crazy, but well worth your wait. Obviously, your first choice should be the roast beef. I'm a fan of with onions. This is one of those places where they have that one item that everyone just has to check out the first time around and the roast beef is definitely it! The gravy is excellent! I can also recommend any of their parm sandwiches. All excellent. It's just a bit crowded at times and seems messy because they have long portions of time where they can only focus on making the food, so it might just look off-putting at first, but it really is a superb place to get good food quickly.

Terrible experience. Tried ordering sandwiches and it took them 2 hours to tell me they were on there way.  Then he got here and left to drop other deliveries before telling me he would be on his way back. 20 minutes later I decided to cancel the order and when I called back into the shop, they tried to put me on hold because they had OTHeR customers. Terrible customer service.

I've recently moved to the area, and have begun exploring some of the local restaurants.  This was by far my best stop yet. My girlfriend and I went on a snowy/rainy night, so the place wasn't too busy which was really nice.  The owner was awesome and took a lot of time to talk to us and go through the menu so we could both get exactly what we wanted.  The food was all unbelievably fresh and we could honestly tell the difference it made. Overall - every course was spot on, all the way down to the bread and pesto spread. We will definitely be returning, and would suggest this restaurant to anyone looking for an unbelievable meal at a completely reasonable cost

We wanted to try the Monk Room but it was closed so we came here instead and we were pleasantly surprised. We ordered a large clam casino pizza and it was a good size for the four of us. The pizza was good and staff was excellent.

I can't really review the food there because we never got it. I went there with my friend last Saturday. The restaurant was half full when we got there (about 6:05 pm). We placed our order within 5 minutes since they really don't have so many choices. And we waited an hour but still didn't get our food. The waitress stopped by twice and said the food was on the way, which never arrived until we left at 7:15 pm. Apparently they can't cook two burgers in 70 minutes.... Wish I could give them -5 stars:(

I went here with my mom and we went to order another drink and the waiter told us we weren't allowed to have more than one drink per person on the table. He made us feel like alcoholics when we just wanted a second glass of wine. Don't know why I keep going back but another time I went here I am pretty sure there was no alcohol in the mojito which I sent back and I hate doing that. Food is also pretty awful. Only redeeming thing is the cheesecake.

The food here is good, and the baked goods are always fresh. Their dinner menu is a good size and is pretty varied. The cod fritters were amazing, the artichoke salad is fresh & delicious and for the entree I'm a bigger fan of their pasta than their meat dishes. The decor is really cute and the atmosphere was laid back. The waitress was really attentive, and they didn't rush us out. One of my neighborhood favs!

Couldnt take a picture because i finnished so fast...i had a crepe with potatoes, bacon and french cheese.....yummyyyyyy! My friend had the shrimp crepe and she dint want to share :-) It was so good! And the service was the best! Very kind!!!!

My new sunday funday destination. NIX makes it cool and casual to hand downtown with the plastics. You are bound to run into a familiar face or two. Great Vibe and hidden in the most exclusive plaza in Adriaen's landing. Enjoy and support this hidden secret amongst the locals.

After a year of living in Philly I promised to break my Vegetarian fast only to eat at Genos Steaks because of the fame, and notoriety from the Boyz II Men MowtownPhilly video in the 1990's.  The service was kind, and the steak sandwich tasted like a steak sandwich.  It had Cheese, Steak, Beef and bread the end. I felt good having gone to 9th street and Passyunk on a nice day. The worker even let me take a photo of him after I asked.

What a nice homey restaurant.  Our family went to celebrate a birthday.  My sister has talked about this place for a long time.  We came for breakfast and was surprised at the line to get in.  But once inside we understood.  The cozy atmosphere was truly enjoyable. There were people of all ages and it felt right.  The food was delicious.  My favorite part of the meal was the rich hot chocolate. Perfect for the cold weather. When I come back to visit, I'll come again.  Well worth the wait in line :)

Hands down best chicken burrito in New York. I've been eating maybe 2-3 a week for the past year and I think it's time for a review. These guys have earned it! Hickory Smoked BBQ sauce from here is my obsession!
Best Spanish restaurant in the city hands down. I grew up in Spain and have been here at least 20 times for the extreme high quality delicious food. Keep up the great work !!

The wine was better then the food but the service was superb and the Creme Brule was nice.$400 for dinner for 2 people I was expecting better food and real truffle not truffle oil... gross. I can understand how people who think truffle oil is gourmet would think this was 5 star quality food but it is far from it. Excellent service though. The ambiance however too cramped for my style. We were stuck between 2 parties eating a lot of food on a tiny table we ordered more food and wine then we could fit on the table... but we still managed.  The people here didn't really care about the food more then they cared about checking in and being seen there. I wouldn't go back even though I live on the same block. It was definitely an interesting experience though.
I made a reservation through open table, had to confirm with a credit card and the hostess tried to fob me off at the bar. Service and food ok.

Craft Beers done right! The variety of craft beers is  extensive... constantly changing.  An all star line up on tap and plenty of  choices in bottle... that beez.in the trap is delicious! Beyond the craft beers, you got chicken and waffles that are airy. Fluffy, crunchy.. and glazed with a sauce your gonna be licking up.. corn.dip,brisket and mac and cheese that can't be beat! Chill out vibe, and simply good stuff!
I live on St Marks for a long time and its funny how hard it is to find a cozy spot sometimes. Love Paprika for its wine selection and delicious courses. Always great to have a dinner in this place.

Great pizza! I love how the cheese blend into the pizza itself! Very nice environment, great for winter cux the restaurant itself is really warm. Service is great and pizza is wonderful!! Must try in Brooklyn!

Recently went to an afternoon wedding at the Manor.   The food was so-so and the vegetables were under cooked. There was a smell under our table that was awful. Told the service people-but what could be done during a wedding. Cocktail hour had about 30 seats for 100 people-we gave our seats to the elderly.  Wine was terrible. Grounds were beautiful!  Glad it wasn't my wedding.
Lovely brunch. Great atmosphere food was delicious . Dean the owner was very hospitable.   Loved this place

My favorite pizza and sandwich shop that does more than that.  I am kind of sad I moved, but it's still not too far away!  Amazing pizza, sandwiches, pastas, apps, etc...  Their white pizza and special cheesesteak are  my two favorites!
I love this place for no frills dumplings when I'm in the mood.   In order the pork fried dumplings.  Always quick and very inexpensive.
Pricey for a hot dog, even with the trimmings, but it's delicious. The Zutto Japanese American Pub aren't really as flavorful as you might expect, though.
love the sushi here.....would go back

By far the best Sushi place i been too Even though there portions have become a bit smaller i still love the pork belly definitely worth a try. Party bomb also great way to go I love the environment and how close to home it is. I could see myself here once week
An adorable owner.  We felt welcome immediately.   Grateful for a drink and good company.
I have been here several times and absolutely love it!!! Spanish tapas. I recommend this place to all my friends! Love the fact that the small plates make you feel like your not eating too much!!!
Best falafel (that I've had) in NYC. Cheap and good! Also great is the lentil soup.

Food is just OK.  Actual Prices are 15 to 40 percent higher than posted in Yelp.  Felt cheated that prices must not have been updated in a very long time or worse its a bait and switch.  No sauce given with Calamari and given only 4 pieces of bread with $200 takeout order.  Better options nearby so I can't recommend.
Delicious seafood, incredible staff, and consistently amazing nights there. Get there early, tables fill fast.

I've really tried to have a good time here. Whether they are busy or not, the staff is too busy to serve (if they even remember you need to order food or drink), food takes forever, and drinks can be hit or miss. Pizza is great, but with all the good pizza nearby, is the bad service really worth it?

Although past meals here have been special, Thanksgiving dinner was an expensive disappointment. The normally attentive wait staff handled the four-course meal like it was assembly line work. Then again the food itself had an assembly line nature - far below the standard we had come to expect. My steak had the texture of cork. My wife barely touched her turkey as it too was dry, totally unremarkable, and diluted in an herb that overwhelmed the natural turkey flavor. Vegetables and sides were passable and minimal. Possibly the most disturbing element was the "Thanksgiving" music - a never ending loop of Vietnam era songs by the Doors, Rolling Stones, the Animals, Canned Heat, Joe Cocker, et al. All great stuff if you're having a pizza and a beer, but unexpected and inappropriate for a Thanksgiving meal that cost more than $200 per person with drinks. It was the wrong aural ingredient under any circumstance and particularly annoying when other senses were also being displeased. This meal wasn't just a slight miscue. For the price, it qualified as a true embarrassment.

4 stars. The food is great. Really delicious. We ordered a big order for a big group and everyone really enjoyed their meal. HOWEVER... I completely agree with 2 reviews before me... 1. THIS PLACE IS REALLY EXPENSIVE. 2. THE LADY WHO TAKES ORDERS OVER THE PHONE IS AGGRAVATINGLY RUDE. As I'm placing a big order, she tells me to hurry up and order quicker!!! I wasn't even taking my time! I let it go until the 3rd time she said "Quick, quick"... and I yelled back that I'm a customer and I'm making a big order from her business and that she needs to relax!!! She immediately changed her tone.   Then at the end of it all, she forgot the rice and we had to make another trip back to pick it up. Anyway... yes, we would order from there again because it was so tasty, but she's obnoxious and probably sets the prices as well.
Been there three times since it opened. Everything is great, especially the pork buns.  BYOB Yeah!!!

The food was great, especially the coconut dumplings which are a must. the only problem I had was the noises coming from the kitchen. The chef and his cooks seemed to be celebrating new years back there or something.

Best pizza in the city, imo. People giving this place only 4, 3 ect. stars must be referring to the unimpressive dining area, or the long wait you will likely encounter...they also must be nuts because...BEST PIZZA in NYC, heck, probably the country...and that's what this place is all about! not candle lit dining or attentive waiters (no waiters here)...but, best pizza in the city is a pretty big deal...how could it be anything but five stars!

My family and I just had thanksgiving dinner at Cheryl's and it was excellent! We are from New Orleans so it's hard to beat our southern cuisine. we decided this year that we didn't want to do all the work. This place did not disappoint. If you are looking for great food in Brooklyn, check it out.  I see some reviews say a Cheryl the owner is not as warm and friendly as some would like. well maybe, she is busy making that kick ass Mac n cheese or her delicious salmon. I will be going back and recommending to friends.

It was expensive but very good. If you're going to eat with 2 people I suggest you share a small pizza. We shared a large and it was too much for 2 people. The large is cut into 8 pieces but very big slices. Bigger than the plate they give you. I suggest you do half /half pizza. I really enjoyed the Italian raspberry and vanilla soda. So good!!

won't be back...gave this place a second chance hoping they needed to get things worked out since they were only open a few weeks and wanted to like it so much as the décor is great and Montclair could use an upscale Mexican place. First, the service...they seemed so enthusiastic but when you tell me - twice - you are going to bring me a new plate and then don't, I kind of feel that you were being insincere.  The food, the traditional guac was  a bit brighter and more plentiful the first time...the second time I ate there..not so much. The tacos..I had the al pastor and the pork belly one both times. With my second visit, both were much much drier. The corn off the cob was the HIGHLIGHT...very good with a bit of a kick. From the crudo menu, we had the ceviche (PS why they label the course as crudo when it's not is a bit suprising...) which was way too citrusy...couldn't enjoy it.  We had the chicken wings...bland is the best I can say about those...and finally, the churros...they looked delectable but undercooked inside. Oh, the chips are real tasty as is the green "salsa" that is brought out.  At the end of the day, it's about the food and service...not much here to make me come back...

My favorite place to stop while in Princeton.    Great fresh and local food, awesome atmosphere and decor as we'll as a friendly staff. I highly recommend the everything's better with bacon crepe, the baked goods and their cappuccino.   Well worth the wait

A nice bar and restaurant with dozens of exotic Belgium beers on tab and an absolutely staggering list of bottled beers from Europe and several states in USA. The mussels with Dijon are also excellent; when you finish the mussels it's good to order an extra Belgian frityes (fries) to go with the sauce. The Belgian fish and chips would be better if they were more lightly flavored.
Amazing, creative food. Friendly service with extra little snacks. They have such a cool, unusual wine list too. They were very helpful with my party's dietary restrictions. Definitely going back!

The combination of the friendly waitstaff and delicious homemade Italian fare at Adrianna's land it on my 5 star list. Chef Valentino came out upon our request so our party of 15 could praise his many dishes.  My personal favorite was the prosciutto stuffed chicken cutlet smothered in pink sauce.  The staff loved our company and made us feel right at home. They even loved that we brought homemade wine with us. If you're ever craving a true home cooked meal head over to Adrianna's on Grand St. in New Haven

Had dinner there last night.  As usual it was perfect! Bread and dipping sauce was fantastic to start the meal.  Veal parmigiana with penne and a house garden salad was perfect. Pasta primavera with chicken was also perfect.  The deserts and coffee finished off a great meal.  PS:  its a greast BYOB
Stopped over for happy hour wings with a few friends. I was really happy with the wings and the curly fries. $1.50 Coors Light pints was a plus. Atmosphere was family friendly. Will be back soon.
Eh
Best pizza in NYC! I make it a point to go here everytime I visit the city! Try the lasagna pizza

It has been almost a year since I first experienced the Spicy Miso at Mu Ramen and I almost forgot how truly great it is.  I was fortunate enough to be able to dine at Mu more than once this past week even though they only opened on Monday for their soft opening (I believe the official opening is Dec 1st).  Pete Wells (NY Times) was spot on in ranking Mu as his top Ramen spot in NYC last year and now they have taken another giant leap forward to distinguish themselves from all the other Ramen restaurants in NYC. Their new permanent spot is cozy and inviting; you can tell that alot of thought went into every aspect of the design at Mu.  We had a little wait before we could get seated but it's to be expected as a result of the large cult following on social media.  Once we were seated, we were warmly greeted by Heidy He (co-owner of Mu) and she quickly updated us on the menu since a few things have been added since their pop-up days.  My wife really appreciated the insight into each dish and the guidance provided.   We decided on the Okonomiyaki, the U&I, and the Gyouza for starters and then the Mu Ramen and Spicy Miso. I was going to add the Kakuni to my Spicy Miso but Heidy recommended the Pork Jowl instead and I'm glad I listened to her advice.  The Okonomiyaki was great and I loved the smoked trout on top.  My wife loved the U&I and I completely agreed with her.  I only wish the dish was bigger bc we were both fighting for the last few bites (she won).   Fortunately for me we still had the Gyouza and this was definitely my favorite dish.  Fried chicken stuffed with foie is just a genius idea and I plan on ordering this every time I come. For our main dishes, the Mu Ramen reminded me of a traditional Korean oxtail soup and I was immediately sold on this new addition to the menu after tasting the broth.  I was very surprised at how they were able to find the perfect balance of saltiness in the broth as typically for oxtail soups, you would add your own salt/pepper to get that perfect balance.  The Spicy Miso was everything I remembered and the add-on of pork jowl made this my favorite ramen of all time.   Mu Ramen is a great addition to the Long Island City neighborhood as we were definitely in need of a restaurant with not only a great environment but great food as well.

This is my late night must eat whenever I'm in the city. There is always a line, however it moves quickly. The chicken platter is my choice of calories along with the white and BBQ sauce! The sauces are located on the side of the food truck and there is also a beverage truck a few feet away.

Just ok for Chinese take out, ordered chicken with Chinese vegetables was some what bland . Maybe it was just me but I had better . I will give them another shot but I'll try something different next time. Good brown rice and friendly people there.

Since I am from China and I have tasted many Nanzhou (actually Lan Zhou in current Mandarin Chinese) noodles, I could say with confidence that the hand-drawn noodles served in this restaurant is quite authentic. The meat that comes with the noodle soup is also very good. The service however needs to be improved.

I love ordering from here and going out to eat! The only complaints that I have are 1)The music is WAYY too loud. You can't have a conversation without yelling. 2)The staff doesn't check on you, they just bring your food and take your plates. 4)You're crammed in there like sardines! But the food is great!

Had dinner here over the weekend. Pros - food was pretty tasty and fresh.   That's it! Cons - pretty expensive for hotpot - service was rushed.   Every time I put a plate down they take it away and asked if I  wanted to order anything else.   And I mean every time. -why do customers have to pay $15 for a soup broth?  I mean this is hot pot. Are we suppose to cook it in plain water? -why do I need to tip a acceptable amount.  I mean what service am I getting here?  All they do is enter your order on a tablet and bring it to your table.  I'm doing all the cooking. But in the end I still tip them 18%. Didn't want to be a as$. -your clothes will smell of hotpot once you leave.   No way to avoid this part.  I know we didn't.
Great pizza and great service. Friendly staff and owners as well. I especially like the grandma pizza and buffalo chicken pizza and I'm looking forward to trying more.

Under new ownership!! The sauce is much MUCH better now, it tastes more fresh than before, and is no longer this weird sour tomato goop. Had the Brooklyn pie and it was very very good. Would recommend again now that it's under new ownership!
oyster leaf! amazing service and wine

Just waited 38 minutes for soup...SOUP. Not to mention that my friend's grilled cheese was the consistency of soggy French toast and tasted like bathroom cleaner thanks to the mango chutney. Really disappointed.

The food was very very good. I had the Flounder (Sautéed filets topped with crab meat and served with parsley-lemon butter sauce, accompanied by ginger fried rice). The service was excellent and the atmosphere was cozy. The view is not the greatest, but I can live with that. I have recommended this Restaurant to everyone I know.

Went here two times before and I have to say that the food is sooooo delicious. I love the Katsu donburi. I ordered that two times as well~~ The first time I ordered was the Katsu Donburi and the green tea ice cream. The second time I just ordered Katsu donburi. The waiter was pretty nice. There was no wifi. I would really come here again since the food is so good.
excellent paninis , excellent service and the crepes are the toping on the cake.  Never had  bad dinner or lunch here. Great place to eat and i will be going back many times.
Every bit just got better and better! Unique flavors and superb service. A must visit!!!!

Came here w my bff Gaby on a Friday night for a "late" dinner. Food was slightly above average. Many dishes were not available and thought to explore by ordering one appetizer st a time. At 945 when my friend went to order fries,  they said the litchen closed - again,  Friday night at 945!  At least i live close by so am looking forward to the new restaurant that will open in six months once this fails. What a shame.
The food is great and the decoration here is lovely!

I can go anywhere for breakfast but I choose to come here. Just Plain Dave's has an awesome breakfast menu and I always get great service when I come. If I lived closer I would definitely dine here more often.
The worst curry I have ever had. Too lame taste, too much breading and too dirty environment

Way too expensive for Schezuan food, in other words: fancied up Chinese food. I strongly suggest other alternatives around the area: Cheng-Du 46 and 23 (well...I admit, there are further) Food and Flavor? They are "okay": nothing spectacular; sometimes blend (such as the curry dishes), and not spicy enough (such as the dishes that use schezuan peppercorns).
This place was well worth the trip to Brooklyn Bridge! The margherita pizza and calzone were delicious!! A must-have for sure!!

A friend and I had lunch at Rowena's today. The food was excellent, the portions were generous and the two of us ate for $13.00 and took home leftovers. The server was a really nice guy who explained the dishes to us and couldn't have been more helpful.

My friend and I were looking for a late breakfast open on thanksgiving. Cafe gitane was the perfect place with their "petit dejeuner complet". It was the first time I had breakfast there and it was delicious.

I ate lunch at The Sea Fire Grill twice and it was fantastic both times.
