Our server was attentive and had a great attitude.  He was managing a number of tables in a this small restaurant and everyone was served quickly and was he able to keep all the tables happy. I would recommend this restaurant for ladies doing lunch, or a romantic lunch/dinner, or actually for anyone.

I use to like going to this place, but now every time i go, my group of friends and I are not satisfied at all. The service sucks and the sushi literally has no meat, its all rice. I tried to tell the lady that we were basically eating rice in a ball and she said thats the usual amount of meat they put in it. I started to pick off the extra rice and the lady comes over and tries to tell me i have to pay a fee for taking off some of the rice, even though no sushi place ever puts that much rice. I ask for a California roll and get basically an avocado roll. Don't get me wrong i love avocado but no when the entire thing is avocado. I have introduced this place to more then 20 of my friends and once the owners realized we love sushi and were always coming no matter what, they started having bad service and trying to add all these extra charges they don't tell you about. Honestly, its a waste of time to come here.

food is good: but way overpriced.  Kids meals are about 9 dollars.  Salad or potato not included with entree.  When I am paying 17 dollars for a chicken entree at a bar I expect more.  3.99 for a side sald is ludicrous.  Will not return unless I have  a coupon.  Last time ordered the french onion soup, and someone must have dropped the whole bottle of thyme in the soup.  Onions were def not carmelized, just thrown in the soup since they were translucent and not browned

I was super impressed by my first visit here.   The salmon, kale, and broccoli salad were top notch and washed down well with the ginger lemonade. The staff were exceptionally helpful and energetic.  The downstairs eating area is quite pleasant and clean.  I'll be back!!!!
While the food is ok, the fact that we saw a cockroach making its way to the table next to us makes me never want to come back here.
Got two pies takeout.  They were small for the price and were skimpy on the toppings.    There are local options.

I went here with some friends for Sunday brunch.  DELICIOUS!!  The ambiance is adorable, very rustic.  We had made reservations but I don't think it was necessary...there were only two other occupied tables in our room.  We all had drinks, I had a pear bellini which was pretty tasty.  I am a vegetarian so usually I just get whatever vegetarian dish is on the menu; however, Agricola had a bunch of veggie options for brunch.  I got the quiche of the day which was amazing.  Everyone else I was with also enjoyed their meals as well.  It was pricey but worth the money, it was a very nice treat.  !@I definitely want to come back and try the lunch and dinner menus.  I would highly recommend it!

Went there week night with my friend. Ordered the chorizo appetizer and the chicken bits which were very tasty. This is a neighborhood restaurant with fairly good quality for the price. I will come back.

I went there today on whim. I had been craving some BBQ these last couple days and decided to give this place a try. Normally I go to Dinosaur (Harlem) or Hill Country (Flat Iron) for BBQ. I am so glad I tried a new place the staff was very pleasant and patient at my request to sample items before I made my selection (sample before purchase is always a plus in my book). Pro- Brisket was AMAZINGLY FLAVORFUL, TENDER and MOIST (exactly what the carver had promised it would :-) ). Brisket had GREAT texture (was not overly chewy). This is a FAVORITE. It outshines everything. Ribs- I enjoyed the ribs that are prepared at Mighty Quinn's. Ribs have a nice crust, GREAT texture, not chewy or rubbery at all. The ribs are not drenched in sauce (I hate when ribs are served in bathed in sauce, especially a sweet sauce). I want to be able to taste my BBQ Rib and control the amount of sauce I put on it (if I need the sauce). Move over Dinosaur,  I found a new BBQ home in Mighty Quinn's. Hill Country, Its the end of the road for us. Take Out- I live in Queens and ordered my brisket, spare ribs and sides to go. I was extremely happy to see the food MAINTAIN its INTEGRITY as I traveled with it via MTA and had to reheat it in my oven 2 hours later (another plus in imho). Cons- Vinegar Coleslaw/Sweet Potato Casserole - It was not bad, but it wasn't memorable. But I prefer the coleslaw to the sweet potato casserole. Really folks it's the brisket that is the star of the show. I am glad this place doesn't offer mac and cheese I feel that has become to predictable as a side.

Went to this place with a bunch of friends and when we walked in we realized we were the only ones in there. The wings we ordered were great as everyone says BUTTTT when we all ordered our food, 3 out of 4 dishes were raw when they came out. When we brought it to their attention they attempted to continue cooking the same food and when we wanted to order something else instead, the grill was closed. Never coming back to this place and I would never recommend anyone going here.

Have eaten here many times and even got catering for a baby shower from here.  Everything is fresh, tasty, and reasonably priced.  Everyone at the baby shower raved about the food.  Support local small business!

Fantastic dinner in the upstairs room at La Fourno Restaurant last night.  Al and his team took wonderful care of us.  Our dinner and appetizers were terrific.  The mozzarella with peppers was very very good and the veal parm lives up to it's best in Philly title.  Our first time in the restaurant but it won't be our last.  Thanks to All the owner for a wonderful night.  Shamus was a fantastic server.  Try this wonderful neighborhood place.  You won't be disappointed.
Cant wait to go back to this place its awesome... very exspensive but awesome... great food... great service... cute girls working... lol but yeah makes menwant it just writing about it...

A Single Pebble is by far the best Chinese food I have ever had. Not only is it authentic but it's rich in variety and flavor. The staff are all such wonderful people. I recently moved to the west and find myself searching for another Chinese restaurant like A Single Pebble and have been unable to find one. Once you eat here no other Chinese food will be the same again. My favorite dishes are the wu Gauk dumplings, double garlic broccoli, red oil chicken and the Hong Kong Lo mien. The tasting menu at both dinner and lunch is always amazing with the variety of dishes that are sent out by the chef and you never know what you'll get which makes it a unique experience that I would definitely recommend!

for dinner  main course was out within few minutes ....and seemed they were from morning buffet. either ways the food taste was ordinary not sure if  traditional malabar fish tastes the way this restaurant cooked. surprised with so many good reviews ....

Didn't get a chance to try the food here because the guy working behind bar is extremely rude. I've never seen any people working in restaurant industry like that. He seems in a really pleasant conversation when I stepped in. When his friends mentioned to him there was someone waiting, he said "she can wait" really loud. After he led us to our "table", he "ordered" us to sit down at the end of the table with a very rude attitude. My friend and I end up leaving. I'm sure the food is great there. But with that kind of attitude, I don't wanna spend a single second in that place.

Goods: Great pan cakes variety. Overall a good place for brunch. The waiter and waitress have great attitude. Bad: Totally overpriced, so cannot make frequent stops Ugly: The place has a long line for the most part, especially on weekends. Don't plan on sitting chatting after you are done. You will be kicked out. We honestly lost track of the fact that people were waiting after we had food. The owner was very rude and did not even come and ask us politely if we were done. He came and told us that we have to leave! Will never go again.

Alright, this pizza place is awesome, great food awesome service, all around great restaurant honestly hands down in the rankings of the top 5 pizzas I've ever eaten. You're probably wondering why only 3 stars then. There's something they do that strikes a nerve in me and regardless of how much I love their pizza I can't see myself going back to them or giving them 5 stars. I myself am a business owner and understand that cash is king and not accepting credit card has its perks and flaws. That being said offering an in-house ATM  so you can bring in more customers is awesome, but charging them a fee of $3.25 so they can pay for YOUR service and restaurants food doesnt sit right with me. Why? I honestly feel that doing that is like slapping me in the face. But thats my opinion and again the pizza is amazingly awesome!!! Good Luck!

Our family of five went for a late afternoon/early dinner (2pm). We called ahead for a reservation as we heard they are always booked. The hostess said they were booked but graciously added us anyway. This restaurant is in the heart of the theater district directly across the the Barrymore theater. The restaurant is just the right size NY restaurant with exposed brick and light hardwood floors. I knew the minute they brought the bread to the table that we were in for a treat. It was the best I've tasted outside of Italy. Dipped in olive oil and balsamic... Perfection. Our server MJ was simply fantastic! He was funny and engaging and greeted everyone at the table individually including our two Tweens. My mother couldn't decide between the seafood risotto and the spinach raviolis so MJ split the dishes and brought her half of each!  I tried the risotto and it was the best I've had outside of Sardegna. He  talked me out of the veal piccata and into the veal martini: lightly Parmesan encrusted perfectly sautéd over linguine. There is no "kids menu" but that didn't stop MJ.  He took their "special order" and the kids we're thrilled!   The cannoli and caramel flan for dessert were house made and even the vanilla ice cream the kids got was delicious.   We met one of the owners on duty on our way out. Class act! This was our first time here but we were treated by all staff as if we were their weekly local patrons.  If you are looking for excellent Italian food this is your place. We will definitely be back.
One of the best meals I've ever had anywhere in the world. Mind blowing.

Used a Groupon for dinner of 4 which included 2 apps, 4 entrees and 4 glasses of wine. The appetizers: hot clams and calamari. The clams were awesome. The calamari could have been a tad crispier but other than that pretty good. Entrees: my sister who is a raw fish fan ordered the tuna which said said was excellent ; boyfriend ordered the filet mignon which was rated as excellent as well; brother in law ordered the filet mignon along with lobster, the filet again, excellent but lobster not so great as it was not cooked enough. I ordered the black bean and corn burrito which was AMAZING (if you like a spicy Mexican I highly recommend!) The service was excellent and our waitress, Janelle was lovely and engaged in small talk with us. Our dinner reservation was at 7:45 and they had a band in the bar section at that time which we will be checking out another time. My only recommendation would be for them to expand the menu to include a few more vegetarian options...minimal options if you are a veggie.

The presentation of food was lovely however the taste was mediocre. A chicken dish was dry and lacked flavor. Our particular waiter was sort of grumpy and not very pleasant but other waiters were interactive and engaging. Overall it is expensive and the experience is not worth the cost. There are many other restaurants in Hanover that I would recommend over The Pine.

The hippest place you can get a pancake. Overpriced and slow service.  My food arrived five to ten minutes before my girlfriends.  The table of 5 next to me seems to be having the same issue.   The food is good but they need sausage and larger servings. Spent 18.75 on 2 crepes, waited 15 minutes for my  food, another 7 for my girlfriends, and im still hungry.
Cozy place, deeeelicious food and really, really good service. The Fulton sammich was stupendous, the empanada fantasic and the coffee really good. Really great place.
Very good and friendly service, I was actually very impressed. Ambiance was a little cold but they have a decent menu and everything we ordered was very good and fresh! Prices are good as well.
Worth the trip.  Cool atmosphere not to be out done by the food.  Fresh seafood and good home cooking Greek food.  Feta appetizer was delicious.  Definitely would visit again...

I can only give one star because this restaurant failed to uphold my reservation made 4 days in advance. I received no confirmation the day before or day of. Thinking this was suspicious and looking forward to eating here I called to double check. The hostess on the phone was curiously rude. "I apologize for the inconvenience but it's not our fault that I can't find your reservation." Her solution was to assume I was entirely in the wrong and offered me to "just show up and try to find a seat at the bar". No thank you.

This place is just absolutely amazing. I have been in new york for the last 4 months and tried several restaurants and this is my all time favorite. first of all the people that work there are incredibly friendly which makes it so much more enjoyable, second of all the food is really good and last but not least the place is very cosy and non touristic. I really recommend it to anyone who is looking for a nice place, good price and very very nice crew that works there.

Not worth the hour and a half wait. I ordered the vegetarian soup, thinking the portion would be ample (as I looked around at the other bowls on the table). There was no mention of the small portion size and after I received the really small bowl (the most expensive ramen on the menu at $18), I asked one of the servers why it was so small. He told me it's a Buddhist portion. This should have been indicated on the menu or told to me when I ordered. The soup was lukewarm and very oily. The fried mung beans on top were pretty but made it oilier. I did however enjoy the sweet potato wrapped chestnut. The staff was very pleasant and I'm sure they have to deal with a lot of difficult people who waited so long to eat. I can't believe I waited for this, paid so much for myself and my husband and left feeling hungry and more than unsatisfied. I do not recommend Ippudo West Side for its food. If you are looking for ambiance and a good date place, this would be the place to go

Last night we were a group of seven celebrating my son's 30th birthday and decided to go for drinks at El Vez - somewhere my son frequents often. We arrived at 11:30 and ordered drinks etc. at 1:45 they announced last call so everyone around the bar ordered another drink.  At 1:50 the GM announced in a loud crass tone that everybody had to finish their drinks and leave the bar by 2:00. Everybody looked at each other in amazement- why do last call at 1:45 if you want your bar cleared by 2:00. At 1:55 he bellowed "everybody clear the bar!"  Let me say this - it will be forever before I ever go back there!

We had brunch here on November 28 and had the  "Mezzze Feast." The only mistake we made was ordering two plates for the three of us. We didn't need anything but the mezzes. Each of them was well prepared and delicious. Although it is not a Turkish restaurant, we thought we were back in Istanbul. Helpful, knowledgeable staff.

While on my visit to the east coast from the west I tried plenty of places an this place was on the top of my list so First of alltheir bacon on a stick is very delicious and I'm not even a bacon lover but it's that good. The burger is also so delicious and the nachos are a great snack too. Must try this place their prices are also very reasonable for some scrumptious food.

Had an awesome Thanksgiving dinner here!  The butternut squash and acorn squash soup was the best soup I have ever had.  Oysters were a bit small but the main course of turkey, green beans and mashed potato was very tasty! Waiter recommended a nice bottle of Pinot Grigio (Mt Beautiful) and we enjoyed 2 bottles.  Only negative comment was related to the dessert.  Brownies and banana bread for thanksgiving dinner?  Really?  Expected so much more.  Regardless, this was a great dining experience.  Thank you.

I've been to Bar Bacon a few times, I love the environment and the staff is always very friendly. The drinks with bacon are surprisingly good!! On Friday I saw they have delivery and decided to order. The food was amazing and got there fast, we got the clam chowder and mac & cheese. Definitely recommend it for lazy days!

Travis was my bartender and he was fantastic! Its was my first time in as i dont really hangout in time square a lot but ill be back for sure just bc of him and the atmosphere he provided. Awesome time :)
Pretty good polenta and kale salad...not sure about the menu ..kind of sophisticated appetizer !

We waited in line outside for about 45 minutes because we heard this is the best pizza around. It wasn't. Not even close. The crust was burnt and grey on all of the pizzas we ordered and the flavor was nothing remarkable.  Not worth the wait at all. The service was normal and the atmosphere was not any better than the hundreds of small pizza joints we passed on the way.

Wonderfully prepared and tasty dishes. Homemade pasta specials. Hannah our server was a delight and Giorgio was pleasant and visited the table to make sure everything was good. Will certainly visit Giogio's again...and soon!

Food was decent however the time for the food to be ready took rediculousy long. Also our waitress chose to sing instead of help us as we were trying to get her attention....and the singing was not worth it

I placed an order through the teriyakiboy.net and received a confirmation email with a number.  The order never went through, my card was charged, and the Teriyaki Boy manager said there was nothing he could do, even though we used his companies' website and gave him the confirmation number.  He said that unless we faxed (not emailed) the order to him  that they wouldn't deliver any food.  So now I have to call my credit card and cancel this order and will never order from this company again!
Food is always good and their service is fast.  Typically I just do take out as the strip mall isn't the nicest ambiance for a night out.

Went to this cafe for late sunday brunch with my boyfriend. The place looks cute with great music and good smell of freshly made  crepe from the tiny cooking corner in front of the restaurant. The food was decent for its location (the financial district). However, the worst part was the service provided. This lady called Emily was our waitress and she was absolutely one of the worst waitresses we have ever met. She kept rushing us while we were having our food. Staring and kept asking if we finished our dishes while we still had half of the food left on the plates. We felt rushed and did not enjoy the meal. But that was not the worst part. When the bill came, the gratuity of 20% was already included. We asked Emily if this is normal for this restaurant and she said no, it is not usually like this. She said that today the restaurant was running slow and that the gratuity will cover the tips for the bartenders! We did not even know if there is a bartender there! She also said with a fussy voice that she didn't want to use her own money to pay the bartender! This is insane! I meant if we received good service we wouldn't be complaining and that we would be more than happy to give you 20% tips! This is absolutely crazy and insane! Will no longer come to this place if the service is not improved!!!

very good thai food though service quality can vary depending on waiter you get. Food tastes good and quantity is sufficient. I go here once a week and never had any bad experience so far. absolute recommend.
Great food and service. When I'm uptown this will be my first stop. Great selections to choose from. 5 stars.

I have always heard great reviews about halal guys but never personally experienced the food until today(11/30). This place is all hype! The quality of the food is garbage,  lamb and chicken tastes like rubber. The meat is hard... Rice are over cooked... They might have been good in the past but now... The food quality sucks! If you like your stomach please don't eat from halal guys. Folks giving this place 5 stars never tasted a good gyro or chicken over rice dish before....
Best Indian Food in Manhattan! Plus the staff has great meal deals, and is really friendly

My family of 4 has eaten there twice. Once in September of 2014 and just last night (November 30).  Food without a doubt is the best we ever tasted. We frequent restaurants often in the tri-state area, and none can complete. For the quality and selection of entrees, we don't find it pricey. We've spent a lot more for bad food at other dining establishments. The small plates and appetizers are also outstanding, not to mention the crab and advocado salad. We like the fact that it's BYOB. Leaves more money to spent on food, and most restaurants overcharge for drinks anyway. I forgot to mention that their desserts and coffee beverages are awesome as well. You will not be disappointed - in fact, this is an incredible place to dine, and the atmosphere is cozy. Service was excellent both times. Can't say enough about Casserole Bistro. I would give it 10 stars if I could.

Got the Cincinnati and the "three cheese" sauce was like what you get for free at 7-11. Not much more to be said for the super salty chili. The produce seemed alright, but it was sad that it was paired with below par ingredients. The bread is more like a roll than a bun. If you're expecting any sense of tradition in your hot dog bun, this isn't the place for you. For $16 I left unsatisfied with one hot dog, an order of (not crispy) fries and a half dozen "jumbo" wings which were definitely not. See Moriarty's for the true meaning of that word. At my table we also had the Saigon, the Windy City, and the Texas Hold em. I wasn't the only one who was underwhelmed by any sense. Overpriced. Not great flavors. And I was really craving a hot dog!

Was here last night, and ordered 4 subs. The roast beef and turkey subs had 1 slice of meat in there, all I tasted was bread and vinegar after taking a bite. Last sandwich was a veggie with everything, however I got a sandwich with lettuce tomato onion and mayonnaise and nothing else. $43 for 3  1/2 pieces of bread, ridiculous. Your better off hitting a subway or even better a Quiznos that doesn't have Indian people working there so they actually load the sub up.
It's a quick little place that has amazing food. I love e chips and salsa... Nice and spicy!  The pork burrito with the red sauce is my favorite!  They also are really good margaritas!

Believe the hype! The food in this spot is off the hook.  The space is indeed small - to put it nicely - cozy, intimate? Whatever the NYC version of small is - this place is small.  But the hot chicken is flavorful - I got hot which was very spicy.   The appetizer and sides were delightful.  The staff was friendly and efficient.  We'll definitely be back although we'll need to figure out the right day/time to go to avoid the wait.  With no indoor waiting area - it's hard to wait outside in the cold.

NOT WORTH MAKING A RESERVATION. Went right on time for the reservation and were told we had to wait until after the group without a reservation to be seated. Then, an obnoxious group, who had missed their reservation by a good whole hour, just bombarded in, pushing everyone waiting into a coat rack and the staff seated them first before even the group before me without the reservation could be seated. Hey, if you miss your reservation, you make another reservation or you wait. Such ill mannered people. IF YOU WANT TO GET SEATED ON TIME, LESSON LEARNED. MAKE A RESERVATION 1 HR PRIOR TO WHAT YOU WANT. Food was decent. I would say 4 stars for the food. Sashimi was not as fresh as I would have liked, which was apparent from color and taste. The dinner special was pretty good (Decent taste and large portions for a great price). The Hana roll was pretty good but the regular Salmon roll not so much. Price was pretty good for the amount and quality of food. If you want to go for sashimi, this place is more of a fusion sushi place. The relatively younger taller waiter and waitress were nice. The older shorter women were just plain rude.  IF YOU RUN INTO AN OLDER CHINESE LADY, ASK FOR ANOTHER WAITER/WAITRESS. I was so pissed that I had to wait 1 hr passed my reservation to get seated and then, when trying to ask a question, rudely dismissed  by an older Chinese lady, who seamed to be the manager or owner, that I don't think the food is worth bearing that kind of poor treatment (hence the 2 stars not 1 since the food was pretty decent for the price). IF YOU WANT TO TRY THIS PLACE, EXPECT A LONG WAIT.
One of my favorite spots for dinner! Great Sangria and the wings were excellent.

I came for the barbecue and was NOT disappointed. I ordered the Bomber, and I got a mountain meat. Huge portions, casual atmosphere, and extremely friendly local staff make this place a South Philly gem. Eat at Ba-Bomb!

Came here with friends (party of 5) on Friday night. the place was packed highly recommended: Vietnamese Ice coffee, already sweet without the sweetener. Crispy pork belly appetizer, it has a crispy skin and juicy inside. Seafood Pad Ped, very delicious! Pad Thai and Basi fried rice were okay, not as unique as the appetizers. service was good. price was reasonable. if you don't make a reservation, be ready to wait, though.

We decided to try this place after ice skating at Penn's Landing...which was magical! Spasso's came up on Yelp as being the best for our current location.  Besides, we all agreed on a big bowl of Italian love! The atmosphere was quaint and relaxing. The service was impeccable.  The table bread and garnish was a nice touch. The food was fresh...the table ordered crab ravioli,  gorgonzola gnocchi,  and fettuccine with shrimp. The ravioli were amazing! The gnocchi was overpowering with flavor and lacked any color in the dish. It looked like a big bowl of mini marshmallows.  The gnocchi themselves were great. Needs something though The fettuccine was bland in flavor.  It was supposed to be tossed in a pesto alfredo sauce...no flavor!  The noodles themselves were great. We don't need to return since Philly has so many great choices.

I've been here many times, and it's honestly such a shame how horrible the service is.  very rude attitude, rushed, they don't make sure everything is okay, always having to wave them down.   this place has so much potential, it used to be my favorite spot!  but really the service has just gotten worse and worse, and the food isn't as great and as fresh and it used to be my first few times coming here but it's good though.  my boyfriend and I are bummed out , were still searching for a good sushi buffet replacement :/
This is my favorite Indian restaurant!!! My wife and I love it! The owner is extremely nice and it is never overcrowded.

If time is indeed money than this place owes us money. Waiting 10 mins for the waiter and another 15 mins to get our breakfast/brunch is totally not acceptable. And hearing a bunch of waiter keep apologizing to every customer for the long wait doesn't make it better... even worse, because instead of going back to work they are standing there and apologizing which makes us wait even longer. I'm not saying it was bad, because the service was still friendly. The brunch is $12 for simply eggs and bread and that kind of things. And if you add a little you can get the $20 menu including a drink. I think both is not cheap and will still make you leaving this place with an empty stomach. Overall it's a nice, cozy place with friendly service and decent food. But the long wait and high price won't get me back.
Great place. I was referred by Brendan Weng; next time you go here, make sure to ask for him! Wonderful service!
Small space with large crowds. Awesome wings and raw bar. Very sports oriented and fun environment.

I went to an event at Jones in Philadelphia  and was really impressed.  I had a taste for a really good brisket sandwich and had heard it was good here. The staff was great and very attentive. I LOVED it!  The seasoning was perfect and you could tell is was homemade sauce.  It was tender and juicy and the bread was soft.  I asked to have it toasted.  I would recommend this place for sure!

I've had many servers/bartenders but I must admit that no one has matched the professionalism and courtesy that Paige delivered today. Food - great. Drinks - awesome. Music/Ambiance - upbeat yet chill. Coming back isn't even an option! Thanks Paige for making an ordinary Monday memorable.

I found craft house on yelp on a boring Sunday afternoon and I'm so glad that I stumbled upon it. I was pleasantly surprised at the amazing beer selection and food. My boyfriend and I are always on the hunt for great craft beer and delicious food, and fortunately we found both. This place is a hidden gem on Staten island and I would definitely recommend it to anyone. Thumbs up for the beer, food and friendly waiter. Highlights: -jalapeno shrimp appetizer -mac and cheese -ribs -evil twin molotov cocktail

Let me start by saying that I love Juniors Colchester! Been going there for years, even before they moved to their current location. Then Juniors downtown opened, pizza is delicious (sad there is no pasta anymore)! I saw a Juniors was coming to rt. 7 and was so excited! After waiting and waiting for them to open, I must say I am rather disappointed. The inside looks nice, but was rather loud, especially for a Monday night. The service was mediocre at best. I ordered the seafood special and it was missing something, the flavor does not compare to Juniors Colchester. My husband loved his thin crust pizza. Overall, not impressed and actually very disappointed. I might try it again because I love the other Juniors locations, hopefully next time is better!
Was in Staten Island for a couple days. Stopped by and had a great meal. It was a good atmosphere, and the food was excellent. I was a huge fan of the desserts too and took some home with me

Came in on the way to the Dolphins Jets game. Very nice little place. The waitress was excellent, great selection on the menu and the wine was delicious. It is BYOB but they have a wine list. Will definitely come back for a date night with the fiance.

Worst experience EVER! A one hour wait for their Pizza/Pasta restaurant yet, no one was in the restaurant. Snotty maître d and staff. There were many vacant tables but to create hype they say it's an hour wait. Our server forgot our salads and gave one of our guests lasagne when she ordered ravioli. The correct dish arrived when we were finished eating. Lastly, the one and only bathroom available for 4 of the restaurants was closed for cleaning! They refused to let us in and the 2 cleaning women inside were laughing and taking their time. My son had to catch a bus back to school and in their broken English "5 minutes, 5 minutes" well 20 minutes and a security guard later it still was not clean so I left and swore never to return. Nasty security, nasty, uppity cleaning ladies - btw I think it's illegal for one restaurant (let alone 5) to NOT have an operating restroom/lounge. Mario Batali you should be ashamed to put your name in this! Save your money people!

I just picked up some beef and chicken tacos and a brisket burrito from this place and they were not good at all. The beef briskets were not cooked and the chicken tasted as if it were cooked a few days ago.

Went here one evening with a friend. We ordered the guacamole and several tacos (al pastor, chorizo, and goat). The guac was very disappointing. DO NOT GET IT. You're better off going to the grocery store next door, buying an avocado, and dumping it onto a plate. There was no flavor at all. Luckily, The tacos were very well prepared... but they took FOREVER to get there. I think we waited 45 minutes to get our food? It was pretty ridiculous. I mean it's a small restaurant too... perhaps no more than 10-12 tables for groups of two. If I have to recommend something... the GOAT tacos were wonderful. I have never had goat tacos... I grew up eating goat curry and am a fan of the taste and was very pleasantly satisfied with the taco version.

Not worth the prices. I don't think it was bad but I can think of way better food for $10 per person. $8 for 1 arepa is almost and insult. It is like $7 for a taco. Lower your prices and watch the money pile up. No one gets it anymore.

Was really excited to give this place a try! I loved the menu and the idea of mimosas always makes me happy! It was THE WORST!!!! When we arrived it was empty which is never a good sign on a Sunday at 11:00! I'm pretty sure our waitress was hungover and the other woman barley greeted us! I ordered a mimosa that was all oj! Then comes the food ugh I asked for medium steak and it was well done and gross! My eggs looked as if a kid made them and were cold! The hash brown were old and soggy! The plantains were the same but cold in the middle! Our waitress was apologetic...hey she didn't prepare it. She brought me a mimosa on the house which was mostly champagne....I'm pretty sure that was no coincidence lol I had a groupon that cost 15 and they comped the rest of the meal but never again!
nothing here that is not delicious and made with such thought and care.  a wonderful addition to yardley.

Most of the food isn't cooked fresh, over seasoned or just plain nasty. the iced tea/uptown is DISGUSTING. And the management sucks, its ran by a bunch of drunk, Haitain, Jehovah Witnesses and the waitresses are all hoodrats. It's on main st in east orange for a reason.

Great place for Thai food! My three friends and I went on a Saturday night, no waiting time which was great and a great table. I ordered Pad Thai which actually came pretty fast, the dish was delicious and everybody seemed to be happy with their orders as well! The only two reasons why I don't give it a five is that there wasn't as much meat as I would normally have on this dish...  sorry but I love meat. The service was pretty good too.

Okay, so I know airport food is not something to hold to too high of a standard, but come on. This was actually nauseating. A sushi platter, miso soup and seaweed salad cost 55$. I was going through reciepts and came across this one with disgust. This was the worst sushi I've ever had, ever--and on top of that it was over priced--even for an airport.  Not only was the food bad, but the service was horrible. We had to flag them down over and over. Do yourself a favor and go ANYWHERE else. For 55$ you can buy yourself a pass into some VIP lounge, which I guarantee you will be more worth your money than this place!

This deli is fantastic. I just ate a roast beef sandwich they made on pumpernickel bread with provolone, lettuce, tomato, onion, and horseradish mayo. The sandwich was delicious. The roast beef there is just right, tender with the right amount of pinkness. I chose to make my own sandwich, but they have a lot of tasty signature sandwiches. If you're in the area, check them out, it's worth the stop.

It was kind of cold outside the evening we went to Thomas Sweet Cafe recently, so I wasn't especially in the mood for ice cream (very rare for me to turn down Thomas Sweet ice cream) ... and, since it was a bit on the late side I didn't want to have coffee either.  So I ultimately decided to try their hot chocolate.  Wow, was that a great choice!  It might be the best hot chocolate I've ever had!   I highly recommended it.  As an extra-added bonus tip, ask if James is around to make it for you!  I watched him meticulously mix the ingredients together and prepare the beverage... and the result clearly spoke for itself.  Yum!  Well done James...

This place is a gem, but I already knew that because they also have locations in willow grove and montgomeryville and I go there all the time too so it's about time I write my 1st yelp review ever for Vic! The fish is fresh, rice is cooked perfectly and the simply elegant presentation makes me smile when it's ready! The 3 rolls for $11 is awesome. Tiger roll is the bomb!
I orders fish today and hade food poison based on review it sound like they never tried fresh fish

Every time I am in the area I make it a must stop place. All their food is always very fresh and good! Everything from their subs to burgers to their soups. All their employees are awesome and very friendly, the few guys that seem like the bosses are awesome and make sure to go out of their way to greet you and make sure to ask how you are doing. Overall 5/5 rating and is a must to try at least once if you are from or around the area!
Great service, friendly staff, and amazing food. 5 stars for this restaurant for sure.

Came here with 10 hungry girl athlete's from Ottawa Uni as we were playing rugby in NY. This place is fantastic, got really fast, fun service and the food was amazing.... Mac and cheese, delicious non-processed chicken, salad, nan bread; finished with a plate of brownies. Perfect.!!

$60 per person i took my father here for his birthday very fancy place. we were at the lobster buffet and pretty much this place is wack for the money. bunch of cold nasty seafood unchucked oysters the libster is unlimed but small and bot even seasoned. turkey very dry and nasty prime rib was so so...felt like a cheap buffet thats was just trying to be fancy
Food options were crap. Had one drink and left. They are trying too hard and not succedding in my opinion.

Zahav gets five stars for service alone, as they have been super helpful in helping this picky vegan navigate their menu. I love the Salatim & Hummus, Roasted Brussels Sprouts, & Fried Cauliflower. That right there is more than enough food for me, so it's okay that I am not as amped about their vegan Al Ha'esh offerings: I'm not a fan of mushrooms when they're the star of the show, so I tried the eggplant which I'm also not crazy about in general, and it was as expected. I'm looking forward to a visit where I can dine a la carte. Unfortunately I usually come here with a non-vegan party, so for me $65 for the hummus and a couple meeze isn't worth it, but would be fantastic, and more reasonable, ordered on their own.

Let me just start of by saying I don't understand how this place got such good reviews I just ate here earlier today with a friend of mine it was so bad I had to write a review. We ordered french toast salad verte( we added avocado and tomatoes) and eggs florentine . The French toast was just ok the whipped cream and fruits on top were good but the French toast itself was hard . Now on to the salad , the onions tasted rotten and the avocado had a lot of black spots on it im not sure what type of place would serve avocado this way, the eggs florentine was also not that great the English muffin was filled with butter and that was all I can taste. Besides the food not being great the service was terrible I do not recommend this place at all.

Whenever I have time I go to the Reading Terminal Market In Philadelphia PA.  I wanted to get a fresh turkey for Thanksgiving and knew this would be the best choice.  Although the market was very crowded I expected it because of the the holiday. I can always count on this place for fresh food and great variety plus excellent pricing. If you have not been it is a must on your lists of places to go  visit and shop.

Ok, first off, they have the best potato soup. It's a must no matter what time of the year it is.  The staff is always super friendly and quick.  There happy hour special is always packed but good time to go.  I think the chicken tenders are $5.  Oh, and I really like their chicken tenders because they are freshly made, not frozen.  I also like their french fries because they are tasty.  Their airliner chicken is one of the best meals and a definite must try. I am not a drinker so I can't really comment on their beer selection. I have been going to For Pete's Sake for years and they are consistently good.

Been here a few times since my work is sometimes in the area. I would highly suggest the pizza, but other things haven't been as good. I one time got a buffalo chicken wrap and ended up biting into two bones throughout the wrap, it was a big turn off. The employees always seem to be pretty helpful and nice.
I tried the Polish plate with pierogies and beef goulash, but food was just ok.  Good prices though.

My boyfriend and I were planning to celebrate our anniversary together in Philadelphia and we asked some local friends for some suggestions. The first placed they mentioned? Varalli. So we booked the reservations and after a long day of doing tourism stuff and exploring the city, we stepped inside expecting just a nice simple dinner. What we did not expect was to be blown away by the food and service. Our server was kind and always checking in on us and making sure we were well with our meal. We had great appetizers but when we were given our entree, wow were we blown away! I am kind of a picky eater and so when I asked the kitchen to take out one of the components in the dish I was hesitant it would not taste the same. My fault for choosing to leave it out but when it came out of the kitchen was I impressed. The presentation was wonderful and the taste of the steak was nothing I could explain in words. The chef who created it make it look absolutely stunning and I couldn't bear to eat it. Even the owner stopped by to comment on the look of the dish. Overall, our experience at Varalli was nothing but wonderful. It was a great day to wrap up our anniversary and I definitely look forward to dining here again soon. I highly recommend it if you're in town for a nice meal in a great location.

My wife and I had our baby shower there last week. Nikki was super helpful with planning.They have great options on their menu for parties at a good price and the space is awesome. The food and drink was well received and all of our guests had a great time. Would def recommend to anyone looking for a good BK spot to have an event. They also have a great brunch, dinner and bar so it's a good place to hang out with friends.

Don't know what happened to the Butcher Bar, but I believe it has been butchered. The food and service used to be better than excellent. Now, it has become a safe haven for employees to text, Facebook and ignore customers. Colin, the bartender is the one remaining stand-out staff member. He is attentive and obviously thankful for his job. The food quality has gone right down the gutter and portions have been reduced to almost nothing. Meat was served cold as were the side orders. The overall experience is nothing like it used to be. I hope the owner(s) get a grip on what is going on here and improve the customer experience. What began as a shining star has dwindled to a fading candle. AND....huge message in the receipt folder "we prefer cash tips". How incredibly tacky.

This is the only broth place I have been to. The service was very quick and the broth, amazing. My boyfriend got the hearth broth which was very fresh and had a ginger taste to it. Definitely has health benefits. The broth was on the saltier side, but overall it was a great experience.

This place is truly unique in every way. From the music to the people to the decor...it is one of a kind! Besides getting the opportunity to hang out in Philly ' s oldest tavern...the prices are what makes it a repeat for us. There is nowhere in Philly that you can get out the door with most of your money left! The food was quite good and the beer selection, mostly local, is fantastic. This is a fun place...so if you're not in the mood then maybe come back another time!
I got the regular Chinese food here, not the sushi, but the food was horrible. I got the chicken with mixed vegetables and the chicken had a weird breading on it. I will never go back.
Experts at seafood!  Scallops amazing.  Oysters best I've had in NYC. Staff top notch. Not a single thing I can say bad and I'm stingy with 5 star reviews.

Wow... The hummus was amazing, lamb kabob cooked to perfection, baklava was delicious, and ginger tea was a perfect addition to an outstanding meal.  I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone that loves great Mediterranean food - owner is super cool, too!

Great atmosphere, great food and great prices. This is my go to spot in downtown burlington, especially for wings. The service is as expected for a bar, but is always friendly. And they always have great drink specials!!!

The staff are down to Earth and very friendly, but my waitress ignored me a little bit because she was chatting a lot with another table.  The atmosphere was nice and not too pretentious.  I had the Chicken Formagio with mashed potatoes and steamed vegetables. The chicken was layered with ham and cheese and was outstanding.
Alan was our server for girls night out... He was very helpful and the food was phenomenal.... Everything came out quickly and made our night!

WARNING .....WARNING ON THE STAFF TO ADD $$ ON YOUR CREDIT CARD!!! Ok I was a regular customer and brought new people in to support local business.....but no more.....DO NOT GO THERE, they add tip to your credit card charges without permission.  I gave them cash for tip and they added $20.00 to my charge.   I have reported this to the BBB of NYC and my credit company of fraud.

Went here again on Saturday with my best friend and we love this place!  I had the special which was salmon done beef wellington style.  The fish had a pastry shell around it like a beef wellington would, it was in the shape of a volcano with an egg at the top - looked like a work of art I swear I am so sorry I did not take a pic of it.  It was so delicious and my friend had the duck with barley  he loved it.  I usually eat like someone will take the food away but not that night I slowly ate and ate.  We also had the chickpea app to start which was another very tasty dish.  I even got the recipe from the chef I had a Manhattan which I have never had before it was so good.  You cannot beat the Bounty.  The place is awesome to look at and the food is top of the line.  The prices are reasonable.  The people who work here are so nice.

The food, atmosphere, and service was great! Our server Alexis was awesome she was extremely helpful with helping us pick out our dinner I have no complaints at all! I will definitely be back again the food was sooooooooooooo good!!!

Looks like the scenery of From Dusk Till Dawn which I think is awesome! The food is phenomenal; great priced to! You'll get a lot of bang for your buck here believe me! The  only drawback to this restaurant I have is the fact that, you cannot make any reservations. Never fails that whatever time or day it is; I wait from the span of 30 minutes to a little above an hour. Well worth it though!

The food was ok, but the service was terrible. The roast pork dumplings were really good, and the beef pho was tasty, the rest of the dishes were nothing great. Rude and impatient staff ruined the experience a little.

I was going to be in Philadelphia with 24 other people for a long weekend, and was responsible for making the dinner arrangements for our first night there. (Italian had been agreed upon for the first night.) After narrowing the field to three restaurants (all highly rated on Yelp and elsewhere) and speaking with them, I decided on La Fourno. (Of the three restaurants, La Fourno was the only one that was both reasonably priced and willing to accommodate a group of our size.) Everyone in our group was impressed with the atmosphere, the wait staff, and the food (served "family style"). We started with the House Salad and the Caesar Salad. For dinner we had the Spaghetti & Meatballs Marinara, the Penne with Broccoli, and the Pollo Salsiccia (boneless chunks of chicken sautéed with sweet Italian sausage, mushrooms, and sundried tomatoes in a balsamic reduction). For dessert we had the Homemade Cannoli, the Cheesecake, and the Tiramisu. Should our group travel to Philadelphia again next year, I expect a return trip to La Fourno will be on the itinerary.

La Fourno Ristorante Trattoria was amazing.  This was probably one of the best dining experiences I have had in a really long time.  I finished work with a friend and we were looking for someplace to eat on a Sunday night.  It was really by default because we didn't want to walk too far from the car and it was directly across the street.  It wasn't crowded but the ambiance was very quaint and cozy.  Lots of candles and great music.  The staff was excellent and the food was even better.  I ordered the lobster ravioli and she had the chicken Alfredo.  The pasta was fresh and the portion was phenomenal.  We had Italian margaritas which were the best Ive EVER had actually.  I cannot wait to go back.  I agree with some of the other reviews and groupon but that was not my experience at all!
Fantastic!  Authentic, delicious Indian food.  Especially loved the lehsooni ghobi and nilgiri shrimp!  Service was great too - highly recommend!

Still craving for BEEF BULGOGI BAHN MI plus all the sauces and ingredients! What a MOUTHFUL tasting cuisines they have it here... I'll definitely get back for more here in Joju: fries, chicken wings, sandwiches and a whole lot more tasty snacks and dine-in meals! Continue to offer good customer service for us, Joju... And, don't make me laugh again of your jokes on every tiring day; thanks though for making me smile at the counter!!! More dine-ins and take-outs every visit. Lots of love in this place!

Dirty food, horrible service. The interior may give you an impression that the food will be clean. However having this awful experience happening twice i see how they do not care about hygeine. Pubic hair came out from the rice last time, told the waiter and he just said okay and brought a new rice without saying sorry. Last week, i ordered salad and hair came out, told the waiter but she only said sorry and that was it. Very disappointing service and i dont even know why they would show them practicing how to speak kind japanese to the customers before opening hours when they cant even handle these kind of issues in a proper and polite way.

Despite an earlier scathing review of this place, our party of four decided to eat at Galli's. "It's Italian food!" we said. "How could anyone screw up pasta and paninis?" Let me tell you, we would have preferred to literally eat our words over the paninis we ordered. The ambience was nice, but very dark. There was one, meager bathroom in the front of the restaurant with a perpetual line, in spite the fact that there were only a few other patrons in the restaurant. Our waiter was pretentious, and so was the water (it came in a tall glass jug. Please!). When we ordered the mozzarella sticks, he corrected us. "Oh, you want the mozz chips?" Granted, they were called "mozz chips" on the menu, but jeez, it would have been more appropriate to call them mozzarella fried nuggets, possibly microwaved (they came out of the kitchen very quickly). Five of them, fairly small and oily, were presented to us. I'm not completely sure? but I think they were eleven dollars on the menu. Two dollars a nugget? TWO DOLLARS A NUGGET?! We also received bread with oil and vinegar to tide us over. The oil and vinegar was so unexciting that I took to dipping it in the marinara sauce that came the mozzarella sticks. It was necessary to dip the bread because it was inedibly dry by itself. After twenty two minutes our "paninis" arrived. Why the quotes, you ask? Correct me if Wikipedia and I are wrong, but paninis are grilled, yes? These were sandwiches. SANDWICHES, which were, according to legend, invented by the Earl of Sandwich in Great Britan. Two slabs of uncooked bread and cheese/vegetables/??? inside. Even Starbucks knows how to turn a sandwich into a panini. What's your excuse, Galli? Three members of our party got the Parma Panini, which I think was $14, with prosciutto, mozzarella, oregano, and lots and lots of oil. It was literally not impressive in that it was not grilled, like I described before. I ordered the Veggie Panini, with grilled vegetables. Funnily enough, the vegetables with amply and generously grilled to the point where they tasted, no matter what the vegetable, of oily zucchini. It also had mozzarella, which I don't have anything to say about. It was mozzarella. Nice. Could probably get it at Wegman's. Despite what I wrote above, the paninis were fine. Just fine, though, by no means good. I would never intentionally pay fourteen dollars for "fine" again though. The weird thing was, though, that what we expected to be the most underwhelming part of the meal turned out to be the best: the side salad. It was perfectly dressed, very easy to eat (you know how sometimes people look like gophers shoving oily lettuce into their mouth when they eat salad? none of that here). The waiter, with his aggressive italian accent, sold it with "the salad is with organic mesclun greens, cherry tomatoes, shredded carrots and lime cilantro dressing." It sounded like a high school cafeteria salad, but it turned out to be the highlight of our sad little meal. We did not stay for dessert.

This place is literally just steps away from my apartment. I love the French inspired cuisine as well as the fact that the menu changes every so often. It seems as if each time I've been there, the menu offers a different variety. The menu, however, is very small. Those who like having many options might not enjoy the experience. It can also be loud because it is next to the elevated JMZ train. The atmosphere, however, is quite cozy. Make sure you cash when you go, as they do not accept credit cards. It is worth it though. Trust me on that.

Pretty basic indian, even fancier atmosphere than Minar Palace down the street, which is my fav, and already too fancy (RIP: Old, unfancy Minar Palace on Sansom Street from 2005.) This seems like it would be the nicer option to go on a date to, and I love that they tell you on the menu what can be made vegan. But if I'm craving Indian, I'm heading to MP.

this review is for wedding and similar events. we have been there several times and found the food to be poor quality and not much variety.  the preparations are cheap, poor taste and not creative at all.

Ate here for the first time this weekend and had a great lunch. The crepes are delicious - light, but filling with an assortment of sweet and savory options. I had the crepe with goat cheese, tomato spread, turkey and arugula (jammin tomato?). It was delicious. I also tried the cheddar soup with  bacon, which I highly recommend. The service was surprisingly prompt for how crowded the place was. I love the hip decor, lively vibe and focus on fresh, local ingredients. Looking forward to returning for dessert!
I've tried going there and ordering for delivery but find the food very average and the staff very rude and unappreciative of your business
delicious, always fresh, better than chipotle's!  and personalized service.
Excellent.  They are really famous, and this was the best cheesesteak I ever tasted anywhere.  It was fresh, hot, and everything I expected and more.  Amazing!

My family and friends had our Thanksgiving meal here - yes reservations were necessary.  This was my first visit, and hopefully not my last.  The food was fantastic, the staff were attentive, helpful, and they had a great sense of humor.  This was also my first experience with many of the dishes (which at one point seemed endless), and the rabbit.  I've never eaten rabbit before, and no it didn't taste like chicken.  This was a wonderful experience, and I shall return!

The food is awesome it's a cool the set up is fun and different the service was really good everyone was very friendly and it was really clean inside the server was really cool she was joking and talking with us which was awesome made our experience there even better! The food was out really fast which was also great there was a lot of parking huge lot which was also a huge plus!
Clam sauce pasta is the way to go! Hands down! Large portions and really delicious! I'm full and I still want more. It's always nice to be a fatty at dinner

The four stars are for the amazing staff at 91st Street. Not for the new bar manager who thinks embarrassing her staff in front of us is ok. Or for making staff so miserable they quit (or get fired ). You guys had such a great thing going... Why did you allow this to happen. Spent over a thousand dollars here. But not any more. People who work in the service industry deserve much more respect then what she delivers. Can't watch it.  They put up with so much from clients daily and now this crazy gal?  Nope. Carmine's. Wake up!!  You are losing all your regulars and all the recommendations for new business.

My recommendation: Bacon loves lobster roll!!! It doesn't get any better than that. I tried it a few weeks ago and couldn't help myself from ordering delivery last week and getting it agin. It made my day! The restaurant is fun and the drinks are just something else. Go in if you get a chance, but if you can't make it try getting delivery. The mac & cheese is also recommended, and the best part is that everything has bacon!

Food bought: calamari (awesome), spider roll (disgusting), steak strip (good), and salmon in paper (good)... So I bought the groupon for Pure, THEN read all the mixed reviews. Had I done the reverse, I might not have bought the groupon. We got the waitress who told the story of Japanese businessmen loving the sushi and buying $200 worth... Blah blah blah... Like the other commenter said, those businessmen were either starving, or make believe... I would not come back there for sushi... However, the staff was polite, the entrees, though REALLY expensive, were delicious, the atmosphere was nice and relaxing. A good place to go for a date. Bring your groupon. Not worth the trip other wise.

What a bust. Five of us shared salads and pastas, and everyone had a cocktail. Cocktails were overly sweet and imbalanced. The spinach salad had NO dressing on it whatsoever and the arugula salad had only a tiny bit of oil. My squid ink pasta was overcooked and flavorless, with rubbery calamari. Desserts tasted like something that comes out of a display case at a diner. And it wasn't that reasonably priced, for such mediocre food. We came here only because we needed to grab a bite before getting drinks at awesome Dynaco. We will definitely not go back.
Truffles on everything!  Smells so good when you walk in!  Great place, good food and nice bartender on Sunday!!!  Can be pricy, but at least you get nice craft beers!!!

I stopped by on a Monday and while it was not very busy I had a great experience thanks to Ashley D. The food was great, the beer cold, and the bartender was beautiful. Not much else you could ask for!
Delicious!

They have very friendly and attentive staff. The 50% off sushi rolls come out to $3-$4 a roll. Such q good deal! Definitely note not all sushi rolls are 50% off. They offer delivery for purchases over $20 to many bordering towns.
I'm reviewing the c terminal kiosk near the 130 gates. Think it replaced Juan Valdez. Perfect latte, you sometimes forget what a great latte should look and taste like.  Great service.
Yummy
Sandwich was alright a bit on the dry side and expected more flavor to the meat.
Awesome and authentic ramen! I'm originally from Japan and this is what we eat 10 out of 10!

Decent sushi for all you can eat. It's not the best I've ever had due to the fact that they tend to put a lot of rice in the rolls and not too much fish. The lunch all you can eat options are limited to basic rolls. If you want specialty rolls, go for the dinner all you can eat.
Delicious food! Love the octopus salad! Def recommend this place. Prob warrants $$$ instead of $$, though.
It's an ok restaurant if you're looking for a busy rather loud place. Waitress and bar tender very friendly. Food is ok.

Loooooove there lobster rolls. My fav is the warm and buttery style, I forget the name. But this place is def the best I've had. I had my order to go so I didn't check out the dinning area next door but that's ok I'll def be back soon.

I ordered takeout and had it delivered to a bar so that was a really nice feature.  I had the baked mac & cheese which was big enough to have leftovers for lunch the next day.  Also got to try some of the spicy fries - delicious! I would have given 4 stars but I'm knocking one off due to a menu issue.  The menu online lists a grilled cheese sandwich but when we called, there was no grilled cheese...not sure how they could be out of that.

A rare but well anticipated stop for burgers in NYC. Delicious and decadent (always have the truffle burger/fries) and amazing ambiance. The service is standard, slightly aloof. Pricey for a burger destination but the quality is definitely there. Always enjoy my visits to Umami!

needs to be updated, most of the seats are ripped, and have tape on them.  wife and daughter went to bathroom, and never got to go. besides ladies room being filthy, the smoke smell from the workers taking cigarette breaks in there is awful.  the food, we never finished and the waitress didnt seem to care and was in a terrible mood. she cared to look at me when i left a quarter tip. this is a once and done place for me.............

Tried SHS twice. Once for lunch on Saturday and then because I could not believe it was so bad, Monday night for dinner as I had head good things and Stella's was closed for repair and it was raining. Lunch: Order ice tea and diet coke, I ordered eggs and toast and spouse ordered soup and salad. Ice tea came with out ice, soda was flat, toast was cold, soup had been left our and had skin on top and salad was mealy. Service was slow even thought we were one of only a few in restaurant. OK slow day and cook must of quit. $34 was very pricey for what we ordered.   Dinner: On my own Monday night. Ordered NA beer, did not have any. Ordered ice tea and took 10 minutes. Ordered burger for $8 and onion rings. Burger was maybe 4oz and came cold. Onion rings OK but not great. Again service marginal but polite. $17. Other issue I had was patron at the bar was in deep conversation with bar tender and every third word was a loud  F this and F that. Does not speak to class. Given the number of other great options within a block or two you think they would figure this out. I have to assume this is remote management. I will be amazed if this place lasts another month. Great tradition in the location, this version  will not be part of any of that history. Given the investment why would you not train staff and kitchen. Quality comes from paying attention to basics first then details. If you want to be just a bar,don't serve food.

Well designed and well lit fun Thai staple in HK. Large portions for a Thai restaurant. Their tuna tar tar is famous! The service was helpful and accommodating. After all these years this place is still great!
Good Vegan options, and the wings tossed in bbq sauce are so so good.  I'm happiest here at late night happy hour and brunch time.  I've really come around on Cedar Point in the past two years.

The food is amazing and really unique for Philadelphia. The cuisine reminds me of living in the South and that may add bonus points to this review. The hush puppies and mac and cheese are to die for and there's plenty of veggie options for my vegetarian lady. Plenty of meat options to feed my cave man needs. Service is mostly good. It's usually packed but the wait for food is never too long. The beer list is amazing. A ton of choices and good details on their menu. Plus, the staff is knowledgeable about the beer. Hit this spot up when in Old City.

Amazing happy hour at 20% off wine and flatbreads.  Biggest small plates I've experienced and first time when ordering a "chefs choice" cheese platter that all 4 picks were equally amazing.  Great atmosphere, can't wait to return.
I've never had better Mexican food in the US. Definitely what I miss most from the year I lived in Littlefield. Someone please send me a J!

This is the best sushi I have had yet in Vermont. I knew immediately as I saw the sushi arrive that I was in for a treat as the rice had that "glimmer" to it. Anyways, the seafood was fresh and skillfully crafted. I went on a quieter weeknight. As other reviewers commented the ambiance is a bit odd and although my service was speedy I can see how things might get a bit behind on a busier night. I did find it odd that they prepare the sushi in the kitchen versus a typical sushi bar. I am looking forward to my next visit and hope it is not a letdown.

This could be the worst restaurant on Earth!  I stopped by to pick up a turkey grinder to go for my wife.  I wish I would have looked at it before I got home because it was the WORST SUB I've ever seen!  I thought a mom and pop place would take pride in their food but it turns out the family prefers to screw customers to save a buck.  For $8, I got 1 slice of turkey and 1 slice of cheese on a 12 inch sub!!  The bread is super thick and when you figure their lack of any generosity with other ingredients, that's about all you get.  An $8 Bread Roll...  My wife took 1 bite of the sub and because of that they offered a 50% refund (while wanting the entire sub back....  Insane! I know!!!)  Please don't support these criminals.  Go anywhere else to eat unless you feel like being robbed.  See the pathetic pictures of the 1 slice of cheese and 1 shaving of turkey on this pathetic piece of garbage they call a Turkey Sub!!

This is a really cool bar and restaurant. I would never be surprised to see a 1920s gangster come out of the restroom. The place plays smooth jazz, TV is on but not a focus, and the atmosphere is really cool. Starting with beer, the list is small but there's always good beer options. It rotates regularly. We know we could have something we haven't had before. As far as food, everything I've had is delicious. Both the burger and the veggie burger are delicious. The fries are great and the serving size is just right so we don't feel gross. The service is always excellent and knowledgable. The bartenders are friendly and for two years, I've seen the same bartenders which is probably why the patrons at the bar are always interesting and friendly. Makes for a really good evening.
Fast, quick and great service. BDC is great if you don't mind the "chain restaurant" feel of the interior. It definitely has a more casual atmosphere compared to Kum Gang or Shilla.

Went in very spontaneously to grab a bite and maybe a drink. My sister in law said "its nice and cozy" so we went in anyways. The seating is a bit uncomfortable if you sit in the middle and have a bunch of people sitting by the bar.... BUT their shrimp tacos and steak tacos are the bomb! Their barrio mojito is also delish. I liked the food and drinks, just didnt like the fact that our server left without saying anything to us.

If you love chocolate this is for you. Had a chocolate martini and chocolate fondue and five other variations of chocolate. Who knew of a chocolate bar? Saturday night it was packed. The service was friendly, will be back in the future for more indulgence.

Holy cow! One of the best meals I've ever had in New York. Between myself and my friend we had the grilled octopus appetizer, the ravioli in brown butter and sage, and the skirt steak. There were so many little goodies hidden under the entrées, I couldn't even tell you what they were but they were all amazing - some little mushrooms, fingerling potatoes, etc. the ambience was perfect. We asked for a quiet private table and they put us smack in the middle of the room but agreed to move us to the remote corner when we pointed it out (the restaurant was almost empty as it was late lunch time). Dinging them one star because they would not serve a Bloody Mary. The waitress said they only serve them on weekends because that's when it is pre-mixed. We asked if they could simply make a Bloody Mary, but she said they couldn't because they "had no tomato juice." In any case, kudos to the chef.

I have been here several times this place deserves the five star rating that it has. everybody who works here including the owner of the nicest people you'll ever meet. all the food is homemade and is absolutely amazing.

Everytime im here the food us great service is always quick and courteous even when they are dealing with annoying college kids Ive never tried anotherprotein besides the steak becsuse its sooo good the sides are all good especially the eggplant trued the beans today theyre meh but everything else us great and good servjce

So, I would just like to start by saying that I have never had the privilege of eating at Savin Rock Roasting Company. I am a new resident of West Haven and am still making my rounds among the local businesses. After walking past Savin Rock Roasting I decided to pop in and grab a printed to-go menu. The waiter was extremely polite, the patrons at the bar all seemed to be enjoying their meals and the atmosphere was inviting. The environment was very clean and I loved that you can see the cooks preparing the meals. Not to mention the fully (maybe even over-supplied bar), which I can absolutely respect, as a bartender. After returning home my husband and I reviewed the menu and are sure that we will be attending this establishment soon. After our experience I will be sure to update my review. As for now, the wonderful scents, lengthy menu, and positive vibes will be what I leave you with as my first experience at Savin Rock Roasting Company.

Used to live in Old City so we would end up here enough times to eat. Although the food is good, the service is lacking and so is the atmosphere. It's a bit basement-like and also can be very loud. Of all the places to grab a just a beer in Old City, this is in the last of the places I'll consider despite a better than decent list. Had the least friendly hipster cliche bartender who really did not want to work. Bad experience.

Been here twice, several months apart. Excellent and Excellent. Tilapia and then salmon. Both perfect.  Fast, polite service. Both times. I like the atmosphere which I won't try to describe. Loungy, Retro but Modern?  See.?  Comfortable.  Easy walk--one block--from independence hall.

Well its the Holidays !!! So what better than to go visit here The psychic always gets it right sitting out front " you will have lots of cocktails and get blind drunk " CORRECT !!! I came here with some coworkers after dinner . The ambiance is really amazing bustling vibe The drinks were spectacular. Being in W Village and serving up cocktails without an air of superiority in such an atmosphere is actually commendable. Definitely a worthwhile stop. Not much seating at bar

I have to Say I Love Just Plain Dave's. Always a great meal for a Great Price . Love the New location cause its Closer to me LOL. and the interior of the new place is very nice as well. GREAT FOOD!!!!!!!!!
Awsome food and the new space looks amazing great meal as always. Very friendly place
Fun, friendly environment! Family style meals make the evening more entertaining and easier to share with everyone.

Grrrreat Brrrunch! Although we had to wait for quite a while (~45 minutes) the food was incredible! So flavourful, so savoury, so filling! We had the crab cakes and shrimp and grits, but don't be fooled, this is not your ordinary crab cake! There is so much great crab meat and a fabulous balance of spices. Juicy goodness!  The shrimp on the grits are very good as well! Highly recommended for all Harlemites and tourists alike!
best!! best!! best!! i love this place!!! best ramen ever!!!!

Excellent, We had Thanksgiving here. It was so wonderful. The Food was awesome and the service was great. Oh yeah the place also had such a nice feel too. Can't say enough nice things about it. We were suppose to stay at an AirBnB at 407 Rugby Rd, Brooklyn, so we booked the Farm for our Thanksgiving Dinner. Unfortunately Rick Mueller the owner of what he calls  "Artist's Ditmas Pk 5 bedroom house" is a dump. The place was unsafe and smelled, So we couldn't stay there and Rick kept our money. Luckily though it showed us the way to the Farm and that made it almost worth the terrible experience with Rick.

We started with Caprese di Bufala as an appetizer. Perfectly sized for sharing, and absolutely perfect for an appetizer. The roasted peppers and buffalo mozzarella were especially delicious, and generously sized. For entrée I had the Pizza Dora with added mushrooms, which was excellent. I could not quite finish the pizza, but I definitely wanted to. If anything, there was too much meat on it for the crust to support it, but the sausage was so good it is hard to complain. Dessert was cannoli, sized perfectly to wash down the big pizza with something small, but sweet. The seating is a bit cramped, but it was expected as this was exactly the kind of hole-in-the-wall pizza place I was looking for. 5 stars.

Excellent selection of burgers, their American nachos are amazing (they make their own chips!). Beer selection is huge too! They also do a bacon week each year, which serves a special bacon menu. Highly recommend if you want a good burger and nachos
Good pizza, but definitely NOT worth the price.  For slices, go across the street to Manhattan Pizza or down the block to Mr. Mike's.  All are thin crust, crispy, cheesy NY style.

Woooooow  thats all.... And this is from someone that hates cream sauce stuff  but wow  sooo good . At first its like no way u can taste good. Way too much dough. Way too..... ::bites::...... HOLY WTF!!! Its goooood  mmmmmmm

I held a private event in the back room and the staff was extremely accommodating.  The space was perfect, music was spot on, the food was great and the drinks were flowing.  There was a delay with some drinks but with a large group that is to be expected - especially with heavy drinkers on a busy Saturday night.  I would highly recommend this venue for a private event in the future.

This is a good spot to grab a quick, non-pizza lunch in Old City. Food is good, lines can be a bit slow and there's rarely a good spot to sit. Fortunately, we lived nearby and could take it with us. Overall, I'd recommend but I don't rush to head back.

This place would be fine if their prices were about half what they are, as it is it's a huge rip off. They charged me 5 dollars for a handful of microwaved storebought crinkle cut fries that were f***ing disgusting, it was outrageous. I ended up spending over $30 for a plain cheese pie with a burnt bottom, a sandwich and aforementioned french fries. They don't even deliver, don't bother with them, there are places with the exact same or better quality of food that are way cheaper, like Rocky's further down Franklin Avenue for example.

We read the rave reviews for this restaurant, and booked it for our Thanksgiving dinner. I made reservations several months in advance. The atmosphere was very nice, and so was our table. The menu was price fixed. Our waiter took our order, and then began the wait. At first we thought it was just talking a long time because it was a special day, or, maybe things just took longer there. But we became concerned when we noticed several tables that had been seated after us, getting, and even finishing, their food. In addition, our waiter had only been back to us once, and our water glasses were empty and we had no silverware. We had to ask another server to find our server. When he came, and we questioned him about where our food was, he said he couldn't get into the kitchen, and there wasn't anything he could do. Miraculously, after he left, our food arrived, lukewarm. We asked to speak to the manager, and were told it would be awhile. After beginning to eat, since our son was starving by this time, and waiting more, I got up and went towards the back where there were several servers, and again asked to see a manager. After an additional 20 minutes, a woman arrived, said she had been upstairs. We told her our experience, and stated that we waited an hour and a half for lukewarm Thanksgiving dinner. She apologized, and offered us drinks to "make it better". We didn't want drinks, as we had already had a drink prior to dinner. We were concerned by her and her staff's lack of recognition and ownership of the apparent problems. These serious issues needed to be acknowledged, so that they can be corrected for the future. Outside of the business aspects of the poor service, we were emotionally distressed by this whole experience. We traveled from DC to have Thanksgiving dinner there. The lack of ownership of the problem by the waiter, "it's out of my hands" in response to "why is our food taking so long?" and then the additional wait for management, created additional frustration. In our opinion, if a customer requests to speak to a manager, leadership should be there almost immediately, to listen, identify, and act. Unfortunately, that was not the case, so after finishing our meal, we paid the check (60 USD per person for the price fix dinner) and left.

I love Thai food and have eaten lots of it in my time, from Boston to New York to Philly and then some. All in all, Baan Thai is easily the best Thai restaurant in Philly and certainly one of the best of all the Thai restaurants I've tried. For me, consistency is key, and Baan Thai brings it every single time. We've eaten here probably around 25 times over the last couple of years and have never been disappointed. The service is impeccable -- friendly, accommodating and fast. They are BYOB, which is a huge plus for us as we do like our wine very much. And, most importantly, the food is amazing. I crave their red curry and I cannot imagine going there without ordering it, with seafood in my case. I read in a previous review that the fish cakes (Tod Mun) were outstanding and that reviewer was absolutely right. Easily the best I have ever had. The firecracker shrimp are also a must-have. Other notable appetizers are the calamari (Golden Rings) and the spring rolls. Everything I've tried has been wonderful. The sauces served with the appetizers are also delightful and overall effect of the complementary flavors is truly a sensuous experience. My wife always must have the Seafood on the Flame which is served actually on fire (part of the allure for her) and is always delicious. We have brought our son, who is not known for his broad palate or his willingness to try new foods, but he ordered the duck tamarind (for reasons unknown to me) and he absolutely loved it. I tried as much as he would allow and it was incredible. We live in the neighborhood so we always eat there which I strongly suggest as nothing beats having the food served to you directly from the kitchen, (especially the dishes served on fire...) The atmosphere is quaint and very pleasant. A nice bit of romance to it. They have a fountain which quietly bubbles in the corner and usually have some decent background music playing.
