Who knows how long we would have sat there. Btw, there were several workers behind the register and busing tables. It took 40 min to receive our food and we had to ask for the check at the end. I was tired of waiting. Food was ok. I've had better Thai food and experience at other local venues. Definitely won't be back!!

I woke up with an appetite so I decided to order from this place since it was the only thing around that was open. I ordered sausage egg and cheese sandwich, some eggs and bacon and what I thought would be a "potato pancake" .. I liked that they arrived quickly but very disappointed with the quality. it cost north of 30 bucks too which is annoying. the orange juice is freshly squeezed with a lot of pulp, that's probably the only thing that I enjoyed. that, and the bacon... the sausage they used for the sandwich was weird shape and hard to chew... they didn't even give me a copy of my receipt or a menu... needless to say, I don't think I'll be ordering from them again.
Delicious! I love this place, their triple pork brisket as awesome! Absolutely try it out!

In a random NJ strip mall sits Spice Grill.This is our second  visit  there.The restaurant is set up as a nice sit down eatery but they seem to do more takeout than dine in business.It lends to a confused atmosphere,as patrons come to pick up their take out as you sit at a candle lit table while kids are screaming  in the attached party room. It was disconcerting  to say the least. Out waiter actually  left our table mid order to answer the phone for a take out order!I was floored,as that has never happened  to me before. The food is definitely  the bright spot of this establishment. I would give the food a 4 and the service a 1.Our waiter never came back to check on us.The water guy was the only person on point as our water glasses were constantly  refilled. I had the tandoori chicken  which was great and my wife had the lamb.Like I stated before the food was authentic  and  tasty  but the atmosphere  and service were  lacking. The prices are moderate and I feel it's a good value.
Worth for their soba soup. Prefer there for lunch to get the box set !

Really good food and desserts. You don't have a specific waiter and they are very attentive so we were constantly getting our water refilled without having to ask and getting checked on which was great. Small space so it's a bit crowded. Was able to hear the entire conversation of the people sitting next to me.
Great food and great service :) very authentic Venezuelan food. Never tried it or heard about it before. It was absolutely delicious!!!

So my parents and I absolutely love seafood soondubu and we get it at every korean place we go. Our fav used to be in fort lee but now we come to this restaurant all the time. Food quality is amazing. Food flavor is on point. Great place and now our favorite place to eat. Ive already recommended it to all my friends in the area :)
Wow the prices are amazing. And yes there is always a wait but it is well worth it. And the food is prepared so fast.

Went on a Thursday night service was fair little slow prices were high more than I was expecting  . it was $16 for some average lasagna. Drink prices way to high. Most likely wouldn't go back again meal for three of us ran $170.   Portions were good quality of the food was average.

I recently ate at Beyond Pita for the first time. I got the cheesesteak with the homemade hot sauce. I loved it! I was very hungry so I was excited that the cheesesteak is so big. I also like that they use seasoned potato chunks in the sandwich. But what made it so yummy is the homemade hot sauce. Oh and the prices r great. The huge cheesesteak was less than $7 and they use fresh ingredients. I've already been back and will continue to eat the food there

Amazing Food. I have always known about this restaurant in Montclair but I never walked in to see what the food was like until yesterday! Their gyros and menu specials are incredible. I will continue to be a regular customer at this restaurant because there are a lot of other delicious meals I want to try in the future!

This place SUCKS to order in from. I have gone into the restaurant to eat and the food is great and you get a good portion. I just ordered a salad for delivery($14.20 w tip) and it was the most pathetic thing I have ever seen. They tried to hide the lack of fish by mixing it with the tomatoes. I was so mad that I isolated the fish just to see how much was actually there....imagine the size of 3grapes. That was how much meat was in my $14 salad! They wouldn't substitute the cheese and sour cream for corn(which is waaay cheaper btw)...Just such an annoyance. I could have gotten a salad anywhere and I feel like they took advantage of the fact that I couldn't return it because I'm not there. I called and they told me that that is just how they make the salad. That's a lie. I've been here before....a lot. But never again. grrrr

I love the food here. My favorite dishes are on the back of the menu it is the traditional menu. The roasted belly pork is so yummy!!!!!!!! And the steamed spicy beef is perfect for the winter time it goes perfectly with rice. The pineapple shrimp is awesome  during the summer time, it's fruity and light.

Many friends of ours raved about this place for years and have made a tradition of going there before and after movies at the nearby theater. When we finally tried it ourselves we were pleasantly surprised by the sophisticated, upscale, interesting menu - definitely not just typical take-out Chinese sort of fare. The food was delicious with good portions, atmosphere quiet and pleasant, and the service extremely friendly from the moment you step inside. We've been back many times, including last night when I got the Szechuan dumplings in spicy sesame sauce and tender, spicy, savory mala chicken. Normally I like to try new things and the menu has so many interesting and rare dishes to try, but I couldn't resist ordering the mala chicken I'd had before because it was just so good! We got take-out because we were so tired, the only problem with that is we miss out on their beautiful and creative plating presentation.

We have been here about five times so far.  Small and intimate.  The service from when you walk in the door is welcoming.  Family owned and ran.  Ceviche OUT OF THIS WORLD. From start to finish the quality, taste and service is 150%.  They put so much care into all the food. Even the small details are done I have brought new people tonight and they loved it as well.   This IS our new place and I think we are regulars as we are just addicted to the whole experience Enjoy as I know I will recommend highly to all my local friends

A bunch of us stopped in here for dinner one night and we are all foodies for the most part: I'll start off by saying the atmosphere in this place is so cool! I absolutely loved it. The food is farm to table - so all very natural, organic options and even a good selection of vegetarian options. Myself and my fiancé ordered the squash soup (amazing) and the chicken (also amazing). My sister ordered the Fettucini and my cousin ordered the parsnip "steak" - both, again, excellent. The service was fantastic and all of the waitstaff was extremely informed and knowledgeable about the foods that were on the menu. Very impressive. One slight minor downfall was it did take us a while to get our meal - from the time we finished our soup to the time we got our meal it had been about 40 minutes. It was worth the wait and I know sometimes kitchens get behind. It wouldn't stop me from coming back. Hope more places like this in Hartford start popping up - excellent!!

Food is pretty good, however every time I put my half full beer down, the bartenders would snag it while I wasn't looking so I would have to pay for another one. Finally I said something and got a free beer, which was nice- but I'm sure they do that to other people who don't notice!

This place really needs to take the word "express" off its name.  For a place at the airport it would be nice if the staff showed some care or urgency.  Only two people in front of me ordering.  By the time  I got my food it had been about 25 minutes later.  They had 5 people working and only two people were actually doing anything.  They had made about 3 peoples burgers before mine who had ordered after me.  They finally gave me my burger and the patty looked like a meatball and the fries were soggy.
Love this new bistro in Upper Montclair.  Dimitri combines his Table 8 and Osteria Giotto experience to create a perfect atmosphere with delicious food. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.
My favorite pizza place ever!! I tell all folks around to eat here ! The food is one of a kind taste and experience. I always eat pizza here when I visit New York!!

Too small they pack tables together together and you can't walk through.  Also very disorganized. They kept seating people that got there after there after me. The staff was also rude. I I went across the street street and street and had street and had a much more pleasant experience.

We went Saturday around 11 for brunch and there was no wait. The food took a little long to come out but everything came out together and was hot. The coffee was also very good. The atmosphere is very warming and the interior was very pretty! We will be back again~

My boyfriend and I have come here a couple times and the food was always decent.  Tonight we made the mistake of ordering online.  The delivery took over an hour (fine, it's raining and it is an online order I get it).  However, the Tuscany salad which I have ordered before which consists of leafy spinach greens, capers, grilled chicken, bruschetta tomatoes with a lemon vinaigrette looked like the scraps from the dumpster out back.  When we called to let them know our complaint, the manager did not express any sort of empathy that what was delivered was clearly mistaken for someone's doggy bag leftovers.

We have ordered several pizzas.  (Coupons are great) Tonight we ordered two hot subs - Meatball Parmigiana and Eggplant Parmigiana. They were excellent and the price was right. We used their online APP and they were ready when we arrived.  We will order again.

OMG, I love this place... Everything about it. Food is great. Love the kebabs (especially swordfish and lamb), rice dishes and sides (don't miss the pumpkin.) Decent wine list, good cocktails, nice bar. Good value... Great for a casual meal, hanging out, with friends, or a special date. Small plates and apps are also really good. Great hummus. Better than Tapas and almost as good as Blue Plate Kitchen.

Ordered through Grubhub and was not pleased with my meal nor the customer service. I found some strands of hair in my food and called them to let them know. They didn't apologize and tried to convince me I was wrong, found them to be very rude! My advice is to skip this place, there's way better food options  in Montclair.

Staff was very rude more interested in personal conversations than helping customers, also they are pretty pricey for the food you get and that food is decent nothing special in anyway. If you are thinking vitos think again don't believe the hype

I generally like Midori. I've eaten at their other locations, but their location in Princeton is far from great. My recent encounter with them, via grubHub, was far from pleasant. When I picked up my order, the person at the counter was very rude and would only acknowledge my order via my phone number. I explained I ordered it via grubHub, but they were dismissive and even got annoyed. Get better people to work the front desk and keep asshole employees away from customers, please. I will definitely never order from their Princeton location again.

Had lunch there to today. Nice space, huge menu, 80 beers on tap! My friend had the bangers and mash which he loved. I had a GIANT stuffed potato which was awesome. Staff helpful and nice. Totally good pub food. Will be back to try other items. Totally fun and enjoyable.
Fulfilling and tasty Chinese foods with affordable prices, be prepared for the waiting lines.

My husband and i came here a few months ago. We did the tasting menu, oh....my....word.... best decision ever! We had so much food! I loved not knowing what was going to come out next, and everything was so delish!
Excellent food And the service from all staff was very accommodating - even sweet. Highly recommended.

My friend and I found this restaurant on yelp and were extremely impressed by the attentive service we received. I had the veal which was amazing and my friend had the ravioli. I would definitely come back again if I lived here.
Great beer, live music, and both bar snacks we ordered were delicious (pretzels and smashed fingerlings w/ bacon)
Awesome food!!  Good size space for NYC.  Server was really great.  Only complaint is that drinks are small.  Would definitely go back!

Great place!! My husband took me for my birthday and it was just what we needed, Intimate and we weren't right on top of the table next to us!  It was an old row home converted into a restaurant, just like most the BYOBs but it was set for mostly 4 tops!  We ended up getting the prefix menu, which turned out to be a great value!! And they catered to gluten free allergies and lactose intolerance!  Usually I don't get dessert because it's all cream and dairy but when it came time to choose, I asked if they could simply cut up fruit and drizzle honey on top!? I gratefully received pears cut in small cubes topped with honey and walnuts presented in a martini glass!!! Loved every bite, it was perfect!
I would love this place so much more if i didnt have to wait on line with 500 tourists just to get a take out pizza
Had a local take us as he states back in the day it was the best but now just a tourist thing to say you did. It's OK. Can't say much.

Tasteless and overpriced all around.  Don't forget the waiter and his attitude.  Maybe we ordered the wrong thing and the lamb,  hummus,  baba ghanoush and salad are just their bad dishes. Idk.  Very very meh.

Small place that fills up quickly... But our waiter was super cute and sweet. We started off with the fresh plantains and guacamole which was wonderful, followed by an assortment of meat empanadas and then dessert empanadas as we sipped our happy hour margaritas. Small sizes, so order several of everything... but they're very affordable.

I just ordered from Blu Orchid, and I could not believe how fasty m food arrived!! I have to admit that I was a bit skeptical when my food arrived, because it only been 10 minutes earlier.. I had the chicken Pad Thai, papaya salad and the naan and hummus. They were all amazing. The entree was hot and the vegetables were cooked to perfection.
Fantastic. Warm and cozy , great food, drink and service.  Great atmosphere and music.
I've lived in New Orleans my entire life and I swear this is the best Gumbo I've had ever
I love the variety of the menu. Reasonably priced. Have been twice now and will go back again!

I went to this restaurant by seeing many good reviews, however, I am very disappointed by the food they made.  The meatballs weren't  fresh made, I can taste the meatballs were stay in the fridge for long time, also I ordered a pesto pasta, the oil in that dishes could fill up an empty glass. So disgusting....
Must try Wood Fired Free Range Chicken !

Tyler the bartender was everything you'd want when trying out a new place.  He politely answered all of our questions and gave us in depth descriptions about our drink choices.  He was attentive and on point with all of his recommendations all while looking exceptionally dapper.  I highly suggest the Secret Knock and the Overnighter.  The atmosphere was perfect with a very rustic/classy feel.  We had the pleasure of meeting two other bartenders Ray and Deon who were also very friendly.  Will definitely return on my next trip to Philadelphia.

I love Bivio.  My fiance and I are regular customers, as we live in town.  The pizza is excellent.   However, I have to complain about the way this business is run.  Many months ago, we asked the owner's wife about having our engagement party there.  She said that we would talk to the owner and took our information, but we never heard from her.  I thought that was kind of rude, but shrugged it off.  I was a waitress.  I know how busy you can get.  I assumed she probably just lost the paper or forgot about it completely.  We kept putting off our engagement party and never really asked about it again. Recently, we decided to condense our engagement party list and just make it an intimate night with immediate family- 12 people in all.  I called a week in advance to ask if they had availability.  I was told that they do not accept parties over 6 people.  Now, I understand that this is not a large restaurant by any means.  However, there is a large enough space in the back to adequately seat our whole party.  The restaurant I worked in was the same size, had a larger menu, one cook, and would have NEVER turned away a 12 top.   This is strike two for this restaurant for me.  Although we love the food, they may have just lost two customers.

Really really good food.  Very comfortable atmosphere.  Great service and a great value for NYC.  The construction isn't doing it any favors but do not let that stop you.  Definitely worth your time.  Will absolutely come back.

So disappointing. Food is over priced and bland. Brown lettuce in my salad. Waitstaff acts like guests are an interruption to their day. Seems like lots of underage drinking at night... Or at least they look young. Was there for drinks and birthday celebration a few weeks back. Drinks were not tasty and the whole experience left me totally underwhelmed. With so many great choices in West Hartford, skip this one.
The extremely rude service makes you loose your appetite to begin with. The tuna was brown -- obviously NOT fresh. We're definitely not coming back!
Three words: sweet potato fritters!!!

Very good food - service needs some work. 3 of the 12 beers were not available (weird they were the specials), no orange even offered for my blue moon (maybe everyone does not do this), no variations from the menu (I wanted meatballs on my pizza - no. Well can I order a side of meatballs...) and then, no basil for the margarita, but they did not tell is until they brought the pizza out (so I guess you can make exceptions from the menu. Food is good... Someone may want to help the management. Ps - the kitchen is open and I can hear you talking about us.

The food and drinks always impress us even if it is a bit pricey and at times ostentatious. The ambience is lovely, especially in the winter sitting beside the fireplace. Drink service in the bar area can at times take a while, and we've had to send drinks back a few times, but the waiters remained kind.

The wife and I frequent the grill for its great food and spirits when We can get a babysitter on a Saturday night. Tonight we were especially pleased when we had Gabriel as our cocktail waitress. An adorable girl with the personality of a firecracker. She took the time to chat and made the experience personal. Our drinks were great, kudos to the bartender. I enjoyed a refreshing Moscow mule, and my wife had a Pino with great legs. Salt creek really lands the timing of drink and food, prompt with our drinks, and enough time after that to chat before the food came. Yet another great experience, we will be back. Came back and had the same lovely experience.

I love Salt Creek grille! This past week was my first visit to this location and I had a wonderful experience. I sat in the bar area with my friend and was greeted by Gabby. She had a lovely personality and didn't leave us needing anything. The drinks and food came out so promptly and it was all delicious. I will definitely be back in the near future!

The food is pretty good but the service is one of the worst I have ever experienced. The staff is constantly talking about their personal problems loud enough (almost as if no guest are even there).  I gave them 3 chances before I decided to give a poor review. I am staying at the hotel next door for the week with no car and this was the only legit (LOL) restaurant the I could go to.  The first night my food took over an hour and was cold when it got to me.  It took a long time to get my check as well.  I tried doing lunch there the next day. I ordered chowder and a house salad. The chowder came out quick and tasted like Cambell's but I like I like Cambell's so I didn't complain. My salad was still not at my table 30 minutes later.  I canceled the salad and paid my bill.  I decided to give them just one more chance and walked in at 10:55 on a Friday night and was treated like an infectious disease when I said I wanted to order food. Apparently an establishment that has a full bar, for the first time in my life stops serving food at 11 and gets gives you an attitude when you ask when it's close to 11.  I did call the on duty manager after my lunch time experience and she was very nice but I think this place has some very deep issues.  I also don't want to hear the staff loudly talking about their personal issues when I have enough of my own and am trying to enjoy a peaceful meal.  AND... to the girl complaining that she has worked 9 days in a row... I have worked over 4 months without a day off.  I come to a place like this to relax.  I don't want to hear it.  P.S. I have been managing restaurants on and off for 20 years so I know.
Great prices, great atmosphere, great food! Simple menu but all the choices are awesome.

Hi guys So ok I went to his restaurant yesterday and I had a pretty good time I had a fish sandwich which was very big and also tasted very good, to me. I am an adult man by age but still I often cannot cook for myself or properly buy food, so often I go to restaurants  like this to help fill both a food hole and an emotional hole in my life. There was also a very helpful British (Australian??) female waiter who was very good to me and brought me literally everything I wanted very skillfully. Altogether it was a great experience to temporarily distract me form the gaping existential void we all feel everyday in our on private lives. Happy dining! I apologize for spelling mistakes I am in dark room alone typing on iPad mini

Came here on a Friday evening and it was packed. We sat at the bar for one drink and then the hostess sat us within 5-10. The food portions are on the small side. The two of us got 4 dishes and they were all fantastic. I would go back in a heart beat

Good atmosphere, however the service was absolutely terrible. The water was being fixed and our server told us 15 minutes until it would be ready. He ignored our table, asking us if we wanted anything, then saying that they don't have it due to the water issue. Only pizzas were available so we ordered the Parma as an appetizer, which was pretty well done. After that, I overhear the server complaining that customers are being seated, and proceeds to tell them that the water isn't working for 10 minutes, 35 minutes after we arrived. Overall an unpleasant experience while visiting NYC.

Just okay banh mi and summer rolls. The summer rolls were filled with 90% rice noodles, a couple shrimp and some flavorless iceberg lettuce, not a herb to be seen. The sauce seemed watered down. The banh mi bread is nice and crusty, but the tofu, which was supposed to be spicy, didn't have much flavor at all, and what herbs were actually in the sandwich were unchopped so you would accidentally pull out some giant stalk you had to chew up with your mouthful. Nothing special, lack of Vietnamese flavor (Cyclo kills this place, but then again NYC isn't a great place for SE Asian food unless you find the few spots in Queens). My biggest problem was the WASTE. They serve everything in plastic takeout containers which they do not recycle. Imagine the waste from every couple that comes in to order a bowl of noodles or an appetizer! Get some plates, Nam Nam.
LaMalt is an absolute gem. It's a fantastic speak easy 1920's cool vibe. The food is surprisingly amazing. Try the Kobe beef burgers. Best cocktail is the Ferrari. Enjoy and thank me later.

I want to give no stars.  City Pizza is the worst tasting pizza in town.  I've lived in this neighborhood most of my life and every time I order from City Pizza I am seriously disappointed and mad that I spent my money there.  Maybe writing this will make me remember to never order from there again.  Flavorless, fake feeling food.

I ate a small appetizer, fried calamari at the Nassau Inn Yankee Doodle tap room the Friday after thanksgiving. 24 hours later, I was sick with severe food poisoning-like symptoms. 24 hours after that, this article comes out. planetprinceton.com/2014… Called manager of hotel to get my one nights stay refunded to me because it's clear to me when 40 people get sick, who all have one place in common - there's something very wrong there. Manager denied my claims. The problem is, I run my own business and was unable to work with my clients for two days because of the illness caused by frequenting the Nassau Inn on that Friday.  So, I believe a refund is more than fair and am appalled at the management of the Inn and its restaurant. I hope the health department shuts them down - I can't believe there have been no reported consequences yet as a result of this incredible story. I will never stay here again. I'd rather stay further out of town and avoid this nonsense. Or maybe I'll go to The Peacock Inn - who has it figured out.

Our concierge recommended this bar to us, my friends had just arrived in town late Saturday night. After leaving 2 other bars because the Bartenders were rude, I can't tell you how refreshing it was to walk into a bar and be greeted with a big smile and friendly "good Morning" from Angie. It was our friends Birthday and The Ear Inn made us feel so special and welcome. Angie is great fun, and a walking encyclopedia of restaurants, bars and the city in general. If only all places treated they're customers like this.

Thoroughly enjoyed this place. We were by the door at first so we asked to move to the back and the quickly accommodated our request. The food was delicious and Our servers recommendations were spot on to what we were feeling.

This was a nice place to go with the previous owners and is now a GEM with the new owners. You could not feel more welcome and the interior is stunningly beautiful and cozy. Food is of the highest quality and caringly prepared - from burgers in the tavern to fine dining. Food & Wine, James Beard and the Globe are not wrong. Weathersfield is worth the drive.

Probably one of the worst Latin food experiences I've ever had,  and being that I'm Cuban (Born in the US) and my girlfriend is  Columbian (from Columbia) we know a little something about Latin food. We were starving and looking for a place to eat and just happened to walk right by it and decided to go in and give it a try that was mistake number one. Mistake number two was ordering the steak with onions and the roast pork. I've hardly ever seen finish stake in my entire life and the taste, well, there wasn't really much of a taste. As far as the roast pork goes I think they ran out of real pieces of roast pork and gave me everything that was on the bottom of the pan. A word on cleanliness... So the owner of the place wrapping up knives and spoons and forks in tissue to place down on tables. She dropped a spoon on the floor, looked down pick it up and then proceeded to put it right back in the pile of clean utensils... Now I'm a New Yorker through and I know stuff like that I know happens all the time but this happened right in front of me and she didn't even bat an eye, it seemed like it was habit. Very not good we also ordered an avocado salad and some green bananas fried up otherwise known as tostones, they ranked high on the list of worst fried bananas I've ever had. The Flan wasn't so bad! I will forgive but I will never forget.

I came her based on a recommendation from an acquaintance and was completely happy in every way. My brother and law stopped here before a show at the Trocadero and were able to get our order in time to see the opening band. The food is delicous -the rolls are soft yet not too soft with meat cooked perfectly and slight crunch of onions not overdone like some others. The cheese was melted into the steak and mushrooms were delicous -just exceeded my expectations and they even have a nice small cooler full of local and national craft beer which is a plus.

We showed up at 9:45 for some pizza and drinks. The bartenders, Henry and Stacy, we're the best. We had signature drinks made for us, laughs, pizza. My wife ordered a gluten free pizza and said it was the best she ever had. We had pesto and shrimp, the crust and cheese and homemade pesto with shrimp with so much flavor better  than all the New Haven landmarks. I found a bar that had blue cheese stuffed olives to top it off for the martinis. Planning tobgo back soon with my friend, David, the pizza aficionado, for their wings and clam pizza soon.

Came here with a big group of girls before our school break, we were all extremely hungry when we showed up so some of the food disappeared before I could snap a picture! Our waitress was so friendly and she got our orders in right away. The fresh guacamole is incredible. The restaurant is so clean and has a cool aura, and the design of the restaurant is very fun. The nachos were a great sized portion and managed to be completely consumed immediately after hitting the table. Our burritos and quesadillas were very well made and good sized portions, I wasn't in love with how the chicken was not shredded in the burrito, but was more of a slice of chicken, but it was still delicious. Great for a date night or evening out with friends!
3.5 stars. Quality food. Quality drinks. Reasonably priced for the city, but moderately overpriced for what you get. Great location and atmosphere with good but not mind blowing food or drinks.

I went here last night for a birthday dinner.  We arrived late and were greeted warmly, the staff was friendly and were able to sit us within five minutes. The food we ordered: Raw Oysters- This was my first time trying them and I decided they are not for me, however a friend that was there who does enjoy them said they were just okay. (I did enjoy the sauces that came with it) Baked Clams- These were small, and had too much bacon (I know there can never be too much bacon but in this case it overpowered the baked clam). New York Strip Steak- I described this as something I would say was good if I had it at a wedding, and knew it was mass produced. However knowing it was individually made for us at that moment...well it fell short. Salmon- This was the most disappointing,  absolutely no flavor and in my opinion a little fishy. The mustard sauce looked like mayo and did nothing to add flavor. Shrimp Provencal- This was absolutely delightful. I was on the fence on whether or not I would enjoy this dish, however the cheese filling in the ravioli was delicious! There was also an incident that I can only describe as "The most awkward conversation of all time"  that happened concerning our drinks. When our drinks arrived we felt that they were watered down. We told our waiter, and moments later we were greeted by someone I will assume is the manager. He informed us that their drinks were all measured and that we were... for lack of better words.. completely wrong about its content . To which I responded with "Lets agree to disagree", and this led to what felt like a 2-3 minute conversation /stare off that felt uncomfortable. I understand the business aspect of it, but if a customer is not happy with a product maybe you should, I don't know....ask if they would like something else? Maybe not make them feel uncomfortable for the rest of the night by having this confrontational conversation? Just my opinion.. Anyway, the food was blah, the waiting staff was nice, but overall I wouldn't recommend it. Unless of course you wanted to try the Shrimp Provencal, which was pretty great.

I just got back from this restaurant and it is the epitome of mediocre. Please let us not continue to support restaurants like this one who simple take your money and offer nothing in return. I ordered their omelette and it was heavy, the cheese they chose added nothing to its flavor, the other veggies they used just had no life left in it. It was a struggle omelette point blank. I hate restaurants who do not seem to even enjoy cooking, instead they are simply trying to get meals out, just no standard. Once again if u are in te area just go to peaches. The service was horrible, I felt rushed the entire time, even though the restaurant wasn't full and there were no potential customers waiting. She repeatedly forgot to bring certain items over to the customers, I heard other people reminding her to bring their items over. In short, stay home and make ur own damn food, you would get better and fresher ingredients. The mimosa lure ain't worth it. Save your money and don't support mediocre places like this, help make New York better.

Horrible experience! My bf and I went here based on the yelp reviews and I really questioned yelp and the reviews after our experience. Waitress was inexperienced and slow. Food: some parts were hot and some were cold which means they weren't made to ordered. The tacos were reheated and also lack flavor. The taco trucks are far better than this place!

Made a late night (10pm) visit to Baby blue BBQ last night. My son and I were in from out of town and this restaurant was in walking distance from my hotel. Honky tonk feel inside. All the staff made us feel welcome right away. They had the games on and we were asked which one we wanted to watch and were seated at the kitchen bar which overlooks the area where the cooks perform their magic. I had water and a drink in minutes  thanks to Tara our waitress. We started with wings in hot sauce which are grilled and than served covered in sauce with blue cheese dressing and celery. I like grilled wing better than deep fried and these were perfect for me. Tender with the meat falling of the bone. I had Memphis ribs with rice and sautéed spinach for dinner. My son had the blue cheese and bacon burger with mac and cheese. His must have been good because he ate it in about three bites. My ribs were great. I actually do not like it when the meat is falling off the bone on my ribs and these ribs did not disappoint. Mind you they were tender but still had some chew in them. The sautéed spinach was excellent. I did not see it on the menu but the women seated at the bar next to me ordered it so I asked for it as well. Ribs come with a nice hunk of corn bread that complimented the ribs nicely.  Price was right as least for my wallet at about $70 including a tip. Highly recommend if you have a hankering for ribs in university city.
I go pretty often. Always very good. Sometimes takes a while to get my sandwich. Mainly due to high demand.
My go to spot for brunch. I love their Lemon ricotta pancakes and the Gouda bacon Mac and cheese. Food is rich and delicious.

one of my favorite places to eat and drink on Smith St. The chef here is brilliant and is always adding amazing specials and tweaks to their menu. their beer list is as exciting as their food as well. The bartenders are super friendly and know their beer extremely well and can guide you to one that you'll love.

After reading all the great reviews about this place, I have to say I was very disappointed with my experience there. I came for brunch on a Saturday and it was very crowded (not a huge surprise). I put my name down and was told the wait would be 45 min to an hour. I sat at the bar and ordered a white peach bellini while I waited for my friend. The bellini was nothing special, but extremely overpriced at $14. We found out another friend would be joining us. We asked the hostess about adding another person and we were told this would mean an additional 45 minutes! We decided to sit at the bar to avoid the wait. The bartender was very sweet, but a horrible server. She didn't give us plates for our appetizer, condiments, or utensils. All this would have been tolerable if the food was as good as I was told it would be, but sadly, it wasn't. I ordered the farmhouse popover. The eggs were soggy and the popover (a croissant-like thing on top) was stale and tough. My friends ordered the avocado sandwich and said that it was at best, average. So, despite Jane's stellar reviews and reputation, I'd have to say it really isn't worth the hype.

The food was absolutely delicious and it is the reason I would go back.  As a vegan for many years now I know what quality fresh vegan food tastes like or does not. The portion sizes are enough to fill me up and the price is reasonable considering the amount of time that goes into preparing this type of food.  Fresh vegan food takes extra time and therefore the price seems fair to me.   On the other hand, the service was not superior.  I have gone twice and on both occasions it was the same thing that happened. I got great service at the beginning up until my food came.  Then it just ends. I have to wait around forever to get my check. Why? I would go back just because the food is so good.

Love their garlic Parm wings Could hold back on the sauce but still delicious. Friendly workers Don't charge a delivery fee for the people living near central The boneless wings are huge and so juicy, def my favorite The fries are good however if you get fries with sauce like the garlic Parm fries ask them to go extra light on the sauce or it just because a soggy mess

We went with a group of 9 on a Saturday night and had a superb meal with friendly and top notch service.  Several of our group had lived in London and hadn't had great Indian food since moving back to the U.S.; until eating here.  The dosas were delectable, crisp, hot delicious with wonderful and creative chutneys and sauces.  This is not your tired, out of the jar stuff.  They are handmade with fresh and vibrant spices.  Everything we had was spiced as requested; those who wanted hot got it just the way they wanted and the "less heat" versions did not mean bland.  The complex spices were still present even without the heat. Don't miss the goat curry, the table's favorite, but the okra curry, eggplant curry and the tandoori breads rocked it as well.  I know, who orders dessert in an Indian  restaurant?  You should here. They served us a dessert sampler plate that blew us away.   The service was awesome, our waiter double checked with the kitchen in every order to make sure our gluten free friend stayed gluten free while she ate.  He helped us choose quantities which is hard with a large group and didn't let us order too much or too little.  Great place and not to be missed!

We got to the place after a Broadway show and my wife was hungry!!! So we followed the smell and found this amazing place. You will get an huge slice of pizza!! My wife said that she never taste that kind of pizza! When we stayed in order to discover the secret we saw the huge amount of better that they are using. Amazing
Really good brunch place. Haloumi was great. I got the shakshuka and my husband got the kanella platter and we enjoyed both.

Called at 10:57am on Sunday to inquire if brunch is served and if the brunch menu online (from an event dated 3/24/13) was the current brunch menu. First I was hung up on after being told in a short tone, "we serve brunch". I called back to confirm the menu and was told I was, "interrupting him trying to cook brunch with my irrelevant questions." I choose to spend my money elsewhere.

This place is a beautiful indoor marketplace with delis, restaurants, butchers, bakeries... You could really go in here and have a free-for-all for hours. Everything is delicious and beautiful here, and my wife and I drive a long distance from Jersey to get here, but it's totally worth it. We love the breakfast at the Dutch Eating Place, but everything we have ever tried here is first class. You could walk around in here for hours and enjoy all the food.

This place is great when you've got food or book needs and you're stuck between stops at the train station. Just wonderful. There is probably nothing else like it in Philly a beautiful station with plenty to do. Love it.

left waitress a $11 tip and she approached me after and asked if i knew that there wasn't a gratuity included.  bill was $54,  she guilted me into paying her the taxed amount on top of the tip. for shame.  i paid her as if she was a person offended by a low tip, much like a pan handler on the street, please fire her. horrible experience, do not ever go here. i was a regular, never will return. been here about 6 times.  i've told friends and family to come here, never again. please don't remove this honest feedback yelp.

First time at a CiCi's pizza buffet, we came to the No. Brunswick spot...oooh this place was so dirty & I didn't realize it until after we paid. There were gnats all over the place ( that can't be good) & the ice tea dispensers looked like they never were cleaned...ever! We really should have just left, but I wanted to taste the pizza, since we drove 30 minutes to get here. The pizza wasn't the worst, but it wasn't good either. Definitely won't be back to this spot, or any other CiCi's. I think I gotta throw up!

Very disappointed.  Smothered chicken was too salty and yams were canned.  Oxtails were extremely small for the price.  Overall customer service was great, but that's about it.  Money wasted, won't be returning ever again.
I love the drunken noodles and indian pancake. Have tried the tofu in black bean sauce and thai basil fried rice and was not disappointed. Will definitely keep coming back.

Excellent meal. The food is delicious and authentic. We ordered both the pork and crab dumplings, both were exceptional- I preferred the the pork. We also ordered one seafood dish, a chicken dish and a noodle soup. Everything is served family style in decently large portions. We went as a party of 3 on a Sunday evening and there was no wait. While the food is exceptional, keep in mind that this is not the restaurant you go to if you are looking for a quiet relaxing sit down experience with family or friends. This place is loud, crowded (there are almost as many employees as customers) and unless you have a large party or wait to sit at one of the smaller tables, you will likely be sitting at a large table with other diners. Cash only and 15% gratuity is added to the check.

My husband and I  had been to this restaurant with friends one other time.  The decor is very pretty and the stemware and dinnerware is nicer than many other Asian restaurants.  The food on our first visit and even the second was acceptable but far from extraordinary.  What was really upsetting to us aside from the fact that everything is a la carte--even tea- is what happened at the end of our meal.  We asked if they had decaf coffee since it was not listed on the menu.  The waiter said they did.  After waiting quite a long time, he arrived with two very small (5 or 6 ounce cups).  Upon finishing mine, I asked for a refill.  Again the wait was extremely long but finally the second cup for me arrived.  (My husband did not order a refill).  When the bill arrived, we were stunned to see that we were charged $3.50 per cup--even for the refill--at a whopping $ 10.50 for ordinary brewed decaf--not specialty coffee such as cappuccino or espresso!  I find this outrageous.  I asked to speak with whomever was in charge and was told by the front desk that nobody is in charge over the weekends!  Because of this arrogance, we will not return.  Also we would not recommend this restaurant to any of our friends.
Service was good. Drinks were good. Food not so much. This was based on brunch. I would not recommend it for brunch.

Very good middle-eastern food here.  The staff is friendly and the environment is lovely.  I have some celebrity friends that frequent this place and took me here my first day in NYC.  Eat Here!!!  You won't regret it!
Extremely poor service. We looked at the menu, were rushed by the waitress, and then basically ignored when we were ready.

This place had terrible service, the boy serving us had sagging pants where his crack was fully exposed. I came with my sister and mom, my sister who has a peanut allergy got the pad Thai, asked for no peanuts. They came with the plate which was full of peanut sauce, then the sagging guy said oh shit, wrong one. He came back 15 mins later with the correct one. Then the mussaman curry had no coconut milk in it. The curry puffs had dairy, which my sister was allergic to. We asked the manager and they said there was nothing, however we had to rush home for Benadryl, because of the curry puffs. Also when we asked to have it wrapped up, my moms soup was "accidentally" thrown away by the manager. We came here before and it was great but this time sucked!! The service was SOOO long for our food to come and nothing tasted right. I'm very disappointed by this terrible experience

I'll keep this review short and sweet. I've been going here for years and this place is just as good now as when I was a little kid. If you live in brooklyn and even in staten island and have never been here then you're missing out.

Great place for healthy Chinese. I have to eat gluten free and the staff always accommodates my needs. It is slightly pricier than your normal Chinese take out but the quality is definitely worth the extra money.

I went here for the first time on 12/7/14.  I had a veggie omelet which was absolutely delicious!  I had a side of fresh bread and parmesan truffle fries which were also super satisfying.  They only offer 1 vegetarian option per brunch/lunch/dinner though but all those creative meat options were making me question myself.

had to say it was my first time here and i enjoyed it i had the seafood paella as my entree also had the prawns as my appetizer those were awesome also had the fried plantains yummy , lance the manager was awesome and my waitress michelle was cool i will def be back

We returned and it was just as good, so updating the review.  Once is an point, twice is a line. Had the Manta dumplings as a first course.  It's served in a yogurt tomato sauce and it was hard to restrain from licking the dish.  Need I say more....
all of the 5 stars, sound like the owner, especially the one about hiring a new chef. Clearly the first chef left because the owner is a criminal. Richard and Jeremy Winter(JAIL).

I had the distinct pleasure of dining at VITAL yesterday for lunch. What a treat!  The food selection is high level, varied and down-right delicious. I dined on the salmon burger -- mmmm, good. And I have raise my hand in voting for VITAL to package its black-eye peas hummus. What!  Off the hook. So good I had to order the side dish. And serving it with sliced fried plantains was genius. This is what I loved about my experience - no detail was overlooked. The hot tea, mine was cinnamon apple, was piping hot, loose tea with real apple bits and served in a diffuser kettle. The aroma was intoxicating alone. There are so many items I am looking forward to enjoying going forward. And they do take-out!  I have found my new top spot for great, fresh, wholesome food. Thank you. Debra Spruill A confirmed fan

My trip started with a sour note. Food was average, for the price you pay there are better options, but this is not where my gripe is at. I've had one of the worst service I can possibly have. Some staff was friendly and helpful while 2 was extremely extremely rude. My group was well dressed slacks, dressshirt and tie. We were not treated fairly infact one of them ignored us for the entire night while giving other guest their full attention. Even after I flagged one of them he would turn to another guest and ask the other guest if he needed anything as if he was trying to make an excuse to ignore me. I will keep my opinions reserved on here but it did look like some group of guest were treated better than others. On top of that they add 20% on top of my tab. I will not come back.
This place is delicious!!! The best in NJ. I've been to plenty of ramen spots in the city but they've always been too far so I'm glad there's one right next door to me. Btw service is great too

made a last minute reservation on a saturday night and they were able to get us seated within 30 minutes even though they were packed..food was excellent, service was great and manager was very courteous. this is my new go to italian spot, other restaurants need to take notes on how to run an establishment!

This was honestly one of the best restaurant experiences I have ever had! Everything we ordered was delicious - we ordered the chicken nicolo, chicken with wild mushrooms, eggplant parmigiana, and mussels in linguini and it was so good! The portions were huge, plus you get bread and oil, salad or soup, and a plate of pasta for the table. The waitstaff was fantastic - we accidentally got there before they were officially open and they took us in early, and were so nice throughout the entire meal! Since it's byob, they recommended a liquor store close by and showed us a wine list from there with prices. And dessert was also amazing - we got cannoli, although there are many different options. Overall, everything about this restaurant was great and I will definitely return!

One of my top brunch picks in the city. Anything on the menu is fantastic and the nontraditional items, such as the pickle flights, make for a fun and unique establishment. Stop by on your next Saturday brunch outing and enjoy one of their fantastic entrees and a nice craft brew.

Donny's New York Pizza is a MOSTLY excellent establishment that really makes Winooski proud.  The atmosphere inside the restaurant is relaxing and the owner is a gentleman and a scholar.  The location is prime and must be visited by all pizza-lovers in the area.  There is just one problem I encountered and it had to do with the delivery.  The delivery guy I encountered was an abomination.  From the moment he stepped out of his noisy, piece of shit vehicle there was clearly a problem.  His attire was less than acceptable and his body odor was noticeable from far away.  As I spoke with him at the door, (if you want to call it that, he was yelling the whole time), I was offended multiple times by his inappropriate language and incessant ranting about the New England Patriots.  I could not tell if he was under the influence of illegal narcotics or not, but there was certainly something off about him.  I was appalled by his general disregard for professionalism, as he seemed to have a strong dislike for Vietnamese people.  He even admitted to "rubbing one out" in the car on the way there.  As he left, I fought the urge to return my pizza because I was so outraged.  An otherwise successful business, I just felt I had to come on here to review my one insanely absurd experience with their delivery service.

I am sorry to say that the food was nothing to brag about. We tried a few items on the menu and I was not impressed. The decor was old run down and outdated. I looked around hoping to see a celeb or two but, was disappointed. At least that would have made the night interesting. The staff were quite friendly but, not worth waiting years for a reservation as some have done.
Wonderful place. I had my rehearsal dinner day before my wedding and it was absolutely wonderful.  Food is great, service is great.  Owners are hard working people and just plain awesome.

I love habana it has an awesome atmosphere great drinks and authentic Mexican food. I highly recommend going here on a cool summer or spring night with a group of friends or it would be a cute spot for a date.

Excellent, clean, and delicious Chinese buffet. The sushi was pretty good, though most of it was vegetable sushi or imitation crab, but that is to be expected from such an extensive buffet with a low price point. They aren't going to offer prime cuts of salmon and tuna in a low-price buffet. Lunch on a Sunday came out to $10.61 with tax. The restaurant was clean, organized, and employees were polite and accommodating. The dessert section is the best I've seen in any Chinese buffet. Lots of ice cream choices, cookies, puddings, and fruit. I had a great dining experience here and will definitely be back.

24 craft beers on tap?  Nachos and an amazing happy hour,  I don't see why not this place merits 5 stars. Not to mention the awesome wait staff. This has been one of the most pleasant bars I've been to. Plus the owner is a prerry dapper gentleman that serves 120 min dogfish on tap. 120. On. Tap. The search is over ladies and gents, your home bar is found.

Came to Ela on a whim tonight. Never been, but saw it coming back from a regular place we go to on Catherine. It is kind of hard to see from outside, but the place is charming and amazing inside.  The bartender, Maria is so informative (I told her I want dry, full bodied red... I GOT the best wine I've ever tasted, on point!) Can't wait to come back for dinner!!!
Overall great experience great atmosphere enjoyed the food and service was good definitely will be back

The Akamaru Ramen is THE BEST ramen I've ever had. The soup was so flavorful and the pork belly was super tender. I also tried the short ribs and it was also very tender and fell right off the bones. I love the atmosphere of this place and the decorations. The only complaint I have is that they keep the temperature way too hot in there! I felt so suffocated the entire time I was there.

Little Delicious is hands down the BEST Jamaican food in Philadelphia!  Try the jerk chicken, beef patties and cabbage--all awesome.  I took the jerk chicken to a Caribbean themed party and it was a huge hit.  The owner is super nice too!  I highly recommend!
One of my favorite restaurants in NYC! The best Ramen by far. The price is reasonable too. Just get ready to wait for a table...

We ate here for the first time and had a great experience. The food was great - we had the trout salad, duck salad, lamb with red beans and rice and chicken wings. The spicy beef jerky was also really tasty and just spicy enough. Recommended! The wait staff were great and attentive in just the right way.
Good place to grab something quick, have a drink, and keep it moving.  Basic food and the music drowns out the nonsense going on at the bar.

Bagel bistro is a pretty Okay bagel shop. Right on route 23 in Little Falls, Bagel Bistro offers a decent variety of bagels, coffee and sandwiches. The shop has a small sitting area that is very clean and well kept. The coffee bar has a good variety of coffee and is also tidy. In addition, The staff is very nice, and the service is quick. The quality of of food is on par. Nothing too special, but it hits the spot especially if you are hungry. The taylor ham egg and cheese sandwich is not too shabby, however it will leave you feeling like you've committed a greasy sin. The coffee is tasty, however, it wasn't as strong as it should have been. Bagel is not a bad choice if you are looking for your morning bagels or are craving a breakfast sandwich. I will most likely return again.
Too expensive for what it is. The $17 vegetable risotto is made from those frozen vegetables in a bag (cubed carrots, peas, etc.), with no fresh vegetables at all. Small portions, too. Disappointing.

The talented duo that brought you the acclaimed 'Traif' a few doors down, Xixa features Mexican faire without using traditional Mexican ingredients. The whimsical approach to the menu will take you on a flavor rollar coaster and present classic dishes in a unconvential and innovative manner. For example, their "Steak Taco" is a flavorful Steak Tartare with buttery bone marrow.
The food was great,especially the pork wings. The decor is nice,cozy but noisy. Service is okay
Just sat here for exactly 25 minutes without being acknowledged.  I wish I could've tasted the food.  It wasn't too busy.

I went to this place yesterday for a birthday dinner . I loved the food and enjoyed the atmosphere. I am giving them one star due to a bad experience with Josephine,one of the hostess.my friend did not call in advance to book a table so when I got there I was talking to the girls upfront trying to see if we could get a table for 9people..they were very nice and helpful until Josephine turned around and told the two other girls :"get back to work,stop talking to this bitch ,you are getting distracted"  . I was very shocked to hear that since I was not rude or pushy and the two girls upfront were helping me. I i did not want to create a scene but I thought wow what a great place with such a rude hostess.. the food was great but I probably will not come back orthere due to her rudeness and lack of respect for the customers . She was rude and unhelpful .

My first trip to Bunna was perfect. The service was stellar and the food delicious. My second trip was far less than perfect. The waiter seemed angry and mostly ignored us. The food was still good but the kita came out soggy. This place feels really hit-or-miss. I'll be back but it's definitely not a top pick in the neighborhood.

Decided to try this place on a cold Sunday afternoon and were very pleased! Since moving to Philly from Australia we've even trying to find great asian food and our experiences with certain cuisines/dishes have been patchy at best. Dumplings were one of of those... This place changed that in one meal! The soup dumplings here have the most delicious filling. Took away a star for the pastry...a little on the dense side. The scallion pancake however is top notch, we loved the salt and pepper squid and their version of dan-dan noodles were awesome. Order the Thai bubble tea too... Cash only but there is an ATM in the restaurant.
Mediocre, overpriced food. Nice ambiance, good location. Service was slow. Meh. ::shrug::
Great place with amazing food, I highly recommend trying this one out. The service is quick and very friendly, they truly care about their customer's.
Can't speak to the beer but the food was not very good. 5 of us and no really good meal.

Unique dishes. Korean inspired. There are many amazing appetizers you can't go wrong and excellent for sharing. The salads are delicious and make wonderful starters. Definitely can't wrong with the mussels and scallops if limited to seafood. Oxtail terrine, Pappardelle Pasta, Hanger Steak Salad, Long Island Duck Breast, Crispy Pork Trotter, and the Shaved Hudson Valley Foie Gras are my favorites. Desserts are must. The ice cream is made fresh so the flavors vary each visit.

Stopped in today b4 going to a friends for Sunday Football . Must say it is OK NOTHING TO brag about not gonna give them a negative review by 3 stars is the best . Portions are good price ok food taste average . May give it another shot !
N ot sure why this place gets bad reviews. Best Brisket I have tried in a long time.  Melt in your mouth goodness. Def be back!
Our favorite in brooklyn.  Great salads and unbeatable pizzas. Quiet back dining room. Family friendly. Neighborhood gem.

Throughout my visits I have consistently been surprised by the fantastic choices of both craft beer and burgers. A few times I have ventured into the surprise dish, but have recently gravitated towards the truffle burger and fries.  Do yourself a favor and also try out the duck burger.
Maybe the best gluten free Italian I have ever had. Seriously rivals Del Posto.  I'm so excited to have found this place. Wonderful!

Very disappointed in this restaurant. They were out of everything including angry orchard, lobster bisque, can't substitute potatoes for home fries and we've been asking for mimosas and drinks for 45 minutes. Don't do bottomless mimosas because you'll only get two by the time you're done because the service is so slow. The worst waiter I've ever had in my life. Horrible horrible service So update- we asked for a new waitress and the service is better now. Her name is Marybeth and she's killin it. Also, get the zeppoles- phenomenal Another update- with the earlier I ordered side grits and it was put in as shrimp grits- pissed

We went a couple weeks ago and were pleasantly surprised by the service. We couldn't decide if we wanted the hot tea or water so the waiter immediately told us not to worry he was bringing us both and we could decide what we liked. He also offered to help us read through the menu when he noticed we couldn't make a decision on what to get. We finally ended up going with the small pho appetizer and one of the apps on the specials menu - stuffed fried chicken wings. They were stuffed with some kind of delicious ground meat (beef?) and came with two dipping sauces. Amazing. The pho was also delish, with a full plate of sprouts, basil etc on the side. Plenty of meat in it for an appetizer. For entrees he got the pan fried seafood noodles. They were great -crunchy on the outside and soft in the center where it was drenched in the yummy sauce. The only complaint was that there could have been a little more seafood. I had the banh hoi with grilled shrimp. Essentially it was the same as those amazing summer rolls you can get as an app, but you roll them yourselves with lettuce. Overall I have to say I am so happy this place has opened. It was so delicious and we will be coming back often. Also don't forget it's byo!

Had dinner with family there and everything was exquisite from the taste to presentation of the food. I actually go to Northern Spy anywhere from 2-3 times a month. As a local I know this place would not disappoint and thoroughly enjoy the seasonal changes to their menu. Again great place for brunch/dinner I always leave very happy.

Im from out of town and after Eagles games we always have gone to Pats and Genos. This trip we decided to try Sonnys based on Adam Richman's column rating this the #1 cheesesteak in Philadelphia. After we got our food we took it back to our hotel to eat it. I took one bite out of my cheesesteak and not a single more. It just tasted awful compared to the cheesesteak at Pats. Its just not good. I dont know what kind of grass Man vs. Food was smoking when he rated this place the best in Philly.

We came into town from Chicago and were really looking forward to eating here. It didn't disappoint. We had the special - a whole salt baked fish, the white prawns in glass noodles, spicy(!!) duck salad, seafood crepe, and the afegado(sp?) ice cream and Thai donuts. Everything was really really good, the duck salad was really good but super spicy and a little hard to eat. Service was great, everyone was super helpful in explaining the dishes and the proper way to eat them.
Love this place!! Food is great, the service is really good, and the atmosphere is awesome!! I wish we have something like this in Cali.
Great Food, Great People, and a Great Vibe. I will definitely go again.
Best chicken soup in all of Manhattan ... maybe the world!

Hu Kitchen has really good quality food. You can't feel bad or guilty after eating there lol. It's healthy but taste great too. It's a bit expensive though but you pay for what you get. It's more like a place for breakfast and lunch, although you could also go for a quick and healthy dinner. It's not vegan or raw - they do serve meat. It's a good place to go eat if you are on a special diet.

The food here is OK. But the set up is all wrong. There are two benches for diners to eat at and about 50 people in line. Something has to be done. You'll see some weird stuff happening in line though, when people are hung over and waiting for an hour to eat some eggs out of a paper cup.
Service wonderful Pleasant place to linger over Sunday brunch Party of 6 and some of our food was cold:(
I really love this place.  We use to come in on the weekends when I was a student a and every time I'm in town I always stop by.  The food is great and the service is really great.  Great spot!
Amazing ! Just a tip: You have to make a reservation well in advance

Amazing find!  Tremendous food - the mushroom pasta and chocolate pudding are highlights on a menus full of highlights!  On a cold, rainy night - I could have stayed all night in the cozy, friendly environment.  It felt like dinner at close friends house - loud and festive.  So, so good.

I love this place . The food is astonishing , everything is fresh and so delicious. I have tried almost everything on the menu and I have to admit EVERYTHING is great! The prices are great as well. Eggplant and chicken parm are out of this world . Pizza is incredible , and the pasta is amazing. Penne vodka is a must to try here ! If you are in the area , don't pass up on a great meal here , you won't be disappointed
delivery took forever
The decor is amazing. Old photos & antiques. The food is outstanding. Be sure to have the oysters & the ny strip steak is the best.

I was looking for another place while walking in. Simple decor ,nothing amazing but the food smelled great.Looks like a lot of locals come here. Lunch buffet has great dish choices and even has mango lassi and sweets without additional charge. Im going again soon.

I need to wait for at least half an hour everytime!!! No matter eat in or take out!!! They told me just 10 minutes, but it always be tripled!!! My next table came later than me, but I didn't get my dishes even after they finished and left!! Very bad service!!!

Very surprising for a Restaurant  in a Department Store.  Private elevator was nice, menu selection was a good one, service excellent, we were early for our reservation but was seated right on time, in fact a little earlier, and we never felt rushed in any way.   Food was excellent.  My husband and I had the steak for 2 and it was cooked to perfection. Coffee and Gelato for dessert was also excellent.  Walked back across to MSG saw The Grinch, got back on the LIRR and was back home in my house in 40 minutes.  Would recommend STELLA 34 to everyone.  Price was good also.  Only gave it 4 STARS  because there is always room for improvement no matter how good they are.

I went to Mickey's for lunch on the advice of a coworker. It's appearance from the outside and inside as a typical lunchtime snack bar is deceiving; because the food was atypical. Like older snack bars, it has perimeter seating around 3 sides of the interior. The fish served here is real and it has a lightly fried coating. The fish and chips basket is loaded with fries and four or five of large pieces of fried fish. On another trip, I've gotten the fish sandwich and an order of onion rings. I asked for a small order of rings but that order is large enough to fill you at lunch time. I don't think I could have eaten the large order of onion rings without a nap. As a work day lunch time stop, I recommend it. I've have been here a few times since being introduced to it a month ago. I will definitely revisit Mickey's the next time I'm in town.

I dont like to write negative reviews unless service as well as quality is really bad, but I feel I have to write something regarding the food here. I'll try to keep it brief. Samosa Chaat - very bland Rasam Soup - decent, not the best in the neighborhood, but not bad either Muligatawni - very oily Channa Masala - tasteless and oily Baingan Bharta - didnt think to ask if this had dairy in it, since so few places I go to make it that way, but not expecting the eggplant "milkshake" that came to the table. It was basically a cream puree with some eggplant in it. My dining partner tried it, as I couldnt eat it, and described it as an overly salty paste. I sent it back, explaining that I couldnt eat it because of the dairy. Not 2 words were spoken to me, asked, nothing. Didnt see a server again until I asked for a check.  The dish was on the check still, which is fine, as it was my bad for not asking, but after working 15+ years in the restaurant business, you're not gonna win over a customer by not even asking if they would like to order something instead. Didnt find a single redeeming dish here (and I ordered takeout from here previously, equally disapointing), so a third try will not be happening.

One of the best pizza places I've ever been to.  Don't live there anymore so I still search for the next Grand Apizza wherever I go.  Can't comment on anything else they serve because I always get the Pizza.  If you are looking for non-greasy semi-healthy pizza, this place is not for you.  Keep up the good work!

We've enjoyed take out from The Rice Pot a few times, however something was very off about our last take out order on December 3rd. Maybe the usual chef was out? We order the same two dishes every time and last week's entirely lacked flavor. Very disappointed. Not sure if this was a fluke or the way things will be from now on.

Nice place (sat in the back), great service, EXCELLENT food every bit of it from app to entree to dessert.  Was not rushed.  Would go back anytime we are in Princeton !! Don't follow the low reviews, I know food and this place was well worth it !!

Came in for a beer and a bite and had a great time. Alicia was very knowledgeable and able to recommend beers based on what we liked. Brussel sprouts and duck fat fries were awesome. Glad we stopped in! Visit New Mexico! #NewMexicoTRUE

This is a cozy little restaurant tucked away in a strip mall.  The food is very good, however, they do not offer a salad with dinner.  I have a feeling that it is under new management because they used to serve this delicious bread, it was like pizza dough.  Now, you don't get a salad, and the bread is different.  Our server was good, but there was no one else in the restaurant but us.  I had the Linguini Di Mare.  It was cooked very well, but I was disappointed that I did not get a dinner salad.  That is the only reason why I am posting 4 stars.
Terrible experience ! Service is really bad and food equally bad !  We got really disappointed.

What's not to like? Pasta good Sauce good Chicken good This is a nice little place with great service. The pasta was cooked perfectly not over done and sauce was pretty good. Compare to many Newark places, it is definitely above average in the quality of food and they stay open late! Wish they opened earlier when I was still a student here. Also big portions!! It's worth a try.

I was in there Saturday. I paid a little under $3 bucks for a slice of Margarita Pizza. The pizza was definitely worth coming back for.  The tomato sauce on this slice was sweet and distinct. This place has a reputation as having some of the best pizza in NJ and it lived up to the hype. I lived in NJ for almost 20 years and I can't remember better pizza than this place. The price for a slice was a little high, but this place has been around for over 50 years and you pay for quality.
Experienced Momoun's Mobile Food Truck over the summer.  Not impressed at all.

Not sure why this place has such a low rating. Reading other low-star reviews, the negatives seem superficial or just having to wait because this place is popular and gets busy. Anyhow, we were driving through New Haven on our way to NYC so we tried this place for lunch. Loved it so much we stopped on our way back to Boston! Their veggie burgers are delicious along with the bread that is very fresh, seems homemade. The veggie burger did fall apart but it still tasted great! They gave us a sample of the pasta puttanesca too. Spicy and flavorful! Got that for dinner when we get home. Definitely coming back the next time we're in New Haven!
so much to enjoy. di nicks pork with broccoli rabe was awesome. the Amish bakery was Great.

Reading Terminal is a Philly icon for a good reason. Come hungry, because you'll probably leave full. If, by some crazy chance, you have room for dessert after a freshly prepared lunch or dinner, there are plenty of places for dessert, including the oldest ice cream company in the US, Bassetts. It will be loud and crowded inside, but that offers a new adventure on every visit.
