Great food!
We've ordered delivery (via grub hub) from here several times and the food is always very, very good! Delivery can take a little time--but that's pretty much anywhere decent in the Hartford area.

I am on a team that competitively cooks bbq all over the US. I have eaten at many famous places all over the US. This place is amazing. Everything I have ever gotten there was good enough to turn in at a national level bbq competition. The one in Jersey is of similar quality. Everything is good, but the burnt ends are the best. Fatty delicious chunks of brisket? oh yea count me in.

I'm addicted to this place.. I live 2 blocks away and every time I walk by I'm always tempted to run in! I'm originally from the south so I appreciate good meat and these guys smoke this stuff to perfection! I highly recommend the beef brisket sandwich!

Amazing is an understatement!!!!  From start to finish, from atmosphere to food to service. I give it 5 stars. I loved it.  I highly recommend it to everyone that has a taste for pure authentic Italian cuisine. I will definitely go back!!!
We go to Penny constantly - best breakfast. period. :)
Small place but very cozy with delicious food. Will definitely come back! Bon Appetite!

This is the best new american place I have been in a while. Pleased to see something like this pop in the area. The NY strip rivals the best steak houses. Staff very friendly. I actually stumbled upon it with work colleagues for lunch a few weeks ago. Great big cobb salad and solid traditional caesar (anchovy!) dressing...that brought me back for dinner with my girlfriend. Didin't disappoint. I had the steak frites which as I mentioned rivaled any steak house I've been to lately. My girlfriend had the rotisserie chicken in au jus...we have ordered it 3 times since via seamless. Definitely worth a visit. I want to get back for lunch and try the fish tacos and the mussels.

If you are interested in a totally different experience in what is loosely called dining but actually a thrilling adventure in the world of pleasure and outright culinary magic (and can afford what you will agree at the end is worth every dollar) then Alinea is not to be missed. I have been to other restaurants that have tried to do what Chef Achatz can do and ended up with what can only be called 'silly food'. What comes out of the Pennsylvania 6 kitchen are flavors and presentations that show such a wonderful understanding of food combinations, textures, smells and even sounds; an edible concert with every note attended to down to the beautifully cut suits of the waiters. I would suggest a 6:30 or even 6pm reservation because you will be there at least 4 hours.

Lillie's, Lillie's, Lillie's. You completely blew me away last night. The ambiance, service, food and drinks were at the top of the list. Having planned a 50th Birthday party there, I called and made a reservation, and the friendly staff made sure our section was reserved, roped off, and taken cared of. NAYESHA was the best server, having to accommodate over 50 people, and she did so with a smile on her face, and speed that's rare in NYC. And location, location, location. Overall a great bar in a convenient location!  Looking forward to visiting again!

The Crispy Watercress Salad!! It's the only food item offered at any NYC restaurant that I will go wildly out of my way for. Rain, subway delays, freezing cold: doesn't matter. Every time I eat here when I leave the restaurant I am actively planning on when and how to return. Fantastically tasty and the rest of the menu is just as delicious.

Had a glass of wine for $13....this was the same exact wine I saw in a state store the next day for $10 a BOTTLE. I understand wine markups at restaurants but based on how swanky they want to label themselves, they should maybe up their wine game. Just saying. Everything was good. Good...not great. It is pretty ambiance but the overall feeling there is snotty, upper class middle aged couples. I felt like I should be at Wimbledon match drinking mimosas.

This is the best pizza in NY. End of discussion. If anyone tells you that is not true, you should no longer be friends with them. The square pie is better then the round pie but get both just to be safe.

Best pizza in the world! I am not exaggerating. Dom is a pizza master and makes everything right in front of you. The quality of the ingredients is obvious from the taste. The only downfall is the wait but this is best pizza you will ever get!
Cocktails were GOOD!!  Had the lonesome dove! Strong and delicious and the bartender BRAD was great!!!!!!!!!

The architecture and design of this place are impressive. It was bigger than I expected and a bit crowded and noisy (I had the sense it was more upscale and intimate than it is). That said, the service was crazy good and so was the food. The wine list could be improved. The homemade passion fruit ice cream was divine.

Every single person was REALLY nice-so service couldn't have been better! The pizza was HUGE & piled extremely high with everything my father asked, so totally worth the money.  My Dad is one that finishes each crumb on his plate but he had leftovers to my amazement :) My panini was also cooked to perfection & I also had leftovers.  Neither of us are close to this location, however it's worth the drive & the prices for the food & friendly as well as accommodating service!
The coal fired pizza is real good... The toppings are top notch... Believe it or not my favorite thing i ate was the buffolo wings

this place is fantastic.  upscale and delicious indian food. right amount of spice level, not too hot or mild and you can really taste that they use quality ingredients.  I catered my wedding food from here and they were nothing short of wonderful to work with, including offering food tastings and working with me on pricing. In addition, they worked the special arrangements I needed.  My guests raved about the food for weeks after the wedding.  I would recommend this restautrant to anyone looking for a quality indian meal in an upscale setting.   Their dum aloo, malai kofta, panch ratni daal and daal tadka are very very good. for dessert, their ras malai is fantastic.
Skip the bistro. Glorified bar fare.  Bland. Over cooked .... Not good. Hopefully the drinks are strong.
nice atmosphere!  food and drink were a little outdoor-family-picnic-y for my taste but it was a nice quick lunch outside.
Place is great. I like their classic recipes of chicken and hand-made bread is always super fresh

Everything about this place is great. Its so nice inside, staff is great, and the food was probably the best thing I have ever eaten in NY. I went back within a few days for lunch because I didn't believe my memory. It really is that good. If I was rich this place would make me a very fat man. Andrew Carmellini is a very talented dude
i can't help myself to compare this place to the places in little toyko los angeles. im going to give it four stars to prevent myself from becoming tarred and feathered among my japanese friends.

a shame to the real authentic Filipino food! dinuguan is like braised beef in black sauce. puto is not puto. chicken inasal is no where near the real thing. really a shame! Go to ugly kitchen or if you dont mind head to Queens or Jersey area. waste of money
Fried Okra was awesome and the cocktails were very well made .

Great prices, delicious dough that was cooked well and still hot on delivery. We ordered a pile of pizzas and salad for a work lunch this week. The variety of pizzas were all delicious and the side salad came with some extra fixings and crumbled cheese! The "loaded" pizza had thick cut fresh mushrooms (I hate when restaurants used canned ones) and the onions were semi-caramelized so they were mild, but not too sweet. Delicious and thoughtful! We used to order from somewhere else, but for the price and, more importantly, the taste, I'd absolutely call Reno's!
Awesome pizza----staff not too friendly. The tables are super close, so any conversation is heard by table on either side. But the thin crust pizza is outstanding!! Well worth it for that alone.

The best cheesesteak that  I ever had. It reminds me of my youth when I always ate cheesesteaks at the eagles games. The combination of the whiz and the fried onions is delicious. In my opinion better than John's roast pork because the bread here is just to my liking, as oppose to johns Italian bread semolina(even though everything else is delicious).A must have.

With high expectations I entered this restaurant  last week, only to find that it was just below basic Afghani food that's overpriced I was fairly disappointed in the service as well as the quality of the food. It did not match the price however the other customers that walked in later received food before we even got our appetizer. The service was awful we barely saw the waitress. I suppose they were more of the regulars so they were treated a lot better. The fastest time the waitress came to us was when we left the money. Don't bother coming here it's a total waste of time because you'll never be attended to

I love it! The people are amazing and greet you very loudly and cheerfully in Japanese despite them not being Japanese! It was a very exciting experience for my friends and I when we went there for the first time! Our waiting time for food was very short and the food itself was delicious! Service is definitely amazing and of you are ever feeling down you should come here, the attitude of the workers pit a huge smile on your face! The only thing is that the food is a bit overpriced in my opinion and doesn't look super fancy but its definitely the experience that makes up for it!
Great cocktails, house infused spirits, friendly staff. What else could you ask for?
Not easy to get reservation, but it is definitely worth the effort. It is not only a dining experience, it plays with all your senses with the food and presentations.

I just had lunch here for the first time and the only thing better than the food was the service.  And the food was pretty darn great.  The owner is such a friendly guy and I thoroughly enjoyed my lunch.

Review purely on the service. So my friends and I came here around 8pm on a Friday night and requested a table for 6. We did notice that the restaurant was slightly small and had concerns for our relatively large party. The hostess told us 45 minutes and that they will call when our table was ready. We walked around East Village for about 20 minutes and decided to just wait in the mini staircase/waiting area. Around the 45 minute mark, I checked in with the host and he said that the table was not ready yet and estimated another 20 minutes, which was understandable. As we proceed to wait, we saw latter smaller parties enter and were promptly seatly. Again, this was understandable. About an hour and a half into our wait, we were not given any updates of our status, more latter parties were seated, and the parties that were seated before were nearing the end of THEIR meals. When I checked in with the host he told me he did not know how much longer and walked away mid conversation while I was trying to explain our frustration of waiting almost 2 hours with no hope of getting a table soon and how latter parties were already finished with their dining experience while we still dont know when we would get our table. We promptly left after the host walked away. We were very understanding of the circumstances. If you can't seat 6 in a small establishment, then tell us. We are reasonable beings. Do NOT give us false hope of a table and just disregard us for about 1.5 hours. Needless to say, this is the worse restaurant service I have ever recieved. The food would have to be life changing delicious for me to even consider giving this establishment a 2nd chance.

I gotta say Carmine's has GREAT calamari.  If there is anything bad about Carmines it is that when I eat family style, I eat as a family of 1 and no one else at the table gets to eat:)  Great food and lots of it.  Even better is they are so in tune with the theater schedules that it doesn't feel rushed!

Incredible place.  Great food, great service; decent prices - it is worth going.  Make a reservation though.  Crowded and noisy so if you want a nice intimate dinner this is not for you.  We were upstairs in a small area with only 3 tables.  We became friends with both tables.  We were there a long time and were not rushed out of there (it was a Wednesday night) but they were packed and probably wanted us to move on.  Great place.  There are so many choices so it is sometimes nice to have an idea of where to go for good food and good service.

Went to this restaurant on a whim and found it to be just average. Portions were small and expensive even considering it was Tapas. We ordered several of the regular size plates and they were also what I would consider small. When we ordered I specifically told the waitress that I didn't want the meal rushed. We ordered soup and salads to start and the tapas plates started arriving before we had even finished the starters. Then the main  plates arrived while we were still on the Tapas. All told we were in and out in one hour for a party of four. Won't be going back.

Chicken not good, hot sauce uhmn so so, service is wack, jalea not good the taste is like  american food and ceviche was good but they xhange a lot so i might try again the following month and see if they got better

Friends of ours who have never steered us wrong on a restaurant mentioned Jojoto to us last weekend. On Tuesday we were watching the news and they did a story on the restaurant and Chef Neil. Everything looked so delicious we went right down there and we were not disappointed! Everything was fresh, tasty and delicious. The pork appetizer was excellent (toston) and we each had one of the Arepas.  I had beef and my wife had chicken and avocado. Delicious. The highlight of the meal was the tres leeches for dessert. It was the best I've ever had. Great san gria and a friendly staff made for a wonderful experience.   We're going again tomorrow and bringing friends!
Great atmosphere, amazing food, staff very attentive.
This place was a huge disappointment, I've never had such a bad Thai lunch in my life, please save your time and money and look for a real Thai restaurant , even the tea was bad...

My Husband and 2 friends went in for lunch and were not happy with any of the 3 dishes they got. my Husband being a Chef . was heart broken that they went to mcdonalds after they left!!!! he got the turkey burger that was way to small dry salad. my friend got the fried fish sandwich he got sick because it was not cooked all the way through. he hated the mac&cheese it was all broccli and oil! my other friend had the empire burger was cooked rare when he asked for well done the fries tasted like they come out the garbage. all in all this is not food network worthy! plus the guy at the front kept looking at us like we were homeless or something? we will never go back!!!
Been coming here for years! The best sushi I've ever had and the owner Paul is a character. Always nice people working and cool atmosphere. BYOB!
very good!

Started going right after they opened and probably been there at least 10 times since.  Love love love the piada ( panini) and the pizza is outstanding....all the ingredients are super fresh...and the  staff was extremely friendly and anxious to please. Cannot say enough how my friends and I are consistently treated like family every time! Gets a bit busy on event or game days (Prudential Arena is around the block) so I get there early. Cannot say enough nice things about the place, the food and the staff...also love that many of the table tops are chalk boards.....fun for the kids, even more fun for me :) Also, Stella and Sam on tap :)

Wow! Words can't even describe the white pizza but amazing and to die for come across my mind. The staff was awesome and the atmosphere on devils game days is amazing. If you like good food and good people this is for you!!

The service was great, and the food was unbelievably good.  As an italian, I was so impressed with the creativity of the food and the freshness of all of the ingredients in everything we ordered. Definitely get the Stella pizza!
I'm sure this will become my go-to spot!
We always have a great tome at Suzie"s and now they have the best happy hour ever.  Happy Hour starts at 3pm and runs until 7pm. They have free pizza from 4pm-6pm and too many drink specials to list.

Went there tonight for takeout. I used my restaurant.com certificate for $5 off when you spend $10. I had a taste for fries, so I got the turkey burger since fries came with it. Well, the owner was rude and impatient when I was trying not to spend over $10 to use the certificate. Service went from nothing special to crappy. I was told it would be a 5 minute wait. It was 20 + minutes. When I got home, I saw they took extra time to burn the fries. Burger was decent, if not lukewarm. Apparently, this is what you get when you use a coupon or discount.

Haven't been here since 2011, but this is probably my favorite restaurant ever for providing authentic Sichuan food on (at least at the time) somewhat of a secret menu. My most memorable experience here was taking someone here fairly late at night in the pouring rain, having been on the road for what seemed like an hour or more, and ultimately having everyone agree that the food was totally worthwhile. Before and after that we visited quite often, and sometimes got free stuff like milk tea and ice cream. May have been fried ice cream once. Regardless of whether that was free, it was very, very good. There was this one lovely waitress I really liked. The Dry Sautéed Sliced Fish Pot was incredible, robust and piquant and full of exotic spices. Sliced Fish with Soft Bean Curd was also excellent and oddly great when refrigerated. I liked the subtle sweetness of it, though the dish was obviously mostly spicy and savory. I keep ordering both of these things  in NYC and Boston, but it's never been nearly as good. My parents first had the Spicy Szechuan Sliced Tripe and the Sliced Beef Tendons here in 2008, and as with my experience with the fish dishes, they kept trying to replicate the experience elsewhere, but we ultimately realized our luck with these items had peaked here. It's too bad because I can't see myself ever being in the area again. Also had: Beef Wraps, Tea Smoked Duck, Cumin Lamb, Sauteed Zucchini, Chinese Style Kung Pao Chicken. All good, though not peak level.

I wanted to go somewhere for my birthday to have some food and listen to music. My friend suggested we try this place because he had a good experience. Well honey it was well over what I expected. The bartenders were attentive, the 2 lady DJ's made the crowd feel alive!!! My group stayed for 7 hours never bored once the whole night.. A must try is the cheesesteak w/fries and a drink called 7 minutes in Heaven. You will not be disappointed!!!

Went back last night for the first time in over 3 months. The place was filled with smoke, smelled like something burning in the oven. Ordered a pizza and guess what, tasted like smoke. Really liked it better when the two original brothers ran the place and made the pizza. Also noticed the place was half empty, use to never see that on a Friday night.

Odeon is one of those restaurants that have become the neighborhood staples.  No matter what time of day we go in, we always have great service and great food.   Order the lemon ricotta pancakes and the eggs benedict (traditional). You will find that their pancakes are better than Sarabeth's, better than Clinton St. You will find that their eggs benedict is better than Norma's. Come here for a breakfast if you are a real foodie and don't need to be eat with the delusional masses. Overall good service and food.
Friendly service, however the food was average. Ordered cheese fries and crab nachos.. Nothing special, I've experienced better.

Had a wonderful meal here !! Recommended as a local and affordable restaurant, although 'off the beaten path'. Restaurant was wonderful !!  Our waitress was Tina. She was very attentive and while we were there she took a photo of a couple who were celebrating something.  Very nice ! Food was wonderful, place was wonderful. I highly recommend the restaurant !!

Could not wait to get home to write this review. I would give 6 stars if I could. Today Otaiko hosted a party for my grandfathers 90th birthday and 25 guests. The view is amazing, food delicious and the staff fantastic. What a great experience for the return customers and first timer hibachi goers in our group. Thanks again to the staff and management. Bob M

During a recent trip to Hartford we decided to visit the famous Mozzicato bakery everyone's been raving about.  To our dismay they did not live up to their reputation.  I'm sure this used to be an amazing shop but the service we experienced was appalling.  The food wasn't edible though the cookies were mediocre at best. This bakery relies on their outdated reputation for business.  I didn't drive all the way to Hartford to be treated like a smelly hobo for lack of better terms.  I'd have better food and service at a Stop and Shop bakery counter.  The employees at this shop should all be fired!

My mother ordered fifteen pounds of cookies which when they arrive were crushed and they were for an anniversary party; I spoke with Paolo and Gina Mozzicato early this morning and I would like to share this nightmarish and traumatizing experience in the hopes this does not happen to any other customers: I had called two months ago and spoke with this younger girl (I thought I had wrote her name down but go figure, of course I can no longer find it) who had confirmed on three separate occasions (as little as one week ago) that I would need to speak with Paolo the day before and he will absolutely have the cookies ready since I thought I would need to notify them months ago to pick it up. I called today so I could pick them up tomorrow since I am going home for Christmas and was going to go out of my way to pick them up for my mom (it's just the good daughter-thing to do). When I called the first time today, I waited patiently for about ten minutes for Paolo to come to the phone, and when he answered, he denied ever knowing about this situation even though my mother called on July 20th to complain (the day the cookies came in the mail).  He asked when this occurred and unfortunately I assumed this was a known situation and I would just have to put the order through, but he needed the information so I called my parents , and finally was able to tell him the exact dates they ordered the cookies. Apparently and conveniently for them , there's no record of this transaction but he said he would look it up and call me back. A few hours later, Gina Mozzicato called me and it just got ridiculous from there. She was extremely rude and unsympathetic and honestly was insinuating my mother was lying and trying rip them off. I was appalled; not only was I told by an employee that the cookies would be replaced (I even made sure to say whose name it was under), but my mother as well received several verbal confirmations even the big guy himself, Paolo, and two other female employees. Gina, in a condescending and smug tone (I actually recorded the phone call because I had to prove to my friends how rude she was) lectured me about how my mother should have called UPS and we needed to file a complaint with them, all which was never disclosed to my mother at any time or by any employee of the bakery. She explained that the only way she could take it into any thought (mind you,  she pretty much said since my mother never told UPS and filed a claim, they weren't replacing the cookies) if I forwarded her the original email from this past JULY. Allegedly, they have no record of any pictures, but my mother today, instead of enjoying her Saturday with my father, is arguing with him trying desperately to find the email and blaming each other for erasing it. This company committed fraud in every sense of the word. Not only did they take my mother's money and did not give her the product she paid for, but  even more twisted and cynical, promised they would replace the cookies, so now my mother can no longer file a complaint against UPS, and now right before Christmas, they rescinded on their verbal agreement. Fraudulent company that treat you so rude that it seems like they do not need our business, so I suggest we do not give it to them........
Great food, great service, and good prices.
This place is so confusing and complicated to navigate through that you need to be a tourist to actually have the kind of time it requires.

NOT a fan of this place. I do really enjoy and respect their efforts towards sustainability, though. Beyond the food being lackluster and over priced, I had one particularly awful experience and refuse to go back. We had reservations for a large party for one of my friend's birthdays. We had to wait 2 hours outside for our table to open. Then, when our server put out a few plates of the potato sticks, a huge bug crawled out!! It honestly look like a roach! The owner (who I heard is nice) came over to our table after hearing our exclamations and said, "oh, it's just a beetle." No apology. He also acted upset at the fact that we thought it was a roach. I was in awe. At our meal the waiter just randomly passed out dishes so none of us knew if we were actually eating what we ordered. And when our server was filling our water glasses he spilled water all down my back. He made a crude, sexual insinuation by saying, "oh, that wasn't water..." I was disgusted. Other than this horrible experience there I think this place is completely overrated.

I go to this place regularly because their food is fresh cooked each day. Great Italian American selection of sandwiches, wraps and hot specials each day. Great Taylor ham, egg n cheese sandwiches also! They make a to die for freshly made each morning mozzarella! Then you have the freshly cooked broccoli rabe. Most fridays, I stop in for their fresh mozzarella , broccoli rabe and grill veggies and I call it dinner. The service is fast and friendly. A MUST to eat at if you want delicious fresh food FAST.
We eat here every time we come to Center City. Tonight had chicken escarole soup and a veggie pie  - motti benne
Get the sizzling si sig and the ox tail.

Recently opened in the space formerly occupied by Aloha.  The chef/owner Everson knows what he is doing in his kitchen. He is also friendly and welcoming. The restaurant's ingredients and oil are fresh and that alone is a welcome change to the area restaurants that have become "tired."  Yummy is basically a take out place with only six seats but the food is a treat: tastey, well prepared and top notch. I knew I wanted to try the food when I saw Ma Po Tofu on the menu.  The tofu was creamy and served with ground meet and vegetables with the right amount of zing.  The lunch special, at $ 6.50, is a good deal and comes with choice of soup, crab rangoon and spring roll and you can opt for white, brown or fried rice. On another visit, the thai green curry was excellent.  Give Yummy Asian a try; you will enjoy it and it's open seven days a week.  Bravo Chef Everson!

FYI...   Closed for renovations till 01/19/2015 Hope the improve the food too...   Last time we just stopped in for 2 Naan...   I've never seen anything like it... Worst Naan ever.  Not homemade must've been frozen in reheated.
burger was very tasty and front of house was very courteous.
Great Bar and Food! In from out of town and happened on this place. Very good staff and great environment. Truffle Burger is amazing!!

My father and I went to the Vietnamese restaurant and it was just like any other Vietnamese restaurant I have been to in the USA. It was authentic Vietnamese food and I loved it as always. I can never ever turned down Vietnamese food ever since I love my ethnic food very much. Vietnamese food is the best in the world!! :) Hehe I wonder what my mother would say if I had told her that. LOL Maybe, she would say, "Ok, no more Filipino food for you then." LOL She was a Pnay.
Sooooooooooooo delicious  chicken !!!!!!!!!!!!!'!!!!!! The best chicken I ate in American !!!!!!can't forgot the taste ,,soft!!!!!

While the food was decent and the atmosphere was okay, the service was poorly lacking. My girlfriend and I were eating lunch in a mostly deserted dining area. We ordered apps and drinks. Another group of 6 women came in and were seated next to us shortly after we arrived. Our server took their drink order then came and took our order for our meal. She did not give us our drinks. About 5 minutes later the ladies received their drinks, we still did not get ours. 3 minutes later our appetizer  came out, but no drinks. The appetizer was okay, the mozzarella sticks were fresh, but the chicken was obviously frozen and over salty. Finally, after 20 minutes when the waitress came out to clear the plate I had to actually ask where our drinks were. Turns out she had forgotten about them. After getting our drinks the pizza came. Very traditional New York crust, but a bit undercooked and very greasy. The price was not bad, $32 for lunch; but due to the lackluster service and frozen food, I do not recommend this as a family restaurant. If you are in a hurry, you can order a slice to go, otherwise I wouldn't waste the time.
Amazing tacos; fresh and clean.  Cactus on corn good for vegetarian.  Flour tortillas have lard.  Beans have pork.

This is a restaurant that serves authentic cuisine of the state of Kerala in India. I have been to many Indian restaurants around NJ and NY and I think this place is unique and is a gastronomical delight. Should try the meen pollichathu (Fish wrapped in a leaf) for sure. The new Chef who moved from California has brought in a lot of new additions and added his own twist to many of the dishes. I recommend this place to all those who love Indian food and would like to try something unique and different from what you get in Edison, NJ.
Good atmosphere, great service, so-so food

Just when we thought our dinner date was having a bad start (small issue with our reservation), the host (I think... A very energetic man with great customer service) made sure he gave us the best service for our night. The food is delicious and the cocktails are really good (Chicha Punch and Urubamba). We had the Seco de Cordero (large portion) and Salmon Macho (very tasty). Our waitress was attentive and friendly. The rest of the staff was helpful and attended us with as smile and great service. It was definitely worth our trip (from CT). We look forward to dining here again for Peruvian Cuisine! Overall I have to give this restaurant 5 stars. A big plus: they have some parking spots available!!!
Food is only okay - and they don't deliver?! Not great at all. No one even smiles when you enter, poor customer service.

Dude, no!   I don't have CiCis where l live and this was right across the street from where I was doing business. It's pretty small, only about 25 tables. You really can't ask for a lower price on unlimited food, but there's nothing to appreciate about this place. I wanted to write a review that made a commentary on the food, but I'll just conclude that I ate it so you don't have to.   Here's what REALLY happened. There were a couple families with small children, it's a cheap feed and a way to get out of the house, I get it. A guy who I presume was the district manager was working as the cashier (eventually he sat down with a backpack and laptop to speak with another person, I'll say the in house supervisor).   Fruit flies were gathering on dirty plates at the tables. This strip mall is relatively new construction, but you would think this place has been getting hammered for 30 years the way everything is broken. (Plenty of pictures.)The table I sat at first was about to fall apart, loose, wobbly, unstable, the whole deal.  Lots of dents in the Sheetrock like someone throws plates at the wall for fun. Broken tiles, no detail cleaning plan.  Just seeing this lack of attention in the main dining area gave me the morbid curiosity to go into the restroom. As expected the exhaust vent had a liberal coating of dust. The splash guard next to the urinal was hanging on by half a hinge, and the best (worst) part was that the toilet paper dispenser appears to have been broken off the wall and never replaced!   I finished force feeding myself this generously portioned economy pizza product and packaged soup not at all satisfied but not gonna miss my 8 bucks. As I got in my car I witnessed the DM and in house supervisor leave the establishment and walk two doors down to get take out from Moe's.  At least they are smart people! If you decide to come here it means you are cheap cheap cheap or your family has more people than you can really afford to take out for a sit down meal.
My friends and I love this place! The service is on point every time, and the food is a slam dunk! My favorite is the lamb burger, it's a must try!
The goulash here is terrible- very watery! I was shocked - the sauce was water and salt. Terrible. The beef was old crumbly chuck cubes- whoever cooks such a goulash hates life!

This is one of the few good restaurants in battery park city.  The pizza is really awesome and a good price. If you want a quick, good meal in BPC without busting your wallet, this place is a good restaurant to which to go.  The pasta is hit or miss but the bread and appetizers are also good.

The food was delicious. I ordered the lightly fried whiting with the sauteed spinach/garlic and macaroni and cheese. I was dispappointed that early Sunday afternoon they had no candied yams. The other diappointment is the service is poor. The servers don't have a pleasant face and don't greet the customers as they come in. The servers take a long time to take your order, even after the menus are down and placed to the side( which indicates that the customer is ready). The server also brought me the wrong check. It was significantly less than what I owed. I am not sure how that mistake could occur.

Ordered eggs over easy.one was broken one was cold,told waitress,she was not concerned.asked for dark toast it looked like it came out of the bag only warm.what really is upsetting is that no one cared,from the waitress to the cook who grunted his disgust at having to cook another egg which took 17 minutes to get.and oh by the way the manager and staff were too busy socializing to be concerned with my poor excuse of a breakfast.from all I have read it seems buss. Is so good you have outgrown being humble keeping your customers the first priority.i am sorry for this experience for myself since no one else was/is.your buss. Will decline if this kind of exp. continues.I will not return any time soon that's for sure

T his pizza never disappoints no matter what Time of day This is the best pizza in Brooklyn and Nyc and probably the entire united states Outside of New York the pizza is terrible I hate to wait but today I waited 10 minutes for fresh pizza

This was my first experience at the shoppe. I decided to try the famous godfather with a nutella milkshake. The two blonde fellows behind the counter made each one. One word- exquisite. The pure genius of these fine young men was astounding. When i bit into the godfather and tasted the milkshake, I knew they were slingers.
Love this place so clean atmosphere.  Their paninis are put of this world totally delicious.

I tried out this place with my girlfriends when they had the groupon specials. We ordered Calamari Fritta, Fiery Mussels, Chili Pepper Chicken Rigatoni and many more that I can't even remember all of the names, but we liked everything that we ordered! The price and portions are very decent! Casual atmosphere - very relaxing. Would recommend this place to anyone!

----Be Warned--- Just came back shocked and horrified from what was supposed to be a fun Saturday night family dinner during the holiday season. When getting ready to leave and reaching out to my coat that was placed at the restaurant's designated coat rack near the kitchen, I discovered that my coat was covered with yellowish slimy and greasy paste. When I asked the manager what happened he said that one of his staff spilled it on the coat and he then moved on to smudging and smearing the unidentified slimy substance until it was fully absorbed into the fabric. He then walked away and when I was trying to talk to him he completely ignored me. He refused to give me his business card or full name. He then claimed that my coat was already stained and that he has no time to speak with me. He proceeded by cursing me and ordering me to leave the premisses. I'm horrified from the experience.
Good!
Good selection of beers and bar food. I enjoyed the burger and different variety of wings.

Michele (s?) wears the cutest make-up and only takes the best care of us. I haven't met a person as on it and together as Michele. I honestly have to be real, people who know me, know..if my food isn't right-we have issues. Michele didn't even have to check in with me. She handled everything and made my experience beyond delicious. Blend on the water already has a better menu than the other one. Michele is a TOTAL gem. If you have her, you are beyond lucky to be in her section. If you want your food done correctly, fast, amazing and awesome you should with out a doubt request Michele. I have requested her AND WAITED. It is totally worth it. SHE CARES.

Wow so I just came here tonight for my brothers birthday and I now understand why all the 5 stars are so accurate! This is an amazing fine Italian restaurant hands down. The service is Top Notch, the food is Amazing so perfect. This restaurant is nothing compared to any Italian restaurant, especially the Chef's coming from il Mulino, this is actually better than il Mulino including the Service nothing compared.
Meat was good. I like family style but they made it a little difficult to decide. They also ran out of everything on the night we went.

Penang is one of my favorite spots in Chinatown! Their food is always consistent and they offer pretty good service. I always get their Indian pancake, ABC drink, Singapore rice noodles - they're muy muy delicious! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone, especially Malaysian food lovers!

Underwhelming. My friend was visiting from out of town, and I was excited to take her to Audrey Claire since I have heard great things about the restaurant from friends and co-workers. Overall, we thought that the food was just okay (some dishes were even bad) and that the meal was poorly paced. We went at 5:45pm and were seated right away. Overall, the restaurant is very "bare bones" which is fine, but the food really needs to be excellent to make the experience special -- which is wasn't. We shared one small plate and two entrees: 1. Grilled Octopus: It was really just an ice berg lettuce salad with an overwhelming amount of feta cheese and a little bit of octopus. We found the dish to be unimpressive and the octopus to be a little dry. 2. Special - Barramundi: The fish was excellent. It was cooked perfectly and very flavorful. However, the risotto was bland and lacked flavor, and the asparagus was overcooked. 3. The Duck: Horrible. It was very tough and bland. It was overcooked (definitely not medium rare we were promised). We found the lentils and cauliflower puree to be a random pairing with the duck as well. The dished had a strange consistency and lacked a unified concept. We ended up leaving the restaurant with two pieces on the plate. Who would leave duck on a plate if it is as succulent as it should be?!? We left the restaurant, politely declining our server's offer of dessert, agreeing that the best part of our meal was the Victory Golden Monkey and the Bell's Two-Hearted Ale that we bought across the street.

Let me preface my review by saying that we are a young couple and have had the privilege of frequenting plenty of high-end establishments. We made reservations for 9:30, entered and found  the place to bebeautiful. There was no one in the front to greet us and we had to 'find our way' to the host. We were seated right away. We received our menus without an introduction or a simple "hello". Ice water was poured in our glasses, a piece of ice flew out of the pitcher and landed on my partner's sleeve; no apology and still no greeting from anyone. Our waiter came and didn't bother to introduce himself or greet us. We proceeded to ordering wine. The Moscato tasted like crap. We asked for suggestions on some appetizers and dishes. Our waiter was clueless. Out of the very few main course selections they had, we ordered steak. I asked for cheese on my mashed potatoes and the waiter out right said, "We don't do that". I was in shock and in disbelief! My partner went out of his way to ask another waiter if anything could be done about this, as it was a simple request. Instead of addressing our concerns he went to get our waiter. The real shocker came when our waiter walked over to us and brought the menu with him and said, "The only cheese we carry is Parmesan, we don't serve cheeseburgers and sandwiches here". My jaw dropped. I could not believe what I had heard. Because I wasn't asking for a slice of cheese which is what would go on burgers and sandwiches it led me to believe that he was basically pointing out the fact that we perhaps didn't belong in such a high-end establishment but rather one that serves burgers and sandwiches. I have never been so humiliated in my entire life! So I demanded my partner to escort me out of there. He asked for the bill for the wine and the appetizer we had ordered but did not consume. The manager came over and my partner explained what happened. He offered to sit us with another waiter or to give us the bill. I felt repulsed and just wanted to leave. We were handed the bill, paid and left. As we were leaving, the manager handed my partner two $25 gift certificates for when we return again which will be NEVER. They didn't even consider the fact that it would be impossible to get reservations anywhere else in NJ at that time and we were celebrating a birthday. The Highlawn Pavilion might as well serve cheeseburgers and sandwiches if this is how they are going to treat their patrons. This is a really disgusting place!

The staff does a great job trying to accommodate guests in spite of the management. I have been to my 2nd wedding here now and was hoping the problems the couple and guests had were isolated but unfortunately the staff here is stuck between a rock and a hard place w the managers that can't seem to get things set up right. It's a shame.

I went by Nolitas yesterday and I received excellent service by my server Yarimar. Everything came out in a timely manner. She was persistent and really friendly. The food was extremely delicious. It is in a really nice location. Overall really good experience and do plan on returning soon.
Best seat for breakfast in Burlington!  and best french toast.  Yelp signed me up last night and I cant stop!  Thanks for breakfast.  mmmmmmm gravy.  Wish I had leftovers about now.

i know this place is about the pizza, and yes, believe the hype, but the broccoli salad is fucking life changing. i dont even order the pizza anymore, just the salad. also, the bread and butter is actually worth $5

Love this place. It's never a let down. Food is always up to par portions are huge and service is always good so far I have been there 4 times. Breakfast is my favorite. Try the boston cream pancakes ! Addicting Prices are right and foods fresh

The service is superb, and the food is really really good!  Sally and Philip are so pleasant and very patient in explaining how every dish is prepared.  The spicy whole sea bass is delicious and the sizzling beef is out of this world!  Such a nice addition to West Hartford's restaurant offerings.

I eat here often.  Food is ok.  Staff are attentive.  The recent visit was dinner for 4.  Ordered appetizers,  corned beef spring rolls and fritters.  Ok big mistake, corned beef and corned beef has are not the same.  We alerted the waitress we were no pleased and the manager, Matt doronty?  Came by and inquired, he the shared that we ordered two of the worst appetizers they have,  he explained they are experimenting with some new ones and brought us a nice cheese platter and potatoes pancakes on the house. Dinner came and Matt stopped by, everything was very good? Some logistical errors, food to go was tossed by accident and a new order was provided. Drink glass was cracked, he the corrected that. Needles to say, there are always minor incidents when eating out, it is inevitable.   The proof is in how it is handled.   These minor blips were handled professionally and I will be back to see the other new items.

Really great spot with incredibly lovely staff.  Can get hectic on the weekend, so get in early to ensure you have time to chat to Michael (the main guy) and linger over your flat white and omelette. They're graceful about having small children/toddlers on site which is both refreshing and welcoming.  Huge thumbs up to a top notch local eatery.

New server absolutely ruined the experience.  Wasn't attentive with any of our requests, refused to refill drinks, and even refused to come to our table to take our check.  My party thought we'd found out new go-to spot, but clearly we were wrong.
This place i really like. The atmosphere is really good. The service here is great and foods are awesome.

We were on 14th street and was craving Thai veggie curry. One of the best authentic Thai in NYC is a little hole in the wall called East Village Thai on E7th. It was a cold night and we didn't want to go so far, plus wanted to visit a place with nicer decor so we chose Bodhi Tree. Maybe we should've walked away when we saw the B GRADE on their door from the Health Department... but was too cold  :( We ordered the Penang veggie curry and the Pineapple veggie red curry without the pineapple. I wanted a red curry but they only carry a Pineapple red curry on the menu, so the waiter recommended it. I decided on it and asked for no tofu in mine, plus extra broccoli. Although the waiter tried to be nice, he wasn't able to hide the distaste on his face for my slight alterations. He was annoyed, and it wasn't even busy, and honestly, I didn't think I was being difficult; I only asked for two alterations. Then, literally one minute after we had ordered, I asked to change to the green curry as I realized there wasn't much veggies in the Pineapple red curry without the pineapple- as the pineapple was the star of the dish. (waiter did not mention that, so I would've had a curry dish with only two types of veggies in it) :( The dishes came and they were very small portions. They were $12 each. The jasmine rice that came with it was also a small portion. My green curry was very very salty and I knew it would bother me, so I tried the Penang curry, SLIGHTLY less salty, and my dinner guest kindly switched with me. The waiter saw our switches and asked if everything was okay- I told him the green curry was very salty and he asked if we wanted it changed. I did, but didn't really want to bother him since he was already annoyed. I can taste that the curries were tasty, but too much salt. I left him a good tip even though I was dissatisfied. I shouldn't have to feel bad and refrain from asking them to fix something, but I did, because he wasn't too tactful right from the start. I was very polite the whole time. Next time will stick with authentic Thai at East village Thai. They make excellent food with a deep depth of flavor without over salting their food. I won't go to Bodhi Tree again. If you want a salty salty curry, go there. If you want authentic flavorful Thai curry, go to the little hole in the wall, East Village Thai on E7th Street.

This place was so disorganized and just very awkward to be in. The food was good, not great. I won't be coming back BC there is no seating inside, it took over 30 mins for a $12 simple order. I'd you live very close by and have all the patience and time in the world, go here for decent food. Otherwise, skip it.
Fast service, reasonably priced, delicious food. Always fresh, very consistent food. ALWAYS busy which says it all.

I have only eaten here once but I will not forget it, and definitely will come back again! The food was delicious and I did not have to wait very long. I went with a Malaysian friend and he was equally satisfied by the food we ate that day, and happy that he could have a taste of authentic Malaysian food.
This was amazing!  We had chicken sandwiches and Po Boys and they were fantastic!!  The service was great!  Highly recommend!

Service was terrific and friendly. The space is beautiful. The food is quite good and very reasonably priced. The appetizers were delicious (Dan Dan Noodles and Spicy Cucumbers). Our Double Cooked Fish was too salty and didn't have enough sauce, but the texture was great. Two appetizers and one entree was plenty for two forty-something adults.
very modern, comfortable and cozy environment. I ordered the vegetable crepe and it was too dry for my taste. Other than that I appreciate local ingredients and cleanliness of the place.

I have had the displeasure of living near this place for years now. It is a last resort option for a quick bite or coffee. The service is very disorganized. On occasion we have had to wait 20 minutes for a latte or a specialty bagel, only to find that they couldn't make the food item offered. Often, I have gone in to find basic menu items (e.g., an everything bagel) not in stock thirty minutes after opening. The food is adequate but they only give one cream cheese for a bagel that is larger than average. By any measure one cream cheese is insufficient ufor a bagel. It is that kind of inept thinking that permeates throughout the operations of the Gold Standard. Unfortunately, this will never change and the neighborhood will continue to be under serviced  by this restaurant/cafe.

Soco is an amazing date night restaurant. I attended Friday night around 10pm. Everyone had seats; there was minimal waiting. The lighting at Soco was dim, so it gave off a very intimate atmosphere. *Thumbs Up* I had the buttermilk fried chicken with the red velvet waffle. I have never tasted a waffle so good. I believe my boyfriend had the pecan crusted or covered pork chop. He enjoyed that very much as well. We also had a side of mac & cheese & cornbread. Those were very tasty too. The servers at Soco were very nice. The bathrooms were clean and the restaurant is very beautiful and cozy. I also enjoyed the background old school R&B very much. I definitely recommend attending. Enjoy!

Very varied menu , seasonal with locally sourced items. Onion Tart, salads very tasty. Fish was beautifully done. Service is a bit too fast, but once they were told to slow down, it was fine. This is the type of place that takes several meals to really judge the kitchen. Definitely will return.
Amazing lobster mac & cheese! There is always some type of wait but it's usually not too long and the food is worth it! Friendly staff will be back!
was ok ,not great not horrible
I finally had a chance to check out Grimaldi's.  By far one of the best pizzas I ever had.  I would go back in an instant if I was in New York City.
Looks kind of trashy but cheesesteak is amazing!!!!! So glad I tried this before I left Philly!
Cute space. Spacious and good for large brunch parties. The free buttermilk biscuits with apple jam  are amazing! I've been here twice in a year which is saying a lot for a NY restaurant!
Really enjoyed the food and the ambiance. Enjoyed the Korean touches in many of the dishes. Nice place to have a quick drink before as well. We will be back.
Good!!!!!!!!!!chinese style ,it is not too sweet!!!can use card ~not cash only is good!!!!!
The atmosphere is great, the margaritas are great, the food was pretty good, too.  I recommend!

4 of us did the tasting menu with wine pairing early on a Friday evening.  Overall the food was excellent. Service - I expected more for a $700+ evening. We notified the waitress multiple times about a nut allergy.   Still my first course had nuts, even though I also added "Without the almonds, please". At the end of the night,  we were served cookies made with almonds and had to ask if they contained nuts instead of being warned by the waitress. We waited something like 40 minutes between the first and second course, and maybe saw the waitress once... maybe. I would've expected a check-in or more wine or something. After that they picked up the speed but we started to feel rushed,  as a server twice tried to take our plates away before the last person was done.  At the end of the night, the manager asked us to get up for another group even though we were certainly not lingering at our table.  To his credit he offered to buy us a round at the bar which we accepted.  Other than what I mentioned, the service was good and the food was delicious. But you don't mess with food allergies.

Where to start: From my drink, which was a watered-down Hi-Ci. On to my soup which was only half of my problem. The lobster bisque: tasted like Campbell's soup & was as thick as pancake mix, there was this extremely fake lobster substance in the continents. But giving them the benefit of the doubt I added the crackers an a TON OF salt & pepper an choked it back. Now we're at about 45 minutes not receiving our dinner, which I might add was the simplest thing on the menu. When asking a waiter to see what the malfunction was he ignored us. NOW the good part. I felt ill & sadly threw up in the restaurant at this point and continue to be sick with food poisoning from this "Mystery" lobster bisque. Congrats on being the worst dinner on the East Coast. Also for the extremely rude, arrogant woman trying to "fix" her restaurants series of unfortunate events, Please memorize the famous phrase "The customer is always right" Happy Holidays.
Fantastic dinner.... 2 thumbs up..... I will be back!!

I am giving 2 stars for meats. The chicken and ribs were amazing. The service...I can not even call it a service. I informed the host that it was my first time dining at the restaurant,  and made a comment that I liked the decor, the best thing to do is to make that first experience unforgettable in the good way. My server Vera never smiled and had a look on her face like" I hate being here and serve you." She never recommended anything, when I asked about their beers she said its in the menu, when I asked about the desert menu she said its on the table. She brought the check without asking if we want anything for desert or if I want another beer. When she brought a check, she did not say anything. Just dropped it on the table.  The host acknowledging that we need an assistance never came to the table when we need help at the time when the restaurant was dead. I felt like they just don't care about their guests.

Just got back from a marvelous dining experience. The sigara appetizers were fabulous, as was the chicken kabob platter - so tender! Baklava and milk pudding equally as tasty and, oh, the Turkish coffee...DELISH! Prices were very reasonable. I'm planning a trip back real soon.

Sooo, I'm a bit bewildered by all these awesome reviews. Perhaps I got the wrong thing? I got a plain white pizza with some veggies on top and it literally did nothing for me...maybe I should've gotten a red sauce but I've gotten plain white pizza from various places and it was still packed with flavor...this one, not so much :(

I am a native New Yorker and love my pizza. Many friends have bragged about how great the pizza is here so I figured I definitely have to try it. I had been DYING to try this place and must say it left me disappointed. I came solo early on Saturday so I wouldn't have to wait.  I ordered the Cherry Jones upon a friends suggestion. I felt like it took forever to get my pizza and when it did finally arrive it was cold and the bread soggy. I think they forgot about me and the pizza. I will not discredit the pizza entirely. It was VERY tasty, I just feel like  I would of enjoyed my experience here better if the pizza was hot. I will come back again because I like the look and decor of this restaurant. There are other things on the menu that I would love to try. I'm almost sad that I had to write a bad review for this place but I had to be honest and cold pizza sucks.

We like the atmosphere and coziness of the fireplaces in the bar area. Music started at 8 and was wonderful. We had Potato chip appetizer, burgers, French dip and ahi tuna steak sandwich with French fries and house salads. Food was delicious. Drinks were generous. Our waiter Scott was wonderful and very attentive! We mentioned that it was my husband's birthday and they brought him a delicious chocolate cake. Great place to spend a Saturday night!
i love chicken and rice. I have not stopped eating this since I moved to NYC. I look forward to trying their 14th street location

Went to eat there tonight. I love Indian food and this place had great reviews so I thought I would go out of my comfort zone when we arrived to find it in the second floor with poor access ( it felt like a firetrap). I could get over that, but it smelled...funky, and not a good Indian smell, but an odd and dirty smell.  There weren't that many tables and they said it would be a 30 min wait so we left. It may not be fair to rate them so poorly since we didn't eat anything but "I think not" applies here.
Wonderful service wonderful octopus need i say more PS I have an octopus fetish.  My how to say this was one of the best octopus dishes I've had

My husband and I stopped by for an impromptu dinner and it was AMAZING!!!!  Nicki was so attentive at the bar that we ending up staying there and enjoying our whole experience.  I am not sure if there was anything we didn't like :0  We started with the BEETS , then the CRUDO, then the PORK BELLY, and then the CAPPELLETTI.   The whole experience was a TASTE EXPLOSION and I can't wait to go back!!!  The service exceeded our expectations...We even met George and Jennifer who were hands on throughout our whole experience!!!   Don't miss this great location just two blocks from the square!

This place is amazing!! the staff is very friendly and always with a smile, i dont care if its fake but it makes u feel welcomed, small portions but it makes up in flavor and freshness LOVE IT!! been there couple of times LOVE LOVE LOVE it.

food is good, service is horrible. only one of our entrees came out, the other two were "lost" in the kitchen. waiter flipped some attitude when questioned about the two missing entrees. good luck getting a drink refill, apparently takes an act of congress. the managers response to the lack of service: feel free not to tip your server. so many good places to eat in NYC -- this isnt one of them.
Love this place and love their ravioli's!

The red,headed guy waiter sat 3 in a small 2-person table (probably 20 x 20) and assured me that "they've fit bigger people before" and it's "standard".  This has never been a policy to any restaurant I've ever been to.  Needless to say, brunch was cramped and uncomfortable.

Don't get too excited people, food is good but this place is SMALL as in tiny as in you have to step outside to change ur mind. Again food-wise it was good, at least my avocado/shrimp salad rocked. As for my wife...not so much. Med requested Burger came out raw. They fix it but not a great first impression for her. Did I mention THIS PLACE IS RIDICULOUSLY small?! You're practically bumping uglies with everyone around you. Food doesn't outweigh experience, sorry Ruby!!!

Sensational long-standing place.  Squid ink with rice, tortilla, chicken liver mousse are permanent standouts.  Great specials like pigs ears, home made gazpacho & fresh grilled sardines allow us to come back 2-3 times a week. Never disappointed.  Great red wines to match and relaxed but happening vibe. Custard balls and flan are superb if you have enough room. I really like it, the place has a bar and two rooms, it has great food with brunch too (French toast) a very nice restaurant and I recommend it.

Great local bar with a cozy atmosphere (fireplace going during winter), super friendly bartenders and staff, not too cramped or crowded, excellent food. Always my go-to spot for any night of the week. Best in the neighborhood!

After many years of lurking, I literally joined Yelp this evening to post a recap of one of the worst meal experiences I've ever had. After having been turned away from Morgan's a few months ago (they served me a drink but then said they were having a private party so I had to leave), I was anxious to return after hearing such good things about their bbq. Arriving on a Sunday evening, we were told that the only available menu items were sandwiches and sides for the next hour. Not sure why, if you can make me a brisket sandwich, you can't also just put some brisket on a plate. But ok, we said, sandwiches only. My friend tried ordering a beef sausage sandwich, but nope, they're out of beef sausage.  So now that we've reduced the menu to about four available options, my friend and I finally settled on an order. After waiting over ten minutes to get our beers delivered, the food came out. My friend's brisket sandwich was decent, he said. My pulled pork sandwich was dry and completely lacking in flavor. This was really bad, even grading on an NYC curve. Then we asked for our check and noticed that we were charged for our side dishes, despite all the sandwiches coming with 1 side dish. When we brought this to our server's attention, she told us oh no--get this--the sandwiches only come with 1 side M-F. On the weekends, my tiny cup of potato salad is $5. All told, we spent 50 bucks on 2 beers, 2 sandwiches, and 2 sides. Without question, the worst dinner I've had in Brooklyn. Bummer.

I've been here several times and as always this time was no exception, I usually get the Cuban but this time tried the fish tacos. They were great as well, next time I may try the pork tacos, mix it up a little!!
Great beer list, hella cool and friendly bartender, dope wings. Fin.

The service was crap. My friends of color and I sat for thirty minutes and wasn't provided with any service. We didn't even receive water or ask what we would like to order. I would never recommend this place.
Great food. great delivery

I've had better scrambles and better eggs Benedict. The scrambled eggs and the hash browns were very greasy. Although made well with a nice crisp exterior. Its texture could be improved by draining out the excess oil.

Recently went to Libretti's for the first time for a work holiday lunch.  There was a special, limited menu due to the size of the group, but there was a chicken, veal, and seafood option.  For a lunch, the portions were great and the meal included a salad, pasta course, and entree.  The bread brought to the table was fresh, warm, and a generous size. The service was attentive and the pace was well-timed.  If I'm back in the area, I would definitely try Libretti's again.
Great dinner very friend and service was outstanding ! But you need reservation

I almost hate to crow about this tiny place because it's been our secret for many, many years. It's tiny. Understand, they do their best to seat you at your reservation time, but they won't be kicking anyone out of their table for you, so you may have to wait. Deal with it, because it is worth it. Many times, the gregarious and personable Peter will forgo sneaking a table in just to keep a table clear for you when you arrive. There is no waiting area, so be prepared to stand outside. Again, once you are in and seated, all will be worth it. The food is terrific - old school Italian. Egg Parm is amazing, and while we don't eat red meat, their meatballs are legendary. I am partial to their pesto, but everything we get over the years is delicious. This is a family establishment - and the wait staff has been around as long as we've been coming and they know how to run a restaurant. Warm, welcoming, and delicious. Just don't tell anyone :-)

I just had my first meal here as per the recommendation of a local friend. It was fantastic! We had meatballs and stuffed artichokes to start. I had veal Milanese for my entree and it was outstanding. The veal was very high quality milk fed. We shared the dessert trio and their tiramisu and funnel fries were a standout. I look forward to going back to try their pizza and pastas. I highly recommend it. Portions are very plentiful. The staff is welcoming. I will definitely be going back.
Nice. I like it.

I've ordered from Candela's a few times, and just keep going back for more. The food is great! The deliveries are always on time, and they've never gotten an order wrong yet. Will certainly continue going there. The only thing I wasn't a fan of so far was their vodka sauce, which I found was a bit bland, and I think their garlic bread needs some work, but other then that, love the place!
Orders are always on point . Drinks always on point. NEVER any issues with you guys!!!

its my favor sushi hibachi place in bayonne,,The fish was very fresh, good presentation  and good service.  Loved everything about the place.  Had all-u-can eat as well as a la cart sushi and hibachi.  Everything was well prepared . I have gone on two separate occasions and was not disappointed at all  either time. The service was excellent and you could see the hibachi chef entertaining as he was cooking for party of 10. It look like everyone was having a wonderful time. The place is clean and welcoming.  Adding a picture of their valentine roll to this review -- adorable and delicious!! i will definitely coming back.

I've only been once to pick up a cake for a party. I can't stress enough how important it is to have what you order ready when you need it to be, and they did. That in itself gained them my respect. They were extremely professional. It was a little overwhelming in the shop because there was no line, just a bunch of people standing around looking at each other and workers running around, or just standing around. I stood there for about 10 mins until I flagged down a flustered attendant who looked at me like a deer in headlights. When she found out I was ordering a cake, someone more experienced stepped in. That was kind funny to me at the time, but she was professional and helped me order the right cake. While I was there I decided to pick up some Italian cookies, that were to die for. I can't find anything wrong with them, but I will stay FAAAR away because I could see myself gaining a good 20 lbs. There's no seating or dining in the shop. It looks like it's just for ordering or buying pastries, but there is a diner next door that is owned by the same people/company, but not associated as far as I can tell. It's also priced very reasonably. In more trendier bake shops in the area I couldn't find anything in our company budget. The amount of cake I got and the size of it for the money was quite phenomenal.
Must get mashed potatoe bacon pizza one of the best slices of pie you will have in nh. You can wash it down with their own brewed toasted blonde

To be honest I only gave a star for the food. The food came out all right and everyone enjoyed there meal. But the service was horrible. Our waiter Sean was not friendly to our table at all. Spilled a whole water on my friend at the beginning of our visit and don't even say sorry. Never asked if we wanted a second round of drinks or if we wanted dessert. Then it took 41 minutes to get our bill. And he even messed up on our credit cards. We could have easily walked out and no one would have paid attention. There was no manager to be found at any possible point of the night either. It was a big group of us and by the end of the night the 8 of us had nothing nice to say. We will not be coming back
Love this place!  Everything is always good!

Hands down one of the beat Italian restaurants in NYC. Been coming here for years. The Penne with garlic Broccoli is great. Tony's Chicken is the best in NY. If you love mozzarella cheese the appetizer, Mozzarella en carozza is to die for. I tried both locations in NY and both always have friendly staff.

Great generous portions, cemitas are delicious, had the breaded beef and my wife had the vegetarian and they were both really good. Complementary homemade nachos with their salsa also added to the experience. You should try it!!

Holy moly! If yelp reviews were ever accurate about any place this would be it. Tonight was very lucky because after a long cold exhausted dY shopping I wanted something satisfying and cost efficient not to say the least just open because it was midnight. I called the place before hand and the guy on the phone was kind enough to let me know that the kitchen would be open til 1230! Boy was I excited I went with my boyfriend and a friend. I already knew what arepas were, but the waiter was so kind to explain the menu after he asked if it was our first time. The menu is to the point, you have your type of Arepas and then meats or cheese. I ordered the regular arepa queso and two arepa choclo one chicken one steak. And when the arepas came out the waiter explained all the condiments and which goes with which best. Not to mention the awesome juices we ordered!!  OMG this review will never end! It was three of us and it was less then 20 a person with tip included. ( I also ordered one to go for my fat ass) best areal place and service hands down!!! Must must must go!!!

Had an amazing time at the Heath. Although I read all the reviews and knew what to expect, being there to experience it was on another level. The food and drinks were amazing. The band, singer, and other entertainers really made us feel like we were in a different world. I will definitely be returning and highly recommend checking it out.

Overall, our experience was not as great as we had hoped, and I am not sure I can say it's worth the price to return. How did they get the temperature wrong on a burger if all they serve is burgers? The waitress was on the job 4 days (though had 2 waitresses as back up to help her). She made a bunch of mistakes, but we were very lenient in her mistakes (ex. bringing the wrong beer, no beer glasses, not offering water, bringing us the wrong food, not giving us plates for our appetizer etc). I'm a teacher who has worked in the food industry myself for a few years, so I was trying to be understanding. I think we couldn't take it anymore when my husband ordered a burger med. rare and it came out extremely well done. The waitress kept apologizing, but we had enough at that point. At that point, it seemed that the wait staff avoided our table and all eye contant for some time, making my husband even more uncomfortable/frustrated. We weren't offered any drinks/water or free appetizers as we waited another 15 minutes. When the burger came out, we asked for a box so we could go home. I will say at the very end a Manager came over and offered to cover the cost for the burger, which was $18 (no sides included). I thought it was better than nothing, though it should have happened sooner. I can't say the burger had any flavor, even with the special sauces we ordered, so I am not sure we will be returning. I'll keep hunting in the area for a great burger joint.

Was there last night for our office Christmas party and loved it. The ambiance , service was great and not to mention the food is outstanding. I definitely  would come back for a nice night out for dinner with family or friends or for a special occasion.    Love this place!

I was visiting from out of town and my cousin had the connections to this place so my first time here. Ordered Sangria which was yummy and had the "Little Victor" for dinner....food was delicious, ambience was nice and service made it a nice destination fitting for catching up with family

This place is good. Our food was good and I loved my cocktail despite another reviewer claiming they were average. Ordered: Gnocchi, large portion, as a starter for 2 as recommended by the waiter. This was really good, but we would have been good with a small portion. Entree: Steak Salad and Steamed Mussels. I preferred the Steak Salad over the mussels. Everything arrived very quickly. Dessert: Lemon Meringue Tart. This was amazing. I would definitely get it again.

I went there yesterday and it was awful there were a lot of people waiting, horrible service... one of guy there started to be rude just because we didn't understand him when he asked about which kind of tortilla we wanted....Tacos are good I mean like real Mexican ones but not so spacial for wait 30 min for your food and horrible costumer service.
Went to Osteria last night and had an amazing meal. The beef carpacio is amazing and pastas remind me of being in Italy. Service is also prompt. Will return.
A good little place. Of course, not a high end French, but a decent little hideaway in a NJ suburb.

Excellent Food!! Authentic Kerala cuisine...Good service...decent ambience and good value for money price..What else do you need in a restaurant.? Will definitely go there again and will recommend it to anyone who likes Indian Kerala cuisine.

Went there yesterday with my friend for dinner. Firstly , on the website it says that Thursday's are ladies night and drinks are 2$. It wound up being full price drinks. I wouldn't have minded but the drinks sucked. My friend ordered a bulldog and it was so strong it was disgusting and nothing to drink with dinner. I also ordered a sangrita which was sangria and a margarita mixed. That too was strong I didn't even drink it. The guac was like sour and bitter I think it was old. The food also took like an hour to come just to make 2 damn quesadillas. The waitress was beyond nice though. She changed my friends drink for another but that too was strong. Probably wouldn't go back for dinner again. Maybe the bar.

Before our show, Home for the Holidays, Featuring Anthony Hamilton w/ Mint Condition. We decided to have the prix fix dinner they offered. Everything was wonderful from start to finish, hostess and the waiters. Friendly, they talk to us a little, sharing their favorites. I recommend this place before any event. Well worth the money. I really enjoyed everything. Kudos to the Chef!!

If I can give this restaurant a rating of 10 stars I would! I absolutely enjoy the meals here every single time. I make it my business to try something new when I visit and I have no complaints. Everything tastes fresh, the ambiance is extremely comforting and friendly and the service is superb. Their fish tacos are the BEST I've had, the Shrimp Penne alla Vodka makes you waking up the next day wishing you can have it for breakfast and if that's not enough, their take out is as delicious as eating at the restaurant. Everything is delivered hot and fresh. OBVIOUSLY, I would recommend this restaurant :)

Though seemingly cheaper than other hibachi places, they use cheap ingredients, charge extra for the salad, the "ginger" sauce is the salad dressing, and they are stingy and a bad show. At the end, the vegetables that I got from the chef were 90% onions that weren't cut, and 2 pieces of broccoli. Will not return.
Was there on a Saturday night. The service was average. We finally got the wine when we were done with the appetizers. Main courses are more less ok but pi portions are small.

Waited about 35 minutes for a table big enough to accommodate four people. The place is built with mostly two tops. Cute atmosphere! Food wise, everybody was pretty happy. I had one of the specials...eggs Benedict with crab hollandaise, potatoes and short ribs. Felt a bit small for 16 smackers but it was tasty...crab is expensive we all know that. My girl had a special also...a shroom bread pudding with an egg, cheese sauce and some extra mushrooms scattered on top. It was very tasty but so small. It looked like an appetizer, really. In fact, she ended up eating again only an hour after in the middle of errands. It was really too small. Our friends had the fried chicken dish and a scrambled egg skillet. They said they were happy with it. Our waitress was kinda short with us, like we were putting her our by being there. Plus, the dude who said he'd bring our check forgot, not to be seen again. This could have been a four star review if not for the tiny mushroom special and the feeling that our presence wasn't wanted. Coulda been worse, coulda been better.okay.

I ordered Spicy Miso Ramen, Chicken Katsu, Chicken Karaage, Teriyaki balls, and a mango bubble tea.   Miso Ramen: the noodles were too soft, and slightly mushy.  The broth was a little off, not what I'm used to when eating miso based ramen.  The rest of the ingredients were ok.  However, if I'm going to spend $10 on ramen, I want it to be really good.  This was not. Chicken Katsu: Served over short grain brown rice.  I thought this was a strange choice for chicken katsu, as it's usually served over medium grain white rice.  The katsu was irregularly cut and strewn about the rice disorderly, very out of place for a japanese restaurant where presentation is usually extremely important.  Also, it had takoyaki sauce on it, instead of katsu sauce.  All in all, not worth the money. Chicken Karaage:  The chicken karaage was tasty, and it came with two dipping sauces.  But it was a little pricey at $10 for a bowl of karaage.   Teriyaki Balls:  These were strange.  It was similar to takoyaki, but with different ingredients.  They were really tangy and gingery and had small pieces of shrimp in them.   Mango Bubble Tea:  You could get better bubble tea at any number of bubble tea places around the city. That being said, the service was great and the workers were nice.  The restaurant is extremely small, it seats 10.  I liked this place, but I had higher expectations for their food.

My friends and I received our order shortly before A-1's closing time. When I realized that my sandwich was not included, I called and, after being accused of being mistaken several times, the woman on the phone refused to do anything about it. I've had orders arrive wrong before, but never in my life has a business refused to correct the problem. I was left feeling ripped-off and hungry. I won't be ordering from A-1 Pizza again.

Ive been here a few times. I drive an hour out from connecticut. Because the mac and cheese balls and chicken and waffles are more than amazing!! The atmosphere is pure nostalga. Its so full of life. Def one of my favorite places to eat!! I will be going back forever!

We had dinner here with friends.  I got the lobster ravioli special and quite enjoyed it.  We had good service by the entire staff.  Everyone one in my party enjoyed their meal.  I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a good meal by the park.
I should add that the diners at Guantanamo Bay probably got better service.
delicious

To start, this place is not very big,  but upon arriving with my group of 7, they were very accommodating for us! The wait was around 20-30 mins, but we had a drink at Von (right next door)  while we waited! and the hostess went in there to let us know the table was ready! Bad bad bad I live 10 mins away The food was cold I ask for no salt on my fries n the put salt away!!! The bread was hard wtf never ordering from them again!!!
