For example: Nachos originated in the city of Piedras Negras, Mexico, just over the border from Eagle Pass, Texas in 1943.  Ignacio "Nacho" Anaya, invented the new snack of tortillas, shredded cheddar cheese, with added sliced pickled jalapeño peppers. When asked what the dish was called, Senor Anaya answered, "Nacho's especiales." But as word of the dish traveled, the apostrophe was lost, and Nacho's "specials" became simply Nachos.  Madera's Veggie version is made with corn tortillas; whole or refried beans; grilled veggies of carrots; celery; onions; Monterey Jack cheese; pico de gallo (tomato, onions, coriander, fresh jalapeños, salt, and lime juice); and sour cream. I usually include Guacamole too. Of course what is missing are the traditional pickled japs - but as to this milder version - it'd be hard to find a more nutritious Vegetarian snack/appetizer option for two people in Burlington.   So my advice - don't ask them to dumb-down the menu (be brave - it has been made mild already / esp their kids menu). And if this isn't your first rodeo - just let your server know.  They can make your fish tacos more Cali - or enchiladas more New Mexican; et cetera.   Lastly Madera's is first and foremost a restaurant (so going in "for a quick beer" and expecting a bar type vibe is kinda dumb). It will be assumed you are waiting for the rest of your dinner or lunch  party - rather than you want to pound a beer every five minutes.

Wow this place is so good! Hands down the best tacos I have had in awhile. They have great customer service and their prices aren't too bad. My favorite is their chicken tacos and a side of rice and beans! This place is my spot for some good tacos.

Firstly I have to say that the food and the service were of the highest standard. My daughter and I shared a full portion of Crab Risotto and Kale and wild mushroom paella. They were excellent choices and our waiter was extremely attentive but I have to confess that at about $28 per portion, the portions were far too small and would not satisfy a hungry person. Overall a good experience but not sure if I would make the journey from mid town or uptown.

This is a neighborhood spot I love to go to. The food is always good and so is the service. You will have to wait during the lunch rush though so be prepared. I had the soup dumplings. They are a must!

Service is good. Pizza is average at best. Sandwiches were not good, the bread was so hard I thought my teeth were going to break!! Chicken cutlet and meat balls were below average. The name of this place is misleading, I've tried every pizza place around and this is not the "Best"  It's too bad because the guys there are nice.

My friend Margie (VegHead) has a hard time finding places we both like so I was not in the mood when she said Positivitea but I went anyway.  I like meat, big meat fan but I didn't miss it here.  The flavors were fresh and complex.

AMAZING food, anything I ever ordered there was absolutely delicious!!!! I live in the neighborhood so I often get a delivery when I am too lazy to leave my place to walk couple of blocks down. Favorites: ALL salads!!!! Mushroom burger!!! falafel Pita yuuuuum.... Gosh can the food be any fresher and any more heavenly delish?!?!?

If you want to get together at a bar with some friends and feel extremely uncomfortable then Black Crescent is your place. It's like all of the asshole bullies from high school got together to open a bar where they could belittle and scowl at you and charge you extra just because they don't like the look of your face. I will definitely not be coming here again willingly.
Food is amazing , I couldn't get enough of the ribs! The Mac and cheese accommodates the dish perfectly. Definitely coming back with friends!
One of the best places left to get a good Sicilian slice! Their dinner menu is pretty awesome as well, decent prices and ample seating both indoors and out along with ample parking.
It was a quick search for some good food post exams and definitely loved it... quick service n very friendly ambience. ..

Stopped here for lunch because of the overall 4star rating. I was surprised that there was just another two top eating I didn't read the actual a reviews ahead of time. I was greeted and seated promptly. Drawback was that my table needed to be wiped down. Got the menu and decided to read the reviews. Overwhelmingly good reviews. The waitress brought me some water and the glass wasn't clean and something black was floating in it. Aargh the reviews were good and so was the score but strike two. Good thing I had a bottle of water in my bag. I decided to stay. Ordered a pizza and it was great. Other reviewers are correct about the crust and the tomato sauce being fantastic. Overall when I wanted to run out, I'm glad I stayed. However they could work on the cleanliness.

This place has terrific potential, but they need a bit of polish. The biggest detractor for me was the service.  They are rather dramatically formal but terribly unresponsive - when we went for lunch we had to wait for 15 minutes for a waiter to even take our drink orders even though we were one of two occupied tables.  When we went for dinner, one of the waiters literally nudged me out of his way so that he could get to some plates.  There was also a rather distracting scene where a hostess was trying to help clear and a waiter insisted on stacking more dishes on top of an already precarious pile, which resulted in silverware clattering to the floor in the middle of the dining room. I've seen more grace in a diner. PLUS both times we went all but one in our party was served at the same time.  Both at lunch and at dinner that last person had to wait until the others were nearly done. As for the food - I would say 50% WOW, 50% meh.  The menu is unclear about things like what is vegetarian or has gluten.  When I ordered the mushroom risotto I just happened to ask whether it was veg and the waiter said that it could be made that way if I wanted.... to my mind, this is a problem.  There are a LOT of vegetarians in New Haven.  Get with it!  I would not have deducted a full point except the risotto was pretty awful.  The rice was chewy and there were chunks of nearly raw crunchy garlic.

This is, without a doubt, the greatest new place in the neighborhood. Not only is the atmosphere and space wonderful, but the bartenders are wonderful and the drinks are top-notch. Love the fireplace, the back deck, and the music choices. Haven't tried the food here yet - but I can't wait to come back. The only downside is that when we tried to come for my birthday, it was already closed by 1AM :(
terrific! great food. great service. a wonderful atmosphere and very friendly!

Neighborhood gem!  This vibrant downtown corner cafe location, walls of interesting artwork and friendly waitstaff are the perfect canvas for an amazing breakfast. I had the leek, pear and goat cheese omelet and my husband had the homemade corned beef hash perfection!  They were both amazing, along w the homemade bread, jam and butter:). Would go back anytime we're n the neighborhood.

I'll keep this honest and to the point. I came here with my girlfriend's family for dinner during the late summer, and other than the fact that the windows have no blinds and we were a bit blinded by the sun set, the food, service and ambiance were great. My girlfriend returned here with a friend a few weeks ago for brunch, and they said that although they found it odd they were made to wait 15-20 minutes for a table when the restaurant was relatively empty, they again found the food to be great- with my girlfriend recommending we should return there for brunch. So we did. Or tried to, at least, this past sunday. We called in advanced to try and make a reservation for 6 but were told that a reservation can't be accepted (more on this interesting tidbit later), and to just come as a "walk in". So we did. 4 of us arrived together, and tried getting a table, but were told we couldn't be seated until the whole party had arrived. this was flaw number 1. The restaurant was almost entirely empty, with maybe only 5 tables being occupied, so we obviously didn't understand this. BTW, this made us very reluctant to order any appetizers or drinks at the bar while waiting, whereas we would have probably spent some money if we were seated. Either way, we gave our name to the hostess, and waited. our friends arrived about 20 minutes later (imagine how much money we would have started spending). We went back to the hostess when they arrived, and tried getting out table. Our name wasn't on the list, even though we gave it to them. Strike 2. Now here was the cherry on top of the cake. The restaurant was still mostly empty, with one large party gathering, but it was clear which table was theirs, and the rest were empty. We were told we would have to wait another 30 minutes before we would get seated. Now, amazingly enough, a couple walks in, drops their name, and gets seated right away. Apparently, they had a reservation. Fancy that. This was probably the least professional place I have been to in a really long time, and there is equally good -or better- food available in that area without the hassle.
Amazing Mexican restaurant. The taco appetizer platter (says for 2 people) but fed 3 of us as our entire meal. So delicious! Service was great as well!

This past weekend my husband and I went to Room 55 after hearing about it from some friends. We're usually not too food enthusiastic, but that dinner was hit all the right notes. For starters, we ordered the Harvest Salad, which was fresh and tasty, with a generous amount of goat cheese. My entree was the Amish Chicken Breast. This type of dish can be a hit & miss, since chicken breast can be easily dried up, but the chef of Room 55 did a great job of keeping the meat juicy. My husband opted for the duck, and according to him it was divine! It's been a while since I've seen him enjoy food like that. Additionally, the service was very kind, and the prices were fair. We'll definitely be back for more!

I love Korean tofu and have been to the Ft Lee and Pal Park tofu restaurants quite a lot in the past few years. When I found out So Gong Dong opened in East Hanover I went out of my way to come here and it was GREAT!! The waiters kept me and my friends well supplied with starting appetizers, especially the always tasty kimchee-cucumbers. I ordered the beef tofu and it came out piping hot along with a nice stone bowl of rice (with the crispy-crunchy rice on the edges). Our beef ribs were already pre-cut (no more scissors!) and the seafood pancake was also excellent! I did not get to order other things like the Bibimbap but my friends and I will definitely visit again and try more of their menu! Highly recommended!

They really tried to be outstanding but they were not (there is great potential). It was pretty loud and we had a small table right next to the bar so it was busy. The red wine selection by glass was not great (mostly wines from France if I remember correctly), it was served too warm and the wine glass was not clean. The food was good but it also had its price, I really liked that the plates were preheated.

I wish I had listened to previous reviews because they were mostly right. I had a reservation a month ahead. Called to confirm a few days before n to update that we were going to be less people on the day off. Me and my party got there on time and even though the whole restaurant was empty they didn't have our table ready! Cocktail at the bar was terrible. Told the bartender, he offered to change it with such a fake halfhearted apology I sticked to my drink so I could avoid more contact with him. He was very awkward in his interaction. Pasta was delicious but overpriced. Dessert was bad. I did not understand what they were going for. The 2 stars are for the good waiter n the pasta. nothing else was good and for the prices they have you would expect outstanding food n service.

The best pizza in the U.S.!  The best regular and sicilian. Even when you can't finish the pies and bring it home and freeze it...when you heat it up it is still better than any newly made pie you can buy.. The master makes all the pies!!!!!

My family has been buying Christmas Eve fish here for 40 years. Hands down the best fish market in the area.Service is Newark style so yuppie metro-sexu^!2 should stay away, PLEASE so the rest of us do not have to hear your whinny mouths. For a week night treat try the Seafood salad awesome. Rich West Caldwell
Pretty good Italian. I got the special (3 cheese ravioli with house meat sauce) and my wife got gluten free chicken alfredo. They were accommodating to our 2 kids!

Best unkosher Jewish restaurant in New York ("trait" means unkosher in Hebrew). Pork all over the menu! But lots of great vegetarian options as well. Cool space, friendly service. Truly spectacular inventive and fresh food.

I have never been more wise than to spend my last dollar(in cash) on 4 pork and chive dumplings. The filling is perfectly seasoned and perfectly cooked. If I lived closer I would pick these up on a daily basis.

Great lil place, had lunch today the calamari was excellent we had a couple of sandwiches with salad, apple crumb cake with vanilla gelato and terrific coffee! The waiter was adorable, I mentioned I was involved in a restaurant with a wood burning oven, he walked me over and explained the coal.oven, too cute!
Brilliant food and great service. Definitely one of my favorite restaurants in New York

My new favorite restaurant in Philadelphia. Right off the bat, the ambiance and the staff won me over. Everyone is friendly and smiling, and we were seated quickly. The decor is tasteful. Our waitress Samantha was super nice and very helpful when it came to the menu. My mom and I decided to split the four cheese pizza Bianca and each get an appetizer (Caesar salad for me, braised meatballs for her). I also got a cocktail from the menu, which was delicious. The appetizers came out quickly and were so tasty. I definitely recommend the braised meatballs--not too rich or heavy. Our pizza was to die for. All in all, an excellent experience. We'll be back for sure!

Some seriously sweet nachos the galbi shredded beef is amazing and the pico with it is awesome as well pour that pico in top and they are some of the best nachos I have ever had. Add on the fact that they have a sick tap list and this place is now my new favorite place to watch the game or go with my buddies for some beers and great eats!!!

I LOVE THIS PLACE!!! I've been coming here about once a week for a year or so. Legit everything is delicious. I believe they just revamped their menu too! Favorite Dishes: Chicken Parm - heavenly Buffola roles - Divine Navajo Chicken Pasta - add shrimp - to die for Check it out, you wont regret it!
Everything is Delicious. I've been here several times! you will not regret it!

Great flavors: broth, noodles. I had the Akamaru Modern and my gf had Karaka Men. We both loved her broth a lot more, but that could be due to both of us liking spicy foods. My broth was still very good and I recommend it for someone who doesn't like a lot of spice. Of course I got the extra noodles. I always do when I eat ramen. Service was GREAT! Very attentive & on top of things, no matter what you needed: extra noodles, refill your water, clear your dirty plates, etc. The speed & efficiency this restaurant runs at is a #1 example of how all companies in the food industry should be ran.

I was there early.... Being alone in a strange city I wanted to eat an head to the hotel room. I was one of the only people there but the bartender was so sweet. She made a killer margarita and I had the biggest best hamburger I have had in years! Yay!

HOLY $%&Y! Stopped by this place last night kinda on a whim--but DAMN am I glad I did. Seriously--the best potatoes and the best dipping sauces (TRY THE PESTO MAYO). Bookmark this place for your next NYC trip!!!

This is the real deal Philly Cheese steak. Wit or witout, make sure you have your order in mind when you step up to the plate. Authentic south Philly spoken here. Look for the imprint of Sylvester Stallone's footprints in the sidewalk....No trip to Philly is complete without a taste of Pats. BTW the hot peppers are really hot!
Good cheesesteak & fries! Had the meat been jucier it would have gotten 5 stars. Very good fries. Unique experience worth checking out. It was more expensive than I expected though.

Umm, Pat's is not a one star restaurant, it's a five star joint considering how delicious and fresh the food is. Only fresh (never frozen), high grade (for the price) beef is used - as well as fresh rolls and scrumptious cheeses and other toppings. Pat's cheesesteaks are grilled to perfection by true pros. I used to be a chef at an expensive restaurant, so it has hard to impress me. Pat's staff is a bit rude, but this is South Philly after all. Service is fast and reliable.

Very good cheesesteaks made fresh to order and 100% delicious. Cash only and expect to wait in a small line. We want there and to the place across the street, and Pats won. You will need extra napkins of course, and the seating is only outdoors. Some may say there are better places and maybe so, but I have not found it. We love Pats and we will be returning soon.

So I am here eating a cheesesteak and I am a cowboys fan and the owner of the cowboys pulls up in a black bus and the yet out to eat a cheesesteak Food was amazing Saw this place on food channel and was really excited to try it Was amazing

Came here for dinner on a Tuesday night. I arrived a little after 6:30 and it was packed. The couple ahead of me were quoted over an hour to be seated. I was dining solo on a work trip so luckily they could seat me within 10 minutes. The food was amazing! I had the raw wasabi octopus and then a ramen, delicious. They paired a Saki for me to have with it which was lovely. The food comes out very quick, I was out in less than an hour. I highly recommend but give yourself time to wait.

I didn't expect a place like this in Linden. The decor is very nice. A friend and I had the clams and Thai favored wings for appetizers, the Angry shrimp tempura roll and the Happy Pig Drunken Shrimp for entree. Everything was delicious expect the Happy Pig Drunken Shrimp. It was very tender but it didn't have any flavor at all. I also had a Dragonberry Tea which was strong but good. The services was great also.
Great friendly service, fabulous margaritas, excellent happy hour (currently 4:00 - 6:30 M-F), and delicious food!
Super nice restaurant!!Wonderful environment,friendly servers!!!Food is super super great!!!Will come again!!
Service was awesome...we were less than whelmed by the ceviche  but the mahi-mahi tacos and tuna tostada were delicious and the service was friendly, informative, and eager to please.
Cant go wrong with kona grill woodbridge nj. Really good food, Awesome sushi! classy spot! perfect for dates ;)
Best Italian food ever !! Go for the dessert sampler platter. It is divine !!

First let me state that I cannot comment on the food because I never ate there. Originally went to have lunch there on a Monday but they were closed, so could not get in but noticed a restaurant right next door (Gastronomia). So we went to eat next door but somebody came out and made a big fuss that we were parking in his lot even though they were closed and the lot was empty with about 30 vacant spaces. Come on -- how small. I would never go back there again. Fortunately Gastronomia turned out to be a great find. Shame on you!

Got a regular classic burger, meat and cheese. OK burger, nothing special. The fries however, are wonderful. Crispy, hot, tater tots mixed in, and a slightly spicy aoli drizzled on top. Yum. Would come back again just for the fries.

I went here with my mom, who was visiting from out of town, the night after Los Imperios's opening celebration. (We were feeling adventurous.) I had such a lovely time! I Here are some plusses: + I was shocked by the beautiful interior. + Our server was very courteous and knowledgeable about the menu. + The food was incredible and the portions were very large. + I didn't go overboard on the booze or anything, but at one point I was gesturing widely with my hands and knocked over a sangria glass. The staff was SO chill about it. (I, on the other hand, was very apologetic--but was shooed away when I tried to help clean up). + For future reference: they're BYOB! Not something I've seen since I lived in Chicago, but have sorely missed. But this isn't because they don't want to shell out on a liquor license--they also have a full bar. I ordered a fish dish--I think without accents it's spelled Pescado Tres Leches. Three little glasses of different spicy "soups" over bits of fish and vegetables. It wasn't something I'd tried before, but was really delicious. I'm not used to Peruvian food, so I don't have a lot to go by--but the only thing that was missing from my meal, perhaps, was a higher proportion of veggies. I felt like it was pretty carb-heavy--just something to consider. I'm SURE it depends on what you order. Awesome dining experience! I definitely recommend trying it for yourself!
Wanted to give a shout out to the amazing bar staff, Randy, Jacob and Vala. They are hands down the best! Try 'The Other Woman'!

I am one of those people who really only gets motivated to write reviews when I'm pissed off about something.   However,  I ordered pick up from this place and was blown away.  Oh my god, what great cooking! Crisp veggies, tasty potatoes,  rich burgers, entrees with addictive sauces.  So glad I tried this place! !!!
Deliscous Food+ Great service= Amazing Athmoshpere. Everything is a yummmmm!!!  A  must to visit and to taste the jewels.
Too many rolls with cream cheese. Slow delivery. For the price good value though. Best delivery option that is not super unhealthy in Hartford

I swung by one evening a few weeks ago after seeing a few reviews floating around. Public transportation is fairly convenient, there is a bus that stops a few blocks away, but you have to take the F train to even get to that bus. A bit of an irritation, but not a major thing. The food is, while tasty, frankly overpriced. The lobster rolls are the size of an average hotdog, but cost $16. What the heck? The roll is more of a $12 value, if that. The ambiance is also very hipster-y, trendy-y kind of place.The decor seems to glory in being very "More money then sense" kind of clientel feeling. The staff were very friendly, though! They brought our order over to the exterior seating and everything.
Great food and very cool ambiance.  Highly reccomend.

My trainer knows when I have been to 5Guys and he make me pay for it, but it is worth the torture. Great burgers and fries with or with out the vinegar.  Even if there is a line it moves quickly. Give them a shot.
Best service ever. Oliver was incredible and very accommodating. The food was terrific and atmosphere is great.
Good Q!  And the greens are perfect. Somebody here knows they're way around a smoker.
When i dont have lunch i go to this place and they have Excellent costumer service they are all very friendly and I love their specials. And I really like their chicken empanadas.

We went for breakfast on our first morning in Philadelphia and had the American breakfast with eggs sausage hash browns and one with pancakes the other toast . I had the White Dog Cafe special French toast but it was so sweet and sickly I was jealous of my husbands and daughters breakfast.Yes it was nice but we would not go out of the way to go again only of we were passing, but would not think twice about getting on a bus down Clark to go to Ellys White Dog Cafe for breakfast or lunch and Ellys will be the last place we go to before going home.

Our monthly tradition of grazing on Starters continues to be an amazing experience.  This time we didn't stop with our old standbys.   We ordered Mac n Cheese, Goat Cheese, Calamari, Crab Cake, and Egg Rolls.  What I love about this place is it's clear that nothing is pre-made because it arrives at our table looking fresh and alive.  Colors and aroma hit you the minute it lands on the table.  So popular with locals, the bar has 6 single diners chatting and feeling comfortable and clearly enjoying eating a meal they thought were eating alone. The overall feeling we get when we come here is - home.   Comfortable asking questions on menu and recommendations.  When paring wine with food, they are not shy in making alternative suggestions.   This alone makes us want to come back.  Service, in my opinion, is the key to forgiveness and LOYALTY.  The food has been consistent and a delight each time.   Tonight in particular if We had to pick a favorite - we can't.  We are arguing over each of our favorites and we can pick a winner among four adults.  So hats off to The Chef - we can't pick a single winner so the award must go to Slate - tonight YOU are our local favorite.   Keep up the amazing job!
Never eat here.  Ever. They serve you stock ready made microwave food.  Even the nan /bread is what you would pick up from a grocery store.
One of the oldest Bistro in Soho and still going strong. A diverse menu and great staff. Love the classic french dishes here and a neighborhood gem.
Fun atmosphere. And hmmm that smell of chocolate is so inviting. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Will definitely go back and recommend!!

Saturday, 12/13/14 went to the Appian Way for a Work Christmas Party, 36-Hours later both my wife and I got sick. The next morning I called into work and found out 15 other employees got sick. I'm still checking to see about the other 25 employees. {FOOD POISONING}

I love this place. Tacos are so amazing, small enough to enjoy a few of them. The guacamole and salsa's are so yummy. The margaritas are amazing too. I love this place! Sometimes it gets alittle crowded but its expected!!! LOVE THIS PLACE

I am thrilled to finally be able to write a stellar review of Tinto.   I live in LA now, but when I used to live in Center City Philly I would take my girlfriend at the time every few months.  It was and still is her favorite restaurant, so when I found out years ago that Tinto had a private dining room upstairs, I kept it to myself and decided that someday it might be a good place to propose.  Sure enough, last month I did just that during our visit to Philly, and the Garces Events staff spent the prior 6 months helping me to plan the perfect proposal and celebration there.  The food was delicious, the wine was wonderful, and it was truly a night to remember.  Special thanks to Stephanie at Garces Events and the whole Tinto staff for helping me pull it off as a complete surprise to my fiancee!  They even through in a free round of bubbly for all 22 of us in the room.   Tinto is unquestionably one of the best restaurants in Philadelphia, but most people don't know about their ability to host events/parties upstairs.  No matter the occasion, Tinto is the right place to go.
Other than our rude waitress, this place was GREAT. Dishes came out superbly, and were delicious. We'll be back.
I love this place.
It was too full on a Sunday night, but the food was great! We ordered two pizzas, all of them were very good.

Okay... so it has taken me forever to write this review and I am not sure why... maybe I am just a procrastinator but the mere fact that I have taken just about everyone that I know to this restaurant says it all. This place is the absolute greatest! From the food which is delectable... the biscuits...the soups of the day... the fried chicken.. the grouper... to name a few. Then the service and the atmosphere (cute cozy spot in the bottom of a brownstone)!!!! I could go on but you really have to experience it for yourself... and the music selection is beyond bananas (in the greatest way possible)! Chef and owner Carlos will come out and bring you your deliciously soft homemade biscuits as well as check in on you throughout the meal... just the right touch to keep you coming back. Oh, and the peach cobbler!!!! Ah-may-zing! Still have to make my reservation for brunch... so I will amend my review with that later. Please come and support this place... keep great restaurants in Harlem! :-)

So, I've been to Otto, REALLY not impressed, but figure, let's give Lupa a try. It has good reviews.  To preface, the food here was fine. Not great, certainly not spectacular, but not awful, just fine. Perhaps though, I would have enjoyed it more had the manager on duty today not been SO rude to our table. A woman in black came over to bring a fork to one of the guests in my lunch party and we were looking at the wine list. I asked the woman if she could please tell us about some of the wine choices and in the snottiest tone she replies: "I don't know. I'm not the som, I'M the manager." Um, ok, I am SOOOOO sorry that I mistook you as someone having any knowledge about what's served in your restaurant? Why would the manager know that? And ok, that's fine if she doesn't but there are about a dozen different nice ways she could have replied to my request if she didn't know the answer. Also, a VERY good friend of mine has managed several high end restaurants through out the city and I have seen him at work and NEVER in a million years would he condescend to a customer asking for a wine recommendation.  999 times out of 1000 he would know what his restaurant was serving and if he didn't, he would happily find the answer. I'm officially done with the Batali properties. So just be warned people, don't get all gaga just because it's a Batali. I think these places are given too much credit for the association with the name.
This place is a classic! No one can truly say they have visited New Haven unless their trip included a burger at Louis'. I love the burgers, and the pie is great too.

Amazing! Spectacular pizza, great sandwiches, SUPERB staff. A must if you're in the area. A danger if your local because you'll want to go back again and again. Small place so sometimes there's a wait but it's well worth it.

I love this place. Great taste and the portions are satisfying! I recommend the bourbon chicken (chicken with bourbon sauce on white rice) and grilled chicken on rice (you get a lot of chicken, salad, and fish sauce on the side).
The food here is amazing. I've had breakfast and now lunch. Great food and great service. Their salads, fried chicken and waffles are all excellent. Great spot! Highly recommended.

This place loses stars based on two things. 1. My burger, ordered medium, was gray, dry and tasteless. If burgers are their specialty, then I got a dud. It was big but it was not good. 2. They charge for refills on their fountain drinks. What restaurant in 2014 charges full price for a refill of a fountain drink? It's mind bogglingly stupid and a good way to lose customers. Like me.

Nightmare. Words can not describe the disappointment felt tonight. David Burke should be embarrassed by the quality of the overall experience. We arrived on time for an early weekday reservation and had to wait for 45 minutes to be seated. No apologies were offered from a manager for the wait. To compensate us for the wait, we were given free bread while waiting for our food. Shouldn't bread come free to begin with?? The food was disappointing and some even sent back. I dislike the idea of even having to pay for the mediocre food that was brought. After having dined all over the world at some of the finest restaurants, I would chose a street cart over Fabrik.

I was blown away by the bright, bold, authentic flavors. Pork tacos are out of this world (cactus is also very good); salsa bar is terrific. Went back a few days later and had an equally delicious experience. A new favorite; will absolutely be my go-to.

I know, I know.  How can I give the Grammery Tavern 2 stars?  Well, reservations were easy.  Got there a few minutes early. Front desk was a tad snooty and aloof, but coat check was efficient.  The bartenders seemed harried and were a tad curt with us as the result. G_d forbid we move to the two available stools, they are being held for others who I guess have been waiting. They didn't however show for 10 more minutes at which point we politely moved away.  We had our mediocre California cabs and the bill was efficiently transferred to our waiting table which was nice.  We forgot about th table and nobody from the hostess station bothered to alert us so we were seated about a half hour late and were hastily scolded for our tardiness! Ice water is served.  Beverage order is requested almost immediately, and since we wanted wine, the waiter made a couple selections. The first couple suggestions were both over $300 per bottle, and we finally settled on a bottle that was $85, good for those on a budget according to Marcello (our waiter).   Appetizers were squid ink spaghetti and smoked trout, both of which were "meh".  The bread was either sourdough or a roll. Cold, but OK.  Butter was the exact perfect temperature which is always a plus. Wine service was attentive.  Glasses always filled evenly and timely so they def had enough staff on the floor to not miss a beat, but then again, the restaurant was only half full this early in the evening. It did fill up later. No steak on the menu. Boo. Real disappointment not being able to get a steak at a tavern.  They seemed to lean heavily toward fish and vegetarian items, and neither of us wanted those. So, there was a poached chicken dish and a lamb.  Neither of these dishes was bad; they were, rather, boring. Uninspired. The wine wasn't great. I've purchased bottles at the store for $8 that were as good or better. I think they could tell we were a little disappointed, or they knew that the food has fallen on tough times since Shake Shack has become the obsession of their famous owner, so they overcompensated with desserts.  Chocolate mousse, chocolate and passion-fruit trifle were amazing. I rarely go for dessert, and I rarely eat a lot when I do, but these were fantastic and  I ate everything in sight! So, why only 2 stars?  For Almost $400, the ambiance is OK, but not exciting in any way, and the food just isn't all that great. For the money, I recommend you look elsewhere and the restaurant should stop resting on it's laurels.
I loved this place!! It is in such a cozy and cute location. The service was amazing and the owner was so kind to my friends and me. The TNT, Happy, Dashiwaki rolls were so good.

I've always enjoyed being pampered by having cheat meals during the weekend, but nothing comes close to comparing to eating the bone marrow here. Just can get enough of it. In terms of the famous Black label burger, I think it's alright.

Reading Terminal is a Philly icon for a good reason. Come hungry, because you'll probably leave full. If, by some crazy chance, you have room for dessert after a freshly prepared lunch or dinner, there are plenty of places for dessert, including the oldest ice cream company in the US, Bassetts. It will be loud and crowded inside, but that offers a new adventure on every visit.

Reading Terminal has an amazing selection of vendors that offer a diverse array of cuisines. A must-see for anyone in Philadelphia. I don't recommend driving here though as cheap parking is hard to come by.

That's right, with Shadasia, at the property # 25716 was wonderful, it was as good as it gets!  The unit was clean when I moved my stuff in.  The manager and Jessica were very helpful when I went there to move in.

A little expensive... but worth it in my opinion. The tomato soup was yummy!! And their salads are good to. They are  crisp and fresh and offer generous portions.  I do wish they had a wider selection of dressings though. The relaxing environment here was just what I needed so I could rest my weary feet, especially after a long day of christmas shopping! The staff there is very friendly and work good together as a team. I would be tempted to give just 4 star because of the price but the service more then makes up for it, so I'll give it 5. They deserve it.

Honestly, 1 star is more than this place deserves. After 20 minutes of not being served with a 40 person party, I go to other side of the bar only to get charged $18 for a double jack and diet. I will never being going back to this establishment.
Just not bad, and not good enough, maybe i chose the wrong food
Can't get better for the price. Found a table quickly and food was delicious!

Not sure how people have liked the service.  My girlfriend and I were made to wait 15 minutes for a table, regardless of the fact that 4, FOUR, booths were empty and waiting for the entire time we stood there awkwardly at the front door.  Meanwhile, 4 tables were paid and ready to leave but decided to sit and chat.  I am not a restaurant owner, but let's be honest, you can't make your potential customers wait for tables while others are empty while also allowing customers who have paid and eaten to just sit around and occupy tables.  We left before getting a table because we were hungry and didn't feel right giving our money to the restaurant that made us wait when we most certainly should not have,

Really good value- good quality for ayce. You can place as many orders as you want but make sure to order enough on the first round because food comes out somewhat slowly (the only downside of it being made to order). Salmon sashimi was our favorite!

Per Guy's recommendation on Food Network, our family had our first brunch last Saturday. All four of us ordered the waffle and wings and we really enjoyed it. The waffles were presented warm with a touch of cranberries and cinnamon butter cream? The chicken was fresh and seasoned just right! Was worth the drive!

Service was ok except the waiter didn't understand English and made mistakes with our order.   Food itself wasn't especially great.  The chicken soup had bones in it.   The lamb chops were served over steak fries.   Nothing especially appealing.   The veal stew wasn't very thick.   Honesty the best part of meal was the bread.

infini-T is perhaps one of my favorite businesses in the Princeton area. Not only do they have a plethora of teas to choose from, but it also makes for a very good place to study. Try the rooibos teas if you get the chance. They also make a pretty mean guacamole if you want to snack while enjoying your tea. It tends to be a fairly quiet establishment, unlike the bustling air of a place like Small World. Be aware that there is no cell reception inside infini-T, but that is often for the best if you're trying to get work done. If you're not trying to get work done, there's Apples to Apples.

A great find! Colombian food is unique - not the hot, hot, hot of almost all restaurants I've been to lately. Very fresh and well presented. The Camaron Y Pina Asada (grilled shrimp, pineapple and coconut milk) came in half pineapple scooped out. The Paella dish was a feast chock full of the sea and enough for 4 people (be prepared to wait for this dish as its complexity requires more time to make). Impressive menu with a vast selection of Spanish favorites. Empanadas light and crisped just right - green salad with tomatoes, strawberries, cucumbers perfectly dressed. The restaurant has just opened - waiting for liquor license but has a separate bar area. Small, intimate and atmospheric with the Latin beat in the background. The owner and her staff were most gracious and attentive to our needs. We were treated like family...a very good attribute for a neighborhood establishment. I will certainly come back when I return to CT to visit my relatives - probably be our new "go to" place when we have the urge to eat out. Thank you for the wonderful dining experience!  - Nancy T-V, Harwich Port, MA

Guys, this little place is orchestrated beautifully. The food is fantastic, the waitress are fully and welcoming and it's very cosy. Fried calamari is a must have. I liked the home made pasta "tagliatelle al ragu". My mamma could not do better...

I travel 2.5 hours almost every month to have lunch here with a friend. Have been doing it for over 2 years. Monument Lane is my 'local' restaurant. The food is superb and the ambience at lunch is quiet. Went on 12/15 for lunch and had the Lamb Schnitzel (memories of Sydney Australia). My friend had the brisket (yum!). Lunch is never complete without their divine cookies at the end and the coffee. Comes in it's own French press. Our server, Justin, was fabulous. Great sense of humour and understated, like all the staff. Food is sourced locally and the chef does wonderful things with it. Want to try brunch and dinner too, but it's my 'go-to' place for lunch in NYC. If you are an 'all-day breakfast' person, you can get that too. Menu is not large, and is available online to view. Makes for better quality, I say. PS - They will accommodate food allergies. Mine is garlic/alium (don't laugh). I ask what I can have or not and they work with me, no probs.
Delicious flan. Delicious ropa vieja and bistec encebollado. Not a fancy place. A great food place. Yum. Commin' back!!

Great food, great location. Awesome service. The owners are so niice! I love this place. The people here are amazing. The first time we went in the lady up front was so kind. She figured we would yelp in and she gave everyone free potato salad to go with the sandwiches. What was even better was since I went last, she gave me chips to make my sandwich messy (its a style of sandwich where they take half a bag of chips and crush it into the the sandwich) so since she understood I'm not a big fan on condiments she gave me the chips for free instead of the potato salad. But it didn't stop there, she also gave us two free bottles of water.
I have no idea who reviewed this place, but it was mediocre at best. Nice, friendly staff, but I won't be returning.

I'm going to get right to it: Root & Bone is as good as it gets. There are so many places to eat in East Village, that it can get overwhelming. But if you're ever in the area, I hope you find some time to get a bucket of bird because it might be the best fried chicken I've ever had. Each time my boyfriend and I go, we order half of a bucket of bird, the mac and cheese, and whatever else we feel like having. The deviled eggs are a MUST! It gets very crowded at times - my boyfriend and I have yet to sit at an actual table. But we'll gladly sit at the counter, knowing that we're about to get a quality meal.

Luuuuuuurve it. Not only is the sushi fresh, tasty and beautifully presented, the staff is over-the-top nice. Truth be told, I've only ever had their sushi because that is the highlight and what they're really good at. One time I went there and had a roll they listed on their special board that had lobster or crab and mango in it which was groan-eye-rolling worthy and when I went back a month later and wanted to order it again, they brought out their specials binder that they have and let me look through it to find the name of the roll. Super accommodating and super tasty, a definitely must eat

Really disappointed with this place.  $15 for a burnt personal pizza with hardly any toppings? No thanks. Not to mention I heard the owner/manager talking to the waiters about up-selling the customers into buying personal pizzas and not sharing.  The place is nice inside, but not the worth the $.

This was my second time here for brunch and the food was outstanding.  This time, my sister and I took my mother for her 80th birthday and she kept commenting on how she could notice the freshness of the ingredients. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is that the busperson knocked over a glass of water and my sister was completely soaked.  He was very apologetic and it was an accident, but it was a very cold day, so we couldn't walk around Princeton afterward.  I would have expected a manager to stop by to see if everything was okay, or make an adjustment on the bill, but that never happened.
Awesome soups. They don't speak a word of English.

I met some friends here for dinner. Every menu item has meat, fish or some kind of dairy in it.  Every single item. As a vegan, I always review the menu before going to a restaurant and I figured this was going to be the kind of place that only offered salad for vegans and I was prepared for that. To my delight that wasn't the case here. The chef prepared me a special Vegan Paella the was absolutely to die for.  I loved it! And the sangria? Delicious! Best I've ever had and I've had plenty. Will be back for sure.

A. Kitchen is an utter disappointment. Went for brunch and service was very good and polished. I believe what they were shooting for were "thrice cooked" chips, a spotted pig fave. What we got were potato rocks with slightly sour taste. Kobe beef was chewy. High street and Fork are delicious but this needs work. You could do better in philly on a Sunday than this place for sure. Bread is awesome!

This place was great!! Boyfriend and I went around 7 and there was a nice line almost out the door. We got veggie dumplings which were so good that i ended up buying a bag of 50 frozen. He got the chicken and chive dumpling soup which he said was soo good. then we both got sesame pancakes with veg which were literally SO AMAZING that we wanted to get like 4 more each but were already so stuffed that we decided against it.. will deff be back soon and perfect for a college budget
Amazing Chinese food, I got the General tsos with pork fried rice it was worth the trip.... I would recommend this to anyone who's looking for good Chinese food.

Horrible service... I feel bad for the many costumes like me having to wait hours upon end to get food. All I ordered was chicken wings but obviously they are too stuck up to understand that. Do NOT eat at ziggys!

The best place ever!!!!! Everything is fresh and healthy, crepes with organic flour, gluten free soups, paninis and warps, 100%organic coffee  and more. Healthier than oranges carrots juice you can't find anywhere. In addiction the fifth and tenth coffee are free. So what are you waiting for? Go check it at kings Court in Lyndhurst another benefit because is free parking. You won't regret

My two grown daughters and I went toStaten Island after reading all of the great reviews  and we are glad that we did! One daughter ordered the berry french toast, one daughter ordered a strawberry/pecan waffle and I got the ham, bell pepper omelet that came with hashbrowns and toast. We each said our meals were the best we ever had! The prices were reasonable and the staff was very friendly and competent.

This place was fantastic. I don't think I've had a tastier pizza at least now outside of New Haven proper. The pizza had just the right amount of grease and most importantly the proper amount of cheese. i ordered and extra cheese and garlic and they man they gave me EXTRA cheese. As a side bonus they are reasonably priced, fast without sacrificing quality, and had a good selection of foxon park soda and desserts.
Delightful atmosphere and excellent food! Tacos were delicious and the guacamole was also exceptional. A great addition to the downtown montclair scene!
Food was ok nothing that was related to any of these reviews ..reason for 2 stars very small portions on take out & when ordered the boiled yucca it was 3 look alike French fries
Really good food. Cheap and tasty!
socialtimes.com/top-yout…

Very very very good and would recommend it. Oysters are great and a large selection from a variety of places. The price is higher which is expected in the area, but absolutely worth the price. Large menu with lots of selection from chowder to fried to raw.

Impressive and very Japanese. While noodles aren't ever a drawing point for me, these are flavorful noodles done with fine point of detail and flavor. The pork buns are the best I've ever eaten and a I had vegan and gluten free noodle option, which had google berries and an earthy mushroom taste. I also had their shochu with fresh grapefruit which is a fresh and clean cocktail that does not interfere with the tastes of the food, so I highly recommend it.
Finally an authentic ramen restaurant.  Well priced and delicious.  Wish they were open more, but what can you do...  I highly recommend.

Had a friend's surprise 30th birthday party here and the staff were AMAZING!!! They were so accommodating from the start to end. Everyone had an amazing time- great crowd, music, drinks and ambience. Rob the  owner could not have been nicer and a better host. Will definitely be back! I would recommend this place for birthday or even just to watch a game.

OMG MUST TRY! The best bbq food around and great customer service. We wish we could post pics but we ate it all already! We ordered ribs,short ribs, pulled pork,fries, and sweet potato fries along with some liters of soda. Delivery was fast and everything we ordered was correct-plus the portions were huge!! If you are thinking about eating here-give it a try! you will love it! SOOOO GOOD

Great set of meatballs! I had their buffalo meatballs with the white sauce and spicy sauce. GAME CHANGER. I also appreciated their selection of beer and wine. Everyone should try out this location because it happens to be the ORIGINAL meatball shop. I shall come back for the kitchen sink next time
Third time here, still as good as it gets. Always order the pasta specials. Also staff is very accommodating and attentive.
i ate here about a month ago, my burger was good but overprised.
My favorite sushi in Manhattan. My husband and I frequent here all the time. Make sure to try their Sashimi, it is the best I have ever had.

Had the worst and most expensive cup of coffee in all of New York!! I was going to try out this place for brunch seeing as I had just moved into the neighborhood but after my coffee experience NEVER!!! $4.00 for a paper cup coffee that was weak flavorless and and no where even slightly fresh. I simply couldn't drink it. When I gasped at the price the waiter just shrugged Ugh This place is the worst.

The good, the bad and the ugly all in one place The order: margherita slice (fresh tomatoes, fresh basil and chopped garlic) and plain slice topped with spinach and mushrooms   The good: it's pizza - who doesn't like pizza? plus, they had some decent variety to choose from. The margherita slice was palatable when hot, which i will give a 3/5 by itself The bad: overpriced ($8.50 for 2 slices w toppings) and the service was somewhat rude The ugly: small space - I had to stand outside to eat, the spinach and mushroom were both from cans and they didn't bother seasoning either, the crusts for both slices were burned Verdict: 2/5 when eaten hot, probably 1.5/5 if eaten cold I recommend staying away and giving John's Pizzeria (260 West 44th Street) a shot instead
great place and sandwiches however the man there which i assume is alan could be more personable !!
I love this place...the veggie buffalo wings are the best and the margaritas are on point!!!!!
Amazing place.  Super friendly owner and massive sandwiches.  Come hungry!!!  Wishing I lived in Philly!!!

This place is definitely a staple of NYC. The chicken is tender and the rice is tasty. It's a perfect blend of protein and carbs. It's my go to before heading home from the bar. Watch out the spicy sauce is no joke.

Best Indian food I've ever had and was extremely reasonable! I got the chicken tikka masala and it was so delicious. The naan here is also out of this world. The waiter was so nice and very attentive. Best meal I've had in a while.

This is definitely one of my favorite places in Leb. They use all sorts of local ingredients and the atmosphere definitely reflects the small town. They are open nice and early, perfect for getting a cup of coffee to start your day, they are always so kind, and everything is priced so reasonably. Definitely try the Monte Cristo sandwich, it's to die for.

Came here for lunch, took them 15 minutes to bring us menus and they don't have draft beer. Pretty sure there is only one person working. I would have left but my coworkers voted to stay. The menus are photocopied paper, not even sure if I should eat here.
The service is outstanding. I might be drunk but I never feel compelled to leave a good review. The staff here is very professional and I would tell anybody to come here for a good time.

I have a hard time deciding how to rate this place.  This review is more about service than food because I never really got my food.   I met two friends for dinner after they finished eating.  I joined late and was planning on eating after them since I had a gig in city and knew the kitchen was open late.  I arrived at 9pm and there were not many tables in front or back.  My friends had just finished and check was still open.  Ordered mac and cheese and kale salad.  After 30 minutes (there's maybe 6 other diners) I still haven't gotten my food.  Someone who came in after me just got there food and I still haven't seen our waitress.  I ask the bartender who comes to clear our drink glasses to check on my food.  He comes back and says its on its way.  I've worked service before and I know that means someone screwed it up and it just got fired.  We were leaving soon so I said cancel the mac and just bring the greens. After a few more minutes the waitress comes back to apologize that it is "100% her fault".   Okay.  That's cool she apologized and I said it's fine. I've worked service before and stuff happens. She brought out salad BUT, if it's your fault and you own up to it- offer something in return. Pick up a few drinks, take the salad off, bring the mac on the house or something so I will want to come back.  But no.  She got off shift sat at the bar next to us, had her dinner and left without ever bringing our check or offering to close out.  Later bartender closed us and bought a few rounds (thanks you sir).  I've heard the food is pretty good but I can think of sooo many other places that have a $30 steak and have better service.

Slate is not a restaurant.  It is an experience; an experience rich with bumping Timberlake songs, sophisticated paintings, and truly excellent European fare. The owner, Lorenzio, is an immigrant from Romania.  The food carries with it the taste of something exotic.  Not everything is great, but the best dish on the menu is by far, the game hen. This place is madly underrated.  Rouge will be packed and this place, a mere three blocks away will be empty.  Take your lover here for a memorable night in a quiet, and welcoming atmosphere.

Loved it! Food was good , service was great and the wine by the glass was actually worth the price. We will definitely be back. I had the fish sandwich and the kale salad. I was just so please with everything about the place, the atmosphere was enjoyable as well.
Went to Red STone for a Christmas party. It was excellent. They did a fablous buffet for us and everything was great. Thank you Paul and crew

I came to this place because of their positive reviews on yelp. I got beef pho with vegetables of my choice. It is very cool to see them make the noodle at the spot and they are super fast too. The staffs were super friendly as well. I ended up eating my noodle at the upstairs sitting which is super clean and relaxing. I will def recommend this place for anyone who is in a rush and want to get something good to eat!
OVERPRICED and less than decent food. They up-charge $.75 for a WRAP because the "tortilla's cost more." They will NICKEL AND DIME you.

"Everything was poor from the food to the service, such a shame...." We were greeted exceptionally well. That is the extent of the best part. Going forward in was a downhill spiral. We were a large party and were seated at a fine table. However, the waiter failed to provide us the wine/drink menu. After asking a few times he did provide it. I was irate at the fact the party next to us brought in their own wine and beer. Nowhere on the menu or web site does it state BYOB. The site only has "fully stacked bar" I would have liked to bring my own wine. The food at best was ok, nothing to scream about and say WOW. The first course consisting of salad was very tasty. The second course, the B'stella was ok, I have had better and found this one to be rather a disappointment. We opted for the mild dish of chicken with the lemon and olive. This had absolutely NO flavor. I did not taste the lemon nor the olives. It may have very well been a roasted chicken bought from a local store and was topped with lemon slices to make it look Moroccan. Then the waiter laid in front of us a dish of lamb and we informed him that we are expecting the beef kabobs as well since we wanted half and half. The waiter picked up the tray of food and stated "oh maybe this is for the other table next to you and brought it down". Isn't there a law about once the dish/plate/food is served you cannot reserve it? The beef kabobs were as tough as nails simply over cooked, dry and flavorless. I do not care for Lamb so I cannot say anything about the lamb dish. A basket of fruit for dessert? Really? Who provides a plate of fruit? Cut the fruit, have fruit salad but not a plate of fruit. Then the tea was served it comes already in a glass. The tea was very light in color which I already know is the Moroccan way but it had very little mint flavor. Here I am going to say they probably used mint flavored tea bags. I am used to the show of tea serving, when the tea is poured in and out of the pot at a high angle several times to infuse the mint and the steep the tea more. The baklava was acceptable. This place was a huge disappointment. Lacking in flavor, service and cohesion. Oh by the it is CASH ONLY!!!! Bottom line, if you like Moroccan food, do not eat here, rather look up a recipe and make it yourself.
Amazing food and service. Would highly recommend. We had a reservation for brunch, and absolutely loved the food! Reasonable prices brunch, but alcohol prices we kind of obscene. Enjoy!!
amazing spanish food

Dharshan will provide you one of the best nepali/vietnamese dinners you can get in vermont. It was so delicious - banh mi, dumplings, pho...the portions were huge. service was excellent and they clearly took pride in their food. we will definitely be coming back

My favorite place to be. Everyone that works there is amazing, Every time I go to Dirk my colleagues and myself are treated with the best hospitality that you can get in this city. The beer is incredible and only gets better and better. The  food is insane! Everything is very fair priced too. Trust me when I say there is nothing like Dirk The Norseman, by far the best bar around.

I have eaten at atticus a lot, but today I found a giant bug in my salad...it looked like a flying cock roach, and when I brought it back, the manager actually asked if I was eating outside....luckily I was fully refunded, but it ruined my and my friend's appetite for the day.....so grossed out

I don't live in NYC anymore but I still miss Eataly in Flatiron. The best fresh pasta selection, great fish and produce. I used to get the drip coffee there every day on the way to work. It was so good!  The place can get a bit busy at times but I guess it adds to the "Italian" vibe.

Good food but I think they need more waitstaff for busy season.. Robin was as lovely as ever but seemed under pressure! Love the food especially their meatballs. Its a great spot near Times Square but don't go for that Cacciatore-too many bones!

I have been coming here for quite some time and i must say this is one of my favorite places to eat. The chicken scarpelli is my favorite dish. I also really enjoy the Dorina wine. It's a dark red full bodied wine definitely worth a try. Make sure you get a hot loaf of bread on your way out from the bakery.

Perfect!! Burgers are sooo good and and its so fun to create it. I had a nutella salted caramel shake which was absolutely amazing, they also have adult shakes which are brilliant and a wide variety of beer and wine. The server was attentive and polite, the place is clean and a good place to hang out with the bar and everything. Ill be back!!

I'm giving this place 2 stars because the servers were nice, but I'm never coming back here. We came here in the summer, and I understand that the wait can be long, but they screwed up the order! They forgot fries with the kids meal, and I had to go back to get them. I went back to give them a second chance. I wanted the kids meal roast beef with cheese, and a few other things. I waited about 15 mins, got the order, and from experience, I checked the bag before I left. They didn't give me fries, again, with the kids meal! No spoon for my soup or crackers, and they didn't ask me sauce I wanted with my fries. When I pointed out there was no fries, they said that there was. I'm like "Yeah those are MY fries, what about the kids fries?" After waiting again for more fries, against my better judgement I left. Guess what? There was no cheese on the roast beef. WTF??? Plus I don't know why i was waiting so long because my other sandwich was cold. Never again.

Terrible, terrible, service.  I went to the drive-in window for a tea and a waffle.  I was the only person on line.  Fifteen minutes after putting in my order I was banging on the window and beeping my horn.  No one to be found.  When the server finally got to me a few minutes later, she was very apologetic.  Seems they where understaffed?  I was the only person on line!!!

First of all, let me say that, in terms of the merchandise, this place is definitely a 4 or a 5. The beer selection is awesome and the food is just amazing. So let me explain why I am rating this place as a 1. I was extremely disrespected here, and for no good reason at all. I was here with two friends recently, having some awesome beers as instructed by one of the hipster waiters. We had the Thai and Kielbasa sausages, as well as the country ham board, and everything was going very well. Then I decided to go to the bathroom. It was occupied. Next to the bathroom door, there was a set of light switches (about six of them). I inadvertently fiddled with one of them, which caused an unimportant light on the wall to go out. Admittedly, not the best thing to do in a bar, but far from a relevant affair. Immediately there came out of nowhere this angry little man, who rightfully asked me not to fiddle with the switches. I immediately apologized and said I was not going to do it again, after which the little man cried, "you have to move". I said I would like to move, but unfortunately  I was standing in line to use the restroom. The little man replied that I was being "aggressive", although I was being anything but, as even the waiter acknowledged. I did proceed to go into the bathroom, finding upon my return that my party had been served the bill. We proceeded to pay said bill, which was over $85 per person (this is definitely not a cheap place). Still the little man felt resentful towards my person and requested that I vacate the premises, although I honestly, really, cannot explain why this was the case. This prima donna of a "manager" had something against me and was refusing to explain himself, letting me feeling extremely flustered and embarrassed. Anyhow, this is my opinion: very nice place, great food, great beer, although overpriced. And when you have to deal with unreasonable, unprofessional "management", it's just not worth it.
Portion is too small. I had a steak and it tasted really good. Just that portion is really little that we have to go to another pastry shop afterwards.

Had dinner here on tuesday night with my best friend! Overall I had to say the food was good. We started off with an appetizer (spinach and artichoke dip). It came on a wooden plate with thinly sliced baguettes. I thought it was good, the bread was a bit hard but I think it went well with the cheesy dip. My friend ordered the burger and I ordered the prosciutto and goat cheese sandwich. She really liked her burger and I thought her fries were good. I would definitely recommend trying the sandwich, sometimes prosciutto can be overpowering (because of the salt content) but I really liked how it tasted. In addition, typically the side salad isn't much to talk about but I loved the dressing and how the salad wasn't swimming in dressing. Our waitress was very sweet and attentive! Although we didn't drink, they have quite a selection of wine to choose from. Also they have a deal on wine on tuesdays so if you're looking to get a drink you should stop by. They also do have a bar on the other half of the restaurant.

Best restaurant in the city, even for non-steak lovers. The food (we were a party of four and had many dishes) was perfect, so get whatever you want.  The service was amazing, very professional and attentive without being overbearing or even, knowing that they were, there. Go here now!!!!

Authentic as it comes.  Designed for the desi palate!  Ask them to spice it up!  The flavors are delicate and has a home made touch to it.  The lamb saag is a must.  So is the Kadhi!  The shahi paneer is brilliant.  The Aloo Gobi is spicy and delicious. The best Gulab Jamun that I have eaten in a long time.  None of the top layer coming of separate like most Gits made fakes.  You must try the Rasmalai - top draw! You cannot go wrong with this place.

I am a regular business traveler to Yale and I was eager to try this new restaurant.  Disappointing.  Part of the dining experience is good service so that one can relax and enjoy the meal. I arrived around 4 pm so it was definitely not busy. I wanted to start off with a cup of hot tea to take the chill off after walking from a nearby hotel.  While it was delivered in a nice warm pot,  I had to ask twice for lemon and three times for sweetener so that by the time I actually got to drink it, it was lukewarm at best.  I decided to use my fork to stir it rather than ask for a spoon.  The entree, tagliarini bolognese, arrived and I had to ask for bread....twice.  The entree was mediocre (I hate to say this but it reminded me of canned Chef Boyardee) but the pasta, itself, was cooked to perfection.  Portions are very large and the pricing very reasonable.  I would definitely give this restaurant a second try.  Next time I'll go with the pizza and hope for a different wait person.  And please consider a pasta spoon for the dishes that need to be twirled unless my wait person forgot that too.

My favorite Thai spot in philly. Awesome family staff that is sweet and helpful. Delicious food that smashed it's closeby competition. Affordable and a pretty big menu. Super cheap lunch specials. Check em out.

This is my usual pho restaurant. I will usually pay extra for the "rare meat"/sliced steak as opposed to the typical sliced flank, & I always order it uncooked/on the side, as opposed to it already cooking/well done in the soup. If I'm feeling particularly fat, then I'll also ask for a small bowl of "oiled onions/scallions"(not sure of the English translation of it) to fatten up my bowl of steak pho! :D The only reason that I did not give this (or most other Asian restaurants) the full five stars is because of the MSG that's used in most Asian restaurants. If I can ever find a restaurants that cooks like my parents (no MSG), then I will consider giving it five stars.
AMAZING!!!! It was just as if it came out of my Grandmothers Kitchen!!! Everything was just incredible! Can't wait to return . Thank you for an incredible meal!

We stopped in late-night for a drink and some deviled eggs. The eggs were really good - I wish I could have them again, but for brunch. The french fries were matchstick-thin and delicious, with fried garlic and rosemary and LOADS of salt. So much salt, I felt pruney. The place is expensive but I'm told to go back for the burgers. I'll definitely try again as long as the wait isn't too long.
So yum! But sometimes because its so busy its hard to get staff attention and also you feel a bit rushed. Cool young spot though.. Love the decor and food just melts in your mouth..
Fabulous burgers.

We stopped in late-night for a drink and some deviled eggs. The eggs were really good - I wish I could have them again, but for brunch. The french fries were matchstick-thin and delicious, with fried garlic and rosemary and LOADS of salt. So much salt, I felt pruney. The place is expensive but I'm told to go back for the burgers. I'll definitely try again as long as the wait isn't too long.

Ever since reading April Bloomfields book, "a girl and her pig", I've wanted to dine here. After walking the Highline we stopped in for lunch and had a great one! The pub is perfect and the staff was terrific. Next time we're in this City, we will be back!

The food is amazing!  I must say we eat out alot and Butcher Bar has the best pulled pork and ribs I've had in my life.  If you like spicy, Try the spicy habanero sauce.   I am so glad they expanded their location.  The new ambiance has a very cool vibe.  The friendly staff and service really puts this restaurant at 5 stars.  I highyly reccomend you try it out.  It is an easy walk from the 30th avenue subway.

You cannot come here without eating at least 3 slices of Sicilian pizza I usually cannot eat this much of anything EXCEPt this pizza I can eat it forever and it's always fresh best place in Brooklyn hands down anddddd their regular pizza is really good too but Sicilian is the way to go
Juicy skirt steak and a fried egg on Sullivan St ciabatta. What's not to love?  A couple of tables added since my last visit. Good move!  I'll be back.
Very good place! The only thing I dislike is their light beer.

I have had it with this restaurant and its horrendous service!!!  We keep giving them a break for a month or two and then giving them another chance.  They forget meals, screw up meals, and have horrible service! We were there with our kids Monday night.  We sat at a table for 10 minutes and no one came over to welcome us, give is menus or even say hello!  Finally after 10 min I put my jacket on, finally someone came over and said sorry we are extremely understaffed and I guess your leaving.  I said yes and they said see Ya!  Not I'm sorry please stay, nothing!  They should be embarrassed and obviously have horrible management.  It's too bad as this place has so much potential.
my favorite place to sit at the bar, order pizza from next door (owned by the same people), and drink delicious house red from the tap. great service too.
Love this place, never disappoints and again Kayla you're a sweetheart, thank you we had a great time!!

This Is my favorite Asian restaurant in Manhattan. I travel from Yonkers once a week for the delicious food, i tried every single item from menu in last year and there is no bad dish in this restaurant. sometimes it is busy in there but I never waited  more than 20 minutes to be seated. The friendly and professional stuff is always on the high level. my favorite dish by far is their house special pho.
Perhaps I am so fond of the traditional kongfu style (小籠包) and my expectation was too high. Kind of disappointed when I really tried it. But generally a good place for some food.
Delicious all the food was great thanksgiving balls are better than the blue balls and the pork chop is to die for our waiter was the best and come to find out one of the owners definitely a must try
Awesome authentic Panamanian restaurant!  Easy train ride from Manhattan. Super nice owner and atmosphere. Reasonably priced. We will be back!

It's the only Chinese place in Claremont that delivers so I tried it and I was very satisfied. The food was hot, fresh and very delicious. I think it's actually the best Chinese place in town and they delivered at the time they said they would.

Unfortunately my family had a terrible experience at this restaurant.  It looks like it could be decent on a less busy night, but this was not the case for us.  We did have a reservation and only had to wait about 10 minutes past our reservation time, which wasn't too bad.  The temperature in the restaurant was so hot that it was unbearable and the people were packed in so tightly that it was uncomfortable.  Our waiter told us that it would be about a 35 minute wait for our entrees, which we were okay with.  We ended up waiting 2 hours for our entrees which we were not okay with.  When we finally spoke to the manager/owner he was very condescending and not very nice.  He did take some money off our bill, but it did not make up for the uncomfortable atmosphere, very long wait and just so-so food.  Needless to say, we will not be going back.

the perfect spot for ramen on a cold day. Excellent choices. I suggest adding an egg into whatever you're getting. Hot sauces available for anyone who needs it spicy. Vegetarian options are delicious as well. There will be a wait - it is worth it. Super casual environment.

Definitely one of the more interesting takes on Ramen I've experienced in NYC. The food was delicious and very rich! Me and a few friends were accomadated and served our food in a decent time. The sake was amazing as well. We will definitely come back soon!

Best chicken broth ramen I have ever had. The wait can be long here but I got seated quickly because I was rolling solo. I got the tuna sashimi which was amazing and a bowl of the chicken broth ramen and both were amazing. I avoided the spicy stuff but I know a lot of people like it. The buns also looked good but my stomach is not that big, yet. Try to get a seat at the bar to see the chefs in action. There may or may not be a blow torch used in prep.

That pizza with the egg was sooooo yummy in my tummy. The fried green tomatoes were so good and there was like a small salad on the dish. The dressing was delish. I hated their wings they had a sweet, cinnamon taste n they were undercooked. Beers were great and cool atmosphere.
If I could eat this everyday, I would. BEST DUMPLINGS IN THE CITY. Everything else is nothing when compared to Prosperity!
Excellent quiche
The hostess  and sever was so rude to our party. The food is great. Dec.12,2014.... Terrible service!!!!

Loved the short rib, but wasn't a fan of the credit card fraud.  A group of 15 of us came here for a birthday and about half of us had our credit card numbers stolen and used in the Bronx exactly a week later - this is the only place we had been together all at once in months, so the process of elimination led us back here pretty quickly.  If you're in the mood for a great short rib with a side of identity theft, this is your place! Otherwise, I suggest you look elsewhere.
The best soup dumplings I've ever had. Very fast service and incredibly affordable. Definitely recommend it to anyone!

Great pizza & staff!  Everyone was sweet & the brick oven combined w/Byob is wonderful!  1st time here. Cozy. Clean & the Pizza was amazing. (We had the margherita & arugula) & Will definitely be back!
The best food day and night! No matter what time you go, service is always great! Not expensive, and very largely portioned meals, so you get more than what you paid for!

For the reviews I read, I didn't find it a great place. Its Very Small N cramped. Nex to our table, ther were a bunch of ladies who were way too loud. It annoyed me and my bf a lot. We didn't find the ambience tht grt. We wanted to get done n leave soon. Its a very pricey restaurant. The cocktails nt sure why, is way expensive too. The Indian cuisine they offer is decent nthng exceptional. They have a very few items on their menu. Needless to say, I wnt b Visiting agn.
Amazing. Went here while visiting NY. The closest to can get to Italy. For a moment I forgot I was in NY. Food also excellent.

Our work department was out to dinner at the Oyster House last night for food and drinks to celebrate the upcoming holidays.  Unfortunately, three of us (out of ten) came down with a nasty case of food poisoning.  We suspect that it might have been the fried clams since none of us ate the same entrees, but we did all share the clams around the table.   From a non-biased opinion, I thought that the decor and service at the restaurant was great and definitely felt modern and cozy, all at the same time.  The only complaint that I have is that some of us ended up sick not long after leaving.  My advice is -- please check your clam inventory and/or the sauces that were served with them.  My main focus is ensuring that no one else gets sick, too!
Excellent food really nice place. The best thing about Vincent's is the wonderful service.

The food and atmosphere are both fair/good. I have been here a few times and each time have had some issue with the service and last night kept up the trend. The food is not worth the hassle that comes with the service and if there is a next time, I will stick with just drinks but sadly you still have to interact with the staff who do not seem to be interested in the place succeeding. Good beer options and a great space with potential to be more than it is.

Being a San Franciscan I've been spoiled by chicken and waffles from a number of places. But here in the LES Sweet Chick takes a new spin with awesome signature waffles and chicken recipes. You have to try the Parmesan Chicken and Waffles!

We had a great dinner to celebrate my wife's birthday yesterday (December 17, 2014) and had a great meal !!! We met Nancy (one the the managers) and talked to her for a few minutes about what  the plans were for this new restaurant.  She was the best - friendly, sincere and engaging to get our input.   The ingredients used were about the freshest I've tasted in all the recent Thai food we have eaten in the past few years (and we eat alot of Thai food)  Also, the quantity of food was very good and the prices were reasonable. As our daughters live close to Xiandu, we will be back many times when we visit them.  I have a feeling that this is one of those restaurants that will grow just by word of mouth.  Hopefully when we come back, we can get a good seat.   If you love Thai Food, you will absolutely love Xiandu !!!!! One more thing - Brian, the waiter, was excellent.  He was also a standup comic - as he told us a few jokes.
Great food, highly recommend, my friends and I like them for a girls night out. The salad bar is amazing and they always have great drinks. Definitely recommend making a reservation.

Great food at very reasonable prices.  The owner is very courteous and helpful. My son's fave is Butter Chicken and Naan. Love the different Kebab dishes.  So good.  We always stop in when we are in the area. Its Franklin Park NOT Kendall Park.

We have been to Cielo several times when it was located on 8th Ave. it was great.  Tonight we went there (at the Mayfair Hotel) for dinner-BIG MISTAKE! The food was mediocre and the service was TERRIBLE! The waitress was rude, slammed the dishes on the table, not attentive, and tried to rush us out from the very beginning of the meal. I was embarrassed in front of friends that had joined us for dinner. You know what they say--"Screw me once shame on you-screw me twice shame on me". We won't be going back!
I love the backed claims and authentic pasta dishes. Very happy I found this place!
Came here for a work holiday party. The calamari and penne pasta with garlic were delicious.  Not sure about the price but it was worth it.

Not too bad but a little bit over hyped.
