I've had a few different kinds of pizza's over there's now and unless I tell them I want the pizza half baked I end up getting pizza with burnt crust which is apparently how it normally is. oddly enough I found that their pizza cold is in fact the best cold pizza I've ever had. The price though isn't really worth it as everything cost almost double what you'd pay anywhere else even if you get just cheese.
I loved it.  I am picky about my pizza and was a bit skeptical.  I am not a fan of the famous New Haven style (read burned) pizza, but this was wonderful.  Will definitely go back

MINDBLOWING!!! Perfect cocktails. You know as soon as you see the beautiful menu (which is apparently the most expensive menu ever made) you're in for a treat. The cocktails are perfection!!! Jessie & Jillian are true artists. This is more than a meal/drink - it's an experience. TRULY THE BEST BAR IN THE WORLD!!!

I was working in the area and saw this place while walking by and decided to try it out.  it is absolutely A.M.A.Z.I.N.G. Great food (you can't be in a rush; it will take time), nice portions, visually appealing dishes, good service, delicious natural juices, affordable prices for such quality... You name it.  I don't live in Staten Island but I gotta go back there!

There were 15 of us going here for a Christmas lunch. It was excellent. The waitress was spot on, the food was delicious, and the place was clean and welcoming. It was great to be able to make a reservation and have real pub food instead of the microwaved dreck at the Chili's type places. We will see you again Grasshopper Too!

I worked with the owner victor to create an awesome ambiance and menu for my staff party and the guys at the restaurant were more than accommodating to our every need!!!! It was PERFECT!!!! I hope this will be  our annual holiday dinner! They are so nice and I can't wait to go and eat there delicious skirt steak! Raved reviews on that

Ordered delivery breakfast at 7:40 am waited roughly and hour and a half and still no food. So I called at 9:00 am asking where was my order and the answer I received was we sent it out and the driver is late. 9:40 am still no delivery so I called and cancel my order. Used a credit card and was never refunded my money back. Currently disputing the charge and will not be ordering again.
Would give 5 but what about Wifi???? How am I supposed to snapchat selfies of how good I look without cell phone service or wifi? On the bright side, right around the corner

Love the apps First our sever Marc, was fantastic.  He never misses a beat.  You need to see this guy pour a glass of wine.  You have to go during Happy Hour.  Half price wines, great apps and a wonderful atmosphere.!

Service was pretty good. Came to have prime rib and they only had medium well. And well done Ordered NY strip and the cut of meat I got was below par. Wasn't at all what I expected. I think it was frozen.. Wasn't cooked very well and didn't have any flavors. Ordered stuffed mushroom appetizer and they were sub par. Caesarsalad appetizer was good Bread was good. Restrooms were on the dirty side. Staff was also on the dirty side. Touching faces after coming out of kitchen, pulling up pants, head resting on food tray while carrying out trays, etc. Hostess was on phone texting when we came in. "Stuffed" shrimp was not good. Larger shrimp pieces with breading and butter along with other baby shrimp pieces surrounding the larger pieces. I wouldn't come back to this place.

I used to go to the old store and the hand drawn noodles with the tasty broth made it unforgettable. After it was moved to the current address, I've tried a couple times which were OK. However after today's visit, I will not come again. The hand drawn noodles were cooked in advance n they just put the beef n broth in the bowl, the watered down broth became warm n not tasty at all. The noodles are clumped together from being cooked in advance. They are supposed to cook the noodles right before they serve. If I can leave zero stars I would!

The food here is amazing!  Authentic Haitian  cuisine, which is absolutely delicious.  In addition to the Haitian cooking, the owner also carries delicious Jamaican patties. .. wait, it gets better!  Ice cream, they really have ice cream and it delicious!  My favorite is the strawberry cheesecake flavor... yummy!!!!!

Alva was great! We had the mussels and the short rib entree. The mussels were plump and the short ribs were tender and delicious with a yummy sauce. The service was excellent. This was such a surprise gem to find in Newark, but I would definitely recommend it!
One of my favorite places in the neighborhood. The pasta is freshly made. My favorite Veal Milanese is the best. Good wine selection. Overall recommended.

The worst Italian ever!and I am Italian, so I can judge every single details! food was made in a cheap way that you can see they were trying to save money (little portions, or too little sauce on the pasta) but charging you as it was a fancy place. actually when you looked at the menu at the first place you could think that this is a convenient place to eat, but after you realize how they do that. I ordered also one appetizer that was mistakenly written in the menu, so I receive half of the ingredient s indicated.I asked and they even did not apologize to me at all! in addition we waited 2h to be served!!!the service was awful, owner and servant were more busy to chat than to take care about us! I felt ashamed to be Italian! horrible experience

Not quite sure what the big deal is about Pok Pok. The ambience is fun. Service was friendly. The menu had such promise and I had heard such good things but the food was not particularly spicy or flavorful, the signature wings were kind of dry, the desserts were so-so - all around, a kind of disappointing meal and on par with the quality of most of the average, neighborhood Thai places I have tried. Not quite the special meal with family I was hoping for.
I dream about this place.

This place is sucks, the service is also sucks, very expensive, food do not have taste at all, I ordered Homos and falafel combo, the taste very smellier to anything except Homos and Falafel, and Also I order Tea with ment, it was horrible. Beside all that we order desert called Konafeh, and they bring to us totally different desert and they insist it's what we order. while we are there, there was a big group of student, they had another bad experience like they missed up with there bills and there order. we were 4 people, we had bad experience and we do not recommend anyone to go there, I'm not sure how this kind of restaurant can service tell now with this kind of service.

We went there based on reviews on Yelp & it was disappointing. The service was great & the staff was super friendly & nice ambiance. Based on reviews I expected old style Italian but it wasn't fresh or good. I had image of old family restaurant, which it seems to be but I don't think cooking that made name for place or quality is same. My first clue was cold bread- that is always a sign to me. Plus it wasn't like a fresh loaf, just store bought sliced bread. The salad had brown lettuce & even though doused in dressing you could tell. They took it off as we sent back but why would you serve that? The pasta sauce was not fresh, tasted like from a can & pasta was overcooked. I was so disappointed as Yelp usually leads me right, but after reading these reviews I am led to believe most have never eaten good Italian food? I don't need fancy just wanted good old style Italian but it wasn't good. Mostly I feel let down by Yelp & think next time I will search other sources or get suggestion from friend.

Great service.   I have been to all the ct usual and this place stands tall among the legends.   In fact, my crew of 6 thought this pizza blew the legends away.  Chewy crust with a hint of char, very good sauce, excellent fresh cheese and loads of toppings.   Great job.  Kudos to Henry our server!
I gave it 2 stars cause it's just alright. Not the best Falafels in the city and I wish the pittas were a bit thinner so not the best especially if your trying to eat less carbs.

Stay away. FAR FAR AWAY. Our pizza arrived cold, it was not the first time either.  After a wait time of over an hour. (Not the first time either) When I called to complain the manager was rude, didn't want to give me a credit and instead offered to deliver another pie. I refused the pie as I was not willing to wait for another hour for another cold pie. I told him that I wanted a credit as this was not the first time I had to call and complain about a cold pizza, he flat out refused so I told him I would never order again and would post a negative review on yelp, he proceeded to yell at me and say that "this is what I get when I order from Harrison"... Seriously? It's a 5 minute drive from my house... Mr. Nino's this is what you get for being plain ol terrible to your costumers!  YOU SUCK and so does your pizza!
Love this place. Second time coming within a week. Foods great. Especially the red velvet waffles with vanilla cream cheese. Awesome service!

Where do I start to explain my wonderful experience...  The host was very nice, bartender very nice and waiter, very nice!!!  Drinks were good and food was EXCELLENT!  The roasted cauliflower was AMAZING!!!  We had the grilled fish and scallops, both very good!  The desert was also good.  We paid just under $100 for each of us and we both had a drink, app, main and desert.  Good deal for the quality!!!

We had a totally ridiculous and extremely frustrating experience with La Fonda. Craving Mexican food and seeing the 6 or 7 five stars we decided to order promptly. It was about 10.30 am but the website said it opened at nine so we tried calling the restaurant many times. To no avail. We did get a person on the line at our 5th or so try, but she hung up on us before we could even say hello. After a few more tries, we finally got through to a person/voice. I asked if I could order takeout and was told 'hang on a minute' and was transferred to another person (maybe someone who spoke english?). She told us they were closed. I asked when they opened and she said 'i don't know'. I asked if they would be open at all today and she said 'i don't know'. i started asking another question and she hung up abruptly mid-sentence. I have no idea why this went down the way it did, but it sure dampened my enthusiasm for trying the food. After this 'experience'/treatment it will take a lot for us to try Teresita again. Especially given all the other incredibly delicious mexican restaurants in this area.

We thought that due to the crowds and long line that this place was going to be great. However, their coffee was some of the worst I have ever had. It was bitter and disgusting. The line was long but it moved very fast. The cashier was very friendly but the other workers were rude and annoyed. The system for delivering your drink is unorganized so it just ends up being the workers yelling out different orders until someone claims it. Also, they didn't have vanilla syrup which seems like it should be a staple at any coffee shop.
Heard it was worth walking a few blocks out of our way for, and we heard right! Very tiny place (walked past it once before finding it), a well-stocked baked goods counter, and excellent coffee.

The good: nice décor, great concept, simple menu The bad: turkey burger was undercooked and mushy, greens of the mesclun salad wilted! The ugly: over thirty minutes wait for two burgers... on a Thursday night, and not that busy...Luckily we did not have to go to the movies... Our food server never came once by our table to let us know what was going on... I I understand it is a new restaurant so I will give it another try, because there is some serious potential there

Visited with the family (4 children) on a Friday night.  It was very quiet in the restaurant.  We were the first group to sit and only two others say the entire time we were there.  There was a healthy take-out business though.   The restaurant is very clean and nicely decorated. We sat at a large coffee table with a nice sofa and some interesting chairs.   Ordering is at the register. The choices are many.  My wife and I really enjoyed the clam chowder and house salad (mesclun with blue cheese and bacon!).  We each had a panini (Cubano and the Steak).  Both were very good.  The kids had a grilled ham and cheese, pizza and chicken nuggets. The kids food was excellent and $4 each (including drink and side).  What a deal!  Restaurant is BYO and has wine glasses, cork screws, frosted mugs and buckets of ice!   The staff was very nice. Food was brought to the table and tables were bussed.   We find it to be a great place to get a high quality meal at a reasonable price in a comfortable setting.  Will definitely be back!

I wish I could give no stars, but to officailly give a review I am required to give at least 1. My coworker and I decided to walk 10 blocks north for lunch today to treat ourselves to some comfort food on this cold winter day. We got there and realized that it was basically a food stand that you order from and then wait outside for the food to be ready. Kinda annoying, but ok. So we order from this guy, who will barely open with window for me to order through (annoying), and he can't hear me (maybe open the window???) so he keeps making me repeat my order over and over.  Anywho, we order a classic and the buffalo blue with a side of tots. We wait....and wait...and wait... and then people who ordered their food after us, get their food...and we are still waiting....and waiting.... and 25 mins go by. Then our order is finally ready.......we look in the bag and notice that the tots are missing. And so we tell them, "Hey, we ordered tots" to which the guy responds "NO they are in there." To which we then show him they are not, and then he finally takes the bag backa nd throws like 5 tots in there. GEE THANKS, MAN. We get back to office and start to eat, and my co-worker who got the buffalo blue alerted me that THERE WAS NO CHEESE ON HER GRILLED CHEESE. WTF, MELT SHOP!??!?! I think your only job is to PUT CHEESE ON THE SANDWHICHES, and you don't even do that?! So disappointing. I am not really sure what the hold up was. There were like 8 people working in the back, not really doing a whole lot except making grilled cheese boxes. There really wasnt even a line. The workers just did not care at all, and for that I wil not return.  I'll just stick with Schnippers for grilled cheese at lunch!

I like Centro a lot.  The atmosphere/ ambiance is great.  The food is decent, but  not amazing.  Some dishes are better than others to be sure.  Overall, the menu is overpriced in my opinion, as are the drinks from the bar.  I get that you pay for atmosphere, but not this much.  Service, like the food is hit or miss.  I've had some good waiters and bartenders and some that are mediocre, who can't answer questions about drinks or menu items.  I still go to Centro from time to time despite these misgivings do to the fact that it's one of the few restaurants in Robbinsville.

This restaurant is just awesome.  From the high quality delicious menu to the amazing staff (including their chef who cares so much and is passionate about what she does!), I can't say enough.  Every time I come it's just a pleasant experience and I would highly recommend to anyone.  It's not often you come across a restaurant that cares so much about the integrity of the food they put into the menu!  Great prices, great happy hour...what more do you want for some incredible aussie food?  One of my favorite spots in Astoria:).

Well I came to Saigon Pho, for the first time today, and although I only had to things the were both very good. I had the Beef Satay as an appetizer $6.95, it was good it came on a skewer and served with a sauce, the beef was really tender and had good flavor. Then I had a large Rare Beef Pho, which is a soup with clear noodles, some aromatics and the beef; its served with a side dish of shoots, and sliced jalapeños. I really enjoyed it. It was different. The restaurant itself is very tastefully done, they did a nice job.
Never a disappointment! My go to for Mac n Cheese - Salmon Benedict - Truffle Fries!

Amazing food, great service, great experience. Im from New York, but found myself in Connecticut looking for a good place to eat. Was driving around in circles, and found myself in the parking lot, so i chose to eat here. Was definitely happy, and will be returning if i find myself in the area again!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Been eating here for years. Normally we order food and I pick up. I have never had a bad experience. When we do eat there it is usually with another family and our crazy kids! They are always accommodating lol! I have tried most of the pizza they make, always order a chicken/shrimp parm when we go there. Great stuff!

I grew up on hoagie haven, this place blows that s**thole out of the water!!!  Best subs, wraps, breakfast around... The pancakes are huge and my fat a** could barely finish... Also they have the best homemade hot sauce, very hot with huge flavor... The menu continues to grow, they now have a vegetarian menu which is just delicious... You must go and try everything, hot and cold!!!  One more thing the chili is the best I have ever had, I always get the chili... Even in 100 degree weather!!!

If you know Sunset Park then you're aware it's nearly impossible to get an artisan, bistro-y type experience with food in this neighborhood - until now. This cafe is as new-school Brooklyn as it guests for SP. Serving breakfast lunch and dinner, they also  brew La Colombe coffee and the pastries are fantastic, too. I'm first going to tell you that YES, everything is yummy. Dinner items are all very good. But lunch menu items are uninspired and have a greasiness to them. I wish there were more "healthy" options available. Quality of ingredients: If you're going to charge Williamsburg bistro prices you'd better NOT be serving GMO produce, farm-raised carcinogenic fish patties or hormonal proteins. The recipes and creativity is on point, I just wish they'd step up their game when it comes to quality of ingredients. I've noticed a bit of a decline in the consistency of quality, overall, too. I hope they tend to this. As for the coffee - and this goes for anyone serving coffee - If you're going to sell iced coffee just prepare and sell cold brew. Everyone is aware that if all you're doing is brewing hot coffee then icing it later the customer is getting ripped off if you're charging the BK standard of $3-4 a cup. If Zona Sur would switch their iced coffee to cold brew, sans a price increase since they just raised it anyway, that would be great. All in all, it's a good place when you need to eat something in SP and don't feel like hitting up a food truck. The staff are friendly and welcoming. Looking forward to seeing what they do after reading this review.
Love this place,  they are incredibly friendly and everyone always smiling.  My 4 year old always has such a great time and the food is great as well! !

We were made to wait 30 min and even then the table was not set up. The hostess was condescending and did not even apologize. Even after that, only 6 out of 8 of us were seated because two earlier guests never left and the restaurant would not ask them to leave because they were 'chef's friends'. The food is great and the service is good but this is unacceptable.

I'm a little biased. This place has a huge and honest GF selection for my Celiac-inflicted boyfriend, but even if that weren't an issue the food is mighty tasty and the drinks are sticky-sweet and somehow appropriate on a rainy Friday night. So glad this place exists.

I really like the atmosphere here.  Recently I was here and had a great cup of soup and sandwich but it is pretty pricey and you can eat the same food at the actual restaurants represented in the market for much less money without the crown.   Although expensive, if you have a lot of indecisive people or people who can not agree on what to eat, this is where to go, you can get anything you want and everyone can have a different type of food!  Great shops and specialty places are also here.
I don't think there is another spot in Philly that makes me more proud to be a Philadelphia. This place has everything delicious you'd ever want and a charming crowded market feel.

This is my favorite place to go & make up a meal to cook as I go. Fresh meats, breads,fruits & veggies and cheese galore. It's pretty much always busy so be ready for a crowd, but so worth it! A Philly treasure!
I order delivery from this place sometimes. It's aight but usually super slow.
Love this place!  Portions are a little small,  but with the prices you can totally oder more and try everything!  Great ambiance and just a beautiful layout!

They really shouldn't limit the name to just pig as the beef, chicken, and even mussels are all just as fantastic here. The restaurant has a great charming British pub or cottage feel and even with the large number of tables, expect a long wait. They don't take reservations so get in right at the opening and get your name in. The beer and wine lists are great and have many interesting inclusions. The spotted pig biter was great with the legions of meat.
Thet have the best fries I ever had. The burger is awesome. The atmosphere is British pub meets the village. Bartenders are really good and they have a nice cask beer.

I really wanted to like this place. It was on my vegetarian list of places to try for over a year and I finally made it there. Had the bean soup, sweet plantains and veggie arepa.  Really plain and lacking pizzazz and rather pricy at $30. I feel like if I had ordered a meat dish I may have been happier. A very nice place but if your looking for outstanding vegetarian food there are much better choices in the city considering they pop up as a good vegetarian option.

Started working in the area in September, find my self dining there every day! Even on my days off I'm driving there from Maplewood! The ironic thing is have 2 Chinese restaurants on my block but the friendly sincere service along with fresh Tasty food has me hooked dumplings are fresh and handmade on the premises! One word Delish!

This was what I was craving for! Yummy, delicious dumplings! The place was packed and super busy but our wait was not long. We were seated with other parties at a big table. The food came out pretty quickly and totally satisfied my appetite. The dumplings were very good and definitely second to no other. The only downside is this was a cash only restaurant. Secondly there is another place that have a very similar name so make sure you visit the right one.
I'm pretty sure they just put crack in everything. And I will lick every last drop of burger.

Came here to celebrate my graduation and ohhh myyy goooddd their Heavenly Chocolate Soufflé is absolutely cosmic.  It is beyond heavenly! The Soufflé is out of this world! Not only was dessert amazing, but the appetizers were also delish!  Everything was made fresh and served relatively quickly.  If I had an entree it would've probably been equally amazing!  On top of that the servers were really nice and the waitress described the menu in depth.  The staff was very open and welcoming and on top of it all we met the two owners and they were the sweetest people ever!   They genuinely cared about us as people and as customers and they even answered all the questions my sisters asked about their food. I was seriously impressed with this place. It was a bit dark but other than that they had a nice ambiance.  Totally going back!  :D

The place was packed when we got there but the wait wasn't that bad. The waitress seemed a little lost and she could've been a little more attentive but she was the only waitress for the entire place so it's understandable. We had a breakfast sandwich and an potato egg and cheese wrap and they were both delicious. Defiantly recommend this place.
Da bes

Absolutely amazing, plentiful, delicious food.  Service is efficient and friendly. The wait can be lengthy since they don't take reservations, but enjoy the free wine they supply waiting customers, outside and in. Our faves:  octopus appetizer, fried cheese, peasant salad, broiled scallops, sardines (yes, there are bones, but fillet those suckers and have at them, carefully, they're amazing), LEMON POTATOES. We always take home leftovers, and it's all great the second time around, too. Completely reasonable prices.  Go there!  GO THERE RIGHT NOW!

Great spot in Forest Hills.  It's tucked right underneath the LIRR station. Great selection of beers which includes huge selections of IPAs. Whiskey is also their specialty. Food was delicious as well. The one negative I have for this place is that it gets very crowded during after work hours and the place is a bit small so it can be tough to get seating there during busy hours.

Stuffed crab appetizer-AMAZING!!! Bread - freaking fresh as it gets!!!! Seafood was steamed to perfection very tasty 2 gripes - WAY to much food portions are good for 2-3 people 2nd gripe - to much rice literally about 1lb with my dinner
This place will be the end of me. I used to order the michelada all the time but I don't know where it went. Fried chicken FTW

There's a reason people always say that you can only get a real Philly Chesesteak sandwich in Philly  And John's is the best of the best according to locals. They fold in the cheese and onions on the grill - superb.

I was staying at the hotel right beside this restaurant in Korea Town NYC and decided to give it a try.  It seemed to be busy and the yelp reviews seemed relatively high so my GF and I gave it a shot.  We are used to very well priced Korean food in Toronto (usually $8 for a Bibimbap and $11 for a bulgogi meal is the norm) that is always delicious and well made.  I suppose the Bloor/Christie area had us spoiled after trying this place out. First of all we were rushed to our seat and we sat beside all the chefs and waiters who were eating and very loud.  The server came buy about 3-5 times before we were ready to take our order and we felt a bit rushed.  The menu is EXTREMELY expensive for what you get as a Bibimbap can get up to $30US and a Bulgogi meal for one person is about $30US as well.  You get a small selection of side dishes, but they won't come by to refill them unless you ask them.  That is if you can find a waiter that is paying attention. When we received our order of Bulgogi, it was tiny and about less than 10 thinly sliced pieces of meat.  Even the bowl of rice which we shared was only about 1/10th the size of the bowls that the chefs and waiters were eating beside us.  Korean rice bowls are small enough and to only have the rice go about half way is fairly cheap in my opinion. As soon as we finished out last bite of paper thin meat, we were rushed with the bill as they wanted to get us out of there.  I paid the bill and proceeded to leave, still waiting for my refill of water which never came. Overall the meal cost us about as much as it would have to eat at a fine dining establishment in NYC.  For this type of meal in Toronto, we would probably be paying around $20 for two people, but in NYC it cost about 4-5 times as much.  Needless to say we won't be coming back.
Waited an hour for delivery, which wouldn't be a big deal if the meal wasn't a gelatinous mess of way overcooked pasta swimming in salty sauce. Ugh.
food, service and ambience are all excellent, without making diners feel stuffy.  one of the best values in town, I think.
Once again, AMAZING!  Never a bad meal!  And their Sangria...  SO GOOD!!!  Will return time after time.

We ate there last night. We were an impossible group of 10. We were treated pretty well but really, I don't go out to chat with the waiters. The food was perfect. My only minor complaint was the two bottles of dessert wine we didn't drink. That was a waste. But I would go back in a heartbeat. They deserve the 3 stars!

This place is around the corner from me, so I had to check it out. first time, get a falafel, not bad, but not great. Second time, get a gyro. Take one bite- pickles and cabbage. I don't know where the owners are from, or what type of sick concoction this is- but under no circumstances should there ever be pickles or cabbage anywhere near a gyro. I eat it because I'm a poor college kid, but felt thoroughly betrayed by my food. Some months go by, I say to myself "lets give this place another chance." This time I wisely order my gyro without pickles or cabbage, because the rest wasn't that bad last time. The place was packed and it took me a good 15 minutes to get my gyro. I finally escape the sweatbox of an interior that place has, and start heading home. I decide to unwrap my sandwich from the foil and take one bite. Pickles. Cabbage. what the hell. I didn't want to go back in because the guy at the register was already surly enough. Will not be returning there, three trips is three too many. How can a Mediterranean food place mess up a gyro?

I wish this review could include a review of the food....but we never got that far. I offered to schedule our office holiday lunch. Although 1 of my co-workers did not have a good experience (Slow service) on her last visit, since we work in EH and I'm from EH, I decided to give them a chance.  I made reservations for lunch @ 11:45 today, through Yelp. This morning I received a reminder text, from yelp. We walk into the restaurant, but there's no hostess. So I walk into the bar area to ask the bartender for help. Her reply was that she had a party schedule at 12 and 12:30. I explained that I had a reservation for 4 @ 11:45 and even received a reminder text. She asked "from Yelp??  I really wish people wouldn't use that!"  OK.....so what does that mean? She said she had no server, but we could sit at the bar, if we wanted to. We're having an office holiday lunch - you don't sit around a bar!  Turned around walked out and went across the street to Margaritas.  Wonderful food and service.  Of course that was after I heard "I told you so!" from the co-worker that already had a poor experience. I would've thought she'd seat us at a table, bring us drinks, put our food order in at which time the server would've been on duty and could've taken over from there. There were only about 10 people in the place....IDK, but, figure it out! Don't turn people away!  Extremely rude, poor service - doesn't matter how good your food is if people can't be served!

Coming here with a Groupon, we have no complaints. We had the 8pm seating and we could have stayed for the 10pm if we wanted. The food and drinks were ok. The music was good considering we were in NJ. I would say about 80% of the people in attendance had a Groupon offer. The service was also acceptable. When my fiance called to make the reservations we were nicely reminded that the Groupon offer did not include the tip. Apparently folks who come with a Groupon do not tip!! C'mon folks you're getting a Jazz band with food and drinks for a fraction of the cost if you traveled to NYC, so the least you can do is leave a tip!!
Fried chicken sandwich with picked tomato was the best!

I just left, and am in a cab as I'm writing this. Everything was great until they told me they were cutting me off. Despite the fact that I was there less than colleagues and drank less than colleagues I was told I would not be served anymore. I don't know if it had to do with the fact that I ordered for others or the fact that I had recently lost my voice- but either way I was mortified. Even when I had a conversation with the manager in which I explained that I had ordered drinks for others, lost my voice, and only had 2 drinks she told me she could not serve me for my own safety. This is the most embarrassing experience I've ever had.

Ate here a couple of says ago and I got food poisoning from this place. My friend and I believe it was their soup we had because she felt queasy after eating it as well. I think they left the soup out for too long that it was not set to the right temperature. Spent the days puking. And also they have a lot of fruit flies that when two of them went inside my drink. You better think twice before coming to this place, you might end up getting sick!
Food was not that great.  Ordered the oxtail and chicken and both were very mediocre at best.
The owner is down to earth. Made sure we have everything we want and how we wanted it. Definitely going back
It was great pizza but I was expecting something phenomenal. Inconvenient that they didn't take credit cards. Overall great place.

Waitresses are rude and mean. and the noodles are too oily. The pork topping is sooooooo soso flavor that doesn't deserve the time we wait and the money for it. DO NOT  WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY on this restaurant because their good marketing!

Cute tapas place to meet up with friends. Nice wine list offering and menu choices seemed to have something for the most finicky eater. It could get a bit loud as it gets busy later in the evening. Service was great!

This place is disgusting. There was hair on our tea and when we asked the server to change our tea, he was so mad and annoyed at us as if we did something stupid in the restaurant. I'm never going back here again.
100% fantastic. I love the tasting menu. Meat on meat on meat.

Wow this was so bad. We were in the area and decided to stop for breakfast after seeing a commercial with a dancing singing pancake for Chip's and decided to give it a shot. First off- it's ugly inside and cash only, should've been first clue to leave but for some reason we stayed. We ordered banana pancakes and I was in the mood for lunch which is served all day... It should never be served at any time though. The worst, dryest most burnt and disgusting sandwich I've ever personally had, and I'm not being dramatic this was an embarrassment. The pancakes were extremely mediocre, yikes. Kudos to their marketing team for an entertaining commercial, and probably some third party unofficial rating as "CT's Best Pancakes." Stay away at all costs.. Service pretty blah as well.

Everyone goes gaga over the crispy okra and the pani puri so decided to try it. The okra was decent but the pani puri was a major disappointment to an indian. I found this bar to be extremely expensive for serving run of the mill food which you can get for 1/3rd the price at other indian restaurants. The drink i ordered also was not as boozy as i expected so that was also a disappointment. Had heard a lot of good things about it but don't think their food or drinks make sense to my indian tastebuds.

On my first real trip to Philly, I knew that I had to try a cheesesteak and my friends had recommended Pat's to me.  People had warned me that people are a bit "gruff" in Philly, so I didn't really anticipate a wonderful customer experience, but I was a little shocked that they spent so much of their time attempting to be rude and brief with people that they messed up orders since they didn't take the time to listen.  They gave us the wrong cheese on our sandwich, but it wasn't worth correcting the error, so we moved on and figured it would do.  We ended up with the cheese steak with cheese whiz (the traditional way).

Epic. Life changing. Exhilarating. Eating a Pat's Cheese Steak with Cheese Wiz is like dying and going to heaven. Why even bother going to Geno's... that would be truly un-American! Oh, but may avoid Pat's King of Steaks at night. You did watch the intro to Fresh Prince right?

Going to visit your son in Philly requires the cheesesteak thing so where better to get the immersion experience than Passyunk Ave where you find both Geno's and Pat's. We chose Pat's. The fare is about typical PCS which is as good as that specialty gets, but the other fun feature of the visit was the faux abuse we get when the order taker detects our southern accents when we say "wit" indicating the inclusion of onions and white cheese. Of course we have to counter abuse back which results in the employee coming out to join us during his break and have a big time joking around. All in all a memorable time at an iconic American fast foodery and the steak was as good as any.

A good sandwich, a better history and story, and open 24 hours. get wit.. Great for a 3 am craving and fun to take out of town guests to because of the lore. I may have to make a run now... see you there! Be prepared to eat at the tables located outside under cover.
Pat is the best Philly steak place, there rolls are fresh and the steak is cooked to order. This has got to be the best cheese Steak in the world order it WIT and provolone that's how I like it.
Delicious mexican food. The taste and quality of the food was really good. Ended up going back to the same place for that reason. Service was good but the music was a little too loud.

Two of us went to El Vez at the recommendation of our hotel front desk clerk. The restaurant was vibrant and full on a Monday night. They were very accommodating and our wait, without reservations, was quick. We shared the guacamole - which is a house specialty and should not be missed. It was creamy and a bit spicy -- just right. We shared the seabass tacos but after taking one bite, I really did not want to share them anymore. They are on the smaller side and just right for lighter appetites or people who've just ate their body weight in chips & guac. we also shared the mixed enchiladas which were 3 - one shrimp, one chicken and one black bean. All were terrific and this was way more than enough food for two. margaritas were great and service was attentive but not smothering. I would definitely go back to El Vez when I am in Philly again.

I never write reviews unless it was really good...or really bad.  There was NOTHING that I tried that I didn't like.  The kindness of everyone that works there is a rare find.  The atmosphere is nice.  It's not noisy like you may imagine it would be.  The food was EXCELLENT!  I highly recommend the blood orange margaritas (these are the only margaritas I've liked) and El Vez cake cannot be neglected from mentioning.  Excellent choice for anyone looking for good Mexican cuisine.

Are there recently with a group of 8 people and everyone loved it. The restaurant is hoping and a great scene. The food is great! The guacamole sampler was awesome and they kept bringing out refills of their chips. Excellent margaritas as you would expect! I'm traditional but they had some fun varieties. Service was really great. With a large..

Three stars because the people there are very nice otherwise I would have rated them a two. I ordered a simple sandwich, a sausage parm.  I've had them at many places and this is the only place I've had that it's a hybrid sausage parm/sausage peppers & onions. It seems to me they cook one batch for either sandwich, a bit lazy I think.

Zen in Livingston is our go-to sushi restaurant. We've visited dozens locally but still come back to Zen. Rolls are quite large compared to others. Even NYC sushi spots get a run for their money in terms of quality and variety and at 3x the price usually. Let's be clear, Zen is not cheap either but you get a better bang for you buck here. We eat in and get take out often. Excellent quality either way. BYOB at the restaurant and there's a liquor store a couple of doors down in the same strip mall.

I was surprised - I went with some friends, and expected it to be pricy. It was actually very reasonable, and the food was great! The ordering process is a little strange - it's halfway between fast food and restaurant - but it works well for a large group, while still maintaining an air of class.
Love this place !!  Everyone is always friendly and smiley and so wonderful 4 year old! !  The foods is great too! !!!
A-OK
Great food , great service that's priced right, will be back !
the bartender was amazing. the chicken was perfect. a great atmosphere. can't wait to come back
Great meal, great service. Lobster Risotto, Hangar Steak. Yummy!  Beer was fresh and cold! 8 of us and every plate was empty.  Thanks!

Italian food, Japanese, French and Mexican are my favorite foods. And whenever I find a GREAT Mexican Cantina that's lots of fine with really good inexpensive Mexican food then there is no reason to go anywhere else -- but Cantina Dos Segundos. That's the way I feel about Cantina Dos Segundos. Si, es muy bueno!   The food is always great and the margaritas, if you're nice to the waiters (slip them an extra $$$$) can give you a quick buzz and are delightful! The only thing they are missing are Mariachis. The bartender is awesome and the staff is wonderful and the waiters are so Northern Liberties COOL!
this is the indian restaurent..which i  really want..everything is asowome..

It's a shame this place doesn't get more attention on Yelp, I have never had a fresher tastier sandwich anywhere else. This place has been around for quite a while, and for a good reason. The staff is kind, capable, and always happy to serve and like I said before their food is to die for. Counting down the days until my next visit!

In reading this review know that I don't love fish. If I eat fish it needs to be super-fresh and not taste like fish. So when I say that I loved the ceviche here it's a big deal for me. And I loved it, and intend to love it again sometime soon. I just hope it's not as insanely loud and crowded next time!
Great dishes, went here for my bday and loved all the flavors.

The food isn't bad but just don't try to call in an order and expect it to be ready when you get there. They do not even start cooking your order until you get there and pay. What was suppose to be a quick stop ended up taking over a 1/2 hour. And that is after the original 20 minutes they give you to come pick it up.

Usually I don't spend this much on ramen but what the hell right? I was able to get a reservation at 8pm for 4 on a Friday night after much practice of my re-dail-foo. My party ordered all 4 appetizers and I really liked them all. The "okonomiyaki" was my favorite due to the sweet and salty flavor. It was scallions in an 'american' pancake  batter but salty due to the trout! I had the mu ramen which had a very full and rich broth. The noodles were the perfect texture for the broth and their attempt at the sous vide egg was much better than my own! I tried the spicy miso and that had a much bolder flavor than mu ramen. It wasn't spicy in the sense of 'need to wash this down with something else', but spicy in taste. I would definitely come back just for the appetizers again! I also recommend bar seating if you like watching the chefs do their thing.

Excellent noodle restaurant in the heart of Chinatown! To cool down during Summer, try the cold shaved pig ears. They have a great crunch to them and are well marinated. Then heat up with a bowl of noodles. I doubt you need any more food than that but the stir fried noodles and boiled dumplings are equally great fillers.
a must eat for anyone who may find themselves traveling through Philly.

I leave very close to Mood and it is one of my favorite places in West Philly. The Salad Chaat is my fave and it's even better when you add chicken. The rice pudding they keep in the fridges opposite of the counter is killer.

the food here was pretty good overall. I don't ever try French food very often. But I though I would try something different for a change. I did like the crossants for the most part but they were just a tiny bit dry, sorry to admit! The service there was just okay,though some of the staff there were not as friendly as other plcaes I've been.. not rude, just not really friendly either. The 1 thing that makes this place not quite a 5 star would be the bathroom. It was kind of dirty and smelled when I went in there, and that's kind of a big issue for me. Clean enviroments, especially places serving food is an absolute MUST. It can sometimes be the difference between whether people come back or not, and based on that alone I dont know if I would.Between a 3 star and 4 stars, I guess I'll be generous and give 4 stars.. in light of the holidays season

I was excited to try this place based on the reviews but was very disappointed. I waited close to an hour for my food - I ordered the lamb saag-and then when it finally arrived, it was barely like warm. As I write this I am hoping I don't have to wait another hour for my check. It is not looking good.

Something is definitely wrong..such highly rated place...I believe some worker is messing with the owner..I called asking to speak to the owner and some guy with a Spanish accent laughed at me and my friend ..He picks up the phone saying 'what you want' and then hangs up. ...I asked to have the owner call me bakc and no one has. .spoke to a man named Bogdan he took a message but owner never called back. ..Also I called twice today and both times the cleaning guy laughed at me and hung up ...saying that if I want to speak to the owner I need to come down there....so weird I'm buffled....All I wanted is to make reservation.for 10 people....geeee

Ordered food for my work from here and it was delicious. Everyone enjoyed it and I really loved everything! ! Especially the causa and the empanadas.  Although the causa was spicy which I don't eat I didn't want to stop! Yumm!!! The empanadas are so different than those that I've tried.
I loved this place!  The calamari, shrimp and corn was great! This is a perfect place to go with a group of friends and enjoy a meal!

We've gone to Massimo's for years, both for take out and dine in. For the most part, it's been pretty reliable. Not amazing, but decent and mostly consistent. But the last time we got take out it was horrible. Buffalo wings we ordered we actually mozzarella sticks, which they realized before I left. They replaced them with "buffalo wings" which I didn't realize until I got home were not buffalo wings, just breaded wings without buffalo sauce on them. They also had a rather strong fishy taste. Even the kids wanted nothing to do with them. Pizza was poor, we got half sausage half plain, sausage was almost non-existent, pizza was overcooked and just seemed "flimsy". Again, even the kids wanted nothing to do with it. Service for take out was also poor and surly. The curly haired guy who is always there needs to not curse so much with his co-workers when customers are there. Maybe a bad night for them but I am not in a hurry to go back, especially with so many other options.
The Soho Squares is the best interpretation of sicilian style pizza -- personal favorite is the Spicy Spring, where the pepperoni is cooked to absolute perfection. This place is no joke.

This place is awesome! They have great service and make us feel like part of the family. The owner is always around and he's so nice. The food is delicious and they make sure you have a great time. The service is impeccable and the portions are awesome. If you come to little Italy, make sure you come by here.

I went with a group of friends for dinner to Cookshop and loved it - It was nothing ridiculously exceptional, but maybe it's just that their brunch is better. The service was honestly kind of awkward - we had two waitresses who would just come up to our table and stand there, and I was put off a bit. Anyway, the place has a cozy ambiance and dim lighting, so perfect for a small get-together with friends or a date. Their bread basket is HUGE (so obviously this place is an automatic 4-stars) with focaccia that could give any Hell's Kitchen Italian place a run for its money. The cocktails are trendy and unique - I ordered a ginger apricot margarita, which was decent but not anything to call home about. My friends got the mojitos and they looked pretty good. We started with the pumpkin gnocchi which is to DIE for if you like that kind of thing. It melts in your mouth and the sauce was perfect to dip the bread in (which is all that matters). For my main course I got the meatloaf, which I LOVED. I was a little skeptical, partly because I don't think I've ever ordered meatloaf in a restaurant before, but it came on top of cauliflower in this tomato bisque and was a little spicy but not too overwhelming. The cauliflower was actually incredible and made me feel super healthy because this tomato sauce could have easily been paired with some hearty pasta. We were so stuffed from our bread refills and dinners, but I definitely need to go back for the desserts - there's something called a Chocolate Deliciousness on the menu (no kidding). Overall hands down one of the best dinners I've had in the area, and definitely coming back for brunch.

We went and I was hoping to find that the not so great reviews were nothing but I too fall into this status.  While the staff was very nice my party of 4 did not find the food to be anything spectacular.  The polenta fries were very bland and the main courses were nothing to rave about. The dishes are made to sound and look sophisticated but fall short of being an amazingly delicious meal.

On a recommendation I went here with 2 friends on a Tuesday night.  We arrived at around 8 and although the place was basically full we were sat quite promptly. The decor was great. I loved the chandeliers and the bare wooden tables were also sharp looking. We sat in the room to the right which looks like we were sitting in someone's house... A feeling I like from restaurants. I love beer and they had 10 taps and the selection was very thought out. It was my first taste of this years Sierra Nevada Celebration and it was awesome.  The service although busy was adequate.  We never waited long for anything and sometimes a server not being so overbearing is welcomed. One of my friends is a vegetarian and Arianne made a special pasta dish for him as they were out of the ravioli special.  Food was great.. crabcake app was perfect. We had some mushroom app that was addicting.  We ordered that for the vegetarian but I think I ate most of it. I had the pork chop which is now in my top 3 pork chops of all time.  My other friend had the chicken pot pie. It wasn't as expected but the quality of the chicken was top notch. Very rarely am I blown away by grilled chicken but the juiciness and freshness of this dish was memorable.  It's hard to mess up dessert and they didn't.  All in all a great place that I am sure is still working out the kinks of being new but I will 100% be back.

Great food - horrible service! The food here is amazing. We all had something different, and it was all delicious. The coffee is also wonderful! It was flavorful and reasonably priced for all of the food we were getting! However the service was absolutely terrible. It was not busy when we went, but yet our server continually kept messing something up up. I'm not sure if she was new, but she 1. forgot to place our order and made us wait for 45 minutes for our food. When we asked, she lied to us saying some of our dishes "take longer to make." Meanwhile everyone else at the restaurant were getting their food in under 10 minutes. The table next to us got the same dishes in about 15 minutes. When we asked for refills of our coffee or water, she would come back 10 minutes later with our refills. Nothing was speedy. 2. She ended up messing up our check 3 times, after making us wait for 15 minutes just to get the check. There were only 4 of us, and there was nothing complicated about our order, she just kept confusing the other tables and giving us the incorrect bill. 3. I had a groupon and she had to take my phone to use the groupon code. She forgot to give me my phone back, and when I went to ask for it, she told me she misplaced it and that it is "somewhere back there." She had me and the other waiters looking for it for 5 minutes before it finally showed up. I wish I could give this place 5 stars, because the food is truly 5 stars. However, the service could only be rated as 1 or 2 stars.

Went to Raymond's for breakfast with high expectations coming from Yelp but was disappointed. I was in the mood for some simple diner fare, but the food prep was executed poorly. My order: Eggs scrambled with cheddar cheese, potatoes, an english muffin, a side of bacon and coffee. The eggs were the only thing to be served well and came out well done. the potatoes were on the edge of uncooked, the english muffin was barely toasted and almost cold, the bacon was very very done, not burnt but was like eating pork rinds. The coffee tasted burnt. It may be that the items exclusive to Raymond's are better (such as the chorizo cheese grits), but missing the staples and being charged an arm and a leg for it left me with a bad taste in my mouth. The service was average, nothing bad to note.

Went there for our holiday work party. The person who set up the party couldn't make it and there had been miscommunication but the staff and owner were beyond accommodating to meet the needs of our diverse staff. Everybody was real friendly, the food was absolutely delicious, and the place was decorated beautifully for the Holidays.

Last night, 9 of us had an expensive dinner at Metro North.  They placed our table in the bar area and the noise was so loud, we literally had to shout to talk to the persons on either side of us.  Then, they would not give us separate checks.  I told the manager that, considering the discomfort of all the VERY loud noise, they should accommodate us with the checks, but he walked away from me.  The food was very good, but the venue was like a sports bar in full swing!  I would never recommend this restaurant to anyone that wanted to carry on a quiet, intelligent conversation and in normal tones.  There are plenty of restaurants with excellent food and a quiet environment.  Why they did not give us a table in the actual dining room, which is separate from the bar, is beyond me.

Great food, great service, great price. No complaints. Some might complain that it is small but thats a positive for a business like this, in my opinion. Great sushi and hibachi and its BYOB. Also, they always have dels on groupon (going on 2 yrs now) and always have coupons in local magazines. Worth checking out

I use to come to this place a while back and they would really be around to serve some quality meat.  Last night, December 19, 2014, 8 of us ate rodizio. The rodizio skewers that kept coming around were mostly chicken and sausage, then sirloin, when requested. The sirloin that passed around, had the texture of liver with a liver-like taste. It was really disappointing. I had to ask 4 times for a quality piece of meat. The only good quality piece of meat that came around for the hefty price tag of 30.00 was skirt steaks, nothing else (with a mere inch piece per person). Afterwards we went out and about to another town for drinks; 3 people left due to stomach aches! Happy holidays. The service was good, but really if we pay 30.00 a person for rodizio, please do not try to fill our stomachs with chicken, sausage, rice, beans and bringing the best of meats out per my request. I have to say this was really disappointing and I will not come back considering the other options. Lost the love for this place. :(

Of all the Viet restaurants i've tried this is definitely the best place if you want a big warm bowl of pho or a rice dish!  The service isn't the best but they are very quick when it comes to serving up the food and is at a very good price.
Shrimp & Chicken Gumbo; Shrimp & Grits; Triple Chocolate Brownie - DELICIOUS!!! Service - EXCELLENT!!! Don't need to say anything else except you should eat here!!!!!
One of the very few places I can order new things because I know that whatever I order will be absolutely delicious. I LOVE this place.

I got excited to hear that a new soul food place is in Jersey City.  Despite the rough looking exterior we went in.  The older lady was very rude...Advice learn how to speak to customers. ..bad attitude made us leave before the food came.

Food was good but for an 8pm reservation we were given our table 840pm. What's even better is that we got a 6 seater for an 8 people table. It's gets better, the hostess told us that she can't ask a 2 seater table next to us to leave so we should hover around them to pressure them to leave!! Expect a long wait, bad service from the hostess and good food. Food worth 4 stars.

Great Victorian holiday ambiance. Ornate and decorative. The staff are a little tightly wound; I brought in outside food and drink. It was immediately brought to my attention that neither were allowed. I politely requested that I be able to eat my food, especially since I was with a party of five who were going to indulge in alcoholic drinks. The manager stepped in and relayed the same information that the waiter did. I put my food away and ordered off the menu. I was the only one in my party to order food, which took 30 minutes to arrive - much longer than my party cared to sit and drink. I can't bring my own food but if I order off the menu, my party and I are held hostage by the wait of my order? My mistake was thinking it was a dive bar in which I could sneak a bite of my own meal while my comrades ordered drinks. Not that kind of place.

I haven't written a review in a very long time because most of my dinning experiences lately have been moderate to good.  So, really nothing to write about.  Koi, on the other hand, deserves special attention because it fits most diner's criteria for a terrible restaurant; (i) bad food, (ii) bad service, and (iii) no liquor license.  At least with a liquor license a diner can order a drink to forget about the bad food and bad service.  We went on a Friday night.  Chinese restaurant on a Friday night -- probably busy, right?  It was, but there was only one waitress running around.  She got support later in the night but the wait staff was entirely ineffective.  There were four of us so, naturally, our entrees came out at three separate times, 15 minutes apart.  (Sarcasm here)  Oh, and the waitress got our order wrong.  Instead of apologizing, after the third stage of our dinner arrived, the waitress asked, "would you like anything else."  Really?  When I asked, "Really?," she looked like a deer in headlights.  Maybe she thought customers don't mind being served the wrong order over a 45 minute period.  Oh, did I mention the food was terrible.  The broccoli with the General Tao's - still frozen.  The sushi appetizer - not edible.  (The waitress didn't ask why almost all of the sushi was still on the plate when she came to take away the plate.  I don't think she cared.)  The miso soup - like chalk.  When we told the waitress that we ordered spicy beef, not chicken, she proceeded to throw the serving spoon from the chicken dish on my plate and walk away rather angry.  She came back a few minutes later to say we were "right" and we ordered beef.  Did she really need to check and then come back and tell the customers they were correct?  There is always a silver lining.  We went to Carvel, next door, and had great service and delicious ice cream!
stay away!!  worst place to eat anywhere on plante earth. No one to ask what's going on. No manager on site. 1 hour to get coffee.  Overall awfully experience.

Awesome place! I went for a date here a few weeks back and it was one of the most romantic dates ever. We both were pretty full from lunch, so we just ordered pizza and wine. The pizza had the most delicately baked crust I have ever had and really well cooked toppings. The ambience is perfect for a romantic evening together, with minimal lighting and beautiful candles on every table and an old worldly charm around you. The price is a bit on the higher side, but compared to how costly the rest of New York City is and what a great experience it was, it was totally worth it.
Nice atmosphere. Had dinner and drinks by the fireplace. Another time we sat in the garden. Food was good, drinks were good. Good vibe. It's not a five star place, but a solid four.
For American, this place is really nice, but for Vietnamese like me, the food is not authentic. If you want true Vietnamese food that might not suit the American taste, don't go here.

I just moved here from Los Angeles, have been visiting Lebanon for a few years and had heard about Gusanoz. The locals never had anything great to say about it aside from them having good salsa. I showed up, and the first thing I heard was blaring Salsa music. My first thought was, if a Mexican owns this place, they have to be from El D.F. Sure enough they are originally near Chilangolandia, A.K.A. The Federal District of Mexico. I had ordered a two taco plate with black beans and rice. First off, who ever made those beans must have had Parkinson's with the salt Shaker. The Salt mines of North Africa had less salt than these beans. The Mexican rice was ooook. The tacos were not asada, but steak, which is cool. Overall the food was ooook. With the two tacos, beans, rice and one beer, a Pacifico, which is a basic Mexican beer, like a Coors of Mexico, the total was 23 dollars. Even in L.A. would you never see a place like Gusanoz this expensive. I asked the bar tender why the prices were this high, his response was that patrons complained they were too cheap. I call bullshit on that or the patrons are blatant idiots. Their menu also gave a definition to the word Gusanoz. Their definition was a Spanish definition as one from Spain,  of Mexico. In Mexico, a gusano is a worm, be it a earth worm, a maggot or any form of worm. Not something you would associate with food. You would associate it with tequila, but the worm in the bottle was not a Mexican idea but an American idea. It would also seem that this place has gone through several renovations to keep it a float. There is only so many holes you can patch on a sinking boat before you just give up on it. Most of the people who post positive reviews seem like they are friends with the owners or friends helping a dying dream. In conclusion, if you want to spend tons of money for sub par Mexican food, come here and get reamed for your money.

Went for my birthday,we were seated in a front room that was freezing. They had one space heater which did nothing,because as soon as the front door opened ,in rushed the cold air. After complaining,they brought in 2 small other heater units,but by this time we were eating with our coats on and our food got cold quickly. I ordered a ziti  baked dish that was  watery and flat tasting. We ordered a meatball panini and noted the meatballs to be fatty and the sauce just ok. service was fair but we had to ask to change tables due to window draft even though we told them it was cold there.Don't plan on returning.  Also parking difficult to find.

I give this place negative three stars. We paid $121.00 dollars for two tacos, guacamole, chili, and four margaritas. If you want to pay 16 dollars for one fish taco and inedible rice and beans you should come here. I literally spit the rice in a napkin as inconspicuous as possible, it was so disgusting. Deconstructed mole sauce?! Buzz words restaurants throw around ten years ago...I should of known better. Guacamole made with brown avocados at the table by your waitress with a potato masher. Stale tostada chips that were made yesterday on the side. When you start thinking, I could make better Mexican food at home, you know you made a bad decision. Be sure to order a few margaritas to help soften the sticker shock of the bill.This is the most expensive terrible Mexican food you will ever have. Mezcal is just up the street skip this place and go pay less for better Mexican food.

Cute restaurant but don't be fooled. The restaurant was warm and welcoming but that quickly changed when we walked in. This place was crowded and no one knew where the line was to order. When we finally ordered, the cashier clearly didn't act like she knew what she was doing. We ordered a black coffee and a iced black tea. The cashier looked confused and asked if we really wanted ice in the tea repeatedly. We also ordered the avocado smash but we can't tell you how it tastes because we never received it. The iced tea didn't even have any ice in it and it was lukewarm. We ended up having to refund our order. We're never going there again.

Here is a letter than I wrote to the company regarding how I was treated. 12/20/2014 To Whom it May Concern, Hello, My name is Troy Cummings. My wife, daughter, and I went to your location at 304 Elm Street in New Haven today which is 12/20/14. We are very unhappy with how we were treated and would like some clarification on why this happened. We are both working people with income to eat out , and decided to try your place after we found that our normal brunch place, Box 63, did not open until 11AM. We liked the way the place looked and had been wanting to eat there. My wife ordered an omelette and I ordered a waffle. According to the receipt which I still have a copy of, this was at 10:19AM. My wife's food came out in 5 minutes, but my waffle had not arrived yet. About 15 minutes after my wife had starting eating, she asked where my food was. The person at the counter told her that it was taking a while because they could only make 4 waffles at a time. We continued to wait. After another 10 minutes we were still waiting. She asked again. We were told that it was coming soon. I have made waffles at home, and I was surprised that this was taking so long. I am a patient person, but then we started to realize that other people who showed up after us were getting their waffles. I finally went to ask for the manager, and this is where things escalated. I spoke with the manager, and my biggest concern was the continuous "non answer" from her. I explained that we ordered our food at 10:19AM, and it was now 11AM with no food. There was no empathy. I asked her why was I skipped and she told me that she would check on my order. I asked her again due to the non answer, and she kept repeating that she had to check first. After checking her answer was that everything was in sequential order. Once again, she chose not to answer my question. I asked again if I was skipped and does it normally take 40 minutes to make food here. She told me I could either take the food or get a refund. I told her I wanted a refund. Even though my wife paid with a credit card, the manager gave us $6.52 cash. To make things worse, upon handing me the money, she turned around to walk away and all of my money fell on the floor. I had to pick money up off the floor of your establishment. At this point I was pretty upset. There was no yelling, but I knew that what could have simply been poor customer service was now going to be a full on complaint. After we packed our daughter up and left, we went to the Apple store to do some Christmas shopping. Afterwards, I went back to your store to ask for the manager's name. When I asked her she said, "Why?" I told her that I was going to contact corporate regarding this. She smirked and said that you guys had no corporate office. I told her that I was writing to your website. She then said that I could just say that she was the manager and did not know what my problem was. I hope you can see my frustration. I also want it to be very clear, I expect a response back from someone regarding this. I will post my experience on Yelp and Foursquare. To make sure that you give me a response, I will also post the contents of this on your Facebook wall. My wife also has concerns that certain characteristics of how I look played a factor, but I am willing to pretend that I do not agree as long as you take the proper action. Lastly, I have a job, and I pay my bills on time. I am not requesting money, I am not requesting a gift card. I am not even requesting that I be treated better the next time I am there since I will never dine there again. I am demanding respect, and how you handle this will go a long way in saving yourself further headaches. Thank you. Sincerely, Troy Cummings
Amazing traditional Italian pizza restaurant. Pies are great and prices are good too. My wife and I had the antipasta and '16 plain pizza. You can't beat Jersey pizza!
Could not have been better sushi or better service . Drinks were different and delicious . Sushi was honestly best In the area . Would recommend to anyone looking for an upscale experience.

Great concept. Get seated, scan boarding pass, order beer & food, chill out while the iPad alerts you on boarding time. Problem is the service is unbearably slow. Saw a customer get up to look for someone to clean the table. I waited 20 min just for 1 beer, and a customer next to me whispered sarcastically,"Brace yourself! Try to get drunk, or you'll get frustrated."

Atmosphere upscale yet casual; great for family or couple who appreciate great food.   Portions were large and food quality was excellent.  The carbonara was possibly the best I ever had.   My husbands steak came with full plate: asparagus potato croquette & beautiful large mushroom cap.   This place is not close to home, but we can't wait to go back.
Had an awesome breakfast. Will defiantly come back and recommend this TriBeCa gem!! Awesome service also.

To be honest this place deserves a 0. My girlfriend and I came into the restaurant at 9:30 and they told us we had about an hour wait. We waited for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Well that is first and second when we were about to pay, we put the credit card in the receipt book (where you put ur cash or card) and a minute later the waitress comes and says that no card was left. First of all I do no understand how a card can get lost within a minute. On top of that it was my birthday, so you could imagine how I was feeling. We are never coming back here again. It's enough waiting that we had to wait 2 hours and fifteen minutes but my girlfriend had to call the card company to cancel her card, which actually took less time then waited to be seated in that restaurant! I recommend no one to go to this place!!
Love this place!!! Good food, fast service!! Faster than you would expect!!  Calamari and fried green beans all day long!!!!!!!!!!!!
Very good food, excellent drinks and great service! Will definitely come back here and I recommend this place to anyone. Very affordable, you will have a great time. :-)
Decent specials at this place, I frequent wing night on Mondays. Steaks look fantastic, drink are alright. Affordable place for a good time to watch the game, whatever you're into.

Very disappointed. Two pizzas and a salad--$$56 bucks! including their "old smokey"- shoulda been called "old salty ", truly inedible!- and we eat anything! At least the beer takeout store across the street is excellent.

they make amazing food.. ive tried pretty much everything and have never been disappointed.. the staff is nice, only thing that stinks is the parking, that is why i took away a star.. its on a very busy street so finding parking is never fun.. but the food is worth it.. trust me...

Been a couple of times good experience just opened overall they are working out a few kinks but the pizzas are decent.  Clean new place... friendly... helpful.  Mussels are awesome (get the 900 degree ones-the others are just average).  They have some Italian dinners as well but have not tried yet.  Great addition to the area.
Won't deliver outside of walking distance.  Hard to call yourself a true delivery service otherwise.

Dank ass raw sausage. It was so soft and mushy that I instantly gagged. Ruined the rest of the already semi gross food for me. Nothing felt right after that. Loud icky people at the table next to me were also awful. Just. Awful.
Slow service. Average food. Sausage was raw. Asked for things and never got it. Burnt coffee. Loud patrons at the next table were. The. Worst. Ever.

This is one of my favorite spots in Manhattan.  The food is off the hook and they have a lot of vegetarian options.  It is a small place, so don't try and go there with too many people.  The only downside is that the bathroom is down stairs, not great accessibility....
Great food , super service , and very friendly staff! Close to 95 exit 42! Place is super clean too
A neighborhood favorite - the fried chicken continues to be one of the best in Brooklyn. Knowledgeable and friendly staff - we are very grateful for Walters!

Good comfort food. The mushroom gravy smothered chicken is excellent.  The burger is also good (although it had more pickles on it than I expected), as is the mushroom mac and cheese. Large portion sizes.

Thirty (30!) minute wait to be seated past our reservation.  15 minute wait for a cup of coffee.  Arrived cold.  Food was unimpressive,  Overcooked poached eggs.  Greasy bacon.  Uncomfortable chairs!!! (can't be understated).  Friendly staff but not attuned to their customers.  Host was very kind and even apologetic, but waiter was on scripted hipster autopilot and completely tuned out.  Won't soon return.
it was a nice romantic dinner, the place is lovely and the food pretty much organic, great taste and good size of meal

Been here several times, sometimes when it's a small crowd not such a long wait for food. The food  I would consider very good for a "quick" meal, however the last couple times I have been  I almost got ill waiting so long for the food I was ready to leave without it. Not worth the wait, considering it's not cheap and there are plenty of great options in Burlington.
We spent two hours and a half on the train to learn they close at 8, not 9 as mentioned on Yelp and Google reviews.
La pizza es increíble!!!! La sangría es deliciosa! Las meatballs también son buenísimas!!

This is a small noodle shop. There are about 12 seats at the counter and 3 tables there. I believe you will have to wait at any time of the day, I waited about 30 minutes in the rain. There is a sign up sheet and you will have to go through waiting people to sign your name. I choose a spicy noodle and it was worth the wait. Each noodle was between $11 and $13. I thought it was reasonable in New York City, but they only accept cash. Most of the staff are Japanese and truly great Japanese noodle shop. I will visit again when I come back to New York.

the perfect spot for ramen on a cold day. Excellent choices. I suggest adding an egg into whatever you're getting. Hot sauces available for anyone who needs it spicy. Vegetarian options are delicious as well. There will be a wait - it is worth it. Super casual environment.
Ambiance is fantastic, the lights were a dim red & music playing in the background. Great spot for a date, great wine selection.

Read a review of Pine restaurant in New Hampshire Magazine and decided to give it a try when in Hanover in the evening for Revels. The waitstaff were numerous and very attentive, starting from when we entered the restaurant. I found the interesting combination of  textures and materials in the decor  pleasing. The several "snacks" we ordered were innovative and very tasty. When we asked to split a salad, which was excellent, there was no hesitation. My wife's pan-seared scallops were cooked perfectly. My duck confit with the kitchen-made fresh fettuccine was superb. The dining room manager stopped by our table several times, checking on how things were and taking away used dishes. I also encountered the inn/restaurant's general manager, making his rounds through the dining area. Obviously, the entire staff is working hard at making this operation a success. Without qualification, we think Pine is with the top restaurants in New Hampshire, counted on five fingers.
Nice chicken, good taste good price. The owners are very kind people. Recommand if you wanna have a quick meal right after visiting the independence square:)

My second bad review for this place. I ordered 3 shots and my bill came out to $36.69... when I asked for an itemized receipt they told me they could not print one... they then proceeded to tell me that they over-charged me and could not void out the ~$10 that was over-charged. My options were to either order another shot or to have a $10 "credit" they would keep in the cash register for when I came in at a later date... RIDICULOUS. Friends ordered Dogfish Head and they were $10 for a 12 oz.

Have you ever gone to a restaurant and felt you were an inconvenience to the wait staff?! I think the number of hipster beards seems to be compensating for their lack of personality. wundergroundmusic.com/75… Dont sit on the bar!

Just got back from my first time at Luca's. Cannot say enough about it. Everything was fantastic! Our waiter was very professional and knowledgeable and described all our dishes in great detail. The bread basket was a goodc starter. The prosciutto wrapped figs and fried mozzarella appetizers were awesome. The chocolate stuffed (with butternut squash)  agnolotti was indescribable! If you are a chocolate and pasta lover this is nirvana!  The other main courses were equally delicious. The marscapone cannoli drizzled with orange zest was the perfect end to a perfect evening. I highly recommend Luca's.

Huge disappointment the food was okay the service was deplorable we were seated quickly by a totally disinterested hostess the waitress came over left our menus and we never saw her again 20 minutes later my husband had to go ask another employee if he could take her order and was told no , we had to break his chops and he finally did and he checked on us once during the entire meal too bad , we were looking forward to having a good time but will not be returning.
This is the best place in Philadelphia to get a cheesesteak I always go cheese wiz wit onions

Cheap, open 24/7, great menu (plantain chips are amazing) and while it is tiny, the turn around is quick and they're accommodating for groups. It's a lovely late night place to grab drinks and good food :)

I think negative reviews are usually unfair to restaurants because, you know, everyone has bad days. Or, maybe you ordered something that you actually don't like and took it out on the restaurant. Food poisoning is something I don't excuse, however. I ordered eggs here and while they tasted great at the time, sure enough a few hours later my stomach was in knots and I was vomiting. I will never go here again and if you do, I hope you have a stronger stomach than I do.

First experience was last night, great atmosphere and the wait staff was responsive and friendly. Would have liked to have a little more to my meal but the guacamole was amazing! Would definitely go again!

We arrived early for lunch and got seated right away.  Our server was AWESOME!!!  She made food and drink recommendations, which were excellent.  The food and service was terrific!!!  Can't wait to go back the next time we visit Philly!!!
The pad Thai is very good and the service is fast. One of the best places for Thai food in the area. I wish they were on grub hub!
Absolutely love them!! Go here for happy hour all the time. They have the best drinks and great appetizers. Never dissapointed

So went to Mikes for dinner.... It's dead.... Took waitress 20 mins to take order..... 15 mins later... Comes over to ask what we wanted..... We walked out..... She was hammered ....so sad that we were the only ones at a table and 3 people in the bar and we could not get served ...The topper was when she said..... Please don't leave just remind me again what you wanted because I am backed up.... With what??
Was there for dinner last week and the food and service was outstanding.  It is my understanding that there is a new chef.  His menu has a great variety.
Good service but bad food!
