There are so many people that they are waiting for someone to get up to take your table,  if you are looking for delicious quick burgers this is one of the best!
Really bad case of dry mouth after eating the sandwich.  Would not order from this place again.
amazing brunch. The biscuits and the brioche toast are to die for. Go ready to explode. The wait was not longer than 20 minutes for a party of two on a Sunday around 11am .

I don't think I have had such a poor dining experience in years.   The food is delicious.  I only wish the service matched.  It took an eternity to get every course, including a cocktail.   Our waiter never came back once to ask us how things were, or if we needed anything.  I actually thought after taking our order he went home.    The managers of the restaurant -- I believe that is what they were -- were just as unresponsive.   It took one of them close to 20 minutes to  get us a glass of wine.   Nobody made us feel welcomed.  Nobody seemed to care if we were there or not.   It almost felt like we were imposing -- especially on our "waiter" -- by being there for dinner. I will never go back.

Merry Christmas from the Macedonian Girls!!! Amazing people start with the owner Frank, finish with all employees: Fernando, LJ. all my Beautiful girls!!!! Thank you so much for everything, we really feel like home, good wine, good cocktails, beer. Good people. WE LOVE LILIES!!!!
Amazing food Fabulous strong drinks Low prices I wish they stayed open longer and had more locations in Manhattan. The Thai restaurants in Chelsea and Hells Kitchen can not compare!

What a joy it is to sit down comfortably and enjoy a good meal without being intruded on by obnoxious adolescent music blasting from overhead speakers.  This is very rare nowadays and one of the reasons we keep coming back.  Love their big salads and deserts.  We've never been disappointed at Paul's.
It is really a nice restaurant near doubletree. I have ordered a pasta with salmon, it is yummy! The vileto with mushroom is nice, too. What an amazing Christmas surprise!

Used to be a more fun bar, drinks now are weak and the bartender covered me in ice, a few times. In August 2014 drinks were much better and larger, service has also declined. I don't mind spending 14 bucks a drink if they are good. Other people at the bar complained about their drinks.

I just got back from Eulogy. Our first time here. My boyfriend wanted to take me out on Christmas because I'm sad and we both finally have the same day off. We wanted to go to the Ice Skating Rink on Penns Landing, but it was closed because of the melting ice and weather from yesterday. So my boyfriend and I decided to go here. Since there was so many good reviews, we were close by and my customer from my old job recommended me to come here. Worse mistake never! I never written a review before, but was call for! We decided to sit at the bar downstairs. The bartender took 5 mins to acknowledge us and he keep telling us to wait for him to take our order. It took him 15 mins to take our order.  There was about maybe 8 people at the bar including us. We got there when after everyone else. So they already got their drinks and foods. I ordered St. Bernardus Christmas Ale and my boyfriend ordered the Dirty Ho. The bartender got my beer in 5 mins, but take 10 mins to tell us he don't got the cup for the Dirty Hoe. So my boyfriend order a different beer and Moules Sausage Boursin & Potato Mussels. When we was waiting for him to take our order he was flirting with the waitress. When she came to tell him that a customer is waiting for their check. He made a comment saying she is so cute that he just want to hug her. So unprofessional! When the mussels arrived the waiter guy was about to give us our mussels, but the bartender took it and say it is the couple next to us and gave it to them. The couple gave it back to us and said that my boyfriend and I order first. Not only that he didn't give us any plates, napkins and utensils. My boyfriend and I was already upset about how long the bartender took to take our order and he just made another two more mistakes! We just wanted to enjoy our Holiday so we drank our beer and ate our mussels. The beers is good, but the mussels was bland! While we was eating the waitress came back to get a drink from the bartender. After he made the drink he made another comment to her. He said he like her smile and she should keep smiling. Can I say "sexual harassment"! My boyfriend and I didn't feel welcome here and felt that the bartender was a jerk! So we finish our beer and food and decided to leave. We waited for our check so I decided to go to the restroom and came back. We still didn't get our check. We waited 15 mins for him to give us our check. Since it is Christmas we was going to give the bartender a BIG TIPS, but he just mess it up for himself! I thought bartender is mostly working off of tips, but in his case all he worried about is flirting with the waitress and bossing the waiter around! I've never been to a bar like this and seen my boyfriend so upset! He was so angry that he just wanted to go straight home and didn't even go to the restroom. Even though he really needed to go! Terrible customer service, the mussels was bland and overcooked, and the bartender was very unprofessional!  We was there maybe an hour and it was the worse experience ever! Monks is more busier, but they gave better customer service, foods is better and they was professional! I wish I got that bartender name, but we were to angry and just wanted to leave! Never going back there again! Sorry one STARS for this place! Thanks for ruining our "Christmas Night"!
Awesome service and great food. It's an incredibly friendly restaurant and the owners make you feel part of their family.

Went there last night for an event. The place is really nice and comfortable- I absolutely love what they did with it. Crowd was good, food was delish, and the drinks were great! I recommend this place to anyone looking for a good night out in a great location. The atmosphere is very chillaxed and classy at the same time.
Delicious! Best tasting Thai delivery in New Haven for sure. The staff is super sweet and accommodating to vegans and carnivores alike
This place is the absolute best. Great pub with great food and amazing people that make you feel like family. I highly recommend. Great place to bring friends and clients!

I make pizza, but let me tell you, this place is the best pizza in Jersey. Doesn't try to imitate Napolitan style, or anything different. Solid, greatly made, filling pizza. Surprise, their wings and calamari are really good too. Been going 20 years.

Dead Rabbit is a cocktail bar in the financial district. It's very much a speak easy atmosphere. The drinks are very good but on the pricey side. Try the Scottish Egg appetizer, it's egg with Sausage. The downstairs can be pretty cramped but still a good time. I wish they had a bit more space downstairs at the main bar.

Delivery driver was VERY rude. Delivery was fast, which was great- so fast that they got here 40 minutes before grubhub told me it would be here- so i was in the other room and missed the call by one minute- the driver didn't want to park his car and then gave me an attitude about it. I didn't tip him because he was so rude, and then he called me after he drove away and was like yeah it was supposed to be a cash tip- and i was like yeah i didn't tip you because you were RUDE, he then started yelling something but i didn't hear because i hung up. Afraid to order from here again because of this experience.
Christmas diner was excellent!
Cool place, crowed people, great service and awesome food in certain Japanese style. Hanging with friends and late night food.
it was a terrible experience. the food was over cooked, which made the sea food rubbery and tasteless. the Sangria tasted bland.

Had dinner there last Saturday and was blown away!  We had a party of five and and asked the chef to serve away. We started with the sardines; light and lemony and perfectly fishy! Empanadas were delicious, crispy, and flaky, Olives were great, and the Endive salad was crunchy and sweet, the perfect accompaniment for what was to come!. The Burrata was also superb- soft, warm sublime. Things started to build with the roasted carrots; the flavor was hard to describe- earthy, sweet, amazing. Octopus was the best I have ever had- WOW- tender and divine in a creamy puree, an inspired combination of flavors. THEN- handmade pappardelle in a braised short rib ragu- this may have been my favorite. If you like the combination of beef and pasta, from a flavor and texture standpoint, as I do, this was nirvana. The steak may have been a special- porterhouse or T-bone- cooked medium rare to perfection, served with a chimichurri- I am salivating as I think about it!  We also had the blood sausage, another delicious plate. My intense dislike of Yelp and it's corrupt business model has caused me to pick and choose very carefully which restaurants I choose to review, but Chef Fernando Navas has created something special and the world needs to know! Enjoy!

Dinner review: Just moved to Sunnyside, thought we'd give the highest rated restaurant in Sunnyside a try. I was dissapointed. Ordered hanger steak, scallops, and korean bbq wraps for 2 people. Portions are small with Manhattan prices. Air of pretentiousness with the ambiance. Feels like they are just trying too hard to be Manhattan Chic. I'm not a big fan of paying for ambiance, and I felt like thats what I did. Plating was pretty, which I never care about with my food. Not my cup of tea, when I'm in Queens, I want great soul touching food, big portion, at a good price. Of the things we ordered though, Hanger Steak was pretty good, but then again it is a small piece of steak at 21 bucks, and I was starving.

I went Bengal Tiger tonight with my family, after seeing all these great reviews..it was a total disappointment.I have gone to many Indian restaurant in Philadelphia, and New York, and clearly this was not four and  a half stars.The food all taste the same.it was overpriced and the malai kofta which is my favorite dish at Indian-restaurant, was the worst I have ever had. It was hard cheeseballs immersed in yellow curry sauce.I basically finished my meal with some curry sauce, rice with some naan.The chola's were too spicy and too few also in spicy curry, and the spinach with paneer was alsoThe same hard cheese, that made the Michael stuff mixed in some little bit of spinach. Basically all The food all tasted  the same and was overly spicy.The service was nice. The guy was pleasant. The stairs to the restaurant were awful. However the restaurant itself was kind of cozy.
Great soup dirt cheap. I had the oxtail hand drawn noodles my brother had the duck. It's like half a duck in a bowl of soup for 6 bucks. Also try their smoothies!

The worst Thai food I ever had. Lamed curry, could't tell the different if it red or green or Panang.. or else, because it was just coconut milk with a tiny hint of chili paste (even I already asked for extra spicy). Stir fried vegetable was so so.. ;(. I can make it better. Service was ok... the waitress kind of rush, nothing special. Very disappointed.... will never go back again.

awesome restaurant! intresting blend of flavors! reccomend everybody to come! casual and good for kids. i reccomend the lamb shank and the filet mignon. the  food comes out quickly and the escargot and octupus salad is divine! desserts are delicious!

I just love The Jolly Goat - everything about it makes me happy, from the silky Latte (best I've ever had) to the exquisite baked goods (if you're gluten-free, try the apple cheddar scone), to the smiling faces behind the counter (the owner is a doll).  In NYC with my daughter for our birthdays, came here the first morning and became instant fans.  Since most folks take their coffees to go, we were lucky enough to get seats in this cozy and charming spot every time.  If I was a glass-half-empty kind of girl, I'd say I'm now ruined for LA coffee shops, but I'm not, so I'll simply look forward to getting back to New York City and The Jolly Goat - I will miss you sweet friend!
One of the best pizza places around. Great choice for anyone looking for real traditional great pizza taste.

I came with my parents about an hour after they opened, it was empty, so the staff was very attentive. The specials are written and shown on a blackboard with the actual prices, no surprises will be seen on the bill. The platter of meats was great and large in quantity for its price compared to most places. The pasta presentation in a pan is different and the homemade quality of the pasta is great. Lastly, the tiramisu was small but great too.

I frequent the Redstone Tavern for dinner approximately twice per month.    The staff is always extremely helpful and friendly.    They have a great selection of reasonably priced items on the menu and I have always liked whatever I have chosen. I recommend the Red Stone to my friends and coworkers.   - Delia / Wayne NJ

I visited this place today and it was a very pleasant experience.  The customer service was great. I ordered the liver cleansing juice and PB&J smoothie - they were both delicious. I highly recommend this café to fellow vegetarians and people who love high quality juices.
Ahhhhhmazing! Had it for the first time and fell in love. It's a small place and very crowded on game days though so call in your order about 45 minutes in advance.

I have been eating here at least twice a month for the last 6 months and this place never disappoints. The homemade pasta is the best in the area. Everything is fresh, the owner is always there and it shows, everything is spot on.
Had one of the best brunches ever here when my husband and I stumbled in by accident. I had a quiche with salad that was exactly what I wanted. Good Sunday place in old city.

First time at Franklin Steakhouse after hearing mixed reviews. We came early on a Friday evening with a group of 9 including 3 children aged 4, 2 and 1. Service was just about perfect, very attentive waitress, runners and bussing. The menu is pretty big with typical steakhouse/pub fare and a decent draft and bottle beer selection. Unfortunately my first 2 draft selections were unavailable but I settled on a Sierra Nevada Pale Ale. For apps for the table we ordered the Calamari Trio which was fantastic - hot and tasty, steamer clams (special) which were plump and fresh, also piping hot. The non-seafood eaters and kids enjoyed a standard mozz stick/potato skin/chicken finger sampler which was average at best. I ordered the full rack of BBQ ribs and truffle fries. The ribs were not the meatiest, but hot, fall-off-the-bone moist and in a tangy and sweet BBQ sauce. The truffle fries were rich, crispy and amazingly flavorful. My wife had the Franklin Steak Sandwich, and my brother had the Sizzling Steak platter - both were thoroughly enjoyed. We skipped dessert but enjoyed an after dinner drink. Overall, moderately priced, nice portions of hot and tasty food served by a very attentive staff in a not-too-crowded bar/pub atmosphere. Would go again and recommend to others.
Good music and good Chicken waaangs!

Love love love this place. Wine selection is awesome as well as the beer! Never had a bad cheese here either. Could sit at their bar and sip wine and eat cheese all day long. Then maybe get a nice chocolate dessert to end the day
They seated other people before us even though we were there first. The fish tacos were okay, but there was too much tomatoes. Overall, the experience wasn't worth the wait.

New, impressive fit-out with incredible views. Our server was very sweet, but overall these guys have a long way to go before summer. The salads were not impressive, drinks took 15+ mins and one main meal was entirely forgotten, despite the dish being specifically recommended by our server. As a local, I really hope the service improves!
Overpriced and extremely bad service.  Did not have any many options and only 2 small baskets of chips and blad salsa for 9 people.

I love Mario's La Mozza wine. The Deli has great mortadella.  Brought the family to the Seafood Reastaurant.  How can they mess up fried calamari?? Tasted like they used spoiled buttermilk. Will go to the wine shop if in the area. Tourist place Will go to authentic places from now on.
Probably my most favorite restaurant on the east coast. You have to plan in advance to get a seat here!
Great experience for the whole family. Great salmon roll sushi and spicy tuna also surprisingly good kimchi french fries, Washington square roll and other goodies.

Stopped in for an early dinner, and I doubt we'll be back. The food was so thoughtlessly prepared. The pappardelle seemed like it was left out on a warming table-it had a hardened layer of, well, something on the top and was tasteless-really visually unappetizing and super-bland. The crispy rice and salmon tartare is usually a favorite, but this, too, was flavorless and seemed like it was thrown together. During past visits, the food made up for the surly, bearded bartender-he's really talented, but he could.not.be.more.unfriendly. Now, though, I think we'll skip it altogether.

Beautiful vintage interior. Perfect place for brunch in the neighborhood. One of the best lamb burgers I have ever had. I think I tried most of the dishes and was never disappointed. Simple but good drink selection. Perfect neighborhood restaurant.

Parmesan sub was huge. Good value. Also had tuna salad. Very fresh veggies. Staff could have been more friendly. Took a long time for food even though we were the only ones there. But for the money was a good

I recently was christmas shopping and saw on the sign that they made Turkish Coffee. That is what first attracted me to go in this corner cafe. I was pleasantly surprised by the welcoming staff and authenticity of the baked goods. The owner is originally from Istanbul and I had a wonderful time speaking with him about the city over some hot Turkish coffee and delight. If you are looking for a quick cafe stop or somewhere to meet a friend, this is an awesome place to go!

This place was good years ago but its gone WAY downhill in the last couple years. Last couple times there the food was terrible. Last week I ordered a tuna melt that tasted - shall we say feculent? I sent it back and was surprised when the bill came that I was charged for it. I asked the manager about it and she said ""Sorry, I tasted it and it was fine. You need to pay for it..."" I can't recall ever being treated like that in a restaurant. \r\n\r\nOrder at your own risk, but they lost my business forever.

I used to frequent this bar often until I had a bad experience when I brought some friends. We were having a great time until the bartender gave us attitude and urged us to leave. They also refused to play hootie & the blowfish.

Do not eat sushi a lot but when I do I usually go to this place, only 5 minute drive from where I live and quick service! Pretty small place but never a problem with seating, I always enjoy the food when I get it from here XD Love anything with spicy mayo haha

I went there for Christmas lunch. I knew it would be unlikely that the "A team" would be working on Christmas Day so I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt. Things started slow when the hostess was too busy on the phone to mutter anything more than "just a minute" while extending her index finger in my face and stepping away on what appeared to be a personal call. Brushing that aside, we were eventually seated at a great table a and ordered a nice bottle of wine. Approximately five minutes later, the wrong bottle was brought to the table (same winery, different varietal). I explained the mistake and five minutes later, our server came to the table, wine list in hand, to double check.  I showed him the exact wine on the list. Five minutes after that, someone else came to the table and said that they didn't have that wine anymore. Fifteen minutes and no wine. Eventually we solved this riddle and we were able to have wine delivered to the table. Unfortunately, that did set the tone for the pace of things for the rest of the meal.  What was gauling was that the restaurant appeared to be fully staffed and servers and bussers were engaged in spirited conversations around the perimeter of the restaurant with complete disregard for the many tables that seemed to be looking around in vain hopes that food was wending its way to their tables. Food was hit and miss but I was so exasperated by the service that I am not sure I could even be objective. Suffice it to say we will NEVER go back, you should NEVER eat there and David Burke should have NEVER lent his name to this embarrassment of a restaurant. Epilogue: Open Table contacted me this morning to inquire why I no showed the restaurant yesterday. Seems the hostess was too busy on her call to correctly check off my reservation.
best goddamn authentic mex in this city! viva mulitas!!!!!!!!

The food is okay here. If you're lucky you'll come in on a good day and the food will be alright. The quality of the food isn't consistent. I started going to this restaurant every once in a while about three months ago. The quality of the food has steadily gone down since then. My favorite thing to get is the chicken shawarma sandwich. I got one this week and while i was eating it noticed the bread was really dry almost stale and i bit into some soft chewy pieces of chicken. I pulled out the pieces thinking it was fat, which i've never had on my sandwiches before. I looked closer and there were a lot of these pieces and they were pink in the middle. I certainly hope I don't get sick from this. I'm really disappointed in this place, because the food can be good but its like a 50/50 chance that it will be bad. The sauce that is put on the sandwich has also been watered down a whole lot. I hope this restaurant can turn things around but I doubt I'll be back. Overall I wouldn't recommend this place because they aren't always good and I'm disturbed by the quality of food from my last visit.

I am sorry thatI have to write such a negative review on this place.  I've been going to eat  at Roma's for the last twenty years.  Ever since they have expanded their location the service and customer has gone down hill.   Today was the last straw.  We went to Roma's for a family memorial dinner which reservations had been made for two weeks.  The bar tender had come to us  that Charlie the owner had tried  called but there was no phone number.. They were overbooked with private parties.

First off, I'm a Clifton resident of 28 years. This is my 3rd time going here in the past 2 years. Now I dunno what happened, I had 2 drinks and a burger. I never have issues when I have 2 drinks. This is y I think it's the burger. 2 hours after leaving I had a stomach ache. Got home about 10:30. By then I just wanted to go to bed. I ended up going to bed and tossed and turned for a bit hoping it would pass. Finally I was just about to fall asleep, then BOOM, I'm wide awake running to the bathroom. Yes I got sick. Very sick. I threw up a few times and then got diarrhea in the process. Finally I was done cleaned myself up then went back to bed. 1:30 am rolls along and boom round 2. I'm now finally back in bed its 1:45 am. I feel like shit and my stomach hurts. I almost wanted to go to the hospital before. I think the grande saloon kitchen is unsanitary and dangerous. It was the burger that got me sick.
Love this place although the crowd is mostly yuppies and hipsters their food is awesome! Plus this has to be one of the best places to have yourself a mojito!
The lasagna was tasty. The mint iced tea also had a lovely flavor.   Gigantic portions

Let me start by saying we were EXTREMELY EXTREMELY disappointed with the service we had at Trattoria Dell'Arte Christmas Eve.  We have been there several times before for special occasions.  Our waiter was extremely unattentive to us and when we did ask for things we would get extremely rude and obnoxious remarks like " yes sir, anything you want sir with a bad a attitude and bad tone in his voice.  Again very unhappy with the service and will not go back to this restaurant again. Unfortunately I need to rate with only 1 star otherwise I wouldn't give it any stars.

The food here is wonderful and it definitely tastes like primo ingredients were used. Scallops were humongous and cooked well. Liver toast is rich. Deviled eggs surprisingly good. Chowder makes soup seem not so boring anymore. Extremely long wait was not enjoyable though.

well its always the burger its always the table upstairs behind the curtain Its always the cool staff Its always the great drinks And its always ***** 5 stars Ken Friedman and April Bloomfield take a bow
This is my favorite lunch place in Princeton - The buffet lunch is cheap and extremely delicious. I love their paneers and the delicious naan. Yum!

We wanted Chinese food but the wait was way too long. After popping open the Yelp app we found this spot was right across the street. The food and the service were both great, with the wait staff constantly filling up our waters and checking in on us. We were put at the communal table in the middle and I will never understand how a restaurant expects you to sit on a stool without a seatback for an extended period and have a comfortable dinner, but we had a good crowd and so still had a good time. Definitely the best pad see ew I've ever had. My girlfriend had a fun twist on a classic dish - pad thai with the noodles made out of zucchini. Everything here felt very fresh and I would definitely recommend it to anyone in the area.
Overrated.   Tried their crab and pork dumplings with scallion pancake. Too salty and very greasy. :/

I had a fantastic time at parc. This is a large brasserie type restaurant right on Rittenhouse square. The chicken and French onion soup I can recommend. Great atmosphere and usually busy so make a reservation. In the summer months the outside seating is great and provides for some entertaining people watching
Delish!!!!! Best hummus in town.. Homemade by talented Israeli chef. Healthy too! Awesome juice bar  :)
Great food! especially the pulled chicken sandwiches! Excellent service too. Anytime I needed a napkin, fork or more water - a waitress was right there! Cant wait to go again

I drove from Wisconsin and I am very very satisfied with TT Skewer. The skewers are so tender and juicy that i can feel the lamb/beef melting in my mouth. Moreover, the lamb/beef is magically preprocessed so that the skewers are very tasty even deep inside the lamb/beef chops. Also, this place is ideal for meat lovers like me coz I can enjoy varieties of skewers with unbelievably low price. Another highlight in TT Skewer is hot pot bowl. I found tons of things that I can put in my hot pot. My favorite includes cabbage, fish ball, tofu and seaweed knots. In sum, I wish I could move to Philadelphia and come here whenever I want. One thing for sure, I'll be back!

A wonderful tasty surprise when I was visiting Phili Chinatown. I had lamb skewer, chicken wings, squid and pork sausage. Lamb was soooo soft and juicy. Wings were different than any grilled wings I had before. Tender, fully-flavored but not greasy at all. My favorite is the squid. Genuine northeastern China style. I also tasted the hot pot bowl, the other main dish they had there. There were around 30 types of contains to choose from. The base soup is newly brewed using veal bones every other day. The taste is just just amazing. Strongly recommend it to anyone who want to try something "new, special and tasty" in Chinatown.

There's a lot of Diner options in West Haven and the surrounding areas but they're all mediocre in comparison to Duchess. Been going there ever since I was 2 with my family and now I've converted all my friends from Elm Diner which has been down hill in the past 5 years. Breakfast is definitely the way to go at Duchess. Foods great people are great locations not so great

Mamouns how I love you and all your locations. It never fails that at the end of a night of boozing I fill my belly here. The food is cheap and amazing even when I'm sober. There shwarma is delicious and I love the fact that the pita is kept simple with lettuce tomatoes and white sauce! I love the falafels too mmmm

Unfortunately my review can't be about the food at Michael Angelo's. We made reservations the Sunday before for the coming Sat. night. When we got there we were advised there was no such reservation for us. Although there were a few open tables we were not offered one. We left promising not to go back. About 10 minutes later they tried to call us to come back b/c they did find the reservation. We missed the call & after trying a few other places we settled on the first place that would take us in. I'm posted w/1 star but not because I wanted to, can't post a review without it.

Ordered the Italian Wedding soup.  The menu pictured showed a large bowl of soup with lots of escarole, white beans and 8 meatballs.  They brought me a small covered ramekin with three meatballs and five white beans (I counted).  Total rip off.
Everything we had was absolutely delicious. We will definitely be back.

Stopped off here to grab a quick breakfast before my connection. Ordered the eggs with bacon and toast, along with an iced tea. I found the eggs and bacon to be cooked to my personal perfection and the tables are stocked with Dickinson's jam which was absolutely delicious with my toast. The prices were reasonable for an airport and the service was quick with no notable hiccups. I honestly can't wait until the next time I stop off at the Newark airport just to get a bite here again. My only ding against the place was that the front part seems pretty crammed, especially since most travelers are lugging large bags around with them.
Were there for the second time to enjoy their grilled octopus served in a tile, delicious! Also tried the portugese clams, delicious too. We'll return soon!

Omg!, I asked one of the waiters  who was older and had a pony tail to please take a picture of us ,  we were a table a four women, he said he would after we put our order  in ,  i asked him again shortly after and  ,he said after,   and then proceeded to say   if I wanted a different waiter to just ask for one. I couldn't believe it. Was that so bad to ask ?I just wanted one picture.  I'm a nice person I would  never  ask in a rude way.  I know so many spanish people that would have enjoyed this place ,  and i would have absolutely recommended this place. But why would I ,  I feel like I loved everything else but why would I come back. Never again, that was so rude , why would someone do that , for that reason alone I'm not coming back.  so thankyou but never again he made me feel really bad for a simple pic.

While the food is spectacular and one of the best I have had in the city, the staff is quite ride. The maitre-d is the worse, when you call to make a reservation he is temperamental and eager to get off the phone. He will cut you off before you are done and hang up. Definitely one of the rudest in the city.

A question was asked of the great Yankee, Joe DiMaggio quite some time ago. They asked him why he played so hard every day. He replied in essence that someone might be seeing me for the first time or the last time and he owed it them to be at his best. How does that relate to a restaurant? Well, when my wife and I attended Bleecker Kitchen & Co a few days before Christmas, it would have been nice if the restaurant would have heeded this advice.  Ordered the hangar steak, medium rare and it came out looking like 6 charcoal briquettes . Now, granted I would even give the benefit of the doubt if the restaurant were packed to the gills. There was one other person in the restaurant. One. Earlier in the meal, I asked if there was bread. "We don't have table bread, but I can have cut some up and bring it over" Translation- You are paying for the barest of essentials and even that is a chore.  I am neither a glutton or demanding patron but these two examples soured the evening. As we move on, my wife just needing some water had to see help staff in full teenage mode, furiously tapping away on their cell phones, perhaps candy crush, perhaps wishing a  long lost relative holiday cheer. Either way, not ideal. My wife's fish, again, overcooked which when you have two diners in the entire place, you think some extra care would have been taken. So as not to spew complete negativity, Bleecker Kitchen is ideally located, extremely cozy and overflowing with potential. If I can refer to my original thought, perhaps they mailed it in the week of Christmas.  new chef? not the prime time staff, etc. Whatever it might have been, it has to be acknowledged that when you leave that sort of taste is a patron's mouth, you have to wonder if this was an isolated issue or a pattern. That is for you to decide My advice -It is 2015 now, in a city full of countless restaurants. Put bread on the table. People eat bread, especially with wine. Making people pay for bread is like buying a car and finding out there is an extra charge for the steering wheel. It is bad enough they have ala carte. Just put the side item in with the meal and charge the added price. I don't want to build a meal. This combined with the no bread policy just screams "We are not bending at all, but you will." Waiter/waitress bus boys should not pace in front of patron's meals like an expectant vulture. I felt the need to scarf down my dinner in fear that a water shortage was imminent and the dishes had to be done. We were headed out for a nice night and that Bleecker Kitchen got us off on the wrong foot.

Tip: if you want a very good espresso drink, and the line is ridonculous at the corner starbucks, come here: and grab a pan au raisins while you're at it. I speak from experience (I work around the corner).

One of my favorite restaurants in NB! Delicious, consistent homemade Lebanese food. I always get the chicken kebab sandwich (the hummus is amazing!) and some rice pilaf. Food takes a little while to make but you can be sure it's always made fresh. I also really like their new location, it's much easier to get to!
The best Thai noodle in NY.

As much as I hate dealing with Brooklyn traffic, I would do it again. Had the large round with pepperoni it was a 10, I couldn't find anything wrong with it. This place is worthy of your hard earned $. Just Go.

I may never order another pie with red onions. For 4 dollars you get 2 cents of sliced onions. Mind you, we've been ordering pizza from this venerable place for years, but finally I think I've learned my lesson.

Delicious!!! I went there with my husband on two occasions and both times we had a great experience. Favorite dishes: pork belly, tuna tartar, strawberry ribs. Dishes are small but delicious. We ordered 7 dishes for two of us and it was more than enough. My favorite drink by far is Red Pearl.
Beer is cold and food is good but been here half a dozen times and never had more than average service and most cases below average!! Don't be in a hurry and bring your patience!!
Great montaditos!! My daughter loved the chocolate bread and the pepper who works there! I love " Elías TINTO DE VERANO

So this was my second time coming and how different it was than the first time!! I was extremely satisfied and more!!! The manager personally messaged me and gave our meal on the house next time we came because we were unsatisfied. Even that itself speaks volumes because they really want to keep the customers happy! As a disclaimer-- you can bring your own alcohol but they do not serve it. So please come prepared or just go dry! We got the BBQ+hot pot. We highly recommend the original and kimchee. The other soup flavors have cloves so if you bite into it, it may ruin your taste buds for a little. The meat was marinated great with tastiness! We had the beef and duck. Highly recommended. For hot pot-- we had a lot of seafood and beef with even more veggies. Our service was impeccable this time and I was happy. I didn't even show the free coupon until the end so they were so great. I would hope last time was a fluke. The only reason it wasn't a 5 is because of the alcohol which I know people can live without! We definitely spent a couple hours eating!!
This is respectably good indian fare, but with a higher than deserving prices.

After reading all the reviews, I wondered if our group had landed in the wrong restaurant...but no, it was Landmarc in TriBeCa.  This was our first visit and we tried it for lunch.  I want to start my review by saying that the service was friendly and attentive and this is where our experience took a turn for the worse. We shared a 'Fried Calamari' and ' Lamb Meatballs'  which arrived cold and lukewarm respectively, both however were nicely seasoned.  Main course breakdown as follows: Two of us had the 'linguine alle vongole' $24 - a huge mound of pasta swimming in oil surrounded by eight very small  clams (yes, no kidding only 8 clams) no seasoning whatsoever...not even a grain of salt. 'Landmarc Burger' again totally bland, not a pinch of salt, salad nicely dressed, and good french fries. "Boudin Noir" with spinach and dried up roasted potatoes, again, everything was bland and in need of copious use of the salt shaker. The salt shaker seemed to be the most popular item at the table as we all kept reaching out for it. I will again compliment a very observant staff, they removed our more than half full plates without asking if something was wrong or if we wanted to take something home...!  Total damage to our wallet was $186 (excluding tip).
They were really rude and disrespectful. Don't choose this restaurant, they use to be good but now they've changed to become a very disappointed restaurant.

Yamada sushi is amazing, I have been coming here for over 13 years and the food is wonderful! The fish is so fresh, and the service is great. Every time I try something different their food never ceases to amaze me. Their special rolls, chicken teriyaki and appetizers are excellent. I highly recommend coming here if you want fresh sushi.
Food is good but received unfriendly response from the attendant. May be she is not in Christmas mood. Do not suggest for new peole

Let's start with the atmosphere, it's the only thing this place has going for it.  Our service was horrible and the food even worse.  Three of us had lunch and split an appetizer.  The calamari came out under cooked.  Had to chase someone down to send it back.  Then came the main course the burger was very bland and the roll was a couple days old.  The crab cake sandwich had no crab flavor to it and the parm sandwich was just gross.  With so many other options in west Hartford this one is off the list of choices. Worst part of the meal is the server never checked back to see how things were.

Still Cheating patrons...Containers have gotten smaller since last review. The daughter of the owner waited on me. You could see air pockets on the side of the container. They do not believe in filling containers to its capacity. Therefore, you get cheated at your expense. Don't waste your time to go here. They are blatantly taking advantage by giving you less product than what you pay for.
Wonderful diner with delicious and vast options and generous portions, friendly service. Will be back!

Chicken was so dry it was next to impossible to cut it, let alone eat it. The amount of rice in the dish was little, as if child's portion. The waitress asked how's the food during my struggle eating the chicken, I told her honestly that it's dry. The old lady sitting next to me confirmed it, she was eating salad with chicken in it. The waitress asked do you want me to bring you some sause to make it easier to eat that chicken? I said can you ask the to cook this dish again but this time without overcooking? She said, "no, he's gonna cook it the same way, trust me you're not gonna like it", while taking that dish away from me. "This is what you tell your customers?", said I. It was my first time there. I was left with no choice but to get up and leave.

Asked waitress if I could plug my phone into the socket next to my table to charge it since I was at 9% after using it as my tour guide all day.  She kept making excuses.  Pizza was thin which was good but was too crunchy & got cold quickly.  Nothing special about this place.  Wanted to go to Lombardi's but had a line going out the door & on the street.  That place smelled really good.  Wish I waited!!!!
Excellent food, great service. Waiter Angelo is the best. My favorite Italian place by miles. High prices but worth it.
Very slow service...servers don't respond or treat u well...will never ever come again...its pathetic..wait for pizza is almost 3 hrs in the restaurant...

Long wait, but worth every minute, even though we had to rush to the airport. Neat atmosphere. Pork buns very tasty. Handmade noodles with the broth were full of flavor. Good sized portions. Sitting at the counter watching them work is fun.

i just moved to the neighborhood, and order take-out probably twice a week from Xiandu ......... I LOVE THIS PLACE OMG!!!!! Everything is so fresh and SOOO delicious. the staff is very nice and very accommodating (i have food allergies so it means a lot not to get an eye roll haha...) it's about time center city had a great thai restaurant :)

A good bar and grill located right in Midtown, off of the main avenues with a tight menu that hits the spot in so many ways. I recommend the sliders and the Mac and cheese...as well as the NY strip steak. I've been here before and would come here again.
NYC meal with NJ price! Definitely go for the tasting menu, which changes seasonally and you can't go wrong. The chef/staff/sommelier gets a 5 star; wine selection 3 thus for the 4 star review.
Dessert is much better then the dinner food. I would like to try all the desserts here.

We booked for Christmas dinner this year quite a while ago, to make sure we got a table. We got our table on time, although the greeters at the desk looked like they'd rather be elsewhere.  We waited a good 10 mins at the table before we were given a menu by the drinks waitress who explained that our main server was "really busy" with the huge table behind us. We ordered a spaghetti bolognese and a veal parm. The portions are huge but for $40 I would have expected the veal to be served on a bed of spaghetti to be honest. There were just 2 admittedly large, portions of veal. The spaghetti bolognese was plentiful, but overdone with the herbs and a little watery. Both our servers obviously finished their shifts during our meal, as we never saw them again.  We ordered dessert with our "new" server and literally waited a full 30 mins for it- looks like the kitchen shift changed as well?  Not impressive service Carmine's. Overall, the food isn't bad but certainly not great, but the service was the lowlight of the visit for us. Wouldn't rush back.
The burger with duck fat fries.  Jesus lord it's to die for. Hands down best burger I've ever had
Good food, friendly service.

A small, crowded restaurant with horrific waits. Food is phenomenal: meat and cheese plate may be the best anywhere. Beef carpaccio is rich, coq au vin is hearty, seasonal veggies are fresh and deliciously prepared. Dishes are small and shareable. Wine list is varied and interesting. Service is pleasant.

Food was excellent here. Some of the best pizza I've ever had. Why I give it 2 stars you might ask.... SERVICE! It was absolutely terrible waiter never came to the table needed a refill and that never happen. Then it took us 30 mins just to get our check. There is a lot lacking. It might have been around for a while but couldn't tell throw the service.

12/26/14   So disappointed!  went there with a nice bottle of wine tonight thinking of having a nice dinner and relax,,  NOT!    we got there at 7:30, placed our order around 7:40,   ordered appi and dinner,,  asked the waitress to take her time with the order,,  she said no problem,,  how about we had our appi and dinners all done by 8:20!  Appi came by 7:50,,  as soon as we were done the dinner came out by 8:05,,  I said to her I thought I asked you to take your time and we didn't want to be rushed,,  her answer was I thought you didn't want all the food at once?  REALLY?   didn't relax! and felt rushed,, I ordered the eggplant ,  it was the worst I ever had,,  it was dry and cakeie,,     my husband had the veal parm,, said it was ok,, I've been here a few times and thought food was pretty good til tonight,, waitress was inexperienced,,  rushed us and I didn't like spending 60 bucks in 45 min on not so great food,,   guess I wont be going back,,, Donna F

I'm here on my 27th birthday and the food is out of this world!  I think ET made it lol. The customer service is very good and the different types of meat they bring out is good as well! It's worth the $52.50.

Just paid 12 dollars here and I would have rather gone to a Ruby Tuesday's,  the food was so bad. I got a tasteless turkey burger that was dry, sweet potato wedges that were burnt, and the restaurant was desolate (barely occupied) and yet the wait was terribly long. Simply put, the food is not good here, and the only reason this restaurant survives is its location and ambiance ... This is food that, had I not paid for it, I wouldn't eat.
Absolutely the best pizza in the island.  I've been a loyal customer for many many years.  Wish they delivered!
We waited for more then 3 hours and still didn't get a table the waitress are terrible too

Our office had our company lunch catered from this place and it was amazing! Everything was really good and super fresh. The best part of it all, HANDS DOWN, was the rib eye and the mac n' cheese! The rib eye was so tender and full of flavor. The baked Mac n' Cheese was perfect with the right amount of cheese and bread crumb, not too overwhelming. It was definitely worth the order and it wont be the last time!
I get the BBQ chicken every time. Friendly staff, very casual fast food look and feel but the food is excellent.
Went on the 2nd night of their pop up shop in LIC and it was fantastic. The broth has incredible depth with a slight muskiness to it. Delicious! Buns are to die for...

This is amazing. I had the mixed gyro and chicken over rice, that was amazing with the white sauce, yum! However, I do think they need to friendly remind customers that the hot sauce is really spicy. I had a bite and I was crying. It was soooooooooo spicy! But the food was really good, you can see a long queue from distance but it was quick and fast.

A visitor might not go to all the effort to find this place, but that's what I like to do when visiting a new city. Eat where the locals eat. So many choices, I am sorry I could only enjoy one meal. We were able to walk there from our hotel. They only take cash, but there is an ATM at the entrance. Keeps the prices down. So worth the hunt. Needed to walk back to hotel as I ate enough for two. I read a review where the person said the noodles seemed to multiple as she ate. I totally agree! Very clean and brightly lit.

So we have been wanting to try the classic roast pork sandwich (with broccoli rabbe and provolone) ever since it won the title of The Best Sandwich in America, and it did not disappoint!!!! It was amazing!!!! I highly recommend it!!!!

Reservation doesn't work.  After making a reseravation a week prior, they made my grand parents and young kids stood outside in the cold for an hour.  Screwed up our drink order like 5 times.  (we tried to communicate in mando, canto, english, they still screwed up).   Finally food came, but they ran out of pots... so some of us had no pot to cook.  They gave us free tea to compensate for that.. wow thank you.  bill came out to $400+.. we gave $50 tip.. waited asked for more, because we were $4.55? shy of 15%... seriously?  food is not nearly as good as it used to.  some of the veget had soil/dirt on it.. make sure you look before you cook it.. table of 10, 4 of us had diarrhea.. worth the time, money, and pain.  never again.

I went to this buffet today with high hopes. Here are some things I am not satisfied with: 1. They did not have a variety of fruits. 2. The cheesecake had more cake than cheese. 3. They did not have a lot of food for the grill section. 4. Their service wasn't the best. However, I am glad to have tried this resturant----I won't be coming back. They had a nice Christmas tree though!

Ordered the chicken noodle soup when i was sick. They put the noodles in with the broth so by the time I got home there was no broth. The noodles sucked up all the liquid. This is why take out places always put the noodles on the side! It was inedible. I called back and the man told me I could order it again sometime and it would be on the house. I thought to myself ok good but that doesn't help me now. Months have gone by and I ordered the soup again. Picked it up, no cilantro, no lime, no sauce. Noodles were separate this to!e because I specifically asked. I called again to ask where was the rest of the stuff that comes with the soup? The woman was rude rude rude! I said I wouldn't be order ng again and she that's fine and hung up! Terrible customer service. No respect for their customers. The food is good but they don't know how to run a restaurant or how to take care of their customers. Not to mention its the day after Christmas. I've never been treated so poorly before. Do not go here ever!!!!? Zero stars for their attitude and unwillingness to right their wrongs!
Tried a couple of coffees here after reading all the 5 star reviews but was severely disappointed.

Awesome ! Can't believe we found an authentic Puerto Rican restaurant. El trifongo was delicious, as was the churrasco.  Prices were very reasonable. And the service was superb from the moment we walked in.

We had a reservation for my cousin's 30th birthday the day after Xmas.  We confirmed the reservation beforehand...showed up and they were closed!!!  It looked like they were closed for repairs, possibly for the holdiays.  Regardless, who does that without informing the people that have reservations?!?  It's the most unprofessional thing I have ever seen out of a restaurant.  We ended up going to Stella, who were gracious enough to accommodate 10 people on short notice.  They said they had a party come in the week before that faced the same predicament.   Zero stars - bunch of amateurs.

After reading many of the reviews-- and having had scores of Geno's steaks over the years,  I think the trick is to courteously tell the order taker EXACTLY how you want your steak sandwich!   Yes,  the staff are true South Philly types, but despite their ATTITUDE [like some police], if you treat them with great respect- they will accommodate you and eventually actually be nice! I never could understand how anyone could prefer Pat's, across the street... As to their obnoxious, distasteful signs,  never could figure that out.    Always thought it might just be a way to gain attention and advertise themselves [which worked,  I understand when they first put their anti Spanish signs up,  business increased dramatically due to large TV local AND national coverage-- no other logical reason as it clearly must antagonize a lot of people... seems crazy but I guess if you are in tremendous demand you can be as obnoxious as you want. That said,  I've never had a Jim's or Tony Luke's, but the reviews seem to say they are better.   I'll try them and let you know.

While Amin A couldn't be more wrong, Geno's does not cut their steak up while Pats does. To all the bad reviews on here I say this..... Why is there a line here 24-7? They clearly do something right. BYW you're not food critics... Don't forget that.
Good Peruvian spot. We shared the Matador(more than enough for 2). Try the Cristal beer it's light & smooth.
Amazing brunch and big portion too. Waited for r0 minutes but so worth it and there is a Morrocan cafe right in front so waiting was no problem at all

Fantastic food. I had the pancakes with berries and my son had the hash & scramble wrap. Both entrees were fresh and very filling. I could not finish the pancakes due to the large portion size (my son took care of that). Real maple syrup, of course, and cinnamon "butter". There are gluten-free options and a variety of baked goods. We'll definitely be back.

As a Newark resident I am always excited to hear about new restaurants opening, we heard about Alva Tavern and decided to give it a try.  From the staff, drinks, and food, everything was fantastic.  Our bartender was attentive but not overwhelming, every drink we ordered from the cocktail menu he took a lot of time preparing and you could tell they really cared about pouring a good drink.  We ordered the burger and lobster roll for dinner.  The burger was cooked perfectly and the fries were amazing, the lobster was good quality and was great as well.  The restaurant itself was really impressive and they did a great job preserving the old building that they occupy.  It seemed that they basically built the restaurant around the old bank vault that was there and you can still see the old vault door with the marble that surrounded it, the bartender said they make the pizzas in the vault now.  Overall it was a nice experience and I really hope this place picks up and does well.  We will definitely be back, tell your friends and go there!!
Great happy hour, good beer selection, food is decent - mussels and wings are very good. I've seen a few shows here and music wise it's a solid intimate venue

Rudest check in ever. Completely unwelcoming. Refused to honor a reservation because we were delayed a few minutes. The charm of a wet blanket.  We were treated as if they were doing us a favor by seating us.

The flatbread was soggy and I got food poisoning after eating at this place. There was a mouse that ran across the floor of the restaurant  and when I told the waitress she didn't seem surprised and told me that they have been trying to get that mouse for months!? Buy a mouse trap- it's not that hard! Stay away from this establishment!

In my book, Goodbye Fatness, Hello Gorgeous, I mention that I am looking for places that serve great food with "less guilt."  And this is the place!  I lost 125 pounds and I do not wish to gain it back.  This is a place that allows me to enjoy a lower calorie/fat dining experience.  Nothing is swimming in butter or rich sauces, yet the dishes are tasty. I had a sesame salmon salad.  It was a generous piece of salmon and the salad had the perfect amount of dressing.  I tried some of my son's burger and it was moist and delicious!  Desserts are served in shot glasses and are amazing.  It is just enough of a sweet treat instead of the big, fattening slab of cake.  The server was very nice and the dining experience was very enjoyable.  Will return again!
Great neighborhood spot, intimate setting, and great food, most especially their filet is unbelievable!

Use to be my go to pizza spot! The caprese is now $7 !! Last time I ordered it there was hardly any topping and it was melted on? That's new.. Maybe to disguise the fact that there wasn't enough topping? No Bueno
Best cheese steaks ever.. Fast  service Great area. Tons of  parking I swear by them

A friend of mine recommended I check this place out. I usually go to the lower lower side of Manhattan for good Indian food so I am now thankful to have found a good Indian restaurant so close to home. The food is good and consistent. Never had a disappointing dish. Pricing is fair for what you get. They also have a great lunch buffet for $9.95. My wife and I go to dinner here at least once a month. If you are a fan of Indian food give this place a try I don't think you will be disappointed.

This is my husband and mine's favorite restaurant! We love the garlic bread fondue as an app, they have nightly specials as well as rotating specials so there is always plenty to choose from. Monday's offer a great meatloaf sandwich and Tuesday's offer an amazing Mac and cheese that you will never finish in one sitting. Regardless if you get pasta, a meat dish, sandwich, or seafood you will not be disappointed. Great atmosphere and great staff!
It is alright. Good service and food. The place is kind of noissy sometimes. But overall it is good.

Went here on the day after Christmas for a mid-afternoon snack. In terms of aesthetic this place is top notch...service is SERIOUSLY lacking though. We ordered 18 oysters since they have such a wide selection and there are taste profiles for each oyster on a card on the table. Excited to try a variety we told the waiter to make a selection for us. We also ordered cocktails and a pretzel. It took a bit to get drinks and a bit longer to get the oysters. Our waiter came back with a ticket listing the pairs of oysters we had on the platter and we dug in. Oysters were great, shucked perfectly with good sauces. Unfortunately, there were only 14 of them...we had ordered 18. We actually didn't notice until the bill came and a variety we hadn't had was listed and then we recounted the ticket that came with the platter and there were only 14 on that. So ordered 18, served 14 and charged for 16. It was tough to get a hold of our waiter so we flagged down a manager who pushed back on us that we had eaten 16 but eventually they took it off the bill. We also never received the pretzel that was ordered at the same time as the oysters. We asked about it after a half hour and was told it was coming but it never materialized after an hour so we cut our losses and had them cancel it. I'll give this place another go after they've been open a little longer but whatever system they use to fire orders is having a communication breakdown. One really important thing to note is that there are only 4 stalls in the ladies room. Even on a light afternoon there was a line, I fear what the line will be like if this place is ever at capacity.

Very disappointing. We eat frequently in Burlington from Hen of the wood to Kens pizza, they missed the mark in a big way. I usually would give a newbie (not so much in this case since they run other shows in town) a second chance but not in this case

Horrible. Ordered from Xi'an through GrubHub and was told an hour wait on their website.  After and hour and 45 minutes, I get a phone call to come downstairs to my lobby to get the food. Are you kidding me? I paid $2.00 extra for delivery because I didn't want to leave my apartment. Two hours after ordering, I finally sit down, starving, ready to devour my food. It is soggy and disgusting. General Tso's chicken isn't that hard to screw up so I don't know what they did to it but it was awful. No heat, all sweet and just a soggy mess. Again, I was starving, and I still couldn't even eat this. I immediately ask GrubHub to return it. The restaurant tells me I can bring it back. Again, what part of delivery do you not understand? Clearly they understand nothing since they refused to come pick it up so in the trash it went along with my money. The next day GrubHub calls the restaurant to get a resolution and they ask if I still have the food so they can come pick it up and give me a $20 credit toward my next meal there. Yea, I kept your nasty food that you refused to pick up last night just in case I wanted to try to return it again the next day. And by the way, my food was $32.17, not $20. At any rate, I definitely don't want the credit since I'll never be eating at Xi'an again. They are beyond rude and the food is just awful. There are plenty of  good restaurants in Chinatown, Xi'an is not one of them.

I've eaten at many Italian and Italian fusion restaurants. None of them top Eataly. I had the beef tortellini in mushroom sauce and my friend had the gnocchi. Both were so delicious and the wine complemented the meal beautifully. Our waiter Anthony was so great. Super helpful in answering all of our questions and very attentive. I will definitely be coming back.

Well, we've given Grazer's three legitimate tries and won't be back.  The first time we went, it had just opened.  It was a nice night and the place was full.  The service was slow and poor - we waited an hour for food and had to get our own drinks.  But we chalked that up to inexperience and have since been trying to find a reason to like the restaurant.  However, each time we've been back, it's been the same experience regardless of how busy the place is.  Last night it was empty (just my family and two others).  The staff is untrained (host/hostess and waitstaff alike), the service is as painfully slow and poor as any I have ever experienced, the food is marginal and they run out of menu items seemingly all the time (yet the wait-staff doesn't tell you until you order it).   Two out of the three times we've eaten there, they've given me no choice but to leave NO tip - now that's pretty bad.   It's a shame - the location is perfect and they've done a great job with the theme and interior decor.  But at this rate, Grazers likely won't be around long and is a waste of prime commercial real estate.  Bring on a worthy Maple Tree tenant!

Comparable to any of the best steak places - at an amazing price.  Beautiful meat, perfectly cooked.  Great sides.  And an awesome little bar tacked on the side for a pre dinner drink.  Get there early - lines around the block

Bar and atmosphere is good, but food is not very Thai, too saucy and bland.  I had basil chili chicken, and there was no perceptible basil, but zuchini slices (yuk). If i go there again, i would ask them to prepare in traditional Thai manner, not Bayonne manner!
Andrea's is the best place of it's kind. I go there every time I come home and am always blown away!
Great place for sushi, appetizers are delicious the hamachi radish, snapper cucumber great for no rice sushi. Good for kids atmosphere was a little romantic.

Let me tell you all of the hideous things on tonight's visit: The waft of industrial strength bleach and bathroom cleaner which hits you in the face as soon as you walk in. How someone who works there hasn't noticed it is beyond me. Smells like a bathroom stall. The beer list where you order three beers off their "huge craft beer list" and they have none of them. When they do get your fourth choice, they charge you full price and when you get another of the two beers they have left, they don't give you a fresh glass to drink it in. The Mrs Ts style microwaved perogies they charge 5.99 for. Cardboard served Luke warm with warm glue-like mush inside. Appetizing. The undercooked tater-tots which taste like the oil they cook everything in and probably dates back to 2013. The fatty undercooked Ruben they have the gaul to charge $11 for. And this is a placed said to host a great St Patrick's Day party at??? Please!!! The ambiance of a strip club with the clientele and wait staff to match. I know it's Hamilton, but c'mon. No wonder we were the only folks in the dinning room after 9pm. Says a lot about the locals and what they like. Last time for me for sure.
Food was great and for being opened for a relatively  short period of time the place looks fantastic! Great service and atmosphere.

made us wait outside even though the dinning room was not crowded. Not sure if they use this method to show the place for potential customers outside. But Ill never go back or recommend it...The food is below average and I really do not care who used to eat in this place

My red snapper was dry. The waiter was over imposing and disappeared for a long period. The prices just  did not justify the overall quality of service. In summary overpriced food for average food quality. I was expecting better. Disappointed .
The Kerala food here is amazing. We drive over an hour to eat here and always worth it.
Awesome food, impeccable service and of course very expensive!
Love having brunch here! The eggs Benedict are delicious! The Bloody Mary is way too spicy for me, so I always get the mimosa. Love the French coffee.
The food was good with a reasonable price. They offer breakfast specials and other daily specials.
Over-hyped and expensive pizza

Had the crab puppies ( good) and the fried chicken ( not so good). My husband had the buffalo wings ( ok) and the rasta pasta (good but a bit to spicy). The server was nice but service was slow. Like others have already stated,  the music so loud we had to shout at each other. We'll try it again.
Hershel's Deli has the best Pastromi sandwiches and they treat you like a king

This is my second visit here and I think I could cheerfully spend a whole day here, aside from the crowds! What an amazing selection of wonderful food! We started with breakfast at Pearl's which even has real maple syrup. We stocked up on sausages, cheeses and baked goods and drooled over coffees, crepes and beautiful mountains of fresh produce. I love this place!
Always a stop for us when in Philly.   Wide variety of different types of food.  Have some time to spend and enjoy.
I would have given a higher score because I like their chinese dishes. I was.disappointed with their japanese dish the ingredients wasn't as fresh as I expected.

With a culturally and dietary-requirement diverse group, we wanted something that wouldn't be diner food yet appeal to the vegetarian, the chili-addict, the low-carb watcher and everything.  We were all on the verge of being totally hangry, and  Cabana did not disappoint.  It was amazing. Everyone loved their dishes, the flan was a great way to cap off the dinner, and the drinks were fab.  The portions are ample, and the service is efficient.  It's definitely a place that is good for many types of groups--even those with kiddos.  It would be ok for a date, but I'd say it wouldn't rank as a "romantic" place, but if the way to a man's heart is through his stomach, then he'll love Cabana!  :D

So glad I found this place! The Spotted Pig is an awesome place to spend your evening. They don't take reservations (which in some ways is nice, you don't have to plan far in advance to come here). The kitchen opens for dinner around 5 or 5:30, so that's when my group got there to put our names down for a table. We were seated by around 6:15 or so. In the meantime we enjoyed some drinks at their bar. The menu changes every day, so they really think through their menu. We had their chicken liver on toast, squid soup (more squid than soup), crispy pig ear salad, seared mackerel with sweet potato mash & house cured pancetta, grilled skirt steak with delicata squash, hazelnuts, and yogurt dressing, and wild striped bass with roasted cauliflower. They err on the "rare" side of medium-rare, just FYI. Our waitress let us know this beforehand, so we ordered the steak medium and it ended up being what we considered medium-rare. Everything was amazing, well-prepared, fresh, good service, etc. The Spotted pig is laid back, cozy, and very welcoming. I look forward to coming back again!

2nd night in the Big Apple and after a disappointing 1st night dinner we wanted to try the best they can offer in Chinatown.  Check yelp and this place have an outstanding review.  When we got there the wait is an hour.  And bec there were about 50 people waiting in line to get in, we decided to wait and give this place a try.  Xiao long bao or soup dumpling was our main purpose and this is our favorite food and boy oh boy what a big disappointment.    The taste is   bland.  Most of the customer have to share table with strangers which I don't mind if the food is worth it.  Hing Kee in Chinatown Chicago has better Xiao long bao or soup dumpling.  Their other food are ok and nothing special.  What makes their food taste better is bec of the MSG.  You'll know because an hour after eating you will be very thirsty even though you had already drank a lot of water.  Beware you've been warned.
A nice place for Chirstmas lunch! The place is a little dim. Food is in good taste and looks nice!
Great food and drinks, and very nice ambiance - especially in warmer weather when you can sit outside
Not bad, I went there a couple times. They are friendly and food is good. Recommended.

Love their pizza and antipasto. Best in town. Owner/employees are very nice. There are too many pizzerias in town to count, but this place is easily top 3 in Bayonne in terms of a standard non-artisan pizza. I recommend without hesitation.
One of my favorite restaurants in Philadelphia. Some dislike Steven Starr - not me I love him - overall this place may be his best. Best baguette in the city period.

Let me start by saying we have tried Butcher Bar at the LIC Flea as well as the Astoria Flea and we were blown away by the brisket so when a Groupon became available we jumped on it. The site suggests you call for reservations and when I called at 5:45pm and asked if I needed a reservation for 6:30 the girl who answered told me no. So, off we go and when we arrive at 6:30 I was asked if I made a reservation and I told her I was the person who called and you told me I didn't need one. She then tells me it will be a 15 to 20min wait. Wait, what?? Really?? I didn't want to ruin our date night so we went to the bar to have a drink and wait. The bar tender was really nice and we enjoyed our beers. So, 20min later we were seated. Moral of that story is don't listen to whoever answers the phone, just make a reservation to avoid starting your evening pissed off. So we sat, very excited to order our brisket. Our waitress came over, introduced herself and handed us our menus. She was super nice and during our entire meal very attentive. I ordered the Philly cheese brisket sandwich which was ok. The cheese sauce that was poured over the brisket really lacks in flavor but the sautéed onions were spot on. The bun was fresh and the cole slaw was amazing! The fresh pickle was another highlight and the side order of mashed potatoes we shared were really tasty. My wife leads a gluten free life so she ordered the beef brisket sandwich without the bun. The brisket was super dry! There were no juices oozing all over her plate like when we had it at both Flea's. It was very flavorful but dry as hay. Did I say it was dry...Dry, dry, dry...Like it had been sitting under a heat lamp at a catering hall dry. So, she put some coleslaw on top with each bite to cut the dryness. Dry I say, dry. So with the meal behind us we were asked if we would like the complimentary apple cake and we said sure. Now, as part of the Groupon it says the cake is part of the Groupon at $3.99 so it made me wonder is it complimentary for everyone or did our waitress just use the wrong word. Had she said "As part of the Groupon you get dessert as well and it's ___" Anyway, you get the point. The cake was ok but very small. If I had ordered it and it came to the table I probably would have sent it back for that price point. So, sad to say we will never go back to this restaurant because it didn't even come close to what we had at the Flea's. We will definitely look forward to next Summer when the Flea's reopen so we can have that awesome fresh brisket again oozing with juicy goodness.

I went there because it was featured in one if the travel channel shows. Definitely not the best Sicilian or pizza in Brooklyn. The service was terrible and the pizza was cold. We ordered a shrimp parmigiana and that was cold too... Money was totally wasted. Travel channel should do a little more research.

Been going to Scottos since 1976 and it has always been great. Went today and picked up a pepperoni pie, plain pie, and a chicken parmigiana roll as always it was absolutely great. Thank you for all the years of great food.
Have dined in and taken out many times, great service and excellent sushi. Also the Korean tacos are amazing!

For as long as I can remember, my family and I have been going to Bella Italia for Christmas Eve dinner. The food is always on point and the owner is always so nice. However, the past few years we had a nasty waitress. She's inconsiderate, inattentive and forgetful. While clearing the table, she hit me in my face and said nothing... She didn't even notice. I love Bella Italia, but some of the waitress could use a reality check instead of a paycheck
this is how I imagine heaven to be. a menu full of the most amazing dishes. and lobster galore.
Great slaw!  Awesome service.  Very friendly and good food.  Skip Molly's and come here instead.
Very friendly place with great food at a reasonable price.  Their buffalo wings are excellent as is the mac n' cheese.
I've been here at least 10 times and never had a bad experience. Some of the best Chinese food I've ever had. I would definitely recommend the pork chow fun and wonton soup.

My family and I choose this restaurant after reading the reviews.  We chose appetizers and entrees to share What a disappointment.   The appetizer portions were very small.....spread out over the plate in an artistic presentation, and expensive.  The chick pea fritters were good.....but tiny.  And they were out of sweet potatoes. How could that be when the restaurant was almost empty? The steak dinner was good with delicious sauce and so was the fish entree. The pork loin was very chewy and dry. We did not eat it. The chocolate dessert was yummy but had a weird presentation with small pieces scattered around the plate. The appearance of the restaurant was modern and attractive. Obviously our experience was different than other reviewers. I thought it was very expensive for what we got.
The meal was astonishing. The sushi just melts in my mouth. So stop reading this review and go to Sushi Yasuda for the best sushi you'll ever get. 5 stars out of 5 stars. This place is awesome.

The front of house here represents all that is snobby in the village. We knew going in that it was cash only. Got there at 7:15pm because we had a large party of 7 coming at 8. They took our name and said it would be about 30 minutes. Everyone arrived by 7:30, and our 7 party group reduced to 5. They told us then it would be another 30 mins, or 8pm. By 8:30 we were getting hangry. Went to check on status and the hostess was extremely rude. She said I told you an hour and look at all these people in front of you. I said this is my birthday dinner and you told us minutes and we're now going on 90. She shrugged. We left and will not be back.

This place is so good it made me want to join yelp. Tacos to die for and prices that are inexpensive. It is so much better than surrounding places that it should be a before and after to any natural history trip. Thanks.

The best pizza in Bayonne if you eat in restaurant. For some reason I feel it loses the taste when you have it delivered or takeout. When judging in terms of dining in, hands down the #1 pizza slice in town.
Very cool atmosphere but the drinks are only soso and you can say the same about the food. Overall the place is ok but a lot more glitz than actual substance.

I went there with family and kids at Xiao Long Bao for lunch, and we all love it. We have a mix of spicy and non-spicy dishes.  We ordered a few noodle soup and from their set lunch menu. Potion size of which is just right, with just rice and the dish plate, and nothing of the nonsense stuffs that I wouldn't even touch. We also order the Kung Fu Xiao Long Bao, and pan fried dumplings, to share. I'm quite impressed by the xiao long bao which is juicy in the inside, and the bao skin is thin yet strong enough to hold the juice/soup inside. Service is friendly and attentive. Prices are very reason, with set lunch menu under $10 ($7.95 per), and noodle soup, xiao long bao, and dumplings all under $13. We were in the neighborhood and just walk. Public transport (metro) is convenient enough, though I wouldn't drive into the area just for the meal. But if I'm in the vicinity, I would surely try it again.

Small and cosy place serves fresh food. Choice is simple-salads, sandwiches (who would have thought that turkey, brie, green apple and mustard belong that well together!), as well as pita and mac&cheese. OK, we were very hungry-but it was delicious. Very friendly service.

Ordered food from here a bunch of times in the past, but they screwed up my order so many times and charged me more than the menu stated.  Decided to give them another chance after 1yr or so, and same story. Quality is good but they consistently screw up take out orders.  Also, this is the 3rd time it has happened, they charged me more than the price on the menu, told me food prices went up.  For a $20 dinner, they would charge $22 or $23 saying, it is what it is.  That's a scummy move, would never give them my business again. Oh yeah, and they packaged my food in bag without putting the container lids on top and the sauce leaked all over my car.  I called to let them know, they said it is what it is.  As long as the food wasn't ruined, they don't care.

Coming from Brooklyn,  they bring back the delicious food s of my youth. Been there dozens of times. Sandwiches rule and the pasta is amazing. The bread is the best in the area. Catering is tremendous! !!!

Our meal at Narcissa was the worst experience of our New York stay. It was not only disappointing, it was also unpleasant. My partner and I are both vegan, and so tend to stick to vegan restaurants. Narcissa was chosen however by friends of ours for their small wedding dinner. Our friends had previously contacted the restaurant by email to ask if they could cater for vegan guests, and they were assured that this would be no problem. When we arrived however, it was a different story. The waiter was overtly offensive when we asked him what our vegan options were, initially huffing loudly, flicking his hair back, shrugging and stating there was nothing we could eat there. When our friends explained that they had been previously told there would be no problem, the waiter replied huffily 'Well you were misinformed'. He then went and spoke to the chef, returning to tell us we could choose from a mushroom risotto, the beetroot entrée (without horseradish cream) or the sea bass main (without the sea bass). The sea bass main was listed as coming with lentils and vegetables, which interested me. Having worked in high-end hospitality for many years, I knew that the usual practice if guests asked for an item to be omitted from a dish, was that they are provided with more of the other items, to ensure a full meal is received. I therefore ordered the 'veganised' sea bass, anticipating a bowl of lentils with vegetables. My partner selected the beetroot entrée as a main. In the meantime, we had finished the pre-dinner drinks we had brought from the bar, but were offered no further drinks. The single exception to this was that at one point a waiter (not the rude one allocated to our table) crept up behind my partner and whispered to her whether she would like another glass of wine, to which she answered 'yes'. He then crept away without offering further drinks to the rest of the table. She received her second glass of wine, but the rest of us were left with no drinks for the remainder of the evening. After a long wait (roughly 30-35 minutes), our meals arrived. My main amounted to four pieces of partially-cooked cauliflower and about a tablespoon of lentils. Nobody at the table was offered bread at any stage. The quality of the meals my partner and I had was pleasant, but insubstantial.
